Ingredient Names: turnip, onion, tomato, green chili, garlic, ghee, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: slice the onions thinly; chop the tomatoes; slit the green chilies; and peel and crush the garlic. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Peel and boil the turnips 20 minutes and mash. Step 3: Fry onion, garlic, tomato and green chili in ghee for 6 minutes. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add the mash and salt and cook 5 minutes. Step 5: Serve with makai roti. Step 6: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: turnip, onion, tomato, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, cumin seeds, garam masala, green chili, oil, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: chop the tomatoes; slit the green chilies; and wash and chop the fresh coriander. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Peel the turnips and cut into large cubes. Step 3: Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds for 30 seconds and fry chopped onion for 7-8 minutes until golden. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add ginger garlic paste, then tomato, red chili, turmeric, coriander powder and salt and bhuno for 6 minutes until oil separates. Keep stirring and scraping the bottom; add a tablespoon of water whenever the masala sticks. It is ready when the oil shines at the edges and the raw smell of the spices is gone. Step 5: Add the turnip and fry in the masala for 3 minutes. Step 6: Pour in 2 cups of water, cover and simmer for 30 minutes until soft and the gravy thickens. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 7: Add green chili, garam masala and fresh coriander and serve with roti or boiled rice. Step 8: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: turnip, onion, tomato, garlic, green chili, cumin seeds, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, oil, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: chop the tomatoes; slit the green chilies; and wash and chop the fresh coriander. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Peel the turnips and cut into large cubes. Step 3: Heat oil, add cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then sliced onion and chopped garlic and fry for 5 minutes until light golden. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add tomato, green chili, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder and salt and bhuno for 4-5 minutes until oil separates. Keep stirring and scraping the bottom; add a tablespoon of water whenever the masala sticks. It is ready when the oil shines at the edges and the raw smell of the spices is gone. Step 5: Add the turnip, mix well, cover and cook on low heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then; add a splash of water only if it sticks. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 6: Uncover and cook on medium heat for 3 more minutes to dry the masala. Step 7: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with roti or paratha. Step 8: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: capsicum, onion, tomato, garlic, green chili, cumin seeds, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, oil, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: chop the tomatoes; slit the green chilies; and wash and chop the fresh coriander. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Deseed the capsicum and cut into squares. Step 3: Heat oil, add cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then sliced onion and chopped garlic and fry for 5 minutes until light golden. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add tomato, green chili, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder and salt and bhuno for 4-5 minutes until oil separates. Keep stirring and scraping the bottom; add a tablespoon of water whenever the masala sticks. It is ready when the oil shines at the edges and the raw smell of the spices is gone. Step 5: Add the capsicum, mix well, cover and cook on low heat for 8 minutes, stirring now and then; add a splash of water only if it sticks. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 6: Uncover and cook on medium heat for 3 more minutes to dry the masala. Step 7: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with roti or paratha. Step 8: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: okra, onion, tomato, garlic, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, amchoor, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the okra and dry every piece completely with a cloth; cut off the tops and slice into 1-inch pieces. Step 2: Fry the okra in oil on medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until it is no longer slimy; remove. Step 3: In the same pan fry sliced onion and chopped garlic for 4 minutes. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add chopped tomato, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder and salt and cook 5 minutes until soft. Step 5: Add the fried okra and cook uncovered on medium heat for 8 minutes; covering it makes okra sticky. Step 6: Sprinkle amchoor, mix gently and serve with phulka. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: potato, yogurt, cumin seeds, curry leaves, green chili, turmeric, red chili powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil, peel and cube the potatoes. Step 2: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, curry leaves and slit green chilies. Step 3: Add turmeric and red chili powder, then lower the heat. Step 4: Add whisked yogurt and stir constantly for 3 minutes so it does not split. Step 5: Add the potatoes and salt and cook gently for 8 minutes. Step 6: Serve with phulka. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, tamarind, okra, potato, drumsticks, cluster beans, carrot, tomato, green chili, ginger, curry leaves, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, turmeric, red chili powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: chop the tomatoes; slit the green chilies; peel the ginger and chop or grate it finely; and peel the potatoes and keep them in water so they do not turn brown. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Roast gram flour in oil on low heat for 8-10 minutes until golden and fragrant. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 3: Add tomato, ginger, green chili and 5 cups water and whisk well; bring to boil. Step 4: Add vegetables and simmer for 25 minutes. Step 5: Add tamarind pulp, cook 5 minutes; temper with cumin, fenugreek and curry leaves. Pour the hot tarka over immediately so it sizzles, and cover for a minute to trap the aroma. Step 6: Serve with rice and aloo tuk. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: bitter gourd, onion, tomato, garlic, green chili, turmeric, red chili powder, fennel seeds, amchoor, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Scrape the karela skin lightly, cut into thin rounds and remove large seeds. Step 2: Rub with salt and rest for 30 minutes, then squeeze out the bitter water with your hands. Step 3: Fry the karela in oil for 8 minutes until crisp and dark green; remove. Step 4: In the same oil crackle fennel seeds, then fry sliced onion, garlic and green chili for 5 minutes. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 5: Add chopped tomato, turmeric and red chili powder and cook 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the fried karela and cook on low heat for 8 minutes, stirring gently. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 7: Finish with amchoor for a sour taste and serve with roti. Step 8: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: okra, kokum, onion, garlic, green chili, turmeric, red chili powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and fully dry the okra, then cut into pieces. Step 2: Soak 4 kokum pieces in a little warm water for 15 minutes. Step 3: Fry the okra in oil for 8 minutes until no longer slimy and keep aside. Step 4: In the same oil fry sliced onion, garlic and green chili for 4 minutes. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 5: Add turmeric, red chili powder, salt and the kokum with its water and cook 4 minutes. Step 6: Add the okra and cook uncovered for 6 minutes; the kokum gives a gentle sour taste. Step 7: Serve with phulka. Step 8: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, kokum, potato, okra, drumsticks, tomato, curry leaves, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: chop the tomatoes; and peel the potatoes and keep them in water so they do not turn brown. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Roast gram flour in oil until golden and fragrant. Step 3: Whisk in water until smooth. Step 4: Add potato, okra, drumsticks, tomato, kokum and salt. Step 5: Simmer 30 minutes, stirring. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 6: Temper with cumin, fenugreek and curry leaves and serve with rice. Pour the hot tarka over immediately so it sizzles, and cover for a minute to trap the aroma. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: drumstick pods, onion, tomato, garlic, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: chop the tomatoes. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Peel the tough strings off the drumstick pods and cut them into finger lengths. Step 3: Fry chopped onion and garlic in oil for 6 minutes. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add tomato, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder and salt and cook 8 minutes. Step 5: Add the drumsticks and 1.5 cups water, cover and cook 15 minutes until the inner pulp is soft. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 6: Serve with roti; eat by scraping the pulp with your teeth. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: moringa flowers, onion, tomato, garlic, green chili, cumin seeds, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: slice the onions thinly; chop the tomatoes; slit the green chilies; and peel and crush the garlic. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Wash the moringa flowers, boil 5 minutes and squeeze to remove bitterness. Step 3: Fry cumin, onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Add tomato, chili, turmeric, coriander powder and salt and bhuno 4 minutes. Keep stirring and scraping the bottom; add a tablespoon of water whenever the masala sticks. It is ready when the oil shines at the edges and the raw smell of the spices is gone. Step 5: Add the moringa flowers, cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes until tender and dry. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 6: Serve with roti. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: to medium sized potatoes, canola oil for cooking, dried red chilies, cumin seeds, crushed chili flakes, salt, washed and
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the potatoes, cut into large wedges and then dice those into 1/2 cm thick slices. If you prefer to cut them another way that is fine too. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat. A wider skillet will allow for quicker cooking but a small 7-8 inch one is fine too. Step 3: Add the cumin seeds and whole red chillies. When the cumin seeds crackle turn down the heat a little and add the chilli flakes. The oil will turn a lovely red. Step 4: Now in go the potatoes and salt, give it all a little whirl and let the potatoes cook for 20 minutes on low heat. Do not add water. Step 5: When the potatoes are done taste, adjust seasoning and then add the chopped dill. Gently stir and cover the pot. Turn the stove off, let sit for a few minutes then eat.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, gram flour, onion, turmeric, red chili powder, dried mint, ghee, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk yogurt with gram flour, turmeric and water. Step 2: Simmer 40 minutes, stirring, until smooth and thick. Check once or twice and stir gently so nothing catches at the bottom; add a little hot (not cold) water if it dries out before it is done. Step 3: Fry sliced onion in ghee until golden, add dried mint and red chili. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 4: Pour the tarka over the kadi and serve with rice. Pour the hot tarka over immediately so it sizzles, and cover for a minute to trap the aroma. Step 5: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Ingredient Names: oil, nigella seeds, cumin seeds, tomatoes, potatoes, salt, turmeric powder, red chili powder, chopped coriander, chopped mint
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot, heat up the oil and add the kalonji and cumin seeds. Allow these to fry for about a minute whilst stirring. Step 2: Add in the chopped tomatoes. Allow these to cook and break down nicely, stirring to help along the process. Cook your tomatoes down until they have broken down almost fully and the water has dried out. You should be able to see the oil separating from the tomatoes at this stage. Step 3: Add in all the remaining spices, the sliced potatoes and about 3/4 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for approximately 20 minutes, or until the potatoes have been cooked through. Step 4: Once cooked, turn off the heat and stir in the coriander and mint. Be careful not to break the potatoes as you stir - use a gentle hand.

Ingredient Names: fresh tomatoes, table salt, crushed red chili flakes, turmeric powder, red chili powder, onion, big cloves of garlic, vegetable oil, nigella seeds, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, red chilies, to
Instructions: Step 1: Add onion and garlic in a food processor until finely chopped. Remove and set aside. Step 2: Add tomatoes in the food processor and process till it becomes finely chopped (salsa consistency). DO NOT ADD WATER. Step 3: In a saucepan or small pot, add oil and place on the stove at medium heat. Step 4: Add the chopped onion and garlic, along with all the whole spices. Saute till the onions and garlic become slightly golden. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low, and add all the remaining spices and salt, saute for 1 to 2 mins. Step 6: Now put all chopped tomatoes in the pot and increase the flame back to medium high. Once you see the tomatoes have heated up, put the lid on and let the tomatoes cook for 10 to 15 mins. Step 7: Once all the water from the tomatoes has evaporated, cook for another 5 mins until you see oil separate on the sides. Step 8: Now add 1 cup water and cook for another 5 mins at medium to high flame or until you start seeing oil seperation again on the sides. Step 9: Serve warm or room temperature with rice or dishes of your choice.

Ingredient Names: potato, eggplant, okra, bitter gourd, capsicum, onion, tomato, chaat masala, red chili powder, cumin seeds, lemon, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: slice the onions thinly. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Cut the potato into wedges, the eggplant and karela into rounds (salt and squeeze the karela), and keep the okra whole. Step 3: On a large tawa, fry each vegetable separately in oil until cooked: potato 10 minutes, eggplant and karela 8 minutes, okra 7 minutes; push each to the side. Keep the tawa on medium heat; if it is too hot the outside burns before the inside cooks. Step 4: In the middle of the tawa fry cumin seeds, onion and capsicum for 3 minutes, then add chopped tomato, red chili and salt. Stir every minute so the onion colours evenly; golden brown gives sweetness, but burnt onion makes the whole dish bitter. Step 5: Mix all the vegetables together and toss for 5 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle chaat masala and squeeze lemon over; serve with BBQ or naan. Step 7: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil or ghee in a pan. Add in all the ingredients except the courgettes and fresh coriander. Fry everything over a medium to high heat, stirring often until the onions become translucent and limp. We're not aiming to brown the onions. This will take about 5 minutes. Step 2: A﻿dd the courgettes in and stir to combine. Cover with a lid and cook over a medium to low heat for 10 minutes, stirring once in between. Step 3: G﻿arnish with fresh coriander and serve!

Instructions: Step 1: Before you start, get everything ready: peel and crush the garlic. Measure out the spices so you can add them quickly. Step 2: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes, drain and toss with a little oil. Step 3: Julienne the cabbage, carrot and capsicum. Step 4: Stir fry garlic and the vegetables on high heat for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the noodles, soy sauce, chili sauce, vinegar, black pepper and salt and toss 2 minutes. Step 6: Finish with spring onion. Step 7: Taste and adjust salt, garnish with fresh coriander and serve with chapati or paratha. Step 8: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 1-2 days.

Dish Name: Acorn Squash Stuffed With Curried Meat
Ingredient Names: acorn squash, butter, yellow onion, tart apple, garlic, curry powder, ground lamb, cumin seed, cayenne pepper, salt, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cut acorn squash in half from stem to. Step 2: In a heavy, non-reactive skillet, melt the butter over medium heat Saut onion for 2-3 minutes Quick trick: use one of those handy green peeling / coring / slicing units that attach to the counter with suction You can find these at most stores for around$20if you dont have one, i recommend getting one They work really well, and save lots of time! Step 3: Core and slice the apple with the peeling arm wedged out of action. Step 4: Slice the spiral to form small, uniform dice. Step 5: Add the apple, garlic and curry powder to the skillet Saut, stirring, for about 3 more minutes, or until apple is beginning to soften and curry has become quite fragrant.

Dish Name: Anglo Indian Beef Or Lamb Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: beef sirloin, rice vinegar, salt, ground turmeric, russet potatoes, canola oil, yellow onion, fresh ginger, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: If using raw beef, freeze 20 minutes and slice paper-thin Rub the beef with the vinegar, 1 tsp salt and 1 / 2 tsp turmeric. Step 2: Bring the whole potatoes to a boil in slightly salted water to cover. Step 3: Boil for 5 minutes, then remove from heat and let sit in the hot water for 15 minutes The potatoes will be perfectly done Peel the potatoes and cut into 6 to 8 wedges each Coat with the remaining 1 / 4 tsp turmeric and 1 / 4 tsp salt. Step 4: Heat 3 tbl oil in a large wok and fry the onion and ginger until slightly softened. Step 5: Add the cayenne and the marinated beef. Step 6: Cook over high heat for 5 to 8 minutes or until tender.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, green chili pepper, prepared mustard, garam masala, salt, eggs, cilantro, dry methi leaves, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix beef with onion, garlic and chili. Step 2: Add mustard, garam masala, salt and eggs. Step 3: Mix until thouroughly blended and bound together. Step 4: Add the coriander and methi. Step 5: Mix just to combine. Step 6: Divide mixture in half and divide each half into 12 equal portions. Step 7: Shape into small patties. Step 8: Brush lightly with oil and grill about 2-3 minutes on each side or until browned and cooked through Alternately put a small amount of oil in a frying pan and cook until browned.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, soy sauce, serrano chilies, yellow onion, garlic cloves, salt, black pepper, turmeric powder, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Add soy sauce, serrano chilis, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, & turmeric powder in the blender or food processor Grind it up into a paste for about one minute. Step 2: Pour the paste in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: Add the ground beef to the paste and mix it in as thoroughly and evenly as possible The meat will take on a brown color from the paste mix. Step 4: Turn on the electric grill and let it heat up for about five minutes While it is heating, take the meat and roll out little sausages 1 lb of beef should make about one dozen little tikka sausages. Step 5: When the grill is preheated and ready, place the tikka sausages on it. Step 6: Let it cook on the grill for about 7 minutes or long enough for the tikka to cook completely.

Ingredient Names: ghee, onions, ginger-garlic paste, chopped tomatoes, ground paprika, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, ground cardamom, bay leaf, salt and pepper, onion, garlic cloves, red bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Balti sauce: Melt the ghee in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onions and garlic and ginger paste and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, until the onions are golden brown. Step 3: Stir in the tomatoes, then add the paprika, turmeric, cumin, coriander, red chili powder, cardamom, bay leaf, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Bring to a boil, stirring, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Let the sauce cool slightly, then remove the bay leaf and pour the mixture into a food processor or blender and process to a smooth sauce Beef: Wipe out the wok and return it to medium-high heat. Step 6: Add the ghee and melt. Step 7: Add the onion and garlic and stir-fry for 5-8 minutes, until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: beef steaks, oil, onions, garlic, green chili peppers, ginger, turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, chili powder, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Step 2: Add the onions and cook till they soften. Step 3: In a small bowl or coffee cup, combine the turmeric, cumin, coriander, and chilipowder. Step 4: Add these spices and the garlic, chilipeppers and ginger to the onions, and mix well. Step 5: Cook for another minute. Step 6: Add the cubed beef and cook until it is well browned and completed covered by the spice mixture. Step 7: Add the salt and the tomatoes. Step 8: Allow to cook at a slow simmer, covered, until the beef is cooked through and tender This make take 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours, depending on the tenderness of the original beef. Step 9: Add the coconut milk and stir well.

Ingredient Names: curry powder, salt and pepper, beef stew meat, coriander seeds, cumin seed, fenugreek seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, red chilies, bay leaves, sugar, cardamom, salt, olive oil, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef with curry, salt, pepper, rub well, cover and chill 2 hrs heat corinder seeds and next 6 spices in a hot skillet, cook 1 minute until fragrant. Step 2: Remove and place spices in a grinder, grind well, add cinnamon sugar and salt and set aside in a dutch oven, over high heat, add some olive oil and brown beef in batches, remove to a bowl reduce heat to medium add onions, and ginger, cook until softened add garlic, toasted spice mixture, paprika, stir well add beef, yogurt and remaining ingredients, bring to a boil cover, reduce to simmer and cook 1 1 / 2 hrs until done.

Ingredient Names: stew meat, flour, curry powder, kosher salt, vegetable oil, butter, chicken broth, onions, bell peppers, sweet potatoes, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the flour, salt and curry powder in a large ziptop bag. Step 2: Add the cubed stew meat to the ziptop bag and shake to coat the meat. Step 3: In a large skillet, heat 2 tb vegetable oil over medium heat. Step 4: Remove the meat from the bag and place it into the skillet Brown on all sides. Step 5: Turn the skillet off and move the browned meat to the crock pot. Step 6: Turn the heat on the skillet back to low, and add the remaining vegetable oil and butter. Step 7: Then dump the seasoned flour from the ziptop bag into the skillet. Step 8: Stir to keep the flour from burning. Step 9: Cook for 1 to 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Beef Curry With Spinach Palak Ghost
Ingredient Names: stewing beef, chicken broth, shallots, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, serrano pepper, cloves, black peppercorns, bay leaves, cardamom, salt, chili powder, cumin, turmeric, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Put cloves, peppercorns, bay leaves, and cardamom capsules in a metal tea filter. Step 2: Heat 3 tb oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the meat in 3 batches until browned. Step 3: Remove the meat and salt it. Step 4: Add another 3 tb oil in the pot and saut the onions, chile, garlic, and ginger until onions are translucent. Step 5: Add the meat and sprinkle with the chile powder, curcuma, garam masala, and cumin. Step 6: Stir well until all is coated with the powdered spices. Step 7: Add enough chicken broth until meat is covered, add the tea filter with the spices, cover and bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat and simmer for 90 minutes. Step 9: Remove spice filter, and add the heavy cream, let simmer for 30 minutes more, do not let it boil! Step 10: Adjust seasonings Clean and wash the spinach.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steaks, ground coriander, ground cumin, mustard seeds, black peppercorns, chili powder, ground turmeric, salt, garlic, fresh ginger, white vinegar, oil, onion, tomato paste, beef stock
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the excess fat and sinew from the meat, and cut it into 1 inch cubes / Place the coriander, cumin, mustard seeds, peppercorns, chilli powder, turmeric, slat, garlic and ginger in a small bowl, stir to combine. Step 2: Add the vinegar and mix to a smooth paste. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large pan. Step 4: Add the onion and cook over medium heat until just soft. Step 5: Add the spice paste and stir for 1 minute. Step 6: Add the meat and cook, stirring until it is coated with the spice paste. Step 7: Add the tomato paste and stock. Step 8: Simmer, covered for 1 hour 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender.

Ingredient Names: coriander, cumin, cloves, cinnamon sticks, black peppercorns, fenugreek seeds, fennel seed, dried chilies, garlic, onion, fresh ginger, white vinegar, chuck steaks, ghee, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Grind coriander, cumin, cloves, cinnamon, peppercorns, fenugreek and fennel to a fine powder Grind chilies with garlic, onion and ginger to make a paste. Step 2: Mix spice powder with vinegar. Step 3: Place meat in container and rub well with spice mixture. Step 4: Pour chili paste over meat and marinate for atleast 3 hours, or overnight Over high heat, heat ghee or butter in large heavy-bottom dutch oven and fry meat until deeply colored. Step 5: Add bay leaves and stock and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer about 1 1 / 2- 2 hours, or until meat is very tender. Step 7: Season to taste This is one of those dishes that taste better the next day so, if time permits, keep that in mind.

Ingredient Names: chuck steaks, fresh lemongrass, red chilies, onion, garlic, fresh ginger, vegetable oil, ground coriander, ground turmeric, ground cumin, cinnamon stick, curry leaves, brown sugar, coconut cream, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef into 3cm pieces Process lemongrass, chillies, onion, garlic and ginger until smooth. Step 2: Heat oil in pan, add extra onion and ground spices, cook, stirring, until onion is soft. Step 3: Add lemongrass mixture, cook, stirring until fragrant. Step 4: Stir in beef, cinnamon, torn curry leaves, sugar and coconut milk, simmer, covered, 1 hour. Step 5: Remove lid, simmer 1 1 / 2 hours or until beef is tender and mixture thick. Step 6: Discard cinnamon, stick in juice.

Ingredient Names: beef sirloin tip, yellow onion, diced tomatoes, plain nonfat yogurt, ground coriander, ground cumin, cayenne, ground turmeric, garam masala, garlic cloves, ginger, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 2 t of ghee. Step 2: Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric, cayenne, coriander and cumin and cook for about 1 minute Increase the heat to medium high and add the beef. Step 3: Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium and add the onion, continuing to cook and stirring frequently until the onions have softened, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and yogurt, stir well and bring mixture to slow boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer about 35-40 minutes, or until beef is very tender. Step 7: In a small separate pan, melt remaining ghee and combine with garam masala, stir well. Step 8: Pour over the beef mixture and stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, frozen peas, vegetable oil, cumin seed, bay leaf, onions, ground beef, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, ground black pepper, salt, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan bring some lightly salted water to boil for potatoes. Step 2: Add potatoes and frozen peas. Step 3: Cook until potatoes are tender about 15 minutes, drain, set aside. Step 4: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat Brown cumin seeds and bay leaf. Step 5: Add in onions and ground beef. Step 6: Saute until beef has all been browned and the onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add garlic, fresh ginger. Step 8: Season with black pepper, salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, cinnamon, cayenne pepper and cardamom.

Dish Name: Beef Short Ribs In Cinnamon Red Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: short rib of beef, grapeseed oil, ghee, onion, garlic, fresh tomato, red wine, vegetable stock, cumin seed, cinnamon bark, ground fenugreek, cumin powder, turmeric, ground cayenne pepper, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy saucepan with fitted lid, melt the ghee on medium to high heat. Step 2: Add the cooking oil and the cumin seeds. Step 3: Let the seeds sizzle for 30 seconds Smell the cinnamon bark before adding to the pot If it's very strong, break the bark in and only use half If it's not strong enough, add bark. Step 4: Add the onions& saut until the onions are medium brown in colour Smell for the cinnamon throughout the cooking process You should smell a mild cinnamon flavour instead of a strong one If cinnamon is the only spice you smell, take out the bark and continue cooking the curry.

Ingredient Names: stewing beef, cumin seed, dried red chilies, peppercorn, fenugreek seeds, green cardamom pods, black mustard seeds, salt, demerara sugar, white wine vinegar, oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together the cumin seeds, chillies, pepper corns, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, and cardamom seeds. Step 2: Add the salt, vinegar and sugar, to make a paste. Step 3: In a large pan heat half of the oil and fry the onions till golden, remove from the pan and drain. Step 4: Add the cooked onions to the spice mix and blend again to make a thick paste. Step 5: Heat the remaining oil and fry the meat till just brown. Step 6: Remove the meat with a slotted spoon and put aside To the pan add the ginger and garlic cook 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the ground coriander and turmeric, fry for 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the onions and spice paste and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 9: Add the water and meat cover the pot and cook till the meat is tender.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, chickpeas, vegetable oil, cumin seed, bay leaf, onions, ground beef, garlic, gingerroot, ground black pepper, salt, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a medium saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Stir in potatoes and peas. Step 3: Cook until potatoes are tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Drain, mash together and set aside. Step 5: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, heat the oil Brown cumin seeds and bay leaf. Step 6: Mix in onions and ground beef. Step 7: Cook until beef is evenly brown and onions are soft, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Mix in garlic and ginger root. Step 9: Season with black pepper, salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, cinnamon and cardamom.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin, vegetable oil, ginger paste, garlic paste, cumin powder, coriander powder, papaya paste, fresh ground pepper, red chili powder, ground star anise, ground mace, sea salt, yogurt, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onions until golden brown and soft then dry on a kitchen paper towel. Step 2: In a food processor or blender, grind the onions to a smooth paste. Step 3: In a mixing bowl, mix the beef strips with the onion paste, all the spices and the yoghurt And set aside overnight or about 8 hours in the refrigerator. Step 4: Take the marinated beef and mix in the papaya paste. Step 5: Let stand for about an hour. Step 6: Thread the beef strips into skewers and grill or broil in the oven for about 20 minutes Rotate the skewer and grill for another 20 minutes or till done Best served as wrapped in paratha with a twist of lemon juice, pinch of chopped onions and a pinch of chopped parsley.

Ingredient Names: plain low-fat yogurt, cornstarch, curry powder, honey mustard, top sirloin steak, cauliflower florets, beef broth, snow peas, fusilli, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 4 ingredients and pepper to taste in a small bowl. Step 2: Stir well with a whisk and set aside. Step 3: Heat a large oiled non-stick skillet over high heat. Step 4: Add meat and saute 3 minutes or until browned. Step 5: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 6: Add cauliflower and broth. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. Step 8: Return meat to skillet. Step 9: Stir in yogurt mixture. Step 10: Add snow peas and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: steaks, pepper, lemongrass, lemon thyme, lemon peel, ginger, peppercorns, butter, shallot, garlic, chili, garam masala, curry, juice, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Steaks: Remove the steaks from your refrigerator at least 1 hour before cooking. Step 2: Press a generous amount of white pepper into the surfaces of the steaks. Step 3: Cover To prepare the steamer, place the lemon grass and water in the bottom of the steamer with ginger and peppercorns. Step 4: Boil 1-2 minutes to release the oils and flavors of the aromatics. Step 5: When ready to cook the meat, salt the steaks and steam them over vigorously boiling liquid for 3 minutes only Curry butter: Blend all of the ingredients in a food processor until smooth Accompaniments and garnishes:.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, curry leaves, lean beef, garam masala, ground cumin, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, hot green chili pepper, salt, fresh lemon juice, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil to a large pan and set over medium-high heat. Step 2: When oil is hot, put in the ginger, garlic and curry leaves, stir. Step 3: When garlic just starts to brown, add the meat. Step 4: Stir one or twice and turn heat to medium low. Step 5: Add the garam masala, cumin, turmeric, cayenne pepper, green chili and salt, stir. Step 6: Add 3 / 4 cup water, cover pan and cook gently for 50 minutes before uncovering and boiling down the liquid. Step 7: Stir in lots of freshly ground black pepper and lemon juice.

Dish Name: Busy Mum's Beef And Vegetable Keema
Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, mild curry paste, cumin, beef mince, diced tomatoes, bay leaf, soy sauce, carrots, butternut pumpkin, celery, chickpeas, frozen corn, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the onion for 2 - 3 minutes, without browning. Step 2: Add the garlic, curry paste and cumin and stir-fry until fragrant. Step 3: Add the mince and stir-fry until the meat has a crumbly appearance and is no longer red. Step 4: Add the tomato, bay leaf, soy sauce, carrots, butternut, celery and chick peas. Step 5: Place the lid on the saucepan and simmer for about 20 minutes, until the carrots and butternut are soft. Step 6: Add the corn and peas and reheat to simmering point. Step 7: Remove from the heat. Step 8: Add salt and pepper and check the taste. Step 9: Add more if needed. Step 10: Serve on couscous or rice, topped with the fresh herbs.

Ingredient Names: beef, water, salt, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, ground black pepper, ground ginger, milk, onion, garlic clove, ghee, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the water with the 1 / 2 tsp salt, add the beef and simmer til it is tender. Step 2: Mix the spices together and add the milk to make a paste. Step 3: Melt the ghee and fry the onions and garlic til golden. Step 4: Add the spice paste and fry for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the meat and half of the water it was cooked inches bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes If the gravy is too thick add some more of the water. Step 6: Garnish with the chopped coriander. Step 7: Serve with boiled rice.

Ingredient Names: ground coriander, ground cumin, stewing beef, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, lemon, cinnamon sticks, white vinegar, salt, ground turmeric, coconut milk, ghee, coconut cream
Instructions: Step 1: Put the coriander and cumin into a dry frying pan and roast over low heat till dark brown in colour. Step 2: Add the meat and all of the other spices, coconut cream and meat, simmer till meat is tender. Step 3: Add the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes strain and keep the liquid, and set the meat on one side. Step 4: Melt the ghee in a pan and fry the cooked meat for three mins, add the reserved liquid to the pan, bring to the boil and add the salt and lemon juice Served with boiled rice.

Ingredient Names: chuck steak, onion, garlic cloves, curry paste, plum tomatoes, mango chutney, creamed coconut, small mushrooms, canola oil, beef stock cube, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Brown onions in frying pan using canola oil. Step 2: Add garlic and fry for further 3 minutes. Step 3: Add curry paste and fry off for 2 minutes. Step 4: Place mixture into crock pot Deglaze pan with boiling water and add to crock pot. Step 5: Add rest of ingredients except mushrooms and cook on high 2 hours and low for 6-8 hours depending on your crock. Step 6: Add mushrooms and check seasoning and cook on high for further 1 / 2 hour Skim off excess fat before serving.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, ground beef, tomato paste, red wine, worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, curry powder, turmeric, paprika, granny smith apples, salt and pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven or large skillet heat oil, add in the onions. Step 2: Saute for about 7-8 minutes or until soft, adding in the garlic and ginger the last 2 minutes of cooking. Step 3: Add in the ground beef and cook until browned. Step 4: Add in all remaining ingredients except the apples and water. Step 5: Stir with a wooden spoon. Step 6: Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes. Step 7: Add in the chopped apples and cook uncovered for another 25-30 minutes (or until apples are soft If the mixture is too thick add in some water. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Delightful Coconut Beef Curry With Chinese Snow Peas
Ingredient Names: flour, curry powder, chili powder, red pepper flakes, red cayenne pepper, vegetable oil, tri-tip steak, russet potatoes, green bell pepper, coconut milk, lipton onion soup mix, baby carrots, salt and pepper, snow peas, medium grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, mix flour, curry powder, chili powder, red pepper flakes and red pepper, add beef, toss to coat. Step 2: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add coated beef to skillet and brown all sides of meat, turning constantly, for about 5 minutes. Step 4: In a slow cooker, add coconut milk, potatoes, bell pepper and onion soup mix With a slotted spoon, transfer cooked beef to slow cooker. Step 5: Stir to mix thoroughly If you want the carrots to be very soft, add them at this time If you prefer crisper carrots, wait until 1 hour of cooking time remains and then add the carrots.

Ingredient Names: oil, stewing beef, onion, red chili peppers, red curry paste, coconut milk, beef broth, sweet potatoes, fish sauce, soy sauce, cashew nuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespooons of the oil in a large casserole dish and brown the beef on all sides. Step 2: Set aside, add 1 1 / 4 cups cold water to the dih and scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon Retain these juices. Step 3: Heat the remaining oil and cook the onion and chili peppers for 5 mins until soft. Step 4: Add the curry paste and turn up the heat for 2 mins or until the onion is going a light brown in colour. Step 5: Return the beef to the pan along with the beef juices, coconut milk and broth. Step 6: Cook, uncovered, over a very gentle heat for 1 1 / 2 hours so that it is barely simmering and the beef becomes tender If the coconut milk boils it will split so keep an eye on it. Step 7: Once the beef is quite tender, add the sweet potatoes and cook for 20 mins or until they are soft. Step 8: Season with the fish sauce and soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, vegetable oil, onions, cloves, garlic, cinnamon sticks, bay leaf, dry crushed red pepper, whole milk, tomatoes, chutney, fresh lemon juice, fresh ginger, curry powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in large pot until hot Working in batches, brown beef on all sides. Step 3: Drain and transfer to plate. Step 4: Heat remaining tablespoon oil in same pot over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add onions and saute until tender and golden brown. Step 6: Return beef to pot. Step 7: Add cloves, garlic, cinnamon sticks, bay leaf and dried red pepper, stir 1 minute. Step 8: Stir in milk, tomatoes, chutney, lemon juice, ginger, curry powder and salt.

Ingredient Names: beef, onion, oil, dried red chilies, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in the oil till golden brown. Step 2: Add the meat and brown them too and saute for around 10 mins. Step 3: Now add the salt and red chillies. Step 4: Keep sauteing and add a little water from time to time so that the meat does not burn but not too much. Step 5: Cook till meat is done and browned. Step 6: Serve with dal and rice and stuffed eggplant That was my combo of a meal last night Lovely!

Ingredient Names: cardamom pods, fennel seed, cloves, cinnamon sticks, fenugreek seeds, black peppercorns, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, oil, onions, garlic cloves, gingerroot, stewing beef, ground turmeric, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Remove seeds from cardamom pods and grind them in a spice grinder along with the fennel seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, fenugreek seeds, peppercorns, coriander and cumin seeds, set aside. Step 2: In a heavy skillet or dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onions, garlic and ginger, cook stirring frequently until lightly browned. Step 4: Add the meat and continue to cook until brown all over. Step 5: Add all the spices and cook for 1 minute. Step 6: Add creamed coconut and 1 cup of water, stir to combine Or stir in the coconut milk. Step 7: Cover and cook on low for 1 hour, stir If the sauce is too liquid, uncover, turn up heat to medium and cook for an additional 20 to 30 minutes or until meat is tender.

Ingredient Names: beef, turmeric powder, fresh lemon juice, ginger paste, garlic paste, cumin powder, garam masala powder, soya sauce, salt, oil, dried red chilies, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients mentioned under"marinade" together in a bowl and mix well. Step 2: Add beef and mix well to coat with everything. Step 3: Marinate for 10-12 hours in the refrigerator, heat oil in a pan. Step 4: Toss in the red chillies, allow to splutter and then add the chopped onion. Step 5: Stir-fry until golden brown. Step 6: Add the marinated beef pcs To it. Step 7: Cover and allow to cook till the water reduces to half. Step 8: Cut the beef into thin slices when it is hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, extra lean ground beef, onions, curry leaves, cardamoms, cloves, cinnamon stick, ginger-garlic paste, fenugreek leaves, tomatoes, turmeric powder, cayenne pepper, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a saucepan. Step 2: Add onions and saute till they start to turn a light golden colour. Step 3: Add curry leaves, cardamoms, cloves, cinnamon stick. Step 4: Stir and then add ginger garlic paste, methi. Step 5: When onions are a golden colour, add tomatoes and stir. Step 6: Keep heat at medium-high. Step 7: In a small bowl, add remaining spices with about 1 / 4 cup of water to form a soupy mixture. Step 8: Add this to the onion-tomato mixture in pan. Step 9: Let the spices cook for about 3 min. Step 10: Add meat and lower heat.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, oil, onions, garlic cloves, gingerroot, fresh green chilies, medium curry paste, ground coriander, mushrooms, stock, tomatoes, salt, creamed coconut, ground almonds, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cube beef into small bite size pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in saucepan and add beef. Step 3: Stir frequently when browned remove. Step 4: Add onion, garlic, ginger, chilies, curry and coriander to the pan cook 2 minute stir in mushroom, stock, salt and tomatoes. Step 5: Return beef to pan, cover and simmer until beef is tender about 1-1 1 / 2h. Step 6: Stir in chopped creamed coconut and ground almonds into the curry then cover the pan and cook gently 3 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile heat the remaining oil in a skillet add pepper, scallion, fry gently you will want them to be tender crisp. Step 8: Add cumin cook 1 minute. Step 9: Spoon over curry and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: stewing beef, onions, ginger, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato puree, beef stock, red lentil, ground turmeric, red chili peppers, garam masala, cumin seed, mustard seeds, oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the aromatics, spices, garlic, ginger and onions together. Step 2: Add beef and cook briefly on all sides. Step 3: Add rest ingredients except cilantro / coriander. Step 4: Bring to the boil in pressure cooker for 2 minutes on high and then on low for 20 minutes If using oven place in dutch oven for 2 1 / 2 hours or until beef is tender. Step 5: Add chopped coriander and stir through If too wet add more tomato paste - if too dry add more beef stock.

Ingredient Names: plain low-fat yogurt, cucumber, onion, fresh jalapeno pepper, of fresh mint, ground cumin, garlic, salt, lean ground beef
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce, in a small bowl stir together yogurt and cucumber. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 3: In a medium bowl, combine onion, jalapeno, mint, cumin, garlic and salt. Step 4: Add the ground beef and mix well For mix into 3 / 4 inch thick patties. Step 5: Grill patties over medium heat, for 14 to 18 minutes, turning once. Step 6: Serve sauce over patties.

Dish Name: Indian Beef Rissoles With Rogan Josh Gravy
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, spring onions, garlic cloves, minced beef, greek yogurt, garam masala, curry paste, salt, fresh ground pepper, plain flour, cooking spray, brown onion, cardamom pods, cinnamon, whole cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat ovento 180c fan forced. Step 2: Heat a little vegetable oil in a pan and gently saut spring onion and 2 minced garlic cloves until tender and then combine with the mince, yoghurt, garam masala, chilli paste, seasonings and 2 heaped tablespoon chopped coriander Form the mixture into 8 rissoles and flour each one and place on 1 - 2 lightly oiled baking trays and then cook the rissoles in the oven for about 15 minutes, turning after 7 minutes and then drain well While the rissoles are cooking, heat a little oil in a fry pan and saut the brown onion and 2 sliced garlic cloves until tender. Step 3: Add the curry paste with the cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and bay leaves and mix well and briefly cook to toast the spices And then add about 1 cup coconut cream with the tomatoes, 1 / 2 cup stock and seasonings and cook for about 5 minutes until reduced quite heavily, adding more coconut cream and / or stock as needed, taste for seasoning. Step 4: Arrange the rissoles on a large plate, spoon plenty of sauce over the top and sprinkle with the remaining coriander. Step 5: Serve with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: beef, potato, red onion, garlic cloves, ginger, green chilies, curry leaves, black pepper, fennel seed, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, red chili powder, turmeric powder, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the beef cubes with salt, pepper, 4 green chillies, garlic and half the quantity of chopped ginger for half an hour Pressure cook the meat till tender with 1 / 4 cup water. Step 2: Reduce the liquid till you get a thin film of gravy at the bottom of the cooker Separately, boil the potato cubes with a pinch of salt, drain and set aside Next, heat the oil in a pan and fry fennel seeds, cinnamon, cardamom, bay leaves and cloves for 30 seconds. Step 3: Then add the onion, remaining green chillies and ginger alongwith 6 curry leaves. Step 4: Saute till onion turns limp and translucent. Step 5: Add the cooked beef, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and potatoes, stir well. Step 6: Then reduce heat to low and add half cup coconut milk diluted in 3 / 4 cup water and salt.

Ingredient Names: ground lamb, eggs, ginger-garlic paste, jeera powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, chili powder, salt, garam masala, potatoes, seasoned dry bread crumb, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Place the ground meat in a pan and add to it the ginger garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric and salt and mix well. Step 2: Add cup of water and cook until the meat is done. Step 3: Let it cool and then place the ground meat in a blender / grinder and make a fine paste of it The paste should not be too liquid you should be able to make balls of the mixture. Step 4: Add an egg while grinding. Step 5: When done add salt to taste. Step 6: Now make 1-inch round balls from the dough and keep aside Also make 3" balls from the mashed potato mixture and keep aside. Step 7: Now flatten each potato ball into a flat disc. Step 8: Place a ground meatball in the centre and cover it with the mashed potato from the sides.

Ingredient Names: rib roast, ginger-garlic paste, vinegar, salt, vegetable oil, onions, chopped tomatoes, sugar, chili pepper flakes, dried red chilies, black peppercorns, cinnamon sticks, cinnamon, green chilies, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Wash meat, cut into thick slices or into 4-6 chunks Prick meat with a fork on all sides. Step 2: Using a mortar and pestle, grind the cinnamon stick, cloves, chili flakes, and dried red chilies, and pepper corns and put into a bowl To that bowl add cinnamon powder and turmeric, ginger-garlic paste. Step 3: Then grind the green chillies in mortar and pestle or chop very finely and add it to the bowl. Step 4: Add the vinegar, sugar and salt to the bowl and stir well Dredge the meat in the spice mixture and let it sit for two hours. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350f In an electric frying pan, heat oil and saute onions till tender. Step 6: Add meat with spices and brown for about 7-8 minutes turning once.

Dish Name: Indian Style Beef Curry With Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: filet of beef, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, salt, black pepper, worcestershire sauce, oil, onions, red bell peppers, curry powder, coconut milk, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the meat, onions and peppers. Step 2: Season the meat with the ginger, salt, pepper & worcestershire sauce. Step 3: Heat 1 / 3 of the oil in a large frying pan / wok over high heat, and saute 1 / 3 of the meat briefly til no longer pink Empty meat and juices into another bowl to keep warm. Step 4: Repeat with the rest of the meat. Step 5: Saute onion and peppers in a bit of oil just a few minutes. Step 6: Add curry powder and meat to the onion and peppers in the skillet, stir well. Step 7: Add coconut milk and heat til warm. Step 8: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: It's A Whole Meal Keema Curry Beef Potatoes And Veg
Ingredient Names: potatoes, oil, onions, chili peppers, garlic cloves, ground beef, ground turmeric, cinnamon, ground cumin, cardamom powder, ginger powder, chili powder, water, tomato paste, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl or coffee cup combine the turmeric, cinnamon, cumin, cardamom, ginger and chili powder. Step 2: In a large frying pan, saute onion, pepper and garlic in the oil until the onion softens. Step 3: Add the spice mix to the vegetable mixture in the frying pan and combine well. Step 4: Add the ground beef, stirring well and often to incorporate the spice mix with the beef and brown thoroughly. Step 5: Add the water and the tomato paste, again mixing well. Step 6: Cook this at a low to medium simmer until most of the water has cooked off. Step 7: Mix in the potatoes and the green beans, then the coconut milk. Step 8: Simmer till everything is heated through, and serve.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, sugar, parmesan cheese, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, italian seasoning, sirloin tip roast, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, egg, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 7 ingredients in medium sauce pan. Step 2: Allow to simmer approximately 15 minutes on med-high heat, then reduce to low to keep warm. Step 3: Slice roast into 1 / 8" slices. Step 4: Dip roast slices in egg, then in breadcrumbs seasoned with the parmesan. Step 5: Heat olive oil to 375 degrees in fry pan or deep fryer also works well. Step 6: Fry roast slices approximately 3-4 minutes for each side until golden brown. Step 7: Layer paper towel in serving dish along with fried slices of roast to provide proper drainage of olive oil. Step 8: Serve roast slice with sauce on the side for dipping.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, granny smith apple, curry powder, top sirloin steak, potato, frozen peas, currants, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp Vegetable oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and saute about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add apple and curry powder and saute three more minutes. Step 4: Add the steak and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in potatoes, peas, currants, lemon juice, salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, fresh ginger, curry powder, garlic, jalapeno pepper, salt, ground pepper, chicken broth, frozen baby peas, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add beef and cook, stirring until browned, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add next 7 ingredients. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring, until onions are translucent, 3 minutes. Step 5: Add broth and peas. Step 6: Cook until broth is reduced and peas are are hot 2 minutes. Step 7: Serve with rice and condiments: chutney, chopped peanuts chopped fresh cilantro and sour cream We keep minced ginger in a small container in the freezer compartment and make chicken broth from the bones whenever we have chicken and keep a bottle of chutney around just for this dish One small jalapeno is sufficient if not generous for the amount.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, crushed tomatoes, frozen peas, potato, cinnamon, turmeric, ginger, curry powder, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef in pan with onions until browned. Step 2: Add tomatoes, peas or corn, potatoes and spices along with salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 25 minutes or till potatoes are done. Step 4: Add water if it becomes too thick It should have the consistency of chili. Step 5: Serve over rice or couscous.

Ingredient Names: oil, green pepper, onion, salt, ground black pepper, ground cumin, garam masala, ground cinnamon, ground beef, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan and lightly fry the peppers for 1 min, remove them from the pan. Step 2: Fry the onions till golden, add the salt, pepper and all of the spices, stir and fry for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the meat to the pan and cook for 15 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the peppers and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Serve with the tomatoes as a garnish.

Ingredient Names: onions, lean beef, peas, fresh coriander, brown rice, green chili, garlic, thumb-sized ginger, turmeric, ground coriander, korma curry powder, fat-free yogurt, cucumbers, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz together the ingredients for the paste in a blender or food processor – add a splash of water if you need. Step 2: Cook the onion in a splash of water for about 5 mins until softened. Stir in the mince and cook for another 5 mins to brown. Add the paste, cook for 1 min, then pour in 100ml water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 mins. Add the peas then simmer for a further 5 mins. Step 3: Meanwhile, mix together the raita ingredients and season to taste. When the mince is cooked, season and stir through the fresh coriander. Serve with the raita and brown rice, if you like.

Ingredient Names: garlic, fresh ginger, chili powder, salt, beef tenderloin, tamarind paste, coconut oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red onions, green chilies, garam masala, ground coriander, ground turmeric, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the garlic, ginger, chili powder and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in a medium bowl Rub the mixture into the beef and let sit for at least 20 minutes. Step 2: Combine the tamarind concentrate with 3 tablespoons boiling water in a small bowl. Step 3: Stir until tamarind concentrate is dissolved, and set aside. Step 4: Put 2 tablespoons coconut oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Step 5: When the oil is hot, add the mustard seeds and curry leaves. Step 6: Let simmer for 1 minute, then add the onions and chilies, and cook until onions start to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the garam masala, ground coriander, ground turmeric, powdered black pepper and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt to the onions. Step 8: Cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, then reduce the heat to low and stir in the tamarind concentrate and yogurt. Step 9: Cook 3 to 5 minutes, or until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, lamb, kosher salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, ginger, ground turmeric, low sodium chicken broth, baby carrots, red potatoes, frozen pearl onions, unsweetened coconut milk, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Season meat with salt and pepper Working in 2 batches and adding remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil between batches, add meat and sear, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer meat to a plate. Step 4: Stir in garlic, chiles, and ginger and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 teaspoons pepper and turmeric. Step 6: Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add broth and reserved meat. Step 8: Bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of pot. Step 9: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover pot, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beef is tender, about 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, ginger, garlic, chilies, vegetable oil, lean ground beef, curry powder, curry paste, tomatoes, stock, salt, fresh ground pepper, frozen peas, steamed rice, coriander sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Place the onion, ginger, garlic, chillies and oil into a hot heavy based pan and cook over a moderate heat until the onion is cooked but not coloured. Step 2: Turn the heat to high and add the mince and over about 5 minutes break up the clumps and cook until the meat has taken on some colour. Step 3: Add the tomato sugo and stock and season well. Step 4: Drop the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until the liquid has reduced to a sauce consistency and then add the peas and cook for 3 minutes longer. Step 5: Serve with steamed rice and garnish with coriander sprigs / cilantro sprigs.

Ingredient Names: ghee, cumin seeds, onion, ginger-garlic paste, bay leaves, mild curry powder, tomatoes, ground coriander, chili powder, ground turmeric, sugar, salt, pepper, lean ground beef, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the ghee in a flameproof casserole or large skillet with a tight fitting lid. Step 2: Add the cumin seeds and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds, or until they start to crackle. Step 3: Stir in the onion, garlic and ginger paste, bay leaves and curry powder and continue to stir-fry until the fat separates. Step 4: Stir in the tomatoes and cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the coriander, chili powder, turmeric, sugar, salt and pepper and stir around for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the beef and cook for 5 minutes or until it is no longer pink, using a wooden spoon to break up the meat. Step 7: Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add the peas and continue simmering for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the peas are thawed and hot If there is too much liquid left in the casserole, increase the heat and let it bubble for a few minutes until it reduces. Step 9: Serve with rice, if desired.

Ingredient Names: minced beef, butter, onion, gingerroot, garlic cloves, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms, cloves, dried red chilies, coriander seed, white poppy seeds, sesame seeds, turmeric, cashew nuts, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt half of the butter in a pan and fry the onions, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes squeeze out as much of the cooking fat as possible and set the onions aside. Step 2: In a spice or coffee grinder grind together the cinnamon stick, cardamoms, cloves, red chillies and the coriander seeds. Step 3: Set aside Grind together the poppy, and sesame seeds. Step 4: Melt the remaining butter and fry the ground spices cook for 30 seconds and add the ground poppy seeds, fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the meat stir and fry till the mixture is dry 10 minutes stir. Step 6: Add the turmeric and salt with the cashews and water, bring to the boil, cover the pan and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes In the meantime, in a blender, liquidize the onions and ginger with the milk, blend till smooth.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, fresh cilantro, ginger paste, salt, curry powder, chilies, bread, diced tomatoes, garlic paste, basmati rice, biryani spice mix, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put onion, cilantro, ginger, kofta masala, salt, chilies, and bread slice in food processer. Step 2: Mix mixture with ground beef. Step 3: Make rice in rice cooker. Step 4: Make meat balls and fry in oil. Step 5: Set meat balls aside. Step 6: Fry onions until golden brown. Step 7: Add pilau masala, garlic paste, and ginger paste, add tomatoes. Step 8: Fry for 10 minutes Be careful not to burn.

Ingredient Names: minced beef, garlic cloves, ground ginger, onion, water, fresh green chile, fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves, salt, oil, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, chili powder, canned tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: To make the koftas. Step 2: In a pan place half of the meat with the ginger, garlic, and the water. Step 3: Cook over medium heat till the water has evaporated. Step 4: Remove from the heat and allow to cool To the cooled meat add the rest of the meat, chilli, coriander leaves, mint leaves and the salt. Step 5: In a blender blitz the meat till fine Form the mixture into walnut sized balls with your hands To make the curry sauce. Step 6: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the onions till soft. Step 7: Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, fresh parsley, egg, oil, ghee, salt, chili powder, ground black pepper, ground cumin, garam masala, paprika, turmeric, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender mix together the meat, half of the onions and half of the garlic with the parsley. Step 2: Add the egg and mix into the meat Form the meat into balls the size of a walnut. Step 3: Heat the oil in a deep pan and fry the meat balls till they are browned, remove from pan. Step 4: In a pan melt the ghee and fry the onions till golden. Step 5: Add all the spices and ginger, and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the meat balls and cook for 20 mins, stir them gently do not allow them to stick to the pot. Step 7: Add the yogurt stir and cook for 20 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, ginger, green chilies, oil, lamb ground meat, garam masala, turmeric, tomatoes, yogurt, peas, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the onion, garlic, ginger and chillies together in a food processor. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the mixture until it becomes very fragrant. Add the mince and fry until it begins to brown, stirring to break up any lumps. Step 2: Add the spices and fry for 1 min. Add the tomatoes and bring to a simmer, cook for 1 min, then stir in the yogurt, some salt and a good grind of black pepper. Add a splash of water if you need to, then cook the mixture for 30 mins. Add the frozen peas and cook for 5 mins, then stir in the coriander. Serve with Indian breads or poppadums, chutney and some more yogurt.

Ingredient Names: beef chuck, extra virgin olive oil, coconut milk, tomato paste, bay leaves, yellow onion, sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, garlic, beef bouillon cubes, chili powder, cayenne pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle beef with salt & pepper. Step 2: Make sure all sides are well seasoned. Step 3: In a dutch oven or big pot, heat extra virgin olive oil to where it starts to sheen. Step 4: Add beef to pot and brown on all sides. Step 5: Once meat is browned, do not drain grease, lower heat and add coconut milk and half a can of tomato paste Proceed to add the rest of the ingredients, except the onion If you don't like your food very spicey -- add the cinnamon or the cinnamon stick -- it will cut the heat down, also a teaspoon of sugar will make it even milder. Step 6: Simmer for 1 hour & 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Step 7: Add diced onion, continue to cook for 15 more minutes Done!

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, garlic clove, ginger, chili, garam masala, onions, curry paste, salt and pepper, sunflower oil, beef stock, crushed tomatoes, evaporated low-fat milk, lemon juice, frozen peas, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, garlic, ginger, chilli, garam masala, half the onion, and 1 tablespoon curry paste. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper, then form into walnut-sized balls. Step 3: Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, add kofta balls and cook in batches until lightly browned. Step 4: Transfer to a plate. Step 5: Add remaining onion to pan and cook over very low heat until soft and lightly golden. Step 6: Add remaining curry paste, stock and tomatoes and cook over medium heat, stirring for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add milk and lemon juice. Step 8: Return kofta to the pan and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Step 9: Add peas and cook for 2 minutes. Step 10: Serve with rice and garnish with coriander.

Ingredient Names: lean meat, oil, onion, cloves, green cardamom pods, green chilies, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, dried red chilies, curry powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt, stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onions, cloves and the cardamom for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the green chilies, dried chilies, ginger, and garlic cook for 3 minutes. Step 3: Mix the curry powder with a little oil to form a paste and add to the pan. Step 4: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the meat and cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the coriander, cumin, salt and stock' cover and simmer till meat is tender. Step 7: Serve with pomegranate rice. Step 8: Boil the rice, seed a pomegranate and stir the seeds into the rice.

Ingredient Names: meat, butter, onion, garam masala, chili powder, tomato puree, cardamoms, salt, lemon, potato, frozen peas, carrots, water
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a large pot and fry the meat to seal it. Step 2: Remove the meat from the pot and set aside. Step 3: Fry the onion with the garam masala and chili powder till the onion is golden. Step 4: Put the meat back in the pot with the tomato puree and the cardamoms. Step 5: Stir and cover the pot with a close fitting lid reduce the heat to low and cook for 30 minutes stirring from time to time If the curry looks too dry add a little water. Step 6: Add the vegetables, salt, lemon juice, and the water. Step 7: Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer till the meat and vegetables are tender. Step 8: Serve with plain boiled rice and a dish of dhal.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, vegetable oil, cayenne pepper, salt, ginger powder, garlic powder, black pepper, onions, tomatoes, curry leaves, cinnamon stick, cardamoms, cloves, ginger-garlic paste, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Spread the ground beef over a plate. Step 2: Add the spices as indicated to form the meatballs. Step 3: Mix thoroughly and shape into one inch balls, set aside. Step 4: In a saucepan, heat oil, fry onions till golden brown. Step 5: Add curry leaves, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon. Step 6: Add tomatoes and stir. Step 7: In a small bowl, combine remaining spices except the coconut, and mix with a bit of water to form a soupy mixture. Step 8: Add to onion-tomato mixture after the tomatoes have cooked down a bit. Step 9: Let spices cook for about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, lean stewing beef, ghee, yellow onions, garlic cloves, ginger, ground cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, turmeric, garam masala, green cardamom pods, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Bring coconut milk to a boil in a large heavy-bottomed pot and add beef cubes. Step 2: Cover and simmer over low heat for about 40 minutes, or until almost tender Lift out beef cubes and reserve in large bowl Skim off any visible oil in the coconut milk, then pour over beef to keep the meat moist Clean and dry the heavy-bottomed pot, place it back on the stove and heat ghee on medium-low. Step 3: Fry onion slices and garlic cloves until light golden, lift out and set aside. Step 4: Add all spices to remaining ghee in pan. Step 5: Fry over low heat for one minute, stirring carefully to avoid scorching. Step 6: Add beef cubes, reserving coconut liquid, and tomato paste, and fry until the mixture turns a rich brown colour, or about 8-10 minutes. Step 7: Stir in yogurt, add salt and fried onions, cover and simmer for 20 minutes to blend flavours.

Ingredient Names: onion, carrots, apple, dripping, flour, curry powder, beef stock, tomatoes, salt and pepper, cooked beef, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Fry vegetables & apple in drippings until soft & beginning to lose colour. Step 2: Stir in flour & curry and cook for 1 minute. Step 3: Add stock, tomatoes & seasoning. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover & simmer for about 1 1 / 2 hours, stirring occasionally Sieve or liquidize the soup & return to pot. Step 5: Add minced beef & rice. Step 6: Bring back to the boil for 2- 3 minutes, check the seasoning & serve.

Ingredient Names: beef, butter, onions, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom seed, red chili peppers, coriander seeds, water, fresh ginger, garlic clove, turmeric powder, hard-boiled egg
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter and brown the onions in it. Step 2: Put in the cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom. Step 3: Add chili peppers and coriander. Step 4: Add meat and cover pan. Step 5: Simmer for 20 min over low heat. Step 6: Add water, garlic, ginger and turmeric, cook 10 min more. Step 7: Serve over rice with grated hard boiled egg on top.

Dish Name: Pot Roast With Gravy Indian Style
Ingredient Names: beef, garlic, gingerroot, dried red chilies, peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon sticks, cumin seed, salt, water, onions, tomatoes, black pepper, tomato ketchup, tomato puree
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the beef with the ginger, garlic, red chillies, peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon, cumin seeds, salt and water in a pressure cooker for one whistle and then 45 minutes on slow, let cool. Step 2: Slice the roast into thickish slices or chunks. Step 3: Strain the liquid discarding the whole spices and other ingredients. Step 4: Squeeze out every drop so as not to miss out on any of the flavours. Step 5: Now heat oil in a pan. Step 6: Fry the onion till dark brown I hasten the process by adding a little sugar or 1 / 2 tsp soya sauce sometimes:0! Step 7: Add the pepper powder, as soon as you get the aroma of the pepper powder sauteing add the chopped tomato You can add a stock cube too at this stage but then you have to add less salt while cooking the meat.

Dish Name: Qaubuli Palau Yellow Rice With Carrots And Ground Beef
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, olive oil, onions, ground beef, salt, pepper, carrots, raisins, garam masala, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice several times in cold water until the water runs clear. Step 2: Add fresh water and leave the rice to soak for at least half an hour. Step 3: Preheat oven to 325. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan and add the onions. Step 5: Stir and cook until brown. Step 6: Remove the onions and set them aside. Step 7: Add ground beef to the hot oil Brown the meat. Step 8: Add one cup of water and salt and pepper to taste. Step 9: Bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover and simmer until the meat is tender.

Ingredient Names: mango, coconut water, mint pudina, ice cubes, watermelon, lemon juice, pepper powder, pineapple, honey, salt, water, sabja seeds, oranges
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a blender take 1 mango, 1 cup coconut water, few mint and few ice cubes. Step 2: Blend to smooth making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Further, pour the mango juice into a glass and enjoy with ice cubes. Step 4: Firstly, in a blender take 1½ cup watermelon. make sure there are no seeds. Step 5: Add ½ lemon juice, few mint, ¼ tsp pepper powder and few ice cubes. Step 6: Blend to smooth making sure everything is well combined. Step 7: Filter the juice to get rid of the pulp. Step 8: Further, pour the watermelon juice into a glass and enjoy with ice cubes. Step 9: Firstly, in a blender take 1½ cup pineapple, 1 tbsp honey and ¼ tsp pepper powder. Step 10: Further, add a few ice cubes. Step 11: Blend to smooth making sure everything is well combined. Step 12: Filter the juice to get rid of the pulp. Step 13: Further, pour the pineapple juice into a glass and enjoy with ice cubes. Step 14: Firstly, in a blender take 2 tbsp lemon juice, few mint, ¼ tsp pepper powder and ½ tsp salt. Step 15: Add 1½ cup water and few ice cubes. Step 16: Blend to smooth making sure everything is well combined. Step 17: In a tall glass take 2 tbsp soaked sabja seeds. Step 18: Finally, pour the pineapple juice into a glass and enjoy with ice cubes. Step 19: Firstly, in a blender take 1 orange, 1 cup coconut water and few ice cubes. Step 20: Blend to smooth making sure everything is well combined. Step 21: Filter the juice to get rid of the pulp. Step 22: Further, pour the orange juice into a glass and enjoy with ice cubes. Step 23: Firstly, in a blender take ½ cup pineapple, ½ cup watermelon, ½ cup mango. Step 24: Also, add 1 cup of water and few ice cubes. Step 25: Blend to smooth making sure everything is well combined. Step 26: Filter the juice to get rid of the pulp. Step 27: Further, pour the mocktail into a glass and enjoy with ice cubes.

Ingredient Names: ginger, pods cardamom, pepper, cinnamon, water, tea powder, sugar, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a mortar pestle take 1 inch ginger, 3 pods cardamom, 4 cloves, ½ tsp pepper, and ½ inch cinnamon. Step 2: Gently pound the pestle into the mortar to help masala release its flavors. Keep aside. Step 3: In a saucepan take 3 cup water and warm it on medium flame. Step 4: Once the water is hot enough, add prepared chai masala and boil for 3 minutes or until the flavors are infused in water. Step 5: Now add 3 tsp tea powder and boil for 2 minutes. Step 6: Once the tea flavors are infused in water, add 3 tsp sugar and boil until the sugar is melted. Step 7: Further, add 1 cup milk and get to a boil. Step 8: Just mix it and boil for 2 minutes for the aroma to be absorbed by the chai. Step 9: Finally, filter out the chai and serve Cutting Chai with biscuits.

Ingredient Names: khus khus poppy seeds, cashews, almonds, saunf fennel, pods cardamom, custard powder, milk, sugar, green food colour, sabja
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a small bowl take 2 tbsp khus khus, 2 tbsp cashew, 2 tbsp almonds, 1 tsp saunf and 2 pods cardamom. Step 2: Soak in water for 30 minutes or until the skin of the almonds separates. Step 3: Peel the skin of the almonds and transfer them to the mixer jar. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp custard powder and grind to smooth paste. keep aside. Step 5: In a large pan heat 1 litre milk. Step 6: Once the milk warms up, add prepared khus paste and mix well. Step 7: Continue to cook on low flame until the milk thickens and turns glossy. Step 8: Also, add ¼ cup sugar and ¼ tsp green food colour. Step 9: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Transfer to a large bowl and chill for 2 hours. Step 11: Also add 2 tbsp sabja and mix well. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Khus Sharbat Recipe topped with ice and nuts.

Ingredient Names: onions, chili, ginger, fresh coriander, rice flour, all-purpose flour, rava, sesame, peanuts, asafoetida, salt, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take 1 onion, 2 chilli, 1 inch ginger and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 2: Add 1 cup rice flour, 1 cup maida and ½ cup rava. Step 3: Also add 2 tbsp sesame, 2 tbsp roasted peanuts, pinch hing and 1 tsp salt. Step 4: Crumble and mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 5: Further, add 2 tbsp hot oil and mix. This helps the vada to turn crunchy. Step 6: Add water slowly and knead the dough. Step 7: Do not add more water as the dough needs to be tight. Step 8: Pinch a ball-sized dough, press and flatten it slightly thick. Step 9: Deep fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 10: Do not touch for 2 minutes as there are chances for the vada to break. Step 11: Stir occasionally and fry both sides until the vada turns golden brown. Step 12: Drain off to remove excess oil. Step 13: Finally, enjoy Maddur Vada Recipe with coconut chutney.
