Ingredient Names: sona masuri rice, methi fenugreek seeds, water, urad dal, toor dal, chana dal, poha avalakki, oil, mustard, red chile, curry leaves, hing asafoetida, chili, ginger, onions, turmeric, salt, potato, fresh coriander, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 3 cup sona masuri rice and ½ tsp methi. Step 2: Rinse well and soak in enough water for 4 hours. Step 3: In another bowl take 1 cup urad dal, 2 tbsp toor dal and 2 tbsp chana dal. Step 4: Rinse well and soak in enough water for 2 hours. Step 5: After soaking dal for 2 hours, drain off the water and transfer to the grinder. you can also grind in mixi if you do not have access to a grinder. Step 6: Add water as required and blend to smooth paste. Step 7: Scrape sides. the smooth and fluffy batter will be ready after 40 minutes. Step 8: Transfer the batter to a large vessel and keep aside. Step 9: In the same grinder add soaked rice and 1 cup rinsed poha. Step 10: Add water slowly and scrape the sides. blend to a coarse paste. Step 11: Transfer the rice batter to the same urad dal batter. Step 12: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 13: Ferment in a warm place for at least 8 hours or until the batter doubles in volume. if you are living in a cold climate, then you can place the batter in the warm oven (just heat the oven until it turns slightly warm and then turn off) to ferment. Step 14: Once the batter is well fermented, mix gently, without disturbing the air pockets. Step 15: Transfer 4 cups of fermented batter to a small bowl and add 1 tsp salt. Step 16: Mix well until the salt is well combined. masala dosa batter is ready. keep aside. Step 17: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil and splutter 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp urad dal, 1 tsp chana dal, 1 dried red chilli, few curry leaves, pinch hing. Step 18: Now add 2 chilli and 1 inch ginger. saute well. Step 19: Also, add 1 onion and saute until onions shrink slightly. Step 20: Further, add ¼ tsp turmeric and 1 tsp salt. saute well. Step 21: Now add 3 potato and mix well, mash slightly making sure everything is well combined. Step 22: Turn off the flame and add 2 tbsp coriander and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Step 23: Mix well and aloo bhaji for masala dosa is ready. keep aside. Step 24: Firstly, add a ladleful of batter on hot tawa. Step 25: Spread as thin as possible making a crispy dosa. Step 26: Take 1 tsp of butter and spread uniformly. Step 27: Also, place 2 tbsp of prepared aloo masala in the centre. Step 28: Roast until the dosa turns golden brown and crisp. Step 29: Scrape the sides of dosa and roll the dosa. Step 30: Finally, masala dosa recipe is ready to serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

Ingredient Names: butter, dried fenugreek, garlic, ginger paste, onions, capsicum, turmeric, chili powder, pav bhaji masala, salt, tomato, lemon juice, fresh coriander, pav
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 1 tbsp butter, 1 tsp kasuri methi, 3 clove garlic and ½ tsp ginger paste. Step 2: Saute slightly until it turns aromatic. Step 3: Now add 1 onion and saute slightly. do not brown the onions, just saute until it turns translucent. Step 4: Also, add ½ capsicum and saute slightly. Step 5: Further, add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, 2 tbsp pav bhaji masala and ½ tsp salt. Step 6: Saute for a minute making sure the spices turn aromatic. Step 7: Now add 2 tomato and saute until tomatoes turn mushy. Step 8: Further, mash the tomatoes until it turns silky smooth. Step 9: Add 2 tsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp coriander. Mix well. bhaji is ready. Step 10: To serve, heat 1 tsp butter. add 1 tsp coriander, ¼ tsp pav bhaji masala. Step 11: Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 12: Now slice 2 pav and toast slightly on both sides. Step 13: Further, spread 1 tbsp of prepared bhaji masala over pav. Step 14: Also, top with chopped onions and close the pav. Step 15: Finally, enjoy masala pav with chopped onions and cucumber.

Ingredient Names: milk, ice cubes, rooh afza, sugar, sabja seeds, watermelon
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 4 cup of chilled milk. Make sure to use full-fat cream milk. Step 2: Add ice cubes to make the milk extra chilled. Step 3: Also, add 2 tbsp rooh afza and ¼ cup sugar. Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 4: Now add 2 cups chopped watermelon, 2 tbsp sabja seeds and mix well. The small pieces of watermelon give a nice crunch in the milk. Step 5: Further to make it extra flavourful, you can add more rooh afza depending on the flavour. Step 6: Finally, mix well and enjoy Watermelon Milkshake or Mohabbat Ka Sharbat.

Ingredient Names: ghee, semiya vermicelli, mustard, cumin, asafoetida, peanuts, cashews, curry leaves, onions, chili, ginger, fresh carrot, capsicum, peas, beans, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, salt, water, fresh coriander, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tsp ghee and roast 1 cup semiya on low flame. Step 2: Roast until the semiya turns aromatic and golden brown. Keep aside. Step 3: Now in a large kadai heat 2 tsp ghee, add 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp cumin and pinch hing. Step 4: Also add 2 tbsp peanuts, 2 tbsp cashew and few curry leaves. Roast until the peanuts turn golden brown. Step 5: Add 1 onion, 4 chilli, 1 inch ginger and saute until the onion softens slightly. Step 6: Further add 2 tbsp carrot, 2 tbsp capsicum, 2 tbsp peas and 2 tbsp beans. Step 7: Saute on medium flame until the vegetables are crunchy. Step 8: Add in ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp garam masala and 1 tsp salt. Step 9: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 10: Pour in 1½ cup water and get to a rolling boil. Step 11: Once the water comes to a boil, add in roasted semiya and mix gently. Step 12: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the semiya absorbs all the water. Step 13: Give a stir, cover and simmer for 2 more minutes. At this stage, you can see there is no water in the kadai. Step 14: Add 2 tbsp coriander and 2 tsp lemon juice. Mix well and cover and rest for 5 minutes, so that all the moisture is absorbed well. Step 15: Finally, enjoy Namkeen Seviyan Upma with raita.

Ingredient Names: rice semiya, oil, peanuts, mustard, urad dal, chana dal, cumin, asafoetida, curry leaves, chili, ginger, onions, fresh carrot, peas, capsicum, beans, salt, turmeric, fresh coconut, fresh coriander, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water in a large vessel. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 tsp oil. Bring to a boil. Step 2: Add 2 cup rice semiya and boil for 3 minutes. Check the package instructions for boiling time. Step 3: Once the semiya is cooked, drain off the water and rinse with cold water. Keep aside. Step 4: In a large kadai, heat 2 tablespoons oil and fry 2 tablespoons of peanuts until they turn crunchy. Keep aside. Step 5: Add 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp urad dal, ½ tsp chana dal, ½ tsp cumin, pinch hing and a few curry leaves. Splutter the tempering. Step 6: Also add 1 chilli, 1 inch ginger, 1 onion and saute well. Step 7: Further add 1 carrot, 3 tbsp peas, 1 capsicum, 1 beans, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp turmeric. Step 8: Stir fry till the vegetables turn crunchy. Step 9: Now add in cooked semiya and mix gently. Step 10: Also add fried peanuts, 3 tbsp coconut, 2 tbsp coriander, and 2 tsp lemon juice. Step 11: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Shavige Bhat Recipe with chutney.

Dish Name: Steamed tilapia with green chilli & coconut chutney
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, tilapia fillet, butter, fat-free yogurt, naan bread, fresh coriander, green chili, desiccated coconut, lemons, ginger, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: To make the chutney, put the coriander, chilli, coconut, lemon juice, ginger and cumin in a food processor. Add good pinches of salt and sugar, then pulse until it has a rough salsa-like consistency. Step 2: Rinse the rice and place in a deep frying pan with 225ml water. Bring to the boil, then turn down low – it will take about 8 mins to cook. Step 3: After about 3 mins, place the fish fillets on top of the rice, then dot a tsp of butter on each and spread the fresh chutney over in a thick layer. Cover with a lid and cook over a low heat for about 5 mins until the fish and rice are cooked through. Step 4: Serve the fish and rice with the yogurt, warmed naan breads and the lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: rava semolina suji, pepper powder, chili flakes, chaat masala, dried fenugreek, salt, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1½ cup rava. make sure to take fine rava. Step 2: Add ½ tsp pepper powder, ½ tsp chilli flakes, ½ tsp chaat masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi, ½ tsp salt and 2 tbsp oil. Step 3: Mix well making sure the flour is moist. Step 4: Now add ½ cup water or as required and start to knead the dough. Step 5: Knead to a smooth and soft dough adding water as required. Step 6: Now grease the dough with a tsp of oil and rest for 20 minutes. Step 7: Knead the dough again making sure the suji has absorbed water and dough is soft. Step 8: Pinch a small ball sized dough and roll to cylindrical. Step 9: Press it on back of fork and roll gently forming a spiral shape. Step 10: Deep fry the snack in hot oil keeping the flame on medium. Step 11: Stir occasionally, frying uniformly on all sides. Step 12: Fry until the suji snack turns golden and crisp. Step 13: Finally, enjoy suji snacks with hot tea or store in an airtight container for 2 weeks.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, fresh carrot, cucumbers, onions, dill leaves sabsige soppu, fresh coriander, chili, ginger, curry leaves, cumin, salt, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Take rice flour in a large bowl. Step 2: Add carrot, cucumber, onion, dill leaves, coriander, ginger, chilli and curry leaves. Step 3: Add cumin and salt. Step 4: Squeeze and mix well to release moisture from the vegetables. Step 5: Add warm water little by little and prepare a soft dough. Step 6: Grease butter paper with oil. You can alternatively use a banana leaf for traditional flavour. Step 7: Take a ball sized dough. Place on the butter paper and start patting gently. Step 8: Grease your hands with oil for easy patting. Step 9: Spread evenly to make a thin roti. Step 10: Place the butter paper upside down on hot tawa. Step 11: Press slightly and cook for few seconds. Step 12: Slowly remove the butter paper. Step 13: Spread little oil for uniform roasting. Step 14: Flip and roast both sides till they are cooked well. Step 15: Finally, Akki Rotti Recipe is ready to enjoy with spicy chutney.

Dish Name: Aloo Methi Paratha Recipe - Perfect Lunchbox Paratha
Ingredient Names: methi fenugreek leaves, curds, chili powder, cumin powder, turmeric, garam masala, ajwain carom seeds, chili, sesame, salt, potato, wheat flour, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 bunch of finely chopped methi. Step 2: Add ¼ cup curd, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp turmeric and ¾ tsp garam masala. Step 3: Also add ¼ tsp ajwain, 2 chilli, 2 tbsp sesame and ½ tsp salt. Step 4: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 5: Now add 2 potato, 2 cup wheat flour and knead the dough. Step 6: Add water as required and knead to a smooth and soft dough. Step 7: Further, add 2 tsp oil and grease the dough well. Step 8: Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Step 9: After 10 minutes, knead the dough again. pinch a ball-sized dough. Step 10: Dust with wheat flour and roll uniformly. Step 11: Further, roll to a slightly thick thickness like paratha. Step 12: Now on a hot tawa place the rolled paratha and cook for a minute. Step 13: Furthermore, when the base is partly cooked, flip the aloo methi paratha. Step 14: Also, spread ½ tsp olive oil / ghee and cook both sides. Step 15: Finally, enjoy aloo methi paratha with raita and pickle.

Ingredient Names: oil, mustard, cumin, asafoetida, curry leaves, onions, ginger, turmeric, chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala, peas, potato, pepper powder, salt, fresh coriander, lemon juice, bread, green chutney, butter, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin, pinch hing, and a few curry leaves. Splutter the tempering. Step 2: Add ½ onion, 1 inch ginger and saute slightly. Step 3: Further add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, and ½ tsp garam masala. Step 4: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 5: Further, add 2 tbsp peas and saute slightly. Step 6: Now add 3 potato, ½ tsp pepper powder, ½ tsp salt, and mix well. Step 7: Mix until everything is well combined. Step 8: Further add 2 tbsp coriander, 2 tsp lemon juice and mix well. Aloo Stuffing is ready. Step 9: To prepare the sandwich, spread butter and green chutney. Step 10: Also top with aloo masala. Step 11: Now on the other slice of bread, spread the butter and tomato sauce. Step 12: Close the sandwich and toast to golden brown. Step 13: Toast both sides until the sandwich turns golden brown and crispy. Step 14: Finally, enjoy Aloo Sandwich Recipe with tomato sauce and green chutney.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, turmeric, cumin powder, chaat masala, chili flakes, asafoetida, salt, water, onions, fresh carrot, tomato, beans, capsicum, green chili, fresh cilantro, bread, butter for roasting
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl take besan, turmeric, cumin powder, chaat masala, chilli flakes, hing and salt. Step 2: Add water gradually and prepare a smooth, flowing batter without lumps. Step 3: Whisk the batter well for a smooth consistency. Step 4: Add onion, carrot, tomato, beans, capsicum, green chilli and coriander. Step 5: Mix well until everything combines evenly. Step 6: Dip the bread slice into the batter and coat well on both sides. Step 7: Top extra vegetables over the bread for better texture and flavour. Step 8: Heat a tawa and spread a little butter. Step 9: Place the coated bread on a hot tawa and roast on a medium flame. Step 10: Apply a little butter on top and flip gently. Step 11: Roast both sides until golden, crisp and crunchy. Step 12: Finally, serve Besan Bread Toast Recipe hot with green chutney, ketchup or masala chai.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, baking soda, egg, sugar, plain yogurt, warm water, ghee, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour, salt and baking soda into a large bowl. Step 2: Beat the egg and add it to the flour with the sugar, yogurt and water. Step 3: Mix to a fairly soft dough, adding more water if necessary. Step 4: Add the ghee and knead the dough until it is smooth and pliable. Step 5: Put it back in the bowl, cover with a damp cloth and put in a warm place for about 4 hours to rise. Step 6: Knead the dough again and divide into ten balls. Step 7: Roll out each one on a greased board to a circle about 4 inches in diameter. Step 8: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan or wok and fry the bhaturas, one at a time turning them so that they tur that they turn pale golden on both sides. Step 9: Drain on paper towels and keep warm while you fry the remainder In the picture all ten are frying at once.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, plain yogurt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder into a large bowl. Step 2: Stir in enough yogurt so dough is soft but not too sticky. Step 3: Turn out on to a lightly floured surface and roll to a thickness of 1 / 8-inch. Step 4: Using 5-6 inch bowl, cut rounds Reroll scraps if necessary Oil heavy large skillet and heat over medium heat. Step 5: Add dough rounds in batches. Step 6: Cook until lightly browned on both sides, turning often 8-10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, salt, warm water, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl stir together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, and the salt. Step 2: Add 3 / 4 cup of the warm water while mixing constantly with your hands till the dough is moist. Step 3: Add the remaining water, 1 tbsp at a time, mixing constantly with your hands. Step 4: Keep working the dough till the dough forms a ball and holds its shape Dampen your hands. Step 5: Keep the dough in the mixing bowl to knead. Step 6: Knead in an additional 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, if necessary, to make a moderately stiff dough. Step 7: Knead dough till smooth and elastic Continue dampening hands, as needed, during kneading The dough is ready for shaping when you can lightly and quickly press two finger.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, salt, water, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the two flours into a large bowl and add the salt Slowly pour in the water and mix into the flour to make a fairly soft dough. Step 2: Add more water if necessary. Step 3: Knead to make the dough pliable Wet your hands and knead the dough again This binds the flours together thoroughly and makes the dough extra smooth. Step 4: Wrap in foil and put in a cool place for 30 minutes. Step 5: Divide the dough into twelve to fourteen balls and roll each one on a floured surface to a circle about 5 inches in diameter. Step 6: Heat a heavy based frying pan or griddle on a medium heat. Step 7: Cook the bread circles, one at a time on the hot griddle or frying pan for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, water, milk, salt, oil, butter, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Put flour and salt in a bowl. Step 2: Add water a cup at a time, kneading. Step 3: When kneading, make your hand into a fist and roll your knuckles into the dough, folding edges in continuously, working in all the flour. Step 4: When all the flour is kneaded into a ball, poke lots of holes into the ball of dough. Step 5: Pour a little oil into the dough and knead it inches. Step 6: Add the rest of the oil. Step 7: Cover with a clean cloth and let sit for at least an hour. Step 8: Roll the ball in a little bit of flour so it's not sticky. Step 9: Divide the dough into about 15-20 balls depending on how big you want the chappatis to be Flour the counter / board.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, oil, dry yeast, baking soda, sugar, low-fat milk, yogurt, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl take some warm water. Step 2: Sprinkle yeast and sugar over it. Step 3: Keep aside for 5 minutes or till frothy. Step 4: Take a large plate. Step 5: Mix salt and flour in it. Step 6: Make a well in the center. Step 7: Add yoghurt in the well. Step 8: Sprinkle baking soda over yoghurt. Step 9: Allow to stand for 2-3 minutes. Step 10: Pour oil and yeast solution in the well.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, thumb size ginger, garam masala, cherry tomato, chickpeas, spinach leaves, chapati
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, then gently cook the onions and ginger for 5 mins until beginning to soften. Stir in the spice, cook for 1 min, then add the tomatoes and chickpeas. Fill the tomato can one-third with water, tip this in too, then bubble for 5 mins until the sauce has thickened a little. Stir in threequarters of the spinach leaves, a handful at a time, then warm through for a few mins. Step 2: Heat the chapatis in the microwave, following the pack instructions. Serve the curry spooned into the warm chapatis, with the remaining spinach and a dollop of Yellow yogurt if you like (recipe below).

Dish Name: Chilli Cheese Sandwich Recipe 2 Ways - Toast & Grill Street Style
Ingredient Names: butter, chili, garlic, mixed herbs, fresh coriander, bread, chili flakes, cheese, tomato, onions, cucumbers
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, spicy chilli garlic butter, in a small bowl take 2 tbsp butter and mash smooth. Step 2: Add 3 chilli, 5 garlic, ½ tsp mixed herbs and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 3: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 4: To prepare Chilli Cheese Toast, spread a generous amount of chilli garlic butter on the bread. Step 5: Top with cheese, chilli flakes, coriander, and chilli. Step 6: Toast on the pan by spreading butter on the other side. Step 7: Cover and toast until the cheese melts. Step 8: Finally, cut half and enjoy chilli cheese toast. Step 9: To prepare the Chilli Cheese Sandwich, spread a generous amount of chilli garlic butter over bread. Step 10: Top with cheese, tomato, onion and cucumber. Step 11: Also top with chilli flakes, chilli and more cheese. Step 12: Spread the chilli garlic butter on the bread slice and cover it. Step 13: Now grill the sandwich in the sandwich maker until it turns golden brown. make sure to spread butter before grilling. Step 14: Finally, cut half and enjoy Chilli Cheese Sandwich Recipe.

Dish Name: Cilantro And Coriander Seed Naan Bread
Ingredient Names: bread flour, plain yogurt, coriander seed, fresh coriander, water, dried yeast, salt, vegetable oil, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast the seeds until aromatic Crush them coarsely using a mortar and pestle, or use that coffee grinder that has been lying around unused for a while now:). Step 2: Put them into a pan with the water and bring it to a boil, set aside. Step 3: Put the yogurt into another bowl, add the yeast. Step 4: Pour the seeds+water mixture and stir well. Step 5: Add 1-1 / 2 cups of flour and stir it well until blended. Step 6: Cover the bowl and let it prove for 30minutes. Step 7: Then add the salt, oil and the remaining flour. Step 8: Knead it well on a lightly floured surface until smooth and place it back in the bowl.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, barley flour, cooked sweet potato, butter, salt, ground cinnamon, water
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly spoon flours into dry measuring cups Level with a knife. Step 2: Combine flours, potato, butter, salt, and cinnamon in a large bowl, mix well, add water. Step 3: Press mixture together with hands. Step 4: Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Step 5: Knead until smooth. Step 6: Divide dough into 16 equal portions, shaping each into a ball Working with 1 ball at a time, roll each into a 4-inch circle on a lightly floured surface.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, curry powder, ground cumin ground coriander turmeric, coconut milk, chicken stock, mayonnaise, leftover turkey, desiccated coconut, fresh coriander, tomato onion lettuce leaves, wholemeal flour
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a saucepan and add a little vegetable oil. Fry the onion and garlic until both are lightly browned. Chuck in all the spices and let them sizzle for 1 min, then add the coconut milk and the stock. Allow this to reduce until you have a thick, rich, creamy, spicy onion mixture in the pan. Pour into a bowl, leave to cool, then stir through the mayonnaise. Can be kept in the fridge for up to a week. Step 2: To make the chapatis, put the flour and 1 tsp salt into a large bowl. Pour in the oil and rub into the flour with your fingertips. Pour in 250ml lukewarm water, mix to form a firm dough, then knead for about 10 mins until springy. Place back in the bowl and leave to rest for 30 mins. Cut into 8 walnut-size pieces and roll out into thin discs on a lightly floured surface. Pan-fry the discs in a dry heavy-based pan for about 1 min on each side. They should colour and blister – use a clean cloth to press flat in the pan while cooking. Step 3: To serve, mix the curried mayonnaise with the turkey. Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan until golden. Sprinkle over the turkey along with some coriander, then serve alongside the chapatis with some tomato, sliced onion and lettuce, if you like.

Dish Name: Curried Chicken Salad With Garam Masala Biscuits
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, garam masala, baking powder, salt, baking soda, unsalted butter, buttermilk, carrot, onion, black peppercorns, bay leaf, chicken breast halves, mayonnaise, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375. Step 2: In a medium bowl, whisk the 2 cups of flour with the sugar, garam masala, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Step 3: Using a pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in the butter until it is the size of small peas. Step 4: Add the cup of buttermilk and stir until a dough forms. Step 5: Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it 2 or 3 times. Step 6: Roll or pat the dough into a 6-by-12-inch rectangle, about -inch thick. Step 7: Using a floured knife, cut the dough into 8 square biscuits. Step 8: Brush the tops with buttermilk and transfer the biscuits to a baking sheet. Step 9: Bake for about 18 minutes, until risen and golden. Step 10: Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

Ingredient Names: strong white flour, salt, fast-action yeast, olive oil, water, sultanas, mild curry powder, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour, salt, yeast and oil in a large bowl and add enough water to make a soft, but not sloppy, dough. Knead well. Put into a lightly oiled bowl to rise for 1 hr until doubled in size. Step 2: Roll out the dough into a square 25cm in diameter on a lightly floured surface. Then spread over the sultanas, curry powder and chutney leaving a 1cm gap around the edges. Fold over one side of the dough (like a book) and press down to seal. Roll the dough out again to the same size. Divide the dough into 8 pieces, about 250g each, and use a rolling pin to flatten each one into a circle, 15cm in diameter and about 1cm thick. Put the pieces on a lightly floured baking tray to prove for a further 5 mins. Step 3: Heat a large frying pan to a medium heat and dry-fry each piece of dough until browned on both sides, about 5 mins in total, then set aside to cool slightly before serving.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, flour, sugar, oil, yogurt, milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl combine the whole wheat and regular flours. Step 2: Make a well in the middle of the mixture, and add the liquid ingredients, and combine everything together using your hands to make a firm dough. Step 3: Divide the dough into 20 small balls approximately The balls should be small enough to make small sized tortillas. Step 4: Roll out each ball on a floured surface Deep fry, keeping the top side of the puri on top, until lightly golden Ready to be served, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, refined flour, salt, oil, carom seeds, water, potatoes, green chili pepper, coriander leaves, garam masala powder, red chili powder, ginger, chaat masala
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the dough making ingredients in your food processor with the dough paddle You will get a soft and elastic dough. Step 2: Set aside and let it rest until we prepare the potato stuffing In the food processor put all the ingredients required for the potato stuffing and pulse it until it all mixes and comes together well Potato should be minced. Step 3: Divide dough 7-8 medium balls, dust the floor and roll the balls into small circle with the help of a rolling pin Hold the rolled dough in your palm and place 2-3 tbsp of potato filling in the center Use your judgement when it comes to filling, you should be able to close the dough with filling inside Pinch the top of the dough to seal it well Flatten the dough lightly with your hands and roll it out gently into 6-8 inch circle.

Ingredient Names: caster sugar, dried yeast, plain flour, table salt, greek yogurt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, yeast and 375ml warm water in a bowl and stand in a warm place for 10 minutes or until mixture begins to foam. Step 2: Combine flour and salt in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture, yoghurt and combine well. Step 3: Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes or until smooth. Step 4: Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with cloth or tea towel and stand for 2 hours Punch dough down, then divide it into 8 portions, place on lightly oiled trays, cover with cloth and stand for another 15 minutes. Step 5: Heat a cast iron skillet or frying pan over medium heat and brush with oil. Step 6: Place one piece of dough on a lightly floured surface and roll out into a thin 22cm round. Step 7: When skillet is very hot, place dough round into pan and cook for 1 minute or until brown spots appear on the base. Step 8: Turn and cook for another minute, then place on a plate and cover with a cloth to keep warm Lightly brush the pan with a little more oil and repeat with the remaining dough rounds.

Dish Name: Griddle Cooked Corn Flatbread Makkai Ki Roti
Ingredient Names: yellow corn flour, all-purpose flour, salt, fresh ginger, green chilies, red onion, fresh cilantro, warm water, ghee, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine corn flour, all-purpose flour and salt in a medium bowl Pulse ginger and chiles in a food processor until minced. Step 2: Add to the flour mixture along with onion and cilantro. Step 3: Drizzle warm water over the mixture, a few tablespoons at a time, stirring it in as you go, until the mixture starts to come together and form a ball. Step 4: Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface Gently knead until a soft dough forms. Step 5: Divide the dough into 12 portions and shape each into a ball. Step 6: Keep the balls covered with plastic wrap or with a slightly damp paper towel. Step 7: Fold a large sheet of foil in half lengthwise. Step 8: Combine ghee and oil in a small bowl.

Ingredient Names: unbleached flour, salt, baking soda, ground cumin, curry powder, garlic powder, onion powder, butter, plain yogurt, water, cilantro, garlic, green onion top, mint, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Measure the dry chapati recipe ingredients first into large bowl of a food processor Process for 10 seconds. Step 2: Leave processor running. Step 3: Add butter through feeder tube Process 10 seconds. Step 4: Whisk the yogurt together with the water Slowly pour yogurt / water mixture through feeder tube of processor while running Process dough ingredients until it forms a ball, about one minute. Step 5: Remove dough from processor. Step 6: Divide the dough into 8 equal portions.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, sugar, warm water, flour, salt, butter, vegetable oil, mixed seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine yeast and sugar in small bowl. Step 2: Add water and stir well and let rest until foamy, about 5 minutes Stire together the flour and salt in a large bowl. Step 3: Make a well in the center of the flour and pour in the mixture and butter. Step 4: Mix together with fingers until a smooth doughs form that is just slightly sticky, working in additional flour if needed. Step 5: Transfer dough to flightly floured board and knead for 3 minutes Oil a small bowl with the remaining teaspoon of butter and place the dough in the bowl, turning to coat. Step 6: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a damp kitchen towl and let rest in a warm draft-free area until doubled in dize, about 1 hour. Step 7: Preheat oven and griddle to 400 degrees f. Step 8: Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and transfer to lightly floured work surface.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, eggs, cumin seed, salt, margarine, baking powder, milk, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Sieve flour. Step 2: Add baking powder, salt, ghee, cumin seeds and grated ginger, mix. Step 3: Make into a dough using eggs and milk. Step 4: Keep aside, covered, for 20 minutes. Step 5: Divide the dough into 6 equal parts. Step 6: Shape them into round balls Flatten and roll out each piece to about 5" diameter, cook as parathas. Step 7: Serve hot and crisp.

Ingredient Names: milk, caster sugar, active dry yeast, plain flour, salt, baking powder, vegetable oil, yogurt, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Put the milk in a bowl. Step 2: Add 1tsp of sugar and the yeast, stir to mix. Step 3: Set aside for 15-20 minutes or until the yeast has dissolved and the mixture is frothy Sift the flour, salt and baking powder into a bowl. Step 4: Add the remaining 1tsp sugar, the yeast mixture, 2tblsp vegetable oil and yogurt and egg. Step 5: Mix to form a ball of dough. Step 6: Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and satiny Form into a ball. Step 7: Pour 1 / 4tsp oil into a large bowl and roll the ball of dough in it.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, salt, sugar, dry yeast, yogurt, oil, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yeast with sugar and warm milk or water. Step 2: Leave for 20 minutes Sift flour and salt together in a large bowl. Step 3: Make a well in the centre and put yoghurt, 2 tbsps oil or butter with the yeast mixture. Step 4: Knead well and leave aside for 3-4 hours in a warm place until it doubles in size Punch down the dough and knead well again. Step 5: Leave it till it doubles in size. Step 6: Divide the dough into 6 portions. Step 7: Roll out into a round disc of 6" diameter. Step 8: Leave it aside so that it can double in size.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, milk, sugar, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, plain yogurt, egg, ghee, fresh cilantro, onion seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the yeast, warm milk, and sugar and set aside for about 5 minutes, until frothy Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt. Step 2: Make a well in the middle. Step 3: Mix together the yeast mixture, milk, yogurt, egg, and ghee. Step 4: Fold it into the flour. Step 5: Knead dough well, about 10 minutes Tightly cover the bowl and keep in a warm place until the dough doubles in size Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees f If using a baking stone, preheat stone for 30 min. Step 6: Roll out the dough onto a floured surface.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, sugar, all-purpose flour, salt, baking powder, milk, greek yogurt, egg, vegetable oil, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine yeast, sugar, and 1 / 4 cup warm water. Step 2: Let stand until foamy, 5 to 10 minutes Into the bowl of your food processor, place 4 1 / 2 cups flour, salt, and baking powder Fit with the dough blade and mix to combine. Step 3: Add in the yeast mixture, milk, yogurt, egg, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, and 3 / 4 cups warm water and knead until smooth and elastic Dough should be soft, but not too sticky, so add flour as needed Lightly oil a large bowl, add dough, turning to coat, then cover bowl with plastic wrap, then a clean kitchen towel. Step 4: Let dough rise, in a warm place, until doubled, about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours Punch dough down and divide into 8 equal pieces, which you will roll into a ball and place on a lightly floured baking sheet. Step 5: Cover with a damp kitchen towel, and let rise until doubled, about 40 to 60 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated bread dough, ghee, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Use the refrigerated pre-mixed dough for no-knead flatbreads recipe #387518 or recipe #309834. Step 2: Remove the selected dough from the refrigerator Lighly dust the surface with flour and cut off a 1 / 4 pound piece With lightly floured hands quickly shape dough into a ball by streching the surface of the dough around to the bottom on all four sides, rotating the ball a quarter turn as you go. Step 3: Using your hands and a rolling pin, andd minimal flour, roll to a uniform thickness of 1 / 8 inch throughout. Step 4: Heat a heavy cast-iron skillet over high heat on the stovetop It's ready when water droplets flicked into the pan skitter across the surface and quickly evaporate. Step 5: Add the ghee or oil to the hot pan. Step 6: Drop the rolled dough round into the skillet, decrease the heat to medium, and cover the skillet to trap the steam and heat. Step 7: Using a spatula check for doness at about 3 minutes, or sooner if deemed necessary.

Ingredient Names: pizza crusts, butter, cumin seed, poppy seed, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray, set aside. Step 2: Remove pizza crust from can and unroll onto baking sheet. Step 3: Using your hands, press out the dough until it is approximately 1 / 4-inch thick. Step 4: Brush the dough with melted butter and sprinkle with seeds. Step 5: Bake until lightly golden, about 10 to 12 minutes. Step 6: Cut into serving size pieces.

Ingredient Names: pork chili sausages, red onions, brown sugar, balsamic vinegar, garlic coriander naan bread, feta cheese, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Skin the sausages, then fry the filling in a hot, non-stick frying pan, breaking up with a wooden spoon until golden. Remove and set aside. Toss the onion in the pan and gently cook in the fat from the sausages until soft, about 8-10 mins. Step 2: Add the sugar and vinegar to the pan and turn up the heat. Cook, stirring often, until caramelised. Season. Step 3: Heat grill to high, put the naan breads on a baking sheet and divide the onion between the two. Scatter over the sausagemeat and grill for 3-4 mins until hot. Scatter with feta and coriander to serve.

Ingredient Names: warm water, unsalted butter, dry yeast, salt, honey, whole wheat flour
Instructions: Step 1: Stir the butter into the warm water until it melts. Step 2: Stir the yeast and salt in the water / butter mixture until dissolves. Step 3: Then allow the yeast to bloom. Step 4: Stir in honey Gradually work in enough flour to make a soft, workable dough. Step 5: Turn out on a floured board and knead until elastic and smooth. Step 6: Let rise until doubled in bulk. Step 7: Preheat oven to 500f. Step 8: Turn out on a floured board and knead briefly Form into 12 balls.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, sooji, sugar, kosher salt, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Add flour, sooji, sugar, and salt to a mixing bowl and mix well. Add flour, sooji, sugar, and salt. Start the mixer at speed 2. Step 4: Slowly add water to the mixer bowl, increasing the speed to 3. Stop the mixer and check the dough before adding all the water. The dough should be firmer than regular paratha or roti dough. Once the dough has fully formed, add the oil and let the mixer run for another 2 to 3 minutes. Take the dough out, cover, and allow it to rest for at least 5 minutes. Step 5: Knead the dough once more for a minute and make small round balls from it. With 4 cups of dough, you can make roughly 25-30 balls. Add oil to a frying pan and preheat on low heat. Step 6: Take one dough ball at a time and lightly roll it in the dry flour so that it is evenly covered with flour. Then roll it using a rolling pin and make a small 4-inch round puri. You can roll all the puris and line them on a parchment paper-lined tray or roll and fry simultaneously. Step 7: Turn the heat for the frying pan to medium-high. Test that the oil is heated to the right temperature by dropping a tiny piece of flattened dough into the oil. If the dough rises instantly and begins to puff up, you are good to go. Step 8: Carefully slide the rolled puri into the hot oil. Step 9: Gently press down with a stainless steel slotted spatula as the puri starts to puff up. Then turn it over, pressing gently, and cook until both sides turn light golden brown. Step 5: In a tiny bowl soak chana dal and in another cup soak another chana dal in water for about an hour. Step 6: Meanwhile, chop all the vegetables and set aside. In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients under grinding - Jeera seeds, Coriander seeds, Byadgi Chillies, Guntur Chillies, cinnamon stick, turmeric powder and fresh coconut with the soaked chana dal and grind to slightly coarse paste with very little water. In a wide vessel add the vegetables - carrots, beans, turnips except pumpkin with little water and cook until just done but not very soft. Step 7: This will take about 5 to. Step 8: Once it is done, add pumpkin and cook until its soft. Now add the ground paste, tamarind extract, salt and cook for 5 minutes or until the Sagu thickens. This sagu must not be very watery or this will make the dosa very soggy. Step 9: Add jaggery if your pumpkin isn't very sweet or simply skip it. In another pan heat some oil, crackle the mustard seeds, follow it with asafoetida, 1 red chilli broken, curry leaves and soaked chana dal that has been drained. Next, add in the finely chopped onions and cook until transparent. Step 10: Pour this tadka into the sagu and mix until combined. Step 11: Cook for a couple of minutes more and top with coriander. Step 12: Your Sagu is ready.*To make the red chutneyWe will add all the ingredients mentioned under chutney which includes Roasted Chana Dal, Byadgi Red Dry Chillies, Fresh Coconut, Tamarind Paste, Garlic and Salt. Grind to a slightly coarse consistency with enough water to bring it all together.*To assemble the dosa. Step 13: Scoop out some batter into a bowl and add water to make the batter to a flowy consistency. Heat a dosa tawa, add some oil and then wipe it out with a clean kitchen towel. Step 14: Pour a ladle of batter in the centre and spread it thinly in circles to make a dosa. Add oil or ghee to cook, once the top is cooked smear the red chutney, top it with vegetable sagu. Step 15: Once it is done, let it cook until golden, fold and remove the dosa onto a plate and serve hot. Serve Sagu Masala Dosa along with Tomato Onion Sambar and South Indian Coconut Chutney for your weekend breakfast or for a weekday night dinner recipe.

Dish Name: Savory Waffles With Roasted Peppers In Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
Ingredient Names: sun dried tomatoes, basil leaves, garlic, almond, parmigiano reggiano cheese, extra virgin olive oil, whole black peppercorns, salt, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, black olives, pickled jalapenos, sun dried tomato pesto, egg, milk, sunflower oil, sugar, baking powder, whole wheat flour, black pepper powder, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Savory Waffles with Roasted Peppers in Sundried tomato Pesto, we need to firsts make the Sun Dried Tomato PestoFor the Sun Dried Tomato PestoTo begin making the Sundried Tomato Pesto, we have to put all the ingredients together and put them into your blender and make a coarse paste. In a blender combine sundried tomatoes, basil leaves, garlic, almonds, parmigiano reggiano cheese, whole black peppercorns and salt. While you blitz, keep adding a little olive oil at a time if the paste if too firm to grind. Step 2: If your sundried tomatoes are too firm, then its a good idea to soak it in a little warm water for about 30 minutes, then grind it to make a pesto. For Roasted Peppers and Sun dried tomatoes toppingIn a pan heat olive oil on medium flame, add mixed bell peppers, black olives and pickled jalapenos. Step 3: Switch to high heat and pan fry them for 3-4 minutes. Finally add in the sundried tomato pesto and give it a good stir. Step 4: Turn off the flame. For the savoury wafflesPreheat waffle iron. Step 5: Beat eggs in large bowl with hand beater until fluffy. Step 6: Beat in milk, vegetable oil, sugar, baking powder, pepper, oregano and salt, just until smooth. Step 7: Finally add in the flour and stir to combine well, until it is smooth with no lumpsGrease the waffle iron pan with oil. Step 8: Pour mix on to hot waffle iron. Step 9: Cook until golden brown. Step 10: To assemble, place the waffles on a plate, top with mixed bell peppers. Step 11: Serve Savory Waffles with Roasted Peppers in Sundried tomato Pesto along with Fried Egg Recipe (Sunny Side Up) and Refreshing Smoothie Recipe With Cucumber & Kiwi and fresh fruits for a Sunday brunch.

Ingredient Names: chicken, red food coloring, cumin powder, low-fat plain yogurt, green chili, ginger-garlic paste, limes, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken and make deep cuts on the pieces Mix all the ingredients Marinate the chicken for a minimum of 2 hours Deep fry Drain on paper towels Serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken, yogurt, ginger paste, garlic paste, tomato puree, salt, red chili powder, black pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the spices, pastes, tomato puree and yogurt together and coat the chicken pieces and leave to marinate for 3 hours. Step 2: Heat oil in pot Empty marinated chicken with the mixture and cook covered till chicken is tender, about 30 minutes on low medium heat only. Step 3: Once chicken is tender saute the same on high heat for 4 minutes Do not add water during cooking the chicken Feel it melt in your mouth tingling your tongue and the taste buds on it Eat it s-----l-----o-----w-----l-----y to get that feeling.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, green chili pepper, cilantro leaves, mint leaves, cumin powder, green bell pepper, scallion, vegetables, chicken breasts, kosher salt, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor / blender, mix cilantro leaves, mint leaves, scallion, bell pepper, cumin powder, green chili and garlic cloves. Step 2: Add oil to the above mixture and blend to form a smooth paste. Step 3: Remove the prepared green mixture in to a zip lock bag along with the chicken tenders Seal the bag and massage the marinade in to the chicken tenders. Step 4: Place this bag in the refrigerator overnight or for at least ten hours Use skewers to place the marinated chicken tenders. Step 5: Sprinkle salt on each side of them. Step 6: Heat the grill and rub it with some oil. Step 7: Place the skewers on it to get grill marks on each side and cook until the chicken is done. Step 8: Drizzle some fresh lemon juice and enjoy with your favorite dipping sauce and loved ones!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil, nigella seeds, mustard seeds, fennel seed, dried red chili pepper, onion, tomato puree, kosher salt, chili powder, turmeric, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Add mustard seeds, nigella seeds, fennel seeds, and dried peppers and saute a few minutes until fragrant. Step 3: Add onions and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove onions and set aside. Step 5: Add chicken and brown on all sides. Step 6: Lower heat, add tomato puree and cook until cooked through, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Return onions, season with salt, chili powder, and turmeric, simmer 5 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onion, fresh lemon juice, cayenne pepper, salt, ground black pepper, cumin seed, chicken legs, chicken thighs
Instructions: Step 1: Set a yogurt strainer, or regular strainer lined with a double layer of dampened cheesecloth, over a bowl. Step 2: Add the yogurt to the strainer and let drain, in the refrigerator, for 4 to 6 hours 2. Step 3: Remove the drained yogurt from the refrigerator and discard the liquid. Step 4: Transfer the yogurt to a large nonreactive bowl. Step 5: Add the garlic, ginger, onion, lemon juice, cayenne, salt, black pepper, and cumin seeds and whisk to blend. Step 6: Set aside while you prepare the chicken 3. Step 7: Remove and discard the skin from the chicken pieces, then rinse the pieces under cold running water.

Ingredient Names: walnuts, chicken, ginger paste, garlic paste, salt, ground cumin, yogurt, oil, onion, tomatoes, green chilies, ground coriander, cream, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Grind walnuts into a fine powder using a food processor. Step 2: Cut chicken into 1 / 2 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Step 3: Add ginger paste, garlic paste, salt, half teaspoon cumin and yogurt and mix well. Step 4: Marinate the chicken for half an hour. Step 5: Heat oil in a pan, add onion and saut till lightly browned. Step 6: Add tomato puree, mix well and continue to saut till oil separates. Step 7: Add green chillies and continue to cook for two minutes. Step 8: Add ground coriander and remaining cumin, mix well and cook for one more minute. Step 9: Add the marinated chicken, mix well, cover and cook till done. Step 10: Add walnuts, simmer for two to three minutes.

Ingredient Names: skim milk, saffron thread, olive oil, cardamom pods, cinnamon, bay leaf, black peppercorns, brown basmati rice, water, salt & pepper, onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger paste, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a small bowl combine warm milk with saffron threads. Step 3: Let it steep at least 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat 3 / 4 tbs Oil in medium saucepan. Step 5: Add cardamom pods, 1 / 4 teaspoons cinnamon, bay leaf and black peppercorns. Step 6: Cook over medium heat until sizzling, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add rice and stir to coat with oil. Step 8: Add the water and 1 teaspoons of salt, bring to boil.

Ingredient Names: curry powder, ground cumin, salt, boneless skinless chicken thighs, yellow split peas, carrot, apple, onion, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, chicken bouillon cube, water, unsweetened coconut milk, raisins, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all in crockpot Cook on low for 8 hours Serve in bowls topped with raisins and almonds.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, ginger-garlic paste, plain yogurt, salt, butter, oil, raw cashew nuts, sour cream, red chili powder, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with ginger garlic paste and salt. Step 2: Let it sit for 10-20 minutes. Step 3: Heat a skillet to medium high and melt the butter. Step 4: Add chicken to the pan and cook until no longer pink. Step 5: Remove pan from heat and set aside In another pan, heat the oil and add cashews, sour cream, red chili powder, tomato sauce and the fried chicken. Step 6: Cook on medium low heat until tender and the oil separates from the sauce. Step 7: Serve hot over rice Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, curry powder, olive oil, white wine vinegar, ginger, peppercorns, salt, sugar, coriander seeds, lime zest, chicken breasts, plain yogurt, tomatoes, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare all ingredients for curry paste. Step 2: Heat fry pan and add all ingredients and heat for 4-5 minutes Scrape ingredients into blender and blend until a smooth paste Scrape out of blender and put into a small bowl Clean out your blender Curry powder will stain Assemble your blender again, as you will be using it again in a few minutes! Step 3: Clean chicken and cut into small pieces, approximately 1 inch pieces In your blender add garlic, ginger, tomato and yogurt and blend until all is nice and smooth. Step 4: Keep lid on blender and set aside for later.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, low-fat yogurt, low-fat mayonnaise, salsa, lime juice, curry powder, mango, apple, celery, fresh mozzarella cheese, cilantro, greens
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the chicken breast in an oven preheated to 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes As the chicken is baking, combine the yogurt, mayonnaise, salsa, lime juice and curry powder in a medium bowl. Step 2: Stir to combine Peel and de-seed the mango then chop into half-inch chunks. Step 3: Remove the apples core and chop into one-inch chunks. Step 4: Chop the celery into 1 / 4-1 / 2 inch chunks. Step 5: Cut the fresh mozzarella into one-inch chunks. Step 6: Add the mango, apple, celery and mozzarella to the bowl. Step 7: Toss to combine Finely chop the cilantro.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, carrot, celery, gingerroot, garlic cloves, curry paste, salt and pepper, coconut milk, chicken stock, butternut squash, granny smith apples, cooked chicken, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: In deep skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Add onion, carrot and celery. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender but not browned, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Stir in gingerroot, garlic, curry paste, salt and pepper and cook one minute. Step 5: Pour in coconut milk and chicken stock and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add squash and reduce heat to simmer for 15 minutes. Step 7: Add apple and chicken and cook just until apples are tender but still hold their shape, about 10 minutes more. Step 8: Sprinkle with coriander and serve with warm naan bread or cooked basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, fresh lemon rind, fresh lemon juice, onions, garlic, gingerroot, ground cardamom, cinnamon, whole cloves, vegetable oil, cumin seed, coriander seed, ground turmeric, ground red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a shallow dish. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt. Step 3: Combine lemon rind and juice. Step 4: Drizzle lemon mixture over chicken. Step 5: Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Step 6: Place skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 7: Add onion, and cook for 4-5 minutes or until tender, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add garlic and gingerroot. Step 9: Cook for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, ghee, ground black pepper, bay leaves, turmeric, chili powder, clove, cardamoms, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, garlic cloves, onions, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the ghee and fry all of the spiceswith the garlic. Step 2: Add the chicken and brown all over. Step 3: Add the onion and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the stock and simmer 1 hour or till meat is tender, serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken thigh, onions, vegetable oil, minced ginger, garlic paste, garam masala, sweet paprika, ground coriander, chili powder, cinnamon sticks, cardamom pods, white sugar, lemon juice, diced tomatoes, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large pan, add oil, sautee onion and set aside Brown diced chicken until just cooked and set aside. Step 2: Melt ghee over medium heat in wok or pan. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic, garam masala, sweet paprika, coriander and chilli powder to the melted ghee, maintaining medium heat. Step 4: Stir with a wooden spoon until aromas are released from the spices and they start to turn into a paste be careful not to let it burn. Step 5: Return onion and chicken to the wok or pan, stirring until everything is coated in the spice paste. Step 6: Add diced or pureed tomatoes and sugar. Step 7: Bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 8: Add lemon juice, cream and yogurt. Step 9: Simmer for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Authentic Karahi Curry With Base Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken, vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, ginger, hot water, curry powder, paprika, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala, cumin, flour, chili powder, ground fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken, or other meat You can grill, fry or oven cook meat in any way you like I often fry in oil adding a little turmeric and garlic. Step 2: Once cooked set the pre-cooked meat aside Base sauce. Step 3: Chop onions, ginger and garlic roughly 5 minutes and fry in oil until cooked, add hot water, just enought to cover onions and garlic, you may not need all 500ml. Step 4: Then simmer for 20 minutes. Step 5: After 20 minutes take off heat let cool then blend with either a hand blender or in traditional blender, then set aside Spice mix While the base sauce is cooling this is a good time to prepare you spice mix, just put all the spices in one bowl and mix together.

Ingredient Names: meat, corn oil, onion, diced tomatoes, tomato puree, fresh lemon juice, ghee, dried red chilies, black pepper, chili powder, cumin seed, fenugreek seeds, turmeric, cardamoms, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meat into cubes and fry in oil to seal. Step 2: Remove with slotted spoon and leave to one side to drain. Step 3: Fry the onion in the same oil until golden then add spices 1, cooking for a further 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the tinned tomatoes and puree and mix well. Step 5: Cook for 10 minutes or so. Step 6: Add the meat and put the the lot into a casserole dish in a pre-heated oven at 200c and cook for 45 - 60 minutes. Step 7: Stir half-way through cooking time. Step 8: Add the lemon or lime juice and spices 2 and simmer for another 10 minutes. Step 9: Add a little water at any stage if it gets too dry. Step 10: Add a knob of ghee just before serving.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic cloves, boneless chicken breasts, ground ginger, cumin, cayenne pepper, turmeric, cinnamon, salt, cream, tomato sauce, sour cream, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, saute onion and garlic in butter, until onions are soft. Step 2: Slice chicken breasts into bite sized pieces. Step 3: Combine spices and toss chicken pieces until well coated. Step 4: Add the chicken to the onions and saute until the chicken is lightly browned on all sides. Step 5: In a separate bowl or large measuring cup, combine the cream, tomato sauce, sour cream and garam masala with a whisk, then pour over chicken mixture. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 15 minutes, making sure that chicken is cooked through. Step 7: Serve over rice and garnish with cilantro if desired.

Dish Name: Bademiya's Justly Famous Chile Coriander Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken quarters, coriander seeds, whole black peppercorns, cumin seed, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, vegetable oil, water, fresh lemon juice, cayenne pepper, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Remove and discard the skin from the chicken legs, then rinse under cold running water. Step 2: Drain and blot dry with paper towels. Step 3: Place the legs in a baking dish large enough to hold them in one layer and set aside while you prepare the seasoning paste 2. Step 4: Heat a dry skillet over medium heat and add the coriander seeds, peppercorns, and cumin seeds Toast the spices until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes, shaking the skillet occasionally. Step 5: Let cool, then transfer to a spice mill and grind to a fine powder. Step 6: Combine the ground spices in a blender or mini chopper with the garlic, ginger, oil, 1 / 4 cup water, lemon juice, cayenne, and salt Process to a smooth paste, adding more water if necessary to obtain a pourable consistency.

Dish Name: Baked chicken masala with almond pilaf
Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, turmeric, curry powder, almonds, low-fat yogurt, skinless chicken breasts, tomatoes, red onions, cilantro picked
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Put the rice in a saucepan with 600ml water, 1 heaped tsp turmeric, 1 tsp curry powder and some salt. Bring to the boil, stir, cover, turn heat to low and cook for 30 mins, or until tender. Try not to take the lid off during cooking. Remove from heat and leave covered for 5 mins. Add the almonds, and fluff with a fork. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix 2 tsp curry powder, the remaining turmeric, 2 tbsp yogurt and seasoning. Add chicken and toss to coat. Step 3: Toss the tomatoes and onions in a roasting tray with the rest of the curry powder, then nestle in the chicken pieces. Bake for 15-20 mins until the chicken is cooked through and the veg are soft. Scatter over the coriander and serve with the rice and remaining yogurt.

Ingredient Names: turmeric powder, coriander seeds, mustard seed, ground cumin seeds, ground fenugreek, black peppercorns, lemons, garlic, ginger, coconut milk, red chilies, chicken bone skin, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Toast all of the spices in a dry pan, then grind to a powder using a pestle and mortar. Mix the lemon juice, garlic, ginger, coconut milk and chillies with a large pinch of salt and the other spices in a food processor to make a paste. Rub the marinade into the chicken and leave to marinate for at least 2 hrs or overnight, if possible, in the fridge. Step 2: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Place the chicken in a roasting tin and cook for 35 mins. Turn the grill to high, then grill it to crisp up the skin. Turn every few mins and cook for about 20 mins until charred. Scatter over coriander sprigs and serve with a simple salad of sliced red onion and green chilli.

Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, red onion, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, tomato paste, brown sugar, cumin seeds, garam masala, red chili pepper flakes, turmeric, salt, boneless skinless chicken breast, low-fat greek yogurt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the oil. Step 2: When it starts to get hot, add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook for 4 minutes, or until the onion is golden. Step 3: Add the tomato paste, brown sugar, cumin seeds, garam masala, red chile flakes, turmeric and salt. Step 4: Cook for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken cubes and stir well to coat. Step 6: Add the yogurt and water and cook, stirring until the chicken is done, about 8 minutes. Step 7: Serve with roti or rice.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, paprika, curry powder, red pepper flakes, salt, balsamic vinegar, grainy mustard, water, chickpeas, skinless chicken thighs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in dutch oven or large sauce pot over medium heat, add onion. Step 2: Cook until translucent, 5-6 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, ginger, paprika, curry powder, salt, and red pepper flakes. Step 4: Cook for about a minute, stirring. Step 5: Season chicken to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Add to onion mixture, cooking 2 minutes per side. Step 7: Stir in vinegar, mustard, and water. Step 8: Sprinkle chickpeas into pot over chicken. Step 9: Simmer, covered, over medium-low heat for about 40 minutes, or at least until thighs are cooked through.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, black mustard seeds, onion seeds, fennel seed, curry leaves, dried red chilies, cumin seed, pomegranate seeds, salt, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, oil, fresh green chilies, onions, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix together the mustard seeds, onion seeds, fennel seeds, curry leaves, red chillies, cumin seeds, pomegranate seeds, salt, ginger and garlic. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the spices with the green chillies and the onions, cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomato and chicken and cook over low heat till the chicken is cooked, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Serve garnished with chopped coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, cumin seed, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, whole black peppercorns, red chili powder, salt, chicken, canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, green chilies, tomato paste, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, combine the yogurt along with the spices. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic and green chilies. Step 3: Stir well to combine then add the chicken pieces. Step 4: Let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4-6 hours. Step 5: In a large deep skillet or wok on medium high heat, add the oil. Step 6: When hot, add the onions and stir fry for 4-5 minutes until slightly browned adding garlic, ginger & thai green chilies in last minute Next, carefully add the chicken along with the marinade. Step 7: Add the tomato paste and stir well. Step 8: Add in garam masala and ground almonds. Step 9: Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10-12 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, split peas, red lentils, oil, onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, ground coriander, salt, fresh coriander leaves, green chili, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the split peas and the lentils, cover with water and cook till soft and mushy In the meantime heat the oil in a wok and fry the onions till golden. Step 2: Stir in the garlic, ginger, turmeric, chilli powder, garam masala, ground coriander and salt. Step 3: Stir well and add the chicken and fry for 6 mins. Step 4: Add 11 / 2 tbsp of the fresh coriander leaves, green chilli, lemon juice and the water cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Mix in the lentils, tomatoes and the remaining coriander leaves, turn off the heat. Step 6: Heat the oil in a small pan and add the cumin seeds, when they start to pop add the garlic, red chillies, and the curry leaves, cook for 1 minute pour over the the chicken and lentils and serve.

Dish Name: Basil Cilantro And Macadamia Nut Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, fresh ginger, garlic, jalapenos, macadamia nuts, olive oil, lime juice, plain yogurt, basil, cilantro, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put ginger, garlic and peppers into a food processor and process til smooth. Step 2: Add macadamia nuts and continue to process. Step 3: Add oil, lime juice yogurt, basil, cilantro and spices and process again until smooth. Step 4: Put the chicken in a medium bowl, and add the mixture, stirring to coat all pieces. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate chicken for 12 hours This step is not necessarily required. Step 6: Heat a bit of oil in a wok, or deep dish fry pan. Step 7: Add chicken and its marinade to pan and cook thoroughly, stirring frequently, until marinade sticks to chicken This will take about 20 minutes to 1 / 2 hour The mixture will look soupy at first, and then begin to thicken up as the sauce reduces.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cream of chicken soup, hellmann's mayonnaise, curry powder, lemon juice, parmesan cheese, pepperidge farm herb dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine condensed soup, mayonnaise, curry, lemon juice, and half of the grated parmesan cheese together. Step 3: Pour over chicken in a shallow baking dish. Step 4: Mix remaining parmesan cheese with the dressing and spread evenly over top of casserole. Step 5: Bake for one hour or until chicken is cooked through I always end up doubling this recipe for my family except for one thing: the mayo I do not double the mayo, i use 1 and 1 / 2 c in my double recipe The sauce is marvelous over jasmine rice This is one of my favorite leftover dishes, it is almost better the next day!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: saffron, milk, hot green chili peppers, onions, garlic, clove, peppercorns, cardamom seed, coriander seed, cumin seed, poppy seed, mace, cilantro, fresh lemon juice, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak saffron in warm milk for 5 minutes and puree in blender. Step 2: Add chiles, onions, ginger, garlic, cloves, peppercorns, cardamom seeds, cinnamon, coriander and cumin seeds, poppy seeds, nutmeg, mace, cilantro or mint leaves and lemon juice. Step 3: Blend into smooth paste. Step 4: Put paste into large bowl, add yogurt and mix well. Step 5: Marinate chicken in yogurt mixture with salt, covered for at least 2 - 6 hours in refrigerator In skillet. Step 6: Heat oil over medium heat for 1 minute. Step 7: Add ghee and 15 seconds later add onion and fry for about8 minutes Reserve for garnish In same skillet, cook chicken with its marinade with tomatoes for about 10 minutes over medium heat, uncovered.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, ginger paste, garlic paste, salt, fresh ground black pepper, white vinegar, turmeric, oil, onions, ginger, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the salt, ginger paste, garlic paste, vinegar, turmeric and 1 tsp of the black pepper Rub the chicken with this mixture, cover and leave in the fridge for 2-3 hours. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan. Step 3: Add 2 tsp of the pepper, saut briefly, then add the sliced onion. Step 4: Cook until golden, then add the onion paste. Step 5: Fry until golden again. Step 6: Add the chicken with any marinade of juices and fry until almost dry. Step 7: Add a little water, then cook the chicken until done, about 20 minutes. Step 8: Sprinkle with the ginger strips, coriander and the remaining pepper. Step 9: Serve hot with naan bread or over basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, curry powder, garlic powder, ground ginger, salt, fresh ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Grease grill and preheat barbecue to medium. Step 2: In a small bowl, stir oil with curry and garlic powders, ginger, salt and pepper. Step 3: Using a brush or your fingers, spread spice mixture on both sides of chicken Barbecue chicken with lid down until chicken feels springy when pressed, from 6 to 8 minutes per side. Step 4: Serve with rice and raita.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, kidney beans, vegetable oil, garlic, onions, ground cumin, salt, fresh ground pepper, cilantro, boneless skinless chicken breasts, curry powder, cooked rice, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp of vegetable oil in large frying pan. Step 2: Stir in chopped garlic, cumin and onions. Step 3: Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 4: Stir in kidney beans and diced tomatoes. Step 5: Cook over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 7: Stir in chopped cilantro, keep warm. Step 8: Brush chicken breasts with remaining 2 tbsp oil, sprinkle with curry powder, salt and pepper. Step 9: Grill under broiler, turning occasionally, until no longer pink inside.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onions, garlic cloves, green chilies, fresh ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, chili powder, chopped tomatoes, coconut cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a non-stick pan over a medium high heat and use a little oil, or cooking spray to brown chicken. Step 2: Remove from pan In same pan cook onions until soft, add garlic, chillies, ginger and spices for 11 minute, or until fragrant. Step 3: Return chicken to pan and stir to coat well in mixture. Step 4: Add tomatoes and simmer gently for 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Step 5: Stir in coconut cream until heated through.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, garlic cloves, onions, salt & pepper, diced tomatoes, ground cumin, ground coriander, curry powder, chicken base, cayenne pepper, heavy cream, tomato soup
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy skillet, saute garlic and onion in butter & olive oil until soft and translucent. Step 2: Add chicken and brown. Step 3: Season with salt & pepper. Step 4: Drain the tomatoes and set aside reserving the juice To the juice add chicken base, and stir to dissolve fully. Step 5: Add this mixture to the pan along with the tomato soup, cumin, coriander, curry & cayenne. Step 6: Bring to a soft boil, turn down the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add cream and tomatoes, stir, simmer for 3 more minutes until heated through. Step 8: Serve with basmati rice & toasted naan bread.

Ingredient Names: butter, tomato sauce, salt, sugar, white pepper, dried parsley, whipping cream, water, garlic powder, ginger powder, red chili peppers, ginger, fresh cilantro, chicken breasts marinated in tandoori paste
Instructions: Step 1: Cook marinated chicken on barbeque or oven. Step 2: Cut into chunks once done, melt the butter. Step 3: Add in tomato sauce, salt, sugar, white pepper, parsley and whipping cream. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil, stirring often. Step 5: Add water according to desired thickness Mixture should not be runny or too thick- should be thick enough to coat a spoon. Step 6: Add in garlic powder, chili pepper and ginger powder, stir. Step 7: Add chicken chunks to mixture. Step 8: Stir in sauted ginger and fresh cilantro.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, plain yogurt, ground almonds, chili powder, bay leaves, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, garam masala, green cardamom pods, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, tomatoes, chicken stock cube, butter, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together in a large bowl the yogurt with the almonds, chilli, bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon, garam masala, cardamoms, ginger, garlic and the tomatoes. Step 2: Add the chicken and allow to marinate for 30 minutes. Step 3: In a wok melt the butter with the oil and fry the onion for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken and the marinade and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add the cream and stir well to blend. Step 6: Serve garnished with coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, gingerroot, garlic cloves, salt, plain yogurt, lemon, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms, cloves, red chili peppers, peppercorns, oil, tomato puree, butter, chopped tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together the cinnamon, cardamoms, cloves, chillies and peppercorns. Step 2: Mix the spices into the yogurt, add the juice of the lemon blend well. Step 3: Marinate the chicken in this mix for about two hours Crush the garlic and ginger to a pulp with the salt, this can be done with the blade of a knife. Step 4: Heat the oil in a pan or wok and fry the ginger and garlic pulp for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the chicken and spices and cook for ten minutes. Step 6: Add then tomato puree and tinned tomatoes, and butter, bring to the boil reduce the heat and simmer till the chicken is cooked. Step 7: Stir in the cream and simmer for a further 5 minutes. Step 8: Serve with boiled rice and curried pineapple Superb.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, yogurt, vinegar, ground coriander, ground cumin, red chili powder, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, salt, sugar, roma tomatoes, butter, fresh cream, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Perforate the chicken pieces with either fork tines or with little knife cuts. Step 2: Mix well the ingredients for the marinade and rub into the chicken pieces. Step 3: Let it marinate for a few hours in the refrigerator, overnight if possible for best results. Step 4: Heat half the butter on medium in a heavy-bottomed pan and put in the chicken along with the marinade. Step 5: Cover and cook for about 25 minutes or till the chicken is fully cooked. Step 6: After the liquids have evaporated, stir fry the chicken for some time in the residual fat. Step 7: Heat the remaining butter in a saucepan and add the red chilli powder, coriander, cumin and black pepper. Step 8: Fry for a few seconds. Step 9: Add the chopped tomatoes, sugar and salt and cook uncovered on medium for about 7 minutes until the puree thickens and the fat separates. Step 10: Stir in the whisked cream and reduce the heat to low.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, curry powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, boneless skinless chicken breasts, diced tomatoes with juice, lite evaporated milk, tomato paste, garam masala, unsweetened plain yogurt, salt, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan, then add the finely diced onion and chopped garlic. Step 2: Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is soft and clear but has not browned. Step 3: Add the ginger, curry powder, cumin, coriander, and cook, stirring constantly, for about a minute longer. Step 4: Add the chicken to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until it has lost its pinkness, then stir in the tomatoes, evaporated milk and tomato paste. Step 5: Allow the mixture to boil, then reduce the heat to a gentle simmer and cook for about 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through. Step 6: Stir in the remaining ingredients, adding the salt only if required, and reheat without boiling. Step 7: Serve over steamed rice, accompanied with poppadums and / or naan bread.

Ingredient Names: onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, salt, cayenne pepper, fresh ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, corn oil, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, onion, ground cumin, ground coriander, plain yogurt, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: To make the marinade: put the onion, ginger, garlic, salt, cayenne pepper, black pepper and 3 tbsp water into a blender. Step 2: Blend to a smooth paste, pushing down with rubber spatula when needed To marinate the chicken: put the sliced chicken in a bowl. Step 3: Add the marinade and mix well. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 3 hours To make the dish: pour the oil into a wide, nonstick pan set over medium-high heat. Step 5: When the oil is hot, add the cinnamon and cardamom. Step 6: Stir for 10 seconds. Step 7: Put in the onion and fry, stirring at the same time, for 6 to 7 minutes, or until the onion turns a reddish-brown color. Step 8: Add the cumin and coriander.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cardamom powder, boneless skinless chicken, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, tomato puree, natural yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil, and lightly fry all but a pinch of the cardamom powder. Step 2: Add the chicken and salt and stir until the meat is seared on all sides. Step 3: Add the spices and tomato puree and mix well. Step 4: Mix the yoghurt with 150ml water, mix and stir into the chicken, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken is tender. Step 5: Serve hot over rice with the remaining pinch of cardamom powder sprinkled over.

Ingredient Names: garlic, thumb-sized ginger, green chilies, cilantro picked, ghee, onions, turmeric, ground fenugreek, chicken breasts, cardamom pods seeds, cinnamon, tomato, yogurt, fresh cream, chapatis rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place the garlic, ginger, chillies and coriander stalks in the small bowl of a food processor with a good pinch of salt, and blend to a fine paste – or grind to a paste using a pestle and mortar. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp of the ghee or oil in a large pan, add the onions and cook slowly for 15-20 mins until golden and caramelised. Tip in the garlic-ginger paste, turn up the heat and cook for a further 5 mins. Add the ground spices and cook for 2 mins more until fragrant. Scoop the spicy onion mixture out of the pan into a bowl. Step 3: Add the remaining ghee or oil to the pan and cook the chicken over a medium-high heat until browned all over. Tip into a bowl, cover and set aside. Step 4: Return the onion mixture to the pan along with the whole spices, tomatoes and a can full of water (400ml). Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 40 mins. Step 5: Return the chicken to the pan and cook, uncovered, for a further 10 mins until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the yogurt and cream, season well and scatter with coriander leaves. Serve with chapatis and rice.

Dish Name: Cashew Chicken Fingers With Curry Mayonnaise
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, all-purpose flour, ground coriander, ground cumin, garam masala, chili powder, salt, fresh ground black pepper, chicken breasts, egg, salted cashews, butter, mayonnaise, curry powder, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 7 ingredients together in a shallow plate / bowl / ziplock bag. Step 2: Mix well Coat the chicken strips with the flour mixture by placing them into the ziplock bag and shaking it, or using chopsticks to dredge them in the plate Lightly beat the egg Shaking off excess flour, dip the chicken fingers in the beaten egg Immediately, roll the chicken in the crushed cashews to coat. Step 3: Set the nut-coated chicken onto lightly oiled baking pan. Step 4: Repeat with remaining chicken You may now bake the chicken fingers or chill it in the fridge for a few hours until you're ready to cook Just before baking, drizzle melted butter / oil over chicken and bake in preheated oven at 400f / 210c for 10-15mins, until cooked through and golden brown.

Ingredient Names: ghee, garlic, onions, curry paste, ground coriander, ground nutmeg, boneless chicken, cashews, cream, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Melt ghee or butter, in a large pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic& onions and cook, stirring, for 3 mins, or until onions are golden. Step 3: Stir in curry paste, coriander, and nutmeg. Step 4: Cook for 2 min, or until fragrant. Step 5: Add chicken and cook for 5 mins, or until chicken is browned. Step 6: Add cashwes, cream, and coconut milk, bring to the boil, reduce heat. Step 7: Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 40 mins, or until chicken is tender, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, cauliflower, ginger, garlic, cayenne pepper, cumin seed, curry powder, plum tomatoes with liquid, water, salt & freshly ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken, lemon, fresh cilantro, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in 12 inch skillet on high. Step 2: Lower heat and add onion, ginger, garlic, and cayenne and cook until it begins to brown. Step 3: Add the cumin seeds and curry, cook briefly. Step 4: Add cauliflower and cook for about one minute over high heat. Step 5: Cut up the tomatoes add them with the juice, 1 / 4 cup of water, salt and pepper. Step 6: Cover and turn heat to medium-low. Step 7: Cook for about 15 minutes. Step 8: Stir occasionally until the cauliflower is tender, add the chicken.
