Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, low-fat plain yogurt, red chili powder, garam masala powder, cumin powder, ajwain, salt, papaya, red food coloring, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make 2 deep slits on each side of the chicken. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients Apply the mixture evenly on the chicken. Step 3: Marinate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Then place the chicken in a pan. Step 5: Cover and cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is fully tender, remove from heat, heat oil in a wok. Step 6: Fry the chicken on each side on low heat for about 2 minutes or until very light brown. Step 7: Serve hot with fresh salad and mint chutney.

Dish Name: Cheats Crock Pot Indian Pakistani Chicken Curry Semi Authentic
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, pasta sauce, onion, garlic, minced ginger, salt, red chili powder, paprika, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, turmeric, dried fenugreek leaves, oil, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Throw everything into the crock pot Set to low for 4 hours Inhale and devour.

Dish Name: Chicken & chickpea salad with curry yogurt dressing
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, fat greek yogurt, mild curry powder, lemons, mint leaves, chickpeas, cherry tomato, red onions, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of water to the boil. Add the chicken breasts and some salt, then put on the lid. Turn off the heat and leave for 15 mins until cooked through. Drain, then shred the chicken. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix the yogurt, curry powder, lemon juice, chopped mint and some seasoning. Step 3: Toss the chicken and chickpeas with half the dressing, and season. Arrange on 2 plates and scatter over the tomatoes, onion, remaining mint and peanuts. Drizzle any extra dressing over the top.

Ingredient Names: coconut yogurt, tandoori spice mix, skinless chicken breasts, onions, red peppers, passata, pouch basmati rice, peas, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together 75g of the yogurt with 1 tbsp of the spice mix and some seasoning. Add the chicken and leave to marinate for at least 15 mins or up to overnight in the fridge. Heat the remaining spices, the onion and a good splash of water, and soften for 5 mins, stirring often. Step 2: Tip in the pepper chunks and passata, and simmer while you cook the chicken. Heat the grill to High, remove the chicken from the marinade and shake off any excess. Grill under a high heat until starting to char at the edges. Step 3: Tip the rice and peas into a pan with a splash of water and heat through. Stir most of the coriander into the sauce. Serve the rice alongside the chicken and sauce, scattered with the remaining coriander and the remaining yogurt on the side.

Ingredient Names: oil, chicken breasts, salt, red chili powder, turmeric, ginger paste, garlic paste, msg, ground black pepper, egg, cornflour, yogurt, green chilies, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the chicken in the marinade n leave for 1 hr, if you dont have the time then go ahead to the next step. Step 2: Put in the egg n corn flour n mix to coat well n make the marinade to stick to the chicken pieces. Step 3: Heat oil for frying, n fry the chicken pieces till light golden brown. Step 4: Make the yougurt mix n put in a bowl nearby while frying As you take out the chicken pieces just dip them directly into the yougurt mix. Step 5: When done with the chicken, take another pan & heat the oil for tempering. Step 6: Add the green chillies & curry leaves, cover immidiately with a lid because the oil will splutter alot. Step 7: Fry till charred, or blackened, be careful at this stage n lower the heat before opening the lid. Step 8: Take this pan away from the heat and add the chicken n yougurt mix. Step 9: Put it back on the heat, lower the heat n cook till the liquid from the yougurt dries up, & a dry curry is left.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken drumsticks, garlic, ginger, cayenne powder, salt, paprika, yogurt, mustard powder, lime juice, white vinegar, egg, all-purpose flour, oil, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade: Mix all ingredients well, except chicken drumsticks. Step 2: Add drumsticks and put it in refrigerator for about 4 hours or overnight. Step 3: Cook the drumsticks and marinate on stovetop at medium heat til they are tender. Step 4: Bring it to a boil. Step 5: Cook covered 15 minutes, remove the lid. Step 6: Let it cool Use a slotted spoon to remove the chicken and set it aside. Step 7: Add egg and flour to cooked marinate.

Dish Name: Chicken 65 Or Hot And Spicy Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, allspice, egg, garlic paste, ginger paste, onion, red chili powder, salt, all-purpose flour, yogurt, vegetable oil, green chilies, red food coloring, cornflour, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix corn flour, all purpose flour, egg, ginger garlic paste, chili powder and salt to thick batter. Step 2: Add water if required. Step 3: Add chicken pieces to the batter and marinate for an hour Deep fry the marinated chicken pieces till they turn golden. Step 4: Heat 4 tsp oil in a sauce pan and add slit chillies, yogurt, garam masala, red color, little salt and the fried chicken pieces. Step 5: Fry for 4-5 minutes and remove from heat. Step 6: Add lime juice, mix well and garnish with onions.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, chicken, celery ribs, onion, garlic, granny smith apples, red bell pepper, curry powder, cinnamon, cumin, all-purpose flour, chicken broth, fresh parsley, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and 1 tblsp butter over moderately-high heat until foam subsides Brown chicken, patted dry and seasoned with salt. Step 2: Transfer to a plate with a slotted spoon. Step 3: Pour off fat from casserole, add remaining 2 tblsps butter and cook celery, onion and garlic over moderately-low heat, until softened. Step 4: Add apples and cook 5 minutes. Step 5: Add bell pepper, curry, cinnamon and cumin and cook 1 minutes. Step 6: Stir in flour and cook over moderate heat 3 minutes. Step 7: Add broth and chicken and cook, covered and at a bare simmer, 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked and tender. Step 8: Transfer chicken to a plate with a slotted spoon. Step 9: Boil sauce 3-5 minutes, or until thickened slightly, and season.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, salt, fresh ginger, garlic clove, green chilies, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, coconut milk, chicken stock, cardamom pods, boneless skinless chicken thighs, beans, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wide saucepan and fry the onions gently, sprinkled with a little salt to stop them burning, until softened. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic, chillies, turmeric, cumin and coriander and cook, stirring, for another minute or so. Step 3: Stir the coconut milk and stock into the onion spice paste and when everything is incorporated add the cardamom and chicken pieces. Step 4: Bring the curry back to the boil then reduce heat and simmer gently for about 10 minutes or until the chicken is just about cooked through. Step 5: Check the seasoning and add the fine beans, cooking for about 8 minutes longer While you are cooking the beans, toast the cashew nuts in a dry frying pan until coloured a little. Step 6: Add the cashew nuts to the curry, then stir in the soured cream and half of the chopped coriander. Step 7: Serve with basmati rice, and sprinkle with more chopped coriander to serve.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onions, salt, fresh ginger, garlic clove, green chilies, turmeric, cumin, ground coriander, unsweetened coconut milk, boiling water, chicken bouillon cube, cardamom pods, boneless skinless chicken thighs, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wide saucepan and fry the onions gently, sprinkled with a little salt to stop them burning, until softened and then add the ginger, garlic, chillies, turmeric, cumin, and coriander and cook, stirring, for another minute or so. Step 2: Stir the coconut milk and prepared chicken stock into the onion spice paste and when everything is incorporated add the cardamom and chicken pieces. Step 3: Bring the curry back to the boil and then turn down the heat and simmer gently for about 10 minutes or until the chicken is just about cooked through. Step 4: Check the seasoning and add the beans, cooking for another 5 minutes or so While you're waiting for them to cook, toast the cashew nuts in a dry frying pan until colored a little, then Ladle into bowls, sprinkling with more of the cilantro as you go.

Dish Name: Chicken And Cashew Nuts In Black Spices
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, desiccated coconut, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, dried red chilies, cloves, cinnamon sticks, cashew nuts, onion, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a dry pan roast the coconut, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, red chillies, cloves and cinnamon over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add 2 oz of the cashew nuts and the onion cook for 10 mins stirring all the time to prevent burning and sticking. Step 3: Turn off the heat and allow to cool. Step 4: In a blender process the spices with 3 / 4 cup water to make a fine smooth paste. Step 5: Set the paste aside. Step 6: Wash blender Grind 1 oz of the nuts with 1 tbsp water to make a paste. Step 7: Heat the oil in a heavy pot and fry the spice mixture over low heat for 10 minutes add the ground cashew nuts and salt to taste, cook 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the chicken and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Step 9: Add 3 cups warm water and cook on low for 10 mins with the pot covered.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cooking onions, mushrooms, garlic cloves, pickled ginger, ghee, paprika, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, green cardamom pods, bay leaves, tomatoes, plain yogurt, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Chop chicken, onion and mushrooms, slice garlic very thinly. Step 2: Heat the ghee till it is just sizzling in a large wok or a heavy saucepan. Step 3: Fry the onions with the garlic, ginger, cardamoms and bay leaves. Step 4: Stir for 5-10 min until the onions are soft, then add the chicken, stir again for 3 min then turn down the heat so the chicken stays fairly soft. Step 5: After 10 min stir in the mushrooms, combine all the spices and. Step 6: Now quickly, as everything will start to stick, add the pasata, yogurt, coconut milk and the drained chick peas. Step 7: Heat through until boiling stirring fairly often, then simmer until the sauce is quite thick but smooth possibly 20-25 min, add a little boiling water if it is reducing rapidly. Step 8: Serve with rice or indian breads, possibly with chilled chopped fresh tomatoes.

Dish Name: Chicken And Lentil Curry With Cucumber Yogurt
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, curry powder, nutmeg, cinnamon, fresh ground pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, sea salt, chicken broth, tomato sauce, lentils, bay leaves, plain low-fat yogurt, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and cook until sizzling. Step 3: Cover, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 10 to 15 minutes. Step 4: Uncover and cook until liquid is almost absorbed, about 8 minutes. Step 5: Add garlic, curry powder, nutmeg, cinnamon, and pepper. Step 6: Cook until onion starts to turn golden brown and spices are fragrant. Step 7: Add broth, tomato sauce, lentils, and bay leaves. Step 8: Add chicken breasts. Step 9: Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 20 minutes. Step 10: Meanwhile, combine yogurt, cucumber, lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt in a small bowl.

Ingredient Names: chicken, turmeric, ground fennel, ground coriander, chili powder, oil, onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, salt, water, butter, curry leaves, cumin seed, fennel seed
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken so that the legs are separated from the thighs, cut each breast in two lengthwise. Step 2: Mix together in a bowl the turmeric, fennel, coriander and chili powder with 3 tbsp water to make a paste. Step 3: Heat the oil over medium heat and fry the onions, ginger and garlic, till the onions are brown, 5 minutes. Step 4: Turn the heat to low and fry the spice paste stir and cook for 5 minutes to the bowl in which the spices were mixed add 3 tbsp water, stir to remove all traces of the spices and add the water to the pan. Step 5: Stir and cook 3 minutes. Step 6: Turn the heat to medium and add the chicken, stir and fry for 4 minutes, till the chicken changes colour. Step 7: Add 1 tsp of the salt and the water, bring to the boil, cover with a lid, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 8: Melt the butter in a separate pan and add the garlic, curry leaves, cumin, fennel and red chillies. Step 9: Stir and add the spinach and 1 / 2 tsp salt. Step 10: Fry for 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Baked With Ginger And Black Pepper
Ingredient Names: lemon juice, salt, fresh ginger, ground black pepper, ground coriander, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, ground turmeric, chicken legs with thigh, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl combine lemon juice, salt, ginger, black pepper, coriander, cumin, paprika, cayenne and turmeric, mix well. Step 2: Add chicken pieces and toss to coat. Step 3: Cover chicken and set a side in fridge a minimum of 3 hours, maximum of 24. Step 4: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c, 400 degrees f, gas mark 6. Step 5: Arrange chick npieces on a baking tray, skin side down, brush with oil. Step 6: Bake in centre of oven 20 minutes. Step 7: Turn pieces over and cook a further 25 minutes until chicken is tender, basting 3-4 times. Step 8: Transfer to a warmed serving plate.

Dish Name: Chicken Bhuna Masala A Chicken Curry
Ingredient Names: cumin seed, coriander seed, cardamom pod, vegetable oil, chicken breast, salt & freshly ground black pepper, curry powder, chili powder, cinnamon stick, tomatoes, red onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, coconut milk, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, toast the cumin, coriander, and cardamom over low heat until you smell the spices, about 1 minute Grind the spices finely in a spice grinder. Step 2: Add oil to the skillet, and heat over medium-high until the oil is very hot or smoking. Step 3: Add the chicken and season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Let the chicken brown before stirring And brown evenly on each side. Step 5: Add the curry powder, chili powder, cinnamon, tomatoes, onion, garlic, ginger, coconut milk along with the rest of the ground spices and white wine. Step 6: Bring to a boil, and then simmer over low heat until the sauce thickens, about 1 hour. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper to taste and add the cilantro.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, salt, whole cardamom pods, whole cloves, cinnamon stick, vegetable oil, onions, chicken breasts, ground cloves, cardamom pods, chile, ground cumin, ground coriander, fresh ground black pepper, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 2: Bring a pan of water to a boil and add the rice, salt, cardamom pods, cloves and cinnamon stick. Step 3: Boil for two minutes and then drain, leaving the whole spices in the rice. Step 4: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onions for about 8 minutes, until browned. Step 5: Add the chicken, followed by the ground cloves, cardamom, chilies, cumin, coriander, black pepper, garlic, ginger and lemon juice. Step 6: Stir-fry 5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer the chicken mixture to a casserole and lay the sliced tomatoes on top. Step 8: Sprinkle on the cilantro, spoon on the plain yogurt and top with drained basmati rice. Step 9: Drizzle the saffron and milk over the rice and pour on 2 / 3 cup water. Step 10: Cover tightly and bake in the oven for 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, fresh ginger, boneless chicken, brown cardamom pods, whole cloves, whole black peppercorns, dried coriander, cumin seed, white poppy seeds, fresh lemon juice, garam masala, cayenne pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large, heavy frying pan and saute onions and garlic until lightly browned. Step 2: Add ginger, fry another minute or two, then transfer mixture to a large bowl. Step 3: Add chicken Grind together the cardamom, cloves, peppercorns, dried coriander, cumin and poppy seeds. Step 4: Blend with lemon juice, garam marsala, cayenne, salt, tomato paste, bay leaves and yogurt. Step 5: Stir mixture into vegetable and chicken mixture, cover and refrigerate for several hours. Step 6: Using a large, heavy frying pan, cook mixture, covered, over low heat for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring often.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, ghee, onions, cardamoms, cloves, bay leaf, rose water, hot water, salt, chicken, onion, garlic paste, ginger paste, onion paste, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Directions for the rice: Soak the rice in water for half an hour. Step 2: Take two tbsp of oil in a microwaveable bowl and add the onions. Step 3: Heat this for about 4 mins on high heat. Step 4: Take out the browned onions, add the rice and everything else except the rose water and hot water. Step 5: Heat for about 2 minutes. Step 6: Now take out the flavoured rice and add the hot water, and cook for about 10 minutes stirring once in between. Step 7: Take out and sprinkle the rose water Directions for the chicken: As per the rice, add the sliced onions in 2 tbsp of oil and cook the onions for about 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, chicken pieces, milk, yogurt, onions, ginger paste, garlic paste, green chili paste, tomato puree, red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, saffron, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix tomato puree, yogurt, ginger, garlic, green chili paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, roasted cumin powder, garam masala, coriander powder and salt, stir well. Step 2: Marinate the chicken with this mixture and keep aside for this mixture and keep aside for 3 to 4 hours, heat oil in a pan. Step 3: Fry the onions until golden brown The golden brown onions are a very very important step in pakistani cooking Do not make it less than golden brown This is why you need the extra oil. Step 4: Add the marinated chicken and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add 4 cups of water to the rice.

Dish Name: Chicken Burgers With Sour Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken, breadcrumbs, fresh mint leaves, fresh rosemary, fresh lemon rind, egg white, garlic, lettuce leaves, tomato paste, onions, tomatoes, whole grain buns, low-fat sour cream, mint leaf, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken, breadcrumbs, egg white, lemon rind, garlic, mint, rosemary and tomato paste in a processor and pulse until smooth Wet your palms. Step 2: Shape the mixture into 4 burgers. Step 3: Now make the sour cream sauce It's simple All you got to do is mix all the ingredients for it together and that's it- it's ready Spray a little oil in a non-stick pan. Step 4: Cook the burgers until well browned on both sides and cooked through. Step 5: Slice the buns horizontally. Step 6: Layer the lettuce, burger, sour cream sauce, tomato and onion on the bottom half of the bun.

Ingredient Names: chicken, lime, vegetable oil, potatoes, salt, green chilies, garlic, green cardamom pods, cloves, coriander leaves, gingerroot, white vinegar, sugar, cumin seed, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Pierce the chicken pcs with a fork. Step 2: Marinate them in salt and sour lime juice grind the masala ingredients to a paste spread this paste too over the chicken and keep at room temperature for 2 hours atleast. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and add the chicken pcs and saute for 10-12 mins until the skin of the chicken is dark and the juices run clear when the chicken pcs are pricked with a knife Halfway through add the potato slices so that they too fry with the chicken, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, curry powder, chili powder, chili, garlic, gingerroot, vegetable oil, coriander leaves, garam masala, coconut, coconut milk, tomatoes, turmeric powder, garam masala powder
Instructions: Step 1: Make a paste of the curry powder and chilli powder with a little water. Step 2: Fry the onion until translucent in the veg oil then add the garlic, ginger and chilli and stir fry on medium for a further 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the curry and chilli powder paste and stir in and fry for a further 30 secs. Step 4: Add the chicken pieces and seal well on all sides. Step 5: Add half the massalla gravy, coconut and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked, stirring constantly If needed add more massalla gravy and water to prevent the curry becoming too thick or dry. Step 6: Now add the finely chopped coriander leaves and cook for a further minute. Step 7: Serve with the whole coriander leaves sprinkled over the top Massalla gravy: fry the onion, tomatoes and garlic in the oil on a medium heat until the onions are soft and translucent and the tomatoes are beginning to go mushy. Step 8: Add half the water and simmer for 5 minutes then add the rest of the water and spices.

Ingredient Names: chicken, dried red chilies, ginger, garlic, coconut, spices, whole coriander seed, water, curry leaf, coriander powder, onions, oil, salt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or fry pan Roast the coconut, dry red chilli pcs, coriander seeds, whole spices and curry leaves till aromatic. Step 2: Then add the onions and fry till brown. Step 3: Add the ginger and garlic and fry for 5 mins more till the raw smell is gone. Step 4: Add soaked tamarind pulp, chicken, salt and coriander powder. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 water if you need a thick gravy. Step 6: Cook open for 10 mins. Step 7: Cover and cook till chicken is done. Step 8: Garnish with fresh cilantro or coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chopped tomatoes, courgette, onion, mushrooms, double cream, paprika, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, turmeric, sugar, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Fry in ghee the onions, when soft add the tomatoes, turn up the heat and stir / break down the mix Use a hand blender if you want a smooth consistency. Step 2: Add the spices, salt and contine to stir. Step 3: Add the chicken, stir until chicken turns white, then add the courgettes. Step 4: Keep cooking until the chicken is almost cooked, add the mushrooms. Step 5: Then check taste first, Add cream-check consistency and taste. Step 6: Serve with basmati rice and / or nan bread.

Ingredient Names: chicken, unsalted butter, onions, salt, flour, curry powder, ginger, black pepper, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: The day before, place whole chicken in a large saucepan. Step 2: Cover chicken with water, bring to a boil. Step 3: Lower heat and simmer for about one hour or until chicken is starting to fall off the bones. Step 4: Remove chicken and put aside to cool. Step 5: Pour stock into a large bowl. Step 6: Place in the refrigerator The next day the fat will have set. Step 7: Remove the fat and throw it away. Step 8: Meanwhile, remove chicken from bones and cut into bite size pieces.

Ingredient Names: butter, boneless chicken breast, tomatoes, onion soup mix, curry powder, water, plain yogurt, rice, peas
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, melt butter and brown chicken over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in tomato, then onion recipe soup mix and curry blended with water. Step 3: Simmer covered 15 minutes or until chicken is done, stir in yougurt. Step 4: Heat through but do not boil To serve, arrange chicken and sauce over hot rice and peas. Step 5: Serve, if desired, with flaked coconut, raisins, cashews, or almonds Microwave directions: In 2-quart casserole, heat butter at high 1 minute. Step 6: Add chicken and heat at high, covered, 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, cayenne pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, canola oil, curry powder, onion, garlic cloves, chicken broth, golden raisin, tomato paste, fresh cilantro, plain nonfat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together flour, salt and cayenne pepper in a plastic bag. Step 2: Add chicken in small batches, shaking to coat. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and cook until lightly browned. Step 5: Then add curry powder and toss to coat, remove from pan. Step 6: Add onion and garlic to pan, adding a little more oil if necessary, and cook for 2 minutes, then add broth, raisins, and tomato paste. Step 7: Return chicken to pan and simmer uncovered for 8 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro and a dollop of yogurt. Step 9: Serve with quick cooking minute rice, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, fresh green chilies, curry powder, garam masala, salt, ground turmeric, paprika, raw cashews, chicken stock, non-dairy coffee creamer, margarine
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into pieces I generally go for very slender, flat pieces perhaps an inch or so in diameter. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Step 3: Add the onions, garlic, ginger and chilies / pepper and fry over medium heat until the onions are browned. Step 4: Add the curry powder, garam-masala, salt, turmeric, paprika, and cashew paste and stir thoroughly. Step 5: Cook for 5 minutes, until the oil separates from the masala. Step 6: Add the stock, mix, and cook for 3 minutes. Step 7: Mix in the non-dairy cream, margarine, tomatoes and chicken and stir thoroughly. Step 8: Cover and simmer for 40 minutes, until the chicken is tender, stirring occasionally and checking to be sure the sauce does not stick to the bottom of the pan. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro leaves.

Dish Name: Chicken Curry Instant And Healthy Curry From Mrcurrys
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, curry powder, coconut milk, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a medium, nonstick dry pan over medium high heat. Step 2: Pour 1 tablespoon cooking oil into the pan. Step 3: Add diced onion and adequate salt to the pan and stir for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add 1- 4 teaspoon of mrcurrys Com's instant curry powder, garlic, and ginger to the pan and stir the mix for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add chicken into the pan and stir for 1 minutes. Step 6: Add diced tomato and coconut milk into the pan and cook for another 5 minutes or until the chicken pieces are cooked to your satisfaction. Step 7: Stir repeatedly to ensure that the curry does not burn and stick to the botton. Step 8: Now you have"coconut chicken curry" ready to serve Suggested serving: good to serve 4 people with cooked rice, heated tortillas, or bread.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, salt, turmeric, red chili powder, black pepper, onion, garlic flakes, gingerroot, green chilies, curry leaves, coriander seeds, red chilies, coconut, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken in chilli powder, turmeric powder, black pepper powder and salt for 15-20 minutes. Step 2: Then add in chopped onions chopped garlic chopped ginger slit green chilles and curry leaves and set aside for another 1 / 2 an hour. Step 3: Meanwhile dry roast the coriander seeds and the chillies till lightly browned. Step 4: Make a paste of this when at room temperature. Step 5: Keep aside Dry roast the scraped coconut till it is brown in colour. Step 6: Make a paste of this too, when at room temperature, and set aside. Step 7: Mix in the dry roasted coriander and chilli paste to the chicken and marinate for another 1 hour or more. Step 8: Heat a thick bottom wok or a deep pan add the chicken and 1 cup of water and cook covered on high flame making sure the chicken doesn't scorch. Step 9: Keep cooking on low after this, while stirring ocassionally.

Ingredient Names: pie crusts, oil, ground chicken, garlic, fresh ginger, salt, turmeric, coriander, cumin, diced onion, chopped tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions in oil until tender. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger and saute 30 sec. Step 3: Add spices and stir together. Step 4: Add tomatoes and 1 / 2 c water, stir. Step 5: Add chicken and cook through Done when the water is cooked out. Step 6: Put 2 t of meat on ea Piece of pie crust. Step 7: Fold over and seal.

Ingredient Names: chicken, oil, onion, cinnamon sticks, cloves, cashew nuts, curry leaves, fresh gingerroot, garlic, turmeric powder, tomatoes, chili powder, chicken stock cube
Instructions: Step 1: In a pan heat the oil and fry the onions with the cinnamon sticks, cloves, nuts and cuury leaves. Step 2: Cook till the onion starts to soften. Step 3: Add the cubed chicken and fry for 4 minutes. Step 4: Add all of the other ingredients, crumble the stock cube, stir, reduce heat to minimum. Step 5: Cover the pan with a lid and continue cooking till the chicken is done and the juices form the gravy.

Ingredient Names: light mayonnaise, plain low-fat yogurt, onions, artichoke hearts, jalapeno juice, curry powder, ground ginger, paprika, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine mayonnaise, yogurt, onion, jalapeno juice and spices in a medium bowl Being careful not to tear the artichoke hearts apart too much, gently add to spice mixture and set aside Spray a large pan with cooking spray and let heat over medium-high for about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add chicken, stirring to cook until it is no longer pink in the middle. Step 3: Pour spice mixture into the pan, gently stirring for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Serve over brown rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin, red chili powder, poppy seed, red onions, garam masala powder, star anise, cinnamon stick, coconut milk, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a small blender, like a magic bullet, process the green chilis, the ginger and the garlic cloves until a smooth paste forms, set aside. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, coriander, cumin, turmeric, lemon juice and half of the ground ginger-garlic-green chili paste. Step 3: Add chicken and let marinate for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a large frying pan, add the star anise, cinnamon stick and chopped onions and fry for 4 minutes. Step 5: Add the remaining ground ginger-garlic-green chili paste and saute for 4 minutes. Step 6: Add red chili powder and mix. Step 7: Add the marinated chicken and cook on high heat for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Reduce to medium heat, add salt and poppy seed paste and mix well. Step 9: Let the chicken cook in this paste for 8-10 minutes, uncovered.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, oil, cumin seed, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, dried red chilies, cinnamon sticks, black cardamom pods, whole cloves, allspice berries, ground turmeric, paprika, water, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the cumin seeds till they start to pop. Step 2: Add the onions, ginger, garlic and red chillies, fry till onions are soft, do not brown them. Step 3: Add the cinnamon, cloves, cardamoms and allspice stir and fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Add the turmeric and paprika, stir and add the chicken. Step 5: Fry for 5 mins over medium heat. Step 6: Add water and salt, bring to boil, cover the pan and cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Step 7: Add the tomatoes, green chilli and the ground almonds stir and cook a further 6 minutes. Step 8: Stir in the coriander leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, plain yogurt, garlic cloves, gingerroot, dried red chilies, ground turmeric, ground coriander, oil, onion, fresh green chilies, salt, garam masala, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken joints into two In blender process the yogurt, garlic, ginger, red chillies, turmeric, and ground coriander, till smooth. Step 2: In a large bowl put the chicken and cover with the spice mix, stir well and refrigerate overnight. Step 3: Transfer the chicken and its marinade to a pot, cover with a lid and cook over medium heat till the chicken is tender. Step 4: Remove from the heat. Step 5: In a large frying pan heat the oil. Step 6: Fry the onions till brown. Step 7: Add the chicken and fry for 4 mins stirring a few times. Step 8: Add the green chillies, salt and garam masala, cook for 3 minutes remove from the heat, stir in half of the coriander leaves. Step 9: Serve with the remaining coriander leaves sprinkled on top.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, salt, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, coriander seed, cumin seed, fennel seed, green cardamoms, cinnamon sticks, dried red chilies, peppercorns, bay leaves, fenugreek seeds, black mustard seeds, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken breasts in two and sever the legs at the joint With the salt mash the ginger and garlic to a pulp. Step 2: In a grinder mix together the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cardamoms, cinnamon stick, dried chillies, peppercorns, bay leaves, fenugreek seeds, and the mustard seed. Step 3: Mix in 6 tbsp water to make a past, add the garlic and ginger pulp mix well and add to the chicken, making sure that the meat is well coated. Step 4: Refrigerate overnight. Step 5: In a large pan melt the ghee over medium heat and fry the chicken with any juices for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the water, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes, turn off the heat. Step 7: Mix the split peas and lentils together and wash them till the water runs clear, drain them.

Ingredient Names: chicken, coconut, red chilies, coriander seed, poppy seed, peppercorn, cloves, bay leaves, fenugreek seeds, onions, cumin seed, refined oil, tamarind pulp, turmeric powder, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the grated coconut till light brown. Step 2: Keep aside In the same skiller roast the red chillies, coriander, peppercorns, cumin, poppy seeds, bay leaves and the fenugreek seeds in oil Grind together the roasted coconut, garlic, cloves and roasted spice mixture to a fine paste with a little water. Step 3: Marinate the chicken with salt and turmeric for 30 minutes, heat oil. Step 4: Add onions Saut till a light brown. Step 5: Add the ground masala and cook for 20 minutes. Step 6: Put in 250 ml of water and simmer for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, ground ginger, turmeric, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, salt, black pepper, water, chicken pieces, small red potatoes, cooked rice, chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a large roasting pan well, or line it with heavy-duty aluminum foil. Step 2: Place the chicken pieces and potatoes in one layer in pan. Step 3: Add oil to a saucepan and saute onions until clear. Step 4: Add spices and water and heat for approximately 5 minutes. Step 5: Pour the heated sauce mixture over the chicken and potatoes, and gently turn them so that they are coated. Step 6: Cover the pan with foil, and place it in a 350f oven and bake for 40 minutes. Step 7: Remove the foil and baste the chicken and potatoes with sauce Continue baking, uncovered, basting and turning the chicken and potatoes occasionally, about 10 to 20 minutes longer, or until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender, and the sauce is thickened If the sauce gets too dry before the end of the cooking period, add small amounts of water as needed If necessary, adjust spices or seasonings before serving.

Dish Name: Chicken In A Cashew Nut Sauce
Ingredient Names: onions, tomato paste, cashew nuts, garam masala, garlic, chili powder, lemon juice, ground turmeric, salt, low-fat plain yogurt, oil, fresh coriander, sultana, boneless skinless chicken, button mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the onions into quarters, place in a food processor or blender and process for about 1 minute. Step 2: Add the tomato puree, cashew nuts, garam masala, garlic, chili powder, lemon juice, turmeric, salt and yogurt to the processed onions Process all the spice ingredients in the food processor for a further 1-1 1 / 5 minutes. Step 3: In a heavy-based saucepan, heat the oil, lower the heat to medium and pour in the spice mixture from the food processor. Step 4: Fry for 2 minutes lowering the heat if necessary. Step 5: When the spice mixture is lightly cooked, add half the chopped fresh coriander, the sultanas and the chicken cubes and continue to stir fry for a further 1 minute. Step 6: Add the mushrooms, pour in the water and bring to a simmer. Step 7: Cover the saucepan and cook over a low heat for about 10 minutes. Step 8: After this time, check that the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick. Step 9: Cook for a little longer if necessary and serve garnished with the remaining fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillet, mushrooms, cashew nuts, golden raisins, onion, tomato puree, garam masala, garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt, lemon juice, plain yogurt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Puree onions in blender till just smooth. Step 2: Add tomato puree, cashews, garam masala, garlic, chili powder, coriander powder, lemon juice, turmeric, salt and yoghurt and blend for a minute. Step 3: In a large pan, heat oil on medium heat, and pour the onion-spice mixture into it. Step 4: Saute gently for 2 minutes, adjusting the heat if needed. Step 5: Add the chicken cubes and golden raisins and continue to stir-fry for a minute. Step 6: Add the mushrooms, pour in the water, and allow to simmer covered over medium-low heat for 10-12 minutes. Step 7: When chicken is cooked and sauce has thickened, remove to serving dish, garnish with chopped cilantro if desired, and serve.

Dish Name: Chicken In A Fried Onion Sauce
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken pieces, onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, canola oil, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, pepper, nonfat plain yogurt, water, tomatoes, salt, garam masala, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into large pieces If you must use chicken breasts, cut them into 4-6 pieces Just keep in mind that by using breasts, you're reducing both the fat content and the flavor and the result will be slightly drier chicken. Step 2: Chop half of the onions coarsely. Step 3: Cut the remaining onions into halves, lengthwise, and then crosswise into very thin slices. Step 4: Put the chopped onions, ginger and garlic into the container of an electric blender, blend to a paste. Step 5: Put the oil in a large, wide saut pan or a large, deep frying pan and set over medium heat. Step 6: When hot, put in the sliced, onions. Step 7: Stir and fry the onions until they are a deep, reddish brown color.

Dish Name: Chicken In A Red Sweet Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken meat, onions, gingerroot, garlic cloves, blanched slivered almonds, red sweet peppers, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, vegetable oil, water, lemon juice, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine onions, ginger, garlic, almonds, peppers, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne and salt in a food processor or blender. Step 2: Blend until you have a smooth paste. Step 3: Put the oil in a large, wide non-stick pan and heat til hot. Step 4: Pour in all the paste from the food processor. Step 5: Stir and fry the paste for 10-12 minutes or until you can see the oil forming tiny bubbles around it. Step 6: Put in the chicken, with the water, lemon juice and pepper and bring to a boil. Step 7: Cover, turn heat to ow and simmer gently for 25mins. Step 8: Stir a few times during this cooking period.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, tomato puree, cumin, coriander, canola oil, paprika, celery seed, cayenne, salt, ginger, cardamom, clove, garlic cloves, chicken thighs, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Whisk first 13 ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish, add chicken, stir to coat. Step 3: Bake until chicken is cooked through, about 40 minutes. Step 4: Divide rice among bowls. Step 5: Top with chicken and sauce.

Ingredient Names: boiling water, flaked coconut, chicken, ghee, onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, ground coriander, ground turmeric, ground red pepper, ground cloves, ground cardamom, salt, cashews, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the boiling water over the coconut, set aside. Step 2: In a large skillet brown the chicken pieces on both sides in 2 tbsp hot usli ghee or cooking oil for 15 minutes. Step 3: Remove from the skillet. Step 4: Set chicken aside, reserving the drippings. Step 5: Add the onion, garlic, and gingerroot to the drippings in the skillet. Step 6: Cook till onion is tender but not brown. Step 7: Stir in coriander, turmeric, red pepper, cloves, and cardamom. Step 8: Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Step 9: Stir in the coconut mixture and salt.

Ingredient Names: chicken fillets, butter, shallot, green peppers, vegetable oil, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, green cardamom pods, cloves, onion, garlic paste, ginger paste, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and saut chicken pieces for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add shallots and green pepper, stirfry for 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Remove sauteed items. Step 4: Add the oil to the remaining butter. Step 5: Add the whole spices: bay leaves, cinnamon, green cardamom and cloves. Step 6: Add onion, garlic and ginger, and fry until lightly browned. Step 7: Add ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, tomato puree and salt. Step 8: Cook gently until the oil separates. Step 9: Reduce heat and slowly add in the yoghurt while stirring. Step 10: Add chicken, shallots, green pepper and cashew-cream paste.

Ingredient Names: green apple, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh mint leaves, plain yogurt, ricotta cheese, fresh green chilies, scallion, salt, granulated sugar, garlic, gingerroot, vegetable oil, skinless chicken breasts, golden raisin
Instructions: Step 1: Place the apple, 3 tbsp of coriander, mint, yogurt, ricotta, chillies, scallions, salt, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a food processer and process for 1 minute Scrape around the outside of the bowl and process for a few seconds more. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or a large pan, pour the yogurt mixture and cook gently over low heat for about 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken pieces and stir well to blend everything together. Step 4: Cook over a medium-low heat for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked. Step 5: Sprinkle the raisins and remaining cilatro over the chicken Plate and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, jalapeno peppers, fresh coriander, curry paste, frozen chopped spinach, tomatoes, chicken stock, boneless skinless chicken breast, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Cook onion, garlic & ginger, stirring occasionally For 3 minutes. Step 3: Add jalapeno pepper, coriander and curry paste. Step 4: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 5: Add spinach, tomato, stock and salt. Step 6: Cook over medium-high heat for 2 minutes, add chicken. Step 7: Cook for 7 minutes or until no longer pink inside. Step 8: Stir in garam masala.

Dish Name: Chicken In Tomato And Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: dried coconut, boiling water, cilantro leaf, green chili, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, tomato puree, chicken thighs, salt, half-and-half
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the coconut in the hot water for 10-15 minutes. Step 2: Puree the coconut and its soaking water in a blender with the coriander, chilies, garlic, and ginger until smooth. Step 3: Put the passata, chicken and salt in a saucepan, at least 12 inches in diameter, and place over medium heat. Step 4: When the passata begins to bubble, reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 20 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the blended coconut mixture and heat until the sauce begins to bubble again, then cover the pan and cook for 10-12 minutes. Step 6: Finally, add the half-and-half, cook for 1 minute and serve at once.

Dish Name: Chicken In Tomato Black Pepper And Coriander Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken legs, lemon, salt, fresh ginger, garlic, onions, canola oil, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms, cloves, paprika, turmeric powder, coriander powder, black peppercorns, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each chicken quarter into 3 pieces If you are using leg quarters, separate the leg from the thigh and cut the thigh into 2 Apply lemon juice and salt to the chicken, keep aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a large pan. Step 3: Toss in the cinnamon, cardamoms and cloves. Step 4: Let these sizzle gently on medium flame until the cardamom pods have plumped up. Step 5: Add the ginger-garlic and onion puree. Step 6: Stir-fry on medium heat for 6 minutes or until the onion juice begins to evaporate. Step 7: Lower flame and stir-fry for 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, green cardamoms, green chilies, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, ground cumin, salt, garam masala, cucumber, green chili, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast 1 tbsp of the cumin seeds for 5 minutes set aside to cool. Step 2: Heat the oil i n a heavy based pan and remaining cumin seeds with the peppercorns, and cardamom for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the chillies, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the ground coriander, ground cumin and salt cook 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken thighs and legs stir to cover with the spices, cover with a lid and cook for 25 minutes over medium heat. Step 6: When th chicken is cooked add the garam masala and toasted cumin seeds. Step 7: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Mix together the cucumber, yogurt, chili, and salt. Step 9: Sprinkle the ground cumin over the yogurt mix and serve as a dip for the chicken.

Ingredient Names: rotis, boneless chicken, ginger paste, garlic paste, green chili paste, salt, onions, carrot, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, oil, cumin powder, chaat masala, chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken cubes with ginger, garlic and the green chilli pastes and salt for 30 minutes, heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Saute chicken cubes in it till done. Step 3: Add cumin powder, chaat masala and check to see if the seasoning is right. Step 4: Mix onion and carrot. Step 5: Now start making the kathi rolls For this, put 1 tsp Of oil on a flat bottomed pan and lightly heat the rotis Smear each roti with 1 tbsp Of green chutney.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, green onion, yellow onion, masala, olive oil, tomatoes, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet, while oil heats, thinly slice both the green and yellow onions. Step 2: Add to the pan and stir fry until light golden brown. Step 3: Add ground chicken, pullao biryani malala and chicken tikka masala to the skillet and stir fry for around 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Pour into serving plate and top with diced tomato and ginger Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: onion, yellow bell pepper, chopped tomatoes, garlic clove, fresh ginger, fresh coriander, garam masala, turmeric, ground coriander, chili powder, sultana, creamed coconut, salt, olive oil, chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Take all the items on the list except olive oil, chicken, cumin, and cream, and chop before adding to a blender Pulse and blend mixture until smooth as possible, set aside. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a hot large frying pan / saucepan. Step 3: Cut chicken into small pieces and fry until beginning to brown. Step 4: Add cumin seeds and continue until nicely browned Overall chicken browning time should be around 8 minutes. Step 5: Add blended ingredients to the chicken, cover, and simmer on a moderate heat for 15 minutes stir regularly to prevent sticking. Step 6: Finally add cream, and allow to heat through. Step 7: Check seasoning, add more coconut and coriander if required.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, cayenne, buttermilk, tomatoes, ground almonds, cashews, whole chickens, salt, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add onions and saute for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic and cayenne. Step 4: Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add buttermilk and tomatoes. Step 6: Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Step 7: Add nuts, chicken and salt. Step 8: Cook over low heat for 1 hour, or until chicken is tender. Step 9: Pour cream over chicken and stir well.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, garlic, ginger, fresh parsley leaves, green chilies, curry leaves, all-purpose flour, cornflour, salt, red food coloring, egg, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Break each chicken wing into two parts at the joint. Step 2: Take each part and pull back the meat from one end of the bone to the other carefully, making sure that you do not pull the meat completely out. Step 3: Put all the chicken lollipops in a bowl. Step 4: Add ginger and garlic to the chicken, mix well. Step 5: Add green chillies, parsley and curry leaves to the same, mix well. Step 6: Add half a cup of all purpose flour and quarter cup of cornflour to the same. Step 7: Mix well Break one egg into the bowl.

Ingredient Names: chicken, red chili powder, lemon juice, salt, curds, ginger paste, garlic paste, garam masala powder, butter, mustard oil, garam masala, tomato puree, sugar, fresh cream, dried fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: Skin and clean the chicken. Step 2: Make incisions with a sharp knife on breast and leg pieces Apply a mixture of red chilli powder, lemon juice and salt to the chicken and leave aside for half an hour Hang the yogurt in a muslin cloth for 15-20 minutes to remove extra water. Step 3: Add red chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, garam masala powder and mustard oil Apply this marinade to the chicken pieces and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Step 4: Put the chicken onto a skewer and cook in a moderately hot tandoor or a preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until almost done Baste it with butter and cook for another 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove and keep aside. Step 6: Heat butter in a pan.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, shallot, white onion, butter, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, chili powder, ground cumin, bay leaf, plain yogurt, half-and-half, tomato puree, cayenne pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Step 2: Saute shallot and onion until soft and translucent. Step 3: Stir in butter, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, 1 teaspoon garam masala, chili powder, cumin and bay leaf. Step 4: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 5: Add tomato puree and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 6: Stir in half-and-half and yogurt. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Season with salt, pepper and cayenne. Step 9: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 10: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large heavy skillt over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, fresh garlic, dried oregano, salt and pepper, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, prune, green olives, capers, bay leaves, brown sugar, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all except brown sugar and white wine & marinate overnight Next day: Dissolve 1 cup brown sugar in 1 cup white wine Gently mix into marinated chicken and bake in preheated 350f oven 1 hour or until done. Step 2: Garnish with chopped cilantro ~1 / 4 cup or so. Step 3: Serve with white rrice.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, ginger paste, garlic paste, white pepper, salt, egg, cheddar cheese, green chilies, coriander, cream, mace, nutmeg, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: If you are using wooden or bamboo skewers, be sure to soak them in water so that they dont splinter or burn on you. Step 2: Mix together the ginger, garlic, salt and pepper Rub this mix into the chicken and set aside for at least 15 minute. Step 3: Mix together the egg, cheese, chillies, coriander, cream, mace, nutmeg and cornstarch Rub this mixture into the chicken as well Marinade for a minimum of 3 hours. Step 4: Thread the chicken strips onto the skewers If you are putting more than one piece on a skewer, leave them spaced about 1 in apart. Step 5: Grill the kebabs for 5 min, or roast in the oven @ 275 degrees, or place in the rotisserie according to appliance directions If you are using the rotisserie, you may roast them until they are done.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, carrots, sweet potatoes, garbanzo beans, chicken breasts, turmeric, cumin, pepper, cinnamon, chopped tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 6 ingredients into slow cooker Mix spices and sprinkle over the food, add tomatoes Cover and cook on high 4 hours.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, all-purpose flour, canola oil, onion, garlic, garam masala, diced tomatoes, cream of chicken soup, light coconut milk, salt and pepper, frozen peas, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts and flour in zip-top bag Shake until chicken is coated with flour. Step 2: Remove from bag, shaking off excess flour and set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 4: When oil is hot, add the chicken breasts and fry until golden brown on both sides. Step 5: Remove chicken to a plate and set aside. Step 6: Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until soft. Step 7: Add the garam masala, tomatoes, soup, coconut milk, and salt and pepper to taste and bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce the heat to a simmer and return the chicken breasts to the pan. Step 9: Simmer for 15 minutes, then add the frozen peas.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, black cumin seeds, black peppercorns, red chilies, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast curry leaves for a min on low flame till it turns crispy. Remove from the heat and keep aside. Step 2: Dry roast red chilies till it changes its color a bit. Remove from the heat. Step 3: Dry roast coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, black cumin seeds and peppercorn together till nice aroma comes. Step 4: Remove from the heat and allow to cool. Step 5: Grind everything together to powder. Add salt to it and mix well. Store in an airtight container and use when needed.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, egg, plain breadcrumbs, tomato paste, salt, black pepper, garam masala, fresh cilantro, ghee, yellow onion, garlic cloves, chilies, ginger, ground turmeric, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the chicken, egg, bread crumbs, tomato paste, salt, pepper, garam masala, and 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro until well incorporated. Step 2: Shape into meatballs about the size of a golf ball. Step 3: Set a large skillet with high sides over medium-high heat with the ghee. Step 4: Once hot, sear the meatballs in batches, for about 8 minutes, turning over halfway. Step 5: Transfer to a plate and continue browning the rest of the meatballs You don't need them to be fully cooked, just brown in color They'll continue to cook later on. Step 6: Add the remaining tablespoon ghee or oil to the same skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Once hot, add in the onion, garlic, and peppers and cook until softened, about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in the ginger, spices, and tomato paste.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, madras curry powder, salt, egg, cream, flour, sesame seeds, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Dry chicken pieces with paper towels. Step 2: Combine curry powder & salt & rub well into chicken until evenly coated. Step 3: Beat egg & cream together. Step 4: Combine flour & sesame seeds. Step 5: Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and then into flour mixture. Step 6: Place in a baking dish lined with foil. Step 7: Brush chicken lightly with melted butter & bake at 180 C for about 45 mins brushing again with butter halfway through cooking time.

Dish Name: Chicken Mulligatawny Soup From The Frugal Gourmet
Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, water, ghee, garlic cloves, yellow onion, celery ribs, carrots, turmeric, coriander seed, red pepper flakes, cumin, cardamom, dried ginger, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4-quart pot, simmer the chicken, covered, in 4 cups of water until tender, about 30 minutes. Step 2: Remove, cool, debone, and chop the meat and skin coarsely Save the stock in the pot. Step 3: Set the meat aside. Step 4: Heat a large frying pan and add the ghee, garlic, onion, celery, and carrot. Step 5: Saute just until the onion is tender. Step 6: Add this to the pot of reserved stock. Step 7: Add 4 more cups of water to the pot along with all remaining ingredients except the garnishes and chicken. Step 8: Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Step 9: Add the deboned chicken.

Ingredient Names: naan bread, yogurt, garam masala, salt, lemon juice, chili powder, fresh coriander, green chili, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Cut into the middle of each naan to make a pocket and set aside. Step 2: Mix together the next 7 ingredients and then pour over the chicken and leave to marinade for about an hour. Step 3: When ready to cook the chicken, preheat the grill to very hot, then lower the heat to medium. Step 4: Place the chicken in a flameproof dish and grill for about 15-20 mins, until tender and cooked through, turning the chicken a couple of times. Step 5: Remove from the grill and fill each naan with chicken I also add shredded lettuce, red onion rings and cherry tomato halves, but feel free to do your own thing!

Dish Name: Chicken Naan Wiches With Date And Yogurt Sauces
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, panko breadcrumbs, ground cumin, cayenne, garam masala, flour, egg, mayonnaise, paprika, olive oil, butter, naan bread, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each chicken breast horizontally, stopping 1 / 2 inch from edge Open each breast and pound to 1 / 4 inch thickness or so the chicken is the same size of the naan bread. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon of the pepper In large pie plate, place panko. Step 3: Stir in cumin, cayenne, garam masala and remaining 3 / 4 teaspoon pepper In another pie plate, place 1 / 2 cup of the flour In third plate, whisk egg and mayonnaise with paprika. Step 4: Whisk in remaining 3 / 4 cup flour until smooth Dredge 1 chicken breast in flour Shake off excess.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, olive oil, cumin seed, onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, boneless skinless chicken breasts, chicken broth, garam masala, ground cumin, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, bay leaf, sundried tomato & oregano salad dressing, peas
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice and place in medium bowl. Step 2: Add enough cold water to cover rice and let stand 10 minute While rice is soaking, heat oil in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat, add cumin seed. Step 3: Cook and stir 30 sec. Step 4: Stir in onions, garlic and ginger. Step 5: Cook 5 minute or until crisp-tender, stirring constantly If using chicken add now. Step 6: Cook and stir 2 minute. Step 7: Drain rice and add to chicken mixture with remaining ingredients.

Dish Name: Chicken Paratha Indian Flat Bread Stuffed With Ground Chicken
Ingredient Names: plain flour, milk, water, baking powder, egg, ghee, salt, ground chicken, potatoes, coriander leaves, tomatoes, green chilies, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Knead together the flour, ghee, egg, baking powder, water, milk and salt. Step 2: Divide the dough into equal-sized round balls. Step 3: Roll out each ball into discs with a rolling pin on a lightly floured surface To prepare the filling, heat the ghee in a frying pan, and saute garlic till light brown. Step 4: Add the mince and green chillies and saute till the mince is cooked. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients for the stuffing and mix till the stuffing is dry. Step 6: Divide the stuffing into the same number of portions as discs and spoon into the middle of each disc. Step 7: Bring the edges together and seal Gently shape it back into a ball. Step 8: Roll out each ball into a disc 1 / 2 inch thick.

Ingredient Names: spinach, oil, onion, curry paste, potato, chicken stock, fillets, salt, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil and add the onion, curry paste and the potato. Step 2: Stir until potato starts to brown, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the stock and bring to a rapid boil. Step 4: Add the chicken and the spinach. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 7 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and fresh lime juice.

Dish Name: Chicken Pulao With Lemon And Onion
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, sunflower oil, onions, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, chili powder, chicken breasts, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the rice and double the quantity of water in a heavy saucepan, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce the heat and simmer partially covered until done Run a fork through to loosen the grains, cover the pan with a lid and reserve. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok, fry the onion. Step 4: When translucent, remove half of the slices and reserve Continue to fry the remaining onion until dark golden in color. Step 5: Drain and reserve separately. Step 6: Put the translucent onion back into the wok and add the ginger-garlic paste.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, garlic clove, ground cinnamon, ground turmeric, ground cumin, curry powder, cayenne pepper, salt, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 2: Bring water to boiling and add chicken bouillon cubes, lower heat and simmer till dissolved--keep it hot. Step 3: Sprinkle chicken with half the spices. Step 4: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet on med-high to high heat and fry the chicken till both sides are brown, lower heat to medium and remove the chicken to a plate In that same skillet saut the onions for 2 minutes, then add the garlic and remaining spices and saut another 2 minutes, then turn off the burner. Step 5: Add the rice and stir for about 30 seconds to 1 minute, till well coated. Step 6: Spread rice in the baking dish and place the chicken thighs over the rice Gently pour in the chicken stock and cover tightly with foil. Step 7: Bake for 40-45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: frozen spinach, onion, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, fresh green chile, black peppercorns, tomatoes, curry powder, cayenne pepper, vegetable oil, bay leaves, chicken, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Puree everything but the last four recipe items in a food processor. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet or medium saucepan. Step 3: Saute the bay leaves for a couple minutes. Step 4: Add the spinach puree and the chicken. Step 5: Simmer until chicken is tender 30-60 minutes. Step 6: Add cream or yogurt, heat through. Step 7: Add some water or milk if spinach seems too dry, serve when hot.

Ingredient Names: spinach, boneless chicken, onion, garlic, potatoes, butter, oil, bay leaf, salt, peppercorns, milk, bread, black pepper, oregano, red chili pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and shred the spinach Next, wash and cut the chicken into small dices Peel and finely chop the onion Likewise, do the same for garlic. Step 2: Put the potatoes in boiling water, allow to become tender, then, peel and mash them. Step 3: Heat oil and butter combo in a soup pot, add bay leaf. Step 4: Add garlic and onion and saute, add spinach. Step 5: Discard the bay leaf.

Dish Name: Chicken Thighs With Lime And Curry
Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, flour, pepper, oil, red onion, garlic, stock, curry powder, hot pepper sauce, lime, fresh cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Blend flour and pepper, and dredge thighs in mixture Brown chicken in oil. Step 2: Remove chicken to a plate. Step 3: Add onion, garlic, and flour, and saute. Step 4: Add broth, curry, and pepper sauce and stir to blend well. Step 5: Simmer mixture for 2 minutes, then bring to a boil and add chicken, lime zest and lime juice. Step 6: Cook until chicken is cooked through. Step 7: Add cilantro and sour cream just before serving.

Dish Name: Chicken Tikka Masala By Jamie Oliver
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red chilies, olive oil, mustard seeds, paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, plain yogurt, chicken breasts, butter, onions, tomato puree, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Grate the garlic and ginger and put to one side in a bowl. Step 2: Chop the chillies as finely as possible and mix them in with the garlic and ginger. Step 3: Heat a good splash of oil in a pan and add the mustard seeds. Step 4: When they start to pop, add them to the ginger and garlic mixture along with the paprika, cumin, ground coriander and 2 t of the garam masala. Step 5: Put half of this mix in a bowl, add the yogurt and the chicken pieces to it, stir and leave to marinate for about a half an hour. Step 6: Melt butter in the same saucepan the mustard seeds were in and add the sliced onions and the remaining half of the spice mix. Step 7: Cook gently for about 15 minutes without browning too much. Step 8: Add the tomato puree, ground nuts, 2 1 / 2 c of water and 1 / 2 t of salt. Step 9: Stir well and simmer gently for a few minutes. Step 10: Let this sauce reduce until it thickens slightly and then place to one side.

Dish Name: Chicken Tikka Masala East Indian Cuisine
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh ginger, garlic, water, plain yogurt, vegetable oil, lemon, ground cumin, ground mace, nutmeg, ground cardamom, salt & pepper, tomatoes, green bell pepper, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken recipe: in a large bowl, combine yogurt, vegetable oil, lemon juice, 4 teaspoons of the ginger / garlic paste that you made in the blender, cumin, mace, nutmeg, cardamom, salt and pepper and mix well Rub the chicken breasts thoroughly with this mixture and place in a glass baking dish, cover and refrigerate for 4 hours. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 3: Remove chicken breasts from marinade and discard remaining marinade. Step 4: Place the chicken in a baking dish Roast for 8 to 10 minutes, basting with vegetable oil and pan drippings at least twice. Step 5: When the chicken is tender and cooked through and its juices run clear, remove from the oven and keep warm Just before serving, slice the cooked chicken and place it in the simmering masala sauce for a few minutes, until heated through. Step 6: Serve hot Masala sauce recipe: about half an hour before you finish marinating the chicken, start the masala sauce.

Dish Name: Chicken Tikka Masala With Seasoned Jasmine Rice
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, plain nonfat yogurt, lemon juice, cumin, ground red pepper, cinnamon, salt, ground black pepper, butter, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, ground coriander, ground cumin, paprika, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from chicken breasts and discard or add to chicken stock bag. Step 2: Cut chicken breasts into 1 inch cubes. Step 3: Place in medium bowl with marinade ingredients. Step 4: Mix together well and refrigerate 1 hour For sauce, heat butter in large skillet on medium heat, saute garlic. Step 5: Add tomato sauce and spices. Step 6: Stir together and reduce heat to low, allowing to simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in heavy whipping cream, allow to simmer. Step 8: Thread marinated chicken cubes onto skewers.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, salt, plain yogurt, sour cream, cucumber, tomatoes, mint leaf, cumin seed, fresh ground pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh ginger, vegetable oil, chinese mustard, fresh lemon juice, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Soak six 12-inch bamboo skewers in warm water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Thread the chicken onto the skewers and set in a shallow glass baking dish On a cutting board, use the side of a large knife to mash the garlic, ginger and salt to a paste. Step 3: In a bowl, whisk the paste with the yogurt, mustard oil, lemon juice, cumin, mace, nutmeg, cardamom, turmeric, cayenne and black pepper. Step 4: Pour the marinade over the chicken, turn to coat. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours, turning occasionally Raita: on a cutting board, use the side of a large knife to mash the garlic with a large pinch of salt to a paste. Step 6: In a medium bowl, mix the garlic paste with the yogurt, sour cream, cucumber, tomato, mint and toasted cumin. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper and put in refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: chicken, salt & freshly ground black pepper, ghee, garlic cloves, yellow onions, ginger powder, cumin powder, yellow mustard seeds, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, turmeric, cayenne pepper, paprika, lemon juice, distilled white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Salt and pepper the chicken quarters. Step 2: Heat a large frying pan and brown the chicken in the ghee You will have to do this in two batches. Step 3: Remove the chicken to a 6-quart stove-top covered casserole, leaving the fat in the pan. Step 4: Add the garlic and onion to the pan and saut until golden brown. Step 5: Add to the casserole along with the ginger, cumin, mustard seed, cinnamon, cloves, turmeric, cayenne, and paprika Saut all for a few minutes and add all the remaining ingredients except for the garnishes. Step 6: Cover and simmer until the chicken is tender About 45 minutes. Step 7: Stir a few times during cooking.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, potato, coriander seed, cumin seed, hot chili powder, turmeric, garlic cloves, ginger, salt, paprika, ground fenugreek, tomato puree, warm water, malt vinegar, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix together the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, chilli power, turmeric, garlic pulp, ginger pulp, salt, paprika, tomato puree, fenugreek with the water and vinegar. Step 2: Add the chicken and allow to stand till needed. Step 3: In a wok heat the oil and fry the onion and curry leaves till golden. Step 4: Reduce the heat and add the chicken with the spice mix and stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the potato, cover the wok with a lid and cook over low heat till the potato is cooked. Step 6: Garnish with green chillies.

Dish Name: Chicken Walnut And Red Grape Salad With Curry Dressing
Ingredient Names: curry powder, light mayonnaise, plain nonfat yogurt, mango chutney, fresh ginger, orange peel, chicken breasts, red seedless grapes, green onion, walnuts, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Stir curry powder in a small skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 2: Transfer to a medium bowl. Step 3: Add mayonnaise, yogurt, chutney, ginger and orange peel, whisk to blend. Step 4: Stir in chicken, grapes, green onions, and walnuts. Step 5: Season salad to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Place one lettuce leaf on each of 4 plates. Step 7: Top each lettuce leaf with salad. Step 8: Garnish each plate with grape clusters.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, blanched almond, onions, garlic cloves, green chilies, fresh gingerroot, oil, cinnamon stick, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, ground turmeric, paprika, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Grind almonds in a food processor. Step 2: Put in bowl and set aside. Step 3: Add onions, garlic, chiles and ginger to food processor and finely chopped, but not pureed. Step 4: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat and add onion mixture and cinnamon stick. Step 5: Stir until onions are lightly browned. Step 6: Add chicken thighs to pan and fry, turning constantly, for 10 minutes, or until golden on all sides. Step 7: Add coriander, cumin, chili powder, turmeric, paprika, salt and pepper to pan and stir with the chicken for about 3 minutes. Step 8: Add 1 / 3 cup water, stirring chicken for another 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 9: Add another 2 / 3 cup water and bring to a boil. Step 10: Reduce heat, cover pan and simmer 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken With Coconut Milk Lemongrass And Ginger
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, chilies, fresh ginger, fresh lemongrass, potatoes, black cumin seeds, ground turmeric, coconut milk, half-and-half, coarse salt, whole chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saute pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onions and chiles and lower the heat. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, for about 10 minutes, or until the onions are golden brown and well caramelized. Step 4: Stir in the ginger and lemongrass and saute for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the potatoes and stir to combine. Step 6: Stir in the black cumin and turmeric. Step 7: When the spices are well incorporated, stir in the coconut milk and the half-and half. Step 8: Add salt and remove from the heat. Step 9: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Step 10: Place the chicken in a dutch oven or another large heavy ovenproof casserole.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, vegetable oil, onion, red bell pepper, fresh ginger, curry powder, ground coriander, garlic, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, cornstarch, mangoes, basmati rice, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt. Step 2: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add the chicken. Step 3: Cook 3 minutes on each side or until done, remove from pan, keep warm. Step 4: Heat 2 teaspoons oil in pan over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add chopped onion and bell pepper. Step 6: Saute 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Add 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, ginger, curry, coriander, and garlic, and saute 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, fresh lemon juice, unsweetened apple juice, white wine, curry powder, ground coriander, ground ginger, ground turmeric, onion, garlic, honey, salt & fresh ground pepper, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except chicken and honey, in a medium skillet, mix thoroughly. Step 2: Place chicken in the pan and turn several times to coat. Step 3: Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Turn on heat and simmer for 25 minutes, turning chicken every 10 minutes. Step 5: Add honey, stir and cook for 10 minutes more, or until chicken is throughly cooked. Step 6: Serve along side basmati rice and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, cider vinegar, paprika, angostura bitters, hot pepper sauce, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the lime juice, vinegar, paprika, bitters and hot pepper sauce in a glass baking dish Wearing kitchen gloves, split the jalapeno pepper, remove seeds. Step 2: Mash the pepper with the garlic into a smooth paste using a mortar or an electric spice grinder. Step 3: Add the paste to the lime mixture in the baking dish and combine. Step 4: Toss the chicken pieces and swish them in the marinade until they are completely coated. Step 5: Cover and let marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Step 6: Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill or broil until cooked through and burnished, about 20 minutes on each side Baste frequently with the marinade If the chicken looks like it is beginning to burn, move it farther away from the heat source. Step 7: Serve hot with chilled orange sections and plenty of napkins.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, skinless chicken breasts chunks, skinless, onions, curry paste, cauliflower florets, chicken stock, tomato, chickpeas, yogurt, spinach, basmati rice following instructions, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Start by making the curry. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large, deep frying pan. Season the chicken and fry until browned, then remove and set aside. Fry the onion in the rest of the oil for 10-12 mins until soft and starting to caramelise. Step 2: Add the paste and cauliflower, stirring to coat everything, then return the chicken. Pour in the stock, tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer everything for 30 mins until the cauliflower is nearly tender. There should be just enough liquid to cover everything so add a splash more water or stock if you need to. Remove from the heat and stir in the yogurt. Step 3: Assemble the bake in either 1 large or 2 smaller, deep ovenproof dishes. Start with a ¹/³ of the spinach leaves, season, then top with a ¹/³ of the curry. Finish with a ¹/³ of the rice then repeat twice more. Scatter on the almonds and either cool completely to freeze, or heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7 and cook for 20-25 mins until the topping has crisped up and the dish is piping hot through.

Ingredient Names: fat greek yogurt, masala paste, fresh cilantro, lime zest, skinless, wholemeal chapatis, cherry tomatoes hulled, red onions, cucumbers
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl mix the yogurt, paste, half the chopped coriander, half the lime juice and all the the zest. Tip in the chicken, stir to coat and leave in the fridge to marinate for 30 mins if you have time. Step 2: Thread the chicken onto 8 skewers and cook in batches on a hot griddle pan, frying pan or barbecue for about 10-12 mins, turning until cooked though. Step 3: Meanwhile, mix the salad ingredients with the remaining lime juice and coriander in a bowl and season. Sprinkle with extra coriander and serve alongside the skewers with warmed wholemeal chapatis.

Ingredient Names: low-fat yogurt, curry paste, boneless, cherry tomatoes, wholemeal chapatis warmed, cucumbers, red onions, fresh cilantro, lemons, lamb's lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Put 8 wooden skewers in a bowl of water to soak. Mix the yogurt and curry paste together in a bowl, then add the chicken (if you have time, marinate for an hr or so). In a large bowl, toss together the cucumber, red onion, coriander and lemon juice. Chill until ready to serve. Step 2: Shake off any excess marinade, then thread the chicken pieces and cherry tomatoes onto the pre-soaked skewers. Cook under a medium grill for 15-20 mins, turning from time to time, until cooked through and nicely browned. Step 3: Stir the lettuce or pea shoots into the salad, then divide between 4 plates. Top each serving with 2 chicken tikka skewers and serve with the warm chapatis.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, low-fat yogurt, tikka paste, cucumbers, mint leaves, red onions, easy-cook long grain rice, curry powder, peas, red peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Slash each chicken breast deeply with a knife 3-4 times on one side. Put in a bowl and add 50g of the yogurt and the tikka paste. Mix well, cover and marinate in the fridge for 30 mins. Make the raita by stirring the cucumber and most of the mint into the rest of the yogurt. Season with black pepper, cover and chill. Step 2: Heat oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 9. Scatter the onion wedges over a foil-lined baking tray. Remove the chicken from the marinade, shake off any excess and place on top of the onion wedges. Cook for 20 mins. Step 3: Meanwhile, tip the rice, curry powder, peas and pepper into a pan of boiling water and simmer for 10 mins or until the rice is just tender. Drain well and divide the rice between 4 plates. Add the chicken, roasted onion and remaining mint. Serve with the cucumber raita.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, iceberg lettuce, green onions, mint leaves, plain naan bread, chicken tikka, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Toss all the salad vegetables together. Step 2: Heat the naan breads in the microwave on Medium for 1 min until puffed up. Step 3: Remove the breads. Step 4: Tip the tikka pieces into a bowl and give them a quick blast in the microwave to heat through. Step 5: Split the breads in half and stuff with the salad, chicken and a spoonful of yogurt.

Ingredient Names: red lentils, garlic, onions, butter, ground ginger, curry powder, chili powder, chicken breasts, potatoes, tomatoes, plain yogurt, mango chutney, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the lentils, garlic and onions in the butter. Add the ginger and curry powder and continue to cook for 10 minutes over a low heat. Step 2: Add the chicken and potatoes. and cook for another 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and enough water to cover the mixture.
