Step 4: Cover and cook until all the water is absorbed (about 20- 30 minutes) Add the yoghurt and chutney and season. Step 5: Mix well and serve with boiled rice.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, chicken thigh fillet, potatoes, mild curry paste, tomato passata, fine green beans, yogurt, plain rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and chicken together over a medium heat for 5 mins until the onion is soft. Step 2: Add the potatoes, curry paste and passata, bring to the boil, then cover and gently simmer for 15 mins. Add the beans and a splash of water and cook for 10-15 mins more until all the vegetables are tender and the chicken is cooked through. Remove from the heat and stir in the yogurt. Serve with rice or naan.

Ingredient Names: skinless, limes, ground black pepper, turmeric, vegetable oil, tamarind pulp, coconut milk, coconut cream, fresh coriander, mustard seed, onions, garlic, ginger, paprika, tomatoes, chicken stock, golden muscovado sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put the chicken in a big mixing bowl, add the lime juice, pepper and turmeric, and mix well. (It’s best to use gloves for this as the turmeric stains fingers.). Step 2: Set aside for 1 hr. Step 3: Make the sauce. Heat the oil in a big pan, toss in the mustard seeds followed by the fresh curry leaves (if you are using dried leaves, add them later with the tomatoes) and fry until it releases a warm, nutty aroma – about 30 secs. Step 4: Add the onions, put on the lid, and cook over a low heat for 10-15 mins until meltingly soft, stirring now and then. Take the lid off, turn up the heat, add the garlic and ginger, and fry for 1 min until it gives off a toasty aroma. Stir in the paprika and continue cooking for another 30 secs. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar (and dried curry leaves if using). Cook, uncovered, for 15-20 mins until the sauce has thickened and reduced by one-third. Step 6: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Meanwhile, fry the chicken. Heat 6 tbsp oil in a frying pan and cook in batches until golden. You may need a little extra oil. Keep warm. Step 7: Pour any excess oil from the frying pan and add a ladleful of water – swirl it around and scrape up any juices with a spoon before adding to the tomato sauce. Step 8: Put the chicken in a deep roasting tin or ovenproof casserole and pour over the sauce. Cover with foil and oven cook for 15 mins until the chicken is tender. Skim off any oil from the top of the sauce. Step 9: Take the chicken pieces out of the tin and transfer to a serving dish. Pour the sauce into a pan and bring to a simmer. Stir in the tamarind pulp, coconut milk and half the coconut cream. Adjust the flavour by adding more sugar or tamarind. Ladle the sauce over the chicken, drizzle with the remaining coconut cream, and scatter with coriander before serving.

Ingredient Names: garam masala, vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, tomatoes, chicken stock, curry paste, double cream, ground almonds, desiccated coconut, bananas, fresh coriander, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the chicken pieces, garam masala and some salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large pan and add the chicken and onion and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden brown. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until beginning to soften. Step 4: Pour in the stock, stir in the curry paste, then bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the cream, almonds and coconut Peel the bananas and cut into 2cm thick slices. Step 6: Add to the pan, season with salt and pepper to taste and simmer for 5 minutes until the bananas are just tender. Step 7: Divide between 4 plates and serve each with boiled rice, a sprinkle of fresh coriander and a wedge of lemon for squeezing over.

Dish Name: Coconut Chicken Clone Of Cheesecake Factory's Bang Bang Chicken
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, chicken breast tenders, chicken broth, onion, garlic cloves, dried cilantro, fresh ginger, lemon zest, ground cumin, turmeric, coconut milk, macadamia nuts, sugar, ground red pepper, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chicken and cook 5 minutes per side or until browned and no longer pink in the center. Step 3: Remove chicken to a plate and set aside. Step 4: Heat the broth in the same skillet. Step 5: Add onion, garlic, cilantro, ginger, lemon zest, cumin and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes or until the onion is tender but not browned. Step 6: Stir in coconut milk, nuts, sugar, red pepper and shrimp. Step 7: Return the chicken to the skillet, cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the chicken is heated through. Step 8: Remove the chicken and shrimp to a plate and keep warm Do not discard the sauce in the pan. Step 9: In a small bowl, combine the tamarind paste and water.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, ghee, onions, tomatoes, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, garlic paste, ginger paste, curry powder, coconut milk, chicken stock, lemon, cilantro, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt ghee over medium heat. Step 2: Add cinnamon, bay leaf, onions, ginger and garlic pastes, and cook slowly till onions are tender and translucent. Step 3: Add one chopped tomato, curry powder, salt and pepper. Step 4: Add in coconut milk and chicken stock, and let cook on simmer till the sauce thickens. Step 5: Now add the rest of the tomatoes, chicken, lemon juice, and toss in a handful of cilantro. Step 6: Allow to cook approximately 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Serve with basmati rice or paratha.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, light coconut milk, chicken broth, green curry paste, curry powder, red pepper flakes, lime juice, lime, green chili salsa, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks and sautee in a little oil until surface is lightly brown. Step 2: Remove chicken from pan. Step 3: Stir in coconut milk, broth, curry paste, curry powder, and red pepper flakes, simmer for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken back to pan and simmer about another 5-10 minutes, until the sauce is slightly thicker and chicken is fully cooked and tender. Step 5: Add lime juice, zest and chile salsa and stir until heated through. Step 6: Toss in stir-fried veggies if desired, and sprinkle with cilantro leaves, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Cooked Chicken For Recipes Needing Cooked Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, cumin seed, fennel seed, salt, ghee, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put water, ghee, and spices in a deep pan. Step 2: Place chicken in water Water should just cover chicken. Step 3: Add more water to keep that level, keep pan covered. Step 4: Simmer gently for 35 minutes or to desired doneness. Step 5: Cut in strips or cubes Use in any recipe that calls for cooked chicken such as curries and cold salads.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken pieces, garlic cloves, plain yogurt, oil, onion, ground coriander, black pepper, ground mixed spice, turmeric, chili powder, warm water, chicken stock cube, ground almonds, hard-boiled eggs, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken joints into two. Step 2: Mix the garlic into the yogurt and pour over the chicken, leave to marinate over night. Step 3: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onions till golden. Step 4: Remove the onion from the pot, keep aside. Step 5: Fry the coriander, black pepper Mixed spice and turmeric for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the chicken and the yogurt marinade. Step 7: Turn heat to medium and fry the chicken for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the chili powder, water, stock cube and the onions. Step 9: Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, water, fresh coriander leaves, green chili pepper, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and brown the chicken, you might have to do that in batches, remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 2: Add the garlic to the same oil, when that starts to brown lower the heat to medium and add the ginger / water mix, fry this for 1 minute then add: coriander, chili, cayenne, cumin, coriander, turmeric and salt, cook for another minute and mix well. Step 3: Return the chicken to the pan, with the accumulated juices, add the water and the lemon juice. Step 4: Stir, bring to the boil, and then cover and simmer on a low heat for 15 minutes, depending what chicken meat is used. Step 5: When cooked and you find the sauce too thin, uncover the pot and reduce the sauce by using some higher heat.

Dish Name: Country Captain East India Chicken Curry
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fresh ginger, all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, boneless chicken breasts, olive oil, garam masala, curry powder, smoked paprika, bay leaf, green pepper, onion, jalapeno, diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a small food processor, combine the garlic and ginger and puree to a paste Salt & pepper the chicken breast coat them in the flour or bread crumbs. Step 2: Heat oil in frying pan or dutch oven and saute chicken to a golden brown. Step 3: Remove, drain and place in a casserole. Step 4: Saute the onions and green peppers in the pan with the drippings, adding more oil if necessary, stirring, until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the garlic-ginger paste, bay leaf, curry powder, garma masalas, smoked paprika and jalapeno. Step 6: Cook, stirring, until lightly browned and fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add tomatoes and simmer until the pan is deglazed. Step 8: Pour sauce over the chicken and bake at 350 degrees for about 35-40 minutes or until chicken breast are tender During the last 5 minutes of cooking add the currants.

Ingredient Names: chicken, chickpeas, garlic, onion, carrots, tomatoes, tomato puree, parsley, couscous, olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and trim the vegetables. Step 2: Fry the chicken pieces in half the olive oil until lightly browned. Step 3: Add the sliced onion and the chopped garlic, the tomato pure and enough water just to cover the chicken. Step 4: Season generously and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add the cooked chick peas, the carrots, cut into batons, and the tomatoes, cut into 8 pieces each. Step 6: Mix the couscous with its own volume of water and the remaining olive oil. Step 7: Stir it and leave it to swell up for about 15 minutes To cook: place it in a colander or sieve over a pan of boiling water, steam for 20-25 minutes until swollen and cooked through To serve: stir a knob of butter into the couscous and pile in a ring around a large dish. Step 8: Spoon the chicken and vegetables into the centre of the dish and pass the sauce separately.

Ingredient Names: greek yogurt, cornstarch, chicken breasts, green cardamom pods, sunflower oil, butter, ground turmeric, ground cinnamon, ground coriander, chicken broth, fresh ginger, lemon juice, heavy cream, ground almonds, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the yogurt with the cornstarch and set to one side. Step 2: Cut each of the chicken breasts into 3 or 4 chunky pieces Lightly crush the cardamom pods so that the green husks split open, then remove the little brownish-black seeds from inside Grind these into a fine powder with a pestle and mortar. Step 3: Heat the oil and butter in a flameproof casserole dish, add the chicken and cook over a medium heat until lightly browned all over. Step 4: Add the turmeric, cinnamon, coriander and ground cardamom seeds and cook for a further minute. Step 5: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the broth, grated ginger, lemon juice and the yogurt mixture. Step 6: Return the pan to the heat, bring to a simmer and leave to cook gently for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender. Step 7: Mix the cream with the ground almonds, stir into the chicken and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Season to taste and serve, garnished with sprigs of cilantro.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic cloves, soy yogurt, turmeric, onions, chicken stock, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, black peppercorns, cloves, coriander seed, fresh ginger, ground cumin, chili powder, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the chicken and place in a bowl Peel and crush the garlic, mix with the soya yogurt and turmeric and pour over the chicken. Step 2: Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight if possible Peel and slice the onions and place in a pan with the stock. Step 3: Cover the pan, bring to the boil and cook for 10 minutes. Step 4: Reduce the heat, uncover and cook gently for 20 minutes until the onions are tender and golden Finely chop ginger and crush coriander seeds. Step 5: Add all the spices to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Then add the chicken and soya yogurt marinade. Step 7: Cover and simmer very gently over a low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, ginger-garlic paste, salt, white pepper, egg, cheddar cheese, green chilies, coriander leaves, ground mace, ground nutmeg, cornflour, cream, oil, coriander, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken cubes with ginger-garlic paste, salt and white pepper for 15 mins. Step 2: Mix well together the beaten egg, cheese, green chillies, coriander, mace-nutmeg powder, cornflour and cream add this to the chicken and marinate for 3 hours more atleast skewer the chicken cubes 2 cm apart and roast in a preheated oven at 137c / 275 f oven / grill / tandoor for 5-8 mins Hang the skewers for 3-5 mins to drain, brush with oil and roast again for 3 mins serve hot garnished with chopped coriander, tomato slices and lemon wedges For any marinade that's left over i normally freeze and reuse for paneer tikkas, or add to scrabled egg the next morning or even use in a chicken casserole the next day I hate to throw it out! Step 3: And this does not only go for this marinade but marinade for any tikka recipe If there is no egg and cream in it i thicken it and serve at the side like a sauce Edited recipe thanks to latchy's review and my apologies to latchy!

Ingredient Names: boneless, turmeric, sunflower oil, onions, mangoes, korma paste, ginger, ground cumin, black onion seed, light coconut milk, chicken stock, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the chicken thighs with 1 tsp of the turmeric and some salt. Heat the oil in a big frying pan or wide flameproof casserole, and brown the thighs well on both sides. Remove from the pan. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 mins until softened. Step 2: Roughly cut all the flesh from one of the mangoes, scraping as much as you can from the stone. Put into a food processor with the korma paste, ginger and quartered onion. Whizz to a paste, then tip into the pan and gently cook until softened. Step 3: Stir in the remaining turmeric, cumin and onion seeds and turn up the heat for a couple of mins. Return the chicken to the pan. Stir in the coconut milk and stock. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook for 20 mins. Step 4: Uncover the pan and cook for another 25-30 mins until the chicken is really tender, adding a few drops of water to keep it saucy. Step 5: Slice the remaining mango and stir in to heat through while you shred the chicken with two forks. Season and serve scattered with the coriander, with basmati rice, naan bread, chutney, lime pickle and our sides, if you like.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, cardamom pods, ground cumin coriander, ground turmeric, green chili, garlic, thumb-size ginger, mixed vegetable such as carrots, vegetable stock, peas, yogurt, ground almonds, raw chicken breast portion, almonds coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. Cook onion with the dry spices over a low heat for 5-6 mins until the onion is light golden. Add the chilli, garlic and ginger and cook for 1 min, then throw in the mixed vegetables and cook for a further 5 mins. Step 2: Divide the mixture appropriately between two pans if serving vegetarians and meat eaters. Chop the chicken into small chunks and stir into one pan. Add the stock, dividing between the pans appropriately, and simmer for 10 mins (if only cooking the veggie version in one pan, use 300ml stock; if dividing between two pans, add 250ml to each). Divide the peas, if necessary, and add, cooking for 3 mins more until the veg are tender and the chicken is cooked through. Step 3: Remove from the heat and stir through the yogurt and ground almonds, if using. Serve sprinkled with the toasted almonds and coriander, with basmati rice or naan bread on the side.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chicken And Potato Curry
Ingredient Names: potatoes, red bell pepper, onion, boneless skinless chicken breast, chopped tomatoes, ground coriander, paprika, fresh ginger, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, ground turmeric, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, chicken broth, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Put the potatoes, red bell pepper, and onion in the bottom of a 6 quart crock pot and place chicken on top. Step 2: In a medium bowl mix the tomatoes, all spices, and the chicken broth, pour over chicken. Step 3: Cover and cook on high 4- 5 hours If using low, switch to high. Step 4: Combine cornstarch and water and add to crock pot. Step 5: Cover and cook for an additional 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vinegar, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, curry powder, ground cumin, ground cardamom, ground cloves, hot pepper, mustard seeds, olive oil, tomato sauce, cinnamon stick, onion, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Puree first 10 ingredients in a blender. Step 2: Pour into the crock pot, add tomato sauce, cinnamon stick and onion and mix well. Step 3: Add chicken and turn to cover. Step 4: Cook on low for 5 hours. Step 5: Sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving. Step 6: Serve with rice or rolls, enjoy!

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chicken Vindaloo Ww 5 Pts Per Serving
Ingredient Names: onion, potato, boneless skinless chicken breast, salt, reduced-sodium chicken broth, thai red curry paste, curry powder, frozen broccoli carrots cauliflower mix, reduced-fat coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: In single layers, place onion, potatoes and chicken in a 5-6 quart slow cooker. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt. Step 3: Combine the broth, curry paste, and curry powder in a medium bowl. Step 4: Pour over the chicken and vegetables. Step 5: Cover and cook until the chicken and potatoes are fork tender, 4-5 hours on high or 8-10 hours on low About 35 minutes before cooking is done, stir the broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, and coconut milk into the slow cooker. Step 6: Cover and cook on high until vegetables are crisp tender, about 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Crockpot Curried Chicken With Ginger And Yogurt
Ingredient Names: tomato paste, garlic cloves, curry powder, fresh ginger, ground cumin, water, onion, boneless skinless chicken thighs, salt, black pepper, greek yogurt, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker, whisk together the tomato paste, garlic, curry powder, ginger, cumin, and water. Step 2: Add the onion and stir to combine. Step 3: Place the chicken on top and season with 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Step 4: Cover and cook until the chicken is tender, on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours Just before serving, add the yogurt and teaspoon salt to the chicken and stir to combine. Step 5: Serve with rice or pasta and sprinkle with the scallions.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, warm water, curry powder, white vinegar, salt and pepper, vegetable oil, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the chicken and pat dry with paper towels Next, rub the chicken all over with the vinegar. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine curry powder, salt and pepper Rub the curry mixture all over the chicken. Step 3: Place the flour in a medium-sized bowl and gradually add the warm water, stirring, until a paste the consistency of yogurt forms. Step 4: Heat a skillet on medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes and add vegetable oil until it is about 1 / 8 inch deep. Step 5: When the oil is hot, dip the chicken into the flour batter, completely coating it. Step 6: Add the chicken to the pan, frying on both sides for 4-5 minutes or until outside coating is golden and crispy. Step 7: Add a bit of lime juice before serving.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, mango chutney, curry paste, firm banana, peanuts, red pepper, spring onions, pappadams, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the chicken thoroughly with the mango chutney, curry paste, banana, peanuts, red pepper and spring onions Carefully toast the poppadoms on both sides, until golden and crisp Quickly sandwich together in pairs with the prepared chicken mixture and sliced cucumber, and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, vegetable oil, black peppercorns, green cardamom pods, green chilies, garlic cloves, ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt, chicken pieces, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat pan and dry-roast 1 tablespoons of the cumin seeds until they turn fragrant - set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the remaining cumin seeds, peppercorns and cardamoms, till aromatic. Step 3: Add the chillies, garlic and ginger. Step 4: Add the ground coriander and cumin, and salt, and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken pieces, stir and mix thoroughly with the spices. Step 6: Cover pan and simmer for 20 minutes approximately. Step 7: Add the garam masala and the reserved cumin seeds, and allow to cook an additional 5 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with a raita on the side if desired.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, salt, garlic, chicken breast tenders, curry powder, plum tomato, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, hot chili sauce, chickpeas, water, olive oil, couscous, fresh spinach, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat. Step 2: Combine 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, garlic, and chicken, tossing to coat. Step 3: Add chicken mixture to pan. Step 4: Saute 3 minutes or until browned. Step 5: Stir in curry powder, cook 1 minute. Step 6: Add tomato, broth, chile sauce, and chickpeas, bring to a simmer. Step 7: Cover and cook 8 minutes While chicken mixture cooks, place 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, 1 cup water, and oil in a medium saucepan.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, curry powder, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, long-grain white rice, tiny peas, roasted red peppers, golden raisins, fresh cilantro, white wine vinegar, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and curry powder and saut 5 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken and saut until cooked through, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to large bowl and cool. Step 5: Mix in rice, peas, bell peppers, raisins and cilantro. Step 6: Whisk remaining 3 / 4 cup oil, vinegar and cumin in small bowl to blend. Step 7: Add enough dressing to salad to season to taste, toss well.

Ingredient Names: margarine, brown onion, garlic clove, curry powder, basmati rice, boneless skinless chicken breasts, water, chicken stock, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Step 2: Cook onion and garlic, stirring until onion softens, add curry powder. Step 3: Cook, stirring until mixture is fragrant. Step 4: Add riced and chicken. Step 5: Cook, stirring for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the water and stock. Step 7: Bring to a boil and then reduce heat and simmer covered for 10 minutes, add zucchini. Step 8: Cook stirring, about 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: chicken livers, flour, curry powder, turmeric, garlic powder, black pepper, canola oil, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together: flour, curry powder, turmeric, garlic powder and pepper. Step 2: Roll chicken livers one by one in flour mixture and place on a plate. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Place chicken livers in a single layer in skillet. Step 5: Sprinkle garlic salt over the chicken livers. Step 6: Let cook about 5 minutes and flip livers over. Step 7: Sprinkle them with more garlic salt. Step 8: Let cook about 5 more minutes more and test for doneness Some people like them pink in the middle I like them well done and browned through.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt and pepper, all-purpose flour, unsalted butter, onions, garlic cloves, ground cumin, fresh ginger, cumin seed, turmeric, caraway seed, cayenne pepper, tomatoes, chicken stock, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken breasts and coat lightly with flour. Step 2: Melt 4 tbs of the butter in a large skillet. Step 3: Add six breasts and cook over moderately high heat, turning once, until golden, about 4 minutes a side. Step 4: Transfer to large plate and repeat with next 6 breasts. Step 5: Melt remaining 4 tbs butter in skillet. Step 6: Add onions and cook over moderate heat, stirring until softened about 10 minutes. Step 7: Stir in garlic and ginger and cook until slightly softened about 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the ground cumin, cumin seeds, turmeric, caraway seeds and 1 / 4 tsp cayenne and cook for 1 minute. Step 9: Stir in the crushed tomatoes and the chicken stock. Step 10: Transfer to an enamaled casserole or dutch oven stew pot.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, chickpeas, sweet red pepper, green onion, raisins, coconut milk, orange juice, brown sugar, curry powder, salted cashews, naan bread, baby spinach, english cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Toss chicken, chickpeas, red pepper, green onion and raisins in a medium bowl until combined. Step 2: Stir coconut milk with orange juice, sugar and curry powder until sugar dissolves. Step 3: Stir into chicken mixture. Step 4: Cover and chill for 1 hour or up to a day. Step 5: When ready to serve, stir cashews into chicken mixture Warm naan in toaster oven or in dry skillet set over medium-low heat. Step 6: Turn naan breads upside down. Step 7: Divide filling lengthwise down centre. Step 8: Fold over and stuff with spinach and cucumber. Step 9: Serve with extra raisins and cashews as well as toasted unsweetened coconut and coarsely chopped coriander, if desired.

Dish Name: Curried Chicken Or Shrimp With Cinnamon Basmati Rice
Ingredient Names: oranges, large shrimp, curry powder, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, onion, celery, dried oregano, tomato juice, heavy cream, basmati rice, golden raisin, fresh oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Using a citrus zester or the small holes of a box grater, zest oranges. Step 2: Squeeze juices of oranges into a small bowl. Step 3: Set zest and juice aside. Step 4: In a large bowl, combine half of the zest with the shrimp, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons curry powder, 1 / 4 tsp Salt, and 1 / 4 tsp Pepper, toss to coat. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Cook shrimp until bright pink, 2 minutes per side. Step 7: Transfer to a plate.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, lime, olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, curry powder, diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the chicken or tofu with the lime juice and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large skillet. Step 3: Add the onions, garlic, and ginger. Step 4: Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes Do not brown. Step 5: Add the curry powder, stir well, and continue to saut the mixture for 3 more minutes, stirring frequently. Step 6: Add the tomatoes and juice. Step 7: Stir, cover, and let simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Uncover the skillet and add the chicken or tofu. Step 9: Stir well and cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chicken is thoroughly cooked.

Ingredient Names: ghee, onion, garlic cloves, serrano pepper, fennel seed, cumin seed, fresh ginger, curry powder, turmeric, garam masala, black pepper, salt, boneless skinless chicken breasts, dry lentils, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the ghee in a large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onions and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, serrano peppers, fennel seeds & cumin seeds. Step 4: Cook for a further 2-3 minutes, while stirring, until the seeds are slightly toasted and fragrant. Step 5: Add the ginger, curry powder, turmeric, garam masala, black pepper & salt. Step 6: Saute for just about a minute. Step 7: Add the chicken to the pot and brown a bit, until no longer pink, for about 5 minutes. Step 8: Finally, stir in lentils, tomato sauce, chicken broth, and spinach. Step 9: Bring to a boil, then lower heat & simmer while covered for 45 minutes. Step 10: Stir every 15 minutes or so, and add water if mixture gets a bit too dry.

Ingredient Names: long grain brown rice, water, butter, chicken pieces, onions, head of garlic, curry powder, ground ginger, tomato paste, chicken broth, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: The rice: dump ingredients into a microwave-safe casserole dish Zap in the microwave until fluffy, keep covered. Step 2: Set aside The chicken: melt butter in large hot frying pan, add chicken and brown on all sides. Step 3: Remove pieces as it browns The sauce: to butter in pan, add onion pieces, cook & stir until soft and beginning to brown. Step 4: Mix in garlic and curry powder, stirring for one minute Quickly add ginger & tomato paste, pour in half of the broth, stirring up the fond, then the remainder of the broth. Step 5: Return chicken to pan, spooning some of the sauce over each piece.

Dish Name: Curried Chicken With Tomatoes And Nuts
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, peanut oil, onions, sugar, ginger, curry paste, light coconut cream, plain flour, water, tomatoes, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan or wok. Step 2: Cook onion, sugar and ginger over medium heat for about 4 minutes or til onion has softened. Step 3: Stir in curry paste for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken, cook til lightly browned, add coconut cream. Step 5: Simmer, covered, for about 30 minutes. Step 6: Blend flour with water. Step 7: Stir into curry over high heat til mixture boils and thickens. Step 8: Add tomato, stir til hot. Step 9: Serve onto bed of steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, couscous, golden raisin, curry powder, mayonnaise, ground ginger, lemon juice, cooked chicken, celery, green onion, toasted almond, red grapes, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken broth to a boil in microwave or saucepan. Step 2: Combine couscous, raisins, and curry powder in a medium bowl. Step 3: Stir in broth, cover and let stand 5 minutes Fluff couscous with a fork and let cool to room temperature. Step 4: In a large bowl mix mayonnaise, ginger, and lemon juice. Step 5: Add chicken, celery, green onions, almonds, and cooled couscous mixture, toss gently. Step 6: Fold in grapes and parsley. Step 7: Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

Dish Name: Curried Mint Barbecue Marinade For Chicken Pieces
Ingredient Names: curry powder, mint leaves, salt, sugar, chicken thighs
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the mint leaves up finely, or put them in a blender. Step 2: Add the rest of the ingredients to the leaves and mix thoroughly. Step 3: Place your chicken into the marinade. Step 4: Put in refridgerator overnight The meat is now ready to barbecue.

Ingredient Names: pasta, cooked chicken, almonds, carrot, bell pepper, onion, sesame oil, curry powder, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Start preparation for pasta. Step 2: Cook chicken to your liking in olive oil or if you will be using cooked chicken as i did you will add it later. Step 3: Add vegetables, almonds and sesame oil and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat. Step 4: Add curry powder and mix well. Step 5: Add olive oil and cooked chicken, mix well. Step 6: Let the mixture simmer thoroughly for about 10 minutes. Step 7: Toss with warm pasta and serve.

Ingredient Names: flour, butter, chicken, olive oil, curry powder, fresh tomatoes, green pepper, garlic clove, onion, salt, pepper, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Put the flour in a bowl, season it with salt and pepper, and coat the chicken pieces in the seasoned flour. Step 3: Using a pan that can go from stove to oven, melt the butter on top of the stove. Step 4: After the butter has melted, put the chicken in to brown on both sides. Step 5: Remove and set aside. Step 6: Add the olive oil and curry powder to the pan with the drippings, and let the curry powder start to foam to bring out the flavor. Step 7: Then add the garlic, green pepper, and onion to saut. Step 8: When its all browned a bit, add the tomatoes and stir it up. Step 9: Put the chicken back in with the sauce, and place it in the oven for about 40 minutes, or until its all bubbly and the chicken is cooked through While the chicken is in the oven, toast some slivered almonds on the stove or in the oven to sprinkle on top at the end.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, flour, plain yogurt, tomato paste, chicken broth, applesauce, salt and pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy-bottomed pot or dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions Saut for about 10 minute. Step 3: Add in ginger and garlic Saut for 1 minute. Step 4: Add in curry powder, cumin and cinnamon Saut for 1 minute just to release flavors. Step 5: Add in flour, yogurt and tomato paste, whisking until sauce is smooth. Step 6: Add in broth and applesauce. Step 7: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: white pearl onions, boneless skinless chicken breasts, curry powder, no-salt-added tomato sauce, white wine, red chili paste, garlic, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the chicken breasts in the olive oil. Step 2: When they are cooked through, remove the breasts and slice them thinly Saut the onions in the same pan, adding the chilipaste, garlic and curry Saut until the onions are translucent. Step 3: Then return the sliced chiscken to the pan and stir in the tomato sauce and wine. Step 4: Allow to simmer for 15 minutes and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, peanut oil, lemon juice, curry powder, ground cumin, dijon mustard, salt, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken under cold, running water and pat dry in paper towels, set aside. Step 2: Combine ginger, oil, lemon juice, curry, cumin, mustard and salt in a non-aluminim bowl, and stir and set aside. Step 3: Add wings to marinade and turn until evenly coated. Step 4: Set aside to marinate at least 15 minutes. Step 5: Preheat oven to 475 degrees. Step 6: Arrange wings in a single layer in a baking pan and bake, uncovered, basting occasionally about 10 minutes per side or until browned.

Dish Name: Dahi Tamatarwala Murgh Chicken In Yogurt N Tomato Gravy
Ingredient Names: yogurt, green chili paste, garlic paste, salt, cloves, onions, fresh mint leaves, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, cardamom powder, ground nutmeg, tomatoes, black pepper, ginger paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl whisk three-fourth cup of yogurt, green chili paste, black pepper powder, one teaspoon of ginger paste, one teaspoon of garlic paste and salt Rub this marinade on the chicken pieces and keep them in the refrigerator for an hour. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan, add black cardamoms, cloves, cinnamon and bay leaves. Step 3: Stir-fry for a few seconds and add sliced onions Saut until golden brown. Step 4: Add the remaining ginger and garlic pastes Saut for two minutes. Step 5: Add the marinated chicken and saut on high heat for two minutes stirring constantly. Step 6: Lower the heat and put it to simmer for another two minutes. Step 7: Add the coriander powder, turmeric powder and red chili powder.

Ingredient Names: butter, vegetable oil, chicken thighs, salt and pepper, onions, dried red pepper flakes, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, curry powder, cumin powder, whole tomatoes, cashew nuts, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor pulse the cashews until a very fine, set aside. Step 2: Heat butter and oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Step 3: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper then brown on both sides, remove to a plate. Step 4: Add in onions, garlic, ginger and dried pepper flakes. Step 5: Saute until softened. Step 6: Add in curry powder and cumin. Step 7: Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Step 8: Add in the chicken pieces back to the pot and toss to coat.

Dish Name: Delicious Indian Spicy Chicken Sandwich Filling
Ingredient Names: garlic, dried red chili, oil, spring onion, chicken breast, red bell pepper, chestnuts, chicken stock powder, heinz ketchup, white bread
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first two ingredients together in a bowl. Step 2: Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Step 3: Add the crushed chilli-garlic mixture to it. Step 4: Stir-fry briefly for 5-7 seconds. Step 5: Add spring onion and chicken. Step 6: Stir-fry on high heat for 3 minutes. Step 7: Add bell pepper, chestnuts, chicken stock powder and ketchup. Step 8: Stir-fry until the chicken is cooked well on either side. Step 9: Transfer filling onto a plate, allow to cool.

Dish Name: Dhal Curry With Meat Gosht Dhal
Ingredient Names: lamb, lentils, brown lentils, salt, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste, coriander powder, cumin, chili powder, onion, oil, tomatoes, cinnamon stick, whole cumin seed, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse dhal and lentils in some lukewarm water. Step 2: Soak overnight if you have the time otherwise not necessary. Step 3: Pour in to large saucepan cover with water, 1 tsp each of the salt and turmeric. Step 4: Boil like you would do for beans until soft and mushy. Step 5: In a separate saucepan, saute onions, cinnamon stick and cumin seeds in oil till a pale gold colour. Step 6: Add meat and the spices. Step 7: Stir a few times without adding water Gently cooking the spices, by adding water you dont give the spices a chance to cook, and then you will have a tasteless curry remember this with all indian food. Step 8: When it starts sticking to the pot add the tomotoe and about half a cup of water. Step 9: Simmer slowly till well blended and the water has dried up.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, water, turmeric, salt, black cardamom pods, oil, onions, black peppercorns, whole cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon sticks, yogurt, garlic cloves, cilantro, cracked black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine meat, water, turmeric, salt, and black cardamom pods in a large saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes for chicken and 45 to 50 minutes for lamb, until meat is cooked. Step 3: Remove meat, reserving broth. Step 4: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 5: Add onions and saut until reddish brown and crisp. Step 6: Remove and drain on paper towels. Step 7: Add spices to the skillet and stir. Step 8: Add yogurt and garlic. Step 9: Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture has reduced to a thick sauce. Step 10: Add meat to the yogurt sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, coriander leaves, garlic cloves, green chilies, plain low-fat yogurt, salt, butter, cardamoms, cinnamon stick, cloves, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and wash chicken pieces thoroughly. Step 2: Take the coriander leaves, garlic cloves and green chillies and grind to paste in the mixer To the above paste, add yoghurt, salt to taste and mix. Step 3: Now marinate the chicken pieces in the above marinade for 45 minutes. Step 4: In a pan add butter, when butter is hot add the cardamom), stick of cinnamon, cloves and cumin. Step 5: Fry for few minutes. Step 6: Now add the chicken and cook till done under a closed lid, on slow fire. Step 7: Serve hot with chappathi or rice.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, carrots, potatoes, salt, fresh ground black pepper, ginger, curry powder, butternut squash, crushed tomatoes, boneless skinless chicken breast, lemon, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion begins to wilt, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Turn the heat to high, add the garlic, carrots and potatoes or turnips. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the ginger and curry powder. Step 6: Add the butternut squash, canned tomatoes and chicken pieces and stir to combine Adjust the heat so that the mixture simmers slowly and place a lid, slightly ajar, over the skillet. Step 7: Simmer for 15 minutes or until the chicken is completely cooked. Step 8: Add the lemon juice and adjust the salt and pepper to taste This can be made in advance and stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, turmeric, chili powder, white pepper, cumin, tamarind paste, green chilies, onion, ginger-garlic paste, oil, salt, lime, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except green chillis, oil and onion. Step 2: Keep covered for 1 hour, longer if possible. Step 3: Heat the oil in a good pan and fry the onion till golden brown, add the chillis and fry for2 mins, fry the chicken pieces on all sides, and cook covered on low heat for 15 mins or until cooked. Step 4: Remove lid and fry until dry. Step 5: Add lime juice and coriander. Step 6: Serve with rice or naan and a cooling raita Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: chicken, margarine, onions, garlic cloves, bay leaves, ground cinnamon, cloves, tomatoes, salt, curry powder, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicen in a non-stick skillet, using a little vegetable oil or margarine. Step 2: Remove to paper towels and drain. Step 3: Discard oil or margarine, retaining any browned bits of the chicken. Step 4: Heat the 2 tb margarine or oil in the same skillet. Step 5: Add onions and garlic and saute until browned. Step 6: Add bay leaves, cinnamon and cloves. Step 7: Cook, covered, for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add remaining ingredients to skillet and stir frequently. Step 9: Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the spicy sauce over it. Step 10: Cover tightly and cook over medium heat until tender.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, fresh lemon juice, plain yogurt, chickpea flour, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, cayenne pepper, ground turmeric, ground cumin, garam masala, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into 1 inch cubes. Step 2: Put in a mixing bowl and rub with the lemon juice and 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt. Step 3: In a separate bowl, mix the yogurt and flour, whisking to combine well. Step 4: Add the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, and the ginger, garlic, cayenne, turmeric, cumin, and garam masala. Step 5: Mix well, then pour the yougurt mixture over the chicken. Step 6: Mix to coat all of the chicken pieces, then set aside for at least 15 minutes. Step 7: Preheat your broiler or grill to high heat. Step 8: Thread the chicken onto skewers. Step 9: Place on a broiling pan or directly onto the grill grate Baste with half of the melted butter.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, lemon juice, salt, ground ginger, chili powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, paprika, orange food coloring, yogurt, garlic, oil, lettuce, red onion ring, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Make several cuts in the chicken meat up to the bone, rub in the lemon juice and the salt, leave for ca 30 minute mix all the ingredients for the marinade, rub it into the chicken, cover and put in the fridge for a day Next day, preheat your oven to 400f, put chicken in a baking dish / tin, bake 15 minutes meat side up, 15 minutes meat side down and finish the cooking under a medium grill for about 10 minutes On a large plate arrange the lettuce, onion and cucumber, place the chicken on top with the lemon wedges. Step 2: Serve with your favourite indian bread and a bowl of yogurt-chutney.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic cloves, cardamom pod, peppercorn, coriander seeds, cumin seed, red pepper flakes, paprika, butter, ground ginger, garam masala, sweet paprika, diced tomatoes, yogurt, half-and-half cream
Instructions: Step 1: Make your spice blend: put the cardamom seeds, peppercorns, coriander seeds, cumin and pepper flakes in a spice grinder and -- grind. Step 2: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Step 3: Saute onions until they begin to caramelize. Step 4: Add garlic and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add your spice blend, ginger, garam masala and paprika. Step 6: Stir everything together until it's well combined and let it all mix together in the skillet for a few minutes. Step 7: Add tomatoes and water and stir everything together. Step 8: Turn your heat down and simmer for about 10-15 minutes - it will thicken up a little and reduce. Step 9: Whisk the yogurt into the sauce, then add the remaining 2 tbsp of butter and the half and half, and whisk everything together. Step 10: When the sauce is simmering again, add the chicken pieces and let it simmer until they are completely cooked.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, gingerroot, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cayenne pepper, salt, ground black pepper, plain yogurt, fresh cilantro, garam masala, uncle ben's ready rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Trim fat from thighs then cut meat into chunks. Step 2: Add all ingredients except yogurt, cilantro, garam masala and rice to heavy, lidded 5-qt pot, stir well, cover. Step 3: Bake until chicken is tender, about 1-1 / 2 hours. Step 4: Remove from oven, stir in yogurt, cilantro and garam masala. Step 5: Serve over microwaved rice.

Ingredient Names: coriander stems, ground cumin, juice limes, vegetable oil, skinless chicken quarters, turmeric, purple cabbage, fresh carrots
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Mix the coriander stems with the cumin, lime zest, juice and oil. Make 3 slashes in each chicken quarter, then sprinkle over the turmeric and half the lime mixture. Season well, then leave to marinate for 10 mins or up to 24 hrs. Roast on a baking tray for 50 mins until golden and cooked through. Step 2: Tip the cabbage and carrots into a bowl, then pour over the remaining dressing. Add the coriander leaves and toss together. Serve alongside the chicken with some naan bread or rice, if you like.

Ingredient Names: green pepper, shallots, butter, chicken bouillon cube, mango chutney, orange juice, water, ginger, mangoes, boneless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 4" thick. Step 2: Saute green pepper and shallots in butter, add chicken, saute till done. Step 3: Remove chicken from skillet. Step 4: Add bouillon, mango chutney, orange juice, water and ginger, stir. Step 5: Simmer for 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens. Step 6: Return chicken to skillet with cubed mango, heat through.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, curry powder, ground cinnamon, paprika, ginger, white sugar, coconut milk, tomato paste, boneless chicken breasts, lemon, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Before cooking: tenderize and cube chicken, chop onion and mince garlic, and combine curry powder, cinnamon, paprika, ginger root, and sugar in a small cereal-sized bowl. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large pan on medium heat. Step 3: Once oil is hot, add onion and garlic. Step 4: Saute onion and garlic until onion is browned. Step 5: Add curry spices to the pan. Step 6: Saute combination until the spices have soaked up all of the remaining olive oil. Step 7: Add coconut milk, tomato paste, and chicken. Step 8: Simmer for 20-25 minutes, remove bay leaf, add lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, coriander seed, cumin seed, methi seeds, peppercorns, whole cloves, cardamom pods, dried red chilies, salt, cayenne, turmeric, cinnamon, oil, onions, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash 6 chicken thighs. Step 2: Remove the skin and excess fat and place the thighs in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: In a large nonstick frying pan put the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, peppercorns, whole cloves, cardamom seeds, and the 2 dried red chilies. Step 4: Stir-fry the whole spices over medium heat until they have lightly browned. Step 5: Put the toasted spices into a spice grinder. Step 6: Add the salt, cayenne powder, turmeric and cinnamon Powder everything together. Step 7: Put the powdered spices in the bowl with the chicken and stir to combine. Step 8: Let the chicken marinate while you cook the onions In the same frying pan put 4 table.

Dish Name: Excellent Mughlai Zaafrani Murg Mughlai Saffron Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken, salt, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, saffron, cashews, low-fat plain yogurt, oil, bay leaves, cloves, onion paste, garlic paste, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To make this yummy chicken, first prepare the marinade Before doing that, soak red chili powder in water and prepare a paste of it. Step 2: Now, in a bowl, mix together, the chicken, salt, ginger-garlic paste, 2-3 tablespoons of cashewnut paste, a pinch of saffron, yogurt and a tsp of red chili paste. Step 3: Mix well, using your hand, and keep aside for 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 5: Add bay leaves and cloves. Step 6: Stir-fry for a minute. Step 7: Add onion paste and saut till it turns brown. Step 8: Add a teaspoon of garlic paste Continue to saut till the raw smell of garlic is gone.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, apricot halves in light syrup, white onion, cinnamon sticks, garlic, butter, curry powder, cayenne pepper, cooked white rice, sour cream, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 475f, line the bottom of a 9"-13" pan with foil. Step 2: Remove the giblets from the chicken and just throw them away Dry the bird off and place it, breast side up, in the lined pan. Step 3: Stuff the bird with as many apricots and onion pieces as you can then just toss the ones that would fit around the bird stuff the cinnamon sticks, one under each breast, inside the bird Smear the butter, curry powder, and cayenne all over the top and sides of the chicken. Step 4: Cook for 20 minutes in the 475f oven then loosely cover with foil, turn the oven to 350f and cook for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours more. Step 5: When the bird is down, remove from the oven and spit it open down the back bone. Step 6: Turn oven down to 250f. Step 7: Remove the apricots and onion from inside and around the bird and place them in a blender or food processor Finish carving the bird and set it aside.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, black pepper, skinless chicken breasts, oil, onion, green bell pepper, garlic, mild curry powder, potatoes, fat-free chicken broth, mango chutney, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour, salt and pepper together on a shallow plate Dredge chicken in flour and shake off excess. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet and add chicken, browning on both sides, remove to a plate. Step 3: Add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the pan and cook until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add curry powder, coating onions, etc. Step 5: Then add potatoes, broth, chutney, to the skillet. Step 6: Bring it all to a boil, add the chicken, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer cooking until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender, about 20-22 minutes. Step 7: Garnish with cilantro, and serve with rice, if desired.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, salt, turmeric, ground cumin, chicken, water, garam masala, heavy cream, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large deep frying pan adding chopped onions and fry for 4 to 5 minutes on a medium heat until the onions are slightly brown. Step 2: Add the garlic and ginger and cook for a further 1 or 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the salt, turmeric and ground cumin. Step 4: Turn up the heat and further cook for another 1 minute then add the chicken It is very crucial that spices are mixed within the pan at this point and stirred to ensure that the chicken cooks with texture and flavor. Step 5: Add water after stirring the chicken into the spices. Step 6: Turn down the heat slightly and stir in the garam masala and cream cook for a further 5 minutes. Step 7: Serve sprinkled with green coriander.

Ingredient Names: curry powder, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, cayenne pepper, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, rotisserie-cooked chicken, light coconut milk, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, cooked basmati rice, fresh cilantro, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Mix spices in small bowl. Step 2: Heat oil in a dutch oven or small soup kettle over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onion and saute until golden, 8 to 10 minutes, add garlic. Step 4: Saute until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 5: Add spices Toast until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute, add chicken. Step 6: Stir until completely coated with spices. Step 7: Add coconut milk, tomatoes and broth.

Dish Name: Fragrant chicken curry with chick peas
Ingredient Names: onions, fat garlic, ginger, moglai curry powder, turmeric, paprika, red chile, fresh coriander, chicken stock cube, water, skinless boneless chicken fillets, chickpeas, natural low-fat yogurt basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the onions, garlic, ginger, ground spices, chilli and half the coriander into a food processor. Add 1 teaspoon salt and blend to a purée. Tip the mixture into a medium saucepan and cook over a low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 2: Crumble in the stock cube, add the boiling water and return to the boil. Add the chicken, stir, then lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender. Step 3: Chop the remaining coriander, reserve 2 tablespoons, then stir the remainder into the curry with the chickpeas. Heat through and divide between four bowls. Sprinkle with the reserved coriander and spoon over the yogurt, then serve with basmati rice, naan bread or poppadums.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, fresh coriander, garlic, ginger, green chilies, vegetable oil, skinless chicken thighs, onions, thumb-size cinnamon, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz together the coconut milk and coriander (leaves and stalks) in a food processor, then tip out and set aside. Quickly wipe out the machine, add the garlic, ginger and chillies, then whizz with enough water to make a paste. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan. Brown the chicken well on all sides, then remove. Add the onion, cloves and cinnamon and fry until lightly coloured. Add the chilli paste to the pan, then cook until most of the liquid has evaporated. Step 3: Return the chicken, then stir in the powdered spices and coconut paste. Bring to a boil, cover the pan, then cook for 40-50 mins, removing the lid halfway through cooking so the sauce can thicken. Check the chicken is cooked, stir in the tamarind paste, season to taste, then add a splash of water if the sauce has thickened too much.

Ingredient Names: butter, boneless skinless chicken breasts, mild curry paste, dry white wine, light sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan set over medium high heat, melt butter Lightly sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Step 2: Add chicken to pan and cook until lightly browned, about 2 minutes per side. Step 3: Whisk curry paste with wine until fairly well blended, pour over chicken. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 5: Cover and simmer until chicken feels springy, about 4 minutes per side. Step 6: Remove chicken to a platter Loosely cover to keep warm. Step 7: Then increase heat to high and boil sauce until reduced to approximately 3 tablespoons, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, garlic cloves, curry powder, coconut milk, fresh spinach, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until very hot but not smoking. Step 2: Add chicken and cook and stir about 4-6 minutes or until browned. Step 3: Add garlic and curry and cook, stirring, about 30 seconds. Step 4: Stir in coconut milk. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 6: Cook 3-4 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked, add spinach. Step 7: Toss and mix to wilt spinach. Step 8: Cook just until spinach is wilted. Step 9: Add salt and pepper to taste and serve with hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flour, salt, pepper, cooking oil, onions, green peppers, garlic, white pepper, curry powder, tomatoes, parsley, ground thyme, currants, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In large plastic bag, mix together flour, 1 teaspoon of the salt and pepper. Step 2: Add chicken, one piece at a time, shaking to coat In large fry pan, place oil and heat to medium temperature. Step 3: Add chicken and cook, turning, about 15 minutes or until brown on all sides. Step 4: Remove chicken from pan and keep warm In same fry pan, place onions, green pepper and garlic. Step 5: Stir-fry about 5 minutes, or until onion is golden brown. Step 6: Add remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt, white pepper, curry powder, tomatoes, chopped parsley and thyme In large baking dish, place chicken. Step 7: Pour tomato mixture over chicken.

Ingredient Names: rice, mutton, ghee, channa dal, jeera powder, green chilies, salt, cloves, cardamoms
Instructions: Step 1: Cook meat with salt, pepper, spices and green chillies till tender. Step 2: Boil chana dal in salted water till done, drain, boil rice. Step 3: In a heavy bottomed vessel, fry a little sliced onion with jeera powder in ghee Be sure to save a little onion for decoration on top. Step 4: Add rice to the browned onion with the cooked meat and dhal and gently toss together to ensure even distribution. Step 5: Pour another tablespoon of ghee over the top with the remaining onions. Step 6: Sprinkle a few tablespoons of water, steam till done.

Dish Name: Ghurka Chicken Cardamom Curry Kukhra Alainchi Sanga
Ingredient Names: chicken meat, onions, natural yogurt, vegetable oil, cardamom seeds, gingerroot, garlic cloves, fennel seeds, cayenne pepper, turmeric, cinnamon stick, cloves, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and chop the onions, garlic and ginger into small pieces. Step 2: Make a masala from the yoghurt, cardamom, chopped ginger, chopped garlic, fennel and cayenne by grinding the mixture into a smooth paste. Step 3: Sprinkle the meat with a little salt, then pour over the masala mixture, and allow to marinade for at least an hour. Step 4: Heat the oil, in a large pan, until a slight blue haze can bee seen. Step 5: Add the cinnamon, the cloves and the onion pieces. Step 6: Cook until the onion is golden brown. Step 7: Add the marinaded chicken pieces to the pan which should still have the onions, cloves and cinnamon, making sure that you get as much of the marinade in the pan as possible. Step 8: Put it back on the heat Without stirring the mixture, you should see oil slowly rising to the surface At this stage carefully add the cold water and bring the mixture back to the boil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, onion, garlic cloves, coconut milk, salt, paprika, ground turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, lemon juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all the marinade ingredients to give you a loose, smooth paste. Step 2: Add the chicken pieces and coat them in the paste They are best left to marinate for around 30 minutes to 1 hour, but if you're in a hurry a few minutes will do. Step 3: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and add the mustard seeds. Step 4: When they start to pop and jump about in the pan, add the onion and garlic. Step 5: Cook until they're golden brown before adding the chicken and any extra paste from the marinade. Step 6: Fry over a gentle heat for about 8 minutes before adding the coconut milk Increase the heat slightly and bring to a simmer. Step 7: Cook for a further 10-12 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly before seasoning with salt if necessary and serving with rice or naan bread.

Dish Name: Gold Rice With Chicken And Pistachio
Ingredient Names: oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, long-grain white rice, carrot, golden raisin, curry powder, coriander, salt, ready-to-serve chicken broth, water, pistachio nut
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large no stick frypan over medium high heat until hot. Step 2: Add chicken strips and onion, cook 5 minutes or until chicken is browned and onion is tender, stirring often. Step 3: Add all remaining ingredients except nuts, mix well. Step 4: Bring to boil and reduce heat to medium low, cover and cook 15-20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, rice is tender and liquid is absorbed Just before serving, sprinkle nuts over top.

Dish Name: Golden Saffron And Cardamom Spiced Chicken Rice Pilau
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, yogurt, lemon, ground cinnamon, garam masala, fresh ginger, saffron thread, chicken stock, butter, peanut oil, basmati rice, sultana, cardamom pods, rose water, fresh lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, lemon, cinnamon, small pinch of garam masala, and grated ginger for about 1 hour. Step 2: Soak the saffron threads in the chicken stock Shake the excess marinade off the chicken. Step 3: In a large dutch oven or le creuset over medium-high heat, fry the meat with a spoonful or so of oil. Step 4: Remove chicken and browned bits to a plate, cover with aluminum foil to keep warm and set aside In the same pan, melt the butter with 1 tablespoon of the oil and add the rice, stirring to coat until glossy. Step 5: Pour in the saffron and chicken stock, add the sultanas, cardamom pods, rose water, lemon juice and zest and bring the pan to the boil, then clamp on the lid and turn the heat down to very low. Step 6: Cook for about 10-15 minutes, by which time the rice should have absorbed the liquid and be cooked through. Step 7: Add the chicken and the browned bits to the rice, stirring gently to combine Toast the almonds by shaking them in a dry frying pan over a medium heat until they color and begin to give off their fragrance, then add to the pilaf along with the chopped parsley.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, fresh green chile, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, soft brown sugar, tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, boneless chicken breasts, dried curry leaves, yogurt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pan. Step 2: Slice the onion and add to the pan De-seed and chop the chilie, chop ginger and add to the pan Crush the garlic and add to the pan. Step 3: Cook for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add chili powder, turmeric, garam masala and sugar. Step 5: Cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Add tomato puree and tinned tomatoes. Step 7: Stir and cook for a few minutes. Step 8: Transfer sauce to a food processor and blitz until smooth.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh lemon juice, plain yogurt, garlic, ginger, ground cumin, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, fresh ground black pepper, butter, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Clean your chicken, and cut it into cubes for threading on skewers. Step 2: Take a fork and prick the chicken many times. Step 3: Put lemon juice in bowl with chicken, stir well, and set it aside. Step 4: In a large bowl, mix yogurt, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, cayenne, salt and pepper. Step 5: Place the chicken in the bowl with the marinade, and marinate for at least 2 hours, preferably 4-6 hours. Step 6: Thread chicken onto skewers. Step 7: Heat your grill with a nice flame and place chicken skewers on the grill. Step 8: Brush with butter or olive oil, and grill approximately 6 minutes on each side, or until done, having nice grill / char markiings. Step 9: Once you have grilled one side for 6 minutes, turn them over and brush with butter or olive oil, and grill 6 more minutes or until done. Step 10: Serve with lime wedges on the side for squirting on chicken pieces.

Dish Name: Grilled Chicken With Coriander And Chili
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, coriander seeds, red thai chile, ground cumin, whole cloves, cardamom pods, ground turmeric, lemongrass, brown onions, garlic cloves, lime juice, coarse salt, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make coriander and chili paste: Blend or process ingredients until mixture forms a smooth paste. Step 2: Marinate chicken thighs: Pierce chicken all over with a sharp knife. Step 3: Combine chicken and paste in a large bowl Rub paste into cuts, cover. Step 4: Refrigerate overnight. Step 5: Cook chicken: Cook chicken, covered in heated, oiled grill pan, 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, lemons, plain yogurt, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, ground cumin, paprika, turmeric, fresh ginger, salt and pepper, cayenne, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lemon juice, yogurt, oil, garlic and spices in blender and blend until smooth. Step 2: Pour into a ziploc bag and add chicken. Step 3: Allow to marinate in the refrigerator for 12 hours or overnight, turning occasionally Oil or spray the grill grates. Step 4: Preheat grill with a hot charcoal fire on one side of the grill or gas grill to 375 f- lighting one side only of the grill. Step 5: Grill chicken on the hot side of the grill for 3 minutes per side until all sides are grilled Move chicken to the no heat side and cook for 40 minutes or until a meat thermometer reaches 170f and juices run clear Wonderful served with an aromatic rice.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, plain yogurt, ground coriander, mild paprika, ground cumin, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, ground black pepper, ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, ground cloves, vegetable oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk yogurt and next 9 ingredients in large bowl to blend. Step 2: Add chicken and turn to coat. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate overnight. Step 4: Remove from refrigerator and wipe off marinade and discard. Step 5: Drizzle with oil, add salt and pepper. Step 6: Prepare barbecue for medium heat and oil grill. Step 7: Transfer chicken to barbecue grill. Step 8: Grill chicken until cooked through, about 7 minutes per side. Step 9: Remove from grill and let rest for 5 minutes. Step 10: Transfer chicken to cutting board.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, garlic cloves, green jalapeno pepper, fresh ginger, salt, cumin powder, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, vegetable oil, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, blend together onion, garlic, jalepeno, ginger, salt, cumin, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala. Step 2: Mix in oil and yogourt. Step 3: Marinate chicken for a few hours or overnight It will take about 20 minutes to cook over medium-hot coals or on a gas covered grill.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, red chili pepper, salt and black pepper, water, vegetable oil, ground cinnamon, black cardamom pods, white onion, ground cumin, ground coriander, yogurt, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: The marinade needs to be a smooth paste. Step 2: Put the 1st 6 ingredients, except chicken, into a blender with a splash of water and puree. Step 3: Place sliced chicken in a bowl and spread the marinade over, coating each piece. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes, though you can leave it longer or even overnight is best. Step 5: When you're ready to cook the dish, put a large pot, preferably heavy bottomed, over a medium heat, add the oil. Step 6: When it's hot stir in the cinnamon and cardamom for a few seconds. Step 7: Add onion and cook for 5 minutes until it starts to soften It will turn brown from the cinnamon. Step 8: Add cumin and coriander, then gradually add the yoghurt, stirring all the time.

Dish Name: Happiness Shows Through Your Tears When You Eat This Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken, spring onions, mint leaf, ginger-garlic paste, fresh coriander leaves, green chilies, lime juice, oil, salt, garam masala powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non-stick wok. Step 2: Once it is hot, add the ginger-garlic paste to it. Step 3: Saute the same for 1 minute. Step 4: Then, throw in with alot of good cheer and love in your heart{for you should be happy when you cook and send those feelings to the food being cooked, i believe}, the spring onions, green chillies, salt and the chicken pcs. Step 5: Cover and cook on medium flame, stirring occasionally as you cook the chicken. Step 6: Once the chicken is cooked and dry, add the lime juice, garam masala powder, coriander and mint leaves. Step 7: Cook for 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Serve hot with rotis or naan bread Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, canola oil, turmeric powder, butter, lemon juice, gingerroot, garlic, garam masala, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, ground cumin, whole milk
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 12" nonstick skillet with cooking spray and sear the chicken cubes. Step 2: Once done, take the chicken out of the pan and put aside Saut onion in one teaspoon of canola oil on low heat. Step 3: Add turmeric powder and saut for another 1 minute, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add tomato paste and saut another minute. Step 5: Add butter, lemon juice, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cayenne pepper, salt, pepper, cumin and saut for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add chicken back to the pan and cook for another 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in milk, yogurt, tomato puree, and water. Step 8: Simmer for 30-45 minutes, or until sauce has thickened.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, crushed red pepper flakes, carrots, celery, garlic, all-purpose flour, seasoning salt, curry powder, evaporated milk, chicken broth, fresh ground black pepper, chicken, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan heat butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add in onion, pepper flakes carrots and celery. Step 3: Saute for about 4 minutes or until softened. Step 4: Add in garlic and cook 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add in flour, seasoned salt and curry powder. Step 6: Cook stirring for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add in evaporated milk and chicken broth. Step 8: Bring to a boil stirring constantly until heated through and thickened. Step 9: Season with fresh ground black pepper to taste. Step 10: Add in cooked chicken and rice or potatoes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, ginger paste, garlic cloves, plain yogurt, paprika, cumin, coriander, lemon juice, salt, chili powder, pepper, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Put onion, garlic and ginger in food processor and blend. Step 2: Add yogurt, lemon juice and spices Pulse lightly. Step 3: Make diagonal cuts across each large piece of chicken In plastic bag, combine chicken and marinade mixture. Step 4: Marinate in refrigerator for a minimum of 8 hours Ideally overnight. Step 5: Prepare grill Spray with non stick spray. Step 6: Remove chicken from marinade and discard marinade.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, butter, honey, dijon mustard, curry powder, garam masala, hot pepper sauce, garlic cloves, soya sauce, lemon juice, ginger, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a well greased / buttered baking dish, arrange the chicken skin side down. Step 2: In a bowl combine all other ingredients and stir until smooth. Step 3: Pour over chicken and refrigerate 1 hour. Step 4: Drain and reserve excess sauce. Step 5: Bake chicken, uncovered in a preheated 375 degree oven for 20 minutes Baste periodically with remaining sauce. Step 6: Turn chicken over and baste with remaining sauce. Step 7: Bake chicken another 20 to 30 minutes or until tender and no pink remains Basting periodically. Step 8: Serve along side your favorite basmati rice recipe and enjoy!

Dish Name: Hot And Cold Chicken Curry Salad
Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, curry paste, honey, lemon, garlic clove, fresh gingerroot, rotisserie-cooked chicken, mango, red bell pepper, red onion, celery ribs, almonds, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, curry paste, honey, lemon peel, lemon juice, garlic and ginger. Step 2: Add the chicken, mango, bell pepper, onion, celery and nuts, toss to combine. Step 3: Season the salad to taste with salt and pepper and pass pita bread or other flatbread around the table.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, ghee, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, water, turmeric, salt, garam masala, ground cumin, black pepper, hot chili powder, green cardamoms, cloves, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the ghee in a large heavy pan, and fry half of the onions till golden Liquidise the ginger garlic and the rest of the onions with the water. Step 2: Add the liquid to the pan of fried onions and cook for 10 minutes. Step 3: Now add all of the spices to the pan and cook for a further 10 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken and yogurt, cook slowly till the chicken is very tender. Step 5: Serve with rice, dhal and a cooling side dish.

Ingredient Names: onions, chilies, tomatoes, basmati rice, chicken, yogurt, lemons, mint, masala, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf, anise, black cardamom pods, mace
Instructions: Step 1: Hyderabadi chicken biryani gravy. Step 2: Marinate chicken overnight with yogurt, salt, lemon, and red chilli powder. Step 3: Slice onions thin and length-wise. Step 4: Fry in oil until brown and crispy. Step 5: Remove and set aside by soaking in paper towels Use the remainder oil to add the following spices: Once fragrant, add in the tomatoes, chillies and girnger / garlic paste. Step 6: Now, add in the garam masala. Step 7: After stirring a few mins, add in the marinated chicken. Step 8: Now, add in the shan biryani masala.

Ingredient Names: onion, celery, margarine, flour, curry powder, chicken broth, worcestershire sauce, chicken, tomato juice, rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan cook the onion and celery in hot margarine or butter until tender. Step 2: Stir in flour and curry powder. Step 3: Add the chicken broth and worcestershire sauce. Step 4: Cook and stir until bubbly. Step 5: Stir in the cooked chicken and tomato juice, heat through. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper if desired. Step 7: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, red bell pepper, garlic, curry powder, chili powder, ground turmeric, ground cinnamon, light coconut milk, mango chutney, lemon, salt, golden delicious apple, frozen green pea, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Spray large, deep skillet with cooking spray and place over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly until both sides are lightly browned, about two minutes per side. Step 3: Remove chicken and keep warm. Step 4: Add onions, red pepper and garlic to the same skillet. Step 5: Cook and stir until vegetables begin to soften, about three minutes. Step 6: Add curry powder, chili powder, turmeric and cinnamon. Step 7: Cook and stir for one more minute. Step 8: Add coconut milk, mango chutney, lemon zest and salt, mix well. Step 9: Stir in chicken pieces and apples.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, butter, garam masala, sweet paprika, ground coriander, green ginger, chili powder, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, tomato puree, sugar, plain yogurt, cream, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok until really hot, add 1 tbsp oil. Step 2: Add half the chicken and stir-fry for about 4 minutes or until chicken is a nice colour, remove to plate. Step 3: Add extra oil and cook remaining chicken, remove from wok. Step 4: Reduce heat and add the butter. Step 5: When melted add all of the spices and stir-fry until fragrant- about 1 minute. Step 6: Return chicken to wok and stir to coat with the spices. Step 7: Add the tomato and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes- stir occasionally. Step 8: Add the yogurt, cream and lemon juice and simmer for 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens a bit.

Dish Name: Indian Butter Chicken From The Spice And Herb Bible
Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillets, tandoori spice mix, plain yogurt, butter, cumin seed, garlic, onions, curry powder, tomato paste, brown sugar, tomatoes, ground almonds, garam masala, coriander leaves, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Mix one half tabdoori spice blend with yogurt and marinate chicken overnight Next day, grill the chicken while preparing the sauce as follows. Step 2: In a pan, melt butter, add ground cumin and stir fry 30 seconds. Step 3: Add garlic and onion, stir fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Mix together remainder tandoori spice blend with curry powder, tomato paste, tomato sauce, chutney, ground almonds and garam masala, then add to sauce. Step 5: Simmer a few minutes, then add cooked chicken, along with any remaining marinade and pan drippings. Step 6: Add coriander leaves, cream, coconut milk, and add salt to taste. Step 7: Simmer gently and allow to reduce a little.

Dish Name: Indian Butter Chicken Without The Butter
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, onion, vegetable oil, cumin, cinnamon, salt, unsalted cashews, plain yogurt, low-fat milk, gingerroot, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, garlic cloves, chili powder, ground cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: Can be made on stove top or in oven (if using oven preheat oven to 325f. Step 2: Chop chicken pieces into bite size pieces or slightly larger, according to preference. Step 3: In a large bowl mix chicken with onion, oil, cumin, cinnamon and salt. Step 4: Set aside To make the sauce, combine all ingredients from the cashews up to and including black pepper Process until pureed using a blender, hand blender or a food processor. Step 5: Melt butter in large heatproof casserole pot Brown chicken and onions turning to brown all sides well. Step 6: Add cashew sauce to pot. Step 7: Cover tightly and bake in oven for 40 minute.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, garlic, potatoes, tomatoes with juice, oil, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, turmeric, ground coriander, chili powder, paprika, salt, cayenne pepper, garam masala, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up chicken into bite-sized pieces If you leave a little of the fat on the chicken you can use less oil in the cooking Scrub potatoes and cut into uniform bite-sized pieces. Step 2: Heat 2 teaspoons of oil at medium-high heat in a large saute pan, add garlic. Step 3: Saute garlic and chicken until the chicken is cooked. Step 4: Remove from pan, leaving behind any oil, set chicken aside. Step 5: Add 2 teaspoons oil to the pan and heat. Step 6: Add cumin seeds and asafoetida and let them sizzle for about 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, yellow onion, tomatoes, cumin, turmeric, curry powder, garam masala, cinnamon, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken breasts into cubes Sear the meat on all sides in a hot skillet. Step 2: Add the ginger, onions and garlic and cook until the onions are tender. Step 3: Add the cumin, turmeric, curry powder, garam marsala and cinnamon and stir to coat the chicken thoroughly. Step 4: Add oil to the pan if necessary to keep the spices from sticking. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and tomato sauce. Step 6: Bring the mixture to a boil. Step 7: Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Step 8: Serve over rice with unleavened bread for a delicious meal For a different flavor, you may substitute beef or lamb for the chicken.
