Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, butter, vegetable oil, onions, sugar, garlic, curry powder, turmeric, saffron, basmati rice, low sodium chicken broth, water, dark raisin, frozen peas, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken cubes with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat oil and butter in a dutch oven with a tight-fitting lid over medium heat. Step 3: Add in chicken then brown until cooked through, remove to plate. Step 4: Add in the onions and 1 teaspoon sugar. Step 5: Saute stirring with wooden spoon for about 15-20 minutes until browned adding in garlic the last 4-5 minutes of cooking. Step 6: Add in curry powder and turmeric. Step 7: Stir for 1-2 minutes to release flavours. Step 8: Add in basmati rice and stir with wooden spoon for 2-3 minutes Slowly add in the chicken broth and water stirring with a wooden spoon to combine.

Ingredient Names: red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander, garam masala, salt, turmeric powder, chicken drumsticks
Instructions: Step 1: Take skin off of the chicken if desired. Step 2: Add all ingredients except chicken into ziploc bag and mix well. Step 3: In a separate ziploc bag place 5 tablespoons of the mixture. Step 4: Place about 4 chicken legs in the bag Close bag and shake well. Step 5: Place legs in baking pan. Step 6: Repeat with remaining chicken legs. Step 7: Bake chicken 45 minutes @375 or until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, curry powder, red pepper, turmeric, black pepper, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, salt, water, vegetable oil, onion, potatoes, carrot, tomato sauce, boneless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare a marinade by combining lemon juice, curry, red pepper, turmeric, black pepper, cinnamon, cloves, salt and water in a shallow pan. Step 2: Cut chicken into 1-inch strips and place in the marinade for 20 minutes, turning at least once. Step 3: In a heavy skillet or dutch oven, heat oil and saut onions for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Add potatoes and carrots and brown them slightly, stirring constantly for about 4 minutes. Step 5: Add tomato sauce, chicken and marinade. Step 6: Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring frequently.

Ingredient Names: smoked paprika, chili powder, curry powder, ground cumin, garlic powder, ground turmeric, ground cardamom, ground coriander, onion powder, dry mustard, fennel seed, garam masala, rubbed sage, salt & fresh ground pepper, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix paprika, chili powder, curry powder, cumin, garlic powder, turmeric, cardamom, coriander, onion powder, mustard, fennel seeds, garam masala, sage, salt, black pepper, and ginger together in a bowl. Step 2: Cook's Rub all dry ingredients over the whole chicken Including the inside cavity and under the skin. Step 3: Cook for 1 hours or until.

Ingredient Names: roasting chickens, salt & freshly ground black pepper, ghee, onion, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, fresh ginger, curry powder, chicken stock, coconut milk, cashew halves, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook it in the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat on the skin side to brown it and to render the fat from the skin, about 15 minute turn the chicken over and cook on the bone side for about 5 minute remove the chicken from the pan and reserve. Step 2: Pour all but 2 tbs Of the fat out of the pan and stir in the onion, garlic, chiles, and ginger. Step 3: Cook over medium heat while stirring frequently until the onion lightly caramelizes, about 15 minute add the curry powder and saut until fragrant, about 2 minute. Step 4: Add the chicken stock to the pan, scraping up any browned bits, and return the chicken pieces to the pan. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer, covered, until the chicken is firm to the touch and cooked through, 20 to 25 minute add the coconut milk, simmer until thickened, and remove from the heat. Step 6: Transfer the chicken to shallow serving bowls, spoon the sauce over, and sprinkle with the chopped cashews and cilantro.

Dish Name: Indian Chicken With Vegetables Murgh Subji Wala
Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, vegetable oil, ground cumin, onion, garlic, minced ginger, turmeric, bell pepper, tomatoes, fresh mushrooms, cayenne pepper, coriander powder, salt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Remove skin and all visible fat from chicken. Step 2: Cut small slits into chicken to allow seasoning to penetrate, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in large saucepan. Step 4: Cook chicken pieces over medium-high heat until chicken is opaque, turning frequently, 5-6 minutes. Step 5: Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Step 6: Add cumin, onion, garlic, turmeric, and ginger to pan. Step 7: Cook stirring constantly until onions are caramelized, about 6-7 minutes. Step 8: Add bell pepper, tomato, mushrooms, cayenne pepper, coriander powder and salt, stirring to mix well. Step 9: Place chicken in pan, cover, reduce heat, and simmer till chicken is tender, 25-35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chicken breast fillets, hot chili powder, ginger-garlic paste, flour, red onion, jalapeno peppers, soy sauce, sweet asian chicken chili sauce, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Add vegetable oil to a depth of 1-2 inches in a pot. Step 2: Heat on medium-high heat. Step 3: Cut chicken breast fillets into bite-sized pieces. Step 4: Combine chicken, chili powder, and five tbsp of ginger-garlic paste in a bowl. Step 5: Mix well while lightly covering mixture with the 1 / 2 cup of flour Chicken pieces should be fully covered with flour, set aside. Step 6: Add about 1 / 4 cup of vegetable oil to the wok and heat on medium-high. Step 7: Add sliced onion, sliced peppers, and two tbsp of ginger-garlic paste to wok. Step 8: Stir occasionally ensuring the vegetables are coated in oil.

Ingredient Names: onions, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic, chicken thighs, chicken breast, chicken, green chilies, green onions, water, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Put in onions and fry until they are caramelized, stirring every so often While the onions are caramelizing, cut the chicken into bite size pieces Coat each piece with cornstarch. Step 3: Add ginger and garlic to onions and fry some more. Step 4: When the onions, ginger and garlic are done, push them up to the sides of the wok to make room for the chicken. Step 5: Add chicken pieces to the hot oil. Step 6: Fry until the chicken is brown and has crispy bits on the edges. Step 7: Stir onion mixture from the wok sides into the chicken. Step 8: Add green chilies and green onion.

Dish Name: Indian Curry With Potatoes Chicken And Eggplant
Ingredient Names: oil, chicken breasts, tomatoes, potatoes, eggplants, onion, water, garam masala, turmeric, curry powder, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cut all of the vegetables and the chicken accordingly. Step 2: Put all ingredients into a large pot. Step 3: Cook over high heat for approximately 10 minutes. Step 4: Turn heat to low and let slow cook for approximately 7 hours. Step 5: Serve with hot basmati rice or naan / chapatis / roti.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, bay leaves, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, ground chicken, fresh peas, turmeric, garam masala, cayenne pepper, salt, lemon juice, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put oil in wide pan and set over medium-high heat. Step 2: When oil is hot, add cinnamon, cardamom, and bay leaves. Step 3: Stir for a few seconds, add in onion. Step 4: Stir and fry until onion browns at edges. Step 5: Add garlic and stir for a few seconds. Step 6: Add ginger and stir for a few more seconds, now add chicken. Step 7: Stir and fry until all lumps are broken up. Step 8: Add remaining ingredients.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, garlic cloves, salt, ground coriander, ground ginger, ground turmeric, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, ground red pepper, chicken, cucumbers, fresh cilantro, garlic clove, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 1 cup yogurt, 2 cloves garlic, salt through red pepper in a large re-sealable food storage bag to blend, add chicken. Step 2: Marinate in refrigerator 4 to 24 hours, preheat broiler. Step 3: Cover baking sheet with foil. Step 4: Place chicken on prepared baking sheet Broil 6 inches from heat about 30 minutes or until cooked through, turning once. Step 5: Meanwhile, make raita. Step 6: Mix cucumbers, 1 / 3 cup yogurt, cilantro, garlic, salt and pepper in a small bowl. Step 7: Serve alongside chicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken, oil, onion, tomatoes, fresh coriander leaves, ginger paste, garlic paste, garam masala powder, bay leaves, red chilies, coriander seeds, red chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind coriander seeds and whole red chillies into a coarse powder. Step 2: Heat oil in a kadai, add bay leaves. Step 3: After about 30 seconds, add onions and saute till they turn light golden brown. Step 4: Add ginger-garlic paste. Step 5: Saute for 2 minutes on medium flame. Step 6: Add the above coarse powder, stir well. Step 7: Add tomatoes and cook till they are fully cooked. Step 8: Add chicken pieces, salt to taste and red chilli powder.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, low-fat plain yogurt, curry powder, fresh coriander, garlic clove, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Make three incisions in the top of each chicken breast. Step 2: Place the chicken in the marinade, evenly coat, leave for at least one hour or overnight. Step 3: Place under a preheated grill and cook for 15-20 minutes until beginning to char and completely cooked through. Step 4: Slice each breast, lay on a bed of cooked rice with diced red pepper and chopped coriander stirred through.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, whole cloves, whole black peppercorns, whole cardamom pods, ground cinnamon, ground coriander, ground cumin, poppy seed, ground mace, salt, lemon juice, plain yogurt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: First you have to make the marinade for the chicken Peel and coarsely chop 3 of the onions. Step 2: Place the chopped onion, garlic, and ginger in an electric blender, along with the cloves, peppercorns, the seeds only from the 8 cardamoms, cinnamon, coriander, cumin, poppy seeds, mace, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt, and the lemon juice. Step 3: Blend all of these at high speed until you have a smooth paste. Step 4: Place this paste in a large bowl. Step 5: Add the yogurt and mix well. Step 6: Now peel the 3 remaining onions. Step 7: Slice them into very fine rings, and halve all the rings. Step 8: In a 10 inch heavy bottomed skillet, heat the oil over medium flame. Step 9: When hot, add the bay leaves and 4 black cardamoms.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, water, paprika, coriander, ginger, cumin, nutmeg, turmeric, cayenne pepper, lemon juice, skinless chicken breasts, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, stir together oil and garlic. Step 2: Stir in water, paprika, ginger, coriander, cumin, nutmeg, turmeric and cayenne pepper. Step 3: Spoon 1 tbsp into another small bowl. Step 4: Stir in lemon juice and set aside. Step 5: Arrange chicken in single layer in shallow glass dish. Step 6: Brush with remaining spice mixture. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate chicken for 1 hour. Step 8: Place chicken, flesh side down, on greased grill over medium-high heat Close lid and cook for 5 minutes. Step 9: Turn and brush flesh with reserved lemon mixture.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, yellow onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, paprika, salt, fresh jalapeno peppers, crushed tomatoes, heavy cream, cinnamon stick, water, frozen chopped spinach
Instructions: Step 1: In large frying pan, heat oil over medium-low heat. Step 2: Add onion and cook until starting to soften, about 3 minutes add garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in cumin, coriander,, turmeric, paprika and 1 tsp of the salt. Step 4: Cook until spices are fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in jalapenos and tomatoes. Step 6: Add cream, cinnamon stick and water and stir well, add spinach, bring to a simmer. Step 7: Cover pan, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in chicken and remaining 1 / 2 tsp salt.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Chicken Patties With Cucumber Raita
Ingredient Names: white bread, chicken breast fillets, mint leaf, ground turmeric, smoked paprika, ground cumin, coriander seeds, oil, lebanese cucumber, greek yogurt, flat leaf parsley, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Place bread in a food processor Processs until breadcrumbs form. Step 2: Add chicken, mint, turmeric, paprika, cumin and coriander seeds Process until mixture comes together. Step 3: Using 1 / 4 cup mixutre pet patty, make twelve 1cm thick patties. Step 4: Heat oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 5: Cook patties, in batches, for 2-3 minutes each side or until cooked through. Step 6: Transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm Raita: - best made for immediate use as per jubes review. Step 7: Meanwhile, using a vegetable peeler, peel long, thin strips from cucumber.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Grilled Chicken South Beach Diet Phase 1
Ingredient Names: nonfat plain yogurt, fresh lemon juice, garam masala, paprika, salt, fresh ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, paprika, salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a small bowl. Step 2: Divide mixture between 2 large resealable plastic bags. Step 3: Place 5 chicken breasts in each bag, seal bags, and turn to coat chicken with marinade Lay bags flat in the refrigerator. Step 4: Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 5: Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high. Step 6: Remove chicken from bags. Step 7: Brush grill with oil and grill chicken until cooked through, about 7 minutes per side, serve warm. Step 8: Make-ahead: chicken can be marinated in resealable plastics bags in the refrigerator up to 1 day.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Marinated Chicken Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, garlic cloves, ground ginger, cayenne pepper, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cardamom, cinnamon, salt, vinegar, peppercorns, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken in large zip-loc style plastic bag Dump the next 9 ingredients in a blender and give a whirl for about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add this marinade to the chicken in the bag and seal. Step 3: Knead bag to mix meat in the marinade and ensure that the meat is covered. Step 4: Marinate in the refrigerator for 18-24 hours. Step 5: Place the chicken in the crock pot with the whole peppercorns and bay leaves. Step 6: Cook on high for 6 hours.

Ingredient Names: cardamom pods, cayenne pepper, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, black peppercorns, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind all the ingredients together in a coffee grinder or pestle and mortar Use as required.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, saffron, ground nutmeg, milk, butter, onion, hard-boiled eggs, dried apricot, fresh green chilies, sultana, ground almonds, white poppy seeds, spring onions, garlic cloves, five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the saffron and nutmeg into the milk. Step 2: Brush the chicken skin with the mixture and then pour the remaining milk into the body cavity. Step 3: Melt the butter in a large pan and when hot brown the chicken all over, remove the chicken and set aside for stuffing. Step 4: Using the same pan, in the remaining butter fry the chopped onions chillies, and sultanas, for 3 minutes remove from the heat. Step 5: Add the ground almonds, poppy seeds, apricots and eggs. Step 6: Stuff the chicken with the mixture In the same pan fry all off the masala ingredients over low heat for 4 mins, add the water and stir well. Step 7: Place the chicken on the bed of masala, cover the pan and cook over medium heat till chicken is tender, about 1 1 / 4 hours. Step 8: Serve the chicken with the masala gravy poured over and garnished with the coconut.

Ingredient Names: limes, low-fat plain yogurt, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, garlic, turkey cutlets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Grate 1 teaspoon peel from 1 lime and squeeze 1 tablespoon juice. Step 3: Cut remaining lime into wedges Reserve for squeezing juice over cooked cutlets. Step 4: In a large bowl, mix lime peel and juice, yogurt, vegetable oil, ginger, cumin, coriander, garlic and salt Just before cooking add turkey cutlets to the yogurt mixture and stir to cover cutlets Do not let cutlets marinate more than 15 minutes or the texture will become mealy Broil 2 1 / 2 minutes on each side, 5 minutes total. Step 5: Serve with lime wedges and steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: fat green mild chili, garlic, ginger, fresh coriander, full-fat greek yogurt, onions, bone-in chicken thighs, groundnut, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, butter, chili-ginger garnish
Instructions: Step 1: Make the Chilli-ginger garnish, before you start the chicken. Step 2: Cut down the length of the green chillies, then remove the seeds by scraping them out with a teaspoon. You may want to wear rubber gloves for this job - fiery seeds can give the fingers a real chilli sting. Cut off the stalk ends, chop the chillies into rough pieces and put them in a blender or food processor. Peel and roughly chop the garlic and add to the chillies. Do the same with the ginger. Step 3: Pick the leaves off the coriander and drop them into the blender as you go (reserve the stems for the garnish). Tip in the yogurt and blitz everything to a puree. This can take a few minutes and you may have to stop the blender a few times to scrape all the gunge down from the sides - a rubber spatula will make this job much easier. Step 4: Peel, halve and thinly slice the onions. Pull the skin off the chicken, using kitchen paper to help you get a good grip. Heat the oil in a saute pan over a medium heat until hot - when you drop in a spice seed or two it should sizzle. Toss in the fennel and cumin seeds and let them crackle and pop for 10-20 seconds, stirring all the time so they don't burn. They're ready when you get a lovely whiff of warm nuts. If the oil starts to smoke, remove pan from the heat. Step 5: Plop in the butter and let it melt, then throw in the sliced onions and turn the heat down a tad. Stir to mix the onions and spice seeds, then cook for about 10 minutes until the onions are meltingly soft and tinged golden brown. Give them a vigorous stir now and then, but don't stir them too often or they won't take on any colour. Step 6: Push the onions to one side of the pan, then add the chicken thighs, smooth side down. Increase the heat to between medium and high and fry the chicken until it's golden brown on both sides. This should take about 15-20 minutes and you will need to turn the pieces over halfway (a pair of tongs are good for this). Watch carefully in case the onions start to brown too much - if they do, pile them up on top of the chicken. Step 7: Stir in some of the yogurt mixture and cook until it disappears - repeat a dollop at a time. Whizz 150ml/¼ pint cold water in the blender to use the last bits of the mixture and add to the pan with a pinch of salt. Stir until bubbling, scraping up any crispy bits. Reduce the heat to its lowest and cover the pan tightly. Simmer for 30-35 minutes or until the chicken is tender when pierced, stirring and turning halfway and adding a splash of hot water if the sauce is too dry. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped coriander stems and a little chilli garnish (put the rest in a bowl on the table).

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic butter, breadcrumbs, korma paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken on a baking tray Rub with a little of the butter, season, then cook under a heated grill / broiler for 15 minutes, turning just once until cooked through. Step 2: Mix together the remaining garlic butter, korma paste and the breadcrumbs. Step 3: Remove the chicken from the grill, then top each breast with a smear of the breadcrumbed butter. Step 4: Return to the grill and cook for 3 to 5 minutes until the breadcrumbs are golden and the butter melted. Step 5: Serve the chicken and all of the buttery juices with some potatoes and veg if you like.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs with thigh, paprika, garam masala, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, dried apricot, warm water, oil, onions, chopped tomatoes, salt, sugar, vinegar, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Step 2: Mix paprika, garam masala, ginger and garlic into a paste and toss chicken into mixture. Step 3: Marinate 4 hours or overnight. Step 4: Using the warm water, rehydrate dried apricots This may take some time depending on where apricots are from. Step 5: When ready to cook, heat oil in large saucepan over high heat. Step 6: Add chicken pieces and cook until browned. Step 7: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 8: Saute onions in same pan for 5 min and then return chicken back to saucepan. Step 9: Add tomatoes, cover and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Jhal Frezi Chicken Easy And Delicious
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, chopped tomatoes, garlic clove, ground turmeric, chili powder, salt, ground cumin, curry powder, ground coriander, fresh ginger, green chili, fresh cilantro, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium or large skillet over med-high heat. Step 2: Add the onions and saut 2 minutes, add garlic and saut 2 more minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken, ground turmeric, chili powder and salt. Step 4: Fry for 5 minutes constantly stirring everything. Step 5: Add the can of tomatoes, bring to boil, cover and simmer on med-low to low heat for 10 minutes. Step 6: Add ground cumin, curry powder, ground coriander ginger, and the optional green chilies, stir, cover again and simmer for another 10 minutes. Step 7: Remove cover, raise heat to to medium to evaporate some of the excess liquid, 7-8 minutes. Step 8: Add the butter / ghee, and cilantro, simmer on low 5-7 minutes and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, baby carrots, curry powder, chinese five spice powder, chicken broth, sour cream, cornstarch, water, hot pepper oil, crushed red pepper flakes, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together sour cream, broth, curry powder, 5 spice and hot pepper oil / crushed red pepper in a large bowl, set aside. Step 2: Cut chicken into cubes or strips. Step 3: Slice onion into medium sized pieces. Step 4: Cut the carrots if you want to also. Step 5: Place chicken, carrots and onion into a large pot on the stove. Step 6: Pour broth mixture into pot, gently stirring ingredients together. Step 7: Bring almost to boiling over medium high heat, the reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 1 hour to 1 5 hours stirring occasionally until chicken is cooked through and carrots and onions have reached desired tenderness During the last 10 minutes of cooking, stir together the cornstarch and water thoroughly, and stir it into the pot.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, white rice, onion, sliced mushrooms, butter, olive oil, smooth cashew butter, half-and-half, coconut milk, chicken broth, cayenne, turmeric, cinnamon, ground cloves, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: In a large saucepan saut the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms in butter and olive oil until onions are opaque. Step 3: Add spices and the remaining sauce ingredients except for one of the cans of broth. Step 4: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Turn off heat and add cubed chicken, stir. Step 6: Put uncooked rice in the bottom a large lightly-oiled lasagne pan and carefully pour the chicken / sauce mixture over. Step 7: Bake in 375 degree oven for 30 minutes, add the remaining can of chicken broth into the pan and stir well, then bake for an additional 30 minutes until rice is cooked through Makes about 10-12 potluck servings.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, extra firm tofu, onion, sliced mushrooms, butter, olive oil, smooth cashew butter, half-and-half, african bird pepper, turmeric, cinnamon, ground cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the onion, saute in butter and olive oil until they're opaque Throw in the sliced mushrooms, cubed firm tofu, cubed chicken breast meat, and saute some more. Step 2: Add the spices, saute until chicken is cooked and onions are browned Warm the cashew butter in the microwave for about 45 seconds, to soften it. Step 3: Then add the half and half and cashew butter to the chicken mixture and stir The sauce will pretty much thicken by itself Mike eats his over fragrant jasmine rice I eat mine over collard greens Yum!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, white rice, water, chicken bouillon powder, dried onion flakes, sliced mushrooms, smooth cashew butter, cayenne, turmeric, cinnamon, ground cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cardamom, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together all ingredients except for the coconut milk and half and half in the crock pot. Step 2: Cook on high for 4 to 6 hours or until rice is tender, stirring well every couple of hours 30 minutes before serving add in the coconut milk and the half and half, stir well, and let cook for another 30 minutes Makes about 4 servings You can also add cauliflower pieces into the recipe to stretch it and it tastes great! Step 3: I've also added cubes of extra firm tofu when i add the coconut milk, and those taste great, as well Either that, or cook the rice separately and you'll have lots of tasty sauce for the meal!

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, tandoori paste, egg, garlic, green chili pepper, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together and make round patties Bake on a greased baking sheet at 450f degrees Degrees for about 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, onions, garlic paste, ginger paste, tomatoes, coriander seed, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, cardamoms, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, red chili pepper, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Add coriander seeds, cinnamon, cardamom and bay leaves. Step 3: Once oil is hot, add the sliced onions. Step 4: Fry till golden brown. Step 5: Add ginger and garlic and fry till onions are dark brown. Step 6: Add cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chili powder and salt. Step 7: Fry the mixture for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add chopped tomatoes. Step 9: Fry the mixture till the you can see oil separating at the sides. Step 10: Add chicken and mix well.

Dish Name: Kali Mirch Murg Chicken Curry With Black Pepper
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, bay leaf, cloves, black peppercorns, ginger paste, garlic paste, chicken fillets, ground turmeric, chili powder, salt, plain yogurt, rice, tomatoes, lemon juice, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the sunflower oil in a wok. Step 2: Add the bay leaf, cloves and peppercorns, and fry briefly, stirring in the ginger and garlic pastes. Step 3: After 30 seconds, add the chicken and mix well. Step 4: Add the turmeric, chilli powder and salt and allow the chicken to cook in its juices. Step 5: Meanwhile, place the tomatoes in a serving dish. Step 6: Season with a sprinkling of salt and lemon juice. Step 7: Sprinkle with coriander leaves. Step 8: Stir the yoghurt into the chicken, mixing well. Step 9: Heat the chicken curry through, check the seasoning and serve with boiled rice and the tomato salad.

Ingredient Names: ghee, nigella seeds, cumin seed, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, turmeric, cayenne pepper, garam masala, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or large deep skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add kalonji seeds and when they begin to sizzle add cumin seeds and allow both to sizzle for 45 seconds. Step 3: Reduce heat and add onions. Step 4: Saute for 10 minutes or until golden, add garlic. Step 5: Cook until garlic is golden, then add ginger, tomatoes and tomato paste, stir well. Step 6: Add salt, turmeric, cayenne and garam masala. Step 7: Cook until oil separates from sauce, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Add chicken pieces and cook, uncovered, on medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, fresh green chilies, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, salt, garam masala, gingerroot, tomatoes, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: For the karahi curry sauce: heat the oil in a pan, add the onions, garlic and chillies and fry over a medium heat for approximately 10 minutes or until the onions are caramelised. Step 2: Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt and garam masala and stir. Step 3: Mix in the ginger and pureed tomatoes and cook for 1 minute, stirring. Step 4: Add the water and cook for about 5 minutes or until the oil surfaces. Step 5: Remove from the heat and keep warm For the chicken: heat the oil in a wok or heavy-based frying pan and add the chicken. Step 6: Stir-fry over a medium heat for 8-10 minutes or until the chicken is golden brown all over. Step 7: Stir in the karahi curry sauce and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green cardamom pods, chicken pieces, yogurt, tomatoes, red chili powder, cashews, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in oil until lightly golden 2. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger and cook until all is light brown 3. Step 3: Add chicken and cardamom and cook 15-20 minutes over med-high heat 4. Step 4: Add yogurt, tomatores and red chile powder. Step 5: Cook 20-30 minutes, stirring constantly, over med heat until chicken is cooked through. Step 6: Remove cardamom pods.

Dish Name: Kashmiri Chicken Cardamom And Saffron Pilau Spiced Indian Rice
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, oil, onions, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, cumin seeds, boneless chicken, saffron strand, boiling water, cardamom pods, of fresh mint, garam masala, cinnamon stick, chopped tomatoes, sultanas
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the basmati rice several times in cold water and drain in a colander - leave to dry. Step 2: Heat half of the oil in a large pan and add half of the onion, the garlic, ginger and cumin seeds. Step 3: Fry them over a gentle heat for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken pieces and brown them - turning them regularly to achieve a good colour all over. Step 5: Add the saffron, boiling water, cardamom pods, mint, garam masala and cinnamon stick. Step 6: Bring it all to the boil and then cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender. Step 7: Transfer all the contents to a bowl and rinse out the pan. Step 8: Add the remaining oil and onion to the pan and fry until the onion is lightly coloured. Step 9: Add the rice and stir it well, cook for about 2 to 3 minutes until the rice is opaque. Step 10: Add the chicken mixture, tomatoes and sultanas - then season to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, ground turmeric, ground coriander, black pepper, chili powder, salt, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, onion, cumin seeds, curry, ginger paste, garlic paste, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a large bowl, and season with turmeric powder, coriander powder, black pepper, chili powder, and salt. Step 2: Cover bowl, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 3: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Step 4: Fry mustard seeds, fenugreek, onion, cumin seeds, and curry leaves in oil for about 3 to 4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in garlic and ginger pastes, and cook for another 2 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken and water, stir, and cover with lid. Step 7: Cook for 20 to 25 minutes. Step 8: Stir in coconut milk, and cook until almost dry. Step 9: Stir to keep the chicken from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Step 10: Stir in lime juice, and cook until dry.

Dish Name: Kaypee's Homemade Indian Lamb Masala Curry
Ingredient Names: lamb shoulder, red onions, tomatoes, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, cinnamon stick, cumin seed, green cardamoms, turmeric powder, garam masala, ground nutmeg, bay leaves, cilantro, cloves, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: If you have time you can marinade lamb with mixture of yogurt, garlic, ginger, salt, kashmiri red chilli powder night before or 2-4 hours for more tenderness. Step 2: In a large pot pour vegetable oil, turn stove on to medium high, add chopped onions, cumin seeds, garlic, ginger, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, cloves. Step 3: Saute onions until golden translucent about 6-8 minutes. Step 4: Add lamb pieces mix so onion mixture is blended together. Step 5: Cover reduce heat to medium and let meat blend with onion mixture for about 8 minutes. Step 6: Uncover give a stir, you will see meat has given out some liquid to mixture. Step 7: Add 2 tablespoon water to avoid sticking at bottom, if necessary, then add garam masala, curry powder, serrano chopped chilliessalt, nutmeg, turmeric powder, coriander powder, reserved yogurt mixture and mix it well so lamb pieces are blended with spices and mixture, cover cook for 8-10 minutes, uncover and mix it well, cover cook for 10-12 minutes. Step 8: Add chopped tomatoes, cover cook 10 minutes. Step 9: Add 1-2 cups of watergive it a stir taste gravy, add salt or cayenne if needed, cover it 3 / 4 way bring heat to little over medium cook for 40-45 minutes Give it a stir add cilantro, bring heat to medium low, cook another 5 minutes covered.

Dish Name: Keema Matar Indian Minced Chicken And Peas
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, green peas, vegetable oil, cumin, onion, garlic cloves, ginger paste, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, tomato paste, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ground chicken with cumin, garlic, ginger, red pepper, and tomato paste. Step 2: Heat the oil on high heat in a large skillet and cook the onion until it begins to brown. Step 3: Add the chicken and cook until done. Step 4: Add the peas and cook until they are heated through and softened, add salt to taste. Step 5: Serve with rice and garnish with chopped cilantro and hard-boiled eggs.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, ground black pepper, turmeric, onions, green chilies, oil, butter, mustard seeds, bay leaf, garlic cloves, cinnamon sticks, cardamoms, cloves, curry leaves, skinless chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the ginger, turmeric and black pepper with mortar and pestle. Step 2: Mix the sliced onions with the chilies. Step 3: Heat the oil, and butter in a deep pan, add the mustard seeds, when they start to pop add the bay leaf, stir. Step 4: Add the onions and chillies, fry till just golden. Step 5: Add the cinnamon, garlic and cardamoms, fry 1 minute add the ginger paste, cloves and curry leaves, cook 1 minute. Step 6: Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes. Step 7: Pour in the coconut milk and stock and cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the frozen vegetables and potatoes, sprinkle with garam masala.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, tomatoes, chili powder, spring onions, green chili, salt, cooking oil, cumin seed, ginger, garlic, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicked in karahi or wok and cook in own juices over low heat for 10 mins, stirring now and then. Step 2: Add tomatoes, chilli powder, spring onions, green chillies and salt then cook uncovered over medium heat for 15 to 20 mins until moisture has almost evaporated In another small pan heat the oil and fry the cummin seeds until they begin to turn pink then add the ginger and garlic Continue to cook for another minute. Step 3: Add this mixture to the chicken along with most of the chopped coriander and mix well together. Step 4: Simmer for 5- 7 minutes. Step 5: Serve, garnished with the remaining coriander along with warm indian breads.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, onion, plain yogurt, butter, garlic, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, ground almonds, salt, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken in ovenproof dish and leave to one side Gently fry onion in the butter until softened. Step 2: Put onion and remaining ingredients in a food processor and process to a smooth sauce, adding a little water if necessary to give a consistency of thick cream. Step 3: Pour sauce over chicken, cover then cook in oven at 200c for 15 mins until chicken is tender. Step 4: Garnish with fresh coriander then serve with boiled rice and warm indian breads.

Ingredient Names: curry leaves, mustard seeds, fennel seed, onion seeds, dried red chili, cumin seed, pomegranate seeds, salt, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, canola oil, fresh green chile, onion, skinless chicken, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the spices and salt together in a small bowl. Step 2: In a separate bowl, combine garlic and ginger. Step 3: Heat oil in non-stick pan, when the oil is hot add the spice mixture, then the green chilies. Step 4: Add onion and stir-fry over medium heat for 5-7 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomato and chicken pieces for about 7 minutes or until the chicken is cooked. Step 6: Stir the mixture for another 3-5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken pieces, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, oil, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, canned tomatoes, salt, water, fresh green chilies, garam masala, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender process the onion, garlic, and ginger, add little water to make a smooth paste. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the onion / garlic mix for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the turmeric, ground coriander, cumin, and the chilli powder, turn heat to low and cook for 30 mins, stirring often so that the mix does not stick or burn. Step 4: Add half of the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken stir and cook till the meat changes colour, 5 minutes now add the rest of the tomatoes and any juice. Step 6: Add the salt and water, bring to the b oil, reduce the heat and simmer covered till the chicken is tender. Step 7: Stir to prevent sticking. Step 8: Add the green chillies and garam masala, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Step 9: Stir in the chopped coriander leaves And serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, spanish onions, boneless chicken breasts, green chilies, white pepper, spring onion, dark soy sauce, hot chili powder, salt, cornflour, gingerroot, garlic cloves, malt vinegar, tomato puree, demerara sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade: Marinating it for longer will increase its flavour. Step 2: Mix all the marinade ingredients together and set aside. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy-based pan and fry the onion over a medium heat for 5 mins until softened, but not coloured. Step 4: Remove from the heat, cool and combine with the marinade in a large bowl. Step 5: Add the chicken and stir to coat. Step 6: Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes. Step 7: Heat the remaining oil in the pan. Step 8: Top with the spring onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken drumsticks, margarine, oil, onion, garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, curry powder, salt, black pepper, paprika, white wine, soy yogurt, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Mix spices with minced onion and garlic. Step 2: In a separate bowl, mix the flour with the yogurt, and then mix in the lemon juice. Step 3: Melt the margarine in a frying pan with the oil. Step 4: Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes on medium heat. Step 5: Flip the chicken over, add the spice mixture and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the wine, cover the pan and cook for 10 minutes. Step 7: Remove the chicken alone from the frying pan and put in an open baking pan. Step 8: Pour the remaining contents of the frying pan into the yogurt-lemon juice-flour mixture and mix. Step 9: Pour this mixture over the chicken in the pan and bake for 15-20 minutes on medium heat.

Dish Name: Kozhi Shtoo South Indian Chicken Stew
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, vegetable oil, whole black peppercorns, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, whole cardamom pods, onions, fresh ginger, flour, hot green chili peppers, coconut milk, potatoes, salt, lemon juice, coconut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Over a medium flame, heat 6 tablespoons of oil in a large, wide-based casserole pan. Step 2: When hot, put in the peppercorns, cinnamon sticks, cloves and cardamom pods. Step 3: Stir once and add the ginger and onions Saut until the onions are translucent. Step 4: Put in the flour and stir it around for half a minute. Step 5: Add the green chillies, chicken, and thin coconut milk, bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover, then turn the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes. Step 7: Add the potatoes and the salt and stir. Step 8: Bring to a boil, then cover.

Dish Name: Kuure Ed Chicken A Yooper Inspired Recipe
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, boneless skinless chicken thighs, garlic, ground ginger, cayenne pepper, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cardamom, cinnamon, salt, vinegar, peppercorns, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken pieces in a ziploc bag Dump the next nine ingredients in your blender and give it a good whirl for about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add the marinade to the bag. Step 3: Remove the air from the bag and seal. Step 4: Knead the bag to mix the meat and marinade Ensure that all the meat is covered. Step 5: Refrigerate for 18 to 24 hours. Step 6: Place in a large pot over low heat. Step 7: Add the whole peppercorns and the bay leaves. Step 8: Simmer for at least 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: chicken, hot sauce, ginger-garlic paste, tomato ketchup, red chili powder, vinegar, plain yogurt, lemons, saffron, curry leaves, green chilies, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into pieces, wash them and keep them in an open vessel so that all the pieces of the chicken touch the surface of the vessel Apply ginger-garlic paste on the chicken and toss to coat it well with the paste. Step 2: Add salt, lime juice, hot sauce, tomato ketchup and mix again. Step 3: Add yogurt, chilli powder and vinegar, mix again. Step 4: Add food colour and mix. Step 5: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 6: Fry curry leaves and green chillies in it, keep aside. Step 7: When the oil is warm, add this oil to the chicken.

Dish Name: Lemon Chicken Stir Fry With Walnuts
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, fresh lemongrass, onion, walnuts, lemon juice, fresh lemon rind, chicken stock cube, soya sauce, rosemary, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a non-stick wok, cook the chicken until browned all over. Step 2: Remove and keep warm in a bowl. Step 3: Add onions, bell peppers' and lemon grass. Step 4: Cook until veggies are crisp tender. Step 5: Add walnuts, stir-fry for a minute or two, add chicken, lime juice, sauce, rind, stock cube and garlic and rosemary. Step 6: Stir-fry until it has heated through, serve hot!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh lemon zest, lemon juice, white wine, olive oil, red onions, coriander seeds, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red potatoes, zucchini, shiitake mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a plastic bag and seal. Step 2: Refrigerate for 30 minutes or longer. Step 3: Drain vegetables and chicken and discard marinate. Step 4: Thread pieces on wooden skewers alternating vegetables, evenly distributing ingredients over all skewers. Step 5: Grill until chicken and potatoes are cooked through basting occasionally with olive oil and turning every few minutes to grill all sides. Step 6: Serve with couscous.

Dish Name: Lemony Chicken With Fresh Coriander Madhur Jaffrey
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, water, chicken breasts, garlic cloves, cilantro, jalapeno, cayenne, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, lemon juice, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ginger and 1 / 4 cups water into a blender or processor. Step 2: Blend until you have a paste. Step 3: Set aside Also, i cut the breasts in half Proceede by putting the oil in a wide, heavy pan over medium-high heat. Step 4: When the oil is hot, put in as many chicken pieces as the pan will hold in a single layer and brown on both sides It's not necessary to deeply brown because of the additional cook time later and they may become dry. Step 5: Remove the chicken pieces with a slotted spoon and put them in a bowl Sear all the chicken pieces this way. Step 6: Add the garlic to the hot oil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cucumbers, low-fat plain kefir, garlic cloves, ground ginger, paprika, cumin powder, ground cayenne pepper, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add the garlic, lemon juice, ground pepper, paprika, cumin and ginger to the kefir / yogurt, stir until well mixed Separate 1 / 2 to 1 cup from the mix Save the rest to use for topping when finished cooking. Step 2: Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Step 3: Make sure to turn to coat all sides evenly. Step 4: Grill: until cooked, juices will run clear Oven: preheat to 425 degrees, cook until finished, about 20 minutes. Step 5: Serve over sliced cucumbers, use remaining kefir / yogurt mix to drizzle over the chicken and cucumbers.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, green capsicum, red capsicum, garam masala powder, dried chili pepper flakes, garlic cloves, chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper, lemon juice, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the chicken in a non-stick large frying pan or wok. Step 2: When the chicken is nearly cooked, add the onion, peppers, garam masala, garlic, and chili and stir-fry for a few minutes now add the tomatoes, salt and pepper and a dash of lemon juice. Step 3: Bring to the boil then simmer very slowly for an hour or so- you want the sauce to reduce by half to give a thick consistency and concentrated flavour.

Ingredient Names: garlic, ginger, ground cinnamon, turmeric, yogurt, boneless, semi-skimmed milk, saffron, onions, rapeseed oil, chili powder, cinnamon half, green cardamom pods to split, cumin seeds, basmati rice, chicken stock, garam masala, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, stir together the garlic, ginger, cinnamon, turmeric and yogurt with some pepper and ¼ tsp salt. Tip in the chicken pieces and stir to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge for about 1 hr or longer if you have time. Warm the milk to tepid, stir in the saffron and set aside. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Slice each onion in half lengthways, reserve half and cut the other half into thin slices. Pour 1½ tbsp of the oil onto a baking tray, scatter over the sliced onion, toss to coat, then spread out in a thin, even layer (step 2). Roast for 40-45 mins, stirring halfway, until golden. Step 3: When the chicken has marinated, thinly slice the reserved onion. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large sauté or frying pan. Fry the onion for 4-5 mins until golden. Stir in the chicken, a spoonful at a time, frying until it is no longer opaque, before adding the next spoonful (this helps to prevent the yogurt from curdling). Once the last of the chicken has been added, stir-fry for a further 5 mins until everything looks juicy. Scrape any sticky bits off the bottom of the pan, stir in the chilli powder, then pour in 100ml water, cover and simmer on a low heat for 15 mins. Remove and set aside. Step 4: Cook the rice while the chicken simmers. Heat another 1 tbsp oil in a large sauté pan, then drop in the cinnamon stick, cardamom, cloves and cumin seeds. Fry briefly until their aroma is released. Tip in the rice (step 3) and fry for 1 min, stirring constantly. Stir in the stock and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and simmer, covered, for about 8 mins or until all the stock has been absorbed. Remove from the heat and leave with the lid on for a few mins, so the rice can fluff up. Stir the garam masala into the remaining 1½ tsp oil and set aside. When the onions are roasted, remove and reduce oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Step 5: Spoon half the chicken and its juices into an ovenproof dish, about 25 x 18 x 6cm, then scatter over a third of the roasted onions. Remove the whole spices from the rice, then layer half of the rice over the chicken and onions. Drizzle over the spiced oil. Spoon over the rest of the chicken and a third more onions. Top with the remaining rice (step 4) and drizzle over the saffron-infused milk. Scatter over the rest of the onions, cover tightly with foil and heat through in the oven for about 25 mins. Serve scattered with the mint and coriander.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, turnip, carrot, yellow onion, chicken breasts, madras curry powder, chicken stock, potato, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a heavy stock pot, add oil. Step 2: Add turnips, carrots, onions, and chicken. Step 3: Saute 'til slightly carmelized. Step 4: Add curry powder, continue to saute 'til the curry coats all of the vegetables and chicken. Step 5: Add water to barely cover ingredients, simmer very slowly for 2 hours. Step 6: Add water to keep the mixture covered. Step 7: Add stock, potato, and chilies. Step 8: Cook and reduce for another hour or so 'til the potatoes break apart and thicken the dish. Step 9: Serve over basmati rice cooked with a few green cardamom pods or a cinnamon stick or a few strands of safron A nice sangria goes very, very well with this dish.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, vegetable oil, curry powder, mango chutney, whipping cream, salt, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Fry onion in oil until translucent but not brown. Step 2: Whisk in curry powder. Step 3: Cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Whisk in pureed chutney and the cream, add salt to taste. Step 5: Saute sliced chicken breast in a small amount of oil until cooked halfway through, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Add sauce and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Garnish with green onions and serve This is great served over jasmine or basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, corn kernel, cumin seed, black peppercorns, coriander seed, cloves, yogurt, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, tomatoes, red capsicums
Instructions: Step 1: Roast cumin seeds, peppercorns, coriander seeds and cloves in a pan. Step 2: Allow to cool completely and then crush them. Step 3: Transfer chicken pieces to a bowl. Step 4: Add salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and yoghurt, mix well, heat oil in a wok. Step 5: Add ginger and garlic. Step 6: Saute for a few minutes until the raw smell is gone. Step 7: Add blanched corn kernels and mix well. Step 8: Stir in half cup of water and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, cayenne, red onions, ginger, chili powder, ground coriander, turmeric, cilantro, chopped tomatoes, fresh lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pour cup oil in a large sauce pot over medium heat. Step 2: When the oil is hot, add the mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, and red chiles Saut for 1-2 minutes, then add the ginger and onions. Step 3: Reduce the heat to medium-low and allow the onions to brown until they are dark and soft enough the smash with a spatulaabout 25-30 minutes. Step 4: Add the chili powder, coriander, turmeric, and cilantromix together. Step 5: Raise the heat back to medium and add the tomatoes, salt, and lime juice. Step 6: Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have disintegrated and the oil separates out15-20 minutes. Step 7: Add cup of water and 1 cup coconut milk. Step 8: Bring to a boil, then turn down the heat. Step 9: In a separate skillet, heat 1 tb.

Dish Name: Malay Style Chicken And Sweet Potato Stew
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, ground cloves, vegetable oil, onions, fresh ginger, garlic, chili peppers, mild curry powder, chicken stock, sweet potatoes, coconut milk, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine the flour, cayenne, cinnamon and cloves and mix well Dredge chicken in flour mixture. Step 2: In a large stockpot, heat the oil over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking. Step 3: Add the chicken pieces in single layer and cook until well browned, remove to platter. Step 4: Reduce the heat to medium, add the onion and cook until just begin to color. Step 5: Add the ginger, garlic, chili pepper and curry powder, and cook stirring constantly for one minute. Step 6: Add stock, the browned chicken and the sweet potatoes, return to a simmer and cook for about 1 hour, covered, until chicken is cooked through Stew may be served at this point or may continue to cook over very low heat for 1-2 hours or longer Just before serving, add the coconut milk, season to taste with salt and continue to cook for one more minute Removed from heat, add the cilantro and mix well.

Ingredient Names: skinless, chunky mango chutney, curry powder, cumin seeds, sunflower oil, onions, bay leaves, cinnamon, basmati rice, fresh coriander, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with foil. Cut a horizontal pocket in each chicken breast, taking care not to cut all the way through to the other side. Stuff with the mango chutney, then seal the pocket closed around the chutney with a cocktail stick. Step 2: Mix the curry powder and 2 tsp cumin seeds with 3 tsp oil, then brush all over the chicken. Place on the baking tray and roast for 25-30 mins until cooked through. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat remaining oil and fry the onions for 6-8 mins until golden. Add remaining cumin, bay and cinnamon then cook, stirring, for 1 min. Stir in the rice. Pour over 450ml boiling water, add a pinch of salt, bring to the boil, stir and cover. Reduce heat; simmer for 15 mins. Step 4: Remove bay and cinnamon, stir in coriander and serve with the chicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs-thighs, dried red chilies, oil, black cardamom pods, green cardamom pods, cloves, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, onions, salt, fennel powder, ginger powder, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Soak whole, dry chilies in water for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 2: Puree to a fine paste with little water. Step 3: Heat oil in a heavy bottom pan. Step 4: Once oil is hot, saute cardamom pods and cloves until fragrant. Step 5: Add bay leaves, onions and fry till brown. Step 6: Add chicken and salt. Step 7: Saute until chicken is nicely browned. Step 8: Add fennel, ginger powder and the prepared red chilli paste. Step 9: Saute for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 10: Add 1 cup of water.

Dish Name: Marinated Chicken Breast With Coconut Curry Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, plain yogurt, lemons, garam masala, turmeric, olive oil, salt, pepper, red chile, lemon grass root, coriander seeds, limes, shallots, garlic, ginger, peanut oil, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare marinade by mixing in a shallow dish the yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala,and turmeric. Step 2: Add the chicken breasts and coat them well with the marinade. Step 3: Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Step 4: Pre-heat oven to 400°F. Step 5: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and brown the chicken on both sides. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Transfer chicken to a small roasting pan and cook in the oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until juices run clear. Step 8: As this is cooking, place the chili, lemon grass, coriander seeds, lime juice, shallot, garlic and ginger in a small food processor and blend into a paste. Step 9: Heat the peanut oil in a small sauce pan. Step 10: Add in the paste and gently fry for 5 minutes, stirring often. Step 11: Add in the coconut milk and mix well. Step 12: Bring to a boil, stirring, then reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce reduces and thickens. Step 13: Remove the chicken to the serving plate and spoon the sauce over the top, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Martha's Cinnamon Broiled Chicken With Raita
Ingredient Names: salt, pepper, cinnamon, whole chicken, cucumber, plain yogurt, sour cream, fresh cilantro, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the broiler. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix 3 / 4 teaspoon salt, 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper, and cinnamon. Step 3: Sprinkle on the chicken. Step 4: Put chicken, skin side down, on a broiler pan, and broil about 6 inches from the heat for 15 minutes. Step 5: Turn chicken, and broil until skin is crisp and brown, about 15 minutes more. Step 6: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together cucumber, yogurt, sour cream, cilantro, cumin, and 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Step 7: Serve chicken hot, with raita on the side.

Ingredient Names: honey, canola oil, coarse salt, fresh ground pepper, garam masala, paprika, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, chicken wings, white wine vinegar, coarse sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons honey, oil, coarse salt, pepper, 1 teaspoon garam masala, paprika, cayenne pepper, and cumin. Step 2: Pour mixture into a 1 gallon resealable plastic bag and add chicken wings, turning to coat. Step 3: Transfer to refrigerator and let marinate at least 30 minutes or up to overnight. Step 4: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 5: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and top with a wire rack. Step 6: Arrange chicken wings in a single layer on rack. Step 7: Transfer to oven and roast for 35 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together remaining 3 tablespoons honey, remaining teaspoon garam masala, and vinegar. Step 9: Remove wings from oven and brush with honey mixture. Step 10: Return wings to oven and continue roasting until wings are slightly charred and crisp, 15 to 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cardamom seed, hot chili powder, ground black pepper, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, vegetable oil, water, chicken drumsticks
Instructions: Step 1: Crush coriander, cumin, and cardamom seeds in grinder or with mortar & pestle. Step 2: Toss seeds and remaining spices in a dry frying pan. Step 3: Stir over heat until fragrant, remove from heat. Step 4: Add oil and water, stir until combined. Step 5: Cut diagonal slits about 1cm apart, through to the bones, on both sides of drumsticks Rub spice mixture all over the drumsticks, place in shallow dish. Step 6: Cover, refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Step 7: Heat oiled griddle pan and cook drumsticks until browned and cooked through Can also be barbecued or grilled.

Ingredient Names: coconut oil, onions, fat garlic, ginger, ground coriander, yellow mustard seeds, garam masala, ground cumin, chicken, chicken stock cube, cinnamon, greek yogurt room temperature, sultanas, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy-based pan. Fry the onions gently for 5 – 10 mins until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, coriander, mustard seeds, garam masala and cumin and cook for 1 - 2 min allowing the aromas to release. Step 2: Add the chicken and cook for 10 mins over a gentle heat, flipping occasionally and making sure the spices don’t catch. Pour in around 300 ml boiling water until almost covering. Stir in the stock cube and cinnamon stick. Simmer for around 45 mins - 1 hour with the lid off so there is a small amount of thickened sauce at the bottom of the pan. Remove the cinnamon stick. Step 3: Stir in the yogurt and sultanas, heat through gently and serve. Scatter with coriander, if using.

Dish Name: Mirj's Hodi Chicken A Curry Creation
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, sweet paprika, fresh ground black pepper, salt, onions, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, garam masala, brown sugar, coconut milk, red peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up the chicken breasts into 3 inch pieces, or into any size you prefer. Step 2: Marinate the chicken breasts in the olive oil, paprika, black pepper and salt Give it a good massage, a relaxed chicken is a tasty chicken You don't have to marinate this for long, 10 minutes should be enough, but overnight works just as well Brown the chicken until cooked through I just brown it in the marinade, but you may want to add some more oil to the pan if you think it needs it. Step 3: Set aside To make the sauce, coarsely chop the onion. Step 4: Saute the onions in the vegetable oil until wonderfully caramalized and golden brown. Step 5: Add the garlic, ginger, garam masala, brown sugar and black pepper.

Ingredient Names: chicken, ghee, ginger, garam masala, pepper, turmeric, saffron, onion, garlic cloves, salt, water, condensed milk, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare your chicken in a heavy pot with lid. Step 2: Add all the ingredients until the salt. Step 3: Turn the chicken until it is coated with the spices, Turn on the heat and fry / roast the chicken pieces until golden During the cooking time turn the chicken delicately several times and prevent to attach to the bottom. Step 4: Add the water and dissolve the fried spices from the bottom of the pot. Step 5: Cover the pot and continue to cook about 15 minutes at low heat 5 minutes before serving add the mild and the almonds. Step 6: Turn the chicken delicately and cook at low heat 5 more minutes. Step 7: Check if you need more salt.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, lemon juice, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, brown sugar, honey, fresh cilantro, green chili pepper, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prick the chicken thighs with a fork Pat dry with paper towels and set aside. Step 2: In a bowl, mix the lemon juice, ginger, garlic, red pepper, salt, sugar, and honey. Step 3: Combine the thighs and spice mixture in a plastic zip bag and marinate in the refrigerator for an hour. Step 4: Set grill to medium. Step 5: Add the cilantro and green chili to the chicken, mix, and transfer to a flameproof dish. Step 6: Pour any remaining marinade over the chicken. Step 7: Grill for about 15-20 minutes, turning and basting the chicken occasionally, until cooked through. Step 8: Serve immediately A garnish of fresh cilantro would be nice.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, curry powder, flour, salt, sugar, ginger, chicken broth, milk, cooked chicken, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in butter with curry powder. Step 2: Blend in flour and other seasonings. Step 3: Cook on low until smooth. Step 4: Stir in broth and milk slowly with whisk to make sure to get all the lumps out, bring to boil. Step 5: Boil for one minute or until thickened while stirring. Step 6: Stir in chicken and lemon juice. Step 7: Serve over rice Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, turmeric, salt, potatoes, ginger, garlic, curry leaves, green chilies, onions, coriander leaves, garam masala powder, pepper, eggs, breadcrumbs, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the cooked chicken Grind the ginger, garlic, curry leaves and chillies till paste form and mix it into the chicken. Step 2: Add the mashed potatoes and mix very well. Step 3: Add the onion, coriander leaves, garam masala, salt and pepper and mix well one more time. Step 4: Take a small ball from the mixture and roll it into a patty. Step 5: Dip in the eggs and then into the bread crumbs. Step 6: Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Step 7: Fry the patties till golden brown. Step 8: Serve hot with tomato ketchup or green chutney.

Dish Name: Mom's Harra Mutton Mutton With Green Masala
Ingredient Names: mutton, onions, garlic, ginger, green chilies, coriander leaves, mint leaf, fenugreek leaves, spinach, low-fat yogurt, oil, garam masala, salt, red chili powder, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil / ghee in a cooker. Step 2: Fry garlic and ginger in the oil / ghee to a golden brown colour. Step 3: Add onions and fry to a golden brown colour. Step 4: Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder, salt and cumin seeds, mix well. Step 5: Add the mutton pieces / mutton chops, fry well. Step 6: Add 3 / 4 cup of water. Step 7: Cook under pressure for 10 minutes In the meantime, to the yogurt, add the coriander leaves, mint leaves, methi leaves, spinach and green chillies.

Dish Name: Mrs Chittaluru's Family Authentic Indian Chicken Curry Recipe
Ingredient Names: ginger, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt & fresh ground pepper, turmeric, whole cloves, whole cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, vegetable oil, cayenne pepper, boneless chicken, onion, tomatoes, butter, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Ginger / garlic paste: in a blender add peeled ginger and peeled garlic in equal parts and a little water and blend into a paste You can also buy this in the indian market, but it is much better when made fresh Meat prep: cut chicken into bite sized pieces. Step 2: In a bowl, mix chicken, salt, pepper, turmeric, cayenne, cumin powder and coriander powder. Step 3: Set aside Cooking: use medium heat! Step 4: Lower heat and longer cooking time gives the best results. Step 5: In a deep wide pan heat oil till it's hot and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon stick Move it it around for several minutes At this point, i remove the clove and cardamom because i hate biting into them later. Step 6: Add onions and saute until they are soft and golden.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, turmeric, yogurt, salt, garlic cloves, ginger paste, ghee, onions, red chili powder, cinnamon, green cardamom pods, black pepper, bay leaves, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yogurt, turmeric, salt, garlic & ginger well in large bowl. Step 2: Add chicken and make sure chicken is well coated. Step 3: Refrigerate 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat ghee or butter in skillet. Step 5: Take chicken out of bowl and discard marinade. Step 6: Add chicken to skillet, cover and cook 20 minutes over med heat. Step 7: Turn and cook until chicken in cooked through, about another 15 minutes. Step 8: Remove chicken to plate. Step 9: Add onions, chile powder, cinnamon, cardamom and black pepper to the skillet you cooked the chicken inches saute on med high heat until onion is browned. Step 10: Add chicken and any juices on plate to the skillet, along with the 1 / 4 celsius yogurt and the water.

Ingredient Names: roasting chicken, unsifted all-purpose flour, onions, carrots, celery, tart apples, butter, curry powder, salt, mace, chili powder, cayenne, grated fesh coconut, bay leaf, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken Dry with paper towels On waxed paper, roll in flour Coat completely Reserve remaining flour. Step 2: Chop onions to make 1-1 / 2 cups Pare carrots. Step 3: Slice diagonally about 1 / 2-inch thick. Step 4: Slice celery 1 / 4-inch thick Pare, core apples.

Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic, turmeric, salt and pepper, onion, chicken, chicken sausage, water, potatoes, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place everything except the potatoes and coriander in the largest pot you have. Step 2: Cover generously with water and cook for 3 / 4 hour. Step 3: Add the potatoes and cook for a further 15-20 minutes, or until done. Step 4: When nearly ready add the coriander. Step 5: Serve over boiled rice, with large helpings of togetherness.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, canola oil, turmeric powder, salt, onions, red capsicums, tomatoes, chaat masala, red chili powder, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Boil chicken breasts with salt and turmeric powder for 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain, cool and shred the chicken. Step 3: Heat oil in a frying pan and saut julienned onion, capsicum and tomatoes for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add shredded chicken. Step 5: Add chaat masala and chili powder, toss well. Step 6: Sprinkle with lemon juice and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, garlic cloves, ginger, fine sea salt, hot chili powder, lemon juice, natural yogurt, garam masala, ground turmeric, ground cumin, vegetable oil, ghee, cardamom pod, cloves, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken in a bowl with the garlic, ginger, salt, chilli powder and lemon juice. Step 2: Mix, cover with cling film and chill for 30 minutes. Step 3: Mix together the yoghurt, garam masala, turmeric and cumin and add to the chicken, making sure that each piece is well coated with the mixture. Step 4: Cover again and chill for 3-4 hours. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 180c / fan 160c / gas 4. Step 6: Put the marinated chicken pieces on a grill rack set on a baking tray and bake for 8-10 minutes. Step 7: Brush the chicken pieces with a little oil and turn them over. Step 8: Bake for another 10-12 minutes until just cooked through For the sauce, heat the ghee or butter in a pan and add the garlic and ginger. Step 9: Fry for a minute or so then add the cardamom, cloves, coriander, garam masala, turmeric, fenugreek and chilli powder.

Dish Name: Murgh Phalhar Salad Chicken Salad With Honey And Mint Dressing
Ingredient Names: chicken, pineapple, red bell pepper, spring onions, olive oil, orange juice, honey, mint leaves, salt, mustard powder, black pepper, heavy cream, olives, oranges
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the oranges and remove the pith and seeds from the segments. Step 2: Blend all the ingredients for the dressing in a food processor or liquidiser. Step 3: Place all the ingredients for the salad in a bowl, add the dressing, mix well. Step 4: Arrange the salad on a flat dish. Step 5: Garnish with the olives and orange segments, serve!

Dish Name: Murgh Pulao Indian Chicken With Basmati Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, basmati rice, cayenne pepper, salt, ginger paste, garlic paste, oil, cumin seed, cloves, green cardamoms, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, onions, tomatoes, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 tsp cayenne, salt, half the ginger paste, half the garlic paste and mix. Step 3: Marinate for fifteen to twenty minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, cloves, green cardamoms, bay leaves and cinnamon Saut till fragrant. Step 5: Add onions and saut until lightly browned. Step 6: Add the remaining ginger paste, garlic paste and cayenne. Step 7: Stir and saut for two minutes. Step 8: Add tomatoes, salt, yogurt and continue to saut for two minutes. Step 9: Add rice, marinated chicken pieces and cilantro and mix well.

Dish Name: Murgh Tikka Pulao Barbecued Chicken Pulao
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, cream, saffron, onion, garlic paste, lime juice, salt, fresh ground black pepper, basmati rice, butter, egg yolks, black pepper, whole black peppercorn, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients with the chicken. Step 2: Set aside for 4 hours. Step 3: Mix the saffron with the cream. Step 4: Thread the chicken pieces onto a skewer. Step 5: Brush the pieces with some of the saffron-cream mixture. Step 6: Wash the rice and soak for 1 hour. Step 7: Cook the rice with salt in 5 cups of boiling water, drain. Step 8: Mix the butter and beaten egg yolk and black pepper powder gently into the rice with a fork. Step 9: Place the rice back on low heat.

Dish Name: Murghi Aur Aloo Chicken And Potato Curry
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken pieces, salt, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, cumin seeds, dried red chilies, black cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon sticks, black peppercorns, white poppy seeds, cashew nuts, cold water, butter, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the salt with the ginger and garlic to make a pulp Grind the cumin seeds, red chillies, cardamom seeds, cloves, cinnamon sticks and peppercorn together to make a powder Grind the poppy seeds and the cashew nuts together. Step 2: Mix all of the ground ingredients with the 4 tbsp of cold water, to make a paste. Step 3: In a heavy pot melt the butter over low heat, And cook the ginger / garlic pulp for 3 mins stirring all the time. Step 4: Add the spice paste and cook for 3 mins, stir. Step 5: Add the chicken and cook till it changes colour 6 minutes. Step 6: Add the coriander leaves, green chillie, and turmeric. Step 7: Stir-fry for 3 miins.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, butter, honey, dijon mustard, curry powder, season salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix up the sauce. Step 2: Grill: marinade chicken at least 2 hours. Step 3: Grill over medium heat, turning and basting every 10 minutes, til done Oven: spray baking pan, put in chicken and cover with sauce. Step 4: Bake at 375, turning and basting chicken every 15 minutes Takes about 30- 45 minutes Stove top: put chicken in pan, cover with sauce. Step 5: Cook, covered, over med-low heat, turning and basting chicken every 15 minutes. Step 6: Remove the lid for the last 15 minutes to thicken up the sauce Takes 30-45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, rice bran oil, whole mustard seeds, onion, garlic paste, ginger paste, chopped tomatoes, fresh cilantro, warm water, garam masala, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix together turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt and black pepper. Step 2: Set-up a clean plate next to the bowl to make an assembly line Pat chicken strips dry, and then rub each strip all over with spice mixture Don't be afraid to get a lot on them, as this will just add to the flavor later Shake off any excess, and continue coating. Step 3: Once all the chicken is coated, heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Set-up another plate near skillet. Step 5: Once hot, add batches of chicken strips in a single layer Brown on all sides, but don't cook all the way through. Step 6: Set cooked strips on a separate plate, and once all are browned, set chicken aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken, mincemeat, potato, onions, garam masala powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, tomatoes, oil, ginger-garlic paste, lemon, salt, hard-boiled egg, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, clean and dry a whole chicken Apply marinade on top and inside the chicken. Step 2: Refrigerate for 5-6 hours. Step 3: Boil the mince and potato in 1 / 2 cup of water, add salt, allow it to cool. Step 4: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 5: Add onions and fry till light brown. Step 6: Add the above mentioned masala for stuffing. Step 7: Add tomatoes and cook until the oil separates.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, yellow onions, garlic, cayenne, ground turmeric, ground cumin, hot water, tomatoes, chicken parts, salt, apple cider vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and saute the onions until they turn dark brown. Step 2: Mix the garlic, cayenne, turmeric, and cumin with 1 tablespoon water to make a thick paste. Step 3: Add the paste to the onions and saute for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the tomates and stir constantly over medium head until the tomatoes start to break up, about 2 minutes Avoid scorching. Step 5: Add the chicken and mix to coat with the spices. Step 6: Stir over medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 7: Add 1 cup water and the salt and bring mixture to a boil. Step 8: Lower heat and simmer, uncovered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes. Step 9: Add the vinegar and sugar, simmer for 1 minute, then taste--adjust sugar, salt, and vinegar as necessary.

Ingredient Names: red chile, finger-length ginger, fat garlic, fresh coriander, sunflower oil, skinless chicken breasts, peanut butter, chicken stock, greek yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Finely slice a quarter of the chilli, then put the rest in a food processor with the ginger, garlic, coriander stalks and one-third of the leaves. Whizz to a rough paste with a splash of water if needed. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan, then quickly brown the chicken chunks for 1 min. Stir in the paste for another min, then add the peanut butter, stock and yogurt. When the sauce is gently bubbling, cook for 10 mins until the chicken is just cooked through and sauce thickened. Stir in most of the remaining coriander, then scatter the rest on top with the chilli, if using. Eat with rice or mashed sweet potato.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, cooking oil, curry powder, all-purpose flour, onion, chicken broth, orange juice, cilantro, toasted almond, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Toss together chicken, flour, curry powder and chili powder until chicken is well coated. Step 2: Heat oil over medium heat in a heavy bottomed pot. Step 3: Cook chicken until browned all over, about 6-7 minutes, remove from pot. Step 4: Stir-fry onions till translucent. Step 5: Add broth and orange juice and bring to boil. Step 6: Return chicken to pot and cook until sauce begins to thicken If needed add a teaspoon of flour if sauce is not thick to your liking. Step 7: Add salt as desired. Step 8: Let simmer for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, garam masala, ground cumin, chili powder, plain yogurt, lime juice, table salt, chicken parts, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in small skillet until shimmering. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger and saute 1 minute or until fragrant. Step 3: Add garam masala, cumin and chili powder. Step 4: Saute another 1 minute or until fragrant Move half the mixture to a bowl and add yogurt and 2 tbsp lime juice In another bowl, combine remaining spice mixture with remaining lime juice and salt Lightly score skin side of chicken pieces with a sharp knife, making 2-3 cuts one inch apart and 1 / 8 inch deep. Step 5: Place chicken in bowl and toss with spices until coated. Step 6: Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Step 7: Place oven rack in upper-middle position and preheat to 325f pour reserved yogurt mixture over chicken parts and toss until evenly but thickly coated.

Ingredient Names: pine nuts, olive oil, red onions, turmeric, skinless boneless chicken thighs, long grain rice, sultanas, chicken stock, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. On the hob, toast the pine nuts in a flameproof casserole dish, remove and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in the casserole and soften the onion with the turmeric for 3 mins. Add the chicken thighs and cook for 3-4 mins until browned all over. Tip in the rice, sultanas and 700ml stock, then bring to the boil. Cover with a lid and bake in the oven for 20 mins, checking halfway and adding more stock if needed. Cook until the chicken is done and the rice tender. Season to taste, then stir in the toasted pine nuts and serve sprinkled with fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, white wine vinegar, tamarind pulp, boiling water, green cardamom pods, cloves, star anise, black peppercorns, plum tomatoes, half-and-half, sesame oil, hot red chili peppers, black cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken and vinegar in a large bowl, cover. Step 2: Refrigerate 30 minutes. Step 3: Place tamarind in a small bowl. Step 4: Cover with boiling water. Step 5: Let stand 20 minutes. Step 6: Combine the green cardamom seeds, cloves, star anise and peppercorns in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder Grind until combined. Step 7: Mix the ground spices into the tamarind gravy, set aside.

Dish Name: Pakistani Punjabi Karachi Style Yakhni Pulao Chicken Stock Pila
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, chicken, water, salt, onion, clove, whole black peppercorn, black cardamom pods, cinnamon sticks, bay leaf, garlic cloves, ginger, coriander seed, ground nutmeg, anise
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients for yakhni. Step 2: Bring them to a boil & let them boil on medium high heat for 20 minutes or till the chicken gets tender. Step 3: Strain the yakhni only leaving the chicken in it, in a pan heat oil. Step 4: Add sliced onions & fry the onions till they turn golden brown. Step 5: Take 1 / 4 out of it & keep aside.
