Step 6: Now add cumin seeds, ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, salt, red chilly powder & coriander powder to the remaining fried onions & stir fry for 3 minutes Next add yogurt, garam masala and green cardamom. Step 7: Cook on medium high heat till the tomatoes get tender. Step 8: Add anise seed & chicken pieces to the masala & let it simmer for another 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, red chili powder, butter, hot sauce, yogurt, garlic powder, onion paste, ginger paste, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: In a large shallow bowl, mix yogurt, chili powder, garam masala, melted butter, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion paste, ginger paste. Step 2: Mix them good, and then marinate the chicken breast with this. Step 3: Put in fridge for one hour to marinate. Step 4: Preheat oven to 335f Lay the breast on foil or oven safe tray and bake for about one hour- two hours or until you think it is done. Step 5: When done, serve hot! Step 6: Add more butter if you like, i prefer more butter.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, all-purpose flour, chicken bouillon cubes, tap water, white onion, cabbage, tomatoes, canola oil, butter, jalapeno pepper, tomato paste, curry powder, mustard seeds, cumin powder, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, dissolve the bouillon cubes in 3 tablespoons of the hot tap water, set aside. Step 2: Cut the chicken into chunks about one-inch in size Wipe the pieces fairly dry with paper towels, roll them in the flour and set them aside on a plate. Step 3: Allow them to sit for at least 10 minutes. Step 4: Blend together the following seasonings in a small bowl: curry powder, mustard seed, cumin powder, white pepper, and seasoned salt, set aside. Step 5: Heat the oil and butter together in a large skillet over medium high heat As soon as the oil is hot, drop in the jalapeno pepper and the chicken pieces. Step 6: Then, sprinkle all the blended seasonings over the chicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken, capsicum, onions, mushrooms, garam masala, salt, turmeric, chili, garlic paste, natural yogurt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients in a large pot, stir well. Step 2: Cook for about 15 minutes until gravy comes out Separate gravy in a different pan. Step 3: Cook chicken and gravy separately for about another 10 minutes until gravy gets a little bit thicker. Step 4: Put gravy back into chicken, add chopped fresh coriander, stir, cook for another 2 or 3 minutes. Step 5: Serve hot with chapati.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, zucchini, red bell pepper, fresh pumpkin, corn kernel, cumin, brown sugar, ground ginger, curry powder, tomato sauce, salt and pepper, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a dutch oven. Step 2: Add the chicken, and saute until no longer pink. Step 3: Add the onion and keep sauteeing until golden. Step 4: Add the zucchini, red pepper, pumpkin and corn. Step 5: Cook over medium heat, stirring, until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the cumin, brown sugar, ginger and curry powder. Step 7: Stir and continue cooking over medium heat. Step 8: Add the tomato sauce and salt and pepper to taste. Step 9: Cook another 7 minutes, making sure that the bottom doesn't burn. Step 10: Serve over rice, top with pinenuts.

Ingredient Names: chicken, fresh pineapple chunk, aubergines, kaffir lime leaves, red curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, instant chicken bouillon granules, dried red chilies, lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime zest, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Combine red curry paste ingredients in a blender and puree with a little water until you get a paste. Step 2: Remove and set aside. Step 3: Simmer thick coconut milk in a saucepan or heavy-based wok over medium low heat for 1-1 minutes Work in 4-5 tablespoons of the red curry paste and continue to fry over low heat for about 5-6 minutes or until fragrant and the oil rises. Step 4: Add the chicken and the thin coconut milk. Step 5: Bring to a low simmering boil until meat is tender and the coconut cream is rather oily. Step 6: Put in pineapple cubes and seasoning. Step 7: Cook for an extra 1-2 minutes. Step 8: Add pea aubergines, kaffir lime leaves and cover the saucepan for 30-40 seconds. Step 9: Check the seasoning before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, pineapple juice, ground cumin, ground coriander, garlic, chili powder, salt, plain yogurt, fresh cilantro, pineapple chunk, red pepper, cherry tomatoes, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: If using wooden kebab skewers, soak in water to prevent burning while grilling Cube chicken. Step 2: Mix all marinade ingredients. Step 3: Add chicken to marinade Refridgerate for at least 2 hours, but the longer the better Skewer the meat If using veggies as well, skewer a mix of veggies and meat on each skewer. Step 4: Grill 10-15 minutes while basting kebabs with remaining marinade.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, skinless chicken quarters, onions, garlic cloves, curry powder, green apple, chicken broth, salt, pepper, flour, yogurt, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil to a very hot pressure cooker pot Brown the cut up chicken pieces nicely on all sides, remove to rest. Step 2: Add the onions and saut till light golden brown. Step 3: Add garlic and saut until onions are dark golden brown. Step 4: Add the curry powder to the pot and stir until fragrant. Step 5: Add the diced apple, water, salt and pepper. Step 6: Return chicken to the pot. Step 7: Stir once again to distribute evenly. Step 8: Place lid on pressure cooker tightly. Step 9: Heat on high until the weight begins to jiggle.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, chili, soya sauce, lime juice, cornflour, tomato puree, tomato sauce, curry leaves, food coloring, egg whites, cumin powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut, wash, drain the chicken well. Step 2: Add all the ingredients except the egg white and marinate for 6-8 hrs Just before cooking, beat the egg white until stiff. Step 3: Add to the marinated stuff Deep fry on slow heat until brown and crispy.

Ingredient Names: tandoori masala powder, ginger paste, garlic paste, coconut yogurt, onions, pepper, skinless chicken thighs, olive oil, fresh coriander, chili powder, passata, coconut cream, rice naan bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a very large bowl, mix half the spice mix, 1 tbsp each of the pastes, three-quarters of the yogurt and some salt. Stir in the onion wedges, peppers and chicken, then leave to marinate overnight in the fridge. Step 2: Fry the chopped onions in the oil until really soft. Add the remaining spice mix and pastes, the coriander stalks and chilli powder. Cook for 1 min, then stir in 100ml water and the passata. Simmer for 15 mins, then add the coconut cream and remaining yogurt. Leave chunky or blitz with a blender. Step 3: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Spread the chicken and veg on a baking tray. Roast for 15-20 mins until cooked and slightly charred. Tip into the sauce. Serve with rice, naan, extra yogurt and coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: onion, basmati rice, chicken, vegetable oil, water, carrots, seedless raisin, salt, cinnamon, cumin powder, ground cardamom, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, brown onion in 2 tbsp oil. Step 2: Add chicken and brown lightly. Step 3: Add 2 cups water, salt, cinnamon, cumin and cardamom. Step 4: Cover and simmer until meat is tender, about one hour. Step 5: Remove chicken and set aside, set juice aside. Step 6: Saute carrots and brown sugar in 4 tbsp oil until lightly browned. Step 7: Remove and set aside. Step 8: Add raisins to oil and cook until they swell up. Step 9: Remove and set aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic, ginger, red chilies, almonds, curry powder, nutmeg, szechwan pepper, green cardamoms, vegetable oil, onions, heavy cream, turmeric, butter, broth, fresh cilantro, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Grind garlic, ginger, fresh red chilies, curry powder, nutmeg, timur, cardamom and almonds with water into a paste. Step 2: In a large bowl, season chicken pieces with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat oil and brown chicken in a sauce pan. Step 4: Reserve browned chicken in a bowl. Step 5: Drain oil and clean the pan, heat butter. Step 6: Add turmeric, chopped onion and sauté till brown. Step 7: Transfer the almond paste to the onion mixture. Step 8: Stir for a few minutes till the oil starts to separate from the mixture. Step 9: Turn down heat to low; add cream, broth, salt and pepper; mix well and cook until a consistent mixture is achieved. Step 10: Transfer browned chicken to the almond sauce. Step 11: Cook on low heat till chicken is tender and the almond sauce has thickened. Step 12: Garnish with chopped cilantro. Step 13: Serve with rice or roti (flat bread).

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts skin, curry powder, basmati rice, chicken stock, cauliflower florets, green beans, lemons, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a frying pan or flameproof casserole, then brown the chicken, skin-side down. Tip in the curry powder and rice, fry for 1 min, then stir in the stock. Step 2: Add the cauliflower, beans, lemon slices and coriander stalks to the pan and turn the chicken skin-side up. Bring to the boil, then simmer with the lid on for 10 mins, until the chicken is cooked through and the rice tender. Sprinkle over the coriander leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, skinless chicken breasts, balti curry paste, quinoa, tomato, chicken stock, salted cashews, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan, fry the onions for 5 mins until golden and softened, then tip onto a plate. Add the chicken breasts, browning for a few mins on each side, then stir in the balti paste, quinoa and onions. Sizzle for a few mins, then pour in the tomatoes and stock and give everything a good mix. Bubble for 25 mins until the quinoa is tender and saucy. Step 2: Stir in the cashews and most of the coriander with some seasoning, then pile into bowls and scatter over the rest of the coriander to serve.

Dish Name: Spiced chicken with rice & crisp red onions
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sunflower oil, curry powder, red onions, basmati rice, cinnamon, saffron, raisins, peas, mint coriander, rounded low-fat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Brush the chicken with 1 tsp oil, then sprinkle with curry powder. Toss the onion in the remaining oil. Put the chicken and onions in one layer in a roasting tin. Bake for 25 mins until the meat is cooked and the onions are crisp, stirring the onions halfway through the cooking time. Step 2: Rinse the rice, then put in a pan with the cinnamon, saffron, salt to taste and 300ml water. Bring to the boil, stir once, add the raisins, cover. Gently cook for 10-12 mins until the rice is tender, adding the peas halfway through. Spoon the rice onto two plates, top with the chicken and scatter over the onions. Stir the herbs into the yogurt and season, if you like, before serving on the side.

Ingredient Names: honey, sugar, lemon juice, dry mustard, curry powder, garlic, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl. Step 2: Pour over chicken for the last 30 minutes of roasting, or if using other cooking method, use like you would bbq sauce, baste often. Step 3: Serve when chicken is cooked through and glaze is golden and bubbly. Step 4: Cook time does not include initial cook time for chicken.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, turmeric, broccoli, tamarind paste, mango chutney, boneless, yogurt, korma paste, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill. Put the potatoes in a pan of cold water, stir in the turmeric, then bring to the boil. Simmer for 12-15 mins until tender. Steam the broccoli in a metal colander or sieve over the potato pan for 4-5 mins until tender. Step 2: Mix together the tamarind paste and mango chutney. Make a few slashes in each chicken breast and place on a baking tray. Brush with the tamarind mixture, then grill for 5 mins on each side or until cooked through and sticky. Step 3: Drain the potatoes. Mash with the yogurt, korma paste and seasoning, then keep warm. To serve, stir most of the spring onions into the mash, then spoon onto plates. Scatter with the remaining spring onions and serve alongside the sticky chicken and broccoli.

Dish Name: Tandoori Chicken Burgers With Creamy Chutney
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, white breadcrumbs, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground ginger, garam masala, yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Place all burger ingredients in a large bowl and combine thoroughly. Step 2: Divide and shape into 6 patties. Step 3: Refrigerate while you make creamy chutney. Step 4: Combine 1/3 cup mango chutney and 2 T yoghurt together, refrigerate until required. Step 5: Heat frypan or grill and brush lightly with oil. Step 6: Cook patties over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes each side or until cooked through, turning only once. Step 7: Serve with Creamy Chutney either alone or with your favourite burger bun.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onions, lemons, thumb-sized ginger, coconut milk, fresh coriander, yogurt, tomato puree, chili powder, garlic whizzed to paste ginger, finger-length ginger whizzed to paste garlic, red food colouring
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients with 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper. Slash the legs of the chicken a few times, then rub the marinade all over, including under the skin of the breast. Marinate in the fridge for up to 24 hrs. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the onions, lemon halves and ginger in a roasting tin. Sit the chicken on top and roast for 1½ hrs or until the thigh juices run clear when tested with a skewer. Step 3: When the chicken is done, lift out of the tin, sit in a new dish, cover loosely with foil and leave to rest. Fish out the ginger from the tin and discard. Scrape out the roasted middles from the lemons into a food processor, add the onions and any pan juices, and whizz to a purée. Scrape the purée back into the tin and sit on the hob. Stir in the coconut milk and bubble gently, scraping up any chicken bits that have stuck. You can add a splash of water if the sauce is too thick. Stir in the coriander and serve with the chicken.

Dish Name: Tangy Apple Curry Chicken and Veggie Stew
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, ginger, curry powder, salt, pepper, ground cinnamon, chicken thighs, fresh lemon rind, lemon juice, flour, milk, chicken broth, fresh carrots, tart apples
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saute for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, salt, pepper and a pinch of cinnamon; cook, stirring for 2 minutes, or until onion is softened. Step 3: Add the chicken thighs; brown for 5 minutes on each side, adding more oil if necessary to prevent burning, leave in the pot. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium; stir in lemon rind and lemon juice or white wine (if using). Step 5: Cook, stirring and scraping up any brown bits. Step 6: In a bowl, whisk flour into milk or half and half cream. Step 7: Gradually stir in the milk/flour mixture with the chicken stock into the pot. Step 8: Add in the chopped carrots. Step 9: Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Step 10: Reduce heat to med-low; cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the chicken is no longer pink, and carrots are tender. Step 11: Stir in apples; cook, uncovered, for 5-7 minutes or until heated through, and stew is thickened.

Dish Name: The Ultimate Makeover: Chicken tikka masala
Ingredient Names: ginger, plump garlic, yogurt, lime juice, fresh cilantro, chili powder garam masala paprika, turmeric, cumin coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, skinless, rapeseed oil, onions, paprika, chili powder, tomato puree, basmati rice, peas, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade, finely grate the ginger and garlic (you should have 1 rounded tbsp of each), then mix them together. Put half of this mix into a medium bowl, then stir in the yogurt, lime juice, chopped coriander, chilli, garam masala, paprika and turmeric. Heat a small heavy-based dry pan, tip in the cumin, coriander and fenugreek seeds, then heat briefly until toasted and smelling fragrant (they will start to jump in the pan). Remove and grind to a powder using a pestle and mortar. Stir half into the yogurt mix (save the rest for the sauce). Stir the chicken chunks into the spiced yogurt until well coated. Cover and leave to marinate for at least 30 mins, or overnight if you like. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the sauce. Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the onions, then fry over a medium heat for about 10 mins, stirring occasionally, until softened and turning brown. Stir in the remaining ginger and garlic, and stir-fry for 2 mins. Mix in the paprika, turmeric, garam masala, chilli and the rest of the toasted cumin, coriander and fenugreek. Cook for 1 min, stirring to scrape up the bits from the bottom of the pan. Stir in the tomato purée, then 150ml water. Cook for 1 min. Carefully transfer to a food processor or blender. Process to a thick, fairly smooth sauce. Return to the pan, pour in another 150ml water, then set aside. Can be made a day ahead. Soak the rice in cold water for up to 30 mins. Step 3: Heat the grill to high. Thread the chicken onto 8 wooden skewers (soaked first), then balance them across a baking tray lined with foil, so they are slightly raised over it. Grill for 12-15 mins until cooked and slightly charred around the edges. Meanwhile, drain the rice, then tip into a pan with 375ml water. Bring to a boil, then cook over a low heat, covered, for 8 mins. Remove from the heat but leave covered for 5 mins. Cook the peas in boiling water for 3 mins, drain. Fluff up the rice with a fork, then toss in the peas. Step 4: When ready to serve, reheat the sauce, stirring in any juices from the chicken and a drop more water to thin if necessary (it should be quite thick). Remove from the heat, stir in the yogurt, then season with a pinch of salt. Serve the chicken skewers with the rice, a scattering of coriander and lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, ginger, cardamom pods, cinnamon, boneless, ground coriander, garam masala, ground mace, ground black pepper, yogurt not fridge, full-fat milk, green chilies, cilantro stems, almonds, basmati rice saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a deep sauté pan or wok. Tip in the onions, then fry over a medium-high heat for about 12-15 mins, stirring occasionally, until a rich golden colour and the pan is sticky on the bottom. While they cook, chop the garlic and ginger. Make a slit down the length of each cardamom pod just deep enough to reveal the tiny seeds. Remove the onions from the heat. Transfer a third of them to a small blender along with the garlic, ginger and 2 tbsp water. Whizz together to make a paste that is as smooth as you can get it. Set aside. Step 2: Return the onions in the pan to the heat, add the remaining oil, cardamom pods and cinnamon stick, then stir-fry for a couple of mins. Stir in the chicken, ground coriander, 1¼ tsp of the garam masala, mace and black pepper, then stir-fry for another 2 mins. Reserve 3 tbsp of the yogurt, then slowly start to add the rest, 1 tbsp at a time, stirring between each spoonful. When all the yogurt has gone in, stir in the oniony paste and stir-fry for 2-3 mins. Stir in 150ml water, then the milk. Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, for 20 mins, scattering in the chillies for the final 5 mins, by which time the chicken should be very tender. Remove the cardamom pods and cinnamon. The flavours mellow all the more if refrigerated overnight. When gently reheating, splash in a little water if needed to slacken the korma sauce. Step 3: Finish by stirring in the chopped coriander. Taste and add a little salt if you wish. Swirl in the reserved yogurt. Spoon the korma into bowls, scatter a few almonds over each portion with a sprinkling of the remaining garam masala. Serve the saffron rice on the side.

Ingredient Names: turkey ground meat, rounded korma paste, groundnut, onions, chicken stock, reduced-fat, sugar snap peas diagonal, cherry tomatoes, almonds, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Make the meatballs: mix the mince with 1 tsp curry paste and seasoning. Shape into walnut-size meatballs. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan. Fry the meatballs for 5 mins, turning until they are browned all over. Step 2: Heat the remaining curry paste in a saucepan. Add the onion and fry over a low heat for about 5 mins, until soft – be careful not to burn the paste (add a splash of water if you need to). Step 3: Pour in the stock and coconut milk, and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down to low and add the meatballs. Cook for 10 mins, or until the turkey is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly. Add the sugar snaps and tomatoes, and cook for another 2 mins. Scatter with the almonds and coriander, if you have any, and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, ground almonds, thumb-size ginger, garlic, fresh cream, vegetable oil, onions, cardamom pods, cinnamon, garam masala, skinless, full-fat yogurt, fresh coriander, naan bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Whizz the chillies, almonds, ginger, garlic, cream and 300ml water to a paste. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large, deep ovenproof casserole and add the onion, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon and 2 tsp garam masala. Fry, stirring for 1 min, then add the paste. Bring to a simmer and season with salt. Add the chicken, turning each thigh to coat it, then bring back to a simmer. Blob the yogurt over the top. Step 3: Bake in the oven for 40 mins or until the chicken is cooked through (spoon any excess fat from the surface). Sprinkle with the remaining garam masala and the coriander. Serve with naan or rice.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, fresh coconut, cashew powder, sugar, ghee, milk, saffron food colour, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai take 1 cup besan, 1 cup coconut, 1 cup cashew powder, 2 cup sugar, 1 cup ghee and 1 cup milk. Step 2: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Now turn on the flame and start cooking on medium flame. Step 4: Stir until the mixture starts to thicken. Step 5: Now add a pinch saffron food colour and mix well. Step 6: Cook until the mixture starts to separate the pan and holds shape. Step 7: Add ½ tsp cardamom powder and mix until the mixture starts to turn frothy. Step 8: Transfer to the tray and level up uniformly. Step 9: Rest for 30 minutes and cut into pieces. Step 10: Finally, enjoy 7 Cup Burfi stored in an airtight container for a month.

Ingredient Names: cake flour, powdered sugar, baking powder, table salt, eggs, water, vegetable oil, cardamom pod, cooking spray, all-purpose flour, heavy whipping cream, rose water, pink food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Method for cake: Preheat oven to 325f Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and 7 tablespoons of powdered sugar, set aside. Step 2: Using the paddle attachment, start beating the egg yolks in a bowl While beating the eggs, very slowly add water, combine well. Step 3: Now slowly add the oil to create an emulsion. Step 4: Add the sifted flour mixture in several batches to form a smooth batter. Step 5: Add the cardamom seeds.

Ingredient Names: atta wheat flour, gram flour, ghee, rava semolina, saffron food colour, powdered sugar, cardamom powder, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai take 1½ cup atta and 1½ cup besan. Step 2: Dry roast for 5 minutes or until the flour turns aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 cup ghee and start roasting. Step 4: Also, add 3 tbsp rava, pinch saffron food colour and roast on low flame. Step 5: Roast until the flour turns golden brown and ghee releases. Step 6: Cool the flour slightly by mixing continuously. Step 7: Once the mixture is slightly warm, add 1½ cup powdered sugar, ½ tsp cardamom powder and 2 tbsp nuts. Step 8: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 9: Further, transfer the mixture to the tray and level uniformly. Step 10: Top with nuts and allow to set. Step 11: Once the burfi has been set fully, cut to the required shape. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Aate Ki Barfi Recipe for a month when stored in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: ghee, almonds, cashews, dry dates chuara, dry coconut, gram flour, wheat flour, gond edible gum, raisins, sesame, poppy seeds, ginger powder, cardamom powder, jaggery powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a heavy-bottomed pan heat 2 tbsp ghee and fry ¾ cup badam, ¾ cup cashew, and ½ cup dry dates. Step 2: Roast on low flame separately and keep aside. Step 3: Also, add ½ cup roasted dry coconut and mix well. Step 4: Cool completely, and powder in a mixer jar. keep aside. Step 5: In a pan heat ¼ cup ghee and roast ¼ cup besan until it turns golden brown. Step 6: Also, add 1½ cup wheat flour and roast on low flame. Step 7: Add ¼ cup ghee and continue to roast until the atta turns aromatic and golden brown. Step 8: Further, add 2 tbsp ghee and 3 tbsp gond. Step 9: Fry until the gond puffs up. make sure to fry until the gonds turn crystals. Step 10: Also, add 2 tbsp raisins and fry well. Step 11: Transfer the mixture to the large kadai. Step 12: Also add 2 tbsp sesame, 2 tbsp poppy seeds, ½ tsp ginger powder, ½ tsp cardamom powder, and prepared dry fruit powder. Step 13: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 14: Once the mixture is slightly warm, add 1 cup of jaggery powder and mix well. Step 15: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 16: Now prepare ladoo or shape of your choice. Step 17: Finally, enjoy Atta Pinni Recipe for 2 to 3 months when stored in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: milk, long grain rice, ground cardamom, sugar, almonds, rose water, ground nutmeg, strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy 3 quart saucepan, combine the milk or light cream, rice, and cardamom, bring to boiling, reduce heat. Step 2: Cook, uncovered over low heat, stirring occasionally about 1 hour or until the milk mixture is reduced to about 2 cups, remove from heat. Step 3: Stir in the sugar and chopped almonds or pistachio nuts, continue stirring till the sugar has dissolved. Step 4: Cool for 30 minutes, stir pudding. Step 5: Stir in the rose water, if desired. Step 6: Spoon the mixture into 4 to 6 sherbet or dessert dishes.

Ingredient Names: anjeer fig, dates, ghee, cashews, almonds, walnuts, pistachios, dried figs, raisins, apricots, sunflower seeds, poppy seeds, dry coconut, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a mixer jar take 250 grams anjeer and 250 grams of dates. Step 2: Pulse and grind to smooth paste. You can also grind by adding a few pieces to avoid the mixer jar getting from jameed. keep aside. Step 3: Now heat 2 tbsp ghee and transfer the anjeer and dates paste. Step 4: Continue to cook on medium flame, making sure the paste is well combined. Step 5: Cook until the anjeer and dates paste turn shiny. Step 6: In a large heat 2 tbsp ghee, add ½ cup cashew, ½ cup almonds, ½ cup walnuts, 2 tbsp pistachios, 2 tbsp anjeer, 2 tbsp raisins, 4 apricot, and 2 tbsp sunflower seeds. Step 7: Roast on low flame until the nuts turn crunchy. Step 8: Also, add 1 tbsp poppy seeds and 2 tbsp dry coconut. Step 9: Continue to roast making sure the coconut turns aromatic. Step 10: Add in roasted nuts and ½ tsp cardamom powder. mix well. Step 11: Mix until the nuts are well combined with the dates anjeer mixture. Step 12: Combine until everything is well combined and starts to hold shape. Step 13: Roll over poppy seeds, pistachios and shape them into a cylindrical log. Step 14: Wrap in baking paper and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 15: Finally, cut into thick slices and enjoy Anjeer Roll Recipe for a month.

Ingredient Names: water, bulgar wheat, skim milk, honey, apricot, ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, vanilla extract, almond extract, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan. Step 2: Stir in bulgar, cover and cook over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. Step 3: Add milk, honey, apricots, cinnamon, and cardamom Increase heat to medium and stirring occasionally bring mixture to a boil. Step 4: Then reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring frequently for 20 minutes or until mixture is thick. Step 5: Stir constantly near the end of cooking time to keep mixture from sticking. Step 6: Remove saucepan from heat and stir in vanilla and almond extracts. Step 7: Spoon pudding into a 1 quart shallow serving bowl and smooth the top. Step 8: Sprinkle with chopped nuts This dessert can be served hot, warm or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: honeydew melon, watermelon, guavas, nectarines, strawberries, coconut, yogurt, sugar, water, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, clove, orange, lime
Instructions: Step 1: To make the syrup put sugar, water and spices in a pan bring to boil stir to dissolve sugar. Step 2: Simmer 2 minutes, remove from heat then add juices leave to cook while preparing the fruit Peel and remove seeds form melons and put into neat slices. Step 3: Cut guava in half and remove seeds then slice. Step 4: Slice nectarine and strawberries. Step 5: Arrange on plate and strain the syrup and spoon over fruit. Step 6: Sprinkle with coconut and serve with strained yogurt if desired.

Ingredient Names: milk, water, yellow cornmeal, butter, molasses, flour, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, salt, egg, vanilla ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f grease an 8" 8" baking dish, set aside. Step 2: Put 2 cups of the milk and 2 cups hot water into a medium pot and bring just to a boil Slowly pour in cornmeal while whisking constantly. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and cook, whisking constantly, until very thick, 12-14 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and whisk in remaining butter. Step 5: Set cornmeal mixture aside. Step 6: Whisk together molasses, flour, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and egg in a large bowl. Step 7: Pour molasses mixture into cornmeal mixture while whisking constantly. Step 8: Transfer batter to prepared baking dish.

Ingredient Names: bananas, fresh orange juice, coconut, cornflour, brown sugar, butter, white sugar, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Peel bananas and cut them in half lengthwise and crosswise. Step 2: Arrange in a shallow buttered baking dish. Step 3: Combine the cornflour, white sugar and orange juice. Step 4: Pour this over the bananas and make sure they are well coated Dot with butter. Step 5: Sprinkle with brown sugar and coconut. Step 6: Bake at 375f for 30 minutes or until the sauce is slightly thick and the bananas are tender. Step 7: Serve top with whipped cream or ice-cream, if desired or enjoy this treat all by itself!

Ingredient Names: potatoes, greek yogurt, garam masala cumin powder, garlic ginger paste, turmeric, red chili powder, lemon juice, vegetable oil, ricotta, green onions, green chilies, fresh coriander, cumin powder, ground black pepper, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Slice the rounded ends off the potatoes, then use an apple peeler and small knife to hollow out the potato, leaving a 1-2cm edge all the way around. Step 2: Mix together the ingredients for the paste and the ingredients for the filling, seasoning both mixtures – I tend to over-season both mixtures as the potato will absorb some of the salt. Step 3: Fill the potatoes with the ricotta mixture, then coat in the paste. Sit the potatoes in an ovenproof dish, spoon any remaining paste on top, then cook for 50 mins-1 hr until the potato is soft when pierced with the tip of a knife. Serve thickly sliced with a salad of tomato, onion and coriander.

Dish Name: Baklava An Indian Milk Sweet In Sugar Syrup
Ingredient Names: milk, semolina, butter, sugar, water, orange rind, vermicelli, mixed nuts, vanilla essence
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a pan on medium flame, add butter. Step 2: Once it melts, add vermicelli to it. Step 3: Stir-fry it until it turns golden brown. Step 4: Remove from heat In an oven proof tray, spread half of the fried vermicelli In another pan, add the milk, essence and semolina. Step 5: Mix it until the mixture is like a thick syrup. Step 6: Add the chopped nuts. Step 7: Cool it for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: bananas, fresh lemon juice, desiccated coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and cut the bananas into 2 cm pieces Dip banana in freshly squeezed lemon juice Roll them in dessicated coconut.

Ingredient Names: bananas, walnuts, butter, sugar, eggs, refined flour, baking powder, baking soda, instant coffee powder, vanilla essence, cinnamon, fresh lemon juice, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs, one at a time, in a large bowl, until light and fluffy. Step 2: Add sugar and butter Cream well, keep aside. Step 3: In a separate bowl, sieve the flour, baking soda and baking powder together. Step 4: Keep aside In another bowl, mix together the walnuts, coffee powder, vanilla essence and cinnamon. Step 5: Keep aside In another bowl, mash the bananas and add lemon juice to them. Step 6: Add the chopped nuts.

Ingredient Names: khova mava, milk, kesar milk, sugar, cardamom powder, almonds badam
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, crumble 100 grams khova and keep it aside. If you are not having access to mawa then you can use ½ cup milk powder. Step 2: In a large kadai, take 1½ litre milk and get to a boil by stirring in between. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp kesar milk and mix well. Step 4: Boil for 5 minutes, or until the milk thickens slightly. Step 5: Once the milk reduces, add crumbled khova and mix well. Step 6: Continue to boil for 5 minutes or until the milk thickens. Step 7: Further, add ¼ cup sugar and get to a boil. Make sure the sugar is dissolved and cooked well. Step 8: Now add ½ tsp cardamom powder, 2 tbsp almonds & badam. Mix well. Step 9: Cool the milk slightly before serving. The basundi will thicken once cooled. Step 10: Finally, enjoy Basundi Recipe chilled or warm up for a week when refrigerated.

Ingredient Names: ghee, besan flour, rava semolina, water, powdered sugar, cardamom powder, pumpkin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a kadai pan heat ¾ cup ghee and add 2 cup besan. Step 2: Cook until the besan absorbs all the ghee. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp rava and continue to roast till the besan turns aromatic. Step 4: Keep roasting on low flame till the ghee releases from the sides and turns golden brown. Step 5: Sprinkle 2 tbsp water and mix well. This helps the besan and rava to turn ga rainy texture. Step 6: Cook till the mixture turns aromatic. Step 7: Transfer to the plate and cool completely. Step 8: Once the besan mixture is cooled, add 1 cup powdered sugar, ½ tsp cardamom powder and mix well. Step 9: Also, add 2 tbsp of roasted pumpkin seeds and mix well. Step 10: Shape the ladoo and garnish it with pistachios. Step 11: Finally, enjoy Besan Ladoo Recipe tastes great for a week.

Dish Name: Bittersweet Chocolate Mousse For Your Valentine
Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, salt, bittersweet chocolate, unsweetened cocoa powder, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a double boiler, whisk together the yolks, sugar and salt until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is warm This takes 3 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat and quickly whisk in the chocolate and the unsweetened cocoa powder. Step 3: Whisk until the chocolate melts completely and you have a yummy thick mixture before you. Step 4: Allow it to cool to room temperature. Step 5: In a medium bowl over lots of ice, whip chilled cream until soft peaks form. Step 6: Whisk half of this mixture into the chocolate mixture. Step 7: Then use a rubber spatula and gently fold in the remaining cream. Step 8: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for atleast 2 hours and upto 24 hours. Step 9: Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: cream, condensed milk, gelatin, hot water, water, bananas, strawberries, strawberry
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 1 cup of water. Step 2: Pour the gelatin powder in it. Step 3: Stir continuously in order to avoid lumps. Step 4: Cool And 1 cup cold water. Step 5: Set aside to form in the refrigerator In the meantime, chop bananas and strawberries. Step 6: Once the jelly has formed, add the cream and condensed milk. Step 7: Whisk extremely well. Step 8: Add the chopped fruits.

Ingredient Names: waxy potato such as charlotte, butter, onions, cumin seeds, black mustard seeds, ginger, red chilies, korma paste, spinach, tomatoes, fresh coriander, filo pastry
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. To make the filling, heat a pan of salted water. When boiling, add potatoes and boil for 15 mins until tender. Melt the butter then fry the onions for a few mins. Add cumin, mustard seeds, ginger and chillies and fry, stirring occasionally, for about 7 mins until soft. Stir in curry paste. Step 2: Cook the spinach in the microwave on High for 5 mins. Drain and squeeze out as much liquid as you can, then chop it. Drain the potatoes and tip them into the spice mixture. Crush lightly to break them up into chunks rather than mash. Toss in the spice mixture with plenty of salt to coat them, then add the spinach, tomatoes and coriander. Step 3: Carefully unroll the pastry and brush 2 x 20cm loose-bottomed sandwich tins with some butter. Brush the first sheet of pastry and lay it in and across the tin so that it hangs over the side. Do the same with another sheet of pastry to cover the other side of the tin (so the two form a cross), butter and fold the final sheet in half and lay it in the base of the tin to create a firm base. Do the same with the other tin and remaining pastry. Step 4: Spoon the filling into the tin and fold up the pastry that is overhanging so that it covers the filling. Brush generously with the remaining butter and sprinkle with seeds. Bake for 35 mins until golden and crisp. Serve with a salad and mango chutney, or a raita made by mixing plain yogurt with mint sauce or jelly, if you like.

Ingredient Names: cantaloupe, milk, sugar, ice, cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: Fill one cup measure with cantaloupe. Step 2: Pour milk over cantaloupe until cup is filled to the top. Step 3: Pour milk and cantaloupe into blender. Step 4: Add ice, sugar and cardamom. Step 5: Blend until smooth and creamy. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Caramelized Cardamom Apples With Pistachio Cream
Ingredient Names: heavy whipping cream, pistachios, unsalted butter, tart apples, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, sugar, blanched slivered almonds, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Whip the cream lightly in a bowl till it just holds its shape, but is not stiff at all. Step 2: Fold half of the pistachio nuts into the cream, cover and refrigerate. Step 3: Melt the butter over low heat in a large nonstick skillet. Step 4: Take the pan off the heat Peel, core and slice the apples thinly, dropping the slices into the butter as you cut them. Step 5: Fold them into the butter as you go so that they do not discolor. Step 6: Add the cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, sugar, almonds and walnuts. Step 7: Cook on medium heat for 2-3 minutes, stirring gently as you do so. Step 8: Turn the heat to high. Step 9: Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring very gently now and then, till apples have caramelized lightly.

Dish Name: Cardamom And Rose Water Panna Cotta With Candied Rose Petals
Ingredient Names: cream, homogenized milk, sugar, gelatin, rose water, cardamom powder, frozen blueberries, frozen raspberries, caster sugar, apricot jam, fresh rose petals, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Heat milk and cream. Step 2: Add in the sugar and gelatin allow to melt. Step 3: Add rosewater and stir. Step 4: Allow to cool and pt into moulds and refrigerate. Step 5: Melt jam on a double boiler add berries and sugar and allow to cool As berries have been frozen they will break down and make a beautiful sauce Berries don't need to cook. Step 6: Brush every rose petal with the egg white and sprinkle sugar. Step 7: Allow to sit in a dry place and will become stiff Do not over beat the egg whites as they will become watery.

Dish Name: Carrot Cake Parfait With Custard And Strawberries
Ingredient Names: sugar, brown sugar, sunflower oil, eggs, all purpose flour, whole wheat flour, cinnamon powder, baking soda, vanilla extract, salt, carrots, raisins, walnuts, almond, milk, custard powder, strawberries, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Carrot Cake Parfait With Custard And Strawberries recipe, firstly we will make the carrot cake. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit or 180 degrees Centigrade. Step 3: Grease and flour a 13 x pan and keep aside. In a bowl, beat sugars, oil and eggs with a beater until well blended. Step 4: Stir in flours, cinnamon, baking powder, salt and blend again on low speed for a minute. Fold in carrots and raisins (you can add nuts at this stage as well). Step 5: Pour into prepared pan, level the batter and bake in preheated oven for 40 to until toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean. Remove from oven and remove from pan after. Step 6: Cool completely on wire rack. The next step is to make the custard. Step 7: In a small bowl, place milk and stir in custard powder. Step 8: Mix well until smooth; ensure there are no lumps. Step 9: Keep aside. Heat the remaining milk in a saucepan on medium heat and bring to a boil. Step 10: Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Tip in the custard milk mixture into the hot mixture and keep stirring until it comes to a boil and the mixture thickens. Step 11: Simmer for a minute, remove from heat and let cool. Keep stirring while it is cooling or it will form a thick film on top. Step 12: Let cool completely. Next, we will make the strawberry compote. Step 13: Wash and chop strawberries into. Sprinkle sugar and heat in a saucepan on medium heat, stirring often for about a minute until slightly cooked and mushy. Step 14: Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice and let cool. Step 15: Keep aside. Now we will assemble the carrot cake trifle. Step 16: Break up carrot cake into chunks that fit into the dessert bowl or glass you will be serving the parfait in. Assemble all the elements of the parfait; carrot cake chunks, cooled custard, strawberry compote, nuts and cinnamon powder. In each dessert glass, layer a few carrot cake chunks at the bottom. Step 17: Pour a few teaspoons of strawberry compote over it to cover the cake. Gently spoon custard over the compote and spread evenly. Step 18: Repeat the layers to fill the dessert glass finishing with custard on top. Sprinkle chopped walnuts and cinnamon powder on top. Step 19: Cover each parfait glass with cling wrap and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or until serving time. Step 20: Just before serving, garnish with strawberry and serve. Serve Carrot Cake Parfait With Custard And Strawberries as a dessert after your Italian meal of Penne Pasta With Roasted Vegetables and Margherita Pizza for a weekend meal.

Ingredient Names: carrot, whole milk, condensed milk, sugar, raisins, ground cardamom, ground cloves, vanilla sugar, ghee, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Place the carrots and both milk in a pan and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring often, until liquid disappears, about 25 minutes As the halva cooks down you must stir more and more frequently to prevent it from burning. Step 3: Add sugar, raisins, cardamom, cloves and the ghee Continue to cook, stirring frequently, and scraping the bottom of the pan to prevent the mixture from sticking. Step 4: Cook until the halva is very thick and forms a ball in the center of the pan as it is stirred, about 20-25 minutes. Step 5: Turn the halva mixture out onto a greased 9-inch square baking dish, smoothing out the paste to an even thickness. Step 6: Arrange the almonds on top, pressing them into the halva slightly Score the top of the halva into rectangles, then cover and chill until firm. Step 7: Cut completely the halva into triangles to serve.

Dish Name: Charishma's Magical Kahlua Vanilla Creme Coffee
Ingredient Names: water, whole milk, sugar, regular grind coffee, semi-sweet chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water for 1 minute in a microwave-proof and microwave-safe cup. Step 2: Add milk and heat for another minute. Step 3: Stir in sugar and heat for another minute. Step 4: Add ground coffee, mix well and heat for another minute. Step 5: Strain into a clean cup. Step 6: Stir in chocolate chips, if desired, mix well and drink away! Step 7: I enjoyed this with hershey's ready-made pie crust Necessity is the mother of invention, as they say!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: water, milk, sugar, chai tea mix
Instructions: Step 1: Pour milk and water in a microwave-safe and microwave-proof cup. Step 2: Heat in the microwave for 1 minute. Step 3: Add sugar and heat again for 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in the chai latta mix, heat for 1 minute. Step 5: Remove from microwave and strain into another clean cup. Step 6: Add a straw into the cup and sip sip sip!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: naan bread, cheddar, red chile, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Sprinkle the breads with a little water, then top with grated cheddar and chilli. Bake on the oven racks for 5 mins until the cheese has melted, then remove and scatter with the coriander. Step 2: Cut into quarters and serve.

Dish Name: Cheese Pudding With Raisins And Almonds
Ingredient Names: cottage cheese, cornstarch, sugar, orange juice, ground cardamom, vanilla extract, almond extract, raisins, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees Lightly oil a 1 quart baking dish or spray with a nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: In a blender container, combine all ingedients, except raisins and almonds. Step 3: Blend until smooth. Step 4: Stir in raisins and almonds. Step 5: Pour into a prepared baking dish. Step 6: Bake uncovered, 1 hour or until pudding is set and edges are lightly browned. Step 7: Let cool 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, cardamom pods, golden caster sugar, bittersweet chocolate, blanched almonds, unsalted shelled pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Heat milk and cardamom pods together in a large, heavy saucepan. Step 2: Bring to boil, then simmer vigorously until liquid is reduced to 1 / 3 of original amount. Step 3: Strain the liquid into a heat-proof bowl, discarding the cardamom, then stir in the sugar and chocolate until melted. Step 4: Add the almonds and half of the pistachios, then leave to cool. Step 5: Pour mixture into a large freezer-proof container, cover and freeze for at least 2 hours, stirring every 30mins Pack the kulfi into 6 yogurt pots or any freezer-proof molds / cups, cover with clingfilm and freeze for 8 hours, or until completely solid To serve, dip the base of the molds briefly into hot water, then unmold kulfi onto dessert plates. Step 6: Sprinkle with remaining pistachios and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: double cream, custard, sugar, vanilla essence, pecans
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce 1 tbsp custard powder 2 tbsp brown sugar 25 gms butter keep aside 3 tbsp of the cream for the sauce Whip the rest of the cream until stiff. Step 2: Fold in custard and vanilla essence. Step 3: Transfer to a shallow, freezer-proof container and freeze for an hour. Step 4: Whisk and re-freeze again In the meantime, prepare the pecan-toffee chunks. Step 5: Grease and set aside a baking sheet. Step 6: Heat sugar in a heavy pan without any water until it begins to caramelise, add pecans. Step 7: Stir until sugar has completely caramelised and coated the nuts.

Ingredient Names: brown onion, carrots, sweet potato, vegetable stock, coconut milk, ground cumin, ground turmeric, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, salt and pepper, coconut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and spices in coconut oil until softened. Step 2: Add all remaining ingredients and gently simmer until all vegetables are soft. Step 3: Blend the soup in batches in a blender, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: cashew nuts, jaggery, unsweetened dried shredded coconut, milk, ghee, cardamom, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pan, toast the cashews in a tsp of the ghee, set aside. Step 2: In a medium saucepan cook jaggery and coconut until blended being watchful that the coconut does not burn. Step 3: Add milk and stir 'til well blended. Step 4: Add the rest of the ghee, cardamom, salt, and nuts. Step 5: Cook stirring frequently 'til mixture is slightly pliable and begins to pull away from the sides of the pan. Step 6: Spread in a greased pan and refrigerate 'til firm or overnight. Step 7: Remove from pan On a cutting board, cut into diamonds or rectangles. Step 8: Wrap in waxed paper if desired.

Ingredient Names: oil, bay leaf, cumin, black cardamom, cinnamon, cardamoms, javetri, garlic, chili, onions, ginger paste, capscium, sweet corn, garam masala, salt, water, basmati rice, lemon juice, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil. add 2 bay leaf, 1 tsp cumin, 1 black cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon, 3 cardamom, 1 javetri, 7 cloves, and saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 2: Add 5 cloves garlic, 4 chilli and saute slightly. Step 3: Also add 1 onion, 1 tsp ginger paste and saute until the onion shrinks slightly. Step 4: Further add ½ capsicum, 1½ cup sweet corn, ½ tsp garam masala, and 1 tsp salt. Step 5: Saute for a minute or until the corn turns aromatic. Step 6: Pour in 2 cup water and get to a boil. Step 7: Once the water comes to a boil, add 1 cup basmati rice, and 2 tsp lemon juice and mix well. Step 8: Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked well. Step 9: Finally, garnish with 2 tbsp coriander, and Corn Pulao Recipe is ready to enjoy.

Ingredient Names: ghee, cashews, raisins, vermicelli, water, milk, sugar, cardamom pods
Instructions: Step 1: Put 3 tbsp ghee in a pan A non stick saucepan is best. Step 2: Add 10 cashews and fry till light brown. Step 3: Add the raisins and fry till swollen. Step 4: Add the vermicelli and fry for 5 min, stirring constantly until the strands are all light brown and a few are dark brown. Step 5: Pour in the water and cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Step 6: Let the vermicelli cook. Step 7: Add the milk and simmer without stirring until the liquid thickens, about 30 minute. Step 8: Add the sugar, mix well. Step 9: Sprinkle powdered cardamom pods and remove from heat.

Dish Name: Curried Cauliflower Over Fragrant East Indian Basmati Rice
Ingredient Names: coconut oil, white onion, chopped tomatoes, fresh jalapeno pepper, ginger-garlic paste, cashew pieces, curry powder, garam masala, chili paste, chili powder, sea salt, sugar, cauliflower, cilantro, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the fragrant east indian basmati rice recipe here, while following the preparation instructions on recipe #408115: 2 cups water, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon coconut oil or ghee or olive oil, 1-2 pinch ground cardamom, 1-2 pinch ground cinnamon, 1-2 pinch ground coriander, 1-2 pinch ground cumin, 1 cup basmati rice). Step 2: Keep prepared rice warmed on low heat Slowly heat 2 tablespoons coconut oil or light olive oil in a 3 quart saucepan over medium-low heat. Step 3: Chop one medium onion, two medium tomatoes, and one seeded fresh jalapeno pepper. Step 4: Add to heated saucepan and stir as needed. Step 5: Meanwhile, trim the cauliflower florets into 1-inch pieces and add to saute mixture. Step 6: Stir in 1 / 3 cup cashew pieces, 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro, 2 tablespoons ginger garlic paste, 2 teaspoons curry powder, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons garam masala, 1 teaspoon chili paste, 1 teaspoon unseasoned chili powder, 1 1 / 4 teaspoons sea salt, and 1 teaspoon sugar. Step 7: Cover saucepan and cook mixture over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender yet firm. Step 8: Sprinkle 3 tablespoons flour evenly over saute mixture. Step 9: Stir until well blended.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, butter, shallot, brown sugar, salt, curry powder, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, ground red pepper, half-and-half, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place potato in a medium saucepan, cover with water, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes or until tender, drain well, return to pan, keep warm. Step 3: Melt butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add shallots to pan. Step 5: Cook 6 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally.

Dish Name: Curry-spiced chicken with a tartare of peas
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, mild curry powder, chicken ready for roasting, smoked streaky bacon, peas, peas podded, shallots, marjoram, chives, olive oil, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Mix the oil with the curry powder, and rub this all over the chicken. Transfer to a roasting tin and cook for 1 hr 30 mins. To check if the chicken is cooked, insert a skewer between the thigh and the breast – the juices should run clear. Remove and allow to rest for 20 mins, loosely covered with foil. Step 2: Meanwhile, fry the bacon until crisp in a dry, non-stick pan. Remove and leave to cool slightly. Pulse the peas separately to a rough purée in a blender, or using a hand blender. Step 3: Mix the peas together with bacon, shallot, marjoram, chives, the splash of olive oil, a sprinkle of ground ginger, and season with salt. Serve alongside the chicken.

Ingredient Names: milk, instant coffee, dark chocolate, sugar, hazelnut syrup
Instructions: Step 1: Pour half a cup of milk into a microwave proof container. Step 2: Place it in the microwave on high power level for 30 seconds. Step 3: Remove from microwave. Step 4: Now, melt the chocolate in the microwave on high power level for 30 seconds. Step 5: Remove and keep aside. Step 6: Prepare a mixture of coffee powder, melted chocolate, sugar and a little milk. Step 7: Whisk well to ensure that there are no lumps It should be frothy as well. Step 8: Add a drop of hazelnut syrup Grab a serving glass.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, eggs, lemon juice, lemon essence, lemons, baking powder, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Put butter and sugar in a bowl and cream together. Step 2: Add in the beaten eggs, one at a time. Step 3: Add in lemon juice, lemon essence, lemon colour and grated lemon rind. Step 4: Mix everything well together In another bowl, mix the flour and baking powder. Step 5: Add this into the bowl containing the butter-cream mixture, mix well. Step 6: Pour into a greased cake tin. Step 7: Bake in an oven that has been pre-heated to 180c for 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Step 8: Cut into slices and serve with tea.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, baking powder, vanilla, cardamom, flour, water, whole almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter over low heat, without stirring, until brown about 30 minutes. Step 2: Place butter in pan over a bowl of cold water until firm About 90 minutes. Step 3: Remove butter to mixing bowl, add sugar, baking powder, vanilla and cardamom, and blend thoroughly Slowly add flour Batter will be very stiff If you must, add a few drops of water to enable mixing. Step 4: Roll into 1" balls. Step 5: Top with whole almonds, if desired. Step 6: Bake 350 degrees for 12 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ghee, almonds, cashews, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, pistachios, sunflower seeds, dates khajoor, dried figs, raisins, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 1 tsp ghee. add ½ cup almonds, ½ cup cashew, ¼ cup walnuts, 3 tbsp pumkin seeds, 3 tbsp pistachios, and 2 tbsp sunflower seeds. Step 2: Roast on low flame until the nuts turn crunchy. keep aside. Step 3: In a mixer grinder take 1.5 cup dates. Step 4: Pulse and grind to a smooth paste. Step 5: In a large kadai heat 1 tsp ghee, add 2 tbsp anjeer, 2 tbsp raisins. Step 6: Roast on low flame until they turn aromatic. Step 7: Add in ground dates paste and cook on medium flame. Step 8: Mash and cook until the dates paste turn glossy. Step 9: Further add roasted nuts, ½ tsp cardamom powder, and mix well. Step 10: Combine until everything is well combined and starts to hold shape. Step 11: Cool slightly, and shape into a small ladoo. Step 12: Or you can roll over poppy seeds and shape them into a cylindrical log. Step 13: Wrap in aluminum foil and refrigerate for 2 hours. Step 14: Finally, cut into thick slices and enjoy dry fruit burfi for a month.

Ingredient Names: milk powder, all-purpose flour, baking powder, ghee, milk, sugar, water, saffron, cardamom powder, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl, take 2 cups of milk powder, ¼ cup of all-purpose flour (maida), ½ tsp of baking powder, and 1 tsp of ghee. Step 2: Crumble and mix well, ensuring everything is thoroughly combined. Step 3: Now add ½ cup milk and mix using a spatula. Step 4: Cover and let rest for 10 minutes, or until the milk is well absorbed. Step 5: To prepare a sugar syrup, take 2½ cups of sugar and 1 cup of water. Step 6: Also, add a few saffron and boil for 5 minutes. Step 7: Do not attain string consistency; make a sticky sugar syrup. Step 8: Add ½ tsp cardamom powder and 2 tsp lemon juice. Mix well and keep aside. Lemon juice prevents sugar syrup from crystallising. Step 9: After 10 minutes of resting the dough, start preparing small, ball-sized jamuns. Step 10: Make sure there are no cracks in the jamun. If there are cracks then there are high chances for jamuns to break while frying. Step 11: Deep fry in medium-hot oil or ghee. Frying in ghee gives a good flavour to jamuns. Step 12: Stir continuously and fry on a low flame. Fry until the jamuns turn black. Step 13: Drain off the excess oil and transfer the jamun into a hot sugar syrup. Step 14: Cover and rest for 2 hours, or until the jamuns have absorbed the sugar syrup and doubled in size. Step 15: Drain off the Kala Jamun and roll into dessicated coconut. Step 16: Finally, enjoy the Dry Jamun Recipe as it is.

Dish Name: Easy Kulfi Ice Cream Without An Ice Cream Freezer
Ingredient Names: fat-free evaporated milk, light cream, low fat sweetened condensed milk, flavoring
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, stir together well the evaporated milk, condensed milk, cream, and optional other flavor. Step 2: Pour into popsicle molds, indian stainless steel kulfi molds, or even a small bowl Freeze overnight. Step 3: Remove from the molds by resting their bottoms very briefly in warm to hot water.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, eggs, sugar, raisins, milk, salt, cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water and rice to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 14 min All water should be absorbed. Step 3: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Step 4: Beat eggs in ungreased 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish. Step 5: Stir in sugar, raisins, milk, salt, and spice, stir in rice. Step 6: Bake uncovered 45 minutes Stirring occasionally. Step 7: Remove from oven and stir well.

Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, whole wheat flour, semolina, milk powder, corn flour, sugar, butter, milk, curd, condensed milk, baking powder, baking soda, tutti frutti, raisins, food color, vanilla extract, cardamom pods, white vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Eggless Tutti frutti cake, prep up all the ingredients and preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius. Step 2: Prepare a loaf tin by applying oil on it and dusting with flour. Sift together the dry ingredients- all-purpose flour, wheat flour, semolina, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda and a pinch of salt. Step 3: Mix well. Take a big mixing bowl and add butter, condensed milk, sugar, yogurt, vanilla essence and mix it well until it forms a creamy texture. Now sprinkle some plain flour over the tutti frutti and spread it well (Dusting the tutti frutti with some flour before incorporating them into the batter helps in even distribution preventing them from sinking to the bottom of the cake). Now add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mix very well. Step 4: For the right consistency, add milk if needed. Step 5: Add tutti frutti and raisins and at last add white vinegar and then mix it well. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf tin and tap well. Step 6: Sprinkle some crushed cardamom if using. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to at the same temperature. The top needs to turn golden brown and a tester (toothpick) should come out clean. Allow the Eggless Tutti Frutti Cake to cool for 10 minutes. Step 7: Then slice and enjoy with Masala Chai or Filter Coffee.

Ingredient Names: milk, vanilla custard powder, chocolate cake, marie biscuits, sugar, milk chocolate candy bar
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the milk with sugar. Step 2: Prepare the custard by adding a little cold milk to the custard powder in a big-sized bowl. Step 3: Once the milk has boiled, remove from flame. Step 4: Allow it to cool for 15-20 minutes In the meantime, take a serving dish. Step 5: Spread a layer of cake slices in it. Step 6: Now, mix the milk into the custard-milk bowl. Step 7: Pour some of this on the cake slices. Step 8: Now pat this with a layer of biscuit crumbs. Step 9: Repeat till 2-3 layers are made in this manner.

Dish Name: Fragrant Rice Pudding With Pistachios Kheerni
Ingredient Names: milk, basmati rice, blanched almond, banana, sugar, ground cardamom, saffron thread, unsalted pistachio nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 6 cups milk to boil in heavy shallow 5-quart saucepan. Step 2: Rinse rice with cold water until water runs clear, drain. Step 3: Stir rice into milk. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer until pudding thickens and rice is very tender, stirring frequently, about 1-1 / 4 hours. Step 5: Puree 1 / 4 cup milk and almonds in blender until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape down sides of blender. Step 6: Add banana, sugar, cardamom and saffron and blend, pour into pudding. Step 7: Rinse blender with remaining 1 / 4 cup milk and add to pudding Continue simmering until thickened to consistency of tapioca, about 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Fresh Fruit In Lime Yogurt Cardamom Dressing
Ingredient Names: vanilla yogurt, lime juice, ground cardamom, honey, cantaloupe, mangoes, banana, seedless black grapes, pine nuts, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the fruit into a bowl Completely mix yogurt, lime juice, cardamom, and honey. Step 2: Fold into diced fruit. Step 3: Keep refrigerated till ready to serve. Step 4: Top with mint leaves and nuts for garnish.

Dish Name: Fruit Kheer Indian Fruit Yogurt Pudding
Ingredient Names: sugar, fresh ground black pepper, red chili powder, salt, plain yogurt, bananas, oranges, saffron strand, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the sugar, pepper, chili powder, salt and yogurt together. Step 2: Add the bananas and oranges and mix for 2 minutes Dissolve the saffron in one tsp of water and sprinkle it over the dish before serving.

Dish Name: Gajar Halva Carrot Pudding An Indian Dessert
Ingredient Names: carrots, half-and-half, brown sugar, golden raisin, butter, ground cardamom, salt, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Heat carrots and half-and-half to boiling in saucepan, reduce heat. Step 2: Simmer uncovered, stirring frequently, until all the half & half is absorbed, about 45 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the brown sugar, raisins, butter, cardamom and salt. Step 4: Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until all of the brown sugar is dissolved and the mixture is of your desired consistency, about 15 minutes. Step 5: Garnish with pistachios or slivered almonds. Step 6: Serve warm and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, ginger marmalade, brown sugar, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine yogurt, marmalade, brown sugar, and lemon juice, mix thoroughly. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate for several hours to blend flavors To serve, spoon into 4 dessert dishes.

Dish Name: Gulab Jamun Recipe - Milk Powder: Delicious Indian Dessert
Ingredient Names: milk powder, maida flour, baking powder, ghee clarified butter, milk, ghee, sugar, water, cardamoms, saffron kesar, lemon juice, rose water
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take ¾ cup milk powder, ½ cup maida and ½ tsp baking powder. Step 2: Mix well, homemade gulab jamun mix is ready. Step 3: Now add 2 tbsp ghee and mix well making the flour moist. Step 4: Further, add milk as required start to combine. Step 5: Combine well forming a soft dough. do not knead the dough. Step 6: Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, prepare the sugar syrup by taking 2 cup sugar, 2 cup water, 2 cardamom and ¼ tsp saffron. Step 8: Mix well and boil for 5 minutes or until the sugar syrup turns sticky. do not attain any string consistency. Step 9: Turn off the flame and add 1 tsp lemon juice and 1 tsp rose water. lemon juice is added to prevent sugar syrup from crystallizing. Step 10: Cover and keep the sugar syrup aside. Step 11: After 10 minutes or resting the dough, start to prepare small ball sized jamuns. Step 12: Make sure there are no cracks in the jamun. if there are cracks then there are high chances for jamuns to break while frying. Step 13: Deep fry in medium hot oil or ghee. frying in ghee gives good flavour to jamuns. Step 14: Stir continuously and fry on low flame. Step 15: Fry until the jamuns turn golden brown. Step 16: Drain off and transfer the jamun into a hot sugar syrup. Step 17: Cover and rest for 2 hours or until jamuns absorb the sugar syrup and doubles in size. Step 18: Finally, enjoy gulab jamun with ice cream or as it is.

Ingredient Names: powdered milk, all-purpose flour, water, rose water, sugar, saffron, baking soda, heavy cream, cardamoms, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the water, rose water and sugar to boil, add the saffron, remove from heat and set aside. Step 2: Mix the milk powder, flour, soda, heavy cream well and knead until a soft dough is made. Step 3: Take a teaspoon of the dough, place one cardamom seed in it and make a small ball Similarly make the balls with the remaining dough, and fry them when the ghee is ready until golden brown. Step 4: Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer into the syrup, which should be quite warm. Step 5: Serve these delicious gulab jamuns with hot syrup and garnished with almonds or pistachio.

Ingredient Names: sugar, water, farina, ghee, blanched slivered almond, sultana, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the sugar, water and saffron together to make a light syrup, set aside. Step 2: Melt the ghee or butter in a deep pan over medium heat, blending in the farina and stirring constantly so that the mixture will not burn. Step 3: Add the sultanas and almonds Within 3 or 4 minutes, the mixture should be a light brown. Step 4: Add the saffron syrup and continue stirring constantly. Step 5: Turn the heat to its highest and cook quickly until the mixture is the consistency of mush and the ghee just begins to separate. Step 6: Remove from heat immediately, and allow to cool. Step 7: Serve hot or warm as a dessert.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, paneer, fresh coriander, mint leaves, green onions, thumb-size ginger, garlic, eggs, flour, sunflower oil, lemon wedges sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the cumin seeds in a large, non-stick frying pan for about 1 min, shaking the pan until a shade darker, taking care not to burn. Remove from the heat and place the seeds in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Add everything else, except the oil, lemon and chilli sauce, to the bowl. Season well and mix very thoroughly. Using wet hands, take walnut-size handfuls of the mixture, then press into flat little cakes, like fish cakes or patties. They can now be chilled until ready to cook, or cooked straight away. Step 3: Reheat the pan over a medium flame and add enough oil to cover the base of the pan. When hot, add the fritters, cook until golden underneath, then turn over and cook until golden all over. Be careful as they may splutter slightly. Drain on kitchen paper and keep warm as you cook batches. Serve with lemon wedges and sweet chilli sauce.

Ingredient Names: carrots, cold water, butter, honey, ground cardamom, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring carrots in salted water to a boil and cook until just before done. Step 2: Strain and place in ice water Before serving, melt butter in a saut pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add carrots to heat through and finish cooking. Step 4: Add honey and cardamom, toss, adjust salt and serve.

Ingredient Names: mineral water, fresh ginger, whole cloves, cinnamon stick, anise seed, ground cardamom, ground coffee, whole milk, jaggery, buckwheat honey, ice
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, add ginger, cloves, anise and cardamom to the cups of water Break the cinnamon stick and add it to the mixture. Step 2: Heat over medium heat until the water boils, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for about 15 minutes. Step 3: Add the coffee, stir, and let steep, off the heat, for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Using a fine meshed filter or cheesecloth, pour the coffee through and into a bowl. Step 5: Pour the strained coffee into a clean saucepan and add the honey, sugar and milk and heat almost to boiling then remove the pan from the heat, pour into a heat-proof pitcher, cool then refrigerate until it is chilled, about 2 hours To serve, add ice to squat glasses, pour on the chai coffee, and enjoy Recipes easily doubles.

Ingredient Names: evaporated milk, egg whites, confectioners' sugar, ground cardamom, rose water, pistachios, golden raisin, sliced almonds, candied cherries
Instructions: Step 1: Remove labels from cans of evaporated milk and put the cans in pan with tight fitting lid. Step 2: Fill the pan with water to reach three quarters up the cans. Step 3: Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: When cool, remove and chill cans in fridge 24 hours Open cans and empty milk into a large, chilled bowl. Step 5: Whisk until it doubles in quantity, then fold in whisked egg whites and confectioners' sugar Gently fold in remaining ingredients, seal the bowl with plastic wrap and leave in freezer 1 hour. Step 6: Remove the ice cream from freezer, and mix well with a fork. Step 7: Transfer to a freezer container and return to the freezer for a final setting. Step 8: Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving in scoops.

Ingredient Names: cooked long-grain rice, whole milk, heavy cream, coconut milk, sugar, ground cardamom, golden raisins, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick saut pan over medium heat, combine cooked rice and whole milk. Step 2: Heat until mixture begins to boil Decrease heat to low and cook to a simmer, stirring frequently, until mixture begins to thicken, approximately 5 minutes Increase heat to medium, add heavy cream, coconut milk, sugar, and cardamom Continue to cook until mixture just begins to thicken again, approximately 5-10 minutes Use a whisk to prevent the cardamom from clumping. Step 3: Once mixture begins to thicken, remove from heat and stir in raisins and pistachios. Step 4: Transfer the mixture to individual serving dishes or a glass bowl and place plastic wrap directly on the surface of the pudding. Step 5: Serve chilled or at room temperature I like my rice pudding a little sweet, so i also added a little bit more sugar than the 2 oz.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, light cream, basmati rice, sugar, ground cardamom, sweetened flaked coconut, golden raisins, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Bring milk& cream to boil over low heat, add rice. Step 2: Simmer 1 hour- or until rice is cooked& milk has reduced& thickened. Step 3: Stir in sugar, cardamom& coconut. Step 4: Serve warm or cold, garnished w / raisins& almonds.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, sweetened condensed milk, honey, cardamom seed, basmati rice, fruit, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the milk, condensed milk and honey with cardamom over med heat, stirring constantly so as not to scorch the milk. Step 2: When it is just about at the boiling point, add rice and continue cooking, stirring often, about 45 min until rice is tender and about half the liquid has cooked away. Step 3: Cool and refrigerate until cold To serve, top the pudding with the fruit and garnish with a a couple of mint leaves.

Ingredient Names: water, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, nutmeg, clove, brewed coffee, milk, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-size pot, bring water to a boil. Step 2: Stir in the spices, cover, and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the pre-brewed coffee. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a saucepan, heat milk until almost boiling. Step 5: Strain the coffee through a fine mesh strainer covered with cheesecloth into the milk. Step 6: Add sweetener, stir, and serve in mugs.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Sweet Potato Steak Fries
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, garam masala, ground coriander, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the sweet potatoes If they are average size, cut them in half lengthwise Lay each half flat on the cutting board and cut it into four slices These should be between 1 / 4 and 1 / 2-inch slabs. Step 2: Put the sweet potatoes in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: Sprinkle on the seasonings and then pour on the olive oil Use your clean hands to toss the potatoes with the other ingredients until all is evenly distributed. Step 4: Set aside and allow the potatoes to marinate for 1 / 2-hour or more, depending upon the timing of your meal. Step 5: When you are ready to cook, spray a shallow sheet pan with a light coat of oil to prevent sticking and then pour out the potatoes, distributing them evenly and avoiding any stacking. Step 6: Place the pan on the middle rack of an oven preheated to 400 degrees fahrenheit.

Ingredient Names: potato, sweet potato, onions, olive oil, cumin seeds, garlic, red chile, thumb-size ginger, ground cumin, chili flakes, peas, lemons, fresh coriander, butter, filo pastry, poppy seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Put the potatoes in a large saucepan of cold, salted water, then bring to the boil. Turn down and simmer for 5 mins, add the sweet potatoes and continue to cook for 8 mins until just tender. Drain really. Step 2: Fry the onion in the oil until soft, add the cumin seeds for 1 min, then stir in the garlic, chilli and ginger with the remaining spices. Cook for a further 2-3 mins, then turn off the heat and stir into the potatoes with the peas, lemon juice and coriander. Step 3: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Halve the filo sheets, and use two-thirds of them, overlapping, to line a 22cm loose-bottomed cake tin with a little overhang. As you lay in each sheet, brush with melted butter and keep the rest covered with a clean tea towel. Spoon in filling and press down lightly. Cover with remaining filo, then fold up overhanging sides and scrunch up pastry near the edges. Step 4: Poke several slits in the top of the pastry and brush with more butter. Sprinkle with the poppy seeds. Bake for 40-45 mins until golden brown. Serve either hot or at room temperature with lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: millet, sugar, milk, cashew nuts, raisins, almonds, kewra essence
Instructions: Step 1: Boil milk in a thick bottom pan. Step 2: Add jhangora in it and then cook well. Step 3: Stir to avoid lumps. Step 4: Add sugar and cook for some more time till the sugar is fully dissolved Next add of kewra essence to give it a sweet flavour. Step 5: Mix this essence well. Step 6: Garnish with chopped dry fruits. Step 7: Serve cold with fruit salsa on the side.

Ingredient Names: cashew kaju, sugar, water, ghee clarified butter, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a mixi take 2 cup cashew and blend to a fine powder. make sure to pulse and blend else, the cashew will release oil and turns into a paste. Step 2: Sieve the cashew powder making sure there are no lumps. keep aside. Step 3: In a large kadai take 1 cup sugar and ½ cup water. Step 4: Stir well and dissolve sugar. boil for 5 minutes or until 1 string consistency is attained. Step 5: Add in powdered cashew and mix well. Step 6: Stir continuously until the mixture is well combined and smooth paste is formed. Step 7: Now add 1 tsp ghee and ¼ tsp cardamom powder. mix well. Step 8: Continue to cook until the mixture turns smooth paste and starts to separate pan slightly. do not overcook, as the burfi will turn hard. Step 9: Transfer the mixture on to the butter paper. make sure to grease the butter paper with ghee. Step 10: Now fold using a spatula until the mixture thickens forming a dough. Step 11: Once the dough is formed, knead slightly, to form a soft dough. Step 12: Place the cashew dough between butter paper and roll using a rolling pin. Step 13: Roll slightly thick making sure it's uniform. Step 14: Now grease with ghee and apply silver leaf or silver vark. applying vark is optional. Step 15: Now cut into diamond shape or shape of your choice. Step 16: Finally, enjoy kaju katli for a month when stored in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: powdered milk, ricotta cheese, sugar, butter, cardamom powder, cashew nuts, almonds, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Place milk powder, sugar, and ricotta cheese in microwave-able bowl and mix well. Step 2: Add butter and mix thoroughly, the mixture should be smooth with very thick consistency Microwave it for 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir it, again microwave it for 4 minutes. Step 4: Repeat until it becomes golden brown in color. Step 5: Mix 2-3 threads of saffron. Step 6: Allow it to cool, garnish it with cardamom powder, cashew nuts, and almonds. Step 7: Serve warm or cool.

Ingredient Names: milk, vinegar, sugar, cardamom powder, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large vessel take 2-litre milk and get to a boil. Step 2: Once the milk comes to a boil add 2 tbsp vinegar and mix well. Step 3: Add vinegar until the milk curdles. Step 4: Drain off the milk and rinse with water. rinsing with water helps to remove sourness. Step 5: Now squeeze off the water and transfer to a large plate. Step 6: Mash the paneer to smooth texture. keep aside. Step 7: In a large kadai, heat 1-litre milk. Step 8: Stir and get to a boil. Step 9: Continue to boil until the milk reduces to half. Step 10: Add ¾ cup sugar and mix until the sugar dissolves. Step 11: Further, add prepared paneer and mix well. Step 12: Continue to cook until the mixture starts to separate the pan. Step 13: Further, add ¼ tsp cardamom powder and mix well. Step 14: Now transfer the mixture to the tray and level up. Step 15: Top with chopped nuts and press gently. Step 16: Rest for 8 hours or until it sets completely. Step 17: Cut into pieces and is ready to serve. Step 18: Finally, enjoy kalakand recipe with chopped nuts for a week when refrigerated.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, oil, cumin seed, black mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, dried red chili, green chili, gingerroot, turmeric powder, asafoetida powder, jaggery, water, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and cube sweet potatoes. Step 2: Put it in a bowl of cold water and set aside. Step 3: In a pan, heat the oil. Step 4: Add the cumin, mustard and urad dal. Step 5: When the mustard splutters and urad dal has changed color, add curry leaves, red chili and ginger. Step 6: Stir for a minute then add the turmeric powder. Step 7: Stir and now add the sweet potatoes Dissolve the asafoetida in the water and add to the pan, add salt to taste. Step 8: Add the crushed jaggery only if using the pale sweet potato as the orange one is sweet enough.
