Ingredient Names: raisins, glazed cherries, dried figs, tutti frutti, almond, cashew nuts, rum, unsalted butter, ghee, caster sugar, egg yolks, vanilla extract, candied orange peel, caramel sauce, orange, all purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon powder, nutmeg powder, cloves, dry ginger powder, milk, egg whites, lemon juice, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kerala Style Christmas Plum Cake Recipe first line a 9″ tin with grease proof paper and set it aside for later use. Soak the dry fruits (raisins, dry cherries, cashew, almond, tutti frutti, dry figs, soaked in rum or the juice of 3 oranges, preferably for a month, if not a day in advance, at least)Drain the soaked dry fruits, next and retain the soaked rum in a bottle for later use. Place the soaked dry fruits and the juice of an orange in a sauce pan. Step 2: Cover it, place it over a medium heat and allow it to cook until the juice is absorbed. If you are making a non-alcoholic version, soak the dry fruits in the juice of 3 oranges overnight or for a couple of hours at least. Step 3: When baking the cake, cook them in the same juice until all the juices are absorbed. If for some reason you have not pre-soaked the fruit, you can also soak and cook them instantly in 50-50 mix of rum and orange juice to get the intensity of flavour in a shorter time. Step 4: For best results, pre-soaking the fruit is recommended. Next, spread the cooked dry fruits on a plate and let it cool completely. At this stage, preheat the oven to 180 C. In a large mixing bowl, sieve together the all purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda and all the spice powders. Add the soaked, cooked mixed fruits in the flour and mix well so that the fruit is completely coated, keep this aside. Step 5: Tossing fruits in flour is to avoid fruits falling to the bottom of the cake during baking time. Step 6: It will ensure that the cake remains studded with fruit, right through. Cream together the butter, ghee, egg yolks and the castor sugar until it is light and fluffy. Add flour-fruits to the butter mixture, alternating with milk. Step 7: Ensure that you begin and end with additions of the fruit mixture. Step 8: Stir well with spatula to blend uniformly. Next, beat the egg whites till they are stiff peaks. Step 9: Add sugar and lime juice and beat again. Step 10: Now, fold in the egg whites to the cake mixture. Step 11: Add the caramel and orange candied peel and mix it using a spatula. Pour plum cake batter into prepared pan. Step 12: Smoothen it well (If you like an uneven top, save a small handful of floured dry fruits and sprinkle it on top or arrange some blanched and peeled almonds in a pattern or you can sprinkle some dried cherries on top )Place the plum cake in the preheated oven and bake for about 25-30 minutes or till a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Check for doneness after, as the cooking time will vary from one oven to another 25-30 minutes. When cooked through, remove the tin from the oven and let it sit in the cake tin to cool slightly. When the cake is still warm pour 1/8th cup rum or brandy over the cake and remove from the tin and cool it over a cooling rack. Serve it at Christmas or slice and store away for a tea time treat. Step 13: Once the cake has cooled completely, sprinkle some more alcohol over it and cover it tightly with clingfilm. Step 14: Then wrap it in aluminium foil or brown paper and store it in a dark cool place. Sprinkle some alcohol over the Kerala Style Plum Cake once in 4 days or a week, as this really deepens the flavours. If you do not want to keep it out, you can also refrigerate it, and remember to thaw it a day before Christmas or when you are serving it. The Kerala Style Plum cake keeps refrigerated for at least 3 months.

Ingredient Names: jaggery, water, fresh coconut, cardamom powder, ghee, rice flour, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai take 1 cup jaggery and ¼ cup water. stir until the jaggery melts completely. Step 2: Now add 2 cup coconut and mix well. Step 3: Continue to cook until the mixture starts to separate the pan and holds the shape slightly. Step 4: Further, add ¼ tsp cardamom powder and 1 tsp ghee. mix well. Step 5: Finally, thengai poorna is ready for stuffing. keep aside. Step 6: Firstly, in a saucepan take 2 cup water and ½ tsp ghee. Step 7: Mix well and get to a rolling boil. keep aside. Step 8: In a large bowl take 2 cup rice flour and ¼ tsp salt. mix well. Step 9: Now add hot water in batches and mix well. Step 10: Add the water until the flour turns moist. Step 11: Now start to knead the dough sprinkling water if requried. Step 12: Knead for 5 minutes or until the dough turns soft. Step 13: Kozhukattai dough is ready. wet your hand and knead if the dough seems dry. Step 14: Firstly, to prepare modak shape, pinch a ball sized dough and with the help of both thumbs start pressing the edges and create a dent in the centre. Step 15: Now place a ball sized coconut stuffing in the centre. Step 16: Bring the edges together and seal by pressing. Step 17: Now prepare the modak shaped kolukattai. Step 18: To prepare half-moon shaped, place a ball sized dough on the greased banana leaf. Step 19: Press as this as possible. Step 20: Now place the coconut stuffing and fold half. Step 21: Seal the sides and half-moon shaped kolukattai is ready to steam. Step 22: To prepare round ball-shaped, take ball sized rice flour dough and flatten on the palm. Step 23: Place the coconut stuffing and roll into a round ball. ready to steam. Step 24: To prepare star and flower-shaped modak, cut using a cookie maker. Step 25: Place the modak in steamer leaving gaps in between. Step 26: Cover and steam the modak for 10 minutes or till the shiny texture appears on them. Step 27: Finally, offer kozukkattai to lord ganesha and celebrate ganesh chathurthi.

Ingredient Names: jackfruit, light coconut milk, dark brown sugar, ground cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, heat the coconut milk The jackfruit i buy comes in 8oz drained weight, and 20oz net weight. Step 2: Drain, rinse and dice the jackfruit if using canned. Step 3: Now add the diced jackfruit and sugar to the coconut milk. Step 4: Cook on medium low flame, stirring often until jackfruit is tender In the last five minutes of cooking, stir in the cardamom. Step 5: Serve either warm or chilled For this dish, use firm fruit not the floppy one Don't throw away the seeds - they can be roasted and taste somewhat like roasted chestnuts For a more authentic flavor, use homemade coconut milk and jaggery in place of brown sugar.

Ingredient Names: evaporated milk, condensed milk, whipping cream, cardamom, saffron strands, almonds, pistachios, mango pulp
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all of the ingredients together except cool whip, in a blender. Step 2: Fold in cool whip, and pour into a shallow 3 liter dish leave in the freezer to set. Step 3: Remove from freezer 20 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Lemon Ginger Cake W Lemon Cream Cheese Frosting
Ingredient Names: sugar, unsalted butter, eggs, fresh lemon juice, lemon, vanilla extract, cake flour, ground ginger, baking powder, baking soda, salt, buttermilk, cream cheese, lemons, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: For cake: position rack in center of oven and preheat to 350 degrees f Butter two 9-inch diameter cake pans with 2-inch-high sides. Step 2: Line bottom of pans with waxed paper Butter paper. Step 3: Using electric mixer, beat sugar and butter in large bowl until well blended. Step 4: Add eggs 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 5: Mix in lemon juice, lemon peel and vanilla Sift flour, ginger, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda and salt into medium bowl. Step 6: Add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk in 3 additions each, beginning with dry ingredients. Step 7: Divide batter equally between prepared pans.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, lemon zest, vanilla essence, eggs, all-purpose flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, almond meal, plain yogurt, lemon juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: First, prepare the lemon syrup To do so, in a small saucepan combine all the ingredients together and stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and the mixture comes to a boil. Step 2: Keep the syrup warm until ready to use. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 4: In a large bowl, cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy. Step 5: Add lemon zest and essence. Step 6: Fold in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 7: In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and almond meal together. Step 8: Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture alternating with the yoghurt, beating well after each addition. Step 9: Pour the batter into a well-greased and lightly floured 8 1 / 2-9 inch bundt pan or any other 9-cup tube pan.

Ingredient Names: mild curry paste, coconut cream, limes, brown sugar, lentils, fresh coriander, warmed naan bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the curry paste in a pan for 1 min. Step 2: Pour in the coconut cream and stir to combine. Step 3: Add the lime zest, brown sugar and lentils. Step 4: Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 mins, adding a squeeze of lime juice and seasoning. Step 5: Stir through a handful chopped coriander and serve with warmed naan breads. Step 6: Sprinkle extra coriander on the dhal if you like. Step 7: Great warm or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: split yellow lentils, dark brown sugar, milk, clarified butter, raisins, cashews, green cardamom pods
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the lentils and cook them until soft in about 2 cups water - i usually use a pressure cooker to cook lentils because it's fastest The lentils should be soft but still retain their shapes faintly so that there will be a slight bite to it. Step 2: Drain water from the cooked lentils if there's any excess. Step 3: Place the lentils in a heavy bottomed saucepan on medium heat and add the milk and sugar, mixing well - bring to a boil. Step 4: Lower heat and simmer the mixture until thick, stirring often. Step 5: Once the mixture has thickened, turn off the heat and stir in the ghee. Step 6: Add the cashews, raisins and cardamom powder If desired, these can be roasted in the ghee beforehand. Step 7: Mix well and serve warm or cold.

Ingredient Names: mango puree, lime, mango rum, confectioners' sugar, mango gelatin, water, heavy whipping cream, egg whites, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, stir together the mango puree with the lime juice, rum and 1 / 4 cup sugar. Step 2: Place 2 large empty mixing bowls into the freezer to chill To a large saucepan on medium heat, add the mango puree mixture and 1 / 2 a cup of water and bring to a low-simmer. Step 3: Add the gelatin and reduce the heat to medium-low. Step 4: Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, then remove from heat and let the mixture cool to room temperature. Step 5: Remove the chilled bowls from the freezer and in one, whisk together the heavy cream and 1 / 8c sugar until the mixture forms stiff peaks In the second chilled bowl, beat together the egg whites and the salt to form stiff peaks. Step 6: Fold the egg white mixture into the cream mixture gently, making sure not to over-mix Carefully fold together with the room temperature mango mixture. Step 7: Pour into individual serving dishes and chill for 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, whole black peppercorns, cloves, bay leaves, cassia buds, carom seeds, asafoetida, dried turmeric, fenugreek leaves, sesame seeds, desiccated coconut, poppy seeds, red chili powder, salt, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Goda Masala Recipe, first place a large pan/wok/kadai on a medium heat to roast all the ingredients. Step 2: When the kadai is moderately hot, with the heat on medium, gently and separately roast the ingredients listed under ‘To be roasted dry’ until they are fragrant and lightly browned. Step 3: Take care to keep the heat consistent and moderate so as not to burn any of the ingredients. When each of the ingredients is roasted till aromatic, remove it in a separate container/wide plate and place it aside to cool. Once that is done, proceed to roast the ingredients under “To be roasted in a little oil”. Step 4: Drizzle very little oil into the warm kadai and once again gently and separately roast the ingredients listed one by one. Step 5: You can club a few spices together such as the cloves, peppercorn, nagkesar etc. Take them out in containers/wide plates and set them aside to cool. Next, in a mixer-grinder, grind all the the dry roasted spices together in a batch. Step 6: Then grind all the ingredients roasted in oil together in another batch. Ina large wide pan, mix the two batches of ground spices together. Step 7: Using a large spoon fold the mixture repeatedly so that the spices are uniformly blended. Next, add in the chilli powder and salt. Step 8: If using turmeric powder add that too at this stage. Step 9: Mix well once again. If you wish, you can once again place the mixed spices in the grinder and pulse once more to ensure perfect blend. Empty the mixture into an airtight container and use it when making Maharashtrian Masale Baath, Dal Vangi and Moong Sprouts Usal.

Ingredient Names: ghee, milk, milk powder, sugar powder, red tutti frutti, green tutti frutti, cardamom powder, sliver vark
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tsp ghee and 1 cup milk. Mix well. Step 2: Now add 2 cup milk powder and mix until everything is well combined. Step 3: Further, add ½ cup sugar powder and continue to stir. Step 4: Keep stirring until the mixture thickens and starts to hold the shape. Step 5: Add 2 tbsp red tutti frutti, 2 tbsp green tutti frutti, ½ tsp cardamom powder and 1 tsp ghee. Step 6: Mix well until the mixture holds the shape and turns non-sticky. Step 7: Transfer to the butter paper and roll cylindrical. Make sure to smoothen the mixture well. Step 8: Apply sliver vark over the roll and rest for 30 minutes. Step 9: Now cut into pieces and ready to serve. Step 10: Finally, enjoy Sweet Roll Recipe for a week when stored in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, mango chutney, onion, curry powder, mixed nuts, ginger paste, cinnamon, cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all in a food processor to make a nice spread Serve with crackers, toasted indian bread{naan}, grilled chicken, or fresh vegies and fruit.

Dish Name: Mango Coconut Saffron Ice Cream No Egg
Ingredient Names: heavy cream, sugar, mango pulp, coconut milk, malibu rum, vanilla extract, saffron threads, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: In a small sauce pan, warm 1 cup heavy cream, do not boil. Step 2: Add the saffron strands if using The cream will take on a pretty yellow-orangeish color. Step 3: Add the sugar and stir just until sugar is dissolved. Step 4: In a medium bowl whisk all other ingredients together. Step 5: Stir or whisk in the saffron infused cream. Step 6: Cover and chill completely in refrigerator Freeze in ice-cream maker and enjoy immediately or when firm Delicious!

Ingredient Names: mangoes, milk, salt, sugar, vanilla essence, gelatin, water, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the mangoes. Step 2: Remove pulp, pour into a mixer bowl. Step 3: Add milk, salt, sugar and essence. Step 4: Blend till smooth To melt the gelatin, sprinkle it over hot water in a small bowl. Step 5: Stir constantly until completely dissolved. Step 6: Mix the gelatin-water mixture with the mango mixture. Step 7: Pour into 4 small bowls. Step 8: Refrigerate until set. Step 9: Garnish with walnuts before serving.

Ingredient Names: eggs, sugar, gelatin, saffron thread, mango puree, candied ginger, heavy whipping cream, mint leaf, fresh edible flower
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the gelatin and saffron in 2-3 tablespoon of warm water for 10 minutes. Step 2: Mix the egg yolks, sugar, gelatin and saffron with 2 tablespoon of water in a bowl and place it over a double boiler and whisk continuously to make a thick custard. Step 3: When the mixture coats the back of a spoon it is ready remove from stove. Step 4: Cool slightly and fold in the mango puree and the candied ginger. Step 5: Beat the egg whites in a clean dry bowl till soft peaks form and set aside Whip the cream and fold into the mango mixture Gently fold in egg whites carefully Pipe it into pretty champange glasses, mini tart crust or mini chocolate shell using a large 5 star nozzle. Step 6: Garnish with mint or flowers, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: mango, sugar, milk, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and extract mango pulp from the ripe mangoes and sieve it. Step 2: In a deep pan, cook mango pulp with equal quantity of water. Step 3: Prepare sugar syrup and mix it with mango mixture while continuously stirring, add milk to it. Step 4: Mix well and keep it boiling until the mixture thickens. Step 5: Decorate it with nuts and serve.

Dish Name: Mango Lassi Frozen Yogurt For Ice Cream Maker
Ingredient Names: mangoes, greek yogurt, sugar, vanilla extract, cardamom, yellow food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: First begin by pureeing two fresh mangoes in a blender with just enough water as was necessary to grind them to a smooth mixture. Step 2: Combine 16 oz of greek yogurt together with the mango mixture and 1 / 2 cup sugar in the ice cream maker While the mixture was churning in an ice cream maker, add 1 / 2 tsp cardamom and 3 drops yellow food coloring for a vibrant yellow color Also add 1 / 2 tsp vanilla extract. Step 3: After 30 minutes of churning, the frozen mango lassi will be ready to be frozen in a freezer. Step 4: Allow to freeze for at least four hours before serving.

Ingredient Names: apples, onions, cider vinegar, raisins, garlic cloves, turmeric, hot red pepper flakes, ground ginger, pitted dates
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and core apples. Step 2: Chop apples and onions into 1 / 2 inch pieces. Step 3: Place in a large saucepan with cider vinegar. Step 4: Add raisins, garlic and spices. Step 5: Bring to a boil, uncovered and stirring often, over medium-high heat. Step 6: Then, reduce heat to low and continue to simmer, uncovered, until apples are tender, about 20 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, remove any pits from dates then coarsely chop Chopped, they should measure about 4-1 / 2 cups. Step 8: When apples are tender, stir in dates Continue to simmer, uncovered and stirring often, until dates have broken down and chutney is thick, about 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: nonfat dry milk powder, splenda granular, stevia truvia, cocoa, ground cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, dried ancho chile powder, brewed coffee, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together powdered milk, sweeteners, cocoa and spices. Step 2: In a blender or mixing bowl, add the vanilla and 1 cup of coffee to the cocoa mix. Step 3: Blend or whisk thoroughly. Step 4: Blend in the other three cups of coffee. Step 5: Pour into cups and serve.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, ajwain, salt, oil, water, peas matar, ginger, chili, asafoetida, cumin, fennel, besan flour, turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, dried fenugreek, sugar, dry mango powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, on a large plate take 2 cup maida, ¼ tsp ajwain, ½ tsp salt, and ¼ cup oil. Step 2: Crumble and mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Add water as required and knead to a smooth dough. Step 4: Grease the dough with oil, cover, and rest for 30 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, prepare the stuffing by sauting 3 cup peas. Step 6: Saute until the peas turn aromatic and soften. Step 7: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 8: Add 1 inch ginger, 4 chilli, and grind to a coarse paste. Keep aside. Step 9: In a pan heat 2 tbsp oil, add pinch hing, 1 tsp cumin, and ½ tsp fennel. Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 10: Further, add 2 tbsp besan and saute till the besan turns aromatic. Step 11: Now add prepared peas paste and cook for a minute. Step 12: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp garam masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi, ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp dry mango powder. Step 13: Mix well making sure all the spices are well combined. Step 14: Matar stuffing is ready. Allow to cool completely. Step 15: Knead the dough again, pinch a small ball-sized dough, and tuck well. Step 16: With your fingers, press the sides gently and make a cup shape. Step 17: Place a small ball-sized prepared matar stuffing. Step 18: Start to pleat and seal tight. Pinch off excess dough. Step 19: Now flatten gently, having a uniform thickness. Step 20: In hot oil, keeping the flame on low. Step 21: Do not touch until the kachori starts to float by itself. Takes approximately 3 minutes. Step 22: Carefully flip over and fry both sides on low flame. Step 23: Fry until the kachori turns golden brown and crisp. Step 24: Drain off the kachori over kitchen paper making sure to remove excess oil. Step 25: Finally, enjoy Matar Kachori Recipe with imli chutney.

Ingredient Names: milk, lemon juice, sugar, ghee, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in large kadai add some water before adding 2 litre milk. Step 2: Stir and get the milk to a boil. Step 3: Now add 2 tsp lemon juice and continue to boil stirring uniforly. Step 4: You can see, the milk starts to get grainy texture. Step 5: Continue to boil till the milk reduces. Step 6: Add in ½ cup sugar in batches to prevent sugar from turning mixture watery. Step 7: Keep boiling and adding sugar in batches. Step 8: Continue to boil, till the milk thickens and turns creamy consistency. Step 9: Now add 1 tsp ghee and continue to cook till the mixture starts to separate the pan. Step 10: Add in ½ tsp cardamom powder, 1 tsp ghee and give a good mix. Step 11: Transfer to a tray lined with baking paper. Step 12: Cover and rest for 30 minutes, to set completely. Step 13: Finally, cut into desired pieces and enjoy Mawa Burfi.

Ingredient Names: milk, lemons, sugar, ghee, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a kadai, take 3 litres of milk and boil it till it reduces. Step 2: Add ½ lemon by dropping the juice slowly. Step 3: Stir and mix slowly. Step 4: Milk starts to curdle little by little. Continue to cook on a low flame till the milk reduces further. Step 5: Once the milk has reduced completely, add 1 cup of sugar and mix until well combined. Step 6: The sugar dissolves, continue to cook, stirring continuously. Step 7: Be careful as the milk starts to splutter. Step 8: Continue to cook until the water is completely evaporated. Step 9: Add 4 tbsp ghee, ½ tsp cardamom powder and cook well. Step 10: Cook till the mixture starts to hold its shape and no water is in the mixture. Step 11: Transfer the mixture to the tray and level it. Step 12: Cover and rest for 4 hours till the mixture cools slightly. Step 13: Finally, cut into pieces and serve the Milk Cake Recipe.

Ingredient Names: milk powder, ghee, sugar, water, saffron, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take 2 cup milk powder and 1 cup ghee. Step 2: Crumble and mix well making sure the milk powder is moist. Keep aside. Step 3: In a large kadai take 1½ cup sugar and ½ cup water. Step 4: Stir and dissolve the sugar. Step 5: Continue to boil on medium flame until 1-string sugar syrup consistency is attained. Step 6: Further, add the prepared milk powder mixture and mix well. Step 7: Keeping the flame on low, continuously stir until the mixture turns silky smooth consistency. Step 8: Add few saffron for enhanced kesar flavor. Step 9: Transfer the burfi mixture to the tray lined with baking paper. Step 10: Top with saffron and 2 tbsp pistachios and press gently. Step 11: Rest the milk burfi for 1 hour to set well. Step 12: Now cut into pieces and enjoy. Step 13: Finally, Milk Powder Burfi Recipe is ready to enjoy for a month.

Dish Name: Mithi Sevai Sweet And Dry Vermicelli
Ingredient Names: vermicelli, sugar, water, cardamom powder, ghee, dried fruits
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the ghee on a low flame in a wok and put the vermicelli into it, fry stirring continuously until golden brown. Step 2: Add water and the vermicelli cook. Step 3: When the water has been absorbed, add the sugar and stir gently, cook until the sugar has mixed in well. Step 4: Remove from fire and garnish with dry fruits of your choice.

Ingredient Names: ghee, fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom powder, water, salt, rice flour
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 1 tsp ghee and saute 2 cup coconut. Step 2: Saute until the coconut turns aromatic. Step 3: Now add 1 cup of jaggery and mix well. Step 4: Keep cooking on medium flame until the jaggery melts. Step 5: Continue to cook until the mixture thickens and still remains moist. Step 6: Now add ½ tsp cardamom powder and mix well. Stuffing is ready, keep it aside. Step 7: Firstly, in a large kadai take 2 cup water, ½ tsp salt, and 1 tsp ghee. Step 8: Mix well and bring the water to a boil. Step 9: Further, add 2 cup rice flour and mix gently. Step 10: Mix until the rice flour absorbs all the water. Step 11: Cover and rest for 3 minutes. Step 12: Now transfer to a large bowl and start to knead the dough. Wet your hand to prevent it from burning. Step 13: Knead for 5 minutes or until the dough turns soft. Wet your hand and knead if the dough seems dry. Step 14: Now take a ball-sized rice flour dough and roll. Step 15: With the help of both thumbs start pressing the edges and create a dent in the center. Step 16: Slowly press from the edges till it forms a cup. Step 17: Start creating pleats with your index finger and thumb. Step 18: Now scoop a tbsp of prepared coconut-jaggery stuffing. Step 19: Get the pleats together to form a bundle. Step 20: Close the top by pinching and making it pointed. Step 21: Grease the modak mould with ghee to prevent it from sticking. Step 22: Stuff the rice flour dough into the mould walls. Step 23: Also, place a small ball-sized mixture in the centre. Step 24: Close tightly and scrape off the excess mixture. Step 25: Unmould the modak gently without breaking. Step 26: Place the modak in steamer leaving gaps in between. Step 27: Cover and steam the modak for 10 minutes or till the shiny texture appears on them. Step 28: Finally, of Ukadiche Modak to lord Ganesha and celebrate Ganesh Chathurthi.

Dish Name: My Never Fail Suji Ka Halwa Semolina Halwa
Ingredient Names: semolina, ghee, sugar, water, raisins, yellow food coloring, dried coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Take a deep pan or kadai, heat ghee, when hot add suji. Step 2: Stir it and lower the flame medium to low. Step 3: In a separate pan take water, sugar, food colouring and raisins together. Step 4: Bring to a boil on medium flame and let it boil for a minute. Step 5: After a couple of minutes the suji will change colour. Step 6: Now don't leave it unattended--constantly stir it to avoid burning until a nice brown colour is reached, something similar to the colour of peanut butter. Step 7: Reduce flame to slowest wear your thick oven gloves and very carefully add the boiling water to the suji The water will splutter, so be careful!

Dish Name: No Way It's Fat Free Sugar Free Mango Kulfi
Ingredient Names: nonfat dry milk powder, water, splenda granular, fat-free half-and-half, mango
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients in blender Pour evenly among 17 ice cream pop molds and insert sticks Freeze at least 4 hours Betcha can't eat just one, i couldn't.

Ingredient Names: carrots, eggs, sugar, fresh lemon rind, blanched almonds, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pre heat oven to 220 degrees c. Step 2: Beat egg yolks and sugar well. Step 3: Add lemon rind, ground almonds and carrots. Step 4: Mix Sift together the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt. Step 5: Add to the carrot mixture. Step 6: Fold in the beaten egg whites. Step 7: Pour the batter into a well greased and floured tin. Step 8: Bake in an oven for 50 minutes. Step 9: When done, turn out and leave to cool.

Ingredient Names: vanilla wafers, graham wafers, pecans, margarine, all-purpose flour, orange gelatin, boiling water, cold water, frozen orange juice concentrate, lemon juice, orange extract, whipping cream, powdered sugar, mandarin orange segments, chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Pie crust---------- In a medium-size mixing bowl, combine crushed vanilla wafers, crushed graham wafers and finely chopped pecans, mix well. Step 2: Add margarine or butter and blend using a pastry blender or a fork. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350 f degrees. Step 4: Prepare a 9 inch oven-proof pie dish by lightly spraying with a vegetable oil. Step 5: Dust with 1 tablespoon of flour Shake off any excess flour off pie plate. Step 6: Spoon wafer mixture into pie dish. Step 7: Press evenly to bottom and sides using a rounded soup spoon.

Ingredient Names: cubes paneer, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, salt, curds, ginger garlic paste, corn flour, oil, asafoetida, ginger, garlic, chili, red chile, tomato sauce, chaat masala, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, take 20 cubes of paneer in a bowl. Add 1 tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala, and ½ tsp salt. Step 2: Also add 3 tbsp curd, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and 3 tbsp corn flour. Mix well. Step 3: Deep fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 4: Once the paneer turns golden brown and crunchy, drain off the paneer and keep it aside. Step 5: In a pan, heat 2 tbsp oil. Add a pinch of salt, 1 inch of ginger, 5 cloves of garlic, 2 chillies, and 2 dried red chillies. Saute well. Step 6: Also add 2 tbsp tomato sauce, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp chaat masala and cook till the sauce turns glossy. Step 7: Now add a few curry leaves and fried paneer. Step 8: Mix well, making sure the sauce is coated well. Step 9: Finally, enjoy Paneer 65 Recipe hot as a starter.

Ingredient Names: milk solids, sugar, milk, cardamom powder, saffron, pistachios, rose essence
Instructions: Step 1: Add saffron in lukewarm milk and leave aside. Step 2: Combine sugar with khoya, mix and then cook over medium heat until the mixture is smooth. Step 3: Add milk in a slow trickle to khoya, stirring continuously and cook till milk is absorbed. Step 4: Repeat the same process till all the milk is used. Step 5: Take off the heat, add rose essence, cardamom powder and chopped pistachio, mix well. Step 6: Now take a little of the mixture and shape it into a round flat peda. Step 7: Make same-sized pedas from the remaining mixture. Step 8: Leave aside to cool thoroughly before serving.

Ingredient Names: khoya, confectioners' sugar, yellow food coloring, cardamom powder, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: First combine khoya and sugar in a sauce pan and heat on low, stirring constantly, until it thickens. Step 2: When thickened, it should form into a soft mass. Step 3: Allow it to cool for approximately 10-12 minutes Next you will add the cardamom powder yellow coloring, and combine very well. Step 4: Roll a nice amount of dough into a ball and press finger into center to make a small well and press 2-3 slices of pistachio in the centers Use the same process for the remaining dough Enjoy!

Dish Name: Perfect Banana Sheera Semolina Pudding With Bananas
Ingredient Names: bananas, semolina, sugar, clarified butter, milk, raisins, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Roast semolina in the ghee till aromatic. Step 2: Heat milk and lower the flame. Step 3: Add roasted rava, chopped bananas, sugar and blend well. Step 4: Add raisins and cardamom powder. Step 5: Heat through and serve hot It can also be chilled and served.

Dish Name: Prawns In Green Spice Paste Hara Masala
Ingredient Names: prawns, onion, fennel seed, cumin seed, coconut oil, lemon juice, turmeric powder, water, salt, coriander leaves, garlic paste, ginger paste, coconut, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and devein the prawns. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 tsp of turmeric and salt to the prawns and leave aside. Step 3: In a blender, add the the coriander leaves, coconut, ginger paste, garlic paste and green chillies. Step 4: Add 1 / 4 cup water to help it blend. Step 5: Blend to form a paste On medium flame heat 1 tbsp oil. Step 6: Add the fennel seeds and cumin seeds and let them sputter, add the onions. Step 7: Add a pinch of salt and cook till the onions are translucent. Step 8: Add the green paste, mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: jaggery, curds, oil, milk, ragi flour, cocoa powder, vanilla extract, salt, baking soda, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 cup jaggery, ½ cup curd, ¼ cup oil, and ½ cup milk. Step 2: Whisk and mix well making sure everything jaggery melts completely. Step 3: Add 2 cup ragi flour and 2 tbsp cocoa powder. Step 4: Also add 1 tsp vanilla extract, pinch salt, ¼ tsp baking soda, and 1 tsp baking powder. Step 5: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 6: Further, add milk as required and mix until the batter turns silky smooth consistency. Step 7: Transfer the cake batter to a cake mold. Step 8: Also, tap twice to level up uniformly and remove any air bubbles if present. Step 9: Place the cake pan into a preheated cooker. To prepare the cake in a pressure cooker add 2 cups of salt and close the lid of the cooker without keeping the gasket and whistle. heat for 5 to 10 minutes. As a result, gives a preheated oven atmosphere. Step 10: Cover and cook on a medium flame for 45 minutes. You can alternatively, preheat and bake at 180-degree Celsius for 45 minutes. Step 11: Insert a toothpick and check if the cake has baked completely. Step 12: Cool the cake and then unmold the Ragi chocolate cake. Step 13: Finally, cut the Ragi Cake into pieces and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, rava, ghee, salt, water, oil, almonds, cashews, poppy seeds, dry coconut, powdered sugar, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, to prepare the dough, in a large plate take 2 cup maida, 2 tbsp rava, ½ tsp salt. Step 2: Pour 2 tbsp hot ghee and mix well. Step 3: Crumble and mix till the flour gets moist. Step 4: Now add warm water and start to knead the dough. Step 5: Knead the dough well, ensuring it is smooth and tight. Step 6: Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Step 7: To prepare the stuffing, heat 1 tsp ghee in a pan and roast 1 cup rava. Step 8: Roast on a low flame till the rava turns aromatic and golden brown. Step 9: Add 2 tbsp almonds, 2 tbsp cashews, 1 tsp poppy seeds and 1 cup dry coconut. Step 10: Continue to roast till the coconut turns golden brown. Step 11: Transfer the mixture to the bowl and cool slightly. Step 12: Now add 1 cup powdered sugar, ½ tsp cardamom powder and mix well. Make sure to add sugar once the mixture has cooled slightly, or else the sugar will melt. Step 13: After the dough has rested well, knead it slightly and pinch off a small ball-sized piece. Step 14: Take a small ball-sized dough and flatten it slightly. Roll the dough slightly thin, ensuring it is of uniform thickness. Place a tbsp of stuffing in the centre and spread water around the corners. Step 15: Fold in half, and seal by pressing gently. Step 16: Now you can decorate by folding with your hand, with a pastry cutter, or with a knife. Step 17: Deep fry in medium-hot oil. Make sure to drop them gently. Step 18: Stir occasionally, keeping the flame on low. Fry until the karanji turns golden brown and crisp. Step 19: Drain off the karanji over a kitchen towel to drain excess oil. Step 20: Finally, enjoy Rava Kajjikayalu for up to 10 days when stored in an airtight container.

Dish Name: Red onion & chilli bhajis with mint & garlic raita
Ingredient Names: red onions, chickpea flour, baking powder, curry paste, red, vegetable oil, yogurt, mint, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop one onion and thinly slice the other. Sift the flour and baking powder into a bowl. Add the curry paste or powder, chopped chilli and a good sprinkling of salt. Add about 150ml of cold water to make a thick batter. Stir in the chopped and sliced onions until they are well coated. Step 2: Mix together the raita ingredients with a little salt and pepper, then spoon into a small bowl. Heat about 5cm of oil in a wok or deep pan. Add a tiny speck of batter, if it rises to the surface surrounded by bubbles and starts to brown, then the oil is hot enough. Step 3: Add heaped tbsps of onion mix to the pan, a few at a time, and cook for a few mins, turning once, until they are evenly browned and crisp, about 3-4 mins. Drain on kitchen paper, sprinkle with a little salt and keep warm while you cook the remaining bhajis. Serve with the raita.

Ingredient Names: sugar, rava semolina, maida flour, salt, ghee, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a mixer jar take ½ cup sugar and 2 tbsp rava. Grind to a fine powder. Step 2: In a large bowl, take 2 cup maida, ½ tsp salt and powdered sugar. Mix well. Step 3: Heat ¼ cup ghee and heat it well. Step 4: Pour the ghee over the flour and mix well. Step 5: Crumble and mix making sure the flour is moist. Step 6: Now add water slowly and start to knead the dough. Step 7: Just bring the flour together, do not over-knead. Step 8: Cover and rest the dough for 30 minutes. Step 9: Further, roll it slightly thick like paratha. Step 10: Cut in a square shape, size of your choice. Step 11: Deep fry in medium hot oil, or bake at 180 degree celsius for 15-20 minutes. Step 12: Stir occasionally keeping the flame on medium. Step 13: Fry till the sweet shankarpalli / shankarpara turns golden and crisp. Step 14: Finally, drain over the kitchen towel and serve / store Sweet Shankarpalli / Shankarpara in an airtight container once cooled completely.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, onions, red chile, garam masala, turmeric, fresh cilantro, flour, baking soda, sunflower oil, tomatoes to smithereens, red onions, green chili, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Tip all the fritter ingredients into a bowl. Gradually work in about 200ml cold water until everything is bound in a thick, spoonable batter (you can do this an hour ahead, but the fritters should be cooked at the last minute). Step 2: Heat a decent layer of oil in a large frying pan, then fry large spoonfuls of the batter for 2 mins until golden. Flip them over, cook on the other side, then lift onto kitchen paper and keep warm while you cook another batch. Step 3: Make the salsa by mixing all the ingredients together. Serve the fritters with the salsa for spooning over.

Dish Name: Spiced potato cake with mint raita
Ingredient Names: potato, butter, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, nigella seeds, thumb-size ginger, onions, ground turmeric, ground coriander, green chili, fresh coriander, peas, limes, filo pastry, baby spinach, greek yogurt, coconut cream, mint sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put half the potatoes in a large pan of cold water and bring to the boil. Add the remaining potatoes and simmer for 12 mins until just tender (boiling the potatoes like this will mean that some will be more cooked than others). Drain, then dice. Step 2: Meanwhile, melt 85g/3oz of the butter in a large pan and fry the cumin, fennel and nigella seeds until they start to crackle. Stir in the ginger and onions, then cook for 10 mins, stirring frequently until the onions are tender. Step 3: Stir in the turmeric, ground coriander and chillies, cook for a min, then add the potatoes and cook, turning them in the from the turmeric. Take off the heat. Chop half the coriander leaves and add to the potatoes, along with a heaped tsp salt, the peas and lime juice. Stir well and set aside. Step 4: Melt the remaining butter. Line the base and sides of a greased 23cm clip-sided or loose-based cake tin with filo pastry, brushing each sheet generously with melted butter as you lay them, butter-side down, in the tin – build up several layers so that the pastry is an even thickness all over. Allow plenty of excess pastry to hang over the tin. Put the spinach in the microwave and cook according to the pack instructions. Squeeze out all the excess juice and season. Step 5: Tip half the potato filling into the tin, pack down, then cover with the spinach. Top with the remaining filling, then fold over the excess pastry to cover the filling, brush with more butter and scatter with nigella seeds. You can now chill the pie overnight if you want to get ahead. Step 6: To serve: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Bake for 45-50 mins until golden and crispy. Meanwhile, tip the yogurt, coconut cream and remaining coriander into a food processor with the mint sauce and some seasoning, and whizz until smooth. Serve with a green salad tossed with chopped bananas coated in lime juice, finely chopped red onion and a handful of sugar-coated cashews.

Ingredient Names: lean lamb, onions, fresh carrots, garam masala, stock, peas, potatoes, turmeric, fresh coriander, half lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick frying pan, cook the lamb, onion and carrots, stirring often, until the lamb is browned and veg is starting to soften, about 8 mins. Add the garam masala and some seasoning and cook for a further 2 mins until fragrant. Pour in the stock, bring to the boil, tip in the peas and cook for a further 2 mins until the peas are cooked and most of the liquid has evaporated. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook potatoes in a large pan of salted water until just tender, about 8 mins. Drain well, return to the pan and gently stir in turmeric and coriander – try not to break up the potatoes too much. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Transfer the mince to a baking dish and top with the turmeric potatoes. Squeeze over the lemon juice, then bake for 30-35 mins until potatoes are golden. Serve immediately with extra lemon wedges on the side.

Ingredient Names: spinach, green onions, cherry tomatoes, garam masala, filo pastry, olive oil, fresh carrot, mustard seeds, green chili, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. In a large bowl, mix the spinach, spring onions, cherry tomatoes and garam masala with a grinding of pepper. Step 2: Lay out a sheet of filo and cut it lengthways into 3 long strips. Brush roughly with the oil – don’t worry about covering the whole sheet. Spoon tablespoons of mix onto the top of each strip and fold each over into a triangle. Keep folding until each strip of filo is used up. Brush with any remaining oil, then bake for 20 mins until golden and crisp. Step 3: To make the salad, toss all the ingredients together and serve alongside.

Dish Name: Surti Obbattu - Fruit & Nut Pooris In Saffron Milk
Ingredient Names: semolina, all purpose flour, ghee, sunflower oil, rose petals, almond, cashew nuts, sultanas, gulkand, cardamom powder, fresh coconut, sugar, milk, saffron strands
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Surti Obbattu, mix semolina, maida, ghee and enough water to make a soft dough, cover and set it aside for to rest. Add the remaining ghee in a pan and roast the almond, cashews, sultanas and coconut on a low flame and toss in the sugar and cardamom and cook until any water evaporates. Step 2: Dish it into a bowl. In a pan, add all the ingredients for soaking surti obbattu and bring it to a boil and let it cool until use. Step 3: This is to warm when needed. In a mixer jar, add the soaked and peeled almonds and grind coarsely. Step 4: Add this along with the other ingredients for the badam milk to be spooned on top of soaked surti obbattu and bring it to a boil in a pan and turn off the flame and set aside until needed, to cool it as well. Divide the dough into 8 portions and roll it out into pooris and deep fry in hot oil. Step 5: This must be done quickly and must not sit in the oil for too long. Step 6: These pooris need not be crispy. Now dip this one at a time into the soaking milk and let it sit for 30 seconds to 1 minute, take it on to a plate, center the dry fruit mixture and roll it into cylindrical rolls. Step 7: You can also use Rose gulkand along with the dry fruit mixture into the rolls. Spoon the thick Badam milk on top and garnish with Rose petals.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, massaman curry powder, palm sugar, turmeric, fish sauce, coconut milk, pineapple chunks, kaffir lime leaves, red chile, lemongrass, raw tiger shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy-based pan, heat the oil and add the curry paste. Step 2: Fry for 2 mins, add the sugar and turmeric, then stir well. Step 3: Splash in the fish sauce, then the coconut milk and pineapple. Step 4: Bring to the boil. Step 5: Add the lime leaves or juice, chilli and lemongrass. Step 6: Simmer for 3 mins, throw in the prawns and simmer for 5 mins more until the prawns change colour.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, vindaloo curry paste, soft brown sugar, lemons, zucchini, cauliflower florets, passata, chickpeas, leaf spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the curry paste and fry for 1 min. Add the sugar and lemon juice, cook for 1 min, then tip in the courgettes and cauliflower and cook for 2 mins. Now stir in the passata, plus 100ml/3½fl oz water and the chickpeas, season to taste. Bring to the boil, cover with a lid and simmer for 15 mins. Make up to this stage and freeze or keep chilled for 2 days in the fridge. Warm through, once defrosted if frozen, and continue with the recipe. Step 2: Just before serving, throw in the spinach, give it a stir and remove from the heat once the leaves have just wilted. Serve with boiled basmati rice.

Dish Name: Sweet & sour lentil dhal with grilled aubergine
Ingredient Names: red lentils, turmeric, tamarind paste, vegetable oil, onions, garlic, ginger, curry powder, eggplants, basmati rice lime
Instructions: Step 1: Cover the lentils, turmeric and tamarind paste with 500ml water. Add some salt and boil for 15 mins or until very soft. Skim off any foam that forms on the top. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp of the oil and cook the onion, garlic and ginger until golden, about 5 mins. Step 2: Add the curry powder and cook for a further 2 mins. Pour in the lentil mixture and cook for another 10 mins. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat a griddle pan until very hot. Rub the remaining oil over the aubergine slices and season. Cook for 2-3 mins each side until cooked through and charred. Eat with basmati rice, lime or mango chutney and a sprinkling of coriander, if you like.

Ingredient Names: sweet corn, turmeric, salt, water, butter, fresh coriander, cumin powder, chili powder, chaat masala, black salt, fresh carrot, cucumbers, capsicum, onions, tomato, ginger, chili
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a vessel, get the water to a boil. Add 4 cups of sweet corn; you can use either fresh or frozen sweet corn, the boiling time will change accordingly. Step 2: Add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp salt and boil for 5 minutes or until the sweet corn softens. Step 3: Drain off and keep aside. Step 4: To prepare the butter corn chaat, take 2 cup boiled sweet corn. Step 5: Add 2 tsp butter, pinch salt and 2 tbsp coriander. Mix well. Step 6: Finally, enjoy Butter Corn Chaat when it's warm. Step 7: To prepare the masala corn chaat, take 2 cup boiled sweet corn. Step 8: Add ½ tsp butter, pinch salt, ¼ tsp cumin powder, ¼ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp chaat masala, ¼ tsp kala namak. Mix well, making sure the butter melts. Step 9: Also add 2 tbsp carrot, 2 tbsp cucumber, 2 tbsp capsicum, 2 tbsp onion, 2 tbsp tomato, 1 inch ginger, 1 chilli, finely chopped and 2 tbsp coriander. Mix well. Step 10: Finally, enjoy Masala Corn Chaat when it's warm.

Dish Name: Sweet Potato Curry With Spinach and Chickpeas
Ingredient Names: sweet onions, canola oil, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, spinach, sweet potatoes, chickpeas, water, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: You may choose to cook the sweet potatoes however you prefer. Step 2: I like to peel, chop and steam mine in a veggie steamer for about 15 minutes. Step 3: Baking or boiling work well too. Step 4: While sweet potatoes cook, heat 1-2 tsp of canola or vegetable oil over medium heat. Step 5: Add onions and sauté 2-3 minutes, or until they begin to soften. Step 6: Next, add the curry powder, cumin, and cinnamon, and stir to coat the onions evenly with spices. Step 7: Add tomatoes with their juices, and the chickpeas, stir to combine. Step 8: Add ½ cup water and raise heat up to a strong simmer for about a minute or two. Step 9: Next, add the fresh spinach, a couple handfuls at a time, stirring to coat with cooking liquid. Step 10: When all the spinach is added to the pan, cover and simmer until just wilted, about 3 minutes. Step 11: Add the cooked sweet potatoes to the liquid, and stir to coat. Step 12: Simmer for another 3-5 minutes, or until flavors are well combined. Step 13: Transfer to serving dish, toss with fresh cilantro, and serve hot. Step 14: This dish is nice served over basmati or brown rice.

Ingredient Names: sweet potato, olive oil, skinless chicken thigh fillets, red onions, rogan josh curry paste, tomatoes, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the sweet potatoes in boiling, salted water for 5-7 mins until just tender. Drain well, then set aside. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan, then add the chicken and onion. Cook for 5-6 mins until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Stir in the curry paste, cook for 1 min, add the tomatoes, then cook for another min. Step 2: Pour in 100ml boiling water and mix well. Simmer for 5 mins, add the spinach, then cook for 2 mins until wilted. Fold in the potatoes and heat through. Serve with rice and naan breads.

Ingredient Names: curry paste from, onions, potatoes, sweet potatoes, vegetable stock from cube is fine, coconut milk, peas, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the curry paste in a large pan and stir in the onion. Cover and cook for 5 mins, stirring occasionally, until softened. Add the potatoes, stock and coconut milk to the pan and bring to the boil. Step 2: Turn the heat down and simmer the curry for 20 mins until the potato has softened. Add the peas, bring back to the boil and simmer for 2 mins more. Season to taste and spoon the curry into bowls. Scatter over the coriander before you tuck in.

Ingredient Names: thandai powder, saffron strands, basmati rice, milk, sugar, condensed milk, almond, pistachios, cashew nuts, rose petals, cardamom powder, mixed nuts, poppy seeds, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, whole black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: To begin with Thandai Flavored Rice Kheer, wash and soak the rice for 30 minutes. Step 2: After, drain the water and keep the rice aside. Soak the saffron and thandai powder separately in lukewarm milk. Step 3: Powder the Thandai Powder ingredients - Almonds, Cashew nuts, Pistachios, poppy seeds, cardamom, cinnamon and whole black peppercorns into a coarse powder and keep aside. The next step is to boil the milk. Step 4: When it comes to a boil, reduce the flame and add the rice in the saucepan. Keep stirring the kheer until it reduces to one-third of the original quantity. Step 5: Once done, add sugar, milk-made, cardamom powder, chopped nuts, thandai milk and saffron. Step 6: Mix everything well and cook the Thandai Kheer for more. After, turn off the flame and garnish it with chopped nuts and rose petals. Serve Thandai Flavored Rice Kheer as a dessert after your delicious meal of Dal Makhani, Sev Tamatar Ki Sabzi, Phulka and Palak Raita.

Ingredient Names: fine besan flour, ghee, powdered sugar, pistachios, ground cardamom, ground nutmeg, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Add ghee and besan to a medium sized heavy bottomed pan. Keeping the heat low, slow roast the besan flour, while stirring constantly with a spatula. Continue to stir evenly and break the lumps that will form initially. Step 2: After about 10 minutes, the flour will start to loosen up and become light and fluffy. Continue roasting for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the flour turns light golden brown. At this stage the ghee will start to separate, filling the kitchen with a delightful aroma. Step 3: Turn the heat off and take out the mixture into a bowl. This will avoid the besan from being overcooked. Allow it to cool for about 15 minutes or until it is luke warm to touch. Step 4: Add powdered sugar, cardamom, nutmeg, saffron and pistachios. Massage the mixture with the palm of your hands, and as you do so the ghee starts to release, allowing the mixture to bind together. Step 5: Grease the palm of your hands with a little bit of ghee so that the mixture does not stick to your hand. Take 2 to 3 tablespoons of mix at a time and start pressing and shaping to form round balls. Repeat with the remaining mix. Makes 8 ladoo. Step 6: Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place. The laddus will stay good at room temperature for 8 to 10 days. For longer shelf-life keep them in the refrigerator and remember to heat in the microwave for about 10 seconds before enjoying them.

Ingredient Names: potato, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, curry leaves, garlic, ginger, onions, turmeric powder, curry powder, chili powder, tomato paste, tomato, zucchini, fresh carrot, cauliflower, black pepper, salt, water, green peas, puff pastry, eggs, plain yogurt, coriander cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pot of water to the boil then cook potato for 12 - 15 minutes until very soft. Step 2: Drain, mash and set aside. Step 3: Sizzling spices: Heat oil in a dutch oven or pot over high heat. Add black mustard seeds, cumin and fennel seeds. Let them sizzle for 15 seconds - careful, they might pop! Step 4: Curry leaves: Then add curry leaves and stir for 15 seconds. Step 5: Aromatics: Add garlic, ginger and onion. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes until onion is tinged with gold. Step 6: Tomato: Add tomato paste and tomato, cook for 30 seconds. Step 7: Spices: Add curry powder, turmeric and chilli. Cook for 30 seconds. Step 8: Most Veg: Add zucchini, carrot and cauliflower. Stir well to coat in the spice paste. Step 9: Water: Add water, salt and pepper. Stir, bring to a simmer then put the lid on and reduce heat to medium low (so it's simmer gently). Step 10: Cook & reduce: Cook for 15 minutes until vegetables are soft. Then remove lid and simmer for 5 minutes to reduce liquid a bit. Step 11: Add mash: Remove from stove. Add peas and potato, mix through well. Step 12: Taste: Taste and add more salt and pepper if needed. Step 13: Cool: Place lid on and cool for at least 30 minutes (even overnight is fine). Step 14: Preheat oven to 180°C/350°F (all oven types). Step 15: Grease a large pie dish with butter, or oil spray. Drape in a puff pastry sheet. Step 16: Fill with Filling - slightly mounded is fine. Step 17: Fold in the corners of the puff pastry sheet. Step 18: Top with puff pastry sheet - turn 90 degrees to the base puff pastry sheet. Step 19: Fold the overhang puff pastry under itself - no need to be neat here, this is a rustic pie! Step 20: Egg wash: Brush with egg, cut a 2cm / 1" cross in the middle (to let steam escape). Step 21: Bake 50 to 60 minutes, until the top is very deep golden and flaky. Step 22: Stand 5 minutes then slice to serve. A dollop of plain yogurt goes well with this!

Dish Name: Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Streusel Cake
Ingredient Names: apricots, whole wheat flour, brown sugar, unsalted butter, cinnamon powder, sugar, pecans, cocoa powder, dark chocolate, coffee, eggs, vanilla extract, sour cream, baking powder, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Streusel Cake Recipe, first get all the ingredients ready for all the steps. To make the Streusel topping, combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Using your fingers make a coarse crumble of the mixture. Step 3: Refrigerate the crumble until we are ready to use it. To make the center layer of the Streusel, combine the sugar and nuts in a bowl and keep it aside. The next step is the make the cake. Step 4: Preheat the oven at 180 C. Step 5: Grease and line 9-inch round cake pan. In a double boiler, melt the chocolate. Step 6: Once the chocolate melts, add the espresso to the melted chocolate and stir well to combine until it looks creamy and smooth. Step 7: Keep the melted chocolate sauce aside. Sift in a bowl, flour, baking powder, baking soda and cocoa powder and keep aside. Beat together sugar, butter and sour cream using a hand mixer until just creamy. Step 8: Do not over beat it. Step 9: Add one egg and continue to beat until the eggs are fluffy. Step 10: Gradually beat in the vanilla essence and espresso chocolate mixture. Step 11: Finally gradually fold in the flour mixture and beat until the cake mixture is just about combined. Step 12: Don't overbeat at this stage. Pour 1/2 of the cake batter in into the cake pan. Step 13: Spread the nuts and sugar over this layer and finally top it with the remaining cake batter. Step 14: Finally sprinkle the refrigerated streusel topping evenly on the top and press it slightly. Place the cake in the preheated oven and bake for about 55 to, until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean. Step 15: Note: After, if you find the top over browning, just cover with aluminium foil to avoid burning. Once done, remove from the oven and allow the cake to cool. Step 16: Once cooled, the Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Cake is ready to be served.

Ingredient Names: potato aloo, ghee clarified butter, sugar, saffron food colour, cardamom powder, ghee, raisins, cashews, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pressure cooker take 5 potatoes and pressure cook for 5 whistles. Step 2: Peel the skin of the potato and grate. keep aside. Step 3: In a large kadai heat ½ cup ghee and add boiled and grated aloo. Step 4: Saute for 5 minutes or until the aloo changes colour slightly. Step 5: Now add 1 cup sugar and ¼ tsp saffron food colour. Step 6: Continuously stir keeping the flame on medium. sugar starts to melt. Step 7: Cook on medium flame until the ghee separates. it takes approximately 15 minutes for ghee to ooze out. Step 8: The halwa will start to hold shape releasing ghee. this is the perfect consistency we are looking for 5 minutes. Step 9: In a pan heat 1 tbsp ghee. add 2 tbsp raisins, 2 tbsp cashew and 2 tbsp almonds. Step 10: Roast on low flame until the nuts turn golden brown and crisp. Step 11: Transfer the roasted nuts over the halwa, add ¼ tsp cardamom powder and mix well. Step 12: Finally, enjoy aloo ka halwa topped with more dry fruits.

Ingredient Names: bread, milk, saffron kesar, sugar, dried figs, almonds, pistachios, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, trim the sides of the bread and cut into pieces. Step 2: In mixi, using pulse mode powder into breadcrumbs. keep aside. Step 3: In a large kadai take 1 litre of milk and ¼ tsp saffron. Step 4: Stir and get the milk to a boil. Step 5: Once the milk comes to a boil add ½ cup sugar and 4 anjeer. Step 6: Stir and boil making sure the sugar dissolves completely. Step 7: Further, add prepared breadcrumbs and mix well. Step 8: Continue to boil until the milk thickens. bread helps to thicken the milk and give a grainy texture like in malai kulfi. Step 9: Now add 2 tbsp almonds, 2 tbsp pistachios and ¼ tsp cardamom powder. Step 10: Mix well, pour the kulfi mixture into kulfi moulds. if you do not have moulds, you can pour until matka or glass cups. Step 11: Cover and freeze for 8 hours or until sets completely. Step 12: After 8 hours, the kulfi has set completely and is ready to serve. Step 13: Finally, garnish the bread kulfi with a few chopped almonds and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: oil, chili, chili flakes, onions, fresh carrot, beans, sweet corn, capsicum, cumin powder, coriander powder, aamchur, garam masala, salt, potato, paneer, fresh coriander, bread crumbs, all-purpose flour, corn flour, pepper powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tsp oil, 2 chilli and ½ tsp chilli flakes. saute slightly. Step 2: Now add ½ onion and saute until the onions sweat. Step 3: Further add 1 carrot, 5 beans, 3 tbsp sweet corn and ½ capsicum. Step 4: Saute for a minute without overcooking the vegetables. Step 5: Keeping the flame on low add ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp aamchur, ½ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp salt. Step 6: Saute for a minute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 7: Cool the vegetables and transfer them to a large bowl. Step 8: Add 3 potato, 2 tbsp paneer, 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 9: Now add ¼ cup bread crumbs and mix forming a soft dough. bread crumbs help to absorb the excess moisture present in vegetables. Step 10: Grease hands with oil and pinch a ball sized mixture. Step 11: Press and shape to an ice cream stick like of kebab. you can shape to your choice. Step 12: To prepare the slurry, in a large bowl take 1 cup maida, ½ cup corn flour, ¼ tsp pepper powder and ¼ tsp salt. Step 13: Mix well making sure there are no lumps. Step 14: Now dip the stick into the slurry and coat over bread crumbs. Step 15: Deep fry in hot oil keeping the flame on medium. Step 16: Flip over and fry uniformly, until the sticks turn golden brown and crispy. Step 17: Drain off over kitchen towel to remove excess oil. Step 18: Finally, enjoy crispy veg starter with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: ghee clarified butter, cashews, raisins, rava semolina suji, pineapple, sugar, water, yellow food colour, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 1 tbsp ghee and add 10 cashew, 2 tbsp raisins. Step 2: Roast on low flame until they turn golden brown. keep aside. Step 3: In the same ghee, add 1 cup rava and roast well. Step 4: Roast for at least 5 minutes or until it turns aromatic. keep aside. Step 5: In a large kadai heat 1 tsp ghee and add 1 cup pineapple, chopped. Step 6: Saute for 3 minutes or until it turns aromatic. Step 7: Now add ¼ cup sugar, 3 cup water and mix well. add more sugar if the pineapple is sour. Step 8: Cover and boil for 3 minutes or until the pineapple softens. Step 9: Add in roasted rava and stir continuously. Step 10: Stir until the rava absorbs all the water without forming any lumps. Step 11: Add ¾ cup sugar, 3 drops yellow food colour and mix until the sugar melts. Step 12: Further add ½ cup ghee and mix until the ghee is well absorbed. Step 13: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until everything is well cooked. Step 14: Now add roasted cashew, raisins and ¼ tsp cardamom powder. mix well. Step 15: Finally, enjoy pineapple sheera or pineapple kesari bath garnished with nuts.

Ingredient Names: ghee, rava semolina suji, milk, sugar, cardamom powder, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat ¼ cup ghee. Step 2: Add 1 cup rava and roast on low flame until the rava turns aromatic. make sure to take fine rava, else the texture of modak will be different. Step 3: Now add 2 cup milk and stir until the milk is absorbed well making sure there are no lumps. Step 4: Further, add ¾ cup sugar and stir until the sugar melts. Step 5: Cook until the mixture starts to hold the shape. Step 6: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes, or until the rava is cooked well. Step 7: Now add ¼ tsp cardamom powder and 1 tsp ghee. mix well. Step 8: Transfer the mixture to a large plate and cool slightly. knead the dough forming a smooth and soft dough. Step 9: To prepare modak without mould, pinch a ball sized rava mixture and flatten slightly. Step 10: Place 2 raisins in the centre and seal tight. Step 11: Form a cylindrical shape and then shape to modak by pressing down gently. Step 12: Using a toothpick, design the modak. Step 13: You can also prepare modak using the moulds. to prevent it from sticking, make sure to grease the mould with ghee. Step 14: Stuff with dry fruits and shape the suji modak. Step 15: Finally, garnish with saffron and enjoy rava modak for ganesh chaturthi.

Dish Name: Aaloo Mattar Indian Style Peas And Potatoes
Ingredient Names: peas, potato, tomatoes, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, green chilies, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, vegetable oil, water, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic, onions, chillies and tomatoes. Step 3: Saute till the tomatoes and onions are softened. Step 4: Add the turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and garam masala, add salt to taste. Step 5: Add the boiled peas and potatoes. Step 6: Add the chopped cilantro. Step 7: Add the water and bring to a simmer. Step 8: Serve with indian bread or rice.

Dish Name: Aarsis Ultimate Strawberry And Rose Lassi
Ingredient Names: strawberries, plain low-fat yogurt, rose water, whole milk, granulated sugar, ice, rose petal
Instructions: Step 1: Blend together the ice, strawberries, yogurt, milk, sugar and the rose water blend everything to a smooth mixture. Step 2: Pour the prepared lassi into the glasses and garnish with rose petals Enjoy with your loved ones!

Ingredient Names: cod, tomatoes, lemon juice, onions, fennel seed, red chilies, coriander seeds, onion seeds, fenugreek seeds, turmeric powder, mustard seeds, red chili powder, green chilies, garlic paste, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the fish well in salt water Apply the lemon juice to the fish and set aside for approximately 1 hour. Step 2: Fry the onions till they are light golden in color. Step 3: Remove with a slotted spoon and crush In the same oil put the red chillies, onion seeds, turmeric powder, red chilly powder and garlic. Step 4: Stir and fry for a few minutes till the oil separates. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and again stir and cook till the oil separates. Step 6: Add the fish Coarsely grind together the aniseed, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds and mustard seeds. Step 7: Add this to the fish along with the green chillies and cook over a low heat till the fish is done, about 10 minute min.

Ingredient Names: ghee, cinnamon, fresh ground black pepper, cardamom, ground ginger, honey, almond milk
Instructions: Step 1: Melt ghee in a pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add ginger, cinnamon and black pepper. Step 3: Simmer until aromatic, about a minute -- more or less. Step 4: Add almond milk and honey Continue to stir just until the mixture comes to a boil Immediately remove from heat and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: eggs, onion, tomatoes, ginger-garlic paste, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dice onion finely Dice tomato into small pieces. Step 2: Fry onion in oil until it brown. Step 3: Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and fry for about 30 seconds, add eggs and salt. Step 4: Turn down heat to low Scramble the eggs by stirring until desired consistency is achieved Enjoy while hot!

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, salt, ground black pepper, ghee, spring onions, red chilies, fresh ginger, ground turmeric, fresh coriander leaves, tomatoes, ground cumin, chopped tomato, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs until well mixed. Step 2: Add the milk, salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat ghee or butter in a large, heavy frying pan and cook the onions, chilies and ginger until soft. Step 4: Add turmeric, coriander leaves and tomato, if used, and fry for a minute or two longer, then stir in the egg mixture and the ground cumin. Step 5: Cook over low heat, stirring and lifting the eggs as they begin to set on the base of the pan. Step 6: Mix and cook until the eggs are of a creamy consistency-they should not be cooked until dry. Step 7: Turn on to a serving plate and garnish with tomato and coriander. Step 8: Serve with chapatis, parathas or toasted bread I squeeze some lime too and scramble it some more until it resembles crumbs for a filling for a chappati or to be had with a loaf of fresh soft / hard bread.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, mixed vegetables, curd, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, cardamom pods, black cardamom, whole black peppercorns, cloves, asafoetida, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilies, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, mustard oil, ghee, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Allahabadi Tehri Recipe (UP Style Vegetable Rice), wash and soak the basmati rice for in water. Cut all the vegetables, namely potatoes, beans, cauliflower and carrots to similar size and keep aside. Heat mustard oil in a wide pan, and let it smoke. Add the asafoetida, whole garam masalas - cinnamon, bay leaf, green and black cardamoms, pepper corns and cloves and let the oil become fragrant. Now, add the sliced onions and saute until translucent. Now, roughly pound the ginger garlic using a mortar and pestle and add it to the pan, and saute until the raw smell goes away. Add the green chillies, turmeric, red chilli, cumin and coriander powder and saute for a minute. Add the cut vegetables and mix well till they turn a bit golden. Now, add the whisked yoghurt and saute until the mixute comes together. Add in the drained rice, water, season with salt and cover it with a lid to cook for untouched. Once its cooked, add in the ghee, lemon juice, gently mix everything together and switch off the flame. Serve the Allahabadi Tehri Recipe (UP Style Vegetable Rice) along with Mirchi Ka Salan and Burani Raita for the weeknight dinner.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, potatoes, tomatoes, ginger paste, garlic, cumin seed, turmeric powder, red chili powder, ground coriander, garam masala, salt, coriander leaves, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium pot with a lid, heat 1 tbsp oil. Step 2: Add the cubed potatoes and sautee over low-med heat for 8-10 minutes until they are lighly crisped and colored on the outside. Step 3: Remove and set aside. Step 4: Add another 1 / 2 tbsp oil, heat, then add the chopped eggplants. Step 5: Saute for 7-8 minutes, then remove and set aside. Step 6: Add another 1 / 2 tbsp oil to the same pan and heat. Step 7: When hot, add the cumin seeds and let them turn slightly brown. Step 8: Then add the ginger paste, garlic, turmeric, chili powder, coriander and 3 tbsp water, stir to combine. Step 9: Add the chopped tomatoes and saute for 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, ginger, ground coriander, minced beef, raisins, salt, coriander, potato, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan, add the onion and ginger and fry until golden. Step 2: Add the ground coriander and beef and fry until brown. Step 3: Add the raisins and salt to taste and simmer for about 20 minutes, until the meat is cooked. Step 4: Spoon out any fat in the pan. Step 5: Stir in the chopped coriander and leave to cool. Step 6: Divide the mashed potato into 8 portions With well floured hands, flatten a portion on one palm, put 3 teaspoons of the meat mixture in the centre and fold the potato over it Form gently into a round patty shape. Step 7: Dip the 'chops' lightly in flour and shallow fry a few at a time in hot oil, until crisp and golden, turning carefully to brown the underside.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, cumin seed, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, hot green chili pepper, turmeric, garam masala, ground coriander, salt, white pepper, fenugreek seeds, ground cumin, baking potatoes, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over high heat in a large wok, karahi, or deep nonstick pan. Step 2: Add onions and cumin seeds, and cook until onion are translucent. Step 3: Add minced garlic, minced ginger and chili pepper. Step 4: Saute for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Add all remaining spices including salt. Step 6: Stir well Immediately add potatoes and stir until coated in oil and spices. Step 7: Turn heat down to medium and saute for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add stock, then put lid on pan, lower heat to medium-low and simmer for about 15 minutes. Step 9: Add the cauliflower florets, grated ginger and lemon juice.

Dish Name: Aloo Ka Raita Potatoes In Yogurt
Ingredient Names: curds, potatoes, mint leaves, green chili, ground cumin, black pepper, chaat masala, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add the salt, pepper powder, chaat masala to the yoghurt and mix well. Step 2: Taste and adjust seasoning. Step 3: Add the potatoes, green chili and mint leaves, mix well. Step 4: Transfer to a serving bowl. Step 5: Garnish with roasted cumin powder. Step 6: Refrigerate until required.

Dish Name: Aloo Matar Ki Sabzi Potato N Peas Curry
Ingredient Names: potatoes, green peas, green chilies, onions, garlic, ginger, garlic clove, gingerroot, tomatoes, oil, cumin seeds, bay leaves, turmeric, salt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add the cumin seeds and the bay leaves. Step 2: When the seeds begin to splutter, add the onion paste and saute till fat separates. Step 3: Add the tomatoes or puree, turmeric, salt, garam masala, red pepper and the coriander powder, and stir-fry till fat separates. Step 4: Add the peas, potatoes and the green chillies and saut? Step 5: Ver high heat till the vegetables look glossy Add 2 cups of water Bring to a boil and simmer, for 10-15 minutes Serve hot, garnished with the coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: rice, green peas, potatoes, onion, ginger garlic paste, green chilies, black cardamom, bay leaf, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, cloves, cumin seeds, coriander powder, cumin powder, black pepper powder, red chili powder, ghee, coriander leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Aloo Matar Masala Khichdi Recipe, wash the rice and keep it soaked in water till you add it into the recipe. Wash, de-skin, cut the potatoes into big cubes and keep it immersed in a bowl of water until further cooking. Heat ghee in a pressure pan, add the whole spices - bay leaf, black and green cardamoms, cinnamon, cloves and let it release its flavours into the ghee. Add the cumin seeds and let it splutter. Add the sliced onions, green chilies and saute until the onions turns translucent. Drain the potatoes from water and add it to the pressure pan along with peas and saute for a minute. Add the coriander powder, cumin pepper and red chilli powder and mix well. Add the drained and soaked rice, about water, season with salt and bring it to a rolling boil. Close it with the pressure pan lid and cook for 4 to 5 whistles, or till done. Switch off the heat, let the pressure release on its own before opening the lid. Garnish with coriander leaves use a fork to carefully mix the khichdi. Serve the Aloo Matar Masala Khichdi Recipe along with Cauliflower & Cucumber Raita Recipe and Papad for a simple yet delightful weeknight dinner.

Ingredient Names: poppy seeds, oil, red chilies, turmeric powder, green chilies, potatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Dry roast the poppy seeds on a tava for 3 to 4 minutes 2 Grind coarsely in a mixer and keep aside 3. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan, add the red chillies, turmeric powder, ground poppy seeds and green chillies and saut for 1 minute 4. Step 3: Add the potatoes and salt and toss well 5, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, cauliflower, red onion, oil, mustard seeds, cumin seed, garlic, ginger, coriander powder, red chili powder, salt, garam masala, mango powder, green coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel the potatoes. Step 2: Cut into long half inch thick pieces Microwave for 6 to 8 minutes, covered, for faster cooking. Step 3: Heat the oil in a wide skillet on high heat. Step 4: Add mustard seeds and cover As soon as the seeds start popping, reduce the heat and add cumin seeds As they change color, add garlic. Step 5: Add the half cooked potatoes, cauliflower pieces, and remaining seasonings. Step 6: Cook covered until ready. Step 7: Stir and sprinkle water if needed.

Dish Name: Ambul Polos Curry - Sri Lankan Jack Fruit Curry With Pol Sambol
Ingredient Names: fresh coconut, dry red chilies, pearl onions, lemon, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, whole black peppercorns, mustard seeds, cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, fennel seeds, sunflower oil, garlic, ginger, onions, curry leaves, jackfruit, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Ambul Polos Curry - Sri Lankan Jack Fruit Curry Recipe, prepare the jackfruit by peeling cutting and keep aside. To make the Pol Sambol, add all the ingredients for pol sambol into a mixer grinder and make a coarse paste of it and keep aside. Step 2: The next step is to make the Sri Lankan Spice powder. Step 3: Place a pan on medium heat, add all the spices and roast for a couple of minutes until the aromas come through. Once done, place the spices in a mixer grinder and blend to make a smooth powder. Now into a pressure cooker, heat oil over medium heat; add the ginger, garlic and onions and saute until the onions caramelize or turn lightly brown. Step 4: Once done, stir in the curry leaves, the spice powder, the pol sambol, the jackfruit, salt and 2-1/water. Step 5: Pressure cook the Ambul Polos Curry for 4 to 5 whistles and turn off the heat,Allow the pressure to release naturally. Once the pressure has realeased, open the cooker and give the Ambul Polos Curry a taste. Step 6: Adjust the salt and seasonings according to your taste. Once done, transfer the Ambul Polos Curry-Sri Lankan Jack Fruit Curry to a serving bowl and serve hot. Serve the Ambul Polos Curry - Sri Lankan Jack Fruit Curry along with Steamed Rice and Carrot Poriyal Recipe by the side for a wholesome meal.

Ingredient Names: seeraga samba rice, ghee, bay leaf, star anise, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, cloves, chicken, sunflower oil, ginger, garlic, onions, tomatoes, red chili powder, salt, coriander powder, curd, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Ambur Star Chicken Biryani, thoroughly wash and clean the chicken and set aside. Step 2: Soak the Seeraga samba rice, for a minimum of. In an open pan, add ghee, bay leaf, star anise, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom. Step 3: To this add water and bring to a single boil. Step 4: Add the washed and drained rice and cook until the rice is about 70% cooked. Step 5: (The rice grain should be undercooked in the center) Set aside. In a deep kadai, on medium flame, heat oil, add the sliced onions and cook till transparent for about 5 minutes. At this stage mix in the ginger paste, garlic paste and salt. Step 6: Saute for a couple of minutes. Mix in the chopped tomatoes and cook until they are soft. Step 7: At this stage add in the red chilli powder and coriander seeds powder. Once the onion-tomato mixture comes together, slightly tilt the kadai, and remove the excess oil, spoon by spoon into a small cup/katori. Now that the excess oil has been drained out, add the yogurt/curd and chicken and mix well. Step 8: Allow the chicken to cook until almost done to about 80%. Step 9: Mix in the mint leavesTo assemble to biryani, while the chicken continues to be in the kadai, add the 70% cooked seeraga samba rice on top of the chicken pieces and pour the excess flavoured oil over the rice and cover the kadai with a plate. Step 10: Turn the flame to the lowest heat possible. Step 11: In a saucepan, boil water and turn off the flame and place this hot pan on the lid of the kadai. Step 12: This process is done in order to seal the kadai in which the biryani is cooking. Step 13: The heat from the hot water in the saucepan provides heat from the top, while there is heat from the bottom as well creating the effect of "Dum". Step 14: Let the biryani sit on this "Dum" for a good. Step 15: After open the lid and lightly fluff up the biryani with a fork and serve piping hot. Serve the Ambur Star Chicken Biryani along with Tadka Raita Recipe (Spiced Curd With Onions) and Chettinad Kathirikai Chops Recipe for Sunday Lunch.

Ingredient Names: fish, carom seeds, gram flour, kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, salt, sunflower oil, curd, water, cinnamon stick, green chilies, fresh red chilies, cashew nuts, tomato puree, onion, coriander leaves, ghee
