Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Amritsari Fish Gravy Recipe, first clean and wash the pieces of fish, rub salt keep for aside for five minutes. In a mixing bowl, add ginger and garlic paste, lime juice, carom seeds, gram flour, red chilli powder and turmeric powder. Step 2: Mix well and add the fish pieces in this paste. Step 3: Marinate the fish pieces in the mixture for at least 2 minutes. Step 4: Place a skillet on medium heat and add some oil on top. Step 5: Place the pieces of marinated fish on to the skillet and cook till crispy red. Step 6: Turn the pieces of fish until they are cooked. Step 7: *To make the gravySoak cashews in water, once soft grind it to a paste with little water. Step 8: In a large mixing bowl, add the beaten curd, cashew paste, tomato paste, chilli powder, turmeric powder and water. Step 9: Place a heavy bottomed pan on low flame and add some ghee and add carom seeds. Step 10: Fry for a minute and add in the chopped onions. Step 11: Saute until translucent. Step 12: Add ginger paste and fry for a few more minutes until the raw smell goes away. Step 13: Pour the mixture of curd and cashew paste along with chopped green chillies and red chillies. Step 14: Add salt according to your tasteAdd the fish pieces on serving dish and the gravy on sides. Step 15: Garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve Amritsari Fish Gravy Recipe along with Whole Wheat Onion Stuffed Kulcha Recipe or Jeera Rice Or Steamed Rice for a delicious Sunday Meal.

Ingredient Names: mutton, turmeric powder, red chili powder, salt, dry coconut, onion, water, ginger garlic paste, coriander powder, garam masala powder, tomato, sunflower oil, dried fenugreek, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Andhra Style Mutton Curry recipe, marinate the mutton with ingredients listed under ‘For marinating’ and keep aside for 2 hours. Step 2: Later pressure cook the marinated mixture for 6 whistles. Step 3: Meanwhile grind all the ingredients given under ‘For grinding’ and keep it aside. Step 4: Add oil in a heavy bottomed pan, add onions to it and cook till the onion turns brown. Add ginger garlic paste and let it cook till the raw smell goes off. Next, add the ground mixture to it and let it fry till the mixture starts to turn golden brown. Step 5: Now, add mutton with its juices and let it cook for at least for 5 minutes. Step 6: After, add tomatoes, red chilli powder, garam masala powder, coriander powder, salt and let it simmer for another 15-20 minutes. Next add the required water and cover it for 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Add kasuri methi, coriander leaves and give the curry a stir. Step 8: Your Andhra Style Mutton Curry is ready to be served. Serve Andhra Style Mutton Curry along with Steamed Rice or Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha for a weekday dinner.

Dish Name: Andhra Style Vegetarian Biryani with Soya Chunks
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, soy chunks, onions, tomatoes, green chili, ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, sunflower oil, bay leaf, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick, star anise, mace, whole black peppercorns, fennel seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Andhra Style Vegetarian Biryani, soak the soy chunks in water and keep it aside. Soak the basmati rice also in water and keep it aside. Step 2: Ground all the spice mix mentioned in the biryani spice mix to a coarse powder. Heat a pressure cooker with oil. Step 3: Add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves, star anise and mace. Step 4: Fry the spice for 10 seconds until the aroma is released. Add the chopped onions, ginger garlic paste and green chili. Step 5: Sauté until the onions become light brown. Add the chopped tomatoes and little bit of salt so that the tomatoes will get cooked faster and become mushy. Add the powdered spice mix, turmeric powder and give it a mix. Wash the soaked rice several times and add only the rice into the sautéed gravy. Step 6: Add the soaked soya chunks as well. Step 7: Mix well till the masala is mixed. Add water, check for salt and pressure cook for 2 whistle and switch off the heat. Step 8: Allow the pressure to release by itself and open the lid and mix the rice well with the masala and serve. Serve the Andhra Style Vegetarian Biryani with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita and Mirchi Ka Salan Recipe by the side.

Ingredient Names: raisins, saffron strand, rose water, apples, sugar, cardamom powder, ground nutmeg, butter, sliced almonds, cashews, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Grate the apples and keep aside 2. Step 2: Heat the butter in a non-stick pan and add the apple and saute on a slow flame until brown in colour 3. Step 3: Add the sugar, saffron, rose water, cardamam powder, javintri powder and mix well 4 Lastly add raisins and mix well 5. Step 4: Serve hot garnished with cashewnut, almonds, pistachionut.

Ingredient Names: rice, sunflower oil, onion, tomato, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, carrots, green peas, green bell pepper, potato, cardamom pods, cloves, garam masala powder, star anise, cinnamon stick, coriander leaves, mint leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Aromatic Vegetable Pulao recipe, wash and soak rice for at least 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain the water and keep it aside. Heat oil in a sauce pan and add onions, whole spices and cook until the onion turns golden brown. Meanwhile add water in a different saucepan and bring it to rolling boil. Add ginger garlic paste and tomatoes with the onions and whole spices. Step 3: Let it cook until the tomatoes are soft and mushy. Once the tomatoes are soft, add all the remaining spices and veggies and cook for a minute. Step 4: After a minute, add the hot water to the veggies. Add the soaked rice into the pan and cover it with a lid. Step 5: Let it cook till the rice is 3/4 cooked and the turn the flame to low heat. Cook it for few more minutes till the rice is almost done and it is ready to be served. Serve Aromatic Vegetable Pulao along with Burani Raita, Raw Mango Raita or any other raita of your choice.

Ingredient Names: aubergines, oil, sesame seeds, garlic, onions, dried red chilies, salt, white wine vinegar, brown sugar, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the sesame seeds until they start to pop. Step 2: Add the garlic and onions and fry for five minutes. Step 3: Add the aubergines and fry for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the vinegar and chillies and cook for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add the sugar and paprika and cook till the chutney is thick Bottle in clean, dry and warm bottles.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, meat, green beans, okra, crushed tomatoes, almond milk, mild curry powder, curry powder, cilantro, ground mace, chili powder, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up your oil using a large saucepan or wok. Step 2: Add your onions and garlic, cooking them until the onions are translucent and the garlic is slightly brown. Step 3: Add your meat, cooking it evenly The time it takes varies depending what meat you use. Step 4: Once your meat appears cooked, add the green beans and okra, stirring them into your onion / garlic / meat mix cook them until your vegetables are slightly browned. Step 5: Stir in the crushed tomatoes and almond / soy milk. Step 6: Bring it to a boil. Step 7: Stir in your remaining spices. Step 8: Reduce heat to simmer, cover for 30 minutes. Step 9: Remove from heat and let it stand for 5 minutes to cool.

Ingredient Names: water, black peppercorns, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, cloves, fresh ginger, milk, black tea, unbleached cane sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Start to heat the water to boiling In the meantime, cut each peppercorn in half with a knife and crack open each cardamom pod by biting it or smashing it. Step 2: Put all spices and ginger in the pan. Step 3: Boil about 5 minutes or until the water is light brown colored from the spices. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 cup of the milk and the tea. Step 5: Then stir in the sugar making sure it melts. Step 6: Add the rest of the milk and heat to almost boiling for a couple more minutes Depending on your taste, you can add more or less milk or sugar to the recipe. Step 7: Strain the mixture into glasses and taste authentic chai from the himalayas!

Ingredient Names: chicken tenders, olive oil, cinnamon sticks, cumin seeds, cloves, yellow onion, roma tomatoes, tomato sauce, green chilies, gingerroot, garlic cloves, salt, fresh cilantro, coriander powder, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat oil and cinnamon sticks, cumin seeds, cloves for 1 minute, before they began to get dark add onions Sautee' onions for 1 minute on medium high heat, add chicken tender cubes. Step 2: Cook that stirring occasionally for 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Add rest of the ingredients. Step 4: Stir and simmer on medium-low for 15 minutes. Step 5: Then serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: ground cardamom, ground ginger, cinnamon, ground cloves, ground nutmeg, condensed milk, strong black tea
Instructions: Step 1: Pour condensed milk and spices into the blender and blend on high speed for a few seconds until the milk looks evenly "flecked" with spices. Step 2: Pour mixture into a clean jar or container with a lid. Step 3: Refrigerate at least 24 hours Alternatively, pour mix into ice cube trays and freeze To use concentrate: brew a strong black tea or strong herbal tea of your choice. Step 4: Stir in 1 frozen concentrate cube or 1 / 2 to 2 teaspoons of chai concentrate mix per cup of freshly steeped tea Frozen cubes will keep up to one year in the freezer if you pop them out of the trays and store in a freezer bag Concentrate will keep in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.

Ingredient Names: oil, boneless pork chops, onion, garlic, cooking apple, red bell pepper, chicken stock, cornstarch, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, salt and pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saute pan, heat oil to med-high. Step 2: Cook pork chops until browned on both sides, and almost cooked through, remove from pan. Step 3: Set aside Over med heat, cook onion, garlic, apple, and red pepper strips for 2 minutes, or until softened. Step 4: Blend chicken stock with cornstarch. Step 5: Add to pan along with curry powder, cumin and cinnamon. Step 6: Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Step 7: Return pork chops to frypan Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: almonds, milk, ghee, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the almonds, wash and grind to fine paste. Step 2: Heat ghee in a heavy pan. Step 3: Add paste and cook on first high then slow flame, stirring continuosly. Step 4: After a while it should turn a light brown and aromatic Carefully pour hot milk and stir Use a long-handled spatula as the mixture tends to splatter. Step 5: When thickens, add the sugar and cook, stirring continously and gently till ghee begins to separate. Step 6: Decorate with chopped nuts and serve hot Enjoy this yummy indian sweet!

Ingredient Names: almonds, cashews, pistachios, pods cardamom, sugar, milk powder, turmeric, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: First, in a heavy-bottomed pan dry roast ½ cup badam, 6 cashew, 3 tsp pistachios and 3 pods cardamom. Step 2: Dry roast on low flame until the nuts turn crunchy. Step 3: Cool completely, pulse, and grind to a coarse powder. Step 4: Now add 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp milk powder, ½ tsp turmeric, and ½ tsp kesar. Step 5: Grind to fine powder. make sure to pulse and grind to prevent nuts from releasing oil. Step 6: Transfer to an airtight container and store Instant Badam Mix for up to 3 months. You can also top with chopped nuts to get crunchy bites in the milk. Step 7: To prepare badam milk from the badam mix, in a saucepan heat 2 cup of milk. Step 8: Stir and get the milk to a boil. Step 9: Once the milk comes to a boil, add 2 tbsp prepared badam mix. Step 10: Stir well making sure everything is well combined. Step 11: Boil for 2 minutes, or until the milk thickens slightly. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Instnat Badam Milk or you can refrigerate and enjoy it chilled.

Dish Name: Baked Chicken With Mushrooms And Lots Of Almonds
Ingredient Names: cremini mushroom, butter, flour, chicken stock, egg yolk, milk, nutmeg, dark soy sauce, cooked chicken, water, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Saut three quarters of a cup of sliced brown mushrooms, get a slight color change and remove them from the pan Then, make a roux What's a roux? Step 2: One tablespoon of butter, one heaping tablespoon of flour cooked about three minutes but not browned. Step 3: Add a half cup of chicken broth and a couple tablespoons of milk or light cream Break an egg, you just need the yoke. Step 4: Put it in a little bowl, add a teaspoon or so of the hot liquid and mix This is called tempering, and it pre heats the egg so when you add it back to the sauce you don't get scrambled eggs This works every time you have to add eggs to something hot. Step 5: Whisk it back in to the sauce. Step 6: Add a good grate of nutmeg.

Ingredient Names: pearl onions, green bell pepper, carrots, green peas, green beans, potato, drumstick, tomatoes, tamarind water, jaggery, salt, barnyard millet, toor dal, turmeric powder, ghee, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dry red chili, curry leaves, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Barnyard Millet Bisi Bele Bath Recipe, in a large pressure cooker, we will add the tamarind water, jaggery, the drumsticks, pearl onions, beans, carrots, bell peppers, tomatoes, salt and finally the Bisi Bele Bath Spice Powder. Stir all the ingredients well. Step 2: Cover the pressure cooker, place the weight and allow the vegetables to cook until you hear at least 2 whistles and turn off the heat. Since the vegetables cook very quickly, we will release the pressure by running cold water over the pressure cooker. Step 3: This process helps to bring the pressure down immediately. Step 4: Open the pressure cooker and keep the vegetable curry aside. The next step is to cook the barnyard millet and the dal. Step 5: To the pressure cooker add in the barnyard millet, the toor dal, the turmeric powder, salt and water. Step 6: Cover the cooker and place the weight on the pressure cooker. Step 7: Turn the heat to high and allow the rice to cook until you hear two whistles. After you hear the whistles, turn the heat to low and simmer for five minutes. Step 8: After have passed, turn off the heat and allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 9: The millets and the rice continue to cook in this resting period, hence wait for the pressure to release completely. While we are waiting for the pressure to release, Lets proceed to make the seasoning. Heat a small pan on medium heat. Step 10: Add in a tablespoon of ghee and allow it to melt. Step 11: Add in the mustard seeds, the cumin seeds. Step 12: Allow it to crackle. Step 13: Then add in the red chilli, curry leaves and roast them until the red chillies are browned lightly. Step 14: Stir to roast the ingredients well. Step 15: Once roasted keep this aside. Once the pressure is released, add in the spicy vegetable tamarind curry. Step 16: Stir all the ingredients together until well combined and the mixture looks like a mish mash. Step 17: At this stage add in the prepared seasoning and two more tablespoons of ghee. Step 18: Once again give the mixture a good stir. Step 19: Check the salt and adjust to suit your taste. Transfer the Barnyard Millet Bisi Bele Bath to a serving bowl. Step 20: Sprinkle the chopped coriander leaves and the fried boondi on top. Serve the delicious Barnyard Millet Bisi Bele Bath from southern india along with a tomato onion raita for lunch or dinner.

Ingredient Names: cinnamon, bay leaves, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, green cardamom seeds, black peppercorns, cloves, ground mace
Instructions: Step 1: Break the cinnamon sticks into pieces Crumble the bay leaves. Step 2: Heat a heavy frying pan and after 2-3 minutes put in the whole spices Dry roast over a medium heat until the color darkens, stirring or shaking the pan frequently to prevent burning. Step 3: Leave to cool, then grind and blend with the mace In an airtight container, the mixture will keep for 3-4 months To make a mild and subtle moghul masala, use only green cardamoms, cinnamon, black peppercorns, mace and a few cloves For a hot gujerati masala, add sesame seeds, fennel seeds, ajowan seeds and chiles For a mildish kashmiri masala, use black cumin seeds, green cardamoms, black peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon, mace, and add a little grated nutmeg For a hot parsi dhansak masala, add fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, chiles and ground turmeric, and double the amount of coriander seeds.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, salt, kashmiri chili powder, gingerroot, butter, garlic paste, ginger paste, dried fenugreek leaves, sugar, garam masala powder, fresh cream
Instructions: Step 1: Quarter the tomatoes. Step 2: Put them in a pressure cooker along with salt, half of the kashmiri red chilli powder, ginger and two cups of water Pressure cook till two whistles. Step 3: Remove and set aside to cool. Step 4: Blend the mixture in a blender and strain. Step 5: Heat butter in a pan, add garlic paste, ginger paste and two tablespoons of water, cook for a minute. Step 6: Add the pureed tomatoes and cook for two to three minutes Dry roast the kasuri methi in a microwave or on a tawa Crush.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, salt, unsalted butter, water
Instructions: Step 1: Pick the rice over and put in a bowl. Step 2: Wash in several changes of water, drain. Step 3: Pour 3 times the water you have rice over the rice and let soak for 30 minutes hour, drain thoroughly. Step 4: Combine the rice, salt, butter and the water in a pot, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover with a tight fitting lid, turn heat to very low and cook for 20 minutes Lift the lid, mix gently but quickly with a fork and cover again. Step 6: Cook for 5-10 minutes until tender.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic cloves, green chilies, ginger, chuck steaks, chili powder, turmeric, pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, coconut milk, warm water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the onions and fry until they are just beginning to brown, then add the garlic, chillies and ginger. Step 2: Fry for 1 minute, then add the beef and remaining spices Sitr well and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add the coconut milk, which should just cover the meat If it does not, add a little water, add salt to taste. Step 4: Bring to a simmering point, cover and cook for about 1 1 / 2 hours, until the meat is almost tender. Step 5: Add the vingear and continue cooking for about 30 minutes, until the meat is tender and the gravy thick.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic cloves, chili powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, ginger, stewing beef, tomato puree, salt, potatoes, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heal the oil in a large pan and add the onions, frying until lightly coloured. Step 2: Add the garlic, chilli powder, cumin, coriander and ginger and cook gently for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally If the mixture becomes dry, add 2 tablespoons of water. Step 3: Add the beef and cook, stirring, until browned all over. Step 4: Add the tomato puree, salt to taste and just enough water to cover the meat, stir very well. Step 5: Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until the meat is almost tender. Step 6: Add the potatoes and whole chillies and simmer until the potatoes are cooked.

Ingredient Names: beef mince, soya sauce, lime juice, salt, gingerroot, garlic, cumin seed, coriander seed, cayenne powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, onions, mint leaves, cilantro, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all upto the egg ingredients well Form into 16-18 cutlets that are of a diameter of around 2 inches when flattened or make them 3 inches across so get around 11-12 Coat with the bread crumbs or semolina. Step 2: Heat a little oil in a pan to a medium high and shallow fry on low for around 5-6 minutes on each side or till they are cooked to the level you like. Step 3: Add a little more oil if you require I normally use non-stick pans and so need a minimum of oil.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground beef, ground coriander, ground cumin, black pepper, turmeric, ground cinnamon, salt, potato, plain yogurt, whole milk, peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large deep frying pan, heat the oil over moderate heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute longer. Step 4: Add the beef and cook until no longer pink, about 3 minutes, drain off any fat. Step 5: Add the coriander, cumin, pepper, turmeric, cinnamon and 1 teaspoon of the salt to the pan. Step 6: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 7: Stir in the potatoes, yogurt and milk. Step 8: Bring just to a boil, cover the pan.

Ingredient Names: fenugreek seeds, onion seeds, salt, garam masala, turmeric powder, curry powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, chili powder, paprika, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, jalapeno peppers, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the fenugreek and onion seeds first by heating and tossing in a saut pan for several minutes Grind them together using a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Step 2: In a food processor, blend fenugreek and onion seeds with the salt, garam masala, turmeric, curry powder, coriander powder, cumin, chili powder, paprika, garlic, vegetable oil, ginger, jalapeos, cilantro and lemon juice until all the ingredients become a smooth paste. Step 3: Spoon the mixture into a large mixing bowl and stir in the yogurt. Step 4: Marinate meat or fish for eight hours Tofu, vegetables or paneer can be tossed into the marinade just before grilling Use the marinade to baste over the grill.

Dish Name: Bengali Aloo Dum - Bengali Aloo Dum
Ingredient Names: small potatoes, turmeric powder, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaf, tomato puree, garam masala powder, yogurt, red chili powder, coriander powder, sugar, salt, oil, coriander leaves, onion, ginger, garlic, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: To make Bengali Aloo Dum recipe, first of all, add onion, ginger, green chilli, garlic and make a paste in a blender, keep it aside. Step 2: Now heat oil in a pan. Step 3: Now add boiled potatoes, turmeric powder, salt and cook till golden brown. Step 4: Now put in a bowl and keep it aside. Step 5: Heat a little more oil in the same oil. Step 6: Add onion, ginger, garlic paste and cook the paste for 5 minutes. Step 7: Now add cinnamon, long, bay leaves and cook for 2 to. Step 8: Add tomato puree, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and cook for 5 minutes. Step 9: Now add curd to it and mix it. Step 10: After add potatoes, sugar, salt, mix and cover the pan. Step 11: Let it cook on low heat for 2 minutes. Step 12: Keep mixing in the bitches so that the spices do not stick down. Step 13: Turn off the gas after, garnish with green coriander and serve. Step 14: Serve Bengali Aloo Dum Recipe along with Bengali Luchis, Cholar Dal and Gourd Raita for dinner.

Dish Name: Bengali Aloo Potol er Dalna - A Traditional Vegetable Side Dish
Ingredient Names: pointed gourd, potatoes, turmeric powder, bay leaves, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, ginger, tomato, coriander powder, garam masala powder, kashmiri red chili powder, dry red chili, asafoetida, sugar, salt, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Bengali Aloo Potol er Dalna Recipe, first prep all the ingredients, get them together and keep ready. We will cook the dish directly in a pressure cooker. Step 2: In the traditional method, you would cook both the aloo and potol separately and then make the masala and add to it. Step 3: The following method, is a healthy way of cooking the recipe and uses much less oil. Heat a teaspoon of oil in the pressure cooker. Step 4: Add the cumin seeds, dry red chilies, the cinnamon, cloves, cardamom and saute till the aromas are released. Step 5: Add the chopped tomatoes and saute till the tomatoes soften. Once the tomatoes soften, add the turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt the chopped vegetables and stir. Step 6: Add 1-1/2 of water, cover the pressure cooker and allow it to cook until you hear three to four whistles. After three to four whistles, turn the heat to low and allow it to simmer for about 15-20 minutes and turn off the heat. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 7: Once the pressure is released, open the pressure cooker the the Aloo Potol er Dalna should be done. Step 8: If the gravy is too watery, simmer and allow the water to evaporate and let the gravy thicken. Step 9: Once done, check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste. Step 10: Turn off the heat and transfer to a serving bowl. Step 11: Serve the Aloo Potol er Dalna as a side dish along with Bengali Chirer Polao Recipe, Phulka and a Bengali Cholar Dal.

Dish Name: Better Chai From A Chai Tea Bag
Ingredient Names: tea bag, water, nonfat milk, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Place water and tea bag in a small saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for about ten minutes, until the water is reduced by half If less than 1 / 2 cup of water remains after ten minutes, just top up with more water. Step 3: Remove tea bag and stir in milk and honey or sugar. Step 4: Allow the chai to just return to a boil, then pour into a mug and serve " this is normal, but if you'd rather not have it, periodically stir your chai while you enjoy it.

Dish Name: Bharwa Lauki In No Onion No Garlic Makhani Gravy
Ingredient Names: bottle gourd, paneer, gram flour, garam masala powder, green chili, salt, ginger, cashew nuts, cardamom pods, cloves, dry red chilies, tomato puree, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, fresh cream, rice bran oil, dried fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Bharwa Lauki Recipe In No Onion No Garlic Makhani Gravy, first prep and keep all the ingredients ready. Combine all the ingredients for the stuffing in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Fill the cut lauki roundels with the stuffing. Heat a shallow pan with a little oil on medium heat. Step 3: Place the stuffed lauki on the oil and shallow fry until the filling and the lauki gets a little golden brown from the sides and center. For the Makhani Gravy:Grind the cashew nuts, ginger, red chillies, cardamom pods and cloves along with water to a smooth paste. Heat the rice bran oil in a heavy bottomed pan; add in the cashew and spice paste and sauté on medium heat for a few seconds. Next add the tomato puree, coriander powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and garam masala powder. Step 4: Stir for another couple of minutes until the tomatoes begin to come to a bubble state. Stir in the fresh cream and give it a brisk boil. We will now prepare the coal for smoking. This method of coal smoking is not shown in the video. Step 5: If you don't have access to coal, you can skip this step. Place the coal on the flame and allow it to become red hot. Step 6: Once you notice that the coal is red hot, place it in a small heat proof cup. Step 7: Place this cup of coal on top of the simmering Bharwa Lauki. Add a spoon of ghee on top of the coal. Step 8: It will begin to smoke. Step 9: At this stage, immediately close the lid and allow the mixture to simmer for another 15-20 minutes. Step 10: This helps the Makhani gravy to get the smoked flavor. After five minutes, turn off the heat, stir in the kasuri methi for added flavor. Step 11: Spoon and transfer the Makhani gravy into the serving bowl and place the Bharwa Lauki over the gravy and serve hot. Serve the delicious Bharwa Lauki Recipe In No Onion No Garlic Makhani Gravy along with Jeera Rice, Tawa paratha and Palak Raita Recipe (Spinach Yogurt Salad) for a delicious Sunday lunch.

Ingredient Names: okra, skinless chicken, onion, fresh ginger, oil, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, coriander leaves, whole tomatoes, coriander powder, garam masala, onions, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into 1 12 inch pieces. Step 2: Put the onions, garlic, salt, chili powder, ground coriander, and meat in a heavy based pot. Step 3: Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the meat is half cook. Step 4: Add tomatoes and ginger in the meat and cook for 5 minutes, stir all the time to mashed the tomatoes. Step 5: Prepare bhuna gosht. Step 6: Meanwhile wash okra under running water, dry with tea cloth or just spread in a tray for some time. Step 7: Now cut okra by removing head and tail in to half inch slices. Step 8: In a large pan heat oil over high heat, add onions and fry until change color and edges turn light brown. Step 9: Remove onion from oil and keep aside. Step 10: Fry okra in the same oil until it changes its color and edges start getting brown.

Ingredient Names: bitter gourd, plain yogurt, turmeric powder, salt, oil, fennel seed, fennel powder, chaat masala
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and gently scrape the karelas so that the ridges diasappear and some skin remains on the vegetable. Step 2: Cut into roundels or semi circles- if the seeds are ripe, discard, or else retain the seeds. Step 3: Sprinkle turmeric powder and salt over the karelas and mix well. Step 4: Keep aside for half an hour for the bitter juices to run out. Step 5: After half hour, squeeze the karelas of any liquid that might remain in them and discard all the liquid. Step 6: Heat oil in a wok or frypan. Step 7: Add whole saunf, give it a few twirls and immediately throw in the squeezed karelas. Step 8: Stir for 2 minutess. Step 9: Add yogurt and cook till the yogurt comes to a rolling boil. Step 10: Cover, lower heat and cook till the karelas are tender.

Dish Name: Black Gram Beans In Cream Sauce Dal Makhani
Ingredient Names: urad dal, water, turmeric, vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger, ground cumin, garam masala, salt, ground cayenne pepper, butter, half-and-half, cooked basmati rice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Drain dal, rinse. Step 2: Combine dal with the 3 cups water, turmeric and oil in a medium saucepan. Step 3: Heat to boiling, cover and cook until dal are cooked through but not mushy, about 30 minutes- the dal should absorb most of the water. Step 4: Stir in garlic, ginger, cumin, garam masala, salt, red pepper, butter and half-and-half. Step 5: Heat to boiling over medium heat. Step 6: Cook, stirring frequently, until mixture thickens and flavors blend, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Serve over cooked rice. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro and ginger.

Ingredient Names: black salt, black peppercorns, black mustard seeds, cardamom seeds, nigella seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all spices except for black salt in a small saucepan and toast until fragrant. Step 2: Remove from heat and allow to cool Grind whole spices in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Step 3: Mix in black salt and store.

Dish Name: Bombay Chicken With Red Split Lentils
Ingredient Names: red lentils, onion, green chili, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ginger, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, oil, whole cumin seed, garlic, ground red pepper, lemon juice, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the lentils, onion, green chili, ground cumin, turmeric, half of the chopped ginger and 6 cups water in a big heavy pot. Step 2: Simmer and cover leaving lid slightly ajar for 45 minutes Next add chicken and salt. Step 3: Bring mixture to a boil and then simmer for another 30 minutes or until the chicken is tender Next get a small pan out and put the tablespoon of oil in it. Step 4: When hot, put in the whole cumin seeds As soon as the seeds begin to sizzle put in the remaining ginger and garlic. Step 5: Saute until garlic is slightly brown. Step 6: Now put in the red pepper and lift the pan up immediately and dump everything into the pot with chicken and lentils. Step 7: Finally, add the lemon juice, sugar, and garam marsala.

Dish Name: Bombay Chops With Corn And Cumin Raita
Ingredient Names: boneless pork chops, vegetable oil, salt, ground coriander, ground turmeric, cayenne, mustard powder, cumin seeds, whole kernel corn, tomatoes, low-fat plain yogurt, ground black pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Brush all surfaces of pork chops with vegetable oil. Step 2: Combine seasonings and rub evenly over chops. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat cumin seeds over high heat, stirring frequently and watching carefully, just until seeds are toasted. Step 5: Remove seeds to a medium bowl and crush with the back of a spoon. Step 6: Stir in remaining raita ingredients, cover and refrigerate until serving time. Step 7: Grill chops over medium heat, lid closed, for 8 minutes. Step 8: Turn chops and grill 7 minutes longer. Step 9: Serve with corn and cumin raita.

Ingredient Names: frozen green beans, cornstarch, water, vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, ground cumin, tomatoes, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook green beans according to package directions. Step 2: Drain Dissolve cornstarch in water in a small bowl, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and garlic. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, 3 minutes or until onion is tender. Step 6: Sprinkle with cumin. Step 7: Cook and stir, 1 minute. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium-low.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, salt, fresh ground pepper, ghee, mushroom, scallions, red chili peppers, gingerroot, tomatoes, turmeric, ground cumin, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl until well blended. Step 2: Heat the ghee or butter in a large skillet over medium heat, and when hot add the mushrooms, scallions, chili, and ginger root. Step 3: Saute, tossing often, until the mushrooms are tender, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Add the tomato, turmeric, and cumin, and cook 3 minutes more, or until the tomato is heated through and tender. Step 5: Reduce the heat to medium-low. Step 6: Pour in the egg mixture and cook, stirring constantly with a spatula, until the eggs are set yet still very creamy Do not let them dry out. Step 7: Serve immediately, garnished with cilantro. Step 8: Serve some naan or chapatis and a fruit salad, and there you have it!

Dish Name: Brinjal Eggplant Aubergine Pickle Goa India
Ingredient Names: eggplants, ginger, garlic cloves, chili powder, turmeric powder, black mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, salt, sugar, mustard oil, tamarind pulp, curry leaf, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Julianne or dice small brinjal-eggplant. Step 2: Layer brinjal with salt alternately. Step 3: Let stand 4-5 hours till water separates from vegetable. Step 4: Squeeze in handfuls brinjal till water is removed. Step 5: Keep in separate bowl Grind ginger and garlic in some of the vinegar to paste. Step 6: Heat oil till smoke starts rising. Step 7: Fry brinjals two hand fulls at a time. Step 8: Drain with slotted spoon and set aside Wait for water to evaporate from oil, till the bubbles stop before frying another lot of brinjal.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, salt, rice bran oil, whole mustard seeds, onion, ginger paste, garlic cloves, cayenne pepper, turmeric, ground cumin, garam masala, water, tomato paste, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the eggplants into 1-inch pieces- preferably keeping at least one side of each piece with the skin on. Step 2: Put the eggplant pieces into a strainer and sprinkle liberally with salt. Step 3: Place a small plate on top of the eggplant, and a weight on top of the plate- this process draws the excess water out of the eggplant, and it won't be overly salty. Step 4: Leave for at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat 1 1 / 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pan. Step 6: When hot, add mustard seeds- they will start to pop in a few seconds. Step 7: When they begin to pop, add the sliced onions, garlic and ginger. Step 8: Turn the heat to medium, and cook until mixture is nicely browned. Step 9: Add cayenne pepper, turmeric, garam masala and cumin to the onion mixture. Step 10: Cook spices for a few minutes, then add water and tomato paste, and reduce heat to low.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, oil, onion, ginger, turmeric, canned tomatoes, green chilies, cardamom, cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Slice egg plant in half and put in a baking dish and cover with foil. Step 3: Bake for about one hour until the egg plant looks greyish Scoop it out and set aside. Step 4: In a saucepan, heat oil and add onio, then add spices. Step 5: Cook for about 3 minutes. Step 6: Add tomatoes, chillies and egg plant and cook until the vegetables are cooked and you may need to add a little water as you're cooking it so that it doesn't get too dry.

Dish Name: Broccoli Chilli Noodles With Grilled Salmon
Ingredient Names: salmon fillet, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar, fish sauce, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, red chili flakes, lemon zest, whole black peppercorns, egg noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, broccoli, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Broccoli Chilli Noodles With Grilled Salmon recipe, mix together all the ingredients for broccoli and grill in a preheated oven at 180 C for 25-30 minutes. You can also stir fry the broccoli in a wok/kadhai at high heat till it is nicely browned. Mix all the salmon ingredients i.e sesame oil, fish sauce, rice wine vinegar and all the spices in a small bowl. Step 2: Whisk well and keep aside. Keep the salmon fillets in a foil and pour the spice mixture over salmon. Close the foils from all four sides sealing the salmon fully. Grill in a preheated oven at 180 C for 10 to. Step 3: Open and broil for till slightly caramelized. Serve the grilled salmon over chilli noodles with broccoli on the side and a glass of Watermelon-Cranberry Mocktail Recipe and Fresh Garden Salad Recipe enjoy a perfect Saturday meal.

Ingredient Names: barley, broccoli, green peas, sweet corn, green beans, carrots, rocket leaves, tomatoes, onion, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, basil leaves, fresh thyme leaves, red chili flakes, salt, black pepper powder, corn flour, water, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe, wash and soak pearl barley in water for 2 to. Drain and place them in a saucepan with water and a dash of salt. Step 2: Bring it to boil and then simmer and let it cook for 15-20 minutes. Once cooked drain the excess water and set it aside. In another saucepan, heat olive oil. Step 3: Add minced garlic and onion and saute for 3-4 minutes until slightly brown in colour. Now add all the chopped vegetables except rocket leaves, tomatoes, salt, pepper, basil, thyme and chilli flakes. Step 4: Stir and cook for a minute. Add in water and let it boil. Step 5: Once boiled keep the heat on low to medium and cook for 10 minutes. Now add the drained pearl barley and rocket leaves. Step 6: Stir and add cornstarch mixed with water. Stir and let the soup thickened a little. Remove from heat. Step 7: Season with more salt and pepper if desired. Serve Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe warm with a dollop of sour cream, pair it up with Cauliflower Chutney Grilled Sandwich or any sandwich of your choice.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, chili powder, black pepper, cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, red lentil, lemon, chicken broth, broccoli, dried coconut, flour, salt, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter in saucepan and saute onions until well browned. Step 2: Add chili powder, pepper, cumin, coriander and turmeric. Step 3: Stir and cook, 1 minute. Step 4: Add lentils, lemon juice, broth and coconut if using. Step 5: Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 45-55 minutes. Step 6: Steam broccoli for 7 minutes Plunge broccoli in cold water and set aside. Step 7: Remove 1 / 3 cup of liquid from the lentil mixture. Step 8: Add to flour to form a smooth paste, return to pan.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, extra virgin olive oil, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cardamom pods, plain yogurt, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the broccoli, and break it into its florets, and cook 4 to 5 minutes at the most in salted water, drain. Step 2: Heat oil in a skillet, and add the drained broccoli. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a small skillet, toast the cumin, fennel and cardamom until fragrant, about 3 to 4 minutes, and then grind them in a mortar and pestle. Step 4: Stir most of the spice mixture into the yogurt with the juice of the lemon Drizzel the spiced yogurt over the broccoli, and garnish with remaining spice mixture and some zest of the lemon.

Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic cloves, onions, ghee, tomatoes, coriander leaves, green chilies, salt, coconut milk, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Grind ginger and garlic together to make a paste. Step 2: Fry onions in ghee until golden. Step 3: Add ginger / garlic paste and tomatoes and let simmer until tomatoes are pulpy. Step 4: Add coriander, chiles, salt, and coconut milk Increase the heat. Step 5: Let the curry come to boil. Step 6: Then break the eggs into the curry and do not stir. Step 7: When the eggs set the curry is ready, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Browned And Braised Cauliflower With Indian Spices
Ingredient Names: canola oil, head cauliflower, onion, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, hot red pepper flakes, lime juice, plain yogurt, water, fresh cilantro leaves, frozen green pea, salt & fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large skillet over medium-high heat until pan is very hot, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 2: Add canola oil, swirling pan to coat evenly, add florets. Step 3: Saute, stirring occasionally, until they just begin to soften, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Add onions Continue sauteing until florets begin to brown and onions soften, about 4 minutes longer. Step 5: Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, and pepper flakes. Step 6: Saute until spices begin to toast and are fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and add lime juice, yogurt, and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 8: Cover and cook until flavors meld, about 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, brussels sprout, mustard seeds, dried red chili, coriander powder, cumin powder, black pepper, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the vegetable oil in a thick bottomed pan. Step 2: Add mustard seeds and fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add red chilies, ground coriander and ground cumin. Step 4: Add the brussels sprouts and water. Step 5: Cover the pan and let simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Fry for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown. Step 7: Add salt to taste and serve hot with roti.

Dish Name: Budgia Silver Beet Chard Indian Vegetable Fritters
Ingredient Names: flour, salt, baking powder, turmeric, silver beet, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except the silver beet with a little water until you have a medium thick batter. Step 2: Add the well drained silver beet and fry in spoonfuls in hot oil until cooked. Step 3: Drain on paper towel and serve with curries as a side dish or as a snack Please.

Ingredient Names: onion, plain yogurt, garlic, ginger, ground cumin, peppercorn, ground nutmeg, buffalo
Instructions: Step 1: In a 9 x 13- glass dish or bowl combine marinade ingredients. Step 2: Thread buffalo onto metal skewers. Step 3: Place skewered buffalo in marinade, turning to coat, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours Spray grill rack or broiler pan with pam and then prepare grill or preheat broiler. Step 4: Remove skewers from marinade, discarding marinade. Step 5: Grill or broil skewers 5-inches from heat until done. Step 6: Transfer skewers to platter or individual plates.

Ingredient Names: chicken, garlic paste, ginger paste, red chili powder, salt, clove powder, cinnamon, olive oil, lowfat curds, balsamic vinegar, masala paste
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken with ginger, garlic, red chilly powder, salt and balsamic vinegar, for 10 minutes For the second marinade, add chilly powder, olive oil, salt, clove powder and cinnamon powder to beaten curd. Step 2: Add the masala paste made with green chilly, brown onion and coriander stalk to the curd mixture. Step 3: Add olive oil mixed with red chilly for colour. Step 4: Marinate the chicken. Step 5: Put the chicken on the skewers and cook in a moderately heated oven Before the chicken is almost done, pour olive oil on top of the pieces and reheat them again in the oven. Step 6: When they are done, serve garnished with salad greens.

Dish Name: Butter Chicken Or Cauliflower With Cashews
Ingredient Names: unsalted cashews, butter, chicken, bell pepper, onion, minced garlic clove, ground ginger, ground cayenne pepper, turmeric, garam masala, cinnamon, tomato paste, tomato sauce, sour cream, water
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter over medium-low heat. Step 2: Add cashews and roast slowly until golden. Step 3: Lower heat if necessary to keep from burning. Step 4: Add cauliflower, onion, garlic and peppers and saut in the cashew butter mixture a few minutes. Step 5: Add ginger, spices, tomato paste and tomato sauce to the pan, along with some water. Step 6: Simmer covered until chicken or cauliflower reaches desired doneness If sauce gets too thick, add more water. Step 7: Add the cream and heat through. Step 8: Serve over rice or with bread.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, butter, canola oil, chicken thigh fillet, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, ground cumin, ground cardamom, coriander powder, garam masala, chili powder, tomatoes, cornflour, thickened cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large heavy based saucepan. Step 2: Cook the chicken in batches until browned. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl. Step 4: Reduce heat and add remaining oil. Step 5: Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until soft. Step 6: Add ginger, garlic and spices. Step 7: Cook, stirring, until fragrant. Step 8: Add tomato puree and chicken. Step 9: Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 10: Place cornflour in a small bowl.

Ingredient Names: skim milk powder, powdered sugar, brown sugar, instant butterscotch pudding mix, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, ground cardamom, ground ginger, ground cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Place mix in standard 8 oz mug Add cold water until cup is 3 / 4 full Microwave for 1 5 minutes Stir to blend Add water Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, carrots, olive oil, cumin seeds, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f Spray a large rimmed baking sheet with nonstick spray. Step 2: Combine carrots and all remaining ingredients in large bowl, toss to coat. Step 3: Spread in a single layer on prepared baking sheet Roast carrots until tender and lightly caramelized, turning carrots over once, 35 to 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, family-size tea bags, cardamom pods, splenda sugar substitute
Instructions: Step 1: Bring two quarts of water, with the cardamom pods, to boil in a pot. Step 2: Remove from heat and add the tea bags. Step 3: Cover and let steep five minutes. Step 4: Remove the tea bags and the cardamom. Step 5: Put the splenda or sugar in a gallon pitcher and add the tea. Step 6: Fill the pitcher the rest of the way with cold water, chill, and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, shallots, hot green chili pepper, carrot, cumin, ground coriander, ground fennel, cayenne pepper, turmeric, salt, coconut milk, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add shallots and chile, cook stirring for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add carrots, spices and curry leaves and cook another 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 20-25 minutes until carrots are tender.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, onion, green chili, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, raw cashew nuts, ground coriander, ground turmeric, vegetable oil, chicken stock, apples, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Fry chicken in hot oil until golden. Step 2: Put onion, chilli, ginger and garlic into blender, add water if required and blend. Step 3: Fry this mix in pan used for chicken for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add nuts and spices stir well and fry until golden. Step 5: Add stock, apples, cream and chicken and simmer for 25 minutes. Step 6: Serve with basmati rice and finely chopped tomato and raw onion.

Ingredient Names: curry, cilantro leaf, green chilies, ginger, cheese, flour, cauliflower, salt, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl mix first 5 ingredients thoroughly. Step 2: Add enough water to make a thick batter. Step 3: Add cauliflower and blend well. Step 4: Using a large, heavy frying pan, pour 1 1 / 4 inch deep oil and heat to 365 To test oil, drop a very small amount of the batter mix into the oil, if it sizzles, it's ready. Step 5: Add all batter to oil, 1 / 4 cup at a time to make "pancakes" and fry until golden brown, drain well.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, carrot, peas, pineapple, coconut milk, chickpeas, green curry paste, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Fry curry paste in oil. Step 2: Add cauliflower, carrots, chickpeas, fry for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add peas and pineapple, and fry for a further 5 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken stock, and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes. Step 5: Add coconut milk, and simmer for a further 20 minutes. Step 6: Serve with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: oil, cumin seed, fresh ginger, cauliflower, potatoes, garam masala, dried red chili, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put oil, cumin seed and ginger in a large frying pan and cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes. Step 2: Add cauliflower and potatoes. Step 3: Add some garam masala and red peppers and mix. Step 4: Cook over medium heat 7 to 10 minutes. Step 5: Cover and reduce heat to low The steam should cook the vegetables If it seems too dry, add a little water.

Dish Name: Cauliflower And Scallions With Black Mustard Seeds
Ingredient Names: cauliflower, scallions, black mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seed, turmeric, kosher salt, warm water, light vegetable oil, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Separate and cut the cauliflower into 1-inch florets Peel the cauliflower stem and cut into thin slices. Step 2: Set aside Trim the scallions and chop them, including the entire green part. Step 3: Set aside Measure out the spices and place them, as well as the water, right next to the stove. Step 4: Heat the oil in a wok or a saute an over high heat. Step 5: When the oil is hot, add the mustard, cumin, fennel. Step 6: Keep a pot lid handy since the seeds may splatter and sputter when added. Step 7: When the seeds stop sputtering, add the turmeric and immediately add the cauliflower.

Ingredient Names: oil, cumin seed, fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, anise seed, nigella seeds, cauliflower, salt, red chili powder, turmeric, garlic, ground ginger, yogurt, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep pan. Step 2: Drop in all seeds at once. Step 3: Cover till they stop spluttering add the cauliflower stir gently to coat with the tempered oil. Step 4: Cook 5 minutes add the salt, chilli powder and turmeric Traditionally this dish uses a lot of turmeric i have toned it down to 1 / 2 tsp you can do so further. Step 5: Cover and cook till the vegetable is half done. Step 6: Add the garlic and cover and cook till 3 / 4ths done. Step 7: Add the ginger and stir. Step 8: Then add the curd and cook till fully tender. Step 9: Garnish with the cilantro before serving.

Ingredient Names: oil, potatoes, cayenne powder, green onions, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick frying pan put the oil and heat over high heat. Step 2: Once the pan is hot, add the potatoes. Step 3: Stir-fry frequently until the potatoes are golden brown, around 20-25 minutes You may need to reduce the heat to medium-high after the potatoes have cooked a bit The last 2 minutes of cooking stir in the cayenne, green onions and salt. Step 4: Serve at once This type of recipe doesn't usually have onions, but i like the mild flavor of the green ones.

Ingredient Names: gingerroot, garlic, lamb chops, tomatoes, onions, cayenne, greek yogurt, salt, ground roasted cumin seeds, garam masala, lemon juice, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ginger and garlic into the container of an electric blender with 2-3 tablespoons of water and blend to a paste. Step 2: Put the chops, tomatoes, onions, cayenne pepper, yoghurt, salt and ginger-garlic paste into a large wok or heavy-bottomed saucepan. Step 3: Stir and bring to the boil. Step 4: Turn the heat to low, cover and simmer for 50 minutes or until the chops are almost cooked. Step 5: Add the cumin seeds and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until the meat is tender and the sauce thick. Step 6: Add the garam masala and lemon juice and stir. Step 7: Sprinkle fresh coriander over the top and serve In the punjab, tomatoes are grated to make a puree Don't be tempted to use ready-prepared tomato puree instead of fresh The spice combinations in garam masala vary in different parts of india.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seeds, ajwain, dried red chilies, black salt, citric acid, mango powder, salt, garam masala, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the first 3 ingredients separately in a dry saute pan over medium high heat until they become aromatic--do not burn Grind them with the chillies, black salt and citric acid until a powder. Step 2: Mix in the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Store in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: coriander seed, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, dried red chilies, whole black peppercorn, mango powder, black salt, ground ginger, carom seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Toast: Dry roast the coriander, cumin and fennel seeds, plus the dried red chilies, in a shallow heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Stir every 15-20 seconds to prevent burning The spices should be just toasted and aromatic. Step 3: After about 4 minutes of roasting, transfer the mixture to a plate. Step 4: Let cool 15 minutes Grind: Transfer spices to a spice grinder or the dry jug of a powerful blender. Step 5: Add whole black peppercorns, mango powder, black salt, ground ginger and carom seeds Process to a fine powder.

Ingredient Names: potato, red chili powder, salt, ground roasted cumin seeds, nigella seeds, garlic, ginger, green chilies, coriander, tamarind juice
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes + cube. Step 2: Heat oil in pan and fry the potatoes in a little oil till theyre brown. Step 3: Remove, drain on paper towels In the same pan, place the potatoes and all other ingredients except the coriander leaves and tamarind. Step 4: After frying 2 minutes, add the tamarind juice, cover and simmer till potato is tender. Step 5: Add coriander leaves before serving Can be served with fresh puris or frozen parathas.

Ingredient Names: chai tea teabags, hot water, vanilla, brown sugar, cream soda, milk, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: Chill glasses in freezer several hours before serving Steep tea bags in hot water 3 - 5 minutes, remove bags. Step 2: Stir in vanilla and brown sugar into tea until sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Stir in all remaining ingredients except cinnamon sticks. Step 4: Refrigerate at least 1 - 2 hours to blend flavors, serve over ice. Step 5: Garnish with cinnamon sticks, if desired.

Ingredient Names: water, milk, black tea bags, cardamom pods, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick, ginger powder, cloves, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Once water begins to boil add the cardamom, peppercorns, cinnamon sticks, ginger and cloves. Step 2: Simmer over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes, add milk. Step 3: Add black tea bags and simmer 4 to 5 minutes or until the desired strength of tea is reached. Step 4: Strain, serve and enjoy! Step 5: If you would like to sweeten things up a bit, add enough sugar to suit your taste.

Ingredient Names: water, half and half milk, ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, ground ginger, ground cloves, black tea bags, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place water, half and half, cinnamon, cardamom, ginger and cloves in tea pot or saucepot and let reach a low boil. Step 2: Stir well and let boil 2 more minutes While still boiling, add the tea bags and let it reach desired tea strength. Step 3: Add sugar as desired, and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: black tea leaves, cinnamon sticks, black peppercorns, cloves, cardamom seeds, cumin seed, allspice, ground nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: To make heat milk and water together in equal proportions and add 1 tablespoon per cup of mixture Let stand for 10 minutes strain and serve.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, lentils, onion, tomatoes, green chilies, garlic cloves, gingerroot, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Clean dal and boil with enough water, salt and turmeric till soft then mashed it with water. Step 2: Cut the chicken into 2-3inch pieces. Step 3: Put the onions, garlic, ginger, salt, chili powder, ground coriander, chicken and 1, 1 / 2cups water in a heavy based pot. Step 4: Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the meat is half cook. Step 5: Add oil, tomatoes and green chillies and cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: Then add mashed dal with water And cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 7: Then sprinkle garam masala.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, garlic, minced ginger, chili, tomatoes, paprika, salt, ground coriander, garam masala, turmeric, fresh lemon juice, chickpeas, cilantro, rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan over medium-low heat, heat oil and add onion. Step 2: Saute until translucent and soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, ginger and chili and saute until soft and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add tomatoes and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 5: Cover and cook until tomatoes are very soft, about 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Step 6: Puree mixture in blender or food processor until smooth. Step 7: Return to pan and place over medium heat. Step 8: Add paprika, 1 teaspoon salt, coriander, garam masala, turmeric and lemon juice. Step 9: Add chickpeas and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Step 10: Cover and simmer until sauce is thick and chickpeas are soft, about 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: baby spinach, chickpeas, plain yogurt, ginger, canola oil, cardamom, ground cinnamon, garlic cloves, diced onion, tomatoes, turmeric powder, ground coriander, red chili powder, garam masala, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chickpeas and roughly chop baby spinach. Step 2: Heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add cardamom and cinnamon Wait for a minute Increase heat to medium-high. Step 4: Add garlic and cook till it starts to change color. Step 5: Then add onions and saut until golden. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium. Step 7: Add turmeric powder, ground coriander, chili powder, garam masala and salt. Step 8: Mix well for a minute.

Ingredient Names: chicken, oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, tomatoes, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, limes, salt, yogurt, water, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a non stick pan heat the oil and fry the onions till light brown in colour. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic and tomatoes, fry for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add turmeric, chilli and garam masala powders. Step 4: Stir and fry for 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove the pan from the heat and allow the mixture to cool. Step 6: In a blender, blitz the spice mix to a smooth paste, add the yogurt and mix well. Step 7: Place chicken in a non metallic bowl, add the lime juice and give a quick stir. Step 8: Add the spiced paste and make sure that all of the chicken is coated with the mixture. Step 9: Allow mixture to stand for 15 minutes Reheat the pan.

Ingredient Names: beetroots, green peas, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, curd, turmeric powder, bay leaf, curry leaves, coriander leaves, ghee, salt, cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, star anise, dry red chilies, cashew nuts, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Chettinad Beetroot Kurma Recipe, heat a pan and dry roast all the ingredients mentioned in the Chettinad masala table except coconut till it gets fragrant and keep aside. Once its cool, grind it along with the coconut to a smooth paste adding little water using a mixer grinder and keep aside. Heat ghee in the same pan on medium flame, add the bay leaf and chopped onions and fry until it turns translucent. Add the curry leaves, ginger garlic paste and turmeric powder and saute until the raw smell of the ginger-garlic goes away. Add the beetroot cubes and saute for a minute. Add the ground Chettinad masala paste, curd, season with salt, mix well and let the gravy simmer for with the lid on. Add the green peas, tomatoes, a cup of water if the gravy is too thick and simmer for another 15-20 minutes and switch off the flame. Serve the delicious Chettinad Beetroot Kurma Recipe along with Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha and Boondi Raita for a weekday lunch or dinner.

Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, coriander powder, chili powder, fennel seed, cumin seed, turmeric, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, coconut milk, oil, fenugreek seeds, cinnamon sticks, onions, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the coriander, chilli, cumin seeds, turmeric, ginger and garlic into a blender with 2 tbsp water and blend to a paste. Step 2: Heat the oil and fry the fennel seeds, fenugreek seeds and cinnamon for 10 seconds. Step 3: Add the onion, cook till just coloured and add the spice paste. Step 4: Cook for 8 minutes If the mixture sticks to the pan add a little water. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add 3 cups of warm water and salt to taste, simmer for 20 minutes till you have a smooth gravy. Step 7: Add the coconut milk, bring to boil, reduce heat, add the lime juice stir well Halve the eggs and put into the gravy, yolks uppermost. Step 8: Serve with plain boiled rice and chettinad chicken curry.

Dish Name: Chettinad Muttai Masala - Chettinad Style Egg Curry
Ingredient Names: eggs, onion, tomato, coriander powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, cinnamon stick, cloves, sunflower oil, salt, coriander seeds, garlic, ginger, fresh coconut, fennel seeds, whole black peppercorns, poppy seeds, cumin seeds, dry red chili
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Chettinad Muttai Masala Recipe, hard boil the eggs in boiling water for 10 minutes. Step 2: Once cooled, remove the shells and keep aside. Now, dry roast the ingredients listed under the Chettinad masala paste like the coriander seeds, garlic, ginger, coconut, fennel seeds, peppercorns, poppy seeds, cumin seeds and red chill in a Shallow fry pan till the coconut starts to turn brown. Step 3: Turn off the heat and let the masala cool down. Once cool grind the roasted masala into a smooth paste in a Mixer grinder with a little water and keep aside. Heat oil in a Kadai on medium flame, add the cinnamon stick and cloves and let the spices release its aroma into the oil. Now, add the sliced onions and sauté until it turns translucent. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and cook until it is well cooked, soft and mushy. Now, add the ground Chettinad masala mix and mix well. Step 5: Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the mix is cooked well. Add the coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and sauté until the oil separates. Add half a cup of water, season with salt and let it simmer for another 15-20 minutes. Now, add the halved boiled eggs and turn off the heat. Step 6: Transfer the Chettinad Muttai Masala into a serving bowl and serve. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve the Chettinad Muttai Masala along with Kerala Parotta and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita for dinner.

Ingredient Names: shrimps, basmati rice, ginger, garlic, fresh coconut, green chili, greek yogurt, curry leaves, sunflower oil, ghee, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, cardamom pods, black cardamom, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, cumin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani Recipe, wash and clean prawns well, collect in a bowl and add ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, few drops of lemon juice and salt. Step 2: Mix well and marinate for 2 hours. Wash and soak rice in water for a minimum before cooking. Heat oil in a large and thick bottomed handi and add the whole spices and wait till they splutter. Now add shallots and saute them till they are pale in color. Add green chili paste, grated coconut and marinated prawns and mix well. Fry for 3-4 minutes and then slowly add curd and carefully mix everything to avoid breaking the prawns. Keep the flames high and let the water from curd dry up completely. Season with coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt. Step 3: Fry till it is cooked and deeper in color. Now add the soaked rice and again stir well such that everything incorporates well with each other. Add warm water (double the quantity of rice), check salt and add a dollop of ghee and mix well. Allow the rice to come to a boil, close the lid and let the rice cook at low heat. Keep the lid covered till the rice is done. Step 4: Gently mix the rice and collect in a serving bowl. Garnish with chopped coriander and chopped curry leaves. Serve the Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani hot with raita for a wholesome meal.

Dish Name: Chettinad Vegetable Casserole - Chettinad Vegetable Pulao
Ingredient Names: rice, pearl onions, garlic, ginger, green chilies, bay leaf, red chili powder, turmeric powder, carrot, green beans, potatoes, ghee, cinnamon, fennel, whole black peppercorns, coriander seeds, green peas, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To make Chettinad vegetable casserole, first cut all the vegetables. Step 2: Soak rice for 30 minutes. Step 3: Heat a pan on gas. Step 4: Add long, cinnamon, fennel, whole black pepper, coriander seeds, and roast for 2 to. Step 5: Turn off the gas and allow this spice mixture to cool. Step 6: After it cools down, put it in a blender and grind it, keep it aside. Step 7: Now heat ghee in a pan. Step 8: Add ginger, garlic, onion, green chilies and cook till the onion becomes soft. Step 9: After the onion becomes soft, add carrots, green beans, potatoes, bay leaves, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, ground spices and mix well. Step 10: After, add rice, salt, water and let it boil. Step 11: After boiling, reduce the heat, cover the pan and cook until the rice is cooked. Step 12: If the rice remains raw, then add some more water and cook it. Step 13: After cooking, turn off the gas, cover and keep it aside for 3-4 minutes, serve. Step 14: Serve Chettinad Vegetable Casserole Recipe along with Bundi Raita and Baked Papad for dinner.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, red pepper, black pepper, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic, brown sugar, onion, green pepper, egg, vegetable oil, tomato ketchup, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into small size piece and mix with soy sauce, corn starch and beaten egg Marinade it for at least 10 minutes. Step 2: Heat the wok or large pan. Step 3: Put the vegetable oil and fry the chicken until it becomes golden. Step 4: Put the onion, garlic, green pepper, black pepper, red pepper, soy sauce, tomato ketchup and brown sugar in the wok or pan. Step 5: Take corn starch and mix it with water and put in the pan. Step 6: Mix everything well, adjust salt and spice as per your taste then let it cook for 5 more minutes and it is ready!

Dish Name: Chicken And Shrimp Bánh Xèo -Vietnamese Stuffed Crepe
Ingredient Names: rice flour, sugar, salt, turmeric powder, coconut milk, water, shrimps, black pepper powder, lemon juice, olive oil, chicken breasts, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, sunflower oil, tomato pasta sauce, coriander leaves, green bell pepper, carrots, cucumber, onion
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Chicken And Shrimp Bánh Xèo Recipe, take a large mixing bowl and mix together the rice flour, sugar, salt and turmeric powder. Step 2: Beat in the coconut milk to make a thick batter. Step 3: Then slowly beat in enough water to make a crepe batter. Step 4: Set the batter aside to rest. Heat olive oil in a Shallow-fry pan over a medium heat add shrimp and cook for about 3-4 minutes, add black pepper and salt. Turn the shrimps over and cook until opaque throughout about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Add lime juice and transfer onto a plate. Heat oil in a wok. Step 6: Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for half a minute. Step 7: Add chicken pieces, turmeric powder, cumin powder, chilli powder and again fry for a minute. Add tomato sauce, salt and sugar mix well and cover the lid to cook the chicken in lower flame. When chicken cooked till soft and tender now sprinkle garam masala powder on it and switch off the flame. Making CrepesHeat a Crepe pan to medium flame, add a small amount of oil, stir the crepe batter well and pour batter into the saute pan. Swirl the pan to coat the bottom. Step 8: Lay 3 or 4 of the lime shrimp and roasted chicken over one-half of the crepe and then sprinkle a small handful of veggies over the filling. When the middle of the crepe looks cooked through and the edges of the crepe begin to brown, fold the crepe over to cover the filling and slide the Vietnamese Crepe onto a plate. To serve the Chicken And Shrimp Bánh Xèo Recipe (Vietnamese Stuffed Crepe) arrange the fresh Charred Corn and Radish Salad Recipe on a platter, with Nuoc Cham Chay Dipping Sauce Recipe for a weeknight dinner.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomatoes, onions, garlic cloves, vinegar, butter, vegetable oil, unsweetened coconut milk, garam masala, coriander powder, chili powder, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Puree tomato, onion, and garlic with vinegar. Step 2: Heat butter in a large deep sauce pan over medium heat until it bubbles for a few minutes and just starts to turn light brown, then add the spices and some salt to taste. Step 3: Add the tomato / onion / garlic mixture to the pan, increase heat to high, and cook at a boil for several minutes, then reduce heat to a simmer. Step 4: Cut the chicken meat into approximately 2-inch cubes. Step 5: Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan and add the chicken when the oil is quite hot Careful with spattering and cover if necessary. Step 6: Cook and roll the chicken pieces until they are just seared on all sides but not cooked inside. Step 7: Add the seared chicken to the tomato / onion / garlic / spice mixture, keep it at a simmer and stirring occasionally for about an hour or until the sauce begins to stick shortly after stirring. Step 8: Make sure the lid of the sauce pan is just ajar so the moisture can escape and the mixture will cook down. Step 9: Add about half of the can of coconut milk, and continue to cook at a simmer, again until the sauce sticks to the bottom shortly after stirring.

Ingredient Names: kidney beans, chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin powder, black pepper powder, cinnamon powder, paprika powder, turmeric powder, salt, oil, tomato, red chili powder, sugar, cooked rice, dried thyme leaves, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, tomato salsa, sour cream, cheese, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Chicken Burrito Recipe, we will first pressure cook the rajma beans in a pressure cooker in about water and salt for at least 5 minutes. To make the Fried BeansOnce done, allow the pressure to release naturally and keep it aside. Step 2: Heat a skillet with oil, add garlic and saute till it softens. Add in onions and saute till they turn translucent and crispy, add in cooked rajma beans and tomatoes together so that the tomatoes remain fresh and juicy as it gets blended with the rajma. Sprinkle salt to taste and spice powders like cumin powder, red chilli powder and pepper powder and give it a mix. Step 3: Check for seasoning, if required, dd some more and keep sautéing until the mixture comes together. Step 4: Once done, allow it to cool for some time. Step 5: To make the Sauteed Chicken Wash the chicken breast thoroughly and cut them into thin stripes and set aside. Step 6: Heat a sauce pan with a tablespoon oil, add ginger and garlic and saute till they turn soft. Step 7: Later add in the onions and saute till they turn translucent. Once the onions are lightly sauteed, add cooked jackfruit and give it a mix. Step 8: Sprinkle the spice powders like paprika, pepper, turmeric, cumin, cinnamon and salt to taste. Step 9: Give it a toss and check for seasonings again and set aside to cool. For the riceHeat a sautéing pan with oil, add rice and sprinkle with thyme, paprika powder and salt and give it a toss. For the FajitasHeat a grill pan with oil, add onions, bell peppers allow it to cook for few minutes. Step 10: Sprinkle with spice powders like cumin powder, paprika powder and salt. Step 11: Toss it well and cook till the bell peppers are soft and crunchy. Step 12: Once done set aside. Step 13: To make the Mexican salsa and sour cream, click on the link below and follow the steps:How to Mexican salsaHow to make Sour creamTo AssembleWarm up the tortillas for on either side. Step 14: Place the Tortillia on a foil to roll. Step 15: Layer it with rice first. Then add in some Mexican tomato salsa, followed by Sauteed Chicken, fried beans, fajitas, sour cream and roll it tightly and cover it with a foil. Step 16: Cut them half and serve. Serve Chicken Burrito along with Low Fat Vegetable Dip Recipe with Herbs at your house parties or serve it for your weekend dinners.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, cornflour, oil, onions, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, green chilies, chicken thighs, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ground cayenne pepper, canned tomatoes, fresh coriander, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Stir cornflour into yoghurt, put aside. Step 2: In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onions and saute until beginning to colour. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium and saute onions until dark golden brown. Step 5: Stir in ginger, garlic and chillies. Step 6: Saute for a further two minutes Increase heat to medium-high and add chicken Brown well. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium.

Dish Name: Chicken Donne Biryani - Bangalore Shivaji Military Style
Ingredient Names: chicken, curd, turmeric powder, lemon juice, salt, coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chilies, seeraga samba rice, sunflower oil, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, star anise, onions, ginger, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Chicken Donne Biryani Recipe, thoroughly clean and wash the chicken pieces.*For the marinationIn a large mixing bowl combine the chicken, yogurt, turmeric powder, salt and lemon juice. Step 2: Nicely massage the chicken for 5 minutes and then allow it to rest for a minimum of.*For the green biryani masalaIn a mixer-jar combine the coriander leaves, mint leaves, and green chilies and grind to a thick fine paste along with some water. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and set aside. To make the Donne Biryani, in a heavy bottomed pan, heat oil on medium flame, add all the whole spices including bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom and star anise, let this sizzle. Once the whole spices have sizzled add ginger and garlic paste and the sliced onions, fry until the onions turn golden brown in colour. Step 4: This will take about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Once the ginger-garlic-onion mixture has cooked well, add in the chicken pieces along with the marinade. Step 6: Mix and continue to cook the entire mixture for 5-7 more minutes, stirring continuously. Finally add in the freshly ground green biryani masala and washed and drained rice, water into the pan. Step 7: Give the Chicken Donne Biryani a good mix and cover the pan. Step 8: Turn the flame to the lowest heat. In a saucepan, boil water and turn off the flame and place this hot pan on the lid of the kadai. Step 9: This process is done in order to seal the kadai in which the Chicken Donne Biryani is cooking. Step 10: The heat from the hot water in the saucepan provides heat from the top. After open the lid to check if the chicken and rice is done. Step 11: If its is done, lightly fluff up the Chicken Donne Biryani with a fork. Step 12: Transfer the Donne Biryani into a serving plate and serve piping hot. Serve this Chicken Donne Biryani Recipe along with Pudina & Dhaniya Raita Recipe, Roasted Papad and Satvik Carrot Sprout Salad for a hearty Sunday lunch.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, wheat, lentils, onions, garlic paste, ginger paste, garam masala powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, bicarbonate of soda, oil, fresh mint leaves, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Put meat in the pan, add garlic, garam masala powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt. Step 3: Cook on medium heat. Step 4: In a separate pan boil wheat grains with lots of water, add salt. Step 5: When the grains become tender and mushy add a pinch of soda and cook further for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 6: Now mix the wheat grains with the meat and mix well. Step 7: Stir continuously so that both are mixed properly. Step 8: Now grind the lentils in a food processor. Step 9: Make it into a thick paste by adding 2 cups of water while processing it. Step 10: Pour the lentil paste into the meat and wheat mixture and stir to mix well.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, curry powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, water, tomato paste, chicken breasts, cilantro, plain yogurt, dried chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the vegetable oil in a dutch oven or other large pot. Step 2: Cook the onions over medium heat until softened. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger, continue to cook until fragrant and softened. Step 4: Remove from heat, add curry powder, cumin, and coriander. Step 5: Pour 1 / 2 cup water into a blender. Step 6: Add cooked vegetables and blend on high until very, very smooth. Step 7: Add additional water if necessary. Step 8: Pour sauce back into pot and stir in tomato paste and chilis, if using. Step 9: Cover and cook for at least 30 minutes, but no more than an hour -.

Dish Name: Chicken Methi Chicken With Dried Fenugreek Leaves
Ingredient Names: chicken, bay leaves, cardamom pods, garam masala powder, onions, garlic paste, ginger paste, green chilies, yogurt, dried fenugreek leaves, turmeric powder, coriander powder, coriander leaves, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Clean, skin, wash and cut chicken into medium sized pieces Peel, wash and chop onions Peel and chop ginger. Step 2: Remove stem, wash and chop green chillies, heat oil in a pan. Step 3: Add whole garam masala and bay leaves Saut until cardamoms starts to crackle. Step 4: Add chopped onions and cook until translucent and soft. Step 5: Make sure to stir continuously. Step 6: Add chopped ginger, garlic paste, turmeric powder, coriander powder and chopped green chillies.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, cinnamon sticks, green cardamom pods, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, turmeric powder, coriander powder, chili powder, yogurt, tomato puree, salt, skinless chicken breasts, sliced almonds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the ghee in a large heavy pan then add the chopped onion and stir for a few minutes with the heat on high. Step 2: Add the cinnamon and cardamons, stir a little then turn the heat down to low and cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the ginger and garlic, stir and cook for another 5 minutes on low heat stirring now and again to make sure nothing browns or burns. Step 4: Add the turmeric, coriander and chili powder and fry gently for a minute. Step 5: Add 1 tablespoon of yoghurt, stir round and turn the heat up so the yoghurt sizzles in the oil.
