Step 6: When the yoghurt has lost a lot of it's moisture add another tablespoon. Step 7: Stir and fry as before. Step 8: Repeat until all the yoghurt is incorporated. Step 9: Add the tomato pure and stir. Step 10: Stir in hot water - enough to make the mixture very fluid.

Dish Name: Chicken Pickle Murg Achaar North Indian Punjabi
Ingredient Names: chicken leg, ginger paste, garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, mustard oil, asafoetida powder, onions, cardamom powder, fennel powder, black cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, bay leaves, malt vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chicken with chili powder, turmeric and salt with half each of ginger and garlic paste Rub into meat and let stand for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat oil to smoking point. Step 3: Reduce heat and deep fry meat for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Strain meat and set aside Reheat oil and add asafetida, 1 sec. Step 5: Add onions and deep fry till golden. Step 6: Add remaining spices and stir for a minute. Step 7: Add vinegar, bring to a boil, add fried chicken and cook over high heat 3-4 minutes remove pot from heat and allow the meat to cool thoroughly. Step 8: Tie muslin, cheese cloth to opening of jar and leave on kitchen counter for 6 hours.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, coriander powder, red chili powder, cumin powder, black pepper powder, turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, extra virgin olive oil, salt, whole wheat flour, active dry yeast, milk, sugar, cucumber, carrot, tomato, vinegar, hummus, tzatziki, onion
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Chicken Shawarma Recipe we will first make the Pita bread. To make the Pita BreadFor the pita bread dough, in a bowl mix together yeast & sugar. Heat the milk until lukewarm and mix it with yeast and sugar. Step 2: Allow this to sit for a while till you notice bubbles rising. Step 3: This is when the yeast starts to activate. Step 4: Now add flour, salt and water slowly and combine to form a soft dough. Step 5: Keep kneading for at least on to a working surface and place it inside a big bowl. Step 6: Cover it with a damp cloth and rest the dough in a warm place, allowing it to rise and doubles its size. Marinade for the chickenIn a mixing bowl, add cumin powder, coriander powder, red chilli powder, black pepper powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and olive oil. Step 7: Combine everything well. Add in the chicken pieces and mix them well till it is nicely coated. Step 8: Marinate the chicken pieces for at least 2 hours. Meanwhile pickle the cucumber, tomatoes and carrots. Step 9: In a separate bowl, add chilli vinegar, salt and sugar and the vegetables. Step 10: Keep it aside. Make the Tzatziki Recipe - A Greek Yogurt Dip and Classic Homemade Hummus Recipe With Lemon And Coriander and keep aside. Step 11: Check on the bread dough, knock out the all the air by kneading it once again. Step 12: Make small sized dough balls. Dust some flour on to your surface and with the help of the rolling pin start rolling one of the ball to a circle shaped flat bread. Step 13: The bread should not be rolled too thin and it has to big enough to stuff the chicken and roll it up to form a roll. Heat a flat skillet, on medium flame and cook the rolled out bread on both sides until you see small brown spots. Step 14: Do the same for the rest of the dough and keep the bread aside as you move ahead to cook the chicken. Heat a pan with oil, add chicken pieces and keep turning them over as they are getting cooked and charred on all the side. Step 15: This will take about to cook. Assembling the Chicken ShawarmaTake one square of parchment paper and place one cooked pita bread, and spoon in hummus evenly, and a tablespoon of the tzatziki dip as well. Step 16: Place one cucumber, carrot and tomatoes julienne in the middle. Step 17: Then place some cooked chicken pieces, add chopped onion and roll it tightly along with the parchment paper and pack both ends of the paper into the roll if you want it as a take away. Serve the Chicken Shawarma Recipe along with Summer Lettuce Salad Recipe to make it a complete meal for your Sunday lunch.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, onion, mustard seeds, diced tomatoes, ground coriander, chili powder, salt, cayenne, garam masala, turmeric, ground cumin, garlic, chicken, water, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and mustard seeds, cook until they begin to soften. Step 3: Add garlic, stir, cook about 1 minute. Step 4: Add chicken and begin to brown, add tomatoes. Step 5: Add all spices except fresh coriander. Step 6: Add water if needed, it should not cover the chicken, but can be used to keep the dish from burning You want the dish to be about the consistency of spaghetti sauce at the end of cooking. Step 7: Cook 5 minutes or more- until chicken is fully cooked yet still tender. Step 8: Serve over rice, sprinkle with coriander.

Dish Name: Chicken With Onions And Fresh Ginger
Ingredient Names: green chilies, onions, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, turmeric, garam masala, coriander, salt, vegetable oil, yogurt, chicken pieces, water
Instructions: Step 1: Grind chilli, onions, garlic and ginger until smooth, adding water if necessary. Step 2: Heat oil and add paste. Step 3: Stir fry until golden, about 15 / 20 minute. Step 4: Add garam masala, turmeric, coriander and salt, stirring and cooking for another 3 minutes. Step 5: Add yoghurt - 1 tbls at a time - stirring well after each spoonful. Step 6: Cook until moisture has evaporated, and sauce is a rich brown colour. Step 7: Add chicken pieces and cook, turning frequently to coat with sauce. Step 8: When golden - add 600ml water, stir well then cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken, turmeric powder, salt, ginger, garlic, coriander, green chilies, peanut oil, onions, gingerroot, coconut, cinnamon, cardamoms, anise seed, peppercorn
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken pcs in the turmeric and salt and keep aside. Step 2: Make a paste of ginger, garlic, coriander, chillies and add to the chicken and marinate for half an hour. Step 3: Heat 1 tsp oil in pan and saut 2 sliced onions, green chillies, ginger, garlic for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add 1 grated coconut and saut for another 5-7 minutes. Step 5: Once onions are crispy, keep aside On a dry pan separately roast cinnamon, cardamom, aniseed, black pepper corn, poppy seeds, coriander seeds, kashmiri red chillies, star anise, mace flower, nutmeg, and turmeric. Step 6: Make xacuti masala by grinding together the onion mix and spice mixture. Step 7: Heat 2 tsp oil in pan and add the remaining 2 sliced onions and green chillies. Step 8: After one minute add the marinated chicken pieces. Step 9: After two minutes add xacuti masala and water.

Ingredient Names: garbanzo beans, baking potato, coriander, paprika, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, baking powder, nonfat yogurt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Process chickpeas in food processor until texture resembles coarse bread crumbs. Step 2: Transfer 2 / 3 of mixture to a mixing bowl along with mashed potato, set aside. Step 3: Add to the remaining chickpeas the following and process until smooth: all of the dried herbs, baking powder. Step 4: Add this paste to the mixing bowl along with the yogurt and cilantro, mix well. Step 5: Drop spoonfuls of mixture on sheet like cookies. Step 6: Bake at 350f for 35-45 minutes. Step 7: Flip them about half way through, flattening with the spatula before flipping. Step 8: Let them cool a bit and remove carefully.

Ingredient Names: courgettes, tomatoes, onion, green chilies, fresh coriander, red chili powder, coriander, turmeric powder, cumin seed, garbanzo beans, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pot and add the onion and cumin seeds. Step 2: When they start to crackle, add the courgette slices and chickpeas. Step 3: Stir and sprinkle with the chilli, coriander and turmeric powder. Step 4: Mix well and add the tomatoes. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt, the green chilli and fresh coriander. Step 6: Cover and cook for about 10-12 mins or until done.

Dish Name: Chilled Almond And Pistachio Milk Shake Pista Badam Milk
Ingredient Names: milk, condensed milk, almonds, pistachios, cardamom powder, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Place the almonds and pistachios in a bowl and pour boiling water over, leave for an hour. Step 2: Chop half the almonds and pistachios fine and place the other half in a blender. Step 3: Place the milk, condensed milk, cardamom powder and ice in the blender too. Step 4: Blend till well mixed and serve garnished with the chopped almonds and thinly sliced pistachios.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, salt, curry paste, curry powder, tomato paste, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, water, cornflour, sultanas
Instructions: Step 1: Warm oil in pan. Step 2: Add chopped onion and brown them, the more caramelized the tastier the end product. Step 3: Add garlic and salt, stir, caramelize further. Step 4: Add curry paste and curry powder and stir over gentle heat. Step 5: Add 1 cup of water, tomato paste, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce and sultanas or raisins. Step 6: Simmer away until mixture reduces, then add further cup of water with the cornflour mixed inches. Step 7: Simmer away on a low heat for at least 15 minutes. Step 8: Put the mixture into a blender and blitz it. Step 9: Serve the amount you need over your chips / fries and then divide the rest into batches and either freeze or keep in the fridge for a couple of days.

Ingredient Names: black tea, cardamom pods, whole cloves, cinnamon stick, ground allspice, cocoa powder, demerara sugar, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tea, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, allspice, cocoa powder, sugar and 1 1 / 2 cups of cold water in a saucepan. Step 2: Bring to the boil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 4: Simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes or until aromatic, add milk. Step 5: Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until hot. Step 6: Strain into 2 heatproof glasses or cups, serve.

Ingredient Names: water, tea bags, sugar, unsweetened cocoa powder, milk, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, ground cardamom, ground cloves, cayenne pepper, salt, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, bring water to a boil, remove from heat, add tea bags. Step 2: Cover and steep 5 minutes, remove tea bags. Step 3: Stir in sugar and cocoa, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 4: Add milk, vanilla, spices and salt. Step 5: Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture is heated through, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rice, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, milk, water, ghee, salt, onions, sunflower oil, potato, dry mango powder, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander leaves, mint leaves, chickpeas, garlic, ginger, green chili, garam masala powder, curd, turmeric powder, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Chole Masala Biryani Recipe, let us keep each of the elements ready. Step 2: For the fried onionsIn a kadai, heat oil on medium flame, add the sliced onions and fry them until they turn into a deep brown colour. Caramelizing the onions takes a good. Step 3: So ensure you do it on low heat. Once the onions are caramelised, drain it on absorbent paper and set aside. For the roasted potatoesIn the same kadai add some more oil and pan roast potatoes until it gets a light brown colour. Step 4: Sprinkle some salt and a pinch of turmeric powder to add taste to the roasted potatoes. Drain the roasted potatoes in absorbent paper and transfer it into a bowl. Step 5: Sprinkle the dry masalas- cumin powder, red chilli powder and amchur and toss. For the RiceIn a pan, heat ghee on medium flame, add cardamom, clove, bayleaf, cinnamon, and salt. Step 6: Add the milk and water and bring to a rolling boil. When the milk-water comes to a boil, reduce the flame add the drained rice, cover and cook until the moisture is fully absorbed. Once cooked, turn off the flame and set aside. Transfer the rice into a mixing bowl and allow it to cool. Once the rice has completely cooled, add the coriander leaves, mint leaves, fried onions and potatoes. Step 7: Give it a good mix. Step 8: For the Chole MasalaWash and soak the Kabuli Chana overnight. In a pressure cooker, add the kabuli chana, and one cup of water with salt. Step 9: Pressure cook for 6 whistles, and turn down the flame and continue to cook for another 3-4 minutes. Turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 10: Drain the chana from its water and set aside. Step 11: In a pan heat ghee, on low flame, ad ginger- garlic-green chili and saute for a couple of minutes, increase the flame to medium heat and add the tomatoes and cover and cook. The tomatoes will take about to soften. Step 12: Once they have softened, add the dry masalas- garam masala, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and chole masala. Step 13: Mix well. At this stage reduce the flame and add the yoghurt and the drained boiled chana. At the end of this procedure, we should have a semi gravy chole masala, the consistency shall not be too thick or too thin. To assemble Chole biryani recipeGrease a large glass bowl with ghee, sprinkle some coriander leaves, put a layer of the rice and press it down with the back of the ladle. Next add a layer of the chole masala. Step 14: Repeat the layers till the bowl is full. Step 15: You need press down each layer. Step 16: The final layer of the biryani must be rice. Once each of those layers are pressed down well, place a plate upside down over the bowl and over turn it. Step 17: You will get a chole biryani dome on your plate. Serve this Chole Biryani Recipe along with Mirchi Ka Salan Recipe (Chillies in Tangy Spicy Peanut Sesame Curry), Burani Raita Recipe (Garlic Based Yogurt), Pickled Onions and Methi Pakoras Recipe for a complete weekend meal.

Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, coriander seed, garam masala, salt and pepper, tomato paste, chicken legs, chicken broth, fresh cilantro, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place a large skillet over medium heat and add the oil. Step 2: When oil is hot, add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute. Step 3: Add the coriander, garam masala and salt and pepper, and cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Stir in the tomato paste, and then add the chicken legs. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt and let them cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the chicken broth, cilantro and crushed tomatoes, and let it simmer until the chicken is fully cooked, about 30 minutes. Step 7: Serve with plenty of sauce.

Ingredient Names: cilantro leaves, mint leaf, jalapeno, garlic cloves, ground cumin, fresh lemon juice, plain yogurt, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender or food processor, combine the cilantro, mint, jalapeo, garlic, cumin and lemon juice and puree to a paste. Step 2: Add the yogurt and puree until smooth, season with salt. Step 3: Allow at least an hour for the flavors to meld. Step 4: Make ahead the sauce can be refrigerated for up to 2 days.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro leaves, fresh mint leaves, onion, ground cumin, table salt, sugar, fresh lime juice, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Process all ingredients in food processor until smooth, about 20 seconds Scrape down sides of processor bowl after 10 seconds.

Ingredient Names: water, cinnamon sticks, cardamom pods, whole cloves, peppercorns, black tea, coconut milk, palm sugar, vanilla bean
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot bring 2 quarts of water to a boil over high heat While the water is heating, take the cinnamon sticks, cardamom pods and cloves and roughly grind or chop them Use a coffee grinder designated for spices for a couple of pulses. Step 2: Add the spices to the boiling water, along with the peppercorns and simmer for 10 minutes In the meantime pour the coconut milk, coconut sugar and vanilla bean and seeds into a small saucepan simmering over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has melted Do not let the mixture boil. Step 3: Remove the vanilla bean pod. Step 4: After ten minutes remove the water from heat and add the tea. Step 5: Let sit for 4-8 minutes and strain out the tea into a pitcher. Step 6: Add in the coconut milk mixture and serve.

Ingredient Names: milk, instant coffee powder, sugar, ice, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients in a blender and process till well blended Pour in two glasses and serve.

Ingredient Names: mutton, green chilies, black peppercorns, ginger-garlic paste, cloves, green cardamoms, fresh coriander leaves, cumin seed, cinnamon stick, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, cumin powder, eggs, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and drain the kheema properly. Step 2: Put 1 / 2 cup water in a vessel. Step 3: Add kheema, green chillies, ginger-garlic paste and salt to taste. Step 4: Cook for sometime, uncovered, until the water has dried. Step 5: Take a broad vessel, add oil. Step 6: Once it's hot, toss in the onion and mix well. Step 7: Add peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon, cardamoms and cumin seeds. Step 8: Fry till the onion becomes soft, add tomato.

Ingredient Names: corn, salt, water, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, dry red chilies, sunflower oil, garlic, ginger, onions, fresh coconut, mustard seeds, curry leaves, tomato puree, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, kashmiri red chili powder, green peas
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Corn and Peas Curry Recipe, we will first cook the corn on the cob. Step 2: Into a pressure cooker, add the cut corn along with salt and water, pressure cook for 2 whistles. Step 3: Turn off the heat and allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 4: Once done open the cooker, drain off the excess water and keep the corn aside. Step 5: The next step is to make the gravy for the Corn and Peas Curry. Heat a skillet on medium flame, dry roast the cumin seeds, coriander seeds and dry red chillies until fragrant this will take about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Transfer the dry roasted whole spices into a mixer jar. Step 7: Next in the same pan, add some oil and heat on medium flame, to this add the garlic cloves, ginger and onions. Step 8: Saute these for about 3-4 minutes until the onions turns soft and lightly brown. Step 9: Once done,stir in the grated coconut and saute for a minute. Mix well and turn off the heat. Step 10: Allow the mixture to cool and add it to the mixer jar that has the whole spices. Step 11: Grind everything into a smooth paste using some water and set aside. Step 12: Heat a kadai with oil on medium flame, to this add mustard seeds, and curry leaves and allow it to crackle. Step 13: Next add the tomato puree and bring it to a single boil. Step 14: Once it comes to a boil, add the freshly ground spice-onion paste mixture, and mix well to combine. Step 15: Now add the turmeric powder, garam masala and kashmiri red chilli powder and mix well. Step 16: At this stage add the boiled corn, into the gravy, adjust the consistency of the Corn and Peas Curry by adding the required amount of water. Step 17: Add the peas, cover and bring the Corn and Peas Curry to a brisk boil. Step 18: Check the salt and spices at this stage and adjust the taste accordingly. Step 19: Once done, turn off the heat, transfer the Corn and Peas Curry Recipe to a bowl and serve hot. Step 20: Serve Corn and Peas Curry Recipe along with Jeera Rice Recipe, Lachedar Kakdi Pyaz Kachumber Recipe - Onion Cucumber Salad and finish the meal with Paan Matka Kulfi Recipe as dessert.

Ingredient Names: corn kernel, tomato puree, onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, chili paste with garlic and ginger, black pepper, red chili pepper, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Soak corn kernels in warm water for 15 minutes and keep aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds and ginger garlic paste. Step 3: Now add finely chopped onions and saute it. Step 4: Add black pepper and tomato puree and let it simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Now add remaining tomatoes and chilly pwder, turmeric powder and coriander powder and mix it well. Step 6: When the paste thickens, add chopped bell peppers. Step 7: Add little water if it turns very dry. Step 8: Now add corn kernels and salt and saute for 10 minute. Step 9: Serve with paratha or chapati or rice.

Ingredient Names: yellow mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, ghee, red pepper flakes, ground ginger, asafoetida powder, garlic cloves, yellow onions, water, turmeric, jalapeno peppers, frozen corn kernels, yogurt, butter, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: In a small covered frying pan, toast the mustard seeds and fenugreek in 1 teaspoons of the ghee Use a lid on the pan, as the mustard seeds will pop. Step 2: Place in a mortar and add the red pepper flakes and ginger Pound into a paste, set aside. Step 3: Heat a 4-qt Saucepan and add the remaining ghee, asafetida, and garlic. Step 4: Saute for a couple of minutes and add the onion, then saute until golden brown and tender. Step 5: Add the water, pounded ingredients, and turmeric. Step 6: Cook a few minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, pumpkin, whole cloves, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, curry powder, cracked wheat, vegetable broth, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, pumpkin, and spices. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add small amounts of water if necessary, about a tbsp at a time, to prevent sticking, add cracked wheat. Step 5: Cook and stir, 2 minutes. Step 6: Stir in broth, salt and pepper. Step 7: When mixture boils, cover saucepan, reduce heat to low, and cook 15 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed Fluff pilaf with a fork before serving. Step 8: Remove and discard cloves, cinnamon sticks, and bay leaves.

Ingredient Names: fresh cranberries, onion, raisins, cider vinegar, sugar, light brown sugar, orange zest, orange juice, salt, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, ground cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, stir together all ingredients, bring to boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring often, for 20 minutes or until thickened. Step 3: Pour into hot, sterilized half-pint jars, leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace Seal and process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes. Step 4: Store in cool, dark, dry place.

Ingredient Names: urad dal, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green chili, oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, chili powder, garam masala, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Bring daal to boil in 6 cups water, lower heat and simmer for 1 hour or until daal feels soft. Step 2: Drain daal and reserve liquid. Step 3: Blend onion, garlic, ginger and chilli together in blender to form a paste, or finely chop them together with a knife. Step 4: Heat oil in frying pan and fry onion mixture over high heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown. Step 5: Add cumin and coriander and fry for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the daal, salt, chilli powder and garam masala. Step 7: Pour 300 mel or 1 1 / 4 cups of reserved liquid into pan, bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes Just before serving stir in the cream and simmer 2 minutes to heat through.

Ingredient Names: unsweetened dried shredded coconut, peanut oil, onions, chilies, garlic, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ground coriander, cashew pieces, salt & freshly ground black pepper, broccoli, green beans, frozen peas, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put the coconut into a bowl and cover with 2 cups of boiling water. Step 2: Stir, and let sit for 20 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile heat the oil in a large saucepan, then put in the onion. Step 4: Cover, and let cook over gentle heat for 7 minutes While the onion is cooking, halve the chilies, remove the seeds, then slice the chilies finely and add to the saucepan, along with the garlic. Step 5: Add the spices to the saucepan, stir well, and cook for a further 1 to 2 minutes. Step 6: Strain the coconut liquid, discarding the solids If you have a food processor or blender, whizz the cashews to a smooth, creamy consistency with the coconut liquid Or, grind the cashews as finely as you can, then mix with the coconut liquid Either way, add this mixture to the saucepan.

Ingredient Names: spinach, onion, tomatoes, ginger, green chilies, salt, turmeric powder, oil, garlic, cumin, coriander, chili powder, cream cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the first 7 ingredients in one cup water for about 10 minutes. Step 2: When little cold, puree in a blender, adding more water as needed. Step 3: Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat. Step 4: Saute the garlic and the spices. Step 5: Add cream cheese and spinach. Step 6: Cook for 10-15 mins To desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: pineapple tidbits, brown sugar, pineapple juice, curry powder, salt, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 / 2 cup of the juice. Step 2: In a large nonstick skillet, combine brown sugar, reserved pineapple juice, curry powder, and slat. Step 3: Heat over medium heat, stirring until brown sugar is dissolved. Step 4: Add pineapple tidbits and carrots. Step 5: Mix well, making sure the spices are evenly distributed. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover skillet, and cook 15 minutes. Step 7: Stir once halfway through cooking time, serve hot. Step 8: Refrigerate leftovers.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, tea leaves, salt, water, ghee, cumin seed, onion, ginger, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, ground cayenne pepper, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sieve or colander, wash the chickpeas under cold running water until the draining water runs clear. Step 2: Drop the chick-peas into a large bowl or pan, pour in enough water to cover them by at least 2 inches, and let them soak at room temperature uncovered for 12 hours or overnight. Step 3: Drain the chick-peas in a large colander or sieve, place them in a heavy 3-4 quart saucepan, and add the tea leaves, salt, and 4 cups of the water. Step 4: Bring to a boil over high heat, partially cover the pan, reduce the heat to low and simmer. Step 5: In a separate 3-4 quart saucepan, heat the ghee over high heat until a drop of water flicked into it splutters instantly. Step 6: Add the cumin seeds and stir 30 seconds, then add the onions and ginger. Step 7: Lower the heat to moderate and, stirring constantly, fry the mixture for 7-8 minutes, until the onions are soft and golden brown Watch carefully for signs of burning and regulate the heat accordingly. Step 8: Stir in the turmeric, cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, red pepper, and 1 tblsp.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, unsalted butter, curry powder, salt, flour, black pepper, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Place cabbage in saucepan and cover with at least 1" water. Step 2: Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes, drain cabbage. Step 3: In a skillet, melt butter over lowheat, and add curry powder, flour, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes, remove from heat. Step 5: Add milk slowly, while stirring to avoid lumping, and return to heat. Step 6: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: When thickened, stir cabbage into sauce and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: aubergine, oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground ginger, cumin powder, coriander powder, chili powder, turmeric, tomato paste, coconut milk, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onion till light golden colour. Step 2: Add the spices, cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomato paste, stir in the coconut milk. Step 4: Cook to form a gravy. Step 5: Add the aubergine, and tomato, stir into the gravy, reduce heat to medium and cook till aubergine is tender About 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: brown onions, turmeric powder, oil, curry powder, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and finely chop onions. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat. Step 3: Add the onions and turmeric powder. Step 4: Cook the onions until golden brown. Step 5: Add curry powder or paste and mix well. Step 6: Turn off heat after 2 minutes. Step 7: Add chopped coriander leaf. Step 8: Serve with pita bread or toast.

Ingredient Names: ground coriander, curry powder, ground cumin, ground turmeric, salt, ground pepper, eggs, toast
Instructions: Step 1: Fill medium saucepan with about 3 inches of water. Step 2: Stir in coriander, curry powder, cumin, turmeric, salt and pepper, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat to a gentle simmer Break one egg into a small dish Gently slip egg into water. Step 4: Repeat with remaining eggs. Step 5: Cook in barely simmering water for 3 to 5 minutes. Step 6: Remove eggs with a slotted spoon and drain well. Step 7: Serve immediately on crisp buttered toast.

Dish Name: Curried Potatoes And Peas Alu Mattar
Ingredient Names: ghee, fresh ginger, garlic, onion, salt, ground cumin, turmeric, ground cayenne pepper, firm ripe tomatoes, coriander, green peas, potato, water, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy 2-3 quart sauce pan, heat the ghee over high heat until a drop of water flicked into it splutters instantly. Step 2: Stir in the ginger and garlic, then add the onions and salt. Step 3: Lower the heat to moderate and, stirring constantly add the cumin, turmeric and red pepper. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes and 2 tblsp Of coriander Still stirring, cook briskly for 5 minutes, until most of the liquid in the pan evaporates and the mixture is thick enough to draw away from the sides and bottom of the pan in a dense mass. Step 5: Drop in the peas and potatoes and turn them about with the spoon until they are evenly coated with the tomato mixture. Step 6: Stir in the water, bring to a boil over high heat, cover tightly, and reduce the heat to low. Step 7: Simmer for 10 minutes, or until the peas and potatoes are tender but still intact. Step 8: Taste for seasonings and serve at once, sprinkled with the remaining tblsp.

Ingredient Names: turkey breast, flour, curry powder, turmeric, chili powder, salt, black pepper, egg, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice turkey breast into strips. Step 2: In a medium bowl combine all dry ingredients. Step 3: In a separate bowl beat egg. Step 4: Using one hand for the wet and the other for the dry, dredge the turkey in the egg followed by the flour mixture. Step 5: Repeat until all strips are coated. Step 6: Drizzle about a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Place turkey strips in skillet, cook for 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Flip strips, cook an additional 3-4 minutes until cooked through, taking care to not overcook or the turkey will become incredibly dry.

Ingredient Names: frozen mixed vegetables, plain yogurt, cornstarch, vegetable oil, cumin seed, fennel seed, mustard seeds, ground turmeric, onion powder, coriander, cinnamon, garlic cloves, dried red chilies, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Poke a few holes into the bag of veggies and microwave on high for 3 minutes to thaw. Step 2: Mix together the yogurt and cornstarch, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a frying pan over med High heat. Step 4: Add cumin seeds, fennel seeds and mustard seeds and cover pan with splatter screen. Step 5: Stir occassionally until they begin to pop. Step 6: Now turn the heat down to medium and add turmeric, onion powder, coriander, cinnamon, garlic, and chiles Sautee until the garlic turns golden brown Slowly add in vegetables, sugar, salt and pepper and cook till veggies are heated thorougly About 5 minutes or so.

Ingredient Names: beef, beer, canola oil, onion, curry powder, minced ginger, garlic, round steak, bell peppers, white pearl onions, roma tomatoes, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Day 1: Measure beer without a head. Step 2: Mix with remaining ingredients, excepting meat and vegetables. Step 3: Pour marinade over beef in sealable container. Step 4: Refrigerate overnight Day 2: If you wish, the vegetables can all be prepped the day before and kept in the refrigerator until it's time to assemble to kebabs. Step 5: Bring large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Step 6: Add halved peppers. Step 7: Cook for about 10 minutes, or until the red peppers begin to lose their skins.

Ingredient Names: lentils, tomatoes, turmeric, water, oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, chilies, onion, garlic, chili powder, curry powder, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lentils, tomato, turmeric, and water, boil until done. Step 2: Add oil to a fry pan. Step 3: Add black mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Step 4: Add chilies and onion. Step 5: Add garlic, chili powder, and curry powder. Step 6: Cook until seeds pop and veggies are limp, add spinach, add lentils, mix.

Ingredient Names: onion, red capsicum, garlic, curry powder, tomatoes, chickpeas, potatoes, natural yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Coat large saucepan with cooking spray and cook onion, capsicum, garlic and curry powder, stirring, until onion is soft. Step 2: Add undrained tomatoes, chickpeas and potato and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes or until potato is tender, stirring occasionally, top with yoghurt.

Dish Name: Curry Masala Use To Make Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: coriander, cumin, garlic powder, fenugreek seeds, turmeric, paprika, chili powder, asafoetida powder, ginger, mustard powder, black pepper, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the spices together. Step 2: Fry 75 grams of butter in a frying pan Use 2 tbsp only of the curry masala and mix with water so that the mixture sluggishly drips off a spoon. Step 3: Add the curry paste to the melted butter and cook on a high heat for 2 minutes, keep stirring. Step 4: After this time, the paste is now ready and you can add meat, poultry or fish depending upon the curry you wish to make.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, passata, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, green cardamom seeds, vegetable oil, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onions in the oil on a medium heat until the onions are soft and translucent. Step 2: Add garlic and saute for 1 minute. Step 3: Add tomatoes and cook for a further 3 minutes. Step 4: Add half the water and simmer for 5 minutes then add the rest of the water and spices. Step 5: Stir in well and simmer for a further 5 minutes. Step 6: Keep stirring regularly throughout cooking. Step 7: Take the pan off the heat and leave to cool slightly before pureeing in a food processor.

Dish Name: Dahi Wale Paneer - Paneer In A Curd Gravy
Ingredient Names: paneer, garlic, ginger, fresh red chilies, red bell pepper, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, curd, butter, onions, tomato puree, whole cashews, fresh cream, coriander leaves, lemon juice, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe, add ginger, garlic and fresh red chillies in a mortar and pestle and grind it to paste. In a bowl, add capsicum, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and mix everything well. Divide this mixture into half and keep in an another bowl. Step 2: In one of them, add curd, salt, paneer and mix everything well. Step 3: Keep it aside to marinate for about 2 hours. To make the gravy for the Paneer Curry, heat butter in a heavy bottomed pan on low heat. Step 4: Add onions and saute till it turns soft. Once the onions turn soft, add the ginger garlic chilli paste and cook it for about 1 hour. Step 5: After, add the capsicum mixture and let it cook till the capsicum turns a little soft. Once done, add the tomato puree, turmeric powder, cashew or almond paste, salt, required water and give it a mix. Step 6: Let it cook for about 3 to. After 3 to, turn the flame to low and add the whisked curd. Step 7: Cook it for another 2 minutes. Meanwhile, shallow fry or grill the paneer pieces on a non stick pan, using oil as required. Step 8: Cook from both the sides till it turns golden brown. Add the fresh cream and mix it again. Step 9: Add the paneer cubes and mix everything properly. Cook for about 2 minutes, add the lemon juice and garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe along with Palak Dal, Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita, Jeera Rice, Phulka and Kachumber Salad for a weekend meal.

Dish Name: Dal Dhokli With Sprouted Moong Dal
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, gram flour, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander leaves, green moong sprouts, coriander powder, cinnamon stick, kokum, jaggery, raw peanuts, lemon juice, salt, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, green chilies, curry leaves, asafoetida, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Dal Dhokli Recipe With Sprouted Moong Dal, we will first make the dal. Step 2: To Make The DhokliIn a large mixing bowl, combine the wheat flour, gram flour, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, and coriander leaves. Step 3: Add water little by little and make a firm and smooth dough. Step 4: Dust the dough in flour and roll out the dough into a large circle and cut the dough into desired shape (either into strips or into a flower using a cookie cutter). Keep the dhokli aside. To Make Dal DhokliInto a pressure cooker, add the sprouts, turmeric powder, salt, cinnamon stick, kokum, jaggery, salt and water. Close the pressure cooker and pressure cook for two whistles. Turn off the heat and allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 5: Once we open the pressure cooker, add in the lemon juice and coriander leaves, check the salt and spices. Step 6: Add water to the dal and then turn the heat back on to high heat until it come to brisk boil. Once the dal comes to a boil, add the dhokli into the dal and allow it to simmer and get cooked in the dal. Step 7: This will not take more than to cook the dhokli. Step 8: Adjust the consistency of the Dal Dhokli, by adding more water if required. Step 9: In the meantime, in a tadka pan heat a tablespoon of ghee. Step 10: Add the mustard seeds, cumin seeds and allow it to crackle. Step 11: Once it crackles, add the green chilies, curry leaves and add to the add. Finally squeeze in the lemon and stir in the coriander leaves and serve. Step 12: Serve the Dal Dhokli With Sprouted Moong Dal topped with melted ghee and Kachumber Salad, papad, for a simple sunday lunch.

Ingredient Names: pigeon peas, soyabean nuggets, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilies, turmeric powder, red chili powder, curry leaves, salt, oil, red chilies, mustard seeds, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and soak dal for 3-4 hours. Step 2: Soak soyabean nuggets in plenty of water for 2-3 hours. Step 3: Drain off water and squeeze out water Re-soak in fresh water for half an hour. Step 4: Drain and then squeeze out excess water. Step 5: Now the nuggets are ready for cooking In the meantime, make a smooth paste of onion, tomato, garlic, green chillies and ginger, keep aside. Step 6: Drain the dal water and pour in 2 cups water Pressure cook till done.

Ingredient Names: potato, onions, ghee, black mustard seeds, ground turmeric, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place the potatoes in a pan, add enough water to just cover, bring to the boil and cook until tender. Step 2: Drain potatoes, allow to cool, then peel and dice. Step 3: Chop the onions finely. Step 4: Heat the ghee or peanut oil in a medium-size skillet. Step 5: Add the mustard seeds and saute until they pop. Step 6: Add the onions, reduce heat and continue frying until they are soft and browned Next add the turmeric and chili powder to the skillet, and stir. Step 7: Finally, add the potatoes, sprinkle with salt and gently toss all the ingredients until mixed together Can be served hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, pure chile powder, hungarian paprika, natural yogurt, tomatoes, chicken stock, salt, whipping cream, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Place the oil in a medium to large non-stick lidded pan and heat over a medium-high flame. Step 2: Add the sliced onions when the oil is hot, and stir and saute about 6 minutes until they become reddish brown in color. Step 3: Toss in the ginger and garlic and continue to stir and fry for a minute Next add the ground spices, namely the coriander, cumin, turmeric, chile powder and paprika, and mix and stir for around 10 seconds Start adding the yoghurt, a tablespoon at a time, stirring well after each addition until it is absorbed. Step 4: Place all the finely chopped tomatoes in the pan and cook, stirring, for 3-4 minutes, until they become pulpy- you can mash them with the back of a wooden spoon, or a potato masher, to aid the process. Step 5: When the tomatoes are pulped to your liking, add the chicken stock and salt to taste, bring to the boil, cover the pan, then gently simmer the sauce for 15-20 minutes over a low heat, during which time it will thicken The sauce can be prepared to this stage ahead of time. Step 6: When ready to serve, stir the whipping cream, garam masala, chilies and cilantro into the heated sauce, then season with more salt if necessary Lay the hard-boiled eggs in a single layer, cut side up, in the sauce, and spoon some sauce over them.

Ingredient Names: evaporated milk, ground cardamom, ground allspice, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place milk and spices into a very clean jar, shake to mix and chill. Step 2: Let set for 24 hours for optimum flavor, though i have used it immediately because i was impatient The longer it sits, the stronger the flavors get, and it will last for a few weeks in the fridge Use 2-3 tablespoons per cup with your favorite tea and sweeten with your favorite sweetener I'm partial to green tea and honey myself.

Ingredient Names: oil, curry leaves, fenugreek seeds, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, pork, curry powder, chilies, salt, vinegar, raw sugar, hot water, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil to pan. Step 2: Add curry leaves and fenugreek seeds to pan, and fire for a moment or two. Step 3: Add onions, garlic and ginger, and fry over medium heat until golden brown. Step 4: Add diced pork, curry powder, chillies, salt, vinegar, sugar. Step 5: Toss until pork is coated in spice mixture and until spices are fragrant. Step 6: Add hot water, and cover pan with lid. Step 7: Simmer for 1 5 to 2 hours until pork is very tender. Step 8: Add coconut milk, and stir. Step 9: Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary.

Ingredient Names: water, ginger, tea bag, honey, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to boil with crushed ginger in it. Step 2: Let it simmer for 5-7 minutes on medium heat. Step 3: Strain and pour in the cup / mug, add tea bag and stir honey You can add a dash of milk if you want It is very good to sip anyway.

Dish Name: Dhaba Style Egg Curry in Electric Pressure Cooker
Ingredient Names: eggs, ghee, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, asafoetida, cloves, bay leaf, black cardamom, cardamom pods, dry red chilies, ginger, garlic, onion, tomato puree, curd, kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt, water, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Dhaba Style Egg Curry, prep all the ingredients and keep them ready. Boil the eggs and keep them ready as well. Place the mode of the pressure cooker into the saute mode. Heat ghee into the electric pressure cooker; add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, hing, bay leaf, red chilli, black cardamom, green cardamom, cloves until you can smell the aromas coming through. Add the finely chopped onion, ginger, garlic and cook them till they turn soft and translucent. Step 2: After a minute, add all the dry masalas including kashmiri red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and the required salt. Step 3: Let it cook for about 3 to. Next, add the tomato puree and cook for about 5 to. Step 4: After 5 to, add the curd and the required water. Mix properly, cover the electric pressure cooker. Set the mode to gravy mode and allow the pressure cooker to do cook until turns itself on to the keep warm mode. Once done, stir in the coriander leaves, check the salt and adjust according to taste. Once done, transfer the Dhaba Egg Curry into a serving bowl and serve hot. Dhaba Style Egg Curry is usually served on the road side dhabas in North Indian with Bajra Ki Roti or Makki Ki Roti.

Ingredient Names: red lentils, salt, curry powder, canned whole tomatoes, onion, water, garlic clove, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine in pan lentils, salt, curry powder, undrained chopped tomatoes, onion and water. Step 2: Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 50-60 minutes, or until lentils are tender. Step 3: Pour half the mixture into blender, blend on medium speed 30 seconds, repeat with the rest of the curry, stir in garlic & oil.

Dish Name: Dhania Chole Masala - Chickpeas In Fresh Coriander Gravy
Ingredient Names: coriander leaves, green chilies, ginger, salt, lemon, chickpeas, ghee, onion, garlic, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, black cardamom, black salt, garam masala powder, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Dhania Chole Masala, wash and soak the chana or chickpeas overnight. Step 2: Drain the water in which the chickpeas/chole is soaked in. Step 3: Pressure cook the drained chana along with water and salt for 6 whistles. Step 4: After 6 whistles reduce the heat to low and continue to cook for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 6: The chana has be cooked well once you open the pressure cooker. Step 7: Once done, when you press between your fingers to should mash easily. The next step is to make the Dhania Masala. Into a mixer grinder, add the coriander, ginger and green chillies, along with a little salt and lemon juice. Step 8: Add water and blend to make a smooth mixture like a chutney. Step 9: Keep the Dhania Masala aside. Heat ghee in a pan over medium heat; add the onion, ginger and garlic and saute until the onion softens. Step 10: Add the bay leaves, cinnamon stick, badi elaichi and saute for a few more seconds until you can smell the aromas. After a few seconds, add the garam masala, coriander powder, kala namak and the dhania masala. Step 11: Give it a stir. Add the cooked chana, give it a stir. Step 12: Add water if required to adjust the consistency of the chana masala. Step 13: Cover the pan and simmer the Dhania Chole Masala for a good. After, you will notice that the chole is well coated with the dhania masala. Step 14: At this stage, check the taste and adjust the salt and chilli accordingly. Once done, turn off the heat and transfer the Dhania Chole Masala to a serving bowl and serve hot. Serve the Dhania Chole Masala, along with Puri, Paneer in White Gravy, Lacha Pyaz and Chaas for a delicious weekend lunch.

Ingredient Names: fresh spinach, cilantro, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, cayenne, mustard seeds, ghee, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, chop, and steam spinach. Step 2: Wash and chop cilantro, discarding lower stems. Step 3: Heat ghee in saucepan on medium-high setting. Step 4: Once ghee is hot, add mustard seed. Step 5: Once mustard seeds pop, add chopped onion and sautee till translucent. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 7: Add to pan the steamed spinach, cumin, coriander, salt, and cayenne. Step 8: Remove pan from heat and add chopped cilantro, stir. Step 9: Serve with your favorite indian main dish.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrots, green beans, green chili, green capsicum, potatoes, onions, ginger, garlic, green chilies, tomatoes, coriander powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, salt, oil, bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom, celery, paneer, butter, cashew nuts, pineapple, pomegranate, raisins, green coriander, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To make Navratan Korma (dry), first of all prepare the ingredients. Step 2: Now heat oil in a pan and add pieces of paneer to it. Step 3: Fry it well and drain it to soak more oil on a tissue. Step 4: Add some more oil and add all the spices. Step 5: After 10 seconds, add onion and cook till it becomes soft. Step 6: After the onion is soft, add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, cook it for 2 to. Step 7: Now add tomato puree and cook for 3 to. Step 8: Now add chopped vegetables to it. Step 9: Mix well and then add coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala and let it cook for 5 minutes. Step 10: Add cashew paste and butter after and mix them all. Step 11: After this, add water and cover the pan. Step 12: Allow it to cook for 7 to. Step 13: When the vegetables become soft, add raisins and cashews to it. Step 14: After add pineapple and pomegranate to it. Step 15: Turn off the gas, add pieces of panner and garnish the green. Step 16: Serve Navratan Korma (dry) with Phulka, Panchamel Dal and Bundi Raita for dinner.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, white vinegar, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground cinnamon, duck, vegetable oil, salt, water, sugar, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Soak chiles in vinegar for 15 minutes. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger and blend into a pure Scrape mixture into a small bowl. Step 3: Add cumin, coriander and cinnamon and mix thoroughly Coat duck pieces well with spice paste. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Step 5: Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add duck pieces and brown on all sides. Step 7: Add salt, water, sugar and any remaining spice pure, bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Dum Pukht Gosht - Slow Cooked Mutton Curry
Ingredient Names: mutton, curd, cardamom pods, black cardamom, black peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon stick, cumin seeds, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilies, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, coriander leaves, ghee, whole wheat flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Dum Pukht Gosht we will first prepare the ingredients required for marinating the mutton. Step 2: Heat ghee in a preheated pan; add the onions and saute until the onion turn golden brown. Once the onions have started to turn golden brown add all the whole spices, black cardamom, green cardamom, cloves, cinnamon stick, peppercorn and saute till the spices release a nice aroma. Step 3: Turn off the heat and let it cool. Once cooled add the caramelized onions and the whole spices to a mixer grinder. Step 4: Add the garlic, ginger, green chillies and half the curd and grind to a smooth paste. Step 5: Marinate the mutton with the above ground spice curd and onion mixture. Step 6: Add the remaining curd, chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder,garam masala powder, salt to taste to the above mutton and marinate it in the refrigerator for two hours or overnight. You can marinate the meat longer to get maximum flavour in the dish. Step 7: While the mutton is marinating knead the dough that you need to seal the vessel in which you are going to cook the gosht in. Step 8: The dough should be a bit stiff, like how you knead for puris.*To make the Dum Pukht GoshtOnce the mutton has marinated, preheat a heavy bottomed vessel or handi and add some ghee. Add the marinated mutton in the handi and saute for a few minutes till the marinated mutton leaves oil on the sides. Step 9: This will take about 10 minutes. Step 10: Add one glass of water and bring the Mutton gosht to a boil. Cover the handi with a lid and seal it with the wheat dough and leave the Mutton gosht cook on low heat for about 10 minutes. Step 11: This process of covering and sealing the lid with the dough is called "Dum Cooking" - a very slow cooking process that brings in flavours to the dish. After about one hour turn off the heat and remove the dough on the lid with the help of a kitchen knife. You will notice the Dum Pukht Gosht has a rich colour and taste with all the natural oils from the the mutton released into the dish. Step 12: Give it a stir and adjust the salt accordingly. Step 13: Transfer the Dum Pukht Gosht into a serving dish and garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve Dum Pukht Gosht with hot with Mande Roti or Butter Garlic Naan and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita for a weekend lunch or dinner. Step 14: You can even serve it at your next dinner party.

Ingredient Names: mutton, sunflower oil, water, ginger, garlic, onion, curd, rose water, saffron strands, coriander leaves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, bay leaves, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, nutmeg powder, cardamom powder, salt, whole wheat flour
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Awadhi Khaas Nihari Recipe, firstly slowly add water into the whole wheat flour and make a tight dough. Step 2: This dough is to seal the vessel. Step 3: Once it is ready, keep it aside. Heat oil in a wok/ pan and add whole spices (green cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, black cardamom and bay leaves. Now add the meat and saute for 3-4 minutes. Add salt and turmeric and mix well. Step 4: Pour in the water, cover the pan and cook. When it comes to a boil, immediately add ginger- garlic paste, coriander powder, red chilli and onion paste. Now add nicely whisked yogurt, rose water, garam masala, nutmeg and cinnamon powder and saffron soaked milk/water. Cover the lid and cook for 30 minutes. Now transfer the prepared meat mix in a broad base heavy bottom vessel/ handi. Cover the with a lid and seal it with the wheat dough and leave to cook on slow fire. Step 5: This may take 1. Once the meat is cooked till tender, garnish with fresh coriander and ginger juliennes. Serve Awadhi Khaas Nihari Recipe hot with roomali roti or butter garlic naan and rice.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, plain fat-free yogurt, cold water, salt, stevia powder
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw the mango. Step 2: Puree thawed mango in the food processor until smooth. Step 3: Add salt, yogurt, and stevia powder, process until smooth, add water, mix to blend, serve as desired! Step 4: I like mine over ice with a straw:d can be pre-made and stored in advance too It keeps for days and doesn't separate.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, garlic, spinach, turmeric, cayenne powder, salt, curry powder, garam masala, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Steam or boil the potatoes in salted water until very tender. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: In a large dutch oven put the oil, mustard seeds, and cumin seeds. Step 4: Heat over high heat until the mustard seeds have popped for a few seconds Quickly stir in the garlic. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium. Step 6: Add the spinach and stir-fry until tender, adding a couple tablespoons of water if needed If the spinach is still half frozen, that doesn't matter, just add it anyway. Step 7: Once the spinach is cooked, stir in the turmeric, cayenne, salt, curry powder and garam masala. Step 8: When everything is well blended, add the cooked potatoes and mix until the spinach mixture is evenly distributed with the potatoes.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onions, dried garlic, sugar, salt, black pepper, bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Take a non stick heavy bottom pan and heat the oil. Step 2: Put bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon first and then add onion, garlic, salt and black pepper powder. Step 3: Saute for 2 minutes and add chopped tomatoes, salt and sugar. Step 4: Keep covered and stirring for 10 minutes or until tomatoes are soft. Step 5: Allow to cool to the room temperature, add nutmeg now. Step 6: Put the mixture in the blender and blend till smooth. Step 7: Fill in a sterilised jar and keep refrigerated.

Ingredient Names: onion, tomatoes, salt, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander seeds, red pepper, turmeric powder, green chilies, garlic, fresh ginger, tomato paste, water, eggs, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large blender add the oinion, tomatoes, tomato paste, garam masala, turmeric, cumin powder coriander seed powder, crushed red pepper, green chillies, garlic cloves and piece of ginger. Step 2: Add a bit of water to help it blend. Step 3: Blend until you get a smooth paste 2. Step 4: In a deep pan add the oil and let it heat up for a minute on medium high. Step 5: Add the paste stir fry for a couple of minutes and then turn to medium heat to let it cook for about 6 minute 3. Step 6: Add potatoes and water and let it cook on low to medium heat. Step 7: Keep cheking every 10 minutes to see if the potatoes are cooked by taking a knife and inserting it in a piece).

Ingredient Names: eggs, coconut, poppy seed, cashews, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, red chili powder, coriander powder, fennel seed, onion, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Grind coconut, poppy seeds, fennel seeds and cashewnuts to a fine paste and keep aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 3: Add the chopped onion and saute. Step 4: Once it is golden brown, add the ginger-garlic paste, the peeled and chopped tomato, red chilli powder, coriander powder and the ground paste. Step 5: Add 1 big cup of water. Step 6: Cook on low flame for 5 minutes Break eggs into it, cover. Step 7: Allow to cook on low flame for 5 minutes. Step 8: Turn each egg carefully and allow it to cook for another 5 minutes on low flame.

Dish Name: Egg Islands In Tomato Sesame Gravy
Ingredient Names: eggs, onion paste, garlic paste, ginger paste, tomato puree, sesame seeds, salt, black pepper, red chili powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan. Step 2: Add onion, garlic and ginger paste Wait till it becomes pinkish brown. Step 3: Add salt, black pepper powder, red chili powder and roasted sesame seeds powder. Step 4: Stir well Wait for a few seconds and allow the spices to mix and proceed to add tomato puree. Step 5: Saute till gravy is well done and raw smell is gone. Step 6: Add some water if the gravy thickens up Gently put the boiled eggs in the mixture and close the lid for 10 minutes on medium heat Alternatively, transfer to the dish and microwave for 5-6 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, onions, ginger, green chilies, ghee, salt, garam masala, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the onions, ginger and chillies to form a paste This is the'masala paste' Hard boil the eggs Peel the eggs. Step 2: Cut the eggs into equal halves. Step 3: Heat ghee / oil in a small skillet. Step 4: Fry the masala paste for 4-5 minutes till the onions turn golden brown Carefully place the halved eggs in the prepared masala. Step 5: Fry for 2 minutes on low flame, add milk.

Ingredient Names: eggs, bread, salt and pepper, tomato ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven for 2 minutes. Step 2: Beat the egg whites of the 2 eggs, one at a time, till stiff. Step 3: Now take the 2 bread slices and using a spoon, apply the egg whites in the 4 corners of each slice. Step 4: Put the entire egg yolk in the center of each slice. Step 5: Place on a wire rack. Step 6: Bake for 5 minutes till golden brown on either side. Step 7: Remove from oven, place on a plate. Step 8: Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste. Step 9: Decorate with tomato ketchup on each slice Enjoy it as picnic food or as a morning or evening snack!

Ingredient Names: eggs, potatoes, tomatoes, onion, green chilies, fresh cilantro, breadcrumbs, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes, peel, mash well and keep aside Peel and chop the onions. Step 2: Wash the tomato and green chillies and chop them very fine Clean, wash and chop the coriander leaves. Step 3: Heat a tablespoon of ghee and fry the onion till pink. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and cook for a few minutes. Step 5: Add salt and chopped coriander leaves and stir to mix well Break in five eggs one by one, stirring continuously till the mixture thickens and sets. Step 6: Remove from heat and cool. Step 7: Beat the remaining egg well in a saucepan and keep aside.

Ingredient Names: eggs, ghee, red chili powder, whole black peppercorns, green chilies, garlic, ginger, basmati rice, onions, tomato, curd, mint leaves, coriander leaves, lemon juice, water, cumin seeds, cardamom pods, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, star anise, turmeric powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Egg Pulao recipe, we will firstly fry the eggs. Step 2: In a pan, heat ghee and add the boiled eggs. Add red chilli powder and toss well. Step 3: Add freshly cracked pepper and fry until eggs are slightly brown and a little crisp. Step 4: Keep them aside. The next step is to make the pulao. Step 5: Take another deep bottom pan or handi, heat ghee or oil. Add cumin seeds, green cardamom, cinnamon, black peppercorns, star anise and fry them for few seconds till the cumin seeds crackle. Meanwhile, add green chilli, garlic and ginger in a grinder and make a paste. Once the cumin seeds crackle, add the ground coarse paste of green chili, garlic, ginger and saute for a minute. Add onions and fry until it just starts picking up the golden color. Step 6: Do not over-fry the onions. Add sliced tomatoes, slit green chilies and cook until the tomatoes are mushy. Step 7: Add turmeric and mix everything properly. After, add in the whisked yogurt and stir until the yogurt is well combined with the spices. Add salt, chopped mint, lemon juice and coriander leaves. Step 8: Cook for half a minute. Add soaked and drained rice and gently mix it. Step 9: Give a slight slit to the fried eggs and add it along with the water. Step 10: Bring it to a boil and cook until 80% of the water dries up. Cover and simmer until done. Step 11: (Approximately for 15 to )Gently fluff up the rice using a fork. Step 12: Cover, let it rest for few minutes and Egg Pulao is ready to be served. Step 13: Serve Egg Pulao along with Burani Raita, Beetroot Raita or any other Raita of your choice and a roasted papad for your everyday meal.

Dish Name: Eggplant Tomato And Green Onion Curry
Ingredient Names: green onions, plain yogurt, mexican chili powder, turmeric, ground cayenne pepper, salt, eggplant, chopped tomato, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the green onions, the white parts, 1 / 4 inch long and the green parts 3 / 4 inch long, set aside. Step 2: In a large mixing bowl, combine yogurt, chili powder, turmeric, cayenne and salt. Step 3: Add eggplant, tomatoes and onions and stir well to make sure the veggies are well coated. Step 4: In a shallow heavy pan, heat oil on medium-high heat for 45 seconds. Step 5: Pour curry into the pan and stir well Saut about 3 minutes, reduce the heat to medium-low and cover. Step 6: Simmer for another 10 minutes, stirring once halfway. Step 7: Turn off the heat and stir once more If you are not serving the curry right away, remove the lid or it will become to mushy.

Ingredient Names: whole black peppercorns, cardamom powder, paprika powder, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, nutmeg, rice, red lentils, macaroni pasta, onions, garlic, vegetable stock, bay leaves, salt, extra virgin olive oil, tomatoes, red wine vinaigrette, red chili flakes, salt and pepper, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Egyptian Koshari Recipe, first prepare the Baharat spice blend. Step 2: To do this, dry roast the whole spices (excluding nutmeg) in a pan on medium heat, without burning them. Step 3: Cool them down and then grind into a powder in a mixer or coffee grinder, along with ground cinnamon and nutmeg. Store in dry, airtight container and use as needed. Next, prepare the rice. Step 4: To do this, warm some olive oil in a pan and add washed and drained rice to it. Step 5: Saute the rice for 3-4 minutes and add the vegetable stock or water and bring it to boil. Then, cover the pan and cook on a low heat for 10 minutes or until rice is done. Meanwhile, wash and soak brown lentils in enough water. Step 6: Cook them in a sauce pan, covered, for in a pan with garlic, cumin and bay leaf and water. Alternatively cook in pressure cooker for 3 whistles with the same ingredients. Once cooked, add salt and drain completely. Step 7: Set aside until later use. Cook the macaroni/vermicelli as per packet instructions in a pot of water and set aside while you prepare the sauce. To make the sauce, place a pan on the heat and add some olive oil. Step 8: When it is warm, add the garlic and onions and saute to cook on high heat for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown in color. Add the tomato puree, baharat mix, salt, pepper, chilli flakes and red wine vinegar. Step 9: Cook, covered on medium heat for 5 minutes. Now that all the components are ready, let's assemble the Koshari. In a wide serving dish add cooked rice, lentils and macaroni/vermicelli. Step 10: Toss well until combined. Serve it into individual bowls or plates, sprinkle some baharat masala over each serving and top with some spicy tomato sauce. Step 11: Add some garbanzo beans and crispy fried onions. Serve Egyptian Koshari as a wholesome weeknight meal along with Light And Healthy Spinach Soup.

Dish Name: Fansi Muthia Nu Shaak - Green Beans With Gram Flour Dumplings
Ingredient Names: green beans, mustard seeds, carom seeds, asafoetida, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, dry mango powder, jaggery, salt, sunflower oil, gram flour, dried fenugreek, sugar, fruit salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Fansi Muthia Nu Shaak Recipe, add the green beans into a pressure cooker, with water, salt to taste and pressure cook for 2 whistles. Step 2: Turn off the heat and release the pressure immediately to retain the bright green color of the beans. Step 3: Open the pressure cooker and keep aside.*To make the Muthia:In a small bowl combine the ingredients for the muthia - Gram flour, kasuri methi, turmeric powder, sugar, asafoetida, enos fruit salt, lemon juice, cooking oil and salt. Step 4: Combine to make a firm dough by adding little water. Step 5: Divide the dough into equal small portions. Step 6: Shape them in ovals and lightly press them down. Step 7: Preheat a paniyaram pan and add little oil into each cavity. Step 8: Place the muthia in each cavity and pan fry until golden and crisp on all sides. Step 9: Once done remove and keep aside.*The next step is to make the Fansi Muthia Nu Shaak:Heat a teaspoon of oil in a heavy bottomed pan over medium heat; add the ajwain seeds, mustard seeds and allow them to crackle. After the seeds crackle, add asafoetida and the cooked green beans. After a minute, add the coriander powder, red chilli powder, amchur powder, turmeric powder, jaggery, muthia and saute until well combine. Step 10: Cover and allow it to steam cook for two minutes and turn off the heat. Step 11: Transfer Fansi Muthia Nu Shaak into a serving bowl and serve. Serve the Fansi Muthia Nu Shaak Recipe along with Gujarati Kadhi, Phulka and Steamed Rice to enjoy your everyday simple lunch.

Dish Name: Fast Yummy And Low Fat Double Strawberry Sauce
Ingredient Names: sugar, strawberry jelly, lemon juice, cornflour, strawberry
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together sugar, 1 / 4 cup water and jelly in a saucepan. Step 2: Stir over medium heat Do so until the sugar dissolves and the mixture begins to boil. Step 3: Mix lemon juice with cornflour. Step 4: Stir into the sugar mixture. Step 5: Cook on medium flame until slightly thickened. Step 6: Mix in strawberries until just heated. Step 7: Serve over slices of poundcake, if you like to!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: figs, milk, sugar, honey, cream, rose essence
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the figs in 1 cup of water for 4-5 hours Grind in a mixer till smooth. Step 2: Add the milk, sugar and honey, beat till frothy. Step 3: Add the cream and essence, beat again, serve ice cold!, yummy, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: turnips, carrots, green bell peppers, onions, garlic, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, fennel seed, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the vegetables in a bowl with 1 / 2 cup water and microwave for 18 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet and add fennel seeds. Step 3: Add garlic and all the powdered spices alongwith salt Empty microwaved vegetables, green pepper and onions. Step 4: Saute on medium heat for 10 minutes turning the veggies gently Bet you will not have a speck left in the serving dish.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, black mustard seeds, onion, fresh gingerroot, salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh green beans, cayenne pepper, unsweetened dried shredded coconut, fresh cilantro, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a 10-inch heavy skillet or 12-inch wok, heat the butter over moderate heat until a drop of cold water dropped into it splutters instantly. Step 2: Add the mustard seeds and fry for 30 seconds Thoroughly stir in the onion, ginger, salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the green bean pieces Stirring constantly, add the cayenne and fry for 5 minutes longer. Step 5: Add the coconut and cilantro, reduce the heat to low, and cover the pan Stirring occasionally, cook for 5-8 minutes more, or until the beans are crisp-tender. Step 6: Sprinkle with lemon juice, taste for seasoning, and serve at once.

Dish Name: Fried Lamb Or Chicken Liver Curry
Ingredient Names: liver, onion, oil, turmeric, chili powder, ground black pepper, ground ginger, salt, garlic clove, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onions till golden. Step 2: Combine all of the spices with the salt and a little water to make a paste Rub the spice paste into the liver and add it to the pan with the garic. Step 3: Cover the pan and cook for 10 minutes. Step 4: Serve garnished with the tomatoes.

Dish Name: Fried Liver Curry Lamb Pork Or Chicken
Ingredient Names: liver, onion, mustard, oil, turmeric, chili powder, ground black pepper, ground ginger, salt, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and add the mustard, stir well to blend them together, add the onion and fry till just golden. Step 2: Mix together the turmeric, chilli powder, black pepper, salt and the ginger with a little milk to make a thin paste Coat the liver with the spice mix and add to the pan with the garlic. Step 3: Cover the pan and cook over low heat till the liver is tender. Step 4: Serve with rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: papaya, pineapple, apple, banana, gooseberries, green grape, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, boiled potatoes, yam, green chilies, coriander, green chutney, tamarind chutney, black salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the chaat ingredients in a bowl and toss well with the seasoning Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, black peppercorns, cloves, coriander seeds, caraway seeds, cardamom seeds, cinnamon stick, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients in small saucepan, stir over medium heat for about 2 minutes or until fragant, cool. Step 2: Blend or process mixture until fine, use coffee grinder to ensure fine mixture.

Ingredient Names: cardamom seed, cinnamon bark, whole cumin seed, whole cloves, whole black peppercorn, ground nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients in the container of an electric coffee grinder and grind until even and powdery.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, cardamom seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, coriander seed, cumin seed, fennel seed, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: This spice is used in many indian receipes to add flavor It can also be used as garnish for salad, yogurt, meat etc The proportion of the ingredients can be changed to suit one's personal taste. Step 2: Place all dry ingredients in a blender and blend into a fine powder The spice powder can be stored in any airtight container.

Ingredient Names: black cumin, whole cloves, black peppercorns, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a clean electric coffee grinder Grind until fine. Step 2: Store in a small jar with a tight-fitting lid. Step 3: Keep away from heat and sunlight This is a spice combo used in many indian recipes.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seed, cardamom seed, whole black peppercorn, fennel seed, mustard seeds, whole cloves, dried hot red chili peppers, ground turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cardamom seeds, peppercorns, fennel seeds, mustard seeds, cloves, and red chile peppers in a small skillet over medium-low heat Toast until fragrant, about 2 minutes Grind the toasted spices in a clean coffee grinder or spice mill to a fine powder. Step 2: Spoon in the turmeric, and process to combine Use immediately, or store in a sealed jar for up to 1 month.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, white onions, dried apricots, carrots, gingerroot, garlic, salt, black pepper, chicken thighs, garam masala, cayenne, tomatoes, garbanzo beans, cauliflower, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over a medium flame until hot. Step 2: Add the onion, dried apricots, carrot, ginger root, and garlic. Step 3: Stir occasionally and cook until the onion turns translucent. Step 4: Add salt and pepper to taste but be careful not to brown the onions. Step 5: Mix the chicken thigh meat with the cayenne pepper and half of the masala. Step 6: Stir the seasoned meat into the vegetables. Step 7: Cook until the chicken is opaque. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and garbonzo beans. Step 9: Stir into the meat and vegetables. Step 10: Cook until the liquid of the tomatoes comes to a simmer.

Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, active dry yeast, lukewarm water, sugar, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, butter, salt, dried oregano, red chili flakes, mozzarella cheese, onions, green bell peppers, baby corn, black olives, button mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Garlic Crust Vegetable Pizza recipe, firstly mix yeast powder in luke warm water and keep it aside for 2 minutes. In a big bowl, add all purpose flour, garlic, oregano and mix everything well. Step 2: Slowly slowly add the reqired water and kneada soft dough. Step 3: Cover it and keep it aside for 15 to. After, add activated yeast, olive oil and kneed for 2 more minutes. Step 4: Let the dough ferment for 3 to. Step 5: Cover with a lid and put it aisde in a warm place. After 3 to, you will see the dough is raised. Step 6: Take it out of the bowl, cut it into 2 equal size balls and let it rest for 10 minutes. Sprinkle some flour on your working table or platform and knead this dough again for a few more minutes. Again put this dough in a bowl for second fermentation, this time put it at the warm place for an hour only. Pre-heat oven at 200 degree celsius. Apply some oil in your palm and take out the pizza dough from the bowl. Step 7: Knead it for 8-10 minutes and make a nice round shape pizza base. Transfer the pizza base to a buttered baking tray. Step 8: Apply Pizza sauce and sprinkle loads of grated mozzarella cheese on it. Now places the sliced vegetables on the pizza which includes onions, bell peppers, mushrooms, baby corn and black olives. Sprinkle some more cheese on the top. Step 9: Place in the preheated Oven at 200 degree Celsius for 25-30 minutes. Increase the baking temperature to 220 degrees and bake further for 25-30 minutes until the cheese is melted and bread is soft and done. Once it is done, take out of the oven and serve hot. Serve Garlic Crust Vegetable Pizza along with Burnt Garlic Pasta With Mushroom for your weekend dinner. Step 10: You can also serve Caramel Apple Trifle to end the meal on a sweet note.

Ingredient Names: bread flour, yeast, warm water, sugar, salt, egg, nonfat milk, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yeast packet with warm water. Step 2: Let stand for 10 minute. Step 3: Add milk, and egg to yeast. Step 4: Mix salt, sugar, & flour together and slowly add to liquid stirring with fork. Step 5: When mixture resembles a soft dough add rest of flour, and knead 6-8 times on lightly floured surface. Step 6: Put dough in a warm spot covered and let rise for 1 hour Punch down dough, cover and let stand for an additional 30 minute. Step 7: Grate or chop garlic clove, add to 1 / 2 cup of evoo. Step 8: Using an electric or fire grill, separate dough into small golf sized balls. Step 9: Roll the dough out flat, and brush both sides with garlic and oil.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, pepper, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, garlic clove, mushrooms, scallions, hot green chili pepper, cilantro, fresh ginger, chopped tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Break eggs into a bowl. Step 2: Add salt and pepper and beat well. Step 3: Pour into a glass measuring cup Filling: Put 2 t of oil in a medium sized frying pan and set over high heat. Step 4: When the oil is hot, put in the mustard seeds - as soon as they begin to pop put in the garlic. Step 5: Stir once or twice As soon as garlic starts to brown, put in the mushrooms and stir till mushrooms lose their raw look. Step 6: Turn heat to medium and put in the scallions, green chile, cilantro, ginger. Step 7: Stir till the green seasonings have wilted - about a minute.

Ingredient Names: garlic, to green chilies, carom seeds, gram flour, oil, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a medium pot. Blanch spinach for 1 to 2 minutes or until they start to wilt. Transfer the spinach into an ice bath so it stops cooking. Blanching allows the spinach to be cooked to a perfect tenderness while retaining the bring green color. Step 2: Drain the water completely and squeeze the spinach leaves by tightly pressing them with your hands to discard the remaining water. Step 3: Add garlic, green chilies, and carom seeds to the blender jar and blend together. Then add the blanched spinach to make a smooth puree. Step 4: Transfer the puree to a mixing bowl. Add besan/chickpea flour salt and ½ tablespoon of oil to the puree, mix well and knead to form a soft dough. Note: Depending on the thickness of the puree, you may need more flour. The dough will be soft and sticky. Add the remaining oil that will help take out any dough stuck to the bowl or on your hand and shape the dough into a ball. Step 5: Keep a frying pan or kadhai on medium heat and heat oil for frying. Step 6: Take the sev press and insert the sev disc with medium-thick holes. Next, fill up the tube of the sev press with some of the prepared dough keeping a 1-inch gap at the top. Tightly secure the top lid/handle on the tube. Step 7: Test the oil for optimum temperature by adding a small piece of dough to the oil, which should rise up gradually in 5 to 10 seconds. If it rises up too fast, lower the heat and if it does not rise up in 10 seconds allow the oil to heat up further. Step 8: Carefully, start pumping out the sev in a circular motion directly in the hot oil. I usually do 1 round spiral shape, then stop pumping the press and break the dough by hand so I get one palm-sized circular nest of sev in the oil. Step 9: Fry the sev for 2 to 3 minutes on medium-high heat. Then slowly turn the sev over and continue to fry for another 2 minutes on low heat. Make sure the oil is not overheated and sev does not burn. Carefully take it out on a paper towel-lined tray. The sev will continue to crisp up as it cools down. Increase the heat for the frying pan back to medium-high and continue pressing another sev spiral and frying. Repeat the process of filling the press, pumping sev, and frying for the remaining dough. Step 10: To air-fry sev, line the air fryer basket with parchment paper and lightly spray it with oil. Then Make a single layer of sev spiral directly inside the basket. Step 11: Air fry at 330 F for 5 minutes. Open the basket. Spray a little more oil and cook for an additional 4 to 6 minutes checking frequently the last few minutes making sure the sev is not browning. Carefully take the sev out, it will continue to crisp up as it cools down.

Ingredient Names: garlic, fresh gingerroot, olive oil, salt, turmeric
