Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, combine the garlic, ginger, salt and optional pinch turmeric Pulse to blend, adding small amounts of olive oil to facilitate the blending, until it makes a smooth paste. Step 2: Refrigerate or freeze.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, rock salt, ginger, cumin, lemon juice, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 1 cup water with sugar, rock salt, ginger, and cumin to make a simple syrup. Step 2: Add remaining water and lemon juice, chill to ice cold. Step 3: Pour over ice or blend with ice.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onions, tomato, tomato puree, sunflower oil, green chilies, tamarind, coriander leaves, salt, garlic, ginger, kashmiri dry red chili, mustard seeds, black peppercorns, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, vinegar, turmeric powder, jaggery
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Goan Chicken Vindaloo recipe, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic and saute till they start softening and browning just a little. Next, add the black pepper corns, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick and Kashmiri red chillies and roast on low flame. In about 25-30 minutes, the coriander seeds will start to brown and the masalas will start to roast and smell. Turn off the heat and let the masalas cool down. Step 3: Once cool, transfer to a blender along with vinegar, salt, turmeric and jaggery. Add about water and blend to a smooth paste. Marinate the chicken with this paste for at least 2 hours or upto 24 hoursThe next step is to make the curry for the chicken vindaloo. Step 4: Heat the oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Once the oil is hot, add the green chillies and onions. Step 5: Let it cook till the onions become golden brown. Step 6: Once the onions are cooked, add the tomatoes and cook till they becomes soft and mushy. Step 7: Once it is done, add the tomato puree and let it cook for about 2 to. Step 8: After 2 to, add the marinated chicken and the remaining marinate mixture. Step 9: Mix everything well and let it cook for about 2 minutes. Step 10: If the Chicken Vindaloo becomes too dry, add some water and mix again. Add water and cook the Chicken Vindaloo on medium flame, covered for till the chicken is falling off the bone. Step 11: Once done, turn off the heat and check the seasonings and adjust to taste. Step 12: Transfer the Chicken Vindaloo to a serving bowl and serve hot. Step 13: Serve Goan Chicken Vindaloo along with Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha or Steamed Rice and a salad of your choice for your weekend meal.

Ingredient Names: ginger garlic paste, curd, onions, bay leaves, black cardamom, sugar, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt, oil, water, coriander leaves, cabbage, gram flour, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: To make Gobi koftas, we will first make Koftas. Step 2: Put the ingredients for the koftas in a bowl. Step 3: Add some water and mix well. Step 4: After mixing, make pakoras and keep them aside. Step 5: Heat oil in a pan. Step 6: Add pakoras to it and cook till it turns brown. Step 7: Take out the kitchen towel so that more oil is released, keep it aside. Step 8: Now heat oil in a pan. Step 9: Add long, bay leaves, big cardamom and cinnamon. Step 10: After, add ginger garlic paste and cook for 5 to. Step 11: After 5 to, add red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt and cook it for 5 minutes. Step 12: After, reduce the flame and add yogurt. Step 13: Mix and add water as per use. Step 14: Let it cook for 4 to. Step 15: Now add the koftas and cook for 2 more minutes. Step 16: Turn off the gas after and garnish with green coriander. Step 17: Serve gobi kofta with boondi raita and tawa paratha for dinner.

Ingredient Names: green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, cloves, bay leaves, sunflower oil, sesame seeds, coriander seeds, desiccated unsweetened coconut, black peppercorns, cassia buds, white poppy seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Split open the cardamom pods and remove the seeds from the husks, discard the husks. Step 2: Heat the oil in a small skillet and saute the cinnamon, cloves, cardamom seeds and bay leaves until the cloves swell Dry roast the remaining ingredients over a low heat until the coconut is slightly darker than a golden brown. Step 3: Stir and watch carefully as the coconut can suddenly burn! Step 4: Cool both mixtures, than place all the spices in a clean coffee grinder, and grind until fine Store in an airtight container for up to 4 months.

Dish Name: Gongura Chicken Curry - Andhra Style Gongura Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, tomato, green chilies, ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, sesame oil, salt, fenugreek seeds, coriander seeds, dry red chilies, fennel seeds, sorrel leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Gongura Chicken Curry Recipe first prep all the ingredients and keep them aside. In a small pan, dry roast the methi seeds, coriander seeds, fennel seeds and red chillies for about 3 to on medium heat, until you notice the seeds crackling. Step 2: Once done, turn off the heat and allow it to cool a bit and blend it into a smooth powder. Heat oil in a pressure cooker over medium heat; add the chopped onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies and saute until the onions are lightly browned and tender. Add the tomatoes, and saute until the tomatoes become soft and mushy. Step 3: Once done add the chicken, the garam masala and turmeric powder. Step 4: Add water and pressure cook the chicken for 3 to 4 whistles and turn off the heat. Once done, allow the pressure to release naturally. Make sure there are no stems when you pick the gongura leaves. Step 5: Wash and chop the gongura leaves and keep aside. In another pan,add some oil along garlic and saute the chopped gongura leaves along with a little salt and the ground masala. Step 6: The gongura leaves will wilt almost instantly. Step 7: Saute the gongura in the masala for about 3 to until it becomes like a mushy paste. Once done, add the cooked chicken curry into the Gongura masala and saute on high heat for another 3-4 minutes and turn off the heat. Check the salt and spices and adjust according to taste. Step 8: Transfer the Gongura Chicken Curry to a serving bowl and serve hot. Serve Gongura Chicken with Ghee Rice Recipe | Neychoru, Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita Recipe and a Semiya Payasam for a delicious weekend lunch.

Ingredient Names: oil, black mustard seeds, asafoetida powder, cayenne, onions, tomatoes, salt, hot chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add mustard seeds and cover until they stop sputtering. Step 3: Add onions and stir. Step 4: Add cayenne and asafetida and cook, stirring, until the onions have wilted. Step 5: Add tomatoes, salt and chilies. Step 6: Cook partially covered for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 7: Allow to rest for 30 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: oil, salt, turmeric, red pepper powder, green bananas, fresh lemon juice, coconut milk, onion, dried garlic, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non stick heavy base skillet. Step 2: Add salt, red pepper powder and turmeric powder Immediately add bananas and saute for about 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Let bananas go brown on the edges. Step 4: Add puree and fresh lemon juice. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup water and cover tightly. Step 6: Bring to a boil and let it simmer on medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 7: Finally add the coconut milk, cover again for 5 minutes on low heat and serve warm with steamed rice or steamed noodles.

Dish Name: Green Beans With Coconut Indian Style
Ingredient Names: green beans, desiccated coconut, onion, cumin seed, ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, green chili, vegetable oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the beans till almost done. Step 2: Heat the oil and saute the cumin seeds, onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies. Step 3: When the onions get a little brown, add the cooked green beans, add turmeric, add the coconut, add salt to taste. Step 4: Cook for about 5 minutes until all the ingredients are combined. Step 5: Serve hot with rice or indian bread.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, onion, tomatoes, water, turmeric, garam masala, salt, red chili powder, green peas, whole milk, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add cumin seed As soon as it sputters, add onion and cook about 5 minutes, until translucent. Step 2: Add tomatoes and cook 2 minutes. Step 3: Add water, turmeric, garam masala, salt and red chile powder. Step 4: Let boil for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add peas and continue cooking until tender, about 7 min for frozen and about 10 min for fresh peas. Step 6: Add milk and cook 3 min more. Step 7: Serve, with cilantro leaves sprinkled on top.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, chicken breasts, salt, whole black peppercorns, dried basil leaves, ginger garlic paste, red chili flakes, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, onion, garlic, baby corn, mixed dried herbs
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Grilled Chicken With Vegetables recipe, firstly we will saute the vegetables. Heat olive oil in a skillet/stir fry pan. Step 2: Add onion, pounded garlic and saute it for a minute or two. Next, add all the vegetables including red pepper, green pepper, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, onions and baby corns. Sprinkle some salt over it and cover the pan with a lid. Step 3: Let it cook for 3 to more. Add mixed herbs and crushed peppercorn. Step 4: Mix everything well and keep it aside. The next step is to prepare the grilled chicken. Take chicken breast and pat it slightly so it becomes flat and can be cooked evenly. Sprinkle salt, crushed black pepper, dry basil leaves and red chilli flakes and rub it properly on both side. Step 5: Apply ginger garlic paste on the both the sides as well. Drizzle some olive oil on it and rub it with mixture. Step 6: Make sure all these steps which are mentioned above, we need to apply it on both sides of chicken breasts. Heat olive oil in a skillet/stir fry pan, put chicken breasts on the hot pan and let it cook for 4 to. Now turn over chicken breasts and cook another side for 4 to. To check the chicken breast is cooked properly or not, cut it against the grain and from inside it should be white in colour and not pink. Serve Grilled Chicken With Vegetables along with a side of Creamy Garlic Mashed Potatoes Recipe, Whole Wheat Seeded Loaf Recipe slathered with Homemade Herb Butter Recipe to make a delciious dinner meal.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, lime juice, garlic paste, ginger paste, pork chops, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, stir together soy sauce, lime juice, garlic, and ginger. Step 2: Place pork chops in a large ziplock bag. Step 3: Pour mixture over chops Seal and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Step 4: Preheat an outdoor grill for direct heat and lightly oil grate. Step 5: Place chops on the grill As they cook, sprinkle with a little more of the garam masala For thick chops, cook about 10 minutes on each side.

Dish Name: Grilled Indian Style Curry Yogurt Chicken
Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, garlic clove, fresh ginger, lemon, curry powder, cayenne pepper, salt, chicken breast fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the yogurt, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, curry, cayenne, and salt in a large ziplock bag until well combined. Step 2: Add the chicken and turn to coat. Step 3: Marinate the chicken at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours. Step 4: Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill over medium-high heat, about 12 minutes per side, until cooked thoroughly. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Pea Curry
Ingredient Names: ghee, onions, serrano peppers, garlic cloves, salt, ground turmeric, cinnamon, ground cumin, ground cardamom, chili powder, ginger, lean ground turkey, sweet potatoes, coconut milk, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat the ghee / oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Saute the onion, pepper and garlic for 3-5 minutes, or until the onion has softened. Step 3: Add the salt, turmeric, cinnamon, cumin, cardamom, chili powder, & ginger and combine well. Step 4: Saute for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the ground turkey & stir well. Step 6: Cook until meat is browned. Step 7: Add the sweet potato, coconut milk, 1 / 2 cup water, tomato paste and sugar. Step 8: Stir well & bring to a boil, then lower heat & simmer for 20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are cooked through. Step 9: Add the other 1 / 2 cup water if too much liquid gets cooked off to your liking. Step 10: Add the peas and garam masala, and cook just a bit more until the peas are warm.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, coriander, mint leaves, green chilies, garlic cloves, ginger, low-fat plain yogurt, lemon juice, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken in small pieces. Step 2: Make a paste of all the ingredients including oil and marinate chicken in this paste. Step 3: Leave for 1 / 2 hour. Step 4: Heat the saucepan then add chicken and stir fry on high heat until chicken is tender, serve hot.

Dish Name: Hard Boiled Eggs In A Moghlai Sauce
Ingredient Names: cayenne pepper, ground cumin, garam masala, ground coriander, lemon juice, salt, ground black pepper, water, olive oil, onions, fresh ginger, tomato paste, chicken stock, skim milk, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cayenne, cumin, garam masala, coriander, lemon juice, salt and black pepper with warm water in a cup. Step 2: Mix into a paste and set aside. Step 3: Put the oil in a large frying pan and set it over a medium-high heat. Step 4: When hot, add the onion, stirring until golden brown. Step 5: Add the ginger, stir to incorporate, then add the spice paste. Step 6: Stir, and allow mixture to cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the tomato paste, chicken stock, milk and fresh cilantro, and bring to a simmer. Step 8: Cover pan, and simmer for 2-3 minutes Lay the egg halves in the pan in a single layer yolk-side up, and spoon the sauce over the tops. Step 9: Cover and simmer for another 2-3 minutes, then serve.

Dish Name: Healthy Black Bean Burger Without Bun
Ingredient Names: black beans, brown rice, onion, coriander leaves, whole wheat bread crumbs, walnuts, cumin powder, jaggery, red chili powder, tomato ketchup, red chili sauce, maple syrup, apple cider vinegar, black pepper powder, salt, extra virgin olive oil, pineapple, beetroot, tomato, black olives, iceberg lettuce, avocado, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare this Healthy Black Bean Burger Recipe Without Bun, get prep with all the ingredients mentioned. Step 2: In a mixing bowl combine avocado, lemon juice and a pinch of salt and mash with a fork. Step 3: Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate until needed. In a bowl combine apple cider Vinegar, honey, tomato sauce, hot sauce and pepper and whisk them together with a fork and set aside this sauce mixture when combined. Step 4: In a pan, sauté diced onion using little oil on medium-high flame until brown and set aside. Step 5: In a blender, add roasted walnuts, cumin powder, chilli powder, raw sugar and a pinch of salt and blend to a coarse powder. Step 6: In a large mixing bowl add black beans and mash it well using a masher. To this, add cooked brown rice, walnut powder, chopped coriander, sautéed onion, chopped jalapenos, bread crumbs, sauce mixture and salt to taste. Mix all the ingredients until they are well combined, cover and set aside for at least 1/2 an hour. Step 7: This helps the flavor soak into the burgers. Divide this mixture into 8 equal portions and shape them into burger patties. Step 8: Grill them on a pan using a little olive oil, flipping both sides. On a platter, lay the salad leaves and place pineapple, beetroot, tomato, mashed Avocado, the grilled patty on top of the other and secure these, using a skewer or a toothpick. Step 9: Place onion rings on top and insert olives from above. Enjoy this Healthy Black Bean Burger Recipe Without Bun with sauce or dip of your choice. Serve the Healthy Black Bean Burger Recipe Without Bun along with Oven Baked Sweet Potato Fries Recipe and a glass of Mango Iced Tea Recipe to complete your meal.

Ingredient Names: water, fennel seeds, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, cloves, ginger, fresh mint leaves, basil, honey, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Crush all the herbs and spices coarsely. Step 2: Boil the water with the herbs. Step 3: Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, covered, strain. Step 4: Serve hot with milk and honey to taste Variation: let the tea cool down. Step 5: Add honey to taste and serve cold on ice, garnished with thin lemon slices.

Ingredient Names: wheat noodles, red bell pepper, spring onions, milk, vinegar, tomato ketchup, red chili sauce, tofu, tomato, green chili sauce, honey, coriander powder, black pepper powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, dry mango powder, onion, sugar, fenugreek seeds, dry red chili, garlic, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Homemade Spicy Ramen with Tofu Recipe by boiling the noodles in a saucepan with water and cook the noodles until done. Step 2: Strain the water and keep the water in the sauce pan itself. Step 3: Toss the noodles in a little oil, so it does not stick to each other. Heat another skillet with oil, and then add the fenugreek seeds, sugar, onions, ginger and garlic and sauté till the onions are translucent. Step 4: Once the onion have turned translucent turn off the heat and allow it to cool down. Step 5: Once cooled add the onion mixture into a mixer grinder and grind into a smooth paste. Add the masala powders like the coriander powder,black pepper powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, amchur powder into the water that was used to cook the noodles and keep it on the heat. Step 6: Add the ground paste also and let it boil for few minutes. Step 7: You can add more water if required depending on how thick you want your soup. Then add the red chili sauce and tomato sauce to adjust the flavor, check for seasonings also and add according to your taste preferences. Step 8: Finally add milk and let it boil for 10 minutes and keep it aside. In another small skillet, pan fry the Tofu cubes, once it is crispy, you can add the sweet chili sauces, green chili sauce, honey and give it a toss, keep it aside. Step 9: Then in the same pan fry the red bell peppers and other vegetables if using and stir fry for a few minutes and keep aside. In order to assemble the noodle bowl, add the cooked noodles, then pour the soup over, add the sautéed vegetables and top it up with crispy Tofu and chopped spring onions. Step 10: Serve the Homemade Spicy Ramen with Tofu Recipe in cold winter season as a comforting meal.

Ingredient Names: chicken, yogurt, turmeric, coriander seed, cardamom pods, cumin seed, galangal, peppercorn, cloves, star anise, cinnamon sticks, peaches, red bell pepper, green onions, lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Roast coriander, cardamom, cumin, pepper, cloves, star anis and ground afterwards Mince peaches or mangos. Step 2: Cut bell pepper and green onions into sticks of 2 inch length. Step 3: Grate ginger Mince red chilli incl Seeds Crush lemon gras. Step 4: Fry bell pepper and green onions in oil for two minutes set aside. Step 5: Fry chicken cubes until brown. Step 6: Add all ingredients except bell pepper and green onions and simmer until chicken is almost done.

Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic, cayenne pepper, peanut oil, baby potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a small bowl And mix well. Step 2: Place the potatoes in a baking dish / tray and add the spice mix and toss to coat evenly. Step 3: Bake at 180oc for 65-75 minutes.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, fennel seed, ground cinnamon, peppercorns, ground nutmeg, whole cloves, ground cardamom, turmeric, ground ginger, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: In a dry skillet over very low heat, place the coriander, cumin, mustard and fennel seeds Roast the seeds gently, shaking the pan occasionally, until they begin to pop. Step 2: When about half the seeds have popped, add the cinnamon, peppercorns, nutmeg, cloves, cardamom, turmeric, ginger and cayenne Continue to heat and stir gently until the mixture is quite hot but not burnt. Step 3: Pour into a dry blender or food processor, or use a mortar and pestle Grind into a fine powder. Step 4: Pour into a clean, dry jar, seal, and let it cool before using.

Dish Name: Hyderabad Soy Biryani With Vegetables & Palak
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, salt, soy chunks, carrots, green beans, green peas, cauliflower, green bell pepper, potatoes, tomatoes, onions, ginger garlic paste, sunflower oil, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, cloves, cumin seeds, spinach leaves, coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chilies, almond, black cardamom, bay leaf, carom seeds, mace, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, milk, saffron strands, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak, wash rice well and soak for half an hour. In a handi, boil water, almost triple the quantity of rice or more, with salt and the whole spices mentioned above. Step 2: When the water comes to a boil, add the soaked rice and cook till almost done. Step 3: When almost a bite remains in the grains, drain the rice in a sieve, keep aside. Step 4: Warm a bowl of milk in a saucepan, and soak the saffron in it and keep aside till required. Step 5: In the meantime, heat a kadai with a bit of oil and on high heat, caramelise the onions with sprinkling some salt on it and sauteing them. Step 6: Keep aside. Now in the same kadai, with a bit of oil heated, add the potatoes and cook till they are shallow fried and crisp-cooked, season with salt and keep aside till required for layering. In another vessel, bring enough water to boil to cook the remaining vegetables except the capsicum. Step 7: Add the cauliflower first to the boiling water. Step 8: After about 10 minutes or when the cauliflower is softened half-way through, add the rest of the vegetables. Step 9: When almost done, drain from the clear stock and keep aside. Step 10: Reserve and use this water for making soups if you wish. Step 11: Take off soy chunks off the hot water, wash thoroughly and squeeze tightly to discard any extra water. Step 12: For the biryani, in another vessel heat oil and add to it all the whole spices mentioned and saute till aromatic. Step 13: Now add the remaining half of the chopped onions and saute on high flame. Step 14: Add a bit of salt to it. Step 15: Add the chopped capsicum too. Step 16: When onions turn translucent, add ginger garlic paste and saute well for a minute till the raw smell vanishes. Step 17: Now add turmeric and the chopped tomatoes. Step 18: Mix well and cover and cook for a while. Step 19: Add all the other dry spice powders and mix well. Meanwhile in a mixer grinder, puree the palak with other mentioned ingredients for palak puree. Step 20: Add the palak puree and mix well. Step 21: Keep stirring on high flame for a while. Step 22: Now add the beaten curds to the gravy and stir continuously on high flame. Step 23: Add the soya chunks and mix well, cover and cook. Step 24: After a few minutes, add the boiled and drained vegetables, and adjust salt to taste, mix well. Step 25: Adjust seasoning or masalas now. Step 26: Add most of the fried onions reserving little for layering and garnishing. Step 27: When all the water has evaporated and the gravy has thickened, switch of heat. Step 28: Keep a thick griddle to heat on the stove top. Step 29: Place a handi on the griddle, just to ensure the even heat distribution such that the bottom of the biryani doesn't get burnt. Step 30: Now in the handi, start layering the biryani. Step 31: Start with spreading half the gravy at the bottom. Step 32: Cover with some cooked rice. Step 33: Spread some ghee, fried onions, potato cubes, coriander leaves and mint leaves over it. Step 34: Repeat layering so that you finish with caramelised onions on top most layer. Step 35: Make four vertical holes in the biryani with the handle of a spoon and pour saffron milk into it. Step 36: Cover the vessel with aluminium foil and shut the lid tightly over it. Step 37: Keep vessel on medium heat for dum. Step 38: Keep on high heat for first and then on a low heat for about 5 minutes. Step 39: Keep covered for few more minutes. Step 40: Open the lid and mix a bit or serve in layers. Step 41: Serve Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak along with Burani Raita Recipe (Garlic Based Yogurt), Pickled Onions Recipe, and Saunf Aloo & Dal Kebab Recipe (Potato & Lentil Kebabs).

Dish Name: Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani - Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani
Ingredient Names: green beans, carrots, cabbage, potatoes, garlic, ginger, onion, rice, tomato, curd, cinnamon, cardamom, bay leaves, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, salt, oil, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To make Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani Recipe, first put the rice in a saucepan with salt and oil in water and cook till the rice is half cooked. Step 2: Now add carrots, green beans, potatoes, cauliflower in a steamer and cook till it becomes soft, keep this aside. Step 3: Now add cardamom, cinnamon, long and grind it in a Hamdasta, keep it aside. Step 4: Now heat oil in a large saucepan. Step 5: Add garlic paste onion ginger and cook for 2 to. Step 6: Now add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, ground cinnamon powder, bay leaves and cook for 10 minutes. Step 7: Now add tomato puree and cook it for 10 minutes. Step 8: Now add curd and let it cook for 2 to. Step 9: Now add mint leaves, potatoes, cooked vegetables, half cooked rice, mint leaves, salt to taste and mix it and cook for 2 to. Step 10: Reduce the flame, cover the saucepan and cook until it is well cooked. Step 11: Turn off the gas and leave it covered for 10 minutes. Step 12: Garnish with fried onions and serve. Step 13: Serve the Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani Recipe with Burani Raita and Mirchi Salon for dinner.

Ingredient Names: milk, cocoa powder, sugar, whipped cream, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cocoa powder to a smooth paste with some of the milk. Step 2: Place the rest of the milk on the stove in a pan. Step 3: Bring almost to a boil. Step 4: Add the cocoa paste and the sugar. Step 5: Stir till boiling point is reached, remove from heat. Step 6: Fill glasses up to 1 / 3rd with chipped ice. Step 7: Strain the cocoa onto this. Step 8: Add a heaped tsp Of whipped cream and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, urad dal, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice and dal and soak in water for about 2-3 hours Grind mixture in a blender, adding enough water to make paste. Step 2: Add salt and keep it aside to get sour for 12 hours. Step 3: Take idli plates and place a drop of oil in each idli mould and spread it over the entire mould. Step 4: Heat 2 cups of water in a large vessel or pressure cooker and place the filled idli plates and cover with lid. Step 5: Cook on high for about 20 minutes. Step 6: Remove the plates from the vessel and remove the idlis. Step 7: Pour 2 tsp of sesame oil while serving Side dish - sambar, dosai milagai powder, and coconut chutney.

Ingredient Names: lean lamb, fresh gingerroot, fresh green chile, ground coriander, curry powder, chicken stock cube, plain yogurt, powdered milk, sliced almonds, sugar, oil, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 190c To the minced meat add the ginger, green chilie, coriander, curry powder, crumble the stock cube into the mixture. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp of yogurt and half of the milk powder, mix well to incorporate the ingredients. Step 3: Divide the mixture into 12 and shape into balls. Step 4: Roll the balls in the flaked almonds and place on a baking sheet, spaced out to allow them to expand while cooking. Step 5: Stir together the remaining yogurt, milk powder, sugar, oil and chilli powder and a little salt to taste. Step 6: Spoon the yogurt mixture over the koftas, coat them well. Step 7: Bake in the oven, uncovered for 30 minutes, the almond coating should be golden and toasted. Step 8: Serve with drinks, salads, curries or just as they are.

Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, garlic, minced ginger, coriander seed, dried fenugreek leaves, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, brussels sprout
Instructions: Step 1: Place a skillet over medium heat and add the oil. Step 2: When it is hot, add the garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the coriander, fenugreek, paprika, salt and pepper and cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add the brussels sprouts and 1 / 2 cup water and cover with a tight-fitting lid. Step 5: Let steam until the sprouts are bright green and tender-crisp, 6 to 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sugar, water, cardamom pods, plain yogurt, buttermilk, rose water
Instructions: Step 1: Stir to dissolve the sugar in the water Crush the cardamom seeds and add them to sugar-water Add all the rest of the ingredients Stir to blend Chill and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken parts, onions, tomatoes, garlic, fresh ginger, turmeric powder, plain yogurt, green chilies, coriander seed, cumin seed, cardamom pods, cloves, garam masala, salt and pepper, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade, mix the yoghurt, salt, turmeric and the chopped chillies. Step 2: Chop up or joint the chicken and coat it in the marinade and leave covered to stand at room temperature for an hour. Step 3: Chop the onion and tomatoes into small chunks and reserve. Step 4: In a large pan over a medium melt your ghee or butter until it begins to sizzle, and pop in the coriander and cumin seeds plus the cardamom, cloves, a little salt and onions, frying until the onions brown a little Next, drop in the ginger and garlic and cook for approximately 5, gently stirring then add the chopped tomatoes and garam masala, stirring for another 5 minutes or so until the mix is bubbling gently and on the verge of being a little sticky. Step 5: Now its time for the chicken to join the party, so add the pieces and fry on high for 3 / 4 minutes until the meat has turned from raw to white. Step 6: Turn the heat down to low, cover and cook for a further 25 minutes, adding a little water to stop it from sticking, check regularly and fold in the rest of the yoghurt after 10 minutes. Step 7: Keep an eye on this dish and make sure that you regularly stir it to keep the yoghurt from splitting Either serve straight away, garnishing with coriander Ravish the chicken curry with rice or chapattis.

Dish Name: Indian Chicken In Tomato Yogurt Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, onion, ginger, garlic clove, chili powder, cumin, garam masala, dry mustard, turmeric, cardamom, tomato paste, tomatoes, water, plain low-fat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Set chicken pieces aside. Step 2: Combine ingredients from onion to cardamom to form a rub. Step 3: Add chicken to rub mixture and mix very well so all chicken pieces are coated with spices and onion. Step 4: Put the chicken mixture into a 10-inch covered sautee pan and sautee 10 to 15 minutes until onions begin to soften ad chicken takes on some color. Step 5: Add the water, chopped tomatoes, and tomato paste and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add the yoghurt and simmer 1-2 minutes till warmed through. Step 7: Serve in a bowl, with or without rice in the bottom I prefer my rice served on the side.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, cucumber, red onion, plain yogurt, vegetable oil, cumin seed, fennel seed, red pepper flakes, ground coriander, onion, fresh ginger, zucchini, bell pepper, chickpeas, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the cilantro, cucumber, red onion and yogurt and mix well. Step 2: Place in serving bowl and refrigerate until needed. Step 3: In a large saut pan, heat the oil over medium high heat, and add the cumin, fennel, pepper flakes, coriander and onion and saut until the onions are lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Step 4: Add ginger, zucchini and bell pepper and mix well. Step 5: Pour 1 / 3 cup of water over the vegetables, cover and reduce heat to low and simmer about five minutes. Step 6: Fold in the chickpeas and the tomatoes and increase heat to medium high and cook uncovered until the ragout is heated through and the sauce is thick, about five minutes. Step 7: Season with salt to taste and generous sprinkle of freshly ground pepper. Step 8: Serve ragout garnished with the cilantro yogurt mixture.

Ingredient Names: milk, water, coffee, sugar, ice, vanilla ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Mix up sugar coffee and boiling water cool. Step 2: Add 1 cup ice to blender. Step 3: Add 1 c milk And 1 cup ice cream. Step 4: Blend add 1 / 4 c coffee mixture, blend. Step 5: Pour in glass repeat with 3 other glasses.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, honey, cucumber, fresh coriander, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a bowl It may be easier to warm the honey, as it is easier to blend with the other ingredients. Step 2: Make sure the cucumber is drained well, otherwise your raita will be too watery. Step 3: Mix well, and add to serving bowl. Step 4: Sprinkle cumin over the top. Step 5: Serve on top or on the side of your favorite indian dish, or serve as a dipping sauce with naan bread.

Dish Name: Indian Dhal With Tomato And Aubergine
Ingredient Names: red lentil, water, turmeric powder, aubergine, green chilies, tomatoes, garlic clove, oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, dried red chilies, chili powder, lemon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the lentils with the turmeric in the water till soft. Step 2: Remove from the heat and set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in a small pan and fry the seeds till they splutter. Step 4: Add the green chillies, eggplant, chilli powder and salt. Step 5: Fry for 30 seconds and add the tomato. Step 6: Cook till the tomato and aubergine is soft, add the lemon juice. Step 7: Add the lentil mixture to the spiced vegetables, reduce the heat and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 8: Serve as a side to a good curry and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, tandoori paste, butter, onion, cabbage, carrot, water, red chili pepper, cumin powder, garlic sea salt, pepper, brown rice, salt, saffron, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Spread meat with tandoori marinade and set aside. Step 2: Melt butter in a pan and add onion. Step 3: When the onion turned golden, add cabbage. Step 4: When the cabbage turned soft, add carrots. Step 5: Add water and shimmer with lid on for about 20 minutes. Step 6: Add the spices when ready and stir. Step 7: Put rice and water into another pot, when water boils add salt and saffron, stir once and cook until tender In the meanwhile mix all the ingredients for the yogurt sauce and set aside, heat grill. Step 8: Grill the meat until tender.

Ingredient Names: bread, chutney, tomatoes, beetroots, cucumbers, onions, potatoes, ketchup, chaat masala, cheese, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Apply butter on all the four slices, one surface each Apply the chutney on two slices on top of the butter. Step 2: Arrange the sliced vegetables. Step 3: Put the ketchup on top. Step 4: Sprinkle the chat masala Close the sandwiches with the buttered sides of the other two slices down I only apply butter if i want to keep the sandwiches for a little while so that they do not get soggy Otherwise, as you can see, its a pretty healthy sandwich.

Ingredient Names: cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, water, ground ginger, fresh ground black pepper, milk, granulated sugar, black tea
Instructions: Step 1: In a mortar, crush the cloves, cardamom pods and cinnamon, or use a coffee grinder. Step 2: Transfer the crushed spices to a small saucepan, add the water, ginger and pepper and bring to a boil. Step 3: Remove the pan from the heat, cover and let steep for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the milk and sugar to the pan and bring to a boil. Step 5: Remove from the heat and add the tea. Step 6: Cover and let steep for 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir the chai, then strain it into a warmed teapot or directly into teacups Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: okra, onion, mustard seeds, cumin seed, garlic cloves, dried red chilies, turmeric powder, curry leaf, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a cooking vessel. Step 2: Once the oil is hot, reduce heat to medium flame, add the mustard seeds, let them splutter, add the cumin seeds and let them brown. Step 3: Add the curry leaves, dry red chilies and garlic cloves, stir them for few seconds. Step 4: Add the chopped onions and saute till transparent. Step 5: Add the okra and turmeric pwd and combine. Step 6: Saute on medium high heat for 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Reduce to low flame, add a tbsp of yogurt or lemon juice and let it cook for 4-5 mts. Step 8: Stir occasionally so that they don't burn. Step 9: Reduce flame and cook till the okra turns soft This could take about 15-20 mts of slow roasting.

Ingredient Names: onion, salt, lemon juice, paprika, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut onion crosswise into paper-thin rings and put rings into a bowl. Step 2: Add all other ingredients, toss and mix. Step 3: Set aside for 30 minutes or more before eating in order to let the flavors blend.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red chilies, ground turmeric, ground cardamom, cloves, peppercorns, ground cinnamon, cumin seed, lemon juice, pork fillets, oil, brown mustard seeds, water
Instructions: Step 1: To male vindaloo paste. Step 2: Place the ginger, garlic, chilli, turmeric, cardamom, cloves peppercorns, cinnamon, coriander, cumin seeds and lemon juice in a food processor Process for 2 seconds or until all the ingredients are combined and the mixture is quite smooth Trim the pork of excess fat and sinew and cut into cubes. Step 3: Heat the oil in a heavy-base pan. Step 4: Add the meat in small batches, and cook q Quickly over medium heat until browned. Step 5: Return all the meat to the pan. Step 6: Add the vindaloo paste and mustard seeds, and cook, to the boil.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, mustard seeds, cumin seed, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, tomatoes, frozen peas, potatoes, salt, red chili powder, dry coconut powder, turmeric, garam masala, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Put oil into skillet and add mustard and cumin seeds. Step 2: When they start to sputter, add onion, garlic and ginger. Step 3: Saute until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add tomatoes and peas and cook until tomatoes are cooked. Step 5: Add potatoes, salt, red chile powder, coconut powder, turmeric and garam masala, add 1 / 4 c water. Step 6: Cook, covered, over med heat until potatoes are cooked through, stirring occasionally, about 10-15 minutes. Step 7: Serve, sprinkled with cilantro leaves as garnish.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground turmeric, cauliflower, salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Drizzle 1 tablespoon of the oil onto a baking sheet. Step 3: Sprinkle on the turmeric. Step 4: Spread the cauliflower on the pan in one layer. Step 5: Drizzle with the remaining oil. Step 6: Add the salt and several grinds of pepper. Step 7: Mix with your hands to coat the florets Roast for 20 minutes. Step 8: Stir the cauliflower, roast 5 minutes and stir again Continue roasting until the cauliflower is almost soft and some.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, potatoes, onion, green chilies, oil, ginger, garlic, coriander seed, cilantro, lemon, turmeric, garam masala, red chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the flour, oil and salt. Step 2: Add a little water, until mixture becomes crumbly. Step 3: Keep adding water, kneading the mixture till it becomes a soft pliable dough. Step 4: Cover with a moist cloth and set aside for 20 minutes. Step 5: Beat dough on a work surface and knead again. Step 6: Cover and set aside Filling, heat 3 tbsp oil. Step 7: Add ginger, garlic, green chillies and few coriander seeds. Step 8: Stir fry for 1 minute, add onions and saute till light brown.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, chili, cumin, coriander powder, garam masala, eggs, salt, pepper, tomatoes, coriander, flat bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy based saucepan and add the garlic, ginger and chilli and cook them until they are aromatic and then add the spices and continue to cook for 2 minutes Lightly beat the eggs and season well with salt and pepper and then add these to the saucepan and lower the heat and cook over a low heat, stirring gently as the mixture sets, until soft curds are the result. Step 2: Remove from the heat and fold through the tomatoes and the coriander and serve at once with the flatbread.

Ingredient Names: curry, cumin, turmeric, ground coriander, ground ginger, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl, mix well. Step 2: Store in a glass jar It will keep for several weeks I use 2-3 tablespoons in a curry for 4 people For a dressing-about 1 tablespoon These are estimates, follow your own tastebuds.

Ingredient Names: ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, ground cardamom, garam masala, flaked sea salt, brown sugar, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cumin, coriander, turmeric, cardamom and garam masala in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: Cook, shaking pan often, for 5 to 8 minutes or until aromatic. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl to cool. Step 4: Stir in remaining ingredients. Step 5: Mix well To use: sprinkle over both sides of chicken thigh fillets, pork cutlets or fish fillets. Step 6: Using your finger Barbecue or grill.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, shallot, onion, turmeric, garlic cloves, coriander seed, ghee, celery, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and chop onion finely Peel and chop shallot finely Dice celery stalks. Step 2: Place shallot and onion and celery aside Crush garlic with large flat knife to remove skin Finely dice garlic Peel the small finger of turmeric with a veggie peeler Be careful, as if you get turmeric on your hands it will stain your hands yellow or orange and is hard to remove Finely dice turmeric. Step 3: Place turmeric, garlic and coriander seeds in mortar and pestle and pound until ingredients reach a paste-like state.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, yukon gold potatoes, vegetable oil, cumin seed, salt, onion, garlic cloves, fresh jalapenos, fresh ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, cayenne, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put oven rack in upper third of oven and place a shallow baking pan on rack. Step 2: Preheat oven to 475f. Step 3: Toss cauliflower and potatoes together in a bowl with 3 tablespoons oil, cumin seeds, and1 / 4 teaspoon salt. Step 4: Spread in hot baking pan and roast, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender and browned in spots and potatoes are just tender, about 20 minutes While vegetables are roasting, cook onion, garlic, jalapeo, and ginger in remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until very soft and beginning to turn golden, 8 to 10 minutes. Step 5: Add ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne, and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and cook, stirring constantly, 2 minutes. Step 6: Stir in water, scraping up any brown bits from bottom of skillet. Step 7: Stir in roasted vegetables. Step 8: Cook, covered, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, spring onion, red onion, green chili, garlic, gingerroot, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, eggs, coriander, mint, lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in frying pan and fry the onion, chilli, ginger, garlic until translucent. Step 2: Add turmeric and saute for a minute more. Step 3: Add the other spices and cook for a few minutes more stirring now and then. Step 4: Take them off the flame. Step 5: Beat the eggs lightly and add salt to taste. Step 6: Now add the cooked mix to the eggs. Step 7: Add the green leaves chopped, Now add it back to the pan which will have some grease in it. Step 8: Cook for a few minutes and then flip over after sprinkling some lemon drops on the first side You can also place this under a grill to do the second side.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Pork In Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground red pepper, cumin seed, mustard seeds, ground coriander, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, black peppercorns, onions, white vinegar, gingerroot, sugar, garlic cloves, boneless pork loin, chicken broth, baking potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat first 7 ingredients in a dry skillet over medium heat about 3 min or til fragrant, stirring often. Step 2: Transfer to blender or food processor. Step 3: Add onion, vinegar, ginger, sugar, and garlic Process 2 min or til well blended. Step 4: Combine pork and spice mixture in a glass bowl, tossing to coat. Step 5: Cover and chill 30 minutes. Step 6: Heat a dutch oven over med heat Coat pan with cooking spray. Step 7: Add half of pork mixture. Step 8: Cook 5 min or til pork begins to brown, stirring often.

Dish Name: Indian Spicy Mutton In Egg Sauce
Ingredient Names: mutton, onions, potatoes, egg, coconut, red chilies, fresh ginger, garlic, cinnamon stick, cloves, anise seed, turmeric powder, lime, salt, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large flat-bottomed pan. Step 2: Add aniseeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, garlic, ginger, curry leaves and the onion. Step 3: Stir-fry for 8 minutes until the onions turn brown. Step 4: Add the meat and salt and mix well. Step 5: Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Step 6: Mix in turmeric powder and water{as required} to cook the mutton. Step 7: Now, carefully extract the thick milk from the coconut. Step 8: Beat an egg in a bowl until light and fluffy. Step 9: Add the thick milk to it, beat again.

Ingredient Names: eggs, onion, garlic cloves, chili pepper, tomatoes, turmeric, mustard seeds, garam masala, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion, garlic and chilli until the onions are translucent. Step 2: Add mustard seeds, turmeric and garam masala and stir fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add the chopped tomatoes and keep cooking, stirring regularly, until tomatoes start to break up. Step 4: Pour beaten eggs into the pan, season with salt and cook, stirring constantly, until they are done You can serve this garnished with fresh, finely chopped coriander leaves I don't always have chillies on hand, so i leave them out - all this means is that the eggs will be slightly less spicy, but will still taste really nice.

Ingredient Names: yellow onion, chicken stock, chutney, dijon mustard, dried basil, ground ginger, cumin, salt, ground cinnamon, curry powder, cauliflower, frozen green pea, cornstarch, water, white wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In a 10-inch nonstick skillet, combine the onion, stock, chutney, mustard, basil, ginger, cumin, salt, cinnamon, and curry powder. Step 2: Bring to a simmer and cook, covered for 6 minutes. Step 3: Add the cauliflower and cook, covered, for 5 minutes over moderately low heat. Step 4: Add the peas, cover and cook 4-5 minutes more or until the cauliflower is crisp-tender. Step 5: Stir in the cornstarch mixture, vinegar, and red pepper sauce. Step 6: Cook for 1 minute or until the sauce has thickened. Step 7: Serve hot or at room temperature For vegetarian use the vegetable stock.

Ingredient Names: carrot, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, dried red chili, salt, sugar, lemon juice, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: Place the grated carrots in a serving bowl. Step 2: In a small frying pan put the oil, black mustard seeds and broken red chili pieces. Step 3: Heat over high heat until the mustard seeds pop for about 10 seconds. Step 4: Pour the mixture over the carrots and stir to blend. Step 5: Add the salt, sugar and lemon juice and mix again If desired, add the raisins. Step 6: Chill until serving time.

Ingredient Names: baby red potatoes, oil, cashew pieces, onion, gingerroot, garlic, madras curry powder, ground turmeric, salt, water, plain yogurt, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the potatoes well Do not peel them- cut them in half if they're small, into quarters if large. Step 2: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add the cashews and cook until browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove the nuts from the skillet and set them aside In the remaining oil, cook the onion, ginger and garlic over medium-low heat until very tender, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the curry powder, turmeric and salt. Step 6: Add the potatoes and toss with the seasonings. Step 7: Add the water and yogurt, cover and cook over medium heat until the potatoes are tender, 20 to 25 minutes If the heat is too high and the potatoes dry out, add water, a tablespoon at a time.

Ingredient Names: green beans, oil, mustard seeds, onion, carrot, ground ginger, ground coriander, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 2-1 tbls oil in large skillet or wok, saute mustard seeds until they pop, Add a little more oil then add vegetables, cook, stiring constantly for 5 minutes. Step 2: Mix in seasonings, reduce heat, cover and simmer 8-10 minutes. Step 3: Stir in lemon juice and serve.

Ingredient Names: plain low-fat yogurt, of fresh mint, garam masala, salt, cayenne pepper, zucchini, eggplant, red sweet peppers, red onion, canola oil, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce, in medium bowl, combine yogurt, mint, the 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1 / 2 t salt and cayenne pepper. Step 2: Cover and chill for at least 1 hour to blend flavors In an extra-large bowl, combine zucchini, eggplant, sweet peppers, red onion, oil, the 1 t garam masala, 1 / 2 t salt and black pepper. Step 3: Toss gently to coat On 16 skewers, alternately thread vegetables, leaving 1 / 4 inch between pieces For a charcoal grill, place vegetable skewers on the grill rack directly over medium-hot coals. Step 4: Grill, uncovered, for 8-10 minutes or just until vegetables are tender and lightly charred in spots, turning occasionally For a gas grill, preheat grill. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-high, place vegetable skewers on grill rack over heat. Step 6: Cover and grill as above.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, onion, garlic clove, lemon juice, curry powder, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ingredients well and place in large resealable bag Add meat Squish meat around in marinade to coat well Marinate for 4 to 24 hours The longer the tastier! Step 2: A Fill sink with enough water to cover bag With the open side of bag up, gently place in water You will notice that all of the air will be squeezed out of the bag. Step 3: When the water is nearing the top of the bag, seal the bag.

Dish Name: Indian Style Mushrooms In A Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: button mushrooms, olive oil, onion, green chili, garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, chili powder, salt, tomato puree, water, chives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium sized saucepan over a medium heat. Step 2: Add the chopped onion and chilli and cook, stirring frequently, for 5-6 minutes The onion should be soft but not browned. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook for a further 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the cumin, coriander and chilli powder and cook, stirring, for one minute. Step 5: Add the mushrooms, salt and tomato puree. Step 6: Stir until all ingredients are thoroughly blended. Step 7: Sprinkle the water evenly over the mushrooms and reduce the heat to low. Step 8: Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring halfway through The sauce should have thickened, but if it appears runny, cook, uncovered, for 3-4 minutes, or until you achieve the desired consistency.

Dish Name: Indian Style Omelet My Mom's Version
Ingredient Names: eggs, red onions, desiccated coconut, crushed red pepper flakes, water, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a small nonstick skillet and spread lightly with oil. Step 2: In a small bowl, whip the eggs, add 2 tablespoons water and whip until fluffy. Step 3: Add in coconut, onion, red chili flakes and salt to taste Continue to mix until all ingredients are blended As soon as the skillet is hot, pour in the egg mixture. Step 4: Cook as you would a traditional omelet, making sure that the underside is browned. Step 5: Flip over and continue cooking until the omelet is well done. Step 6: Serve hot and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, sesame oil, soy sauce, cayenne pepper, peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken thighs on the bottom of a slow cooker. Step 2: Sprinkle with garlic, ginger, sesame oil, soy sauce, and cayenne pepper. Step 3: Cover, and cook on low for 8 hours or until a meat thermometer reaches 180 degrees fahrenheit With a slotted spoon remove chicken pieces from slow cooker. Step 4: Stir peanut butter into remaining juices If the sauce is thicker than you like, stir in 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 cup of water. Step 5: Spoon peanut butter sauce over chicken to serve.

Ingredient Names: tamarind, jaggery, asafoetida, salt, chana dal, urad dal, coriander seeds, dry red chilies, whole black peppercorns, sesame seeds, flax seeds, sunflower seeds, melon seeds, fenugreek seeds, sesame oil, raw peanuts, mustard seeds, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Instant Puliyodharai/ Puliyogare/Pulihora Powder Recipe, place a kadai on medium heat, dry roast all the ingredients given under 'for roasting' till the dals start getting roasted and start releasing aroma. Step 2: Turn off the heat and keep it aside. Step 3: Roast the dry red chili in sesame oil for on low heat. Step 4: Keep this aside, let it cool. In the same pan, lightly roast tamarind for just one minute on low heat, keep it aside. Step 5: We will now proceed to make the tempering ingredients. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Step 6: Roast the peanuts for 25-30 minutes, keep it aside. Step 7: In the remaining oil, fry the curry leaves till they turn crisp. Do not brown the leaves. Step 8: Take out the curry leaves and add mustard in the remaining oil and take out the mustard seeds once they crackle. Powder the ingredients that are given under for roasting along with jaggery, tamarind, hing and salt to taste. Mix the tempered ingredients with the ground powder and allow the mixture to cool completely. Transfer the contents to an air tight container and store in a cool dry place. You can also add Sesame, flax, melon seeds, delicately roasted them on low flame and enhance the nutrition quotient of the powder. Instant Puliyodharai/ Puliyogare/Pulihora Powder can be stored in an air tight container for 3-4 months. Refer to 'Method to Make the Puliyodharai / Puliyogare Recipe' in Puliyodharai / Puliyogare Recipe to prepare the Puliyodharai / Puliyogare rice.

Ingredient Names: jowar flour, rava, salt, curds, water, caspcium, fresh carrot, onions, fresh coriander, ginger, chili, eno fruit salt, sesame, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl, take 1 cup jowar flour, 3 tbsp rava and ½ tsp salt. Step 2: Add ¼ cup curd and 1½ cups water, mix well, forming a smooth lump-free batter. Step 3: Also add 2 tbsp capsicum, 2 tbsp carrot, 2 tbsp onion, 2 tbsp coriander, 1 inch ginger, 2 chilli. Mix well. Step 4: Now add ½ tsp eno fruit salt and mix well till the batter turns frothy. Step 5: Now sprinkle the pan with sesame seeds and pour the batter. Step 6: Top with oil and cook on a low flame. Step 7: Once the bottom is cooked, flip and cook both sides. Step 8: Finally, enjoy Jowar Chilla Recipe with green chutney or tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, ghee, mustard seeds, onion, garlic, fennel, curry powder, tomato puree, tomatoes, salt and pepper, asafoetida powder, hot water, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee and fry mustard till they begin to pop. Step 2: Reduce heat, add onion, saute until translucent. Step 3: Add garlic and fennel and saute for up to 5 minutes Dont let garlic burn. Step 4: Reduce heat and add curry paste. Step 5: Fry gently on low heat, constantly moving until water evaporates and paste darkens a little. Step 6: Add tomato puree, chickpeas and tomatoes with pint hot water. Step 7: Cook gently until water evaporates. Step 8: Add another pint hot water and the salt, pepper and asafoetida. Step 9: Cook gently until water has evaporated again leaving a dryish curry.

Ingredient Names: panir, green chilies, onion, garlic paste, ginger paste, curds, oil, cumin seeds, bay leaves, turmeric, salt, garam masala, dry red pepper, coriander seed, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and add the cumin seeds and the bay leaves. Step 2: When the seeds begin to splutter, add the onion and the ginger and garlic pastes Saut till brown and fat separates. Step 3: Add the curd, turmeric, salt, garam masala, red pepper and the coriander powder, and stir-fry till the fat separates. Step 4: Add the paneer and the green chillies and saut over high heat till well mixed. Step 5: Serve hot, garnished with the coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: tofu, green bell pepper, onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, cumin seeds, dried fenugreek, sunflower oil, turmeric powder, sugar, salt, coriander leaves, coriander seeds, whole black peppercorns, fennel seeds, pomegranate, dry red chili, bay leaf, black cardamom, dry mango powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kadai Tofu Sabji, first make the dry masala. In a small pan, dry roast the coriander seeds, peppercorns, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, red chillies, tejpatta and black cardamom. Step 2: Cool and coarsely grind it in a blender along with the Anardana and dry mango powder. Now we will make the Kadai Tofu SabjiIn a kadai/wok, heat the oil. Step 3: Add the cumin seeds and let it splutter. Once done add the onion and the ginger and garlic paste and sauté for a few seconds till the onion becomes translucent. Once the onions have turned translucent add the turmeric powder, tomato puree and cook for 1 to. Add the freshly ground masala and kasuri methi, mix well to combine. Once done add the capsicum and stir fry for a few seconds. Step 4: Add the Tofu cubes, sprinkle salt and sugar. Mix nicely so that the masala coats the Tofu cubes. Step 5: Cook for another minute. Garnish with coriander leaves and transfer Kadai Tofu Sabji to a serving bowl,it is ready to be served. Serve Kadhai Tofu Sabji with Pudina Lehsun Laccha Paratha, Dal Palak and Red Cabbage Carrot, Sprout And Onion Salad for a wholesome lunch.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork, vinegar, salt, garlic clove, ginger, dried red chilies, cinnamon, cloves, black peppercorns, cumin seed, turmeric, fenugreek seeds, oil, onion, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the spices from the garlic to the fenugreek seeds in the vinegar and salt. Step 2: Wash pork and poke with a fork marinate the pork in ground spice paste for 2 hours at least or overnight Pressure cook for 1 whistle or cook till done, drain fat if any. Step 3: Slice the pork or cut into chunks and set aside. Step 4: Slice the onion and saute in the oil till golden brown. Step 5: Add the bay leaf and then the pork. Step 6: Heat through This makes lovely sandwiches too.

Ingredient Names: bitter melon, potatoes, onions, chopped tomatoes, oil, cumin seed, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, mango powder, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse bitter melon Trim on both ends as needed and scrape any blemishes or hard skin. Step 2: Cut into small rounds. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet on medium-high heat. Step 4: Add karela almost in a single layer. Step 5: Stir and cook until brownish. Step 6: Reduce the heat if they tend to burn. Step 7: Add the onions, potatoes and all the seasonings. Step 8: Stir until the potatoes are cooked, add the tomatoes.

Dish Name: Karnataka Style Avarekalu Huli Saru (Field Beans in a Coconut based Gravy )
Ingredient Names: lilva beans, potato, eggplant, garlic, pearl onions, tomato, salt, tamarind, fresh coconut, red chili powder, coriander leaves, turmeric powder, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: We begin making the Karnataka Style Avarekalu Huli Saru Recipe (Field Beans in a Coconut based Gravy Recipe) by soaking the averekallu in water for half an hour and remove the skin. Step 2: Next heat a pressure cooker with oil and then saute the list of ingridients mention in the list to grind for few minutes till it turns golden. Step 3: Once that is done, cool it down and grind it into a smooth paste using the mixer or a blender into a smooth paste. In the same pressure cooker, add some oil and saute the garlic, onion and tomato for few mintues till it becomes mushy and the raw smell goes away. Step 4: Then add in the chopped vegetables along with the beans in the pressure cooker, adjust consistency by adding water into it. Step 5: Cover it with the lid and pressure cook it for 4 whistle and open till all the pressure is released. Step 6: Now to temper, heat a small skillet with oil and slowly temper the ingredients mentioned in the list and add it onto the gravy. Step 7: Serve the Karnataka Style Avarekalu Huli Saru Recipe (Field Beans in a Coconut based Gravy Recipe) along with Steam Rice or Ragi Mudde to enjoy your lunch meal.

Dish Name: Kashmiri Kokur T Nadir -Chicken and Lotus Stem Curry
Ingredient Names: lotus stem, chicken, water, bay leaf, fennel seeds, black cardamom, cloves, ginger, mustard oil, cumin seeds, asafoetida, curd, kashmiri red chili powder, fennel powder, dry ginger powder, salt, mint powder, carom seeds, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kashmiri Kokur T Nadir recipe, wash and clean the chicken. Mix the chicken with kashmiri red chilli powder, fennel powder and dry ginger powder in a bowl and keep it for marination for about 2 hours. Put the sliced lotus stem in warm water for few minutes to remove inside dirt and impurities. Strain Lotus stem slices and pressure cook them along with water, bay leaf, fennel seeds, black cardamom, cloves, ginger slices and salt as per taste. Step 2: Cook till the cooker releases 2 to 3 whistles. Step 3: Leave it aside for pressure to settle down. Heat mustard oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 4: Add cumin seeds and asafoetida powder into it, mix it well and cook it for 8 to 10 seconds. Add the above marinated chicken along with the curd mix and cook in medium to low flames till yogurt starts to thicken and oil starts leaving from sides. Now add the boiled and strained Lotus stem into the gravy and cook it on low flame for five minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: (you can add the spices as well) Now put caraway seeds into a Mortar and Pestle and crush them to form a powder. Step 6: Also crush dry Mint leaves between your hand and add into the gravy. Step 7: Adjust salt as needed and cook till the curry starts to thicken. Step 8: Once it is done, switch off the stove and garnish with some fresh coriander leaves. Step 9: Serve hot. Serve Kashmiri Kokur T Nadir along with Kashmiri Dum Monji, Steamed Rice and Phulkas for a weekday meal with your family.

Dish Name: Kashmiri Phool Rogan Josh - Cauliflower in Red Curry
Ingredient Names: cauliflower, greek yogurt, fennel seeds, cardamom pods, black cardamom, cloves, whole black peppercorns, kashmiri red chili powder, cinnamon stick, salt, mustard oil, asafoetida, dry ginger powder, red chili powder, alkanet root
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Kashmiri Phool Rogan Josh Recipe, wash cauliflower and cut them into medium size florets. Step 2: Allow to dry. In a mixer, add all the ingredients mentioned under “For marinating” and grind them into fine powder. In a bowl, add the chopped cauliflower florets and the grounded powders. Step 3: Combine them together. Step 4: Marinate the florets and set it aside for about 1 to 1. Heat oil in a non-stick pan on high flame. Step 5: Once the oil is smoking hot, add cinnamon stick, cardamoms, cloves and fennel seeds. Step 6: Cook until the seeds sizzle. Add peppercorns and cook for about a minute. Reduce the flame and add the marinated florets to the spices in the pan. Step 7: Combine them wellSeason it with salt. Step 8: Add hing and dry ginger powder. Step 9: Give them a stir. Now, add the red chili powder and combine them well. If you are adding ratan jot, add at this stage. Step 10: Heat oil in a small pan. Step 11: Once the oil is warm, add the root and allow it to infuse in the oil for an hour. Step 12: Add the infused oil to the florets at this stage. Step 13: The root is added to the curry for the rich red color. Step 14: Some prefer to use saffron. Step 15: Infuse saffron in warm milk and add it to the curry. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add thick curd and beat them with a whisk. Add the whisked yogurt to the florets and mix them well. Lower the flame and cook the Kashmiri Phool Rogan Josh Recipe in low flame till the florets are cooked thoroughly and oil separates from it. Adjust salt if needed. Enjoy this delicious Kashmiri Phool Rogan Josh Recipe with Homemade Butter Naan Recipe (Soft Yogurt Bread), Saffron Pilaf Recipe (Kesar Pulao) and Burani Raita Recipe.

Ingredient Names: rice, chicken breasts, mace, cinnamon stick, cloves, ginger, garlic, onion, curd, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, black pepper powder, cashew nuts, almond, salt, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kashmiri Chicken Pulao Recipe, heat a pressure cooker with oil on medium flame, once the oil is hot add mace, cloves, cinnamon stick and let it sizzle. Once it sizzles, Aad ginger, garlic and saute for a couple of minutes. Step 2: Add onions and saute them well till they turn translucent. In a mixing bowl, combine the curd along with red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and pepper powder and whisk well. Turn down the heat and add this whisked curd into the sautéed onions and mix well. Step 3: Add chicken pieces and saute till the chicken is half cooked. Step 4: This will take about 6 to. After 6 to, add in soaked and washed rice along with water. Step 5: Sprinkle salt accordingly and stir well. Step 6: Close the lid of the cooker and pressure cook for 2 whistles. After 2 whistes, switch off the gas and allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 7: Open the cooker and fluff up the rice and mix it evenly with the masala. Garnish with cashew nuts and crushed almonds and serve hot. Serve the Kashmiri Chicken Pulao Recipe along with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita,Carrot Cucumber Tomato Salad with Lemon and Coriander by the side so it will make a complete meal.

Dish Name: Kashmiri Style Shab Deg -Mutton Kofta and Turnip Curry
Ingredient Names: turnips, poppy seeds, almond, mutton, kashmiri red chili powder, ginger garlic paste, gram flour, coriander leaves, salt, fennel powder, curd, fresh cream, onions, coriander powder, garam masala powder, carom seeds, cloves, cardamom pods, saffron strands, milk, whole wheat flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Shab Deg recipe, firstly slowly add water into the whole wheat flour and make a tight dough. Step 2: This dough is to seal the vessel. Step 3: Once it is ready, keep it aside. Collect all the ingredients on your counter and do the preparations mentioned like, grind Almond and Poppy to make a paste and keep aside. Peel and wash the turnips, cut into half or four quadrants and keep aside. Step 4: Soak saffron in milk and keep in fridge to get more intense colour. Step 5: Take a large mixing bowl and combine all the ingredients required for making kofta and mix well to make a dough. Pinch a lemon sized ball from the dough, roll it and shape into kofta and keep aside. Step 6: Heat ghee in a heavy bottomed vessel known as DEG and fry the turnips till they are golden in colour. Step 7: Collect them and keep aside. In the remaining ghee add caraways seeds, cardamom and cloves and wait till they crackle. Add mutton and fry for atleast. Step 8: Now add ginger garlic paste and saute for another couple of minutes. Season it with chilli powder, coriander powder and salt. Step 9: Mix well and add whisked curd/yogurt. Step 10: Keep stirring till curd incorporates with the spices well. Add garam masala powder and some water, give a quick stir and simmer the gas. Step 11: Cover the lid and let it cook on low flame till one hour. Add water (preferably warm) and fried onions. Step 12: Mix and add turnips and meat balls. Check salt again and adjust if needed. Step 13: Cover the deg with a lid that fits well and seal the sides with dough. Let the deg be on very low flame for another 5 minutes. Step 14: Once the curry is done, break the seal carefully and open the lid. Stir in the saffron milk and garnish with some finely chopped coriander or kasuri methi and drizzle some cream/malai all over. Serve Shab Deg along with Jeera Rice or Naan, Boondi Raita and a plate of Onion salad.

Dish Name: Kashmiri Style Yakhni Pulao With Chicken
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, chicken, onion, black cardamom, whole black peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, nutmeg powder, mace, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, water, salt, ginger garlic paste, tomato, cumin seeds, curd, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, cardamom pods, fennel seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kashmiri Style Yakhni Pulao With Chicken Recipe, we will first make the Yakhni or the stock/broth using 'Bouquet Garni' or a Spice PotliTo make the 'bouquet garni' or a Spice Potli, take a clean muslin cloth and place the onion, garlic pods, whole ginger, black cardamom pods, black peppercorns, coriander seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, nutmeg, and mace on it and collect the ends of the cloth to tie a potli. Step 2: In a saucepan, add water on medium heat, and add the chicken, salt and the bouquet garni and boil it for around 10 minutes. Remove the bouquet garni and keep the stock with chicken pieces aside. Step 3: The 'yakhni' is ready. In a wide pan, heat oil on medium heat, and fry the sliced onions. Step 4: Take 1/4 of the onions and keep aside. In the remaining onions, add cumin seeds, ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, salt, red chilly powder, coriander powder and stir fry for about 3-4 minutes. After, add yogurt, garam masala and green cardamom. Step 5: Cook on medium-high heat till the tomatoes get tender. Add fennel seeds and chicken pieces to the masala and let it simmer for another 3 to. Add this masala and soaked & drained rice to the prepared yakhni ( stock ) in the saucepan, turn on the heat and cook the rice in it uncovered for about 3-4 minutes or till the water dries up. Sprinkle fried onion on the rice, add a tablespoon of ghee and seal the pot with foil or atta dough so that the flavors don't escape from the Yakhni Pulao. Cook the Yakhni Pulao on low heat for 5 minutes or till rice is done. Step 6: After, switch off the stove and it is ready to be served. Serve Yakhni Pulao With Chicken with Burani Raita or Tadka Raita Recipe (Spiced Curd With Onions) over a Family lunch on a Sunday afternoon. Step 7: You can also serve a Satvik Sprouts Carrot Salad with this meal.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onions, garlic, ginger, green chilies, curd, fresh cream, cashew nuts, melon seeds, dried fenugreek, whole black peppercorns, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, sunflower oil, carom seeds, cardamom pods, black cardamom, cloves, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, mace
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kasuri Malai Murgh recipe, wash chicken nicely and fry in oil/ghee till they turn golden in colour. Step 2: Keep them aside. In the same wok/kadhai, add more oil if needed and add all the whole spices and let them crackle. Now add finely chopped or ground onion and saute till raw smell goes off. Now add finely chopped garlic and ginger and saute till golden. Add the fried chicken in the onion mix and fry in high flames for 2 to. Now add fresh curd and kasuri methi and mix everything well. Fry the chicken in low to medium flame till curd leaves water. Step 3: Cover the lid and allow the chicken to cook for 8 to. Step 4: Meanwhile adjust oil if needed. As soon as the curd reduces and oil starts leaving from the sides, add coriander powder, red chilli powder and chopped green chilies. Mix and fry for 5 to on medium flame. Now add fresh cream and cashew-melon seeds paste and mix such that everything incorporates well. Fry for some time and add salt and water as per required consistency. Step 5: Close the lid and cook. Once the chicken is done, add freshly ground black pepper and some more crushed kasuri methi and turn off the gas. Serve Kasuri Malai Murgh with Roomali Rotis or Hot phulkas for a perfect dinner.

Dish Name: Kathal Masaledar Sabzi - Jackfruit Masala Sabzi
Ingredient Names: jackfruit, potatoes, onions, asafoetida, bay leaf, garlic, ginger, curd, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, tomato puree, mustard oil, salt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kathal Masala Sabzi Recipe, let us first cut the raw jackfruit. Step 2: In order to do that we have to first grease our hands and the knife that is going to be used with oil. Step 3: This important tip ensures that the hands don't get sticky from the natural fruit latex/sap present in the fruit and makes the cutting process hassle-free. Once cut keep aside in a bowl of water with salt so that the cut Kathal pieces do not become brown. Step 4: Meanwhile in a bowl, add curd, tomato puree, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder. Step 5: Pour some water to it and stir well to combine. In a small pressure cooker, add oil. Step 6: Once the oil is hot, add hing/asafoetida to it. Next add finely chopped onions garlic, ginger and saute until the onions brown up. Step 7: Once done add in cinnamon stick and black cardamom and stir the spices well into the onions. Step 8: Now add the prepared curd masala in the cooker. Add the tomato puree, the kathal/raw jackfruit and aloo/potato to the masala, add salt as per taste and stir well to combine. Add water, cover the pressure cooker and cook the Kathal Masala Sabzi for 3 to 4 whistles and turn off the heat. Step 9: Allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 10: Once the pressure has released, turn off the heat. Step 11: Open the cooker, add in the chopped coriander leaves and mix, check the salt and spices and adjust accordingly. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot. Serve Kathal Masala Sabzi Recipe along with Phulkas or even Jeera Rice along with a Carrot Salad and a bowl of curd for a complete and simple Sunday lunch. For an Indian Diabetic meal, serve this Kathal Masala Sabzi Recipe along with Masala Jowar Methi Roti Recipe and Kollu Pachadi Recipe for a full meal.

Dish Name: Kathiri Urulai Masala Kuzhambu - Brinjal And Potato Masala Gravy
Ingredient Names: eggplant, potato, tamarind, onion, tomato, red chili powder, turmeric powder, fresh coconut, fennel seeds, poppy seeds, cashew nuts, dry red chilies, mustard seeds, cinnamon stick, curry leaves, sunflower oil, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Kathiri Urulai Masala Kuzhambu, soak tamarind in hot water and extract its pulp. Step 2: Keep aside. Heat a tablespoon of oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 3: Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds. Step 4: When mustard seeds crackle, add cinnamon stick and curry leaves. Step 5: Sauté it for a minute. After a minute, add chopped onion and sauté it till onion turns soft and translucent. Add in the sliced brinjal and potato, mix, cover the pan with a lid until the potatoes and brinjals are half cooked. Step 6: This will take about 3 to. Now, add finely chopped tomato and cook till the tomatoes turns mushy. Step 7: Finally, add in tamarind pulp, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt. Step 8: Let it cook for 3 to. Meanwhile, take grated coconut, khus khus, fennel seeds, cashews and red chillies in a mixer jar. Step 9: Grind it to a smooth paste. Add this paste to the gravy. Step 10: Boil it for 10 minutes. Step 11: Turn off the heat and Kathiri Urulai Masala Kuzhambu Recipe is ready to be served. Step 12: Serve Kathiri Urulai Masala Kuzhambu along with any South Indian Breakfast Item like Idli, Dosa, Kerala Parotta or even serve for dinner along with Rotis or Steamed Rice and Beetroot Raita.
