Ingredient Names: oil, onion, ground veal, ground beef, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, tomatoes, ginger, garam masala, jalapeno, peas, lemon, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil is a non stick skillet. Step 2: Add onion and cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add veal and beef, season with salt& pepper and cook breaking up with spoon until no longer pink, drain grease. Step 4: Add garlic tomatoes, ginger, garam masala and jalapenos, cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add peas and lower heat, cook for 5-10 minutes more until flavor is blended. Step 6: Stir in lemon juice and basil. Step 7: Serve over basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, ground fenugreek, crushed red pepper flakes, ground veal, fresh tomato, peas, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet, add onions, garlic, and stir until softened. Step 2: Add spices and continue stirring add meat, continue stirring. Step 3: When meat is browned you may drain excess grease. Step 4: Then add tomatoes and peas. Step 5: Reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook 10 minutes more. Step 6: Sprinkle with lemon juice if you want, serve.

Dish Name: Keeme Ja Bhalla - Sindhi Mutton Keema Balls In Gravy
Ingredient Names: mutton keema, garlic, ginger, green chilies, salt, mint leaves, egg, coriander leaves, gram flour, sunflower oil, onions, tomato puree, red chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Keeme Ja Bhalla Recipe - Sindhi Mutton Keema Balls In Gravy, make sure you have the mutton keema ready. Step 2: To make the Mutton Keema Balls for the Keeme Ja BhallaIn a mixer jar, combine the ginger, garlic, green chillies, and salt and grind to a fine paste. Step 3: Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Step 4: Into the mixing bowl with the freshly ground masala, add chopped coriander and mint leaves, and the egg. Step 5: Combine well, add the mutton keema and mix until well combined. Step 6: At this stage you will see the mutton keema mixture is way too moist, to bind the mixture well, now add the besan and mix well. Step 7: Grease a steel plate with oil. Step 8: Grease your hands with oil and make lemon sized balls and place it on the greased plate and set aside. Step 9: To make the Gravy for the Keeme Ja BhallaIn a kadai, heat oil on medium flame, Once hot, add the chopped garlic and ginger, saute for about 30 seconds. Step 10: Next add in the onions, and fry until it turns into a deep brown colour. Step 11: This will decide the colour of your Keeme Ja Bhalla gravy. Step 12: Once you've achieved a lovely brown colour, add all the dry spice powders - red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, and salt, mix well. Step 13: Gradually mix in the tomato puree and allow it to simmer for a good, by placing the plate with the keema balls on it. Step 14: Now cover these keema balls with a lid, allowing the keema balls to cook in the steam. Step 15: After, once the oil has come to the surface, remove the keema balls plate and it's lid to check. Step 16: To the gravy add water and bring the gravy of the Keeme Ja Bhalla to a brisk boil. Step 17: Mix well and add the par cooked keema bhallas. Step 18: Cover and continué to cook with the lid on, until the keema balls are completely cooked. Step 19: Check the salt and adjust according to taste. Turn off the flame, transfer the Keeme Ja Bhalla a serving bowl and serve hot. Step 20: Serve Keeme Ja Bhalla along with Phulka, Sindhi Bhuga Chawal, Pickled Onions for a completely satisfying Sindhi meal.

Dish Name: Khara Obbattu (Bread Stuffed With Spicy Potato Mixture )
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all purpose flour, semolina, curd, turmeric powder, salt, sunflower oil, potatoes, cumin seeds, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilies, curry leaves, coriander leaves, red chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: We begin by baking Kara Obbattu Recipe(Bread Stuffed with Spicy Potato Mixture Recipe) the dough by combining all the ingredients with curd and soak it for 30 minutes then knead with enough water till it is soft and stretchy. Step 2: Add oil for a good binding. For the filling heat the pan with oil and temper with cumin and curry leaves. Step 3: Then add the rest of the ingredients except boiled potato and the spice powders. Once the onions are translucent add the spice powders. Step 4: Then add the mashed potato and combine it together, finally add some coriander leaves. Step 5: Bind them and make small balls and keep it aside. Make small balls and divide the dough equally. Keeping a little flour for dusting handy on a plate; roll out the dough into diameter circles. Step 6: Place a portion of the filling (potato) mixture into the center of the circle. Step 7: Bring edges of the circle towards the center and fold over to cover the entire filling; making sure the edges are all sealed well by pinching them together if there is any opening. Flatten the stuffed dough; dust the dough over a little flour and roll gently into a 5 to diameter circle taking care not to put too much pressure as the filling can come out of the dough. Preheat an iron skillet on medium-high; place the rolled obbattu onto the skillet to cook until golden brown on both sides. Step 8: You can cook the obbattu with ghee to give it a richer taste and flavor. Repeat the above process for all the remaining dough and filling portions. Serve the Karnataka style Kara Obbattu hot with ghee smeared on the top, or with allam pachadi recipe.

Ingredient Names: honeydew melon, fresh orange juice, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: If using small melons, slice off the top of each as a lid, if using large melons, cut them into half. Step 2: Cut the edges into zigzag pattern. Step 3: Cut a thin slice off the bottom so that the melon stands upright without Scoop out the seeds and discard Scoop out the flesh and process in a blender, along with the remaining ingredients, until smooth. Step 4: Chill well and serve in the shells, if desired, with reversed lids and a straw.

Ingredient Names: vermicelli, oil, onions, tomatoes, cinnamon stick, cardamoms, cloves, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, green chilies, coriander leaves, chicken frankfurters, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 2: Add cinnamon, cloves and cardamoms. Step 3: Add onions and green chillies. Step 4: Stir-fry until golden. Step 5: Add ginger-garlic paste. Step 6: Fry until the raw smell of the same is gone. Step 7: Add turmeric powder, pepper powder and red chilli powder, mix well. Step 8: Saute' for a few minutes. Step 9: Add tomatoes and cook till they form a soft thick gravy.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, salt, cumin, ground cinnamon, turmeric, cayenne pepper, frozen peas, potatoes, tomato sauce, water, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in a large skillet. Step 2: Drain all but 2 tablespoons of fat. Step 3: Add chopped Onions, garlic, ginger and salt to beef Saut 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in spices and mix well. Step 5: Cook 1 minute over medium high heat. Step 6: Add peas, potatoes and mix again. Step 7: Bring to a boil, cover pan and cook over medium heat 10 minutes. Step 8: Stir in sauce, water and chickpeas.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ginger, garam masala, minced beef, potatoes, salt, peas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a lidded fying pan, add the onions and cook until sof. Step 2: Add the spices and fry for 5 minutes over low heat. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon water if the mixture starts to burn. Step 4: Stir in the meaned beef and cook over high heat until very well browned. Step 5: Lower the heat and add the potatos and salt to taste. Step 6: Cover and cook gently for 5 minutes, then add the peas Continue cooking until the potatoes and peas are tender.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, mung dal, butter, turmeric powder, ginger, salt, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Pick over rice and dal for any grit. Step 2: Rinse a couple of times and drain. Step 3: Put everything together in a large pot with about 6 cups water. Step 4: Cook on high heat, partially covered. Step 5: When it starts to boil, lower the heat to medium and let it cook for about 15 minutes. Step 6: Lower the heat to low and simmer, covered, until rice and dal are tender. Step 7: Add more water as needed It can be semi-thick or thin consistency, mash it a little. Step 8: Heat the oil in a small pot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, minced garlic cloves, green chili, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, garam masala, fresh ginger, tomato puree, kidney beans, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in saucepan and add chopped onion and garlic. Step 2: Fry for 5-6 mins then add chilli. Step 3: Stir in the turmeric, cumin and coriander followed by salt and garam masala and cook for a minute. Step 4: Add grated ginger and fry for a minute then stir in the tomato puree. Step 5: Add the drained and washed beans and mix well continuing to fry for another minute. Step 6: Pour in 200 ml water, cover and simmer over very low heat for 3 mins until thickens or oil floats to the surface - pour this off if you wish. Step 7: Stir in the butter if you are using it.

Ingredient Names: lamb, onion, garlic cloves, flour, coriander, garam masala, cumin, pepper, paprika, salt, chopped tomatoes, cinnamon, curry powder, chili, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: For the meatballs: Stir fry the onion and garlic, take from heat and add all spices, blend with meat, make 16 to 20 balls and fry on pan For the sauce: Cook on a pan, preferably wok for 5 minutes, add yogurt and milk and let settle If your use a tangine, soak in water for 1 hour, add sauce, put in meatballs and cook in oven on 350f for 1 hour or more.

Dish Name: Kongunadu Cucumber Juice - Spicy & Tonji Eggplant Juice
Ingredient Names: eggplant, tomato, tamarind water, turmeric powder, salt, coriander seeds, toor dal, cumin seeds, dry red chilies, garlic, whole black peppercorns, curry leaves, coriander leaves, ghee, mustard seeds, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kongunadu Kathirikai Rasam Recipe, soak the coriander seeds, tuvar dal, cumin seeds, dry red chillies, garlic pods, peppercorns, curry leaves, coriander leaves, for 10 minutes and then transfer to a mixer jar and grind them to a fine paste in a mixer grinder. Cut the crown of the baby brinjals and slit cutting just half way through the brinjals. Place the tamarind water in the sauce pan along with the slit brinjals, tomatoes, turmeric powder and salt. Step 2: Cook this until the brinjals have softened. Step 3: Once the brinjals have softened, add the freshly ground rasam masala, 2 more additional cups of water and salt to taste. Bring the Kathirikai Rasam to a brisk boil. Step 4: Once it comes to a brisk boil, turn the heat to low and simmer the rasam for about 15-20 minutes until you notice it starts to froth up. At this stage turn off the heat. Step 5: To Season The RasamHeat ghee in skillet or tadka pan on medium heat; add the mustard seeds and allow to to crackle. Step 6: Add the red chili, curry leaves and asafoetida and keep it going for a few seconds. Pour the seasoning into the Kathirikai Rasam and serve. Step 7: Serve the Kongunadu Brinjal Rasam along with steamed rice topped with ghee and a poriyal like Beetroot Curry.

Ingredient Names: blanched almond, cashews, yogurt, milk, green cardamoms, white pepper, salt, vegetable oil, garlic paste, ginger paste, saffron, curry leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Soak almonds, cashews and cardamoms in water for at least 15 minutes. Step 2: Put almonds, cashews and cardamoms into blender with yogurt, milk, pepper and salt, and blend until smooth If mixture is too thick, add water and blend again. Step 3: Put oil in frying pan and cook garlic paste and ginger paste over medium low heat until light brown. Step 4: Add saffron, curry, and yogurt mixture, and cook for 7 minutes.

Dish Name: Kurkuri Bhindi With Spicy Tomato Yogurt Gravy
Ingredient Names: okra, sunflower oil, gram flour, salt, red chili powder, chaat masala powder, water, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, asafoetida, ginger garlic paste, green chilies, onion, curd, tomato, turmeric powder, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Kurkuri Bhindi With Spicy Tomato Yogurt Gravy, firstly we will make the crispy bhindi. Wash the bhindi, make a cut, take out the seeds and then thinly slice all of the bhindis. Take a mixing bowl, add the bhindi and all the ingredients mentioned under ‘for the crispy bhindi’. Heat oil in a deep frying pan, and deep fry the bhindi till they become crisp. Step 2: Take them out on a absorbent paper to absorb the excess oil. Once done, keep them aside. Next heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, hing and ginger garlic paste. After 30 seconds, add the green chillies and onions. Step 3: Cook till the onions becomes soft and translucent. Next, add the tomatoes and cook for about 5 minutes or till the tomatoes gets mushy. Add all the dry masalas including red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and coriander powder. Cook for about 5 to and then add curd in it. Step 4: Stir continuously for about a minute. Step 5: Add water if required. Let it cook for about more and when it is cooked properly, add the chopped coriander leaves. Now mix the crispy bhindi on the gravy, give a stir and serve hot. Step 6: Serve Kurkuri Bhindi With Spicy Tomato Yogurt Gravy along with Panchmel Dal, Phulkas and Rice for a perfect weekday meal.

Dish Name: Lagan Ki Machli - Delicious Pomfret Curry
Ingredient Names: pomfret fish, ginger, garlic, salt, lemon juice, red chili powder, turmeric powder, sunflower oil, cumin seeds, star anise, cinnamon stick, dry red chilies, onions, garam masala powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, tomato puree, curd, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Lagan Ki Machli Recipe we will first mariante the pomfret fish. Step 2: To marinate the PomfretWash the fish well, make slits on both sides of the surface of the fish. Step 3: In a mixing bowl, combine the ginger paste, garlic paste, salt to taste, lemon juice, red chilli powder and turmeric powder. Step 4: Mix well and rub this marinade into the the slits on the fish. Step 5: Massage the fish well and allow it to marinate. Step 6: Heat a skillet, on medium flame, with a teaspoon of oil, place the fish along with the marinade, until the outside of the fish is cooked and gets a nice fried texture. Step 7: This will take about 5 minutes on each side. Step 8: We are focusing only on cooking the outer surface of the fish. Step 9: The inside of the fish will cook, when it is simmered in the gravy. Step 10: To make the gravy for the Lagan Ki MachliHeat a kadai, with oil on medium flame, to this add the cumin seeds, star anise, cinnamon stick and dry red chillies. Step 11: Once these spices begin to sizzle, add in the sliced onions and cook until they turn into a deep brown colour. Step 12: This will take a good. Step 13: Once done turn off the heat and set aside to cool. Step 14: Once the onion mixture has cooled to room temperature, transfer it to a mixer jar and grind to a fine paste using very little water. Step 15: Transfer this to a bowl and set aside. Step 16: In the same, kadai, add the tomato puree, and allow it to come to a single boil, now add in the freshly ground onion paste and whisked yogurt, mix well, Now add the red chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder, cumin powder and salt to taste. Step 17: Add the precooked pomfret fish and allow the Lagan Ki Machli to come to a boil. Step 18: Once the Lagan Ki Machli comes to a boil. Step 19: Turn off the heat. Step 20: Mix in the coriander leaves and serve hot. Step 21: Serve Lagan Ki Machli along with Cheese Garlic Naan Recipe or Dhaba Style Spicy Ghee Rice Recipe Made From Whole Spices, Pickled Onions for a complete meal.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, cream, rose water, fruit, sugar, ice cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients except the ice cubes in a blender and blend until smooth 2 One by one, add the ice cubes and blend further until they are broken down into a slush 3. Step 2: Serve in a tall, cold glass on a hot, hot day Variations Plain lassi: eliminate the sugar, fruit and rosewater Substitute a pinch of salt and some toasted cumin seeds Bhang lassi: a traditional lassi with cannabis extract and ground almonds.

Dish Name: Lauki Ka Salan - Bottle Gourd Salan
Ingredient Names: bottle gourd, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilies, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, tamarind water, tomatoes, sunflower oil, salt, coriander leaves, roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, fresh coconut
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Lauki Ka Salan Recipe prep all the ingredients and keep them ready. Into a mixer grinder blend the peanuts, sesame seeds and grated coconut along with a little water to make a smooth paste and keep aside. Make a puree of the tomato and keep aside. Next take a kadai or a deep pan and heat oil. Step 2: Add mustard seeds, methi seeds, curry leaves and allow it to crackle. Once the mustard seeds crackle, add the slit green chilies, chopped onions, ginger and garlic and saute the onions till they turn translucent and soft. Stir in the tomato puree, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and give it a brisk boil. Step 3: Add the bottle gourd, slices, tamarind water and addition water. Cover the pan and simmer until the bottle gourd/ lauki has cooked through. Step 4: Once done, stir in the peanut sesame paste and simmer the Lauki Ka Salan for 3 to until the salan gets a good gravy like consistency. Check the salt and spices and adjust according to taste. Step 5: Turn off the heat and transfer the Lauki Ka Salan into a serving bowl and serve hot. Step 6: Serve Lauki Ka Salan Along with Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani and Dangar Pachadi With Grated Carrots for a weekend lunch. Step 7: You can also serve it with Tawa Paratha Recipe - Plain Paratha or Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, green chilies, onion, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, water, turmeric, cumin, coriander, coconut milk, black mustard seeds, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the onion and chilis small. Step 2: In a blender put water ginger and peeled garlic and blend it If mixture is too thick add a bit more water The paste should be the consistancy of apple sauce, set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in the pan and add the onion and chilis, cook till the onion is transparent take onions / chilis out with a slotted spoon and put in the blender. Step 4: Add mustard seeds to oil and cook until they start to pop. Step 5: Add the ginger garlic paste and spices, fry for about a minute. Step 6: Blend coconut milk with the onion and chilis in the blender until the chilis are nothing but minute green specks. Step 7: In a pot heat chicken in a bit more oil.

Ingredient Names: lemons, red chile, white vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind chillies. Step 2: Wash and dry lemons. Step 3: Cut them in convenient sizes To the chillies, add salt, vinegar and lemon sections. Step 4: Toss well Pack in a clean jar At intervals of 6 weeks, mix together half a cup of vinegar and 2 tbsp Of salt. Step 5: Pour this over the lemon pickle and stir into a bottle having a knife blade Re-cap the bottle.

Dish Name: Lemon Rice A Dish From Southern India
Ingredient Names: cooked rice, green chilies, curry leaf, onion, fresh coconut, cilantro, cumin seed, mustard seeds, urad dal, turmeric powder, asafoetida powder, salt, lemon, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, add seeds, and dal, allow to splutter. Step 2: Add green chillies, curry leaves, onions, asafoetida. Step 3: Cook till onions are light pink. Step 4: Add rice, turmeric, salt, lemon, coriander, coconut. Step 5: Stir gently till well mixed. Step 6: Cover and simmer till steaming hot, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, fresh ginger, cumin seed, turmeric, red pepper, garlic cloves, cauliflower florets, tomatoes, water, dried lentils, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, salt, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion, ginger, cumin, turmeric, red peppers, and garlic, saute 2 minutes. Step 3: Add cauliflower and tomatoes, saute 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in water and lentils, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 35 minutes or until lentils are tender. Step 6: Stir in lime juice, cilantro, and salt. Step 7: Serve 1 cup lentil mixture with 1 cup rice.

Dish Name: Lentil Dal Or Dahl Daal Dhal
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, cumin seed, turmeric, garam masala, red pepper, cauliflower florets, beef broth, dried lentils, fresh lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, turmeric, garam masala and red pepper and saute for approx 2 minutes. Step 3: Add cauliflower and saute 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in broth and lentils, making sure to mix well, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for about 35 minutes or until lentils are tender. Step 6: Stir in lime juice and salt.

Dish Name: Lentil Or Split Pea Dal With Garlic Butter
Ingredient Names: yellow split peas, water, turmeric, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh coriander, light vegetable oil, cumin seeds, garlic cloves, red peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Pick over, clean, and rinse the split peas. Step 2: Place them in a deep pot, add the water, turmeric, and salt, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Boil the peas gently, partially covered, until they are very soft, about 45 minutes, checking and stirring occasionally to ensure they do not stick to bottom of the pan. Step 4: Turn off the heat and beat the split peas with a wire whisk or wooden spoon for a minute or until they look thick and creamy You should have 5 cups of puree If not, add additional water. Step 5: Return the puree to the pot, add black pepper, and heat until boiling. Step 6: Turn off the heat and fold in the chopped coriander. Step 7: Keep the dal covered. Step 8: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, dried lentils, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large 2 quart pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook until just turning golden. Step 3: Add tomatoes and cook down to thick, around 8 minutes. Step 4: Add lentils and 2 1 / 2 cups water. Step 5: Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat, simmer 30 minutes. Step 6: Add the salt and lemon juice, mix well.

Dish Name: Lentils With Noodles Onions And Tomatoes Syrian Rishta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, lentils, unsalted chicken stock, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, hot pepper flakes, ground cumin, ground allspice, ground coriander, salt & freshly ground black pepper, tagliatelle pasta noodles, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a 5-qt nonstick dutch oven and saute the onions and garlic over low heat, stirring constanly for 5 minutes, or until the onions are soft and begin to brown. Step 2: Stir in the lentils and add the chicken stock. Step 3: Bring to a boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 4: Then stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, hot pepper flakes, cumin, allspice, coriander, salt and pepper. Step 5: Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes more, or until the lentils are soft but hold their shape. Step 6: Meanwhile, boil and drain the pasta. Step 7: Transfer the lentils and pasta to a large warm serving bowl. Step 8: Sprinkle with lemon juice and toss lightly, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: red lentil, mung beans, salt, cold water, vegetable oil, asafoetida powder, panch phoron, plum tomato, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, rinse the lentils and mung beans well and pick out discolored beans. Step 2: Drain in a sieve and put into a heavy pot with the salt and cold water. Step 3: Stir and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, to prevent sticking. Step 5: When lentils are tender, remove from heat. Step 6: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add asafetida and panch phoran, stir and allow spices to sizzle, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Add tomato and turmeric Work mixture with wooden spoon into a puree. Step 9: Cook about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: wheat, bajra, jowar, chana dal, masoor dal, rice, garlic, ginger, curry leaves, coriander leaves, cumin powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, asafoetida, sunflower oil, onions, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the Lentils and Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe, first get all the ingredients handy. Drain water from the soaked wheat and bajra and grind them in a mixer grinder to make a coarse paste. Pour water in a deep kadai just enough to cook the coarse grain mixture. Add rice and chana dal to the boiling mixture. After when the rice is half done, add in masur dal, turmeric powder, salt and mix well. Step 2: Allow it to cook further for about on a medium flame. Take another deep frying pan to heat oil. Step 3: Once the oil is hot, fry in onions till golden brown. Add in green chillies, ginger garlic paste and jeera powder and mix it well. Simmer the flame to toss in red chilli powder, garam masala powder, curry leaves and hing powder. Step 4: Saute for half a minute. Slowly add cooked cereals to it and mix until the masala blends in it evenly. Garnish the Lentils and Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe with a generous pinch of finely chopped coriander, a few rings of onion and lemon for the dish to look as yummy as it tastes.

Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, ghee, gingerroot, garlic clove, turmeric, cayenne, ground coriander, tomatoes, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch beans in boiling water and rinse in cold running water. Step 2: Melt ghee in saucepan add ginger root, garlic, stir add turmeric, cayenne, and ground coriander, stir 1 minute. Step 3: Add tomatoes, tossing them until coated in spices. Step 4: Add stock, bring to boil and cook over medium-high for 10 minutes until sauce thickened stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add beans reduce heat and cook 5 min stir occasionally. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: dried lentils, oil, celery ribs, carrots, yellow onion, garlic cloves, bay leaves, cumin, chopped tomatoes, bouillon cube, water, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium skillet over a medium flame. Step 2: Once oil is hot add your onions and garlic and saute until onions carmeilize. Step 3: Add your cumin, celery and carrots cover and saute stirring occasionly. Step 4: In a large pot add water, bay leaf, and bouillon cube. Step 5: Once water comes to a boil add your sauteed veggies, the can of tomatoes, and your lentils. Step 6: Turn flame down to low cover your pot and simmer for 25-30 minutes or until lentis are cooked through, add salt and pepper to taste Server over rice or enjoy alone Bon apetite.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seed, brown mustard seeds, black peppercorns, chili powder, ground turmeric, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients except vinegar into small bowl and mix together well. Step 2: Add the vinegar and mix to a smooth paste. Step 3: Keep for up to one month in an airtight container in fridge.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, mutton, green chilies, ginger garlic paste, coriander leaves, mint leaves, curd, tomatoes, onions, cumin seeds, bay leaf, cashew nuts, raisins, cardamom pods, ghee, coriander powder, milk, saffron strands, water, cinnamon stick, cloves, fennel seeds, whole black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Malabar Mutton Biryani Recipe, prep all the ingredients well. Step 2: Once done, take the ingredients for biryani masala in a mixer grinder and grind to a smooth paste with the help of little water. Step 3: Also soak basmati rice in water for 30 minutes. Heat the ghee in a cast iron or heavy bottomed kadai; Once the ghee is hot but not yet smoking, add the sliced onions and saute till golden brown in colour and caramelized. Step 4: You can take these onions out and add them at the end of the recipe for a nice texture. Now into the same pan, add the sliced tomatoes and saute well till mushy. Once the tomatoes are mushy, add in ginger garlic paste, curd and freshly ground biryani masala paste, cardamom, turmeric powder, and coriander powder and saute a bit till the raw smell of ginger garlic paste goes away. Step 5: Add the mutton pieces and cook well with lid closed. Melt the ghee in a biryani pot and add in the remaining spices- green chillies, mint, coriander leaves, cashew nuts, raisins, bay leaves and saute till brown in colour. Add milk, curd, and water. Step 6: Wait till it comes to a boil and then add rice. Step 7: Add salt to taste. Step 8: Lower the heat, cover the pan with a lid and continue to cook for 5 minutes or till the rice is done. Take another biryani pot, place half the rice into it. Step 9: Now layer the cooked flavourful mutton on the top of the rice. Step 10: Add the remaining rice on top of the mutton. Step 11: Spread the contents of the pan to make an even layer. Step 12: Make random holes through the rice with a spoon and pour into each a little saffron milk. Place a few spoons of ghee, caramelized onion, cashew nuts and raisins on the surface and cover tightly. Step 13: Serve the biryani hot. Serve Malabar Mutton Biryani Recipe along with Biriyani Chammanthi Recipe (Green Chutney Recipe) and Masala Chaas Recipe (Indian Spiced Buttermilk).

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, oil, powdered milk, sugar, onions, ginger, garlic cloves, green chilies, cinnamon sticks, cardamoms, clove
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the cauliflower into florettes. Step 2: Boil in a broad vessel in salted water taking care to see that the cauliflower remains firm 2. Step 3: Make a paste of the powdered milk with 3 / 4 teacup of water 3. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil and fry the cauliflower for 3 to 4 minutes 4. Step 5: Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. After a minute or two, add chopped potato, carrot, green beans, green chilies, garam masala and turmeric powder. Step 9: Saute for two minutes. Add water to this along with salt. Sprinkle lemon juice and garnish with coriander leaves before serving. Serve Mixed Beans Vegetable Pulao with Lauki Raita, Beetroot Raita or any other raita of your choice and a roasted papad.

Ingredient Names: ghee, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, fresh green chile, black mustard seeds, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, asafoetida powder, toor dal, urad dal, mung dal, channa dal, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the lentils together in a large bowl and wash in several changes of water. Step 2: Heat the ghee in a large, heavy-based, preferably non-stick saucepan, and add the onion, garlic, ginger and chili. Step 3: Cook, stirring, until onion is soft, and starting to brown. Step 4: Add the seeds and powdered spices, and cook, stirring until fragrant. Step 5: Add the lentils along with the undrained tomatoes and stock, and stir to combine. Step 6: Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about one hour, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender. Step 7: Add small amounts of water from time to time if the mixture appears to be sticking, or is too thick before the lentils soften. Step 8: Add the coconut cream and cilantro just before serving, stirring and heating through over low heat.

Ingredient Names: spinach, broccoli rabe, mustard greens, cornflour, fenugreek leaves, chopped tomato, oil, salt, garlic, ginger, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: If using fresh greens, trim and remove all fibrous material, and wash in a colander immersed in a large bowl filled with water Dirt will settle down. Step 2: Remove the colander and throw away the water. Step 3: Repeat until water is clear. Step 4: Chop or tear the leaves and boil them in about 3 cups of water and salt, on medium to high heat, for about 10 minutes until soft. Step 5: When little cool, give it a few rounds in the food processor or blender to make it smooth and creamy, adding corn flour, fenugreek leaves, and tomatoes. Step 6: Add more water as needed. Step 7: Heat the oil in a 4 quart pot on medium to high heat, add garlic. Step 8: Add ginger, cumin powder and coriander powder.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, mango powder, salt, sambhar powder, sugar, coconut oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy- bottomed skillet, cook the eggplant in oil. Step 2: Stir every once a while so that the eggplant does not stick to the bottom of the skillet. Step 3: Once it is cooked, add the salt, amchur powder, sugar and sambar powder and switch off the heat Eggplant sabzi is ready! Step 4: This goes very well with yoghurt rice or just mixed with rice and eaten as such Since this can be oily and spicy, i usually combine it with dal and eat with hot rotis.

Ingredient Names: ghee, milk, sugar, all purpose flour, salt, vanilla extract, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine Ingredients: In a saucepan, add ghee, milk, and sugar. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until the sugar fully dissolves. Once dissolved, let the mixture cool. Step 2: Make the Dough: In a mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, salt, and vanilla. Gradually add the cooled milk mixture to form a soft dough. Let the dough rest for 20 minutes. Note: The dough will continue to firm up as the ghee solidifies. Step 3: Shape the Dough into Shankarpali: Divide the dough into four equal parts and knead each portion into a round ball. Take one ball at a time and roll it into an 8 to 10-inch circle. Use a knife, pizza cutter, or pastry wheel to cut the circle into 1-inch squares or diamonds. Gently separate the cut Shankarpali with a silicone or flat spatula and place them on a tray. Tip: You can either finish rolling and cutting all the Shankarpali before frying or do it simultaneously. If you choose to do it all at once, make sure to separate them into different trays to avoid stacking. Step 4: Heat the Oil: In a frying pan, heat oil over medium heat. Before adding the Shankarpali, ensure the oil is hot enough. Tip: To check the temperature, drop in one piece of Shankarpali or a small piece of dough. It should rise to the surface within 5 to 10 seconds. If it doesn’t, let the oil heat up for a few more minutes. If the test piece browns too quickly, the oil is too hot, so lower the heat. Step 5: Fry the Shankarpali: Maintain the heat at medium-high. Using a slotted stainless steel spatula, gently add some of the cut Shankarpali to the hot oil. Depending on the size of your frying pan, you can add another handful. Wait about a minute, then lower the heat to medium-low. Fry the Shankarpali on medium-low for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring carefully in the oil. Once they turn golden brown on both sides, remove them using a slotted spoon to allow excess oil to drain. Tip: Lower the heat while taking them out so you’re not rushed, and the ones left in the pan don’t darken too much. Step 6: Repeat the Process: After removing the first batch, increase the heat back to medium to let the oil temperature rise again. Then, add the next batch of Shankarpali and repeat until all the rolled and cut pieces are fried. Step 7: Cool and Store: Allow the Shankarpali to cool completely on a large baking tray. Once cooled, store them in an airtight container. They will stay fresh for at least a month at room temperature and freeze well too!

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, yellow onions, fresh coconut, kosher salt, jaggery, kashmiri red chili powder, garam masala, fresh cilantro, oil, black mustard seeds, ground turmeric, asafetida
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the tomatoes in half and partially scoop out the inside and reserve. Note: Sometimes the tops of the tomatoes are not flat. Place the top side down to see if they are flat, if not shave off the uneven top so the tomato can be placed flat. Similarly shave off some from pointy side so that it can be placed upright while cooking. Step 2: In a medium bowl add onion, coconut, salt, jaggery, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala and cilantro and mix well. Step 3: Fill the hallowed tomatoes with the stuffing. You can use a spoon or fill them with your hands like my mom does. Press down on the filling gently so you can stuff more inside each tomato. Step 4: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add mustard seeds and allow them to splutter. Add asafetida and lower the heat. Step 5: Carefully place the stuffed tomatoes in the pan facing the stuffed side up. Cook covered on medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes. Note: Depending on the size of the tomatoes and the heat level you use, it may take up to 10 to 12 minutes to cook the tomatoes. Cook them just until you can easily cut through each one with a fork. Garnish with remaining cilantro and enjoy with homemade parathas.

Dish Name: Moroccan Chickpeas Curry with Quinoa and Coriander Curd
Ingredient Names: quinoa, water, sunflower oil, chickpeas, mixed vegetables, tomatoes, salt, cumin powder, coriander powder, paprika powder, ginger, black pepper powder, greek yogurt, coriander leaves, mint leaves, lemon juice, white pepper powder, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Moroccan Chickpeas Curry with Quinoa and Coriander Curd, firstly soak the Quinoa in warm water for 30 minutes. After drain the water from the quinoa. Step 2: Fluff it with a fork and reserve. Blanch tomatoes and make a puree out of it. Step 3: Then blanch the veggies with a pinch of salt. Step 4: Drain and retain the water. Take oil in a heavy bottomed pan and add ginger. Step 5: Sauté it for about 20 seconds and add the tomato puree, cooked chickpeas, blanched veggies, retained water from boiled veggies and let it simmer. Step 6: Mash the chickpeas slightly to give it a little volume. Once it is done, add all the spice powders, salt and adjust the consistency and taste. Finish with crushed black pepper and adjust spice and top the dish with celery or coriander. Step 7: Transfer it to a serving bowl. To make the coriander curd, firstly mix all the ingredients for the same and cool it in a refrigerator before serving. Serve Moroccan Chickpeas Curry with Quinoa and Coriander Curd on its own or with Moroccan Roast Chicken for a weekend meal.

Dish Name: Mrs Mm's Potato And Bean Bhaji
Ingredient Names: cooking oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, onion, dried red chilies, fenugreek seeds, fresh coriander leaves, ground turmeric, potato, french beans, salt, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Use a non stick pan with a well fitting lid, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: When hot add the mustard seeds, when they start to pop add the cumin seeds, onions, red chillies, and fenugreek seeds, fry for 4 minutes. Step 3: Add the coriander leaves and the turmeric, stir and fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Add the beans, potatoes and salt, stir to mix all the ingredients together. Step 5: Cover the pan and reduce the heat to minimum and cook for 20 mins, stir from time to time to prevent sticking and burning. Step 6: Stir in the ground cumin and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Serve with boiled rice and a dish of tarka dhal to accompany any good meat curry.

Ingredient Names: black cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, whole cloves, black peppercorns, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Break open the cardamom pods, remove the seeds and reserve. Step 2: Discard the skin Crush the cinnamon into small pieces with a rolling pin or mallet. Step 3: Combine all the spices except the nutmet and grind them to a fine powder. Step 4: Mix in the grated nutmeg. Step 5: Store in an airtight container in a cool place.

Ingredient Names: eggs, all purpose flour, whole wheat flour, rice flour, ghee, salt, water, mutton, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilies, mint leaves, coriander leaves, curd, sunflower oil, coriander powder, turmeric powder, cardamom pods, cloves, whole black peppercorns, dry red chilies, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, mace powder, carom seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mughlai Keema Paratha recipe, we will first make the dough. Step 2: To make the dough into a mixing bowl, add the all purpose flour, wheat flour, rice flour, ghee, salt and mix this well. Step 3: Now gradually add required amount of water to make a smooth and soft dough. Step 4: Knead well and bring the dough together. Step 5: Add a teaspoon of oil over the dough completely smoothen it out and place it in a bowl. Step 6: Cover and set side. Step 7: To make the All Spice -spice mix. Step 8: Heat a small skillet on medium-low heat and roast the spices - green cardamom, cloves, whole black peppercorns, dry red chillies, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, mace and caraway seeds. Step 9: Mix occasionally and continue to roast them, until the aroma begins to waft in the air. Step 10: Turn off the flame and let them cool. Transfer to a mixer jar and grind the roasted spices into fine powder and set aside. To make the Keema filling for Mughlai Keema ParathaHeat a kadai on medium flame, add the oil and once the oil is hot, add in the ginger, garlic, green chillies and saute for about a minute. Next add the onions and continue to sauté till they turn into a deep golden brown colour. Step 11: To this add the keema and curd together and mix well. Step 12: Simmer the gas and add salt, coriander powder, turmeric powder and thee allspice mix and mix thoroughly. Step 13: Close the lid and let the kheema cook through until soft and tender. Step 14: Ensure that the keema mixture is not too dry yet moist. Step 15: Add chopped mint and coriander and quickly give a nice mix again and turn off the flame. Meanwhile in a separate bowl, beat the eggs and keep aside. Step 16: To assemble the Mughlai Keema ParathaHeat a non stick tawa. Step 17: Pinch a large portion of the dough, make a ball between your palms. Step 18: Dust it with flour and start rolling it out into a roti. Step 19: We need about a diameter rotiPlace the roti on the heated tawa. Step 20: Immediately spread beaten egg evenly on the roti. Place two tablespoons of the keema mix and place on the centre of the roti over the beaten egg. Now carefully close all sides of paratha to make a square, by folding the curves over the keema and towards the centre. Step 21: Add oil from sides and shallow fry the parathas till they are golden and crisp from all sides. Step 22: Transfer the paratha to the serving plate and serve hot. Serve Mughlai Keema Paratha by cutting it into little squares along with Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and pickled onions for a weekend lunch or dinner.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic flakes, ginger, salt, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, green chilies, mutton, hot water, green peas, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, onions and salt. Step 3: Stir-fry till the raw smell of ginger and garlic is gone, and the onions are lightly browned. Step 4: Add all the spice powders and green chillies. Step 5: Add mutton, stir and cook for 5 minutes, add hot water, bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover pan with a lid and cook on low flame for 30 minutes. Step 7: Add peas and lime juice. Step 8: Cook until the liquid has been reduced.

Ingredient Names: cracked wheat, wheat germ, milk, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 9 cups water in a pot Meantime put all the grains in a 3 to 4 quart pot on low to medium heat. Step 2: Stir for a few minutes until lightly roasted. Dish Name: Mung Bean & Tofu Salad With Sweet Potatoes, Cucumbers & Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: green moong sprouts, tofu, sweet potato, onions, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, coriander leaves, green chili, lemon juice, green chutney, coriander, mint, sweet chutney, tamarind, salt, chaat masala powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, pomegranate, sev, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mung Bean & Tofu Salad with sweet potatoes, cucumbers and tomatoes, first place a pan on the heat. Add oil, add in the sprouted mung beans and saute them well, on a medium heat for 2 to. Step 2: Once they are just tossed slightly, transfer them into a bowl. In the same pan add another ½ teaspoon of oil and add the cubed tofu. Step 3: Stir fry gently till slightly brown on all sides. Turn off the heat, add ½ teaspoon of lime juice and toss. Then, combine all the masalas under “Dry Masalas” in a small bowl. Step 4: Sprinkle a generous pinch of the masalas into the tofu and toss well. Step 5: Set aside till later use. In a salad bowl add sautéed sprouts, stir fried and spiced tofu, and the rest of the chopped vegetables. Add the green chutney and sweet chutney to the salad, add extra lime juice and a pinch of the dry masala mix over it and toss well once more, will well combined. Arrange lettuce leaves like cups in a platter and scoop spoonfuls of the salad onto them, garnished with pomegranate arils and sev (optional) if you wish to. Serve the Mung Bean & Tofu Salad along with Cream of Celery Soup for a weeknight dinner.

Ingredient Names: chicken, ghee, onion, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, fresh cream, cashew nuts, salt, mint leaves, coriander leaves, curd, ginger, garlic, green chili, mustard oil, lemon juice, bay leaves, whole black peppercorns, cloves, black cardamom, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, mace, carom seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Murgh Ajmeri recipe, clean and wash chicken nicely collect in a bowl. Add all the above mentioned ingredients under 'marination' and mix well with the chicken. Step 2: Cover the bowl with a lid or cling wrap it and refrigerate it for 1 hour. Heat oil or ghee in a pan and add all the above mentioned ingredients under 'whole spices' and let them crackle. Now add coarsely ground onion and saute till raw smell goes off and it turns golden in colour. Step 3: Add marinated chicken pieces along with marination and mix well, fry till curd starts leaving water. Keep the flames high and allow the curd water to dry. Now add coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and mix well. Add some torned mint leaves while the chicken is frying with the masala for some aroma. Let the chicken cook on low heat till oil starts leaving from sides. Step 4: This might take around 25 to. Step 5: Adjust salt as needed and add fresh cream, chopped cashews and mix well. Step 6: Cook on low heat for another 2 minutes. Once the chicken masala is nicely fried and oil starts oozing out from sides, add warm water to the chicken to make curry as per required consistency. Step 7: Usually the curry is thick so add water accordingly. Check salt again and adjust if needed. Step 8: Mix well and let the chicken cook in low heat with lid closed until soft and tender. Turn off the heat and garnish the curry with fresh chopped coriander. Step 9: Serve Murgh Ajmeri along with Garlic Naan or Jeera Rice and Onion salad for a weeknight dinner.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground turmeric, chili powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt, tomato puree, button mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the onions until golden brown. Step 2: Lower the heat and add the garlic, turmeric, chili powder, coriander and cumin. Step 3: Stir fry the spices for about 5 minutes adding a little water if necessary to prevent them sticking to the wok. Step 4: Add the salt and tomato puree, mix well and add the mushrooms. Step 5: Stir until the ingredients are thoroughly mixed. Step 6: Sprinkle about 2 tblsp water and cover the pan. Step 7: Simmer for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, mushrooms, onion, fresh parsley, green chili, salt, black pepper, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, beat eggs one at a time, until light and fluffy. Step 2: Add salt, milk and pepper and mix well, add parsley. Step 3: Mix and keep aside. Step 4: Heat a tbsp Of butter or margarine in a non-stick frying pan. Step 5: Fry onions and mushrooms in it until golden brown. Step 6: Remove on an absorbent paper to allow the excess fat to drain off, keep aside, heat a tbsp.

Ingredient Names: onion, ground turmeric, ground ginger, vegetable oil, frozen green peas, whole mushrooms, lemon juice, salt, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir onion, turmeric, ginger in the oil in a large frypan over medium heat until onion is tender This should take about three minutes. Step 2: Stir in the mushrooms, peas, salt, and lemon juice. Step 3: Cook uncovered stirring until peas are tender about 7 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the tomatoes, and heat thru until just hot.

Ingredient Names: mutton chops, black cardamom pods, peppercorn, chaat masala, cloves, ginger-garlic paste, gram flour, lemon juice, mustard oil, mustard seeds, onion seeds, papaya, yogurt, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the mutton chops with a hammer until they are softened. Step 2: Mix the raw papaya paste, ginger-garlic paste, salt and marinate the mutton chops in this mixture for an hour atleast Dry roast the gram flour in a pan till it gives out a nice aroma. Step 3: Mix this flour onto the marinated mutton chops. Step 4: Mix all the other ingredients except chaat masala and lemon juice in curd and again marinate the mutton chops for 2 hours. Step 5: Heat oil in a pan and fry the mutton chops until golden brown. Step 6: Sprinkle lemon juice, chaat masala and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: mutton, curd, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder, mustard oil, eggs, potatoes, ghee, radhuni, fenugreek leaves, bay leaf, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, salt, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, black cardamom, mace, nutmeg powder, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, green chilies, dry red chili, whole black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mutton Dak Bungalow Curry recipe, we will first marinate the mutton. Take the goat meat under the water at room temperature, and clean very well. Step 2: Now put the meat in a large pasta strainer for to drain all the excess water. Now put the clean meat in a large bowl, add sour curd, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder & mustard oil and marinate all together very well. Rub the pieces of meat with the marination. Step 3: Cover the pan and leave the marinated meat for overnight or. Remove the marinated meat before cooking. In the meantime make the "special spice powder" by dry grinding all the ingredients under the heading of "Special Spice Powder", in a spice grinder. Step 4: Pour the "Special Spice Powder" in an airtight container and keep aside. The next step is to prepare the gravy. Step 5: Take the boiled egg and prick the skin of the egg to prevent from bursting while frying. Step 6: Now marinate the boiled eggs and potatoes with some salt and turmeric powder and keep aside for 5 minutes. Heat oil and ghee in a large non-stick pan, fry the marinated eggs and potatoes till they are golden brown, take them out of the pan and keep aside. Now in the same pan add Bay leaf, Radhuni & Methi and fry for a few seconds, but be careful, do not let the Methi burn. Step 7: Add sliced onion and some salt and cover the pan for 5 minutes. Open the lid after and fry the onion till golden brown. Step 8: Add ginger garlic paste to the pan and fry again for 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Add sliced tomatoes and fry till the tomatoes are pulpy. Now add the marinated meat and the "special spice powder" to the pan and cover it for 5 minutes. Step 10: After open the lid, and start frying on medium heat for 3-4 minutes. If the masala starts burning at the bottom, sprinkle some water and again fry. Step 11: Add the fried potatoes to the pan and water. Here you can cook the meat in Pressure Cooker or in the same pan. Step 12: If you are using a pressure cooker, then add all the meat along with the spices into the cooker, close the lid and cook for 5 minutes or upto 4 whistles. Let release all the pressures of the cooker by itself, and open the cooker and add the fried eggs now. Step 13: Boil the curry for 10 minutes and turn off the heat and serve with plain rice and cucumber salad. ORIf you are cooking the meat in the pan, then cover the pan, lower the heat and let the gravy boil for 10 minutes or till the meat is soft and tender. Step 14: When the meat is well cooked, open the lid and serve hot. Serve Mutton Dak Bungalow along with Phulka and Jeera Rice for a weekday meal.

Dish Name: Mutton Matar Keema -Minced Mutton With Green Peas
Ingredient Names: mutton, curd, onions, garlic, ginger, potatoes, green peas, green chilies, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, salt, sunflower oil, coriander leaves, dry red chilies, bay leaf, black pepper powder, cloves, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, black cardamom, carom seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mutton Matar Keema Recipe, firstly wash the minced mutton with running water, strain and keep it aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan and fry the potato pieces till golden and keep aside. In the remaining oil, add all the whole spices mentioned, after a few seconds add ginger slices and whole garlic cloves and fry till they turn golden brown. Now add sliced onions and green chilies and saute till the raw smell goes off. Add in the mutton mince and mix well. Step 3: Fry for some time till the moisture goes off. Add sour curd and mix nicely such that everything incorporates well. Step 4: Gradually the curd will start leaving water, so simmer the flames, close the lid and allow the minced mutton to cook nicely. Step 5: This may take 15 to. Once the mutton mince is soft and cooked completely, add in the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt, green peas and adjust the oil as well. Fry everything nicely on high to medium flame till the keema starts taking a deep brown color and leaves oil from sides. Now add the fried potatoes and give a quick mix again and cook for another 5 to or till the potatoes get soften. Turn off the gas and garnish with fresh chopped coriander. Serve Mutton Matar Keema with Hot Phulkas or Roomali rotis. Step 6: It is very popularly made in every Muslim household during any special occasion.

Ingredient Names: water, milk, sugar, tea leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil. Step 2: Add sugar and tea leaves. Step 3: Bring to a boil again and reduce heat. Step 4: Keep simmering for around 2 minutes. Step 5: Add milk and bring to boil again. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for a minute. Step 7: Take off the gas and strain into 2 cups Enjoy some kadak chai indian ishtyle and fay ishtyle too.

Ingredient Names: maida flour, nigella seeds, ajwain, salt, ghee, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large plate take 2 cup maida, 2 tsp kalonji, ½ tsp ajwain and 1 tsp salt. Step 2: Add 3 tbsp ghee and mix well. Crumble and mix, making sure the flour is moist. Step 3: Add water as needed and begin kneading the dough. Step 4: Add water in small batches to prepare a tight dough. Step 5: Rest the dough for at least 20 minutes. Step 6: Knead the dough again, then pinch off a ball-sized dough. Step 7: Roll them into a round / square shape, making them slightly thin. Step 8: Take a knife / pizza cutter and cut them into a diamond shape. Step 9: Drop the namak pare into the hot oil. Alternatively, bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Stir occasionally, and fry them to a nice golden brown on a low to medium flame. Step 11: Drain them off to remove excess oil. Step 12: Finally, allow Namak Para Recipe to cool to room temperature and store it in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: green moong dal, white urad dal, black urad dal, masoor dal, red kidney beans, chickpeas, yellow moong dal, toor dal, onion, tomato, ginger garlic paste, green chili, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, dried fenugreek, ginger, ghee, sugar, cumin seeds, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To make Navrang dal, first soak all the lentils overnight. Step 2: Soak pili moong dal and arhar dal for 30 minutes. Step 3: Put the lentils in the pressure cooker in the morning and cook till 3 years come. Step 4: After the cooker cools, mash the pour and keep it aside. Step 5: Now heat oil in a pan and add ghee to it. Step 6: After that add cinnamon, cumin and let it cook for 15 seconds. Step 7: After 15 seconds, add onion and let it cook till it turns light brown. Step 8: Now add garlic ginger paste and let it cook for 3-4 minutes. Step 9: After, add chopped tomatoes, green chilies and cook till the tomatoes soften slightly. Step 10: Now add coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder and cook for 5 minutes. Step 11: After, add the cooked lentils, salt, water as per the usage and let it cook for 5 minutes. Step 12: After, add Kasuri methi to it and mix. Step 13: After, add ginger to it and turn off the gas. Step 14: Serve Navrang dal with gram flour and chilli vegetable and phulka for dinner.

Ingredient Names: cashew nuts, almond, melon seeds, onion, tomato, mixed vegetables, ginger garlic paste, coconut milk, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt, ghee, pomegranate, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: To begin with Navratan Korma, soak cashew, almond and melon seeds in water for to prepare a paste. Step 2: Drain the water completely. Peel off the almond skin and blend all in a mixer to smooth paste adding a little water. Step 3: Keep it aside. Heat ghee or oil in a pan or a kadhai. Step 4: Add chopped onions and saute a while. Step 5: Next, add ginger-garlic paste and stir well. Add tomato and give a stir. Step 6: Add turmeric powder, chilli powder and coriander powder and mix well everything. Step 7: Add ground paste and water. Cook it uncovered for 5 minutes and add mixed vegetables and water. Step 8: Cook it covered on low-medium flame for 5 minutes. Add coconut milk, garam masala and salt to taste. Step 9: Mix well everything and cook again for another 2 minutes. Meanwhile, roast cashew and raisin in ghee and add this to the korma. Step 10: Garnish with pomegranate seeds and your dish is ready to be served. Serve Navratan Korma with Whole Wheat Lachha Parathas and Mushroom Pulav for a delicious lunch or dinner.

Dish Name: Nawabi Paneer Curry - Nawabi Paneer Curry
Ingredient Names: paneer, lemon juice, salt, cumin powder, chaat masala powder, black pepper powder, oil, coconut, cashews, green chilies, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, cumin, water, ghee, onions, garlic, ginger, green peas, red capsicum, coriander, turmeric powder, pepper powder, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Nawabi Paneer Curry Recipe, first of all, add cheese, lemon juice, salt, cumin powder, chaat masala powder, black pepper powder and oil to a mixing bowl.
