Ingredient Names: new potatoes, salt, vegetable oil, cumin seed, ground cumin, garam masala, cayenne pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub potatoes and put them in a saucepan. Step 2: Cover with water to come about 1 inch above the potatoes. Step 3: Add 1 t salt to the water and bring to a boil. Step 4: Cover and boil till potatoes are just tender, drain and peel. Step 5: Put the oil in a frying pan and set over med-high heat. Step 6: When the oil is hot, put in cumin seeds. Step 7: Let the seeds sizzle for a few seconds, put in potatoes. Step 8: Turn heat down to medium.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, lemons, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare sugar syrup first by simmering a cup of water to which 2 / 3 cup sugar or brown sugar is added. Step 2: Allow sugar to dissolve completely and cool Extract juice from 9-10 limes / lemons or approx 1 cup of lime / lemon juice. Step 3: Strain and discard the seeds, keep aside. Step 4: Take a pitcher and add 10 cups of cold water, add the extracted lime / lemon juice and cooled sugar syrup and combine. Step 5: Add 1 tsp of salt and combine If you find it to be less sweet, add more sugar syrup and if it needs to be more tart, add more lime / lemon juice. Step 6: Serve with ice in tall glasses.

Ingredient Names: coriander seed, cloves, cumin seed, brown cardamom pods, black peppercorns, nutmeg, cassia, bay leaves, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly roast everything except the ground ginger under low to medium heat or in a low oven Do not let the spices brown They should give off a light steam. Step 2: When the spices give off an aroma, remove from the heat, cool and grind in batches. Step 3: After grinding, add the ground ginger, mix thoroughly and store in an airtight container This will last almost indefinitely Makes about 14 ounces for an aromatic garam masala, omit the peppercorns and ginger.

Dish Name: Noodle Sizzler With Garlic Pepper Sauce And Baked Vegetables
Ingredient Names: hakka noodles, extra virgin olive oil, cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, red chili sauce, black pepper powder, salt, red bell pepper, fresh red chilies, onion, mixed vegetables, green bell pepper, button mushrooms, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Noodle Sizzler With Garlic Pepper Sauce And Baked Vegetables, we will first make the noodles. Heat oil in a wok or a heavy bottomed pan. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, cabbage and saute. Step 3: Cook on high heat for till the cabbage softens. Add soya sauce, red chilli sauce, pepper powder, salt and stir. Step 4: Add the noodles and toss to mix evenly. The next step is to make the garlic pepper sauce. Step 5: Remove the burnt skin from the capsicum and pepper. Step 6: Deseed and roughly chop them. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 7: Add garlic, onion and saute for a few seconds. Step 8: Add the chopped capsicum, peppers and salt. Cool and blend to a smooth paste. Step 9: Add water if required to get a pouring consistency sauce. Now, we will make the baked vegetables. Step 10: Preheat the oven to 180 degree C. Toss all the ingredients under baked vegetables, in an oven proof dish and bake till the vegetables are just soft. The final step is to assemble the sizzler. Step 11: Heat one large or two small sizzler plates till it becomes red hot. Ensure that the noodles and vegetables are hot too. Step 12: Place the hot plate on the wooden base. Step 13: Place 1-2 cabbage leaves on the hot sizzler plate. Place some noodles on one half of the plate and baked vegetables on the other. Step 14: Pour the sauce over the noodles and vegetables. Step 15: Serve immediately, sizzling hot. Serve Noodle Sizzler With Garlic Pepper Sauce And Baked Vegetables Recipe during your house parties along with Korean Style Kim chi Udon, stir. Step 16: Fry and Hunan Style Smacked Cucumber Pickles.

Dish Name: Okra Aubergine Eggplant And Meat Curry
Ingredient Names: mutton shoulder, onions, clarified butter, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, peppercorns, garlic cloves, gingerroot, garam masala, salt, tomatoes, okra, oil, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Trim mutton and cut into cubes heat the clarified butter / ghee in a pressure cooker or a thick bottomed vessel with a lid. Step 2: Add the whole spices and wait for them to bloat. Step 3: Then add the onions and fry till they are translucent add the ginger and garlic and fry till the mixture is golden brown now add the tomatoes and stir till the tomatoes are cooked and incorporated into the mixture, add the garam masala or spice powders and stir. Step 4: Add the meat pieces and stir till they are coated with the curry sauce. Step 5: Now add some water and salt, mix and cover. Step 6: Bring to a boil and then simmer until cooked. Step 7: Meanwhile cut the okra / aubergines into chunks Deep fry the vegetable used till slightly crisp, drain well.

Ingredient Names: okra, plain yogurt, chickpea flour, red chili pepper, garam masala, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and dry the okra. Step 2: Cut of the stem Shred the okra length-wise Dry the shredded okra. Step 3: Add all the other ingredients except oil and mix thoroughly Ensure that the coating is thick and is not running at all, heat oil in a wok. Step 4: Fry okra in hot oil in small batches, fry till brown. Step 5: Remove excess oil by draining on paper towel.

Ingredient Names: okra, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green chilies, ground cumin, ground coriander, water, oil, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a processor blend half of the onion with the garlic, ginger, chilli, coriander and cumin, add a little water to make a thin paste. Step 2: In a pan heat the oil and fry the remaining onions till golden and remove them and set aside. Step 3: Add the spice mixture to the pan and cook over low heat for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the okra, lemon juice and 4 fluid oz of water, simmer till the okra is tender. Step 5: Serve garnished with the fried onion.

Ingredient Names: onions, tomatoes, salt, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, black pepper, sugar, mustard oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the onions and give 2 slits diagonally without letting the layers come off Use of mustard oil is preferred but feel free to use your regular cooking oil if you want. Step 2: Take a heavy bottomed skillet or broad pan with flat bottom. Step 3: Let oil smoke properly if you are using mustard oil. Step 4: Once oil is smoked, lower the heat, wait for the oil to cool down for a minute or so. Step 5: Add all the spices and the salt. Step 6: Take care as not to burn the spices Immediately add onions and tomatoes. Step 7: Keep sauteeing and tossing them on high flame / heat for 10-12 minutes. Step 8: Let them go brown on the edges.

Dish Name: Oven Roasted Eggplant And Butternut Squash Curry
Ingredient Names: eggplant, butternut squash, canola oil, cumin seeds, onions, tomatoes, turmeric, ground fenugreek, ground coriander, ground pepper, jalapeno pepper, salt, green onions, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Wrap the eggplant and the butternut squash individually in aluminum foil. Step 3: Place them on a baking tray and bake them for 1 1 / 2 hours or until they are very soft The eggplants will become mushy and deflated While the eggplant and butternut squah are cooking, heat oil in large frying pan on medium-high heat for 1 minute. Step 4: Add cumin seeds and allow them to sizzle for about 30 seconds. Step 5: Stir in onions and saute until brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium and stir in tomatoes. Step 7: Add turmeric, fenugreek, coriander, black pepper, jalapeo pepper and salt. Step 8: Cook this masala for 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Palak Ki Puri A Puri Made Of Fresh Spinach
Ingredient Names: wheat flour, spinach, onion, milk, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and wash spinach. Step 2: Place in a pan with little water and onion, cook until tender. Step 3: Drain and grind to a paste Sift flour and salt in a large bowl. Step 4: Add spinach and milk to make a stiff dough. Step 5: Knead the dough well. Step 6: Divide it into 20 parts. Step 7: Roll them out into round puris of 3" diameter each. Step 8: Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry 1 or 2 puris at a time.

Ingredient Names: rice, masoor dal, spinach leaves, garlic, onion, green peas, broccoli, tofu, cinnamon stick, cumin seeds, bay leaf, green chilies, turmeric powder, asafoetida, garam masala powder, tomato, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Palak Kichdi recipe, In a pressure cooker add rice, dal, broccoli, peas, turmeric, one pinch of hing, little oil and water and pressure cook. In a saucepan, bring water to a boil and add the cleaned spinach leaves and let it sit for a minute in the pot while the flame is still on. Step 2: Now drain it in a colander and transfer it into a bowl of cold water. Step 3: Once its cool grind it to a paste in a mixer grinder and set aside. In a wide pan, heat some oil and add bay leaf, jeera, chopped garlic, pinch of hing, green chillies, chopped onions and saute it until the onions have started to change colour to this mixture. Once it is done, add the pureed spinach and mix everything properly. Lower the flame, add the cool dal and rice mixture into the pot and mix until combined with the palak mixture, add the chopped tofu, some water if necessary and season with salt. Also add the garam masala if using at this stage. Step 4: Cook for 5 minutes and turn of the flame. In a tadka pan, add some ghee/oil add sliced garlic and cook till its starts to brown, pour this onto the khichdi. Garnish with sliced tomatoes and it is ready to be served. Step 5: Serve Palak Kichdi with Lauki Raita, Avocado Raita or any other raita of your choice for a comforting weekday meal.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, spinach, onion, red chili powder, turmeric powder, green chili, fruit salt, sunflower oil, greek yogurt, lukewarm water, coriander powder, garam masala powder, asafoetida, salt, cumin seeds, curry leaves, ghee, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Palak Onion Kadhi Pakora Recipe, we will make the pakoras first. Step 2: *Method for Pakora'sCombine all the ingredients for the palak pakora in a large bowl. Step 3: Add very little water to make a thick batter. Heat the kuzhi paniyaram pan on medium heat; add a teaspoon of oil into each of the cavities and drop a spoon of the pakora batter into the cavity. Step 4: Cover the pan and steam cook the pakora's until you notice the top has steamed. Once the top has steamed, flip them over to cook on the other side. Step 5: Continue to cook on medium heat until the pakoras has cooked through from the inside and have a golden brown color. Step 6: Proceed the same way with the remaining pakora batter and keep them aside.*Method for the Punjabi KadhiWhisk the yogurt, gram flour, water, asafoetida, chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt until well blended. Step 7: Add the water and whisk more until well blended. Step 8: Place the kadhi in a saucepan, on medium high heat and allow it to come to a brisk boil. Keep whisking it continuously while it is on heat, as this will help the yogurt and the spices along with gram flour come together into a creamy texture. Step 9: Allow the kadhi to boil briskly for about 3 to, then turn the heat to low and simmer for another 15-20 minutes. The simmering process helps the kadhi get the flavors of the spices and the gram flour. Step 10: It will thicken slightly and attain a smooth creamy consistency and it will have a shine to it. Towards the end of the simmering process, add in the spinach pakora's. Step 11: We will proceed to make the seasoning for the Khadi. Heat ghee in a large sauce pan; add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, cinnamon stick and the whole red chillies. Step 12: Allow them to crackle. Step 13: Add the onions and ginger and saute until onions turn golden and tender. Step 14: Finally, stir in the curry leaves and pour the seasoning mixture into the simmering Kadhi. Note: The Kadhi will thicken as the Pakora simmers in the yogurt curry, so once again adjust the thickness by adding little or more water as required and adjust to the consistency you like. Step 15: Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste. Transfer the Palak Kadhi Pakora to the serving bowl. Step 16: Garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve the Palak Onion Kadhi Pakora along with Phulka, Bhindi Masala Recipe (Bhindi Tamatar Ki Sabzi) and Bean Sprout & Corn Salad Recipe.

Dish Name: Palak Paneer Indian Fresh Spinach With Paneer Cheese
Ingredient Names: baby spinach, onion, cinnamon, ground cardamom, ground ginger, garlic, chopped tomato, plain yogurt, coriander powder, garam masala, paprika, salt, paneer cheese, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cut spinach into shreds and cook in 3 tablespoons water until tender, remove from heat. Step 2: Saute onion, cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger in 1-2 tablespoons ghee or oil until onion is translucent. Step 3: Then add garlic and chopped tomatoes, and reduce heat. Step 4: Cook this briefly and slowly blend in yogurt a little at a time to prevent curdling. Step 5: Add coriander, garam masala, paprika, and salt, mixing well. Step 6: Add cooked spinach with liquid, cover and simmer on low heat for approximately 20-30 minutes, remove from heat. Step 7: Take half of spinach mixture and puree in food processor or blender, and return to mixture and stir Slowly stir in heavy cream, and heat through on low heat.

Dish Name: Paneer Butter Masala Biryani - Layered Paneer Butter Masala Biryani
Ingredient Names: rice, water, ghee, cardamom, cloves, star anise, cinnamon, whole black pepper, salt, bay leaf, onion, coriander leaves, mint leaves, paneer, tomatoes, cream, ginger, garlic, green chili, cardamom powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, dried fenugreek, honey, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: To make Paneer Butter Masala Biryani recipe, first wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes. Step 2: To make rice for biryani, heat ghee in a pressure cooker. Step 3: Add cardamom, long, star anise, cinnamon, whole black pepper, bay leaves, and cook for 10 minutes. Step 4: Now add rice, salt, water and close the cooker. Step 5: Cook till 2 cities come and turn off the gas. Step 6: Allow the pressure to drain automatically. Step 7: Open the cooker and spread out the rice in a plate so that it becomes slightly cold. Step 8: Now add fried onions, coriander leaves, mint and mix well, keep it aside. Step 9: To make Paneer Butter Masala for Biryani, heat oil in a pan. Step 10: Add cumin, cardamom, green chillies, ginger, garlic, onion and cook till the onion turns brown. Step 11: Now add tomatoes, salt and turn off the gas, allow to cool. Step 12: Now put this mixture in a mixer grinder and grind it into a paste. Step 13: Heat some oil in a pan. Step 14: Add the ground spices to it and cook for 5 minutes. Step 15: After this, add cumin powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, honey, kasoori methi and let it cook on low flame. Step 16: After the gravy boils, add cottage cheese, cream and mix it. Step 17: Turn off the gas after. Step 18: To make biryani, grease a large bowl with butter. Step 19: Add fried onions, mint leaves, coriander. Step 20: Make a rice layer over it, press it well. Step 21: Now add Paneer Butter Masala to it. Step 22: Re-insert these layers and place the rice on the topmost layer. Step 23: Now place a plate over it and reverse it, serve. Step 24: Serve Paneer Butter Masala Biryani Recipe along with Bundi Raita and Papad for dinner.

Ingredient Names: onions, chopped tomatoes, dried fenugreek leaves, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, double cream, garlic cloves, panir, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Shallow fry the paneer in a pan with 1 cm of oil until it is golden brown all around and set aside on a kitchen paper covered plate Grind the onion in the blender until pureed. Step 2: Heat a 2-3 tablespoon of oil in a wok and fry minced garlic for 1 minute. Step 3: Add the blended onion and continue frying on medium heat until the smell of raw onion goes, about 10-15 mins. Step 4: Add the coriander, cumin, chilli and turmeric powder and continue frying for 3-4 mins. Step 5: Blend the tin of tomato and fenugreek leaves in the blender until pureed. Step 6: Add the tomato mixture to the onion mixture in the wok and continue frying for 3-4 minutes until the mixture is cooked. Step 7: Add the grama masala and continue frying for another minute or two. Step 8: Add the frozen peas and add salt to taste. Step 9: Add the double cream and bring it to boil and simmer for 3-4 minutes.

Dish Name: Paneer Matar Butter Masala (Indian Cottage Cheese and Peas Masala With Butter)
Ingredient Names: paneer, sunflower oil, green peas, salt, sugar, red chili powder, milk, dried fenugreek, onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, ghee, dry red chilies, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, whole black peppercorns, coriander seeds, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Paneer Matar Butter Masala recipe, first shallow fry the paneer cubes in oil in a wide pan until it is slightly golden/ creamy golden and keep it aside. The next step is to prepare the masala/gravy. Step 2: Heat butter/clarified butter in a large heavy bottomed pan, add onions and peas/matar. Sauté until onions & peas/matar till the onions turn transparent. Step 3: Add ginger and garlic and stir for 1 to. Add whole dry red chilies, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, whole black peppercorns and coriander seeds (that is all the whole spices) and stir a few times. Add tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn soft and mushy. Step 4: Remove from heat and keep aside to cool a little. Puree this entire mixture along with cashews until smooth, adding a little water if required. Transfer this gravy back to the wide pan and place on heat. Step 5: Add shallow fried paneer pieces to the gravy, add salt to taste, sugar, kasuri methi, chili powder (if using), water if required to achieve desired consistency and simmer on low heat for the flavors to mingle. Finally add milk, mix well, allow the curry to simmer for another minute or so on low heat, then remove. Serve Paneer Matar Butter Masala with Phulkas or even steamed rice for a delicious weekday meal.

Ingredient Names: green peas, potato, paneer, tomato, tomato puree, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, asafoetida, onion, ginger garlic paste, coriander leaves, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, sunflower oil, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Paneer Matar Keema Recipe, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 2: Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, asafoetida and let it splutter. Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the finely chopped onions. Step 3: Cook them till they turn soft and translucent. Once the onions are soft, add the ginger garlic paste and let it cook for about 5 minutes. After add the finely chopped tomatoes and tomato puree. Cover with lid and let it cook it for about 3 to. Next, add the spices including red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt. Step 4: Let it cook for 5 minutes. Now add the mashed potato, crumbled paneer and water. Step 5: Mix everything properly and let it cook for 6 to. After 6 to, add the boiled green peas, mix well, cover the pan and let the Green Peas Gravy With Vegetables cook for another 3 to. Once it is done, garnish Matar Keema recipe with coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve Paneer Matar Keema Recipe along with Dal Palak, Lauki Raita and Phulka for an everyday meal with your family.

Ingredient Names: panir, salt, red chili powder, fresh ginger, plain yogurt, oil, tomatoes, green chilies, green pepper, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, bay leaves, coriander powder, turmeric, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the paneer about 1 / 4 inch thick into 1-inch squares. Step 2: Put into bowl and mix in ginger, salt, red chili powder, coriander, and yogurt. Step 3: Marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Step 4: Blend the tomatoes and green chiles into a paste. Step 5: Set aside Over medium heat with oil, gently fry the marinated paneer for about 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Remove paneer and set aside For gravy: add additional oil if needed. Step 7: Fry cumin seeds until they sizzle. Step 8: Add asafetida and bay leaves.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic cloves, cumin seed, ground turmeric, curry powder, chili, tomatoes, eggs, double cream, fresh coriander, toast
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a frying pan and fry the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes, or until soft. Step 2: Add the spices and chilli and cook for a further 4-5 minutes, or until fragrant and well combined Be careful not to burn the chili or garlic! Step 3: Add the tomatoes and cook for a further 3-4 minutes, or until softened. Step 4: Beat the eggs and cream together in a bowl, then add the mixture to the pan and cook, stirring constantly, until the eggs are just set. Step 5: Stir in the coriander. Step 6: Spoon the eggs onto the toast to serve.

Ingredient Names: mutton, onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, green chilies, curd, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, bay leaf, salt, sunflower oil, black pepper powder, cloves, cardamom pods, black cardamom, cinnamon stick, mace, carom seeds, coriander leaves, potato
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Parsi Salli Boti recipe, wash mutton pieces nicely under running water, strain and keep aside in a mixing bowl. Add yogurt/curd along with ginger garlic paste, coriander powder, red chilli powder and turmeric. Step 2: Season with salt and mix well. Add the curd mix to the mutton pieces and mix well such that everything incorporates well. Cover the marinade with a cling wrap and keep the bowl in the refrigerator for around 30 to. Heat oil in a thick bottomed pan or wok and add bay leaf. Step 3: Now add chopped onions and saute till they are golden in colour. Add in the chopped tomatoes and mix well. Step 4: Cook till the tomatoes soften and turn mushy. Take the mutton marinade and add in to the wok and ground spice mix. Step 5: Stir well and fry till the texture becomes a little watery. Adjust salt if needed and also add more oil if required. Close the lid of the allow the mutton to cook in medium to low flames till it softens. Step 6: This might take an hour or so. Once the mutton is cooked, turn the flames high and fry nicely till oil starts leaving the sides. Adjust the consistency of the gravy to semi liquid and give a boil again. Turn off the heat and garnish with plenty of potato fried and coriander. Step 7: Serve Parsi Salli Boti along with Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha and Steamed Rice for a weekend lunch or dinner.

Dish Name: Parsi Style Lagan Sara Istew - Rich Sweet Assorted Vegetable Curry
Ingredient Names: carrot, baby potatoes, elephant yam, green peas, raisins, dates, vinegar, jaggery, onion, tomato, garlic, ginger, green chilies, turmeric powder, red chili powder, dhansak masala, salt, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin by making the Parsi Style Lagan Sarai Istew Recipe in a pressure cooker add carrots, baby potatoes and elephant yam with water and salt for about 1 whistle. Step 2: Set aside to release the pressure naturally. Step 3: In a small bowl soak the raisins and jaggery in vinegar. Step 4: Keep it aside to rest. Step 5: Next is to heat a small shallow pan, add oil, saute the onions and tomato with little salt, cook until the tomatoes turn soft. Step 6: Let it cool, and blend into a smooth paste in a hand blender. Step 7: Heat a heavy bottomed pan with oil, saute the vegetables that have been cooked first till it becomes crisp little. Step 8: Remove the vegetables and in the same oil add the ginger, garlic, and chillies. Add in the blended paste along with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, dhansak masala powder and add the soaked raisins and dates along with the vinegar and jaggery. Step 9: Check for the seasoning. Step 10: Finally, add in the vegetables along with the peas and add water and reduce the heat. Step 11: Cook it over low heat for about till the vegetables are well cooked, once done. Step 12: Garnish Parsi Style Lagan Sara Istew with chopped coriander leaves and serve. Serve the Parsi Style Lagan Sara Istew Recipe with Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha Recipe and Beetroot, Carrot & Cucumber Salad With Peanuts for a wholesome dinner meal.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, mustard oil, cumin seeds, asafoetida, fenugreek seeds, green chili, red chili powder, cumin powder, bay leaf, coriander powder, dry mango powder, chaat masala powder, garam masala powder, turmeric powder, dried fenugreek, tomato puree, tamarind paste, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Patiala Aloo Recipe, keep the peeled and cubed potatoes immersed in salt water to avoid discoloration. Step 2: Heat a deep bottomed pan with mustard oil on high heat and take it to smoking point. Step 3: Reduce the flame once it reaches the smoking point, add the cumin seeds, bay leaf, fenugreek seeds, asafoetida and allow it sizzle. Step 4: Right after, drain the water off the potatoes and add them into the pan. Step 5: Now add the slit green chilli, salt, turmeric powder and give it a good mix. Step 6: Cover and cook until the potatoes are almost done. Step 7: This will take a good on medium-high flame. Step 8: Now open the lid, and reduce the flame. Step 9: Ensure that the potatoes have cooked through. Step 10: To the aloo add, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, amchur, chaat masala and garam masala. Step 11: Sprinkle a few drops of water and give it a good stir. Step 12: Next add in the tomato puree and the tamarind paste, such that the potatoes get well coated with this spice-tomato masala. Step 13: Continue to cook the Patiala Aloo for another minute or two, until the raw smell of the tomatoes go away. Step 14: Finally mix in the chopped coriander leaves and transfer the Patiala Aloo to a serving bowl and serve hot. Step 15: Serve Patiala Aloo Recipe along with Dhaba Style Dal. Step 16: Fry, Phulkas, Dhaba Style Spicy Ghee, Boondi Raita, Pickled Onions followed by a dessert of Thandai Shahi Tukda.

Dish Name: Pavakka Theeyal - Spicy & Tangy Karela In Tamarind Gravy
Ingredient Names: bitter gourd, onions, tamarind water, water, jaggery, sunflower oil, salt, fresh coconut, turmeric powder, coriander seeds, dry red chilies, fenugreek seeds, whole black peppercorns, curry leaves, coconut oil, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Pavakka Theeyal recipe, firstly cut the bitter gourds into semi circles and soak them in required salt water. Step 2: After, squeeze the bitter gourds and keep it aside. Step 3: The next step is to make the masala for Bitter Gourd curry. Step 4: Add coconut, coriander seeds and dry red chillies into a heavy bottomed pan and dry roast till the coconut turns dark brown. Then reduce the flame and add turmeric, fenugreek seeds, peppercorns and curry leaves. Step 5: Let it cook for 1 more minute. After a minute, add coconut oil and switch off the heat. Step 6: Add this gravy mixture into a grinder, add a little water and grind it into a smooth paste. Heat some more oil the same pan and add the cut bitter gourd. Step 7: Stir fry them till the bitter gourd roundels become crispy. Step 8: Once the bitter gourd becomes crispy, add onions and cook them till they turn soft and brown. Add the grounded curry paste, tamarind juice, jaggery and water. Step 9: Mix everything properly. Step 10: Add salt in the curry and let it cook for about 5 to. Step 11: Once it is ready, switch off the heat. Next, to make the tadka for curry, heat oil in a tadka pan. Step 12: When the oil is hot, add mustard seeds, curry leaves and dry red chillies. Step 13: Let it cook for about 30 seconds and add it to the curry. Step 14: Give it a mix and it is ready to be served. Step 15: Serve Pavakka Theeyal along with Palak Raita and Phulka for a weekday lunch with your family. Step 16: You can also pack it in your Lunch box. Step 17: You could also serve it along with Steamed rice, Snake Gourd Thoran Recipe (Turai Thoran) and drink a glass of Spiced Butter Milk With Coriander And Ginger Recipe with the meal.

Ingredient Names: sugar, roasted peanuts, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the skin of the roasted peanuts. Step 2: Grease a metal plate with little oil and keep aside. Step 3: In a heavy saucepan, add sugar and moist it with 5 tbsp of water. Step 4: Cook and keep mixing on a low flame till the sugar turns into a light brown caramel. Step 5: Add the peanuts into the caramel and mix them quickly. Step 6: Drop in the pat of butter and stir Quickly pour the sticky mixture onto the greased plate. Step 7: Allow it to cool and set Break into small pieces and serve.

Ingredient Names: bosc pears, onion, golden raisin, fresh ginger, orange zest, garlic cloves, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, jalapeno pepper, sugar, cider vinegar, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain the pears Pat dry with toweling Peel the fruit, core and then chop coarsely, into about 1 / 2-inch pieces. Step 2: Place the fruit in a heavy medium-size saucepan, along with the onions, raisins, ginger, orange or lemon peel, garlic, cinnamon, clove or allspice, red pepper flakes or jalapeno pepper and sugar. Step 3: Stir in the cider vinegar, salt and black pepper and mix well. Step 4: Place the saucepan on medium high heat and bring to a boil, stirring well. Step 5: Then, lower the heat to simmer and continue cooking and stirring the sauce for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours, or until it is the consistency of thick jam and almost all of the liquid is absorbed. Step 6: Make sure to stir often from the bottom of the pan to prevent it from scorching The chutney is ready when the pears are translucent and the mixture is thick, dark and syrupy Pack the hot chutney into jars, cover with lids and let cool before storing in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, sunflower oil, salt, butter, whole wheat flour, milk, cheddar cheese, black pepper powder, italian seasoning, red chili flakes, sweet corn, broccoli, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Penne Pasta In White Sauce Recipe, heat enough water in a saucepan, add salt and oil to it. Step 2: Once the water boils add pasta and cook it uncovered until al dente (it is soft but firm). Step 3: Keep stirring in between. Strain the cooked pasta through a colander and reserve the water in which the pasta is cooked. Step 4: (this starchy water may be used further to thin the sauce)In a sauce pan melt butter on a low flame and add flour to it. Step 5: Roast the flour well for about a minute. Add 1/2 of the boiled and cooled milk slowly, as you stir the flour continuously so that it blends well with the milk without forming lumps. Now stir in remaining milk and allow the sauce to boil and thicken. Step 6: Season it with black pepper powder, salt and chilly flakes. Step 7: (be careful while adding salt as veggies and pasta also have salt). Lastly add grated cheese, mix well and cook for a while and put off the flame. Step 8: The white sauce is ready. Step 9: If the sauce appears lumpy and thick, add hot water( we reserved in )to thin it. Step 10: Allow the sauce to simmer until desired consistency is reached. Meanwhile heat butter in another pan and add the boiled sweet corn kernels and other veggies and saute for 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Season the veggies with salt and chilly flakes. Step 12: Do not over cook the bell peppers and broccoli. Step 13: Veggies give a nice crunch to the creamy pasta. Add the sauteed vegetables to the white sauce and stir well. Step 14: Lastly add boiled pasta to vegetables and white sauce and stir so that the pasta coats well with the sauce. Serve Penne Pasta In White Sauce Recipe immediately Healthy Fresh Vegetable Salad Bowl with Sour Yogurt Dressing Recipe or any salad of your choice.

Dish Name: Phall The Hottest Curry Of All
Ingredient Names: meat, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ghee, canned tomatoes, tomato ketchup, tomato puree, dried chilies, cumin, coriander, chili powder, dried fenugreek leaves, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the meat in a pan in half the ghee or oil, until sealed, set aside. Step 2: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger until golden in remaining ghee or oil. Step 3: Mix the spices with a little water to make a paste. Step 4: Add to the onion mixture and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomato and chilies. Step 6: Cook for a further 10 minutes. Step 7: Combine the meat and all ingredients in a casserole dish and cook in a pre-heated oven at 400 deg f, gas 6 for 45 to 60 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sift all purpose flour and salt. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 tbsp oil, knead lightly. Step 3: Add water and knead well till becomes soft Water should be added gradually. Step 4: Keep aside covered for about 20 minutes. Step 5: Divide into about 10 portions. Step 6: Roll out each portion into a round size of about four inch diameter. Step 7: Heat oil to very hot in a deep frying pan. Step 8: Fry one at a time with light tapping so that it puffs, turn over till light golden.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, onions, garlic cloves, sunflower oil, madras curry powder, cardamom pods, tomato puree, chicken bouillon powder, fresh ground black pepper, dark soy sauce, coconut cream, apricot halves in light syrup, lemon juice, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in the sunflower oil in a heavy pan until deep golden in colour. Step 2: Add the pork and fry for further 3 mins stirring. Step 3: Add the crushed garlic and fry for further 2 minutes. Step 4: Now add the curry powder and cardamom pods and keep stirring until all the spices in the powder have released their scent. Step 5: Add tomato puree and stir well then add enough water to cover all ingredients. Step 6: Add 3 / 4 can of apricots and all the syrup, chicken bouillon powder, pepper and soy sauce. Step 7: Simmer covered for 11 / 2 to 2 hours until pork is meltingly tender. Step 8: Add last of apricots, coconut cream and salt if necessary. Step 9: Cook for further 1 / 2 hour until sauce has thickened, taste again and add lemon juice if needed to balance the sweetness This curry should be savoury and not too sweet.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, butter, onions, garlic cloves, ground cinnamon, chili powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, tomatoes, tomato puree, water, coconut cream, green chili, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a pot and melt the butter. Step 2: Fry the onions and garlic for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the cinnamon, chili powder, coriander, cumin and turmeric, stir and fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the pork and cook for 3 minutes stirring to coat the meat with the spices. Step 5: Add the chopped tomato and puree with the water, mix well and add the chopped chili coconut cream and paprika. Step 6: Cover pot and cook on low heat till the meat is tender, approx 30 minutes. Step 7: Season with salt to taste. Step 8: Serve with rice and a vegetable curry for a complete meal.

Ingredient Names: country-style pork ribs, chili powder, ground coriander, turmeric, ground ginger, cayenne, salt and pepper, coconut milk, onions, garlic cloves, beef stock, butter, red potatoes, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all the spices and add a few spoonfuls of coconut milk, enough to make a thin paste. Step 2: Add enough cayenne to make it fairly hot Enough to give spicy heat to all the meat and onions. Step 3: Heat the oil or butter, etc And cook the onions and garlic until lightly browned. Step 4: Add the paste and continue frying for a couple minutes. Step 5: Add the meat and stir to cover with the paste and brown a bit. Step 6: Add the beef broth, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently until the meat is very tender - at least 2 hours. Step 7: Add the optional potatoes when the meat is tender and continue cooking until the potatoes are done. Step 8: Stir in the remaining coconut milk and the lemon juice and continue simmering for 10 minutes until thickened a bit.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork shoulder, coriander seed, cumin seed, mustard seeds, dried red chili peppers, turmeric, red wine vinegar, garlic, mustard oil, cinnamon sticks, cloves, onion, fresh ginger, paprika, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Trim all visible fat off the pork and cut into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl. Step 2: Combine coriander, cumin, mustard and chilies, grind into a fine powder and transfer into a measuring cup. Step 3: Add turmeric, vinegar and garlic and mix. Step 4: Pour the marinade over the pork and rub well. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate overnight. Step 6: Heat the oil in a large heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat until hot. Step 7: Add the cinnamon, cloves, onions and ginger. Step 8: Cook until the onions are very soft - do not let them brown - about 5 minutes. Step 9: Remove pork from the refrigerator and drain, reserving the liquid. Step 10: Add pork to the onion mixture and cook until the meat is lightly seared.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, butter, onion, boneless pork, whole cumin seeds, chicken stock, light coconut milk, coarse grain mustard, salt, turmeric, cayenne, spinach, yukon gold potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil in pressure cooker. Step 2: Cook onion, stirring often, for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add pork and cumin seeds and cook until pork is lightly browned - 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Add water and stir well, making sure to scrape up all fond. Step 5: Add coconut milk and blend in mustard, salt, turmeric, and cayenne. Step 6: Add frozen blocks of spinach and set potatoes on top Lock pressure cooker lid in place and bring to high pressure. Step 7: Lower heat and cook for 15 minutes Slow-release pressure. Step 8: Cut potatoes into smaller pieces and adjust sauce for taste - adding salt, cayenne or mustard as needed.

Dish Name: Posto Chicken - Bengali Chicken In Poppy Seed Paste
Ingredient Names: chicken, poppy seeds, garlic, ginger, green chilies, onion, tomato, red chili powder, garam masala powder, mustard oil, salt, bay leaf, cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, fennel seeds, lemon juice, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Posto Chicken recipe, wash and clean the chicken. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine the chicken pieces, lemon juice, ginger, garlic, salt to taste, turmeric powder and mustard oil. Step 3: Cling wrap the bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 4: Soak Poppy Seed in water and then grind to make a paste along with cloves, ginger and green chilli. Heat mustard oil in a wok or pan on medium heat, add the bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon stick and fennel seeds, when they begin to sizzle add finely chopped onion and fry till golden. Add chopped tomato and fry till the tomato is mushy. Add the poppy seed paste and Red Chilli powder and Garam Masala powder. Fry the masala till oil starts leaving the sides. Step 5: Add the marinated chicken pieces and fry them till the raw smell goes off and they loose their pink color and becomes a light yellow. Step 6: Adjust salt as need and add about water or more as needed for the gravy. Step 7: Cover the lid and cook till the chicken is done. Step 8: Garnish with fresh chopped coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve Posto Chicken along withSteamed Rice, and Bengali Bhetki Macher Paturi Recipe for a lovely Sunday lunch.

Dish Name: Potato And Egg Pan Omelette Parsi Style
Ingredient Names: potato, ghee, eggs, salt, black pepper, ground cumin, fresh cilantro, onion, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Parboil potato in lightly salted boiling water for a minute or two, drain well in colander. Step 2: Heat ghee or oil in a frying pan fry the potato until lightly browned Lift out on slotted spoon and set aside Separate eggs and beat the whites until frothy, then beat in the yolks, salt, pepper and cumin. Step 3: Fold in coriander, onion and chilies Golden brown on bottom, turn omelet over and cook until brown on other side. Step 4: Serve hot with chapatis or bread.

Ingredient Names: sweet onions, garlic cloves, ginger, green chilies, fresh cilantro, salt, turmeric, coriander, cumin, water, green plantains, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Put first five ingredient in food processor and puree. Step 2: Heat oil medium in saucepan and add next four ingredients cook on medium 3-5 minutes, add puree to pan. Step 3: Cook 5 - 7 minutes. Step 4: Add water, potatoes, and plantain. Step 5: Boil, then reduce heat to simmer for 30 minutes. Step 6: When potato and plantain are soft, scoop some out and mash in a separate bowl. Step 7: Mix the mashed back into the pot to thicken the sauce. Step 8: Simmer for 5 more minutes, then serve.

Ingredient Names: potato, onion, tomatoes, curry powder, salt, cooking oil, whole mustard seeds, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes with skins on Remove skins Mash potatoes lightly, but not as you would for mashed potatoes! Step 2: There should be nice small chunks in the potatoes but partially mashed. Step 3: Heat oil on medium heat in a nice sized vessel, add mustard seed. Step 4: Let mustard seed splutter. Step 5: Add chopped onion, and fry lightly. Step 6: Add diced tomatoes and fry until soft. Step 7: Add the chopped coriander leaves, curry powder.

Dish Name: Potato Curry With Peas And Carrots
Ingredient Names: olive oil, curry powder, garlic cloves, onions, carrots, frozen peas, salt, ground coriander, turmeric, potatoes, coconut milk, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy-bottomed skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: When hot, add the hot curry powder and stir it around for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the onions to the pan and saute until they are tender and a bit golden. Step 4: When youre there, add the carrots, potatoes, and minced garlic Give it all a good stir, and then add about a half cup each of water and coconut milk. Step 5: Stir in the turmeric, salt, and coriander. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low and cover it. Step 7: Check every so often to stir the pot and check the moisture level. Step 8: When the moisture is almost all absorbed, add more coconut milk and water, in equal parts Continue to cook, stir, and add liquid until the vegetables are very tender and the curry is nice and thick.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, salt, sunflower oil, potato, red chili powder, garam masala powder, coriander leaves, sugar, lemon juice, toor dal, turmeric powder, raw peanuts, tomato, green chili, ginger, jaggery, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, asafoetida, curry leaves, dry red chilies, cinnamon stick, cloves, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Potato Stuffed Dal Dhokli Recipe, get prep with all the ingredients mentioned and proceed with making the dumplings. Step 2: Start with sieving the flour with salt and knead into a semi-stiff dough with enough water. Cover the dough with a lid and keep aside for 5 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile prepare filling for dumplings. Step 4: Take boiled and mashed potato in one bowl, add salt to taste, chilli powder, turmeric powder, chopped coriander, Garam masala, lemon juice and sugar(optional). Mix all spices well into potato. Step 5: Make medium sized balls from the potato mixture. Make about 10-15 equal small sized balls from the dough. Roll out into 3-4 inches diameter roti base with a rolling pin, place the potato ball in center of roti. Step 6: This rolled out roti dough should be thinner, like the thickness of regular chapati. Bring together all the edges in the center and join them. Step 7: Cover whole potato roll with roti, remove the excess dough if necessary. Step 8: Try to avoid thick covering around the stuffing. Similarly, prepare 10-15 dumplings till all the filling is used up and cover with a plate. For Lentil CurryTo make lentil curry, clean, wash and drain the lentils. Step 9: Combine the lentil, about water, & turmeric powder in a pressure cooker and cook for 3 whistles. Combine the cooked dal and a cup of hot water in a tall mixing bowl and blend it well using a hand blender till smooth. Step 10: Add enough water and mix very well. Place the mixture in a shallow frying pan on the flame and add turmeric powder, peanuts boiled, salt to taste, tomato, green chilli, ginger, lemon juice, & jaggery. Mix well and cook on a medium flame for 10 to, while stirring occasionally. Now add prepared dumplings gently into dal, and cook them for another 5 minutes, once dumplings are starting to come at top of dal, it is almost cooked. Meanwhile, for the tempering, heat the oil in a small non-stick pan, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds, allow them to crackle. When the seeds crackle, add the asafoetida, curry leaves, red chillies, cinnamon, cloves, bay Leaf and sauté on medium till aromatic. Add this tempering to the dal, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 2 to, while stirring occasionally. After adding tempering cook for 5 minutes and now it is ready to serve. Serve Potato Stuffed Dal Dhokli Recipe along with Masala Khichia Recipe (Spicy Corn Flour Papad) for a meal in itself.

Dish Name: Potatoes In Sweet Sour Tomato Gravy
Ingredient Names: potatoes, tomatoes, curry leaves, cinnamon stick, mustard seeds, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, sugar, tomato ketchup, salt, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok / kadai Crackle the mustard seeds, throw in the cinnamon sticks. Step 2: Add the curry leaves and the chopped tomatoes, stir and cover with a lid. Step 3: Cook with the lid on for 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove the lid and mash the tomatoes to form a not-so-fine paste. Step 5: When the oil starts coming out of the tomatoes add in all the dry powders and the sugar. Step 6: Stir for a minute or two. Step 7: Add in the potatoes and stir. Step 8: Pour the water and bring to a boil The consistency of the preparation should not be very thick or watery.

Dish Name: Potatoes With Garam Masala And Spicy Tomato
Ingredient Names: yukon gold potato, vegetable oil, asafoetida powder, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, cayenne, cold water, plum tomatoes, garam masala, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub potatoes. Step 2: Place in a medium pot and cover with water. Step 3: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and cover. Step 5: Simmer until fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Step 6: Drain and rinse in several changes of cold water and let stand. Step 7: When potatoes are cool enough to handle, peel and cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes. Step 8: Place in bowl and toss with 2 tablespoons of the oil. Step 9: Heat remaining oil over medium-high heat in a medium saucepan or skillet. Step 10: When hot, add asafetida, stir and let sizzle for 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, bay leaves, onions, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, carrot, green chili sauce, green bell pepper, tomato pasta sauce, prawns, butter, sunflower oil, cloves, whole black peppercorns, cinnamon powder, black pepper powder, coriander leaves, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Prawn Masala Rice Recipe, firstly marinate the prawns by applying chilly powder, turmeric powder and salt and keep them aside for 1 hour. Scrape the outer skin of the carrot and cut it into fine long slices. Step 2: Chop the capsicum into thin long slices. Par boil the basmati rice in a saucepan by adding bay leaves, peppercorns, cloves and a pinch of salt. Also add oil to the boiling rice so that they don't become sticky. After the rice gets par-boiled, spread it on a colander/big strainer so the water drains out and let it dry for 5 minutes. Spread the cinnamon and pepper powder on it. In a kadai/wok add oil and fry onions and let them turn pinkish. Step 3: Then add the paste made out of garlic and ginger. Step 4: Let it get fried for sometime. Add the veggies and fry for sometime. Step 5: Cut the prawns into and add it to the kadai and fry for about 3-4 minutes. After, add the sauces and fry for one more minute. Add salt and mix well. Once this is done add the cooked basmati rice and mix well ensuring that the rice grains does not break. Step 6: Add butter and mix properly. Switch off the gas and garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve Prawn Masala Rice Recipe with green salad and raita of your choice for a delicious weekday lunch or dinner.

Ingredient Names: prawns, coconut milk, fennel seeds, black pepper powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, curry leaves, coriander leaves, tamarind paste, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, onion, mustard seeds, salt, coconut oil
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Prawns Coconut Curry Recipe, begin by making a paste of fennel, pepper, ginger and garlic by adding a little water. Heat a Kadai or meen chatty with oil. Step 2: Once hot, splutter mustard seeds. Add the above paste and saute till the raw smell leaves. Add curry leaves, green chilli and chopped onions. Step 3: Saute till onions turn translucent. Add in chopped tomatoes and cook till tomatoes turn mushy. Add in tamarind paste. Step 4: Add coriander powder and chilli powder and mix for a minute. Add second and third milk extract of coconut. Step 5: Add salt and bring it to a boil. Add cleaned and deveined prawns. Step 6: Cook for 10 minutes. Now add first milk extract of coconut and mix well, do not boil. Step 7: Once it is heated enough take it off flame and garnish prawns coconut curry recipe with chopped coriander leaves. Serve Prawns Coconut Curry with hot steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: rice, bay leaves, onions, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, carrot, green chili sauce, green capsicum, tomato sauce, prawns, butter, oil, cloves, whole black peppercorns, sugar, black pepper powder, coriander leaves, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: To make prawn fried rice, first marinate the parvans. Step 2: Now put red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt on it and keep it aside for 5 minutes. Step 3: Take out the peel of the carrot and chop it thin. Step 4: Also cut the capsicum thinly. Step 5: In a saucepan, add the rice along with bay leaves, black pepper and salt. Step 6: Add water and cook rice as per use. Step 7: Add oil to it so that the rice does not stick. Step 8: After the rice is cooked, cool it down. Step 9: Add cinnamon powder and black pepper powder to the rice and mix. Step 10: Now heat oil in a pan and add onions. Step 11: Cook onion until it becomes soft. Step 12: Now add ginger garlic paste and cook for next. Step 13: Now add vegetables and let it cook for 5 minutes. Step 14: Cut the prawns in 2 or and put them in the pan. Step 15: Let it cook for 7 to. Step 16: After add all the sauces, mix and cook for 2 minutes. Step 17: Add salt and butter, mix and garnish with green coriander. Step 18: Serve prawn fried rice with Manchurian for dinner.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, button mushrooms, soy chunks, onion, ginger, curd, biryani masala, garlic, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, mint leaves, salt, ghee, green chilies, carom seeds, bay leaf, star anise, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani recipe, wash and soak the rice in water for 30 minutes. Step 2: In a bowl, place the soya chunks, and pour boiling hot water over it and allow it to soak in it. Step 3: In a pressure cooker, heat ghee on low flame, add the whole spices - cumin seeds, bay leaf, star anise, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon stick, once these begin to sizzle, add in the ginger, garlic, green chili, saute for a coulee of minutes. Step 4: Next increase the heat to medium -low and add the sliced onions and cook until transparent, this will take about 5 minutes. Step 5: At this stage, add the mushrooms, and the dry masalas - biryani masala, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, salt and give it a good mix. Step 6: Now add the curd, drained soya chunks, pudina leaves, drained rice and water and close the pressure cooker. Step 7: Allow the Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani recipe to pressure cook for 2 whistles and turn off the flame. Step 8: Allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 9: Once released, open the pressure cooker and gently sluff up the Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani recipe and transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot. Serve hot Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani along with Boondi raita and Kachumber Salad for a weeknight dinner.

Dish Name: Punjabi Kadhi Pakora - Delicious Punjabi Kadhi
Ingredient Names: gram flour, green chilies, onion, potato, carom seeds, cooking soda, salt, water, sunflower oil, curd, turmeric powder, ginger, ghee, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chili powder, dry red chilies, asafoetida, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Punjabi Kadhi Pakoras lets begin to make pakora mixture in a bowl by combining all the ingredients of pakora together except water. Step 2: Add a little water at a time to the dry ingredients and mix well until all the ingredients come together to make a thick batter. Heat a Kuzhi paniyaram Pan, drizzle some oil in each cavities. Step 3: Once the oil is heated, take a small portion of batter in spoon or finger and drop them into each cavities. Fry the pakoras on medium heat until pakoras turn golden brown from outside. Step 4: Flip it on the other side as well. Step 5: Once done transfer to a plate lined with a paper napkin. Step 6: Set the pakoras aside while you prepare Kadhi. To prepare Kadhi, whisk the yogurt along with the gram flour until well combined. Step 7: Add water and whisk again. Step 8: Whisk thoroughly to ensure there are no lumps. Step 9: Add in the spices, salt, chopped green chili, grated ginger to this gram flour mixture. Step 10: Stir once again to combine the ingredients. Pour the kadhi mixture in a heavy bottomed saucepan and heat it over medium heat. Step 11: Once punjabi Kadhi starts simmering stir to avoid lump formation. Once it has begun to boil, turn the heat to low and simmer for about 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 12: Now add fried pakoras to it and simmer the punjabi kadhi pakora further for 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Turn off the heat. Step 14: For tempering the punjabi kadhi pakora, add a tablespoon of ghee into a saucepan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds, once seeds crackle add the curry leaves, red chilies and fry for 3-4 minutes until roasted. Step 15: Now add asafoetida, red chili powder and stir to combine. Step 16: Turn off the heat. Pour this seasoning over the Punjabi Kadhi Pakora. Step 17: Garnish with coriander leaves and serve. Serve the Punjabi Kadhi Pakora along with Phulka Recipe (Roti/Chapati), Carrot Cucumber Tomato Salad and Kaddu Simla Mirch Sabzi.

Dish Name: Punjabi Lobia Masala (Punjabi Style Black Eyed Beans Curry)
Ingredient Names: black eyed beans, onions, tomatoes, green chili, ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, cloves, red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, dried fenugreek, ghee, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Punjabi Lobia Masala, wash and soak the lobia for 4 to and then pressure cook with enough water for 2 whistles and keep aside. Make a puree of tomatoes using a hand blender and keep aside. Heat ghee in a wok on medium flame, add the cinnamon stick, cloves and bay leaves and let release its aroma into the ghee. Add the cumin seeds and let it crackle. Add the ginger garlic paste and cook until the raw smell goes away. Add the finely chopped onions and saute until it turns light brown. Now, add the slit green chilli, tomato pureè and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Add the red chilli, turmeric and cumin powder, mix well and let the mixture cook until the ghee leaves the sides. Now, add the cooked lobia along with the water in which it has been boiled and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Gently smash a few lobia for the gravy to thicken further. Slightly crush the kasuri methi between your palms and add it to the gravy along with garam masala and mix well. Switch off the flame, and garnish with the ginger juliennes. Serve the Punjabi Lobia Masala along with phulkas or steamed rice for a weeknight dinner.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, cumin seed, onions, green chili, gingerroot, turmeric, garam masala, red chili powder, fennel seed, water, salt, oil, plain yogurt, mustard oil, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Make pakoras: Mix pakora ingredients in a bowl until smooth. Step 2: Add enough water to make a very thick batter. Step 3: Fry mixture by tablespoonfuls in hot oil until golden and crispy, then drain on paper toweling. Step 4: Keep warm in low oven. Step 5: Prepare the kadai sauce: Blend yogurt, 4 cups water, pinch of turmeric powder, salt, pinch of red chilli powder, and besan It should look like a buttermilk lassi mixture with besan in it. Step 6: Keep it aside for half an hour before starting to make kadi For the remainder of the kadai:.

Dish Name: Punjabi Style Lobia Masala (Black Eyed Peas Masala)
Ingredient Names: black eyed beans, sunflower oil, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cinnamon stick, onion, green chilies, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, coriander powder, garam masala powder, cumin powder, sugar, tamarind paste, tomato puree, milk
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Punjabi Style Lobia Masala recipe, heat oil in a wok/kadai. Add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cinnamon and saute for a minute. Step 2: Add onion and green chillies. Add ginger garlic paste and saute them till onion turn golden in colour. Add all dry spices including turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder, cumin powder, sugar, salt and tamarind paste. Step 3: Mix it well and add tomato puree. Cook mixture till oil separates from it. Step 4: Add cooked black eyed peas(lobia) and mix well. Step 5: Cook for 2 minutes. Add milk and mix well. Step 6: Cook on slow heat for 1 hour. Step 7: Lobiya is ready to serve. Serve Punjabi Style Lobia Masala along with Phulka and Kachumber Salad for a weekday lunch or dinner.

Dish Name: Rajasthani Gatte Ki Sabzi With Onion & Garlic
Ingredient Names: gram flour, carom seeds, red chili powder, curd, sunflower oil, salt, garlic, onion, asafoetida, turmeric powder, bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon stick, coriander leaves, mustard seeds, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Rajasthani Gatte Ki Sabzi Recipe we will first make the gatte. In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients for the gatta. Step 2: Add a few teaspoons of water at a time and knead to make a firm dough. Step 3: Knead well for about to make a very soft melt in the mouth gatta. Step 4: If you add more water and it does not shape into a dough, then you will have to add more gram flour and knead it well. Roll the dough into a long cylinder and cut them into discs. Step 5: The next step is to cook the gattas in boiling water. In a large saucepan boil water until it comes to a brisk boil. Step 6: Once the water comes to a brisk boil, add the gattas into the water and boil until they comes floating to the top. Step 7: Once they come floating to the top, boil for another 3 to. Step 8: Drain the gattas and keep it aside, till we get the Kadhi ready. To make the kadhi, in a mixing bowl, combine the yogurt, gram flour until it becomes a smooth paste. Step 9: Add water, asafoetida, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt. Step 10: Whisk well. Heat ghee in a sauce pan; add the mustard seeds and allow it to crackle. Step 11: Add the onion, ginger and saute until the onion softens. Step 12: Add the bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon and green chillies and saute until you can smell the aromas coming through for a few seconds. Stir in the Gatte Ki Kadhi mixture into the masala and boil briskly until the Gatte Ki Sabzi mixture thickens and comes together. Step 13: You can either keep it thick or keep it a little thin, by adding water if desired. Once the boiled enough, stir in the boiled Gatte and simmer Rajasthani Gatte Ki Sabzi for 2 to 3 more minutes. Step 14: Once done, check the salt and spices and turn off the heat. Step 15: Stir in the coriander leaves and serve. Step 16: Serve the Gatte Ki Sabzi along with Khooba Roti and Spicy Paneer Pulao With Vegetables, Kachumber Salad and Boondi Raita.

Dish Name: Ras Malai (Indian cheese balls in milk)
Ingredient Names: milk, sugar, green cardamoms, saffron, paneer, all-purpose flour, rose water, pistachio nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Put the milk into a large pan with the sugar. Step 2: Crush the cardamoms and add to the pan with the saffron. Step 3: Simmer the mixture over a medium heat until it has been reduced by half and thickened slightly. Step 4: Turn the heat down as low as possible under the pan. Step 5: Beat the cottage cheese and flour together, divide into six or eight portions and roll these into balls. Step 6: Flatten each one slightly and drop them into the pan of milk. Step 7: Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 8: Remove the pan from the heat and carefully transfer into a serving bowl. Step 9: Cool completely, then stir in the rosewater or kewra essence, chill. Step 10: Just before serving, chop the pistacchio nuts and sprinkle over the top.

Ingredient Names: kidney beans, jackfruit, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin powder, black pepper powder, cinnamon powder, paprika powder, turmeric powder, salt, oil, tomato, red chili powder, sugar, cooked rice, dried thyme leaves, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, sour cream, tomato salsa, tortillas

Dish Name: Raw Jackfruit Kofta Curry - Kathal Kofta Curry
Ingredient Names: jackfruit, all purpose flour, fresh coconut, cardamom powder, raisins, green chili, cumin powder, water, cinnamon stick, salt, sunflower oil, tomato, onions, ginger, turmeric powder, asafoetida, cumin seeds, red chili powder, garam masala powder, fresh cream, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Raw Jackfruit Kofta Curry Recipe, first clean the jackfruit pieces and then cook for up to 1-2 whistle in a cup of salted water and a cinnamon in a pressure cooker. Switch off the stove and let the pressure release naturally. Once fully cooked strain the water and keep the jackfruit aside to dry. Take a blender, add boiled jackfruit with coconut and green chilli without adding water. Step 2: Blend it into a paste. Once it is done, add the all purpose flour, salt, cardamom and cumin powder. Step 3: And mix everything well. Mix everything well and keep it aside to cool down the jackfruit kofta mixture. Now make small flat oval shaped balls with the mixture. Step 4: Heat a paniyaram pan with oil in each cavity and fry the kathal koftas from both the sides till they turn golden brown. The next step is to make the kofta gravy. Next add tomatoes, ginger paste cook for about 6 to until the tomatoes are soft. Step 7: Switch off the heat. Once the tomato mixture is cooled down, blend this mixture with a hand blender to smooth gravy adding a cup of water. Add this kofta gravy back in the wok and switch on the heat. Step 8: Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cook on medium to low till thick gravy is forming with bubbles on top. Add garam masala powder, salt to taste and coriander leaves. Step 9: Let this kofta gravy cook for about 6 to. Step 10: Drop the jackfruit koftas in the gravy, let it soak for few minutes before serving. Step 11: Finally garnish the Raw Jackfruit Kofta Curry with fresh cream and chopped coriander leaves. Serve Raw Jackfruit Kofta Curry Recipe along with Palak Raita, Phulka and Satvik Carrot Sprout Salad for your weekday Indian Vegetarian meal.

Dish Name: Restaurant Style Chettinad Style Fish Curry

Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Restaurant Style Chettinad Style Fish Curry Recipe, clean the fish fillets and apply salt & turmeric powder on it. Step 2: Keep aside. In a shallow fry pan add oil & fry onions until they turn brownish, keep aside to grind later. Step 3: Add the shallots & fry for 3-4 minutes then add tomatoes. Step 4: Switch off the gas & keep the cover the pot with a lid. In a grinder, make a fine powder of cumin seeds, peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom & red chilli. Step 5: Keep aside for later use. Add the fried onions, ginger, garlic, grated coconut & tamarind to the make a smooth paste. Add the dry masala powder & paste to the tomato-onion, add water as required to make gravy. When the gravy comes to a boil add the fish, add curry leaves. Step 6: Cover the pot n let the fish cook properly. Step 7: Garnish with freshly chopped coriander. Don't make the gravy too thick or watery. Step 8: Serve this delicious and full of flavour Chettinad Style Fish Curry Recipe along with Idiyappam's or Steamed Rice and Elai Vadam for an everyday meal.

Dish Name: Safed Achari Baingan - White Aubergine in pickled spices
Ingredient Names: eggplant, onion, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, dry mango powder, tomato, salt, coriander leaves, fennel seeds, nigella seeds, carom seeds, fenugreek seeds, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Achari Baingan Recipe, we will first make the achari masala. To prepare marinade for Achari masala, in a pan add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, nigella seed, carom seeds, fenugreek seeds and dry red chilies. Step 2: Dry roast the spices and chilies over medium heat till fragrant and slightly browned. Step 3: Turn off the heat. Step 4: Transfer spices to the jar of mixer and grind into a coarse powder. Step 5: Keep the achari powder aside. Wash and clean baingan and keep aside. Heat oil in a wok and add mustard and cumin seeds in it and wait till they crackle. Add chopped onions and saute till raw smell goes off. Step 6: Now add ginger garlic paste and fry well till golden. Now add turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder and the achari masala along with chopped tomatoesSaute until the tomatoes soften. Step 7: Meanwhile slit the baingan from the middle into two but keep the joint intact. Step 8: This is done so that the masala gets inside the aubergine nicely while cooking. Add the baingan in the fried masala and mix well such that everything incorporates well. Add little amchur if required and stir well. Step 9: Add little water just to make sure the masala doesn't stick to the bottom of the heavy bottomed pan. Add salt as per your taste and slow cook the baingan in low flame with lid closed. Once the baingan softens, turn off the heat and garnish with freshly chopped coriander and stir. Serve the Safed Achari Baingan Recipe along with hot Phulkas smeared with ghee or along with hot steamed rice as a one dish dinner or a quick weeknight dinner.

Dish Name: Saoji Methi Pulao - Maharashtrian Style Fenugreek Leaves Pulao
Ingredient Names: rice, ginger, garlic, onions, tomatoes, green peas, fenugreek leaves, red chili powder, cumin seeds, saoji masala, sunflower oil, water, salt, whole black peppercorns, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, cardamom pods, star anise, fennel seeds, poppy seeds, desiccated coconut
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Saoji Methi Pulao Recipe, start by preparing saoji masala first. Step 2: Dry roast all the spices mentioned for saoji masala like whole black peppercorns, bay leaves, cinnamom stick, black cardamom, cardamom, star anise, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, poppy seeds, dessicated coconut powder except chilli powder. Grind it in Mixer grinder along with chilli powder into a fine powder. Step 3: (If using dry red chilli, dry roast it along with other spices.)Take oil in Cast Iron Handi, add cumin seeds and then add onion into it. Step 4: When onion is translucent and looks cooked, add ginger garlic paste. Cook it for 2 to, add tomatoes to it. Step 5: When the tomatoes become tender, add red chilli powder, and saoji masala with salt. Now wait for the masala to cook well in the mixture, when it is blended well, add green peas and fenugreek leaves into it. Cook for 10 minutes and then add rice with water. Let the rice cook on a high flame. Step 6: When there is a little water left, lower the flame, cover pan with lid and let the rice fully cook. Serve Saoji Methi Pulao Recipe along with Ajwaini Tamatar Bhindi and Phulka to make it a delicious everyday meal.

Dish Name: Sarson Saag Pulao -Spinach Mustard Greens Pulao

Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Sarson Saag Pulao Recipe first prep all the leaves. Step 2: Take the bathua, palak, methi and sarson leaves. Step 3: Discard the stems of the leaves, wash them thoroughly and chop and keep them aside. Step 4: Wash and keep coriander and mint leaves separately. Wash the basmati rice and keep it soaked for about 15 to. Next in a pressure cooker add ghee; add all the whole spices including bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, shahi jeera, cardamom and let them splutter. Step 5: Next add the onions, ginger and garlic and saute till the onions turn soft. Step 6: Now add all the chopped sarson, bathua, palak and methi leaves except coriander and pudina leaves. Step 7: Saute till the they wilt a little. Add the drained basmati rice and salt and mix everything together. Step 8: Add water, garam masala and lemon juice, check seasoning and close the lid. Give the Sarson Saag Pulao 3 whistles on high and turn off the heat and let the pressure release naturally. Once the pressure has released completely, open the pressure cooker and gently stir in the coriander and mint leaves into the Sarson Saag Pulao and serve hot. Serve Sarson Saag Pulao with Cauliflower and Vegetable Curry (With Almonds and Spices) and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita for a lovely weekday lunch.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, mutton, onions, ginger, garlic, green chilies, curd, sunflower oil, ghee, salt, coriander powder, red chili powder, cloves, whole black peppercorns, bay leaves, carom seeds, cardamom pods, black cardamom, cinnamon stick, star anise, mint leaves, coriander leaves, cashew nuts, raisins, lemon juice, saffron strands, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Shehenshahi Parsi Keema Pulao recipe, wash keema nicely under running water and collect in a bowl and keep aside. Wash and soak rice in water for 40 to before cooking. Heat oil in a wok or a thick bottomed biryani handi and add whole spices including cloves, whole black peppercorns, bay leaves, ajwain, cardamom, black cardamom, cinnamon stick, star anise and wait till they crackle. Now add ginger garlic paste and saute for a while. Step 2: Add in the chopped onions and fry till they are golden in colour. Add in the mutton keema and mix well. Step 3: Cook on high flames for a while till the moisture from the keema evaporates. Once the keema starts to look dry, add in whisked curd and mix well. Season with salt, stir and cook with lid closed till the minced meat is cooked properly. Step 4: The keema will look watery hence no need to add any extra water. Once the keema looks cooked and mutton is tender, add in red chilli powder, green chillies, coriander powder and mix well. Fry everything together till oil starts leaving from sides. Step 5: Keep the consistency of keema semi dry and turn off the gas. In a separate thick bottomed handi, heat water double the quantity of rice and add salt and lemon juice to it. Once the water starts getting hot, add soaked rice and cook till its 95% cooked. Turn off the gas and strain the rice and collect them on a wide tray. Step 6: Spread the rice and allow it to cool. Step 7: Don't mix the rice else the grains may break. Once the rice are warm, layer them over the cooked keema and add pure ghee all over. Garnish with green chilies, coriander, mint, boiled eggs, fried cashews and raisins, fried onions and saffron soaked milk for color. Cover the handi with a foil and seal from sides. Step 8: Put on a heavy lid and keep the pulao on dum for another 15 to. Serve Shehenshahi Parsi Keema Pulao along with Burani Raita and a roasted papad for weekend night dinners or you can also serve this for your house parties.

Dish Name: Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, spring onions, green chilies, garlic, soy sauce, lemon juice, black pepper powder, red chili powder, cumin powder, red chili sauce, tomato, salt, sunflower oil, rice, ginger, green bell pepper, onion, carrots, chinese five-spice powder, white pepper powder, egg noodles, mayonnaise, egg, tomato ketchup, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe, keep all the ingredients prepped and ready. Marinate the chicken cubes by combining chicken with spring onions, garlic, green chilies, soya sauce, lemon juice, black pepper, red chili powder, cumin, chilli sauce, sweet and spicy sauce, and salt to taste in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Allow chicken to marinate for about 2 hours. You can meanwhile boil the noodles as per instruction on packet and drain it and keep it aside. Step 3: Toss the noodles with teaspoon of oil to prevent them from sticking together. To make Mayonnaise SaucePrepare the mayo sauce by mixing mayonnaise, tomato ketchup, red chilli garlic sauce and vinegar. Step 4: Keep aside in a bottle or a closed container. Step 5: You can make this ahead of time and keep ready before a few days as well. To make Fried Rice Recipe:Cook the rice in a pressure cooker for two whistle and let the pressure releases naturally. Step 6: Once done open the pressure cooker and fluff up rice and keep aside. To make fried rice recipe,heat oil in a wok. Step 7: Once the oil is hot add ginger & garlic, and slit green chillies. Step 8: Saute till the raw smell disappears, on a low flame such that the ginger garlic does not char. Now add carrots, saute for a minute, add all the vegetables, and saute on medium heat. Once they are a bit tender, and then add salt, 5 spice powder, white pepper powder and mix well. Add rice to the wok and toss till the spiced veggies mix well and turn off heat. Step 9: Keep aside. To make Chicken:In another wok, heat a tablespoon oil and add the marinated chicken and cook covered. Step 10: Saute occasionally till tender and cooked well. Assembling Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice RecipePlace a cup of cooked rice on the serving plate. Top it up with boiled noodles. Pour the prepared mayonnaise sauce. Put sauteed marinated chicken as the topmost layer of the layered fried rice. Serve Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe as a one pot meal for lunch, along with a dessert like Coconut Tapioca Pudding Recipe with Spicy Strawberry Sauce or Cinnamon Rice Pudding With Cherry Compote Recipe.

Dish Name: South Indian One Pot Sambar Rice
Ingredient Names: ghee, chana dal, urad dal, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, dry red chilies, fresh coconut, rice, masoor dal, potato, green beans, bottle gourd, onion, sunflower oil, cumin seeds, green chili, asafoetida, turmeric powder, tamarind water, jaggery, water, salt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preparing Masala PasteTo begin making South Indian One Pot Sambar Rice Recipe, heat a small saucepan with a teaspoon of ghee. Step 3: Saute them for a minute or so until fragrant. Lastly, stir in the red chillies and coconut pieces. Saute well, transfer on to a plate and cool them to room temperature. Step 4: Add enough water and grind into a thick paste. Step 5: Set this aside until required. Preparing One Pot Sambar Rice RecipeWash and soak the rice and dal in enough water for 30 minutes.
