Dish Name: Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime
Ingredient Names: fish fillet, prawns, clams, baby potatoes, carrots, onion, tomato, fresh red chilies, garlic, cumin powder, paprika powder, salt, lemon juice, black pepper powder, coriander leaves, extra virgin olive oil, chicken stock, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime recipe, clean basa fish and cut into small pieces. Step 2: Clean, wash and devein the prawns. Step 3: Wash well. I could not get clamps so I did not use it in the recipe but I highly recommend you to use it. Now marinate seafood in lime juice, salt and pepper powder for about 2 hours. Step 4: Let it marinate in the fridge. While the seafood is marinating in fridge, we will prepare the stew. In a wide pan, heat olive oil. Step 5: Add minced garlic and sauté till garlic turns golden brown. Step 6: Add finely chopped onions and finely chopped red chilies. Step 7: Cook till onions turn soft. Add finely chopped tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn mushy. Add cumin powder, paprika power and remaining salt to taste. Step 8: Add peeled potatoes and chopped carrots and give it a mix. Add chicken stock and bring it to boil. Step 9: Cook till potatoes and carrots are fully cooked. Step 10: Check for seasoning. Step 11: Boil the stew for 5 to more. Step 12: Add more stock if needed. Now add the marinated seafood and cook in low flame for about 8 to. Once the seafood is cooked, add coconut milk and continue to cook for a minute or two. Turn off the stove, add fresh chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with toasted bread. Serve Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime along with steamed rice for a weekend lunch or dinner.

Dish Name: Sweet & Spicy Stuffed Paneer In Kofta Curry
Ingredient Names: paneer, green chili, ginger, raisins, cashew nuts, almond, pistachios, turmeric powder, gram flour, salt, cardamom powder, sunflower oil, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cloves, mace, star anise, tomato puree, garlic, onion, coriander powder, red chili powder, curd, dried fenugreek, honey, fresh cream
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Stuffed Paneer In Kofta Curry Recipe, we will begin with the stuffing for the panner. Step 2: Scoop out or cut out little paneer from the center of each cube. Step 3: You can use a melon scooper or with a small spoon. Step 4: Transfer the scooped out paneer to a bowl, crumble / grate and set aside. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 5: Add finely chopped green chillies and ginger, sauté until the ginger is fragrant. Add raisins and chopped nuts, sauté another 30 seconds. Step 6: Add this mixture to crumbled paneer along with, turmeric powder, besan, salt and cardamom powder, mix well to come. Step 7: Adjust the salt according to taste. Stuff this paneer and nut mixture in scooped out paneer cubes and press firmly. Step 8: Heat a teaspoon of oil in a pan over medium heat. Step 9: Add the stuffed paneer pieces and pan fry the paneer cubes until lightly golden on both sides. Step 10: Once done remove from the pan and keep aside. Step 11: To begin making the kofta curry, grind the onion, ginger and garlic to a smooth paste. Step 12: Keep aside. Grind the cashewnuts along with a little water and make a smooth paste, keep aside. Step 13: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat; add the whole spices and saute it for a few seconds until you can smell the aromas coming through. Step 14: Add the ginger garlic and onion paste and saute for about a minute until the raw smell goes away. At this stage, add the turmeric powder, coriander powder, and red chilli powder. Step 15: Adding the condiments to the onion ginger garlic paste helps further reduce the raw smell. Step 16: Saute for a few seconds and then add the tomato puree, cashewnut puree, salt to taste and the fresh cream. Step 17: Add a little water to adjust the consistency of the kofta gravy. Step 18: Simmer this kofta curry for 3 to until the flavors combine well. Step 19: Once done, turn off the heat, stir in the kasuri methi and check the salt and spices. Step 20: Adjust to suit your taste. Transfer the kofta curry to a serving bowl and when you are ready to serve, place the stuffed paneer in the curry and serve warm. Step 21: Serve your Stuffed Paneer Baskets with Punjabi Dal Tadka, Mixed Vegetable Pulao (Pilaf), Butter Garlic Naan, Kela Anar Raita for a perfect weekend dinner with family and friends.

Ingredient Names: masoor dal, sweet potatoes, coconut oil, onion, tomato, cumin seeds, green chilies, garlic, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, curry leaves, salt, water, sunflower oil, urad dal, mustard seeds, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Sweet Potato Dal recipe, wash masoor dal with water and soak in water for about an hour. In a pressure cooker, add dal, a cup of water and pressure cook for about 2 whistles. Step 2: Set aside. In a non-stick pan, add oil and heat over medium flame. Add cumin seeds to the oil and wait till the seeds splutter. Now, add green chilies and garlic. Step 3: Fry until the garlic becomes brownish. Gently add sliced onions and fry till they are translucent. Step 4: Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they become mushy. Now, add the mentioned spice powders and combine them well. Add potato pieces and stir them until the spices are blended evenly with the potato. Add water and cook on high flame until the potato pieces are cooked well. Add the cooked dal to the pan. Step 5: Adjust water according to your required consistency. Season it with salt. Step 6: Reduce the flame and cook on medium flame for about 15-20 minutes, until the dal are blended with potatoes and spices. Step 7: Switch off the flame and set asideIn a small pan, add oil. Step 8: Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds followed by urad dal and cumin seeds. Let the mustard seeds sizzle and cumin seeds turn brownish. Add the tempered oil to the dal and give a stir. Step 9: Garnish with coriander leaves. Prepare this Sweet Potato Dal and serve with steamed rice with a dollop of ghee or jeera rice and Kachumber Salad for a simple and comforting weekday meal.

Dish Name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken & Red Rice
Ingredient Names: lemongrass, green chilies, coriander leaves, basil leaves, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, whole black peppercorns, onion, garlic, ginger, salt, chicken breasts, button mushrooms, carrots, coconut milk, thai green curry paste, water, brown sugar, sunflower oil, red rice
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Thai Green Curry with Chicken & Red Rice RecipeMethod for Thai Green Curry PasteTo prepare the lemongrass, we will first have to trim away and discard any root section below the bulb base. Step 2: We will also now remove the dried part of the root until we reach a stage we know that the root cuts easily and is tender. Add all the ingredients for the paste into a blender and a little bit of water. Step 3: Cover the blender and grind the mixture. After a few seconds of grinding, open the blender and stir to combine the ingredients and if required add a little more water to grind into a smooth paste. Transfer the Thai curry paste and store it in a glass jar. Step 4: You only need to use the paste for a single recipe of Thai curry. Step 5: So with this paste you will be able to make Thai curry at least 3 times over. Method to make the Thai Green CurryNext we will proceed to make the Thai Curry with this paste. Step 6: Heat a teaspoon of oil in a heavy wok. Step 7: Add in chopped ginger and vegetables. Step 8: Add in some salt and stir fry the vegetables on high heat until lightly tender. Step 9: Once tender turn off the heat and keep aside. Add a teaspoon of oil into the hot wok, next add in the thai curry paste and saute for a few seconds in the oil. Step 10: Next add in a cup of water and stir to combine into the curry. Step 11: Next we will add in a tablespoon of brown sugar and finally the coconut milk. Step 12: Stir to combine all the ingredients. Step 13: Once combined, add in the salt, stir and allow the mixture to come to a thicken a little and come to a boilOnce the mixture comes to a boil, add in some torn basil leaves and the stir fried vegetable, Drop in the chicken pieces. Instructions: Step 1: We begin making the Thai Yellow Coconut Curry Rice Recipe by boiling milk and water in a sauce pan. Dish Name: Tofu Banh Mi - Vietnamese Grilled Tofu Sandwich
Ingredient Names: baguette, mayonnaise, sriracha sauce, coriander leaves, extra virgin olive oil, english cucumber, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, carrot, radish, pickled jalapenos, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper, tofu, soy sauce, red chili sauce, honey, black pepper powder, dry ginger powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Vietnamese Style Veg Bánh Mì Recipe, we will first keep the vegetables chopped and ready. Add all the vegetables into a bowl, add in chilli vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper and mix it well. Step 2: Rest the vegetables in the fridge until you finish making your grilled tofu for the Bánh mì. Take a mixing bowl, add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, honey, pepper powder, ginger powder, salt a pinch and give it a mix. Step 3: Add in tofu slices and mix will and allow it to soak in the mixture for 2 minutes. Heat a grill pan, once it is hot, brush the pan with some olive oil and place the marinated tofu pieces on to the grill. Step 4: Grill on each side for at least 3-4 minutes, until you notice brown grill marks on either side. Once done, take the grilled tofu slices and place them on a plate. Ingredient Names: bhajani flour, oil, water, brown sesame seeds, ajwain carom seeds, kashmiri red chili powder, ground turmeric, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add the flour to a mixing bowl. Add the hot oil and then the hot water. Add red chili powder, carom seeds, turmeric, salt and sesame seeds. Mix everything with a spatula. Gradually add cold water and knead the flour to make soft dough. Cover the dough with a moist paper towel so it does not dry out. Step 2: Start heating the oil in a frying pan or kadhai on medium heat. Insert the chakli disc with a star shape in the middle into the chakli press. Next, take some dough and knead it for a minute. Make it into a cylindrical shape to fit in the chakli press. Insert just enough dough to almost fill the tube. Tightly secure the top lid/handle on the tube. Step 3: Start pumping out the chakli in a circular motion on small pieces of parchment paper or paper towels. I usually do 3 to 4 spiral rounds, close to each other to make one chakli. Secure the end by pinching it to the outermost circle so the chakli will stay together. Continue pressing remaining chaklis. The tube usually holds enough dough to press out 6 to 8 chaklis. Step 4: Test the oil for optimum temperature by adding a small piece of dough to the oil, which should rise up gradually in 5 to 10 seconds. If it rises up too fast, lower the heat and if it does not rise up in 10 seconds allow the oil to heat up further. Step 5: Carefully add chakli one at a time into the hot oil, taking care not to crowd the frying pan. You can add 3 to 6 chaklis at a time depending on the size of your pan. Keep on high heat when adding the chakli in the hot oil. After about 1 minute, lower the heat to medium. After 2-3 minutes, turn them over, one at a time and continue to fry on medium to low heat or until they are golden brown in color another 1 to 2 minutes. It usually takes a total of about 5-6 minutes to perfectly fry a batch of chaklis. Lower the heat when you are ready to take out the chakli. Take them out in a paper towel lined tray and allow to cool down in a single layer. Step 6: Repeat pressing out the chakli and frying process for the remaining dough, steps 3 and 5. Remember to increase the heat for the oil to high before adding the next batch of chakli. Allow the chakli's to completely cool down and then store them in an airtight container at room temperature. They stay good for weeks or even months as long as you keep them away from moisture. Step 7: This recipe and mesurements are with my mom's super fine Bhajani flour from India. Read the main post to see how to make the flours at home especially in the US. 1. The homemade flour made without a professional mill can be a bit coarse and needs upto 2 cups of cold water to make soft dough.2. The Instant chakli flour with mixed flours, needs up to 1 cup of cold water to make soft dough. Step 8: Sift the flour especially if making homemade flour. This will remove any larger pieces of rice or lentils that have not been ground finely. Step 9: Add water little bit at a time. Remember different flours will need different amounts of liquids to make soft dough. We found that home milled flour needed a lot more water than the instant chakli flour or mom’s flour from India. Step 10: Taste the dough to make sure the salt and spice are to your taste. Add more red chili powder for spicier chakli. Step 11: After pressing 3 to 4 spirals, make sure to secure the end to the outermost circle so the chakli will stay together. Step 12: Make sure the oil is hot enough before adding the chakli. This will prevent the chaklis from dissolving or breaking in the oil. Step 13: Make sure each batch takes about 5 to 6 minutes, fry them slowly so they stay crispy for weeks. Step 14: Adding room temperature chakli to hot oil makes the oil cooler. So make sure you have high heat when adding chakli. Wait for a minute as the chakli starts to harden and then turn over. Then remember to lower the heat and continue frying at medium low heat. Step 15: Use a slotted spatula which will drain out most of the oil. Place fried chakli on a paper towel lined tray. Allow them to completely cool down before storing in an airtight container.

Step 3: Place it in the spiralizer, in between the spiked handle and the end of the blade. Step 4: Then by spinning the handle you can get shreds of Zucchinni. Or otherwise cut thin slices of zucchini lengthwise and then cut them into thin long julienne to get your desired shape. Step 5: Once done toss it with few teaspoon of olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and keep it aside. To make the SauceIn a pressure cooker, add the Tomatoes that are just scored on one end. Step 6: Add water and then pressure cook it for about 1 whistle. Step 7: Release the pressure take it out and cool it down. Step 8: Blitz it in the blender till it becomes a smooth paste. Heat a sauce pan, add chopped garlic, onions and saute till it is translucent. Step 9: Add the tomato paste along with basil leaves, oregano, cumin powder, honey, red chilli powder, pepper and salt. Let it cook till the color changes to dark reddish. Step 10: Add in water and chopped mushroom and give it a stir then cook for 20 more minutes. Step 11: Keep it aside. To make the MeatballHeat another saucepan, add oil and garlic and onions, saute till it is translucent. Step 12: Then add in the chopped mushroom. Step 13: Saute till all the water evaporates. Once that is done grind the soaked chickpeas into a coarse mixture and then add in that into the pan along with rest of the herbs and seasonings. Step 14: Once it all combines switch of the flame. Let it cool down, and make them into balls, coat them well with bread crumbs and keep it aside. Step 15: Heat a Kuzhi paniyarama pan with oil and fry these balls till they become crispy on the outside. Step 16: Then dung them into the sauce mixture. Now to assemble, place the zoodles on the plate and then pour over the meatball sauce mixture on top and serve with some chopped parsley. Step 17: Serve the Zucchini Zoodles with mushroom Meatball Recipe as a one pot meal for your Sunday lunch.

Ingredient Names: brinjal eggplant, tomato, chili, garlic, shallots, oil, cumin powder, garam masala, salt, fresh coriander, mustard, cumin, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, take large brinjal and slit randomly making holes. Step 2: Stuff in 3 garlic and 3 chillies into the holes. Step 3: Grease 1 tsp of oil over brinjal, as it helps to peel off the skin easily once roasting. Step 4: Place the brinjal, onion and tomato over the flame. Step 5: Roast on medium flame by flipping in between. Step 6: Roast uniformly until the brinjal gets cooked from inside. Step 7: Now cool completely, and start to peel off the skin. Step 8: Cut the brinjal and tomato and see, making sure there are no insects and is cooked well. Step 9: Transfer to a large bowl. Step 10: Now mash making sure everything is well combined. you can use a chopper to mash to a uniform texture. Step 11: Further add ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp salt. Step 12: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 13: Now for the tempering, heat 2 tbsp oil. splutter 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin and pinch of hing. Step 14: Pour the tempering over chutney, add 2 tbsp coriander. Step 15: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 16: Finally, enjoy brinjal chutney with rice, roti or paratha.

Dish Name: Acorn Squash Stuffed With Lamb Curry
Ingredient Names: acorn squash, butter, yellow onion, tart apple, garlic cloves, curry powder, ground lamb, cumin seed, cayenne pepper, salt, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cut acorn squash in half from stem to. Step 2: In a heavy, non-reactive skillet, melt the butter over medium heat Saut onion for 2-3 minutes Quick trick: use one of those handy green peeling / coring / slicing units that attach to the counter with suction You can find these at most stores for around $20if you dont have one, i recommend getting one They work really well, and save lots of time! Step 3: Core and slice the apple with the peeling arm wedged out of action. Step 4: Slice the spiral to form small, uniform dice. Step 5: Add the apple, garlic and curry powder to the skillet Saut, stirring, for about 3 more minutes, or until apple is beginning to soften and curry has become quite fragrant.

Ingredient Names: lamb, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, fresh green chilies, plain yogurt, butter, onions, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground nutmeg, chili powder, water, salt, single cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the meat into thin strips about 1 1 / 2 inches long. Step 2: In a blender, process the ginger, garlic, green chillies and the yogurt till smooth. Step 3: Heat the butter in a pan and fry the onions till just brown. Step 4: Add the turmeric, cumin, coriander, nutmeg and chili powder, lower the heat and fry for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the meat and fry till it changes colour 3 minutes Slowly add the yogurt mixture stirring all the time. Step 6: Cook for 5 minutes when the fat comes to the surface add the water and bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes. Step 7: Add the salt, cream and the ground almonds cook for 4 minutes, stir in the garam masala. Step 8: Serve with the paprika sprinkled over the dish.

Ingredient Names: leg of lamb, cooking oil, onions, garlic, ginger, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, red chili powder, water, salt, tomatoes, green chilies, garam masala, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the fat from the meat and cut into 1-inch cubes. Step 2: Heat the oil over medium heat and fry the onions, ginger and garlic until the onions are just soft. Step 3: Lower the heat and add the turmeric, cumin, coriander and red chilli powder. Step 4: Stir and fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add the meat and turn the heat to medium. Step 6: Fry for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Step 7: Cover the pan and cook on medium heat until all the liquid dries out. Step 8: Turn the heat to high and fry the meat for 2-3 minutes continuously. Step 9: Reduce the heat to medium and fry for a further 7-8 minutes, stirring frequently By now the meat should look fairly dry and the fat should be floating on the surface.

Ingredient Names: lamb, onion, garlic clove, ghee, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, fresh coarse ground black pepper, garam masala, chilies, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, low-fat yogurt, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel onion and slice and mince garlic. Step 2: Heat oil in a medium size saucepan. Step 3: Fry onion and garlic over low heat until soft. Step 4: Add diced lamb and cook, stirring until sealed on all sides. Step 5: Remove meat from the saucepan and set to one side. Step 6: Add the coriander, turmeric, black pepper and 1 tablespoon garam masala. Step 7: Stir together for 1 minute. Step 8: Top and tail green chilies--remove seeds first for a milder heat. Step 9: Chop small and add to the saucepan stirring for a further minute or two. Step 10: Add bay leaves and cinnamon.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, ginger, sunflower oil, cardamom pods seeds ground, ground coriander, lean lamb, lamb stock, red chilies, tomato puree, creamed coconut, curry leaves, eggplants, spinach, new potato, tamarind paste, turmeric, cumin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Put the onion, garlic and ginger in a food processor and blend to a purée. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion purée for 20 mins until starting to colour, stirring frequently. Add the cardamom and coriander, and fry a few mins more. Step 2: Stir in the lamb, fry until it starts to brown, then pour in the stock. Add the chilli, tomato purée, coconut and curry leaves, then cover and simmer for 1 hr. Add the aubergines and cook for 30 mins more until the lamb and aubergine are tender. Step 3: Meanwhile, make the potato topping. Boil the potatoes whole in their skins for 15-20 mins until just tender, then drain and cool. Also, wilt the spinach in a hot pan. Cool and squeeze in your hands to remove as much water as you can. Peel and thickly slice the potatoes, then toss with the oil, tamarind, turmeric, cumin seeds, curry leaves and seasoning. Step 4: Stir the spinach into the curry and spoon into one extra-large or two regular-size ovenproof dishe(s). Pile the potatoes on top and lightly press down. Dish can now be frozen, see below. If eating straight away, heat oven to 160C/180C fan/gas 4 and bake for 50 mins-1 hr (add 30-40 mins if using an extra-large dish). Serve with chutney and raita or an Indian salad made with chopped red onion, coriander, tomatoes, cucumber and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: chicken, rice, yogurt, salt, green chilies, garlic paste, ginger paste, mint leaves, coriander leaves, tomatoes, coriander powder, cumin powder, chili powder, ground cloves, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine together ingredients 3 to 15 and mix well. Step 2: Add the meat to it and let it marinate for about 2 hours. Step 3: Heat the ghee in a pan and add the cashew nuts, cinnamon, cardamom and cloves. Step 4: Fry for 15 seconds and add the sliced onion. Step 5: When the onions turn transparent, add the marinated meat and without adding any water, cook the meat on medium heat till the meat is completely done The masala will reduce and lose all moisture, set aside. Step 6: Wash the rice and steam cook it so that individual grains can be separated Dissolve the saffron in the milk. Step 7: Take about one cup of cooked rice and add the saffron to it.

Ingredient Names: ground lamb, onion, garlic cloves, eggs, cayenne pepper, curry powder, plain breadcrumbs, soy sauce, brown sugar, diced tomatoes, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lamb with onion, garlic, eggs, curry, 1 / 2 tsp cayenne, salt and breadcrumbs. Step 2: Shape into a loaf, and place in a 9x12-inch pyrex baking dish. Step 3: Combine tomatoes with worcestershire, reserved cayenne, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Step 4: Pour this over the loaf, and bake in a preheated 400f oven for 45 minutes to one hour. Step 5: Serve with chutney and cooked basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground lamb, red pepper, yellow pepper, sweet onion, butter, curry powder, tomato sauce, spinach, cilantro, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Salt and pepper the lamb, then mix and form into little balls. Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a skillet and start browning the meatballs. Step 3: Slice the peppers and onion thinly and add to the browning meatballs Shake the pan or stir every so often to brown the meatballs all over. Step 4: When the meatballs are brown and the peppers and onions have softened slightly, add the butter and curry powder. Step 5: Stir again and add the tomato sauce. Step 6: Stir again and cover with a lid, simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 7: Remove lid, stir in the spinach and cilantro and simmer 5 minutes. Step 8: Serve with steamed basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, tiny peas, oil, garlic, onion, curry powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground lamb, ketchup, chicken broth, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Step 2: Season with salt & pepper Brown the meat in a large skillet, and put in colander to drain. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet and add the onions and garlic. Step 4: Cook, stirring occasionally until they are wilted. Step 5: Add the curry powder, cumin and coriander and cook briefly, stirring. Step 6: Add the meat, salt, pepper, the ketchup, broth and sugar. Step 7: Cook, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes. Step 8: Put mixture into a baking dish and top with the defrosted frozen peas, then the mashed potato mixture Smooth over the top.

Dish Name: Curry Masala Lamb Burgers With Yogurt Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground lamb, curry powder, mixed spice, olive oil, salt and pepper, cilantro, mint, garlic clove, lemon juice, plain yogurt, pita bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix the lamb, curry powder, masala spice and salt and pepper well Form lamb into 4-5 patties, depending on how thick you like your burgers. Step 2: Place patties on a plate, and set aside. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix the cilantro, mint, garlic and squeeze of lemon juice. Step 4: Add the yogurt and stir until mixed. Step 5: Set aside Coat lamb patties with a little olive oil and either cook in a cast iron skillet on the stove or on the grill Either way, the patties will need about 3 minutes on either side. Step 6: Serve the patties in the pita bread, topped with the sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken, green chilies, garlic, fresh ginger, cayenne pepper, salt, vinegar, oil, onions, cumin, coriander seed, black peppercorns, tomato puree, sugar, brandy
Instructions: Step 1: Pound green chilli, garlic, ginger and cayenne together with salt in a mortar until smooth, add vinegar. Step 2: Marinate the meat in this for 2 hours Save the marinade. Step 3: Heat the oil with cumin, coriander and peppercorns. Step 4: When hot, add the meat and onion and broil on high heat until brown. Step 5: Add the marinade, sugar and tomato pure. Step 6: Add water and salt if necessary. Step 7: Let simmer until meat is done and the sauce has thickened, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic cloves, lamb, tomatoes, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, potatoes, red lentil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Fry onions, garlic, meat. Step 2: Add tomatoes, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne, salt. Step 3: Cook on high for 10-15 mins until oil seems to separate. Step 4: Add potatoes, lentils. Step 5: Cook on low for 70 mins.

Ingredient Names: whole tomatoes, tomatoes, lamb shanks, onion, garam masala, cumin, cardamom, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Simply place all ingredients, except cilantro into a crockpot, and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 4 hours. Step 2: Serve with polenta or mashed potatoes, and top with chopped fresh cilantro.

Ingredient Names: ground lamb, scallion, garlic cloves, pistachios, dried mint, turmeric, ground allspice, salt, cayenne, egg, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the lamb with all the other ingredients Form 4 large patties. Step 2: Cook the patties as you would a hamburger They should not be cooked rare, but a barely pink center is okay.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, cardamom pods, tomatoes, ginger, oil, onions, lamb, paprika, salt, water, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the cardamom seeds and peppercorns finely. Step 2: In a blender or food processor, puree the tomatoes and ginger. Step 3: Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the onions until golden. Step 4: Add the lamb and the ground spices. Step 5: Cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the tomato mixture, paprika, and salt, stir into the meat, and cook for another 2-3 miniutes. Step 7: Add the water, bring to a boil, then cover and reduce the heat to very low. Step 8: Garnish with the chopped cilantro and serve with rice.

Dish Name: Fancy Curried Lamb Chops With Asparagus Spears
Ingredient Names: lamb chops, butter, onion, garlic clove, curry powder, ground ginger, salt, tomatoes, water, all-purpose flour, asparagus spears
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from meat, brown in butter and then remove from skillet. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cook till tender, do not brown. Step 4: Return meat to skillet. Step 5: Add curry powder, ground ginger, salt and tomatoes. Step 6: Cover simmer 50 to 60 minutes, or until lamb chops are tender. Step 7: Blend flour and water. Step 8: Add to meat mixture, cook until bubbly and then cook 1 to 2 minutes more. Step 9: Transfer to fancy round casserole dish, form pinwheel of hot cooked asparagus on top, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: leg of lamb, fresh coconut, fresh lemon juice, garlic cloves, gingerroot, hot green chili peppers, vegetable oil, onions, chopped tomato, tamarind paste, salt, dried hot red chili peppers, green cardamom pods, cloves, black cardamom pods
Instructions: Step 1: Cut lamb into 1 1 / 2 inch cubes and place in non-aluminum bowl In blender, puree lemon juice, garlic, ginger and hot green peppers, mix with lamb. Step 2: Marinate for 1 hour at room temperature or refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours Crack open coconut, discarding the liquid Pry out coconut meat Pare off brown out side layer, discard. Step 3: Grate coconut In dry skillet, toast coconut over medium heat, stirring often, until golden brown, about 12 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lemon, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh oregano, leg of lamb, coarse salt, plain yogurt, sour cream, mint, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In shallow dish, combine lemon juice, zest, olive oil, onion, garlic, and oregano. Step 2: Add lamb and turn to coat all over. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning several times. Step 4: Grill over hot coals, turning several times and basting with the marinade, about 40 minutes. Step 5: Serve thinly sliced with the garlic raita Garlic raita. Step 6: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Step 7: Serve chilled Makes 1 cup.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, egg, garlic cloves, scallions, paprika, ground coriander, ground cumin, sugar, ginger, cinnamon, cayenne, breadcrumbs, ground lamb, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mince the garlic and chop the scallions. Step 2: Combine the yogurt, egg, garlic, scallions, paprika, coriander, cumin, sugar, ginger, cinnamon, cayenne, and breadcrumbs and mix well. Step 3: Add the lamb and salt as desired and mix well. Step 4: Divide mixture into 8-12 portions and form each into a sausage shape. Step 5: Insert a metal or bamboo skewer into each sausage so that the. Step 6: Grill or broil for 6-8 minutes, turning gently to cook all sides.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, cinnamon, red onion, garlic, serrano chili, dried bay leaves, ground lamb, frozen peas, tomatoes and green chilies, salt, garam masala, yogurt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the mustard seeds in the oil over medium heat They will begin to pop, so keep the pan covered until they stop. Step 2: Now saute the onion, garlic, chilies, bay leaves, and cinnamon until onion is soft Brown the lamb in a separate pan. Step 3: Drain the fat and then add the meat to the onions If you are using a leaner meat, you can just brown it in the original pan. Step 4: Add the peas and cook about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, salt, garam masaala, and yogurt. Step 6: Allow the yogurt to become fully warm, then remove pan from heat. Step 7: Top with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: ground lamb, oil, onion, carrots, crushed tomatoes, eggplant, cayenne pepper, curry powder, brown sugar, salt and pepper, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the lamb in the oil. Step 2: Add the onion, carrots, crushed tomatoes and eggplant. Step 3: Stir-fry until the eggplant is tender and the onion is golden. Step 4: Add the cayenne pepper, curry powder, brown sugar and salt and pepper. Step 5: Mix well to combine If necessary, add a little water to get it to the consistency that you like Just before serving, toss in the roasted peanuts and mix. Step 6: Serve over basmati rice If making this ahead, don't add the peanuts, and toss them in just before reheatings There's nothing as unappetizing and un-gurulike as soggy peanuts.

Ingredient Names: lamb chops, curry powder, salt, light soya sauce, white sugar, limes, tomato puree, water, green chilies, red chilies, tomatoes, potatoes, yogurt, canola oil, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Add ginger, onions and garlic into food processor and grind till really fine. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok and stir fry the ingredients till fragrant. Step 3: Add curry paste and stir fry for 4-5 minutes over medium heat till oil exudes and mixture is fragrant. Step 4: Add the lamb chops and stir fry well. Step 5: Add potato wedges after stir frying the chops for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add lime juice, tomato puree, water, salt, sugar and soya sauce and cook for 15 minutes. Step 7: Add carrots in and allow all this to cook covered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Add chillies and yoghurt / coconut milk, simmer gently for 5-10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: cumin seed, cardamom seeds, fennel seed, turmeric powder, curry powder, cayenne pepper, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, leg of lamb, salt & freshly ground black pepper, tomatoes, water, russet potato
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all the seeds in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat until fragrant and toasted, about 8 minutes. Step 2: Let cool Crush the seeds with a mortar and pestle until they form a powder Alternately, you can use a coffee grinder to grind the spices. Step 3: Stir in the cayenne pepper, curry powder and turmeric. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a heavy large pot over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the onion slices and saute until they become pale golden brown, about 8 minutes. Step 6: Add the garlic and ginger and saute for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Step 7: Add the spice mixture and saute for a further 2 minutes. Step 8: Transfer the onion mixture to a bowl.

Ingredient Names: boneless lamb, vegetable oil, bay leaves, black cardamom pod, cinnamon sticks, peppercorns, whole cloves, onions, ginger paste, garlic, green chili pepper, salt, turmeric, coriander powder, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan. Step 2: Add bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, and cloves. Step 3: When leaves begin to sizzle and fragrance starts to release, add onions and saute until light golden, about 12-15 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 4: Stir in the ginger paste, garlic, chile pepper, and lamb. Step 5: Season the lamb with salt Continue cooking, stirring mix, for about 20 minutes more, adding a little water if necessary to keep food from sticking. Step 6: Add turmeric, coriander powder, cayenne, and garam masala. Step 7: Stir for 5 minutes, adding 2 tablespoons water. Step 8: Add diced tomatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 9: Then add 4 cups of water and simmer for 15 minutes, or until meat is getting tender.

Dish Name: Indian Lamb Meatballs In Curry Sauce
Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, mint leaf, dried red lentils, ground lamb, brown onion, mild curry paste, diced tomatoes, chicken stock, water, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine yoghurt, 1 tablespoon mint and salt and pepper in a small bowl. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 3: Place lentils in a bowl and cover with cold water. Step 4: Allow to stand for 30 minutes. Step 5: Drain, rinse and drain well again. Step 6: Transfer to a large bowl. Step 7: Add mince, onion and remaining mint. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper, mix well. Step 9: Roll tablespoonfuls of mixture into balls.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, carrot, onion, curry powder, ground cumin, ground cardamom, kosher salt, pepper, boneless lamb, cooked basmati rice, plain yogurt, mango chutney, green onion, peanuts, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick skillet, over medium heat, heat 2 teaspoons olive oil. Step 2: Add the next 5 ingredients and 1 / 2 teaspoon kosher salt. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3-5 minutres or until the onion is translucent. Step 4: Transfer to a bowl Clean skillet and return to stove. Step 5: Add 2 teaspoons of olive oil over high heat. Step 6: Add the lamb and 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 to 5 minutes or until browned on all sides. Step 8: Add the vegetable mixture, rice, yogurt, chutney, green onions, and peanuts, stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, ground lamb, fresh ginger, garlic clove, garam masala, spring onions, green chilies, fresh coriander, of fresh mint, lime, salt and pepper, tomatoes, butter, double cream, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and boil the potatoes. Step 2: Meanwhile, dry-fry the lamb mince, ginger and garlic to brown the lamb. Step 3: Add the garam masala, cook for a couple more minutes, then set aside. Step 4: When ready to assemble, mix the chopped spring onions, chillies, coriander, mint and the juice of the lime to the lamb, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Transfer to a deep pie dish or casserole dish and spread the chopped tomatoes on top. Step 6: When the potatoes are cooked, mash them with half the butter, the double cream and the milk, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 7: Spread the potato mixture over the lamb and tomatoes, then mark the top with a fork. Step 8: Melt the remaining butter, brush over the top, then sprinkle with paprika. Step 9: Bake at 180c until golden brown on top It also freezes quite well.

Dish Name: Indian Tandoori Spiced Leg Of Lamb
Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, fresh lime juice, fresh garlic, lime zest, fresh ginger, salt, paprika, coriander, cumin, turmeric, cardamom, mustard powder, cayenne pepper, clove, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl combine yogurt with all remaining ingredients whisk to blend well. Step 2: Place the leg of lamb in rack in a roasting pan Coat the leg with yogurt mixture all over. Step 3: Cover the lamb with plastic wrap. Step 4: Refrigerate for 24 hours. Step 5: Set oven to 375 degrees Roast the lamb uncovered for about 1-1 / 2 hours. Step 6: Let rest for 15 minutes before serving Delicious!

Ingredient Names: parmesan, curry powder, lamb cutlets, olive oil, tomato chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Mix the parmesan and curry powder together. Season the lamb, then press the meat into the cheese mix to coat. Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan or heavy baking tray and fry the cutlets for 2 mins on each side to brown. Step 2: Transfer to the oven for 5 mins for medium, or longer for well done. Delicious served with a dollop of tomato chutney and some mash flavoured with chopped coriander.

Dish Name: Indian lamb with spiced pumpkin pickle
Ingredient Names: lamb cutlets, yogurt, ground coriander, turmeric, fresh coriander, zest lemon, naan bread, chunk squash, sunflower oil, onions, thumb-size ginger, green chili, black, cornflour, sugar, cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To make the pickle, cook the squash in boiling water for 6-10 mins until just tender but not falling apart. Drain gently. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onions, ginger and chilli for 10-12 mins until soft. Add the mustard seeds, ground coriander and turmeric for 1 min. Stir in the cornflour, then the sugar, then gradually stir in the vinegar. Simmer for 6-8 mins until thickened. Gently stir in the squash until just hot, then divide between 2 hot, sterilised jars and cover. Cool completely. The pickle can be eaten straight away or left in the fridge, unopened, for up to 1 month. Step 3: Put the lamb into a dish. Mix together the yogurt, ground coriander, turmeric, nearly all the chopped coriander, the lemon zest and juice and marinate for 1 hr or up to 1 day. Step 4: Griddle or pan-fry the lamb for 1-2 mins on each side until cooked to your liking, then scatter over the remaining coriander and eat with spoonfuls of pickle and naan.

Ingredient Names: lean lamb, onions, curry paste, fresh coriander, fat-free yogurt, mint, garlic, herb salad, indian-style breads
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. In a medium bowl, combine the lamb, onion, curry paste and most of the coriander with some seasoning. Press 2-3 tbsp of the lamb around skewers to form kebabs and transfer to a baking tray. Step 2: Cook for 15-20 mins until cooked through. Mix yogurt, mint and garlic. Warm breads following pack instructions and serve with leaves, remaining coriander, skewers and yogurt.

Ingredient Names: butterflied leg lamb, finger-length ginger, garlic, turmeric garam masala cumin seeds, paprika, fresh cilantro, lemons, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Using a hand blender or mini food processor, whizz marinade ingredients to a smooth paste, then season with salt. Lay the lamb in a ceramic dish and coat with the marinade. Cover in cling film and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hrs or preferably overnight. Step 2: If you are using a charcoal barbecue, wait for the coals to become white and glowing (light the barbecue about an hour before you want to cook the lamb). If using a gas barbecue, cook the lamb over medium heat. Lift lamb out of the marinade and barbecue, flesh-side down, for about 25 mins. Flip it over and give the fat side about 15 mins. When the lamb has a dark brown crust and is cooked to your liking, leave it to rest on a board for 15 mins. (If the weather forces you indoors, the lamb can be roasted at 220C/200C fan/gas 7 for about an hour for pink meat; the breads can be cooked on a very hot griddle). Step 3: To serve, carve the lamb into thick slices and scatter with the coriander and some of the Pickled red onion. Serve the remaining onion in a dish alongside the raita and breads.

Dish Name: Instant Pot Cumin Lamb Stew With Curry and Chilis
Ingredient Names: lamb shoulder, kosher salt, grapeseed oil, onions, ginger, garlic, arbol chiles, ground cumin, garam masala, cornstarch, granulated sugar, water, steamed rice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat Instant Pot to saute setting. Step 2: Generously season lamb cubes with salt. Add grapeseed oil to pot and swirl to coat. Add lamb, in batches so as not to overcrowd pot, and sear until golden, turning once, about 5 minutes per side. Remove lamb to a large plate as they finish. Step 3: Drain all but 1 tablespoon oil (or add an additional tablespoon if pan is dry). Add onion, ginger, garlic cloves, and chile de arbol, season with salt, and saute until golden in spots, about 5 minutes. Add lamb back to pan. Create a well in the center, add one additional tablespoon grapeseed oil, and add spices. Stir to coat with oil and toast until fragrant, 30 seconds. Gently fold to incorporate lamb and onions. Sprinkle with cornstarch and sugar, stir to combine, and add water, scraping bottom of pan to deglaze. (You can also do this in a skillet on the stovetop over high heat; cooking time will be reduced. Transfer mixture to Instant Pot and proceed as per recipe.). Step 4: Cover and cook on high pressure for 25 minutes. Release the pressure naturally. Step 5: With a slotted spoon, remove lamb and aromatics to a bowl. Cover to keep warm. Skim fat from cooking liquid, using a fat separator, if desired. Season cooking liquid and lamb with salt. Return lamb and aromatics to cooking liquid, stir to combine, and serve over rice, garnished with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: oil, boneless lamb, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, ground cardamom, ground cloves, bay leaves, chicken stock, cream, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and over medium heat brown the lamb in batches. Step 2: Add the onions, garlic and ginger and cook, stirring often, for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the spices and cook, stirring, for 1- 2 minutes until spices are fragrant. Step 4: Return the lamb and any juices to the pan. Step 5: Add the stock and bay leaves. Step 6: Bring to the boil and then reduce heat, stir well, cover and simmer for 35 minutes. Step 7: Add the cream, stir, cover and cook a further 20 minutes. Step 8: Add the spinach and cook until the spinach has softened.

Ingredient Names: mutton chops, milk, egg, ginger powder, ground aniseed, cardamom powder, black pepper, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a pressure cooker place the chops. Step 2: Add in the milk, ginger powder, aniseed powder, cardamom powder and pepper powder Pressure cook this for 10 minutes or till chops become tender. Step 3: Remove the cooker lid and on low flame dry the milk. Step 4: Add salt, cook for few mins then keep aside. Step 5: Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt in it, heat oil in a pan. Step 6: Dip the chops in the egg and deep fry till golden brown.

Dish Name: Kashmiri Rogan Josh Indian Mutton Lamb Curry
Ingredient Names: lamb, fennel powder, plain yogurt, oil, cinnamon stick, clove, asafoetida powder, paprika, garam masala, cayenne pepper, ginger powder, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add cinnamon stick and cloves. Step 3: After a second, add asafoetida, meat and salt. Step 4: Saute for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add paprika and cayenne pepper, stir. Step 6: Add yoghurt gradually. Step 7: Stir till all the liquid evaporates and the meat turns brown in color. Step 8: Add fennel and ginger powders, stir.

Dish Name: Keema Matar Ground Meat And Peas
Ingredient Names: ground lamb, garlic, curry powder, cinnamon stick, fresh ginger, salt, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in a large skillet, using a spoon to break up clumps. Step 2: When pan becomes moist, add garlic, curry powder, cinnamon, ginger and salt. Step 3: Cook, stirring, until meat is cooked, continuing to break it up into crumbles. Step 4: Add peas and cook, stirring, just until peas are thawed and heated through. Step 5: Remove cinnamon stick before serving.

Ingredient Names: cinnamon stick, cloves, coriander seeds, dried hot red chili peppers, black peppercorns, cumin seed, fennel seeds, green cardamom pods, vegetable oil, fresh coconut, ground turmeric, salt, brown mustard seeds, curry leaves, shallots
Instructions: Step 1: To make the spice powder, dry roast the spices in a medium-sized skillet, over medium heat, and stir and toss them around for 1-2 minutes, or until they begin to look toasted and release their aromas Immediately remove from heat and place the spices in a clean coffee grinder, and when cooled slightly, grind to a fine powder, then set aside If you choose not to grate the coconut, cut the thinly sliced coconut flesh into - inch dice Next, wipe out the skillet with a paper towel, return to medium heat, and add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Step 2: When hot, add the diced coconut, the turmeric and teaspoon of salt, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until the coconut is toasted, then set aside. Step 3: Heat 2-3 tablespoons vegetable oil in a large pan, preferably non-stick, over medium to high heat. Step 4: Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, and stir a few seconds until they pop. Step 5: Add 20 fresh curry leaves, 3 oz shallots, and all the ginger and garlic, and saute, stirring, for 3-4 minutes until the shallots are lightly browned. Step 6: Now add the meat and the roasted ground spice mixture, and stir well to coat the meat with the spices. Step 7: Toss in the toasted coconut dice and teaspoon of salt, and then add the vinegar and 2-3 cups water.

Dish Name: Kheema Mattar Ground Lamb And Peas
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green chilies, ground lamb, ground coriander, cumin, chili powder, salt, water, frozen peas, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and fry the onion for about five minutes over medium heat, until browned. Step 2: Add the garlic, ginger and chillies and fry for two more minutes. Step 3: Add the lamb and stir-fry over high heat for about five minutes, then stir in remaining seasoning and water. Step 4: Cover the pan and simmer for about 25 minutes. Step 5: Add the peas and lemon juice, then cook, uncovered, for about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, cloves, ghee, plain yogurt, cumin seeds, ground coriander, red chili powder, salt, cinnamon, green cardamom pods, black cardamom pods, garlic cloves, onions, lamb, lamb stock
Instructions: Step 1: Optional for extra flair of tadka: set aside 3-4 of dried chillies, 4-6 cloves, and 1 tbs of ghee or oil. Step 2: Soak remained in 1 / 2 cup of water. Step 3: Mix yogurt with cumin seeds, ground coriander, chili powder, salt, set aside. Step 4: Heat rest of ghee or oil in heavy-based pan. Step 5: Add remainder of cloves, cinnamon or bay, and the cardamoms. Step 6: When they begin to crackle and change color, add garlic and saute for 2 minutes or until garlic is golden brown. Step 7: Add onions and cook for 10 minutes or until golden brown, stirring constantly. Step 8: Stir in meat and cook for 2-3 minutes. Step 9: Drain chillies and add to pan.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, paprika, ground cumin, turmeric, ground coriander, dry crushed red pepper, ground cardamom, ground cloves, lamb shoulder, onions, tomato puree, plain yogurt, white wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ginger, garlic, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil and next 7 ingredients in processor. Step 2: Puree until paste forms. Step 3: Heat remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in heavy large pot over medium high heat. Step 4: Add half of lamb Saut until brown, about 8 minutes. Step 5: Using slotted spoon, transfer lamb to bowl. Step 6: Repeat with remaining lamb. Step 7: Add onions and spice paste to pot Saut until onions are tender, about 8 minutes. Step 8: Return lamb to pot.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, boneless lamb shoulder, butter, cumin seeds, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onions, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, cayenne, cloves, cinnamon sticks, plain yogurt, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp canola oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook lamb, in batches, for 3 to 5 minutes, until browned on all sides With a slotted spoon, remove lamb to a plate as each batch browns, and add more oil to the saucepan as necessary Wipe out the saucepan with paper towels and melt 2 tablespoons butter in the same saucepan over low heat. Step 3: Add cumin seeds and cook, stirring, for 1 minute, until seeds start to sizzle. Step 4: Add garlic and ginger, then cook, stirring for 1 minute, until garlic is softened. Step 5: Add onions, increase heat to medium-low, then cook, stirring for 7 to 10 minutes until onions are golden brown. Step 6: Add remaining butter, then stir in ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, cayenne, cloves and cinnamon Increase the heat to medium, then cook, stirring often, for 5 minutes, until butter starts to separate from the spice mixture If spices start to stick to the bottom of the saucepan, add more butter or lower the heat slightly.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, garlic cloves, cayenne, ground cumin, black pepper, salt, boneless lamb, butter, onion, ground coriander, turmeric, cloves, cinnamon stick, basmati rice, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the yogurt, garlic, cayenne, cumin, black pepper and teaspoon of the salt, stir in the lamb. Step 2: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over moderate heat. Step 3: Add the onion and cook until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the coriander, turmeric, cloves, cinnamon, rice, and the remaining salt. Step 5: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 6: Add the lamb mixture to the pan. Step 7: Stir in the water and raisins, bring to a simmer. Step 8: Cover and simmer until the rice and lamb are almost done, 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lamb shoulder, sour cream, garam masala, mild curry powder, ghee, blanched almonds, sultana, dried apricot, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onions, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place the meat in a bowl, mix together the soured cream, garam masala and curry powder, mix into the meat and leave to stand for a couple of hours. Step 2: Heat the ghee in a pan and fry the almonds till golden remove from the pan, do the same with the apricots and sultanas, remove from the pan. Step 3: Fry the onion, ginger and garlic till golden. Step 4: Add the meat to the pan with the marinade, cook for 5 minutes add the apricots and sultanas simmer till meat is tender. Step 5: Add a little water if the curry dried out while cooking. Step 6: Season with saltand lemon juice, garnish with the almonds.

Ingredient Names: fennel seed, cumin seeds, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, curry powder, salt, sweet hungarian paprika, cayenne pepper, onions, vegetable oil, stewing lamb, jalapeno chiles, fresh ginger, water, nonfat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the fennel and cumin seeds finely, and mix all the dry spices in a small bowl Peel and chop the onions Mince the jalapenos and grate the ginger. Step 2: Saute the onions in the oil until soft and translucent. Step 3: Add the meat, turn up the heat a bit, and brown them both, stirring frequently. Step 4: Add the minced jalapenos and grated ginger and the mixed spices. Step 5: Stir in the water and the yogurt. Step 6: Simmer for about 45 minutes, stirring regularly to prevent sticking, until the meat is tender and the sauce is quite thick.

Dish Name: Lamb Do Piaza Lamb With Onions
Ingredient Names: onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, water, vegetable oil, cinnamon sticks, whole cardamom pods, whole cloves, boneless lamb shoulder, ground coriander, ground cumin, plain yogurt, cayenne pepper, salt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Cut three of the onions into thin sliced half rings, cut the fourth finely. Step 2: Keep the two types of onions separate. Step 3: Put the garlic and ginger into a blender add 100ml of the measured water and blend until fairly smooth. Step 4: Heat the oil in a wide heavy saucepan over a medium heat. Step 5: When hot, put in the sliced onions. Step 6: Stir and fry for 10-12 minutes until the onions turn a reddish-brown colour You may have to turn the heat down towards the end of this cooking period. Step 7: Remove onions when cooked and spread them on a paper towel lined plate. Step 8: Put the cinnamon, cardamom and cloves into he hot oil. Step 9: Stir them for about 5 seconds, now put in the meat and brown the meat on one side.

Dish Name: Lamb In Fragrant Garlic Cream Sauce Rogan Josh
Ingredient Names: onion, fresh ginger, ground coriander, red pepper, plain yogurt, sour cream, kosher salt, ghee, lean boneless lamb, garlic, black cumin seeds, ground cardamom, garam masala, heavy cream, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ingredients for the marinade except the ghee into a food processor and blend until finely pureed. Step 2: Pour the marinade over the lamb, the pour the ghee over it. Step 3: Mix thoroughly to coat the lamb pieces, then cover and let the meat marinate at least 1 / 2 hour at room temperature, or 2 hours in the fridge. Step 4: Transfer the meat and the marinade into a large dutch oven. Step 5: Bring the contents to a boil over med-low heat, reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the lamb is very tender. Step 6: Stir frequently to prevent the sauce's sticking to the bottom of the pan and burning. Step 7: Heat the 4 tbl ghee in a small frying pan on high heat. Step 8: When it is very hot, add the garlic, and fry for 15 seconds stirring very rapidly. Step 9: Add the cardamom, cumin, and garam masala As soon as the spices begin to sizzle and become fragrant, turn off the heat and pour the spiced butter and spices over the meat.

Dish Name: Lamb In Indian Spices And Yoghurt
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, fresh gingerroot, plain yogurt, red chili powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cardamom, ground cloves, ground turmeric, chopped tomatoes, boneless leg of lamb, slivered almonds, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the onion and cook, stirring for 5 minutes or until it has softened. Step 2: Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes more. Step 3: Stir in the yoghurt and all the spices. Step 4: Add the canned tomatoes, a teaspoon of salt, then cook for 5 minutes more. Step 5: Add the lamb and stir until it is coated. Step 6: Cover and cook on a low heat for 1 1 / 2-1 3 / 4 hours or until the lamb is tender, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Add a little water if the lamb begins to stick. Step 8: Meanwhile, toast the almonds in a dry frying pan, shaking gently until golden-about 3-4 minutes. Step 9: When the lamb is tender, add the garam masala to the curry and mix through. Step 10: Sprinkle with the slivered almonds and chopped cilantro, then serve.

Dish Name: Lamb In Pureed Spinach Saag Gosht
Ingredient Names: lamb, onion, ghee, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, fresh tomatoes, frozen chopped spinach, fresh coriander, cloves, brown cardamom pods, cumin seed, turmeric, chili powder, ground black pepper, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Remove fat and cut meat into cubes Seal the meat by lightly browning in a saucepan and then remove At the same time, in a separate pan or wok, fry onion until golden in some ghee or oil, then add ginger, garlic and spices 1. Step 2: Add tomatoes after 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the browned meat, add spices 2 and the spinach. Step 4: Stir it all about ensuring it doesn't stick and that the spinach is distributed throughout. Step 5: Simmer until the meat is tender- about 45 to 60 minutes. Step 6: Add spices 3 and fresh coriander and cook for at least another 10 minutes. Step 7: Serve with pullao / basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, garlic, salt, ground coriander, ginger, cardamom pods, cayenne, cinnamon stick, cloves, lamb shoulder, yogurt, cornstarch, fresh cilantro leaves, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put butter in a large skillet or casserole that can later be covered, and turn heat to medium-high. Step 2: Add onions, garlic and a large pinch of salt. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions become very soft and brown, at least 15 minutes. Step 4: Stir in spices, and cook another minute or so. Step 5: Add lamb or chicken, and stir. Step 6: In a bowl, whisk yogurt with cornstarch until smooth. Step 7: Stir it into mixture If using chicken, add 1 / 3 cup water. Step 8: Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, then cover and turn heat to low. Step 9: Cook at least 40 minutes or longer, stirring occasionally, or until lamb is quite tender.

Dish Name: Lamb Khemma Kheema W Peas Potatoes Carrots
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin seed, chili powder, turmeric, coriander, cumin, curry powder, salt, lean lamb, carrot, peas, potato
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan with a lid heat the oil and add in the cumin seeds. Step 2: Add the chopped onions and fry over a medium heat for a few minutes until golden. Step 3: Blend together the garlic, ginger, chilli powder, turmeric, ground coriander and cumin, curry powder and salt. Step 4: When the onions are ready add this mixture to the onions and stir fry for about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the lamb to the mixture and stir fry for about 7-10 minutes, breaking up any lumps of meat that may form. Step 6: Finally, add the carrots, peas, potatoes and coriander leaves to the pan, stir and cover until the potatoes are cooked and the mixture is thick.

Ingredient Names: lean ground lamb, egg, onions, curry paste, fresh coriander, garlic cloves, oil, diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine mince, egg, one of the onions, 2 tablespoons curry paste 3 tablespoons of coriander and 1 clove garlic Form mixture into small meatballs. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in non stick frying pan and cook balls in batches until golden repeat until all balls are cooked till golden, remove from pan and set aside. Step 3: Cook remaining onion and garlic till softened, add remaining curry paste and cook for 1 minute then add one cup of water and diced tomatoes. Step 4: Let mixture simmer for 5 minutes before placing meatballs and any juices to the sauce, and gently stir. Step 5: Simmer until meatballs are cooked through. Step 6: Serve with rice or mashed potatoes sprinkled with remaining coriander.

Ingredient Names: ghee, onion, mutton, green cardamoms, black cardamom pods, bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon stick, garlic paste, ginger paste, yogurt, coriander powder, red chili powder, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee in a deep pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add green cardamoms, black cardamoms, bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon stick and saut. Step 3: Add the finely sliced onions and saut till they are transparent. Step 4: Reduce the heat, add the ginger garlic paste and stir well. Step 5: Add the lamb, stirring constantly till it changes colour. Step 6: Add yoghurt, coriander powder, red chili powder and cook till oil starts separating. Step 7: Add some salt, then chicken stock or water and bring to a boil. Step 8: Cover and cook on a slow fire till done. Step 9: Mix in black pepper powder, saffron. Step 10: Garnish with thin deep fried onion rings, cream and serve hot.

Dish Name: Lamb Korma Crock Pot Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: boneless lamb, garam masala, garlic powder, onion powder, potatoes, tomatoes, raisins, water, salt and pepper, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: In a separate bowl, toss lamb with garam masala. Step 2: Place potatoes in a 4 quart slow cooker, add seasoned meat. Step 3: Sprinkle with garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper. Step 4: Pour undrained tomatoes, raisins and water over all. Step 5: Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 8 to 10 hours or on high-heat for 4 to 5 hours Ladle stew into bowls and top with yogurt if desired.

Dish Name: Lamb Mince With Spinach Keema Saag
Ingredient Names: cinnamon, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, whole cardamom pods, whole cloves, olive oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, fresh green chilies, tomato paste, ground lamb, water, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Mix spices together, and set aside Over medium-high heat, heat oil in a large pan, adding in the onion, ginger, garlic and chilies, saute until soft. Step 2: Add spice mix to onion mixture, allowing to fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add tomato paste, incorporating well, and fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Add ground lamb, mix well with mixture and allow to cook thoroughly Carefully drain off any fat. Step 5: Reduce heat and add water and spinach. Step 6: Simmer for 30 minutes, being careful not to let lamb mixture go dry. Step 7: Add yogurt, coriander, salt and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: lamb shoulder, onions, garlic cloves, green chili peppers, turmeric, chicken stock, lemon juice, red lentil, mint sauce, fresh mint leaves, fresh coriander, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cube lamb and cut off any fat. Step 2: Put the lamb, onions, garlic, ginger, turmeric and chicken stock in a heavy based saucepan over meium heat. Step 3: Bring to simmer reduce to low heat and cover for 2 hours. Step 4: Place the coriander, mint, chillies, lemon juice and 2 tablespoon of the cooking fluid into a food processor Process to fine consistency. Step 5: Add to curry 5 mins before serving Salt and pepper to taste Please.

Ingredient Names: ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, natural yogurt, lemon, lean lamb fillets, vegetable oil, onions, garlic, fresh ginger, potato, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, salt and pepper, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the coriander, cumin, turmeric, yoghurt and lemon juice in a large bowl and add the lamb. Step 2: Mix well and cover. Step 3: Place in the fridge and marinate for at least 3 hours-overnight would be better. Step 4: Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes or until soft. Step 5: Add the lamb and the potatoes, crushed tomatoes and paste. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper, stir and bring to the boil. Step 7: Reduce the heat and simmer gently uncovered for 1-1 1 / 4 hours or until the lamb is very tender. Step 8: Check and adjust the seasonings if necessary. Step 9: Add the spinach and simmer for a further 3 or 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lamb, oil, cardamom pods, ground cloves, red chile, onions, fresh ginger, garlic, chili powder, yogurt, salt, tomato paste, ground almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Before starting, pure the chillies and onion together with a hand blender or food processor You can use a touch of water, if necessary. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan Throw in the cardamom pods and cloves and leave just until they start to sizzle and pop. Step 3: Then add in the pured chillies and onions along with the ginger, garlic and chilli powder. Step 4: Let saut for a few minutes, then add the yogurt. Step 5: Mix until the yogurt is completely combined with the other ingredients, then add the lamb. Step 6: Turn the heat down and leave to simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring from time to time. Step 7: When the mixture is fairly dry, stir in the tomato paste and the ground almonds. Step 8: Serve over basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: green chili, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, oil, boneless lamb, fenugreek seeds, cumin seed, black mustard seeds, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, onions, ground turmeric, ground cumin, chili powder, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Remove seeds and white membrane from the chilli and chop finely. Step 2: Set aside with garlic and ginger. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp oil in frying pan and brown the lamb in batches, drain on paper towel. Step 4: In a dry frying pan combine fenugreek, cumin, mustard, cinnamon and cardamom. Step 5: Cook for 1 minute or until seeds start to pop, set aside. Step 6: Heat remaining oil and cook onion until softened, 3-4 minutes, then add roasted spices. Step 7: Add garlic, ginger, chilie, turmeric, cumin, chili powder, coriander and bay leaves to onion. Step 8: Cook for 1 minute, then add lamb and stock. Step 9: Bring to boil then reduce heat to low and cook, covered for 1 1 / 4 hours.

Ingredient Names: lamb shanks, yogurt, garam masala, vegetable oil, onions, gingerroot, garlic cloves, bay leaves, tomato paste, potato, sea salt, water, green beans, nigella seeds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the shanks and trim neatly. Step 2: Mix the yoghurt with the garam masala and massage into the shanks. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Step 4: Combine the spice mix ingredients. Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frypan and cook the onion until soft but not browned. Step 6: Add the ginger, garlic, bay leaves and spice mix and cook for 3 minutes, set aside. Step 7: Heat the remaining 2 tbsp oil in a heavy, lidded pot and brown the lamb shanks on all sides. Step 8: Add the onion mixture, tomato paste, diced potato, salt and 400ml water, and bring to a high simmer. Step 9: Cover and cook over gentle heat for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours, until the lamb is tender and the sauce is thick.

Ingredient Names: lamb shanks, all-purpose flour, chili powder, ground coriander, ground ginger, ground cumin, salt, nutmeg, vegetable oil, yellow onion, celery ribs, lamb stock, greek yogurt, cardamom pods, saffron strand
Instructions: Step 1: With paper towels, gently pat any excess moisture from the lamb shanks, set aside. Step 2: In a gallon-sized ziplock or other bag, combine the flour, chili powder, coriander, ginger, cumin, salt and nutmeg. Step 3: Add the lamb shanks and shake to dust the shanks in the mixture. Step 4: In a large dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 5: Add the dusted lamb shanks from the bag Reserve any remaining flour / spice mixture from the bag, setting it aside Brown the lamb on all sides for about 7 to 10 minutes, careful not to let the flour / spice mixture burn. Step 6: Transfer the browned meat to a plate and set aside. Step 7: Add the thinly sliced onion and celery to the dutch oven and saut for 5 to 7 minutes until the onion is golden brown.

Ingredient Names: boneless leg of lamb, ground cumin, ground turmeric, salt, plain yogurt, onion, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, red food coloring, garam masala, skewers
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from lamb. Step 2: Cut lamb into 1 1 / 2 -inch cubes. Step 3: Place lamb cubes in a bowl. Step 4: Add cumin, turmeric, salt, yogurt, onion, gingerroot and garlic. Step 5: Mix together well If desired, add enough coloring to give mixture a red tint. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours. Step 7: Drain lamb from marinade and thread cubes onto eight short skewers, pressing cubes closely together. Step 8: Preheat broiler or grill. Step 9: Cook kabobs 15 to 20 minutes, or until done, basting kabobs with any remaining marinade and turning occasionally during cooking.

Ingredient Names: whole grain mustard, cumin, turmeric, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, red wine vinegar, vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, boneless leg of lamb, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine curry ingredients in a glass bowl or cup, mix well. Step 2: Put oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the onion and fry until they are brown. Step 4: Add garlic to the onions and fry for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add the curry mix, stir and fry for a minute. Step 6: Add the meat, stir and brown about 5 minutes. Step 7: Pour in the coconut milk. Step 8: Add additional water to just cover the meat. Step 9: Bring to a boil, then cover the pot, reduce to a simmer, and cook for 75 minutes.

Dish Name: Lamb With Spinach Dilli Ka Saag Gosht
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, black peppercorns, whole cloves, bay leaves, cardamom pods, onions, garlic, ginger cube, lamb, cumin seeds, coriander seed, cayenne pepper, salt, plain yogurt, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pot over a medium-high flame. Step 2: When hot, put in the peppercorns, cloves, bay leaves, and cardamom pods, stir for a second. Step 3: Now put in the onions, garlic and ginger. Step 4: Stir and fry until the onions develop brown specks. Step 5: Now add the meat, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, and 1q / 2 of the salt. Step 6: Stir and fry for a minute. Step 7: Add 1 tablespoon of the yogurt. Step 8: Stir and fry for a minute. Step 9: Keep doing this until all yogurt has been incorporated.

Dish Name: Lamb With Spinach No2 Palak Gosht
Ingredient Names: lamb, fresh gingerroot, garlic, green chilies, natural yogurt, cumin powder, oil, cinnamon, cardamom powder, clove, onions, coriander powder, red chili powder, tomatoes, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the lamb from the bones, reserving the bones. Step 2: Puree the ginger, garlic and green chil1 in a blender. Step 3: Whisk the yoghurt and add this to the puree, together with the first 1 / 2 teaspoon of cumin. Step 4: Add the lamb meat to this mix and marinate for at least 1 hour, longer if possible. Step 5: Heat the oil in a cooking pot with the cinnamon, cardamom and cloves. Step 6: When the oil is hot, add the onions and fry for 15 minutes over a low to moderate heat. Step 7: Add the coriander powder and saute for 2 minutes, stirring continuously. Step 8: Add the extra cumin and chili powder and after 10 seconds, add a little water. Step 9: Cook for another minute or two. Step 10: Add the meat, marinade and reserved bones, stir well and cook over a moderate heat for 10 minutes, until the yoghurt is absorbed.

Dish Name: Lamb kebabs with fennel & cucumber slaw
Ingredient Names: green lentil, lean lamb, ground coriander, cucumbers, fennel bulb, reduced-fat greek yogurt, garlic, mild red chili
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Put the lentils into the bowl of a food processor, then whizz to a rough paste. Tip into a bowl, add the mince, coriander and plenty of seasoning, then mix well. Roll into 16 balls, thread onto 4 skewers, then grill for 10 mins, turning halfway through, until golden and juicy in the middle. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix the cucumber and fennel with the yogurt, garlic if using, chilli and salt and pepper to taste. Serve with the kebabs.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, ginger, cashews, water, ghee, lamb shoulder, ground turmeric, ground ginger, garam marsala, kashmiri chili powder, chicken stock broth, cardamom pods, cinnamon, white sugar, cooking salt kosher salt, coconut cream, fresh cream, basmati rice, naan, coriander cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Onion puree – Place the onion, garlic and ginger into a tall container that fits the head of a stick blender. Blitz until smooth – about 5 to 10 seconds. Scrape into a bowl, set aside. Step 2: Cashew puree - In the same jar, while covering the mouth of the jar with your hand (to prevent flying cashew comets), blitz the cashews and water with the stick blender until smooth, about 10 seconds., Set aside. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F (160°C fan-forced). Step 4: Reduce onion puree – Melt and heat ghee in a ~24 cm/ 10" oven-proof pot over high-heat. Cook the onion puree, stirring regularly, for 8 minutes until it has reduced by half. Don’t let it caramelise. Step 5: Add lamb, reduce to medium-high heat then stir until the meat changes from red to light brown. Don’t try to brown the meat (it won't happen). Step 6: Sauce - Add turmeric, ground ginger, garam marsala and kashmiri chilli, then stir through. Pour in the stock (the liquid should just barely cover the meat). Add cardamom pod sachet and cinnamon sticks, then stir. Bring to a simmer, cover with a lid then transfer to the oven. Step 7: Slow cook – Cook for 1 1/2 hours. Stir in Cashew Puree, put the lid back on then return to the oven for another 30 minutes. The sauce should have thickened to a creamy consistency and lamb should be tender end to pull apart with forks with no effort. Step 8: Creamy sauce - Place the pot on a low heat. Add the sugar, salt, coconut cream and cream, then stir. Simmer for 2 minutes, then you’re done! Step 9: Serve over basmati rice with a sprinkle of cashew nuts and coriander, if desired. Naan for dunking highly recommended!

Ingredient Names: sunflower, lamb neck fillet, onions, garlic, curry powder, fat red chili, reduced-fat coconut milk, lamb stock, basmati rice, mango, fresh coriander, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Heat the oil in a large, shallow ovenproof pan, tip in the lamb, then fry on a high heat for 5 mins until browned all over. Take out of the pan and set aside. Fry the onions in what’s left of the oil for 5 mins, until starting to soften and turn golden at the edges. Tip in the garlic and curry powder and fry for 1 min more until toasty and aromatic. Step 2: Stir the lamb back in to the pan along with the chilli, coconut milk and stock, then bring to the boil. Cover the pan and place in the oven for 1 hr, until the lamb is completely tender. Alternatively, you can simmer the pan on a low heat for 1 hr on the hob. Step 3: Season to taste, stir in the rice, re-cover pan, then return to the oven or hob for 30 mins until all the liquid has been absorbed. Take off the heat, leave to stand, covered, for 10 mins, then fluff the rice with a fork. Sprinkle with the mango, coriander and almonds, if using, then serve straight from the pan.

Ingredient Names: butter, cooked lamb, onion, apple, celery, garlic, curry powder, dried thyme, chicken stock, canned tomato, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Using a food processor, finely chop the onion, apple, celery and garlic. Step 2: Melt the butter in a skillet and cook the vegetables until softened but not browned. Step 3: Stir in the curry powder and thyme. Step 4: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in the chicken stock and tomatoes. Step 6: Simmer for two minutes. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Add more curry powder if desired For a smooth sauce, puree in the food processor and pour back into the skillet. Step 9: Add the lamb to the skillet.

Dish Name: Leg Of Lamb In A Spicy Yogurt Sauce
Ingredient Names: leg of lamb, blanched almonds, onions, garlic, ginger, green chilies, plain yogurt, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, garam masala, vegetable oil, whole cloves, cardamom pods
Instructions: Step 1: Remove all the fat from the outside of the leg and the white skin, or ask your butcher to do it. Step 2: Put the leg in a baking dish, stainless steel or glass is preferred because of the yogurt marinade. Step 3: Put in your blender or food processor the almonds, onions, garlic, ginger, green chilies and about 3 tablespoons of the yogurt, process to a paste The remaining yogurt you put in a dish, beat lightly until smooth, add the paste and the cumin, coriander, cayenne and garam masala, mix Stab the lamb all over, making good deep cuts. Step 4: Now the fun begins, using your hands push generous amounts of paste in the natural openings of the lamb, then in the cuts you made. Step 5: Spread remaining paste all over and around the lamb, the side that will be up should get a thick layer. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours. Step 7: When ready to bake, remove the lamb from the fridge and give it enough time to get to room temperature. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: boneless lamb, salt, coriander powder, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, ground black pepper, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion, fresh ginger, water, lemon juice, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place lamb in a large bowl and sprinkle with salt, coriander, cumin, cayenne and black pepper, stir to coat. Step 2: Let stand at room temperature for 1 / 2 hour. Step 3: Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add mustard seeds and cover to avoid splattering. Step 5: Add onion and ginger and cook until onion is lightly brown. Step 6: Add lamb and its marinade, and mix with onion. Step 7: Stir for about 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in water and bring to a boil. Step 9: Cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 - 45 minutes.

Dish Name: Marinated Lamb Popsicles With Fenugreek Cream Curry
Ingredient Names: racks of lamb, white wine, yellow mustard, salt, garlic, canola oil, turmeric, whipping cream, dried fenugreek leaves, cayenne pepper, lemon juice, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the racks of lamb into the'popsicles' by slicing the chops in between the bones. Step 2: Mix the white wine, mustard and salt together in a large bowl, then add the popsicles, turning to coat them on all sides. Step 3: Cover and set aside in the refrigerator for a couple of hours. Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix together the whipping cream, salt, paprika, cayenne, fenugreek flakes and lemon juice. Step 5: In a medium-sized, heavy pot, saut the crushed garlic in the canola oil. Step 6: Once the garlic is golden in colour, add the turmeric, stir and heat for one minute. Step 7: Add the whipping cream mixture, stir and heat on low to medium heat for a few minutes If making the sauce a day ahead, let the garlic mixture cool completely, then add to the cream mixture and refrigerate Thicken the sauce close to serving time by heating gently. Step 8: Grill the popsicles just before you are ready to serve your meal.
