Ingredient Names: onions, garlic cloves, gingerroot, green chilies, oil, bay leaves, boneless lamb shoulder, asafoetida powder, chili powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, garam masala, tomato paste, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Place onion, garlic, ginger and chiles in a food processor and chop to form a paste. Step 2: Heat oil in a dutch oven and add onion mixture and the cassia leaves. Step 3: Fry over high heat for 5 minutes, reduce heat to medium and fry another 2 minutes Onions should be just starting to brown. Step 4: Add the lamb and stir until all pieces are coated with onion mixture. Step 5: Fry 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 6: Add the asafoetida, chili powder, coriander, cumin, turmeric and garam masala, stir well, cook 2 minutes. Step 7: Add tomato paste and yogurt and cook 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: mutton, water, turmeric powder, peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon sticks, ginger paste, garlic paste, onion, tomatoes, coriander powder, chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mutton, water, turmeric powder, pepper, cloves, cinnamon and salt in a pressure cooker or a stewer. Step 2: Cook until mutton is tender. Step 3: Place oil in a pot. Step 4: Add chopped onions, fry. Step 5: Then add chopped tomatoes, cook until soft. Step 6: Now add the ginger and garlic pastes, stir well. Step 7: Add all the other masalas and fry for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Nordic Moon Ranch's Most Excellent Ground Lamb
Ingredient Names: ground lamb, onion, olive oil, curry powder, red wine, tomato paste, garlic, salt, red pepper flakes, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, preheated heavy skillet over medium heat, brown lamb evenly. Step 2: Drain of all fat In same skillet, saute onion in olive oil until soft. Step 3: Using mortar and pestal, grind garlic to a paste with the salt. Step 4: Add paste to onions in skillet. Step 5: Stir in curry powder and red pepper flakes if used. Step 6: Return lamb to skillet and add tomato paste and broth or wine. Step 7: Reduce heat and let simmer for 10 to 20 minutes, or until flavors have blended and liquids are thickened.

Ingredient Names: lamb, onions, tomatoes, cumin powder, chili powder, turmeric, nutmeg, red chilies, broth, garlic, gingerroot, cooking oil, salt, pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, season lamb pieces with salt and pepper. Step 2: In a non-stick pan, heat two tablespoons of oil. Step 3: Add seasoned lamb pieces and brown well; discard excess oil and reserve meat on a plate. Step 4: In a non-stick sauce pan, heat oil. Step 5: To the hot oil, add whole red chilies; fry for 30 sec. Step 6: Add turmeric and chopped onions, and fry until brown. Step 7: Put garlic and ginger into the onion mixture; fry for 30 sec. Step 8: To this mixture, add cumin, chili powder, grated nutmeg and chopped tomatoes; mix well for a few minutes. Step 9: Transfer browned lamb pieces into the spice mixture, add salt and pepper; stir well. Step 10: Add broth to the browned lamb; lower the heat to low and let simmer until lamb pieces are tender, and the sauce has attained a thick, saucy consistency, about 35-45 minute. Step 11: When cooked, turn off the heat and add chopped cilantro to garnish. Step 12: Serve hot with rice, and or roti (flat bread).

Dish Name: Pleasure In Every Spoon Indian Mutton Lamb Biryani
Ingredient Names: mutton, basmati rice, onions, green chilies, ginger, salt, garlic, fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves, tomatoes, saffron, milk, plain fat-free yogurt, turmeric powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Soak rice for 5-6 hours in water, drain and keep aside. Step 2: Cut half the ginger into juliennes and make a paste of the rest. Step 3: Soak saffron in warm milk and keep aside. Step 4: Marinate the mutton or lamb in a large bowl for 4 hours in a cool place, in a mixture of yogurt, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp Each of ginger and garlic pastes. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok and fry half of the onions in it until brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain on a paper towel and keep aside. Step 7: Cook rice in salted 7 cups of boiling water alongwith the cloves, cinnamon, black and green cardamoms and peppercorns till the rice is almost cooked. Step 8: Strain and keep rice warm. Step 9: Heat ghee in a pressure cooker or a thick-bottomed pan.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fresh ginger, cayenne pepper, paprika, ground cumin, ground cloves, lamb, red chilies, cashew nuts, vegetable oil, mushrooms, natural yogurt, garam masala, rice, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and soak the rice for 30 mins then drain. Step 2: Mix the marinade ingredients together and rub into the lamb chunks, chill for 2 hours or overnight. Step 3: Allow lamb to get to room temperature then thread onto wooden skewers. Step 4: Make a paste of the chillies and nuts in a blender then fry in a little oil gently for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the mushrooms, garlic, ginger, yoghurt, garam masala and seasoning. Step 6: Fry gently for 5 minutes. Step 7: In a separate pan fry the rice in a little vegetable oil for about 3 minutes add just enough water to cover, season with salt and pepper and add the turmeric and cook until tender, about 30 minutes lay out on a tray to dry a little. Step 8: Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350f, fry the onion until golden and crisp. Step 9: Grease either individual ovenproof dishes or one large one with butter and sit the bay leaves on the bottom. Step 10: Now layer up the rice, mushroom mix, onion and a splash of the lime juice and rosewater.

Dish Name: Punjabi Lamb In Spinach And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: garlic, fresh green chilies, fresh ginger, ground cumin, vegetable oil, stewing lamb, ghee, onions, bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon stick, ground coriander, spinach, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Blend or process garlic, chillies, ginger, cumin and oil until smooth. Step 2: Spread chilli mixture all ove the lamb, cover, refrigerate 3 hours or overnight Best if left overnight. Step 3: Heat ghee in a large pan, cook onions, stirring, until browned lightly. Step 4: Add bay leaves and spices, cook, stirring, until fragrant. Step 5: Add lamb, cook stirring, until lamb is just browned. Step 6: Boil, steam or microwave spinach until just wilted, drain. Step 7: Blend or process spinach, undrained chopped tomatoes and paste until pureed, add to lamb mixture. Step 8: Simmer, covere, for 1 1 / 4 hours. Step 9: Remove cover and simmer 30 minutes or until lamb is tender and sauce is thickened.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, sunflower oil, lean lamb steak, red peppers, green chili, mild curry paste, tomato, coconut cream, baby spinach, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Dry-fry the cumin seeds for about 20 secs in a wok, then add half the oil and stir-fry the lamb for about 1 min until browned, but not cooked all the way through. Tip onto a plate. Step 2: Add the rest of the oil to the wok, then stir-fry the pepper and chilli for a couple of mins until softened. Stir in the curry paste, tomatoes and coconut cream with half a can (from the tomatoes) of water, then simmer for about 5 mins until saucy. Add the lamb, spinach and coriander, stir until the spinach has wilted, then serve with basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: ground lamb, ginger, garlic, cayenne bell peppers, onions, eggs, turmeric, garam masala, fresh cilantro, mint leaves, potato, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ground meat in a larger bowl, and add ginger, garlic, cayenne peppers, onion, egg, turmeric, garam masala, cilantro, mint, potato, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Mix well (you'll have to use your hands for this one). Step 3: Form golf ball sized balls with the meat mixture, and set aside. Step 4: Allow to rest 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat oven to 375º. Step 6: Place the kofta on a non-stick cookie sheet and bake 25 minutes or until cooked through, and slightly browned. Step 7: Serve hot, with nan bread, cucumber-yogurt sauce and a fresh tomato and mint salad.

Dish Name: Tandoori lamb skewers with crunchy slaw & raita
Ingredient Names: fat-free greek yogurt, tandoori paste, leg lamb steak, fresh coriander, wholemeal chapatis, carrot peeler, white cabbage, red onions, limes, olive oil, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine 2 tbsp of yogurt with the tandoori paste. Add lamb, mixing to coat all the pieces. Make raita with the remaining yogurt, 1 tbsp of the chopped coriander and some seasoning, then set aside. For the slaw, mix together all of the vegetables and the remaining coriander in a large bowl, then stir in the lime juice, oil and mustard seeds. Step 2: Heat the grill to high. Divide the lamb between 4 skewers, grill for 3-4 mins each side, until lightly charred and cooked through. Serve with the slaw, raita and warmed chapatis.

Dish Name: Aloo Matar Ka Pulao Indian Rice With Potatoes And Peas
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, butter, cumin seed, fresh ginger, green peas, potato, coriander seeds, garam masala, salt, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and soak in 2 cups of water for an hour, drain well. Step 2: In a heavy pan, heat the butter and add the cumin and the ginger. Step 3: When the ginger becomes a light brown, add the peas and potatoes, coriander, garam masala, salt and turmeric. Step 4: Stir-fry till well mixed. Step 5: Add the drained rice & 4 cups of water, bring to a boil uncovered, then lower the heat to simmer and cover The rice should be done in 10 minutes, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, frozen black-eyed peas, water, onion, garlic cloves, raisins, chicken bouillon cubes, salt, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, cardamom pods, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350. Step 2: Put 1 cup water in a 2 quart saucepan and with the black eyed peas and bring to a full boil for five minutes While the peas are boiling, peel and cut the onion, wash the rice and drain, and bring 16 oz Water to a boil with the bouillon cube in a separate saucepan. Step 3: Drain the black eyed peas and put them in a bowl. Step 4: Add the oil to the saucepan that had the black eyed peas and set the range to medium heat. Step 5: Add the onion to the oil. Step 6: Once the onions get soft, add the salt, cloves, cinnamon, cumin and crushed cardamom. Step 7: Stir frequently for about 3 minutes while the smells of kenya fill your home! Step 8: Add the garlic and stir for another 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, red bell pepper, basmati rice, water, lemon zest, salt, chickpeas, cilantro, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium nonstick saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is soft, about 7 minutes. Step 3: Add the bell pepper and rice, stirring to coat. Step 4: Stir in the water, lemon zest and salt, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook until the rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the chickpeas and cook until heated through, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the cilantro and toasted almonds at serving time.

Ingredient Names: dried apricot, lemon zest, water, unsalted butter, garam masala, onion, kosher salt, basmati rice, fresh ground black pepper, mint leaf, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Put the apricots and lemon zest in the 2 cups of cold water. Step 2: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat, add the garam masala, and toast, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add the onion and 1 / 4 of the salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is tender and translucent, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the rice and cook, stirring occasionally, until it begins to brown, about 4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the water along with the apricots, lemon zest, the remaining 1 teaspoons salt and pepper to taste, bring to a simmer. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low, wrap a clean dish towel around the saucepan lid, and cover the saucepan. Step 7: Meanwhile, toast the nuts and set aside. Step 8: Cook the rice for 10 minutes, set aside for 5 minutes undisturbed, then remove the lid and fluff with a fork Mound the pilaf on a serving dish and tear the mint over it and top with nuts.

Dish Name: Basmati Rice Seasoned With Garam Masala
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, butter, onion, garlic, garam masala, salt & freshly ground black pepper, vegetable broth
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a medium stove-to-oven pot melt butter over medium heat. Step 3: Add chopped onions, garlic and garam masala and cook 3 to 5 minutes, stirring until onions are softened. Step 4: Add rice and stir until well coated. Step 5: Add vegetable stock, salt and pepper to taste, bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover and bake in the oven until the rice is tender and the stock is absorbed, about 20 to 25 minutes. Step 7: Let stand, covered for 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, basmati rice, onion, water, salt, apricot, currants, sliced almonds, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Warm olive oil in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Add rice and onion. Step 3: Stir until rice is well coated and translucent around edges, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add water and salt. Step 5: Stir, cover, reduce heat to low and cook 20 minutes remove from heat and let rest, covered, for 5 minutes Fluff rice. Step 6: Then gently mix in remaining ingredients.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, jalapeno pepper, frozen green peas, tomatoes, salt, pepper, brown rice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and garlic. Step 3: Sprinkle with coriander, cumin, clobes, cinnamon, and jalapeno. Step 4: Cook, stirring frequently, 5 minutes. Step 5: Add peas, tomatoes, salt and pepper. Step 6: Mix well so that spices are evenly distributed. Step 7: Cover and cook 5 minutes, add rice. Step 8: Cook, stirring constanly, until mixture is well blended and rice is hot. Step 9: Top each serving with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, lemongrass, fresh ginger, shallots, cucumber, canola oil, peanuts, coconut milk, salt, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non-stick pan on medium heat. Step 2: Toss in the peanuts. Step 3: Saute until golden. Step 4: Drain onto an absorbent paper, keep aside. Step 5: Put rice in a thick-bottomed pan. Step 6: Add lemon grass, ginger, shallots and coconut milk. Step 7: Mix well If the coconut milk is too thick, add 1 / 2 cup of water, add salt.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, whole cumin seed, mustard seeds, basmati rice, butternut squash, water, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan melt the butter. Step 2: Add cumin seeds and mustard seeds and cook over high until mustard seeds begin to pop. Step 3: Add rice and squash and toss with seeds to mix thoroughly. Step 4: Add water and salt, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until squash is tender and water is completely absorbed - about 15 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes Fluff rice before serving.

Dish Name: Chicken In Peanut Curry With Saffron Rice And Snow Peas
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless chicken thighs, carrots, celery ribs, shallot, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, curry powder, chicken stock, smooth peanut butter, coconut milk, cornstarch, medium grain rice, saffron, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stockpot or dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of the oil and cook all sides of the chicken pieces until lightly browned. Step 2: Remove chicken from pot and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 4: Add carrots and celery and cook until softened. Step 5: Add shallots, ginger and garlic and cook until shallots soften. Step 6: Add curry powder, stir for 15 seconds and pour in the stock. Step 7: Return chicken to the pot. Step 8: Add water to barely cover the chicken. Step 9: Heat to a boil and then reduce heat and simmer uncovered until chicken is fully cooked Internal chicken should be approximately 170f.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, buttermilk, oil, onion, green chili pepper, ginger, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together with a whisk or your hand. Step 2: Add more buttermilk if needed, to make a thick consistency batter, as for pancakes. Step 3: Heat a griddle on medium heat. Step 4: Grease with 1 teaspoon of oil the first time only. Step 5: Pour 2 tablespoons of batter and spread evenly and thinly with the back of a serving spoon into a round shape. Step 6: Add teaspoon of oil around the edges. Step 7: Cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the top appears dry and the bottom has just begun to brown. Step 8: Turn over with a flat spatula Brown the other side very lightly, adding teaspoon of oil around the edges. Step 9: Make all the crepes the same way.

Ingredient Names: water, basmati rice, cinnamon stick, cloves, cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil in saucepan Slowly add rice then cinnamon, cloves and cumin. Step 2: Cover and reduce to simmer. Step 3: Cook until rice is tender and water is absorbed, about 10- 15 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat Fluff with a fork and serve.

Ingredient Names: oil, butter, garlic, onions, tomato, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, tomato sauce, schezwan sauce, salt, fresh carrot, sweet corn, red capsicums, green capsicum, macaroni pasta, water, cheese, mixed herbs, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a cooker heat 2 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp butter. Step 2: Add 2 clove garlic, 1 onion and saute until the onion shrinks. Step 3: Add 2 tomato and saute until the tomato softens and turns mushy. Step 4: Further add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp schezwan sauce and 1 tsp salt. Step 5: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 6: Also, add 1 carrot, 2 tbsp sweet corn, ½ red capsicum and ½ green capsicum. Step 7: Stir fry for 1 minute or until the vegetables turn crunchy. Step 8: Now add 2 cup macaroni pasta and 1½ cup water. Step 9: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Pressure cook for 1 whistle on medium flame. Step 11: After the pressure is released, you can see the pasta has cooked well. Step 12: Now add 2 slice of cheese, ½ tsp mixed herbs and ½ tsp chilli flakes. Step 13: Cover and rest for 2 minutes, so the cheese melts. Step 14: Mix gently making sure everything is well combined. Step 15: Finally, enjoy Cooker Pasta Recipe when it is still hot.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, coriander seed, red bell peppers, cayenne pepper, ground cinnamon, chicken stock, saffron thread, couscous, fresh thyme, eggs, mint, cream cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pan over medium heat and fry coriander seeds until toasted. Step 2: Add bell peppers, cayenne and cinnamon and saut until tender. Step 3: Add chicken stock and saffron threads and bring to a boil. Step 4: Stir in couscous, cover and remove from heat. Step 5: Let it sit until all the liquid has been absorbed If the liquid is not fully absorbed after the allotted time, return to low heat and cook until it is fully absorbed While stirring season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with chopped baby thyme, cover and refrigerate to cool. Step 6: When the couscous has cooled, beat the eggs together and fold them into the couscous. Step 7: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate again for 1 / 2 hour. Step 8: Using your hands, form palm sized pancakes with the mix and place them in a hot, oiled, non-stick skillet.

Dish Name: Creamy Curry Pork And Rice Bake
Ingredient Names: oil, pork shoulder, curry powder, carrots, onion, fresh garlic, coconut milk, chicken broth, water, salt, pepper, chickpeas, basmati rice, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a large deep oven-proof pot, heat oil over medium-high heat Brown the pork in 2 batches about 3 minutes per batch. Step 3: Set aside to a plate. Step 4: Return meat to the pot. Step 5: Add in curry powder, carrots and onion. Step 6: Cook about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add in coconut milk, chicken broth, water and salt, bring to a boil. Step 8: Stir in rice, chickpeas and spinach, cover with lid.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, black cumin seeds, basmati rice, water, salt, warm water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and fry black cumin seeds for 10 seconds. Step 2: Add rice and saute for a few minutes until rice starts to change color and become opaque. Step 3: Add water and salt. Step 4: Bring to a boil, turn down heat and cover. Step 5: Simmer until all liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked. Step 6: Pour saffron water into middle 2-inch circle of rice. Step 7: Leave covered for a few minutes for water to be absorbed Fluff up rice with a fork and mix Rice should be a marbled mix of white and yellow grains.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, mushroom, carrots, celery, diced tomatoes, lentils, chicken broth, water, worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, pineapple juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot sweat the onion, garlic, and mushrooms in canola oil until soft. Step 2: Add carrots, celery, lentils, salt, and spices and saute for 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken broth, tomatoes, and 2 cups of water. Step 4: Simmer until lentils are al dente about 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Add pineapple juice and spinach simmer until lentils are done about 5-10 more minutes. Step 6: Take soup off the heat and add couscous. Step 7: Let sit 5-10 mins then serve.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, long grain rice, green onion, curry powder, chicken broth, frozen peas, unsalted dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, in hot oil, cook rice and green onion with curry powder until rice is browned. Step 2: Add broth, heat to boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, simmer 20 minutes. Step 3: Add peas and peanuts. Step 4: Cook 5 minutes more.

Dish Name: Dal And Rice With Spicy Fried Cabbage
Ingredient Names: oil, garlic, onion, garam masala, curry powder, turmeric, ginger powder, cinnamon, ground cloves, carrot, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, masoor dal, white rice, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan over medium-high heat, saute garlic and onion in just enough oil to cover bottom of the pan scantily. Step 2: When onion begins to turn clear, add garam masala, curry, turmeric, cinnamon, and cloves. Step 3: Saute a minute or two more, until well mixed. Step 4: Add carrot, tomatoes, chicken broth, dal, rice, and water, and stir well. Step 5: Reduce heat to low. Step 6: Cover and cook 20-30 minutes, until dal and rice are soft and liquid is absorbed. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to taste Just before serving, heat enough oil to cover bottom of pan in a wok or large frying pan until very hot. Step 8: When oil is very hot, fry cumin and chili powder for a few seconds, then add cabbage and sugar, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until wilted. Step 9: Serve dal and rice mounded on a plate with fried cabbage on top.

Ingredient Names: split peas, water, turmeric, cayenne, salt, butter, onion, whole cumin seed, cloves, black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: Soak peas or beans 3-4 hours in the 2 1 / 2 cups water. Step 2: Add turmeric, cayenne and salt and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat, partially cover and simmer 20-30 minutes Peas should be tender and beginning to disintegrate. Step 4: Add additional water if necessary to maintain thick gravy consistency. Step 5: Meanwhile, saute in a small pan the onion in butter with remaining seasonings. Step 6: Fry till onion is well browned, add onion to peas, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, apples, celery, onion, garlic clove, curry powder, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, white pepper, cornstarch, canned chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken, raisins, cooked long-grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add apple and next 7 ingredients. Step 3: Cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Combine cornstarch and chicken broth, and add to apple mixture. Step 5: Stir in chicken and raisins, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, serve or rice.

Dish Name: East Indian Farina Hot Cereal Payasam
Ingredient Names: whole milk, farina, salt, butter, ground cardamom, unbleached cane sugar, pistachios, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: In saucepan bring milk to almost boil and stir in the cereal using a fork to break up the clumps, stir in the salt. Step 2: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes for farina, 10 minutes for rice meal. Step 3: In a small saute pan, melt the butter on medium heat and add the cardamom, cane sugar and raw nuts Toast for about 2 minutes, being careful not to burn. Step 4: Add the raisins to the butter mixture and heat through. Step 5: Once the hot cereal is cooked, stir the cardamom / nut mixture into the cereal. Step 6: Serve piping hot Mmmm!

Ingredient Names: butter, basmati rice, turmeric, bay leaf, green cardamom pods, cloves, fennel seed, salt, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a saucepan. Step 2: Stir in the rice until it is coated in the butter. Step 3: Add the spices and salt. Step 4: Add the boiling water. Step 5: Cover with a tight fitting lid, and simmer on the lowest heat for 15 minutes--do not stir in the meantime.

Ingredient Names: water, long grain rice, salt, vegetable oil, cashews, dried hot chili peppers, mustard seeds, cumin seed, curry leaves, ground turmeric, fresh lime juice, tamarind paste, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Measure the water into a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add the rice and salt, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is tender and the water has been absorbed. Step 3: Heat 1 / 2 tablespoon of oil in a small skillet set over medium heat. Step 4: Add the cashews and toast until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the heat and set aside. Step 6: Heat the remaining oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Add the chile peppers, mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Step 8: Once the seeds start to pop, add the curry leaves and half of the nuts. Step 9: Cook and stir until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Step 10: Remove from the heat.

Ingredient Names: cumin seed, water, olive oil, salt, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, basmati rice, curry powder, frozen peas, cashews, fresh cilantro, of fresh mint, garlic paste, ginger paste, black mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Toast 1 / 2 teaspoon cumin seeds over medium heat in a pot you wish to cook your rice in, until seeds become aromatic and lightly pop. Step 2: Add 2 cups water, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 3 / 4 teaspoon salt, 4 whole green cardamom pods or 3 / 8 teaspoon ground cardamom, 1 / 8 cup frozen peas. Step 3: Raise heat to high, bring to a boil. Step 4: Add 1 cup basmati rice, cover. Step 5: Boil 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 6: Reduce heat to lowest setting for 40-45 minutes. Step 7: Remove cardamom pods and cinnamon stick if desired Fluff rice with a fork before serving.

Ingredient Names: panir, basmati rice, ghee, cloves, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, cardamom pods, salt, cumin seeds, rose water, saffron, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee and add cloves, cinnamon, bayleaves and cardamom. Step 2: After a minute, stir in rice, water and salt. Step 3: Allow to boil, reduce heat and cover. Step 4: Cook on simmer for 15-20min until the rice is cooked and tender. Step 5: Add the paneer Dissolve saffron in rose water. Step 6: Drizzle this over the rice and toss to mix evenly, serve with curry.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, vegetable oil, onion, celery, fresh gingerroot, dried apricot, curry powder, turmeric, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, water, salt, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice and soak if desired If you are using a rice other than basmati, skip this step. Step 2: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and celery. Step 4: Cook, stirring frequently, 1 minute. Step 5: Add ginger root Continue to cook 2 minutes more. Step 6: Add apricots and spices, along with about a tbsp of water Continue to cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly and adding small amounts of water if necessary, about a tbsp at a time to prevent sticking. Step 7: Add water starting with the rice soaking water if you are using soaked basmati rice, and adding enough tap water to equal the 2 cups.

Dish Name: Honey Bunches Of Oats Diwali Chivda Hot Mix
Ingredient Names: honey bunches of oats cereal, mixed nuts, raisins, chili powder, salt, sev, lemon juice, cumin seed, curry leaves, oil, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil. Step 2: Add cumin seeds and curry leaves. Step 3: Stir till they sizzle 1 minute. Step 4: Lower heat add raisins and nuts and stir for a minute. Step 5: Add salt, turmeric and chili powder. Step 6: Add lemon juice keeping away face from the pan in case it splashes, add cereal. Step 7: Stir till the cereal is coated with the spices, add sev. Step 8: When cool store in an air tight container.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, salt, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dough we're going to add our flour to a bowl and sprinkle the salt This is optional, in case you know you don't use salt that's fine too Incorporate the salt well, and then we'll pour oil inside it. Step 2: Now you want to mix the flour again to make sure all the oil gets incorporated in to the flour and you don't want lumps of oil in there Just for a few seconds. Step 3: When the oil and salt are nicely incorporated, add water slowly This water has been warmed in the microwave for about 30 seconds, pour little at a time and just mix We have used whole wheat flour from the indian store as its a little different from the whole wheat flour that you find in the grocery stores The one in the american grocery stores is usually a lot darker in color, so chapattis turn a little browner than you probably like them, this one is available in any indian store its called chapatti atta and is readily available Just mix all that dough in and form a nice ball.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, shallot, golden raisin, cashews, frozen peas, basmati rice, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, cardamom pods, bay leaf, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse basmati rice. Step 2: Melt butter over a medium heat. Step 3: Saute shallots, until they start to soften. Step 4: Add the golden raisins, chopped cashews, and frozen peas. Step 5: Saute until raisins start to plump. Step 6: Add the basmati rice. Step 7: Saute until rice begins to turn white. Step 8: Add the cinnamon stick, pepper corns, cardamom pods, and bay leaf, giving it one last stir. Step 9: Transfer rice mixture to your rice maker and add as much chicken stock as the rice maker recommends for 1 cup of rice Start your rice cooker on the white rice setting.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, ghee, cumin seeds, bay leaves, salt, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice in luke warm water, drain completely and let it sit. Step 2: Heat the ghee or oil on medium heat, add the bay leaves and cumin seeds and saute for a minute. Step 3: Add the rice and saute for a few minutes. Step 4: Now add the hot water and the salt. Step 5: Boil until almost all the water has evaporated. Step 6: Cover and reduce heat to low and cook for another 10 minutes or so - stir often and make sure that it doesn't start to stick to bottom of saucepan. Step 7: When there is a tiny amount of extra water left in the rice, remove from heat and let the rice sit for a minute The extra should evaporate as the rice cools a bit, serve! Step 8: If you would like, add a dollop of butter to the top.

Ingredient Names: mutton, basmati rice, potatoes, onions, tomatoes, garlic paste, ginger paste, yogurt, salt, oil, cinnamon, cloves, black peppercorns, green cardamoms, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: First of all, cut potatoes into quarters Apply salt to them Deep fry. Step 2: Pour oil / ghee in a skillet. Step 3: Fry the onions until pink in colour and crisp, remove them and keep aside before adding the cinnamon, cloves and the pastes. Step 4: Add cinnamon, cloves, peppercorns, bay leaves and green cardamoms. Step 5: Add ginger-garlic pastes, fry for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add in the washed mutton pieces. Step 7: Saute until the mutton gives out its own juices.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, ghee, cardamom pods, whole cloves, black peppercorns, salt, saffron thread, water
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the basmati rice for several changes of water, until the water runs clear. Step 2: Leave the rice to soak for 30 minutes. Step 3: Drain and then set aside until ready to cook. Step 4: Heat the ghee in a large heavy-based saucepan. Step 5: Add the cardamons, cloves and peppercorns. Step 6: Fry, stirring for one minute. Step 7: Add the rice andstir-fry for a further 2 minutes. Step 8: Add theremaining ingredients to the rice mixture and reduce the heat. Step 9: Cover the saucepan and leave to simmer over a low heat for 20 minutes, until all the water has evaporated. Step 10: Transfer the rice to a large, warmed serving dish and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: onion, slivered almonds, butter, seedless raisin, cooked long-grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onions and almonds in butter until golden Add raisins and heat through until they puff Add mixture to rice Mix lightly Serve with curry.

Dish Name: Jasmine Rice With Shallots Cumin And Red Pepper
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, jasmine rice, chicken broth, shallots, ground cumin, red pepper flakes, rice wine vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil over medium high heat in a medium-sized sauce pan that has a lid. Step 2: Add the cumin and red pepper. Step 3: Then cook the shallots until soft- 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Remove shallots and set aside. Step 5: Add rice and cook, stirring constantly for 30 seconds. Step 6: Pour in the chicken broth and let rice cook on low heat until liquid is absorbed- 15-17 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in shallots, vinegar and salt and serve.

Dish Name: Leftover Turkey Biryani With Red Onion And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, carrots, red onions, basmati rice, hot chicken stock, turkey, curry paste, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Add the oil to a large flameproof casserole dish and set it over a medium heat. Step 2: Add the carrots and onions, and cook for 5-6 minutes until the onions are softened. Step 3: Add the rice, pour over the stock, then add the turkey. Step 4: Stir in the curry paste and bring to the boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat then cover and simmer gently for about 15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Step 6: Stir in the cilantro, then divide between serving bowls. Step 7: Serve with poppadoms and mango chutney.

Ingredient Names: butter, oil, onion, garlic cloves, lentils, potato, salt, dried red chilies, turmeric, curry powder, water, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot melt the butter with the oil, Fry the oniions till light brown in colour, add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Step 2: Add all the other ingredients apart from the cabbage. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and cook till potato is tender. Step 4: Stir in the cabbage, turn off the heat cover pot with a lid and allow to stand for a few minutes. Step 5: Serve along with a curry of your choice.

Ingredient Names: red lentil, basmati rice, potato, oil, cloves, cumin seed, onion, turmeric, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place lentils in a bowl and cover with cold water, allow to stand for 15 minutes wash the lentils in running water till the water runs clear. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the cloves and cumin seeds for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the onion and potato, stir and fry for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the lentils, rice, turmeric and salt and fry for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the water, bring to the boil, cover the pan, reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Turn off the heat, leave the lid on the pan and let it stand for 10 minutes. Step 7: Serve with any curry dish.

Ingredient Names: water, turmeric, rice, shallots, mandarin segments, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water & add turmeric & rice, boil until rice is tender Drain the rice & gently stir in remaining ingredients.

Ingredient Names: mushrooms, green chilies, olive oil, cumin seed, garlic, ginger, ground coriander, garam masala, tomato puree, salt, fresh peas, fresh coriander, chicken stock, creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, until very hot. Step 2: Add the cumin seeds and sizzle for 10 seconds. Step 3: Add the garlic, mushrooms, ginger and chillies. Step 4: Cook, stirring until the mushrooms turn silken. Step 5: Put in the ground coriander and garam masala and stir for 30 seconds. Step 6: Now add the tomato pure, salt, peas and fresh coriander, and water or stock. Step 7: Stir well, bring to a boil. Step 8: Cover and simmer for five minutes. Step 9: Stir in the sour cream and cook gently for one more minute Eat immediately, either over boiled basmati rice or as a side dish with other indian dishes.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, light italian dressing, broccoli florets, green onions, grape tomatoes, carrot, salt, black mustard seeds, chili flakes, cumin seed, coriander seed, black peppercorns, cloves, fennel seed, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast the spice mix spices, except for the ginger powder and the paprika Whizz it to a powder in your coffee grinder, then mix in the ginger powder and paprika, set aside. Step 2: Cook the pasta until it is done but still somewhat firm. Step 3: Rinse with cold water. Step 4: Combine the pasta with the vegetables in a large bowl. Step 5: Stir in the salad dressing. Step 6: Add salt and 1 1 / 2 tb of the spice mix. Step 7: In a small skillet, heat a dab of oil until it is sizzle-hot. Step 8: Add the black mustard seeds.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, cumin seed, coriander powder, cardamom, bay leaf, chicken broth, nuts, salt and pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice in a sieve under cold running water until water runs mostly clear. Step 2: Place rice in a bowl with fresh cold water, and let sit 30 minutes, drain well. Step 3: Heat oil in a larger saut pan, and lightly saut the onion and garlic until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the rice, cumin seeds, coriander, cardamom and bay leaf. Step 5: Toss rice to coat well with the seasonings, and lightly saut 2 minutes. Step 6: Add broth, and season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to low, and cook 10 minutes. Step 8: Remove from heat and allow to sit 5 minutes before lifting lid. Step 9: Add nuts and toss to combine.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, sugar, butter, vanilla essence, raisins, ground nutmeg, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 300f. Step 2: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Step 3: Beat eggs and add milk. Step 4: Stir in sugar, uncooked rice, butter, vanilla essence, raisins and nutmeg. Step 5: Pour into the prepared pan. Step 6: Bake uncovered for 2 1 / 2 hours and make sure to stir frequently during the first hour. Step 7: Serve warm / cold as per your choice.

Dish Name: Pearl Israeli Couscous With Garam Masala And Pine Nuts
Ingredient Names: pine nuts, olive oil, shallot, carrot, lemon juice, garam masala, chicken broth, israeli couscous
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a medium skillet over med-high heat and add pine nuts Swirl in pan until they begin to brown Be careful not to burn, set aside to cool. Step 2: In a heavy saucepan, heat oil over medium heat and saute shallot and carrot for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in lemon juice and garam masala. Step 4: Add broth to pan and bring to a boil, stir in couscous. Step 5: Reduce heat and cover pan. Step 6: Simmer 8-10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, vegetable oil, onion, salt, of fresh mint, coriander, garam masala, lemon juice, saffron, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Soak basmati rice in water to cover for 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain While rice is soaking, heat oil in large skillet on medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and salt, and saut for 10 minutes or until brown and crisp. Step 4: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 5: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add rice and boil for 3 minutes. Step 6: Drain Butter a heavy ovenproof saucepan with a tight-fitting lid. Step 7: Divide rice in three. Step 8: Place a layer of rice on base.

Dish Name: Pineapple Fried Rice From Cooked Leftover Rice And Chicken
Ingredient Names: oil, garlic, eggs, white rice, fried chicken, spring onions, soy sauce, salt, white pepper powder, sugar, pineapple, raisins, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Put oil in a wok, add garlic. Step 2: When it turns slightly brown, add eggs or vegetables, rice, chicken or vegetables, spring onions, salt, soy sauce, white pepper powder and sugar, mix well. Step 3: Add in raisins and pineapples, mix well. Step 4: Garnish with fried cashews and serve.

Ingredient Names: butter, basmati rice, water, chicken stock cube, salt, sliced almonds, pomegranate
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot melt the butter, add the rice, and stir to coat the rice with the butter Do not fry the rice. Step 2: Add the water, stock cube and salt. Step 3: Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to minimum, cover the pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until all of the water has been absorbed by the rice. Step 4: Let the rice stand covered for 10 minutes In the mean time remove the seeds from the pomegranate. Step 5: Stir the almonds and pomegranate seeds into the rice and serve.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, gingerroot, garlic cloves, garam masala, chili powder, ground turmeric, green chilies, mint, ground coriander, basmati rice, onions, salt, oil, butter, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the pork in a bowl with the ginger, garlic, garam masala, chili powder, turmeric, chillies, mint and coriander. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate overnight The next day, put the sliced onion in a colander, sprinkle with salt to draw liquid out of the onions. Step 3: Discard liquid, rinse onions and pat dry. Step 4: Heat oil and butter in a dutch oven, then fry onions until golden brown. Step 5: Remove onions and drain. Step 6: Pour off and reserve all but about 2 tbsp of the butter and oil. Step 7: Fry the pork in the dutch oven until well browned. Step 8: Add cooked onions and yogurt and cook on low for 40 minutes. Step 9: In a large saucepan, boil enough water to cover rice.

Ingredient Names: garlic, onions, pork, canola oil, diced tomato, salt and pepper, cooked white rice, cilantro, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, ground cloves, turmeric, ginger, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To make the curry paste: in a spice or coffee mill grind the spices and ginger until very finely minced. Step 2: Turn out into a bowl and stir in the vinegar to make a smooth paste. Step 3: In a glass baking dish or non-reactive mixing bowl combine curry paste with the garlic and half of the onion. Step 4: Add the pork, turn to coat thoroughly and set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat the oil in a large skillet over low heat and gently saut the remaining onion. Step 6: Drain the pork, reserving the marinade. Step 7: Turn up the heat and add the pork, a few cubes at a time, tossing until it is browned on all sides Saut for 5 minutes, and then add the tomatoes and the reserved marinade. Step 8: Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 5 additional minutes. Step 9: Serve over hot rice, garnished with cilantro or parsley.

Ingredient Names: rice, onion, ghee, raisins, instant chicken bouillon, curry powder, salt, water, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir rice and onion in ghee until rice is yellow and onion is tender. Step 2: Stir in raisins, bouillon, curry powder and salt. Step 3: Pour into ungreased 1 1 / 2 quart casserole, stir in water. Step 4: Cover and cook in 350 degree oven until liquid is absorbed, 25 to 30 minutes, stir in almonds.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add the salt and water together and mix in a small bowl. Step 2: Combine the salted water with 2 1 / 2 cups of whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: Beat and roll the thick bread mixture by hand until all the flour is evenly textured and smooth The dough should be firm but moist. Step 4: Using the palm of your hands, roll the dough into the size of a plum Be sure that you roll it as evenly as possible with no bunching of the dough There should be enough dough balls to make about 16-18 rotis total. Step 5: Keep the dough in the bowl covered with a dishcloth to sustain moisture On a flat surface, douse some whole wheat flour on the area to keep the dough from sticking Douse the rolling pin with flour as well.

Ingredient Names: idli rice, toor dal, chana dal, moong dal, urad dal, fennel, cumin, fenugreek leaves, red chile, water, asafoetida, turmeric, ginger, salt, onions, fresh coriander, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 cup idli rice, ¾ cup toor da, ¾ cup chana da, ¾ cup moong dal and ¾ cup urad dal. Step 2: Also add 1 tsp fennel, 1 tsp cumin, ¼ tsp methi and 10 dried red chilli. Step 3: Rinse the dal well and soak in water for 4 hours. Step 4: Drain off the water and transfer to the mixer jar. Also add ¼ tsp hing, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 inch ginger and 1 tbsp salt. Step 5: Grind to coarse paste adding water as required. Grind in batches depending on the size of the mixer jar. Step 6: Transfer the batter to the large bowl and mix well adjusting the consistency as required. Step 7: Rest the batter for 2 hours before making dosa. Step 8: Take the required amount of batter, add 1 onion, 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 9: Heat the dosa pan and pour the dosa batter. Step 10: Spread gently making the dosa slightly thick. Step 11: Now top with ghee and roast on medium flame until the dosa turns golden brown from the bottom. Step 12: Flip over and cook until the dosa is cooked well. Step 13: Finally, enjoy Adai Dosa Recipe with coconut chutney.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, podded broad bean, butter, green onions, ground allspice, dill fronds, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice in several changes of cold water until the water runs clear, then soak in warm water with a pinch of salt for 30 mins. Meanwhile, cook the broad beans in boiling unsalted water for just 2 mins. Drain the beans, then tip into ice-cold water and leave to cool. Remove the beans from their skins and set aside. Step 2: Heat the butter in a saucepan, then sizzle the spring onions, pine nuts, allspice and half the dill for a few mins until pine nuts are toasted. Drain rice, then add to the pan and stir to coat in the butter. Cover the rice with about 1cm of water, then cover the pan and bring to a hard boil. Stir once, then reduce heat to a minimum, cover again and leave for 5 mins. Turn off the heat and leave rice undisturbed for 10 mins. Finally, stir beans through the rice, pile onto a serving platter, scraping any golden crispy bits from the pan, and scatter with the remaining dill.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, urad dal flour, sesame, asafoetida, salt, butter, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 3 cup rice flour, ¾ cup urad dal flour, 2 tbsp sesame, pinch hing, and 1 tsp salt. Step 2: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Add 3 tbsp butter and mix well. Crumble and mix making sure the flour is moist. Step 4: Add water slowly and start to knead the dough. Step 5: Knead to smooth and soft dough adding water as required. Step 6: Now take the star mold and fix it to the chakli maker. Step 7: Grease the chakli maker with some oil. This prevents the dough from sticking to the mold. Step 8: Furthermore, make a cylindrical shape out of dough and place the dough inside the maker. Step 9: Tighten the lid and start preparing chaklis. Step 10: Press the chakli onto hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 11: Flip the murukku and fry on medium flame till they turn crispy from both sides. Step 12: Furthermore, drain over a paper towel to remove excess oil. Step 13: Finally, once cooled enjoy Instant Butter Chakli or store in an airtight container for 2 weeks.

Ingredient Names: fresh coriander, mint, chili, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, black cardamom, pods cardamom, pepper, ghee, cumin, onions, capsicum, potato, fresh carrot, beans, peas, water, salt, basmati rice, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, to prepare the masala paste. In a mixer jar take ½ bunch coriander, few mint, 5 chilli, 1 inch ginger and 7 cloves garlic. Step 2: Also add 1 inch cinnamon, 1 black cardamom, 5 pods cardamom, 6 cloves and ½ tsp pepper. Step 3: Add water as required and grind to a smooth paste. Keep aside. Step 4: In a large kadai, heat 2 tbsp ghee. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 onion and saute well. Step 5: Also add ½ capsicum, 1 potato, 1 carrot, 5 beans, and 4 tbsp peas. Step 6: Stir fry till the vegetables turn crunchy. Step 7: Further, add prepared masala paste and cook well. Step 8: Now add 3 cup water, 2 tsp salt and mix well. Step 9: Once the water comes to a boil, add 1½ cup basmati rice, 2 tsp lemon juice and mix well. Step 10: Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked well. Step 11: Fluff the rice gently without breaking the rice grains. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Coriander Rice Recipe / Cilantro Rice with raita.

Dish Name: Curry Eggs over Rice (For Leftover Hard Boiled Eggs)
Ingredient Names: ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, ground turmeric, cider vinegar, water, canola oil, onions, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, unseasoned tomato sauce, sugar, salt, ground black pepper, hard-boiled eggs, fresh cilantro leaves, steamed white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first 4 spices along with vinegar and water to make a thin paste; set aside. Step 2: Heat a large saucepot over a medium heat and add oil. Step 3: Add onion, ginger, garlic and saute until golden brown. Step 4: Add spice mixture to the pot and stir well. Step 5: (Add more water in small amounts if mixture begins to stick.) Add chopped tomatoes to onion mixture. Step 6: Pour tomato sauce into a 2-cup measuring cup and add enough water to make 2 cups liquid. Step 7: Add to the pot and simmer 20 for minutes. Step 8: Add pinch of sugar, salt, and pepper to taste. Step 9: Cut eggs in half lengthwise and slide them into the sauce. Step 10: Serve over rice, sprinkled with fresh chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: flaxseed, rice flour, water, curds, coconut oil, amla powder, shikakai powder, methi powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a saucepan take 3 tbsp flaxseed, 2 tbsp rice flour and 4 cup water. Step 2: Stir and get to a boil. Step 3: Boil for 10 minutes or until the mixture turns gel consistency. Step 4: Strain off the mixture to separate the seeds. Step 5: Whisk and cool the mixture completely. Step 6: You can see the mixture turns into a gel consistency. Flaxseed gel is ready. Step 7: Firstly, in a bowl take 1 cup of prepared flaxseed gel. Step 8: Also, add 2 tbsp curd and 2 tbsp coconut oil. Step 9: Mix well until everything is well combined. Step 10: The flaxseed hair mask is ready to apply for hair. make sure to wash off the hair after 1 hour. Step 11: Firstly, in a bowl take 2 tbsp amla powder, 2 tbsp shikakai powder, 1 tbsp methi powder and 2 tbsp curd. Step 12: Add 1 cup of prepared flaxseed gel and mix well. Step 13: Mix well until everything is well combined. Step 14: The amla hair mask is ready to apply for hair. make sure to wash off the hair after 1 hour.

Dish Name: Fragrant duck breasts with wild rice pilaf
Ingredient Names: duck breasts skin, garam masala, ginger, butter, cumin seeds, mixed basmati wild rice, chicken, peas, green onions, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Score criss-crossed lines into the duck skin, then rub in the garam masala and ginger. Chill for 30 mins if you have time. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Heat a heavy, non-stick pan, then gently fry the duck, skin-side down, for 10 mins until the fat runs out. Pour off the excess fat halfway through. Transfer to a baking dish, roast, skinside up, for 10 mins, then leave to rest. Step 3: While the duck is cooking, melt the butter in a pan. Add cumin seeds, fry for 2-3 mins, then stir in the rice for another few mins. Pour over the stock, cover partly with a lid, then simmer for 10-12 mins, adding the peas for the final 4 mins. When the rice is cooked and all the liquid has been absorbed, fork through the spring onions and some seasoning to taste. Slice the duck and serve with the rice and a spoonful of chutney.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, onions, sunflower oil, thumb-size ginger, korma curry paste, cinnamon, green cardamom pods, star anise, potatoes, cauliflower, greek yogurt, peas, pinches saffron, rosewater, butter, onions very, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice in several changes of water to remove excess starch, then put in a bowl of cold water and leave to soak for 30 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, fry the onions in the oil for 8 mins until soft and starting to colour. Add the ginger, then cook for 2 mins more. Stir in the curry paste followed by the whole spices, cook for 1 min more, then tip in the potatoes and cauliflower. Pour in 300ml water, cover and boil for about 5-7 mins until the veg are just tender, but still have a little resistance. Stir in the yogurt and peas with 1 tsp salt. Step 3: Mix the saffron, rosewater and 3 tbsp boiling water together and stir well. Drain the rice, tip into a pan of boiling salted water, then cook for 5 mins until almost tender. Drain again. Get out a large ovenproof dish with a lid and butter the base. Tip the curry sauce into the base, scatter over the nuts, then spoon over the rice. Drizzle over the rosewater mixture, then cover with foil followed by the lid. Can be chilled overnight until ready to cook. Step 4: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Put the biryani in the oven for 45 mins-1 hr until thoroughly heated through. To check it’s ready, try a spoonful from the centre of the rice. For the garnish, slowly fry the onions in the oil until really golden and crisp (this can be done in advance). When the biryani is hot and ready to serve, gently toss through the onions and coriander.

Ingredient Names: ghee, cashews, raisins, cumin, bay leaf, cinnamon, pods cardamom, pepper, onions, garlic, ginger, chili, water, salt, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a kadai heat 2 tbsp ghee and fry 2 tbsp cashew and 2 tbsp raisins. Step 2: Roast them till the cashews turn golden brown. Keep aside. Step 3: In the same ghee, add spices and saute till they turn aromatic. Step 4: Further add ½ onion, 5 cloves garlic, 1 inch ginger, 2 chilli till the onion softens. Step 5: Pour in 2 cup water and 1 tsp salt. Mix and get to a boil. Step 6: Add 1 cup basmati rice and mix gently. Step 7: Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice are cooked well. Step 8: Fluff the rice gently, and add fried cashew, raisins, and 2 tbsp coriander. Mix gently. Step 9: Finally, enjoy Ghee Rice Recipe with curry or dal.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, ghee clarified butter, rice flour, oil, mustard, chana dal, urad dal, sesame, red chile, asafoetida, curry leaves, chili, ginger, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai take 1½ cup water, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp ghee. Step 2: Get the water to a rolling boil. Step 3: Now add 1½ cup rice flour and mix well. Step 4: Continue to mix until the water is absorbed well. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes or until the flour turn moist. Step 6: Now transfer the flour into a large mixing bowl. Step 7: With a wet hand start to knead the dough. Step 8: Sprinkle hot water if required and knead to a smooth and soft dough. Step 9: Now take a very small sized ball and roll. Step 10: Place the ball into steamer and steam for 10 minutes. Step 11: After 10 minutes, take the steamed goli idli and keep aside. Step 12: To prepare the tempering, heat 2 tsp oil. splutter 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp chana dal, 1 tsp urad dal, 2 tsp sesame, 1 dried red chilli, pinch hing and few curry leaves. Step 13: Splutter the tempering making sure all the spices turn aromatic. Step 14: Further, add 1 chilli and 1 inch ginger. saute slightly. Step 15: Now add steamed idli and mix gently without breaking the idli. Step 16: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes, or until the flavours are absorbed. Step 17: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and enjoy goli idli with spicy chutney.

Dish Name: Instant Pot Egg Biryani (Stovetop Instructions in notes)
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, eggs, ghee, yellow onions, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, bay leaves, kashmiri red chili powder, ground turmeric, kosher salt, garam masala, plain yogurt, ginger, garlic, fresh cilantro leaves, mint leaves, tomato, saffron mixed milk, lemon wedges, red onions, sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice and soak in water for 20 minutes. Drain all the water after 20 minutes. Step 2: While the rice is soaking hard boil the eggs. Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot. Place the trivet and place eggs on top of it. Close the Instant Pot lid with the pressure valve to sealing. Set the Instant Pot to pressure cook (hi) for 5 minutes. Allow 5 minutes of natural pressure release and then release the remaining pressure and open the Instant pot. Using a pair of heat-resistant mitts, carefully pick up the Instant Pot insert and place it in the sink. Run cold water for 2 minutes over the eggs or place them in an ice bath. Once the eggs are cool to handle, peel them. Make 3 shallow slits to the hard-boiled eggs and keep them aside. Step 3: Set the Instant Pot to saute mode and add ghee. Add onions and saute until they turn light golden brown, about 10 minutes. Take half of the onions out and reserve. Note: If you have an air fryer you can use it or perfect golden fried onions. Step 4: Deglaze the bottom of the pot to remove any browning from sauteeing the onions. Use 1 to 2 tablespoons of water to help remove any stuck browned bits as this will help the Instant Pot come to pressure properly and not show the dreaded "BURN". Step 5: Add cumin seeds, black peppercorns, bay leaves, and saute for a minute. Turn the Instant Pot off and add red chili powder, turmeric, salt, garam masala, ginger, garlic, mint, cilantro, tomatoes, and yogurt. Mix well once again deglazing the pot. Step 6: Add eggs and mix coating the eggs with the spices. Add rice over and spread it evenly. Add water and stir gently making sure most of the rice is under liquids. Close the Instant Pot and turn the pressure valve to sealing. Pressure Cook (Low) for 5 minutes followed by 5 minutes natural pressure release. Release the remaining pressure and open the Instant Pot. Layer the reserved caramelized onions and saffron milk evenly on top. Garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy hot with a lemon wedge and raita. Step 7: To make the raita, whisk the yogurt in a medium bowl. Add onions, tomatoes, salt, sugar and mix well. Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, rice flour, salt, cumin, water, onions, fresh carrot, chili, fresh coriander, curry leaves, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take ½ cup wheat flour, 1 cup rice flour, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp cumin. Step 2: Add 3 cup water and mix well. Mix well making sure there are no lumps. Step 3: Rest the batter for 5 to 10 minutes. after resting, the batter will thicken slightly as the flour is soaked well. Step 4: Add in 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 chilli, 2 tbsp coriander, and few curry leaves. Step 5: You can adjust the consistency by adding water if required. Step 6: When the pan is super hot, pour the batter on the pan. Step 7: Spread 1 tsp oil and allow to roast for 2 minutes or until the dosa turns crisp. Step 8: Finally, enjoy the crispy Wheat Flour Dosa Recipe with spicy tomato garlic chutney.

Ingredient Names: cashew kaju, water, rice flour, besan flour, turmeric, chili powder, sesame, salt, asafoetida, butter, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take ½ cup cashew, ½ cup water and soak for 30 minutes. Step 2: Transfer the soaked cashew into mixi jar and blend to smooth paste. keep aside. Step 3: In large bowl, take 2 cup rice flour, ¼ cup besan, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, 2 tbsp sesame, ¾ tsp salt and pinch hing. Step 4: Now add 1 tbsp butter, crumble and mix until the flour is well combined with butter. Step 5: Add cashew paste and water slowly and start to knead the dough. Step 6: Knead to smooth and soft dough adding water as required. Step 7: Now take star mould and fix to the chakli maker. Step 8: Grease the chakli maker with some oil. this prevents the dough from sticking to mould. Step 9: Furthermore, make a cylindrical shape out of dough and place the dough inside the maker. Step 10: Tighten the lid and start preparing chaklis. on the wet cloth or butter paper make small spiral shape chaklis by pressing. Step 11: Seal the ends so that it doesn’t fall apart while deep frying. Step 12: Take one murukku at a time and slide it into the hot oil. Step 13: Flip the murukku and fry on medium flame till they turn crispy from both sides. Step 14: Furthermore, drain over a paper towel to remove excess oil. Step 15: Finally, once cooled enjoy instant kaju chakli or store in an airtight container for 2 weeks.

Ingredient Names: rice, moong dal, ghee, turmeric, salt, water, cumin, bay leaf, asafoetida, onions, ginger garlic paste, tomato, chili powder, garam masala, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl rinse and soak ½ cup rice, ½ cup moong dal for 10 minutes. Step 2: In a cooker heat 1 tsp ghee and add soaked dal and rice. Step 3: Saute for 2 minutes, or until the dal turns aromatic. Step 4: Now add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp salt and 3¼ cup water. mix well. Step 5: Cover and pressure cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp ghee. add 1 tsp cumin, 1 bay leaf and pinch hing. Step 7: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 8: Now add 1 onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute well. Step 9: Further, add 1 tomato and saute until the tomato turns soft and mushy. Step 10: Keep the flame on low add ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp salt. Step 11: Saute for 2 minutes or until the spices turn aromatic. Step 12: Now add cooked rice and dal. Step 13: Also, add 1 cup water and mix well adjusting consistency as required. Step 14: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until the flavours are absorbed well. Step 15: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and enjoy dal khichdi with pickle and curd.

Ingredient Names: oil, peanuts, mustard, urad dal, chana dal, cumin, chili, ginger, curry leaves, red chile, asafoetida, turmeric, salt, leftover rice, lemons, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat ¼ cup oil and roast ½ cup peanut until it turns crunchy. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp mustard, 2 tbsp urad dal, 2 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp cumin. Step 3: Splutter tempering keeping the flame on low. Step 4: Now add 3 chilli, 2 inch ginger and roast well. roast in batches for uniform frying. Step 5: Further add 3 tbsp curry leaves, 2 dried red chilli and fry until it tunrs crunchy. Step 6: Turn off the flame and add ¾ tsp hing, 1 tsp turmeric and 2 tbsp salt. Step 7: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. heat of the pan is enough for turmeric to cook. Step 8: Transfer to an airtight container and lemon rice gojju is ready to store upto a month. Step 9: Firstly, take 3 cup of leftover rice and add 2 tbsp prepared lemon rice gojju. Step 10: Also add ½ lemon and 2 tbsp coriander. mix well. Step 11: Finally, enjoy lemon rice with coconut chutney.

Dish Name: Medu Vada Recipe in Mixer Grinder
Ingredient Names: urad dal, rice, asafoetida, salt, chili, ginger, fresh coriander, curry leaves, cumin, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take 1 cup urad dal, 2 tbsp rice and rinse well. Step 2: Soak for 6 to 8 hours making sure the dal is soaked well. Step 3: Drain off the water and transfer to the mixer jar. You can also grind in grinder for better texture. Step 4: Grind to smooth paste adding water as required. Make sure to add very little water as it helps to make the batter thick. Step 5: Transfer the fluffy batter to a large plate. Step 6: Add a pinch hing ¾ tsp salt and whisk well. Step 7: This helps to incorporate air in the batter and make the batter fluffy. Step 8: Also add 2 chilli, 1 inch ginger, 2 tbsp coriander, few curry leaves, and 1 tsp cumin. Step 9: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Now you can shape the vada using a tea strainer. Make sure to wet your hands and tea strainer. Place a ball-sized batter and make a hole in center. Step 11: Drop down gently in medium hot oil. Step 12: Flip over and fry on low to medium flame. Step 13: Fry till the vada turns golden brown and crispy. Drain off. Step 14: Finally, enjoy Medu Vada Recipe with chutney and sambar.

Ingredient Names: oil, peanuts, cashews, almonds, dry coconut, curry leaves, red chile, turmeric, salt, bowl murmura puffed rice, chili powder, black salt, powdered sugar, aamchur, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 3 tbsp oil and fry ¾ cup peanuts on low flame. Step 2: Once the peanuts turn crunchy, keep them aside. Step 3: In the same oil, fry 2 tbsp cashew, 2 tbsp almonds, 2 tbsp dry coconut, few curry leaves, and 2 dried red chilli in batches. Step 4: Keep aside once they turn crunchy. Step 5: Keeping the flame on low, add 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp salt. Saute till the turmeric turns aromatic. Step 6: Now add 1 big bowl murmura and mix gently. Step 7: Fry for 3 minutes or until the murmura turns crunchy. Step 8: Transfer to the the large bowl, add 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp black salt, 1 tbsp powdered sugar, ½ tsp aamchur, and pinch hing. Step 9: Mix well making sure all the spices are well combined. Step 10: Add in fried nuts and mix well. Step 11: Finally, enjoy Murmura Chivda Recipe topped with chopped onions.

Ingredient Names: rice, fresh coconut, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, rinse and soak 1 cup of rice for 5 hours. I have used sona masuri rice. However, you can use idli rice or any short-grain rice. Step 2: Drain off the water and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 3: Add ½ cup of coconut and water as required to grind a smooth paste. Step 4: Transfer the rice batter to a large bowl. Step 5: Also, add 3 cups of water and 1 tsp of salt. Step 6: Mix well, making sure the batter is of a watery consistency. Step 7: Heat the dosa pan and spread oil, rub with onion to prevent sticking. Step 8: Now, carefully pour the dosa batter over the hot tawa. Step 9: Cover and cook for 1 minute on low to medium flame. Step 10: Once the dosa is cooked thoroughly, it is ready to serve. Do not cook neer dose on both sides. Step 11: Finally, fold the dosa and serve Neer Dose Recipe / Neer Dosa Recipe immediately with tomato chutney or coconut chutney.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, garlic, curry paste, basmati rice, vegetable stock, chickpeas, raisins, leaf spinach, cashew nuts, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan that has a lid, then fry the garlic and curry paste over a medium heat for 1 minute, until it's fragrant. Step 2: Tip the rice into the pan with the stock, chickpeas and raisins and stir with a fork to stop the rice from clumping. Season with salt and pepper, then cover and bring to the boil. Reduce to a medium heat and cook for 12-15 minutes or until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Step 3: Squeeze the excess water from the spinach with your hands. Tip it into the pan along with 2 tbsp of hot water and fluff up the rice with a fork, making sure the spinach is mixed in well. Toss in the cashews. Serve drizzled with natural yogurt if you like.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, sunflower oil, onions, garlic, thumb-sized ginger, cinnamon, cardamom pods cracked, curry powder, peas, sweetcorn, almonds, stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Rinse and soak the rice for 10 mins. Heat a large, ovenproof saucepan. Add the oil, then the onion, garlic and ginger. Cook on a low heat until the onion is soft. Add the cloves, cinnamon and cardamom pods and cook for a further 2 mins on a low heat. Add the curry powder and cook for a further 2 mins, then stir. Step 2: Drain the rice and add it to the saucepan. Stir so that the rice is coated in the oil and spices. Add the peas, sweetcorn and half the flaked almonds, if using. Pour over the stock and stir. Step 3: Cover the pan with a lid or with a sheet of foil, then cook in the oven for 15-20 mins. Remove from the oven, scatter with the remaining almonds, if using, and serve.

Dish Name: Paneer Fried Rice Recipe with Secret Sauce - Street Style
Ingredient Names: oil, cube paneer, chili, garlic, onions, beans, fresh carrot, capsicum, chili sauce, schezwan sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, pepper powder, salt, cabbage, rice, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large wok heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 20 cubes paneer. Step 2: Fry until the paneer turns golden brown, keep aside. Step 3: In the same oil, add 2 chilli, 2 cloves garlic and fry on high flame. Step 4: Now add ½ onion, 5 beans, 1 carrot, ½ capsicum and fry on high flame. Step 5: Fry until the vegetables turn crunchy. Step 6: Keeping the flame on high, add 2 tsp chilli sauce, 2 tsp schezwan sauce, 2 tsp vinegar, 2 tsp soy sauce, ½ tsp pepper powder and 1 tsp salt. Step 7: Stir fry on high flame until the sauces are well combined. Step 8: Add in fried paneer, 3 tbsp cabbage and mix well until the sauce is coated well. Step 9: Now add 4 cups of cooked rice and mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Finally, add 2 tbsp spring onion and enjoy Paneer Fried Rice.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, vegetable oil, cumin seeds, onions, green chilies split, bay leaves, vegetable stock, peas
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice, then soak in enough cold water to cover for 15 mins. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan with a lid, add the cumin seeds and cloves, then fry until fragrant. Stir in the onions, then reduce the heat and cook with the lid on for 10 mins, stirring occasionally or until soft. Add the chillies and bay leaves, then increase the heat and fry until the onions are golden. Step 2: Drain the rice, then add it to the onions and spices, stirring to coat the grains with oil. Cover the rice with stock and bring to a simmer. Scatter the frozen peas on top, put the lid on, then cook on a very low heat for 12-15 mins – don’t be tempted to remove the lid. Step 3: Turn the heat off and leave, with the lid on, for another 5 mins. Lightly fluff up the rice with a fork before serving.

Ingredient Names: onions, vegetable oil, turmeric, basmati rice, vegetable stock, green onions, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in the oil in a large frying pan or saucepan until softened. Stir in the turmeric, then the rice, and keep stirring until the grains are golden. Step 2: Pour in the hot stock, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and cook for 15 mins until the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and stir through the spring onions, pistachios and some seasoning before serving hot, or allowing to cool.

Ingredient Names: saffron strands, onions, butter, garlic, ginger, chili powder, ground cardamom seeds, nutmeg, cinnamon, bay leaves, blades mace, garam masala, green chili, limes, pumpkin, greek yogurt, basmati rice, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the saffron strands in 4 tbsp hot water and leave on one side for about 30 mins until the liquid turns a deep auburn. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Soften the onions in 100g of the butter for 10-15 mins in a covered pan. Give them a stir now and again to stop them catching. Put the garlic and ginger in a small food processor with 3 tbsp water and blend to a paste. Add to the onions and fry for 2-3 mins. Stir in the spices, green chilli and lime juice. Step 3: Cut the top off the pumpkins and scrape out any seeds, leaving the flesh and skin intact. Transfer to a roasting tin and spoon the spiced onion mixture into the cavity of each pumpkin. Step 4: Put the lids back on the pumpkinscover with foil, and bake for about 1 hr 15 mins – until the flesh is tender when pierced with a knife. Leave to cool slightly. Turn oven down to 160C/140C fan/ gas 2. Scoop the filling and most of the pumpkin flesh into a pan, leaving a thin layer of flesh inside the skin. Stir in the Greek yogurt. Step 5: Wash the rice, then soak for 15 mins in enough cold water to cover. Drain, then partially cook the rice in a pan of fast-boiling water for 4-5 mins – it should still have bite to it. Drain in a colander. Step 6: Warm the spiced pumpkin mixture and layer it inside the pumpkin shells with most of the rice and a scattering of mint leaves. Finish with a layer of rice on top. Dot the top of the rice with the remaining 75g butter and drizzle each pumpkin with the saffron and soaking liquid. Step 7: Pour water into the base of the roasting tin to about 1cm depth. Put the lids on the pumpkins and cover with wet greaseproof paper, then seal the tin with foil. Bake for 1 hr – the rice should now be perfumed and perfectly cooked. Place the pumpkins on a serving plate, gently fluff up the rice with a fork and serve straight from the shells.

Dish Name: Quinoa rice pilau with dill & roasted tomatoes
Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, olive oil, onions, celery, cumin seeds, garlic, basmati rice, quinoa, fresh dill, chicken, pine nuts, white fish
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Put the tomatoes on a baking sheet and drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil and some seasoning. Roast for 15 mins, remove and set aside. Step 2: Heat the remaining olive oil in a large pan. Add the onion, celery, cumin and garlic, then season to taste. Fry on a medium heat for 10 mins until golden. Add the rice, quinoa, dill and stock. Cover with a lid and cook for 12-15 mins or until the rice is soft. Add the tomatoes and pine nuts, and gently stir through. Serve with white fish or a green salad.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, ragi flour, rava semolina, cumin, salt, water, onions, fresh carrot, chili, curry leaves, fresh coriander, ginger, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take 1 cup rice flour, ½ cup ragi flour, and ¼ cup rava. Step 2: Also, add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt and 3 cup water. Step 3: Whisk and mix well making sure there are no lumps. Step 4: Now add ½ onion, ½ carrot, 2 chilli, few curry leaves, 2 tbsp coriander and 1 inch ginger. Step 5: Also, add 1 cup water and mix well adjusting the consistency. Step 6: When the pan is super hot, pour the batter on the pan. Step 7: Spread 1 tsp oil and roast for 2 minutes or until the dosa turns crisp. Step 8: Finally, enjoy the Crispy Ragi Dosa Recipe with chutney, notes:. Step 9: Firstly, adjust the consistency of the batter by adding water as required. If the batter is thick, then the dosa will be soft. Step 10: Also, the chutney tastes great when prepared spicy. Step 11: Additionally, you can add maida for the batter to help with binding. Step 12: Finally, the crispy Crispy Ragi Dosa Recipe tastes great when served hot with spicy chutney.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, mixed herbs, chili flakes, rice, salt, pepper powder, fresh coriander, oil, fresh carrot, capsicum, onions, brocolli, sweet corn, paneer, all-purpose flour, milk, schzewan sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, heat 1 tbsp butter in a pan. Add 4 cloves of garlic, 1 tsp mixed herbs, and ½ tsp chilli flakes. Step 2: Saute till the spices turn aromatic. Step 3: Add in 2 cup cooked rice, ½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper powder and mix well. Step 4: Also, add 2 tbsp of coriander and mix well. Herb Rice is ready to serve. Step 5: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tsp oil. Add carrot, capsicum, onion, broccoli, sweet corn and paneer. Step 6: Sprinkle chilli flakes, salt and mixed herbs. Step 7: Stir-fry till the vegetables turn crunchy. Keep the vegetables and paneer aside. Step 8: To prepare the sauce, heat 1 tsp butter and saute 1 tsp maida till it turns aromatic. Step 9: Add in 1 cup of milk and mix well, making sure the sauce thickens slightly. Step 10: Further add 2 tsp schzewan sauce and cook till the sauce turns creamy. Step 11: Add in stir-fried vegetables and mix well. Step 12: In a bowl, serve a small bowl of rice. Step 13: Also add saucy stir-fried vegetables and fried paneer. Step 14: Finally, enjoy the Vegetable Rice Bowl Recipe.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, butter, vegetables, turmeric, garlic, ginger, ground cumin ground cardamom, curry leaves, long red chilies, saffron strands
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the rice to the boil in 2 litres of water and allow to cook for 7 mins. Rinse the rice in a colander with cold water. Leave to drain for 5 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, put half the butter and the oil into a saucepan. Bring to a medium heat and add the rest of the ingredients, except the rice and the saffron. Slowly fry until fragrant, then stir in the drained rice. Using the end of a wooden spoon to make holes in the rice to allow the steam to rise. Dot the remaining butter on top of the rice and scatter over the saffron. Put the lid back on the pan, and cover with a tea towel to seal the steaming process. Turn off the heat and leave to steam for 30 mins – this makes the rice fluffy and separated without drying it out.

Ingredient Names: onions, bay leaf, cardamom pods, cinnamon, butter, turmeric, curry paste, basmati rice, raisins, chicken stock, almonds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onions, bay and whole spices in the butter for 10 mins. Sprinkle in the turmeric, then add the curry paste and cook until aromatic. Add the rice and the raisins, stir and cook for a good few mins, then add the stock and bring to the boil. Cover with a tight-fitting lid and when really boiling lower the heat and cook for 10 mins. Turn the heat off but don’t lift the lid and leave to sit for 20 mins. Step 2: Stir in half the almonds and coriander, with the rest of the coriander and the almonds thrown over the top.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, olive oil, onions, ginger, garlic, green chili, cumin mustard seeds, black-eyed bean peas, bay leaves, cinnamon, turmeric, pumpkin seeds plain
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice several times in cold water until the water runs clear. Drain well. Heat the oil in a large pan, add the onion and ginger and fry for 5 mins until the onion is lightly coloured. Stir in the garlic, chilli, cumin and mustard seeds, and fry for 1 min. Step 2: Tip the rice and beans into the pan and mix well. Add 600ml water, the bay, cinnamon stick, turmeric and a little salt. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and gently cook for about 15 mins until the rice is tender. Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and serve with a tomato salad or Tomato cooler.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, fresh carrots, basmati rice, red lentils, korma paste, cauliflower, peas, cashew nuts, yogurt, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and carrots, then fry for 5 mins until lightly coloured. Stir in the rice and lentils, cook for 1 more min, add the curry paste and 900ml water, then bring to the boil. Cover, then simmer for 10 mins. Step 2: Stir in the cauliflower, then cook for 10 mins more until the rice and lentils are tender. Add the peas 2 mins before cooking time is up, stirring through. Top with the nuts, then serve with yogurt and mango chutney in bowls.
