Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, ground lamb, fluid beef stock, basmati rice, spinach, sultanas, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a LARGE pan, add the onion and fry for 3- 4 minutes until softened. Step 2: Add the garlic and spices and fry for another 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the minced beef and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until all the meat has browned. Step 4: Add the stock and bring to the boil. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 40 minutes until all the meat is tender. Step 6: MEANWHILE cook the rice in a pan of boiling water for 10- 12 minutes until just tender. Step 7: Add the spinach to the rice and cook for just 30 seconds. Step 8: Drain well and stir rice and spinach mixture into the minced beef mixture, together with the sultanas and almonds. Step 9: Transfer the mixture to a warmed serving dish and serve with naan breads.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, garam masala, peas, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice following pack instructions. Step 2: Drain rice and return to pan, stir in the garam masala and cook for 1 min over a low heat. Stir in the peas, flaked almonds and seasoning. Cook for 2-3 mins more, then serve.

Dish Name: Taste of Heaven - Mushroom and Carrots Biryani
Ingredient Names: button mushrooms, basmati rice, fresh carrot, onions, ginger, garlic, fresh cilantro, mint leaves, tomatoes, bay leaf, cayenne pepper, green cardamoms, black cardamom pods, cinnamon, salt, oil, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, plain yogurt, skim milk, curry powder, cumin powder, sugar, kewra essence, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Cut mushrooms into quarters and keep aside. Step 2: Chop the carrot into 1/2 inch pieces and keep aside. Step 3: Soak rice in 4 cups of water. Step 4: Keep aside for 30 minutes. Step 5: Drain and keep aside. Step 6: Slice onions and keep aside. Step 7: Grind together the ginger and garlic, adding water as required, to get a fine paste. Step 8: Wash and finely chop coriander and mint leaves. Step 9: Puree the chopped tomatoes in a blender. Step 10: Whisk the yoghurt and keep aside. Step 11: Soak saffron in 1/4 cup warm skimmed milk and keep aside. Step 12: Boil 4 cups of water in a thick-bottomed vessel. Step 13: Add bay leaf, cloves, green cardamoms, black cardamoms, cinnamon, sugar and 1 teaspoons, salt. Step 14: Add rice when the water starts boiling rapidly. Step 15: Cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, or until the rice is 3/4ths done. Step 16: Drain in a colander. Step 17: Heat oil in a non-stick pan, add onions. Step 18: Stir-fry over high flame for 3 minutes or until the onions turn translucent. Step 19: Add ginger-garlic paste and cook briefly. Step 20: Add red chili powder, coriander powder, cayenne pepper, cumin powder and turmeric powder, stir-fry briefly. Step 21: Add the pureed tomatoes. Step 22: Cook over high flame for another 3 minutes, stirring continuously or until the masala is very thick. Step 23: Add the whisked yoghurt, garam masala powder and half the quantity of chopped fresh coriander and mint leaves, stir well. Step 24: Cook for 2 more minutes. Step 25: Add mushrooms, carrots and salt to taste. Step 26: Stir-fry over high flame for 3 minutes, remove from heat. Step 27: Arrange the cooked rice and mushroom masala in alternate layers in an oven-proof dish or biryani vessel. Step 28: Sprinkle chopped fresh coriander and mint leaves, kewra water and the skimmed milk with saffron on top. Step 29: Ensure that the topmost layer is of rice. Step 30: Cover the biryani with a tight-fitting lid. Step 31: Seal the edges with kneaded atta (flour) dough (if required). Step 32: Place the dish on a flat bottomed pan. Step 33: Cook on low flame for 10 minutes. Step 34: Place a few burning charcoals on the lid. Step 35: Alternatively, cook in a pre-heated oven at 180C for 10 minutes. Step 36: Break open the seal. Step 37: Grab a spoon and serve this biryani immediately. Step 38: ENJOY this with a raita of your choice. Step 39: I like it with a cucumber raita.

Ingredient Names: oil, butter, cumin, onions, ginger garlic paste, capsicum, peas, fresh carrot, tomato, turmeric, chili powder, pav bhaji masala, salt, water, potato, fresh coriander, rice, chili, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp butter and splutter 1 tsp cumin. Step 2: Add ½ onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute until onion softens. Step 3: Now add ½ capsicum, 3 tbsp peas, 1 carrot, 2 tomato and stir fry until the vegetables turn crunchy. Step 4: Keeping the flame on low, add ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 3 tsp pav bhaji masala and 1 tsp salt. Step 5: Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 6: Also, add 2 tbsp water and cook until all the masala are cooked well. Step 7: Add in 1 potato, 2 tbsp coriander and mix until the masala is coated well. Step 8: Further, add 5 cup cooked rice and mix gently. Step 9: Now add 2 chilli, 2 tbsp coriander and ½ lemon. Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Finally, enjoy Tawa Pulao Recipe with raita.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, urad dal flour, salt, cumin, asafoetida, butter, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large parath take 2 cup rice flour, ½ cup urad dal flour, 1 tsp salt, ½ tbsp cumin, pinch hing and 2 tbsp melted butter. Step 2: Crumble and mix well, making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Add water slowly and start to knead the dough. Step 4: Knead to smooth and soft dough adding water as required. Step 5: Now take 5-hole plate and fix it to the chakli maker. Step 6: Grease the chakli maker with some oil. This prevents the dough from sticking to the mould. Step 7: Furthermore, make a cylindrical shape out of dough and place the dough inside the maker. Step 8: Tighten the lid and start pressing to spiral shapes. Step 9: Drop the chakli into the hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 10: Flip the murukku and fry on medium flame till they turn crispy from both sides. Step 11: Furthermore, drain over to remove excess oil. Step 12: Finally, once cooled, enjoy Instant Thenkuzhal Murukku or store in an airtight container for 2 weeks.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, olive oil, cumin seeds, black mustard seeds, onions, just under turmeric, red
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly rinse the rice until the water looks completely clear. Drain, then tip into a large pan of salted water. Bring to the boil and cook for 6 mins until just tender, but check after 5 mins. Drain well, cool and chill. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large wok and fry the spices until they start to pop. Add the onions, then cook, stirring frequently, until the onions are tender and golden. Stir in the turmeric and chilli, and cook for 1-2 mins more. Cool. Step 3: TO BARBECUE: Heat the wok over the coals and, when the onions are sizzling, add the rice and cook, turning until heated through. If the embers are starting to die down a bit, cover the wok with a lid or the wok with a lid or foil to keep in the heat.

Ingredient Names: fresh coriander, mint pudina, ginger, garlic, chili, pod cardamom, cinnamon, fennel saunf, water, ghee clarified butter, cumin, bay leaf, pepper, cashews, onions, tomato, beans, capsicum, peas, fresh carrot, potato, salt, basmati rice, curds, cucumbers, cumin powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a small mixi take ½ cup coriander, ¼ cup mint, 1 inch ginger, 2 clove garlic, 2 chilli, 2 pod cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon, 5 cloves and 1 tsp fennel. Step 2: Add ¼ cup water and blend smooth paste. keep aside. Step 3: Ina large kadai, heat 2 tbsp ghee. add 1 tsp cumin, 1 bay leaf, 1 inch cinnamon, 2 pod cardamom, 3 cloves, ½ tsp pepper and 5 cashew. Step 4: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 5: Now add ½ onion and saute until the colour changes slightly. Step 6: Further, add 1 tomato and saute until the tomatoes turn soft and mushy. Step 7: Additionally, add 5 beans, ½ capsicum, 2 tbsp peas, ½ carrot and ½ potato. Step 8: Saute for a minute until the vegetables turn aromatic. Step 9: Now add prepared coriander pudina masala paste and 1 tsp salt. mix well. Step 10: Further, add 2 cup water and stir well getting to a boil. Step 11: Once the water comes to a rolling boil, add 1 cup basmati rice. make sure to soak basmati rice for 20 minutes. Step 12: Mix well, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 13: After 20 minutes, veg pulao is ready to serve. Step 14: Firstly, in a large bowl, take 1 cup curd and whisk with 1 cup water. Step 15: Add ½ onion, ½ tomato, ½ cucumber, 2 tbsp coriander, ½ tsp roasted cumin powder and ¼ tsp salt. mix well. Step 16: Finally, onion tomato raita is ready to enjoy with mix veg pulao.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, sunflower oil, onions, ginger to make, garlic, tomatoes, red chili powder, ground turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom pods, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, star anise, bay leaves, greek yogurt, potatoes, fresh carrots, peas, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice thoroughly in cold, running water, then leave to soak in a bowlful of water for 1 hr. Once soaked, drain, then cook in plenty of boiling salted water for about 8 mins until 90 per cent cooked. Drain again and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large pan, add the onions and fry until golden brown. Lift out half the onions with a slotted spoon and set aside. Continue frying the rest of the onions at a high heat until really crisp, then lift these out with a slotted spoon. Drain on kitchen paper, sprinkle with a little salt and set aside until ready to serve. Step 3: Return the first reserved batch of onions to the pan. Fry with the ginger and garlic for 1 min, then stir in the tomatoes, all the spices, the bay, yogurt and some salt. Cook for a few mins until the oil separates out, then add the potatoes and carrots with 400ml water. Gently cook for 20-30 mins or until the veg are almost cooked and saucy (splash in more water if the sauce gets too thick). Turn off the heat and stir in the peas. Step 4: Spread half the cooked rice over the bottom of a large casserole dish. Spread the saucy vegetables on top, sprinkle with the chopped coriander, then evenly cover with the remaining rice. Dampen a clean, thick tea towel, lay it over the casserole and put on the lid. Set it over a very low heat and cook for about 30 mins. Spoon into a large shallow dish to serve, gently mixing the vegetables and rice as you go, then scatter over the crispy onions.

Ingredient Names: rice, moong dal, masoor dal, black urad dal, horse, almond badam, wheat, water
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 cup rice and rinse with enough water. Step 2: Drain off the water and spread on clean kitchen towel. Step 3: Allow it to dry for 30 minutes. you can sun dry to hasten the process. Step 4: In another bowl, take 2 tbsp moong dal, 2 tbsp masoor dal, 2 tbsp black urad dal, 2 tbsp horse gram and 7 almond. Step 5: Rinse with enough water to get rid of dust and impurities. Step 6: Drain off the water and spread on clean kitchen towel. Step 7: Allow it to dry for 30 minutes. Step 8: Now take dried rice and roast on low flame. Step 9: Roast until the rice turns fully dry. it takes 10 minutes, to dry completely on low flame. Step 10: Cool completely, and transfer to the plate. Step 11: Once the lentil is dried completely, transfer to the pan and start to roast. Step 12: Roast on low flame until it dries completely. Step 13: Cool completely, and transfer to the plate. Step 14: Now take the mixture to a blender and blend to a fine powder. Step 15: Sieve the powder using a fine mesh to prevent any grains. Step 16: Store the homemade cerelac mixture in an airtight container and use it up to a month. Step 17: Firstly, take 1 tbsp of mixture in a clean saucepan. Step 18: Add 2 cup of water and start to whisk making sure there are no lumps. Step 19: Now place the pan on low flame and stir continuously. Step 20: Cook for 10-12 minutes or until the mixture thickens and cooked completely. Step 21: Finally, serve the baby food prepared from homemade cerelac for 6 months above babies.

Ingredient Names: sabudana sago, buttermilk, salt, chili, ginger, rice flour, peanuts, fresh coriander, curry leaves, dry coconut, cumin, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 cup sabudana and rinse well with water. Step 2: Drain off the water and add 1 cup buttermilk. Step 3: Also, add ¾ tsp salt, 2 chilli, 1 inch ginger and mix well. Step 4: Cover and rest for 8 hours or until sabudana turn soft. Step 5: After 8 hours, the sago will absorb all the buttermilk and turns non-sticky. Step 6: Now add ¾ cup rice flour, 2 tbsp peanut, 2 tbsp coriander, 2 tbsp curry leaves, 2 tbsp dry coconut and 1 tsp cumin. Step 7: Squeeze and mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 8: Further, add 2 tbsp water and mix well. Step 9: Form a soft dough adding water if required. Step 10: Now grease the hand with oil and pinch a ball sized dough. Step 11: Deep fry in hot oil keeping the flame on medium. Step 12: Stir occasionally, and fry on medium flame until the bonda turns golden brown and crisp. Step 13: Finally, drain off the sabudana bonda and enjoy with peanut chutney.

Ingredient Names: sama rice samo rice moriyo samvat barnyard millet, water, ghee clarified butter, cumin jeera, pods cardamom, pepper, ginger, chili, potato, fresh carrot, sendha namak rock salt, pepper powder, peanuts, almonds, cashews, dry coconut, makhana fox nuts, lemon juice, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl soak 1 cup sama rice for 20 minutes. Step 2: In a large kadai heat 1 tbsp ghee, add 1 tsp cumin, 3 pods cardamom and ½ tsp pepper. saute slightly. Step 3: Now add 1 inch ginger, 2 chilli and saute well. Step 4: Add ½ potato, ½ carrot and saute for 3 minutes or until they are half cooked. Step 5: Further add soaked sama rice. make sure to drain off the water completely. Step 6: Pour in 2 cup water, ½ tsp sendha namak, ½ tsp pepper powder and mix well. Step 7: Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the sama rice is cooked completely. Step 8: Now in a pan heat ½ tbsp ghee, add 2 tbsp peanut, 5 almond, 10 cashew, 2 tbsp dry coconut, ½ cup makhana. Step 9: Roast on low flame until they turn crunchy and golden brown. Step 10: Transfer the roasted nuts over pulao. Step 11: Add 1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp coriander. mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 12: Finally, enjoy sama ke chawal pulao with curd.

Dish Name: Bollywood Potato Salad Pink Potato Salad
Ingredient Names: potatoes, beets, red onion, garlic clove, gherkin, hard-boiled eggs, greek yogurt, mayonnaise, red wine vinegar, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the potatoes roughly into chunks. Step 2: Grate the beets into the potatoes on the large holes of a standard box grater. Step 3: Add onion, garlic, gherkins and hard-boiled eggs. Step 4: In a small bowl whisk together yoghurt, mayo, red wine vinegar and curry powder. Step 5: Pour over chopped veg in a large bowl and combine gently with a spatula to evenly coat all veg with the dressing and get the hot-pink colour of the beets everywhere. Step 6: Refrigerate for an hour before serving to blend flavours.

Dish Name: Cabbage and Carrot Thoran-style Salad (Indian Salad)
Ingredient Names: coconut oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seeds, eschalots, onions, garlic, green chili, curry leaves, turmeric powder, desiccated coconut, water, salt, red cabbage, fresh carrots, coriander cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Melt oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium high heat. Step 2: Add black mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds – they will pop and sizzle. Step 3: Add cumin seeds and cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add eschalot and onion, cook for 3 minutes until translucent but not coloured. Step 5: Add garlic and green chilli, cook for 2 minutes until softened but not golden. Step 6: Add turmeric and curry leaves, cook for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add coconut, water and salt. Cook until water mostly evaporates – about 3 minutes. Step 8: Place carrot and cabbage in a large bowl. Add hot coconut mixture. Toss well – the cabbage should wilt from the heat. Step 9: Taste and check if it needs more salt for your taste. Step 10: Toss through coriander. Serve warm or at room temperature. Best eaten on the day of making. See Note 7 regarding reheating/making ahead.

Ingredient Names: frozen corn, yogurt, sour cream, water, salt, oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, serrano chili, asafoetida, curry leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a serving bowl put the yogurt, sour cream, corn, water and salt to taste. Step 2: Add a little more water if the yogurt mixture is still too thick, stir until smooth. Step 3: In a small frying pan put the oil, mustard seeds, and cumin seeds. Step 4: Heat over high heat until the mustard seeds have popped for about 10 seconds. Step 5: Stir in the minced green chili pieces and cook until they soften. Step 6: Remove from heat and stir in the hing and curry leaves If desired, you can also add the corn here at the end rather than putting it in the yogurt right away. Step 7: Pour the seasonings into the yogurt and stir to blend. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, tomatoes, serrano chili, plain nonfat yogurt, of fresh mint, cumin seed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well Cover and chill for an hour.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, plain yogurt, cumin, paprika, black pepper, salt, lime juice, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Drain excess liquid from yoghurt by placing it in a mesh strainer or in cheesecloth for about half an hour 2 Roughly chop the cucumber with its seeds and skin. Step 2: Season with salt, black pepper, and lime juice, set aside 3. Step 3: Transfer the drained yoghurt to a large bowl. Step 4: Add cucumber mixture, cumin, and paprika, mix well.

Dish Name: Cucumber Raita Super Simple Quick And Easy
Ingredient Names: cucumber, salt, plain yogurt, chili powder, ground cumin, fresh ground pepper, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the grated cucumber well so that you squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Step 2: Add the yougurt, chili powder, ground cumin and salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Chill 30 minutes in refrigerator and stir well before serving. Step 4: Dust the single cucumber slice in paprika and garnish Goes well with poppadoms.

Ingredient Names: english cucumber, salt, yellow bell pepper, carrots, cherry tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, vegetable oil, rice vinegar, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place cucumber slices in a colander, add salt, toss. Step 2: Let stand over a bowl until juice has drained Pat cucumbers dry and put in large salad bowl. Step 3: Add remaining vegetables along with the cilantro and oil, toss. Step 4: Add vinegar and pepper, toss.

Dish Name: Curried Lentil Wild Rice And Orzo Salad
Ingredient Names: wild rice, green lentil, orzo pasta, currants, red onion, slivered almonds, white wine vinegar, ground cumin, dijon mustard, sugar, salt, ground coriander, turmeric, paprika, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the wild rice in a large, covered pot of boiling, salted water, for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add the lentils and boil for 20 minutes. Step 3: Add the orzo and boil for about 5 minutes, or until just tender. Step 4: Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Step 5: Add the currants and onions and set aside Dressing: whisk all ingredients together in a small bowl. Step 6: Pour over the rice mixture and toss gently. Step 7: Let the salad cool completely, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or better, over night. Step 8: Sprinkle on the almonds just before serving.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, sour cream, mango chutney, curry powder, salt, fresh ground pepper, turkey meat, scallions, celery ribs, roasted cashews, dried currant
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, mango chutney, curry powder, salt and pepper together in large mixing bowl. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Step 3: Serve salad at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: melon balls, navel oranges, salad greens, salad oil, limes, sugar, ground ginger, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put melon balls, oranges, and salad greens in a bowl Toss Combine remaining ingredients and pour over salad Toss Serve at once.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, chicken broth, extra virgin olive oil, low sodium soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, ground cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all of the ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid, and shake until well blended Use the dressing immediately, or refrigerate until ready to use.

Ingredient Names: carrot, salt, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, lemon juice, sultanas
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the sultanas in water for 2-3 hours. Step 2: Grate the carrots and put them in a bowl, mix in the salt. Step 3: Heat the oil and when hot, put in the mustard seeds. Step 4: When the mustard seeds begin to pop, pour the oil and seeds over the carrots. Step 5: Add lemon juice and sultanas and toss.

Dish Name: Indian mince with fresh tomato salad
Ingredient Names: red onions, ground beef, red lentils, beef stock, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, mini naan bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a non-stick frying pan, dry-fry onion and mince over a high heat for 2 mins, breaking up the mince as you go. Stir in the curry powder and lentils, pour in stock, then fiercely simmer for 10 mins. Step 2: While the mince is cooking, dice the tomatoes and roughly chop the coriander, then mix together in a small bowl. Put the naans briefly in a toaster to warm through, then pop one on each plate. Spoon a quarter of the mince over each naan, then top with a spoonful of the fresh tomato and coriander salad.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, sesame seeds, red chili powder, curry powder, coriander powder, black pepper, salt, sesame oil, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy bottomed skillet / pot Do not smoke the same. Step 2: Add sesame seeds and wait till they begin to crackle. Step 3: Lower the heat and add all the other spices. Step 4: Take care as not to burn the same Immediately add cubed potatoes and keep sauteeing and tossing on high heat for 5 minutes. Step 5: Let the potatoes go brown on the edges. Step 6: Transfer them to the serving bowl and garnish with fresh sprigs of parsley and coriander leaves Enjoy with the noodles, rice, pasta, salads and breads.

Ingredient Names: new potatoes, olive oil, lemons, black mustard seeds cumin seeds, green chili, finger-length ginger, turmeric, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the new potatoes for 15 mins until just slightly overcooked but still holding their shape. Step 2: While still warm, toss with all the other ingredients, season. Step 3: Can be made up to a day ahead and chilled, but take out of the fridge a good few hours before serving.

Dish Name: Low Cal Indian Yogurt And Spinach Salad
Ingredient Names: olive oil, black mustard seeds, green serrano chilies, garlic paste, spinach, yogurt, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a shallow frying pan, heat the oil. Step 2: When hot, add the mustard seeds and fry till they start crackling At this point add the chopped green chillies. Step 3: Now add the boiled spinach and saute till the oil seperates. Step 4: Let the mixture cool to room temperature. Step 5: In a separate bowl, beat the yogurt with the garlic paste and salt. Step 6: Now simply mix the spinach and voila, a yummy low cal salad is ready.

Ingredient Names: phool makhana, ghee, mustard, cumin, chana dal, urad dal, curry leaves, asafoetida, peanuts, raisins, cashews, almonds, turmeric, chili powder, aamchur, chaat masala, salt, tomato, onions, cucumbers, green chutney, tamarind chutney, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, dry roast 1½ cup phool makhana on low flame until it turns crunchy. Keep aside. Step 2: In a pan heat 2 tbsp ghee. add 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chana dal, 1 tsp urad dal, few curry leaves and pinch hing. Step 3: Splutter the tempering. Step 4: Also add 2 tbsp peanut, 2 tbsp raisins, 2 tbsp cashew and 2 tbsp almonds. Step 5: Roast on low flame until the nuts turn crunchy. Step 6: Further add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp aamchur, 1 tsp chaat masala and ¼ tsp salt. Step 7: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 8: Add in roasted makhana and mix well. Mix until the masala is coated well. Step 9: Finally, enjoy Makhana Bhel or store it in an airtight container. Step 10: Firstly, dry roast 1½ cup phool makhana on low flame until it turns crunchy. Keep aside. Step 11: In a bowl take ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp aamchur, 1 tsp chaat masala and ¼ tsp salt. Mix well. Step 12: Also add 2 tbsp tomato, 2 tbsp onion, 2 tbsp cucumber, 2 tbsp green chutney, and 2 tbsp tamarind chutney. Step 13: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 14: Furthermore, add roasted makhana and mix well. Step 15: Add 2 tbsp coriander, and 2 tbsp peanuts. mix well. Step 16: Finally, Makhana Chaat Recipe is ready to enjoy.

Ingredient Names: mango juice, flax seed oil, lemon juice, coriander powder, clove powder, salt & freshly ground black pepper, of fresh mint, red onion, baby tomatoes, mango, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the mango juice, oil, lemon juice, coriander, clove powder, salt, and pepper together in the bottom of a salad bowl. Step 2: Add the mint, onion, tomatoes, mango, and cilantro and toss well. Step 3: Taste the dressing and season again with salt, and pepper, if necessary. Step 4: Let the dressing sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: red onion, malt vinegar, salt, chili powder, coriander leaves, green chili
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and shred onion into thin slivers Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well Serve on the same day.

Ingredient Names: pineapple, red apple, cabbage, radishes, peas, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak shredded cabbage in salted water Drain Add grated pineapple and other ingredients and toss Serve with meat dishes.

Ingredient Names: lentils, water, fuji apple, yellow bell pepper, jalapeno pepper, flat leaf parsley, lemons, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, sesame oil, gingerroot, unsweetened coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Pick lentils over for any small stones. Step 2: Rinse and soak 2 hours in tepid water, drain. Step 3: Place lentils and water in a large saucepan, heat to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Cover and cook until lentils are tender, but still firm, 20-25 minutes. Step 6: Rinse the lentils with cold water, drain. Step 7: Mix together the lentils, apple, bell pepper, jalapeno, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar and salt in a large bowl.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seeds, spatchcooked poussin legs breast, tamarind paste, jaggery, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, green cardamom pods, ginger, green chili, chili powder, ground ginger, chaat masala
Instructions: Step 1: First make the tamarind glaze. Put all the ingredients except the ground ginger and chaat masala in a medium saucepan with 500ml water. Boil for 20 minutes, stirring frequently, until reduced by about half and slightly syrupy. Strain into a bowl to remove all the spices, stir in the ground ginger and chaat masala and leave to cool. Step 2: Pour half the glaze into a large bowl and set another 4 tbsp aside to serve (The rest will keep in the fridge for up to a month for a sauce or marinade.). Step 3: Whisk in the oil and cumin and add the poussin. Cover and marinate in the fridge for half an hour at least – overnight is ideal. Step 4: Preheat the oven to fan 180C/conventional 200C/gas 6. Lift the poussin pieces out of the marinade and lay on a roasting tray. Roast for 30 minutes, basting with the cooking juices and the leftover marinade every 5 minutes until the poussins are lacquered and sticky. Step 5: To serve, mix the reserved glaze with 1 tablespoon water and drizzle over the poussins on 4 plates. Serve with a mushroom risotto and poppadums.

Ingredient Names: tomato, fresh coconut, red chile, cumin, water, salt, buttermilk, ghee, ginger, chili, fenugreek leaves, curry leaves, mustard, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, place a large tomato on the flame directly. Step 2: Roast on medium flame flipping all over. Step 3: Cook making sure all sides are uniformly cooked. Step 4: Cool completely, and peel the skin of the tomato. Step 5: Now take the roasted tomato into the mixi. Step 6: Add ¼ cup coconut, 1 dried red chilli, 1 tsp cumin and ¼ cup water. Step 7: Blend to smooth paste. Step 8: Transfer the tomato masala paste into a large bowl. Step 9: Add ½ tsp salt and 1 cup buttermilk. mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Now prepare the tempering by heating 1 tsp ghee. Step 11: Splutter 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp cumin, few curry leaves, 1 dried red chilli and pinch hing. Step 12: Pour the tempering over the tambuli and mix well. Step 13: Finally, enjoy tomato raita or tomato tambuli with hot steamed rice. Step 14: Firstly, in a pan heat 1 tsp ghee. roast 2 inch ginger and 2 chilli. Step 15: Also, add 1 tsp cumin and roast until everything turns aromatic. Step 16: Cool completely and transfer to the mixi. Step 17: Add ¼ cup coconut and ¼ cup water. Step 18: Blend to smooth paste adding water as required. Step 19: Transfer the ginger masala paste into a large bowl. Step 20: Add ½ tsp salt and 1 cup buttermilk. mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 21: Pour the tempering over the tambuli and mix well. Step 22: Finally, enjoy ginger raita or shunti tambuli with hot steamed rice. Step 23: Firstly, heat 1 tsp ghee and add ½ tsp methi and 2 dried red chilli. Step 24: Roast until the methi turns aromatic. Step 25: Cool completely and transfer to the mixi. Step 26: Add ¼ cup coconut and ¼ cup water. Step 27: Blend to smooth paste adding water as required. Step 28: Transfer the methi masala paste into a large bowl. Step 29: Add ½ tsp salt and 1 cup buttermilk. mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 30: Pour the tempering over the tambuli and mix well. Step 31: Finally, enjoy methi raita or menthe tambuli with hot steamed rice. Step 32: Firstly, in a pan heat 1 tsp ghee. roast sprig curry leaves and 2 chilli. Step 33: Also, add 1 tsp cumin and roast until everything turns aromatic. Step 34: Cool completely and transfer to the mixi. Step 35: Add ¼ cup coconut and ¼ cup water. Step 36: Blend to smooth paste adding water as required. Step 37: Transfer the curry leaves masala paste into a large bowl. Step 38: Add ½ tsp salt and 1 cup buttermilk. mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 39: Pour the tempering over the tambuli and mix well. Step 40: Finally, enjoy curry leaves raita or curry leaves tambuli with hot steamed rice.

Dish Name: 3 Spice Fuss Free Fish Fillet Curry
Ingredient Names: fish fillets, onion, garlic, tomatoes, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil preferably in cast iron skillet and add onions and garlic Wait till they begin to turn brown. Step 2: Add tomatoes and all the spices. Step 3: Saute gently on medium heat till the oil comes out on the sides and curry is bright red. Step 4: Add fillet cubes and saute gently till pieces are well coated. Step 5: Add around 1 / 2 cup water and cook covered on medium heat for 10 minutes Fragrant, no fuss fish curry is ready!

Ingredient Names: butterfish, fresh lemon juice, turmeric powder, salt, fenugreek leaves, yogurt cheese, cream, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, dried fenugreek leaves, gram flour, egg yolks, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pat dry fish pieces on a clean paper towel. Step 2: In a bowl, combine together the fish, lemon juice, salt and turmeric powder. Step 3: Keep aside to marinate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Soak fenugreek leaves in salted water for 10 minutes. Step 5: Squeeze and drain out water. Step 6: Combine fresh fenugreek leaves, cream, labneh, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, kasoori methi, gramflour, egg yolks and fish, mix well. Step 7: Thread fish tikka pieces onto skewers Barbecue over a hot charcoal or electric grill. Step 8: When half done, baste fish tikkas with oil once and then cook until completely done.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, gram flour, garlic paste, ginger paste, ajwain, red chili powder, lemon juice, egg, yogurt, oil, salt, chaat masala
Instructions: Step 1: Clean, wash and cut fish into one and a half inch size cubes Apply salt, lime juice, ginger paste, garlic paste and red chili powder. Step 2: Keep aside for 20 minutes. Step 3: Make a batter of gram flour, yogurt, egg, ajwain, salt and water. Step 4: Keep the already marinated fish pieces dipped in this batter for 15 minutes. Step 5: Heat oil in a kadhai / wok and deep fry the fish till golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Serve hot sprinkled with chaat masala and lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: fish fillet, ajwain, chaat masala, raw rice, ginger, garlic, red chili powder, cumin powder, orange food coloring, black pepper, salt, lemon juice, green chilies, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice in water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Then, dry it on a clean paper napkin Grind the rice. Step 3: Keep aside Next make a paste of ginger, garlic, green chillies, salt, orange / red food colour and all the spice powders in your mixer To this, add the powdered rice with a little water, making a thick batter This is the marinade for the fish fillets. Step 4: Now, clean the fish and cut into pieces Rub lemon juice over these and keep aside for 30 minutes. Step 5: Put the fish pieces in the above prepared marinade.

Ingredient Names: imitation crabmeat, carrot, cucumber, scallion, peanuts, mayonnaise, soy sauce, rice vinegar, curry powder, granulated sugar, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients May be eaten as is, but tastes best chilled overnight.

Dish Name: Asian Spiced Salmon Kedgeree Nigella Lawson
Ingredient Names: cold water, limes, salmon fillets, unsalted butter, oil, onion, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, basmati rice, hard-boiled eggs, cilantro leaves, lime, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425f pour the water into a roasting pan, add the lime leaves and then the salmon. Step 2: Cover the pan with foil, put in the oven and cook for about 15 minutes, by which time the salmon should be tender. Step 3: Remove the pan from the oven and drain the liquid off into a pitcher. Step 4: Keep the fish warm simply by replacing the foil on the pan. Step 5: Melt the butter in a wide, heavy saucepan that has a tight-fitting lid, and add the oil to stop the butter burning Soften the onion in the pan and add the spices, then keep cooking till the onion is slightly translucent and suffused with soft perfume of the spices. Step 6: Add the rice and stir with a wooden spoon so that it's all well coated There's not enough onion to give a heavy coating: just make sure the rice is fragrantly slicked. Step 7: Pour in the reserved liquid from the pitcher, about 2 1 / 4 cups, and stir before covering with the lid and cooking gently for 15 minutes At the end of the cooking time, when the rice is tender and has lost all chalkiness, turn off the heat, remove the lid, cover the pan with a dish towel and then replace the lid.

Dish Name: Baked King Fish Cod In Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: kingfish, salt, chili powder, turmeric powder, vegetable oil, fennel seed, mustard seeds, onions, garlic, gingerroot, cumin powder, tomatoes, garam masala, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and dry the fish slices. Step 2: Marinate the fish with the salt, turmeric and chilli powder for 1 / 2 an hour. Step 3: Heat 2 tbslp oil over medium heat and when hot put in the fennel and mustard seeds as soon as the mustard seeds pop add the onions and garlic and ginger root saute until the onions are light brown. Step 4: Then add the 2 tsps of cumin and the green chilli. Step 5: Stir and then add the tomatoes, the rest of the cumin and the garam masala. Step 6: Boil and then simmer covered for 15 mins on low Pre heat oven to 180c heat a little more oil in a non stick and when hot put in the fish slices and just brown all the steaks on both sides. Step 7: Put the fish in a baking dish. Step 8: Now just pour the sauce over and bake uncovered for 15 mins or until the fish is cooked.

Dish Name: Baked Trout With Spicy Almond And Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: trout, lemon juice, tomato puree, ground almonds, ginger, garlic, tabasco sauce, garam masala, plain low-fat yogurt, coconut milk, coriander leaves, oil, bay leaf, black cardamom pods, cinnamon bark
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the fish under running water. Step 2: Sprinkle the fish with half the lemon juice and place in oven proof dish. Step 3: Preheat oven 190c / 375f / gas5. Step 4: In a bowl, mix together the tomato puree, ground almonds, ginger pulp, garlic pulp, tabasco sauce, garam masala, yoghurt, salt, cocnut milk, coriander and the remaining lemon juice. Step 5: Pour in 125ml / 4fl Oz water and blend everything together. Step 6: In a frying pan, heat the oil with the bay leaf, cardamoms and cinnamon for 30 seconds. Step 7: Pour the sauce mixture into this and bring to the boil. Step 8: Reduce the heat and cook for a further 1-2 minutes. Step 9: Pour over the trout and bake in oven for 15-20 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked fish with mint & mango relish
Ingredient Names: line-caught skinless cod fillets, green chili seeds, mango, ground cumin, finger-length ginger, mint leaves, mango chutney, limes, crustless stale white bread, garam masala, turmeric, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and put the fish fillets in a roasting tin. Combine the chopped chilli, mango, cumin, ginger, mint, mango chutney and lime juice. Spoon a quarter of the relish on top of each fillet and pat it down into an even layer with your fingers. Step 2: Put the bread in a food processor with the garam masala and turmeric and whizz to fine crumbs. Add the olive oil and give the processor one final pulse to mix everything together. Step 3: Spoon the crumbs over the relish-topped fillets. Cover the tin with foil and bake for 10 mins. Remove the foil and continue cooking for another 5 mins until the fish flakes easily and the crumbs have crisped on top. Serve with a green salad – see recipe, below.

Ingredient Names: halibut fillets, garlic paste, ginger paste, shallot, canola oil, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, ground fenugreek, coconut milk, salt, pepper, curry leaves, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Cut halibut into chunks and set aside. Step 2: Slice shallot thinly Gently fry shallot, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, or until the shallots are soft. Step 3: Add chilli powder, turmeric, garam marsala and funugreek and cook for a further 2 minutes. Step 4: Add coconut milk and heat till the coconut milk bubbles. Step 5: Add halibut chunks, curry leaves and salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Cook over a low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 7: Mix cornflour with a little water and add to the dish to thicken.

Dish Name: Bengali Chingri Malai Curry Shrimp Milk Curry
Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, turmeric powder, mustard oil, vegetable oil, onion, mustard seeds, clove, cinnamon sticks, bay leaf, cayenne pepper, coconut milk, fresh coriander leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Make a paste of turmeric, 1 tablespoon mustard oil, and salt Apply the mixture to the shrimp. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Step 3: Heat the remaining oil in a medium-sized saute pan over medium heat and saute the marinated shrimp for 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and keep aside. Step 5: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add mustard seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, and bay leaf. Step 7: Cook, stirring constantly until it is toasted and fragrant. Step 8: Add chopped onions and cook till it is translucent. Step 9: Add cayenne pepper and 1 / 2 cup water and cook until the oil separates.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, shallot, curry powder, red bell pepper, diced tomatoes, light coconut milk, fresh basil, fresh lemon juice, sugar, salt, reduced-sodium chicken broth, cooked rice, sweetened flaked coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Combine shrimp and flour in a bowl. Step 2: Toss well, and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Add shallots and curry powder, saute 1 minute, add bell pepper, saute 1 minute. Step 5: Add next 6 ingredients. Step 6: Bring to a simmer, and cook 2 minutes. Step 7: Add shrimp mixture. Step 8: Simmer 4 minutes or until shrimp are done.

Ingredient Names: bombay duck, garlic cloves, gingerroot, green chilies, red onions, cumin seed, green cardamoms, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, dried red chilies, mustard oil, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, pat dry and apply salt and turmeric to the fish pieces and keep aside for 15 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat mustard oil in a flat non-stick girdle or deep pan. Step 3: When smoking, add dried red chillies, whole spices, cumin seeds, let splutter, add sliced onion. Step 4: Cook for 2 minutes add ginger-garlic- green chilly paste / mix. Step 5: Fry well for 2 minutes in high flame. Step 6: Add the spice powders and 4 tbspn of water to cook the spices Move the spice mix to the side of the pan. Step 7: Add the fish pieces to the same pan, side by side.

Dish Name: Bombay Fish And Chips With Curried Coleslaw And Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, fresh lime juice, curry powder, green cabbage, carrots, green onions, dried currants, tabasco sauce, sweet potatoes, oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, mackerel fillet, lemons, ginger paste
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate mackerel fillets with lemon juice, ginger, garlic, salt, sambla oleck, orange color and egg. Step 2: Cut sweet potatoes into 1 / 4-inch thick sticks and allow to soak in water. Step 3: Mix shredded cabbage with carrots, currants, and green onions and season with salt pepper and lemon juice allow to sit for at least 15 minutes. Step 4: Squeeze the coleslaw to get the excess moisture out. Step 5: Mix in the mayonnaise, curry powder and tabasco sauce. Step 6: Mix cabbage with the mayo and refrigerate. Step 7: In a deep pan, heat oil for fries and crispy fry drained and patted sweet potato sticks Hold in warm oven till ready to serve. Step 8: In a skillet heat 2 tbsp oil Dredge each fillet of fish with gram flour and shallow fry till crisp on the out side and juicy on the inside.

Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic cloves, garam masala, ground cumin, ground turmeric, mustard powder, cayenne pepper, fresh lemon juice, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper, unsalted butter, fish fillets
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, mustard powder, cayenne pepper, lemon juice, 3 / 4 teaspoon salt, and a pinch of black pepper. Step 2: Stir in about 1 tablespoon warm water to form a very thick paste. Step 3: Brush a baking sheet or broiler pan with 1 tablespoon butter, place fish on top. Step 4: Cover fish on both sides with marinade. Step 5: Set aside for at least 15 minutes but no more than 30 minutes, preheat broiler. Step 6: Drizzle 2 tablespoons butter over fish Broil until nicely browned, 5 to 6 minutes. Step 7: Turn over steaks, and drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons butter.

Ingredient Names: fish fillet, clarified butter, onions, garlic paste, salt, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric, yogurt, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the sliced onions in the clarified butter till brown. Step 2: Drain and blend the onion to a paste. Step 3: Keep the ghee aside now saute the garlic paste in the same pan and keep aside. Step 4: After the ghee cools, stir in the onion paste, garlic and all the other ingredients and marinate for 2 hours Skewer the fish pcs and roast in a grill for 10 minutes. Step 5: Remove and baste with the butter and cook for another 5 minutes. Step 6: Remove from skewers and serve hot with lemon wedges and a yogurt and mint chutney.

Ingredient Names: large shelled prawn, onions, garlic cloves, ginger, chili powder, salt, turmeric powder, mustard seeds, coriander, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Deshell, devein, wash and drain prawns thoroughly. Step 2: Add half the chilli powder and 1 / 2 tsp of salt to the prawns, mix well and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 3: In a wok on medium flame add oil and heat a little. Step 4: Add mustard seeds and let it spatter. Step 5: Add onions, ginger and garlic paste, turmeric powder and fry till onions are golden brown. Step 6: Add the marinated prawns and stir. Step 7: Add the remaining chilli powder and salt, stir and place the lid on utensil. Step 8: Reduce flame to the minimum and let it cook, approximately 15 minutes Open lid and stir the prawns add the water and coriander leaves and stir again. Step 9: Check salt content.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, ginger, onions, garam masala, turmeric, ground coriander, garlic powder, coconut flakes, cornstarch, chili, coriander, salt, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange your fish in a baking greased baking mold. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients for the crust together. Step 3: Add some more water if necessary. Step 4: Press the crust ingredients on the fish, sprinkle with oil. Step 5: Bake 30 minutes at 180c. Step 6: Heat and timing are basing it on convection oven Enjoy!

Dish Name: Coconut Curry Shrimp with Basmati Rice
Ingredient Names: onions, red sweet bell pepper, gingerroot, garlic, lime zest, red pepper flakes, ground almonds, ground coriander, paprika, turmeric, black mustard seeds, vegetable oil, salt, coconut milk, lime juice, shrimps, basmati rice, water, almonds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the 3 cups water to a boil and add the rice. Step 2: Stir, return to a boil and cover, reducing heat to medium low-you want it simmering. Step 3: In a food processor or blender puree the onion, red pepper, ginger, garlic, lime zest, and pepper flakes. Step 4: Pulse a few times, scrape down and add the ground almonds, coriander, paprika and turmeric. Step 5: Blend into a paste. Step 6: In a large skillet toast the mustard seeds over medium high heat. Step 7: Skake the pan to prevent burning. Step 8: Remove from pan and pour into a bowl to cool, set aside. Step 9: Reduce heat to medium and add the oil. Step 10: Swirl a few times and add the paste, cooking for 10-12 minutes. Step 11: You want it a deep orange color and clumping together. Step 12: Add the mustard seeds, 1 cup of water and the salt, bring to a boil. Step 13: Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 14: Strain through a fine sieve into a bowl, pressing with a spatula to extract the liquid. Step 15: Rinse and dry skillet and return liquid to it. Step 16: Gently whisk in the coconut milk and lime juice until well blended. Step 17: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer and add the shrimp, stirring gently until shrimp turn pink, about 3-4 minutes. Step 18: Pour over cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: cinnamon bark, cumin seed, whole cloves, cardamom seed, onions, cumin, green chili, tomatoes, salt, coconut milk, vinegar, tiger shrimp, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: To make garam masala, roast cinnamon, cumin, cloves and cardamom in a pan until the colour changes Grind to a powder and save. Step 2: Heat onions, cumin, onions, chilies in saute pan. Step 3: Stir in tomatoes, salt. Step 4: Add coconut milk and vinegar and heat through, add prawns. Step 5: Saute till colour changes then stir in garam masala. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Coriander And Lemon Crusted Barramundi With Cucumber Mint Salsa
Ingredient Names: barramundi fillets, yogurt, coriander, lemon, cumin, turmeric, flaked sea salt, black pepper, butter, cucumber, fresh mint leaves, white wine vinegar, icing sugar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Fish: Mix the yoghurt, lemon zest, coriander leaves, coriander root, cumin, turmeric, a touch of salt and pepper and mix well. Step 2: Place the fish in the yoghurt marinade and massage well, place in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours Salsa: In a medium mixing bowl place the vinegar, sugar, olive oil and a touch of salt and pepper and mix well. Step 3: Add the vinegar mix to the cucumber and the chopped mint. Step 4: Toss it all together and set aside. Step 5: Preheat oven to 180 degrees. Step 6: In a non stick pan over hight heat sear the fish fillets in a little butter mixed with olive oil. Step 7: Once seared on both sides transfer the fish to the oven for approx 12 minutes.

Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, garlic cloves, coriander leaves, hot green peppers, whole cumin seed, chopped coconut, ground turmeric, lemon juice, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pat fish dry and set aside. Step 2: Make a paste of all the other ingredients Apply thickly on the fish on both sides Broil for 10 minutes on either side. Step 3: Serve very hot, straight from the oven.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillet, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, small onion, garlic cloves, ginger, hot green chili peppers, turmeric, tomato paste, water, salt and pepper, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a nonstick saucepan, add mustard seeds. Step 2: When mustard seeds start to splatter, add onion and whole green chilies. Step 3: Cook on a low flame until onions are golden brown. Step 4: Blend ginger and garlic with tomato paste and around 1 / 2 cup water until smooth. Step 5: Add to the pan with the spices and salt and cook on medium-high until oil starts to appear on the surface. Step 6: Lower heat as necessary as the mixture reduces. Step 7: Taste mixture and add seasoning as necessary. Step 8: Add some water, vinegar and coconut cream, and boil until creamy. Step 9: Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.

Ingredient Names: tiger shrimp, lemon juice, oil, onion, ground turmeric, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, bay leaves, gingerroot, garlic cloves, chili powder, creamed coconut, water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails intact. Step 2: Put them in a bowl, add the lemon juice, then toss together and leave the for 10 minutes. Step 3: Rinse the prawns under running cold water and pad dry with paper towels. Step 4: Heat the oil in a heavy based frying pan and fry the onion until lightly browned. Step 5: Add the turmeric, cinnamon, cloves cardamom, bay leaves, ginger and garlic, and fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Add the chili powder, creamed coconut or coconut milk, and salt, to taste, and simmer for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the prawns, return to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the prawns are cooked through and the sauce is thick.

Dish Name: Crispy Melt In Your Mouth Indian Shrimp
Ingredient Names: ginger, green serrano chilies, fresh cilantro leaves, shrimp, turmeric, salt, cream of rice, oil, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Place the ginger, chilies and cilantro in a food processor and process them until everything is finely minced, scraping down the bowl as needed. Step 2: Put the mixture into a small work bowl and add the shrimp. Step 3: Mix and stir well until the shrimp are well-coated. Step 4: Add the turmeric and mix, making sure the shrimp are again well-coated. Step 5: Cover or wrap and place in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 3 hours. Step 6: When ready to cook, remove the shrimp from the refrigerator, mix in the salt, and allow to stand for 10 minutes. Step 7: Put about 1 / 3 of the cream of rice in a medium-sized plastic bag. Step 8: Pour enough oil into a small, deep saucepan to cover 6 of the shrimp completely at one time and begin to heat the oil until hot enough to fry the shrimp While the oil is heating, put 6 shrimp into the plastic bag, close the bag, and toss to coat evenly with the cream of rice. Step 9: Place the shrimp on a slotted spoon and ease them into the hot oil.

Dish Name: Curried Cream Of Asparagus Soup With Crab
Ingredient Names: asparagus, onion, potato, surimi, chicken broth, milk, flour, butter, garlic powder, curry powder, ground cayenne pepper, ground black pepper, salt, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook asparagus, onion, and potato in a round covered casserole dish, with the chicken broth, in the microwave on high for 10 minutes. Step 2: When vegetables are tender, remove half of the potatoes and set them aside. Step 3: Put the vegetables in a blender and puree until smooth Alternately, put them in a pot and use a hand blender. Step 4: Put the puree in a pot on medium heat and whisk in 1 t flour. Step 5: Stir until smooth and soup begins to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low and add the remaining potatoes to the pot. Step 7: Stir in the butter, milk, garlic, curry, cayenne, black pepper, salt and worcestershire, and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add the crab and simmer for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: grouper, fresh lemon juice, salt, garlic cloves, ginger, coconut milk, ground coriander, ground cumin, brown sugar, black pepper, turmeric, cayenne pepper, jalapeno, onion, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lemon juice, 1 tsp salt, and fish:allow to marinate outside refrigerator for about 10 minutes Seed, core, and chop the tomatoes into cubes, slice onion, mince jalepenos. Step 2: Puree garlic, ginger, coconut milk, coriander, cumin, sugar, pepper, cayenne, and turmeric in a blender. Step 3: Heat oil and cook onion until golden: add tomato and cook 5 minute. Step 4: Add puree, jalepenos, water, and remaining 3 / 4 tsp salt and bring to a simmer. Step 5: Add fish and 1 tbsp of the marinade and simmer until fish is cooked.

Ingredient Names: boiling water, dried oysters, morel, porcini mushroom, leeks, flour, curry powder, skim milk, chicken bouillon cube, fresh portabella mushrooms, fresh shiitake mushrooms, dry sherry, fresh chervil
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the boiling water, the oysters and dried mushrooms in a bowl and set aside to soak. Step 2: Preheat a heavy stockpot over medium heat for about 1 minute, then spray it twice with the vegetable oil. Step 3: Add the leeks and saute for about 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until translucent. Step 4: Add the flour and curry powder. Step 5: Stir with a wooden spoon until the leeks are well coated. Step 6: Add the milk and bouillon cube. Step 7: Raise the heat to high and cook just until bubbles begin to form around the edge. Step 8: Lower the heat to low and whisk until all ingredients are thoroughly combined. Step 9: Stir in the fresh mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes. Step 10: Meanwhile remove the reconstituted mushrooms from their soaking liquid, strain, squeeze out excess moisture, and roughly chop.

Ingredient Names: pink salmon, instant oats, eggs, madras curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine salmon, oats, eggs and curry powder in a bowl, mix well. Step 2: Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions. Step 3: Shape each portion into a 8cm patty. Step 4: Heat a large non-stick pan and spray with cooking oil. Step 5: Add the salmon patties and cook for 3 minutes each side or until browned and cooked through. Step 6: Serve with minted yoghurt, if desired and vegetables.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, green chili, green onions, salt, mayonnaise, garam masala, paprika, shrimp, lettuce, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook cauliflower in lightly salted boiling water for 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Step 2: Drain and allow to cool In large bowl combine mayonnaise, garam masala, paprika, chilli and green onions. Step 3: Toss in the cauliflower and shrimp and stir until coated. Step 4: Chill until ready to serve. Step 5: Serve on a bed of torn lettuce leaves with cilantro leaves sprinkled over the top if desired.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, red onion, fresh ginger, curry powder, shrimp, fresh cilantro, cracked black pepper, salad greens, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a sprayed large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion, saute until soft. Step 3: Add ginger and curry, saute 1 minute, add shrimp. Step 4: Stir to incorporate Kill the heat and remove from heat source. Step 5: Stir in cilantro and season with black pepper. Step 6: Arrange salad greens on salad plates. Step 7: Divide shrimp mixture between 5.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, mild curry paste, plum tomatoes, whipping cream, fresh coriander, pickled ginger
Instructions: Step 1: If you're starting off with frozen shrimp, don't thaw them. Step 2: Place in a sieve and rinse under cold running water until the ice crystals are melted Pat shrimp dry with paper towels You can also use frozen cooked shrimp in this recipe as well, the recipe indicates the 2 different cooking methods No matter what kind of shrimp you start out with, cooked or raw, place peeled shrimp and curry paste in a bowl and, using your hands, rub shrimp with curry to evenly coat It is important that you've dried the shrimp well so the curry paste sticks Core tomatoes, slice in half, then squeeze out and discard juice and seeds Coarsely chop tomatoes and set aside If using raw shrimp: place a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and, when hot, add shrimp. Step 3: Stir-fry just until shrimp are a bright coral colour.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillet, yellow, desiccated coconut, juice lime, soy sauce, basmati rice, sweet chili sauce, red chile, thin-stemmed broccoli
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Tear off 4 large pieces of foil, double them up, then place a fish fillet in the middle of each. Spread over the curry paste. Divide the coconut, lime zest and juice, and soy between each fillet. Bring up the sides of the foil, then scrunch the edges and sides together to make 2 sealed parcels. Step 2: Put the parcels on a baking tray and bake for 10-15 mins. Tip the rice into a pan with plenty of water, and boil for 12-15 mins or until cooked. Drain well. Serve the fish on the rice, drizzle over the chilli sauce and scatter with sliced chilli. Serve with broccoli and lime wedges.

Dish Name: Dover Sole Fillets With Cashew Chutney
Ingredient Names: chopped tomato, roasted cashews, red onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, jalapenos, fresh cilantro, kosher salt, olive oil, sole fillets, ginger-garlic paste, ground turmeric, chili powder, roasted cumin
Instructions: Step 1: For the chutney, mix all ingredients and allow flavors to mingle for about 3 hours- if you are in a pinch, it's fine to marinate it for less time. Step 2: Rinse fillets and pat dry-- make sure they are not slippery at all. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 4: Put olive oil in the bottom of a baking dish, tilt to coat bottom. Step 5: Combine ginger garlic paste with turmeric, chili powder, cumin and salt and rub this all over the fillets on both sides. Step 6: Take each fillet and place about 3 tablespoons of chutney near the wide end and roll it up. Step 7: Place fillet rolls seam side down in the oiled dish. Step 8: Bake in preheated oven Fish are done when they flake with a fork, about 30 minutes Serves 4- 8, depending on the size of your fillets- we serve 2 per person.

Ingredient Names: ghee, onion, curry powder, red chili powder, cooked beef, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the ghee or oil in a pan and stir-fry the onion over moderate heat until crisp and light brown Do not burn. Step 2: Add the curry powder, chili, and the cooked meat or fish and mix well. Step 3: Add the salt and water and cook for 5 minutes as a rich, brown sauce develops. Step 4: Serve warm with rice.

Ingredient Names: butter, curry, onion, dried ginger, flour, chicken broth, milk, salt, sugar, lemon juice, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter with curry, onion, and ginger and cook until onion begins to soften. Step 2: Add the flour and stir to combine with butter. Step 3: Add the broth, milk, salt, sugar and lemon and stir to combine with flour. Step 4: Bring to a simmer and add the shrimp. Step 5: Simmer until the shrimp is cooked, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Easy Peasy Red Thai Salmon Curry
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, thai red curry paste, onion, coconut milk, salmon fillets, green beans, lime, salt, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil and thai curry paste in a large pan and heat through. Step 2: Add the onion and cook until softened. Step 3: Pour in the coconut milk and bring to the boil. Step 4: Add the salt and lime juice. Step 5: Taste - this is where you'll need to use your imagination if the curry paste wasn't as tasty as you'd hoped! Step 6: If necessary, add more ginger, spices etc as mentioned in the description above, or a can of thai red curry soup. Step 7: Reduce to a simmer and add the beans and salmon. Step 8: Simmer very gently for five minutes until the salmon is just cooked. Step 9: Mix in the coriander just before serving.

Dish Name: Exceptionally Savoury And Delicious Indian Fish Biryani
Ingredient Names: kingfish, basmati rice, onions, oil, nonfat plain yogurt, tomatoes, ginger-garlic paste, green chili paste, cinnamon, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, salt, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the fish with the ingredients mentioned under"marinating" for 30 minutes in a dish, keep aside, heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Toss in the sliced onion and stir-fry it until its brownish in colour. Step 3: Remove it from the oil Crush the fried onion and keep aside. Step 4: Fry the marinated fish in the remaining oil. Step 5: Pour the remaining oil in a pan. Step 6: Add the ginger and garlic pastes and green chilli paste. Step 7: Stir-fry for 2 minutes until the oil separates from the pastes.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, garlic paste, gingerroot, mustard seeds, bay leaves, coriander powder, shallots, red chilies, cumin seed, turmeric powder, salt, tomatoes, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a grinder grind the onions, ginger, 2 bay leaves, red chili, mustard seeds, cumin seed all together Preserve some cut pieces 1 cup) of onion. Step 2: Cut small pieces of tomatoes. Step 3: Make small pieces of fish fillets, about 3 inches in length Clean them properly if you are using the whole fish and make it into small pieces. Step 4: Take a big plate, put the fish in it and sprinkle 2 teaspoon of salt, two teaspoon of turmeric powder and the garlic paste. Step 5: Mix all of them properly. Step 6: Allow to marinate for 1 / 2 hour. Step 7: Take a pan or a wok, heat it and put oil to deep fry the fish. Step 8: Once the oil is much hotter, fry the fish, 3-4 pieces at a time, 3-4 minutes on each side.

Ingredient Names: kingfish, onions, ginger, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, turmeric powder, salt, chinese salt, potato, breadcrumbs, egg, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put a cup of water, turmeric powder and fish in a utensil. Step 2: Boil for 10 minutes. Step 3: Once boiled, remove the bones of the fish and keep the fish aside, take a pan. Step 4: Heat some oil in it. Step 5: Add ginger and saute till the raw smell is gone. Step 6: Add onions and saute till golden brown. Step 7: Add green chillies and stir-fry, add fish. Step 8: Add the mashed potato, coriander leaves, salt and chinese salt.

Ingredient Names: butterfish, tomatoes, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, red chilies, garlic cloves, turmeric powder, green chilies, coconut milk, lemon juice, curry leaves, ginger, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Julienne the onion. Step 2: Keep aside Clean the fish, remove the skin, and cut into 1 inch pieces. Step 3: Pour the oil into the pan, heat on medium. Step 4: Saute the onion and green chilies for five minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, crush the red chili with garlic with a mortar and pestle. Step 6: Add the crushed chili, garlic, and ginger. Step 7: Fry for ~3 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, add turmeric, cardamom, and cinnamon stick.

Dish Name: Fish Kebabs With Red Bell Pepper
Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, lime juice, fresh coriander leaves, garlic, ginger, red chilies, fish sauce, soya sauce, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Grind ginger, garlic, red chillies and coriander leaves to a fine paste. Step 2: Add the fish and soya sauce with lime juice. Step 3: Marinate fish in this mixture for 30 minutes in your refrigerator. Step 4: Thread the fish kebabs, alternating with one diced piece of red bell pepper, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: hamour fish, spring onions, salt, white pepper, dried lime powder, fresh coriander leaves, burghul
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mash the fish along with the spring onions, salt, pepper and powdered dried lime. Step 2: Add coriander leaves and mix well. Step 3: Now rub the burghul with the fish. Step 4: Mash well and mix with a spoon or fork. Step 5: Then shape the fish mixture into egg-shaped kibbehs. Step 6: Place the kibbehs in a shallow dish. Step 7: Bake in a pre-heated oven for 30 minutes or until cooked and well browned.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, whole cumin seed, cumin powder, garlic, salt, green chilies, turmeric powder, tomatoes, flour, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together cumin, cumin powder, garlic, salt and chillies. Step 2: Cut a slice across each piece of fish and fill slits with the spice mixture. Step 3: Dust each piece lightly with flour and then sprinkle with turmeric. Step 4: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Step 5: Add fish and fry for about two minutes on each side. Step 6: Fry the sliced tomatoes at the same time next to the fish. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: fish, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, black pepper, oil, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, onion, coconut milk, ginger, garlic, green chilies, curry leaves, water
Instructions: Step 1: Grind coriander, chilli and turmeric powders. Step 2: Mix the pepper powder with it, heat oil in a pot. Step 3: Add mustard seeds and allow to splutter. Step 4: Once they stop spluttering, add onion, ginger, garlic, green chillies and curry leaves. Step 5: Stir-fry until the raw smell of ginger and garlic is gone. Step 6: Add the ground masala and continue to stir-fry on low flame. Step 7: Pour the water into the sauteed masala, add tamarind. Step 8: When it boils, add the fish and mix well.

Dish Name: Fish Reshad Stuffed Fish Goan Style
Ingredient Names: mackerel, olive oil, lime, malt vinegar, onion, fresh coriander leaves, turmeric powder, red chilies, cloves, black pepper, cumin seed, garlic, fresh ginger, rice flour
Instructions: Step 1: Take a sharp knife and make a slit in the middle{a longitudinal slit} of the mackerel fish so that the fish opens as 2 equal halves This is done so that the masala can be stuffed inside the fish. Step 2: Now, de-bone the fish Likewise, repeat this for all the mackerels' Take a bowl and in it, put salt, lime juice, olive oil, turmeric powder and all the slit fishes. Step 3: Mix well so as to let the fish absorb all the ingredients. Step 4: Marinate for 15 minutes In your mixer / grinder / blender, grind together the cloves, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, red chillies, ginger, garlic, salt and vinegar. Step 5: Heat 4-5 tbsps Of oil in a skillet.

Ingredient Names: salmon, potatoes, onions, leeks, curry leaves, black pepper, turmeric powder, eggs, breadcrumbs, all-purpose flour, green chilies, salt, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsps Of oil in a pan. Step 2: Add onions, curry leaves, green chillies and leeks to it. Step 3: Mix well and cook for 5 minutes until the onions are golden brown. Step 4: Add salt, pepper and turmeric powders, mix well. Step 5: Add fish, mix well and remove from heat. Step 6: Add potatoes and mix well To make a pastry, mix the flour, a pinch of turmeric powder, salt to taste, one egg and water till you get a thick batter. Step 7: In a flat frying pan, prepare pancakes with this batter.

Ingredient Names: fish, red chili powder, turmeric powder, mustard oil, salt, sugar, green chilies, black mustard seeds, banana leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Add the chilli powder, turmeric, salt, sugar, mustard oil and green chillies to the fillets. Step 2: Mix well to coat evenly. Step 3: Marinate fish for 20-30 mins. Step 4: Now add the ground mustard and immediately wrap each fillet with a little extra marinade on top into individual pouches with the banana leaf. Step 5: Steam for 20 mins in a steamer Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: fresh gingerroot, water, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, black pepper, canola oil, onion, chicken broth, light coconut milk, fresh lemon juice, fish fillets, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 7 ingredients in a small bowl. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 teaspoon of black pepper, stirring until well blended. Step 3: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, add onion. Step 4: Cook 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add ginger mixture. Step 6: Cook 1 minute, stirring frequently, add broth, bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: limes, sunflower, onions, curry powder, tomato puree, greens, mango chutney, white fish fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop one of the lime quarters, including skin. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a medium saucepan then fry onions over a medium heat for 5 mins until softened and starting to colour. Add the curry powder and tomato purée then fry for another min. Tip in 200ml water, lentils, mango chutney and the chopped lime then bring to the boil. Simmer for 5 mins or until thickened. Step 2: Heat remaining oil in a frying pan. Season the fish with salt and pepper to taste then fry for 5 mins, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through. Add a squeeze of lime to the pan and to the lentils then serve together with naan bread or chapatis on the side.

Ingredient Names: lemons, boneless, vegetable oil, cinnamon, green cardamom pods, black peppercorns, curry leaves, onions, green chilies, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, turmeric, chili powder, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Stir the lemon juice and 1 tsp salt into the fish pieces and set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the whole spices and curry leaves, cook for 3-4 mins, then add the onions. Fry until the onions are soft, then add the chillies, ginger and garlic. Tip in the tomatoes and the remaining spices and cook, uncovered, on a low heat for about 5-8 mins. Stir frequently to prevent the spices sticking and burning. Step 2: Pour 150ml water into the pan, bring to a simmer, then add the fish. Cover with a lid and cook for 5 mins more. Serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, zucchini, cumin seeds, ginger, garlic, red chile, ground coriander, ground turmeric, tomato, vegetable stock, raw jumbo shrimp, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok and stir-fry the courgettes for 5-6 mins until softened. Lift from the pan with a slotted spoon, leaving the oil behind. Step 2: Add the cumin seeds to the pan and toast for a few secs, then add the ginger, garlic, chilli and spices. Cook, stirring for 1-2 mins, then tip in the tomatoes and cook for a few mins more. Step 3: Pour in the stock and simmer to make a pulpy sauce, then add the courgettes and prawns. Cook gently until the prawns change from grey to pink and the courgettes are tender, but not too soft. Stir in most of the coriander, saving some to sprinkle over the top. Serve with basmati rice and mango chutney, if you like.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, vine tomatoes, garlic, thumb-sized ginger, madras curry paste, coconut milk, fresh coriander, pollock fillets, flour, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan. Tip in the onions and a pinch of salt. Cook for about 8 mins until soft and golden. Step 2: Meanwhile, blitz the tomatoes, garlic and ginger in a food processor to a smooth purée. Add the curry paste to the onions and fry for 3 mins more. Stir in the tomato mix and simmer for 10 mins until thickened. Add the coconut milk and chopped coriander. Simmer again to thicken. Step 3: Dust the fish fillets in some seasoned flour. Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan. Cook the fillets, in batches, over a high heat for 1 min or so on each side, until they begin to brown. Carefully place fish in the tomato mixture and simmer until just cooked through. Scatter over coriander sprigs and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: kingfish, oil, onion, tomatoes, green chilies, curry leaves, turmeric powder, tamarind juice, salt, red chilies, coriander seed, cumin seed, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together all the ingredients listed under"masala" in a mixer / grinder / blender, using a little water, and make a paste, keep aside, heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Fry the onion in it till golden brown. Step 3: Add tomatoes and turmeric powder Continue to stir-fry for 3 minutes on medium flame. Step 4: Add the ground masala paste and curry leaves. Step 5: Fry on medium flame for another 3-5 minutes until the oil starts leaving the sides of the pan. Step 6: Add green chillies, tamarind juice, salt and a cup of water, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: paprika, ground turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, tamarind paste, salt, water, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, onion, garlic cloves, coconut milk, tiger shrimp, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all of the marinade ingredients to create a smooth paste. Step 2: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and add the mustard seeds. Step 3: When they start to pop, add the onion and garlic. Step 4: Cook for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Step 5: Stir in the spice paste. Step 6: Fry over a gentle heat for 4-5 minutes, until the spices are aromatic. Step 7: Stir in the coconut milk and prawns. Step 8: Simmer for 5-6 minutes, until the prawns are cooked through and the sauce has thickened. Step 9: Season to taste In the meantime, wash the rice in several changes of cold water, to get rid of any excess starch.

Ingredient Names: cumin seed, cloves, red pepper flakes, ground cinnamon, ground turmeric, black pepper, jalapeno peppers, garlic, fresh ginger, malt vinegar, olive oil, onion, roma tomato, medium shrimp, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In spice grinder or small food processor, combine cumin seed, cloves, red pepper flakes, ground cinnamon, turmeric and black pepper and grind until fine. Step 2: Combine spice mixture with jalapeno, garlic, ginger and malt vinegar and whisk into a paste. Step 3: Heat olive oil in saute pan. Step 4: Add onion and cook until it begins to turn golden brown. Step 5: Add roma tomatoes and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add spice paste and cook anothr 2 minutes. Step 7: Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are done, about 4 to 5 minutes, remove from heat. Step 8: Add salt and cilantro. Step 9: Serve immediately with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, curry leaves, shallots, garlic clove, ground turmeric, ground coriander, chili powder, coconut cream, white fish fillet, large shrimp, lime, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large skillet, over high heat, and cook the mustard seeds, while stirring, until they pop, about a minute. Step 2: Stir in curry leaves. Step 3: Add shallots and garlic, stir occasionally, until golden, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in turmeric, coriander, chili powder, and stir 30 seconds. Step 5: Stir in the coconut cream, bring to a boil, reduce heat and stir for 2 minutes. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low, add fish, and simmer, spooning the sauce over the fish to cook, about a minute. Step 7: Add shrimp and cook until fish flakes easily and shrimp turns pink, about 4 to 5 minutes. Step 8: Grate the peel from the lime and juice. Step 9: Add half the juice to the skillet, taste, and add more as needed. Step 10: Sprinkle with the lime peel and serve.

Dish Name: Goan prawn & coconut curry with cumin rice
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, ginger, garlic, red chile, turmeric, chili powder, ground coriander, curry leaves, potato, half-fat coconut milk, cherry tomatoes, baby spinach, raw shrimp, cumin seeds, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and fry the onion, ginger, garlic and chilli for 5 mins until starting to soften. Add the spices, curry leaves and potato, then cook for 1 min more. Stir in the coconut milk and tomatoes, cover and leave to simmer for 10 mins until the potato is tender. Step 2: Add the spinach and prawns. Cook for 1 min more until the spinach wilts and the prawns turn pink. Step 3: Meanwhile, make the rice. Tip the cumin into a pan and toast over a dry heat for 30 secs. Add the rice, salt to taste and 400ml water, then cover and cook for 8-10 mins until the rice is tender and the water has been absorbed. Serve with the curry.

Ingredient Names: prawns, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, fresh basil, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, black peppercorns, dried rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Shell and de-vein the prawns, making sure you keep the tail intact. Step 2: Wash well and keep aside. Step 3: Mix together the olive oil, lemon juice, salt, peppercorns, basil leaves and rosemary to prepare a marinade. Step 4: Thread prawns on satay sticks. Step 5: Marinate them in the above marinade. Step 6: Refrigerate for 30 minutes Pre-heat the barbecue. Step 7: Arrange the prawns on the hot barbecue and cook till done, heat oil in a pan. Step 8: Add the bell peppers and saute.

Ingredient Names: size crab, greek yogurt, red chili paste, cumin powder, garam masala, lemon juice, salt, cooking oil, ghee, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: First you need to clean the Crab. The best way to clean it is under running water. Step 2: * Take the Crab on a chopping board and place your left Palm over the shell of the Crab. Take a knife with your right hand and place it below the eye part of the Crab. Insert little and press upwards. The shell will come out. Step 3: * You can clean the shell and can use it for garnish the Crab when serving. Step 4: * Now you can see some yellowish color things on it. You have to remove all these except the white color substances, which is the meat of the Crab. Hold it on running water and it will get cleaned. Step 5: * Now using a knife cut the Crab into two parts and keep it aside. Step 6: * Make a Tandoori masala also known as tandoori red masala using all the above ingredients in a mixing bowl. Step 7: * Mix both the Crab part in the Tandoori masala properly and keep it aside for half an hour to absorb all the flavours. Step 8: * Now using a iron Shewer, shew both part of the Crab and cook in an Ovalclay Tandoor for 7-8 minutes busting clarified butter on it. Step 9: * Remove from the shewer and serve hot with your choice of Sauces preferably with Mint sauce or Chutney.

Dish Name: Hot And Sour Tomato Broth With Shrimp
Ingredient Names: tamarind pulp, shrimp, lemon, salt, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, cumin seed, curry leaves, garlic cloves, asafoetida powder, grape tomatoes, fresh green chile, curry powder, jaggery
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the tamarind pulp in six cups of very hot water for 20 minutes and crush it with the back of a spoon to make a pulp. Step 2: Marinate the shrimp in lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Step 3: Set aside in the fridge. Step 4: In a deep soup pot, heat the vegetable oil on medium heat and add the mustard and cumin seeds, fenugreek, curry leaves and garlic, and cook 3-4 minutes As soon as the mustard seeds begin to pop and crackle out of the pan, add the asafetida, tomatoes and green chilies. Step 5: Stir for a couple minutes and then add the curry powder Be careful as the mustard seeds will pop out of the pan! Step 6: After about 4-5 minutes, when the tomatoes have started to wilt and become soft, pour in the strained tamarind gravy.
