Step 7: Stir in the jaggery piece and the fish sauce, and heat for about 10 minutes. Step 8: Make sure the jaggery dissolves completely.

Ingredient Names: onion, cayenne pepper, turmeric, garlic, ginger, cumin powder, coriander powder, curry powder, tomatoes, vegetable oil, dungeness crab, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Roast onion a bit on a grill just until the outside is tender. Step 2: Chop finely Roast spices dry on a hot frying pan, no oil, for about one minute. Step 3: Remove spices from a pan. Step 4: In a bowl, put 1 / 2 cup of water and add the roasted spices to it and make a paste, heat a dutch oven. Step 5: Add roasted onion and fry till golden-brown. Step 6: Add spice paste and cook on medium heat for 2 minutes, add tomatoes. Step 7: Let spices cook for 5 minutes or so.

Dish Name: In A Heartbeat Atlantic Salmon With Red Curry Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, tomato and basil pasta sauce, fresh ginger, shrimp bouillon cube, red curry paste, fresh cilantro, salt, pepper, salmon fillets, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, combine coconut milk, tomato sauce, ginger, shrimp bouillon, and curry paste. Step 2: Bring sauce to a boil over medium high heat, stirring constantly Immediately lower temperature to medium low and simmer for 7 minutes, stirring occationally. Step 3: Stir in cilantro and remove from heat. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Meanwhile, brush salmon with vegetable oil and season to taste with salt and pepper on both sides. Step 6: Grill for 3-5 minutes on each side, or until cooked to taste. Step 7: Pour the sauce over the salmon and serve with rice if you like Enjoy!

Dish Name: Indian Fish Curry Chettinad Fish Curry
Ingredient Names: fish fillets, tamarind extract, onions, tomatoes, garlic, red chili powder, coriander powder, fennel seed, ground fenugreek, turmeric powder, oil, coconut milk, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Apply a pinch of salt and turmeric powder to the fillets, mix evenly and keep it aside. Step 2: In a frying pan, pour 4 tablespoons of oil, and add the fennel seeds and fenugreek Saut till aroma. Step 3: Add onions and garlic. Step 4: Fry till the onion becomes slight golden brown. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, red chile powder and coriander powder and saute it for 2 minutes, till the tomatoes are pulpy At this point, add 3 cups of water. Step 6: Now add the tamarind extract, and let this mixture boil on low flame for about 10 minutes. Step 7: Add the coconut milk and continue in low flame for another 5 minutes. Step 8: Now the mixture would have reduced considerably and will be quite thick.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, curry powder, pepper, fish fillets, canola oil, butter, onion, minced garlic cloves, sliced almonds, sultana raisins, unsweetened dried shredded coconut, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour, 2 tsp curry powder and pepper in a bowl Lightly coat the fish fillets. Step 2: Heat oil and 2 tbsp butter at medium heat in a pan and cook fillets 4-5 minutes on each side. Step 3: Remove filets from pan and keep warm. Step 4: Using the same pan, melt the rest of the butter. Step 5: Add onions and garlic and stir until tender. Step 6: Add almonds, raisins and coconut and saut for 2-3 more minutes. Step 7: Sprinkle the rest of the curry powder, mix well and leave to cook for a few minutes. Step 8: Add the coconut milk. Step 9: Cover to simmer for 10-15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ginger-garlic paste, fresh lemon juice, flour, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, plain fat-free yogurt, prawns, butter, mango powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix together the ginger and garlic paste with 1 / 3 cup of fresh lemon juice. Step 2: Add salt, red chili, turmeric and garam masala powders, gramflour and yogurt, mix well. Step 3: Add prawns to this prepared mixture and toss to coat well in it. Step 4: Keep aside to marinate for 2 hours Skewer prawns and barbecue until done Baste the prawns once with butter for a few minutes before they are done. Step 5: Transfer to a serving dish. Step 6: Sprinkle with 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice and mango powder, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: fish, turmeric powder, red chili powder, ginger-garlic paste, black pepper, lemon juice, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the fish and set aside. Step 2: Make a fine paste with the ingredients turmeric powder, red chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, black pepper powder, lemon juice and salt to taste Rub the paste on both sides of the fish. Step 3: Marinate the same for half an hour. Step 4: Heat oil in frying pan, add the marinated fish pieces to pan and fry for 4 min in simmer. Step 5: Fry both side of fishes pieces until golden brown. Step 6: Serve hot with sprinkled lemon juice and sliced onion.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, olive oil, onion, garlic, italian plum tomatoes, lemon juice, ground coriander, ground ginger, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, parsley sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp In large nonstick skillet, heat oil. Step 2: Add onion and garlic, saute until softened. Step 3: Add tomatoes, lemon juice and spices. Step 4: Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add shrimp and cook 3-5 minutes, or until cooked through. Step 6: Garnish with parsley if desired.

Ingredient Names: medium raw shrimp, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground turmeric, garam masala, canola oil, salt and pepper, basmati rice, onion, tomatoes, greek yogurt, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Place prawns in a bowl with garlic, ginger, spices, 2 teaspoons oil and some salt and pepper. Step 2: Stir well to coat, then cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the rice according to packet instructions. Step 4: Cover and keep warm. Step 5: Heat 1 tbs oil in a wok or frypan over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add prawns and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until lightly golden. Step 7: Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 8: Add the remaining 1 tbs oil to the pan, reduce the heat to medium, then add onion and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes until softened. Step 9: Stir in the tomato, then cover and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes until tomato is softened. Step 10: Return prawns to pan with yoghurt and cilantro, then warm through, stirring, for 1 minute.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Fish In Creamy Yoghurt Sauce
Ingredient Names: white fish fillet, butter, onions, green chilies, ginger, yogurt, cream, turmeric powder, fenugreek seeds, ground cardamom, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the butter and fry the onions until limp, add the green chilies and the ginger, fry for a few minutes mix yoghurt, cream, turmeric, fenugreek and the cardamom, add this to the frying pan and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 2: Add the fish to the sauce, simmer for another 10 minutes or until the fish is done transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle the coriander over it.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Fish With Coriander Rice
Ingredient Names: ground coriander, garam masala, chili powder, plain flour, salt and pepper, fish fillets, vegetable oil, broccoli, peas, coriander, wild rice mix
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ground coriander, garam masala, chilli powder and flour on a large plate and season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Dust fish in flour mixture to coat both sides, shaking of excess. Step 3: Heat oil in a large frying pan over moderately high heat and add fish skin side down and cook for 2-3 3 minutes each side or until just cooked and drain on paper towels. Step 4: Meanwhile cook broccoli and peas in a medium saucepan of boiling water until just tender and then drain. Step 5: Add vegetables and coriander to the rice and season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Serve fish with rice mixture.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, cooking spray, fresh lime juice, salt, ground ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, ground red pepper, plain fat-free yogurt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Place salmon, skin sides down, in a roasting pan or jelly roll pan coated with cooking spray. Step 3: Brush evenly with juice. Step 4: Combine 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and next 5 ingredients, and sprinkle evenly over fish. Step 5: Bake at 425 for 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Step 6: Combine yogurt and cilantro, and serve with fish.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, ginger, ground coriander, cumin, coarse salt, black pepper, curry powder, garam masala, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, butter, salmon fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine yogurt and all the spices. Step 3: Meanwhile, melt butter in skillet and saute salmon fillets so that they're brown on each side, about 3 minutes per side. Step 4: Transfer salmon to small baking dish and spoon yogurt sauce over top. Step 5: Bake in oven until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, curry powder, cumin powder, ginger, garlic cloves, cayenne, salt, shallots, tomato paste, water, brown sugar, large raw shrimp, lemons, cilantro leaf, flat bread
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate shrimp in 1 1 / 2 t olive oil, curry powder, cumin, minced ginger, minced garlic, cayenne, and salt for 1 / 2 hour. Step 2: Saute shallots in oil, in a heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, for about 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in tomato paste, water, and brown sugar, bring to a simmer. Step 4: Add shrimp mixture and cook until shrimp are just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle with cilantro, and serve with lemon or lime wedges and flat bread, or over rice.

Ingredient Names: ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, ground cardamom, ground cloves, black pepper, ground cinnamon, cayenne pepper, salt, medium shrimp, vegetable oil, fat free tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 8 ingredients together in a small skillet. Step 2: Place over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly, stir in salt, cool mixture. Step 4: Add spice mixture and shrimp to a large heavy-duty plastic zip-lock bag Shake around to coat shrimp Seal and marinate in refrigerator 1-2 hours. Step 5: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add shrimp mixture.

Dish Name: Indian Style Shrimp Pizza With Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: naan bread, salsa, mango chutney, baby shrimp, curry powder, mozzarella cheese, cilantro, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f. Step 2: Place naan or pita on parchment-covered baking sheet. Step 3: Mix salsa and mango chutney. Step 4: Spread out evenly on naan or pita. Step 5: Add shrimp and sprinkle with curry. Step 6: Top with cheese and bake 15 minutes While pizzas are baking, mix together cilantro and mint. Step 7: Sprinkle over pizzas once removed from the oven. Step 8: Serve with a salad.

Dish Name: Indian Style Shrimp and Scallop Skewers
Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh cilantro, garlic, ground cumin, ground ginger, turmeric, salt, cayenne, shrimps, scallops, skewers
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk oil and spices in a large bowl until blended. Step 2: Add shrimp and scallops and toss gently to coat. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours to let seafood absorb marinade flavors. Step 4: Thread shrimp and scallops on separate skewers. Step 5: Oil grill rack and place it 4 to 6 inches above hot coals. Step 6: Grill skewers 2 to 3 minutes per side until seafood is lightly browned and just barely opaque in the center.

Ingredient Names: chunk tuna, celery rib, dill pickle relish, mayonnaise, yellow mustard, garam masala, pine nuts, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except pine nuts and chill Stir in nuts just before serving.

Dish Name: Indian crumbed fish with spicy chips
Ingredient Names: potatoes, curry paste, vegetable oil, garlic coriander naan bread, curry powder, sustainable white fish fillets, raita
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss chips with curry paste, half the oil and some seasoning on a baking tray, then cook for 20 mins on the top shelf. Step 2: Meanwhile, toast the naan in a toaster, then whizz to crumbs in a food processor with the curry powder. Lay the fish on a baking tray, brush with the rest of the oil, then pack the crumbs on top and drizzle with a little extra oil. Transfer the chips to a lower shelf and cook the fish above for 10 mins until crisp and golden.

Dish Name: Jhinga Nisha Prawns In Saffron Cashew Nut And Almond Sauce
Ingredient Names: almonds, unsalted cashews, large raw shrimp, saffron, milk, green cardamoms, ghee, onions, green chilies, fresh ginger, salt, single cream, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Drop almonds and cashewnuts in 2 separate pans of boiling water. Step 2: Boil for 30 minutes and drain Peel the almonds by slipping them out of their skins and place in a food processor with the boiled cashewnuts Whiz until they form a paste. Step 3: Meanwhile, peel, wash and de-vein the prawns by making a small incision down the length of the back of each prawn and removing its black digestive cord. Step 4: Wash and pat dry Crumble saffron into warm milk, leave to infuse. Step 5: Remove the tiny black cardamom seeds and grind to a fine powder, set aside.

Ingredient Names: red chilies, onion, fresh ginger, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, turmeric, cracked black pepper, scallops, coconut milk, lime, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor blend the chillies, ginger, and onion with 3 tbsp water until mix forms a paste. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok, when hot add the mustard and fenugreek seeds, fry for 10 seconds. Step 3: Add the chilli paste and fry for 5 minutes, adding water if it starts to stick to pan. Step 4: Add turmeric and black peppercorns and fry the spices for a few seconds. Step 5: Add the shrimp and the coconut milk. Step 6: Cook until the scallops are done is cooked through and the curry is thoroughly heated through Splash lime juice on top, and finish with sprinkle of cilantro And enjoy!

Dish Name: King prawns in saffron almond sauce
Ingredient Names: raw king shrimp de-veined, vegetable oil, cashews, blanched almonds, ghee, bay leaf, green cardamom pods, onions, ginger, green chili, turmeric, pt fish stock, saffron strands, golden sugar, fresh cream, garam masala, garlic very, ground white pepper, greek yogurt, green cardamom pods mace ground together, cumin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Make the sauce. Tip the cashews and almonds into a saucepan and just cover with cold water. Boil gently for 20 minutes until slightly softened. Tip the nuts and water into a food processor and blend. Step 2: Heat the ghee or butter in a heavy saucepan, add the bay leaf, cardamoms and onion and fry for 8-10 minutes until golden. Add the ginger and chilli and fry for a minute until fragrant. Add the turmeric and fry until the onion turns yellow, which should take another minute. Now stir in the nut purée and cook the paste carefully, stirring regularly until yellow. Pour in 150ml of the fish stock and simmer for 2-3 minutes. As the sauce turns glossy, add the infused saffron, sugar and cream, sprinkle in the garam masala and season with salt. Simmer for a few more minutes. The sauce should be too thick to pour, but thin enough to spoon, so you may need to dilute it with more fish stock. (The sauce can be made up to an hour ahead.). Step 3: Tip the prawns into a bowl, and mix in a sprinkling of salt and all the ingredients for the first marinade. If this looks dry, add a drop of water. Set aside for 10 minutes. Heat the oil in a large pan and sear the prawns for 20 seconds so they curl up. Remove and set aside to cool. Step 4: Mix ingredients together for the second marinade, toss prawns in it (they can be left for up to 1 hour). Step 5: Preheat the oven to fan 180C/conventional 200C/gas 6. Pierce a long wooden skewer through the tail of each prawn and thread it through to the tip of the head. Prop the skewers on a roasting tray and roast for 6-8 minutes until lightly charred. Meanwhile, reheat the sauce and add more stock if it is too thick. Serve the prawns on a large plate in a pool of sauce for people to help themselves, with the extra sauce and pilau rice in bowls.

Dish Name: Lapa's Prawn Udon Noodle Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: udon noodles, water, olive oil, long beans, carrot, broccoli florets, zucchini, leeks, bamboo shoots, rice wine vinegar, low sodium chicken broth, prawns
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to boil, add noodles, cook 12 minutes, drain and reserve. Step 2: Add oil to skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Reduce to medium heat. Step 4: Add veggies, shoots, vinegar and broth. Step 5: Bring to boil, reduce heat, add prawns. Step 6: Add noodles, simmer until prawns are cooked through If too dry add water, cook 5 minutes. Step 7: Serve with hot and sour soup. Step 8: Stir fried veggies and spring rolls.

Ingredient Names: hamour fillet, salt, turmeric powder, cumin powder, garlic, oil, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place fish fillets in a bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt, turmeric, black pepper, garlic and cumin powder, tossing to coat well. Step 3: Cover and marinate for 20 minutes at room temperature or longer in the refrigerator. Step 4: Preheat oven to 200c Coat the bottom of the baking dish with oil. Step 5: Place the fish in a single layer. Step 6: Pour the marinade over it. Step 7: Bake uncovered for 25 minutes The fish should be firm to touch Fish is ready when it easily flakes with a fork.

Ingredient Names: halibut steaks, fresh lemon juice, black pepper, salt, vegetable oil, onion, ground cayenne pepper, turmeric, ground coriander, tomatoes, cilantro, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle lemon juice, black pepper and 1 teaspoon salt on both sides of fish. Step 2: Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add onions and cook, stirring, until golden brown and soft, 7-8 minutes. Step 5: Stir in red pepper, turmeric, ground coriander and remaining salt. Step 6: Cook for 30 seconds. Step 7: Stir in tomatoes and 2 tablespoons cilantro. Step 8: Remove and set aside. Step 9: Add remaining oil to skillet, Add fish and top each piece with tomato mixture.

Dish Name: Madam Nupur Sen's Mudi Ghanto Fish Head With Rice
Ingredient Names: fish head, basmati rice, potatoes, onion, ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, cumin seed, cardamoms, cloves, cinnamon stick, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, wash the pieces of fish head thoroughly Rub in a little turmeric powder and salt. Step 2: Keep aside Roast dry cumin and coriander seeds Grind these with ginger and garlic. Step 3: Keep aside Roast half the quantity of dry cardamom, cloves and cinnamon and powder these. Step 4: Keep this powder in a tightly sealed jar. Step 5: Heat oil in a frying pan. Step 6: Fry the fish head pieces till they turn dark brown.

Ingredient Names: cayenne pepper, red paprika, ground turmeric, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, ground coriander, ground cumin, coconut milk, kokum, prawns, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, combine 1-1 / 4 cups water with the cayenne pepper, paprika, turmeric, garlic and ginger. Step 2: Mix well Grind the coriander seeds and cumin seeds in a clean coffee grinder and add to mixture. Step 3: Bring the spice mixture to a simmer over medium-high heat. Step 4: Turn the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and is reduced somewhat. Step 5: Add the coconut milk, salt, kokum or tamarind paste, and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Add the prawns and simmer, stirring occasionally, until they turn opaque and are just cooked through. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to taste, serve while hot.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, madras curry powder, unsweetened coconut milk, chicken stock, medium shrimp, salt, cayenne pepper, mint, lemon zest, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large, deep skillet until shimmering. Step 2: Add onion and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened and just beginning to brown. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic and curry and cook, stirring, until fragrant. Step 4: Add coconut milk and stock and simmer over medium heat until reduced by 1 / 3 and thickened. Step 5: Add shrimp, season with salt and cayenne and simmer over medium heat until the shrimp are pink and cooked through. Step 6: Stir in the mint and lemon zest and serve in deep bowls over steamed rice.

Dish Name: Meen Moilee Fish In Fragrant Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: white-fleshed fish, turmeric, salt, lime, peanut oil, green chilies, ginger, garlic cloves, white onion, curry leaves, coconut milk, tomatoes, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the diced fish chunks in water. Step 2: Drain off the excess water and place the fish in a bowl. Step 3: Add turmeric powder and a large pinch of salt. Step 4: Add lime juice and mix. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate for 25 minutes. Step 6: Heat the oil in a deep saucepan over a medium gas flame until seriously hot, but not burning. Step 7: Add the chiles, ginger, garlic, onion, and curry leaves to the oil The curry leaves must be added in at the beginning, so the flavors can infuse with the other ingredients. Step 8: Stir lightly until onions are transparent. Step 9: Add 1 / 2 teaspoon of turmeric powder, and stir.

Dish Name: Muchli Masala Indian Spicy Fried Fish
Ingredient Names: cod, garlic cloves, salt, fresh ginger, ground turmeric, black pepper, cayenne, lemon juice, vegetable oil, coriander, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse fish in cold water, pat dry with paper towels In small bowl combine salt, spices, ginger, garlic and lemon juice - form into a paste Rub fish with paste. Step 2: Let the fish stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Step 3: In a heavy skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 4: Fry fish about 5 min, turn and fry other side until golden brown, about 4 minutes more. Step 5: Garnish with fresh coriander or parsley and lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, fish, hard-boiled eggs, parsley, cream, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients to the hot rice and reheat for a few minutes Serve at once.

Ingredient Names: dungeness crabs, whole coriander seeds, whole black peppercorn, sweet paprika, cayenne pepper, turmeric, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, onion, garlic cloves, water, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Drop in the crabs and cook until they stop moving, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Remove the crabs from the pot and cool. Step 4: When they are cool enough to handle, pull of and discard the top shell Scrape the insides clean with a small spoon. Step 5: Remove the spongy lungs on both sides of the body With a heavy knife, cut the crabs in quarters and crack the claws, set aside. Step 6: Heat a small frying pan over medium heat Toast the coriander seeds and peppercorns, stirring constantly, for 1 minute, then grind finely in a spice mill or coffee grinder.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, ginger, garlic, red chile, golden sugar, black mustard seeds, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, garam masala, malt vinegar, tomato, raw king shrimp, fresh coriander, basmati rice yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep-sided frying pan and cook the onion for 8-10 mins until it starts to turn golden. Add the ginger, garlic and chilli and cook for 1-2 mins. Stir in the sugar and spices for 1 min, then splash in the vinegar and tomatoes. Season with salt and simmer for 5 mins, stirring, until the sauce thickens. Step 2: Stir in the prawns, reduce the heat and cook for 8-10 mins until cooked through – if the sauce gets really thick, add a splash of water. Remove from the heat, stir though most of the coriander. Serve straight from the dish scattered with the remaining coriander and the rice, yogurt, chutney and salad in separate bowls.

Ingredient Names: kingfish, onions, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, low-fat plain yogurt, fenugreek seeds, oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot. Step 2: Add onions and saute until brown, grind the onions. Step 3: Put the ground onions in a large mixing bowl. Step 4: Add yoghurt to the ground onions. Step 5: Add fish pieces to this, mix well and marinate the fish in this mixture for 2 hours. Step 6: In the same oil which was used to saute the onions, add the methi seeds. Step 7: Allow to sizzle a bit, then remove them once they turn brown. Step 8: Add ginger-garlic paste to the same oil. Step 9: Saute until the raw smell is gone. Step 10: Add red chilli and turmeric powders. Step 11: Mix well and continue to stir-fry for a few minutes. Step 12: Add the marinated fish pieces. Step 13: Add half a glass of water and mix well. Step 14: Keep on low flame for 10 minutes. Step 15: Garnish with coriander leaves. Step 16: Serve hot with chappatis.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, cornstarch, olive oil, shrimp, shallots, garlic cloves, fresh crabmeat, dry white wine, whipping cream, curry powder, water, saffron thread, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cup stock and cornstarch in small bowl to blend. Step 2: Heat oil in heavy large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add shrimp, shallots and garlic Saut for 1 minute, stir in crabmeat. Step 4: Add wine and simmer until almost evaporated for about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 cups stock and bring to boil. Step 6: Stir cornstarch mixture to blend, mix into sauce. Step 7: Bring to boil, stirring frequently.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, ginger, turmeric, lemon juice, shrimp, salt, oil, coriander seeds, dried chili pepper flakes, tomatoes, chili powder, garam masala, cumin seeds, birds eye chiles, fenugreek seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Crush 3 cloves of garlic with half the ginger to form a paste. Step 2: Add turmeric, lemon juice, salt and shrimp, cover and marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes. Step 3: Heat 2 tsp oil in a saucepan over medium heat add remaining garlic, stir, add coriander, red pepper, tomato and cook 5 minutes until thickened. Step 4: Add chili powder, remaining ginger and 6 tbsp water, cook until reduced by half. Step 5: Stir in garam masala, set aside. Step 6: Heat remaining oil in a skillet. Step 7: Add cumin seeds and stir Aadd birds eye chiles, shrimp and marinade, and sauce and cook until shrimp turns pink, 8-10 minutes. Step 8: Stir in fenugreek, add pomegranate seeds. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro and serve over white rice.

Dish Name: Possibly The Easiest Shrimp Curry Ever
Ingredient Names: oil, scallions, plum tomatoes, curry powder, garlic clove, chicken broth, sour cream, frozen peas, cooked shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the scallions and tomatoes in the oil for a few minutes until soft, add garlic and curry powder, sate for 30 second longer. Step 2: Add chicken broth, cook down a bit Throw in the peas, and sour cream. Step 3: Stir until combined. Step 4: Add the cooked shrimp, heat through. Step 5: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, korma paste, cinnamon, stock, basmati rice, peas, greek yogurt, shrimps, ground almonds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan with the onions and soften for 10 mins. Add the korma paste and cinnamon and fry for 3 mins more. Pour in the stock and simmer for another 3 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the basmati rice following pack instructions. Step 3: Tip peas and prawns into the korma sauce and gently cook until piping hot. Stir in the Greek yogurt, almonds and seasoning. Discard cinnamon, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice.

Dish Name: Prawn And Pumpkin Coconut Milk Curry Konju Pulungari
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, mustard seeds, whole cumin seed, ginger, green chili pepper, onions, curry leaves, ground turmeric, salt, red pumpkins, coconut milk, water, prawns, fresh spinach, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add the mustard seed and cumin and saute until the mustard seeds start to pop, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add the ginger, chili peppers, onions and curry leaves and saute over medium heat until the onion is translucent, but not browned. Step 4: Stir from time to time. Step 5: Stir in the turmeric and salt, then add the cubed pumpkin or sweet potato. Step 6: Stir well and saute for a few minutes. Step 7: Add the coconut milk and the water. Step 8: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until the pumpkin or sweet potato is tender, stirring from time to time. Step 9: Add the prawns or shrimp and spinach, and simmer just until the shrimp is cooked, three to five minutes. Step 10: Stir in the vinegar.

Dish Name: Prawn Balchao Goan Pickle Style Hot Prawns
Ingredient Names: prawns, vegetable oil, onions, tomatoes, curry leaves, garlic paste, ginger paste, dried red chilies, black peppercorns, cumin seed, turmeric powder, mustard seeds, cinnamon sticks, cloves, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put the prawns in a large bowl and sprinkle salt on them. Step 2: Keep aside Roast the chillies, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, peppercorns, turmeric, cloves and cinnamon till they begin to release their aroma. Step 3: Remove from heat and cool Grind the ginger, garlic and roasted spices into a smooth paste using the vinegar. Step 4: Heat the oil on a medium flame in a wok-style pan to medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the prawns and stir fry till opaque. Step 6: Remove from the pan and keep warm In the same pan, fry the onions till light brown. Step 7: Add the tomato and curry leaves and fry until the tomatoes are soft.

Ingredient Names: prawns, fresh coriander, lemon, curry powder, onion, garlic clove, oil, long-grain rice, chicken stock, mushrooms, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Place prawns in a dish and sprinkle with coriander, lemon juice and half the curry powder. Step 2: Set aside to marinate. Step 3: Place onion and garlic in a microwave-proof bowl with oil. Step 4: Cook on high for about 1 minute. Step 5: Add remaining curry powder and cook for 1 minute. Step 6: Stir in rice with 1 cup of boiling stock. Step 7: Cook on high for 4 minutes, stirring twice. Step 8: Add mushrooms and cook for 1 more minute on high, stirring halfway through, add prawns. Step 9: Cook on high for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: prawns, onion, garlic clove, oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, chili powder, salt, ground black pepper, crushed tomatoes, ground ginger, water
Instructions: Step 1: Shell green prawns and return to fridge. Step 2: Heat the oil and slowly cook the onions and garlic until soft, add the spices and stir to blend. Step 3: Add the water and simmer for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the prawns and stir making sure that the prawns are well coated then add the tomatoes and simmer for just another few minutes Do not overcook as the prawns will become tough. Step 5: Serve with hot rice, pappadums and side dishes of, chopped spring onions, tomatoes, capsicums, dried coconut, fresh chilli, cucumber etc.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, curry paste, raw king shrimp, peas, fresh cilantro, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in frying pan, then fry the onions over a medium heat until soft and beginning to brown, about 5 mins. Meanwhile, reserve 8 of the tomato wedges, then whizz the remainder in a food processor with the ginger and garlic. Step 2: Add the curry paste to the pan for 30 secs. Stir through the tomato mix and remaining tomato wedges, then bubble over a high heat for 5 mins, stirring so the sauce doesn’t catch. Mix in the prawns and peas; simmer until prawns are pink and cooked through. Scatter with coriander, then serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, fresh ginger, water, vegetable oil, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, bay leaves, ground cumin, ground coriander, tomatoes, plain yogurt, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the onions, garlic, ginger and 3 tablespoons water in an electric blender until you have a paste. Step 2: Put the oil in a wide pan and set over medium high heat. Step 3: When hot, put in the cinnamon, cardamom and bay leaves. Step 4: Stir for 3-4 seconds. Step 5: Put in the paste from the blender. Step 6: Stir and fry for about 5 minutes or until the paste turns a light brown color. Step 7: Add the ground cumin and ground coriander. Step 8: Stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 9: Put in the tomatoes. Step 10: Stir and keep frying until the paste has a nice reddish brown look to it.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic, green chili, curry paste, tomato puree, vegetable stock, coconut cream, raw shrimp, coriander rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Fry the onion, garlic and half the chilli for 5 mins or until softened. Add the curry paste and cook for 1 min more. Add the tomato purée, stock and coconut cream. Step 2: Simmer on medium heat for 10 mins, then add the prawns. Cook for 3 mins or until they turn opaque. Scatter on the remaining green chillies and coriander sprigs, then serve with rice or cauliflower rice for a keto-friendly version.

Ingredient Names: ghee, skinless white fish like pollack, skinless salmon, raw shrimp, mussels cleaned de-bearded, onions, ginger, vegetable oil, garam masala, asafoetida, turmeric, red chile, tomatoes, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For the curry sauce, whizz the onion and ginger together to a purée. Heat the oil in a large pan until smoking. Add the garam marsala and sizzle for 30 secs, then add the onion and ginger purée, reduce the heat and slowly cook for 5 mins. Add the remaining spices, fry for 1 min, stir in the chilli and fry for another min, then add the tomatoes and a good pinch of salt and grind of pepper, and stir well. You can do this way in advance, then just throw the curry together on the night – the sauce will freeze or keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Step 2: To make the curry, melt a third of the ghee in a large pan. Cook the white fish for 2-3 mins until lightly browned, then set aside on a plate. Repeat this process with the salmon and prawns, adding another third of ghee each time. For the mussels, heat a medium-sized saucepan on a high heat. Add the mussels with 2 tbsp of water, cover tightly with a lid, and steam for 3-4 mins, shaking the pan every so often. Drain and set aside with the other seafood. Step 3: Bring the sauce to the boil, stir the fish and mussels in gently, bring to the boil again, then remove from the heat and leave for 3-4 mins – the fish will finish cooking in the heat from the sauce. Add the coriander leaves and serve with Spiced rice and Carrot & cumin salad.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice well, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, vegetable oil, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, cinnamon, cardamom pods, onions, turmeric, chili powder, ground coriander, raw shrimp, unsweetened coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the rice according to pack instructions, then set aside. Put the ginger, garlic and tomatoes into a food processor, blend to make a paste, then set aside until you’re ready to cook. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and add the whole spices. Once they sizzle, add the onion, frying over a medium heat for about 10 mins until soft. Add the ground spices and paste, then cook over a low heat, stirring occasionally until the sauce has released the oil back into the pan. Add the prawns, then cook for a few mins until cooked through – the mixture should be quite dry and paste-like. Step 3: Stir the cooked rice into the pan to coat it well in the spices. Make sure the rice is heated through, then serve scattered with the coconut.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, madras curry paste, tomato, vegetable stock, sustainable white fish fillets, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep pan and gently fry the onion and garlic for about 5 mins until soft. Add the curry paste and stir-fry for 1-2 mins, then tip in the tomatoes and stock. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, then add the fish. Gently cook for 4-5 mins until the fish flakes easily. Serve immediately with rice or naan.

Dish Name: Tandoori Salmon Fillets with Mango Mint Relish
Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, vegetable oil, marinade, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, garam masala, plain yogurt, relish, mango, green onions, jalapeno peppers, lime juice, mint leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine marinade ingredients in a small bowl& spread on salmon; refrigerate for an hour. Step 2: Dice mango into 1/2 inch cubes& combine with remaining relish ingredients; refrigerate until needed. Step 3: It can be made up to 12 hours ahead. Step 4: Brush salmon with oil, then grill for 2 minutes- flesh side down. Step 5: Turn over, close lid& grill for another 5 minutes or until white juices appear. Step 6: Serve relish on the side.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onions, ginger, garlic, curd, cashew nuts, turmeric powder, cumin powder, red chili powder, kashmiri red chili powder, green chilies, salt, sugar, sunflower oil, ghee, milk, rose water, cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, nutmeg, mace, black cardamom
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Badshahi Chicken Recipe, wash the chicken pieces, and transfer to a bowl marinate with salt for half an hour. In a mixer jar, combine the cashew nuts and grind it with some water until smooth. Step 2: To make the fresh masala. Step 3: In a skillet, dry roast the ingredients - green cardamom, black cardamom, mace and nutmeg till fragrant, on a low heat. Once the spices are done, allow them to cool down, pulse them in a mixer-grind to a fine powder. Step 4: We will need about 3/4th tablespoon of this masala for this recipe. Step 5: You can store the rest in an airtight container and use it for a later use. In a kadai, add oil to deep fry the chicken.on medium-high flame. Once the oil is hot, add the chicken pieces gradually within the oil and fry them for about on medium flame. Step 6: Take them out with a slotted spoon and drain out excess oil. Step 7: Keep aside.(You can also shallow fry them for 3-4 minutes or till done, if you prefer to use less oil. Step 8: This recipe uses a traditional way of making chicken)In a kadai, heat a bit of oil, and add the spices once the oil is hot- cloves, cardamom, and cinnamon stick and saute a bit till fragrant. Add sliced onion to it and fry them till it golden brown and caramelized, on a medium high heat. Once done, add ginger, garlic,& onion paste one by one sauté them together till the raw aroma disappears. Now add turmeric, red chili powder, & cumin powder then sauté. Step 9: Save Kashmiri chilli powder till next step. Also, in a small bowl, make a smooth mixture of curd, ground cashew nut paste and Kashmiri chilli powder. Step 10: Add this mixture to the kadai & stir till the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and sort of comes together. Now add the fried chicken pieces and mix them nicely. Add slit green chillies & the freshly ground masala to it, about 1 hour. Step 11: You can adjust this to your liking. Keep stirring occasionally. Step 12: Continue cooking for about 5 minutes and then add milk and add salt after checking. Step 13: Be careful while adding salt since we had already added salt while frying the chicken. Step 14: Adjust water if needed. Cover and cook till the chicken is tender. Check the tenderness of chicken, once tender, add ghee and rose water to it, if using, Cover & cook for another 5 minutes or till combined well, and switch off. Serve this lip-smacking Badshahi Chicken Recipe along with Homemade Butter Naan Recipe, Chilli Coriander Fried Rice Recipe and a Mutton Shami Kebab Recipe for a complete meal on a weekend with family.

Dish Name: Bhindi Masala Gravy - Ladies Finger In Tomato Onion Gravy
Ingredient Names: okra, onion, ginger, garlic, green chilies, cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, mace, tomatoes, curd, dried fenugreek, bay leaf, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, sunflower oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Bhindi Masala Gravy Recipe, make sure to first rinse and dry each Bhindi. Step 2: This process is done in order to ensure that the bhindi doesn't get sticky while cooking it. Step 3: After wiping the bhindis dry, slit the bhindi vertically till about half an inch from the tail (thinly sliced), so that each bhindi is slit but held together by the tail. Step 4: Heat oil for cooking into a pan; add the bhindi, sprinkle some salt and saute the bhindi until cooked. Cover the pan of the bhindi partially while it is cooking. Step 5: This will help the bhindi steam cook, at the same time roast a bit. Step 6: Keeping the lip ajar, helps the steam at the same time, trap a little steam. Step 7: It will take a good to cook the bhindi. Step 8: Keep stirring to ensure it gets roasted well on all sides. Next step is to make the gravy for the Bhindi Masala. Add the tomatoes, into a mixer grinder and make a puree. Step 9: Keep aside. In a mixer grinder, add garlic, onions, ginger, chillies, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon stick and made and grind it to a smooth paste, keep aside. Step 10: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat; add in the bay leaf and saute for about 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, add in the onions garlic and spice paste and saute for 2 to. Add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and mix everything well. Step 11: Cook for about a minute until the raw smell goes away. Step 12: Next, add the tomato puree, curd and salt. Step 13: It will take about 2 to over medium heat for the tomato to cook. Step 14: Check the salt and allow the masala to be thick. Once done, add the roasted bhindi into the masala gravy. Step 15: Check the salt and turn the heat to high and cook for another minute so that the bhindi gets coated well with the masala. After a couple of minutes, add the crushed kasuri methi and turn off the heat. Garnish the Bhindi Masala Gravy with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve Bhindi Masala Gravy along with Paneer Biryani, Jackfruit Biryani or any Biryani of your choice for a vegetarian lunch or dinner. Step 16: If can also serve the along with Tawa Paratha and Boondi Raita for an Indian lunch or dinner.

Ingredient Names: black beans, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, onion, tomato, green bell pepper, carrot, cumin powder, dried oregano, red chili flakes, coriander leaves, salt, lemon juice, fresh orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the black bean soup with Mojo sauce first cook beans till they become soft. Step 2: You can either pressure cook them or cook them in a saucepan on the stove top. In a saucepan, heat the oil. Step 3: Add garlic and onion. Step 4: Sauté till the onion becomes translucent. Add capsicum and carrot. Step 5: Stir and cook covered for 5 minutes. Add some water if required. Step 6: Add the tomatoes, beans, cumin, oregano, chilli flakes and salt. Add some water and bring it to a boil. Step 7: Mash some of the beans with a ladle to thicken the soup. Step 8: (You can blend some beans in a food processor if you want a thick soup)Serve in individual bowls, topped with a spoonful of mojo sauce and garnished with herbs. For the mojo sauce: Whisk together all the ingredients and use as required. Serve Black Bean soup with Mojo on its own or with baked Tortilla chips for a delicious light meal.

Ingredient Names: chana dal, dry red chilies, fennel seeds, salt, sunflower oil, onion, tomato, green chilies, garlic, coriander powder, red chili powder, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, cardamom pods, curry leaves, coriander leaves, fresh coconut, poppy seeds, cashew nuts, roasted gram dal
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Chettinad Pakoda Curry Recipe, we first prepare making the batter for the pakodas. Soak the channa dal along with red chillies for 1 hour and then grind it with fennel seeds, salt using a mixer grinder to a coarse paste with very little water. Now, heat oil in a pan, and drop a spoon full of the pakoda mix into the oil and fry until golden brown in medium heat. Remove it on a kitchen towel and keep aside. Like wise, prepare the next batch of the pakodas with the remaining batter and keep aside. Now, grind the ingredients mentioned in the 'to grind' table to a smooth paste using a mixer grinder and keep aside. To prepare the gravy, heat oil in a pan, add the bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cardamom and let it release its aroma into the oil. Add the fennel seeds, curry leaves and let it splutter. Add the garlic and fry until golden brown. Add the finely chopped onions and saute until transparent. Add the tomatoes, green chillies, a pinch of saute and saute until the tomatoes are mushy. Add the coriander and red chilli powder and saute for a minute. Now, add the ground paste, 1.water, salt and simmer until the masala paste is cooked well and the gravy comes together. Add in the prepared pakodas and simmer for another 15-20 minutes. The gravy will eventually be watery, but the pakodas will soak up the water and thicken the gravy. Switch off the flame and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve the Chettinad Pakoda Curry Recipe along with Tawa Parathas or Roti's, Steamed Rice, Poondu Rasam and Papad.

Dish Name: Dahi Baingan - Brinjal In Curd Based Gravy
Ingredient Names: eggplant, onion, tomatoes, curd, gram flour, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, fennel powder, turmeric powder, salt, dry red chilies, sesame seeds, coriander leaves, sunflower oil, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, urad dal, cloves, cardamom pods, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, curry leaves, ginger garlic paste
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Dahi Baingan Recipe (Brinjal In Curd Based Gravy), prepare all the ingredients, with chopping veggies and keeping all the other ingredients handy. In a shallow frying pan, heat about cooking oil, and saute all the brinjal cubes lightly without making them mushy, on a medium flame till the brinjals are browned. Step 2: Switch off and keep aside. In a mixing bowl, mix curd (yogurt) and besan until there are no lumps. Step 3: Now add coriander powder, red chilli powder, fennel powder, garam masala, turmeric powder to the bowl and mix well. Take a kadai and dry roast sesame seeds and dry red chillies. Step 4: Once they cool down to room temperature, blend them in a mixer to a fine powder. Now take little oil in the same kadai, heat. Step 5: Once it is heated, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Step 6: Let it splutter. Add split urad dal, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, bay leaf and wait for it to change color. Step 7: When color changes add curry leaves, allow them to splutter and add ginger garlic paste immediately and fry for a few seconds till the raw smell disappears. Add finely sliced onions and fry on medium heat until onion i brownish. Add sliced tomatoes and cook until they turn soft and mushy. Step 8: Once the tomatoes are cooked, add curd besan and spice powder mix from the bowl and fold till everything gets mixed well. Now add the brinjal cubes which were previously sauteed and continue cooking for some more time till the masala gets seeped into the brinjal, by cooking covered and sauteing occasionally. Add salt, mix, do a taste check and garnish the Dahi Baingan with coriander leaves and switch off heat. You can serve Dahi Baingan Recipe (Brinjal In Curd Based Gravy) with Phulka Recipe or Pudina Tawa Paratha. Step 9: You can also serve it with mild Saffron Pilaf Recipe (Kesar Pulao).

Dish Name: Lauki Wadi Tarkari - Bengali Style Moong Dal Dumplings & Bottle Gourd Sabzi
Ingredient Names: yellow moong dal, ginger, cumin seeds, red chili powder, asafoetida, salt, bottle gourd, tomato, onion, green chilies, panch phoran, turmeric powder, coriander powder, sugar, mustard oil, sunflower oil, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Lauki Wadi Tarkari Recipe, prepare wadis first. Step 2: Wash and soak moong dal in enough water for about 30 minutes or overnight. Drain excess water and pulse it a couple of times to make a fine paste in a food processor. Add the remaining ingredients listed under wadi like the ginger, cumin seeds, dry red chillies, hing, salt to taste and whisk to combine. Step 3: Arrange a baking tray with aluminium foil or lined with a parchment paper. Using a piping bag or zip lock bag, drop out small roundels. Dry them under the sunlight for 3-4 days or until they are completely dried. Step 4: Store in an airtight container and use them when needed. Step 5: This can be stored up to 6 months.*For Lauki Wadi/Badi TarkariOnce you have the homemade or store bought wadis, heat oil for frying in a pan and saute the wadis. Step 6: Drain on a kitchen towel to absorb excess oil. Step 7: Keep them aside. Heat oil in a pan and add panch phoran masala on a low heat. Step 8: Saute for few seconds and then add ginger and onions. Step 9: Stir until the onions are light brown. Now add green chillies and tomatoes, stir and add turmeric powder, salt and sugar. Step 10: Stir well on a medium heat to cook tomatoes. Once the tomatoes are soft and mushy, add in lauki and cook covered until lauki is soft. Step 11: Mine took about 5 minutes. Add crushed or whole wadis,stir to combine and cook for few minutes more. Remove Lauki Wadi Tarkari from heat and put it into a serving bowl, garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Step 12: Serve hot. Serve Lauki Wadi Tarkari Recipe along with Pudina Lahsun Laccha Paratha and Mooli Raita Recipe for your everyday meals.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all purpose flour, active dry yeast, curd, sugar, salt, water, sunflower oil, potatoes, onions, green chilies, chaat masala powder, dry mango powder, cheese spread, mint leaves, ghee, greek yogurt, cucumber, saffron strands, parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mini Chilli Cheese Aloo Kulcha Recipe,we will first make the dough and keep it ready. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, all purpose flour, yeast, curd, sugar, salt and mix with your fingers. Step 3: Next add little warm water at a time and knead to make a soft dough. Finally drizzle some oil and knead for a few more minutes. Step 4: Cover the pan and allow it to rest and rise for about 1 hour. To make the stuffing for the Kulcha. Into a bowl, add in the mashed potatoes, onions, green chillies, amchur powder, chaat masala powder, salt to taste and finally mint leaves. Step 5: Mix well to combine. Finally we will stuff the kulchas. Remove the dough from the warm place, punch the dough back with your knuckles. Step 6: Now divide the dough into equal portions of lemon ball sizes, dust in flour and flatten them using a rolling pin to about diameter. Step 7: Spoon the aloo filling into the kulcha dough, then add the grated Britannia cheezza and close the edges. Gently roll it and keep aside. Step 8: Make a few more Cheese Aloo Kulcha Recipe before you begin to cook them. Place the Mini Chilli Cheese Aloo Kulcha onto a preheated pan and cook for a few seconds on both sides. Once you notice the rawness of the dough is gone, drizzle some ghee and cook well until golden and crisp on both sides. Once done transfer the Mini Chilli Cheese Aloo Kulcha into a serving plate and serve hot with the roasted garlic dip. To make the Roasted Garlic Dip; into a mixing bowl combine Britannia roasted garlic cheese spreadz, hung yogurt, cucumber, saffron, parsley leaves, salt and mix well to combine. Step 9: Check the taste and adjust the salt accordingly. Step 10: Transfer the Roasted Garlic. Step 11: Dip to a serving bowl and serve along with the Chilli Cheese Kulcha as an appetizer for parties. You can also serve the Mini Chilli Cheese Aloo Kulcha Recipe along with Tadkewali Masoor Dal or Dum Murgh Aatishi, Pickled Onions for a simple yet flavoursome party meal or even a special weekend dinner.

Dish Name: Oil Free Gujarati Undhiyu - No Onion No Garlic
Ingredient Names: gram flour, fenugreek leaves, red chili powder, turmeric powder, asafoetida, sugar, cooking soda, coriander leaves, green chilies, desiccated coconut, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt, lilva beans, ivy gourd, raw banana, green peas, cabbage, purple cabbage, eggplant
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Oil Free Gujarati Undhiyu Recipe (No Onion No Garlic), prep up with all the ingredients required and proceed with making muthiya. To make muthiya, mix all the ingredients - besan, fenugreek leaves, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, hing, sugar, salt, soda along with some water required to make a stiff dough. Once the dough ahs come together, form small round dumpling of the size of muthiyas. Steam them in a preheated steamer for on medium-low heat, or until the dumplings are steamed. Step 2: Keep aside. In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients of dry masala which include - coriander leaves, green chillies, coconut powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt to taste, sugar and mix them well with a little water just enough to bind it. Step 3: Fill this dry masala into the eggplants. Step 4: Similarly, rub the same masala on to other vegetables except cabbage. Step 5: Keep the veggies to marinate in the masala for 2 hours. In a pressure cooker, add all the veggies - lilva, tindora, raw banana, and the green peas with a glass of water and salt to taste. Step 6: Pressure cook for 2 whistles and turn off the flame. Step 7: Allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 8: Bake cabbage in a preheated oven, at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 25-30 minutes or till done. Step 9: You can steam it as well. Bake filled eggplants for about in oven at 375 degrees fahrenheit. Step 10: Now take a large kadai or saucepan and add all the vegetables, except the eggplants and mix well. Step 11: Adjust water only if required. Add in the steamed muthia and eggplants and give a quick and careful mix. Step 12: Garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve Gujarati Undhiyu along with Gujarati Puran Poli Recipe, Gujarati Kadhi Recipe - Sweet And Spicy Gujarati Kadhi and some steamed rice and finish the meal with a dessert of Golpapdi Recipe.

Dish Name: Palakottai Kujambu -Kongunad Style Jackfruit Seeds Curry
Ingredient Names: jackfruit seeds, tamarind water, garlic, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, turmeric powder, red chili powder, sambar powder, asafoetida, coriander leaves, salt, sunflower oil, fresh coconut, whole black peppercorns, dry red chilies, onion, tomato, coriander seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe wash the jackfruits seeds thoroughly, make a slit on the outer layer and remove the outer white layer. Step 2: In a pressure cooker, add the Jackfruit seeds, add enough water to submerge the seeds,add a pinch of salt, and pressure cook it on a high heat for 3-4 whistles or till they are cooked al-dente. Step 3: Allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 4: Drain and reserve the jackfruit seed stock for later use. Heat a kadai on medium flame, add oil once the oil is hot, add onions and saute until almost translucent, for about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Now add chopped tomatoes, cover and cook until the tomatoes are mushy. Step 6: Transfer the sauteed onion-tomatoes and allow them to cool. Transfer the onion-tomato mixture into a mixer-jar, add coriander seeds and grind well along with some of the jackfruit stock. Step 7: We need a smooth paste. Step 8: Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Step 9: Yet again, in a mixer grinder, combine fresh grated coconut, red chillies and black pepper along with a little jackfruit seeds stock, and grind to a smooth paste, keep aside. Step 10: Heat a pan with oil, on medium heat, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds and curry leaves. Step 11: Once they splutter and sizzle, add in asafoetida and the crushed garlic cloves and saute till the garlic turn golden. Once garlic turns to golden, add the ground onion tomato paste and saute well until it starts boiling. Add the tamarind water to it and stir. Step 12: Boil for 10 minutes and cooked palakottai/jackfruit seeds. Step 13: Mix well. Add required salt, turmeric powder, chilli powder, sambar powder. Step 14: Mix well and cook for in medium heat, such that the flavours seep into the jackfruit seeds. Now add the ground coconut mixture and stir well. Step 15: Cook on a low heat until it thickens. Step 16: Taste and adjust seasoning and consistency of the Palakottai Kuzhambu to your liking. Step 17: Turn off the flame. Step 18: Garnish with coriander leaves. Step 19: Serve Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe along with Raw Jackfruit Poriyal Recipe, Steamed Rice Recipe and Thayir Semiya Recipe for a hearty weekday lunch.

Ingredient Names: curd, gram flour, green chili paste, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, ghee, cloves, whole black peppercorns, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, asafoetida, boondi
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Punjabi Style Boondi Kadhi Recipe, firstly combine yogurt, gram flour, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt in a bowl. Step 2: Add water and whisk well. Step 3: Make sure that no lumps are formed. Heat ghee in a deep non-stick pan, add cloves, peppercorns, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds and sauté for a minute. After a minute, add asafoetida, chopped ginger and red chillies, mix and sauté for about a minute. Now, add methi seeds (soaked in the night) and stir for few mintues. Now, add the gram flour and yogurt mixture and stir continouly until the bubbles form in the kadai. Step 4: As the mixture gets thick while boiling, add water and keep the flame low and allow to cook for 15 to. After 15 to, switch off the gas, add boondi and and garnish with coriander leaves. Make this easy and nutritional Punjabi Style Boondi Kadhi Recipe and pair it along with Bajri-Til Bhakri Recipe, a piece of gur and a dollop of ghee smeared on roti. Step 5: You can also serve Kachumber Salad on the side.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, red chili powder, turmeric powder, carom seeds, curd, sunflower oil, khoya, green chilies, cashew nuts, raisins, desiccated coconut, salt, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, coriander leaves, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, asafoetida, dry red chilies, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Rajasthani Govind Gatta Curry Recipe, in a large mixing bowl - add besan, curd, red chilli powder, turmeric, salt, carom seeds, oil and mix them well to form a dry crumble. In a separate bowl, mix mawa, green chillies (optional), salt, chopped cashews, raisins and keep it aside. Now add a little water to the dry besan mix and knead to make a firm dough. Divide the dough to equal balls, take a ball and make a disc. Take filling and place in the center of the disc, fold in to cover from all sides and then roll to shape into a ball. Step 2: Do the same for rest of the dough and filling and keep aside. Step 3: Heat enough water in a pan and bring it to boil. Carefully drop the prepared gattas in the boiling water and cook them well for till you prick a toothpick, it should come out clean. Strain the gattas and reuse the water to use in the gravy. For making the curry, heat oil in a wok and add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, rey red chilies, bay leaf and asafoetida and wait till they splutter. After they splutter add besan, mawa and saute them well till the raw smell goes off. Now add red chilli powder, cumin powder, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt and the restored water and bring it to boil. Now add the gattas and cook them well for few minutes. Whisk the curd well and add in the wok carefully. Step 4: Stir them well and cook the gravy for few minutes till the oil float on the gravy. Turn off the flames and garnish with fresh chopped coriander and serve Rajasthani Govind Gatta Curry Recipe with Garlic Naan Without Yeast Recipe and Bharma Baingan Aur Pyaaz Ki Sabzi Recipe (Spicy Stuffed Brinjals With Onions).

Dish Name: Rajasthani Style Dried Gatta Capsicum Vegetable
Ingredient Names: gram flour, carom seeds, red chili powder, curd, sunflower oil, salt, green bell pepper, cumin seeds, asafoetida, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, dry mango powder, coriander powder, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe we will first make the gatte. In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients for the gatta. Step 2: Add a few teaspoons of water at a time and knead to make a firm dough. Knead well for about to make a very soft melt in the mouth gatta. Step 3: If you add more water and it does not shape into a dough, then you will have to add more gram flour and knead it well. Roll the dough into a long cylinder and cut them into discs. Step 4: The next step is to cook the gattas in boiling water. In a large saucepan boil water. Step 5: Once the water comes to a brisk boil, add the gattas into the water and boil until they comes floating to the top. Step 6: Once they come floating to the top, boil for another 3 to. Step 7: Drain the gattas and keep it aside. To make the Sabzi, in a sauce pan add oil, add cumin seeds and asafoetida, allow the cumin seeds to crackle for few seconds. Once that is done, you can add chopped bell peppers (Capsicum) and saute until the capsicum become slightly soft. Turn the heat to low, add red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, coriander powder, amchoor and salt. Add the cooked gattas at this stage, mix well to combine and sprinkle some water and cook until the raw smell of spice goes away. Saute for another 3-4 minutes and switch off the heat and garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve the Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe along with Kadhi Pakoras, Mooli Paratha and Kadai Paneer Recipe to make it a rich meal for your Sunday lunch.

Dish Name: Sepu Vadi (Himachali Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy)
Ingredient Names: urad dal, ginger, salt, fruit salt, lemon juice, sunflower oil, spinach, curd, mustard oil, dry red chili, cloves, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, bay leaf, cumin seeds, green chili, asafoetida, coriander powder, cumin powder, red chili powder, fennel powder, black pepper powder, dill leaves
Instructions: Step 1: For the Dumplings (Vadi)To make Sepu Vadi Recipe (Himachali Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy), make the dumplings by washing and soaking urad dal (split black gram) in about 1.water overnight. Drain and wash the dal. Heat water in a steamer and let it boil. In a blender/grinder jar, combine washed and drained urad dal, ginger, green chilli and grind to make a smooth paste adding about ¼ cup water gradually, so that the mixture is very thick and forms a paste. Take the paste in a bowl and add salt. Step 2: Whisk it well till it becomes light and fluffy. Add eno and lemon juice and immediately transfer the mixture to a greased plate and steam for about 10-12 minutes. Remove from steamer and insert a toothpick to check whether it is done. Step 3: If toothpick comes out clean, our vadi is ready. Step 4: If it doesn’t come out clean, steam for another few minutes more. Meanwhile heat enough oil in a deep frying pan to fry the vadis. Cut the steamed vadis into square pieces. Deep fry the vadi pieces in hot oil till they are crisp and golden in colour. For the Palak PureeSoak Palak leaves in a bowl of water and pinch of salt for about 10 minutes. Remove the stems from the leaves. Step 5: Roughly chop the leaves. Add water in a wide pan and bring to a boil. Step 6: Then add spinach leaves and cook for 10 minutes. Immediately remove and soak the leaves in a bowl of ice cold water for a minute. Step 7: Drain all the excess water. In a mixer/blender jar, add blanched palak leaves, dill leaves and about water and blend till you get a smooth puree. Keep the spinach puree aside. For the GravyHeat oil in a kadai. Step 8: Add dry red chilli, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, bay leaf and cumin seeds. Once they splutter, add green chilli and hing. Step 9: Saute for a couple of seconds. Now turn off the flame and add jeera powder, dhaniya powder, red chili powder, fennel powder and black pepper powder, mix well. Step 10: Turn on the flame and saute for on a low flame so that spice powders does not burn. Add spinach puree and cook for about 5 minutes. Now add salt, whisked curd and the fried sepu vadis and let it simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 11: At this stage, you may add required quantity of water as per the consistency of the gravy you prefer. Step 12: Switch off heat once the gravy is well combined. Serve Sepu Vadi Recipe (Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy) with Papad Parathas Recipe, Pudina Tawa Paratha (Mint Leaf Skillet Flat Bread) or steamed rice.

Dish Name: Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings in Red Oil )
Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, sunflower oil, cabbage, green peas, onion, soy sauce, red chili sauce, honey, salt, sesame oil, sesame seeds, water, brown sugar, cinnamon stick, star anise, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: We begin making the Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings in Red Oil Recipe) by mixing the ingredients to make a dough for the wonton wrappers in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Add enough water to get a soft but not a sticky dough consistency. Step 3: Once done cover it with a damp cloth so that it does not become dry. The next step is to make the stuffing for the dumplings, heat a heavy bottomed shallow pan, and add oil and sauté the garlic, ginger onions, cabbage, peas and spring onions for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Cook until the cabbage is soft and crunchy. Once done add soya sauce, Sichuan chili paste, honey, salt and pepper according to your taste. Step 5: Give it a toss so that the sauces are well coated with all the vegetables. Step 6: Set it aside to cool down. Next to make the chili oil, heat a small flat bottomed pan, heat the oil and add the Sichuan chili paste and sesame seeds. Step 7: Let it cook in the oil for few minutes till the aroma comes out and keep it aside. To make the soya sauce concentration, heat a sauce pan with all the ingredients combined. Step 8: Keep the heat low and slowly let it boil and keep stirring occasionally to combine the ingredients well. Step 9: After switch off the heat. Now it is time to roll the wonton wrappers, divide the dough into small ball shaped balls, roll each ball on a board, the dough has to be rolled very thin making sure it does not tear. Step 10: Roll the dough into a circle shape. Once done, in a small bowl keep some water ready to bind the wonton mixture, Take a teaspoon of the filling and place it in the center of the rolled dough, dab some water on the edges of the dough. Form a taco shape and pinch at one end and seal till the middle, then join the opposite side to the middle to form a triangle shape. Step 11: Make sure all the edges are sealed properly. Heat a vegetable gas steamer by adding one cup of water below, apply some oil on the plate where the dumpling are kept, once the water starts to boil, place all the dumplings and cover them. Step 12: Let it cook for 10 minutes. Remove the dumplings after it is cooked, place it on a plate, add a teaspoon of chili oil and drizzle the concentrated soya on top and serve. Serve the Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings in Red Oil Recipe) along withDinner meal.

Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, dried oregano, dried thyme leaves, parsley leaves, extra virgin olive oil, red chili flakes, salt, sunflower oil, cheese, garlic, baby spinach, onion, vegetable stock, black pepper powder, italian seasoning, tortellini
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Spinach And Tortellini Soup recipe, combine the plain flour, oregano, thyme, parsley, dry red chilli flakes, olive oil and salt in a deep bowl and knead into a firm dough using enough water. Cover with a wet muslin cloth and keep aside for 5 minutes. Step 2: Divide the dough into 2 equal portions. Step 3: Roll out each portion of the dough into 250 mm. Step 4: (10”) diameter circle using a little plain flour for rolling. Cut into circles using a 50 mm. Step 5: (2”) cookie cutter to get 5 roundels. Step 6: Keep doing till all the dough is over, to get 20 roundels in all. Step 7: Place one roundel on a clean, dry surface and put cheese in the center. Fold over to make a semi-circle and press the edges lightly with your fingers to seal it. Bring both the corners of the semi-circle one over the other and again pinch it with your fingers to seal it together. Repeat steps 7 to 9 to make the remaining 19 herb tortellini. Step 8: Boil enough water in a deep non-stick pan, with salt and oil. Step 9: Add the prepared tortellini, few at a time and cook on a medium flame for 3 to. Step 10: Drain and keep aside. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Step 11: Add onion, garlic, and salt and cook for a couple of minutes. Step 12: Stir in stock, bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to simmer until veggies are tender. Step 13: Remove lid and add spinach and tortellini. Step 14: Cook for few minutes, stir in parsley and black pepper, Italian seasoning to taste. Step 15: Ladle into bowls and add grated cheese on top. Serve Spinach And Tortellini Soup along with Garlic Bread and Savory Melon Salad for your weekday dinner.

Ingredient Names: chicken, tandoori masala, curd, lemon, salt, tomato puree, tomato ketchup, fresh cream, red chili powder, cashew nuts, potato, carrot, green peas, chaat masala powder, black pepper powder, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Stuffed Chicken Recipe With Mixed Vegetables, wash and clean the chicken thoroughly well. Now marinate the whole chicken with tandoori masala, curd, salt and lemon juice. Step 2: Let the chicken marinate for about 2 hours. After, bake the marinated chicken at 425 F for 2 hours. Make stuffing in a large mixing bowl by mixing boiled potatoes, Carrots,peas, coriander leaves,chaat masala, salt and black pepper. Step 3: Set it aside. Preheat oven to 350 degree F. Heat oil in a pan on medium flame, to this add tomato puree, tomato ketchup, salt, red chilli powder and the cashew paste. Step 4: Once the mixture begins to bubble up, turn down the heat, and add in the cream. Step 5: Simmer for a couple of minutes more until the gravy is nice thick and creamy. Step 6: Now cut open the chicken to slice in middle and stuff with vegetable stuffing and top it with tomato gravy then bake it on 350 degrees F for 25-30 minutes. Serve Stuffed Chicken Recipe With Mixed Vegetables along with Butter Garlic Naan Recipe (Garlic Flavoured Flat Bread) and Carrot Cucumber Tomato Salad with Lemon and Coriander Recipe.

Dish Name: White Vegetable Kurma With Coconut & Cashew
Ingredient Names: carrot, potatoes, cauliflower, onion, ginger garlic paste, salt, sunflower oil, fresh coconut, whole black peppercorns, green chilies, fennel seeds, poppy seeds, cashew nuts, cinnamon stick, star anise, cloves, cardamom pods, cumin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew, wash the vegetables - carrot, potato, cauliflower, chop into small pieces, keep aside. Step 2: Keep the potato immersed in water until use. In a mixer jar, combine the grated coconut, peppercorns, green chilli, fennel seeds, poppy seeds, cashews. Add little water and grind into smooth paste. Step 3: Keep aside. Heat a kadai with oil and add the spices - cinnamon, star anise, cloves, cardamom and cumin seeds. Step 4: Allow them to sizzle. Step 5: Add ginger-garlic paste and saute until raw smell goes. Step 6: Now add chopped onion and saute until translucent without turning brown. Step 7: Add the chopped vegetables and saute for a minute. Step 8: Pour the required water for cooking vegetables along with required salt. Mix and cook covered in medium flame until the veggies are cooked through. Step 9: Then add the ground coconut paste along with required quantity of water for the gravy, check for salt. Step 10: Cook on low flame for few minutes until it is combined well and starts boiling. Remove from flame. Step 11: The delicious white veg kurma is ready. Step 12: Serve White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew along with Muttai Parotta Recipe ( Ande Ka Paratha / Egg Filled Flat Bread) and Kerala Style Egg Roast Curry Recipe.

Dish Name: Andhra Style Mirapakaya Bajji - Stuffed Chilli
Ingredient Names: green chili, roasted gram dal, red chili powder, cumin powder, carom seeds, chaat masala powder, tamarind, asafoetida, salt, gram flour, rice flour, fruit salt, sunflower oil, onion, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Andhra Style Mirapakaya bajji Recipe, wash the chillies and cut them in the middle. Step 2: Deseed them and keep it aside. Step 3: Be sure to wash your hands after deseeding. Step 4: In a mixer jar combine the roasted chana dal, red chilli powder, cumin seeds, ajwain seeds, chaat masala, tamarind, hing and grind it a mixer by adding water to a smooth mixture. Stuff this mixture into each of the hollow chilies. Move on to make the batter by mixing all the ingredients- besan, rice flour, red chilli powder, enos salt, salt in a bowl with water to a smooth thick batter. Heat a kadai with oil to deep fry the chillies on medium-low flame. Step 5: Check if the oil is hot by dropping a little amount of batter into the oil. Step 6: If the batter rises up quickly then it is hot enough. Dip the green chilies into the batter and coat it evenly, carefully drop the chilies into the hot oil and fry. Step 7: Turn the chilies after 30 seconds so that it has an even brown color all over. Take out the chilies using a slotted spoon and place it on a kitchen paper towel to drain the oil. Step 8: Do the same for the rest of the chilies. Mix the onion and coriander leaves together and add it on top as a garnish. Step 9: Serve the Andhra Style Mirapakaya bajji Recipe along with hot cup of tea for your evening snack.

Dish Name: Asian Style Baby Corn With Sesame Seeds and Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: baby corn, tofu, water, corn flour, rice flour, salt, sunflower oil, green bell peppers, capsicum, light soy sauce, garlic, fresh red chili, rice vinegar, honey, onion, raw peanuts, fresh orange juice, orange marmalade, paprika powder, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To begin with Asian Style Baby Corn With Sesame Seeds & Peanut Sauce, firstly blanch baby corns in hot water for to soften them and cut paneer into 1/2" cubes. In a bowl take baby corns and paneer and all the marinating ingredients, mix well and let it sit for about an hour. Make a stiff batter by mixing corn flour and water. Step 2: Coat each baby corns and paneer with batter and roll in rice flour. Heat oil in a wok and fry the corn and paneer till they change their colour. Heat oil in a heavy wok, stir fry the onions and capsicums. The next step is to make the peanut sauce. Step 3: For the sauce, add marmalade jam and corn flour in the orange juice. Heat oil in a pan and add garlic and onions. Step 4: Saute it till the onions changes its colour. Once it is done, add yellow paprika and orange juice mixture in it. Step 5: Let it cook till the mixture becomes thick. Later, add peanuts and salt according to your taste. Step 6: Stir it continuously till the sauce becomes thick. Step 7: Add a little vinegar if required. Switch off the heat and pour the sauce on the deep fried paneer and baby corns. Step 8: Mix everything properly and garnish it with spring onions and sesame seeds. Serve Asian Style Baby Corn With Sesame Seeds & Peanut Sauce with Thai Style Noodles With Spinach and Leeks.

Dish Name: Baba Ganouy Baba Ghanoush Baba Gannoujh
Ingredient Names: eggplants, lemon, tahini, garlic cloves, parsley, salt, scallion, black pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: First off, buy only shiny eggplants-dull ones are old. Step 2: Cut off the stem ends of eggplants and prick them like you would a spud for baking. Step 3: Place on the middle rack in oven and bake at 250 degrees for about 1 hour They should look quite pooped out. Step 4: Using mitts remove and cool to touch. Step 5: Cut open and scoop out-toss the peel. Step 6: Place in a food processor with all the ingredients except oil Whirl away-until smooth. Step 7: Taste and adjust-remember the pepper and garlic will get stronger. Step 8: Place in a serving dish and cover with oil if not serving right away.

Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, gram flour, turmeric powder, kashmiri red chili powder, ghee, salt, water, poppy seeds, sesame seeds, desiccated coconut, ginger, green chili, coriander powder, garam masala powder, cumin powder, carom seeds, asafoetida, coriander leaves, mint leaves, sugar, lemon, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Baked Bhakarwadi Recipe, in a medium bowl add all the ingredients listed under "For the Dough" like the all purpose flour, gram flour, turmeric powder, kashmiri red chilli powder, ghee, salt to taste and stir well. Step 2: Add water little by little and knead until you get a firm dough. Step 3: Cover with a damp cloth and keep aside. Heat up a pan, add poppy seeds and sesame seeds. Step 4: Roast them on low flame until nice aroma comes out. Step 5: Once done transfer the seeds to a bowl and keep aside. In the same pan roast dry coconut until slightly golden. Step 6: Remove that and keep aside. Step 7: In a mixer add roasted poppy seeds, sesame seeds, coconut and all the other ingredients (Except sugar) listed under "For the Filling". Step 8: Pulse couple of times so that everything is mixed well. Step 9: Now add the sugar and stir with a spoon. Step 10: Keep the Bhakarwadi filling aside. Preheat oven to 180 C. Step 11: Keep your work space ready by greasing the place with a few drops of oil. Step 12: Divide the Bhakarwadi dough to 3 equal balls. Step 13: Work one by one. Place one ball and roll out thin. Step 14: Brush with some lemon juice. Step 15: Spread 1/3rd of the prepared filling. Step 16: Press with your hand to keep the filling in place. Step 17: Roll in from the corners and until the end to get a cylindrical roll. Press well on the top. Step 18: Use a knife and cut them in sized pieces pinwheels. Step 19: Arrange the filled Bhakarwadi on a baking tray lined with wax paper. Step 20: Bake the Bhakarwadi for about 35 to or until brown and crispy. Step 21: Cool down and store in an airtight container. Serve Baked Bhakarwadi Recipe as a tea time snack along with a hot cup of Adrak Chai.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, sunflower oil, baking soda, salt, water, cauliflower, potato, raw peanuts, ginger, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, asafoetida, dry red chili, green chilies, turmeric powder, sugar, dried fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Baked Cauliflower Samosa Recipe, prepare all the ingredients and start with making the dough. In a bowl, add atta (wheat flour), oil, salt and baking soda. Step 2: Keep mixing with hand until the dough becomes crumbly enough to take a shape. Add water and make a medium tight dough, almost like chapathi dough. Step 3: Cover it and rest it for 10 minutes. For Stuffing In a frying pan, heat oil, add raw peanuts, fry a bit till roasted, and then add dried whole red chilli, hing powder, fennel and cumin seeds for tadka and saute a bit. After seeds start crackling add blanched cauliflower and diced potato. Fry for about 3-4 minutes then add salt, sugar, turmeric powder, grated ginger and green chillies. Step 4: Mix it properly then let it cook on low heat. Step 5: Stir occasionally until vegetables are well cooked. Step 6: Add kasuri methi and let it cool before proceeding to stuffing it.
