Making SamosasPreheat oven into 350 F(180 C). Divide dough into 6-7 balls. Step 7: With a rolling pin roll each dough in a round shape to medium thickness then cut them in the middle. Step 8: Take one portion of the flattened dough and shape like a cone overlapping the flat side together. Step 9: Now put 1 and stuffing inside the samosa cone and seal the edges with brushing water on the edges. Step 10: Cover them with kitchen towel otherwise it will dry out. In a baking tray, place a parchment paper and line up all samosas. Step 11: Spray some cooking oil over them. Bake samosas for 25-30 minutes or when it nice golden in color. Step 12: Cooking time varies from oven to oven so after check them, when done, you can take them out and allow them to cool a bit before serving for snacks. Enjoy this Baked Cauliflower Samosa Recipe with Khajur Imli Chutney or plain tomato ketchup with a hot cup of Ginger Cardamom Chai for an evening.

Ingredient Names: bananas, all-purpose flour, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Take the flour in a bowl. Step 2: Add water, a little at a time, stirring continuously to make a paste. Step 3: Cut the bananas into half, lengthwise. Step 4: Dip the bananas into the flour batter. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok or deep frying pan. Step 6: When the oil is hot, take each slice of banana and put gently into the oil. Step 7: Fry them until golden. Step 8: Serve them hot with tea!

Dish Name: Black Eyed Pea Chorizo Hummus Zwt 8
Ingredient Names: black-eyed peas, chorizo sausage, onion, garlic cloves, cream cheese, tahini, ground cumin, lemon juice, parsley, lemon zest, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat med-sized sauce pot on med-high heat. Step 2: Add chorizo to render fat & brown. Step 3: Reduce heat to med. Step 4: Add onions + garlic & cook until tender. Step 5: Add cans of black eyed peas w / their liquid & bring mixture to a boil. Step 6: Cook for 2 min & reduce to a simmer. Step 7: Reduce liquid by half. Step 8: Add cream cheese, tahini, cumin, lemon juice, parsley & lemon zest, combine well. Step 9: Transfer mixture to a food processor to puree.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, cheddar cheese, sherry wine, curry powder, chutney, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix softened cheeses together until well blended. Step 2: Add wine and curry powder, mix well. Step 3: Place on a platter and arrange into a pie shaped wedge about 1" high Frost completely with chutney and sprinkle with the scallions over the top This can be make several days ahead of serving Just keep refrigerated until ready to serve. Step 4: Serve with crackers.

Ingredient Names: popped popcorn, butter, curry powder, salt, sugar, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Place popcorn in a large bowl Microwave butter 20 seconds or until melted. Step 2: Stir in curry powder until well blended. Step 3: Drizzle seasoned butter over popcorn and stir to distribute. Step 4: Sprinkle with salt, sugar and optional ingredients. Step 5: Stir gently until blended.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, honey, cayenne, ground cumin, curry powder, unsalted almonds, unsweetened coconut, coarse sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan to medium and add the oil. Step 2: Stir in the honey and cayenne, cumin and curry powder. Step 3: Once the oil and honey are combined, add the nuts and stir until all the nuts are evenly coated. Step 4: Add the toasted coconut and gently stir until the nuts are evenly coated with coconut. Step 5: Season with coarse sea salt to taste Immediately transfer nuts to a large non-stick baking sheet and spread them out to cool. Step 6: Transfer to a bowl and serve.

Dish Name: Cauliflower With Toasted Cumin Paprika Caper Vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: cumin seed, sherry wine vinegar, garlic, paprika, capers, olive oil, cauliflower, fresh parsley, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saut pan over medium-low heat, add the cumin seeds. Step 2: Stir frequently, until fragrant and slightly darkened, about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from the heat and let cool. Step 4: In a mixing bowl, combine the vinegar, cooled cumin, garlic, paprika and capers Slowly drizzle in the olive oil. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Set aside In the sink, prepare a large bowl of ice water. Step 7: In a 4-quart pot with salted boiling water, cook the cauliflower until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 8: Drain and immediately plunge into the ice water.

Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, sunflower oil, salt, water, carom seeds, baking soda, potatoes, green peas, onion, cheese, green chili, ginger, dried fenugreek, cumin seeds, dry mango powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, coriander powder, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: For the doughTo begin making Cheesy Potato Peas Potli Recipe, first start with preparing the dough. Step 2: Mix the all purpose flour, ajwain, salt, baking soda and oil in a mixing bowl. Step 3: Now add water as required to form a firm dough. Step 4: Knead a dough that is not too soft or hard. Step 5: Cover it with a moist kitchen cloth and keep it aside. For the fillingHeat oil in a pan. Step 6: Add cumin seeds to hot oil and allow to crackle. Once they crackle, add ginger paste and green chillies and sauté it for a minute or till the rawness disappears. Now add finely chopped onions and sauté till onions turns translucent. Step 7: It might take on low/ medium flame. Add boiled and mashed potatoes and coarsely crushed green peas. When the green peas are cooked, add the dry masala powders: turmeric powder, coriander powder, kasuri methi, red chilli powder, amchur powder, garam masala and salt. Step 8: Mix well. Add coriander leaves and mix well. Step 9: Saute for about a minute and switch off the flame, let it cool. Step 10: Once the filling cools, add the grated cheese and mix well to combine. For making the potli’sKnead the dough lightly again and roll the dough lengthwise with the help of rolling pin. Make small round balls out of this (like you would make for puri). Step 11: You can use a cookie cutter or the lid to make the roundels. Roll out on a lightly floured surface till about 6 inches in diameter. Now, put the above prepared stuffing in the center. Close and give shape of a potli (Small Basket). Likewise, repeat for all the balls of dough. Step 12: As you go on making them, cover them with a kitchen towel so that the outer cover does not dry out. Preheat the oven at 180 degree centigrade. Brush all the potlis with some oil on all the sides. Now bake them in the oven at 180 degree centigrade for 25-30 minutes or till the crust is golden brown and crisp. Step 13: Serve Cheesy Potato Peas Potli Recipe along with tomato ketchup, Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and Peanut Chilli Dipping Sauce Recipe.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, greek yogurt, turmeric powder, salt, sunflower oil, onion, garlic, ginger, fresh coconut, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, nigella seeds, whole black peppercorns, dry red chilies, fennel seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, mustard seeds, ghee, tamarind paste, jaggery, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe, thoroughly wash and clean the chicken leg, keep it aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan, on medium flame. Step 3: Add onions, coconut, ginger and garlic and cook till the onions become soft and the coconut turn light brown in colour. Turn off the flame and grind to a coarse paste with a little water in a mixer grinder. The next step is to marinate the chicken. Step 4: In a mixing bowl, add the onion coconut paste, yogurt, turmeric powder and chicken legs. Mix everything well and ensure that the chicken is properly quoted with the masala. Step 5: Keep it aside for 5 minutes. For the Chettinad Spice MixHeat a heavy bottomed pan. Step 6: Add chettinad spice mix ingredients - includes cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, kalonji, black peppercorn, dry red chillies, fennel seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom and mustard seeds. Dry roast them for about 25-30 minutes. Step 7: Once done, let it cool down a bit. Step 8: Now, add thes spices into a mixer grinder and grind it into a powder. Heat ghee in the same pan and add this Chettinad spice mix into the ghee. Step 9: After 30 seconds, add the chicken along with all the marinade. Mix everything well, add the tamarind pulp, jaggery and water. Step 10: Cover the pan and cook for about 8 to or till the chicken is 3/4th done. Turn off flame. Step 11: Take out the chicken pieces seperatly and keep the masala aside. Heat a grill pan on high heat, until smoking hot and place only the chicken leg on it. Let this get a nice crispy skin by cooking it for about 5 minutes on each side. Step 12: Once done, turn off the heat and keep the chicken piece on a plate. The final step is to temper the chicken. Step 13: To make the tempering, heat ghee in a tadka pan on medium flame. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves and allow it to crackle. Step 14: Add the chopped garlic and fry till golden brown. Step 15: Turn off the flame. To assemble the Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe, in a serving plate, place the chicken leg, top it with the thick masala and garnish with the tadka. Step 16: It is ready to be served. Serve this Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe on its own as a party starter or with Kerala Style Appam Recipe (Without Yeast) or Mangalorean Neer Dosa Recipe (Savory Rice & Coconut Crepe) for a complete meal.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, chili peppers, curry powder, mustard seeds, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil Add onion, small hot chilies, curry powder, and mustard seed Fry just a little Add chickpeas until lightly toasted.

Ingredient Names: ghee, onions, garlic cloves, chopped tomatoes, ground turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, cremini mushroom, sugar, salt, plain yogurt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the ghee in a large skillet or wok, over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onion and saute, stirring frequently for about 5-8 minutes until they are golden. Step 3: Stir in the garlic and saute another 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the chopped tomatoes and their juice and mix. Step 5: Stir in the turmeric, garam masala and chili powder and continue cooking for an additional 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the mushrooms, sugar, and salt, to taste, and cook for about 8 minutes until they have given off their liquid and are soft and tender. Step 7: Turn off the heat and stir in the yogurt, a little at a time, stirring very well so it doesn't curdle. Step 8: Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Step 9: Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: butter, salt, turmeric, cayenne pepper, mustard seeds, rice krispies, puffed rice cereal
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter or ghee. Step 2: Add the salt, turmeric, cayenne pepper, and mustard seed. Step 3: Heat spices until the mustard seeds pop, turn off the heat. Step 4: Place cereals in a large bowl. Step 5: Stir in the butter mixture. Step 6: Stir until all the cereal is completely coated.

Ingredient Names: sweet corn, fresh carrot, capsicum, onions, fresh coriander, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, potato, bread crumbs, corn flour, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a mixer jar take 1 cup sweet corn, pulse, and grind to coarse texture. Step 2: Transfer the coarse sweet corn into a large bowl. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp carrot, 2 tbsp capsicum, ½ onion, 2 tbsp coriander. Step 4: Also add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, and ½ tsp salt. Step 5: Now add 2 potato and mix well making sure all the spices are well combined. Step 6: Further, add ¼ cup bread crumbs and 2 tbsp corn flour. Step 7: Mix well forming a soft dough. corn flour helps to make cutlet crispy and bread crumbs absorbs excess moisture and prevents from breaking in oil while frying. Step 8: Grease hands with oil, and shape the cutlet. Step 9: Deep fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 10: Stir occasionally, until the cutlet turns golden brown and crispy. Step 11: Drain off the cutlet over a kitchen towel to remove excess oil. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Crispy Corn Cutlet Recipe with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: bhetki fish, onion, garlic, green chilies, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, tomato ketchup, sugar, sunflower oil, salt, potatoes, black pepper powder, egg, all purpose flour, whole wheat bread crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Croquettes Recipe With Bhetki Fish, for the fish stuffing, in a mixing bowl, add the fish steaks, quartered onions, crushed garlic cloves, bay leaves, crushed green cardamom, cinnamon, a generous sprinkle of salt and about a cup of water to a pressure cooker.(You can also pressure cook the potatoes separately during this process and allow to cook and then mash the potatoes after deskinning them)Cook over a high heat, one whistle I would reckon on. Allow the pressure to be released by itself. Step 2: Once it cools down on its own, carefully debone the fish steaks, and mash the fish with a wooden masher or ladle. Step 3: Keep aside till needed. Heat about oil in a pan, once hot, add the chopped onions and garlic, fry on medium high heat till close to caramelised. Add the chopped green chillies, saute for a minute or two. Add the mashed fish, tomato ketchup, salt and sugar. Cook on a low heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until combined well enough. Step 4: Switch off and allow to cool till luke warm so that it is easy to handle with bare hands. Form 10 oval roundels and keep aside. Assembling and frying the Fish CroquettesSprinkle a little salt and black pepper to the mashed potatoes and mix well till combined. Divide the potatoes into 10 equal portions. Take one portion of mashed potato in the palm of your hand, make a well in the center. Place a portion of the fish filling in the potato well, bring the corners of the potato case together and cover the fish stuffing. Step 5: (It should be a very thin coating of mashed potato over the fish stuffing)Gently shape into elongated croquettes. Step 6: Keep a plate of flour, a bowl of whisked eggs, and a plate of bread crumbs are ready, Roll the croquettes over flour, and dip into whipped egg and roll over breadcrumbs. Keep aside in the refrigerator to set, for about 1 hour or more is good enough. Heat oil in deep frying pan, once hot, deep fry till golden. Take out on a kitchen towel to soak up the extra oil. Croquettes Recipe With Bhetki Fish can be served as an evening snack along with dips like tomato ketchup, Peanut Chilli Dipping Sauce Recipe or Tzatziki Recipe - A Greek Yogurt Dip, with a steaming cup of Homemade Hot Chocolate with Whipped Cream Recipe or Coffee Recipe With Instant Coffee Powder.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, cottage cheese, curry powder, green onion, dry roasted peanuts, raisins, coconut, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Beat cream cheese and cottage cheese until smooth. Step 2: Add curry through coconut. Step 3: Stir until incorporated. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate overnight Form into two balls and wrap in wax paper. Step 5: Chill six more hours Plate and pour chutney over cheese if desired. Step 6: Serve with sesame crackers.

Dish Name: Delicious Cauliflower N Cheese Sandwich Filling
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, cauliflower, coriander powder, cumin powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, vegetable stock powder, cheddar cheese, fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves, white bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Step 2: Add onion and stir-fry until its transparent. Step 3: Add cauliflower and stir-fry for 4 minuts. Step 4: Add coriander, cumin, garam masala and red chilli powder. Step 5: Mix in the grated maggi cube powder. Step 6: Add few tbsps Of water to cook the cauliflower. Step 7: Cook until the mixture is dry. Step 8: Add chopped coriander, mint and grated cheese, mix well.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, cottage cheese, curry powder, green onion, dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, golden raisin, flaked coconut, mango chutney, mango
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Step 3: Add green onions and next 3 ingredients. Step 4: Beat at low speed until mixed well, stir in chutney. Step 5: Cover and chill slightly. Step 6: Divide cheese mixture in half. Step 7: Shape each portion into a 12-inch log. Step 8: Wrap in wax paper, and chill 6 hours or until firm. Step 9: Place cheese logs on a serving tray.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, rice flour, cumin powder, chili powder, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all except oil with water till a stiff dough forms Push directly into hot oil, through a murukku mould to get fine strands or ribbons. Step 2: Fry until golden, turn over and cook the other side till golden, drain.

Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, chickpea flour, salt, cayenne pepper, black pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and cut boiled egg into two halves. Step 2: Sprinkle little salt and pepper on eggs. Step 3: In a bowl mix the chickpea flour with salt and cayenne to taste and make a thick batter by adding a little water. Step 4: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 5: Dip each egg piece in the batter and deep fry till golden brown. Step 6: Serve egg pakora hot.

Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, pepper, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Make around six slits on the eggs, do not go deep into the egg white, otherwise it would split. Step 2: Mix the chilli powder, turmeric powder, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a paste, add little water if necessary. Step 3: Roll the eggs and coat it properly. Step 4: Leave for a couple of minutes for the mixture to properly coat. Step 5: Heat pan and pour oil, let it heat. Step 6: Fry the eggs till golden brown. Step 7: Serve with ketchup.

Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, mayonnaise, green onions, jalapeno chile, mango chutney, garam masala, radish
Instructions: Step 1: Shell eggs, then cut in half lengthwise. Step 2: Transfer yolks to small bowl and mash with fork, mix in mayonnaise. Step 3: Stir in next 4 ingredients. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Spoon yolk mixture into whites. Step 6: Top generously with chopped radishes.

Dish Name: Garam Masala Dipping Sauce With Pita Wedges
Ingredient Names: plain low-fat yogurt, plum tomato, onion, garam masala, salt, pita bread
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl Cover and chill 1 hour Serve with pita wedges.

Ingredient Names: darjeeling tea, milk, water, gingerroot, cardamom seeds, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the water in a saucepan. Step 2: Once it starts to boil add the tea powder. Step 3: Meanwhile grind the ginger and cardamom and add it to the saucepan. Step 4: After 3-4 minutes of boiling add the milk allow it to boil for 3-4 more minutes The strength of the tea can be adjusted by the ratio of milk and water. Step 5: Now strain the tea and serve immediately. Step 6: Add sugar according to ones taste The amount of ginger can also be adjusted as per ones taste.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, panir, spinach, green peas, fresh ginger, green chilies, cornflour, salt, pepper, mango powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 teaspoon oil and fry chopped ginger for 30 seconds. Step 2: Add chopped spinach and mashed green peas, continue frying for 1 minute. Step 3: Remove from fire and mix with chillies, mashed potato, paneer and cornflour. Step 4: Add all the spices to this and mix well. Step 5: Make small patties from this mixture and deep fry till golden brown.

Dish Name: Hummus W A Tomato Twissis Twist My Invention Zwt 8 India
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, tahini, garlic cloves, lemon pepper, salt, lemon juice, olive oil, red pesto sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Drain & reserve the liquid from the canned chickpeas & rinse thoroughly. Step 2: Allow to drain again of any excess water. Step 3: Combine all ingredients in a food-proc, whiz to a thick paste & add reserved chickpea liquid to achieve desired consistency. Step 4: Taste & adjust to suit preferences Done! Step 5: I add 1 can of the drained & rinsed chickpeas to the jar w / the rest of the ingredients & whiz til fully combined. Step 6: Then i add the 2nd can of chickpeas as a final step Ck to be sure all chickpeas have been macerated Most popular w / guests & family has been to serve this w / olive oil & garlic-flavored pita bread triangles crisped in the oven I also sprinkle a bit of dried parsley on them for color & i always make the hummus & pita crisps at least a dy ahead of intent to serve.

Ingredient Names: greek yogurt, onion, green chilies, coriander leaves, mint leaves, salt, boneless chicken, chana dal, red chili powder, turmeric powder, ginger, garlic, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, cloves, whole black peppercorns, carom seeds, egg, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Hyderabadi Chicken Shikampuri Kebab Recipe, firstly heat water in a pan and add chicken pieces, chana dal, crushed cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves, black pepper, shahi jeera, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, chopped ginger and garlic. Cover the lid and cook till the chicken is done and the dal is soft cooked. Step 2: Discard excess water since more water will ruin it. Step 3: Allow to cool and grind everything together to make a fine paste. Add egg, chopped mint and coriander into the mixture and mix well. Step 4: Keep aside. Meanwhile, take a bowl and prepare the filling by mixing the hung curd with finely minced onion, salt, green chili and coriander powder. Pinch a lemon size ball of the kebab paste and flatten it between your palms like a disc. Place a small filling of the hung curd and cover up the filling. Cover from all sides nicely and again flatten it to shape a disc and place on a tray lined with parchment paper. Heat a skillet or shallow frying pan with a little oil. Once the oil is hot, fry in hot oil till browned on a medium heat and flip to brown evenly on the other side too. Transfer the kebabs once shallow fried, on a kitchen napkin to soak excess oil. Serve the Hyderabadi Chicken Shikampuri Kebab Recipe along with dips like Dhaniya Pudina Chutney Recipe (Green Chutney) and other appetizers like Tawa Crispy Pomfret Fry Recipe for your house parties.

Dish Name: Indian Cauliflower Rice Raw Foods Sushi
Ingredient Names: olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, cinnamon, sunflower seeds, italian parsley, salt, turmeric, fennel seed, cauliflower, nori, sesame oil, tamari, sugar, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, add cauliflower. Step 2: Blend until desired rice consistency. Step 3: Add first 9 ingredients until well combined, set aside. Step 4: In a blender combine sesame oil, tamari, sugar, lime juice. Step 5: Blend until well combined. Step 6: Set aside On a flat surface, place one nori roll and fill entire surface with indian wild rice. Step 7: Repeat process for more nori sheets At the edge closest to you, place a small line of carrot, then small line of radish, small line of alfalfa, small line of spinach, and small line of beetroot.

Ingredient Names: corn chex, shredded wheat cereal, rice krispies, chow mein noodles, red pepper powder, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, asafoetida, garlic powder, salt, turmeric powder, spanish peanuts, cooking oil, onion, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix cereals together Do not mix in noodles. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 3: Fry mustard seeds and cumin seeds well. Step 4: Add noodles and heat for approximately 2 minutes. Step 5: Add other spices and mix well, mix in peanuts. Step 6: Add two handfuls of the cereal mix and mix well. Step 7: Add oil mix to remaining cereal mix in bowl and stir well. Step 8: Place in baking dish and cook in 250 degree oven for 25- 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, sunflower oil, garlic, ginger, green chilies, onion, green bell pepper, soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper powder, salt, red chili sauce, green chili sauce, tomato pasta sauce, corn flour, water, all purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli recipe, firstly let us marinate the chicken. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine, black pepper powder, soy sauce, red chilli sauce, corn flour, and maidaAdd a little water to make it a smooth batter. Step 3: Make sure that the batter is neither too thick nor too runny. The next step is to coat the chicken pieces in the batter for the Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli recipe. Once they are coated well, deep fry them on medium-high in a deep fry pan. Step 4: Drain them on a tissue paper to absorb the extra oil. Step 5: Keep them aside. Heat oil in a wide skillet on medium flame, add ginger, garlic and green chillies. Step 6: Saute it for about a minute. After a minute, add onion, green bell pepper and salt. Step 7: Toss them on high flame. Step 8: Do not over cook, as we want the crunchiness in the vegetables. Now bring the flame back to medium and add soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper powder, green chilli sauce, tomato sauce and red chilli sauce. Step 9: Again bring the flame to high and toss them properly. After 2 to, mix cornflour with water and add it to the veggies. Step 10: When its cooked, add the fried chicken pieces. Adjust the salt according to your taste and mix it properly so that the chicken pieces are well coated with the prepared sauce. Once it is done, switch off the stove and Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli ready to be served. Serve Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli with Hakka Noodles or Szechuan Vegetarian Fried Rice for a weekend dinner with your friends and family.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, ginger, water, gram flour, salt, cooking soda, fruit salt, sugar, turmeric powder, sunflower oil, lemon juice, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, fresh coconut, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin preparing the Khaman Dhokla, prepare all the ingredients and keep them ready. Grease a cake tin or a dhokla pan and keep aside. Step 2: Prepare a steamer with water and keep it ready. Step 3: First, make the green chilli ginger mixture. Step 4: Into a small jar of mixer grinder, add the green chillies, ginger and water and blend to make a puree. Step 5: Keep this aside. Into a large mixing bowl, add all the ingredients along with the above green chilli ginger paste and keep aside. Whisk well to combine, the addition of lemon juice and soda will make the Khaman Dhokla batter froth up. It is important you steam the batter immediately once it is well combined, so that the Khaman Dhokla remains fluffy when steamed. Pour the Khaman Dhokla batter into the greased pan and place it in the prepared steamer. Step 6: Cover the steamer and turn on the heat to high and steam for 10-12 minutes until done. You will know when it is done, when you insert a knife in the centre and around the edges and it comes out clean. Remove the Khaman Dhokla from the steamer and allow it to cool completely. Step 7: Do not cut it while it is warm or hot as it will crumble. The next step is to prepare the tadka along with the sugar lemon water. Preheat a pan with oil over medium heat; add the mustard seeds and cumin seeds and allow it to crackle. Step 8: Once it crackles, add the green chillies and curry leaves and stir for about a minute. Step 9: Once done, add the water, lemon juice, sugar and salt. Step 10: Stir well until the sugar has dissolved and turn off the heat. Step 11: Allow the tadka to cool a bit. Step 12: Once the Khaman Dhokla has cooled completely, cut it into squares or diamonds. Step 13: Spoon the tadka over the Khaman Dhokla so it gets soaked well. Step 14: If there is more tadka water remaining, just keep it aside and pour it later when you feel it has become dry or you want it more juicy. Remove the Khaman Dhokla from the pan and place it on a serving platter. Step 15: Sprinkle freshly grated coconut and chopped coriander leaves and serve. Step 16: Serve it along with Green Chutney and Adrak Chai as an evening snack.

Ingredient Names: buttermilk, gram flour, wheat flour, ground cloves, bay leaf, fenugreek leaves, cumin seed, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chili peppers, ginger, red chile, salt, sugar, clarified butter
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour and butter milk well with a hand mixer or whipper. Step 2: Heat the clarified butter in a saucepan, add cumin and mustard seeds, curry leaves, whole chilli and ginger allow to splutter. Step 3: Add the buttermilk. Step 4: Stir continuously adding crushed chilli, salt, sugar, turmeric and asafoetida and the mint / fenugreek leaves. Step 5: Stir continuously till it reched boiling point. Step 6: Simmer on low for 10 minutes till the flour cooks, stirring once in a while. Step 7: Serve piping hot garnished with coriander Kadhis have to be stirred continuously, till the curd mixture starts boiling to get a smooth and uncurdled texture. Step 8: Once boiling starts, then it may be simmered on slow, to extract flavours to full extent, stirring occasionally 2.

Ingredient Names: fish fillet, onion, ginger, garlic, red chili powder, green chilies, turmeric powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, potato, coriander leaves, sugar, salt, mustard oil, eggs, whole wheat bread crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Macher Chop Recipe (Bengali Style Fish Croquettes), clean the fish pieces. Step 2: Smear a teaspoon turmeric powder and some salt to the fish pieces. Cook the fish pieces in microwave for on high or more time depending on the fish and power of microwave. Step 3: You can boil the fish pieces with little water in a pan too. Step 4: Let the fish pieces cool down. Step 5: If you are using fish with bone, then discard skin and fish bones, mash the fish pieces. In a pan heat a bit of oil. Step 6: Add chopped onions and cook till the onions become translucent. Add ginger paste and chopped ginger, garlic paste mix well and cook for 2 minutes. Add the mashed fish and mix well, cook for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add mashed potato, salt and sugar, mix well. Add turmeric powder, roasted cumin powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, mix well. Step 8: Add chopped coriander and green chilies, mix well. Let the fish mix cool down. Step 9: Shape up the mixture. Step 10: You can make any shape of your choice. Step 11: I made elongated patty. In a bowl beat the eggs some water and salt. Step 12: In another plate take the breadcrumbs. Roll the patties in breadcrumbs and keep them aside for 5 minutes. Then dip each fish patty into the egg wash, roll in breadcrumb to coat well, keep aside. Step 13: Repeat the process for all other patties. Step 14: Keep the patties in refrigerator for 1 hour. Heat oil in a deep pan or wok. Step 15: Slowly slide the croquettes 3-4 at a time and fry the fish croquettes to brown. Macher. Step 16: Chop Recipe (Bengali Style Fish Croquettes) for your weekend snack along with slices on onions, Homemade Dijon Mustard Sauce Recipe or kasundi and Dhaniya Pudina Chutney Recipe (Green Chutney) and enjoy with your friends and family over Masala Chai Recipe.

Ingredient Names: mutton, onion, green chilies, fresh mint leaves, cinnamon, powdered clove, ground mace, ground nutmeg, black pepper, red chili powder, cream, salt, graham flour, egg, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything together in a large bowl except the oil, mix well. Step 2: Grease your palms with a little oil. Step 3: Shape small portions of the keema mixture into kebabs Flatten slightly. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok Shallow fry the kebabs on medium flame in it until well browned on either side, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: pappadams, tomatoes, onions, green chili pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl except the papads Roast the papads on high flame, turning each side Be careful not to burn them up On each roasted papad, spread the fresh masala. Step 2: Serve before or with your lunch or dinner.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic, black beans, tomato puree, sweet corn, vegetable stock, carrot, cumin powder, zucchini, red chili powder, lemon juice, pickled jalapenos, coriander leaves, black pepper powder, salt, extra virgin olive oil, avocado, sour cream, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: To begin with the Mexican Black Bean Corn Soup Recipe first, Blend beans in a mixer jar to a paste. Step 2: And prepare all the ingredients required. Heat oil in a large saucepan, add garlic and sweat the onions with a pinch of salt to this add the carrots and vegetable stock and cook for 5 minutes. Now add the beans, sweet corn and zucchini and bring it to a boil. Add the pureed beans, tomato puree, cumin powder, chilli powder, jalapenos,remaining vegetable stock, reserved liquid from the can, lime juice and cook for 5 minutes until it returns to a boil. Season with salt and pepper, garnish with coriander leaves over the top. Step 3: Mexican Black Bean Corn Soup Recipe along with Mexican Vegetable Nachos Recipe and Mexican Vegetarian Bean & Cheese Enchiladas Recipe to make a lip smacking mexican meal for your family.

Dish Name: Mini Dal Mature Chat - That Perfect Party Snack
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all purpose flour, carom seeds, cumin seeds, ghee, salt, sunflower oil, chana dal, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, red chili powder, dry mango powder, sugar, asafoetida, green chilies, curry leaves, sweet chutney, tamarind, green chutney, coriander, mint, onion, pomegranate, sev
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Dal Pakwan Chaat, we will first make the Pakwan and keep it ready. Sift both the flours together. Step 2: Add ajwain, cumin, salt and ghee and mix all together into the flour. Step 3: Knead the flour into a smooth dough adding water little at a time. Step 4: Preheat the oil for deep frying. Divide the Pakwan dough into equal lemon size portions. Dust the surface with flour and roll the pakwan dough into a small disc. Use a fork and mark impressions on the rolled pakwan. Step 5: Pierce from both sides, this will prevent the pakwan from puffing up. Place the pakwans into the preheated oil and deep fry on low to medium heat until golden brown and crisp on both sides. Step 6: Transfer the fried pakwan on a kitchen paper towels to drain the excess oil and store in airtight containers. Next step is to make the Dal for the Pakwan Chaat. Step 7: Wash and soak chana dal in water overnight or for at least 1 hour. Once soaked, drain the water and cook the chana dal in water in the pressure cooker for a couple of whistles along with salt, sugar, turmeric powder, garam masala and amchur powder. After a 4 to 5 whistles, turn the heat to low and simmer for another 15-20 minutes and turn off the heat. Step 8: Allow the pressure to release naturally. Step 9: The grains of the chana dal should be soft and yet separate. Open the lid once the pressure releases completely. In a small tadka pan, heat ghee over medium heat. Step 10: Add the cumin and green chilies. Saute for a few seconds, add the curry leaves and asafoetida and turn off the heat. Pour the seasoning over the Sindhi Chana Dal and give it a stir. To make the Mini Dal Pakwan ChaatWhen you are ready to serve, place the Pakwan (the crisp puri) on serving platters. Step 11: Spoon a small portion of the dal over each of the pakwan (crisp puri). Drizzle some date chutney and green chutney and finally top with with some chopped onions and pomegranates, sev and serve. These Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat make great appetizers at parties, you can even serve it this was for a delicious weekend breakfast as well. Serve these Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat as an evening snack or as an appetizer for parties along with Pav Bhaji, Dahi Vada, Pani Puri and finally end it with a Paneer Kheer as a dessert.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, tamarind paste, jaggery, carom seeds, fennel seeds, gram flour, red chili powder, salt, baking soda, turmeric powder, water, onion, peanuts, coriander leaves, lemon, chaat masala powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mirchi Pakodi Recipe, firstly we will mix the tamarind paste and jaggery in a bowl. Make a slit in the green chillies and takes the seeds out, so that we can stuff the masala inside the green chillies. Now in the tamarind and jaggery mixture, add in the ajwain seeds, fennel seeds, gram flour, red chilli powder and salt. Step 2: Mix everything well. Step 3: Stuff this mixture into the green chillies one by one and keep it aside. Step 4: To make the Gram flour batter, add gram flour, baking soda, turmeric powder, ajwain and water. Step 5: Mix everything to create a thin batter. Step 6: Make sure it should not be too watery and it should be thick enough to coat the green chillies. Meanwhile, heat the required oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Step 7: Dip the stuffed chillies into the batter and add it to the hot oil. Step 8: Fry them till it becomes golden brown. Once done, take them out and let them cool down a bit. Step 9: Cut into half and add to the serving bowl. Garnish the Bajjis with Onions, Peanuts, Coriander Leaves, Lemon Juice and Chaat Masala Powder and it is ready to be served.

Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, sunflower oil, carom seeds, lemon juice, potatoes, green peas, carrot, mustard seeds, coriander seeds, onion, curry leaves, green chili, ginger, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare Mixed Vegetable Samosa Recipe, take a big bowl and add maida/all-purpose flour, salt, oil and carom seeds, and lemon juice. Step 2: Mix them all well and make stiff and tight dough. Step 3: Addition of lemon juice makes the cover of samosa crunchier. Heat a pan with oil and add mustard seeds, let them crackle and add chopped onions, green chilly, curry leaves, ginger and cook them until onions turns light pink. Step 4: Add all the spices including salt and cook for seconds. Now add boiled and mashed potatoes, boiled green peas and boiled carrot in it and mix it very well. Step 5: Sprinkle some chopped coriander leaves on the mixture and your samosa stuffing is ready. Step 6: Let the mixture come on room temperature. Now make medium size small balls from the dough, roll out the dough ball by keeping it little thick, then divide the round poori into two halves and lift one part in your hands, apply some water on the edges and fold it to cone shape. Now stuff the samosa mixture in the cone, and again fold at the back and apply some water on the edges. Step 7: Take both the ends together and stick well, make them in a perfect samosa shape. Step 8: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok. Like same way, prepare all the samosas. Step 9: Now deep fry the samosas on medium heat until they get brown and crispy from all the sides. Drain out the fried samosas on tissue paper to remove excess oil and your super delicious Mixed Vegetable Samosas are ready to serve with hot cup of tea or coffee!! You can serve it with green chutney, or Tamarind-jaggery chutney or simply with Tomato ketchup too!

Ingredient Names: garbanzo beans, tahini, virgin olive oil, lemon juice, garlic cloves, heavy cream, orange juice, honey, pita bread, fresh basil, onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor or blender add the tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, heavy cream, orange juice and honey, blend. Step 2: Add garbanzo beans and blend until really smooth. Step 3: Add salt to taste Refridgerate an hour or two and then serve on warm pita bread topped with basil and onion slices Makes a nice breakfast snack or appetizer too Enjoy!

Dish Name: Mutton Khurdi - Bohra Style White Mutton Stock Soup
Ingredient Names: mutton, onion, bay leaves, green chilies, ginger, garlic, salt, water, sunflower oil, cumin seeds, whole black peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon stick, whole wheat flour, milk, black pepper powder, mint leaves, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Mutton Khurdi Recipe, we will first cook the mutton. Step 2: In a pressure cooker, combine the mutton, onion, bay leaves, green chillies, ginger, garlic, salt, water. Step 3: Pressure cook for three whistles and turn off the flame. Step 4: Allow the pressure to release naturally. In a kadai, heat oil on medium flame, once the oil is hot, add the whole spices- cumin seeds, peppercorns, cinnamon, cloves. Once the spices begin to sizzle, add the whole wheat flour and mix well along with the oil and spices. Step 5: To the kadai add the milk, whisking continuously, ensuring no lumps are formed and allow the bhora soup to thicken. Once it thickens, add salt and pepper, and mutton and all the contents of the pressure cooker into the kadai. Step 6: Give the Mutton Khurdi/ Bohra Style White Mutton Soup a brisk boil for 3 to until all the flavours get into the mutton. Once done, turn off the heat, check the salt and seasonings and adjust to suit your taste. Serve the Mutton Khurdi/ Bohra Style White Mutton Soup hot along with some mint leaves and lemon wedges. Step 7: Serve this lip smacking Mutton Khurdi Recipe over a weekend meal along with Kalmi Kabab Recipe - Mughlai Style Chicken Tangdi Kebab and Prawns Biryani Recipe followed by a dessert of Rose Flavoured Shahi Tukda Recipe.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, turmeric, ground cumin, garam masala, chili pepper, fresh coriander, salt, onion, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour with the spices, add some water until the mixture is gluey. Step 2: Mix the onion into this paste, it should hold together, if necessary add more flour. Step 3: Heat the oil to medium heat and drop golf ball size blobs into the fat. Step 4: Cook for about 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown, drain on kitchen paper, serve warm with a yogurt- mint raita.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, chili powder, turmeric, baking powder, fennel seed, onion seeds, cumin seed, onions, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour, chilli powder, turmeric, baking powder and salt together in a bowl Get as much air into it as possible Crush the seeds in mortar and pestle, add to the bowl. Step 2: Now add the green chilli, onions and the chopped coriander. Step 3: Mix in some water to make a thick batter that holds the ingredients together. Step 4: Heat the oil in a wok. Step 5: Drop spoonfulls of the batter into the oil and fry till golden brown. Step 6: Place on kitchen paper to allow the excess oil to run off These can be eaten as they are or with a dip.

Ingredient Names: egg, lemon juice, chickpea flour, salt, chili powder, garam masala, cumin seed, ground cumin, ground turmeric, hot green chili pepper, fresh coriander, vegetable oil, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Break the egg into a bowl and beat well, add 4 tbs water and the lemon juice. Step 2: Mix, add the flour and mix well with a whisk. Step 3: Put in the spices, coriander leaf and chilli if using. Step 4: Mix well and set aside for at least 10 minutes or longer. Step 5: Mix again with a whisk The batter should be of a fairly thick, droppable consistency. Step 6: Heat the oil in a wok or deep fat fryer over a medium heat A minimum of 3 inches is required in the centre of a wok. Step 7: When the oil is ready, put the onions in the batter and mix this is always best done just before cooking. Step 8: Take heaped tsp of the batter and drop into the hot oil.

Ingredient Names: lentils, water, salt, egg, tomato juice, tomato paste, breadcrumbs, pine nuts, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground black pepper, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain the lentils. Step 2: Chop the onion and the garlic. Step 3: In a dry skillet, toast the pine nuts for 2-3 minutes or until browned. Step 4: Put the lentils in a large saucepan, cover with the water, and add the salt. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, drain. Step 6: Whisk the egg, tomato juice, and tomato paste in a mixing bowl. Step 7: Add 1 / 2 cup breadcrumbs and the drained lentils and mix well. Step 8: Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat. Step 9: Add the chopped onions and garlic and saute for 3 minutes, until onion is soft.

Ingredient Names: cumin powder, coriander, chili, curry powder, garlic, onion, potato, flour, salt, pepper, ginger powder, tomato ketchup, chives
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cumin powder, coriander, chili, curry powder, garlic, onion, potato, flour, salt and pepper, ginger powder, ketchup, and chopped chives with enough water to make a thick batter If you like it hot use more chili or hot chili sauce, heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Place spoonfuls of the mixture until puffed up and crispy. Step 3: Turn over if the oil is shallow This mixture can be played with to suit your tastes.

Ingredient Names: spinach, onion, red chili powder, salt, black pepper, plain yogurt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Beat yogurt in a bowl and keep aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan, add red chillies powder, salt, black pepper powder and wait for a second. Step 3: Add onions and saut till tender. Step 4: Now add spinach and saut for at least 5 minutes on medium heat. Step 5: Allow the mixture to cool down a little and then add gently into the yogurt bowl. Step 6: Mix, allow it to rest for a few minutes and enjoy with stuffed indian breads or spiced rice.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, salt, ghee, paneer, greek yogurt, gram flour, ginger, garlic, dried fenugreek, turmeric powder, chaat masala powder, garam masala powder, mint leaves, charcoal, green bell pepper, onion, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll Recipe, get all the ingredients prepped and ready. Step 2: If you are making paneer at home you can use our homemade paneer recipe. To make the paneer tikka, add all the ingredients for Paneer Tikka in a bowl except the paneer and stir them well until combined. Add the cut paneer pieces into it and allow it to rest for 10 minutes. Heat a teaspoon of oil or ghee in a wok or a skillet, add the paneer mixture and sauté over high heat for four to five minutes, stirring occasionally and cook the paneer until all the marination thickens and forms a coat over the paneer. Once done, check the salt and spice and adjust to suit your taste. Step 3: Keep this aside. Next step is the give the paneer tikka a smoked flavour. Step 4: Place a large piece of coal on the gas flame and allow it to turn red hot. Place a katori in the center of the paneer tikka pan, place the red hot coal in the katori/ cup and spoon a little bit of ghee over the coal. Step 5: It will begin to emit smoke. Step 6: Cover the pan and allow the paneer tikka to get the smoky flavours. After about 30 seconds, remove the coal cup and the smoked paneer tikka is ready. The next step is to make the roti for the rolls. Step 7: In a large mixing bowl add the flour and salt, give it mix with your fingers. Step 8: Add a little water at a time and make a smooth dough. Once you have the dough ready, add a teaspoon of oil over the dough and knead for a couple of minutes, this will give the dough a flaky texture. To make the wrap for the kathi rolls, divide the dough into 5 large portions. Step 9: Roll the dough into a large circle by dusting it in flour. Step 10: Preheat a skillet on medium heat, place the rolled dough on the skillet and cook it on both sides by smearing ghee over it until it is cooked through and browned and slightly crisp. The addition of ghee helps in creating a crisp texture to the rolls. In a small mixing bowl, combine the raw onions, capsicum, lemon, mint leaves and salt. Step 11: Toss them together. Place the cooked rotis on a flat surface and place a portion of the filling towards the center, sprinkle some onion capsicum mixture and if you like a little more chaat masala and roll it up tightly. The Paneer Tikka Kathi rolls are now ready to be served. Step 12: Proceed the same way with the remaining dough portions and serve. Serve the Paneer Tikka Kathi Rolls as a snack for tea on weekends, as an appetizer for parties along Mumbai Style Tawa Pulao Recipe With Moong Sprouts and Nawabi Kofta Curry Recipe or make it less spicy and pack it into your kid's lunch box.

Ingredient Names: floury potato, peas, curry powder, yogurt, mint half, white, iceberg lettuce, red onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Boil the potatoes for about 8 mins until tender, throwing in the peas for the final few mins. Drain well, pick out the potato, then return to the saucepan with a third of the peas. Add the curry powder and some seasoning, then mash together over a low heat – this will help to dry out the veg. Stir in the remaining peas. Step 2: Using 2 tablespoons, shape the mix into rough rugby ball shapes (you should get about 16), then place on a baking sheet lined with baking parchment. Bake for 20 mins until golden and crisp around the edges. Step 3: Mix the yogurt with the chopped mint. Warm the halved pittas, and toss the remaining mint leaves with the shredded lettuce. Serve the hot pakoras with all the extras for stuffing into the warmed pittas.

Ingredient Names: roasted peanuts, channa dal, potatoes, onions, green chilies, breadcrumbs, lemon juice, spinach leaves, coriander leaves, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the roasted peanut and chana dal to a coarse mixture. Step 2: Add the boiled potatoes to the ground mixture, add onions, green chilies, coriander leaves, flour, lemon juice, chopped spinach and bread crumbs mix well. Step 3: Shape the mixture into balls, flatten them and then fry them in a medium hot oil till crisp and golden brown, serve hot.

Dish Name: Potato Bonda Flavoured With Sambar Powder
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, gram flour, corn flour, red chili powder, garam masala powder, asafoetida, cooking soda, salt, potatoes, green peas, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, sambar powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making Potato Bonda Recipe Flavoured With Sambar Powder, get prep with all the ingredients needed. Heat oil in a pan, once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Step 2: Once it splutters add green peas and saute well. Add the mashed potato to it and add little water along with required salt. Step 3: Cook on medium heat. Add turmeric powder, chilli powder, asafoetida, sambar powder and coriander powder to it. Step 4: Stir well and cook. Keep mashing the pieces with ladle and cook until water evaporates and combined. The stuffing is ready. Step 5: Remove from flame and allow it to cool, make small balls from it and keep aside. Step 6: Heat oil in a kadai/deep frying pan for frying bonda. Meanwhile, for making batter, take all the ingredients mentioned under “for batter” and mix well adding little water. The batter has to be thick enough to coat the potato balls. Step 7: Dip the prepared potato balls into the batter and drop into hot oil. Fry on medium heat until it turns golden on all sides. Step 8: Remove from oil and drain excess oil on kitchen tissues. Serve Potato Bonda Recipe Flavoured With Sambar Powder along with tomato ketchup, Dhaniya Pudina Chutney Recipe, and Masala Chai Recipe.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, bread, eggs, onion, coriander leaves, mint leaf, green chilies, lime juice, red chili powder, chicken stock powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly dry roast the potatoes in a non-stick frying pan to dry out the water. Step 2: Heat 2 tsps Oil in a pan. Step 3: Add onions and green chillies to it. Step 4: Saute until the onions are softened. Step 5: Add the mashed potatoes, coriander and mint leaves, red chilli powder, knorr chicken stock powder and lime juice, mix well, remove from heat. Step 6: Spread a thick layer of potato mixture on each bread slice. Step 7: Brush over with the beaten egg.

Ingredient Names: fresh mint leaves, onion, green chilies, limes, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Wash mint leaves and combine all the ingredients in an electric blender. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp water Run mixer at speed at speed 1 for 20 seconds Switch off Push the chutney down with a rubber spatula Again run mixer at speed 3 for 1 minute Empty the paste into a glass bowl Variations: dahi-pudina chutney- add 2 tbsps of yoghurt to the chutney paste just before serving Lasan-pudina chutney- add 4 cloves of garlic instead of onion while grinding.

Dish Name: Raw Mango Dhokla Topped With Sweet Mango Chutney
Ingredient Names: raw mango, mustard seeds, dry red chilies, panch phoran, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, nigella seeds, fenugreek seeds, sunflower oil, jaggery, salt, gram flour, turmeric powder, sugar, fruit salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Raw Mango Dhokla Recipe Topped With Sweet Mango Chutney, we will first make the chutneyIn a pressure cooker, add mustard seeds and dried red chillies. Then add the mango pieces, jaggery, panch phoran salt and turmeric powder. Step 2: Add little water and cook the mangoes for 3 to 4 whistles. Once done, open the cooker and check the salt and spices and adjust accordingly. Step 3: Keep the Sweet and Spicy Mango Chutney aside. The next step is to make the Raw Mango DhoklaIn a bowl, add besan, salt, sugar, turmeric powder, and add water and mix it well to make a thick Khaman Dhokla Batter. Step 4: Stir in the grated raw mangoes, oil and the eno's fruit salt. The Raw Mango Khaman Dhokla batter should be of idli batter consistency. Now grease a dhokla plate with oil and also preheat the dhokla steamer with water and keep ready. Spoon the Raw Mango Dhokla Batter into the dhokla plates, place them in the steamer and steam the dhokla on high heat for about 10 to until done. When you insert a knife inside, it should come out clean. Step 5: Turn off the heat and allow the Raw Mango Dhokla to cool down. Step 6: Now, once the Raw Mango Dhokla is cooled, loosen the sides and invert the bowl to unmold dhokla on a plate and cut them into diamonds. Place them on a serving platter and spoon the Sweet and Spicy Raw Mango Chutney over the dhokla and serve. The Raw Mango Dhokla Recipe makes a great party starter recipe or even serve for an evening snack during the summers.

Ingredient Names: paneer, pickled onions, sunflower oil, charcoal, greek yogurt, gram flour, mint leaves, garlic, ginger, fennel seeds, carom seeds, saffron strands, cumin powder, coriander powder, black pepper powder, turmeric powder, black salt, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Smoked Tandoori Paneer Tikka Recipe, In a bowl, combine yogurt and gram flour making a smooth paste. Step 2: Using a pestle and mortar, pound the ginger, garlic, and mint leaves to make a coarse paste. Add in the fennel seeds and ajwain and pound until blended. Step 3: Add this to the yogurt mixture. Step 4: Add in the remaining marinade ingredients into the yogurt mixture and stir to combine well. Place the paneer cubes in a large bowl, add in the marinade and allow it to rest covered for about half an hour to one hour or even overnight. Step 5: While the paneer marination is close to over, we will now prepare for the coal smoking method. Take a piece or two of coal (about 3 inches big) and hold it over a gas flame with the help of tongs. Step 6: The coal will begin to turn red hot and also grey in about 3-4 minutes. This indicates that the coal can be used for smoking. Step 7: Place this hot coal inside a crack proof bowl. Step 8: At this point heat a large wok or a skillet with rim that can be covered on medium heat. Add a little oil and place a few pieces of marinated paneer along with a little of the marinade. If you have a stove top grill or a skillet, then arrange the paneer pieces and pour a little of the marinade over each of them. Step 9: Place the coal along with the bowl over the paneer. Add a spoon of ghee or oil on the coal. Step 10: It will begin to smoke. Step 11: Immediately cover the pan and reduce the heat to low and let it sit for about a minute until the smoke has gone away. Step 12: Open the lid and remove the coal cup. You dish will get a smoked flavored paneer that taste just like the Tandoori Paneer Tikkas. Step 13: Serve the Smoked Tandoori Paneer Tikka Recipe as a Party Appetizer with your meal of Dal Makhani, Paneer Butter Masala, Jeera Rice and Phulka.

Ingredient Names: swede, flour, creme fraiche, eggs, red chile, red onions, cayenne pepper, garam masala, ground turmeric, coriander seeds, fresh coriander, sunflower oil, mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the swede in a pan of boiling water for 15 mins until tender, then drain well. In a large bowl, mix together the flour, crème fraîche and egg to make a smooth, thick batter. Stir in the chilli, onion, spices and coriander, then season generously. Very roughly mash the swede and stir into the mixture. Step 2: Heat a splash of the oil in a large non-stick pan and cook small, flattened spoonfuls of the mixture for 2 mins on each side until crisp and browned. Serve hot with chutney.

Dish Name: Spicy Lemon Chilli Paneer Tart With Curry Leaves
Ingredient Names: all purpose flour, unsalted butter, icing sugar, egg, salt, paneer, green bell pepper, onion, garlic, green chilies, spring onions, black pepper powder, turmeric powder, green chili sauce, curry leaves, mustard seeds, corn flour, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Chilli Lemon Paneer Tart Recipe, it is best to make the dough for the tart the previous day and allow it to rest in the refrigerator overnight.*For the tart shellTo make the tart shell, cut butter into small cubes and freeze them for about 1 hour or until solid. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, icing sugar, salt and butter and rub with your fingers, until the butter is fully combined and the mixture has a sand like texture. Add one whole egg into this sand like mixture and bring the dough together. Step 2: The dough will be sticky. Pack this dough in a cling wrap and allow it to rest in the refrigerator overnight. Keep a loose bottom pie tin ready. Dust some flour on the counter and begin rolling the dough, you need to roll out a thick sheet of thickness. Carefully lift the sheet of dough and place it over the pie tin, press the dough against the base and the walls. Step 3: Let the excess dough be there as is, place this pie tin in the freezer for 1 hour. Remove the pie tin from the freezer, cut off the excess from the edges using a fork or a knife. Dock (prick) the pastry so that it doesn't puff up when it is being baked. Step 4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degree celsius for till golden in colour. Remove from the oven and allow the tart shells to cool.*For the Chilli Lemon Paneer fillingIn a pan, heat oil on medium-high flame, add the mustard seeds and curry leaves and let them crackle. Once done add the garlic, green chilies and onions. Step 5: Saute for 3-4 minutes until the onions are soft and pink. Once the onions turn pink, add in the capsicum, salt, turmeric, pepper powder, green chili sauce and paneer and give it a good mix. Make a slurry of cornstarch and water and add it to the paneer mix. Step 6: Stir continuously until well combined. Turn off the heat, squeeze the lemon wedges and drop the lemon skin into the paneer mix. At this stage also add in the spring onion greens and mix well. Add this Chilli Lemon Paneer Filling into the prepared baked Pie Tarts just before serving. Step 7: Serve this Spicy Lemon Chilli Paneer Tart with Curry leaves Recipe as a party appetizer along with Rose Buns With Stuffed Mushroom Recipe and Lebanese Spinach Triangle Pies Recipe.

Dish Name: Thai Pumpkin Soup With Red Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, vegetable stock, black pepper powder, extra virgin olive oil, salt, red chili, coriander leaves, onion, lemongrass, fresh red chilies, garlic, ginger, cumin seeds, white pepper powder, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: For the Red Thai Curry Paste:To prepare Thai Pumpkin Soup With Red Curry Paste Recipe, prepare the Red Thai Curry paste recipe. Step 2: Place the ingredients - lemongrass, red chillies, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, white pepper powder, salt to taste, lemon juicein a food processor or blender and process well to create a fragrant Thai red curry paste. Use as required or store refrigerated for further use. Step 3: If you find the paste too thick, add a little more coconut milk to help blend ingredients. For the Roasted Pumpkins:Add a little olive oil in a pan and add the chopped pumpkin along with salt, chilli powder and a pinch of turmeric powder. Step 4: Roast them till they are soft. Step 5: Cool and grind to a paste. Heat the remaining Olive oil in a large sauce pan and cook the curry paste for one minute or until it becomes fragrant. Add the vegetable stock along with the pumpkin puree and bring it to a boil. Step 6: Simmer and let it boil for a good on low flame. Add salt and pepper powder along with the coconut milk. Step 7: Stir well and cook for further 5 more minutes. Stir in the lime juice and strain the soup for a smooth texture. Pour Thai Pumpkin Soup With Red Curry Paste Recipe into serving bowls. Step 8: Swirl in some coconut milk and garnish with pepper powder, red chillies and fresh coriander leaves. Serve with Vegetarian Pad Thai Recipe for wholesome and comforting meal.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, wheat flour, salt, curds, water, oil, cumin, asafoetida, chili, garlic, ginger paste, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, aamchur, chili sauce, tomato sauce, potato, fresh coriander, lemon juice, vinegar, green chutney, chaat masala, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 2 cup maida, ½ cup wheat flour, ½ tsp salt and ¼ cup curd. Step 2: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Now add water as required and knead to smooth and soft dough. Step 4: Grease the dough with oil, cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 5: After the dough has rested well, knead the dough again and pinch a ball-sized dough. Step 6: Dust with maida and roll thin. Step 7: Now cook the roti on hot pan spreading oil. Step 8: Flip over and cook both sides. Step 9: Also, spread the oil and cook until the roti is cooked from both sides. Keep aside. Step 10: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tbsp oil. add 1 tsp cumin, pinch hing, 2 chilli, 2 cloves garlic and ½ tsp ginger paste. Saute well until the raw aroma goes off. Step 11: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp aamchur, 2 tbsp chilli sauce and 2 tbsp tomato sauce. Step 12: Saute on low flame until the spices are well combined. Step 13: Now add 3 potato, ½ tsp salt and mix well. Step 14: Mix until the spices are well combined. Step 15: Now add 2 tbsp coriander, 2 tsp lemon juice and mix well. Step 16: Once the mixture is cooled slightly, shape the tikki. Step 17: Roast on hot pan adding oil as required. Step 18: Roast both the sides until the tikki turns golden brown and crispy. Keep aside. Step 19: In a small bowl take 3 tbsp vinegar, 2 chilli and ¼ tsp salt. Step 20: Mix well, and chilli vinegar is ready to use. Step 21: Firstly, take roti and spread green chutney. Step 22: Place the prepared aloo tikki, and top with coriander, chaat masala, onion, chilli vinegar and tomato sauce. Step 23: Roll tight and wrap in butter paper. Step 24: Finally, Veg Frankie Recipe is ready to enjoy with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: onions, cabbage, fresh carrot, potato, spinach, ginger, chili, curry leaves, turmeric, chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala, asafoetida, salt, aamchur, gram flour, rice flour, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the vegetables: Finely chop the onion, cabbage, carrot, potato and palak into similar-sized pieces. Uniformly chopped vegetables cook evenly and give the pakodas a consistent texture. Step 2: Add the aromatics: Transfer the chopped vegetables to a large mixing bowl. Add the chopped ginger, green chillies and curry leaves. Step 3: Add the spices: Add turmeric, chilli powder, cumin powder, garam masala, hing, salt and aamchur powder. Step 4: Release the vegetable moisture: Squeeze and mix the vegetables thoroughly using your hands. The salt will help the vegetables release their natural moisture. Step 5: Add the flours: Add 1 cup of besan and the rice flour. Continue squeezing and mixing until the flour coats all the vegetables evenly. Step 6: Avoid adding water: Use only the moisture released by the vegetables to bind the mixture. Adding extra water can make the pakodas soft and oily. Step 7: Heat the oil: Heat enough oil for deep frying in a kadai over medium heat. Test the temperature by dropping a small portion of the mixture into the oil. It should rise gradually without browning immediately. Step 8: Shape the pakodas: Take small portions of the mixture and loosely drop them into the hot oil. Drop them randomly without pressing or shaping them, as the uneven edges become extra crispy. Step 9: Do not overcrowd: Fry the pakodas in small batches. Make sure they do not touch each other while frying. Step 10: Fry until crispy: Stir occasionally and fry over medium heat until the pakodas turn golden brown, crisp and crunchy. Step 11: Drain the pakodas: Remove the fried pakodas using a slotted spoon and drain them on a wire rack or absorbent paper. Step 12: Season and serve: Sprinkle chaat masala over the hot pakodas and serve immediately with green chutney, tomato sauce or a cup of masala chai.

Ingredient Names: paneer, curd, onion, garlic, ginger, green chili, bay leaf, nigella seeds, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, turmeric powder, black pepper powder, cloves, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, yellow mustard seeds, sesame seeds, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, dry mango powder, red chili powder, star anise, pomegranate, black salt, saffron strands, sunflower oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Start to prepare Veg tunday kababs recipe by taking out all the dry spices in a pan and temper them well. Grind them to make a fine powder and keep it asideBoil the Paneer/Cottage Cheese to make sure its softChop the paneer, capsicum,onion into chunks for sticking on to the skewersPuree the half onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli into a paste and keep asideNow lets prepare the marinade-add in curd, tempered spice powder,pureed ginger-garlic-onion-chilli pasteUsing both hands mix together the marinate to the chopped veggies and paneer and keep in the refrigerator for a good one to one an half hours for marination. The longer the better. Take a flat pan,pour in one table-spoon oil and spread uniformly bringing to low-medium heatTake your skewers and line them with capsicum followed by onion followed by paneer and so on. Step 2: You can other vegetables like zucchini, tomato also to it. Place the skewers on the hot flat plan and reduce the flame to lowCook each side rotating the skewers and brushing in the marinate on the cooked side as soon as it cooksServe Veg tunday kababs recipe hot as a starter or a dry curry with bread of your choice.

Ingredient Names: potato, chili, ginger paste, chili powder, turmeric, aamchur, chaat masala, cumin powder, fresh coriander, salt, gram flour, rice flour, ajwain, baking soda, water, capsicum, oil, sev, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 2 potato, 2 chilli and ½ tsp ginger paste. Step 2: Add ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp aamchur, ½ tsp chaat masala, ½ tsp cumin powder, 2 tbsp coriander and ½ tsp salt. Step 3: Mix well making sure all the spices are well combined. Step 4: Aloo stuffing is ready. keep aside. Step 5: Further, take small capsicum and remove the seeds from it. Step 6: Stuff in aloo stuffing into capsicum. keep aside. Step 7: To prepare the besan batter, in a bowl take 2 cup besan and 2 tbsp rice flour. Step 8: Add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp ajwain, ¼ tsp baking soda and ½ tsp salt. Step 9: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Further, add water as required and mix well. Step 11: Mix well forming a smooth thick batter. Step 12: Now dip the stuffed capsicum into besan batter and dip completely. Step 13: Deep fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 14: Stir occasionally, and fry uniformly until the bajji turns golden brown. Step 15: Drain off over kitchen paper to remove excess oi. Step 16: Now cut the aloo capsicum bajji into half. Step 17: Top with chopped onions and crispy sev. Step 18: Finally, enjoy capsicum bajji recipe with tea or coffee.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, corn flour, salt, water, onions, poha avalakki flattened rice, chili, chili powder, cumin powder, chaat masala, fresh coriander, maida paste, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 2 cup maida, 2 tbsp corn flour and ½ tsp salt. Step 2: Add 2 to 2½ cup water and mix well using a whisk. Step 3: Whisk until a smooth lump-free batter is formed adding water as required. Step 4: Now grease the pan and pour a ladleful of batter on a hot pan. Step 5: Swirl once making sure the batter is uniformly spread. Step 6: Cook for a minute or until the sheet is cooked without browning. Step 7: Now flip over gently and continue to cook. Step 8: Finally, the samosa sheet is ready. you can cover and use it to prepare patti samosa or spring rolls. Step 9: Firstly, in a large bowl take 2 onion, 1 cup poha, 1 chilli and 1 tsp chilli powder. Step 10: Also add ½ tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp chaat masala, ¾ tsp salt and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 11: Mix well by squeezing onions. Step 12: Onion stuffing is ready. Step 13: How to fold irani samosa:. Step 14: Firstly, take the prepared samosa sheet and cut in half. Step 15: Fold into triangle sticking using maida. Step 16: Stuff the onion stuffing. make sure to stuff well else the samosa will be bland. Step 17: Seal the samosa using maida paste. Step 18: Deep fry the samosa in hot oil keeping the flame on low. Step 19: Stir occasionally, frying in between making sure to brown uniformly. Step 20: It will take approximately 15-20 minutes to get crispy golden coloured samosa. Step 21: Drain off the samosa and enjoy irani samosa with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: oil, ginger, garlic, onion, besan flour, green apple, curry powder, turmeric powder, tomatoes, bay leaf, fresh coarse ground black pepper, chicken stock, rice, cooked chicken, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and add the ginger and garlic. Step 2: Saute for 2 minutes, then add the onion and saute until onion is transparent. Step 3: Add the gram flour, apple, curry powder, turmeric, tomatoes, bay leaf, pepper and chicken stock. Step 4: Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat. Step 5: Simmer for 45 minutes, then process in a blender. Step 6: Add the rice if using and chicken. Step 7: Stir well and serve with lemon wedges.

Dish Name: Baby Carrot Soup With Cilantro and Curry
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, baby carrots, onions, curry paste, flour, vegetable stock, fresh cilantro, salt, pepper, low-fat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add carrots and onion, and cook until slightly softened, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Mix in curry paste and flour. Step 4: While stirring, slowly pour in stock. Step 5: Bring to a boil, and then adjust heat so the soup gently simmers. Step 6: Cook until carrots are tender, about 20 minutes. Step 7: Working in batches, puree mixture in a blender or food processor. Step 8: Return soup to pot and bring back to a simmer. Step 9: Stir in the cilantro; season with salt and pepper. Step 10: Pour soup into bowls. Step 11: If desired, set a spoonful of yogurt in the centre of each bowl.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, lemon juice, ground coriander, cumin, chili powder, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, butter, onion, gingerroot, canned tomatoes, tomato paste, plain flour, brown sugar, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade: Cut the meat into small pieces or slice thinly. Step 2: Combine with the other ingredients in a glass bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour Soup: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan and add marinated chicken and chopped onion. Step 3: Stir constantly until the chicken is sealed and the onion is soft, add the dried spices and ginger, then stir in the tomatoes and chicken stock. Step 4: When simmering, pour in the basmati rice, stir, and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Mix together the tomato paste and flour and whisk, a little at a time, into the soup. Step 6: Add the brown sugar and cream and season to taste. Step 7: Serve in soup bowls with a dollop of natural yoghurt, chopped fresh coriander and torn up naan bread for dunking.

Dish Name: Butternut Squash Red Lentil And Coconut Soup
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, olive oil, onion, leek, hot pepper, celery, carrot, garlic clove, minced ginger, curry powder, salt & freshly ground black pepper, chicken stock, red lentil, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f cut the squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds and stringy center Oil each half gently with olive oil or cooking spray, put face down on a cookie sheet and bake until tender. Step 2: Meanwhile heat a soup pot over medium heat. Step 3: Add a tablespoon of olive oil, the onion, celery, carrot, leek, pepper, garlic, curry powder, ginger and a good pinch of salt and pepper. Step 4: Stir regularly and sweat for about 10 minutes or until veggies soften a bit. Step 5: Add stock and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Add lentils and stir regularly at a simmer for 15 minutes. Step 7: When squash is tender scoop out and gently mash and stir into the soup. Step 8: Stir the coconut milk into the soup until well incorporated. Step 9: Taste and correct for seasoning then served.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red onions, garlic, finger length ginger, mild red chilies, turmeric, garam masala, ground cumin, tomatoes, tomato puree, chickpeas, baby spinach leaves, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the onion over a low heat until softened. Stir in the garlic, ginger and chillies and cook for a further 5 mins until the onions are golden and the garlic slightly toasted. Step 2: Add the turmeric, garam masala and cumin, stirring over a low heat for a few secs. Tip in the chopped tomatoes and add the tomato purée, then simmer for 5 mins. Step 3: Add the chickpeas to the pan with 300ml water (fill the can three-quarters full). Simmer for 10 mins before stirring in the spinach to wilt. Season and serve with rice or naan.

Ingredient Names: onions, cucumbers, yogurt, green coriander, tabasco sauce, salt & freshly ground black pepper, stock
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the coriander thoroughly. Step 2: Chop the leaves and the stalks and keep aside. Step 3: Add the peeled and chopped onions and the peeled, seeded and sliced cucumbers with the coriander into a blender and mix well till everything is finely chopped. Step 4: In a bowl mix the yoghurt with the tabasco and the salt and freshly ground black pepper to your taste If you want the spice to be a little less then hold back on the tabasco adding just 4-5 drops, for a stronger flavour add in more tabasco. Step 5: Whisk the stock and the cucumber mixture into the yoghurt well. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate for 2-3 hours allowing it to chill For best effect, chill the bowls you want to serve the cucumber soup in and pour the chilled soup into them, when you are ready to serve This can be garnished with a dollop of yoghurt and a few coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: yellow split peas, water, turmeric, lemon juice, fresh green chile, ground cumin, ground coriander, plain yogurt, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pick over the peas to remove any grit & then wash and drain them. Step 2: Place the drained peas in a large saucepan with water and turmeric, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and cover. Step 4: Simmer for 90 minutes or until peas are tender, remove from heat. Step 5: Put peas & liquid into a blender or food processor. Step 6: Add the lemon juice, cumin, coriander, chili, salt and pepper. Step 7: Blend until smooth. Step 8: Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate until cool.

Ingredient Names: butter, diced onions, garlic, bell pepper, carrots, fresh gingerroot, cayenne pepper, curry powder, water, salt, pepper, frozen broccoli, half-and-half, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions, garlic, pepper, carrots, ginger, cayenne pepper and curry powder in butter over medium heat for 2-5 minutes. Step 2: Add water and broccoli, season to taste. Step 3: Simmer 10-15 minutes Don't simmer too long or broccoli will lose its color. Step 4: Using a slotted spoon, transfer vegetables to the bowl of a food processor, leaving the cooking liquid in the pan Process until smooth and then return to the cooking liquid. Step 5: Stir in cream and cheese. Step 6: Heat over medium fire until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: onion, potato, garlic cloves, all-purpose flour, curry powder, garam masala, red pepper flakes, chicken broth, whole milk, sugar, frozen baby peas, lime, salt, yogurt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Saute potatoes, onion, and garlic in butter in a large saucepan over medium heat until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Stir in flour and spices. Step 3: Saute for about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add the broth, milk, and sugar. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stir occasionally. Step 6: Stir in the peas and cook uncovered for 5 minutes. Step 7: Season with lime juice and salt. Step 8: Garnish with a dollop of yogurt and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, yellow onions, garlic, curry powder, salt, ground turmeric, ground cumin, cayenne, summer squash, chicken stock, heavy cream, pappadams, cucumber, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy pot, melt the butter over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onions and cook, stirring, until soft, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, curry powder, salt, turmeric, cumin, and cayenne, and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 45 seconds. Step 4: Add the squash and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the stock and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the squash is soft, 25 to 30 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the heat With a hand-held immersion blender, puree on high speed. Step 8: Add the cream, stir, and adjust the seasoning, to taste. Step 9: Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until well chilled.

Ingredient Names: cayenne pepper, olive oil, curry powder, onions, garlic cloves, chicken broth, tomato paste, fresh cilantro, plain yogurt, garbanzo beans
Instructions: Step 1: Place onion, olive and garlic in a pan and cook until lightly browned, then add broth and tomato paste. Step 2: Add garbanzo beans, cilantro and curry and let simmer for 10 minutes. Step 3: Spoon garbanzo beans and onions into a blender and a ladle full of the broth / tomato paste mixture as well. Step 4: Blend until smooth. Step 5: Transfer mixture back to the pot and stir. Step 6: Add cayenne pepper and yogurt, stir and serve.

Ingredient Names: lentils, water, chicken breasts, chicken bouillon cubes, onion, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes with juice, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, nutmeg, ground coriander, ginger, white vinegar, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients but the cilantro in the crock pot If you want your chicken in a 'shredded' like consistency, put it in now, if you want it less done, add about 1 5 hours before you want to eat it in chunks. Step 2: Leave to cook overnight or start in the morning for dinner. Step 3: Taste to season with salt and pepper and add fresh cilantro. Step 4: Stir and enjoy Can be eaten alone or with rice Can be cooked on the stove top as well, but the crockpot is easiest Soooo yummy.
