Ingredient Names: butter, garlic cloves, onion, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, cumin, chopped tomatoes, red lentil, lemon juice, vegetable stock, coconut milk, salt and pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onion and garlic in butter for 2-3 minutes. Step 2: Add all spices and cook for 30 more seconds. Step 3: Stir in tomatoes, red lentils, lemon juice, stock and coconut milk, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until lentils are tender and cooked. Step 5: Season to taste, garnish with cilantro.

Dish Name: Fish N Lentil Chowder Dal Machh
Ingredient Names: fish head, lentils, turmeric, fenugreek seeds, coriander, green chilies, mustard seeds, cumin seed, tomatoes, onion, water, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly fry fish heads in 2 tbsp oil and keep aside. Step 2: Fry onions in the remaining oil til lightly golden. Step 3: Add mustard seeds and cumin. Step 4: Add cooked lentils into it. Step 5: Add water, fenugreek, turmeric, cubed tomatoes and salt and bring to simmer. Step 6: Add fish heads and boil for 5 minutes Crush the head roughly using a heavy ladle while on fire. Step 7: Garnish with coriander and take it off the fire to serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, potatoes, cauliflower floret, chicken stock, salt, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Put in onion, ginger and garlic and saute until onion is somewhat brown. Step 3: Add spices all at once, stir and add potatoes, cauliflower and chicken stock. Step 4: Add salt in needed. Step 5: Cover and simmer until potatoes soften. Step 6: Taste for salt and add if needed. Step 7: Put soup in blender in batches and blend thoroughly. Step 8: Strain, pushing down to get all the pulp. Step 9: Add cream and mix Reheat gently or refrigerate if prepared in advance and then can reheat gently.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, ginger, garlic, garam masala, vegetable stock, fresh carrots, chickpeas, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan, then add the onion, ginger and garlic. Step 2: Fry for 2 mins, then add the garam masala, give it 1 min more, then add the stock and carrots. Step 3: Simmer for 10 mins, then add the chickpeas. Step 4: Use a stick blender to whizz the soup a little. Step 5: Stir in the beans and simmer for 3 mins. Step 6: Pack into a flask or, if you’ve got a microwave at work, chill and heat up for lunch. Step 7: Great with naan bread.

Ingredient Names: pearl barley, vegetable oil, brown mustard seeds, cumin seeds, green chilies, bay leaf, cinnamon, ground turmeric, onions, garlic, parsnips, butternut squash, sweet potato, paprika, ground coriander, red lentils, tomatoes, fresh coriander, ginger, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the pearl barley and cook following pack instructions. When it is tender, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a deep, heavy-bottomed pan. Fry the mustard seeds, cumin seeds, chillies, bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon and turmeric until fragrant and the seeds start to crackle. Tip in the onion and garlic, then cook for 5-8 mins until soft. Stir in the parsnip, butternut and sweet potato and mix thoroughly, making sure the vegetables are fully coated with the oil and spices. Sprinkle in the paprika, ground coriander and seasoning, and stir again. Step 2: Add the lentils, pearl barley, tomatoes and 1.7 litres water. Bring to the boil then turn down and simmer until the vegetables are tender. When the lentils are almost cooked, stir in the chopped coriander, ginger and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, onion, gingerroot, garlic, coriander seed, cumin seeds, green tomatoes, green bell pepper, red chili pepper, potato, chicken stock, palm sugar, skim milk, salt, nonfat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onions, garlic, ginger, coriander and cumin and cook, stirring, until the onions are soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes, pepper, potatoes, broth, chili pepper and sugar. Step 4: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes Pure the soup in batches in a blender or food processor. Step 5: Return the soup to a pot and add the milk and salt, heat to a simmer. Step 6: Serve garnished with a dollop of yogurt, cashews, and cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: chicken soup base, water, lentils, brown rice, apples, tomatoes, celery, onion, raisins, curry powder, cinnamon, black pepper, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Chop about 3-4 apples and 3-4 large tomatoes Finely chop celery and 1 small onion. Step 2: Stir together chicken soup base and water. Step 3: Mix all ingredients in a 4 quart crock pot. Step 4: Simmer 3 hours on high or until thick.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic, ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, curry powder, carrot, potato, lentils, apple, chicken stock, lime juice, coconut milk, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan, addd onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and spices. Step 2: Cook, until onion is lightly browned and spices are fragrant. Step 3: Add carrot, apple, potato, lentil and chicken stock and then bring to boil, simmering until lentils and vegetables are cooked- about 15- 20 minutes. Step 4: Blend soup until smooth, then add lime juice, coconut milk and coriander. Step 5: Heat through but do not boil.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, fresh carrot, garam masala, finger-length ginger, oranges, vegetable stock, reduced-fat coconut milk, mixed beans, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Gently cook the onions and carrots for 15 mins until soft and golden. Add garam masala and ginger, then cook for 1 min more. Step 2: Add the orange juice and stock, then bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 mins until the carrots are tender, then stir in the coconut milk. Using a stick blender, purée until smooth, then add the beans. Bring to a simmer, scatter over coriander and serve.

Dish Name: Spicy lentil soup with curry pinwheel rolls
Ingredient Names: curry paste, onions, fresh carrots, red lentils, vegetable stock, bread mix
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. For the rolls, make up the bread mix following pack instructions, then roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread over the curry paste, then roll up, starting with the longest edge, like a roly poly. Cut into 8 slices and transfer to a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake for 20-25 mins or until golden and cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the soup. Fry the curry paste and onion in a large pan for 2 mins until fragrant. Stir in the carrots and lentils and mix to coat in the curry paste. Cook for 2 mins, then pour in the stock and simmer for 20 mins until the lentils are tender. Whizz with a stick blender until smooth, add some seasoning and serve with the curry pinwheels.

Ingredient Names: apples, sugar, condensed milk, semolina, ground cinnamon, dried fruit, ground cardamom, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Microwave the grated apples 3 minutes. Step 2: Add sugar, condensed milk and semolina. Step 3: Mix well Microwave all together 12 minutes Dived in 2 portions. Step 4: Prepare 2 greased pans of 5 to 7 inches Cinnamon halva: add cinnamon, mix well, spread in the first pan and decorate with dried fruits Cardamom halva: add cardamom, mix well, spread in the first pan and decorate with almonds or nuts. Step 5: After cooling down keep in refrigerator and cut in small pieces. Step 6: Serve refrigerated or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk powder, sugar, water, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Pour water in a pot. Step 2: Add sugar and allow it to come to boil till the mixture has one thread consistency, remove from heat. Step 3: Pour coconut milk powder into this mixture and mix thoroughly and quickly. Step 4: Spoon out the mixture into a greased tray While the burfi mixture is still warm, cut it into pieces with a sharp knife Otherwise, let it cool and then break into pieces The choice is yours I prefer to do it while it is still warm. Step 5: Store in an airtight container for upto a week but i am sure it won't last that long because its quite yum and will be gone in the belly soon:).

Dish Name: A Great Appetiser Mushroom Salt And Pepper
Ingredient Names: canned mushrooms, cornflour, maida flour, water, salt, oil, garlic, ginger, green chili, onions, red chili paste, vinegar, soya sauce, spring onion, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok In the meantime, wash and drain the canned mushrooms. Step 2: Remove the stem of each mushroom. Step 3: Put into a large bowl. Step 4: Add cornflour, maida, salt and a little water, mix well. Step 5: Put each mushroom, one at a time, into the hot oil and fry until light brown. Step 6: Remove onto a clean paper napkin so as to drain out the excess oil. Step 7: Prepare red chilli paste by heating a little garlic in a pan and then adding it to a little red chilli powder. Step 8: Mix well and then add a little water to prepare the red chilli paste.

Dish Name: A Ramchandani Special Subru Uncle's Traditional Sindhi Curry Mo
Ingredient Names: vegetable drumsticks, ladyfingers, potatoes, yams, beans, white pumpkin, carrots, green chilies, turmeric powder, red chili powder, oil, tomatoes, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes in plenty of water until tender, drain and keep aside In the meantime, heat oil in a pot. Step 2: Add fenugreek seeds and allow it to crackle. Step 3: Once it stops crackling and turns lightly golden brown, add cumin seeds and allow to crackle. Step 4: Once it stops crackling, add 10-15 fresh curry leaves, green chillies and ginger. Step 5: Mix well and stir-fry until the raw smell of ginger is gone This takes about 5 minutes. Step 6: Then add gramflour and stir-fry it for 20 minutes, mixing it continuously, on low flame, until it is no longer raw taste-wise. Step 7: Add the remaining 10 fresh curry leaves alongwith asafoetida powder. Step 8: Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes on high flame.

Ingredient Names: potato, red chili powder, chaat masala, coriander powder, onion, salt, tamarind pulp, oil, butter, mint leaves, coriander leaves, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan and add onions fry till they soften do not brown. Step 2: Now add coriander powder, chillies powder and tamrind pulp. Step 3: After this add the potatoes, salt and chaat masala, mix well, add butter. Step 4: Turn off the heat And garnish it with greens that is coriander leaves, mint leaves and green chillies.

Ingredient Names: fresh mango, orange juice, clear honey, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine mango, orange juice& sweetener in food processor. Step 2: Blend for 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 3: Pour milk into processor& process till it has expanded& becomes frothy. Step 4: Add the mango puree Process for about 1 minute. Step 5: Pour into chilled glasses. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: green mangoes, mustard oil, dried red chilies, bengali five-spice mix, water, sugar, salt, powdered cumin, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the mango into 6 pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in the pan. Step 3: Fry the mango slices in the hot oil until slightly brown. Step 4: Remove mango pieces and keep aside To the same pan add the dry red chilli and panch phoron. Step 5: Pour in two cups of water, the sugar and the salt. Step 6: Let this boil then add the mango slices. Step 7: Simmer over medium heat until the sugar syrup thickens to your desired Consistency. Step 8: Pour in a serving bowl and sprinkle the dry grounded spices.

Ingredient Names: semolina flour, granulated sugar, water, ghee, sliced almonds, golden raisin
Instructions: Step 1: 1) heat water and sugar together and bring to a boil to make simple syrup 2) meanwhile, heat ghee in a non-stick pan 3) add sooji to the ghee and stir regularly until the sooji turns golden brown 4) switch off the gas and place this pan on the side 5) add sugar and water mixture to the sooji Be careful, as it will boil up on you 6) return the above to the stove and on medium heat, stir frequently until the water gets evaporated 7) add half the almonds and all the raisins 8) cook this until the mixture leaves ghee on the sides 9) remove and garnish with rest of the almonds and enjoy this warm and comforting dessert with your loved ones!

Ingredient Names: water, cinnamon stick, green cardamom pods, whole cloves, star anise, fresh ginger, black tea leaves, honey, whole milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, bring the water, all of the spices and the ginger to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Turn off the heat and allow it to steep for 15 minutes. Step 3: Bring the mixture back to a boil, then add the tea. Step 4: Turn the heat off, and allow it to steep for 3 to 5 minutes depending on how strong you like your tea. Step 5: Stir in the honey and add milk to your liking. Step 6: Strain it into a bowl or pitcher and serve!, enjoy!

Dish Name: Absolutely Addicitve Kale Moti Biryani Lunch That's Complete
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, salt, green cardamoms, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaves, urad dal, baking soda, salted butter, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, low-fat plain yogurt, tomatoes, green chili
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the black urad dal overnight in plenty of water The following morning, drain, and replenish with fresh water. Step 2: Add baking soda and salt, boil until cooked, drain, keep aside. Step 3: Wash the rice and soak for 15 minutes in water, drain. Step 4: Boil rice in 3 5 cups water with salt and garam masala powder.

Dish Name: Achingya Thoren Kerala Style Green Bean Curry
Ingredient Names: curry leaves, coconut, ground cumin, cayenne, turmeric, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, brown mustard seeds, raw rice, dried hot red chiles, green beans, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop 5 of the curry leaves, and put in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add coconut, cumin, cayenne, turmeric, and garlic, and mix well. Step 3: Add enough water to make coconut mixture moist enough to just hold together when pinched between thumb and forefinger, then set aside. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add mustard seeds and rice, and fry until mustard seeds pop, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add chiles, fry for a few seconds, and carefully add remaining 10 curry leaves Be careful - leaves will spatter when they hit the hot oil. Step 7: When leaves have crackled but are still green, about 30 seconds, add green beans, salt, and 2 tbsp water, and stir to mix well. Step 8: Cook, stirring often, until beans begin to soften yet are still slightly crunchy, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Stir in reserved coconut mixture, and cook, stirring often, until beans are tender, about 5 minutes more.

Dish Name: Addictive Milk Toffee To Enjoy With Coffee
Ingredient Names: condensed milk, sugar, butter, green cardamom powder, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first 3 ingredients in a pan. Step 2: Stir well and put on high flame to cook. Step 3: Add water{exactly half the quantity of the milk in the milk tin} and stir well. Step 4: Cook till the mixture leaves the sides of the pan. Step 5: Grease a tray with little butter. Step 6: Pour the cooked mixture in it. Step 7: Sprinkle chopped nuts on top and powdered green cardamom. Step 8: Allow it to set in a cool place or in a refrigerator. Step 9: Once its set, cut it into square shapes. Step 10: Now all you got to do is eat them!

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, agave nectar, dijon mustard, vegan butter, onions, curry powder, salt, red pepper flakes, ground ginger, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Dump all ingredients into slow cooker, stir to combine Cover and cook 4-5 hours on low setting Serve over basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, salt, black pepper, cilantro, butter, onion, jalapeno chile, fresh ginger, dried red pepper, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the eggs lightly with the milk, salt, pepper and chopped cilantro. Step 2: Heat butter, or ghee, in a large skillet and saute the chopped onions until they begin to color. Step 3: Add the chiles, ginger, red pepper, turmeric and cumin. Step 4: Stir over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Step 5: Raise the heat slightly and pour in the beaten eggs. Step 6: Stir constantly until the eggs are just set but still creamy. Step 7: Serve immediately with chapatis.

Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, cilantro, onion, pomegranate seeds, salt, oil, garlic, buns, green chili, bread, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the boiled rajma with the back of a fork in a large bowl. Step 2: Using your fingers, break the 2 slices of bread and add to the bowl. Step 3: Add garlic, onions, green chillies, salt, cilantro and pommegranate seeds. Step 4: Mix everything well. Step 5: Make small round / slightly big tikkis out of this Shallow fry in oil on either side till brown. Step 6: Drain out excess oil. Step 7: Remove from oil and keep aside, now take the bun. Step 8: Cut it into 2 halves.

Ingredient Names: ground almonds, sliced almonds, blanched almonds, evaporated milk, superfine sugar, vanilla extract, chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the evaporated milk, sugar and vanilla extract for 1 minute. Step 2: Add the ground almonds and whisk for a further minute. Step 3: Stir in the flaked almonds. Step 4: Pour the kulfi mixture into an 850ml plastic freezer container and freeze overnight Half an hour before serving, remove the container from the freezer and place in the fridge to soften slightly. Step 5: Cut the kulfi into slices and garnish each portion with a whole blanched almond. Step 6: Sprinkle with grated chocolate, if using.

Dish Name: Almond Milk Vegan Raw Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: almonds, water, molasses
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients to blender Process at low speed for 1 minute, and 3 minutes at high speed until smooth. Step 2: Strain the mixture through a cheese cloth to remove remaining solids. Step 3: Refrigerate until ready to use.

Dish Name: Aloo Baigain Potato And Eggplant Aubergine
Ingredient Names: potato, eggplants, red chili powder, cumin, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, garlic paste, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut potato and eggplant into small pieces. Step 2: Take frying pan and pour 1 tbsp oil. Step 3: After the oil is hot, add cumin and mustard seed to it. Step 4: When the mustard seeds crackle, add potato and eggplant. Step 5: Saute about 10-15 seconds. Step 6: Add garlic paste and other dry spices as mentioned above. Step 7: Stir in one cup of water, add salt. Step 8: Cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Step 9: Heat till until potatoes are soft, but not mushy.

Ingredient Names: aubergine, potato, onion, gingerroot, garlic cloves, curry powder, cumin powder, chili powder, turmeric, coriander leaves, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potato with a little salt and turmeric for 10-15 minutes until almost cooked. Step 2: Fry the finely chopped onion until translucent in the veg oil. Step 3: Add the curry powder and cumin powder and sliced garlic and grated ginger and stir fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Chop the aubergine and add to the pan. Step 5: Simmer on a medium heat for 20-30 minutes until the aubergine is soft, 5 minutes before the end add the cooked potatoes, mix well and leave to simmer. Step 6: When finished drain as much oil as you can and serve immediately topped with the coriander!

Ingredient Names: oil, cumin, asafoetida, onions, garlic, ginger, chili, turmeric, chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, tomato puree, curds, fresh coriander, dried fenugreek, butter, capsicum, boiled potato
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil, add 1 tsp cumin and pinch hing. Step 2: Add 1 onion, 5 cloves garlic, 1 inch ginger and 2 chilli. Step 3: Saute until the onions turn golden brown. Step 4: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp coriander powder and 1 tsp salt. Step 5: Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 6: Add 1 cup tomato puree and cook until the oil separates from the sides. Step 7: Also, add ½ cup curd and cook till the oil separates. Step 8: Now in another pan, heat 2 tsp oil and 1 tbsp butter. Step 9: Add ½ onion, ½ capsicum and saute till the capsicum turn crunchy. Step 10: Further add pinch turmeric, ¼ tsp chilli powder and ½ tsp salt. Step 11: Saute till the spices turn aromatic. Step 12: Add 3 boiled potatoes and mix, ensuring all the spices are coated well and the potatoes are roasted. Step 13: Transfer the roasted potato to the sabzi and mix gently. Adjust the consistency adding water as required. Step 14: Add 2 tbsp coriander and 2 tbsp kasuri methi and mix well. Step 15: Finally, enjoy Aloo Bhuna Recipe with roti.

Dish Name: Aloo Channa Chaat Tangy Potato Chickpea Snack
Ingredient Names: garbanzo beans, potatoes, shallots, tamarind paste, water, mild chili powder, brown sugar, salt, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain the garbanzo beans, place in a bowl. Step 2: Boil water in a pan, add the diced potatoes and cook until they are soft and tender. Step 3: Remove potatoes, drain and set aside to cool. Step 4: In a small mixing bowl, mix the tamarind paste and water. Step 5: Add the chili powder, sugar and salt, mix well. Step 6: Pour the tamarind mixture on the garbanzo beans and add the potatoes, chopped onions and the cilantro. Step 7: Mix well and adjust salt to taste. Step 8: Garnish ideas: a slit green chili or a slice a tomato or a slice of lime with a sprig of mint leaves.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, onions, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, green chilies, salt, turmeric, red pepper, cloves, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all the ingredients of puree to a smooth paste and keep aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a non stick heavy base skillet and when medium hot put cloves. Step 3: Now add all the spices and wait for 10 seconds. Step 4: Add the puree and saute for 2-3 minutes till the raw smell is gone and oil appears on the sides of the skillet. Step 5: Add 2 cups of water and the potatoes. Step 6: Let it simmer for 15 minutes. Step 7: Serve warm with rice, indian roti, paratha etc.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, khoya, fresh curds, garam masala, ground nutmeg, water, jeera seeds, coriander powder, jeera powder, sugar, salt, butter, onions, ginger paste, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes and peel them Prick the potatoes as much as you can with out breaking them. Step 2: Sprinkle salt over potatoes. Step 3: Take a non-stick pan, put 2 tablespoons butter in it. Step 4: Then put the potatoes in, sprinkle a pinch of tumuric powder, and roast it until potatoes are golden colored. Step 5: Put the potatoes aside In the same pan put rest of the butter, red chili, and cumin seeds to splutter. Step 6: Then put the onion and fry it until golden brown. Step 7: Then put the ginger paste, coriander and jira powder, and fry for 4-5 minutes. Step 8: Then add the sugar and rest of the tumuric powder.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, fresh coriander, green chili, cauliflower, potatoes, diced tomatoes, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, cumin seed, turmeric, salt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add the chopped onion and one teaspoon of cumin seeds to the oil. Step 3: Stir together and cook until onions become creamy, golden, and translucent. Step 4: Add chopped coriander stalks, two teaspoons of turmeric, and one teaspoon of salt. Step 5: Add chopped chillis stir tomatoes into onion mixture. Step 6: Add ginger and garlic, mix thoroughly. Step 7: Add potatoes and cauliflower to the sauce plus a few tablespoons of water Ensure that the potatoes and cauliflower are coated with the curry sauce. Step 8: Cover and allow to simmer for twenty minutes.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, boiling potatoes, vegetable oil, fenugreek seeds, fennel seed, whole cumin seed, dried hot red chili pepper, ground turmeric, ground coriander, salt, ground pepper, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large 12 to 14 inch skillet. Step 2: When the oil is smoking, scatter in the fenugreek, fennel, cumin and red peppers. Step 3: Stir once and add the cauliflower and potatoes. Step 4: Stir lightly until coated with spices and oil. Step 5: Turn heat down to medium. Step 6: Add turmeric, ground coriander, salt and pepper Saut for 810 minutes. Step 7: Add cup water and cover immediately. Step 8: Turn heat very low and steam vegetables for 7-10 minutes. Step 9: Sprinkle the garam masala over the vegetables, stir once and serve.

Dish Name: Aloo Gobi Mattar Cauliflower Pea And Potato Curry
Ingredient Names: cauliflower, onions, baking potatoes, frozen green pea, vegetable stock, olive oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, hot green chili pepper, turmeric, garam masala, ground coriander, salt, white pepper, fenugreek seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large wok, karahi, or deep nonstick pan over high heat. Step 2: Add onions and cumin seeds, and cook until onions are translucent. Step 3: Then add the minced garlic, chunks of ginger and chili pepper Saut for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 4: Add all remaining spices, including salt. Step 5: Stir well Immediately add potato to pan. Step 6: Stir until coated in oil and spices. Step 7: Turn heat down to medium and saut potato for 3-5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add chicken or vegetable stock, then put lid on pan, lower heat to medium-low and simmer for around 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Aloo Gobi Potato And Cauliflower Curry
Ingredient Names: potatoes, cauliflower, oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, fenugreek seeds, dried red chili, onion, fresh green chile, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes in their skins and allow to cool Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2 inch squares Blanch the cauliflower in boiling water for 2 minutes-do not over boil the cauliflower as it should still be firm after cooking. Step 2: Cut into small florets. Step 3: Heat the oil over medium heat in a wide frypan. Step 4: Add the mustard seeds and as soon as they begin popping, add the cumin and fenugreek seeds and then the red chillies. Step 5: Add the onion and the green chilli, stir and fry until the onions are golden brown-8-10 minutes. Step 6: Add the cauliflower, reduce the heat to low, cover the pan and cook for 6-8 minutes. Step 7: Add the potatoes, dried spices and salt. Step 8: Stir gently until all the ingredients are mixed thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: asafoetida powder, cumin seed, ginger, cardamom powder, green chilies, mustard seeds, oil, potato, red chili powder, salt, turmeric powder, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes, cool, peel and cut them into small cubes and set aside Peel and wash the ginger and set aside. Step 2: Remove the stems, wash and roughly chop the green chillies and grind them to a fine paste and set aside And whip the yoghurt until it is smooth. Step 3: Heat the oil in a pan, and add the asafoetida, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, ginger and the green chilli paste Saut for two minutes. Step 4: Then add the potato pieces, and mix well. Step 5: Add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, green cardamom powder, salt and cook for some time. Step 6: Add the yoghurt and cook stirring continuously. Step 7: Then add half a cup of water and mix well.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, frozen peas, green chili, white onion, garlic paste, ginger paste, tomato sauce, olive oil, cumin seeds, bay leaves, turmeric, garam masala, ground red pepper, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add cumin seed and bay leaves. Step 3: When seeds begin to splutter, add onion, garlic, and ginger paste and saute until oil separates. Step 4: Add half the tomato sauce, turmeric, garam masala, red pepper, and coriander powder. Step 5: Stir fry until the oil separates. Step 6: Add peas, potatoes, and green chilis and the rest of the tomato sauce and heat through. Step 7: Take out the bay leaves I like to serve this over jasmine rice with pita bread or naan You can also add plain yogurt to taste if you desire a creamier dish Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, ginger-garlic paste, cloves, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, garam masala, chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, tomatoes, potatoes, peas, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in the pan, and add the onions in along with the ginger garlic paste, cook for 1 minute. Step 2: Add in the cloves, cinnamon stick, and bay leaves Saut for 2 minutes add the garam masala, chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, tomatoes and salt. Step 3: Add in your diced potatoes, and peas. Step 4: Mix and pour in 1 cup of water. Step 5: Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Step 6: Serve with indian flatbread or rice.

Dish Name: Aloo Mutter Indian Potatoes With Peas
Ingredient Names: olive oil flavored cooking spray, cumin seed, onion, tomatoes, salt, ground red pepper, turmeric, red potatoes, frozen peas, water, fresh cilantro, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Spray saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and stir fry for 1-2 minutes till golden brown. Step 3: Stir in tomatoes, salt, ground pepper and turmeric, stir fry for 1-2 minutes till tomatoes are tender. Step 4: Stir in remaining ingredients, except the garam masaala, boil, then reduce to medium-low. Step 5: Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Step 6: Uncover and cook for 5 minutes until sauce is thick. Step 7: Add garam masaala.

Ingredient Names: spinach, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onions, green chili, potatoes, turmeric, ghee, cumin seed, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, fresh cream, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a pan cook the spinach with garlic, ginger, onions and the green chilies for about 5-10 minutes. Step 2: Remove from the pan and blend to a fine puree and keep aside In the meantime boil the potatoes with salt and turmeric until done, apprximately 10 minutes and set aside when done. Step 3: Heat ghee in a pan, fry cumin seeds along with spinach-onion paste and simmer for a few minutes. Step 4: Add the cooked potatoes, garam masala, coriander and cumin powder and a little water if needed. Step 5: Simmer for few minutes till the potatoes absorb the flavor. Step 6: Add fresh cream if desired.

Dish Name: Aloo Paratha Indian Potato Stuffed Flatbreads
Ingredient Names: potatoes, whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, cumin, sea salt, olive oil, water, cayenne, salt, fresh ground pepper, citrus juice, kalamata olive
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes in salted water to cover, until tender While potatoes cook, mix the flours, cumin, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Step 2: Add 2 tablespoons of oil, then water. Step 3: Mix until this becomes a defined ball of dough. Step 4: Remove and knead until smooth, adding flour or water as necessary. Step 5: Cover dough with plastic wrap and set aside while preparing potatoes. Step 6: When potatoes are finished, remove, drain and mash them with cayenne, salt, pepper, citrus juice, olives and 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 7: Taste and adjust seasonings as necessary On a lightly floured surface, roll dough into 12-inch long snake and cut into 12 pieces. Step 8: Roll each piece into about 4-inch round.

Ingredient Names: onions, vegetable oil, potato, salt, cayenne, ground turmeric, cumin, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly brown onion in oil in medium skillet. Step 2: Stir in salt cayenne turmeric and cumin. Step 3: Add potatoes and cook 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add tomatoes; cover and cook until potatoes are soft, about 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, corn oil, gram flour, water, red chili powder, cumin powder, garlic, ginger, salt, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Add water to the besan Besan has a tendency to be very clumpy, so you should add just a few tablespoons at a time to keep the batter smooth. Step 2: Add the chilli powder, cumin powder, garlic, ginger, salt and chopped coriander and stir the batter The potatoes should be sliced very thinly No thicker than 1 / 4 of an inch At this point test one slice of potato in the batter There should just be a thin coat of batter. Step 3: Heat the oil in a pan Use a larger frying pan so that you have more surface area The oil doesn't need to be too deep since the potato slices are very thin.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, dried fenugreek leaves, mint leaf, fresh cilantro, green chili pepper, ginger paste, ajwain, salt, pepper, vegetable oil, nonfat plain yogurt, flour, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes till tender, then grate them. Step 2: Mix together in a large bowl, the wholewheat flour, ap flour, fenugreek and mint leaves, cilantro, chili, ginger, ajwain seeds, salt and pepper. Step 3: Mix in the grated potatoes and oil You should have a semi-firm dough that does not stick to your fingers, but if you don't have enough moisture, add some of the optional yogurt to yield a dough of such consistency Do not knead the dough anymore than needed to incorporate everything There is also no need to let it rest. Step 4: Divide the dough into 10-12 balls with lightly oiled, clean hands. Step 5: Dust your rolling surface with some flour, and roll each ball into a thin 6-inch circle. Step 6: Heat your griddle over medium-high heat and cook the breads until they are speckled with golden dots on each side This should take about a minute per side.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, tomatoes, ground turmeric, potatoes, salt, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, water, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add the cumin, mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds, if using, let splutter. Step 3: Add tomatoes or tomato sauce and cook for 2 minutes until tomatoes are soft. Step 4: Add turmeric and potatoes, mix well. Step 5: Then add salt, coriander and cayenne pepper, if using. Step 6: Add water, cover and let simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with cilantro, if desired.

Dish Name: Alu Paratha Mashed Potato Stuffed Bread
Ingredient Names: wheat flour, boiled potatoes, onion, green chili, roasted cumin seeds, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the dough take the wheat flour, add half tsp of salt, 1 tbsp of vegetable oil. Step 2: Mix well and pour water over the flour and knead into a smooth dough. Step 3: Keep aside to rest. Step 4: Mash the boiled potatoes, add roasted cumin seeds, chopped onion, and green chilly and salt. Step 5: Mix well till all the ingredients are nicely combined Doubh and smashed potato To prepare the paratha, take a golf ball sized portion of the dough, flatten it with your palm. Step 6: Now place a spoon full of the prepared stuffing in the centre of the flattened dough ball. Step 7: Now bring together all the sides of the dough and pinch them tightly to form a dumpling. Step 8: Place this dumpling on your work top and roll it out gently using a rolling pin.

Dish Name: Alu Patras Fried Spicy Potato Swirls
Ingredient Names: potatoes, coconut, sesame seeds, brown sugar, fresh ginger, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, garam masala, salt, lemon juice, white flour, turmeric, cayenne, butter, water
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the filling first, so that it will be cool by the time the dough is ready If you spread it while hot, it will make holes in the dough. Step 2: Boil the potatoes until soft. Step 3: Rinse under cool water and peel, mash with fork. Step 4: Add grated coconut and next 8 ingredients. Step 5: Spread the mixture on a surface to cool. Step 6: Mix flour, turmeric, cayenne together in a large bowl Rub in the melted butter, then add the water slowly and mix into a dough, knead until soft.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, oil, spring onions, cloves, cinnamon, green cardamoms, bay leaf, mushroom, garam masala powder, cumin powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Drain rice after washing it and keep aside. Step 2: Combine oil, spring onion whites, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom and bay leaf in a glass bowl Microwave on high for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add mushrooms Microwave on high for 1 more minute. Step 4: Add rice and mix well Microwave on high for 1 minute. Step 5: Add 2 cups of hot water to the rice mixture alongwith the remaining ingredients. Step 6: Mix well Microwave on high for 10 minutes, stirring twice in between.

Ingredient Names: oil, asafoetida powder, brown mustard seeds, whole cumin seed, curry leaves, frozen peas, serrano pepper, salt, sugar, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, coconut, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large frying pan on medium-high heat. Step 2: When hot, put in the aesofetida and then a second later the mustard and cumin seeds. Step 3: When the mustard seeds start popping, toss in the curry leaves. Step 4: Stir for a good second or two and put in the peas, chiles, salt, sugar, and all the ground spices. Step 5: Stir for a minute until the peas are fully defrosted. Step 6: Add 4 tbsp water and bring to a boil. Step 7: Cover, turn the heat down to low, and simmer for 5 minutes or until peas are tender. Step 8: Uncover and turn the heat back up to medium-high, add the shredded coconut and cilantro and cook off excess liquid.

Ingredient Names: panir, tomatoes, onion, cashews, cinnamon, ground cloves, turmeric, chili powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste, cooking oil, heavy cream, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, make a paste of the onion and tomato. Step 2: Add the ginger garlic paste. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet, then add the tomato mixture, and cook until it starts to separate. Step 4: Add salt, chili powder, turmeric, cinnamon and cloves, cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup water and bring to a simmer. Step 6: In a blender, process the cashews and cream to make a paste. Step 7: Add the mixture in the skillet and cook for another 1 - 2 minutes. Step 8: Cut paneer into small pieces, and add to the curry mixture, let simmer for 5 more minutes. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro.

Dish Name: Amras A Mango Delicacy That Will Make You Kitchen Goddess
Ingredient Names: condensed milk, mangoes, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the pulp of the mangoes Mash / blend it coarsely Add condensed and cold milk and serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, curds, coriander powder, garam masala, chaat masala, pav bhaji masala, oil, butter, cumin, dried fenugreek, garlic, onions, turmeric, chili powder, tomato, milk, paneer, salt, chili, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a thick-bottomed pan dry roast 2 tbsp besan on low flame until it turns aromatic and golden brown. Step 2: Transfer the roasted besan to a bowl and allow to cool completely. Step 3: Now add ¾ cup curd, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp chaat masala, 1 tsp pav bhaji masala. Step 4: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Keep aside. Step 5: In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp butter, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tbsp kasuri methi. saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 6: Add 5 cloves garlic, and 1 onion and saute well. Step 7: Keeping the flame on low add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, and saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 8: Furthermore, add 2 tomatoes and saute making sure the tomato turns mushy. Step 9: Now add the prepared besan curd mixture and cook well. Step 10: Cook until the mixture separates the oil from it. Step 11: Also, add ¾ cup milk and mix adjusting the consistency as required. Step 12: Add 200 grams paneer, 1 tsp salt, and mix well. Cook for 1 minute or until the paneer is well cooked. Step 13: Now add onion, tomato, 1 chilli and mix well. Do not cook as the crunch of the onion will be lost. Step 14: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and enjoy Amritsari Paneer Bhurji Recipe with bread.

Ingredient Names: eggs, oil, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, bay leaves, crushed tomatoes, ground turmeric, chili powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Step 2: Add the onion, ginger, garlic, and bay leaves, and cook for four minutes, or until the onion is soft. Step 3: Add the tomato, turmeric, chili powder, cumin, coriander, 1 tsp salt, and 1 cup of water. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for three minutes. Step 5: Add the garam masala and eggs, then simmer for a minute or two to warm the eggs.

Dish Name: Anytime Two Step Green Pea Curry
Ingredient Names: green peas, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, yogurt, salt, red chili powder, coriander powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare a puree of ingredients. Step 2: Heat oil, add the puree and spices. Step 3: Saute for 7 minutes on medium heat till the raw smell is gone. Step 4: Add green peas and saute for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup of water and cook covered for 8 minutes. Step 6: Serve hot with steamed rice, pasta, indian rotis or arabic bread.

Ingredient Names: apples, plain fat-free yogurt, fresh lime juice, water, sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the yogurt, sugar and cold water together in a blender. Step 2: Add the limejuice and apple to the lassi, blend again. Step 3: Put crushed ice in glasses. Step 4: Pour lassi over it and serve.

Ingredient Names: rice, coconut, cooked rice, milk, sugar, salt, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the raw rice in water for around 3-4 hours Scrape the coconut Grind the rice with the coconut and the cooked rice till very fine. Step 2: Keep it overnight or for 8 hours early next morning add 1 glass of boiling hot milk to the batter and the sugar, salt and yeast / cooking soda mix well cover and keep aside for 3 hours. Step 3: Now heat a non stick wok. Step 4: Pour a ladle full of the batter into the wok and swirl the wok around so that the batter spreads around 6-8 inches in diameter. Step 5: Cover and cook on medium heat till the lower part of the appam is light brown or the top part is not moist but spongy The sides will seem lacey and the centre will be thick like an idli This dish can be served with coconut milk and powdered cardamom sweetened with jaggery and sugar or with chicken or mutton stew and yes do try it with maple syrup or as it is.

Ingredient Names: apples, milk, sugar, green cardamoms, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel apple and cut in small pieces. Step 2: Now blend milk, sugar and apple in a mixer Grind elaichi to a powder and mix in the shake. Step 3: Now pour shake in the glasses. Step 4: Put some crushed ice and serve it chilled.

Ingredient Names: dried apricot, onions, cider vinegar, garlic cloves, oranges, light brown sugar, golden raisin, salt, english mustard, ground allspice, ground ginger, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dried apricots overnight in water. Step 2: Drain apricots and chop. Step 3: Boil the chopped onions for a few minutes to soften them, drain. Step 4: Cut zest from oranges in long strips, and dice strips into 1 inch pieces. Step 5: Put all the ingredients except the walnuts into a large non-aluminium kettle and bring to the boil. Step 6: Turn down the heat and cook gently, stirring regularly, for 1 1 / 2 hours until the mixture is thick. Step 7: Stir in the walnuts. Step 8: Pour while hot into warm sterilized jars Seal with lids and rings.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, salt, cinnamon stick, green cardamom pods
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice in a fine strainer, then drain thoroughly. Step 2: Place all ingredients in the rice cooker bowl, and swirl to combine. Step 3: Set the machine for the regular white rice cycle. Step 4: When the machine shifts to 'keep warm', set a timer for 15 minutes. Step 5: After 15 minutes, fluff rice with the plastic paddle or a wooden spoon. Step 6: Serve now, or leave on 'keep warm' for up to 4 hours.

Dish Name: Aromatic Peas And Carrot Pilaf For One
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic powder, butter, basmati rice, cumin seed, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, cloves, carrot, fresh peas, salt, water, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice well, drain. Step 2: Melt butter / margarine / ghee in a saucepan over low to medium heat. Step 3: Saute garlic paste / powder / minced garlic in butter for about 15 seconds, then add the chopped onions and saute until browned, about 5-10 minutes. Step 4: Add the rice, cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, and cloves to the onion-garlic mixture and saute for 10-15 minutes or until the rice is evenly browned. Step 5: Now add carrots, peas, salt, and water, stir, bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook, without stirring, until the rice is tender, about 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Uncover and evaporate excess water if any, remove from flame, and fluff up with a fork. Step 7: Season with extra salt and pepper, if necessary, and serve hot!

Ingredient Names: potatoes, vegetable oil, yellow mustard seeds, cumin seed, jalapeno, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, yellow onion, turmeric, fresh cilantro leaves, salt, fresh lemon juice, besan flour, cayenne pepper, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: In a frying pan, heat 2 tablespoons oil, and add your mustard seeds. Step 2: When the mustard seeds begin to sputter, add the cumin seeds, jalapeno, salt, ginger and garlic. Step 3: Fry these ingredients for just a few seconds and then add the onions and turmeric. Step 4: When the onions begin to brown, add your cilantro and lemon juice and then add the potatoes. Step 5: Mix well, being careful not to mash the potatoes anymore, and turn off the heat. Step 6: Allow this mixture to cool completely. Step 7: After the mixture has cooled, begin to shape the mixture into small balls, approximately 1 inch in diameter. Step 8: In a medium sized bowl, make a thick batter with your besan flour, cayenne, baking soda and salt, using enough water to make a thick batter. Step 9: Heat your oil in a deep fryer or something large enough to deep fry in. Step 10: Take a potato ball, coat it in the batter, and then carefully drop it into the heated oil.

Ingredient Names: butter, curry powder, lemon juice, salt, extra virgin olive oil, shallot, asparagus
Instructions: Step 1: Combine butter, curry powder, lemon juice and salt in a small bowl, creating a curry butter. Step 2: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add shallot and cook, stirring, until softened, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add asparagus and cook, stirring, until just tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir the curry butter into the asparagus. Step 6: Toss to coat and serve.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, sunflower oil, brown, curry leaves, onions, chilies, garam masala, ground coriander, turmeric, coconut milk, tomatoes, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the aubergines, then cut each half into wedges. Heat ½ tbsp oil in a large pan, preferably non-stick, and brown half the aubergines for 2-3 mins on each side until golden brown and crisp all over. Scoop onto a plate, repeat with more oil and the remaining aubergines, then set everything aside. Step 2: Add the remaining oil to the pan with the mustard seeds and curry leaves and fry for 30 secs until fragrant. Stir in the onions and continue cooking until they are softened and beginning to brown. Add the dried chillies and spices with a spoonful of the thick coconut milk from the top of the can, then fry for 1 min more. Add the remaining coconut milk, tomatoes and half a can of water. Simmer for 25-30 mins until thick and saucy. Step 3: Stir in the chickpeas and aubergines. Continue simmering for 5 mins or so, until everything is hot and the aubergines are tender. Serve with rice or warm naan bread, scattered with a few extra curry leaves sizzled in a splash of oil, if you like.

Dish Name: Aubergine Eggplant And Chickpea Curry In Minted Tomato Cream
Ingredient Names: aubergine, zucchini, ghee, onion, garlic cloves, fresh green chile, ground coriander, cumin seeds, ground turmeric, garam masala, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, salt and pepper, chickpeas, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the unpeeled eggplant into 3 / 4"-1" cubes Trim the ends off the unpeeled zucchini and slice. Step 2: Heat the ghee or oil in a large saucepan or heavy skillet and saute the eggplant, zucchini, onion, garlic and chillies for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until vegetables have softened If necessary add more ghee or oil, or add, as i do, a splash of water from time to time to help the process along. Step 3: Stir in the spices and cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add the undrained tomatoes, 3 / 4 cup of stock, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Cook gently for 10 minutes, adding another 1 / 4 cup of stock if the mixture is becoming dry. Step 6: Add the chickpeas to the pan and cook a further 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the mint and cream and gently reheat. Step 8: Meanwhile heat 2 tablespoons oil in a small skillet.

Ingredient Names: mixed vegetables, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, frozen coconut, hot green chili pepper, cumin seed, salt, yogurt, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: In a small amount of water, cook vegetables until almost done Grind together the coconut, chili, and cumin seeds using just a little water to accomplish this You should end up with a paste. Step 2: Add yogurt, turmeric and salt to the spice paste and mix well. Step 3: Turn heat on the vegetables to low and add the yogurt mix to the vegetables A low heat keeps the yogurt from curdling If it curdles, it's ok You can still eat it It just won't look as nice. Step 4: Heat the vegetable or coconut oil in a small pan.

Ingredient Names: avocados, onion, tomatoes, green chili, red chili powder, cumin powder, fresh cilantro leaves, lemon, unsweetened plain yogurt, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the peel and seed from the avocados and put into a mixing bowl. Step 2: Mash till almost smooth. Step 3: Add the chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, all the spices and the lemon juice and chopped cilantro or parsley. Step 4: Mix until all ingredients are blended. Step 5: Add the yogurt, salt to taste and stir to blend with avocado mixture. Step 6: Chill well in refrigerator and serve.

Ingredient Names: dried red lentils, carrot, water, potatoes, olive oil, mustard seeds, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, dried chili, curry powder, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the lentils, water and carrots in a large pot and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to med / low and partially cover, letting it simmer for 20 minutes. Step 3: Add the potatoes, and cook for 15-20 minutes more, till the potatoes are soft You may need to add an additional 1 / 2-1 cup of water if you find it getting too thick. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a small frying pan heat the olive oil and stir in the mustard seeds. Step 5: Stir for a minute, till they start to pop, reduce heat. Step 6: Stir in the other spices and saute for 1 minute, set aside. Step 7: When the potatoes and lentils are fully cooked, stir in the spice mixture, salt and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: ghee, black mustard seeds, carom seeds, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, onion, fresh ginger, minced garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up the ghee in a sauce pan and add the seeds in the following order: Mustard Adjwan Cumin. Step 2: When the seeds start popping, add the onion and the fresh ginger. Step 3: Cook until half way brown and add the asafoetida. Step 4: When the onions are nicely brown add the tomatoes and garlic. Step 5: When the tomatoes are fully cooked, add all of your powdered spices. Step 6: Cook for another 2-3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, fresh ginger, cumin, fennel, black peppercorns, mint
Instructions: Step 1: To make the water, boil two quarts of water and put it in a thermos flask. Step 2: Then add all the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Let it steep Drink this water throughout the day for a very purifying effect Also, this water will help enhance your digestion.

Ingredient Names: urad dal, mung dal, asafoetida, salt, green chilies, coriander leaves, ginger, baking soda, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Soak 1 / 2 cup urad dal and 1 / 2 cup moong dal in a large bowl of water for 2-3 hours. Step 2: Drain excess water, and grind to a smooth paste in a food processor. Step 3: Add hing / asafetida, salt, green chilies, coriander leaves, ginger and baking soda This should be a nice thick batter In hot ghee or oil, shape batter into doughnut-like shapes with a hole in the center and fry the bada in batches on both sides until golden brown. Step 4: Drain on paper towels. Step 5: Serve with a fresh chutney such as coriander.

Ingredient Names: almonds, sugar, whole milk, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a shallow 6x6 inch pan with ghee. Step 2: In a frying pan over a low flame, mix almonds, sugar and milk and keep stirring. Step 3: After 5 minutes, add ghee Continue stirring till the mixture thickens to the consistency of bread batter, and starts leaving the sides of the pan Continue stirring for another couple of minutes. Step 4: Remove from flame and pour it into the prepared greased pan Smoothen surface of the mixture if necessary 20 minutes later, after it partially cools down, cut into 1 inch squares using a knife or pastry cutter. Step 5: Cool completely, and store squares in an airtight tin.

Ingredient Names: heavy cream, condensed milk, bread, badam powder, pista powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the above ingredients together in a bowl. Step 2: Make sure eveything blends completely together well. Step 3: Then fill this mixture either in an ice-cream tray or in kulfi cones. Step 4: Refrigerate overnight in the frozen section of your refrigerator At the time of serving the kulfi, put the cones under the flowing hot water tap for only 1-2 seconds, and with a slight jerk, remove it in the individual serving plates.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, ghee, cumin seed, onion, ginger, garlic, diced tomatoes, green chilies, garam masala, red chili powder, salt, peas, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Prick a few holes and place on hot grill. Step 2: Keep turning until charred and soft inside Collect the pulp, discard the skin, chop roughly. Step 3: Heat ghee or oil, add cumin seeds. Step 4: Add onions and fry till golden. Step 5: Add ginger and garlic. Step 6: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the tomatoes, chillies, red chili powder, garam masala and salt.

Dish Name: Baingan Bharta Spicy Roasted Eggplant With Tomatoes Cilantro
Ingredient Names: eggplants, vegetable oil, onions, ginger, tomatoes, ground cumin, sweet paprika, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Oil rimmed baking sheet. Step 2: Place eggplant halves, cut side down, on sheet Roast eggplant until flesh is soft, about 1 hour, cool slightly. Step 3: Using spoon, scoop pulp from eggplant halves into medium bowl and mash, discard skins. Step 4: Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add onions and saut until golden brown, for about 6 minutes. Step 6: Add ginger and stir for 1 minute.

Dish Name: Baingan Ka Bharta Indian Punjabi Style
Ingredient Names: eggplant, onions, green chilies, fresh ginger, tomatoes, red chili powder, dhaniya powder, salt, oil, jeera powder, coriander leaves, garam masala powder, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to broil on high. Step 2: Grease the egg plant with some oil, poke 2 or three holes and put it in the oven. Step 3: Keep checking it till the outer skin starts cracking and can be peeled off easily You want the skin to burn a little so the eggplant has a smokey flavor. Step 4: Allow the eggplant to cool a little Peel the outer skin of the eggplant under cold water. Step 5: When the skin is removed, mash the eggplant well so that it has an even consistency, you can keep seeds or remove them based on your preferance. Step 6: Put some oil in a pan. Step 7: When hot, put hing and jeera in. Step 8: After a minute or so, when the cumin seeds begin to turn darker and give off aroma, add the finely chopped onions.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, green chili, garam masala, ground cumin, ground coriander, vegetarian baked beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a small saucepan. Step 2: Put in the chopped onion and fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add seeded and chopped chilli and cook for a couple of mins stirring continuously until onion begins to turn golden brown. Step 4: Add spices and fry for another minute. Step 5: Add beans reduce heat and cook for 3 minutes. Step 6: Taste and season if necessary. Step 7: Serve hot with toast or chapatis, naan or pita bread. Step 8: Stir in a knob of butter at end of cooking if creamier taste is required.

Ingredient Names: bread, olive oil, vegetarian baked beans, onion, carrot, green bell pepper, green peas, red chili powder, green chili, parsley, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat until hot. Step 2: Add green chilli and onions. Step 3: Saute till the onions turn light brown. Step 4: Add all the veggies, red chilli powder and baked beans, mix well. Step 5: Simmer for 2-3 minutes In your toaster in the meantime, toast the bread until it turns brown or as toasted as you would like it. Step 6: Remove the beans mixture from heat. Step 7: Spread it on the bread slice. Step 8: Garnish with parsley and grated cheese.

Dish Name: Baked Joghurt With Figs In Syrup Bhapa Doi E Gooler Mishti
Ingredient Names: sweetened condensed milk, natural yogurt, ground cardamom, pistachios, raisins, paper baking cups, figs, sugar, cloves, cinnamon sticks, star anise, lemon, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 150c / 300f put 6 paper muffin cups into 6 small oven-proof dishes. Step 2: Mix condensed milk, joghurt and cardamom with a whisk in a bowl. Step 3: Fold in pistachios and roughly chopped raisins. Step 4: Divide mixture into paper muffin cups. Step 5: Set oven-proof dishes into a roasting tin filled with warm water up to the middle of the oven proof-dishes Figs in syrup: In the meantime heat 300ml water together with the sugar, the spices, the grated lemon rind and the lemon juice over low heat. Step 6: When the sugar is dissolved, increase the temperature, so that the mixture simmers. Step 7: Let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Divide each fig into four or six parts lengthwise and add them to the syrup.

Ingredient Names: long-grain rice, saffron threads, milk, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, sugar, flaked coconut, walnuts, egg, single cream, butter, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Bring milk to a boil with saffron threads, cardamom and cinnamon, while stirring frequently to prevent scalding As soon as it comes to a boil, add the rice, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook for 20-25 minutes or until the rice has softened. Step 3: Remove from heat, and stir in the sugar, coconut and nuts. Step 4: Beat in the egg, single cream and butter. Step 5: Transfer to an ovenproof dish. Step 6: Sprinkle with nutmeg if desired. Step 7: Bake for 20-30 minutes until set or lightly golden. Step 8: Garnish with chopped nuts or dribbled with additional cream.

Dish Name: Baked Samosas From The New Revised Edition Moosewood Cookbook
Ingredient Names: flour, salt, buttermilk, potatoes, butter, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, mustard seeds, dried coriander, green peas, lemon juice, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: Dough. Step 2: Mix the flour and salt together in a medium sized bowl. Step 3: Make a well in the centre and add the buttermilk or yogurt. Step 4: Mix first with a spoon and then with your hand to make a smooth dough. Step 5: Add extra flour as needed to keep the dough from being sticky The dough will be quite soft. Step 6: Knead in the bowl for about five minutes. Step 7: Cover tightly and refrigerate until you are ready to assemble the samosas Filling Peel potatoes and chop them into 1-inch pieces.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, carrots, cauliflower, green beans, bell peppers, eggplant, onion, oil, cumin seeds, garlic, ginger, green chili pepper, turmeric powder, coriander powder, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel the potatoes. Step 2: Cut into small pieces and microwave them, covered, for about 6 minutes until half cooked. Step 3: Prepare and cut all other vegetables into small pieces. Step 4: Heat the oil in a saucepan on medium heat Saut cumin seeds, garlic and onions. Step 5: Stir until onions are translucent. Step 6: Put the potatoes and vegetables in a large baking dish. Step 7: Mix in the sauted spices and the remaining seasonings. Step 8: Bake covered at 400f until the vegetables are tender. Step 9: Bake uncovered at 450f for another 10 minutes to get a roasted look.

Ingredient Names: lentils, butter, brown sugar, egg, whole wheat flour, baking soda, vanilla, quick-cooking rolled oats, slivered almonds, pumpkin seeds, chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the lentils in boiling water for 35 minutes. Step 2: Strain the lentils and crush with a fork. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Step 4: Grease a cookie sheet or line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Step 5: In a bowl, cream the crushed cooked lentils, butter, and brown sugar together and then add the egg and blend. Step 6: Add the flour, baking soda, and vanilla. Step 7: Stir in the oats, slivered almonds, pumpkin seeds, and chocolate chips and mix well. Step 8: Drop the cookies by the spoonful onto the prepared baking sheet and flatten. Step 9: Bake the cookies for 13 to 18 minutes and allow to cool on a baking rack.

Ingredient Names: seitan, tomato paste, ground fennel, minced ginger, coriander, garlic, chili powder, curry powder, ground turmeric, lemon juice, salt, water, vegetable oil, onion, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the tomato paste, fennel seeds, ginger, coriander, garlic, chilli powder, curry powder, turmeric, lemon juice, salt, and water in a bowl. Step 2: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan and cook the onions until they are softened. Step 3: Pour the spice mixture into the pan and let simmer Break the seitan into pieces and add to the pan. Step 4: Let the seitan simmer for about 10 minutes, until much of the liquid has been absorbed by the seitan or has evaporated. Step 5: Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the chopped chiles, and serve.

Ingredient Names: fine semolina, milk, bananas, sugar, raisins, cardamom powder, clarified butter
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the semolina in the clarified butter for 10 mins till golden brown. Step 2: Then add 2 cups of milk / half and half. Step 3: When cooked add the mashed bananas and the sugar. Step 4: Then when the mixture is almost dry, add the cardamoms and raisins. Step 5: Serve hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: bananas, sugar, unsalted butter, non-fat powdered milk, lemon juice, cardamom seed, nuts, coconut flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and cut the bananas into small pieces. Step 2: Mix with sugar and keep aside for 12 hours Warm the butter in a skillet on medium heat. Step 3: Add banana-sugar mixture and stir until all the moisture evaporates. Step 4: Mash the bananas as you stir. Step 5: Add the non-fat dry milk It should be solid enough to set when spread on a cookie sheet. Step 6: Add more dry milk as needed. Step 7: Stir in the seasonings and spread on a greased cookie sheet, about one-fourth inch thick. Step 8: Garnish with the nuts and coconut.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, vegetable oil, turmeric, red lentils, vegetable stock, cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, salt and pepper, firm bananas
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil over a gentle heat for approx ten minutes until golden. Step 2: Add the turmeric and fry for a further 1 minute. Step 3: Add the lentils and fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the warmed stock and bring to the boil then simmer for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add the spices and seasoning and simmer for a further 10 minutes If using banana or plantain add it a coupe of minutes before serving to allow to warm through. Step 6: Serve with warm chapattis or naan bread.

Ingredient Names: banana, lemon juice, icing sugar, fresh fruit, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Serve the fruit into 2-4 bowls. Step 2: Beat the egg white until foamy and then add the bananas, lemon juice, icing sugar until it forms stiff peaks and use this mixture to top the fruit I just beat the bananas, sugar and lemon juice and top over the fruit.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, water, salt, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a saucepan on a medium flame and add mustard seeds and urad dal. Step 2: When the mustard sputters, immediately add the chopped cabbage. Step 3: Add salt and turmeric powder, 1 / 4 cup water, and cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid. Step 4: Uncover after 10 minutes, stir the cabbages, and cover again. Step 5: Repeat after 10 minutes, and if required add some more water. Step 6: After 5 minutes, the water would have evaporated Switch off the burner, stir once more, and serve.

Ingredient Names: beans, water, turmeric, salt, gingerroot, garlic, clarified butter, cilantro, cumin seed, garam masala, coriander powder, mango powder, red chili powder, coriander seeds, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Wash pulses. Step 2: Soak whole pulses overnight or soak in boiling hot water for 20 mins Split / unhusked pulses can be soaked in cold water for 30 mins before cooking Use the same water for cooking in which the pulses have soaked. Step 3: Add a little salt, turmeric powder and ginger and garlic i add an onion and tomato too while cooking if i am not using these in the tempering or sometimes even if i am there is no limit to the permutations and combinations once you get the hang of it Spinach, pumpkin, beans and many more veges can be added while cooking Also can add a little oil or ghee to speed up the cooking and keep the dals from frothing Pressure cook for 1 whistle and then reduce heat for 1-7 mins for split beans and pressure cook and then reduce heat for 30- 45 mins for whole dals Well cooked and blended dals taste better. Step 4: Take off heat and wait for all steam to escape.

Ingredient Names: mint, basil, ginger, water, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Blend basil, mint, ginger to a smooth paste Add this puree to 3 cups water boil for 8 minutes Strain the tea and mix honey to it Drink it when still hot.

Dish Name: Basmati Rice With Cashews Peas And Fresh Coriander
Ingredient Names: water, salt, turmeric, ghee, asafoetida powder, onion, basmati rice, peas, baby spinach leaves, cashews, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pan over a medium heat, bring the water to the boil. Step 2: Add the salt and turmeric. Step 3: Reduce to a simmer and cover tightly. Step 4: In a larger - preferably heavy-based - pan, over a medium heat, heat the ghee or oil. Step 5: Add the yellow asafetida powder and chopped onion and stir to combine for 1-2 minutes, add the rice and saut for about 2 minutes, or until the rice becomes whitish in colour Carefully pour the simmering water into the pan containing the rice, stir briefly, and if the peas you are using are fresh, add them now Increase the heat so that the water is again boiling, then reduce to a very low heat and cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid. Step 6: Simmer the rice for 15-20 minutes or until the water has been absorbed by the rice and the rice is tender and flaky If you are using frozen peas, add them 5 minutes before the end of this stage of the cooking. Step 7: Stir through the rice quickly, and replace the lid as soon as you can.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, cloves, cardamom pods, bay leaves, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick, whole cumin seeds, basmati rice, water, salt, saffron, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, melt the butter and saute onion until translucent. Step 2: Add cloves, cardamom pods, bay leaves, peppercorns, cinnamon and cumin seeds. Step 3: Saute two to three minutes. Step 4: Add rice, water, salt, saffron and peas. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to simmer. Step 6: Cook with lid on for 20 minutes. Step 7: Turn off heat and let sit for five minutes with lid on Fluff with fork before serving.

Dish Name: Bastani Persian Rose Water Saffron And Pistachio Ice Cream
Ingredient Names: whole milk, heavy cream, egg yolks, sugar, pistachio nuts, rose water, vanilla extract, saffron, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium thick-bottomed bot, slowly heat the milk to boiling while stirring. Step 2: Add the vanilla extract and saffron Continue to cook on low heat, stirring occasionally while doing the next step. Step 3: Beat the egg yolks with the sugar until smooth and foamy Very carefully and slowly, pour the egg / sugar mixture into the milk. Step 4: Make sure to stir it rapidly with a fork or use a whisk while pouring Continue heating the mixture on low heat while stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until thickened. Step 5: Pour the custard mixture into a bowl, and refrigerate until well chilled. Step 6: Once cold, stir in the cream, rose water or extract, and chopped pistachios Churn in an ice cream maker until finished.

Dish Name: Batata Vada Potato Balls In A Gram Flour Crust
Ingredient Names: potatoes, ginger, garlic, mustard seeds, turmeric powder, fresh cilantro, asafoetida powder, salt, gram flour, chili powder, ground cumin, baking soda, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes mash them. Step 2: Add the ginger garlic, turmeric powder and cilantro and salt. Step 3: Heat 3 tsp on oil in a saucepan. Step 4: Add the mustard seeds and wait for them to crackle then add the asefetida. Step 5: Pour the oil over the potatoes And mix it in well till blended. Step 6: Mix all the ingredients with the water. Step 7: Divide the potato mix into 16 balls, heat the oil. Step 8: Dip the potatoes into the batter.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric powder, red chili powder, green chilies, gingerroot, garlic, lime, coriander leaves, salt, gram flour, water, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the potatoes until tender, peel and mash. Step 2: Heat 1 tsp oil and add mustard seeds, after they crackle add the curry leaves. Step 3: Add the green chillies, garlic and ginger and the spice powders Do not let the powders burn. Step 4: Add this to the mashed potatoes. Step 5: Squeeze lime and add the cilantro leaves, mix well. Step 6: Make a thinnish batter out of the chick pea flour and all the other ingredients. Step 7: Divide the potato mixture into equal sized portions, approximately the size of a small orange. Step 8: Dip each ball in the batter and deep fry until golden brown in colour.

Dish Name: Batatya Chi Sukki Bhaji Sauteed Potatoes And Bell Pepper
Ingredient Names: potatoes, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, oil, cumin seed, turmeric powder, paprika, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes till cooked but firm Peel and cube them. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt, turmeric powder and paprika, mix well, heat oil in a pan. Step 3: Toss in cumin seeds and stir-fry for a few seconds. Step 4: Saute the potatoes for a few minutes. Step 5: Lower flame and cook covered till lightly roasted and golden. Step 6: Stir in the red and green bell peppers. Step 7: Cook for a few minutes.

Dish Name: Beet Koshumbir Beet Salad With Yogurt
Ingredient Names: beets, plain low-fat yogurt, fresh dill
Instructions: Step 1: Fold the beets gently into the yogurt Place in a serving bowl and garnish with chopped dill.

Ingredient Names: beets, sugar, salt, pepper, coriander, cumin, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, boil the beets for 5 minutes Grate or shred the beets In a small bowl, combine the shredded beets with the remaining ingredients.

Ingredient Names: butter, cumin seed, mustard seeds, garlic clove, ginger, beet, sambal powder, garam masala powder, peas, rice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in pan. Step 2: Add cumin and mustard seeds. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger, saute, add beets. Step 4: Cook on low until beets are tender You may need to add a little water to prevent sticking. Step 5: Add sambal powder, and garam masala powder, stir in peas, stir in rice.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, green bell peppers, tomatoes, onion, cumin seed, mustard seeds, curry leaf, ginger-garlic paste, peanut butter, water, turmeric, garam masala, sesame seeds, coconut milk powder, plain fat-free yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Gather and prepare all ingredients prior to commencing cooking. Step 2: Heat a medium to large heavy-based saucepan on high, then reduce heat slightly and add peanut oil. Step 3: When hot, add cumin seeds, mustard seeds and curry seeds, and cook stirring until mustard seeds start to pop and splutter. Step 4: Add onions and continue sauteing until golden brown. Step 5: Add ginger and garlic paste and cook 1 minute, then reduce heat to medium before adding peanut butter. Step 6: Stir continuously until peanut butter forms a sauce and add as much water as necessary to prevent the mixture catching on the bottom of the pan. Step 7: Add bell pepper and tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes until pulpy, adding a little more water as necessary. Step 8: Add turmeric, garam masala, sesame seeds and dry coconut powder and cook for another 15 minutes, stirring from time to time. Step 9: Add yoghurt, chile powder, lemon juice and tamarind concentrate, and heat through gently until hot and flavors have blended. Step 10: Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

Dish Name: Bengali Butternut Squash And Chickpeas Garbanzos
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, bay leaf, panch phoron, dried mild red chili peppers, onion, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, sugar, ginger, butternut squash, boiling water, chickpeas, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over a medium heat. Step 2: Add bay leaf, panch phoran and chillies and fry for 1-2 minutes, stirring well to combine. Step 3: Add the onion, stir to coat in the spices, and fry for 4 minutes, or until softened and golden-brown. Step 4: Add the ground turmeric, cumin and coriander, the salt, sugar and ginger and stir well. Step 5: Add a 1 / 2 of water, stir and cook for a further 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Add the butternut squash pieces and 1 / 2 - 1 cup boiling water. Step 7: Bring the mixture to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, cover the pan with a lid and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the butternut squash is tender. Step 8: Add the chickpeas, ground garam masala and fennel seeds and another splash of water if necessary to keep the mixture loose. Step 9: Add more salt and sugar, if you like, to taste. Step 10: Stir well and continue to cook for 1-2 minutes, or until warmed through.

Ingredient Names: mung dal, water, kosher salt, turmeric, mustard oil, fenugreek seeds, mango powder, ground coriander, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Place moong dal, water, salt, turmeric and mustard oil in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Lower heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until dal is tender. Step 3: Stir in fenugreek, mango powder, coriander, onion and garlic powders, cayenne, and garam masala. Step 4: Simmer 20 minutes more. Step 5: Serve garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, ghee, salt, water, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, put the flour. Step 2: Make a small whole in the middle, put the ghee and the salt. Step 3: Mix the flour and ghee by hand for a minute or so till the ghee is fully incorporated. Step 4: Add the water a little at a time, kneading the flour till a firm, smooth, pliant dough is obtained. Step 5: Let the dough sit for 30 minutes On a greased countertop, use a rolling pin to roll the dough into an even sheet about 1 / 4" thick, or as thin as you can handle successfully - too thin, and all kinds of things will go wrong and unlike popular belief, thin is not necessarily a pre-requisite to puffing Use a pasta roller, if you have one Use a 3-4" round cookie cutter to cut out as many discs of dough as possible. Step 6: Knead up the remaining dough and repeat Fancy shapes are also possible - they will all puff.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, sunflower oil, panch phoron, garlic cloves, onion, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Boil sweet potatoes until soft. Step 2: Heat a wok, add the oil and stir fry the panch phoran for 1 minute and then add the garlic and stir fry for another minute. Step 3: Now add the onion and stir fry for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the sweet potatoes and coriander and stir fry until all the ingredients are well blended and heated through. Step 5: Season with salt if desired and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: squash, sunflower oil, onion, garlic cloves, hot red chili pepper, fresh ginger, green cardamom pods, sweet paprika, ground coriander, ground cumin, hot chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas 6. Step 2: Cut the kabocha or butternut squashes into long wedges and remove the peel, seeds and fibres from each piece. Step 3: Heat the sunflower oil in a large frying pan. Step 4: Add the onion wedges, garlic, chilli and ginger to the pan and cook over a low heat for 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until the onions are just tender. Step 5: Add the spices and cook for a few seconds more. Step 6: Add the pieces of butternut squash and toss everything together until well coated in the spicy mixture. Step 7: Put the squash into a roasting tin and roast it for 35-40 minutes, or until the squash is tender and lightly browned around the edges This is delicious served together with roasted chicken and mint raita, made from chopped fresh mint into natural yogurt.

Ingredient Names: almonds, warm water, ghee, black mustard seeds, whole cumin seed, fenugreek seeds, brown sugar, ginger, green chili, fresh spinach, shredded coconut, salt, water, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Soak nuts in warm water for 4 hours or overnight. Step 2: Drain, wash and drain again. Step 3: Heat ghee in a large pot over moderate heat. Step 4: When hot, but not smoking, add the spice seeds and sugar. Step 5: Fry until the seeds darken and the sugar caramelizes. Step 6: Add the ginger, chiles, spinach, nuts, coconut and salt. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: Uncover, gently turn the spinach over. Step 9: Add water if necessary. Step 10: Cook for a further 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, water, bay leaves, fresh chili peppers, ground turmeric, asafoetida powder, vegetable oil, onion, fresh gingerroot, creamed coconut, fresh green chile, brown sugar, tamarind paste, garam masala, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse lentils thoroughly under running water, and remove any foreign matter. Step 2: Combine the lentils and water in a large pan and bring to the boil, skimming off the foamy scum as necessary. Step 3: When the scum has ceased rising to the surface, stir in the bay leaves, chilies, turmeric and asafoetida With the lid half covering the pan, let the lentils simmer gently for around 40 minutes, or until tender and the water is absorbed. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat the oil over medium-high heat in a large skillet or wok. Step 5: Add the onion and ginger and saute, stirring frequently, for 6 to 8 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the grated creamed coconut, green chili, sugar, tamarind paste, garam masala, cumin and coriander, and stir for around 1 minute.
