Step 7: When the lentils are tender, add the sauteed coconut / spice mixture and stir around to mix thoroughly. Step 8: Taste and add salt, as necessary, and extra sugar or tamarind as desired. Step 9: Transfer the dal to a serving dish, drizzle the hot ghee over the top, and sprinkle with the garam masala and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, onion, garlic, ketchup, chopped tomato, green onion, cumin, fresh coriander, mixed spice, asafoetida powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: First, roast the eggplant. Step 2: Put the oven at 450 degrees Pierce the eggplants with a fork about ten times each. Step 3: Cover lightly in oil and a pinch of salt Roast for 30 min to an hour- however long it takes for the skin to wrinkle but not burn, and make crackling sounds as it bakes. Step 4: Allow eggplant to cool enough to handle. Step 5: Remove the outer skin and either mash completely, or use one of those dicer machines and dice fine. Step 6: In a large sauce pan, heat the vegetable oil, put in the cumin / mustard seeds and asefoitida, or if using my weird mix mentioned in the description, do not add the spice yet Either way, add the onion' / garlic and saute until golden If using my spice mix, add to diced tomatoes and ketchup and mix in a cup.

Dish Name: Besan Burfi Sweet Gram Flour Squares
Ingredient Names: coconut, gram flour, sugar, ghee, cashews, water, cardamom powder, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a shallow dish / pan with some ghee. Step 2: In a frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of ghee and fry cashewnuts until golden. Step 3: Remove To the same ghee, gradually add the besan, stirring gently. Step 4: Fry on low heat until golden brown. Step 5: Remove and set aside. Step 6: Now in the same frying pan, heat 1 cup water and add sugar. Step 7: Boil on low heat until the sugar dissolves Increase flame and boil briskly until a thick syrup is obtained. Step 8: Add the dessicated coconut and fried besan.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, sugar, ghee, milk, cardamom powder, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the milk and 1 / 4 cup ghee with the gram flour in a mixing bowl Use your fingers to mix. Step 2: Cover and set aside for half an hour. Step 3: Chop nuts or break them to fine pieces. Step 4: Heat the rest of the ghee in a wok. Step 5: Now, fry the gramflour in the ghee for 5-7 minutes Break the whole lump of gramflour into smaller pieces. Step 6: Keep stirring continuously. Step 7: Add sugar, nuts and cardamom powder, mix well.

Dish Name: Best Healthy Vegan Indian Naan Or Garlic Naan Bread
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, baking powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, plain soymilk, vegan sour cream, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together flour, baking powder, salt, cumin and coriander in a lerge mixing bowl. Step 2: Stir in the soy milk and vegan sour cream, then knead it in the bowl till it holds together well, adding more flour if necessary. Step 3: Place on a floured surface and continue kneading for about 5 to 10 minutes till the dough feels smooth and elastic Form the dough into a ball and put it in a non-stick bowl, covered with a towel, to rest for an hour or longer. Step 4: Take the dough out and cut it into 12 equal pieces Form each into a ball and press the balls flat into round discs. Step 5: Heat a large non-stick frying pan or griddle on medium heat. Step 6: Take 1 piece of dough at a time and roll it out on a floured surface till it is about 8-10 inches across and less than 1 / 4 inch thick Lay it on the hot griddle and cook it over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side or until it puffs up and some blackish-brown spots apear, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: peanuts, fennel, cumin, coriander seeds, sesame, chili powder, turmeric, aamchur, salt, garlic, gram flour, bhindi okra, oil, asafoetida, dried fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan dry roast 2 tbsp peanuts on low flame until they turn crunchy. Step 2: Add 2 tsp fennel, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander seeds and 2 tbsp sesame. Step 3: Roast until the spices turn aromatic. Step 4: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 5: Add 1 tbsp chilli powder, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp aamchur, 1 tsp salt, 3 cloves garlic and 3 tbsp roasted besan. Step 6: Grind to fine powder without adding water. Step 7: Now cut the head and tail of bhindi and slit in the centre. Step 8: Stuff the masala in bhindi and keep it aside. Step 9: Now in a large pan heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 tsp cumin, pinch of hing and splutter the tempering. Step 10: Add in stuffed bhindi and roast on medium flame. Step 11: Now cover and cook on medium flame until the bhindi is cooked well. Step 12: Stir and cook until the bhindi is cooked from all the sides. Step 13: Add in leftover masala, 2 tbsp kasuri methi and mix well. Step 14: Finally, enjoy Bharwa Bhindi with roti or steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: puffed rice cereal, potato, onion, tomatoes, sev, green mango, coriander leaves, khajur imli ki chutney, green chutney, puri, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Take a bowl. Step 2: Add puffed rice, both the chutneys, 3 / 4 of onions, 3 / 4 of tomatoes, puri's, half portion of sev, lemon juice, mix well, serve in 2 plates. Step 3: Add the topping of coriander leaves, sev, green mangoes, balance onions, tomatoes & sev.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, ground turmeric, ground coriander, salt, okra, vegetable oil, onions, water, fresh coriander, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl combine the chili powder, turmeric, coriander, and salt With a sharp knife, cut lengthwise slit in each okra pod, taking care not to cut completely through. Step 2: Stuff each pod with a little of the spice mixture. Step 3: In a medium saucepan, heat the oil over high heat. Step 4: Add onions and cook, stirring constantly, 12 minutes, or until browned. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low and add the okra. Step 6: Add the water if the mixture seems to dry. Step 7: Cook covered 10 minutes, or until the okra is tender but still retains it's color. Step 8: Serve garnished with fresh coriander and lemons.

Ingredient Names: mung dal, water, turmeric powder, amchoor, cumin powder, red chili powder, cumin seed, oil, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the mung dal in water for 1 hour, drain and keep aside. Step 2: Heat water in a pan, add salt, turmeric and the soaked mung dal. Step 3: Cook the mung dal on low flame with closed lid until all the water has evaporated and the mung is cooked but not soggy. Step 4: Remove from fire, transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle the rest of the spices. Step 5: Heat oil in a small wok crackle the cumin seeds in it and pour it over the dal. Step 6: Sprinkle chopped cilantro and serve with sindhi phulkas or paranthas and mixed vegetable pickle.

Dish Name: Bihari French Cut Green Bean Masala
Ingredient Names: oil, almonds, garlic cloves, paprika, chili flakes, cumin, coriander, onion, green beans, coconut milk, lime juice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the almonds in the oil, remove. Step 2: Add paprika, chili flakes, cumin, and coriander to the oil, cook, add onion. Step 3: Cook until translucent, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Toss in garlic at last end with onions. Step 5: Toss in green beans and coat. Step 6: Add coconut milk and lime juice Warm it.

Ingredient Names: self-rising flour, white sugar, baking powder, ghee, pineapple essence, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the melted ghee in a bowl. Step 2: Put the sugar in a mixer and grind it nicely. Step 3: Add the ground sugar to the ghee, mix with a spoon. Step 4: Add the maida, pineapple essence and baking powder. Step 5: Mix well using your hands and only your hands If the mixture is too hard, you may add a little melted ghee. Step 6: Make small round balls out of the mixture. Step 7: Garnish each of these with 2 slices of almonds. Step 8: Put in a greased baking tray, keeping 2 inches apart.

Ingredient Names: black-eyed peas, broccoli, oil, cumin seed, tomatoes, paprika, yogurt, garlic, ginger, turmeric, garam masala, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Drain beans, and bring to boil in plenty of fresh water, cook until tender. Step 2: Heat oil, and add cumin and sizzle approx 30 seconds. Step 3: Add broccoli and tomatoes, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add paprika, yoghurt and garlic. Step 5: Mix and cook 7-8 minutes over a low heat. Step 6: Add drained black eyed beans, turmeric, garam masala, and salt. Step 7: Mix, and cook 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Add 3 / 4 cup water and bring to the boil. Step 9: Reduce heat, and simmer 10-15 miutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, green chili, garlic cloves, onion, gingerroot, curry powder, turmeric, ground cumin, tomatoes, salt, dried black-eyed peas, plain yogurt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Drain your peas. Step 2: Heat oil / ghee in a medium heavy pot over medium heat and fry chiles, garlic, onion, and ginger for approx 6 minutes. Step 3: Add your curry powder / garam masala, turmeric and cumin, and then add the tomatoes. Step 4: Cook for approximately 3 minutes until it begins to thicken and add your peas and salt to taste, along with 4 cups of water. Step 5: Allow water to boil and then reduce your heat, cover and cook for approximately 2 hours until your peas are done and the sauce is nice and thick. Step 6: After the peas are done, fold in your yogurt and cilantro, and serve This goes well with rice or with chappati / roti. Step 7: Garnish with minced cilantro.

Ingredient Names: black-eyed peas, vegetable oil, onions, fresh gingerroot, fresh garlic, chili powder, salt, ground coriander, ground cumin, water, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and soak the black-eye beans in a bowl of water overnight. Step 2: Place the beans in a pan of water and bring to a boil over a low het for about 30 minutes. Step 3: Drain the beans thoroughly and set aside. Step 4: Heat the oil in a pan. Step 5: Add the onions and fry until golden brown. Step 6: Add the ginger, garlic, chilli powder, salt, ground coriander and ground cumin and stir-fry the mixture for 3-5 minutes. Step 7: Add the water to the pan, cover and cook the mixture until all of the water has completely evaporated. Step 8: Add the boiled black-eye beans, green chillies and coriander leaves to the onions and stir to blend together. Step 9: Stir-fry the bean mixture for 3-5 minutes. Step 10: Transfer the black-eye beans to a serving dish and sprinkle over the lemon juice.

Dish Name: Black Eyed Peas With Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: dried beans, corn oil, garlic, fresh ginger, cayenne, coconut milk, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beans according to pkg directions. Step 2: Heat oil over med-high heat for one minute. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until garlic colors--about 1 minute. Step 5: Add beans, cayenne and coconut milk. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then lower heat for simmering. Step 7: Cook until most of the coconut milk is absorbed and beans are very soft, about 20 minutes. Step 8: Stir in lime juice. Step 9: Taste Use salt and pepper for seasoning if desired.

Ingredient Names: black-eyed peas, water, mushroom, oil, cumin seed, cinnamon stick, onions, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, coriander, cumin, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place black-eyed peas and water into a covered pot and bring to a boil. Step 2: Let simmer for two minutes and then remove from flame and let steep for one hour. Step 3: Let cumin seeds and cinnamon stick sizzle for a few seconds in heated oil. Step 4: Add onions and garlic and fry until the onions turn translucent and brown at the edges. Step 5: Add mushrooms and cook until they begin to soften. Step 6: Add tomatoes, coriander, cumin, turmeric, and cayenne pepper. Step 7: Stir and cook for one minute. Step 8: Cover, and let simmer for ten minutes. Step 9: Remove cooked sauce from flame. Step 10: Return peas to a boil and let simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, molasses, coconut, ghee, cashew nuts, sugar, cardamom powder, nutmeg, rose essence
Instructions: Step 1: Add 2 cups of water to the flour and knead well to make a soft dough. Step 2: Add another 18 cups of water to the dough and make a loose batter. Step 3: Strain the batter and keep aside for a few hours. Step 4: Drain off the clear water from the top. Step 5: Melt molasses in 3 cups of water. Step 6: Strain and keep aside Extract milk from the grated coconut, adding 6 cups of water, keep aside. Step 7: Pour the flour batter, molasses syrup and the coconut milk into a pan The consistency of the mixture should be like that of fresh milk.

Ingredient Names: black grapes, low-fat plain yogurt, cumin powder, fresh coriander leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything together in a bowl Leave aside for 10-15 minutes Refrigerate and serve chilled.

Dish Name: Black Magic Black Lentils Soybean Dal
Ingredient Names: black lentils, soybeans, onion, garlic, salt, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, asafoetida powder, ginger powder, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Put soaked lentils and soyabeans in a cooker with 4 cups of water. Step 2: Add salt, turmeric powder and onions along Pressure cook for 18-20 minutes on medium heat If you do not use a pressure cooker then you have to wait till the ingredients turn absolutely tender and may have to increase the quantity of water in the pot This will take a longer time. Step 3: Meanwhile take a pan and melt the butter. Step 4: Add garlic and brown the same. Step 5: Add all the remaining spices and turn the heat off Open the cooker and mash dal gently. Step 6: Transfer the same to the pan.

Ingredient Names: blackberries, plain yogurt, orange juice, sugar, fresh lemon juice, ice cubes, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, combine the blackberries, yogurt, orange juice, sugar, and lemon juice, and puree. Step 2: Taste and add more sugar or honey, as necessary. Step 3: Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove the seeds, and reserve the liquid To serve, place 3 ice cubes into each of 2 serving glasses. Step 4: Pour over the lassi and garnish with a mint leaf Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cauliflower floret, broccoli, canned chick-peas, water, cumin seed, onion, ginger, garlic, tomato paste, soy sauce, garam masala, lemon juice, cayenne, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In microwave safe bowl, steam cauliflower, broccoli, chickpeas and water in microwave at half power for 15 minutes or until very soft and tender. Step 2: Drain veggies and chickpeas, leaving 2-3 tbs of remaining water. Step 3: Mash or puree thoroughly. Step 4: In a non-stick pan on medium heat, toast cumin seeds for roughly two minutes. Step 5: Add chopped onions to cumin seeds and saute until translucent. Step 6: Lower heat slightly. Step 7: Add ginger, garlic, tomato paste, soy sauce and garam masala. Step 8: Stir and saute for one minute. Step 9: Stir in mashed vegetables, lemon juice and cayenne until thoroughly mixed. Step 10: Saute for another two or three more minutes on low heat.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, water, oil, mustard, chana dal, urad dal, cumin, red chile, curry leaves, asafoetida, onions, ginger, chili, salt, turmeric, tomato, fresh coriander, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take 3 tbsp besan and mix with ½ cup water. Step 2: Prepare a smooth lump free batter. Keep aside. Step 3: In a pan heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp chana dal, ½ tsp urad dal, ½ tsp cumin, 2 dried red chilli, few curry leaves and pinch hing. Splutter the tempering. Step 4: Add 2 onion and saute until the onions soften slightly. Step 5: Also add 1 inch ginger, 4 chilli, 1 tsp salt, ¼ tsp turmeric and saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 6: Now add 1 tomato, 1 cup water, cover and cook for 3 minutes or until tomato softens. Step 7: Add in the prepared besan mixture and mix well. Step 8: Once the besan mixture starts to thicken add 2 cups water and stir well. Step 9: Adjust the consistency adding water as required. Keep the consistency slightly watery as the chutney thickens once cooked and cooled. Step 10: Boil for 5 minutes or until the besan is cooked well and turns flavourful. Step 11: Add 2 tbsp coriander and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Mix well. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Besan Chutney with poori, chapathi or dosa.

Ingredient Names: onion, salad oil, rice, tomato paste, water, cinnamon, lentils, salt, raisins, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in oil in large skillet until soft, add rice. Step 2: Cook, stirring, several minutes. Step 3: Combine tomato paste, water, cinnamon and lentils in a bowl, add to rice. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil. Step 5: Cover tightly, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Step 6: Stir in seasoned salt, raisins and pinenuts. Step 7: Grease an 8-inch-square baking dish. Step 8: Pour in rice mixture.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic clove, curry, worcestershire sauce, chili powder, cayenne, salted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Stir first 6 ingredients together in a large frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: When butter mixture bubbly, add cashews and stir until hot and coated, Spread on paper towels to cool.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, sunflower oil, garlic clove, brown mustard seeds, onion seeds, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, fennel seed, lemon juice, salt and pepper, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a saucepan of salted water to boil, add the potatoes and simmer until just tender, drain well. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan then add the garlic along with the whole and ground spices. Step 3: Fry gently for about 1-2 minutes, stirring until the mustard seeds start to pop. Step 4: Add the potatoes and stir fry over a medium heat for about 5-10 minutes until heated through and well coated with the spiced oil. Step 5: Season well and sprinkle with the lemon juice. Step 6: Garnish with chopped coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: sweet potato, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, bay leaf, ginger, onion, turmeric, chili powder, lemon juice, garlic, kosher salt, tomatoes, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Peel potatoes and cut into 2-inch pieces. Step 2: Place in a saucepan and cover with water. Step 3: Bring to a boil over medium high heat, cooking until softened drain. Step 4: In a wok or skillet heat oil over medium high heat. Step 5: Stir in mustard seeds and bay leaf. Step 6: When seeds start jumping add ginger and onion. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium low and add next 5 ingredients and the potatoes. Step 8: Cook stirring occasionally. Step 9: Stir in tomatoes and a little water if needed and cook a few minutes more or until potatoes are tender. Step 10: Top with cilantro.

Dish Name: Bottle Gourd Balls In Spicy Sauce Mock Meatballs
Ingredient Names: red onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, coriander powder, chili powder, cashews, tomatoes, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pod, salt, bottlegourd, ginger-garlic paste, green chili pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Instruction for the balls: Peel the skin of the bottle gourd And grate it. Step 2: Let it drain for at least 1 hour. Step 3: Press nicely to take away all the water that comes out. Step 4: Meanwhile chop the onion finely. Step 5: In a bowl mix all the ingredients for the balls, except the oil. Step 6: Make balls with it and fry it until dark brown. Step 7: Keep the ball aside Instruction for the sauce:.

Ingredient Names: oil, fresh ginger, chili pepper, brown mustard seeds, cumin seed, cauliflower, ground coriander, turmeric, salt, tomatoes, water, garam masala, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and cut cauliflower into small flowerets, about 1x2 inches Peel ginger, cut into thin matchsticks. Step 2: Cut jalapenos into thin strips. Step 3: Wash and cut tomatoes into eight wedges each. Step 4: Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium to medium high heat. Step 5: When hot add ginger, jalapenos, cumin and mustard, cook until mustard pops and cumin has darkened a few shades, about 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Add coriander, salt and turmeric, stir once, add cauliflower and stir-fry until cauliflower is slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Reduce heat to low, add tomatoes and water, stir once and cover. Step 8: Cook covered for 15-20 minutes until cauliflower is just tender Shake pan occasionally to avoid sticking, don't stir.

Ingredient Names: bread, cashews, raisins, oil, ginger, green chili, cilantro, cumin powder, milk, curds, red chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok In the meantime, remove the edges of the bread slices. Step 2: Now prepare the filling For this, take a dish In it, put cashews, raisins, ginger, green chillies, cilantro and cumin powder, mix well, keep aside. Step 3: Now dip the bread slices in milk. Step 4: Remove and squeeze. Step 5: Add the filling on 4 slices and cover with the remaining four slices.

Ingredient Names: bread machine quick-acting active dry yeast, warm water, white sugar, milk, egg, salt, bread flour, butter, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients to bread machine in order suggested by manufacturer. Step 2: Remove bread after kneading cycle, then divide into pieces about the size of a golf ball. Step 3: Roll into ball shape, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes During second rising, heat grill or grill pan to medium high heat At grill side, roll one ball of dough out into a thin circle Lightly oil grill. Step 4: Place dough on grill, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until puffy and lightly browned If you want to use the butter and garlic, let the garlic soak in the butter and brush uncooked side with butter before turning over. Step 5: Brush cooked side with butter, and cook until browned, another 2 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Remove from grill, and continue the process until all the naan has been prepared.

Ingredient Names: brinjals, frying oil, salt, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a deep frying pan Fry brinjal slices till they turn light brown Remove extra oil with paper towel Sprinkle salt and chilli powder.

Ingredient Names: new potatoes, salt, onion, jalapeno peppers, butter, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, water, carrots, broccoli, frozen peas, tomatoes, lemons, rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the potatoes, chop at least into quarters and boil until just tender. Step 2: Drain and leave to cool. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat half of the butter in a spacious frying pan and fry the onion and chillies for about five minutes. Step 4: Mix the spices and water together, and then add to the frying pan along with the carrots and broccoli and the rest of the butter. Step 5: Let cook for about ten minutes, or until broccoli starts to become tender Dice the cooled potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Step 6: Add in the peas, potatoes and tomatoes and cook for another five to seven minutes. Step 7: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, pepper and a bit of lime or lemon juice Just before the dish is done, cut rolls in half and brush with olive oil. Step 8: Grill until toasted.

Ingredient Names: chapati, butter, sesame seeds, broccoli, cheddar cheese, lettuce leaves, tomatoes, salt & pepper, herb salad dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Lay chapatis on a bread board. Step 2: Spread 1 tbsp of butter down the center of each chapati. Step 3: Sprinkle some sesame seeds on each. Step 4: Spread the chopped broccoli on top of the butter. Step 5: Then place 3 cheese slices down the middle. Step 6: Add lettuce leaves. Step 7: Then the tomato Just before serving drizzle you favorite dressing. Step 8: Roll the chapati so you can lift it up with your fingers and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: refined flour, broccoli, tomatoes, low-fat mayonnaise, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the broccoli with a little salt and black pepper for 5 minutes. Step 2: In a bowl, mix the flour with the salt. Step 3: Add just enough water to form a soft dough. Step 4: Roll out small circles of approximately 14 cm diameter. Step 5: Heat oil on a flat bottomed pan and place a cicle of the dough, one at a time, on the tava. Step 6: Cook on either side till lightly golden-brown. Step 7: Then, flip and cook on the other side till done. Step 8: Then, remove from the pan, drain excess oil. Step 9: Spread the mayonnaise on it. Step 10: Put three pieces of tomatoes and broccoli in the middle from the top to the bottom and roll.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, ghee, onion, cinnamon sticks, cloves, peppercorns, black cardamom pods, bay leaves, cumin seed, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and soak in water for around 1 / 2 an hour drain and set aside heat ghee in a vessel and add the onions. Step 2: Fry till they are translucent and add the whole spices and bay leaves. Step 3: Fry now till onions are golden brown now add the cumin and sugar and let the sugar caramalise add the drained rice and mix well till the rice is well coated. Step 4: Then add 5 cups of boiling hot water and salt. Step 5: Lower heat and cover pan and cook till water is absorbed and rice cooked.

Dish Name: Buddha's Happy Belly Curried Lentils Cauliflower And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: olive oil, green onion, garlic cloves, curry, ground cumin, head cauliflower, diced tomato, cooked lentils, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add green onions and garlic, and saute until fragrant. Step 3: Reduce heat, add curry and cumin. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Add cauliflower and tomatoes, and saute until cauliflower is tender, add lentils. Step 6: Cook 1-2 minutes to heat through. Step 7: Add salt to taste, and garnish with sprinkling of paprika, if desired.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, pumpkin, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, curry powder, bulgur, vegetable broth, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in medium sauce pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, pumpkin, and spices. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, until onion is tender If mixture starts to stick at all, add water as necessary. Step 4: Add bulgur and stir to mix. Step 5: Cook and stir for about 2 minutes. Step 6: Stir in broth, salt, and pepper. Step 7: When mixture boils, cover saucepan, reduce heat to low, and cook 15 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed Fluff with fork before serving.

Dish Name: Burfi A La Yamuna Indian Fudge
Ingredient Names: butter, brown sugar, white sugar, milk, powdered milk, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter over low heat, stir in sugars. Step 2: Add the milk and bring to a boil gradually over medium heat. Step 3: Lower the flame and add the powdered milk slowly, stirring to work out all the lumps If you're adding nuts, mix them in once the lumps are smoothed out. Step 4: Cook on medium heat for approximately 4-5 minutes, until nice and thick Butter a 9x13 inch cake pan and pour mixture into pan, spread evenly. Step 5: Cover with plastic wrap and place in fridge to set - the girls stick it in the freezer so they don't have to wait so long:). Step 6: Once set, cut into 1 1 / 2 inch squares. Step 7: Keep refrigerated and covered with plastic wrap.

Dish Name: Buttered Wild Mushrooms With Onion And Hot Chilis
Ingredient Names: butter, wild mushrooms, onion, salt, hot green chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a skillet or wok over moderate heat Add all the ingredients at once and stir-fry for 10 minutes Serve warm with plain rice.

Ingredient Names: onion, canola oil, curry powder, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, frozen spinach, butternut squash, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, light coconut milk, salt and pepper, cilantro, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place cubed butternut squash on a foil lined baking sheet, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Sprinkle generously with curry powder, salt and pepper, and roast at 350 for 35-45 minutes, or until tender You still want them to hold their shape when added to the curry, and not be mush:> While squash cooks, heat 1-2 tsp of canola oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add onions and a little bit of salt, and saut 2-3 minutes, or until they begin to soften Next, add the curry powder, cumin, coriander and cinnamon, and stir to coat the onions evenly with spices. Step 4: Add tomatoes with their juices, and the chickpeas, stir to combine Next, add the spinach, stirring to coat with cooking liquid. Step 5: When all the spinach is added to the pan, cover and simmer until just wilted, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Add coconut milk and gently stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, vegetable oil, potatoes, onion, cumin seed, mustard seeds, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt, desiccated coconut, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Quarter, core and shred cabbage. Step 2: Heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: When hot, add cumin and mustard seeds and wait till they sputter. Step 4: Then add finely sliced onion. Step 5: Allow onion to soften and then throw in the shredded cabbage. Step 6: Add salt, turmeric and coriander powders Close pot, reduce heat slightly and allow to cook until cabbage wilts As soon as cabbage reduces in volume, add small pieces of diced potatoes and continue cooking on medium heat till potatoes soften and cabbage is tender If desired, add in shredded coconut with potatoes as allow to cook as in previous step. Step 7: Garnish with coriander sprigs.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, graham flour, mint leaf, curry leaf, ginger paste, garlic paste, red chili powder, curry powder, coriander powder, oil, salt, cucumbers, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl combine all the ingredients except the oil. Step 2: Mix well, then add some water to the mixture to make a paste and keep aside If you find the mixture is already moist and paste-like, there is no need to add water. Step 3: Shape the mixture into equal sized balls, heat oil in a wok. Step 4: Add the pakodas and deep fry on medium heat until they become brownish in colour. Step 5: Drain on clean kitchen paper towels. Step 6: Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with cucumber and carrot and serve hot with chutney or tomato ketchup.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, wheat flour, gingerroot, tomatoes, green chilies, coriander leaves, ghee, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grate the cabbage and finely chop the green chillies & coriander leaves. Step 2: Take the wheat flour in a bowl, add the ghee and mix. Step 3: Add the grated cabbage, ginger, tomato, coriander leaves, green chillies & salt. Step 4: Knead & make a dough by adding small amount of water as needed. Step 5: Make 6-8 balls, roll them into round parathas with a rolling pin Roast them on both sides on a tawa by adding oil to it. Step 6: Serve hot with pickles or curd.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, coconut, purple onions, cabbage, garam masala, red chili powder, cinnamon stick, turmeric powder, cloves, green cardamoms, oil, ghee, lemon, salt, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Roast peanuts for 5 minutes. Step 2: Remove the skin of the roasted peanuts. Step 3: Soak rice for an hour. Step 4: Drain off excess water and keep aside. Step 5: In a heavy bottomed saucepan, fry cinnamon, cloves, cardamoms and onion on high flame with ghee and oil. Step 6: Add rice, coconut, cabbage, green peas, garam masala, chilli powder, turmeric powder, the ground paste and 2 cups of water& salt, mix well. Step 7: Cook on medium flame for 15 minutes, stir. Step 8: Garnish with roasted peanuts and serve.

Dish Name: Cabbage With Mustard Seeds And Coconut
Ingredient Names: mustard oil, black mustard seeds, bay leaves, head of cabbage, salt, sugar, chili pepper flakes, green chilies, desiccated coconut
Instructions: Step 1: First heat the mustard oil in a wok. Step 2: When the oil is heated, add the mustard seeds and bay leaves. Step 3: When mustard seeds turn gray and start popping add the cabbage, salt and sugar Quickly toss the cabbage in the oil until its lightly coated with oil and add coconut, green chili and optional pepper flakes. Step 4: Keep stirring for 2-5 minutes until the cabbage turns bright green and slightly wilted. Step 5: Serve with basmati rice.

Dish Name: Cabbage With Paneer And Tomato Bund Gobhi Paneer
Ingredient Names: canola oil, cumin seed, thai red chili peppers, cabbage, ground cumin, ground coriander, white sugar, coarse salt, ground cayenne pepper, sweet paprika, turmeric, water, tomatoes, panir, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Mix spices together and cook in oil until fragrant and cumin seeds turn a reddish brown. Step 3: Stir in cabbage and toss to coat it with the spices, cook until slightly wilted 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in 1 / 2 cup water, tomato, paneer, and cilantro. Step 5: Lower heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is tender and the cheese is spongy-soft The sauce will not thicken. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Cachumbar Tomato Onion And Ginger Salad
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onion, cilantro, fresh lemon juice, fresh ginger, salt, hot green chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, onions, cilantro, lemon juice ginger and salt, and mix well Sprinkle the chili peppers on top Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: onion, tomatoes, fresh green chilies, vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the onions, tomatoes and chillies in a dish Pour over the vinegar and salt to taste Chill before serving.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, mango juice, almond syrup, rose syrup, lime juice, lemonade
Instructions: Step 1: Place some cubed mango pieces in serving glasses. Step 2: Stir together almond syrup, rose syrup and mango juice in a bowl. Step 3: Add a dash of sour lime juice, mix well. Step 4: Pour into the glasses. Step 5: Top with lemonade and serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: rice, curds, onions, ginger, green chilies, sugar, oil, salt, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon sticks, raisins, cashew nuts, coriander powder, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice, heat oil. Step 2: Add the raisins and cashwents, fry. Step 3: Add sliced onions and fry till they turn golden brown. Step 4: Add cloves, cinnamon and cardamoms, fry. Step 5: Add sugar and when it turns dark brown in colour, add rice. Step 6: Add green chillies, ginger, coriander and chilly powder, fry for a while.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, sunflower oil, onion, cinnamon stick, green cardamom pods, cumin seed, pistachios, raisins, water, salt, shredded coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice, until the water runs clear. Step 2: Place the rice in a bowl and cover with cold water. Step 3: Set the rice aside for one hour to soak, drain the rice. Step 4: Heat half of the oil in a saucepan using a high heat, add the onion. Step 5: Stir and cook the onion for about ten minutes, until crisp. Step 6: Remove the onion and drain on paper kitchen towel. Step 7: Heat the remaining oil over a low heat. Step 8: Add the cinnamon stick, cardamom pods and cumin seeds.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, sugar, cardamoms, almonds, lemons, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender bowl, put half cup of water, yogurt, sugar, cardamom, almonds and salt, cover, blend thoroughly. Step 2: Add the remaining water and lemon juice, blend again, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: baby spinach leaves, unsalted butter, shallots, cardamom, hot pepper flakes, double cream, lemon, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch spinach in boiling salted water for 30 seconds, drain in a colander and refresh under cold running water. Step 2: Squeeze out water until spinach is quite dry. Step 3: Place in a blender and blitz to a coarse puree. Step 4: Heat butter in a saucepan, add shallots and cook for 1 min, until softened. Step 5: Add cardamom and chili and mix well. Step 6: Stir in the spinach and cream and heat gently until they are lightly bound together. Step 7: Add the lemon zest, season with salt and black pepper and serve sprinkled with the toasted almonds.

Ingredient Names: coconut, sunflower seeds, wheat germ, carob powder, tahini, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Mix it all together Separate in half, place each piece on waxed paper, and shape into a one-inch thick roll. Step 2: Wrap in the waxed paper and keep in the refrigerator. Step 3: Cut off one-inch pieces as needed Variation: leave out the carob from half the recipe to have two different kinds.

Ingredient Names: russet potatoes, onion, garlic, frozen spinach, fresh parsley, curry powder, chili powder, turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne, tomato sauce, oil, salt, peas, cauliflower
Instructions: Step 1: Fry onion over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add potatoes and continue cooking for about 10 or 15 minutes, until onions are soft. Step 3: Add garlic and cook for only seconds. Step 4: Then add the rest of the ingredients and stir and let heat through. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium low and then cover and let cook until potatoes are soft and ingredients are melded, stir frequently.

Ingredient Names: lentils, yellow onion, cilantro, tomatoes, coconut milk, tomato sauce, curry powder, turmeric, ginger, ground cloves, cumin, cayenne, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cover bottom of saucepan with vegetable oil. Step 2: Fry onion about 5 minutes, add cilantro and continue frying over medium heat, until onion is golden. Step 3: Add tomato and let get a little soft. Step 4: Add rest of ingredients, including spices and let simmer for about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, coriander seed, cumin seed, mustard seeds, ground coriander, turmeric, carrots, basmati rice, water, salt, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a lidded saucepan and cook the onion until soft. Step 2: Add the coriander, cumin and mustard seeds, ground coriander and turmeric and cook for 1 minute, then add the carrot, stirring well. Step 3: Add the rice, water and salt and bring to the boil, stirring. Step 4: Cover tightly and simmer very gently, undisturbed, for 15 minutes. Step 5: Take from the heat for a further 5 mins, covered, then fluff up with two forks. Step 6: Serve with lemon quarters and fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: carrots, tomatoes, salt, celery, black pepper, ice cube, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Freeze the chopped tomatoes and carrots for 30 minutes. Step 2: Put the frozen tomato cubes in a blender or in a smoothie maker and blend. Step 3: Toss in the frozen carrot cubes and blend again. Step 4: Add celery pieces, salt and pepper and blend. Step 5: Add ice cubes and lemon juice and blend again. Step 6: Pour juice into a long stemmed glass and serve chilled Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: carrots, sugar, nonfat dry milk powder, unsalted butter, cardamom seed, blanched almond, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook the grated carrots and sugar, covered, for about 20 minutes, add the dry milk. Step 2: Cook, stirring occasionally to avoid sticking at bottom, until no moisture is left. Step 3: Stir in the butter. Step 4: Cook on medium heat until the mixture is of desired consistency that can be spread on a tray and cut into pieces. Step 5: Add more dry milk as needed. Step 6: Mix in the cardamoms and spread on a 9 by 13 inches greased cookie sheet, garnish with nuts. Step 7: Cut into squares when cold.

Dish Name: Carrot Curry With Shallots And Chiles
Ingredient Names: corn oil, shallots, green chili pepper, carrot, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground fennel, cayenne pepper, ground turmeric, curry leaves, salt, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy medium pan add the oil and set over medium heat. Step 2: Add shallots and chiles to hot oil. Step 3: Stir and fry for 2 minutes, or until the shallots have softened a bit. Step 4: Add the carrots, cumin, coriander, fennel, cayenne pepper, turmeric, curry leaves, and salt and continue to stir and fry over medium, heat for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add coconut milk and bring to simmer. Step 6: Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer very gently for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, sugar, salt, cumin powder, ground cayenne pepper, oil, mustard seeds, carrots, coriander leaves, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the sugar, salt, cumin and chilli or cayenne into the yoghurt and adjust seasoning to taste. Step 2: Grate carrots and chill Just before serving mix the yoghurt and the grated carrots together. Step 3: Heat the oil in a small vessel. Step 4: When it is hot add the mustard seeds As soon as they sizzle add the oil and the mustard to the curd and carrots. Step 5: Serve garnished with coriander and mint.

Dish Name: Carrot Juice Not For The Parrot For You
Ingredient Names: carrots, water, orange juice, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put the carrots in a blender and blend using a little water, orange juice and sugar Stir well, strain the juice and serve chilled.

Dish Name: Carrot Koftas In Creamy Dreamy Yummy Float
Ingredient Names: carrots, potato, panir, red chili powder, salt, green chili, ginger powder, gram flour, butter, oil, low-fat yogurt, turmeric powder, sugar, mustard seeds, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation of the koftas: heat butter in a frying pan. Step 2: Once it melts, add the grated carrots in it. Step 3: Allow to simmer for 2 minutes. Step 4: Cover and keep for 5 minutes on low flame. Step 5: When the carrots turn a little soft, remove from pan, allow to cool. Step 6: Mix the other ingredients except oil to deep fry. Step 7: Make small balls out of the mixture. Step 8: Heat the oil for deep frying. Step 9: Now here's the interesting part.

Ingredient Names: long-grain rice, water, roasted peanuts, butter, onion, gingerroot, carrot, salt, pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine rice and water in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, cover with lid, and allow to steam until tender / cooked While rice is cooking, pulverize peanuts in a blender and set aside. Step 4: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Saute onions until golden brown. Step 6: Stir in ginger, carrots, and salt to taste. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and cover to steam 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in pepper and peanuts. Step 9: When rice is done, add it to the skillet and stir gently to combine with other ingredients.

Dish Name: Carrot Salad With Black Mustard Seeds
Ingredient Names: carrot, red bell peppers, cashews, salt, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: If very moist, press shredded carrots dry before mixing the salad. Step 2: Mix carrots, bell pepper, cashews and salt. Step 3: In a small pan heat oil over medium heat until hot. Step 4: Add mustard seeds and fry until they sputter and turn grey. Step 5: Pour oil and seeds over salad, add herbs and toss to mix, serve.

Ingredient Names: water, carrots, potatoes, celery ribs, onion, soy sauce, ground cumin, ground cayenne pepper, chili powder, garlic powder, garam masala, whole milk, instant potato flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan or cooking pot, measure water and bring to boil. Step 2: Add chopped carrots, diced potatoes, chopped celery and chopped onion and return to boil. Step 3: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 / 2 hour or until carrots are tender. Step 4: Remove from heat and let cool for about 5 minutes. Step 5: In a food processor or blender, puree' soup in batches until smooth and return to saucepan. Step 6: Add soy sauce, cumin, cayenne pepper, chili powder, garlic powder, curry powder, whole milk, instant potato flakes and return to boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally Adjust seasonings to taste. Step 8: Serve hot along with cooked rice You can also use vegetable broth or chicken broth instead of water.

Ingredient Names: carrot, butter, garam masala, salt, ginger powder, red chili powder, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Cook carrots until just tender, 10-15 min depending on size of carrots. Step 2: Melt butter in pan until browned. Step 3: Add garam masala, salt, ginger and red chili powder if using, cook 1 minute. Step 4: Add carrots and toss to coat. Step 5: Serve with cilantro leaves sprinkled on top as garnish.

Ingredient Names: carrots, butter, cumin seeds, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook carrots in boiling salted water until just tender. Step 2: Melt butter in a medium-sized saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add salt, pepper and cumin seeds. Step 4: Stir until seeds begin to sizzle and pop. Step 5: Add carrots, stir until carrots are thoroughly coated with mixture and are heated through, serve.

Dish Name: Cauliflower & cashew pilaf with chickpea curry
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, cashews, basmati rice, cauliflower, curry sauce, chickpeas, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan, add the onion and fry until lightly coloured. Add the cashews and fry until golden. Stir in the rice until coated in the oil. Add the cauliflower and 600ml water, season, then bring to the boil. Cover, then gently cook for 12-15 mins until the rice and cauliflower are tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the curry sauce and chickpeas together, then simmer for 5 mins. Spoon the rice into 4 shallow bowls and spoon the curry on the side. Scatter over the coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, curry paste choice, basmati rice, cauliflower florets, chickpeas, vegetable stock, almonds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large, non-stick pan and add the onions. Cook over a medium heat for 5 mins until starting to turn golden. Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 min. Add the rice, cauliflower and chickpeas, stirring to coat in the paste. Step 2: Pour in the stock and stir. Cover and simmer for 10-15 mins until the rice and cauliflower are tender and all the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the almonds and coriander, then serve.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, fresh coriander leaves, ginger, spring onions, plain flour, rice flour, cornflour, red chili powder, soya sauce, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first four ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Add the next six ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Keep aside for 30-40 minutes. Step 4: Mix well, once again Deep fry in hot oil. Step 5: Drain on clean kitchen paper napkins / towels. Step 6: Serve hot with chilli sauce or tomato ketchup.

Ingredient Names: onions, vegetable oil, green chili, ground cumin, ground coriander, paprika, turmeric, salt, cauliflower, vegetable stock, tomato puree, tomatoes, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Chop one of the onions and cook gently in half of the oil. Step 2: Add the chilli and spices and cook for a minute. Step 3: Add the salt and cauliflower to the pan, turn in the mixture then pour in the stock and the tomato puree. Step 4: Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for about 10 minutes until almost tender While the cauliflower is cooking in the curry sauce, slice the remaining onions into rings. Step 5: Heat the rest of the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion rings until crisp and deep golden. Step 6: Drain on kitchen paper. Step 7: Add the tomatoes to the pan and cook for a further 3 minutes. Step 8: Serve topped with the onion rings and garnish with fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, fennel seed, dried red chilies, ghee, poppy seeds, red chili powder, onions, ginger, tomato paste, curry leaves, tomatoes, lime juice, nutmeg, coconut cream, baby potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee in a large wok on medium flame. Step 2: Add onions and saute until light brown. Step 3: Then add the ginger, chilli powder, nutmeg and the ground spices. Step 4: Mix well and cook until it releases its aroma. Step 5: Add the cauliflower florets. Step 6: Stir-fry for 4 minutes. Step 7: Add all the remaining ingredients, except the cauliflower. Step 8: When the potato is half-cooked, that's when you have to add the cauliflower florets. Step 9: Simmer and cook until the sauce thickens and the cauliflower is crisp-tender Do not overcook the cauliflower.

Ingredient Names: onion, cayenne pepper, coriander, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, cumin, cinnamon, peppercorns, cloves, turmeric, paprika, tamarind paste, fresh gingerroot, oil, frozen cauliflower
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all but the last three ingredients in a food processor Run the processor until it forms a paste. Step 2: Add a little oil and / or a little water if ingredients have trouble processing. Step 3: Saute in a pan with the cauliflower and oil for a few minutes until aromatic. Step 4: Add the coconut milk and simmer until cauliflower reaches desired tenderness If the curry gets too dry as it simmers, add a little water so that it finishes with a thick, gravy-like sauce.

Ingredient Names: oil, tomatoes, cauliflower, onion, cumin seed, chili powder, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in the pan and put tomatoes, cauliflower, onion and cumin seeds in the oil. Step 2: Place the lid on the pan, until the cauliflower is cooked, about 15 minutes. Step 3: Add salt and chilli powder to taste. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: flour, water, chili powder, ground coriander, mustard powder, ground turmeric, vegetable oil, curry leaves, cumin seed, cauliflower, coconut milk, lemons, salt, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour with a little bit of water to make a smooth paste. Step 2: Add the chilli, coriander, cumin, mustard, turmeric, and salt. Step 3: Add the remaining water and mix to blend the ingredients. Step 4: Heat the oil in a wok or large pan and fry the curry leaves and cumin seeds. Step 5: Add the spice paste and simmer for about 5 minutes If the sauce is too thick add a little bit of hot water. Step 6: Add the cauliflower and coconut milk. Step 7: Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover and cook until the cauliflower is tender but crunchy. Step 8: Cook longer if you prefer. Step 9: Add the lemon juice and mix thoroughly and serve hot and garnish with the sliced lime.

Ingredient Names: coriander leaves, garlic, green chilies, cauliflower, ginger, spring onions, tomatoes, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together the coriander leaves, green garlic, chillies, ginger and spring onions This will give you the'green masala' Heat oil in a non-stick skillet. Step 2: Fry the above ground green masala in it till some of it evaporates, stirring on and off, for 18-20 minutes, on medium flame. Step 3: Add tomatoes to the masala. Step 4: Mix in salt, turmeric powder and the garam masala. Step 5: Mix in cauliflower florets and coat well with the masala paste, cover the skillet. Step 6: Cook with an occasional sprinkling of water on low flame for 20-30 minutes, turning occasionally, for even cooking.

Ingredient Names: flour, panko breadcrumbs, garam masala, baking soda, salt, cumin, turmeric, cayenne, black pepper, lemon juice, club soda, egg whites, cauliflower florets, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 475f in a large bowl, whisk together flour, 1 / 2 c panko, baking soda and remaining spices. Step 2: Whisk in lemon juice and club soda, set aside. Step 3: In a small bowl, whisk the egg whites until foamy. Step 4: Whisk whites into flour mixture. Step 5: Using your hands, add cauliflower and combine until all florets are coated. Step 6: Place remaining panko in a bowl Lift florets, one at a time out of batter and toss in panko. Step 7: Place on a large baking sheet coated with oil. Step 8: Bake until brown and crispy, about 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Cauliflower Panko Pakoras Breaded And Baked Fried
Ingredient Names: flour, panko breadcrumbs, garam masala, baking soda, salt, ground cumin, ground turmeric, cayenne, black pepper, fresh lemon juice, club soda, egg whites, cauliflower florets, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 475. Step 2: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, 1 / 2 cup panko, the garam masala, baking soda, salt, and remaining spices. Step 3: Whisk in lemon juice and club soda, set aside 2. Step 4: In a small bowl, use a clean whisk to beat egg whites until foamy 3. Step 5: Whisk whites into flour mixture. Step 6: Using your hands or a spatula, add cauliflower and combine until all florets are coated.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, peas, potatoes, corn oil, mustard seeds, ajmoh seeds, sesame seeds, salt, turmeric, red chili powder, garlic, ginger, cumin powder, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cut cauliflower into small florets Peel potatoes and cut into quarters and whole if using baby. Step 2: Pour oil into a saucepan and set over a moderate heat and add the mustard seeds, ajmoh and sesame seeds. Step 3: Put a lid on the saucepan The mustard seeds will start popping when heated and once they have stopped. Step 4: Add the vegetables and toss a few times. Step 5: Add garlic, ginger pulp and all the spices and salt, toss again. Step 6: Add 1 / 4 pint of water and cook on a moderate heat for about 20 minutes. Step 7: Serve garnished with fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: onion, fresh ginger, olive oil, garlic cloves, cumin seed, red pepper flakes, ground turmeric, vegetable stock, cauliflower, frozen spinach, tomatoes, dried red lentils, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium soup pot on medium heat, saut the onions in oil until translucent. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic, cumin, red pepper, and turmeric and saut for 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir constantly to avoid sticking. Step 4: Add the stock, cauliflower, tomatoes, and lentils. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Step 6: Cover with lid and simmer for 1 minutes or until veggies and lentils are cooked. Step 7: Stir in the cilantro and salt, remove from heat, and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, baking powder, salt, coconut, water, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour, salt and baking powder. Step 2: Add coconut and mix well. Step 3: Add water and knead to a soft dough. Step 4: Cover with a damp cloth. Step 5: Keep aside for 30 minutes. Step 6: Divide dough into 8 parts. Step 7: Roll each into a ball. Step 8: Roll out each ball into a round disc 5" in diameter and of 1 / 4" thickness. Step 9: Sprinkle with a little flour, if needed. Step 10: Heat griddle, lightly grease and cook one at a time over low heat until brown specks appear on both sides.

Ingredient Names: oatmeal, turmeric, salt, ground coriander, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, ground allspice, nutmeg, honey, milk, dried fruit
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oatmeal and flavourings in a deep, microwave safe bowl. Step 2: Add milk and stir to combine. Step 3: Cook on high power for 2 minutes, then stir Continue cooking and stirring at one minute intervals until the oatmeal is as thick as you like. Step 4: Top with favourite toppings I like plain yogurt and a touch of maple syrup.

Ingredient Names: seeds, dried mint, cardamom pod, dried rose petals, fennel, whole cloves, cinnamon sticks, dried ginger, granulated sugar, pure vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the spices in a cast iron pan. Step 2: Turn the heat to medium and stir the spices until you smell their beautiful oils filling the air. Step 3: Remove spices from pan just as they start to crackle. Step 4: Transfer to a mortar and pestle Grind spices roughly 5 minutes, not worrying about getting it perfect, just break open the toasted spices This will release an overwhelming smell of wonderfullness. Step 5: Put the sugar in a large bowl and spritz / sprinkle the vanilla, stirring until the sugar is evenly light brown from the vanilla It will combine if you stir it enough. Step 6: Mix the spices with the vanilla sugar and leave the bowl uncovered overnight The next day, the vanilla will be dry and sugar will have become like a hardened sand castle.

Ingredient Names: water, cinnamon stick, cardamom pod, black peppercorns, whole cloves, fennel seed, vanilla pod, star anise, saffron threads, anise seed, nutmeg, ground ginger, black tea leaves, milk, honey
Instructions: Step 1: You'll have to try several types of tea to find out which you prefer. Step 2: Pour the water into a heavy bottomed pan. Step 3: Add the spices and tea bags. Step 4: Bring to a boil, partially cover pan and simmer about 20 minutes to allow spices to intensify. Step 5: Add the milk or milk substitute and heat through without boiling until hot. Step 6: Pour chai tea through a strainer into tea cups. Step 7: Add sweetener of choice if desired Sit, sip, close your eyes, relax, enjoy! Step 8: Servings are estimated.

Dish Name: Chana And Aloo Chickpea And Potato Curry
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, coconut cream, potatoes, onion, garlic cloves, bay leaf, cumin seed, mustard seeds, curry powder, sugar, olive oil, salt, chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a medium sized pot on medium high with some oil. Step 2: When oil is hot add in onion, bay leaf, chili, cumin & mustard seeds Saut until the onion starts to go translucent add in garlic Saut until mixture starts to brown add in sugar and curry powder. Step 3: Add in more oil as needed. Step 4: Fry until mixture becomes dark brown not burnt it doesn't take to long and add in coconut milk, stir well. Step 5: Add in your potatoes and chickpeas, at this point you may need to add in some water, you want the liquid to be about one inch below the vegetable level, stir well. Step 6: Bring mixture to a boil, stir and turn heat down to medium low, cover and cook, stirring the curry every few minutes, until potatoes are done It is ok if the potatoes fall apart in fact it is yummier that way.

Ingredient Names: chana, potato, tomatoes, coriander leaves, green chili, lime juice, chaat masala, black salt, ground cumin, salt, red chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Boil and cut the potato into cubes Finely chop the tomato and chilli and coriander leaves. Step 2: Add them to the cooked chana. Step 3: Add chaat masala, salt, red chilli powder, roasted cumin seed powder and black salt, mix well. Step 4: Squeeze lime juice. Step 5: Mix well once again. Step 6: Garnish with coriander leaves, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, coconut milk, ginger, cabbage, green bell pepper, curry leaves, chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala, lemon juice, jalapeno, roma tomato, oil, salt, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: Cook dal in 4 c of water until soft, adding more water as needed. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in another pan. Step 4: Saute cabbage and bell pepper over high heat, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add ginger, jalapeno, hing, dry spices and tomato. Step 6: Saute until the oil separates from the ingredients in the pan. Step 7: Add 1 c of water and bring to a boil. Step 8: Add cooked dal and cook 10 minutes until gravy is thick. Step 9: Add the coconut milk and remove from heat, add lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, cooking oil, red bell pepper, tomatoes, onion, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, coriander powder, mustard seeds, dried red chilies, bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon stick, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak chana dal in water for a few hours prior to use. Step 2: Heat oil and add mustard seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon, ginger and garlic pastes, and cloves. Step 3: Add onions and let it heat till they turn translucent. Step 4: Add chopped tomato and curry leaves and then the chana dal, making sure to add enough water to cover the dal as it boils. Step 5: Cook on medium-high heat with a closed lid for 15-20min until the chana dal softens, while continuing to replenish the water now and again as it evaporates As soon as chana begins to soften, add the sliced capsicum. Step 6: Stir it in well with the chana and continue to cook until both the chana and capsicum, have softened sufficiently. Step 7: Garnish with cilantro. Step 8: Serve with rice or paratha.

Dish Name: Chana Dal Yellow Lentils With Spinach
Ingredient Names: channa dal, water, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, frozen spinach, garam masala, coriander powder, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash lentils and allow to soak in water at least an hour before use. Step 2: Drain the lentils, place in a large pot with enough water to cover the lentils, bring to a boil and let simmer for 20-30 minutes until the lentils have softened. Step 3: Cook uncovered to let the cooking liquid evaporate - but be careful not to overcook such that they become mushy. Step 4: Heat oil, add bay leaves and cinnamon, and then fry mustard seeds till they sputter, then add onion, ginger, garlic and chili and fry a further 5 minutes. Step 5: Add spinach and cook for 10 minutes or until spinach is dry and liquid has been absorbed. Step 6: Stir in the remaining spices and salt and cook for 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Finally add the lentils, stir and cook a further 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Chana Masala In The Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: water, onion, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, fresh cilantro leaves, garam masala, garlic powder, cumin, cayenne pepper, ground coriander, turmeric, sea salt, chickpeas, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything except the chickpeas and basmati rice in your slow cooker and turn on low for 6-8 hours, add chickpeas. Step 2: Cook 2 more hours until they're tender and have incorporated the indian flavors. Step 3: Serve over basmati rice.

Dish Name: Chana Masala Spicy Chickpeas With Spinach
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, water, onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, lemon, curry powder, coriander powder, cumin, garam masala, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or frying pan, sautee onions and garlic in olive oil until soft, about 3-5 minutes. Step 2: Add chickpeas straight from the can, including all the water. Step 3: Add spices and lemon juice, cover, and simmer about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, adding more water if needed, until chickpeas are browned and soft. Step 4: Reduce heat, add spinach and cover. Step 5: Allow spinach to wilt for 2-4 minutes. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, water, turmeric, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, margarine, cumin seed, onion, garlic clove, fresh ginger, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put chickpeas in a bowl. Step 2: Add enough cold water to cover and soak overnight To cook, drain chickpeas. Step 3: Place chickpeas, water, turmeric, cumin, coriander, and cayenne in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, cover pan, and simmer for about 1 hour. Step 5: In a large saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat. Step 6: Add cumin seed and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, or until onion turns golden brown. Step 8: Add chickpeas and cooking liquid to onion mixture. Step 9: Turn heat to high and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.

Dish Name: Channa Kurma Recipe - South Indian Style
Ingredient Names: chole chickpea, water, salt, baking soda, oil, fennel, black cardamom, cinnamon, pepper, onions, ginger, garlic, tomato, fresh coconut, cumin, turmeric, chili powder, chana masala, fresh coriander, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, put 1½ cups chole, 4 cups water, 1 tsp salt, and a pinch of baking soda in a pressure cooker. Step 2: Pressure cook for 5 whistles or until the chole is cooked well. Keep aside. Step 3: To prepare the masala paste, heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Add 1 tsp fennel, 1 black cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon, 1 tsp pepper, and 1 tsp cloves. Step 4: Saute on a low flame till the spices turn aromatic. Step 5: Add 1 onion, 1 inch ginger, 3 clove garlic and saute well. Step 6: Also, add 1 tomato and cook till the tomato softens. Step 7: Further add 1 cup of coconut and cook till the coconut turns golden brown. Step 8: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Add 1 ladleful of boiled chole and water. Step 9: Blend to a smooth paste. Keep aside. Step 10: In a large kadai, heat 2 tbsp oil and saute 1 tsp cumin. Step 11: Saute 1 onion till it turns golden brown. Step 12: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tbsp chana masala and saute till the masala turns aromatic. Step 13: Further add 1 tomato and saute well. Step 14: Now add prepared masala paste and cook well till the oil separates. Step 15: Also add boiled chole, 1 tsp salt and mix well, adjusting the consistency. Step 16: Simmer for 10 minutes, or until the chole absorbs all the flavour. Step 17: Add in 2 tbsp coriander, ½ lemon and mix well. Step 18: Finally, enjoy Chana Kurma Recipe with poori and roti.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, star anise, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, mustard seeds, whole black peppercorn, black cardamom pods, onions, tomato paste, water, chickpeas, plain yogurt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and add star anise, cinnamon, cloves, mustard seed, peppercorns and cardamom pods. Step 3: Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, 30-45 minutes, until the mustard seeds are nearly burnt. Step 4: Using a slotted spoon, scoop out and discard the spices, leaving the oil in the pan. Step 5: Add onion to oil and continue to cook very slowly, stirring occasionally, 2-3 hours, or until onions are completely limp and dark mahogany brown. Step 6: Add tomato paste and water and simmer 10 minutes. Step 7: Add chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes more. Step 8: Add yogurt and garam masala. Step 9: Simmer a final 10 minutes, then serve with steamed basmati or jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: onions, black channa, ginger, garlic, green chilies, oil, cinnamon, cloves, cardamoms, cumin seed, tomatoes, coriander powder, red chili powder, water, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Add cardamom, cinnamom, cloves and cumin seeds. Step 3: Stir fry for a minute. Step 4: Add the 8 finely chopped onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies. Step 5: Stir fry on medium-high flame for 20-30 minutes Till reddish-brown in colour. Step 6: Add coriander powder, turmeric powder and red chilli powder, mix well. Step 7: Now add tomatoes followed by water and black pepper powder, mix well.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, spring onion, ginger, garlic, plain flour, cornflour, red chili powder, red chilies, cooking oil, water, milk, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add milk to water in a pot and mix well. Step 2: Add the cauliflower florettes to the pot and boil for 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Remove from pot, drain and pat dry on a clean cloth. Step 4: In a bowl, prepare a batter out of 1 / 4 cup flour, 2 tbsps Cornflour, 1 / 4 teaspoons chopped ginger, 1 / 4 teaspoons chopped garlic, salt to taste and red chilli powder. Step 5: Dip the florettes in the batter, one by one. Step 6: Heat oil in a wok Deep fry the cauliflower florettes in hot oil. Step 7: Drain on clean kitchen paper towels and keep aside. Step 8: Pour the remaining oil in a pot.

Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, canola oil, cumin seeds, green cardamoms, cloves, bay leaf, salt, water, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot on medium flame. Step 2: Once its hot, toss in the cloves, cardamoms, bay leaf, cinnamon stick and cumin seeds. Step 3: Allow the cumin seeds to crackle. Step 4: Once they stop crackling, fold in the drained rice and cook on medium flame, stirring continuously for 4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in water and salt. Step 6: Mix well and bring to a boil. Step 7: Lower flame and allow to cook until all the water has been absorbed and the rice is cooked, remove from heat. Step 8: Serve hot with "charishma's delicious pressure-cooked black-eye peas " Enjoy!

Dish Name: Charishma's Delicious Pressure Cooked Black Eyed Peas Chauli
Ingredient Names: onions, tomatoes, black-eyed peas, garlic cloves, green chili, fresh ginger, salt, turmeric powder, red chili powder, water, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pressure cooker on medium flame. Step 2: Once its hot, toss in the green chilli, garlic, ginger and onions. Step 3: Saute for 5-7 minutes or until the raw smell of the ginger and garlic is gone, and, they smell aromatic, and appear golden-brownish in colour{appearance} Add turmeric and red chilli powders. Step 4: Stir-fry for 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the drained black-eye peas and cook, covered, on full flame for 5 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Step 6: Fold in the chopped tomato and salt. Step 7: Mix well and cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in 3 cups of water, mix well and close the cooker with its lid. Step 9: Cook on full flame{high heat} until the first whistle is heard.

Dish Name: Charishma's Double Mocha Cocoa Sweetened Milk Coffee Coffee
Ingredient Names: sugar, water, sweetened condensed milk, cocoa powder, instant coffee, instant cappuccino mix
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve sugar in water, stir, and simmer on low flame for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add in sweetened condensed milk, stir, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Meanwhile, put the cocoa powder, coffee and cappucino powder in your coffee mug. Step 4: Pour the milk-water-sugar mixture over these dry ingredients. Step 5: Stir vigorously until combined. Step 6: Keep aside for 10 minutes to allow it to'cream' together Sit back, log onto zaar, and sip sip sip, my very own magical cocoa1-coffee-mocha mix! Step 7: I won't say, "burn your lips and think of me", i'm sweeter now, ain't i.

Dish Name: Charishma's Jasmine And Brown Rice With Veggies
Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, jasmine rice, carrot, garlic cloves, onions, turmeric powder, black pepper, red chili powder, green cardamoms, bay leaf, maggi vegetable cube, water, dried thyme, dried oregano, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot. Step 2: Once its hot, add the cardamoms and bay leaves. Step 3: Stir-fry for 20 seconds then add garlic and onions. Step 4: Sprinkle a few drops of water to prevent onions from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Step 5: Stir-fry until the raw smell of garlic is gone and the onions are lightly browned. Step 6: Add carrots and continue to stir-fry for 5 minutes, uncovered You may sprinkle a few drops of water to prevent the food from sticking to the bottom of the pot. Step 7: Add turmeric, red chilli and black pepper powders. Step 8: Mix well and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 9: Add the drained brown rice and jasmine rice and mix well.

Dish Name: Charishma's Malted And Yummy Raisin Bran Snack
Ingredient Names: raisin bran cereal, milk, ovaltine
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the raisin bran and ovaltine well in a cereal bowl, such that the powder covers most of the bran. Step 2: Add milk Sit well Grab a spoon, open your mouth wide, and eat immediately!

Ingredient Names: potatoes, cauliflower, cumin seed, methi seeds, fennel seed, fresh ginger, green chilies, yogurt, tomatoes, garam masala powder, salt, chaat masala, turmeric powder, coriander powder, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 2: Once medium hot, toss in cumin seeds, fennel seeds and fenugreek seeds, allow to sizzle. Step 3: Once this stops, toss in the curry leaves and lightly stir-fry for 10 seconds. Step 4: Add chopped ginger and green chillies Continue to stir-fry until the raw smell of ginger is gone. Step 5: Fold in the cauliflower florets. Step 6: Add the masala powders and toss to coat the florets in the same. Step 7: Stir in the tomato paste and salt. Step 8: Cover and cook for 10 minutes until the cauliflower florets become tender.

Dish Name: Charishma's More Of A Veggie Yellow Lentil Curry
Ingredient Names: channa dal, turmeric powder, red chili powder, green chili, salt, water, garlic, fresh ginger, canola oil, onion, tomatoes, roma tomatoes, cumin seeds, dry methi leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pressure cooker or pot on medium flame. Step 2: Once the oil is hot, lower flame and add cumin seeds to it, allow to crackle. Step 3: Once it stops crackling, add ginger, garlic, onion and green chillies. Step 4: Mix well and stir-fry until the raw smell of ginger and garlic is gone, and the onions are softened. Step 5: Then, add the turmeric powder, kasoori methi and red chilli powder. Step 6: Mix well and then fold in the chopped tomatoes. Step 7: Stir and cook for 5-7 minutes. Step 8: Drain the chana dal and add it to the ginger-garlic-tomato mixture. Step 9: Mix well and fold in salt and stir in the water.

Dish Name: Charishma's Okra Sweet Corn Veggie Delight
Ingredient Names: turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, yellow onions, garlic, green chilies, fresh ginger, canola oil, tomatoes, salt, okra, sweet corn
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot on medium flame. Step 2: When it's hot, lower flame and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Step 3: Allow the seeds to splutter and crackle in the hot oil. Step 4: Once they stop doing that, add ginger, garlic, onions and green chillies to the oil. Step 5: Mix well and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes or until the raw smell of ginger and garlic is gone and the onions are softened. Step 6: Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and coriander powder. Step 7: Mix once again and then add the cut okra and sweet corn{both drained} Mix well, cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid and allow the veggies to cook on medium flame for 5 minutes. Step 8: Uncover, add tomatoes and salt. Step 9: Mix well and cover the pot with the tight-fitting lid.

Dish Name: Charishma's Own Quick N Easy Theplas
Ingredient Names: wheat flour, graham flour, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, asafoetida powder, cumin seed, sesame seeds, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Using a little water, mix all ingredients together except 'oil for shallow frying. Step 2: Knead to a soft pliable dough. Step 3: Divide dough into 10 balls. Step 4: Roll each ball into a 5 inch round Quick. Step 5: Place on a hot griddle, roast and drizzle oil, to shallow fry. Step 6: Once you see small brown circles appear, flip side. Step 7: Repeat for other side. Step 8: Repeat for remaining dough. Step 9: Serve hot with yogurt or tomato pickle.

Ingredient Names: panir, onions, tomatoes, red chili powder, dried fenugreek leaves, coriander powder, green chili, cumin seed, oil, fresh coriander leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Once it is hot, add cumin seeds and green chilli and allow to crackle. Step 3: Once they stop crackling, toss in the onion and stir-fry until lightly browned. Step 4: Add all the masala powders and stir-fry well. Step 5: Add kasoori methi and mix well. Step 6: Allow to cook for 3 minutes. Step 7: Then toss in the tomatoes and mix well. Step 8: Add the mashed paneer, mix gently, cover and allow to cook for 5 minutes. Step 9: Uncover, mix well, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with rotis Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, water, onions, tomatoes, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, salt, dried oregano, dried basil, fresh parsley, tomato ketchup, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot. Step 2: Saute onion and garlic in the oil till the onion is transparent and the raw smell of garlic is gone. Step 3: Add tomatoes, parsley and spices. Step 4: Cook on low heat for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add a teaspoon of salt. Step 6: Cook pasta in water that should contain a good dash of salt. Step 7: Cook, stirring often, until cooked al dente i E Until the pasta has got just a slight bite to it Chef's.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, lemon, salt, green chilies, mustard seeds, cumin seed, oil, turmeric powder, red chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice potatoes In the meantime, heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Once hot, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds, allow to crackle. Step 3: Add all the other ingredients, mix well, cover. Step 4: Cook on medium heat for 10-15 minutes until slightly brown. Step 5: Serve with hot puris.

Ingredient Names: coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric powder, green chili pepper, tomatoes, cumin seed, mustard seeds, oil, salt, okra, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Once hot, toss in the cumin and mustard seeds, allow to splutter. Step 3: Once it stops spluttering, add green chilli and onions. Step 4: Stir-fry on medium heat until browned. Step 5: Remove from heat and keep aside in a plate. Step 6: Pour 1 / 4 cup of oil in the same wok. Step 7: Add the chopped okra and stir-fry for a few minutes until cooked and aromatic This way, the okra will not split while cooking and the dish turns out very tasty. Step 8: Remove the okra from heat, once fried and lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, onions, leeks, green cabbage, vegetable bouillon cubes, bread, cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first four ingredients in a large and heavy-bottomed pan. Step 2: Add water, until it is 1 inch over the veggies, and the stock cubes. Step 3: Cover and cook until the veggies are very tender. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper, remove from heat. Step 5: Allow to cool down to room temperature Process once it has cooled down In the meantime, cut the bread into cubes, heat oil in a pan. Step 6: Fry the bread cubes in the hot oil until golden.

Ingredient Names: vegan chicken, soy yogurt, fresh lemon juice, ground cumin, ground red pepper, fresh ground black pepper, cinnamon, salt, fresh ginger, bamboo skewers, earth balance margarine, garlic cloves, ground coriander, paprika, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Chop 'chicken' into 1" cubes. Step 2: Mix all marinade ingredients together and add the cubed gardein chicken. Step 3: Marinate for about 1 hour. Step 4: Soak bamboo skewers in warm water while preparing sauce For sauce, melt 'butter' on medium heat until melted. Step 5: Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Step 6: Stir in coriander, cumin, paprika, garam masala and salt. Step 7: Stir in tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 8: Add peas and stir in coconut milk. Step 9: Simmer on low heat while preparing the gardein chicken.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, baking potato, canola oil, madras curry powder, cumin seeds, cayenne, chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, sugar, fresh coriander, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, then add the cauliflower and potatoes. Step 2: Return to the boil and cook for 5 minutes approx. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: Heat a large non stick frying pan, add the oil, then the curry powder, cumin and cayenne. Step 5: Cook until fragrant, then add the chickpeas and cook another minute. Step 6: Stir in the tomatoes and sugar, cook 1 minute then add the cauliflower and potatoes, cook until the tomato sauce thickens and the vegetables are tender. Step 7: Remove from heat and add the coriander and salt then serve.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, paneer cheese, red onion, garlic cloves, coconut milk, pickle, garam masala, mustard seeds, turmeric, chili powder, cumin, spices, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Drain chickpeas of liquid Cube paneer in about half inch cubes. Step 2: Chop onion and garlic. Step 3: Heat one tb oil in a non stick skillet and fry paneer until browned and crispy. Step 4: Transfer cheese to a plate. Step 5: Mix all dry spices in a bowl. Step 6: Heat the other tb oil in a skillet and add mustard seeds and let fry until they crack. Step 7: Add onion and garlic and let fry until translucent. Step 8: Add spices and let roast until fragrant. Step 9: Add chickppeas and stir until they are covered with spices.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onion, chickpeas, potatoes, diced tomatoes, water, cinnamon, cardamom, cumin, coriander, fennel seed, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a skillet. Step 2: Add the mustard seeds and heat them until they start to pop. Step 3: Add the rest of the spices and cook on low for a couple of minutes.
