Step 4: Add the onions, garlic and ginger and saute until the onions are translucent. Step 5: Add the potatoes and chickpeas, stir them, and cook a few more minutes, coating the potatoes with the oil and spices. Step 6: Add the water, cover the pan / pot, and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 7: When the potatoes are tender but not completely cooked yet, add the tomatoes. Step 8: Stir and cover for another 10 to 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Chickpea And Sweet Potato Koftas Reduced Fat
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, chickpeas, garlic clove, scallions, cumin seeds, fresh ginger, salt, fresh lemon juice, fresh ground black pepper, unbleached white flour, peas, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice the sweet potato or yam, and cook it in boiling water until soft. Step 2: Drain well You should have about 1 1 / 2 cups of cooked sweet potato. Step 3: Transfer to a food processor. Step 4: Add all other ingredients, except the flour, peas, and oil Pure until fairly smooth. Step 5: Transfer to a bowl. Step 6: Stir in the flour until thoroughly incorporated, then gently stir in the peas Form into large or small patties To make them really uniform and professional looking, use a 1 / 4-cup-capacity ice cream scoop or a 1 / 4-cup measure to scoop up portions of the mixture, then pat each one down until it is about 1 / 2-inch thick and 2 1 / 2 inches in diameter.

Ingredient Names: dried garbanzo beans, desiccated unsweetened coconut, fresh ginger, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, vegetable oil, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, coconut milk, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: If using dried chickpeas, soak overnight in plenty of water, then drain. Step 2: Place soaked chickpeas in a large pot with plenty of fresh water, bring to the boil for 15 minutes, then reduce heat and simmer for about an hour, or until chickpeas are tender Alternatively you can pressure-cook the dried chickpeas according to the manufacturer's instructions. Step 3: When the chickpeas are cooked, or if you are using canned chickpeas, put them aside Next, heat a wok or skillet over medium-high heat, and dry-roast the desiccated coconut, reducing heat as necessary- it is important to stir continuously, as the coconut will readily catch and burn As soon as the coconut starts to brown remove the skillet from the heat, and immediately place the coconut in a blender bowl- if left in the skillet it will become dark brown and bitter. Step 4: Add ginger, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder and a little water to the blender bowl and grind to a fine paste. Step 5: Heat the oil in a clean pan and saute mustard seeds until they start to pop and release their aroma. Step 6: Add onion and curry leaves and saute and stir a further minute or two. Step 7: Add coconut paste and cooked chickpeas, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding more water if necessary.

Ingredient Names: canned chick-peas, oil, onion, garlic clove, gingerroot, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric, salt, fresh tomatoes, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a deep saucepan or a medium sized wok and add the oil or butter followed by the onions and garlic. Step 2: Fry the mixture till the onions are caramelised. Step 3: Then add the salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric and red chilli powders. Step 4: Mix for a minute and. Step 5: Cook the sauce until it begins to thicken. Step 6: Add cup of water and stir, then. Step 7: Mash a few of the chickpeas while mixing. Step 8: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 9: Then add the ginger and the garam masala.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, oil, mushroom, onion, garlic clove, fresh ginger, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric, salt, tomatoes, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a deep saucepan and add the oil followed by onions mushrooms and garlic. Step 2: Fry the mixture till the onions are caramelised. Step 3: Then add salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric and red chili powder. Step 4: Mix for a minute and add in the chopped tomato. Step 5: Cook the sauce until it begins to thicken. Step 6: Add 1 / 4 cup of water and stir. Step 7: Add chickpeas and mix. Step 8: Mash a few of the chickpeas while cooking. Step 9: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 10: Then add grated ginger and garam masala.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, curry powder, salt, tomatoes, olive oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions in olive oil for 3 minutes. Step 2: Add ginger, garlic and curry powder, stir and cook for another minute or so. Step 3: Add chickpeas and salt and a tablespoon or so of water. Step 4: Cook and stir about a minute. Step 5: Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring gently. Step 6: Add another spoonful of water if it seems dry or if it's burning or sticking. Step 7: Serve with flatbread and rice.

Dish Name: Chickpea Curry Indian Style Over Basmati Rice
Ingredient Names: vidalia onion, garlic cloves, red chili powder, cumin, curry powder, coriander, chickpeas, lemon, tomato paste, peanut butter, salt, cilantro leaf, basmati rice, butter, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: For the rice: Rinse 1 1 / 2 cups basmati rice in cold water until the rinsing water is no longer cloudy. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp butter to a skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add rice to skillet and toast in butter for a minute or two until fragrant. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 tsp salt and 3 / 4 tsp turmeric and mix into rice Next add 3 cups of water and cover. Step 5: Bring to a slight boil then reduce heat to low and simmer for about 10-12 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and let sit a minute or two Fluff rice with fork, and keep covered until ready to serve For the curry:.

Dish Name: Chickpea Curry With Fresh Dill Rasa Walla Kabuli Chana
Ingredient Names: canola oil, yellow onion, cayenne, coriander seed, garlic, fresh ginger, ground turmeric, tomatoes, fresh dill leaves, chickpeas, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan and saute the onion over medium heat until it has softened, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the cayenne, coriander garlic ginger, and turmeric and stir for 3 to 4 minutes. Step 3: Mix in the tomato and cook until it is soft, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the dill, chickpeas, water, and salt, and simmer until the dill is soft and tender, 5 to 8 minutes. Step 5: Serve warm with rice.

Dish Name: Chickpea Curry With Pumpkin Squash Baby Spinach
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, tomato paste, canned whole tomatoes, canned chick-peas, butternut squash, salt, fresh coriander, baby spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and saut the onion and garlic until soft. Step 2: Add spices and saut one minute, to release flavours. Step 3: Add tomato paste, pureed tomatoes and 1 cup of water, stir well. Step 4: Add the chickpeas and pumpkin and bring to the boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer for around 15 minutes, or until the pumpkin is tender. Step 6: Add the coriander and baby spinach leaves and simmer for a few minutes until leaves just start to wilt. Step 7: Serve with basmati rice, pappadums, and yoghurt or raita.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, salt, onions, garlic cloves, butter, ginger, chopped tomatoes, green onion, tomato paste, potatoes, masala, dry crushed red pepper, garam masala, turmeric, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chickpeas in water. Step 2: Put chickpeas in fresh water with salt, two parts water to one part chickpeas. Step 3: Leave overnight to soak. Step 4: Put chickpeas into a large pot. Step 5: Top up water to maintain 2 parts water to 1 part chickpea ratio if necessary. Step 6: Bring water to a boil. Step 7: Cover and turn down to medium heat, skim off any white foam. Step 8: Leave to simmer until chickpeas are tender, usually 2 or 3 hours, take off heat. Step 9: In a large pot, saut onions and garlic on high heat, then turn down to level 8.

Ingredient Names: grape tomatoes, onions, fresh ginger, curry powder, cumin, olive oil, margarine, diced tomatoes, potatoes, frozen baby peas, chickpeas, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in salted water until tender yet firm. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Saute onion in 1 tablespoons oil until clear. Step 4: Transfer to a food processor along with the tomatoes and fresh ginger, and blend until smooth, set aside. Step 5: In a large saucepan, melt margarine and add the curry powder and cumin. Step 6: Saute for 4-5 minutes over medium heat. Step 7: Stir often to avoid burning. Step 8: Add the tomato mixture and continue to cook for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring often. Step 9: Add the chickpeas, potatoes and frozen peas.

Ingredient Names: garbanzo flour, salt, water, rosemary, extra virgin olive oil, chopped tomatoes, onion, parmesan cheese, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the broiler Sift the chickpea flour with the salt into a medium bowl Slowly add 1 / 4 cup of the water, whisking constantly to form a paste. Step 2: Beat with a wooden spoon until smooth. Step 3: Whisk in the remaining 1 / 4 cup of water and let the batter stand at room temperature for 30 minutes, then stir in the rosemary. Step 4: Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a 12" nonstick ovenproof skillet. Step 5: Stir the batter once, pour it into the skillet and drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil on top. Step 6: Cook the pizza over moderately high heat until the bottom is golden and crisp and the top is almost set, 2 to 3 minutes Burst any large air bubbles with the. Step 7: Sprinkle the tomato, onion, parmesan and pepper over the top, then place the skillet under the broiler and cook until the pizza is golden and crisp, 4 to 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, red onion, fresh ginger, ground cumin, sugar, fresh lemon juice, salt and pepper, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the chickpeas, peppers, onion and ginger together in a large bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle on the cumin, sugar, and lemon juice and mix well. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro, if using, and serve.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, chili flakes, yeast extract, red lentils, coconut cream, broccoli, chickpeas, baby spinach leaves, lemons, sesame seeds, cashews to mix sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Put the onion, garlic, ginger and tomatoes in a food processor or blender and whizz to a purée. Step 2: Heat oil in a large pan. Add the spices, fry for a few secs and add purée and yeast extract. Bubble together for 2 mins, then add lentils and coconut cream. Cook until lentils are tender, then add the broccoli and cook for 4 mins. Stir in chickpeas and spinach, squeeze over lemon and swirl through sesame and cashew mixture. Serve with brown rice, if you like.

Dish Name: Chili Lime Rubbed Indian Corn On The Cob
Ingredient Names: corn, chili powder, salt, lime, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the corn in your favorite way but if a grill is available i absolutely recommend grilling it for the best results and slather with butter. Step 2: In a small dish, mix together the chili powder and salt Grab a lime wedge, dip in the chili mixture and rub over the corn, making sure to squeeze lime juice as doing so Dig in while hot and don't worry about getting messy - just make sure to enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, yogurt, garlic cloves, mint, cilantro, paprika, cumin seed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place cucumber in blender Add the yogurt Add remaining ingredients and process until smooth Chill at least 2-4 hours or overnight.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, tomato juice, fresh ginger, ground coriander, sugar, extra virgin olive oil, fresh lime juice, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper, low-fat plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Blend tomatoes, tomato juice, ginger, coriander, sugar, oil and 3 tbsps Lime juice in a blender. Step 2: Puree on full speed until liquified. Step 3: Pour into a large bowl and season generously with salt and pepper. Step 4: Refrigerate until cold. Step 5: Check taste prior to serving You may add cold water to thin it a bit. Step 6: In a bowl, whisk together yoghurt and the remaining 1 tablespoons lime juice until smooth. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to season Ladle soup into individual serving bowls.

Dish Name: Chilli Paneer Tofu Kofta Naramdil Spicy Soft Hearted Tofu
Ingredient Names: panir, flour, baking powder, salt, white pepper powder, green chili, garam masala, saffron, almonds, green chilies, chili powder, oil, onion paste, garlic paste, ginger paste
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients mentioned above"filling" Leave 1 / 4 of the mixture for the centre filling and make 18-20 balls out of the rest. Step 2: Keep aside I'll call this"white mixture" Likewise, mix all the ingredients mentioned under"filling" and make 18-20 tiny yellow paneer balls. Step 3: Keep aside I'll call this"yellow mixture" Now, flatten the"white mixture" on your palm. Step 4: Place the"yellow mixture" in the centre Close the top and make smooth balls.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, vegetable oil, garlic clove, brown onion, yellow mustard seeds, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, ground turmeric, chopped tomatoes, sultanas, banana peppers, lebanese cucumbers, greek yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180c / 160c fan forced. Step 2: Boil, steam or microwave potatoes until tender and drain. Step 3: Using a fork, crush the potatoes roughly. Step 4: Heat oil in a large frying pan, cook garlic and onion, stirring until onion softens. Step 5: Add spices and cook stirring until fragrant. Step 6: Add undrained tomatoes and cook stirring 5 minutes and then stir in the potatoes and sultanas. Step 7: Make a lenghtway slit in each chilli, stopping 1cm from top and bottom, taking care not to cut all the way through, carefully remove and discard seeds and membranes. Step 8: Divide potato filling among the chilli cavities. Step 9: Place chillies on oiled oven tray, cover and roast for 30 minutes. Step 10: Uncover and roast for a further 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, sun-dried tomato, chickpeas, onion, olive oil, garlic cloves, ground turmeric, cumin, ground chipotle chile pepper, ancho chilies, plum tomatoes, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler Roast bell peppers on a baking sheet under broiler, turning often, until blistered and blackened, about 10 minutes. Step 2: Place in a paper bag, seal and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 3: Remove and discard skin, ribs and seed. Step 4: Puree peppers in a blender or food processor, set aside. Step 5: Soak sun-dried tomatoes in boiling water until softened, about ten minutes. Step 6: Drain, reserving liquid. Step 7: Puree sun-dried tomatoes with 2 tablespoons of the soaking liquid in a food processor or blender, set aside.

Ingredient Names: dutch-processed cocoa powder, sugar, low-fat milk
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients in a blender bowl Cover Process for 2 minutes Pour over ice cubes in a tall glass Serve!

Ingredient Names: sweetened condensed milk, almonds, unsweetened cocoa powder, butter, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a shallow dish with butter. Step 2: Pour condensed milk into a thick-bottomed pan. Step 3: Add butter, sugar, cocoa powder and the chopped nuts into the pan. Step 4: Stir continuously on a low flame till the mixture leaves the sides of the pan. Step 5: Remove from flame and pour evenly into the prepared greased dish. Step 6: Allow to cool and set, and cut into 1 inch squares. Step 7: Store in an airtight tin in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: milk, powdered cocoa mix, vanilla extract, peppermint extract, vanilla ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 2 cup milk just until hot. Step 2: Combine hot milk and cocoa mix in container of electric blender Process until smooth. Step 3: Add remaining 1 1 / 2 cups milk, vanilla and peppermint, blend well. Step 4: Add ice cream and process until mixture is smooth.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, fresh jalapeno, whole cumin seeds, ground coriander, turmeric, ground cumin, tomatoes, fresh ginger, chickpeas, fresh cilantro, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In large deep skillet, saute onions and jalapeno in olive oil. Step 2: Add whole cumin after a few minutes. Step 3: Once onions are soft and slightly brown, add coriander, turmeric and ground cumin Coat onions, add more oil if needed. Step 4: Add tomato and ginger. Step 5: Allow to cook until a gravy like consistency is reached You may need to stir and break up the tomatoes some. Step 6: Drain one of the two cans of chickpeas and add both to the skillet. Step 7: Simmer about 20 minutes I like to add some of the fresh cilantro to the skillet and allow it to wilt in the mix right before serving.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, oil, green chilies, ginger, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, potatoes, salt, mango powder, water, fresh coriander, cinnamon stick, cloves, black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: Mash one teaspoon of the cooked chickpeas. Step 2: Heat oil or ghee in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 3: When heated, add the chopped green chilies and ginger, stir. Step 4: Remove the skillet from the flame and add the red chili powder, turmeric powder and coriander powder. Step 5: Stir, and return the skillet to the flame. Step 6: Add the diced potatoes and saute for about 8 minutes or until the potatoes turn golden brown. Step 7: Now add the cooked chickpeas and salt. Step 8: Saute for a minute, and then add the 1 teaspoon of mashed chickpeas, and mango powder or tamarind pulp. Step 9: Add 1 cup water and bring to a vigourous boil. Step 10: Garnish with chopped coriander and sprinkle with the ground spices.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, green chili, salt, water, onion, garlic, ginger, oil, cumin seed, coriander powder, chili powder, cumin powder, tomatoes, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Soak gram overnight and pressure cook with rest of ingredients till done Grind the paste with water. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok add cumin seeds. Step 3: When they splutter add the ground paste and stir constantly till brown. Step 4: Add coriander, chilli and cumin powder. Step 5: Add tomatoes and fry until oil seperates. Step 6: Add cooked gram and garam masala. Step 7: Simmer for 5-10 minute. Step 8: Garnish with lemon slices.

Ingredient Names: red onion, cucumbers, tomatoes, cilantro, red chile, green chili, lemon juice, oil, black pepper, chaat masala, salted peanuts, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix red onion, cucumber, tomatoes, cilantro, chilli, lemon juice, oil, pepper and chaat masala in a bowl and mix well This could be done some hours in advance as the flavours will improve Just before serving, add the chopped peanuts and taste if extra salt is necessary.

Ingredient Names: butter, orange rind, orange juice concentrate, brown sugar, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything in a blender or mixer Process until smooth. Step 2: Store refrigerated for upto 1 week or frozen for upto 2 months. Step 3: Serve on warm bread toast slices for a quick snack or brunch.

Ingredient Names: water, clove, cinnamon, tea leaves, sugar, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Put water on the heat for boiling alongwith crushed clove and cinnamon powder. Step 2: Cover with a lid tightly so as to retain the flavours. Step 3: Let it boil for good 2 minutes. Step 4: Lower the heat and add tealeaves / teabag. Step 5: Turn the heat off and let it stand. Step 6: Pour in the cup and add sugar and milk Sip sip sip!

Dish Name: Coco Banana's Chickpea Lemon And Ginger Rice
Ingredient Names: long grain brown rice, chickpeas, lemon, onion, fresh ginger, olive oil, water, yellow mustard seeds, curry leaves, black pepper, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot, combine water, rice, curry leaves and chickpeas. Step 2: Bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a frypan, heat the olive oil and add the onion, mustard seeds, ginger and lemon rind. Step 4: Cook until fragrant. Step 5: Add onion mixture to the rice mixture, and add the lemon juice, salt and pepper. Step 6: Discard the curry leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: split peas, olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, seasoning, sea salt, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Begin boiling legume and cook until soft and mushy and absorbed all the water. Step 2: Keep adding more water if necessary. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a fry pan, and combine spices of choice, onion, garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant. Step 4: Add the onion mixture to the legumes and cook on low for 20 minutes or so. Step 5: Stir in the lemon juice and serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, peanut oil, onion, garlic cloves, curry leaves, dried red chili, brown mustard seeds, turmeric, cinnamon stick, cloves, green cardamom pods, fenugreek seeds, asafoetida powder, coconut milk, water
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the lentils well in cold water, then drain. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large, heavy-based, preferably non-stick, saucepan and saute the onion and garlic with the curry leaves, chili and mustard seeds, until golden and fragrant. Step 3: Add the drained lentils, turmeric, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom pods, fenugreek, asafetida powder and coconut milk. Step 4: Mix well, then add the water. Step 5: Bring to the boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer gently for 40 minutes, or longer if necessary. Step 6: Stir occasionally to ensure the dal does not stick to the bottom of the pan You may choose to increase the cooking temperature, and / or partially uncover the dal towards the end of the cooking time, if you prefer your dal with less fluid, rather than 'soupy' When the dal is soft, season to taste with sea salt. Step 7: Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with curry dishes and rice or parathas.

Ingredient Names: coriander, serrano chilies, channa dal, salt, sugar, coconut, plain yogurt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Coriander leaves should be removed from the stem. Step 2: Put all the ingredients in a blender and mix If the ingredients won't mix completely, you will need to add a little more water. Step 3: Serve with samosas or on the side with a curry.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, curry leaves, black mustard seeds, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, ground cumin, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, coconut milk, eggplant, cauliflower, red bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan heat oil over medium heat for one minute and add curry leaves and mustard seeds Wait until they start to sizzle and them sizzle for approximately 30 seconds or until a few start to pop The curry leaves will cook and become shriveled Immediately add garlic and onions Saut until onions are golden brown. Step 2: Add the tomatoes and the powdered spices Continue to saute until the oil separates from the tomato masala. Step 3: Add the coconut milk. Step 4: Bring to a light boil, add eggplant, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the remaining vegetables, cover the pan and cook to taste, approximately 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Coconut Curried Vegetables Adapted From Vij's
Ingredient Names: canola oil, curry leaves, black mustard seeds, onion, garlic, tomatoes, ground cumin, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, coconut milk, eggplant, cauliflower, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan heat oil over medium heat for one minute and add curry leaves and mustard seeds Wait until they start to sizzle and them sizzle for approximately 30 seconds or until a few start to pop The curry leaves will cook and become shriveled Immediately add garlic and onions Saut until onions are golden brown. Step 2: Add the tomatoes and the powdered spices Continue to saut until the oil separates from the tomato masala. Step 3: Add the coconut milk. Step 4: Bring to a light boil, add eggplant, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the remaining vegetables, cover the pan and cook to taste, approximately 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, curry powder, sugar, turmeric, garlic powder, onion powder, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, chicken base, molasses, water, light coconut milk, jasmine rice, roasted peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in medium saucepan on medium heat. Step 2: Add curry powder and sugar. Step 3: Cook and stir 30 seconds. Step 4: Pour water and coconut milk into saucepan, bring to boil. Step 5: Stir in rice, turmeric, garlic, onion, chicken base, and molasses, return to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to low. Step 7: Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes or until rice is tender, remove from heat.

Dish Name: Coconut Curry With Cauliflower Carrots Chickpeas
Ingredient Names: coconut, carrots, onion, cauliflower, curry powder, crushed red pepper flakes, vegetables, chickpeas, salt, coconut milk, lime, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet heat the oil to medium-high heat. Step 2: Add sliced carrots, onions, and cauliflower pieces. Step 3: Saute, stirring frequently, until the onions become translucent. Step 4: Stir in curry powder and crushed red pepper flakes, and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add broth, chickpeas, and salt. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add coconut milk and lime zest / juice. Step 8: Let it simmer, uncovered for a couple of minutes, stir in mint. Step 9: Serve on hot rice with yogurt on top.

Ingredient Names: yellow split peas, light coconut milk, low sodium vegetable broth, yellow onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, turmeric, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except for cilantro in saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Simmer uncovered about 30 minutes, or until peas are tender and it begins to thicken. Step 3: Serve over brown rice and garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, bay leaves, curry leaf, rice, peas, coconut milk, salt, cilantro, mint, green chilies, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, add shallots, bay leaves, curry leaves and rice, and stir over medium heat until the rice turns translucent. Step 2: Add the coconut milk, salt and peas and bring to a boil until most of the liquid is absorbed. Step 3: Reduce heat to very low, cover, and cook for a few more minutes, being vigilant that the rice does not scald at the bottom. Step 4: Remove bay and curry leaves and stir in the cilantro, mint and chilies Fluff up with a fork, garnish with lime wedges if desired and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: coconut, bengal gram dal, green chilies, water, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a small frying pan, take 1 / 2 tsp oil and fry the chickpeas till it turns slightly brown. Step 2: After it cools, grind it with grated coconut, green chillies and salt in a mixer Slowly add water while grinding The consistency of the mixture should be akin to that of ketchup. Step 3: Now, in the same frying pan, heat the remaining 1 / 2 tsp of oil, add the mustard seeds, split black gram and curry leaves. Step 4: When the mustard sputters, add this to the ground coconut mixture. Step 5: Serve this chutney with idlis or dosas.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, hot water, coconuts, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix in the salt to the rice flour and knead with hot water to form a soft dough. Step 2: Mix the coconut with the sugar / jaggery. Step 3: Make medium sized balls of the dough. Step 4: Take each ball and flatten them in the well of your palm, spoon in a little of the coconut mix and close it in to make a ball again Do the rest. Step 5: Steam these balls until cooked, serve hot!

Ingredient Names: rice, coconut milk, onion, ginger, tomatoes, bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon stick, turmeric powder, pepper, cashews, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Fry onions which are cut into rings till they are crisp, keep aside, now heat oil. Step 2: Add the bay leaf, cinnamon stick and cloves. Step 3: Then add the chopped onions and ginger till soft. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add turmeric powder and pepper. Step 6: Now add rice and salt. Step 7: Pour in the coconut milk, allow to boil.

Ingredient Names: yams, onion, garlic cloves, low-fat soymilk, curry powder, black pepper, vegetable bouillon cube, cilantro, butter, light coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Chop onions and garlic and saut in butter in a large saucepan until onions are translucent but not brown. Step 2: Meanwhile puree yams one at a time in a blender with cup soymilk each and add to saucepan. Step 3: Add bouillon, curry powder, pepper and coconut milk and heat until bouillon is incorporated, five to ten minutes. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan bread or rycrisp.

Ingredient Names: cashews, olive oil, shallots, red bell pepper, peas, curry powder, lemon, coriander, turmeric, salt, green chilies, garlic cloves, ginger, unsweetened coconut milk, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the shallots, red bell pepper, and peas in the olive oil or butter, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Step 2: Add the curry, lemon, turmeric, chiles, garlic, ginger, and salt, and cook until fragrant, 5-10 minutes more. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and simmer until thickened, another 5-10 minutes, serve with rice. Step 4: Garnish with more cilantro, if desired.

Dish Name: Complete Milkshake Tonic For Growing Kids
Ingredient Names: milk, banana, brewer's yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients in a blender bowl Cover Process until smooth Give this to growing kids daily This is a complete tonic for them.

Ingredient Names: cilantro, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, white onion, red pepper, lemon, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Chop cilantro, cucumber, onion, pepper. Step 2: Cut grape tomatoes in half. Step 3: Combine everything in bowl. Step 4: Squeeze half the lemon in bowl. Step 5: Squeeze the whole lime in bowl. Step 6: Mix everything together.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, fresh mint leaves, cucumber, cumin powder, red chili powder, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all the ingredients together in a large bowl and blend till mixed well Chill well and serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves, green chilies, black salt, sugar, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Put the coriander and mint leaves alongwith the green chillies and a little water in your mixer and process until you have a smooth paste. Step 2: Remove from mixer into a serving bowl. Step 3: Add salt and sugar. Step 4: Stir in lemon juice. Step 5: Serve alongside cutlets, kebabs, etc Or as a sandwich spread Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: frozen peas, frozen corn, butter, salt, pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first five ingredients in a pan. Step 2: Add water to barely cover these veggies, bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover and cook on medium flame for 15 minutes. Step 4: Serve warm with rotis Enjoy!

Dish Name: Corn Flakes Chivda Spicy Indian Snack Mix
Ingredient Names: oil, cumin seed, peanuts, golden raisin, red chili powder, turmeric powder, kosher salt, sugar, lime juice, corn flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds Wait until they sizzle, then toss in the raisins and nuts, stir a minute. Step 2: Keep on very low heat and stir in the chili powder, turmeric powder, salt and sugar. Step 3: Mix in the lime juice, keeping your face averted because the oil will splatter. Step 4: Finally gently fold in the cornflakes over low heat for about 3-4 minutes until the cornflakes are well coated with the spice blend. Step 5: Cool completely before storing in an airtight container at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, peppercorns, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom, onion, fenugreek leaves, sweet corn, turmeric powder, butter, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice and keep it aside. Step 2: In a vessel add 2cups of water and bring it to a boil. Step 3: Heat butter and oil in a pressure cooker, add in the peppercorns, dalcini, laung, elaichi and onion and fry for some time. Step 4: Then add methi leaves, corns and haldi powder and stir for a few seconds. Step 5: Finally, add the rice and 2 cups of hot water along with salt and perssure cook for 1 whistle. Step 6: Allow the steam to escape before opening. Step 7: Serve hot with fresh curds and papad.

Ingredient Names: corn, spinach, onion, rice, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick, cloves, green cardamoms, turmeric powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Warm oil. Step 2: Add peppercorns, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, stir for a minute. Step 3: Add onions& turmeric and fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the corn, spinach and salt and mix well, add rice, mix again. Step 5: Add 2 cups of hot water and let it come to a boil. Step 6: Put a lid and let cook on very low heat for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sliced mushrooms, spring onions, curry powder, mango chutney, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the olive oil and curry powder. Step 2: Stir in the mango chutney. Step 3: Allow to cool and mix with the mayo Use to fill sandwiches or jacket potatoes.

Dish Name: Cottage Cheese In Spinach Gravy Palak Paneer
Ingredient Names: cottage cheese, baby spinach, butter, cumin seed, onions, green chili peppers, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, coriander powder, tomatoes, water, salt, garam masala powder, heavy cream, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the stems from the spinach, blanch them in hot water and grind them into a fine paste. Step 2: Add butter in a heavy bottomed vessel and add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Step 3: Add finely onions and green chili saute them till light brown Dont burn them Mean while shallow fry cottage cheese cubes in 1 tbsp of oil slightly brown. Step 4: Add ginger garlic paste and fry further for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add red chili powder and coriander powder and combine well. Step 6: Blend the tomatoes, add the tomato paste and let it cook for 5-6 min on medium heat. Step 7: Add the spinach paste and let it cook further for another 4-5 minute. Step 8: Add the fried cottage cheese cubes and combine.

Ingredient Names: cottage cheese, gram flour, ginger-garlic paste, fresh green chilies, red chili powder, turmeric powder, onion, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put the grated cottage cheese in a bowl. Step 2: Add the gramflour, green chillies, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt to taste and the chopped onions. Step 3: Mix extremely well. Step 4: Make round balls, about 1 inch in diameter, out of the mixture Gently, flatten all the balls. Step 5: Heat oil in a flat frying pan. Step 6: Place the flattened balls on the pan Shallow fry the balls on either side till they turn golden brown. Step 7: Drain on clean paper towels. Step 8: Serve hot with tomato ketchup or coriander and mint chutney.

Dish Name: Courgette And Green Pepper Sabzi Tori Aur Hari Mirch Ki Sabzi
Ingredient Names: olive oil, asafoetida powder, cumin seed, brown mustard seeds, courgettes, green pepper, natural yogurt, ground coriander, salt, chaat masala
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the oil into a large pan or wok and set over a medium-high heat. Step 2: When the oil is hot, put in first the asafetida and then, in quick succession, the cumin and mustard seeds As soon as the mustard seeds begin to pop, a matter of seconds, add the courgette and the green pepper. Step 3: Stir and fry for five minutes. Step 4: Add the yoghurt, and cook, stirring, until it has been absorbed. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low and add the coriander and salt Sir for a minute. Step 6: Add the chaat masala and toss. Step 7: Taste for balance of flavours.

Ingredient Names: orange lentils, oil, mustard seeds, cumin seed, dried red chilies, curry leaves, turmeric, cayenne pepper, coriander powder, chopped tomato, salt, tamarind juice
Instructions: Step 1: Wash dal thoroughly, boil the dal, set aside. Step 2: In a separate frying pan, heat oil. Step 3: Add mustard, cummin seeds, dry red chillies and curry leaves when the oil is hot. Step 4: Lower the heat and put in the cayenne pepper, turmeric, coriander powder add chopped tomatoes and cook this on slightly higher heat adding a little water as necessary. Step 5: Add tamarind juice and add this mixture to the boiled dal. Step 6: Bring it all to a boil.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, onions, red pepper powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, sunflower oil, indian spicy mango pickle
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a big heavy bottomed skillet Do not smoke the same. Step 2: Lower the heat and add salt, red pepper powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and 2 pieces of indian mango picky take care not to burn the spices Immediately add zucchini pieces and start sauteing over high heat. Step 3: Keep tossing gently for 10 minutes. Step 4: Lower the heat and cover the lid for 5 minutes Open and saute on high heat again for 5 minutes letting the zucchini go brown on the edges. Step 5: Take out the zucchini carefully in the serving dish with a spoon leaving the excess oil in the skillet. Step 6: Put onions in the left oil and brown over high heat for 5-7 minutes. Step 7: Spread the onions over zucchini.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic cloves, red curry paste, chickpeas, coconut milk, soy sauce, tomatoes, brown sugar, fresh lime juice, fresh basil, cooked jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over a medium high heat. Step 2: Add onions and cook until they start to brown. Step 3: Add garlic and curry. Step 4: Stir-fry until garlic is soft and curry dissolved. Step 5: Add chickpeas, coconut milk, and soy sauce. Step 6: Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes. Step 7: Add tomatoes, sugar, and lime juice. Step 8: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 9: Stir in basil or cilantro until combined, and serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, onion, garlic cloves, celery ribs, diced tomatoes, red curry paste, vegetable broth, coconut milk, milk, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put cauli, onion, garlic, celery, tomatoes, water and curry paste in a large pot. Step 2: Bring to a boil and simmer until all ingredients are well cooked. Step 3: Using an immersion blender, puree all ingredients to desired smoothness and return to heat. Step 4: Lower temperature and add milk and coconut milk. Step 5: Heat through and serve.

Ingredient Names: onion, minced garlic cloves, gingerroot, sunflower oil, whole milk, half-and-half cream, coconut milk, tomato paste, curry powder, cumin, paprika, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Gently heat sunflower oil in a large pan. Step 2: Add onion and stir over high heat for 5 minutes until soft. Step 3: Add ginger and garlic, stir for 30 secs, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add tomato paste, cream, coconut milk and milk. Step 5: Bring to boil, stirring continually, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add spices, salt and sugar, stir them in well and then simmer for a further 15 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat, allow to cool slightly then liquidize in a blender.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, lentils, turmeric powder, ghee, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, cloves, cardamom pods, cumin seeds, onion, garlic cloves, salt, lemon juice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice and lentils in several changes of water, and let soak for 1-4 hours, drain. Step 2: Add enough water to cover the lentils and rice by 1 inch, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and add turmeric and salt. Step 4: Cover and let simmer on low heat until rice and lentils are tender, about 30mins. Step 5: Keep checking to see if water needs replenishing, you don't want it to dry out. Step 6: Stir often so it doesn't stick at the bottom. Step 7: Keep adding water till rice is overcooked and you have a thick porridge-like consistency. Step 8: In a small saucepan, heat ghee and then add the cinnamon stick, bay leaves, cloves, cardamom and cumin seeds. Step 9: When they are fragrant and splutter, add the onion and garlic and cook till onion is softened.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, potatoes, carrots, celery, garlic cloves, soy sauce, ground cumin, ground cayenne pepper, chili powder, turmeric, white pepper, fresh dill, heavy cream, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in the bottom of a large pot. Step 2: Add onion and saut until onion is somewhat translucent. Step 3: Add potato cubes and cook, stirring frequently, until cubes are slightly browned, add water, bring to a boil. Step 4: Add carrots, garlic, and celery. Step 5: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for twenty minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Step 6: Remove from heat and cool for 5 minutes. Step 7: Puree soup in food processor until smooth. Step 8: Add soy sauce, cream, dried spices, half-and-half and the fresh dill.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions very, yellow mustard seeds, madras curry paste, raw beetroot, green chili, tomatoes, ground almonds, low-fat yogurt, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan, stir in the onions and cook for 8 mins until soft. Tip in the mustard seeds and cook for 1 min until toasted. Stir through the curry paste and sizzle for 3 mins. Step 2: Mix the beetroot through the spicy onions, then add the chilli, tomatoes and 2 cans of water. Cover and simmer for 30 mins, stirring occasionally, until the beetroot is tender. Remove the lid, turn up the heat and cook until the sauce is thick. Step 3: Take off the heat, then stir through the almonds, yogurt and some seasoning. Top with yogurt and serve with basmati rice, if you like.

Ingredient Names: mustard seed, cumin seeds, olive oil, onions, garlic, ginger, cardamom pods, red lentils, reduced-fat coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, on a low heat, toast the mustard and cumin seeds until they give off a nutty aroma; be careful not to burn them. Set aside in a bowl. In the same pan, heat the oil over a low heat and soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the cardamom pods for 10 mins, adding a little water if they look like they might burn. Step 2: Tip the lentils and toasted seeds into the pan, then stir for a couple of mins before pouring in the coconut milk and enough water to cover it all well. Bring to the boil, immediately cover the pan, turn it down to a low heat and leave to simmer for about 45 mins, stirring every now and then to make sure the mixture is not sticking. If it starts to become too thick, add a little more water. Serve with warmed pitta bread.

Dish Name: Creme De Menthe Chocolate Vanilla Drink
Ingredient Names: andes mints candies, low-fat milk, coffee syrup, vanilla ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Put everything in a blender Cover and process until smooth Pour into a tall glass, add a straw and sip away!

Ingredient Names: okra, plain low-fat yogurt, cayenne pepper, cumin powder, coriander powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan, add okra and shallow fry on very low heat for about 30 mins, tossing occasionally, till the okra looses its water content and becomes dark brown and crisp. Step 2: Add cumin and coriander powder and fry for another 5 mins, add cayenne pepper and salt, toss and fry for another minute or so. Step 3: Take pan off the heat, let it cool slightly, the okra should now be crunchy Whip the yogurt to a smooth consistency, add okra from the pan and mix nicely. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: low-sodium tamari, garlic cloves, lemon juice, orange juice concentrate, tamarind paste, ketchup, fresh ginger, curry powder, garam masala, molasses, cornstarch, cold water, extra firm tofu, sunflower seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tamari, garlic, lemon juice, orange juice, tamarind paste, ketchup, ginger, curry powder, garam masala, and molasses in a small saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a rolling simmer. Step 3: Combine cornstarch and cold water With the sauce simmering slowly, whisk in diluted cornstarch. Step 4: Simmer sauce for one minute, then remove the pan from the heat. Step 5: When tofu is ready, cut it into 1-inch squares, coat it in marinade and marinate for two hours in the refrigerator. Step 6: Preheat the oven to 400f. Step 7: Roll the tofu cubes in sunflower seeds until well coated. Step 8: Place the tofu on a lightly oiled baking pan. Step 9: Bake for about 25 minutes, or until deep golden brown, turning the pan once during the cooking process.

Ingredient Names: spinach, sesame seeds, green chilies, salt, sugar, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Separate spinach leaves from stems and wash in plenty of water Dry leaves completely and slice into fine shreds make sure the leaves are completely dry dry roast sesame seeds for a few minutes till lightly coloured. Step 2: Place sesame seeds, chopped green chillies, salt and sugar in separate bowls close to the stove. Step 3: Line a colander with absorbent paper and place it close by. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or deep frying pan till smoking hot. Step 5: Add a handful of spinach shreds and fry for a few seconds till spinach turns bright green. Step 6: Remove from oil with a slotted spoon and place in the colander Quickly sprinkle on a few sesame seeds, some green chillies, salt and sugar and toss to coat the spinach with the flavorings Continue cooking remaining spinach in the same way. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, rotel tomatoes & chilies, kidney beans, white onions, olive oil, curry powder, cayenne, cardamom, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a saucepan or skillet. Step 2: Add spices, saute for 1 minute or so. Step 3: Add onions and saute for 2 - 5 minutes. Step 4: Add both cans of rotel. Step 5: Pour mixture into crockpot. Step 6: Add potatoes and canned beans to crockpot. Step 7: Allow to crock on low for 6 - 9 hours or on high for 3 - 5 hours, depending on your crockpot. Step 8: Serve over rice or with makki di roti.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Southwestern Pumpkin Soup Aka Korma Soup
Ingredient Names: whole cloves, coriander seeds, green peppercorn, ground cumin, dried ancho chile powder, dried chipotle powder, ground cinnamon, garlic powder, ground nutmeg, vegetable stock, half-and-half, evaporated milk, pumpkin puree, pure maple syrup, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a hot skillet, toast the cloves, coriander seeds, and peppercorns. Step 2: Add the ground spices to the whole ones in the skillet- the cumin, chile powders, cinnamon, garlic powder, and nutmeg, and toast the mixture over high heat, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minutes or until the spices begin to smoke. Step 3: Remove from heat, let cool, and grind together to a powder, set aside. Step 4: Pour the stock, half and half, and evaporated milk into the crock pot. Step 5: Stir well, cover, and turn on high. Step 6: Put the pureed pumpkin into a large bowl, then add the maple syrup, salt, and the now-powdered spice mixture Use a whisk to incorporate the mixture well. Step 7: Add the pumpkin mixture to the liquids in the crock pot, whisking it well to make sure there are no lumps. Step 8: Cover and let simmer on high for 2 to 3 hours.

Ingredient Names: fat free cream cheese, fat-free flour tortillas, lettuce leaves, alfalfa sprout, red cabbage, chopped tomato, blue cheese, red onions
Instructions: Step 1: Spread 1 tablespoon cream cheese over each tortilla. Step 2: Top each with a lettuce leaf. Step 3: Divide sprouts and remaining ingredients evenly among tortillas, roll up. Step 4: Cut each rolled wrap in half diagonally.

Dish Name: Cucumber And Fennel With Orange Mint Dressing
Ingredient Names: cucumber, fennel bulb, granny smith apple, fresh lemon juice, walnuts, fresh orange juice, walnut oil, of fresh mint, cilantro, mild paprika, salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the cucumber, fennel, apple, and lemon juice in a serving bowl and gently mix. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk the orange juice through paprika until emulsified. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and pour over salad. Step 4: Serve immediately or marinade covered, in refrigerator for 1-2 hours. Step 5: Toss before serving and garnish with toasted nuts.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, red onion, plain nonfat yogurt, garlic, of fresh mint, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: Slice cucumber halves into thin half-moons Blot off moisture with paper towels. Step 2: Put veggies in a bowl. Step 3: Mix yogurt, garlic, and mint together and add to veggies, toss to coat. Step 4: Sprinkle with pepper, if desired. Step 5: Chill before serving.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, onion, garlic, tomatoes, yogurt, salt, roasted cumin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Strain yoghurt of excess water for approximately 1 hour Peel and deseed cucumber Salt the cucumber and leave aside for 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain excess water and dice finely Deseed tomato and dice finely Finely dice onions or, optionally, crush garlic cloves. Step 3: Mix all of the above with the yoghurt Roast cumin seeds until brown and add to the raita. Step 4: Serve chilled, preferably leave in the fridge for a couple of hours for the ingredients to blend.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, ground cumin, of fresh mint, fresh coriander, green chili, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the yogurt, ground cumin, mint, coriander, ginger and chilli Season well and sprinkle with cumin seeds.

Ingredient Names: rice, curds, milk, curry leaves, red chilies, cumin seed, black mustard seeds, asafoetida powder, oil, cashews, bengal gram dal, salt, sugar, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice and keep aside. Step 2: Beat curd and milk together. Step 3: Add salt and sugar and keep aside. Step 4: Now heat oil in a pan. Step 5: Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds and chana dal and wait till the dal turns light brown. Step 6: Now add chilli, hing, cashews and curry leaves and allow these to sizzle, add to the curd. Step 7: Add in the cooked rice, mix well. Step 8: Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with my favourite, sindhi papad!

Ingredient Names: couscous, vegetable bouillon cube, frozen green pea, walnut oil, cashews, curry powder, fresh ginger, turmeric, raisins, green onions, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine couscous with 2 cups water and bouillon cube in a large skillet or stir-fry pan. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, cover and let stand off the heat for 5 to 10 minutes or until water has been absorbed. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients, stir together, then cook, stirring often, for 2 to 3 minutes longer. Step 4: Transfer to serving bowl and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, water, butter, flour, curry, milk, salt and pepper, cashews, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 and grease a 1 5 qt casserole dish Microwave cauliflower with water and nuke for 4 minutes. Step 2: Drain You could also steam the cauliflower if you choose. Step 3: In a small saucepan, melt 2 tbs of the butter. Step 4: Stir in flour and curry and cook for about 2 minutes It will make a thick paste. Step 5: Whisk in milk and cook a few minutes, whisking periodically until the lumps disappear and the sauce starts to thicken. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, cauliflower florets, curry powder, garbanzo beans, rotel, unsweetened coconut milk, garam masala, ground cumin, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large saute pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and saut until golden brown. Step 3: Add cauliflower, curry powder, and garbanzo beans, stir. Step 4: Add rotel, coconut milk, garam masala, cumin, and ginger. Step 5: Heat to medium-high, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and boil gently until cauliflower is tender and liquid thickens slightly, stirring occasionally, about 16 minutes. Step 7: Season to taste with salt, if desired. Step 8: Serve with crusty bread or over rice.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, curry powder, tomatoes, cauliflower, chickpeas, salt, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and curry powder, cook and stir for a few minutes to soften the onion. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes break down and soften, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the cauliflower, chickpeas, and 3 / 4 cup of water. Step 5: Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the cauliflower is tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Step 6: Uncover, and continue cooking until the excess moisture has evaporated and the cauliflower and chickpeas are coated with a thick sauce. Step 7: Season with salt, to taste, and garnish with cilantro before serving. Step 8: Serve over a bed of rice.

Dish Name: Curried Cauliflower And Potatoes Aloo Gobi
Ingredient Names: hot green chili peppers, gingerroot, cumin seed, black mustard seeds, ghee, potatoes, cauliflower, tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, garam masala, brown sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chilies, ginger, cumin seeds and mustard seeds in a small bowl. Step 2: Heat ghee in a large pot. Step 3: When hot, add the spices. Step 4: When the mustard seeds start to pop, drop in the potatoes & cauliflower. Step 5: Fry for 4 minutes or so. Step 6: Add the tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, garam masala, sugar, salt and half the coriander. Step 7: Mix well, cover and gently heat for 15 minutes If the vegetables start to stick, add a few drops of water. Step 8: Top with remaining coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, mushrooms, grape tomatoes, garlic cloves, salt, cumin, curry, garam masala, black pepper, cilantro, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up enough vegetable oil to cover the bottom of the pan and heat until very hot. Step 2: Saute mushrooms and garlic with some cumin. Step 3: Add the cauliflower, tomatoes, salt, and curry powder. Step 4: Mix well and cover. Step 5: Check and stir every now and then. Step 6: Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Step 7: Turn off heat when the cauliflower softens and tomatoes have reduced to sauce. Step 8: Add garam masala, black pepper and cilantro. Step 9: Mix well and cover until serving, at least 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Curried Chickpeas And Black Beans Low Fat
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, ginger, curry powder, diced tomatoes, salt, black beans, chickpeas, fresh cilantro, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large, non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and ginger and saute about 3 minutes, or until tender. Step 3: Add curry powder and stir to coat onions evenly. Step 4: Add tomatoes with their juices and cook 1-2 minutes or until mixture seems slightly thickened, stirring well. Step 5: Add black beans, chickpeas and salt to taste. Step 6: Stir to coat beans evenly. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes or until chickpeas are heated through. Step 8: Turn off heat, and stir in fresh cilantro, and lemon juice. Step 9: Serve warm This dish goes nicely over some jasmine or basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, chickpeas, curry paste, garlic, minced ginger, ground cumin, turmeric, baby spinach, plain yogurt, tomato paste, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients except spinach in slow cooker, stir well and set for 8 hours cooking time on low At 30 minutes, add in 3 cups spinach, and stir well to mix At 7 hours 40 minutes, add yogurt, and stir well. Step 2: When done, serve over saffron rice, garlic naan or pappadums.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, ground cayenne pepper, ground cardamom, ground cumin, ground coriander, curry powder, ground turmeric, brown mustard seeds, fresh cilantro, water, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: If you are using dry chickpeas, soak and cook them, according to the package directions If you are using canned chickpeas, drain and rinse them. Step 2: In a 2 quart saucepan, saute onion, garlic, pepper, cardamom, cumin, coriander, curry powder, turmeric, and mustard seeds in oil. Step 3: When the onions are soft, add the cilantro Adding water as necessary, stir constantly to cook the cilantro, about 1-2 minutes, add chickpeas. Step 4: Stir and cook until heated through, about 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Serve over brown rice.

Ingredient Names: couscous, unsalted butter, boiling water, plain yogurt, olive oil, white wine vinegar, curry powder, ground turmeric, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, carrot, parsley, dried currant, blanched almond, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Pour couscous in a large bowl, melt butter in the boiling water and pour over couscous. Step 2: Cover tightly and set aside for 5 minutes. Step 3: In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, olive oil, vinegar, curry powder, turmeric, salt and pepper Fluff the couscous with a fork and pour the curry mixture on top, mixing well. Step 4: Add the carrots, parsley, currants, almonds, scallions, and red onions. Step 5: Mix well and adjust seasonings. Step 6: Serve at room temperature.

Dish Name: Curried Egg Salad Sandwich On Raisin Bread
Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, mayonnaise, coconut, green onion, curry powder, salt, cracked black pepper, hard-boiled eggs, cashews, baby spinach leaves, raisin bread
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the yogurt, mayonnaise, coconut, green onion, curry powder, salt and black pepper. Step 2: Stir in eggs and cashews. Step 3: Divide and spread the egg salad mixture between four slices of raisin bread. Step 4: Add the spinach leaves and top with the other four bread slices. Step 5: Serve with fresh sliced mangoes and papayas!

Dish Name: Curried Egg Salad With Caramelized Onions
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, salt, sugar, fresh ground black pepper, hard-cooked eggs, red onion, red bell peppers, mayonnaise, cilantro, serrano chili, madras curry powder, prepared mustard, spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Caramelize the onion: heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the sliced onion and salt and saut for 3 to 5 minutes, until the onion becomes translucent. Step 3: Add the sugar and black pepper and cook until the onion is golden brown, divide the onions. Step 4: Set aside until the rest of the salad is ready. Step 5: In a large bowl, mash the boiled eggs with a fork. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 the caramelized onions diced and bell pepper and mix well. Step 7: Add the 1 / 3 diced onion. Step 8: In a separate bowl, combine the mayonnaise, cilantro or parsley, chili, curry powder, and salt to taste, mix well.

Ingredient Names: peach halves in syrup, pear halves in natural juice, pineapple rings, maraschino cherries, butter, brown sugar, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Drain fruit well on paper towels. Step 2: Melt butter with sugar and curry and cook for 1 minute. Step 3: Pour the butter mixture over the fruit in a covered, oven-proof dish. Step 4: Bake covered for 1 hour at 325 degrees.

Ingredient Names: garbanzo beans, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, red chili powder, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, garlic, ground ginger, lemon juice, fresh cilantro, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In 1 / 2 inch of water, stir the spices and heat for a few minutes. Step 2: Stir in the garbanzos and just enough water to barely cover them. Step 3: Stir well, mash a few with a potato masher or fork. Step 4: Cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes, or until the sauce is thickened, stir often, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in the lemon juice, the cilantro and tomato. Step 6: Taste and correct seasonings if desired.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, mustard seeds, crushed red pepper flakes, shallot, garbanzo beans, turmeric, ground cumin, ground ginger, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Fry mustard seeds in oil until they begin to pop. Step 3: Add red pepper flakes and shallot and saute until shallot is soft. Step 4: Add garbanzos, turmeric, cumin, ginger, salt and enough water to prevent sticking. Step 5: Simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

Dish Name: Curried Greens By Dr Andrew Weil
Ingredient Names: spinach, garlic cloves, curry powder, tomatoes, tomato paste, dark brown sugar, canola oil, onion, potato, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and drain greens, removing any coarse stems and midribs. Step 2: Cut into half-inch strips. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix together the garlic, curry powder, tomatoes, tomato paste and sugar. Step 4: Heat the canola oil in a skillet and saut onion over medium-high heat until it begins to brown. Step 5: Add the spice-and-tomato mixture, mix well, and cook for a few minutes. Step 6: Add the potatoes and 2 cups water. Step 7: Mix well, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add greens and cook for 10 minutes more, or until potatoes are done Correct seasoning to taste. Step 9: Garnish with the chopped fresh cilantro if desired.

Ingredient Names: carrots, celery, potatoes, onion, garlic, butter, curry powder, tomato puree, vegetable stock, red lentils, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Gently melt the butter in a heavy saucepan Gently fry the onions and garlic until transparent. Step 2: Add the other vegetables and gently fry for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the curry powder and fry for a further 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the lentils, tomato puree and the vegetable stock and cook for approximately 20 minutes until all the ingredients are cooked Just before serving add the fresh coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, carrot, yellow onion, potato, red bell pepper, garlic, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, curry powder, cayenne pepper, brown lentils, peanut butter, breadcrumbs, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Lightly spray a 9x5 loaf pan with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add carrot, onion, potato, pepper and garlic, and cook until vegetables begin to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, curry powder, cayenne and salt, and mix well. Step 5: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until the vegetables are soft, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Turn off heat and stir in the lentils place 1 cup of the lentil / vegetable mixture with the peanut butter in a blender or food processor, and blend until smooth. Step 7: Fold this into the remaining lentil and vegetable mixture, along with the bread crumbs. Step 8: Taste and see if more salt is needed, then add mixture to the loaf pan. Step 9: Bake loaf until firm, about 40-50 minutes.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, of fresh mint, basmati rice, olive oil, onion, curry powder, minced ginger, ground cumin, brown lentils, vegetable stock, kosher salt, tomatoes, red chili pepper flakes, lemon juice, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Mix mint and yogurt and refrigerate. Step 2: Wash rice in warm water until the water runs clear. Step 3: Add olive oil, onion, curry, ginger and cumin to the rice cooker. Step 4: Cook 4-5 minutes, stirring, to soften the onions. Step 5: Add lentils and stir to coat. Step 6: Add the broth, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Step 7: Add remaining ingredients, except spinach, and continue to cook until rice cooker swithches to "warm" function Carefully lift cover, then quickly stir in the spinach and re-cover. Step 8: Allow to stand for 10 minutes The rice should have an attractive, light brown crusting on the bottom.

Ingredient Names: lentils, olive oil, garlic cloves, spinach leaves, canned plum tomatoes, tamari, curry powder, ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Wash lentils. Step 2: Cook till tender but firm. Step 3: Heat olive oil in large pot & when hot add garlic Sautee for 1 minute. Step 4: Add spinach leaves & steam till they wilt. Step 5: Add lentils & rest of ingredients. Step 6: Cover & simmer for 15 minutes, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Curried Lentils With Sweet Potatoes And Spinach
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, curry powder, fresh ginger, ground cumin, dried lentils, broth, sweet potato, baby spinach leaves, salt, plain yogurt, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a medium pot. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and saute until soft About 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in curry powder, ginger and cumin, and cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in lentils and broth. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Step 6: Add sweet potatoes, cover, and cook for 10 minues longer, untiil water is absobed and sweet potatoes are just tender. Step 7: Stir in baby spinach and cook for 1 minute longer, until spinach is just wilted. Step 8: Add salt and adjust seasonings to taste. Step 9: Transfer to bowls and top each with 1 / 4 cup yogurt and 2 tbsp chopped almonds.

Ingredient Names: water, lentils, onion, salt, olive oil, curry powder, plain low-fat yogurt, honey, carrot, fresh parsley leaves, red delicious apple
Instructions: Step 1: In a 2-quart saucepan, heat water, lentils, onion, and 1 / 2 tsp Salt to boiling over medium heat. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and cook, partially covered, until lentils are tender but not mushy-about 30 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, in medium-size skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 4: Add curry and cook 30 seconds. Step 5: Remove from heat and cool 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in yogurt, honey, and remaining 1 / 4 tsp Salt. Step 7: Drain lentil mixture in strainer. Step 8: Transfer to large serving bowl.

Dish Name: Curried Okra Mushrooms And Garbanzo Beans
Ingredient Names: garlic, fresh gingerroot, red chilies, water, safflower oil, coriander seeds, cumin seed, ground cumin, green cardamom pods, ground turmeric, chopped tomatoes, mushroom, garbanzo beans, okra, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For the relish: first you will want to peel your mango and then cut off the flesh from the pit. Step 2: Place the mango in a bowl, and process it with a food processor, or simply mash it with a hand masher, whatever you choose to do. Step 3: Mix in the rest of the ingredients and set aside For the curry: in a clean food processor bowl, place the garlic, ginger, chiles and 3 tablespoons of water, and process until smooth Next, heat your oil in a large saucepan, and add the whole coriander seeds, cumin seeds, and allow them to sizzle for a few seconds, allowing for the flavors to release a bit. Step 4: Then add the ground cumin, the ground cardamom seeds, and turmeric and cook for about a minute or so. Step 5: Then add the garlic paste that you made in the processor, along with the tomatoes and remaining water. Step 6: Stir to mix well, and then add the mushrooms, okra, and garbanzo beans. Step 7: Stir again, and then bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce your heat and then cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: papayas, white vinegar, water, brown sugar, mustard seeds, salt, garam masala, curry powder, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Put a heavy bottomed pan over medium heat and add vinegar, water, sugar and mustard and bring to boil. Step 2: Cook until liquid becomes syrupy. Step 3: Add papayas and curry powder, salt, garam masala. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes more, stirring constantly. Step 5: Remove from heat and mix in onion. Step 6: Cool to the room temperature. Step 7: Pour in jar and refrigerate for 5 days before using.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, curry powder, vegetable broth, tiny peas, plain low-fat yogurt, fresh cilantro, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add 1 onion and saut until tender, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add curry and stir 30 seconds. Step 4: Add 4 cups broth and peas and bring to boil, reduce heat. Step 5: Simmer until peas are very tender, about 15 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Puree in blender in batches Thin with more broth if desired. Step 8: Mix yogurt, cilantro and red onion in small bowl.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, curry powder, olive oil, fresh ginger, onion, cinnamon, cumin, tomatoes, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix together coconut milk, and curry. Step 2: In a saucepan, heat oil over medium. Step 3: Add onion, cinnamon and cumin Saut until onions are soft. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes, peas and coconut milk. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer until peas are tender. Step 6: Serve over rice and pass naan bread.

Ingredient Names: quinoa, green peas, peanut oil, onion, garlic cloves, whole cumin seed, fenugreek leaves, fennel seed, curry powder, turmeric, vegetable broth, head cauliflower, low-fat plain yogurt, raw cashews, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, with a pinch of salt I like to use a large saute pan with a fitted lid, to save on dishes later. Step 2: Add in quinoa and cook until tender, Should be tender but still slightly crunchy While that is cooking, cut up the cauliflower into small florets. Step 3: Place the frozen peas in a colander. Step 4: Drain the boiled quinoa over the peas and set aside If you are making your broth using a powder, try to reserve 1-1 1 / 2 cups of this liquid to prepare your broth. Step 5: Rinse out you pot / pan and dry it, returning it to the stove, and heating the oil over medium-high heat. Step 6: Saute the onion and garlic for about 5 minutes until it starts to become translucent.

Dish Name: Curried Red Kidney Beans And Cauliflower Rajma Masala
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, garlic clove, ginger, fennel, cumin seed, green cardamom pods, cayenne, ground coriander, turmeric, garam masala, plum tomatoes, serrano chili
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed 4- to 5-qt Pot or saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and fry, stirring occasionally, 2 to 3 minutes, or until slightly softened. Step 3: Stir in cinnamon, bay leaf, garlic, ginger, fennel, cumin, and cardamom and fry, stirring, 2 minutes. Step 4: Add cayenne, coriander, turmeric, and garam masala and fry, stirring, 1 minute Shred tomatoes into pot with your fingers. Step 5: Stir in serrano chile, salt, kidney beans, cauliflower, and 1 1 / 2 cups water. Step 6: Lower heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender and liquid has thickened into a velvety-looking sauce. Step 7: Season beans with salt if needed. Step 8: Stir in lemon juice and cilantro.

Dish Name: Curried Red Lentil And Swiss Chard Soup
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, curry powder, cayenne pepper, vegetable broth, swiss chard, dried red lentils, chickpeas, salt, greek yogurt, jalapeno pepper, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium heat, add onion. Step 2: Cook, stirring frequently, until light gold, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Stir in curry and cayenne. Step 4: Add 4 cups broth and chard Increase heat and bring to a boil, stirring, until chard is wilted. Step 5: Stir in lentils and chickpeas, lower heat to low. Step 6: Cover and simmer 16 - 18 minutes, stirring twice, until lentils are tender, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, wine vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, ground cumin, dry mustard, chili powder, cayenne, ground cloves, ground nutmeg, ground cinnamon, dried red lentils, currants, red onions
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, whisk together all ingredients for dressing, set aside, wash lentils. Step 2: Cook in boiling water 5-6 minutes or until just tender. Step 3: Rinse and drain well. Step 4: Add capers, currants and onions to lentils. Step 5: Combine with dressing and let marinate at least 2 hours in the refrigerator before serving Enjoy!

Dish Name: Curried Rice With Cauliflower And Peas
Ingredient Names: butter, minced ginger, curry powder, lemon zest, cauliflower florets, red peppers, green onion, white rice, salt, water, frozen peas, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add ginger, curry powder and lemon zest and stir for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add cauliflower, peppers, onions, rice and salt, stir. Step 4: Add water and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat and cover. Step 6: Cook 15-18 minutes, until water is absorbed and rice is cooked through. Step 7: Stir in peas and black pepper, cover and let sit for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, light olive oil, onion, salt and pepper, garlic cloves, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, ground fenugreek, long-grain white rice, fresh spinach, coconut milk, fresh lemon juice, unsweetened dried shredded coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the stock over low heat. Step 2: In a separate soup pot, heat the oil and add onions, 1 / 2 tsp salt, and a few pinches of pepper. Step 3: Saute the onions over medium heat until tender, about 7-8 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and spices to onions, saute 2 minutes. Step 5: Add rice to onion mixture, and 3 cups of warm stock. Step 6: Cover and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes, until rice is tender. Step 7: Add spinach, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 2 cups of stock, and cook uncovered until spinach is wilted and soft. Step 8: Puree the soup in a blender or food processor and return it to the pot over low heat. Step 9: Add coconut milk, and stock if necessary to reach your desired consistency. Step 10: Add lemon juice and season to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, onions, fresh ginger, garlic, butter, basmati rice, curry powder, salt, de-fatted chicken broth, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Peel squash and cut in half lengthwise. Step 2: Remove and discard seeds. Step 3: Cut squash into 1 / 2- to 3 / 4-inch cubes. Step 4: In a 5- to 6-quart pan over medium heat, frequently stir onions, ginger, and garlic in butter until onions are very limp, 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Add rice and stir often until opaque, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add curry powder and stir for 30 seconds longer. Step 7: Stir in 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, squash, and broth. Step 8: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 9: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice and squash are tender to bite, 16 to 18 minutes.

Dish Name: Curried Sweet Potatoes Cauliflower And Green Beans
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, red bell pepper, flour, curry powder, ground cumin, salt, pepper, sweet potatoes, cauliflower, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and bell pepper. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Sprinkle on flour, curry powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add sweet potatoes and 2 cups water to the skillet. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add cauliflower and green beans, cover, and cook until potatoes are tender and beans are crisp-tender, about 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Curried Sweet Potatoes In Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: sweet potato, salt, onion, fresh gingerroot, garlic clove, vegetable oil, cumin seed, green cardamom pods, bay leaf, peppercorns, cinnamon stick, cayenne pepper, ground coriander, garam masala, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 1 inch cubes. Step 2: Place the cubes in a colander and sprinkle liberally with salt. Step 3: Let stand 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Steam the potatoes for 10 minutes, until just barely soft. Step 5: Meanwhile, finely chop the onion, ginger and garlic. Step 6: Heat the cooking pan over a moderate flame, add the cumin seed, and cook until they begin to splutter. Step 7: Add the chopped onion, ginger, and garlic. Step 8: Cook until the onion is a rich golden color. Step 9: Add all the spices and season with salt to taste. Step 10: Let this cook while you continue with the sweet potatoes.

Dish Name: Curried Sweet Potatoes With Green Peas
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, frozen green peas, tomatoes, curry powder, coconut milk, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Bake or microwave sweet potatoes in their skins until done but still firm Peel and cut into large dice. Step 2: Combine peas and tomatoes in a large saucepan and bring to simmer over medium heat. Step 3: Stir in the sweet potatoes, curry, and coconut milk. Step 4: Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: red lentils, hot water, onion, green chili pepper, vegetable oil, sweet potatoes, mild curry powder, ground cumin, fresh gingerroot, water, cauliflower florets, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, baby spinach, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the lentils well. Step 2: In a saucepan, add water and lentils. Step 3: Cover pan and bring to a boil. Step 4: Lower the heat, uncover the pan, and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender. Step 5: In a big soup pot, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add onion and minced chile. Step 7: Saute for several minutes. Step 8: Add the sweet potatoes, curry powder, cumin, and ginger. Step 9: Saute 2-3 minutes, stirring often. Step 10: Add in the 2 cups of water.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, salt, vegetable oil, water, potatoes, diced onion, minced garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, green peas, carrot, garam masala, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Doough: Mix flour and salt. Step 2: Add oil and mix until flour is like corn meal. Step 3: Add water to dough mixing well This will be a fairly moist dough. Step 4: Knead dough 5 to 10 minutes until dough is soft and velvety. Step 5: Cover and let stand 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Knead again for about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic Form into a long 1 1 / 2" diameter "rope" Cut into 1 1 / 2" slices.

Dish Name: Curried Yellow Split Peas And Cauliflower
Ingredient Names: dried split yellow peas, water, vegetable oil, ground turmeric, curry powder, onion, cauliflower, vegetable stock, green peas, red bell pepper, shredded coconut, raisins, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, combine split peas and water, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Cover pan with lid slightly ajar, reduce heat to low and cook about 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Stir in turmeric, curry powder and onion, and saut, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Add cauliflower florets and 1 cup vegetable stock, and continue cooking and stirring for 7 to 10 minutes more. Step 6: Add split peas, remaining oil and any remaining cooking water to skillet, stirring to combine well. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium- low and add green peas, red pepper and more stock, if needed Continue to cook until split peas are soft, about 5 minutes more. Step 8: Stir in coconut, raisins and salt to taste, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seeds, red chilies, cinnamon, bay leaf, onions, ground turmeric, garlic, chickpeas, paprika, ground coriander, tomatoes, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy-bottomed pan. Fry the cumin, chillies, clove, cinnamon and bay leaf together until the cumin starts to crackle. Tip in the onion, turmeric and a pinch of salt. Cook for 2 mins until starting to soften, then add the garlic. Step 2: Continue cooking 4-5 mins until the onion is soft, then add chickpeas, paprika, black pepper and ground coriander. Give everything a good stir so the chickpeas are well coated in the spices. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and 2 tbsp water. Cook on a medium heat until tomatoes are soft and the sauce is thick and pulpy. Take off the heat and sprinkle on the coriander.

Ingredient Names: tomato, oil, bay leaf, cinnamon, pods black cardamom, javetri, cumin, ginger garlic, onions, salt, cashew paste, dried fenugreek, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, water
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, grind 1 kg of tomatoes to a smooth paste and keep aside.
