Step 2: In a small bowl, take 1 tsp turmeric, 1½ tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tbsp garam masala. Step 3: Prepare a smooth paste by adding ½ cup of water. Keep aside. Step 4: In a large kadai, heat ½ cup oil. Add 4 bay leaf, 2 cinnamon, 1 tsp cloves, 2 pods black cardamom, ½ javetri and 1 tsp cumin. Sauté on a low flame till the spices turn aromatic. Step 5: Add 2 tbsp of ginger-garlic and sauté well. Step 6: Now add 5 onions and sauté until golden brown. Step 7: Further, keep the flame on low and add the prepared masala paste, stirring until well combined. Step 8: Cook till the oil separates from the sides. Step 9: Add the tomato puree and cook until well combined. Step 10: Also, add 2 tbsp of salt and cook until well combined. Be careful as the base starts to splutter. Step 11: Cover and cook till the oil separates. Step 12: Now add 1 cup of cashew paste and cook until well combined. Continue cooking until the oil separates. Step 13: Add 2 tbsp kasuri methi and mix well. Step 14: Finally, store Gravy Base in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 3 months.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, fresh ginger, shallot, garlic clove, green chili pepper, garam masala, curry powder, lemon juice, ground turmeric, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in food processor and process, scraping down sides of bowl a few times, until smooth Use immediately or store as directed in recipe description.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, olive oil, garlic cloves, curry powder, lemon juice, water, salt, dried currant
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chick peas, olive oil, crushed garlic, curry powder, lemon juice and water in a food processor or blender. Step 2: Puree until smooth, add salt to taste. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and gently stir in currants by hand. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap and chill at least 4 hour for flavours to blend.

Ingredient Names: mango chutney, mayonnaise, scallions, curry powder, limes, cayenne pepper, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the chutney if it's chunky and stir it into the mayonnaise along with scallions, curry, and enough lime juice to make it tart but nicely balanced in taste. Step 2: Stir in a pinch of cayenne, or more if desired. Step 3: Add yogurt or sour cream if using. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Step 5: Taste before serving to make sure balance is correct and add a little more lime juice if it seems too sweet Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, celery ribs, carrots, mild curry powder, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, garam masala, bay leaf, yellow potatoes, red lentil, tomato juice, yellow mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Fry onions in olive oil until beginning to brown 2. Step 2: Add garlic, celery and carrots and cook until beginning to soften 3. Step 3: Add spices and cook until fragrant 4. Step 4: Add potatoes, lentils, tomato juice, mustard and bouillon and water to cover by a couple of inches 5. Step 5: Simmer until potatoes are soft and lentils are beginning to break down, about 1 / 2 hour.

Dish Name: Curry Powder Trio Take Yer Pick
Ingredient Names: ground coriander, besan flour, ground cumin, fresh coarse ground black pepper, salt, ground fenugreek, amchoor, dry mustard, red chili powder, ground cinnamon, turmeric, dried curry leaves, asafoetida powder, ground turmeric, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: To make sambar podi -- combine 3 tablespoons ground coriander 3 tablespoons besan flour 1 tablespoon ground cumin 1 1 / 2 teaspoons coarsely ground black pepper 1 teaspoon each salt, ground fenugreek seeds, amchur powder, dry mustard, and hot red chile powder 1 / 2 teaspoon each ground cinnamon and turmeric 8 crumbled dried curry leaves And 1 / 4 teaspoon asafetida Makes about 2 / 3 cup To make a basic curry powder -- combine 5 tablespoons ground coriander seeds, 2 tablespoons ground cumin seeds, 1 tablespoon ground turmeric, 2 teaspoons ground ginger, 2 teaspoons dry mustard, 2 teaspoons ground fenugreek seeds, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons ground black pepper, 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, 1 / 2 teaspoon ground cloves, 1 / 2 teaspoon ground cardamom, and 1 / 2 teaspoon ground chile peppers.

Dish Name: Curry Rice With Orange And Brown Lentils
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, orange lentils, brown lentils, canola oil, tomato paste, tomatoes, onion, carrot, garlic clove, curry powder, salt & pepper, turmeric, cumin, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil to medium size pot, fry onion until soft. Step 2: Add chopped tomato, carrot, tomato paste and garlic and stir until a bit soft, about 8 minutes or so on low heat. Step 3: Add dry spices to bring out their flavors and aroma. Step 4: Add rice and lentils, cover with water just a bit over the rice, approximately 2-1 / 2 cups or so, bring to boil, cover and simmer for approximately 40 minutes checking periodically to see if tender Great next to chicken or a great vegetarian meal all by itself!

Dish Name: Dad And Char's Excellent Yellow Moong Dal Curry
Ingredient Names: yellow moong dal, water, mustard seeds, methi seeds, cumin seeds, fresh ginger, green chili, curry leaves, turmeric powder, red chili powder, asafoetida powder, roma tomatoes, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve asafoetida powder in 1 / 2 cup of water, mix well to dissolve completely, then keep aside. Step 2: Put the cleaned and washed lentils in a large pot. Step 3: Add 12-14 cups of water and boil on high flame until the lentils are tender and done. Step 4: Mash the lentils using an electric beater and keep aside, covered, until required. Step 5: Heat oil in a pot on medium flame. Step 6: Once its hot, toss in the mustard, methi and cumin seeds. Step 7: Allow to splutter and crackle. Step 8: Once they stop doing so, reduce flame quickly, add the curry leaves, mixing continuously as you do so. Step 9: Then toss in the chopped green chilli and chopped fresh ginger. Step 10: Stir continuously and cook on medium flame unil the raw smell of ginger is gone and it turns slightly brown.

Ingredient Names: potato, water, salt, oil, gram flour, red chili powder, baking soda, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, peel and slice a medium-sized potato into thin concentric circles. Step 2: Make sure you slice the potato thin and not thick. Step 3: Pour 2 1 / 2 cups of water in a bowl. Step 4: Add salt to taste and mix well. Step 5: Add the potato slices to this salted water, mix well. Step 6: Keep aside for 10 minutes. Step 7: In a medium sized bowl, make a thick batter with your besan flour, red chilli powder, baking soda, salt and 1 cup of water. Step 8: Now drain out the water from the potato slices. Step 9: Dip the slices of potato in the gramflour batter.

Dish Name: Dad's Favourite Yummy Indian Dessert Shrikhand
Ingredient Names: low-fat plain yogurt, sugar, cardamom powder, ground nutmeg, saffron strands, milk, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Put the yogurt in a thick cloth. Step 2: Tie it and hang it up to drain out the water for an hour. Step 3: Put the remaining yoghurt that is inside the cloth into a container. Step 4: Add in the sugar Whip it nicely till the mixture is soft and smooth. Step 5: Add in the soaked saffron with the milk, nutmeg powder and cardamom powder. Step 6: Transfer the mixture into a serving dish. Step 7: Garnish with finely chopped pistachios. Step 8: Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 9: Serve as a dessert!

Dish Name: Dad's Half Way Sindhi Half Way Yellow Rice Pulao
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms, cloves, bay leaves, turmeric powder, oil, curry leaves, garlic, mustard seeds, cumin seed, green chili
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pot on medium flame for 3 minutes. Step 2: Once the oil is hot, toss in the cinnamon stick, cardamoms, cloves and bay leaves. Step 3: Stir-fry these spices gently for 2 minutes until your kitchen is wafting with the aroma of the spices. Step 4: Add the cumin and mustard seeds followed by the green chillies. Step 5: Allow them{the mustard and cumin seeds} to battle as the splutter and crackle in the pot. Step 6: Once they stop fighting in the pot{pun intended! Step 7: }, i E, to say when they stop spluttering and crackling, add the curry leaves. Step 8: Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 9: Add garlic and stir-fry now until the raw smell of the garlic is gone and it turns golden brown.

Dish Name: Dad's Nutritious Muthiyas An Indian Appetiser With Tofu Stuff
Ingredient Names: soyabean nuggets, semolina, cornflour, whole wheat flour, rice flour, gram flour, yellow moong dal, green peas, potato, coriander leaves, green chili, red chili powder, salt, oil, panir
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, we'll start off by preparing the dough For this, take a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Put soya nuggests, semolina, cornflour, wheat flour, rice flour and gramflour in a bowl. Step 3: Using a spoon, mix well, from top to down. Step 4: Keep potato to boil in the meantime in water on the stove and boil until tender. Step 5: Now prepare the yellow moong dal paste For this, put yellow moong dal in a mixie alongwith a little water and prepare a somewhat coarse paste Likewise, prepare the greenpeas paste. Step 6: Add yellow moong dal paste, green peas paste, the boiled and grated potato, coriander leaves, green chillies, red chilli powder, salt and oil. Step 7: Grease your palms slightly.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, baking soda, cilantro, mint leaf, green chili, red chili powder, salt, ginger, garlic paste, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric, yogurt, water, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients for the batter and keep aside for 10-15 minutes. Step 2: Mix the spices& herbs in the yoghurt It should be of thin consistency. Step 3: Heat oil in a frypan Lightly drop the batter with a teaspoon or tablespoon depending upon your taste for the size Deep fry to a medium golden brown and drop these into the yoghurt mixture, directly from the oil Please be careful of the spatters while dropping the badas Alternatively, you could drop the hot badas in salted water. Step 4: Let them soak for 4-5 mins and press between the palms to take out excess water And then transfer to the yoghurt mixture.

Ingredient Names: yellow split peas, water, turmeric, salt, onion, garlic cloves, mustard seeds, chili powder, oil, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place yellow split peas, water, turmeric and salt into largish saucepan and bring to boil. Step 2: Turn down heat once boiling and simmer until peas are tender About 45 - 60 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat ghee or oil and gently fry onion and garlic until slightly brown. Step 4: Add mustard seeds and chilli powder and fry a further 2 - 3 minutes. Step 5: Add onion mixture to soup. Step 6: Garnish with chopped coriander and serve with roti bread or poppadoms Optional: a skinned, finely chopped tomato can also be added to soup when serving Enjoy!

Dish Name: Daikon Radish Stuffed Flatbread Mooli Paratha
Ingredient Names: wheat flour, salt, chili powder, jeera powder, oil, water, radish, ajwain, turmeric powder, onion, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Make up the dough using the water discard any left over water. Step 2: Leave the dough covered in a warm place to rest for half an hour. Step 3: Add salt to the grated radish. Step 4: After 15 mins squeeze out more water and discard this. Step 5: Then to the dry grated radish add the rest of the filling mix. Step 6: Now make small balls of the dough a little bigger than an egg Flatten them out, dip in dry flour and roll them out using a rolling pin to a teacup saucer size. Step 7: Make smaller balls of the filling mix about the size of an egg yolk and place each filling ball in the center of the dough soucer Gather the rest of the dough around it so that the dough complety covers the filling. Step 8: Dip it in dry flour and roll it out again theis time bigger than a saucer.

Ingredient Names: split red, onions, tomatoes, garlic, gingerroot, green chilies, turmeric powder, salt, oil, asafoetida powder, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, chicken stock cube, chili powder, garam masala powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, fresh cilantro, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the dal in the water it soaks in with the next 8 ingredients, in a vessel or pressure cooker till cooked (my pressure cooker takes 1 whistle to cook the dal) In the meanwhile keep the rest of the ingredients ready. Step 2: When the dal is cooked heat a tblsp of oil in a kadai/ vessel Add the asafetida and the mustard, cumin and curry leaves in quick succession. Step 3: Add the garlic as soon as the mustard splutters. Step 4: Then add the onion slices and fry till light brown. Step 5: Then add the stock cube and saute. Step 6: When you get the aromas add the chopped tomato and then the spice powders. Step 7: Add the cooked dal and stir to mix well. Step 8: When heated through add the lime juice. Step 9: (One tsp at a time. Step 10: Taste and add some more if you feel like it you can go beyond 2 tsp if your taste buds give you the go ahead). Step 11: Garnish with coriander leaves (we really add a lot of these but I have only put and serve hot over rice). Step 12: Try a dry meat dish as an accompaniment.

Dish Name: Dal Bhat Red Lentils With Rice
Ingredient Names: red lentil, vegetable oil, red onion, garlic cloves, ginger, salt, mustard seeds, turmeric, cumin seed, coriander powder, tomatoes, butter, cilantro, water, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the lentils and rinse a couple of times Be careful to remove any stones If you have time, soak the lentils in water as long as you can, up to overnight, before you cook They get very soft and cook faster Start rice preparation according to package directions Prep the onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and cilantro / green onion and set aside, heat oil on high. Step 2: Add ginger, garlic and onion, and stir fry on high until the onion is a little brown on the edges, 1-2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in cumin seeds, salt, turmeric, mustard seed and coriander powder. Step 4: Turn the heat down to medium and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often.

Ingredient Names: asafoetida powder, bengal gram dal, red capsicums, curry leaves, mustard seeds, oil, split peas, red chilies, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the toor dal and chana dal in two cups of water for half an hour. Step 2: Wash, halve, deseed and finely chop the capsicums. Step 3: Wash and pat dry the curry leaves. Step 4: Remove the stems from the whole red chillies Grind the soaked dals along with the whole red chillies, asafoetida and add a little salt. Step 5: In a pan heat two tablespoons of oil, add the chopped capsicum and saut until the capsicum has softened, set aside. Step 6: In a kadai heat the remaining four tablespoons of oil, add the mustard seeds and curry leaves. Step 7: Once they begin to crackle, add the ground dals and stir. Step 8: Cook until the liquid has evaporated and the dals have turned golden brown.

Dish Name: Dal Maharani The Queen Of Indian Lentils
Ingredient Names: onion, green chilies, tomatoes, ginger, red kidney beans, black gram dal, channa dal, red chili powder, turmeric powder, fresh cream, butter, oil, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Soak red kidney beans, black gram and chana dal in water for 4-5 hours Pressure cook the above dals once the time for soaking is over. Step 2: Transfer the dals to a skillet. Step 3: Simmer, on low flame, for 30 minutes, until the lentils become extremely soft. Step 4: Heat oil in a skillet Saut the onions and ginger in it till the raw smell of ginger is gone and onions turn golden brown. Step 5: Add tomatoes and green chillies and continue to saut. Step 6: Add turmeric powder and red chili powder once the onion-tomato mixture becomes soft Continue to saut. Step 7: Pour the cooked dal over this mixture and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: black lentils, kidney beans, cumin seed, green chilies, cinnamon, cloves, cardamoms, onion, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric powder, tomato puree, cream, water, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Clean, wash and soak the whole black lentils and kidney beans overnight. Step 2: Drain and keep aside. Step 3: Combine the lentils and beans with salt and 2 cups of water and cook till the dals are overcooked. Step 4: Whisk well till the mixture is almost mashed. Step 5: Heat the butter in a pan and add the cumin seeds. Step 6: When the cumin seeds crackle, add the green chillies, cinnamon, cloves, green cardamom, onions, ginger-garlic paste and saut till the onions turn golden brown in color. Step 7: Add the chilli powder, turmeric powder and tomato puree and cook over a medium flame till the oil separates from the tomato gravy. Step 8: Add the dal mixture, water and salt if required and simmer for 10 t 15 minutes. Step 9: Add the cream and mix well. Step 10: Garnish with the cilantro and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: dried brown lentils, crushed tomatoes, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, cayenne pepper, cumin, butter, evaporated milk, cilantro, dry active yeast, sugar, water, flour, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dal: Place the lentils in a pot and cover with a couple inches of water. Step 2: Bring to a boil over high heat and boil until tender. Step 3: Drain the lentils in a colander While the lentils are boiling, mince the garlic and peel and grate the ginger. Step 4: Return the drained lentils to the pot and add the butter, ginger, garlic, cayenne, salt and pepper. Step 5: Add the can of tomatoes and one cup of water. Step 6: Stir it all together, bring it to a simmer then reduce the heat to low. Step 7: Put a lid on the pot and let it simmer for half an hour The mixture should be soft and thick after a half hour.

Dish Name: Dal With Spiced Tomatoes And Potatoes
Ingredient Names: baking potato, red lentil, canola oil, onion, jalapeno pepper, garam masala, cumin seed, plum tomato, chickpeas, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add potatoes, return to a boil, and cook until fork-tender, 7 minutes. Step 3: Remove with slotted spoon and set aside, reserving the cooking liquid. Step 4: Add lentils to the same saucepan and return cooking liquid to a boil. Step 5: Cook until lentils are tender but still hold their shape, 8 - 10 minutes. Step 6: Drain and set aside. Step 7: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat Swirl in the oil, then add the onion, jelapeno, garam masala, and cumin. Step 8: Cook until onion begins to soften, 3 - 4 minutes. Step 9: Stir in the potatoes, tomatoes, chickpeas, ginger, and garlic.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, vegetable stock, salt, turmeric, chili powder, spinach, ghee, onion, curry powder, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, garam masala, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse lentils and soak for 20 mins or so. Step 2: In a large saucepan, bring stock to a boil and stir in salt, lentils, turmeric and chili powder. Step 3: Cover and return to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the spinach and cook for 5 minutes uncovered, or until lentils are soft Use a potato masher or a fork to mash the dal to get your desired consistancy. Step 5: Simmer for another few minutes to thicken up While lentils are cooking, heat ghee and cook onion with curry powder, cumin and mustard seeds over very low head til caramelized around 20 minutes. Step 6: Combine with lentils, stir in garam masala and yoghurt.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, onions, green chili, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, turmeric powder, curry leaves, salt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet on a medium flame and add the mustard seeds and urad dal. Step 2: When the mustard begins to sputter, add the sliced green chilli, curry leaves, and chopped onions. Step 3: Saute until the onions become translucent. Step 4: Now add the boiled potatoes, turmeric powder, and salt. Step 5: Stir well for a minute or so and switch off the burner. Step 6: Garnish with coriander and serve immediately!

Ingredient Names: carrot, tomatoes, salt, garam masala powder, water, black pepper, fresh coriander leaves, cumin seed, oil, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the carrot and chop it into small pieces, bring to a bowl. Step 2: Drain out excess water. Step 3: Put it into a mixer alongwith water, to make a paste Likewise, make a paste of the tomatoes, alongwith water, as much as is required to make a smooth paste Pass, both the carrot and the tomatoes mixture through a sieve and into a large saucepan. Step 4: Add 1 1 / 2 cups of water, salt, sambar masala powder and black pepper powder, stir well. Step 5: Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, allow to simmer.

Ingredient Names: sweet corn, salt, sugar, pepper, butter, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Take a skillet with a medium deep bottom, heat it and add about one generous cup of the corn. Step 2: Heat on medium heat and keep stirring so that the corn browns evenly. Step 3: Once it is brown, add the salt, pepper and sugar to it and stir on high heat for 30 seconds. Step 4: Serve hot in a bowl and eat!

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, gram flour, plain yogurt, water, baking soda, ghee, sugar syrup
Instructions: Step 1: Put flour in a mixing bowl, add gramflour, mix well. Step 2: Add yogurt and water. Step 3: Mix well, using a spoon, ensuring that no lumps remain. Step 4: Mix to obtain what is technically called, "ribbon consistency" Add a pinch of baking soda At this point, this mixture can be refrigerated if you are planning on making the jalebis later If you plan to make the jalebis instantly, put the mixture in a jalebi bottle If you dont have a jalebi bottle, you can use an empty well-washed and thoroughly clean, tomato ketchup bottle.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, basmati rice, onions, curry leaves, tomatoes, oil, ghee, coconut, red chilies, turmeric powder, cumin seed, salt, mustard seeds, lemon, mangoes
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chickpeas in plenty of water and soak overnight in a bowl filled with water or for about 8 hours The next day, when you want to prepare this pulao, soak rice for 30 minutes in water after cleaning and washing it in plenty of water. Step 2: Cook rice in 2 5 cups of water, on low-medium flame, partially covered, until all the water has been absorbed by the rice. Step 3: Spread the cooked rice out in a broad plate, allow it to cool. Step 4: Now, pressure cook the chickpeas till it becomes soft. Step 5: In a wok, heat oil on medium flame. Step 6: When hot, add the mustard seeds and curry leaves to the oil and allow the seeds to splutter. Step 7: Once they stop spluttering, add the sliced onions.

Dish Name: Deliciously Versatile Bean Burgers Veggie Burger
Ingredient Names: cannellini beans, egg, onion, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper, cumin, nonstick cooking spray, curry powder, garam masala, smoked paprika, chipotle pepper, cayenne, oregano, cajun seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: For the patties, chop in a food processor beans, onion, garlic, and chosen seasonings until beans are coarsely chopped. Step 2: Stir in egg and enough breadcrumbs or flour to make the mixture workable. Step 3: In a nonstick pan, spray with non stick spray or add a little oil. Step 4: Take mixture and form into a patty approximately 1 / 2 inch thick Brown on each side over med - med high heat, taking care when flipping. Step 5: In a small bowl, mix ingredients for sauce. Step 6: Serve patty drizzled with sauce, in a tortilla, pita, bun or plain Feel free to top with tomato, onion, lettuce, etc.

Ingredient Names: corn on the cob, butter, salt, cayenne pepper, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the corn until it's almost cooked. Step 2: Then mix the butter and salt in a bowl Coat the corn in the butter mixture. Step 3: Wrap in foil and bake or grill for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Then unwrap, brush coat the corn with lime juice, sprinkle the paprika on top and grill without foil wrap for a few min until the kernels start to turn a golden colour.

Ingredient Names: bengal gram dal, red kidney beans, urad dal, onions, garlic, green chili, tomatoes, coriander leaves, oil, red chili powder, cumin powder, salt, dried fenugreek, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, clean, wash and soak all the dals in sufficient water for minimum 6 hours Peel and finely chop onion and garlic. Step 2: Wash, remove stem and finely chop green chillies Next, wash and finely chop the tomatoes Do the same for the coriander leaves. Step 3: Drain soaked dals, then add 6 cups water and pressure-cook for 30 minutes or until the dals are completely cooked. Step 4: Mix them well, using a round ladle. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan. Step 6: Add garlic and stir-fry briefly until golden brown. Step 7: Add onion and green chillies.

Ingredient Names: red lentil, ghee, onion, garlic, fresh gingerroot, ground turmeric, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash lentils thoroughly, removing those that float on the surface, drain well. Step 2: Heat ghee or oil and fry onion, garlic and ginger until onion is golden. Step 3: Add turmeric and stir well. Step 4: Add drained lentils and fry for 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add water, lower heat, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add salt to taste, mix thoroughly and continue cooking until lentils are soft and the consistency is thick, similar to porridge. Step 7: Serve dhal plain or garnish with sliced onion, fried until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: spinach, toor dal, tomatoes, yellow onion, green chilies, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, mustard seeds, cumin seed, dried red chilies, curry leaves, salt, oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the dhal. Step 2: In a large saucepan add dhal, 2 cups of water, spinach, tomatoes, onion, chillies, and cook over med-high heat until lentils are very tender In another pan, add 1 tsp oiland add mustard & cumin seeds. Step 3: After the mustard starts popping, add dry red chillies and curry leaves. Step 4: Saute for 35 seconds, and then pour the cooked dal over this. Step 5: Add red chilli powder, garam masala, turmeric, sugar, salt to taste, mix well. Step 6: Cover & bring to boil & simmer for 2-3 minute stir in lemon juice & turn off stove. Step 7: Serve hot with rice.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, salt, fresh spinach, vegetable oil, whole mustard seeds, onion, garlic cloves, garam masala, cayenne pepper, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 2 1 / 2 qts water to a boil Peel potatoes and cut into 3 / 4 inch cubes, then add to boiling water with 1 t salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil again. Step 3: Cover, turn heat to low and cook potatoes till just tender, about 6 minutes Do not overcook. Step 4: Drain, spread out and leave to cool If using fresh spinach, wash and drop into large kettle of boiling water to wilt. Step 5: Drain and squeeze out as much liquid as you can and chop fine, set spinach aside. Step 6: Heat oil in a heavy, 12-inch, preferably nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

Ingredient Names: toor dal, red lentil, water, tomatoes, salt, turmeric powder, canola oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, serrano pepper, dried red chilies, curry leaves, garlic cloves, cumin powder, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the lentils several times, then combine the first 6 ingredients and pressure cook until soft. Step 2: In a saucepan, heat oil, add mustard seeds. Step 3: When mustard crackles, add cumin seeds and red chillies. Step 4: Stir for a few seconds. Step 5: Now add serrano pepper, curry leaves and garlic. Step 6: Stir until garlic is barely colored. Step 7: Now add the cooked lentil mixture, water if needed and bring to a boil. Step 8: When dal is boiling, add cumin and salt to taste. Step 9: Lower heat, cover and simmer for a few minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, saffron strand, unsalted butter, semolina, sliced almonds, ground cardamom, sultana
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the water, sugar and the soaked saffron in a 2-litre / quart saucepan. Step 2: Place over moderate heat, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Step 3: Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to very low and cover with a tight-fitting lid. Step 4: Melt the butter in a 2- or 3-litre / quart saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add the semolina, and slowly and rhythmically stir-fry the grains for about 20 minutes, or until they darken to a tan colour and become aromatic. Step 6: Add the flaked almonds to the grains towards the end of the toasting process. Step 7: Raise the heat under the syrup, add the cardamom and the sultanas, and bring it to a rolling boil. Step 8: Raise the heat under the semolina for 1 minute, stirring continuously. Step 9: Remove the saucepan of semolina from the heat, and slowly pour the hot syrup into the semolina, stirring steadily The grains may at first splutter, but will quickly cease as the liquid is absorbed.

Dish Name: Dosas Indian Rice And Lentil Pancakes
Ingredient Names: bottled water, basmati rice, urad dal, sugar, sea salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 6 cups water, rice and lentils in a large bowl. Step 2: Cover and let stand 8 hours, drain and rinse. Step 3: Place the rice mixture, 1 1 / 4 cups water, and sugar in a food processor and puree until smooth. Step 4: Spoon batter in a clean bowl and cover. Step 5: Let stand for 12 hours or overnight, stir in salt. Step 6: Heat 1 / 2 tsp Of oil in an iron skillet. Step 7: Spoon 1 / 3 cup into pan and heat over medium heat.

Dish Name: Dream Mushroom Vegetable Broth Pulao Pilaf With Parsley And Yogurt
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, mushrooms, onion, vegetable broth, garlic, oil, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, prepare the vegetable broth For this, add 1 cube of'maggi vegetable stock with onion' to 3 cups of water. Step 2: Allow to boil until the cube has completely dissolved in the water, set aside. Step 3: Now, heat oil in a large heavy bottomed skillet. Step 4: Add in the chopped onions and garlic. Step 5: Saute on medium flame till golden brown. Step 6: Add mushrooms and continue to saute for 4 minutes. Step 7: Add vegetable broth and rice. Step 8: Stir once, bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Dreamy Yummy Easy And Healthy Peachy The 5 Ending In Y Fruit
Ingredient Names: fresh peaches, red apple, green seedless grape, mangoes, firm banana, apple pie filling
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the fruit in a large salad bowl Add the pie filling Toss to coat Serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, mustard seeds, asafoetida, chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric, fenugreek seeds, salt, oil, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Add mustard seeds, cover to avoid splatter. Step 3: After seeds crackle, add potatoes and hing, cook 1 minute. Step 4: Add chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric, salt, and fenugreek seeds, stir well. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium. Step 6: Cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are crispy and tender, stir in cilantro.

Dish Name: Dum Aloo Banarsi Delicious Potatoes Cooked In A Savoury Indian
Ingredient Names: boiled potatoes, sesame seeds, turmeric powder, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt, coriander leaves, mint leaves, cornflour, onions, yogurt, oil, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Add all the spices to the grated and boiled potatoes in a bowl. Step 2: Mix well and shape into balls. Step 3: Roll into corn flour and deep fry in a pot. Step 4: Drain onto kitchen paper towels and keep aside Next, in another pot, deep fry the sliced onions till golden brown. Step 5: Mix with yoghurt and using a blender, blend to obtain a fine paste. Step 6: Heat a pan and add into it butter, spices, onion, ginger and garlic paste and tomatoes. Step 7: Saute for 15 minutes on low heat. Step 8: Stir in tomato paste and all the remaining masalas. Step 9: Now fold in the onions, salt, pepper and yoghurt paste.

Dish Name: Dum Aloo Fried Potatoes In Spicy Sauce
Ingredient Names: baby potatoes, oil, cumin seed, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms, onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, fennel seed, garam masala, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the potatoes and pierce them all over with a fork. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan for frying and deep fry the potatoes till they get a red- brown tinge. Step 3: In a separate pan, heat the 2tbsp oil on medium heat. Step 4: Add cumin seeds, cardamoms and the cinnamon stick to the hot oil. Step 5: Add onions and saute them till they become translucent. Step 6: Add the ginger garlic paste and saute them till they loose the raw smell. Step 7: Add the tomatoes and cook then covered for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the turmeric powder, chillli powder, coriander powder, fennel seeds and garam masala, saute the spices till the oil starts oozing out. Step 9: Add the yogurt and keep stirring the yogurt until it comes to a boil. Step 10: Now add salt and stir.

Ingredient Names: onions, fresh lemon juice, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients Let it stand for half and hour Serve with main dish, barbequed food or kebabs Great taste!

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, cucumbers, green onions, fresh lime juice, lime zest
Instructions: Step 1: Place all vegetables in a non-reactive serving bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle vegetables with the lime juice, adding 1 tablespoon at first, then adjusting the amount if needed If you want, you can add a sprinkle of lime zest for garnish.

Dish Name: East Indian Inspired Potatoes With Mint
Ingredient Names: raisins, russet potatoes, olive oil, red onion, green chili peppers, fresh ginger, turmeric, garlic cloves, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, lemon juice, ground black pepper, salt, fresh spearmint, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Soak raisins in 1 cup very hot water for 10 minutes until plump. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Cook the potatoes in a large pot of salted boiling water for 10-12 minutes or just until fork tender Do not overcook. Step 4: Drain potatoes and set aside. Step 5: Heat olive oil or ghee over medium heat in large saute pan. Step 6: Add the red onions, drained raisins, chili peppers, ginger, turmeric, garlic, cumin seeds and fennel seeds. Step 7: Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Stir in the potatoes and most of the spearmint stir to coat the potatoes. Step 9: Toss with lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: water, brown mustard seeds, ground cumin, ground turmeric, onion, fresh jalapeno, small red potatoes, salt, lime, frozen peas, currants, parsley, wheat flour tortillas, cooked rice, nonfat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a medium pot or skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add saute liquid, mustard seeds, cumin, and turmeric, stirring constantly. Step 3: When seeds start to pop, add onion and jalapeno and saute a few minutes more. Step 4: Add potatoes, salt, and water, and simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes, until potatoes are tender Watch closely as it cooks, adding more water, if needed, just enough to keep the pot bottom covered until the very end. Step 5: Add lime juice and stir quickly to deglaze the pan. Step 6: Stir in peas, currants, and parsley. Step 7: Heat through and spoon into warm tortillas with rice and a spoonful of sour cream, if desired.

Dish Name: Easy And Healthy Low Cal Corn On The Cob
Ingredient Names: corn on the cob, water, salt, turmeric powder, red chili powder, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Pour water in a pressure cooker. Step 2: Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt to the water, stir. Step 3: Add the corn on the cob Tightly close the cooker with its lid. Step 4: Boil the corn on high flame till it's cooked completely This takes 10-12 minutes Open the cooker Carefully, remove the corn. Step 5: Wrap in individual foils.

Ingredient Names: granny smith apples, mango powder, tamarind extract, chili powder, whole green chili, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, butter, gingerroot, salt, pecan nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter. Step 2: Add cinnamon, bay leaf and green chilli. Step 3: Stir for few seconds, then toss in mango powder and chilli powder. Step 4: Stir again briefly, then add apples and tamarind. Step 5: Add a few tablespoons of water and close lid. Step 6: Cook on medium-high heat for about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add salt and pecan nuts. Step 8: Cook apples till all liquid is evaporated, they should be soft Enjoy This dish would accompany any protein dish, like lentils or eaten with mashed potato for ekadasi fasters.

Dish Name: Easy Bitter Gourd Salad I Love Way Too Much
Ingredient Names: bitter melons, tomatoes, onions, lemons, turmeric powder, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Scrape off the skin of the bittergourd and any hard edges and trim the ends Finely slice the bittergourd, heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Fry the bittergourd slightly in it. Step 3: Add a pinch of turmeric powder and salt to taste, mix well, remove from heat. Step 4: Once it has cooled, arrange the bittergourd on a plate with the sliced tomatoes and onions. Step 5: Add lemon juice on top. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, sea salt, water, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: In the bowl of a food processor fitted with a dough blade, process flour, salt and water until the mixture forms a ball. Step 2: Turn dough onto a floured work surface and knead for 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Step 4: Let dough rest for 30 to 90 minutes. Step 5: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Step 6: Divide dough into 8 equal pieces. Step 7: Roll each piece into a 7-inch circle Spray a cast-iron griddle or skillet once with cooking spray and set over medium-low heat. Step 8: Cook a chapati for 1 minute. Step 9: Turn over and cook 5 minutes on second side or until chapati bubbles up.

Dish Name: Easy Crescent Samosa Indian Style Sandwiches
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, potatoes, carrot, sweet peas, soy sauce, curry powder, cumin, dried cilantro, ground ginger, turmeric, salt, red pepper flakes, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and garlic in oil 5 minutes until onion is soft. Step 2: Add all other ingredients except crescent rolls. Step 3: Stir gently over medium heat for several minutes until well incorporated, set aside. Step 4: Heat oven to 375f Open cans of crescent rolls and unroll the dough Separate into 4 rectangles and pinch the triangular perforations to seal. Step 5: Cut each rectangle in half crosswise to make squares You may have to coax the dough gently with your hands to make it square and to close up the perforations. Step 6: Spoon a heaping spoonful of filling in the center of each square and fold over to make a triangle.

Dish Name: Easy Curried Chickpeas Chana Masala Vegetarian Vegan
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, vegetable oil, onions, fresh ginger, turmeric, garam masala, salt, chopped tomato, red chili pepper, mint, lemon juice, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a sauce pan. Step 2: Saute the onions, garlic, and ginger in the hot oil until the onions are golden brown. Step 3: Stir in the remaining ingredients. Step 4: Cook over low heat for ten minutes. Step 5: Add one cup of water and mix well. Step 6: Cook until the tomatoes and chile are very soft. Step 7: Then pour over rice and serve.

Dish Name: Easy Curried Yellow Dal Yellow Split Peas
Ingredient Names: yellow split peas, butter, onion, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, low sodium vegetable broth, water, salt, curry powder, cumin, coriander powder, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan melt butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add chopped onion and salt. Step 3: Saute until soft, about five minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and saute until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 5: Add remaining spices and stir. Step 6: Saute for about 1 minute, cooking spices If spices start to stick to pan, add some water - 1 / 4 cup should do. Step 7: Add peas and stir to coat with butter, onion, and spice mixture. Step 8: Add broth, 1 / 2 cup water and bring to boil. Step 9: Cover and reduce heat to simmer.

Ingredient Names: moong dahl, basmati rice, fresh spinach, chopped tomatoes, cumin seed, chili flakes, garlic powder, black mustard seeds, coriander powder, ghee, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Nb all spices and quantities are adjustable, you can leave out one or more spices If you like a thinner dahl, add more water If you like a thicker dahl, add less water This serves more if used as a side dish Pick through dried pulses for stones or other foreign material in a plastic bowl or ice- cream container. Step 2: Rinse several times by swishing water in this container, like washing rice. Step 3: Place in dutch oven or extra large saucepan and cover with water about two inches over the top. Step 4: Bring to the boil and simmer for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Drain pot, and save the water for your plants. Step 6: Cover with fresh water and bring to boil.

Ingredient Names: red lentils, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, fresh coriander, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, lemon juice, vegetable oil, asafoetida powder, whole cumin seed, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and wash the lentils thoroughly. Step 2: Put them in heavy-bottomed 3-4 quart pot, add 5 cups water, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Remove the froth and scum that collects at the top. Step 4: Now add the garlic, ginger, fresh coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper. Step 5: Cover, leaving the lid very slightly ajar, lower heat, and simmer gently for about 1 1 / 2 hours, stir occasionaly. Step 6: When dal is cooked, add the salt and lemon juice (it should be thicker than pea soup, but thinner than cooked cereal. Step 7: In a 4-6-inch skillet or small pot, heat the vegetable oil or ghee over a medium-high flame. Step 8: When hot, add the asafetida and cumin seeds As soon as the asafetida sizzles and expands and the cumin seeds turn dark, pour the oil and spices over the dal and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, ground cumin, chopped tomatoes, red lentil, lemon juice, vegetable stock, coconut milk, salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, warm olive oil and add garlic and onion. Step 2: Saute, stirring 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, and cumin. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes, lentils, lemon juice, vegetable stock, coconut milk, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 25-30 minutes or until lentils are tender. Step 6: Serve warm You can garnish with lemon slices and cilantro if desired Also good with naan bread.

Ingredient Names: green beans, butter, garam masala, salt, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook green beans until tender and immediately cool in cold water to stop cooking. Step 2: Melt butter in pan. Step 3: When it is lightly browned, add garam masala and salt. Step 4: Add grean beans and toss to coat. Step 5: Serve with chopped tomato sprinkled over the top.

Dish Name: Easy Moong Dal Mashed Yellow Split Peas
Ingredient Names: yellow split peas, salt, yellow onion, jalapenos, fresh turmeric, curry powder, peanut oil, black mustard seeds, lemon, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In large pan boil the split peas in plenty of water for about 30 minutes until tender If the water starts evaporating too quickly, add more as needed By the end of the cooking time, the split peas should have the dry consistency of mashed potatoes, the majority of the lentils will have lost their shape and most of the water will have evaporated. Step 2: Remove pot from range, drain the water from the lentils and stir in salt. Step 3: Cover and set aside. Step 4: Chop onion, and combine with the jalapeno, turmeric and curry powder. Step 5: Heat the oil or ghee over medium heat in a heavy saute pan with lid. Step 6: When oil is hot, carefully add the black mustard seeds Stand back as they may pop up into your face. Step 7: Cover the pan with the lid and continue cooking the mustard seeds until the popping quiets down.

Dish Name: Easy Punjabi Style Chickpea And Potatoes
Ingredient Names: new potatoes, chickpeas, canola oil, garam masala, curry powder, coriander, cumin, salt, black pepper, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain the chickpeas and potatoes thoroughly. Step 2: In a saucepan, mix them together with the canola oil so all the pieces are thoroughly coated I listed 1 / 4 cup to start with-- but add more if there's not enough to coat the food. Step 3: Add all the seasonings listed, then mix together until thoroughly blended. Step 4: Turn on high heat until oil starts bubbling. Step 5: Lower the heat to medium-low, cover, and let simmer for 10 minutes, stir it occasionally to make sure pieces don't get stuck to the bottom of the pot. Step 6: Remove from the heat element and let sit on a trivet for 5 minutes still covered. Step 7: Uncover and enjoy! Step 8: It's like eating samosa filling! Step 9: Great with naan, a good curry, or as a wonderful side dish / accompaniment to prantha, bhajia, rice and dal, curried vegetables, or mash it up a bit to use for samosa and masala dosa filling.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, vegetable oil, onion, cinnamon stick, cumin seed, tomatoes, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix together coconut milk, red chile powder, coriander, turmeric, and salt. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion, cinnamon stick, and cumin seeds. Step 4: Saute until onions are soft. Step 5: Stir in tomatoes, peas, and coconut milk mixture. Step 6: Reduce heat, and simmer until the peas are tender, about 5-10 minutes. Step 7: Serve hot over basmati rice, chappatis, tortillas or bread.

Ingredient Names: kale, mustard greens, olive oil, cumin seed, mustard seeds, salt, green chili pepper, garlic, lime wedge, water
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the kale and mustard greens by cutting middle stem out of each leaf. Step 2: Rinse the leaves thoroughly. Step 3: Cut the greens into strips that are about 1 inch by 3-4 inches. Step 4: Add 4 tsp of water to a 2 quart pot. Step 5: Bring to boil on medium heat. Step 6: Add the kale first, then the mustard greens pour 1 / 4 teaspoon into the greens and cover tightly with lid. Step 7: Cook for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the greens are wilted and tender. Step 8: When the greens are done cooking, they should be dark green. Step 9: Keep the lid on the pot and set aside. Step 10: In a small saucepan heat 1 tsp oil or butter until almost smoking at medium high heat.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, ghee, water, salt, cauliflower, frozen peas, reduced-fat feta cheese, chili powder, fennel seed, garam masala, mustard seeds, gingerroot, asafoetida powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Filling: Heat oil. Step 2: Add fennel, mustard and ginger. Step 3: When mustard crackles, add garam masala, chili powder and asafetida, stir briefly. Step 4: Add cauliflower and salt and stir. Step 5: Cook for 10 minutes or so Can add few tbsp of water or so if cauliflower is sticking. Step 6: Add peas and cook for a further 10 minutes or so Again a bit of water may be needed.

Ingredient Names: potato, butternut squash, eggplants, tikka masala paste, vegetable oil, onions, tomato passata, coconut milk, red peppers, zucchini, fresh coriander, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the potato, squash and aubergine with 2 tbsp curry paste and 2 tbsp oil in a large roasting tin. Season, then roast for 30 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the sauce. Fry the onions in the remaining oil in a large pan until softened and golden – add a splash of water if they start to dry out. Stir in the remaining curry paste, cook for 3 mins, then add the passata, coconut milk and 100ml water. Simmer for a few mins. Step 3: When the vegetables are roasted, tip them into the sauce with the peppers and courgettes. Simmer for 10-15 mins until tender. Scatter with coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, chickpea flour, water, tomatoes, green pepper, garam masala, fennel seed, cinnamon, cardamom pods, fresh ginger, asafoetida powder, curry powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Roast chickpea flour in a heavy frying pan for few minutes, till aromatic and a few shades darker, keep aside, heat oil. Step 2: Add fennel, cinnamon, cardamom and ginger. Step 3: Fry for a few seconds till aromatic. Step 4: Add asafetida, curry powder and chickpea flour. Step 5: Add water gradually and stir mixture till smooth, breaking up any lumps. Step 6: Add tomato and chopped pepper. Step 7: Simmer for few minutes and then lower heat. Step 8: Add drained and washed chickpeas and cook gently for 2-3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: icing sugar, butter, lemon zest, vanilla bean, salt, flour, ground hazelnuts, baking powder, whipping cream, raisins, carrots, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, whip together the icing sugar, butter, vanilla and lemon zest Sift the flour and baking powder together in a separate bowl. Step 2: Add the ground hazelnut to the flour and mix well. Step 3: Now, mix in this flour-hazelnut mixture into the butter mixture. Step 4: Add the whipped cream and mix well Next, stir in the raisins and carrots. Step 5: Grease and flour a seven inch cake tin now. Step 6: Pour the prepared mixture into it Alternatively, use well greased and dusted individual muffin molds. Step 7: Put the whole walnuts over the cake.

Dish Name: Eggless Easy And Tasty Gingerbread Made Without Molasses
Ingredient Names: flour, baking soda, sugar, butter, golden syrup, boiling water, cinnamon, ground ginger, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the sugar into a half-pint measuring cup. Step 2: Fill the cup with the golden syrup. Step 3: Pour the mixture into a bowl. Step 4: Then, put butter into the half-pint measuring cup and fill with boiling water, mix well, add baking soda. Step 5: Now, sift together the remaining dry ingredients. Step 6: Mix well until you have a soft, smooth consistency. Step 7: Pour into a square or oblong baking pan lined with greaseproof paper. Step 8: Bake at 350f for 40 minutes.

Dish Name: Eggless Easy And Tasty Peanut Butter Bread
Ingredient Names: flour, baking powder, salt, peanut butter, sugar, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Sift together flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt, stir in sugar. Step 2: Add peanut butter and rub in well. Step 3: Add milk and beat thoroughly. Step 4: Bake in a greased loaf pan at 350f for an hour. Step 5: Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove from pan and cool completely. Step 7: Slice and serve If you have bread remanining, wrap in aluminium foil and freeze Thaw for sometime before serving the next day.

Ingredient Names: dark chocolate, gianduja, corn flakes, candied fruit
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, melt the chopped chocolate in a double boiler Instead of a double boiler, you may also do it this way. Step 2: Place a small saucepan with the chocolate in it in a larger pan of simmering water. Step 3: Then, stir the chocolate with a wooden spoon. Step 4: Once you see that the chocolate is half melted, remove from heat and continue stirring it at room temperature till it is soft and dissolved. Step 5: Stir in the nutella or nougatine and mix well. Step 6: Add the candied fruits and cornflakes, mix well. Step 7: Using a tbsp, drop small portions of the heavenly chocolate mixture on a bakig sheet{butter paper} Allow it to cool and harden on its own.

Dish Name: Eggless Tasty And Easy Honey Bread
Ingredient Names: sour cream, ginger, brown sugar, honey, flour, baking soda, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cream, sugar and honey together in a bowl Sift in flour and ginger Dissolve baking soda in warm water. Step 2: Add baking soda-water mixture to the flour-honey mixture, mix well, grease a loaf tin. Step 3: Pour mixture into the greased loaf tin. Step 4: Bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour, remove from oven. Step 5: Allow to cool on a wire rack before slicing and serving.

Dish Name: Eggplant And Dhal Curry With Basmati Rice
Ingredient Names: eggplant, lentils, basmati rice, olive oil, turmeric, salt, cumin seeds, water, mustard seeds, onion, garlic, curry powder, baby spinach, tomato puree, cayenne powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400, stab the eggplant with a fork a couple of times and put in a small casserole dish, uncovered on the middle rack for 30 minutes. Step 2: When done, run under some cool water and peel of skin, and scrape out all of the seeds. Step 3: Place in a food processor While the eggplant is roasting, brown the basmati rice in a skillet with 2t of olive oil, the turmeric, salt, and cumin seeds for 5 minutes. Step 4: Then add the 2 cups water, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes Start the lentils cooking in a pot with about 2 of water covering them. Step 5: Bring them to a boil and then cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until the water is almost gone. Step 6: After they are done cooking, put them along with 2t of lentil water in the food processor with the eggplant. Step 7: In a small skillet, cook 3t olive oil, the mustard seeds, the chopped onions, and the garlic. Step 8: After onions are tender and mustard seeds start sputtering, add the salt and the curry seasoning.

Ingredient Names: oil, black mustard seeds, potato, eggplant, coriander, cumin, turmeric, cayenne, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium-high heat in a big skillet. Step 2: When hot, put in the mustard seeds. Step 3: When they start to pop, put in the vegetables, stir once, add seasonings. Step 4: Stir and fry for a minute. Step 5: Add 3 tablespoons of water, lower heat, cover, and simmer 10-15 minutes. Step 6: Stir every now and then If vegetables stick, add a little water Dish is done when the potatoes are tender.

Dish Name: Eggplant And Potato Stew With Cumin
Ingredient Names: eggplant, garlic cloves, russet potatoes, cumin seeds, peanut oil, bay leaf, yellow onion, fresh ginger, canned tomato, water, salt, plain yogurt, fresh cilantro, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Cut several slits in the eggplant, stuff with sliced garlic. Step 3: Bake the eggplant and potatoes on cookie sheet until eggplant is shriveled and potatoes are done, about an hour. Step 4: When vegetables cool enough to handle, peel the eggplant and chop the flesh into large pieces. Step 5: Cut potatoes, with skins, into 1 / 2 inch chunks Roast cumin seeds in dry skillet until you can smell them, about 10 seconds Grind half into a powder and set aside whole for garnish In large heavy pan, heat the oil with the bay leaf. Step 6: When it is hot, add the onion, ground cumin, and ginger. Step 7: Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are lightly colored, 12 to 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, onion, garlic cloves, green chilies, salt, fresh cilantro, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggplants in half Rub some oil over the cut side of the eggplant Roast or broil, until the skin is lightly burned, and the eggplant is completely soft Peel eggplant. Step 2: Put pulp into a bowl, and mash with a potato masher. Step 3: Add onion, garlic, chilies, salt, cilantro, and 1 / 2 tsp oil, and mix very well. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in a frying pan. Step 5: Add eggplant mixture, and fry for 3-5 minutes, until fairly dry. Step 6: Serve alone, or with basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, roasted garlic, sherry wine vinegar, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the eggplant into 1-inch slices, brush one side lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper Roast in a preheated 400 degree oven until brown, approximately 20 minutes. Step 2: When cool, scoop the flesh from the skin and process with remaining ingredients until smooth Correct seasoning Can be stored refrigerated for up to one week.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, kosher salt, brown mustard seeds, canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, cumin, coriander, cardamom, garam masala, cayenne, ground cloves, diced tomatoes, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Put eggplant cubes in colander over large bowl, sprinkle with kosher salt, and let stand for 30 minutes to sweat Pat dry and remove excess salt with paper towels or clean dishcloth Toast mustard seeds in a small dry non-stick pan over medium-low heat until they turn grey and begin to pop. Step 2: Remove from heat and reserve in a small bowl. Step 3: Place eggplant in a mid-sized steamer and cook for about 10 minutes, until eggplant is soft and tender but not mushy. Step 4: Remove from heat and reserve. Step 5: Heat canola oil in large pot over medium heat. Step 6: Add onion and saut until golden. Step 7: Stir in garlic, ginger, and all other spices, being careful to avoid scorching. Step 8: After 1 minute, add spinach and tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic cloves, ginger powder, cayenne powder, cumin powder, cinnamon, black pepper, turmeric powder, tomatoes, eggplant, salt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a saucepan on medium flame. Step 2: Add onion and saute until it turns transparent. Step 3: Fold in garlic and saute for 2 minutes or until the raw smell is gone. Step 4: Stir in all the spice powders. Step 5: Saute for 2 minutes. Step 6: Now add half a cup of water and the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Step 7: Fold in eggplant and salt. Step 8: Cook for 10 minutes or until the eggplant is well cooked It should be dry. Step 9: Garnish with chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: yellow onion, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, garam masala, brown sugar, canola oil, eggplants, diced tomatoes, cilantro leaf, ground coriander, paprika, turmeric, ground cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine the ingredients for the masala paste blend it to a smooth paste. Step 2: Set this masala paste aside. Step 3: Cut into the baby eggplants up to about 1 / 4 inch from the stem, without breaking up the stem, into roughly lengthwise quarters gently separate at the slits, while holding the stem tight, and slather on the masala paste into the slits of the eggplant, in a thin layer, taking care not to break apart the eggplant. Step 4: Set aside Or use the long thin eggplant cut into 1 inch slices and make a cut halfway through to slather the masala into and on the slices. Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan, add the diced onions and a pinch of salt and any remaining marsala paste left over after coating the eggplants. Step 6: Saute till onion turns translucent about 4-5 minutes. Step 7: Add the diced tomatoes and the rest of the spices, stir till well-incorporated. Step 8: Season with salt to taste Gently place the 'stuffed and coated' eggplants into the sauce so they are mostly submerged, cover and let it simmer over medium low heat till eggplant changes color and is cooked through but not mushy about 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, onions, garlic cloves, ginger, red chili pepper, green chili pepper, ground coriander, brown mustard seeds, cumin seed, curry leaves, ghee, puree, tomato paste, coconut milk, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice eggplant lenghthwise about 3 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: Sprinkle slices with salt and set aside Finely mince garlic and ginger, sprinkle with little salt, mince some more until nearly mashed. Step 3: Slice onions thinly Seed and finely chop red and green chili peppers. Step 4: In a deep skillet, heat ghee and fry sliced onions until soft and lightly browned. Step 5: Meanwhile, pat eggplant slices dry and cube them. Step 6: Add red and green chili peppers, minced garlic and ginger, curry leaves, mustard seeds, cumin seeds and ground coriander to the onions, fry, stirring, until fragrant, then add tomato paste and tamarind puree, stir and add eggplant cubes. Step 7: Fry one more minute, then add coconut milk, bring to a gentle boil, cover and let simmer for about 20 minutes or until eggplant is soft. Step 8: Serve with rice, roti, dal or meat curry!

Dish Name: Eggplant Curry No Fry Sri Lankan Style Using Coconut
Ingredient Names: eggplants, canola oil, sea salt, ground black pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, ground fennel, cayenne, fresh lime juice, cinnamon bark, curry leaves, onion, light coconut milk, brown mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your broiler, placing the rack about 6 inches below the heat source. Step 2: Cut the eggplant into 1 / 2 inch thick round slices. Step 3: Place the slices on a baking sheet and lightly brush with about 1 tbsp of the oil, on both sides. Step 4: Place the tray under the broiler and cook on one side for about 4 minutes, flip and do same on other side It will depend on your broiler, you're looking for light browning on both sides. Step 5: Remove and set aside to cool slightly. Step 6: When you're able to handle the eggplant, cut the pieces into quarters. Step 7: Place them in a bowl along with 1 / 2 tsp sea salt, the cumin, coriander, turmeric, fennel, cayenne and lime juice, toss gently. Step 8: Put the remaining tbsp of oil into a skillet and bring to medium-high heat.

Dish Name: Eggplant With Capcisum Mushroom And Feta Cheese
Ingredient Names: butter, onions, mushroom, red capsicum, eggplant, feta cheese, fresh thyme leaves, fresh parsley, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a little butter. Step 2: Stir-fry the onions until soft and golden brown, remove from flame. Step 3: Then, fry mushrooms until well-browned, remove from heat, keep aside. Step 4: Add a little more butter. Step 5: Saute the red capsicum, remove from flame, keep aside.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, green chilies, fresh ginger, eggs, heavy cream, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the heavy cream, salt, and cilantro in with the eggs in a bowl. Step 2: Melt the butter in a skillet and add the onions and cook until golden. Step 3: Add the chiles and ginger and cook until aromatic. Step 4: Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook, stirring until the eggs are set and done to your liking. Step 5: Serve with warm breads.

Ingredient Names: ice cube, orange juice, mangoes, honey, plain yogurt, rose water
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients on high speed for 30 seconds Toss in the yoghurt and process for 45 seconds or until frothy Chill and serve.

Ingredient Names: ground black pepper, ground ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, black cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the spices together and store in an airtight container Saute small amounts in butter / ghee to spice vegetables and grains.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, cumin seeds, dried red chilies, turmeric, garlic cloves, dried lentils, cayenne pepper, amchoor, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the oil, cumin, red chiles and turmeric in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic or asafetida, lentils, cayenne, and mango powder, if using,, and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Step 4: Add the water and salt, bring to a boil and skim well. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the lentils are soft, 20 to 30 minutes. Step 6: Add more water during cooking if necessary. Step 7: Taste for salt and add more if you need to Ladle about cup of the lentils into a small bowl and mash them with a spoon. Step 8: Return the mashed lentils to the pot and give the dal a stir. Step 9: Then continue cooking at a simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes to thicken.

Ingredient Names: milk, chinese noodles, rose water, falooda seeds, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the takmaria seeds in water for at least 1 hour. Step 2: Boil the noodles / sev in water for about 15 minutes. Step 3: Drain the water, and boil the noodles in a little milk for about 5-10 minutes on low heat Do not burn the noodles! Step 4: Turn off the heat and add lots of ice to the pot to cool the noodles for about 10 minute stir them to quicken the process. Step 5: Put the noodles in the glass, add rooafzah / rose water, pour in milk, add a little crushed ice and stir. Step 6: Top it off with a scoop or two of the pista kulfi ice cream and enjoy!

Dish Name: Falooda Pakistani Ice Cream Sundae Float
Ingredient Names: ice cream, milk, basil seeds, rose syrup, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Soak basil seed for 2 hours and drain water They will swell and look like little eyeballs. Step 2: Boil noodles and drain and cool. Step 3: Make in 3 individual glasses You will be dividing all ingredients between 3 glasses, add noodles. Step 4: Add kulfi cut in small pieces, add basil seeds, add rose syrup, add milk.

Dish Name: Fathers Day Special Cashew Caramel Burfi
Ingredient Names: cashews, sugar, cardamom powder, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the cashewnuts in water for 2 hours Grind to a fine paste. Step 2: Keep aside Powder the sugar in a mixer. Step 3: In a heavy-base pan, pour 1 1 / 2 tbsp ghee and then the cashewnut paste along with 2 cups of powdered sugar. Step 4: Keep on mixing for about 10 minutes till the paste and sugar make a solid lump. Step 5: Add the cardamom powder and the rest of the ghee. Step 6: Mix again In the meantime, in another pan, put half cup of powdered sugar and fry for 2-3 minutes till it gets caramelised i E the sugar will turn brownish.

Ingredient Names: pineapple, sugar, ground cumin, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, black pepper, fresh ginger, salt, lemon, chile, red onion, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and core pineapple, cut into small pieces. Step 2: Puree 2 cups of it and set the rest aside. Step 3: Combine the puree, sugar, spices, ginger, salt and lemon juice in a medium saucepan. Step 4: Bring the mixture to a boil, then cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring as needed, to make a pineapple syrup. Step 5: Add the pineapple chunks, chilies, and red onion. Step 6: Reduce the heat a little and cook over medium low heat for 25 minutes The puree and the pineapple chunks will blend together with the chunks retaining some of their texture Move the chutney to a bowl and let it sit for 1-2 hours before serving It will keep for at least a week in the refrigerator but don't add the mint until your'e ready to serve it Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: potato, onions, green chilies, gingerroot, frozen peas, turmeric powder, salt, coriander leaves, water, oil, mustard seeds, asafoetida powder, black gram dal, bengal gram dal, dried red chili
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes in their skin in a pressure cooker for 3-4 pressures or in a pan of boiling water until tender You can microwave them in a sandwich bag, with 2-3 tbs Water, for 6-8 minutes You must leave a hole for the steam to escape, otherwise, the bag may splode ). Step 2: Allow to cool, peel and break roughly into small pieces. Step 3: Keep aside Tempering & making the filling: Heat oil in a wok. Step 4: Add mustard seeds, asafoetida powder, chana and urad dal, and let the seeds splutter.

Dish Name: Fire Roasted Eggplant Aubergine With Yogurt
Ingredient Names: globe eggplant, yogurt, cilantro leaves, red onions, fresh green chile, chili powder, mustard seeds, canola oil, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Smoke the eggplant This can be done under the broiler, on an open flame or on an outdoor grill First wash the eggplant and dry thoroughly. Step 2: Using a small knife, pierce the skin all over and rub lightly with the 1 tbsp of oil. Step 3: Place the eggplant on an open flame or under the broiler. Step 4: Turn frequently so it blackens evenly on all sides It is ready when soft and collapses on itself when touched remove in a bowl and set aside While the eggplant is cooling, prepare the yogurt. Step 5: In a serving dish, lightly beat the yogurt with a pinch of sugar and salt to taste. Step 6: Then stir in the chopped onion and cilantro and the green chili.

Dish Name: Five Colour Pretty Indian Pulao Pilaf
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, onions, fresh carrot, french beans, yellow bell pepper, cauliflower florets, green peas, oil, cinnamon, green cardamoms, cloves, black peppercorns, bay leaves, cumin seed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak rice in 4 cups of water for 30 minutes, drain. Step 2: Heat ghee or oil in a skillet on medium flame. Step 3: Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, whole black peppercorns, bay leaves and cumin seeds, stir-fry briefly, add onions. Step 4: Saute for 3 minutes or until translucent. Step 5: Add carrots, french beans, cauliflower and greenpeas. Step 6: Cook for a minute, stirring continuosly. Step 7: Add 3 1 / 4 cups of water and salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, urad dal, masoor dal, toor dal, mung dal, water, turmeric, cayenne pepper, oil, onion, garlic clove, cumin seed, garam masala, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse dals. Step 2: Bring water to boil in large pot. Step 3: Add dals, stir, and bring back to boil. Step 4: Remove from heat, cover, and let sit 2 hours. Step 5: Add turmeric and cayenne to dal and bring water to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat slightly and simmer until dal is tender, approximately 35 minutes 10-15 minutes before dal is ready, begin cooking spice mixture. Step 7: Heat oil in heavy skillet or saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 8: When hot, add onion and garlic and fry 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 9: Add cumin and garam masala and cook another minute.

Dish Name: Flat Rice Bread From Southern India Uttapam
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, white lentils, salt, sugar, baking soda, onion, diced tomato, green chili pepper, fresh cilantro leaves, ghee, vegetable oil, dried red chilies, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, grated fresh coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice and lentils separately in several changes of water. Step 2: Leave each to soak in a large pan of clean water for a couple of hours. Step 3: Drain the rice and lentils, place in a blender, and grind to a smooth paste. Step 4: Add a little water to form a thick batter. Step 5: Add the salt, sugar and baking soda to the batter and mix well. Step 6: Set aside to ferment at room temperature for at least 4 hours and up to 15. Step 7: Place the chopped onion, diced tomatoes, chopped green chile, and chopped cilantro in separate bowls. Step 8: Heat a griddle or nonstick pan. Step 9: Brush with a little ghee or oil and pour in 2 to 3 tablespoons of the batter. Step 10: Spread evenly with the back of a spoon into a thick circle 4 inches in diameter.

Dish Name: Flavors Of India Spiced Pumpkin Bread
Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, butter, onion, curry powder, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, unbleached all-purpose flour, cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, pumpkin puree, serrano peppers, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: To puree pumpkin, peel the pumpkin and cut into cubes approximately 2-inches in size. Step 2: Boil the cubes in salted water until tender, 10-12 minutes. Step 3: Drain the pumpkin and then puree it in a food processor. Step 4: Allow it to cool completely For the bread: first, you will want to preheat your oven to 350 degrees f Butter a loaf pan. Step 5: Heat a small heavy skillet, and add the cumin seeds allowing them to toast just until they are aromatic Do not allow them to brown or burn. Step 6: Remove seeds from skillet and set aside In the same skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of butter and add the onion, curry powder, ground cumin, cayenne, and salt.

Ingredient Names: long-grain rice, water, butter, onion, broccoli floret, tomato paste, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice well. Step 2: In a saucepan, cover the rice with 1 cup water, add a little salt, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Now lower the flame, cover the saucepan with a lid, leaving a small gap for the steam to escape, and cook for about 15 minutes or until the rice is cooked While the rice is cooking, melt butter in a skillet and saute the onions on medium-high heat until browned. Step 4: Remove onions from the skillet and reduce the flame to low. Step 5: Add 1 / 3 cup water to the same skillet, salt to taste, and cook the broccoli in it for about 5 minutes. Step 6: Now add the tomato paste, mix well, and cook for another minute or so. Step 7: When all the water has evaporated, add the browned onions and the cooked rice to the skillet and mix well. Step 8: Heat through for a minute, add salt to taste, and turn off the burner. Step 9: Add a dash of pepper and serve hot!

Ingredient Names: digestive biscuits, low-fat butter, low-fat cream cheese, low-fat yogurt, sugar substitute, lemon juice, lemon zest, lemon essence, sugar-free orange marmalade
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the low fat butter and biscuits in a bowl. Step 2: Mix well with your fingers and then put these into the bottom of a 4 inch diameter loose bottomed cake tin. Step 3: Refrigerate till this sets. Step 4: Now, blend the cream cheese till it is lump free and smooth in a blender You may add some warm milk or whey if need be. Step 5: Combine with the remaining ingredients in a bowl and whisk till it has a smooth mixture. Step 6: Combine the marmalade and 1 tablespoons water in a pan. Step 7: Melt on low heat and allow to cool a little. Step 8: Pour the cheesecake mixture over the set crust and refrigerate till the mixture sets. Step 9: Pour the warm topping over and chill again for 10-15 minutes.

Dish Name: For Diabetics Veg Chinese Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: rice, french beans, carrot, red capsicum, celery, spring onions, soya sauce, olive oil, salt, green chili
Instructions: Step 1: Boil rice in 2 cups of water Ensure that each grain of cooked rice is separate. Step 2: Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Step 3: Add all the veggies except the spring onion greens. Step 4: Sprinkle 2 tbsps Water and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the rice, soya sauce, spring onion greens and salt. Step 6: Mix well and saute for 2 minutes. Step 7: Serve hot with chillies in vinegar Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, salt, ground cardamom, turmeric, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, saffron, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan Bring to a boil, and stir Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes Remove from heat and let rice stand 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Fragrant Indian Spiced Potatoes And Chickpeas 5Fix
Ingredient Names: simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion, garam masala, chickpeas, tomatoes with spicy red pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large, non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add potatoes and garam masala, and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Add chickpeas and diced tomatoes Scrape up any browned bits that have adhered to the pan. Step 4: Stir and bring to a low boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 25 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle with chopped cilantro to serve.

Dish Name: Fresh And Good For Health Tomato Bell Pepper And Corn Salad
Ingredient Names: whole kernel corn, fresh tomatoes, green bell peppers, onion, low-fat plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix / toss together all the ingredients in a large glass bowl cover and chill for as little as 2 hours or as long as 24 hours! Step 2: Serve on a bed of fresh green iceberg lettuce and enjoy it to the fullest!

Ingredient Names: cucumber, spring onions, mint leaf, garlic, ginger, salt, lemon juice, sugar, toasted sesame seeds, oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel cucumber and cut in half. Step 2: Cut halves into quarters lengthwise. Step 3: Cut each quarter into strip and cut strips finely. Step 4: Wash and slice onions finely. Step 5: Chop mint leaves Crush garlic, peel and chop finely. Step 6: Mix cucumber, onion, mint, ginger and garlic together with salt, lemon juice, sugar, sesame seeds and oils. Step 7: Serve with cold meats, fish, or as a topping for crackers or with bread and cheese.

Ingredient Names: berries, sugar, lime juice, water, ice cube, club soda, lime slice
Instructions: Step 1: Place berries, sugar & lime juice in a small sauce pan & cook over medium heat until the sugar melts and berries are soft, about 5 minutes Process in a blender o food processor and then pass over a very fine Mesh strainer. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 cup water to the seeds and strain more to get all the juices Retur all the juice to the pan and bring to boil once more. Step 3: Divide into 2 glasses, add ice and, club soda to taste, garnish with lime slices & serve.

Ingredient Names: channa dal, panir, onions, tomatoes, cinnamon sticks, black cardamom pods, cloves, bay leaves, red chile, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander, fresh ginger, garlic, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chana dal and soak for 2 hours, grate onions, chop coriander. Step 2: Make ginger-garlic paste, chop tomatoes. Step 3: Cut paneer into cubes and fry. Step 4: Heat oil in a cooker. Step 5: Fry onions till light brown. Step 6: Add ginger-garlic paste, cinnamon, cardamoms, cloves, bay leaves and red chilli. Step 7: Add tomatoes and fry.

Ingredient Names: bitter gourd, salt, rice flour, besan flour, red chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Slice each piece of bitter gourd into fairly thin half-moon shape. Step 2: Transfer them to a colander and sprinkle the salt over Shake the colander to distribute the salt evenly. Step 3: Leave to rest for about an hour or so. Step 4: Squeeze out as much moisture as possible from the bitter gourd pieces and dry them on paper towels. Step 5: Transfer to a ziploc bag or a big bowl. Step 6: Mix the seasoning ingredients together and sprinkle over the pieces Shake the bag or bowl so that the seasoning is distributed evenly over the pieces. Step 7: Heat the oil in a wok, and fry the bitter gourd pieces in batches to a crisp brown. Step 8: Drain on paper towels and try not to eat them all like i just did.

Ingredient Names: onion, sesame oil, braggs liquid aminos, cooked brown rice, pineapple, tomatoes, raisins, curry powder, ground turmeric, sea salt, black pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, on medium heat, saute the onions in the sesame oil until the onions are translucent. Step 2: Add the braggs, cooked rice, pineapple, tomato, raisins, curry powder, and turmeric. Step 3: Mix thoroughly and cook for 6-8 minutes or until all ingredients are heated throughout. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper and garnish with cilantro Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, olive oil, onions, green pepper, garlic, ginger, curry powder, tomato sauce, coconut milk, whole cloves, cardamom, cinnamon stick, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and saut tofu pieces until crispy and browned. Step 2: Remove tofu from skillet and set aside Saut onion and green pepper until onion is translucent then add ginger and garlic. Step 3: Cook for 2 to 3 min until fragrant, then stir in the curry powder. Step 4: Return tofu to skillet and add tomato sauce, coconut milk, cloves, cardamom and cinnamon stick. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper And stir all together. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Dish Name: Friendly On The Waistline Bread Delight
Ingredient Names: white bread, honey, oats, carrots, cucumbers
Instructions: Step 1: Apply honey on one side of a bread slice, add oats over it. Step 2: Add shredded carrot and grated cucumber over the oats. Step 3: Pour and spread 1 tbsp Honey over this. Step 4: Top with the other bread slice Pick it up and start eating!

Ingredient Names: yogurt, ice water, milk, ground cardamom, rose water, mangoes, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients, except almonds, in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth Serve with ice cubes and sprinkle with almonds Enjoy!
