Ingredient Names: mixed fruit, caster sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice, mango essence, whole milk, vanilla custard powder, sugar, butter, bread, condensed milk, coconut, pomegranate, cherries
Instructions: Step 1: For the fruit salad: combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Refrigerate until served For the custard sauce: mix custard powder, sugar and 1 cup milk into a mixture, free of lumps, keep aside. Step 3: In a deep glass dish, microwave leftover milk on high for 5 minutes uncovered. Step 4: Stir once in between. Step 5: Add custard solution, mix and microwave on medium for 7 minutes uncovered. Step 6: Stir once in between. Step 7: Cool the mixture and refrigerate until served Coconut fingers: remove the brown edges of the bread and cut them into 2 lengthwise.

Ingredient Names: fruit, curds, honey, orange juice, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the curd, honey and orange juice place fruit in bowl and pour the curd mixture over fruits. Step 2: Keep in the refrigerator till it is time to serve. Step 3: Serve individual bowls and top with grated coconut.

Ingredient Names: ghee, carrot, evaporated milk, sugar, khoya, almonds, water, saffron, cardamom powder, edible silver foil
Instructions: Step 1: Grate khoya and keep aside. Step 2: Combine carrots and milk in a large heavy based pan, bring to a boil. Step 3: Lower the heat and cook the carrots, stirring constantly, until all the milk dries up. Step 4: Pour ghee into the carrots, add khoya. Step 5: Saute for a few minutes. Step 6: Add sugar Continue to cook and stir the carrot mixture till it dries. Step 7: Remove from heat when still moist.

Ingredient Names: carrots, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, cardamom pods, ghee, powdered milk
Instructions: Step 1: Cook evaporated milk, cadamom pods, and carrots in a heavy deep saucepan and bring it to boil then reduce heat. Step 2: Cook over medium heat until all the milk gets dried up. Step 3: Stir the mixture occasionally to prevent any sticking. Step 4: Add sweetened condensed milk and ghee and let the mixture dry. Step 5: When it is close to dry and carrots are soft add powdered milk. Step 6: Mix with a little water to make a paste.

Dish Name: Garam Masala Aromatic Kashmiri Spice Blend For Spicy Cooking
Ingredient Names: green cardamom pods, whole cloves, black cardamom pods, cinnamon sticks, black cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fennel seed, black peppercorns, fenugreek seeds, whole nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Bash the nutmeg in a plastic bag with a rolling pin to break it into several smaller pieces! Step 2: Remove the seeds from the cardamom pods - again, a gentle bash with a rolling pin will suffice, or use a pestle and mortar. Step 3: Place all the spices in a dry-frying pan or skillet and heat over a very low heat, stirring constantly As soon as the aroma from the spices is released, remove the pan from the heat Working with only a small quantity at a time, put the spices in an electric blender or coffee grinder and grind them to a fine powder, allow to cool. Step 4: Store the garam masala in an air-tight container As long as the container is tightly closed after each use, it should last for about 2 - 3 months with no adverse affects to the flavour and fragrance Use as directed in recipes that call for garam masala.

Dish Name: Garam Masala Sauteed Portobello Mushroom Curry In Porcini Cream
Ingredient Names: dried porcini mushrooms, water, canola oil, onion, flour, whipping cream, dried fenugreek leaves, salt, cayenne, portabella mushrooms, asafoetida powder, mango powder, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Porcini cream: soak dried porcinis in 1 cup of hot water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat& fry onions, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in flour& cook, stirring constantly, until light brown, about a minute. Step 4: Add porcinis with their soaking liquid, along with remaining ingredients& bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low& simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened& reduced to 2 cups, about 20 minutes Mushrooms: remove stems from portobellos& slice each cap into 6 pieces. Step 6: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Sprinkle in asafetida powder& let sizzle for 30 seconds Immediately, stir in remaining spices& fry until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Add mushroom caps& fry, stirring often, until browned& bendable if lifted, about 7 minutes.

Ingredient Names: garbanzo beans, ghee, onion, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, cumin powder, turmeric, coriander powder, chili powder, garam masala, coriander leaves, lemon slice
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onions, add garlic and ginger in ghee. Step 2: Fry for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add tomatoes, and cumin, coriander, turmeric and chili powders, and salt to taste. Step 4: Cook for another 5 minutes. Step 5: Add garbanzo beans, boil for a few minutes. Step 6: Add garam masala, let mixture simmer, remove from stove. Step 7: Serve garnished with coriander leaves and lemon slices.

Dish Name: Garbanzo Stew With Peanut Rice Cooking Light
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, tomatoes, sugar, curry powder, salt, ground turmeric, ground red pepper, garbanzo beans, garam masala, fresh cilantro, water, basmati rice, dry roasted peanuts, tiny peas
Instructions: Step 1: Garbanzo stew: heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, and saute 5 minutes or until tender. Step 3: Stir in tomato and next 5 ingredients. Step 4: Cook 8 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Stir in garbanzo beans and garam masala for 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Step 6: Sprinkle each service with 1 tablespoon cilantro. Step 7: Serve over peanut rice Peanut rice: bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Step 8: Add rice, salt, and turmeric. Step 9: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onions, garlic, new potato, mixed vegetables, paprika, turmeric, fenugreek seeds, fresh ginger, salt, green chilies, water, tamarind paste, garam masala, cardamom seed
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large, deep skillet, add the onion and garlic, and lower the heat to medium. Step 3: Fry at medium-high heat until the onion starts to brown. Step 4: Set aside, off the heat. Step 5: Drop the potatoes in the boiling water and boil 10 minutes. Step 6: Drain and set aside. Step 7: Slice the vegetables about 1 / 2 inch thick. Step 8: Place the skillet with the onion back on low heat and add paprika, turmeric, fenugreek, ginger, salt, and green chiles Reheat until sizzling a bit and add 2 / 3 c water. Step 9: Stir in the vegetables and the potatoes.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic, canola oil, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add crushed garlic Wait for a few seconds and turn the heat off. Step 2: Toss tomatoes, hot oil with garlic, salt and black pepper powder and spread on greased baking tray. Step 3: Keep in the preheated oven for 7-10 minutes. Step 4: Serve warm with any dish of your choice!

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, olive oil, parsley, salt, mini pita pockets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Combine the first four ingredients and mix well. Step 3: Arrange pitas on baking sheet. Step 4: Drizzle teaspoonful of garlic / oil mixture over each pita, spreading it to the edges with the back of the spoon Broil for a couple of minutes to lightly brown, but be careful not to burn Chow down with sue ls recipe #47590 or your favorite hummous!, murp.

Ingredient Names: tamarind pulp, hot water, salt, curry leaves, garlic, oil, red chilies, black peppercorns, coriander seeds, bengal gram dal, cumin seed, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: First, soak the tamarind in 2 cups hot water for 15 minutes. Step 2: Strain the tamarind water into another container squeezing as much liquid out of it as you can While the tamarind is soaking, heat the oil in a heavy skillet and add the ingredients in the paste. Step 3: Cook 2-3 minutes or until the seeds begin to smell wonderful and toast. Step 4: Blend to a find paste in a blender or coffee grinder. Step 5: Now, add the salt and curry leaves to the tamarind water and heat for 15 minutes or so until the raw smell disappears. Step 6: Meanwhile, saut the garlic cloves in oil until golden. Step 7: Add garlic and paste to the tamarind liquid and simmer until well blended In the last seconds before serving heat 2 tsp oil on the stove, add mustard seeds and red chilies. Step 8: When the mustard seeds turn grey and begin to pop add mixture to soup.

Ingredient Names: garlic-infused olive oil, salt, black pepper, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 180c Warm the oil slightly. Step 2: Add salt and pepper, toss in the nuts. Step 3: Mix well Immediately spread out the oiled walnuts onto a baking sheet lined onto a baking tray. Step 4: Bake for 15-20 minutes, stirring and tossing the nuts frequently, until the nuts are light brown. Step 5: Cool the nuts completely. Step 6: Store in a tightly covered jar.

Ingredient Names: mung dal, dal, onion, chopped tomato, oil, salt, turmeric powder, cumin seed, garlic, ginger, coriander powder, red chili powder, green chili pepper, garam masala, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Pick over dry dal for grit. Step 2: Rinse a couple of times and drain. Step 3: Bring to boil about 3 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan. Step 4: Add dal to hot water. Step 5: Stir in salt and turmeric powder Partially cover and simmer on medium heat until dal is tender, 30 to 45 minutes To saut, heat the oil in a small skillet on medium heat. Step 6: Add cumin seeds As soon as they change color, add garlic and onions. Step 7: Stir, sprinkling little water if needed, until onions are golden brown.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, salt, baking powder, cumin seed, chili powder, water, garlic cloves, onion, button mushrooms, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the gram flour, salt, baking powder, cumin and chilli in a bowl. Step 2: Make a well in the centre and add the water, mixing well to for a smooth batter. Step 3: Add the garlic and onion to the batter and mix inches leave the mixture to stand for ten mins while you wipe and trim your mushrooms. Step 4: Mix the mushrooms into the batter and stir to coat. Step 5: Heat enough oil to cover the pakoras in a pan to about 180c. Step 6: Once the oil is hot fry a few pakoras at a time until golden brown. Step 7: Drain and keep warm. Step 8: Serve with salt and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: red chili peppers, red bell peppers, cider vinegar, sugar, liquid pectin
Instructions: Step 1: Puree peppers and 1 cup vinegar in blender. Step 2: Combine puree 1 cup vinegar and sugar in a large saucepan. Step 3: Bring to a rolling boil and boil for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Step 4: Stir in pectin and return to a rolling boil for 1 minute. Step 5: Remove from stove and skim foam Ladle hot jelly into clean hot jars, leaving 1 / 4 inch head space Adjust caps process 10 minutes in boiling water canner. Step 6: Let set at room temperature for 24 hours out of drafts. Step 7: Store for up to 1 year.

Ingredient Names: salted butter, fresh ginger, garlic, lemon juice, fresh parsley, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare a paste of ginger and garlic in your mixer / blender bowl. Step 2: Combine butter, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and parsley, mix well. Step 3: Line a small square or rectangular butter dish with clingfilm. Step 4: Spoon the butter onto it Freeze. Step 5: When it has frozen into shape, remove it from the dish alongwith the clingfilm. Step 6: Store refrigerated for 1 week or in the freezer for upto 2 months.

Dish Name: Gluten Free Naan Roti Indian Flat Bread Version 1
Ingredient Names: whole milk, rice flour, tapioca flour, salt, gluten free baking powder, caster sugar, active dry yeast, vegetable oil, plain yogurt, egg, xanthan gum, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix tepid milk with 1 teaspoon sugar and the yeast, then sit bowl in warm place for 4-5 minutes Sift the flours, xanthan gum, salt, baking powder into a bowl or food mixer. Step 2: Add remaining sugar, oil, yogurt, egg and mix until smooth. Step 3: Preheat oven to the highest setting. Step 4: Make dough into 6 equal sized balls. Step 5: Roll out balls into a tear shape that is inch thick. Step 6: Preheat a heavy baking tray in oven. Step 7: Remove tray and put the naan on it. Step 8: Return to the oven for 3 minutes or until the naan puffs up and turns light brown. Step 9: Place tray under the broiler 30 seconds to 1 minute for extra browning.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lime, grape tomatoes, red onion, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients except olive oil in bowl and toss gently to combine. Step 2: Taste and add more cayenne or salt and pepper if required. Step 3: Add olive oil and toss again. Step 4: Refrigerate for 2-3 hours to allow the flavours to develop.

Dish Name: Goan Black Eyed Peas Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: dried black-eyed peas, tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, thai peppers, ground coriander, salt, ground turmeric, ground cumin, brown sugar, water, coconut milk, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put the black-eyed peas in the slow cooker - no need to presoak Peel and chop the tomatoes Grind together the tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic and chiles in a food processor. Step 2: Add to slow cooker. Step 3: Add the coriander, salt, turmeric, cumin and sugar to the slow cooker. Step 4: Add the water and give it a stir. Step 5: Cook on high for 7 hours Just before it's done, stir in the coconut milk and let it heat through, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Garnish with cilantro. Step 7: Serve with bread, naan, or rice, or on its own as a soup.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, tomato puree, red chili powder, garam masala powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, oil, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Remove stalk from cauliflowers. Step 2: Boil cauliflower in salted water with 1 tsp Turmeric powder till half cooked. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 4: Add onions and saute until golden brown in colour. Step 5: Add ginger and garlic pastes, cumin powder, coriander powder, 1 tsp Turmeric powder, garam masala powder and salt. Step 6: Stir for half a minute, add tomato puree. Step 7: Cook till oil leaves the masala.

Dish Name: Gobi Ki Sabzi Dry Cauliflower Curry
Ingredient Names: cauliflower, oil, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, onions, ginger paste, garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric powder, chopped tomatoes, salt, coriander leaves, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Step 2: Heat oil on medium high heat in a large pan or wok and add the cumin seeds. Step 3: When they start to make a noise, add the asafoetida and stir for a few seconds. Step 4: Add the chopped onions and saute till they turn clear. Step 5: Put in the ginger and garlic pastes and fry till lightly golden. Step 6: Add the chilli and turmeric powder and fry for a minute. Step 7: Add the cauliflower, salt and tomatoes and mix well. Step 8: Cover and cook till the cauliflower is done. Step 9: Add the chopped coriander leaves and the garam masala and mix well. Step 10: Taste and add salt if needed.

Dish Name: Goddess Blessed Vegetarian Chocolate Clusters With Orange Rind
Ingredient Names: honey-nougat chocolate bar, toblerone chocolate bar, walnuts, orange rind
Instructions: Step 1: Place the honey-nougat chocolate and white chocolate separately in heat-proof bowls. Step 2: Place each bowl over a pan of simmering water. Step 3: Stir and melt the chocolate until smooth. Step 4: Set aside to let it cool. Step 5: Mix the orange rind into the honey-nougat chocolate. Step 6: Mix in the walnuts into the white melted chocolate. Step 7: Place a spoonful of mixtures{of the dark and white chocolates} separately into the small paper baking cups You need 35-40 small baking paper cups. Step 8: Leave to set in the refrigerator for sometime. Step 9: Store in an airtight container in a cool and dry place.

Ingredient Names: toor dal, coconut milk, jaggery, curry leaf, asafoetida powder, oil, garam masala, cumin seed, tamarind pulp
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the dal in a pan. Step 2: Add the coconut milk and boil Next add the jaggery and tamarind water. Step 3: Then add garam masala and salt. Step 4: Heat oil in a separate pan. Step 5: Add cumin seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida. Step 6: Fry till cumin seeds begin to splutter. Step 7: Pour this mixture into the boiling dal. Step 8: Cover and cook on low heat. Step 9: Garnish with chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: white flour, semolina, cooking oil, red chili powder, fresh mint leaves, cumin, salt, black salt, water, green chilies, fresh ginger, tamarind paste, chickpeas, potato, green pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Directions for gol gappay. Step 2: Mix the white flour and semolina together and knead into a hard dough. Step 3: Set aside Flatten into a very thin sheet and cut into 2" diameter circles with a cookie cutter Deep fry in cooking oil until golden Directions for dip. Step 4: Combine all of the ingredients for the dip together in a grinder and grind well. Step 5: Then strain any liquid from the ground mixture. Step 6: Set aside the liquid that was strained disregard the strained ingredients To eat, punch a hole in the gol gappay, put some juice inside the gol gappay and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, water, cumin seed, turmeric, cloves, onions, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except salt in a large pot and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce to a gentle simmer, cover and let cook 15-20 minutes If you want to do it the really indian way, stir in the salt partway through Personally i never add the salt, but you could probably just add it at the start. Step 3: Check after 15 minute and let it continue to cook till the water's gone If it starts to stick on the bottom don't worry. Step 4: Take it off the heat. Step 5: Let the rice sit, mostly covered, for 7-10 minutes This time will allow the rice to firm a litle, and none will be stuck to the pot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, curry powder, ground cumin, garlic cloves, salt, water, chickpeas, potatoes, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: In frying pan, heat oil over medium-high heat and saute onions about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add curry powder, cumin, garlic, salt and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 3: Cook until onions are soft. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients, reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender Additional liquid may be required to prevent scorching. Step 5: Serve on top of steamed white rice or brown rice.

Ingredient Names: onions, vegetable oil, ground cumin, turmeric, ground coriander, fresh ginger, yellow split peas, water, sweet potatoes, apple, cinnamon, chili powder, chopped tomato, lime juice, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a soup pot, saut the onions in the oil for about 8 minutes, until golden, stirring frequently. Step 2: Add the cumin, turmeric, coriander and ginger and cook for another minute. Step 3: Add the split peas, water, sweet potatoes, apples, cinnamon, and chili powder, cover and bring to a boil. Step 4: Lower the heat and simmer for 40 minutes, or until the split peas are tender. Step 5: In a bowl, combine the tomatoes, lime juice and soy sauce. Step 6: When the split peas are tender, add the tomato mixture. Step 7: Puree the soup in a blender or with a stick blender, adding more water if needed.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, whole wheat bread, olive oil, dried rosemary, tomatoes, cucumbers, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, lemon juice, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash lettuce under running water. Step 2: Drain and allow to dry Tear into bite-sized pieces and refrigerate. Step 3: Cut bread into cubes. Step 4: Drizzle with 1 tbsp Of olive oil, dried rosemary and continue to roast on low flame Scald red, yellow and green bell pepper Immediately dip in cold water. Step 5: Drain, peel off skin and cut them into cubes. Step 6: In a large bowl, mix together the cucumbers, tomatoes, red, yellow and green bell pepper and the lettuce leaves.

Ingredient Names: ghee, gram flour, flour, sugar, water, yellow food coloring, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a pan on medium flame. Step 2: When hot, spoon ghee into it, allow to melt. Step 3: Add gramflour and flour. Step 4: Cook till the rawness of the gramflour is gone This will take about 20 minutes You will know when it's done when you see bubbles on the sides of the pan. Step 5: When this happens, remove the pan from heat and keep aside. Step 6: Now, put sugar in another pan. Step 7: Add water and yellow food colour.

Dish Name: Green Beans Thoran Green Beans With Coconut
Ingredient Names: green beans, shallot, hot green chili pepper, garlic, coconut, ground cumin, ground turmeric, vegetable oil, brown mustard seeds, white rice, curry leaves, dried hot red chili pepper, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, string beans if necessary, make several bundles and slice them crosswise into 1 / 4-inch segments Coarsely grind the shallots, green chilies, garlic, coconut, cumin and turmeric in a food processor or blender, and set to one side. Step 2: Place the oil in a wok or large skillet, which has a lid, and heat over a medium-high flame. Step 3: Add the mustard seeds and rice, and stir and saute for a few seconds until the mustard seeds begin to pop and splutter and the rice swells and turns golden. Step 4: Add the curry leaves and red chili, and after a few more seconds, when the chilli swells and darkens, add the green beans Continue to stir and fry for 2-3 minutes, then roughly pile them into a mound in the cooking vessel Form a hole in the center of the mound and place within it the coarsely ground spices. Step 5: Now cover over the spices with some of the beans, season with salt, and add the water to the pan Immediately cover with a lid, reduce the heat to low, and cook approximately 10 minutes until the beans are tender. Step 6: Mix all the ingredients together well, and serve hot.

Dish Name: Green Beans With Cumin And Fennel
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, whole cumin seed, fennel seed, shallots, garlic clove, fresh ginger, green beans, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, cayenne, water, salt, tomatoes, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil in a large frying pan and set over medium-high heat. Step 2: When very hot, add the whole cumin and fennel seeds. Step 3: Stir for a few seconds Quickly add the shallots, garlic, and ginger. Step 4: Stir for about a minute, or until lightly browned. Step 5: Add the beans and stir for another 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the coriander, cumin, turmeric, and cayenne and stir a few times. Step 7: Add 1 / 2 cup water and the salt and bring to a simmer, stir and cover. Step 8: Turn the heat down to low and cook gently for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, water, dried lentils, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, salt, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a saucepan on a low flame and add the mustard seeds. Step 2: When they begin to sputter, add the chopped french beans, lentils, salt, turmeric powder and water The water should be sufficient to cover the beans, so add some more if necessary. Step 3: Cover the saucepan tightly and cook on a low flame for about 30 minutes or until the beans are well cooked. Step 4: Check to see that the water is sufficient every 10 minutes, with stirring, and add more water if necessary. Step 5: After 30 minutes most of the water should have evaporated Switch off burner, remove from flame and serve hot.

Dish Name: Green Chilies Stuffed And Fried Set Your Mouth On Fire
Ingredient Names: green chilies, graham flour, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, mango powder, asafoetida powder, roasted cumin seeds, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Take 1 / 2 a tsp of oil and add the asafoetida, besan and the cumin, red chilli, dry mango powder and turmeric and cook on a very low flame, till the flour and cumin turn a golden brown in colour. Step 2: Fill this mixture in the deseeded and slit green chillies. Step 3: Heat 2 tsp oil in a fry pan, put the stuffed green chillies and cook for a while till the chillies get a little soft Cry me a river!

Ingredient Names: green curry paste, coconut milk, evaporated milk, soy sauce, gingerroot, kaffir lime leaves, vegetables, cooked white rice, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan or wok bring the curry paste, coconut milk and evaporated milk to a simmer. Step 2: Stir in soy sauce, ginger, lime leaves or zest and vegetables. Step 3: Simmer until tender, about 5 to 8 minutes. Step 4: Remove and discard the lime leaves. Step 5: Serve the curry over rice or noodles. Step 6: Garnish with the basil leaves Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: green chili, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, creamed coconut, coriander, mint, salt, caster sugar, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Put the chilies, ginger, garlic and creamed coconut into a food processor and make into a paste. Step 2: Add the coriander and mint and pulse until they are blended. Step 3: Add the salt and sugar With the motor still running, pour the juice of 2 5 of the limes down the funnel, processing to mix thoroughly. Step 4: Taste to see if the juice of the other 5 lime is needed This can be kept for up to a month in a sealed jar in the fridge It will solidify due to the creamed coconut, but can be restored by bringing back to room temperate, blitzing and adding a little more lime juice if needs be.

Ingredient Names: potato, green beans, zucchini, spinach, ghee, onions, garlic cloves, ground turmeric, coriander powder, ground cumin, cayenne, hot paprika, ground black pepper, ground cinnamon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub the potatoes, quarter lengthwise, and thickly slice each quarter. Step 2: Boil in salted water for 5 minutes, drain, and set aside Trim the green beans, cut into 1-inch lengths, boil in salted water for 5 minutes, drain, and set aside Thickly slice zucchini, boil in salted water for 3-4 minutes, drain, and set aside. Step 3: Wash and coarsely chop spinach and set aside. Step 4: Heat ghee or oil in a large pot Peel, halve, and thickly slice the onions Mince the garlic or squeeze through a garlic press. Step 5: Saute onions and garlic in ghee until just turning light golden color. Step 6: Add all the dry spices to the onions.

Ingredient Names: water, fennel seed, sugar, tea leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water with fennel seeds for a good 2-3 minutes. Step 2: Add tea leaves, turn off the heat and let the same stand. Step 3: Add sugar and enjoy U can add a dash of milk if you want!

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, lemonade, sugar syrup, peppermint extract, green food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Add all the ingredients in a tall glass decorate with a cherry and serve chilled Variation: instead of mint use khus syrup.

Dish Name: Green Lentils With Garlic Onion Madhur Jaffrey
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, whole cumin seed, garlic cloves, onion, green lentil, water, salt, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy pot over a medium flame. Step 2: When hot, put in the cumin seeds A few seconds later, put in the garlic. Step 3: Stir and fry until the garlic pieces turn a medium brown colour. Step 4: Now put in the onion. Step 5: Stir and fry until the onion pieces begin to turn brown at the edges. Step 6: Put in the lentils and the water, bring to the boil. Step 7: Cover, turn heat to low and simmer for about an hour or until lentils are tender. Step 8: Add the salt and the cayenne.

Ingredient Names: frozen green peas, ghee, rice, onion, cloves, cinnamon stick, dried red chili, green cardamoms, garlic, minced ginger, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the two cups of rice in water until just done Do not over cook this or you will have mush for dinner. Step 2: Drain the rice in a colander In the mean time fry the onions on med heat in ghee until golden brown. Step 3: Add the ginger garlic and the green peas. Step 4: Stir fry for a minute, add the spices. Step 5: Add the chili otherwise leave it whole. Step 6: Stir fry till the peas are done. Step 7: Add the salt and then gently add the rice.

Ingredient Names: frozen spinach, carrot, dried split peas, broth, tomato juice, water, garlic, onion, tomatoes, jalapenos, spices, vegetable oil, curry powder, turmeric, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Over high heat in a large soup pot, combine 1 / 2 tbs of the ghee or oil, garlic, minced pepper, and tomato slice. Step 2: Saute over high heat until close to burning. Step 3: Add 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 the spice mixture and the rest of the oil, if you need to. Step 4: Saute until spices are slightly roasted and everything is nice and melded. Step 5: Add the tomato juice and water, allow to come to a boil. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 of the remaining spice mixture and the split peas. Step 7: Simmer for 30-35 minutes. Step 8: Add carrots and last of the spice mixture. Step 9: Simmer for 10-15 minutes. Step 10: Mash the split peas with a spoon or potato masher, or use a blender, then return to the pot.

Ingredient Names: green tea, saffron, cardamoms, blanched almonds, cinnamon stick, cloves, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 3 cups of water along with cinnamon, cardamom and cloves and pour over the tea. Step 2: Leave to infuse over a very low flame for 10 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, dissolve saffron in a little water by rubbing it gently. Step 4: Strain the tea and add the saffron liquid together with almonds Sweeten if you like and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: green tomato, oil, fenugreek seeds, cumin seed, green chili peppers, chili powder, ground coriander, turmeric powder, mango powder, salt, sugar, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and quarter the tomatoes, if they are very large, halve the quarters again. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan. Step 3: Add the fenugreek and cumin seeds. Step 4: When they start to crackle add the tomatoes and green chilies, fry this for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add everything else except the garlic, stir, cover and cook for approx 6 minutes. Step 6: Uncover, add the garlic, turn up the heat and stir fry for 2 / 3 minutes, you will see that the oil which was separating first will now blend and make it more saucy together with the juices from the tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro leaves, spring onions, green chilies, garlic, fresh ginger, salt, sugar, garam masala, lemon juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Seed and roughly chop the chillies Crush the garlic with the salt. Step 2: Place these and the remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender and work until smooth Pack into a small dish, cover and chill until ready to use.

Ingredient Names: buttermilk, gram flour, salt, green chili paste, ghee, asafoetida powder, cumin seed, clove, cinnamon stick, curry leaves, jaggery, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together besan and yogurt thoroughly. Step 2: Add 4 cups water and mix again Peel, wash and cut radish into small dices. Step 3: Wash, dry and cut ladyfingers into half, grate jaggery. Step 4: Now combine yogurt mixture, vegetables, jaggery and green chilies. Step 5: Cook until mixture returns to medium thick consistency stirring all the time Adjust salt. Step 6: Heat oil, add fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves and asafetida powder. Step 7: When the seeds crackle add it to kadhi, mix well.

Ingredient Names: charlotte, sunflower oil, asafoetida, black mustard seeds, cumin seeds, red chilies, red, pointed cabbage, lemons, desiccated, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in a pan of salted boiling water for 10 mins until tender. Drain well and return to pan. Lightly crush with the back of a fork, just to break, not to mash. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and then add the asafoetida, spices and dried chillies. Cook for a few mins until the spices pop and the chillies darken. Step 3: Add the fresh chilli, cabbage and some salt and stir-fry for 3-4 mins. Add the warm potatoes to the pan and cook for 2-3 mins more until the cabbage is tender, but still has some bite. Stir in the lemon juice, coconut and coriander, and serve.

Ingredient Names: almonds, extra virgin olive oil, water, nutritional yeast, braggs liquid aminos, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients with half of the water in a blender. Step 2: When almonds are pureed, add remaining water a little bit at a time until desired thickness Dressing should appear thin as it will thicken upon sitting for more than a half hour.

Dish Name: Hari Bhari Hari Roti All The Way Green Green Peas Roti
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, green peas, salt, lime juice, cilantro, oil, black pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Sift wheat flour with salt in a bowl. Step 2: Add in 2 tbsps Of oil. Step 3: Add mashed peas and mix well. Step 4: Add pepper, cilanto and lime juice, knead well. Step 5: Divide into 16 equal parts. Step 6: Shape into round balls. Step 7: Roll each ball on a floured board into a circle Lift each roti carefully with floured hands.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, kosher salt, coconut oil, moroccan seasoning, pine nuts, lemon wedges, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Trim stem of cauliflower, leaving core intact. Step 2: Cut cauliflower in half from top to base. Step 3: Set half aside for another use. Step 4: Cut other half from top to base into four thick, equal steaks. Step 5: Sprinkle with half of the salt. Step 6: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in large frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 7: Cook cauliflower for 3 to 4 minutes or until browned, turn over. Step 8: Sprinkle with harissa blend and remaining 1 / 4 tsp salt. Step 9: Stir in remaining 1 tsp oil.

Dish Name: Have Mercy On Me Spicy Lentil Soup With Crock Pot Instructions
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, kosher salt, black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, celery ribs, carrots, garlic cloves, cauliflower, curry powder, cumin, dry lentils, vegetable broth, diced tomatoes with juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil in a large pot over medium-low heat. Step 2: Add onions, salt, pepper, and crushed red pepper, cover and simmer for 6 minutes, or until onions are clear and soft. Step 3: Add celery, carrots, garlic, cauliflower, curry, and cumin, and stir. Step 4: Cover and let simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Stir in lentils, vegetable broth and tomatoes. Step 6: Cover and let simmer for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Add 8 cups of water and increase to high heat, and leave uncovered until it begins to boil. Step 8: When the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat and add cayenne pepper. Step 9: Let simmer for at least 2 hours, or until lentils are soft.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, water, ice cubes, mango, cardamom powder, sugar, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a blender Blend and garnish with fresh mint Serve chilled!

Ingredient Names: instant oats, banana, low-fat milk, honey
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixer add all above ingredients and blend till a smooth drink is obtained If required add more skimmed milk to adjust the consistency Serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, carrots, nuts, coconut flakes, raisins, baking soda, ground aniseed, bananas, peanut oil, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Turn on the oven, set to 350. Step 2: Mix flour, carrots, nuts, coconut, raisins and baking soda in a big bowl. Step 3: Mix anise, bananas, oil and brown sugar in a smaller bowl. Step 4: Add wet ingredient mixture to dry ingredient mixture, and stir gently but thoroughly. Step 5: Add some milk, a bit at a time, if the batter is too thick to stir comfortably. Step 6: Pour into large buttered cake pan. Step 7: Bake 35-40 minutes, until toothpick or knife inserted in the middle comes out clean. Step 8: Allow to cool in pan, and cut into squares. Step 9: Refrigerate if you want it to last longer Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: white potatoes, sweet potatoes, string beans, red onion, lentils, tandoori paste, cumin seed, coriander paste, chili paste, garlic paste, whole wheat sandwich wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Place potato, beans and onion in a container and bake in microwave. Step 2: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Step 3: Place lentils on stove with cumin, coriander, chilli and garlic, stir occasionally. Step 4: When vegies are cooked, mix with lentils mixture on stove and cook until fragrant. Step 5: Cut mountain bread into halves, so you have triangles. Step 6: Place a small amount of mixture in the middle and fold into a samosa shape. Step 7: Place on sprayed or baking paper lined tray. Step 8: Cook in oven for eight minutes or until hard on the outside. Step 9: Serve with a chilli dip and salad.

Ingredient Names: mint leaf, green onion, salt, green chilies, lime, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ingredients and grind in a blender No water should be added For those who like their chutneys sweet, a tsp of sugar can be added to the mixture.

Ingredient Names: mixed berry, honey, plain yogurt, ice cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the mixed berries and the 1 tbls Honey in a blender until smooth. Step 2: Spoon into 2 chilled glasses. Step 3: Blend the yogurt with the 2 tbls Honey and the 6 ice cubes. Step 4: Pour over the top of the berry mixture and gently stir Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: whole milk, honey, fresh ginger, nutmeg, ice cubes, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the ingredients except the ice in a blender. Step 2: Blend for 30 seconds to froth the milk. Step 3: Add the ice cubes, and blend until the ice is pulverized. Step 4: Pour the lassi into large glasses filled with ice, and serve Variation: the same ingredients can make a soothing warm drink Increase the milk to 3 cups, and heat it almost to a boil. Step 5: Add the honey, ginger, and nutmeg, and stir well Omit the ice, serve in mugs.

Ingredient Names: tofu, onions, tomatoes, green chilies, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, apricot jam, salt, cooking oil, ginger-garlic paste, low-fat plain yogurt, coriander leaves, fried onions
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the soya chunks in warm salted water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Squeeze, wash and drain. Step 3: Marinate the soya chunks in the ginger-garlic paste and yogurt marinade for 20 minutes. Step 4: Heat 1 tbsp Of oil in a pot. Step 5: Saute the marinated soya chunks until all the liquid dries up, keep it aside. Step 6: Heat 3 tbsps Of oil in the same pot. Step 7: Add onions and fry until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: panir, onion, tomatoes, dried red chilies, coriander seeds, turmeric, green chilies, garlic cloves, sunflower oil, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Dry-fry the dried chilies in a pan for a couple of minutes over a medium heat. Step 2: Add coriander seeds and turmeric and grind for a further minute Grind spices and dried chilies to a fine powder. Step 3: Fry the onion in oil until browned. Step 4: Add green chilies and fry until soft. Step 5: Stir in ground spices and fry for another minute. Step 6: Add tomato and stir until everything is well blended. Step 7: Stir in paneer and fry in spice paste, stirring until well coated - for about 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with coriander and serve with chapatti.

Ingredient Names: instant coffee powder, skim milk, water, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the milk and water together in a pot and heat on a low flame As the mixture just starts to boil, add the coffee powder and stir. Step 2: Bring to a boil and switch off burner. Step 3: Add cinnamon, stir, and pour into two small cups to serve.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, garlic paste, garlic, dried red chilies, spring onion, carrot, oil, salt, chili-garlic sauce, red capsicum, soya sauce, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 4 cups of water, add rice to it, add salt to taste. Step 2: Stir and allow to cook, drain. Step 3: Add cold water and drain once more. Step 4: Now heat oil in a wok. Step 5: Add garlic paste, chopped garlic and red chillies. Step 6: Fry for 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add spring onions, carrot, capsicum and salt.

Ingredient Names: soya milk, ground ginger, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, ground allspice, artificial sweetener
Instructions: Step 1: In a large cooking pot, mix everything together and heat on high while stirring constantly. Step 2: Bring to a boil, and the concoction will froth up. Step 3: Remove from heat, let the froth subside, and repeat this cycle three more times This is why your pot has to be bigger: the frothing would cause a major spill if you used a smaller pot. Step 4: Serve and drink while hot.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, chili powder, lemon juice, minced garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients in a bowl Serve with roast chicken or mashed potato Will keep in fridge for up to 1 week.

Dish Name: Hyderabadi Khatti Dal Mango Lentil Curry From The Indian State
Ingredient Names: yellow lentils, mangoes, tomatoes, curry leaves, fresh coriander leaves, turmeric powder, garlic, red chili powder, salt, oil, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first three ingredients in a pressure cooker Pressure cook for upto 2-3 whistles. Step 2: Remove from flame and let out the steam. Step 3: Mix the cooked lentils with water using a wooden spoon. Step 4: Boil the mixture for 5 minutes, heat oil in a pan. Step 5: Add cumin seeds and mustard seeds, allow to splutter. Step 6: Once they stop spluttering, add curry leaves. Step 7: Stir-fry until fragrant.

Dish Name: I Can T Wait For Chole
Ingredient Names: onions, fresh ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, tomatoes, ground coriander, turmeric, salt, cayenne pepper, garbanzo beans, garam masala, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan over medium heat, heat cumin seeds, bay leaf and cinnamon until very fragrant, swirling around to prevent burning. Step 2: Add ginger and garlic, cooking until the smell of those fills the air, then add onions. Step 3: Saute onions, stirring frequently, and adding drops of water to prevent sticking, until they are translucent. Step 4: Add the tomatoes, coriander, turmeric, salt, and cayenne. Step 5: Check for seasoning, adding more as you prefer, bring to a boil. Step 6: Add garbanzo beans, cover, and reduce heat. Step 7: Simmer on low for 10-15 minutes. Step 8: Stir in garam masala and lemon juice just before serving. Step 9: Garnish with a sprinkle of chopped cilantro if you desire.

Dish Name: I Love Palak Paneer Spinach And Cheese Curry
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, fenugreek seeds, garam masala, onion, garlic clove, lemon juice, spinach, cream, paneer cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large frying pan. Step 2: Cook spices, onion and garlic, stirring, until onion softens. Step 3: Add lemon juice and spinach: cook, stirring, until wilted. Step 4: Blend or process spinach mixture until smooth, return to pan, stir in cream. Step 5: Add in paneer, cook over low heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes or until heated through. Step 6: Serve on steamed rice.

Dish Name: I Wanna Make Em Sneeze Potatoes
Ingredient Names: canola oil, salt, potatoes, turmeric powder, green chilies, cumin seeds, water, garam masala powder, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet on medium flame. Step 2: Once its hot, toss in the cumin seeds and let them crackle. Step 3: Once they stop crackling, throw in the green chillies. Step 4: Stir-fry for a minute. Step 5: Add the cubed potatoes, turmeric and garam masala powders and salt, mix well. Step 6: Stir in water and increase to high heat. Step 7: Allow to cook for 10 minutes, uncovered, until the potatoes are semi-tender. Step 8: Lower flame to medium, cover the skillet and cook the potatoes until they are so tender that they can be mashed with the back of a spoon, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: limes, sugar, ice cube, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the limes into 4 pieces without removing the skin, remove the seeds. Step 2: Put into a mixer with the rest of the ingredients and half cup water, cover, blend well. Step 3: Add the remaining water, blend again, strain the juice. Step 4: Serve immediately If you dont, then it will become bitter and lose its taste.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, tomato puree, spinach, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, take washed, fresh spinach and steam it for 4 minutes in microwave, place in blender, puree. Step 2: Remove puree to another container. Step 3: Put one cup of flour in a bowl. Step 4: Put salt and ghee in it. Step 5: Make a dough with plain water, put it aside. Step 6: Now again take another cup of flour. Step 7: Put salt and ghee.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, salad oil, cumin seed, fresh ginger, red onion, turmeric, green pepper, ground coriander, ground cumin, paprika, salt, black pepper, tomatoes, water, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place whole eggplant in a shallow pan and bake in a 400 Oven until very soft, about 50 minutes Alternatively, prick with a fork, set on paper toweling, and microwave, uncovered, at 100% for 18-20 minutes, cool slightly. Step 2: Cut eggplant open and scoop out the pulp in large chunks, discarding larger seed pockets, stem and skin Coarsely chop. Step 3: Set in a colander to drain Coarsely slice red onion Mince ginger. Step 4: Heat oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, red onion, garlic cloves, green chili peppers, desiccated coconut, coconut oil, black mustard seeds, red chili pepper, cumin seed, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil on medium high, add black mustard seeds, red chilli and cumin seeds. Step 2: When the mustard seeds begin to crackle, add green chillies and salt Next add the onions and garlic, fry for 2 minutes, then add the chopped asparagus pieces. Step 3: Stir well, simmer the heat, add 1 / 4 cup of water, cover with lid and stir every 4 minutes. Step 4: When the asparagus is tender, uncover and cook until water is gone. Step 5: Add the fresh coconut, stir for 10 seconds, remove from heat. Step 6: Keep covered until ready to use.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrot, jalapenos, vegetable oil, yellow mustard seeds, dried red chili, salt, sugar, fresh cilantro, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or deep, wide skillet over a medium-high flame. Step 2: When hot, put in mustard seeds As soon as the seeds begin to pop, put in the dried chili. Step 3: Stir once Within seconds the chili will turn dark red. Step 4: Put cabbage, carrots, and hot pepper in the pan. Step 5: Turn the heat down to medium and stir the vegetables for about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add salt, sugar and cilantro. Step 7: Stir and cook for another 5 minutes or until the vegetables are just done and retain some of their crispness. Step 8: Stir in lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, dried red chili, ground ginger, whole mustard seeds, ground cumin, bay leaves, ground coriander, turmeric, salt, cabbage, peas, water, soy margarine, garam masala, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Shred the cabbage coarsely. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large skillet and stir in the crushed red chilies, ginger, mustard seeds, cumin, bay leaves, coriander, turmeric, and salt. Step 3: Heat the spices gently for about 2 minutes, stirring often. Step 4: Add the shredded cabbage and saute it, until it is evenly coated with the spices, and beginning to wilt, 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Add the water and the peas. Step 6: Cover, and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Step 7: Remove the cover, stir in the margarine, garam masala, lemon juice, and sugar, and simmer- uncovered- for another 10 to 15 minutes There should be very little or no excess liquid at this point. Step 8: Serve hot with basmati rice Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: ground cumin, ground turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, ground coriander, head cauliflower, potatoes, oil, ginger, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, onion, unsweetened coconut milk, salt, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine garam masala, ground coriander, chili powder, ground turmeric, ground cumin, and salt together in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Cut cauliflower and potato into medium sized cubes and thoroughly wash it, put in bowl, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a frying pan / kadai. Step 4: Add green chilli, ginger garlic and stir for few seconds. Step 5: Add chopped onions and fry over medium heat until light golden brown. Step 6: Add coconut milk, spice mixture, and the cauliflower and potato, stir well.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, onion, tomatoes, green chili pepper, garlic cloves, gingerroot, bay leaves, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, olive oil, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut onion, tomato and green chili Grind it in food processor along with ginger and garlic and make paste. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and fry bay leaves for 30 secs. Step 3: Add the paste and fry on medium heat until golden brown. Step 4: Add red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt, mix well. Step 5: Fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add water enough to make thick gravy. Step 7: Bring the gravy to boil. Step 8: Add can chick peas.

Ingredient Names: red onion, ghee, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, green chilies, red chili powder, curry powder, garam masala, turmeric powder, salt, scallion, cilantro, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: For the paste: heat ghee over pan on medium heat Saut onions for 2 minutes, then add tomatoes and ginger-garlic paste. Step 2: Cook for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and dump contents into blender. Step 4: Blend into a smooth paste and set aside. Step 5: Heat olive oil in pan over medium heat. Step 6: Add mushrooms and fry for about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add green chiles, chili powder, curry powder, garam masala, turmeric, and salt. Step 8: Cook for about 20 seconds and immediately add the paste You can add about 1 / 2 cup of water for consistency.

Ingredient Names: butter, shredded coconut, pistachios, honey, cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, fennel, milk, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Sautee coconut in butter until toasted, stirring well. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 cup pistachios, sauting a little longer. Step 3: Add honey and spices and stir. Step 4: Add milk and coconut milk, stirring slowly. Step 5: Heat but don't boil Froth individual servings in blender or espresso machine if desired Caution: be careful not to put more than one serving at a time in the blender or it may overflow and scald you. Step 6: Serve garnished with pistachios.

Ingredient Names: milk, boiling water, instant coffee powder, cream, sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve instant coffee powder and sugar in boiling water and allow to cool. Step 2: Blend the the coffee mixture and milk in a blender for few seconds. Step 3: Add cream and crushed ice. Step 4: Blend for another few seconds till it becomes frothy, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, cumin seed, cinnamon sticks, cardamom pods, basmati rice, vegetable stock, corn kernel
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Add cumin, cinnamon and cardamom and cook over moderate heat, stirring often, until cumin is browned, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add rice and vegetable stock, cover and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Step 5: Add corn, cover and heat through, about 2 minutes more. Step 6: Season with salt and fluff.

Ingredient Names: sweet corn, whole wheat flour, chili powder, cumin seed, lemon juice, coriander, sugar, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the sweetcorn to a fine paste in a food processor, without adding any water. Step 2: Mix the corn paste with the rest of the ingredients in a bowl to make a soft dough Only use water if needed. Step 3: Divide the mixture into 6 equal portions and roll each one into a circle of 4" diameter. Step 4: Heat a tava or frying pan and cook each roti on both sides on a slow flame until golden brown, using a little oil I must admit i have to use more oil than stated but that may be my inexperience! Step 5: My girls eat these on their own with some yogurt dip.

Ingredient Names: milk, cardamom pods, rice, sugar, blanched slivered almonds, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the milk into a wide, preferably non-stick pan. Step 2: Add the cardamom pods and bring to a boil without letting the milk spill over Quickly turn heat to medium- the milk should simmer vigourously as possible without boiling over- and cook, stirring now and then, for about 15-20 mins Or until the milk has reduced to 750 ml. Step 3: Sprinkle the ground ruce slowly into the pan, stirring as you go. Step 4: Add the sugar as well. Step 5: Stir now and then cooking for 7-8 mins Or until the pudding has thickened to a creamy consistency, turning the heat down a bit towards the end. Step 6: Turn off the heat and pick out the cardamom pods and discard Roast the almonds and pistachios lightly over a cast iron griddle pan.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, salt, water, oil, cumin seed, turmeric, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, peel and cut potatoes in 3 / 4 dice or wedges, or leave skin on if you prefer. Step 2: Bring potatoes to a boil in water and 1 / 2 t salt. Step 3: Cover and let boil for 5-8 minutes until just cooked. Step 4: Drain and let steam off moisture until they have a sort of dry outer skin, 10-15 minutes, or let cool completely and keep in the fridge up to 2 days. Step 5: Make sure they are dry before frying. Step 6: Heat oil in a large non-stick pan over medium high heat. Step 7: Add cumin seeds and fry 30-60 seconds until they turn a shade darker and give off smell. Step 8: Add potatoes and sprinkle with turmeric Shake pan and fry potatoes about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until evenly golden and crisp The trick is not to stir too frequently, so that a crust can develop.

Ingredient Names: red lentils, oil, onion, garlic cloves, garam masala, ground turmeric, ginger powder, fresh parsley, water
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the lentils well under cold water. Step 2: Drain in a colander. Step 3: Heat oil or ghee in a large pan. Step 4: Add onion and cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes or until lightly coloured and soft. Step 5: Add garlic, ginger and spices and sautee until fragrant. Step 6: Now add the lentils and the water. Step 7: Bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes or until nealy all the liquid has been absorbed and the lentils are soft The dhal should be thick Sitr in the chopped herb of your choice. Step 8: Serve warm with naan bread.

Ingredient Names: ghee, lentils, mustard seeds, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, cinnamon stick, garlic cloves, ginger, curry leaves, onion, green chili pepper, vegetable broth, tomatoes, eggplant
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat the ghee and add the dhal, mustard seeds, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, cinnamon stick, garlic, minced ginger, curry leaves, onion, and green chilly pepper. Step 2: Cook over low heat for 5 minutes until the spices are fragrant and deep brown in color and the onion has softened. Step 3: Add the vegetable broth and simmer until the dhal is spft, about 30-45 minutes. Step 4: Remove the cinnamon stick, green chilly pepper and curry leaves. Step 5: Blend the dhal until smooth with a hand-held electric beater, then return to the saucepan. Step 6: Add the diced vegetables and simmer for a further 20 minutes or until the vegetables are soft. Step 7: Add the lemon juice, salt to taste, and chopped coriander. Step 8: Stir well and serve with a dollop of yogurt, garnished with a few coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, tomatoes, cauliflower florets, green peas, capsicum, carrots, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, lemons, fresh coriander leaves, chili powder, oil, turmeric powder, buns
Instructions: Step 1: For the masala: Roast for about 1 minute all the spices separately One after the other in same pan is ok Its just to dry them out fully and bring out their flavours. Step 2: Cool these completely Grind them together This may make more quantity of masala than needed for this recipe. Step 3: Store in air tight, dry containers For the gravy: Just blanch together peas, cauliflower, carrots.

Ingredient Names: cooked basmati rice, mixed vegetables, salt, chili powder, cinnamon, garam masala, ghee, garlic cloves, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Cut all the vegetables into long pieces. Step 2: Pour the ghee in the frying pan and add the garlic and cashews, stirring until slightly browned. Step 3: Add the vegetables and fry until they are fully cooked. Step 4: Add the spices, adjusting to your taste. Step 5: Add rice, stirring well to coat with the spices, and fry until heated through and well mixed.

Ingredient Names: rice, onion, peach, oil, ginger, slivered almonds, ground cardamom, hot red pepper sauce, salt and pepper, coriander sprigs
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in boiling salted water until tender, about 20 minutes and drain. Step 2: Return to hot pot and let stand, covered. Step 3: Heat 1 tbs oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add ginger and cook about 30 seconds Push onion and ginger to one side and add remaining 1 tbs oil. Step 6: Add almonds to oil and cook, stirring until golden, 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in rice, peach, cardamom, red pepper sauce, 1 / 4 tsp salt and 1 / 4 tsp pepper and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Top with coriander sprigs if using.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, fresh mushrooms, green beans, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, garam masala, cayenne pepper, salt, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Put oil in wide pan and set over medium high heat. Step 2: When oil is hot, add cumin seeds As soon as seeds begin to sizzle, add onion. Step 3: Stir and fry till onion browns. Step 4: Add ginger and garlic. Step 5: Stir until garlic starts to brown, add mushrooms. Step 6: Stir and fry for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add beans, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, garam masala, cayenne, salt, tomato, and 1 / 2 c water, bring to boil.

Ingredient Names: green cabbage, vegetable oil, cumin seed, fennel seed, sesame seeds, onion, salt, cayenne pepper, lemon juice, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Remove coarse outer leaves of cabbage. Step 2: Cut cabbage lengthwise into fourths, and then core the sections. Step 3: Now cut each quarter into fine, thin shreds. Step 4: Put oil in wide, nonstick pan and set over medium-high heat. Step 5: When oil is hot, add cumin, fennel, and sesame seeds As soon as sesame seeds begin to pop, add onion. Step 6: Stir and fry for 3-4 min or until onion begins to brown, add cabbage. Step 7: Stir and fry for 6 min or until cabbage browns. Step 8: Add salt and cayenne.

Ingredient Names: chapati flour, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Dough: Put the flour in a bowl Slowly add about 3 / 4 cup plus 2 tablespoons water, just enough to gather the dough together and make a ball. Step 2: Knead the dough well for 10 minutes. Step 3: Make a smooth ball and put it in a bowl. Step 4: Cover with a damp cloth and set aside for 30 minutes It will turn quite soft. Step 5: Divide into 12 balls. Step 6: Keep covered while you work with the twelfth, cook:.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, water, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, salt, turmeric, ground red pepper, olive oil, fennel seed, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, cover potatoes with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Lower heat and simmer, covered, 30-35 minutes, until tender. Step 3: Drain, cool slightly, and peel. Step 4: Chop the potatoes into 1 / 2" cubes. Step 5: In a food processor, pulse the water, ginger, garlic, salt, turmeric, and red pepper until a paste is formed. Step 6: In a large nonstick frying pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 7: When hot, add the fennel and cook 30 seconds. Step 8: Remove pan from the heat, stir in the spice paste, then cook 2 more minutes. Step 9: Add the potatoes and stir to evenly coat them with the spice paste. Step 10: Fry 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the potatoes have a golden brown crust.

Ingredient Names: onion, lemon juice, hungarian paprika, ground cayenne pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse onions in sieve under cold running water, drain. Step 2: Mix together ingredients in a small bowl. Step 3: Allow flavors to meld over 1 hour period before serving. Step 4: Serve as table condiment with indian foods, samosas, pakoras, along with other chutneys.

Dish Name: Indian Jaggery Rice Pudding Vellam Payasam
Ingredient Names: medium grain rice, water, jaggery, ghee, cardamom powder, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Add rice and water to a pot on a high flame and bring to a boil. Step 2: Lower the flame to low and simmer covered until the rice is cooked, about 15 minutes. Step 3: Uncover, add jaggery and 2 1 / 2 tablespoons of ghee and let the mixture simmer on the low flame, stirring every 2 minutes. Step 4: When the mixture starts to thicken to the consistency of pourable custard, remove from flame. Step 5: Sprinkle cardamom powder over the pudding. Step 6: In a small skillet, roast the broken cashewnuts in 1 / 2 tbsp ghee and pour over the pudding. Step 7: Mix well, and serve immediately, or cold, after refrigeration.

Dish Name: Indian Khatte Chole Hot And Sour Chickpeas
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, canola oil, yellow onions, tomatoes, coriander, cumin, fenugreek seeds, cinnamon, green chili, fresh ginger, lemon, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, keep about 2 tbsp of the onion aside and fry the rest over medium heat for about 4-5 minutes, until tinged brown. Step 2: Add the tomatoes, cook for another 5 minutes, until soft. Step 3: Stir frequently, mashing the tomatoes to a pulp. Step 4: Stir in coriander, cumin, fenugreek, and cinnamon, add the chickpeas, add salt to taste. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add some water if the mixture becomes too dry. Step 7: Meanwhile mix together the chillies, ginger, lemon juice, cilantro, and remaining onion Just before serving, and the ginger and onion mixture.

Ingredient Names: green onions, gingerroot, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, vegetable broth, dried lentils, ground turmeric, salt, tomatoes, coconut, of fresh mint, cooked rice, plain nonfat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Spray 3-quart saucepan with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Cook green onions, gingerroot, red pepper and garlic in saucepan over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions are tender. Step 3: Stir in 5 cups of the broth, the lentils, turmeric and salt, heat to boiling, reduce heat. Step 4: Cover and simmer about 25 to 30 minutes, adding remaining stock if needed, until lentils are tender. Step 5: Stir in tomato, coconut and mint. Step 6: Serve over rice with yogurt.

Ingredient Names: butter, raw cashews, sultana, cardamom seed, saffron thread, milk, sugar, vermicelli, edible silver foil
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large pot. Step 2: Add cashews and sultanas, cook 3 minutes till nuts are toasted. Step 3: Add cardamom seeds and saffron, cook 60 seconds till fragrant. Step 4: Add milk and sugar, bring to the boil. Step 5: Add noodles, reduce heat to low. Step 6: Cook, covered for 10 - 15 minutes till noodles are tender. Step 7: Cook, uncovered a further 10 minutes till thickened, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Remove from heat, spoon into bowls. Step 9: Add garnish if desired.

Ingredient Names: garam masala, coriander seed, cardamom pod, fennel seed, allspice berries, curry leaves, dried chili, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the spices and oil in a sterilized bottle Seal and leave for 3 days in a cool, dark place. Step 2: Strain into a 3 cup sterilized bottle. Step 3: Store in a cool, dark place for up to 3 months.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, cilantro, salt, pepper, butter, green chilies, onions, turmeric, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix eggs, milk, cilantro, salt and pepper in a bowl Into a hot pan that has butter you can cook the green chilies, little ones like jalapenos, onion and then add turmeric right before you add eggs. Step 2: Pour in egg mixture and cook until set. Step 3: Garnish with tomato.

Ingredient Names: chapati flour, ghee, salt, cumin seed, ajwain, baking powder, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ghee and flour with your fingers. Step 2: Stir in seeds, salt, and baking powder. Step 3: Add yogurt and knead dough until smooth and even. Step 4: Divide dough into four balls. Step 5: Roll each out into a 5" circle. Step 6: Heat a frying pan over medium. Step 7: Add 1 teaspoon ghee and fry a piece of the bread on both sides until brown. Step 8: Press it down with a spatula to make it puff up. Step 9: Repeat with the rest of the dough, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: pineapple chunks, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, onion seeds, dried chili, ginger, sugar, raisins, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Drain pineapple but reserve the juice, chop finely. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan, and add mustard seeds immediately to it As soon as it begins to sputter, add cumin and onion seeds. Step 3: Add ginger and chilies and saute for about a minute until just aromatic. Step 4: Add the pineapples, raisins, sugar and salt. Step 5: Add 1 1 / 4 cups of pineapple juice. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium and cook uncovered for 15-20 minutes.

Dish Name: Indian Potato Cakes Aloo Tikki With Cilantro Chutney Yogurt
Ingredient Names: simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes, red bell pepper, green onions, egg, flour, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric powder, oil, cilantro, jalapeno, pistachios, lime juice, yogurt, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in frying pan to medium heat. Step 2: Mix simply potatoes mashed potatoes, red bell peppers, green onions, egg, flour, cumin, coriander, turmeric powder. Step 3: Allow to stand for 10 minutes In the meantime, blend the cilantro, jalapeno, pistachios, lime juice and yogurt into a smooth consistency, add salt to taste. Step 4: When oil is ready, use two tablespoons to make patties, smoothing one over the other, like making a cannelle, drop into hot oil. Step 5: Fry each side until golden brown If doing in batches, you can keep warm in a 200 degree oven Plate them with sauce and enjoy!

Dish Name: Indian Potatoes With Cauliflower Aloo Gobi
Ingredient Names: cauliflower florets, potatoes, onion, chilies, cumin seeds, turmeric, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, vegetable oil, water, cilantro, garam masala, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Steam cauliflower until tender. Step 2: Set aside Peel potatoes. Step 3: Chop into 1 / 2" cubes. Step 4: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet. Step 5: Add 1 teaspoon cumin seed, 3 / 4 tsp turmeric, 1 / 2 tsp cayenne, and 2 tsp ground coriander. Step 6: Heat briefly until mixture becomes fragrant. Step 7: Add onions to pan and cook until onions are tender. Step 8: Add potatoes and 1 / 2 tsp salt to pan, mixing spices onto potatoes. Step 9: Then add 1 cup water.

Dish Name: Indian Potatoes With Mustard Seeds Sookhi Bhaji
Ingredient Names: cumin seed, brown mustard seeds, onion, serrano chilies, potatoes, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, salt, cayenne pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat cumin seeds and mustard seed in hot dry skillet over high heat, swirling pan, until seeds start to pop. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium. Step 3: Add onions, chilies, and add a small amount of water. Step 4: Cook until onion is tender, adding more water as necessary to prevent sticking. Step 5: Add potatoes, ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and cayenne pepper, stirring to mix well. Step 6: Add 2 / 3 cup water, cover, reduce heat and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until spices are absorbed and potatoes are tender. Step 7: Add a small amount of water at a time if all liquid evaporates. Step 8: Fold in cilantro just before serving.

Dish Name: Indian Punjabi Palak Kadhi Spinach Curry With Yogurt Sauce
Ingredient Names: plain nonfat yogurt, water, gram flour, ground coriander, turmeric, salt, vegetable oil, serrano peppers, onion, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, dried fenugreek leaves, fresh spinach, dried hot red chili peppers, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor or blender, combine yogurt, 4 cups water, gram flour, 2 tablespoons coriander, turmeric, and salt, set aside. Step 2: Make sure yogurt is thoroughly blended, or it will curdle during the cooking process. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large wok or a saucepan over moderately high heat and cook, stirring, until the peppers sizzle, about 30-45 seconds. Step 4: Add the onion, ginger, and garlic, cooking until the onion is tender, about 2 minutes Very slowly add the yogurt mixture, stirring constantly, and bring it to a boil, cooking about 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Make sure you stir the yogurt or it will curdle. Step 6: Reduce wok heat if ingredients start to boil over. Step 7: Once liquid comes to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce is smooth and silky, and oil becomes visible, about 45-50 minutes Adjust thickness of sauce with the exta cup of water, if needed.

Dish Name: Indian Red Gun Powder Molaha Podi
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, channa dal, urad dal, dry red chile, asafoetida powder, sesame seeds, salt, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the 1 t oil in a wok or heavy skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes. Step 2: Add the urad and channa dal and chiles. Step 3: Fry stirring constantly until the beans begin to turn color, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the asafetida and sesame seeds Continue frying until the contents of the pan are nicely browned and smell roasted, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Turn off the heat, transfer mixture to a plate and cool completely. Step 6: Blend in the sugar and salt Grind the mixture to a powder using a coffee grinder, or a large mortar and pestle or spice mill The powder should be neither course, nor as fine as flour It should have a grainy texture.

Dish Name: Indian Restaurant Style Onion Bhajia Deep Fried Onion Fritters
Ingredient Names: onions, chickpea flour, baking powder, rice flour, turmeric, onion seeds, chili powder, cumin, coriander, salt, water, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put the vegetable oil into a large pan and heat over a medium to high heat. Step 2: Make the batter: in a large bowl, add the chickpea flour, baking powder, rice flour, turmeric, black onion seeds, chili powder, cumin, coriander, salt and the water. Step 3: Mix together well and then add the sliced onion - mix the onion through until well coated. Step 4: Check the temperature of the oil by dropping a small cube of bread in - it should brown fairly slowly - not burn or go dark brown straight away Carefully drop spoons of the bhaji batter in to the oil, do not overcrowd as they will stick together. Step 5: Fry them in small batches for 1 to 2 minutes until they are a golden brown and crispy. Step 6: Remove them with a slotted spoon and allow them to drain on a paper covered plate in a warm oven. Step 7: Repeat until all the bhaji batter is finished and they are all cooked. Step 8: Sprinkle over a little salt and serve straight away with coriander chutney or cucumber raita.

Dish Name: Indian Rice Pudding With Cardamom And Rose Water
Ingredient Names: cooked basmati rice, soymilk, unsweetened coconut milk, sugar, ground cardamom, salt, rose water, slivered almonds, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place the rice, soy milk, coconut milk and sugar in saucepan, bring to a simmer over low heat and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is very soft. Step 2: Add cardamom, salt, rose water, almonds and the cornstarch mixture and simmer for 5 minutes longer or until smooth and creamy. Step 3: Stir, then taste and adjust seasoning in necessary. Step 4: Serve warm or refrigerate and serve cold.

Dish Name: Indian Saag Paneer Low Fat Cheese With Spinach
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, tomato sauce, frozen chopped spinach, panir, low-fat whipping cream, minced ginger, garam masala, coriander, cumin, red cayenne pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Use cooking spray and heat garlic and ginger over medium-high heat till golden brown. Step 2: Stir in tomato sauce, coriander, cumin, pepper, masala, salt, and reduce heat to low Partially cover and summer for 8-9 minutes stirring frequently, stir in spinach. Step 3: Simmer 8-10 minutes until spinach turns olive green. Step 4: Stir in whipping cream, stir in cheese. Step 5: Simmer for 3-4 minutes or until cheese is hot and remove from stove.

Ingredient Names: cheese, plain low-fat yogurt, carrot, tomatoes, green bell pepper, cucumber, mixed fresh herbs, candied ginger, hot sauce, salt, pita pocket bread
Instructions: Step 1: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients Serve in pita bread pockets or rolled in wheat tortillas.

Dish Name: Indian Scrambled Eggs With Onion And Tomatoes Khichri Unda
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onions, green chili pepper, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, eggs, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil in a large nonstick frying pan and set over medium heat. Step 2: When hot, put in the oniona nd stir for 20 seconds. Step 3: Add the green chile and tomato, and stir until the onion ad tomato are soft, 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Now add cilantro, eggs, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Stir the eggs gently until they form thick, soft curds or are done to your taste. Step 6: Remove from the heat and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: green beans, carrots, whole wheat bread, new potatoes, ginger, mango powder, garam masala, chili powder, cilantro, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Steam the beans and carrots, covered, until very soft, slightly salted water. Step 2: Stir occasionally and make sure there is enough water to keep them from scalding until they are tender-soft. Step 3: Drain off any excess water. Step 4: Combine all ingredients except oil and combine well in a food processor or mash together by hand. Step 5: Taste and adjust the seasoning as per your preference. Step 6: Divide into equal portions and shape into 3 / 4 inch patties, and chill for a few minutes to help them firm up better. Step 7: Heat oil, add patties, and brown undisturbed for 1-2 minutes before flipping over. Step 8: Cook for 1 minute periods on each side until they are crisp golden brown on the outside If desired, garnish with lemon wedges and serve with a green dipping chutney on the side.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, ground cumin, garlic, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour, salt, cumin, and garlic together in a bowl. Step 2: Stir in water and oil. Step 3: Knead for 2-3 minutes, till dough is somewhat soft. Step 4: Let sit for 25-30 minutes in a warm draft-free place. Step 5: Divide dough into 4 balls and flatten each until 4-5 inches in diameter by hand or with a well-oiled rolling pin. Step 6: Heat a frying pan on high heat and place one flattened ball in the pan Do not use oil in the pan. Step 7: When the dough becomes mostly translucent, flip it and cook the other side. Step 8: When both sides are slightly browned, remove from pan and immediately spread one side of the bread with margarine. Step 9: Repeat with the other 3.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Chickpea And Fire Roasted Tomato Soup
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, chickpeas, onion, cumin, ground cardamom, turmeric, salt and pepper, vegetable stock, fire-roasted tomatoes, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil over medium heat in a large pot. Step 2: Add garlic and cook 2-3 minutes Grind the chickpeas and onion in a food processor. Step 3: Add to pot and cook 5 minutes to sweeten onion. Step 4: Season the chickpeas with cumin, cardamom, turmeric, salt and pepper. Step 5: Stir in stock, then tomatoes. Step 6: Simmer soup for 5-10 minutes to combine the flavors. Step 7: Serve with a dollop of yogurt and warm pita for dipping.

Dish Name: Indian Spiced Chickpeas And Red Peppers
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, olive oil, onion, garlic, turmeric, red bell peppers, jalapenos, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Drain chickpeas, reserving 1 cup of liquid. Step 2: In a blender of food processor, puree 1 cup of chickpeas with reserved liquid until smooth. Step 3: Heat olive oil in large skillet. Step 4: Add onion and garlic and cook over moderately-high heat, stirring frequently, until onion is translucent and garlic is golden, 2-3 minutes, stir in turmeric. Step 5: Add chickpea puree, bell peppers and jalapenos and season with 1 tsp salt. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add remaining chickpeas, cover and simmer until the peppers are just tender, about 5 minutes longer If stew is too thick, thin with a little water.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh ginger, salt, ground coriander, ground cumin, pattypan squash, red onion, cooking spray, lemon juice, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat grill. Step 2: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl, toss well. Step 3: Thread squash and onion alternately onto each of 8 skewers. Step 4: Place skewers on grill rack coated with cooking spray. Step 5: Grill 10 minutes or until tender, turning frequently. Step 6: Drizzle with juice. Step 7: Sprinkle with mint.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, kale, reduced-sodium chicken broth, ground coriander, ground cumin, garam masala, salt, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add kale and cook, tossing with two large spoons, until bright green, about 1 minute. Step 4: Add broth, coriander, cumin, garam masala and salt. Step 5: Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender, 8 to 10 minutes, stir in chickpeas. Step 6: Cover and cook until the chickpeas are heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 7: When preparing kale for these recipes, remove the tough ribs, chop or tear the kale as directed, then wash it--allowing some water to cling to the leaves The moisture helps steam the kale during the first stages of cooking Ingredient.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, extra firm tofu, cornstarch, yellow onions, fresh ginger, garam masala, diced tomatoes, frozen green peas, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a cast iron or heavy saucepan, heat about 1" oil until hot but not smoking. Step 2: Toss tofu cubes with corn starch and fry in a single layer until golden brown on all sides Carefully remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 3: Let oil cool slightly and drain off all but about 1 / 4 cup Reheat and saut onions and ginger until onions are golden brown. Step 4: Add garam masala and tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup water, peas and fried tofu, cover and lower heat, simmer an additional 1015 minutes, season to taste.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, potato, onions, garlic, green chili peppers, cumin seeds, turmeric, ground coriander, garam masala, salt, cardamom pods, bay leaves, cinnamon, yogurt, tomatoes, fresh coriander
