Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the potatoes, onion, garlic and shallow fry them over a medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring from time to time, until softened and golden brown. Step 2: Add the cumin seeds, turmeric, ground coriander, garam malasa, salt, cloves, cardamoms, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, chopped chili and cook, stirring for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and yoghurt, cover and cook very gently for 5 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked, adding a little water if necessary. Step 4: Serve hot with the coriander sprinkled on top.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, fresh gingerroot, garlic, coriander powder, ground cardamom, ground nutmeg, red chili powder, ground cumin, basmati rice, salt, dry lentils, water, potato, green bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onions, and cook, stirring frequently until they have softened. Step 3: Sprinkle in the ginger, garlic, coriander, cardamom, nutmeg, red chili powder, and cumin. Step 4: Cook for 3 minutes more, stirring frequently. Step 5: Add the rice to the saucepan and saute the rice with the spices for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 6: Now add the lentils and salt into the saucepan. Step 7: Add 3 cups of water into the pan, stir. Step 8: Place the potatoes into the pan. Step 9: Bring the mixture to a boil, cover the pan and turn the heat to low. Step 10: Cook for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground turmeric, salt, cauliflower, chickpea flour, plain low-fat yogurt, ginger paste, garlic paste, vegetable oil, roasted cashews, green beans, carrot, garam masala, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, ground fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425. Step 2: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 3: Stir in the turmeric and 1 tablespoon of salt, add the head of cauliflower and cook until barely tender, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Transfer the cauliflower to a large colander and let cool. Step 5: In a small skillet, toast the chickpea flour over moderate heat, stirring, until golden brown, about 2 minutes Scrape the flour into a medium bowl and let cool, then stir in the yogurt, ginger paste, garlic paste and 1 tablespoon of the oil, season with salt. Step 6: In a mini food processor, finely grind the cashews In the small skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 7: Add the green beans and carrot and cook over low heat, stirring, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, vegetable oil, cumin seed, frozen green peas, turmeric, cayenne pepper, ground coriander, salt, water, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in saute pan over medium heat and cook cumin seed until they sizzle and fragrance is released. Step 2: Add onion and cook until tender. Step 3: Then stir in peas, turmeric, cayenne, coriander, salt, and water, mixing well. Step 4: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Stir in garam masala and cook for a few minutes more, until liquid evaporates, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Serve with other dishes such as dal, and curries Have some steamed basmati rice, a crisp salad, a selection of warm breads, and an herb plate available Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: oil, potatoes, onion, garlic clove, tomatoes, eggs, green chili pepper, spinach, parmesan cheese, milk, pepper, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in oil 5 minutes. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and chilies cook until potatoes tender mix in bowl eggs tomato milk and pepper. Step 3: Pour over potato mixture. Step 4: Cook until set on bottom. Step 5: Add spinach and cheese on 1 side. Step 6: Flip over top and cook until cheese melts Can add lime juice when done.

Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, roasted peanuts, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, mango powder, red chili powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make a lengthwise slit in the peppers and remove the seeds. Step 2: In a bowl, mix together crushed peanuts, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, dry mango powder and red chili powder Generously fill peppers with the peanut mixture Lightly coat outside of peppers with a little oil. Step 3: Place peppers in a microwave safe dish and microwave for 3 minutes. Step 4: Check the peppers and turn if necessary Microwave for additional 2 minutes. Step 5: Heat little oil in a flat skillet. Step 6: Place peppers on the skillet to brown them. Step 7: Flip the peppers and brown other side also.

Ingredient Names: green bell peppers, potatoes, panir, cashews, raisins, amchoor, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, garam masala, fresh cilantro, salt, oil, onion, fresh ginger, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 430f. Step 2: Slice off the tops of the green peppers and remove seeds. Step 3: Slice off thinly from the bottom so that the peppers stand steady when placed on a baking tray. Step 4: Mix potatoes, paneer, cashewnuts, raisins, amchur, cayenne, cumin, garam masala, cilantro and salt, set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in a pan and add onion. Step 6: Cook till translucent and add ginger and green chillies. Step 7: Mix in potato mixture and continue to cook for two minutes. Step 8: Divide this mixture evenly into four portions and stuff the green peppers with the mixture. Step 9: Sprinkle cheese on top and place on baking tray.

Ingredient Names: potato, green bell peppers, oil, onions, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, chili powder, salt, onion, whole cloves, green cardamom pods, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in a saucepan of simmering water for 15 minutes, or until tender, then drain and cut into small cubes. Step 2: Bring a large pan of water to a boil and add peppers and blanch for 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain and run cold water over peppers. Step 4: Cut around the stems and remove stems and seeds. Step 5: Drain well upside down on paper towel. Step 6: Heat oil in a small frying pan and cook onions over medium heat until soft but not browned. Step 7: Add coriander, cumin, turmeric and chili powder and mix thoroughly. Step 8: Mix in the potatoes and season with salt, to taste. Step 9: Fill each pepper with equal amounts of mixture To make the sauce, combine all of the sauce ingredients in a deep, heavy-bottomed frying pan and bring slowly to a boil.

Ingredient Names: dry lentils, olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, ketchup, unsweetened coconut milk, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Cook lentils in 4 cups water until tender 15-25 minute meanwhile saute the garlic and onion in the oil. Step 2: Transfer to a medium sized bowl and add the rest of the ingredients and stir very well. Step 3: Once lentils are soft, combine the onion mixture with the lentils in a slow cooker and cook over low heat for at least two hours Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground cumin, caraway seed, cumin seed, ground coriander, red onion, garlic, hot chili pepper, fresh ginger, turmeric, cayenne pepper, new potatoes, cilantro, of fresh mint, lime
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet heat cumin, caraway, cuminseed, ground coriander in the oil only until fragrant, swirling the pan. Step 2: Add the onion and cook 1 minute. Step 3: Add the garlic, hot chile, and ginger, and cook until the onion is tender. Step 4: Add the turmeric and cayenne to the pan and mix into the onion mixture before adding the potatoes and lime juice. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper Warm the dish through until hot and garnish with the cilantro and mint leaves, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, scallion, potato, cauliflower floret, green peas, coconut milk, rice vinegar, curry powder, jalapeno, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potato, cauliflower and peas, if necessary. Step 2: Cook rice in abundant salted water, as you would pasta, until it's just done White will take 10-15 minutes, brown 30 minutes or more. Step 3: Drain, rinse in cold water, drain again, then combine with vegetables in a large bowl. Step 4: Combine black pepper, coconut milk, rice vinegar and curry powder in a blander and turn machine on A creamy emulsion will form within 30 seconds. Step 5: Taste and add more vinegar a teaspoon or two at a time until balance tastes right to you, then add more curry powder, salt or pepper, if needed. Step 6: Drizzle vinaigrette over rice and vegetables Use 2 big forks to combine, fluffing rice and tossing gently to separate grains. Step 7: Stir in jalapeno if using and cilantro, taste and adjust seasoning or moisten with a little more dressing.

Dish Name: Indian Sweet Saffron Rice With Raisins And Pistachios
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, saffron threads, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, salt, yellow onion, jaggery, cardamom seeds, ghee, pistachios, raisins, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to boil in saucepan. Step 2: Place the saffron threads in a small bowl and add 2 1 / 2 tablespoons of the boiling water and soak the threads for 10 to 15 minutes In the meantime, add the basmati rice, cinnamon stick, cloves and salt to the saucepan of boiling water. Step 3: Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender. Step 4: Remove from heat and let sit with cover on for 5 minutes Optional: in small pan, lightly saute onion in oil and set aside Next combine the saffron water, sweetener and cardamom seeds in a small saucepan. Step 5: Place over medium heat and stir until the sweetener is dissolved. Step 6: Lower heat and simmer 1 minute. Step 7: Pour the syrup over the rice then re-cover pan.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, sugar, tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, green chili, coriander, of fresh mint, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the lime juice, sugar and salt in a large bowl. Step 2: Stir until the sugar has completely dissolved. Step 3: Add all remaining ingredients and toss well to mix. Step 4: Cover with clingfilm and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Toss the vegetables again before serving to ensure the dressing is distributed.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, serrano chili, garlic paste, ginger paste, grain, tomato puree, tomato sauce, clove, garam masala, red chili powder, sugar, salt, water, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and soak rice for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat butter or oil in pan and add garlic and ginger pastes. Step 3: Stir and add onions and green chile. Step 4: Cook until onion is well cooked, add rice. Step 5: Stir, and add dried clove, garam masala, chilli powder, sugar, tomato puree, tomato sauce, salt, bring to a boil. Step 6: Add water, taste for seasoning and bring to a boil. Step 7: Cover and lower heat to simmer. Step 8: Simmer until rice is almost done.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, red onion, english cucumber, vegetable oil, wine vinegar, lime juice, garlic clove, dijon mustard, ground cumin, salt, ground black pepper, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, lime juice, garlic, mustard, cumin, salt and pepper, stir in the mint. Step 2: Add the tomatoes, onion, and cucumber and toss gently. Step 3: Garnish with additional mint leaves. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, red chilies, garlic cloves, curry powder, celery ribs, potatoes, sweet potato, pumpkin, red lentils, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pot. Step 2: Saute onion, chilli, garlic and curry powder until softened. Step 3: Add vegetables and give a stir to coat. Step 4: Add stock and lentils, bring to boil. Step 5: Lower heat and simmer soup covered until vegetables are soft, blend and serve.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, oil, carrot, beans, green peas, bay leaf, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon stick, onions, ginger, garlic, green chilies, pepper, coriander powder
Instructions: Step 1: 1soak the rice for 30 minutes, drain it 2. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and add bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom 3. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic and saute till it turn transparent Do not let it burn 4. Step 4: Add chopped onions stir fry with a dash of salt 5.

Ingredient Names: winter squash, sugar, cardamom, saffron, unsweetened coconut milk, whole almond, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Cut squash in half, scoop out and discard seeds. Step 3: Place cut side down in a baking dish with 1 / 4 inch water. Step 4: Cover and bake about 1 hour. Step 5: When finished, let cool slightly, scoop out flesh and cut into 3 / 4" cubes. Step 6: Toss in large bowl with all ingredients except almonds, spread in 6 quart baking dish and sprinkle with almonds. Step 7: Bake 30 minutes, until bubbly and thick If almonds are getting too dark, lower heat to 325 and bake longer.

Dish Name: Indian Yam Fritters Classic Crunch Patties
Ingredient Names: yams, gram flour, garam masala, curry powder, sea salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel the yams. Step 2: Boil until tender, about 20 minutes. Step 3: Drain the yams thoroughly and puree in the food processor with the flour A thick and sticky mixture should result. Step 4: Add the seasonings and pulse again Form little discs with your hands about the size of half-dollars Shallow pan fry in olive oil, blot on paper towels. Step 5: Serve with tamarind date sauce or a good chutney.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, chickpea flour, ghee, dried red chilies, turmeric powder, gingerroot, asafoetida powder, peanuts, cumin seed, cinnamon stick, mustard seeds, curry leaves, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Stir chickpea flour and turmeric into yoghurt, set aside, heat ghee. Step 2: Add chillies, ginger, cinnamon, cumin, curry leaf, peanuts and mustard, stir briefly. Step 3: Add asafetida, stirrring briefly again. Step 4: Lower heat and add yoghurt mixture and salt. Step 5: Cook partially covered on a medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes till soup has thickened. Step 6: Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seeds, mustard seed, green chilies, ginger, turmeric, greens such as kale, peas, lemons, ground coriander, fresh coriander, unsweetened desiccated coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan or wok, sizzle the cumin and mustard seeds for 1 min, then add the chilli, ginger and turmeric. Fry until aromatic, then add the greens, a pinch of salt, a splash of water and the peas. Step 2: Cover the pan and cook for 4-5 mins until the greens have wilted. Add the lemon juice, ground coriander, half the fresh coriander and half the desiccated coconut, then toss everything together. Pile into a serving dish and scatter with the rest of the coconut and coriander.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, green peas, bay leaves, tomato puree, fresh curds, sugar, celery, oil, salt, onion, fresh coconut, garlic, coriander seeds, cumin seed, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: In a glass bowl, combine half of the oil and cauliflower. Step 2: Cover with a lid and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Step 3: Remove and keep aside In the same bowl, combine green peas with 2 tbsp water and microwave on high for 1 minute In another glass, combine the remaining oil, bay leaves and the prepared paste and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the tomato paste, curds, cauliflower, green peas, sugar, celery, 1 / 2 cup of water and salt and microwave on high for a further 4 minutes till the veggies turn soft, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, water, ghee, cumin seeds, yellow onions, ginger, garlic, ground coriander, kosher salt, to kashmiri red chili powder, ground turmeric, plum tomatoes, garam masala, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain dry chickpeas. In a bowl, combine the chickpeas and 2 cups of warm water and let soak for at least 4 hours or up to overnight. Drain the chickpeas and set aside. Step 2: Select the high saute setting on the Instant Pot and heat the ghee. Add the cumin seeds directly to the hot oil and cook until they start to sizzle, about 1 minute. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until translucent, about 5 minutes. Cover the pot with a glass lid to speed up the process. Step 3: Add the ginger and garlic and saute until aromatic, about 1 minute. Add the coriander, salt, chili powder, turmeric, and chickpeas; pour in the 1.5 cups water; and stir well with a wooden spoon nudging loose any browned bits from the pot bottom. Step 4: Secure the lid and set the pressure release to sealing. Press the Cancel button to reset the cooking program, then select pressure cook/manual(hi) and set the cooking time to 35 minutes. Step 5: Allow natural pressure release. Open the Instant Pot and stir in the tomatoes and garam masala. Select the high saute setting and cook until the tomatoes soften, about 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro. Step 6: Serve with hot parathas or puri. For gluten-free options serve with Jeera rice or Instant Pot Basmati Rice.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, wheat flour, semolina, curds, baking soda, green chilies, mustard seeds, cumin seed, gingerroot, peppercorns, oil, curry leaf, asafoetida powder, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix wheat / maize, rice, rava, curd, baking soda and salt. Step 2: Add water to it and make dough of pouring consistency. Step 3: Heat oil in kadai and add the mustard seeds. Step 4: After the mustard seeds splutter, add the cumin seeds, asafoetida, green chilles, ginger, pepper corns and curry leaves. Step 5: Heat till the cumin seeds get golden. Step 6: Add the seasoning to the batter. Step 7: Leave it for 3-5 mins or even upto an hour Important: making a rava dosa is different from making a normal dosa The consistency of the dough has to be more watery You need to pour the batter all over the fry pan starting from the outer circle and fill it towards the center.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, onion, oil, cumin seed, garam masala, chaat masala, amchoor, red chili powder, green chilies, red onion, tomatoes, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet, when heated add cumin seeds, green chilies and then add onions, saute until they turn golden brown add garam masala, chaat masala, red chili powder and amchur powder. Step 2: Saute for another 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add canned chick peas, keep on cooking for another 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp water, cover it and let it cook for 10 minutes on low-medium heat uncover after 10 minutes, and add diced red onions and tomatoes and cook for another 5 minutes enjoy with puris / rotis or parathas.

Dish Name: Iron Soup Spinach And Lentil With A Punch
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, tomato paste, vegetable stock, red lentils, spinach, frozen cauliflower, frozen broccoli, firm tofu, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, coriander, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and cook, stirring, until soft. Step 3: Add garlic, tomato paste, and cook, stirring, for about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add the stock / liquid and and lentils to the pan, bring to the boil, reduce heat. Step 5: Add broccoli, cauliflower, tofu, and spices, stir. Step 6: Let cook for 15 minutes, add spinach.

Ingredient Names: jackfruit, powdered jaggery, coconut, milk, cardamom powder, ghee, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fresh jackfruit into equal square shaped slices. Step 2: Fry the cut pieces in a wok, in 2 tbsps Of ghee for 7-8 minutes. Step 3: In a mixer, grind the coconut and jaggery to a fine paste. Step 4: Add 2 cups of water. Step 5: Boil the coconut-jaggery mixture in another vessel for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the fried jackfruit pieces into the vessel. Step 7: Boil again for 2 minutes. Step 8: Boil the milk in a vessel, make it lukewarm.

Ingredient Names: pita bread, edamame, extra virgin olive oil, salt, ground cumin, ground coriander, garlic cloves, flat leaf parsley, tahini, water, fresh lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Arrange pita halves in a single layer on oven rack. Step 3: Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until crisp. Step 4: Cool completely on wire rack Break each pita half into about 6 chips. Step 5: Prepare edamame according to package instructions, omitting salt. Step 6: Place 1 tablespoon oil, along with salt, cumin, coriander, and garlic in a food processor Pulse 2 to 3 times or until coarsely chopped. Step 7: Add edamame, parsley tahini, water, and lemon juice Process 1 minute or until smooth.

Dish Name: Jaffrey's Homemade Indian Cheese With Spinach
Ingredient Names: whole milk, distilled white vinegar, fresh spinach, dried fenugreek leaves, green chili pepper, cornmeal, peanut oil, onion, fresh ginger, tomatoes, salt, ground roasted cumin seeds, cayenne, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Paneer: Put the milk in a large, heavy pan and set over medium-high heat. Step 2: Meanwhile, place a colander in the sink and line it with a clean dish towl or 3-4 layers of cheesecloth at least 24 inches square. Step 3: When the milk begins to boil, turn the heat down to low Quickly add 3 tablespoons of the vinegar and stir The mixture will curdle at this point, the thin, greenish whey completely separating from the white fluffy curds If this does not happen, add the remaining tablespoon of vinegar and repeat the process Empty the mixture into the lined colander Most of the whey will drain out To make small patty: allow most of the whey to drain out of the colander.

Dish Name: Jaipur Style Quick And Easy Mung Dal
Ingredient Names: mung beans, water, turmeric powder, carrot, cauliflower florets, ghee, cumin seeds, fennel seed, chile, fresh gingerroot, fresh coriander leaves, fresh lemon juice, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add the mung beans, water, turmeric and carrots to a heavy-based medium pan over a high heat and bring the water to the boil. Step 2: Reduce the heat and allow the contents of the pan to simmer, semi-covered, for 15 minutes, or until the mung beans start to break down. Step 3: Add the cauliflower florets to the pan and simmer for another 10 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat the ghee in a small pan over a medium heat. Step 5: Add the cumin and fennel seeds and gently cook them, stirring occasionally, until they have darkened a few shades. Step 6: Add the chilies and ginger and continue cooking until aromatic. Step 7: Pour the contents of the small pan into the simmering soup in the medium-sized pan. Step 8: Add the fresh coriander leaves, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Step 9: Serve hot in individual serving dishes with a simple rice dish or bread.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, basmati rice, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium size saucepan over a medium-high heat. Step 2: Drop in the cumin seeds, and cook until they splutter Do not allow the cumin seeds to burn or become really dark brown in color. Step 3: Add the rice and fry it in the oil for about 1 minute. Step 4: Add the water and salt and bring to a boil. Step 5: Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan. Step 6: Cook the rice for approximately 15 minutes If you feel the rice is getting burnt near the base of the pan as it cooks, one trick is to place the saucepan on another flat pan or griddle which is directly on the flame, toss with a fork.

Ingredient Names: puffed rice cereal, noodles, roasted peanuts, lentils, tomatoes, cucumber, mung bean sprouts, fresh gingerroot, onion, fresh cilantro, fresh coriander leaves, coconut meat, tamarind paste, fresh lime juice, chaat masala
Instructions: Step 1: Mix puffed rice, peanuts, chickpea flour noodles, and fried lentils together in a pot. Step 2: Add tomato, cucumber, mung beans sprouts, ginger, mild onion, coconut, cilantro, and coriander. Step 3: Add tamarind sauce, lime juice, chat masala, garam masala and mustard oil, mix well. Step 4: Serve in a bowl or a cone made from newspaper Eat with a spoon.

Dish Name: Jhat Phat Sabzi Bell Pepper Paneer
Ingredient Names: ghee, panir, ginger-garlic paste, chili paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, tomatoes, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, dried fenugreek, garam masala powder, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee in a large pan, add cubed paneer and saute for 2 minutes. Step 2: Remove the paneer from the heat and place paneer in warm water for 3 minutes, drain and keep aside In the same pan, add the ginger-garlic paste and chili paste and saute for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chilli powder and combine. Step 4: Add the chopped bell peppers and cook till they turn slightly soft, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add tomatoes and stir well to combine and cook for 7 minutes, with lid. Step 6: Add the paneer cubes and toss the contents well and cook for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add garam masala powder and kasuri methi and combine. Step 8: Finally, garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with naan bread.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, cucumber, scallion, of fresh mint, cumin seed, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving, allowing flavors to mingle.

Ingredient Names: paprika, ground cumin, ground fennel, ground mustard, dried ancho chile powder, ground coriander, ground turmeric, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, white pepper, ground fenugreek, ground ginger, saffron thread
Instructions: Step 1: Mix them all together very well. Step 2: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place Makes 1 / 2 cup curry powder. Step 3: When i use this mix, i usually lightly toast the powder in a hot skillet, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 minutes before adding into my recipes.

Dish Name: Just Right Spinach Chickpea Curry Vegan Chole Palak
Ingredient Names: fresh tomatoes, fresh ginger, fresh green chile, grapeseed oil, asafoetida powder, whole cumin seed, fresh spinach, chickpeas, water, ground coriander, chili powder, turmeric, sea salt, garam masala, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Pull out your blender, a small one if you have it, and combine the tomatoes, the ginger and the fresh chili if you are using. Step 2: Puree until completely smooth the set aside. Step 3: In a medium sized saute pan over medium heat, add the oil. Step 4: Once the oil is hot add in the asofetida followed by the whole cumin seeds. Step 5: Stir - and once the spices are sizzling, add in the tomato mixture Be careful, it will splatter. Step 6: Mix to combine - it takes quite a few stirs to get it combined so don't worry. Step 7: Let that saute a few minutes. Step 8: Add the next three spices, as well as the salt. Step 9: Mix that together and let it all mingle together over medium low heat for about 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Kaandha Poha Maharashtrian Potato Onion Beaten Rice
Ingredient Names: beaten rice, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, turmeric powder, green chili pepper, onion, potato, salt, water, lemon, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak poha in enough water to cover for 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain and squeeze out excess water, working in batches of handfuls. Step 3: Heat oil in a skillet and add the mustard seeds, urad dal, turmeric, and slit green chili. Step 4: When the mustard seeds start to sputter, add the onion and potato and saute for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add salt and 2 tablespoons of water, and cover. Step 6: After 5 minutes, uncover, add the poha and saute for another 5 minutes. Step 7: Remove from flame add the lime juice and garnish with chopped coriander, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, cucumber, onion, fresh lemon juice, salt, black pepper, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients, allow to stand for 1 / 2 an hour and serve with main dish of your food Absolutely mast salad!

Ingredient Names: cumin seed, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, garlic cloves, onion rings, tomatoes, cucumber, ground black pepper, salt, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a small skillet over med-high heat. Step 2: Add the cummin seeds and toast stirring constanly for 20-30 seconds. Step 3: Transfer to a plate and allow to cool. Step 4: In a large salad bowl, whisk the oil, vinegar, and lemon juice until blended. Step 5: Add the garlic, onion, tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and salt to taste: toss very well. Step 6: Sprinkle with the cumin seeds and mint, toss well, toss again, and serve.

Dish Name: Kachumber Fresh Tomato Cucumber And Onion Relish
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, cucumber, onion, green chili, cilantro leaves, vegan sugar, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, mixing well Serve chilled Goes well with spicy curries.

Ingredient Names: chili, coriander seeds, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, tomatoes, onion, red chili powder, turmeric powder, ground fenugreek, salt, panir, green peppers, coriander seed, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For kadai sauce: Put the red chilies, coriander seeds in a blender and blend for 20 secs until you have a coarse powder. Step 2: In a frying pan add 3 tbsp of vegetable oil and fry the coarse powder in low heat, to this add 6 cloves of finely chopped garlic. Step 3: Fry until golden brown. Step 4: Add chopped onion and tomatoes chili powder, turmeric powder, fenugreek powder, salt fry for 15 minutes with lid closed until the mixture is cooked For paneer: In a pan add 1 / 2 tsp vegetable oil, after the oil is hot add 1, 2 tsp coriander seeds. Step 5: When the coriander seeds crackle and pop add cubed paneer fry for about 2 minutes until paneer is golden. Step 6: Now add cubed green peppers stir for about a minute. Step 7: Now add this paneer green pepper mixture to kadai sauce and stir them until each paneer cube is coated with the sauce.

Dish Name: Kadai Paneer Cottage Cheese On The Wok
Ingredient Names: panir, onions, red capsicums, tomatoes, ginger, salt, garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, ghee, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To begin with, cut the paneer into equal-sized thin lengthwise pieces Next, peel and chop the onions Grind them to a fine paste. Step 2: Cut the ginger into juliennes. Step 3: Heat ghee or oil in a wok. Step 4: Add the cumin seeds. Step 5: Allow to sizzle briefly. Step 6: Add the finely cut capsicum pieces, fry for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the onion paste.

Ingredient Names: besan flour, turmeric, chili powder, curds, water, oil, mustard, cumin, fenugreek leaves, coriander seeds, asafoetida, ginger, chili, curry leaves, salt, fresh coriander, dried fenugreek, cumin powder, coriander powder, baking soda, ghee, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take ½ cup besan, 1 tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder and 2 cup curd. Step 2: Whisk and mix well making sure there are no lumps. Step 3: Add 4 cup water and prepare a smooth watery consistency mixture. Keep aside. Step 4: In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp methi, 1 tsp coriander seeds, pinch hing. Step 5: Also add 1 inch ginger, 2 chilli, few curry leaves. Splutter the tempering. Step 6: Pour in the besan curd mixture and mix well. Step 7: Keep stirirng till the besan and curd mixture are well combined, and starts to thicken. Step 8: When the mixture comes to a boil, add 1 tbsp salt and mix well. Step 9: Stir occasionally, and boil for 15 to 20 minutes or until the raw flavour of besan is gone. Step 10: The mixture will turn glossy, adjust the consistency as required. Keep aside. Step 11: To prepare the pakoda, in a bowl take 2 cup besan. Step 12: Add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, 2 tbsp kasuri methi, pinch hing and ½ tsp salt. Step 13: Mix well, ensuring all the spices are well combined. Step 14: Now add water slowly, and prepare a smooth lump free batter. Step 15: Also add ¼ tsp baking soda and mix well till the batter is light and fluffy. Step 16: Wet your hands with water, and pinch off a ball-sized piece of dough. Step 17: Drop in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 18: Stir occasionally, until the pakoda turns golden brown and crisp. Step 19: Drain off to remove excess oil. Step 20: Drop the pakoda into the kadi. Step 21: To prepare the tempering, heat 1 tbsp ghee. Add ½ tsp cumin, 2 dried red chilli, pinch hing, pinch chilli powder. Step 22: Pour the tempering over the kadhi. Step 23: Also add 2 tbsp coriander, 2 tbsp kasuri methi and mix well. Step 24: Finally, enjoy Kadhi Pakora Recipe with jeera rice.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, ghee, onions, cloves, peppercorns, cardamom pods, ground turmeric, salt, curry leaves, fresh lemongrass, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and drain thoroughly. Step 2: Heat the ghee in a large, heavy based saucepan. Step 3: Add the onion, and fry until it begins to turn golden brown. Step 4: Add the cloves peppercorns, cardamom pods, turmeric, salt, curry leaves and lemon grass. Step 5: Add the rice and fry, stirring continuously for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well coated with ghee and turmeric, add the cocnut milk and bring to the boil. Step 6: Lower heat, cover and cook for 20-25 minutes without lifting the lid. Step 7: When the rice is cooked, the spices will have risen to the top. Step 8: Remove spices and leaves used for flavouring and fluff the rice up with a fork serve hot as part of an indian or sri lankan style meal.

Ingredient Names: black lentils, onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, green chili, oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, chili powder, garam masala, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Put the lentils in a large, heavy-based saucepan, add 2 litres water and bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes - 1 hour. Step 2: Drain the lentils, reserving the cooking liquid. Step 3: Blend the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli together in a food processor to form a paste. Step 4: Heat the oil in a frypan and fry the onion mixture over high heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown. Step 5: Add the cumin and coriander, fry for 2 mins, then add the lentils aswell as the salt, chilli powder and garam masala. Step 6: Pour 300ml of the reserved cooking liquid into the pan, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes Just before serving, stir in the cream and simmer for another 2 minutes to heat through.

Dish Name: Kandhe Ki Roti Mummy's Favourite Onion Paratha
Ingredient Names: onions, green chilies, gram flour, whole wheat flour, oil, fresh coriander leaves, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Knead the first nine ingredients together Pinch off even-sized balls of the dough to make parathas Use a rolling pin to roll out the parathas. Step 2: Heat a griddle on the stove top. Step 3: Cook the paratha on either side on the griddle. Step 4: Transfer to a plate and serve hot with a cup of hot indian chai Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: yogurt, raisins, walnuts, caster sugar, hot water, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Place yoghurt in a bowl Whip it well with a wooden spoon Add all the ingredients to the yoghurt Serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: shallots, green chili, green coriander, black cumin seeds, dried mint, kashmiri chili powder, vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 1tbsp salt with the shallots and keep aside for a few minutes. Step 2: Then wash and drain the water completely. Step 3: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl and cool in the refrigerator This is best if made at least an hour before eating to allow the flavours to mingle.

Dish Name: Keerai Mologutal South Indian Spinach Lentil Stew
Ingredient Names: fresh spinach, salt, water, yellow lentils, turmeric powder, coconut, cumin, red chile, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, urad dal
Instructions: Step 1: Make sure that you don't dry the spinach after washing. Step 2: Cook the chopped spinach in a microwavable bowl, covered, in a microwave on high for 5 minutes, with 1 teaspoon salt, stirring thrice, set aside to cool. Step 3: Add water, lentils, and turmeric in a pot, bring to a boil, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until lentils are tender Do not drain Grind coconut, cumin, red chili, with 1 / 2 cup water in a blender, to a paste. Step 4: Remove from the blender and set aside In the same blender, separately grind the spinach coarsely. Step 5: Mix the spinach, coconut paste, and cooked lentils together in a large pot and bring it to a boil, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Remove from the flame and set aside.

Ingredient Names: green gram, bengal gram dal, spinach, rice, ginger, green chilies, asafoetida powder, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and soak the dals and rice in seven cups of water for two to three hours Clean, wash and blanch the spinach leaves in two cups of hot water for two to three minutes. Step 2: Drain and chop finely Peel, wash and grate the ginger. Step 3: Remove the stems, wash and roughly chop the green chillies. Step 4: Drain the dals and rice and coarsely grind them along with the ginger, green chillies and asafoetida. Step 5: Add the chopped spinach and salt to taste and mix well. Step 6: Heat sufficient oil in a kadai. Step 7: Make small balls of the prepared mixture and deep-fry them until they are crisp and brown. Step 8: Drain the keerai vada onto absorbent paper towels and serve hot with a chutney of your choice.

Dish Name: Kele Aur Khus Khus Ki Puri Banana And Poppy Seeds Puri
Ingredient Names: bananas, all-purpose flour, oil, khus khus
Instructions: Step 1: Just 5 ingredients make a delicious banana and poppy seeds puri To make this incredible puri, put the bananas in a bowl and mash You may use over-ripe bananas as well and those having brown spots are best to use, add in the flour. Step 2: Mix with your fingers, add 2 tsp oil, mix well. Step 3: Allow the dough to rest for 30 minutes. Step 4: Now put little oil on your palms. Step 5: Make small round balls out of the dough.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, coconut, chili powder, coriander powder, water, mushrooms, gingerroot, green chili, onion, turmeric powder, mushroom liquid, salt, curry leaves, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: For the coconut paste: heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick, heavy skillet and add the coconut and garlic Stirring frequently, gently toast the coconut with the garlic cloves, until the coconut is golden brown If using freshly grated or frozen grated coconut, this will take 15 to 20 minutes If using unsweetened dessicated coconut, it will take less time Be careful not to burn the coconut. Step 2: Stir in the chili powder and coriander powder and roast with the coconut for one minute. Step 3: Set aside and cool lightly, then transfer the mixture to a blender with the water, and grind to a very fine paste. Step 4: Set aside For the mushroom curry: lightly saute the mushrooms in vegetable oil, butter or ghee until silken and just softened. Step 5: Drain and reserve any liquid.

Ingredient Names: mix vegetables including eggplant, turmeric, green chilies, ground cumin, ground coriander, fresh coconut, onions, curry leaves, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the vegetables in a saucepan and cover with 500ml water. Add the turmeric and a pinch of salt and bring to the boil. Simmer for 20-25 mins until tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, blend 4 chillies, the cumin, coriander, half the coconut, the onion and some seasoning in a food processor. Step 3: When the vegetables are tender, add the paste, curry leaves and remaining chilli and simmer for 5 mins. Stir in the yogurt and very gently simmer for 1 min. Scatter with remaining coconut and serve.

Ingredient Names: rava, banana, sugar, milk, ghee, cashew nuts, pistachios, raisins, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Put rava, bananas, sugar, milk in a saucepan Wait for a while till it gets sufficiently heated Continue stirring until the rava is cooked. Step 2: Fry cashew, raisins and pista in ghee and add it to the above. Step 3: Add saffron [ saffron immersed in 1 tbsp milk ].

Ingredient Names: potato, cooking oil, onion, ginger, chile, mustard seeds, cumin seed, ground cumin, turmeric, cauliflower floret, salt, water, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes for 5 minutes then drain. Step 2: Heat oil in a karahi or wok, add onion and ginger then cook until onion is golden brown. Step 3: Add chillies, mustard seeds, cummin seeds, ground cummin and turmeric then cook for 2 minutes, stirring continuously. Step 4: Add potatoes and cauliflower, stirring to coat all the pieces in the mixture, add salt and water then cover and cook gently until vegetables are tender but not overcooked. Step 5: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve as a main dish with warm indian breads or as a side dish with a meat curry.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, mint sauce, mango chutney, sugar, chili powder, garam masala, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients thoroughly using milk to thin to taste. Step 2: Place in refrigerator for one hour to cool. Step 3: Serve over kebabs, pakora, samosas, tikkas, or with any other indian starter.

Dish Name: Khasta Aloo Spicy Pan Fried Potatoes
Ingredient Names: potatoes, ghee, cumin seed, ground coriander, turmeric, dried hot chili peppers, hot green chili pepper, ginger, lime, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee in large non-stick pan until shimmering. Step 2: Add cumin and stir until fragrant. Step 3: Add coriander, turmeric, ground chile, green chile and ginger and stir, making a hot paste Dump in potatoes and toss until coated on all sides Move around into one layer and leave alone for a minute, allowing some crust to form. Step 4: Turn and repeat until crusted to your liking. Step 5: Remove from heat, squeeze lime juice over top, sprinkle salt and toss to blend. Step 6: Pour into serving dish and garnish with cilantro Serves 4 but i just ate most of it as a lunch.

Dish Name: Khatta Channa A Punjabi Indian Speciality Chickpeas Dish
Ingredient Names: black channa, canola oil, asafoetida powder, ground fenugreek, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, salt, gram flour, tamarind juice, water, mango powder
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the black channa overnight in a large bowl with lots of water The water level should be atleast 3 inches above the level of the black channa{chickpeas} The next morning, drain out the water completely and wash the channa in a bowl of fresh and clean water. Step 2: Now, put the washed channa in a large pot. Step 3: Add water{should be 2-3 inches over the level of the chickpeas} Boil the chickpeas on high heat, heat oil in a pot. Step 4: Add asafoetida, fenugreek, coriander, turmeric and red chilli powders with salt to taste. Step 5: Mix well and stir-fry for a few seconds. Step 6: Prepare tamarind water by dissolving a lemon-sized piece of tamarind in 1 / 2 cup of hot water.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, almond milk, green cardamom pods, sugar, blanched slivered almond, ground cardamom, ground nutmeg, rose water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice and boil in the water over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, until the rice is one quarter done. Step 2: Drain in a colander. Step 3: In a saucepan, bring the almond milk and cardamom pods to a boil over medium heat. Step 4: Add the rice and cook for 30 to 40 minutes, until the rice is soft and the milk is very thick. Step 5: Stir occasionally at first and then constantly when the milk begins to thicken, to prevent the ingredients from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Step 6: Add the sugar or honey, almonds, ground cardamom, and nutmeg and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 7: Remove from the heat and set aside. Step 8: Sprinkle with the rose water and mix, you may add more rose water if you desire. Step 9: Serve warm or chilled in dessert bowls.

Dish Name: Kheer Indian Rice Pudding Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, basmati rice, sugar, cardamom seed, golden raisin, milk, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Coat the bottom and sides of a 5 quart slow cooker with vegetable oil. Step 2: Put the rice, sugar, cardamom seeds, raisins and milk in the slow cooker If using agave nectar, add it towards the end, as it will make the dish pinkish-brown in color. Step 3: Cook on high for 3 hours, stirring once or twice Be careful not to let it overcook, as the milk will separate. Step 4: Sprinkle with chopped nuts and serve, hot or cold It will thicken as it cools.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, sweetened condensed milk, milk, cardamom powder, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice in 2-3 changes of water. Step 2: Drain and keep aside. Step 3: Now pour the fresh milk into a large pot, bring to a boil, add rice. Step 4: Cook on slow fire for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Bring to a boil twice again, stir constantly. Step 6: Lower flame and check if the rice is soft. Step 7: Stir in cardamom powder.

Dish Name: Kidney Bean Chili Indian Style Rajma In Masala
Ingredient Names: kidney beans, onion, onions, ginger, coriander seed, green chili pepper, red chili peppers, cumin seed, turmeric, black peppercorns, cinnamon sticks, ghee, mango powder, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the kidney beans well and soak in water overnight Next morning, steam them until tender Or cook in a large pot of water for about an hour or until tender. Step 2: Remove 1 / 2 cup of cooked beans, crush coarsely and keep aside Grind 1 onion, ginger, coriander seeds, chili peppers, cumin, turmeric, peppercorns, and cinnamon to a very fine paste. Step 3: Heat ghee in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the chopped onions and saute until golden brown. Step 5: Add the ground paste and saute, sprinkling water occasionally, until the ghee starts separating from the paste. Step 6: Add the cooked beans, stir for a while and add salt and dried mango powder. Step 7: Pour 3 cups of water and add the crushed beans.

Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, white breadcrumbs, butter, leek, celery, parsley, green chilies, onion, cayenne pepper, egg, salt, pepper, oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: For the garlic-herb filling, blend all the ingredients for it and chill until ready for use. Step 2: Melt butter and saute leek and celery. Step 3: Mash the beans until fairly smooth. Step 4: Stir in half of the breadcrumbs till well incorporated. Step 5: Add the bean mixture to the leek and celery, add parsley, green chillies, onion, cayenne, salt and pepper and combine well. Step 6: Divide the bean mixture into 4 balls. Step 7: Make a slight depression and insert a slice of garlic-herb filling into the patty And then mold the mixture so that the filling is completely enclosed Coat the patties in the beaten egg and roll generously in the remaining breadcrumbs. Step 8: In a heated skiller, shallow fry the patties for 8-10 minutes until they are golden brown.

Dish Name: Kidney Bean Stew With Sweet Potatoes And Oranges
Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, bay leaves, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, cumin seeds, garam masala, fenugreek seeds, dried oregano, dried rosemary, turmeric, salt, tamarind pulp, crushed tomatoes, sweet potatoes, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place the oil in a dutch oven or large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the bay leaves, cumin seeds, garam masala, fenugreek seeds, oregano, rosemary, and turmeric, and cook, stirring for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the tamarind pulp, tomatoes, sweet potatoes, and water and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Step 6: Add the kidney beans and oranges and cook for 2 minutes to heat through. Step 7: Turn the heat off, cover with a lid and let sit for 10 minutes. Step 8: Remove the bay leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: mung beans, rice, water, carrot, celery, parsnip, fresh ginger, ghee, onion, mustard seeds, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, dried red chili pepper, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and mung beans, chop vegetables and ginger. Step 2: Combine first set of ingredients in stockpot and bring to boil, then reducing to simmer. Step 3: Prepare second set of ingredients, heat ghee in pan. Step 4: Add mustard seeds, wait for them to pop, then add onion and spices and fry till slightly browned. Step 5: Add ingredients from pan to stockpot. Step 6: Let simmer for one hour. Step 7: Add final set of ingredients and serve Enjoy this healing kichadi!

Ingredient Names: mixed vegetables, yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, salt, oil, onion, cinnamon, clove, peppercorn, black cumin, mace, dried coconut, coriander seed, kashmiri chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add the onions and stir-fry till light brown. Step 2: Add the ground masala, saut till well mixed and add the vegetable mixture. Step 3: Bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer 3-4 minutes and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, white onion, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, yukon gold potatoes, carrots, fresh jalapeno pepper, unsalted cashews, tomato sauce, curry powder, cardamom, garam masala, sea salt, frozen green pea, green bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: On a stove top heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion until tender. Step 2: Mix in the ginger, garlic, and 1 tablespoon of the curry powder Continue to cook for 1 minute. Step 3: In a separate bowl mix potatoes, carrots, jalapeno, cashews, and tomato sauce then add to skillet with salt and 1 / 2 tablespoon curry powder. Step 4: Cook for about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Step 5: Add the bell peppers, peas, and coconut milk to the skillet. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes until the consistency has thickened. Step 7: Put cilantro on top if desired.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, coriander seed, garlic cloves, ginger, cayenne pepper, garam masala, sea salt, grapeseed oil, tomato puree, green chilies, desiccated coconut, ground almonds, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Dry fry the cumin & coriander seeds over medium heat, until they start to change colour and release an aromatic smell, then remove from heat. Step 2: Place all the ingredients in a food processor or mortar and pestle and grind until the desired paste is achieved.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, coriander seed, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, cayenne pepper, garam masala, sea salt, peanut oil, tomato paste, green chilies, unsweetened dried shredded coconut, almond flour, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place a frying pan on medium to high heat and add the cumin and coriander seeds to the dry pan Lightly toast them for a few minutes until golden brown and fragrant. Step 2: Remove pan from heat. Step 3: Add toasted spices to a mortar and pestle and grind until fine, or put them into a food processor and whiz to a powder. Step 4: Add ground spices to a food processor, if you havent done so already, with the remaining ingredients and process until you have a smooth paste.

Dish Name: Kuska Biryani A Treat At Parties
Ingredient Names: rice, water, bay leaves, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, red chili powder, salt, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy bottomed vessel. Step 2: Then add bay leaves, cardamoms, cloves and the piece of cinnamon. Step 3: Mix well in the oil. Step 4: Add ginger-garlic paste and continue to mix well. Step 5: Allow it to fry till the smell of ginger and garlic leaves the oil. Step 6: Add the slit green chillies and diced tomatoes, mix well. Step 7: Once the tomatoes turn mushy, add salt to taste and chilli powder. Step 8: Then add half the coriander leaves and water to cook the rice Increase heat and add rice only once the water starts boiling.

Dish Name: Ladies Fingers Okra North Indian Style
Ingredient Names: ladyfingers, salt, turmeric, ginger paste, coriander leaves, mango powder, coriander powder, chili powder, ajwain, fennel seed, fenugreek seeds, asafoetida powder, clarified butter, lemon juice, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Cut off the top and end of the ladies' fingers and slit lengthwise on one side. Step 2: Stuff the masala through the slit. Step 3: Heat the clarified butter and add the ladies' fingers to it. Step 4: Stir-fry over high heat, till they look glossy. Step 5: Lower the heat to medium, add 1 tsp lemon juice and mix well. Step 6: Leave uncovered and continue to saut over medium heat. Step 7: Add the lemon juice in two more stages, till the vegetable is cooked through The ladies' fingers should retain some of their green colour and their shape. Step 8: Serve hot, garnished with mint leaves.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, baking potatoes, garlic cloves, curry paste, curry powder, turmeric, garlic salt, ginger powder, cumin, coriander powder, vegetable stock, diced tomatoes, lime, onion, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium and then add the potatoes. Step 2: Cover and let sit until they are browned a bit and about halfway cooked through You can remove the potatoes but i just push them out of the center and throw in the garlic and curry paste Brown the paste up a bit and then add the rest of the spices and the stock Get the spices all mixed through the stock and add the tomatoes, lime juice, onion & sugar. Step 3: Mix all this thoroughly and heat until bubbly. Step 4: Allow this to cook until the potatoes are just about finished then add in the peas, zucchini, and cilantro and then season with salt & pepper Continue to cook until the peas are heated thoroughly and the zucchini is tender. Step 5: Serve over rice with chapati or naan bread, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: low-fat plain yogurt, sugar, nestle cream, strawberry ice cream, vanilla ice cream, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all the ingredients in your blender until smooth Garnish with almonds Serve to your little prince / princess!

Ingredient Names: water, cloves, sugar, milk, tea leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Put water in a pan on high heat Crush cloves and add to the water Wait till water starts boiling. Step 2: Now lower the heat and let it simmer for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add tea leaves / tea bag and let it boil for a few seconds on high heat again. Step 4: Add milk and give one boil. Step 5: Add sugar Switch off the gas and cover the lid tightly. Step 6: Let it stand for a minute and sip sip sip! Step 7: Adjust milk and sugar as per your preferences!

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, water, sugar, lemon juice, lemon, ice cube, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, blend together the yoghurt, water, sugar, lemon juice and zest until light and frothy. Step 2: Taste and adjust the sugar and lemon to your liking To serve, pour into a tall glass filled with ice cubes and mint.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, cooking oil, roasted peanuts, mustard seeds, cayenne powder, turmeric powder, coconut, hot green peppers, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Lemon rice: cook the rice with required amount of salt and cool The grains should be separate. Step 2: In a wok heat the oil. Step 3: When hot, put in the mustard seeds and lower the heat. Step 4: When the seeds splutter, put in the roasted, peanuts, the turmeric powder and cayenne pepper powder, take off the heat. Step 5: Add the cooled rice. Step 6: When cool, add the juice of two lemons Adjust the amount of lemon juice depending upon the size of lemons and the sourness required and stir carefully so as not to break the rice grains. Step 7: Serve with coconut chutney, mint chutney, tomato ketchup and potato crisps.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, masoor dal, channa dal, onion, lemons, butter, mustard seeds, cumin seed, turmeric powder, bay leaves, cloves, cinnamon sticks, curry leaves, cashew nuts, coriander sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Soak masoor and chana dals for a few hours prior to cooking. Step 2: Boil rice with about 4-5 cups water and salt until grains are soft and firm Just before draining the rice, add the turmeric powder. Step 3: Stir to ensure that the color spreads evenly over the rice. Step 4: Remove from heat and drain In another pot, add the masoor and chana dals. Step 5: Cover with water and boil until the dals soften. Step 6: In a separate small saucepan, add butter on low heat until it melts. Step 7: Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, bayleaves, cloves, cinnamon, curry leaves and cashew nuts. Step 8: When the seeds begin to splutter, add the onion and allow to heat till onion becomes translucent.

Dish Name: Lemons Limes With Vinegar Salt Brine
Ingredient Names: lemons, limes, bay leaves, salt, white vinegar, wax paper
Instructions: Step 1: Also will need 1 glass jar, gallon size, with lid Hit the lemons and limes on all sides of the counter top, bruising them but not breaking the skin. Step 2: Set aside In saucepan heat the vinegar and salt, stir until dissolved, cool slightly On a cutting board with raised edges, slice each fruit into wedges, limes 4 wedges, lemons could be up to 6 wedges, remove seeds. Step 3: Place in the jar with the bay leaves. Step 4: Add the heated liquid. Step 5: Stir around with a large wooden spoon. Step 6: Add more white vinegar to cover.

Ingredient Names: radish, lemon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and coarsely chop radishes and put in bowl. Step 2: Squeeze lemon juice on the radishes and stir, so each radish chunk gets coated in juice. Step 3: Sprinkle on salt to taste and stir, serve.

Dish Name: Lentil And Rhubarb Curry With Potatoes And Peas
Ingredient Names: ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ground fennel, ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, unsalted butter, onion, shallots, fresh ginger, sea salt, garlic cloves, green cabbage, potatoes, rhubarb
Instructions: Step 1: For the spice blend: in a bowl, stir together all the ingredients For the lentils: in a heavy 3 to 4 quart saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion, shallots, ginger, and a large pinch of salt, cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is soft, 8-10 minutes. Step 3: Uncover, stir in the garlic and the spice blend, and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the cabbage, potatoes, rhubarb, lentils, brown sugar, and bay leaf, along with enough cold water to cover by 1 inch. Step 5: Raise the heat to high and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently, uncovered, until the lentils are tender, about 30 minutes. Step 6: Stir occasionally and add more water as necessary to keep the dish fairly soupy. Step 7: When lentils are tender, season with salt to taste, stir in the peas, and simmer until the peas are just tender, about 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dry lentils, water, bay leaf, onion, celery, vegetable oil, fresh tarragon, marjoram, cumin, dark sesame oil, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, rolled oats, dry breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, simmer the lentils in water with the bay leaf until the lentil skins split easily, about 45 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the onion and celery in the vegetable oil, stirring until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the remaining ingredients except the oats and bread crumbs Process the oats in a blender or food processor until finely ground. Step 4: Combine the oats and bread crumbs with the lentil mixture. Step 5: Shape the mixture into 12 patties while it's still warm. Step 6: Bake at 400 degrees on non-stick baking sheet for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: dal, water, turmeric, stewed tomatoes, curry leaves, olive oil, black mustard seeds, ground fenugreek, curry powder, onion, cabbage, lemon, salt, pepper, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the toovar dal well with plenty of hot water. Step 2: Place water, turmeric and dal into a pan and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer for approximately 45 minutes It should become very soft. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and curry leaves to the pan and set aside In another pan heat the olive oil. Step 5: Add the mustard seeds and cook for a few seconds before adding the fenugreek and the curry powder. Step 6: Now add the cabbage and onion. Step 7: Cover and cook on a low heat for approximately 5 minutes. Step 8: Now combine the contents of both pans and simmer for 20 more minutes, or until all vegetables are tender, over a low heat.

Ingredient Names: split red lentils, green bell pepper, red onion, garlic cloves, garam masala, chili powder, cumin powder, lemon juice, peanuts, water, egg, all-purpose flour, ground turmeric, peanut oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the first 10 ingredients in a large pan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer slowly, about 30 minutes until all the liquid has been absorbed. Step 3: Remove the mixture from heat and cool slightly. Step 4: Now beat in the egg and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 5: Let the mixture cool completely. Step 6: Combine the flour, turmeric and chili powder in a small plate. Step 7: Once lentils are cool, shape the mixture into circles. Step 8: Roll the croquettes in the above spiced flour mixture to coat well. Step 9: Heat oil in a skillet and cook the croquettes in batches, turning once until crisp and brown on both sides. Step 10: Serve immediately with chutney or a crisp salad.

Dish Name: Lentil Curry - mega flavour lentil recipe!
Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, ginger, onions, curry powder, turmeric powder, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, lentils, coconut milk, canned tomato, water, coriander cilantro, yogurt, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion: Melt butter in a pot over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and ginger. Slowly cook, stirring every now and then, for 10 minutes until tinged with gold and the onion is sweet. Step 2: Cook off spices: Turn heat up to high, add curry powder and turmeric, stir for 1 1/2 minutes. Step 3: Add everything else: Add remaining ingredients and stir. Bring to simmer, then place lid on and adjust heat to low / medium low so it's simmering gently. Step 4: Simmer: Simmer for 30 minutes, then remove lid and simmer for a further 10 minutes to reduce the sauce. {Note 2 for cook times of other lentils}. Step 5: Lentils should be soft, sauce should be thickened and creamy. Too thick, add water. Too thin, simmer with lid off - thickens quickly. Step 6: Coriander: Stir through half the coriander, then taste and add more salt if needed. Step 7: Serve over basmati rice, sprinkled with more coriander and a dollop of yogurt. (Low carb option - cauliflower rice).

Ingredient Names: garlic, extra virgin olive oil, ghee, onion, fresh green chilies, fresh gingerroot, split yellow lentils, water, ground cumin, ground coriander, tomatoes, lemon juice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh cilantro, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the whole head of garlic in an oiled roasting tin - i used a little pannacotta mould that the garlic could sit snugly in and drizzle a little olive oil over the garlic Pop the garlic in a preheated 350f oven, and roast it for 30 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, wash and drain the lentils, and then place them in a large, heavy-bottomed, preferably non-stick pan, with the 3 cups of water. Step 3: Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, partially covering the pan with its lid Stirring occasionally, allow the lentils to simmer for about 35 minutes, or until the mixture starts to take the appearance of very thick soup You may need to add some water to the pan, from time to time, as it evaporates and the mixture starts to look dry. Step 4: Once you have the lentils on to cook, melt the ghee or butter in a small to medium skillet, and cook the onion, fresh chilies and ginger over low heat, stirring from time to time, until golden about 10 minutes Just as the lentils are becoming tender, add the onion mixture to the lentils and stir to combine. Step 5: Then allow the lentils to finish cooking Give the skillet a bit of a wipe with kitchen paper, as you will use it again shortly.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ground cinnamon, chili powder, potato, red lentil, canned tomatoes, coconut milk, vegetable stock, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat and cook the onions for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Add the garlic, ginger, ground coriander, cumin, turmeric and chili and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 3: Add the potato and lentils and stir to coat with the spice mixture. Step 4: Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, stock, garam masala, salt and sugar, bring to the boil and cover with a lid. Step 5: Reduce the heat to medium and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add the peas to the curry and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes While the curry simmers, cook the rice. Step 7: Remove from the heat and stir in the cilantro and lemon juice. Step 8: Serve on a bed of rice.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, salt, ground turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, mustard powder, cayenne pepper, water, tomatoes, yukon gold potato, lentils, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, saute until translucent. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger, saute a 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Add salt, turmeric, coriander, cumin, mustard powder, cayanne pepper and cook for 1-3 minutes until fragrant. Step 5: Add water, scraping to loosen browned bits from the bottom. Step 6: Stir in tomato, potato, and lentils, bring to a boil. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until potato mixture is tender. Step 8: Remove from heat and stir in parsley & red wine vinegar. Step 9: Serve over rice or with naan.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower head, olive oil, green onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, curry powder, ground cumin, ground turmeric, water, canned stewed tomatoes, salt, red lentil, lemon juice, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Trim cauliflower and cut into florets, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat until hot To saucepan, add green onions, garlic, ginger, curry, cumin and turmeric. Step 3: Cook and stir 5 minutes. Step 4: Add to pan: water, tomatoes with juice and salt. Step 5: Bring to a boil over high heat Meanswhile, rinse lentils under cold running water, picking out and discarding any debris or blemished lentils. Step 6: Add lentils to saucepan. Step 7: Reduce heat to low.

Ingredient Names: dried lentils, water, onion, cauliflower, sweet potatoes, red bell pepper, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, cumin seed, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cinnamon, cayenne, green chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the lentils, place them in a small saucepan with the 3 cups of water, and bring them to a boil. Step 2: Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, until tender. Step 3: Stir occasionally, adding more water if necessary While the lentils are cooking, chop the onion, cauliflower, sweet potatoes, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces and set aside Warm the oil in a pot and saute the mustard, fenugreek, and cumin seeds on medium heat, covering the pot and shaking it occasionally to prevent burning. Step 4: When the mustard seeds begin to pop, stir in the turmeric, coriander, cinnamom, cayenne, and chopped chile and saute for another 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 5: Stir in the tamarind liquid, then add the onions, cauliflower, sweet potatoes, and salt and combine. Step 6: Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Add the bell peppers, cover, and continue to cook until all of the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Drain the cooked lentils and stir them into the vegetable mixture.

Ingredient Names: oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, white onions, red chilies, curry powder, salt, red lentils, sweet potatoes, courgettes, coconut cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pan over medium high heat Saut the onions, garlic and ginger until onions are tender, but not browned. Step 2: Add the curry powder and stir through. Step 3: Add the lentils, sweet potato and courgette, stir and just barely cover with water. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer covered for about 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the lentils are tender If there's quite a bit of liquid you can add more lentils, add salt to taste. Step 5: Add coconut milk and simmer for a few minutes. Step 6: Serve over rice, with naan or just enjoy on its own.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, cumin seed, onion, lentils, ground turmeric, salt, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in medium sized pan. Step 2: Add cinnamon stick, bay leaves and cumin seeds and stir until bay leaves darken a little. Step 3: Add onion, fry 7-8 minutes until browned. Step 4: Add lentils, 750ml water, turmeric, salt, and cayenne pepper. Step 5: Stir and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Cover, turn heat to low and cook 45 minutes to an hour, stirring every so often until lentils are tender. Step 7: Add water if mixture seems too dry.

Ingredient Names: plain low-fat yogurt, reduced-fat milk, rose water, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, caster sugar, cold water, ice cube
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients except ice into the blender and blend smooth Serve very cold over ice.

Dish Name: Lime Flavored Rice Noodles With Cashews
Ingredient Names: water, rice noodles, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, asafoetida powder, yellow split peas, cashews, limes, salt, ground turmeric, curry leaves, thai red chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan, remove from heat, add fresh noodles, soak 30 seconds, drain. Step 2: Rinse with cold water If using dried noodles, cook according to package directions, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil and mustard seeds in wok or 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Once seeds begin to pop, cover wok and wait until popping stops.

Ingredient Names: almonds, milk, ghee, sugar, cardamom powder, saffron, sliced almonds, rose petals
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ghee in a pot. Step 2: Add powdered almonds and roast until light brown, add milk. Step 3: Stir until all the milk gets absorbed. Step 4: Once the milk is absorbed, add cardamom, saffron, sugar and stir until the mixture leaves the sides of the pot, mix well. Step 5: Transfer to a serving dish. Step 6: Garnish with sliced almonds and rose petals, serve.

Dish Name: Low Cal Bran Tikkis That Look Like Falafels
Ingredient Names: bottle gourd, cauliflower, spinach, coriander leaves, potato, wheat bran, salt, white pepper powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the vegetables, salt and white pepper powder in a bowl. Step 2: Mix well with your hand. Step 3: Put a small portion of this on your palm and shape into a thin and small tikki Likewise, repeat for remaining mixture. Step 4: Pour 1 tsp oil on a flat non-stick griddle. Step 5: Put tikkis on this and lightly fry on both sides. Step 6: Serve with ketchup and have without worry as 1 tikki is not more than 45 calories as compared to a standard size potato tikki which is 100 calories!

Ingredient Names: baking potatoes, cooking oil, onion, ginger, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, low-fat yogurt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Wash and wipe the potatoes and prick them all over with a fork. Step 3: Now bake the whole potatoes for about an hour or till they become soft. Step 4: After 5 minutes, cut them lengthwise into halves Use a spoon to take out the fleshy part of the potato taking care that the outer cover does not tear off. Step 5: In a wok, heat oil and fry the onion for a minute. Step 6: Now add the mashed potatoes with salt, turmeric, chilli, coriander and cumin powders and grated ginger. Step 7: Mix everything well on low flame, mashing occasionally. Step 8: Now fill the outer cover with the potato mixture and place it on serving plates For serving, top the potato with a spoonful of yogurt and garnish with finely chopped coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, carrots, cabbage, panir, potatoes, white pepper powder, red chili powder, salt, sesame oil, tomatoes, wonton skins
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the veggies, white pepper powder, red chilli powder, salt and sesame oil in a bowl and mix well. Step 2: Stuff this mixture into 8-10 wanton skins, making sure you seal it carefully so that the mixture does not fall out. Step 3: Garnish each with tomato pieces If you dont get the wanton skins in the market, prepare these at home by making a tight dough of all-purpose flour and water. Step 4: Once the dough is made, cut it in circles and then its ready to use. Step 5: Steam these little treats in an idli steamer or a bamboo basket for 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Serve hot with ketchup!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, diced tomatoes, chickpeas, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, cumin powder, garam masala, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Add olive oil to medium heat. Step 2: Once oil is hot add onions and salt. Step 3: Once onions are sauted, add ginger and garlic paste fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Add in tomatoes and cook until it becomes like a gravy. Step 5: Add chickpeas in and add 4 cups water and all spices. Step 6: Let this boil until chickpeas are soft and smash some of chickpeas. Step 7: Once water thickens this dish is ready to serve --.

Dish Name: Low Fat Low Cal Indian Vegetable Curry
Ingredient Names: water, vegetable bouillon granules, garlic cloves, onion, apple, chili powder, ground ginger, turmeric powder, green beans, cauliflower, carrots, potatoes, tomato puree, sultanas, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix water & bouillon, heat in a large pan and stir fry garlic, onion, and apple for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add chili, ginger & turmeric and continue to stir fry gently for a further minute. Step 3: Add green beans, cauliflower, carrots and potatoes plus 300 ml water. Step 4: Stir in tomato puree, sultanas and a pinch of salt. Step 5: Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 35 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, roasted red pepper, cumin, coriander, cayenne, salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Drain& rinse chick peas / garbanzos, reserving liquid In small bowl, combine cumin, coriander, cayenne, & salt, mixing throughly. Step 2: Put garbanzo beans / chick peas in bowl of food processor with chopping blade, & sprinkle the spice mixture over the top evenly. Step 3: Add the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, & roasted red peppers, and blend until well mixed. Step 4: Add the fresh ground pepper. Step 5: Once the hummus gets smooth, add some of the reserved liquid from the chick peas / garbanzos while it is being processed, until it reaches the desired consistency. Step 6: Serve with toasted pita bread or as a dip or spread with almost anything Have fun with this basic recipe- you can change the amounts or even the actual spices used to change the flavor of this healthy dip Please share your discoveries!

Ingredient Names: whole black peppercorn, extra virgin olive oil, ginger, garlic cloves, ground cumin, ground coriander, madras curry powder, curry powder, turmeric, ground fennel, cayenne pepper, chickpeas, yukon gold potatoes, split red lentils, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast whole peppercorns in soup pot over medium heat until fragrant, add oil. Step 2: When hot, add ginger and garlic and stir for 10 seconds or until fragrant Next add all spices from cumin through cayenne and stir for another 10 seconds. Step 3: Add well-rinsed chickpeas and potato pieces and stir to coat with spices Next, add well-rinsed lentils along with stock and salt. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes If soup gets too thick, add more water or stock to make it your desired consistency, remove from heat. Step 5: Add lemon juice and coconut milk and puree soup with immersion blender to your desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic clove, curry powder, tomato paste, water, salt, lemon juice, hard-boiled eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a skillet. Step 2: Saute onion and garlic 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Stir in curry powder, tomato paste and water, simmer 10 minutes. Step 4: Stir in salt and lemon juice. Step 5: Add eggs and cook just until heated through.

Ingredient Names: madras curry powder, orange juice, green onion, ginger, salt, fresh garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a bowl, or use tightly covered tupperware and shake to mix Adjust the amounts of curry powder and orange juice to suit your personal taste Goes well with chicken, pork, or shrimp The longer the meat soaks in the marinade, the stronger the flavor will be Poking holes in the meat with a fork will also help the flavor soak into the meat Works well on the grill, in the oven, or under the broiler.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, butter, madras curry powder, salt, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Chop sweet potatoes into 1 inch squares. Step 2: Steam in steamer basket over medium-low heat for about 20 minutes or until fork tender. Step 3: Place in bowl and mash with butter until almost smooth. Step 4: Add salt and curry powder Continue to mash until blended. Step 5: Add honey to sweeten to your liking.

Dish Name: Madrasi Green Beans Or Other Vegetables
Ingredient Names: green beans, jaggery, turmeric, mustard seeds, oil, curry leaves, coconut, jalapeno, asafoetida, channa dal, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil beans in water with the jaggery and salt until tender, put aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet, add mustard seeds. Step 3: When the seeds begin to crackle add chana dal and saute until lightly browned. Step 4: Add hing, curry leaves, jalapeno, turmeric and cilantro. Step 5: Stir fry for one minute. Step 6: Add beans, coconut, and salt and cook for 5-7 minutes.

Dish Name: Makai Nu Shaak Corn Cooked With Milk
Ingredient Names: frozen corn, whole milk, oil, whole cumin seed, gingerroot, fresh green chile, salt, sugar, cayenne pepper, coconut, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put the corn and milk in a heavy pan. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, making sure it doesn't boil over. Step 3: Simmer vigorously, stirring occasionally, until there is very little milk left. Step 4: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Step 5: When hot, put in the cumin seed A few seconds later, add the ginger and green chili, stir once. Step 6: Add the corn, sugar, salt, and cayenne to the frying pan, stir to mix. Step 7: Add the coconut and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric, black pepper, cinnamon, cloves, cardamoms, ginger, coconut, water, sunflower oil, ghee, mustard seeds, shallots, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the ingredients starting from coriander powder to water to a smooth paste. Step 2: Heat the oil& ghee in a wok add the mustard seeds fry till the seeds splutter. Step 3: Add sliced shallots, garlic, slit green chillies& curry leaves. Step 4: Saute till shallot is soft. Step 5: Now add the blended paste, fry over low heat till oil separates. Step 6: Add thin coconut milk& the cut potatoes. Step 7: Boil till potatoes are cooked. Step 8: Add the hard boiled eggs& thick coconut milk. Step 9: Bring to boil stirring constantly, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: raisins, oil, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, tomato puree, red chili powder, khoya, fresh cream, garam masala powder, gravy, onions, ginger paste, garlic paste, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes, cool, peel and grate them, grate paneer. Step 2: Wash all green chillies, deseed and chop them fine Peel onions, cut them into halves and boil with a cup of water for ten minutes.
