Step 3: Drain excess water, cool onions and grind them into a smooth paste. Step 4: Mix mashed potatoes, paneer, two chopped green chillies, cornflour and salt, mix well. Step 5: Divide into sixteen equal sized balls. Step 6: Stuff raisins into them Deep fry in hot oil until slightly coloured.

Dish Name: Malai Kofta Stuffed Potato Balls In Cream
Ingredient Names: potatoes, panir, cornflour, cumin powder, salt, oil, raisins, cashews, onions, fresh ginger, garlic, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients for the koftas together. Step 2: Divide the mixture into equal portions. Step 3: Shape into balls Flatten each ball. Step 4: Place 1 / 2 tsp Of chopped nuts and raisins in the center of each ball Close the ball. Step 5: Prepare all koftas in this way. Step 6: Heat oil in a wok and deep fry the koftas till golden brown on either side. Step 7: Remove onto clean paper napkins, allow the excess oil to drain and keep aside till you prepare the wonderful gravy.

Dish Name: Malai Kofta Vegetable Dumplings In Curry Sauce
Ingredient Names: panir, cream, goat milk yogurt, fresh cilantro, thai green chili, frozen peas and carrot, russet potato, tomatoes, garlic cloves, minced ginger, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, yellow onion, jeera powder
Instructions: Step 1: Koftas: Boil potatoes, drain, cool and grate 1 cup Defrost 1 cup peas and carrots in microwave. Step 2: Using cheesecloth, squeeze moisture out of peas & carrots. Step 3: In a medium-size bowl, combine vegetables with grated potatoes. Step 4: Grate 1 cup paneer and add to vegetable mixture. Step 5: Add 1 small handful chopped cilantro, chopped green chiles, 2 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tbsp cumin powder, a sprinkle of chile powder, 1 / 2 tsp salt. Step 6: Add medium-ground cashews and 1 / 8 cup raisins and mix well With your hands, form into round koftas 1 1 / 2 to 2 inches in diameter and roll in flour, coating all sides of koftas Deep fry in oil in a wok or kadai until golden brown on each side and place on a paper towel to drain.

Dish Name: Malai Methi Paneer Delicious Indian Cottage Cheese Curry
Ingredient Names: cottage cheese, onion, garlic, fresh ginger, coriander seed, cumin seed, red chile, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, dried fenugreek leaves, tomato puree, green bell pepper, fresh cream, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Take a microwaveable glass bowl and toss in the onion, ginger and garlic in it Microwave it on high power level for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the coarsely ground cumin, whole red chilli, coriander seeds, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and kasoori methi Microwave it on high power level for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in the tomato puree, capsicum and 1 / 4 cup of water Microwave on high power level for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the cottage cheese cubes, cream, sugar, salt and 1 / 4 cup of water. Step 5: Mix it very gently so as to not let the cottage cheese cubes break Microwave on high power level for 1 minute. Step 6: Garnish with coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: onion, oil, garlic cloves, ginger paste, tomatoes, sugar, jalapeno pepper, dried fenugreek leaves, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Fry garlic in oil. Step 2: Add onions and fry till golden. Step 3: Add ginger, tomatoes, and peppers and fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add paneer, fenugreek and toss. Step 5: Pour in cream and simmer for a few minutes. Step 6: Serve hot with roti or basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: potato, flour, eggs, fine breadcrumbs, oil, paneer cheese, cashew nuts, raisins, green chilies, sugar, ground coriander cumin chili powder, cardamom powder, vegetable oil, onions, garlic, ginger, poppy seeds to powder, peanuts, tomatoes pur ed, chili powder, garam masala ground coriander, almond cream
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain, return to the pan and put over a low heat to steam dry for a few mins. Mash with some seasoning and cool. Step 2: Mix all the filling ingredients together. Make 12 balls of potato. Take one, press your finger into it to make a little hole, then place a little of the filling mixture into the centre. Pinch the potato back over to seal and shape into a round. Repeat with remaining potato balls and filling. Roll each kofta in flour, dip in the beaten egg, then roll in the breadcrumbs. Fill a deep saucepan halfway with oil, and heat until a small piece of bread browns in 20 secs. Fry the koftas in batches for a few mins until golden, then set aside on kitchen paper. Step 3: For the gravy, blend together the onions, garlic, ginger, poppy seeds and nuts in a food processor to a purée. Heat the oil, then fry the onion purée until just turning brown. Add the puréed tomatoes, spices and sugar. The gravy should be quite thick, but if you want to thin it down a bit, add a little water. Step 4: When the gravy comes to a boil, add the koftas. Heat through and serve with a drizzle of single cream and some flaked almonds scattered on top.

Ingredient Names: raw cashews, blanched almonds, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, whole coriander seed, whole cumin seed, fennel seed, white peppercorns, toor dal, channa dal, ground turmeric, peanut oil, cinnamon stick, green cardamom pods, cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the cashews and almonds in 4 oz water overnight or for at least four hours. Step 2: Blend the nuts and liquid in an electric blender until smooth, remove to a bowl and set aside. Step 3: Rinse the blender container with water before blending the garlic and ginger with two tablespoons water until smooth, set aside. Step 4: Using an electric spice or coffee grinder, grind the coriander, cumin and fennel seeds as finely as possible, then set aside. Step 5: Combine the two dals in a bowl and wash in several changes of water. Step 6: Drain and place in a large lidded pan with 7 cups water and bring to the boil With a slotted spoon skim off any scum that rises to the surface, then add the turmeric and stir Partially cover the pan with its lid, then reduce heat to low. Step 7: Simmer gently until the dal is tender, then remove from heat and set aside.

Ingredient Names: fresh mango, brown sugar, garlic, onions, chilies, peppercorns, cloves, raisins, cayenne pepper, apple cider vinegar, salt, ground ginger, allspice
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients in a large bowl and leave overnight The next day, put everything in a heavy bottomed saucepan and cook slowly for two hours over a low heat. Step 2: Put into sterilised jars while still warm and seal.

Ingredient Names: alphonso mangoes, dried red chilies, honey, lime juice, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Blend everything in a blender till smooth Pour over your green salad and serve.

Ingredient Names: milk, mango ice cream, canned pineapple, fresh mango, grenadine
Instructions: Step 1: Blend milk and half the quantity of the ice-cream. Step 2: Add pineapple and 4 mango pieces. Step 3: Take 2 tall glasses. Step 4: Pour grenadine syrup in them. Step 5: Add 2 slices of fresh mango to each glass. Step 6: Pour prepared milkshake into the glasses. Step 7: Top off with a scoop of the remaining ice-cream, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: mango juice, milk, vanilla ice cream, sugar, vanilla extract, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in a blender and blend the mixture until smooth Pour it in a glass and serve it chilled.

Ingredient Names: water, yogurt, ground cardamom, granulated sugar, salt, mango pulp, ice cube
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a blender Process about 1 minute or until smooth.

Ingredient Names: mango pulp, plain yogurt, milk, cardamom powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all in a blender Keep in refrigerator to serve cold Shake before pouring.

Ingredient Names: mango, orange juice concentrate, plain yogurt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel mango and cut fruit away from pit, discard pit. Step 2: Puree mango flesh in food processor or blender with orange juice concentrate. Step 3: In a bowl, stir yogurt until smooth and creamy. Step 4: Add sugar and pureed mango mixture and stir to blend thoroughly. Step 5: Taste for sweetness If it tastes perfect before freezing, add a pinch or two more sugar Flavors tend to diminish when frozen. Step 6: Pour into pop molds and freeze at least 8 hours To extract, run hot water over bottom and sides of pop mold for 5 seconds.

Ingredient Names: fresh mango, nonfat plain yogurt, sugar, lemon juice, nutmeg, salt, black grapes
Instructions: Step 1: Put mango, yogurt, sugar, lemon juice, nutmeg and salt into blender & process until smooth. Step 2: Spoon into 4 serving dishes, if desired, garnish with grapes cut in 1 / 2, seeds removed Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: mango puree, plain low-fat yogurt, water, sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Put the yogurt, sugar and cold water in a blend. Step 2: Blend at high speed, add mango puree, mix well. Step 3: Take 2 glasses and put some crushed ice in them. Step 4: Pour your mango lassi over it and serve Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: mango, low-fat plain yogurt, garam masala, lite olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the mango and dice into 1 / 2 inch cubes Stir in yogurt Transfer to a serving bowl, sprinkle with the garam masala and a very few drops of oil Serve.

Ingredient Names: milk, cardamom pods, water, sugar, cinnamon stick, coffee
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water and milk in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add cinnamon, cardamom pods, sugar and coffee into boiling liquid in saucepan. Step 3: Stir a few times and boil over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes. Step 4: Make sure it does not boil over. Step 5: Strain coffee through cheesecloth into another pan. Step 6: Place coffee over heat and bring to a boil. Step 7: Pour coffee between two pans until thick and creamy. Step 8: Serve in cups immediately.

Dish Name: Masala Dosa With Coconut Chutney South Indian Savory Crepes With Filling
Ingredient Names: parboiled rice, rice, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, salt, oil, ghee, mustard seeds, gram dal, onions, green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, red chili powder, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: For the dosa: soak the parboiled and uncooked rice together in water Separately, soak the dal and fenugreek seeds together in water. Step 2: After 3-4 hours, drain and reserve the water and grind both separately in a blender to a fine paste, adding some the reserved water as needed until the mixture is of batter consistency. Step 3: Add the salt, some water if necessary, and mix both together thoroughly. Step 4: Keep overnight to ferment The next day, check the batter If too thick, add some water and mix so that it is of a pouring consistency. Step 5: Heat a skillet and grease with some oil. Step 6: Pour a ladleful of batter and spread as quickly as possible into a thin circle. Step 7: Pour a little oil all around the crepe and on the centre as well.

Ingredient Names: white rice, green gram, mixed herbs, onion, ginger, garlic, oatmeal, wheat germ, red chili powder, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, dried bay leaf, salt, vegetable oil, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok, add cumin seeds and let it splutter for few seconds. Step 2: Add astefeodia, bay leaf, curry leaves. Step 3: After the leaf change color add garlic and ginger, let it cook for sometime The add onions, salt, chilli powder. Step 4: Mix for few minutes till onions are slightly transparent. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients and water a little over twice the volume of rice. Step 6: Transfer it in pressure cooker or rice cooker and cook till done. Step 7: Serve hot with curd or any kind of raita For decoration sprinkle the khichdi with chopped coriander leaves and mint leaves.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, potatoes, peas, onion, green chilies, chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, ginger, garlic paste, yogurt, cardamoms, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and soak rice for around 1 / 2 an hour In the meanwhile, cut the vegetables. Step 2: Mix the spice powders and yogurt together in a bowl, heat oil. Step 3: Saute the onion till light brown. Step 4: Add the ginger, garlic and green chilli and saute till brown. Step 5: Add the spice paste and saute for 5 mins more. Step 6: Add some water if needed to avoid burning. Step 7: Add the potatoes, peas and rice saute for few mins. Step 8: Add 4 cups water and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: ground coriander, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, ground turmeric, oil, onions, chickpeas, black pepper, salt, fresh lemon juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To make masala, mix spices until blended and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil over med-high heat. Step 3: Add onions and saute until light brown, 8-10minutes, add masala. Step 4: Stir 1 minute or until spices are fragrant. Step 5: Stir in chickpeaks, pepper, salt and 1 t Water. Step 6: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly for 7 minutes or until the first few chickpeas begin to split It it becomes dry, add some water Only add 1 t.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, dried chilies, canola oil, salt and pepper, curry powder, chopped tomato, water, winter squash, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Place onions and garlic into food processor bowl and grind until it is turns into a paste. Step 2: Add oil to a saucepan or skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add garlic-onion paste, salt, pepper and curry and saut for 5 to 10 minutes. Step 4: Stir occasionally and allow the onions to brown. Step 5: Add drained tomatoes, chili and squash to the skillet. Step 6: Stir in in cup of water or reserved liquid from canned tomatoes if using. Step 7: Cover and adjust heat so that you achieve a low simmer. Step 8: Stir occasionally, adding more liquid as needed Squash should be tender and ready to serve in 20 minutes. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, cumin, ground coriander, cayenne, amchoor, garam masala, chaat masala, salt, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, dried red chilies, curry leaves, asafoetida powder, turmeric, green chili
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes, leaving them very slightly on the firm side Peel, cool and cut into 3 / 4" cubes. Step 2: Sprinkle the cumin, coriander, cayenne, amchur, garam masala and chaat masala on the potatoes and mix well but gently. Step 3: Add salt to taste, keeping in mind that some dry spices have their own saltiness Do a taste test and mix gently. Step 4: In a skillet, heat the oil on medium heat. Step 5: Once the oil is hot, add in mustard seeds and allow them to pop. Step 6: Add in the dry red chili, if using. Step 7: Add in asafoetida, turmeric, curry leaves and green chillies in that order. Step 8: Then add in the potatoes and mix gently, but thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, gram flour, salt, green chilies, black pepper, mango powder, coriander, onions, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Mix wheat flour, gram flour and salt together Rub ghee into it. Step 2: Add green chilies, pepper, mango powder, coriander and onions Gradually add water and knead till it forms into a soft ball. Step 3: Cover and leave for 30 minutes. Step 4: Make approx 10 small balls of the dough, roll them out. Step 5: Heat a flat bottom pan and cook on one side till brown then turn over to other side and spread little ghee on them.

Ingredient Names: red lentil, water, ghee, onion, garlic cloves, whole coriander seeds, cumin seeds, dried red pepper flakes, cardamom seed, cinnamon sticks, turmeric powder, salt, lemon juice, plain low-fat yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the lentils well, and then put them into a sauce pan. Step 2: Add 4 - 6 cups of salted water to cover the lentils. Step 3: Bring lentils to a boil then reduce heat, cover and allow to simmer until they are soft. Step 4: Keep the water level above the lentils While the lentils are simmering, grind the spices together then toast them over low heat in a dry saut pan until you have released their aromas, set spices aside. Step 5: Using the same saut pan, heat ghee or oil over low to medium heat. Step 6: Add onions and saut until they are soft. Step 7: Add garlic, saut another 3-4 minutes Do not burn the onions or garlic.

Ingredient Names: green lentil, onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ground red chili pepper, ground cardamom, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the lentils in the water over medium heat until tender. Step 2: In a fry pan, saute the onions and garlic in olive oil until tender. Step 3: Add the spices and lentils into the fry pan. Step 4: Cook over medium heat until the lentils are just slightly mushy Be very careful with the cardamom, it can easily overpower any spice. Step 5: Add it a dash at a time. Step 6: Serve with brown rice or warm pita.

Dish Name: Masoor Masala Red Lentils With Onion And Garlic
Ingredient Names: red lentils, water, sunflower oil, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, tomatoes, chili powder, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place the lentils in a large saucepan and add the water, boil until mushy. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the onions until golden. Step 3: Drain half of them with a slotted spoon and reserve in a separate bowl. Step 4: Add the ginger and garlic pastes to the pan and stir for a few seconds. Step 5: Stir in the tomatoes and the chili powder and cook until soft. Step 6: Season with salt and stir in the cooked lentils. Step 7: Serve hot, topped with the reserved fried onions and a sprinkling of cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: lentils, salt, oil, onions, green chili pepper, garlic clove, coriander seeds, clove, cinnamon, ginger, poppy seed, cumin, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer lentils in water with salt and 1 tsp oil. Step 2: Place chopped onions and chile, peeled garlic clove and spices in blender Grind. Step 3: Fry this in oil, then add cumin and turmeric, stirring until oil separates, add a little salt. Step 4: Mix with the cooked lentils, boil for ten minutes. Step 5: Cook's hints: remove and discard chile seeds with the end of a potato parer while wearing plastic gloves I like serrano chile. Step 6: Keep your mouth shut while chopping onions and you won't cry.

Dish Name: Mattar Paneer Indian Peas With Paneer Cheese
Ingredient Names: paneer cheese, vegetable oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt, ground turmeric, ground cayenne pepper, diced tomato, water, frozen green peas, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1-2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet and saute the paneer in batches, until lightly browned, and drain on paper toweling. Step 2: In a large pan, heat the 3 tbsp oil or ghee and cook the onion, ginger and garlic until the onion is tender, about 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Add the coriander, cumin, salt, turmeric, and cayenne, and cook until the spices become fragrant, 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and cook 2-3 minutes, stirring once or twice. Step 5: Add the paneer, water, and peas and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 8-10 minutes or until the sauce is thick and smooth. Step 7: Garnish with cilantro before serving.

Dish Name: Matthan Erisheri South Indian Pumpkin And Lentil Stew
Ingredient Names: dried lentils, pumpkin, salt, turmeric, coconut, red chile, cumin seed, oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook lentils in a pressure cooker till tender Alternately you can also cook it in a saucepan. Step 2: Add 1 cup water to lentils, bring to a boil, then reduce flame to low, cover, and simmer until tender. Step 3: Cook chopped pumpkins in another saucepan with approximately 1 cup water, along with salt and turmeric, until tender. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a grinder or food processor, grind grated coconut, red chili, and cumin seeds into a paste. Step 5: When the pumpkin is cooked, add the cooked lentils and coconut paste to it and bring to a boil. Step 6: In a small frying pan, heat oil over medium-high flame and add mustard, urad dal and curry leaves. Step 7: When mustard sputters, add 1 teaspoon grated coconut and fry until it turns brown. Step 8: Add the contents of the frying pan to the lentil-pumpkin mixture, stir well.

Dish Name: Melting In The Mouth Spinach Potato Curry
Ingredient Names: spinach, potatoes, tomato puree, onion paste, garlic paste, ginger paste, green chilies, salt, black pepper, turmeric powder, fennel seed, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan, add fennel seeds, let them crackle. Step 2: Add onion, green chillies, garlic, ginger paste and saut till it turns pinkish brown. Step 3: Add salt, turmeric and black pepper powder Saut for 3-4 seconds and add tomato puree Wait till gravy is well cooked and raw smell is gone. Step 4: Add cubed potatoes and stir well for 4 minutes. Step 5: Add pureed spinach now and lower the heat. Step 6: Let it cook fir 15 minutes on heat or microwave for 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Methi Dum Aloo Fenugreek Indian Spicy Potatoes
Ingredient Names: ghee, asafoetida powder, mustard seeds, cumin seed, dried fenugreek, salt, black pepper, baby potatoes, tomatoes, onions, garlic, fresh ginger, green chilies, kashmiri chilies, coriander seed
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together all the ingredients mentioned under'masala paste' and keep aside Prick potatoes all over using a fork, heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Once its hot, deep fry the potatoes in it until golden in colour. Step 3: Drain on clean paper towels and keep aside. Step 4: Heat oil or ghee in a skillet. Step 5: Add cumin and mustard seeds alongwith asafoetida powder, allow to splutter. Step 6: Once they stop spluttering, add the ground paste and fry until the ghee or oil separates from the masala. Step 7: Add kasoori methi, salt, pepper, potatoes and a little water.

Ingredient Names: fenugreek leaves, red onion, tomatoes, green chili peppers, turmeric, masala, asafoetida powder, ginger-garlic paste, toor dal, vegetable oil, salt, fenugreek seeds, coriander seed, chili, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast and grind the dhal masala ingredients to powder. Step 2: Heat oil and add asafetida and green chilli, fry onions. Step 3: Then add tomatoes, dhal masala, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste One the paste is ready, add methi leaves and toor dhal. Step 4: Add adequate water and pressure cook. Step 5: Add salt after the pressure is released. Step 6: Decorate with cilantro and add lime juice if added.

Dish Name: Methi Malai Paneer Curry Recipe - Dhaba Style
Ingredient Names: methi fenugreek leaves, ghee, asafoetida, cumin, cinnamon, black cardamom, onions, ginger garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, tomato puree, salt, water, cubes paneer cottage cheese, fresh cream, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, take 1 bunch methi leaves in a large bowl. Step 2: Add 1 tsp salt and soak for 15 minutes. Step 3: Squeeze off the water, this helps to remove bitterness from methi. Step 4: Chop them finely making sure the methi is clean. Keep aside. Step 5: In a kaai, heat 2 tbsp ghee and saute chopped methi. Step 6: Once the methi turns aromatic, keep it aside. Step 7: Add 2 tbsp oil, pinch hing, 1 tsp cumin, 1 inch cinnamon, 1 black cardamom and 4 cloves. Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 8: Add 1 onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute until the onions turn golden brown. Step 9: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp coriander powder. Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 10: Now add 1 cup tomato puree, 1 tsp salt and cook well. Step 11: Cook until the oil separates from the sides. Step 12: Add 2 cup hot water and adjust the consistency. Step 13: Further add 20 cubes paneer, 2 tbsp cream and mix gently. Step 14: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until the flavors are well absorbed. Step 15: Now add ½ tsp garam masala and mix well. Step 16: Finally, enjoy Methi Malai Paneer Recipe with roti and rice.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, fenugreek leaves, coriander leaves, turmeric powder, water, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour in a bowl. Step 2: Mix the rest of the ingredients with 1 tsp Ghee. Step 3: Make a soft dough using water. Step 4: Knead well for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Divide the dough into 20 portions. Step 6: Shape them into round balls. Step 7: Roll out each ball on a floured board into a round puri 4" in diameter. Step 8: Heat ghee in a deep frying pan. Step 9: Fry 1 or 2 puris at a time until it turns golden brown.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, gram flour, fenugreek leaves, chili powder, yogurt, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Sieve the wheat and gram flours separately. Step 2: Make a well in the center of the flour and add all the ingredients except oil for frying. Step 3: Mix well If needed add enough water to make a stiff dough, knead well. Step 4: Cover and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 5: Knead the dough again and divide into walnut sized portions. Step 6: Shape the portions into small balls and roll out like chapatis. Step 7: Heat a griddle on a high flame. Step 8: Once heated, lower the flame to lowest.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, frozen mixed vegetables, raisins, vegetable stock cube, curry paste, salted cashews, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Put rice, raisins and veg in a large microwaveable bowl. Step 2: Pour the water over and crumble in the stock cube and curry paste, stir well and cover with cling film leaving a gap at one side to let steam escape Microwave at full power for 12 mins add more time if your microwave is less powerful. Step 3: Take out and leave to stand while you get out plates and forks, fluff the rice and serve sprinkled with the nuts.

Ingredient Names: paprika, ground cumin, ground ginger, ground turmeric, ground coriander, ground cardamom, ground red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients Store in an airtight container in a dark, cool place for up to 2 months.

Dish Name: Mild Delights Yellow Pumpkin In Coconut Gravy
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, coconut milk, onion, salt, black pepper, dried red chilies, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 6 cups of water in a pot, add 1 tsp Of salt and when it starts boiling add pumpkin pieces. Step 2: Allow the water to boil for 4 minutes. Step 3: Strain, run under cold water and reserve the pumpkin, mash it lightly. Step 4: Heat butter in a thick bottomed pan and add red chillies first Wait for a few seconds till the chillies begin to release their colour in the butter Proceed to add salt, black pepper and onion Saut till the onion is translucent. Step 5: Add blanched pumpkin and saut gently for 5-7 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, cheddar cheese, tamarind paste, coriander leaves, green chilies, ginger, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind all the ingredients in a mixer / grinder until smooth Use as a spread for sandwiches, and top with anything you like!

Ingredient Names: dried yeast, sugar, warm water, flour, salt, ghee, plain yogurt, garlic cloves, parsley, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yeast, sugar and water in a bowl. Step 2: Cover and leave undisturbed for 10-15 minutes. Step 3: Mix flour and salt and sieve into a bowl, make a well. Step 4: Put into the middle the melted ghee or butter, the yogurt and the yeast mixture Form to a dough. Step 5: Knead on a floured surface for 10-15 minutes until the dough is smooth. Step 6: Put into a big, oiled bowl, cover with a wetish towel and leave to rest for an hour by when the dough should have doubled. Step 7: Knead for one minute. Step 8: Cut into 32 pieces.

Dish Name: Mirj's Easy Sweet And Spicy Fat Free Curry Flavored Pumpkin
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, tomato paste, sweet chili sauce, curry powder, cinnamon, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pumpkin dice in a large microwave-safe bowl. Step 2: Add the rest of the ingredients and combine thoroughly Nuke, covered and vented, for about 13 minutes on high, this will give you a crisp bite For a mushier dish, nuke for about 18 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mixed vegetables, onion, tomatoes, green chili pepper, ginger-garlic paste, coriander powder, turmeric powder, chili powder, garam masala powder, cumin seed, panir, water, oil, coriander leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a kadhai or thick bottomed pan, heat oil, add cumin seeds. Step 2: Once they splutter, add the chopped onions. Step 3: Fry the onions till they become transparent. Step 4: Add the ginger-garlic paste. Step 5: Fry for a minute or till the raw smell disappears, add the tomatoes. Step 6: Keep on stirring till the tomatoes become soft and pulp when the mixture becomes smooth and one, then add all the spice powders mentioned above. Step 7: Now add all the spice powders one by one. Step 8: Stir the spice powders with the onion-tomato mixture.

Ingredient Names: mixed vegetables, onions, oil, green cardamoms, whole cloves, cinnamon sticks, green chilies, ginger, black peppercorns, coconut milk, water, curry leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan on medium level till it is hot. Step 2: Add the green cardamoms, cloves and cinnamon. Step 3: Fry for a few seconds. Step 4: Now add the green chilli, ginger and the sliced onions. Step 5: Saute on medium heat for 3 minute or till the onions are transparent and soft. Step 6: Add the mixed vegetables, curry leaves, salt and water. Step 7: Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes or till the vegetables are cooked. Step 8: Add the peppercorns and the coconut milk. Step 9: Simmer on very low heat for about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut, cilantro leaf, low-fat coconut milk, garlic cloves, serrano chili, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, carrots, sweet potato, cauliflower, green beans, coconut oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Pure cilantro leaves, coconut, coconut milk, garlic, serrano chile, coriander, and cayenne pepper in food processor until mixture forms a smooth paste, set aside. Step 2: Place carrots and sweet potato in large skillet, and cover with 1 cup water. Step 3: Bring to a simmer over medium heat, and cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Add cauliflower, cover skillet, and simmer 2 minutes. Step 5: Add green beans, cover, and cook 2 minutes more, or until vegetables are just tender. Step 6: Stir in cilantro-and-coconut paste, and season with salt and pepper, if desired. Step 7: Cover, and keep warm. Step 8: Meanwhile, heat oil in small skillet over medium-high heat. Step 9: Add mustard seeds, and cover.

Ingredient Names: head of cabbage, carrot, french beans, spring onions, green capsicum, salt, refined flour, cornflour, oil, gingerroot, garlic cloves, green chilies, soy sauce, sugar, msg
Instructions: Step 1: Reserve the chopped greens of the spring onions for garnishing. Step 2: Mix cabbage, carrot and french beans in a bowl and thoroughly rub in one teaspoon of salt. Step 3: Add spring onion, green capsicum, refined flour and one-fourth cup of cornflour, mix thoroughly. Step 4: Shape into lemon sized balls. Step 5: Heat sufficient oil in a wok and deep-fry vegetable balls in small batches for three to four minutes on medium heat or until golden brown. Step 6: Drain and place on an absorbent paper. Step 7: Heat two tablespoons of oil in a wok or a pan and stir-fry ginger and garlic briefly. Step 8: Add green chillies, stir-fry briefly.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, cayenne pepper, canola oil, onion, yellow bell pepper, boiling potatoes, carrots, garam masala, chili powder, cauliflower floret, light coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Pulse ginger and garlic in a blender or food processor until they are both finely chopped. Step 2: Add the tomatoes with the juice and the cayenne pepper Pulse together until combined but don't let it turn into a puree, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a nonstick pan or large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and bell pepper. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, until softened About 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in potatoes, carrots, garam masala, and chili powder. Step 7: Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, onions, curry paste, potatoes, chopped tomatoes, carrots, green beans, peas, single cream, coriander, lemon, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Step 2: When they sizzle add onions and cook until they begin to brown. Step 3: Stir in the paste and 150 ml water and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the potatoes and stir well. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and 250 ml water. Step 6: Cover and cook for 10 mins before adding carrots and having a good stir. Step 7: Add green beans and cook for five mins more. Step 8: Add the peas, cream and 2 tbsp coriander and leave to cook for another 2 minutes. Step 9: Check seasoning and serve topped with the rest of the coriander and the lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, butter, milk, green chili, mixed vegetables, panir, fresh coriander leaves, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter in a pan. Step 2: Add plain flour Roast on low flame for 3 minutes, add milk. Step 3: Stir continuously to avoid lumps. Step 4: Boil the sauce till it becomes reasonably thick. Step 5: Add salt, pepper and chopped chillies as per taste. Step 6: Add boiled mixed vegetables and paneer, mix well. Step 7: Cook on low flame for a minute.

Dish Name: Mom's 3C S Mologutal South Indian Vegetable Lentil Stew
Ingredient Names: carrot, cucumbers, boiling water, salt, water, yellow lentils, turmeric powder, coconut, cumin seed, red chile, curry leaves, vegetable oil, mustard seeds, urad dal
Instructions: Step 1: Add chopped carrots and cucumbers to enough boiling water to cover, with a little salt, in medium saucepan, and simmer for 10 minutes or until tender While the veggies are cooking, boil 1 cup of water and add the yellow lentils and turmeric to it. Step 2: Simmer for about 15-20 minutes or until soft Grind the shredded coconut, cumin seeds, and red chili in a blender / grinder with a little water to form a paste. Step 3: Add this paste to the cooked veggies. Step 4: Once the lentils are cooked, add them to the veggie-coconut mixture and mix well. Step 5: Bring the stew to a boil, and add water if it appears too thick. Step 6: Add curry leaves and salt to taste. Step 7: In a small frying pan, heat the oil, and add the mustard seeds and urad dal. Step 8: When the mustard starts to sputter, pour the oil-seed mixture into the stew.

Ingredient Names: bulgar wheat, water, onions, green chili, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fresh coriander leaves, cauliflower florets, french beans, tomatoes, carrot, green peas, salt, oil, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast the dalia in a wok until lightly brownish in appearance and it smells aromatic. Step 2: Remove from flame and transfer to a plate. Step 3: Now heat oil in the same wok. Step 4: Once hot, add cumin and mustard seeds, allow to splutter. Step 5: Once they stop spluttering, add curry leaves, green chilli and onions. Step 6: Stir-fry until the mixture smells aromatic and the onions are lightly browned. Step 7: Add coriander leaves and mix well. Step 8: Fold in the veggies, salt and tomato, mix again.

Dish Name: Mom's Quick N Easy Kesari Indian Semolina Sweet Dish
Ingredient Names: water, sugar, saffron, semolina, ghee, ground cardamom, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water, saffron and sugar in a skillet over high heat. Step 2: Once the sugar has melted and the water is boiling rapidly, reduce flame to low, add the semolina and 1 tablespoon and 2 teaspoons ghee and stir continuously for 2 minutes The mixture should have"clumped" together into a homogeneous, non-sticky mass. Step 3: Remove from flame, add the ground cardamom and mix well In another small pan heat the remaining 1 teaspoon of ghee and roast the broken cashewnuts in it until golden brown. Step 4: Add the roasted nuts along with any leftover ghee to the cooked semolina mixture and mix well. Step 5: Now here's where the fun is! Step 6: Pack a 1 / 3 cup measure with the kesari, pressing down well, then invert onto an individual serving dish-- it's not jello, so you'll have to use some force while inverting! Step 7: Repeat for the rest of the kesari, sit down with friends and family and enjoy this simple sweet dish!

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon, black cardamom pods, cloves, whole black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly roast all the ingredients Powder the lightly roasted ingredients in a grinder Store in a bottle and use as and when desired.

Ingredient Names: mung dal, water, green chili, ginger, garlic clove, cilantro, salt, flax seeds, cumin seed, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Add dal, chili, ginger, garlic, cilantro, salt, ground flaxseed and half the water into a blender. Step 2: Blend until the consistency of a thick paste / thick pancake batter, adding remaining water a little at time until you get the right consistency. Step 3: Pour batter into a large mixing bowl. Step 4: Stir the cumin seeds into the batter Spray nonstick griddle or cast iron flat pan with oil spray or add 2 tsp of oil and spread with a piece of onion. Step 5: Heat pan until it is hot. Step 6: Pour one ladle full of batter into the center of pan and spread it around in a circular fashion shaping the batter into a thin round Wait few seconds and sprinkle 1 / 2 tsp of oil around the edges of the pesarattu Wait for few minutes until the bottom gets golden, then reverse it, cook the otherside now, for few seconds Optional: reverse it back, sprinkle finely chopped onions on the top and fold it half.

Ingredient Names: moong dal, ginger, chili, curry leaves, fresh coriander, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, cumin, ajwain, onions, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, soak 1 cup moong dal for 1 hour. Ensure that you do not over-soak the dal, as this makes the pakoda soft rather than crunchy. Step 2: Drain off the water and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 3: Add 1 inch of ginger and grind to a coarse paste. Step 4: Transfer the moong dal paste to a large plate. Step 5: Add 2 chilli, few curry leaves, 2 tbsp coriander. Step 6: Also add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala, ½ tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, ¼ tsp ajwain, ½ onion and 1 tsp salt. Step 7: Squeeze and mix well, ensuring all the species are thoroughly combined. Step 8: Drop a small bite-sized mixture into hot oil. Step 9: Stir occasionally, keeping the flame on medium. Step 10: Fry till the pakoda turns golden brown and crunchy. Drain off. Step 11: Finally, enjoy the Moong Dal Pakoda Recipe with green chutney.

Ingredient Names: dried lentils, onion, tomatoes, coriander, green chili pepper, cumin seed, vegetable oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Add cumin seeds Wait until they crackle before adding the chili. Step 3: Now add onion, a pinch of salt, and saute on a low flame till the onion turns translucent. Step 4: Add the tomato and a bit of salt and let it fry on a low flame until the water starts separating from the tomato. Step 5: Add the moong dal and mix it well into the onion-tomato paste, add salt, let it fry for a few minutes. Step 6: Add enough water to just about submerge the moong, cover the pan with a lid and leave it to cook on a low flame. Step 7: Stir the mixture occasionally to make sure that the water does not evaporate leaving the moong stuck to the bottom of the pan. Step 8: When all the water has disappeared, check to see that the moong is soft enough to be eaten The mix should be dry and not liquid like indian dal normally is.

Dish Name: Mouth Watering Carrot And Cheese Parathas
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, salt, water, ghee, fresh carrots, cheddar cheese, pepper, red chili powder, fresh mint leaves, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Sieve flour and salt in a large bowl. Step 2: Add water, a little at a time, and knead well to make a dough, cover. Step 3: Keep aside for 30 minutes. Step 4: Now mix all the ingredients listed under carrot and cheese filling in a bowl. Step 5: Divide the dough into 8 balls. Step 6: Roll each ball into a paratha. Step 7: Place spoonfuls of the carrot-cheese filling on each paratha. Step 8: Bring together the edges of the paratha and seal completely. Step 9: Roll out the parathas, one at a time.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic, curry, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and cook onions, stirring, for about 4 minutes. Step 2: Add 1-4 teaspoons mrcurrys Com instant curry seasoning powder Also add garlic& ginger and stir mixture for about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add tomato, salt as needed and cook& stir for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add cooked, drained potato pieces and gently stir for another 4 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red chilies, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, mild curry powder, cinnamon, cardamom pods, red lentil, chicken stock, potato, apple
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan add onion, garlic, ginger, chillies and ground spices. Step 2: Cook stirring for about 5 minutes or until the onion is soft. Step 3: Add lentils, stock, potato and apple, simmer covered about 20 minutes or until the potato is tender and the lentils are cooked Process until smooth, return to pan. Step 4: Add coconut milk, juice and coriander leaves. Step 5: Serve Can be made a day ahead.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, garlic, peanut oil, spanish onion, black mustard seeds, garam masala, tandoori spice mix, curry powder, kosher salt, ground cardamom, cayenne, whole tomatoes, vegetable stock, brown lentils, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Puree the ginger and garlic in a blender or food processor. Step 2: Heat oil and add onion and ginger and garlic, until tender. Step 3: Add the mustard seed and cook until they begin to pop. Step 4: Add in garam masal, tandoor spice mix, curry salt, cardamom and cayenne and stir to coat onion, ginger and garlic. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the stock and lentils and bring the mixture to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat, partially cover and simmer for 1 hour, until the lentils are tender stir in coconut milk and simmer 2 minutes. Step 8: Remove from heat and stir in spinach and lemon juice and sugar. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: sona masuri rice, black chana, lobia black eyed pea, urad dal, mung beans, poha, fenugreek leaves, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 3 cup sona masuri rice, 1 cup black chana, 1 cup lobia, 1 cup urad dal, 1 cup mung beans, 1 cup thin poha, and 1 tsp methi. Step 2: Rinse with enough water and soak for 6 hours. Step 3: After the dal have soaked well, transfer it to the mixer jar. Step 4: Grind to smooth batter adding water as required. Step 5: Transfer the batter to a large vessel and mix well with hand. Step 6: Cover and allow to ferment for 8 hours in a warm place. Step 7: After 8 hours, the batter would have doubled indicating it is well fermented. Step 8: Now mix the batter gently and use the batter to prepare dosa adding salt as required. Step 9: Spread the dosa batter on hot tawa. Step 10: Roast the dosa adding little oil or ghee. roast until the dosa turns golden brown. Step 11: Finally, the Multigrain Dosa batter can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a week and used to make weekly breakfast.

Ingredient Names: cayenne pepper, allspice, turmeric, gingerroot, salt, cabbage, butter, tomato paste, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Chop onions and brown in butter. Step 2: Mix spices, tomato paste and ginger to a paste and add to onions. Step 3: Simmer on medium heat for a couple of minutes, add cabbage. Step 4: Stir, adding a bit of water as needed until cooked.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, crackers, mayonnaise, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put a slice of tomato on each biscuit / cracker Smear with little mayo and sprinkle black pepper Munch without guilt!

Ingredient Names: bread, relish sandwich spread, cucumber, cheese, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the cucumber Coat the slices of bread with mayonnaise or sandwich spread. Step 2: Place a few slices of cucumber on one slice. Step 3: Add a slice of cheese. Step 4: Sprinkle pepper For special flavour try sprinkling roasted cumin seeds powder. Step 5: Cover with the other slice Munch-- munch-- munch!

Ingredient Names: baby eggplants, salt, fennel seed, coriander seed, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, coriander powder, chili powder, turmeric, lemon juice, tomatoes, dried red chilies, curry leaves, deep frying oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggplant into quarters up to 1 / 2 inch to the stem Leaving the stem and the area closest to it intact The stem will hold the eggplant together during the cooking Submerge the eggplants in 2 cups of cold water and 1 teaspoons of salt for 5 minutes and then drain thoroughly Deep fry eggplants for 2-3 minutes. Step 2: Remove with a slotted spoon, set aside to cool. Step 3: Using a coffee grinder, lightly crush 1 teaspoon of the fennel seeds, 1 / 2 teaspoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 teaspoon of fenugreek seeds, and 1 teaspoon of mustard seeds. Step 4: Mix these with the coriander powder, chili powder, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt, turmeric, and lemon juice. Step 5: Set aside a quarter of this spice paste. Step 6: Divide the remaining paste into the cuts in each eggplant.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, potato chunks, eggplant chunks, button mushrooms, curry paste, vegetable stock, reduced-fat coconut milk, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the onion and potato. Cover, then cook over a low heat for 5 mins until the potatoes start to soften. Throw in the aubergine and mushrooms, then cook for a few more mins. Step 2: Stir in the curry paste, pour over the stock and coconut milk. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 mins or until the potato is tender. Stir through the coriander and serve with rice or naan bread.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, red chilies, cold water, vegetable oil, coriander seed, cumin seed, ground cumin, green cardamom pods, ground turmeric, tomatoes, mushroom, okra, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the seeds from the cardamom pods and grind in a mortar and pestle. Step 2: Set aside With either a stick blender or food processor, blend the garlic, ginger and chilies with 3 tablespoons of the water, until smooth, set aside. Step 3: Heat a large pan over medium to high heat, add the oil, and when hot, add the coriander and cumin seeds and allow them to sizzle for a few seconds. Step 4: Add the ground cumin, cardamom and turmeric and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the garlic, ginger and chili paste, the tomatoes, the remaining water, mushrooms and okra. Step 6: Mix well, bring to the boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Uncover and cook the curry for 10 minutes more, or until the okra is tender. Step 8: Serve hot, garnished with the cilantro and accompanied by rice and a tangy indian relish.

Ingredient Names: mushroom, potato, oil, onions, gingerroot, turmeric powder, ground dried chile, salt, tomatoes, spinach leaves, garam masala, cilantro leaf, lemon juice, mustard seeds, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil or ghee in a wok or kahai, and saute the onion and ginger until onion is turning golden brown. Step 2: Add turmeric, chile powder and salt and saute for two minutes. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, potatoes and tomatoes and cook over gentle heat until the potatoes are tender. Step 4: Add a splash of water if necessary. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat a small skillet and saute the mustard seeds in the extra two tablespoons oil until they pop. Step 6: Add the curry leaves, sliced garlic and shredded coconut, and stir and fry until coconut is turning golden Immediately remove from the heat and set aside. Step 7: When the potatoes are tender, stir in the garam masala, chopped cilantro leaves and lemon juice. Step 8: Pour the contents of the small skillet over the curry, then serve with dal and rice.

Ingredient Names: red onion, tomato puree, mushroom, vegetable oil, cloves, cinnamon stick, chili powder, ground coriander, garlic, turmeric, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and add the cloves and cinnamon stick. Step 2: Fry for a few seconds, add the onions and saute for a few more minutes. Step 3: Add the chili powder, coriander, garlic and turmeric along with just a little bit of water and saute until the onions soften. Step 4: Add the tomato puree, mushrooms and salt and simmer for 5-8 mins on low heat. Step 5: Serve hot, great with rice!

Ingredient Names: mushroom, onions, oil, cardamom pods, bay leaves, whole black peppercorns, whole cloves, cinnamon bark, garlic cloves, chilies, fresh ginger, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. Step 2: Add cardamom pods, bay leaves, black peppercorns, cloves and cinnamon Wait until the cloves swell up or the bay leaves begin to take on colour This just takes a few seconds. Step 3: Now add chopped onions, stir and fry until they are golden brown. Step 4: Turn heat to low and add garlic, ginger, chillies, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, garam masala, paprika, tomato puree and stir to mix. Step 5: Cool this mixture by placing pan into a bowl of cold water. Step 6: Now put in a tablespoon of yoghurt one spoon at a time incorporating it into the sauce each time before adding any more. Step 7: Then add mushrooms and stir to mix. Step 8: Turn heat to medium low, cover and simmer for about 10 - 15 minutes or until the sauce has reduced and turned fairly thick or until the mushrooms are cooked.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cumin seed, onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, chili powder, celery leaves, fenugreek seeds, heavy cream, salt, white button mushrooms, green bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok, and add the cumin seeds. Step 2: When they begin to sizzle add the onion. Step 3: Cook on medium heat till onion is brown. Step 4: Then add the ginger garlic paste and stir for about 45 seconds. Step 5: Pour in the tomato puree and sprinkle the coriander, cumin, turmeric and chili powders, bring to a boil. Step 6: Then reduce heat to a simmer, and let the gravy cook for about 12 minutes or till it thickens and oil floats on top If the sauce gets too thick add cup water whenever needed While the sauce is cooking, work on the mushrooms Wipe the mushrooms clean with a paper towel.

Dish Name: Mushrooms With Ginger And Green Chilli Khombi Tarkari
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, gingerroot, garlic, green chilies, turmeric, mushrooms, salt, cumin seed, lemon juice, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or a large skillet. Step 2: Add onions and fry them on medium heat for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic and chilli and fry for another 2 minutes. Step 4: Add turmeric, mushrooms and some salt. Step 5: Fry until all the liquid from the mushroom has vanished and the mushrooms have browned. Step 6: Reduce the heat, add the cumin seeds and the lemon juice and fry until the mushrooms have absorbed the lemon juice. Step 7: Check the seasoning and serve hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: water, mustard powder, sugar, cider vinegar, pears, mango, dark seedless raisins, onion, garlic clove, ground ginger, red pepper flakes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Stir water into mustard in small cup. Step 2: Combine the sugar and vinegar in a medium-size saucepan. Step 3: Bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve sugar. Step 4: Boil gently 10 minutes. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients, including mustard mixture. Step 6: Boil gently, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid evaporates and the fruit is tender, about 30 minutes, cool completely. Step 7: Refrigerate, covered, for up to 1 week, serve cold.

Ingredient Names: white vinegar, water, sugar, mustard seeds, papayas, curry powder, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, water, sugar and mustard in 1-quart pan. Step 2: Place over medium heat and bring to boil. Step 3: Cook until liquid becomes syrupy. Step 4: Add papayas and curry powder. Step 5: Cook 2 minutes more, stirring constantly. Step 6: Remove from heat and mix in onion Pack mixture into jar and refrigerate 1 week before using.

Ingredient Names: light sesame oil, mustard seeds, head of cabbage, jalapeno, curry leaves, shredded coconut, onion, turmeric, powdered cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place in a large skillet or wok the sesame oil, add the mustard seeds and cover for a couple minutes, the seeds will pop. Step 2: Add all the remaining ingredients and saut for about 10 minutes stirring every so often so it does not stick If it starts to stick you may add a little bit of water or a little bit more of the sesame oil The cabbage needs to remain al dente with a crunch, do not overcook. Step 3: Taste and adjust salt to taste. Step 4: Let it rest to develop a pretty yellow color from the turmeric for about 10-15 minutes and then serve hot or cold You may prepare the night before, it keeps well and tastes even better the next day.

Ingredient Names: paneer cheese, onion, chopped tomatoes, frozen peas, garlic cloves, ground ginger, ground coriander, garam masala, turmeric, ground cumin, ground black pepper, salt, oil, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put a little bit of oil in a deep, heavy bottomed frying pan and brown the cheese, turning frequently so no sides burn. Step 2: When it is browned, set aside on a plate. Step 3: Add more oil, if needed, to the pan and throw in the onions. Step 4: Let them fry until golden, then add the garlic and spices. Step 5: Fry some more for a couple minutes, then add the tin of tomatoes and about 1 / 2 cup of water. Step 6: Let simmer for about five minutes, then put in the fried cheese and peas and simmer covered over a low heat for about 20 minutes. Step 7: Check the consistency and simmer some more if needed to bring it down to a thickness you like. Step 8: Serve with rice and other indian curries of your choice.

Ingredient Names: vermicelli, raisins, almonds, cashews, ghee, cardamom powder, sugar, milk, sunflower seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Break roasted vermicelli with hand and keep aside. Step 2: Wash and pat dry raisins. Step 3: Cut almonds into slivers and chop cashewnuts. Step 4: Heat ghee in a pan. Step 5: Add cardamom powder and sugar. Step 6: Cook on low heat, stirring continuously, for 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Add milk and continue to cook for 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Add broken vermicelli and continue to cook for 4-5 minutes or till the vermicelli is dry. Step 9: Serve hot, garnished with sunflower seeds, raisins, almonds, cashews and edible silver foil, if desired.

Ingredient Names: panir, ginger, garlic, onions, coriander powder, cumin powder, cinnamon, ghee, turmeric powder, mango, red chili powder, cream, lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut paneer into 1 x 2 inch rectangles of 1 / 2 inch thickness. Step 2: Combine panner, ginger and garlic in a bowl. Step 3: Marinate for an hour in the refrigerator Barbecue the paneer on an electric grill or shallow-fry in a non-stick frying pan. Step 4: Heat 3 tbsps Of ghee in a large non-stick wok, add onions. Step 5: Stir-fry until golden in colour. Step 6: Add coriander, cumin, cinnamon, chilli and turmeric powders. Step 7: Stir-fry for a minute.

Dish Name: My Addictive Besan Gram Flour Ladoo Will Leave U Licking Ur Fingers Clean
Ingredient Names: gram flour, almonds, cashews, ghee, cardamom, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsely grind the cashews and almonds, keep aside. Step 2: Melt ghee in a wok, add besan. Step 3: Cook on low heat till besan is fragrant and well cooked It takes only about 5-8 minutes. Step 4: Let it cool for a while. Step 5: Add powdered nuts, cardamom powder and sugar, mix well. Step 6: Shape into round balls and store in an airtight container.

Dish Name: My All Time Favourite Nutritious Veggie Lentil Salad
Ingredient Names: carrot, yellow lentils, lentils, mustard seeds, green chili, cucumbers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and grate a carrot and keep aside. Step 2: Chop cucumbers into very small cubes and keep aside In the meantime, bring a little over half cup of water to a boil and soak the washed yellow lentils in the same. Step 3: Simmer on low flame for 10-15 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Now, squeeze out the excess water from the grated carrot and the chopped cucumbers by squeezing them in the palm of your hand tightly. Step 5: Place the veggies in a large salad serving bowl. Step 6: Now, heat oil in a frying pan over high flame. Step 7: When hot, add mustard seeds and allow to crackle. Step 8: Add the chopped green chilli and the white urad dal, mix once.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, onion, salt, dried cranberries, curry powder, vegetable broth, couscous, baby spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter with the oil in large saucepan. Step 2: Saute onion briefly. Step 3: Add salt, dried cranberries & curry powder. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until onions are softened. Step 5: Add broth & bring to a boil, stir in couscous, remove from heat. Step 6: Cover & let stand 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in spinach, cover & let stand additional 2 minutes This wilts the spinach but doesn't cook it.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, curds, hot water, salt, oil, mustard seeds, methi seeds, hing water, red chile, curry leaves, clove, green cardamoms, green chilies, ginger, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put the gramflour in a bowl. Step 2: Add the curd and mix ensuring that no lumps are formed. Step 3: Add hot water and salt and mix well. Step 4: Allow the kadhi to boil in a large open-mouthed vessel. Step 5: Make sure you remove the scum the collects on the top, from time to time While the kadhi is boiling on medium flame, prepare the seasoning For this, put a tbsp of oil in a pan. Step 6: Add the ingredients listed under'seasoning' Saute the ginger till the raw smell is gone. Step 7: Put the seasoning ingredients into the boiling kadhi.

Dish Name: My Favourite Spicy Potato And Kasoori Methi Raita
Ingredient Names: butter, onion, potato, salt, red chili powder, dried fenugreek, yogurt, tomatoes, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter in a pan. Step 2: Add the chopped onions and cubed potatoes. Step 3: Saute for 2 minutes. Step 4: Remove on absorbent paper. Step 5: Pour the yogurt in a bowl. Step 6: Add salt, red chilli powder and kasoori methi to it, mix well. Step 7: Add the sauteed onions and potatoes, green chillies and tomatoes, mix well. Step 8: Refrigerate until it's time to serve.

Ingredient Names: wheat berries, boiling water, black olives, fresh parsley, mint, fresh spinach, red onion, garlic cloves, sun-dried tomato, lemon juice, soy sauce, extra virgin olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook wheat berries at a high simmer for about 2 hours This goes a little faster if you soak them overnight. Step 2: Drain remaining water and run the wheat under cold water for a couple of minutes. Step 3: Strain and set aside. Step 4: Chop olives, parsley, mint, spinach, onion, garlic and tomatoes. Step 5: Put all ingredients in large bowl. Step 6: Add the wheat berries to bowl. Step 7: Add lemon juice, soy sauce and olive oil, mix together well. Step 8: Add salt to taste.

Dish Name: My Very Own Summer Yogurt Cooler Indian Lassi
Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, cold water, salt, ground cumin, pepper, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk / beat the the yogurt or curds with a wire whisk until smooth. Step 2: Add the water slowly and continue to whisk until well combined. Step 3: Add the seasonings, mix well, and pour into a tall glass to serve immediately Alternately, you can double or triple this recipe and store it in the refrigerator, it'll keep for a day at least Before serving, stir it once, as the seasonings tend to settle at the bottom Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: flour, yeast, salt, warm water, buttermilk, egg, honey, oil, butter, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 1 c flour, yeast, and salt, in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Stir in water, buttermilk, egg, oil and honey one at a time. Step 3: Beat until smooth in mixer. Step 4: Stir in enough flour to form a soft sticky dough. Step 5: Turn onto floured surface continuing to knead in flour to make dough smooth and elastic 3-5 minute. Step 6: Place in an oiled bowl turning once to coat. Step 7: Cover and let rise till doubled - about 45 minutes Punch down and shape into 16 equal balls. Step 8: Roll out each to 1 / 4 inch thickness, place on greased cookie sheet, brush with butter and sprinkle with one of the seed toppings. Step 9: Cook 450 for 5-8 minutes.

Dish Name: Naan Bread With Garlic And Coriander Cilantro
Ingredient Names: water, sugar, dry active yeast, whole wheat flour, self-rising flour, salt, fresh lemon juice, garlic, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Make sure your breadmaker is clean and add the ingredients in the order the manufacturer suggests. Step 2: Mix on the dough setting. Step 3: When ready to cook the naan, knead for another 50 strokes and then divide into naans Form balls of dough and then flatten into thin ovals Use oil spray to stop them from sticking. Step 4: Preheat a grill / broiler. Step 5: Now put the frying pan on medium heat, letting the naan cook until the bottoms are golden-brown Stick the frying pan under the grill, and let the naans cook until puffed up and golden. Step 6: Serve immediately with hommous, beans, curry or just eat them by themselves Alternatively, you can let them cool and then freeze them.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, egg, plain yogurt, butter, milk, poppy seed
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt together into a nice sized bowl. Step 2: Stir in the beaten egg, yogurt and 2 tablespoons of the butter / ghee Gradually stir in enough milk to make a soft dough. Step 3: Knead dough very well Lightly grease bowl and cover the dough with a damp cloth and place in a warm place for 2 hours. Step 4: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Step 5: Knead dough on a floured surface for 2 or 3 minutes until smooth. Step 6: Divide into 8 pieces. Step 7: Roll each piece into a ball, and then into ovals about 6 to 8 inches long. Step 8: Grease a baking sheet with oil and brush both the sides of the rolled out naan with oil.

Ingredient Names: water, fennel seeds, cinnamon, black cardamom pods, green cardamoms, ginger powder, cloves, cumin seed, salt, nadru, gram flour, low-fat plain yogurt, coriander leaves, ghee, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 cups of water in a skillet. Step 2: Add saunf powder, cinnamon powder, black and green cardamoms, ginger powder, cloves, cumin seeds and salt to taste, stir once. Step 3: Add sliced kamal kakri and mix well. Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix in the gramflour in the yogurt. Step 5: Add gramflour-yogurt mixture to the skillet, mix well, bring to a boil. Step 6: Lower flame and allow to cook on medium flame while you prepare the seasoning To prepare the seasoning, heat ghee in a non-stick pan.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, unsalted butter, powdered sugar, cardamom powder, baking powder, salt, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Take a mixing bowl with the room temperature butter in it, add the powdered sugar to it and cream together till the mixture becomes light and fluffy Sift all the dry ingredients into a separate bowl. Step 2: Add this to the creamed butter mixture little at a time and keep mixing. Step 3: Knead it to form a soft dough. Step 4: Cover the dough and let it rest in the refrigerator for 10-15 minutes. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Step 6: Make small gooseberry sized balls of the dough Smooth the balls by rolling in between your palm, you can also use a cookie cutter to shape the cookies. Step 7: Place each ball in a cookie sheet leaveing some space in between as the cookies will expand when it bakes. Step 8: Press a pistachio or raisin or cashew or almond on top of the balls gently.

Ingredient Names: small red potatoes, water, baby spinach, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, jalapenos, tomatoes, cilantro, cilantro leaf, ground coriander, ground cumin, paprika, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Put the potatoes in a large pot of salted water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Boil over moderate heat until tender when pierced with a knife, about 25 minutes. Step 3: Drain and let cool, then halve the potatoes. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a large, deep skillet, bring the water to a boil Working in batches, add the spinach by handfuls and cook over moderately high heat until wilted. Step 5: Using tongs, transfer the spinach to a colander and repeat with the remaining spinach. Step 6: Squeeze the spinach dry, then transfer it to a food processor and puree Wipe out the skillet. Step 7: Heat the oil in the same skillet. Step 8: Add the onion and cook over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until beginning to brown, about 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, sunflower oil, onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, whole cloves, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, curry powder, frozen peas, frozen sweet corn, sliced almonds, vegetable stock cube, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180c / fan 160c / gas 4. Step 2: Rinse and soak the rice for 10 minutes. Step 3: Heat a large, ovenproof saucepan. Step 4: Add the oil, then the onion, garlic and ginger. Step 5: Cook on a low heat until the onion is soft. Step 6: Add the cloves, cinnamon and cardamom pods and cook for a further 2 mins on a low heat. Step 7: Add the curry powder and cook for a further 2 mins, then stir. Step 8: Drain the rice and add it to the saucepan. Step 9: Stir so that the rice is coated in the oil and spices. Step 10: Add the peas, sweetcorn and half the flaked almonds, if using.

Dish Name: Nigella Lawson Caramelized Onion Lentil Pilaf
Ingredient Names: onion, turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, cloves, mustard seeds, dried curry leaves, salt, fresh ground black pepper, green lentil, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy-based saucepan, heat over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion slices, and saut until softened and deep golden brown. Step 3: Remove half the onions and set aside. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium-low and add turmeric, cumin, coriander, cloves, mustard seeds and curry leaves. Step 5: Add salt, and season with black pepper to taste. Step 6: Combine lentils and rice in a fine-meshed sieve, and rinse well with cold water. Step 7: Drain, then add to pan. Step 8: Add 4 cups water, raise heat, and bring to a boil. Step 9: Cover, reduce heat to very low, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes Water should be completely absorbed.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, spring onion, chile, garlic clove, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, eggs, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan, and fry the spring onion, chili, garlic and turmeric until soft. Step 2: Add the other spices and fry for another minute, stir occasionally. Step 3: Add the eggs, swirling the pan to help the eggs set underneath. Step 4: When the omelet is nearly set, flash it under a hot grill to finish it off, serve.

Dish Name: Nimbu Ka Chaval Saffron Rice With Lime
Ingredient Names: saffron thread, boiling water, water, basmati rice, salt, ghee, cashews, fresh ginger, black mustard seeds, clove, green chili pepper, fresh coriander, fresh lime juice, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Place saffron in a small bowl and pour 1 / 4 cup boiling water over it. Step 3: Let stand at least 10 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a heavy saucepan. Step 5: Add rice, stirring constantly to keep water at a boil. Step 6: Add 1 teaspoon salt. Step 7: Cook over moderate heat, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Step 8: Drain rice and set aside. Step 9: Heat butter or ghee in a heavy 3-4 quart casserole with a tight-fitting lid. Step 10: Add cashews, ginger, mustard seeds and clove.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, cinnamon, red lentil, fresh ginger, vegetable stock, hot water, chili powder, lemon, garlic clove, green chili pepper, bay leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 3 cup of the oil in a large, deep saucepan over a medium-low heat and cook three-quarters of the sliced onion for about 5 minutes, until soft. Step 2: Add the cinnamon sticks, lentils and ginger, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 3: Add the stock, hot water and chili powder. Step 4: Bring to the boil and boil rapidly for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Squeeze the juice from the lemon half and add to the pan with the squeezed lemon shell. Step 6: Cook for a further 50 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 7: Remove the lemon shell. Step 8: Meanwhile, chop the remaining sliced onion, heat the remaining oil in a small frying-pan and cook the chopped onion, garlic, chili and bay leaves for about 10 minutes, until the onion is browned. Step 9: Add this mixture, including the oil, to the lentils when they are cooked. Step 10: Sprinkle with chopped coriander and serve hot.

Dish Name: No Fry Karela Crispies Bitter Melon
Ingredient Names: bitter melons, oil, salt, red chili powder, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to about 375f. Step 2: Wash the bitter melon and slice them using a mandolin slicer into thin round slices. Step 3: Mix with salt, turmeric and chilli powder and marinate for about 1 / 2 an hour. Step 4: Squeeze excess moisture out. Step 5: Spread foil on a baking tray and grease it with about a tbsp oil. Step 6: Toss the bitter melon slices with 2 tbsp oil and spread them on the baking tray. Step 7: Bake for about 5-7 mins and then broil it for 7 minutes depending on the type of your oven, the broiling might be a few mins more or less Crispy karela -- without frying!

Dish Name: No Fuss Red Kidney Bean Salad
Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, yogurt, mayonnaise, onion, garlic, black pepper, cumin powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the above Decorate with finely chopped fresh parsley and eat without guilt.

Ingredient Names: flour, baking soda, baking powder, milk, yogurt, oil, egg, sugar, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together dry ingredients, heat oil in pan. Step 2: Add milk, egg and yogurt to pan and heat until just warm. Step 3: Add wet ingredients to dry. Step 4: Mix the dough, knead just until held together. Step 5: Let rest, covered up to 45 minutes On floured surface pat out into two patty shaped surfaces About 1 / 2 inch thickness Broil under medium heat, turning once These will bubble and go slightly brown.

Dish Name: Noodles With Bean Sprouts Coriander And Mint
Ingredient Names: noodles, peanut oil, garlic cloves, red chilies, lime juice, vegetable stock cube, hot chili sauce, heinz ketchup, dried parsley, white pepper, bean sprouts, red bell pepper, roasted peanuts, fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Boil noodles as per instructions on the packet. Step 2: Drain completely and pat dry with paper kitchen napkins, heat oil in a wok. Step 3: Add garlic and saute for a minute. Step 4: Add red chillies and saute for another minute. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients except coriander and mint leaves. Step 6: Stir-fry on high flame for 5-8 minutes. Step 7: Add coriander and mint leaves, mix again. Step 8: Check seasoning now and if required add an additional stock cube.

Ingredient Names: red pepper, red onion, green chili peppers, red lentil, couscous, black olives, garlic, milk, margarine, cracked black pepper, coriander, chili powder, oregano, mixed herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Add freshly boiling water to the couscous in a plastic tub, with 5 splashes of lemon juice and 5 splashes of soy sauce. Step 2: Place the lid on the tub and leave for 10 minutes. Step 3: Chop the pepper and onion very finely and fry together in a little sunflower oil. Step 4: Rinse the lentils with water and add them to the pan, with the margarine and a good splash of milk. Step 5: Add the crushed garlic. Step 6: Turn the heat down so it doesn't burn, and keep stirring! Step 7: Add the chilli pepper, deseeded and finely chopped, along with the spices and the black olives, mix well. Step 8: Add the couscous to the pan and mix thoroughly off the heat and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, diced tomatoes, sweet potato, frozen chopped spinach, onion, peanut oil, curry powder, cumin, cayenne, cinnamon, ginger, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Sliced the onion and dice the sweet potato I don't peel the sweet potato for the fiber and nutrients, and the texture, but this is up to you Microwave the diced sweet potato for 2-3 minutes, to partly or mostly cook While it microwaves, heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet. Step 2: When it is quite hot, add about half of the spices, stir and cook for about a minute or less, then add the onion and saute while the potato finishes. Step 3: When the potato is done, add it to the skillet. Step 4: Cook for 3-5 minutes. Step 5: Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, spinach, and the other half of the spices Continue to cook on high for 5-10 minutes, then simmer until it is dry or saucy enough to your taste.

Ingredient Names: water, ground nutmeg, ginger, sugar, tea leaves, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water with nutmeg powder and ginger piece for a good 2-3 minutes. Step 2: Add tea leaves, turn off the heat and let the same stand for a minute or so. Step 3: Add sugar and enjoy U can add a dash of milk if you want.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, ghee, baking soda, salt, milk, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix wheat flour, salt and soda in a bowl Rub in ghee. Step 2: Add milk-sugar mixture. Step 3: Mix well The dough will be a bit sticky. Step 4: Heat a flat bottom pan. Step 5: Pour few drops of ghee in the center and spread to the outside. Step 6: Make small balls out of the dough. Step 7: Roll them out not too large in size. Step 8: Put each roti, one at a time, on the tava.

Ingredient Names: of fresh mint, fresh coriander, roasted peanuts, tamarind paste, green chilies, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: It's simple enough: plonk all the ingredients in a blender and process till fairly smooth. Step 2: Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving Goes well with vegetarian curries and biryani Use own discretion when adding water and salt as quantities in a bunch will vary 2 Adjust the quantity of the nuts according to preference You may add more if you prefer and thicker and / or crunchier chutney.

Dish Name: Oh My God These Are The Best Potatoes In The Cosmos
Ingredient Names: oil, potatoes, curry leaves, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, salt, green chilies, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash potatoes under plenty of running tap water Peel them and then cut them into cubes of about an inch in size. Step 2: Put'em in a large bowl and keep aside. Step 3: Now, heat oil in a skillet on medium-high flame. Step 4: When hot, put in the cumin seeds and allow to crackle for 15 seconds. Step 5: Then, add the green chillies and the curry leaves. Step 6: Saute lightly on low-medium flame. Step 7: Now, gently fold in the potatoes and mix well. Step 8: Allow to cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Step 9: Add the turmeric powder and salt.

Ingredient Names: okra, water, salt, tamarind paste, sambhar powder, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok / pan, add okra, salt, tamarind pulp and turmeric -this prevents the okra from becoming slimy. Step 2: After it comes to a boil, adjust the heat to medium and let it cook through Ater the okra is soft and done, add the sambar powder Ready to eat! Step 3: Vary the ingredients according to your own taste Goes very well with chappatis, puris or yoghurt rice.

Dish Name: Okra Bhindi Masala Indian Punjabi Style
Ingredient Names: okra, tomatoes, onions, green chilies, garam masala, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, oil, coriander leaves, salt, bay leaf, cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the onions Dice the tomotoes. Step 2: Chop the chillies and corainder. Step 3: Slice bhindi in long pieces. Step 4: Heat the oil in pan and add the bhindi pieces Shallow fry them. Step 5: Keep the fried bhindi aside. Step 6: Heat 3 spoons of oil in a pan. Step 7: Add the bay leaves and cloves. Step 8: After a minute add onions and fry them until light brown.

Ingredient Names: okra, plain yogurt, green chili, curry leaf, mustard seeds, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil for deep frying. Step 2: Fry the okra pieces till crisp and light brown. Step 3: Drain well Whip yoghurt and salt till smooth and creamy, add okra. Step 4: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and let them splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves, fry for a minute. Step 5: Add to the yoghurt mixture Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: okra, onion, mustard seeds, pepper, cumin powder, mango powder, coriander powder, salt, tomatoes, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a non-stick vessel, fry the onion in the oil will dark golden brown or even close to burning add the okra and then the mustard seeds saute till okra is almost done then add all the powders and the salt mix well and then add the tomato mix well till the tomato is heated through serve hot.

Dish Name: Okra With Coconut Masala Bhindi Sabji
Ingredient Names: okra, ground coriander, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, ghee, cumin seeds, black mustard seeds, asafoetida powder, fresh coconut, sugar, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Wash okra, dry, cut off the two ends and discard. Step 2: Slice into 1 / 5 inch. Step 3: Put into a bowl and mix with the ground coriander, the turmeric, the cayenne pepper and the salt. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp ghee or oil in a large skillet or wok. Step 5: When hot, add cumin seeds and mustard seeds and cover with a lid, as the mustard seeds may jump out of the skillet / wok otherwise. Step 6: When mustard seeds popped add asafoetida, stir. Step 7: Add half of the okra and fry for 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Add half of the sugar and coconut, stir and remove from pan. Step 9: Heat another 2 tbsp ghee or oil. Step 10: When hot, add remaining okra and fry for 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, milk, fresh mango, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 2 minutes, then pour into glasses and serve.

Dish Name: Ondhwa Or Handvoh Spicy Lentil Cake
Ingredient Names: flour, semolina, wheat flour, natural yogurt, potatoes, onion, carrot, fresh green chile, fresh garlic cloves, ginger, cooking oil, mustard seeds, salt, turmeric, cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Method: Overnight preparation: Mix the ondhwa flour, plus the semolina and strong flour with yoghurt to form a firm mixture. Step 2: Cover it and keep it overnight in a warm place This enables the ondhwa flour to ferment On the next day: Grate the potatoes, onions and carrots. Step 3: Add them to the ondhwa mixture. Step 4: Blend the ginger, garlic and green chillies in a mixer or blender and add to the mixture. Step 5: Add the salt and turmeric.

Dish Name: One Pot Mushroom And Potato Curry
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, potato, aubergine, button mushrooms, curry paste, vegetable stock, reduced-fat coconut milk, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan and add onion and potato. Step 2: Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes until potatoes begin to soften. Step 3: Add aubergine and mushrooms and cook 2-3 minutes more. Step 4: Stir in curry paste, pour over the stock and coconut milk and bring to a boil. Step 5: Turn heat down to simmer 10 minutes or until potato is tender. Step 6: Stir through coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: spinach, onion, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, oil
