Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add salt, black pepper powder, onion, tomato and spinach in that order one by one. Step 2: Saute on medium heat for 8 minutes. Step 3: Serve warm as a wonderful side dish.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, onion, coriander leaves, mint leaf, ginger, cumin seed, salt, mustard seeds, green chilies, red chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and mince the onion Clean, wash and chop coriander and mint leaves. Step 2: Wash and mince the green chillies Peel and chop the ginger Roast and powder the cumin seeds Powder the mustard seeds. Step 3: Put the onions in water for 15 minutes. Step 4: Drain thoroughly and keep aside. Step 5: Blend the yoghurt with 2 tablespoons of water and seasonings, beat till smooth.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, salt, yogurt, ghee, onion, red chili powder, green chili pepper, oil, cumin powder
Instructions: Step 1: Sieve atta with salt Peel and finely chop the onion. Step 2: Wash and finely chop the green chili. Step 3: Add onion and green chili to yogurt. Step 4: Add ghee, red chili powder, cumin powder and half cup of water. Step 5: Add flour and knead to a soft dough. Step 6: Cover with a moist cloth. Step 7: Keep aside for half an hour, knead again. Step 8: Divide into 4 equal parts.

Ingredient Names: yellow onions, red onions, raisins, fresh jalapeno, brown sugar, granulated sugar, balsamic vinegar, cider vinegar, salt, orange zest, frozen raspberries
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients except raspberries in a large saucepan. Step 2: Cover and bring to boil. Step 3: Uncover and boil gently about 25 minutes or until thickened, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add the thawed raspberries to the chutney, stirring lightly. Step 5: Return to boil and boil gently 4 minutes longer, without stirring, or until slightly thickened. Step 6: Pour hot chutney into sterilized jars and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks or can using usda canning guidelines for longer storage.

Ingredient Names: onions, ground coriander, jalapeno chile, lemon juice, white whole wheat flour, salt, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Filling: combine all ingredients in a bowl Dough: pulse flour and salt in food processor until combined. Step 2: Add 1 1 / 4 cups water, and process 2 minutes, or until smooth. Step 3: Cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Step 4: Roll dough into 8 balls, then dust with flour. Step 5: Roll out each ball into a 3-inch circle. Step 6: Place 2 tablespoons filling in center of each circle Join dough edges together, and crimp tightly. Step 7: Dust with flour once more. Step 8: Place crimped-side down and roll into 6-inch circles.

Ingredient Names: oil, urad dal, ginger, garlic, red chile, onions, tomato, turmeric, salt, mustard, asafoetida, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tbsp oil and roast 2 tbsp urad dal till turns aromatic. Step 2: Add 1 inch of ginger, 3 cloves of garlic, and 10 dried red chilies. Roast until the chilies puff up. Step 3: Further saute ½ onion, till the onion softens and raw smell is lost. Step 4: Add 3 tomato, ¼ tsp turmeric, and cook until the tomato softens and turns mushy. Step 5: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 6: Add 1 tsp salt and grind to a smooth paste adding water as required. Step 7: Transfer the chutney to the large bowl and adjust the consistency by adding water as required. Step 8: To prepare the tempering, heat 2 tbsp oil. Add ½ tsp urad dal, 1 tsp mustard, 2 dried red chillies, a pinch of hing, and a few curry leaves. Step 9: Splutter the tempering and pour over the chutney. Step 10: Finally, enjoy Tomato Onion Chutney Recipe with dosa, idli, and rice.

Dish Name: Oooey Gooey Incredibly Yummy Banana Cinnamon Toast
Ingredient Names: bananas, ground cinnamon, muffins, almonds, unsalted butter, maple syrup
Instructions: Step 1: First, you got to slice the muffins into round slices and toast them lightly. Step 2: Remove onto a plate melt butter in a pan. Step 3: Add banana slices and saute till they brown a little and are soft. Step 4: Stir in maple syrup, powdered cinnamon and the almonds, mix lightly. Step 5: Pour this mixture over the muffin slices. Step 6: Remove onto a serving plate. Step 7: Serve hot Enjoy with full joy!

Dish Name: Orange Cardamom Brown Rice With Peas Vegan
Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, water, vegan margarine, sea salt, orange rind, turmeric, ground cardamom, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: If you're using dried orange or lemon rind like me, place 2 1 / 4 tsp dried rind and 6 3 / 4 teaspoons water in a bowl and let stand for 15 minutes to hydrate. Step 2: Bring the water to a boil. Step 3: Add the salt, rind, earth balance, turmeric, and cardamom and mix well before adding the rice. Step 4: Make sure the rice is covered, then lower the heat to a simmer and loosely cover. Step 5: Cook for 45-50 minutes or until the rice has absorbed all the water and steam and is soft and fluffy. Step 6: Mix the peas in with the cooked rice, cover and let sit for 5 minutes so they can absorb the steam, stir and serve.

Dish Name: Orange Coffee Topped With Honey Nougat Chocolate And Orange Peel
Ingredient Names: cream, sugar, toblerone chocolate bars, orange, brewed coffee, orange rind
Instructions: Step 1: Whip the cream with sugar until the latter dissolves, keep aside. Step 2: Place a slice of orange in each cup. Step 3: Pour freshly brewed coffee over the orange slice. Step 4: Stir in 1 tsp Of whipped cream in each cup. Step 5: Top with grated toblerone honey nougat chocolate and orange peel. Step 6: Serve with a smile!

Ingredient Names: orange juice, seedless oranges, low-fat plain yogurt, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Blend everything together in a blender Process till smooth Strain into a jug Serve chilled on a hot summer afternoon!

Dish Name: Oranges And Lemons Pick Me Up
Ingredient Names: orange, lemon, honey, ice cube
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all together Pour over ice cubes in a tall glass Pick it up Sip away!

Ingredient Names: flour, fresh yeast, water, plain yogurt, egg, salt, nigella seeds, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sieve the flour. Step 2: Add water, yogurt, egg yeast, nigella and salt to make a soft dough If dough sticks too much then use little bit of oil on hand and then punch into dough, top with oil. Step 3: Let rest covered 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Divide dough into 8-10 portion and form balls with little flour. Step 5: Let rest 20 minutes. Step 6: Now to make naan, set oven at broil. Step 7: Roll oval shape out of dough: flat your balls and toss to make them bigger. Step 8: Put 2 naans on the baking tray and place it into stove and flip it after about 2 min.

Ingredient Names: masoor dal, tamarind pulp, green chilies, turmeric powder, jaggery, peanuts, cooking oil, salt, mustard seeds, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Dilute the tamarind pulp in a bowl with 4 tbsps Of water, making sure that there are no lumps and keep aside, wash the lentils. Step 2: Bring the lentils to a boil in 2 cups of water. Step 3: Allow to simmer until nearly done. Step 4: Add turmeric powder, tamarind water, green chillies, jaggery, peanuts and salt. Step 5: Simmer until dal is cooked. Step 6: Heat oil in a small pan, add mustard seeds, allow to crackle.

Ingredient Names: idaho potatoes, salt, extra virgin olive oil, onion, jalapeno pepper, fresh gingerroot, garlic clove, ground coriander, curry powder, ground cumin, ground allspice, cinnamon, black pepper, roma tomato, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Cook the potatoes in a large pan of boiling salted water until tender, 5-7 minutes. Step 3: Drain and reserve in the same pot you cooked them inches. Step 4: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Step 5: Add the onions and cook until soft, 5 minutes, then addd the jalapeno, ginger, garlic, coriander, curry powder, cumin, allspice, cinnamon, and salt and pepper. Step 6: Cook for about 3 minutes more. Step 7: Stir in the drained potatoes, tomato, and peas. Step 8: Cook for another minute. Step 9: Stir in enough of the stock to moisten the mixture, then remove it from the heat and let cool On a lightly floured surface, unroll.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, skim milk, sugar, cardamom pods, cashews, pistachios, raisins, ghee
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice well. Step 2: Place a heavy bottomed vessel on a high flame, add rice and milk, and bring to a boil, stirring continuously. Step 3: Reduce flame to low and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes. Step 4: After 40 minutes, check if the rice is done. Step 5: After the rice is done, add sugar, and stir till dissolved. Step 6: Remove vessel from flame and set aside. Step 7: In a small frying pan, heat ghee on a low flame, and add cashews and pistachios Roast until the cashews turn slightly brown. Step 8: Add raisins, which will swell up immediately. Step 9: Now quickly pour contents of the frying pan into the cooked pudding and mix well.

Dish Name: Paarikyaai Poolikootakari Bitter Gourd Side Dish
Ingredient Names: oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, bitter melons, turmeric, salt, tamarind pulp, sambhar powder, jaggery
Instructions: Step 1: Head oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add mustard seeds and urad dal. Step 2: When the mustard starts to sputter, add the sliced gourd, turmeric powder and salt and saute on a low flame for about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the water that the tamarind was soaked in, sambar powder and jaggery. Step 4: Cover and cook on a low flame for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Then check if the karela has been cooked If not, add an additional 1 / 4 cup water, cover and cook until all the water has been absorbed. Step 6: Remove from flame and serve hot with rice and sambar, or chappatis.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, bay leaf, star anise, black cumin, cumin, green cardamoms, black cardamom pod, coriander, mace, fennel, ground red chili pepper, ground turmeric, cinnamon, clove
Instructions: Step 1: Grind all spices together in a spice mill Make sure to use ground turmeric as, in its whole form, it's hard like a rock.

Ingredient Names: dried red lentils, water, diced onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, chopped tomatoes, curry powder, red chili powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, cooking oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water in pot until boiling. Step 2: Add lentils and boil for one minute. Step 3: Reduce heat to a simmer. Step 4: Simmer lentils until they resemble a thick paste While lentils are simmering, heat oil in frying pan. Step 5: Add onion, garlic and ginger, fry until soft. Step 6: Add curry, chili, cumin, coriander, salt and pepper, saut for 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Add tomatoes and saut for another 3-5 minutes. Step 8: Add fried spice mixture into lentil paste, stir and cook an additional 15-20 minutes.

Dish Name: Pakistani Rice With Lentils And Nut Sauce
Ingredient Names: lentils, white poppy seeds, cashews, almonds, jalapeno pepper, garlic, salt, green onions, cilantro, yellow onion, vegetable oil, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and cook lentils in plenty of water. Step 2: Let reduce until there is about 4 cups of liquid leftover. Step 3: Drain lentils, reserving liquid. Step 4: Set liquid aside In the meantime, in a skillet, lightly toast, one by one: poppy seeds, cashews and almonds, put in blender. Step 5: Add jalapeno pepper, garlic, and salt Gradually add leftover lentil liquid and puree this mixture. Step 6: Puree until smooth and pour into bowl. Step 7: Add to this the green onions and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: spinach, panir, butter, onions, dhaniya powder, red chili powder, jeera powder, cashews, poppy seeds, tomatoes, turmeric powder, curds, salt, sugar, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Soak paneer in a bowl of water for atleast 15-20 minutes This makes the paneer soft, drain the water. Step 2: Cut paneer into cubes, set aside. Step 3: Wash and chop palak finely. Step 4: Cut onions into small pieces. Step 5: Cut tomatoes into 2 inch cubes. Step 6: Heat a little butter. Step 7: Fry palak till it shrinks.

Ingredient Names: fenugreek seeds, nigella seeds, fennel seed, cumin, mustard seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all together, you can use less or more of your favorite seeds so adjust to taste. Step 2: Store out of light in a sealed jar This recipe is meant to be used as whole seeds roasted before using in a recipes to release the oils for more fragrance Roast in hot oil, until a strong aroma of each spice is released, and use the fragrant oil as a base to cook dal, meats or vegetables Roast in vegetable oil, butter or ghee and add as seasoning to different dals or thick curries.

Ingredient Names: nigella seeds, black mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, fennel seed, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Mix seeds and store in an airtight container Do not grind them before storage or cooking. Step 2: When using in a recipe, add the mixed seeds into a pan with ghee or cooking oil. Step 3: When they sizzle and pop a little bit, begin adding the other ingredients to the pan.

Ingredient Names: russet potato, curry powder, cayenne pepper, coriander, cumin, cinnamon, garlic clove, olive oil, salt, water, egg, roma tomato, white vinegar, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put 1 tablespoon oil in a nonstick pan with the crushed garlic clove, saut until the clove is lightly browned and then discard the garlic. Step 2: Add the potato and turn it around in the garlic oil until well coated. Step 3: Put the lid on the pan and let the potatoes brown for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Once the potatoes are browned, add 1 / 4 of water put the lid on and let this steam for another 5-10 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender While this is happening, prepare the egg If you want a poached egg, place 1 cup of water, the vinegar and a dash of salt in a saucepan, let this come to a simmer and cook the egg until it is done, but still runny, about 2-3 minutes Or -- fry the egg in oil. Step 5: When the potatoes are fork tender, drain off any excess liquid to prevent the potatoes from getting mushy. Step 6: Add the remaining 1 or 2 tablespoons of oil, and the spices: the curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, cayenne, coriander and saut for about 2-3 minutes, until all the flavors have mingled Lastly, add the chopped tomato and a pinch of salt.

Ingredient Names: panir, onions, tomatoes, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, fresh cream, butter, salt, raisins, cashews, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions and tomatoes till they turn brown. Step 2: Add turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder and salt. Step 3: Add the paneer and stir fry for a minute. Step 4: Garnish with 1 tsp cream, finely chopped cashew nuts, raisins and finely chopped cilantro leaves Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: paneer cheese, mushrooms, red bell peppers, spinach, onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, red chilies, fresh cream, turmeric, curry powder, oil, salt, pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a non-stick sauté pan, heat two tablespoons of oil. Step 2: Brown cheese cubes on all sides and reserve in a plate. Step 3: In a large pot of boiling water, blanch vegetables, including cauliflower, mushroom and red bell pepper for a brief time. Step 4: Remove immediately and place in ice bath. Step 5: In the same sauté pan, add remaining three tablespoons oil. Step 6: Add turmeric and dry red chilies and fry until the chilies turn dark, releasing an earthy flavor. Step 7: Add chopped onions and stir constantly until lightly browned. Step 8: Add garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry for a minute or so. Step 9: Transfer the browned cheese cubes and vegetables and stir-fry for five minutes over low heat. Step 10: Add tomatoes, cream, salt and pepper; mix well. Step 11: Allow cooking for another five to eight, adding a bit of water if necessary. Step 12: At last, add spinach to the cheese-vegetable mixture and gently fold in to wilt it down. Step 13: Garnish with chopped cilantro. Step 14: Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Step 15: Serve with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: panir, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom, chili powder, turmeric, salt, garam masala, tomato puree, cream, butter, dried fenugreek, onion, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the chopped onions, garlic & ginger into a coarse paste, keep it aside. Step 2: Heat 1 / 2 tbsp butter in a heavy bottom pan. Step 3: Add cinnamon, cloves, bay leaf and cardamom, fry 4 seconds, now add the paste. Step 4: Fry it till golden brown. Step 5: Add all the dry powders, sugar, tomato puree, fry for 2 minutes. Step 6: Now add 2 cups water, reduce heat to low let the gravy simmer for 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onions, potato, cottage cheese, tomatoes, green chilies, coriander leaves, garam masala, chili powder, bread, salt, butter, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a kadhai or wok. Step 2: Add onions and fry them till golden brown. Step 3: Add tomatoes, and cook till soft. Step 4: Add potato pieces, garam masala, chilli powder and salt. Step 5: Cook on low flame for 4 minutes, stirring thoroughly. Step 6: Add the paneer and green chillies and mix well. Step 7: Keep aside Coat one side of bread slices with butter and place on a hot tawa. Step 8: Keep it on low flame till bread turns crisp only on one side. Step 9: Cut the bread slices in triangular shapes.

Ingredient Names: milk, lemon juice, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To make about a pound of paneer, heat 1 gallon of milk in a large pot that allows enough space for milk to boil. Step 2: When milk is about to boil, immediately add 4 to 5 tablespoons of lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of vinegar You may optionally add 1 cup of plain yogurt too Be careful that milk does not boil over. Step 3: Lower heat if needed. Step 4: Simmer until the milk curdles (cheese separates from clear liquid ) Use more lemon juice or vinegar as needed, turn off the heat. Step 5: Strain the cheese in a large sieve set over a bowl and lined with a thin muslin cloth or cheesecloth. Step 6: Mash the cheese to make it smooth.

Ingredient Names: oil, cubes paneer, onions, ginger, garlic, green chili, cashews, bowl palak spinach, mint, fresh coriander, curds, turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, pepper powder, cumin, salt, fresh cream, dried fenugreek
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan and add cubed paneer. Step 2: Roast the paneer on medium flame until it turns light golden brown. Keep stirring so the paneer roasts evenly. Step 3: Transfer the roasted paneer into warm water and soak for a few minutes. This keeps the paneer soft and removes excess oil. Step 4: In the same pan, add onion and saute until it softens. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic, green chilli and cashew. Step 6: Saute until the onion turns golden brown. Cashew helps make the gravy thick and creamy. Step 7: Add palak and saute until it shrinks. Step 8: Cool the mixture completely. Transfer it to a mixer jar. Step 9: Add mint and coriander. This gives the special Hyderabadi flavour. Step 10: Blend to a smooth green paste, adding water if required. Step 11: In a bowl, take curd and add masala powder. Step 12: Mix well and make a smooth lump free curd mixture. This helps prevent the curd from splitting. Keep aside. Step 13: Heat oil in a kadai and saute cumin until aromatic. Step 14: Add the prepared green masala paste. Step 15: Cook well until the raw flavour disappears and oil starts separating. Step 16: Add the curd mixture and stir continuously. Step 17: Cover and cook until the oil separates from the sides. Step 18: Add salt, cream and the roasted paneer. Drain the water from the paneer before adding it to the gravy. Step 19: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes so the paneer absorbs the flavour. Step 20: Add kasuri methi and garnish with cream. Step 21: Mix gently and serve Paneer Hyderabadi hot with roti, naan or rice.

Dish Name: Paneer Jalfrezi Paneer With Green Peppers Onions And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, cumin seed, onion, ginger paste, garlic paste, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, salt, green pepper, tomatoes, panir, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet and fry cumin seeds for one minute. Step 2: Add onion and fry on low heat until soft. Step 3: Add more oil if necessary. Step 4: Add ginger and garlic paste and fry for a few seconds until well blended. Step 5: Sprinkle in the spice powders and some salt and cook on low heat until the oil begins to separate in about 3 minutes. Step 6: Stir frequently to prevent scorching. Step 7: Add the sliced pepper pieces, stir and simmer gently until they are nearly done but still hold their shape, for about 8 minutes. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and paneer and cook for about 2 minutes until soft but not mushy The tomatoes will begin to soften at once because of the salt that has already been added. Step 9: Check the seasoning (you may need to add a little bit more salt, take off the heat and serve hot, sprinkled with fresh coriander.

Dish Name: Paneer Kofta In A Tomato Gravy
Ingredient Names: chickpea flour, panir, baby spinach, onion, ground coriander, ground cumin, garam masala, turmeric powder, garlic cloves, ginger paste, green chili, salt, cilantro, lemon, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the kofta ingredients and mix with a little water to form small balls. Step 2: Heat oil and deep fry the balls until golden For the tomato gravy, heat the oil in a saucepan and add the cumin and mustard seeds. Step 3: When they start to pop, add the remaining ingredients. Step 4: Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add the paneer kofta into the tomato gravy and garnish with fresh cilantro.

Ingredient Names: oil, cubes paneer, onions, tomato, curds, cashews, ghee, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a kadai heat ¼ cup oil and roast 20 cubes paneer. Step 2: Once the paneer turns golden brown, keep it aside. Step 3: In the same oil fry 2 onions until it turns golden brown. Step 4: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 5: Add 2 tomatoes, 3 tbsp curd, 3 tbsp cashew, and grind to a smooth paste. Keep aside. Step 6: In a large kadai heat, 2 tbsp ghee. Add 1 tsp cumin, ½ inch cinnamon, 4 cloves and saute on low flame till the spices turn aromatic. Step 7: Also add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, and saute till spices turn aromatic. Do not burn the spices. Step 8: Further, add in prepared masala paste and cook well. Step 9: Cook until the masala paste is cooked well separating the oil. Step 10: Add 2 cup hot water, 1 tsp salt and mix well adjusting the consistency. Step 11: Boil for 5 minutes or until the oil separates. Step 12: Add in fried paneer and cook on low flame. Step 13: Finally, enjoy Paneer Korma Recipe with hot steamed rice or roti.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, ginger, panir, bay leaf, cardamoms, red chili powder, fenugreek seeds, sugar, cream, garam masala, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, add the chopped tomatoes, ginger, bay leaf, cardamom, methi and chilli powder. Step 2: Cook covered till the tomatoes turn soft. Step 3: Cool, and grind the tomato mixture to a puree and pass through a sieve. Step 4: Keep the tomato puree on the fire, and add salt, sugar, garam masala and cook on low flame for 3-5 minutes. Step 5: Add the paneer cubes and cook till soft. Step 6: Now add the cream keeping some for the garnish and remove from fire Just before serving add the paneer pieces and garnish with beaten cream and coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, cumin, pepper, pods cardamom, cinnamon, fennel saunf, cubes paneer, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, ginger garlic paste, salt, ghee clarified butter, oil, bay leaf, onions, tomato, curds, water, dried fenugreek, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 20 cubes paneer. Step 2: Also add ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp garam masala, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste, ¼ tsp salt. Step 3: Mix well and marinate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Now heat 1 tbsp ghee and marinated paneer. Step 5: Fry for a minute making sure all the sides are cooked well. keep aside. Step 6: Firstly, in a heavy-bottomed pan take 2 tsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp cumin, ¼ tsp pepper, 3 cloves, 2 pods cardamom, ½ inch cinnamon and ½ tsp fennel. Step 7: Dry roast on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 8: Cool completely, and blend to a fine powder. keep aside. Step 9: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tbsp ghee and 2 tbsp oil. Step 10: Add 1 bay leaf, 2 pods cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon, 2 cloves and 1 tsp cumin. Step 11: Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 12: Now add 1 onion and 1 tsp ginger garlic paste. saute until the onions turn golden brown. Step 13: Further keeping the flame on low, add the prepared spice powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder and ¾ tsp salt. Step 14: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 15: Now add 2 tomato and saute until tomatoes turn soft and mushy. Step 16: Further, keeping the flame on low add ½ cup curd. Step 17: Stir continuously until the curd is combined well and oil separates out from the mixture. Step 18: Add ½ cup water or as required adjusting the consistency. Step 19: Now add fried paneer and mix well. Step 20: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until the flavours are absorbed well. Step 21: Add 1 tsp kasuri methi, ¼ tsp garam masala and 2 tbsp coriander. mix well. Step 22: Finally, enjoy paneer masala recipe dhaba style with roti, naan or phulka.

Ingredient Names: paneer, besan flour, rice flour, turmeric, chili powder, ajwain carom seeds, ginger garlic paste, salt, asafoetida, fresh coriander, water, baking powder, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 cup besan, 2 tbsp rice flour, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp ajwain, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste, ½ tsp salt, pinch hing and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 2: Add water and whisk smooth. Step 3: Prepare a smooth lump free thick batter. Step 4: Now add ½ tsp baking powder and mix well. Step 5: Take small pieces of paneer slices and dip them in batter. Step 6: Deep fry in hot oil keeping the flame on medium. Step 7: Stir occasionally, until the pakoda turns golden brown and crispy. Step 8: Drain off and finally enjoy Paneer Pakoda Recipe with green chutney.

Ingredient Names: milk, lemon juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water in a large pot, then add milk. Step 2: Bring to a full foaming boil, stirring to prevent sticking. Step 3: Lower heat, the add lemon juice stirring constantly Soft curds should appear in 10-15 seconds, separating from the light yellow, clear whey. Step 4: Remove from heat and allow to stand 5-6 minutes. Step 5: Line a colander with finely woven tea towels Use a slotted spoon to remove the curds from the pot and into the towel-lined colander Use fine strainer to get the smallest remainders Gather the corners of the towels and twist into a tight ball. Step 6: Put a weight on top of the ball and let it rest 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: paneer cheese, yogurt, red chili powder, cumin powder, tandoori spice mix, sugar, ginger-garlic paste, coriander leaves, mint leaf, vegetables, chaat masala, butter, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all the ingredients for the marinade with some salt and set aside Juliennes the veggies and add the chat masala and remaining marinade to them. Step 2: Brush the marinade on the paneer slices and refrigerate for 2-3 hours. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp butter / oil and fry the paneer on both sides till well done Alternatively, you can brush each paneer piece with some oil and bake in a 350 degree f oven till done. Step 4: Heat 1 tbsp oil and stir fry the veggies till they are crisp Just like the paneer, you can alternatively bake these in an oven till they are done. Step 5: In a platter, arrange the paneer slices in the middle and place the veggies around it. Step 6: Garnish with lemon wedges and serve hot.

Dish Name: Paneer With Scallions And Tomatoes Mulayam Paneer Bhurjee
Ingredient Names: canola oil, cumin seed, panir, scallions, fresh tomatoes, fresh cilantro, coarse salt, garam masala, turmeric, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Sprinkle in cumin seeds and cook until they sizzle, turn reddish brown, and smell fragrant, about 10 seconds. Step 3: Add all the remaining ingredients and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the flavors infuse the cheese, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: sprouting broccoli, vegetable oil, asafoetida, cumin seeds, sesame seeds, green chili, brown mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, paneer cheese, ginger, garlic, lemon juice, ground mace
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the broccoli and boil or steam for 5-6 mins until tender but firm to the bite. Drain and cool under cold running water. Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan, then add the asafoetida, cumin seeds, sesame seeds, chilli, mustard seeds and the curry leaves. Cook for 1 min until fragrant, then add the onion and cook another 2 mins. Step 2: Throw in the paneer, ginger and garlic, and season. Cook on a medium heat for 4-5 mins until the paneer turns golden. Add the broccoli and mix through the paneer and spices, then add lemon juice, mace and twist of pepper.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, cauliflower, carrots, green peas, channa dal, onions, tomatoes, rolls, oil, salt, mustard seeds, red chilies, red chili powder, masala
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, peel, and cut the potatoes. Step 2: Wash, trim, and chop the cauliflower and carrots in small pieces. Step 3: Rinse and drain dal and put in a 2-quart pot to boil in 2 cups water. Step 4: When little cooked, add the potatoes and salt. Step 5: Cook until the potatoes are done. Step 6: Mash them along with dal. Step 7: Add the chopped cauliflower, carrots, and green peas to the dal mix. Step 8: Cook for another 15 minutes until the carrots are tender. Step 9: Add water, as needed. Step 10: Heat 2 tablespoons oil on medium heat in a skillet.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, black pepper, ground cumin, salt, garlic, water, cayenne, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the flour, pepper, ground cumin seed, and salt in a large bowl or in the food processor. Step 2: Mix thoroughly until the spices are evenly distributed. Step 3: Add the garlic and mix well. Step 4: Add enough of the water to form a dough that will hold together in a cohesive ball If necessary, add up to 1 additional tablespoon water The dough should be fairly stiff and dry If it is too wet, it will not roll well. Step 5: Knead the dough for about 5 minutes by hand or pulse for about 15 seconds in the food processor The dough should be smooth With your hands, shape the dough into a cylinder or log about 2 inches thick and 6 inches long.

Ingredient Names: papaya, fresh pineapple chunks, bananas, green apple, lime, canola oil, onions, sweet potato, jalapeno peppers, madras curry powder, ginger, cayenne, light coconut milk, raisins, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Combine fruits in a bowl and sprinkle with lime juice. Step 2: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat and saute onions, stirring often, until they soften and start to turn golden brown. Step 3: Add next 5 ingredients and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 4: Add coconut milk and continue cooking and stirring, 5 minutes. Step 5: Add fruit and raisins, turn heat to low and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Serve over steamed white or brown rice, sprinkled with cashews.

Ingredient Names: papayas, soy yogurt, lime juice, orange juice, honey, salt, ice cube
Instructions: Step 1: Mix papaya, yogurt, lime juice, orange juice, honey, and salt in blender until smooth. Step 2: Add ice to blender and blend until smooth Lassi should be thick. Step 3: Pour into 2 glasses and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: gram flour, bicarbonate of soda, ajwain, oil, salt, turmeric powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients. Step 2: Add water, little by little, to make a very soft dough. Step 3: Take a fistful of dough. Step 4: Place on a greased polythene sheet With the base of your palm, drag the dough in a straight line, from the start For support, hold the dough at starting point with the other hand. Step 5: Heat oil in a heavy wide pan. Step 6: Make 3-4 such strips, put in hot oil. Step 7: Fry on medium heat till crisp but not brown.

Ingredient Names: dried garbanzo beans, garlic cloves, onion, fresh ginger, fresh green chilies, water, peanut oil, cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, chili powder, cashew nuts, tomatoes, parsnips, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Put the chickpeas in a pan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Step 2: Boil vigorously for 10 minutes, then reduce the heat so that the water boils steadily and cook for 1-1 1 / 2 hours. Step 3: Meanwhile, make the sauce. Step 4: Set 2 tsp of the garlic aside and place the remainder in a food processor. Step 5: Add the onion, ginger and half the chillies. Step 6: Pour in 75ml of the water and process to a smooth paste. Step 7: Heat the oil in a large stock pot and cook the cumin seeds for 30 seconds. Step 8: Stir in the coriander seeds, turmeric, chilli powder and ground cashew nuts. Step 9: Add the ginger and chilli paste and cook, stirring frequently, until the water begins to evaporate. Step 10: Add the tomatoes and stir-fry until the mixture begins to turn red-brown in colour.

Ingredient Names: baby spinach leaves, vegetable oil, yellow onion, fresh ginger, tomatoes, plain yogurt, water, turmeric, cracked black pepper, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, salt, jalapenos
Instructions: Step 1: Add the spinach to a large pot with a little bit of water and cook, uncovered over medium heat, stirring frequently. Step 2: Cook spinach just until it starts to darken and slightly wilt. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: Heat the oil in a saucepan and saute the onion over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, until the onion starts to brown. Step 5: Stir in the fresh ginger, tomatoes, plain yogurt, water and spices. Step 6: Cook the mixture over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently, being careful not to burn if the mixture starts to stick to the pan, add a little bit more water or broth to the bottom of the pan. Step 7: Lower the heat on the pan. Step 8: Chop the spinach and add to the spice mixture. Step 9: Stir over low heat until the spinach is heated through and coated with the yogurt Adjust seasoning if necessary.

Ingredient Names: sugar, passion fruit, water, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fruits into half and scoop out the inside on a plate. Step 2: Put in a blender along with the remaining ingredients, except the lemon juice, and process until smooth. Step 3: Strain and add lemon juice. Step 4: Serve chilled over ice cubes in tall glasses on a hot sunny afternoon!

Dish Name: Pea Curry With Carrots And Potatoes
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, frozen peas, carrots, russet potatoes, dry mustard, ground turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, garam masala, vegetable broth
Instructions: Step 1: First, take out a nice-sized saucepan and heat oil to medium heat. Step 2: Add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeks and fry for about 25 seconds. Step 3: Add onion and garlic and saut for 4 minutes until onions begin to soften. Step 4: Add your ginger, peas, carrots, potatoes and spices, and allow the ginger and spices to become very fragrant. Step 5: Add your broth, wine and water and allow mixture to come to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer covered until vegetables are soft. Step 7: Combine the cornstarch and water in a bowl. Step 8: Turn heat up a bit and bring to a slight boil, and add your cornstarch mixture. Step 9: Stir until a bit thickened. Step 10: Add your tomato soup and parsley and allow to heat through.

Ingredient Names: tea bag, water, brown sugar, apple juice
Instructions: Step 1: To boiling water add sugar and apple juice take off heat add 2 tea bags and let set until done stir And serve over ice if you want cold.

Dish Name: Peach Salad India Aru Ka Salad
Ingredient Names: rose water, sugar, saffron, lemon, fresh peaches, water, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a serving bowl, combine the rose water, sugar, saffron, lemon juice, and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 2: Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Add the sliced peaches and stir them gently to coat with the liquid. Step 4: Cool in the refrigerator and serve garnished iwth a few mint leaves, if desired.

Ingredient Names: oil, shallots onion, garlic, peanuts, fresh coriander, mint, chili, tamarind, salt, water, urad dal, chana dal, red chile, tomato, mustard, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tsp oil. saute 2 shallots onion, 1 garlic until it shrinks slightly. Step 2: Add ½ cup roasted peanuts and saute well. Step 3: Also add few coriander, few mint and 4 chilli. Step 4: Saute until the coriander shrinks slightly. Step 5: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 6: Add small tamarind, ½ tsp salt and ½ cup water. Step 7: Grind to smooth paste adding water if required. Step 8: To prepare the tempering, heat 2 tsp oil. Splutter 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp urad dal, 1 dried red chilli and few curry leaves. Step 9: Pour the tempering over the chutney and mix well. Step 10: Finally, Hotel Style Peanut Chutney is ready to serve with idli and dosa. Step 11: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tsp oil. add 2 tbsp urad dal, 2 tbsp chana dal and 3 dried red chilli. Step 12: Roast until the chilli puffs up and dal turns golden brown. Step 13: Further, add ½ cup of roasted peanuts and roast for a minute. Step 14: Also, add 2 tomatoes and saute until the tomato turns soft and mushy. Step 15: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 16: Add ½ tsp salt and ½ cup water. Step 17: Grind to smooth paste adding water if required. Step 18: To prepare the tempering, heat 2 tsp oil. Splutter 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp urad dal, 1 dried red chilli and a few curry leaves. Step 19: Pour the tempering over the chutney and mix well. Step 20: Finally, Hotel Style Peanut Chutney is ready to serve with idli and dosa.

Ingredient Names: pears, sugar, chocolate, brandy
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the pears and remove the cores. Step 2: Place in a saucepan. Step 3: Sprinkle with sugar. Step 4: Cover and heat on medium flame for 5 minutes, reduce heat. Step 5: Cook on low for 5 minutes or until pears are fork tender. Step 6: Keep pears warm In the meantime, heat a small pan over low heat for 5 minutes Break up the chocolate and place in the pan, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, frozen mixed vegetables, cooked rice, raisins, curry powder, orange juice, soy sauce, chicken-flavored vegetarian seasoning, salt, pepper, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in medium pan. Step 2: Cook frozen vegetables, stirring often, for about 2 minutes Gently stir in rice and raisins. Step 3: Stir in curry powder. Step 4: Add orange juice and soy sauce. Step 5: Stir in "chicken" flavoring, salt and pepper If desired, you may stir in the eggs and stir occasionally for 3-5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, cardamom pod, fresh ginger, whole cloves, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick, peppermint tea bags, pure maple syrup, soymilk
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, combine the water and spices. Step 2: Cover and bring to a boil over high heat Immediately reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from the heat and add the peppermint tea. Step 4: Cover the pan and let steep for 3 to 5 minutes The longer you leave it, the stronger the tea will be. Step 5: Strain out the spices and tea. Step 6: Serve immediately, letting each person add syrup and soy milk to their taste.

Ingredient Names: urad dal flour, rice flour, buttermilk, salt, fenugreek seeds, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the urad dal flour and rice flour Slowly add in buttermilk until it drops from the spoon smoothly A blender will ease this process. Step 2: Add salt and fenugreek seeds to taste. Step 3: Refrigerate batter overnight in an air-tight container, heat oil in pan. Step 4: Pour the dosa into the pan quickly Use the bottom of a ladle to spread it thin and gently smooth it out in a circle motion Too hard and you will tear the dosa.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, salt, turmeric, bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice well, put water on to boil with salt. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350f and grease a 1013 pan. Step 3: Add rice and all other ingredients to boiling water. Step 4: Boil for 10 minutes, take off pan and rinse well under running water. Step 5: Spread rice in roasting pan and place in oven. Step 6: Bake for 10-15 minutes. Step 7: Serve or add any other ingredients.

Dish Name: Perfect To Beat The Summer Heat Colourful Orange Salad
Ingredient Names: oranges, fresh spinach leaves, fresh carrots, honey, ginger, olive oil, sesame seeds, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put the olive oil, sugar, honey, sesame seeds and ginger in a bowl. Step 2: Mix well This is the dressing for the salad. Step 3: Put the oranges, grated carrots and chopped spinach leaves in another bowl. Step 4: Mix well This is the salad. Step 5: Add the dressing to the salad, mix well. Step 6: Refrigerate for atleast 2 hours, serve chilled.

Dish Name: Pigeon Pea Paste Aka Arhar Dal Or Toovar Dal
Ingredient Names: pigeon peas, water, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pick over the peas and wash them well, drain. Step 2: Soak the peas overnight in water to cover by 5 inches. Step 3: Drain, discard soaking liquid Pressure cooker method: Put the drained peas in a pressure cooker and cover with water by 1 / 2 inch. Step 4: Add a few drops of cooking oil to prevent foaming. Step 5: Put the lid on and bring up to pressure. Step 6: Cook for 15 minutes. Step 7: Allow the pressure to drop by itself.

Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, frozen peas, oil, cashews, green chili pepper, fresh ginger, cumin seed, water, raisins, salt, turmeric, garam masala, fresh basil, dried oregano, dried thyme
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and drain the rice Start defrosting peas. Step 2: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 3: Heat the oil in a small pot over medium heat. Step 4: When hot add cashews and fry for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, stirring frequently. Step 5: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels Cashews will darken a few shades while cooling. Step 6: Raise heat to medium hot, add cumin, chili and ginger to the oil, stir-fry 30 seconds. Step 7: Add rice and stir-fry another 2 minutes until hot. Step 8: Add water, raisins, salt, turmeric, garam masala and herbs.

Ingredient Names: pineapple juice, banana, honey, evaporated milk, kiwi, pineapple chunk, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the first 5 ingredients together in a blender. Step 2: Pour into chilled glasses and sprinkle with a dash of nutmeg. Step 3: Decorate the rim of the glasses with pineapple wedges and serve with a smile!

Ingredient Names: kabuli channa, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, garlic, ginger, green chilies, coriander leaves, cumin seed, mustard seeds, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, turmeric powder, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Pressure cook the chickpeas till soft. Step 2: Heat oil in a large and heavy bottomed saucepan. Step 3: Add cumin seeds and mustard seeds. Step 4: Allow to crackle and splutter. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic, chopped onions and asafoetida. Step 6: Fry till onions are lightly browned. Step 7: Add all dry masala, except cinnamon and clove. Step 8: Stir well, add tomatoes and cook till oil separates. Step 9: Drain chickpeas, add to the skillet and stir in well. Step 10: Add tamarind extract.

Dish Name: Pineapple And Kiwi Fruit Juice For Fresh And Young Skin
Ingredient Names: pineapple juice, kiwi juice, mango nectar, grenadine, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything in a cocktail shaker Shake well Strain Pour into a glass Garnish with pineapple and strawberry slices Serve chilled!

Ingredient Names: pineapple, chili, onion, carrot, golden raisin, garlic cloves, lime, ginger, turmeric, cumin, cinnamon, sugar, salt, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Place all but the vinegar in a food processor and pulse till pureed. Step 2: Add to pot with vinegar and cook 15 minutes If needed blend again for a smooth sauce. Step 3: Fill hot sauce into sterilized hot bottles or jars. Step 4: Place in a hot water bath for 10 minutes. Step 5: Let age for at least 1 week.

Ingredient Names: oil, mustard seeds, ginger, canned pineapple, pineapple syrup, yogurt, salt, red chili powder, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, allow to splutter. Step 2: Once they stop spluttering, add ginger, chopped pineapple and the pineapple syrup. Step 3: Simmer on low heat for 3 minutes or until thick, remove from heat, allow to cool. Step 4: Pour into a bowl that has the beaten yogurt. Step 5: Add salt, red chilli powder and curry leaves, mix well.

Ingredient Names: parboiled rice, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and soak the parboiled rice in water for 6-8 hours. Step 2: Wash and soak the urad dal and fenugreek seeds in water in another bowl for 6-8 hours. Step 3: Make a smooth batter of rice in a blender. Step 4: Make a smooth batter of urad dal in a blender. Step 5: In a large bowl, combine the rice batter with the urad dal batter, add salt to taste, mix well, cover. Step 6: Keep the batter to ferment overnight for minimum 12 hours. Step 7: Now, the next morning, to start preparing the dosa, heat a non-stick frying pan and lightly brush with oil.

Ingredient Names: flour, baking powder, salt, ghee, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Sift all dry ingredients, add ghee. Step 2: Mix with milk into a soft smooth dough. Step 3: Roll out into 1 / 8 inch thickness, cut in rounds. Step 4: Fry in hot ghee or oil till a pale gold colour Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: yogurt, cumin seed, salt, black pepper, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl Keep in a cool place until needed Serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: plantains, sugar, raw cashews, raisins, milk, allspice, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Steam the plantains with the skin on if you have a steam cooker Else microwave whole, skin and all, over a little water for about three to four minutes on high power This enhances the sweetness of the plantains. Step 2: Make a few slits in the skin of the plantains You can even cut them in half. Step 3: Allow to cool and skin them I apologise for leaving this part out to those who may have already tried this! Step 4: Mash the ripe plantains with the milk, the sugar and half the butter I use a food processor as it blends the bananas well Keep aside.

Dish Name: Poached Eggs With Slow Cooked Spicy Lentils
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, ginger, ground coriander, cumin seed, black pepper, red lentil, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, coconut milk, salt, chili flakes, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions, and cook, stirring, until softened, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, and black pepper. Step 4: Cook, stirring constantly, for one more minute. Step 5: Add lentils, tomatoes, and stock, bring to boil. Step 6: Transfer to slow cooker. Step 7: Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours. Step 8: Stir in coconut milk, salt, and chili flakes. Step 9: Cover and continue to cook for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: poha, oil, peanuts, potato, mustard, cumin, asafoetida, chili, ginger, curry leaves, onions, turmeric, salt, sugar, lemons, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, place a sieve in a bowl and rinse 2½ cups of poha till the water runs clean. Do not soak the poha in water. Step 2: Keep the poha aside for 10 minutes, and it will become non-sticky and soft. Step 3: In a wok heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 2 tbsp peanut till they turn crunchy. Keep aside. Step 4: Also, fry 1 potato till it turns golden and crisp. Keep aside. Step 5: In the same oil, add ½ tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin, pinch hing, 2 chilli, 1 inch ginger, few curry leaves and splutter the tempering. Step 6: Add 1 onion, and saute till the onions softens. Step 7: Now add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar and saute till the spices turn aromatic. Step 8: Further add fried peanut and potato and mix well. Step 9: Now add in poha and mix gently. Step 10: Also add ½ lemon and 2 tbsp coriander. Mix gently. Step 11: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the poha is cooked fully. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Kanda Poha Recipe with chivda.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, shredded coconut, salt, water, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour into a bowl and mix in salt and coconut. Step 2: Add as much water as needed to have a stiff dough that doesn't stick to your hands. Step 3: Knead well Separate into even balls and flatted to make circles, 1 / 2" thick and 3 to 4" wide Sear both sides on a hot frying pan or cast iron skillet abt 3 minutes on each side or until browned and cooked in middle.

Dish Name: Pol Roti Coconut Roti Indian Flatbread
Ingredient Names: refined flour, coconut, onions, water, green chilies, margarine, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix together the flour, coconut and salt, add some water. Step 2: Grease your palm with a little butter. Step 3: Then, mix the batter well to form a dough. Step 4: Add chillies and onions, mix well. Step 5: Divide the dough into 6-8 equal sized balls. Step 6: Then, using a rolling pin, on a floured board, roll out each ball into a round roti, heat a flat pan. Step 7: Put the roti on it in the middle of the pan.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, scallions, pomegranate, sea salt, pomegranate molasses
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl, reserving some pomegranate seeds for garnish. Step 2: Add pomegranate juice or pomegranate molasses as it states in the introduction if wished and stir until yogurt is smooth Scatter the reserved pomegranate seeds over top Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, canola oil, salt, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Put the flour and salt into a medium-sized bowl. Step 2: Pour the oil and hot water on top. Step 3: Mix together with hands until it becomes a soft dough. Step 4: Cover the dough with a damp towel to keep it moist. Step 5: Let the dough sit for 30 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle some flour on the counter and knead the dough for a couple of minutes. Step 7: Divide the dough into 6 equal parts. Step 8: Roll each piece into a 6-inch circle Be sure to cover each circle with a cloth to keep from drying out. Step 9: Heat a couple of tablespoons of canola oil in a skillet.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, fennel seeds, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, chili powder, turmeric, garlic bulbs, red wine vinegar, pork shoulder, vegetable oil, red onions, red peppers, tomato, dark muscovado sugar, chickpeas, chicken stock, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a small pan over a medium heat. Add the peppercorns, fennel, coriander and cumin seeds, and dry-fry for about 1 min, stirring constantly, until fragrant. Tip into a small food processor with the chilli powder and turmeric. Put the garlic in the pan and fry for 1-2 mins until flecked golden. Add the garlic and vinegar to the spices and process to a coarse paste. Step 2: Put the pork in a bowl. Add the paste and mix with your hands to combine – it’s best to use disposable gloves, as turmeric stains. Leave to marinate for 15 mins. Step 3: Heat oven to 150C/130C fan/gas 2. Heat oil in a flameproof dish and fry the onions until beginning to colour. Increase heat to high, add the pork and fry, stirring often, for about 10 mins until darkened. Add the peppers, tomatoes and sugar, and cook for 10 mins more until the tomatoes have reduced and the paste clings to the meat. Stir in the chickpeas and stock. Put on the lid, bring to a simmer, then put in the oven for about 1½ hrs until the meat is tender and the sauce thickened. Eat immediately with rice, or cool before freezing in batches for up to 3 months.

Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, unsweetened coconut milk, fresh cilantro, fresh parsley, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, lime juice, portabella mushroom, olive oil, green onion, madras curry powder, crushed red pepper flakes, cherry tomatoes, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan mix rice, 2 cups water, and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, bring to boiling, reduce heat. Step 2: Simmer, covered, 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a blender or food processor mix 1 / 2 cup of the coconut milk, cilantro, parsley, 1 teaspoon of the fresh ginger, 1 garlic clove, and the lime juice, cover. Step 4: Blend or process until nearly smooth, stir into rice, cover, keep warm.

Dish Name: Potato Aloo Posto A Bengali Indian Vegetarian Recipe
Ingredient Names: oil, bay leaf, onion, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, salt, water, potatoes, poppy seed paste, coriander leaves, black cumin seeds, methi seeds, fennel seed
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet, add bayleaf. Step 2: Add all the ingredients mentioned under"paanch phoran" Allow to crackle. Step 3: Add onion and saute. Step 4: Add ginger-garlic paste and saute till lightly golden brown. Step 5: Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chilli powder, salt and water, bring to a boil. Step 6: Add potatoes Dilute poppy seeds paste in 2-3 tbsps.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, potatoes, carrot, yogurt, green chilies, fresh ginger, fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl, mix well. Step 2: Add just enough batter to form a batter of pouring consistency. Step 3: Prepare dosas Follow recipe for"plain dosa" posted separately. Step 4: Serve hot with chutney.

Ingredient Names: onions, cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, olive oil, curry paste, fresh ginger, garlic, vegetable stock cube, tomatoes, water, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place oil in a large saucepan or soup pot. Step 2: Add onions and saute until beatiful and caramelised brown I sometimes add a splash of water if the onions aren't browning in oil. Step 3: When onions are done and curry paste and fry about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and ginger and fry 2 minutes more Do not burn. Step 5: Add potatoes and carrots and saute a further 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add tinned tomatoes, water, stock cube and bay leaf and reduce heat to a simmer. Step 7: Simmer for about half and hour, then add cauliflower. Step 8: Allow the curry to simmer until thickened and reduced.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, cauliflower, sour curd, tomato puree, black cardamom pod, bay leaf, oil, asafoetida powder, turmeric powder, anise seed, carom seeds, kashmiri chili powder, coriander powder, salt, garam masala
Instructions: Step 1: Peel potato skins Pierce whole potatoes with a fork at 3-4 places all over. Step 2: Place them on the circumference of a microwave turntable Microwave on high for 3 1 / 2 minutes so that they are partially cooked. Step 3: Allow standing time of 5 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a frying pan. Step 5: Add black cardamom, bay leaf and asafoetida. Step 6: Cut potatoes into big cubes and deep fry in hot oil on medium flame till pink in colour Deep fry cauliflower florets similarly. Step 7: Remove onto a tissue paper.

Ingredient Names: butter, fresh ginger, cumin seeds, madras curry powder, garam masala, potatoes, sultana, frozen baby peas, fresh coriander leaves, green onions, egg, oil, plain yogurt, plain flour, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the butter in a large frying pan, add the ginger, cumin seeds, curry powder and garam marsala and fry lightly for 1 minute or until very fragrant. Step 2: Add the potato and 3 tablespoons of water and cook over low heat for 15-20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Step 3: Add the sultanas, peas, coriander leaves and green onion and stir through. Step 4: Set aside to cool Pastry: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl- make a well in the centre. Step 5: Add the butter, yoghurt and 3 / 4 cup of water Use a flat-bladed knife to bring the dough together. Step 6: Turn onto a lightly floured surface and form a smooth ball. Step 7: Divide the dough into four pieces.

Dish Name: Potato And Hard Boiled Egg Curry
Ingredient Names: potato, eggs, coriander, ground ginger, curry powder, salt, black pepper, butter, dried cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pot of water to boil, add the eggs and boil for 10 minutes. Step 2: After ten minutes add the salt to the water and add the potatoes with the eggs and boil for another five minutes. Step 3: In a small frying pan add the spices, and toast them over low heat for about two minutes, or until the spices become aromatic. Step 4: Drain the potatoes and eggs, and add the butter to the pan with the spices, stir the spices into the melting butter, and add the potatoes and coat Peel and chop the eggs into bite sized pieces, and add to the pan and toss again If the spices and butter become to dry to toss the potatoes and eggs with, add 1 / 4 cup of water or milk to thin it out. Step 5: Add the cilantro and salt to taste, and cook for about a minute longer until all flavors are combined.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, brown onion, garlic, ground cumin, ground cilantro, ground fennel, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, garam masala, potatoes, tomatoes, water, frozen peas, greek yogurt, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pan. Step 2: Add onion and garlic, cook until onion is soft. Step 3: Add potato and spices, cook another 2 minutes. Step 4: Add tomatoes and water, bring to boil. Step 5: Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: When potato is tender, add peas. Step 7: Cook until peas are hot. Step 8: Stir yogurt and parsley or mint together in a separate bowl. Step 9: Serve curry over rice with a dollop of cooling yogurt.

Dish Name: Potato Chickpea Curry With Rice Dutch Oven
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, low sodium vegetable broth, russet potatoes, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, onion, garlic cloves, curry powder, baby spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f Generously spray inside of 5 1 / 2 or 6-quart dutch oven with cooking spray. Step 2: Stir together rice and 2 1 / 4 cups broth in pot. Step 3: Top with potatoes, season with salt and pepper, then add chickpeas. Step 4: Combine tomatoes, onion, garlic, curry powder, and remaining 3 / 4 cup broth in bowl. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Spread tomato mixture over chickpeas, then top with spinach. Step 7: Cover pot, and bake 53 minutes, or about 3 minutes after aroma wafts from oven.

Ingredient Names: russet potatoes, oil, salt, cumin seeds, black mustard seeds, turmeric powder, ground coriander, cayenne, water, peas
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice potatoes. Step 2: Heat oil and add spices. Step 3: Simmer for 2-3 minutes, add potatoes. Step 4: Immediately stir around until evenly coated. Step 5: Continue for 5-10 minutes until some cubes are a little crisped. Step 6: Add the water and lower the heat. Step 7: Simmer for 1/2 hour, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Add peas and simmer for an additional 5 minutes, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, potato, mushroom, chili pepper, curry powder, yogurt, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and saut the potato for 5-6 minutes. Step 2: Add mushrooms, chilli and curry powder. Step 3: Fry for a further few minutes. Step 4: Stir in the yoghurt and cook for 2-5 minutes or until the potatoe is done. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin, fennel seed, nigella seeds, tamarind pulp, water, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1 inch cubes. Step 2: Put it in a pot with 2 cups water. Step 3: Add all the ingredients except tamarind water. Step 4: Boil the potatoes until tender. Step 5: Add tamarind water and stir well. Step 6: Now mash some of the potatoes in the pots but not all. Step 7: Let it cook for 1 or 2 minutes. Step 8: Sprinkle with cilantro leaves and enjoy.

Dish Name: Potato Fried In Garlic Chauke Aaloo
Ingredient Names: small potatoes, garlic, green chilies, red chili powder, amchoor, garam masala, salt, green coriander, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the potatoes thouroughly. Step 2: Cut each of them into 4 pieces with skin. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Step 4: Add chopped garlic And fry till crisp and reddish. Step 5: Now add the potatoes, chillies, salt, garam masala, and amchur powder. Step 6: Fry for a few minutes. Step 7: Add 3 tbsp wter and cover to cook till potatoes are cooked and all the water has evaporated. Step 8: Garnish it with chopped coriander leaves and serve with dal, rice, and chapati.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, ginger, garlic, green chili, cornflour, coriander leaves, salt, oil, soya sauce, tomato ketchup, chili-garlic sauce, hot chili sauce, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the potato balls, first of all, you got to boil the potatoes Next, mash the potatoes. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic, green chilli, chopped coriander leaves and salt. Step 3: Mix well, using your hand Out of this mixture, prepare 20-22 balls, keep aside, heat oil in a wok. Step 4: Meanwhile, while the oil is being heated, put cornflour in a plate. Step 5: Roll the balls in the cornflour, dust the balls.

Ingredient Names: boiling potatoes, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, dried hot red chili pepper, cumin seed, coconut, ground turmeric, ground cumin, tomatoes, salt, sugar, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice potatoes and put into a bowl of cold water Saut the garlic in oil for a few seconds, then add the pepper pod and cumin seeds and sizzle for 3 seconds. Step 2: Lower the heat and add the coconut. Step 3: Cook, stirring, for 15 seconds. Step 4: Drain the potatoes and add to the skillet along with turmeric, ground cumin, tomatoes, salt and 1 1 / 2 cups water. Step 5: Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add the sugar and vinegar. Step 7: Cook, uncovered and stirring, for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, cm-piece ginger, green chilies, oil, potatoes, peas, fresh cilantro, mango chutney, flour
Instructions: Step 1: To make the pastry, add the oil to the flour with 100ml warm water and mix to form a dough. Knead briefly and leave to rest for 30 mins. Step 2: Fry the onions, garlic, ginger and chilli together in 2 tbsp oil for 1 min, then add the potatoes. Cook over a low heat, stirring often, until the potatoes are cooked through – add a little water if they begin to stick. Add the peas or beans and cook until tender, then stir in the coriander, season well and leave to cool. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Divide the dough into 8 balls. One by one, roll each ball into a thin circle, then halve to make 2 semi-circles. Use your finger to brush a little water along the straight edges. Hold one and bring the 2 corners together and, using your hand as a cup, seal along the straight edge to form into cones. Step 4: Fill the cones with the potato mix and pinch the tops closed, sealing again with water. Brush with remaining oil on all sides. Put on baking sheet and bake for 20 mins or until the pastry is crisp. Serve with mango chutney.

Ingredient Names: baking potatoes, olive oil, tikka masala curry paste, tomato puree, reduced-fat coconut milk, fresh cilantro, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Cut the potatoes into wedges. Pour the oil into a large roasting pan (no need to peel), toss in the wedges until coated all over, then season with pepper. Bake for 35-40 mins until crisp and golden. Step 2: Put the curry paste and tomato purée in a saucepan, stir well and fry for 1 min. Add the coconut milk, bring to the boil, then gently simmer for 10 mins. Can be frozen or made up to a day ahead. Season to taste and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and a scattering of coriander, if using.

Dish Name: Potatoes And Carrots In Coconut Curry
Ingredient Names: red potatoes, water, vegetable oil, onion, fresh garlic cloves, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, carrot, curry powder, coconut cream, salt, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the potatoes thoroughly, then place them in the slow cooker insert and add the water. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours, or until the potatoes are fairly tender Tiny red potatoes, for instance, will generally cook in less than 4 hours, so use a fork to determine doneness If your potatoes are fairly large, you may wish to cut them carefully into quarters. Step 3: In a saute pan, heat the oil and saute the onion over medium-high heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Add the garlic, cumin seeds, and fennel seeds and continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add the onion, carrots, and curry powder to the potatoes and carefully stir in the coconut cream Re-cover and continue cooking for 1 hour. Step 6: Add salt to taste, then spoon the curry into a bowl or onto plates and garnish with the chile slices and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: potato, plain yogurt, green chilies, onion, chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, ginger, vegetable oil, water, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place a skillet on medium heat and heat the oil / ghee in it. Step 2: When heated, add the minced ginger, and then the chopped onion. Step 3: Saute for a minute. Step 4: Add the potato cubes and fry for a while. Step 5: Reduce the flame to low, cover the skillet, and cook until the potatoes are tender. Step 6: Once potatoes are done, uncover the skillet and add the whole green chillies, turmeric powder, chilli powder and salt. Step 7: Fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Add the yogurt / curds to the potato mix, and then add the water. Step 9: Mix well and bring it to a boil. Step 10: Remove from the flame and garnish with the coriander.

Dish Name: Potatoes With Fresh Curry Leaves Bhaji
Ingredient Names: potatoes, ghee, brown mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, garlic cloves, green chili pepper, ground cumin, salt, cumin seed, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes in salted water until half-cooked - about 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Melt the ghee in frying pan. Step 4: Add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Step 5: Cook until sizzling. Step 6: Add onion, garlic and chili. Step 7: Cook gently over low heat until onion is soft and slightly browned. Step 8: Add potatoes and ground cumin, mix well. Step 9: Fry until potatoes are lightly browned - about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, vegetable oil, turmeric, red chili powder, coarse salt, cumin seed, fennel seed, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the potatoes into half-inch rounds, then dice these further into small, evenly-sized cubes. Step 2: Using a wok or other non-stick pan, take the minimum amount of oil needed and fry these cubed potatoes over a high heat to start with and then turn the heat down and cover. Step 3: When the potatoes are a little more than half done, add the turmeric, chili powder and some salt, closely followed by the remaining spices. Step 4: Stir to combine and put the lid back on once again. Step 5: When the potatoes are nearly ready, take the lid off, turn the heat up and stir-fry to enable any excess liquid to evaporate. Step 6: Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve.

Dish Name: Potatoes With Poppy Seeds Aloo Poshto
Ingredient Names: potatoes, poppy seeds, dried red chilies, green chilies, turmeric powder, oil, water, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place the poppy seeds in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat Gentle stir and cook seeds for one or two minutes so that they are toasted but not burned Grind the roasted poppy seeds along with the green chillies and a few tablespoons of water to a very fine paste, set aside. Step 2: Heat half of the oil in a pan for 2 minutes till very hot Shallow fry the cubed potatoes in batches on medium heat till they are lightly browned If needed, sprikle one or two drops of water to keep the potatoes from sticking. Step 3: Drain on a paper towel and keep aside. Step 4: Now, heat the remaining oil in the same pan. Step 5: Add the whole dry red chillies and turmeric powder.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, vegetable oil, white poppy seeds, fennel seed, cumin seed, onion seeds, black mustard seeds, red chilies, turmeric powder, salt, warm water, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a pan on medium heat, add poppy seeds and reduce heat to medium-low Carefully roast them until they are just a shade darker. Step 2: Remove from pan and cool In same pan, heat oil and add the mustard, fennel, cumin and onion seeds. Step 3: When they turn color, add the chillies and allow them to just blacken. Step 4: Stir in the turmeric powder and immediately potatoes and salt. Step 5: Stir thoroughly and add the warm water. Step 6: Cover and reduce to low heat. Step 7: Cook for a further 15 minutes until potatoes are tender Grind the cooled poppy seeds using a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle.

Ingredient Names: new potatoes, oil, asafoetida, black mustard seeds, whole cumin seed, turmeric, ground coriander, ground cumin, cayenne, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan on medium heat In quick succession, put in first the hing and a second later the mustard, followed by the cumin seed. Step 2: Add the potato and stir. Step 3: Sprinkle in the turmeric. Step 4: Cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are lightly browned and almost cooked. Step 5: Sprinkle in the remaining spices and cook for 1-2 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: onion, mushroom pieces, sodium-free vegetable broth, tomato puree, cornstarch, white wine, black pepper, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, saut onion and mushrooms in a small amount oil. Step 2: Mix dissolved cornstarch into a cup of vegetable broth Slowly add to onions and mushrooms. Step 3: Add the other ingredients too. Step 4: Check the seasonings and cook gently until thickened Use on vegetables, over cooked rice or noodles, in casseroles, or over mashed potatoes.

Dish Name: Prize Winning Pall Milk Poli Indian Sweet
Ingredient Names: channa dal, self-raising flour, sugar, milk, yellow food coloring, sesame oil, green cardamoms, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour with cold milk and salt in a bowl. Step 2: Prepare a smooth dough out of it. Step 3: Pour the oil on the dough. Step 4: Keep aside for 4 hours. Step 5: After about 3 hours have passed, boil the chana dal in a pot of water until it is soft. Step 6: Drain the water Grind it to a fine paste. Step 7: Add sugar and cardamom powder. Step 8: Boil it and stir it constantly till it thickens. Step 9: Make small balls of the dal{chana dal / lentil} mixture.

Ingredient Names: wheat flour, ghee, salt, mint, water
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour and salt Rub ghee evenly. Step 2: Add water& make a stiff dough, add mint paste, mix well. Step 3: Keep aside for 30 minutes. Step 4: Divide the dough into 10 parts. Step 5: Shape them with your palm and flatten them. Step 6: Roll each part into a round. Step 7: Place one at a time on a hot griddle.

Ingredient Names: fresh mint leaves, onions, panir, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, salt, oil, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tomatoes into 4 big pieces, remove the pulp. Step 2: Chop into tiny pieces. Step 3: Keep the pulp aside. Step 4: Cut paneer into 1 / 2 " cubes, heat oil. Step 5: Add onions and fry. Step 6: Add tomato pulp and cook for 1-2 minutes till the pulp is dry. Step 7: Add paneer and finely chopped pudina and tomato pieces. Step 8: Then add garam masala.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, jalapeno, mint leaves, bay leaves, cloves, black peppercorns, ghee, ginger, yogurt, coconut, green cardamom pods, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and drain. Step 2: Heat ghee in a heavy bottom pot. Step 3: Add cardamom, cloves, and black peppercorns. Step 4: When they crackle, add bay leaves, ginger, jalapeno, coconut, and yogurt. Step 5: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add water, bring to a boil, then add rice and salt. Step 7: Bring to a boil, then add mint leaves, cover and cook over low heat until rice is cooked and fluffy.

Ingredient Names: chickpea flour, spring onions, cumin seed, fresh coriander, chili powder, black pepper, asafoetida powder, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ingredients, then add water to make a batter. Step 2: Leave to rest for an hour. Step 3: Heat flat griddle or frying pan. Step 4: Spread a little oil on it. Step 5: Pour in a little of the mix and spread it out with a wooden spatula so it thinly covers the pan. Step 6: Cook for about a minute, then turn over. Step 7: Serve with yogurt, pickles or chutneys.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, vegetable oil, onion, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, bay leaf, cashews, sultanas, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice several times and let it soak for 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain the rice well in a sieve. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and cook onion until soft. Step 4: Add all ingredients & spices, to the pan and stir fry for 2 minutes over medium heat. Step 5: Add 2 cups of water to the pan with salt and bring to a boil then cover tightly and. Step 6: Turn the heat to low. Step 7: Simmer for 20 minutes, adding additional water during cooking, if necessary, until rice is tender and fluffy and all the water is absorbed. Step 8: Remove bay leaf, cloves and cinnamon sticks before serving.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onion, garlic cloves, red pepper, fresh ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, ground cinnamon, pumpkin, curry paste, tomato sauce, dried red chilies, vegetable stock, canned chick-peas
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pumpkin in a bowl, add the curry paste and toss well to coat the pumpkin evenly. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a saucepan. Step 3: Add the onion, garlic, red pepper, ginger and ground spices and fry over a medium heat for 5-6 minutes until the onion is lightly browned. Step 4: Remove mixture to a bowl In the same frying pan, add the pureed tomatoes, chilies and stock to the onion mixture, and bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in another frying pan, add the coated pumpkin and fry for 5 minutes until golden. Step 6: Add into the tomato / onion sauce along with the chickpeas, cover and cook for 20 minutes until the pumpkin is tender Peel the banana, slice thickly and stir into the curry 5 mins before the end of the cooking time. Step 7: Stir in the chopped cilantro or parsley, and sprinkle the pine nuts over the top. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: ghee, butternut pumpkin, silver beet, brown onions, garlic, ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, turmeric, green chilies, red lentils, water, vegetable oil, cumin seed
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Step 2: Add half of the ghee and cook pumpkin in batches, tossing the pan often until pumpkin is well coloured and starting to soften, set aside. Step 3: Add another tablespoon of the ghee, and working in batches, cook silverbeet until wilted and tender. Step 4: Remove from pan and add to reserved pumpkin In the same pan, heat remaining ghee. Step 5: Add onions, garlic and ginger. Step 6: Cook until starting to soften and fragrant. Step 7: Add spices, stirring until fragrant. Step 8: Add chillies, lentils and water.

Ingredient Names: oil, pumpkin, coconut, tamarind paste, urad dal, asafoetida powder, red chilies, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 2 teaspoon oil in a skillet over medium and add the chopped pumpkins. Step 2: Saute for 1 minute and then cover. Step 3: After 5 minutes, uncover, stir, and cover And now after another 5 minutes remove the pumpkin from the skillet and keep aside In the same skillet add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil, urad dal, and red chilies and fry until the dal start turning pale brown. Step 4: Add the asafoetida powder just around the time when you think the dal is starting to turn pale brown Grind the above fried mixture in a grinder along with grated coconut and salt, and grind coarsely, without water. Step 5: Now add the tamarind paste and cooked pumpkin and grind until it is a coarse paste Don't add water unless it is too thick. Step 6: Add upto 1 tablespoon water if required.

Ingredient Names: pumpkin, red onion, apple, pear, raisins, crystallized ginger, white sugar, cinnamon stick, ground cloves, red chili pepper, salt, ground black pepper, cider vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in a large stainless steel pan, bring to the boil, boil for 3 to 5 minutes then simmer on low heat for 50 to 60 minutes, if needed add a few more tablespoons of water and, depending on the pumpkin, mash the flesh a little bit if necessary. Step 2: Remove the cinnamon stick. Step 3: Put in clean hot jars, seal and label when cold. Step 4: Keep in cool dark place, once opened keep in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: onions, sunflower oil, garlic, ground cumin coriander curry powder, chili powder, pumpkin, tomato puree, black bean water, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Toss half the onions in 1 tbsp oil, then roast for 15-20 mins, until they are crisp and golden. Step 2: Meanwhile, fry the remaining onion in the oil until lightly golden. Add the garlic and spices; cook for 1 min. Add the pumpkin, stir in the tomato purée and 425ml boiling water, then return to the boil. Simmer, covered, for 15 mins, then stir in the beans. Cook for a further 5 mins. Step 3: Put the spinach in a colander and pour over a kettle of boiling water until it is wilted. Press with a wooden spoon to remove excess water, then roughly chop. Stir into the curry, then warm through. Serve scattered with the crisp roasted onions.

Dish Name: Puneri Dal Yellow Lentils Pune Style
Ingredient Names: toor dal, garam masala powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, kokum, jaggery, fresh coconut, salt, vegetable oil, black mustard seeds, cumin seed, asafoetida powder, curry leaves, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer the lentils in 4 cups of water for approximately 20 minutes, until just cooked, but not mushy. Step 2: Keep an eye on the lentils while they cook to ensure the water does not fully evaporate. Step 3: Drain off most of the water when the lentils are cooked and add the powder spices, kokum, desiccated coconut and salt to taste. Step 4: Simmer for a couple of minutes and stir until well mixed, adding more water if necessary to make a moist, but not sloppy, consistency. Step 5: Remove from the heat and keep warm. Step 6: Heat oil in a small pan, add the mustard seeds, and saute until they pop and crackle. Step 7: Add the cumin seeds, asafoetida and curry leaves. Step 8: Stir once, then pour the oil and spices over the lentils. Step 9: Mix well, and serve hot garnished with cilantro Accompany with rice and a vegetable curry if desired.

Ingredient Names: flour, butter, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Put flour into bowl & rub butter / margarine into it. Step 2: Add half of the water and stir to combine. Step 3: Add the remaining water slowly, stirring until all of the flour is hydrated. Step 4: Knead for approximately 3 minutes The dough will spring back slightly when pressed & may be slightly sticky. Step 5: Leave covered for 30 minutes.
