Step 6: Divide into small balls and dip into extra flour. Step 7: Press gently in your hand until slightly flattened into a disc. Step 8: Roll with a rolling pin into thin round pancakes. Step 9: Heat a heavy based frying pan.

Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, oil, cumin seed, fresh ginger, red bird's eye chili, diced tomatoes, chili powder, coriander powder, salt, garam masala, asafoetida, water, fresh cilantro, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain kidney beans. Step 2: Heat the oil on medium to medium high. Step 3: Add cumin seeds, ginger, and chilies Sautee until cumin seeds darken, about one minute, or how you like. Step 4: Add tomatoes with the water from the can. Step 5: Simmer uncovered until the liquid has reduced quite a bit, again to your preference The longer you simmer, the tastier it will be! Step 6: Add the rest of the spices and mix well Add the kidney beans and mix well Add the water.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, salt, ghee, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flours, salt and ghee until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Step 2: Add just enough water until it forms a soft dough. Step 3: Place on a counter and knead for 5-8 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Step 4: Put aside, covered, let rest for 20 minutes Form the dough by rolling rounded teaspoonfuls into balls, then rolling those into 3 to 4 inch circles on a lightly floured surface. Step 5: Cover to prevent drying. Step 6: Heat 2" oil to 375 degrees. Step 7: Fry patties, two or three at a time, turning once, until golden brown, about 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes You may need to help the puffing by holding down flat spots with your spoon. Step 8: Drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: green beans, onion, green chilies, salt and pepper, canola oil, black mustard seeds, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet. Step 2: Add black mustard and onions. Step 3: Add green chillies, beans, salt and pepper. Step 4: Cover and cook over medium heat. Step 5: Add a little water if needed but let it eventually evaporate.

Ingredient Names: water, cardamoms, cinnamon, green tea, almonds, saffron, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place water and tea leaves in a pan Boil and strain Put in the cardamom, cinnamon, shredded almonds and saffron Heat Pour into individual cups Serve at once.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, cloves, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, green cardamom pods, cumin seeds, vegetable oil, onion, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice in several changes of water and soak for 30 minutes bring a litre of water to the boil drain the rice and add with the rest of the ingredients for the rice boil for 5 - 8 minutes the rice should still have a little bite. Step 2: Drain rice and keep warm, seasonings can be removed or left in. Step 3: Heat the oil in the pan and fry the onion for 5 - 10 mins until crispy, remove and drain. Step 4: Serve rice topped with onions and coriander.

Ingredient Names: maggi noodles, ginger-garlic paste, onion, green chili, potato, tomatoes, carrot, chili powder, garam masala, oil, mozzarella cheese, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: According to the packet's instructions, boil noodles. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: In a shallow pan, add oil. Step 4: When the pan is hot, add ginger-garlic paste and fry for a minute or two Throw in onions, fry until soft. Step 5: When onions are soft, add in green chilli. Step 6: Stir fry for 3 minute, add in potatoes. Step 7: Fry for 5min, then add chilli powder and carrots.

Dish Name: Quick N Easy Coconut Chutney Dip
Ingredient Names: coconut, green chilies, onion, oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together the coconut, chillies and the onion to form a very smooth paste Heta oil in a wok, crackle the mustard seeds and add the curry leaves, pour in the coconut paste mixed with salt. Step 2: Add water to adjust the consistency as per your desire. Step 3: Remove from fire"do not boil or over heat"-- serve Done!

Ingredient Names: oil, mustard, chana dal, urad dal, cumin, asafoetida, cashews, fresh carrot, chili, ginger paste, curry leaves, rava, ragi flour, salt, curds, fresh coriander, water, eno fruit salt
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tbsp oil. add 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp chana dal, 1 tsp urad dal, 1 tsp cumin, pinch hing and 2 tbsp cashew. Step 2: Fry on low flame until the cashew turn golden brown. Step 3: Now add 2 tbsp carrot, 2 chilli, 1 tsp ginger paste and a few curry leaves. Step 4: Saute slightly until it turns aromatic. Step 5: Further, add 1 cup rava and roast for 2 minutes. Roast until the rava turns aromatic. Step 6: Add 1 cup ragi flour and roast for 1 minute. Step 7: Cool completely, and transfer to a large bowl. Step 8: Add 1 tsp salt, 1 cup curd and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 9: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 10: Furthermore, add 1 cup water and mix well adjusting the consistency. Step 11: Cover and rest for 20 minutes, for rava and ragi flour to soak well. Step 12: Now add 1 tsp eno fruit salt and 2 tbsp water, and mix gently till the batter turns frothy. Step 13: Pour the idli batter into the greased idli moulds. Step 14: Steam for 15 minutes, or until the toothpick inserted comes out clean. Step 15: Finally, enjoy Ragi Idli Recipe with chutney.

Ingredient Names: ghee, cashews, mustard, urad dal, chana dal, cumin, curry leaves, asafoetida, chili, ginger, rava, curds, salt, water, fresh coriander, eno fruit salt
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tbsp ghee and roast 10 cashews. Step 2: Roast on low flame until the cashew turns golden brown. keep aside. Step 3: In the same ghee, add 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp urad dal, ½ tsp chana dal, ½ tsp cumin, few curry leaves and pinch hing. Splutter the tempering. Step 4: Add 2 chilli, and 1 inch ginger, and saute slightly. Step 5: Now add 1 cup rava and roast on low flame until the rava turns aromatic. Step 6: Cool completely and transfer to the large bowl. Step 7: Add 1 cup curd and ½ tsp salt. Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 8: Also, add ½ cup water and mix adjusting the consistency. Step 9: Now add 2 tbsp coriander, cover, and rest for 20 minutes. Step 10: After the rava has soaked well, add ½ tsp eno fruit salt and mix gently. Step 11: Mix the batter until the batter turns frothy. Step 12: Now place the roasted cashew in a greased idli plate and pour the batter in the idli mould. Step 13: Place the idli plate in a steamer and steam for 15 minutes. Step 14: Finally, enjoy Rava Idli Recipe with chutney.

Ingredient Names: fresh carrot, onions, capsicum, chili, ginger, curry leaves, cumin, salt, rava suji, curds, water, eno fruit salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, to prepare the topping, in a bowl take 1 carrot, 1 onion, 2 tbsp capsicum, 1 chilli, 1 inch ginger, 2 tbsp curry leaves, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp salt. Step 2: Mix well, making sure all the vegetables are well combined. Keep aside. Step 3: In a small bowl, take 1½ cup rava, ½ cup curd, ½ tsp salt and water. Step 4: Mix well, ensuring the batter is thoroughly combined and adjusting the water as needed. Step 5: Rest the batter for 5 minutes. Step 6: Now add ½ tsp eno fruit salt and 2 tbsp water. Step 7: Mix gently till the batter turns frothy. Step 8: Heat the griddle and pour a ladleful of batter. Spread out in a circular motion, slightly thicker than a regular masala dosa. Step 9: Top with the mixed vegetable mixture uniformly and pat slightly. Step 10: Also pour 1 tsp oil around the edges. Step 11: Roast the dosa to a golden brown on the bottom. Step 12: Flip over and roast both sides. Step 13: Finally, enjoy Mixed Vegetable Rava Utappam with chutney.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, ginger, garam masala, brown basmati rice, vegetable stock, curry leaves, cauliflower, curry powder, fresh coriander, hazelnuts, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large pan, add the onion and cook for 5 mins until golden. Add the garlic, ginger, garam masala and rice, and cook for a few more mins. Add the stock and curry leaves, and season. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 40 mins. Step 2: Toss the cauliflower in the curry powder and remaining oil, season and put on a baking sheet. Roast in the oven for 40 mins until tender. Step 3: Remove the rice pan from the heat and leave for 5 mins, then gently stir through the roasted cauliflower, coriander and toasted hazelnuts. Serve with natural yogurt.

Dish Name: Romano peppers stuffed with paneer & peas
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, mustard seed turmeric, cumin seeds, paneer cheese, peas, tomato, romano peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan. Add the mustard seeds, turmeric and cumin seeds, and cook until the mustard seeds start to pop. Add the paprika, ground coriander, ground cumin and ½ tsp black pepper with the paneer, and stir-fry until a light golden colour, about 3-4 mins. Step 2: Add the peas and tomato with some salt. Cook for 5 mins more until the tomatoes have softened to a pulp-like texture, then remove from the heat. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Cut a slit in the peppers from top to bottom, but leaving 3-4cm intact at each end. Use a teaspoon to scoop out the seeds then stuff the peppers with the paneer mix. Transfer to a baking tray and roast for 10-12 mins until the peppers have blistered and browned lightly. Serve with the Yogurt & spice crusted roast potatoes.

Ingredient Names: red, turmeric, tamarind paste, vegetable oil, shallots, ground asafoetida, ground fenugreek, black mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chilies, green bean half
Instructions: Step 1: Place the lentils in a large pan with 400ml water. Add turmeric and tamarind and boil for 25-30 mins until very soft. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and gently fry the shallots for 8-10 mins. When softened, add the spices, curry leaves, chillies and a good pinch of salt. Cook for another 2 mins, until fragrant. Step 3: Boil another pan of salted water and cook the beans for 4 mins until tender, then drain well. Step 4: Once the lentils are cooked, add the shallot spice mix and the beans, stir well and add more seasoning if necessary.

Ingredient Names: ghee, kidney beans, onion, garlic clove, carrot, potatoes, garam masala, curry powder, tabasco sauce, salt and pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onions& garlic with ghee on low heat. Step 2: When onions golden, add carrots and shortly after potatoes. Step 3: After 2 minutes add beans Do not rinse beans. Step 4: Add bean"juice" as well. Step 5: Cover veges with water plus a little bit. Step 6: Add curry / garam masala, bring to a boil. Step 7: Simmer for 20 minutes or until veqes are done Salt, pepper and spice to taste.

Dish Name: Shahi Paneer Recipe: Creamy and Delicious Dish
Ingredient Names: oil, pepper, bay leaf, cumin, cinnamon, pods cardamom, ginger, garlic, onions, tomato, almonds, curds, butter, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, fresh cream, salt, cubes paneer, saffron, sugar, dried fenugreek, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tbsp oil. Take spices and saute on low flame. Step 2: Add 1 inch ginger, 4 cloves garlic and 2 onion. Saute until the onions turn golden brown. Step 3: Also add 2 tomato, 2 tbsp badam and cook till the tomatoes soften. Step 4: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 5: Add ¼ cup curd, and grind to smooth paste. Step 6: Now sieve the puree to get a silky smooth texture. Keep aside. Step 7: In a Kadai, take 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil. Add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder and ½ tsp cumin powder. Step 8: Saute on low flame till the spices turn aromatic. Step 9: Add in prepared puree and cook well. Step 10: Also add ¼ cup cream, 1 tsp salt and cook till the oil separates. Step 11: Now add 20 cubes paneer, few kesar, 1 tsp sugar and mix well. Step 12: Simmer for 5 minutes, or until the flavours are well absorbed. Step 13: Add 2 tbsp kasuri methi, 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 14: Finally, enjoy Shahi Paneer Recipe with roti and naan.

Ingredient Names: kokum punarpuli bhirand muragalu kaatampi, fresh coconut, ginger, chili, cumin, salt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, soak dried kokum in hot water for 2 hours. Step 2: Squeeze the juice of kokum and keep it aside. Step 3: In a mixer jar, take 1 cup of coconut, 1 inch of ginger, 2 chillis, and 1 tsp of cumin. Step 4: Add 1 cup of water and grind well. You can also add garlic for authentic flavour while grinding. Step 5: Squeeze the milk from the coconut using a cloth and a strainer. Step 6: Add in extracted kokum juice to the coconut milk. Step 7: Also, add ½ tsp salt and 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 8: Finally, enjoy Sol Kadhi Recipe chilled.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, red chile, olive oil, cumin seeds, garam masala, red onions, limes, sugar, chapati, yogurt, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the sweet potatoes with chilli, 1 tsp oil, cumin seeds, garam masala and plenty of seasoning on a roasting tray. Roast for 25-35 mins, turning wedges halfway, until tender and golden. Step 2: Meanwhile fry onion in remaining oil for a few mins until partly softened, stir in the lime juice and sugar with some seasoning, then turn off the heat. Step 3: Warm chapatis following pack instructions, then assemble by adding a couple of wedges of sweet potato to each, followed by a scattering of onions, a dollop of yogurt and a small handful of coriander leaves. Roll up and eat.

Ingredient Names: potato, onions, garlic, olive oil, ground coriander turmeric mild chili powder, cumin seeds, chickpeas, tomato puree, baby spinach, fresh cilantro, wholemeal chapatis low-fat yogurt mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender. While they are cooking, soften the onions and garlic in the oil in a frying pan for a few mins. Add all the spices, then fry for 1 min more. Stir in the chickpeas and tomato purée with 400ml water, then turn the heat up and bubble for a few mins. Step 2: When the potatoes are ready, drain and add to the pan. Cook for a few mins until the sauce is thick, stir in the spinach, then season. When the spinach has wilted, scatter with coriander and serve with the chapatis, yogurt and chutney on the side.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, okra, tomatoes, red chile, ground coriander, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large wok or frying pan over a medium heat. Add the oil, then the onions, cooking until soft. Stir in the okra. Add the tomatoes and chilli, then season. Mix well and keep stirring gently, taking care not to break up the okra. Okra releases a sticky substance when cooked, but keep cooking, stirring gently – this will disappear and the tomatoes will become pulpy, about 10 mins. Step 2: Lower heat, add ground coriander and cook for another 5-10 mins. Add 2 tbsp water, cover and let simmer for another 4-5 mins. Sprinkle with coriander and serve with basmati rice or chapati bread.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, potatoes, curry paste, filo pastry half, tomatoes onion mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Heat half the oil in a non-stick frying pan. Tip in the onions and cook until soft and golden, about 8-10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the potato cubes for 5 mins, until just tender, then drain. Tip into the softened onions and fry for 2 mins more. Stir in the curry paste and cook for 2 mins. Pop in the peas, plus 1 tbsp water. Cook for 1 min, give everything a good mix and season. Tip into a bowl to allow to cool slightly. Step 3: Brush half the filo half-sheets with some of the remaining oil, then lay the remaining sheets on top so you have 4 x double layers. Spoon a ¼ of the potato mix along one edge of each, leaving a bit of space at each end. Fold in the ends then roll up to seal. Place seam-side down on a baking sheet, brush with the remaining oil and bake for 20 mins, or until crisp. Serve warm with a dollop of mango chutney and a tomato & onion salad, if you like.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, ginger, tomato puree, ground cumin, garam masala, basmati rice, vegetable stock, red lentils, spinach leaves, mint leaves, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan with a lid. Add the onion, garlic and ginger, then gently cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the tomato purée and spices, and cook for 1 min more. Add the rice, stir to coat, then pour in the stock. Bring to the boil, tip in the lentils, cover with the lid and leave to cook over a low heat for 15 mins, until the lentils and rice are cooked. Stir through the spinach and mint. Step 2: Use a sharp knife to slice the top off each pepper. Cut out the middle stalk and scoop out any seeds. Carefully trim the bottoms slightly so they stand upright, but the filling won't fall out. Fill each pepper with the rice mix and place the lid on top. Bake or wrap tightly in cling film or freezer bags and freeze. Step 3: To cook, defrost peppers completely if frozen. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Place the peppers on a lightly greased baking tray and cook for 25-30 mins or until the peppers have softened. Serve with a green salad tossed with cucumber, herbs and a dollop of yogurt.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ginger, chili flakes, cumin seeds, turmeric, cauliflower, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a big pan or wok with a lid, then add the ginger and spices. Step 2: Swirl everything around for a few secs until the spices are aromatic. Step 3: Reduce the heat, then stir in the cauliflower and some seasoning. Step 4: Put the lid on and cook for 10 mins or until softened, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Sprinkle over the coriander before serving.

Ingredient Names: paneer cheese, lemons, ground cumin, flour, garam masala, paprika, fresh cream, garlic, red chilies, peppers red yellow, zucchini, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Soak 12-15 bamboo skewers in water for 15 mins – this helps to stop them from burning under the grill. Cut the paneer cheese into 3cm cubes and toss with the lemon juice and ground cumin. Set aside for 30 mins. Step 2: Sieve the gram flour, garam masala and paprika into a bowl and add the cream, garlic and chopped chillies plus enough water to make a thick batter, then stir until smooth. Drain the paneer and add to the batter with 2 tbsp of the cumin-spiced lemon juice. Coat all the paneer cubes in batter. Step 3: Heat grill to its hottest setting and line the grill pan with foil. Thread the paneer onto skewers, alternating it with chunks of pepper and courgette. Drizzle with batter from the bowl and cook for 4-5 mins on each side, spooning over more batter when you turn them. Grill until charred at the edges. Brush with melted butter, sprinkle with the ground cumin, and serve immediately, accompanied with lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: roasting potatoes, chili flakes, turmeric, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Boil the potatoes for 5 mins. Drain well, place back in the pan, cover with a lid and shake vigorously to lightly roughen up the edges. Step 2: Meanwhile, grind the spices using a pestle and mortar until lightly crushed, then mix with the oil. Put the spice mix in a roasting tin and place in the oven to heat up. Carefully put the potatoes into the roasting tin, tossing them in the hot oil and spice mixture. Roast in the oven for 40-45 mins or until crisp and golden, turning once or twice during cooking.

Ingredient Names: flour, rice flour, spinach, onions, potatoes, oil, green chili peppers, coriander powder, garam masala, mango powder, pomegranate seeds, red chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the gram flour. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients (except oil), to make a smooth and thick (almost like dough) batter. Step 3: Cover and let it stand for ½ hour. Step 4: Sprinkle little water if needed. Step 5: (If using frozen spinach, thaw before using.) Blend in all the seasonings (except salt) and mix well. Step 6: (You may chill the batter in the refrigerator for about 2 hours or more until it can be handled.) Mix in salt when ready to cook. Step 7: Heat the oil in a deep skillet or wok on medium to high heat. Step 8: For each pakora, scoop a heaped teaspoon of the batter, and with a second spoon, scrape the mixture into the hot oil. Step 9: Put the'pakoras' in a single layer in the skillet. Step 10: Fry, turning them with a slotted flat spatula, until all sides become golden brown. Step 11: (Regulate the heat as needed while the'pakoras' are being fried.) Remove and drain on paper towels or brown paper bag lined with plastic. Step 12: Fry all the'pakoras' this way. Step 13: Serve hot with any chutney. Step 14: Variation: Add 1 cup corn kernels to the mixture for extra crispness. Step 15: May also add ½ teaspoon baking soda to ensure softness.

Ingredient Names: red lentils, sunflower oil, garlic, finger-tip ginger, garam masala, reduced-fat coconut milk, paneer, baby spinach leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Boil lentils for 8-12 mins, then drain. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan and gently cook the garlic, ginger and garam masala for 2-3 mins. Reserve 2 tbsp of the coconut milk, add the rest to the pan with the lentils and simmer for 5 mins. Step 2: Heat grill to high. Arrange the cubed paneer on a foil-lined baking sheet and grill for 5 mins, turning once, until golden. Step 3: Stir spinach into lentil mix and gently cook until just wilted. Divide between bowls, then top with the paneer and reserved coconut milk. Scatter over coriander and serve with naan bread.

Ingredient Names: madras curry paste, butternut squash, red peppers, reduced-fat coconut milk, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan or wok, tip in the curry paste and fry for 1 min. Add the squash and red pepper, then toss well in the paste. Step 2: Pour in the coconut milk with 200ml water and bring to a simmer. Cook for 15-20 mins or until the butternut squash is very tender and the sauce has thickened. Season to taste, then serve scattered with chopped coriander and naan bread or rice.

Ingredient Names: red thai curry paste, low-sodium vegetable stock, onions, eggplants, red lentils, reduced-fat coconut milk, red, peas, baby spinach, brown basmati rice mango chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the curry paste in a large non-stick saucepan with a splash of the stock. Add the onions and fry for 5 mins until starting to soften. Stir in the aubergine and cook for a further 5 mins – add a little more stock if starting to stick. Step 2: Add the lentils, coconut milk and the rest of the stock, and simmer for 15 mins or until the lentils are tender. Add the peppers and cook for 5-10 mins more. Stir through the peas and spinach and cook until spinach has just wilted. Serve the curry with rice and mango chutney.

Ingredient Names: vegetables, nigella seeds, fennel seeds, onions, tomato, green chilies, light muscovado sugar, paprika, turmeric, chickpeas, tamarind paste, fresh coriander, half baby spinach leaves, yogurt chapatis
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a saucepan, fry the nigella and fennel seeds for about 10 seconds. Add the onion and cook gently for 8-10 minutes until golden. Step 2: Mix in the tomatoes, chillies, sugar, paprika, turmeric and chickpeas. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the tamarind and coriander. Add the spinach leaves and stir gently until they’ve just wilted. Serve with yogurt and chapatis.

Dish Name: The Best Vegetarian Vegan Vegetable Samosas
Ingredient Names: all-purpose white flour, salt, unsalted butter, potatoes, vegetable oil, onion, frozen peas, fresh ginger, parsley, ground coriander, garam masala, ground roasted cumin seeds, lemon juice, oil, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour and salt into a bowl. Step 2: Add the softened butter and rub it in with your hands so that the flour resembles fine bread crumbs. Step 3: Add warm water, a tablespoon at a time, and begin to gather the flour into a ball You will need 5 tablespoons of water Form a ball and begin to knead it. Step 4: Knead well for about 10-15 minutes or until dough is very soft and pliable (if you have a food processor, put the steel blade in place and empty the sifted flour and salt into a container. Step 5: Add the softened butter and turn on the machine. Step 6: When you have a bread-crumb consistency, begin to add about 5 tablespoons of water slowly through the funnel Stop when the dough forms a ball.

Dish Name: Tide Me Over Indian Chaat Simple Veggie Salad
Ingredient Names: cucumber, potato, chopped tomato, plain yogurt, chaat masala, paprika, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Toss everything well in a serving bowl Grab a fork or large spoon and eat immediately, or refrigerate until hunger strikes, and then eat! Step 2: Feel extremely pleased with yourself that you snacked on this instead of that bag of chips you were eyeing Proceed to eat several helpings of dessert after dinner as reward.

Ingredient Names: tikka paste, yogurt, cumin seeds, thumb-size ginger, new potatoes, paneer cheese, red onions wedges through root, red peppers, mango chutney, mint leaves, salad leaves, chapati
Instructions: Step 1: Soak 12 wooden skewers in water for 30 mins (this helps to stop them burning). In a large bowl, mix together the tikka paste with half of the yogurt, the cumin, ginger and seasoning. Boil the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water for 7 mins, then drain well and tip into the tikka mixture with the paneer. Gently mix into the marinade, then chill for at least 2 hrs to take on flavour. Step 2: To assemble the kebabs, alternately thread the marinated potatoes and paneer onto the skewers with the onions and peppers, then cover on a tray until you are ready to barbecue. Step 3: Heat the barbecue or a grill. Mix the mango chutney into the remaining yogurt, and the mint leaves into the salad leaves. Barbecue or grill the kebabs for 10-15 mins, turning, until the veg are charred and softened. With a few minutes to go, add the chapattis to the barbecue in batches to warm through. Serve the kebabs with the minty salad, cooling mango yogurt and chapattis, and let everyone assemble their own wraps.

Ingredient Names: chana dal, pepper, coriander seeds, cumin, fenugreek leaves, red chile, garlic, ginger, curry leaves, chili, tomato, water, tamarind extract, turmeric, salt, fresh coriander, oil, mustard, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, to prepare the rasam powder, in a pan take 2 tbsp chana dal, 2 tsp pepper, 2 tsp coriander seeds, ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp methi and 10 dried red chilli. Step 2: Dry roast till the spices turn aromatic. Step 3: Cool completely, and grind to a fine powder. Keep asdie. Step 4: In a mortar pestle, take 5 cloves garlic, 1 inch ginger, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp cumin, few curry leaves, and 2 chilli. Step 5: Pound and crush til the spices are into well combined. Keep aside. Step 6: In a saucepan, take 3 tomato and boil in 3 cup water. Step 7: Boil for 5 minutes til the tomato is blanched well. Step 8: Cool completely, and peel the skin off. Also mash the tomato well. Step 9: Add in ½ cup tamarind extract, few curry leaves, ½ tsp turmeric, and 1 tsp salt. Step 10: Boil for 5 minutes or until the tamarind is well cooked. Step 11: Add crushed garlic masala, 1 tbsp rasam powder and mix well. Step 12: Pour in required water, adjusting the consistency. Step 13: Boil for 5 minutes, or until the flavours are well absorbed. Step 14: To prepare the tempering, heat 2 tsp oil. Splutter 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin, pinch hing and 1 dried red chilli. Step 15: Splutter the tempering and pour it over rasam. Step 16: Also add 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 17: Finally, enjoy Tomato Charu Recipe with hot steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: toor dal, ghee, turmeric, salt, water, oil, onions, tomato, chili, tamarind extract, chili powder, fresh coriander, mustard, cumin, garlic, red chile, curry leaves, asafoetida
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pressure cooker take 1 cup toor dal. You can even soak the dal for 15 minutes to hasten the cooking time. Step 2: Add 1 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp salt and 3 cup water. Step 3: Cover and pressure cook for 5 whistles or until the dal is cooked well. Step 4: Once the pressure settles down, mash the dal slightly and keep aside. Step 5: In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil and saute ½ onion until the onion softens. Step 6: Add 3 tomato and saute for 2 minutes or until the tomato softens. Step 7: Further add 4 chilli, ½ cup tamarind extract, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp salt. Step 8: Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft and mushy. Step 9: Add in cooked toor dal and mix well. Step 10: Adjust the consistency, and boil for 5 minutes or until the flavour is absorbed well. Step 11: Now to prepare the tempering, heat 2 tbsp ghee. Add 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp cumin, 10 cloves garlic, 2 dried red chilli, few curry leaves and a pinch hing. Step 12: Splutter the tempering and fry until the garlic turns golden. Step 13: Pour the tempering over the tomato pappu and add 2 tbsp coriander. Mix well. Step 14: Finally, enjoy Tomato Dal or Tomato Pappu with hot steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: tomato, garlic, red chile, fresh coconut, cumin, coriander seeds, oil, mustard, asafoetida, curry leaves, turmeric, chili powder, salt, jaggery, water, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a mixer jar, take 3 tomatoes, 4 garlic cloves, 4 dried red chillis, 1 cup of coconut, ½ tsp cumin and 1 tsp coriander seeds. Step 2: Grind to a smooth paste and keep aside. Step 3: In a kadai, heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 tsp of mustard, ½ tsp of cumin, a pinch of hing, and a few curry leaves. Splutter the tempering. Step 4: Add in the prepared masala paste. Step 5: Add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp jaggery. Step 6: Cook till everything is well combined. Step 7: Add an additional 4 cups of water and mix well. Step 8: Boil well until the flavours are infused. Step 9: Now add 2 tbsp of coriander and mix well. Step 10: Finally, enjoy the Tomato Saar Recipe with hot steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: peanuts, sesame, dry coconut, coriander seeds, cumin, water, oil, mustard, asafoetida, onions, garlic, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, salt, curry leaves, jaggery, tomato, chili, tamarind extract, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan dry roast 2 tbsp peanut until it turns crunchy. Step 2: Add 2 tbsp sesame, 2 tbsp dry coconut, 1 tsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp cumin. Step 3: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 4: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixer jar. Step 5: Add ½ cup water and grind to smooth paste. keep aside. Step 6: In a pan heat 2 tbsp oil. splutter 1 tsp mustard, pinch hing and 1 tsp cumin. Step 7: Add ½ onion, 10 cloves garlic and saute until onion softens. Step 8: Further add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala and 1 tsp salt. Step 9: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 10: Also, add the prepared masala paste and cook until the oil separates. Step 11: Now add 2 cup water, few curry leaves and small piece of jaggery. Step 12: Mix well adjusting the consistency as required. Step 13: Boil for 10 minutes, or until the oil separates. Step 14: Now add 2 tomato, 2 chilli and ½ cup tamarind extract. Step 15: Cover and boil for 5 minutes or until the tomato softens. Step 16: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and enjoy tomato curry with biryani or roti.

Ingredient Names: semiya, oil, mustard, cumin, urad dal, chana dal, asafoetida, red chile, cashews, ginger, onions, capsicum, tomato, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, cumin powder, salt, curry leaves, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water in a large vessel. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 tsp oil. Bring to a boil. Step 2: Add 2 cup rice semiya and boil for 3 minutes. Check the package instructions for boiling time. Step 3: Once the semiya is cooked, drain off the water and rinse with cold water. Keep aside. Step 4: In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil. Add ½ tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp urad dal, ½ tsp chana dal, pinch hing, 1 dried red chilli and 2 tbsp cashew. Step 5: Splutter the tempering. Step 6: Add 1 inch ginger, ½ onion and saute slightly. Step 7: Also add ½ capsicum, 2 tomato and saute till the tomato softens. Step 8: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp garam masala, ¼ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp salt and few curry leaves. Step 9: Saute on low flame till the spices turn aromatic. Step 10: Further add in cooked semiya and mix gently, mixing everything well. Step 11: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and serve Tomato Semiya Recipe.

Dish Name: Turkey Slices With Curry Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: turkey tenderloins, butter, all-purpose flour, chicken broth, milk, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, lemons, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place tenderloins in a 13 X 9 inch pan; bake at 400 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through. Step 2: Cut turkey into 1/2 inch slices and keep warm. Step 3: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth; cook one minute, stirring constantly. Step 4: Gradually add broth and milk (or cream), cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Step 5: Stir in spices and lemon rind; Cook one minute longer, stirring constantly. Step 6: Place turkey slices on top of hot rice;pour sauce over turkey and serve with your favorite choices of curry condiments.

Ingredient Names: tuvar dal, fenugreek seeds, urad dal, red chilies, coriander seeds, curry leaves, fresh coconut, shallots, mustards seeds, asafoetida, green chilies, chunks vegetables, tamarind pulp, salt, jaggery, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the tuvar dal till tender then mash. Step 2: Heat 1 tblsp oil in a heavy bottomed pan and roast the fenugreek seeds till light red, then add 1/2 tsp urad dal and let it saute till they change colour too. Step 3: Add the red chilli and coriander seeds. Step 4: Add a 3 sprigs of curry leaves and the grated coconut and roast. Step 5: They should all turn light brown and aromatic. Step 6: Cool and grind to a fine paste with a little water. Step 7: Heat 1 tblsp oil in a pan. Step 8: Add the mustard seed. Step 9: When they splutter add 1/2 tsp of urad dal and the hing, fry for a minute. Step 10: Add the onions and green chillies, slit and the rest of the curry leaves. Step 11: Add your choice of vegetables Fry till you get a nice aroma. Step 12: Add a little water. Step 13: Cover and cook till the veges are done. Step 14: Extract pulp from the tamarind and add to the vegetables. Step 15: Add salt and crumbled jaggery (you can use brown sugar i think instead) and cook till the raw smell of the tamarind disappears. Step 16: Add the mashed dal and the ground masala. Step 17: Mix weel and add a little water if reqd. Step 18: Simmer for a few mins. Step 19: Serve with dosas, idlis or rice, and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: onions, salt, chili powder, fennel, ginger, chili, fresh coriander, curry leaves, all-purpose flour, besan flour, asafoetida, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, slice 5 onion as thin as possible. Step 2: Transfer the onions to the large bowl. Step 3: Add 1 tsp salt and squeeze the onions. Step 4: Now add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp fennel, 1 inch ginger, 2 chilli, 2 tbsp coriander and few curry leaves. Step 5: Also, add ¼ cup maida and 2 tbsp besan and pinch hing. Step 6: Squeeze and mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 7: Add more maida as required, making sure the mixture holds the shape. Step 8: Grease the hands with oil and shape them into vada. Step 9: Deep fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 10: Stir occasionally, and fry on low to medium flame until the vada turns golden brown. Step 11: Drain off once the vada turns crispy golden brown. Step 12: Finally, enjoy Ulli Vada Recipe with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: oil, cumin, garlic, chili, onions, ginger paste, fresh carrot, beans, sweet corn, florets cauliflower, capsicum, potato, chili powder, cumin powder, garam masala, black salt, salt, paneer, fresh coriander, corn flour, breadcrumbs, all-purpose flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan, heat 2 tbsp oil and saute 1 tsp cumin. Step 2: Add 5 cloves garlic, 2 chilli, 1 onion, ½ tsp ginger paste and saute well. Step 3: Also add ½ carrot, 5 beans, 2 tbsp sweet corn, 4 florets of cauliflower, ½ capsicum. Step 4: Sauté till the vegetables are cooked well. Step 5: Transfer to the large plate and allow to cool completely. Step 6: Now add 3 boiled and mashed potatoes. Step 7: Also add ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp garam masala, ¼ tsp kala namak, 1 tsp salt, ½ cup paneer and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 8: Mix well, making sure everything is well combined. Step 9: To absorb excess moisture, add 2 tbsp corn flour and mix well. Step 10: Now prepare tikki and keep aside. Step 11: To prepare the slurry, in a bowl, take ½ cup maida, ½ cup corn flour, ½ tsp salt and ½ cup water. Step 12: Mix well, making sure there are no lumps. Step 13: Dip the kebab into the slurry and coat with breadcrumbs. Step 14: Shallow fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 15: Fry both sides till they turn golden and crispy. Step 16: Drain off to remove excess oil. Step 17: Finally, enjoy Mix Veg Kebab Recipe with green chutney and sauce.

Ingredient Names: onions, ginger, garlic, green chilies, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, ground, ground cardamom, oil, assorted vegetables, salt, plain yogurt, water, cashew nuts, pine nuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Puree half the onion with the ginger, garlic, and chilies into a fine paste in a food processor. Step 2: Add the ground spices and mix. Step 3: Chop half the nuts to a fine paste with a food processor, set aside. Step 4: Heat the oil and fry the remaining onion (chopped) over medium heat until browned, stirring frequently. Step 5: Add the spice/onion paste and fry until it starts to smell really good (30 seconds or so). Stir in the veggies with longer cooking times such as potatoes and fry for a while. Step 6: Add nuts, nut paste, and other veggies as cooking times dictate. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and add water (or milk to make it even more rich) and yogurt (whole milk yogurt!). Take care not to overcook the yoghurt, as it will separate and degrade. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro and serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: semiya vermicelli, rava semolina suji, cumin, salt, curds, curry leaves, chili, ginger, fresh coriander, asafoetida, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan dry roast ¾ cup semiya until it turns golden brown. Step 2: Cool completely, and transfer to a large bowl. Step 3: Add 1 cup rava, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp salt. Step 4: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 5: Now add 1 cup curd, few curry leaves, 3 chilli, 1 inch ginger, 2 tbsp coriander and pinch hing. Step 6: Mix well combining everything well. Step 7: Cover and rest for 20 minutes or until the rava and semiya are softened well. Step 8: Now pinch a ball-sized dough and flatten it slightly. Step 9: Coat with semiya on both sides to get extra crisp vada. Step 10: Pan fry on medium flame by adding oil as required. Step 11: Fry on both sides until the vada turns golden brown. Step 12: You can alternatively deep fry in hot oil with the shape of your choice. Step 13: Finally, enjoy Vermicelli Vada or Semiya Vada with tomato sauce or coconut chutney.

Ingredient Names: cumin seeds, chili pods, black peppercorns, cardamom seeds, cinnamon, black mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, white wine vinegar, salt, brown sugar, vegetable oil, onions, water, pork, ginger cube, garlic, coriander seeds, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Grind cumin seeds, red chilies, peppercorns, cardamom seeds, cinnamon, black mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds in a mortar & pestle or other spice grinder. Step 2: Put the ground spices in a bowl and mix in the vinegar, salt and sugar; set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pot over a medium flame, add the onions. Step 4: Fry, stirring frequently, until the onions turn brown and crisp. Step 5: Remove the onions with a slotted spoon and place them into an electric blender or food processor - add 2-3 tablespoons of water to the blender and puree the onions. Step 6: Add this puree to the ground spices in the bowl. Step 7: -= You have now created your vindaloo paste - You can make this ahead of time and freeze -. Step 8: Put the ginger and garlic into an electric blender or food processor; add 2-3 tablespoons of water and blend until you have a smooth paste. Step 9: Heat the oil remaining in the pot once again over a medium-high flame. Step 10: When hot, add in the pork, a few at a time, and brown them lightly on all sides; remove each batch with a slotted spoon and reserve in a bowl - continue this procedure until all of the pork has been browned. Step 11: Now add the ginger-garlic paste to the same pot. Step 12: Turn down the heat to medium; stir the paste for a few seconds. Step 13: Add the coriander and turmeric; stir for another few seconds. Step 14: Add the meat, any juices that may have accumulated as well as the vindaloo paste and the water and bring to a boil. Step 15: Cover and simmer gently for an hour or until pork is tender; stirring occasionally during the cooking period. Step 16: Serve with Basmati rice and.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, kosher salt, ground turmeric, water, olive oil, yogurt, to kashmiri red chili powder, garam masala, ground cumin, ground coriander, ginger, garlic, dried fenugreek, greek yogurt, persian cucumbers, fresh cilantro, pistachios, pomegranate seeds, pickled onions, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Add 1 cup water to Instant Pot. Step 2: Place the cauliflower head on the trivet and place the trivet inside the Instant Pot. Step 3: Mix salt and turmeric in 2 tablespoons of water and brush it all over the cauliflower. Turn the cauliflower over and evenly pour any remaining brine on it. Step 4: Then place the cauliflower back on the trivet with the stem down. Close the Instant Pot with pressure valve to sealing. Pressure Cook for 1 minute followed by quick release and open the Instant Pot. Step 5: Mix all the ingredients for the marinade in a small bowl. Apply the marinade on the steamed cauliflower using a brush or silicone spatula. You can also turn the cauliflower over to get any remaining marinade under the cauliflower. Then place the cauliflower back on the trivet with the stem down. Apply the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil over the cauliflower. Step 6: Preheat the air fryer to 400 F. Place the marinated cauliflower in the air fryer. Air fry at 400 F for 5 minutes. You can also roast in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 5 to 10 minutes. Step 7: In a bowl, add finely grated cucumber, salt, grated garlic, ground cumin and cilantro. Add yogurt and mix well. Step 8: Place the cauliflower in a medium serving platter. Pour Raita around the cauliflower. Garnish with cilantro, pistachios, pomegranates and pickled onions. Add lemon wedges to the side. Step 9: Cut into ½ inch steaks while serving.

Dish Name: Yellow lentil & coconut curry with cauliflower
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, thumb-sized ginger, curry paste, yellow lentils, vegetable stock, unsweetened desiccated coconut, cauliflower, basmati rice cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, then add the onion, garlic and ginger. Cook for 5 mins, add the curry paste, then stir-fry for 1 min before adding the lentils, stock and coconut. Bring the mixture to the boil and simmer for 40 mins or until the lentils are soft. Step 2: During the final 10 mins of cooking, stir in the cauliflower to cook. Spoon rice into 4 bowls, top with the curry and sprinkle with coriander leaves, and coconut if you like. Serve with mango chutney and naan bread (optional).

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, coriander seeds, chana dal, fenugreek leaves, pepper, cumin, red chile, fresh coconut, water, mustard, curry leaves, shallots, drumstick, brinjals, radish, turmeric, salt, tamarind extract, jaggery, toor dal, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a pan heat ½ tbsp sesame oil. add 2 tsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp chana dal, ¼ tsp methi, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp cumin and 6 dried red chilli. Step 2: Roast on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 3: Add ¼ cup coconut and saute for a minute until the coconut turns aromatic. Step 4: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixi jar. Step 5: Add ½ cup water and blend to smooth paste. finally, arachuvitta masala paste is ready. Step 6: Firstly, in a kadai heat 2 tbsp sesame oil. splutter, 1 tsp mustard, ¼ tsp methi, 2 dried red chilli and a few curry leaves. Step 7: Add 10 shallots and saute for a minute. Step 8: Also add 4 piece drumstick, ½ brinjal, ½ radish, ½ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp salt. Step 9: Saute for a minute until the vegetables turn aromatic. Step 10: Now pour 3 cup water and mix well. Step 11: Cover and boil for 8 minutes, or until the vegetables are almost cooked. Step 12: Further, add ½ cup tamarind extract and ½ tsp jaggery. Step 13: Mix well and boil for 5 minutes or until the raw flavour of tamarind goes away. Step 14: Add in the prepared masala paste, 1 cup toor dal and ¾ tsp salt. Step 15: Mix well and boil for 3 minutes or until all the flavours are well absorbed. Step 16: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and enjoy arachuvitta sambar with hot steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: bitter gourd karela, salt, turmeric, water, oil, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, sesame, poppy seeds, peanuts, dry coconut, chili powder, ball sized tamarind, onions, fresh coriander, mustard, cumin, asafoetida, curry leaves, ginger garlic paste, coriander powder, garam masala, tomato, jaggery
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, slit the karela and remove the seeds. removing the seeds will create room for stuffing and also reduce bitterness. Step 2: Sprinkle 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp turmeric. Step 3: Soak in water for 20 minutes. this helps to reduce bitterness. Step 4: Firstly, in a pan heat 2 tsp oil. Step 5: Add 2 tsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 2 tbsp sesame and 1 tsp poppy seeds. Step 6: Roast on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 7: Now add ¼ cup peanut, 3 tbsp dry coconut and roast until it turns crunchy. Step 8: Cool completely and transfer to mixi. Step 9: Add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, small ball sized tamarind and ½ tsp salt. Step 10: Blend to a coarse paste without adding any water. Step 11: Transfer the masala powder to the pan, add ½ onion and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 12: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 13: Now take the karela and stuff the masala into it. keep aside. Step 14: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 3 tbsp oil. splutter 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp cumin, pinch hing and few curry leaves. Step 15: Add 1 onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute well. Step 16: Keeping the flame on low add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp coriander powder and 1 tsp garam masala. Step 17: Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 18: Now add 2 tomato and saute until the tomatoes turn soft and mushy. Step 19: Add in stuffed karela and cook for a minute. Step 20: Also add 2 tbsp jaggery, ½ tsp salt and 1 cup water. Step 21: Stir well adjusting consistency as required. Step 22: Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until karela gets cooked well. Step 23: Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander and enjoy bharwa karela with roti or phulka.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, rava semolina, sugar, baking soda, salt, oil, curds, water, chana chickpea, tea, bay leaf, black cardamom, pod cardamom, cinnamon, cumin jeera, dried fenugreek, onions, ginger garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, aamchur, tomato puree, fresh coriander, ghee clarified butter, chili
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 2 cup maida, 2 tbsp rava, 1 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp baking soda, 1 tsp sugar, ½ tsp salt and 2 tbsp oil. mix well. Step 2: Now add ¼ cup curd and mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 3: Further, add water as required and knead the dough. Step 4: Knead to the smooth and soft dough without putting much pressure. Step 5: Grease the dough with oil, cover and rest for 2 hours. Step 6: After 2 hours, knead the dough slightly. Step 7: Pinch a ball sized dough and make a ball without andy cracks. Step 8: Roll slightly thick, applying oil to prevent from sticking. Step 9: Drop the rolled dough into the hot oil. Step 10: Press until the bhature puffs up and splash oil to puff up fully. Step 11: Flip over and fry until it turns golden brown. Step 12: Finally, drain off the bhatura and is ready to enjoy with chole masala. Step 13: Firstly, in a pressure cooker take soaked chana. i have soaked 1 cup chana in enough water for 8 hours. Step 14: Add 2 tea bags, ¼ tsp baking soda, 1 tsp salt and 3 cup water. Step 15: Cover and pressure cook for 5 whistles. if you do not have tea bags, then you can prepare tea decoction and add to cooker. Step 16: Once the pressure releases, open the cooker and discard the tea bags. keep aside. Step 17: In a large kadai, heat 2 tbsp oil, 1 bay leaf, 1 black cardamom, 2 pod cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp kasuri methi. saute on low flame until the spices turn aroamtic. Step 18: Now add 1 onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute until onions turn golden brown. Step 19: Add ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp garam masala, 1 tsp aamchur and ¼ tsp salt. Step 20: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 21: Further add 1½ cup tomato puree and saute until the oil separates. to prepare tomato puree, i have blended 2½ ripened tomatoes in blender without adding water. Step 22: Now add boiled chole and mix well. adjust consistency by adding water if required. Step 23: Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, or until chole absorbs all the flavour. Step 24: To prepare the tempering, heat 1 tbsp ghee in a pan. Step 25: Add 2 chilli, ¼ tsp turmeri, ¼ tsp chilli powder and ¼ tsp garam masala. Step 26: Saute on low flame without burning the spices. Step 27: Pour the tempering over the chole masala, add 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 28: Finally, chole bhature is ready to enjoy with some onions.

Ingredient Names: oil, ginger, garlic, chana dal, urad dal, coriander seeds, methi fenugreek, cumin, red chile, tamarind, jaggery, salt, water, mustard, asafoetida, curry leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large pan heat 3 tsp oil, add 75 grams ginger and saute for 2 minutes. Step 2: Saute on medium flame until ginger changes colour slightly. Step 3: Also, add 3 clove garlic and saute until it turns slightly golden brown. keep aside. Step 4: In the pan heat 3 tsp oil, add 1 tbsp chana dal, 1 tbsp urad dal, 1 tbsp coriander seeds, ¼ tsp methi and 1 tsp cumin. Step 5: Roast on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 6: Further, add 30 dried red chilli and saute until the chills puff up. Step 7: Cool completely, and transfer to the mixi. Step 8: Blend to coarse powder without adding water. Step 9: Now add roasted ginger and garlic. Step 10: Blend to a thick paste by scraping sides. Step 11: Now add 50 grams tamarind soaked in ¼ cup hot water for 30 minutes. Step 12: Also, add 75 grams of jaggery and 1 tbsp salt. Step 13: Blend to smooth paste. Step 14: To adjust the consistency, add ½ cup of water and blend well. Step 15: Blend to a slightly thick paste, making to a silky texture. Step 16: Now to prepare the tempering, heat 2 tbsp oil. Step 17: Add 1 tsp mustard, ½ tsp chana dal, ½ tsp urad dal, pinch hing, 2 dried red chilli and few curry leaves. Step 18: Splutter the tempering and pour over the pachadi. Step 19: Finally, enjoy ginger chutney or allam pachadi with idli or dosa.

Ingredient Names: urad dal, idli rava, water
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, soak 1½ cup urad dal for 2 hours. make sure to rinse urad dal well. Step 2: Drain off the water and transfer to the grinder. Step 3: Blend for 40 minutes to smooth and fluffy batter adding water as required. Step 4: Transfer the urad dal batter to a large bowl and keep aside. Step 5: In a large bowl take 3 cup idli rava and rinse 3 times. Step 6: Drain off the water making sure the water is running clean. Step 7: Now squeeze off the idli rava and transfer to the urad dal batter. Step 8: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 9: Cover and ferment for 8 hours or until it is well fermented. Step 10: Now add 1 tsp salt and mix gently. Step 11: Finally, idli batter is ready to prepare idli, uttapam, appe or punugulu.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, soya chunks, curds, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, coriander powder, cumin powder, dried fenugreek, oil, bay leaf, pods cardamom, cinnamon, cumin, onions, tomato puree, cashew paste, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large vessel take enough water. Step 2: Add 1 tsp salt and get to a boil. Step 3: Now add 1½ cup soya chunks and boil for 8 minutes or until the soya softens. Step 4: Drain off and rinse in cold water. Step 5: Squeeze off the water from soya chunks and transfer to a large bowl. Step 6: Add ½ cup curd, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste, ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric. Step 7: Also, add 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp kasuri methi and ½ tsp salt. Step 8: Mix well making sure everything is well combined. Step 9: Cover and allow to marinate for 30 minutes. Step 10: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 2 tbsp oil. add 2 bay leaf, 5 cloves, 2 pods cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon and 1 tsp cumin. Step 11: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 12: Now add 1 onion and saute until the onions turn golden brown. Step 13: Keeping the flame on low, add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder and ½ tsp coriander powder. Step 14: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 15: Now add marinated soya and cook for 2 minutes. Step 16: Further, add 1½ cup tomato puree. to prepare puree, blend 2 ripened tomatoes to smooth paste without adding water. Step 17: Cook until the tomato puree thickens slightly. Step 18: Now add ½ cup cashew paste, ½ tsp salt and mix well. to prepare cashew paste, soak 10 cashews in ½ cup hot water and blend to a smooth paste. Step 19: Cover and continue to cook until the oil separated from the curry. Step 20: Adjust the consistency of gravy adding water as required. also, add 2 tbsp coriander and mix well. Step 21: Finally, enjoy meal maker curry with roti or paratha.

Ingredient Names: curds, salt, baking soda, maida flour, chili, ginger, curry leaves, fresh coconut, fresh coriander, cumin, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large bowl take 1 cup curd, ¾ tsp salt and 1 tsp baking soda. Step 2: Mix well until the curd turns frothy. Step 3: Now add 2 cup maida and start to mix gently. Step 4: Adding more curd if required, start to beat in 1 direction. Step 5: The batter will turn elastic texture. Step 6: Now add 2 chilli, 1 inch ginger, few curry leaves, 2 tbsp coconut, 2 tbsp coriander and 1 tsp cumin. Step 7: Mix well combining everything well. Step 8: Now, cover and rest for 4 hours. Step 9: After 4 hours, the batter will turn more soft and fluffy. Step 10: Beat it further for a minute. Step 11: Dip your hand in the water and pinch a ball sized batter. Step 12: Drop in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 13: Stir and fry until the bonda turns golden brown and crisp. Step 14: Finally, drain off the mysore bajji and enjoy with chutney.

Ingredient Names: toor dal, urad dal, moong dal, masoor dal, chana dal, turmeric, salt, bay leaf, ghee, water, black cardamom, cumin, red chile, onions, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, tomato, garam masala, dried fenugreek, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take ¼ cup toor dal, ¼ cup urad dal, ¼ cup moong dal, ¼ cup masoor dal and ¼ cup chana dal. Step 2: Rinse well and soak for 30 minutes. Step 3: Transfer the soaked dal into the pressure cooker. Step 4: Add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp salt, 2 bay leaf, 1 tsp ghee and 3 cups water. Step 5: Pressure cook for 5 whistles or until the dal is cooked completely. Step 6: Once the pressure releases, open the cooker and check if the dal is cooked well. keep aside. Step 7: In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp ghee. add 1 bay leaf, 4 cloves, 1 black cardamom, 1 tsp cumin and 1 dried red chilli. Step 8: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 9: Now add 1 onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute until onions turn golden brown. Step 10: Further add ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder and ½ tsp salt. Step 11: Saute until the spices turn aromatic. Step 12: Add 2 tomato and saute until the tomatoes turn soft and mushy. Step 13: Now add cooked dal and mix well adjusting consistency as required. Step 14: Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the flavours are well absorbed. Step 15: Further add ¼ tsp garam masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi and 2 tbsp coriander. mix well. Step 16: To prepare the tempering, heat 1 tsp ghee. add 1 tsp cumin, ¼ tsp chilli powder and 1 dried red chilli. Step 17: Immediately pour the tempering over dal. make sure the tadka doesn't get burnt. Step 18: Finally, enjoy panchmel dal or pancharatna dal with roti or jeera rice.

Ingredient Names: boiled potato, onions, chili, ginger garlic paste, fresh coriander, turmeric, chili powder, cumin powder, aamchur, chaat masala, pepper powder, garam masala, salt, asafoetida, bread crumbs, all-purpose flour, corn flour, water, breadcrumbs, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, on a large plate, take 6 boiled potatoes and mash as smoothly as possible. Step 2: Add ½ onion, 2 chilli, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and 2 tbsp coriander. Step 3: Also add ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp aamchur, ½ tsp chaat masala, ½ tsp pepper powder, ½ tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt and a pinch of hing. Step 4: Mix well, ensuring all the spices are thoroughly combined. Step 5: Add ¼ cup bread crumbs and prepare a non-sticky dough. Step 6: Prepare a small ball-sized ball and keep it aside. Step 7: To prepare a slurry, in a bowl, take ½ cup of maida, ½ cup of corn flour, ½ tsp of pepper powder, and ½ tsp of salt. Step 8: Add water and prepare a smooth slurry. Step 9: Dip the small potato ball into the slurry. Step 10: And coat in the breadcrumbs, making sure it's uniformly coated. Step 11: Now, deep-fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 12: Stir occasionally, until the aloo balls turn golden brown. Step 13: Drain off, and you can serve like a lollipop with a toothpick. Step 14: Finally, enjoy the Potato Lollipop Recipe, which tastes great when served with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: potato, fresh carrot, beans, brinjals, okra bhindi, bitter gourd, oil, butter, cumin jeera, bay leaf, dried fenugreek, onions, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt, tomato puree, aamchur, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, fry the vegetables till they turn crunchy and keep aside. Step 2: I have taken 1 potato, 1 carrot, 5 beans, 2 brinjal, 5 okra and ½ bitter gourd. Step 3: In a large tawa, heat 2 tsp oil, 1 tsp butter. Step 4: Add ½ tsp cumin, 1 bay leaf, ½ tsp kasuri methi till it turns aromatic. Step 5: Now add ½ onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute well. Step 6: Keeping the flame on low, add ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp salt. Step 7: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aroamtic. Step 8: Now add ½ cup tomato puree and saute until it is cooked well. Step 9: Further add fried vegetables, 1 tsp aamchur and mix well. Step 10: If required add 2 tbsp water and cook for a minute. Step 11: Now add 2 tbsp coriander and give a good mix. Step 12: Finally, enjoy tawa sabzi or veg tawa fry as a starter or with roti.

Ingredient Names: skirt steak, sweet onion, celery ribs, green onions, garlic cloves, canola oil, crushed red pepper flakes, cornstarch, soy sauce, szechuan sauce, hot chili sauce, sake, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Partially freeze beef and slice thinly against the grain. Step 2: Toss with corn starch, add soy, and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes Thinly slice onion, dice celery and mince garlic. Step 3: Combine all ingredients for sauce. Step 4: Heat wok over high heat until almost smoking. Step 5: Add pepper flakes if desired and oil. Step 6: Cook beef at a time until meat is medium, remove and set aside. Step 7: Add onion, celery to hot wok and stir-fry for 30 seconds, then add garlic and beef, toss together. Step 8: Add sauce and cook for 1 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Al's Beef And Spinach In Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, spinach, garlic cloves, oyster sauce, peanut oil, onions, green peppers, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the beef into thin narrow slices. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or large pan To test if the wok is hot enough drop in one small piece of onion It should sizzle on contact. Step 3: Add the onions and garlic. Step 4: Fry for two minutes. Step 5: Add the beef and fry for about 3 to 5 minutes Till the beef is just underdone. Step 6: Add the ginger and stir. Step 7: Add the peppers and spinach and stir well for about a minute.

Dish Name: Ants Creeping On The Trees Vermicelli Minced Pork Or Beef
Ingredient Names: vermicelli, oil, pork, dark soy sauce, chili paste with garlic, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the vermicelli in enough boiling water to cover it. Step 2: Let stand 20 minutes, drain. Step 3: Divide into thirds, set aside. Step 4: Heat oil in wok to 400f. Step 5: Stir fry the meat in the oil for about 1 minute. Step 6: Add vermicelli, and mix well. Step 7: Add the remaining ingredients, and cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, top sirloin steak, oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles, broccoli florets, carrot, mushroom, red bell pepper, water, ground ginger, snow peas, sliced water chestnuts, frozen peas, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet over medium-high heat, add the oil. Step 2: Cook the beef for 3 minutes. Step 3: Remove the meat and toss with one season packet from the noodles, set aside. Step 4: Add the broccoli, carrots, mushrooms, and red pepper and saut until almost cooked through, 8-10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Add water, ginger, noodles, and remaining season packet. Step 6: Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Step 7: Add the snow peas, water chestnuts, and peas. Step 8: Reduce the heat and simmer 5-7 minutes, or until the noodles are tender, stirring occasionally. Step 9: Add beef and scallions.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, cornstarch, vegetable oil, fresh ginger root, garlic, beef round steak, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl until smooth; set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Stir-fry ginger and garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add steak and stir-fry until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in snow peas and cook until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Pour in soy sauce mixture and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until sauce is thickened and smooth. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, garlic, red onion, ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, sesame seeds, leeks, carrot, beef round steak
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix together the soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, garlic, and red onion. Step 2: Stir in the black pepper, red pepper flakes, sesame seeds, leeks and carrot. Step 3: Mix in the meat by hand to ensure even coating. Step 4: Cover and let marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 5: Brush the bottom half of a wok with cooking oil, and heat over medium-high heat. Step 6: Put in all of the meat and marinade at once, and cook stirring constantly. Step 7: The meat will be cooked after just a few minutes. Step 8: Remove from heat and serve with rice or noodles. Step 9: For Korean-style fire meat, roll the meat mixture up in a leaf of red lettuce.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, water, rice vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, fresh ginger, dark sesame oil, nutmeg, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, flank steak, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 9 ingredients in a small bowl Reserve 1 / 4 cup hoisin mixture. Step 2: Spoon remaining mixture into a large zip-top plastic bag. Step 3: Add steak to bag Seal and marinate in refrigerator 24 hours, turning bag occasionally. Step 4: Remove steak from bag, discard marinade. Step 5: Prepare grill, grill pan or broiler to medium-high heat. Step 6: Place steak on rack coated with cooking spray. Step 7: Grill 4 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, cabbage, carrot, salt and pepper, garlic powder, egg roll wrap, egg, canola oil, grey poupon dijon mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the ground beef with the salt and pepper and garlic powder until the meat is completely browned. Step 2: Make sure to add a lot of the salt and pepper and garlic powder This needs to have a strong flavor because you'll be frying it with other ingredients Don't put so much in that you can't eat it, but you want to really taste it. Step 3: Once you are done getting the flavor right, get a large bowl and put the shredded cabbage and carrots in it and then add the ground beef on top. Step 4: Mix together completely and let sit for about 15 minutes I do that so the mixture will soften and i can roll them more easily. Step 5: Check the mixture after it sits to make sure the flavor is still there and really stands out If not, add more of the salt and pepper and garlic powder It's really up to your taste buds, but this is what i've done and i get rave reviews.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, cabbage, carrot, salt and pepper, garlic powder, egg roll wraps, egg, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees Brown ground beef with salt, pepper and garlic powder Use a lot of salt, pepper and garlic powder because the flavors will decrease when the meat is mixed with the cabbage and carrots. Step 2: After browning meat and getting the seasoning to the right taste place the cabbage and carrots in a very large mixing bowl. Step 3: Add the ground beef on top of the veggies. Step 4: Mix well and allow to sit for about 15 minutes This step allows the cabbage to soften for easier rolling and lets the flavors mix. Step 5: Taste the cabbage and see if the flavoring is still strong enough. Step 6: Add more salt, pepper and garlic powder until you get a taste you enjoy Crack the egg into a small bowl to make an egg wash to use when sealing the egg rolls.

Ingredient Names: beef rump, chinese five-spice powder, ready-cooked rice noodle, red chile, fat garlic, ginger, lemongrass, sunflower oil, sugar snap peas, baby corn diagonally, green onions diagonally, limes, soy sauce, fish sauce, peanuts, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the beef and five-spice in a bowl, then set aside to marinate. Soften the noodles in boiling water following pack instructions, drain then set aside. Thinly slice the red chilli, leaving the seeds if you prefer a little extra heat. Mix with the garlic, ginger and lemongrass in a small bowl. Heat half the oil in a wok, add the chilli mixture and stir-fry for 1 min until softened but not coloured. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside while you cook the beef. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil, add the beef and stir-fry over a high heat for 1 min until browned and just cooked through. Step 3: Return the chilli mixture to the pan with the sugar snaps, baby corn and half the spring onions. Stir-fry for 1 min more before adding the drained noodles. Mix to thoroughly combine, take off the heat and add a squeeze of lime juice, the soy sauce and fish sauce. Step 4: Divide between four plates. Scatter with the peanuts, garnish with remaining spring onions and chopped coriander.

Ingredient Names: bok choy, oil, garlic cloves, rump steak, soy sauce, sweet sherry, fresh basil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the bok choy and drain it. Step 2: Cut the leaves into thin strips. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan or wok. Step 4: Add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 5: Heat the remaining oil. Step 6: Add the meat in small batches and stir-fry for 3 minutes over high heat until the meat has browned but is not cooked through. Step 7: Remove the meat from the pan. Step 8: Stir-fry the bok choy for 30 seconds or until it is just wilted. Step 9: Add the meat, soy sauce and sherry Sir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until the meat is tender.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, light soy sauce, black pepper, sambal oelek, sesame oil, cornstarch, fresh broccoli, peanut oil, salt, water, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, mix together soy sauce, pepper, sambal oelek, sesame oil and corn starch. Step 2: Add sliced beef, coat well and let marinate for 15 minutes. Step 3: In a wok, heat 2 tablespoons of peanut oil until smoke begins to rise. Step 4: Add broccoli florets and salt, stir well. Step 5: Now add 1 / 2 cup of water, cover with a lid and cook on high heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until steam starts to escape from the edge of the lid. Step 6: Remove broccoli and any liquid to a bowl Reheat wok to high heat, add the remainder 2 tablespoons of peanut oil. Step 7: When hot, add garlic and brown for 1 minute, stirring often. Step 8: Add sliced beef and marinade and stir-fry until the color of meat changes, about 1 minute. Step 9: Return broccoli and liquid to the wok and mix.

Dish Name: Beef And Broccoli With Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: beef sirloin steak, cornstarch, sesame oil, low sodium chicken broth, vegetable oil, broccoli, carrot, onions, bok choy, yellow bell pepper, pepper, garlic, gingerroot, fish sauce, water chestnut
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from beef steak. Step 2: Cut beef lengthwise into 2 inch strips, and each strip cut crosswise into 1 / 8 inch slices In cup, mix cornstarch, sesame oil and broth, set aside. Step 3: Heat 12 inch skillet or wok until very hot. Step 4: Add vegetable oil Rotate skillet to coat bottom, add beef. Step 5: Stir fry 2 minutes or until beef is brown. Step 6: Remove beef from skillet, keep skillet hot.

Ingredient Names: skirt steaks, canola oil, sesame oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, bell pepper, oyster sauce, water, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cornstarch, apple juice, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients and pour over the steak in a dish, mix well, cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat the oils in a preheated wok / large frying pan, add garlic and ginger, stir fry for about a minute. Step 3: Add the pepper and stir fry for a minute or 2. Step 4: Add the steak and the marinade, stir fry for a further 5 minutes or until meat is cooked. Step 5: Add oyster sauce and water, cook until sauce is thickened, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, egg white, salt, soy sauce, sugar, sherry wine, cornstarch, oil, water, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef into very thin slices. Step 2: Mix together the next 5 ingredients, and marinate the beef in this mixture for 1 / 2 hour. Step 3: Heat a little oil in a frying pan and saute the beef mixture for 2 minutes. Step 4: Mix together the cornstarch, oil and water and add it to the beef mixture. Step 5: Cook until the cornstarch is clear, and set aside. Step 6: Saute the bean sprouts in a little hot oil for 2 minutes. Step 7: Mix with the beef and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: warm water, active dry yeast, sugar, bread flour, salt, eggs, vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, ground beef round, hoisin sauce, light soy sauce, paprika, ground red pepper, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare dough: in small bowl or 1-cup measuring cup, combine water, yeast, and 1 / 2 tablespoon sugar. Step 2: Stir to dissolve yeast. Step 3: Let stand until foamy -- about 5 minutes In medium-size bowl, combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour, the remaining 3 tablespoons sugar, and the salt. Step 4: Stir in yeast mixture, eggs, and oil, mixing until combined. Step 5: Turn dough out onto floured surface. Step 6: Knead dough, adding as much of remaining bread flour as necessary to prevent stickiness, until smooth and elastic -- about 8 minutes. Step 7: Wash, dry, and oil mixing bowl. Step 8: Place dough in bowl and turn to bring oiled side up. Step 9: Cover with clean cloth and let dough rise in warm place, away from drafts, until double in size -- about 1 1 / 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, canola oil, beef sirloin steak, onions, celery, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, sliced water chestnuts, sugar, cornstarch, beef broth, soy sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry cabbage in oil until cabbage begins to soften, add beef. Step 2: Cook and stir for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the onions and celery. Step 4: Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 5: Add the bean sprouts, bamboo shoots and water chestnuts. Step 6: In a small bowl, combine the sugar, cornstarch, broth and soy sauce until smooth. Step 7: Stir into beef mixture, bring to a boil. Step 8: Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened and vegetables are tender.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, oil, soy sauce, sugar, salt, cornstarch, pepper, onions, celery, carrots, fresh mushrooms, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, fresh ginger, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef into thin slices and marinate in a mixture of the next 6 ingredients for 10-15 minutes. Step 2: Heat a little oil and saute the onions& celery until onion is transparent, and set aside. Step 3: Stir-fry the carrots, mushrooms, sprouts and bamboo individually for 1 minute each & set aside. Step 4: Saute the ginger for 1 minute, add the cabbage and cook for another minute. Step 5: Add the rest of the vegetables, mix well and add a tsp of sugar and 2 tsp salt or salt and sugar to taste. Step 6: Remove vegetables and set aside. Step 7: Heat a little oil and saute the garlic. Step 8: Add the marinated beef and cook for 2 more minutes. Step 9: Mix together the remaining 4 ingredients and stir into the beef. Step 10: Cook until cornstarch is clear and pour beef over the vegetables.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, beef, spring onions, red capsicum, red chili peppers, bean sprouts, ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, cornflour, sesame oil, sugar, oil, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: First of all its important that you have your wok very hot, so make sure all ingredients are prepped and ready to go. Step 2: Combine 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cornflour, 1 chilli, garlic, ginger and marinate the meat for approximately 1 / 2 hour While the meat is marinating separate the noodles. Step 3: Heat approximately 1 tbsp of oil in the wok on a very high heat. Step 4: Add the capsicum strips and fry for a couple of minutes, remove from wok and set aside If needed add more oil as you go. Step 5: Add the meat and cook in batches until meat is nicely browned, remove from wok and set aside At this stage you may want to add more oil. Step 6: Add the rice noodles to fry, constantly stirring and keeping the heat as constant as possible to get that mildly charred effect on the noodles. Step 7: Return beef and capsicum to the work.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, garlic, fresh gingerroot, oil, boneless sirloin steak, onion, green pepper, red pepper, celery ribs, water, cornstarch, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and 2 t oil, add beef, toss to coat. Step 2: Chill for 15 minutes In wok heat remaining oil. Step 3: Stir-fry beef over med heat for 2 minutes. Step 4: Remove beef and set aside. Step 5: Stir-fry onion for 1 minute. Step 6: Add peppers and celery. Step 7: Stir-fry 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, cornstarch, gingerroot, sesame oil, garlic cloves, pepper, top sirloin steak, garlic scapes, hot red pepper, vegetable oil, salt, beef stock
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk first 6 ingredients together in a bowl. Step 2: Slice beef across the grain into thin strips, add to bowl& toss to coat. Step 3: Let stand for 15 minutes. Step 4: Cook garlic scapes in a pot of boiling salted water until tender-crisp, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Drain& refresh under cold water. Step 6: Drain again, pat dry& set aside Wearing rubber gloves, cut hot pepper in half lengthwise, deseed& finely slice. Step 7: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a wok or deep skillet over high heat. Step 8: Stir fry beef in batches, using remaining oil as necessary, until browned but still pink inside, about 2 minutes. Step 9: Transfer to a bowl.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice vinegar, potato starch, black pepper, oyster sauce, chicken broth, onion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate beef: stir the 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon rice vinegar, potato starch and black pepper in a medium bowl and add the beef. Step 2: Leave for 10 minutes Blanche the broccoli. Step 3: Heat large frying pan or wok until water sizzles instantly, or evaporates upon contact. Step 4: Add cooking oil and stir to coat. Step 5: Add beef, immediately spread beef out all over surface in single layer and leave for 1 minute. Step 6: Flip, add garlic for 30 seconds to 1 minute until no longer pink, pour on sauce. Step 7: Add broccoli and bring to a boil. Step 8: Pour in dissolved potato starch and cook, stirring the sauce for 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: round steak, oil, soy sauce, beef-flavor ramen noodles, frozen vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the steak strips in oil in a large skillet for 4 minutes or until it is brown. Step 2: Add soy sauce and seasoning packet from soup mix. Step 3: Add the vegetables. Step 4: Cook for 6 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Step 5: Prepare the noodles from the soup mix using directions from package, drain well. Step 6: Add the noodles to the steak and toss.

Ingredient Names: top round steak, fresh carrots, pea pods, fresh mushrooms, roasted peanuts, dry sherry, soy sauce, hot black bean sauce, black and red pepper blend, ginger, garlic, paprika, cooking oil, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut steak into bite-sized strips. Step 2: Steam carrots until tender. Step 3: Mix sherry, soy sauce, hot bean sauce and spices for sauce, set aside. Step 4: Preheat wok over high heat. Step 5: Heat cooking oil, then add chili oil. Step 6: Stir-fry carrots, pea pods and mushrooms until crisp-tender, remove from wok. Step 7: Stir-fry beef, push to side Warm sauce in center of wok. Step 8: Stir in vegetables and beef, add peanuts.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, hoisin sauce, ground bean sauce, soy sauce, seeds, curry powder, sugar, cooking sherry
Instructions: Step 1: Put beef in freezer for 20 minutes to harden. Step 2: Cut meat into 1 / 4-inch thick slices, 4 inches long, 2 inches wide. Step 3: Put on 6-inch bamboo skewers. Step 4: Mix flavorings together until smooth. Step 5: Pour over beef and marinate for at least 2 hours. Step 6: Heat fryolator or grill to 350f, cook 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rump steak, peanut oil, black bean paste, dry sherry, garlic clove, onion, beer, water, capsicum, baby corn, cornflour
