Instructions: Step 1: Mix marinade ingredients in a bowl, stir through steak cubes to coat well and marinate for 30-60 minutes For the sauce heat oil in a large saucepan and lightly saute the onion and garlic until soft. Step 2: Remove from heat, add all other sauce ingredients and mix well At this stage if you like you can place the sauce in the refrigerator for later. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or frypan and cook beef until done to your liking, it won't be cooked much further so make sure it is done but being cubed it doesn't take long to cook. Step 4: Return sauce to medium heat and stir until sauce starts to thicken. Step 5: Allow it to bubble but not boil hard, this step will take about 5 minutes. Step 6: Place cooked beef in the saucepan and warm through and mix for a few minutes. Step 7: Serve over cooked plain rice with generous lashings of the sauce.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, peanut oil, green onions, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, roasted cashews, cornstarch, soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce, chinese chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil- cook meat 3 to 5 minutes, remove from wok. Step 2: Heat remaining oil. Step 3: Add onions, garlic, ginger and cashews, cook 1 minute. Step 4: Return beef to wok. Step 5: Mix cornstarch with remaining ingredients and add to wok, stir until liquid boils and thickens.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, wine, sesame oil, ginger, cornstarch, oil, flank steak, fresh asparagus, carrot, fresh ginger, oyster sauce, sugar, beef stock
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together soy sauce, wine, sesame oil, ginger, cornstarch and oil for marinade. Step 2: Cut beef across the grain into 1 1 / 2 by 2 inch slices. Step 3: Marinate 2 hours Break off and discard tough ends of asparagus. Step 4: Cut diagonally into 1 1 / 2-2 inch lengths Peel and cut carrot into 1 / 2 inch rounds. Step 5: Heat oil in wok or skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add ginger and stif for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add beef to skillet and stir-fry till redness disappears, about 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes. Step 8: Remove and set aside.

Ingredient Names: green beans, flank steak, soy sauce, cornstarch, chinese rice wine, sugar, black pepper, peanut oil, water, ginger, onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl whisk together marinade ingredients. Step 2: Slice steak with the grain into 2-inch strips and then across the grain into 1 / 2 inch pieces and then add them to marinade, toss, and set aside. Step 3: Heat one tablespoon oil in wok over medium high heat until hot. Step 4: Add beans and stir for 1 minute. Step 5: Add water and reduce heat to medium. Step 6: Cover and cook for 5-10 minutes. Step 7: Transfer beans to bowl. Step 8: Add remaining oil to wok and increase heat to high. Step 9: Add ginger and stir until oil is hot and ginger sizzles. Step 10: Add onion and stir for one minute.

Ingredient Names: beef, cornstarch, egg white, soy sauce, sesame oil, sherry wine, oil, green peppers, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate beef in soy sauce, cornstarch, sherry, egg white, and sesame oil for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat 2 tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 3: Stir-fry green pepper and salt 2 minutes, remove from pan, set aside. Step 4: Heat 2 more tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot, add meat mixture. Step 5: Stir-fry 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef, onions, soy sauce, cornstarch, sherry wine, sesame oil, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate shredded beef in soy sauce, cornstarch, sherry, and sesame oil for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat 3 tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 3: Stir-fry onions until light brown, about 4 minutes, add salt, remove from pan, set aside. Step 4: Heat 3 more tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 5: Stir-fry beef 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cornflour, peanut oil, garlic cloves, ginger, red chile, filet of beef, onion, red capsicum, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oyster and soy sauces along with sesame oil, sugar and cornflour in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil in a wok Swirl to coat. Step 3: Add half the beef and stir fry until browned. Step 4: Remove and set aside. Step 5: Repeat with the remaining peanut oil and beef and remove and set aside. Step 6: Add garlic, ginger and chilli to the wok. Step 7: Cook for 30 seconds. Step 8: Add onion and capsicum and stir fry for 1 minute.

Dish Name: Beef With Rice Noodles Kway Teow
Ingredient Names: filet of beef, rice noodles, chinese chives, bean sprouts, canola oil, ginger, garlic cloves, soya sauce, chinese wine, oyster sauce, white sugar, cornflour, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Step 2: Mix the beef with all the seasoning ingredients except the sesame oil and canola oil. Step 3: Leave the beef to marinate for 20 minutes. Step 4: Then add the sesame and canola oil. Step 5: Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok, stir fry the chives and bean sprouts till they are slightly limp, set them aside. Step 6: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok Till hot and not smoking, saut the garlic till crispy and golden. Step 7: Add rice noodles and stir fry for about 4 minutes till lightly browned. Step 8: Set the noodles aside.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, chinese rice wine, cornstarch, black pepper, sirloin steak, oyster sauce, chicken broth, broccoli, oil, garlic, water
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the beef: Stir together the beef marinade ingredients (soy sauce, Chinese rice wine, cornstarch, black pepper) in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add the beef slices and stir until coated. Step 3: Let stand for 10 minutes. Step 4: Prepare the sauce: Stir together the sauce ingredients (oyster sauce, Chinese rice wine, soy sauce, chicken broth) in a small bowl, set aside. Step 5: Blanch or steam the broccoli: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Step 6: Add the broccoli and cook until crisp-tender, about 10 minutes, drain thoroughly. Step 7: Stir-fry the beef: Heat a large frying pan or wok over high heat until a bead of water sizzles and instantly evaporates upon contact. Step 8: Add the cooking oil and swirl to coat. Step 9: Add the beef and immediately spread it out all over the surface of the wok or pan in a single layer (preferably not touching). Step 10: Let the beef fry undisturbed for 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Flip the beef slices over, add the garlic to the pan, and fry for an additional 30 seconds to until no longer pink. Step 12: Add the sauce, cornstarch, and broccoli: Pour in the sauce and the cornstarch slurry (cornstarch dissolved in water). Step 13: Stir until the sauce boils and thickens, about 30 seconds. Step 14: Stir in the broccoli. Step 15: Serve immediately, with steamed rice or on its own.

Ingredient Names: beef broth, hoisin sauce, reduced-sodium soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce, cornstarch, brown sugar, new york strip steak, butter, frozen broccoli rice, garlic, salt, ground black pepper, toasted sesame seeds, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together beef broth, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce, cornstarch, and brown sugar in a bowl until cornstarch and sugar are dissolved. Step 2: Place sliced steak in a separate bowl and drizzle with remaining sesame oil. Step 3: Stir until evenly coated. Step 4: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add broccoli rice, garlic, salt, and pepper. Step 6: Cook for 5 minutes; stirring occasionally. Step 7: Divide broccoli rice into serving bowls. Step 8: Add beef to the skillet. Step 9: Cook over medium-high heat, stirring continually, for 5 minutes. Step 10: Pour sauce over beef and cook for 5 more minutes or until sauce has thickened. Step 11: Spoon beef over broccoli rice. Step 12: Garnish with sesame seeds and crushed red pepper.

Ingredient Names: dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, chinese cooking wine, white sugar, white pepper, sesame oil, eggs, oil, onions, garlic, ground beef ground beef, fresh carrots, day-old rice, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix Sauce ingredients in a small bowl, then set aside. Step 2: Scramble eggs - Heat sesame oil in a large wok or non-stick pan over medium high heat. Add egg and cook, stirring gently, so it is softly scrambled. Remove onto a plate. Step 3: Cook beef - Heat vegetable oil in the same pan over high heat. Add onion and garlic, cook for 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up as you go, for 2 minutes or until you no longer see raw beef. Add 2 tablespoons of sauce and cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Veg / caramelise beef - Add frozen vegetables and cook for 2 minutes or until the beef gets nicely caramelised - this is the trick to great flavour so do not shortcut this! Step 5: Rice & sauce - Add rice and remaining sauce. Toss for 2 minutes until the sauce is well dispersed throughout the rice and the rice grains start to caramelise a bit. Step 6: Egg & green onion - Then add scrambled eggs and green onion, give it a quick toss to disperse then divide between bowls. EAT!

Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, vegetable oil, beef rump steak, finger-tip length chunk ginger, spring greens, chestnut mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the sauces together and set aside. Heat a wok until smoking hot, add 1 tsp oil, then stir-fry the meat until browned all over. You may need to do this in 2 batches, adding a little more oil. Remove the meat, then wipe the wok clean. Step 2: Add a little more oil. Stir-fry the ginger until golden, then add the spring greens and mushrooms. Cook for 3 mins, stirring often, then add the steak and soy sauce mixture. Cook for 3-4 more mins until the sauce has thickened a little and everything is warmed through. Serve over rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chinese cabbage, carrot, onion, egg, soy sauce, vegetable oil, sugar, salt, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together beef, cabbage, carrot, and onion in a large bowl. Step 2: Stir in egg, soy sauce, oil, sugar, and salt. Step 3: Place 1 heaping teaspoon filling in the center of a wonton wrapper. Step 4: Moisten wonton edges with a few drops water. Step 5: Fold dumpling in half and pinch the edges together to seal. Step 6: Create a ripple pattern along the sealed edge by pinching and gently pushing together small segments. Step 7: Repeat to make remaining dumplings. Step 8: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 9: Add dumplings and cook until they float to the surface, about 5 minutes, drain.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, cornstarch, oil, egg, salt, water, sugar, hoisin sauce, ponzu sauce, white vinegar, sambal oelek, vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, whisk together all marinade ingredients. Step 2: Place marinade in a small sealable plastic bag, adding beef slices Seal and massage to coat. Step 3: Marinate for 15 minutes In the meantime, in a small bowl mix all the sauce ingredients together, whisking to completely combine, set aside. Step 4: Drain marinade from beef Coat the beef slices with cornstarch. Step 5: Heat oil over medium-high heat until very hot Shake off any excess cornstarch from the beef slices and fry in batches until golden brown.

Dish Name: Beijing Beef Recipe Like Panda Express
Ingredient Names: flank steak, cornstarch, oil, egg, salt, water, garlic cloves, shallot, chili peppers, sugar, ketchup, vinegar, chili sauce, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef into thin strips against the grain. Step 2: In a bowl combine marinade and refrigerate at least 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat ingredients for sauce and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add 1 tablespoon corn starch then simmer Coat beef with 6 tablespoons cornstarch, shake off excess Quickly deep fry in wok, remove to paper towel and remove all except 2 tablespoons oil. Step 5: Add garlic shallot and peppers, stir in beef. Step 6: Pour sauce into the wok and heat until boiling Quickly stir and serve.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, oil, green peppers, water, onion soup mix, soy sauce, sherry wine, salt, pepper, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cut steak lengthwise in 1 / 2 inch strips. Step 2: Heat oil in lg skillet. Step 3: Fry steak a handful at a time only long enough to change color. Step 4: Remove steak from skillet. Step 5: Saute the green peppers. Step 6: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in dutch oven. Step 7: Add onion soup mix and boil for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add steak and peppers. Step 9: Simmer for 1 / 2 hour. Step 10: Add soy sauce, salt, pepper and wine.

Dish Name: Bitter Melon and Black Bean Sauce Beef
Ingredient Names: bitter melon, soy sauce, cornstarch, baking soda, beef, oil, onion, garlic, fresh ginger, black bean sauce, oyster sauce, white sugar, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large bowl with ice; add enough salted water to make an ice bath. Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Add bitter melon and cook uncovered until tender yet firm, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Drain in a colander and immediately immerse in ice bath; allow to sit until bitterness is extracted, about 5 minutes, drain. Step 5: Whisk soy sauce, cornstarch, and baking soda together in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Step 6: Add beef and toss to evenly coat. Step 7: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Step 8: Heat wok or a large skillet on high until smoking, add oil. Step 9: Add beef to wok in a single layer; cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 10: Transfer beef to a plate, heat oil in wok. Step 11: Add onion, garlic, and ginger; cook and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 12: Stir in bitter melon; cook until combined, about 5 minutes. Step 13: Stir black bean sauce into melon mixture, then stir in oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce, and sugar. Step 14: Pour in water; cover and let simmer until flavors combine, 2 to. Step 15: Meanwhile, whisk remaining cornstarch and water together; stir in until sauce thickened.

Ingredient Names: eggs, allspice, msg, salt, pepper, dark soya sauce, garlic powder, fine cracker crumb, ribs
Instructions: Step 1: Stir first seven ingredients together and pour over ribs. Step 2: Marinate in fridge overnite mixing occasionally. Step 3: Dip in fine cracker crumbs Deep fry approx 5 minutes Prep time includes marinading overnite Time approximate- probably few hours sufficient too!

Ingredient Names: spareribs, allspice, salt, eggs, msg, soya sauce, flour, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Mix spareribs, allspice, salt, eggs, msg and soya sauce together. Step 2: Marinate for 2 to 4 hours. Step 3: Mix together flour and crumbs. Step 4: Put ribs into flour mixture and mix until well covered Deep fry 2 or 3 minutes if freezing or 4 to 5 minutes if eating right away.

Ingredient Names: boneless round steak, garlic powder, ground ginger, onion powder, frozen broccoli florets, soy sauce, cornstarch, water, rice vinegar, brown sugar, vegetable oil, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine garlic powder, ground ginger, & onion powder, add beef and toss. Step 2: Put into quart sized freezer bag. Step 3: Put frozen broccoli into separate freezer bag. Step 4: In a quart sized freezer bag combine soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, cornstarch & water until smooth Seal bags tightly, lay flat on cookie sheets, and freeze everything To cook from frozen: Defrost everything overnight in the fridge Half hour before cooking, take everything out of the fridge so it can completely defrost. Step 5: In a large skillet or wok, over medium-high heat, stir-fry beef in your choice of oil until beef reaches desired doneness.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce leaves, vegetable oil, garlic clove, red capsicum, beef sausages, plum sauce, chili sauce, soy sauce, brown lentils, spring onions, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, spring onion, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the lettuce leaves into cup shapes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Step 3: Add the garlic and capsicum. Step 4: Cook, stirring occasionally, until almost soft Snip one end of the sausages with the kitchen scissors. Step 5: Squeeze out 1cm lengths of meat from each sausage into the pan. Step 6: Cook, stirring, until browned and cooked through Reserve the rest of the sausages for use in another dish. Step 7: Add the combined sauces, brown lentils and spring onions. Step 8: Stir over the heat until the lentils are hot.

Ingredient Names: rump steak, plum sauce, soy sauce, garlic clove, fresh ginger, red chile, sugar, dry sherry, cornflour, oil, water, beef stock cube
Instructions: Step 1: Trim beef, slice thinly. Step 2: Combine beef, sauces, garlic, ginger, chilli, sugar, sherry and cornflour in a large bowl. Step 3: Cover, marinate for 30 minutes or overnight. Step 4: Drain beef and reserve marinade. Step 5: Heat a little oil in a wok, add beef in batches, stir-fry until browned. Step 6: Remove from wok as each batch is cooked. Step 7: Repeat with remaining oil and beef. Step 8: Return beef to wok with reserved marinade, blended extra cornflour and water and the stock cube. Step 9: Stir until mixture boils and thickens, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, ginger, red chile, green onions, sirloin steaks, sunflower oil, pak choi, egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Place the stock, ginger, chilli and spring onions in a large saucepan and bring to the boil. Meanwhile, heat a griddle pan until very hot and brush the steak with the oil. Griddle the steak for 2 mins each side for medium-rare. Transfer to a chopping board and leave to rest for 1 min, then thinly slice. Step 2: Add the pak choi to the stock, then the noodles, bring to the boil and simmer for 3 mins until tender. Ladle the stock, noodles and pak choi into large serving bowls and top with thin slices of steak.

Dish Name: Chinese Beef And Asparagus With Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: asparagus, flank steak, peanut oil, soy sauce, fresh ginger, dry sherry, cornstarch, garlic cloves, fermented black beans, salt, sugar, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the asparagus by washing, breaking the stem at the "natural" break point and slice diagonally into 1 / 2 to 1 inch pieces, put aside. Step 2: Combine the marinade ingredients in a small bowl then add the sliced meat. Step 3: Mix well and let sit for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally if you wish Head a wok or large frying pan, add the oil. Step 4: When it is is just beginning to smoke, add the meat, laying each piece on one side in the pan, do not turn but cook over high heat for a moment, until the one side begins to brown. Step 5: Toss-stir the meat for a moment and remove from the pan, allowing the oil to drain back into the pan You may want to do this in two batches to keep the meat sizzling. Step 6: Heat the pan to hot again and add the garlic. Step 7: Stir-fry for a minute then add the rinsed, chopped black beans and stirfry another bit.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, frozen broccoli, garlic clove, fresh ginger, peanut oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the steak against the grain into very thin slices. Step 2: Combine the soy sauce, sherry, and cornstarch and pour this mixture over the steak. Step 3: Marinate the meat for 15 minutes While the meat is marinating, slice the broccoli at a diagonal and mince garlic and ginger. Step 4: Heat a wok or large frying pan for 30 seconds, add oil, wait about 20 seconds, and add minced garlic and ginger root. Step 5: Fry over high heat, stirring constantly for about 20 seconds more, then add the beef. Step 6: Stir-fry, stirring constantly, for about 1 minute. Step 7: Add broccoli and stir-fry for another 4 to 6 minutes, until the broccoli is cooked but still crisp and still dark green. Step 8: Serve hot This is low in carbohydrates.

Dish Name: Chinese Beef And Mango Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: steak, broccoli florets, fresh mango, corn oil, cornstarch, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, chili powder, triple sec, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and triple sec in a large bowl an mix well. Step 2: Add meat, combine and coat. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours. Step 4: Drain meat, reserving marinade. Step 5: Add cornstarch to reserved marinated and mix until blended, set aside. Step 6: Add oil to a large wok or skillet and bring to medium heat. Step 7: Stir fry steak for 3 minutes or until almost cooked through. Step 8: Add broccoli and stir fry for another 3 minutes, or until tender. Step 9: Add reserved marinade and mango and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: round steak, soup, soy sauce, ground ginger, green onion, cornstarch, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, bean sprouts, frozen chinese pea pods
Instructions: Step 1: Combine steak in crock pot with the consomm, soy sauce, ginger, and onion. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 5-7 hours. Step 3: Turn control to high. Step 4: Stir in cornstarch that has been dissolved in 2 tablespoons of cold water. Step 5: Cook on high for 15 minutes or until thickened During last five minutes of cooking, add water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, bean sprouts and pea pods. Step 6: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: napa cabbage, green bell pepper, sliced mushrooms, scallions, sliced water chestnuts, beef top round steak, dry sherry, soy sauce, water, hoisin sauce, chili paste with garlic, garlic powder, garlic pepper seasoning, cornstarch, frozen cut green beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a 3 and 1 / 2 or 4 quart slow cooker, mix togther the cabbage, green pepper, mushrooms, scallions, water chestnuts and beef. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix together 2 t each of the sherry and soy sauce, the water, hoisin sauce, chili paste with garlic, and garlic powder. Step 3: Pour over the beef and vegetables in the pot. Step 4: Sprinkle with the garlic pepper. Step 5: Cover and cook on the low heat setting 5 and 1 / 2 to 6 hours In small bowl or cup, mix together the cornstarch and remaining 2 t sherry and 1 t soy sauce Increase the heat setting to high. Step 6: Stir in the cornstarch mixture. Step 7: Place the cover slightly ajar and cook on high 1 / 2 hour, stirring once or twice until the sauce clears and thickens slightly. Step 8: Stir in the green beans and red pepper and cook 5-10 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: boneless lean beef, water, soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, salt, star anise, cinnamon sticks, fresh ginger, green onions, dried hot chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meat lengthwise into long strips about 3 inches thick and wide. Step 2: Place in a wide frying pan with the water, soy, sherry, sugar, salt, star anise, ginger, onions and chile peppers. Step 3: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer turning meat occasionally for 30 minutes. Step 4: Remove meat from cooking liquid, cool, and chill for at least 1 hour or until firm Thinly slice meat across the grain. Step 5: Return meat slices to cooking liquid. Step 6: Cook, uncovered, over medium heat, turning slices occasionally until all liquid is absorbed turn meat more frequently as liquid is absorbed. Step 7: Discard onion, ginger, and star anise. Step 8: Arrange strips of meat slightly apart in a single layer on cooky sheets. Step 9: Bake, uncovered, in a 300 degree f oven until dry to the touch but still pliable pat dry any beads of oil with paper towels, let cool thoroughly.

Dish Name: Chinese Beef Or Pork Stew Red Cooked Meat
Ingredient Names: stewing beef, oil, vegetables, yellow onion, garlic, fresh ginger, star anise, orange rind, chile, brown sugar, soy sauce, dry sherry, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Staranise comes in the form of an eight point star, each point having an anise seed in it Most of them are broken up so use a total of eight points, more or less, to taste Theorange peel has a slightly bitter taste that i like better with beef but this is personal taste It comes in plastic bags and has a long shelf life Start by browning the meat in a few t of oil Do it in batches so it gets well caramelized. Step 2: When the last of the meat is well browned, remove it all to a bowl. Step 3: Add the onion, garlic, ginger, anise, orange peel and chiles to the wok. Step 4: Keep cooking, stirring frequently, until the onion starts to brown.

Dish Name: Chinese Beef Stir Fry Over Golden Pancake
Ingredient Names: dry sherry, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic, ginger, sirloin, chicken broth, oyster sauce, chili-garlic sauce, white pepper, sesame oil, chinese egg noodles, onion, asparagus
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate beef. Step 2: Stir sherry, soy, cornstarch, garlic and ginger. Step 3: Toss beef to marinate Sauce: stir fry chicken broth, oyster sauce, chili garlic sauce, cornstarch, pepper and sesame oil together, set aside. Step 4: Cook noodles in large pot, according to directions. Step 5: Drain, rinse under cool water, drain again. Step 6: Heat skillet over medium high heat. Step 7: Add 1 t of oil and coat. Step 8: Spread noodles evenly and cook, pressing lightly from time to time to form a cake, until bottom is golden brown, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, salt, egg white, cornstarch, oil, onions, cooking sherry, sugar, soy sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, salt, egg white and cornstarch. Step 2: Mix well with hand. Step 3: Heat oil Deep-fry beef until it is seared. Step 4: Drain Reheat 2 tablespoons of oil. Step 5: Add onion and stir-fry until soft and well browned, about 20 minutes. Step 6: Add beef, sherry, sugar and soy sauce. Step 7: Stir-fry 1 minute, until beef is glazed and brown, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: egg noodles, lean beef, garlic, salt, ginger, five-spice powder, oil, soy sauce, duck broth, cornstarch, water, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles in salted boiling water just until tender. Step 2: Drain, and rinse under cold water. Step 3: Cut the beef into very thin slices. Step 4: Mix together the garlic, salt, ginger, and five-spice powder, and add the mixture to the beef, mix. Step 5: Heat the oil and saute the beef over high heat for 2 minutes. Step 6: Mix together the soy sauce and broth, and add it to the beef, bring to a boil. Step 7: Mix the cornstarch with the remaining 4 tsp water, stir into the beef and cook until smooth and thick. Step 8: Add noodles, mix well and heat thoroughly.

Dish Name: Chinese Braised Beef And Potato Stew
Ingredient Names: water, beef, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, leeks, boiling water, star anise, lard, soy sauce, potato, carrots, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a sauce pan that has a lid, bring water to a boil, add meat, bring back to a boil, then turn off and let stand while you prepare the vegetables. Step 2: Prepare ginger, garlic, and leek or onion. Step 3: Discard water off the beef, and add enough boiling water to almost cover the meat, along with anise, ginger, and leek or onion. Step 4: Heat an empty wok over high heat, add lard or oil, heat and swirl in pan, then add garlic and stir quickly for a moment until the fragrance rises from the oil. Step 5: Then add soy sauce and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add soy sauce mixture to the saucepan with the beef, cover the dish, and braise for an hour or more, stirring occasionally, and discarding water that has condensed under the lid While the meat and vegetables cook, peel and cut up the carrots and potatoes Twenty to forty minutes before serving, add the carrots and potatoes and salt and pepper. Step 7: When the potatoes are cooked through and the sauce is just starting to thicken naturally from the potato starch, the dish is prepared In north china, this stew is served with thick, chewy, crusty flat bread.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cinnamon sticks, scallions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, anise seeds, chili paste, water, low sodium chicken broth, soy sauce, rice vinegar, boneless beef chuck, fresh udon noodles, bok choy, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef chuck into 3 / 4 in thick chunks if you did not purchase precut stewing beef. Step 2: Heat the oil in a heavy soup pot or dutch oven over medium heat. Step 3: When very hot, add the cinnamon, scallions, garlic, ginger, anise seeds, and chile paste. Step 4: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the water, broth, soy sauce, and vinegar. Step 6: Bring to boil over high heat. Step 7: Add the meat and bring to vigorous simmer. Step 8: Lower the heat to maintain a gentle simmer and cook, partially covered, until the meat is very tender, about 1 1 / 2 hours, checking to be sure that the soup doesn''t boil or stop simmering Shortly before the soup is done, bring a large pot of water to boil. Step 9: Cook the noodles according to package directions until just tender.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, boneless beef shank, rice wine, dark soy sauce, soy sauce, water, cinnamon sticks, star anise, szechuan peppercorns, granulated sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add beef shanks and brown briefly. Step 4: Stir-fry about 1 minute. Step 5: Add rice wine, soy sauces, water, cinnamon, star anise, and sichuan peppercorns, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2 hours. Step 7: Check and add liquid if needed, stir in sugar. Step 8: Simmer an additional 10 minutes or until beef is tender.

Ingredient Names: steak, potatoes, onions, curry powder, chicken stock cubes, oil, satay sauce, chinese chili sauce, soy sauce, water, sherry wine, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Slice steak thinly across the grain Peel potatoes and cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes Peel onions, cut into quarters and separate each layer. Step 2: Heat oil in pan or wok, add potatoes, cook 5mins or until just tender but still crisp, tossing occasionally. Step 3: Add onions and curry powder, cook further 2 minutes, remove from pan. Step 4: Heat extra oil in pan, add steak, cook until golden brown on both sides and cooked through. Step 5: Add potatoes, onion and extra curry powder. Step 6: Toss for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add combined sate sauce, chilie sauce, soy sauce, water, stock cube, cornflour and sherry. Step 8: Toss until sauce boils and thickens.

Dish Name: Chinese Five Spice Short Ribs Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: onion, short rib of beef, garlic salt, black pepper, vegetable oil, beef broth, stewed tomatoes, onion soup mix, chinese five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the onion and put it into a slow cooker. Step 2: Season the short ribs with garlic salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat Working in batches, brown all sides of the short ribs. Step 4: When browned, place in slow cooker on top of sliced onions. Step 5: In a mixing bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Step 6: Pour over the top of short ribs. Step 7: Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours.

Ingredient Names: beef, cornstarch, salt, sugar, sherry wine, soy sauce, msg, greens, bamboo shoots, oil, dried chinese mushrooms, garlic clove, water
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate beef in cornstarch, salt, sugar, sherry, soy sauce and msg for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat 2 tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 3: Stir-fry garlic until brown. Step 4: Add chinese greens, bamboo shoots, and mushrooms. Step 5: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 6: Add water and cook 1 minute more. Step 7: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 8: Heat 2 tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steaks, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic clove, orange, dark soy sauce, scallion, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the steak in a little cornstarch. Step 2: Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick frying pan. Step 3: Stir-fry beef strips in small batches for about 2 minutes, until browned. Step 4: Remove the beef and set aside. Step 5: Add the garlic, orange juice and soy sauce and bring to the boil. Step 6: Return the beef to the pan, add the scallions and heat through. Step 7: Meanwhile, cook the noodles in a large pan of boiling water following packet instructions. Step 8: Serve the beef on a bed of piping-hot cooked noodles.

Dish Name: Chinese Pot Roast Diabetic Crock Pot Recipe
Ingredient Names: pot roast, flour, canola oil, onions, light soy sauce, water, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Dip roast in flour and brown on both sides in oil in a saucepan. Step 2: Place meat in slow cooker and top with onions. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, water and ginger and pour over the meat. Step 4: Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and cook for 8-10 hours. Step 6: Slice and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: beef short ribs, salt and pepper, vegetable oil, onion, ginger, garlic clove, all-purpose flour, low sodium soy sauce, low sodium beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Season ribs with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add half of ribs. Step 3: Cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to a slow cooker. Step 5: Repeat with remaining ribs. Step 6: Add onion, ginger and garlic to skillet. Step 7: Cook over medium heat, stirring, until onion is slightly softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes. Step 9: Add soy sauce and broth Increase heat to high and bring to a simmer, stirring to pick up browned bits.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, top sirloin steaks, ground pepper, garlic salt, beef broth, onion soup mix, diced tomatoes, five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Slice onion and put on bottom of crock pot. Step 2: Season the steak with pepper and garlic salt. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet and lightly brown the steak. Step 4: When done, place steak on onions in crock pot. Step 5: In a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Step 6: Pour over top of steak. Step 7: Cook 4-6 hours depending on your crock pot or until steak is tender. Step 8: Serve over noodles or rice.

Dish Name: Chinese Style Braised Beef One Pot
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, scallions, red chili pepper, stewing beef, all-purpose flour, salt and pepper, chinese five spice powder, star anise, light brown sugar, chinese wine, dark soy sauce, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large, shallow casserole. Step 2: Fry the garlic, ginger, scallions and chili for 3 mins until soft and fragrant. Step 3: Toss the beef in the flour, add 1 tbsp more oil to the pan, then brown the meat in batches, adding more oil if you need to It should take about 5 mins to brown each batch properly. Step 4: Add the five-spice and star anise to the pan, Add the sugar, then the beef and stir until combined. Step 5: Keep the heat high, then splash in the wine or sherry, scraping up any meaty bits, heat oven to 300f. Step 6: Pour in the soy and broth, bring to a simmer, then tightly cover, transfer to the oven and cook for 1-2 hrs, stirring the meat halfway through The meat should be very soft, and any sinewy bits should have melted away.

Dish Name: Chinese Style Stuffed Green Bell Peppers
Ingredient Names: onion, fresh mushrooms, egg, lean ground beef, green peppers, oil, sugar, salt, cornflour, sherry wine, thin soy sauce, pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Dice onion and mushrooms and beat egg. Step 2: Place the ground beef in a mixing bowl and marinate for 5 minutes with sherry, salt, pepper, sugar, thin soya sauce, cornflour and oil, mix well. Step 3: Add the onions, mushrooms and beaten egg and mix well. Step 4: Cut the peppers lengthwise in halves, and remove core and seeds and wash. Step 5: Stuff each half firmly with meat mixture. Step 6: Heat a little oil in wok or frying pan, then add the peppers meat side down. Step 7: Sprinkle with a little salt, cover and cook about 5-8 minutes on medium heat. Step 8: Turn over and cook green side for another 5mins. Step 9: Remove and set aside on a warm serving dish.

Ingredient Names: lean hamburger, bean sprouts, sliced water chestnuts, celery, onion, low sodium soy sauce, cream of mushroom soup, water, chow mein noodles, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Lightly brown hamburger and drain off excess fat. Step 2: Add pepper, onion and celery plus enough water to cover. Step 3: Simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Add sprouts, water chestnuts and canned soup plus one soup can of water Should be a little thin, as it will thicken upon baking. Step 5: Add soy sauce and pour mixture into 2 -3 qt, casserole. Step 6: Bake 25 - 30 minutes Served over noodles.

Dish Name: Chow Mein In The Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: round steak, celery, onion, garlic clove, beef broth, tamari soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, chinese vegetables, cornstarch, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients except chinese vegetables and corn starch to crock pot. Step 2: Cook on low for 7 hours. Step 3: Add chinese vegetables and corn starch to crock pot and mix well. Step 4: Cook on low for 1 more hour. Step 5: Serve on top of chow mein or low mein noodles Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, light soy sauce, sherry wine, fresh ginger, peanut oil, garlic cloves, green onions, hoisin sauce, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade the meat in the soy, wine and ginger, mix well and sit for 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain the marinade well and separate the meat slices into individual slices. Step 3: In a wok heat the oil to 375f. Step 4: Add the meat all at once. Step 5: Stir a bit to separate. Step 6: Remove after 1 minute and allow the meat to drain well Empty out the oil, reserve for another use Wipe wok with paper towels. Step 7: Heat wok again and add the tbsp oil for chowing. Step 8: Add garlic and green onions, chow for a moment.

Ingredient Names: oranges, dry sherry, soy sauce, fresh ginger, boneless beef roast, cornstarch, salad oil, celery, fresh bean sprout, fresh snow pea
Instructions: Step 1: Grate peel from one of the oranges. Step 2: Squeeze juice from both oranges into a bowl, add grated peel, sherry, soy sauce, and ginger. Step 3: Slice meat 1 / 8th inch thick across the grain, place in marinade. Step 4: Let meat marinate at least 5 minutes or cover and chill for 24 hours. Step 5: Remove beef from marinade before cooking and set aside. Step 6: Mix marinade with corn starch. Step 7: Heat wok or heavy frying pat to high heat, add 2 tsp Oil. Step 8: Stir fry meat quickly, in several small batches, until lightly browned. Step 9: Add more oil as needed.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic, soy sauce, beef bouillon, water, frozen chinese pea pods, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, mandarin orange segments, cornstarch, molasses
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir the meat, onion and garlic in a large skillet until the meat is brown. Step 2: Drain off the excess fat. Step 3: Mix the soy sauce, cornstarch, and molasses and stir this mixture into the meat mixture. Step 4: Stir in the bouillon, water, pea pods, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots and reserved mandarin orange syrup and heat to boiling. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Stir in the orange segments, recover and heat for about 2 minutes. Step 7: Serve over cooked rice with additional soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, cornflour, beef
Instructions: Step 1: Make the eggs, cornflour and salt into a batter Coat the strips of beef in this batter. Step 2: Turn the wok onto high heat and fry the beef for 2 minutes. Step 3: Serve with plum sauce or sweet and sour sauce or any sauce you desire.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Asian Shredded Beef Pork
Ingredient Names: boneless beef roast, gluten-free soy sauce, hoisin sauce, ketchup, honey, chinese five spice powder, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Use a 5 quart slow cooker Trim any visible fat from the meat, and plop it into your stoneware My meat was fresh, but it's okay if your meat is still frozen. Step 2: Sprinkle the dried spices directly onto the meat, and top with the ketchup and honey. Step 3: Pour in the soy and hoisin sauces. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours, or until meat shreds easily with a fork You may need to take the meat out and cut in chunks after 8 hours, then turn to high for an hour or so to get it to shred nicely. Step 5: Serve over white or brown basmati rice, or over shredded cabbage.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Short Ribs With Hoisin Black Beans
Ingredient Names: beef short ribs, black beans, tomato sauce, hoisin sauce, onion, shallots, peri-peri, instant minced garlic, crystallized ginger, fennel seed, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: Brown your ribs. Step 2: Place all the ingredients except ribs& carrots in a crock pot, stir well. Step 3: Place browned ribs in crock pot. Step 4: Cover turn on high for 30 minutes. Step 5: Turn to low and cook 3 1 / 2 hours. Step 6: Add carrots cut into 3-inch pieces. Step 7: Turn heat to medium and allow about 45 minutes for the carrots to cook, serve.

Ingredient Names: beef, curry powder, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, sugar, oil, water, onions, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate beef in soy sauce, curry, sesame oil, cornstarch and sugar 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat 2 tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot, add onions. Step 3: Stir-fry until light brown, remove from pan, set aside. Step 4: Heat 2 more tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 5: Stir-fry meat mixture for 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, lean ground beef, garlic clove, onion, salt, ground black pepper, curry powder, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, breadcrumbs, egg, garam masala, turmeric, curry leaf, desiccated coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the meatball ingredients Form into small balls about the size of a walnut. Step 2: Heat wok and add peanut oil. Step 3: When hot, fry the meatballs until browned all over. Step 4: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper Carefully drain all but 1 teaspoon of oil, removing any black bits that may be leftover in the pan. Step 5: Fry the garam masala and turmeric for the broth for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add onion, curry leaves and garlic. Step 7: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, strain coconut in a sieve over a bowl, pressing out as much liquid as possible.

Ingredient Names: rib eye steaks, dark sesame oil, green onions, packaged cabbage carrot coleslaw mix, beef-flavor ramen noodles, water, low sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from steak; cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slice. Step 2: Heat 1 Tsp oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Add steak and green onions; stir fry 1 minute. Step 4: Remove steak mixture from skillet; keep warm. Step 5: Heat remaining 1 Tsp oil in skillet over medium high heat. Step 6: Add slaw; stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 7: Remove slaw from skillet and keep warm. Step 8: Remove noodles from packages; reserve 1 seasoning packet for another use. Step 9: Add water and remaining seasoning packet to skillet; bring to a boil. Step 10: Break noodles in half; add noodles to water mixture. Step 11: Cook noodles 2 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed, stirring frequently. Step 12: Stir in steak mixture, slaw, and soy sauce; cook until thoroughly heated.

Ingredient Names: beef rump steak, baking soda bi-carbonate soda, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chinese cooking wine, white sugar, sesame oil not untoasted, white pepper, cornstarch corn flour, water, peanut oil, garlic, onions, red capsicum bell pepper, carrots, bok choy, green onions, steamed white rice, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Tenderise beef 20 minutes, rinse, toss with 1.5 tbsp sauce. Mix in cornflour then water into Sauce. Stir fry in this order: onion + garlic > beef > carrot + capsicum + bok choy stems + green onion stems > sauce > wilt bok choy leaves + green onion. Serve! Step 2: Velvet beef - Place the beef in a bowl. Sprinkle the baking soda over then use your fingers to toss the beef to coat as evenly as possible. Set aside for 20 minutes (no longer). Step 3: Rinse the beef under tap water in a colander to remove baking soda. Shake and pat off excess water (doesn't need to dry fully, just don't want it soaking). Put in a bowl. Step 4: Sauce - Mix ingredients together. Measure out 1 1/2 tablespoons and use it to coat the beef. To the remaining sauce, mix in the cornflour until lump-free, then add the water. Step 5: Cook aromatics - Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over high heat. Add the onion and garlic, cook for 10 seconds. Step 6: Add the beef and cook until it changes colour from red to light brown but not cooked through. Step 7: Vegetables #1 - Add the capsicum, carrots, bok choy stems and white part of the green onions. Stir fry for 1 minute. Step 8: Add Sauce, then stir until it starts to bubble (it will thicken quickly). Step 9: Leafy vegetables - Add the bok choy leaves and green part of the green onions. Toss for another 30 seconds to 1 minute until they are just wilted, the sauce thickens and becomes glossy, coating everything nicely. Step 10: Serve immediately with rice - or for a low carb, low cal option, try Cauliflower Rice! Garnish with sesame seeds, if desired.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, salt, boneless sirloin steak, onion, celery, fresh snow peas, whole mushrooms, water chestnut, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, water, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet. Step 2: Add salt, then beef. Step 3: Cook, stirring often, over high heat to brown meat, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add onion, celery, snow peas, mushrooms, and water chestnuts Continue cooking over high heat, stirring constantly for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Cover, lower heat and simmer for about 3 minutes. Step 6: Combine cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce and water in small dish, mix well, add to skillet. Step 7: Cook stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: round steak, oil, onion, green pepper, au jus mix, water, soy sauce, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cook meat, onion, and pepper in oil until meat is browned Stir in remaining ingredients Cook and stir for 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: steak, salt, fresh ground black pepper, sesame oil, green onion, fresh ginger, oyster sauce, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the broiler, or light a fire in an open grill Rub the steak with the salt, pepper, and toasted sesame oil. Step 2: When the broiler is hot, or the coals are covered with gray ash, cook the steak on one side for 7 1 / 2 minutes. Step 3: Turn the steak over and cook the other side for another 7 1 / 2 minutes for medium-rare. Step 4: Allow the steak to rest for 10 minutes before slicing Just before you are ready to serve, combine the green onions, ginger, and oyster sauce. Step 5: Heat the oil in a small pan until it is smoking and pour this over the green onion mixture Ladle the mixture over the steak and serve at once.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, nests egg noodles, thumb-sized ginger, garlic, five-spice powder, chili powder, snow peas, beef stock, light soy sauce, sesame oil, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large non-stick frying pan or wok, then fry the beef for 10 mins until very well browned. Don’t add any oil. Meanwhile, boil the noodles following pack instructions, then drain. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic, five-spice, chilli powder and mangetout to the browned mince, then fry for a few mins more until fragrant and the pods are bright green. Splash in the stock, add the noodles, then season with the soy sauce. Pile into bowls (use tongs, it’s easier), sprinkling with the sesame oil and red chilli if using.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, water, cornstarch, white sugar, soy sauce, white wine, fresh ginger, boneless beef round steak, vegetable oil, broccoli florets, carrots, frozen pea pods, onion, water chestnuts, chinese cabbage, bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: Bring brown rice and water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, and liquid has been absorbed, 45 to. Step 3: Combine cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, and wine in a small bowl until smooth. Step 4: Stir in ginger; toss beef in sauce to coat. Step 5: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Cook and stir broccoli, carrots, pea pods, and onion for 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in water chestnuts, Chinese cabbage, and bok choy; cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Remove from skillet and keep warm. Step 9: In same skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 10: Cook and stir beef until desired degree of doneness, about 5 minutes per side for medium. Step 11: Return vegetables to skillet; cook and stir until heated through, about 3-4 minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, carrot, green bell pepper, garlic, green cabbage, frankfurters, instant chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In 9 or 10" nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, carrot, pepper and garlic. Step 3: Saute about 5 minutes or until onion is translucent. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, add cabbage, cover skillet. Step 5: Cook stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes or until cabbage wilts, add frankfurter. Step 6: Cook until heated through. Step 7: Meanwhile in measuring cup or small bowl stir broth, cornstarch and soy sauce until cornstarch dissolves.

Dish Name: French Onion Seafood Steak Soup Bowl By Sy
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, butter, yellow onions, shallots, fresh ginger, garlic, flour, dry sherry, beef stock, sesame oil, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, granulated sugar, thin egg noodles, french baguettes
Instructions: Step 1: For noodles, vegetables, topping: place noodles in boiling water and cook until 3 / 4 done, drain and set aside Toast french baguette / bread and set aside. Step 2: Cut swiss gruyere cheese into small but thick slices and slightly smaller then the toasted bread and set aside. Step 3: Cut mushrooms in half and set aside. Step 4: Cut tomatoes into thin pieces and set aside. Step 5: Add 2 tablespoon peanut / olive oil in a wok. Step 6: Add curry powder and cook for about 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Add the steak and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 8: Add the scallops and stir fry 1 minute. Step 9: Add the shrimps and stir fry 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: beef sirloin steak, dried minced onion, garlic, soy sauce, white rice, water, vegetable oil, bamboo shoots, mushrooms, green onion, green bell pepper, red pepper flakes, broccoli florets, sugar snap peas, cornstarch, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place steak in a bowl; top with minced onion, garlic, and soy sauce, stir to coat. Step 2: Bring rice and water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender, and the liquid has been absorbed, 20 to. Step 4: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir bamboo shoots, mushrooms, green onion, green bell pepper, red pepper flakes, and soy sauce in the hot oil until green bell pepper is slightly tender, 4 to. Step 5: Add steak, broccoli, and sugar snap peas; cook until beef is browned and no longer pink in the center, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Whisk cornstarch and water together in a bowl until cornstarch is dissolved. Step 7: Heat oyster sauce in a saucepan over medium-low heat; slowly stir in cornstarch mixture until sauce is thickened, 3 to. Step 8: Stir oyster sauce mixture into steak mixture; sprinkle with green onions. Step 9: Cook steak mixture until sauce is thickened, 7 to, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Ga Lei Se Dik Chinese Beefsteak In Curry Sauce
Ingredient Names: sugar, light soy sauce, oil, sirloin steaks, cornstarch, curry powder, chicken stock, garlic clove, gingerroot, salt, onion, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the sugar, soy sauce and 1 tbsp oil Use mixture to marinate the sliced beef for 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain the marinade from the beef and add the cornstarch, curry powder and chicken stock to the marinade Dry-heat wok or large skillet over high heat, then add 1 1 / 2 tbsp oil and use to stir-fry the garlic, ginger and salt until garlic and ginger are golden brown. Step 3: Add the marinated beef and brown quickly on outside, about 1 minute. Step 4: Remove to a bowl Clean wok or pan and heat it hot and dry again. Step 5: Add 1 1 / 2 tbps oil and stir-fry onion rings until golden brown. Step 6: Stir in the curry-marinade mixture and heat, stirring, until it thickens. Step 7: Return beef to the pan, mixing thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: steak, cornstarch, vegetable oil, water, minced garlic cloves, broccoli florets, yellow onion, soy sauce, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Slice steak into pieces 1" wide x 3" long x 1 / 8" thick If you are having difficulty getting the steak sliced thin enough, place it in the freezer for 30-60 minutes, long enough to firm the meat for easy slicing but not long enough to freeze solid. Step 2: Place sliced meat in a wide dish and sprinkle the 2 tablespoon portion of cornstarch on the steak, tossing it until the meat is evenly coated. Step 3: In a bowl, combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, and the 1 tablespoon portion of soy sauce with a fork The cornstarch will settle to the bottom before you've used this solution so leave the fork in the bowl so you can re-incorporate it right before adding to the pan. Step 4: Heat a large skillet, wok, or dutch oven over medium-high to high heat. Step 5: When the pan is hot add the first tablespoon of vegetable oil, swirl to coat the bottom of the pan, and immediately add the meat, separating the pieces so they form a single layer on the bottom of the pan Sear for 3-4 minutes, tossing to keep the meat from burning to the bottom of the pan. Step 6: When the meat has browned and is cooked to your desired doneness, remove from the pan and put on the receiving dish. Step 7: Add the second tablespoon of vegetable oil, swirl to coat the bottom, and add the garlic, onion, and broccoli.

Ingredient Names: beef, cornstarch, sherry wine, egg white, sesame oil, msg, soy sauce, sugar, oil, green onions, ginger, water
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate meat in cornstarch, sherry, egg white, sesame oil, msg, soy sauce and sugar for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat oil in frying pan until hot. Step 3: Stir-fry green onions and ginger for 1 minute. Step 4: Add meat mixture and stir-fry for 5 more minutes. Step 5: Add water and cook for 1 more minute, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, eggs, cornstarch, water, oil, carrot, green onion, fresh ginger, garlic, soy sauce, wine, white vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the steak while partially frozen into narrow strips Defrost the meat completely and squeeze out any excess water in the beef strips. Step 2: In a bowl, mix together the beef strips and beaten eggs Dissolve the cornstarch in 1 / 2 cup water, and mix with beef / egg mixture. Step 3: Pour in about 3-4 tablespoons of oil in a wok until very hot, but not smoking. Step 4: Add half of the beef to the oil Separate with a fork, and cook, stirring occasionally until crispy, transfer to a plate. Step 5: Repeat with the remaining beef. Step 6: Remove the beef, set aside and drain oil Up to this point, the beef can be prepared well in advance.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, beef consomme, soy sauce, fresh ginger, garlic clove, green onion, cornstarch, water, sugar snap pea, fresh bean sprouts, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice flank steak diagonally across the grain. Step 2: In a slow cooker, combine steak, consomme, soy sauce, ginger, onions, and garlic. Step 3: Cover and cook on low 5-6 hours or until steak is tender. Step 4: Turn control to high Dissolve cornstarch in water in a small bowl and stir into cooker. Step 5: Cover and cook on high 10-15 minutes or until thickened During the last 5 minutes, drop in vegetables and re-cover, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, garlic, fresh gingerroot, scallions, light soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, dry sherry, salt, pepper, hot sauce, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Works well with chicken or pork too Score the steak by making xs with a sharp knife. Step 2: Marinate at least 3 hours. Step 3: Grill to the desired degree of doneness. Step 4: Slice and serve with potatoes or rice and a salad Hint: when using flank or skirt steak make sure you slice against the grain or it will be too tough to eat!

Dish Name: Grilled Or Broiled Asian Flank Steak
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, lime juice, of fresh mint, low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, fresh ginger, jalapeno, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from steak. Step 2: Combine steak and remaining ingredients in a large zip-loc bag Seal bag and marinate in refrigerator for 8-12 hours Spray grill or broiler with non-stick coating. Step 3: Remove steak from bag, and discard marinade. Step 4: Place steak on grill rack or broiler pan. Step 5: Cook 8 minutes on each side, or until desired degree of doneness. Step 6: Let steak sit 5 minutes or longer, then cut diagonally across grain into thin slices.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, celery, mushroom, bell pepper, beef broth, soya sauce, macaroni
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, brown meat. Step 2: Add onions, garlic and celery. Step 3: Cook until vegetables have softened. Step 4: Add mushrooms and green pepper. Step 5: Let simmer another 5 minutes. Step 6: Add beef broth, soya sauce and macaroni. Step 7: Cover and cook until macaroni is tender.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, celery, bean sprouts, sliced water chestnuts, mushroom stems and pieces, beef broth, diced pimentos, soy sauce, fresh ginger, cornstarch, water, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Brown and drain ground beef. Step 2: Add celery, bean sprouts, water chestnuts, mushrooms, broth, pimientos, soy sauce and ginger. Step 3: Heat over medium heat and mix well. Step 4: In a small bowl or jar, mix cornstarch and water until smooth. Step 5: Stir cornstarch mixture into beef mixture. Step 6: Cook until it is bubbly and slightly thickened. Step 7: Serve over chow mein noodles or cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: hamburger, celery, onion, boiling water, rice, salt, chicken and rice soup, mushrooms, brown sugar, soy sauce, butter, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir hamburger, celery and onion until hamburger is light brown, then drain. Step 2: Pour water on rice and add salt in greased 2qt casserole. Step 3: Stir in hamburger, soup, mushrooms, sugar, soy sauce and margarine. Step 4: Cover and cook in 350f oven for 30 min, stir. Step 5: Cook uncovered for 30 min longer. Step 6: Stir in noodles, serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, green onions, celery ribs, bean sprouts, fresh mushrooms, red bell pepper, gingerroot, cooked rice, soy sauce, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef in large skillet, drain. Step 2: Stir in onions, celery, bean sprouts, mushrooms, red bell pepper and gingerroot. Step 3: Cook over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring frequently. Step 4: Stir in rice and soy sauce. Step 5: Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Step 6: Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: shortening, ground beef, onion, celery, hot water, salt, ground black pepper, bean sprouts, water, cornstarch, soy sauce, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat shortening in a large, deep skillet Sear ground beef until it cooks through. Step 2: Then add onion and saute for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add celery, hot water, salt and pepper. Step 4: Cover skillet and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add sprouts and heat to boiling. Step 6: In a small bowl combine the cold water, cornstarch, soy sauce and sugar. Step 7: Mix together and add to skillet mixture. Step 8: Cook for 5 minutes, or until thickened to taste.

Dish Name: Healthy Beef And Broccoli Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh ginger, scallions, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, orange zest, sirloin steak, broccoli, red bell pepper, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large nonstick wok, set over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the ginger, scallions, and garlic. Step 3: Cook, tossing and stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add red-pepper flakes and orange zest, cook 20 seconds longer Slip the sirloin strips in the pan and cook, stirring and tossing, until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the broccoli and bell pepper Continue tossing and stirring until slightly softened but still crunchy, about 1 minute. Step 6: Pour in the soy sauce and vinegar and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: Add roux and cook, stirring, until thickened, about 15 seconds Immediately remove from heat.

Dish Name: Ho Yau Ngau Stir Fried Steak W Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: sugar, white pepper, light soy sauce, oil, sherry wine, sirloin, oyster sauce, chicken broth, cornstarch, salt, ginger, garlic clove, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the sugar through sherry and use to marinate the steak at least 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain steak, reserving the marinade. Step 3: Mix the marinade with the oyster sauce through cornstarch and put aside. Step 4: Heat a wok hot and dry, then add 2 tbs oil. Step 5: Add the salt, ginger and garlic and fry until golden brown. Step 6: Add the steak and fry 1-2 minutes until steak is browned on the outside. Step 7: Remove beef from the wok. Step 8: Add scallions and fry 30 seconds. Step 9: Add the soy sauce-marinade mixture, stirring. Step 10: When the gravy thickens, return beef to pan, stir in quickly, turn off heat and remove food to a serving dish.

Dish Name: Hoisin pork with garlic & ginger greens
Ingredient Names: pork loin steak, hoisin sauce, light soy sauce, thin-stemmed broccoli, sunflower oil, garlic, cm-piece ginger, green onions, bok choi, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put the pork, hoisin and soy sauce in a bowl and allow to stand for 10 mins. Heat the grill to high, shake off any excess sauce, then lay the pork on a tray. Grill for 5 mins, turning halfway, until cooked through. Remove and leave to rest in a warm place for 5 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, put the broccoli in a microwave-safe bowl with 4 tbsp water, cover with cling film, then microwave on High for 3 mins. Heat the oil in a wok, add the garlic and ginger, and stir-fry for 1 min. Add the spring onions and bok choi, then stir-fry for a further 2 mins. Tip in the broccoli with a dash of soy sauce and stir-fry for 1-2 mins more until the veg is warmed through. Serve the pork with the greens, a drizzle of any resting pork juices and rice or noodles, if you like.

Ingredient Names: wholewheat noodles, sunflower oil, purple sprouting broccoli, sugar snap peas, green onions, reduced-salt soy sauce, lean rump steak, sesame seeds, clear honey
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles in boiling salted water until just tender, then drain and rinse in cold water. Heat half the oil in a non-stick wok. Add the broccoli, peas and 2 tbsp water, then cover and steamfry for 3 mins. Remove the lid, add the spring onions and stir-fry for 2 mins, adding a splash more water if needed to cook the veg. Add the noodles and half the soy sauce and toss with the veg. Divide between 2 bowls and keep warm. Step 2: Wipe out the wok and heat the remaining oil until smoking. Tip in the beef and stir-fry for 2 mins over a high heat, but don’t move it around too much initially or it will release liquid and stew rather than fry. Tip in the sesame seeds, cook for 1 min more, then add the honey. Toss to coat the beef well, then add the remaining soy and bubble briefly. Spoon over the vegetables and noodles and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Hot Spicy Szechwan Beef Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry sherry, egg white, cornstarch, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, plum sauce, round steak, oil, baby carrots, celery, red bell pepper, onion, crushed red pepper flakes, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the marinade in a zip-lock bag. Step 2: Add the beef, knead the bag every 5 minutes or so. Step 3: Combine the sauce ingredients, set aside, heat the wok. Step 4: Add 2 tbs oil Swirl to coat. Step 5: Add carrots and stir fry 1 minute. Step 6: Add celery, red bell pepper, and onion, stir fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Remove and set aside Reheat wok.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef steak, cornstarch, soy sauce, garlic, sugar, broccoli, crushed red pepper, vegetable oil, onion, seasoned rice vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef across grain into thin slices, combine. Step 2: Each cornstarch and soy sauce with garlic and sugar in medium bowl; stir in beef, let stand. Step 3: Meanwhile, remove flowerets from broccoli; cut into bite-size pieces. Step 4: Peel stalks; cut diagonally into thin slices. Step 5: Combine water, remaining. Step 6: Soy sauce, cornstarch and crushed red pepper in small bowl, set aside, heat. Step 7: Oil in hot wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 8: Add beef and stir-fry; remove, heat remaining, oil in same pan. Step 9: Add broccoli and onion; stir-fry, sprinkle. Step 10: Water over vegetables; cover and cook, stirring occasionally. Step 11: Add beef and soy sauce mixture; cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens. Step 12: Remove from heat; stir in vinegar.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, meat tenderizer, soy sauce, cornstarch, peanut oil, thai red chili peppers, salt, garlic, rice wine vinegar, sugar, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Remove all the fat from the beef and partially freeze beef for ease in slicing. Step 2: Cut it across the grain into thin 1 inch slices. Step 3: Place the beef slices in a container with a tight fitting lid and add the marinade in the following steps First add the meat tenderizer by sprinkling it sparsely so that it hits each piece of meat Next add the soy and stir. Step 4: Then sprinkle on the cornstarch coating each piece. Step 5: Finally add the oil and stir to coat all of the meat. Step 6: Let the meat marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes While the meat marinates, chop the thai chilies into tiny pieces, set them aside. Step 7: Once the meat has marinated, velvet it by bringing a pot of water with the salt and just 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil to boil.

Ingredient Names: sugar, low sodium soy sauce, chili paste, fresh lime juice, dark sesame oil, garlic cloves, flank steaks, salt, cooking spray, corn tortillas, green onions, napa cabbage, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 6 ingredients in a shallow dish, add steak to dish, cover. Step 2: Marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour Turning after 30 minutes. Step 3: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Step 4: Remove steak from marinade and discard marinade. Step 5: Thread steak onto 8 skewers. Step 6: Sprinkle with salt. Step 7: Place skewers on grill rack coated with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, salt, egg white, cornstarch, peanut oil, dry roasted peanuts, dried red chili peppers, red bell pepper, green onions, garlic, ginger, water chestnut, steamed rice, chili paste with garlic, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Slice beef diagonally, across the grain, into thin slices. Step 2: Combine beef, salt, egg white, and cornstarch. Step 3: Toss together until well mixed and set aside. Step 4: Stir together all ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl and set aside. Step 5: Add two tbsp oil to the wok and stir-fry beef until just browned, remove from wok. Step 6: Add 2 more tbsp oil to wok and add peanuts and the hot peppers to the wok and cook until the peppers turn dark. Step 7: Remove all from wok and place with the beef. Step 8: Add more oil to wok if needed- and add bell peppers to wok and cook for one minute, then reduce heat on wok. Step 9: Add green onions, ginger and garlic to bell peppers and cook for a few moments but do not let garlic burn.

Ingredient Names: mint leaf, watercress, mixed salad green, tomatoes, onion, roast beef, fish sauce, garlic, chili, sugar, water, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and dry mint leaves and watercress in a salad spinner. Step 2: Toss the packaged salad leaves and watercress in a salad bowl and top with tomatoes and onion. Step 3: Add beef slices, torn into bite-sized pieces. Step 4: Mix dressing in a bowl, stir well to combine. Step 5: Cover salad with spicy dressing. Step 6: Top with mint leaves and serve with rotti for a twist.

Dish Name: Lions Heads With Spicy Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, green onion, water chestnut, cornstarch, all-purpose flour, fresh ginger, low sodium soy sauce, dark sesame oil, hot red pepper, salt, vegetable oil, fresh basil, lemon, light coconut milk, soymilk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork through salt in a large bowl and form into 8 large balls Saut meatballs in oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides Continue cooking 6-7 min, then drain. Step 2: Combine sauce ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add meatballs to sauce, cover, reduce heat and continue simmering 8 minutes. Step 4: Serve garnished with basil and lemon peel.

Ingredient Names: beef, carrot, potato, brown onion, tomatoes, cabbage, cooking wine, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the beef into 1 and 1 / 2" pieces Blanch the beef in boiling water, remove and drain. Step 2: Transfer the beef to a deep pot. Step 3: Add 12 c water ad bring to a boil. Step 4: Turn heat to low and cook for 1 hour or until the liquid is reduced to 3 / 4 its original amount. Step 5: Cut carrot, potato, brown onion and tomato into 1 / 2" pieces. Step 6: Cut the cabbage into large squares. Step 7: Place carrot, potato, brown onion, tomato and cabbage in the pot. Step 8: Cook for 20 minutes over medium heat.

Dish Name: Low Carb Beef And Broccoli Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: canola oil, broccoli, carrot, onion, sirloin steaks, chicken broth, low sodium soy sauce, guar gum, splenda sugar substitute, salt
Instructions: Step 1: -in a 10" skillet or wok heat the oil. Step 2: Add the prepared vegetables -cook, stirring quickly& frequently until vegies are crisp tender& onions are browned -stirin the beef strips, cook till desired doneness -ina small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, stirring to dissolve the cornstarch. Step 3: Add to the beef mixture& cook stirring constantly until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tofu, minced beef, sesame seed oil, salt, doubanjiang, fermented black beans, pepper, sichuan pepper, soy sauce, water, cornstarch, oil, scallions, spring onions, garlic, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Add a small pinch of salt and sesame oil to minced beef. Step 2: Mix well and set aside. Step 3: Mix cornstarch with 2 and ½ tablespoons of water in a small bowl to make water starch. Step 4: Cut tofu into square cubes (around ). Step 5: Bring a large amount of water to a boil and then add a pinch of salt. Step 6: Slide the tofu in and cook for 5 minutes. Step 7: Move out and drain. Step 8: Get a wok and heat up around oil, fry the minced meat until crispy. Step 9: Transfer out beef out and leave the oil in. Step 10: Fry doubanjiang for over slow fire and then add garlic, scallion white, ginger and fermented black beans to cook for 30 seconds until aroma. Step 11: Then mix pepper flakes in. Step 12: Add water to the seasonings and bring to boil over high fire. Step 13: Gently slide the tofu cubes. Step 14: Add light soy sauce and beef. Slow the heat after boiling and then simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 15: Then add chopped garlic greens. Step 16: Stir the water starch and then pour half of the mixture to the simmering pot. Step 17: Wait for around 30 seconds and then pour the other half. Step 18: You can slightly taste the tofu and add pinch of salt if not salty enough. Step 19: By the way, if you feel it is too spicy, add some sugar can milder the taste. Step 20: But be carefully as the broth is very hot at this point. Step 21: Transfer out when almost all the seasonings stick to tofu cubes. Step 22: Sprinkle Szechuan peppercorn powder (to taste)and chopped garlic greens if using. Step 23: Serve immediately with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: bean curd, ground beef, oil, garlic, chili peppers, leek, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, water, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut bean curd into bite-sized squares and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil and fry garlic, chili peppers and chopped leek, add meat. Step 3: When meat changes color, lightly stir in bean curd, soy sauce and = sugar. Step 4: Cover with lid and cook for 10 min. Step 5: Add cornstarch mixture, allowing it to thicken for a few minutes. Step 6: Turn out into serving dish, sprinkle with the sesame oil and serve hot Emmadeer.

Dish Name: Madame's Orange Or Tangerine Peel Beef
Ingredient Names: flank steak, dark soy sauce, sugar, egg, flour, oil, dried red chili peppers, dried orange peel, cornstarch, frozen orange juice concentrate, catsup, water, orange extract
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Cut beef into thick slices and pound until 3 / 8 inch thick. Step 3: Marinate in soy sauce and sugar 10 minutes. Step 4: Add egg and flour, mix with hand. Step 5: Heat oil for deep frying Slide beef into oil piece by piece to prevent sticking together, fry until crispy, remove, fry again.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, ground ginger powder, beef, snow peas, onions, green peppers, mushrooms, oil, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine, the first five ingredients; remove half, set aside. Step 2: Add sliced beef to remaining marinade; cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Step 3: In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry veggies in oil for 2 mins; remove, keep warm. Step 4: Drain, and discard the marinade. Step 5: In the same skillet, stir-fry the beef, until no longer pink. Step 6: Add the reserved veggies. Step 7: Combine the cornstarch and reserved marinade until smooth; add to skillet. Step 8: Bring to boil; cook and stir for 2 mins, or until thickened, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, soy sauce, chop suey vegetables, garlic powder, pepper, breadcrumbs, egg, sweet and sour sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all together except the sauce Bake 350 1 hour 15 minutes Pour sauce over top Bake 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, soy sauce, cornstarch, peanut oil, sugar, salt, white pepper, garlic cloves, ground ginger, sliced water chestnuts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine meat, soy sauce, cornstarch, oil, sugar, salt, and pepper and refrigerate at least 1 hour In 375 degree wok, cook garlic and ginger in oil for 3-5 minutes. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients, including meat mixture. Step 3: Stir fry for 5-10 minutes, or until meat is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic, beef round steak, water, white sugar, red pepper flakes, vegetable oil, carrots, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a dry skillet over medium heat, toast sesame seeds for 1 to2 minutes, or until the seeds begin to turn golden brown; set aside. Step 2: In a medium bowl, mix together soy sauce, cornstarch, and minced garlic. Step 3: Stir in beef strips. Step 4: Let stand for at least 10 minutes. Step 5: In a separate small bowl, mix together water, soy sauce, cornstarch, sugar, sesame seeds, and red pepper flakes; set aside. Step 6: Heat oil in a wok or skillet over high heat. Step 7: Cook and stir beef in hot oil for 5 minutes; remove, and set aside. Step 8: Heat remaining tablespoon of oil in the same pan. Step 9: Saute carrots and white part of green onions for 3-4 minutes. Step 10: Stir in green parts of the green onion, and saute for 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Stir in sesame seed mixture and beef. Step 12: Cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens.

Ingredient Names: boneless sirloin tip roast, soy sauce, dry sherry, sesame oil, cornstarch, brown sugar, crushed red pepper, dried red chile peppers, vegetable oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Partially freeze the roast for easier slicing. Step 2: Slice the roast into 3x1/ strips, and set aside. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine well the soy sauce, sherry, sesame oil, cornstarch, brown sugar, crushed red pepper and whole chile peppers. Step 4: Place beef in the mixture and coat well. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate for 20 to. Step 6: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat. Step 7: Place green onions in the hot oil. Step 8: Cover, reduce heat to low and cook, or until tender. Step 9: Remove green onions and set aside. Step 10: In the same skillet or wok, heat remaining oil over medium high heat. Step 11: Add beef mixture and saute for 3-4 minutes, or until the beef is thoroughly cooked. Step 12: Return green onions to the pan and saute for 30 seconds more, or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, sesame oil, ground black pepper, beef flank steak, red pepper, green pepper, onion, broccoli floret, black bean garlic sauce, green onion, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, chopped garlic and ginger, sesame oil and black pepper in a large mixing bowl and whisk together. Step 2: Slice flank steak on a bias, approximately 1 / 8-inch thick. Step 3: Add to marinade, cover, and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours. Step 4: When ready to cook, drain marinade from meat Lightly oil wok or deep skillet. Step 5: Grill the beef for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the peppers, onions, and broccoli Continue cooking for 1 to 2 minutes until beef is almost cooked throughout. Step 7: Add sauce and toss with beef mixture Coat well and continue to saute for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: sherry wine, gingerroot, soy sauce, peanut oil, brown sugar, cornstarch, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, flank steaks, bok choy, fresh shiitake mushrooms, scallions, carrots, beef stock, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the sherry, ginger, soy sauce, 1 tbsp oil, brown sugar, corn starch, garlic, red pepper flakes, and beef in a resealable plastic bag and seal. Step 2: Turn several times to coat and marinate 30 minutes at room temperature, or refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Step 3: Heat a large wok or pot over high heat. Step 4: Add 1 tsp oil Lift the beef from the marinade with a slotted spoon, reserving the marinade Quickly stir-fry the beef until lightly browned on both sides, about 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the pan and set aside. Step 6: Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the bok choy, shitakes, scallions, and carrots for 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Add the reserved marinade, stock, water, and hoison sauce, bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Moo Shu Beef Lettuce Cups 4 Points
Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, yellow onion, ginger, garlic cloves, bok choy, sweet red pepper, button mushrooms, low sodium soy sauce, bibb lettuce, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, onion, ginger and garlic in a skillet on medium heat Break meat up as it cooks. Step 2: When beef is browned, add bok choy, pepper, mushrooms and soy sauce and cook until bok choy is wilted, about 3-5 minutes Clean and dry bibb lettuce leaves. Step 3: When beef mixture is done, spoon 1 / 2 cup of beef mixture into each lettuce leaf Yields 2 filled leaves per serving. Step 4: Serve with extra soy sauce if desired.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, cold water, barbecue sauce, hoisin sauce, reduced sodium soy sauce, fresh ginger, garlic, salt, onion, sweet red pepper, canola oil, coleslaw mix, lean ground beef, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine cornstarch, water, barbecue sauce, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, ginger, garlic and salt. Step 2: In a large skillet saute onion and red pepper in oil until crisp-tender. Step 3: Remove from pan and set aside In same skillet cook ground beef until no longer pink and then drain.
