Step 4: Stir sauce mixture over meat bring to a boil and cook two minutes until thickened. Step 5: Add coleslaw mix and stir. Step 6: Spoon into tortillas and top with onions and peppers.

Ingredient Names: beef, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic, rice wine, soy sauce, sugar, yellow onion, green onions, white pepper, sesame seed oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix beef and cornstarch well and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Step 2: Heat 4 cups vegetable oil and fry beef until it is crispy. Step 3: Remove beef from oil. Step 4: Heat 2 teaspoons vegetable oil and add chopped garlic, rice wine, soy sauce, and beef, stir-fry well. Step 5: Add sugar and continue stirring for 1 minute. Step 6: Add sliced yellow onion and green onion, stir, add white pepper, stir well.

Dish Name: My O My Best Thai Beef Salad Ever
Ingredient Names: sirloin steaks, salad greens, red onions, kaffir lime leaves, red chilies, cilantro leaf, mint leaf, basil leaves, soya sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Brush the beef with a little oil and char-grill, barbecue, or pan-fry till cooked to your liking. Step 2: Set aside for five minutes and slice it thinly. Step 3: Place salad greens, onions, kaffir lime leaves, chili, cilantro, mint and basil into a salad bowl and toss lightly To make the dressing, combine the soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice and sugar. Step 4: Stir the dressing well. Step 5: Place the beef on the salad and pour over the dressing. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Nat's easy peppery Beef Broccoli Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: top sirloin steaks, fresh broccoli, sweet onions, mushrooms, hoisin sauce, soya sauce, steak spice, cornstarch, grapeseed oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut broccoli, use florets and stems cut into thin rounds. Step 2: Slice mushrooms and onion. Step 3: Slice steak in 1/4 inch think strips. Step 4: Mix hoisin, soya sauce, steak spice and corn starch together in a cup or bowl. Step 5: Heat oil in a large frying pan over med, high heat. Step 6: Add beef and stir fry till brown. Step 7: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 8: Add mushrooms to same pan, cook until just brown. Step 9: Remove from pan, and set aside on top of beef. Step 10: Add onions to pan, stir fry 1-2 minutes. Step 11: Remove from pan and throw on top of mushrooms and beef. Step 12: Add the 1/3 cup of water to fry pan, deglaze. Step 13: Add broccoli to pan and stir fry until water evaporates. Step 14: Returm meat, mushrooms, onion to pan. Step 15: Pour sauce mixture on top. Step 16: Stir constantly, until all is nice and hot and coated evenly with sauce. Step 17: Enjoy over rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, ginger, garlic, ground beef, salt, soy sauce, chinkiang vinegar, warm water, cornstarch, cold water, toasted sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the lettuce in a wide salad bowl or serving dish and set aside. Step 2: Place a wok or heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: When it is hot, add the oil and swirl to coat the bottom of the pan. Step 4: Toss in the garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds, then add the ginger. Step 5: Stir-fry over medium-high to medium heat until slightly softened and starting to turn color. Step 6: Add the meat and use your spatula to break it up so there are no lumps at all, then add the salt and stir-fry until most of the meat has changed color. Step 7: Add the soy sauce and vinegar and stir to blend. Step 8: Add the warm water and stir The dressing can be prepared ahead to this point and set aside for up to 20 minutes. Step 9: When you are ready to proceed, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: bulgur, orange juice, rice vinegar, light soy sauce, light brown sugar, minced ginger, round steak, broccoli florets, canola oil, red bell pepper, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine orange juice, vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar and ginger and set aside. Step 2: Toss beef strips with cornstarch and season with salt and pepper, set aside. Step 3: In a large skillet, combine broccoli with water. Step 4: Bring to a boil and partially cover skillet with lid, steaming broccoli until crisp-tender, about 4-6 minutes. Step 5: Transfer to plate Wipe skillet out with papertowel and then heat 1 t of oil over high heat. Step 6: When pan is very hot, add half of the beef. Step 7: Cook until browned, 2-4 minutes. Step 8: Remove with slotted spoon to plate with broccoli and cook other half of beef.

Ingredient Names: scallions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, orange zest, boneless sirloin steak, baby carrots, sugar snap peas, reduced sodium soy sauce, orange juice, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a large nonstick wok or skillet with nonstick spray and set over high heat. Step 2: When a drop of water sizzles on it, add the scallions, garlic, ginger and orange zest. Step 3: Stir-fry until the scallions soften, about 1 minute. Step 4: Add the beef and stir-fry until browned, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the sugar snap peas and baby carrots. Step 6: Stir-fry until crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the soy sauce and orange juice. Step 8: Bring to a simmer and cook 20 seconds. Step 9: Meanwhile, mix the cornstarch and cold water in a small bowl until smooth. Step 10: Add the cornstarch mixture to the wok and cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce is thickened, 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, carrots, oranges, oyster sauce, soya sauce, sherry wine, cornstarch, hot pepper sauce, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic cloves, sugar snap peas
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from steak. Step 2: Slice across the grain in 1 / 8 inch thick strips. Step 3: Cut into 2-inch lengths. Step 4: Cut carrots into 1 / 4 inch pieces. Step 5: Using zester, peel rind of oranges into long, narrow strips. Step 6: Squeeze oranges to make 1 / 3 cup of juice. Step 7: Whisk together half of the rind, the juice, oyster and soy sauces, sherry, cornstarch and pepper sauce In bowl, combine beef with 2 tbs of the sauce and let stand for 20 minutes In wok, heat half of the oil over high heat. Step 8: Stir fry beef in batches for 1- 2 minutes or until browned but still pink inside.

Ingredient Names: beef top sirloin, low-sodium soy sauce, cornstarch, dark sesame oil, baking soda, frozen orange juice concentrate, rice vinegar, brown sugar, peanut oil, garlic, fresh ginger root, orange zest, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, and baking soda in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate, 1 to. Step 3: Heat peanut oil in a wok or large, nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 4: Stir in garlic, ginger, orange zest, and red pepper flakes, and cook until garlic begins to brown, 20 to 30 seconds. Step 5: Add beef; cook and stir until beef begins to brown and crisp, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Whisk together soy sauce, orange juice concentrate, rice vinegar, sesame oil, brown sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl. Step 7: Stir into beef, and cook until sauce has thickened and turned clear, about 30 seconds.

Dish Name: Oriental Beef And Noodles Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: boneless sirloin, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, carrots, rice vinegar, tomato sauce, sherry wine, oyster sauce, sugar, peanuts, cooked vermicelli
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except the noodles in a crock pot Cover and cook on low 8-10 hours Serve over noodles This recipe may be doubled for 5-quart models.

Ingredient Names: fresh carrots, onions, beef round steak, ginger, garlic, water, low sodium soy sauce, envelope beef gravy mix, fresh broccoli florets, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Layer the carrots, onions, and beef strips (in that order) in a 4-quart slow cooker. Step 2: Sprinkle evenly with ginger and garlic. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix together the water, soy sauce, and gravy mix. Step 4: Pour over meat and vegetables. Step 5: Cover and cook on LOW for 6-8 hours. Step 6: Increase heat to HIGH; add in broccoli, stir to combine. Step 7: Cover and cook 15 minutes or until crisp tender. Step 8: Season to taste with salt and pepper if desired. Step 9: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green pepper, mushroom pieces, water, cornstarch, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, add onion, green pepper, and mushrooms. Step 2: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Mix water, cornstarch, and soy sauce. Step 4: Stir into meat mixture until smooth and thickened.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, hoisin sauce, ground ginger, garlic powder, ground black pepper, egg, evaporated milk, breadcrumbs, onion salt, lean ground beef, corn kernel, zucchini, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk cornstarch with soy sauce, vinegar, hoisin sauce, ginger, garlic powder and pepper, set aside. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine egg, evaporated milk, bread crumbs, onion salt, garlic powder and black pepper Crumble beef over mixture and blend well. Step 4: Shape into 1-inch balls Tear off 4 12-inch pieces of reynold's wrap. Step 5: Set 1 / 4 of the vegetables onto center of each piece of foil. Step 6: Top each with 1 / 4 of the meatballs and 1 / 4 of the sauce. Step 7: Fold foil over mixture and crimp edges to make packets.

Ingredient Names: beef tail, tomatoes, potatoes, onion, carrots, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place ox tail, onions and water in a kettle, bring to boil. Step 2: Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Step 3: Add potatoes, carrots, tomatoes and salt. Step 4: Cover and simmer for 1 more hour, serve hot.

Dish Name: Oyster Sauce Beef And Snow Peas
Ingredient Names: beef, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, sherry wine, oyster sauce, oil, garlic clove, onion, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, sherry, oyster sauce and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Step 2: Marinate for 20 minutes. Step 3: In a wok or skillet, heat remaining oil and brown garlic. Step 4: Add meat and onion, stir-fry 1 minute. Step 5: Add peas and cook 1 more minute.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Beef A La Sichuan
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, celery ribs, carrots, green onion, peanut oil, cornstarch, red pepper flakes, sesame oil, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, garlic and red chile paste, chinese hot mustard, rice wine vinegar, chili oil, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all of the sauce ingredients together and set aside Julienne your carrots and celery and set aside. Step 2: Place the beef in a medium bowl. Step 3: Add the cornstarch and toss to make sure each piece is thoroughly coated. Step 4: Set aside for 10 minutes. Step 5: In a large skillet, fry the sliced meat in hot oil until crispy to your liking. Step 6: Remove from oil and drain on paper towels. Step 7: Drain used oil, if any In the same pan, add the sesame oil. Step 8: Bring to high heat and then add the following ingredients one at a time and then give a good stir before adding the next ingredient: the celery, crushed red pepper flakes followed by carrots.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Beef With Broccoli
Ingredient Names: flank steak, broccoli, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, cornstarch, cooked white rice, low sodium soy sauce, mirin, oyster sauce, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Place the sliced beef in a large ziplock bag. Step 2: Stir together the marinade ingredients and pour into the bag Smoosh to coat the beef in the mixture, then let it sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, steam the broccoli for 2 minutes, or until crisp tender, set aside. Step 4: Stir together the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Step 5: Heat an wok or very large skillet to high heat. Step 6: Add the oil then gently place the beef in the wok and spread into a single layer. Step 7: Let the beef cook for 1 minute without touching it. Step 8: Add the garlic and ginger and stir continuously for 1 minute, then add in the sauce and broccoli.

Ingredient Names: beef sirloin, garlic powder, fresh ground black pepper, vegetable oil, beef bouillon, hot water, cornstarch, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, stewed tomatoes, soy sauce, white sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine garlic powder and black pepper in a medium bowl. Step 2: Cut beef across the grain into 1 1 / 2 inch long and 1 inch wide cubes. Step 3: Mix with garlic powder / black pepper mixture and set aside. Step 4: Slice bell peppers and onion into cubes Dissolve bouillon in hot water and mix in cornstarch until dissolved. Step 5: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Heat the oil to hot and brown the seasoned beef cubes. Step 7: Transfer stir fried meat to a crock pot Give a quick stir to bouillon mixture and pour into the slow cooker. Step 8: Stir in onion, bell peppers, stewed tomatoes, soy sauce, sugar and salt.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, cornstarch, oil, egg, salt, water, sugar, ketchup, vinegar, chili pepper, garlic, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, white onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef into thin strips. Step 2: In a bowl of sealable bag combine all marinade ingredients and mix well. Step 3: Add beef slices and marinate for 15 minutes While beef in marinating mix all of the sauce ingredients together in a bowl and refrigerate. Step 4: When the beef is done marinating coat the beef slices with 6 tablespoons of cornstarch. Step 5: Remove any access cornstarch and deep fry beef slices in batches until floating or golden brown. Step 6: Drain on paper towels. Step 7: Add a couple tablespoons of oil to the wok and add minced garlic and stir fry for 10 seconds. Step 8: Add red and green bell peppers and onions and stir fry for 2 minutes. Step 9: Remove vegetables and set aside.

Ingredient Names: stir-fry beef, peanut oil, hoisin sauce, five-spice powder, honey, soy sauce, garlic cloves, sesame oil, dry sherry, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all of the marinade ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Make sure you mix them well. Step 3: Put meat into mixture and cover Refridgerate for 2 hours. Step 4: Heat frypan over medium heat, add oil. Step 5: When oil is hot add marinaded meat. Step 6: Leave frypan at medium heat until beef is cooked. Step 7: When meat is cooked turn the frypan down to a simmer Sauce should start to thicken up within 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pineapple chunks in juice, fresh ginger, soy sauce, fresh cilantro, round steak, vegetable oil, garlic clove, cornstarch, green beans, sweet red pepper, scallions, canned chili
Instructions: Step 1: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 cup of chunks, 1 / 2 cup juice. Step 2: Combine 1 / 2 cup of the juice, ginger, soy sauce, cilantro and meat in bowl. Step 3: Cover bowl, marinate for 15 minutes In large, nonstick skillet, heat oil, add garlic, saut 30 seconds, until fragrant. Step 4: Remove the meat from the marinade, place in the skillet. Step 5: Stir fry 5 minutes, just until cooked through, remove the meat and keep warm. Step 6: Combine marinade and cornstarch in bowl. Step 7: Add the beans, chilies, pepper and marinade to skillet. Step 8: Stir fry 4 minutes. Step 9: Stir in 1 cup pineapple chunks, scallions and meat.

Ingredient Names: rump steak, soy sauce, soft brown sugar, chili sauce, rice wine vinegar, vegetable oil, thumb-sized ginger, green onions, pineapple, fresh cilantro, rice greens
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the steak, soy sauce, sugar, chilli sauce and vinegar together, and set aside for 10 mins. Step 2: Heat a wok with 1 tsp of the oil. Lift the steak from the marinade and sear, in batches, then remove. Add a bit more oil and fry the ginger until golden. Add the spring onions and pineapple, and return the steak to the pan. Stir to heat through for 1 min, then add any remaining marinade. Keep stirring until the marinade becomes thick and everything is hot. Serve sprinkled with coriander, and with rice and greens, if you like.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, peeled and deveined, ground beef, fresh ginger root, shallot, green onions, napa cabbage, soy sauce, asian toasted sesame oil, salt, white pepper, white sugar, gyoza wrappers, vegetable oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: To make the filling: Place shrimp in a food processor, and process until shrimp are finely ground; transfer into a large bowl and set aside. Step 2: Working in batches, process ground beef until fine, add to ground shrimp. Step 3: Add ginger, shallot, green onions, napa cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, white pepper, and white sugar to shrimp and beef mixture; mix thoroughly until well combined. Step 4: To fill the potstickers: Place a wrapper on the work surface and add a scant teaspoon of filling in the center. Step 5: With a wet finger, dampen the edges of the wrapper. Step 6: Fold dough into a half-moon shape, enclosing the filling, and press and seal to remove extra air and tightly seal the edges together. Step 7: It's nice to fold several small pleats in the top half of the wrapper for a traditional look before you seal in the filling. Step 8: Refrigerate the filled wrappers on a parchment-lined baking sheet while you finish filling and sealing the potstickers. Step 9: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet with a lid over medium heat. Step 10: Place potstickers into hot oil, flat-side down, without crowding, and let fry until the bottoms are golden brown, 1 to. Step 11: Turn dumplings over, and pour water over them. Step 12: Cover the pan with a lid and let dumplings steam until water has nearly evaporated and dumplings have begun to fry in oil again, 5 to. Step 13: Uncover the skillet, and let potstickers cook until all the water is evaporated and the wrapper has shrunk down tightly onto the filling, another 2 to.

Dish Name: Quick And Easy Stir Fry Beef
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, pea pods, sliced water chestnuts, gingerroot, green onions, olive oil, soy sauce, water, vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice in pot, and cook While the rice is cooking, slice flank steak in thin slices and place in marinade. Step 2: Make sure that the steak is coated in marinade. Step 3: Wash pea pods and pinch off the ends. Step 4: Chop the green onions and slice ginger. Step 5: Heat large skillet on high heat. Step 6: Drop 1 tbsp olive oil onto skillet. Step 7: Put meat and marinade in skillet and fry until brown. Step 8: Add more olive oil if necessary. Step 9: Add ginger and green onions to skillet.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, oil, garlic, scallions, ginger, chili bean paste, soy sauce, rice wine, hoisin sauce, salt, sugar, chinese noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in skillet or wok. Step 2: Add garlic, scallions, ginger, and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 3: Add pork, stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 4: Add chili bean paste, soy sauce, rice wine, hoisin sauce, salt, and sugar, cook 5 minutes. Step 5: Prepare pasta in boiling water and serve with meat sauce.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, teriyaki sauce, green onions, gingerroot, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix all ingredients in a bowl- making sure teriyaki sauce spreads evenly Form balls & place in baking dish. Step 3: Bake for approximately 20-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef cubes, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, red chilies, star anise, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, brown bean sauce, sugar, salt, chili oil, water, carrots, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium high heat, bring a large pot of water to boil and add beef, boil for 10 seconds. Step 2: Drain, and rinse under cold water for 1 minute, set aside. Step 3: In a small bowl combine next 5 ingredients. Step 4: Set aside In another small bowl or cup combine next 5 ingredients. Step 5: Set aside Over high heat heat hot chili oil in a wok or large skillet. Step 6: Add onion mixture to wok and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in beef and stir-fry 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dry sherry, oyster sauce, asian toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, white sugar, cornstarch, beef sirloin steak, vegetable oil, fresh ginger root, garlic, broccoli, mushrooms, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk sherry, oyster sauce, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch together in a bowl until sugar dissolves. Step 2: Arrange steak slices in a shallow bowl, pour the oyster sauce mixture over the meat, stir to coat, and refrigerate at least. Step 3: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cook and stir ginger and garlic in hot oil until fragrant about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Remove and discard the ginger and garlic. Step 6: Stir broccoli, mushrooms, and snow peas together in the skillet; cook and stir in the hot oil until the broccoli is bright green and almost tender, 5 to. Step 7: Remove the vegetable mixture to a bowl. Step 8: Pour beef slices with the marinade into the skillet; cook and stir until the sauce forms a glaze on the beef and the meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Return the cooked vegetables to the wok; cook and stir until the broccoli is heated through, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rice, minced beef, eggs, vegetable oil, salt, soy sauce, cornflour, sugar, oil, oyster sauce, pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Season the beef with the seasonings listed. Step 2: Cook the rice with a rice cooker, using suitable amount of water as usual. Step 3: Add oil and salt and stir well before starting cooking the rice. Step 4: Beat the eggs well. Step 5: When the rice is cooked and the rice cooker says"keep warm", add the seasoned beef and eggs into the rice. Step 6: Stir the ingredients well inside the rice cooker Close the lid until the beef is totally cooked If it is not salty enough, add further soy sauce into the rice to suit your taste, serve hot.

Dish Name: Roast beef sirloin with oyster sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless beef sirloin, chinese five-spice powder, sugar, vegetable oil, fresh coriander, chicken stock, garlic, ginger, oyster sauce, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Score the fat on the beef in a criss-cross pattern. Mix together the five-spice and sugar, then season really well with salt and pepper. Rub all over the beef, then leave to marinate, preferably overnight. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. When ready to cook, rub the oil all over the meat. Heat a griddle pan or, if the weather is good, a barbecue. You’ll need to leave the griddle pan for 10-15 mins to make sure it gets really hot. Place the meat, fat-side down, on the griddle and leave to cook for 5-10 mins until the fat starts to melt (the kitchen will probably get quite smoky so make sure you have an extractor fan turned on). Turn the meat over and cook for 5 mins more until it is well browned all over. Step 3: Place in a roasting tin, then cook in the oven for 30 mins for rare (15-20 mins more for medium, or 30-40 mins more for well done). Cover and leave to rest for 15 mins. Step 4: To make the sauce, trim the stalks from the coriander and place them in a pan along with the stock, garlic, ginger, oyster sauce and the white part of the spring onion. Bring to the boil, then leave to simmer and infuse for 10 mins. Strain, then chop the coriander leaves and place in the sauce along with the green spring onion slices to serve.

Ingredient Names: steak, water, soya sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, garlic, fresh ginger, cornstarch, oil, broccoli, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate steak in mixture of 1 / 2 of water, soya sauce, sugar, vinegar, garlic, ginger and cornstarch. Step 2: Drain well, reserving marinade. Step 3: Heat oil in wok or skillet. Step 4: Add steak and brown. Step 5: Add broccoli and onion. Step 6: Cook at medium-high heat, stirring for 1 minutes. Step 7: Add remaining water, cover and steam for 3-4 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp. Step 8: Add marinade and cook until sauce is hot and thick.

Ingredient Names: sirloin tip steaks, green onion, bean sprouts, chinese pea pod, low-fat beef broth, low sodium soy sauce, cornstarch, water, ground ginger, hot sauce, water chestnut, bamboo shoot
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice the sirloin. Step 2: Wash all the fresh vegetables Finely chop the onions. Step 3: Place the sirloin in the slow cooker, 3-6 quarts size pot. Step 4: Pour broth, soy sauce, ginger and onion over the beef. Step 5: Cover and cook on low, 6-7 hours. Step 6: Uncover and turn to high. Step 7: Mix cornstarch and water in a small measuring cup. Step 8: Stir this mixture with the hot sauce into the cooker Leaving lid slightly ajar, cook on high for 15 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: boneless sirloin, sugar, vegetable oil, soy sauce, pepper, green onions, garlic, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from beef and cut diagonally across grain into slices as thin as you can. Step 2: Mix next 6 ingredients in large bowl. Step 3: Stir in beef until well coated. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes, drain beef. Step 5: Cook and stir sesame seed in 10 in Skillet over med. Step 6: Heat till light brown. Step 7: Remove from skillet. Step 8: Heat 1 tbsp veg oil in same skillet until hot.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, dijon mustard, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, ginger, flank steak, onion, red pepper, green pepper, frozen broccoli florets, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, 4 tbsp oil, honey, mustard and red pepper into bowl and add in steak. Step 2: Mix and bag -- will marinate as it defrosts. Step 3: Slice and bag -- 1 medium onion 1 red pepper 1 green pepper Broccoli florets. Step 4: Put both bags in a large bag with a copy of the instructions and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, yellow onion, chinese rice wine, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, bay leaves, turmeric powder, white pepper, chinese five spice powder, oil, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a ziplock bag, combine onions, 1 / 3 cup rice wine, soy sauces, bay leaves, turmeric, pepper, and 5-spice. Step 2: Mix well and add pork, turning to coat. Step 3: Marinate in refrigerator over-night, turning once. Step 4: Remove the pork from the marinade. Step 5: Set marinade aside Pat the pork dry with paper towels. Step 6: Heat a wok over high heat until hot. Step 7: Add the oil and swirl to coat the sides. Step 8: Place the meat fat side down in the wok and cook, turning as necessary until brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side then remove from wok. Step 9: Discard pan drippings.

Ingredient Names: steak, condensed beef broth, oil, sliced water chestnuts, water, red capsicum, soy sauce, cornstarch, scallions, black pepper, rice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in hot oil in a skillet for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add water chestnuts, capsicum, scallions, salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook 2 minutes longer. Step 4: Mix broth, water, soy sauce and cornstarch. Step 5: Stir into beef mixture. Step 6: Cook and stir until mixture thickens and comes to a full boil. Step 7: Stir in rice Continue cooking the dish until the rice is soft, remove from heat. Step 8: Let the dish stand 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Shanghai Style Noodles With Spicy Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, fresh gingerroot, dried red pepper flakes, onions, ground beef, chicken broth, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, vermicelli, sesame oil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger root, and pepper flakes and saute about 5 seconds. Step 3: Add onions and stir fry until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in ground meat, breaking it up with a spoon or spatula. Step 5: Cook until meat has lost pink color. Step 6: Combine 1 / 2 cup chicken broth, hoisin sauce, soy sauce and sherry. Step 7: Stir into meat mixture. Step 8: Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. Step 9: Meanwhile, dissolve the cornstarch in the remaining 1 / 2 cup of chicken broth Slowly stir into meat mixture and cook and stir until sauce thickens.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, rice wine vinegar, salt, vegetable oil, sesame oil, baking soda, green peppers, fresh gingerroot, green onion, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Using a sharp knife, slice beef across grain and at an angle into thin strips. Step 2: Combine marinade ingredients in a medium bowl. Step 3: Add beef shreds, mix well. Step 4: Let stand about 15 minutes. Step 5: Slice green peppers into thin strips. Step 6: Heat 5 t oil in a wok over high heat 1 minute. Step 7: Stir fry marinated beef for 10 seconds. Step 8: Remove beef, draining well over wok and reduce heat to medium. Step 9: Stir fry ginger root and freen onions 1 minute. Step 10: Add green pepper shreds, sugar and salt.

Ingredient Names: hot chili peppers, oil, orange, garlic cloves, carrot, beef, broth, soy sauce, honey, potato starch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the carrot, chili pepper, garlic, and orange zests, set aside. Step 2: Add oil into the pot and heat the oil. Step 3: Add pepper, garlic and orange zest into the pot and stir fry for 4 minutes. Step 4: Add the carrot and beef and stir fry for about 2 minutes to brown the beef. Step 5: Add the water, broth, soy sauce, honey, and orange liqueur Give it a good stir. Step 6: Bring to boil and turn the heat into low, cook for a hour. Step 7: Mix the potato starch and water in a small bowl and add the mixture into the pot for another stir.

Ingredient Names: short rib of beef, teriyaki sauce, toasted sesame seeds, sugar, tabasco sauce, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Score meaty side of ribs opposite bone, 1 / 2" apart, 1 / 2" deep, lengthwise and crosswise. Step 2: Place ribs in large plastic bag. Step 3: Combine teriyaki sauce, sesame seed, sugar, tabasco and garlic, pour over ribs. Step 4: Press air out of bag, tie top securely. Step 5: Refrigerate 4hours, turning bag over occasionally. Step 6: Remove ribs and broil or grill 4" from heat source or hot coals 15 to 18 minutes, or until outsides of ribs are brown and crisp. Step 7: Turn ribs over occasionally during cooking.

Dish Name: Sizzling Beef With Spring Onions Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: sea salt, black pepper, long grain rice, sirloin steaks, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, chili, spring onions, fresh coriander, sesame oil, peanut oil, black bean sauce, soy sauce, limes, egg
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare your stir-fry: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil, add the rice and cook according to the packet instructions. Step 2: Drain the rice in a sieve, run it under a cold tap to cool, then allow to dry out in the fridge Trim any excess fat from your steak and slice the meat into finger sized strips Peel and finely slice the ginger and garlic Finely slice the chili. Step 3: Cut the ends off your spring onions and finely slice Pick the coriander leaves and put to one side, and finely chop the coriander stalks Get yourself a big bowl and put in the ginger, garlic, chilli, spring onions, coriander stalks and steak strips. Step 4: Add the sesame oil and mix everything together.

Ingredient Names: skirt steaks, soy sauce, peanut oil, scallion, fresh ginger, garlic clove, red bell pepper, snow peas, baby corn, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: If there's time, place steak in freezer for 10-20 minutes to make slicing easier Holding knife at 45-degree angle, thinly slice steak. Step 2: Toss steak with 1 t Soy sauce in small bowl and let stand 10-20 minutes. Step 3: Heat large wok or skillet over high heat 30 seconds. Step 4: Add oil and swirl to coat surface. Step 5: Heat just until oil starts to smoke. Step 6: Add scallion, ginger, and garlic and heat until fragrant, about 20 seconds. Step 7: Add beef and stir-fry until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Step 8: Add pepper and peas and stir-fry just until pepper wilts, about 20 seconds.

Dish Name: Sliced Beef With Black Beans Chinese Broccoli On Rice
Ingredient Names: flank steak, broccoli, peanut oil, preserved black beans, ginger, cornstarch, stock, rice wine, sugar, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, garlic cloves, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Preparation 2. Step 2: Slice the meat at an angle and into thin bite size pieces, then add to a bowl 3. Step 3: Add to the meat bowl, 2 tablespoons oil, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon rice wine, sugar, 2 teaspoons cornstarch, salt & pepper to taste, mix well and let sit for 20 minutes 4. Step 4: Remove and discard the leafy part of the chinese broccoli, cut the stems at an angle and into bite side pieces, set a side 5. Step 5: In a cup add the dried salted black beans, rinse briefly and discard the water, add 2 tablespoons rice wine to cover, let sit for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sirloin, soy sauce, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, sugar, cornstarch, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange sliced meat in bottom of crock pot. Step 2: Combine soy sauce, garlic cloves, ginger, sugar, cornstarch and sesame oil in blender Process until smooth. Step 3: Pour mixture over meat in crock pot. Step 4: Cook on low for 6-8 hours High for 3-4 hours.

Ingredient Names: beef round steak, soy sauce, ground ginger, honey, orange juice, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, green onions, bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat in a zip top bag with soy sauce, ginger, honey and orange juice. Step 2: Refrigerate overnight. Step 3: Transfer contents of bag to 4 qt slow cooker. Step 4: Add peppers, onions and bok choy. Step 5: Cover and cook on low 6-7 hours or high 3-4 hours, until meat is very tender, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Spareribs In Sweet N Sour Sauce
Ingredient Names: spareribs, vegetables, light soy sauce, salt, white pepper, chinese white rice vinegar, sugar, tomato ketchup, vegetable oil, green pepper, onion, carrot, garlic, gingerroot, pineapple chunks
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the marinade ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Add spareribs, let marinade for at least 20 minutes. Step 3: In a bowl, mix together the vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and ketchup, set aside. Step 4: Heat enough oil in wok to deep fry spareribs Deep fry ribs for about 8 minutes. Step 5: Drain and set aside. Step 6: Remove all but 1 tablespoon of oil from wok. Step 7: Then stir fry the green pepper, onion, and carrot for about 3 minutes, remove from wok and set aside. Step 8: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to wok. Step 9: Fry the garlic and ginger root until fragrant.

Dish Name: Spicy Beef Filet in Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, oyster sauce, cornstarch, beef tenderloin, water, sugar, black pepper, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together vegetable oil, oyster sauce, and cornstarch in a bowl. Step 2: Add beef and toss to coat. Step 3: Marinate in the refrigerator 30 to. Step 4: Remove from the refrigerator before cooking. Step 5: Stir together water, cornstarch, oyster sauce, and pepper in a small bowl; set aside. Step 6: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat. Step 7: Stir in onion, and cook until it beings to brown on the edges, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Add the beef, and continue cooking and stirring until the beef is just slightly pink, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Pour in the sauce; cook and stir until the sauce has thickened and turned translucent, about more.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, rice vinegar, dark soy sauce, black bean sauce, sesame oil, sambal oelek, flank steaks, five-spice powder, sugar, garlic cloves, egg, brown onion, broccoli, carrot, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cornstarch with vinegar and half of the sauces. Step 2: Marinate beef in bowl with five spice, sugar, garlic, egg and sauce mixture for an hour. Step 3: Heat half the oil in a wok. Step 4: Stir-fry beef in batches, leaving the excess marinade in the bowl. Step 5: Set cooked beef aside. Step 6: Heat remaining oil in wok and stir-fry onion until soft. Step 7: Add carrot and bell pepper and cook for a further minute, leaving the vegetables crispy. Step 8: Return beef to wok with broccoli and snow peas. Step 9: Add the saved marinade, the rest of the sauces and the stock. Step 10: Cook, stirring often, until sauce biols and thickens slightly.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, oranges, chili sauce, red pepper flakes, black pepper, sugar, fresh garlic cloves, soy sauce, red bell peppers, onions, cremini mushroom, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix together the first 9 ingredients, cover, and refrigerate over night or at least 6 hours soak kabob skewers in water for 5 minutes Skewer all of the ingredients in a chosen order and sprinkle with salt meanwhile, preheat grill to about 400f. Step 2: Grill for about 10 minutes or until the meat is cooked through, basting with the orange marinade through and after cooking.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin, orange juice, seasoned rice vinegar, soy sauce, hot chile paste, brown sugar, garlic, water, cornstarch, orange zest, green onions, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, orange juice, rice vinegar, soy sauce, hot chili paste, brown sugar, and garlic in a large bowl. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate for 1 to. Step 3: Strain beef in a colander set over a large bowl, allowing beef to drain thoroughly, about 5 minutes, reserve marinade. Step 4: Stir water and cornstarch into the bowl of marinade. Step 5: Whisk until cornstarch is dissolved, set aside. Step 6: Spray skillet with cooking spray and place over high heat. Step 7: Cook beef for without stirring; cook and stir for an additional minute. Step 8: Stir in light parts of green onion and orange zest; cook for 30 seconds. Step 9: Stir in marinade and green onion tops; cook and stir until beef is no longer pink inside and sauce is reduced and thick, about 2 to. Step 10: Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, minced garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, onions, gingerroot, steak, chicken broth, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, beef broth, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, cornstarch, sesame oil, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok to 375f and then add oil. Step 2: Stir-fry garlic, ginger, red pepper, and onion until soft and translucent. Step 3: Add beef and stir-fry until beef is light brown and lightly springy to touch In bowl combine 1 / 4 cup chicken broth, hoisin sauce, beef broth and soy sauce. Step 4: Stir broth mixture into beef / onion mixture. Step 5: Cover and reduce heat. Step 6: Simmer for 10-15 minutes Dissolve cornstarch in remaining 1 / 4 cup of chicken broth. Step 7: Stir cornstarch mixture into wok. Step 8: Cook until sauce thickens.

Ingredient Names: round steak, soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, cornstarch, oil, hoisin sauce, cayenne, celery, carrot, green onions, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 4 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 2 tablespoons oil, white pepper, and cornstarch to form marinade. Step 2: Add beef and let stand 30 minutes, or longer. Step 3: Combine 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, hoisin sauce, and cayenne Reserve. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in skillet over high heat. Step 5: Add beef and stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile add vegetables to meat. Step 7: Stir fry until just done, crisp tender. Step 8: Add prepared sauce. Step 9: Cook until heated through, about 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, extra-lean ground beef, eggplants, red chile, garlic, shiitake mushrooms, green onions horizontally, oyster sauce, brown sugar, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a drop of the oil in a non-stick wok or large frying pan. Cook the mince, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, for about 10 mins, or until cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil in the pan and fry the aubergine for about 10 mins, until tender and cooked through. Add half the chilli, the garlic and mushrooms, then cook for a further few mins. Return the mince to the pan and add most of the spring onions, the oyster sauce, sugar and 200ml water. Bubble for a few mins, then serve immediately with boiled rice and the remaining chilli and spring onions scattered on top.

Ingredient Names: egg noodles, steak, red bell pepper, garlic clove, sesame oil, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, adobo seasoning, garlic powder, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut bell pepper into thin strips and fry until the texture is soft. Step 2: Add scallions about 5 minutes after the bell pepper While the bell pepper is cooking cut steak into thin strips Coat with a little vegetable oil and then with adobo powder, worcestershire sauce, and add garlic powder if you'd like. Step 3: Add to peppers and scallions and cook until it is no longer red. Step 4: Boil noodles according to directions, strain and add to steak and peppers. Step 5: Add soy sauce little by little tasting in between to make sure you did not put in too much. Step 6: Add the sesame oil and mix well Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, sirloin steaks fat, fresh broccoli, garlic, sugar snap peas, green onions, pak choi leaves, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok or deep frying pan, then sizzle the beef strips for 3-4 mins until browned. Remove and set aside. Step 2: Toss the broccoli and garlic into the wok with a splash of water, then fry over a high heat for 4-5 mins until starting to soften. Add the peas, spring onions and pak choi, then stir-fry for another 2-3 mins, then stir in the hoisin sauce and beef. Heat through quickly, adding a splash of water if it seems a little dry. Great with noodles or rice.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Beef And Broccoli With Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: flank steak, soy sauce, dry sherry, low sodium chicken broth, oyster sauce, light brown sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch, garlic cloves, ginger, peanut oil, broccoli, water, red bell pepper, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the beef and soy sauce in a medium bowl. Step 2: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 10 minutes or up to 1 hour, stirring once. Step 3: Meanwhile, whisk the sherry, chicken broth, oyster sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and cornstarch in a measuring cup. Step 4: Combine the garlic, ginger and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons peanut oil in small bowl. Step 5: Drain the beef and disgard the liquid. Step 6: Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons peanut oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over high heat until smoking. Step 7: Add half of the beef to the skillet and break up clumps. Step 8: Cook without stirring, 1 minute, then stire and cook until beef is browned about the edges, about 30 seconds. Step 9: Transfer the beef to a medium bowl Addd 1 1 / 2 teaspoons peanut oil to the skillet, heat until just smoking, and repeat with the remaining beef.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, peanut oil, salt, sugar, pepper, garlic clove, fresh snow pea, bok choy, green onions, water chestnuts, cornstarch, cold water, dry sherry, soy sauce, chinese noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Pat steak dry with paper towels Partially freeze beef, about 15 minutes, in order to make slicing it easier. Step 2: Then, using sharp knife, cut steak in half lengthwise, then cross-wise, on diagonal, into slices 1 / 8 inch thick. Step 3: Set aside In large shallow bowl, toss steak slices with 1 tablespoon peanut oil, salt, sugar, pepper and minced garlic, mix well. Step 4: Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes. Step 5: Rinse snow peas under cold water. Step 6: Drain With fingers, remove stem ends and strings.

Ingredient Names: beef steak, peanut oil, onions, garlic, spring onions, light soy sauce, sesame oil, rice wine, cornstarch, curry paste, dark soy sauce, sugar, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Place beef in a bowl. Step 2: Add all marinade ingredients and allow to marinate for 20 minutes Pre-heat wok until very hot. Step 3: Add the peanut oil, and heat until oil smokes a little. Step 4: Then stir-fry beef until lightly browned. Step 5: Remove from wok and drain well in a colander set inside a bowl to reserve oil Wipe the wok clean and re-heat over high heat. Step 6: Return 1 tablespoon of reserved oil to the wok, and stir-fry the onions and garlic for 1 minute. Step 7: Mix in all ingredients listed under sauce, and let mixture simmer for 3 minutes. Step 8: Return the beef to the wok and toss to coat thoroughly with sauce.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Beef With Bok Choy
Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, vegetable oil, cornstarch, salt, sugar, soy sauce, white pepper, bok choy, green onions, cold water, gingerroot, garlic, chicken broth, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from beef. Step 2: Cut beef with grain into 2-inch strips. Step 3: Cut strips across grain into 1 / 8-inch slices. Step 4: Toss beef, 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1 teaspoon salt, the sugar, soy sauce and white pepper in glass or plastic bowl. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes Separate bok choy leaves from stems. Step 6: Cut leaves into 2-inch pieces. Step 7: Cut stems diagonally into 1 / 4-inch slices. Step 8: Cut green onions into 2-inch pieces. Step 9: Mix 2 tablespoons cornstarch and the water.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Beef With Garlic And Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, garlic cloves, steak fillets, beef stock, cornflour, cracked black pepper, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok over medium high heat until hot. Step 2: Add 3tsp oil Swirl to coat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic. Step 4: Stir-fry 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Transfer to bowl Increase heat to high, add 3 tsp oil and half the beef. Step 6: Stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 7: Remove from wok to plate. Step 8: Repeat with remaining beef.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Beef With Green Beans
Ingredient Names: flank steak, cornstarch, salt, sherry wine, soy sauce, green beans, sugar, oil, garlic clove, fresh ginger, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve the 2 tsp cornstarch into the 1 / 2 cup chicken broth and 1 tsp soy sauce. Step 2: Marinate beef in cornstarch, sherry, salt, and soy sauce mixture for 30 minutes. Step 3: Cook beans in 1 cup boiling water for 3 minutes. Step 4: Rinse in cold water. Step 5: Heat oil in preheated wok Brown garlic and ginger and remove. Step 6: Add beef and stir-fry until colour changes. Step 7: Add beans, sugar, salt and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 8: Add dissolved cornstarch and stir-fry until thickened.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, soy sauce, olive oil, cornstarch, sugar, broccoli, fresh shiitake mushroom, green onions, water, dry sherry, fish sauce, oriental sesame oil, salt, fresh ginger, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: With a sharp knife, cut beef across the grain into slices about 3 inches long and 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: In a bowl, combine the beef, soy sauce, 1 tbls Oil, 1 teaspoons cornstarch, and 1 / 2 teaspoons sugar. Step 3: Set aside to marinate 15 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, with paring knife, cut a thin slice off the bottom of each broccoli stalk and discard the dried end. Step 5: Remove any leaves and, from cut end, pull thick, fibrous skin upward toward flowerets to remove. Step 6: Cut broccoli flowerets off stalks into 2 1 / 2 inch lengths Split broccoli flowerets lengthwise into thinner pieces if stalks are thicker than 1 / 2 inch. Step 7: Cut remaining peeled stalks diagonally into thin slcies. Step 8: Cut mushroom caps into 1 / 4 inch thick slices.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Garlic Beef With Broccoli
Ingredient Names: round steak, garlic, medium sherry, cornstarch, lite olive oil, broccoli, chicken stock, green onions, small mushrooms, soy sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the steak very thinly, the easiest way to do this is to have it half frozen when you slice it. Step 2: Put sliced steak in a bowl with the sherry, soy sauce and the cornstarch, and a little salt, let it rest for 20 minutes. Step 3: Put 2 tbsp oil in a skillet. Step 4: Add garlic, stir fry for 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add mushrooms stir fry 2 minutes. Step 6: Remove and keep warm. Step 7: Put 2 tbsp of oil in the skillet and stir fry the beef until nicely browned, remove and keep warm. Step 8: Add 1 tbsp oil and stir fry the green onions for 1 min, remove and keep warm. Step 9: Pour in the chicken stock, heat to bubbling add broccoli cover and steam for 3- 4 minutes. Step 10: Remove lid and put all the ingredient together.

Dish Name: Stir Fry Beef With Cauliflower And Peas
Ingredient Names: flank steak, salt, cornstarch, peanut oil, cauliflower, carrot, water, frozen peas, sherry wine, light soy sauce, chicken stock, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef with 1 / 2 tsp of salt, cornstach, and 1 t Of the oil. Step 2: Mix well with your hands. Step 3: Cook cauliflower and carrot in boiling water for 8 minutes. Step 4: Drain well Plunge peas into boiling water for 5 seconds: rinse with cold water and drain. Step 5: Heat 2 t Of oil over medium-high heat in wok. Step 6: Stir-fry beef 1 minute: add sherry and cook 1 minute. Step 7: Remove and set aside.

Dish Name: Stir Fry Chilli Beef In Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: cooking oil, steak, soya sauce, oyster sauce, five-spice powder, ginger, garlic cloves, mixed vegetables, chilies, sesame oil, salt, water, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the steak up really thin and place in a bowl to marinade with the light soya sauce, oyster sauce and the five spice powder, cover and put it in the fridge. Step 2: Prepare the vegetables which can consist of a combination of bean shoots, red capsicum, bok choy, chinese leaf, baby corn, spring onions, asparagus, broccoli, celery (the asparagus and broccoli need to be blanched for 2 minutes, drained and allowed to cool For the sauce mix the water, dark soya sauce, sesame oil and cornflour together. Step 3: Heat the wok, adding some of the oil - stir fry the vegetables along with the garlic, ginger and the chillies for a few minutes adding some salt if necessary. Step 4: Place in a hot dish and add more oil to the wok and stir fry the beef, taking care to stir frequently, add the sauce and as soon as it starts to thicken add the vegetables back into the wok, stir to coat. Step 5: Serve immediately either with fried rice or plain boiled noodles Delicious.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, lean ground beef, pork mince, garlic, ginger, water chestnuts, spring onions, oyster sauce, tamari, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine meat in bowl. Step 2: Heat pan, add oil Brown meat. Step 3: Add greated garlic and greated ginger, cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Add water chestnuts and finely chopped spring onion Stirring for 1 minute. Step 5: Add oyster sauce and tamari, cook 2 minutes, combine well.

Ingredient Names: instant brown rice, salt, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, boneless sirloin steak, orange rind, fresh orange juice, cornstarch, low sodium soy sauce, dark sesame oil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Step 2: Combine rice and salt, tossing well. Step 3: Combine garlic, pepper, and beef, tossing well. Step 4: Combine rind, juice, cornstarch, and soy sauce, stirring with a whisk. Step 5: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add beef mixture and onions Saut 2 minutes, add juice mixture. Step 7: Cook 2 minutes or until sauce thickens, stirring frequently. Step 8: Serve beef mixture over rice.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, salt, pepper, garlic powder, worcestershire sauce, honey, ketchup, plum jam, sugar, red pepper flakes, ground ginger, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, mix together all of the meatball ingredients. Step 2: Shape into 1-inch balls and set aside. Step 3: In a small bowl, stir together all of the sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 4: Heat a wok or large sauce pan on medium-high with just a little oil in it. Step 5: Saute / stir fry the meatballs until all browned. Step 6: Pour the sauce over them and cook on low heat for 3 minutes. Step 7: Serve over rice for pour into a bowl, cover and refrigerate until needed.

Ingredient Names: walnut halves, sugar, canola oil, salt, beef tenderloin, sesame oil, chili oil, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, lemon juice, cilantro, ginger, orange zest, garlic, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Place 3 cups of water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add walnuts, return to boil and cook for 1 minute. Step 3: Drain, rinse under warm water and drain again. Step 4: Transfer to large bowl, pour sugar over and stir until dissolved Deep fry nuts at 350 for about 5 minutes or until golden, remove to a colander, salt and stir every few minutes to keep from sticking. Step 5: Spread on paper towel to cool Will keep for about 2 weeks in tightly covered container. Step 6: Grill beef, rest and cut on bias into thin strips. Step 7: Combine canola, sesame oil, chili oil, soy, vinegar, lemon juice, cilantro, zest, ginger and garlic in bowl, whisk to blend.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, cornstarch, peanut oil, orange, dried hot peppers, onion, sliced water chestnuts, garlic, green onion, rice wine, sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, oyster sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Theorange: with vegetable peeler, cut zest from orange into long pieces. Step 2: Cut pieces into thin strips Dry slightly in microwave oven. Step 3: Slice the orange for garnish Steak should be frozen, but still pliable for easier slicing, slice in strips across the grain Coat the meat completely with cornstarch and set aside. Step 4: Combine dried orange peel in a small dish with hot pepper. Step 5: Cut onion and combine in another small dish with water chestnuts Mince garlic and green onion Sauce: combine rice wine, sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, and oyster sauce in a small bowl.

Ingredient Names: cornflour, water, oil, garlic, onion, red chili paste, minced beef, cooking wine, hoisin sauce, salt, pepper, beef stock, hong kong noodles, fried onions, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve corn flour in water to get corn flour solution. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan, lightly fry the garlic, onion and chili paste until fragrant. Step 3: Add the beef and fry for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the wine, hoisin sauce, salt and pepper and cook for another 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the stock, bring to boil and thicken with corn flour solution. Step 6: Pour the sauce over the cooked noodles. Step 7: Garnish with sliced spring onion, coriander leaves and chili padi Ready to serve.

Dish Name: Szechuan Noodles With Spicy Beef Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, garlic, fresh ginger, dry crushed red pepper, sesame oil, cornstarch, beef broth, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, vermicelli, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef in a large skillet, stirring until it crumbles. Step 2: Drain and keep warm. Step 3: Pour sesame oil in pan and heat till hot. Step 4: Saute onion and next 4 ingredients hot sesame oil until tender. Step 5: Combine cornstarch and beef broth, whisking until smooth. Step 6: Stir broth mixture, hoisin sauce, and soy sauce into onion mixture. Step 7: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 8: Boil, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Step 9: Stir in ground beef. Step 10: Toss with hot cooked pasta, and sprinkle with sliced green onions.

Ingredient Names: beef steak, peanut oil, dried red chili peppers, dark soy sauce, rice wine, gingerroot, cornstarch, sesame oil, orange juice, dried orange peel, szechuan peppercorns, salt, sugar, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix all marinade ingredients well and let meat marinate in mixture for 20 minutes. Step 2: Combine sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 3: Heat wok over high heat, then add peanut oil. Step 4: Remove beef from marinade and stir-fry until browned. Step 5: Remove and let drain through a sieve. Step 6: Pour most of the oil out of the wok, reserving about 2 teaspoons Reheat the oil, and when it's very hot and smoking slightly, add the dried chili peppers and stir-fry for about 10 seconds. Step 7: Return the beef to the pan and add sauce. Step 8: Stir-fry for 3 minutes, mixing well.

Ingredient Names: beef rump, hot bean paste, light soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, ginger, oil, celery ribs, carrot, onion, green bell pepper, dried red chilies, garlic, sesame oil, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut partially frozen beef into thin slices, then julienne into a fine shred, set aside. Step 2: Mix bean paste, soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, and ginger. Step 3: Pour over beef in shallow dish or plastic bag, coating meat well. Step 4: Marinate meat 2 hours. Step 5: Cut celery, carrot, and green pepper into thin shreds. Step 6: Cut onion into thin slivers, and set aside. Step 7: Heat 1 tbsp oil in wok and add dried chilies and minced garlic. Step 8: Cook until aromatic, then add vegetables. Step 9: Stir-fry vegetables 2 minutes then remove from wok.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, soy sauce, chicken stock, oyster sauce, chili sauce, white sugar, ground black pepper, water, cornstarch, green onions, fresh ginger root, garlic, lean ground beef, shrimp, peeled and deveined, sesame oil, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Remove eggplant stem and cut flesh into 1-inch cubes, set aside. Step 2: Mix together soy sauce, stock, oyster sauce, chili sauce, sugar, and black pepper in a medium bowl until well combined; set aside. Step 3: Stir together water and cornstarch in a small bowl until smooth; set aside. Step 4: Coat a large, deep pan with cooking spray over high heat and heat until very hot, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Cook and stir 1/2 of the green onions, ginger, and garlic in the hot pan until lightly browned, 3 to. Step 6: Add beef; cook and stir until lightly browned and crumbly, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Stir in eggplant, then pour soy sauce mixture over all. Step 8: Cover the pan, reduce heat to medium low, and let simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 9: Add shrimp during the last few minutes of cooking. Step 10: Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook until thickened. Step 11: Mix in remaining green onions and sesame oil. Step 12: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef top sirloin steak, low sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, water, cornstarch, fresh gingerroot, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh ground black pepper, chili powder, vegetable oil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Slice steak into thin slices, cutting across grain. Step 2: In a small bowl, stir next eight ingredients together until smooth. Step 3: Heat oil in a hot wok or deep skillet. Step 4: Add garlic and beef strips. Step 5: Stir-fry over high heat for 3-4 minutes or until cooked to the medium stage Quickly stir in sauce, continue to stir until sauce has lightly thickened and is bubbly. Step 6: Serve immediately over rice Crisp snow peas make the perfect accompaniment.

Dish Name: Szechwan Beef Stir Fry Us Family Style
Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, reduced sodium soy sauce, dark sesame oil, sugar, cornstarch, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, crushed red pepper flakes, red bell pepper, baby corn, pea pods, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut steak lengthwise into 2 strips. Step 2: Slice across the grain into 1 / 8-inch strips. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, 2 teaspoons oil, sugar and cornstarch, stir into strips. Step 4: Heat remaining 2 teaspoons sesame oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper, cook 30 seconds. Step 6: Add bell pepper and corn. Step 7: Stir-fry 1 1 / 2 minutes, add pea pods.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, oil, ground pork, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, fresh ginger, garlic, hot red peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Pare eggplant and cut into 2-inch strips. Step 2: In a wok or skillet, heat oil to 450f fry eggplant until soft. Step 3: Remove from oil and set aside. Step 4: Pour out all but 1 teaspoon of the oil. Step 5: Fry meat for 1 minute, stir in eggplant. Step 6: Combine remaining ingredients and stir into eggplant mixture, cook 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, soy sauce, sherry wine, pepper, egg yolk, sesame oil, tangerines, cornstarch, dried red chilies, onions, orange juice, beef broth, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Slice steak against grain and pound with tenderizer. Step 2: Combine 1 tbs soy sauce, 1 tbs sherry, pepper, egg yolk, and sesame oil. Step 3: Marinate beef in mixture Peel tangarines. Step 4: Boil peel and shred Coat the beef with cornstarch. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok and brown beef, remove the beef. Step 6: Add the chilis to the hot oil and stir-fry. Step 7: Add tangerine peel and onion and stir-fry.

Dish Name: Tasty Beef Sugar Snap Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: sirloin steaks, reduced sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, gingerroot, garlic cloves, peanut oil, sugar snap peas, chestnut mushrooms, spring onion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Put the strips of beef in a shallow, non metallic dish. Step 2: Mix the soy sauce vinegar, honey, garlic & ginger together & pur over the beef. Step 3: Cover, place in the refridgerator & marinate over night or for at least 1 hour. Step 4: Heat the oil in a wok or deep frying pan & add the sugar snap peas & mushrooms. Step 5: Stir fry for 3-4 minutes, then remove vegetables with a slotted spoon & set aside. Step 6: Remove the beef from the marinade & add to the wok / pan. Step 7: Stir fry for 2-3 minutes, then add the vegetables along with the marinade & spring onions to the wok. Step 8: Stir fry for 1 minute. Step 9: Divide between 4 bowls, serve with noodles & scatter the sesame seeds over the top of each portion.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin steak, green onions, celery, red pepper, water chestnut, carrot, baby corn, cashews, chow mein noodles, peanut oil, soy sauce, dry sherry, sesame oil, garlic cloves, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine marinade ingredients in a bowl and add beef. Step 2: Toss and let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Step 3: Stir water into cornstarch in a small bowl. Step 4: Add osyter sauce and stir. Step 5: Set aside Toast the cashews while preparing the vegetables by laying them out on a single layer on a shallow pan. Step 6: Bake at 350f for 5-10 minutes, stirring or shaking often. Step 7: Heat wok until hot, add peanut oil and let it get hot. Step 8: Add the beef with the marinade and green onions. Step 9: Stir-fry until done, about 3 - 4 minutes, and transfer to a plate.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, onion, vegetable oil, low sodium beef broth, teriyaki sauce, fresh gingerroot, carrot, fresh broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat and stir fry the beef together with the onions until beef is just barely pink, but browned on all sides Do not cook all the way through. Step 2: Now add broth, teriyaki sauce and ginger root. Step 3: Bring the meat and sauce to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Step 4: Cover and simmer until meat is done, about 10-15 minutes During the last 5 minutes of cooking time, add carrots and broccoli, cover skillet again and cook until veggies are done to your liking.

Ingredient Names: beef, salt & freshly ground black pepper, vegetable oil, carrot, onion, water, beer, soy sauce, diced tomatoes with juice, pearl barley, unsalted butter, button mushrooms, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Season the meat generously with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large soup pot over medium-high heat Brown the beef for about 4 minutes, or until it is seared on all sides, then remove it from the pot. Step 3: Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in the pot over medium heat and saut the carrot and onion for about 10 minutes, or until the onion turns slightly translucent. Step 4: Add the water, beer, soy sauce, and beef to the pot. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then decrease the heat and simmer gently, covered, for 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 6: Add the tomatoes with their juice, the barley, butter, and mushrooms to the pot and cook for an additional 30 minutes, or until the barley is tender. Step 7: Season with salt to taste and stir in the cilantro just before serving.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, rice wine, sugar, soy sauce, gingerroot, pepper, cornstarch, oil, chicken broth, sesame oil, ketchup, green onions, green pepper, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cut flank steak into thin strips about 2 inches long. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine wine, sugar, soy sauce, ginger, pepper, cornstarch, and oil. Step 3: Add meat strips and toss to coat. Step 4: Let marinate for 30 minutes. Step 5: In a small bowl, combine the broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar and ketchup, set aside. Step 6: Place wok over high heat and add 1 / 4 cup of oil. Step 7: Stir fry beef for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 8: Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to a large bowl. Step 9: Add remaining 1 / 4 cup of oil and heat.

Ingredient Names: meatballs, catalina dressing, ketchup, plum jam, mustard, soy sauce, ground ginger, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, cold water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saute pan, add about 2 tablespoons of oil and brown the meatballs for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile stir together the rest of the ingridients. Step 3: After meatballs are browned, pour the sauce over the meatballs and let boil over medium-high heat are 5-8 minutes while stirring it occasionally. Step 4: Serve over rice or buttered egg noodles.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, top round beef, bell peppers, onion, garlic cloves, low sodium beef broth, dry red wine, low sodium soy sauce, cornstarch, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer meat with its juice to a plate. Step 4: Heat the remaining 2 tsp of oil in the same skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the peppers and onion and cook, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the garlic and continue cooking until the peppers are softened and the onions are trasnlucent, about 5 minutes more. Step 7: Return the beef and juices to the skillet and add the broth, wine, soy sauce and pepper, bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce the heat and simmer until the liquid has reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Stir in the dissolved cornstarch and cook until the mixture thuickens, about 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: barley flour, daikon radish, beef broth, peanut oil, onion, boneless beef round steak, water, soy sauce, baby spinach leaves, butter
Instructions: Step 1: To make sure your flour is fine enough, pass it through a fine sieve and set aside Peel the daikon radish and grate into long strands, set aside. Step 2: Pour 3 cups of the broth into a wide, heavy pot and bring to a boil. Step 3: Add roasted flour and stir until smooth. Step 4: Add remaining 3 cups broth and bring to a boil. Step 5: Add radish strands and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Bring the 2 tablespoons of oil or butter in a skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Add the onion and saute gently for several minutes. Step 8: Add the meat strips and 1 / 2 tablespoon soy sauce, raise the heat to medium-high and cook, turning once, just until the beef has changed color, about 3 minutes total.

Ingredient Names: oil, lamb, onion, carrot, salt, water, rice, bulb of garlic, red hot pepper, cumin, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pot. Step 2: Set the stove temperature at 7 / 10 at highest. Step 3: Cook the meat in the oil, stirring occasionally until evenly browned. Step 4: Add the chopped onion to the pot, still stirring, and cook until it is translucent. Step 5: Stir carrots into the pot. Step 6: Add salt according to your taste. Step 7: Pour water into the pot. Step 8: When the water boils, add the hot pepper and whole garlic bulb. Step 9: Let them simmer in the mixture for five minutes, and then fish them back out and set them aside, add cumin.

Dish Name: Vegetable And Beef Stir Fry With Brown Rice
Ingredient Names: brown rice, flank steak, peanut oil, dry sherry, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, fresh ginger, garlic, scallions, snow peas, yellow squash, red bell pepper, hot red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, slice steak 1 / 4-inch thick, then cut slices crosswise in half. Step 3: Whisk 1 t Peanut oil, the sherry, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, and half the ginger and garlic in small bowl. Step 4: Add steak and toss to combine. Step 5: Heat 1 t Peanut oil in large heavy skillet over high heat until a drop of water evaporates on contact. Step 6: Add remaining ginger, garlic, and the scallions. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-high. Step 8: Stir-fry 1 minute.

Dish Name: Weight Watchers Beef And Broccoli Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, salt, sirloin, canola oil, reduced-sodium chicken broth, broccoli florets, gingerroot, garlic, red pepper flakes, low sodium soy sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 2 tablespoons cornstarch with the salt. Step 2: Add beef and toss to coat. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat and add beef. Step 4: Stir-fry about 4 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Step 5: Transfer to bowl with slotted spoon and keep warm. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 cup broth to the pan and stir to loosen any bits of food on bottom. Step 7: Add broccoli, cover and cook. Step 8: Toss occasionally and sprinkle with water if necessary until broccoli is crisp-tender. Step 9: Add ginger, garlic and red pepper flakes and stir-fry for about 1 minute Until fragrant.

Ingredient Names: water, chicken broth, broccoli, carrots, green onion, steak, yellow onion, garlic cloves, ground pork, salt, pepper, soy sauce, wonton wrapper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients from part 1 in a large enamel pot and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 2: Mix together the onion, garlic, pork, salt and pepper, and soy sauce in a medium bowl Lay out 10 won ton wrappers and place 1 tsp of meat mixture in the center of each Moisten the edges with water, fold and seal. Step 3: Take the two opposing points and pinch together. Step 4: Set aside and repeat until mixture is used up. Step 5: Add won ton's to part 1, bring to a lazy boil and cook for 15 minutes. Step 6: Serve with hot oil.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic cloves, beef round steak, water, splenda sugar substitute, red peppers, olive oil, carrots, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, and minced garlic. Step 2: Stir in beef strips. Step 3: Let stand for at least 10 minutes. Step 4: In a separate small bowl, mix together water, soy sauce, 2 1 / 2 teaspoons cornstarch, splenda, and red pepper, set aside. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over high heat. Step 6: Cook and stir beef in hot olive oil for 1 minute. Step 7: Remove, and set aside. Step 8: Heat remaining tablespoon of olive oil in the same pan. Step 9: Saute carrots and white part of green onions for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rump beef steak, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, garlic, sugar, baking soda, canola, green onion stems, green beans, fish sauce, eggs, sesame oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate beef 1 hour. Cook beef in 2 tbsp oil on high in a large pan until lightly seared, add white part of green onion and beans, cook until beef is caramelised, adding garlic towards the end. Add rice and sauce, toss well. Scramble egg on side of pan, toss through green part of green onion. Eat! Step 2: Marinade & tenderise beef - Mix the marinade ingredients in a bowl then add the beef and toss well. Set aside for 1 hour (up to 24 hours), or the time specified in Note 1. Step 3: Sauce - Mix the Sauce ingredients. Set aside. Step 4: Whisk the Scrambled Egg ingredients. Set aside. Step 5: Sizzle beef - Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large non-stick pan over high heat. Add the beef and cook for 2 minutes until the surface is sealed. Add the garlic, white part of the green onion and beans. Cook for another 1 minute until the beef is caramelised, stirring constantly so it doesn't catch and burn. Step 6: Rice and sauce - Add the rice and sauce. Toss for a good 1 1/2 - 2 minutes to give the rice a chance to get toasty. Step 7: Scramble egg - shove all the rice to one side and shif the pan so the empty space is set over the flame. Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil and spread. Pour the egg, swirl, give it 10 seconds to partially set then do lazy swirls with your spatula to scramble it softly. Once mostly cooked, quickly (but gently!) toss it though the rice. Step 8: Serve - Add the green part of the green onion and toss through. Divide between bowls and.

Ingredient Names: beef broth, soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, boneless beef sirloin, salad oil, garlic, chipped gingerroot, green onions, cornstarch, water, water chestnuts, la choy crunchy chow mein noodles, baby corn, fresh broccoli
Instructions: Step 1: Combine broth, soy, sherry and sugar, set aside. Step 2: Cut beef with the grain into strips. Step 3: Place wok over med-high heat. Step 4: Add 1 tbsp of oil. Step 5: Add garlic and ginger. Step 6: Stir-fry for about 30 seconds. Step 7: Turn heat to high. Step 8: Add half the beef and onion and stir-fry until meat is lightly browned, remove from wok. Step 9: Repeat using remaining beef and onion. Step 10: Return cooked meat to wok. Step 11: Pour in broth mixture. Step 12: Cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Step 13: Mix cornstarch and water and gradually stir into wok. Step 14: Cook until slightly thickened, stirring to coat meat. Step 15: Add water chestnuts, baby corn, and broccoli. Step 16: Serve with steamed white rice and sprinkle the noodles on top.

Ingredient Names: top sirloin steaks, beef broth, soy sauce, ginger, cornstarch, butter, olive oil, sesame oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cut steak into 4 equal portions. Step 2: Place each piece between 2 pieces of plastic wrap. Step 3: With a heavy, flat-sided mallet, pound meat firmly but gently all over to a thickness of 1/3 to 1/2 inch. Step 4: In a small bowl, stir together broth, soy sauce, ginger, and cornstarch, set aside. Step 5: Melt butter in oil in a wide nonstick frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 6: When butter sizzles, add steak. Step 7: Cook, turning once, until steak is well browned on both sides and still pink in center; cut to test (2 to 3 minutes). Step 8: Transfer to a platter and keep warm. Step 9: Stir broth mixture, then add to pan, increase heat to high, and bring to a boil, stirring. Step 10: Then continue to boil and stir until slightly thickened (1 to 2 minutes). Step 11: Pour sauce over steak; drizzle with sesame oil to taste, then sprinkle with green onions.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, gingerroot, garlic, salt, red pepper flakes, fresh broccoli florets, bok choy, lemon juice, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion, ginger, garlic, salt, and red pepper flakes; stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add in broccoli and bok choy; stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Add lemon juice and sugar; stir-fry 3 minutes or until crisp-tender.

Dish Name: Chinese Steamed Fish with Ginger Shallot Sauce
Ingredient Names: bream, stems shallots, ginger julienned, japanese cooking sake, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, oil, red chili julienned
Instructions: Step 1: Cut 2 slashes on each side of the fish. Cut through to the bone. Step 2: Drizzle 1 tbsp of sake onto each fish. Step 3: Steam fish using method of choice, or bake. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat oil over medium high heat until hot. Step 5: Transfer fish onto serving plates. Top with shallots and ginger. Step 6: Sprinkle with salt, drizzle over soy sauce and sesame oil. Step 7: Pour oil over fish - enjoy the drama as it bubbles! Step 8: Sprinkle with red chilli if using and serve with rice and steamed Asian Greens. Step 9: Place fish on a plate and put plate in bamboo steamer. Repeat with other fish. Stack bamboo steamers and put lid on. Step 10: Fill wok with water, ensuring it doesn't touch the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to boil over high heat, then place bamboo steamer on wok. Step 11: Steam for 10 minutes. Carefully transfer fish onto serving places. Step 12: Wrap each fish in foil, place on tray. Bake at 180C/350F for 15 minutes. Open foil and carefully transfer fish onto serving plates. Step 13: Steamer fitted inside a large pot, or a microwave steamer.

Ingredient Names: chinese five-spice powder, sirloin steaks, bok choi, sesame oil, black bean sauce, garlic, ginger, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the sauce ingredients together in a small saucepan, then gently simmer until hot. Heat a griddle pan until very hot. Rub the five-spice all over the steak, then season with a little salt and pepper. Sear steak for 2-3 mins on each side until cooked to your liking, then leave to rest. Step 2: Meanwhile, gently simmer or steam the bok or pak choi for 4-5 mins until wilted, but still crunchy. Toss the greens in a few tbsps of sauce and the sesame oil. Cut steak into thick slices. Serve on a plate with a small pot of sauce, the greens and some steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: thai jasmine rice, sesame seeds, sunflower oil, pork fillets, red yellow pepper, cornstarch, soy sauce, limes, clear honey, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Place the rice in a saucepan with 300ml boiling water. Bring to the boil, stir once, cover with a lid and reduce the heat to low. Cook for 15 mins, by which time the rice should have absorbed all the liquid and be perfectly cooked. Dry-fry the sesame seeds until toasted golden, then tip into a small bowl and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan or wok, add the pork and peppers and stir-fry for 5-6 mins over a high heat until the pork is lightly browned and cooked through. Mix the cornflour and soy sauce together in a bowl, then add the lime juice, honey, chilli and sesame seeds, plus 6 tbsp cold water. Pour into the wok and cook until the sauce has slightly thickened, tossing the pan to coat the pork and peppers. Serve with the rice.

Ingredient Names: mazola corn oil, pork steak, onions, salt, pepper, celery, water, lachoy bean sprouts, cornstarch, lachoy soy sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Pour shortening into a hot skillet. Step 2: Add the pork steak and seer quickly. Step 3: Add onion and fry for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add celery, salt, pepper and hot water. Step 5: Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add drained, LaChoy bean sprouts. Step 7: Mix thoroughly and heat to a boiling point. Step 8: Add flavoring and thickening ingredients. Step 9: Stir lightly and cook 5 minutes. Step 10: Can be served over LaChoy chow mein noodles, or over rice.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, chili bean paste, oyster sauce, soy sauce, vegetable oil, pork fillets, garlic, red onions, green beans, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix together the lime juice, chilli bean paste, oyster sauce and half the soy sauce. Set aside. Heat a large wok with 1 tbsp of the oil. Season the pork and toss with the remaining soy sauce. Sear the meat quickly, then remove from the pan. Step 2: Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the garlic, onion and beans for 2 mins. Return the meat to the pan with the sauce and stir-fry for another 3 mins, until the sauce has thickened. Serve with steamed rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, reduced-salt soy sauce, sunflower oil, ginger, green onions, basmati rice, prepared veg, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into chunks and mix with the soy, then set aside. Heat the oil in a pan with a well-fitting lid, then add the ginger and onions and fry briefly. Stir in the rice. Add the veg, pour in the stock, then bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for 5 mins, then put the chicken on top of the rice and pour over the soy. Step 2: Re-cover the pan and cook for a further 12-14 mins until everything is tender.

Dish Name: Steamed Dumplings With Ginger Hoisin Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground pork, green onions, garlic, sesame oil, salt, pepper, dumpling wrappers, soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, sugar, peanut oil, ginger, water, cornstarch
