Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl combine pork, onions, garlic, sesame oil, salt and pepper. Step 2: Fill each wrap with a small spoonful of the pork mixture and seal with water, pressing edges and folding a bit to "ruffle" them. Step 3: Heat water to boiling, and place bamboo steamer (or sieve) lined with a large cabbage or lettuce leaf (to prevent sticking) over the pot. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Place dumplings in a single layer (not touching each other) on leaf, cover and steam for 20 minutes or so--until cooked through. Step 6: Meanwhile, make sauce. Step 7: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, hoisin, sesame oil and sugar; set aside. Step 8: In a small sauce pan, heat oil, and sauté garlic and ginger until barely golden. Step 9: Add soy mixture and heat through. Step 10: If desired, whisk cornstarch and water to make a slurry and use this to thicken the sauce. Step 11: Thickening the sauce allows for better coating of the dumplings while dipping, but is not necessary. Step 12: Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Step 13: Serve hot dumplings with sauce.

Ingredient Names: sea bass, greens, ginger, green cabbage, sunflower oil, sesame oil, garlic, low salt soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the fish with the chilli, ginger and a little salt. Steam the cabbage for 5 mins. Lay fish on top of the cabbage and steam for a further 5 mins until cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oils in a small pan, add the garlic and quickly cook, stirring until lightly browned. Transfer the cabbage and fish to serving plates, sprinkle each with 1 tsp of soy sauce, then pour over the garlicky oil.

Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, sherry, fillets sea bass, pak choi
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix all of the ingredients, except the fish and the pak choi, together to make a soy mix. Line one tier of a two-tiered bamboo steamer loosely with foil. Lay the fish, skin side up, on the foil and spoon over the soy mix. Place the fish over simmering water and throw the pak choi into the second tier and cover it with a lid. Alternatively, add the pak choi to the fish layer after 2 mins of cooking – the closer the tier is to the steam, the hotter it is. Step 2: Leave everything to steam for 6-8 mins until the pak choi has wilted and the fish is cooked. Divide the greens between two plates, then carefully lift out the fish. Lift the foil up and drizzle the tasty juices back over the fish.

Ingredient Names: plaice haddock, pak choi, green onions, red chile, ginger, reduced-salt soy sauce, limes, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Place each fillet in the centre of a large square of foil. Top with the pak choi, spring onions, chilli and ginger, then pull up the edges of the foil. Step 2: Mix together the soy sauce, lime juice and 1 tbsp of water then spoon a little over each fillet. Crimp the top of the foil to enclose the fish and make sure there are no gaps for the steam to escape. Step 3: Place the parcels on a baking sheet and bake for 10-15 mins until the fish is cooked through (this will depend on the thickness of your fish). Open up the parcels and drizzle over a few drops of sesame oil. Serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: char siu pork, peanut oil, ginger, hoisin sauce, chili paste, scallions, dry yeast, sugar, warm water, all-purpose flour, cake flour, salt, olive oil, lean pork, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: To make meat: Combine marinade. Step 2: Marinate pork at least 3 hours, or overnight Cooking methods: A) place meat on a roasting pan with a rack -- with the pan below filled with water and roast at 350 f until done or B) cook in a crock pot with 3 cups of water for 1 hour on high and then 7 hours on low or until it flakes apart or C) you could try grilling or broiling the meat, but it might lack some of the moisture that the other two methods will give you To make filling: Saut ginger in hot peanut oil, stirring constantly, for about 4 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and mix with hoisin, chili paste, green onions and meat.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, water, oil, green onion, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour and water together. Step 2: Knead it into a dough. Step 3: Combine the oil, green onion, and salt, and add to the dough. Step 4: Knead it all together, and shape the dough into a long rectangular shape Twist it, knead, twist it, knead [<- repeated process] Section the dough into 3-4sections. Step 5: Roll the dough to 5inches or less thickness Pan fry them.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, white sugar, all-purpose flour, water, warm water, salt, vegetable oil, black pepper, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, sprinkle the yeast and sugar over a mixture of 1 / 4 cup water and 1 / 4 cup flour and leave for around 15-30 minutes. Step 2: Stir in the remaining water / milk, flour, salt, sugar, pepper and oil. Step 3: Mix everything to a dough. Step 4: Turn it on to a floured work surface and knead it until it is smooth. Step 5: Return it to the bowl, cover it and leave it in a warm place for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours or until it has tripled in size Punch down the dough with the back of your fist to flatten on a floured board. Step 6: Sprinkle the baking powder over and knead for a few minutes. Step 7: Shape the dough into 24 rolls. Step 8: Keep each ball on a wax paper and let it rise for another 30 minutes You can place these balls on individual pieces of wax paper so you can use these to place in the steamer too for easier handling.

Dish Name: Chinese Wife Cake Lo Paw Bang
Ingredient Names: winter melon, sesame seeds, caster sugar, glutinous-rice flour, water, oil, high-protein flour, plain flour, golden syrup, shortening, vanilla essence, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 180c. Step 2: Mix filling ingredients. Step 3: Divide into 60g portions. Step 4: Mix water dough ingredients. Step 5: Set aside for 1 / 2 hour. Step 6: Divide into as many pieces as there are filling portions. Step 7: Mix flour and shortening. Step 8: Place in plastic wrap and place in fridge for 1 / 2 hour. Step 9: Divide into portions also. Step 10: Wrap oil dough in water dough.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, dark sesame oil, egg, green onion, peanut oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Brush 4 tortillas with sesame oil then some of egg. Step 2: Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons green onions over each tortilla. Step 3: Top each with remaining tortillas. Step 4: Press firmly around edges and cover with plastic wrap or cover with wax paper. Step 5: Place a plate on top of the cakes for 15 minutes to help seal the edges. Step 6: Let stand until ready to deep fry. Step 7: Heat oil for deep-frying in wok or deep pan to 400f. Step 8: Using tongs, slip tortilla cakes, one at a time, into hot oil. Step 9: Cook, turning with tongs, to puffy and golden brown on both sides. Step 10: Drain each cake, holding it vertically over pan.

Ingredient Names: cake flour, flour, salt, caster sugar, instant yeast, water, shortening, custard powder, wheat starch, milk, butter, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Sift cake flour, hk flour, and salt into a mixing bowl. Step 2: Combine castor sugar, yeast and water with the flours, and blend to mix well-- then knead until soft dough is formed. Step 3: Add in shortening, and continue to knead until dough is smooth and elastic Prove dough for 60-90mins until dough has risen to its limit. Step 4: Meanwhile, prepare custard filling-- combine custard powder, wheat starch, and castor sugar in a nonstock pan. Step 5: Add in milk, and stir mixture over low heat until mixed-- then add butter. Step 6: When butter is dissolved, turn off heat, and keep stirring while gradually adding the egg. Step 7: Divide dough into 12 portions, shaped into balls, cover with damp cloth, and set aside. Step 8: Using a rolling pin, roll the a ball where the edges are thinner than the center. Step 9: Add custard filling in the middle, and wrap to form a bun.

Dish Name: Mantou Baozi Steamed Bun Dough I
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, skim milk, water, sugar, peanut oil, fast rising yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the yeast and flours in a large bowl Dissolve the sugar and add the peanut oil in the water. Step 2: Add to the flour bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 3: Knead dough until it becomes a consistent ball, adding milk or more flour as needed. Step 4: Cover dough in a bowl and allow to rest 10 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove dough, pound it down, and re-knead until it forms a fully elastic dough ball. Step 6: Place ball in a greased, covered bowl and allow to rise for 40 minutes to 1 hour, until doubled or tripled in bulk. Step 7: Divide into 16-24 small dough balls, or roll out into one large flat rectangle on a floured surface Flatted dough balls with a rolling pin, or measure 3 5 inch rounds out of the pressed rectangle. Step 8: Fill each flat round with roughly 2 tbs of the filling of your choice in the center.

Dish Name: Mantou Baozi Steamed Bun Dough Ii
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, cake flour, milk, water, sugar, peanut oil, fast rising yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the yeast and flours in a large bowl Dissolve the sugar and add the peanut oil in the water, which should be 120-130 degrees. Step 2: Add water mixture to the flour bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 3: Knead dough until it becomes a consistent ball, adding milk or more flour as needed. Step 4: Cover dough in a bowl and allow to rest 10 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove dough, pound it down, and re-knead until it forms a fully elastic dough ball. Step 6: Place ball in a greased, covered bowl and allow to rise for 40 minutes to 1 hour, until doubled or tripled in bulk. Step 7: Divide into 16-24 small dough balls, or roll out into one large flat rectangle on a floured surface Flatted dough balls with a rolling pin, or measure 3 5 inch rounds out of the pressed rectangle. Step 8: Fill each flat round with roughly 2 tbs of the filling of your choice in the center.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, apple juice, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, five-spice powder, kaiser rolls, napa cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Trim any fat from the roast. Step 2: Cut the roast to fit into your slow-cooker in needed. Step 3: Put roast into slow-cooker. Step 4: In a small mixing bowl, add the apple juice, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and five-spice powder; stir to combine, pour over roast. Step 5: Cover and cook on LOW for 8-10 hours. Step 6: Take meat out of slow-cooker and place in a large bowl or on a flat surface. Step 7: Shred meat, using two forks (remove bone if there is one). Step 8: Place meat on roll bottoms. Step 9: Top with shredded cabbage; add roll tops. Step 10: Skim fat off of cooking juices. Step 11: Serve cooking juice in small bowls for dipping.

Ingredient Names: ground meat, light soy sauce, sugar, salt, chicken bouillon powder, rice wine, green onions, ginger, cold water, all-purpose flour, warm water, active dry yeast, baking powder, oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Add the soy sauce, sugar, salt, chicken powder, rice wine, spring onion and ginger to the minced pork and stir. Step 2: Add 1 tablespoons of cold water into the mixture and stir in one direction till you feel the sense of elasticity. Step 3: Set aside Dissolve sugar in the warm water, and then add the yeast. Step 4: Let stand for 10 minutes, or until mixture is frothy Sift the flour and baking powder into a mixing pan. Step 5: Stir in the yeast mixture, mix well. Step 6: Knead the dough until smooth and elastic. Step 7: Place the dough in a greased bowl, and cover it with a wet towel. Step 8: Let the dough rise in a warm place for about 1 hours, or until it has doubled in bulk.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, warm water, dry active yeast, baking powder, sugar, ground pork, celery, spring onion, soy sauce, white pepper, sesame oil, garlic, ginger paste, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the celery finely and squeeze the extra juice out. Step 2: Mix with other ingredients for the filling and stir until all the ingredients well combined, set aside. Step 3: Combine all the ingredients for the dough and mix until dough forms. Step 4: Knead the dough until smooth. Step 5: Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 60 minutes until the dough double in size Punch the dough down to release gases. Step 6: Divide dough into 10-12 equal portions, each is about 30-40 grams and let stand for 10 minutes. Step 7: Roll each dough on lightly floured surface into a circle, 13-15 cm in diameter The center of the circle should be thicker than the edge.

Ingredient Names: sugar, warm water, yeast, cake flour, all-purpose flour, shortening, vegetable oil, char siu pork, soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, sesame oil, salt and pepper, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: To make dough: dissolve sugar in warm water, add yeast. Step 2: Let stand 10 minutes as yeast foams and rises Sift flours together twice. Step 3: Place in a large bowl. Step 4: Add shortening, then slowly add the yeast mixture, incorporating it into the flour gradually Form into a ball. Step 5: Turn onto a floured surface and knead 5 to 7 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Step 6: Add more flour or water if necessary. Step 7: Place in a clean bowl and cover with a damp cloth.

Dish Name: Wok Less Yeast Less Steamed Buns
Ingredient Names: sugar, warm water, all-purpose flour, baking powder, lard, boneless lean pork, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, cornstarch, dry sherry, water, vegetable oil, onion, parchment paper
Instructions: Step 1: Dough: Dissolve sugar in warm water Sift the flour into a large mixing bowl, making a well in the center of the flour then pour the baking powder in the well Gradually pour in the water solution, stirring until all the ingredients are well combined. Step 2: Knead with lard, adding a little at a time, into the dough until smooth and elastic. Step 3: Cover and set aside Filling: Put the cut up pork in a large bowl and season with garlic, ginger, 2 teaspoons sugar, and 2 tbs Soy sauce. Step 4: Mix well and set aside.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, garlic cloves, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, red bell pepper, carrot, zucchini, chicken broth, light brown sugar, scallion, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oils in a wok over high heat. Step 2: Toss the cubed chicken breast in a bowl with the cornstarch to coat. Step 3: Add the chicken and minced garlic to the wok and stir-fry until the chicken is lightly browned. Step 4: Add the remaining ingredients except the scallions. Step 5: Cover and cook for three minutes, add the scallions. Step 6: Cover and cook for two more minutes. Step 7: Serve with hot, cooked rice or fried rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken tenders, broccoli, kosher salt, cornstarch, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, honey, red chili pepper flakes, sesame oil, garlic cloves, ginger, white rice, scallion, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Step 2: Place chicken tenders on a rimmed baking sheet and transfer to oven. Step 3: Bake until very crispy and golden, about 10 minutes beyond recommended bake time on the package. Step 4: Reduce heat to 200 degrees f to keep tenders warm until ready to serve. Step 5: Meanwhile, fill a medium pot fit with a steamer insert with 1-inch of water. Step 6: Place over medium-high heat and when water boils, add broccoli and season with salt. Step 7: Cover, and steam until broccoli is tender, about 8 minutes, keep warm. Step 8: Place cornstarch in a medium bowl. Step 9: Add rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, honey, chile flakes, and 3 tablespoons water and whisk to combine.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, chicken broth, rice wine, sugar, sesame oil, white pepper, cooking oil, garlic, ginger, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, broth, rice wine, sugar, sesame oil and white pepper. Step 2: Dissolve the cornstarch in 1/4 cup water. Step 3: Heat a pan over high heat; add the cooking oil, swirling to coat; add the garlic and ginger; cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 15 seconds. Step 4: Add the soy sauce mixture; bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and cook for 1 minute. Step 6: Add the cornstarch solution and cook, stirring, until the sauce boils and thickens.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil, egg white, soy sauce, salt, sugar, white pepper, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, flour, chicken broth, cornstarch, baking soda, slivered almonds, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: In medium bowl, mix together egg white, soy sauce, salt, sugar, pepper, cinnamon, and cloves. Step 2: Stir chicken pieces into mixture. Step 3: Marinate, covered, in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Step 4: Mix together the flour, chicken broth, cornstarch, 1 teaspoon salt, the baking soda, almonds and almond extract. Step 5: Stir chicken into batter until well coated In wok, heat 1 1 / 2-inches oil to 350f. Step 6: Fry chicken pieces, about fifteen at a time, turning frequently, until light brown. Step 7: Drain on paper towels Increase oil temperature to 375f. Step 8: Fry chicken all at once until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: white rice, chicken, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet spread out rice Layer on chicken chunks next Put butter in middle Add pepper and salt to taste Add 1 cup water Cook on low heat until finished.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, rice vinegar, cooking sherry, garlic powder, boneless skinless chicken, oil, broccoli florets, carrots, cornstarch, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, ground ginger, salted cashews, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large plastic back, combine first four ingredients. Step 2: Add chicken& toss to coat Seal& marinate in refrigerator for two hours. Step 3: Remove chicken from marinade& reserve marinade. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet. Step 5: Stir-fry chicken for 2-3 minutes or until no longer pink With a slotted spoon, remove chicken and set aside In the same skillet, stir-fry broccoli& carrots for 3 minutes or just until crisp-tender. Step 6: Combine cornstarch, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, ginger& reserved marinade. Step 7: Stir into veggies.

Dish Name: Another Kung Pao Chicken Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, cornstarch, rice wine, soy sauce, red bell pepper, cucumber, red onion, green onions, hoisin sauce, cider vinegar, oyster sauce, brown sugar, chicken stock, dried red chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Dice chicken into 1-inch pieces. Step 2: Place the chicken cubes, oil, cornstarch, wine, and soy sauce in a bag and give a quick toss before placing in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to marinate While the chicken is marinating, dice bell pepper and cucumber into 1 / 2-inch squares, dice the red onion, and chop the green onions into 1 / 2-inch pieces Mince the garlic and grate the ginger, set aside. Step 3: In a wok or any suitably large frying pan, dry-roast the dried red peppers and peppercorns until they release their aroma, set aside. Step 4: In a blender or food processor, combine hoisin sauce, soy sauce, rice wine, vinegar, oyster sauce, sugar, and chicken stock. Step 5: Toss in the roasted peppercorns and 2 dried peppers and puree until no big chunks of the dried red pepper remain and the peppercorns are pulverized If you don't have a blender or food processor or if you want to be more thorough, crush the peppers and peppercorns with a mortar and pestle, then just whisk together with the sauce in a small bowl or use the blender anyway.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, curry powder, fresh ginger, instant brown rice, dried apricot, golden raisin, chives, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, cooked chicken breasts, toasted sliced almonds, olive oil, white wine vinegar, dry sherry
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4 quart pot, bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil. Step 2: Stir in rice, cover tightly and cook over low heat for about 10 minutes until water is absorbed While the rice is cooking, combine all dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Step 3: Remove rice from heat and discard ginger. Step 4: Stir in apricots, raisins, chives, bell peppers, chicken and almonds, add dressing. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: dark brown sugar, fish sauce, ginger, red pepper flakes, soy sauce, dry sherry, garlic, scallions, boneless skinless chicken breasts, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together first 7 ingredients in a small bowl in a wok, heat 1 tsp oil until very hot stir fry the scallions until they start to look golden and remove heat remaining oil, stir fry chicken until it is browned and almost done. Step 2: Remove, pouring any juices over chicken add the mixture from the small bowl to the pan and boil until it gets syrupy add chicken and juices and cook until chicken is done and liquid looks like it is glazing the chicken remove from heat and fold in scallions.

Dish Name: Asian Chicken And Snow Pea Noodle Bowl
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, vermicelli, cooked chicken, snow peas, carrot, chili sauce, green onion, cilantro, lime juice, soy sauce, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Stir in vermicelli or other noodle, return to boil. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium high and simmer about 6 minutes. Step 4: Stir in chicken, snow peas, carrots and chili sauce. Step 5: Simmer about 2 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and stir in green onions, cilantro, lime juice, soy sauce and ginger. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, vegetable oil, cornstarch, dark soy sauce, sake, ginger juice, egg whites, green onions, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into 1 inch squares. Step 2: Combine the seasoning ingredients and marinade for about 30 minutes. Step 3: Preheat the oil to a low deep-frying temperature For the batter, beat the egg whites until frothy but not stiff. Step 4: Add the cornstarch and mix well. Step 5: Add the green onions and ginger Dredge the chicken in cornstarch and then cover well with coating mixture Deep-fry the chicken. Step 6: Remove from oil before the chicken becomes overly brown It should fry gently.

Ingredient Names: arborio rice, butter, shiitake mushrooms, garlic, ginger, shrimp, chicken broth, dry sherry, soy sauce, red bell peppers, pine nuts, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Melt 3 TBS of the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in mushrooms and saute until softened, about 5 minutes, then remove to a plate. Step 3: Melt remaining 2 TBS butter in the same saucepan. Step 4: Stir in ginger and garlic, saute until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in rice; cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Step 6: In another saucepan, combine shrimp, chicken broth,sherry and soy sauce. Step 7: Bring to a boil; remove shrimp to a bowl. Step 8: Add about a third of the hot broth to the rice. Step 9: Cook over medium heat until broth is absorbed, stirring 2 or 3 times. Step 10: Continue adding a third more broth and stirring until rice is still firm but not raw tasting, about 25 minutes. Step 11: Stir in mushrooms,red pepper, pine nuts and shrimp; heat through, for about 4 more minutes. Step 12: Stir in cilantro and serve right away. Step 13: To toast pine nuts:can pan toast or toast in a preheated 325* oven until golden-watch carefully.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, plain breadcrumbs, salt, egg, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil, distilled white vinegar, red pepper, red onion, sugar, fresh ginger, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sesame seeds, breadcrumbs, and salt in pie plate. Step 2: Beat egg in medium bowl. Step 3: Dip chicken in egg. Step 4: Dip both sides chicken in sesame seed mixture to coat. Step 5: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through, transfer to plate. Step 7: Whisk vinegar, pepper, onion, sugar, ginger, salt and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl, whisk in oil. Step 8: Toss chicken in with the dressing.

Dish Name: Asparagus Chicken With Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, soy sauce, dry sherry, sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, black bean sauce, hot chili paste, fresh ginger, garlic clove, chicken broth, oyster sauce, yellow onion, vegetable oil, fresh asparagus, water
Instructions: Step 1: For marinade: combine 2 teaspoons cornstarch, 2 teaspoons soy sauce, sherry and sesame oil in a large bowl, mix well, add chicken, stir to coat well. Step 2: Let stand 30 minutes. Step 3: Combine black bean sauce, hot chili paste, ginger and garlic, set aside. Step 4: Combine remaining 3 teaspoons cornstarch, remaining 2 teaspoons soy sauce, chicken broth and oyster sauce in a small bowl, mix well, set aside.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, salt, light soy sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, scallions, fermented black beans, shaoxing wine, dried chili pepper flakes, red bell pepper, rice vinegar, sesame oil, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into bite sized chunks. Step 2: Put them in a bowl and add salt and soy sauce. Step 3: Mix well and set aside. Step 4: Heat peanut oil in the wok over high heat. Step 5: Add the chicken and stir-fry until it changes color, then remove from the wok with a slotted spoon. Step 6: Drain off all but 3 tablespoons oil from the wok, then return it to medium heat. Step 7: Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for a few minutes until they are fragrant and the garlic cloves are tender. Step 8: Add the black beans and stir-fry until fragrant, splashing in the wine as you do so. Step 9: Add the chili flakes and stir-fry for a few moments. Step 10: Return the chicken to the wok.

Ingredient Names: whole boneless chicken breasts, light soy sauce, cooking wine, sesame oil, flour, cornstarch, water, baking powder, baking soda, brown sugar, vegetable oil, hoisin sauce, dark soy sauce, garlic cloves, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into small, approximately 1-inch cubes. Step 2: Add the marinade ingredients and marinate the chicken for at least 20 minutes While the chicken is marinating, prepare the sauce. Step 3: Mix together all of the sauce ingredients except for the green onion. Step 4: Pour them into a small pot and bring to a boil. Step 5: Turn the heat down to a low and keep warm while you are deep-frying the chicken. Step 6: Heat oil for deep-frying. Step 7: When the oil is ready, add the marinated chicken a few pieces at a time, sliding them into oil carefully, and not to overcrowd Deepfry until golden brown. Step 8: Remove the cooked chicken pieces from the oil and drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: water, butter, egg, bread flour, sugar, salt, yeast, sesame seeds, boneless skinless chicken thighs, green onion, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Add yeast to water. Step 2: Stir in 1 / 4 cup of sugar. Step 3: Allow to sit for 10 minutes until foamy. Step 4: Beat egg with 2 tbsp of butter and add to yeast mixture With mixer on low, add salt and slowly add in 31 / 2 cups of flour, one cup at a time. Step 5: Knead in mixer on low for 10 minutes or until dough is pliable. Step 6: Remove and shape as rolls, placing them on a pan lined with wax or parchment paper. Step 7: Allow to rise for 30 minutes While dough rises, heat a skillet over medium-high heat Coat pan with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, honey, hoisin sauce, warm water, salt, black pepper, garlic cloves, scallion, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Marinate chicken wings for 15 minutes in a mixture of honey, hoisin sauce, water, salt, pepper, garlic, scallion, and ginger. Step 3: Place chicken wings on a baking pan line with alum foil and bake for 30 minutes, brushing occasionally with marinade. Step 4: Turn oven to broil and broil chicken wings five more minutes. Step 5: Turn wings every two minutes to avoid burning To serve, transfer chicken wings to a serving platter and serve hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, shaoxing wine, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, star anise, sesame oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except the chicken in a saucepan or flame-proof casserole, bring to boil over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken thighs, simmer for 2 minutes, turning the chicken to coat with sauce. Step 3: Transfer pan / casserole to oven and bake uncovered for 40mins, turning once halfway through the cooking time. Step 4: Sprinkle with shredded green onions and red chilli before serving with plain jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, dark sesame oil, red bell peppers, shiitake mushroom caps, boneless skinless chicken breast half, ginger, garlic, low sodium soy sauce, chicken broth, cornstarch, sherry wine, rice vinegar, red pepper flakes, bok choy, green onions, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°. Step 2: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, omitting salt and fat (be sure to break pasta in half), drain well. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large enough skillet or wok. Step 4: Add red bell pepper strips and mushrooms, saute 2 minutes. Step 5: Add chicken, ginger, and garlic; saute 3 minutes. Step 6: Stir in soy sauce, cook 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 7: Combine broth and cornstarch, stirring well with a whisk. Step 8: Add broth mixture to pan and cook 2 minutes or until mixture is slightly thick, stirring constantly. Step 9: Remove from heat; stir in sherry, vinegar and crushed red pepper. Step 10: Add pasta, bok choy, green onions, and 2 teaspoons of the sesame seeds. Step 11: Toss well to combine and then spoon into an 8-inch square casserole dish that has been lightly coated with cooking spray. Step 12: Sprinkle remaining teaspoon of sesame seeds evenly over the pasta mixture. Step 13: Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Sesame Chicken With Soy Dip
Ingredient Names: breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, chinese five spice powder, boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg, soy sauce, lemon, lime, caster sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400 degrees and line a baking tray with baking paper. Step 2: Mix the breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, five-spice and a little seasoning on a plate Pat dry the chicken, dip into egg, then roll in the breadcumb mix. Step 3: Arrange on the baking tray, then bake for 25 to 30 minutes until crips and cooked through. Step 4: Mix the soy sauce with the citrus juices and sogar to make a dipping sauce. Step 5: Serve the chicken with little dishes of the sauce for dipping, plus lime wedges for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt and pepper, cornstarch, eggs, canola oil, sugar, ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper Working in two batches, toss the chicken pieces in cornstarch and then coat with the egg. Step 3: Heat the oil over medium-high heat and again in two batches, brown the chicken, turning it so that all sides are browned but not cooked through. Step 4: Place the chicken in a single layer in a foil lined 9x13 inch baking dish Wisk together the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Step 5: Pour sauce evenly over the chicken and turn the chicken to ensure each piece is coated. Step 6: Bake for 1 hour, turning the chicken every 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, barbecue sauce, clear honey, oyster sauce, olive oil, garlic cloves, long-grain white rice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, peanut oil, frozen peas, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the chicken thighs, barbecue sauce, honey, oyster sauce, olive oil and 2 cloves chopped garlic. Step 2: Cover and marinate in the fridge for 2-4 hours. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 375f transfer the marinated chicken to a roasting tin Roast in the oven for 40 minutes, turning now and then, until the chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Meanwhile, rinse the rice to wash out excess starch. Step 5: Place in a medium-sized heavy saucepan. Step 6: Add 1 1 / 4 cups water and season with salt. Step 7: Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover tightly and simmer over a very low heat for 15 minutes until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Step 8: Spread the rice out on a large plate to cool. Step 9: Heat a wok until very hot.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, olive oil, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, asparagus, red bell peppers, scallions, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, honey, garlic, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Place the chicken breasts on a sheet pan and rub the skin with olive oil. Step 3: Sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is just cooked. Step 4: Set aside until cool enough to handle. Step 5: Remove the meat from the bones, discard the skin, and shred the chicken in large, bite-sized pieces Blanch the asparagus in a pot of boiling salted water for 3 to 5 minutes, until crisp-tender Plunge into ice water to stop the cooking, drain. Step 6: Cut the peppers into strips about the size of the asparagus pieces.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, unsalted dry-roasted cashews, onion, red chili pepper, garlic cloves, fresh basil leaf, chicken fillets, palm sugar, salt, limes, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in a pre-heated wok. Step 2: Fry the cashew nuts until they are a light golden brown. Step 3: Remove nuts onto absorbent paper. Step 4: Heat oil again in the wok Stirfry onion and chili pepper and garlic until it is light brown. Step 5: Add 3 / 4 cup basil leaves and saute until the mixture is fragrant. Step 6: Add chicken slices and continue to stirfry all ingredients over moderate heat for approximately 2 minutes until the colour of the meat changes. Step 7: Add cashew nuts, remaining basil leaves. Step 8: Stir in the palm sugar, squeeze of lime or lemon and pinch of salt and sprinkle in the fish sauce, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Beef Chicken Curry Ramen Dinner Cole Slaw
Ingredient Names: beef, olive oil, toasted sesame oil, smooth cashew butter, plain yogurt, mayonnaise, mild green chilies, garbanzo beans, garlic cloves, dried onion flakes, soy sauce, cider vinegar, lemon juice, mild curry powder, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the thinly sliced beef or chicken pieces in olive and sesame oils until browned. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: In a very large bowl, stir together the dressing ingredients well. Step 4: Add the browned meat and coleslaw mix or shredded cabbage to the dressing and toss well to coat. Step 5: Set aside Into a bowl, break up the ramen noodles into smaller pieces. Step 6: In a saucepan, heat the amount of water according to package directions to a brisk boil and add the seasoning packets. Step 7: Add the bowl of noodles all at once to the boiling seasoned water and cook, stirring occasionally, for 90 seconds. Step 8: When noodles have cooked for 90 seconds, remove from heat and immediately drain. Step 9: Add the semi-cooked drained ramen noodles to the coleslaw and toss again to combine well.

Ingredient Names: frying chicken, teriyaki sauce, dry sherry, fresh gingerroot, fennel seed, orange peel, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Step 2: Place in large, plastic bag. Step 3: Combine teriyaki sauce, sherry, ginger, fennel, orange peel and honey, pour over chicken. Step 4: Press air out of bag. Step 5: Tie or seal top securely. Step 6: Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight, turning bag occasionally Reserving marinade, remove chicken and place on rack of broiler pan. Step 7: Heat reserved marinade to boiling, let boil 5 minutes so it will be safe for basting Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat source, about 40 minutes or until chicken is tender, turning pieces over and basting occasionally with reserved marinade.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 10 Honey Soy Braised Chicken Wings
Ingredient Names: chicken wings, peanut oil, dark soy sauce, honey, chinese wine, garlic clove, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cut wings intp three pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in wok and fry the larger joints on high heat for 3-4 minutes or until browned. Step 3: Add soy, honey, wine, garlic and ginger, stir well. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until the wings are tender Towards the end watch the wings carefully, stir frequently to make sure the glaze does not burn. Step 5: Serve warm or at room temperature.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 9 Steamedrice Bundles With Chicken And Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: medium grain rice, water, light soy sauce, sesame oil, dried chinese mushrooms, dark soy sauce, sugar, boneless skinless chicken breasts, pork, garlic, ginger, salt, cornstarch, bamboo leaves, string
Instructions: Step 1: Put rice ia a saucepan cover with the 4 cups of water, add light soy sauceand 1 teasp of sesame oil. Step 2: Bring to boil quickly, then turn heat to low cover and cook for 15 minutes While the rice cooks soak the mushrooms in very hot water for 30 minutes. Step 3: Cut off the mushroom stems and discard, slice the caps and put them in a saucepan with 3 / 4 cup of the soaking water, the dark soysauce and 2 teasp sesame oil. Step 4: Add chicken and pork to the saucepan along with the garlic, ginger and salt. Step 5: Add up to 1 / 2 cup of the mushroom water and mix the ingredients. Step 6: Cover and simmer 5 minutes Thicken gravy with the cornstarch. Step 7: Cook until gravy has thickened. Step 8: Let the mixture cool and then gently mix with the cooked rice.

Dish Name: Best Copycat Benihana Japanese Chicken Rice
Ingredient Names: cooked rice, sweet butter, garlic cloves, sesame oil, eggs, boneless skinless chicken breasts, frozen peas, frozen carrots, onion, green onion, salt, black pepper, low sodium soy sauce, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: The rice could be pre-cooked the night before and stored in fridge or cook the rice using package directions -- For this recipe you would use 4 cups of water and 2 cups of uncooked rice, pinch of salt and once you bring it to a boil, turn the heat down and cook for 20 minutes covered You must spread the rice out after it is cooked in a shallow pan and cool it off in the fridge Needs to be at room temperature or cooler. Step 2: Make your garlic and butter compound. Step 3: Put softened butter in a bowl large enough to allow you to mix the garlic into the butter Needs to be well blended Use a potato masher to mash the butter or use a hand mixer if you wish Peel garlic by hitting each clove with the side of a knife being careful and keep sharp end of knife away from you It is now easy to peel and you will do this with both cloves and then finely mince.

Ingredient Names: egg, water, butter, onion, white rice, soy sauce, black pepper, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Beat egg with water in a small bowl. Step 2: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium low heat. Step 3: Add egg and let it lie flat until cooked. Step 4: Remove from skillet and cut into shreds. Step 5: Add onion to skillet. Step 6: Saute onion until tender. Step 7: Add rice, soy sauce, pepper, and chicken. Step 8: Stir fry together for about 5 minutes then stir in egg.

Dish Name: Best Ever Sweet Sour Chicken Meatballs
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, green bell pepper, carrot, chicken broth, tomato sauce, brown sugar, distilled white vinegar, crushed pineapple in juice, ketchup, white bread, milk, ground chicken, zucchini, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large skillet. Step 2: Add onion, green pepper and carrot. Step 3: Cook 5 minutes until onion is softened. Step 4: Stir in broth, tomato sauce, brown sugar, white vinegar, pineapple with juice, and ketchup. Step 5: Simmer 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender While that's cooking, soak bread in milk in large bowl until milk is absorbed. Step 6: Mix together with chicken, zucchini, egg, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Step 7: Shape 12 meatballs, approx 2 tablespoons mixture each. Step 8: Drop meatballs into the simmering sauce, cook 15 minutes or until cooked through. Step 9: Turn over once during cooking.

Dish Name: Best General Tso's Chicken From Serious Eats
Ingredient Names: egg white, soy sauce, shaoxing wine, vodka, baking soda, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken thighs, flour, baking powder, kosher salt, rice vinegar, low sodium chicken broth, sugar, sesame seed oil, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade. Step 2: In a large bowl, beat egg whites until broken down and lightly foamy. Step 3: Add soy sauce, wine, and vodka, whisk to combine. Step 4: Set aside half of marinade in a small bowl To large bowl, add baking soda and cornstarch and whisk to combine. Step 5: Add chicken and turn with fingers to coat thoroughly. Step 6: Cover with plastic wrap and set aside Dry coat. Step 7: In a second large bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt.

Dish Name: Beth's Best Sweet And Sour Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg, cornstarch, soy sauce, white pepper, flour, water, oil, baking soda, salt, sugar, chicken broth, rice wine vinegar, vegetable oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: To make the chicken: cut the chicken into bit size nuggets. Step 2: Mix the egg, 1 tbs Cornstarch, 2 teaspoons soy sauce and white pepper in a glass or plastic bowl. Step 3: Mix in the chicken chunks, stir and cover with plastic wrap Refridgerate for at least 20 minutes, i often do overnight. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet to about 350 degrees f. Step 5: Mix 1 / 2 cup flour, 1 / 2 cup water, 1 / 4 cup cornstarch, 1 tbs Oil, salt, and 1 / 2 teaspoons baking soda for the breading into the bowl with the chicken and marinade Do not drain off the marinade! Step 6: Mix until well coated!

Dish Name: Better Than Take Out Sesame Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, brown sugar, fresh ginger, black pepper, garlic, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in about 1-inch chunks. Step 2: In a small skillet, combine sesame seed and vegetable oil: cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until seeds are golden about 2 minutes. Step 3: Let cool a for a few minutes. Step 4: Stir in soy sauce, sugar, ginger, pepper, garlic and half of the green onions. Step 5: Mix in the chicken and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Step 6: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 7: Arrange chicken with marinade in a single layer in a 7" x 5" baking pan. Step 8: Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden and cooked through. Step 9: Serve over steamed or fried rice. Step 10: Garnish with remaining green onions.

Dish Name: Bhutanese Chile Chicken With Red Rice
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, chicken breast, sesame seeds, garlic cloves, onion, chili pepper, gingerroot, soy sauce, tomatoes, red rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook whole-grain red rice according to package directions in unsalted water. Step 2: Cut the chicken into 2 5 cm cubes and toss with cornstarch making sure all pieces are totally coated If not, add a bit more cornstarch. Step 3: Heat the canola / vegetable oil over medium heat in a non-stick wok or skillet. Step 4: Cook chicken until pieces are browned on both sides and slightly crispy. Step 5: Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 6: Add 15 ml of sesame oil, sliced onions, minced garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add chopped peppers and sliced tomato wedges and cook another 2 minutes. Step 8: Return chicken to pan and heat through.

Dish Name: Black Bean Sauce Chicken With Vegetables
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, sugar, oil, chicken, assorted fresh vegetables, black bean sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cornstarch and sugar with 1 / 2 cup water. Step 2: Stir-fry chicken in oil over medium-high heat until done. Step 3: Add vegetables and black bean sauce. Step 4: Stir fry for 1 / 2 minute. Step 5: Add cornstarch mixture to the chicken-vegetable mix. Step 6: Bring to a full boil and continue to cook, stirring, until vegetables are tender and sauce is thick. Step 7: Serve pver steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, chicken tenderloins, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red pepper flakes, apple juice, dark brown sugar, ketchup, rice vinegar, bourbon whiskey, soy sauce, jasmine rice, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok, over high heat, add 2 tablespoons oil and when hot, working in batches, add the chicken and cook until lightly browned, about 3 to 5 minute remove and set aside. Step 2: Reduce the heat to medium, add the garlic, ginger and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant, about 30 sec. Step 3: Add in the apple juice, sugar, ketchup, vinegar, whiskey and soy sauce and cook stirring until the sugar dissolves, about 1 minute return the chicken and bring to a boil. Step 4: Lower heat to low and simmer for 20 minute In the meantime, cook the rice according to package directions. Step 5: Serve the chicken over the rice and garnish with the scallions.

Ingredient Names: bok choy, oil, sesame oil, garlic, gingerroot, chicken stock, oyster sauce, ketjap manis, hoisin sauce, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Blend together: chicken stock, oyster sauce, ketjap manis, hoisin sauce and cornstarch. Step 2: Heat both oils in a wok and saute garlic and ginger. Step 3: Add bok choy and stir fry 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in liquid ingredients and heat through until thickened and bok choy is tender crisp.

Ingredient Names: chicken leg, dark soya sauce, sugar, cornflour, sweet onion, fresh shiitake mushrooms, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, cloves, star anise, peppercorns, salt, water, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken pieces with ingredient no To for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the onion and garlic till fragrant. Step 3: Add the chicken pieces and fry lightly. Step 4: Put in the ingredient numbers to and simmer till the chicken is cooked and the sauce thickens. Step 5: Add a little more water if necessary as this dish should be quite wet. Step 6: Put in the coriander leaves and stir for a minute Ready for serving. Step 7: When the dish is cold, the fats will coagulate as a white layer on top. Step 8: Remove the layer of fats with a spoon.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, rice wine, light soy sauce for flavour, thumb-size ginger, garlic, red chile, vegetable oil, green onions, star anise, five-spice powder, cinnamon, sugar any type, tomato puree, chicken stock, plums
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork into big pieces about the length of your thumb and twice as wide. Put into a bowl or food bag, and add the wine, soy sauces, half the ginger, half the garlic and half the chilli. Marinate for at least 1 hr or up to 24 hrs. Step 2: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3, then heat the oil in a large casserole. Tip in half the spring onions, remaining ginger and garlic, the star anise, five-spice powder and cinnamon. Fry gently until fragrant and soft. Stir in the sugar, turn up the heat, then lift the pork from the marinade and turn in the oniony mix for about 3 mins until the meat is just sealed but not browned. Tip in the marinade, tomato purée and stock, give it a stir, cover, then braise in the oven for 2 hrs. Step 3: After the first hr is up, add the plums to the pan. Take the lid off and carry on the cooking, uncovered. The meat should be completely tender, turning golden brown where it breaks the surface of the sauce. Spoon off any excess fat from the surface, then scoop the meat and plums carefully from the pan with a slotted spoon. Turn up the heat and boil the sauce for 5-10 mins until reduced and slightly syrupy. Return everything to the pan, gently warm through, then scatter the rest of the spring onions over the top to serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken, wide rice noodles, peanut oil, shallots, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, ginger, broccoli florets, soy sauce, sweet soy sauce, fish sauce, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Soak rice noodles in warm water for about 30 minutes or until soft. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet. Step 3: Stir fry chicken about 5 minutes, remove. Step 4: Add shallots, garlic, jalapeno and ginger to skillet or wok. Step 5: Stir fry over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes. Step 6: Add broccoli and stir to mix. Step 7: Cover and cook 3 minutes until broccoli is crisp tender. Step 8: Meanwhile, drain noodles and add to skillet or wok, stir to combine.

Dish Name: California Pizza Kitchens Kung Pao Spaghetti
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, cornstarch, soy sauce, dry sherry, chili paste with garlic, sugar, red wine vinegar, toasted sesame oil, egg whites, salt, spaghetti, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, dried red chili peppers, unsalted dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: To make the kung pao sauce: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the chicken stock and cornstarch until the cornstarch is fully dissolved. Step 2: Stir in all the remaining sauce ingredients and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 15 to 20 minutes. Step 4: Set aside To make egg white-cornstarch mixture: In a mixing bowl, use a whisk to stir together the egg whites, cornstarch, and salt until thoroughly blended Be careful not to beat them into a froth. Step 5: Set aside To prepare the pasta:.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, chinese rice wine, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breasts, oyster sauce, sesame oil, chili sauce, peanut oil, garlic cloves, yellow onion, green bell pepper, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken: in medium bowl, stir together marinade ingredients until cornstarch dissolves, add chicken, stir to coat. Step 2: Let stand at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 3: Prepare the sauce: in a small bowl, mix together soy sauce, rice wine, oyster sauce, sesame oil and chili sauce, set aside. Step 4: Heat a work or large skillet over medium-high heat until a bead of water sizzles and evaporates. Step 5: Add oil Swirl to coat base. Step 6: Add garlic and stir-fry until just aromatic, about 20 seconds.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, black pepper, monosodium glutamate, cooking wine, light soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, water, peanut oil, cashew nuts, fresh gingerroot, garlic, onion, fresh mushrooms, frozen mixed vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken across grain into slivers, 1 / 4 inch thickness in a mixing bowl, combine pepper, gourmet powder, cooking wine and 1 tablespoon soy sauce. Step 2: Add chicken, coat well and marinate for 15 minutes Starch mixture in a small mixing bowl, combine remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce, sesame oil and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 3: Mix well and set aside. Step 4: Heat peanut oil in a wok to medium-high heat. Step 5: Add cashews and stir fry until light brown, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Remove cashews to a bowl and keep warm in oven. Step 7: Remove all but 2 tablespoons of peanut oil and bring to high heat. Step 8: Add ginger, garlic, and onion and stir-fry for 1 minute or until light brown. Step 9: Now add chicken slivers and stir-fry for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: breaded chicken nuggets, green pepper, onion, vegetable oil, chicken broth, syrup, cider vinegar, soy sauce, pineapple chunks, cornstarch, garlic powder, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken nuggets for only half of required baking time and set aside. Step 2: Saute onion and green pepper in vegetable oil until crips tender. Step 3: Add pineapple chunks, reserving juice, heat on low. Step 4: Add cornstarch to reserved pineapple juice and stir until dissolved. Step 5: Add chicken broth, pancake syrup, vinegar, garlic powder, and soy sauce to vegetable mixture. Step 6: Bring to a boil and add cornstarch mixture Continue to boil until mixture begins to thicken@ 2-3 minutes, reduce heat. Step 7: Add chicken and stir to coat them in sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken, oil, roasted almonds, soya sauce, celery, broccoli, salt, pepper, sliced water chestnuts, cornstarch, onion, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch almonds, then peel the skins off Roast in oven at 375 for about 10-15 min add oil to wok and heat until smoking. Step 2: Add onion and chicken, cook about 4 minute stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add the remainder of the ingredients. Step 4: Cover wok and stir every two min for about 4-6 min. Step 5: Then add corn starch mixture and allow to thicken in the wok. Step 6: Add almonds and serve.

Dish Name: Chicken And Asparagus Stir Fry With Ginger Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, soy sauce, dry sherry, garlic cloves, oil, carrot, asparagus, chicken broth, sugar, cornstarch, toasted sesame oil, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tspn of vegetable or olive oil in a 12-inch non-stick skillet over high heat until just smoking. Step 2: Add the chicken, soy sauce, and sherry and cook until lightly browned. Step 3: Transfer chicken to a bowl. Step 4: Add vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender If you use other vegetables the cooking time may be more or less. Step 5: Add the garlic cloves to the center of the pan and cook until colored and toasty and then mix with the vegetables. Step 6: Add the chicken back inches. Step 7: Mix all the sauce ingredients and add to the pan. Step 8: Bring the mixture to a simmer and toss.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, canola oil, scallions, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, baby corn, corn kernels, chicken broth, dry sherry, cornstarch, hot sauce, saffron, tomatoes, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Clean chicken breast, then cut lengthwise into four strips Thinly slice strips across the grain. Step 2: In a large saucepan or stock pot, heat the oil over medium-high heat, until almost smoking, and then add chicken, stirring constantly. Step 3: Cook chicken 3-4 minutes or until lightly browned. Step 4: Add the scallions, bell pepper, and garlic, and cook, stirring, 2-3 more minutes. Step 5: Add the baby corn and stock and bring to a boil, cook 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the corn kernels and hot sauce, and continue to cook about 5-7 more minutes. Step 7: Blend the sherry and cornstarch and add to the soup. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and cook an additional 2-3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry sherry, rice wine vinegar, hoisin sauce, brown sugar, green onion, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil, broccoli florets, fresh mushrooms, cornstarch, water, fried chinese noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl, stirring well, set aside. Step 2: Cut chicken into 2-inch strips. Step 3: Add chicken to marinade, toss to coat. Step 4: Refrigerate in tightly covered container 8-24 hours. Step 5: Pour oil around top of a preheated wok or skillet, coating sides. Step 6: Heat on medium-high for 1 minute. Step 7: Remove chicken from marinade. Step 8: Place marinade in a small saucepan. Step 9: Bring to a boil, and cook 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken And Broccoli Stir Fry With Variations
Ingredient Names: gingerroot, oyster sauce, soy sauce, five-spice powder, brown sugar, cornstarch, dark sesame oil, chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, rice wine, egg white, cooking oil, peanut oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together sauce in a cup and set aside Have all ingredients near the wok or large skillet. Step 2: Mix together the chicken with salt and rice wine in a small bowl Lightly beat the egg and stir in with the chicken, then sprinkle in the cornstarch. Step 3: Allow this to sit for 20 minutes to absorb the wine flavor. Step 4: Then add it to the wok. Step 5: When it sizzles, lower heat and stir until the chicken turns white, then drain chicken on paper toweling, and remove excess oil form wok, moving it carefully out of your cooking area so it is not accidentally spilled. Step 6: Add the combination of oils to wok, and when it is hot, toss in the garlic, hot peppers, and onions. Step 7: When it sizzles and becomes fragrant, add the chicken again and cook for 2-3 minutes until chicken cooks through. Step 8: Stir in sauce mixture and boil to thicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken meat, cashew nuts, lettuce leaves, coriander, egg white, water, cornstarch, salt, meat tenderizer, msg, cooking oil, rice wine, light soy sauce, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix minced chicken meat with egg white, water, cornstarch, salt, tenderizer, msg and 1 tbsp of oil. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan. Step 3: Add the meat, coriander and wine, soy sauce and pepper into the pan. Step 4: Stir-fry until the meat is cooked. Step 5: Remove into a plate. Step 6: Divide the meat into 6 portions. Step 7: Place each portion on each lettuce leaf. Step 8: Sprinkle cashew nuts over the meat and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, soy sauce, cornstarch, peanut oil, onion, mushroom, cabbage, salt, sugar, cashew nuts, fried chinese noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken strips, soy sauce and cornstarch in small bowl and coat chicken well. Step 2: Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat peanut oil in wok over high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and stir-fry until meat is white and firm. Step 5: Add onion and mushrooms, continue to stir-fry until vegetables are soft. Step 6: Remove to a separate bowl. Step 7: Add peanut oil to wok. Step 8: Stir-fry cabbage, salt and sugar for 3-4 minutes until cabbage is crisp-tender. Step 9: Return chicken and vegetable mixture to wok. Step 10: Add cashews, toss to combine.

Dish Name: Chicken And Chinese Broccoli Miso Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, broccoli, sweet onion, garlic cloves, dark soy sauce, salt, peanut oil, red miso, water, cornstarch, green onions, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Stir fry garlic and onions in oil until they are slightly cooked. Step 2: Add chicken meat and cook until mostly cooked. Step 3: Add chinese broccoli cut into bite size pieces along with miso and cook about 2 minutes more. Step 4: Add soy, water and cornstarch and bring to a boil. Step 5: Check seasoning once chicken has cooked through, and add salt as desired. Step 6: Garnish with green onions and parsley, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice vinegar, ground chicken, egg, fresh cilantro, scallions, sesame oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together soy and vinegar in a bowl for dipping sauce. Step 2: Stir together chicken, egg, cilantro, scallions, sesame oil, and salt with a fork until just blended With wet hands form chicken mixture into 1-inch balls, transferring them to baking pan as formed. Step 3: Bake in a 425 oven for 10-12 minutes. Step 4: Serve meatballs with dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg white, cornstarch, salt, fresh mushrooms, water chestnuts, peas, scallions, peanut oil, soy sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cornstarch, egg white and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt. Step 2: Put the slices of chicken into this mixture. Step 3: Heat half the oil in a non-stick wok. Step 4: Stir fry the chicken until lightly coloured. Step 5: Remove meat with a perforated spoon. Step 6: Heat the remaining oil in the wok until smoking. Step 7: Toss in the spring onions. Step 8: Then add the mushrooms, water chestnuts and peas. Step 9: Add the remaining salt and stir for approximately 5 minutes. Step 10: Add the chicken slices, soy sauce and sugar.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry white wine, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breast half, vegetable oil, onion, fresh ginger, garlic clove, poblano chiles, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh orange juice, papayas, fresh lemon juice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the soy sauce with the wine and cornstarch. Step 2: Add the chicken and turn to coat. Step 3: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over moderately high heat. Step 4: Add the onion, ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the poblano and crushed red pepper and continue stir-frying until the chicken is cooked through and the poblano softens, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 8: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the chicken to a plate. Step 9: Add the orange juice to the wok and boil until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes. Step 10: Return the chicken to the wok, add the papaya and stir-fry until hot, about 1 minute.

Dish Name: Chicken And Red Pepper Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sweet red pepper, orange, chicken stock, soy sauce, granulated sugar, cornstarch, sesame oil, red pepper flakes, hot pepper sauce, olive oil, gingerroot, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into thin 2 inch long strips, set aside. Step 2: Cut red pepper into strips, set aside. Step 3: Using vegetable peeler remove thin orange rind and cut into julienne strips, set aside. Step 4: Squeeze orange and reserve 1 / 4 cup juice in small bowl. Step 5: Stir in chicken stock, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, sesame oil, pepper flakes and hot pepper sauce. Step 6: Set aside In wok or large skillet, heat 1 tbsp oil over high heat.

Ingredient Names: wine, soy sauce, salt, pepper, cornstarch, oil, boneless chicken thighs, green onions, garlic, sesame oil, cucumber, water chestnut, red pepper, water, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Step 2: Add 1 tablespoon oil and chicken, coating well. Step 3: Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil in wok or large skillet. Step 4: Add chicken mixture and stir-fry until medium well then move to side of pan. Step 5: Add green onions, garlic, and sesame oil to available space in pan and stir-fry until fragrant. Step 6: Add cucumber, water chestnuts, and red pepper and stir briefly In small bowl, mix together the soy sauce, water, sugar, vinegar, wine, dash pepper, and cornstarch. Step 7: Stir into wok or skillet. Step 8: Cover and cook until steamy, then stir to mix well. Step 9: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic clove, gingerroot, cornstarch, hot chicken stock, sweetcorn, egg, fresh lemon juice, scallion, dark soy sauce, shrimp crackers, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep pan and gently cook the chicken, garlic and ginger for 3-4 minutes without colouring. Step 2: Blend the cornstarch with a little stock and add to the soup pan with the remaining stock and the sweetcorn. Step 3: Bring to the boil, stirring continuously and simmer gently for 5-7 minutes. Step 4: Beat together the egg and lemon juice and slowly trickle into the soup pan, stirring with a chopstick or fork to form egg strands. Step 5: Season to taste, garnish with scallions and toasted sesame seeds, and serve with a drizzle of soy sauce and some prawn crackers.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, sesame seeds, marinade, soy sauce, water, sugar, mirin, ground ginger, garlic powder, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Mix marinade ingredients Soy sauce, water, sugar and mirin. Step 2: Add chcken and marinade in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Step 3: Mix 4 teaspoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water and set aside In small sauce pan mix together teriyaki sauce ingredients Soy sauce, water, sugar, mirin, ginger and garlic powder, bring to a boil. Step 4: Add cornstarch mixture. Step 5: Stir until thickened. Step 6: Brush sauce on chicken and grill or roast f until done.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, chicken thighs, dried scallops, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, oyster sauce, chinese wine, soya sauce, white pepper, sugar, low-sodium worcestershire sauce, sesame oil, carrot, broccoli
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken thighs up into two inch lengths. Step 2: Marinate the chicken with the oyster sauce, chinese wine / sherry, soy sauce, pepper, sugar, worcestershire sauce and sesame oil. Step 3: Leave the chicken to marinate in the fridge for about 30 min or longer Grab a large pot, pour the rice, water, ginger, garlic and dried scallops inches. Step 4: Let this boil on a low heat for about 1 hour Do check on the congee frequently and give it a stir, so that the rice doesn't stick and burn at the bottom of the pot. Step 5: Pour in the carrots, and allow the congee to continue simmering. Step 6: Take the chicken out of the fridge, and pour it into the congee. Step 7: Add 2 cups boiling hot water into the pot, and stir the congee. Step 8: Allow this to cook for about 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, shiitake mushrooms, watercress, chicken stock, salt, cornflour, rice wine, pepper, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with salt, cornflour and rice wine, pepper and sesame oil. Step 2: Bring chicken stock to boil in a saucepan. Step 3: Add in the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add in the chicken and stir to separate the chicken slices. Step 5: When soup starts to boil, add in the watercress and stir. Step 6: Cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Remove and serve in a soup bowl.

Dish Name: Chicken And Zucchini With Spicy Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken thigh, black bean paste, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, salt, shaoxing wine, oil, cornstarch, zucchini, yellow onion, green pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl add in the chicken, black bean, chili garlic, soy sauce, sugar, salt, wine, oil and cornstarch and mix well and set aside to marinade for 30 minutes Trim of each end of the zucchinis and slice in half and slice the half lengthwise at a 45 and repeat this until done. Step 2: Slice the onion and pepper into wedges and set aside with the zucchinis. Step 3: Heat up a wok and lightly coat with oil and when the oil is smoking add in the chicken mixture and stir fry until the chicken is halfway done add in the zucchinis and combine together and add in the water and bring to a boil and when the sauce start to thicken add in the onion and pepper and mix well and turn off the heat and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, light soy sauce, sherry wine, cornstarch, peas, onion, celery, red bell pepper, roasted cashews, whole mushrooms, oil, garlic clove, gingerroot, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cornstarch and water together to make a thickener, set aside. Step 2: Combine the 1st four ingredients together and let stand for 15 minutes. Step 3: Prepare the vegetables as directed. Step 4: Place 1 tablespoon oil in wok and heat. Step 5: Stir-fry or saute onions, mushrooms and celery, remove from wok. Step 6: Add a little more oil if necessary and stir-fry the bell pepper and peas, remove from wok. Step 7: Heat 2 tablespoons oil and brown the garlic and ginger.

Dish Name: Chicken Cashews And Red Pepper Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, low sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, rice wine vinegar, sugar, hot pepper sauce, chicken breast tenders, unsalted cashews, canola oil, red bell peppers, garlic, fresh ginger, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and dry sherry, rice vinegar, the sugar or splenda, & 1 / 2 tablespoon garlic & red chile paste in a small bowl, stir with a whisk. Step 2: Combine remaining 2 3 / 4 teaspoons cornstarch, remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and chicken in a medium bowl, toss well to coat. Step 3: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add cashews to pan. Step 5: Cook 3 minutes or until lightly toasted, stirring frequently, remove from pan. Step 6: Add oil to pan, swirling to coat. Step 7: Add chicken mixture to pan.

Dish Name: Chicken Cashews Red Pepper And Scallion Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: extra large egg, cornstarch, soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken, sesame oil, peanut oil, cashews, chicken broth, sherry wine, sugar, red pepper, scallion, crushed red pepper flakes, rice, water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Now, it looks like a lot, but it is very easy Just start each step and honestly it doesn't take any time Chicken marinade -- in a small bowl, add the egg white, corn starch and soy sauce and whisk well. Step 2: Add the chicken and toss well to combine Just set off to the side on the counter The chicken will come to room temp as it marinates I like to let it set 30-45 minutes This gives you time to prepare everything else Cashews -- this only takes a few minutes In the same large pan you are going to cook the chicken in, add the oil and bring to medium heat.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, fresh ginger, sugar, soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken breasts, green onions, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sesame seeds, ginger, sugar and soy sauce. Step 2: Grill chicken over medium coals, or broil 6 inches from heat source, until cooked through, about 4 minutes per side Baste with soy mixture frequently. Step 3: Garnish with green onions and serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: medium egg noodles, sesame oil, chicken breasts, dark soy sauce, five-spice powder, chili sauce, cornflour, peanut oil, red bell pepper, bean sprouts, spring onion, light soy sauce, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles in boiling water until al dente. Step 2: Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Step 3: Drizzle with a little sesame oil and toss. Step 4: Place chicken in a bowl and toss with dark soy, five-spice powder and chilli sauce. Step 5: Dust with cornflour. Step 6: Heat a wok until smoking before adding the groundnut oil. Step 7: Add chicken and cook, stirring, until golden brown and cooked through. Step 8: Add red pepper, stir fry for a minute, then add onion and beansprouts, cooking for a further 30s. Step 9: Stir in the noodles and season with light soy sauce, a dash of sesame oil and black pepper, to taste.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, onion, carrot, broccoli, cauliflower, bean sprouts, oyster sauce, black bean sauce, soy sauce, cornflour, chinese noodles, peanut oil, salt, garlic, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice carrot, onion, cauliflower and broccoli. Step 2: Heat wok half filled with salted water, add vegetables and boil for ten minutes. Step 3: Drain vegetables and put to side. Step 4: Heat wok with 1 dessert spoon of oil, added chicken plus the sauces, garlic, ginger and half teaspoon of salt. Step 5: Cook chicken until tender then add vegetables to meat, add bean sprouts. Step 6: Cover with warm water and bring to boil. Step 7: When boiling have cornflour mixed with about quarter cup of water and stir into mixture. Step 8: Cook a minute more then serve with noodles. Step 9: Cook noodles as per instructions.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, vegetable oil, rice vinegar, sugar, garlic clove, oriental sesame oil, dijon mustard, green cabbage, red cabbage, chicken, carrot, scallion, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk first 7 dressing ingredients. Step 2: Mix dressing and other ingredients together except chow mein noodles. Step 3: Cover and chill 1 hour Just before serving add in chow mein noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken, salt, white pepper, ginger juice, spring onions, rice, water, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: MARINATING THE CHICKEN In a bowl, add chicken, salt, white pepper, ginger juice and then mix it together well. Step 2: Set the chicken aside. Step 3: RINSE THE WHITE RICE Rinse the rice in a metal bowl or pot a couple times and then drain the water. Step 4: BOILING THE WHITE RICE Next add water and then set the stove on high heat until it is boiling. Step 5: Once rice porridge starts to boil, set the stove on low heat and then stir it once every for around 10 minutes. Step 6: After, this is optional but you can add a little bit more water to make rice porridge to make it less thick or to your preference. Step 7: Next add the marinated chicken to the rice porridge and leave the stove on low heat for another 10 minutes. Step 8: After an additional add the green onions, sliced ginger, salt, white pepper and stir for 10 seconds. Step 9: Serve the rice porridge in a bowl Optional: add Coriander on top of the rice porridge.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, boneless chicken breasts, carrot, green onion, red bell pepper, bean sprouts, sesame oil, egg roll wraps, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok or large skillet and add 2 tbsp of veggie oil. Step 2: Once hot, add onion and garlic. Step 3: Slice chicken thinly and add to skillet. Step 4: Stir mixture constantly until browned. Step 5: Add the carrot, green onions, & bell pepper to the skillet and stir fry for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the bean sprouts, stir in the sesame oil, and remove from heat. Step 7: Add desired amount of filling to middle of egg roll, fold in the sides, and roll up the pastry Seal and glaze the rolls with brushes of egg white. Step 8: Chill in the fridge for 15 minutes before cooking You can either add remaining oil and cook in a wok or skillet in batches or you can use a deep fryer and cook at a medium-high frying temperature until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: chicken, soy sauce, long grain rice, salad oil, chicken broth, onion, green pepper, celery, eggs, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, soy sauce and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt. Step 2: Let stand 15 minutes. Step 3: Cook rice in hot oil in skillet over medium heat until golden brown, stir frequently. Step 4: Reduce heat, add chicken with soy sauce and broth. Step 5: Simmer, covered, 20 to 25 minutes, or until rice is tender. Step 6: Remove cover last few minutes. Step 7: Stir in onion, green pepper and celery. Step 8: Cook uncovered over medium heat until liquid is absorbed Push rice mixture to sides of skillet.

Dish Name: Chicken In Foil Triangles Aka Twice Baked Chicken
Ingredient Names: white chicken meat, hoisin sauce, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, green onions, fresh cilantro, water chestnut
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients. Step 2: Put into covered dish and put in fridge to marinate for one hour. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 4: Wrap tablespoon sized portions in pieces of aluminum foil, either in triangular shapes or about 2 1 / 2-inch square. Step 5: Bake in 350 degree f oven for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Serve along with stirfry and rice, or as an appetizer.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic clove, onion, green apple, water, banana, honey, turmeric, curry powder, tomato ketchup, chicken broth, salt, black pepper, cornstarch, chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a saucepan and add the garlic, onions and apples. Step 2: Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Pour over 1 cup of the water and bring to a simmer. Step 4: Stir in the banana, honey, turmeric, curry powder and ketchup. Step 5: Add the chicken broth and bring the sauce to boil. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Mix the cornstarch with the remaining cup water, and add to the curry sauce. Step 8: Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally While the sauce is cooking, prepare the chicken breasts With a sharp knife, make two diagonal slashes across each breast and coat the chicken in flour on both sides.

Dish Name: Chicken Lime and Cashew Nut Stir-fry
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, fine egg noodles, clear honey, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic, coriander root, red chile, green onions, carrots, red bell peppers, bok choy, dark soy sauce, ketjap manis, sesame oil, kaffir lime, fresh cilantro leaves, unsalted cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles as per the instructions on the packet, drain and set aside. Step 2: Heat a large wok to a high heat. Step 3: Add a little of the vegetable oil to the wok, and when it is hot, stir-fry the chicken in batches until sealed and half-cooked. Step 4: Return all the chicken to the wok, add the honey, and continue cooking until the chicken is fully cooked and a rich golden colour. Step 5: Add a little water to the wok, as necessary, just to prevent the chicken and honey from sticking. Step 6: Remove the chicken and honey mixture from the wok and set aside while you cook the remainder of the dish. Step 7: Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the wok and saute the ginger, garlic, coriander roots and chilli for about a minute. Step 8: Add the vegetables and stir-fry over high heat until just tender. Step 9: Add the pre-cooked noodles and saute for a minute or so before returning the chicken to the pan. Step 10: Add the soy sauces, sesame oil, the lime zest and juice. Step 11: Heat through and correct the seasoning, adding a little more honey if desired. Step 12: Finally, stir through the fresh coriander. Step 13: Serve with a scattering of cashews over the top.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken breasts, soy sauce, cornstarch, linguine, salad oil, mixed mushrooms, pea pods, green onions, red pepper, chicken flavor instant bouillon
Instructions: Step 1: Start cooking linguine. Step 2: Soak cut up breast with soy sauce and cornstarch, set aside In hot oil over medium-high heat, cook mushrooms, pea pods, green onions and peppers about 3 to 5 minutes, remove vegetables. Step 3: Cook chicken strips about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Return vegetables to pan and add bouillon and 1 / 2 cup water, heat to boiling. Step 5: Add cooked linguine and mix well.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, soy sauce, sherry wine, cornstarch, oil, mixed mushrooms, scallion, fresh chinese pea pods, red pepper, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, soy sauce, sherry and cornstarch and marinate. Step 2: Cook 8 ounces thin linguine and drain. Step 3: Stir-fry in 1 / 4 cup oil the mushrooms, scallions, pea pods and red pepper. Step 4: Cook until just tender, remove vegetables. Step 5: Add chicken mixture and stir-fry until browned. Step 6: Add vegetables to chicken with 1 / 2 cup water and 1 / 2 teaspoon chicken bouillon. Step 7: Add cooked linguine and toss together. Step 8: Add soy sauce to taste.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, oil, cooked chicken, celery, mushrooms, cabbage, fresh snow peas, bean sprouts, chicken stock, cornstarch, water, soy sauce, teriyaki sauce, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles in salted boiling water, rinse in cold water, and drain. Step 2: In a wok or large skillet, saute the chicken in hot oil for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the vegetables and saute for another 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken stock and mix well. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Mix together the cornstarch, water, soy sauce and teriyaki sauce until smooth, and add the mixture to the chicken and vegetables. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Stir in the noodles, re-heat and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, salt, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, bean thread noodles, green onions, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: In a large covered pot, cook chicken with ginger and salt in enough chicken stock to cover until tender. Step 2: When chicken has cooled, debone and shred meat Reserve chicken stock. Step 3: In a skillet, heat oil and saute onion, garlic and ginger until lightly browned. Step 4: Add noodles and enough reserved chicken stock to cover. Step 5: Add chicken and soy sauce. Step 6: Simmer until noodles are tender Optional: top with chopped or minced green onions This recipe is slightly on the bland side May want to add soy sauce, or more salt, ginger or some chicken bouillon to flavor.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cornflour, sugar, salt, ground black pepper, oil, gingerroot, garlic, chicken stock, ketchup, tabasco sauce, chili-garlic sauce, green chili, msg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken cubes with the ingredients for the marinade. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok. Step 3: Add ginger & garlic and sweat it for a minute.
