Step 4: Add chicken & stir fry it for 5-8 minutes. Step 5: Take it off the flame & then put in the stock, ketchup, sugar, tobasco, green chilli, msg, salt, black pepper. Step 6: In a small cup mix together the corn flour & water. Step 7: Put the wok back on the heat & cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the corn flour paste n cook for 2 more minutes You can add a little red food color to brighten it up.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, flour, butter, pineapple chunks, cornstarch, pineapple juice, soy sauce, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Shake chicken in flour, mixed with salt and pepper Brown in butter. Step 2: Cook for 5 minutes, add pineapple. Step 3: Mix cornstarch, juice and soy sauce. Step 4: Stir into chicken until thickened and glossy. Step 5: Sprinkle almonds over each serving.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, boneless chicken breast, salt, black pepper, sesame seeds, oil, baby corn, mixed vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and drain pasta according to package and set aside. Step 2: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and 1 clove minced garlic. Step 3: Sprinkle both sides of chicken with salt and pepper In dry skillet, over medium heat, cook sesame seeds until golden, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and set aside In same skillet, heat peanut oil over medium heat. Step 5: Add remaining garlic, cook, stirring, until golden, about 1 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken, cook, stirring, until no longer pink, about 6 minutes In large bowl, combine corn, veggies, and pasta with chicken and soy mixture, toss well.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sugar, cider vinegar, ketchup, ginger, garlic, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil, stir fry vegetables, pineapple chunks, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 7 ingredients with reserved 1 / 4 cup pineapple juice in small bowl In large skillet, stir-fry chicken in hot oil 5 minutes. Step 2: Add vegetables, stir-fry 4 more minutes. Step 3: Stir in pineapple and sauce, heat through, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, green onions, soy sauce, salt, pepper, egg roll wraps, dark sesame oil, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: To create the filling, mix the ground chicken, green onions, soy sauce, salt, and ground pepper in a large bowl. Step 2: Place an eighth of the mixture in the center of a wrapper. Step 3: Use a water to dampen the corners and edges of the wrapper. Step 4: Pull the corners up around the filling and press them together, creating a neat little package. Step 5: Repeat 7 more times until you have created 8 wontons. Step 6: (If you're cooking in bulk and want to freeze the wontons, stop here.) In a non-stick skillet, heat sesame oil over medium heat. Step 7: Place the wontons in the skillet, seam side up, and cook for approximately 2 minutes. Step 8: When the bottoms of the wontons begin to brown, add chicken broth. Step 9: Place a lid on the skillet and cook until chicken is done, approximately 5 minutes. Step 10: Serve with soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, sugar, soy sauce, oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, mushroom, green pepper, onion, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ingredients together. Step 2: Marinate chicken for a minute 1 hour. Step 3: Thread veggies on skewers alternating with chicken. Step 4: Grill till chicken is cooked or bake in oven at 350 for 45 minute on a pan with water below it, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, napa cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts, bean thread noodles, cooked chicken breasts, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, coriander, spring roll wrappers, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add the garlic, ginger, cabbage, carrot, and bean sprouts. Step 3: Cook for 2 minutes or until the cabbage is just limp. Step 4: Add the noodles and chicken Continue to cook until heated through. Step 5: Stir in the hoisin and oyster sauces, toss to coat the mixture The filling should be moist but not wet. Step 6: Remove from heat, and allow to cool. Step 7: Toss in the chopped coriander Lay a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface on an angle so it looks like a diamond.

Dish Name: Chicken Steamed With Fresh Lemons Sai Ling Mung Ching Gai
Ingredient Names: chicken cutlet, fresh lemon juice, fresh lemon, ginger juice, shaoxing wine, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, sugar, sesame oil, peanut oil, white pepper, cornstarch, red bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients except the chicken and the red bell pepper into a bowl, mix well. Step 2: Add the chicken, mix to coat and allow to marinate for 20 minutes. Step 3: Put the chicken and marinade into a steamproof dish. Step 4: Place the dish in a steamer and steam for 10 minutes. Step 5: Turn the chicken over and steam for another 10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through, turn off the heat. Step 6: Remove the chicken from the steamer. Step 7: Sprinkle the red bell pepper over the chicken. Step 8: Serve over cooked rice, with a slice / wedge of lemon -- you may want to"temper" any dish that is not known to be"steamproof" or"ovenproof"-- here's how.

Dish Name: Chicken Stir Fried With Bosc Pears
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, peanut oil, fresh ginger, asparagus, celery, red pepper, bosc pear, shallots, garlic, rice wine, macadamia nuts, egg whites, cornstarch, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the marinade ingredients in a large bowl. Step 2: Add the chicken and allow to rest for at least 20 minutes In another bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and reserve. Step 3: Heat a wok over high heat for at least 45 seconds. Step 4: Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the peanut oil and coat the wok using a spatula. Step 5: When a wisp of white smoke appears, add the ginger slices, stir and cook for 15 seconds. Step 6: Add the asparagus and cook, stirring, for one minute. Step 7: Add the celery and bell pepper and cook, stirring for another minute. Step 8: Add the pear and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. Step 9: Remove the contents of the wok and reserve on a platter.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cornstarch, soy sauce, garlic, oil, fresh broccoli, celery, carrots, onions, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1/2 inch strips. Step 2: Stir together cornstarch, soy sauce and garlic. Step 3: Add chicken strips, toss to coat. Step 4: Marinate at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet. Step 6: Stir fry chicken until no longer pink. Step 7: Remove and keep warm, do not overcook. Step 8: Add remaining 1 tablespoons oil to skillet. Step 9: Stir fry broccoli, celery, carrots, and onions until done as you like. Step 10: Add chicken stock. Step 11: Add reserved cooked chicken. Step 12: Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.

Dish Name: Chicken Stir Fry On Pita Bread
Ingredient Names: cooked rice, green onion, celery, carrot, sesame oil, garlic powder, chicken, soy sauce, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Before stir frying, make sure the rice is cooked and cooled and the onions, celery and carrots are chopped! Step 2: Combine the sesame oil and garlic powder in a bowl and add chicken to marinate briefly while wok or skillet is heating. Step 3: Heat electric skillet or wok to about 375 degrees and add chicken. Step 4: Stir chicken and cook for about 5- 7 minutes. Step 5: Add onions, celery, carrots and 2 tablespoons of the soy sauce. Step 6: Stir to mix and add the egg Continue mixing quickly. Step 7: When egg is cooked, add cold rice and remaining 2 tablespoons of soy sauce. Step 8: Stir-fry over high heat until rice is hot. Step 9: Serve with crisp toasted pita bread.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, oil, garlic, ground ginger, boneless skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all marinade ingredients in shallow dish. Step 2: Place chicken in marinade and refrigerate for 1-1 / 2 hours. Step 3: Preheat broiler Broil chicken 5 inches from heat for about 15 minutes, turning and basting with marinade often.

Ingredient Names: chicken, teriyaki sauce, water, ginger, dried onion, garlic, garlic powder, stir fry vegetables, extra virgin olive oil, cornstarch, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Start defrosting chicken if it's frozen. Step 2: Take the bag of frozen veggies out and let them defrost on your counter. Step 3: Prepare the marinade: boil water, teriyaki sauce, ginger, onion, garlic powder, and the jarred minced garlic for 2 minutes. Step 4: Cool the marinade while waiting for the chicken to defrost. Step 5: Cut the defrosted chicken into bite sized pieces before marinading. Step 6: Marinate the chicken for 20 minutes: combine the chicken with the marinade in a glass bowl. Step 7: Make sure that all the chicken is coated with marinade Start preparing the spaghetti 5 to 10 minutes before using the marinated chicken You'll want the spaghetti to be done when you make the left-over marinade into a kind of spaghetti sauce Pluck the chicken out of the marinade with your hands to reserve the marinade in the marinade bowl.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, butter, onion, flour, curry powder, garlic, chinese white rice wine, water, salt, sugar, pepper, potato, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter or oil and stir fry onion over low heat until fragrant. Step 2: Then add in the curry paste and stir fry for 1 minute over low heat. Step 3: Remove and set aside. Step 4: Make several vertical cuts on the chicken thighs. Step 5: In a pan, add in the chicken thighs, vegetables and ingredients a, bring to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium then cover pan and cook for another 20 minutes Lastly, add in the curry paste with onion to thicken. Step 7: Serve dish over rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg whites, cornstarch, salt, green pepper, dry-roasted cashews, scallions, garlic cloves, ground ginger, corn oil, dry sherry, soy sauce, water, sugar, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Skin & bone chicken. Step 2: Cut into 1 / 2" cubes With your hands, mix chicken w / egg whites, cornstarch and salt in large mixing bowl. Step 3: Make sure the chicken is coated thoroughly, set mixture aside. Step 4: Mix together the green pepper, cashews, scallions, garlic, ginger & set aside in a bowl. Step 5: Pour oil in wok or large deep sided frying pan over med, heat. Step 6: Fry chicken pieces. Step 7: Cook a few minutes until done, drain.

Dish Name: Chicken W Cashews And Snow Peas
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic cloves, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, hoisin sauce, peanut oil, snow peas, sliced water chestnuts, hot chicken stock, salt, unsalted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken for 15-30 minutes in mixture of the first 5 ingredients. Step 2: Heat oil in uncovered wok until temps reach 375% degrees. Step 3: Add chicken mixture and stir fry for 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Add snow peas and water chestnuts stir fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Add chicken stock and salt, stir fry until slightly thickened. Step 6: Stir in cashews and cook for a few seconds. Step 7: Serve immediately over noodles or rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, dried shrimp, sherry wine, garlic cloves, onion, eggplants, hot sauce, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, artificial sweetener, tomato paste, light olive oil, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Brine chicken for 1-3 hours in solution of 2 cups water, 1 / 4 cup kosher salt and 1 / 4 cup sugar. Step 2: Soak dried shrimp in sherry for 1-3 hours. Step 3: Meanwhile, halve eggplant then slice halves radially into 4 slices per half And then into smaller pieces. Step 4: Spread on cooling racks over the sink or cookie sheets. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt and weight down with heavy cutting board. Step 6: Let drain for one hour or more Quarter and slice onion, set aside Mince garlic, set aside. Step 7: Drain chicken and pat dry.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, egg white, cornstarch, oil, gingerroot, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, salt, pepper, rice wine, english cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise, then cut diagonally in 1 / 4-inch slices. Step 2: Combine the soy sauce, sugar, salt and pepper as a sauce, set aside. Step 3: Cut the chicken into thin diagonal slices at a 45 angle. Step 4: Dip the chicken slices into the egg, then into the cornstarch Rest slices on wax paper. Step 5: Heat the oil over medium-low heat Gently fry the chicken in single layer batches. Step 6: Remove and drain on paper towels or brown paper bag. Step 7: Add more oil if necessary.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, salt, egg white, cornstarch, peanut oil, garlic, ginger, scallion, carrot, red pepper, green pepper, bamboo shoot, dried black mushrooms, firm tofu, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients in a bowl, set aside. Step 2: Combine chicken shreds with salt, egg white and cornstarch. Step 3: Mix lightly with hand. Step 4: In a wok, heat 1 1 / 2 t Oil until hot. Step 5: Add chicken, stir to separate, cook until no longer pink. Step 6: Remove and set aside Wipe out wok with paper towel, heat 2 t.

Dish Name: Chicken With Mushrooms Moo Goo Gai Pin
Ingredient Names: chicken meat, tapioca starch, reduced-sodium soya sauce, chinese wine, sesame seed oil, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh mushrooms, bamboo shoot, onion, green onions, minced ginger, garlic, green pepper, peanut oil, reduced sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with 1 tablespoons tapioca starch or cornstarch, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoons wine, crushed red chilies, and drops of sesame seed oil while preparing other ingredients. Step 2: Heat wok or large frypan, add oil and when hot, brown green onion, garlic and ginger, put in chicken and saute until meat changes colour. Step 3: Add vegetables and stir fry for 3 to 4 minutes. Step 4: Add sauce and cook until it boils, mix thoroughly. Step 5: Serve with either plain white rice or fried rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic cloves, seasoning salt, butter, long grain white rice, green onion, carrot, water, stir-fry sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle / rub chicken with smashed garlic and seasoned salt. Step 2: Melt butter in medium nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Step 3: Add chicken, cook until browned on both sides. Step 4: Remove chicken from frypan, cover to keep warm. Step 5: Add rice, onions and carrot to same frypan, cook and stir 3-5 minutes or just until mixture begins to brown. Step 6: Add water and stir fry sauce, mix well. Step 7: Place chicken over rice mixture. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium low, cover and cook 15-20 minutes or until chicken is fork tender, its juices run clear and liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally.

Dish Name: Chicken With Two Onions In Sand Pot
Ingredient Names: chicken, chicken stock, yellow onions, green onions, brown sugar, five-spice powder, iceberg lettuce, light soy sauce, dry sherry, ginger, peanut oil, garlic cloves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken and mix with the marinade. Step 2: Allow to sit for 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat the wok and add half the oil. Step 4: Stir-fry the garlic and salt for just a moment. Step 5: Add the chicken, drained of the marinade Reserve the marinade Brown the chicken on all sides and add the broth. Step 6: Cover and cook until the chicken is done to your taste. Step 7: Remove the cover and allow the broth to reduce a bit. Step 8: Remove all from the wok and set aside.

Dish Name: Chicken Wontons With Raspberry Szechuan Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, wonton wrappers, raspberries, vinegar, sugar, hot chili sauce, lime juice, liquid honey, salt, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet over medium heat, combine first 5 ingredients and stir until the chicken is no longer pink. Step 2: Remove from heat and let cool. Step 3: Preheat oven to 400f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 4: Put 1 tsp of ground chicken mixture in the middle of a wonton wrapper. Step 5: Brush edges of wrapper with water. Step 6: Fold wrapper in half to make a triangle and press edges to seal, brush two. Step 7: Place completed wontons on parchment paper lined pan. Step 8: Repeat with remaining filling and wrappers Lightly brush each wonton with vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast half, peanut oil, garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, chicken broth, asian fish sauce, cornstarch, basil leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken into 1/8-inch thick strips, 2 to 3 inches long. Step 2: Place a nonstick frying pan or wok over high heat. Step 3: When hot, add oil, garlic, ginger, pepper flakes and chicken. Step 4: Stir-fry until chicken is no longer pink in the center 3 to 4 minutes. Step 5: In a small bowl, mix broth, fish sauce and cornstarch until smooth. Step 6: Add to pan and stir until sauce is boiling, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add basil leaves and stir just until barely wilted, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Add salt to taste and pour into a serving bowl.

Ingredient Names: skinless boneless chicken breast fillets, egg whites, cornstarch, fragrant thai rice, thumb sized ginger, red peppers, shallots, garlic, red chile, vegetable oil, fish sauce, limes, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Velveting the chicken: Slice the chicken into bite-size pieces. Beat together the egg white and 1 tbsp cornflour in a bowl. Tip in the chicken and coat with the mix. Marinate for 15-30 mins (don’t place in the fridge or the mix will harden). Now rinse the rice in a sieve under the cold tap until the water runs clear. Step 2: Making perfect rice: Drain the rice, tip into a pan with a lid and pour over 600ml water and a pinch of salt. Bring the water to the boil, then cook the rice uncovered for 10 mins or so until the water has almost boiled away and small craters appear. Cover with a lid, turn the heat down as low as it will go and cook for 10 mins more. Step 3: Getting the ingredients ready: Strip the ginger skin with a teaspoon and finely chop until you have 1 tbsp. Halve the pepper and trim off the stalk, inner pith and seeds. Cut into bite-size pieces. Peel the shallot and garlic clove, then thinly slice. Trim the ends off the chilli, if using, removing the seeds if you like it milder, and cut into thin slices. Remove the chicken from the egg marinade and pat dry with kitchen paper. Step 4: Foolproof stir-frying: Heat a wok and pour in 1 tbsp oil. Cook the chicken for 7-10 mins, tossing until just cooked. Set aside. Pour in some more oil if you need to. Add the pepper and cook for 1 min, then cook the ginger, shallot and garlic for 1-2 mins more. Combine the fish sauce, lime juice, 50ml water and 1 tsp cornflour. Tip into the wok, then add the chicken. Cook for 1 min, stir through the basil, then serve with the rice.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, chestnuts, garlic cloves, ginger, dark soya sauce, oyster sauce, white sugar, water, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rub 2 teaspoon of the dark soya sauce all over the chicken, and leave it to marinate for 30 minutes. Step 2: Boil 11 cups of water in a pot, and add the chestnuts and boil for 10 minutes to loosen the skin. Step 3: Drain and rinse in tap water This makes the skin easier to remove Ease off chestnut skins with the. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok till smoking, stif fry the garlic and ginger, till aromatic About 1 / 2 minute. Step 5: Add chicken and stir fry for 7 minutes or till the chicken changes to white in colour. Step 6: Add remaining soya sauce, oyster sauce and sugar. Step 7: Stir fry for a while before adding the hot water.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, salt, oil, orange zest, lemon zest, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, peppercorns, sugar, chicken stock, orange juice, lemon juice, mirin, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In a small food processor, process the garlic, zests, ginger, salt and sugar into a paste. Step 2: Add that and the sauce liquids into a small sauce pan and simmer for about ten minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat a wok to high heat. Step 4: Add chicken, flour and salt to a large plastic bag and shake to coat chicken. Step 5: Add oil to wok and add chicken immediately, stirring to keep from sticking. Step 6: Fry the chicken until golden brown, then remove for a moment and drain oil. Step 7: Return the chicken to the work with the sauce and add cornstarch The sauce will thicken as soon as it comes to boil, and when it does remove the wok from the heat. Step 8: Stir, and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, rice wine, toasted sesame oil, fresh ginger, cornstarch, peanut oil, scallions, garlic, chili paste, water chestnut, chicken broth, sugar, black vinegar, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into 1 / 2-inch cubes and place in a bowl. Step 2: Combine the 2 t soy sauce, 1 1 / 2 t rice wine or sake, 1 tsp sesame oil, ginger and 1 tsp cornstarch and add to the chicken, tossing chicken cubes to coat. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and let chicken marinate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat a wok or large skillet and add 2 1 / 2 tablespoons of the peanut oil, heat until very hot and add the chicken cook over high heat until the chicken cubes become opaque and are cooked, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Remove with a slotted spoon to a plate Wipe out the pan Reheat the pan, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, heat, and add the scallions, garlic and hot chile paste. Step 6: Stir-fry briefly, about 15 seconds, then add the water chestnuts and stir-fry over high heat for about 1 1 / 2 minutes to heat them through. Step 7: Mix the chicken broth through cornstarch together and add to the pan, cook, stirring continuously to prevent lumps, until thickened. Step 8: Return the cooked chicken and add the cashews.

Dish Name: Chili Chicken Stir-fry With Asparagus and Bok Choy
Ingredient Names: mild sweet chili sauce, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, red chilies, chicken thigh fillets, peanut oil, onions, fresh asparagus, bok choy, green onion tops
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first eight ingredients in a glass bowl, add the chicken, mix. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Step 3: Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus, discard, cut asparagus in approx 1 ½ inch pieces. Step 4: Cook, steam or microwave the asparagus until just tender, rinse under cold water, drain. Step 5: Now drain the chicken from the marinade, reserve the marinade. Step 6: Heat one tablespoon of oil in the wok and stir-fry the onions until going soft, remove. Step 7: Heat the rest of the oil, stir-fry the chicken until just browned, add marinade, simmer for approx 10 minutes, until tender, probably less when you use chicken breast, stir now and then. Step 8: Add the onion, asparagus and bok choy, cook until heated through and the bok choy starts to wilt (this won’t be long). Step 9: Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle on the green onions….

Ingredient Names: corn, sesame oil, scallion, ginger, peppercorns, chili flakes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a heavy, non aluminum 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan Rest a deep-fry thermometer on the rim of the pot Over moderately low heat, bring the mixture to a bubbly 225 degrees, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Let simmer for 15 minutes, checking to make sure the temperature does not rise. Step 3: Remove from the heat and let stand until cool or overnight. Step 4: Strain the oil without pressing the solids. Step 5: Then, discard the solids. Step 6: Store the oil in an completely clean glass jar at cool room temperature.

Ingredient Names: pasta, boneless skinless chicken breasts, frozen baby peas, carrot, red bell pepper, green onions, light soy sauce, canola oil, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, dark brown sugar, fresh ginger, hot chili oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, cooked chicken, peas, carrots, red bell pepper and green onion. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk the soy sauce, canola oil, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, brown sugar, ginger and chili oil. Step 3: Pour over chicken pasta mixture and toss to combine. Step 4: Sprinkle on the sesame seeds. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cornstarch, egg, vinegar, soya sauce, salt, green chilies, garlic, green pepper, shallot, water, msg, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make a batter with the'marinade' ingredients. Step 2: Put chicken pieces into it and mix well. Step 3: Set aside for 1 / 2 hour. Step 4: Heat oil, about 2 inches deep, in a wok / frypan. Step 5: Fry chicken pieces, in batches of 6-8 pieces, till cooked through. Step 6: Drain fried chicken on a paper towel. Step 7: When all the chicken pieces are fried, remove oil from the pan, letting about 2 tablespoons remain in it. Step 8: In a small bowl mix together cornstarch and water. Step 9: Put back the wok on fire and heat the 2 tblsps of oil. Step 10: Add green chillies, garlic, green pepper and shallot and stir fry for 30 secsonds.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, asparagus, red bell pepper, scallions, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, honey, garlic, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Place the chicken breasts on a shallow pan and rub the skin with olive oil. Step 3: Sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is just cooked. Step 4: Set aside until cool enough to handle. Step 5: Remove the meat from the bones, discard the skin, and shred the chicken in large bite-sized pieces Blanch the asparagus in a pot of boiling salted water for 3 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender Plunge into ice water to stop the cooking, drain. Step 6: Combine the cut chicken, asparagus, and peppers in a large bowl.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, olive oil, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame paste, sesame oil, ginger, cabbage, purple cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts, sliced water chestnuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Slice each chicken breast horizontally into two or three pieces. Step 2: Combine cup soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and olive oil to make a marinade. Step 3: Marinate the chicken for 30 minutes in the refrigerator, discard marinade. Step 4: Grill chicken breast pieces until cooked through. Step 5: Cool for 15 minutes then thinly slice chicken on the diagonal. Step 6: Meanwhile, shake together remaining cup soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, diluted sesame paste, sesame oil, and minced ginger to make a salad dressing. Step 7: Combine cabbages, carrots, bean sprouts, and water chestnuts. Step 8: Toss well with part of the salad dressing On each serving plate, arrange sliced chicken over a bed of the dressed salad.

Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, wonton wrappers, cooked chicken breasts, iceberg lettuce, bean sprouts, green onions, cilantro leaf, salted peanuts, plum sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, dry mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f Spray large custard cups or foil tart pans with oil. Step 2: Cut wrappers into 6 circles ( use the top of a 6" bowl for a pattern Fit each into pans / cups Lightly spray each wrapper. Step 3: Bake until golden brown, 6-7 minutes, remove to cool. Step 4: Store in airtight container until ready to fill. Step 5: Combine chicken, lettuce, bean sprouts, onions and cilantro in large bowl.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar, chicken broth, cornstarch, fresh broccoli, carrots, peas, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly brown chicken breasts in a small amount of oil. Step 2: Remove from pan and add garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar and 1 cup chicken broth. Step 3: Stir to mix and return chicken to pan and cover. Step 4: Simmer for a few minutes until the chicken is done (15-20 minutes). Step 5: Remove chicken again and add remaining broth, which has been mixed with cornstarch. Step 6: Bring to a boil to thicken and return chicken to the pan, coating it well.

Ingredient Names: chicken, salt, pepper, flour, water, red wine vinegar, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, prepared mustard, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up whole chicken. Step 2: Dust with flour, salt and pepper Brown in skillet. Step 3: Arrange in greased baking dish. Step 4: Combine water, vinegar, brown sugar, worchestershire sauce, mustard and hot sauce in a saucepan and cook until simmering. Step 5: Pour over chicken in baking dish. Step 6: Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, salt, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce, rice wine, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, chili paste, sugar, toasted sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into quarters and rub each piece evenly with the salt. Step 2: Combine the rest of the ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree them. Step 3: Place the chicken in a resealable plastic bag and pour the marinade over Squish around good so the marinade is evenly coating the chicken. Step 4: Set aside to marinate at least 1 hour at room temperature, or refrigerate overnight. Step 5: Preheat broiler, light a fire in an open gril or turn on your gas grill. Step 6: When your chosen cooking method is hot, place the chicken on the grill and cook, over indirect heat, for about 45 minutes turning occasionally, or until meat is no longer pink near the joints This is really good served with steamed jasmine rice and greens or stir-fried pea pods and mushrooms.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, dark soy sauce, hoisin sauce, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, rice wine, toasted sesame oil, chili bean paste, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Step 2: Place the chicken wings in an oven proof baking dish. Step 3: Add the barbecue sauce ingredients to a blender and mix for 5 seconds. Step 4: Pour sauce over the chicken wings and toss to coat thoroughly. Step 5: Bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Step 6: Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f and bake for an additional 20 minutes. Step 7: Serve hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: chicken thigh, soy sauce, powdered ginger, hoisin sauce, white pepper, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken pieces into long thin strips, 3-4 per piece. Step 2: In a large bowl or zip top bag, combine the soy sauce, ginger, hoisin sauce, white pepper, and garllic. Step 3: Place 2 tb of the marinade in a small covered bowl. Step 4: Refrigerate until it is time to cook the chicken. Step 5: Add the chicken to the remaining marinade in the bag, toss until well coated, push the air out of bag and seal. Step 6: Marinate for at least 20 minutes - a few hours is nice and overnight even better. Step 7: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 8: Remove the chicken from marinade. Step 9: Discard the marinade and skewer the chicken using a weaving method with the skewer. Step 10: Place on foil-lined cookie sheets in a single layer,.

Dish Name: Chinese Boiled Chicken With Onions Chow Yow Gai
Ingredient Names: chicken, green onions, light soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large kettle with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: When the water boils, place the whole cleaned chicken into it. Step 3: When the water stops boiling, take the chicken out. Step 4: Cover the pot and when the water again boils, place the chicken back in the pot. Step 5: Cover the pot and turn off the heat. Step 6: Leave the chicken in the pot and the pot on the burner. Step 7: After one hour, the chicken is done. Step 8: Remove, and cool Debone the chicken and tear the meat into small strips. Step 9: Place them on a large platter.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, pepper, green onions, carrot, black bean garlic sauce, garlic, gingerroot, sugar, broccoli, fat-free chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into strips. Step 2: Toss chicken, cornstarch, salt and pepper in medium glass bowl. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes. Step 4: Cut green onions and carrots into thin slices. Step 5: Mix black bean sauce, garlic, gingerroot, and sugar together Spray a 12-inch skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Step 6: Heat until spray bubbles, add chicken and cook until chicken turns white. Step 7: Remove chicken from the skillet Reheat skillet and add chicken broth. Step 8: Add broccoli and carrot.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken And Corn Soup Egg Drop
Ingredient Names: green onions, gingerroot, peanut oil, creamed corn, chicken stock, rice wine, soy sauce, white pepper, cooked chicken, sesame oil, egg
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, saute the onions and ginger in peanut oil until aromatic. Step 2: Add corn, stock, wine, soy sauce and pepper. Step 3: Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes. Step 4: Mix in chicken and sesame oil, and bring just to a simmer. Step 5: Pour the egg slowly into the pan in a thin stream, stirring lightly with a fork to form strands. Step 6: Garnish with onion tops and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, soy sauce, honey, oriental sesame oil, red pepper flakes, fresh ginger, garlic, green onions, linguine, snow peas, cooked chicken, red bell pepper, sliced water chestnuts, green onion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Dressing: combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Step 2: In a food processor, process ginger, garlic, and green onions until chopped fine. Step 3: Whisk into soy mixture. Step 4: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 5: Drain, rinse under cold water and set aside. Step 6: Heat snow peas and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in 1 inch water in medium saucepan over high heat until snow peas are bright green, 20 seconds, remove from heat. Step 7: Drain and rinse under cold water Julienne. Step 8: Add snow peas and pasta to dressing with remaining ingredients.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken And Shrimp Noodle Soup
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken pieces, onion, water, large shrimp, mushroom, cellophane noodle, soy sauce, oil, green onions, garlic, ground coriander, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken, onion, water and salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer for approx 20 minutes, or until meat is tender. Step 3: Remove chicken from pot and allow to cool, then remove the meat from the bones. Step 4: Cut the meat into long thin slivers, and discard bones. Step 5: Place chicken back in the pot along with the shrimp and mushrooms. Step 6: Bring to a boil and simmer gently, for about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the noodles and the soy sauce and cook 5 minutes more. Step 8: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a small skillet and cook green onions, garlic, and ground coriander for approx 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Add to soup just prior to serving, mixing well.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken Bites With Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, scallions, flour, soy sauce, water, sesame oil, ground ginger, salt, pepper, peanut oil, hot water, hoisin sauce, honey, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients-chicken through pepper- and mix well. Step 2: Pour about 1 / 2" peanut oil in a heavy skillet. Step 3: Heat to medium high heat. Step 4: Drop chicken mixture by teaspoonfuls into hot oil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low and fry the chicken bites for 5 to 6 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Step 6: Drain on paper towels and serve immediately. Step 7: In a small saucepan, saute scallions in the sesame oil for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer until flavors are incorporated. Step 9: Simmer for about 5 to 10 minutes. Step 10: Sprinkle in the flour and stir well.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken Burgers With Rainbow Sesame Slaw Contest Winner
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, soy sauce, sugar, toasted sesame oil, garlic cloves, lemongrass, scallion, hamburger buns with sesame seeds, butter, vegetable oil, hoisin sauce, mayonnaise, lime, chili sauce, bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, mix together ground chicken, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, lemongrass and scallions. Step 2: Divide the mixture into 6 patties and set aside. Step 3: Place a grill pan over medium heat. Step 4: Spread softened butter on hamburger buns and place on grill pan until light brown Wipe grill pan with paper towel and brush with vegetable oil. Step 5: Place chicken patties on grill pan and cook over medium-high heat, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees, about 7 minutes per side During last few minutes of cooking, baste each burger with 1 tablespoon of the hoisin sauce To assemble, place 1 tablespoon sriracha lime mayo on each bottom and top bun. Step 6: Place chicken on bun bottoms and top each with 1 / 3 cup rainbow sesame slaw. Step 7: Serve with any remaining slaw and mayo on the side.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground chicken, celery, onion, mushroom pieces, peas and carrots, milk, condensed cream of chicken soup, soy sauce, salt, pepper, parsley flakes, butter, almonds, dry breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Fry chicken in oil with celery and onion until chicken is done. Step 2: Add mushrooms and peas and carrots. Step 3: Stir in milk and soup. Step 4: Add soy sauce, salt, pepper, and parsley, mix well. Step 5: Pour into 1 1 / 2 qt casserole, melt butter. Step 6: Add almonds and bread crumbs to butter and mix well. Step 7: Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over top of casserole. Step 8: Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes at 350 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, cream of mushroom soup, pineapple tidbits, soy sauce, celery, green onions, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except noodles, mixing well Gently fold in 1 cup of noodles. Step 2: Spoon into 8x8x2 inch baking dish. Step 3: Sprinkle with remaining noodles. Step 4: Bake in 350 oven for 50 minutes or until hot.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, cooked chicken breast, green onion, sesame seeds, almonds, ramen noodles, celery, sugar, salt, pepper, vinegar, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix dressing ingredients in a small jar and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Step 2: Layer cabbage, celery, green onions and chicken, set aside. Step 3: Add toasted sesame seeds and toasted almonds and top ramen noodles just before adding dressing. Step 4: Toss and serve immediately for best flavor and "crunch".

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, onions, chicken breasts, curry powder, sugar, salt, soy sauce, water, potatoes, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy pot over high heat, about 30 seconds, add garlic, fry until brown, add onions. Step 2: Stir fry 3 minutes. Step 3: Remove onions and set aside. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in pot. Step 5: Add chicken and curry powder. Step 6: Stir fry 3 minutes. Step 7: Add sugar, salt, soy sauce and water.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, green onions, aluminum foil, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sherry wine, oil, sesame oil, garlic clove, pepper, sugar, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1"x1" pieces. Step 2: Place in a shallow pan. Step 3: Sprinkle green onions on top. Step 4: Mix all marinade ingredients together and pour over chicken. Step 5: Marinate for 2 hours at room temperature, or overnight in the refrigerator. Step 6: Wrap each piece of chicken in a square of foil. Step 7: Place in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Step 8: Bake at 450 for 12 minutes.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken In Sweet And Sour Sauce
Ingredient Names: celery, carrots, green pepper, flour, garlic, egg, ginger, salt and pepper, chicken breast fillets, oil, water, brown sugar, vinegar, tomatoes, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cook celery, geen peppers and carrots in a small amount of water in a saucepan, until tender-crisp, drain, set aside. Step 2: Combine flour, minced garlic, egg, ginger, salt and pepper in a bowl. Step 3: Mix well Pound the chicken fillets with a meat mallet, cut into strips. Step 4: Dip the chicken strips into batter Coating well Brown lightly in hot oil, in a large skillet. Step 5: Drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, olive oil, lean ground chicken, garlic cloves, ginger, sweet chili sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, coriander leaves, lettuce cups
Instructions: Step 1: Pour boiling water over the rice noodles. Step 2: Allow to sit for 5 minutes then drain. Step 3: Cut into smaller lengths. Step 4: Heat a wok or non stick pan over a high heat with the oil. Step 5: Add the chicken mince and stir fry for 4 minutes or until cooked through breaking up with a wooden spoon. Step 6: Add the garlic and ginger and fry for a further 2 minutes. Step 7: Toss in the noodles and stir until heated through. Step 8: In a small bowl combine the sweet chilli sauce, fish sauce and soy sauce and stir through the mince. Step 9: Remove from the heat and stir through the coriander. Step 10: Serve in the lettuce cups.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, egg noodles, vegetable oil, chicken breasts, garlic, yellow onion, yellow pepper, red pepper, sliced water chestnuts, shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, chili sauce, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Unwrap lettuce into "cups" and wash thoroughly. Step 2: Heat vegetable oil in a wok, on medium high heat, and after a minute, add noodles You will want to separate them with your fingers as you add so that the noodles are not clumpy. Step 3: Cook for 5 to 10 minutes depending on the level of crispiness desired. Step 4: Prepare your chicken and vegetables as you wait. Step 5: Once the noodles are done, remove and set aside If desired, pour 1 tsp of oil in the same wok before you saute the garlic Do this for about 30 seconds Garlic can burn quickly so do not leave it too long. Step 6: Add chicken, stir fry until no longer pink.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken Lettuce Wraps Or Chinese Tacos
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, black mushrooms, lettuce, peanuts, rice noodles, vegetable oil, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, sesame oil, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation: mince chicken breast meat. Step 2: Chop bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, and black mushrooms into small pieces, then boil in hot water for one minute. Step 3: Wash lettuce thoroughly, tear into round leaves and set on small plates Mince peanuts Cooking: deep fry the rice noodles and set in the center of lettuce. Step 4: Heat one tsp Vegetable oil in a pan, stir-fry minced garlic first. Step 5: Add the chicken meat and cook over medium heat until almost dry Next add bamboo shoots, water chestnuts and black mushrooms, stir-fry with soy sauce and sugar for one minute before adding a dash of white pepper and sesame oil. Step 6: Remove from the stove and pour mixture over the fried rice noodles.

Ingredient Names: top ramen noodles, swanson chicken broth, frozen peas, water chestnut, egg, chicken breasts, bok choy, carrots, sesame oil, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: This soup changes as the ingredients are available in my refrigerator or on my cupboard shelves Takes about 20 minutes from start to table Start 2 cups of water to boil, add chicken broth. Step 2: After stock boils, add the packet of seasoning supplied with top ramen While broth is boiling, add 1 raw chicken breast, the chopped vegetables and the raw egg The egg will cook into threads Just before serving, add the noodles and the peas, then the sesame oil and scallions Don't let soup sit around for long time because vegetables need to be a bit crunchy, cooked soft If using leftover meat in your soup, just add at the end because it only needs to warm up again.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, boneless chicken thighs, carrot, celery, red bell pepper, water chestnuts, baby sweet corn cobs, brown sugar, low sodium soy sauce, water, worcestershire sauce, garlic, ginger, pepper, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 9 x 13 pan and add chicken and veggies of your choice Except for scallions and corn starch mix together sauce ingredients adjusting the amount of sugar and spices to suit your preferences and pour over chicken and veggies, toss to coat. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400 and bake uncovered for about 45 minutes or until chicken and veggies are done. Step 3: Stir once at about 30 minutes and check for doneness About 10 miutes before it is done mix water and corn starch and sesame oil and mix into chicken and continue baking to thicken sauce.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken Salad With Peanut Sesame Dressing
Ingredient Names: whole chicken breasts, salt, chinese egg noodles, peanut oil, white sesame seeds, red bell pepper, carrot, fresh cilantro leaves, cucumber, peanut butter, sesame paste, sugar, dark soy sauce, chinese red vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large saucepan three-fourths full with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add the chicken breasts and return to a boil, skimming off any scum that forms on the surface, then immediately reduce the heat to low. Step 3: Simmer, uncovered, until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Step 4: Drain and let cool. Step 5: Remove the skin from the chicken breasts, bone the breasts and hand shred the meat with the grain into strips about 1 / 2 inch thick and 2 inches long Refill the large saucepan three-fourths full with water. Step 6: Bring to a boil over high heat and add the salt Gently pull the strands of noodles apart, then drop them into the boiling water, stirring to separate the strands. Step 7: When the water comes to a second boil, boil for 1 minute longer. Step 8: Pour the noodles into a colander and rinse thoroughly with cold running water.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken Salad With Spicy Noodles And Sesame Sauce
Ingredient Names: linguine, sesame oil, roasted chicken meat, tahini, chunky peanut butter, garlic, light soy sauce, sake, water, safflower oil, hot chili oil, water chestnuts, cucumber, red bell pepper, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, about 12 minutes, drain. Step 2: Toss with 1 tablespoon sesame oil in bowl. Step 3: Cover and chill at least 2 hours. Step 4: Cut chicken meat from breast and legs into 1 / 4-inch strips, cover and chill. Step 5: Blend tahini, peanut butter and garlic in small bowl Gradually mix in remaining 2 teaspoons sesame oil, soy sauce, sake', water, safflower oil and 1 teaspoon chili oil. Step 6: Taste and add more chili oil if desired, add to noodles.

Ingredient Names: bibb lettuce, whole wheat pita bread, chicken, fresh bean sprout, mayonnaise, green onion, sesame seeds, soy sauce, pepper, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place one lettuce leaf inside each pita half In a small bowl stir together remaining ingredients Fill pita halves with mixture Wrap in plastic wrap and chill.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, pineapple chunks, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, cornstarch, chicken broth, hoisin sauce, sweet red peppers, green peppers, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In resealable bag, put the chicken pieces, pineapple and juice, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, cornstarch, chicken broth and hoisin sauce Shake well. Step 2: Refrigerate for 25 minutes Coat a wok with cooking spray and set to med hi heat. Step 3: Remove the chicken and pineapple from bag with slotted spoon, When wok is hot, add the chicken and pineapple. Step 4: Cook and stir for 2 minutes, add the peppers. Step 5: Cook and stir for 3 minutes, add the marinade.

Ingredient Names: sweet red peppers, sesame oil, garlic clove, fresh gingerroot, carrot, green onion, chicken, cooked rice, frozen english peas, egg, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut a 1 / 2" thick slice from the side of each pepper, reserving slices, remove seeds. Step 2: Place peppers in boiling water, boil 5 minutes, drain, set aside Coat a large skillet or wok with pam. Step 3: Add sesame oil, and place over med heat until hot. Step 4: Add garlic and gingerroot. Step 5: Stir fry 30 seconds. Step 6: Add carrots and green onions. Step 7: Stir fry 2 minutes more, remove from heat.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken With An Indian Touch
Ingredient Names: chicken, soya sauce, egg, plain flour, fresh ginger, fresh green chilies, black pepper, salt, oil, ajinomoto, garam masala powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place the small chicken pcs, in a bowl. Step 2: Beat the egg in a bowl using an electric beater. Step 3: Add this beaten egg, plain flour and salt to the chicken pcs, mix well. Step 4: Keep aside for 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat oil in a frying pan for deep frying the chicken pcs Gently put the chicken pcs In the pan and deep fry them on low flame Ensure that the chicken remains soft.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken With Black Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, cornstarch, onion, frozen peas and carrot, cooking oil, steamed rice, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, black pepper, white pepper, rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Step 2: Cut chicken into a small dice, about 1 / 4-inch. Step 3: Heat 1-2 cups peanut or other cooking oil in your wok. Step 4: Place cornstarch in a small bowl and begin to dust chicken pieces, shaking off excess. Step 5: Fry in hot oil in small batches until crispy and golden, about 2-3 minutes, drain. Step 6: Remove oil from wok and discard. Step 7: Heat 1 tbsp oil in wok and stir-fry onion about 1 minute. Step 8: Add peas and carrots and cook another 30 seconds. Step 9: Add sauce mixture to wok along with chicken pieces and stir to coat everything evenly.

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken With Leeks And Black Beans
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, light soy sauce, chinese rice wine, fresh ginger, peanut oil, garlic cloves, fermented black beans, leeks, sesame oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken and soak in the marinade for 15 minutes. Step 2: Heat the wok and add 1 tablespoon of the oil, along with the garlic and the rinsed black beans. Step 3: Stir fry for a moment and add the drained chicken. Step 4: Stir over high heat until the chicken is cooked, and remove to a serving plate. Step 5: Add the remaining peanut oil to the hot wok, along with the leeks. Step 6: Stir until leeks are tender. Step 7: Return chicken to the pan along with the remaining ingredients. Step 8: Stir fry for a moment, and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, green onions, canned pineapple, honey, soy sauce, dry mustard, pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, egg, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Beat egg lightly and set aside for egg wash. Step 3: Mix together honey, soy sauce, and dry mustard in a bowl. Step 4: Add chicken, green onion, and pineapple and stir well Unroll crescents and separate into 4 pieces and pinch together the seams. Step 5: Cut each triangle crosswise into halves. Step 6: Spoon 1 tablespoonful of mix onto each dough piece, pull corners to center, and roll up to seal. Step 7: Brush top of roll with more egg wash and sprinkle with seame seeds. Step 8: Place on an ungreased baking sheet while waiting for others to get done. Step 9: Repeat procedure with rest of dough and filling.

Ingredient Names: chicken, scallions, fresh ginger, orange zest, peanut oil, toasted sesame oil, honey, soy sauce, five-spice powder, rice vinegar, garlic clove, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken: Preheat oven to 425f. Step 2: Stuff the chicken cavity with the scallions, ginger, and orange zest. Step 3: Set a v or regular rack in a roasting pan and brush with 1 teaspoons of the peanut oil. Step 4: Whisk the rermaining 1 teaspoons peanut oil with the sesame oil, honey, and soy sauce. Step 5: Brush the soy mixture over all of the chicken and sprinkle with five spice powder Tuck the wings under the back, cross the legs, and tie them with kitchen twine. Step 6: Place the chicken breast side down on the rack and roast until the back is golden brown, 35-40 minutes. Step 7: Remove chicken from the oven and turn it over, breast side up. Step 8: Cut the string where it holds the legs together and gently open the legs a bit.

Ingredient Names: chicken, soy sauce, sherry wine, salt, sugar, scallion, gingerroot, peanut oil, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the 8 chicken pieces into 2-inch pieces cutting across the bones. Step 2: Rinse chicken, drain and pat with paper towels. Step 3: In a large bowl combine next 6 ingredients, stirring until salt& sugar dissolve. Step 4: Add chicken to bowl, tossing so all the pieces are coated with mixture. Step 5: Marinate for 1-2 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator. Step 6: Drain marinade and discard Wipe chicken pices dry with paper towels. Step 7: Pour the oil into wok or deep-fryer and heat over med high heat until oil forms a haze or it registers 375-degrees f on deep frying thermoter. Step 8: Put flour in plastic or paper baggies. Step 9: Add chicken and shake well to coat chicken evenly.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cornstarch, splenda granular, soy sauce, white wine vinegar, ground ginger, olive oil, scallions, garlic, red pepper flakes, boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 2 inch pieces. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix together chicken broth, cornstarch, splenda, soy sauce, vinegar and ginger, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add scallions, garlic and pepper. Step 5: Cook 2 minutes, add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 more minutes. Step 6: Add sauce and simmer until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Serve chicken and sauce over rice.

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, olive oil, garlic clove, hoisin sauce, honey, soy sauce, ground ginger, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except chicken in a plastic bag Stab the chicken a few times to make sure it soaks up all the goods, then add to the liquid. Step 2: Place in fridge for at least a few hours. Step 3: Remove chicken from marinade and grill until done turning once.

Dish Name: Chinese Honey Soy Braised Chicken Wings Mut Jup Mun Gai Yik
Ingredient Names: chicken wings, peanut oil, dark soy sauce, honey, chinese wine, garlic clove, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each chicken wing into 3 pieces, discard wing. Step 2: Heat oil in wok or skillet and fry joints on high heat for 3-4 minutes, or until browned. Step 3: Add soy, honey, wine or sherry, garlic and ginger, stir well. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until tender. Step 5: Stir frequently towards end of cooking and make sure the sweet does not burn. Step 6: Serve warm, either with white rice or as a main course for two.

Dish Name: Chinese Hot And Sour Chicken Noodle Salad
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, dry linguine, peppercorn, dried hot red chile, salad oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, fresh cilantro, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: In a 5-6 quart pan, bring about 3 quarts of water to a boil. Step 2: Add chicken, cover and bring to a boil. Step 3: Remove from heat and let stand, covered, until meat is white in thickest part, about 20-25 min Lift out chicken, let cool and reserve water. Step 4: Remove and discard skin and bones Tear chicken into bite-size shreds If made ahead, cover and chill chicken and water until next day. Step 5: Bring water to a boil and add linguine. Step 6: Boil, uncovered, until just tender to bite, 6-8 min, drain.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, vermicelli, dried shiitake mushrooms, chicken, bamboo shoot, fresh ginger, ketchup, sherry wine vinegar, white pepper, scallions, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Heat stock in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Place noodles in a bowl, add boiling water to cover and soak until soft-about 3-5 minutes drain and add to the stock. Step 3: Place mushrooms in a bowl, add boiling water to cover and soak for 5 minutes. Step 4: Drain, slice thinly and add to the stock. Step 5: Add diced chicken, bamboo shoots and ginger and stir to combine. Step 6: Cook until chicken is tender, 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Stir in remaining ingredients and cook for 1-2 minutes more. Step 8: Taste and adjust seasonings by adding a little more vinegar or chili as desired. Step 9: Serve immediately, ladled into bowls.

Dish Name: Chinese Imperial Palace General Tso's Chicken
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, water, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, sugar, soy sauce, white vinegar, sherry wine, condensed chicken broth, msg, boneless skinless chicken, white pepper, egg, green onions, dried hot peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients for sauce in a quart jar with a lid and shake gently. Step 2: Store in refrigerator until ready for use. Step 3: Mix chicken, soy sauce, and pepper, stir in egg. Step 4: Add cornstarch, and mix until chicken pieces are coated Deep fry 7 or 8 chicken pieces at a time in a 350 degree oil until chicken pieces are crispy. Step 5: Drain on paper towels. Step 6: Repeat until all chicken is fried. Step 7: Place a small amount of oil in wok, and heat to 400 degrees. Step 8: Add onions, peppers, and stir fry about 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red pepper, scallions, celery, carrot, cayenne pepper, garlic, dried ginger, fresh mushrooms, salt, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or a wok heat the oil. Step 2: Add the red pepper, scallions, celery, carrots, cayenne pepper and garlic. Step 3: Saute until tender. Step 4: Add the ginger, salt and mushrooms. Step 5: Cook for an additional 5 minutes. Step 6: Lower the heat and add the chicken. Step 7: Make sure you heat the chicken thoroughly. Step 8: Serve over passover noodles or rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, egg white, cornstarch, white pepper, soy sauce, thai peppers, green pepper, onion, celery, sliced water chestnuts, dry sherry, rice wine vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Step 2: Combine egg white, corn starch, pepper and soy sauce in a glass bowl. Step 3: Add chicken pieces mixing to coat well. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes Vegetables: set aside prepared vegetables Sauce: mix all sauce ingredients in a glass bowl and set aside ) in a wok or large frying pan, stir fry the red peppers in the 1 tbsp peanut oil over med -high heat until the peppers are almost golden brown. Step 5: Add chicken mixture and stir-fry until the chicken is almost cooked through-add the vegetables and stir-fry a couple of minutes. Step 6: Add the sauce mixture and heat for a minute or so.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, salt, eggs, cornstarch, baking powder, white pepper, oil, sugar, chicken broth, lemon juice, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Place cut chicken breast pieces into a bowl and mix with 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and teaspoon of salt. Step 2: Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes To make the batter beat 2 large eggs with cup of cornstarch, a pinch of white pepper and baking powder Coat the chicken with the batter. Step 3: Heat deep fryer to 350 degrees and deep-fry in batches until chicken is fully cooked. Step 4: Drain on paper towels and set aside You can also cook the chicken using a wok if you dont have a deep fryer. Step 5: Now, to make the lemon sauce combine 1 / 3 cup of sugar, 2 tablespoons cornstarch, 1 cup chicken broth, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and teaspoon salt. Step 6: Mix until well combined and add 3 slices of lemon to the sauce mixture. Step 7: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in your wok and stir in the lemon sauce mixture and heat until well mixed and sauce becomes clear.

Ingredient Names: garlic, ground pepper, ground beef, scallions, cubes instant chicken-flavored broth, water, sugar, oyster sauce, soy sauce, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Saute' meat and seasonings, add scallions. Step 2: Dissolve Herb-Ox in water and add to meat. Step 3: Add sugar, oyster sauce and soy sauce. Step 4: Mix corn starch with some of the liquid to thicken.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, dark soy sauce, white wine vinegar, dry sherry, superfine sugar, garlic cloves, clear honey, five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Finely grate the ginger, collect it up into a ball and squeeze out the juice into a bowl Stir in the other ingredients and use as required.

Dish Name: Chinese Melon Soup Dong Gwah Jong
Ingredient Names: watermelon balls, chicken stock, bamboo shoot, mushrooms, smoked ham, cooked turkey, gingerroot, sugar, salt, white pepper, toasted almond
Instructions: Step 1: For fancy presentation - remove top of melon Scoop out melon and seeds, reserving 3 cups melon balls Scallop edge of melon. Step 2: In a large pan, heat stock, bamboo, mushrooms, ham, chicken, ginger, sugar, salt, and pepper and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce the heat to low, half cover the pan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes Just before serving add reserved melon balls and pour soup into the melon shell. Step 4: Sprinkle with almonds and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: orange zest, orange juice, soy sauce, water, rice vinegar, cornstarch, sesame seed oil, sugar, chicken thighs, large egg, salt, black pepper, all purpose flour, vegetable oil, garlic, shallots, scallions, sesame seeds, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Make the orange sauce: Whisk together sauce ingredients in a medium bowl, set aside. Step 2: Prep the chicken: Cut chicken into about 1-inch cubes. Step 3: Whisk eggs with salt and black pepper in a bowl and add chicken, stir together. Step 4: In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and cornstarch. Step 5: Remove chicken from eggs with a slotted spoon or tongs, letting excess egg drain off, then transfer to cornstarch mixture and coat well. Step 6: Fry the chicken: Add oil to a large 10- to 12-inch skillet. Step 7: Heat over medium-high heat until it reaches. Step 8: If you don’t have a thermometer, you can also test the temperature by sprinkling in some flour. Step 9: If the oil is hot enough, it should fizzle immediately. Step 10: Once oil is hot, fry the chicken in two batches. Step 11: The oil might not completely cover the chicken—that’s okay, cook for 3 to. Step 12: Flip the chicken pieces and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 to 4 more minutes. Step 13: Total cook time is about 6 to. Step 14: Remove fried chicken cubes and transfer to a plate lined with paper towels, so the chicken can drain. Step 15: Repeat until all the chicken is cooked. Step 16: Simmer the chicken in the sauce: Once chicken is done, pour out hot oil and wipe pan clean. Step 17: Add a fresh tablespoon of oil along with chopped garlic and shallot. Step 18: Cook for a minute and then add the sauce. Step 19: Simmer the sauce until it starts to thicken. Step 20: Once the sauce is lightly bubbling, add fried chicken and toss together to coat. Step 21: The sauce should continue to thicken and stick to the chicken. Step 22: Let simmer for a minute or two more. Step 23: Serve orange chicken over cooked white rice, garnished with sesame seeds and fresh scallions. Step 24: Did you love this recipe? Step 25: Let us know with a rating and review!, lEFTOVERS! Step 26: The orange chicken keeps well in the fridge for 5 days. Step 27: Reheat in a skillet with a splash of water over low heat. Step 28: Freeze the orange chicken for up to 3 months, but be sure to thaw it before reheating so the chicken doesn’t clump together.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, peanut oil, cornstarch, toasted sesame seeds, orange juice, light soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, chicken stock, sugar, oil, garlic clove, apple cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the ingredients for the marinade. Step 2: Add chicken and marinate for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 3: In a separate bowl, mix together the sauce ingredients: orange juice, chicken stock, sugar, soy sauce, salt, and sesame oil. Step 4: In a small to medium sized pot, heat up a few teaspoons oil and saut minced garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add apple cider vinegar, then the combined sauce ingredients. Step 6: Simmer until liquid is reduced by three fourths, about 15 minutes. Step 7: Stir in cornstarch and water mixture until sauce thickens, then season with salt to taste. Step 8: Set sauce aside and keep warm Drip excess marinade off the chicken, and toss cubes in 1 cup of cornstarch Shake off excess before frying.

Dish Name: Chinese Pineapple Chicken With Cashew Nuts Ginger Spring Onion
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, roasted cashew nuts, spring onions, onion, green pepper, pineapple chunks in juice, gingerroot, garlic cloves, sunflower oil, rice wine, soy sauce, honey, golden syrup, tomato ketchup, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: First of all make the sauce. Step 2: Combine everything, mix well until smooth and set aside. Step 3: Fry the chicken in the oil with the onion and ginger for 5 minutes over a medium high heat. Step 4: Add the green pepper and the pineapple chunks and fry for another 5 minutes adding half of the spring onions after 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the crushed garlic and the cashew nuts, fry for 2 minutes then pour over the sauce and bring to the boil. Step 6: After a minute or 2, the sauce should thicken and stick to the chicken It it looks too thick, add some water, little by little until desired consistency is acheived Utterly delicious.

Ingredient Names: egg roll crepes, chinese cabbage, water chestnuts, green onion, salt, boiling water, light soy sauce, catsup, fresh lemon juice, honey, pork, egg, lite olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl combine the cabbage, water chestnuts& green onion. Step 2: Pour the boiling water over them and let stand 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain completely, let all the water drain off. Step 4: Stir in the pinch of salt, soy, catsup, lemon juice, honey& pork. Step 5: Place about two tbsp on each crepe. Step 6: Fold up the bottom of the crepe then fold in the sides and finally bring down the top. Step 7: Brush overlapping edges with the beaten egg and seal Carefully drop the crepes into about 1 inch of hot oil. Step 8: Fry until crisp brown. Step 9: Drain on paper towel.

Dish Name: Chinese Pot Stickers Chicken Pork Or Vegetarian
Ingredient Names: boiling water, dried shiitake mushrooms, vegetable oil, green onion, gingerroot, green cabbage, water, pork sausage, soy sauce, white pepper, dark sesame oil, egg white, garlic clove, wonton wrappers, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine water and mushrooms, cover and let soak for 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain, discard stems, and mince caps. Step 3: In a large non-stick skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat until hot. Step 4: Saute mushrooms in oil with onions and ginger. Step 5: Add cabbage and cook until cabbage is lightly browned, stirring frequently While cabbage is cooking add water 1 tbsp at a time to keep it from sticking to the pan, if needed. Step 6: Spoon cabbage mixture into a medium sized bowl and let it cool. Step 7: Add chicken and next 5 ingredients to the bowl and mix well Working with one wonton wrapper at a time, spoon a tablespoon full of the mixture into the middle of the wrapper Moisten the edges with water.

Ingredient Names: broiler-fryer chicken, soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, sesame oil, dry mustard, ground ginger, garlic, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, sesamme oil, dry mustard, ginger, garlic and ground black pepper to make the marinade. Step 2: Place chicken in a bowl or zip lock plastic bag. Step 3: Pour marinade over it. Step 4: Marinate in refrigerator for at least one hour, i marinate it for at least 12 hours. Step 5: Turn the chicken over in marinade occasionally. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit Roast chicken on rack until chicken is dark brown and a fork can be inserted with ease, at least 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 7: Bring marinade to full boil and use to baste chicken every 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, white pepper, light soy sauce, rice wine, ginger, egg white, flour, cornstarch, sesame seeds, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate thighs for 15 mins Dip each thigh into egg white and dredge in flour and cornstarch mixed with sesame seeds Deep fry until tender, 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chinese sesame paste, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sugar, dark sesame oil, hot chili oil, cooked chicken breast, cucumber, chinese egg noodles, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together sesame paste, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sugar, sesame oil and hot oil. Step 2: Stir in 1 / 4 cup cold water until it forms a smooth sauce, set aside. Step 3: Chop chicken into bite-size pieces and set aside Peel cucumber, slice, and remove seeds. Step 4: Chop into bite-size pieces. Step 5: Cook noodles in boiling water just until tender, 5-8 minutes. Step 6: Place noodles in cold water and allow to drain. Step 7: Place drained noodles in a large bowl and toss with the chicken and cucumber. Step 8: Pour half the sauce over the noodles along with the sesame seeds and toss gently.

Ingredient Names: marinade, garlic, fresh ginger, kosher salt, sugar, soy sauce, rice wine, chicken, frying chicken, flour, corn oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the marinade ingredients with the chicken and set aside for 1 hour. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f Dredge the pieces of chicken in the flour. Step 3: Place a rack in a shallow baking pan and put the pan near the stove. Step 4: Heat a large skillet and add the oil. Step 5: When the oil is hot, fry the pieces of chicken on both sides until lightly browned, about 4 or 5 minutes. Step 6: Arrange the chicken on the rack so they don't touch and bake for 45 minutes or until done. Step 7: Serve hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: chicken, soy sauce, water, brown sugar, oyster sauce, rice wine, fresh ginger, five-spice powder, star anise, garlic, birds eye chile, scallion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients, except chicken, scallions, sesame seeds in a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken, then let simmer 30-40 minutes, turning chicken pieces occasionally. Step 3: Remove chicken pieces from sauce and set aside in a serving platter Skim fat from the sauce, thicken it with cornstarch mixture and pour the sauce over chicken. Step 4: Sprinkle scallions and sesame seeds and serve with rice.

Dish Name: Chinese Steamed Chicken And Chinese Sausage
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, soy sauce, sugar, salt, cornstarch, sherry wine, ginger juice, dried mushrooms, chinese sausage
Instructions: Step 1: Chop chicken into 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch pieces. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix chicken with soy sauce, sugar, salt, cornstarch, sherry wine, and ginger juice. Step 3: Remove stems from mushrooms that have been soaked and softened. Step 4: Slice into long pieces. Step 5: Stir mushrooms and larp chong into chicken. Step 6: Put mixture into a 9 inch glass pie plate. Step 7: Steam over boiling water for 25 minutes or cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 13 - 16 minutes. Step 8: Serve with steamed white rice.

Ingredient Names: onion and garlic croutons, cornstarch, light soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken thighs, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, whisk crouton crumbs and cornstarch. Step 2: Stir in the soy sauce. Step 3: Add chicken and toss until completely coated, cover. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add chicken and cook, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes until nice and crispy and cooked through. Step 7: Turn about 4 or 5 times during cooking to avoid burning. Step 8: Drain on paper towels. Step 9: Serve immediately with additional soy sauce, chopped scallions, cooked rice and steamed sugar snap peas, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillets, garlic cloves, spring onions, red chile, egg, five-spice powder, plum sauce, white bread, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, salad leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into small pieces, peel and chop the garlic, trim and finely chop the spring onions and deseed and finely chop the chilli. Step 2: In a food processor, process the chicken, garlic, chili, egg, five spice powder a 1 tablespoon of the plum sauce until it has formed a coarse paste. Step 3: Transfer the mixture to a mixing bowl and add the spring onions, stirring until they have been well-combined with the rest of the ingredients. Step 4: Spread equal amounts of the chicken mixture over each slice of bread, sprinkle with sesame seeds and then press down gently with your fingers. Step 5: Cut each bread slice diagonally into quarters. Step 6: Heat the oil in a pan, preferably non-stick, until it is really hot, then add the toasts and shallow-fry them in batches for 5 minutes per batch, or until golden brown. Step 7: Drain them on paper kitchen towels, brush with the remaining plum sauce and garnish with salad leaves Drier bread will give the toasts a crunchier texture.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg yolk, butter, soy sauce, lemon juice, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Mix egg yolks, melted butter, soy sauce, lemon juice and honey together, pour over chicken. Step 2: Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 45 minutes. Step 3: Uncover and bake an additional 45 minutes or until juices run clear.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Chicken Chow Mein With Crispy Noodles
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, rice wine, soy sauce, chicken stock, rice vinegar, sesame oil, oyster sauce, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, cornstarch, chinese egg noodles, peanut oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken, 1 tablespoon of rice wine and 1 teaspoon of soy sauce in a medium bowl. Step 2: Marinate at room temperature while you assemble the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: In a separate bowl, combine the remaining 1 / 4 cup of soy sauce, the remaining 3 tablespoons of rice wine, the stock, rice vinegar, sesame oil, oyster sauce, sugar, red chili sauce, and cornstarch, set aside. Step 4: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil in an large pot. Step 5: Add the noodles and cook according to the package directions. Step 6: Drain the noodles and rinse them under cold water to stop the cooking Lay the noodles out on paper towels to dry. Step 7: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan to 360f and add the noodles They will cling together forming a pancake of sorts.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out General Tso's Chicken
Ingredient Names: egg, cornstarch, soy sauce, mirin, boneless chicken, rice vinegar, sugar, hoisin sauce, chili paste with garlic, black peppercorns, sesame oil, vegetable oil, hot chili peppers, fresh ginger, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the egg, 3 tablespoons of cornstarch, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon mirin. Step 2: Add the chicken and let it marinate at room temperature while you assemble the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: In a separate bowl, combine the remaining tablespoon of cornstarch, the remaining 1 / 4 cup soy sauce, the remaining 2 tablespoons mirin, and the rice vinegar, sugar, hoisin, chili paste, peppercorns, sesame oil, and 1 / 2 cup water, set aside. Step 4: In a heavy pot over medium heat, heat 3 inches of oil to 360f. Step 5: Add about 10 pieces of chicken to the hot oil and fry until brown and crispy, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Remove from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Step 7: Repeat with the remaining chicken, set aside. Step 8: Remove all but 3 tablespoons of oil from the pot and add the chilies, ginger, and garlic, and cook for 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, peanut oil, tangerine peel, gingerroot, dried red chilies, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken in oil until no longer pink. Step 2: Stir in the tangerine peel, ginger root and dried chiles, fry for a mintue. Step 3: Then add soy sauce and vinegar and sugar. Step 4: Simmer for 15 minutes Before serving discard chiles.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, soy sauce, chicken stock, egg whites, peanut oil, sugar snap pea, fresh shiitake mushroom, water chestnuts, chili paste, mushroom soy sauce, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and grate ginger Finely mince garlic cloves. Step 2: Mix ground chicken with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, 1 / 2 cup chicken stock Lightly beat and gently fold in egg whites Thinly slice mushrooms. Step 3: Chop water chestnuts. Step 4: Heat peanut oil in wok to frying temperature of 375. Step 5: Drop chicken mixture by rounded spoonful 5 or 6 at a time You should taste test to be sure seasoning is to your liking Finish frying chicken.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, snow peas, red pepper, sugar-free orange gelatin, cornstarch, chicken broth, fat-free italian salad dressing, garlic cloves, oil, orange, canned pineapple chunk
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pineapple chunks in half for smaller pieces Leaving peel on, cut orange into eighths. Step 2: Chill 4 sections in refrigerator for garnish Peel remaining 4 sections and chop into bite-sized chunks. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet on medium-high heat, add chicken. Step 4: Cook 4 minutes or until cooked through, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add snow peas and peppers, cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 6: Mix dry gelatin mix and cornstarch in small bowl. Step 7: Add broth, salad dressing and garlic.

Dish Name: Chinese braised pork with double spring onions
Ingredient Names: pork osso buco, rapeseed oil, shaohsing rice wine, ginger, garlic, green onions fat ones thinner ones, red chile, chicken, miso paste, soy sauce, steamed rice bok choi
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Brown the pork on both sides in the oil, then transfer it to a large casserole dish. Deglaze the pan you used for browning with the rice wine or Sherry and add it to the casserole. Add the ginger and garlic. Trim the ends off the 8 fat spring onions and add these to the pan whole along with the chilli, stock, miso paste (if using) and soy sauce. Bring everything to a simmer, then cover and put the casserole in the oven for 2 hrs. Step 2: Remove the lid from the casserole and cook for a further 20 mins. Chop the 4 thinner spring onions and add them to the casserole just before serving with steamed rice and bok choi.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, salt and pepper, honey, soy sauce, brown sugar, fresh garlic, lemon juice, peppercorns, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut. Step 2: Cut remaining wings in half at joint. Step 3: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Step 4: Put in ungreased, shallow baking pan in single layer. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 6: Mix together in a small jar the remaining ingredients. Step 7: Cover and shake well, pour over wings. Step 8: Cover pan with foil and bake 2 hours at 325 degrees. Step 9: Remove foil, reduce heat to 300 degrees and continue baking another 30 minutes, basting with drippings every 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dark soy sauce, cornstarch, egg white, peanut oil, flank steak, sugar, rice wine, pepper, oyster sauce, wide rice noodles, garlic, ginger, fermented black beans, onion, green pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the meat into thin slices. Step 2: Mix the 4 marinade ingredients together and stir in the meat. Step 3: Let marinate for 15 minutes. Step 4: Mix the sauce ingredients together and set aside. Step 5: Heat a wok or large frying pan and add 2 tbs Of peanut oil.
