Step 6: Toss the noodles about in the oil until they are very hot and begin to color just a bit on the edges. Step 7: Remove to a serving platter and set aside. Step 8: Heat the wok again and add 3 more tbs Of peanut oil, along with the garlic and ginger.

Ingredient Names: salt, medium shrimp, cornstarch, white pepper, chicken, fresh ginger, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, oil, garlic, hoisin sauce, chili paste, water chestnut, green onions with tops
Instructions: Step 1: Place 1 / 2 t salt and 1 cup warm water in a small bowl and soak the shrimp for 5 minuutes. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and dry. Step 3: In a medium bowl, toss the shrimp, 1 t cornstarch and white pepper, set aside. Step 4: Toss the chicken with the ginger, the remaining 1 / 2 t salt and remaining cornstarch and set aside. Step 5: Cut the green and red peppers into 3 / 4 inch pieces. Step 6: Heat wok over high heat. Step 7: Add oil, garlic, chicken and shrimp. Step 8: Stir fry for 1 minute or till shrimp turns pink. Step 9: Stir in hoisin sauce, chili paste, green and red peppers and water chestnuts, stir fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 10: Place on platter and garnish with green onions.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, cornstarch, sesame oil, dry sherry, chinese five spice powder, white pepper, garlic clove, soy sauce, fresh gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: In a non-metal bowl, combine the ingredients for the marinade, mix well, and marinate the pieces of chicken for at least half a day, turning frequently. Step 2: When ready to cook, presoak pot, top and bottom, in water for 15 minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken and the marinade to the pot. Step 4: Place covered pot in a cold oven. Step 5: Set temperature to 450 degrees f. Step 6: Cook 45 minutes Ten minutes before end of cooking time, remove the pot and pour off the liquid into a saucepan. Step 7: Return the pot to the oven, uncovered, for the final 10 minutes of cooking. Step 8: Meanwhile, bring the liquid in saucepan to a boil and thicken with cornstarch. Step 9: Serve with rice, liberally drenched with the sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken thigh fillets, soy sauce, dry sherry, dried chinese mushrooms, leeks, orange sweet potatoes, peanut oil, gingerroot, chicken stock, sesame oil, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken under cold water Pat dry with absorbent paper. Step 2: Cut into small pieces. Step 3: Place in a dish with the soy sauce and sherry, cover and marinate for 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Step 4: Soak mushrooms in hot water to cover for 30 minutes. Step 5: Drain, squeeze to remove excess liquid. Step 6: Remove stems and chop caps into shreds. Step 7: Wash leeks thoroughly to remove all grit. Step 8: Cut leeks and sweet potato / carrot into thin slices. Step 9: Drain the chicken, reserving the marinade.

Dish Name: Clay Pot Chicken Rice Without The Clay Pot
Ingredient Names: long grain rice, water, garlic, onions, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken, chinese sausage, white pepper, shallots, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice, then stir in the rest of the ingredients except for the garnishes. Step 2: Cook the mixture in a rice-cooker as you normally would for rice. Step 3: Garnish the cooked rice with the shallots and spring onion If you like, drizzle a little more dark soy sauce over and serve.

Ingredient Names: egg, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken thighs, peanut oil, ginger, birds eye chiles, yellow onion, garlic, carrots, green pepper, shiitake mushrooms, chicken stock, white wine, tomato paste, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Stir cornstarch into slightly beaten egg until well combined. Step 2: Add chicken pieces, stir to coat. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat until just below smoking Shallow-fry the coated chicken in several batches until golden brown, turning if necessary, then remove to drain on absorbent papers. Step 4: Leave about 2 tsp hot oil in the wok, stir fry ginger and chilli for 30sec, until fragrant. Step 5: Add onion slices, continue to saute another 1-2mins, until onions are soft. Step 6: Add garlic and stir fry for another minute. Step 7: Add the carrot matchsticks, continue to cook until they're semi-tender. Step 8: Stir in chicken pieces and saute for 1 minute. Step 9: Add in the sauce mixture, adding chicken stock / water when necessary, depending how much sauce you like.

Ingredient Names: pork, chinese five spice powder, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, peanut oil, prawns, chicken breasts, carrot, brown onion, celery ribs, red capsicum, button mushroom, chicken stock, cornflour, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place diced pork, five spice, hoisin sauce and soy into a bowl, mix and let marinate a few hours covered in fridge. Step 2: Heat one tablespoon of peanut oil in wok and stir-fry prawns a few minutes until just starting to change color. Step 3: Remove and cover to keep warm. Step 4: Add diced chicken and marinated pork to wok and str-fry until cooked. Step 5: Remove and keep covered along with prawns. Step 6: Heat other tablespoon of peanut oil in wok and stir-fry carrot and brown onion until soft. Step 7: Add celery, capsicum and mushroom and stir-fry until vegetables are cooked but still firm. Step 8: Combine chicken stock, cornflour, light soy sauce and oyster sauce in small bowl and mix well. Step 9: Return prawn / chicken / pork mixture to wok and add bok choy, bean sprouts, green onion and blended sauce mix. Step 10: Stir-fry until sauce boils and thickens.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, garlic clove, diced onion, bell pepper, meat, frozen peas, cooked rice, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat 1 to 2 minutes. Step 2: Add eggs and gently stir 1 minute or until softly scrambled. Step 3: Remove eggs from skillet, chop. Step 4: Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil in skillet. Step 5: Add onion, garlic and bell pepper and stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 6: Add chopped cooked meat and peas. Step 7: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 8: Add rice, soy sauce and chili-garlic sauce. Step 9: Stir-fry 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

Dish Name: Copy Cat Panda Express Sweet Fire Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cornstarch, flour, eggs, vegetable oil, jalapenos, garlic cloves, granulated sugar, water, white vinegar, salt, pineapple chunks
Instructions: Step 1: For the chicken, dip strips in flour I usually do this by putting the chicken strips in a big zip-top bag with the flour in it, and shake until all of the chicken pieces are evenly covered with flour Next, drop the chicken strips in the beaten egg Again, i do this all at once Just make sure the egg is in a big bowl, dump all of the chicken strips in, and evenly coat Lastly, dip in cornstarch This time the process is a little more precise, so i take about one-third of the strips and toss them in a zip-top bag with cornstarch Lay them on a wire rack to prep for frying, and repeat the process This method is pretty messy, and if you have another way of doing it, feel free to do it! Step 2: =) In a large skillet, heat oil to medium-high heat.

Dish Name: Copycat P F Chang's Singapore Street Noodles
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, oil, shrimp, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, cabbage, carrot, tomatoes, scallion, cilantro, dark sesame oil, shallot, lime, vinegar, madras curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Boil rice stick noodles for 2 minutes or until just soft. Step 2: Rinse under hot water and drain. Step 3: Toss noodles with 2 tbsp oil and keep warm To prepare sauce, mix vinegar with curry powder and turmeric until blended. Step 4: Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, sriracha, and ketchup, mixing well. Step 5: Set sauce aside until needed. Step 6: Stir-fry shrimp and chicken with remaining 2 tbsp of oil until until cooked through. Step 7: Add garlic, cabbage, tomatoes and carrots and cook for one minute more. Step 8: Stir in sauce mixture until everything is evenly coated. Step 9: Cook for 1-2 minutes more or until dish is heated through.

Ingredient Names: cornish hens, soy sauce, frozen orange juice concentrate, sesame oil, honey, curry powder, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Rinse hens under cold water until water runs clear and pat dry with paper towels. Step 3: Place hens in either a baking dish or small roasting pan just large enough to hold the hens. Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk soy sauce with undiluted orange juice concentrate, sesame oil, honey and curry powder until the honey dissolves Gently place your thumb between skin and breast, lifting the skin Tilt bird upward and pour about 2 tablespoons of the mixture under the skin. Step 5: Drizzle about 1 / 2 tablespoon in cavity. Step 6: Repeat on the second hen, third hen and fourth hen. Step 7: Pour remainder of the soy mixture over the hens and rub evenly over skins Tightly cover dish or pan with aluminum foil or lid.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooking oil, salt, pepper, pineapple tidbits, cornstarch, barbecue sauce, whole berry cranberry sauce, green pepper, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pineapple liquid and cornstarch. Step 2: Stir in sauces and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a large fry pan over high heat. Step 4: Add chicken, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Stir-fry until no longer pink. Step 6: Add peppers and pineapple tidbits. Step 7: Stir fry 2 minutes longer. Step 8: Stir the cornstarch mixture and add to chicken. Step 9: Cook and stir constantly, over med heat until thickened Server over rice or chow mien noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken tenders, sweet onion, carrot, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, chili pepper, ground ginger, salt, lemon juice, cream of coconut, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, over med-high heat, saut onion and garlic. Step 2: Cut chicken into medium size pieces and place in skillet and brown both sides. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium. Step 4: Add carrots and jalapeno peppers, continue cooking. Step 5: Add spices to coconut milk and mix well. Step 6: Pour mixture over chicken in skillet and cover Continue to cook over medium heat until chicken is done About 30 minutes. Step 7: Stir occasionally to keep from sticking.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, pineapple juice, salt, pepper, chicken breasts, flour, butter, chicken stock, cream, peanut butter, roasted peanuts, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, and pineapple juice Dredge chicken in flour, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Marinate chicken in soy sauce mixture for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight. Step 3: Stir fry chicken in wok and remove from pan. Step 4: Combine butter and flour and cook in wok until bubbly. Step 5: Add stock and cook until the mixture thickens. Step 6: Add cream and peanut butter. Step 7: Stir until peanut butter melts. Step 8: Top chicken with peanut sauce and garnish with peanuts and onions.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cornflour, eggs, oil, chinese five spice powder, fine breadcrumbs, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, cracked black pepper, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken breasts in half lengthways. Step 2: Dust lightly with cornflour and set aside. Step 3: Combine all coating ingredients in a shallow bowl or plate. Step 4: Dip chicken into beaten egg and then press firmly into the coating mixture. Step 5: Heat 1 cm of oil in frying pan over med-high heat. Step 6: Fry the chicken 2-3 minutes each side, until golden and crisp Do not crowd the pan. Step 7: Fry in batches if necessary. Step 8: Drain on absorbent paper.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, carrot, cabbage, mushrooms, cooked chicken, white pepper, caster sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sesame oil, cornflour, spring roll wrappers, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the peanut oil in a wok. Step 2: When hot, stir fry the carrot for 1 minute. Step 3: Add the cabbage, mushroom, and chicken and fry for another minute, stirring all of the time. Step 4: Season with a little pepper. Step 5: Add the sugar, both soy sauces and the sesame oil. Step 6: Combine 2 tsp of the cornflour with about 3 tbsp of water and stir into the filling while still on the heat Any juices will soon thicken. Step 7: Remove from heat and leave to cool. Step 8: Combine remaining cornflour with enough water to make a thin paste Lay out a spring roll wrapper and put 1 tbsp of filling across one end.

Dish Name: Crispy Garlic Chicken With Dipping Salt
Ingredient Names: kosher salt, five-spice powder, chicken bouillon cube, chicken, distilled white vinegar, water, light brown sugar, baking powder, szechwan pepper, vegetable oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Set a fine sieve over a small bowl. Step 2: Add 2 tablespoons of kosher salt, the five-spice powder and bouillon cube and rub them through the sieve. Step 3: Set the chicken on a platter Rub the spice blend all over the chicken inside and out and refrigerate it for 4 hours. Step 4: In a medium saucepan, combine the vinegar with the water, brown sugar and baking powder and cook over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved. Step 5: Transfer the syrup to a large bowl and let cool to room temperature Stand the chicken in the syrup and ladle the syrup over it several times. Step 6: Transfer the chicken to a rack set over a plate and refrigerate overnight. Step 7: Bring to room temperature before cooking Pat the chicken dry inside and out with paper towels.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh mushrooms, green onions, soy sauce, fresh gingerroot, chicken broth, salt, pepper, bamboo shoots, cashews, chinese pea pod, cornstarch, water, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken and mushrooms in a slow cooker. Step 2: Add green onions, soy sauce, ginger, broth, salt and pepper. Step 3: Cover and cook on low about 4 hours. Step 4: Add bamboo shoots, cashews and pea pods. Step 5: Turn control to high. Step 6: In a small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in water. Step 7: Stir into chicken mixture in cooker. Step 8: Cover and cook on high 20-30 minutes or until thickened, stirring at least once. Step 9: Serve over cooked rice if desired.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chinese Chicken With Pineapple
Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, salt and pepper, oil, onion, red pepper, chicken stock, brown sugar, soy sauce, ground ginger, pineapple chunks, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat crock pot on high. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat oil in skillet and brown chicken on all sides, transfer to crock pot. Step 4: Mix all remaining ingredients, except the cornstarch, into the skillet and heat through, stirring well, transfer to crock pot. Step 5: Turn crock pot to low and cook for 8 hours until chicken is tender, depending on your crock pot Half an hour before serving, blend the cornstarch with a little water and stir into the crock pot to thicken sauce, serve on rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, hoisin sauce, plum sauce, soy sauce, fresh gingerroot, lime, cornstarch, salt and pepper, fresh garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Add the chicken to the mixture Coat well. Step 3: Put all ingredients in the slow cooker. Step 4: Cook for 5-6 hours, or until chicken is tender, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken, salt, pepper, ground ginger, garlic clove, chicken broth, pineapple, water chestnuts, green onions, cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Step 2: Place in slow cooker. Step 3: Combine ginger, garlic, broth and syrup from pineapple, set aside. Step 4: Cut pineapple slices into fourths. Step 5: Arrange pineapple and water chestnuts over chicken. Step 6: Pour ginger sauce over all. Step 7: Cover and cook on high 1 hour. Step 8: Reduce heat to low and cook an additional 2 to 3 hours or until chicken is tender, add green onions.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, salt, black peppercorns, orange marmalade, water, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Place cubed chicken in crock pot. Step 2: Add sliced onion, salt, & peppercorns then top with water & orange marmalade. Step 3: Stir to combine ingredients. Step 4: Cook on low 6-8 hours. Step 5: Serve over rice topped with chopped cashews.

Ingredient Names: broiler-fryer chickens, vegetable oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, water, garlic, ground ginger, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium heat, brown the chicken in oil on both sides. Step 2: Transfer chicken to a slow cooker. Step 3: Combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, water, garlic, and ginger, pour over chicken. Step 4: Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Step 5: Reduce heat to low. Step 6: Cook 4 to 5 hours longer or until the meat juices run clear. Step 7: Remove chicken to a serving platter. Step 8: Sprinkle with almonds. Step 9: Spoon juices over chicken or thicken if desired.

Dish Name: Cubed Chicken In Lettuce Leaves Yang Chow Chicken Soong
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, egg white, cornstarch, salt, green chilies, water chestnuts, celery, carrots, fresh ginger, green onions, garlic, wine, soy sauce, chili paste with garlic, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, egg white, 1 tablespoon cornstarch and salt in medium bowl and stir to blend well. Step 2: Cover with plastic and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Step 3: Combine chilies, water chestnuts, celery, carrot and ginger in another bowl. Step 4: Combine green onion and garlic in separate bowl. Step 5: Mix wine, soy sauce, chili paste and sugar in another bowl. Step 6: Blend remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch and water in small bowl, mixing until smooth. Step 7: Pour peanut oil into wok. Step 8: Place over high heat. Step 9: When oil begins to smoke, add chicken in batches and cook, stirring constantly to separate cubes, about 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 10: Remove chicken with slotted spoon, drain well on paper towels and set aside.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, canola oil, fresh ginger, garlic, green onion, shrimp, soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place a wok or heavy pan over high heat. Step 2: When wok is hot, add 1 tablespoon of the oil. Step 3: When oil is hot, add cucumbers and 1 tablespoon of the ginger and a couple of splashes of soy sauce Stirfry until cucumbers are tender-crisp to the bite. Step 4: Pour onto a platter and keep warm. Step 5: Pour remaining 2 tablespoons oil into wok. Step 6: When oil is hot, add garlic, remaining 1 tablespoon ginger, onions, and shrimp / chicken / pork Stirfry until all are cooked through. Step 7: Add a couple of slashes of soy sauce during the last minute of cooking. Step 8: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: brown sugar, pineapple chunks, bell pepper, maraschino cherries, lemon juice concentrate, red wine vinegar, ketchup, chicken broth, soy sauce, garlic powder, ginger, cornstarch, worcestershire sauce, chicken breast, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Blend cornstarch and small amount of the juice from the pineapples. Step 2: Combine all other ingredients into a stock pot. Step 3: Bring sauce to a slow boil, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add cornstarch mix to the sauce and mix until blended. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 45 minutes to one hour, stirring often While sauce is simmering, cut chicken breast into desired size chunks Saut chicken in butter until tender, then drain. Step 6: Once pineapples, peppers and cherries are tender, add sauted chicken to the sauce. Step 7: Simmer for five minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, iceberg lettuce, green onions, celery ribs, water chestnuts, bean sprouts, cilantro, salad dressing, bean thread noodles, sesame seeds, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: In a salad bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, onion, celery, water chestnuts, bean sprouts and cilantro. Step 2: Drizzle dressing over mixture and toss lightly. Step 3: Add bean thread noodles and toss very lightly. Step 4: Top with sesame seeds and cashews To test temperature, drop in a single noodle If it puffs up, oil is ready. Step 5: Cook in small batches As they puff, push them down and turn them to be sure they are all cooked. Step 6: When they stop crackling, remove with a strainer and drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, green onion, rice wine, soy sauce, gingerroot, garlic, rice wine vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, hot chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: In large plastic bag, combine the marinade ingredients. Step 2: Add the chicken wings to the bag, give it a bit of a shake, then allow the wings to marinate at least one hour in refrigerator. Step 3: Drain the wings, and place in one layer on a well-greased baking pan. Step 4: Bake on the middle shelf of a 400 f oven for about 40 minutes, or until cooked. Step 5: Mix the sauce ingredients together until thoroughly blended. Step 6: Arrange wings on a warm serving platter. Step 7: Pour sauce over wings to completely cover. Step 8: Garnish with finely chopped green onion.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, oyster sauce, light soya sauce, garlic, ginger, white pepper, tabasco sauce, bourbon, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken wings into two pieces One part wing, and the other drumlet. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl. Step 3: Add the chicken wings and drumlets into bowl and mix well. Step 4: Wrap bowl with glad wrap and pop it into the fridge overnight The next day, place chicken on the grill and brush with remaining juices in the bowl. Step 5: Grill the chicken at 400 fahrenheit for 20 minutes turning over once The more often juices from the bowl is brushed on, the tastier the wings will be.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, soy sauce, garlic clove, oyster sauce, cornstarch, noodles, olive oil, green onions with tops, green cabbage, sesame oil, carrots, mung bean sprouts, water, celery
Instructions: Step 1: Coat chicken with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and garlic. Step 2: Let stand for 20 minutes. Step 3: Combine remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, oyster sauce, potato starch and 1 / 3 cup water - set aside. Step 4: Cook noodles as package directs, set aside. Step 5: Heat wok or large frying pan over medium high heat. Step 6: Add olive oil to coat wok. Step 7: Add chicken and stir fry for 2 minutes, or until lightly browned. Step 8: Add green onions, carrots, cabbage, etc. Step 9: Stir fry for 1 minute.

Dish Name: Easy And Yummy Chicken Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: broccoli, baby corn, chicken breast fillets, fresh ginger, spring onion, carrots, oil, chicken stock, dark brown sugar, cornflour, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a wok of water to the boil Blanch the broccoli and corn in the water for 2 minutes, drain well. Step 2: Cut the chicken into strips, peel and slice the ginger into thin matchsticks Trim and diagonally slice the spring onions Peel and cut the carrots into matchsticks Wipe the wok with paper towel and heat oil until almost smoking. Step 3: Add the chicken and stir-fry until golden and cooked through. Step 4: Transfer to a plate and keep warm. Step 5: Stir-fry the ginger, spring onions and carrots for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, sliced almonds, broccoli carrots and water chestnut mix, cornstarch, brown sugar, ground ginger, soy sauce, pineapple juice, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok on medium-high. Step 2: Add chicken and almonds. Step 3: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 4: Add frozen vegetables, cover and cook 4 minutes, stirring once. Step 5: Combine cornstarch and next 4 ingredients, add to wok. Step 6: Cook, stirring constantly, 2 to 3 minutes or until mixture thickens, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, ginger, oyster sauce, soy sauce, black pepper, shiitake mushrooms, scallions, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rice cooker: dump all ingredients into rice cooker, turn it on and stir occasionally, until congee is smooth and no longer grainy Stovetop: combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan, bring to boil over medium heat then turn down heat and let simmer until water has been absorbed. Step 2: Add more water / broth if necessary. Step 3: Sprinkle with black / white pepper, a few drops of sesame oil and chopped scallions just before serving.

Dish Name: Easy Sesame Chicken With Apricot Sauce
Ingredient Names: plain breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, eggs, water, soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken breasts, apricot preserves, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first six ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Beat the eggs with the water and soy sauce in another bowl. Step 3: Dip the chicken into the egg mixture, then coat with the bread crumb mixture. Step 4: Bake, uncovered at 375 degrees for 40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Step 5: Combine the sauce ingredients in a saucepan and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Serve with the chicken.

Ingredient Names: eggs, shrimp, chicken, green peas, mushrooms, carrots, tomatoes, spring onions, white onions, flavor enhancer, vegetable oil, sugar, sesame oil, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together all the ingredients except the oils and the spring onion. Step 2: Heat a non-stick frying pan and pour in the vegetable oil. Step 3: Once the oil is hot, pour in the egg mixture and cook on moderate heat. Step 4: When the surface begins to cook, drizzle sesame oil around the omlette. Step 5: Flip and repeat for the other side. Step 6: Cut into four pieces and garnish with chopped spring onion, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: skinless, low-salt chicken stock, wholewheat noodle, baby corn, eggs, lemon juice, sherry vinegar, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken and stock in a large pan and bring to a simmer for 5 mins. Meanwhile, cook the noodles following pack instructions. Step 2: Add the corn to the stock and cook for 2 mins. Stir the broth vigorously, then while it’s still swirling, hold a fork over the pan. Pour the eggs over the prongs in a slow stream. Stir again in the same direction then turn off the heat. Add a squeeze of lemon juice and the vinegar. Step 3: Drain the noodles and divide between four bowls. Ladle over the egg drop broth, scatter with onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, broccoli florets, napa cabbage, baby spinach leaves, green onion, garlic, ginger, thai chiles, fresh cilantro, cooking oil, soy sauce, rice wine, cornstarch, sugar, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok over medium high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, and chiles and cook until very fragrant. Step 3: Add chicken and stir-fry until chicken is cooked through, remove from wok. Step 4: Add a small amount of oil to wok and swirl. Step 5: Add broccoli and cabbage to wok and stir-fry, adding about 1 oz of water as needed to help cooking come along but not too much you want it too sizzle off. Step 6: Cook until broccoli and cabbage are crisp-tender. Step 7: Add spinach, onions, and chicken to wok and cook until spinach is wilted, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Pour sauce mixture into wok and stir to coat everything, and stir until everything is thickened. Step 9: Add cilantro and mix well. Step 10: Serve with hot steamed rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, sugar, cornstarch, soy sauce, white vinegar, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, boneless skinless chicken breasts, dark soy sauce, egg, green onions, hot peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 7 ingredients in a jar and shake vigorously. Step 2: Store in fridge until ready. Step 3: Mix chicken with 1 / 4 cup dark soy sauce, stir in egg. Step 4: Add cornstarch and mix chicken until coated Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Step 5: Drain on paper towels. Step 6: Place a small amount of oil in wok and heat to very hot. Step 7: Add onions and peppers and stir fry 30 seconds. Step 8: Stir in sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, dark soy sauce, dry sherry, fresh ginger, garlic, vegetable oil, cornstarch, chicken stock, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken wings into three pieces at the joint sections, discard. Step 2: In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, sherry, ginger, garlic, and wings. Step 3: Marinate wings for several hours refrigerated. Step 4: Take wings out of the marinade and set marinade aside for use later in recipe. Step 5: Heat the vegetable oil in a large deep skillet Dredge wings in cornstarch, shaking off excess. Step 6: Add wings to the pan, but do not crowd. Step 7: Cook until golden, and remove from pan. Step 8: Drain oil from skillet and add marinade and chicken stock to the skillet, cooking until hot.

Dish Name: Erica's Broccoli And Chicken Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, soy sauce, garlic-flavored olive oil, orange juice concentrate, chicken broth, cornstarch, onion, broccoli, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: Combine broth, soy sauce, and concentrate in a small bowl In another small bowl, mix cornstarch with a little water. Step 2: Rinse chicken and cut into 1 1 / 4 inch cubes. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons oil on high in a large pan or wok. Step 4: When oil is hot, add chicken and season with garlic salt. Step 5: When cooked, set aside. Step 6: Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons more oil to the pan and throw in minced onion. Step 7: Meanwhile, steam broccoli and green beans separately in microwave, but make sure not to burn onions. Step 8: When onions are lightly browned, add chicken However, if vegetables are not steamed by the time onions are this color, remove pan / wok from heat with chicken and onions in it.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, sesame oil, soy sauce, flour, cornstarch, water, brown sugar, oil, chicken broth, white vinegar, sugar, garlic powder, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, the smaller, the faster this cooks. Step 2: Mix the marinade ingredients in a zip-top bag and toss in the refrigerator while you assemble everything else Deep fry the chicken pieces in hot oil and drain on a paper towel. Step 3: Keep the meat warm. Step 4: Pour all the ingredients in the skillet and cook until the thickness you desire I aim for the consistency of giblet gravy. Step 5: Return the meat to the skillet and turn the heat to low. Step 6: Leave on the stove until meat is hot. Step 7: Serve garnished with the toasted sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: honey, soy sauce, chicken broth, sesame oil, ground ginger, garlic, brown sugar, red chili pepper flakes, cornstarch, chicken breasts, sherry wine, chinese five spice powder, vegetable oil, sesame seeds, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken ingredients except cornstarch and let marinate for at least 30 minutes in the fridge. Step 2: Remove chicken from marinade and toss in cornstarch then cook chicken in hot oil on the stove top until cooked thru. Step 3: Remove from pan and keep warm in oven while making the sauce. Step 4: Combine all sauce ingredients except cornstarch in a sauce pan and bring to a boil over med, heat. Step 5: Mix cornstarch with a little water in a cup until disolved then slowly add to the sauce mixture on the stove and heat until thickened to you liking. Step 6: Add chicken to sauce on the stove until heated thru. Step 7: Remove and sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions and finally enjoy!

Ingredient Names: seasoned rice vinegar, soy sauce, ground ginger, cooked chicken, cabbage, carrot, green onions, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, soy sauce and ground ginger. Step 2: Add chicken and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes In salad bowl, combine remaining ingredients Just before serving, remove chicken from marinade, reserve. Step 3: Pour marinade into cabbage mixture, toss, top with chicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken, baby shrimp, beef, pork, green onion, bean sprouts, water chestnut, chinese vegetables, bok choy, carrots, peanut butter, soy sauce, salt and pepper, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Make sure all meat is cooked, and everything mentioned as'chopped' above is chopped I use the food processor. Step 2: Mix everything but the egg roll wrappers in a very large bowl Use your hands to be sure to get a good mix. Step 3: Place an eggroll wrapper in front of you, with a point up, as in a diamond. Step 4: Put about a third of a cup of filling horozontally across the middle, bring down the top point, tuck under the filling, and roll, folding in the two side points as you go Seal the bottom point with some water before you roll completely up If in doubt, check the back of the eggroll wrapper package for pictures Spray the biggest cookie sheet you have with pam, put eggrolls on it, make sure they aren't touching Spray the tops of the eggrolls with pam.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs drumsticks, green onions, groundnut oil, garlic, finger-length ginger, shaohsing rice wine, light soy sauce, clear honey, five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the marinade ingredients, put the chicken into a dish, then pour over the marinade, mixing to coat. Cover, then chill for at least 20 mins, or up to a day if you have time. Step 2: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4, and lift the chicken out of the marinade into a roasting tin. Roast for 40 mins, pour over the remaining marinade, then cook for a further 30 mins until golden and sticky. Sprinkle with the spring onion, then serve.

Ingredient Names: honey, soy sauce, oranges, sriracha sauce, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, ginger powder, salt, vegetable oil, chicken tenderloins, cornstarch, bao bun, fresh parsley leaves, sesame seeds, scallions, kewpie mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Add the honey, soy sauce, orange juice and zest, sriracha, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, ginger powder, and salt to a bowl. Whisk well and set aside. Step 2: Heat about 3 inches of oil in a Dutch oven to 375°F. Step 3: Add cornstarch to a shallow bowl. Dredge chicken in the flour, shake off excess, and fry for 4-5 minutes. Drain on a rack on top of a baking sheet. Step 4: Pour the sauce mixture into a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Let the mixture come to a simmer and let cook for 1 – 2 minutes, until thickened. Step 5: Add the chicken to the sauce and toss to coat. Step 6: To build the sandwiches, place parsley leaves in the buns, then top with 3 – 4 chicken pieces, sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions. Top with a squeeze of Kewpie.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, cornstarch, water, chili pepper flakes, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, honey, green onion, sugar, white vinegar, vegetable oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine cornstarch and water into a smooth batter. Step 2: Add chicken slices and stir to coat thoroughly In another bowl, combine pepper flakes, garlic, ginger, honey, green onion, sugar and vinegar. Step 3: In a wok, heat vegetable oil until very hot, add chicken. Step 4: Stir and cook for a few minutes until the chicken turns golden brown. Step 5: Remove the chicken, set it aside and allow it to drain Into a heat-proof container, carefully pour off all the oil from the wok, except one teaspoon. Step 6: Return the wok to high heat and add the sauce mixture. Step 7: Stir frequently and cook until the sauce begins to caramelize.

Dish Name: Five Jewel Rice Stuffed Chicken Breast With Hot Sour Sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, arborio rice, slivered almonds, water chestnuts, scallions, garlic, kosher salt, ground black pepper, white wine vinegar, hoisin sauce, toasted sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil, sesame seeds, plum jam
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f Coat a baking sheet or broiler pan with nonstick spray. Step 2: Bring broth to boil in a small saucepan over med-high heat, add rice, cover pan. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, simmer rice 20 minutes. Step 4: Remove rice from heat. Step 5: Stir in almonds, water chestnuts, scallions, garlic, salt & pepper. Step 6: Combine 2 t vinegar, 2 t hoisin sauce and 1 t sesame oil in small bowl. Step 7: Cut a pocket in each chicken breast with a pairing knife, being careful not to completely split the breast.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, five-spice powder, ginger, garlic, flour, eggs, almonds, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken. Step 2: Combine soy sauce, wine, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and 1 tsp of the 5 spice powder, and marinate chicken for at least 1 hour. Step 3: Combine the remaining 5 spice powder with the flour and dredge the marinated chicken. Step 4: Dip the dredged chicken in the eggs, then roll in the nuts. Step 5: Heat the oil and cook chicken 3-4 minutes on each side.

Ingredient Names: chicken drumsticks, five-spice powder, sesame oil, light soy sauce, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Just mix all the marinade ingredients and pour over the chicken. Step 2: Leave to marinade in the fridge for 4 hours, turning after 2. Step 3: Cook on a medium heat until chicken is cooked Do not cook on too high a heat as the sugar in the tomato sauce might burn.

Dish Name: Foil Wrapped Chicken Baked Or Fried
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, oyster sauce, gingerroot, sesame oil, dry sherry, sugar, five-spice powder, dried chinese mushrooms, green onions, cilantro, parchment paper, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into coarse mince and playfully spank it with a mallet to tenderize Say, youve been a naughty little chicken! Step 2: Mix the marinade ingredients together, add chicken, and refrigerate for one hour At the 45 minute mark, add the mushrooms and scallions. Step 3: Cut paper or foil pieces into 6-inch squares Paper-wrapped chicken is normally wrapped envelope style. Step 4: Take a square of paper and lay it out in front of you. Step 5: Add 2 of the chicken slices, 1 slice of mushroom, 2 slices of green onion and a coriander sprig in the middle, being sure to keep the filling in the center and not near the edges. Step 6: Bring the bottom flap up over the chicken. Step 7: Fold the right side over toward the middle, then the left side, so that one is overlapping the other.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dark brown sugar, dark soy sauce, gingerroot, chicken thigh pieces, green onions, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine soy sauce, brown sugar, dark soy sauce, and ginger. Step 2: Add chicken, toss to coat, cover, and chill for at least 1 hour and up to overnight. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375 Lay out 8 pieces of aluminum foil, 6 to 8 inches long each. Step 4: Put 1 / 8 of the marinated chicken in the middle of each. Step 5: Top chicken with green onions and sprinkle with pepper. Step 6: Fold 1 side of foil over the chicken to cover it, fold opposite side of foil over first fold, and then fold in each end once to seal and create a little packet Lay packets on a foil- or parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet. Step 7: Bake until chicken is cooked through and marinade is reduced and starting to caramelize in each packet, 45 to 60 minutes. Step 8: Serve hot or warm.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, bok choys, fresh bean sprouts, fresh egg noodles, mls chicken stock, water, soy sauce, sugar, chinese cooking wine, ginger, garlic, star anise, scallion shallot, fried asian shallots
Instructions: Step 1: Combine Soup Stock ingredients in a medium saucepan large enough to hold the 2 chicken breasts side by side (without being crammed in). Bring to boil, taste and adjust if necessary. Step 2: Add chicken to soup, bring back to boil. Remove from heat and put aside covered for 20 - 25 mins. Don't worry if you leave it for longer, it won't over cook. Step 3: When the chicken is poached, remove from the soup and slice into 1/4" / 0.5cm slices. Step 4: Cook noodles according to the packet instructions - usually for fresh noodles soaking them in boiling water is sufficient. Step 5: Cut the bok choy leaves from the stems, cut the stems vertically into 1/3" / 1cm wide sticks. Step 6: Bring the soup (without the poached chicken in it) back to boil, add the bok choy stems, boil for 30 seconds then remove from heat, add the bok choy leaves and bean sprouts. Step 7: To assemble place noodles in bowl, top with bok choy, chicken and spoon over soup. Step 8: Garnish with scallions/shallots and fried shallots.

Dish Name: Forevermama's Authentic Pot Stickers Northern Chinese
Ingredient Names: gyoza skins, ground pork, napa cabbage, ginger, rice wine, soy sauce, salt, white pepper, scallion, sesame oil, sugar, chicken stock, peanut oil, water, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the pork, cabbage, rice wine, soy sauce, salt, pepper, scallions, sesame oil, sugar and stock. Step 2: Mix well and set aside. Step 3: Once you remove wrappers from its packaging, keep them covered with a damp dish towel. Step 4: Place 4 wrappers at a time on a work surface. Step 5: Place about 1 teaspoons of filling in the center of each wrapper and fold in half Moisten the edges with water and pinch together with your fingers, making sure there are no open gaps Pleat around edges, pinching to seal well. Step 6: Transfer the dumplings to a floured sheet pan and keep covered with a damp towel until you have finished stuffing all the dumplings. Step 7: Heat a large skillet over high heat until it is hot. Step 8: Add the peanut oil and place the dumplings, flat side down in the pan.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, chinese five spice powder, sugar, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, dry sherry, fresh gingerroot, cornstarch, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the drumsticks for 4- 5 hours, refrigerated Improvise a steamer. Step 2: Steam the drumsticks for one hour, covered with aluminum foil that has several small holes pierced in it Air dry the drumsticks for a couple hours. Step 3: When ready to deep fry, dredge the steamed drumsticks with cornstarch. Step 4: Heat oil to 350- 375 and cook the drumsticks a few at a time until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, ginger, garlic, sweet chili sauce, cornflour, water chestnuts, wonton wrappers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the minced chicken, ginger, garlic, water chestnut, corn flour and sweet chilli sauce in a bowl and stir till it is combined Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and brush a little water around the edge of the wrapper. Step 2: Place 2 teaspoons of the chicken mixture in the middle of the wrapper. Step 3: Bring the corners together and pinch the edges together to seal. Step 4: Repeat with the remaining mixture and wonton wrappers. Step 5: Heat a pan of hot oil, and deep fry them till they are golden brown.

Ingredient Names: white rice, boneless chicken, eggs, green onion, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice and leave sit to the side. Step 2: Cut green onions into about 1 / 4 inch stalks to make up a half cup Scramble eggs and leave to side. Step 3: Cut chicken up into chunks as large or small as you like and brown them in wok I prefer to use a light marinade, but cooking in oil will be fine too, leave to side. Step 4: Heat up wok and lightly coat entire wok with sesame oil You can substitute vegetable oil also, but sesame oil gives it a really good flavor Throw in green onions and lightly brown them making sure not to burn them. Step 5: Once cooked, throw in rice followed by chicken and then eggs.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, green chilies, chicken breasts, cooked jasmine rice, white sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, green onions, basil leaves, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet, over medium-high heat. Step 2: Fry the garlic until golden, then add the chili pepper and chicken meat, and stir-fry until cooked through. Step 3: When the chicken is cooked, add the rice, sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce. Step 4: Cook over medium heat, stirring gently. Step 5: When the mixture is well blended, stir in the green onions, basil, and cilantro. Step 6: Cook for 1 more minute, then serve hot.

Dish Name: Fried Rice With Ham And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, eggs, salt, salad oil, onion, garlic, green bell pepper, mushroom, cooked ham, dry roasted salted peanut, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Rub cooked rice with wet hands so all grains are separated, set aside. Step 2: In a small bowl, lightly beat together eggs and salt. Step 3: Place a wok over medium heat. Step 4: When wok is hot, add 1 tablespoon of the oil, when oil is hot, add eggs and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft curds form. Step 5: Remove from wok and set aside Increase heat to medium-high and add 1 tablespoon more oil to wok. Step 6: When oil is hot, add onion and garlic, stir-fry until onion is soft, then add bell pepper, mushrooms, ham and peanuts. Step 7: Stir-fry until heated through, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Remove from wok and set aside.

Ingredient Names: chili oil, chicken thigh fillets, dried red chili, green onions, sugar, ginger, garlic cloves, stock, vinegar, chinese wine, light soy sauce, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Coat wok or pan in chilli oil. Step 2: Add chicken pieces and stir until just cooked and set aside Into wok or pan add chilli, green onion, ginger, garlic, vinegar, stock or water and stir. Step 3: Add sugar, cooking wine and light soy sauce and stir It's really important here to make sure that everything reduces and caramelises The restaurants green onions and dried chilli's are quite well cooked. Step 4: Return chicken to the pan and mix ingredients together. Step 5: When juice becomes slightly sticky add the nuts. Step 6: Place in serving dish.

Dish Name: Garlic Chicken Breast With String Beans
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, cornstarch, sugar, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, black bean sauce, green beans, red bell pepper, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts into 1 / 4 in strips. Step 2: Place in medium bowl. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, wine, sesame oil, cornstarch and sugar in small bowl. Step 4: Pour over chicken breast, toss to coat. Step 5: Cover: refrigerate 20 minutes or until ready to cook. Step 6: Heat vegetable oil in wok over high heat until quite hot, add chicken. Step 7: Cook, stirring constantly, 3 minutes or until chicken begins to brown and is cooked through. Step 8: Remove with slotted spoon to serving dish.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, olive oil, coke, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Fry wings in the oil in a skillet until browned. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients and pour over wings in pan. Step 3: Cover pan and cook slowly for 45 minutes. Step 4: Remove cover for the last 15 minutes to thicken sauce Watch carefully, turning often.

Ingredient Names: sherry wine, soy sauce, garlic cloves, honey, fresh basil, ground ginger, chinese five spice powder, crushed red pepper flakes, pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first nine ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Remove 3 tablespoons for basting. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate. Step 4: Place the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag. Step 5: Add the remaining marinade Seal the bag and turn it around to coat it thoroughly. Step 6: Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Step 7: Drain and discard the marinade Broil the chicken strips 3"-4" from the heat for 3 minutes. Step 8: Then turn the strips over.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, cornstarch, reduced-fat chicken broth, reduced sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, dry sherry, hoisin sauce, minced ginger, garlic, red pepper flakes, sesame oil, red bell pepper, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breats between two sheets of plastic wrap, use flt side of meat mallet to pound them into 1 / 3 inch thickness cut the breasts into strips. Step 2: Transfer to medium bowl and toss with cornstrach to coat. Step 3: Let stand for 5 minutes. Step 4: Whisk the remaining ingriendeints. Step 5: Heat wok or skillet and add 1 teaspoon saesme oil. Step 6: Add pepper and onions and stir fry remove and set aside. Step 7: Add 1 teaspoon seasme oil and chicken cook till no longer pink inside, then add veggies and sauce and heat throu.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, chicken breast, eggs, cornstarch, oil, rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl combine the cornstarch and beaten eggs. Step 2: Mix well to create a batter. Step 3: Add the shrimp and chicken and coat well. Step 4: In a small bowl combine rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, the white parts of the scallion, and cornstarch. Step 5: Mix well and set aside. Step 6: Add oil to wok and heat to 375 degrees. Step 7: Add shrimp and chicken to the wok in batches and cook until shrimp are white and chicken is not pink. Step 8: Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 9: Add crushed red peppers to the oil remaining in the wok and stir fry for about 30 seconds. Step 10: Return the shrimp and chicken to the wok and stir fry for a minute or two.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice vinegar, water, cornstarch, dry sherry, sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger, eggs, boneless chicken breasts, oil, dried hot red chilies, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, water or chicken and cornstarch mixture, dry sherry, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, set aside. Step 2: Combine egg and cornstarch mixture well. Step 3: Add chicken and toss to coat. Step 4: Heat oil until hot. Step 5: Fry chicken in batches until crisp and brown. Step 6: Drain on paper towels. Step 7: Pour off all but 2 teaspoons oil from pan. Step 8: Add chilies and toss for a few seconds. Step 9: Return chicken to pan with soy sauce mixture and cook until glazed.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, dark soy sauce, rice wine, gingerroot, cornstarch, sesame oil, peanut oil, dried red chilies, orange rind, roasted sichuan peppercorn, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into thin slices, 2 inches long, cutting against the grain. Step 2: Put it into a bowl together with the soy sauce, rice wine, ginger, cornstarch and 1 tsp sesame oil. Step 3: Mix well, let mixture marinate for about 20 minutes. Step 4: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet until i t is very hot. Step 5: Remove the chicken from the marinade with a slotted spoon. Step 6: Add it to the pan and stir-fry it for 2 minutes until it browns. Step 7: Remove it and leave to drain in a colander or sieve. Step 8: Pour off most of the oil, leaving about 2 tsp Reheat the pan over a high heat and add the dried chilies. Step 9: Stir-fry them for 10 seconds, then return the chicken to the pan.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, water, garlic, ginger, sugar, soy sauce, white vinegar, hot chicken broth, msg, dark chicken meat, white pepper, egg, salad oil, scallions, dried hot chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: To make pepper sauce, mix cornstarch and water together. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, and wine. Step 3: Then add chicken broth and msg and stir until sugar dissolves. Step 4: Refrigerate until needed In separate bowl, mix chicken, soy sauce, and pepper, stir in egg. Step 5: Add cornstarch until chicken is coated evenly. Step 6: Add oil to separate chicken pieces. Step 7: Divide chicken into small quantities and deep fry at 350f until crispy. Step 8: Drain on a paper towel.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, white vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, red pepper flakes, egg whites, all-purpose flour, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade and sauce: whisk hoisin, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarchand water in bowl. Step 2: Combine 6 tablespoons hoisin mixture and chicken in zipper-lock bag. Step 3: Refrigerate 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Step 5: Cook garlic, ginger, and pepper flakes until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 6: Add 2 cups hoisin mixture and simmer, whisking constantly, until dark brown and thickened, about 2 minute. Step 7: Cover and keep sauce warm For coating and frying: whisk egg whites in shallow dish until foamy. Step 8: Combine cornstarch, flour, baking soda, and remaining hoisin mixture in second shallow dish until mixture resembles course meal. Step 9: Remove chicken from marinade and pat dry with aper towels.

Dish Name: General Tso's Chicken Tso Chung Gai
Ingredient Names: egg, salt, black pepper, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken thighs, dark soy sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, hoisin sauce, sugar, rice wine vinegar, dry sherry, peanut oil, dried hot chili peppers, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together egg, salt, black pepper, and cornstarch in a bowl. Step 2: Add the chicken cubes. Step 3: Mix to coat, and marinate for at least 15 minutes. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce, sugar, rice wine vinegar, and sherry for the sauce Reserve. Step 5: Heat wok over high heat for a minute or so. Step 6: Add about 3 1 / 2-4 cups of peanut oil to wok, and heat to 350 degrees f With tongs, remove chicken cubes individually from bowl, dust with 1 tbsp Cornstarch, shaking off excess, and place in the hot oil Deep-fry chicken pieces for 1 1 / 2-2 minutes, until browned and crisp.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, hot water, chicken bouillon cubes, cornstarch, sesame oil, garlic powder, ground ginger, sugar, soy sauce, cooking sherry, rice vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl or tupperware, dissolve chicken bouillon in hot water. Step 2: Allow broth to cool to at least room temperature, then mix in cornstarch until well blended. Step 3: Stir in sesame oil, garlic powder, ginger, sugar, soy sauce, sherry, vinegar and red pepper flakes. Step 4: Set aside in fridge. Step 5: Heat oil or spray oil in wok or large skillet, brown chicken on each side. Step 6: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 7: Add more oil, if necessary, stir fry green onions until softened. Step 8: Remove sauce mixture from fridge, give it a stir if any ingredients have settled to the bottom. Step 9: Pour into pan with green onions, stirring frequently to prevent burning. Step 10: Cook to desired thickness.

Ingredient Names: canned chicken broth, cornstarch, sugar, low sodium soy sauce, white wine vinegar, ground ginger, sesame oil, green onions, broccoli, red pepper flakes, chicken breast, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, whisk together broth, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar and ginger, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add scallions, garlic and red pepper flakes. Step 4: Cook, stirring frequently, 2 minutes. Step 5: Add chicken Saut until browned all over, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add reserved sauce to pan and simmer until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Serve chicken and sauce over rice Yields about 1 cup chicken with sauce and 1 / 2 cup rice per serving.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, olive oil, cornstarch, salt, pepper, broccoli floret, cold water, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, honey, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, white rice, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice as per instructions on the package and blanch the broccoli by boiling it for 1 - 2 minutes then shocking it in ice water, drain and set aside. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine 1 tablespoon of constarch and water until smooth. Step 3: Add the garlic, ginger, honey, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes, then set aside. Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix 3 tablespoons of constarch, salt and pepper together. Step 5: Add the chicken and toss until coated. Step 6: Heat a large nonstick skillet with olive oil. Step 7: Cook the chicken in batches until golden, 4 - 6 minutes or until almost done. Step 8: Return the broccoli florets to the pan with the chicken. Step 9: Add the sauce mixture and cook until the sauce has thickened, mixture is hot and chicken is fully cooked. Step 10: Serve over the rice, and garnish with the scallions greens.

Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium chicken broth, cornstarch, splenda sugar substitute, low sodium soy sauce, white wine vinegar, ground ginger, peanut oil, scallions, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl whisk together the broth, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, and ginger, set aside. Step 2: Heat your oil in a large skillet, and add your garlic, scallions, and pepper flakes until the garlic becomes fragrant, about 45 seconds. Step 3: Add your chicken and cook until browned on all sides about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the sauce mixture you made earlier and allow to simmer until it thickens and the chicken cooks through, 3-5 minutes. Step 5: Serve chicken over your rice About 1 cup of chicken and sauce and 1 / 2 cup of rice per serving Makes 4 servings.

Ingredient Names: eggs, vegetable oil, skinless boneless chicken breast fillets, ginger, garlic, green onions, sak, straight-to-wok noodle, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the eggs with 2 tbsp water. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan. Swirl the eggs into the pan and cook for 2 mins until set, flip over and continue to cook for 1 min. Tip the omelette onto a board and, when cool enough to handle, slice into strips and set aside. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil in a large wok and stir-fry the chicken for 5 mins until browned, then add the ginger and garlic, and cook for a few minutes. Scatter over most of the spring onions, reserving some to sprinkle on the top, followed by the sake or sherry and noodles. Give everything a good mix. Drizzle over the soy, stir through the shredded omelette, sprinkle over the reserved spring onions and serve.

Dish Name: Ginger Chicken And Shrimp Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: soya sauce, chicken stock, rice vinegar, rice wine, cornstarch, sesame oil, honey, peanut oil, shrimp, boneless skinless chicken thighs, garlic cloves, ginger, celery, onions, baby carrots
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Heat the wok over high heat. Step 3: Add 2 tbs oil and swirl to coat. Step 4: Add shrimp and stir fry 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove and set aside. Step 6: Add 1 tbs oil, swirl. Step 7: Add chicken, stir fry 3 minutes. Step 8: Add garlic and ginger. Step 9: Stir fry 1 / 2 minute more.

Ingredient Names: oil, boneless chicken, celery, carrot, sugar snap peas, onion, garlic, chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, dried ginger
Instructions: Step 1: In wok or large skillet, heat 2 t oil. Step 2: Stir fry chicken until done and browned. Step 3: Remove chicken, keep warm In same pan add remaining oil, saute celery and carrots until crisp tender. Step 4: Add snow peas and saute 3 minutes. Step 5: Add onion and garlic. Step 6: Mix broth and cornstarch. Step 7: Add soy sauce and ginger, stir until smooth, add to vegetables. Step 8: Cook and stir until mixture thickens.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, boneless chicken breasts, cornstarch, low-fat milk, creamy peanut butter, limes, reduced sodium soy sauce, honey, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, fresh cilantro, crushed red pepper flakes, chives
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken in skillet, approximately 2-3 minutes per side. Step 2: Take chicken out of skillet and set aside In small bowl, dissolve corn starch in 2 t Milk. Step 3: Stir in remaining milk and add to skillet. Step 4: Cook for 1 minute, or until thick and bubbly. Step 5: Reduce heat to low In another small bowl, mix peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper. Step 6: Stir into milk mixture until smooth. Step 7: Add chicken, chives, and cilantro.

Dish Name: Ginger Scented Honey Hoisin Chicken Thighs With Sesame
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, cooking oil, soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, chicken broth, fresh ginger, pepper, toasted sesame seeds, cooked brown rice, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet over medium high heat, place cooking oil. Step 2: Add chicken and saut until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 3: In a small saucepan, mix together soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, chicken broth, ginger and pepper. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil and simmer to reduce sauce, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Pour sauce over chicken, turning to coat. Step 6: Place chicken in 325 f oven. Step 7: Bake about 10 minutes or until internal temperature of chicken registers 165f stir in sesame seeds. Step 8: Place hot rice on serving platter, add chicken and sauce and garnish with scallions.

Ingredient Names: bean thread noodles, water, mushrooms, fresh ginger, dried shiitake mushrooms, green onions, chicken stock, oyster sauce, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Soak the noodles in boiling water. Step 3: When they are soft and transparent, drain well and discard any bits which stay white. Step 4: Meanwhile, prepare the vegetables. Step 5: Layer them in a small deep casserole dish with the noodles. Step 6: Drizzle with the oyster sauce, and pour over the chicken stock, enough to just cover. Step 7: Bake at 350f for 20 minutes. Step 8: Serve garnished with the cilantro, if you like.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, roasting chickens, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Set a rack at the highest oven position and heat the oven to 400f. Step 2: In a small, shallow bowl, whisk the hoisin sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger Dredge each chicken piece in the glaze, coating completely. Step 3: Put the pieces, skin side down, in a rimmed, shallow 10x15-inch sheet pan. Step 4: Pour any leftover glaze over the chicken. Step 5: Sprinkle liberally with pepper Roast on the top rack until the juices run barely clear when you prick the chicken, about 40 minutes. Step 6: Remove the pan from the oven and set the broiler on high. Step 7: Turn the chicken over and baste it with the pan drippings If a lot of fat has rendered out, spoon some off before broiling to prevent flare-ups.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, chili paste, garlic clove, soy sauce, honey, dark sesame oil, ginger paste, orange marmalade, scallions, chicken legs with thigh
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients up to marmalade in a large bowl and mix well. Step 2: Wash and pat dry the chicken legs and thighs. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 4: Place the chicken in a large shallow roasting pan or baking dish pour the hoisin marmalade sauce over the top. Step 5: Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until the chicken is done Baste with juices one or two times during the baking process. Step 6: When finished, remove chicken from roasting pan onto serving platter. Step 7: Spoon some sauce over it and garnish with the scallion. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Glazed Teriyaki Chicken Stir Fry Sub
Ingredient Names: honey dijon mustard, teriyaki sauce, sugar, gingerroot, cider vinegar, oil, boneless chicken breast, red peppers, chopped tomato, red onion, hoagie rolls, napa cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Combine mustard, teriyaki sauce, sugar, ginger and vinegar in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in large skillet or wok over high heat. Step 3: Stir fry chicken about 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Step 4: Add vegetables and stir fry about 2 minutes longer or until just barely tender. Step 5: Pour sauce over stir fry and cook one minute. Step 6: Arrange lettuce on rolls and top with stir fry mixture, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: chicken, gingerroot, spring onion, water, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, wine, hoisin sauce, honey, sesame oil, star anise, bay leaf, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken well and pat dry with paper towels. Step 2: Place ginger and spring onion in the cavity of the chicken. Step 3: Bring the sauce ingredients to the boil in a saucepan large enough to hold the chicken. Step 4: Make sure honey and sugar dissolve completely. Step 5: Place the chicken in the saucepan with the sauce. Step 6: Bring back to the boil, basting the sauce over the chicken, then reduce heat to a low simmer. Step 7: Simmer the chicken for 15 minutes The sauce should be just bubbling. Step 8: Turn the chicken over to cook for another 15 minutes, then return the chicken to its back again for a final 25-30 minutes of low simmering The chicken is cooked when the flesh on the drumstick has shrunk back from the bone.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, chicken drumsticks, scallions, peanut oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, rice wine, light soy sauce, honey, five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the marinade ingredients, put the chicken into a dish then pour over the marinade and mix to coat. Step 2: Cover then chill for at least 20 minutes or up to a day if you have time. Step 3: Heat the oven to 350f and lift the chicken out of the marinade into a roasting tin Roast for 40 minutes, pour over the remaining marinade then cook for a further 30 minutes until golden and sticky. Step 4: Sprinkle with the scallion and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, sake, soy sauce, brown sugar, mirin, fish sauce, fresh ginger, star anise, hot chili pepper, cinnamon stick, green onion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place a 14-inch nonstick saute pan over high heat. Step 2: Add the chicken and dry-sear to lightly brown the chicken. Step 3: Add the sake, soy sauce, 1 / 3 cup water, brown sugar, mirin, hoisin sauce, ginger, star anise, dried chile and cinnamon stick and bring to a simmer. Step 4: Cook, covered, about 12 minutes. Step 5: Uncover and simmer until the pan is almost dry, tossing frequently to coat the wings, 10 to 12 minutes Skim off the fat if you like, and serve, garnishing with scallion shavings and sesame seeds Andrew likes to emulsify the chicken fat into the sauce by turning up the heat at the last minute to boil the fat into the other liquids.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, sesame oil, cornstarch, szechwan chili sauce, rice vinegar, rice wine, sugar substitute, soy sauce, chicken stock, panko breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Grill the chicken breasts until they are fully cooked. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, prepare the sauce mixture by combining the 1 tablespoon of cornstarch with the wine, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, chili sauce, and broth. Step 3: Heat the sesame oil in the wok or frying pan and add the sauce-mixture to the wok, tossing over the heat until the sauce caramelizes into a glaze. Step 4: Cut chicken into bite size pieces, add it to the sauce and toss to coat If you like the crunch often found in traditional general tso's. Step 5: Sprinkle the panko over top right before serving. Step 6: Serve immediately Serves 6, along with steamed broccoli and rice We have doubled the sauce and added the cooked broccoli and that works great too!

Dish Name: Grilled Hoisin Chicken With Mai Fun
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, rice vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, dark sesame oil, ginger, hoisin sauce, ketchup, honey, toasted sesame seeds, rice noodles, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: The night before preparing food, mix together marinade ingredients in a small bowl. Step 2: Place chicken in a ziplock bag and add marinade and seal, removing as much air as possible. Step 3: Refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally The next day, well before preparing food, heat oil to a depth of 2-inches at 375-400f in a large skillet or use a deep fryer. Step 4: Add small amounts of mai fun to hot oil and allow them to cook briefly. Step 5: Remove them and drain as soon as they do this and set aside to use later. Step 6: Whisk together ingredients for sauce in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 7: Lower heat and simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat and allow to cool. Step 8: Bring chicken out of refrigeration and allow to warm to room temp- 30-45 min, then drain from marinade, reserving marinade. Step 9: Bring marinade to a boil in a saucepan, lower heat, and simmer for 2-3 minutes, then allow to cool.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, celery leaves, peppercorns, salt, spring onions, peanut oil, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, onion, short-grain rice, soy sauce, red chilies, chinese cabbage, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken under cold water. Step 2: Place in a large pan with the celery leaves, peppercorns, salt and spring onion, cover with water. Step 3: Cover the pan, bring to the boil, simmer for 15 minutes. Step 4: Turn off heat and leave, covered, for 45 minutes. Step 5: Heat the oils in a pan with a well fitting lid. Step 6: Add ginger, garlic and onion and cook until soft and golden. Step 7: Set aside 1 tablespoon of the oil to use for a dipping sauce. Step 8: Add rice to pan and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes, add 3 cups of stock from the pan in which the chicken was cooked, bring to the boil. Step 9: Simmer until holes appear in the rice.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, chicken fat, water, ginger, garlic cloves, salt, chicken stock, screwpine leaves, chicken, red chilies, lime juice, garlic oil, sesame oil, light soya sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: First of all wash the rice then place it on to a tea towel or colander to dry. Step 2: Then, prepare the chicken. Step 3: Bring enough water to boil in a large pot. Step 4: Once boil, add in the salt, ginger, garlic and chicken. Step 5: Lower the heat and cook chicken for about 20 - 25 minutes, uncovered It is very important to boil the chicken very slowly over low flame. Step 6: Turn of flame and cover the pot. Step 7: Allow the chicken to steep inside for another 20-25 minutes. Step 8: Remove chicken and immerse it into a basin of cold water for 5-6 minutes. Step 9: Take chicken out and drain in a colander to drip dry before cutting it into serving pieces.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, ham, pepper, five-spice powder, garlic clove, spring roll wrappers, flour, egg, milk, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place one chicken breast between plastic wrap or freezer bags and bash it until it is nice and thin -- repeat with the other breast. Step 2: Mix the pepper, five spice and crushed garlic. Step 3: Sprinkle the mixture over both breasts. Step 4: Roll up one slice of ham and place it on the chicken breast. Step 5: Roll the chicken up firmly and fold the ends under. Step 6: Whisk the egg and milk together Coat the chicken with flour shake off the excess. Step 7: Dip in the egg mixture -- shake of the excess This step will stop the chicken from separating from the spring roll wrapper. Step 8: Place the chicken "roll" diagonally across the spring roll wrapper.

Dish Name: Healthy Family Friendly Chicken Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt and pepper, garlic, broccoli, baby carrots, onion, snow peas, sesame oil, teriyaki sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat about a tsp or two of sesame oil over high heat in a large skillet. Step 2: Add garlic and saut until golden. Step 3: Add chicken, sprinkled with salt and pepper, and stir fry until no longer pink remove chicken and garlic from pan. Step 4: Add another tsp or two of sesame oil and return to high heat. Step 5: Add all vegetables and stir fry for 5 or 10 minutes, or until tender-- if using frozen snow peas, add them the last couple of minutes. Step 6: Add back chicken and garlic and add teriyaki sauce. Step 7: Stir fry another minute or two. Step 8: Serve over hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, light soy sauce, mirin, all-purpose flour, sesame seeds, black pepper, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Cut the chicken breasts in half. Step 3: Place chicken in a shallow dish and pour soy sauce and mirin over the chicken. Step 4: Turn the chicken over to thoroughly coat. Step 5: Combine the seeds, flour, pepper and chili flakes in a bowl, mix well. Step 6: Place the chicken in the dry mixture and turn over to coat completely Spray a baking dish with non-stick spray. Step 7: Place coated chicken in the dish. Step 8: Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until done, uncovered.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, scallion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil in a bowl large enough to hold the chicken. Step 2: Transfer 1 / 4 cup of the mixture to a small bowl, and reserve for glazing. Step 3: Add the chicken to the bowl, turning to coat. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour 2. Step 5: Heat a gril or grill pan to medium-high. Step 6: Grill the chicken 3 minutes per side, or until just cooked through. Step 7: Brush with some of the reserved glaze, turn and cook 30 seconds left Move to a platter.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, honey, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, salt, black pepper, garlic clove, fresh ginger, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix mix the hoisin sauce, honey, soy / chinese teriyaki sauce, salt, black pepper, ginger, garlic and scallion together. Step 2: Marinate the chicken wings in this mixture for 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat oven to 350f put the chicken wings onto skewers, two per skewer, and put on a baking tray or cookie sheet. Step 4: Bake for 30-35 minutes, basting occasionally with the marinade Change oven setting to "broil" and broil for 5-8 minutes, changing sides and basting occasionally to prevent the chicken from burning. Step 5: Take out from the oven. Step 6: Remove from the skewers and serve Suggestion: i put in a tiny bit of extra-hot pepper paste when i make this for my boyfriend because he likes doesn't like anything too sweet In case you don't have that, just increase the black pepper or use cayenne pepper instead.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, garlic clove, fresh ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: Combine hoi sin sauce, garlic, ginger, soy sauce and seasme oil in a bowl. Step 2: Add chicken wing pieces, mix, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 3: Place on a rack in a baking dish, lines with foil. Step 4: Bake at 180oc for 30-45 minutes until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: dry sherry, cornstarch, light soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, chicken stock, sunflower oil, garlic, green onions, chicken, water chestnuts, fresh coriander, gem lettuces
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the sherry and cornflour to a smooth liquid. Add the soy and hoisin sauces, sugar and stock. Set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan, toss in the garlic and whites of the spring onions and stir fry for 2-3 minutes. Tip in the chicken and stir fry over a high heat until it colours, using the back of a spoon to break up any big lumps. Tip in the water chestnuts and stir fry for a further 1-2 minutes. Step 3: Push the chicken mixture to one side of the wok. Pour the sherry mixture into the empty part and stir for 1-2 minutes until it bubbles and thickens. Combine thoroughly, then leave to simmer for 5-10 minutes. Season and stir in the green spring onions and coriander. Step 4: Lay the lettuce leaves on serving plates, spoon in the warm mixture without overfilling, and scatter with the shredded spring onion. Suggest your guests roll the lettuce up around the filling to make a shape that’s easy to eat as finger food. Step 5: Prepare ahead; you can cook the filling the day before, leave to cool and store in a plastic container in the fridge overnight. Reheat it well for 5-10 minutes until hot, stirring all the time and adding a splash of hot water if it’s too dry.

Ingredient Names: hokkien noodles, chicken thighs, canola oil, garlic, green onion stems, red capsicum, green cabbage, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, white pepper, white sesame seeds, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with 1 1/2 tbsp Sauce. Cook chicken 1 min, add garlic and white part of green onion, cook 1 min. Add capsicum & cabbage, cook 2 min. Add green part of green onion, noodles, sauce, toss 2 min. Serve! Step 2: Sauce - Mix the sauce in a small bowl. Step 3: Briefly marinate chicken - Toss the chicken with 1 1/2 tbsp of the Sauce. Marinate for 10 minutes while you prepare the noodles and vegetables. Step 4: Rinse noodles - Prepare the noodles per the packet directions (soak in boiling water or briefly boil). Drain in a colander then rinse briefly under tap water. Step 5: Sear chicken - Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over high heat until very hot. Add the chicken and toss for 1 minute. Add the garlic and white part of the green onion, then toss for another 1 minute or until the surface of the chicken is sealed (but still a bit raw inside). Step 6: Cook veg & noodles - Add the capsicum and cabbage. Toss for 2 minutes until the cabbage is mostly wilted. Add the green part of the green onions, noodles and sauce. Toss for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until the noodles are stained a lovely mahogany colour. Step 7: Serve immediately, sprinkled with sesame seeds and green onion if desired!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, flour, baking powder, salt, eggs, milk, oil, fat
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour and add baking powder, and salt In separate bowl, beat eggs and add milk and oil. Step 2: Blend liquid mixture into dry, beat well until smooth. Step 3: Drop diced chicken into batter. Step 4: Spoon out and place in deep fryer or pot of hot grease over stove burner. Step 5: Fry until golden brown. Step 6: Remove and place in bowl lined with paper towel to soak up excess grease.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil, brown gravy mix, water, honey, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, ground ginger, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, carrots, onion, bell pepper, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken into thin strips. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 3: Stir-fry chicken until lightly browned, drain excess oil. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine gravy mix, water, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Step 5: Stir until smooth consistency Slowly pour sauce mixture over chicken in the skillet and heat and stir until thickened. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 7: Cover skillet / wok and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add carrot strips and simmer for 10 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: broiler chicken, flour, salt, vegetable oil, water, lemon juice, cornstarch, chinese chili sauce, soy sauce, gingerroot, honey, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Remove giblets from chicken and discard. Step 2: Rinse chicken and cut into small serving-size pieces. Step 3: Combine flour and salt Coat chicken pieces with flour mixture. Step 4: Heat oil in wok to 375f. Step 5: Add chicken pieces, one at a time, to hot oil. Step 6: Cook until golden, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Drain on paper towels. Step 8: Repeat with remaining chicken. Step 9: Pour all but 1 tablespoon of the oil out of wok.

Ingredient Names: chicken fillets, flour, salt, oil, ginger, honey, cornflour, water, sweet chili sauce, lemon juice, soy sauce, shallots
Instructions: Step 1: Dice chicken and coat lightly with flour which has been seasoned with salt. Step 2: Fry chicken in batches in hot oil until golden brown or until chicken is cooked through. Step 3: Remove from oil, drain on paper towels. Step 4: Repeat with remaining chicken. Step 5: Pour off excess oil leaving one tablespoon of oil in pan. Step 6: Add ginger to pan, saute gently one minute. Step 7: Add honey, stir for one minute. Step 8: Add combined cornflour, water, chilli sauce, lemon juice and soy sauce.
