Step 9: Stir until sauce boils and thickens. Step 10: Add chicken pieces, toss in sauce for three minutes or until chicken is heated through.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken drumsticks, milk, cornstarch, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, green onions, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in greased 9" x 13" dish. Step 2: Combine milk, cornstarch, soy, honey, vinegar and garlic. Step 3: Pour over chicken, tossing to coat. Step 4: Bake at 425 for 25 min, stirring twice Addd green onions and sesame seeds. Step 5: Bake 10 minutes until chicken is done and sauce thickened If desired, spice this up with asian hot chili sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, milk, cornstarch, soy sauce, liquid honey, rice vinegar, fresh garlic cloves, green onions, toasted sesame seeds, hot chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 425 degrees Butter a 13x9-in baking pan. Step 2: Place the chicken legs in baking dish. Step 3: In a bowl, gradually whisk milk into cornstarch. Step 4: Whisk in soy sauce, honey, vinegar and garlic, pour over chicken, toss to coat. Step 5: Bake for 25 minutes, stirring twice, until chicken is cooked, and until sauce is bubbling, and starting to thicken. Step 6: Stir the green onions into dish, and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. Step 7: Bake 10 minutes longer, or until the chicken is cooked.

Ingredient Names: chicken, lemon, ground ginger, peanut oil, honey, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rub chicken pieces with the lemon. Step 2: Sprinkle chicken with 1 / 2 the ginger and salt. Step 3: Combine the oil, honey and remaining ginger. Step 4: Brush chicken honey mixture Roast in oven 350f for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours, basting occasionally with honey mixture, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: chicken parts, honey, fresh lime juice, low sodium soy sauce, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375f arrange chicken, skin side-up, in cingle layer in shallow casserole dish or 11x7-inch baking dish. Step 2: Combine remaining ingredients except noodles in small bowl, mix well. Step 3: Brush 1 / 3 of honey mixture over chicken, bake 15 minutes. Step 4: Brush remaining honey mixture over chicken. Step 5: Bake 10 - 15 minutes more, or until juices run clear. Step 6: Transfer to serving platter. Step 7: Serve with noodles.

Dish Name: Honey Nut Pork Or Chicken Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: pork steak, orange juice, honey, soy sauce, cornstarch, ground ginger, vegetable oil, carrots, celery ribs, cashews, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into thin strips, set aside. Step 2: Combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, cornstarch and ginger in small bowl, mix well. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add carrots and celery. Step 5: Stir-fry about 3 minutes, remove vegetables, set aside. Step 6: Add remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil into skillet.

Dish Name: Honey Seared Chicken Pf Chang's Copycat
Ingredient Names: flour, cornstarch, egg, water, baking soda, baking powder, boneless chicken breast, light soy sauce, white pepper, kosher salt, sake, honey, rice vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ingredients for the batter together thoroughly and let sit in the refrigerator for a couple of hours Coat chicken with seasonings and marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes Coat chicken with batter and fry in oil. Step 2: Mix ingredients for the sauce together. Step 3: When ready to eat, mix 1 / 4 cup water with 1 / 4 cup cornstarch. Step 4: Bring the ingredients for the sauce to a boil and add the cornstarch mixture slowly, boil 1-2 minutes It should be like loose honey Coat the cooked chicken with the sauce.

Dish Name: Honey Soy Chicken Wings W Bok Choy
Ingredient Names: chicken wings, bok choy, peanut oil, white rice, marinade, water, honey, light soy sauce, garlic cloves, ginger, chinese five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a bowl and pour over chicken wings Marinade the wings for about 30 min - 1 hour. Step 2: Bake them in the oven uncovered for about 30 minutes total at 400 f degrees, turning them every 15 minute to make sure both sides are cooked thoroughly Use a bit of the remaining sauce to pan fry the bok choy until well cooked. Step 3: Serve together on a plate.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, garlic, pineapple chunks, red bell peppers, water, honey, instant chicken bouillon granules, sesame oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in half or thirds for manageable serving size pieces Coat chicken with cornstarch. Step 2: Heat vegetable oil in fry pan over high heat. Step 3: Add chicken pieces and cook until golden brown. Step 4: Drain on paper toweling and set aside. Step 5: Pour all but 2 tbls of oil out of the pan. Step 6: Stir-fry the ginger and garlic in the oil over medium heat about 1 minute. Step 7: Add pineapple and pepper strips to ginger mixture. Step 8: Stir-fry over high heat 2 minutes, remove from pan.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, eggs, oil, soy sauce, honey, dry sherry, garlic clove, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven 250f. Step 2: Cut chicken into 2 inch squares. Step 3: Combine flour, salt and pepper. Step 4: Dip chicken in eggs then coat with seasoned flour. Step 5: Pour oil into large frying pan. Step 6: Bring up to frying temperature. Step 7: When oil is hot enough, add chicken half portion at one time, Cook turning as needed until chicken is golden brown. Step 8: Cook a total of 6-8 minutes. Step 9: Meanwhile heat soy, honey, sherry, garlic and ginger in a small pan.

Dish Name: Hot And Sour Soup Easy Version
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, tomato juice, soya sauce, bamboo shoots, mushroom, straw mushroom, red pepper, hot red pepper sauce, red pepper flakes, green onion, cooked chicken, rice wine vinegar, cornstarch, water, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Combine broth, tomato juice, soya sauce, bamboo shoots, mushrooms, red pepper, hot pepper sauce and pepper flakes. Step 2: Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Step 3: Add vinegar, green onion and chicken. Step 4: Simmer for 1 minute longer. Step 5: Combine cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup water. Step 6: Mix well and stir into soup. Step 7: Simmer until mixture is slightly thickened Slowly add beaten egg in a continuous stream while soup is boiling Continue stirring until egg is cooked and looks like threads throughout the soup, serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, snow peas, fresh mushrooms, green onions, bamboo shoot, baby corn, fresh bean sprout, bok choy, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh gingerroot, garlic, peanut oil, sesame oil, steamed rice, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together ingredients for marinade and add to chicken. Step 2: Marinate chicken at least 30 min, up to an hour. Step 3: Mix together ingredients for cooking sauce in a small bowl and set aside. Step 4: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp peanut oil, garlic, and red pepper in wok until you just start to smell them. Step 5: Add chicken and cook, stir-frying 3-4 minutes or until cooked through. Step 6: Remove from wok and set aside. Step 7: Add the other 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp peanut oil to wok and add snow peas, mushrooms, and bok choy. Step 8: Stir-fry 2-3 minutes or until bok-choy becomes crisp-tender. Step 9: Add green onions, bamboo shoots, baby corn, and bean sprouts to the other veggies and stir-fry another minute or so. Step 10: Add the chicken back to the wok and stir all together.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, vegetable oil, red chili peppers, celery, sliced water chestnuts, fresh broccoli florets, carrot, garlic cloves, gingerroot, green onion, rice wine, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken lengthwise into 1 / 4-inch strips, set chicken aside. Step 2: Pour oil around the top of a preheated wok or skillet with sloped sides. Step 3: Heat at medium-high for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add chile pepper pods, and stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Remove chile pepper pods from the wok, set aside. Step 6: Add the reserved chicken, and stir-fry for 7 minutes or until lightly browned. Step 7: Remove chicken from the wok. Step 8: Drain well, and set aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, water, mushroom, bamboo shoot, gingerroot, garlic, soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, chicken, sesame oil, scallions, cilantro, vinegar, cornstarch, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the stock, water, mushrooms, bamboo, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and red pepper to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Step 2: Toss the chicken with sesame oil. Step 3: Blend the vinegar with corn starch, beat the egg. Step 4: Return broth to a boil and add chicken While stirring briskly, slowly add the beaten egg. Step 5: Add the vinegar and cornstarch mixture, and boil until the chicken is cooked. Step 6: Stir in the scallions and sprinkle with cilantro immediately before serving.

Dish Name: Hot Spicy Chicken Shrimp Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: carrot, cabbage, peas, cooked chicken, cooked rice, oil, egg, green onion, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: On a heated wok, add 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 2: Cook egg and set aside. Step 3: Add remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, stir-fry chicken, cabbage, carrots and peas for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add rice, soy sauce and chili garlic sauce. Step 5: Cook until heated through. Step 6: Toss in cooked egg. Step 7: Serve with chopped green onions.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, low sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, dried chilies, sherry wine, soy sauce, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, water, peanut oil, green onion, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into small pieces and marinate in the soy sauce, sherry, and cornstarch. Step 2: Combine sauce ingredients. Step 3: Place peanut oil in hot wok, add the red pepper. Step 4: Cook for 15 seconds. Step 5: Add the chicken, marinade and all, and cook over high heat, stirring constantly for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the sauce mixture, and cook until it thickens. Step 7: Serve, topped with green onions and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, honey, chicken soup base, soy sauce, lemon juice, garlic powder, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Spread wings in a single layer on a jellyroll pan or in a roaster. Step 3: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile whisk together the rest of the ingredients. Step 5: Drain juices from pan. Step 6: Pour sauce over wings and bake 25 to 30 minutes more I serve these with a green salad, rice and corn.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cornstarch, salt, water, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic, chili oil, roasted sesame seeds, oil, chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, white vinegar, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To roast sesame seeds. Step 2: Put in a pan on medium heat and brown lightly, stirring constantly. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix all sauce ingredients until well combined. Step 4: Cut chicken in 1 / 2 inch strips. Step 5: Place in a bowl with water and salt and let soak for about 15 minutes Do not drain. Step 6: Add cornstarch and mix well, coating chicken. Step 7: Add 1 tbsp Vegetable oil to chicken and mix until smooth Separate chicken pieces.

Ingredient Names: onion, green bell pepper, broccoli, cauliflower, carrot, garlic cloves, yellow squash, zucchini, portabella mushroom, chicken breast, curry powder, salt, pepper, olive oil, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the meat of choice into stir fry style strips. Step 2: Then slice all the vegetables into medium to large chunks or slivers. Step 3: Press and finely chop the garlic and place in a bowl with the vegetables The mushrooms can be sliced and also go with the vegetables, even though vegetable they are not I keep the meat separate from the veggies since it will be used first. Step 4: Place your wok on the stove and turn the heat on medium high Coat the entire inside surface of the wok with olive oil, and add enough to cover the bottom about a 1 / 4 of an inch. Step 5: Toss in 1 to 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of butter. Step 6: When the butter has melted, and the oil is starting to get good and hot, its time to brown the meat Continue to stir and fry the meat until it is mostly browned.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, chicken stock, egg whites, cornstarch, salt, spinach leaves, oil, sherry wine, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Chop chicken very fine, or put in a blender or food processor. Step 2: Soak chopped chicken in 1 / 2c of chicken stock. Step 3: Beat egg whites stiff then gently fold in cornstarch, chicken, and 1 tsp of salt, set aside. Step 4: Cook spinach in a small amount of boiling water, drain well then squeeze out water and chop very fine. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 6: Stir-fry spinach for 30 seconds. Step 7: Pour remaining 4c chicken stock and sherry over spinach and bring to a boil. Step 8: Add chicken mixture and bring to a boil, stirring rapidly. Step 9: Season with 1 teaspoons salt.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cold water, scallions, fresh cilantro, onions, ginger, salt, sugar, shaoxing wine, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place first seven ingredients in a large pot. Step 2: Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Lower heat to simmer, leave lid partially open, and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Turn heat off, cover pot again and allow chicken to rest in liquid for 15 more minutes. Step 5: Combine the wine sauce ingredients with 1 / 4 cup poaching liquid from the previous step Reserve. Step 6: Remove chicken from pot and allow to cool. Step 7: Remove skin and bones and slice into 1 x 2-inch pieces. Step 8: Place in a serving dish. Step 9: Stir wine sauce and pour over chicken.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, flour, fat-free low-sodium chicken broth, rice vinegar, chinese five spice powder, garlic cloves, low sodium soy sauce, water, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Remove as much fat as possible from chicken thighs. Step 2: Place flour on a plate and roll chicken in flour, shaking off excess. Step 3: Mix chicken broth, vinegar, five-spice powder, garlic, soy sauce and water together in a small bowl. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or skillet over high heat until smoking Brown chicken on all sides, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add sauce and lower heat to medium. Step 6: Simmer 25 minutes, turning chicken a few times Liquid should be just at the bubbling stage The sauce will boil down to a glaze, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry sherry, sesame oil, garlic clove, five-spice powder, hot sauce, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: Make marinade Place all in gallon ziploc bag Marinate from 24-48 hours in refrigerator, turning every 8 hours Grill until done.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, rice wine, soy sauce, chicken breast, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, dried hot red chili peppers, white sugar, water, vinegar, sesame oil, peanuts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk 1 / 4 cup cornstarch, 3 tablespoons rice wine, and 2 tablespoons soy sauce together in a bowl. Step 2: Add chicken to the marinade and stir to coat completely. Step 3: Set aside to marinate for 15 minutes 2. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet. Step 5: Cook and stir chicken in the hot oil until completely browned. Step 6: Remove from oil with a slotted spoon to a bowl, retaining oil and drippings in the skillet 3. Step 7: Pour remaining 1 tablespoon oil into the skillet and let it get hot before adding garlic, ginger, and red chile peppers.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, soy sauce, dry sherry, salt, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, red wine vinegar, chicken broth, sugar, vegetable oil, salted peanuts, dried hot chili peppers, fresh ginger, green onions, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: For marinade, combine 2 tsp Cornstarch, 2 tsp Soy sauce, 2 tsp Sherry and salt in large bowl, mix well, add chicken, stir to coat well. Step 2: Let stand 30 minutes. Step 3: Combine remaining 1 1 / 2 tsp Cornstarch, 3 tsp.

Dish Name: Kung Pao Chicken Shrimp Or Beef Panda Express Style
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, egg, water, cornstarch, salt, green onions, red pepper, green pepper, zucchini, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, vegetable oil, garlic, ground ginger, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine meat in a zip-type bag with egg, water, cornstarch and salt. Step 2: Marinate chilled, for at least 30 minutes Prep and chill veggies. Step 3: Combine water and soy sauce, stir in dissolved cornstarch and rice wine, chill to reserve About 20 minutes before serving time heat about 1-tbsp of oil in hot wok. Step 4: Stir meat, drain and discard marinade Quickly stir-fry the meat in oil, for 60-90 seconds. Step 5: Transfer to a large container. Step 6: Stir meat, drain and discard marinade. Step 7: Stir-fry the red and yellow peppers until almost tender.

Ingredient Names: water, soy sauce, cornstarch, dry sherry, sugar, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, peanut oil, dried red pepper flakes, green onions, garlic, fresh ginger, broccoli florets, salted peanuts, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Blend water, soy sauce, cornstarch, sherry and sugar in bowl, set aside. Step 2: Toss chicken with 1 tblsp cornstarch to coat. Step 3: Heat 2 tblsps oil in wok over high heat. Step 4: Add chilies and cook until blackened, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring frequently, 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Remove chicken using slotted spoon, set aside. Step 7: Add remaining 2 tblsps oil to wok. Step 8: Add green onions, garlic and ginger and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 9: Add broccoli and stir-fry 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, white wine vinegar, dry sherry, chicken broth, sugar, cornstarch, salt, white pepper, red pepper flakes, boneless skinless chicken breasts, peanut oil, dried hot chili peppers, cashews, fresh ginger, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Cooking sauce:in a small bowl, combine 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon dry sherry, 3 tablespoons chicken broth, red pepper flakes and 2 teaspoons each sugar and cornstarch. Step 2: Set aside In another bowl, combine 1 tablespoon sherry, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon white pepper. Step 3: Add chicken and coat well. Step 4: Stir in 1 tablespoon peanut oil, and let stand 15 minutes to marinate. Step 5: Heat wok over medium heat. Step 6: Add 1 tablespoon peanut oil. Step 7: Add chile peppers and nuts. Step 8: Stir until peppers begin to char. Step 9: Remove and set aside.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg white, cornstarch, chili paste with garlic, soy sauce, dry sherry, red wine vinegar, chicken broth, oriental sesame oil, vegetable oil, unsalted peanuts, green onions, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine chicken with egg white and 3 teaspoons of the cornstarch, toss to coat In another bowl, blend chili paste, soy sauce, sherry, vinegar, broth, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, and sesame oil, set sauce aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add chicken and stir fry until it separates and turns white, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Step 5: Fry the peanuts in the oil over medium heat until they are golden brown, about 3 minutes, remove and drain. Step 6: Remove all but 2 tablespoons oil from the pan, stir fry onions, garlic and hot pepper for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add chicken, and stir fry over high heat 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, light soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, gin, egg whites, water chestnut flour, peanut oil, sugar, rice vinegar, chicken broth, cornstarch, water, msg, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken breasts in a shallow dish. Step 2: Combine the soy sauce, sesame oil, salt and gin or vodka, and pour over the chicken. Step 3: Toss to coat and let sit for 30 minutes. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 200. Step 5: Beat the egg whites, drain the chicken, and toss to coat. Step 6: Pour the water-chestnut flour on a plate and dredge chicken completely in the flour. Step 7: Arrange the shredded lettuce attractively on a platter To cook the chicken, pour the peanut oil into a skillet to a depth of 1 / 2 inch and heat to 350 degrees. Step 8: Add the chicken in batches, browning one side, then turning to brown the other. Step 9: Drain and keep warm in the oven if necessary.

Ingredient Names: cooked pasta, carrots, peas, egg, cooked chicken, soy sauce, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything but pasta on stove top and heat until bubbling Add pasta and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, frozen mixed vegetables, cooked rice, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a little olive oil in a wok or deep skillet. Step 2: Add egg and cook slightly You want to cook it all the way through, but don't over cook it You don't want it to brown in this stage. Step 3: Remove egg, break it up and set aside. Step 4: Add a little more oil Reheat chicken in the pan. Step 5: Add rice and egg and toss until heated through. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: lemons, light muscovado sugar, thumb-sized ginger, garlic, soy sauce, chinese five spice powder, dry sherry, chicken thighs
Instructions: Step 1: Juice 1 lemon and cut the other into slices. Put in a large food bag along with remaining ingredients and shake well to coat. leave for 10 mins (or up to 24 hrs if making ahead). Step 2: Heat the grill to high or fire up the barbecue. lift the chicken out of the marinade, shake off excess, then cook under a grill or on a barbecue for 20 mins, spooning over the marinade every few mins. Turn occasionally, until cooked through and dark golden brown. Great served with new potatoes and a green salad.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, salt, light soy sauce, flour, cornstarch, baking soda, baking powder, sugar, water, vegetable oil, oil, chicken stock, lemons, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: The batter should be about as thick as pancake batter, or just a little thicker. Step 2: Dip chicken in batter and refrigerate for 10- 15 minutes Double deep fry the chicken, allowing at least 20 minutes between steps Blot on paper towels to remove excess grease. Step 3: When ready to add sauce, slice and put chicken on a serving platter lined with lettuce leaves and garnished with some cherry tomatoes For the sauce: heat about a teaspoon of vegetable oil in a skillet. Step 4: Stir in scallion until it sizzles, about 30 seconds. Step 5: Add lemon slices & stir 1 minute until sizzling. Step 6: Add chicken stock, salt, and sugar. Step 7: Stir in cornstarch.

Dish Name: Lemon Chicken And Asparagus Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: reduced sodium soy sauce, fresh lemon juice, lemon zest, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breast, canola oil, garlic cloves, scallions, asparagus, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: In a glass dish, stir together soy sauce, lemon juice, lemon zest and cornstarch. Step 2: Add chicken and coat well with marinade. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 15 to 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a large, nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add garlic and fry till softened Reserving the marinade, add the chicken, followed by scallions, asparagus, and carrot. Step 6: Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink. Step 7: Add marinade and cook until sauce is slightly thickened, about 1 minute.

Dish Name: Lemon Chicken And Spring Veg Noodles
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic cloves, lemon, chicken stock, superfine sugar, gingerroot, cornstarch, egg noodles, frozen peas, scallions, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, fry the garlic gently until aromatic, take care not to burn it, then fry the chicken for 5 mins until almost cooked. Step 2: Pour chicken stock into the pan with the lemon zest and juice, sugar and ginger. Step 3: In a bowl, mix the cornstarch with a little water until smooth, then whisk into the pan. Step 4: Bring to the boil, stirring, then add the chicken to the sauce. Step 5: Reduce the heat Bubble for a few mins until chicken is cooked and the sauce thickened. Step 6: Meanwhile, cook the noodles and veg together in boiling water for 4 mins, then drain. Step 7: Toss together the chicken, noodles, veg and scallions. Step 8: Serve scattered with nuts if using.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, water, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, brown sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, chinese wine, fresh ginger, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f Unroll the chicken thighs and place in a 9" x 13" baking pan. Step 2: Brush with 2 tablespoons water and sprinkle the thighs evenly with the flour. Step 3: Bake for 30 minutes. Step 4: Combine the cornstarch and brown sugar in a bowl Gradually whisk in the soy sauce, lemon juice, cooking wine and water. Step 5: Add the ginger and pepper. Step 6: Pour over the chicken and bake for an additional 20 minutes. Step 7: Serve with basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken leg portions, lemons, thin-stemmed broccoli, garlic, thumb-sized ginger, light soy sauce, clear honey, sesame seeds, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the chicken and lemon chunks in a large roasting tin, season with pepper, then roast for 30 mins until the chicken is turning golden. Step 2: After 25 mins, bring a little water to the boil in a frying pan, add the broccoli, cover and steam for 3 mins until bright green and almost tender, then drain. Step 3: Tuck the broccoli around the chicken, scatter the garlic and ginger over and around the meat, then splash over the lemon juice, soy and honey. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds. Roast for another 15 mins until the chicken is golden and tender, and juices look sticky. Drizzle with sesame oil, then serve the chicken, broccoli and juices with rice.

Ingredient Names: long grain brown rice, cornstarch, snow peas, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, light brown sugar, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, egg whites, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, in large bowl, stir together 1 t cornstarch and 1 / 2 cup cold water until smooth. Step 3: Add snow peas or sugar snap peas, garlic, ginger, sugar, soy sauce and red pepper flakes. Step 4: Toss to combine and set aside In another bowl, whisk together egg whites, remaining 3 t cornstarch, 1 / 2 t salt and 1 / 4 t pepper. Step 5: Add chicken and toss to coat In large nonstick skillet, heat 1 t oil over medium-high heat Lift half the chicken from egg-white mixture and add to skillet. Step 6: Cook, turning occasionally, until golden, 6-8 minutes. Step 7: Transfer to a plate, repeat with remaining oil and chicken, and set aside.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, gingerroot, mild red chile peppers, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, chili powder, curry powder, plain flour, self-raising flour, water, chicken broth, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy-based pan and cook the chopped onion for a few minutes over a high heat. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic and red chilli. Step 3: Stir for 30 seconds then reduce the heat to very low. Step 4: Cook for 15 minutes, stirring from time to time, making sure nothing browns or burns. Step 5: Add the turmeric, cumin, coriander, curry powder and chilli powder and cook very gently for a further 5 minutes Don't burn the spices or the sauce will taste acrid. Step 6: Sprinkle on a few drops of water if you're worried. Step 7: Remove from the heat and cool a little. Step 8: Put the water in a food processor or blender and add the contents of the pan Whiz until very smooth.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, gingerroot, garlic cloves, red chilies, turmeric, cumin, coriander, chili powder, curry powder, water, plain flour, self raising flour, chicken stock, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: Heat the oil or ghee in a heavy based pan or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add the onion and stir fry for 3 minutes, or until starting to soften, but not brown. Step 3: Add the ginger, garlic and chillies and continue stir-frying for 30 seconds and then reduce heat to very low and leave to cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is completely soft, but nothing browns. Step 4: Stir in the turmeric, cumin, coriander, chili and curry powders and continue cooking very gently for 5 minutes Don't burn the spices or they will taste acrid. Step 5: Sprinkle on a few drops of water if you're worried. Step 6: Remove the pan from the heat and allow to cool a little. Step 7: Put the water into a food processor or blender, then add contents of the pan. Step 8: Blend until everything is very smooth, then add both flours and blend again.

Dish Name: Little Chinese Laundry Bundles Spring Rolls
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, broccoli slaw mix, crunchy peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, ground ginger, fresh cilantro, spring roll wrappers, chives, egg white, peanut oil, vegetable oil, green onions, cucumber, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mince or finely chop your chicken breasts If the broccoli florets in the broccoli slaw are very large, break them down into very small pieces. Step 2: Prepare the fresh cucumber and onion garnish - combine the shredded green onions with the cucumber strips in a serving bowl with a little soy sauce. Step 3: In a mixing bowl, combine the broccoli slaw, peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger and cilantro leaves. Step 4: Mix them together and allow to infuse for about 10 minutes In another small bowl, add a little soy sauce to the minced chicken breasts Pre-heat the vegetable oil for deep-frying to 180 degrees c or 360 degrees f while preparing the spring rolls. Step 5: Heat a wok over medium high to high heat. Step 6: Add 1 tablespoon of peanut oil. Step 7: When the oil is hot, add the minced chicken and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes, then add the seasoned vegetable mix, and cook for a further 1 to 2 minutes stirring vigorously all the time to toss the chicken and vegetables around in the wok.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, black mushrooms, bamboo shoot, carrots, french beans, coriander leaves, eggs, chicken stock, dark soya sauce, salt, ajinomoto, sugar, cornflour, shrimp, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Soak black mushrooms until soft. Step 2: Remove the stalks and wash. Step 3: Cut the bamboo shoot and vegetables into small dices Also cut the chicken and shrimps into small dices and mix 1 tsp of cornflour well Use the remaining cornflour to make corn-starch solution. Step 4: Heat chicken stock in a wok Scald the chicken and shrimps till cooked. Step 5: Bring the stock to a boil and add the vegetables, bamboo shoot and mushrooms. Step 6: When this comes to boil, add seasoning and stir in corn starch stirring continuously. Step 7: Bring to boil and add the coriander leaves and the beaten eggs stirring continuously.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, cornstarch, oil, thai red chili peppers, white mushrooms, onion, chicken broth, soy sauce, szechuan hot bean sauce, white pepper, ground szechuan peppercorns, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into small dice and dredge in cornstarch, shaking off Excess. Step 2: Heat enough oil in a wok or deep skillet to fry chicken until it is Cooked through, and drain. Step 3: Heat 1-2 tbs oil in wok and add chiles, cooking just for a moment, Then add mushrooms and onions, cooking until onions are softened. Step 4: Add cooked chicken back to pan. Step 5: Mix the chicken broth with soy sauce, hot bean paste, cayenne pepper, White pepper and schezuan peppercorns powder along with 1 tablespoons Cornstarch and add to wok, stir-frying briefly until sauce thickens.

Dish Name: Ma You Ji Sesame Oil Chicken
Ingredient Names: dark sesame oil, fresh ginger, chicken, chinese wine, kosher salt, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add ginger and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add chicken and toss to coat with the oil, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 7 minutes. Step 4: Remove breast meat and transfer to a plate. Step 5: Add wine and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce to medium low and simmer, covered, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Return breast meat and cook 15 minutes, season with salt.

Dish Name: Mah Gu Gai Pin Moo Goo Gai Pan
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh ginger, salt, button mushroom, snow peas, bamboo shoot, water chestnuts, garlic, chinese white rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, oyster sauce, soy sauce, cornstarch, fresh ground white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the marinade ingredients. Step 2: Add the chicken and allow to rest for at least 30 minutes Reserve. Step 3: In a small bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and reserve. Step 4: Heat a wok over high heat for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add 2 tablespoons of the peanut oil and coat the wok with it using a spatula. Step 6: When a wisp of white smoke appears, add the ginger and salt and stir for 10 seconds. Step 7: Add the mushrooms and stir for 10 seconds. Step 8: Add the snow peas, bamboo shoots, and water chestnuts and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 9: Turn off the heat, transfer the mixture to a bowl, and reserve.

Ingredient Names: whole boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil cooking spray, sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, vegetable oil, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Spray chicken breasts with vegetable oil spray. Step 2: Grill chicken breasts 4-6 minutes per side or until done. Step 3: Chop chicken into bite size pieces, set aside. Step 4: Combine sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, oil, garlic and ginger in a small saucepan. Step 5: Heat over medium until sugar is dissolved, stirring often, bring to boil. Step 6: Combine cornstarch and water. Step 7: Add to sauce pan, stirring often. Step 8: Reduce heat and simmer 4-6 minutes or until sauce thickens. Step 9: Pour chicken into a large frying pan over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: mandarin oranges, honey, lemon, soy sauce, dried ginger, all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, butter, oil, chow mein noodles, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Make the sauce by combining reserved orange juice with honey, soy sauce, lemon juice,, and ginger in a small bowl. Step 2: Blend well and set aside. Step 3: Combine flour with salt and pepper in a shallow pie pan. Step 4: Set aside Trim off any fat and white veins from chicken breasts and slice each breast into about three strips Dry between double layers of paper towels. Step 5: Heat butter and oil in large skillet or wok over medium-high heat Coat all sides of chicken strips in seasoned flour and brown lightly in skillet Reserve browned pieces on a plate lined with paper towels. Step 6: When all chicken is browned, pour sauce into wok or skillet.

Ingredient Names: real maple syrup, rice vinegar, rice wine, soya sauce, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, fresh ground black pepper, peanut oil, ginger, garlic, chilies, green onions, red bell pepper, daikon radishes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first 5 sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Combine the flour, cornstarch, and black pepper in a bag. Step 3: Add the chicken, shake to coat. Step 4: Heat the wok over high heat. Step 5: Add 2 tbs oil, swirl to coat. Step 6: Add the chicken, 8-10 pieces at a time. Step 7: Stir fry'til done, 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Drain on a paper towel. Step 9: Add oil as needed Continue until all of the chicken is done.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, oyster sauce, sesame oil, dry sherry, cooking oil, ginger, dried black mushrooms, carrot, zucchini, water chestnut, iceberg lettuce, hoisin sauce, walnuts, asian chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat in a bowl with oyster sauce, stir to coat. Step 2: Let stand for 10 minutes. Step 3: Soak mushrooms in warm water to cover until softened, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Drain, reserving 1 / 4 cup of the soaking liquid Trim and discard stems, chop caps. Step 5: Place a wok over high heat until hot. Step 6: Add cooking oil, swirling to coat sides. Step 7: Add ginger and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 10 seconds.

Ingredient Names: chicken thigh, eggs, cornstarch, dried chili pods, rice vinegar, rice wine, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, thoroughly blend the 1 / 2 cup of cornstarch and the eggs. Step 2: Add the chicken and toss to coat If the mixture is too thick, add some vegetable oil to separate the pieces. Step 3: In a small bowl, prepare the sauce mixture by combining the 2 tsp cornstarch with the wine, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce First-stage frying: heat 1-2 inches of peanut oil in a wok to medium-high heat. Step 4: Fry the chicken in small batches, just long enough to cook the chicken through. Step 5: Remove the chicken to absorbent paper and allow to stand Second-stage frying: leave a tablespoon or two of the oil in the wok. Step 6: Add the pepper pods to the oil and stir-fry briefly, awakening the aroma but not burning them. Step 7: Return the chicken to the wok and stir-fry until the pieces are crispy brown.

Dish Name: Midweek Chicken Spring Onion And Noodle Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, thin egg noodles, fresh ginger, garlic clove, spring onions, light soy sauce, chicken stock, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, cook the noodles as per the directions on the packet, drain and leave to one side Warm the oil in the pan and fry the garlic and ginger, stirring for about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add the chicken and stir around the pan. Step 3: Meanwhile prepare the stock and add the soy sauce to the stock, stir and leave to one side. Step 4: Check the chicken is cooked / brown before moving on. Step 5: Add the spring onions and stir briefly. Step 6: Then add the stock, stir. Step 7: Then add the noodles abit a time and mix everything together. Step 8: Add a good pinch of black pepper, toss everything together until nice and hot and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, flour, salad oil, garlic cloves, green onion, cilantro, sugar, oyster sauce, water, pepper, dry sherry, salt, saimin noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Pancake noodles: bring water and salt to a boil. Step 2: Add noodles slowly so water continues to boil vigorously. Step 3: Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until noodles are barely tender. Step 4: Drain and rinse with cold water, drain again. Step 5: Mix noodles with 3 tablespoons of the oil. Step 6: In a large skillet, heat 3 tablespoons of the remaining oil. Step 7: Arrange one-third of the noodles in the pan to form a large pancake Brown noodles on both sides, using high heat. Step 8: Remove from skillet.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, cornstarch, dry sherry, salt, black pepper, chicken stock, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic clove, mushroom, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, snow peas, red bell pepper, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, toss chicken with ginger, garlic and 1 tablespoon corn starch, set aside. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch, chicken broth, soy sauce and sesame oil, set aside. Step 3: In a saute pan, saute almonds in butter, set aside. Step 4: In a wok or large skillet heat oil over med-high heat. Step 5: Add chicken and cook stirring quickly and frequently 3 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Step 6: Add sherry, mushrooms, snow peas, red pepper, green onions, water chestnuts, salt and pepper and stir fry 4-5 minutes or until red bell pepper is tender-crisp. Step 7: Stir soy mixture until blended then pour into wok, stirring constantly. Step 8: Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute, add almonds.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, dry sherry, cornstarch, sugar, oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, green onions, garlic, broccoli, zucchini, bok choy, snow peas, mushroom, water chestnut, red chili pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the sauce ingredients Hot wok, add 2 tablespoons oil, swirl. Step 2: Add the chicken, stirfry 3 minutes. Step 3: Add green onions and garlic. Step 4: Cook 1 / 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove and set aside Scrap wok clean and reheat. Step 6: Add 2 tablespoons oil Swirl. Step 7: Add vegetables and stir fry 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, light soy sauce, brown sugar, sugar, garlic powder, ginger, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: If you are using frozen chicken wings, defrost them first If you prefer, cut off. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 3: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl Spray a 9x11 baking dish with veg Oil spray. Step 4: Place chicken wings in single depth in the pan. Step 5: Pour the mixture over the chicken wings and place in oven. Step 6: Bake for 30 minutes, then turn wings. Step 7: Bake for another 30 minutes, and turn wings again.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, green onion, peanut oil, sesame oil, coleslaw mix, sliced mushrooms, cornstarch, sherry wine, reduced sodium soy sauce, garlic, broccoli coleslaw mix, carrot, flour tortillas, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the peanut and sesame oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet on medium. Step 2: Slice the green onions, using all the whites and enough of the tender green tops to make about 1 cup Immediately add the onions, shredded cabbage mix and mushrooms to the skillet. Step 3: Raise the heat to high and cook to soften vegetables, stirring from time to time. Step 4: Meanwhile, cut the chicken through its width into 1 / 4 inch wide strips, adding strips to the skillet as you slice. Step 5: Mix the cornstarch into the sherry and add it to the skillet along with the soy sauce and garlic, stir well. Step 6: Add the broccoli slaw and carrots and stir Continue to stir fry, stirring frequently, about 5 to 7 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink Just before serving, put the tortillas on a plate and microwave, uncovered, 1 minute 30 seconds to warm through.

Ingredient Names: rice wine, sesame oil, soy sauce, chicken breasts, chicken broth, cornstarch, sugar, black pepper, mixed mushrooms, green cabbage, red bell pepper, green onions, peanut oil, eggs, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine 1 tbsp rice wine, 2 tsp sesame oil, and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Step 2: Mix thoroughly with the chicken or pork strips. Step 3: Marinate at least 15 minutes but no longer than 8 hours. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine sauce ingredients and set aside for later. Step 5: Chop mushrooms, cabbage, bell pepper, and green onions. Step 6: Place in bowl for later. Step 7: In a small bowl, beat eggs with 2 tsp of sesame oil, set aside. Step 8: Heat a large wok or skillet on high. Step 9: When the wok becomes very hot, add 2 tbsp peanut oil to the center. Step 10: Add marinated meat.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, bean curd, black pepper, rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken wing for few hours or overnite in the fridge Deep fry and served.

Dish Name: One Pot Chicken With Noodles Ginger Sweet Onion And Lemon
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil, chicken stock, green onion, fresh lemon, fresh gingerroot, chili-garlic sauce, fresh ground black pepper, sweet onion, salt, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each chicken breast half into two portions. Step 2: Cut through at the meatiest portion of each breast so you end up with four relatively equal-sized portions. Step 3: In a deep-sided, heavy-bottomed pot, brown the chicken pieces in the vegetable oil over medium-high heat, turning once to brown on both sides. Step 4: Reduce the heat slightly, remove the chicken pieces to a plate, pour in the broth, stirring and scraping to dissolve all of the caramelized chicken juices. Step 5: Return the browned chicken to the pot, and add the green onions, lemon slices, ginger root, chile-garlic sauce, and black pepper. Step 6: Cover, and cook for 30 minutes. Step 7: Add the chopped sweet onion, cover, and continue simmering just until the chicken is tender and cooked, about another 10 or 15 minutes Adjust the seasonings, adding salt if desired The chicken may be prepared to this point up to 24 hours ahead and refrigerated Five or ten minutes before serving, bring the mixture to a boil, then remove the chicken pieces with a slotted spoon.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, carrots, celery, vegetable oil, cornstarch, ground ginger, orange juice, honey, soy sauce, salted cashews, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry chicken, carrots and celery in oil for 8-10 minutes or til joices run clear, reduce heat. Step 2: In a bowl, combine the cornstarch, ginger, orange juice, honey and soy sauce until well-blended. Step 3: Stir into chicken mixture, bring to a boil. Step 4: Cook and stir for 2 minutes, or until thickened, stir in cashews. Step 5: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chicken breasts, salt and black pepper, onion, garlic cloves, red bell peppers, broccoli florets, crushed red pepper flakes, ground coriander, oranges, tamari, honey, chicken stock, cornstarch, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a large, deep skillet over high heat with 3 tablespoons of the oil. Step 2: Season the chicken with some salt and pepper and brown it in 2 batches if necessary. Step 3: Once the chicken has browned, remove it to a plate and reserve. Step 4: Return the skillet to the heat and add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil, the onions, garlic, red bell peppers, broccoli, red pepper flakes, and coriander. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, for 3-4 minutes, or until the veggies start to get tender. Step 6: Add the orange zest and juice, tamari, and honey. Step 7: Stir, scraping up any brown bits on the bottom of the pan. Step 8: Add the chicken stock and bring up to a simmer, then return the browned chicken to the pan and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through. Step 9: Mix the cornstarch with a little splash of water in a small bowl and add to the pan to thicken up the sauce a bit. Step 10: Add the cashews--as many as you want! Step 11: Serve the cashew chicken over rice and garnish with the chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: water, orange juice, dark brown sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, lemon juice, water chestnut, fresh ginger, garlic, green onions, crushed red pepper flakes, cornstarch, arrowroot, boneless skinless chicken breasts, ice water
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce, in a small saucepan over high heat, combine everything listed except for the cornstarch, arrowroot, and 3 tablespoons of water Stirring frequently bring the sauce mixture to a boil. Step 2: When it starts to boil, remove the pan from the heat and allow it to cool just a tad, uncovered. Step 3: Remove exactly 1 cup of the sauce mixture and pour it over the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag or other container which allows the chicken to be completely covered The chicken should marinate for at least a couple hours. Step 4: Set aside the remaining sauce until the chicken is ready. Step 5: When chicken has marinated, preheat 2 inches of vegetable oil in a wok or skillet to 350 degrees. Step 6: Combine cornstarch with arrowroot in a small bowl, then add 3 tablespoons of water. Step 7: Stir until cornstarch and arrowroot have dissolved. Step 8: Pour this mixture into the sauce and set the pan over high heat.

Ingredient Names: water, orange juice, lemon juice, rice vinegar, soy sauce, orange zest, brown sugar, fresh gingerroot, garlic, green onions, red pepper flakes, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pour into saucepan water, orange juice, lemon juice, rice vinegar, and soy sauce And set over medium-high heat. Step 2: Stir in orange zest, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, red pepper, and chopped onion. Step 3: In a small bowl mix 3 tablespoons of cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of cold water mix well and add it to your sauce, bring to a boil. Step 4: Remove from heat, and let cool 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Place chicken pieces into a resealable plastic bag. Step 6: When contents of saucepan have cooled, pour 1 cup of sauce into bag Reserve remaining sauce Seal bag, and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

Dish Name: Orange Chicken With Red Chilies Szechuan Style Dave Dewitt
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, dry vermouth, boneless chicken breast, minced ginger, garlic, scallion, ground szechuan peppercorns, soy sauce, szechuan hot bean sauce, dried orange peel, sugar, sesame oil, frying oil, dried hot red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the ingredients for the marinade in a bowl large enough to hold the chicken, stir the liquid ingredients well, and then add the chicken. Step 2: Leave the chicken in the marinade for 30 minutes. Step 3: Take the dried orange peel, soak it in hot water for 30 minutes, then shred it. Step 4: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a bowl, stir well, and set aside. Step 5: Heat the wok over high heat. Step 6: Add the oil, swirl it around to coat the wok cooking surface. Step 7: When the oil just begins to smoke, add the chilies and the marinated chicken. Step 8: Stir fry for about 1 minute, until the chicken begins to take on color. Step 9: Add the sauce and stir fry for another 30-45 seconds. Step 10: Remove the chilies before serving, or tell your guests not to eat them!

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, soy sauce, canola oil, lemon juice, rice wine vinegar, splenda sugar substitute, orange marmalade, five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken in a large zip-lock bag. Step 2: Mix all other ingredients together and pour over chicken Seal the bag, pressing out the air as you go. Step 3: Turn the bag to coat, and place it in the refrigerator. Step 4: Let sit for at least 2 hours, longer is fine. Step 5: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 6: Place the chicken in a baking pan Reserving marinade in a small bowl Roast chicken for 1 hour, basting 2-3 times with the reserved marinade.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice wine, cornstarch, fresh ginger, sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, orange rind, chicken stock, white pepper, peanut oil, snow peas, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients in small bowl. Step 2: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes and add to bowl, toss to coat well. Step 3: Cover and marinate at room temperature at least 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Soak orange peel in enough water to cover, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain and set aside. Step 6: Combine stock, soy sauce, rice wine, cornstarch, sesame oil, and pepper in another small bowl, set aside. Step 7: Heat peanut oil in wok. Step 8: Drain chicken and add to wok in small batches and stir-fry until cooked through, about 2 minutes, adding more oil if necessary.

Ingredient Names: sugar, gingerroot, garlic, soy sauce, boneless chicken breasts, cornstarch, water, water chestnut, green onion, flakey biscuits, butter, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat over to 375 degrees In large skillet combine sugar, ginger, garlic and soy sauce. Step 2: Cook over medium heat until boiling. Step 3: Add chicken, cooking 3 to 4 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat With a slotted spoon, remove chicken from pan juices. Step 5: Drain well reserving liquid. Step 6: Combine cornstarch and water, stir into reserved liquid, return to heat. Step 7: Heat to boiling, stirring constantly until clear& thickened.

Ingredient Names: honey, rice vinegar, hellman mayonnaise, gray poupan dijon mustard, sesame oil, iceberg lettuce, romaine lettuce, green onions, carrots, purple cabbage, hard-boiled eggs, breaded chicken, almonds, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix oriental dressing, chill until ready to use. Step 2: Toss salad ingredients and top with oriental salad dressing. Step 3: Garnish with toasted almonds and chow mein noodles.

Dish Name: Oriental Chicken Salad With Crunchy Ramen Noodles
Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breasts, cabbage, green onion, slivered almonds, sunflower seeds, top ramen noodles, oil, vegetable oil, seasoned rice vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare dressing and set aside Smash noodles of top ramen and brown over medium heat in 3 tbs oil. Step 2: Once noodles have begun to slightly brown, add slivered almonds If you start to brown the ramen and almonds at the same time, the almonds will burn before the ramen browns. Step 3: Once the ramen noodles have turned a dark golden brown, remove from heat and set aside. Step 4: Combine cabbage, green onions, chicken and sunflower seeds in a large bowl. Step 5: Add the ramen / almond mixture and stir well. Step 6: Add dressing and stir to coat I generally prepare the dressing right before serving If it sits in the refrigerator too long, it gets very thick and won't remix well.

Ingredient Names: cooking sherry, soy sauce, cider vinegar, ground ginger, cornstarch, canola oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, red bell pepper, scallions, sliced mushrooms, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine sherry, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger and cornstarch. Step 2: Stir to blend well. Step 3: In a wok or large frying pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and stir-fry 2 minutes until meat turns white. Step 5: Add red pepper, scallions, mushrooms, and water chestnuts. Step 6: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir sauce and add to wok. Step 8: Stir over heat until sauce thickens, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: water, soy sauce, dry white wine, cornstarch, ground black pepper, ground ginger, boneless skinless chicken breasts, oil, green onions, fresh mushrooms, zucchini, garlic, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: In bowl, stir together water, soy sauce, white wine, cornstarch, and seasonings. Step 2: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces and add to marinade, stirring to coat. Step 3: Let stand at room temp For 30 minutes. Step 4: Drain chicken, reserving marinade. Step 5: Preheat wok or large skillet over high heat, add oil. Step 6: Stir-fry green onion, mushrooms, zucchini, and garlic in hot oil for 2-3 minutes, until tender. Step 7: Remove from skillet. Step 8: Add chicken to skillet.

Ingredient Names: chicken, dried chinese mushrooms, baby bok choy, shallots, garlic cloves, red wine, light soya sauce, honey, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the mushroom slices in water till they soften. Step 2: Keep the soaking liquid aside Loosen skin of chicken Rub the marinade under the skin, in the cavity and over the skin Do keep a little bit of marinade aside for the gravy Tuck the sliced mushrooms under the skin of the chicken. Step 3: Heat oven to 200c Roast chicken in a large roasting tin, loosely covered with foil for 30 minutes. Step 4: Turn heat down to 150c, add shallots and garlic, and roast uncovered for 20 minutes Pierce with a skewer, if the juice runs clear, the chicken is ready.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Chicken Lettuce Wraps By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, water chestnut, mushroom, onions, garlic, iceberg lettuce, sugar, water, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, ketchup, lemon juice, sesame oil, hot mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Make the special sauce by dissolving the sugar in water in a small bowl. Step 2: Add soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, ketchup, lemon juice and sesame oil. Step 3: Mix well and refrigerate this sauce until you're ready to serve. Step 4: Combine the hot water with the hot mustard and set this aside as well Eventually add your desired measurement of mustard and garlic chili sauce to the special sauce mixture to pour over the wraps. Step 5: Bring oil to high heat in a wok or large frying pan. Step 6: Saute chicken breasts for 4 to 5 minutes per side or done. Step 7: Remove chicken from the pan and cool. Step 8: Keep oil in the pan, keep hot As chicken cools mince water chestnuts and mushrooms to about the size of small peas.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Hot And Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chicken stock, soy sauce, white pepper, bamboo shoots, wood ear mushrooms, cornstarch, water, eggs, white vinegar, silken tofu
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken strips till done, set aside. Step 2: Bring stock to boil. Step 3: Add soy sauce, white pepper, bamboo, mushrooms and chicken, stir. Step 4: Let cook for 3 minutes While cooking, in separate bowl combine cornstarch and water to make slurry. Step 5: Add slurry a little at a time and stir until thick. Step 6: Add eggs while stirring and cook for 30 seconds or until eggs are done, turn off heat.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Lettuce Wraps By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: oil, chicken breasts, green onions, water chestnut, sliced almonds, lettuce leaves, water, cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame seeds, red pepper flakes, chili oil, minced ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Stirfry sauce: combine water and cornstarch and stir until cornstarch is dissolved. Step 2: Add this to the other stir fry sauce ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer till thick Sesame ginger dipping sauce: combine water and cornstarch in and mix until cornstarch is dissolved. Step 4: Combine this solution with the other dipping sauce ingredients in small pan over medium heat. Step 5: Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes Peanut dipping sauce: combine ingredients in a pan over medium low heat. Step 6: Heat while whisking until sauce becomes smooth. Step 7: Remove from heat when done. Step 8: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: chicken, cooking oil, salt, sugar, light soya sauce, dark soya sauce, rice wine, ginger juice, cornflour, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Get grease-proof paper and cut into 18cm by 18cm 12 square pieces of papers. Step 2: Marinate the chicken pieces with seasoning 1 for 15 minutes. Step 3: Brush 1 side of the each paper with oil. Step 4: Place a piece of chicken at one corner of the paper. Step 5: Fold up this corner to cover the chicken. Step 6: Then fold the sides to cover the chicken as well. Step 7: Fold the remaining corner down and tuck into the pocket to make a package. Step 8: Repeat for the rest of the chicken pieces. Step 9: Heat oil in a saucepan for deep-frying. Step 10: When the oil is hot, reduce the heat to medium-low.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, peanut oil, sesame oil, ground ginger, garlic, smooth peanut butter, scallions, unsweetened coconut milk, salt and pepper, white rice, peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick skillet heat peanut oil& sesame oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add ginger& garlic& cook until aroma is released. Step 3: Stir in chicken pieces& cook until golden brown. Step 4: Stir in peanut butter. Step 5: Stir in scallions& coconut milk& simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt& pepper& serve over white rice If desired, garnish with toasted peanuts& cilantro.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, gingerroot, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, dark sesame oil, flour tortillas, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl. Step 2: Stir well Reserve 1 cup hoisin sauce mixture, set aside. Step 3: Cut chicken diagonally across the grain into thin slices. Step 4: Add chicken to the remaining sauce mixture in bowl and stir well. Step 5: Cover and marinate in refrigerator up to 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Remove chicken from bowl. Step 7: Discard marinade Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, five-spice powder, fresh ginger, dark soy sauce, sesame oil, mirin, brown sugar, rice wine vinegar, kosher salt, ground black pepper, cucumber, green onions, hoisin sauce, all-purpose flour, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken: using the tines of the fork, prick holes through the skin and meat of the chicken This allows for the marinade to seep through. Step 2: Combine all the rest of the ingredients and marinate the chicken breasts for up to 4 hours. Step 3: Slice the cucumber into very thin julienne strips. Step 4: Slice the green onion stalks into very thin julienne strips. Step 5: Soak both the cucumber and the onions in 1 cup of ice cold water. Step 6: Drain very well before serving Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees. Step 7: Drain the breasts, discard marinade, and pat the chicken very dry, especially the skin side. Step 8: Heat 3 tablespoons of cooking oil in large oven proof fry pan on high heat.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, vegetable oil, rice wine vinegar, garlic cloves, ground ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and dry chicken legs. Step 2: Place chicken legs in a non-metallic dish or resealable plastic bag To make marinade, place marinade ingredients in a 2-cup measuring cup and stir until well combined. Step 3: Pour marinade over chicken and cover or close bag. Step 4: Marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight To make basting sauce, place sauce ingredients in a 2-cup measuring cup and stir until well combined, set aside. Step 5: Preheat grill and lightly coat with oil or cooking spray. Step 6: Drain chicken and discard marinade. Step 7: Place chicken on prepared grill 4 to 6 inches from source of heat.

Dish Name: Peppered Chicken Or Pork Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic, ginger, dry sherry, dried bird's eye chile, black pepper, soya sauce, sesame oil, chicken stock, cornflour, chinese vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade the chicken or pork in the sherry, 1 tablespoon of soya sauce, and half of the garlic and ginger. Step 2: Add the black pepper and return to fridge for as long as possible. Step 3: Prepare vegetables, of your own choice, i E Bok choy, bean sprouts, capsicum, onion, broccoli, asparagus, chinese leaf, baby corn--a mixture is great Blanche asparagus and broccoli for two minutes before adding to the other vegetables. Step 4: Add the remaining garlic and ginger plus the chili, crushed over the vegetables. Step 5: Add the remaining1 / 2 tablespoon of light soya sauce and the dark soya sauce and sesame oil to the chicken stock and thicken with the corn flour. Step 6: Drain excess marinade into the chicken stock, heat wok.

Ingredient Names: flour, cornstarch, salt, eggs, water, skinless chicken breast half, cooking oil, onion, pineapple tidbits, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, unsweetened pineapple juice, green pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Batter: stir flour, cornstarch and salt in medium bowl. Step 2: Beat eggs and water with fork. Step 3: Add to flour mixture. Step 4: Stir until consistency of medium-thick batter and only a few lumps remain. Step 5: Add chicken and stir until coated. Step 6: Remove, 1 piece at a time with fork or spoon, to hot cooking oil in deep fryer or wok. Step 7: Stir with slotted spoon until chicken comes to surface to brown evenly Deep-fry, in 3 or 4 batches, for about 5 minutes, turning until golden brown on all sides and chicken is no longer pink. Step 8: Remove to paper towels to drain Pineapple sauce: heat oil in medium saucepan or wok on medium.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, pineapple chunks, pineapple juice, red chili peppers, red bell pepper, sesame and ginger marinade, dry roasted peanuts, cooking spray, ginger, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Spray non-stick pan and brown chicken on both sides While chicken browns, seed and chop the bell peppers Seed and quarter the chili peppers. Step 2: Remove the chicken from the pan and chop it. Step 3: Return chicken to pan. Step 4: Add all other ingredients. Step 5: Simmer for 30 minutes. Step 6: Serve over fluffy rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, cornstarch, soy sauce, hot red peppers, sake, sugar, salt, sesame oil, oil, szechuan peppercorns, fresh ginger, peanuts, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Chop chicken into 1 inch pieces. Step 2: Combine 2 tablespoons cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce in medium bowl. Step 3: Add chicken, stir and let sit for 30 minutes. Step 4: Combine sake, soy sauce, sugar, salt, cornstarch and sesame oil, set aside, heat oil in wok. Step 5: Stir fry chicken 2 minutes until lightly browned. Step 6: Remove all but 2 teaspoons oil from wok. Step 7: Stir fry dried pepper and peppercorns briefly. Step 8: Add minced ginger and cooked chicken stir fry 1 minute.

Dish Name: Quick & easy hot-and-sour chicken noodle soup
Ingredient Names: wholewheat noodle, groundnut oil, ginger, red chile, skinless, shaohsing rice wine, vegetable stock, chestnut mushrooms, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, rice vinegar, cornflour mixed water to make slurry, fresh bean sprouts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a small pan of water to the boil and cook the noodles following pack instructions. Drain, rinse under cold running water to stop them cooking further, then drizzle over a little oil to prevent them sticking together. Divide between 2 deep bowls. Step 2: Heat a wok over high heat and add the rest of the oil. When it starts to smoke, add the ginger and chilli, then stir-fry for a few secs. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 2 mins. As the meat starts to turn brown, add the rice wine and cook for 3 mins more. Add the vegetable stock, bring to a simmer, then add the mushrooms. Season with the dark soy, light soy and rice vinegar. Step 3: Bring back to a simmer, then add the cornflour paste. Simmer and stir until thickened. Stir in the beansprouts and most of the spring onions, then ladle the soup over the noodles. Serve immediately, scattered with the remaining spring onions.

Ingredient Names: snow peas, sliced water chestnuts, chicken breast, salt, cornstarch, vegetable oil, hoisin sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Soak snow peas in very cold water for a few minutes only if they are not crisp Trim and string them Blot peas and water chestnuts dry with a clean paper towel, set aside. Step 2: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and cornstarch. Step 3: Stir or toss to coat evenly. Step 4: Add vegetable oil to a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 5: Heat until oil is almost smoking. Step 6: Add chicken to skillet and saut 2 minutes or until the chicken is just barely done. Step 7: Add snow peas, water chestnuts, hoisin sauce, and sugar to skillet.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic, hot pepper oil, sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 2" thickness. Step 2: Mix together hoisin sauce, peanut butter, garlic, and oil. Step 3: Spread over both sides of chicken. Step 4: Grill or broil chicken 4-5 inches from heat source until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Step 5: Slice chicken diagonally across the breast and serve on a piece of iceberg lettuce If you desire, serve with ramen noodles and steamed snow peas, as fast and easy side dishes.

Ingredient Names: sunflower, skinless, garlic, red peppers, green onions, straight-to-wok noodles, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, then stir- fry the chicken for about 3 mins, until golden. Step 2: Throw in the garlic and pepper and cook for 2 mins more. next, add the spring onions, beansprouts, noodles, sauce and 5 tbsp water and toss everything together for a final 2 mins cooking. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, green pepper, peanut oil, pineapple chunk, chicken broth, white vinegar, pineapple juice, sugar, plum sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in preheated wok. Step 2: Stir-fry chicken and green pepper until chicken turns white and is mostly cooked through. Step 3: Add rest of ingredients and stir-fry 3-4 minutes.

Dish Name: Rachael Ray Easy Egg Foo Young
Ingredient Names: eggs, deli chicken, shiitake mushrooms, fresh bean sprout, baby bok choy, carrot, scallion, red bell pepper, fresh ginger, garlic clove, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cornstarch, chicken stock, tamari, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a griddle over medium heat and brush it with some oil. Step 2: Whisk the eggs in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: Stir in the chicken, mushrooms, bean sprouts, bok choy, carrots, scallions, bell pepper, grated ginger and garlic. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Using a large spoon, drop about 1 / 2 cup of the mixture onto the griddle for each "pancake" Cook until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Step 6: Meanwhile, mix the cornstarch with a splash of chicken stock to dissolve. Step 7: Combine the remaining stock, the cornstarch mixture, tamari, hot sauce and sliced ginger in a small saucepan. Step 8: Boil until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 3 minutes. Step 9: Discard the sliced ginger.

Ingredient Names: noodles, sesame oil, carrots, bean sprouts, red bell pepper, cooked chicken, scallion tops, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, chili paste, smooth peanut butter, soy sauce, sugar, black vinegar, toasted sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles until just tender. Step 2: Rinse under cold water. Step 3: Drain, and toss with 1 teaspoon sesame oil. Step 4: Arrange the noodles in a large serving bowl. Step 5: Arrange the vegetables in concentric circles over the noodles and then pile the chicken in the center. Step 6: Sprinkle the scallions on top. Step 7: Serve at room temperature or chilled, with the chinese peanut dressing For chinese peanut dressing: in a food processor fitted with the metal blade or in a blender, finely chop the ginger and garlic. Step 8: Add the remaining ingredients in the order listed and process until smooth The dressing should be the consistency of heavy cream.

Dish Name: Red Cooked Chicken Eastern Chinese Style
Ingredient Names: frying chickens, vegetable oil, star anise, garlic, ginger, scallions, chicken stock, brown sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, dry sherry
Instructions: Step 1: Star anise comes in cellophane bags Whole ones have a total of eight points, each with an anise seed inside If you can't find a whole one, just count out eight broken pieces Use a little more or less to taste but don't omit it since it's an important element in this recipe The original recipe calls for chinese rock sugar which imparts a lustrous finish to the gravy Available in asian stores. Step 2: Remove any excess fat from the chicken. Step 3: Heat oil and brown chicken on all sides. Step 4: Add the anise, scallions, ginger& garlic and brown slightly. Step 5: Combine the soy sauces, brown sugar, stock and sherry and pour into the pot with the chicken.

Dish Name: Restaurant Quality Chinese Chicken Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: rice, onion, water, garlic salt, butter, pepper, dried parsley flakes, salt, egg, oil, soy sauce, water chestnuts, green bell pepper, chicken meat
Instructions: Step 1: Make rice first. Step 2: Add all ingredients together in saucepan and bring to boil. Step 3: Turn to simmer and cook 20 minutes with lid on. Step 4: Set aside to cool In large skillet pan melt butter. Step 5: In a small bowl stir egg and water. Step 6: Add to skillet on medium low heat in one big thin pancake formation. Step 7: Cook for 1-2 minutes or until set. Step 8: Take out carefully with spatula. Step 9: Cut egg into long thin shreds on cutting board.

Dish Name: Restaurant Style Chinese Orange Chicken With Spring Peas
Ingredient Names: orange juice, brown sugar, low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, cornstarch, orange zest, boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg whites, water, flour, salt, ground black pepper, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, minced ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Orange sauce: In small bowl, combine orange juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, rice wine, cornstarch and orange zest. Step 2: Set aside Chicken: In a small bowl, whisk together the egg whites and water. Step 3: Stir in chicken pieces. Step 4: In a pie plate, stir together cornstarch, flour, salt and pepper with a fork or clean whisk Taking a few pieces of chicken at a time, dip chicken into the flour mixture. Step 5: In a large skillet, add vegetable oil to cover pan to a 1 / 2-inch depth. Step 6: Heat skillet over medium to medium-high heat.

Dish Name: Rice Flour Chicken Crisp And Crunchy Batter
Ingredient Names: chicken piece, soy sauce, honey, five-spice powder, garlic, onion, sesame oil, rice flour, salt, baking powder, water
Instructions: Step 1: Make the soy sauce, honey, spice powder, garlic, onion and sesame oil into a marinade mixture. Step 2: Add the chicken pieces for at least 2 hours, but even better, overnight. Step 3: Mix batter ingredients with enough water to form athick batter If not crunchy when fried add slightly more baking powder. Step 4: Dip marinaded chicken into batter and deep fry until cooked and golden brown.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, salt, pepper, water, egg yolks, vegetable oil, green onions, lemon juice, brown sugar, honey, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in 1 1 / 2 inch pieces. Step 2: Combine cornstarch, salt and pepper. Step 3: Mix in egg yolks and water. Step 4: Dip chicken in mixture and fry until golden brown, drain on paper towels Sauce: combine all ingredients, cook until sauce boils and thickens. Step 5: Add green onions and chicken. Step 6: Serve with rice and a stir-fried vegetable.

Ingredient Names: szechuan peppercorns, whole black peppercorn, sea salt, chinese five spice powder, caster sugar, roasting chickens, spring onions, ginger, light soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dry fry the two peppers over medium heat for 30-60 seconds, until fragrant and slightly coloured Grind them with a pestle and mortar or in a coffee grinder til fine, then combine with the salt, five spice and sugar. Step 2: Pour a kettle of boiling water over the chicken then thoroughly pat dry with paper towel Rub spice mixture all over the chook. Step 3: Place in the fridge uncovered for 6 hours, then brush off any extra spice mix before putting in a roasting dish in a 200c oven Roast for 60-70 minutes, until cooked and golden. Step 4: Check the doneness by piercing the flesh between the thigh and body, when juices run clear it's ready. Step 5: Serve in pieces with the dipping sauce - - and some steamed vegetables.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, buttermilk, flour, cornstarch, sesame seeds, paprika, kosher salt, chicken, mayonnaise, cilantro, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Dressing -- i make the day before Just add everything to a small tupperware container and shake. Step 2: Set in the fridge until you are ready to make the salad Almonds -- i also make these the day ahead, so all you have to worry about if the chicken and putting the salad together Simply melt the butter in a small non stick saute pan and cook on medium heat until golden brown. Step 3: Then add in the brown sugar and stir until melted. Step 4: Remove to a piece of parchment paper or foil to let cool. Step 5: Make sure to spread out the almonds out, otherwise they will stick together Just let them cool and store in a small baggie Chicken -- i marinade the chicken in just buttermilk.

Dish Name: Scallion And Ginger Chicken Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt & freshly ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, scallion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, reduced-sodium chicken broth, cider vinegar, hoisin sauce, sugar, scallion top, cornstarch, reduced sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into small bite sized strips and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the chicken and stir until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover to keep warm. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil to the pan. Step 6: Add scallion whites, garlic and ginger. Step 7: Cook, stirring for 1 minute. Step 8: Add broth, vinegar, hoisin sauce, cornstarch and sugar, bring to a simmer. Step 9: Cook until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.

Dish Name: Scenter Steamed Chicken Rice With Ginger Dressing
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, ginger, extra virgin olive oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice, scallions, fresh cilantro, black pepper, dried cilantro, lime zest, frozen peas, rice, water, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Fill your base to the high water mark. Step 2: Place pepper, cilantro and zest in flavor center. Step 3: Put rice and water in a cup - like a large coffee cup or other similair size cup. Step 4: Put this cup inside the steamer basket. Step 5: Put the frozen peas and onions in the bowl divder basket. Step 6: Place the the bowl divider beside the rice cup. Step 7: Steam for 8 minutes While the peas are cooking, prepare the dressing by combining all the dressing ingredients, set aside. Step 8: Add the red pepper to the peas and onions.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, chicken breasts, soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, cornstarch, ground ginger, tabasco sauce, carrots, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large skillet, over high heat, heat oil. Step 2: Add garlic& saute 1 minute. Step 3: Add chicken& stir fry till pieces turn white. Step 4: Combine soy sauce, sherry, sugar, cornstarch, ginger, & tobasco sauce. Step 5: Add to skillet along with carrots. Step 6: Stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 7: Add snow peas& stir fry for 3 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: swanson chicken broth, fresh ground black pepper, carrot, celery, onion, garlic powder, medium egg noodles, cooked chicken, dried dill
Instructions: Step 1: Mix broth, black pepper, carrot, celery onion & garlic powder in saucepan, heat to a boil. Step 2: Stir in noodles and chicken. Step 3: Cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until noodles are done. Step 4: Sprinkle with dried dill or parsley Oriental variation. Step 5: Add a little fresh grated ginger, crushed garlic clove, a shot of soy sauce and some crushed red pepper Don't use broad noodles use linguine or spaghetti Mexican variation. Step 6: Stir in some salsa and garnish with chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, sesame oil, garlic, fresh mushrooms, chicken broth, sesame ginger salad dressing, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine flour, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Toss chicken with flour mixture to coat evenly. Step 3: Heat a non-stick skillet then coat it with sesame oil. Step 4: Add garlic and chicken. Step 5: Fry until browned, stirring only infrequently To keep chicken from sticking to skillet add a little broth as needed. Step 6: Place mushrooms on top of chicken and add 1 / 4 cup chicken broth. Step 7: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 10-12 minutes, adding chicken broth and stirring every few minutes as needed to keep chicken from drying and sticking to pan At end of the 10-12 minutes braising time, stir in 1-3 tablespoons additional broth until sauce is preferred consistency. Step 8: Stir in sesame ginger dressing.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, garlic clove, ground ginger, cornstarch, egg white, white bread, sesame seeds, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, garlic, ginger, cornstarch and egg white in a bowl. Step 2: Cut the bread into triangles.
