Step 3: Remove crusts from the bread and spread the chicken mixture over one side of each slice. Step 4: Dip the bread, chicken-side-down into the sesame seeds, to coat Just before serving, deep-fry the chicken toasts in hot oil until well browned, starting with the paste side down and then turning over. Step 5: Drain on absorbent paper.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, teriyaki sauce, all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, egg whites, sesame seeds, red currant jelly, soy sauce, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees f Coat baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Combine chicken pieces and teriyaki sauce in medium-size bowl. Step 3: Let stand 15 minutes. Step 4: Combine flour, salt and pepper in large, resealable plastic food-storage bag Lightly beat egg whites in a bowl. Step 5: Spread out sesame seeds in shallow pan. Step 6: Add chicken cubes, a few at a time, to flour mixture Seal bag Shake to coat.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, ginger wine, cornflour, chicken thighs, peanut oil, sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger, chicken stock, green onion, honey, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a glass bowl mix together soy sauce, wine and cornflour. Step 2: Cut up chicken, if not already done, and add to the bowl. Step 3: Stir together well. Step 4: Let this marinade a few minutes. Step 5: Heat up frying pan or wok. Step 6: Add peanut oil, sesame oil, crushed garlic and grated ginger, fry breifly. Step 7: Drain chicken pieces, reserving the liquid, and add them to the pan a few at a time Do this in batches so that they brown nicely. Step 8: When all of the chicken has been fried off, add the chicken pices back to the pan with the reserved marinade and chicken stock.

Ingredient Names: breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, chinese five-spice powder, skinless chicken breasts flatten, eggs, tenderstem broccoli, soy sauce, lemons, limes, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6 and line a baking tray with baking paper. Mix the breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, five-spice and a little seasoning on a plate. Pat dry the chicken, dip into the egg, then roll in the breadcrumb mix. Arrange on the baking tray, then bake for 25-30 mins until crisp and cooked through. Step 2: When the chicken is almost ready, boil the broccoli in salted water for a few mins until just tender. Mix the soy sauce with the citrus juices and sugar to make a dipping sauce. Serve the crispy chicken with the broccoli and little dishes of the sauce for dipping, plus lime wedges for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, fresh ginger, toasted sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, pepper, napa cabbage, red bell pepper, scallion, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk vinegar, 3 tbsp soy sauce, hoisin sauce, ginger, and sesame oil together in medium bowl. Step 2: Place chicken in single layer in dutch oven. Step 3: Pour 1 / 3 cup vinegar mixture over chicken breast, reserve remaining vinegar mixture to use as dressing. Step 4: Add remaining 1 / 3 cup soy sauce and 3 cups water to pot. Step 5: Bring to boil over high heat. Step 6: Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer chicken until cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes. Step 7: Transfer chicken to plate, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until cool enough to handle Shred chicken into long thin strands using two forks. Step 8: Transfer chicken to large serving bowl, toss with 2 tbsp of reserved vinegar mixture and season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Add cabbage, bell pepper, scallions, and remaining vinegar mixture and toss to combine.

Dish Name: Shanghai Cold Noodles With Peanut Butter Sauce
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, chicken breasts, baby carrots, cucumber, sesame seeds, sriracha sauce, peanut butter, milk, low sodium soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce, add peanut butter and milk in a small bowl, press the peanut butter against the bowl by the back of a small spoon, stir until smooth. Step 2: Add vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and minced ginger. Step 3: Stir and set aside. Step 4: In a saucepan, bring a quart water to a boil and add chicken breast to cook for 5 minutes or until the chicken is thoroughly cooked. Step 5: Remove chicken and set aside to cool down Follow the instructions on noodle package to cook noodles by using the chicken broth in the same saucepan Normally cook in the boiling water for 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Remove the cooked noodles from heat and rinse with cold water, then drain. Step 7: Toss with 1 tsp sesame oil and set aside.

Dish Name: Shanghai Fried Noodles With Pork Or Chicken
Ingredient Names: fresh chinese noodles, cold water, sesame oil, pork tenderloin, light soy sauce, rice wine, cornstarch, scallion, garlic clove, ginger, peanut oil, sugar, chinese cabbage, dark soy sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Drop noodles into boiling water, and cook about 4 minutes. Step 2: Add cold water, and bring to boil for 1 minute. Step 3: Rinse with cold running water, drain, mix with sesame seed oil, and set aside. Step 4: Cut meat crosswise and julienne. Step 5: Mix with 1 tablespoon light soy sauce, the wine, and the cornstarch. Step 6: Stir-fry scallion, garlic, ginger and meat in 2 tablespoons heated oil at 400f until meat changes color. Step 7: Add other tablespoon light soy sauce and sugar, remove, and keep warm In clean wok, stir-fry cabbage in 2 tablespoons heated oil at 400f for 2 minutes, remove, and wipe out wok. Step 8: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in wok, and add noodles. Step 9: Let noodles brown on bottom, then turn noodle cake over.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, water, raw carrot, green pepper, baby corn, water chestnut, bamboo shoot, cooked rice, garlic paste, low sodium soy sauce, green onion, hoisin sauce, sugar, powdered ginger, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In about 2 inches of hot oil, saute the chicken for about 1-2 minutes until no longer pink Scoop the chicken out with a slotted strainer and set aside. Step 2: Pour the hot oil into a container. Step 3: Add the 1 / 2 cup water and heat to boiling Dump in all the vegetables at the same time and stir around for about 30 seconds. Step 4: Dip the vegetables out with a strainer. Step 5: Pour off any remaining water. Step 6: Put the sauce ingredients into the empty pan. Step 7: Heat and stir together well. Step 8: Add the chicken and vegetables back into the sauce and stir around until well coated.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cornstarch, boneless chicken breasts, ketchup, chicken broth, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic, green onions, dried red chilies, jalapeno, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the soy sauce, dark soy and cornstarch. Step 2: Whisk to blend well, and add the chicken to the sauce. Step 3: Toss to evenly coat the chicken and set aside for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 4: In a medium bowl, combine the ketchup, stock, chili garlic sauce and sugar. Step 5: Stir to combine and set aside until ready to use. Step 6: Place a wok over high heat and add the vegetable oil to the pan Swirl the wok to be sure to coat well with the oil. Step 7: Add the ginger, garlic, green onions, dried chilies and jalapenos to the wok. Step 8: Cook, stirring often until the garlic is fragrant and the chilies begin to brown, about 20 to 30 seconds. Step 9: Add the chicken, bell peppers and onions to the pan and stir-fry until the chicken is no longer pink, about 4 to 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, black pepper, scallion, peppercorn, fresh ginger, sugar, mandarin orange segments, mixed salad greens
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the seasonings together until the sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Pour over the chicken and allow to marinate for 2-4 hours or even overnight in the refridgerator. Step 3: When ready to serve, add salad greens and mandarin oranges that have been chilled and mix thoroughly. Step 4: Serve immediately on chilled plates.

Ingredient Names: sugar, soy sauce, chinese bean garlic sauce, green onion, fresh cilantro, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, oriental sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic, salt, five-spice powder, chicken thighs
Instructions: Step 1: 64 fl Oz Vegetable oil, for frying you will also need: 24 9" foil squares. Step 2: Combine first 12 ingredients in a large bowl and stir to blend. Step 3: Add the chicken and turn to coat. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Place 1 foil square on work surface with 1 corner pointing toward the edge. Step 6: Place 1 chicken piece in the center of the foil. Step 7: Drizzle with 1 teaspoon of marinade. Step 8: Fold the bottom corner of the foil over the chicken, and fold the sides inches.

Ingredient Names: fryer, oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, water, catsup, apple juice, garlic, green onion, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in dutch oven, brown chicken on all sides. Step 2: Mix soy sauce and next 6 ingredients, pour over chicken. Step 3: Cover, simmer 45 to 50 minutes. Step 4: Remove chicken to platter, draining juices back into pan Skim fat from sauce. Step 5: Mix cornstarch and water, stir into sauce. Step 6: Stir, constant, until thick. Step 7: Serve with chicken.

Ingredient Names: whole chickens, oil, water, soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, apple juice, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, green onion, cornstarch, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place the cut up chicken parts, or cut up breasts if using only white meat into a gallon sized bag. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine all remaining ingredients. Step 3: Pour the sauce mixture over the chicken Close and squeeze bag to coat all pieces of chicken well Lay flat and freeze To prepare: thaw in refrigerator overnight. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 5: Cook in 3 qt casserole dish for 45 - 60 minutes, depending on cuts of chicken you used. Step 6: Serve over rice with some steamed broccoli Leftovers can be frozen for a quick and easy lunch.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, iceberg lettuce, red pepper, green pepper, scallion, cilantro, bean sprouts, chicken breasts, olive oil, red pepper flakes, no-sugar-added peanut butter, sesame oil, sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Shred the cabbage and the lettuce. Step 2: Combine with all the remaining salad ingredients in a large bowl. Step 3: Combine all the ingredients for the salad dressing in the bowl of a food processor Pulse until evenly blended. Step 4: Toss the salad with the dressing.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, honey, roasted sesame seeds, fresh ginger, chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the soy sauce, honey, sesame seeds, and ginger well Baste the chicken breasts and broil or grill 5-8 minutes on each side, brushing frequently with sauce Alternately, cube the chicken and baste / marinate in the sauce, then fry in very hot oil and serve with vegetables over rice as a stir-fry.

Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, chicken stock, baby bok choy, carrot, salt, white pepper, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Add the wontons and cook for about 4 minutes, drain. Step 3: In a medium soup pot, bring the chicken stock to a boil. Step 4: Add the carrots and baby bok choy. Step 5: Cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the sesame oil, salt, white pepper, and cooked wontons. Step 7: Cook until they are heated through.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, water, chicken breast, cornstarch, soy sauce, chicken stock, watercress, green onion, sesame oil, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rice: this step is done the night before, or 1 hour before if the rice is to be dried in a microwave oven. Step 2: In a large saucepan or dutch oven combine rice and water over high heat. Step 3: Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to medium and cook 10 minutes then reduce heat to low and cook an additional 30 minutes without removing lid The crusty rice around the sides and bottom will stick to the pan and will be used in the soup. Step 4: Take off the top layer of soft rice and reserve for another use Lift out the crusty rice and place on a cookie sheet to dry at room temperature, or place in a glass baking dish in a microwave oven for 10 minutes on low The soup: toss the strips of chicken breast with 1 tablespoons of the cornstarch and set aside. Step 5: In a small container combine remaining 2 tablespoons cornstarch with water and soy sauce. Step 6: Heat chicken stock just to boiling then stir in soy mixture and chicken and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the shredded greens, onions and sesame oil, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, low sodium soy sauce, honey, blackberry jam, hoisin sauce, fresh ginger, red chili pepper flakes, garlic cloves, onion, cornstarch, green onions, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, honey, blackberry jam, hoisin sauce, fresh ginger, garlic, chopped onion and chili flakes. Step 2: Place chicken breasts in slow cooker and pour sauce on top. Step 3: Cook on low for 4-5 hours. Step 4: Remove chicken from slow cooker and shred, set aside. Step 5: In a small bowl, combine 3 tablespoons of water and cornstarch. Step 6: Place liquid from slow cooker into a saucepan and bring to a boil While stirring the liquid, add cornstarch mixture and stir until thickened, let boil 1 minute. Step 7: Pour sauce over shredded chicken and stir to combine. Step 8: Serve over rice with desired toppings.

Dish Name: Smoky Hot Chicken Stir Fried With Dried Red Chillies And Green G
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, cornstarch, wine, peanut oil, dried red chilies, ginger, brown sugar, light soy sauce, black vinegar, garlic chives
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken with cornflour and shao sing wine in a bowl. Step 2: Cover, place in refrigerator and leave to marinate for 1 hour. Step 3: Place 1st measure of oil and chillies in a cold wok and then turn heat to low. Step 4: Cook for about 1 minutes or until chillies begin to darken slightly. Step 5: Using a slotted spoon, immediately remove chillies and drain on kitchen paper Leaving chilli-infused oil in wok, turn heat up to high and stir-fry half the chicken cubes for 3 minutes. Step 6: Remove with a slotted spoon. Step 7: Add extra oil to wok with remaining chicken and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 8: Return all chicken to wok, along with ginger and reserved chillies, and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 9: Add sugar and stir-fry for 30 seconds.

Dish Name: South China Morning Post 1963 Authentic Chicken Satay Skewers
Ingredient Names: chicken piece, lemongrass, ground coriander, saffron, sugar, peanut oil, salt, fresh onions, roasted peanuts, red chili powder, tamarind pulp, water, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Satay sauce: Pour peanut oil into a cooking pot and heat the oil. Step 2: Add the onions and stir over the fire for about 10 minutes. Step 3: Then add the chillies and stir over the fire for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Now add the ground nuts and stir over the fire for 5 minutes. Step 5: Mix the tamarind with the two and half pints of water, stir well and then pour it into the cooking pot through a strainer. Step 6: Boil for 15 minutes stirring all the time, until the peanut oil rises to the surface. Step 7: Add salt, pepper and the sugar and simmer for a further 10 minutes, your satay sauce is now ready Chicken satay skewers: Cut chicken into 1 / 2" cubes.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, pork tenderloin, hot chili paste, sesame oil, soy sauce, cumin, garlic, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, peanuts, banana, black beans, frozen corn
Instructions: Step 1: Dice chicken breast into small bite-sized chunks. Step 2: Divide into two ziploc bags or bowls for marinating Dice the pork into similar size pieces, divide, and add to containers with chicken To one container of chicken and pork add: 1 teaspoon hot chili sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, and 1 tablespoon soy sauce Coat the chicken and pork pieces and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes In the other container of chicken and pork, add 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon cumin, 2 minced cloves of garlic, 1 tablespoon of cilantro, and diced jalapeno, if desired Coat the chicken and pork pieces and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes. Step 3: In a small or medium pan, mix 1 tablespoon of cornstarch with 1 tablespoon of water. Step 4: Stir in 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, peanuts, 1 teaspoon of chili paste, 1 teaspoon balsamic of vinegar, and 1 tablespoon of brown sugar, heat slowly.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, cornstarch, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, chicken wings, vegetable oil, green onions, chicken broth, sesame oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, sherry, sugar, two-thirds of the minced garlic, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl to create marinade. Step 2: Stir in wings and turn to coat. Step 3: Marinate overnight in the refrigerator, turning 2 or 3 times. Step 4: Heat vegetable oil in wok or large skillet over hight heat. Step 5: Drain chicken wings, reserving liquid. Step 6: Cook wings, in batches, 10 to 15 minutes until browned on all sides, turning occasionally. Step 7: Remove each batch and set aside. Step 8: Pour off any remaining oil. Step 9: Add remaining garlic and onions to wok or skillet and cook 30 seconds. Step 10: Add wings and chicken broth, cover and cook 5 minutes or until wings are tender, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

Dish Name: Soy Roast Duck with Hoisin Gravy
Ingredient Names: boneless duck breasts, soy sauce, five-spice powder, clear honey, chicken stock, hoisin sauce, ginger, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prick the duck's skin really well with a fork. Step 2: Mix the soy, 5 spice and honey in a large bowl, add the duck and coat well. Step 3: Cover and place in the fridge until ready to roast. Step 4: For the gravy, tip the stock into a pan, add the hoisin sauce and ginger and boil for a few minutes to make a smooth gravy. Step 5: Add the sesame oil and set aside. Step 6: Preheat the oven to 200*C (425*F). Step 7: Pour 1 litre of water in the base of a roasting tin and place a rack over the top. Step 8: (This keeps the fat from the duck dripping on to the tin and filling the kitchen full of smoke) Lift duck from marinade and arrange on rack, skin side up. Step 9: Roast for 20 minutes for medium, 30 minutes for well done. Step 10: Slice each duck breast in half. Step 11: Add any meat juices from the duck to the hoisin gravy and pour a spoonful or two over the duck.

Dish Name: Soy Sauce Chicken For The Birthday Girl
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chicken stock, cinnamon sticks, star anise, fresh ginger, sugar cane, mushroom soy sauce, shaoxing wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, place the stock, cinnamon, anise, ginger and sugar, and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add mushroom soy sauce and bring back to a boil. Step 3: Lower heat and allow to simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Turn heat back to high, add the wine, and return to a boil. Step 5: Lower chicken breasts into liquid, meat side down, and bring back to a boil. Step 6: Lower heat, cover and simmer for 12 minutes. Step 7: Turn chicken over and simmer for another 12 minutes. Step 8: Turn off heat, leave cover on, and allow chicken to rest in liquid for one hour. Step 9: Remove chicken from pot. Step 10: Remove skin and bones.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, light soy sauce, cooking oil, sesame seeds, salt, minced garlic clove, eggs, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken wings apart at the joint, and discard wing Measure the rest of the ingredients into a large container with a lid, mix well. Step 2: Add wings into the above marinade. Step 3: Make sure all pieces are coated with the marinade, then place lid over tightly. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Step 5: Turn bowl often as wings marinate. Step 6: Remove from marinade, discard marinade. Step 7: Arrange chicken on foiled lined tray.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, chinese wine, star anise, cinnamon stick, chicken breast fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Place the sesame oil, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, chinese wine, star anise and cinamon stick in a frying pan over a medium-low heat and bring to a simmer. Step 2: Add the chicken and cook for 6-7 minutes each side or until cooked through. Step 3: Serve on plates with the sauce from the pan, with steamed greens and rice.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken breasts, salt, egg white, cornstarch, oil, roasted peanuts, dried hot chili peppers, scallions, garlic cloves, chili paste with garlic, dark soy sauce, sherry wine, sugar, red wine vinegar, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, salt, egg white, and cornstarch, mix well by hand. Step 2: Set aside In small bowl, blend sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil to 350 in a wok Deep fry chicken until it seperates and is almost cooked. Step 4: Remove by draining through strainer into another pot Reheat same oil Deep fry peanutsover moderate heat until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic, green onions, eggplant, zucchini, yellow onion, olive oil, soba noodles, soy sauce, rice wine, orange, chili-garlic sauce, ginger, thai seasoning, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients for marinade Reserve about 1 / 4 of mixture in separate container. Step 2: Add chicken and let sit for at least an hour. Step 3: Put pan or wok over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add fire oil / olive oil combo until sizzling. Step 5: Add green onions and garlic. Step 6: Add chicken mixture and simmer until chicken is no longer pink. Step 7: Add eggplant, zucchini and onion. Step 8: Add reserved marinade as necessary. Step 9: Simmer for about 10 minutes, until vegetables are crisp-tender.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, chinese rice wine, soy sauce, white pepper, low sodium chicken broth, dark soy sauce, brown sugar, cooking oil, dried red chilies, ginger, green onions, cinnamon stick, szechuan peppercorns, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Remove. Step 2: Cut wings apart at joint. Step 3: Combine the 2 tbs rice wine, 1 tbs soy sauce, and white pepper in a bowl or ziplock bag. Step 4: Mix well then add chicken wings to coat. Step 5: Let marinate for at least 15 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, combine broth, dark soy sauce, remaining rice wine, and brown sugar in a small bowl to make sauce. Step 7: Place wok over high heat until hot. Step 8: Add oil and chilies, swirling to coat sides of wok. Step 9: Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 3-4 minutes. Step 10: Add ginger, green onions, cinnamon stick, and peppercorns.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, chicken thighs, black bean garlic sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce, chili oil, toasted sesame seeds, garlic cloves, scallion, gingerroot, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingridients except for chicken in a large bowl and mix together. Step 2: Dip the chicken in and thoroughly coat each side. Step 3: Place chicken in baking dish and pour the remaining sauce on top of the chicken For maximum flavor, marinate for 2-3 hours at room temperature If you are in a rush, you may skip this step. Step 4: Bake at 375 degrees farenheit for 45 minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, green pepper, red pepper, orange, orange juice, thai sweet chili sauce, sherry wine, sugar, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the peppers, remove the ribs and seeds, and cut into strips. Step 2: Using vegetable peeler, remove the rind from the orange. Step 3: Cut the rind into very thin julienne strips about 3 inches long. Step 4: Squeeze the orange. Step 5: Add more frozen juice if necessary to make 3 / 4 cup. Step 6: In a bowl, combine orange juice, chili sauce, sherry, sugar, and cornstarch. Step 7: Stir until smooth In wok, heat oil over high heat and stir-fry chicken until browned and cooked through, remove chicken. Step 8: Add orange rind, garlic and ginger and stir-fry until aromatic.

Dish Name: Spicy Peanut Chicken Ramen Dinner Cole Slaw
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, toasted sesame oil, chunky peanut butter, plain yogurt, mayonnaise, garlic cloves, dried onion flakes, cider vinegar, soy sauce, lemon juice, dried ancho chile powder, cayenne, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the chicken pieces in olive and sesame oils until browned. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: In a very large bowl, stir together the dressing ingredients well. Step 4: Add the browned chicken and coleslaw mix or shredded cabbage to the dressing and toss well to coat. Step 5: Set aside Into a bowl, break up the ramen noodles into smaller pieces. Step 6: In a saucepan, heat the amount of water according to package directions to a brisk boil and add the seasoning packets. Step 7: Add the bowl of noodles all at once to the boiling seasoned water and cook, stirring occasionally, for 90 seconds. Step 8: When noodles have cooked for 90 seconds, remove from heat and immediately drain. Step 9: Add the semi-cooked drained ramen noodles to the coleslaw and toss again to combine well.

Dish Name: Spicy Stir Fried Chicken In Hoisin Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, vegetable oil, scallion, stir fry vegetables, whole mushroom, fresh ginger, garlic, green bell peppers, hoisin sauce, fresh ground black pepper, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, combine soy sauce, sherry and cornstarch. Step 2: Add the chicken and toss until coated. Step 3: Let chicken stand in marinade for at least 10 minutes. Step 4: In a sprayed+oiled wok or saute pan, heat the vegetable oil over high heat until just smoking. Step 5: Add the scallions and ginger, and stir-fry for about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the chicken, reserving any remaining marinade, and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, until the chicken is just done. Step 7: Add the vegetables+mushrooms, green peppers and stir-fry for another minute. Step 8: Add the hoisin sauce, sherry, salt and black pepper, and combine. Step 9: Add sesame oil to the marinade remaining in the bowl, stir it, and add to the wok. Step 10: Toss to blend well and boil, then simmer until slightly thickened.

Dish Name: Spicy Stir Fried Chicken With Greens And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry sherry, sesame oil, golden brown sugar, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, peanut oil, green onions, serrano chilies, greens, salted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sherry, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon sugar in medium bowl. Step 2: Add chicken Marinade 20 to 30 minutes. Step 3: Whisk remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sherry, 2 teaspoons sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon sugar in small bowl and reserve. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 5: Add white parts of onions and chiles, stir 30 seconds, add chicken. Step 6: Stir-fry just until cooked through, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Transfer chicken mixture to bowl.

Dish Name: Spicy Sweet Chicken Marinated With Soy Sauce
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic clove, scallion, whole chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together soy sauce and sugar until sugar dissolves. Step 2: Add sesame oil, garlic, and scallion. Step 3: Stir well Poke several holes in each chicken breast so they can soak up the marinade. Step 4: Place marinade and chicken in large plastic baggie, remove air, and shake to coat chicken in marinade. Step 5: Refrigerate 3 1 / 2 hours, turning the bag about every half hour to redistribute the marinade. Step 6: Prepare an indirect fire on a charcoal or gas grill. Step 7: Grill chicken, turning about every 5 minutes, until cooked through Cooking times will vary depending on your cooking conditions It took me about 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mixed green vegetable, sunflower oil, skinless chicken breasts, red chili desseded, stir-fry oyster sauce, soy sauce, cashews, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil, cook the green vegetables for 2 mins only, then drain. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan or wok, then fry the chicken slices for 4 mins until almost cooked. Add the drained green veg, chilli, stir-fry sauce and soy sauce. Stir-fry briefly to heat everything through and to finish cooking the chicken. Mix in the cashews and spring onions, then serve.

Dish Name: St Louis Noodle Parlor Chop Suey
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, peanut oil, bean sprouts, bamboo shoot, sliced mushrooms, onion, celery, water, cornstarch, soy sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In wok or non-stick skillet heat oil and stir-fry chicken until done. Step 2: Add sprouts and stir then add bamboo shoots, mushrooms, onion and celery, stir thoroughly. Step 3: Add 1 cup of the water or broth. Step 4: Cover and let simmer for about 5 mins or until celery is crisp tender Dissolve cornstarch in the 1 / 2 cup water and add to chicken mixture, stirring until mixture thickens. Step 5: Season to taste with soy sauce and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, tomatoes, red chilies, ginger, spring onion, ginger juice, rice wine, light soya sauce, fine sugar, cornflour, sesame oil, garlic oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, mix ginger juice, wine, light soya sauce, fine sugar, cornflour, sesame oil and garlic. Step 2: Marinate the chicken in seasoning for at least 5 minutes. Step 3: Put chicken in a shallow dish and add tomatoes, chillies, ginger and spring onions. Step 4: Steam for 12-15 minutes or until chicken is tender, serve hot.

Dish Name: Steamed Chicken With Sausage And Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, shoyu, cornstarch, sherry wine, sugar, kosher salt, lemon pepper, garlic cloves, ginger juice, shiitake mushrooms, chinese sausage
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix shoyu with cornstarch, sherry, sugar, salt, pepper, garlic, and ginger juice, and marinate chicken pieces in mixture for 20-30 minutes. Step 3: Remove stems from mushrooms, slice caps. Step 4: Stir mushrooms and sausage in with chicken. Step 5: Put mixture in a steamer basket. Step 6: In a wok, steam on rack over boiling water for 25 minutes with lid on, or place in a 9-inch glass pie plate and cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 13-16 minutes, serve hot.

Dish Name: Steamed Chicken Zheng Ji With Ginger Scallion Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: roasting chickens, kosher salt, sugar, salt, light soy sauce, gingerroot, garlic cloves, scallions, peanut oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the chicken in cold, running water, and blot dry completely with paper towels Rub the salt all over the skin of the chicken and inside the cavity. Step 2: Place the chicken, breast-side down, on a heat proof platter, and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 3: Set up your steamer, or place a rack inside a wok or other deep pan. Step 4: Fill with about 2 inches of hot water. Step 5: Cover tightly and gently steam over medium heat for 1 hour, replenishing the water from time to time. Step 6: Remove the platter of cooked chicken and pour off all of the liquid. Step 7: In a small bowl, combine the sugar, salt, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and scallions. Step 8: In a small pan, combine the oils and heat until they smoke. Step 9: Pour the hot oils over the ginger-scallion mixture.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, red chilies, ginger, water, soya sauce, white wine vinegar, sugar, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place chilli, ginger, water, soya sauce, vinegar and sugar in a deep frying pan, and simmer over medium heat. Step 2: Allow to simmer for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken wings and cook covered for 35 minutes, turning occasionally. Step 4: Remove lid from pan and continue cooking for 25 minutes, turning the chicken pieces till it is cooked and well coated in the chilli sauce. Step 5: Stir through the coriander leaves and serve with steamed rice and greens.

Ingredient Names: onion and garlic croutons, cornstarch, light soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken breasts, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, whisk crouton crumbs with cornstarch, stir in soy sauce. Step 2: Add chicken and toss until completely coated. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add chicken and cook, covered for 20 - 25 minutes or until nice and crispy and cooked through. Step 6: Turn about 4 or 5 times to avoid burning. Step 7: Drain on paper towels and serve hot with rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken parts, red onion, dried chinese mushrooms, soy sauce, chicken bouillon cube, water, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: First, soak the mushrooms for 10 minutes in boiling hot water, slice. Step 2: In a hot wok, add oil and fry the onions till golden brown. Step 3: Add chicken pieces, fry till golden brown as well over high heat, constantly stir-frying to Prevent overcooking the chicken. Step 4: Once the chicken is browned, add the chicken stock, one cup of water, cover, bring to a boil. Step 5: Lower heat when it starts bubbling. Step 6: Let simmer for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, fresh broccoli, cornstarch, soy sauce, dry sherry, water, sesame oil, oil, salt, garlic, green onions, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare ahead: Slice chicken across the grain into pieces 1 / 8 inch thick. Step 2: Toss chicken and marinade in a bowl, mix well. Step 3: Let stand 30 minutes. Step 4: Wash and drain broccoli and cut into bite size pieces. Step 5: Mix ingredients for thickening sauce in a small bowl To cook: heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or frying pan over high heat. Step 6: Add broccoli and salt and stir fry for 4 minutes. Step 7: Transfer to a plate.

Ingredient Names: oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, bok choy, mushroom, onion, green pepper, carrot, shrimp, chicken stock, dry sherry, cornstarch, soy sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In wok, heat oil over high heat. Step 2: Add chicken and stir fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 3: Add bok choy, mushrooms, onion, green pepper and carrot and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in shrimp, stock and sherry and cover and cook until shrimp are just pink, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Blend cornstarch with soy sauce and pour into wok. Step 6: Cook, stirring until thick, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Chicken Black Mushrooms Bamboo Shoots And Spinach
Ingredient Names: shiitake mushrooms, fresh spinach, peanut oil, garlic cloves, salt, chicken breasts, cornstarch, stock, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, white wine, sugar, red wine vinegar, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation "a": place the shitake / black mushrooms in a bowl and fill to the top with medium-hot water Use a dish to cover in order to keep the mushrooms submerged in the water. Step 2: Soak for 30 minutes Next drain and squeeze excess water from mushrooms. Step 3: Then cut away the stem and cut each mushroom in half. Step 4: Set aside Preparation "b": place chicken pieces in a bowl, add 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 2 teaspoons soy sauce, 2 teaspoons red vinegar and 1 tablespoon oilstir. Step 5: Set aside Preparation "c": in a cup add 1 / 3 stock, 1 tablespoon light soy sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, 2 tablespoons oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon wine, 1 / 4 teaspoon sugarstir, set aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cornstarch, cooking sherry, onion, gingerroot, garlic clove, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, chicken broth, roasted cashews, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine cubed chicken, one tablespoon of cornstarch, and two tablespoons of sherry, mix thoroughly. Step 2: Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, broth, and remaining 1 5 tbs sherry, set aside. Step 3: Heat 2 tbs vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet. Step 4: Add chicken and stir fry until lightly browned. Step 5: Remove chicken from pan. Step 6: Add the rest of the oil to pan. Step 7: Stir fry the onions, garlic, and ginger root.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Chicken With Honey And Ginger
Ingredient Names: chicken thigh fillets, vegetable oil, light soy sauce, honey, shaoxing wine, gingerroot, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, five-spice powder, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken with marinade ingredients in a large bowl and leave to marinade in the refrigerator overnight. Step 2: Heat the oil in a hot wok until surface seems to shimmer slightly. Step 3: Add half the marinated chicken with the marinade and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Remove from wok and set aside. Step 5: Add remaining chicken and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Return reserve chicken to the wok with the soy sauce and stir-fry for a further 2 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through and slightly caramelised. Step 7: Serve with steamed rice.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Chicken With Mango And Peppers
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, soy sauce, salt, pepper, cornstarch, cider vinegar, ketchup, sugar, water, star anise, canola oil, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, ginger, fresh garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Put the raw chicken in and let it sit for half an hour. Step 3: Mix the sauce ingredients in another bowl and put aside Break off the star arms of the anise and throw away the middle Carefully press between your fingers until you hear a crack. Step 4: In a non-stick frying pan or a wok, heat the oil and the star anise on high heat. Step 5: Put in the chicken and stir-fry for about 4 or 5 minutes, until the chicken is opaque. Step 6: Put in the pepper slices, ginger, garlic and shallots and stir-fry for another minute. Step 7: Put in the sauce ingredients and stir to mix until it thickens a bit It should take about another minute.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, dry white wine, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, sugar, boneless skinless chicken thighs, garlic, fresh ginger, snow pea pods, onion, hoisin sauce, ketchup, toasted sesame oil, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl mix together the cornstarch, white wine, soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and sugar. Step 2: Cut the chicken into 1 1 / 2 by 1 / 2 inch pieces. Step 3: Toss in the soy sauce mixture. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for 20 to 30 minutes On a small plate place the minced garlic and the fresh ginger. Step 5: In a small bowl, thoroughly mix together the hoisin sauce, ketchup, toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes Have ready the chicken stock and scallions. Step 6: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat until hot. Step 7: Add the peanut oil Swirl the oil around the pan until very hot but not smoking.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg white, cornflour, peanut oil, chicken stock, lemon juice, sugar, rice wine, soy sauce, garlic, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the egg white with the corn flour, combine with the chicken, cover and put in the fridge for about 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok until moderately hot and stir-fry the chicken for about one minute until they have turned white. Step 3: Drain the chicken in a sieve or colander, discard the oil and wipe the wok clean Reheat the wok, add all the sauce ingredients, except the corn flour mix, and bring it to the boil, then add the corn flour mix and simmer for one minute. Step 4: Return the chicken strips to the wok and continue to stir-fry them for a few minutes until done and coated with the sauce Do a last taste check for soy, sugar and lemon juice.

Dish Name: Stir Fry Sweet Sour Pork Or Chicken Or Shrimp
Ingredient Names: water, white vinegar, fresh orange juice, honey, lemon juice, ketchup, cornstarch, peanut oil, garlic cloves, green onions, pork tenderloin, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, baby carrots, yellow onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Heat the wok over high heat. Step 3: Add oil swirl to coat. Step 4: Add garlic and green onions, stir fry 1 / 2 minute. Step 5: Add pork or chicken, stir fry 3 minutes or 'til is opaque If doing shrimp, stir fry 2 minutes, 'til pink. Step 6: Remove and set aside. Step 7: Keep warm Quickly wipe the wok, reheat. Step 8: Add oil, swirl to coat.

Ingredient Names: dried apricots, white wine, portabella mushrooms, chicken breasts, garlic cloves, garlic salt, mashed potatoes, milk, butter, extra virgin olive oil, celery, scallions, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Soak apricots overnite in wine Wipe outside of mushrooms gently with damp cloth Chicken. Step 2: Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry Use microwave stamer or stovetop steamer. Step 3: Put 6 cloves smashed garlic in water. Step 4: Place chicken in steamer portion. Step 5: Sprinkle with garlic salt. Step 6: Cover and cook until juices are clear. Step 7: When done and cooled a little put thru food processor or chopper until finely chopped.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, water, sugar, sesame oil, green onions, garlic cloves, sesame seeds, ground black pepper, ground cayenne pepper, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: In a large food storage bag, combine soy sauce, water, sugar, sesame oil, green onions, garlic, sesame seeds, and peppers, add chicken wings. Step 2: Turn bag to coat well Seal and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight, turning occasionally I've often marinate them for 2 days for that extra flavor. Step 3: Remove chicken to a shallow rack in baking dish or roasting pan. Step 4: Discard the marinade. Step 5: Bake wings, uncovered, at 350 for 30 minutes. Step 6: Turn wings and bake 25 minutes longer, or until tender At first i thought 55 minutes baking time would be too long, but they turn out tender and moist.

Ingredient Names: cooked white rice, onion, egg, oil, bean sprouts, roast pork, low sodium soy sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the onion in oil in a wok for one minute over medium-high heat Add the remaining ingredients and toss constantly until hot.

Dish Name: Super Simple Sweet And Sour Chicken With Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sweet and sour sauce, pineapple tidbits, bell pepper, onion, chicken broth, uncooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place uncooked rice in 9 x 13 glass baking dish. Step 2: Top with uncooked chicken breasts. Step 3: Drain juice from pineapple into a bowl. Step 4: Add the sweet and sour sauce and chicken broth. Step 5: Mix to lightly to blend Scatter peppers, onions and pineapple chunks over the chicken. Step 6: Pour sweet and sour mixture over all. Step 7: Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Step 8: Remove foil in last 15 minutes of cooking.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Chicken And Broccoli
Ingredient Names: bacon, chicken breast, broccoli, onion, garlic cloves, hoisin sauce, cider vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, garlic powder, ginger powder, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together all of the sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 2: In a large wok or skillet, over medium-high heat, brown the bacon and then remove from the pan. Step 3: Add the rest of the stir fry ingredients to the pan and stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add then sauce and stir fry for about 2-3 minutes Crumble in the bacon. Step 5: Serve with white or fried rice, or just as it is Enjoy!

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Chicken Low Fat And Volumetric
Ingredient Names: oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, bell peppers, onion, vinegar, salt, orange juice, pineapple juice, tomato paste, cornstarch, splenda sugar substitute, pineapple chunk
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non-stick pan or wok. Step 2: Cook chicken until no longer pink. Step 3: Remove chicken, saving the liquid in the pan. Step 4: Add the peppers and onions to the liquid in the pan and heat until cooked I like my peppers and onions crunchy, so i don't overcook. Step 5: Once cooked, drain and set aside While chicken and peppers are cooking, prepare the sauce To make sauce: place vinegar, salt, juices and tomato paste in a pot. Step 6: Heat on medium and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Combine cornstarch with a small amount of water.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, boneless chicken, medium shrimp, salt, white sugar, soy sauce, egg whites, green onions, vegetable oil, cornstarch, celery, green bell peppers, onions, sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place cubed pork, cubed chicken and shrimp in a large bowl, and season with salt, sugar, and soy sauce. Step 2: Mix in the egg white and green onions. Step 3: Cover, and place in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Step 4: Heat oil to 365f in a large, heavy saucepan or deep fryer Coat the pork with cornstarch, and fry in the heated oil about 10 minutes, until evenly browned. Step 5: Drain on paper towels. Step 6: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat. Step 7: Stir in the celery, green bell pepper, and onion, and cook until tender. Step 8: Season with salt and sugar. Step 9: Remove from heat, and set aside.

Ingredient Names: bell pepper, ginger, green onions, pineapple chunks in juice, boneless chicken breast, oil, chicken-flavored ramen noodles, sweet and sour sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the pineapple juice into a measuring cup and add enough water to measure 2 cups, set aside. Step 2: Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with ginger. Step 3: Heat a bit of oil and stir fry the chicken for 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Add the pineapple juice and bring to a boil Break the noodles into pieces and add to the skillet with the seasoning packets. Step 5: Bring back to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer for 3 minutes until the noodles are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Step 6: Add the sweet and sour sauce, pepper, onion, and pineapple. Step 7: Cook until the peppers are tender-crisp.

Ingredient Names: sweet red pepper, onion, vegetable oil, pineapple chunks in juice, white vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, cornstarch, popcorn chicken
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or wok, heat oil. Step 2: Stir-fry pepper and onion for 3-4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Step 3: Drain pineapple, reserving juice in a 2-cup measuring cup. Step 4: Set pineapple aside. Step 5: Add enough water to the juice to make 1 1 / 3 cups. Step 6: Stir in the vinegar, soy sauce and ketchup. Step 7: In a bowl, combine brown sugar and cornstarch. Step 8: Stir in pineapple juice mixture and mix until smooth Gradually add to skillet, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: ketchup, low sodium soy sauce, salt, worcestershire sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cayenne pepper, chicken broth, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breasts, oil, fresh ginger, garlic, onion, bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Step 2: In a large plastic resealable baggie, combine cornstarch, sugar and salt. Step 3: Add chicken chunks, seal baggie and shake to coat chicken in cornstarch mixture. Step 4: Heat wok or large frying pan on high and add oil. Step 5: Heat to hot, but not smoking. Step 6: Add chicken pieces, garlic, ginger and onion, stirring until chicken is lightly cooked on the outside. Step 7: Add bell pepper, mushrooms, and carrots. Step 8: Stir 2-3 minutes until softened. Step 9: Add snow peas and sauce, cooking until sauce comes to a boil. Step 10: Add cashews and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, large egg white, kosher salt, cornstarch, pineapple chunks, pineapple juice, white vinegar, tomato ketchup, brown sugar, oil, red pepper, yellow pepper, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Coat the chicken with egg white: In a bowl, combine the chicken with the egg white, kosher salt, and cornstarch. Step 2: Stir to coat the chicken evenly. Step 3: Let sit for at room temperature or up to overnight in the refrigerator. Step 4: Make the sweet and sour sauce: Whisk together the pineapple juice, vinegar, ketchup, kosher salt, and brown sugar. Step 5: Stir-fry the chicken over high heat: Heat a large frying pan or wok over high heat until a bead of water instantly sizzles and evaporates. Step 6: Pour in cooking oil and swirl to coat. Step 7: It's important that the pan is very hot. Step 8: Add the chicken and spread the pieces out in one layer. Step 9: Let the chicken fry untouched for 3-4 minutes, until the bottoms are browned. Step 10: Flip and fry the other side for 3-4 minutes. Step 11: The chicken should still be pinkish in the middle. Step 12: Dish out the chicken onto a clean plate, leaving as much oil in the pan as possible. Step 13: Stir-fry the bell pepper and ginger: Reduce the heat to medium and add the remaining cooking oil. Step 14: Let the oil heat up before adding the bell pepper chunks and ginger. Step 15: Fry for 3-4 minutes. Step 16: Add the pineapple, sauce, and then, the chicken: Add the pineapple chunks and the sweet and sour sauce. Step 17: Turn up the heat to high. Step 18: When the sauce is simmering, add the chicken pieces back in. Step 19: Let simmer for 1 to, until the chicken is cooked through. Step 20: Timing depends on how thick you've cut your chicken. Step 21: The best way to tell if the chicken is done is to take a piece out and cut into it. Step 22: If it's pink, add another minute to the cooking. Step 23: Adjust the seasoning and serve: Taste the sauce and add more brown sugar or vinegar to suit your tastes, if you’d like. Step 24: Serve hot with steamed white or brown rice.

Ingredient Names: onion, celery rib, garlic clove, vegetable oil, carrot, fresh gingerroot, hot red pepper flakes, chicken broth, soy sauce, creamy peanut butter, sugar, sesame oil, milk, heavy cream, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy saucepan cook onion, celery, and garlic in oil over moderately low heat, stirring, until onion is softened. Step 2: Add carrots, ginger root, red pepper flakes, and broth and simmer, covered, until carrots are very tender, about 45 minutes. Step 3: Stir in remaining ingredients and, in a blender or food processor, puree mixture in batches. Step 4: Return soup to pan and heat over low heat until hot, being careful not to let boil. Step 5: Serve soup drizzled decoratively with sour cream mixture.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast half, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, fresh ginger, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, vegetable oil, green onions, green pepper, red pepper, dry-roasted unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: With knife held in slanting position, almost parallel to cutting surface, cut each chicken breast half crosswise into 1 / 2-inch thick slices In medium bowl, combine soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, ginger, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Step 2: Add chicken, tossing to coat In wok or large non-stick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat until very hot. Step 3: Add green onions and red and green peppers and cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes With slotted spoon transfer vegetables to bowl Increase heat to high and add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to skillet. Step 4: Heat until very hot. Step 5: Add chicken mixture and stir-fry until chicken looses its pink color throughout, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 6: Return vegetables to pan.

Dish Name: Szechuan Chicken Or Tofu In Lettuce Bundles Solo Cooking
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, green peppers, celery, gingerroot, garlic clove, sugar, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, red pepper flakes, bean sprouts, unsalted dry roasted peanuts, green onion, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Chefs comment: the cooking for this stir-fry moves rather quickly so have your ingredients prepared and ready before you begin cooking. Step 2: Place a large nonstick skillet over high heat for two minutes. Step 3: Add the oil and swirl oil to coat the pan. Step 4: Add the chicken, peppers, celery and ginger to the pan and cook for three minutes until the chicken is opaque. Step 5: Stir the garlic and sugar / splenda into the pan. Step 6: Add the soy sauce, vinegar, red pepper flakes and cook an additional minute. Step 7: Toss in the scallions and peanuts. Step 8: Take pan off the heating element. Step 9: Place half of the stir fry into the cup of each lettuce leaf Tuck in the sides of the lettuce leaves so it looks a bit like an open envelope.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg, cornstarch, salt and pepper, dried chili, dried hot red chilies, spring onion, garlic, cashew nuts, sake, sherry wine, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the chicken breast into inch pieces, dip each piece in egg white, then in cornstarch mixed with a pinch of salt. Step 2: Fry the chicken pieces in a wok with heated oil until golden brown. Step 3: Drain the fried pieces of chicken and set aside. Step 4: Fry the cashew nuts in moderately-hot oil until lightly brown and crunchy Canned or packed cashew nuts will do. Step 5: Slice the long dried peppers into small circumferential pieces, and chop the hot red peppers into finer pieces. Step 6: In a separate small bowl, mix the soy sauce, salt, sugar, vinegar, and sesame oil. Step 7: Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a wok, add the chopped garlic, all of the sliced red peppers, the spring onions ~stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the chicken and the cashew nuts.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg white, cornstarch, dry sherry, sesame oil, sugar, water, soy sauce, cooking oil, dried hot peppers, garlic, gingerroot, dry roasted peanuts, frozen pea pods, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces. Step 2: Combine egg white, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, sherry, sesame oil If desired, and sugar. Step 3: Add to chicken pieces Work the cornstarch mixture into the chicken using your hands, set aside. Step 4: Combine cold water, soy sauce, and 1 teaspoon cornstarch in a small bowl, set aside. Step 5: Heat wok or large skillet over high heat, add cooking oil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, cornstarch, salt, five-spice powder, chicken stock, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, chinese wine, black pepper, water, oil, dried red chilies, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meat into bite-size pieces. Step 2: Mix cornstarch, salt, and five spice powder, and toss chicken pieces to dust. Step 3: Mix stock, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, vineger, wine, five spice powder, and pepper together. Step 4: Mix cornstarch and cold water, heat oil very hot. Step 5: Add 1 / 3 of the chicken pieces, and fry on high heat to brown all over. Step 6: Repeat until all chicken is cooked, draining each batch on absorbent paper. Step 7: Pour off all but 2 tbs Of oil. Step 8: Add chiles, garlic, and ginger, and stir fry until garlic is golden.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, carrot, french beans, green capsicum, spring onions, chicken, small shrimp, soya sauce, celery, chili sauce, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, ajinomoto, salt, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Put a tsp of oil in a vessel. Step 2: Fry the onion till transparent. Step 3: Add carrots, beans, capsicum, celery, spring onion and mushrooms, if desired. Step 4: Cook for a few minutes until they begin to turn brown. Step 5: Transfer to another vessel. Step 6: Now, fry the chicken and prawns. Step 7: Pour a little oil in the vessel. Step 8: Add chopped garlic. Step 9: When it turns brown, remove it and keep aside. Step 10: Once the oil is flavoured with garlic, put the rice in the same vessel of oil.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil, cornstarch, chicken broth, garlic, sliced water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, salt, sugar, soy sauce, water, sesame oil, dry sherry, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Chop chicken breasts into 2-inch square pieces. Step 2: Mix marinade ingredients in a medium bowl, add chicken, mix well. Step 3: Let stand 20 minutes. Step 4: Heat vegetable in wok over medium heat 1 minutes. Step 5: Add chicken pieces. Step 6: Stir-fry until chicken is almost cooked, 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Remove chicken, draining well over wok, set aside.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, egg white, cornstarch, vegetable oil, unsalted peanuts, scallions, dry sherry, hoisin sauce, black bean sauce, chili paste, vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the cubed chicken with the egg white and cornstarch. Step 2: Refrigerate for 1 / 2 hour. Step 3: Heat oil in wok and stir-fry chicken 3 to 4 minutes, until done. Step 4: Add nuts, scallions, and remaining ingredients. Step 5: Heat thoroughly and serve at once with rice.

Ingredient Names: thin spaghetti, sesame oil, red bell peppers, green onions, garlic, fresh spinach, cooked chicken, sliced water chestnuts, soy sauce, rice vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Step 2: Drain, rinse with cold water, drain again. Step 3: Put spaghetti in a large bowl, set aside. Step 4: In a big skillet, heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil. Step 5: Add red pepper strips, green onions, and garlic. Step 6: Saute and stir occasionally for 2 minutes, stir in spinach. Step 7: Cover and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until spinach is wilted. Step 8: Remove skillet from heat and let cool.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, sugar, fresh gingerroot, garlic, hot chili flakes, boneless skinless chicken breast, vegetable oil, cooked rice, green onion, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To make blood orange sauce, mix all sauce ingredients in a 10-12" nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 2: Bring to boil and boil until reduced to 1 cup, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Stir often to prevent burning May be made up to 2 days in advance Use either hot or cold. Step 4: Meanwhile, rinse chicken and pat dry. Step 5: Cut into 1 / 2 inch chunks. Step 6: In a 12" nonstick skillet or 5-6 qt nonstick pan, heat oil over high heat. Step 7: Add chicken and stir-fry until lightly browned and cooked through, about 4-5 minutes. Step 8: Add blood orange sauce and stir until it comes to a boil, about 1-2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: szechuan peppercorns, scallions, fresh ginger, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, chicken stock, red wine vinegar, sugar, iceberg lettuce, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Remove seeds from peppercorns, discard seeds and crush the peppercorns. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients. Step 3: Place lettuce on a serving plate and arrange the chicken on it& pour over the sauce.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, scallions, sesame oil, sesame seeds, red wine vinegar, soy sauce, chicken stock, szechuan peppercorns, hot chili oil, bean sprouts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the sauce ingredients to gether in a bowl Arrange warm chicken and hot sprouts on a platter and pour the sauce over.

Ingredient Names: egg white, cornflour, chicken breast fillets, peanut oil, sesame seeds, dark soy sauce, cider vinegar, chili sauce, sesame oil, sugar, rice wine, szechuan peppercorns, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the egg white with the cornflour, pour into a shallow dish and add the chicken strips. Step 2: Turn to coat, cover with clingfilm and leave in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Step 3: Heat a wok, add the peanut oil and when hot, add the chicken pieces and stirfry for 2 minutes or until the chicken turns white. Step 4: Remove chicken with slotted spoon and drain on absorbent paper. Step 5: Pour off the oil and reserve 1 tablespoon of oil Wipe wok clean Reheat wok, add 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil with the sesame seeds and stirfry for 30 seconds, or until golden. Step 6: Stir in the dark soy sauce, cider vinegar, chili sauce, sesame oil, sugar, chinese rice wine, szechuan peppercorns and the spring onions, bring to boil. Step 7: Return chicken to wok and stir-fry for 2 minutes, making sure the chicken is coated evenly with the sauce and sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, onion, green onions, dried chilies, szechwan pepper, fresh ginger, tangerine juice, dark soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, chili paste with garlic, vegetable oil, tangerine peel, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken and cornstarch, set aside. Step 2: Combine onions in small bowl. Step 3: Combine chili peppers, peppercorns and ginger in another bowl. Step 4: Combine juice, soy sauce, hoisin, sugar and chili paste and mix well. Step 5: Set all 3 bowls aside. Step 6: Heat oil in wok to 225f. Step 7: Add chicken and cook until it loses pink color. Step 8: Remove chicken and drain. Step 9: Pour out all but 1 tablespoon of oil.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, sweet peppers, celery ribs, chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, hot sauce, ground ginger, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick skillet or wok, heat oil over high heat. Step 2: Add chicken and stir-fry for 8 minutes. Step 3: Remove to a plate and reserve. Step 4: Add peppers and celery to skillet and stir fry for 5 minutes. Step 5: In a medium size bowl, whisk together chicken broth and cornstarch. Step 6: Add soy sauce, hoisin sauce, hot sauce and ground ginger. Step 7: Whisk until combined. Step 8: Add chicken back to skillet. Step 9: Stir in broth mixture, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic cloves, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, rice wine, chinese five spice powder, sesame oil, potato starch, vegetable oil, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken to 1 inch cubes. Step 2: Add the garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, five spice, and sesame oil, marinate for at least half an hour in refrigerator. Step 3: Roll the chicken pieces in the sweet potato starch to cover evenly. Step 4: Heat oil to about 350 degrees fahrenheit Carefully drop the chicken one piece at a time and fry for about 2 minutes or until done, turning at least once. Step 5: Remove from oil and place on paper towels, sprinkle white pepper and salt while hot, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chicken thighs, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, dry sherry, soy sauce, water, white sugar, basil leaves, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chicken pieces, and cook until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove chicken from skillet and set aside. Step 4: Heat sesame oil in skillet, then add ginger and garlic. Step 5: Cook and stir until the ginger begins to brown, about 30 seconds. Step 6: Stir in the reserved chicken, sherry, soy sauce, water, and sugar. Step 7: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until there is only 1 / 4 cup of liquid left in the skillet, about 20 minutes. Step 8: Stir in the basil and chiles, and increase heat to medium Continue cooking until the liquid is almost gone.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, fish sauce, sugar, blocks egg noodles, sunflower oil, red peppers, garlic, green onions, leftover roast chicken, ground coriander, chili powder, peas, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cornflour with the fish sauce and sugar, then gradually add 8 tbsp water until smooth. Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 4 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok, then stir-fry the pepper, garlic and spring onions for about 3 mins. Tip in the chicken, spices and peas, stir-fry for a couple of secs more, then pour in the fish sauce and flour mix. Stir until thickened, then toss in the drained noodles and basil or coriander.

Ingredient Names: salt, szechuan peppercorns, chicken, black tea leaves, brown sugar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the salt and peppercorns together in a skillet over a low flame until it starts to smoke. Step 2: Let cool and grind in a mortar and pestle Rub the mixture all over the chicken, inside and out. Step 3: Refrigerate overnight. Step 4: Steam the chicken in a large pot for about 45 minutes, until juices run clear when thigh is pricked I use one of those collapsible steamer inserts in a soup pot Do save the resulting broth, it's quite flavorful. Step 5: Line a wok and its lid with heavy-duty foil. Step 6: Combine the tea and sugar in the bottom of the wok and place a rack over the mixture. Step 7: Heat the wok until the mixture begins to smoke.

Dish Name: Ten Variety Fried Noodles Chow Mein
Ingredient Names: pork loin, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, egg noodles, eggs, salt, lite olive oil, scallions, bamboo shoot, chinese cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Put pork or chicken in a bowl with the soy sauce, sugar and corn starch. Step 2: Mix well and leave to marinate for 20 minutes or so. Step 3: Cook the noodles until tender drain and rinse under cold running water then rinse again. Step 4: Beat the eggs lightly but well mixed. Step 5: Heat a little oil in a skillet. Step 6: Add eggs and cook to make a thin omelet, remove from pan and cut into thin strips. Step 7: Heat a little oil in the pan add pork and stir fry until cooked, remove from pan. Step 8: Heat the last of the oil and add scallions, then the bamboo shoots, green veggie and a touch of salt. Step 9: Add pork to the pan with the egg strips. Step 10: Mix ingredient thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dark brown sugar, corn oil, ground ginger, garlic powder, black pepper, boneless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, oil, ginger, garlic powder and black pepper in a medium-size bowl, set aside. Step 2: Cut the chicken into strips. Step 3: Add the chicken to the bowl and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Step 4: Preheat the broiler. Step 5: Make sure the top oven rack is in the highest position, just under the broiling unit. Step 6: Place the chicken in a single layer on a baking sheet or thread the chicken strips onto skewers. Step 7: Discard the marinade Broil the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until it is completely white and is just beginning to turn brown.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, chinese vegetables, lawry's teriyaki marinade, garlic, chinese five spice powder, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the chicken in a pan until the outside has turned white. Step 2: Add the vegetables, garlic, 5-spice and the entire bottle of marinade to the chicken. Step 3: Cover and let simmer until most of the liquid has cooked down and thickened. Step 4: Add soy sauce if desired, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Thai Clear Soup With Sweet And Sour Chile
Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, chicken broth, garlic cloves, ginger, rice vinegar, soft brown sugar, chicken breast, scallions, lemongrass, red thai chile, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: If using the chinese mushrooms, place them in a small bowl, cover with boiling water and soak for 30 minutes. Step 2: Place the broth, garlic, ginger, rice vinegar, and brown sugar in a pan and heat, stirring constantly, until gently simmering. Step 3: Add the chicken, scallions, lemongrass, red chile, and chinese mushrooms, if using, and continue to simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Taste and adjust the seasoning, remove the lemongrass, then serve the soup, garnished with fresh cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, soy sauce, rice vinegar, bourbon, brown sugar, scallion, powdered ginger, garlic cloves, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsely chop the scallion and mix all but the chicken and peanut oil together in a bowl and whisk until well blended. Step 2: Set aside Dice chicken thighs into bite sized pieces and saut in very hot pan or wok with the peanut oil until lightly browned on the outside. Step 3: Add liquid mixture to the chicken and reduce heat to medium. Step 4: Cook this uncovered until liquid is reduced to a glaze on the chicken bites and chicken is fully cooked. Step 5: Serve with your choice of side dish Fried rice or lo mein noodles work well.

Dish Name: The Have Your Cake And Eat It Too General Tso's Chicken
Ingredient Names: chinese rice wine, oyster sauce, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken thighs, low sodium chicken broth, rice vinegar, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cooking oil, dried red chilies, garlic, ginger, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine rice wine, oyster sauce, 2 tsp cornstarch & mix well. Step 2: Add chicken & toss to coat. Step 3: Let stand for 10 minutes. Step 4: Combine broth, vinegar, soy sauces, sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl. Step 5: Place a wok over high heat until hot. Step 6: Add oil, swirling to coat sides. Step 7: Add whole chilies and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until fragrant. Step 8: Add chicken and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 9: Add garlic, ginger, green onions, and crushed chilies. Step 10: Stir-fry for another minute.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, serrano peppers, chicken breasts, soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, thai basil, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up the sesame oil in a wok or a large skillet on high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger and serrano peppers, stir fry until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken pieces and cook until it's white in color, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir together the soy sauce, rice wine and sugar in a bowl, pour over chicken. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then turn down the heat to low. Step 6: Let cook, uncovered, until sauce thickens, about 30 minutes. Step 7: Turn heat back up to high and add basil and scallions, cook for another 2 minutes. Step 8: Serve over steamed rice.

Dish Name: Three Cup Chicken San Bei Ji
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, oil, soy sauce, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a saucepan. Step 2: Pour oil, soy sauce, and wine over chicken, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 3: Cover and simmer until chicken is tender, approximately 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg white, milk, cornflour, peas, tomatoes, chicken stock, rice wine, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove sinew and membrane from the chicken breast, chop or mince very finely to almost a paste. Step 2: Mix with a tablespoon of the cornflour, milk, add the egg white and blend well Skin the tomatoes, cut them in small cubes about the size of the peas. Step 3: Bring the stock to the boil. Step 4: Add the peas and the tomatoes, when it boils again remove from the stove With one chopstick pick up a little of the chicken mixture and drop that in the stock, go on until all the chicken is used up and you have lots of chicken bits / balls pea size. Step 5: Put the pan back on high heat and bring to the boil again, mix the one-tablespoon of cornflour with some water, add to the soup, then add salt, white pepper and 1 tablespoon of the rice wine Do a last taste check and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, eggs, garlic salt, chili paste, sugar, ketchup, brown sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, white vinegar, salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place all cut up chicken into a 9x13-inch pan and sprinkle with garlic salt. Step 2: Let sit at least one hour. Step 3: Mix the eggs in a bowl and pour the box of cornstarch on a large plate The pieces get dipped in the egg and then the cornstarch. Step 4: Fry them in a pan over medium heat in batches with a little olive oil. Step 5: After frying them, place them in a 9x13-inch pan. Step 6: Mix all of the ingredients in the sauce in a sauce pan and heat until sugar dissolves only. Step 7: Pour this over the breaded chicken in the pan. Step 8: Cook at 325f stirring every 15 minutes for 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt and pepper, ground ginger, garlic clove, chicken broth, pineapple chunks in juice, water chestnuts, green onions, cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 2: Place in slow cooker. Step 3: Combine ginger, garlic, broth, juice from pineapple, vinegar, and sugar, set aside. Step 4: Arrange pineapple and waterchestnuts over chicken. Step 5: Pour ginger sauce over all. Step 6: Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and cook an additional 2 to 3 hours or until chicken is tender. Step 8: Add green onions Dissolve cornstarch in soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: red chili pepper, gingerroot, garlic clove, flour, sugar, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, toasted sesame oil, chicken breasts, broccoli florets, oil, minced ginger, tomato paste, water
Instructions: Step 1: Save yourself a little time and chop the all the garlic and ginger when you make the marinade! Step 2: Mix together the chili peppers, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 clove garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil in a wok until sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Heat it up a little just to make sure sugar is totally dissolved. Step 4: Let it cool for a couple minutes. Step 5: Put the chicken and broccoli into a large bowl and coat it with the flour. Step 6: Pour the marinade over the chicken and broccoli. Step 7: Mix to coat, and marinate for at least 15 minutes but no longer than 2 hours. Step 8: Heat wok over high heat until very hot and add the oil Working quickly add the ginger, garlic, chili, sugar, soy sauce, and rice wine vinegar and stir to combine. Step 9: Add the chicken and broccoli in the wok along with the marinade and continue to cook until the chicken is brown.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, salt and pepper, lemons, water, lime juice, lemon juice, sugar, salt, yellow food coloring, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken: saute cubed chicken in olive oil until done. Step 2: Set aside Sauce: in a small sauce pan, combine first 7 ingredients and bring to a low boil Slowly stir in cornstarch solution Depending on how thick you want the sauce determines how much cornstarch solution you use Careful- sauce tends to boil up when cornstarch solution is added. Step 3: Serve chicken over a bed of rice. Step 4: Pour sauce over chicken& rice Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: water, dark brown sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, orange juice, water chestnut, fresh ginger, garlic, green onions, crushed red pepper flakes, cornstarch, chicken breast fillets, ice water, egg, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the sauce ingredients-- except the corn starch-- in a small saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Stir often while bringing mixture to a boil. Step 3: When sauce reaches a boil, remove it from heat and allow it to cool a bit, uncovered. Step 4: Slice chicken breasts into bite-size chunks. Step 5: Remove exactly 1 cup of the marinade from the pan and pour it over the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag or other container which allows the chicken to be completely covered with the marinade The chicken should marinate for at least a couple hours. Step 6: Cover the remaining sauce and leave it to cool until the chicken is ready. Step 7: When chicken has marinated, preheat 2-inches of vegetable oil in a wok or skillet to 350 degrees. Step 8: Put corn starch in a small bowl, then add 3 tablespoons of water. Step 9: Stir until corn starch has dissolved.

Dish Name: Very Flavourful Chinese Honey Chilli Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken, soy sauce, egg, cornstarch, garlic, green chilies, sugar, black pepper, salt, oil, red chilies, vinegar, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and dry the chicken pieces. Step 2: Cut into 1 inch sized cubes. Step 3: Marinate the chicken pieces in a mixture of 1 tablespoon soy sauce, salt, egg and 1 tablespoon cornflour for 10 minutes Peel and crush garlic finely. Step 4: Remove stems, wash and chop the green chillies finely. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok Deep fry the chicken pieces in hot oil till light brown. Step 6: Drain and keep aside De-stem and break red chillies into two Grind these alongwith vinegar in a blender to obtain a paste.

Ingredient Names: rice vermicelli, chicken, carrot, mint, chili, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boilding water and stand for 5 minutes or until softened and drain and rinse under cold water and drain and return to the bowl. Step 2: Add chicken, carrot, nunt and dressing and toss to combine. Step 3: Divide mixture between lettuce leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, dark soy sauce, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, cornstarch, ground szechuan peppercorns, sesame oil, peanut oil, scallions, minced ginger, garlic, red pepper flakes, chinkiang vinegar, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl combine the chicken, 2 tsp of the dark soy sauce, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp of the rice wine, sugar, cornstarch, ground sichuan peppercorns, and salt, stir to combine. Step 2: In a small bowl combine the sesame oil and the remaining 2 tsp dark soy sauce, 1 tsp soy sauce and 1 tsp rice wine. Step 3: Heat a 14 inch wok or a 12 inch skillet over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes within 1 to 2 seconds of contact Swirl in the peanut oil, add the scallions, ginger, garlic, and red pepper flakes and stir-fry 10 seconds or until the aromatics are fragrant Push to the aromatics to the sides of the wok, carefully add the chicken and spread it evenly in one layer in the wok. Step 4: Cook undisturbed for 1 minute, letting the chicken begin to sear. Step 5: Then stir fry 1 minute or until the chicken is lightly browned but not cooked through Swirl the soy sauce mixture into the wok and stir-fry 1 minute or until the chicken is well-glazed with the soy sauce Swirl in the vinegar and stir-fry 30 seconds or until the chicken is just cooked through.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, rice wine, fresh ginger, cornstarch, hoisin sauce, sugar, dark soy sauce, water, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, walnut halves, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Add marinade ingredients to chicken and mix well. Step 2: Marinate for 10 minutes While marinating chicken mix together the sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 3: Heat wok on high with the oil. Step 4: Add the garlic and stir for a few seconds. Step 5: Add the chicken and cook to 80% done. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium and add the sauce, giving it a good stir, cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Add the walnuts and sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, soy sauce, sherry wine, cornstarch, apple jelly, ground ginger, vegetable oil, walnut halves, sugar, green peppers, salt, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In medium bowl, combine soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, jelly. Step 2: Stir in chicken and set aside. Step 3: In a wok or large frying pan, heat 1 tblsp oil. Step 4: Add walnuts and cook until golden, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Remove pan from heat, sprinkle nuts with sugar. Step 6: Spoon walnuts onto paper towels to drain. Step 7: Add 1 / 3 cup oil to hot pan, heat. Step 8: Add green peppers and salt. Step 9: Cook, stirring quickly until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, skinless boneless chicken breasts, cashew nuts, red, red onion chunks, watercress, rice, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To make the sauce, mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl until completely blended. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan until very hot. Step 3: Throw in the chicken, cashew nuts, pepper and onion, then stir-fry for about 4-5 mins until the chicken is cooked and the nuts are toasted. Step 4: Pour over the sauce and simmer with a splash of water. Step 5: Remove the pan from the heat, then stir through the watercress just before serving with boiled rice.
