Ingredient Names: whole chickens, lemon, ginger, garlic cloves, brown sugar, soy sauce, chinese five spice powder, chinese rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the chicken under cold water Pat chicken dry with paper towel. Step 2: Place the lemon inside cavity. Step 3: Tie the chicken legs together with kitchen string. Step 4: Place chicken in a glass or ceramic dish. Step 5: Combine ginger, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, five spice and rice wine in a jug. Step 6: Pour half this sauce mixture over the chicken. Step 7: Turn the chicken to coat evenly. Step 8: Cover chicken and refrigerate for 30 minutes, if time permits. Step 9: Preheat the oven to 190c / 170c fan-forced.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, egg, salt, cornstarch, flour, oil, scallion, fresh spinach, catsup, hot pepper oil, sugar, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, egg, 1 tsp of salt, and cornstarch. Step 2: Mix well with hand Coat chicken evenly with flour. Step 3: Discard leftover flour, set aside. Step 4: In a small bowl, blend sauce ingredients. Step 5: Heat oil to 400 in wok Deep-fry chicken a few pieces at a time until golden brown and crispy, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Drain through strainer Reheat 2 t.

Dish Name: Won Ton Wrapped Chicken With Apricot Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: brown sugar, salt, garlic cloves, dry sherry, cornstarch, vegetable oil, soy sauce, boneless skinless chicken breast, wonton wrappers, peanut oil, apricot preserves, yellow mustard, teriyaki sauce
Instructions: Step 1: For the chicken: in a small bowl combine the brown sugar, salt, garlic, sherry, cornstarch, vegetable oil, and soy sauce. Step 2: Mix the chicken squares with the marinade. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight For the wrappers: lay the won ton wrappers in a single layer. Step 4: Place 1 square of the marinated chicken in the center of the won ton wrapper Dab a small amount of marinade on each of the corners. Step 5: Fold the won ton over the chicken by bringing each of the corners to the center of the square, overlapping slightly, like a squared envelope. Step 6: Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet until hot. Step 7: Cook the won ton wrapped chicken for about 2 minutes per side, turning once For the sauce: in a small bowl, blend the apricot preserves, mustard and teriyaki sauce.

Ingredient Names: butter, soy sauce, cracker, ground ginger, salt, boneless chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 Mix all ingredients together except chicken Roll chicken in the mixture and place on a sprayed cookie sheet bake for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Worlds Best Chicken Stir-Fry for Two
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, red bell peppers, green bell peppers, french white onion, mushrooms, green onions, white rice, olive oil, soy sauce, marsala wine, fresh cilantro, garlic powder, ginger, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saute sliced chicken in hot oil until one side is cooked and then add white onion while turning chicken. Step 2: Cook until onions are very soft. Step 3: Toss in red and green peppers, mushrooms and green onion and continue sauteing over med/high heat. Step 4: Stir in Cilantro, garlic powder, ginger, salt and pepper. Step 5: (If you use a very salty soy sauce you might not want to add salt). Step 6: Continue cooking until red and green peppers are soft. Step 7: Once peppers are soft stir in Marsala wine and soy sauce, continue cooking over med/high heat until almost all of the liquid has evaporated and you are left with a thick sauce. Step 8: Pour over a bed of rice and serve. Step 9: NOTE*It is very important to keep cooking until nearly all of the liquid has evaporated because you want the flavor of the soy sauce and wine on the vegetables NOT on the plate in a puddle. Step 10: If you prefer extra sauce for the rice just use more soy sauce and wine but make sure you burn off most of the excess water or your dish will lack flavor and be too liquidy. Step 11: Adding a little extra olive oil will always help to thicken the sauce, enjoy.

Dish Name: Ww Chinese Pineapple Chicken With Black Bean Sauce Points 7
Ingredient Names: scallions, gingerroot, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breast, pineapple, black bean sauce, brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add scallions, ginger and garlic. Step 3: Cook until soft, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken and cook until lightly browned on all sides, stirring often, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add pineapple and black bean sauce to skillet, bring to a simmer. Step 6: Simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes more. Step 7: Divide rice among 4 shallow bowls and spoon chicken mixture over top Yields about 1 cup of chicken and 1 / 2 cup of rice per serving.

Dish Name: Xue's Chicken With Celery And Leek
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, celery, leek, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the chicken and celery The celery should be sliced lengthways and then chopped along the lengths This will stop parts of it burning when you stir-fry it Finely chop the leek. Step 2: Place the celery in boiling water for a minute This will reduce the taste slightly, stir-fry the leek. Step 3: Then add the chicken and celery. Step 4: Cook until the chicken is cooked all the way through. Step 5: Add soy sauce and salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pineapple, soy sauce, ketchup, white wine, orange marmalade, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the soy sauce, ketchup, wine, marmalade and honey in a glass or ceramic dish large enough to hold all the chicken. Step 2: Cut the chicken breasts into 2 inch cubes and add to the dish, stirring to coat the chicken well. Step 3: Marinate for at least 1 hour in the fridge. Step 4: Preheat a grill rack or bbq Could also be broiled, your choice. Step 5: Drain the marinade and discard it. Step 6: Thread the chicken cubes and pineapple cubes together onto the skewers If you are using wooden skewers you should soak them first. Step 7: Cook until done, turning occasionally About 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chinese eggplants, ground lean pork, garlic cloves, scallions, chili bean paste, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, salt, cornstarch paste, sesame oil, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the eggplant into 2" long sections Halve, then cut into thirds or quarters [sticks approximately 2"x "x1 / 2"] Steam the eggplant using any steaming method I usually place a steaming rack in my wok, add half cup water & turn the heat to high, then place the ingredients on a dish and place the dish on the rack in the wok. Step 2: Cover and steam The eggplant will take approximately 15-20 minute to cook. Step 3: When tender [you can easily poke a chopstick, fork, etc Through one of the pieces], remove from heat If the veggies are sitting in a deep pool of liquid, drain, but not too thoroughly, set aside.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, eggs, almond filling, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 300f grease 13x9" baking pan, set aside. Step 2: Beat granulated sugar and eggs in medium bowl with electric mixer until thoroughly blended. Step 3: Add almond filling. Step 4: Beat until blended Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Step 5: Fold into almond mixture. Step 6: Spread batter evenly in prepared pan. Step 7: Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Step 8: Cool completely in pan on wire rack.

Ingredient Names: cold water, unflavored gelatin, sugar, boiling water, evaporated milk, vanilla, almond extract, kiwi fruits, fresh strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: Measure cold water into small bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water. Step 3: Let stand for 1 minute. Step 4: Add sugar to gelatin mixture. Step 5: Stir until gelatin dissolves. Step 6: Pour boiling water into medium bowl. Step 7: Stir in gelatin mixture. Step 8: Combine milk, vanilla and almond extract. Step 9: Stir milk mixture into gelatin mixture. Step 10: Divide mixture between four serving dishes.

Ingredient Names: caster sugar, gelatin powder, almond essence, sweetened condensed milk, lychees
Instructions: Step 1: Place sugar and 2 cups water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Stir throughout to dissolve the sugar, remove from heat. Step 3: Sprinkle the gelatine over and stir until dissolved. Step 4: Stir in the almond essence, condensed milk and 3 cups of water until well combined. Step 5: Pour mixture into a 19 x 29 cm slice tin and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight until set. Step 6: Using a sharp knife, cut jelly into 2 cm cubes. Step 7: Divide among bowls with fruits.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, ground almonds, sugar, egg white, clear honey, almond extract, blanched almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325f. Step 2: Mix the rice, ground almonds, and sugar Thoroughly beat in the egg white, honey, and almond essence. Step 3: Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper. Step 4: Place teaspoons of the mixture well apart on the paper, and press a split almond on top of each. Step 5: Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes, until the cookies are light golden brown. Step 6: Leave them to cool slightly on the cookie sheet, then lift them off the waxed paper. Step 7: When cool, store in an airtight tin.

Ingredient Names: boiling water, gelatin, sugar, milk, almond essence, fruit salad in syrup, raw sugar, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve the gelatine with boiling water, dissolve in the sugar. Step 2: Add warm milk and essence. Step 3: Using a shallow dish, pour the jelly in, to around 1cm deep / high. Step 4: Meanwhile, dissolve brown or raw sugar in hot water to taste, make it a little sweeter than usual so it's the right sweetness after adding in the fruit salad. Step 5: Add the fruit salad, chill well. Step 6: When the jelly solidifies, cut into 1cm cubes, and add to the chilled liquid Do not add the jelly into hot or warm liquid! Step 7: Make sure the liquid is at least cold before adding them inches Add more sugar to the liquid if required, otherwise ready to serve!, p S.

Dish Name: Anman Steamed Buns With Azuki Sweet Red Bean Paste
Ingredient Names: azuki beans, water, sugar, salt, flour, instant yeast, baking powder, milk, vegetable shortening
Instructions: Step 1: Making the azuki paste. Step 2: Put the azuki beans in a large pot and fill with water. Step 3: Let them soak overnight. Step 4: Bring the beans to a boil. Step 5: Turn down the heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove the beans from the pot and drain them. Step 7: Put the beans back in the pot and add 4 cups of water Brings the beans to a boil. Step 8: Turn down the heat and simmer the beans for around an hour, until they're soft. Step 9: Drain the beans again.

Dish Name: Asian-style baked onions, potatoes & sweet potatoes
Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, sichuan pepper, kalonji black onion seed, flowers star anise, sea salt, spanish onions, sweet potatoes, groundnut oil, tamari, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 220C/Gas 7/fan oven 200C. Combine all the spices and salt in a small, electric spice or coffee grinder (or use a pestle and mortar), and pulverise them to a powder – ignore the bigger bits of coriander husk. Tip the ground spices into a very large mixing bowl. Step 2: Cut the onions into sixths, leaving a little root attached to hold the layers together. Cut the ordinary potatoes into six segments, lengthways. If the sweet potatoes are slender (they normally are) cut them into quarters, lengthways; if they’re bulky round the middle, cut them into sixths. Put all the vegetables into the mixing bowl, add the oil and toss thoroughly, using clean hands. Step 3: Lightly oil the large tray which comes with your oven (or 1 or 2 baking trays), spread the vegetables out in a single layer and bake them for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the glaze ingredients in a small jug with 4 tablespoons cold water. Remove the oven tray, brush the vegetables with the glaze and continue to bake for about 20-30 minutes, or until they’re slightly charred and tender. A little squeeze of lime or lemon juice adds vivacity, but the vegetables are very nice with or without it.

Ingredient Names: shredded coconut, all-purpose flour, rice flour, caster sugar, desiccated coconut, egg, coconut milk, butter, bananas, brown sugar, lime juice, lime rind
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Spread the shredded coconut on an oven tray and toast it in oven for 10 minutes or until it is dark golden, shaking the tray occasionally. Step 3: Remove the coconut from the tray to prevent it from burning and set aside Sift both flours into a medium bowl. Step 4: Add the sugar and desiccated coconut and mix through with a spoon. Step 5: Put the beaten egg and coconut milk together in small bowl. Step 6: Make a well in the center of the flour, pour in the combined egg and coconut milk, and beat until smooth. Step 7: Add in the three tablespoons of melted butter. Step 8: Melt a little extra butter in a large non-stick frying pan-if you have a crepe pan use that. Step 9: Pour 3 tablespoons of the pancake mixture into the pan and cook over medium heat until the underside is golden.

Ingredient Names: banana, walnuts, brown sugar, wonton wrappers, egg, vegetable oil, chocolate syrup
Instructions: Step 1: Combine banana, nuts and sugar. Step 2: Mix gently Lay wonton on work surface. Step 3: Brush edges with egg Center teaspoonful of banana filling in center. Step 4: Fold wrapper in half, pressing edges to seal Pinch center to form bowtie. Step 5: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until needed. Step 6: In a large heavy skillet, heat 3 / 4" oil to 350f add bowties and cook in small batches until golden, about 1 minute per side. Step 7: Transfer with slotted spoon to paper towels to drain.

Ingredient Names: banana, wonton wrappers, sugar, oil, caramel sauce, chocolate syrup, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Chop bananas. Step 2: Sprinkle sugar over bananas. Step 3: Place a won ton wrapper on a smooth surface, and place 1 tbsp of banana in the middle With your finger, rub water on the edge of the wrapper, then fold one side over to make a triangle and press edges together to seal. Step 4: Place wontons in hot oil, and fry for about 2 minutes on each side or until golden. Step 5: Let cool for about 5 minutes or so. Step 6: Place on a plate and drizzle with caramel and chocolate sauce, and top with whip cream.

Ingredient Names: skinless, soy sauce, sesame oil, groundnut, batter, red peppers, carrot diagonal, fat garlic, ginger, white wine vinegar, sherry, light soft brown sugar, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into small chunks and mix with the soy sauce and sesame oil. In a jug or bowl, mix together the sauce ingredients with 100ml cold water. Line a large plate with kitchen paper. Step 2: Heat the groundnut oil in a deep-fat fryer to about 180C. Then dip a few chunks of chicken at a time into the batter, then place in the hot oil using tongs or a slotted spoon, but don’t crowd the pan. Fry until crisp and golden – about 2 mins. You may need to do this in batches, so reheat the oil each time. As the chunks cook, lift out with tongs/spoon to the paper-lined plate to drain. Step 3: Heat a wok to hot, add about 3 tbsp oil and stir-fry the vegetables with the garlic and ginger for about 3 mins. Give the sauce a quick final stir and pour into the wok, mixing as it cooks to a light glossy sauce. Bubble for 1 min, then spoon over the chicken and serve.

Dish Name: Beijing Banana Toffee Deep Fried Bananas
Ingredient Names: bananas, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, egg, water, granulated sugar, sesame seeds, ice water, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel bananas and cut them into 1 5" chunks combine flour, cornstarch, egg, water and mix till smooth. Step 2: Heat frying oil till moderately hot. Step 3: Dip the banana chunks into the batter, lift them out one at a time, tap off the excess batter and put them into the hot oil. Step 4: Fry for 1-2 minutes, till the batter is golden Lift them out right away and drain on paper towels Have the bowl of ice water nearby. Step 5: Put sugar and sesame seed in a clean dry pot, melt the sugar till it darkens a little. Step 6: Reduce heat to very low, just to keep it warm but not burned. Step 7: Dip the fried banana chunks in, a few at a time, coat them thoroughly with sugar syrup and sesame.

Ingredient Names: yellow cake batter, fat-free half-and-half, tea, milk, prepared tapioca, sugar syrup, candy sprinkles, nutmeg, yellow food coloring, vanilla extract, sugar-free vanilla syrup, ice
Instructions: Step 1: To make cake batter i used a recipe from this site for cake mix frosting and a recipe for make your own cake mix In the second recipe i omitted adding, leavening and eggs to the cake mix. Step 2: Add everything except tapioca and ice to your cocktail shaker, seal tight and shake for 10 seconds. Step 3: Place tapioca at the bottom of a tall glass, pour shaken mixture over pearls and serve with bubble tea straw and as much ice as you want.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, brown sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sugar and water in a large pot Cook at medium high heat When sugar dissolves and the mixture boils remove from heat Let cool and refrigerate or serve.

Ingredient Names: cantaloupe, honey, lime zest, orange zest, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl combine sauce ingredients and heat for 30 seconds in the microwave, set aside to cool. Step 2: Place fruit in a mixing bowl, top with dressing and mix well. Step 3: Serve alone or with vanilla ice cream.

Ingredient Names: tea, fat-free half-and-half, warm water, sugar-free chai latte mix, sugar syrup, prepared tapioca, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour tea base and fat free half and half into cocktail shaker or thermos. Step 2: Spoon 3 tsp of chai latte mix into pyrex measuring cup. Step 3: Add 1 / 2 cup warm water and mix until mix is dissolved. Step 4: Pour chai tea into cocktail shaker and add sugar syrup Shake for about 10 seconds or until frothy. Step 5: Spoon tapioca pearl into tall glass and pour shaken mixture over it. Step 6: Serve with bubble tea straw and enjoy!, ^_^.

Ingredient Names: oranges, sugar, ginger, red chilies, star anise, cinnamon sticks, sweet chili sauce, thai fish sauce, rice wine vinegar, red wine, duck breasts, canola oil, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub the oranges well, cut the rind from 2 oranges, using a sharp knife, and trim off most of the pith. Step 2: Cut the rind into short, thin strips. Step 3: Squeeze the juice from the oranges, you need 250ml. Step 4: Combine the orange rind and juice, sugar, ginger, chilli, star anise, cinnamon sticks, sweet chilli sauce, fish sauce, vinegar and red wine in a saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring. Step 5: Boil for around 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly syrupy Prick the duck skin well, and heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan. Step 6: Add the duck breasts and sear, skin side down for 8 minutes or till brown. Step 7: Then turn and cook for another 8 minutes. Step 8: Remove the duck and allow it to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Step 9: Cut the spring onions into finger lengths, then into strips.

Dish Name: Chinese Apricot Duck On The Grill Bbq
Ingredient Names: duck breasts, dried apricots, shallots, honey, dark soy sauce, sesame oil, chinese five spice powder, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the barbeque. Step 2: Using a sharp knife, cut a long slit in the leshy side of each duck breast to make a pocket. Step 3: Divide the apricots and shallots between the pockets and secure with skewers. Step 4: Mix the honey, soy sauce and sesame oil together in a small bowl and brush all over the duck. Step 5: Sprinkle with the chinese five-spice powder To make the garnish, make a few cuts lengthways down the stem of each scallion. Step 6: Place in iced water and leave until the stems start to curl. Step 7: Drain before using. Step 8: Cook the duck over medium hot coals for 6-8 minutes on each side. Step 9: Remove the skewers, set on a bed of cous cous and garnish with the scallion curls.

Dish Name: Chinese Black Sesame Seed Porridge Geema Woo
Ingredient Names: black sesame seed, sugar, cold water, rice flour, rock sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over high heat until hot but not smoking. Step 2: Add sesame seeds and stir for 45 seconds-1 minute or until they stop crackling. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the wok for 15 seconds longer before transferring to a bowl to cool Grind the seeds and 1 / 4 cup of sugar until fine. Step 4: Add 1 / 4 cup of cold water and process to a smooth paste. Step 5: Mix the rice flour with a little of the remaining water to form a smooth paste. Step 6: Whisk in all of the remaining water. Step 7: Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring so no lumps form Crush the rock sugar and add to the pot along with the sesame paste. Step 8: Return to a boil and cook, stirring as needed, until the sugar dissolves and the soup thickens to the consistency of a thin porridge.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, lard, hot water, salt, eggs, sugar, milk, yellow food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: To make the pastry, sift flour and salt into bowl Rub lard into flour until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Step 2: Mix in hot water to form a firm dough. Step 3: Knead lightly on lightly floured surface. Step 4: Roll out 3mm thickness. Step 5: Cut out with an 8cm fluted cutter. Step 6: Put into greased patty tins. Step 7: Beat together eggs and sugar Gradually add milk. Step 8: Mix in food colouring.

Ingredient Names: flour, cream of tartar, salt, baking soda, unsalted butter, granulated sugar, egg, almond extract, almonds, five-spice powder, dark brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375. Step 2: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, salt and baking soda Cream together the butter and sugar with a hand mixer. Step 3: Blend in the beaten egg and almond extract. Step 4: Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until the dough takes on a flaky, moist consistency Gather the crumbly mixture together using your hands or a spatula To make the topping, chop up the almonds and combine in a small bowl with the five-spice powder and brown sugar To form the cookies, roll dough into 1 1 / 2-inch diameter balls between the palms of your hands. Step 5: Place on the prepared baking sheet.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, sugar, eggs, all-purpose flour, baking soda, salt, blanched almond, orange zest, vanilla extract, whole almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees Lightly butter 2 cookie sheets. Step 2: Place butter and sugar in mixter bowl and beat until light and fluffy. Step 3: Add 1 egg and continue beating until completely blended Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto sheet of waxed paper and gradually mix in butter mixture. Step 4: Add chopped almonds, orange zest, and vanill and mix just until blended. Step 5: Drop dough by rounded teaspoon 1 inch apart onto prepared cookie sheets. Step 6: Dip thumb in flour and make indentation in center of each cookie. Step 7: Beat remaining egg and lightly brush over each cookie, using pastry brush. Step 8: Place whole almond in each indentation.

Dish Name: Chinese Sponge Cake Baked Not Steamed
Ingredient Names: cake flour, sugar, oil, cream of tartar, water, eggs, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water and dissolve sugar, let cool. Step 2: Mix yolk into sugar water Slowly add flour into the mixture. Step 3: Blend in oil and extract. Step 4: In a large bowl, beat egg whites until peaks are stiff. Step 5: Add cream of tartar. Step 6: Fold batter from above into egg whites. Step 7: Pour combined batter into an ungreased aluminum cake pan. Step 8: Bake at 350 degrees for 45-60 minutes until done.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, eggs, salt, vanilla essence, butter, chestnuts, water, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Cake: preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Grease a 7" round baking pan and dust lightly with flour. Step 3: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Step 4: Beat egg yolks lightly and fold into egg white. Step 5: Blend well Sift together flour and salt. Step 6: Add 1 / 3 flour mixture to egg mixture and mix well using light, swift actions. Step 7: Repeat with the remaining flour mixture, mixing well after each addition. Step 8: Add vanilla essence. Step 9: Add melted butter and blend quickly.

Ingredient Names: butter, confectioners' sugar, egg, flour, vanilla extract, sugar, water, eggs, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: Direction to make crust. Step 2: Mix sugar, butter and flour. Step 3: Then add egg and vanilla extract. Step 4: Mix well Texture of dough should be slightly moist, not dry, and not oily Pull dough and make a ball shape to about 1 5 inch diameter, then press into tart mould, start from the center then push up until it goes higher than the side, then use two fingers to shape the edge to a a shape. Step 5: Boil sugar and water until sugar is melted. Step 6: Cool down to room temperature. Step 7: Add eggs, vanilla extract and evaporated milk.

Ingredient Names: catsup, apple cider vinegar, orange juice, red wine vinegar, granulated sugar, dry mustard, hot sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cornstarch and water. Step 2: Set aside In saucepan heat all remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved and liquid is hot Slowly add the cornstarch and water mixture, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens, about 1 minute, remove from heat. Step 3: Serve warm or room temperature.

Dish Name: Chinese Sweet Peanut Soup Fa Sung Woo
Ingredient Names: raw peanuts, sugar, cold water, rice flour
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over high heat until hot but not smoking. Step 2: Add peanuts and stir for 30 seconds. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and continue roasting for 3-5 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden. Step 4: Remove from heat to cool Gring the peanuts in a food processor until the consistency of peanut butter. Step 5: Add the sugar and process again. Step 6: Mix the rice flour and 1 cup of cold water, whisking until smooth. Step 7: Add the peanuts and 1 cup of water and whisk again. Step 8: Add the remaining water and bring to a boil stirring constantly until the soup thickens. Step 9: Serve hot, 1 cup per person.

Ingredient Names: sugar, red beans, lotus seeds, vanilla, pearl tapioca, rice balls, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water and beans in a large pot, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to simmer, cook uncovered till beans are tender. Step 3: Add lotus seed and sugar, cook until soup thickens a little and lotus seeds are tender, but not mushy. Step 4: Add vanilla, serve hot for a perfect winter dessert, or you can let the soup cool down, then add ice With this basic recipe, you can take out all the beans, increase the amount of lotus seeds and have a lotus seeds sweet soup instead.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Sweet And Sour Pork
Ingredient Names: pork butt, salt, sugar, soy sauce, egg white, green onions, vegetable oil, cornstarch, green bell pepper, onion, crushed red pepper flakes, white sugar, sesame seeds, water, apple cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Place the cubes pork in a medium bowl, add in 1 teaspoon salt, 1 / 4 teaspoon sugar and 1 teaspoon soy sauce. Step 2: Using clean hands toss well to combine, then add in 1 egg white and toss once again. Step 3: Mix in chopped green onion. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 1 or more hours. Step 5: Heat 1 quart of oil to 365 degrees f in a large heavy pot or in an electric deep-fryer. Step 6: Remove the pork from the fridge and toss with 1 / 2 cup cornstarch. Step 7: Fry the pork in hot oil about 8 minutes or until evenly browned drain on paper towels or on a rack. Step 8: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large wok over medium heat. Step 9: Stir in bell pepper strips, onion and crushed chil flakes. Step 10: Stir fry until just tender, then season with 1 / 4 teaspoon sugar and salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: oven-ready duck, chinese five-spice, star anise, orange peel off, chinese black vinegar, shaohsing rice wine, chicken stock, chinese pancakes, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 140C/120C fan/gas 1. Loosen the skin on the duck by wriggling first your fingers, then your hand between it and the flesh until it pulls away – be careful not to break the skin. Trim off any excess fat from cavity and skin around the neck. Rub the skin all over with the five-spice plus a good sprinkling of salt. Put the duck in a roasting tin and push the star anise, orange peel and orange halves inside. Spoon the vinegar, rice wine and stock into the cavity, don’t worry if it spills out again. Cover the roasting tin with a tent of foil and cook for 2 hrs. Step 2: Turn oven up to 240C/220C fan/gas 7. Take foil off, pour off any juices and return duck to the oven for 30-40 mins or until the skin is browned and crisp. Step 3: Once cooked let it rest for 10 mins. Slice off the breasts and shred meat and skin. Pile onto a plate, keeping meat and skin separate. Keep warm in a low oven, covering meat with foil to stop it drying out but skin uncovered to crisp it further. Step 4: Heat the pancakes and serve the duck with accompaniments.

Ingredient Names: fortune cookies, semi-sweet chocolate chips, shortening
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, melt chocolate chips in the microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, add shortening. Step 2: Stir until blended. Step 3: Dip the purchased fortune cookies half-way in the chocolate and place on waxed paper to cool.

Ingredient Names: oil, country-style boneless pork ribs, cola, garlic cloves, soy sauce, ginger, green onion, sliced mushrooms, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pot over high heat. Step 2: Add half of pork Saut until brown. Step 3: Transfer pork to bowl. Step 4: Repeat with remaining pork. Step 5: Return pork to pot. Step 6: Turn off heat and slowly add cola into pot, bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat to med-low, cover and simmer 30 minute. Step 8: Add garlic, soy sauce, ginger, mushrooms and half of the onions.

Dish Name: Creamy Vanilla Coconut Or Banana Ice Cream Dairy Soy Free
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, maple syrup, vanilla, rice milk, guar gum, bananas, cashews, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a blender, blend thoroughly. Step 2: Add to ice cream maker, following manufacturers directions for churning For soft serve ice cream, eat immediately For a harder ice cream, transfer to an airtight container and freeze for several hours to a day, depending on degree of hardness desired Enjoy!

Dish Name: Crock Pot Sweet And Sour Ham
Ingredient Names: cooked ham, carrots, green pepper, onion, celery, teriyaki sauce, chicken broth, ginger, garlic salt, cider vinegar, pineapple chunks in juice, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: I used a 7 qt crock pot and fed 9 people with about 4 cups leftover You might want to half the recipe. Step 2: Combine all ingredients including pineapple juice, but not the pineapple or cornstarch yet. Step 3: Cook on low 5 hours. Step 4: Add cornstarch - and the pineapple. Step 5: Cook for an additional 1 or 2 hours I cooked for 6 hour total, but after all cooking was done i had it on warm for another 2 hours I started way too early and misjudged how long it would take to cook The ham made a kind of smoky tasting sweet and sour sauce, but it was good I served it with rice on a busy school night and except for one teenage dweeb who eats nothing but hamburgers, they all liked it.

Ingredient Names: eggs, white sugar, milk, salt, miniature tart shells
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine eggs, sugar, milk and salt, beat well till fluffy. Step 3: Place tart shells on a cookie sheet. Step 4: Spoon filling into tart shells, filling nearly to the top. Step 5: Bake 20-30 minutes or till tart filling cracks Can be topped with a fresh strawberry slice or a raspberry.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, catsup, brown sugar, salt, chinese five spice powder, garlic, boneless pork roast
Instructions: Step 1: Add everything except the roast to a small mixing bowl. Step 2: Spread a generous layer of the sauce on all sides of the roast Reserve the rest of the sauce for later. Step 3: Marinate for at least 1 hour. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 5: Place the roast in a small casserole dish and loosely cover with foil With the remaining sauce baste the roast ever 20 - 30 minutes for 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, almond extract, cake flour, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Put eggs and sugar into mixing bowl. Step 2: Beat on high for 5 minutes until creamy. Step 3: Add rest of ingredients. Step 4: Blend on low for 3-5 minutes until smooth. Step 5: Line 9-inch cake pan with wax paper. Step 6: Pour mixture into cake pan. Step 7: Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Step 8: Steam for 15 minutes, knife should come out clean when inserted.

Dish Name: Easy Sweet And Sour Sauce For Chicken Or Pork
Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, soy sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, and soy sauce together and bring to a boil in a small pot. Step 2: Mix together the cornstarch and water, add to the other ingredients and stir to thicken For a thicker sauce, increase the cornstarch to 5 teaspoons.

Dish Name: Eggplant Aubergine With Hot Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: chinese eggplants, peanut oil, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, hot bean paste, soy sauce, sugar, chicken stock, water chestnut, scallion, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggplant 1 / 2-inch wide by 2-inch long strips. Step 2: Saute 1 / 2 the eggplant in 1 / 2 the oil in a non-stick pan / wok, until soft. Step 3: When browned and soft, remove from pan about 5 minutes. Step 4: Then repeat with rest of eggplant or sautee in 2 pans On low heat, cook garlic, ginger, and hot bean paste for a minute, then add sugar, soy sauce and stock / water. Step 5: Add water chestnuts. Step 6: Return eggplant to the pan and cook for about five minutes until garlic is soft and a sauce forms If sauce is too thin, thicken with 1t corn starch mixed with 2t water, fold sesame oil. Step 7: Top with green onions and sesame seeds.

Dish Name: Flu Fighting Mustard Green And Sweet Potato Soup
Ingredient Names: mustard greens, sweet potato, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the mustard greens very thoroughly in several changes of water When you think they are clean, wash them again! Step 2: Cut the greens into 1'' peices Peel and cut the sweet potato into large chunks. Step 3: Bring all ingredients to a boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 3 hours, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: egg white, sugar, salt, butter, all-purpose flour, vanilla extract, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Combine egg whites, sugar and salt. Step 3: Mix well until sugar and salt dissolve. Step 4: Add butter, flour, and extracts, mix. Step 5: Drop a few tablespoons of dough onto a well-greased cookie sheet. Step 6: Leave plenty of space for the cookies to expand I'd bake only a few until you get the hang of molding them. Step 7: Bake 10 minutes or until edges are light brown Mold warm cookie over a wooden spoon handle to form a cylinder.

Ingredient Names: powdered sugar, all-purpose flour, unsalted butter, fresh ginger, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, salt, almonds, whipping cream, crystallized ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Step 2: Line 2 heavy large baking sheets with parchment paper. Step 3: Combine first 7 ingredients in processor and blend using on / off turns until mixture resembles coarse meal. Step 4: Add almonds, cream and crystallized ginger and process just until moist clumps form. Step 5: Shape dough into 1 1 / 4 inch diameter balls. Step 6: Place on prepared sheets Moisten bottom of glass: dip into powdered sugar and press each dough ball to 1 / 4 inch thickness. Step 7: Bake cookies until brown on bottom and at edges, about 28 minutes. Step 8: Transfer cookies to rack and cool. Step 9: Store in airtight container at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, fresh ginger, whole milk, ginger in syrup, egg yolks, heavy cream, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: To make the syrup, heat the water and 1 / 4 cup sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Step 2: When the sugar is dissolved, add the fresh ginger. Step 3: Stir to distribute sugar, then bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 4: Reduce the heat and simmer the syrup uncovered for 5 minutes. Step 5: Remove the pan from the heat In another pan combine the milk, 2 tablespoons sugar, and the minced preserved ginger. Step 6: Stir over medium heat until the milk comes to a scalding temperature, just short of a simmer, then remove the pan from the heat Scrape the fresh ginger syrup into the milk mixture, and stir well to blend. Step 7: Cover and steep 20 minutes to infuse the milk. Step 8: In a small bowl beat the egg yolks and 1 / 4 cup sugar until the mixture is pale yellow, thick, and falls in ribbons from the beater.

Ingredient Names: eggs, butter, molasses, sugar, flour, baking soda, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground nutmeg, powdered sugar, cream cheese, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Grease a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan. Step 3: Line pan with parchment paper and grease. Step 4: Dust pan with flour. Step 5: Beat egg yolks for 4 minutes in a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed until thick and lemony. Step 6: Add butter and molasses and beat 1 minute. Step 7: In a separate bowl, beat egg whites until foamy. Step 8: Add sugar, beating until soft peaks form. Step 9: Fold in egg yolk mixture Sift together flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg.

Dish Name: Gourmet Noodle Kugel Base Recipe Exotic Add Ins
Ingredient Names: noodles, light cream cheese, nonfat vanilla yogurt, eggs, sugar, vanilla, flour, coconut flavoring, fruit cocktail, pineapple, mangoes, shredded coconut, mini chocolate chip, syrup, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all base recipe ingredients till smooth then fold in noodles and your 'exotic' variations! Step 2: Pour into 9"x13" pan sprayed with pam. Step 3: Bake at 375f for about 1 hour till golden and firm The ones containing more liquid require an additional 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Allow to set for at least 30 minutes before serving. Step 5: Serve at either room temp or lightly chilled.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, chinese rice wine, soy sauce, gingerroot, garlic, boneless pork butt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork into 1 / 2 inch thick slices. Step 2: Combine the marinade ingredients in a large bowl or zip lock bag. Step 3: Add the pork and turn to coat. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 6: Arrange the pork in a single layer on a rack over a large foil-lined baking sheet. Step 7: Bake for 30 minutes. Step 8: Turn the slices over and baste with the hoisin sauce Continue baking until tender, 20 to 30 minutes, brushing occasionally with the hoisin sauce.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, hoisin sauce, ketchup, chile, green onions, fresh ginger, pepper, fresh pineapple
Instructions: Step 1: Combine hoisin sauce, ketchup, chili, green onion, and ginger, set aside. Step 2: Season pork cubes with pepper. Step 3: Thread pork and pineapple onto skewers. Step 4: Grill over direct heat for about 4 minutes, turn and glaze with hoisin mixture Continue cooking on grill until pork browns, about 8-10 minutes total cooking time.

Ingredient Names: pork, garlic, honey, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: When oil is hot, add pork pieces, being careful not to crowd While cooking, season pork with red pepper flakes, salt and pepper. Step 3: Saute pork, turning occasionally, until pork pieces are nicely browned and turning crisp on all sides. Step 4: Add garlic and continue to stir until fragrant, approximately one or two minutes. Step 5: Turn heat down to medium, add honey to pork. Step 6: Stir well, continue to cook for two to three more minues until honey has coated pork well and has slightly thickened Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: confectioners' sugar, all-purpose flour, butter, egg, vanilla extract, white sugar, water, eggs, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, mix together the confectioners' sugar and flour. Step 2: Mix in butter with a fork until it is in small crumbs. Step 3: Stir in the egg and vanilla until the mixture forms a dough The texture should be slightly moist. Step 4: Add more butter if it is too dry, or more flour, if the dough seems greasy. Step 5: Shape dough into 1 1 / 2 inch balls, and press the balls into small tart molds so that it covers the bottom, and goes up just above the rim Use 3 fingers to crimp the edges. Step 6: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Step 7: Combine the white sugar and water in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil, until the sugar is dissolved. Step 8: Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, vanilla, eggs, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Soften the butter in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Add sugar and and blend together until fluffy, add vanilla. Step 3: Add eggs to the mixture one at a time, beating well after adding each egg. Step 4: Add flour and beat thoroughly, heat oven to 375. Step 5: Grease the cookie sheets and then dust lightly with flour. Step 6: Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough at least 2 inches apart on each sheet. Step 7: Bake for twenty minutes and remove with a wide spatula, loosening each cookie from the sheet. Step 8: Place a folded fortune on each cookie.

Dish Name: Hong Kong Style Egg Roll Swiss Roll
Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, cake flour, cornstarch, oil, milk, baking powder, egg whites, whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375f. Step 2: Beat the yolks in a non-metal mixing bowl with an electric mixer at medium speed Gradually add in sugar. Step 3: Blend in oil and milk Continue to mix until a pale yellow batter is formed. Step 4: Add in sifted cake flour, cornstarch and baking powder. Step 5: Beat the egg whites in another bowl with high speed Gradually add in sugar and mix until you see soft peaks. Step 6: Spoon half of the egg white batter into pale yellow cake batter, fold in slowly.

Dish Name: Hot Orange Pudding Hsi Mi Chu Keng
Ingredient Names: pearl tapioca, orange, cold water, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cover the tapioca with 1 / 2 cup of cold water in a small bowl. Step 2: Let soak at least 4 hours Peel the orange and remove the white membrane. Step 3: Cut the orange meat into small pieces. Step 4: Combine 2 cups cold water with sugar in a sauce pan. Step 5: Bring to a boil over high heat, and stir until the sugar is dissolved. Step 6: Drain the tapioca and slowly pour it into the saucepan, stirring constantly. Step 7: Cook over medium heat, continually stirring, for 2 minutes, or until the pudding thickens. Step 8: Stir in the orange pieces, and bring to a boil again, serve hot.

Dish Name: Kueh Pisang Or Chinese Banana And Cinnamon Pancakes
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, baking powder, whole milk, eggs, bananas, salt, granulated sugar, powdered sugar, lemon, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, whisk together flour, cinnamon & baking powder. Step 2: Make well in center & add half the milk & half the eggs, beating until batter is smooth. Step 3: Then add remaining milk & eggs, stirring thoroughly In separate bowl, mash bananas with salt & sugar. Step 4: Stir banana mixture into batter. Step 5: Sprinkle waxed or parchment paper with powdered sugar & set aside. Step 6: Heat some oil in skillet over high heat, then drain off any excess oil & drop in enough batter to make a pancake 5-7 inches in diameter. Step 7: Cook on each side until golden, working in batches if needed. Step 8: When a pancake is done, place on sugared parchment paper & sprinkle with extra cinnamon & powdered sugar. Step 9: Add a little lemon juice to each pancake, then fold into quarters & serve hot.

Ingredient Names: lemons, catsup, white sugar, water, cornstarch, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: Add sugar, the juice of 2 lemons, and the zest of one lemon and catsup. Step 2: Mix cornstarch with the water and slowly drizzle into mixture. Step 3: Simmer over medium, stirring constantly heat until sauce thickens It should only take 2-3 minutes for the sauce to thicken.

Ingredient Names: mixed fruit, water, cider vinegar, light brown sugar, salt, garlic cloves, dry mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Combined all ingredients in a med-sized pan, and bring to a boil. Step 2: Turn the heat down, and simmer uncovered until all the fruit is very soft, about 30 mins, or longer. Step 3: When room temperature, mix well. Step 4: Put in a container, and store in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: superfine sugar, water, mandarin orange segments, lemon juice, grand marnier, lychees, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar and water and heat over low heat until sugar has dissolved. Step 2: Bring to boil before cooling. Step 3: Make mandarin puree by blending or pushing mandarin orages through sieve. Step 4: Add puree with juice and liqeur to sugar syrup, combine well. Step 5: Pour into pan and freeze till firm. Step 6: Stir occasionally To serve, place a few extra mandarin segments in a glass, followed by a few chilled lychee on top, 2 tbsp of the canned lychee syrup, and a scoop of mandarin orange sorbet. Step 7: Place a sprig of mint on top of you like!

Ingredient Names: mangoes, mango nectar, lemon juice, coconut milk, cream, caster sugar, gelatin powder
Instructions: Step 1: Use a food processor-puree the mango, nectar and lemon juice until smooth. Step 2: Leave the mango puree in the processor bowl. Step 3: Add the coconut milk, cream and caster sugar to a saucepan. Step 4: Bring to a simmer and stir for about 5 minutes, until the sugar dissolves. Step 5: Sprinkle over the gelatin and quickly whisk until the gelatin is dissolved. Step 6: Add the milk mixture to the mango puree in the food processor bowl Process until well combined. Step 7: Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove any lumps, strain into a jug. Step 8: Pour the pudding mixture into 6 serving bowls or ramekins.

Ingredient Names: milk, light cream, vanilla, salt, maple syrup, eggs, cooked long-grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f Butter a 12-inch square casserole dish. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the milk, cream, maple syrup, vanilla, salt, and eggs. Step 3: Mix well to ensure that the eggs are thoroughly incorporated. Step 4: Add rice and stir until well combined. Step 5: Pour mixture into casserole dish. Step 6: Bake until mixture is set and top is golden and bubbling or for a slightly creamier consistency cook in a hot water bath for 40-45 minutes. Step 7: Serve hot or cold, drizzled with maple syrup.

Ingredient Names: glutinous-rice flour, boiling water, sugar, roasted unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl stir together the rice flour and sugar While mixing with a spoon or small stiff spatula, pour in the boiling water. Step 2: Stir in clockwise direction until the lumps disappear, and the batter is slightly elasticky, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Cover the container with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 2-4 minutes, depending on your microwave. Step 4: Meanwhile, grease a ziploc bag well Invert the bag, and remove the mochi from the bowl into the bag Don't burn yourself! Step 5: While the mochi is still warm, start kneading To knead: stretch and flatten the dough inside the bag with the palm of your hand, then pick up the bag at one corner, shake it so that it rolls into a ball again, then repeat You can also knead it by placing the mochi into a greased bowl, and knead it as you would a normal dough.

Dish Name: Mung Bean Hopia Filipino Chinese Pastry
Ingredient Names: mung beans, sugar, salt, all-purpose flour, grapeseed oil, water, egg
Instructions: Step 1: One 14-oz package of dried peeled split yellow mung beans makes 35 hopia Dough recipe is for 18 hopia It is best to cook the entire package and freeze the unused portion Mung bean paste filling In medium glass bowl, soak beans in water for 4 hours at room temperature You can soak overnight, but place bowl in fridge to prevent bean sprouting. Step 2: After soaking, drain yellow water and rinse beans well. Step 3: Transfer beans to medium saucepan, add fresh water about 1 / 8-inch above beans, and bring to boil. Step 4: When beans start to soften, scoop out foamy water on top and reduce heat to medium Continue cooking into a paste, stirring often to prevent burning.

Ingredient Names: butter, groundnut oil, garlic, carrots, spring, bamboo shoots, chestnut mushrooms, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Sandwich 3 sheets of filo together, brushing with melted butter between each layer, then repeat with the rest of the filo. Using a 7cm round cutter, cut out 24 circles. Brush the holes of a non-stick mini muffin tin with melted butter, then press the circles into the holes (you may need to make these in batches – just keep the rest of the filo circles covered with a damp tea towel until ready to cook). Bake for 15 mins until golden brown. Can be stored in an airtight container for up to a day. Step 2: To serve, return the filo cases to a warm oven to heat through. Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan over medium heat. Fry the garlic for a few secs, add the carrot, cabbage and bamboo shoots, then stir-fry for 2 mins. Stir in the mushrooms, oyster and soy sauce for 1 min more, remove from the heat, then add the chives. Season with some pepper, then spoon into the cases and serve the dumplings immediately.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, salt, vanilla, corn oil, milk, cake flour, cornstarch, baking powder, egg whites, caster sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Sieve flour, corn starch and baking powder together. Step 2: Beat egg yolks, sugar, salt and vanilla essence together till thick and creamy. Step 3: Stir the warm corn oil / melted butter and milk into the yolk mixture, mix well. Step 4: Fold in the sieved flour mixture and mix well. Step 5: Beat egg whites till white in colour and add in sugar by thirds and beat till egg white is stiff. Step 6: Fold half portion of the egg white into egg yolk and blend well. Step 7: Pour the yolk mixture into the remaining egg white and blend well. Step 8: Spoon batter into paper cups lined with baking paper up to 80% full and bake at 180c for 20 minutes or till golden brown. Step 9: Cut baking paper into 19cm x 19cm put it on top of a paper cup then use another paper cup to push the baking paper into the cup.

Ingredient Names: peanuts, peanut oil, egg, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, caster sugar, egg yolk, water
Instructions: Step 1: Grease baking sheet / line with parchment. Step 2: Preheat oven to 180c Toast peanuts until golden brown, then grind till fine, set aside. Step 3: Combine ground nuts and sifted dry ingredients Slowly add oil, combine well. Step 4: Add the egg Form a fine dough. Step 5: Roll pieces of dough into a small ball and place on cookie sheet. Step 6: Brush with egg wash and bake for 10-15 minutes until golden.

Ingredient Names: crushed pineapple in juice, granulated sugar, cinnamon sticks, cream cheese, unsalted butter, powdered sugar, eggs, baking soda, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, salt, cooking spray, egg yolk, water
Instructions: Step 1: For filling: drain crushed pineapple in a colander, pressing to render as much of the juice as possible. Step 2: Place pineapple in a large pot with granulated sugar and cinnamon sticks and stir over medium-low heat about 1 hour, until sugar begins crystallizing against the sides of the pan. Step 3: Remove cinnamon sticks and let pineapple filling cool For pastry: using a mixer, beat together cream cheese, butter and confectioners' sugar at medium-high speed. Step 4: Add 2 eggs, baking soda and vanilla and beat until incorporated. Step 5: Reduce speed to low, add flour and salt until mixed well and dough begins to form ball. Step 6: Refrigerate dough for 30 to 60 minutes before assembling tarts. Step 7: Preheat oven to 350f Lightly spray 2 mini-muffin tins with cooking spray. Step 8: Mix yolk and water together to make a wash.

Ingredient Names: pistachio nut, water, canola oil, brown rice syrup, brown rice flour, amaranth flour, baking powder, baking soda, chinese five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a blender, grind nuts to a powder and put in a small bowl. Step 3: Add water, oil, and syrup, mix well. Step 4: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda and five-spice powder. Step 5: Stir in nut mixture to form a dough Form 1 balls and bake on ungreased cookie sheets for 8-10 minutes, or until lightly browned Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

Ingredient Names: evaporated milk, milk, water, tea, sugar free pistachio pudding mix, sugar syrup, tapioca, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients, except tapioca pearl and ice, in cocktail shaker or thermos Shake well for 10 seconds. Step 2: Place tapioca pearl into bottom of tall glass and pour shaken mixture over it. Step 3: Put as much ice as you want into glass and serve with bubble tea straw.

Dish Name: Pork & noodle pan-fry with sweet & spicy sauce
Ingredient Names: green onions, sunflower oil, fresh broccoli florets, half egg noodle, lean pork stir-fry, shiitake mushrooms, cantonese sweet spicy stir-fry sauce, beansprout, salted cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Over a high heat, bring a pan of water to the boil (for the noodles). Chop the onions into chunky lengths. Heat the oil in a wok, tip in the broccoli and stir fry for 2 minutes until it starts to soften. Step 2: Tip the noodles into the boiling water and boil for 4 minutes until softened. Meanwhile, add the pork strips to the wok and fry until the meat changes colour. Add the onions and mushrooms and cook for a minute or so until the mushrooms start to soften. Step 3: Stir in the sauce until everything is well coated. Drain the noodles and toss into the wok with the beansprouts and cashews. Heat until the beansprouts start to soften slightly then serve.

Ingredient Names: squid, oil, chinese five spice powder, sesame oil, fresh coriander, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Ask the fishmonger to clean the squid; little ones often come ready-cleaned. Using kitchen scissors, cut open the body and open out. Wash well, then pat dry. If you have a large squid, cut the body into four portions, roughly square. Small squid can just be opened up. Step 2: Using the tip of a very sharp knife, score the top in a neat criss-cross. Brush with oil and set aside while you heat the barbecue or griddle until ready to cook. Step 3: Mix together 2 tsp sea salt, Chinese five-spice and 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper. Sprinkle on both sides of the squid just before cooking, according to taste. You may not need it all. Heat the griddle pan to hot and cook about 1 min each side, until it starts to curl. Remove with tongs to a serving plate and drizzle with a little sesame oil. To serve, garnish with coriander leaves and serve with small bowls of sweet chilli sauce to dip into.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, white vinegar, water, sesame seeds, unsalted dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, vinegar and water in a medium saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring just until sugar dissolves Continue to cook without stirring until mixture boils. Step 2: Allow to boil without stirring until mixture is golden and reaches 300 f on a candy thermometer, about ten minutes While the sugar mixture is boiling, generously butter an 11" x 7" baking pan. Step 3: Sprinkle half the sesame seeds and all of the peanuts evenly onto the pan. Step 4: When the sugar mixture has reached the requisite temperature, carefully pour the sugar mixture over the nuts in the baking pan Smooth the surface with the back of a buttered wooden spoon. Step 5: Sprinkle with the remaining sesame seeds and cool slightly While candy is still warm, cut into 2" by 1" pieces and then allow to cool completely in the pan. Step 6: Remove from pan and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, baking powder, chinese five spice powder, salt, brown sugar, corn oil, egg, vanilla, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Toast sesame seeds in a frying pan at medium heat Stir them occasionally and watch them like a hawk! Step 2: They will stay light and then suddenly brown in a few seconds - remove them from heat to a small bowl once they are golden brown. Step 3: Combine flour, baking powder, spice powder, salt, brown sugar, corn oil, egg, vanilla in a mixing bowl, mix well. Step 4: Knead dough with hands until slightly rubbery. Step 5: Roll into balls about one inch in diameter. Step 6: Dip each ball into toasted sesame seeds to cover with seeds. Step 7: Place on a cookie sheet Flatten with a fork.

Dish Name: Sesame beef skewers with cucumber salad
Ingredient Names: thin-cut sirloin steaks, stir-fry sauce, sesame seeds, white wine vinegar, light soy sauce, cucumbers, green onions, red chile, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. In a bowl, mix the steak strips with the stir-fry sauce and sesame seeds. Thread onto 12 skewers, then grill for 12 mins, turning halfway through, until golden and sticky. Step 2: For the salad, mix the vinegar and soy together, then toss with the cucumber, spring onions, chilli and coriander. Serve with the beef skewers and some boiled basmati rice.

Dish Name: Spiced sweet potato salad with crisp noodles
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, cumin seed, sunflower oil, fine egg noodles, juice half orange, red wine vinegar, spinach leaves, avocado, half red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Toss the potato chunks with the cumin, 1 tsp oil and some seasoning. Spread over a baking tray, then roast for 20-25 mins until tender and golden. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to pack instructions, then drain. Heat 1cm oil in a wok or deep pan until a piece of noodle dropped in begins to sizzle immediately. Fry the noodles in a couple of batches for 30 secs until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon, then drain well on kitchen paper. Step 3: When the potatoes are ready, whisk together the final tsp of oil with the orange zest and juice, red wine vinegar and a little seasoning. Tip the potatoes into a bowl with the spinach, avocado and red onion, drizzle with the dressing, then gently mix – with your hands is easiest. Divide between 2 plates and crumble over the crispy noodles.

Ingredient Names: wontons, green onions, chili oil, garlic, caster superfine sugar, red chili flakes, sichuan pepper powder, chinese five spice powder, chinese chicken stock powder, chinese chili oil, vegetable oil, light soy sauce, rice vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix spices - Put the garlic, sugar, chilli flakes, sichuan pepper, five spices and stock powder in a medium mixing bowl. Step 2: Heat oil - Heat the chilli oil and vegetable oil in a small frying pan over medium heat until hot. Pour over garlic mixture. Enjoy the sizzle! (Don't worry, it doesn't spit). Step 3: Add sauces: - Whisk in soy sauce, rice vinegar and hot water. The oil will remain a little separated on top. Set aside while you make wontons. Step 4: Cook wontons - Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil. Add wontons and cook until they float: 4 minutes for freshly made, 6 to 8 minutes from frozen. Step 5: Assemble - Transfer to serving dish using a slotted spoon. Pour over sauce, add an extra drizzle of chilli oil (if you dare!), sprinkle with green onion. Serve immediately!

Ingredient Names: pears, honey, cognac
Instructions: Step 1: Slice off the top of pear and save as a lid. Step 2: Fill each pear with 1 tablespoon of each the honey and cognac. Step 3: Place lid back on and steam the pears for about 10 min Or until tender. Step 4: Serve hot Optional: you can place pear atop of your favorite almond or sugar cookie with additional honey drizzled on top.

Ingredient Names: glutinous-rice flour, brown sugar, boiling water, dates, milk, water, white sesame seeds, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the wok for steaming. Step 2: In a bowl, mix the boiling water and the sugar, stirring to dissolve, cool. Step 3: Soak the chinese dates in hot water for at least 30 minutes to soften (you can also Soften them quickly by placing them in a bowl with water and microwaving on high heat for 30 seconds). Step 4: Cut the dates in half and remove the pits. Step 5: Place the glutinous rice flour in a large bowl. Step 6: Make a well in the middle and stir in the sugar and water mixture.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, navel orange, peanut oil, garlic, minced ginger, chili paste with garlic, cornstarch, water, scallion top, chicken broth, soy sauce, chinese rice wine, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet that has a cover. Step 3: Add orange zest, garlic, ginger, and chili paste and stir-fry until fragrant, about 10 seconds. Step 4: Add sweet potatoes and stir-fry until coated, about 30 seconds Re-stir sauce and add to sweet potatoes. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then cook, covered, over moderate heat until sweet potatoes are tender but not soft, 10 - 12 minutes Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to sweet potatoes, stirring until thickened. Step 6: Stir in scallions.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, catsup, soy sauce, sugar, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix it all together in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Turn off immediately and serve with your favorite eggrolls, chicken, pork, veggies-- the possibilities are endless!

Ingredient Names: pork spareribs, brown sugar, sugar, cornstarch, ketchup, vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place ribs on rack in a large shallow pan. Step 2: Bake uncovered at 350°F for an hour and a half. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine sugars and cornstarch in medium size pan over stove. Step 4: Stir in ketchup, vinegar and water; bring to a boil. Step 5: Cook and stir until thickened and clear. Step 6: Remove ribs and rack from pan; discard fat. Step 7: Pour about a cup and a half of the sauce over the ribs. Step 8: Bake 30 minutes longer. Step 9: Cut into serving pieces. Step 10: Brush with remaining sauce. Step 11: Yields 6 to 8 servings! Step 12: Absolutely delicious!

Ingredient Names: pineapple chunks, tomato ketchup malt vinegar cornflour, vegetable oil, onions, red chile, red green pepper, carrots diagonal, skinless chicken breasts, baby corn, tomatoes, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Make the sweet & sour sauce by whisking together the pineapple juice, tomato ketchup, malt vinegar and cornflour. There should be 300ml – add water or stock if you’re short. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan or wok over a high heat. Add the onion, chilli, peppers, carrots and chicken and stir-fry for 3-5 mins until the vegetables are starting to soften and the chicken is almost cooked. Step 3: Add the corn, pineapple and sauce. Bubble for 2 mins, add tomatoes and cook for 2 mins until the sauce thickens, the chicken is cooked and the vegetables are tender. Serve with rice, if you like.

Dish Name: Sweet & sour chicken skewers with fruity noodles
Ingredient Names: pineapple chunks, tomato ketchup, white wine vinegar, skinless chicken thighs, red chilies, red peppers, egg noodles nests, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the pineapple juice, tomato ketchup, vinegar and some seasoning together. Reserve half, then add the rest to a bowl with the chicken and half the red chilli. Marinate for 5 mins. Step 2: Thread the chicken, pepper and half the pineapple onto 8 skewers. Step 3: Heat your grill, or fire up a barbecue. Brush any excess marinade over the skewers, then grill or barbecue, turning regularly, for about 8 mins or until the chicken is starting to char at the edges and is cooked through. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook the noodles following pack instructions, drain, then stir through the remaining pineapple, chilli and spring onions. Serve with the remaining sauce on the side or drizzled on top of the skewers.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, green onions, red pepper seeds, soy sauce, sesame oil, runny honey, fresh egg noodles, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Pull the chicken into strips, then cut it into chunks small enough to pick up on a fork. Put in a large bowl. Step 2: Use your scissors to snip the hairy root ends off the spring onions and throw away. Snip the rest of the spring onion into pieces. Add to the chicken. Step 3: Use scissors or a small knife to cut the pepper into strips and then pieces. Like the chicken you want the pieces to be small enough to pick up. Step 4: Measure the soy sauce, sesame oil (or seeds) and honey into the bowl, mix together. Ask a grown-up helper to cook the noodles at the same time. Step 5: Tip the hot noodles into the bowl and mix everything together with a large spoon or pair of tongs. Step 6: Divide the noodles between 2 bowls and add some fresh coriander to each one, if you like it.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, scallions, garlic, chicken stock, chambord raspberry liquor, rice vinegar, soy sauce, honey, ground black pepper, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a saucepot. Step 2: Add scallions, garlic and ginger, and cook for 20 seconds Do not brown. Step 3: Add chicken stock, chambord, vinegar, soy sauce, honey and pepper, and cook over low heat for two minutes. Step 4: Stir in cornstarch to thicken and cook for an additional two minutes. Step 5: Strain through fine mesh strainer if desired.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, golden brown sugar, salt, pineapple, white vinegar, soya sauce, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Blend dry ingredients in medium sized saucepan till free of lumps. Step 2: Add all liquids and stir well. Step 3: Cook over medium heat, stir constantly as will thicken quickly. Step 4: Add few drops of red food colouring till desired hue achieved. Step 5: Serve over cooked meats, rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, chicken stock, celery, onions, red peppers, green peppers, pineapple juice, brown sugar, vinegar, cornstarch, soya sauce, pineapple chunks
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in strips. Step 2: In large skillet bring chicken and stock to simmer over medium high heat. Step 3: Add celery, onion and sweet peppers. Step 4: Cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and vegetables are tender crisp. Step 5: Mix together juice, vinegar, brown sugar, corn starch and soya sauce until blended Stir into skillet and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cook, stirring, for about 2 minutes until glossy and thickened, add pineapple. Step 7: Simmer for about 2 minutes or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: soft brown sugar, vegetable oil, fresh broccoli, half baby sweetcorn, thai red curry paste, red peppers, thai fish sauce, frozen shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the sugar into a wok, add a splash of water and let it dissolve over a low heat. Once dissolved, turn up the heat until it bubbles, then pour into a heatproof bowl. Step 2: Heat the oil in the wok, then stir-fry the broccoli and sweetcorn for 3 mins until they start to blister. Stir the curry paste into the caramel, then pour into the wok. Add the pepper and continue to cook for 2 mins. Splash in the fish sauce or soy, add the prawns and fry again to heat through. Serve immediately with rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: chinese five-spice powder, clear honey, orange juice, pork loin steaks, bok choi
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the five-spice powder, honey and enough orange juice to loosen, then smear over the chops. Leave to marinate for 10 mins. Step 2: Heat grill to medium, then grill the chops for 4-5 mins on each side, basting with any leftover glaze, until cooked through. Step 3: Steam the heads of bok choi for 2 mins until wilted. Serve with the pork chops, drizzled with any juices and glaze from the grill pan.

Ingredient Names: pineapple filling, pineapple, granulated sugar, cinnamon, salt, corn syrup, all-purpose flour, shortcrust pastry dough, unsalted butter, confectioners' sugar, egg yolks, vanilla, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Pineapple filling: drain the pineapple well over a bowl, pushing on it through a fine mesh strainer to push out as much juice as possible. Step 2: Mix together the sugar, cinnamon and salt, set aside. Step 3: In a saucepan place the strained pineapple and cook over medium heat until all the juice is gone and pineapple appears dry About 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the sugar / cinnamon / salt mix and stir constantly over medium heat and cook until all the juice is absorbed, it appears dry and sticky This will take about 10-15 minutes. Step 5: Add in the corn syrup and cook again until mixture appears sticky and dry This will take about another 10 minutes. Step 6: Add in the flour, stir and cook for about 7 more minutes Mixture will become very sticky and dry.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, powdered sugar, all-purpose flour, baking powder, walnuts, dry roasted salted peanut, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 320 f. Step 2: Line a layer of baking sheet on a baking pan. Step 3: In a mixing bowl, combine butter, powdered sugar, all-purpose flour and baking powder with a fork first Use fingers to mix well and form dough. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Step 5: Add walnut and peanut into the mixing bowl Gently fold nuts into dough. Step 6: Divide into 9 pieces and roll each into a ball. Step 7: Press each dough to make it a little flat, about 2 / 3 inch thick. Step 8: Transfer dough to baking pan.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, water, ground ginger, garlic powder, brown sugar, honey, cornstarch, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all but cornstarch and 1 / 4c water in a sauce pan and begin heating 2. Step 2: Mix cornstarch and cold water in a cup and dissolve. Step 3: Add to sauce in pan 3. Step 4: Heat until sauce thickens to desired thickness 4. Step 5: Add water to thin if you over-thick it.

Ingredient Names: bananas, light muscovado sugar, butter, cream, sesame seeds, vanilla ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the bananas in 2 tbsp of the sugar. Heat a griddle to medium, then cook the bananas, a few pieces at a time, until sticky and showing griddle marks. Keep warm in a low oven. Step 2: For the sauce, put the remaining sugar, the butter and cream into a saucepan and stir over a gentle heat until the sugar has melted. Stir in the sesame seeds. Can be made up to a day ahead. To serve, put a few pieces of banana into 8 serving dishes, spoon over some of the caramel, then top with a scoop of ice cream.

Dish Name: Traditional Chinese Sweet Potato Ginger Dessert Soup
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, fresh gingerroot, water, red dates, raw brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, wash and chop sweet potatoes into chunks. Step 2: Bring water to a boil. Step 3: Add ginger, sweet potatoes and red dates and simmer for 12-15 minutes Upon boiling, add slab sugar and boil until sugar dissolves. Step 4: Serve hot or cold!

Ingredient Names: water, coconut milk, milk, tea, rum extract, sugar syrup, tapioca, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients, except ice and tapioca pearls, in cocktail shaker or thermos or other tightly sealed container and shake for about 10 seconds. Step 2: Place tapioca pearls at bottom of a tall glass and pour liquid mixture over it. Step 3: Add ice and serve with bubble tea straw.

Dish Name: Tsr Version Of Twin Dragon Almond Cookies By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking soda, salt, whole almond, granulated sugar, lard, almond extract, water, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f Use ungreased cookie sheets in a bowl, mix the flour, baking soda and salt. Step 2: In a blender, grind 1 / 2 cup of the almonds to a fine powder. Step 3: Add the ground almonds to the flour mixture In another large bowl, cream the sugar, lard, almond extract, one egg, and the water. Step 4: Add to the dry mixture and mix thoroughly Form the dough into 1-inch balls and place on the cookie sheets, 2-inches apart. Step 5: Press one of the remaining whole almonds into the center of each ball, while flattening the cookie slightly with your fingers. Step 6: Beat the remaining egg well and with a pastry brush, brush each cookie lightly with the beaten egg. Step 7: Bake for 20 minutes, or until cookies are lightly brown around edges.

Ingredient Names: watermelon, lychee, lemon, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the water melon to small cubes of about 1 1 / 2 cm x 1 1 / 2 cm. Step 2: Remove the skin and seed of the lychees Tear them into small pieces. Step 3: Boil a suitable amount of water to dissolve the sugar, let it cool down. Step 4: Squeeze lemon juice into the sauce. Step 5: Add the fruits into the sauce and place the whole thing into the fridge until they are cold enough, serve cool.

Dish Name: Weight Watchers Tomato Egg Drop Soup 2 Pts
Ingredient Names: cooking spray, tomatoes, salt, stevia, fresh ginger, dried chili, chicken broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, egg, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Spray sauce pan, heat to med high. Step 2: Put in chopped tomato, salt and splenda. Step 3: Cook for 6 min, or until tomato is broken down. Step 4: Add broth, ginger, dried chili, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Step 5: Boil for 6 minute 2. Step 6: Whisk egg with egg white. Step 7: Pour slowly in circular motions into soup, stir.

Dish Name: Winter Rice Pudding With Dried Fruits
Ingredient Names: glutinous rice, peanuts, pine nuts, lotus seeds, mixed dried fruit, water, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice in a bowl of cold water for at least 2 hours, drain well. Step 2: Soak the peanuts, pine nuts, and lotus seeds in a separate bowl of cold water for at least 1 hour, drain well. Step 3: Soak the dried fruits as necessary, drain well. Step 4: Chop all the large fruits into small pieces. Step 5: Bring the water to a boil in a pan, then add the sugar and stir until dissolved. Step 6: Add the drained rice, peanuts, pine nuts, lotus seeds, and dried fruits, return to a boil.

Ingredient Names: baby back ribs, chicken stock, gingerroot, five-spice powder, soy sauce, garlic cloves, plum sauce, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, chili paste with garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Place stock, garlic, gingerroot, 5-spice powder and soysauce into a large pan and bring to a simmer. Step 2: Add ribs and simmer slowly, without lid for around 30 minutes. Step 3: Remove the ribs and leave them to cool. Step 4: Boil cooking liquid gently until reduced to about 1 / 2 pt. Step 5: Place ribs on a baking sheet and brush with chinese barbecue sauce. Step 6: Bake in oven at 450 degrees for around 10 mins until sauce has caremelized slightly. Step 7: Heat the reduced liquid and pour over ribs to moisten, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, tamari soy sauce, water, five-spice powder, star anise, molasses
Instructions: Step 1: Cut cakes in half horizontally. Step 2: Combine rest of ingredients in pan large enough to accommodate slices of tofu flat and bring to a boil. Step 3: Add the tofu carefully and lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes, uncovered. Step 4: Remove from heat, cover and marinate 3 hours, turning over occasionally. Step 5: Drain and use or store up to a week, wrapped in plastic.

Dish Name: Al Tipper Gore's Chinese Chicken With Walnuts
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, soy sauce, water, cornstarch, chinese rice wine, sugar, fresh ginger, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, vegetable oil, green peppers, scallions, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the soy sauce with the water, then blend in the cornstarch. Step 2: Stir in the wine, sugar, ginger, red pepper and salt. Step 3: Preheat a wok or large fry pan over high head. Step 4: Add 2 teaspoons of vegetable oil. Step 5: Stir-fry the green peppers and onions for 2 minutes and remove. Step 6: Add the walnuts and stir fry for 1-2 minutes or until golden brown, remove. Step 7: Add the rest of the oil and stir fry the chicken. Step 8: Once the chicken is no longer pink, add the soy sauce mixture. Step 9: Then stir in the vegetables and walnuts, cover and cook until heated through.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, salt, ground black pepper, sesame oil, apricot preserves, tamari soy sauce, pickled ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the pork in about 1 / 2 thick slices and add salt and pepper to both sides for seasoning. Step 2: Chop the ginger into small pieces. Step 3: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add pork and sear 2 minutes per side. Step 5: Add apricot preserves, tamari sauce, ginger and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Simmer 5 minutes, or until pork cooked through and sauce reduces. Step 7: Once done, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, rice vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil, soy sauce, iceberg lettuce, boneless chicken breast halves, green onions, sesame seeds, olive oil, rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Make the dressing: Shake oil, vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil, and soy sauce together in a small lidded container. Step 3: Set aside until salad is ready. Step 4: Make the salad: Combine lettuce, chicken, green onions, and sesame seeds in a large bowl. Step 5: Cover and chill for 1 hour. Step 6: While the salad is chilling, heat oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Step 7: Break rice noodles into pieces and fry in the hot skillet in small batches until they begin to puff up, 15 to 25 seconds. Step 8: Remove to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Step 9: Remove salad from the refrigerator. Step 10: Portion into salad bowls, top with fried rice noodles, and drizzle dressing over top.

Ingredient Names: rice wine vinegar, olive oil, celery seed, chili-garlic sauce, splenda sugar substitute, coleslaw, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a jar with a lid and shake until sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Add to cabbage and mix well. Step 3: Add a little salt if desired. Step 4: Chill for about 30 minutes and serve.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, lemon juice, ground ginger, garlic, pork loin chops, butter
Instructions: Step 1: N a small bowl, combine soy sauce, lemon juice, ginger, and garlic, mix well. Step 2: Place chops in a 9- x 13-inch baking dish and pour soy sauce mixture over top, turning chops to coat thoroughly. Step 3: Cover and chill 2 hours, turning after 1 hour. Step 4: Remove chops from marinade and discard marinade. Step 5: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Step 6: Cook chops 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until cooked through. Step 7: Serve immediately To make a sauce for the pork chops, reseve the marinade and bring it to a boil. Step 8: Simmer 2 to 3 minutes, the pour over the chops.

Dish Name: Asian Turkey Burgers With Spicy Yogurt Sauce
Ingredient Names: lean ground turkey, egg, spinach, dried onion, soy sauce, honey, ginger, salt and pepper, greek yogurt, lemon juice, chili powder, cayenne
