Instructions: Step 1: Mix together turkey, onions, spices, soy sauce, honey and egg Pure spinach using food processor and combine with turkey mixture. Step 2: Heat skillet and put 3 tablespoons olive oil inches brown patties on both sides, remove from skillet and place on a greased baking sheet Finish cooking at 350 degrees until cooked through For yogurt sauce, just combine all ingredients and chill until burgers are cooked. Step 3: Serve asian turkey burgers with spicy yogurt sauce on top!

Ingredient Names: asparagus, canola oil, butter, garlic, ground ginger, granulated sugar, mushroom, soya sauce, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Wash asparagus well Break off bottoms and cut spears diagonally into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces In large frying pan, heat oil and butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add asparagus, garlic and ginger. Step 3: Stir fry one minute. Step 4: Add sugar, cover and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add mushrooms and stir fry for 2 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and stir in soya sauce and sesame oil. Step 7: Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, salt, sugar, slivered almonds, scallions, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Snap off and discard the tough ends of the asparagus. Step 2: Slice the rest on the diagonal Parboil for about two minutes. Step 3: Rinse in cold running water to stop the cooking process and drain. Step 4: Heat the oil and toss the scallions for 15- 20 seconds. Step 5: Add the parboiled asparagus and stir fry on high flame until thoroughly heated. Step 6: Stir in the salt& sugar, then the almonds. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: oil, ginger, green onion, garlic, asparagus, oyster sauce, chicken stock, sugar, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok over medium-low heat. Step 2: Stir-fry ginger, scallion, and garlic until aroma develops, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add asparagus and raise heat. Step 4: Stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Pour in last 4 ingredients. Step 6: Stir-fry quickly over high heat for 3 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.

Ingredient Names: oil, vegetable soup mix, asparagus, water chestnut, wonton wrappers, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In uncovered electric skillet, heat 3 / 4 inch of oil to 360 degrees. Step 2: Meanwhile, in medium bowl combine 1 envelope instant spring vegetable soup mix, asparagus, and water chestnuts. Step 3: Place 2 teaspoons of the mixture on the center of each won ton wrapper Moisten corners with water, fold wrappers in half to form a triangle, and press edges to seal Form won ton by bringing together two opposite points and overlapping Moisten overlapping points and press to seal well. Step 4: Fry in hot oil until golden brown, drain. Step 5: Serve, if desired, with soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, olive oil, sesame oil, ginger, cashews, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut off the tough ends of the asparagus, and then slice diagonally into 2-3 pieces. Step 2: Heat the oil together in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat. Step 3: Add the ginger and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Add the asparagus and stir fry until tender but still a tiny bit crisp, 4-5 minutes. Stir in the cashews and soy sauce. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, garlic cloves, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, vegetable oil, shortening, water, celery, onion, molasses, sliced water chestnuts, bean sprouts, mushrooms, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meat into thin strips. Step 2: Combine 2 tbsp cornstarch with sugar, blend in 1 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp oil, mix to blend. Step 3: Pour over pork strips. Step 4: Toss well to coat, marinade in mixture for 20 minutes. Step 5: In a wok or large saute pan heat 2 tablespoons shortening Brown the meat lightly on all sides in hot shortening. Step 6: Add remaining 4 tbsp soy sauce and 1-1 / 2 cups water. Step 7: Simmer, covered on low heat for 45 minutes. Step 8: Add in the celery and onions.

Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, cornstarch, rice wine vinegar, dry sherry, salt, cabbage, carrots, bamboo shoots, dried shiitake mushrooms, green onion, sugar, white pepper, soy sauce, sesame oil, spring roll wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Mix marinade ingredients well, add pork. Step 2: Mix well and marinate at room temperature for about 20 minutes. Step 3: Saute cabbage and carrots in 1 - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in wok until crisp-tender Alternately, steam vegetables in a bamboo steamer until crisp-tender. Step 4: Spread out on a cookie sheet or jellyroll pan and put in refrigerator until thoroughly cold. Step 5: Saute meat in wok in 1 - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil until no longer pink Continue to saute until all moisture / juices have evaporated Meat should appear dry. Step 6: Spread out on another cookie sheet or jellyroll pan and put in refrigerator until thoroughly cold.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, rice wine, fresh ginger, mixed mushrooms, bamboo shoot, red bell peppers, onion, green onions, zucchini, chicken broth, oyster sauce, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into thin strips, and then into pieces. Step 2: Mix with meat marinade for 30 minutes. Step 3: Slice mushrooms, bamboo shoots, red pepper and zucchini into thin strips. Step 4: Mix sauce Parboil noodles for 3 minutes, rinse and drain. Step 5: Bring another pot of water to boil, and keep hot. Step 6: Heat 2 t Oil in wok. Step 7: Stir fry all vegetables together for 2-3 minutes.

Dish Name: Baby Bok Choy And Mushroom Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: tamari, oyster sauce, sake, olive oil, garlic clove, ginger, carrot, baby bok choy, mushrooms, salt, pepper, potato starch, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix 2 / 3 cup water, tamari, oyster sauce and sake or chinese rice wine. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan Saut garlic and ginger. Step 3: Add carrots and bok choy and cook a few more minutes. Step 4: Add the sauce mixture. Step 5: Cover and cook until vegetables are almost cooked. Step 6: Add mushrooms and cook a few more minutes. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper Dissolve potato starch in 2 tbsp of water. Step 8: Reduce heat and add it to the pan.

Dish Name: Baby Bok Choy With Mushrooms And Tofu
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, cornstarch, vegetable oil, vegetable broth, fresh gingerroot, baby bok choy, fresh shiitake mushrooms, green onion, fish sauce, low sodium soy sauce, sugar, oriental sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: On paper towels, pat tofu dry on all sides. Step 2: Cut tofu crosswise into 1 / 2 inch thick slices On small plate, place cornstarch. Step 3: Heat nonstick wok or large skillet over medium heat until hot. Step 4: Add 2 tbls Oil and swirl to coat pan One at a time, dip tofu slices into cornstarch to coat cut surfaces and place in wok. Step 5: Fry until well browned on one side--about 5 minutes. Step 6: Turn tofu slices and fry other sides until well browned. Step 7: Transfer tofu to center of large serving platter.

Dish Name: Baby Bok Choy With Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, chicken stock, soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, baby bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, combine oyster sauce, stock, soy sauce, sesame oil and cornstarch mixture. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until sauce bubbles and thickens. Step 3: Remove from heat Blanch bok choy in a saucepan of boiling water for 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 4: Remove from pan with a slotted spoon and place on a serving plate. Step 5: Pour oyster sauce over it and serve.

Dish Name: Baked Pork Ribs With Hoisin Barbecue Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork baby back ribs, chinese five spice powder, onion powder, hoisin sauce, bottled chili sauce, sherry wine, chili-garlic sauce, fresh ginger, oriental sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place ribs in large roasting pan Pierce meat with fork. Step 2: Sprinkle with chinese five-spice powder and onion powder Rub mixture into meat. Step 3: Whisk remaining ingredients in small bowl to blend. Step 4: Pour sauce over ribs, turning to coat. Step 5: Turn ribs meat side down. Step 6: Cover pan with aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight. Step 7: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 8: Bake ribs, covered, until just tender, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: milk, egg, boneless skinless chicken breasts, potato starch, all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, shichimi togarashi, oil for frying, mayonnaise, honey, sweet chili sauce, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together milk and egg in a large bowl until well combined. Step 2: Add chicken; stir to coat and allow to marinate for 2 hours. Step 3: Drain and discard egg mixture. Step 4: Combine potato starch, flour, salt, pepper, and shichimi in a medium bowl. Step 5: Pour into a large plastic resealable bag. Step 6: Add chicken; seal the bag and shake until chicken is well coated. Step 7: Heat 2 inches oil in a deep saucepan over medium heat to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 8: Working in batches of about at a time, cook chicken in hot oil for about 90 seconds. Step 9: Remove to a paper towel-lined plate; keep each batch separate. Step 10: Increase oil temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 11: The oil should be continuously boiling at this point. Step 12: Carefully re-add the first batch of chicken and fry for another 90 seconds. Step 13: Remove to another paper towel-lined plate. Step 14: Repeat with remaining batches of chicken. Step 15: Mix together mayonnaise, honey, sweet chili sauce, and gochujang in a large serving bowl until combined. Step 16: Toss fried chicken with sauce to coat, serve and.

Ingredient Names: pork, salt, five-spice powder, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, dry sherry, honey, vegetable oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat off pork and cut meat into pieces about the size of pork chops, 3 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: Combine the marinade ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 3: Dip each piece of pork into the marinade to coat well. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Step 5: Place pork pieces on a barbecue grill over medium heat and barbecue for about 30 minutes or until fully cooked, turning once or twice while cooking During the last 10 minutes, baste with the marinade. Step 6: Line a roasting pan with foil and add some water to prevent smoking. Step 7: Put the pan on the lower rack. Step 8: Place the pork on the upper rack, 3 inches from the heat source Broil pork pieces 2 minutes on each side.

Ingredient Names: pork fillets, soy sauce, dry red wine, honey, brown sugar, red food coloring, garlic clove, shallot, chinese five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, red wine, honey, sugar, food colouring, crushed garlic and halved shallot in a large bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle cinnamon on top, add pork, marinate one hour or cover and refrigerate overnight for best results, turning occasionally. Step 3: Drain pork fillets from marinade, reserve marinade. Step 4: Put pork on wire rack over baking dish. Step 5: Bake in a moderate oven 30 minutes, turning frequently with tongs and basting frequently with marinade. Step 6: Remove from oven, put on board and allow to cool. Step 7: Cut pork into diagonal slices to serve.

Dish Name: Barbecued Roast Pork Tenderloin Char Shui
Ingredient Names: pork fillet, garlic, ginger, sugar, pepper, sesame oil, black bean sauce, hoisin sauce, wine, light soy sauce, five-spice powder, red food coloring, dark soy sauce, oil, golden syrup
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a dish, add the pork and marinate for at least 2 hours, turning occasionally. Step 2: Heat the oven to 180c. Step 3: Place the pork on a rack in the middle of the oven. Step 4: Place a pan with 6mm of water on the bottom rack in the oven and roast for 30 minutes. Step 5: Allow to rest for 10 minutes For the glaze, heat oil in saucepan over moderate heat, stir in golden syrup and soy sauce. Step 6: Spoon over meat just before serving. Step 7: Slice on the diagonal to serve.

Dish Name: Basic Chinese Sauce For Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, rice wine, dark brown sugar, cornflour, water, stock
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cornflour and water together to form a smooth paste. Step 2: Add everything else to the paste and mix well- it will take a little while for the sugar to dissolve. Step 3: Add to meat and / or veg after stir-frying& heat until the sauce has thickened. Step 4: Serve immediately with rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, toasted sesame oil, hot sauce, sugar, vegetable oil, carrot, pork tenderloin, fresh mushrooms, peas, green onions, garlic, fresh ginger, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all sauce ingredients and set aside To a large skillet or wok, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add carrots and stir fry for 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Add pork and continue to saute' 2-3 more minutes Increase heat to medium high and add mushrooms, green onion, garlic, and ginger. Step 4: Saute' 2-3 more minutes. Step 5: Add linguini and sauce and stir fry until heated through, 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Serve immidiately.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, dark soy sauce, dry sherry, garlic, fresh ginger, brown sugar, pork tenderloin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a large zip lock bag. Step 2: Place bag in a bowl. Step 3: Put pork in the bag and seal. Step 4: Let stand at room temperature for 4 hours turn the bag often reserve the marinade for basting cook meat about 4 inches from the heat source If you wish, you can broil in your oven if you do not want to bbq turn often to brown the meat evenly and cook until crisp, basting often About 40 min but it depends on the thickness of the tenderloin so check internal temp with your meat thermometer to be sure you do not over cook it. Step 5: Slice pork thinly and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: pork spareribs, soy sauce, water, sugar, hoisin sauce, gingerroot, garlic, onions, dry sherry, ground black pepper, chicken stock, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch ribs in boiling water for two minutes. Step 2: Mix soy sauce, water, sugar, hoisin sauce, ginger, garlic and diced onion in a small bowl. Step 3: Place ribs into a lightly oiled baking tray to avoid a mess on your bbq and pour over the sauce mixture The tray is also necessary so the sauce can be reserved. Step 4: Cook for 20 minutes over a low heat with the hood of the bbq closed. Step 5: Add the sherry and season with pepper, stir to mix and turn over the ribs Continue cooking over low temperature with hood down for another 40 minutes, stirring and turning ribs several times. Step 6: Turn the grill section of the bbq to high and transfer the ribs to the grill. Step 7: Cook around 5 minutes a side until they are crisp and well browned. Step 8: Blend chicken stock and cornflour together.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, dark sesame oil, peanut oil, garlic, fresh ginger root, mixed vegetables, flank steak, reduced-sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, oyster sauce, chile paste
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain and transfer to a large bowl. Step 3: Drizzle sesame oil over the spaghetti; toss to coat. Step 4: Place a plate atop the bowl to keep the noodles warm. Step 5: Heat peanut oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Cook and stir garlic and ginger in hot oil until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 7: Add mixed vegetables to the skillet; cook and stir until slightly tender, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir flank steak into the vegetable mixture; cook and stir until the beef is cooked through, about 2 minutes. Step 9: Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, oyster sauce, and chile paste together in a small bowl; pour over the spaghetti. Step 10: Dump spaghetti and sauce mixture into the wok with the vegetables and steak; cook and stir until the spaghetti is hot, 2 to.

Ingredient Names: beef filet, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, fresh ginger root, green bell pepper, carrot, beef broth, cornstarch, white sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium high heat, saute the beef slices in the oil for 3-4 minutes, or until well browned. Step 2: Add the onion, garlic and ginger and saute for 5 more minutes. Step 3: Then add the green bell pepper, carrot and beef broth. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and let simmer. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a separate small bowl, combine the corn flour, sugar, soy sauce and oyster sauce, if desired. Step 6: Stir thoroughly, forming a smooth paste. Step 7: Slowly add this to the simmering beef and vegetables, stirring well, and let simmer to desired thickness. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, tomatoes, red pepper, green peppers, chili pepper, garlic cloves, garlic, celery, green onion, gingerroot, salt, cooking oil, sugar, white pepper, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into approximately 1 inch cubes. Step 2: Heat the wok with oil. Step 3: When hot, add the chicken pieces until golden brown. Step 4: Flip and reduce heat. Step 5: Add the beer to the wok, until it half covers the fish. Step 6: Add all peppers, garlic, ginger, garlic root Increase heat and add pinch of salt, pinch of white pepper, pinch of sugar, 1 tsp oyster sauce, 1 / 2 tsp soy sauce. Step 7: Cover and cook 4 minutes. Step 8: Put a pinch of corn starch in water and mix. Step 9: After the 4 minutes, put the tomatoes in the wok and then turn the chicken over.

Dish Name: Best Ever Stir Fried Chinese Cabbage
Ingredient Names: chinese cabbage, garlic cloves, chili, dried scallops, dried shrimp, vegetable oil, oyster sauce, salt, soy sauce, chinese wine, cornflour, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dried scallops and dried shrimp in hot water or put it in the microwave for 5 minutes on high and slice the chili and garlic as well as roughly chopping the chinese cabbage. Step 2: Once the dried scallops have significantly soften, drain them while reserving liquid. Step 3: Heat oil in pan and brown the garlic slices. Step 4: Once garlic is browned, remove half the browned garlic slices and set aside. Step 5: Then add the chilies and then the soaked dried scallops and shrimp and fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Add the chinese cabbage and fry till it slightly wilts and then add then cooking wine, oyster sauce, the soaking liquid. Step 8: Season with soy sauce to taste. Step 9: Cook cabbage for a further 3-5 minutes till cooked but retaining a bit of crunch and then thicken with corn flour. Step 10: Garnish with the crunchy garlic slices and enjoy!

Dish Name: Better Than Takeout Chicken Fried Rice From Rachel Schultz
Ingredient Names: rice, boneless skinless chicken breast, peas and carrots, white onion, garlic cloves, eggs, sesame oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, peas, and carrots. Step 3: Stir fry until tender Crack eggs into pan and scramble, mixing throughout vegetables. Step 4: Add rice, and chicken to pan. Step 5: Stir in soy sauce and remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: black bean sauce, peanut oil, toasted sesame oil, yellow onions, garlic cloves, low sodium chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, broccoli florets, boneless skinless chicken breast, cornstarch, dry sherry, toasted sesame seeds, green onion, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: If using fermented beans in whole bean form, place the beans in a bowl and cover with warm water. Step 2: Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Step 3: Drain and rinse with cold water, drain well. Step 4: Cut the chicken breasts into thin, 1 / 4-inch strips This can be done easier if the breasts are partially frozen, by the way, but it can be done while theyre thawed, as well Do cut them into the strips rather than chunks, as black bean chicken tastes completely different if chunks are used. Step 5: In a large, nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high temperature, heat the oils together. Step 6: Add the onion and garlic and saut while stirring for 30 seconds to flavor the oil. Step 7: Add bean sauce or whole beans and saut for 10 seconds.

Dish Name: Black Pepper Beef and Cabbage Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, ground beef, cabbage, red bell pepper, soy sauce, cornstarch, water, ground black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Gather ingredients. Step 2: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat, and add oil. Step 3: Saute garlic for about 5 seconds, then add ground beef. Step 4: Stir-fry until beef is evenly brown, 5 to; drain excess fat. Step 5: Stir in cabbage and pepper, and cook until vegetables are tender and beef is fully cooked. Step 6: Stir in soy sauce. Step 7: Mix together cornstarch and water, and stir in. Step 8: Season with pepper; add salt to taste. Step 9: Cook, stirring, until sauce has thickened, serve hot and.

Dish Name: Blanched Gai Lan With Oyster Sauce Chinese Broccoli
Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, cornstarch, chicken stock, rice wine, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic clove, gai lan, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the oyster sauce, cornstarch, chicken stock, rice wine, sugar, soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil in a small saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil and cook until sauce thickens, set aside. Step 3: Wash the gai lan in cold water Trim off and discard the tough bottoms Peel stalks if they are thick and tough. Step 4: Leave gai lan whole or cut into thirds. Step 5: Bring 1-3 quarts of water to a boil in a wok and add the soy and oil. Step 6: Add the greens, bring back to a second boil with lid on. Step 7: Turn off the heat and let greens steam for a minute or two.

Ingredient Names: bok choy, garlic powder, ginger powder, oyster sauce, sesame oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Tear the bok choy leaves apart. Step 2: Cut the leaves from the stems. Step 3: Cut the stems into thin strips. Step 4: Drop the cut stems into a pot of a quart of boiling salted water. Step 5: Reduce heat to a simmer, and simmer until the stems are tender, drain the water. Step 6: Add the leaves and the rest of the ingredients and stir-fry until the leaves are wilted, and then serve.

Ingredient Names: bok choy, butter, flour, salt, nutmeg, light cream, swiss cheese, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Boil bok choy for 5 minutes, drain well, preheat broiler. Step 2: Place bok choy in ungreased square oven dish In 1 quart saucepan, melt 1 tbsp butter over low heat. Step 3: Stir in flour, salt, and nutmeg. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until smooth Quickly add cream and cheese, heat to boiling, stirring. Step 5: Boil and stir 1 minutes. Step 6: Pour over bok choy.

Ingredient Names: chinese cabbage, vegetable oil, salt, sugar, stock, cornstarch, water, milk, ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Separate the leaves and cut each in half length-wise, then cross-wise. Step 2: Heat 4 t of the oil in a wok until hot. Step 3: Add cabbage and fry for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add salt & sugar and mix well. Step 5: Remove from pan when tender. Step 6: Heat 1 t oil in the wok. Step 7: Add stock and bring to a boil. Step 8: Put cornstarch in water, mix well. Step 9: Add cornstarch mix & milk to stock, stirring well about 1 minute until thick. Step 10: Pour 1 / 2 the stock mix into a container.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, all-purpose flour, sesame oil, chicken broth, soy sauce, sherry wine, onion, garlic clove, ground ginger, pepper, dried red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place 4 tbls Flour in a large zip-type plastic bag. Step 2: Place 1 / 4 of the meat in bag, shaking until meat is covered with flour. Step 3: Remove meat to plate. Step 4: Repeat with remaining meat, in batches, adding more flour if needed. Step 5: Heat oil in dutch oven or large skillet. Step 6: Add half of meat and brown quickly. Step 7: Remove meat and set aside Brown remaining meat. Step 8: Remove and set aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, broccoli, peanut oil, fresh ginger, green onion, garlic clove, oyster sauce, sugar, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to boil in medium saucepan. Step 2: Add broccoli stems, cover and cook until crisp-tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 3: Drain, reserving 1 / 2 cup broth. Step 4: Heat oil in wok or large skillet. Step 5: Add ginger, onion and garlic and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 6: Add broccoli stems and florets and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Add oyster sauce, sugar and 1 / 2 cup broth and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 8: Stir in dissolved cornstarch mixture and cook briefly until thickened.

Dish Name: Broccoli N Red Peppers Stir Fried
Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, lite olive oil, sesame seed oil, garlic, fresh ginger, onion, broccoli, sweet red pepper, button mushroom, chicken stock, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large skillet heat oils over high heat. Step 2: Stir fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, remove garlic& ginger and discard. Step 3: Add onions stir fry 1 minute. Step 4: Add mushrooms, stir fry 1 minute. Step 5: Add broccoli, stir fry 1 minute. Step 6: Add red pepper and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 7: Add stock& soy sauce, bring to a simmer for about 1 minute or until the veggies are cooked to your liking. Step 8: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.

Ingredient Names: broccoli florets, carrot, water, cornstarch, chicken bouillon granules, salt, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add broccoli and cook uncovered until bright green, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer broccoli to a bowl of ice water using a slotted spoon and immerse for several minutes to stop the cooking process, drain. Step 4: Bring water back to a boil in the same large pot; add sliced carrot and cook for 10 minutes, drain. Step 5: Mix water and cornstarch together in a bowl until smooth. Step 6: Add chicken granules and salt and mix well. Step 7: Heat peanut oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat; saute broccoli and carrots for 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Add cornstarch mixture; cook and stir until vegetables are coated evenly, 1 to.

Ingredient Names: meat drippings, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the ingredients, adding the cornstarch last Bring to a boil, stirring.

Ingredient Names: chicken tenders, oyster sauce, cornstarch, peanut oil, scallions, ginger, garlic cloves, mushrooms, baby bok choy, low sodium chicken broth, toasted sesame oil, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the chicken with the oyster sauce in a bowl. Step 2: Mix the cornstarch with 3 tablespoons cold water in another bowl. Step 3: Place both bowls near the stove with the remaining ingredients. Step 4: Heat a wok or deep skillet over high heat until hot. Step 5: Add the peanut oil, then the scallions, ginger and garlic, and stir-fry about 20 seconds. Step 6: Add the chicken mixture and stir-fry until the meat is no longer pink on the outside, 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the mushrooms and bok choy. Step 8: Add the broth and sesame oil to the skillet and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 9: Add the cornstarch mixture, return to a boil and cook, tossing, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick and glossy, 2 - 3 minutes. Step 10: Serve with rice, if desired.

Ingredient Names: water, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, ground black pepper, skinless boneless chicken breast half, chicken broth, oyster sauce, white sugar, canola oil, chow mein noodles, celery, carrot, bean sprouts, onion, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk water, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, and black pepper together in a bowl until marinade is smooth. Step 2: Add chicken and marinate, about 2 hours. Step 3: Stir chicken broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice wine vinegar, and sugar together in a bowl until seasoning mixture is well combined. Step 4: Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir noodles until golden brown and crisp, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Transfer noodles to a platter. Step 6: Pour the remaining into skillet with the oil; cook and stir chicken over high heat until no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add seasoning mixture, celery, carrot, bean sprouts, onion, and green onion; cook and stir until sauce thickens, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Pour chicken mixture over noodles.

Ingredient Names: wild ducks, orange, celery leaves, salt, apricot preserves, water, prepared mustard, soy sauce, lemon juice, msg
Instructions: Step 1: Season both ducks inside and out with salt. Step 2: Place half the orange wedges and a few celery leaves into the cavity of each bird. Step 3: Place birds, breast side up, on rack in shallow roasting pan Roast uncovered in a hot oven for 1 hour or until tender If necessary, cover pan with foil to prevent excess browning. Step 4: Prepare sauce by combining all ingredients in a sauce pan. Step 5: Heat through, stirring constantly During the last 10 minutes of roasting, baste ducks occasionally with sauce. Step 6: Remove ducks from oven, discard stuffing.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, vegetable oil, pineapple chunks in juice, tomato sauce, mushrooms, onion, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, salt, white vinegar, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tenderloins in half, lengthwise. Step 2: Then cut into 1 / 4 inch slices. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet and brown slices over medium low heat. Step 4: Place pork in crockpot. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients, except rice. Step 6: Cook on high for 4 hours or 6 to 8 hours on low. Step 7: Serve over hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, milk, fine dry breadcrumb, flour, seasoning salt, pepper, garlic powder, oil, onion, garlic, cornstarch, cold water, tomatoes, ketchup, hp steak sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a baking dish. Step 2: In a shallow dish, combine breadcrumbs, flour and seasoning salt pepper and garlic powder. Step 3: Dip the pork chops in milk, then into breadcrumb mixture Brown in hot oil on both sides, drain fat. Step 4: Place the pork chops in prepared baking dish To make the sauce: in the same frypan saut onion and garlic for about 5-6 minutes. Step 5: Add in tomatoes with juice, and remaining ingredients bring to a boil, and simmer about 15 minutes. Step 6: Mix cornstarch with cold water. Step 7: Add into tomato mixture, and cook, stirring until thickened.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, salt, pepper, five-spice powder, egg, cornstarch, oil, garlic, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, pineapple chunks in juice, wine vinegar, sugar, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a saucecpan with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add the pork and boil until it changes color. Step 3: Drain the pork and pat dry, set aside. Step 4: Mix together the salt, pepper, 5 spice powder, sherry, egg and cornstarch. Step 5: Add the pork and toss to coat well. Step 6: Heat the oil to 350 degrees Deep fry the pork until brown, drain. Step 7: Heat 2 t of oil in a wok over high heat.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, teriyaki sauce, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, celery ribs, green onions, vegetable oil, chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, cashews, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in thin strips, place in shallow dish. Step 2: Combine teriyaki sauce, ginger and garlic, pour over chicken. Step 3: Cover and chill 1 hour. Step 4: Drain chicken, discard marinade. Step 5: Stir fry celery, and onions in 1 tbs oil in large skillet 3 minutes. Step 6: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 7: Stir fry chicken in remaining oil 4 minutes. Step 8: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 9: Mix broth, cornstarch and soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, peanut oil, white sugar, shaoxing wine, fresh ginger, star anise, dried red chilies, cinnamon stick, light soy sauce, salt, sugar, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Plunge the pork into a pan of boiling water and simmer for 3-4 minutes until partially cooked. Step 2: Remove and, when cool enough to handle, cut in bite-sized chunks. Step 3: Heat the oil and sugar in a wok over low heat until the sugar melts, then raise the heat and stir until the melted sugar turns a rich caramel brown. Step 4: Add the pork and splash in the wine. Step 5: Add enough water just to cover the pork, along with the ginger, star anise, chilies and cinnamon stick. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then turn down the heat and simmer for 40-50 minutes Toward the end of the cooking time, turn up the heat to reduce the sauce, and season with soy sauce, salt and a little sugar to taste. Step 7: Add the scallion greens just before serving.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, soy sauce, honey, dry sherry, hoisin sauce, five-spice powder, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut small incisions in pork at 1 inch intervals. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients together. Step 3: Place pork in a large plastic bag, pour marinade over, refrigerate overnight, turning a few times. Step 4: Heat broiler and position rack 6 inches from heat. Step 5: Put a rack in a roasting pan, place pork on rack. Step 6: Add 1 / 4-inch of water to the pan. Step 7: Cook 15-25 minutes until a thermometer registers 145f.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, honey, ketchup, brown sugar, chinese rice wine, hoisin sauce, red bean curd, chinese five-spice powder, pork tenderloins
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Stir soy sauce, honey, ketchup, brown sugar, rice wine, hoisin sauce, red bean curd, and five-spice powder together in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Step 3: Cook and stir until just combined and slightly warm, 2 to. Step 4: Meanwhile, slice each pork tenderloin lengthwise into 1 陆- to 2-inch-thick strips. Step 5: Place pork strips in a large, resealable plastic bag. Step 6: Pour marinade into the bag with the pork. Step 7: Squeeze air from the bag, seal, and turn the bag a few times until pork is well coated. Step 8: Marinate in the refrigerator, to overnight. Step 9: When ready to cook, preheat a charcoal grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Step 10: Remove pork from marinade and shake to remove excess liquid. Step 11: Set aside the remaining marinade for basting. Step 12: Rake the hot coals into two equal piles on opposite sides of the charcoal grate. Step 13: Add a small container of water to the grate. Step 14: Place pork strips in the center of the grate for indirect cooking. Step 15: Cook pork over indirect heat, turning regularly and basting as desired, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), or longer, serve hot and.

Dish Name: Char Siu Chinese Sweet Barbecued Pork
Ingredient Names: pork, garlic cloves, salt, fresh ginger, soy sauce, honey, wine, chinese five spice powder, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the fat from the pork and cut into chunks Each chunk should be between 2-4 bites. Step 2: Blend all remaining ingredients The pork and marinade should be fairly bright red- add enough food coloring to give it a nice color. Step 3: Marinate for at least 3 and preferable 24 hours Broil or grill for 3-4 minutes on a side or until the pork is done through.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, pork, shallots, green beans, snow peas, char siu sauce, water, walnuts, fresh egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over a high heat. Step 2: Add 1 teaspoon of oil and swirl it around the wok. Step 3: Cook the pork strips in batches for 1-2 minutes or until golden, adding a little more oil if necessary. Step 4: Transfer to a large plate. Step 5: Add the the green shallots, beans and snow peas to the wok and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Add 2 tablespoons of water, cover the wok and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Add the char siu sauce, the remaining tablespoon of water, the walnuts and the pork. Step 8: Toss until well combined and heated through. Step 9: Spoon the noodles or rice onto the serving plates. Step 10: Top with the stir-fry and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: pork fillets, char siu sauce, hoisin sauce, vegetable oil, tortillas, spring onions, carrot, red capsicum, toothpicks
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork and sauces in a medium bowl, toss to coat. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, or overnight. Step 3: Drain the pork, reserving the marinade. Step 4: Heat the oil in a hot wok. Step 5: Add the pork in two batches. Step 6: Stir-fry for 5 minutes or until it is just cooked through. Step 7: Remove from the wok and cover to keep warm while cooking the second batch. Step 8: Place the reserved marinade in a small saucepan. Step 9: Bring to the boil and gently simmer for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, cornstarch, dry sherry, dark soy sauce, bamboo shoots, tomatoes, fresh ginger, garlic, scallions, szechuan hot bean sauce, vinegar, chicken stock, sugar, ketchup, chinese chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Szechuan peppercorns are available in chinese groceries To use, put a teaspoon or two of them in a dry skillet Toast over medium heat until they start to smoke It takes less than a minute or two Crush them with a rolling pin or in a mortar and pestle. Step 2: Strain the crushed peppercorns through a little mesh strainer, discard the hulls. Step 3: Heat wok until smoking hot. Step 4: Pour in 3- 4 t oil. Step 5: Stir fry chicken until just cooked. Step 6: Remove to a colander and let excess oil drain into a bowl.

Ingredient Names: water, rice vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, green onions, boneless skinless chicken breast, sesame oil, celery, carrot, broccoli, chinese pea pod, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a glass dish, combine water, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, onions and chicken and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Step 2: Drain chicken and reserve marinade. Step 3: In a large skillet or wok, heat sesame oil over medium-high heat until hot. Step 4: Add chicken and cook, stirring constantly, until chicken loses it's pink color. Step 5: Remove chicken add celery, carrots, and broccoli and cook, stirring, for at least 3 minutes. Step 6: Add pea pods and marinade and cover. Step 7: Let vegetables steam for 2-3 minutes add chicken and sesame seeds and stir to combine vegetables should be crisp-tender, pea pods still bright and green, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, green bell pepper, onion, celery, carrots, boiling water, soy sauce, chicken bouillon cube, salt, white sugar, bok choy, bean sprouts, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken; cook until golden on the outside and no longer pink in centers, 5 to. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in the same skillet. Step 5: Add bell pepper, onion, celery, and carrots. Step 6: Combine boiling water, soy sauce, bouillon cube, salt, and sugar in a bowl; add to bell pepper mixture. Step 7: Bring to a simmer; cook until carrots are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Add bok choy and bean sprouts; cook until bok choy is tender, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Return chicken to the skillet. Step 10: Combine water and cornstarch in a bowl; stir into skillet. Step 11: Simmer until broth thickens, 3 to.

Ingredient Names: egg, water, butter, vegetable oil, onion, cooked white rice, cooked chicken, soy sauce, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Beat egg and water together in small bowl. Step 3: Melt butter in a large skillet or wok over medium-low heat; add egg and cook without stirring, 1 to. Step 4: Remove egg from skillet and cut into shreds; set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in the same skillet. Step 6: Add onion; cook and stir until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in rice, chicken, soy sauce, and pepper. Step 8: Cook and stir for about 5 minutes; stir in shredded egg, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: skinless boneless chicken breast, oyster sauce, soy sauce, vegetable oil, garlic, onion, water, ground black pepper, white sugar, water chestnuts, snow peas, broccoli, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken, oyster sauce, and soy sauce in a mixing bowl until the chicken is evenly coated with the sauce; set aside. Step 2: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 3: Stir in the garlic and onion; cook and stir until the onion is limp, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken and marinade. Step 5: Cook and stir until the chicken has browned and is no longer pink, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Pour in water; season with pepper and sugar. Step 7: Add the water chestnuts, snow peas, and broccoli. Step 8: Cover; boil until the vegetables are just tender, about 10 minutes. Step 9: Dissolve the cornstarch in water. Step 10: Stir into the boiling mixture; cook until thick and no longer cloudy.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, ground ginger, vegetable oil, skinless boneless chicken breast halves, garlic, sliced fresh mushrooms, water chestnuts, snow peas, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the chicken broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, and ginger together in a small bowl; reserve. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok. Step 3: Cook and stir chicken and garlic in the oil until chicken is cooked through, 8 to. Step 4: Stir in mushrooms, water chestnuts, and reserved chicken broth mixture. Step 5: Cook until sauce begins to thicken, 3 to. Step 6: Stir snow peas into the pan and cook until tender, 3 to. Step 7: Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, water, light soy sauce, white sugar, salt, skinless boneless chicken breast halves, bean sprouts, oyster sauce, vegetable oil, black bean sauce, garlic, onion, bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To make the marinade: Mix cornstarch with water in a bowl; stir in light soy sauce, sugar, and salt. Step 2: Add chicken; toss to combine. Step 3: Set aside to marinate for 2 hours. Step 4: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. Step 5: Add bean sprouts; cook just until blanched, about 30 seconds; drain and set aside. Step 6: Combine water, oyster sauce, and sugar together in a small bowl; set aside. Step 7: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over high heat. Step 8: Add black bean sauce and chopped garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Add onion; cook and stir until soft, 3 to. Step 10: Add chicken and marinade mixture; stir-fry until cooked through and no longer pink in the middle, about 4 to. Step 11: Stir in oyster sauce mixture; cook until heated through. Step 12: Cover and simmer until flavors blend, about 1 or. Step 13: Stir in bell pepper; cover and cook until softened, 1 to more. Step 14: Dissolve cornstarch in water. Step 15: Stir in bean sprouts and cornstarch mixture; cook until sauce is thickened, 2 to more.

Ingredient Names: spareribs, peanut oil, garlic, dry sherry, chili bean paste, water, hoisin sauce, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork in a large pot with water to cover. Step 2: Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes, drain well. Step 3: Place all the remaining ingredients and the pork ribs in a wok. Step 4: Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Step 5: Drain, reserving 1 cup liquid. Step 6: Heat a clean wok and sear the pork until browned. Step 7: Add the reserved liquid and cook over medium until it glazes. Step 8: Chop the pork into bite size pieces and serve.

Ingredient Names: spareribs, preserved bean curd, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper, garlic paste
Instructions: Step 1: Cut spare ribs into 2" long pieces and put in marinating dish. Step 2: Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. Step 3: Marinate for at least one hour or up to 8 hours Pre-heat oven to 450-degrees f. Step 4: Bake ribs in oven for 30 minutes, turning and brushing with marinade every 10 minutes, or until done.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, garlic clove, sugar, salt, sherry wine, soy sauce, honey, five-spice powder, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into strips, 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: Combine garlic, sugar, salt, sherry, soy sauce, honey, five-spice, and food coloring. Step 3: Pour over meat and marinate for at least 1 hour. Step 4: Remove meat from marinade and roast in a 325' oven for 1-1 / 2 hours basting frequently with the marinade and drippings.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, brown sugar, pepper, garlic clove, brandy, honey, salt, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients Cook over low heat 10 minutes Brush onto ribs or chicken and barbecue.

Ingredient Names: sherry wine, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, garlic cloves, black bean paste, chinese five spice powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a double boiler and simmer for 10 minutes or until it begins to thicken Or cook over very low heat, stirring constantly.

Dish Name: Chinese Barbecued Pork Char Siu Cook's Illustrated
Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, sugar, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, white pepper, five-spice powder, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, ketchup, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork butt in half lengthwise. Step 2: Turn each half on cut side and slice each half into 4 equal pieces Trim excess hard, waxy fat, leaving some fat to render while cooking. Step 3: Using fork, prick each piece of pork on all sides. Step 4: Place pork in large plastic zipper-lock bag. Step 5: Combine sugar, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sherry, pepper, five-spice powder, sesame oil, ginger and garlic in medium bowl Measure out 1 / 2 cup marinade and set aside. Step 6: Pour remaining marinade into bag with pork. Step 7: Press out as much air as possible Seal bag.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, brown sugar, five-spice powder, salt, ground red pepper, cooking spray, hoisin sauce, orange juice, dark sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Combine sugar and next 3 ingredients Rub pork with spice mixture. Step 3: Place pork on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray. Step 4: Insert a meat thermometer into thickest portion of tenderloin. Step 5: Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. Step 6: Combine hoisin, orange juice, and sesame oil in a small bowl, brush over tenderloin. Step 7: Bake for an additional 15 minutes or until thermometer registers 160 degrees.

Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, hoisin sauce, honey, soy sauce, chili powder, green onion, pork spareribs
Instructions: Step 1: Grill directions: Heat grill In small bowl, combine all ingredients except spareribs, mix well, set aside. Step 2: When ready to grill, place spareribs 6 to 8 inches from medium coals, brush with sauce, cover. Step 3: Cook 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours or until meat is tender and starts to pull away from bone, brushing frequently with additional sauce To serve, cut ribs apart carefully with knife and arrange on platter.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, honey, chinese rice wine, hoisin sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, garlic, chinese five-spice powder, ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, pink curing salt, boneless pork butt, red food coloring, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place soy sauce, honey, rice wine, hoisin sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, garlic, five-spice powder, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and curing salt in a saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil on high heat; reduce heat to medium-high. Step 3: Cook for 15-20 minutes, remove from heat. Step 4: Cool to room temperature. Step 5: Cut pork in half lengthwise. Step 6: Cut each half again lengthwise forming 4 long, thick pieces of pork. Step 7: Transfer cooled sauce to a large mixing bowl. Step 8: Stir in red food coloring. Step 9: Place pork sections into sauce and coat each piece. Step 10: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 4 to. Step 11: Preheat grill for medium heat, 275 to 300 degrees F (135 to 150 degrees C) and lightly oil the grate. Step 12: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 13: Remove sections of pork from marinade and let excess drip off. Step 14: Place on prepared baking sheet. Step 15: Sprinkle with kosher salt to taste. Step 16: Transfer pork sections to grate over indirect heat on the prepared grill. Step 17: Cover and cook for about 8-10 minutes. Step 18: Brush with marinade; turn. Step 19: Continue cooking until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), about 5 minutes and more. Step 20: Do not use any more marinade on cooked meat until after you boil it. Step 21: Place leftover marinade in a saucepan; bring to a boil; let simmer for 15-20 minutes, remove from heat. Step 22: Now you can use it to brush over the cooked pork.

Ingredient Names: sugar, salt, five-spice powder, garlic clove, fresh ginger, ketchup, soy sauce, white wine, hoisin sauce, honey, boneless lean pork
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl large enough for the pork and set aside Trim pork to remove visible fat. Step 2: Slice into thin slices. Step 3: Add pork to sauce and stir to cover meat. Step 4: Marinate at least 1 hour, but can sit in fridge overnight. Step 5: Place pork with its marinade in an ovenproof dish. Step 6: Bake at 375 for 45 minutes to 1 hour Consider making extra and serve with rice.

Dish Name: Chinese Bbq Pork With Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, ketchup, soy sauce, garlic, sugar, pork tenderloin, rice vinegar, chili oil, fresh coriander leaves, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Make barbecued pork: preheat oven to 350f and line a shallow baking pan with foil. Step 2: In a small bowl whisk together hoisin sauce, ketchup, soy sauce, garlic, and sugar. Step 3: Put pork tenderloin in baking pan and coat with hoisin sauce mixture Roast pork in middle of oven 35 to 40 minutes, or until a meat thermometer inserted in center registers 160f. Step 4: Cool pork completely in baking pan. Step 5: Make garlic sauce while pork is cooling: in a small bowl stir together sauce ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Step 6: Transfer pork to a cutting board and with a knife held at a 45 angle cut meat across grain into thin slices. Step 7: Arrange pork, overlapping slices slightly, over noodles. Step 8: Spoon garlic sauce over pork and sprinkle pork with coriander. Step 9: Serve with curried, stir-fry noodles.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, oil, flank steaks, green pepper, soy sauce, onion, dry sherry, beef bouillon cube, garlic, boiling water, ground ginger, cornstarch, ground black pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice beef on the diagonal. Step 2: Place in a snug-fitting bowl. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, sherry, garlic, and black pepper. Step 4: Pour over meat, tossing to coat completely. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate 8 to 10 hours. Step 6: In a large skillet or wok, heat oil. Step 7: Add green pepper and onion saute for 2 minutes Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water. Step 8: Add beef and marinate. Step 9: Bring to boiling point.

Dish Name: Chinese Black Bean Sauce Moosewood Style
Ingredient Names: dry sherry, red wine vinegar, fresh lime juice, garlic, fresh ginger, fish sauce, sugar, chili sauce, black beans, vegetable broth, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the sherry, vinegar, lime juice. Step 2: Add the garlic and ginger, and cook over medium high heat for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in the fish sauce, sugar, chili sauce, black beans, and vegetable broth. Step 4: Bring the sauce to a boil: reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Whisk in the dissolved cornstarch, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens slightly This can be made ahead and refirgerated for up to 1 week Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: broccoli, homemade chicken broth, rice wine, ginger juice, cornstarch, salt, sugar, vegetable oil, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the broccoli stalks in half lengthwise if more than 1 / 2 inch in diameter. Step 2: Cut the stalks and leaves into 2-inch-long pieces, keeping the stalk ends separate from the leaves. Step 3: In a small bowl combine the broth, rice wine, ginger juice, cornstarch, salt, and sugar. Step 4: Heat a 14-inch flat-bottomed wok over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes within 1 to 2 seconds of contact Swirl in the oil, add the ginger, and stir-fry 10 seconds or until the ginger is fragrant. Step 5: Add only the broccoli stalks and stir-fry 1 to 1-1 / 2 minutes until the stalks are bright green. Step 6: Add the leaves and stir-fry 1 minute until the leaves are just limp. Step 7: Stir the broth mixture and swirl it into the wok. Step 8: Stir-fry 1 minute or until the sauce has thickened slightly and lightly coats the vegetables.

Ingredient Names: chinese mustard, peanut oil, oyster sauce, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Toast sesame seeds in fry pan, until fragrant About 1 minute. Step 2: Stir fry broccoli in peanut oil until it is bright green, 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add oyster sauce and sesame oil. Step 4: Sprinkle over sesame seeds and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cucumbers, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken in boiling water, cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Step 2: Take out, let cool, and shred Peel cucumbers into strips, skin and all, and put the strips in a large bowl. Step 3: Put chicken shreds on cucumber, mix the sauce and pour on top. Step 4: Sprinkle scallions on top of salad.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, onion, cooked chicken meat, soy sauce, carrots, celery, red bell pepper, snow peas, green bell pepper, cooked white rice, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and saut茅 until soft. Step 3: Add cooked chicken and soy sauce; stir-fry for 5 to. Step 4: Stir in carrots, celery, red bell pepper, pea pods, and green bell pepper; stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Mix in cooked rice until thoroughly combined. Step 6: Stir in scrambled eggs and soy sauce; cook until heated through and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: beef, oil, salt, soya sauce, minced garlic clove, onion, celery, mushrooms, bean sprouts, cornstarch, chinese noodles, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in fry pan. Step 2: Add the meat, salt, soya sauce, and garlic Brown quickly and remove from pan To the pan add onion, celery, mushrooms, and bean sprouts and fry a few minutes, add meat. Step 3: Mix cornstarch with mushroom liquid and add to pan. Step 4: Heat until hot and thickened Chinese noodles may be added before serving Service with rice Serves 4.

Dish Name: Chinese Coin Purse Eggs With Ginger Spinach
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, fresh spinach, dry sherry, soy sauce, vegetable oil, eggs, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Spinach: set a wok or heavy skillet over high heat until very hot. Step 2: Add both oils and heat until smoking, then add the ginger, garlic and red pepper flakes and stir-fry until fragrant, 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the spinach and stir until slightly wilted but still brightly colored, no less than 1 minute. Step 4: Remove the wok from the heat and toss the spinach with the sherry and soy sauce. Step 5: Turn the spinach onto a warmed platter and keep it warm while the eggs cook Coin-purse eggs: heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add the oil, swirling to coat the bottom of the pan Crack each egg into a saucer and then add it to the hot oil, as for regular fried eggs. Step 7: Cook until the bottoms are set, about 1 minute. Step 8: Then fold each fried egg over into a half-moon shape, enclosing the yolk and pressing the edges of the white to seal it closed like a coin purse.

Ingredient Names: pork, onion, green pepper, fresh mushrooms, tomato sauce, carrots, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown pork strips in small amount of oil Remove excess fat Place pork and all other ingredients in the crock pot and cook on low 6-8 hours Serve with hot rice.

Ingredient Names: peach jam, plum jam, garlic cloves, dried red chili pepper, rice vinegar, gingerroot, soy sauce, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth Refrigerate a few hours before using.

Dish Name: Chinese Fried Rice The Real Deal
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, wok oil, ginger, white onions, chicken stock, sugar, sesame oil, eggs, frozen peas and carrot, salt, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the jasmine rice. Step 2: Combine 4 cups of jasmine rice and 4 cups of water in a rice cooker. Step 3: Once the rice is cooled place in the refrigerator until chilled Scramble eggs in separate pan using whatever oil you normally cook eggs with. Step 4: Make sure to fold the eggs over, so they can be cut into thin strips. Step 5: Heat wok and 3-4 tablespoons of wok oil to medium heat. Step 6: Saute the white onion until soft and partially transparent along with 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, frozen peas and / or carrots If you opted for green onions skip this step and saute the peas / carrots in wok oil. Step 7: Add the rice making sure to separate the grains and mix with the vegetables. Step 8: Add another 3 tablespoons of wok oil, sesame oil, egg strips, ginger, chicken stock, and sugar.

Ingredient Names: walnuts, water, sugar, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat 6 cups of water to boiling. Step 2: Add walnuts and bring to a boil again and cook for 1 minute. Step 3: Rinse under running water and drain. Step 4: Place walnuts in a large bowl, add sugar and toss to mix. Step 5: Heat oil in skillet to 350f. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 of the walnuts at a time and fry for about 5 minutes or until golden in color. Step 7: Place walnuts in a sieve to drain. Step 8: Sprinkle with salt. Step 9: Toss to keep walnuts from sticking together. Step 10: Place on waxed paper to dry.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, sesame oil, eggs, water, peanut oil, swiss brown mushrooms, gai lan, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the hoisin sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl. Step 2: Whisk together eggs and water in a jug. Step 3: Heat 2 teaspoons of peanut oil in a wok over high heat. Step 4: Add one-quarter of egg mixture, tilting wok to cover base and side As omelette sets, lift edge so that any uncooked egg runs underneath. Step 5: Cook for 2-3 minutes or until just set Slide onto a plate and cover. Step 6: Repeat, in 3 more batches, with 6 teaspoons of oil and the remaining egg mixture, reheating the wok between batches. Step 7: Heat remaining peanut oil in wok over medium heat. Step 8: Add mushroom and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes or until tender.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic, oyster sauce, fresh ginger, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok or deep pan over high heat until it is hot. Step 2: Add oil and wait until it is smoking, add ginger and garlic and leave for a minute or so. Step 3: Then add the oyster sauce and stock simmering for another few minutes. Step 4: Pour over your favorite fried rice, white rice or meat, especially chicken.

Dish Name: Chinese Glass Noodles With Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: noodles, soup stock, peanut butter, tap water, light soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, chili paste, green onion, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles for 1 hour and drain. Step 2: Place in a saucepan with the soup stock and simmer until they are tender but not mushy, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Drain the stock from the noodles, reserving it for another use. Step 4: Place the noodles on a tray and refrigerate them for one hour. Step 5: Mix the sauce by putting the peanut butter in a 2-cup measuring glass and adding the hot water. Step 6: Stir with a fork until it is the consistency of whipping cream. Step 7: Add the remaining ingredients for the sauce and mix with the chilled noodles. Step 8: Place the noodles on a serving dish and garnish with the green onions and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: string beans, lemon, garlic, salt and pepper, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and string green beans Dry. Step 2: Melt butter in a saut pan. Step 3: Add the lemon juice and garlic. Step 4: Add the green beans and salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook over medium-low heat until almost tender You can cover if desired, but don't cook until mushy unless you like your green beans that way. Step 6: Remove from pan and serve Very good.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, oil, cornstarch, flour, baking powder, water, salt, egg, egg white, ginger, garlic, honey, rice wine vinegar, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: - in a large bowl mix all batter ingredients together until smooth. Step 2: Cover and allow the batter to sit for at least 30 minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken to the batter tossing to coat heat a deep fryer to 350 degrees. Step 4: Fry chicken bit in batches for 2 minutes or until batter becomes firm. Step 5: Drain on paper towels to make sauc. Step 6: Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoon of oil in your wok. Step 7: Add garlic and ginger and stir fry for 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, yellow onions, garlic, fresh ginger, serrano peppers, snow peas, red bell pepper, mushroom, oyster sauce, rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet or wok, heat the oil over medium heat until hot. Step 2: Add the onion, cook and stir until tender, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, ginger, chili pepper, snow peas, bell pepper and mushrooms. Step 4: Cook and stir until the moisture evaporates, about 5 to 7 minutes or so. Step 5: Stir in the oyster-flavored sauce and wine Eat it.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, carrot, snow peas, garlic chives, reduced sodium soy sauce, chinese rice wine, oyster sauce, sweet chili sauce, flat egg noodles, broccoli stems, thai basil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Place a pot of salted water over a high heat and bring to a boil. Step 2: Place a wok over a high heat, and once hot add the oil to the hot wok. Step 3: Add the onions and garlic to the wok and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until the onions soften slightly. Step 4: Add the carrot strips, snow peas, bean sprouts and garlic chives and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until the carrots are crisp-tender. Step 5: Remove the wok from the heat and add the soy sauce, rice wine, oyster sauce and sweet chili sauce. Step 6: Place the noodles and broccoli in the boiling water and cook for 2 minutes or until the broccoli is crisp-tender and the noodles are al dente. Step 7: Strain the noodles and broccoli, and add them to the vegetables in the wok. Step 8: Add the basil and toss to combine and to coat the noodles and vegetables with the sauces. Step 9: Place the noodle mixture on a large serving platter. Step 10: Garnish with the green onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, water, soy sauce, sugar, garlic cloves, cider vinegar, fresh cilantro, cayenne
Instructions: Step 1: Place peanut butter in a small bowl. Step 2: Add the hot water and stir patiently with a spoon or a small whisk until uniformly mixed. Step 3: Stir in remaining ingredients and mix well. Step 4: Cover tightly and refrigerate. Step 5: Let it come to room temperature before serving Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: beef top sirloin steak, soy sauce, white sugar, cornstarch, ground ginger, vegetable oil, red onion, green bell pepper, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Slice steak into 1/2-inch thick slices across the grain. Step 2: Whisk together soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and ginger in a bowl until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is smooth. Step 3: Place steak slices into the marinade, and stir until well-coated. Step 4: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat, and cook steak strips in batches in hot oil so as not to crowd the pan. Step 5: Cook and stir until well-browned, about 3-4 minutes, and remove steak from the wok to a bowl. Step 6: Repeat with remaining steak, adding more oil as needed, and set the cooked meat aside. Step 7: Return cooked steak strips to the hot wok, and stir in onion. Step 8: Toss steak and onion together until onion begins to soften, about 3-4 minutes, then stir in green pepper. Step 9: Cook and stir the mixture until peppers have turned bright green and started to become tender, about more, then add tomatoes. Step 10: Stir everything together to mix and blend flavors, and serve.

Ingredient Names: green peppercorns, fresh cilantro, olive oil, yard-long beans, garlic cloves, brown sugar, red chili pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, using the bottom of a glass or jar, crush the peppercorns into a coarse pulp. Step 2: Stir in the cilantro. Step 3: Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Stir in beans, garlic, brown sugar, chile pepper, peppercorns and cilantro. Step 5: Stir fry for 45 seconds. Step 6: Pour in the water and cover to steam until tender crisp, about 1-2 minutes for smaller beans and 7-9 minutes for the bigger beans depending on the size of the vegetables. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: plums, onion, water, gingerroot, garlic, granulated sugar, rice vinegar, coriander, salt, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, clove
Instructions: Step 1: In large heavy saucepan, bring plums, onions, water, ginger and garlic to boil over medium heat. Step 2: Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until plums and onions are very tender, about 30 minutes. Step 3: Press through food mill or sieve and return to clean pan. Step 4: Stir in sugar, vinegar, coriander, salt, cinnamon, pepper and cloves. Step 5: Bring to boil, stirring. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer until mixture reaches consistency of applesauce, about 45 minutes. Step 7: Fill and seal jars Process in boiling water bath for 30 minutes Makes about 4 cups.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, seasoned rice vinegar, chinese chives, sesame seeds, chile-garlic sauce, ground pork, garlic, egg, sesame oil, fresh ginger, dumpling wrappers, vegetable oil for frying
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dipping sauce: Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, chives, sesame seeds, and chile-garlic sauce in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: To make the dumplings: Mix pork, garlic, egg, chives, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Step 3: Place a dumpling wrapper on a lightly floured work surface and spoon about filling in the middle. Step 4: Wet the edge with a little water and crimp together forming small pleats to seal the dumpling. Step 5: Repeat to form remaining dumplings. Step 6: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Place 8 to 10 dumplings in the pan and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 8: Pour in water; cover and cook until dumplings are tender and pork is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Repeat to cook remaining dumplings, adding more oil and water for each batch. Step 10: Serve dumplings with dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, hoisin sauce, garlic, oyster sauce, white pepper, salt, rice wine, five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except pork, in a bowl and mix well Coat pork in mixture I store mine in quart sized zipper bags, 2-3 chops per bag. Step 2: Let pork marinade in refrigerator for a minimum of 1 hour I marinate for 24 hours. Step 3: Cook outdoors on grill until done On my grill that's 4-5 minutes per side They also cook well indoors on a contact type grill I generally cook for 5-6 minutes indoors Pork filled bags may be frozen with marinade and thawed to cook later.

Ingredient Names: pork fillets, oil, shallots, red chile, soy sauce, sherry wine, cornflour, garlic, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork across the grain into 5mm thick slices. Step 2: Place slices between greaseproof paper or plastic wrap and pound lightly to tenderise and flatten. Step 3: Prepare the marinade by combining the marinade ingredients. Step 4: Add the pork and marinate for 20 minutes. Step 5: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Step 6: Drain the pork and add to the pan Stirfry for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the shallots, chilli, soy sauce and sherry. Step 8: Cook another 1-2 minutes. Step 9: Serve immediately with rice or noodles and steamed vegetables.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, gingerroot, salt, chinese five spice powder, pot roast, soy sauce, brown sugar, sherry wine, canola oil, water, potatoes, carrots, onion, cornstarch, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 4 ingredients, stir well Rub garlic mixture over entire surface of roast. Step 2: Place roast in a large zip-lock plastic bag. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, brown sugar and sherry. Step 4: Pour over roast Zip bag shut and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes, turning over once or twice. Step 5: Remove roast from marinade, reserving marinade Brown roast in oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat. Step 6: Add reserved marinade, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, water, soy sauce, mirin, star anise, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, brown sugar, cherries in juice, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f using a sharp knife, score 3" slits all over pork skin. Step 2: Place pork in large dutch oven. Step 3: Add enough cold water to cover pork. Step 4: Bring to boil over high heat, cook 10 minutes. Step 5: Drain by rinsing under cold water. Step 6: Return pork to dry pot. Step 7: Mix 1 / 2 cup water, 1 / 4 cup soy sauce, and 1 / 4 cup mirin, drizzle over pork. Step 8: Cover and bake for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sparerib racks, garlic, catsup, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, fresh ginger, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350. Step 2: Cut ribs into individual ribs and arrange in a baking pan. Step 3: Bake for 45 minutes. Step 4: Mix sauce ingredients, brush on ribs. Step 5: Bake for 30 more minutes, turn the ribs. Step 6: Brush with more sauce. Step 7: Bake 30 more minutes.

Dish Name: Chinese Roast Pork Authentic And Delicious
Ingredient Names: pork loin roast, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, white wine, hoisin sauce, garlic, red food coloring, sugar, oyster sauce, ground ginger, chinese bean paste, shallots, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Combine salt, sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, ginger, hoisin sauce, bean paste, garlic, shallots and wine in a large bowl. Step 2: Add the pork loin roast, baste thoroughly and marinate 2 hours. Step 3: Place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan, and bake in a preheated oven at 425 degree for 15 minutes. Step 4: Turn meat and bake 7 minutes longer. Step 5: Remove the meat and brush with the honey mixed with the red food color. Step 6: Return to the oven for 10 minutes, or until done. Step 7: Cut the meat crosswise into thin slices and serve either hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, ketchup, honey, soy sauce, sake, rice vinegar, lemon juice, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, chinese five-spice powder, pork spareribs
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Mix hoisin sauce, ketchup, honey, soy sauce, sake, rice vinegar, lemon juice, ginger, garlic, and five-spice powder together in a shallow glass dish. Step 3: Place ribs in the dish and turn to coat. Step 4: Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour or up to overnight. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 6: Fill a broiler tray with enough water to cover the bottom. Step 7: Place the grate or a rack over the tray; arrange ribs on the grate. Step 8: Cook in the preheated oven on the center rack for 25-30 minutes, turning and brushing with marinade every. Step 9: Let marinade cook on for final to make a glaze. Step 10: Finish under the broiler if desired. Step 11: Discard any remaining marinade.

Ingredient Names: oil, pork fillets, prawns, cornflour, chinese wine, salt, dried chinese mushrooms, bamboo shoot, spring onion, sesame oil, sugar, hot water, glutinous-rice flour, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dried mushrooms for 45 minutes. Step 2: Then drain them and cut into a small dice, set aside. Step 3: Meanwhile -- chop the pork and the prawns finely Do not mince them. Step 4: Mix the pork and prawns with the 3 teaspoons of cornflour, wine and 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt. Step 5: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok and then stir-fry the pork and prawn mixture for about 2 or three minutes. Step 6: Add the remaining filling ingredients, including the mushrooms. Step 7: Stir until the mixture boils and thickens. Step 8: Remove and cool (overnight works best.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, salt, vegetable oil, shiitake mushrooms, green onion, gingerroot, white wine, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cover potatoes with water and salt in a medium saucepan, heat to a boil, cook 1 minute, drain. Step 2: Transfer to a bowl filled with cold water and ice. Step 3: Cool completely, drain on paper towel Pat dry. Step 4: Heat a wok over high heat, add vegetable oil. Step 5: Stir-fry potatoes in oil until tender, about 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, broccoli, low sodium soy sauce, garlic clove, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large wok or high-sided skillet over med-high heat. Step 2: Add broccoli and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add soy sauce, garlic, and lemon juice Continue to stir-fry until broccoli is crisp-tender, about 5 minutes, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, salt, pepper, garlic, egg, cornstarch, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Tenderize meat pork with a meat mallet If you're short on time, pound to at least 1 / 4 inch thickness or thinner. Step 2: Mix together all the ingredients except cornstarch and oil and pour over pork. Step 3: Allow to marinate for 30 minutes Just before frying, pour cornstarch on top of pork and stir into marinade. Step 4: Heat enough oil in a large skillet to cover bottom. Step 5: Place pork in pan when oil begins to shimmer. Step 6: Cook pork chops over med-high heat until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic clove, kale, boiling water, soy sauce, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan Throw in the kale and toss around the pan to coat in the garlicky oil. Step 2: Pour over boiling water and cook for 7 minutes more until the kale has wilted and is cooked through. Step 3: Stir in the soy and oyster sauces and heat through to serve.

Dish Name: Chinese Style Spicy Eggplants With Pork
Ingredient Names: ground pork, eggplants, leeks, garlic, ginger, oil, chili bean sauce, cornstarch, sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch eggplants in boiling water or deep fry them in oil. Step 2: Drain and set eggplants aside. Step 3: Mix all ingredients of the sauce together Sautee garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp of oil. Step 4: Add minced pork and stir fry until done. Step 5: Add eggplants, leek / scallion and sauce mixture into the pan, bring to boil, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: egg, flour, salt, water, pork shoulder, oil, canned pineapple chunk, green pepper, vinegar, brown sugar, molasses, tomatoes, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the egg. Step 2: Mix flour, salt, and water with it to form thin batter. Step 3: Pour over pork, mix to coat the pieces, then fry them, piece by piece, in deep, hot oil till browned, drain. Step 4: Mix pineapple, green pepper, vinegar, sugar, 3 / 4 cup water, and molasses. Step 5: Stir until it boils, add tomato. Step 6: Mix cornstarch with the 1 / 4 cup water and stir into the sauce. Step 7: Cook till thickened. Step 8: Add pork, stir to mix well, and serve at once.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, bamboo shoots, egg, cornstarch, green onions, green pepper, sea salt, sesame oil, rice wine, garlic cloves, peanut oil, brown sugar, vegetable oil, malt vinegar, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix salt, rice wine or sherry and egg. Step 2: Stir in pork to evenly coat. Step 3: Remove pork and roll in cornstarch to coat evenly. Step 4: In a wok, heat peanut oil until hot, deep fry pork 5 minutes until crispy Use a slotted spoon to remove pork from oil, drain pork on paper towels. Step 5: Pour out oil from wok leaving 2 tablespoons, add bamboo shoots, green onions, green pepper and garlic and stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 6: Stir in pork and heat thoroughly To make sauce: In a saucepan stir together, sauce ingredients and place over medium heat and cook for 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 7: Pour sauce over pork and vegetables.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Chinese Five Spice Powder
Ingredient Names: fennel seed, szechuan peppercorns, star anise, ground cinnamon, ground cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a heavy bottom skillet over medium-low heat. Step 2: Add peppercorns and shake pan back and forth for 2-3 minutes Immediately put peppercorns into a spice grinder, along with the star anise and fennel seed Grind until the spices are finely powdered Sift the spices through a fine mesh strainer and discard what remains behind. Step 3: Put powdered spices back into the grinder and add the ground cinnamon and ground clove. Step 4: Mix again until thoroughly combined. Step 5: Store in a tightly sealed container in a cool, dark place for 4-6 months (i usually make a double batch and use a small baby food jar for storage) Enjoy your "home-made chinese five spice powder"!

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Mu Shu Pork
Ingredient Names: pancakes, pork tenderloin, dry sherry, light soy sauce, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, chicken stock, sesame oil, light brown sugar, chili paste with garlic, salt, fresh ground black pepper, eggs, napa cabbage, shiitake mushroom
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the pancakes according to the directions with the chinese take-out peking duck. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine the pork, 2 tablespoons of the sherry, 2 tablespoons of the soy sauce, 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil, and half the garlic. Step 3: Toss together, and refrigerate while assembling the remaining ingredients. Step 4: In a separate bowl, combine the remaining 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and sherry, the stock, 1 tablspoon of the sesame oil, the sugar, chili paste, 1 / 2 tsp of the salt, and black pepper to taste, set aside. Step 5: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a wok or saute pan set over medium heat. Step 6: Add the eggs and stir-fry until they become firm, about 1 minute. Step 7: Transfer the eggs to a large bowl. Step 8: Add another 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the wok and heat. Step 9: Add the cabbage, mushrooms, and green onion.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, cold water, eggs, vegetable oil, sesame seeds, scallion, chicken broth, orange juice, granulated sugar, white vinegar, soy sauce, garlic cloves, orange zest, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly mix together all the marinade ingredients. Step 2: Put chicken pieces into a large zip-lock baggie. Step 3: Add 1 / 2 cup of marinade to the baggie and seal, reserving the rest. Step 4: Toss chicken to thoroughly cover and place baggie into a glass dish and refrigerate for 1 hour, tossing again after 30 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, place beaten eggs in a bowl on the counter. Step 6: Place the 1 cup of cornstarch into a pie pan. Step 7: Put the 1 cup oil into a deep, heavy bottom skillet. Step 8: Place remaining, un-used marinade into a sauce pan. Step 9: Remove chicken pieces from the marinade, and place on a plate. Step 10: Discard used marinade.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, water, soy sauce, black soy sauce, black tea leaves, star anise, cinnamon stick, tangerine zest
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, combine eggs and 1 teaspoon salt. Step 2: Cover with cold water. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat, drain, and cool. Step 5: When cool, tap eggs with the back of a spoon to crack shells.
