Step 6: In a large saucepan, combine 3 cups water, soy sauce, black soy sauce, salt, tea leaves, star anise, cinnamon stick, and tangerine zest. Step 7: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 3 hours. Step 8: Remove from heat, add eggs, and let steep for at least 8 hours.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, broccoli florets, water, carrot, snow peas, fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced water chestnuts, garlic, fresh ginger, reduced sodium soy sauce, chicken broth, cornstarch, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Make 2 cups of rice as instructed on package and keep hot. Step 2: Heat wok over medium heat and add the oil, increase to medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the broccoli and water, stir-fry for 1 minute or until broccoli is bright green. Step 4: Add carrots, snow peas, mushrooms, water chestnuts, garlic and ginger. Step 5: Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes or until tender crisp In small bowl, combine the soy sauce, broth and cornstarch. Step 6: Mix well to dissolve. Step 7: Add to wok and stir-fry for about 1 minute, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: meaty pork ribs, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, clear honey, vinegar, chinese five-spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ribs in a large pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 15 mins. Meanwhile, pour the hoisin sauce in a jug and stir in the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and five-spice. Step 2: Drain the ribs very well, then brush with the glaze – if barbecuing, chill, cover and keep in the fridge for later. Step 3: Heat the grill to high, if using. Grill or barbecue for 15-20 mins, turning from time to time until shiny and slightly charred in places. Serve hot.

Ingredient Names: duck, sugar, star anise seeds, ginger, green onions, malt syrup, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: The day before, soak 4 wooden skewers in water for 20 mins. Wash the ducks inside and out with cold water, drain and pat dry with kitchen paper. Mix together the sugar, star anise, ginger, spring onions and a few good pinches of salt, then use this to fill the cavities. Close the cavities with wooden skewers and set aside. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix the maltose and 2 tbsp of the vinegar. Add the remaining vinegar to a jug of boiling water and pour over the ducks. (The boiling water opens up the pores, while the vinegar helps to strip some of the waxiness from the skin, so it will be more receptive to the maltose, which adds sweetness and a lacquered caramel colour.) Smear the maltose mixture over the ducks, then place them in a large plastic container and put in the fridge overnight, uncovered. Step 3: To cook, heat oven to 220C/200C fan/ gas 7. (Fan ovens are particularly effective for roasting duck.) Put a little water in the bottom of a large roasting tin, place the ducks on a rack over the top and cover with foil. Roast for about 45 mins. Take off the foil and roast for another 45 mins – the duck must be well done, there is no such thing as a rare Chinese roast duck! Take the duck out of the oven and let it rest for a good 20 mins before carving.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, salt, fresh bean sprout, eggs, green onions, fresh cilantro, oyster sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok or large skillet; add oil, salt and bean sprouts; cook for 1 minute, then pour in the beaten eggs and add the green onions and cilantro. Step 2: Allow to cook for 2 minutes, then, when it still looks moist but is cooked through, with a spatula turn half of the omelette over the other half. Step 3: Drizzle the omelette with the oyster sauce mixture and serve.

Dish Name: Chiu Yim Yuk Lau Fried Fillet Of Pork Coated With Peppery Salt
Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, cornstarch, pork fillets, peanut oil, kosher salt, five-spice powder, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade: combine all of the ingredients in a bowl Pound the pork lightly to tenderize and marinate it for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan. Step 3: When the oil starts to smoke, add the pork and fry over medium heat for 1 minute. Step 4: Remove the pan from the heat and leave th epork in the hot oil for 1 minute. Step 5: Remove the pork from the pan, but do not drain the oil Reheat the oild until it starts to smoke. Step 6: Return the pork to the pan and fry for 30 seconds. Step 7: Remove, drain, and set aside Clean the pan and return it to the heat.

Ingredient Names: beef, pork chop, beef stock, onion, chop suey vegetables, sliced water chestnuts, cornstarch, ground ginger, soy sauce, molasses, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large dutch oven over high heat, add olive oil and add both meats, cook stirring often, until browned, add onions and cook a few minutes until onions are slightly tender. Step 2: Add soy sauce and stock, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until meat is very tender, about 45 minutes. Step 3: Drain chop suey vegetables and water chestnuts and add to pot. Step 4: Cover and heat through. Step 5: Blend cornstarch, ginger, soy sauce, molasses and water until smooth. Step 6: Bring chop suey to a boil and add the cornstarch mixture and stir until thickened, serve over rice cooked in beef stock Enjoy, sooooo yummy!

Ingredient Names: turkey breast, celery, onion, mushroom, water chestnut, brown sugar, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the turkey strips in a little oil until browned. Step 2: Add the celery, onion, mushrooms and water chestnuts. Step 3: Stir-fry until the onion becomes translucent. Step 4: Add the brown sugar, salt and soy sauce, cook for an additional 10 minutes until ready. Step 5: Serve with plain white rice.

Dish Name: Clever Connie's Sweet Sour Pork Chops
Ingredient Names: pork chops, oil, garlic cloves, brown sugar, tomato ketchup, soya sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Set the oven at 250 degrees fahrenheit Trim excess fat off the pork chops. Step 2: Add oil to frying pan and heat on high. Step 3: Add garlic and swirl around for 30 seconds- don't let it brown or burn. Step 4: Lower heat under frying pan Brown the chops on both sides. Step 5: Remove chops and place in an ovenproof baking dish in a single layer Scrape the garlic and "brown bits" from the frying pan onto the top of the chops. Step 6: Mix remaining ingredients together well and pour over the chops. Step 7: Place chops into the oven.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, dark sesame oil, salt and pepper, green onions, eggs, sugar, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the tomato into wedges. Step 2: In a small bowl, gently toss the wedges with sesame oil and a sprinkling of salt and pepper. Step 3: Chop the green onions and place in a separate bowl with the eggs, sugar, a teaspoon of water, and a dash of salt and pepper, beat until foamy. Step 4: In a small skillet on med-high heat, warm the oil. Step 5: Pour in the egg mixture and turn the heat down to medium In about a minute, when the eggs have begun to set, with a spatula, gently push the eggs from the outside of the pan towards the center. Step 6: After about a minute, flip the eggs and cook on the other side As soon as the eggs are fully set, remove from the heat. Step 7: Divide the eggs between two plates and top with the tomatoes.

Dish Name: Crisp Noodle And Vegetable Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, rice vermicelli, green beans, carrots, zucchini, shiitake mushrooms, fresh gingerroot, napa cabbage, scallions, fresh bean sprout, dark soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Half-fill a preheated wok or deep, heavy-bottom skillet with oil, heat to 350. Step 2: Add the noodles, in batches, and cook for 30 seconds, or until crisp and puffed up. Step 3: Remove with tongs, then drain on paper towels and set aside. Step 4: Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of oil from the wok. Step 5: Heat the remaining oil in the wok over high heat. Step 6: Add the green beans and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the carrot and zucchini sticks, mushrooms, and ginger and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the napa cabbage, scallions, and bean sprouts and stir-fry for an additional minute. Step 9: Add the soy sauce, rice wine, and sugar, and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, water, eggs, flank steak, canola oil, carrot, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, green onions, fresh ginger root, garlic cloves, white sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place cornstarch in a large bowl; gradually whisk in water until smooth. Step 2: Whisk eggs into cornstarch mixture; toss steak strips in mixture to coat. Step 3: Pour canola oil into a wok, 1-inch deep; heat oil over high heat until hot but not smoking. Step 4: Place 1/4 of the beef strips into hot oil; separate strips with a fork. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, until coating is crisp and golden, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Remove beef to drain on paper towels; repeat with remaining beef. Step 7: Drain off all but oil; cook and stir carrot, bell peppers, green onions, ginger, and garlic over high heat until lightly browned but still crisp, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Whisk sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes together in a small bowl. Step 9: Pour sauce mixture over vegetables in wok; bring mixture to a boil. Step 10: Stir beef back into vegetable mixture; cook and stir just until heated through, about 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef top sirloin, water, long grain rice, white sugar, rice wine vinegar, frozen orange juice concentrate, soy sauce, salt, oil for frying, cornstarch, fresh ginger, garlic, orange zest, broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Lay beef in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with paper towels. Step 3: Allow to dry in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Step 4: Meanwhile, bring water and rice to a boil in a medium saucepan. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Mix together sugar, rice vinegar, orange juice concentrate, soy sauce, and salt in a small bowl, set aside. Step 7: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 8: Toss dried beef in cornstarch to coat. Step 9: Fry coated beef in hot oil in small batches until crispy and golden brown; set aside. Step 10: Drain oil from the wok, leaving about 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Add ginger, garlic, and orange zest to remaining oil in wok. Step 12: Cook and stir briefly until fragrant. Step 13: Pour in soy sauce mixture; bring to a boil and cook until thick and syrupy, about 10 minutes. Step 14: Stir in fried beef and cook until heated through. Step 15: Serve hot over steamed rice and garnish with broccoli.

Ingredient Names: pork steak, oil, onion, green pepper, mushrooms, tomato sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in oil Place in crock pot Mix remaining ingredients and add to pork Cover and cook on low for 6 hours Serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, soy sauce, oil, garlic cloves, brown sugar, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Brush the pork with soy sauce. Step 2: Let stand 10 minutes. Step 3: Add oil, garlic, and pork to crock pot. Step 4: Top with brown sugar. Step 5: Cover and cook on low for 4 to 7 hours, on high 2 to 3 hours. Step 6: Add cashews 30 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken, chicken broth, teriyaki sauce, brown sugar, garlic cloves, soy sauce, orange zest, ground ginger, sesame oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, teriyaki sauce, brown sugar and garlic cloves in large bowl. Step 2: Add chicken to sauce, and toss to combine. Step 3: Pour chicken mixture into crock-pot. Step 4: Cook on low 4-6 hours, or until chicken is cooked through. Step 5: Serve over hot cooked rice and spoon extra sauce if desired.

Ingredient Names: country-style pork ribs, salt and pepper, ketchup, honey, rice, soy sauce, five-spice powder, onion, garlic, fresh ginger, cornstarch, cold water, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl combine ketchup, honey, vinegar, soy sauce, five-spice powder, onion, ginger and garlic. Step 2: Pour into the slow-cooker. Step 3: Set oven heat to broil and set the rack 6 inches from heat source. Step 4: Season ribs with salt and pepper. Step 5: Place the ribs on a baking pan, then broil, turning once until browned. Step 6: Transfer the ribs to the slow-cooker / crock pot. Step 7: Turn to coat with the sauce. Step 8: Cover the slow-cooker and cook on low heat for about 5-6 hours or until ribs are tender. Step 9: Transfer the ribs to a platter to keep warm Skim any fat from the top of the sauce.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chinese Style Country Ribs
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, garlic clove, orange marmalade, country-style spareribs, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the soy sauce, marmalade, ketchup, and garlic. Step 2: Brush on both sides of the ribs. Step 3: Place in a slow cooker. Step 4: Pour remaining sauce all over. Step 5: Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, ginger, peanut oil, leek, baby bok choy, brussels sprouts, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the stems of the bok choy into slices. Step 2: Heat a large frying pan / wok on high heat. Step 3: Add the peanut oil, then the ginger & garlic. Step 4: Stir fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the chopped sprouts & leeks, stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the bok choy stems, fry for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the sesame oil, oyster & soy sauces, then add the bok choy leaves. Step 8: Stir fry for 1 minute. Step 9: Remove from the heat & toss through the sesame seeds. Step 10: Serve with steamed rice.

Dish Name: Crystal Or Rock Candied Pork Roast
Ingredient Names: pork roast, soy sauce, candies, sherry wine, green onions, ginger, star anise
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pot until hot Brown both sides of roast. Step 2: Add onions, ginger, star anise, crystal candy or granulated sugar, sherry and soy sauce, bring to boil. Step 3: Cover and simmer 1 1 / 2 hours each side, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, brown sugar, cinnamon, ground cloves, hoisin sauce, pork spareribs, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 5 ingredients in glass measuring cup Microwave at hi 1 minute stirring once or twice. Step 2: Arrange ribs in 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Step 3: Pour sauce on top, cover with plastic wrap Microwave on hi 5 minutes Microwave at 50 for 20 minutes. Step 4: Turn ribs over, microwave at 50 for 20 minutes. Step 5: Drain liquid, reserve Microwave ribs uncovered at 50 for 4 minutes Skim fat from reserved juices.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, green peppers, eggplants, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, olive oil, water, soy sauce, chicken bouillon, sugar, cornstarch, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash all the vegetables thoroughly Peel and dice potatoes to 1 / 2 inch length Core and roughly dice green peppers. Step 2: Cut ends off egg plant. Step 3: Cut lengthwise Dice roughly. Step 4: Chop up the onion and garlic. Step 5: Heat up oil in wok on high. Step 6: When oil is very hot, add potatoes and stir constantly until golden More oil may be added throughout the cooking process at any time.

Ingredient Names: absolut mandarin vodka, cointreau liqueur, lime juice, cranberry juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour all ingredients in a shaker with ice Shake and strain 2 times in an iced cocktail glass Garnish with an orange zest.

Ingredient Names: carrot, celery, flank steak, scallion, gingerroot, soy sauce, palm sugar, sesame oil, salt, ground szechuan peppercorns, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the carrots, celery, ginger, and flank steak into very thin matchstick-size pieces, 1 inch long. Step 2: Slice the scallions lengthwise, and then cut them into 1 inch long pieces. Step 3: Heat 2t of the oil in a wok, and flash-fry the carrots until they are limp Do not brown them Wipe the wok out, and repeat for the celery Wipe the wok out again, add the remaining 2t oil and the palm sugar. Step 4: When the oil is hot, and the sugar is bubbling, add the scallions and the flank steak. Step 5: Stir-fry 3 minutes, then add the soy sauce, and continue to stir-fry until the liquid is reduced, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Return the carrots and celery to the wok, add ginger root.

Ingredient Names: peking duck, oil, red onion, garlic cloves, red chili pepper, red curry paste, smooth peanut butter, coconut milk, chicken stock, lime juice, fish sauce, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Remove skin and bones from peking duck and cut meat into bite-size pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in saucepan or wok over medium heat, add onion and cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic and chilli and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in curry paste and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until fragrant, then stir in peanut butter Gradually whisk in the coconut milk and cook for 2 minutes, or until well combined. Step 5: Add the stock, bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the duck and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce Scatter the coriander over the top and serve with rice or noodles.

Dish Name: Earl's Kung Pao Protein Of Your Choice
Ingredient Names: tofu, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, sugar, vegetables, pasta, dried red chili peppers, garlic cloves, green onion, fresh ginger, peppercorn, oil, salted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the marinade, adding the cornstarch last, and whisking well until there are no lumps. Step 2: Cut the tofu or chicken into 1-inch cubes. Step 3: Combine with the marinade ingredients. Step 4: Marinate - 1 hour While the tofu or chicken is marinating, prepare the sauce and vegetables, set aside. Step 5: Heat wok over medium-high to high heat, add 2 tbsp oil. Step 6: When oil is hot, add tofu or chicken and marinade. Step 7: Stir-fry until chicken is cooked or tofu is browned.

Dish Name: Easy Baked Sweet And Sour Meatballs
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, water, ketchup, pineapple juice, apple cider vinegar, ponzu sauce, brown sugar, maple syrup, ground beef, egg, applesauce, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried oregano, soft breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce mix the cornstarch with cup water in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Add all of the remaining sauce ingredients to a small saucepan and stir over a medium heat for approximately one minute. Step 3: Add the cornstarch mixture and stir to combine Continue stirring until the mixture becomes thick and glossy- about 5 minutes. Step 4: Set the sauce aside to cool For the meatballs preheat oven to 350f Use a food processor to make fresh breadcrumbs. Step 5: Add all meatball ingredients to a medium sized mixing bowl and thoroughly mix together. Step 6: Roll into small meatballs with your hands, using about a tablespoon of mix at a time.

Ingredient Names: broccolini, peanut oil, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, dry, and cut broccolini into thirds. Step 2: Heat oil over high in a wok or similar type pan. Step 3: Stir fry the stems first for about 3-4 minutes You may need to turn the heat down to medium high. Step 4: Add the top leaf portion, and cook for another 3-4 minutes Shut off heat and add oyster sauce, stirring to coat, serve.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, sesame oil, water, vegetable oil for frying, cornstarch, ground white pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Make batter: Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Step 2: Drizzle in sesame oil. Step 3: Gradually add water, whisking constantly until smooth; batter should be the consistency of cream. Step 4: Let sit for at least 5 minutes. Step 5: Fill a deep pan or wok with oil and slowly heat to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 6: Prepare chicken: Mix together cornstarch and white pepper in a large shallow dish. Step 7: Dust chicken in cornstarch mixture, then dip into batter, evenly coating each piece. Step 8: Working in batches, fry coated chicken in hot oil until golden and no longer pink in the center, 4 to. Step 9: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).聽Use a slotted spoon to remove fried chicken to a clean kitchen towel to drain.

Ingredient Names: plum jam, vinegar, onion powder, ginger powder, allspice, garlic salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ingredients together well. Step 2: Bring to a boil on low heat. Step 3: Boil about 2 minutes stirring constantly. Step 4: Cool the sauce and store in a jar in the refrigerator Use within a few days.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, cornstarch, oyster sauce, red pepper sauce, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, frozen mixed vegetables, coleslaw mix, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix broth, cornstarch, oyster sauce and pepper sauce, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook garlic and frozen vegetables in oil about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until vegetables are tender. Step 4: Stir in coleslaw mix and broth mixture. Step 5: Cook and stir 1-1 / 2 minutes. Step 6: Serve over noodles.

Ingredient Names: eggs, celery, bean sprouts, cooked chicken, nonfat dry milk powder, onions, parsley, salt, pepper, sesame oil, cornstarch, chicken broth, soy sauce, sliced mushrooms, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together all casserole ingredients, pour into greased 12x8x2-inch baking dish. Step 2: Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean To make the sauce, combine cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup broth. Step 3: Heat remaining broth to boiling in a saucepan Gradually whisk in cornstarch, mushrooms and green onions To serve cut casserole into squares and top with mushroom sauce.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, onion, green onion, celery, bean sprouts, cornstarch, shrimp, soy sauce, salt, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet over medium heat, heat sesame oil and lightly fry the onions, celery and sprouts. Step 2: Stir in cornstarch and add shrimp, soy sauce and salt. Step 3: Stir until well blended. Step 4: Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl. Step 5: Return the pan to the heat, and add the beaten eggs. Step 6: Fry the eggs while stirring gently. Step 7: Return the vegetable and shrimp mixture to the pan while the eggs are still liquid. Step 8: Finish frying until eggs are fully cooked.

Dish Name: Egg Foo Yung For 2 With Oriental Sauce
Ingredient Names: eggs, water, soy sauce, fresh bean sprout, fresh mushrooms, green onions, cooking spray, cornstarch, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: For omelets: In a medium bowl, beat the eggs with water and soy sauce. Step 2: Stir in bean sprouts, mushrooms and green onions. Step 3: Mix well Spray an 8-inch non-stick skillet with cooking spray, and heat skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Pour in approximately one fourth of the egg mixture As mixture sets at the edges, with spatula, gently lift cooked portion to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Step 5: Cook until bottom is set and beginning to brown, and top is almost set, then slide onto a plate. Step 6: Flip over back into skillet and cook until eggs are done in the middle, about 1-2 minute Slide onto a serving plate, keeping warm.

Ingredient Names: stock, salt, soy sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat stock. Step 2: Then stir in salt and soy sauce. Step 3: Meanwhile blend cornstarch and cold water to a paste. Step 4: Then stir in to thicken. Step 5: Spoon sauce over each omelet Or serve hot in a side dish as a dip Variations-------- In, add to the stock 1 / 4 teaspoon sugar, a dash of pepper, and either 1 tablespoon peanut oil or a few drops of sesame oil Or add 1 tablespoon oyster sauce Or add 1 tablespoon catsup and / or 2 teaspoons sherry.

Dish Name: Eggplant And Pork With Black Bean Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: eggplants, ground pork, red bell pepper, cornstarch, sugar, water, cooking oil, dry sherry, minced ginger, black bean garlic sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water, cornstarch, sugar, sherry / broth and black bean garlic sauce in a small bowl. Step 2: Mix well and set aside. Step 3: In a heated pan with oil, brown the pork until well done, drain. Step 4: Add in ginger and eggplant and cook for another 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Add sauce mixture and cook until sauce thickens, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: chinese eggplants, peanut oil, sesame oil, ginger, red chili pepper, chicken broth, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, cornstarch, sesame seeds, cilantro leaf, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise, then into 1 inch wedges crosswise. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Stir-fry eggplant in batches until seared and sticky, about 3 minutes per batch. Step 4: Add more oil as needed. Step 5: Remove eggplant from pan. Step 6: Stir-fry green onions, ginger, garlic, and chile for 1 minute. Step 7: Add chicken broth to the pan. Step 8: In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch. Step 9: Add mixture to the pan and cook for another minute. Step 10: Add eggplant to the pan and toss until the sauce is absorbed.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, eggplants, garlic cloves, chili paste with garlic, fresh ginger, chicken stock, soy sauce, sugar, rice vinegar, green onions, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 4 tablespoons peanut oil in heavy 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add eggplant and stir-fry until soft, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Remove, using slotted spoon, set aside. Step 4: Add remaining peanut oil to skillet and warm over medium heat. Step 5: Add garlic, chili paste and ginger and cook 15 seconds. Step 6: Add stock, soy sauce and sugar and bring to boil. Step 7: Add vinegar and eggplant and cook until eggplant has absorbed most of sauce, about 1 minute. Step 8: Stir in green onion and sesame oil. Step 9: Serve hot, removing eggplant with slotted spoon.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, dry sherry, egg white, salt, cornstarch, chicken broth, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, water, chili paste with garlic, vegetable oil, eggplants, green bell pepper, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork in mixing bowl. Step 2: Add sherry, egg white and salt and mix with hands until egg white is foamy. Step 3: Add cornstarch and mix again until smooth. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour For sauce: combine broth, soy sauce Vinegar, sugar, dissolved cornstarch, chili paste and wine or sherry in small bowl and mix well, set aside. Step 5: Heat 4 cups oil in wok or deep fryer to 350 degrees. Step 6: Add eggplant in small batches and fry until lightly colored. Step 7: Drain on paper towels, pressing to remove as much oil as possible.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, soy sauce, pepper, egg, cornstarch, oil, water, garlic powder, ginger, chicken stock, sugar, white vinegar, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: In a zip-top bag, combine marinade and chicken. Step 2: Refrigerate at least 30 minutes While marinating, assemble rest of ingredients and combine in a bowl This step is very important because after you fry the chicken, this recipe moves very fast! Step 3: After marinating, fry chicken and drain, keep warm. Step 4: Drain the oil if any is left Toast the chilies in a drop of oil, being careful not to burn them. Step 5: Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl, stirring until the cornstarch is combined. Step 6: Add to the skillet and bring to a boil and reduce heat.

Ingredient Names: simply potatoes shredded hash browns, lump crabmeat, sriracha sauce, fresh ginger, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium mixing bowl, hand mix simply potatoes shredded hash brown, lump crab meat, fresh ginger, green onion, and sriracha. Step 2: Set aside so flavors can infuse. Step 3: In a medium skillet, heat 1 / 4 cup of vegetable oil on medium heat. Step 4: Take 1 / 4 of mixture in hand and press / shape into a ball. Step 5: Then press flat by using the palm of one hand while the other holds Patty should be 1 / 2 inch thick with some shredded hash faring out. Step 6: Place gentle into hot oil. Step 7: Cook on each side for about 2 minutes or browned. Step 8: Take care flipping the patties so as not to break them. Step 9: Once cooked on both side, remove patty and place on paper towel to drain off excess oil.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, margarine, fresh chives, nonfat milk, egg, five-spice powder, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Place flour, five spice powder, and chives in a medium bowl. Step 2: Combine milk, margarine, and egg in a separate bowl. Step 3: Add milk mixture to the flour mixture, stirring with a whisk until blended. Step 4: Cover and chill for an hour. Step 5: Place an 8-inch crepe pan or nonstick skillet pan coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot. Step 6: Remove pan from heat and pour scant 1 / 4 cup of batter into pan Quickly tilt pan in all directions so batter covers the bottom of pan. Step 7: Place pan back on burner and cook about 1 minute Carefully lift edge of pancake with a spatula to test for doneness The pancake will be ready to turn when it can be shaken loose from the pan and the underside is lightly browned.

Dish Name: Five Spice Duck Breasts With Vegetable Sticks
Ingredient Names: green beans, carrots, red pepper, zucchini, snow peas, duck breasts, chinese five spice powder, clear honey, ketjap manis, red chile, sunflower oil, garlic clove, fresh gingerroot, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut all the vegetables into to thin sticks, about the same size as the beans. Step 2: Drop the beans into a pan of boiling water and bring back to the boil. Step 3: Add the carrots and the red pepper and cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Drain, rinse under cold water, and then dry on kitchen paper Lightly score the skin of each duck breast into a diamond pattern with the. Step 5: Heat a dry frying pan until it is quite hot. Step 6: Add the duck breasts, skin-side down, reduce the heat to medium and cook them for about three to four minutes until the skin is crisp and golden brown. Step 7: Turn the breasts over and cook them for another five minutes, or a little longer if you don't like your duck too pink. Step 8: Meanwhile, mix together the five-spice powder, honey, sweet soy sauce, balsamic vinegar and chili. Step 9: Pour away all of the excess fat from the pan.

Dish Name: Five Spice Pork And Rice Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: cooked brown rice, salt & pepper, fat-free low-sodium chicken broth, rice vinegar, chinese five spice powder, garlic cloves, low sodium soy sauce, canola oil, pork tenderloin, onion, red bell pepper, flour, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Season rice to taste. Step 2: Mix broth with vinegar, five-spice powder, garlic, and soy sauce, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 4: Add pork and onion and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 5: Add bell pepper and continue to stir-fry 1 minute. Step 6: Sprinkle flour over ingredients and toss. Step 7: Add broth mixture to wok and stir-fry 2 minutes, remove to a bowl. Step 8: Add seasoned rice to wok and stir-fry 1 minute to heat.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, butter, garlic, peppercorn, shallots, salt & fresh ground pepper, milk, sour cream, horseradish sauce, red onion, fresh dill, salt, lemon juice, sugar, fresh gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Cracked pepper sauce: beat cream cheese& butter together until smooth. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and mix. Step 3: Chill a few hours or overnight to blend flavors. Step 4: Serve at room temperature Dill sauce: combine all ingredients. Step 5: Chill several hours or overnight Teriyaki sauce: saute garlic and ginger in oil 30 seconds. Step 6: Add soy sauce, water, & sake. Step 7: Bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 8: Combine brown sugar and cornstarch.

Dish Name: Forevermama's Sweet And Sour Meatballs Asian Style
Ingredient Names: ground pork, sesame oil, cornstarch, egg, soy sauce, oil, water, dry sherry, tomato paste, granulated sugar, white wine vinegar, pineapple chunks in syrup, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Meatballs: In a bowl. Step 2: Mix the ground pork with the sesame oil until well mixed, then mix in the cornstarch, egg and soy sauce Prior to shaping the meatballs, have a plate ready to set your meatballs inches wet your hands under cold water. Step 3: Take small portions of the meat mixture, about the size of walnuts, and roll them in-between your palms, shaping them into balls. Step 4: Keep wetting your hands as to prevent the meat from sticking to your hands This will also help in producing an even, smooth surface. Step 5: Once all meatballs have been shaped and placed in plate. Step 6: Set aside Preparing sweet and sour sauce:.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, water, sherry wine, dark soy sauce, gingerroot, scallion, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put pork in boiling water, boil 1 minute, drain. Step 2: Rinse in cold water. Step 3: Cut pork in 2-inch cubes. Step 4: Put pork and 1 cup water in an earthenware or any other heavy pot. Step 5: Bring water to boil. Step 6: Add sherry, soy sauce, ginger, and scallions, cover pot tightly. Step 7: Simmer over very low heat 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: baby carrots, baby corn, fresh mushrooms, red bell peppers, scallions, fresh ginger, garlic, dried red pepper flakes, chicken broth, soy sauce, chinese rice wine, sugar, vinegar, cornstarch, oriental sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place carrots in medium saucepan, add cold water to cover, and heat to boiling. Step 2: Boil uncovered until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain and cool under cold running water Blanch corn in medium saucepan of boiling water 30 seconds. Step 4: Drain and cool under running water Trim and halve mushrooms. Step 5: Cut bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips, then cut strips crosswise in half. Step 6: Combine scallions, ginger, garlic, and pepper flakes. Step 7: Place remaining ingredients except safflower oil in mixing bowl and stir until completely blender, set sauce aside.

Dish Name: Fragrant Cinnamon Pork With Sweet Potatoes
Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, olive oil, scallions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, chili paste, cinnamon sticks, star anise, water, soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, sweet potatoes, scallion tops
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork into 1-1 / 2-inch cubes. Step 2: Heat the oil until very hot in a 4-quart casserole or a dutch oven with a lid. Step 3: Add half the pork pieces Sear the outside of half the pork over high heat until brown, turning once. Step 4: Remove and sear the remaining meat. Step 5: Set aside Reheat the pan and oil, add the seasonings. Step 6: Stir-fry until fragrant, about 15 seconds, then add the braising mixture. Step 7: Reduce the heat to low, cover, and let simmer for 20 minutes. Step 8: Add the pork, bring the liquid to a boil, and reduce the heat to low.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, gingerroot, red peppers, salt, garlic, fresh cilantro, green onion, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat veg oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add minced ginger root, red pepper, salt and garlic, saute 2 minutes, remove from heat. Step 3: Spoon into a small bowl and stir in remaining ingredients.

Dish Name: Fresh Asparagus Salad Liang Pan Lu Sun
Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bend each asparagus stalk back until the tough root end snaps away, discard the ends. Step 2: Wash the stalks and slice diagonally into bite- sized pieces Blanch the pieces in boiling water for 1 minute, drain at once, and run cold water over the asparagus to stop their cooking. Step 3: Spread them on a double thickness of paper towels and pat them dry. Step 4: In a container large enough to hold the asparagus, combine the remaining ingredients and mix well until the sugar is completely dissolved. Step 5: Add the asparagus and toss to coat each piece with the dressing. Step 6: Chill slightly--no more than 2-3 hours--before serving May be served chilled or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: salt, szechuan peppercorns, chinese five spice powder, quail, salt and pepper, sugar, light soy sauce, rice wine, plain flour, oil, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: To make the spicy salt and pepper, combine the ingredients and dry fry over a low heat for 2-3 minutes or until aromatic Split each quail in half down the middle and clean well. Step 2: Marinate with the teaspoon of spicy salt and pepper, sugar, soy and rice wine for 2-3 hours, turning frequently Coat each quail piece in flour, dustin off the excess. Step 3: Fill a wok to 1 / 4 full with oil and heat the oil to 190c. Step 4: Fry the quail for 2-3 minutes each side then remove from the wok and drain on kitchen paper. Step 5: Serve with the lemon wedges on the side.

Dish Name: Gai Lan Chinese Broccoli With Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: gai lan, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, chicken stock, sake, sugar, oyster sauce, fresh ginger, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the gai lan and trim the ends of stalk and discard the ends. Step 2: Mix the chicken stock, sake, and sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Step 3: In a large wok or pan heat 1 1 / 2 t vegetable oil over medium heat. Step 4: Add the garlic cloves and cook until lightly golden about 1 to 2 minutes Be careful you do not burn the garlic. Step 5: Turn the heat to high and add the ginger and cook for 15 to 20 seconds and add gai lan stalks With a large spoon or spatula scoop up the oil and bathe the gai lan stalks for about 1 minute. Step 6: Pour the chicken stock mixture and immediately cover the wok or the pan with a tight fitting lid. Step 7: Turn down the heat to medium and let gai lan steam for about 3-4 minutes You should be able to easily pierce with the stalks with a fork.

Ingredient Names: racks of baby-back pork ribs, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, dry sherry
Instructions: Step 1: Cut racks into 2 or 3 rib serving size portions. Step 2: Place in 2 large plastic bags or lay flat in a large dish. Step 3: Whisk remaining ingredients together in a medium-sized bowl. Step 4: Divide between the plastic bags Push the meat down into the marinade, squeeze out as much air as possible and seal the bags as close to the meat as possible Massage the bags to evenly coat the ribs. Step 5: Refrigerate overnight or up to 2 days. Step 6: Bring meat to room temperature Lightly oil a bbq grill& heat to medium temperature. Step 7: Drain ribs& save marinade.

Ingredient Names: spinach, tomatoes, black bean sauce, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, chili sauce, fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Add tomatoes, garlic, black bean sauce, stir fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in the spinach, chili sauce, and lemon juice, and mix well. Step 4: Keep stirring for about 3 minutes, until spinach gets wilted. Step 5: Season with salt and black pepper. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: leafy greens, garlic, dried japone chilies, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and drain greens Warm wok over low heat, add oil. Step 2: Add garlic and chilies, tossing in oil, until they give off fragrance. Step 3: Add greens and cover immediately. Step 4: Cook three minutes, take the lid off, toss the greens and cover again for two more minutes. Step 5: Turn off heat, add salt to taste, and toss, serve.

Ingredient Names: skinless boneless chicken breast halves, cornstarch, eggs, salt, ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, baking powder, vegetable oil, chopped green onion, fresh ginger root, sesame oil, water, white sugar, distilled white vinegar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Coat chicken pieces with cornstarch in a bowl; set aside. Step 3: Beat eggs, salt, and pepper in a mixing bowl until combined. Step 4: Stir in flour and baking powder until no large lumps remain. Step 5: Mix in chicken pieces until evenly coated. Step 6: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Step 7: Cook chicken in hot oil until golden brown and no longer pink on the inside, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Set chicken aside; keep warm. Step 9: Make sauce: Reduce heat to medium-high; add green onion, ginger, and sesame oil to the skillet. Step 10: Cook and stir until onion is limp and ginger begins to brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Pour in water, sugar, and vinegar; bring to a boil Dissolve cornstarch in soy sauce in a small bowl and stir into vinegar mixture along with oyster sauce and ketchup. Step 12: Cook until sauce has thickened and is no longer cloudy. Step 13: Stir in chicken; simmer until heated through.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sugar, rice wine, rice wine vinegar, chili paste, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a saute pan Cook at medium temperature until thickened, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil for frying, egg, skinless boneless chicken thighs, salt, white sugar, white pepper, cornstarch, vegetable oil, green onion, garlic, dried whole red chilies, orange zest, soy sauce, chicken broth, peanut oil, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ground ginger, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Whisk egg in large mixing bowl. Step 3: Add chicken, salt, sugar, and pepper; mix well. Step 4: Mix in cornstarch, a little bit at a time, until chicken is well coated. Step 5: Working in batches, carefully drop one piece of chicken at a time into the hot oil. Step 6: Fry until chicken turns golden brown and begins to float, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Remove chicken to a plate and allow to cool as you fry the next batch. Step 8: Once all of the chicken has been fried, refry the chicken, starting with the batch that was cooked first. Step 9: Fry each batch until chicken turns deep golden brown, about more. Step 10: Drain on a paper towel-lined plate. Step 11: To make the sauce: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 12: Stir in green onion, garlic, whole chiles, and orange zest. Step 13: Cook and stir until garlic turns golden and chiles brighten, 1 to. Step 14: Add sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, peanut oil, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and ginger; bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes. Step 15: Whisk cornstarch in water until dissolved. Step 16: Stir into the boiling sauce. Step 17: Return to a boil and cook until the sauce thickens and is no longer cloudy from the cornstarch, about 15-20 minutes. Step 18: Stir chicken into the boiling sauce. Step 19: Reduce heat to low and cook until chicken is heated through and has absorbed some of the sauce, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: scallions, ginger, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat skillet and add the oil. Step 2: Heat until the oil is almost smoking. Step 3: Combine scallions, ginger, and salt in a bowl and pour the hot oil into the bowl The sauce will sizzle You can use this immediately It should keep in the refrigerator for at least a week It freezes well too.

Ingredient Names: green onion, ginger, salt, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut green onions into very small slices put onions into small bowl peel ginger, cut and dice into fine pieces in a wok, heat up peanut oil or sesame oil until it bubbles pour oil on top of ginger and green onion until it just fills to the top of the vegetables. Step 2: Add salt to taste, i use about 1 tsp salt mix and use on meat this sauce can last in the fridge for about 3 weeks because it sits below the oil.

Ingredient Names: green onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, olive oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: To make pesto, combine all of the pesto ingredients in a food processor Pulse on and off until mixture achieves a uniform consistency Use immediately or store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to a week.

Dish Name: Ginger Scallion Tripe Dim Sum Style
Ingredient Names: tripe, chicken broth, water, ginger, scallions, garlic cloves, sesame oil, rice wine, white pepper, salt, dried red chili peppers, peanut oil, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the tripe well under running water. Step 2: Place the whole pieces of tripe in a large pot and fill with chicken stock, water, 2 1 / 2 ounces of the sliced ginger, 4 scallion stalks, 1 garlic clove, sesame oil, 1 / 2 cup of the rice wine, white pepper, salt and the dried chilil peppers. Step 3: Place the pot over high heat and bring to a boil. Step 4: Lower heat to a simmer and continue to simmer for 2-3 hours. Step 5: Check for doneness by piercing tripe with a fork Tripe should be tender but easily sliced with a knife, not rubbery. Step 6: Drain the tripe and slice into 1 inch strips, discard broth. Step 7: In a wok, heat peanut oil on medium high heat. Step 8: Add and sautee the garlic clove, 1 / 2 ounce of julienned ginger, and 2 julienned scallions.

Dish Name: Ginger Stir Fried Cauliflower With Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: cauliflower, soy sauce, sugar, lite olive oil, ginger, garlic, scallions, chicken, oyster sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cauliflower with 1 tbsp soy sauce & have the sugar stirred into the soy. Step 2: Turn wok or large skillet to high heat, add oil, and when it starts smoking add ginger and garlic for about 15 seconds turn heat down a little bit but still high. Step 3: Add cauliflower and scallions, stir and cook for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add stock, water, oyster sauce and remaining soy sauce cook for 1 minute If you like a thicker sauce add corn starch stir and cook for no more than 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: pork ribs, eggs, soya sauce, chinese wine, sugar, chinese five spice powder, salt, garlic powder, flour, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Cut ribs into individual ribs. Step 2: Mix next 7 ingredients, add ribs and marinade minimum 1 / 2 hour Longer the better. Step 3: Remove ribs from marinade and toss in mixture of flour and breadcrumbs. Step 4: Remove and deep fry til golden.

Ingredient Names: egg, sweet rice flour, water, salt, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil to 370 degrees. Step 2: Mix egg, flour, salt and water Use more or less water to reach a thick batter consistency If you have a pastry bag, put the batter in the pastry bag, using a medium-small If you don't have a pastry bag, take a large plastic ziploc freezer bag and cut a small piece off of one of the corners Be careful, as it's easy to cut a larger hole than you need. Step 3: Squeeze the batter out of the bag into the hot oil I found it easiest to squeeze out a rather large "squiggle", overlapping the strings, rather than trying to make shorter, individual noodles Having the noodles fry together in a squiggle also makes it easier to turn the noodles to brown on both sides. Step 4: Once the noodles are golden brown, remove from the oil and place on a cake rack to drain.

Dish Name: Green Bean And Chinese Sausage Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: chinese sausage, green beans, peanut oil, garlic, salt, chicken broth, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the sausages to boil in water, cook for 5 minutes. Step 2: Cool slightly, then slice on the diagonal into 1 / 2-inch slices. Step 3: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat and then add 2 tablespoons of the oil. Step 4: Add the garlic and salt and cook for a few seconds, then add the green beans and cook, stirring and tossing constantly, for 6 minutes. Step 5: Add chicken broth, cover the pan and cook until crisp-tender, about 2 to 3 minutes longer Push the beans to one side, pour the remaining oil in the space and stir-fry the sausage for 2 minutes. Step 6: Mix with the green beans, add the oyster sauce and stir until heated through. Step 7: Serve as a side dish or as a main course over brown rice.

Ingredient Names: frozen green beans, bamboo shoot, margarine, salt, sugar, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cover and microwave frozen green beans in 1-qt casserole on high until tender, 6 to 7 minutes, drain. Step 2: Stir in remaining ingredients Microwave uncovered until hot, about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: bread flour, boiling water, vegetable oil, salt and pepper, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Use a fork to mix flour and boiling water in a large bowl. Step 2: Knead dough into a ball. Step 3: Cover bowl with plastic wrap; let dough rest for 30 to. Step 4: Evenly divide dough into. Step 5: Roll each piece into a thick circle. Step 6: Brush each circle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with about green onions. Step 7: Roll up, cigar style; coil each pancake and pinch open ends together to form a disc. Step 8: Roll each circle flat to about thickness. Step 9: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 10: Fry cakes until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side. Step 11: Add more oil between batches, if necessary.

Ingredient Names: pork, oil, onions, ginger, garlic clove, celery, mushroom, peas, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, salt, white pepper, cornstarch, soy sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Stir fry pork in oil. Step 2: Add onions, ginger and garlic. Step 3: Add rest of vegetables. Step 4: Add salt and pepper. Step 5: Mix cornstarch and soy sauce into water, pour into pan, cook until thick.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger root, skinless boneless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a small microwave-safe bowl; heat in the microwave on medium power for 5 minutes, then stir. Step 3: Heat again for 30 seconds, watching closely to prevent boiling. Step 4: Place chicken breasts in a shallow dish. Step 5: Pour soy sauce mixture over top and set aside to marinate for 2 hours. Step 6: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Step 7: Meanwhile, remove chicken from marinade; transfer marinade into a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat to low and simmer until thick, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Set aside for basting. Step 10: Cook chicken on the preheated grill, basting frequently with reserved marinade, until golden brown on all sides and chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 6 to per side. Step 11: An instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest piece should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

Ingredient Names: pork chops, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sherry wine, chili-garlic sauce, sesame oil, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the pork chops by removing all of the fat. Step 2: Then poke both sides of each chop with a fork. Step 3: Place the chops in a container with a tight fitting lid to be marinated. Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix together thoroughly all of the ingredients for the marinade. Step 5: Pour the marinade over the pork chops and stir them to coat. Step 6: Place them in the refrigerator and marinate overnight. Step 7: When you are ready to cook the chops, pre heat the grill to medium high. Step 8: Once the grill is hot remove the chops from the marinade and immediately place them on the grill Reserve the marinade in the container and let the pork chops sit for 2 minutes. Step 9: After 2 minutes, rotate the chops, dont flip them yet.

Ingredient Names: beef skirt steak, hoisin sauce, vinegar, sherry, soy sauce, hot sauce, sesame oil, fresh ginger root, garlic, brown sugar, salt, ground black pepper, green onion, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk hoisin sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, hot sauce, sesame oil, grated ginger, garlic, brown sugar, salt, and pepper together in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Cut skirt steak crosswise into about 4 or 5 smaller pieces. Step 3: Transfer steak into marinade and toss until all pieces are evenly coated. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap. Step 5: Refrigerate; marinate at least and up to. Step 6: Line a baking pan with paper towels. Step 7: Transfer pieces of steak to the paper towels and mop off some of the marinade. Step 8: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Step 9: Transfer steak pieces to grill. Step 10: Cook to medium rare or medium, 4 to per side. Step 11: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read between 130 and 135 degrees F (about 54 degrees C). Step 12: Thinner pieces might finish earlier. Step 13: Transfer steak to a warm plate. Step 14: Let rest for a few minutes. Step 15: Transfer steak to a warm serving platter and pour any accumulated juices over skirt steak. Step 16: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

Ingredient Names: pork spareribs, low sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, crushed pineapple, sugar, honey, garlic cloves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place ribs in a large shallow pan. Step 2: Mix together marinade ingredients. Step 3: Pour marinade over ribs. Step 4: Cover and marinate, turning occasionally, for 1 to 2 hrs or up to 24 hrs, refrigerated. Step 5: Bring to room temperature before cooking. Step 6: Remove ribs from marinade, reserving marinade. Step 7: Place ribs on an oiled grill 4 to 6 inches from the off-set coals. Step 8: Grill ribs indirectly, turning occasionally and brushing with marinade, until crusty outside and tender juicy inside, about 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork chops, green onions, soy sauce, garlic cloves, toasted sesame oil, lemon juice, chili paste, sugar, fresh gingerroot, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: To make marinade, combine green onions, soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, lemon juice, chile paste, sugar, ginger root and chile oil in a small bowl. Step 2: Place chops in a 1-gallon self-sealing plastic bag, pour marinade over chops, seal bag. Step 3: Marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight. Step 4: Drain chops, reserving marinade. Step 5: Place chops on a kettle-style grill directly over medium-hot coals, lower grill hood and grill for 4-5 minutes. Step 6: Brush chops with reserved marinade. Step 7: Turn and brush again. Step 8: Grill for 4-5 minutes more until chops are just done.

Dish Name: Healthy Chicken Or Shrimp Or Pork Lo Mein
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, eggs, cornstarch, light soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, whole wheat spaghetti, stir fry vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta per package directions. Step 2: Heat wok or skillet on medium high heat. Step 3: Add olive oil and garlic, cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes stirring continuously. Step 5: Add 3 tbsp soy sauce, sesame oil, and vegetables and cook until veggies are tender Push mixture aside in pan and add eggs. Step 6: Let cook for 2 minutes and scramble eggs until done. Step 7: Add to chicken and veggies. Step 8: Add cooked pasta, corn starch, and remaining soy sauce and stir fry for 4 minutes until fully heated and sauce thickens, serve and enjoy!

Dish Name: Hoisin Barbecued Game Hens With Stir Fried Vegetables
Ingredient Names: cornish hens, reduced sodium soy sauce, mirin, honey, rice wine vinegar, fermented black beans, sesame chili oil, lime juice, garlic cloves, ground ginger, cilantro, oil, onion, garlic, minced ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Remove neck and giblets from hens and rinse them and pat dry Halve hens by cutting firmly through the breast and backbone with a sharp knife Pound each half with the palm of your hand to flatten the hens Marinade: In a medium saute pan or skillet, combine all marinade ingredients and simmer 7-8 minutes. Step 2: Cool in refrigerator or freezer. Step 3: In a large, resealable plastic bag, marinate hens for 2-3 hours. Step 4: Remove hens from marinade Reserve marinade. Step 5: Prepare a charcoal fire.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, honey, scallion, crushed red pepper flakes, cornish hen, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oil in a pot large enough to fit a cornish hen comfortably, to about 350 degrees Thoroughly wash and pat cornish hen dry to avoid unnecessary spatter, and carefully ease into hot oil. Step 2: Cook for 8-10 minutes on each side until you see that it is turning slightly golden brown around the edges and crispy. Step 3: Remove and place on cooling rack. Step 4: In a small bowl, prepare glaze by mixing together first 4 ingredients, adding red pepper flakes to your heat preference Baste entire hen liberally with the glaze Pop in pre-heated oven at 350 degrees for about 8 minutes or until it gets crispy. Step 5: Flip over, and re-baste bottom of hen, and put back in oven for another 8 minutes to crisp up the other side. Step 6: Let rest before serving You can cut into quarters for 2 servings, or serve whole.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, salt and pepper, pork tenderloin
Instructions: Step 1: Combine marinade ingredients in small bowl. Step 2: Place tenderloin in shallow bowl, pour in the marinade, refrigerate 4 hrs. Step 3: Preheat oven to 425 Roast 15 minutes per side.

Ingredient Names: red chilies, shallots, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Grind chillies, shallots, garlic and ginger till semi-fine. Step 2: Put paste into a bowl and add boiling chicken stock. Step 3: Stir well before adding lemon juice, vinegar, sugar and salt. Step 4: Leave it for at least 1 hour to pickle before serving.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, ground ginger, garlic, center-cut pork chops, brown sugar, honey, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Trim excess fat from chops. Step 2: Then prick with a fork on both sides and set aside. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, ginger and garlic in a small bowl. Step 4: Pour half of this in a shallow pan and add the chops. Step 5: Pour remaining sauce / marinade over the chops, then refrigerate for up to 8 hours, turning occasionally. Step 6: Prepare grill Spray grill rack with non-stick spray before heating. Step 7: Combine sugar, honey and sesame oil in a small saucepan. Step 8: Cook on low until sugar dissolves then remove from heat. Step 9: Remove chops from marinade and discard marinade.

Ingredient Names: boneless ham, brown sugar, light soy sauce, water, honey, asian pears, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Lay the ham slices out in the rice bowl of a steamer. Step 2: Sprinkle with the brown sugar. Step 3: Steam for 25 minutes, adding more water as needed. Step 4: When the ham is nearly finished cooking, combine the soy sauce, water and honey in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low and keep warm. Step 6: Add the pear slices to the steaming dish. Step 7: Brush the pears and ham slices with some of the sauce. Step 8: Steam for 5 more minutes. Step 9: Pour the remainder of the sauce over and garnish with the green onion before serving.

Ingredient Names: whole duck, star anise, parsley, soy sauce, orange juice, honey, sherry wine, salt, ginger juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water in a large kettle. Step 2: Place duck, anise and parsley in boiling water, cook 10 minutes. Step 3: Remove duck from water. Step 4: Let cool on rack for 2 hours. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350. Step 6: Bake duck on rack in a roasting pan for 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 7: Mix orange juice, soy sauce, honey, sherry, salt and ginger juice. Step 8: Pour half of mixture into cavity and brush remaining mixture on duck. Step 9: Bake 30-40 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: honey, soy sauce, cider vinegar, cornstarch, orange rind, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, sweet red pepper, snow peas, shrimp, green onions, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the sauce ingredients, mix until smooth, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in wok or large fry pan over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the garlic and ginger Saut for 1 minute. Step 4: Add the diced pepper and snow peas. Step 5: Stir-fry for 1 minute or until tender-crisp, add the shrimp. Step 6: Stir-fry just until shrimp turns pink.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, vegetable oil, brown gravy mix, water, honey, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, ginger, garlic salt, carrots, onion, green pepper, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork in 1 inch squares. Step 2: Discard bones Brown pork in oil in large skillet. Step 3: Fry for 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Combine gravy mix, water, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, and garlic salt. Step 5: Add to skillet, cover, and cook 20 minutes. Step 6: Add carrots, cook 15 minutes. Step 7: Add onion and green pepper, cook 5-10 minutes. Step 8: Serve over hot rice or egg noodles.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloins, oil, low sodium soy sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, liquid honey, brown sugar, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Step 2: Place the pork tenderloin in a heavy plastic bag. Step 3: Pour the soy mixture over the pork to coat well. Step 4: Cover and marinate 6-24 hours in the refrigerator. Step 5: Remove the pork from the marinade; pat dry. Step 6: Let sit out at room temperature for 1 hour before coating and cooking. Step 7: Mix together the honey and brown sugar in a shallow plate. Step 8: Rub the tenderloin in oil all over. Step 9: Place sesame seeds on a separate shallow plate. Step 10: Roll pork in the honey mixture, coating well. Step 11: Then roll in sesame seeds. Step 12: Roast in a shallow pan at 375 degrees for 20-30 mins or until the pork is cooked. Step 13: Remove to a platter, slice thinly to serve.

Ingredient Names: duck breasts, honey, sherry wine vinegar, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, chinese five spice powder, ground black pepper, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Score the duck breast skin in a criss-cross fashion. Step 2: Blend the honey, vinegar, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, five spice powder and pepper in a small bowl Coat the duck in this marinade in a shallow bowl. Step 3: Cover and leave for 1 hour or overnight. Step 4: Set the oven to fairly hot, 200c / 400f. Step 5: Put the duck on a rack in a roasting tin, reserving the marinade. Step 6: Cook for 20-30 minutes depending on their size and how well you like your duck cooked. Step 7: Put the marinade and 40mls of the roasting juices in a small pan. Step 8: Add the spring onions and bring to the boil. Step 9: Simmer gently for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Hong Kong Sweet and Sour Pork
Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, white sugar, potato starch, sesame oil, ground black pepper, pork loin, water, white vinegar, ketchup, salt, red food coloring, egg, peanut oil for frying, green bell pepper, cayenne peppers, canned pineapple, garlic, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the soy sauce, sugar, potato starch, sesame oil, and black pepper in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix the pork into the marinade and turn until all the pork is covered. Step 3: Allow to rest for 10 minutes. Step 4: To make the sauce, whisk together the water, vinegar, ketchup, sugar, salt, potato starch, and red food coloring in a separate bowl, set aside. Step 5: Dip the pork pieces in the beaten egg, then dredge in the potato starch. Step 6: Use your hand to press the starch onto the pork, assuring a consistent coating. Step 7: Heat the peanut oil in a wok over medium-high heat to a temperature of 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 8: Fry the pork pieces in the hot oil until crisp and light brown, 4 to. Step 9: Remove the pork from the oil and drain, keeping the oil hot. Step 10: Return the drained pork pieces to the hot oil for 30 seconds more. Step 11: Remove and drain again. Step 12: Pour off all but oil from the wok. Step 13: Heat reserved oil in the wok over medium heat. Step 14: Cook the green bell pepper, cayenne pepper, pineapple, garlic, and green onion in the heated oil for about 5 minutes. Step 15: Add the sauce and stir until it thickens. Step 16: Stir in the pork and toss until the pork is coated with sauce. Step 17: Remove from heat and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, peanut oil, fresh snow peas, straw mushrooms, sliced water chestnuts, fresh carrots, bok choy, chicken broth, sake, salt, accent seasoning, sesame oil, soy sauce, cornstarch, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw the boneless chicken about halfway, then cut into bite-sized chunks. Step 2: Place in bowl and let chicken thaw completely. Step 3: Combine the marinade ingredients of the honey, lime juice, ginger root, soy sauce, sherry and garlic, then pour over the chicken and mix thoroughly. Step 4: Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least an hour For the chicken batter, mix all ingredients together. Step 5: Let stand for 10-15 minutes then dip your chicken pieces in the batter. Step 6: Fry the battered chicken pieces in pre-heated peanut oil, in a wok set on med-high temp, at about 375 degrees Do not fry too many pieces all at once, or the chicken will stick together About six-to-eight pieces at a time, works best. Step 7: Place fried chicken bites in a non-corrosive plastic container with a few layers of paper towels underneath them to absorb the oil.

Dish Name: Hot And Spicy Tofu And Beef
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, ground beef, scallions, onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, rice wine, chili sauce, sugar, oyster sauce, salt, black pepper, dried chilies, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, sherry, chilli sauce, sugar and oyster sauce, stir. Step 2: Marinate tofu cubes in the sauce ingredients for 15mins or more. Step 3: Sprinkle ground beef with salt and pepper. Step 4: Heat oil in wok, stir fry onions, garlic and ginger until fragrant. Step 5: Add dried chilli and scallion bottoms, stir fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Add seasoned ground beef and continue to stir fry until browned. Step 7: Add tofu and sauce, combine well. Step 8: Let simmer 1-2mins. Step 9: Add chilli flakes, if you like it really spicy!

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, peanut oil, garlic, salt, roasted sichuan peppercorn
Instructions: Step 1: Each of the ingredients above is a dipping sauce, all by itself, other than the sichuan pepper and salt Provide small bowls of each dip for each individual diner ============= sichuan pepper salt ============ Dry roast the sichuan peppers until they are fragrant -- do not burn them. Step 2: Using a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle, grind the peppers You may either serve the pepper and salt in individual dipping bowls or you can mix the salt and pepper to create a single dipping ingredient.

Dish Name: Hunan Bean Curd In Hot Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, pork, white wine, cornstarch, vegetable oil, szechuan hot bean sauce, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, light soy sauce, frozen green pea, hot pepper oil, chicken broth, salt, water, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the pork in a mixture of the white wine and 1 / 2 teaspoon cornstarch for a few minutes. Step 2: Then fry in a hot wok containing the vegetable oil. Step 3: Cook for just a moment, and then add the bean curd cubes. Step 4: Add the hot bean sauce, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, peas, and hot pepper oil or cayenne. Step 5: Stir-fry for about 1 minute. Step 6: Add the chicken broth and optional salt, and stir over high heat until mixture comes to a boil Thicken the sauce with the cornstarch mixture. Step 7: Garnish with the black pepper, scallions, and sesame oil, serve hot.

Dish Name: Hunan Smoked Ham Hock With Hot Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: smoked ham hocks, vegetable oil, fermented black beans, garlic, green bell pepper, soy sauce, red pepper powder, chicken broth, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Place ham hocks in a pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until the meat easily separates from the bone with a fork. Step 3: Remove hocks from water, allow to cool, take off meat from the bones and slice into 1 inch slices This step can be done well ahead. Step 4: Heat wok or saute pan over high heat, add vegetable oil and when very hot add black beans and garlic, mash together. Step 5: Stir in meat, add green pepper, soy sauce, red pepper powder and chicken broth. Step 6: Stir continuously until well blended, add green onion, serve hot.

Dish Name: Hungry Girl Kung Pao Chicken 4 Ww Pts
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, mushroom, red bell peppers, celery, onion, water chestnut, reduced sodium soy sauce, water, rice vinegar, artificial sweetener, cornstarch, dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, garlic, red chili sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Begin by combining 2 tablespoons of cold water with soy sauce, vinegar, splenda, cornstarch and chili sauce -- stir well until all ingredients have dissolved. Step 2: Set sauce aside Spray a large pan or wok with nonstick spray, and bring to medium-high heat. Step 3: Add chicken, mushrooms, bell peppers, celery, onion, garlic and 2 tablespoons of water Stirring occasionally, cook for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Once chicken is almost fully cooked but still tender, add peanuts and water chestnuts to the pan or wok. Step 5: Raise heat to high, give sauce a stir, and add it to the pan / wok as well. Step 6: Mix entire dish until all ingredients are coated in sauce, and the sauce is hot and thick. Step 7: Season to taste with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: japanese eggplants, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green onions, tamari soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat to medium high. Step 2: Chop eggplants to about 1 inch cubes. Step 3: Add eggplants along with garlic, ginger, green onions, and tamari in heated skillet and cook until eggplants are tender. Step 4: Remove from heat and drizzle with sesame oil, stir to combine, serve and enjoy! Step 5: Tastes great with steamed brown rice:).

Dish Name: Ji Dan Bao Dan Cai Bao Egg And Cabbage Bun
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic, gingerroot, soy sauce, scallions, green cabbage, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in a wok over high heat. Step 2: Add 2 / 3 of the ginger, all the garlic, and stirfry for 1-2 minutes to bring out flavor. Step 3: Add leeks or scallions Stirfry for 1 - 2 minutes Break eggs over wok, stirfry until almost done, 3 - 5 minutes depending on how hot your wok and oil are. Step 4: Add soy sauce, remaining ginger, and cabbage Stirfry until cabbage begins to get tender, 5 - 10 minutes. Step 5: Add oil, water, or spice as needed.

Dish Name: Jian Bing Beijing Style Chinese Breakfast Burrito
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, oil, milk, water, green onions, cilantro, hoisin sauce, chinese chili sauce, sweet bean paste, eggs, crackers
Instructions: Step 1: To make the crepe batter, mix the flour, 1 tablespoon oil, milk, and cup water together until smooth. Step 2: In a small pan, add teaspoon oil, and heat on medium. Step 3: Add the sliced green onions to the pan. Step 4: Fry for about 30 seconds, then add the hoisin sauce and chili sauce, cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add cup water, and stir. Step 6: Set aside for later use. Step 7: Using a folded paper towel, coat the bottom of a large skillet or hot plate with teaspoon of oil to prevent sticking. Step 8: Heat on medium high heat, wait until the pan is heated. Step 9: Stir the crepe batter again, and pour cup of it into the pan.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, wine, cornstarch, pork chops, ketchup, sweet and sour sauce, worcestershire sauce, sugar, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: To make the marinade combine the soy sauce, wine and cornstarch in a bowl. Step 2: Add the pork chops and turn to coat let stand for ten minutes To make the seasoning sauce, combine the ketchup, sweet and sour sauce, worcestershire sauce and sugar in a bowl. Step 3: Place a wide frying pan over high heat until hot. Step 4: Add the oil, swirling to coat the sides. Step 5: Add the pork chops and cook until golden brown, about 2-4 minutes each side. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium. Step 7: Add the seasoning sauce. Step 8: Cook, stirring, until the sauce is reduced and thickens slightly, about 3 minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: gingerroot, safflower oil, kale, soy sauce, water, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet, cook the ginger root in oil, stirring, over medium heat for 1 minute. Step 2: Add the kale and raise the heat to medium high. Step 3: Add the soy sauce and water, and stir-fry until the kale is wilted but still slightly crunchy, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Step 5: Serve warm or cold. Step 6: You may substitute spinach or bok choy for the kale.

Ingredient Names: white wine, soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, skinless boneless chicken breast halves, hot chile paste, brown sugar, distilled white vinegar, water chestnuts, peanuts, green onions, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Whisk wine, soy sauce, sesame oil, and 1 陆 teaspoons cornstarch in a large glass bowl until smooth. Step 3: Add chicken pieces and toss to coat. Step 4: Cover the dish and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 5: Combine remaining wine, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a medium bowl. Step 6: Whisk in chili paste, brown sugar, and vinegar. Step 7: Add water chestnuts, peanuts, green onions, and garlic and toss to coat. Step 8: Transfer water chestnut sauce mixture to a medium skillet. Step 9: Heat slowly over medium heat until aromatic. Step 10: Meanwhile, transfer chicken from marinade into a large skillet; cook over medium-high heat, stirring, until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Step 11: Combine water chestnut mixture and cooked chicken together in one skillet. Step 12: Adjust heat and simmer until sauce thickens and coats chicken, 1 to.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, dry sherry, soy sauce, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, peanut oil, roasted unsalted peanuts, dried red pepper flakes, low sodium chicken broth, black vinegar, toasted sesame oil, oyster sauce, hoisin sauce, cornstarch, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Toss chicken with sherry and soy sauce in medium bowl. Step 2: Marinate until breast have absorbed flavors, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Mix garlic, ginger, and 1 teaspoon oil in small bowl, set aside. Step 4: Combine peanuts and chiles in small bowl, set aside. Step 5: Mix chicken broth, vinegar, sesame oil, oyster-flavored sauce, hoisin sauce, and cornstarch in small bowl or measuring cup, set aside. Step 6: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in 10-inch skillet over high heat until just beginning to smoke. Step 7: Add chicken and cook without stirring for 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes, allowing chicken to brown on one side.

Dish Name: Lacquered Squab W Gingered Cabbage And Fennel Pear Puree
Ingredient Names: kosher salt, szechuan peppercorns, fennel, bartlett pears, grape juice, star anise, sugar, salt, napa cabbage, radicchio, olive oil, spinach leaves, ginger, garlic, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: For the sichuan pepper-salt: In a small heavy-bottomed pot, slowly roast the salt and peppercorns over low-medium heat until very aromatic, about 20 minutes. Step 2: Cool Grind in a spice grinder and sift through fine sieve and set aside For the fennel-pear pure: Combine the fennel, pears, verjus, anise, sugar and salt in a heavy-bottom pot. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover and cook until everything is very tender, about 30 minutes. Step 4: Remove the star anise and pure in a high-speed blender until smooth Adjust the seasoning and pass through a fine sieve and keep warm until ready to serve For the gingered napa cabbage.

Dish Name: Lao Nai Yang Yu Chinese Spicy Mashed Potatoes
Ingredient Names: potato, peanut oil, garlic cloves, dried red chilies, green onions, greens, hot chinese chili paste, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel potatoes, and dice into 1-inch cubes. Step 2: Boil potatoes in water for 10 minutes or until done, drain water. Step 3: Mash potatoes briefly with a hand masher--there should still be a lot of large lumps. Step 4: Heat empty wok over highest heat until you can see heat rise from the surface. Step 5: Add peanut oil and swirl in wok for a moment until heated. Step 6: Add garlic cloves and chilies and toss in oil for a moment until fragrant If the garlic starts to brown before you get the other ingredients added, move off heat for a moment. Step 7: Add green onions, fennel, chili paste, and salt and stir-fry for a moment until ingredients are fully combined and green onion is wilted. Step 8: Add potatoes, stir-fry until ingredients are thoroughly combined and potatoes are heated through.

Ingredient Names: lemons, brown sugar, water, white sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour water into a pot. Step 2: Squeeze the halved lemons into the water. Step 3: Drop the already-squeezed lemons into the pot. Step 4: Put in brown sugar and mix well Start boiling the mixture. Step 5: Boil for about 2 minutes, leave to cool, add white sugar, serve over ice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, light soy sauce, fresh lemon juice, brown sugar, shaoxing wine, cornstarch, peanut oil, scallions, fresh ginger, chili peppers, lemons, broccoli, lemon, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chicken with the next five ingredients, and allow to marinate for twenty to forty minutes. Step 2: Heat wok over high heat until a thin thread of smoke rises. Step 3: Add 3 tablespoons peanut or canola oil and allow to heat another thirty seconds. Step 4: Add scallions, ginger, chilies and half of the lemon zest and stir fry for thirty to forty seconds, or until all is fragrant. Step 5: Add marinated chicken, and spread into a single layer on the bottom of the wok, and leave undisturbed for about one minute, or until the chicken browns on that side. Step 6: Stir fry until the chicken is 2 / 3 donein other words, 2 / 3 of the chicken is white or brown, and the rest is pink. Step 7: Add half the lemon slices and stir fry for another thirty seconds, then remove chicken and lemon from wok to a clean bowl. Step 8: Add reserved tablespoon of oil to wok, and allow it to heat thirty seconds. Step 9: Add broccoli and stir fry for thirty seconds, then add wine and lemon juice Deglaze any browned bits sticking to wok, and add chicken back to wok.

Ingredient Names: chicken bouillon granule, water, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, capers, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve cornstarch and subsequently bouillon in water and blend with remaining ingredients. Step 2: Add to your recipe instead of prepared stir-fry sauce. Step 3: Cook, stirring until thick and clear.

Dish Name: Liang Mu Di Chinese Stir Fried Corn And Edamame
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, edamame, kernel corn, red bell pepper, salt, ground sichuan pepper, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: If using fresh corn and edamame, parboil for a couple of minutes. Step 2: Drain water If using frozen, and cooking in a western kitchen, i recommend thawing the corn and edamame before stir-frying Outside of china, i don't find burners with enough heat to stir-fry something that's frozen. Step 3: Wash and dice bell pepper. Step 4: Heat wok over highest heat until smoking. Step 5: Add oil and swirl in pan to coat pan and heat oil Throw in bell pepper and stir fry briefly. Step 6: Add corn and edamame. Step 7: Stir to coat with oil.

Ingredient Names: lean boneless pork, egg, sugar, salt, soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, pineapple juice, cornstarch, canola oil, garlic, ginger, onion, pineapple chunk
Instructions: Step 1: Cube pork and marinade in next four ingredients for 20-30 minutes. Step 2: Combine vinegar, soy, brown sugar and pineapple juice. Step 3: Set aside dredge pork in cornstarch Coat wok with oil and heat. Step 4: Cook pork in wok until done and brown. Step 5: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 6: Stir fry garlic, ginger, and onion. Step 7: Add pineapple chunks. Step 8: Add sauce mixture and heat until thick and clear. Step 9: Add meat and cook until hot.

Ingredient Names: ginger, green onion, water, ground pork, sherry wine, light soy sauce, salt, cornstarch, cold water, peanut oil, bok choy, chicken stock, sugar
