Instructions: Step 1: Pound ginger and green onion with back of knife or cleaver. Step 2: Put into a bowl with the water. Step 3: Set aside 10 minutes. Step 4: Strain green onion and ginger out of the water, reserving water. Step 5: Put ground pork into a bowl. Step 6: Add green onion and ginger water, sherry, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Step 7: Mix well with your hand in one direction Form meat mixture into 4 large balls. Step 8: Using your hands, lightly coat balls with dissolved cornstarch. Step 9: Heat 4 tablespoons peanut oil in a wok.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, flour, salt, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: First mix the milk and eggs in a medium sized bowl Next add the flour, salt and baking powder and form a dough. Step 2: Put your dough onto a floured surface and roll very thin. Step 3: Cut into long noodles of your liking We like a wider noodle, like a fettuccini.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin roast, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic cloves, sugar, salt, fresh cracked pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all, cover, chill 24 hours, heat oven 375. Step 2: Put pork and marinade into a sprayed baking dish, cover, bake 30 minutes, uncover, stir well. Step 3: Bake 40 minutes or until liquid is reduced and pork is crispy.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, soy sauce, water, brown sugar, flank steak, cornstarch, green onion, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the flank steak against the grain and toss in cup of cornstarch. Step 2: Make sauce: heat tsp olive oil, add ginger and garlic. Step 3: Cook but dont burn. Step 4: Add the soy sauce, water and brown sugar bring to a boil for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and place sauce in a separate bowl. Step 6: Add 1 tsp oil and brown beef. Step 7: Add sauce, green onions and cook through, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Ma Po Tofu Braised Spicy Pork With Tofu
Ingredient Names: ground pork, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic clove, green onions, firm tofu, chicken broth, cornstarch, sugar, cooking wine, chinese rice wine, sesame oil, dark soy sauce, garlic and red chile paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok, heat vegetable oil on medium high heat for 2 minutes Have all your ingredients ready next to your cooking area as you will need them close at hand as cooking progresses. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger to the wok and stir-fry for about 1 minute, be careful not to burn the garlic. Step 3: Add the ground pork to the wok and break up into large chunks. Step 4: Let the pork sear and gently combine the garlic and ginger as you continue to break up the meat, abour 3-4 minutes If desired, you may season the pork at this stage with salt and black pepper, but this is not necessary For the sauce, combine the sugar, cooking wine, rice wine, sesame oil, soy sauce and chili paste. Step 5: Add the sauce mixture to the wok Gently combine and bring the wok to a simmer. Step 6: Add green onions, tofu and 1 / 2 cup of chicken stock.

Dish Name: Ma Po Tofu Spicy Szechwan Bean Curd
Ingredient Names: ground beef, fresh ginger, dried mushrooms, boiling water, firm tofu, garlic cloves, water chestnuts, green onions, peanut oil, brown bean sauce, szechwan chili sauce, sugar, light soy sauce, water, szechuan peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: Place 1 tablespoon of the chopped ginger in a medium-sized bowl, and reserve the remainder. Step 2: Add the remaining marinade ingredients to the bowl, and mix well. Step 3: Add the ground beef or pork, give it another stir and set aside for approx 30 minutes. Step 4: Place the tree ears or shiitake mushrooms in small bowl, pour over boiling water, and soak for about 15 minutes until they are soft and gelatinous. Step 5: Drain the soaked tree ears, rinse, remove hard stems, and slice finely Blanch the tofu in boiling water for 2- 3 minutes, then drain. Step 6: Combine the garlic with the reserved ginger, and process together with a stick blender or spice grinder until they form the consistency of a thick paste. Step 7: Heat a wok over a moderately high flame. Step 8: Add the peanut oil, and just as it is starting to smoke, add the garlic / ginger paste and stir-fry, stirring continuously, for approximately 30 seconds Next add the brown bean paste, szechwan chile paste, water chestnuts and tree ears, and stir-fry for a further minute.

Ingredient Names: long beans, macadamia nuts, extra virgin olive oil, butter, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Place rough chop mac nuts in pan with olive oil and butter & turn burner on as low as low can go. Step 2: Leave it there the longer the better, i usually leave for an hour while making the rest of dinner. Step 3: Leave long beans long or cut into smaller bite size pieces Crank up the heat and add long beans Do a quick stir fry for 4-5 minutes. Step 4: Remove to serving dish. Step 5: Garnish with green end of green onion sliced on the diagonal Perhaps another sprinkle of chopped mac nuts, too.

Ingredient Names: string bean, cooking oil, garlic, soy sauce, sherry wine, sugar, chicken broth, sesame oil, scallion, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook green beans until almost tender. Step 2: In a saute pan, heat the 1 t Oil and add the garlic, cook till soft. Step 3: Add the soy sauce, sherry, sugar and broth. Step 4: Cook for two minutes on med-high heat. Step 5: Add the sesame oil and scallions, swirling to heat through. Step 6: Add beans, heat through, serve.

Ingredient Names: cut green beans, almond halves, oil, celery, soy sauce, chicken bouillon cube, sugar, lemon juice, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 4 cups water in a pot and add green beans. Step 2: Boil for 2 minutes. Step 3: Drain liquid and save Lightly brown almonds in oil. Step 4: Add celery and saut for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup of liquid from the boiled beans, chicken bouillon, soy sauce, sugar and lemon juice. Step 6: Cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in green beans until hot through. Step 8: Add cornstarch mixture and cook until sauce thickens.

Dish Name: Mapo Dofu Spicy Tofu With Meat Sauce Szechwan Style
Ingredient Names: sesame oil, cooking oil, sweet onion, garlic, ground turkey, chili paste, chicken stock, soy sauce, sake, gingerroot, silken tofu, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sturdy frying pan, saute the onions and the garlic in the oils until onions are somewhat tender. Step 2: Add in the ground meat and chop it up with your spatula as you stir-fry Continue until meat is no longer pink. Step 3: Add in ginger, chili paste, sake or other wine, soy sauce, and chicken stock. Step 4: Bring to a boil, skimming off fat, if needed. Step 5: Add in the cubed tofu and stir gently, while trying to avoid breaking up the cubes. Step 6: Cook only until tofu is coated and hot. Step 7: Stir the cornstarch into a few tablespoons of water--just to moisten--and add this mixture slowly to the meat and tofu--stirring constantly Scoop heaping portions of the mapo dofu over steamed white rice and let guests add in more chili paste, if they desire.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, ground pork, salt, chili paste, chicken broth, leeks, black bean paste, tapioca starch, soy sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix marinade ingredients. Step 2: Marinate pork for about 20 minutes. Step 3: Cut the bean curd into 1 / 2 inch square cubes, and blanch for 2- 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from boiling water and drain. Step 5: Chop leeks or green onions into short lengths. Step 6: Heat wok and add oil. Step 7: When oil is ready, add the marinated pork. Step 8: Stir-fry pork until the color darkens, add salt and stir. Step 9: Add the black bean paste.

Dish Name: Marvelous Mu Shu Pork Without Cabbage
Ingredient Names: boneless lean pork, dried mushrooms, dried wood ear mushrooms, peanut oil, fresh ginger, bamboo shoot, carrot, fat free chicken broth, bean sprouts, green onions, hoisin sauce, mandarin pancakes, light soy sauce, wine, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Place dried mushrooms and wood ears in small bowl and cover with hot water. Step 2: Let stand 30 minutes. Step 3: Combine marinade ingredients in large bowl. Step 4: Add pork and stir to coat. Step 5: Let stand 30 minutes. Step 6: Drain and squeeze excess water out of mushrooms and wood ears. Step 7: Cut off and discard mushroom stems and cut caps into thin slices Pinch out hard nobs from center of wood ears and discard. Step 8: Cut wood ears into thin strips Omelet: heat oil in small nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

Dish Name: Mashed Potatoes Cauliflower With Ginger Scallion Pesto
Ingredient Names: potato, cauliflower, salt, butter, milk, pesto sauce, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, combine potatoes, cauliflower and salt with enough cold water to cover. Step 2: Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are easily crushed with a fork. Step 3: Drain and mash with butter and milk until smooth Warm potatoes over medium heat for 1 minute. Step 4: Add pesto, and stir well. Step 5: Season to taste with salt and pepper, serve.

Dish Name: Mean Chef's Dry Fried Chinese Eggplant Aubergine Nuggets
Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic, scallion, chinese chili sauce, dried shrimp, soy sauce, brown sugar, balsamic vinegar, hot water, corn, chinese eggplants
Instructions: Step 1: Combine aromatics. Step 2: Combine sauce ingredients. Step 3: Heat large heavy skillet. Step 4: Add 3 tbs Oil and swirl to glaze pan. Step 5: Reduce heat to moderate. Step 6: Add aromatics, stir gently 20-30 seconds- do not brown. Step 7: Add eggplant, toss to combine Adjust heat so eggplant cooks without scorching. Step 8: Drizzle in more oil as needed to keep from sticking, but beware that eggplant will absorb oil.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat spaghetti, reduced sodium soy sauce, sesame oil, canola oil, rice wine vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, scallion, fresh cilantro, snow peas, red bell pepper, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente, drain. Step 3: Rinse under cold water. Step 4: Meanwhile, whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, canola oil, vinegar, crushed red pepper, 1 / 4 cup scallions and 2 tablespoons cilantro. Step 5: Add noodles, snow peas and bell pepper. Step 6: Toss to coat To serve, mix in sesame seeds and garnish with remaining scallions and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, olive oil, green onion, green pepper, mushroom, chop suey vegetables, water chestnut, chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown pork in fat. Step 2: Remove meat from skillet. Step 3: Add onion, pepper, and mushrooms. Step 4: Cook gently 3 minutes add chop suey vegetables, chestnuts, stock, and pork. Step 5: Mix cornstarch, soy sauce, salt and pepper, stir til smooth, add to meat. Step 6: Simmer 10-15 minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger root, dark brown sugar, soy sauce, water, beef flank steak, cornstarch, vegetable oil for frying, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Heat vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger; cook and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 4: Stir in brown sugar, soy sauce, and water. Step 5: Increase heat to medium-high; stir until sauce boils and slightly thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Remove sauce from the heat and set aside. Step 7: Place beef into a large bowl; add cornstarch and mix until beef is thoroughly coated. Step 8: Set aside until most of the cornstarch has been absorbed, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 10: Shake excess cornstarch from beef slices and drop into hot oil, a few at a time, stirring briefly and frying until edges become crisp, about 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Remove beef with a large slotted spoon; drain on paper towels. Step 12: Remove excess oil from the skillet, then heat the skillet over medium heat; add beef slices and stir in prepared sauce. Step 13: Add green onions and bring to a boil; cook until the onions have just softened and are bright green, about 1 to, serve and.

Dish Name: Mongolian Hotpot With Chicken And Shrimp
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, red snapper fillet, large raw shrimp, napa cabbage, spinach, bean thread noodles, chicken stock, water, chinese rice wine, ginger, green onion, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, sesame paste, bean curd
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken and red snapper filets into thin slices. Step 2: Rinse the shrimp under warm running water and cut in half lengthwise. Step 3: Wash and shred the napa cabbage and spinach. Step 4: Soak the bean thread noodles in hot water until softened. Step 5: Place the sliced chicken, shrimp, red snapper and the shredded vegetables on separate platters on the table. Step 6: Place the dipping sauces on the table in small individual bowls. Step 7: Make sure each guest has a complete place setting, including a dipping fork and a small bowl for placing the cooked food On the stove, bring the broth and water with the rice wine to a boil, and add the ginger and green onion. Step 8: Transfer enough broth to the fondue pot or hot pot so that the pot is approximately 2 / 3 - 3 / 4 full. Step 9: Place the pot on the burner, and keep it simmering throughout the meal.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, broccoli florets, sliced fresh mushrooms, straw mushrooms, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, garlic, skinless boneless chicken breast, chicken broth, cornstarch, white sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until it begins to smoke. Step 2: Stir in broccoli and fresh mushrooms, then add straw mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and water chestnuts. Step 3: Stir-fry until broccoli is tender and all vegetables are hot, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to a bowl and wipe out the wok. Step 5: Heat remaining oil in the wok over high heat until it begins to smoke. Step 6: Add garlic and stir-fry until it turns golden, a few seconds. Step 7: Add chicken and stir-fry until browned on the edges and no longer pink in the center, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Stir broth, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice wine together in a small bowl; pour over chicken in the wok and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 9: Boil until sauce thickens and is no longer cloudy, about 30 seconds. Step 10: Return vegetables to the wok; toss with sauce and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, sesame oil, cornstarch, chicken breast tenderloins, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, vegetable oil, eggs, cabbage, shiitake mushrooms, garlic, sherry, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk water, sesame oil, and cornstarch together in a large bowl. Step 2: Add chicken, toss to coat, and set aside. Step 3: Combine remaining water and sesame oil in a separate bowl. Step 4: Whisk in hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, and soy sauce until well combined; set sauce aside. Step 5: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add eggs and cook for 5 minutes; flip and cook until firm and set, about more. Step 7: Transfer to a cutting board and slice into thin strips. Step 8: Add marinated chicken to the skillet and cook over medium-high heat for 2 hours. Step 9: Flip and cook until golden brown on the outside and the juices run clear, about more; transfer to a plate. Step 10: Heat remaining oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Step 11: Add cabbage, shiitake mushrooms, garlic, and sherry; cook until cabbage starts to wilt, about 5 minutes. Step 12: Add chicken, sliced egg, and reserved sauce to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Toss in green onions and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, eggs, fresh ginger, garlic clove, hot red pepper flakes, coleslaw mix, water, soy sauce, sesame oil, hoisin sauce, scallion, flour tortillas, cooked chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Yield: makes 4 servings Active time: 10 minute Total time: 25 minute Better than anything you can get at your local takeout joint, this way of making the chinese classic can be done in record time. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking, then cook eggs, stirring, until just cooked through. Step 3: Transfer scrambled eggs to a plate. Step 4: Add remaining 3 tablespoons oil to skillet and heat until hot but not smoking, then cook ginger, garlic, and red pepper flakes, stirring, until garlic is golden, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add coleslaw mix and 2 tablespoons water and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until coleslaw is wilted, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir together soy sauce, sesame oil, remaining 2 tablespoons water, and hoisin sauce in a small bowl. Step 7: Add to coleslaw mixture along with scallions and eggs and cook, stirring, 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Mu Shu Pork And Mandarin Pancakes
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dry sherry, hoisin sauce, boneless lean pork, dried black mushrooms, napa cabbage, carrot, scallions, bean sprouts, peanut oil, eggs, salt, garlic cloves, ginger, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, sherry and hoisin sauce in a bowl. Step 2: Add the pork, toss to coat evenly, cover, refrigerate and marinate for 30 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, soak the mushrooms in enough hot water to cover for 20 minutes. Step 4: Drain and thinly slice. Step 5: Set aside on a plate, along with the cabbage, carrot and scallions. Step 6: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil and swirl to coat. Step 8: Pour in the eggs, swirling and tilting the wok to form a thin film. Step 9: Cook just until the eggs are set and feel dry on top, about 1 minute. Step 10: Transfer to a platter, let cool slightly and cut into 1 inch strips.

Dish Name: Mu Shu Style Pork Roll Ups
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, toasted sesame oil, lean boneless pork, stir fry vegetables, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degree f. Step 2: Wrap tortillas tightly in foil. Step 3: Heat in preheated oven for 10 minutes to soften. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a large skillet heat sesame oil over medium-high heat, add pork strips. Step 5: Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until done add stir-fry vegetables. Step 6: Cook and stir for 3 to 4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 7: Spread each tortilla with 1 tablespoon of the plum or hoisin sauce. Step 8: Place a quarter of the meat mixture just below the center of each tortilla. Step 9: Fold the bottom edge of each tortilla up and over the filling.

Dish Name: Mustard Soy Braised Pork Chops With Celery
Ingredient Names: boneless sirloin pork chop, celery ribs, soy sauce, mustard, chili paste with garlic, oyster sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Season the pork chops with very little salt and considerably more black pepper, and sear in a medium saute pan over medium high heat for 2 minutes per side. Step 2: In a bowl or measuring cup, whisk the soy sauce, mustard, chili-garlic paste, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and salted black beans into the vegetable stock. Step 3: Pour the seasoned stock into the pan with the seared pork chops, bring to a low boil and lower the temperature to as low as the stove will allow. Step 4: Add the celery and simmer for 1 hour. Step 5: Serve in a bowl with plain white or brown rice.

Ingredient Names: dried wood ear mushrooms, boneless pork loin, salt, sugar, soy sauce, white pepper, shaoxing wine, cornstarch, water, peanut oil, eggs, garlic clove, scallions, sesame oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Soak wood ears in boiling water for 20-60 minutes, then drain and squeeze out excess water, and slice julienne Freeze the pork loin for 20-30 minutes to firm up a little bit, then slice very thin, then stack the slices and julienne. Step 2: Combine 1 / 4 t salt, 1 / 2 t sugar, 2 t soy sauce, 6 turns white pepper mill, 1 t wine, 1 t cornstarch, and 1 t water for the marinade. Step 3: Add to the pork and stir to coat. Step 4: Marinate meat for about 20 minutes, then stir in 1 t oil. Step 5: Beat the eggs lightly with 1 t oil and 1 / 4 t salt. Step 6: Heat a wok over high heat until smoke rises. Step 7: Add 1 t oil and swirl it around. Step 8: Add the wood ears and stir for 30 seconds. Step 9: Season with 1 / 4 t salt, 1 / 4 t sugar, and 1 t soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: pheasants, bok choy, fresh ginger, soy sauce, rice wine, garlic cloves, pepper, peanut oil, fermented black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Put bok choy and pheasant in a large sauce pan and add enough water to cover. Step 2: Add all remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover and simmer forty minutes or until tender.

Ingredient Names: egg roll wraps, dried mushroom, boneless skinless chicken breast, garlic clove, cooking oil, fresh bean sprouts, cabbage, green onion, bamboo shoot, soy sauce, cornstarch, ginger, artificial sweetener, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak mushrooms in warm water 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain, chop, discard stems, chop chicken. Step 3: Stir fry chicken and garlic quickly in heated cooking oil for 2 minutes, add vegetables. Step 4: Stir fry for 3 minutes more. Step 5: Blend soy sauce into cornstarch, ginger, sugar, and salt. Step 6: Stir into chicken mixture, cook until thickened, cool. Step 7: Wrap 2 tbsp filling in wrapper burrito style.

Ingredient Names: meat, pineapple, brown sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic, green pepper, onion, carrot, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Dice meat- chicken or pork. Step 2: In a large pan, brown meat over a medium heat. Step 3: Add carrots and cook to soften. Step 4: Add garlic, onions and pepper. Step 5: Once all vegetables are softened to desire, add pineapple and reduce heat to keep warm. Step 6: In a sauce pan, add enough water to pineapple juice to equal 1 1 / 2 cup liquid, add cornstarch and mix. Step 7: Add in sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce. Step 8: Bring to boil to thicken. Step 9: Pour over meat and vegetables. Step 10: Serve over hot rice.

Ingredient Names: pork, shaoxing wine, soy sauce, ginger juice, potato starch, black vinegar, rice vinegar, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine pork, 1 tablespoon of shaoxing wine, the soy sauce and ginger juice. Step 2: Allow it to marinate for 1 hour. Step 3: When done marinating, add 1 inch oil to a heavy bottomed pot and preheat the oil to 340 degrees f. Step 4: Prepare a wire rack by lining it with several layers of paper towels. Step 5: Put the potato starch in a small bowl, and roll each piece of pork in it to give each piece an even coating of starch. Step 6: Fry the pork in batches until lightly browned and cooked though. Step 7: Transfer the fried pork to the paper towel lined rack. Step 8: In a saute pan, add the remaining shaoxing wine along with the black vinegar, rice vinegar, soy sauce and sugar. Step 9: Turn the burner on to high heat and bring the mixture to a boil. Step 10: Add the cooked pork to the black vinegar sauce and continue boiling until the sauce is very thick and syrupy and coats each piece of pork, rather than the pan.

Ingredient Names: water, rice vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, orange juice, brown sugar, green onion, grated orange zest, fresh ginger root, garlic, red pepper flakes, cornstarch, skinless boneless chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine water, rice vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, and orange juice for sauce into a saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 3: Stir in brown sugar, green onion, orange zest, ginger, garlic, and pepper flakes; bring to a boil. Step 4: Remove from heat, and cool for 10 to. Step 5: Place chicken in a resealable plastic bag. Step 6: Pour in cooled sauce. Step 7: Seal the bag, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Step 8: Reserve the remaining sauce. Step 9: Mix flour, salt, and pepper in another resealable plastic bag. Step 10: Remove chicken from the marinade and place into the bag of seasoned flour. Step 11: Seal the bag and shake to coat. Step 12: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 13: Cook chicken in the hot skillet until browned on both sides. Step 14: Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and cover with aluminum foil. Step 15: Wipe out the skillet. Step 16: Pour reserved sauce into the skillet and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 17: Mix together cornstarch and water until completely smooth. Step 18: Stir into the boiling sauce. Step 19: Reduce heat to medium-low, add the chicken, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 15-20 minutes. Step 20: Serve over rice and.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, celery, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, water, raw rice, soy sauce, pepper, fried chinese noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together Place in covered casserole dish and microwave on high for 25 minutes Uncover and cook 5 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, french style green beans, chop suey vegetables, onion, salt, pepper, sharp cheddar cheese, cream of celery soup, water chestnuts, soy sauce, french-fried onions
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Mix together all ingredients except for fried onions, and place in a 2 1 / 2 quart casserole dish or baking pan. Step 3: Bake until heated through and bubbly. Step 4: Top with french-fried onions, if desired, the last 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, green onions, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, garlic, square wonton wrappers, nonstick cooking spray, chili-garlic sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine sausage, green onions, soy sauce, hoisin sauce and garlic. Step 2: Place 8 wonton wrappers on a clean surface and brush edges with water. Step 3: Place 1 tablespoon of mixture in the center of each wrapper. Step 4: Gather edges of wrapper together over filling. Step 5: Press edges of wrappper together enclosing the filling completely. Step 6: Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Step 7: Place a collabsible metal steamer rack in a large wide pot. Step 8: Fill pot with 1/2 inch of water. Step 9: Spray steamer with non-stick cooking spray. Step 10: Bring water to a simmer. Step 11: Working in batches, arrange dumplings on rack 1" apart. Step 12: Cover pot with lid and steam dumplings until cooked thoroughly, about 8 minutes. Step 13: Watch the water level and add more as needed. Step 14: Transfer dumplings to a platter and serve with dipping sauces.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, red wine vinegar, light soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat small skillet over high heat. Step 2: When hot, add sesame seeds and swirl until seeds become light brown and fragrant, remove from heat. Step 3: When seeds are cool, combine with other ingredients Use marinade on meats several hours before cooking.

Ingredient Names: mushrooms, garlic, gingerroot, chicken thighs, chicken breasts, oyster sauce, soya sauce, sesame oil, white pepper, cornflour, ketjap manis, pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat frying pan with 4 tbs of cooking oil. Step 2: Once oil is hot enough, put garlic and ginger in pan and fry for 1 / 2 minute. Step 3: Put chicken pieces in and fry for about 8 minutes. Step 4: Put the sauce in and cook on slow fire for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Oyster Sauce On Chinese Broccoli Gai Lan
Ingredient Names: broccoli, salt, baking soda, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the chinese broccoli. Step 2: Cut off the ends if not already trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces. Step 3: In a large saucepan, add enough water to cover the broccoli. Step 4: Add the salt, baking soda and ginger. Step 5: Bring to a boil While waiting for the water to boil, prepare the sauce. Step 6: Combine the chicken broth or water, oyster sauce, rice wine or dry sherry and sugar. Step 7: Bring to a boil in a small saucepan. Step 8: Turn the heat down and keep warm while blanching the broccoli. Step 9: Add the chinese broccoli to the boiling water.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, peanut oil, salted cashews, cornstarch, dry sherry, chicken broth, bamboo shoots
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in 1 inch cubes. Step 2: In a bowl, mix sauce of cornstarch, soy sauce, sherry, hoisin sauce and chicken broth, heat oil in wok. Step 3: When oil starts to smoke, add chicken and stir fry for 5 minues stir in bamboo shoots. Step 4: Pour sauce over chicken and stir until sauce thickens, stir in cashews. Step 5: Garnish with mandarin orange sections, cilantro, and / or green onions sliced on the bias You can check the readiness of the oil by putting the.

Ingredient Names: pea pods, oil, fresh mushrooms, salt, chicken stock, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Snip off ends of pea pods. Step 2: Wash, leave in colander. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in wok. Step 4: Add pea pods and stir-fry for one minute then remove and set aside. Step 5: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok, add mushrooms and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add pea pods, salt, stock and sugar. Step 7: Stir-fry 2 minutes and serve hot!

Dish Name: Pea Shoots Stir Fried Pea Shoots Chow Dau Miu
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, sugar, pea shoots, soy sauce, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the pea shoots thoroughly in cold water twice, lightly drain. Step 2: In a large wok or skillet over high heat, heat oils add ginger, garlic and sugar. Step 3: Toss and add shoots, soy, & oyster sauce. Step 4: Stir-fry for two to three minutes, or until the leaves soften and are tender. Step 5: Remove shoots leaving the liquid in pan. Step 6: Place shoots on serving dish. Step 7: Reduce the remaining liquid by 1 / 2. Step 8: Pour over shoots and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, sugar, peanut butter, rice vinegar, hot sauce, salt, asian noodles, sesame oil, white sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first 8 ingredients together in a nonreactive bowl and set aside. Step 2: Cook your noodles in a large pot of boiling water, following the directions on the package. Step 3: Drain and rinse well with cold water. Step 4: Return to pot and mix noodles with 2 tablespoons sesame oil If you want to eat your noodles cold, let them cool in the oil before mixing the peanut sauce with them This will help the flavors stay bright If you're eating them right away, mix the peanut sauce in right away and enjoy. Step 5: Sprinkle sesame seeds on individual portions for extra flavor and crunch.

Ingredient Names: roast beef, garlic, onion, cider vinegar, brewed coffee, water, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: With a sharp knife, cut slits all the way through the roast and insert slivers of onions and garlic. Step 2: Put the meat into a bowl and slowly pour the vinegar over it so that it runs down the sides into the slits. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24-48 hours. Step 4: When ready to cook, pour the vinegar off. Step 5: Place the meat in a heavy dutch oven and brown in oil until very dark on all sides. Step 6: Pour the 2 cups of brewed coffee over the meat and then add 2 cups of water. Step 7: Cover and cook slowly for approximately 6 hours on top of the stove You may need to add more water at some point, so check it once in a while and add only a small amount of water at a time. Step 8: Season well, but do not add the salt and pepper until about 20 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, plum sauce, dried red chili pepper, salt, garlic, onion, sesame oil, pizza crusts, duck, sweet onion, roma tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, fresh parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place into a mixing bowl hoisin sauce, plum sauce, chili, salt, garlic, onion and sesame oil and combine set aside until needed. Step 2: Preheat oven to 450. Step 3: Place a half size baking pan into the oven for 20 minutes. Step 4: Place the roast duck onto a cutting broad and hand shredded into pieces. Step 5: Place the pizza crust onto a flat surface. Step 6: Brush some plum hoisin sauce onto the crust and top with cheese, parsley leaves, and shredded duck meat, sliced onion and tomatoes and lightly with cheese. Step 7: Place onto the hot baking pan and into the oven About 15 minutes or until the pizza is golden brown. Step 8: Slice and serve hot.

Dish Name: Pepper Steak Stir Fry Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: beef tips, oil, garlic cloves, yellow onion, green onions, pepper, chili pepper flakes, broth, stewed tomatoes, green bell peppers, red pepper, light soy sauce, cornstarch, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut steak into 1" cubes. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large pan On high heat add steak and garlic, and cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add yellow onion and cook until meat is done. Step 4: Add the next 8 ingredients and cook until the peppers are soft. Step 5: Add the cornstarch to the water and mix well, then pour into the work slowly. Step 6: Cook about one minute until thickened.

Ingredient Names: pineapple juice, coconut milk, low-fat milk, tea, sugar syrup, tapioca, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients, except tapioca pearls and ice, into cocktail shaker or other tightly sealed container Shake for about 10 seconds or until nice froth or bubbles appear at surface. Step 2: Place tapioca pearls at bottom of tall glass, then pour shaken liquid into the glass on top of them. Step 3: Put as much ice as you want and stick a bubble tea straw in your glass and enjoy.

Dish Name: Pork And Green Bean Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: ground pork, garlic cloves, salt, ground red pepper, french haricots vert, peanut oil, teriyaki sauce, fresh lime zest, fresh lime juice, rice, red jalapeno chile, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground pork and next 3 ingredients in a large stainless steel skillet over medium high heat, stirring often, 7 - 8 minutes or until meat crumbles and is no longer pink. Step 2: Drain Wipe skillet clean. Step 3: Cook green beans in hot oil in skillet over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, 4 -5 minutes or until just tender and slightly charred. Step 4: Stir together teriyake sauce and next 2 ingredients. Step 5: Stir pork mixture into green beans. Step 6: Stir in teriyaki mixture, tossing to coat. Step 7: Serve immediately over rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: plum preserves, soy sauce, lemon juice, prepared horseradish, cornstarch, crushed red pepper flakes, yellow sweet peppers, ground ginger, oil, pears, pork tenderloin, sliced water chestnuts, snow peas, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a bwl, combine the first six ingredients, set aside. Step 2: In a skillet or wok, stir fry the yellow pepper and ginger in oil for 2 minutes, add pears. Step 3: Stir fry for 1 minute or until pepper is crisp tender. Step 4: Remove and keep warm. Step 5: Stir fry half the pork at a time for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 6: Return pear mixture and all of the pork to pan. Step 7: Add water chestnuts and reserved sauce Brint to boil.

Ingredient Names: white rice, boneless pork chop, cornstarch, soy sauce, fresh ginger, pineapple chunks in juice, oil, frozen sugar snap peas, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice according to package instructions and keep warm Should give you about 4 cups prepared. Step 2: Mix 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons soy sauce and ginger and coat pork. Step 3: Drain pineapple keeping a 1 / 2 cup of the juice and set pineapple aside. Step 4: Combine the 1 / 2 cup of pineapple juice with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup soy sauce and set aside. Step 5: Heat oil and stir fry pork for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add peas and pepper and stir fry another 2 minutes. Step 7: Add sauce mixture and pineapple and cook on medium heat until it boils and thickens, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Pork And Stir Fried Vegetables With Spicy Asian Sauce
Ingredient Names: canola oil, hoisin sauce, ketchup, low sodium soy sauce, garlic, ground red pepper, pork tenderloin, fresh ground black pepper, salt, dark sesame oil, button mushroom, red bell pepper, sliced water chestnuts, fresh ginger, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat canola oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Combine hoisin sauce and next 4 ingredients, stirring until blended, set aside, add pork to pan. Step 3: Sprinkle with black pepper and salt. Step 4: Cook 3 minutes on each side or until done, remove from pan. Step 5: Add sesame oil to pan. Step 6: Add mushrooms, bell pepper and ginger. Step 7: Stir fry 4-6 minutes or until bell pepper is tender and the liquid has evaporated.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, lean pork, garlic, red pepper flakes, firm tofu, bamboo shoots, scallions, chicken stock, dark soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, chili-garlic sauce
Instructions: Step 1: It is best to have everything prepped before starting. Step 2: Combine the stock, soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, and chili-garlic sauce. Step 3: Heat wok or large frying pan to medium hot. Step 4: Add the oil, pork, garlic, and pepper flakes. Step 5: Stir frequently to prevent garlic from burning and cook until pork is cooked through and lightly browned. Step 6: Add the tofu and bamboo shoots and stir gently until heated through Only about 1 minute. Step 7: Stir the sauce one last time and pour into wok or pan. Step 8: Stir gently until sauce is thickened and the tofu and pork is totally covered by sauce. Step 9: Top with scallions.

Dish Name: Pork Belly Sea Salt And Szechuan Pepper
Ingredient Names: pork belly, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, rice wine, brown onions, szechwan pepper, sea salt, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork, garlic, ginger, soy and wine in a bowl, cover and place in fridge to marinate for about six hours or overnight If possible, turn the pork over a few times. Step 2: Preheat oven to 200c. Step 3: Cut the unpeeled onions in half and place on a baking tray skin side up. Step 4: Place pork on top skin side up and bake in the oven for an hour or until cooked through and a deep golden brown Rest 30 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, dry-fry or place the szechuan pepper in the oven for two minutes to release aroma. Step 6: Then grind to a fine powder with the sea salt in a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle, place in a dish. Step 7: Serve slices of pork with lemon and szechuan salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, bok choy, celery, red bell pepper, sliced mushrooms, water chestnuts, garlic, chicken broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, dry sherry, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from pork, cut into pieces. Step 2: Combine flour and pork in a resealable bag, seal and shake well. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Add pork, cook or until browned. Step 5: Remove from pan and keep warm. Step 6: Heat remaining tablespoon oil in pan. Step 7: Add bok choy, celery, red pepper, mushrooms, water chestnuts and garlic; stir fry for 3-4 minutes. Step 8: In a bowl combine chicken broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, sherry and ginger. Step 9: Stir well with a whisk. Step 10: Combine pork and broth mixture in skillet, cook or until thick.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork chops, light soy sauce, white pepper, sugar, salt, sesame seed oil, cornstarch, oil, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Pound pork chops to thin them a bit. Step 2: Combine next five ingredients and marinate the chops in the mixture for 30 minutes, then drain Dredge pork chops with cornstarch. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or skillet. Step 4: Fry chops until golden brown. Step 5: Cook about 5 minutes each side. Step 6: Drain on paper towel. Step 7: Place on a platter and garnish with cilantro.

Dish Name: Pork Chops With Ginger Soy Glaze
Ingredient Names: low sodium chicken broth, dry white wine, soy sauce, sugar, fresh ginger, garlic, boneless pork loin chops, vegetable oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, wine, soy sauce, sugar, ginger and garlic in shallow glass dish, whisk to blend. Step 2: Add pork and turn to coat. Step 3: Refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 3 hours. Step 4: Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Drain pork and reserve marinade. Step 6: Add pork to skillet and saut until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Step 7: Transfer pork to platter. Step 8: Add marinade and green onions to same skillet. Step 9: Boil until reduced to glaze, about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, celery, pork, soy sauce, bean sprouts, cornstarch, beef broth, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep skillet or wok. Step 2: Saute the onion and celery 5 minutes. Step 3: Mix in the pork, soy sauce and sprouts, cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Mix the cornstarch with the broth. Step 5: Add to the skillet, stirring steadily to the boiling point. Step 6: Cook 3 minutes more. Step 7: Serve with rice or chow mein noodles.

Ingredient Names: lean boneless pork, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red peppers, green onions, black bean paste, oyster sauce, soy sauce, chili paste with garlic, sugar, chicken stock, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Stir fry pork, garlic and ginger in a tablespoon or so of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet for about 4-5 minutes or till cooked through. Step 2: Remove from pan, add peppers and green onions and stir fry 2 minutes or till still fairly crisp. Step 3: Meanwhile mix all the rest of the ingredients together, add to pan with pork, cook, stirring, till thickened and bubbly, 1 minute or so.

Ingredient Names: linguine, low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, cornstarch, white sugar, sesame oil, canola oil, snap peas, sweet onion, pork tenderloin, white mushrooms, red bell pepper, garlic, fresh ginger, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook the linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to; drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, whisk soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, sugar, and sesame oil together in a small bowl. Step 3: Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add snap peas and onion; cook and stir until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add pork, mushrooms, red bell pepper, 1/3 of the garlic, and ginger; cook until pork is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add remaining garlic to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Pour in soy sauce mixture; cook and stir until sauce thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Remove from the heat. Step 9: Stir linguine into the skillet until coated; sprinkle green onions over top.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, dark soy sauce, cornflour, cashew nuts, peanuts, frying oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red bell peppers, celery ribs, baby corn, sugar snap peas, chicken stock, fresh coriander, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork into 1 / 2 slices & place in a shallow dish. Step 2: Mix the soy sauce & cornflour together & pour over the pork mixing evenly. Step 3: Cover with clingfilm & leave to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours. Step 4: Stir fry the cashew & peanuts in a dry wok until toasted Reserve. Step 5: Combine all the vegetables, garlic & ginger. Step 6: Heat a wok with 1 / 2 of the frying oil & stir fry the vegetables until the celery & peppers have softened. Step 7: Remove from wok & keep warm. Step 8: Drain the pork reserving the remaining marinade. Step 9: Using the remaining oil heat in the wok until nearly smoking & stir fry the pork for around 5 minutes or until browned.

Dish Name: Pork Patatim Filipino Chinese Stewed Pork Leg Knuckles
Ingredient Names: pork legs, star anise, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, water, brown sugar, rice wine, sake, peppercorn, sesame oil, cornstarch, baby bok choy, dried shiitake mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Bake pork pata in oven at 450 until the skin turns brown This is what prevents the skin from breaking when it is stewing While the pork pata is baking, soak the shitake mushrooms in hot water. Step 2: When done, place pata in a casserole. Step 3: Add the 6 cups of water, soy sauce, hoysin sauce, brown sugar, pepper corns and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add the star anise and sesame oil. Step 5: Simmer for an hour, or until pork is tender that the meat almost falls off the bone. Step 6: Mix constarch in 1 / 4 cup cold water, and add to the pot Continue to let it simmer until sauce thickens Blanch the bokchoy in boiling water seasoned with garlic salt.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, garlic cloves, onions, lemon juice, soy sauce, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Combine garlic, onion, lemon juice, soy sauce, and honey in a self-sealing plastic bag. Step 2: Mix well to blend, add tenderloin Seal bag and refrigerate 4-24 hours. Step 3: Remove tenderloin from marinade, discarding marinade. Step 4: Grill over medium-hot coals, 20-30 minutes, turning as necessary.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, oil, soy sauce, water, sugar, onion, gingerroot, firm tofu, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice pork. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet Brown pork. Step 3: Add soy sauce, water, sugar, onion and ginger root. Step 4: Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes Gently stir in tofu. Step 5: Simmer a few minutes longer. Step 6: Add green onions just before serving.

Ingredient Names: pork fillet, peanut oil, garlic, fresh coriander, dark soy sauce, sugar, pineapple, green chili pepper, light soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork into thin strips about 5cm / 2in long. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine the marinade ingredients. Step 3: Add the pork, mix well and leave to marinate at room temperature while you prepare the other ingredients. Step 4: Drain, discarding the marinade. Step 5: Heat a wok over a high heat until it is hot, add the oil, and when it is very hot and slightly smoking, add the garlic and stir-fry for 15 seconds or until golden brown. Step 6: Add the pork and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 7: Finally, add the pineapple, coriander, chili if using, soy sauce and sugar and continue to stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 8: Sprinkle with the chopped coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, bamboo shoots, garlic, fresh red chile pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, ground pork, shaoxing rice wine, salt, rice vinegar, soy sauce, chicken broth, green onions, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat one tablespoon peanut oil in a wok set over medium heat. Step 2: Add the bamboo shoots to the pan; stir-fry until dry and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Remove from wok and reserve. Step 4: Increase temperature to high, and pour in the remaining peanut oil. Step 5: Quickly fry the garlic, red chile, and red pepper flakes in the hot oil until fragrant. Step 6: Stir in the pork, and continue to stir-fry until it is cooked through. Step 7: Pour in the wine; season with salt to taste. Step 8: Return the bamboo shoots to the wok, and heat until sizzly. Step 9: Stir in the rice vinegar, soy sauce, chicken broth, and additional salt to taste. Step 10: Cook and stir for 1 to to allow the flavor to penetrate the bamboo shoots. Step 11: At the end of cooking, stir in green onions. Step 12: Remove wok from heat; stir in sesame oil before serving.

Dish Name: Qdm's Whatever Ya Got Egg Rolls
Ingredient Names: egg roll wraps, oil, cornstarch, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, pork steak, green onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, stir fry vegetables, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together corn starch, soy sauce and hoisin. Step 2: Add meat, ginger, onions and garlic. Step 3: Let sit for 30 minutes. Step 4: Spread frozen vegetables on cutting board and chop them up very finely. Step 5: Wrap vegetables in paper towels or a cotton towel to soak up moisture. Step 6: Heat wok with 3 tbs of oil Chow the meat mixture in 3 batches just until meat is done. Step 7: Remove from wok and set aside Adding more oil, if necessary, chow the vegetable for around 2 minutes, making sure not to lose crispness. Step 8: Return meat to wok and stir well into vegetable.

Ingredient Names: instant noodles, water, large egg, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, chili sauce, spring onions, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil: Bring water to a boil, gently add eggs, and cook for exactly 6½ to. Step 2: Ice Bath: Immediately transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 3– to stop cooking. Step 3: Marinate (Optional but recommended): Peel the eggs and marinate in a mix of soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and water for at least (or overnight). Step 4: Serve: Slice in half, letting the yolk flow into the broth.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork chops, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, sesame oil, five-spice powder, fresh ginger, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients except the pork chops. Step 2: Add pork and coat both sides with marinade and marinate in refrigerator for 2-4 hours. Step 3: Drain chops, discarding marinade. Step 4: Place in baking dish and roast at 400f in the oven for 20-25 minutes or grill over direct heat for 8-10 minutes, turning once.

Dish Name: River Road Cookbook Sweet And Sour Pork
Ingredient Names: egg, cornstarch, lean pork, oil, sugar, cider vinegar, red wine vinegar, salt, water, sweet peppers, pineapple
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the egg and incorporate the 2 tablespoons cornstarch in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add the pork and coat the pieces with the egg / cornstarch batter Deep fry in 375 degree fahrenheit oil in batches to keep the oil up to temperature, until light brown. Step 3: Drain on paper towels. Step 4: Cut peppers into 1 / 4-inch slivers. Step 5: Cut slivers in half. Step 6: Drain pineapple If using sliced pineapples, cut them into tidbits. Step 7: Put the sugar, vinegars, salt and water, or pineapple juice, in a large saucepan, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: duck, salt, ground chinese flower pepper, soy sauce, sherry wine, green onions, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Rub salt and chinese flower pepper on duck and put green onions in the cavity. Step 2: Keep in refrigerator for 24 hours, take out 2 hours before baking. Step 3: Preheat oven to 450. Step 4: Bake 45 minutes at 450 on roasting pan rack with breast up. Step 5: Reduce heat to 350 and continue baking 1 hour more. Step 6: Mix honey, soy sauce, and sherry Baste duck with sauce mixture Continue baking 30 minutes more Brushing 3 times until mixture is gone. Step 7: Remove duck and let cool 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, salt, dark soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, ground ginger, pork roast
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together sauce ingredients adding only 1 minced garlic clove. Step 2: Place roast in crockpot. Step 3: Slice remaining garlic cloves and tuck into roast pour sauce over roast and cook 6-8 hrs. Step 4: Turn roast over half way through cooking Serving suggestions. Step 5: Serve with rice and ramen salad or coconut carrot salad.

Ingredient Names: eggs, scallion, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a medium sized skillet over meduim heat. Step 2: Add eggs and scallions Use a wisk to move cooked eggs to side of skillet. Step 3: Once all eggs are in the pile serve hot If you would like harder eggs break the pile and cook until eggs reach desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: kashmiri red chili, spicy red chili, water, oil, garlic, ginger, tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, pepper powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl take 50 grams kashmiri red chilli and 50 grams of spicy dried red chilli. Make sure to deseed the chilli to reduce the spice level. Step 2: Soak in hot water for 30 minutes. Step 3: Cool completely, and grind to a smooth paste. Keep aside. Step 4: In a pan heat ½ cup oil, add 1 cup garlic and ½ cup ginger. Step 5: Fry until the garlic and ginger turns aromatic. make sure not to brown the garlic. Step 6: Add in prepared chilli paste and mix well. Step 7: Continue to cook until the oil separates. Step 8: Now add 3 tbsp tomato sauce. 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp vinegar, 2 tsp soy sauce, ½ tsp pepper powder, and 1 tsp salt. Step 9: Mix well making sure everything is well combined and the oil separates. Step 10: Finally, cool completely, and Schezwan Chutney Recipe is ready to enjoy for up to a month.

Ingredient Names: oil, shrimp if, thumb sized ginger, fresh bean sprouts, green onions, eggs, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan and stir-fry the prawns on a high heat for 30 secs until they start to take on a little colour. Tip in the ginger, bean sprouts and half of the spring onions and stir-fry for another 30 secs, then turn down the heat and pour in the eggs. Step 2: Leave to set for a few seconds, then move the loosely-set egg around the pan with a spatula to scramble. When all of the egg has set, tip in the soy sauce and let it sizzle for a few seconds. Serve sprinkled with the rest of the shredded spring onion and season with more soy sauce to taste.

Ingredient Names: light rum, lime juice, tahini, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the lime juice, honey and tahini in a shaker Add the rum and ice, shake and pour into a martini glass.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, green onions, pork tenderloin, vegetable oil, garlic, fresh broccoli, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, cornstarch, and soy sauce, blend well. Step 2: Add chopped green onions, toss lightly and set aside. Step 3: Cut tenderloin into bite-size pieces. Step 4: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add pork and garlic, stir fry until meat is cooked. Step 6: Remove pork and set aside. Step 7: Add broccoli and broth, cover and simmer on low for approximately 10 minutes. Step 8: Add the pork and cook until hot, stirring frequently. Step 9: Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: asparagus spears, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: With one hand, hold an asparagus stalk at its base. Bend the stalk over with your other hand – the asparagus will break where the woody part ends and the tender part begins. Discard the base. Place 4 or 5 asparagus stalks next to one another 5 minutes. Skewer them crosswise in two places – just below the tips and 3cm from the bottom – with slender bamboo skewers. You will end up with something that looks like a raft. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine the sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic and sesame seeds and stir with a fork to mix. Brush this mixture on the asparagus rafts on both sides. Season the asparagus with a little salt and lots of pepper. Step 3: Grill the asparagus on a barbecue or in a griddle pan for 4-5 mins per side, turning with tongs. Sprinkle with sesame mix as they grill.

Ingredient Names: peppercorn, chicken stock, soy sauce, rice vinegar, white wine, sesame oil, cornstarch, boneless skinless chicken breasts, oyster sauce, shanghai noodles, raw cashews, peanut oil, garlic, fresh ginger, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the peppercorns in a dry pan for 30 to 60 seconds. Step 2: Make the sauce by whisking together the chicken stock, soy sauce, black vinegar, rice wine, sesame oil, cornstarch and peppercorns. Step 3: Place the chicken in a bowl with the oyster sauce and soy sauce. Step 4: Stir together and let stand 15 minutes. Step 5: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 6: Cook according to directions on package, drain, rinse and drain again. Step 7: Preheat the oven to 375f Toast the cashews in the oven for 5 to 7 minutes until golden Coarsley chop and set aside. Step 8: Place a wok or wide skillet over high heat until hot.

Dish Name: Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes)
Ingredient Names: rice, rice flour, salt, oil, bok choy, carrot, cabbage, button mushrooms, corn flour, dark soy sauce, red chili sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: We begin making the Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes) by preparing the rice cakes, so mix all the ingredients in a microwave bowl and add water. Step 2: Mix thoroughly and make it into a sticky paste. Cover the bowl with cling film, leaving an inch open. Step 3: Place it in the microwave oven for on high. Step 4: Remove and add 1/4 water and mix it again and repeat the process. Once done remove dough and it and place it on the board and using a muddler, pound the dough in order to combine and get a smooth consistency. Step 5: You can apply some oil on the board before doing this process to prevent sticking. Step 6: Pound the dough for 2 minutes. After it is done, use your hand to bind it together and knead it for 8-10 minutes. Step 7: Divide the dough into two and roll it into the cylindrical shape by applying some more oil on your hand as well as on the board. Step 8: Wrap it using a cling film and store it in the fridge for 5 minutes. Remove from the fridge and cut them lengthwise and keep it aside. Step 9: Heat a wok with oil, add ginger and garlic, saute for few seconds. Add all the vegetables and saute them till it is cooked, you can add some water and cover it and let it cook. Meanwhile,mix all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl with 1/4 water and keep it aside. Step 10: Once the vegetables are done, pour in the sauce mixture and keep stirring till it thickens. At this point, you can add in the rice cakes and give it a stir. Step 11: Serve the Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes) along with General Tso cauliflower for a satisfying lunch.

Dish Name: Shih Tzu Tou Lion's Head Casserole
Ingredient Names: dried shiitake mushrooms, boiling water, ground pork butt, scallion, water chestnuts, chinese rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, fresh ginger, soy sauce, salt, napa cabbage, peanut oil, cornstarch, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cover mushrooms with boiling hot water in a small bowl and let stand 30 minutes, then squeeze excess water from mushrooms and reserve 1 cup mushroom-soaking liquid. Step 2: Discard mushroom stems and cut caps into very thin slices. Step 3: Meanwhile, mix together pork, scallions, water chestnuts, rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, 1 tablespoon ginger, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl with your hands Gather together pork mixture and throw against bottom or side of bowl 5 or 6 times to firm texture, then chill, covered, until ready to use. Step 4: Remove and reserve 4 large cabbage leaves Halve cabbage head lengthwise, then cut out and discard core. Step 5: Cut cabbage leaves crosswise into 2 inch pieces. Step 6: Heat wok over high heat until a drop of water evaporates instantly Swirl 2 tablespoons oil to coat bottom and sides of wok, then stir-fry mushrooms, half of cabbage, and remaining tablespoon of ginger until cabbage begins to wilt, about 1 to 2 minutes. Step 7: Add remaining cabbage and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and stir-fry until all of cabbage has begun to wilt, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, shaoxing wine, cornstarch, fresh ground black pepper, rice vinegar, black vinegar, dark soy sauce, sugar, garlic and red chile paste, sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger, scallion, water chestnuts, cloud ear mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with wine, cornstarch and black pepper while cutting vegetables. Step 2: Mix together sauce ingredients: vinegars, soy sauce, wine, sugar, chili garlic paste and sesame oil, set aside. Step 3: Slice water chestnuts into shreds, about three pieces per slice Trim any woody parts from the fungus and discard. Step 4: Roll up fungus into a cigar shape and thinly slice crosswise to make thin ribbon-like shreds. Step 5: Heat wok on high heat until it is about to start smoking, add oil and heat until it shimmers, then stir fry garlic, ginger and white part of scallion together for thirty seconds. Step 6: Add drained chicken, and pat into a layer on the bottom of the wok. Step 7: Allow chicken to brown lightly by sitting undisturbed on the wok for 45-60 seconds. Step 8: Stir and fry until chicken is nearly done.

Ingredient Names: fresh bean sprouts, cooked small shrimp, eggs, green onions, garlic powder, vegetable oil, chicken broth, cornstarch, sugar, chinese cooking wine, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix bean sprouts, shrimp, eggs, green onions, and garlic powder together in a large bowl until well combined. Step 2: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add about egg mixture into the skillet to make a patty. Step 4: Repeat to add more egg patties to the skillet. Step 5: Working in batches, fry patties until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 6: Meanwhile, to make the sauce: Whisk chicken broth, cornstarch, sugar, cooking wine, and soy sauce together in a saucepan over medium-low heat; simmer until sauce thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Spoon sauce over egg patties.

Dish Name: Shrimp with Broccoli in Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: fresh broccoli florets, water, peanut oil, garlic, low-sodium chicken broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce, fresh ginger root, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, water chestnuts, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Combine broccoli and water in a glass bowl; steam in microwave oven until slightly tender, 2 to. Step 2: Heat peanut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Add chicken broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and ginger root to the garlic; bring to a boil. Step 6: Add shrimp; cook and stir until the shrimp turn pink, 3 to. Step 7: Toss steamed broccoli and water chestnuts with shrimp mixture to coat with sauce. Step 8: Stir cornstarch into mixture, at a time, until sauce thickens, about 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, cooking sherry, shrimp, peeled and deveined, vegetable oil, garlic, ground pork, water, soy sauce, sugar, salt, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve cornstarch in sherry in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add shrimp and toss to coat. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add shrimp and stir-fry until pink, 3 to. Step 5: Use a slotted spoon to transfer shrimp to a plate; leave as much oil in the wok as possible. Step 6: Add garlic to the wok and stir-fry for a few seconds, then add ground pork. Step 7: Stir-fry until pork is no longer pink, 3 to. Step 8: Mix water, soy sauce, sugar, and salt together in a small bowl; pour into the wok and stir to combine. Step 9: Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce the heat to medium, and simmer for about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Whisk cold water and cornstarch together in a small bowl; pour into the wok. Step 11: Add shrimp and bring to a simmer. Step 12: Drizzle beaten egg into the wok, stirring quickly as it cooks. Step 13: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Sichuan Stir Fried Pork In Garlic Sauce Cook's Illustrated
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, sugar, soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, chinese rice wine, ketchup, fish sauce, cornstarch, country-style boneless pork ribs, baking soda, cold water, minced garlic cloves, scallions, garlic and red chile paste
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all sauce ingredients together in bowl, set aside 2. Step 2: Cut pork into 2 lengths and then cut each length into 1 / 4 matchsticks. Step 3: Combine pork with baking soda and water in bowl. Step 4: Let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes 3. Step 5: Rinse pork in cold water. Step 6: Drain well and pat dry with paper towels.

Ingredient Names: frogs, garlic, onion, ginger, cracked black pepper, salt, olive oil, sesame oil, cornstarch, buttermilk
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the 4 pairs of frog legs in buttermilk for 1 hour in the meantime, prepare stock: combine other parts of the frog with 3 cups of water, garlic, onions, ginger, salt and black pepper in a pot, cover, let boil and simmer for about 15minutes heat olive oil in wok and pan-fry the marinated legs until lightly browned, add sesame oil. Step 2: Add stock, cover and simmer legs for 20-30 minutes until tender combine cornstarch with 1 to 2 tablespoon of cold water, stir until dissolve and use it to thicken the stock if required serve with rice and stir-fried vegetables for a complete chinese meal.

Dish Name: Singapore Pork And Onion Stir Fry Chinese
Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, onion, light soya sauce, dark soya sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, cornstarch, ground black pepper, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice onions, set aside. Step 2: Slice pork against the grain into thin, matchbox-sized pieces. Step 3: Place in large bowl. Step 4: Marinate with sauces, sugar and sesame oil, mix well. Step 5: Leave for 15-60 minutes to marinate. Step 6: Heat frying pan / wok with 2 tablespoons of oil. Step 7: Stir-fry onions on low fire, till soft and fragrant, add pork.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, cornstarch, olive oil, onion, garlic, green onions, soy sauce, water, brown sugar, fresh ginger root, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place flank steak and cornstarch into a resealable plastic bag. Step 2: Shake the bag to evenly coat the flank steak with the cornstarch. Step 3: Allow to steak rest for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Cook and stir steak until evenly browned, 2 to. Step 6: Place onion, garlic, flank steak, green onions, soy sauce, water, brown sugar, ginger, and hoisin sauce in a slow cooker. Step 7: Cook on Low setting for about 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: red cabbage, green bell pepper, onion, carrots, coriander leaves, mint leaves, basil leaves, sesame seeds, peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha sauce, salt, black pepper powder, red chili flakes, lemon juice, soba noodles
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Soba Noodle Salad recipe, in a pot boil the soba noodles as per package instructions. Step 2: Strain under cold water and keep aside. In a salad bowl, add the red cabbage, bell peppers, green onions, carrots, coriander leaves, mint leaves and basil leaves. Step 3: Mix all the vegetables. Then take another bowl and add the peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha, ginger, salt, pepper, chilli flakes and lime juice. Whisk well to combine all the ingredients to form a dressing. Add the noodles to the veggies in the salad bowl followed by the dressing and sesame seeds. Mix well and serve cold. Step 4: The salad tastes better if you let it sit in the refrigerator for some time. Step 5: Enjoy! Serve Soba Noodle Salad along with Chinese Vegetarian Fried Rice With Apples for a weekend night dinner.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sugar, pork belly, soy sauce, five-spice powder, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large dutch oven or wok, heat oil and sugar over medium-high heat, swirling pot until sugar melts and turns a caramel-amber color. Step 2: Place pork belly slices in pot and sear on all sides, about 1 minute per side, using tongs to turn. Step 3: Pour enough cold water into vessel to cover the pork. Step 4: Add soy sauce, five spice powder, ginger, garlic, and salt. Step 5: Bring to a boil and skim any scum that rises to the surface. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 3-4 hours, until pork is very tender and fat is easily penetrated with a spoon. Step 7: Add water as necessary to keep pork fully submerged. Step 8: Remove pork belly and set aside. Step 9: Strain solids from braising liquid and return liquid to pan Over high heat, reduce until lightly thickened and glossy.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, oil, gingerroot, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, combine all ingredients Mix well Serve at room temperature.

Dish Name: Soy Sherry Marinade For Barbecued Pork
Ingredient Names: salt, sugar, garlic, scallion, soy sauce, sherry wine, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Rub pork strips with 1 tsp salt and 2 tsp sugar, let stand 30 minutes Crush garlic and mince scallion, combine with soy sauce sherry and 1 tbls honey. Step 2: Add to pork strips and let stand 30 minutes more, turning frequently. Step 3: Drain, discarding marinade. Step 4: Combine remaining honey and sugar, brush over meat and roast.

Ingredient Names: soya chunks, salt, water, cornstarch, chili powder, garam masala, oil, ginger garlic, green onions, onions, capsicum, chili, chili sauce, tomato sauce, vinegar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a bowl, take 1 cup of soya chunks, 1 tsp salt and hot water. Step 2: Soak for 5 minutes or until the soya softens. Step 3: Squeeze off the water and transfer to the bowl. Step 4: Add ¼ cup corn flour, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp salt. Step 5: Mix well, ensuring the soya is evenly coated. Step 6: Deep fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 7: Fry until the soya turns golden and crispy. Keep aside. Step 8: In a pan, heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 2 tbsp ginger garlic, 2 tbsp spring onion and saute well. Step 9: Also add ½ onion, ½ capsicum, 3 chilli and saute well. Step 10: Now add 2 tbsp chilli sauce, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp vinegar, 2 tsp soy sauce and ½ tsp salt. Step 11: Mix well, ensuring the sauces are thoroughly cooked. Step 12: Further add fried soya, 2 tbsp spring onion and mix well. Step 13: Finally, enjoy Soya Chilli Recipe with tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: coleslaw mix, ground chicken, sesame seeds, sesame oil, stir-fry sauce, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook sesame seeds in large skillet or wok for 3 minutes over medium heat or until golden brown in color. Step 2: Remove from heat and set aside In same skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until hot. Step 3: Cook chicken approximately 6 minutes or until it is no longer pink, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add coleslaw and stir fry sauce, stir. Step 5: Cook 2-3 minutes or until crisp tender. Step 6: Serve on lettuce leaves if desire and sprinkle with sesame seeds for garnish.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless pork loin steaks, salt and pepper, light brown sugar, tomato paste, pineapple, chili powder, chinese five spice powder, cilantro leaf, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Add the oil to a large non-stick pan, season the steaks well, then fry for 5 mins on each side until golden and almost cooked through. Step 2: Mix the sugar, soy, tomato paste and most of the pineapple juice in a bowl. Step 3: Add the pineapple rings to the pan and let them caramelise a little alongside the pork. Step 4: Add the chili and five-spice to the pan, then fry for 1 min until aromatic. Step 5: Sprinkle with cilantro, and serve with rice and chinese greens.

Ingredient Names: medium-dry sherry, cornstarch, soy sauce, sesame oil, boneless pork loin, sugar, peanut oil, fresh ginger, garlic, hot red pepper flakes, red bell pepper, snow peas, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together sherry, cornstarch, and 1 tblsp soy sauce, then stir in sesame oil. Step 2: Add pork, stirring to coat well, and let stand 10 minutes. Step 3: Stir together sugar and remaining 2 tblsps soy sauce. Step 4: Heat a wok or large nonstick skillet over high heat until a bead of water dropped on cooking surface evaporates immediately. Step 5: Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons peanut oil, swirling wok to coat evenly, then stir-fry 1 teaspoon ginger, 1 teaspoon garlic, and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper flakes until fragrant, about 5 seconds. Step 6: Add bell pepper and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Add snow peas and cashews and stir-fry until snow peas are crisp-tender, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 8: Transfer vegetables to a bowl. Step 9: Heat remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons peanut oil in wok until just smoking, then stir-fry remaining ginger, garlic, and pepper flakes until fragrant, about 5 seconds. Step 10: Add pork and stir-fry, separating strips, until browned and barely cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, water, steak seasoning, chicken, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, water, and spicy steak seasoning. Step 3: Add chicken and stir. Step 4: Let marinate 5 to 10 minutes. Step 5: Spoon meat onto each wrap Moisten edges of wrap with water or egg whites. Step 6: Fold over to make a triangle and pinch closed. Step 7: Bring the ends together and twist slightly, forming the characteristic wonton shape. Step 8: Place on greased baking sheet and bake 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, soy sauce, water, dry sherry, sugar, cornstarch, ground red pepper, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, peanut oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash beans Trim ends, and remove strings. Step 2: Slice beans in half lengthwise, and set aside. Step 3: Combine soy sauce and next 5 ingredients, stirring until smooth, set aside. Step 4: Cook ginger and garlic in hot peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Step 5: Add beans and cook 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 6: Stir soy sauce mixture, and add to beans. Step 7: Cook stirring constantly, 1 minute or until mixture thickens. Step 8: Remove from heat, and sprinkle with a few drops of sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, hoisin sauce, vegetable oil, sugar, garlic, red pepper flakes, meat, water, butter, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In heavy duty freezer bag, mix soy sauce, hoisin sauce, oil, garlic, sugar and red pepper flakes. Step 2: Add meat and stir stir to coat all over Seal and refrigerate for at least 1 to 3 hours, turning bag over occasionally. Step 3: Remove meat, reserving marinade, and cook meat until desired doneness. Step 4: Meanwhile pour marinade from bag into saucepan. Step 5: Rinse bag with the 1 / 2 cup of water. Step 6: Add water to saucepan. Step 7: Bring to a low boil. Step 8: Boil slowly for 5 to 6 minutes Right before meat is ready to serve, add butter to saucepan.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, salt, black pepper, flank steak, oil for frying, soy sauce, rice vinegar, rice wine, honey, granulated sugar, chile paste, water, fresh ginger root, vegetable oil, garlic, onion, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in deep-fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, combine cornstarch, salt and pepper together, mix thoroughly. Step 3: Toss the steak slices in the cornstarch mixture and coat well. Step 4: Deep fry the coated steak slices until golden brown. Step 5: Check to make sure they are cooked through. Step 6: Remove from oil, and set aside. Step 7: In another mixing bowl, combine the soy sauce, rice vinegar, rice wine and honey. Step 8: Add sugar, chili paste, water, and ginger. Step 9: Mix well and set aside. Step 10: Heat a wok or deep frying pan over medium high heat. Step 11: Add oil, and quickly saute the onion, garlic and red pepper for 30 seconds. Step 12: Add the sauce mixture, and cook another 30 seconds. Step 13: Finally, add the strips of fried steak and toss to heat through and coat with sauce.

Ingredient Names: beef top round steak, cornstarch, orange zest, low sodium beef broth, orange juice, reduced sodium soy sauce, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, canola oil, gingerroot, green beans, red bell pepper, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and orange rind in medium bowl. Step 2: Toss well to coat and set aside. Step 3: Combine remaining 1 tbsp cornstarch, broth, orange juice, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in small bowl, set aside. Step 4: Heat nonstick skillet over med-high heat until a drop of water sizzles. Step 5: Add 2 tsp oil, then add beef. Step 6: Stir-fry until cooked through. Step 7: Transfer to a plate. Step 8: Add remaining 2 tsp oil, then add the ginger. Step 9: Stir-fry until fragrant.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, olive oil, light soy sauce, water, cornstarch, ketchup, red pepper flakes, ground ginger, chili sauce, sesame seeds, cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Step 3: Cook chicken in the oil until just done then add the soy sauce and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the cornstarch to the water and stir until dissolved then add to chicken. Step 5: Cook for 2 minutes then add all the rest of the ingredients and cook until desired thickness, approx time 5-10 minutes Salt and pepper is optional, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Spicy Szechuan Noodles Dan Dan Mian
Ingredient Names: ground pork, soy sauce, dry sherry, white pepper, oyster sauce, peanut butter, rice vinegar, chicken broth, peanut oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, toasted sesame oil, asian noodles, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine meat mixture ingredients in small bowl Work together well and let rest while preparing other ingredients. Step 2: Whisk together sauce ingredients except broth until smooth. Step 3: Add broth and whisk well. Step 4: Boil 4 quarts of water. Step 5: Heat 12 inch skillet over high heat until hot, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add peanut oil and swirl. Step 7: Add meat mixture and cook, breaking up into small pieces until pork is well browned, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in ginger, garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 9: Add sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: brussels sprouts, sunflower oil, chili rings, garlic, ginger, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the sprouts in boiling salted water for 3 mins, then drain. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok, then stir-fry the chilli, garlic and ginger for 1 min. Step 3: Add the brussels sprouts, cook for 2 mins, then drizzle with the soy sauce. Step 4: Give everything a final toss before serving.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic cloves, ginger, red pepper flakes, red bell pepper, shiitake mushrooms, fresh spinach, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Step 3: Stir fry 30 seconds. Step 4: Add bell pepper and mushrooms. Step 5: Stir fry 2 minutes. Step 6: Add spinach and fish sauce. Step 7: Stir fry 2 minutes or until spinach is wilted.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, rice flour, eggs, milk, salt, sesame oil, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all ingredients except the onions in a bowl until smooth. Step 2: Stir in the spring onions Lightly coat a small frying pan with cooking spray. Step 3: Place over med-high heat. Step 4: Pour in the batter and swirl the pan to spread the mixture thinly. Step 5: Cook for 2 minutes each side or until lightly browned. Step 6: Keep pancakes warm while cooking the remainder Serving suggestions- hoisin chicken / pork, char siu bbq pork, peking duck.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, thumb-size ginger, brussels sprouts, beansprout, green onions diagonally, clear honey, soy sauce, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large frying pan, heat the oil. Fry the ginger and brussels sprouts, tossing to coat them in the oil for 5-6 mins, until slightly browned. Add a few tbsp water during cooking to stop them sticking if needed. Step 2: Throw in the beansprouts, spring onions, honey and soy sauce, then stir-fry for 1 min. Sprinkle on the sesame seeds and serve immediately with extra soy sauce, if you like.

Ingredient Names: eggs, black pepper, salt, fresh bean sprout, green onion, celery, yellow onion, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, cooked pork, white bread, cooking oil, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Whisk together the soy sauce with cornstarch in a small bowl or cup. Step 3: Heat a small amount of oil in a skillet and add vegetables, and saute over medium heat until they cook through. Step 4: Set them aside to cool.
