Step 5: When cool, add the cooked vegetables, soy sauce with cornstarch, sesame oil, and main ingredient of choice to the beaten eggs, stirring to mix well. Step 6: Heat a small amount of oil in a skillet and when hot pour in about 1 / 2 cup of the foo yung mixture. Step 7: When the underside browns, flip the patty and brown the other side. Step 8: Serve patty on soft white bread with lettuce, tomato, pickle, and mayo.

Ingredient Names: duck, chinese five spice powder, sugar, salt, fresh ginger, garlic, green onion, tangerine, rice vinegar, honey, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To reduce the fat and produce a crispy skin, begin by trimming the excess fat from the neck and body. Step 2: Rinse the duck, inside and out, and pat dry thoroughly with paper towels. Step 3: Combine the chinese five-spice, sugar, and salt in a small bowl Rub the spice mixture all over the duck, inside and out Salt and five-spice powder makes a fragrant dry marinade, which draws some of the moisture from the duck so that the spices penetrate. Step 4: Stuff the duck cavity with the aromatics: the ginger, garlic, green onions, and tangerine peel. Step 5: Fold the wing Poke the duck breast a few times, piercing the skin. Step 6: Place a roasting pan on the stovetop over 2 burners and fill with 2-inches of water, turn the heat to medium. Step 7: Set a v-rack insert inside the pan and lay the duck on the rack, breast-side up.

Dish Name: Steamed Bean Curd With Soy Sauce
Ingredient Names: soft silken tofu, garlic, ginger, shallot, canola oil, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, instant chicken bouillon granules, sesame oil, sugar, pepper, water, scallion, cilantro, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Steam tofu over gentle heat for six to seven minutes to warm the tofu. Step 2: Remove and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok, fry ginger, garlic and shallots till crisp and golden. Step 4: Remove but leave the oil in the wok. Step 5: Add the sauce ingredients to the wok and bring to boil. Step 6: Reduce the heat and simmer until sauce thickens slightly. Step 7: Pour hot sauce over tofu. Step 8: Top with the crisp garlic, ginger and shallots, and finally the garnishing ingredients, serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: halibut fillet, salt, kosher salt, fresh ginger, green onion, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, peanut oil, toasted sesame oil, fresh cilantro sprigs
Instructions: Step 1: Pat halibut dry with paper towels. Step 2: Rub both sides of fillet with salt. Step 3: Scatter the ginger over the top of the fish and place onto a heatproof ceramic dish. Step 4: Place into a bamboo steamer set over several inches of gently boiling water, and cover. Step 5: Gently steam for 10 to. Step 6: Pour accumulated water out of the dish and sprinkle the fillet with green onion. Step 7: Drizzle both soy sauces over the surface of the fish. Step 8: Heat peanut and sesame oils in a small skillet over medium-high heat until they begin to smoke. Step 9: When the oil is hot, carefully pour on top of the halibut fillet. Step 10: The very hot oil will cause the green onions and water on top of the fish to pop and spatter all over; be careful. Step 11: Garnish with cilantro sprigs and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: eggs, cold water, salt, pepper, vegetable oil, spring onion, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first five ingredients well. Step 2: Pour the mixture into a shallow saucer. Step 3: Steam the mixture over boiling water, or you can steam it inside rice cooker above rice, until it is just cooked. Step 4: Sprinkle the spring onion on top. Step 5: Add soy sauce on top to suit your taste. Step 6: Serve hot with rice and other dishes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, lard, water, chinese barbecue pork, oil, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour. Step 2: Add sugar, baking powder and lard. Step 3: Pour in water and knead until smooth. Step 4: Cover with a damp teatowel and rest for 30 minutes. Step 5: Saute the onions and pork briefly in the oil. Step 6: Add water and seasonings and simmer until the sauce thickens. Step 7: Spread this filling onto a plate to cool. Step 8: Roll the dough into a long sausage shape and cut into twelve equal pieces. Step 9: Roll each into a ball and flatten into a circle with your fingers. Step 10: Place a spoonful of filling in the center and bring the dough up around it.

Dish Name: Steamed Spinach With Soy And Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: spinach leaves, oyster sauce, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put the spinach leaves on a plate inside a bamboo steamer and place over a wok of boiling water. Step 2: Cover with a lid and steam for 1-2 minutes. Step 3: Season the steamed leaves with oyster sauce and light soy sauce, and serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, tofu, coriander, shiitake mushrooms, cooking wine, salt, pepper, cornflour, oyster sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: For the beancurds --------------- Mixed minced pork, some corianders, mushrooms and cooking wine, salt, pepper, corn flour together. Step 2: Fill the hole on each beancurd with the mixture. Step 3: Put the beancurds into the steamer to steam for 15 minutes For the gravy -------------------- Boil 1 / 2 cup of water in a small saucepan. Step 4: Add oyster sauce, corn flour, pepper and salt to the boiling water and stir well. Step 5: Turn off the gas and add 1 tbsp of cooking wine or sherry and the remaining coriander to the gravy and stir well. Step 6: Sprinkle the gravy over the steamed beancurds and serve.

Ingredient Names: tofu, pork, egg white, salt, pepper, spring onions, soy sauce, cornflour, sugar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the pork with the seasonings for 30 minutes or more. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly and place them flat on a plate. Step 3: Steam the mixture until they are cooked It is a good idea to steam it over rice cooker, using a suitable rack to hold in position, when you are cooking the rice. Step 4: Serve hot If you want it more salty, add some soy sauce on top to suit your taste.

Dish Name: Steamed Vegetables With Tofu And Oyster Flavored Sauce
Ingredient Names: bok choy, shiitake mushrooms, tofu, oyster sauce, sesame oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Steam tofu, bok choy and shitake mushrooms for 10 minutes, drain. Step 2: Combine oyster sauce, sesame oil and water in a bowl, whisk together. Step 3: Pour sauce mix over steamed tofu and vegetables.

Ingredient Names: pork cutlets, chinese wine, soya sauce, ginger, chili sauce, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Heat frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: Cook meat for 2 minutes each side, or until meat is well browned. Step 3: Remove meat, set aside - keep warm - Add cooking wine, soy sauce, ginger, chili sauce / flakes and honey to the same pan without washing the pan. Step 4: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 5: Return the meat to pan and cook on each side for 1 minute. Step 6: Simmer until the sauce thickens, and pork is cooked through. Step 7: Serve with rice and greens.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, pepper, vegetable oil, carrot, celery, onion, snow peas, baby corn, straw mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl. Step 2: Stir with a wire whisk until well-blended, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 4: Add carrot, celery, and onion. Step 5: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 6: Add snow peas, corn, and mushrooms. Step 7: Stir-fry 2 minutes, add broth mixture. Step 8: Stir-fry 1 minute or until thick and bubbly.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Asparagus With Garlic And Shallots In Chili Oil
Ingredient Names: chili-flavored olive oil, shallots, garlic cloves, asparagus, chicken broth, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a non-stick wok or skillet over medium-high heat for 30 seconds. Step 2: Add chili oil, shallots, and garlic. Step 3: Saute until the shallots are tender and beginning to brown. Step 4: Add asparagus and continue to cook until it begins to soften and color, add stock. Step 5: Cook over medium heat until asparagus is tender and all moisture has evaporated. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Toss until well mixed, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: mixed mushrooms, cellophane noodles, ginger, green onions, pork, oil, chicken broth, chicken bouillon cube, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Soak mushrooms in water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Discard tough stocks. Step 3: Cut mushrooms into thin slices. Step 4: Soak cellophane noodles, in a separate bowl, in hot water for 5 minutes, drain. Step 5: Slice ginger, green onion, and pork. Step 6: Heat oil in skillet. Step 7: Stir fry ginger, pork, and mushrooms for 2 minutes. Step 8: Add green onions, chicken broth, bouillon cube, and soy sauce, bring to boil.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, reduced sodium soy sauce, garlic, fresh gingerroot, vegetable oil, bok choy, red bell pepper, snow peas, carrot, bamboo shoot, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick skillet, then add the cabbage and bell pepper stir frying 3 minutes Next stir in the broth mixture, snow peas and carrots, reducing the heat, and cook another 3 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables are tender crisp and sauce is thickened. Step 3: Add the last two items, cooking about 1 more minute, stirring frequently, until heated through.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Choy Sum With Ginger And Garlic
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, gingerroot, garlic cloves, choy sum, water chestnut, sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok until it smokes. Step 2: Add oil and heat until it shimmers and is about to start smoking. Step 3: Add ginger and garlic, stir fry until very fragrant, about forty seconds. Step 4: Add choy sum all at once, and stir fry very vigorously Water will escape from the greens immediately. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients, including water chestnuts if you are using them, and stir and fry until the leaves are wilted and the stems are just starting to wilt Immediately remove from heat and scrape into a heated serving platter and serve right away.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, salt, oil, chili bean sauce, garlic, black beans, water, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the cucumbers, cut them in half lengthways and remove the seeds using a teaspoon. Step 2: Cut the cucumber in 1 inch cubes, put them in a colander, sprinkle with the salt, mix and let them stand for about 20 minutes to drain excess liquid. Step 3: Then rinse them in water and dry them with kitchen paper. Step 4: Heat a wok, then add the oil, when the oil is hot adding the bean sauce, garlic and black beans, stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 5: Now add the cucumbers, fry them until coated with the spices, add the water and go on stir-frying for several minutes on a high heat until most of the water has evaporated. Step 6: Add the sesame oil, mix and serve.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, onion, spring onion, gingerroot, oil, water, sesame oil, dark soya sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch, salt, wine
Instructions: Step 1: Slice pork loin into slices. Step 2: Mix sliced pork with sesame oil, dark soya sauce, oyster sauce, salt, wine and corn starch. Step 3: Leave for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in pan and fry slice ginger and onion till soft. Step 5: Add pork and turn till color changes. Step 6: Pour water into pan and continue to stir fry until pork is cooked but make sure that meat has some gravy. Step 7: Add spring onion and dish pork.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Green Beans And Peppers
Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, bell peppers, olive oil, sea salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Wash beans and dry thoroughly Use fresh green beans- the longer the better for presentation Traditionally long beans are used Trim beans at each end and slice pepper into strips equal to the size of the beans. Step 2: In a hot wok or skillet add oil and beans and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add 1 / 4 cup hot water. Step 4: Cover and cook on high for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add bell pepper strips and re-cover cooking for 1 minute. Step 6: Add salt and sugar and stir to combine. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Hoisin Chicken With Sesame Seeds
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sesame seeds, ginger, chicken breast, yellow onion, red bell pepper, salt, water chestnuts, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, worcestershire sauce, long grain white rice, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat, warm the oil. Step 2: Add the sesame seeds and ginger to the oil and saute until fragrant and seeds golden, about 2 minutes careful have a lid ready, it pops! Step 3: Add the onions, bell pepper and salt. Step 4: Saute for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the chicken, more oil if necessary and continue to saute until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink. Step 6: Add water chestnuts, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, vinegar. Step 7: Cook until flavors are well blended, about 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Serve over rice and top with green onions.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Pork With Mustard Greens
Ingredient Names: mustard greens, cornstarch, water, sugar, light soy sauce, rice wine, pork tenderloin, vegetable oil, black bean garlic sauce, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash greens and discard tough stems. Step 2: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add greens and time 2 minutes. Step 3: Drain and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking. Step 4: Drain again, then cut greens into long diagonal strips. Step 5: In a medium bowl, combine cornstarch and water. Step 6: Stir in sugar, soy sauce and rice wine. Step 7: Cut pork into thin slices and add to the mixture. Step 8: Marinate about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 9: Heat oil in a preheated wok or large heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 10: Add black bean sauce and stir-fry 1 minute, then add pork and stir-fry 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Pork With Sweet And Sour Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork loin, cornstarch, salt, soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, carrot, green pepper, green onions, cold water, vegetable oil, garlic clove, chicken broth, pineapple chunks, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from pork. Step 2: Cut pork into slices, 2 x 1 x 1 / 8 inch. Step 3: Toss pork, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, the salt, 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1 / 2 teaspoon sugar and the white pepper in glass or plastic bowl. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes. Step 5: Cut carrot diagonally into thin slices. Step 6: Cut green pepper into 1-inch pieces. Step 7: Cut green onions into 2-inch pieces. Step 8: Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch and the water. Step 9: Heat wok until 1 or 2 drops of water bubble and skitter when sprinkled in wok. Step 10: Add vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: fresh spinach, oil, garlic, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the spinach thoroughly. Step 2: Remove all stems leaving just the leaves. Step 3: Heat the wok until it is very hot, add the oil. Step 4: When the oil it is very hot and slightly smoking, add the garlic and salt. Step 5: Stir-fry both for 10 seconds. Step 6: Add the spinach and stir-fry for about 2 minutes to coat the spinach leaves thoroughly with the oil, garlic and salt. Step 7: When the spinach has wilted to about one-third of its original size, add the sugar Continue to stir-fry for another 4 minutes. Step 8: Transfer to a plate and pour off any excess liquid.

Ingredient Names: shiitake mushroom, tomatoes, chicken broth, ketchup, soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, salt, red wine vinegar, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic, minced ginger, green onion, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: Immerse tomato into boiling water for 30-45 seconds, then plunge into ice water Gently peel skin from tomato. Step 2: Cut in half and remove stem and seeds Coarsely chop and set aside. Step 3: Combine chicken broth, ketchup, soy sauce, sherry, sugar, salt, vinegar and cornstarch in a small bowl, set aside. Step 4: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in your wok over med-high heat and add ginger and garlic, cooking for 30-45 seconds Do not scorch. Step 5: Add mushrooms, tomato, and green onion, and stir fry for about 1 minute before adding the chicken broth. Step 6: Bring all to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, adding up to 1 / 4 cup water, if necessary, to control consistency.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Zucchini With Hoisin Sauce
Ingredient Names: zucchini, salt, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, sesame oil, canola oil, garlic, chili flakes, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Quarter zucchini lengthwise. Step 2: Slice off the soft seed core It's ok if some seeds remain. Step 3: Arrange the zucchini, cut side up, on paper towels. Step 4: Sprinkle with salt, set aside for 10 mins Blot the zucchini quarters dry with paper towels. Step 5: Cut quarters into 2 inch lengths. Step 6: Mix soy sauce, hoisin, sherry and sesame oil in a small bowl. Step 7: Heat a wok or large skillet over med-high heat for 1 min. Step 8: Pour in canola / peanut oil.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Zucchini With Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: zucchini, vegetable oil, garlic, salt, sugar, oyster sauce, dry sherry, chicken stock, wood ear mushrooms, cornstarch, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: These are the same mushrooms used in mu shu pork They are variously called tree ears or wood ears. Step 2: Pour boiling water over them and let soak for 15 minutes. Step 3: Remove tough stems with a knife and julienne They swell up to about four times their original size when soaked so it takes very little to make 1 / 4 cup! Step 4: Be sure to remove the stems because they are extremely tough If using cucumber, peel and remove seeds Zucchini just needs to be washed. Step 5: Slice or julienne Or cut in finger sized pieces.

Ingredient Names: crabmeat, green asparagus, cayenne pepper, soy sauce, oyster sauce, peanuts, garlic, whole black peppercorn, sesame oil, salt, cornstarch, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Skin asparagus, remove bottom woody parts and cut into 2cm pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in wok till hot, add sliced garlic and fry till golden, remove from wok and keep aside for later use. Step 3: Add in the crushed black pepper, fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Now add asparagus and crab meat, stir fry for another 1 minute. Step 5: Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, cayenne pepper and water and cornstarch mixture, stir and let simmer for 2 minutes or until gravy start to thicken. Step 6: Check seasoning and add more salt if necessary. Step 7: Add 2 to 3 dashes of sesame oil, stir and dish out into serving dish. Step 8: Garnish with roasted peanut and fried garlic.

Dish Name: Stir Fry Ground Pork With Corn
Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, garlic cloves, red chili peppers, ground pork, white pepper powder, whole kernel corn, water, low sodium salt, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok, heat grape seed oil over medium Saut garlic and chili peppers for 20 seconds. Step 2: Add ground pork and white pepper powder to it Increase heat over medium high. Step 3: Stir-fry pork until 80% cooked Continue to stir in corn and combine well. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Pour water into wok and cover. Step 6: Simmer until corn is completely heated, about 1 minute. Step 7: Uncover and season with salt.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, fresh ginger, lean pork, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, salt, sugar, sesame oil, green onion, chinese rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Fry ginger in hot oil until fragrant, then add pork, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, salt, and sugar. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the sesame oil, green onion, and rice wine. Step 5: Simmer until the pork is tender.

Ingredient Names: nests egg noodles, cornstarch, soy sauce, honey, sunflower oil, pork tenderloins, thumb-sized ginger, garlic, green peppers, mange tout, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil and cook the noodles following pack instructions. Meanwhile, mix the cornflour with 1 tbsp water, then stir in the soy sauce and honey, and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat. Add the pork and cook for 2 mins until browned all over. Add the ginger, garlic, pepper and mangetout, and cook for a further 2 mins. Reduce the heat, then add the soy and honey mixture, stirring and cooking until the sauce bubbles and thickens. Divide the drained noodles between 2 bowls. Top with the pork and vegetables, and finish with a sprinkling of sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef top sirloin steaks, garlic cloves, olive oil, carrots, celery, bell peppers, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, pineapple, oyster sauce, garlic sauce, cayenne pepper, salt, pepper, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade beef in oyster sauce overnight in sealed zip lock bag or bowl with tightly cover lid. Step 2: Add oil to an large nonstick, covered pan but do not turn on the heat until all ingredients are assembled, add garlic. Step 3: Add carrot on top of garlic Do not stir. Step 4: Add celery on top of carrots. Step 5: Add peppers on top of celery. Step 6: Sprinkle with all granulated seasonings. Step 7: Add beef on top of peppers. Step 8: Add water chestnuts and bamboo shoots on top of beef.

Dish Name: Super Easy Chinese Sweet N Sour Ribs
Ingredient Names: pork ribs, rice wine, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Boil about 1 l of water in a pot, or enough to cover the ribs Carefully drop the ribs in the boiling water, stir til outside browns, roughly 1 minute. Step 2: Drain ribs, put in a medium sized pot big enough for the ribs to be layed down in one layer A deeper pan will work too. Step 3: Add rice wine, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and water in the pot. Step 4: Bring to a boil for about 10 minutes then reduce to a simmer. Step 5: Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is very dark and almost dry or to your desired thickness, roughly half an hour Be careful not to dry all the sauce out, the sauce will reduce much quicker in the final stage, so keep an eye on it. Step 6: Serve with steamed rice and stir fried veggies for a great chinese meal!

Dish Name: Super Easy General Tso Chicken Dinner
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, stir fry vegetables, stir-fry sauce, olive oil, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cube chicken and brown in oil in a large skillet. Step 2: After chicken is done, add vegetables and stir-fry until crisp tender. Step 3: Pour in sauce and simmer until heated through, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, white sugar, garlic, red pepper flakes, beef flank steak, peanut oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl. Step 2: Toss beef with marinade; cover the bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour to overnight. Step 3: Heat peanut oil in a wok or large, nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 4: Cook and stir green onions in hot oil for 5 to 10 seconds. Step 5: Remove beef from marinade and add to green onions in the wok; discard marinade. Step 6: Cook and stir until beef is no longer pink and begins to brown, about 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, shallots, red pepper, mushrooms, cucumber, celery, oil, pineapple chunks, tomato sauce, white vinegar, water, stock, cornflour, lean pork, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: If making pork: Combine sugar, 11 / 2 tblsps soy sauce, sherry and egg yolk, stir well. Step 2: Cut meat into i inch cubes, place into soy sauce mixture, stir until meat is coated. Step 3: Cover, leave in fridge in hour, stir occasionally. Step 4: Drain meat from marinade, reserve liquid. Step 5: Toss meat lightly in cornflour. Step 6: Heat oil, cook meat until golden-brown and cooked through, about seven minutes Do this in several batches so meat browns well, drain well The veggie part Peel and slice onion.

Ingredient Names: orange marmalade, chili sauce, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, celery seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients, stir well Use for basting, or serve with----chicken--ribs--or lamb.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Chicken Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, sugar, red wine vinegar, chicken broth, dried cilantro, catsup, soy sauce, dry sherry, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, pineapple chunks, peanut oil, garlic, chicken breasts, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together sauce ingredients. Step 2: Place a wok over high heat. Step 3: When wok is hot, add 2 tbsp peanut oil. Step 4: When oil is hot, add garlic and chicken and stir fry until chicken is cooked. Step 5: Remove from wok and set aside. Step 6: Pour remaining 1 tbsp oil into wok. Step 7: When oil is hot, add onion and bell pepper. Step 8: Stir fry until vegetables are tender crisp. Step 9: Add pea pods, stir fry about 1 minutes. Step 10: Return chicken to wok.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Pork As It Should Be
Ingredient Names: pork, bamboo shoot, green pepper, salt, vodka, egg, cornstarch, flour, garlic clove, spring onion, oil, vinegar, sugar, tomato paste, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the meat with the salt and vodka set aside for 15 minutes. Step 2: Mix together all of the ingredients for the sauce. Step 3: Drain off the vodka, to the meat add the beaten egg and the cornstarch, stir well to coat the meat. Step 4: Now coat the meat with the flour. Step 5: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the meat in batches for 3 minutes Replace all of the meat, to the oil turn off the heat and allow the meat to sit for 2 minutes Reheat the oil, add the bamboo shoots and the meat cook for 2 minutes. Step 6: Remove from wok and drain. Step 7: Pour off excess oil from wok, leave about 1 tbsp of oil and fry the garlic, green pepper and onion for 2 minutes add the sauce and stir to make a smooth sauce. Step 8: Add the meat and bamboo shoots, heat for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, sesame oil, cornstarch, egg, soy sauce, dry sherry, tomato paste, sugar, white wine vinegar, oil, pineapple chunks in syrup, onion, green bell pepper, carrots, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix pork with sesame oil, then add cornstarch, egg and soy sauce, ensuring that each is well encorporated. Step 2: Prepare walnut-sized meatballs and store them on a plate. Step 3: Prepare sauce by mixing cornstarch with cold water, then adding each of dry sherry, soy sauce, tomato paste, sugar, vinegar, and the liquid from the pineapple, making sure mixture is well blended. Step 4: Heat oil in your wok and cook the meatballs until they are browned and cooked through. Step 5: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain. Step 6: Add the onion, green pepper, and carrots to the oil in the wok, and stir-fry until they are crisp-tender Briefly stir sauce before adding to pan, and bring all to a boil, stirring continuously. Step 7: Add the meatballs and the pineapple, and stir-fry for several minutes more until everything is thickened and heated through Adjust thickening with cornstarch and water to your taste, if necessary. Step 8: Serve with hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, chinese rice wine, boneless pork, distilled white vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, water, cornstarch, chili-garlic sauce, egg, cooking oil, onion, pineapple chunk, bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 2 tbs soy sauce, 1 tbs rice wine, and meat in a bowl. Step 2: Stir to coat & let marinate for at least 10 minutes. Step 3: Mix in a small bowl, vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, water, 1 tbs cornstarch, 2 tsp soy sauce, and chili garlic sauce, set aside. Step 4: Remove meat from marinade. Step 5: Dip meat in egg wash, drain excess, then dredge in cornstarch and shake off the excess. Step 6: In a wok or deep fryer, heat oil to 360 degrees. Step 7: Fry meat a few pieces at a time to not drop temperature, turning occasionally until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Step 8: Remove and drain on paper towel. Step 9: Repeat process for remaining meat pieces.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Pork Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: olive oil, pork tenderloin, gingerroot, garlic, green bell peppers, carrots, onion, pineapple chunks, ketchup, white vinegar, brown sugar, reduced sodium soy sauce, cornstarch, chili powder, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a non-stick wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add pork, gingerroot and garlic. Step 3: Cook and stir for 6 to 7 minutes, until pork is cooked through and begins to brown. Step 4: Remove pork from wok and keep warm. Step 5: Add green pepper, carrots and onions to wok. Step 6: Cook and stir for about 5 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Step 7: Meanwhile, prepare sauce. Step 8: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 / 2 cup juice. Step 9: In a small bowl, whisk together reserved 1 / 2 cup pineapple juice, 1 / 4 cup ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch and chili powder. Step 10: Add sauce to vegetables in wok, along with cooked pork and pineapple chunks.

Ingredient Names: pork ribs, vegetable oil, soy sauce, white vinegar, brown sugar, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, onion, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large wok over medium high heat and brown ribs-around 10 minutes. Step 2: Add the soy sauce and continue browning. Step 3: Add the vinegar and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Add brown sugar and simmer 10 minutes more You might need a bit more vinegar at this point You want the sauce thick but fluid. Step 5: Add the peppers and onions and cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the ketchup and stir. Step 7: Taste and adjust the vinegar / brown sugar ratio If needed add cornstarch to thicken.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, carrots, green pepper, pineapple chunks in juice, white vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, soy sauce, cornstarch, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in bite size pieces Brown in oil in a large pan or wok. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cover and cook 10 minutes. Step 4: Add carrots and green pepper to pan. Step 5: Combine sauce ingredients and pour into pan. Step 6: Cover and simmer 10 minutes longer, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: egg, philadelphia cream cheese, sugar, egg roll wraps, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a small pot, beat egg. Step 2: Mix cream cheese and 1 / 2 cup of sugar with egg. Step 3: Spoon mixture into center of wonton wrapper Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water and fold into whatever shape you desire. Step 4: Make sure to seal the edges so the cream cheese mixture doesn't escape during frying. Step 5: Drop into hot oil and brown both sides. Step 6: Serve with your favorite sauce or just eat 'em alone!

Dish Name: Sweet Sour Chicken In Pineapple Shells
Ingredient Names: fresh pineapple, olive oil, garlic clove, skinless chicken breasts, onion, green pepper, cooked rice, sweet and sour sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each pineapple in half lengthwise, cutting through crown, and remove fruit. Step 2: Set shells aside, laying them upside down to drain Trim core from fruit, then cut fruit into chunks. Step 3: Place wok over high heat, add 1 tbs oil. Step 4: Then cook garlic & chicken Move up the sides of the pan. Step 5: Add remaining oil, onion, green pepper. Step 6: Stir fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Return chicken to vegetables.

Ingredient Names: spam, pepper, onions, mushrooms, pineapple, water, cornstarch, splenda sugar substitute, ketchup, vinegar, powdered ginger, garlic powder, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Spray wok or large pan with pam-type spray. Step 2: Add cut up spam and saute until browned, remove and set aside. Step 3: Cut up pineapple and set aside Spray again and saute veggies until mushrooms have released their liquid. Step 4: Mix rest of ingredients into the cold water, add to pan. Step 5: Stir until mixture has thickened, add pineapple and spam, heat until warmed through, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: pork butt, soy sauce, salt, white sugar, egg white, green onions, vegetable oil for frying, cornstarch, vegetable oil, celery, green bell pepper, onion, water, apple cider vinegar, ketchup, pineapple chunks
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Place cubed pork in a medium bowl and season with soy sauce, salt, and sugar for marinade. Step 3: Add egg white and green onions and mix until well-combined. Step 4: Cover and place in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Step 5: Heat 1 quart oil to 365 degrees F (185 degrees C) in a large, heavy saucepan or deep fryer. Step 6: Coat pork with cornstarch. Step 7: Fry in hot oil until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Drain on paper towels and set aside. Step 9: Heat oil for vegetables in a wok over medium heat. Step 10: Stir in celery, bell pepper, and onion; cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Season with pinch of sugar and salt. Step 12: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 13: Mix water, sugar, apple cider vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, and salt in a large saucepan; bring to a boil over high heat. Step 14: Stir in cooked pork, celery mixture, and pineapple chunks with juice. Step 15: Return to a boil, then mix in remaining water and cornstarch. Step 16: Cook until thickened and warmed through, about 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, salt, ground black pepper, ketchup, seasoned rice vinegar, pineapple chunks with juice, brown sugar, garlic, chili sauce, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, vegetable oil, butter, chopped green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tenderloin into. Step 2: Arrange in a single layer between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet until each is about 1-inch thick. Step 3: Generously season with salt and black pepper. Step 4: Whisk ketchup, rice vinegar, reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar, garlic, hot chili sauce, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes in a bowl, set aside. Step 5: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over high heat. Step 6: Place pork in pan; reduce heat to medium. Step 7: Cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, 5 to per side. Step 8: Transfer to a plate. Step 9: Return skillet to medium heat. Step 10: Stir butter into hot pan. Step 11: When butter melts and starts to brown, stir in pineapple chunks. Step 12: Cook, stirring, until pineapple is golden brown, 3 to. Step 13: Stir in ketchup mixture and green onion (white parts). Step 14: Reduce heat to low and simmer until garlic and onion have softened,. Step 15: Return pork to skillet; cook, stirring, until pork is heated through. Step 16: Garnish with green onion tops.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, granulated sugar, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, red pepper, ground ginger, garlic cloves, broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl combine soy sauce, vinegar & sugar, then set aside. Step 2: In a skillet over medium heat, add sesame seeds & cook for 1 minute, then remove seeds & set aside To the skillet add oil, red pepper, ginger & garlic & cook for 30 seconds, then add broccoli & cook for another minute. Step 3: Add soy mixture, then cover the pan & cook for 2 minutes, before sprinkling the sesame seeds over the broccoli & serving.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, chicken broth, sugar, scallions, light soy sauce, garlic, chili bean sauce, fresh gingerroot, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok heat oil and cook the eggplant pieces for 3 to 4 minutes, or until lightly brown, remove from wok, drain on paper towels and set aside In clean wok, heat 2 tablespoons of oil, add chili bean sauce, stir rapidly, Add the gingerroot, and garlic stir until fragrant. Step 2: Add the stock, sugar, and soy sauce. Step 3: Add the eggplant pieces and let simmer for 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the scallions and serve.

Ingredient Names: duck, ground pepper, salt, ginger, spring onions, shaoxing wine, tea, sugar, cinnamon, star anise
Instructions: Step 1: Clean duck, rub inside and out with lots of pepper powder and a bit of salt. Step 2: Put half the ginger and spring onion inside. Step 3: Pour shao hsing wine on top and rest of ginger and spring onion. Step 4: Leave to marinate for at least 45 minutes. Step 5: Once marinated, boil enough water to cover the duck and boil for 15 minutes. Step 6: Drain water and pat dry the duck. Step 7: Put sugar, tea and spices into the wok and heat over low heat until fragrant, constantly stirring. Step 8: Put a metal frame type thing so the duck won't touch the spices. Step 9: Put the duck on top and cover the wok Smoke on very low heat for 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork chops, bamboo shoots, sliced water chestnuts, green onions, worcestershire sauce, szechuan hot bean sauce, soy sauce, fresh ginger, rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, garlic cloves, hot chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Trim chops of excess fat and brown on both sides in a skillet on the stove top. Step 2: Place chops in the bottom of the crock pot and cover with bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, and green onions. Step 3: Combine remaining ingredients together in a bowl and pour over vegetables. Step 4: Cook on low for 3-5 hours or until chops are tender and cooked through. Step 5: Serve hot with cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, reduced sodium soy sauce, steak sauce, garlic cloves, fresh onions, crushed red pepper flakes, peanut oil, cauliflower florets, sweet bell peppers, dry roasted peanuts, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together pork tenderloin slices, soy sauce, steak sauce, garlic, onion and red pepper in a gallon ziplock bag. Step 2: Marinate 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Step 3: Preheat wok & add oil. Step 4: Stir fry pork tenderloin mixture on high heat 4 - 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in cauliflower and pepper squares & continue stir frying until vegetables are barely cooked. Step 6: Top with peanuts and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: dry sherry, ginger, garlic cloves, dry crushed red pepper, low sodium chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ginger, garlic, red pepper, soy sauce, chili garlic sauce and sugar in a pan and warm to near boiling. Step 2: Combine broth and cornstarch in small bowl. Step 3: Stir to dissolve cornstarch. Step 4: Stir the cornstarch mixture into the soy mixture. Step 5: Stir until thickened.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, salt, green onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, peanut oil, sesame oil, dried red pepper flakes, dry sherry, white wine vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, chili paste with garlic, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Toss eggplant in colander with salt. Step 2: Let stand 30 minutes. Step 3: Rinse off salt and pat eggplant dry with paper towels, set aside. Step 4: Place green onion in work bowl of food processor with steel knife With machine running, drop ginger and garlic through feed tube and mince finely. Step 5: Combine peanut oil, 1 tablespoon sesame oil and dried red pepper flakes in wok or heavy 12 inch skillet over high heat and cook until pepper flakes turn black. Step 6: Add green onion mixture and stir fry until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add eggplant and toss to coat with oil. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium, cover and cook until eggplant softens, shaking wok occasionally to prevent sticking, 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: japanese eggplants, soy sauce, brown sugar, chicken broth, peanut oil, ginger, garlic, red pepper flakes, water chestnut, scallions, rice wine vinegar, dark sesame oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook eggplant in 2-3 tbsp oil in a large deep skillet until tender While eggplant is cooking, mix soy sauce, sugar, and broth together in a small bowl till sugar dissolves. Step 2: Remove eggplant from skillet when cooked and keep warm. Step 3: Heat garlic, red pepper flakes, and ginger in 1 tbsp oil until aromatic. Step 4: Stir in the water chestnuts and half of the scallions along with the eggplant and the soy sauce mixture. Step 5: Stir and cook until the soy sauce is absorbed into the eggplant. Step 6: Add the vinegar, sesame oil, and remaining scallions, stirring to mix. Step 7: Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: water, ketchup, soy sauce, cornstarch, honey, crushed red pepper, ground ginger, vegetable oil, green onions, garlic, cooked shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together water, ketchup, soy sauce, cornstarch, honey, crushed red pepper, and ground ginger in a small bowl until combined, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook and stir green onions and garlic in hot oil until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 4: Stir in cooked shrimp; toss to coat with oil. Step 5: Pour in ketchup mixture. Step 6: Cook and stir until sauce is bubbly and thickened.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, soy sauce, garlic, sugar, white wine, chinese five spice powder, vegetable oil, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: With a sharp knife, make several small slits near the edges of the pork chops to keep them from curling when fried. Step 2: Add the soy sauce, garlic, sugar, white wine, and five-spice powder to a 1-gallon zip-lock plastic bag, mix thoroughly. Step 3: Place chops in the bag, and close the seal tightly Carefully massage the marinade into chops, coating well. Step 4: Refrigerate at least 1 hour, turning the bag occasionally to ensure even marinating. Step 5: In a large skillet, heat enough vegetable oil to cover the bottom of the skillet. Step 6: Remove chops from resealable bag without wiping off the marinade Lightly sprinkle cornstarch on both sides of the chops Carefully add chops to skillet. Step 7: Cook over medium heat, turning once, until chops are golden brown on both sides and cooked through.

Ingredient Names: dried shiitake mushrooms, olive oil, minced garlic cloves, green onions, rice wine, soy sauce, five-spice powder, ground turkey, sugar, dried shrimp, soft tofu, cilantro, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dried shiitake mushroom until soft and cut into bits. Step 2: Add olive oil to skillet over medium heat and sautee the garlic. Step 3: Once garlic is slightly browned, add the mushroom and chopped shallots add the small dried shrimp. Step 4: After browning all the ingredients, add the ground turkey. Step 5: Add soy sauce, sugar, cooking wine, and 5 spice powder. Step 6: Cover and cook until sauce thickens, allowing it to boil first then on low heat. Step 7: Garnish with cilantro and serve with sliced cucumber on the side.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, vegetable oil, garlic, shallots, water, soy sauce, sugar, rice wine, five-spice powder, black pepper, msg, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Brown pork in skillet until cooked. Step 2: Drain off oil and set aside. Step 3: Add vegetable oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Step 4: Saute garlic for 1 minute. Step 5: Add pork and shallots, stir a few times. Step 6: Add water and the rest of the ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring a couple of times. Step 8: Uncover and cook for 15 more minutes. Step 9: Serve over steamed rice.

Dish Name: Tangcu Paigu Chinese Sweet And Sour Pork Ribs
Ingredient Names: pork baby back ribs, rice wine, soy sauce, green onions, sugar, black vinegar, cornstarch, sesame oil, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Separate the ribs if the butcher hasn't already done so They should be roughly bite-size. Step 2: Marinate ribs with wine and soy sauce for 30 minutes. Step 3: Remove ribs from marinade, reserving marinade for later. Step 4: Heat peanut oil in wok until it's almost smoking Deep fry ribs for 2 minutes, remove from oil with slotted spoon, reheat oil, and fry for another 1 / 2 minute until brown. Step 5: Remove ribs from oil. Step 6: Pour oil out of wok into a heatproof bowl To soy sauce marinade, add sugar, vinegar, corn starch mixture, sesame oil, and green onion to make sweet-sour sauce. Step 7: Heat one tablespoon of oil in the wok, pour in the sweet-sour sauce, and boil and stir until thickened.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, tangerine juice, honey, garlic, scallions, ginger, cinnamon, sesame oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl Whisk until honey has dissolved Marinade chicken or pork for 1 1 / 2-2 hours.

Dish Name: Tasty Stir Fry Szechuan Prawns Shrimps
Ingredient Names: prawns, sherry wine, soya sauce, sesame oil, pepper, vegetables, stock, vinegar, chili, ginger, garlic, sugar, oil, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Peel prawns if necessary and de-vein. Step 2: Mix sherry soya sauce sesame oil and szechuan pepper together and add the prawns, marinade for at least an hour, heat wok. Step 3: Add half of the oil and stir fry the garlic, ginger and vegetables. Step 4: Place in warm oven. Step 5: Drain prawns adding the marinade into the stock. Step 6: Add remainder of the oil to wok and quickly stir fry the prawns for just a minute or two. Step 7: Add the chicken stock, soya sauces, sherry, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and cornflour add the vegetables back in and quickly stir. Step 8: Serve immediately with fried rice or noodles of your choice.

Ingredient Names: tempeh, tamari, mirin, arrowroot, worcestershire sauce, honey, fresh ginger, green pepper, onion, carrot, celery, broccoli floret, cauliflower, vegetable stock, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put the steamed tempeh in the marinade and stir once in a while to coat all of the tempeh. Step 2: Bring the vegetable stock to a boil and add carrots, broccoli& cauliflower, boil for 1 minute only, remove veggies immediately, reserve stock for sauce. Step 3: Drain tempeh, adding any left over marinade to the stock. Step 4: Heat wok or skillet add 2 tbsp oil. Step 5: Fry tempeh uintil browned remove to a bowl. Step 6: Heat pan add remaining 2 tbsp oil. Step 7: Stir fry onions& peppers for a few minutes add celery cook 2 minutes. Step 8: Pour liquid stock into the pan, bring to a simmer, add 2 tbs tamari. Step 9: Add tempeh, carrots, broccoli & cauliflower stir until heated Do not over cook the vegetables should still be crisp.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic, low-sodium soy sauce, white wine vinegar, water, white sugar, green onions, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken and cornstarch into a bag or bowl, and toss to coat. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Fry the chicken pieces and garlic, stirring constantly until lightly browned. Step 4: Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and water. Step 5: Cover, and cook until the chicken pieces are no longer pink inside, 3 to. Step 6: Stir in the green onion, and cayenne pepper, cook uncovered for about 2 more minutes. Step 7: Serve over white rice.

Ingredient Names: brown sugar, soy sauce, dry sherry, oil, ginger, garlic powder, boneless skinless chicken thighs, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, red bell pepper, zucchini, fresh pineapple
Instructions: Step 1: In a 2-quart baking dish, combine all marinade ingredients. Step 2: Cut chicken thighs in half. Step 3: Add to marinade and cover Refrigerating at least 2 hours, turning chicken once, heat grill. Step 4: Drain chicken, reserving marinade, alternately thread chicken, bell pepper, zucchini, and pineapple into four 12-inch metal or wooden skewers. Step 5: When ready to grill, place kabobs on gas grill over medium heat or on charcoal grill 4-6 inches from med-high coals. Step 6: Cook 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink, turning often and brushing frequently with reserved marinade. Step 7: Discard any remaining marinade.

Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium chicken broth, reduced sodium soy sauce, red wine vinegar, honey, garlic cloves, boneless pork loin, olive oil, broccoli florets, carrots, celery ribs, cabbage, green onions, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine 2 / 4 cup chicken broth, soy sauce, vinegar, honey and garlic powder, mix well. Step 2: Pour 1 / 3 cup marinade into a large resealable plastic bag then add the pork Seal the bag and turn to coat and refrigerate bag for 1 hour. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade. Step 4: Drain and discard marinade From pork, In a large nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry pork in oil for 2-3 minutes or until pork is no longer pink. Step 5: Remove pork from skillet or wok and keep warm In the same pan, stir-fry broccoli and carrots in reserved marinade for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, reduced sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, green onions, brown sugar, fresh ginger, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in self-sealing bag Seal bag and mix well. Step 2: Let rest at room temperature for 20-30 minutes. Step 3: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Step 4: Remove tenderloin from marinade, discarding leftover marinade Roast tenderloin in shallow pan in oven for 20-25 minutes, until meat thermometer inserted in thickest part reads 155 degrees to 160 degrees fahrenheit. Step 5: Remove from oven and let tenderloin rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing.

Ingredient Names: honey, water, tamari, wine vinegar, onion, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, combine honey, 1 / 3 cup water, tamari, vinegar and onion, bring to a boil. Step 2: Mix the 2 tbsp cornstarch with the remaining 1 / 3 cup water, until well combined. Step 3: Add to simmering teriyaki sauce. Step 4: Stir until thickened. Step 5: Simmer for 7-10 minutes. Step 6: Marinate the chicken in sauce for 5 or more hours. Step 7: Grill or bake as desired.

Dish Name: The Day After Thanksgiving Turkey Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: reduced sodium soy sauce, catsup, white wine vinegar, sugar, chicken broth, cornstarch, turkey, cooking oil, red onion, sweet potato, broccoli florets, red sweet bell peppers, water
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: combine all ingredients in small bowl Stir_fry: combine 2 tbsp sauce and the turkey in a bowl. Step 2: Let marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat, add onion. Step 4: Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add sweet potato, broccoli and pepper. Step 6: Stir-fry for 2 minutes, add cup water. Step 7: Cover and cook 6-8 minutes until sweet potato is tender.

Ingredient Names: pork, ketjap manis, onions, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place everything in a heavy based pan and simmer gently with the lid on for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until meat is meltingly soft Alternatively, just pop everything in an oven safe dish with a lid, and bake in a preheated oven for 2 hours at 160 degrees celcius, serve and enjoy.

Dish Name: The Ubiquitous Egg Stir Fry Jidan Er Dun
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, eggs, scallions, garlic, black pepper, salt, peanut oil, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Chop tomatoes or peppers coarsely, not the usual fine dice for stirfry. Step 2: Heat oil in wok until sizzling. Step 3: Add garlic and scallions, stirfry to bring out flavors. Step 4: Add eggs all at once to center of wok, flip and slice with spatula and stirfry until almost done. Step 5: Add tomato or bell peppers, salt Use black pepper to taste / if desired this works best with the tomatoes. Step 6: Stir fry until tomatoes fully release water, or peppers are tenderized but not chewy. Step 7: Add stock or water to desired consistency this dish can be anything from soupy to totally dry. Step 8: Serve over rice if soupy, with pancakes if dry.

Ingredient Names: dried shiitake mushroom, chicken stock, rice wine, soya sauce, cornstarch, firm tofu, sesame seeds, peanut oil, garlic cloves, ginger, cauliflower, broccoli, snow peas, baby carrots, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the shiitaki in a micro wave safe bowl with water to cover Nuke for 22 seconds. Step 2: Let set for 30 minutes. Step 3: Mix the four marinade ingredients, add the tofu. Step 4: Stir gently to coat. Step 5: When the mushrooms are ready, drain and cut into thin slices the size of your thumb nail, set aside. Step 6: Heat the wok Toast the sesame seeds 'til golden.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, eggs, cornstarch, dried chili pods, rice vinegar, rice wine, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix 1 / 2 cup of cornstarch and 3 eggs thoroughly. Step 2: Toss chicken in mixture to coat. Step 3: In a small bowl, combine the rest of the cornstarch, rice vinegar, rice wine, sugar, and soy sauce. Step 4: Heat 1-2 inches of peanut oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 5: Fry chicken in small batches long enough to cook through, but not golden brown. Step 6: Remove from pan and place on a paper towel. Step 7: Leave a tablespoon or two of peanut oil in the wok. Step 8: Add chicken and chili pods to the wok and stir fry until crispy and brown. Step 9: Once chicken is done, add the sauce mixture over the chicken in the wok and toss over heat until sauce thickens. Step 10: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Tsao Mi Fun (Taiwanese Fried Rice Noodles)
Ingredient Names: pork loin, soy sauce, rice wine, white pepper, chinese five-spice powder, cornstarch, dried chinese black mushrooms, rice vermicelli, vegetable oil, eggs, garlic, dried shrimp, carrots, onion, bean sprouts, napa cabbage, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork into a mixing bowl and pour in the soy sauce and rice wine. Step 2: Sprinkle with the white pepper, five-spice powder, and cornstarch. Step 3: Mix well, then set aside to marinate. Step 4: Soak the mushrooms in a bowl of cold water for 30 minutes, then pour off the water, cut off and discard the stems of the mushrooms. Step 5: Slice the mushrooms thinly and reserve. Step 6: Soak the rice vermicelli in a separate bowl of cold water for 30 minutes, then pour off the water and set the noodles aside. Step 7: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Step 8: Pour in the eggs, and cook until firm, flipping once, to make a pancake. Step 9: Remove the egg pancake, and allow to cool, then thinly slice and place into a large bowl. Step 10: Heat 2 more tablespoons of the vegetable oil in the wok over high heat. Step 11: Stir in the garlic and dried shrimp, and cook until the shrimp become aromatic, about 20 seconds. Step 12: Next, add the pork along with the marinade, and cook until the pork is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Step 13: Stir in the carrots and onion, and cook until the carrots begin to soften, about 3-4 minutes. Step 14: Finally, add the bean sprouts, napa cabbage, and sliced mushrooms; cook and stir until the vegetables are tender, about more. Step 15: Scrape the pork mixture into the bowl along with the eggs, then wipe out the wok and return it to the stove over medium-high heat. Step 16: Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the wok, then stir in the drained rice vermicelli noodles. Step 17: Cook and stir for a few minutes until the noodles soften, then stir in the reserved pork mixture. Step 18: Scrape the mixture in to a serving bowl and garnish with cilantro to serve.

Dish Name: Twice Cooked Pork Hui Guo Rou
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, mirin, ginger, garlic, leek, red bell pepper, peanut oil, sambal oelek, soybean paste, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork in a large saucepan and cover with water, bring to the boil. Step 2: When it is boiling, add the mirin and ginger. Step 3: Cook the pork for 20 minutes, then remove from the water and allow to cool. Step 4: When the pork is cool enough to handle, slice across the grain as thinly as possible in pieces about 2 inches long Clean the leek and slice in half lengthwise, then slice in 1 inch pieces Clean the bell pepper, remove seeds, and chop in pieces similar in size to the leek. Step 5: Heat a wok over medium-high to high heat. Step 6: Add the oil, and when it is hot, add the flattened garlic clove. Step 7: Fry the garlic until it is very brown, then remove it and discard.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, garlic, green chili, carrots, green beans, green bell pepper, onion, cabbage, roasted tomato pasta sauce, red chili sauce, soy sauce, ginger, spring onion greens, salt, vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin making the Vegetable Fried Brown Rice recipe, collect all the ingredients on the kitchen platform before you start cooking. You can use fresh cooked brown rice or even the left over brown rice. Heat oil in heavy bottomed pan and add garlic and saute till golden in colour. Now add onion and green chilies and again saute for 2 to till the raw smell goes off. Add in the rest of the chopped vegetables and fry them all. Season with salt and black pepper and then add vinegar and the three sauces together. Cook for 2 to on low flame and then add the pre cooked brown rice and mix well such that the flavours incorporate well. Turn off the gas stove and garnish the brown fried rice with some fresh spring onion greens and coriander. Brown rice when teamed up with plenty of fine vegetables and tossed in olive oil and sauces to give a Chinese flavour. Step 2: Vegetable Fried Brown Rice dish makes an amazing rice meal that can be anytime enjoyed with any Chinese curry like Indo-Chinese Paneer Manchurian.

Dish Name: Vegetable Kung Pao With Broccoli And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, broccoli, peanut oil, scallions, garlic, fresh ginger, chili paste, scallion top, water chestnuts, chicken broth, soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, sesame oil, black vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap the tofu slabs in paper towels and place a heavy weight, such as a skillet, on top. Step 2: Let stand for 30 minutes to press out the excess water. Step 3: Cut the tofu into slices 1 / 2-inch thick and 2 1 / 2-inches long and place them in a bowl. Step 4: Cut away the broccoli florets and separate into bite-size pieces. Step 5: Cut the stalks on the diagonal into 1-inch pieces. Step 6: Heat a large pot of water to boiling, add the broccoli and boil for 3 minutes. Step 7: Drain, refresh under cold water and drain again. Step 8: Heat a heavy skillet and add 2 1 / 2 t of the oil arrange some of the tofu slices in the pan and sear over high heat for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown remove with a spatula and drain in a colander reheat the pan and add 2 more t of oil continue frying the rest of the slices, removing and draining as they are cooked Reheat the skillet, or a wok, add the remaining t of oil, heat until hot, and add the seasonings, stir-fry briefly, about 15 seconds, then add the scallion greens and water chestnuts, and stir-fry over high heat about 1 1 / 2- minutes. Step 9: Add the premixed sauce and cook, stirring continuously to prevent lumps, until it thickens.

Ingredient Names: hakka noodles, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, carrot, broccoli, onion, spring onion greens, soy sauce, red chili sauce, brown sugar, sriracha sauce, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: To begin with Vegetable Lo Mein, in a saucepan of boiling water, cook noodles as per packet instructions, drain, rinse twice, rub oil all over the noodles. Step 2: Keep it aside. Whisk together soy sauce, red chilli sauce, brown sugar, siracha and keep it aside. Heat oil in a wok. Step 3: Add minced garlic and white onions, sauté for about a minute. Add all the vegetables, cook, stir frequently, until tender or for about 5 minutes. Stir in cooked noodles and soy sauce mixture, and gently toss to combine. Step 4: Serve immediately. Serve Vegetable Lo Mein with Vegetarian Wonton Soup for a weekend dinner.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, tabasco sauce, vinegar, sugar, ketchup, stock, cornstarch, oil, garlic cloves, carrot, bamboo shoot, mushroom, celery, zucchini, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients and bring to a boil. Step 2: Cook till thickened, keep warm. Step 3: Heat skillet or wok with 1 1 / 2 t oil over high heat. Step 4: Add garlic and stir for 10 seconds. Step 5: Add carrot, bamboo shoots and mushrooms and stir for 1 minute. Step 6: Add remaining vegetables and continue stirring for another minute. Step 7: Add sugar, sesame oil, salt and stock. Step 8: Cover and cook 1 minute. Step 9: Add cornstarch and stir to thicken.

Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, iceberg lettuce, vegetables, soy sauce, peanut oil, sesame oil, pine nuts, garlic, spring onions, water chestnuts, caster sugar, bean paste, hoisin sauce, cornflour, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in large wok. Step 2: Add garlic and vegetables, fry for a few minutes then add soy sauce. Step 3: Fry until cooked but still crunchy. Step 4: Add spring onions and cook for a few minutes Having whisked all the sauce ingredients together, make a well in the middle of the mixture and pour it inches. Step 5: Bring to the boil and stir, simmering for a few minutes until it thickens. Step 6: Sprinkle with pinenuts and serve in the pan to keep warm. Step 7: Serve this with a plate of lettuce cups placing a few spoons of the mixture in the lettuce.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, broccoli florets, celery ribs, mushrooms, garlic cloves, tamari soy sauce, ground ginger, chicken broth, cornstarch, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Soak broccoli in water. Step 2: Heat canola oil in large frypan or wok and steam wet broccoli, covered, for 4-5 minutes. Step 3: Add celery, mushrooms, garlic, soy sauce and ginger. Step 4: Saute uncovered for about 5 more minutes, depending how crunchy you want your veggies. Step 5: Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Step 6: Stir in cornstarch paste and simmer 1 minute. Step 7: Serve over rice, with soy sauce and chow mein noodles.

Dish Name: Velveting Chicken Breast, Chinese Restaurant Style
Ingredient Names: egg white, chinese rice vinegar, cornstarch, kosher salt, skinless boneless chicken breast, water, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together egg white, vinegar, cornstarch, and salt in a large bowl until smooth. Step 2: Add sliced chicken; mix to coat thoroughly. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Step 4: Bring water and oil to a boil in a pot over high heat. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium. Step 6: Remove chicken from the marinade and shake off excess; discard remaining marinade. Step 7: Add chicken to boiling water and cook until just white on the outside but not completely cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Drain chicken and finish cooking in a hot oiled wok or skillet until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, or store parboiled chicken in the refrigerator in a sealed container until ready to use, up to a few hours.

Ingredient Names: wasabi powder, rice vinegar, dijon mustard, vegetable oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, combine the wasabi powder, vinegar, and mustard. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 cup of water and with the machine on, slowly pour in the oil to form a lightly thickened sauce. Step 3: Add the salt and process briefly The sauce can be refrigerated for up to 1 month Shake or stir before using.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breast, table salt, black pepper, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, low sodium soy sauce, celery, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, cornstarch, cooked white rice, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Step 3: Season chicken on both sides with salt and pepper and add to skillet. Step 4: Cook until browned on all sides, stirring frequently, about 4 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 cup of broth, soy sauce, celery, bamboo shoots and water chestnuts to chicken and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes Dissolve cornstarch in remaining 1 / 2 cup of broth. Step 7: Add cornstarch mixture to skillet and simmer until sauce thickens, stirring constantly, about 1 minute To serve, divide rice among 4 shallow dishes. Step 8: Spoon chicken mixture onto rice and sprinkle with cashews.

Ingredient Names: cooked white rice, red bell pepper, onion, coriander, mushroom, beef liver, cold water, butter, sesame, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Adobe the liver with two tablespoons of soy sauce. Step 2: Fry in butter onions, red bell peppers and mushrooms for 7 minutes. Step 3: Remove from skillet Added to the same skillet over 2 tablespoons of butter and saut the liver Again incorporates vegetables and add coriander To finish cooking, add the demiglace meat sauce and boil it to low heat until the sauce thickens. Step 4: Serve the liver on a cradle of rice and decorated with sesame.

Ingredient Names: wonton skins, canola oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Take a pastry brush and lightly brush the pan with some of the oil. Step 3: Brush each wonton skin very lightly with with some oil as well. Step 4: Sprinkle wontons with s pinch of salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste. Step 5: Bake 6-8 minutes or until crisp and browned. Step 6: Let cool on paper towels Crumble over salad or asian style stir fry dishes.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, shrimp, chinese rice wine, light soy sauce, brown sugar, green onions, fresh ginger root, wonton wrappers, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: To make the wontons: Mix pork, shrimp, rice wine, soy sauce, brown sugar, green onions, and ginger together in a large bowl until well combined. Step 3: Let stand for 25 to. Step 4: Spoon about filling onto the center of a wonton wrapper. Step 5: Moisten all four wrapper edges with water and fold over filling to make a triangle; press the edges firmly to seal. Step 6: Bring left and right corners together above filling; overlap the tips of these corners, moisten with water, and press together to seal. Step 7: Repeat until all wrappers have been filled and sealed. Step 8: To make the soup: Bring chicken stock to a rolling boil in a pot. Step 9: Gently drop in wontons and cook for 10 minutes. Step 10: Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.

Ingredient Names: scallion, pork spareribs, rice wine, dark soy sauce, soy sauce, water, fresh ginger, star anise, cinnamon sticks, rock sugar, fresh coarse ground black pepper, cornstarch, sesame oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch whole scallion in a 4-quart pot of boiling water until softened, about 1 minute. Step 2: Transfer scallion to a work surface and return pot of water to a boil. Step 3: Add ribs to boiling water and return to a boil, then immediately drain ribs in a colander. Step 4: Transfer ribs to a wide 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart heavy pot Carefully tie blanched scallion into a knot and add to pot with ribs. Step 5: Add wine, soy sauces, 3 cups water, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, rock sugar, and pepper to pot with ribs and simmer, covered, until meat is just tender, about 1 hour. Step 6: Remove lid and boil over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until sauce is reduced by three fourths and meat is very tender, about 20 minutes more. Step 7: Whisk together cornstarch and remaining tablespoon water in a cup. Step 8: Reduce heat to moderate and add cornstarch mixture to ribs, then cook, stirring, until sauce is thickened, about 1 minute. Step 9: Remove from heat and stir in sesame oil.

Dish Name: Ww Weight Watchers Sweet Sour Pork
Ingredient Names: cooking spray, pork tenderloin, unsweetened pineapple chunks, water, rice wine vinegar, brown sugar, cornstarch, table salt, low sodium soy sauce, green peppers, onion, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add pork and cook until golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 4: Drain any remaining fat from skillet. Step 5: Drain pineapple chunks, reserving juice, set aside. Step 6: Combine water, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, salt, soy sauce and reserved pineapple juice in a small bowl. Step 7: Add to skillet and cook until sauce is slightly thickened, about 2 minutes, add pork. Step 8: Cook covered over low heat until meat is tender, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Xiao Sun Zi Chao Rou Mo Slender Bamboo Shoots With Ground Pork
Ingredient Names: bamboo shoots, garlic cloves, red chile, dried chili pepper flakes, ground pork, shaoxing wine, salt, rice vinegar, light soy sauce, chicken stock, scallions, sesame oil, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over medium heat with just a smear of peanut oil. Step 2: Add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry for a few minutes until they are dry and a little fragrant. Step 3: Set aside Increase the temperature to high and add the remaining peanut oil. Step 4: Add the garlic and fresh and dried chiles and stir-fry briefly until fragrant. Step 5: Return the bamboo shoots to the wok, and when everything's hot and sizzly, add the vinegar, soy sauce and more salt to taste. Step 6: Add the stock or water and stir for 1-2 minutes longer to allow the flavors to penetrate the shoots. Step 7: Toss in the scallions at the end of the cooking time. Step 8: Turn off the heat, stir in the sesame oil and serve.

Dish Name: Asian Racks Of Lamb With Sesame Sauce
Ingredient Names: lamb racks, garlic cloves, ginger, sesame seeds, sugar, light soy sauce, sesame oil, beef stock, tahini
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200c place lamb racks in oven dish and season well. Step 2: Combine all other ingredients and rub onto racks. Step 3: Marinate at least 1 hour in fridge Roast racks until golden brown and cooked to your liking. Step 4: Set racks aside and cover with foil to rest. Step 5: Meanwhile remove fat from oven pan. Step 6: Add stock to deglaze. Step 7: Then add sesame oil and paste. Step 8: Bring to boil stirring until thickened and season. Step 9: Serve racks with the sesame gravy.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, soy sauce, dry sherry, chili oil, rice vinegar, garlic, green onion, shoulder lamb chops
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare barbecue. Step 2: Whisk hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sherry, chili oil, rice vinegar, and finely chopped garlic to blend in shallow dish. Step 3: Mix in 1 / 3 cup thinly sliced green onions. Step 4: Add lamb and turn to coat. Step 5: Let marinate 20 minutes. Step 6: Brush grill rack with oil. Step 7: Grill lamb to desired doneness, about 3 minutes per side for medium-rare. Step 8: Sprinkle lamb with remaining green onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: lamb, garlic powder, butter, onion, water, salt, instant brown rice, soy sauce, cornstarch, pepper, green pepper, mandarin orange segments
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir lamb strips and garlic powder in margarine in a 10-inch skillet, until lamb is brown, about 6 minutes. Step 2: Stir in onion and 1 cup water, heat to boiling, reduce heat. Step 3: Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Step 4: Heat 1 1 / 2 cups water and 1 / 2 tsp salt to boiling in 1 1 / 2-qt Saucepan, stir in rice, reduce heat. Step 5: Cover and steam 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Minced Lamb With Ginger Hoisin And Green Onions
Ingredient Names: orange juice, cornstarch, ground lamb, sesame oil, gingerroot, garlic, orange peel, green onion, hoisin sauce, butter lettuce leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Combine orange juice and cornstarch in small bowl. Step 2: Saute lamb in heavy large skillet over high heat until cooked through, breaking up with back of spoon, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Pour lamb with its juices into colander, drain. Step 4: Heat oil in same skillet over high heat. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic and orange peel. Step 6: Stir-fry 30 seconds. Step 7: Add green onions and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 8: Add hoisin sauce and lamb to skillet. Step 9: Stir until blended.

Ingredient Names: lamb tenderloin, sugar, dark soy sauce, egg, bicarbonate of soda, cornflour, peanut oil, onions, spring onion, garlic cloves, five-spice powder, hoisin sauce, ground bean sauce, chili bean sauce, chinese wine
Instructions: Step 1: Partially freeze lamb so it's easier to cut and then slice paper thin. Step 2: Soak lamb in cold water for 30 minutes. Step 3: Rinse well under cold running water, drain and squeeze out excess moisture. Step 4: Mix salt, soy sauce, egg, bicarbonate of soda and cornflour in a medium bowl. Step 5: Add lamb to the bowl and mix well. Step 6: Add one tablespoon of peanut oil, mix again, and leave to marinate in refrigerator for two hours. Step 7: Heat one tablespoon of peanut oil in a wok over medium-high heat and stir fry onion wedges and spring onion for one minute. Step 8: Remove and place aside. Step 9: Heat remaining three tablespoons of peanut oil in the wok swirling to cover the surface. Step 10: Stir fry garlic for 5 seconds.

Dish Name: Mongolian Lamb Stir Fry With Rice
Ingredient Names: cornflour, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, black bean sauce, chinese five spice powder, olive oil, lamb steaks, brown onion, button mushrooms, celery ribs, zucchini, carrots, chinese cabbage, garlic cloves, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Put the cornflour in a small bowl and stir in the soy sauce, vinegar, black bean sauce and five spice powder and set aside. Step 2: Brush a little oil over a large wok and heat on high until wok is hot and add half of the lamb and stir fry for 2 minutes or until lamb is almost cooked and transfer to a plate. Step 3: Brush to wok with a little more oil and reheat wok to high and repeat with remaining lamb and then remove lamb from the wok and put on the plate with first batch of lamb. Step 4: Brush the wok with the remaining oil and heat on medium-high and add the onion, mushroom, celery, zucchini, carrot, cabbage, garlic and ginger and stir fry for 2 minutes and then add the water, cook covered tossing twice, for 2 minutes or until the vegetable are just tender. Step 5: Add the lamb and sauce to the wok and toss to combine and heat through. Step 6: Divide the rice between plates and top with mixture to serve.

Dish Name: Roasted Red Peppers With Lamb Eggplant And Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, peanut oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, ground lamb, eggplant, rice wine, chili-garlic sauce, light soy sauce, salt, fresh ground pepper, extra virgin olive oil, kalamata olives
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the tops off each pepper, keeping stems intact. Step 2: Spoon out the seeds from the bases. Step 3: Set pepeprs and lids aside. Step 4: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Step 5: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add the peanut oil. Step 7: Heat until oil just begins to smoke. Step 8: Add the garlic and ginger, add the lamb. Step 9: Stir-fry until slightly browned, about 3 minutes.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Lamb With Spring Onions
Ingredient Names: lamb fillets, light brown sugar, light soy sauce, dry sherry, cornflour, mushrooms, spring onions, vegetable oil, ginger, yellow bean sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice lamb thinly. Step 2: Make up a marinate with the sugar, soy sauce, wine and cornflour paste and add the sliced lamb and marinate for 30-45 minutes. Step 3: Soak the mushrooms for 25 to 30 minutes, then chop them into small pieces with the spring onions. Step 4: Heat the oil in a preheated wok until hot and stir-fry the meat for about 1 minutes or until the colour changes and then remove with a slotted spoon and drain. Step 5: Keep about 1 tablespoon of oil in the wok and then add the spring onions, ginger, mushrooms and yellow bean sauce and blend well, then add the meat and fry for 1 minute more and then sprinkle with the sesame oil and serve.

Dish Name: Szechuan Lamb With Peppers And Spinach
Ingredient Names: lamb tenderloin, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, peanut oil, fresh ginger, red bell peppers, scallions, water, chicken broth, cornstarch, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the lamb across the grain into strips 1 / 2 inch thick. Step 2: In a medium bowl or resealable plastic bag, mix 2 tsp soy sauce, all of the hoisin sauce, 2 of the minced garlic cloves, and 1 / 4 tsp of the red pepper flakes. Step 3: Add lamb and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours During this time, thaw the spinach and allow to come to room temperature. Step 4: Press out as much moisture as possible. Step 5: Heat a wok over high heat and add 1 tsp of the oil. Step 6: When the oil is hot, add the lamb and stir-fry until the pink color is gone, about 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Remove the lamb to a plate and set aside. Step 8: Add the remaining 2 tsp oil to the wok and when warm stir in ginger, remaining garlic and pepper flakes. Step 9: Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Dish Name: Yang Rou Chuan Spicy Lamb Kebabs
Ingredient Names: bamboo skewers, boneless leg of lamb, vegetable oil, cumin powder, chili powder, ground black pepper, ground szechuan peppercorns, fresh garlic, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak bamboo skewers in cold water for one hour This will make the meat slide onto the skewers better and they won't burn as easily on the grill. Step 2: Cut the lamb into pieces the size of almonds. Step 3: Thread them onto the bamboo skewers Light a charcoal grill and wait for the coals to turn gray or set a gas grill to medium-high. Step 4: Mix the cumin and chile powders, the pepper and salt, the peppercorns and the garlic together in a bowl. Step 5: Pour the oil onto a plate On 1 other plates, put the cumin and peppercorn mixture. Step 6: Roll the skewers in the oil, then in the cumin and peppercorn mixture. Step 7: Set the skewers on the grill rack, cover, and cook for 3 minutes.

Dish Name: stir fried noodles with curried lamb
Ingredient Names: udon noodles, oil, sesame oil, dry sherry, cornstarch, soy sauce, mild molasses, unsweetened coconut milk, sambal oelek, ginger, garlic, scallions, jalapeno chiles, napa cabbage, red bell peppers, green bell peppers, leg lamb, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Boil udon noodles according to package directions, drain and return to pot. Step 2: Mix in 1 tbsp oil and sesame oil and set aside. Step 3: Mix cornstarch with sherry until blended. Step 4: Stir in next 5 ingredients, set aside. Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp oil in skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add ginger, garlic, scallions, and chiles, cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Add cabbage, lamb and peppers, cook for 2-3 minutes until lamb is cooked through. Step 8: Stir in the sherry mixture and cook until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Step 9: Add lamb sauce to the noodles in the pot. Step 10: Toss over high heat until the noodles are coated with the sauce. Step 11: Mix in 2 tbsp cilantro. Step 12: Transfer to a large bowl, sprinkle with remaining cilantro, serve.

Dish Name: Ants Climbing A Tree Ma Yi Shang Shu
Ingredient Names: bean threads, ground pork, green onions, fresh ginger, szechuan hot bean sauce, rice wine, soy sauce, salt, chicken stock, peanut oil, red chili peppers, dried mushrooms, serrano pepper, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Soften the noodles briefly in warm water. Step 2: When they are soft, mostly clear and pliable, drain and cut both ends to shorten them to manageable lengths Be careful not to over soak. Step 3: Set aside To prepare the red peppers: top and seed the red peppers and chop finely If using dried red peppers, soak in warm water until softened, then seed and chop. Step 4: Set aside To prepare the green pepper: top, seed and cut into shreds. Step 5: Fry shortly in 1 tbsp cooking oil on high heat with a pinch of salt, set aside.

Ingredient Names: bulgar wheat, boiling water, water chestnuts, bean sprouts, sliced mushrooms, green onions, carrot, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh lime juice, napa cabbage leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse bulgar wheat several times, then pour boiling water over it, stir and put in the refrigerator for 30 minutes The bulgar will soak up most of the water after 30 minutes but if it doesn't, drain it to make sure there is no longer any water present.
