Step 2: Add all of the other ingredients into the soaked bulgar wheat. Step 3: Put the tabbouleh into the refrigerator for an hour or so tossing every now and then. Step 4: Serve in place of a salad or use to make asian tabbouleh cabbage rolls in place of egg rolls As always, if you prefer fresh mushrooms or fresh bean sprouts please use those.

Ingredient Names: instant rice, water, onion, peas and carrots, soy sauce, egg, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pot, bring the water to a boil and then stir in rice. Step 2: Cover with a tight-fitting lid and set aside. Step 3: In a large skillet, place 2 tablespoons of oil to get hot over med-high heat Scramble egg, stir-frying the heck outta that sucker to make sure it's good and broken up. Step 4: Put it into your serving bowl for holding. Step 5: Put the other 2 tablespoons of oil in the skillet and fry the onion until almost transparent. Step 6: Add the peas and carrots, stir-frying those to thaw. Step 7: Heat thoroughly By this time, the rice should be ready. Step 8: Pour it into the skillet and add the egg.

Ingredient Names: white rice, water, chicken bouillon cubes, red pepper sauce, water chestnuts, green onions, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium sized sauce pan, bring rice, water, bouillon cubes and pepper sauce to a boil. Step 2: Stir once or twice, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in water chestnuts, green onions and lemon zest Recover and let stand for 10 minutes Fluff with a fork before serving.

Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, water, bacon, eggs, salt, black pepper, onion, vegetable oil, scallion, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring rice and water to a boil in a 3 quart heavy saucepan, then reduce, heat to low and cook, tightly covered, until water is absorbed and rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat and let stand, covered, 5 minutes Gently stir rice from top to bottom of saucepan with a heatproof rubber spatula. Step 3: Cook bacon in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until golden and crisp, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Pour into a sieve set over a heatproof bowl and reserve bacon and fat separately. Step 5: Whisk together eggs, t salt and t pepper in a medium bowl. Step 6: Return 3 tablespoons fat to skillet and saut onion over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until pale golden, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add eggs and cook, stirring, until eggs are just set, about 1 minute. Step 8: Make a well in center of egg mixture, then pour in vegetable oil and 2 tablespoons reserved bacon fat. Step 9: Add rice, remaining teaspoon salt and remaining teaspoon pepper and cook, stirring, 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, bacon, green onions, egg, soy sauce, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Fry bacon until crisp. Step 2: Add onion and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add egg and scramble until egg forms small flakes. Step 4: Stir in rice and garlic, continue to stir fry until heated through Gently separate grains of rice with fork so mixture is fluffy. Step 5: Add soy sauce and stir until mixture is well blended.

Ingredient Names: chow mein noodles, peanut oil, bean sprouts, green onions, onion, garlic cloves, celery, bok choy, sesame seeds, char siu pork, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking pan. Step 2: Mix noodles, vegetables, sesame, and char siu, and place in pan. Step 3: Mix sauce ingredients, and lace noodle mixture with sauce Seal with foil. Step 4: Bake at 325f for 45 minutes. Step 5: Remove from oven and loosen foil immediately to let steam escape. Step 6: Serve hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: barbecued pork, eggs, oil, green onions, rice, salt, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs lightly. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Step 3: Add the green onions and eggs, and stir for 10 to 20 seconds. Step 4: Add rice and the diced pork. Step 5: Stir briskly for 2 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and soy sauce. Step 7: Mix well and serve.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, oil, salt, light soy sauce, chicken stock, barbecued pork, bok choy, bean sprouts, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut noodles into pieces, 1 1 / 2" long and 1 / 2" wide, set aside. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in wok to 400f. Step 3: Add chow fun, and stir-fry quickly until it is well heated. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 tsp salt and the soy sauce If it's too dry, add the chicken stock, remove from wok. Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in wok to 400f. Step 6: Stir-fry pork for 1 minute. Step 7: Add bok choy, sprouts, and scallion, and 1 / 2 tsp salt.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, green onions, oil, soy sauce, salt, sugar, sherry wine, eggs, roast pork, roast beef, lamb, duck, turkey, chicken, boiled ham
Instructions: Step 1: Dice or shred meat and vegetables, heat oil in wok. Step 2: Stir-fry green onions. Step 3: Add fresh vegetables and stir-fry to soften. Step 4: Add canned vegetables and meat. Step 5: Stir-fry to heat and blend flavors, remove from wok. Step 6: Heat some more oil if needed, to smoking. Step 7: Add rice and heat through completely. Step 8: Return vegetables and meat to wok, add soy sauce, salt, sugar and sherry.

Ingredient Names: water, chicken stock, red chilies, ginger, lemon juice, lemongrass, coriander, chinese barbecued duck, shallots, ramen noodles, bean sprouts, red chile, bok choy, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine stock and water into saucepan and heat till liquid is simmering. Step 2: Add, galangal, chillies and lime juice to saucepan Bruise lemon grass and coriander, and add to saucepan. Step 3: Simmer liquid for 20 minutes. Step 4: Strain liquid, and return to saucepan. Step 5: Heat liquid with duck and shallots. Step 6: Boil ramen noodles in separate saucepan for 3-5 minutes or till tender, drain noodles. Step 7: Add noodles and bak choy to soup stock and simmer for 5 minutes Ladle soup to serving bowls, garnishing with bean sprouts, chilli strips and coriander.

Dish Name: Beef Black Beans And Rice Noodles With Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, ginger, garlic, red chili pepper, filet of beef, fermented black beans, shiitake mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, rice wine, palm sugar, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, flat rice noodles, gai lan, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok until just smoking. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic and chilli and fry til fragrant. Step 3: Add the beef slices and stir-fry for one minute, then add the black beans, both sorts of mushrooms, shao xing, palm sugar, soy and oyster sauces and chicken stock. Step 4: Stir fry for one minute. Step 5: Add the rice noodles, broccoli leaves and spring onions and cook for a further minute. Step 6: Finally, add the sesame oil and remove from the heat. Step 7: Spoon into a large bowl or platter then sprinkle over the pepper.

Ingredient Names: rice, butter, onion, carrot, green onion, sesame seeds, eggs, soy sauce, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package directions. Step 2: In a large skillet melt butter. Step 3: Add onions, carrots and scallions. Step 4: Saute until carrots are translucent, set aside, heat oven to 350f. Step 5: Place sesame seeds in a shallow pan. Step 6: Bake until golden brown, shaking pan occasionally for even color Lightly grease another skillet. Step 7: Beat eggs and pour into hot skillet.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, frozen peas, carrots, eggs, onion, butter, soy sauce, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice following instructions on package. Step 2: Pour rice into a large bowl to let it cool in the refrigerator Scramble the eggs in a small pan over medium heat Separate the scrambled chunks of egg into small pea-size bits while cooking. Step 3: When rice has cooled to near room temperature, add peas, grated carrot, scrambled egg and diced onion to the bowl Carefully toss all of the ingredients together. Step 4: Melt butter in a large frying pan over medium / high heat. Step 5: When butter has completely melted, dump the bowl of rice and other ingredients into the pan and add soy sauce plus a dash of salt and pepper. Step 6: Cook rice for 6-8 minutes over heat, stirring often.

Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, salt, butter, flour, milk, black pepper, italian seasoning, nutmeg, spicy mustard, monterey jack cheese, shredded cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Bring one gallon of water to a boil and add a splash of olive oil and 1 tbls Salt. Step 2: Cook the pasta until tender but still firm, about 12 minutes, stirring frequently, drain. Step 3: Melt butter in a pan and stir in flour and cook for a few minutes. Step 4: Heat milk until hot and slowly add to the roux. Step 5: Add the rest of the ingredients except bread crumbs and cup of the cheese. Step 6: Spread in greased 13 x 9 pan and sprinkle on remaining cheese and breadcrumbs. Step 7: Bake at 375 f for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, onions, lemon juice, soy sauce, honey, olive oil, pork tenderloin, chicken broth, broccoli florets, cornstarch, water, lemon rind
Instructions: Step 1: ------marinade-------mix garlic, onions, lemon juice, soy sauce and honey together -------pork-------- Trim fat from pork. Step 2: Cut pork into 1 / 2" pieces. Step 3: Place into a resealable plastic bag and pour marinade over pork Seal bag Marinade pork for 20 minutes, or refrigerate until ready to use, no longer than 24 hours. Step 4: Drain pork, reserving marinade Spray skillet with nonstick spray. Step 5: Add olive oil and heat until oil is hot.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, oil, salt, cayenne pepper, dry white wine, bell pepper, onion, garlic, soy sauce, pineapple chunk
Instructions: Step 1: Use salt and cayenne to coat chops. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 3: Add chops and brown slowly. Step 4: Add wine, bell pepper, onion and garlic. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes, remove pork chops. Step 6: Add soy sauce and reserved pineapple juice. Step 7: Stir and allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add pineapple chunks and pork chops. Step 9: Bring to a boil, turn off heat.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, eggs, meat, cooked rice, green onions, bean sprouts, low sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet or wok Saut onion over medium-high heat for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add garlic and saut for 1 minute Push onions and garlic to side. Step 3: Pour eggs onto bottom of wok. Step 4: Cook and stir eggs for 1-2 minutes until firm. Step 5: Stir onions, garlic, and eggs together. Step 6: Add meat, rice, green onions, and any additional veggies from optional list below to wok. Step 7: Stir and toss until evenly mixed and almost heated through. Step 8: Add bean sprouts and soy sauce to wok.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, cornstarch, low sodium soy sauce, sugar, chili powder, bean thread noodles, tomatoes, garlic cloves, green onions, oil, chicken stock, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into bite-size pieces. Step 2: Mix cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, chili powder, & a pinch of salt in a medium bowl. Step 3: Add pork to soy mix, stir well to coat pork pieces, and marinate, covered in the fridge, for 15 minutes. Step 4: Soak noodles in lukewarm water for 15 minutes. Step 5: Prepare tomatoes: submerge in boiling water for 30 seconds. Step 6: Remove and rinse under cold water Peel, remove seeds, and chop Peel and mince garlic and green onions. Step 7: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet and stir-fry onions and garlic til translucent. Step 8: Add pork & stir-fry for 2 minute.

Dish Name: Cha Siu Bao Sweet Barbecue Pork Buns
Ingredient Names: char siu pork, mushrooms, water, cornstarch, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, hoisin sauce, sugar, red food coloring, canola oil, garlic cloves, yeast, milk, oil
Instructions: Step 1: You can use my recipe for char siu or make it with a mix- both powdered and liquid mixes are available at asian food stores I like the noh brand, personally. Step 2: Chop the char siu and mushrooms finely. Step 3: Combine the water and cornstarch and stir into the char siu and mushrooms. Step 4: Add salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, hoisin sauce, and sugar, and add enough food coloring to color the mixture a bright red. Step 5: Heat the oil and lightly cook the garlic, then add the rest of the filling mixture and cook until thick To make the bao dough, dissolve the yeast and sugar in the water and let stand for 5 minutes. Step 6: Combine water with salt, milk and oil, stir in flour. Step 7: Knead 5-10 minutes or until dough is smooth.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, sesame oil, carrot, onion, cabbage, chicken breast, eggs, fresh ginger, bean sprouts, water, brown sugar, soy sauce, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the rice noodles in a pot of hot water and allow them to soak for 15 to 20 minutes While the noodles are soaking, heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the carrot and onion. Step 3: Cook and stir until crisp tender. Step 4: Stir in the cabbage, cooking and stirring for 1 minute longer, add the chicken. Step 5: Cook and stir for a few minutes until chicken is browned on all sides. Step 6: Stir in the ginger, bean sprouts and eggs. Step 7: Once the eggs are cooked, stir in the water, brown sugar and soy sauce Continue to cook and stir until the chicken is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, cornflour, salt, peanut oil, chicken breasts, spring onions, carrot, mirin, hokkien noodles, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chilli powder, cornflour and salt Thoroughly coat chicken slices. Step 2: Heat peanut oil in wok over med-high heat, cook chicken in 4 batches, adding more oil between batches if necessary. Step 3: Remove from wok and leave on paper towels to drain. Step 4: Put hokkein noodles in a strainer and run under warm water, using your fingers to separate the noodles Re-heat wok over medium heat, add a splash of oil and stir-fry carrot and spring onion for 1 minute. Step 5: Add noodles and mirin, toss for 1 minute. Step 6: Add oyster sauce and 2 tab water, stir through then cover and steam for 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Add chicken, toss, cover and steam 30 seconds. Step 8: Serve into warm bowls and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: dried fermented black beans, vegetable oil, thai chiles, shallot, fresh ginger, garlic, reduced-sodium tamari, shaoxing rice wine, brown sugar, ground sichuan pepper, chinese five-spice powder, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse black beans thoroughly and dry. Step 2: Remove about 5 minutes and set aside. Step 3: Roughly chop the rest of the beans. Step 4: Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium-low heat. Step 5: Add chiles, shallot, ginger, and garlic. Step 6: Fry until soft and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Do not let the ingredients burn. Step 8: Reduce the heat if necessary. Step 9: The objective is to slow cook the ingredients. Step 10: Add all the beans; both chopped and whole. Step 11: Simmer, stirring often, until the beans are soft, about 15-20 minutes. Step 12: Add tamari, rice wine, brown sugar, ground Sichuan pepper, and five spice. Step 13: Simmer until thickened, stirring often. Step 14: Remove from heat; let cool, about 10 minutes. Step 15: Mix in sesame oil and cover. Step 16: As the sauce rests, the beans will settle and the oil will float, creating a barrier which will protect it from mold. Step 17: The sauce is ready to use or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

Ingredient Names: miracle whip, soy sauce, ground ginger, hot pepper sauce, rotini pasta, cooked chicken, pea pods, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Mix miracle whip, soy sauce, and seasonings in a large bowl Add remaining ingredients Mix lightly Refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, cornstarch, reduced sodium soy sauce, sesame oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, white vinegar, sugar, canola oil, fresh snow peas, carrots, green onions, ground ginger, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk corn starch and 1 tbsp soy sauce until smooth. Step 3: Stir in 1 tbsp sesame oil. Step 4: Transfer to a large resealable plastic bag and add chicken Seal bag and turn to coat chicken. Step 5: Let stand for 10 minutes. Step 6: In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, sugar, remaining soy sauce and sesame oil, set aside. Step 7: In a large nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry the chicken in canola oil until the juices run clear. Step 8: Remove to a platter and keep warm.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder, chicken wings
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic powder in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Cook and stir until sugar has dissolved. Step 3: Remove from heat and allow to cool. Step 4: Place chicken wings in a large bowl. Step 5: Pour soy sauce mixture over wings and toss to coat evenly. Step 6: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Step 7: Allow chicken to marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour to overnight. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 9: Pour chicken wings and marinade into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 10: Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil. Step 11: Bake in the preheated oven until thoroughly hot, about 25-30 minutes. Step 12: Remove foil and bake for 15 more minutes, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, cabbage, carrot, bamboo shoots, wood ear mushroom, green onions, soy sauce, salt, sugar, msg, egg roll wrappers, egg white, oil for frying
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Pour in beaten eggs and cook, without stirring, until firmed up. Step 3: Flip eggs over and cook for an additional 20 seconds to firm the other side. Step 4: Set egg pancake aside to cool, then slice into thin strips. Step 5: Heat remaining vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 6: Stir in cabbage and carrot; cook for to wilt. Step 7: Add pork, bamboo shoots, mushroom, green onions, soy sauce, salt, sugar, and MSG; continue cooking until vegetables soften, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Stir in sliced egg, then spread the mixture out onto a pan, and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour. Step 9: To assemble the egg rolls: Place a wrapper onto your work surface with one corner pointing towards you. Step 10: Place about cooled filling in a heap onto the bottom third of the wrapper. Step 11: Brush a little beaten egg white onto the top two edges of the wrapper, then fold the bottom corner over the filling and roll firmly to the halfway point. Step 12: Fold the left and right sides snugly over the egg roll, then continue rolling until the top corners seal the egg roll with the egg white. Step 13: Repeat with remaining egg roll wrappers, covering finished egg rolls with plastic wrap to keep from drying out. Step 14: Heat about 6 inches of oil in a wok or deep-fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 15: Fry egg rolls 3 or 4 at a time until golden brown, 5 to. Step 16: Drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, oil, onion, eggs, cooked shrimp, frozen peas, garlic powder, soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice according to directions and drain. Step 2: Heat oil in large skillet. Step 3: Add onion, saute a few minutes and add eggs Scramble. Step 4: Stir in shrimp and rest of ingredients. Step 5: Heat through Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: eggs, onion, spring onions, ham, peanut oil, cooked medium-grain rice, frozen peas, soy sauce, small shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Season eggs with salt and pepper Peel onion and cut into wedges about 1 5cm wide. Step 2: Cut spring onions into shorts lengths on the diagonal. Step 3: Cut the ham into very thin strips. Step 4: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large frying pan and add the eggs, pulling the set egg towards the centre and tilting the pan to let the unset egg run to the edges. Step 5: When almost set, break up into large pieces, to resemble scrambled eggs. Step 6: Transfer to a plate and set aside. Step 7: Heat the remaining oil in the wok, swirling to coat the base and side. Step 8: Add the onion and stir-fry over high heat until it starts to turn transparent.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, fresh ginger, garlic clove, soymilk, creamy peanut butter, fresh lemon juice, dry white wine, soy sauce, cornstarch, black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, thin spaghetti, cooking spray, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: First, prepare the peanut sauce. Step 2: Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a small saucepan over medium high heat. Step 3: Add onion, 1 teaspoon of the grated ginger, and garlic. Step 4: Saute about 5 minutes until onion is tender Next stir in the soy milk, peanut butter and lemon juice until the peanut butter is melted, stirring constantly. Step 5: Remove from heat and allow to cool Next prepare the marinade. Step 6: Combine the wine, soy sauce, 2 teaspoons ginger, cornstarch and 1 / 2 teaspoon black pepper in a medium bowl. Step 7: Add chicken pieces and toss. Step 8: Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cabbage, boneless pork, chicken broth, soy sauce, gingerroot, green onions, thin egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high. Step 2: Add pork and cabbage and stir fry until meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken broth, soy sauce, and ginger. Step 4: Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Step 5: Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add noodles and cook until tender, about 2 to 4 minutes. Step 7: Stir in onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cooked chicken breast, cooked rice, green onions, celery, carrot, soy sauce, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat, add chicken. Step 2: Cook and stir until lightly browned. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients. Step 4: Cook and stir about 10 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sliced mushrooms, garlic, chicken stock, chow mein noodles, sherry wine, lemon juice, sesame oil, hot pepper sauce, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Cook mushrooms and garlic for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add stock and 2 cups water, bring to boil. Step 4: Add noodles, sherry, lemon juice or rice vinegar, sesame oil and hot pepper sauce. Step 5: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 3 minhtes. Step 6: Stir in scallions.

Ingredient Names: kosher salt, broccoli slaw mix, toasted sesame oil, extra firm tofu, vegetable oil, scallions, fresh ginger, shiitake mushrooms, low sodium vegetable broth, soy sauce, fresh ground black pepper, cornstarch, chinese noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add the noodles and broccoli slaw. Step 3: Cook, stirring until the noodles are al dente and the slaw is tender, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Drain and rinse under cold water. Step 5: Then transfer to a large bowl. Step 6: Add the sesame oil and season with salt - toss. Step 7: Meanwhile, spread out the tofu on a kitchen towel Lay another towel on top and press to remove as much water as possible. Step 8: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a dutch oven or large deep skillet over high heat. Step 9: Add the tofu and cook, turning, until golden, about 6 minutes.

Ingredient Names: snow peas, rice vermicelli, red pepper, english cucumber, shrimp, crabmeat, fresh ginger, garlic, sesame oil, black pepper, salt, lemon juice, vegetable oil, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and trim snow peas. Step 2: Place them in a bowl and pour in enough boiling water to cover them. Step 3: Let stand 10 minutes. Step 4: Drain and set aside. Step 5: Cook the noodles in plenty of boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Drain in colander, rinse with cold water and set aside In large bowl, combine noodles, snow peas, red pepper, cucumber, shrimp and crabmeat. Step 7: In a small bowl, combine ginger, garlic, sesame oil, pepper, salt, vegetable oil, lemon juice and vinegar. Step 8: Pour this dressing over the other ingredients and mix thoroughly. Step 9: Chill before serving.

Dish Name: Chinese Pasta Salad With Creamy Ginger Dressing
Ingredient Names: precooked shanghai noodles, sesame oil, snow peas, shrimp, coriander, scallions, oil, salt, white pepper, chinese wine, fresh ginger, garlic clove, egg yolk, egg white, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients in a small bowl and add shrimp Blanch the noodles, rinse under cool water and sprinkle with sesame seed oil, toss, and set aside Blanch whole snow peas and set aside. Step 2: Heat wok, add 1 tablespoon oil, when oil is hot, add shrimp and stir-fry until pink. Step 3: Set aside Dressing: in a blender or food processor, mix ginger, garlic, egg yolk, egg white, and lemon Slowly drizzle in oil. Step 4: Mix in soy and cream, set aside. Step 5: Toss noodles, shrimps, and snow peas.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, instant rice, onion, peas and carrots, soy sauce, eggs, vegetable oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pot bring the water to a boil, stir in the rice. Step 2: Cover with a lid and set aside. Step 3: Cut the pork into tiny diced pieces. Step 4: In a large skillet, place the vegetable oil over medium-high heat and get it hot. Step 5: Place onions into skillet and fry until almost transparent. Step 6: Add the peas and carrots, stirring until thawed and heated thoroughly The rice should now be ready. Step 7: Pour rice into skillet. Step 8: Add the diced pork, soy sauce and sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, chicken stock, ham steak, frozen peas, eggs, canola oil, salt, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook your rice You want it a bit on the crunchy side, so even though you might want to add more water, don't. Step 2: Let your rice cool completely You can even cook your rice the night before and let cool in the fridge. Step 3: Heat a wok over high heat with 1 tbs Of oil. Step 4: Add eggs and scramble until cooked. Step 5: Add ham and peas and fry for about a minute. Step 6: Remove omelet from wok Clean the wok out a bit so the leftover egg doesn't burn while you're heating up your wok and oil again.

Ingredient Names: long grain white rice, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place rice in fine-mesh strainer set over bowl. Step 2: Rinse under running water, swishing with hands until water runs clear, drain thoroughly. Step 3: Bring rinsed rice, water, and salt to boil in saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cook, uncovered, until water level drops below surface of rice and small holes form, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until rice is tender and water is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: fried rice, egg, flour, oil
Instructions: Step 1: If your rice has any large items pull these out and chop into small pieces, add back to rice. Step 2: Put rice in a mixing bowl. Step 3: Add egg, and mix to coat rice If the rice is not well coated, add another egg. Step 4: Stir in flour The mixture should be fairly loose, but not runny. Step 5: Heat enough oil to coat the bottom of a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Drop the rice mixture by tablespoons into hot oil Gently flatten each spoonful with the back of a spoon, so that it is about 1 / 4 inch thick.

Dish Name: Chinese Sausage And Rice Rice Cooker
Ingredient Names: white rice, cooking spray, chinese sausage, green onion, water, cilantro leaf, black sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice well in a fine strainer Coat the rice bowl with cooking spray. Step 2: Add the drained rice, sausage, and onions to the rice bowl. Step 3: Add the water, stir just to combine. Step 4: Cook on the regular white rice cycle. Step 5: When the machine switches to keep warm, let it steam for 15 minutes Fluff the rice with a plastic rice paddle, or wooden spoon. Step 6: Place in a serving dish, and garnish with the cilantro and the sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: bread flour, kosher salt, hot water, vegetable oil, sesame oil, all-purpose flour, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine bread flour and salt in a large bowl. Step 2: Make a well in the middle and pour in hot water. Step 3: Mix together with a wooden spoon to form a shaggy dough. Step 4: Transfer dough onto a lightly floured work surface. Step 5: Knead dough until sticky but relatively smooth and elastic, dusting with a minimal amount of flour if needed. Step 6: Wrap in plastic wrap and let dough rest for 10 minutes. Step 7: Mix vegetable oil, sesame oil, and flour together in a skillet over medium heat until starting to bubble, about 5 minutes, cook for more. Step 8: Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Step 9: Unwrap dough and cut in half. Step 10: Roll out into a tube and press down with your fingers. Step 11: Use a rolling pin to flatten dough into a rectangular shape about 1/8-inch thick, flipping over and dusting lightly with flour halfway through. Step 12: Paint surface of the dough with the oil mixture until just covered, leaving of space on the edges. Step 13: Sprinkle scallions on top. Step 14: Roll dough up tightly to seal in the scallions, starting with the long side. Step 15: Pull the opposite edge over the top once you have reached it. Step 16: Coil 1 end of the dough inward toward the middle; wrap the opposite end around the coil to finish, tucking the tip under the bottom. Step 17: Dust the coil with flour and roll dough out into a pancake about 1/4-inch thick. Step 18: Repeat with remaining dough, oil, and green onions to make the second pancake. Step 19: Heat vegetable oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat. Step 20: Add 1 pancake; lower heat to medium. Step 21: Cook until crispy and browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 22: Repeat with the other pancake, cut into wedges.

Ingredient Names: napa cabbage, green onion, sesame seeds, ramen noodles, sliced almonds, butter, vinegar, sugar, vegetable oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cabbage and onions. Step 2: Refrigerate until ready to toss Brown noodles, almonds and sesame seeds lightly in butter, set aside. Step 3: Bring to a boil in a pan the vinegar, oil, sugar and soy sauce, just enough to dissolve the sugar. Step 4: Cool dressing completely. Step 5: Combine all ingredients and toss just before serving.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, warm water, active dry yeast, white sugar, vegetable oil, salt, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Mix together flour, warm water, yeast, and sugar in a large bowl. Step 3: Allow to sit for 5 minutes. Step 4: Mix in remaining 1 陆 cups flour, remaining warm water, sugar, vegetable oil, and salt. Step 5: Knead until dough is smooth and elastic. Step 6: Transfer to a greased bowl, roll to coat with oil, and let sit until tripled in size, 2 陆 to. Step 7: Punch down dough and spread out on a floured board. Step 8: Sprinkle baking powder evenly on surface of dough; knead for 8-10 minutes. Step 9: Divide dough in half; set aside one half in a covered bowl. Step 10: Divide remaining half into 12 equal pieces. Step 11: Shape each into a ball; transfer each ball to a small square of waxed paper with the smooth surface facing up. Step 12: Repeat portioning and shaping with remaining dough half. Step 13: Cover all 24 dough balls and let sit until doubled in size, about 5 minutes. Step 14: Bring some water to a boil in a wok, then reduce heat to medium and keep water at a low boil. Step 15: Place the steam plate on a small wire rack in the middle of the wok, leaving at least 2 inches of space between the plate and the wok. Step 16: Working in batches, place buns on waxed paper squares onto the steam plate, leaving 1 to 2 inches between buns. Step 17: Cover and steam buns for 10-12 minutes. Step 18: Carefully remove the lid, so condensation doesn't drip onto buns. Step 19: Continue steaming remaining buns until all are cooked.

Ingredient Names: oil, cooked rice, ground cumin, onion, coriander, gingerroot, lemon zest, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil in a wok over high heat, when hot, saute the onion cubes, and minced ginger, then stir fry grated lemon zest and ground cumin over medium heat for about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add the rice into the wok, stirring and tossing to mix well, season with salt. Step 3: Remove from the wok to a bowl, serve immediately.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Spicy Szechuan Noodles
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, smooth peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, black vinegar, toasted sesame oil, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, garlic cloves, wheat noodles, red pepper, carrot, green onion, peanuts, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Meanwhile, combine the stock, peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, black vinegar, sesame oil, chili garlic sauce, sugar, and garlic in the bowl of a food processor Pulse to combine well and transfer to a large bowl. Step 3: Cook the noodles about 6 minutes, or until they are almost done but still have a little bite in the center. Step 4: Drain the noodles, and add immediately to the sauce mixture. Step 5: Toss the noodles, then add the red pepper, carrot, green onions, peanuts and sprouts. Step 6: Taste to adjust the seasoning with more soy sauce or chili sauce If the mixture is dry, add a few tablespoons of hot water to make mixing the ingredients easier. Step 7: Let the noodles sit to come to room temperature As they sit, they will absorb the extra sauce in the bottom of the bowl.

Ingredient Names: water, black tea leaves, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, tangerine zest, cinnamon stick, star anise, salt, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine water, tea leaves, soy sauce, black soy sauce, zest, cinnamon stick, star anise, and salt in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, place eggs and remaining salt into a medium pot; cover with cold water. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat, drain, and cool. Step 7: Tap cooled eggs with the back of a spoon to crack shells; do not remove shells. Step 8: Remove the saucepan from the heat. Step 9: Add eggs and let steep for at least 5 minutes, or for a richer flavor, up to 1 陆 days.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, green cabbage, peanut oil, garlic, chow mein noodles, carrots, fresh bean sprouts, green onions, water, cornflour cornstarch, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chinese cooking wine, sugar, sesame oil, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together cornflour and soy sauce, then mix in remaining ingredients. Step 2: Alternative: Use 1/3 cup Chinese All Purpose Stir Fry Sauce, if you have some in stock. Step 3: Marinate Chicken: Pour 1 tbsp of Sauce over the chicken, mix to coat, set aside to marinate for 10 minutes. Step 4: Noodles: Prepare the noodles according to the packet instructions (my pack says soak in boiled water for 1 minute), then drain. Step 5: Heat oil in wok or large fry pan over high heat. Step 6: Add garlic and stir fry for 10 seconds or until it starts to turn golden - don't let it burn! Step 7: Add chicken and stir fry until the surface gets a tinge of browning but inside is still raw - about 1 minute. Step 8: Add the cabbage, carrot, and the white pieces of shallots (i.e. from the base of the stalk). Stir fry for 1 1/2 minutes until the cabbage is mostly wilted. Step 9: Add the noodles, Sauce and water*. Stir fry for 1 minute, tossing constantly. Step 10: Add bean sprouts and remaining shallots/scallions. Toss through for 30 seconds or until the bean sprouts just start to wilt. Step 11: Remove from heat and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, light soy sauce, sugar, cornflour, chili sauce, vermicelli rice noodles, peanut oil, red chile, spring onions, dark soy sauce, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Mix pork with light soy, sugar, cornflour and chilli sauce and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 2: Soak noodles in warm water for 15 minutes until soft, drain. Step 3: Heat oil in wok, add fresh chilli and spring onions, then pork and its marinade, stirring well. Step 4: When meat starts to brown add the drained noodles and stir well. Step 5: Add dark soy sauce and chicken stock / water and continue to cook for around 10 minutes until the noodles absorb all the liquid This looks lovely served in a lettuce leaf cup!

Dish Name: Classical Chinese Fried Rice Yang Zhou Chao Fan
Ingredient Names: rice, eggs, cantonese roast pork, shrimp, fresh coriander leaves, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, salt, oil, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Break up the lumps in the cooked rice Dice roast pork, beat eggs. Step 2: Heat iron wok till smoking hot Swirl a ladle of cold oil in the wok to coat the inside evenly, pour off the oil. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp oil to wok. Step 4: Pour the beaten egg into the hot wok Before the eggs are completely set, put in the rice, then the roast pork and the fresh coriander. Step 5: Toss and turn the rice very quickly for about ten seconds with spatula.

Ingredient Names: chili oil, black soy sauce, cider vinegar, granulated sugar, kosher salt, oranges, thin egg noodles, sesame oil, bean sprouts, carrots, scallions, cilantro, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce: Combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a blender and puree for thirty seconds. Step 2: Place sauce in a jar and keep, covered, in the fridge For the noodles: Cook noodles according to package directions until al dente. Step 3: Remove from boiling water and shock in ice water and drain again. Step 4: Toss noodles with sesame oil Blanch bean sprouts in boiling water and shock them in ice water. Step 5: When ready to serve: Place noodles in bowl and toss with 1 / 4 cup of chili-orange sauce.

Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, dark sesame oil, peanut oil, green onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red chili paste, lime, brown sugar, creamy peanut butter, rice vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, hot water, toasted sesame seeds, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles in large pot of boiling unsalted water over medium heat until barely tender and still firm, about 3 minutes. Step 2: Drain immediately and rinse with cold water until cold. Step 3: Drain the noodles really well and transfer to a wide bowl. Step 4: Toss with the sesame oil so they don't stick together In the same pot, heat the peanut oil over medium low heat Addd green onions, ginger, garlic, and chile paste. Step 5: Cook, stirring, until vegetables are softened, only about a minute or so. Step 6: Then stir in brown sugar, peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, and hot water. Step 7: Stir until the sugar has dissolved and peanut butter is smooth. Step 8: Toss noodles back into pan and coat with sauce.

Dish Name: Cold Sesame Noodles With Shredded Chicken
Ingredient Names: toasted sesame seeds, creamy peanut butter, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, rice vinegar, hot sauce, light brown sugar, hot water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, fresh chinese noodles, sesame oil, scallions, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: First, make the shredded chicken. Step 2: Boil 4 qts Of water with one tablespoon of salt. Step 3: When the water reaches a boil, add the chicken and cook for about 20-25 minutes. Step 4: Pour out the water and allow the chicken to cool on a cutting board or in a bowl If you are unable to find toasted sesame seeds, toast the sesame seeds in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until golden and fragrant, about 10 minutes Reserve 1 tablespoon sesame seeds in a small bowl. Step 5: In a blender or small food processor, puree the remaining 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, peanut butter, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, hot sauce, and sugar until smooth, about 30 seconds With the machine running, add hot water 1 tablespoon at a time until the sauce has the consistency of heavy cream, about 5 tablespoons. Step 6: Set the mixture aside.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, garlic cloves, gingerroot, rice, water chestnuts, ham, carrot, frozen peas, green onion, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 12-inch skillet. Step 2: Add eggs Tilt skillet so eggs form about a 6-inch pancake. Step 3: Cook until set spooning oil over eggs where necessary to set edges. Step 4: Remove from skillet with a spatula, cool, cut into strips. Step 5: Add 3 tablespoons oil to skillet. Step 6: Saute garlic and ginger, add rice.

Ingredient Names: bacon, mushrooms, green onions, garlic, light cream, cream cheese, fresh basil, thyme, salt, pepper, tomatoes, wide egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp, remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels then crumble. Step 2: Pour off all but 2 tbls of the bacon fat, add mushrooms and cook over high heat until they begin to brown. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium low, add green onion and garlic, cook and stir 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Add cream, cream cheese, basil, thyme and bacon, reduce heat to low and stir until cheese melts and sauce is smooth. Step 5: Add tomato, season with salt and pepper, pour over hot noodles and serve.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, water chestnuts, green onion, low sodium soy sauce, salt, cornstarch, fresh gingerroot, wonton skins
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork, water chestnuts, green onions, soy sauce, salt, cornstarch and ginger in a medium bowl, mix well. Step 2: Place a half teaspoon of the pork mixture in center of each wonton skin. Step 3: Fold wonton skin over filling to form a triangle. Step 4: Turn top of triangle down to meet fold. Step 5: Turn over Moisten one corner with water Overlap opposite corner over moistened corner, press firmly. Step 6: Heat oil in wok or large saucepan over medium-high heat to 375f / 190c.

Dish Name: Dan Dan Mian Sichuan Spicy Noodles
Ingredient Names: pork, dark soy sauce, garlic, ginger, onions, peanut butter, chili oil, sesame oil, szechuan peppercorns, salt, chicken stock, udon noodles, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork and soy sauce in a small bowl and mix well. Step 2: Heat a wok or large skillet until hot. Step 3: Stir-fry, stirring with a spatula to break it into small pieces. Step 4: When the pork is lightly browned, about 3 minutes, remove and set aside. Step 5: Bring a large pot of water to boil While the water is heating, go to the next step Reheat the wok and stir-fry the garlic, ginger, and onions until aromatic, about 1 minute. Step 6: Add peanut butter, soy sauce, chilli oil, sesame oil, sichuan pepper, salt, and chicken stock and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, when the pot of water has come to boil, toss in noodles and cook according to package directions, drain well.

Dish Name: Deborah Lee's Egg Flower Jewel Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken-flavored ramen noodles, frozen mixed vegetables, chicken broth, chicken flavored bullion cubes, pepper, eggs, sesame oil, cornstarch, water, salt, chinese noodles, baby shrimp, chicken breast, imitation crabmeat, tofu
Instructions: Step 1: Crush the ramen noodles into small pieces and set aside. Step 2: Beat the eggs with the sesame oil and set aside. Step 3: Mix the cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup water and set aside. Step 4: In a large saucepan, add 6 cups broth or water and the frozen vegetables, bring to a boil. Step 5: Add the crushed noodles and the broth packet and buillion cubes and boil for an additional 3 minutes At this point add any additional optional ingredients you might be using then return to the boil. Step 6: Pour in the eggs and stir the soup This will make the egg drops. Step 7: Return to the boil.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, soy sauce, bacon, oil, onion, scallion, celery, chicken breast, pork, egg, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Add soy sauce to rice. Step 2: Add more if you desire, less if you want In fry pan add bacon and fry. Step 3: When cooked remove from pan. Step 4: Add oil to bacon grease. Step 5: Add meat to oil and cook until almost done. Step 6: Add onions, scallions and celery. Step 7: Fry until lightly browned, add peas.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, vegetable oil, diced onions, chicken, eggs, salt, msg, soya sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the egg, like a pancake, when cooled, dice, set aside. Step 2: Heat up the wok with the vegetable oil. Step 3: When a light haze forms over the oil, sprinkle the salt over the entire wok surface Carefully add the onions and diced meat. Step 4: Stir-fry for a minute If using green onions, leave them out in this step. Step 5: Add the cooled rice, mixing well, turning the rice over continually until all is heated through. Step 6: Sprinkle soya sauce over the rice--mixing until the rice is all the same desired colour.

Ingredient Names: oil, green onions, thumb-size ginger, chinese cabbage, water chestnuts discs, remaining meat from roast duck, soy sauce, egg noodles following instructions, fresh coriander, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok. Step 2: Throw in the spring onions and ginger, cook for 1 min, then add the cabbage. Step 3: Stir-fry until wilted, then add the water chestnuts and duck, and stir quickly to heat them through. (You can leave the recipe at this point, then finish it off just before serving if you prefer.). Step 4: Add the soy sauce (and heat everything through if you are finishing off at the last minute) and noodles, and toss everything together. Step 5: Tip onto a platter and keep warm while you eat the duck pancakes. Step 6: Sprinkle with coriander and drizzle over some reserved duck juices (if you have them) and a little sesame oil just before serving.

Ingredient Names: duck, chicken consomme, water, soy sauce, mirin, garlic cloves, onion, cinnamon stick, star anise, szechwan pepper, garlic clove, cinnamon, green onions, bean sprouts, cooked noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ingredients of the marinade, and add the breast fillets and legs. Step 2: Refrigerate overnight To make the stock, put carcass portions and other stock ingredients into a large saucepan. Step 3: Add water to cover and bring to the boil. Step 4: Simmer gently for 45 minutes. Step 5: Strain, return stock to a clean pot and reduce over medium heat for 15 minutes. Step 6: Remove any remaining meat from the carcass and reserve. Step 7: Cool reduced stock, and refrigerate overnight. Step 8: When stock is cold, skim fat from the surface The stock is ready for use.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, vegetable oil, eggs, green onions, carrot, green peas, red bell pepper, sesame oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Step 3: Cook ramen noodles, reserving seasoning packets, in boiling water until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Drain noodles and set aside. Step 5: Heat vegetable oil in a small skillet. Step 6: Cook and stir beaten eggs in hot oil until scrambled and firm, set aside. Step 7: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat. Step 8: Add green onions into hot oil and stir fry until softened, 2 to. Step 9: Remove green onions to a plate; set aside. Step 10: Heat remaining vegetable oil in the same wok or skillet over medium heat. Step 11: Add carrots, peas, and bell pepper separately; stir frying until softened, removing each to the plate with green onions when done. Step 12: Combine sesame oil with remaining vegetable oil in the same skillet or a wok over medium heat. Step 13: Stir fry cooked noodles in hot sesame-vegetable oil, tossing frequently, until golden, 3 to. Step 14: Season with desired amounts of sesame oil, soy sauce, and reserved ramen seasoning packets; toss to coat. Step 15: Stir in cooked vegetables, tossing frequently, until heated through, about 5 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, sesame oil, egg, soy sauce, stir fry vegetables, cooked rice, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: 1 tbsp oil in a skillet and stir fry onion until it is golden but not burnt. Step 2: Put onions to the side of the skillet. Step 3: Add eggs to skillet and fry until fluffy, remove eggs from skillet. Step 4: Add the extra oil to skillet then add veggies and rice, tossing to get everything mixed. Step 5: Add egg back to skillet then sprinkle the rice with soy sauce and enjoy.

Dish Name: Easy Peasy Ham And Egg Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: cooked long-grain rice, eggs, sesame oil, nut oil, salt, black pepper, bean sprouts, water chestnuts, spring onions, frozen peas, ham, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare your ingredients by slicing the water chestnuts, chopping the spring onions and ham. Step 2: Then arrange your ingredients on a plate or in bowls ready This makes it easier when coming to the actual stir frying section as you can just grab your ingredients. Step 3: Beat the eggs together with the sesame oil and set aside. Step 4: Place your wok over a high heat and add the groundnut oil. Step 5: Heat until very hot. Step 6: Add the cooked rice and stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the ham, peas, salt, pepper and soy sauce. Step 8: Then stir fry for another minute or two. Step 9: Add the beaten egg and sesame oil mix and stir through.

Ingredient Names: low salt vegetable stock, ginger, garlic, soy sauce sugar, leftover chicken, mixed vegetables, straight-to-wok noodles, green onions, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Put stock, ginger, garlic, soy sauce and sugar in a saucepan, then heat. Simmer for 5 mins. Take off the heat, pour into a microwave-safe bowl, then cool. Throw in chicken and veg, cover, then chill for up to a day. Step 2: When ready to eat, remove from fridge, then add the cooked noodles. Microwave on High for 2 mins, stir, then cook for 1 min more or until piping hot. Divide between two bowls or mugs, sprinkle with spring onions and add the lime juice.

Ingredient Names: cooked long-grain rice, bacon, oil, onion, green onions, celery, mushrooms, green pepper, garlic cloves, egg, soya sauce, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, deep skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain on a paper towel-lined plate and discard some of the bacon fat. Step 3: Keep 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings. Step 4: Return the skillet to the stove and turn the heat to medium high. Step 5: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the bacon fat. Step 6: Add the onion, the celery, 1 / 2 of the green onions and cook for 4 minutes. Step 7: Add the garlic, green pepper and mushrooms. Step 8: Cook another 3 minutes. Step 9: Add the cooked rice, soya sauce and stir to coat, stir together.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, dark soy sauce, water, hot sauce, spaghetti, salt, vegetable oil, eggs, chicken breasts, pork chops, black pepper, ground coriander, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together sauce ingredients and reserve. Step 2: Bring pasta water to a boil, salt water and cook spaghetti to al dente While pasta is cooking, heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large, nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 3: When oil ripples, add beaten eggs and scramble them to light golden brown. Step 4: Remove and reserve. Step 5: Season the meat with salt, pepper and coriander. Step 6: Heat the remaining vegetable oil to a ripple, then add meat and stir-fry for 4 minutes Push meat to the side and add ginger, garlic and veggies. Step 7: Stir-fry veggies for 2 minutes. Step 8: Drain and add pasta and eggs to the skillet.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, vegetable oil, pasta, fresh spinach leaves, soy sauce, sherry wine, sesame oil, scallion, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Mix dressing and set aside In wok over high heat, stir-fry pork in oil just until lightly browned. Step 2: Toss pork strips with dressing. Step 3: Toss pasta with spinach, top with pork strips. Step 4: Garnish with chopped green onion and almond slices, if desired.

Ingredient Names: water, egg noodles, olive oil, bean sprouts, bamboo shoot, carrot, dried shiitake mushroom, green onions, salt, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot on high heat, bring 10 cups of water to boil. Step 2: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender or al-dente, approximately 5 - 7 minutes, drain and set aside. Step 3: Heat a nonstick wok or pan over high heat. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 tablespoon oil, swirling to coat the pan, add noodles and pan-fry until noodles are golden, about 7 to 10 minutes. Step 5: Remove noodles from wok. Step 6: Add remaining 1 / 2 tablespoon oil to wok, add vegetables, and stir-fry until just cooked, about 5 to 7 minutes. Step 7: Return noodles to the wok, add salt, sugar and soy sauce. Step 8: Stir to combine and serve.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, oil, eggs, garlic cloves, carrot, red bell pepper, scallions, frozen peas, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: If you're making fresh rice for this, take a Finely chop the garlic, bell pepper, and scallions, grate the carrot. Step 2: Heat a large non-stick skillet over high heat. Step 3: Add about half the oil to the center. Step 4: Add the eggs and quickly scramble, then push them off to the edges. Step 5: Add the rest of the oil to the center of the skillet. Step 6: Add the garlic, carrot, bell pepper and scallions, and quick-fry them for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the rice, combine with the veggies, then incorporate the scrambled eggs and fry for another 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the peas and soy sauce and fry for 1 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rice, bacon, eggs, meat, green onions, fresh bean sprout, mushrooms, salt, black pepper, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon til lightly browned but not crunchy and set aside. Step 2: Add beaten eggs to bacon drippings and scramble. Step 3: Remove and chop very fine. Step 4: Add cooked rice and fry for approximately 5 minutes stirring constantly then add remaining ingredients. Step 5: Mix well and continue cooking for 10 minutes longer, serve piping hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cabbage, carrots, onion, gingerroot, garlic clove, cooked white rice, eggs, water, cooked turkey, soy sauce, black pepper, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat about 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet. Step 2: Add cabbage, carrot, onion, ginger and garlic and stir fry about 5 to 7 minutes or until tender crisp. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl to keep warm. Step 4: Heat remaining 2 tbsp oil in the same skillet and add the rice and meat slivers, cook stirring constantly about 2 to 5 minutes or until hot. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and push the rice out to the edge of the pan to make a large well, pour in the eggs. Step 6: Cook 2 or 3 minutes without stirring until almost set With a spoon or other utensil, break the eggs into small pieces and mix into the rice. Step 7: Return the vegetables to the pan, season with black pepper and add the soy sauce. Step 8: Toss about 1 or 2 minutes to heat through.

Dish Name: Fried Rice For The Rice Cooker
Ingredient Names: rice, chicken broth, water chestnut, mixed mushrooms, bean sprouts, egg, soy sauce, red chili paste, carrots, onion, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter over medium heat in a medium-sized skillet. Step 2: Add onion and carrot and stir until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add rice and cook another 5 minutes until browned. Step 4: Add rice mixture and remaining ingredients to rice cooker, set to cook. Step 5: Beat egg in small bowl Wipe out sauce pan and cook egg on medium low heat. Step 6: Chop egg and set aside. Step 7: When rice is done, add egg and stir, then let sit for 5-10 minutes, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: frozen peas, onion, carrot, bell pepper, cooked rice, parsley flakes, olive oil, eggs, soy sauce, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: --- freezing day --- In a large bowl, combine the peas and carrots, rice, onion and parsley flakes, mix well. Step 2: Pour into 2 quart size freezer bags Seal, lable and freeze --- serving day --- Thaw bag of rice mixture overnight in fridge or run warm water over bag. Step 3: Heat 2 tsp oil in a large skillet Dump rice mixture into the skillet. Step 4: Cook and stir over medium heat, breaking up any chunks of rice, until hot, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, vegetable oil, egg, raw shrimp, ham, dry sherry, light soy sauce, frozen peas, yellow onions, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: The rice should be smoothed out to get rid of any lumps Day old, cold rice works best If using eggs, lightly beat them with a pinch of salt. Step 2: Heat a little oil in your wok, pour eggs in and tilt the wok back and forth to spread evenly Lift the edges to let the uncooked portion come in contact with the hot pan so it cooks evenly. Step 3: After the eggs set up a little, lightly scramble them so you have medium small pieces. Step 4: Remove eggs to a bowl Wipe out wok If adding raw shrimp, heat a little more oil and stir fry them to just cook, remove to a bowl.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, green onions, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, fresh gingerroot, red pepper, pepperoni, frozen peas, soy sauce, cooked long-grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a little of the oil in a wok or large skillet. Step 2: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 3: Heat the remaining oil in the pan and stir-fry the chicken, garlic, ginger and pepper over a high heat for 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the pepperoni, peas, onions, rice and eggs and continue to cook, stirring, for a further 3-4 minutes until piping hot, season with the soy sauce and serve.

Ingredient Names: white rice, soy sauce, water, white pepper powder, ginger, oysters, chinese rice wine, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and drain. Step 2: In a measuring cup, add soy sauce first and then water until it reaches 1 2 / 3 cups. Step 3: Pour the water mixture into rice Continue to add white pepper powder and ginger, combine well. Step 4: Cover and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 5: Place oysters on top of the rice. Step 6: Sprinkle rice wine over the oysters. Step 7: Cook in a rice cooker. Step 8: When the rice cooker switches to the "warm" setting, let rice rest in it for 10 minutes before uncovering.

Ingredient Names: cellophane noodles, vegetable oil, onion, carrots, fresh ginger, chicken stock, water, ham, watercress leaf, mushroom, snow peas, oriental sesame oil, rice vinegar, green onions, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put cellophane noodles in large bowl. Step 2: Cover with boiling water. Step 3: Let stand 5 minutes, drain thoroughly. Step 4: Heat oil in wok or deep large skillet over medium high heat. Step 5: Add onion and carrots and stir fry 3 minutes. Step 6: Add garlic and ginger stir fry 30 seconds. Step 7: Add stock, water and soy sauce. Step 8: Cover and boil 2 minutes. Step 9: Add ham water cress, mushrooms and noodles.

Ingredient Names: egg noodles, couple dashes sesame oil, groundnut oil, finger-length ginger, shiitake mushrooms, green onions, oyster sauce, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles according to pack instructions, then toss with a little sesame oil to stop them sticking. Step 2: Heat a wok over a high heat, then add the groundnut oil. Once it’s smoking, add the ginger, stir-fry for a couple of secs, then add the mushrooms with a splash of water to create steam, and cook for 1 min. Toss through the cooked noodles for 2 mins until hot, then add the spring onions, oyster and soy sauces, and a dash more sesame oil.

Dish Name: Ground Pork Peas And Rice Casserole
Ingredient Names: long-grain rice, water, fresh peas, peanut oil, ground pork, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice wine, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Add rice and water to a large, heavy saucepan and bring to a boil Continue boiling for 10 minutes, or until most of the surface liquid has evaporated The surface of the rice will be uneven and look like a pitted crater At this stage, cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid and set the heat to low. Step 2: Meanwhile, prepare the rest of the dish If you went the fresh peas route, blanch them in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain, and set aside Otherwise, thaw frozen peas at room temperature. Step 3: Add the oil to a heated wok or skillet. Step 4: Add the pork and stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the peas, soy sauces, oyster sauce, and rice wine Continue to cook for another 2 minutes, then add the green onions.

Dish Name: Guy Fieri's Bbq Pork Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, oyster sauce, fresh ginger, garlic, sesame oil, pork tenderloin, sweet and sour sauce, canola oil, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, red onion, green cabbage, snap peas, carrot, celery
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, oyster sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil in a medium bowl, add pork. Step 2: Cover and marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Step 3: Heat grill to medium-high, and grill pork on both sides until done. Step 4: Heat remaining marinade to 165 degrees f and use to baste meat as it cooks. Step 5: When meat is almost cooked through, glaze both sides with sweet and sour sauce and let finish cooking while sauce caramelizes on meat. Step 6: Remove from grill and allow to stand for 10 minutes While pork is standing, heat oil in wok or large skillet on high heat until oil almost begins to smoke. Step 7: Add ginger and all vegetables except garlic. Step 8: Cook for 3 minutes, or until vegetables are cooked, then add garlic.

Ingredient Names: onion, eggs, instant rice, water, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, olive oil, butter, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-cook the rice in a medium large pot with the water on medium heat Normally you should use equal amounts of rice and water, but since we are going to fry it in a bit, i cook it a little dry so it doesn't get all mushy before its done Just remember to stir often and keep a close eye on it. Step 2: Once it absorbs all the water, take it off of the heat so it doesn't stick and scorch in the pan It's precooked! Step 3: Place your wok on the stove and turn the heat on medium high Coat the entire inside surface of the wok with olive oil & butter, and add enough to cover the bottom about a 1 / 4 of an inch. Step 4: Once the oil is starting to get good and hot, toss in the pre-cooked rice. Step 5: Let this sizzle and stir for a moment, and then make a well in the bottom for the onions, garlic, and eggs. Step 6: Add a little oil if needed.

Dish Name: Hot And Spicy Szechuan Noodles Dan Dan Mian
Ingredient Names: szechuan peppercorns, peanut oil, ground pork, chicken stock, pickled radishes, soy sauce, black vinegar, garlic, sesame oil, chili oil, white pepper, udon noodles, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over low heat and dry-fry the szechuan peppercorns for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Step 2: Add the peanut oil and cook over low heat for 10 minutes to infuse it with the flavour of the peppercorns. Step 3: Cool, then strain the oil into a saucepan, discarding the peppercorns. Step 4: Add the chicken stock, preserved radish, soy sauce, black vinegar, garlic, sesame oil, chili oil and white pepper to the peppercorn oil in the saucepan. Step 5: Keep warm over medium heat. Step 6: Meanwhile, either soak udon noodles for a few minutes in hot water, drain and add to stock mixture, or cook wheat noodles for 2 minutes in boiling water, drain and add to mixture. Step 7: Heat the extra oil in wok over high heat and stir fry the pork til brown and crispy, about 3-5 minutes. Step 8: Divide noodle / broth mixture into four soup bowls, top with the pork and garnish with spring onion Eat, slurp and make appreciative noises at will!

Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, pork tenderloin, soy sauce, fresh orange juice, balsamic vinegar, honey, cornstarch, pepper, vegetable oil cooking spray, sweet red pepper, yellow sweet pepper, hot pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork & 1 tbsp soy, stir well & set aside. Step 2: Combine the remaining soy, juice, vinegar, honey & cornstartch. Step 3: Stir well Spray a skillet and over high heat stir fry the pork until browned. Step 4: Remove pork from skillet. Step 5: Stir fry the peppers for 2 minutes. Step 6: Return pork to skillet & add juice mixture. Step 7: Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly, add noodles. Step 8: Cook until heated through.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, cooked rice, vidalia onions, char siu pork, garlic clove, frozen peas, eggs, ground turmeric, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large flat-bottomed wok or 12-inch skillet, heat oil. Step 2: Add onion and chopped pork and cook over high heat, stirring, until pork browns and onions just start to caramelize. Step 3: Add garlic, cooking briefly. Step 4: Stir in crumbled and separated rice along with peas. Step 5: Cook over medium heat, stirring for several minutes The rice is going to stick a little anyway- but if it sticks a lot, add some oil to loosen it up. Step 6: Beat eggs with turmeric in a small bowl. Step 7: Make an open space or well in the center of the rice in the pan. Step 8: Pour in the eggs, and allow to cook a little before stirring Do not mix in the rice until the eggs are about 75% set, then just stir to blend until the rice is nice and yellow.

Dish Name: Jasmine Rice With Garlic Ginger And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, low sodium chicken broth, salt, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place rice in large sieve. Step 2: Rinse under cold running water until water runs clear, drain. Step 3: Heat oil in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add ginger and garlic. Step 5: Stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add rice and stir 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in broth and salt. Step 8: Sprinkle cilantro over, bring to boil.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, carrots, green onion, baby bella mushrooms, garlic cloves, ginger, soy sauce, dry sherry, cooked brown rice, boneless chicken breasts, boneless pork chops, frozen green pea, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: In a 6-quart nonstick wok or 6-quart le creuset pot, heat the wok / pot over medium-high heat, and then heat oil until glistening. Step 2: Add 1st bowl, and stir-fry over medium-high heat until softened, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Add 2nd bowl and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 4: Add soy sauce and 3rd bowl Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add 4th bowl, and mix Push the fried rice to the outer edge of the wok or pot to create a well. Step 6: Pour the slightly beaten eggs into the well, and cook, stirring gently, until nearly set. Step 7: Toss rice and eggs together Portion fried rice in bowls and garnish with the reserved 1 tablespoon of scallion greens.

Ingredient Names: oil, kielbasa, water, chinese vegetables, soy sauce, cornstarch, cooked white rice, chow mein noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Saute kielbasa in oil over medium high heat until lightly browned. Step 2: Add water and frozen vegetables, cook separating vegetables with a fork until defrosted. Step 3: Reduce heat, add soy and cook 4-5 minutes. Step 4: Mix cornstarch and water, add to the pan and cook, stirring constantly for about 3 minutes. Step 5: Serve over rice and top with chow mein noodles.

Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, rice wine vinegar, dark sesame oil, soy sauce, toasted sesame seeds, fresh ginger, kosher salt, scallions, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions. Step 2: Drain and rinse under cold running water. Step 3: Transfer the noodles to a large bowl. Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, oil, soy sauce, sesame seeds, ginger, salt, scallion, and, if using, red pepper. Step 5: Remove the noodles from the refrigerator and mix with the sesame mixture until well coated. Step 6: Serve cold or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, red onion, gingerroot, boneless chicken thighs, white sugar, dry sherry, steamed rice, bean sprouts, green onion, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a hot wok, until surface seems to shimmer slightly. Step 2: Pour beaten eggs into wok and leave to cook on the base of the wok for 10 seconds before folding egg mixture over onto itself with a spatula and lightly scrambling for about 1 minute or until almost cooked through Carefully remove omelette from wok with a spatula and drain on paper towel, set aside. Step 3: Heat remaining oil in the hot wok and stir-fry onion and ginger for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add chicken and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in sugar and cook, stirring, for 20 seconds. Step 6: Add sherry and stir-fry for a further 20 seconds. Step 7: Toss in reserved omelette along with remaining ingredients, except cilantro and garnish. Step 8: Stir-fry, using a spatula to break up the egg into smaller pieces, for about 2 minutes or until will combined and rice is heated through.

Ingredient Names: linguine, dark sesame oil, scallions, flat leaf parsley, sesame seeds, tahini, water, lemon juice, soy sauce, ginger, chili paste, lemons, sugar, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Make dressing: Add tahini into bowl and gradually add boiling water until smooth. Step 3: Add remaining dressing ingredients and whisk until combined. Step 4: Dressing can be made ahead and refrigerated for up to 3-4 days. Step 5: Boil pasta until just tender (about 7 minutes). Step 6: Drain pasta and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking. Step 7: Transfer to serving bowl and drizzle with sesame oil. Step 8: Toss to coat evenly. Step 9: Add the dressing and mix well. Step 10: Sprinkle with scallions, parsley, and toasted sesame seeds. Step 11: Refrigerate or serve at room temperature.

Dish Name: Lillian's Spring Onion And Ginger Noodles
Ingredient Names: thin egg noodles, peanut oil, sesame oil, fresh ginger, scallions, salt, fresh ground white pepper, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles in a large pot of boiling water, allowing 3 minutes for fresh noodles and 5 minutes for dried. Step 2: Drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, and toss them with a little sesame oil, set them aside. Step 3: Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Step 4: Add the two oils and, when very hot, add the ginger. Step 5: Stir-fry for 10 seconds. Step 6: Add the scallions and stir-fry for 30 seconds longer. Step 7: Remove from the heat and mix in the noodles. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper and finally add the oyster sauce, mix well.

Dish Name: Lo Bak Go Chinese Radish Cakes
Ingredient Names: dried shrimp, dried shiitake mushrooms, water, chinese radishes, rice flour, salt, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the shrimp and mushrooms in the boiling water Peel and grate the radish directly into the chicken stock. Step 2: Simmer for about 15 minutes. Step 3: Drain the chicken stock from the lo bok, and the soaking water from the shrimp and mushrooms, and reserve them both Mince the shrimp and the shiitake. Step 4: Add the combined stock and soaking water slowly to the rice flour, stirring constantly, to make a batter of medium viscosity. Step 5: Season with salt, if required, and a little pepper. Step 6: Mix the lo bak, shrimp and shiitake into it, and put it in a large sauce pan. Step 7: Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture begins to thicken. Step 8: Pour it into an oiled 10" square cake pan, and cover it tightly in foil.

Dish Name: Lu Rou Fan Taiwanese Stewed Pork With Hard Boiled Eggs
Ingredient Names: pork, shallots, garlic cloves, shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, rice vinegar, dark soy sauce, water, star anise, chinese five spice powder, cinnamon, ginger, eggs, scallion, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into small cubes. Step 2: Chop shallots and mince garlic. Step 3: Saute pork until brown. Step 4: Remove meat and saute the shallot and garlic on medium-high heat until lightly brown. Step 5: Remove and saute mushrooms. Step 6: Add everything back into the pan, including the soy sauce, rice vinegar, dark soy sauce, water and spices. Step 7: Simmer for about 60 minutes or until tender. Step 8: Add the eggs during the last 10-15 minutes. Step 9: Garnish with chopped scallion and sliced hard cooked eggs.

Dish Name: Ma Yi Shang Shu Szechuan Pork With Cellophane Noodles
Ingredient Names: ground pork, cornstarch, light soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, bean thread vermicelli, vegetable oil, scallions, garlic clove, ginger, chili bean sauce, chicken broth, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork, cornstarch, 1 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoons rice wine, and 1 / 2 teaspoons sesame oil in a bowl. Step 2: Marinate for at least 30 minutes. Step 3: Place noodles in a bowl, cover with boiling water, and soak for 3-5 minutes, then drain well. Step 4: Heat a wok over high heat, and add the vegetable oil. Step 5: Cook the four chopped scallions, ginger, garlic, and chilli bean sauce for about 10 seconds. Step 6: Add the meat mixture and cook for two more minutes, making sure to stir to break up any lumps. Step 7: Stir in the stock, sugar, and the remaining soy sauce, rice wine, and sesame oil. Step 8: Add the noodles to the wok and toss to combine. Step 9: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simme for 7-8 minutes. Step 10: Garnish with the remaining scallions and serve.

Ingredient Names: sugar, fish sauce, lime, olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, eggs, cooked long-grain rice, green bell pepper, corn kernel, chorizo sausage, green olives
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine the sugar, asian fish sauce, and lime juice and stir until the sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or heavy frying pan over high heat. Step 3: Add the garlic and onion and saut for 3 minutes, or until the onion starts to turn translucent. Step 4: Pour in the eggs and scramble until they are just set, and then immediately toss in the rice and stir until well mixed Decrease the heat to medium and add the bell pepper, corn, chorizo sausage, olives, and the sugar mixture, and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 5: Remove the wok from the heat and let rest for 4 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, cornstarch, water, bamboo shoots, sliced water chestnuts, fresh broccoli, shiitake mushrooms, oil, garlic, steamed rice, sake, soy sauce, frozen orange juice concentrate, ginger, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients for marinade in a shallow dish. Step 2: Slice pork at an angle in thin medallions and add to marinade, tossing to coat. Step 3: Allow meat to marinate for at least 30 minutes at room temperature or several hours refrigerated. Step 4: Mix together sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Step 5: Mix together cornstarch with the 3 tbsp water in a shallow dish and set aside. Step 6: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in wok on med-high heat and add the 4 cloves of minced garlic. Step 7: Allow garlic to sizzle briefly, then add pork, and stir-fry for approximately 3 minutes. Step 8: Remove pork from wok using a slotted spoon and leave any meat juices in the pan. Step 9: Add broccoli to the wok with the pan juices and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 10: Add mushrooms to the wok along with 1 / 2 tbsp of oil and stir-fry for another minute.

Ingredient Names: linguine, chicken, cornstarch, light soy sauce, sherry wine, garlic, chicken broth, oyster sauce, sesame oil, green onion, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Par boil linguine noodles for about 3 minute. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and drain. Step 3: Marinate chicken for 15 minute in 1 t cornstarch 1 t light soy sauce and 1 t sherry Have a pot of hot water ready, heat wok. Step 4: Add 2 t vegetable oil and reheat. Step 5: Add garlic Brown and discard. Step 6: Add chicken with marinade. Step 7: Stir until 3 / 4 done.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, white wine, sesame oil, cornstarch, pork tenderloin, dried shiitake mushrooms, green onions, garlic, fresh ginger, napa cabbage, white sugar, ground black pepper, vegetable oil, eggs, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Place soy sauce, white wine, sesame oil, and cornstarch in a non-reactive bowl; stir until smooth. Step 3: Stir pork into marinade until thoroughly coated; refrigerate for to an hour. Step 4: Meanwhile, pour hot water over mushrooms in a bowl; set aside to soften for 15 to. Step 5: Drain mushrooms; pat dry, remove any hard stem pieces, and finely chop. Step 6: Combine mushrooms, green onions, garlic, and ginger in a bowl; set aside. Step 7: Remove outer leaves from napa cabbage; tear green leafy portions from the central stalks of the leaves. Step 8: Slice stalks into thin 1-inch pieces. Step 9: Finely chop green leafy portions, and set aside the sliced stems and chopped leaves in separate bowls. Step 10: Combine soy sauce, white wine, cornstarch, sugar, and ground black pepper in a small bowl; set aside. Step 11: Heat vegetable oil and sesame oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 12: Add marinated pork; cook and stir until cooked through and edges have begun to brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 13: Transfer pork to a bowl. Step 14: Pour beaten eggs into the hot wok, adding more vegetable oil if necessary; cook and stir until eggs are scrambled, firm, and well-broken up, about 5 minutes. Step 15: Stir in mushroom mixture; cook and stir 1 to. Step 16: Add napa cabbage stem pieces; cook and stir until hot but still crunchy, about 5 minutes. Step 17: Add chopped cabbage leaves and white wine; cook and stir until hot, about 10 minutes. Step 18: Add cooked pork and reserved cornstarch mixture. Step 19: Stir everything together until slightly thickened and hot, about 15-20 minutes. Step 20: Mix hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a small bowl until thoroughly combined. Step 21: To serve, spread about hoisin mixture on each pancake, top with about the pork mixture, roll, and serve.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh mushrooms, onion, cooked pork, cooked rice, light soy sauce, eggs, green onions, fresh parsley, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add mushrooms and onions, and cook until beginning to soften, stirring or tossing several times. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-high, add pork or shrimp, and continue cooking for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add rice and soy sauce. Step 5: Stir to combine, and continue cooking for about 5 minutes, stirring or tossing several times. Step 6: Make a well in center of rice, add eggs, and cook until partially set, stirring just the egg portion of the mixture. Step 7: When mostly set, stir into the rice, breaking up the eggs. Step 8: Add green onions, parsley, and pepper, and continue cooking, tossing or stirring regularly, until heated. Step 9: Season to taste with more soy sauce or salt as desired.

Ingredient Names: bacon, green onion, red bell pepper, green peas, egg, cooked rice, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon in wok until crisp. Step 2: Add green onions, red peppers and peas stir fry 1 minute. Step 3: Add egg and scramble. Step 4: Stir in rice and cook until heated, gently separating grains, add soy sauce. Step 5: Cook until heated through. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: noodles, green onions, fresh ginger, lite olive oil, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put noodles in 8 cups of rapidly boiling water, cook for 3 minutes, stir occasioally. Step 2: Drain and rinse noodles under cold water for 1 minute until they are cold. Step 3: Drain well and let them dry. Step 4: Mix oyster sauce, lite soy, dark soy and sesame oil. Step 5: Heat wok to medium heat, add olive oil.
