Step 6: When oil is hot stir fry green onions and ginger for a few seconds until soft. Step 7: Add noodles and stir fry for 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 8: Pour in premixed sauces, stir fry until well mixed. Step 9: Serve hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, vinegar, garlic cloves, water, noodles, cucumber, peanuts, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together peanut butter, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, vinegar, and garlic in a medium sized bowl. Step 2: Stir in water to desired consistency. Step 3: Stir until smooth, which may take a little while. Step 4: Drizzle peanut sauce on noodles. Step 5: Garnish with cucumber, crushed peanuts, and hot oil or sriracha if desired.

Dish Name: Noodles with turkey, green beans & hoisin
Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, green beans, hoisin sauce, limes, chili sauce, vegetable oil, turkey ground meat, garlic, green onions diagonally
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the noodles following pack instructions, adding the green beans for the final 2 mins. Drain and set aside. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix together the hoisin, lime juice and chilli sauce. In a wok or frying pan, heat the oil, then fry the mince until nicely browned. Add the garlic and fry for 1 min more. Stir in the hoisin mixture and cook for a few mins more until sticky. Finally, stir in the noodles, beans and half the spring onions to heat through. Scatter over the remaining spring onions to serve.

Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, sesame oil, black soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, sugar, kosher salt, hot chili oil, green onions, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 2: Drain immediately in a colander and chill thoroughly under cold running water Shake off excess water, then return the noodles to a clean dry bowl. Step 3: Blend the seasonings in a small bowl. Step 4: Pour the sauce evenly over the noodles, using a handful of noodles to wipe the bowl clean so you don't lose any of the sugar. Step 5: Toss gently with your hands to separate the noodles and distribute the sauce, then add the green onions and toss again to mix Remember that the chili will grow more pronounced within a few hours, so err on the cautious side if you are not eating the noodles immediately For best flavor, cover and put aside for several hours at room temperature or store overnight in the refrigerator. Step 6: Toss before eating to redistribute the seasonings. Step 7: Garnish with green onion slices.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, scallions, sugar snap pea, fresh bean sprout, fresh mushrooms, ginger, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken broth, soy sauce, scallions, and peas in a large saucepan, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for an additional 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the bean sprouts, mushrooms, and ginger. Step 4: Simmer for 5 more minutes. Step 5: Add the cooked noodles and heat for 2-3 minutes, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: hokkien noodles, chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, peanut oil, pork tenderloin, scallions, carrots, fresh mushrooms, fresh snow pea
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and keep warm in a large serving bowl. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine chicken broth, soy sauce, and sugar. Step 4: Mix well and set aside. Step 5: In a large skillet, heat oil over high heat. Step 6: Add pork and cook until no pink remains, stirring constantly. Step 7: Add scallions, carrots, mushrooms, snow peas and the chicken broth mixture. Step 8: Stir fry 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 9: Toss with the noodles and serve.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, water, eggs, butter, frozen peas and carrot, white onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper, table salt, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: If you are using leftover, cooked white rice, skip this step and go to. Step 2: In a covered saucepan on the stove top, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Step 3: When the water reaches a full boil, stir in the rice. Step 4: Stir to bottom of pan a few times to make sure all rice is moistened and not sticking on the bottom of pan in lumps. Step 5: Return water to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to a very low simmer, place lid on pan and simmer for 20-minutes. Step 7: Place cooked rice a in large bowl. Step 8: Set aside until needed Scramble eggs in skillet on stove top with 1 tbsp of butter. Step 9: After eggs are cooked, chop the scrambled eggs into pea size bits with spatula.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, cooked beef, cooked chicken, cooked shrimp, eggs, onion, bean sprouts, carrot, peas, green onion, garlic, salt, sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oiled or sprayed wok or large pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add vegetables and garlic and cook, stirring continuously, until they are hot, but still crisp. Step 3: Add in rice, eggs, meat, and soy sauce Continue to stir and cook until hot. Step 4: Stir in sugar, salt, and pepper, serve.

Ingredient Names: kway teow, garlic, cooking oil, prawns, cockles, bean sprouts, chives, chili paste, eggs, water, light soya sauce, salt and pepper, dark soya sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix seasoning ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Heat wok with 3 tbsp oil until hot and fry chopped garlic until light brown. Step 3: Add prawns and cockles Push all the fried ingredients to one side and add in kway teow. Step 4: Stir-fry the kway teow quickly and add seasoning and chili paste. Step 5: Sprinkle with a little water and mix in all the fried ingredients together. Step 6: Spread all the ingredients around the wok to create an empty space in the centre, then crack an egg into it and add a little more oil. Step 7: Cover the egg with all the ingredients and stir-fry evenly. Step 8: Add beansprouts and chives and stir well Do not overcook.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, water, salt, butter, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan with a good fitting lid bring water, salt and optional ingredients if desired to a boil The salt and butter are simply for flavor The vinegar keeps your grains separated and gives you a prettier dish No one will taste the vinegar at all!, add rice and stir. Step 2: Cover and reduce heat to medium low You will know that your temperature is correct if a little steam is visible leaking from the lid A lot of steam means your heat is too high. Step 3: Cook for 20 minutes Do not lift lid!

Ingredient Names: ground pork, garlic, green onions, fresh ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, cayenne pepper, green cabbage, all-purpose flour, kosher salt, hot water, seasoned rice vinegar, vegetable oil for frying
Instructions: Step 1: To make the filling: Place ground pork, green onions, garlic, ginger, plus soy sauce, sesame oil, and cayenne in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Top with chopped green cabbage. Step 3: Mix with fork until thoroughly combined. Step 4: Tamp down lightly; cover with plastic. Step 5: Refrigerate until chilled, about an hour. Step 6: To make the dough: Place 2 陆 cups of flour and kosher salt in a mixing bowl. Step 7: Slowly pour in hot water. Step 8: Stir with a wooden spoon until mixture forms a shaggy dough. Step 9: Flour your hands and transfer dough to a work surface. Step 10: Knead dough until it becomes smooth and elastic, about 3 to. Step 11: If dough seems too sticky, sprinkle with a bit more flour, up to an additional, and continue to knead. Step 12: Wrap dough ball in plastic, and let it rest about 10 minutes. Step 13: When dough has rested, divide into 4 equal pieces. Step 14: Cover with a dish cloth while you work the first piece. Step 15: Roll into a small log about the thickness of a thumb, about 5 minutes. Step 16: Divide each log into 6 equal pieces. Step 17: Roll each piece into a thin 3 陆-inch circle on a lightly floured surface to form the pot sticker wrappers. Step 18: Repeat with the remaining dough pieces. Step 19: Lightly moisten the edges of a wrapper with your wet finger. Step 20: Place a small scoop of the ground pork mixture onto the center of a wrapper. Step 21: Fold up the 2 sides and pinch together in the center. Step 22: Pinch together the remaining edges, forming "pleats" along one side. Step 23: Tap the pot sticker on the work surface to slightly flatten the bottom; form a slight curve in it so it stands upright in the pan. Step 24: Transfer to a well-floured plate. Step 25: Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Step 26: To make the dipping sauce: Mix seasoned rice vinegar and soy sauce together in a small mixing bowl, set aside. Step 27: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Step 28: Place about 6 or 7 pot stickers in the hot oil, flat-side down. Step 29: Cook until bottoms are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 30: Drizzle in water and quickly cover the pan; steam for 10-12 minutes. Step 31: Uncover; reduce heat to medium. Step 32: Continue cooking until water evaporates and bottoms are browned and crunchy, 1 or. Step 33: Transfer to a warm serving dish. Step 34: Repeat with remaining pot stickers. Step 35: Serve dumplings with dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, lean pork, green onions chunks, fresh carrots, soy sauce, sugar, rice vinegar, limes, mint cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Put the rice noodles in a bowl and pour over enough boiling water to cover, wrap with cling film and soak for 10 mins. Meanwhile, heat a large wok or frying pan and crumble in the mince. Dry fry with some seasoning, breaking it up with a fork or wooden spoon for 7-10 mins until browned. Throw in the spring onions and carrots and cook for 2 mins more. Step 2: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar and lime juice. Drain the noodles, add to the pan and heat through. Pour in the dressing, top with the herbs and serve.

Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, ground pork, fresh ginger root, garlic, green onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, egg, chinese cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork, ginger, garlic, green onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, egg and cabbage in a large bowl. Step 2: Stir until well mixed. Step 3: Place 1 heaping teaspoon of pork filling in the center of each wonton wrapper. Step 4: Moisten edges with water and fold over to form a triangle. Step 5: Press edges firmly to seal. Step 6: Keep filled dumplings covered with a damp towel to prevent drying out until ready to cook. Step 7: Arrange dumplings in a covered bamboo or metal steamer lined with parchment, making sure they're not touching to prevent them from sticking together; steam over simmering water until pork is cooked through, about 15-20 minutes, serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, carrots, celery, cabbage, garlic, green onion, curry powder, light soy sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, uncle ben's converted brand rice, flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tenderloin in half. Step 2: Slice tenderloin into bite size pieces, dust with flour. Step 3: Grate carrots, celery, and cabbage Finely chop garlic, thin slice green onions 1st pan- heat 3 tbs oil and 1 / 2 tsp sesame oil, when hot add tenderloin and cook until no longer pink, add garlic at end, cook for 3 minutes, then add 3 wooden spoonfuls of lite soy sauce, cook for another 3 minutes. Step 4: Add veggie's into the meat, stir and cook about 5-10 minutes 2nd pan- heat 2 tbs oil and 1 / 2 tsp sesame oil unti hot- add dry rice and coat with oil, stir for 3 minutes until light brown. Step 5: Then add water and stir. Step 6: Take meat and veggie's and add with rice, add curry powder.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrot, green onions, ground pork, sesame oil, sugar, soy sauce, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, gyoza skins, vegetable oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all filling ingredients in a bowl and mix well by hand. Step 2: Place a teaspoonful of filling in a wrapper and put water along the edge of the wrapper. Step 3: Make a semicircle, gathering the front side of the wrapper and sealing the top. Step 4: Heat oil in a frying pan. Step 5: Put gyoza in the pan and fry on high heat for a min until the bottoms become brown. Step 6: Add 1 / 4 cup water in the pan. Step 7: Cover the pan with a lid and steam the gyoza for a few minutes on low heat. Step 8: Serve warm with gyoza sauce Can be found in asian food stores.

Dish Name: Pork Stir Fry With Hokkien Noodles
Ingredient Names: pork, hokkien noodles, red capsicum, peanut oil, sesame oil, ginger, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice wine, shallot, coriander, greens, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a bowl and cover with boiling water Stand for 3 minutes or until noodles separate, drain. Step 2: Heat half the peanut oil in a wok over heat. Step 3: Add half the pork and stir fry for 1-2 minutes till light brown. Step 4: Transfer to plate and cover with foil. Step 5: Repeat with remaining pork. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium, add sesame oil to wok and cook ginger and capsicum for 1 minute. Step 7: Add noodles, soy, hoisin, rice wine, shallots and coriander. Step 8: Cook for 2 minutes stirring constantly.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, vegetable oil, garlic, soy sauce, chili sauce, salt and pepper, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil; stir in rice noodles and return to a boil. Step 2: Cook until al dente, 2 to; try not to overcook as they will become mushy, drain. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add garlic and saut茅 until tender. Step 5: Stir in noodles; season with soy sauce, chili sauce, salt, and pepper. Step 6: Sprinkle with chopped green onion.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, frozen spinach, egg, seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Add 1 5c water and spinach to a small pot and bring it to a boil Use the seasoning packet to your liking in this step 2. Step 2: Add the dry noodles to the pot to cook for 3 minutes total 3 2 minutes into the cooking time, slowly incorporate the beaten egg 4. Step 3: After the egg has cooked through, take the pot off the burner.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh gingerroot, mushrooms, green onions, salt, ramen noodles, soy sauce, sesame oil, cooking sherry, beef
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok 375 degrees Add 1st 4 ingredients Cook about one minute Add remaining ingredients and heat through Serve.

Dish Name: Rice Porridge Congee With Century Egg And Pork Or Chicken
Ingredient Names: white rice, salt, vegetable oil, cold water, chicken broth, ginger, chicken, eggs, white pepper, green onion, sesame oil, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rinsed white rice, salt and vegetable oil in the cold water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Add the ginger and chicken broth and bring to a boil, simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally in the beginning and then more frequently near the last 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the green onions, century eggs, and chicken or pork. Step 4: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the sesame oil and ground white pepper. Step 6: Serve the congee in bowls and garnish with a tiny drizzle of the dark soy sauce and garnish with some chopped green onions Enjoy!

Dish Name: Sesame & honey tofu with rice noodles
Ingredient Names: sesame oil, tofu, brown rice noodles, tamari, chinese five-spice powder, clear honey, red peppers, green onions, pak choi
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. When hot, add the tofu and cook for 5 mins on one side. Turn, then fry for another 3 mins. Continue cooking for 10 mins more, turning regularly – make sure you scrape up any bits that are stuck. Don’t worry if it falls apart a little, these pieces become crispy. Remove to a plate and keep warm. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the noodles following pack instructions. Drain and set aside. Make the dressing by mixing ½ tbsp oil, tamari, five-spice and honey. 3 Heat the remaining ½ tbsp sesame oil in the frying pan and cook the pepper for 1 min, then add the onions and pak choi. Toss together for 3 mins, until just wilted. Add the noodles and half the dressing and mix well. Heat through and divide between 4 bowls. Top with the tofu and drizzle remaining dressing over.

Ingredient Names: fine egg noodles, chicken broth, fresh mushrooms, tahini, water, hot chili oil, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, sesame oil, peanut oil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to boil and add noodles. Step 2: Cook, stirring occasionally, about 5-7 minutes, or until done. Step 3: Drain and rinse under cold water until chilled. Step 4: Drain thoroughly and place in a bowl. Step 5: Toss with 2 teaspoons of sesame oil and add mushrooms In another bowl stir water into tahini until smooth. Step 6: Add chili oil, soy sauce, wine vinegar, 2 t Sesame oil, peanut or vegetable oil and garlic and stir until well combined. Step 7: Add sauce to the noodles and mushrooms and toss until well mixed.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, dark sesame oil, gingerroot, salt, cayenne pepper, garlic cloves, moo shu pancakes, vegetable oil cooking spray, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat off pork and cut into thin strips. Step 2: Combine pork with marinade ingredients in a zip-top plastic bag, and shake well to coat. Step 3: Marinate in refrigerator for 20 minutes. Step 4: Heat moo shu shells according to directions on package Coat a skillet with cooking spray, and warm over medium-high heat until hot. Step 5: Stir-fry pork for 4 minutes. Step 6: Divide pork evenly between moo shu shells, drizzle with hoisin sauce, and roll up.

Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, yellow onion, water chestnuts, celery, green onion, cooked crabmeat, egg, chopped fresh parsley, sesame oil, garlic, soy sauce, salt, ground black pepper, water, white sugar, garlic powder, oil for frying, white bread
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Make the shrimp paste: Mix shrimp, onion, water chestnuts, celery, and green onion together in a mixing bowl. Step 3: Stir in crabmeat, egg, parsley, sesame oil, garlic, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Make the dipping sauce: Whisk soy sauce, parsley, water, sesame oil, sugar, and garlic powder together in a small bowl. Step 5: Make the toast: Heat oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Spread each slice bread with a thick layer of shrimp paste, pressing gently so it sticks to bread. Step 7: Working in batches, fry bread, paste-side down, in hot oil until golden and shrimp is pink, 2 to. Step 8: Flip carefully and cook until bread is golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Drain on paper towels. Step 10: Slice shrimp toasts diagonally and serve with dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, udon noodles, egg, water, salt, oil, yellow onion, spring onion, garlic cloves, ham, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Partially cook broccoli and udon in salted boiling water for a few minutes. Step 2: Drain and reserve 1 / 4 cup of the water. Step 3: Beat the egg with 2 tb water and a pinch of salt. Step 4: Heat 1 tb of oil in a wok. Step 5: When hot, pour the egg in and cook until set. Step 6: Remove and set aside. Step 7: Heat remaining 1 tb oil in the same wok over high heat. Step 8: When hot, saute the onions until soft. Step 9: Add garlic and saute for 30 sec. Step 10: Add ham slivers and saute for another 30 sec.

Ingredient Names: chow mein noodles, frozen shrimp, eggs, bean sprouts, water chestnut, baby sweet corn cob, onion, tomatoes, garlic, fresh ginger, curry powder, peanut oil, canned chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation. Step 2: Boil noodles until cooked but still firm- 3 minutes. Step 3: Drain and rinse with cold water, then refrigerate Thaw shrimp and cut off tails. Step 4: Beat eggs and stir fry / scramble. Step 5: Set aside Blanch bean sprouts, water chestnuts and corn, set aside. Step 6: Slice onion and set aside. Step 7: Mix sauce ingredients in bowl and set aside.

Ingredient Names: rice vermicelli, oil, eggs, onion, bean sprouts, curry powder, sugar, light soy sauce, cooked chicken, peas, large shelled prawns, spring onion, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice vermicelli in hot water for 15-20 minutes. Step 2: Drain and rinse in cold water Heatabout 1 tbsp oil and scramble the beaten eggs, remove and reserve. Step 3: Heat the remaining oil, fry the onions until opague. Step 4: Add the bean sprouts and rice vermicelli with the curry powder and the sugar, blend well. Step 5: Add the soy sauce, meat, prawns, peas and scrambled eggs Continue stirring for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add the spring onion and chilles, Mix gently and serve.

Ingredient Names: noodles, eggs, curry powder, oriental sesame oil, peanut oil, medium shrimp, lean pork, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh ginger, garlic clove, hot chili pepper, chinese barbecue pork, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Drop in the rice noodles and boil until tender but firm to the bite, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 3: Drain and rinse under cold water. Step 4: Let the noodle air-dry and firm up in a colander for at least 30 minutes or as long as 2 to 3 hours, toss occasionally. Step 5: When you are ready to prepare the dish, whisk together the eggs, 1 / 2 teaspoon of the curry powder, and all of the sesame oil until blended. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 2 tablespoon of the peanut or vegetable oil into a heavy skillet or wok set over moderately high heat. Step 7: Pour in the egg mixture and immediately reduce the heat to low Scramble the eggs until just set. Step 8: Turn out onto a plate and reserve.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, white onion, green onions, eggs, toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, white pepper, bacon drippings, long-grain rice, frozen peas and carrot, cooked chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw frozen peas and carrots and drain. Step 2: Chop 1 / 2 cup white onions. Step 3: Slice 4 green onions thinly (if optional group four meat if used in recipe, toss meat in 1 teaspoon soy sauce with 1 pinch white pepper and 1 dash sesame oil, set aside. Step 4: Beat 2 eggs from group two ingredients with 1 dash sesame oil, 1 dash soy sauce and 1 dash white pepper: set aside. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil in wok, swirling oil carefully to coat wok surface. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 cup chopped white onions and 4 thinly sliced green onions, sauteeing 1 minute or lomger. Step 7: Remove onions with deep-fry strainer. Step 8: Place into medium bowl. Step 9: Set aside, close to your working station.

Ingredient Names: long grain white rice, peanut oil, garlic clove, spring onions, cooked chicken, cooked shrimp, frozen peas, egg, salt, lettuce, light soy sauce, caster sugar, salt & freshly ground black pepper, roasted cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice in two to three changes of warm water to wash away some of the starch, drain well. Step 2: Put the rice in a saucepan and add 1 tbsp of the oil and 350 ml water. Step 3: Cover and bring to a boil, stir once, then cover and simmer for 12-15 minutes, until nearly all the water has been absorbed. Step 4: Turn off the heat and leave, covered, to stand for 10 minutes Fluff up with a fork and leave to cool. Step 5: Heat the remaining oil in a wok, add the garlic and spring onions and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the chicken, shrimps and peas and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, then add the cooked rice and stir-fry for further 2 minutes. Step 7: Pour in the egg and stir-fry until just set. Step 8: Stir in the lettuce, soy sauce, sugar and seasoning.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless chicken breast, skirt steaks, pork loin, ramen noodles, water, red bell pepper, broccoli florets, green onions, parsley, ground ginger, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet or wok heat oil over medium to high heat. Step 2: Add meat and saute until no longer pink in the middle and completely done If you wish to make your dish vegetarian, substitute meat with 2 cups of washed and pared vegetables Such as, onions, mushrooms, bean sprouts, sugar snap peas, etc Be sure and use the vegetarian version of the ramen noodles Break noodles into pieces and add to the meat along with seasoning packets, water and remaining ingredients. Step 3: Bring ingredients to a boil, stirring and adding more water if necessary Continue to stir occasionally and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until noodles are desired tenderness.

Ingredient Names: thai rice, ground pork, chili-garlic sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, red chili padi, chinese bean paste, shallots, water, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in 1 and a half cups of water until it forms a almost thick texture. Step 2: Marinate minced pork with chilli sauce, sesami oil and oyster sauce. Step 3: Add corn flour to the minced pork mixture. Step 4: Leave for about 20 minutes. Step 5: Fry shallots in oil until fragrant. Step 6: Add minced pork and fry until the pork is no longer pink, add chilli padi. Step 7: Add half cup of water and the soya bean paste Continue to fry over a medium flame until half the water is gone. Step 8: Pour over rice porridge and serve.

Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, boiling water, green cabbage, red cabbage, green onions, red pepper, carrot, sesame seeds, canola oil, ginger, garlic clove, water, chicken bouillon powder, crushed red pepper flakes, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Put noodles into medium bowl. Step 2: Pour boiling water over noodles. Step 3: Let stand for 5 minutes, drain. Step 4: Rinse with cold water and return to bowl. Step 5: In a large bowl combine cabbage, onions, pepper, carrot and sesame seeds. Step 6: Toss To make the dressing, heat oil in a small skillet or saucepan. Step 7: Saute garlic for 1 minute. Step 8: Add water, ginger, bouillon, chilies, and honey.

Ingredient Names: low sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, garlic, lime zest, pork tenderloin, chinese noodles, sesame oil, chicken broth, soy sauce, cilantro, sugar, cornstarch, chili-garlic sauce, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl stir together soy sauce, sherry, garlic and lime peel, toss with pork. Step 2: Marinate in fridge for at least 15 minutes or up to 8 hours. Step 3: Cook noodles according to package directions. Step 4: Rinse, drain and set aside In deep skillet or wok heat sesame oil, add pork. Step 5: Cook over med high heat Stirring occasionally until cooked through, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, chinese cabbage, bean sprouts, shiitake mushrooms, garlic, red onion, dried shrimp, anchovy, curry powder, shrimp paste, oyster sauce, soy sauce, black pepper, salt, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Soak noodles in cold water for 1 / 2 hour or warm water for 15mins, then drain. Step 2: Beat eggs with fork in a small bowl, with a pinch of salt and black pepper Spray non-stick frying pan with cooking spray and fry beaten eggs. Step 3: Remove and slice egg into strips. Step 4: Heat canola oil in non-stick frying pan. Step 5: Once hot, fry anchovies until golden brown and fragrant. Step 6: Remove and use kitchen paper towel to soak up excess oil from anchovies Still using the remaining oil, saute garlic, onions and dried shrimps for approx 2 minutes over medium heat, until fragrant. Step 7: Add cabbage, sprouts and mushrooms, saute for 1-2 minutes. Step 8: Add curry powder, belacan powder, black pepper, oyster sauce, chilli flakes, continue to stir fry.

Ingredient Names: green beans, water, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, white sugar, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine green beans and water in a skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender-crisp, 4 to. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic, and sesame oil; cook, stirring frequently, until garlic is fragrant and golden brown, 1 to. Step 4: Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and red pepper flakes together in a small bowl. Step 5: Pour over beans and cook until sauce thickens enough to coat beans, 3 to.

Ingredient Names: low-salt vegetable stock cube, nests egg noodles, fresh broccoli, sesame oil, shiitake, fat garlic, chili flakes, green onions, hoisin sauce, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Put the stock cube into a pan of water, then bring to the boil. Add the noodles, bring the stock back to the boil and cook for 2 mins. Add the broccoli and boil for 2 mins more. Reserve a cup of the stock, then drain the noodles and veg. Step 2: Heat a frying pan or wok, add the sesame oil and stir-fry the mushrooms for 2 mins until turning golden. Add the garlic, chilli flakes and most of the spring onions, cook 1 min more, then tip in the noodles and broccoli. Splash in 3 tbsp of the stock and the hoisin sauce, then toss together for 1 min using a pair of tongs or 2 wooden spoons. Serve the noodles scattered with the cashew nuts and remaining spring onions. Add a dash more sesame oil to taste, if you like.

Ingredient Names: bamboo shoot, pork loin, sesame oil, rice wine, cornstarch, egg white, salt, sugar, white pepper, wonton skins
Instructions: Step 1: The 8 ounces pork loin should be ground together with 1 ounce of fatback or suet Blanch bamboo shoots for 1 minute in boiling water. Step 2: Drain, pat dry and mince finely. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine pork, bamboo shoots, sesame oil, rice wine, cornstarch, egg white, salt, sugar and pepper until well mixed Form into 30 1-inch balls Trim the corners of won ton wrappers to form circles. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap to prevent them from drying out To assemble, place a meatball in the center of each wrapper and bring up sides, to form an open topped basket Flatten the top of each meatball with a butter knife dipped in water and flatten bottoms of dumpling so they stand upright. Step 5: Place on a lightly oiled plate and set in bamboo steamer or on an inverted heatproof bowl or trivet set in a wok filled with 2 inches of boiling water.

Dish Name: Steamed Rice With Coconut And Lemon
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, stock, salt, coconut milk, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot with a tight-fitting lid combine all ingredients. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, cooking uncovered, stir occasionally. Step 3: When rice boils, cover pot and reduce heat to low. Step 4: Cook for 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and let sit with lid on for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: clear honey, juice limes, pork fillets, fresh egg noodles, radishes, snow peas, carrots, fresh coriander, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the honey and lime zest and juice together in a large bowl and season. Add the pork and mix well to coat in the marinade. Cover and chill for 10 mins. Step 2: Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 4 mins. Mix together the radishes, mangetout, carrot and coriander in a serving bowl. Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan. Remove the pork from the marinade and add to the pan. Stir-fry for 3-5 mins, until golden and cooked through. Add the marinade to the pan and allow to bubble for 1 min. Step 3: Drain the noodles and divide them between serving plates. Spoon the pork and all the pan juices over the vegetables and gently mix. Serve the noodles with the pork and vegetables.

Dish Name: Sticky pork with gingered noodles & kale
Ingredient Names: ginger, soy sauce, clear honey, five-spice powder, pork steak, fresh egg noodles, sunflower oil, kale, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Mix half the ginger with the soy, honey and five-spice in a shallow dish. Add the pork steaks and turn in the mixture to coat. Grill for 6-8 mins, turning once, until the pork is cooked and nicely browned. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the noodles following pack instructions. Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan, then quickly fry the remaining ginger with the kale and chilli for 2 mins until wilted. Drain the noodles and add to the pan, tossing everything together. Serve with the pork steaks.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Chicken In Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, shallots, garlic cloves, black bean sauce, ginger and shallot sauce, vegetable oil, white pepper, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and steam in rice cooker. Step 2: Season chicken with white pepper. Step 3: Add ginger and shallot sauce and leave to marinate for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsps oil in a wok and lightly fry garlic over medium heat, until golden. Step 5: Add chicken and brown on all sides, turning pieces over once or twice. Step 6: Remove and drain off excess oil, leaving about 1 tbsp of the cooked oil in the wok. Step 7: Fry the shallots until beginning to soften. Step 8: Add black bean sauce and stir fry on high heat until sauce starts to bubble. Step 9: Return chicken to wok and stir fry on high heat until cooked through. Step 10: Serve immediately with steamed white rice.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Garlic Pork Or Chicken
Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, shaoxing wine, sesame oil, cornstarch, lean boneless pork, peanut oil, garlic, spring onions, chili bean sauce, sugar, chicken stock, coriander leaves, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix marinade ingredients until smooth. Step 2: Place pork in a small bowl with marinade and coat in mixture. Step 3: Let marinate for at least 20 minutes. Step 4: Heat the wok and add half the oil. Step 5: When it's very hot and almost smoking, lift the pork out of the marinade with a slotted spoon, and put it in the wok. Step 6: Stir-fry quickly it begins to brown. Step 7: Remove from wok and drain well Wipe the wok clean, re-heat it and add the rest of the oil Quickly add the garlic, onions, and chili bean sauce, then a few seconds later add the Rest of the ingredients.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, broccoli florets, red bell pepper, carrot, garlic clove, cooked turkey sausage, sliced water chestnuts, teriyaki sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok or large skillet over mediumhigh heat. Step 2: Add broccoli, pepper and carrots. Step 3: Stir-fry 2-3 minutes 2, add garlic. Step 4: Stir-fry 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add sausage, water chestnuts and teriyaki sause Increase heat to high. Step 6: Cook until sausage us heated through.

Ingredient Names: egg noodles, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic, carrots, yellow pepper, snow peas sugarsnaps, green onions, beansprout, soy sauce, white wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles according to pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan, then stir-fry the ginger, garlic, carrot, pepper and mangetout, sugar snap or frozen peas over a high heat for 2-3 mins. Step 3: Drain the noodles thoroughly, add to the pan with the onions and beansprouts, if using, then stir-fry for 2 mins. Step 4: Mix together the soy sauce and vinegar, stir into the pan, then cook for 1-2 mins. Divide between individual plates or bowls and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: nests egg noodles, vegetable oil, green onions, beansprout, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put the egg noodles in a large bowl, cover with boiling water and leave to soak for 8 mins, or until the noodles are tender. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large, non-stick frying pan and fry the spring onions for 1 min. Step 2: Add the beansprouts and continue to fry, stirring, for 2 mins. Drain the noodles and add to the pan with a good splash of soy sauce. Stir-fry for 1 min more, then serve.

Ingredient Names: fine rice noodle, tofu, sunflower oil, green onions, chunk ginger, red peppers, snow peas, fresh bean sprouts, tikka masala paste, reduced-salt soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, coriander lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Put the noodles in a bowl and pour over boiling water to cover. Leave for 4 mins, then drain and rinse under running cold water until cold. Drain well, then snip into short lengths with scissors. Step 2: Rinse the tofu in cold water, then cut into small chunks. Pat dry with kitchen paper. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a wok or large frying pan, add the tofu, then stir-fry for 2-3 mins, stirring until lightly browned. Drain on kitchen paper. Step 3: Add the remaining oil to the wok and heat up. Add the spring onions, ginger, pepper and mangetout, then stir-fry for 1 min. Add the noodles and beansprouts, then stir to mix. Blend together the curry paste, soy, chilli sauce and 1 tbsp water, then add to the wok, stirring until everything is well coated in the sauce. Serve sprinkled with coriander, with lime wedges for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: kaffir lime leaves, blocks egg noodle, sesame oil, red peppers, carrots batons, ginger, green onions, soy sauce, fresh bean sprouts, block tofu, fresh coriander, garlic, rice wine vinegar, lemongrass, red chile, golden sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dressing, tip all the ingredients and 4 of the torn lime leaves in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer. Boil for 1 min, then remove from the heat to infuse. Step 2: Cook the noodles according to pack instructions, then drain and toss with 3 tbsp of the sesame oil. Leave to cool, tossing occasionally so they don’t stick. Set aside. Step 3: Heat the rest of the oil in a wok and stir-fry the peppers, carrots, ginger and garlic for just 1 min, then set aside. To serve, tip the noodles into a bowl and drain over the dressing. Finely shred the remaining lime leaves and toss in with all the other ingredients, setting aside a small handful of coriander leaves. Taste the noodles, adding a splash more vinegar, soy or sesame oil to suit your taste. Pile the noodles onto a platter or into a large bowl. Scatter over the rest of the coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, dark sesame oil, eggs, onion, carrot, bean sprouts, scallions, frozen peas, brown rice, toasted sesame seeds, butter, salt, black pepper, soy sauce, coconut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Use small cereal bowls to assemble ingredients. Step 2: Place chopped pork in a small bowl and toss with the sesame oil and set aside. Step 3: Whisk two eggs in a small bowl and set aside. Step 4: Place chopped onion and carrots in a small bowl together and set aside. Step 5: Place bean sprouts, peas, and scallions in a small bowl together and set aside. Step 6: Heat 2 tablespoons coconut oil in a wok until hot and cook egg, swivelling wok to keep the runny portion in motion until it sets, then flip the omelet and cook briefly on the other side. Step 7: Remove to platter and chop into small pieces. Step 8: Add 2 more tablespoons wok oil to wok and add the contents of the bowl with onions and carrots. Step 9: Cook until carrots soften, then add pork, and cook and stir until all are hot and sizzling. Step 10: Remove to the platter with eggs.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ginger, roast pork, bok choy, hoisin sauce, rice wine, green onion, thin egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok or heavy saut pan. Step 2: Add ginger and pork and stir fry until pork begins to develop a crust. Step 3: Add bok choy and hoisin sauce with splash of rice wine, toss. Step 4: Add noodles and green onions and continue stir frying until noodles are heated through To serve, remove pan from heat. Step 5: Using tongs, pull all noodles from the pan and then top noodles with pork, onions and bok choy. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, cabbage, soy sauce, chinese cooking wine, shaoxing wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in garlic and cook until it begins to brown, 3 to 5 seconds. Step 3: Stir in cabbage until coated in oil; cover the wok and cook for 5 minutes. Step 4: Pour in soy sauce; cook and stir for another minute. Step 5: Increase heat to high and stir in Chinese cooking wine. Step 6: Cook and stir until cabbage is tender, about more, serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: nests egg noodles, sunflower oil, tenderstem broccoli stems angle, red peppers, baby corn lenthways, garlic, red chile, thumb-sized ginger, skinless chicken breasts, raw king shrimp, madras curry paste, soy sauce, fresh bean sprouts, fresh coriander, green onions, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Pour boiling water over the noodles and leave to soften. Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a large non-stick wok and stir-fry all the vegetables, except the beansprouts and onions, with the garlic, chilli and ginger until softened. If the broccoli won’t soften, add a splash of water to the wok and cover to create some steam. Step 2: Tip the veg on to a plate, add the rest of the oil to the wok then briefly stir-fry the chicken and prawns until just cooked. Set aside with the vegetables and add the curry paste to the pan. Stir-fry for a few secs then add 150ml water and the soy sauce. Allow to bubble then add the drained, softened noodles and beansprouts, and toss together to coat. Step 3: Return the vegetables, chicken and prawns to the wok with the coriander and spring onions. Toss well over the heat and serve with lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: chunky peanut butter, oil, red pepper, green onions, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, sugar, szechuan peppercorns, chinese noodles, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 8 ingredients in small bowl, add water if thinner consistency is desired. Step 2: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender but still firm, checking frequently to avoid overcooking. Step 3: Drain and transfer to serving bowl. Step 4: Add spinach / watercress and sauce. Step 5: Toss lightly and serve.

Dish Name: Szechuan Spaghetti Noodles With Spicy Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: oil, ginger, scallion, ground pork, sherry wine, light soy sauce, brown bean sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, chili paste with garlic, water chestnuts, szechwan preserved vegetables, dried black mushrooms, bamboo shoots, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok to 275f. Step 2: Stir-fry ginger and scallion 1 minute. Step 3: Turn up heat to 425f, and add the meat. Step 4: Stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 5: Add sherry and soy sauce. Step 6: Cook 1 minute, and remove from wok. Step 7: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok to 275f. Step 8: Add bean sauce, hoisin sauce, and sugar. Step 9: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 10: Add chili paste, water chestnuts, preserved vegetables, mushrooms, and bamboo.

Ingredient Names: vermicelli, dark sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, bok choy, red bell pepper, reduced-sodium chicken broth, reduced sodium soy sauce, green onions, water chestnuts, fresh large mushrooms, canadian bacon, fresh cilantro, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Cook vermicelli according to pkg directions. Step 2: Drain and toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil. Step 3: Keep warm and set aside. Step 4: Meanwhile heat remaining oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic and pepper flakes. Step 6: Stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add bok choy, bell pepper, and mushrooms. Step 8: Stir-fry 4 minutes. Step 9: Add broth and soy sauce. Step 10: Bring to a simmer.

Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, dark sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, hot chili oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a stockpot with water and boil to a boiling add the noodles cook until al dente Use chopsticks or two wooden spoons to separate noodles as they cook Do not overcook Empty noodles into a large colander then immediately flush with cold running water until cool Shake off excess water and drain for 15 to 30 minutes. Step 2: Combine sesame oil soy sauce vinegar sugar and chili oil, mix well. Step 3: Pour over noodles and use your hands to evenly distribute seasoned sauce Work carefully so noodles dont break Gently spread sauce over each strand and allow the noodles to fully absorb sauce before eating.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, ginger, limes, tofu, fresh egg noodles, vegetables, cucumber ribbons, peanuts, fat red chili
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the soy sauce, ginger and lime juice in a dish, then add the tofu. Leave to marinate for 5 mins, turning once. Boil the noodles for 4 mins, or according to pack instructions, then drain and cool. Step 2: Dry the tofu on kitchen paper. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan, then fry tofu for 3 mins on each side until golden. Cut into cubes. Step 3: To serve, mix the noodles, chilli, cucumber, tofu and the marinade in a bowl. Toss, then serve with lime wedges and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, butter, onion, carrots, frozen peas, eggs, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter or margarine in non-stick skillet. Step 2: Add onions and carrots, and fry until onions are transparent and carrots are crisp. Step 3: Add peas and cook for 1 minute more Push veggies to one side and scramble eggs in empty side of skillet, add soy sauce. Step 4: Spoon in rice and mix until well blended. Step 5: Fry until steamy and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, scallions, celery, white mushrooms, green cabbage, fresh bean sprouts, cooked turkey, soy sauce, dry sherry, chicken broth, cornstarch, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok until very hot. Step 2: Add the scallions, celery, mushrooms and cabbage and stir-fry until cabbage is tender, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add the bean sprouts, turkey, soy sauce, and dry sherry and stir-fry until heated through, about 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Combine the broth and cornstrch to make a smooth paste. Step 5: Add to pan and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened Seerve with white rice.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, sesame oil, eggs, vegetable oil, garlic, thumb-sized ginger, red chile, red peppers, beansprout, green onions, leftover turkey meat, leftover ham, madras curry powder, turmeric, soy sauce, dry sherry, sprinkling sugar, coriander chili
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain and toss in 1 tsp of the sesame oil. Beat the eggs with the rest of the sesame oil and some seasoning. Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok and pour in the eggs to make a flat omelette. Cook on one side, then flip over, cook all the way through and transfer to a plate. Step 2: Place the wok back on the heat with the rest of the oil and quickly fry the garlic, ginger and chilli. Add all the vegetables to the wok, fry for 1 min more, then add the turkey and ham. Tip the noodles into the pan and stir through the curry powder, turmeric, soy, Sherry and sugar. Cook everything together for 1-2 mins, then shred the omelette and stir it through the noodles. Serve the noodles scattered with coriander sprigs, sliced chilli and extra soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, butter, parmesan cheese, eggs, onions, tabasco sauce, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the ramen according to package directions, but without adding the seasoning packet, drain well. Step 2: Melt the butter in a pan, then add the parmesan and stir well The cheese should almost become like a paste together with the butter. Step 3: Add the cooked noodles and stir well to coat. Step 4: In a bowl mix together the egg and onion / scallion / chives. Step 5: Pour the egg mixture over the noodles in the pan and stir well. Step 6: Cook omelet until egg has set, then flip half of the omelet over the other You can garnish with extra parmesan, if you like, serve.

Ingredient Names: long grain and wild rice blend, beef consomme, french onion soup, water chestnut, sliced mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a medium-size baking dish, combine rice and seasonings, soups, water chestnuts and mushrooms. Step 3: Using one of the opened soup cans, add one additional can of water to the mixture. Step 4: Stir until combined. Step 5: Cook uncovered for approximately 1 hour or until rice is tender, serve hot.

Dish Name: Wonton Soup Ala College Inn Chicken Broth
Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, ground pork, celery, green onions, egg, soy sauce, white wine, sesame seed oil, salt, white pepper, chicken broth, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: To make the wontons: In a medium bowl mix filling ingredients thoroughly. Step 2: Cover wonton wrappers with damp cloth. Step 3: Remove only a few at a time to fill Moisten each with water. Step 4: Place 1 tsp filling in center of each. Step 5: Fold over in triangle shape and seal. Step 6: Take the long folded side and fold it down on itself once more. Step 7: Take the 2 long points and bring them together at the back of the wonton Seal with a bit of water.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, canola oil, eggs, ham, soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, frozen peas, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice Chill overnight Heat oil in a wok Add eggs Cook until set Remove to a plate Chop Wipe out wok Heat oil until very hot Add rice and ham.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, egg whites, scallion, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breasts, carrot, cooked brown rice, frozen green pea, low sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add egg whites and cook, until scrambled, stirring frequently, about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from pan and set aside Offheat, recoat skillet with cooking spray and place back over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add scallions and garlic Saut 2 minutes. Step 5: Add chicken and carrots Saut until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in reserved cooked egg whites, cooked brown rice, peas and soy sauce. Step 7: Cook until heated through, stirring once or twice, about 1 minute.

Dish Name: Xi Fan Easy Breakfast Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: brown rice, turkey bacon, frozen peas and carrot, egg white, garlic powder, pepper, non-fat cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Spray skillet with non-fat cooking spray and heat on high. Step 2: Add rice, bacon and veggies and mix together. Step 3: Once heated through, add egg white and turn heat down to medium. Step 4: After it starts to cook, stir through rice mixture. Step 5: Sprinkle with spices to taste and serve.

Ingredient Names: yakisoba noodles, pork, carrot, cabbage, shiitake mushrooms, fresh ground black pepper, cooking oil, worcestershire sauce, ketchup, soy sauce, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix worcestershire sauce, ketchup, soy sauce, and oyster sauce together. Step 2: Heat oil to medium high heat Saut pork, then add vegetables, cook until soft, but not too soft. Step 3: Add cooked yakisoba and sauce Your done!

Dish Name: Yu Xiang Pai Gu Mian Sichuan Noodle Pork Shoulder Soup
Ingredient Names: canola oil, boneless pork shoulder, garlic cloves, ginger, bean paste, sugar, light soy sauce, chinkiang vinegar, cornstarch, kosher salt, chinese wheat noodles, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a 14 inch flat-bottomed wok or very large frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add pork and cook, stirring until browned, 810 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, ginger, and chile paste. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add sugar, soy, and vinegar. Step 6: Cook, stirring, until sugar dissolves. Step 7: Add 6 cups water and bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium and cook until pork is very tender, about 2 hours. Step 9: Return to boil, add cornstarch mixture, and cook, stirring, until slightly thickened, 12 minutes, keep soup warm.

Dish Name: Brown rice stir-fry with coriander omelette
Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, rapeseed oil, thumb-size ginger, garlic, green onions, shiitake mushrooms, fresh carrots, red peppers, eggs skimmed milk, fresh coriander, soy sauce, sesame oil, chili jam, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the rice following pack instructions. Heat 2 tsp oil in a large frying pan or wok. Add the ginger and garlic and fry for 1 min. Tip in the veg and stir-fry over high heat for 3-4 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix the eggs with the coriander and seasoning. Heat a small non-stick frying pan with the remaining oil. Add the egg, stir once, then allow to cook over a gentle heat until almost set. Flip (using a plate if necessary) and cook on the other side until cooked through. Tip onto a board and cut into strips. Step 3: Add the drained cooked rice, soy sauce, sesame oil and chilli jam to the veg, mixing to heat through. Divide into bowls and top with the omelette strips, a few coriander leaves and sesame seeds.

Dish Name: Burnt Garlic Fried Rice Recipe - Street Style
Ingredient Names: oil, garlic, ginger, chili, green onions, onions, carrots, capsicum, beans, sweet corn, chili sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, cabbage, pepper powder, salt, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large wok heat 2 tbsp oil. add 10 cloves of garlic and fry until it turns golden brown and crunchy. Step 2: Add 1 inch ginger, 2 chilli, 2 tbsp spring onion and stir fry. Step 3: Now add ½ onion and stir fry until the onions shrink slightly. Step 4: Further add ½ carrot, ½ capsicum, 10 beans, 3 tbsp sweet corn and stir fry until the vegetables turn crunchy. Step 5: Make sure not to overcook the vegetables as it turns mushy. Step 6: Make some gap and add 2 tbsp chilli sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp vinegar. Step 7: Stir fry until the sauces are well combined. Step 8: Now add 3 tbsp cabbage, ½ tsp pepper powder and ½ tsp salt. stir fry slightly. Step 9: Further, add 4 cup of cooked rice, ½ tsp pepper powder and ½ tsp salt. Step 10: Stir fry making sure everything is well combined without breaking rice. Step 11: Finally, add 2 tbsp spring onion, and enjoy burnt garlic fried rice.

Ingredient Names: water, cornstarch, low sodium soy sauce, light brown sugar, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, chinese five spice powder, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, chinese eggplants, vegetable oil, salt, pepper, garlic, scallions, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Add 3/4 cup of water and the cornstarch to a medium bowl. Whisk to combine. Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, hoisin, vinegar, Chinese five spice, garlic powder and red pepper flakes. Whisk to combine and set aside. Step 2: To prepare the eggplant, slice the ends off of an eggplant. Slice into thirds horizontally, so you have 3 cylinders. Slice each cylinder lengthwise into quarters, so you have sticks. Repeat with remaining eggplants. Step 3: Heat about 2 tablespoons of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add half of the eggplant, season with salt and pepper, and cook until charred and softened, about 7 – 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and repeat with remaining half. Step 4: Deglaze the pan with 2 tablespoons of water, scraping up the brown bits on the bottom of the skillet. Pour into the bowl with the eggplant. Step 5: Lower the heat to medium and add about a teaspoon of oil to the skillet. Add the garlic and scallions and sauté for 30 – 60 seconds. Step 6: Give the sauce mixture a good whisk and pour into the skillet. Let simmer until thickened, about 1 – 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the eggplant and chili oil to the skillet. Season with salt. Stir to combine and let cook for 5 – 7 minutes so the eggplant can absorb all the flavors. Step 8: Garnish with sliced scallions.

Ingredient Names: duck, peach, chinese five-spice powder, sichuan pepper, sea salt, jasmine rice green onions, peaches, honey, japanese, sesame oil, ginger, hoisin sauce, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 140C/120C fan/gas 1. Prick the duck skin all over with a fork – don’t go too deep or you’ll puncture the meat instead and lose all the juices during cooking. Push the whole peach up into the duck’s cavity, neatly tuck in any excess fat and tie the legs together with string. Using a pestle and mortar, grind together the Chinese five-spice, Sichuan pepper and sea salt. Rub all over the duck and sit, breast-side down, on a rack in a roasting tin. Roast for 3 hrs. Step 2: Meanwhile, put the peaches, cut-side up, in a snug-ish ovenproof dish. Mix the honey, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger and hoisin with 3 tbsp water. Pour over the peaches, then scatter over the sesame seeds. Step 3: Lift the duck out of the oven and drain off any fat in the tin. Turn up the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and flip the duck over so it is now breast-side up. Roast for 30 mins more, with the peaches on the shelf below, until the duck is brown and crispy and the peaches are tender. Serve with jasmine rice and shredded spring onions.

Ingredient Names: long grain white rice, chicken, light soy sauce, chinese cooking wine, garlic, veg, white pepper, bacon, sesame oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200°C / 390°F (180°C fan). Step 2: Mix ingredients in baking dish: Place all Baked Fried Rice ingredients except bacon in a baking dish (~22 x 32cm / 9 x 13"). Stir, then spread rice evenly across pan. Step 3: Top with bacon: Scatter bacon across surface. Step 4: Bake covered 40 min: Cover with foil. Bake 40 minutes. Step 5: Bake uncovered 15 min: Remove foil. Bake uncovered 15 minutes - this will colour the bacon. Liquid should be absorbed, rice should be cooked (but will seem wet, will absorb and soften while resting). Step 6: Rest 10 min: Cover loosely with foil, stand for 10 minutes. Step 7: Fluff: Add green onion and sesame oil. Fluff rice with fork, marvel at how perfectly cooked the rice grains are. Serve!

Dish Name: Five-spice pork fillet with fried rice
Ingredient Names: pork fillet medallions, soy sauce, chinese five-spice, honey, cornstarch, eggs, rice, peas, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the pork medallions with the soy sauce and five-spice; leave to marinate for 5 mins. Heat a large non-stick pan, then fry the pork for 2-3 mins on each side until cooked through. Pour in 150ml boiling water with the honey and bubble for 2 mins. Mix the cornflour with a little water, stir into the sauce and cook until it thickens and is glossy. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the fried rice. Pour the egg into a non-stick frying pan to make an omelette, cooking for 2 mins on each side. Remove, roll up, and cut into thin strips. Add the rice to the pan with the peas and stir-fry for 3-5 mins until piping hot, then gently stir through the omelette with the spring onions and seasoning and cook for 1 min. Serve with the pork and a dash more soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, ginger, garlic, shrimp, green onions whites greens, eggs, rice, rice wine, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok. Step 2: Add the ginger and garlic, then stir-fry briefly until just coloured. Step 3: Add the prawns and the whites of the spring onions, and cook for a further 3 mins. Step 4: Pour in the beaten egg, let it set for a couple of secs, then break it up and stir well to scramble. Step 5: Add the cooked rice and stir-fry everything together for 10 mins. Step 6: Add the rest of the spring onions, rice wine and soy, then toss everything together well. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Mackerel with sizzled garlic, ginger & tomatoes
Ingredient Names: mackerel gutted cleaned, sunflower, thumb-sized ginger, garlic, fat red chilies if you like, green onions, cherry tomatoes, chinese rice vinegar, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill to High, or fire up the barbecue. Slash the fish a few times on each side, then season with black pepper. Grill or barbecue the fish for 3-5 mins on each side, until charred and cooked through. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan (you can put the pan on the barbecue rack), then fry the ginger, garlic and chillies for about 2 mins until the garlic is lightly golden. Take off the heat and toss in the spring onions and cherry tomatoes. Lift the fish onto a plate, splash with the vinegar, then spoon over the contents of the pan and splash with soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, dark sesame oil, water, scallions, sesame seeds, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, toss the rice with 1/2 teaspoons of the sesame oil to coat the grains. Step 2: Add the water, cover, and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the rice is tender, about 40 to 45 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the scallions, sesame seeds, the remaining sesame oil, and soy sauce to taste, enjoy!, note:. Step 4: Toast sesame seeds in a single layer on an unoiled baking tray at 350*F for 2 to 3 minutes, until fragrant and golden. Step 5: Watch carefully, so as not to burn!

Dish Name: Soy Ginger Dipping Sauce (For Dumplings or Pot Stickers)
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sugar, scallions, gingerroot, sesame oil, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 1/4 cup water to boil in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Step 2: Pour mixture into bowl and stir in scallion, ginger, oil, and hot red pepper flakes (Sauce can be refrigerated in air-tight container for several days). Step 3: Makes about one cup.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, eggs, red chile, green onions, rice, soy sauce sweet chili sauce, peas, ham, leftover turkey
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a wok or frying pan. Add the eggs, swirl to coat the base of the pan and allow to set to an omelette, flip and cook for 1-2 mins. Once cooked, remove, shred and set aside. Add the remaining oil to the pan, then stir-fry the chilli, if using, and spring onions for 1 min. Step 2: Add the remaining ingredients and the egg, and heat through, stirring, until piping hot. Serve immediately with some extra soy and sweet chilli sauce, if you like.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, cornstarch, water, pork tenderloins, limes, rice vinegar, dark sesame oil, peanut oil, gingerroot, green chili peppers, julienned carrot, sugar snap peas, chili oil, green onions, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, mix 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon cornstarch and water. Step 2: Wisk together until smooth then stir in the pork cubes. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 30 to 45 minutes. Step 4: In another bowl combine the lime juice, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, vinegar, 1 teaspoon cornstarch and sesame oil. Step 5: Mix together and set aside. Step 6: Remove pork and marinade from refrigerator. Step 7: In a large fry pan or wok heat peanut oil until hot. Step 8: Stir in ginger and chile pepper and saute for 1 minute. Step 9: Then stir in pork with marinade, carrots, and sugar peas and stir-fry for 6 to 8 minutes or until pork is tender. Step 10: Pour in lime mixture, reduce heat and simmer until sauce thickens, approximately 6 to 8 minutes. Step 11: Remove from heat and stir in hot chile oil, green onions and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, red chilies, garlic, sunflower oil, fresh carrots, chinese cabbage, eggs, green onions, peas, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: If making the rice from scratch, cook it following pack instructions, then drain. Mix the chillies and garlic (in a pestle and mortar, if you have one) with a pinch of salt, to make a paste. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan on a medium-high heat. Add the carrots and stir-fry for 5 mins until tender. Add the cabbage and chilli paste and cook for 1 min more. Tip in the cooked basmati or leftover rice and stir-fry for 1 min until piping hot. Step 3: Push the rice mixture to one side of the pan. Add the eggs to the cleared space and scramble until set. Mix in the onions, peas and soy and stir-fry everything together until the peas are hot.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, garlic puree, eggs, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan over a high heat. Add garlic purée and stir briefly. Add the peppers and broccoli florets, stir-fry for 3 mins. Tip in the rice, then stir-fry for another 3-4 mins. Step 2: Make a well in the centre of the rice and add the egg. Cook for 1 min, then stir the egg into the rice. Season to taste and spoon into serving bowls. Drizzle with soy sauce and serve.

Ingredient Names: sunflower, pepper, shiitake, long grain rice, garlic, five-spice powder, dry sherry, petits pois, sesame oil, eggs, green onions diagonally, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the kettle. Heat the oil in a large, deep frying pan, then add the peppers and mushrooms. Fry over a high heat for 3 mins or until starting to soften and turn golden. Turn down the heat, then stir in the rice, garlic and five-spice. Sizzle for 2 mins, then splash in the sherry, if using, and top up with 350ml hot water. Step 2: Cover the pan and simmer for 15-20 mins until all of the liquid has gone and the rice is tender, stirring now and again. Add the peas for the final few mins. Step 3: Heat another frying pan, add a drop of the sesame oil, then add the eggs. Swirl around the pan to make a thin omelette. Once set, turn out onto a board, roll up and shred thinly. Tip the egg and spring onions onto the rice, fluff up with a fork, season with soy sauce and sesame oil, then serve.

Dish Name: Actual P F Chang's Lettuce Wrap Recipe Not A Copycat
Ingredient Names: chicken, fresh ginger, garlic, dried chili pepper flakes, soybean oil, romaine lettuce, fresh orange juice, fresh lime juice, fresh lemon juice, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the chicken into tiny pieces. Step 2: Place the chicken in a mixing bowl and add 2 tablespoons soybean oil, ginger, garlic, chili flakes and 2 tablespoons soy sauce. Step 3: Mix together in circular motion until well mixed. Step 4: Let marinate in refrigerator for 2-4 hours. Step 5: Mix together the citrus juices, soy, and hoisin sauce with a whisk Reserve until needed Clean the romaine lettuce, chopping off the stem, peeling each spear and running under clean cold water Reserve in refrigerator until ready to use. Step 6: Chop scallions into rings and reserve chilled Coat a very hot saut pan lightly with soybean or vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, cucumber, fresh spinach, fresh mushrooms, carrots, green onions, green pepper, celery, beef broth, soy sauce, sake, ground black pepper, garlic powder, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place all vegetables in large salad bowl. Step 2: Combine broth, soy sauce, sake, black pepper, garlic powder, and sugar in small mixing bowl Just before serving, pour dressing over salad and toss to coat Dressing If you do not use it all, refrigerate leftovers for use on other salads.

Ingredient Names: fresh broccoli, mushrooms, carrots, almonds, vinegar, sesame oil, honey, tamari, ginger, pressed garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Peel tough"skin" from broccli stems; slice stems about 1/8"- 3/16" thick. Step 2: Cut florets into bite size picees. Step 3: Steam broccoli until just crisp. Step 4: (Stems will take slightly longer than florets to steam.) Do NOT overcook. Step 5: Mix dressing ingredients and toss w/ broccoli. Step 6: Stir in grated carrot, sliced mushroom and almonds, chill.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, slivered almonds, sesame seeds, butter, napa cabbage, green onions, vegetable oil, white vinegar, white sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a medium skillet on low heat. Step 2: Add ramen noodles, almonds and sesame seeds. Step 3: Cook, stirring often, until golden brown. Step 4: Remove from heat, cool. Step 5: In a small saucepan bring oil, sugar and vinegar to a boil for one minute, cool. Step 6: Stir in soy sauce. Step 7: In a large bowl, combine cabbage, onions, noodles and soy sauce mixture, toss well. Step 8: Serve NOTE: The prep time does not include the cool down time for the noodles and oil/vinegar/sugar mixtures. Step 9: This salad is best served at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: sugar, olive oil, red wine vinegar, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix in a saucepan over low heat, until sugar is dissolved Cool & pour over salad - add chow mein noodles and mandarin oranges -- mmmmmm!

Dish Name: Asian Slaw A Raw Food Recipe
Ingredient Names: rice wine vinegar, vegetable oil, sesame oil, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, green onions, cashews, raw carrots, raw beets, jalapeno pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl and whisk until combined Add remaining ingredients and mix well Chill in refrigerator for 2 hours and serve Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: duck breasts skinless if you find them, red chile, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, honey, limes, pineapple, shallots rings, bean sprouts blanched water, fresh cilantro, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Light the barbecue if you are using charcoals. If your duck breasts have the skin on, remove it by simply pulling it off. Use a knife to cut into the thickest part of the duck breast, but don’t cut all the way through. Place between cling film and use a meat mallet or rolling pin to bat them out so that the meat is about 1cm thick all over. Step 2: Mix the chilli, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, honey and lime juice. Place the duck in a flat dish and pour over the chilli mix, making sure it’s completely coated – it’s now ready to cook. Unlike other marinades, there’s no need to leave it as the duck meat will ‘cure’ in the marinade and become pappy. Step 3: To make the salad, use a sharp knife to shave the pineapple into wide strips. Mix with the rest of the ingredients and set aside. When the coals are ashen, barbecue each piece of duck for a few mins on each side until sticky and charred. Then lift it straight onto a plate and place a pile of salad on the side – the idea is that the salad dressing mixes with the juices from the duck as it rests.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, slivered almonds, ramen noodles, chinese cabbage, green onion, vegetable oil, cider vinegar, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Saute in butter, sesame seeds and noodles. Step 2: Stir until browned, set aside. Step 3: Slice cabbage thinly and onion into large bowl. Step 4: Add sesame seed-noodle mixture and almonds, mix together. Step 5: Combine dressing ingredients and pour over cabbage mixture Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: chinese cabbage, pineapple, fresh parsley, carrot, red onion, mayonnaise, pineapple juice, whole grain mustard, ginger, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large zip-lock bag combine cabbage, parsley, pineapple, shredded carrot and thinly sliced red onion Seal and chill. Step 2: Combine mayonnaise, whole grain mustard, ginger, pineapple juice and salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Step 3: Cover and chill Just before serving, pour dressing in with the zip-lock bag mixture and fumble / toss to coat, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: coleslaw mix, green onions, canola oil, seasoned rice vinegar, sesame seeds, almonds, sugar, ramen noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oil, vinegar, sugar and seasoning packets from ramen to make dressing Toast the almonds and sesame seeds in dry pan. Step 2: Mix the cabbage, onions and ramen noodles in large bowl. Step 3: Toss with dressing and nuts. Step 4: Let set in fridge to meld flavors. Step 5: Toss again before serving, as the dressing settles to the bottom. Step 6: Add chicken to make this a main dish salad.

Dish Name: Chinese Cabbage And Bean Sprout Salad
Ingredient Names: chinese cabbage, fresh bean sprouts, green onions, red pepper, soy sauce, lemon juice, sesame oil, honey, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients for salad together in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix all ingredients for dressing in a small bowl. Step 3: Pour dressing over salad and toss. Step 4: Let sit for 5 minutes and serve.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, green onions, ramen noodles, slivered almonds, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, sugar, white vinegar, salt, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Shred cabbage if not using coleslaw mix, and place in salad bowl with green onions. Step 3: Crumble noodles onto broiler pan, add almonds and sesame seeds and broil for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Careful not to let sesame seeds burn. Step 5: In a glass jar with a lid, combine oil, sugar, vinegar, salt, and contents of seasoning packet. Step 6: Pour dressing over salad, and toss well. Step 7: Add toasted noodles, almonds, sesame seeds and fresh basil (if using) RIGHT before serving.

Ingredient Names: sugar, pepper, soy sauce, vinegar, water, sesame oil, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat all ingredients except oils until sugar dissolves, cool then add oils Salad suggestions: Toasted sesame seeds Toasted slivered almonds Shredded cabbage Cilantro Peas Cumcumber Bean sprouts Chicken.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, salt, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, scallions, fresh gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Peel cucumbers Slice thinly Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers Stir carefully Chill.

Ingredient Names: boneless duck meat, bean sprouts, coriander, iceberg lettuce, light soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, sesame seeds, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the dressing with a whisk Place ingredients in a salad bowl Toss with dressing Serve over iceberg lettuce.

Ingredient Names: chinese cabbage, fried chinese noodles, pine nuts, spring onions, caster sugar, white wine vinegar, soy sauce, olive oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine salad ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Step 2: Combine dressing ingredients in a jar and mix well Immediately before serving pour dressing over salad and mix well.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, bacon, bok choy, red pepper, green onion, cilantro, mayonnaise, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, mustard powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes until cooked, but still firm. Step 2: Cut into salad-sized chunks. Step 3: Mix the ingredients for the sauce together, using more or less sesame oil and hot mustard, according to taste. Step 4: Put all salad ingredients in a large bowl, then add the sauce and mix well, chill.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, scallion, garlic, sesame oil, chinese white rice vinegar, salt, white pepper, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients for the dressing, and set aside Thinly slice the tomatoes Arrange tomato slices on a plate, and spoon the dressing over the top.

Ingredient Names: duck leg, chinese five-spice powder, rice noodles, celery, carrots, cucumbers, green onions, hoisin sauce, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Rub the duck leg all over with five-spice and seasoning, place on a baking tray and roast for 25 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the rice noodles following pack instructions. Drain and cool under cold running water, then drain again well and toss with the celery, carrot, cucumber and spring onions. When cool enough to handle, remove the duck meat and crispy skin from the bone and finely shred. Step 3: To make the dressing, mix the hoisin and soy sauce with 2 tbsp water. Divide the noodles between two plates and top with the shredded duck. Drizzle over the dressing and serve.

Dish Name: Cold Lo Mein With Ham And Cucumber
Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, sesame oil, cucumber, ham, soy sauce, white vinegar, sugar, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in boiling water for about 3 minutes or until done. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and drain well. Step 3: Place in a large bowl. Step 4: Sprinkle with the sesame oil and mix well. Step 5: Add the cucumber and ham to the cool noodles. Step 6: In a small bowl combine and whisk together the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and tabasco. Step 7: Pour the above mixture over the noodles and mix again before serving.

Dish Name: Cong Xiang Yuan Bai Cai Onion Fragrant Cabbage
Ingredient Names: onions, cabbage, salad oil, salt, soy sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, rinse, and thinly slice onion Peel and rinse cabbage. Step 2: Chop into 1-inch squares. Step 3: Steam about 8 minutes and remove to serving bowl, heat wok. Step 4: Add oil and swirl to heat. Step 5: Add onion and toss briefly until fragrant, turn off heat. Step 6: Add salt, soy sauce, and sugar, and toss. Step 7: Pour onion mixture over cabbage, and serve as part of a chinese meal.

Ingredient Names: light firm tofu, tamari soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, sugar, dijon-style mustard, salt, cooking oil, cornmeal, sesame seeds, spinach, watercress, button mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, red onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu crosswise into eight 1/2-inch slices. Step 2: In a 2-quart rectangular baking dish arrange slices in a single layer. Step 3: Pour tamari sauce over tofu; turn slices to coat. Step 4: Let stand for 15 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, for vinaigrette, in a blender container or food processor bowl combine vinegar, ginger, sugar, mustard, and salt. Step 6: Cover and blend or process until combined. Step 7: With blender or processor running, add the 1/3 cup oil in a thin steady stream. Step 8: Blend or process for 15 seconds more. Step 9: Drain tofu, discarding tamari sauce. Step 10: In a shallow dish combine cornmeal and sesame seeds. Step 11: Carefully dip tofu slices in cornmeal mixture to lightly coat both sides. Step 12: In a large nonstick skillet cook tofu in the 2 teaspoons hot oil for 5 to 6 minutes or until crisp and hot, carefully turning once. Step 13: (You may need to cook tofu in two batches; avoid crowding the skillet.) In an extra-large bowl combine spinach, watercress, mushrooms, tomatoes, and red onion. Step 14: Pour the vinaigrette over spinach mixture; toss to coat. Step 15: Divide among 4 dinner plates. Step 16: Cut the tofu slices in half diagonally. Step 17: Arrange the tofu over spinach mixture. Step 18: If desired, sprinkle with additional sesame seeds, makes 4 servings.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, garlic cloves, soy sauce, white vinegar, chicken broth, sesame oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Lay cucumber on a cutting board and place the flat side of a large knife on top Proceed to hammer on the knife, smashing the cucumber Continue this along the whole cucumber This process allows for better flavour absorption. Step 2: Chop cucumber coarsely into half-inch pieces and place in a coupe-shaped bowl. Step 3: Add pressed garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, chicken broth, sesame oil and sugar and stir until mixed. Step 4: Let stand 5 minutes Voila!, a masterpiece!

Ingredient Names: tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, hot pepper oil, cayenne pepper, sugar, toasted sesame oil, corn oil, ginger, garlic, scallion, white wine, hot mustard, salt, broth
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all dressing ingredients together Use as a dipping sauce or for a salad Will adjust when i have the chance.

Ingredient Names: mung bean noodles, napa cabbage, watercress, carrot, seedless cucumber, red bell pepper, green onion, baby corn, cilantro, mint, sesame oil, sweet chili sauce, lime juice, soy sauce, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the bean threads in warm water to cover for 10 minutes or till pliable. Step 2: Drain, then cook in boiling water till the noodles expand and appear glasslike, 1-2 minutes. Step 3: Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Step 4: Cut into 4-inch lengths. Step 5: Place in a large bowl along with the rest of the salad ingredients. Step 6: In a small bowl whisk together the ingredients for the dressing till well combined. Step 7: Toss with the salad to evenly coat. Step 8: Garnish with sesame seeds.

Dish Name: Light and Refreshing Sesame Orzo Salad
Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, fresh broccoli florets, green onions, red bell peppers, peas, carrots, mung bean sprouts, water chestnuts, oranges, sunflower seeds, light sesame oil, rice vinegar, sesame seeds, garlic, red pepper flakes, ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook orzo pasta in boiling water for about 4 minutes. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and drain. Step 3: Place in a large bowl. Step 4: In a liquid measuring cup with a spout, mix the dressing ingredients together. Step 5: Slice the water chestnuts if they weren't presliced, and then cut the slices into quarters to make small pieces. Step 6: Add these to the bowl with the pasta. Step 7: Add the broccoli, onions, bell pepper, peas, carrots, and sprouts to the bowl, and mix gently but thoroughly. Step 8: Add the dressing and mix again. Step 9: Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Step 10: Before serving, stir the salad up to remix it, and sprinkle sunflower kernals on top.
