Step 11: Thinly slice the orange and then cut the slices in half. Step 12: Stand these up around the edge of the bowl as a garnish. Step 13: Serve cold or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: fresh chinese noodles, oil, vegetable oil, green onions, garlic, ginger, asian chili peppers, rice vinegar, soya sauce, sugar, chinese sesame paste, chicken stock, sesame oil, roasted sesame seeds, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles, fresh or fried, until al dente. Step 2: Drain and rinse in cool, then cold, water, drain well. Step 3: Sprinkle with vegetable, peanut or sesame oil Sauce: in a small skillet, heat vegetable oil and saute onions, garlic, ginger and chili peppers until garlic is soft but not brown. Step 4: Turn off heat and add vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, sesame paste and chicken stock. Step 5: Heat and simmer sauce, stirring for 2 minutes. Step 6: Stir in sesame oil. Step 7: Cool to room temperature. Step 8: Pour sauce over chilled noodles and mix well.

Ingredient Names: sugar, oil, vinegar, sunflower seeds, peanuts, ramen noodles, coleslaw mix, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sugar, oil, vinegar and the seasoning packets that come with ramen noodles. Step 2: Refrigerate for 4-6 hours Right before ready to serve mix cabbage, sunflower seeds, chopped peanuts, and ramen noodles and green onions. Step 3: Add the dressing mix and serve.

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce, oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles, cooked chicken, white shoepeg corn, tomatoes, green onions, peanuts, sugar, salt, gingerroot, pepper, oil, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Salad: arrange romaine in bottom of large clear glass serving bowl. Step 2: Discard seasoning packet from soup mix Coarsely crush noodles. Step 3: Layer noodles and all remaining salad ingredients, on order listed, over romaine lettuce Dressing: in small jar with tight-fitting lid, combine all dressing ingredients Shake until well blended, pour over salad. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: grainy mustard, shallots, black vinegar, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, grapeseed oil, kosher salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender or food processor, combine the mustard, shallots, vinegars, soy sauce, and sugar and pure With the machine running, slowly drizzle in the oil until an emulsion is formed. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper, remembering that not much salt will be needed because of the soy sauce Use or store Lasts 2 weeks, refrigerated.

Ingredient Names: tofu, salad oil, fresh bean sprouts, cucumbers, carrots, green onions, salted peanuts, fresh coriander, white wine vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, ground red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu crosswise into 1-inch thick slices. Step 2: Let drain in a colander for 15 minutes, then place between paper towels and gently press out excess water. Step 3: Place tofu on a rack in a shallow rimmed baking pan and brush all surfaces with oil. Step 4: Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes. Step 5: Let cool, then cut into 1/4 by 1/4 by 1 inch strips. Step 6: Prepare Sesame Dressing and add tofu, stirring gently to coat. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 24 hours. Step 8: Meanwhile, fill a 24-quart pan half-full with water. Step 9: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 10: Add bean sprouts and cook for 10 seconds; then drain, rinse under cold water, and drain again. Step 11: Cover and refrigerate. Step 12: Peel cucumber, if desired, and cut in half lengthwise. Step 13: Scoop out and discard seeds, if large, and slice thinly; cover and refrigerate. Step 14: Just before serving, combine tofu and dressing, bean sprouts, cucumber, 2/3 C. Step 15: Of the carrots, thinly sliced onions, and nuts in a large salad bowl; toss gently. Step 16: Garnish with remaining carrots, coriander, and diagonally sliced onions. Step 17: Sesame Dressing: Combine dressing ingredients and mix well.

Ingredient Names: duck legs, five-spice powder, rice vinegar, soy sauce, oranges segmented, watercress, radish, chicory leaves, green onion diagonally
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pat the duck legs dry with kitchen paper and rub in the five-spice and some seasoning. Pour the vinegar, soy and orange juice into a small roasting tin and put the duck on top. Cover with foil and cook for 30 mins, then remove the foil and increase oven to 240C/220C fan/ gas 9, or put under the grill and cook until the skin is crisp. Remove and strain the liquid through a sieve. Let the duck cool until you can shred the meat from the bones. Skim fat from the liquid. Step 2: Meanwhile, gently toss together the oranges, watercress, radishes, chicory and spring onions. Pour over reserved cooking liquid, then add the duck and arrange on a platter.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, black vinegar, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, minced ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Cut strips off the peel, so that it is striped Fancy! Step 2: Pretty food is good food. Step 3: Cut the cucumber lengthwise into fourths Seed and slice into 1 inch lengths, mix both vinegars. Step 4: Add sugar and salt to taste. Step 5: Pour over the cucumber Mound the cucumber on a plate, top with ginger.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, red cabbage, carrots, green onion, lemon juice, cider vinegar, sugar, salt, fresh ground black pepper, mayonnaise, sour cream, coarse grain mustard, asian chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, sriracha, and mustard, lemon juice, vinegar, sugar and salt. Step 2: Add cabbage, carrots and onion, mix well. Step 3: Refrigerate for 1 hour.

Dish Name: Weight Watchers Chinese Chicken Salad With Creamy Soy Dressing
Ingredient Names: fat-free mayonnaise, low sodium soy sauce, gingerroot, cooked boneless skinless chicken breast, snow peas, sweet red pepper, carrot, scallion, bibb lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk mayonnaise, soy sauce and ginger together in a large bowl until blended. Step 2: Add chicken, snow peas, peppers, carrots and scallions. Step 3: Toss to mix and coat. Step 4: Serve immediately in lettuce cups or cover and refrigerate up to 1 day Yields about 1 1 / 4 cups per serving.

Dish Name: 1 Favorite Chinese Steamed Whole Fish By Sy
Ingredient Names: fish, scallions, rice wine, peanut oil, sesame oil, white pepper, salt, gingerroot, low sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and scale the fish and remove the insides, however, leave the head and tail on. Step 2: Rinse under cold water and then pat dry. Step 3: Place the fish in an oblong oven proof / microwave proof dish and add a little rice wine to both sides. Step 4: After 5 minutes, remove the wine. Step 5: Place two whole scallions under the fish to prop the fish up, which will allow steam to flow underneath Steaming the fish: place water in a large wok and using a flat round trivet on top of the wok, bring water to a boil. Step 6: Place the fish plate on the trivet and cover. Step 7: Steam the fish for about 10-15 minutes, use a fork to poke the flesh of the fish to see that it is done. Step 8: Remove the fish plate from the wok, pour off the cloudy liquid, discard the scallions and then place the plate in the kitchen sink As an alternative for steaming, put plastic wrap over the fish plate and then into the microwave oven.

Dish Name: 15 Minute Tiger Prawns With Chinese Greens
Ingredient Names: tiger shrimp, baby spinach, pak choi, thai fish sauce, dark soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, sunflower oil, cornflour, water, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the lime zest and juice with the fish sauce, soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, water & cornflour, set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan & stir fry the pak choi for 2 minutes. Step 3: Remove from pan and stir fry prawns until cooked - turn pink or heated through if already cooked. Step 4: Put pak choi back in wok with prawns. Step 5: Add the sauce and cook until simmering point. Step 6: Mix well and serve with fresh white rice.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, lump crab meat, scallions, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, wonton wrappers, asian sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cream cheese, crab meat, scallions, soy sauce, and Worcestershire sauce in a large bowl; stir until evenly combined. Step 2: Set filling aside. Step 3: Preheat an air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 4: Grease the air fryer basket with cooking spray. Step 5: Fill a small bowl with warm water. Step 6: Place 12 wonton wrappers on a clean work surface. Step 7: Spoon filling into the center of each wonton wrapper. Step 8: Dip your index finger into the bowl of warm water and wet around the sides of each wonton wrapper. Step 9: Crimp wrapper corners upwards to meet in the center to form dumplings. Step 10: Place dumplings in the prepared basket and mist the tops with cooking spray. Step 11: Cook dumplings in the preheated air fryer until desired crispness is reached, 8 to. Step 12: Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Step 13: While the first batch is cooking, assemble dumplings with remaining wonton wrappers and filling. Step 14: Serve dumplings with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

Ingredient Names: linguine, hoisin sauce, chicken broth, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, cornstarch, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, onion, mushrooms, carrot, broccoli floret, sugar snap pea, bok choy, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles according to the package directions until just tender. Step 2: Drain out the water. Step 3: Rinse the noodles with cold water, drain them well, and then set them aside. Step 4: In a small bowl, mix the hoisin sauce, chicken broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch. Step 5: Then set the sauce aside. Step 6: Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a large wok or nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Stir-fry the ginger for 30 seconds. Step 8: Then add the onion and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 9: Add the mushrooms and carrots and stir-fry 2 minutes more. Step 10: Finally, add the broccoli, pea pods, and bok choy.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, garlic, salt, soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, raw shrimp, cornstarch, eggs, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok Stirfry pork, breaking apart any chunks. Step 2: Add garlic and salt. Step 3: Add soy, oyster sauce and water to pork. Step 4: Cover and boil five minutes. Step 5: Add shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through Thicken mixture with cornstarch slurry. Step 6: Cook until mixture is clear and thick. Step 7: Add green onions and beaten eggs, stirring constantly.

Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, eggs, chicken stock, salt, peanut oil, sherry wine
Instructions: Step 1: Wash shrimp thoroughly. Step 2: Drain Dry them on a paper towel then chop fine, beat eggs. Step 3: Add stock, shrimp, salt, oil and sherry, mix thoroughly. Step 4: Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish. Step 5: Bake in a 400 oven 15 minutes. Step 6: Serve immediately before it falls.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, mirin, granulated sugar, salt, sesame oil, green onion, cilantro, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the wok for steaming. Step 2: Rinse the fish fillets and pat dry with paper towels. Step 3: In a small bowl, whisk the rice wine or sherry, sugar, salt and sesame oil. Step 4: Place the fish fillets on a deep, heat-proof plate that will fit inside the steamer basket. Step 5: Pour the rice wine mixture over the fish. Step 6: Sprinkle with the chopped green onion. Step 7: Cover and steam the fish over high heat until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Step 8: Serve hot, garnished with the chopped cilantro and lemon wedges.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 1 Pork Lettuce Rolls
Ingredient Names: pork, crab, mushroom, shallots, water chestnut, bamboo shoot, lite olive oil, sesame seed oil, soy sauce, oyster sauce, dry sherry, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet and add minced pork, toss until dark golden brown add mushrooms, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, crab and shallots. Step 2: Toss well, cook 1 minute combine sesame oil, oyster sauce& sherry, add to pan and toss until well combined, remove from heat Have a bowl of cleaned lettuce leaves ready. Step 3: When you are ready to serve this course bring the hot pork mixture and lettuce leaves to the table Everyone helps themselves to a lettuce leaf adds a heaping tbsp of the pork, rolls the leaf around the meat and enjoy! Step 4: Optional: you may serve a sauce to go along with the wraps, serve on the side Something like recipe#48345 asian dipping sauce by markthegastonome or a spicy one of your choosing.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 2 Pork Prawn Wraps
Ingredient Names: ground pork, shrimp, cabbage, egg, cornstarch, shallots, soy sauce, sesame oil, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Oil for deep frying. Step 2: In a bowl combine all the ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Place a teaspoon of this mixture in the centre of each wrap. Step 4: Bring the sides of the wrap up toward the centre, pleating edges together around the filling You may now freeze them or you may proceed to cook them. Step 5: When you wish to serve them place frozen wraps in a 375f for about 15-20 min or until cooked completely and golden brown There are two ways to do this: heat oven to 400f degrees, place parcels on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake for about 10-15 minutes turning once, or until golden and the filling is fully cooked, or deep fry the filled wraps However if you choose to deep fry this must be done before you freeze them. Step 6: When ready to serve put them frozen in a 375f oven for about 15 min or until heated through. Step 7: Drain well on paper towel.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 5 Steamed Shrimp Dumplings
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, boiling water, shrimp, water chestnuts, light soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour and salt into a bowl of mixer fitted with the dough paddle and quickly add the boiling water, mix until springy. Step 2: When cool enough to touch, knead a few times on an oiled surface If you do not have a mixer, after you have added the water to the flour / salt work the dough with the handle of a wooden spoon until it is cool enough to knead by hand. Step 3: Then knead on an oiled surface until springy. Step 4: Cover with a damp cloth and set aside. Step 5: Mix shrimp, water chestnuts, soy sauce, sugar and cornstarch with your fingers until sticky. Step 6: Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 7: Roll the dough out into a long sausage and cut off pieces. Step 8: Roll out each piece into a thin round.

Dish Name: Best Pork And Or Shrimp Egg Rolls
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, ginger, green onion, celery rib, napa cabbage, bean sprouts, pork, shrimp, chicken stock, sugar, cornstarch, water, sesame oil, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok set over moderately high heat, add the ground ginger, onion, and celery and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 2: Add the cabbage and bean sprouts and stir fry 2-3 minutes more, or until vegetables are slightly softened. Step 3: Add the pork and / or shrimp and stir-fry 1 minute more. Step 4: Add the chicken stock and sugar, bring the mixture to a boil and stir in the cornstarch mixture. Step 5: Simmer until lightly thickened. Step 6: Stir in sesame oil, salt and pepper to taste Have 1 cup water at a boil. Step 7: Remove from heat and whisk in cornstarch mixture Have 12 egg roll wrappers ready under a dampened towel. Step 8: Place a portion of the filing in a line diagonally across one corner of wrapper, brush with some of cornstarch paste and fold in the ends.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, shrimp, garlic cloves, green onions, soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, cornstarch, oyster sauce, ground black pepper, wonton wrappers, chicken stock, salt and pepper, mushroom soy sauce, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except wonton wrappers and stock. Step 2: Place a teaspoon of meat mixture in the center of wrappers Enclose the filling - you can shape the wontons into any shape you want Don't forget to wet the edges of wrappers to ensure the filling is sealed well. Step 3: Boil the chicken stock over high heat. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer Carefully put dumplings into stock and cook, covered, until dumplings float in the surface Don't crowd the dumplings - you may need to repeat this step for 2-3 times. Step 5: Add the vegetables along with the last batch of dumplings, if using. Step 6: Add salt, pepper, or soy sauce to taste.

Dish Name: Broiled Bass With Ginger Scallion Oil Stir Fried Asparagus
Ingredient Names: scallions, fresh ginger, garlic clove, crushed red pepper flakes, vegetable oil, fresh lemon juice, soy sauce, kosher salt, bass fillets, asparagus, sesame oil, lemon zest, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the scallions, ginger, garlic and red pepper. Step 2: In a saucepan, heat the oil until shimmering. Step 3: Pour the hot oil over the scallion mixture and stir in the lemon juice, soy sauce and salt. Step 4: Preheat the broiler. Step 5: Brush the fillets on both sides with some of the scallion oil. Step 6: Arrange on a broiler pan skinned side down Broil until just cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer the fillets to plates. Step 8: Spoon some scallion oil on top. Step 9: Serve with the stir-fried asparagus.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, tabasco sauce, crayfish tails, eggs, salt, peanut oil, onion, cooked rice, bean sprouts, frozen green pea, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl combine soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and 2 tsp tabasco, mix well. Step 2: Stir in crawfish and set aside In another bowl beat eggs with 1 / 4 tsp salt, remaining sesame oil, and tabasco. Step 3: Heat wok or large skillet until hot. Step 4: Add 1 tbsp oil and crawfish mixture. Step 5: Stir-fry 3-4 minutes or until crawfish are done. Step 6: Remove from wok and set aside. Step 7: Add another tbsp oil to wok, add onion.

Ingredient Names: salt, chicken bouillon, sugar, oyster sauce, sesame oil, chicken breast, barbecued pork, shrimp, baby bok choy, broccoli, cauliflower, shiitake mushroom, bamboo shoot, sliced water chestnuts, baby corn
Instructions: Step 1: Immerse egg noodles into boiling water for 30 seconds, then remove and set aside. Step 2: Heat your wok at high heat, keep it dry. Step 3: Add 5 tbsp oil and coat the wok evenly with oil. Step 4: Fry the noodles for about 2 minutes, and keep shaking it back and forth, until the noodles turn golden brown. Step 5: Flip and repeat The outer noodles should be golden, inner ones are soft. Step 6: Remove noodles and arrange in center of a plate Blanch the vegetables in boiling water You can arrange the bok choy in a circle around the noodles if you like. Step 7: Put some oil and fry minced garlic in the work, then add the blanched vegetables and stir fry.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, cornstarch, garlic, salted fermented black beans, oil, gingerroot, ground pork, green onions, eggs, dry sherry, soy sauce, sugar, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the shrimp. Step 2: Rinse thoroughly, pat dry and coat with cornstarch (do this in a small plastic bag, a few shrimp at a time). Step 3: Peel and smash the garlic. Step 4: Rinse the black beans under hot water, then drain well. Step 5: In separate bowls, combine the First and Second Sauces so they are ready to be added. Step 6: Cook the shrimp in boiling salted (1 tsp) water for 30-40 seconds. Step 7: Drain and pat dry. Step 8: Place on a platter. Step 9: Heat a wok and add the oil. Step 10: Heat for 15 seconds, then add the ginger slices. Step 11: Stir until lightly browned, then add the garlic. Step 12: Stir until lightly browned. Step 13: Remove and discard both. Step 14: Add the salted beans, stir for 10 seconds, then add the ground pork or beef. Step 15: Stir vigorously to mix and break up the meat. Step 16: Cook until the meat is no longer pink and add the green onions. Step 17: Stir another 30 seconds, add the shrimp, and stir to mix well. Step 18: Mix the First Sauce quickly and pour down the side of the wok, stirring all the while. Step 19: Shovel the contents of the wok to one side. Step 20: Mix the Second Sauce quickly and pour down the vacated side of the wok. Step 21: Stir to thicken with the point of the spatula. Step 22: Mix with the shrimp, reduce the heat. Step 23: Pour the beaten egg over the shrimp. Step 24: Allow to set for 15 seconds then fold in slowly until soft threads appear. Step 25: Stir gently to mix. Step 26: Remove to a platter and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: salt, rice wine, egg white, cornstarch, sesame oil, shrimp, fresh snow pea, scallions, fresh ginger, ketchup, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimps if necessary, rinse and drain. Step 2: Combine ingredients for marinade. Step 3: Add shrimp, allowing to sit at least 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Prepare seasoning sauce in a small bowl and set aside Trim ends off snow peas Parboil and set aside. Step 5: Heat 1 tbsp oil in wok. Step 6: Stir-fry the snow peas for a few moments, until crisp-tender. Step 7: Season with salt, and place in the center of serving platter.

Ingredient Names: live lobsters, peanut oil, garlic, lean ground pork, fresh ginger root, chicken broth, cooking sherry, soy sauce, cornstarch, brown sugar, green onions, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse lobsters; hold bellies up. Step 2: Stick a long skewer into small openings at bottom of the tails to drain any urine in the bodies. Step 3: Crack the tails off; chop tails into small pieces and place in a bowl. Step 4: Crack the claws in half; add to tails. Step 5: Cut the body up (if you know how to eat a lobster); add to tails and claws. Step 6: Heat 陆 peanut oil in a deep heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Add crushed garlic; cook about 5 minutes. Step 8: Add lobster; cook until cooked through, 4 to. Step 9: Transfer lobster and garlic to a plate; keep warm. Step 10: Heat remaining 陆 oil in the skillet. Step 11: Add pork and minced ginger; cook until pork is no longer pink. Step 12: Add chicken broth; bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 13: Whisk sherry, soy sauce, cornstarch, and brown sugar together in a small bowl until well blended; stir into skillet. Step 14: Cook until thick and becomes somewhat clear, 1 to. Step 15: Stir in green onions; remove from heat. Step 16: Drizzle in beaten eggs; stir until eggs are in little pieces. Step 17: Return lobster to the skillet; cook over low heat to blend the flavors, about 2 minutes. Step 18: Transfer to a serving dish; let stand, covered, before serving, about 10 minutes. Step 19: Serve with steamed rice.

Dish Name: Cantonese Style Pork and Shrimp Dumplings
Ingredient Names: ground pork, watercress, water chestnuts, green onions, oyster sauce, sesame oil, garlic, soy sauce, ground white pepper, salt, dumpling skins, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the pork, watercress, water chestnuts, green onion, oyster sauce, sesame oil, garlic, soy sauce, ground white pepper and salt and mix together well. Step 2: Place ful of this filling onto each dumpling skin. Step 3: Place 1 shrimp on the filling, slightly wet the edge of the dumpling skin, fold over and pinch with your fingers to form a seal all the way around. Step 4: To cook: Pan fry the dumplings in a large skillet over medium heat with oil for 3-4 minutes, turning over halfway through OR Place them in a pot of boiling water for 10 minutes; drain and serve in hot chicken broth.

Dish Name: Chau Har Kau Stir Fried Shrimp With Cucumber Black Wood Fungus
Ingredient Names: egg white, salt, pepper, cornstarch, shrimp, raw shrimp, peanut oil, cucumbers, ginger, garlic, dried black mushrooms, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice wine, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade: mix together all of the ingrediants in a bowl. Step 2: Marinate the shrimp in the refrigerator for 30 minutes For the sauce: mix all of the ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in a wok or skillet and stir-fry the shrimp for 20 seconds. Step 4: Remove, drain, and set aside Reserve the leftover oil. Step 5: Heat 1-2 tablespoons of the reserved oil in the wok and stir-fry the cucumber for 30 seconds. Step 6: Remove, drain, and set aside. Step 7: Heat 1-2 tablespoons of the reserved oil in the wok and add the ginger and garlic. Step 8: Add the shrimp, cucumber, and wood mushrooms to the wok.

Ingredient Names: crab, oil, onion, tomatoes, cayenne pepper, soy sauce, brown sugar, sherry wine, cornstarch, water, salt, egg white, ginger, garlic cloves, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok over high heat, when hot, fry crabs In batches for 2 minutes each batch. Step 2: Remove and keep aside. Step 3: Lower heat slightly, add onion and ground ingredients and stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add canned tomatoes, sugar, soy sauce, cayenne pepper, sherry and let simmer for another 5 minutes or till tomatoes are very soft and starts to form a gravy. Step 5: Check seasonings, add more salt if necessary. Step 6: Add crabs and cornstarch mixture and stir fry for another 4 to 5 minutes or till mixture start to thicken, remove from heat. Step 7: Stir in beaten egg white. Step 8: Remove to a serving dish. Step 9: Garnish with sliced spring onions and ginger strips.

Ingredient Names: squid, cornstarch, plain flour, hot chili powder, sea salt, szechuan peppercorns, vegetable oil, iceberg lettuce, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and dry the squid thoroughly. Step 2: Slice each squid tube horizontally into 1 / 2in rings, set aside. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine both types of flour with the chili powder, sea salt and szechuan pepper. Step 4: Add the squid and toss to coat, shaking off any excess flour. Step 5: Fill a wok with oil to about a third full and heat until the surface seems to shimmer slightly. Step 6: Add half the squid and deep-fry it for between 45 seconds and 1 minute, or until it's just tender and beginning to colour. Step 7: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain well on kitchen paper. Step 8: Repeat the process with the remaining squid. Step 9: Arrange the lettuce leaves on a platter and top with the squid.

Ingredient Names: squid, all-purpose flour, chili powder, sea salt, vegetable oil, red chilies, spring onions, coriander sprig, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Clean squid by gently pulling head and tentacles away from the body Pull out the clear backbone from inside the body and discard entrails. Step 2: Cut tentacles from the head just below the eyes, discard head. Step 3: Remove side wings and fine membrance from body. Step 4: Rinse body, tentacles and wings thoroughly and pat dry with kitchen paper. Step 5: Cut squid down the centre so that it will open flat out, and slice body and wings into 5mm wide strips. Step 6: In a large bowl, combine flour, chilli powder and salt. Step 7: Add squid, including tentacles, and toss to coat, shaking off any excess flour. Step 8: Heat oil in a hot wok until the surface seems to shimmer slightly.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, barbecue sauce, rice wine vinegar, scallions, ginger, chives, napa cabbage, cabbage, extra virgin olive oil, mushroom, white wine, salt, pepper, mayonnaise, mustard powder
Instructions: Step 1: To make salmon: Preheat the grill. Step 2: Leave the skin on the salmon, if desired. Step 3: Place the barbecue sauce, vinegar, scallions, and ginger in a blender and mix Start grilling the salmon to the desired doneness and baste with barbecue sauce mixture as you are grilling If grilling with skin, grill skin side down until the skin is crispy, then turn over and continue basting with barbecue sauce mixture To make the vegetables: Take out the hard bottom center of the greens. Step 4: Slice greens thinly. Step 5: Heat a saucepan over high heat, add oil and saute cabbage, radicchio, and mushrooms quickly.

Ingredient Names: catfish, soy sauce, oriental sesame oil, scallion, red pepper, cucumber, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: In a cup, mix soy sauce, and sesame oil until well combined. Step 3: Set mixture aside Tear off 4-12 inch squares of aluminum foil. Step 4: Place 1 fish filet on one side of each square. Step 5: Sprinkle each filet evenly with some sliced scallion, diced red pepper, diced cucumber and minced ginger. Step 6: Then drizzle each filet with 1 teaspoon soy sauce mixture. Step 7: Fold foil over filets to make packets and seal edges tightly. Step 8: Place packets on a baking sheet. Step 9: Bake for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dry white wine, dark soy sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, salmon steaks, spinach leaves, papaya
Instructions: Step 1: Stir first 5 ingredients in small bowl until sugar disolves. Step 2: Place salmon in nonaluminum pan. Step 3: Pour marinade over. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate 3 hours, turning salmon occasionally. Step 5: Prepare barbeque grill, adjusting rack 1 1 / 2 inches from fire. Step 6: Line platter with spinach Generously grease grill rack. Step 7: Transfer salmon to grill rack, reserving marinade. Step 8: Cook until salmon is opaque, about 9 minutes per inch thickness, turning once. Step 9: Meanwhile simmer marinade in small saucepan until reduced to 4 tablespoons, stirring frequently, about 6 minutes.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, red chile, dry sherry, crabmeat, corn kernels, chicken stock, soy sauce, salt & pepper, spinach leaves, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pot. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, ginger and chili and saute until softened. Step 3: Add sherry and reduce by half. Step 4: Add crab, corn, stock, soy sauce, salt, pepper, and simmer for 8 minutes. Step 5: Stir in spinach and season. Step 6: Remove from heat, Add eggs and stir into pot with a fork, forming ribbons.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, oil, sesame oil, gingerroot, chinese wine, salt, sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat work with both oil. Step 2: Stir fry ginger until fragrant. Step 3: Add prawns and fry for 1 minute. Step 4: Add rice wine and bring to boil. Step 5: Blend in salt and sugar Dish out when prawns are cooked and serve immediately with garnish.

Ingredient Names: fresh white fish, light soy sauce, peanut oil, white pepper, iceberg lettuce, fresh ginger, salt, chicken stock, chinese rice wine, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice the boneless fish and soak in the marinade Shred the lettuce and set aside. Step 2: Cook the ginger, oil and salt just until the ginger begins to brown a little bit. Step 3: Add to the soup stock and bring to a heavy simmer Just prior to serving, drain the marinade from the fish and add the fish to the soup pot, all at once, along with the lettuce and the rice wine or sherry. Step 4: Bring back to a full simmer, then remove from stove Do not overcook the soup. Step 5: Add a few drops of sesame oil and pepper for garnish, and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, olive oil, chinese five spice powder, brown sugar, lime zest, lime, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salt and pepper, sesame oil, shiitake mushrooms, fresh gingerroot, bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Coat fillets with olive oil and place skin-side down in large baking dish. Step 2: Sprinkle fillets with five-spice powder, sugar, lime peel, lime juice, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, and salt and pepper. Step 3: Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat sesame oil in large nonstick skillet. Step 5: Add mushrooms and ginger. Step 6: Cook and stir until mushrooms are soft. Step 7: Stir in bok choy and cook until heated through. Step 8: Serve salmon over mushroom-bok choy mixture.

Dish Name: Chinese Five Spice Salmon With Ginger Broth
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, fresh ginger, star anise, orange zest, salmon fillets, salt and pepper, five-spice powder, sunflower oil, bok choy, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: For broth - place stock, ginger, star anise and zest in saucepan. Step 2: Bring to boil, set aside for 20 minutes for flavours to infuse. Step 3: Cut salmon into 4 portions. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Dust with five spice powder to coat. Step 6: Heat a little oil in fry pan. Step 7: Add salmon skin side up, cook 3 - 4 minutes to brown. Step 8: Turn over and cook 2 minutes more. Step 9: Cut bok choy into half lengthways, cook in boiling, salted water 2 minutes then drain. Step 10: Strain broth, reheat, add soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: egg white, salt, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, water, white sugar, walnuts, mayonnaise, honey, sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, cornstarch, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix egg white and salt together in a bowl; add shrimp and toss to coat evenly. Step 2: Cover and let shrimp marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Step 3: Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan. Step 4: Add sugar; cook until dissolved, about 5 minutes, add walnuts. Step 5: Turn heat down to medium-low. Step 6: Cook, stirring occasionally, until syrup thickens and turns into a dark caramel color, 4 to. Step 7: Line a baking sheet. Step 8: Pour walnuts onto the baking sheet, spacing the pieces apart, let cool. Step 9: Mix mayonnaise, honey, condensed milk, and lemon juice together in a small bowl for the dressing. Step 10: Drain excess liquid from the shrimp. Step 11: Place cornstarch in a plastic sandwich bag. Step 12: Toss shrimp in the cornstarch in batches. Step 13: Heat 2 to 3 inches of oil in a medium to large pot to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 14: Drop shrimp carefully into the hot oil in batches; fry until golden brown, about per batch. Step 15: Drain on paper towels to preserve crispiness. Step 16: Serve shrimp with the walnuts and honey dressing.

Ingredient Names: zatarain's jambalaya mix, water, crab, celery, bamboo shoot, water chestnut, bean sprouts, snow peas, white onion, carrot, cabbage, black pepper, soy sauce, oil, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook zatarain's jambalaya mix according to package instructions, omitting the meat Reserve, heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Add crab and cook until done. Step 3: Add all the vegetables and lightly stir fry leaving vegetables crisp. Step 4: Add the tomatoes Do not overcook. Step 5: Add soy sauce, pepper, and pecans and mix well. Step 6: Add cooked jambalaya, stir to mix well and cook until rice is hot Can be served as an entree or side dish.

Dish Name: Chinese New Year Whole Fish With Sweet And Sour Vegetables
Ingredient Names: fish, salt, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, red chile, spring onions, carrot, red capsicum, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame oil, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Score the fish flesh, cutting 3-4 diagonal slits through to the bone on both sides. Step 2: Season with salt rubbing the salt into the cuts. Step 3: Cook under a preheated grill 4 minutes each side Alternatively bbq it. Step 4: Meanwhile heat a wok, add a little oil, add ginger, chilli and vegetables tossing well over high heat for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add soy and oyster sauces, sugar, vinegar and sesame oil and bring to the boil. Step 6: In a bowl mix cornflour to a smooth paste with some cold water, add to the pan and simmer until sauce thickens. Step 7: Place fish on serving platter and spoon sauce and vegetables over the top.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, salt, shrimp, lean pork, light soy sauce, rice wine, green onion, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, wonton wrappers, vegetable oil, chicken stock, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle salt over the shredded cabbage and let stand for 5 minutes, then squeeze out liquid. Step 2: Squeeze out any liquid from the shrimp. Step 3: Mix cabbage, shrimp, pork, soy, wine, onion, oil, ginger and garlic On each wrapper place about 2 tsp of the mix and seal the edges, use a bit of water on the edge, try to press out all the air and ensure they are tightly sealed In 2 large skillets heat 1 tbsp oil, fry 16 dumplings for 1 minute or until golden on one side add 1 / 4 cup of stock into the pan, reduce heat to low, cover and cook, without turning for about 7 minutes or until the dumpling is translucent and most of the liquid has evaporated uncover and on higher heat cook for another 5-7 minutes or until the bottoms are dark brown, drain put on a platter and keep warm. Step 4: Repeat for the remaining 32 dumplings. Step 5: Mix the dipping sauce and serve with warm or hot dumplings.

Dish Name: Chinese Prawn Cakes With Sweet Chilli Sauce
Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, prawns, spring onions, coriander, fresh breadcrumbs, eggs, salt and pepper, vegetable oil, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place fish and prawns in processor. Step 2: Chop to chunky paste, remove to bowl. Step 3: Stir in onions, coriander and breadcrumbs. Step 4: Season Moisten your hands, and form mixture into small cakes. Step 5: Heat a little vegetable oil in pan or wok and cook cakes in batches until golden brown on both sides. Step 6: Drain on paper towels. Step 7: Serve with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

Dish Name: Chinese Spring Rolls Shanghai Dim Sum
Ingredient Names: unbleached flour, salt, eggs, water, vegetable oil, peanut oil, celery ribs, mung bean sprouts, bamboo shoot, water chestnut, light soy sauce, sugar, crabmeat, oriental sesame oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: For the filling: heat peanut oil in wok or skillet and stir-fry celery, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, soy and sugar 2 minutes. Step 2: Stir in crab and remove from heat. Step 3: Pour off any juices and add sesame oil, green onion, cornstarch and egg slivers. Step 4: Cool and place 3 tablespoons of mixture on edge of spring roll skin. Step 5: Place a coriander sprig on top and fold skin over twice. Step 6: Then fold in sides and roll like jelly roll Deep-fry, seam side down, in hot oil until crisp and golden. Step 7: Drain, cut into 1-inch slices and serve immediately with mustard, chili oil and soy Yield: approximately 18 spring rolls Egg slivers: divide this recipe in half using only 2 eggs.

Ingredient Names: halibut, green onions, fresh mushrooms, napa cabbage, fresh ginger root, garlic, low-sodium soy sauce, water, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh cilantro sprigs
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange 1/2 of the green onions on the bottom of the steaming bowl (it is important to steam in a container in order to retain the steam and juices around the fish). Step 2: Place 1/2 of the mushrooms and Napa cabbage sections on top of onions. Step 3: Place fish on top of vegetables. Step 4: Sprinkle ginger, garlic, and red pepper flakes over fish. Step 5: Top with remaining green onions, mushrooms, and napa cabbage. Step 6: Drizzle soy sauce and water over everything. Step 7: Place steam bowl in a steamer over of boiling water, and cover. Step 8: Steam until fish flakes easily, about 15 to. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro, if desired.

Dish Name: Chinese Steamed White Fish Fillet with Tofu (Cantonese Style)
Ingredient Names: thai chile, garlic, fresh ginger, black bean sauce, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, vegetable oil, white sugar, white pepper, cornstarch, cold water, white fish fillets, tofu, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Bring about 1 1/2 inches of water to boil in a pot fitted with a steamer basket. Step 2: In a large bowl, stir together the chile, garlic, ginger, and black bean sauce. Step 3: Stir in dark and white soy sauces, vegetable oil, sugar, and white pepper. Step 4: In a small cup, mix together the cornstarch and water. Step 5: Stir into the sauce. Step 6: Cut fish fillets into thin strips, add to bowl, and coat well. Step 7: When water in steamer has reached a boil, carefully place the tofu cubes in a single layer in the basket, and steam, covered, for 10-12 minutes. Step 8: Place the fish strips on top of the tofu; cover and steam for another 10-12 minutes. Step 9: Remove and garnish with chopped green onion. Step 10: Serve with steamed white rice and stir-fried or steamed Asian vegetables.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, onion, cornstarch, water, sugar, pepper, oil, salt, sherry wine, curry powder, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Shell and devein shrimp, cut onion in half, slice thinly. Step 2: Blend cornstarch, water, sugar and pepper to a paste, set aside, heat oil. Step 3: Add salt, then shrimp, and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 4: Sprinkle shrimp with sherry. Step 5: Stir-fry until pinkish. Step 6: Remove and set aside.

Dish Name: Chinese Stir Fried Shrimp With Asparagus
Ingredient Names: jumbo shrimp, green asparagus, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic cloves, shaoxing wine, malt vinegar, light soy sauce, white sugar, sesame oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, devein and butterfly the shrimp, leaving tails intact. Step 2: Wash asparagus and snap off tough ends. Step 3: Cut each spear into 4 diagonal cuts. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a hot wok. Step 5: Add half the shrimp and stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 6: Remove shrimp from wok with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 7: Repeat with remaining shrimp. Step 8: Add remaining oil to hot wok. Step 9: Stir in asparagus, thinly sliced ginger and garlic. Step 10: Stir fry for 30 seconds, stirring constantly so that garlic does not burn.

Dish Name: Chinese Style Shrimp Celery And Ginger Pancakes With Soy Ginger
Ingredient Names: small shrimp, fresh ginger, soy sauce, oriental sesame oil, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, eggs, celery, green onion, peanut oil, fresh ground pepper, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl and chill 1 to 4 hours Sift flour, baking powder and salt into large bowl. Step 2: Make well in center and add eggs, mixing until smooth. Step 3: Stir in shrimp with marinade, celery, green onions, slivered ginger and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons peanut oil. Step 4: Season with pepper. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil in griddle or heavy large skillet over medium-high heat Ladle batter onto griddle by scant 2 tablespoonfuls. Step 6: Cook until bottoms are brown, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Turn, gently pressing pancakes with spatula to flatten, and cook until second sides are golden brown and pancakes are cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 8: Transfer to heated platter.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, garlic, fresh ginger root, water chestnuts, snow peas, white button mushrooms, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, ground black pepper, shrimp, peeled and deveined, chicken broth, rice vinegar, fish sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok or large skillet until very hot. Step 2: Cook and stir garlic and ginger in the hot oil until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the water chestnuts, snow peas, mushrooms, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, and shrimp to the pan. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until shrimp turns pink, 2 to. Step 5: Combine the chicken broth, rice vinegar, fish sauce, and dry sherry in a small bowl. Step 6: Pour into the shrimp mixture; cook and stir briefly to combine. Step 7: Combine the cornstarch and water and stir into the wok. Step 8: Stir until sauce has thickened, about 15-20 minutes.

Dish Name: Chinese Tuna With Curry Chive Mayonnaise
Ingredient Names: tuna, sherry wine, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, lemon juice, sesame oil, ground pepper, green onions, minced ginger, water, vegetable oil, mayonnaise, honey, chives, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: For mayo, combine all ingredients in a steel bowl and stir until completely incorporated. Step 2: Refrigerate for later use For marinade, add all ingredients in a steel bowl and stir until well combined. Step 3: Let sit for 2 hours for flavors to blend. Step 4: Marinate tuna steaks in marinade for 2 hours. Step 5: Grill tuna on high heat for 2 minutes on each side. Step 6: Place mayo in a plastic bag, cut off the bottom corner of bag and squeeze sauce across grilled tuna in a "zig zag" pattern.

Dish Name: Chinese eggplant and minced pork - Sichuan Fish Fragrant Eggplant
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggplants, pork ground meat ground pork, ginger, garlic, green onion from green part, pickled red chili, broad bean sauce, cornflour cornstarch, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, honey, black vinegar, water, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: ABBREVIATED - Mix sauce. Fry eggplant until soft. Keep 2T oil. Cook pork 2 min, then garlic, ginger and white part green onion for 30 sec. Cook chilli + broad bean sauce 1 min. Add eggplant and sauce in 2 batches, once thickened, serve! Step 2: Sauce - Mix the cornflour and light soy in a jug until lump free. Add the remaining Sauce ingredients and mix to combine. Set aside. Step 3: Fry eggplant - Heat oil in a wok on high heat until hot - 180°C/350°F. Add half of the eggplant and fry for around 4 minutes, stirring and turning gently a few times, until soft all the way through and a bit browned on the surface. Remove with a slotted spoon onto a paper towel lined tray. Repeat with remaining eggplant. Step 4: Remove oil - Carefully remove the leftover oil from the wok except 2 tablespoons, for cooking. Step 5: Stir fry - Cool the wok slightly then return to high heat. Add the pork and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, breaking it up as you go, until you no longer see pink. Add garlic, ginger, white part of the green onion. Stir fry for 30 seconds. Add pickled red chilli and broad bean sauce. Cook for 1 minute. Step 6: Add sauce - Give the Sauce a quick mix (to dissolve settled cornflour). Add eggplant, then add half the Sauce into the wok, toss gently until the sauce starts thickening - about 30 to 45 seconds. Add remaining Sauce, toss gently for 45 seconds until it thickens (goal: between maple syrup and honey). Step 7: Serve - Turn off heat. Pour into a serving bowl, sprinkle with green onion. Serve with rice! Step 8: Brown eggplant - Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large non-stick pan (with lid) over medium high heat. Pan fry eggplant for 1 1/2 minutes on each side until lightly browned. Step 9: Steam - Carefully add 1/3 cup water around the eggplant (it will steam, so be careful). Immediately cover with a lid to trap the steam. Steam for 2 minutes or until the water has evaporated and the eggplant is soft all the way through (if needed, add more water and keep steaming). Step 10: Proceed - Transfer eggplant to a plate. Proceed with recipe using the large non stick pan rather than wok.

Ingredient Names: mung bean sprouts, fish, cooking oil, szechuan peppercorns, dried chilies, gingerroot, garlic cloves, salt, fresh cilantro, water
Instructions: Step 1: If not already done, clean and gut fish. Step 2: Chop the head and tail off and reserve Split the fish body at the spine and chop the body into 1 wide chunks In your wok, boil several cups of water. Step 3: When water boils, put the mung bean sprouts in and blanch for about 1 minute drain and put blanched sprouts in a large dry bowl Dry wok. Step 4: Pour oil in wok and heat on medium-to-high flame. Step 5: When oil is hot, add the sichuan peppercorns and chilis. Step 6: When they smoke and fill air with their fragrance, add the ginger and the garlic. Step 7: Toss ingredients in the oil for a moment, and then add the fish chunks.

Dish Name: Chow Mein With Shrimp And Pork
Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, oil, shrimp, salt, cornstarch, lean pork, sherry wine, light soy sauce, sugar, bok choy, mushroom, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Drop noodles into boiling water and boil for five minutes. Step 2: Rinse under cold water, drain. Step 3: Mix with 1 tablespoon oil, set aside. Step 4: Mix shrimp with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and cornstarch. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon oil to 400f in wok and stir fry shrimp until they turn pink, about 1 minute, remove. Step 6: Heat 2 tablespoons oil to 400f. Step 7: Stir fry pork until color changes.

Dish Name: Cl Sichuan Shrimp Stir Fry With Broccoli Or Asparagus
Ingredient Names: dark sesame oil, broccoli florets, large shrimp, garlic cloves, fresh shiitake mushroom, sugar, rice vinegar, ketchup, cornstarch, red chili paste, sliced water chestnuts, cooked rice, green onion tops
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 teaspoon sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add broccoli Saut 4 minutes. Step 3: Add 1 teaspoon sesame oil, shrimp and minced garlic Saut 4 minutes or until the shrimp are done. Step 4: Combine sugar, rice vinegar, ketchup, cornstarch and red chili paste, add to skillet. Step 5: Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Step 6: Stir in sliced water chestnuts, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, water, white rice, apple cider vinegar, fish sauce, fresh ginger, salt, sesame oil, white fish fillets, pickled chinese vegetables, chinese roast pork, scallions, crushed peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken stock, water, rice, apple cider vinegar, fish sauce, ginger, salt, and sesame oil in a large stockpot; bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer until congee has thickened to the consistency of a light porridge, about 15-20 minutes. Step 3: Stir fish into congee and simmer until cooked through, about 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Serve congee in bowls topped with pickled vegetables, roast pork, scallions, and peanuts. Step 5: Drizzle vinegar and soy sauce over toppings.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, mayonnaise, soy sauce, crab, sugar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Steam / boil asparagus for 5 min until nice and pretty green then transfer into bowl of ice water. Step 2: Mix mayo, soy sauce, sugar salt and pepper until smooth. Step 3: Cut spears in half and drizzle dressing over crab and asparagus folding the mixture together. Step 4: Refrigerate for 1 hour and hour or eat right away. Step 5: Sprinkle with seaseme seeds if desired.

Dish Name: Crab And Corn Soup Hai Yung Suk Mai Gang
Ingredient Names: crabmeat, water, creamed corn, salt, pepper, cornstarch, egg
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan bring water, crab and corn to a boil. Step 2: Simmer 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add salt and pepper. Step 4: Mix 2 teaspoons water and 2tsp cornstarch together. Step 5: Stir until soup is thickened Quickly stir in the egg and serve Blanch frozen crab meat in boiling water for about 30 seconds. Step 6: Remove from water with a slotted spoon. Step 7: Set aside until ready to add to soup.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, sweetcorn, imitation crab sticks, crab claws, egg, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the stock and add all the other ingredients except for the egg Let cook for five minutes, stir in the egg Serve I said it was easy!

Dish Name: Crab Asparagus Egg Rolls With Three Dipping Sauces
Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrots, asparagus spears, scallions, lump crabmeat, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, canola oil, sesame oil, white pepper, egg roll wraps, rice wine vinegar, fish stock, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: For egg rolls: heat 1 tbsp canola oil in wok or saut pan over medium high heat. Step 2: Add ginger and garlic, toss in oil Saut cabbage, carrots and asparagus for 1-2 minutes, to heat through. Step 3: Add soy sauce, sesame oil and saut for one minute more. Step 4: Lower heat to medium and fold in crab meat and scallions. Step 5: Add white pepper to taste. Step 6: Keep over heat to warm through. Step 7: Remove from heat, and let filling cool. Step 8: Place egg roll wrapper in front of you, point down. Step 9: Place about 3 tbsp of filling towards the lower half.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, pepper, canola oil, sesame oil, yellow onion, crabmeat, light soy sauce, scallion, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly beat eggs with salt and pepper, set aside. Step 2: Heat wok with 2 tsp oil and sesame oil. Step 3: Add onion and fry until soft Push to one side of the wok, add crabmeat or shrimps and stir-fry well. Step 4: Stir in soy sauce, more salt and pepper if desired, then remove crabmeat mixture and set aside. Step 5: Heat the remaining 2 tsp oil in the wok. Step 6: Add beaten eggs Swirl pan around to spread the omelette evenly. Step 7: When eggs have set, add the cooked crabmeat / shrimp mixture and sprinkle with spring onion and red chillies 'fold'in the four corners of the omelette to cover the filling.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, crabmeat, green onions, garlic, worcestershire sauce, reduced sodium soy sauce, wonton wrappers, peanut oil, vegetable oil cooking spray, soy sauce, sweet and sour sauce, hot chinese chili paste, chinese mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except wonton skins until well blended Adjust seasonings, but be gentle with the worcestershire and soy sauces, or the cheese will turn a dirty brown color, which isnt too appetizing. Step 2: Chill cheese well before starting assembly. Step 3: Place 1 rounded teaspoon of filling in the center of each wonton skin Moisten edges with water, and fold in half to form triangles, squeezing out air as you do so Moisten one bottom corner, pull bottom corners down and overlap slightly, pressing them together to seal To prevent wonton skins from drying out too much, prepare just a few at a time, keeping the remaining skins covered with a damp towel. Step 4: Transfer to a tray, cover with plastic wrap, and chill thoroughly before proceeding Your can either deep fry the crab rangoon, which tastes wonderful, or you can bake them, which is much better for you, but not near as crispy It is up to you.

Ingredient Names: crabmeat, reduced-fat cream cheese, steak sauce, garlic powder, wonton wrappers, chinese duck sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix first four ingredients together. Step 3: Set aside Spray wonton wrapper with non-stick cooking spray and place sprayed side down in mini-muffin tin. Step 4: Place a heaping teaspoon of crab mixture in each cup. Step 5: Bake 12-15 minutes. Step 6: Remove from oven and top each with 1 / 2 teaspoon duck sauce.

Ingredient Names: agar-agar, chicken broth, crabmeat, shrimp, lean pork, dried chinese mushrooms, salt, sugar, white pepper, soy sauce, sesame oil, all-purpose white flour, egg, cold water, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Hours or a day before making the dumplings, cook the agar-agar in the chicken broth until completely dissolved. Step 2: Pour into a shallow dish. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for a few hours until it gels. Step 4: Mix all the filling ingredients Dice the gelled agar-agar / broth into small pieces and mix with the filling ingredients. Step 5: Refrigerate this mixture To make the wrappers: Mix flour and egg. Step 6: Add water a little at a time until a soft but not sticky dough is formed. Step 7: Knead until dough is smooth and elastic.

Dish Name: Crab Wontons With Szechuan Blackberry Sauce
Ingredient Names: blackberry, sake, cornstarch, salt, red pepper flakes, ginger, lime juice, garlic cloves, honey, spinach leaves, butter, onions, cream cheese, lemon juice, dry breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: To make the sauce, puree blackberries and mix with remaining sauce ingredients in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil or medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook until thickened Sauce may be made a day ahead To make the filling, wash the spinach With water still clinging to leaves, place in a large pan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cook until spinach just begins to wilt and most of the water has evaporated Empty onto a cutting board and chop fine, set aside. Step 5: Melt butter in a saute pan over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, onion, cabbage, imitation crabmeat, water, chinese five spice powder, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok, saute onion in oil till soft. Step 2: Add cabbage, stir fry till wilted. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients, stir fry 3-5 minutes till thoroughly heated. Step 4: Serve over steamed rice, chow mein noodles, instant ramen, or angel hair pasta.

Dish Name: Crabby Cream Cheese Wontons Crab Rangoon
Ingredient Names: oil, cream cheese, imitation crabmeat, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, worcestershire sauce, green onion, wonton wrappers, egg whites
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl mix cream cheese, imitation crabmeat, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, worcestershire sauce and green onions. Step 2: Place about a teaspoon of the cream cheese mixture in the center of each wonton wrapper. Step 3: Put egg whites in a bowl Use your fingers or a brush to apply the egg whites over two edges of the wonton wrappers. Step 4: Fold into triangles and press to seal edges In small batches, deep fry the won tons until golden brown, 2 to 4 minutes. Step 5: Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, plain flour, cornflour, egg white, water, oil, green ginger, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, chili sauce, sugar, soy sauce, dry sherry
Instructions: Step 1: The strength of the chili sauce will effect how hot this dish is I recommend a sweet chili sauce for those who don't like it too hot. Step 2: Place oil, ginger, garlic, tomato sauce and chili sauce in a pan on medium heat for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and let it simmer on low for a few more minutes. Step 4: Leave the sauce to sit while you prepare the fish. Step 5: Chop the fish into approximately bite-size pieces Sift the flour and cornflour into a bowl. Step 6: Make a well in the flour and add the egg white and water. Step 7: Mix to a smooth batter Coat the pieces of fish with the batter.

Dish Name: Crispy Fish With Sweet And Sour Sauce
Ingredient Names: sea bass fillet, cornstarch, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, baking powder, salt, water, pineapple chunks in juice, sugar, red wine vinegar, hot pepper sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, lemon, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Toss fish pieces with 2 tablespoons cornstarch in medium bowl to coat. Step 2: Mix flour, 3 tablespoons oil, baking powder and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in small bowl Gradually add water, whisking until batter is smooth. Step 3: Pour batter over fish and stir to coat. Step 4: Let stand 15 minutes. Step 5: Whisk remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch, pineapple juice, sugar, vinegar, hot pepper sauce and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt in small bowl to blend. Step 6: Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in heavy medium skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add garlic and stir for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Step 8: Add ginger and lemon peel and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds, remove and discard garlic clove. Step 9: Add bell pepper and stir-fry just to heat through, about 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, water, low-fat milk, pineapple-orange juice, honey, cornstarch, toasted sesame oil, frying oil, sesame oil, all-purpose flour, cinnamon, salt, pepper, sesame seeds, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour, salt, pepper, and cinnamon in a large bowl. Step 2: Add water, milk, and egg and mix until a smooth batter. Step 3: Set aside for 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Now is the time to prepare ahead and get any side items ready to be plated quickly. Step 5: Once you begin battering and frying the shrimp it becomes difficult to keep up. Step 6: Heat the frying oil skillet 1 / 2 inch full to med-med / high Coat all shrimp in cornstarch or a sesame oil / toasted sesame oil mixture. Step 7: Add the coated shrimp to the large bowl of batter and coat well with batter Carefully drop battered shrimp into oil. Step 8: Remove all shrimp onto tray covered with paper towels.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, chicken stock, white wine vinegar, fresh ginger, sugar, flounder fillets, cornstarch, eggs, salt, fresh breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan combine the soy sauce, the vinegar, the gingerroot, the sugar, and pepper to taste and heat the mixture over low heat while preparing the fish Pat the fish dry and season it with salt and pepper Have ready in separate shallow dishes the cornstarch, the eggs beaten with the salt, and the bread crumbs combined with the sesame seeds Dredge each fillet in the cornstarch, coating it thoroughly and shaking off the excess, dip it in the egg mixture, letting the excess drip off, and dredge it in the bread crumb mixture, pressing the mixture to help it adhere. Step 2: In a skillet heat 1 / 4 inch of the oil over moderately high heat until it just begins to smoke, in it fry the fillets, 2 at a time, reheating the oil between batches, for 45 seconds to 1 minute on each side, or until they are golden brown, and transfer them to paper towels to drain. Step 3: Transfer the fillets to plates, bring the soy sauce mixture to a boil, and spoon it over the fish.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, flour, salt, ground ginger, pepper, egg whites, unsweetened coconut, large shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in deep fryer or deep skillet to 325. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix flour, salt, ginger, and pepper. Step 3: Beat egg whites, just until foamy Coat shrimp with flour. Step 4: Dip into egg whites Pat coconut onto shrimp. Step 5: Fry, turning once, for about 2-3 minutes, until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: medium grain rice, water, oil, carrot, dried oysters, dried scallops, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Soaked dried oysters and scallops in cold water separately for at least 2 hours to soften them Retain the soaking liquid Shred the scallops, and cut oysters into small pieces Peel carrot and dice into 0 5cm cubes. Step 2: Wash and rinse the rice several times. Step 3: Place rice in a pot, add water and seafood liquid, and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add oysters, carrots and 1 tsp oil. Step 5: Let the congee boil, then lower heat to let it bubble for 20 minutes. Step 6: Add the shredded scallops, and let congee simmer for 20-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: orange peel, orange juice, soy sauce, water, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, celery, butter, pea pods, bean sprouts, sliced water chestnuts, canned tuna, orange, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce, in a small mixing bowl stir together orange peel, orange juice, soy sauce, water, ginger, and cinnamon, set aside. Step 2: Stir-fry celery in melted butter or margarine for 1 minute, add pea pods. Step 3: Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until pea pods are crisp-tender. Step 4: Stir in bean sprouts and water chestnuts Push vegetables from center of skillet, stir sauce. Step 5: Add to center of skillet. Step 6: Cook and stir until boiling.

Dish Name: Egg Fu Young Peony Flower Eggs
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, reduced sodium soy sauce, arrowroot, sesame oil, chili-garlic sauce, eggs, fresh bean sprouts, raw shrimp, mixed mushrooms, green onions, white pepper, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the sauce ingredients well in a medium bowl. Step 2: Pour into a medium saucepan. Step 3: Bring sauce to full boil until sauce thickens. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Stir as needed before serving, beat eggs. Step 6: Add remaining egg mixture ingredients, combine well. Step 7: Add 1 tablespoon oil to 8-inch saucepan or omelet pan over medium heat. Step 8: Pour enough egg to cover bottom and swirl it around to coat sides.

Dish Name: Egg fried rice with prawns & peas
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, vegetable oil, garlic, red chile, eggs, peas, green onions, shrimp, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put the rice in a saucepan with 600ml water. Bring to boil, cover, then simmer for 10 mins or until almost all the water has gone. Leave off the heat, covered, for 5 mins more. Step 2: Heat the oil in wok or large frying pan. Add the garlic and chilli, then cook for 10 secs – making sure not to let it burn. Throw in the cooked rice, stir fry for 1 min, then push to the side of the pan. Pour the eggs into the empty side of the pan, then scramble them, stirring. Once just set, stir the peas and spring onions into the rice and egg, then cook for 2 mins until the peas are tender. Add the prawns and soy sauce, heat through, then serve with extra soy sauce on the side, if you like.

Ingredient Names: fresh crabmeat, eggs, chicken stock, light soy sauce, oil, fresh ginger, scallions, cornstarch, red wine vinegar, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine crab meat, eggs and stock. Step 2: Add soy sauce and beat lightly with a fork. Step 3: Heat 1 t Of oil in wok over medium-low heat. Step 4: Stir-fry ginger and scallion for one minute, remove and set aside. Step 5: Heat 2 t Of oil in wok over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add crab meat and egg mixture and stir-fry very gently. Step 7: When mixture starts to set, add ginger and scallion. Step 8: Cook for about 2 more minutes then thicken with dissolved cornstarch.

Dish Name: Fast And Easy Scallop Stir Fry For One
Ingredient Names: scallops, soy sauce, dry sherry, garlic clove, ground ginger, sesame oil, cooked broccoli, garlic sauce, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place scallops in a bowl with soy sauce and sherry, garlic, and ginger. Step 2: Let marinate for a few minutes, heat oil to med. Step 3: In a skiller and add scallops and marinade and cook until almost done. Step 4: Add cooked broccoli and stir fry sauce to the pan and simmer until scallops are done, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, water chestnut starch, vegetable oil, mayonnaise, coconut juice, lemon juice, broccoli, sesame seeds, kiwi, strawberry, walnuts, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Cook shrimp in boiling water 5 to 10 seconds. Step 2: Place in colander and rinse with cold water. Step 3: Sprinkle shrimp with water chestnut starch. Step 4: Mix to coat evenly. Step 5: Heat large wok and add enough vegetable oil to fry shrimp. Step 6: Heat oil to 300 degrees. Step 7: When oil is very hot, add starched shrimp and fry 2 minutes With slotted spoon, remove shrimp for 30 seconds, then return to oil and fry for another minute. Step 8: When done, remove and let drain on paper toweling In large bowl, mix mayonnaise, coconut juice and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, shell-on prawns, spring onions, fresh ginger, chicken stock, white sugar, rice wine, soy sauce, chicken bouillon granules, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add prawns; saute until pink, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a plate. Step 4: Pour remaining oil into the wok. Step 5: Add spring onions and ginger; cook and stir until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Return prawns to the wok; cook and stir for 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add chicken stock, sugar, rice wine, soy sauce, bouillon granules, and salt; bring sauce to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat to low; simmer until flavors combine, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Arrange prawns on a serving plate; pour sauce on top.

Dish Name: Fried Rice With Shrimp Pork Shiitake Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, soy sauce, peanut oil, eggs, small shrimp, frozen peas, dried shiitake mushroom, ground pork, roast pork, garlic cloves, cooked white rice, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oyster sauce and soy sauce in small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Step 3: Add 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil. Step 4: Add eggs and cook without stirring, until they just begin to set, about 20 seconds, then scramble and break into small pieces Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until eggs are cooked through. Step 5: Transfer eggs to small bowl and set aside. Step 6: Return skillet to medium heat and heat until hot About 1 minute. Step 7: Add 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil.

Ingredient Names: scallops, rice wine vinegar, salt and pepper, cornstarch, salt, egg, fine breadcrumbs, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash scallops pat dry with paper towel. Step 2: Mix together marinade and let scallops stand in marinade for 15 minutes. Step 3: Combine cornstarch and salt in a plastic bag Shake several scallops in bag dip in egg then in bread crumbs. Step 4: Heat oil in wok to 350. Step 5: Lower heat some and lower scallops into oil and fry until brown about 2 minutes. Step 6: Drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, water chestnuts, bamboo shoot, fresh ginger, salt, black pepper, white wine, cornstarch, egg white, deep frying oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare shrimp by cleaning thoroughly and removing shell, legs and devein Mince the shrimp. Step 2: Combine all of the ingredients except oil use a teaspoon of the mixture and shape into balls. Step 3: Heat oil in a deep pot or skillet and deep fry shrimp balls until golden brown. Step 4: Remove from oil and place onto paper towells to drain excess oil. Step 5: Serve hot Increase the cornstarch to 1 tbs and use one whole egg.

Ingredient Names: prawns, olive oil, sprite, rock salt, pepper, garlic cloves, peppercorn, oregano, curry powder, ground basil, green chili peppers, red bell pepper, parsley, sesame oil, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Remove legs and antennaes from prawns. Step 2: In a bowl, mix sprite, rock salt, pepper -- add prawns in the marinade, refrigerate for 30 minutes For the sauce, heat olive oil in a non-stick pan, saute garlic red and green peppers. Step 3: Add oyster sauce, red pepper sauce, honey, vinegar, liquid seasoning, sesame oil, 1 tbsp minced parsley, peppercorn, oregano, curry powder and basil. Step 4: Whisk until well mixed. Step 5: Put in a bowl and set aside In another non-stick pan, heat olive oil. Step 6: Stir fry prawns for a minute, then pour 1 / 2 cup of the marinade. Step 7: Let marinade boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Then pour in garlic & chili sauce -- mix well.

Ingredient Names: scallops, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, green onions, cornstarch, water, chicken broth, oyster sauce, rice wine, granulated sugar, oil, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the scallops under running water and pat dry. Step 2: In a small bowl, prepare the cornstarch slurry and set aside. Step 3: In a separate bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, oyster sauce, rice wine or sherry or rice vinegar, and sugar to form the sauce, set aside. Step 4: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high to high heat. Step 5: Add the oil to the heated wok. Step 6: When the oil is hot, add the garlic cloves and half the green onion. Step 7: Stir-fry until the garlic is aromatic but not browned as that will give it a bitter edge. Step 8: Add the red bell pepper and the scallops and stir-fry for about 2 minutes, taking care not to overcook the scallops. Step 9: Add the sauce and simmer the scallops and pepper in the sauce, uncovered, for about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: prawns, garlic, white pepper, salt, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Trim prawn whiskers and devein by making a slit along the center of back, rinse. Step 2: Mix garlic, pepper, salt together. Step 3: Season prawn with the mixture, taking care to place some of the mixture inside the slits. Step 4: Set aside for 30 minutes or more. Step 5: Heat oil in wok or skillet and quickly saute prawns until they turn pink Do not overcook. Step 6: Serve with plain rice.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, water chestnuts, fresh jalapeno peppers, fresh ginger, fresh cilantro leaves, scallions, red onion, peanut oil, shrimp, pine nuts, sesame oil, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse off asparagus, snap off tough ends, and cut diagonally into 1 1 / 2 inch lengths Peel the water chestnuts, rinse under cool water and slice thinly Halve the jalapeos. Step 2: Remove the seeds and veins and very finely chop You should have about 2 tablespoons. Step 3: Place in a mound on a platter Peel the ginger and very finely chop to equal about 3 tablespoons. Step 4: Place on the platter with the jalapeos. Step 5: Rinse the cilantro and coarsely chop the leaves Trim the scallions and chop the entire length, including the green part.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, dried chili pepper flakes, medium shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except shrimp, in a medium bowl. Step 2: Stir well to dissolve. Step 3: Add shrimp and stir to coat. Step 4: Cover and place in refrigerator to marinate for 30 minutes, up to 2 hours. Step 5: Put 3-5 shrimp per skewer, depending on size. Step 6: Grill on lightly oiled hot grill until done - approximately 2 minutes per side Large shrimp may not require skewers and be placed individually on the grill. Step 7: Transfer to serving plate and serve hot or warm.

Dish Name: Grilled Prawns With Cilantro And Ginger Sauce
Ingredient Names: prawns, light soy sauce, rice wine, toasted sesame oil, fresh cilantro, chinese white rice vinegar, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the broiler or light a fire in an open grill Peel prawns, discarding shells Optional step: devein prawns using a small sharp knife to partially split the prawns lengthways and remove the fine digestive cord Pat prawns dry with paper towels. Step 2: Mix together the marinade ingredients. Step 3: Add the prawns and set aside for 10 minutes. Step 4: Mix sauce ingredients together and set aside. Step 5: Place prawns on a baking tray big enough to fit under the broiler Alternatively, cook them on a grill over gray coals. Step 6: Cook the prawns for 3 minutes on one side, flip, and cook for 2 minutes on other side.

Dish Name: Grilled Salmon With Creamy Lime Dressing
Ingredient Names: honey, nonfat plain yogurt, fresh lime juice, ginger, garlic, mint, salmon steaks, green grapes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine dressing ingredients in a glass bowl and whisk until creamy. Step 2: Set aside half the dressing to serve with the cooked salmon. Step 3: In a large glass casserole dish, marinate the salmon in the remaining dressing and refrigerate for 1-2 hours. Step 4: Preheat the barbecue. Step 5: Grill salmon for 5-10 minutes per side. Step 6: Meanwhile, warm the reserved lime dressing in a small pan on low To serve, place a salmon fillet on each plate then sprinkle with grapes. Step 7: Serve with extra dressing on the side.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, scallion, water chestnuts, egg white, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, light soy sauce, oil, tapioca flour, wheat starch, boiling water, sesame seed oil, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix filling ingredients together. Step 2: Stir in one direction, mixing thoroughly. Step 3: Refrigerate this mixture for 1 hour. Step 4: Combine dip ingredients and set aside Sift flour and starch together Gradually add boiling water. Step 5: Add oil and let dough cool. Step 6: Knead dough until smooth. Step 7: Divide dough in half and shape each half into a sausage. Step 8: Divide each sausage into twelve pieces.

Ingredient Names: fish fillet, tomatoes, garlic, white onion, ginger juice, olive oil, oregano, basil, cracked black pepper, orange, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Cut a piece of tin foil big enough to wrap round the fish twice. Step 2: Brush the middle portion of foil with olive oil. Step 3: Place the fish fillet on top of the greased foil Rub ginger juice into fish. Step 4: Sprinkle a pinch of pepper on top of fillet. Step 5: Spread the oregano and basil evenly over the top of fillet. Step 6: Sprinkle the finely chopped garlic over the top of herbs Rest the tomato slices on top. Step 7: Arrange the onion rings over the fillet. Step 8: Squeeze the juice of both the orange and the lemon over the whole fillet.

Dish Name: Hoisin Glazed Salmon or Sea Bass
Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, hoisin sauce, soya sauce, sesame oil, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients except the fish. Step 2: Pat fish dry and coat with sauce. Step 3: Preheat barbeque or broiler and cook fish for 5 minutes on each side.

Ingredient Names: hokkien noodles, sesame oil, ginger, shallots, garlic cloves, broccoli, oyster sauce, sweet chili sauce, chicken stock, eggs, bean sprouts, pork loin, prawns, chili oil, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in bowl and cover with boiling water. Step 2: Leave this to stand for 2 minutes, drain well. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Step 4: Add shallots, garlic and ginger and stir fry for 2 minutes, or till fragrant. Step 5: Add eggs, and stir it up till it breaks up. Step 6: Add chinese broccoli or bok choy, oyster sauce, sliced pork and sweet chili sauce to wok and cook for 2 minutes The egg should be coating all the ingredients in wok. Step 7: Add noodles and cook for another 3 minutes, add bean sprouts. Step 8: Pour chicken stock in, and stir well.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, peanut oil, liquid honey, dry sherry, dark soy sauce, chinese five spice powder, garlic, fresh ginger, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together 1 1 / 2 tbs of the oil, the honey, sherry, soy sauce, five-spice powder, garlic and ginger in a bowl. Step 2: Add the shrimp, making sure to coat them evenly with the marinade. Step 3: Cover and marinate for at least an hour or up to 8 hours in the refrigerator. Step 4: Remove the shrimp from the marinade, reserving the marinade. Step 5: Heat a wok over high heat until it smokes, and then add the remaining 1 1 / 2 tbs oil. Step 6: Heat the oil for a couple of seconds, then add the shrimp and stir-fry for a minute, or until they have turned pink. Step 7: Pour in the reserved marinade and the water. Step 8: Cook briskly, stirring constantly and coating the shrimps with the sauce, for about two minutes. Step 9: Remove the shrimps from the wok, and continue cooking the sauce until it is well-reduced and syrupy, a matter of just a minute or so. Step 10: Serve sauce over the shrimps.

Ingredient Names: honey, soy sauce, fresh lemon juice, whole grain dijon mustard, water, horseradish, canola oil, tuna steaks, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl whisk together first five ingredients and set aside Crush sesame seed with a motar and pestle, then spread evenly in a pie plate Coat the tuna steaks with the crushed seeds. Step 2: In a large non stick skillet, heat oil over med high heat, and cook tuna steaks 3-4 minutes per side, until golden and just cooked through. Step 3: Transfer tuna to serving plates. Step 4: Add honey glaze to hot skillet and simmer one minute, then pour over tuna. Step 5: Serve with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Honey Lime Cajun Shrimp Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: lime juice, honey, light soy sauce, cajun seasoning, salt and pepper, raw shrimp, sweet potato, carrots, sugar snap pea, cabbage, red onion, cornstarch, cold water, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients together in a bowl. Step 2: Place the shrimp in a sealable container and pour half the marinade over them. Step 3: Refrigerate for 1 hour to overnight. Step 4: Take the reserved marinade and pour into a wok, heated on high. Step 5: Add vegetables to wok and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes, until vegetables are tender Push the vegetables to the side and add the shrimp. Step 6: Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are pink, about 3 minutes or so. Step 7: Mix the cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup of water and add to the wok to thicken the sauce. Step 8: Cook for about 1 minute. Step 9: Serve over cooked brown rice.

Ingredient Names: water, honey, walnuts, oil, medium shrimp, cornstarch, salt, mayonnaise, granulated sugar, white pepper, vanilla extract, fresh lemon juice, condensed milk, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the water and honey in a quart size pot. Step 2: Bring to a boil and add the walnuts. Step 3: Boil for 2 minutes, then drain and place walnuts on a cookie sheet to dry overnight. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok and deep fry the walnuts and remove and drain into a baking pan line with paper towel and a wire rack. Step 5: Pour the oil into a can and cool and place into the garbage can. Step 6: Place the cornstarch and salt into a bowl and add some of the shrimps and coat the shrimp and remove extras cornstarch and deep fry in oil for a minute or two and drain on a rack. Step 7: Repeat is step until done. Step 8: Cool the oil and pour into a glass jar for use favor oil for stir fry Assemble sauce by whisking together ingredients until smooth. Step 9: Make 4 cups of sauce.
