Ingredient Names: sherry wine, peanut oil, egg white, kosher salt, cornstarch, medium shrimp, snow peas, carrot, fermented black beans, green onions, fresh ginger, dried red pepper flakes, chicken broth, rice vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To make marinade: combine 1 tablespoon sherry, 1 tablespoon oil, egg white and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cornstarch in processor and mix until smooth and thick. Step 2: Transfer to medium bowl or mariniating dish. Step 3: Add shrimp and toss. Step 4: Cover and chill overnight or at least 8 hours. Step 5: Cook snow peas in boiling water 5 seconds, drain and rinse. Step 6: Add snow peas to carrots and set aside. Step 7: In a small bowl combine black beans, chopped green onion, ginger, garlic and red pepper flakes and set aside. Step 8: Combine sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 9: In a small saucepan combine 4 cups water and 1 tablespoon oil and bring to simmer over medium-high heat.

Dish Name: Hot And Sour Shrimp Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: shrimp, low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, fresh shiitake mushrooms, vegetable oil, green onions, fresh snow peas, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp. Step 2: Combine shrimp and next 5 ingredients in a shallow bowl, stir well. Step 3: Cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Discard stems from mushrooms. Step 5: Cut mushrooms tops in half, set aside. Step 6: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add green onions and shrimp. Step 8: Stir-fry 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: tomato ketchup, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, red chilies, fresh gingerroot, jumbo shrimp, boiling water, lime juice, scallions, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients for the sauce and leave on one side. Step 2: Heat a wok or large frying pan, and add the vegetable oil. Step 3: Toss in the chopped garlic, ginger and chilies, and stir fry for about 30 seconds, until the chilies have darkened. Step 4: Add the shrimp and continue frying for about 3-4 minutes - until they turn pink. Step 5: Stir in the sauce, bring to a simmer and pour in the boiling water Sharpen with the lime juice and add the scallions and chopped cilantro. Step 6: Serve straight away with boiled rice.

Ingredient Names: prawns, sherry wine, chili oil, garlic, ginger, green onions, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oil, garlic and ginger in a fry pan or wok. Step 2: Stir and fry until the oil has absorbed the fragrance. Step 3: Add sherry, soy sauce, chili oil and cook about 90 seconds. Step 4: Add prawns, braise until they turn pink and look opaque 60-90 seconds Do not over cook the prawns. Step 5: Add green onion cook 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: skinless boneless chicken breast halves, shrimp, peeled and deveined, soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic, dried red chile peppers, sichuan peppercorns, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, dark soy sauce, white sugar, salted peanuts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken and shrimp in a mixing bowl along with soy sauce, rice wine, and sesame oil. Step 2: Sprinkle with cornstarch, and mix until evenly combined. Step 3: Set aside to marinate for 2 hours. Step 4: Heat 1/2 of the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Step 5: Stir in chicken mixture and cook until chicken has turned white on the outside and is still a bit pink in the center, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Remove chicken mixture and wipe the wok clean. Step 7: Heat remaining vegetable oil over high heat. Step 8: Stir in garlic; cook for a few seconds until garlic begins to turn brown. Step 9: Stir in dried chiles and Sichuan peppercorns; cook and stir for a few seconds until peppers begin to darken. Step 10: Add red and green bell peppers, dark soy sauce, rice wine, and sugar. Step 11: Bring to a boil and stir in chicken mixture. Step 12: Cook until peppers are nearly tender and chicken is no longer pink in the center, about more. Step 13: Stir in peanuts and green onion until green onion becomes limp. Step 14: Stir in a few drops of sesame oil to serve.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, oyster sauce, asian chili sauce, tomato paste, clam juice, cornstarch, sugar, boneless skinless salmon fillet, chili powder, peanut oil, lemon, scallions, garlic cloves, gingerroot, pumpkin seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, chili paste, tomato paste, clam juice, 2 teaspoons of cornstarch, sugar and lemon juice, set aside. Step 2: Toss the salmon in the remaining cornstarch mixed with the chili powder. Step 3: Heat a large wok until smoking. Step 4: Add the peanut oil and gently stir fry the salmon, in 2 batches, until its surface is lightly browned and crisp, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove the salmon with a slotted spoon to a strainer or colander to drain. Step 6: Pour off all but a thin film of the oil. Step 7: Add the scallions, garlic and ginger root and stir fry 10 seconds. Step 8: Return the salmon, add the sauce mixture and simmer until lightly thickened. Step 9: Toss in the pumpkin seeds.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, imitation crabmeat, sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, cooking wine, egg, egg roll wraps, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Chop crab meat. Step 2: Mix cream cheese, crab, sugar, garlic powder, salt and cooking wine well. Step 3: Cut egg rolls into 1 / 4 size about 3 1 / 2 in x 3 1 / 2 inches. Step 4: Put a spoonful of cream cheese mixture into the center of the egg roll skin. Step 5: Spread the beaten egg around the edges of the egg roll skin. Step 6: Fold over the skins to form a triangle shape and pinch the ends together. Step 7: Heat 8 cups of oil to 360f Deep fry the angels for 3-6 minutes or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, shrimp, green onion, cellophane noodles, carrot, water chestnuts, sugar, fish sauce, pepper, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Break up cellophane noodles in to approximately 1-2 inch lengths, and prepare according to package instructions. Step 2: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Step 3: Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the mixture into each egg roll wrapper and roll and seal according to package instructions Deep-fry in small batches of 3-4 eggrolls at 350 degrees until golden brown and delicious, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Drain on paper towels & serve.

Dish Name: Just Like The Restaurant Crab Rangoon
Ingredient Names: cream cheese, soy sauce, garlic powder, green onions, crabmeat, wonton wrappers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cream the cheese, soy sauce, garlic powder, and green onions, stir in crab meat. Step 2: Place 1 teaspoon filling just below center of each won ton wrapper. Step 3: Roll up wrapper, leaving top half unrolled Moisten the right and left corners with water. Step 4: Bring them over filling and press firmly to seal. Step 5: Fry a few at a time in oil heated to 375 degrees 2-3 mins, or until golden brown. Step 6: Drain on paper towel.

Ingredient Names: garlic, prawns, tomato ketchup, water, egg, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Fry garlic in oil until slightly browned. Step 2: Add prawns / shrimps and lightly sear until they start to redden. Step 3: Combine tomato ketchup and water, mix well and add to prawns, stirring constantly. Step 4: Once prawns / shrimps curl and is just about cooked, beat egg and add in. Step 5: Stir and serve when egg is cooked.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, oyster sauce, chili paste, cornstarch, peanut oil, sesame oil, large shrimp, dry roasted peanuts, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the broth, oyster sauce, chile paste, and cornstarch in a small bowl. Step 2: Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Add shrimp and peanuts and cook, stirring, until the shrimp are just barely cooked. Step 4: Transfer them to a plate. Step 5: Heat the sesame oil in the skillet, and saute the bell pepper until just barely tender. Step 6: Then add the garlic and ginger to the skillet with the bell peppers and cook, stirring, until fragrant. Step 7: Add the broth mixture to the pan with the pepper mixture, bring to boil. Step 8: When boiling, add the shrimp and peanuts and simmer until the sauce has thickened, about 1 minute. Step 9: Make sure the shrimp are done.

Ingredient Names: fresh orange juice, red wine vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, vegetable oil, dried red chilies, salt, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, large shrimp, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the orange juice, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and cornstarch. Step 2: In a wok or large frypan, heat the oil over high heat until smoking. Step 3: Add the chiles and salt. Step 4: Stir-fry until browned, 45 seconds. Step 5: Add the onion, ginger and garlic. Step 6: Stir-fry until fragrant, 15 seconds. Step 7: Add the peppers and cook until crisp-tender, 30 seconds. Step 8: Add the shrimp and stir-fry until nearly cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Stir the sauce, add to the wok and cook until thickened slightly, 30 seconds. Step 10: Stir in the cashews and sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: prawns, soy sauce, cornflour, rice vinegar, tomato puree, caster sugar, water, sunflower oil, peanuts, dried chilies, garlic clove, water chestnut, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cornflour and soy sauce, toss in the prawns and set aside for 2 minutes. Step 2: Stir the vinegar, remaining soy sauce, tomato purée, sugar and water together to make a sauce. Step 3: When you’re ready to cook, heat a large frying pan or wok until very hot, then add oil. Step 4: Fry the prawns until they are golden in places and have opened out– then tip them out of the pan. Step 5: Heat the remaining oil and add the peanuts, chillies and water chestnuts. Step 6: Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes or until the peanuts start to colour, then add the ginger and garlic and fry for 1 more min. Step 7: Tip in the prawns and sauce and simmer for 15-20 minutes until thickened slightly, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, green onion, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, fresh gingerroot, sherry wine, honey, tabasco sauce, ground black pepper, garlic, ground turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Puree sauce ingredients in a blender until almost smooth. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400f Lightly oil a baking dish. Step 3: Place fillets, skin side down in dish, pouring half of sauce over fish. Step 4: Bake until fish is just cooked through, about 20 minutes, basting frequently with remaining sauce and adding 1 / 3 c water to dish if sauce begins to burn. Step 5: Arrange fish on platter pouring sauce over.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, dry sherry, soy sauce, egg white, cornstarch, water, broccoli floret, carrot, snow peas, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, dry white wine, scallion, peanut oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the shrimp, reserving the shells for later use. Step 2: Mix sherry, soy sauce, cornstarch, egg white and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 3: Marinate shrimp in above mixture for about 1 / 2 hour Meahwhile, put shrimp shells in a small saucepan, add water to just cover, simmer uncovered for about 1 / 2 hour allowing the water to reduce. Step 4: Heat 1 tsp of the peanut oil in a wok or large frying pan, stir-fry the vegetables until just crisp, and remove from pan. Step 5: Add remaining peanut oil, garlic and ginger to pan and cook just until fragrant. Step 6: Add shrimp mixture and stir-fry for a few seconds, then add white wine and shrimp shell broth and cook for a couple of minutes until liquid reduces. Step 7: Return the vegetables to the pan Thicken the sauce if necessary, using a mixture of another tsp of cornstarch and 2 tbsp of water - you may not need to add all of this cornstarch / water mixture, add some, cook gently, and adjust according to taste. Step 8: When sauce is glossy and of desired thickness, turn out onto a warm plate and garnish with scallions and sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, lettuce leaves, ginger, cooking oil, bamboo shoots, sweet onions, chinese celery, water chestnuts, shiitake mushrooms, egg white, rice wine, cornflour, salt, chicken stock, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix bomboo shoots, sweet onions, chinese celery, water chestnuts and mushrooms together in a bowl. Step 2: Leave the vegetables mixture aside. Step 3: Mix egg white, rice wine, cornstarch and a dash of salt together in a separate bowl and pour it over into the vegetables mixture above Parboil these quickly and drain. Step 4: Heat 3 tbsp of oil in a pan. Step 5: Stir-fry the ginger until fragrant. Step 6: Add in the vegetables mixture to stir-fry. Step 7: When vegetables are about ready, add in the stock, sesame oil, dash of salt, sugar and pepper to season. Step 8: Add in the shrimps. Step 9: Stir-fry till the shrimps are just cooked, then add in the cornstarch solution to thicken.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, lobsters, garlic powder, egg, green onion, wonton wrappers, garlic sauce, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the cream cheese, green onion, garlic powder, egg and sriracha until well combined. Step 2: Add the lobster Ready a small bowl of water This is to help seal the edges of the wonton wrappers Working in groups of about 6 wontons at a time, place about one teaspoon of the cheese filling in the center of each wonton square. Step 3: Using your fingers, wet the wrapper all along the four sides. Step 4: Fold them diagonally corner to corner and pinch the wrapper together to seal Try to squeeze the air out as you make the first fold. Step 5: Bring the two opposite points of the triangle together around front and squeeze together to seal. Step 6: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil.

Ingredient Names: lobster tails, ground pork, green onions, ginger, sherry wine, preserved black bean, eggs, broth, soy sauce, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 2: Saute green onions and ginger 1 minute. Step 3: Add lobster and stir-fry 4 minutes, remove from pan, set aside. Step 4: Heat 2 more tblsp Oil in frying pan until hot. Step 5: Stir-fry pork and salted black beans 5 minutes. Step 6: Add broth, soy sauce, sherry, and salt.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, water chestnuts, scallions, rice wine, fresh ginger, salt & freshly ground black pepper, egg white, cornstarch, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, devein and finely chop the shrimp Finely chop water chestnuts and scallions. Step 2: Mix together the shrimp, water chestnuts, scallions, rice wine, ginger and salt and pepper. Step 3: Beat the egg white until stiff. Step 4: Fold the egg white and the cornstarch into the shrimp mixture. Step 5: Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Step 6: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the balls a few at a time until golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 7: Drain on a paper towel covered rack and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, onions, gingerroot, chili sauce, tomato sauce, crab, egg, oyster sauce, olive oil, black pepper, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Saut garlic, ginger and onions with olive oil until you can smell the lovely aroma. Step 2: Add in tomato and chili sauce, fry until oil surface. Step 3: Add in salt and sugar to taste, stir. Step 4: Then add in the crabs. Step 5: Cover for 10 minutes in medium heat You may add a bit of water if it turn out too dry Break the egg, then slowly stir. Step 6: Cover for another 2 minutes or until the crabs are cooked / turned pink.

Ingredient Names: crabmeat, cream cheese, tabasco sauce, worcestershire sauce, garlic clove, white pepper, egg white, wonton wrappers, oil, mustard powder, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first six ingredients in a food processor. Step 2: Mix well If not using a food processor, mix well with a spoon Wet the edge of each won ton wrapper with egg white. Step 3: Put 1 / 2 tablespoon of the mixture in the center, bring edges together to form a triangle and press well to seal. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan to 375f Deep-fry triangles for 2 minutes. Step 5: Serve with mustard sauce Mustard sauce: stir mustard into water slowly until it becomes a smooth paste. Step 6: Set aside for 15 minutes before using to allow flavor to mellow.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, egg white, cornstarch, salt, sesame oil, white pepper, mango, peanut oil, fresh ginger, garlic, rice wine, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl large enough to hold the shrimp, combine the egg white, cornstarch, 1 / 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sesame oil, and white pepper Pat the shrimps dry, and mix them well with this marinade, making sure all are well coated. Step 2: Leave in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Step 3: Heat a wok or large frying pan until very hot. Step 4: Add 2 tbs peanut oil. Step 5: When the oil is very hot, remove the wok from the heat and add the prawns. Step 6: Stir vigorously to prevent them sticking, return to heat and cook until they turn white, about 2 minutes depending upon the size of your shrimp. Step 7: Remove the shrimp, and discard the oil Wipe wok with paper toweling, removing all residues. Step 8: Return the wok to the heat, again heating until very hot.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, sea salt, black peppercorns, szechuan peppercorns, rice flour, squid, peanut oil, coriander, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast spices in a pan over a low heat until salt starts to turn golden and spices fragrant. Step 2: Place into a mortar and pestle and cool. Step 3: Once cool, grind with the mortar and pestle to a fine consistency. Step 4: Mix through the rice flour. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok or saucepan to 180 degrees celsius. Step 6: Cut squid into thin strips. Step 7: Dust lightly in the flour mix and cook a small batch at a time to retain the heat in the wok to give your squid crunch. Step 8: Drain on absorbent paper and place onto your plate To serve sprinkle some chopped coriander over the top, a bit more salt if you wish and add some lime wedges Great with an asian beer!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh gingerroot, garlic, fat-free chicken broth, cornstarch, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, fructose, crushed red pepper flakes, stir fry vegetables, raw shrimp, fresh cilantro, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in ginger and garlic and cook 3 minutes, until tender. Step 3: Stir together 1 cup broth with cornstarch. Step 4: Add mushrooms, bamboo, soy, vinegar, fructose, crushed red pepper, remaining broth and cornstarch mixture to the pot. Step 5: Bring to a boil and cook until thickened. Step 6: Stir in frozen mixed vegetables, shrimp, and cilantro. Step 7: Simmer until shrimp is opaque, about 10 minutes. Step 8: Stir in spinach until just wilted, 2 minutes, serve at once.

Ingredient Names: fish stock, ginger, lemongrass, fresh lemon rind, mussels
Instructions: Step 1: Place stock, ginger, lemongrass and lemon rind in a saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Bring the broth to the boil then add the mussels and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the mussels open. Step 3: Discard any mussels that don't open. Step 4: Serve mussels in deep bowls with the broth and some bread or with some cooked pasta.

Ingredient Names: dried shrimp, boiling water, napa cabbage, peanut oil, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, water, cornstarch, kosher salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dried shrimp gives this Chinese dish a punch of salty umami flavor. Step 2: You can find it at an Asian grocery store in the frozen or refrigerated section. Step 3: Look for small-sized dried shrimp, about a 1/4-inch in size. Step 4: If you use medium or large dried shrimp, hydrate the shrimp with more water (for medium-sized shrimp, for large) and for longer time (45 to ), then chop it up into smaller 1/4-inch chunks. Step 5: To make this recipe vegetarian, omit the dried shrimp and use four or five dried shiitake mushrooms, rehydrated, and sliced thin. Step 6: Rehydrate the dried shrimp: Place the dried shrimp in a small bowl and pour the boiling water over it. Step 7: Cover with a small plate and let sit for so the shrimp can rehydrate. Step 8: The shrimp will be lighter in color and plump up slightly. Step 9: Prep the cabbage: Meanwhile, split the napa cabbage in half lengthwise. Step 10: Rinse the cabbage and shake it dry. Step 11: Cut out the core of the cabbage and discard. Step 12: Set out two large bowls. Step 13: Cut the remaining cabbage into 1-inch pieces, putting the thicker white pieces at the bottom of the cabbage into one bowl and the top thinner leafy green pieces into the other bowl. Step 14: Drain the shrimp: Once the shrimp has rehydrated, drain it and discard the liquid. Step 15: Cook the shrimp and cabbage: In a large wok or skillet over high heat add the peanut oil, swirling it around to coat the pan. Step 16: Heat until the oil looks shimmering hot, then carefully add the scallions, ginger, and rehydrated shrimp, paying specially attention as the wet ingredients may cause the hot oil to splatter. Step 17: Toss with a spatula until the scallions are bright green and the entire mixture is fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 18: Add the thicker white part of the napa cabbage to the pan and lower the heat to medium high. Step 19: Continue to cook and stir for 3 to, or until the edges of the cabbage pieces start to look slightly translucent but the center of the cabbage pieces are still opaque white. Step 20: Reduce the heat to medium low and add the leafy green pieces of cabbage into the pan. Step 21: Cook until the leaves are wilted, about 10 minutes. Step 22: Make a cornstarch slurry: In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, cold water, and cornstarch, stirring to make a slurry. Step 23: Then pour over the cabbage and continue to cook and stir until a sauce has thickened slightly to the consistency of whole milk. Step 24: Season the stir fry: Season the stir fry with salt and pepper, then taste and add more salt and pepper if you wish. Step 25: The cabbage will be translucent and silky looking, with specks of dried shrimp all over.

Ingredient Names: noodles, shrimp, pork, onion, ginger, garlic clove, green pepper, scallions, eggs, bean sprouts, soy sauce, salt, sugar, sesame oil, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp oil Crack eggs into hot oil and stir fry to scramble, remove. Step 3: Add additional oil to wok if needed, add onions, ginger, garlic, and light green parts of scallion. Step 4: Stir fry for 1-2 minutes until softened. Step 5: Add shrimp, pork and peppers, stir fry until heated through. Step 6: Add needle noodles and stir fry to mix well. Step 7: Add sauce ingredients, continue stirring. Step 8: Add green parts of scallions, bean sprouts, eggs, mix well, serve.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, garlic clove, orange zest, tea, rice vinegar, honey, soy sauce, orange juice, shrimp, salad greens, mandarin orange sections, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Step 2: When butter melts, add the garlic. Step 3: Saute garlic until fragrant and just beginning to turn golden. Step 4: Add orange zest and stir quickly with garlic, about 15 seconds. Step 5: Add tea, vinegar, honey, soy sauce and orange juice to pan and allow to come to a simmer and reduce slightly, a minute or two. Step 6: Add shrimp and continue to cook until prawns are opaque and firm, cooked through. Step 7: Place a handful of greens on each plate. Step 8: Serve shrimp with drizzle of sauce over the greens. Step 9: Garnish with mandarin orange slices and sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: crabmeat, bamboo shoot, lettuce leaves, walnuts, soy sauce, dry white wine, canola oil, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, snow peas, chinese hot mustard, plum sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, wine or juice, garlic, and ginger in a large bowl. Step 2: Add crabmeat, snow peas, and bamboo shoots to soy mixture, mix well. Step 3: Top each lettuce leaf with portion of crab mixture. Step 4: Fold leaves around crab by first turning in the sides, then rolling up. Step 5: Serve on plate scattered with finely chopped toasted walnuts ---serving suggestion--- Make a quick sauce of half chinese hot mustard and half sweet plum sauce. Step 6: Spoon in a zig-zag pattern on each plate. Step 7: Place 3 rolls on top of the sauce, propped like fallen logs.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, honey, white wine, dijon mustard, tuna steaks
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except for tuna in a medium mixing bowl. Step 2: Place tuna in sauce mixture. Step 3: Marinate for 2-3 hours. Step 4: Grill tuna over medium coals for 10 minutes or until cooked throughout, turning once.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, scallions, peanut oil, salt, sugar, gin, fish fillets, soy sauce, dry sherry, rice vinegar, ground pepper, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Combine poaching liquid ingredients with water to bring the mixture within 1 1 / 2 inches from top of fish poacher, dutch oven or lidded pan. Step 2: Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add fish to poaching liquid. Step 4: Cover pan Immediately turn off heat. Step 5: Let fish cook, undisturbed for 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir together soy sauce, sugar, sherry, vinegar, pepper and chicken stock in mixing bowl, set aside. Step 7: Transfer fish to warmed platter. Step 8: Discard poaching liquid.

Dish Name: P F Chang's China Bistro Shrimp Dumplings
Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, medium shrimp, carrots, green onions, fresh ginger, oyster sauce, sesame oil, soy sauce, white vinegar, chili paste, sugar, water, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Take lb Of shrimp and mince fine in a food processor. Step 2: Take the other lb And dice small. Step 3: Combine rest of ingredients With a small spoon, place about oz Of mixture into wonton wrapper Moisten outside edge. Step 4: Fold corner to corner. Step 5: Top should look like cross.

Ingredient Names: white crab meat, cream cheese, light mayonnaise, sriracha sauce, bell peppers, chives, fresh ground black pepper, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Spray a mini muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine crab meat, cream cheese, mayonnaise, sriracha, bell pepper, 2 tsp chives, and pepper. Step 3: Mix until well combined. Step 4: Place 1 won ton wrapper in each 12 mini muffin cups The edges of the won ton wrappers will extend beyond the mini muffin tin cups and may need to be folded slightly. Step 5: Fill the center of each won ton cup with crab mixture. Step 6: Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until edges of cups are golden brown and filling is heated through. Step 7: Garnish with remaining chives.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Shrimp With Lobster Sauce
Ingredient Names: shrimp, cornstarch, white wine, vegetable oil, garlic clove, ground pork, mushroom, green onions, eggs, salt, soy sauce, black bean sauce, sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel shrimp and devein. Step 2: Rinse shrimp and mix with cornstarch and white wine in a bowl. Step 3: Mix sauce ingredients except cornstarch and marinate ground pork for 15 minutes. Step 4: Add oil in wok and heat over medium-high heat. Step 5: Stir in shrimp and cook for 4-5 minutes. Step 6: Remove with a strainer and set aside Reserve oil Reheat wok and add garlic. Step 7: Cook until aromatic, then add the mushrooms and the ground pork, stirring constantly until the color of the pork changes. Step 8: Simmer over medium heat.

Dish Name: Pan Seared Shrimp With Ginger Hoisin Glaze
Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, soy sauce, fresh ginger, water, scallions, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl Follow "base recipe for pan seared shrimp" recipe number 316590, except, subsitute an equal amount of red pepper flakes for black pepper. Step 2: Add hoisin mixture when returning first batch of shrimp to skillet.

Dish Name: Panda Inn's Sweet And Pungent Shrimp
Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, egg white, cornstarch, oil, salt, sugar, catsup, vinegar, sherry wine, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green onions, crushed red pepper flakes, lemon zest, orange zest
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp. Step 2: Slice in halve lengthwise. Step 3: Rinse well pat dry. Step 4: Add the egg white to shrimp mix well. Step 5: Mix 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, add to the shrimp, stir to coat well. Step 6: Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoon oil and mix well again. Step 7: Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Step 8: Remove the shrimp and dust with remaining cornstarch.

Dish Name: Pf Chang's Shrimp With Candied Walnuts
Ingredient Names: water, brown sugar, walnuts, coconut milk, sweetened condensed milk, mayonnaise, rice vinegar, turmeric, celery salt, shrimp, egg whites, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, oil, melon ball
Instructions: Step 1: The the walnuts: Prepare a piece of parchment paper or lightly grease a baking sheet, set aside. Step 2: Combine water and sugar in a saucepan, bring to a boil. Step 3: Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Step 4: Add in the walnuts, stirring constantly. Step 5: Cook for 5-10 minutes or until thickened. Step 6: Place the walnuts on the parchment paper or baking sheet Separating them carefully.

Ingredient Names: butter, peanut oil, garlic, medium shrimp, tofu, pineapple chunk, lemon juice, light soy sauce, sugar, fresh parsley, lemon slices
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, nonstick skillet, heat butter and oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic, shrimp and tofu. Step 3: Saute until shrimp just begin to turn pink, about 4 minutes Push food in skillet to edge of pan and warm pineapple briefly in center. Step 4: Add lemon juice, sugar, soy sauce and parsley Swirl pan to distribute juices and gently mix pineapple with shrimp. Step 5: Transfer mixture to warmed serving platter or individual dishes and garnish with lemon slices.

Dish Name: Pork And Prawn Shrimp Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: pork loin, prawns, oil, light soya sauce, sherry wine, pepper, oyster sauce, sesame oil, garlic clove, gingerroot, chili flakes, chicken stock, vegetables, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into thin strips and add the soya sauce, sherry, half the garlic and ginger to the pork, plus the black pepper mix and leave for at least half an hour for the flavors to merge. Step 2: Set to one side while you shell the prawns if necessary. Step 3: Prepare vegetables, of your own choice, i E Bok choy, bean sprouts, capsicum, onion, broccoli, asparagus, chinese leaf, baby corn--a mixture is great. Step 4: Add the chili, crushed, place to one side Blanche asparagus and broccoli for 2 minutes then add to the other vegetables - this ensures that all the vegetables will cook at the same time. Step 5: In a cup place the stock, sesame oil and oyster sauce together mixing the corn flour with enough water to mix then add to the sauce. Step 6: Drain the marinade off the pork into the stock. Step 7: Heat wok and add half of the oil.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, raw shrimp, sunflower oil, stir-fry mixed vegetables noodles, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put the crushed peppercorns into a medium bowl, then toss with the prawns and a little salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or frying pan over a high heat. Add the prawns and fry for 30 secs without turning. Stir and leave for another 30 secs-1 min until pink. Set aside. Step 2: Heat the rest of the oil in the pan and stir fry the veg and noodles according to pack instructions. Push to the side of the pan, pour the oyster sauce into the empty side, then heat until it bubbles. Toss the prawns back into the pan and stir into the sauce with the noodles and veg for 30 secs until hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, white bread, crabmeat, egg, cornflour, spring onions, plum sauce, prawns, fresh herb, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Grease the recesses of 2 12-hole mini muffin pans. Step 2: Using a 6 5cm round cutter, cut a round from each slice of bread Gently press the bread rounds into the recesses of the mini muffin pans. Step 3: Combine the crab meat, egg yolk, cornflour, spring onions and plum sauce in a bowl. Step 4: Whisk the egg white in a small bowl until foamy. Step 5: Add it to the crab mixture and mix well Peel and de-vein the prawns, leaving the tails intact. Step 6: Place 1 prawn in each bread case, leaving the tail overhanging the edge of the basket. Step 7: Divide the crab mixture between the bread cases, curling the prawn tails around the edge of the cases.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, oil, mushrooms, shallots, celery, prawns, bean sprouts, water, cornflour, chicken stock cubes, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put eggs in bowl. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Beat with rotary beater, only until eggs are slightly frothy. Step 4: Heat small amount of oil in pan Gently saut finely chopped mushrooms one minute. Step 5: Remove from pan, drain, add to beaten eggs. Step 6: Add finely chopped shallots, finely chopped celery, shelled prawns and well-drained bean sprouts, mix well. Step 7: Add enough oil to medium-sized frypan just to cover base when oil is hot, pour omelet mixture into pan using cup to make four small omelets. Step 8: When mixture is firm on one side, separate omelets with spatula.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, canola oil, eggs, ginger, red chilies, prawns, lemon juice, fish sauce, sugar, bean sprouts, green onions, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Place the rice stick noodles in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Step 2: Allow to soak till soft. Step 3: Drain and rinse with cold water. Step 4: Heat 1 tablepsoon of the oil in a wok over high heat. Step 5: Add the eggs, swirl, stir gently and cook until just set. Step 6: Remove from the wok and set aside. Step 7: Add the remaining oil, ginger and chilli to the wok and cook for 1 minute. Step 8: Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes or till they start to turn pinkish. Step 9: Add the noodles, lemon juice, fish sauce and sugar and cook for another 3 minutes. Step 10: Toss through the cooked egg, beansprouts and green onions / scallions.

Ingredient Names: prawns, sesame oil, olive oil, spring onions, garlic cloves, ginger, water chestnuts, red chili pepper, coriander root, coriander leaves, salt and pepper, lime, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sesame and olive oil in wok over medium heat. Step 2: Add spring onions, garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute. Step 3: Turn heat to high and add prawn meat, water chestnuts, chile, coriander root, coriander leaves and black pepper and stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat, season to taste and add lime juice To serve: with a slotted spoon scoop mixture into lettuce-leaf cups and serve.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, peanut oil, red spanish onion, red capsicum, broccoli floret, prawns, hokkien noodles, teriyaki marinade
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into cubes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or deep frypan. Step 3: Add onion, capsicum and broccoli, stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add seafood and carefully stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Step 5: Add hokkein noodles and the teriyaki marinade and stir fry until the noodles are heated through properly, serve.

Ingredient Names: nests egg noodles, fresh broccoli florets, baby corn, olive oil, red peppers, shrimp, tomato ketchup, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles, broccoli and corn in boiling water for 3-4 mins, or until tender. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a large frying pan or wok and fry the pepper for 3 mins, until starting to soften. Step 2: Tip in the noodles and vegetables along with the prawns and toss together. Add the sauce ingredients and heat everything through for 2-3 mins, until piping hot.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, water, tiger shrimp, fresh ginger, garlic, pineapple, orange juice, dry white wine, honey, wine vinegar, soy sauce, butter, vegetable oil, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice with water until it runs clear. Step 2: Place it in a saucepan with a good fitting lid and 400ml of water. Step 3: Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down very low, cover and cook about 10 minutes. Step 4: Turn off the heat and leave for 10 minutes to cook in the steam. Step 5: Meanwhile, defrost the prawns if necessary and remove the shells You can freeze the shells to make fish stock with later. Step 6: Place the orange juice, wine, honey, wine vinegar, soy sauce and slightly less than half the ginger in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 7: Heat the butter and oil in a wok over a high heat You can also use a large frying pan. Step 8: When the butter is bubbling, stir in the prawns, remaining ginger, garlic and flaked almonds.

Dish Name: Quick And Easy Sweet And Sour Shrimp
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, onion, broccoli florets, medium shrimp, sweet and sour sauce, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add the pasta and cook as per package directions and drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 12 inch skillet, over medium-high heat, add onions and cook 2 minutes then add broccoli and continue to cook, stirring, an additional 5 minutes, add shrimp. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 3-5 minutes until shrimp are no longer pink. Step 5: Stir in sweet and sour sauce and the pasta too, tossing with tongs so that ingredients are well blended, remove from heat. Step 6: Divide onto plates and serve immedietly.

Dish Name: Red And White Prawns Shrimp With Green Vegetables Yuan Yang X
Ingredient Names: prawns, salt, egg white, cornflour, snow peas, vegetable oil, light brown sugar, spring onion, ginger, light soy sauce, dry sherry, chili bean sauce, tomato puree
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and de-vein the prawns and mix with the pinch of salt, the egg white and the cornflour past. Step 2: Top and tail the snow peas. Step 3: Heat about 2 to 3 tablespoon of the oil in a preheated wok and stir fry the snow peas for about 1 minute and then add the salt and sugar and continue stirring for another minute, remove and place int he centre of a serving platter. Step 4: Heat the remaining oil, par cook the prawns for 1 minute and then remove and drain. Step 5: Pour off the excess oil, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the wok and add the spring onion and ginger to flour the oil. Step 6: Add the prawns and stir-fry for about 1 minutes, then add the soy sauce and wine or sherry and blend well and place about half of prawns at one end of the platter. Step 7: Add the chilli bean sauce and tomato puree to the remaining prawns in the wok and blend well and then place the red prawns and the other end of the platter and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, baby shrimp, green onion, frozen peas, egg whites, cold water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to a simmer and add shrimp, green onions, & peas let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add egg while whisking the soup to give it the 'shredded' look let simmer for about 2 minutes. Step 3: Mix the cold water and corn starch to the consistency of whole milk. Step 4: Bring to a boil and add corn starch / water to thicken.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, green chilies, sesame oil, coriander, basil, cumin seed, rice paper, oil, black sesame seed
Instructions: Step 1: Wash fish, pat dry on absorbent paper and cut into 12 pieces. Step 2: Place chillies, sesame oil, coriander, basil and cumin seeds in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, and grind until they form a rough paste. Step 3: Spread paste over fish. Step 4: Brush rice papers with warm water and set aside for 4 minutes or until they are soft. Step 5: Place a piece of fish on each round, fold in sides and roll to enclose. Step 6: Heat a little oil in a frypan over medium heat. Step 7: Cook fish parcels for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until rice paper is golden and crispy, and fish is tender. Step 8: Drain on absorbent paper. Step 9: Sprinkle fish with sesame seeds, and serve with steamed asian greens drizzled with oyster sauce and steamed jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: rice wine, water, light soy sauce, white pepper, salt, sugar, cornstarch, fish fillets, sesame oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the rice wine, water, soy sauce, pepper, 1 tsp of the salt, and the sugar to a boil in a skillet. Step 2: Reduce the liquid over high heat to about half its original volume, add the cornstarch mixture, and cook for 30 seconds While the sauce is reducing, rub the fish fillets with the remaining 1 tsp salt and the toasted sesame oil and set aside. Step 3: Add the fish fillets to the liquid and simmer gently for 2 minutes. Step 4: Take it off the heat and let sit for another 5 minutes, covered. Step 5: Transfer the fish fillets to a serving platter, pour the sauce over them, and sprinkle with the green onions.

Dish Name: Salmon And Snow Pea Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: skinless salmon fillet, reduced sodium soy sauce, orange juice, garlic clove, sesame oil, nonstick cooking spray, onion, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: Cut salmon into 1 1 / 2 inch cubes and place in a resealable plastic bag. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, juice, garlic and sesame oil. Step 3: Pour half the marinade into the plastic bag with salmon. Step 4: Marinate the fish for 30 minutes in the fridge Coat a nonstick frying pan or wok with nonstick spray. Step 5: Remove salmon from bag. Step 6: Discard leftover marinade. Step 7: Stir-fry salmon over medium-high heat, about five minutes. Step 8: Turn salmon over gently so that all sides cook evenly Be very careful with the salmon pieces so they stay intact - this was the hardest part for me.

Dish Name: Salmon Salad with Asian Ginger Sesame Dressing
Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, salt, pepper, oil, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, avocado, red radish, leafy crisp lettuce choice, edamame, green onions, crispy fried shallots, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, olive oil, sugar, ginger, garlic, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place Dressing ingredients in a jar and shake well. Step 2: Sprinkle both sides of salmon with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat oil in a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Place salmon in upside down (ie skin side up), cook for 3 minutes or until deep golden. Step 5: Turn and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes, or until cooked to your taste. Step 6: Remove onto plate and cool for 5 minutes. Step 7: Place lettuce in a large bowl. Drizzle with a bit of dressing and toss. Step 8: Place lettuce in a large serving bowl (or individual plates). Top with salmon, then place tomato, cucumber, avocado, edamame and radish in piles around it. Step 9: Sprinkle with green onion and crispy shallots. Step 10: Just prior to serving, drizzle all over with remaining Dressing.

Ingredient Names: light soya sauce, sweet sherry, cider vinegar, granulated sugar, fresh gingerroot, garlic, salmon steaks
Instructions: Step 1: Make marinade in a small saucepan, combining the soya sauce, rice wine, vinegar, sugar, ginger and garlic. Step 2: Simmer until sugar dissolves and liquid is reduced to about 1 / 2 cup. Step 3: Pour into a pan large enough to hold salmon steaks in a single layer. Step 4: Cool to room temperature, add fish, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, turning fish occasionally in marinade. Step 5: Bake in oven at 400 and on broil for the last 3 minutes on each side.

Ingredient Names: maple syrup, soy sauce, garlic, lemon juice, brown sugar, dijon mustard, rice wine vinegar, fresh ginger, salmon fillets, scallion, olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350-degrees fahrenheit Lightly oil a shallow baking pan for the salmon Halibut can be substituted for the salmon, alaskan halibut is preferable over atlantic which is high in mercury. Step 2: In a saucepan, simmer the maple syrup, lemon juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, dijon mustard, rice wine vinegar, ginger, and garlic for 30 minutes. Step 3: Keep the sauce warm while you prepare the fish. Step 4: Arrange the scallions in the pan to form a bed for the salmon. Step 5: Put the salmon, skin down, in the bed of scallions. Step 6: Season the salmon with salt and pepper, and pour the sauce made in over the fish. Step 7: Cook the salmon in the middle of the oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Step 8: Cut the salmon into six pieces.

Dish Name: Salmon Won Tons With Ginger Red Vinegar Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, chinese red vinegar, caster sugar, cornflour, skinless salmon fillet, wonton wrappers, shallots, salt, fresh ground black pepper, vegetable oil, herbs
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dipping sauce, place the ginger in a small heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water and leave to soften for 1 minute, drain well and place in a small serving bowl along with the vinegar and sugar. Step 2: Stir to dissolve the sugar, then set aside Dissolve the cornflour in 2 teaspoons cold water, stirring to form a paste. Step 3: Cut the salmon into 1cm-wide strips that are 6cm in length. Step 4: Place a salmon piece on each won ton wrapper and top with a couple of slices of green shallot. Step 5: Season with a little salt and freshly ground black pepper. Step 6: Brush around the edges of the won tons with some of the cornflour mixture. Step 7: Fold each of the won tons over to enclose the salmon, forming a small rectangle. Step 8: Press to seal the edges, pressing out any air as you do do so The won tons can be stored in the fridge at this stage until you are ready to cook them.

Ingredient Names: skinless salmon fillet, salt, ground black pepper, fresh asparagus, red peppers, green onions, soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, cornstarch, sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot. Step 2: Add fish and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook fish 5-7 minutes or until fish turns opaque throughout, gently stirring occasionally. Step 4: Transfer fish to platter and keep warm. Step 5: To same skillet, add asparagus and red pepper, cook covered for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender/crisp, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Meanwhile in a small bowl, whisk together green onion, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic, cornstarch, sugar and water until well blended. Step 7: Add soy sauce mixture to vegetables and bring to boil. Step 8: Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Step 9: Spoon vegetable mixture over fish and toss gently to coat, serve!

Ingredient Names: squid rings, flour, egg, milk, fresh breadcrumbs, sea salt, szechwan pepper, cracked black pepper, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius Lightly dust calamari with flour shaking off any excess. Step 2: Then dip in to the combined egg and milk. Step 3: Combine breadcrumbs, sea salt and peppers in a shallow bowl, and coat calamari in this mixture. Step 4: Transfer to a plate and place in the fridge for 20 minutes. Step 5: Heat oil in saucepan and deep-fry calamari in batches until golden brown. Step 6: Drain on paper towels. Step 7: Serve with some sweet chilli sauce.

Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, green peppercorn, red peppercorns, white peppercorns, shrimp, salt, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Put peppercorns in a mortar and crush roughly with a pestle Or put peppercorns in a large resealable plastic bag, spread out on a hard, flat surface, and crush with the bottom of a heavy frying pan or rolling pin. Step 2: Put shrimp, half of the crushed peppercorns, and 1 teaspoons salt in a large bowl and toss to coat shrimp evenly, set aside. Step 3: Heat a wok or large pot over high heat. Step 4: Add oil, garlic, remaining crushed peppercorns, and remaining 1 teaspoons salt and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add shrimp and cook, stirring constantly, until pink and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Add cilantro, turn off heat, and toss to combine. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: fenugreek seeds, cumin, onion, ginger, garlic, curry leaf, water, tamarind juice, fish curry powder, salt, sardines, lady finger bananas, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and fry the fenugreek and cumin till fragrant. Step 2: Add onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves. Step 3: Saute till onions are soft. Step 4: Add tamarind water, curry powder, salt and boil for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Add the rest of the ingredients and boil till the ladies fingers are cooked.

Ingredient Names: prawns, onions, oil, water, five-spice powder, chili powder, satay sauce, salt, curry powder, cornflour, sugar, soy sauce, dry sherry
Instructions: Step 1: Shell prawns - using point of small knife, cut each prawn down back and remove back vein and then make deep slit down back of prawn, taking care not to cut right through. Step 2: Combine marinade ingredients in bowl, add the prawns, mix well and stand for 2 hours Peel onion, cut in half then cut each half in wedges. Step 3: Heat oil in large pan or wok, add onions, saute until transparent, approximately 2 minutes. Step 4: Add prawns and marinade mix to wok, saute until prawns have turned light pink and prawns are cooked, approximately 3 minutes, add water and mix well Suggested you serve by arranging lettuce leaves around edge of plate and spoon prawns over or to serve in the traditional style, place small metal bowl in centre of prawns and fill with warmed brandy and set alight and pick up a prawn with chopsticks and hold over brandy flame to heat and flavour prawns as for barbecue prawns.

Ingredient Names: sea scallops, fresh ginger, scallions, water, chinese rice wine, garlic, chicken broth, oyster sauce, soy sauce, cornstarch, sugar, oriental sesame oil, safflower oil, snow peas, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each scallop horizontally in half to make 2 coins Smash 6 slices ginger with flat side of knife. Step 2: Cut 6 scallions crosswise in half and smash. Step 3: Heat smashed ginger and scallions, the water, and 1 / 4 cup rice wine in large saucepan to boiling. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, mince remaining slice ginger and scallion and mix with garlic in small bowl. Step 6: Mix broth, oyster and soy sauces, 1-1 / 2 t Rice wine, the cornstarch, sugar, and sesame oil in mixing bowl. Step 7: Set oyster sauce aside. Step 8: Add scallops to poaching liquid in saucepan and simmer until just cooked through, about 1-1 / 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fermented black beans, fresh ginger, sugar, rice wine, soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh sea scallops, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Soak beans in several changes of cold water, about 5 minutes each time. Step 2: Drain beans and lightly crush half of them. Step 3: Mix beans with ginger, sugar, rice wine, soy and sesame oil. Step 4: Spoon over scallops and scatter with chilli. Step 5: Place scallops in a steamer over simmering water for 4-5 minutes until just cooked, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: scallops, soy sauce, dry sherry, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, green onion, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: For the dipping mix soya sauce and sherry in a bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle scallops with a little pepper. Step 3: Divide the green onion in white and green part. Step 4: Cut both in very fine stripes. Step 5: Cut ginger in very fine stripes. Step 6: Heat oil in a pan over high heat The oil should be very hot. Step 7: Put scallops into the pan an sear for about 30 to 45 seconds, remove from heat. Step 8: Put scallops into the dipping and drizzle some dipping on top.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, dry white wine, peanut oil, green onions, scallops, clam juice, salt, ground cayenne pepper, ground ginger, water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in dry white wine, set aside. Step 2: In a large skillet, heat peanut oil on medium-high heat until almost smoking. Step 3: Remove the skillet from heat and add green onions. Step 4: Return the skillet to heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the scallions are soft. Step 5: Add the scallops to the skillet. Step 6: Cook the scallops for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 7: Add clam juice or broth to the skillet. Step 8: Continue stirring. Step 9: Add salt and red pepper or hot sauce to taste. Step 10: Stir in ginger and water chestnuts. Step 11: Stir in the mixture of dissolved cornstarch and white wine. Step 12: Turn the heat to high, and cook the mixture until it boils and thickens.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, salt & freshly ground black pepper, peanut oil, eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil, scallion, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Devein shrimp if you like If large, cut into bite-size pieces. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Put oil or butter in a large skillet, preferably nonstick or cast iron, and turn heat to medium. Step 4: When hot, add shrimp. Step 5: Cook, stirring, until shrimp is somewhat pink. Step 6: Beat eggs in a bowl with soy sauce and sesame oil. Step 7: Turn heat to medium high and add eggs and scallions. Step 8: Cook, scraping pan with a rubber spatula. Step 9: Fold eggs over themselves, breaking up curds.

Ingredient Names: yellowfin tuna steaks, toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, sesame seeds, kosher salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Rub tuna steaks with sesame oil and soy sauce, cover, and return them to the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Step 2: Pour sesame seeds onto a plate and pat tuna steaks onto seeds to coat evenly. Step 3: Heat an iron skillet to medium high, add the salt, and place sesame crusted tuna steaks on top of salt. Step 4: Cook tuna steaks for 2 minutes per side, being careful not to burn the sesame seeds. Step 5: Serve immediaely, garnished with cilantro sprigs, and serve with sauteed snow peas or asparagus.

Dish Name: Sesame Ginger Pasta With Shrimp And Scallops
Ingredient Names: honey, rice vinegar, fresh ginger, soy sauce, chili paste, oriental sesame oil, orange zest, fresh cilantro, of fresh mint, asian noodles, shrimp, scallops
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients and stir gently I generally will make the sauce the night before to allow the flavors to soak in together, but letting the sauce sit for an hour will do perfectly as well. Step 2: Cook shrimp and scallops in sauce for about 10 minutes. Step 3: Mix sauce with noodles and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: jellyfish, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, sugar, chili sauce, green onion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare jellyfish as directed on package This step usually takes about three hours Jellyfish should be dried and desalted before using. Step 2: Chop the green onion into small pieces. Step 3: Mix the jellyfish, green onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, sugar, and chili sauce together in a bowl or other container. Step 4: Stir so that all the jellyfish strips are coated with the sauce mixture. Step 5: Cover and let sit for at least 30 minutes refrigerated -- the longer the better, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: prawns, fresh gingerroot, spring onion, egg white, cornflour, sesame oil, dark soy sauce, salt, brown bread, white sesame seeds, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the prawns with the ginger, spring onion, egg white, cornflour, sesame oil, soy sauce and salt. Step 2: Spread one side of each slice of bread with the prawn mixture, and dip the filling side into sesame seeds Deep fry the toast in hot oil, over a moderate heat - filling side up until golden brown - about 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Drain on absorbent paper and serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, cider vinegar, soy sauce, honey, vegetable oil, spicy brown mustard, ground ginger, sesame seeds, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Place the salmon in a shallow dish. Step 2: Combine vinegar, soy sauce, honey, oil, mustard, and ginger; pour over salmon. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour, turning once after 30 minutes. Step 4: Drain and discard marinade. Step 5: Broil the salmon or grill, covered, over medium high heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Step 6: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and onions.

Dish Name: Sesame Salmon Fillets And Bok Choy
Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, gingerroot, black peppercorns, salt, egg, salmon fillets, vegetable oil, bok choy, sweet red pepper, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In shallow dish, combine sesame seeds, grated ginger, peppercorns and salt In another dish, lightly beat egg. Step 2: Dip each salmon fillet into egg, letting excess drip off Gently press into sesame mixture, turning to coat In large nonstick skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook salmon, turning once, for 4 to 8 minutes or until golden. Step 4: Transfer to plate Wipe out skillet. Step 5: Add bok choy, red pepper, vinegar, soy sauce and sesame oil to pan. Step 6: Cook, stirring often, for about 3 minutes or until bok choy is wilted.

Ingredient Names: water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, light brown sugar, cornstarch, garlic powder, sesame oil, red pepper flakes, shrimp, unsalted butter, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add the water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, cornstarch, garlic powder, sesame oil and red pepper flakes to a bowl. Whisk well to combine and set aside. Step 2: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the butter and let melt. Add the shrimp and season with salt and pepper. Cook until they just turn pink, about 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate or bowl. Step 3: Increase the heat to high. Give the reserved sauce a good whisk and add to the skillet. Let simmer until thickened, about 3 – 4 minutes. Step 4: Turn the heat down to medium. Add the shrimp and toss to coat. Let cook for 30 seconds. Garnish with sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, ground ginger, ground red pepper, garlic clove, sesame seeds, black pepper, instant rice, sesame oil, sweet red pepper, scallions, teriyaki sauce, sugar snap pea, cornstarch, chicken broth, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In plastic food storage bag, mix shrimp, ginger, red pepper, garlic, sesame seeds, black pepper. Step 2: Put rice in heatproof serving bowl. Step 3: Bring 2 1 / 2 cups water to boiling in saucepan, then pour over rice, cover with foil-set aside In large wok or skillet heat the oil, sweet pepper and scallions Saut for 3 or 4 minutes to slightly soften. Step 4: Add teriyaki sauce, then peas, shrimp, and seasoning Saut for 4 minutes, until shrimp are opaque. Step 5: Stir the cornstarch and broth in small bowl. Step 6: Add to wok / saucepan While stirring cook until bubbly and thickened.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, canola oil, reduced-sodium soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, sugar, fresh ginger, chunk light tuna, sugar snap pea, scallions, napa cabbage, radishes, fresh cilantro leaves, sesame seeds, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk vinegar, canola oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar and ginger in a small bowl. Step 2: Combine 3 tablespoons of the dressing with tuna, peas and scallions in a medium bowl. Step 3: Divide cabbage among 4 plates Mound one-fourth of the tuna mixture in the center of each plate and garnish with radishes, cilantro and sesame seeds. Step 4: Drizzle with the remaining dressing and season with pepper.

Dish Name: Shanghai Pork And Shrimp Spring Rolls
Ingredient Names: sugar, cornstarch, pork tenderloin, medium shrimp, dried shiitake mushrooms, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic cloves, bamboo shoot, bean sprouts, salt, pepper, spring rolls, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, 1 / 2 teaspoon cornstarch, soy sauce, pork, and shrimp in a bowl and stir, set aside. Step 2: In a bowl, rehydrate shitake mushrooms in hot water just enough to cover until softened Depending on mushrooms used this can take anywhere between 15-30 minutes to soften Reserve the liquid for dissolving cornstarch. Step 3: Cut off the stem and cut into very thin match stick pieces. Step 4: In a small cup dissolve 1 1 / 2 t cornstarch with 3 t of reserved mushroom soaking liquid This will be used to thicken the filling mixture. Step 5: Heat 1 1 / 2 t oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and add ginger and garlic. Step 6: Cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned and add pork and shrimp mixture.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, fresh broccoli, olive oil, mushroom, dry sherry, soy sauce, ginger, garlic powder, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, stir-fry shrimp and broccoli in hot oil over high heat for about 3 minutes. Step 2: Add mushrooms Continue to stir-fry an additional 2 minutes or until shrimp are pink and vegetables are crisp tender. Step 3: Stir in remaining ingredients except rice. Step 4: Cook until heated through. Step 5: Serve over hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: green onions, white onion, sesame oil, chinese five spice powder, medium shrimp, garlic clove, mushrooms, egg, low sodium soy sauce, cooked brown rice, bean sprouts, carrot, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: If using frozen shrimp, defrost under cold running water, then clean, de-vein, and remove tails of shrimp If using cooked shrimp or crab, add it when the veggies are almost done. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in wok on medium high heat. Step 3: When oil is hot, add shrimp and stir-fry until pink. Step 4: Then remove them from wok. Step 5: Add garlic and white onion to wok, and after they are soft add the other veggies You can really use just about any veggie with this. Step 6: When veggies are mostly done, move them to the sides of the wok, creating a hole of bare pan on the bottom. Step 7: Pour in beaten egg. Step 8: Let it scramble a bit and break it into smaller pieces.

Dish Name: Shrimp And Mushroom Egg Foo Young Better Than Take Out
Ingredient Names: jumbo eggs, shrimp, mixed mushrooms, green onion, mung bean sprouts, low sodium soy sauce, salt, chicken stock, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Crack all eggs into a bowl and beat until foamy. Step 2: Add 1 teaspoons salt, and shrimp stock, beat well again. Step 3: Chop shrimps, mushrooms, and green onions. Step 4: Place each in their own little bowls. Step 5: In a 6 inch non-stick skillet heat 1 tablespoons vegetable oil until it shimmers. Step 6: Add a small handful of mushrooms and green onions. Step 7: Fry briefly stirring continually. Step 8: Add 1 / 4 of egg mixture to pan on top of mushrooms, and onions Dribble a little of the soy sauce, and salt into egg mixture now and sprinkle a small handful of shrimps, then bean sprouts on top.

Ingredient Names: pineapple, red pepper, scallions, fresh jalapeno peppers, soy sauce, sugar, anchovy paste, turmeric, vegetable oil, small shrimp, garlic, steamed rice, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Peel pineapple and cut up into inch pieces to measure 1 cups. Step 2: Combine pineapple, bell pepper, scallions and jalapeno. Step 3: In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sugar, anchovy paste, turmeric and 1 tblsp water In wok, heat 1 tblsp oil over moderate-high heat until hot but not smoking. Step 4: Stir fry shrimp for 1 minutes or until just firm and transfer to a bowl. Step 5: Heat remaining 1 tblsp oil and stir fry garlic 5 seconds, or until golden. Step 6: Add rice and stir-fry 30 seconds, or until rice is hot. Step 7: Add soy mixture and fry 1 minute. Step 8: Add pineapple mixture and shrimp. Step 9: Stir-fry 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, ground pork, dry sherry, light soy sauce, sugar, salt, cornstarch, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except oil Form into walnut sized balls Deep fry at 350 degrees f If making shrimp toast use sliced white bread cut in quarters. Step 2: Spread mixture on bread keeping it thinner at the edges Deep fry as above Blot on paper towels and serve.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, prawns, egg, white pepper, sesame seed oil, cornstarch, oil, garlic, ginger, onion, bean sprouts, spring onions, cooking wine, oyster sauce, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: SOAK THE RICE NOODLES Soak the rice noodles overnight until they are soft BOIL THE RICE NOODLES Boil the noodles for 8-10 minutes and then rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process of the noodles. Step 2: MARINATING THE SHRIMP In a bowl add the shrimp, egg, white pepper, sesame seed oil, corn starch and oil. Step 3: Mix together well STIR FRY In a wok add oil, shrimp and stir fry them until it is golden brown. Step 4: Set the shrimp aside. Step 5: Add oil to the work and then add minced garlic, ginger and all of the vegetables. Step 6: Add the noodles to the wok Next add sherry cooking wine, oyster sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame seed oil, white pepper, and soy sauce. Step 7: Add back in the shrimp To thicken the sauce, whisk together corn starch and water in a bowl and slowly add to your stir-fry until it's the right thickness.

Dish Name: Shrimp Egg Foo Yong Low Cal Fat Carb
Ingredient Names: canola oil, eggs, yellow onion, bok choy, soy sauce, garlic powder, salt, pepper, bamboo shoot, medium shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Place 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet and cook the onions and cabbage over medium-high heat until tender. Step 2: Remove from the heat, drain and set aside. Step 3: In a bowl, whisk the eggs and add soy sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, drained cabbage mixture and sliced bamboo shoots. Step 4: In a non-stick pan, over medium-high heat, add 2 tablespoons oil and heat until oil is hot Ladle half of cabbage mixture into the hot pan, and then the other half of the cabbage mixture into the pan, as you would for 2 large pancakes and then sprinkle the diced shrimp evenly on top of each. Step 5: Cook about 3 minutes, or until the edges begin to brown and when jiggled, they slide in the pan. Step 6: Turn over and cook another 2 to 3 minites until cooked through.

Dish Name: Shrimp Egg Foo Yong Low Carb And Low Fat
Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, cabbage, eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic powder, salt, fresh ground black pepper, bean sprouts, small shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Place 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet, and cook onions and cabbage over medium-high heat until tender. Step 2: Remove from heat and drain off excess liquid and set the onions and cabbage to the side. Step 3: Whisk eggs in a bowl and mix in soy sauce, sesame oil, spices, onion and cabbage mixture, and sprouts. Step 4: Using a non-stick pan over medium-high heat, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil Ladle about 4 ounces of the mixture into the hot pan, as you would for pancakes, and sprinkle the shrimp evenly on top of each. Step 5: Cook for about 3 minutes, or until edges begin to brown, and when jiggled, they slide in the pan. Step 6: Flip them over and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, cornstarch, dry sherry, peanut oil, bean sprouts, shallots, fresh mushrooms, celery, garlic, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together shrimp, cornstarch and sherry. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok or skillet until hot. Step 3: Add shrimp mixture and stir-fry until pink, remove from wok. Step 4: Add more oil if necessary. Step 5: Add bean sprouts, mushrooms and shallots, stir-fry 1 minute, remove from wok. Step 6: Add a little more oil. Step 7: Stir-fry celery and garlic for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Shrimp Fried Rice A One Dish Meal
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic, shrimp, green onions, sweet red pepper, water chestnuts, celery, light soy sauce, long grain rice, frozen peas, egg, egg white, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or fry pan stir fry the onions in a tbsp of oil until they are crisp & golden, remove from heat and place in small bowl, cover add garlic to the pan fry for1 minutes & remove and add to the onions Get all your remaining veggie ingredients chopped & ready- you may do this early in the day- or cook immediately. Step 2: Put the shrimp, green onions, sweet pepper, waterchestnuts, celery & soy sauce in a bowl cover & refrigerate. Step 3: Mix the rice & peas together in a bowl & cover. Step 4: Beat egg & egg white cover & set aside. Step 5: When you have everthing ready to cook and 10 minutes before serving heat 1 tbsp of oil in a wok or skillet add crisp fried onions & garlic, whisk around the wok for 1 / 2 minute, Add shrimp mixture, stir fry until the shrimp are just starting to turn pink do not over cook. Step 6: Stir in the rice & peas, mix well. Step 7: Add eggs by slowly pouring the egg mixture around the top edge of the wok letting it run down and cook on the way down into the mixture. Step 8: Stir to mix you may now add the broth if you are using it.

Ingredient Names: lo mein noodles, sesame oil, raw shrimp, rice wine, salt, egg white, cornstarch, green onions, bean sprouts, celery rib, bamboo shoot, carrot, water, soy sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Boil lo mein noodles for 3 minutes then drain and rinse in cold water. Step 2: Place in a bowl, toss with 2 tbsp of sesame oil and refrigerate until well-chilled, about 30 minutes Peel and devein shrimp, if necessary. Step 3: Mix together 1 tsp rice wine, 1 / 2 tsp salt, egg white, and cornstarch and pour over shrimp, and marinate 15-20 minutes. Step 4: In a small bowl, mix together 2 cups water, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp rice wine 1 1 / 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tsp sugar, and the 1 / 2 tsp salt. Step 5: Set aside as your seasoning sauce. Step 6: Heat 1 tbsp peanut oil and 1 tbsp sesame oil in wok and add ginger slices. Step 7: Cook until fragrant, then add shrimp and stir-fry until just pink, about 2-4 minutes. Step 8: Add green onions, bean sprouts, celery, bamboo shoots, and shredded carrot and stir-fry another minute. Step 9: Place chilled noodles into the wok and cook, stirring, until the noodles are hot, 2-3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, garlic powder, ground ginger, vegetable oil, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, broccoli, yellow onion, crimini mushrooms, garlic, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain and set aside. Step 3: Meanwhile, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, garlic powder, and ginger in a small bowl until sugar dissolves; set sauce aside. Step 4: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat; cook and stir shrimp in hot oil until they begin to turn reddish-pink, 1 to. Step 5: Add broccoli, onion, and mushrooms; cook and stir until vegetables begin to soften, 3 to. Step 6: Stir in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Step 7: Push shrimp and vegetables to one side of the skillet. Step 8: Cook eggs in the clear space in the skillet, scrambling lightly, until no longer wet, 3 to. Step 9: Stir together cooked eggs, shrimp, and vegetables until combined. Step 10: Add spaghetti and sauce; cook and stir until hot and evenly mixed, about more.

Dish Name: Shrimp Or Chicken With Cashew Nuts
Ingredient Names: shrimp, cornstarch, oil, cashews, dried red chilies, green onion, garlic, onion, green pepper, chicken stock, light soy sauce, red wine vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 2: Mix shrimp with cornstarch. Step 3: Heat oil Deep-fry shrimp until color changes, drain. Step 4: Remove Deep-fry cashews in large strainer until light brown. Step 5: Drain, remove Reheat 2 t Oil in wok.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, sugar, sesame oil, rice vinegar, oil, shrimp, green onions, garlic, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, mushroom
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 7 sauce ingredients, set aside, heat the wok. Step 2: Add oil, swirl to coat. Step 3: Add the shrimp and stir fry 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 4: Add green onions and garlic, cook 30 seconds more Empty the wok, scrape the good stuff and save Reheat the wok, add oil, swirl to coat. Step 5: Add the bell peppers, stir fry 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the mushrooms, stir fry 1 more minute Push the peppers to the sides of the wok.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, carrot, green onion, garlic, fresh ginger, salt, sugar, wonton wrappers, egg, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Filling prep: Puree raw shrimp in food processor until a smooth paste forms. Step 2: Add carrot, green onion, ginger, garlic, salt, sugar and pulse a couple of times Measure a heaping tbls of filling into the center of wonton wrapper, brush beaten egg on top of the four edges and bring corners together and press to seal. Step 3: Let sit in refrigerator for 10 min so that the egg glue sets. Step 4: Prepare a steamer with hot water. Step 5: Once steaming drop a couple dumplings in and steam for 15 minutes -- remove. Step 6: Serve with sauce: Make sauce by simmering ingredients over medium heat for 1-2 minutes, remove from heat and set aside Delicious served hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, lime juice, raw shrimp, vegetable oil, sesame oil, green onions, garlic, fresh ginger, water chestnuts, red chile, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cooked white rice, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the lettuce and separate the leaves Shake off any excess water and dry thoroughly on paper towels. Step 2: Combine soy sauce, oyster sauce and lime juice in a small bowl. Step 3: Set aside until needed If the shrimp are large, cut into smaller pieces. Step 4: Heat a wok over high heat, add the vegetable and sesame oils and swirl to coat the side of the wok. Step 5: Add spring onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the shrimp meat, water chestnuts and chilli, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper and continue to stir-fry for 2 more minutes. Step 7: Add the rice, sprouts and cilantro and stir until combined. Step 8: Pour in the set-aside stir-fry sauce, toss briefly, then remove the wok from the heat.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rye whiskey, powdered ginger, garlic clove, sugar, chicken stock, shrimp, vegetable oil, green peas, water chestnuts, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, whiskey, ginger, garlic, sugar and stock in a large bowl. Step 2: Add shrimp and mix well. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 4: Drain shrimp, reserving marinade. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add shrimp and stir-fry 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Add peas and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 8: Add water chestnuts and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 9: Remove shrimp and keep warm. Step 10: Mix cornstarch with enough cold water to form a thin paste.

Dish Name: Shrimp Stir Fry With Egg Noodles
Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, olive oil, onion, garlic, broccoli florets, red bell pepper, cooked shrimp, water chestnuts, baby corn, bamboo shoots, oyster sauce, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat; stir in noodles and return to a boil. Step 2: Cook until pasta floats to the top, about 1 to; drain. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; cook and stir onion and garlic for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add broccoli and bell pepper; cook and stir until just tender, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in shrimp, water chestnuts, baby corn, bamboo shoots, oyster sauce, and red pepper flakes. Step 6: Continue cooking until shrimp and vegetables are heated through, about more. Step 7: Serve shrimp and vegetables over noodles.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, garlic oil, garlic, fermented black beans, shaoxing wine, fresh coriander, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, salt, pepper, cornstarch, seafood stock
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 2: Heat wok over high heat for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add garlic oil and coat the wok. Step 4: When a wisp of white smoke appears, add garlic and black beans. Step 5: Stir for 30 seconds and add shrimp. Step 6: Mix together, then spread shrimp in a thin layer. Step 7: Cook for 30 seconds. Step 8: Add wine by drizzling around the edges of the wok, mix well. Step 9: When the shrimp begin to curl and turn pink, make a well in the center of the mixture.

Dish Name: Shrimp With Black Beans In Lobster Sauce
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, coarse salt, preserved black beans, garlic cloves, ginger, rice wine, ground pork, soy sauce, chicken stock, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, tapioca starch, eggs, scallions, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation The shrimp- remove the shells from the shrimp and devein by cutting a slit along the back of the shrimp, butterfly, place the shrimp in a bowl, add 2 teaspoons of salt, mix and then rinse under cold water, add another 2 teaspoons of salt, mix and then set aside for 15 or more minutes The salted black beans- rinse the beans briefly, place in a small bowl, add minced garlic, graded ginger, 1-2 tablespoons rice wine and then set aside to soak for 15 minutes The ground pork- in a bowl add the ground pork, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, mix and then set aside The stock- in a bowl add the stock, 1 tablespoon light soy sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, stir and then set aside The thickening agent- in a small bowl add the tapioca powder with water, stir and then set aside The eggs- in a small bowl add the eggs, with the water, mix lightly and then set aside The scallions- wash and clean the scallions and cut at an angle into 1 / 2 inch pieces, set aside The sesame oil- in a small frying pan heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil, keep warm and then set aside in the frying pan, as an option see the Cooking instructions.

Dish Name: Shrimp With Hot Sauce Szechuan Style
Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, cooking oil, dried hot red chili peppers, garlic, carrot, soy sauce, sugar, dark sesame oil, worcestershire sauce, rice wine, cornstarch, water, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together ingredients for the seasoning sauce in a small bowl and keep near the cooking area. Step 2: Stir together the cornstarch and water in a small dish and keep near the cooking area. Step 3: Heat small amount of oil in wok or large skillet. Step 4: Add shrimp and stir-fry until they just turn pink and start to curl. Step 5: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 6: Add a little oil to pan and heat. Step 7: Add dried peppers and garlic to pan and cook just until you start to smell them Do not allow to burn. Step 8: Add the carrots and cook for 1- 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 9: Return the shrimp to the pan and toss with the carrots.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, dry sherry, kosher salt, shrimp, peanut oil, ground ginger, garlic, snow peas, soy sauce, chicken stock, scallions, sesame seed oil
Instructions: Step 1: You can also use sugar snap peas for this recipe. Step 2: Save prep time by prepping the peas, ginger, and garlic while the shrimp is marinating. Step 3: Marinate the shrimp: Mix all marinade ingredients in a large bowl, then add the shrimp, toss to coat. Step 4: Let sit for 15 to while you prep the peas, ginger, and garlic. Step 5: Stir-fry the ginger and garlic: Heat a wok or large sauté pan over high heat for 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add the peanut oil and let it get hot, about 30 seconds. Step 7: Add the ginger and garlic and toss to combine. Step 8: Stir-fry for about 30 seconds. Step 9: Add the shrimp, snow peas, soy sauce, stock: Add the shrimp and all the marinade to the pan (scrape out all the marinade with a rubber spatula). Step 10: Add the snow peas, soy sauce and chicken stock. Step 11: Stir-fry until the shrimp turns pink, about 3-4 minutes. Step 12: Add the scallions and finish with sesame oil: Add the scallions and stir-fry 1 more minute. Step 13: Turn off the heat and add the sesame oil. Step 14: Toss to combine once more and serve with steamed rice.
