Ingredient Names: shrimp, green onion, gingerroot, oil, sesame oil, cooking wine, salt, egg white, chicken broth, sugar, pepper, firm tofu, tomatoes, mushroom, green peas
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ingredients in #1 and marinate the shrimp for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Heat up wok or skillet and add cooking oil. Step 3: Stir-fry the shrimp until pink and just cooked and remove Use oil left in pan and saut the ginger root and green onions until fragrant. Step 4: Add the broth #2 and bring to a boil, then add #3, bring it back to a boil again and cook for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add shrimp back in and #4 to the stir to thicken. Step 6: Add sesame oil and transfer right away to a serving dish.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, rice vinegar, chicken broth, soy sauce, ketchup, cod fish fillets, salt, black pepper, eggs, canola oil, chilies, scallions, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix the 2 tsp corn starch with the 2 tbsp rice vinegar. Step 2: Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, and ketchup. Step 3: Season the fish with 1 / 2 tsp salt and 1 / 2 tsp pepper. Step 4: Spread the 1 / 2 cup of corn starch on a wide plate. Step 5: Put the eggs in a bowl wide enough to dip the largest pice of cod Dredge the fish in the corn starch. Step 6: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a 12 inch non-stick pan over medium high heat until shimmering Move each piece of cod from the corn starch to the egg to coat, then put into the pan. Step 7: Cook on the first side for 3 minutes, then turning the fish, until brown on all sides and a little firm to the touch -- it should not be cooked all the way through. Step 8: Transfer the fish to a large plate.

Ingredient Names: fresh crab, dried red chilies, onions, garlic cloves, egg, dried shrimp, cornflour, tomato ketchup, light soya sauce, ginger, corn oil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Blend garlic, ginger, dried chile, dried shrimp in a blender to form a smooth paste. Step 2: Stir-fry the paste in 30 tbsp of hot corn oil til fragrant. Step 3: Transfer to a deep bowl Clean crabs and cut each into 4-6 pieces Crack the claws with a pestle. Step 4: Stir-fy 10 tsp of minced garlic in 20 tbsp of hot corn oil till fragrant. Step 5: Add crabs and stir-fry for about 10 minute. Step 6: Cover and cook for another minute. Step 7: Uncover and stir briskly once more. Step 8: Add in 1 / 2 cup of water, light soya sauce and 20 tbsp of the paste.

Ingredient Names: noodles, eggs, canola oil, raw shrimp, barbecued pork, celery, green onion, curry powder, stock, soy sauce, bean sprouts, cilantro, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cover noodles with warn water and soak until soft, about 15 minutes, drain and set aside. Step 2: Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat, pour in eggs and swirl to form thin layer on bottom. Step 3: Flip eggs and cook other side briefly. Step 4: Cut omelette into thin strips and set aside. Step 5: Heat 2 teaspoons oil in large nonstick skillet or wok over high heat. Step 6: Add shrimp and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 7: Add barbecued pork and celery and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 8: Remove from heat and stir in green onions and egg strips. Step 9: Remove mixture from pan. Step 10: Heat remaining 2 teaspoons oil in same pan over medium heat.

Dish Name: Singapore noodles with shrimps & Chinese cabbage
Ingredient Names: rice vermicelli, sunflower oil, ginger, curry powder, chinese cabbage, carrot very, chicken stock, brown sugar, vinegar, fresh bean sprouts, green onions, oriental chili oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: If using dried noodles, place in a heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water and leave to soak for 5 mins, or follow the pack instructions. Drain well. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the ginger for 1 min. Add the curry powder and cook for 1 min more. Step 3: Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry for 2 mins. Mix together the stock, sugar and vinegar and add to the pan with the prawns, beansprouts and drained noodles. Cook until piping hot, then stir through the spring onions, divide between bowls and serve with a splash of chilli oil and soy sauce.

Dish Name: Sizzling Chilli Prawns With Egg Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, garlic, spring onion, eggs, coriander, vegetable oil, tabasco sauce, tiger shrimp, soy sauce, dry sherry, cornstarch, fresh breadcrumbs, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Start by washing the rice until the water runs clear. Step 2: Then bring to a boil with 300ml of water. Step 3: Heat until the water is simmering gently, cover the pan and cook for 10 minutes without removing the lid All the water should be absorbed and the grains separate. Step 4: Meanwhile, trim the spring onions. Step 5: Chop the white area and thinly slice the green stalks. Step 6: Keep them in separate piles. Step 7: Beat two eggs with 1 / 2 tablespoon of vegetable oil, a few drops of tabasco and half the coriander leaves. Step 8: Prepare the prawns by removing the shells and de-heading if necessary Stretch out each prawn and run a sharp knife down its back, cutting two-thirds of the way through.

Dish Name: Sliced Fish With Chinese Broccoli On White Rice
Ingredient Names: cod, broccoli, peanut oil, cornstarch, stock, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, egg, rice wine, cooked white rice, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation. Step 2: Remove any fish bones and cut the fish up into bite size pieces, set aside. Step 3: Beat one egg yolk in a bowl, set aside. Step 4: Place about 4 or more tablespoons of cornstarch on a big flat plate and spread out, set aside. Step 5: Remove and discard the leafy part of the chinese broccoli, cut the stems at an angle and into bite side pieces, set a side. Step 6: Grate 2 tablespoons ginger, set aside. Step 7: In a bowl add the stock, ginger, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, sesame oil, salt & white pepper to taste, 1 tablespoons cornstarch, set aside Cooking directions. Step 8: Bring a small pot of water to a boil, add 1 / 8 teaspoon salt and then add the cut up broccoli and par-boil for about 1 minutes, drain and set aside. Step 9: In a wok add 1 tablespoon peanut oil, then add the par-boiled broccoli and cook stir for about two minutes, remove and set aside.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil for frying, shrimp, peeled and deveined, cornstarch, garlic, fresh ginger, cayenne pepper, water, white sugar, white wine, white vinegar, ketchup, salt, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Toss shrimp with 录 cup cornstarch to coat. Step 3: Carefully lower shrimp into hot oil; fry until golden brown, about 45 seconds. Step 4: Drain on paper towels; set aside. Step 5: Remove and discard all but oil from the wok. Step 6: Add garlic, ginger, and cayenne pepper to the wok; cook, stirring continuously, until garlic is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 7: Add 录 cup water, sugar, wine, vinegar, ketchup, and salt; bring to a boil over high heat. Step 8: Dissolve cornstarch in water in a bowl; stir into boiling sauce until thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Add shrimp and green onions; toss to coat.

Dish Name: Soy & ginger salmon with soba noodles
Ingredient Names: thumb-sized ginger, garlic, light soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, salmon fillets, soba noodles, soya bean, baby corn mange tout mix
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix the ginger, garlic, soy and vinegar. Add the salmon and leave to marinate for 10 mins. Heat a large non-stick frying pan. Lift the fish from the marinade with a slotted spoon and fry for 2-3 mins on each side, then tip in the marinade and a splash of water, and bubble for 1 min. Step 2: Cook the noodles following pack instructions. Tip in the soya beans 3 mins before the end, then add the veg mix for the final min. Drain everything really well. Serve the noodles and veg with the salmon and sauce spooned over.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, peanut oil, ginger, red chilies, reduced-sodium soy sauce, chinese wine, brown sugar, white fish fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oils in a skillet over med-high heat. Step 2: Add ginger and chillies and cook for 2 mins, until crisp. Step 3: Add soy sauce, wine and sugar to skillet and simmer 1 min, until sauce has thickened slightly. Step 4: Add the fish, cook in the sauce for approx 3 mins each side or until cooked. Step 5: Serve immediately on top of steamed rice with steamed greens Optional: sometimes i add some garlic too, together with the ginger and chillies.

Dish Name: Soy Glazed Salmon With Cucumber Avocado Salad
Ingredient Names: honey, low sodium soy sauce, cornstarch, salmon fillets, sesame oil, salt, rice vinegar, mayonnaise, english cucumber, green onions, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 Rub fish all over with 1 / 2 tsp of the sesame oil and season lightly with salt. Step 2: Place in oven and bake 5 minutes. Step 3: In a small microwavable bowl, combine the honey, 2 tsp soy sauce and the cornstarch Microwave on high for 30 seconds Baste the filets with the honey soy mixture and return to the oven to continue baking for another 9 minutes. Step 4: In a large bowl, mix together the vinegar, mayo, the remaining 1 / 2 tsp sesame oil, soy sauce and 1 / 4 teaspoons salt. Step 5: Toss with the cucumber and gently fold in the avocado. Step 6: Serve with the fish.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, red onions, mixed vegetable medley, shrimp raw, garlic, thai fish sauce, coriander soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok. Add the red onion and vegetables, then stir-fry for 2 mins until starting to wilt. Throw in the prawns, garlic and fish sauce and cook everything together for 3-4 mins until the prawns change colour and cook through. (If using cooked prawns, you just need to stir them into the rice to warm through before serving.). Step 2: Scatter in the rice, then carry on cooking for 3-4 mins until the rice is piping hot. Serve scattered with coriander and pass round the soy sauce bottle for those who want it.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, peas, oil, onions, streaky bacon, tikka masala curry paste, tiger shrimp if, eggs, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the rice into a pan of boiling, salted water and simmer for 10 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes. Drain well. Step 2: While the rice is cooking, heat the 2 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan or wok. Add the onion and bacon and stir fry for 3-4 minutes, until the onion starts to turn golden and the bacon begins to cook. Stir in the curry paste and cook for a few seconds, then tip in the prawns and heat them through for a minute or so. Step 3: Push the prawn mixture to one side of the pan and add the drop of oil to the other side. Pour the egg into the oil, stir until cooked like scrambled eggs, then mix into the prawns. Add the rice and peas and mix well. Serve immediately, with soy sauce for sprinkling, if you like.

Dish Name: Spicy Cod Fish and Tofu Soup/Sauce by Sy
Ingredient Names: cod, ground pork, tofu, chicken stock, peanut oil, garlic, ginger, cornstarch, water, soy sauce, mild curry powder, cayenne peppers, sugar, rice wine, sesame oil, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot add peanut oil, then garlic and ginger. Step 2: Stir fry for about 15 seconds. Step 3: Add ground meat and stir fry about 1 minute, then add soy sauce. Step 4: Add soup stock, curry powder, cayenne pepper, sugar and heat to a simmer. Step 5: Add fish and simmer for about 3-5 minutes (don't over cook the fish). Step 6: Add tofu, rice wine and cook for about 2+ minutes. Step 7: Then add cornstarch to thicken (stir carefully and making sure not to break up the fish or tofu) Add sesame oil and then scallions and one easy stir. Step 8: Serve in individual soup bowls. Step 9: "SPICY FISH SAUCE" (alternate recipe)- Reduce the stock to 3-4 cups, add about 2 or more tablespoons of cornstarch (for the thickness of the sauce you desire) and bring to a boil to thicken. Then serve on individual plates and with white rice. Step 10: Finally, you can add more spices to taste -- Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: tuna in water, bell pepper, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, egg whites, miracle whip, szechuan hot bean sauce, corn flake crumbs, soy sauce, dried cilantro, lemon juice, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except the cooking spray. Step 2: Heat a skillet on med-high heat and spray with nonstick cooking spray Form 4 patties and place on the skillet. Step 3: Let cook about 5-7 min on each side. Step 4: Remove from heat and enjoy your healthy, tasty meal:).

Dish Name: Spicy Kung Pao Scallops And Orange Rice
Ingredient Names: bay scallop, dry sherry, cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, szechuan oil, sesame oil, hoisin sauce, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, garlic, red peppers, scallion, dry roasted peanuts, converted rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl combine sherry, cornstarch and stir well. Step 2: Add scallops and set aside for 10 minutes. Step 3: In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, sugar, hot szechuan oil, sesame oil and hoisin sauce. Step 4: In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic and stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add scallops, red pepper& scallions and cook, stirring constantly 4 to 5 minutes or until the scallops turn opaque. Step 7: Stir the sauce mixture. Step 8: Add it to the pan and cook, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens. Step 9: Add peanuts and cook 2 minutes. Step 10: Stir in sesame oil.

Dish Name: Spicy Scallop And Snow Pea Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: water, reduced sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, cornstarch, sugar, red pepper flakes, canola oil, scallops, garlic, ginger, orange bell pepper, snow peas, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together 1 / 4 cup of the water with soy sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch until evenly blended. Step 2: Whisk in sugar and red pepper flakes, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat Swirl to coat pan. Step 4: When hot, add scallops. Step 5: Cook undisturbed for 3 minutes until golden brown on one side. Step 6: Transfer scallops to a plate and cover with foil, set aside. Step 7: Add garlic, ginger, bell pepper, snow peas, and remaining 2 tablespoons of water to the pan.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic cloves, scallions, habanero pepper, fresh gingerroot, sugar, tamari soy sauce, white wine, catsup, white vinegar, sesame oil, water, bass fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: saute the garlic, scallions, ginger, and the habanero chili in oil in a saucepan. Step 2: When browned, add the remaining ingredients and cook for 5 minutes Bass: grill the striped bass Depending on the thickness of the filets and the heat of the fire, grill for 8 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Pour sauce on the bass filets. Step 4: Garnish with chopped scallions.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, hot pepper sauce, large raw shrimp, vegetable oil, yellow onion, green bell pepper, carrot, pineapple chunk, kosher salt, tomato sauce, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a zip-lock plastic bag combine together the first six ingredients. Step 2: Add the shrimp and let marinate in the refrigerator for several hours. Step 3: Turn the bag over several times. Step 4: Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the next four ingredients and season with salt. Step 6: Stir-fry for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 7: Remove from skillet. Step 8: Using the same skillet, heat the remaining oil. Step 9: Drain shrimp and discard marinade. Step 10: Add to the skillet.

Dish Name: Steamed Fish With Ginger And Scallions
Ingredient Names: fish fillets, salt and pepper, fresh ginger, scallions, soy sauce, chicken stock, sugar, fresh cilantro, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 2: Place each fish fillet on a large piece of aluminum foil. Step 3: Combine the smashed ginger, scallions, oil and salt and pepper and distribute the mixture among the four pieces of fish. Step 4: Bring up the ends of each piece of foil and close up to form four loose pouches. Step 5: Place the four pouches on a cookie sheet and place in the oven for about ten minutes While the fish is cooking, make the sauce by combing the ingredients and stirring until the sugar is dissolved Open one foil packet and make sure fish is coked through If so, place each piece of fish on an individual serving plate on which you have pooled a tablespoon or two of the warm sauce and garnish with the julienned scallions and ginger. Step 6: Drizzle the hot oil over the fish and serve, with extra sauce on the side.

Ingredient Names: tiger prawns, light soy sauce, garlic, brandy
Instructions: Step 1: Wash prawns thoroughly and leave shells and heads on. Step 2: Mix soy sauce, garlic, and brandy in a bowl. Step 3: Arrange prawns on a dish, and cover with soy sauce mixture. Step 4: Fill a pot or wok about 1/2 full with water. Step 5: Place a steamer basket over the water and bring to a boil. Step 6: Place the dish with prawns onto the steamer basket. Step 7: Cover wok, and steam prawns for 10-12 minutes, until opaque, serve hot.

Dish Name: Steamed Halibut With Chili Lime Dressing
Ingredient Names: limes, kosher salt, sugar, oyster sauce, garlic clove, fresh ginger, chili sauce, halibut fillet, roma tomatoes, cucumber, of fresh mint, thai basil, fresh cilantro, shallots, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: For the dressing. Step 2: Combine the ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Step 3: Taste and adjust seasoning For the fish. Step 4: Steam the filets for 9 to 11 minutes Fan out tomato and cucumber slices on serving platter or on four individual plates. Step 5: Place steamed fish on top of tomato and cucumber. Step 6: Drizzle dressing over fish Rough chop herbs and scatter over the dressed fish. Step 7: Garnish, if you like, with fried shallots and pickled red chilis.

Ingredient Names: water, salmon fillet, gingerroot, chinese rice wine, thai fish sauce, peanut oil, garlic clove, green onions, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To steam in a wok, cross two chopsticks in an x, then cut a groove in the lower chopstick so that the top one fits snugly. Step 2: Set the chopsticks in the wok and add water to 1 inch below the level of the chopsticks. Step 3: Place lid on wok and turn heat to high. Step 4: Place the salmon, skin side down, on a glass pie plate or rimmed glass plate slightly smaller than the diameter of the wok. Step 5: Cover with ginger slices. Step 6: Pour rice wine and fish sauce over fish. Step 7: When the water is boiling, remove the lid from the wok and position the plate containing the salmon and seasonings on top of the chopsticks Replace the lid and cook 7 to 8 minutes, or until the salmon just turns opaque and begins to flake Two to three minutes before the salmon is done steaming, heat the peanut oil in a small skillet over high heat. Step 8: When the oil is very hot, add the garlic and cook until browned.

Dish Name: Steamed Sea Bass With Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: sea bass fillets, black bean garlic sauce, ginger, green onions, peanut oil, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place a rack in a wok or frypan with 1" water. Step 2: Place fish in pyrex pie plate in a single layer. Step 3: Spread black bean sauce over top and side of fish. Step 4: Top with ginger and green onion. Step 5: Drizzle oil over fish. Step 6: Place pie plate on rack, cover and steam for about 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Step 7: Remove and garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, mirin, green tea leaves, cornstarch, dried black mushrooms, soft tofu, white fish fillet, bamboo shoot, minced ginger, salt, white pepper, baby bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce: while fish is steaming, combine sauce ingredients in a small saucepan. Step 2: Bring to boil over medium-high heat and cook, stirring until sauce thickens slightly Fish: in a bowl, soak mushrooms in warm water to cover until softened, about 15 minutes, drain. Step 3: Discard stems and cut each cap into 3 slices. Step 4: Prepare a stir-fry pan for steaming. Step 5: Cut tofu into 4 pieces and place in a heatproof dish. Step 6: Arrange fish, mushrooms, and bamboo shoots over tofu. Step 7: Sprinkle with ginger, salt and pepper. Step 8: Arrange bok choy around outside of fish.

Ingredient Names: skinless salmon fillet, oyster sauce, teriyaki sauce, honey, oil, ginger, garlic, red chili amd, mixed green vegetables we used bok choi
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Place the salmon on a baking tray. Mix together the oyster sauce, teriyaki and honey, then brush a little over the fish. Roast for 8-10 mins until glazed and just cooked through. Set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok, then fry the ginger, garlic and chilli for 1 min. Stir-fry the broccoli or any larger, harder veg for 3 mins, then add the leafy veg and cook for 1-2 mins more. Stir in the rest of the sticky sauce, heat through and serve with the fish.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Prawns In Chilli Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: oil, prawns, garlic, ginger, bean sprouts, spring onions, asparagus, capsicum, chicken stock, soya sauce, oyster sauce, chili bean sauce, sesame oil, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Shell the prawns, remove the heads, devein and cut in half, the flesh should be about the size of your thumb -, of if you have small prawns double the amount, shell etc but do not cut in half. Step 2: Place in a small bowl, cover and place in the fridge Blanch the asparagus, and add to the bean sprouts ginger, garlic, red capsicum and spring onions. Step 3: In a measuring cup make the 1 / 2 cup of chicken stock and add the oyster sauce both the soya sauces, the sesame oil and the chilli bean sauce add the cornflour mixed in enough water to make a thick paste. Step 4: Heat the wok, adding the oil and stir fry the vegetables, ginger and garlic until cooked but still crisp I do my chinese cooking a different way by then putting the vegetables in a warm dish in the oven then, adding a dash more oil toss the prawns in and stir fry for just a couple of minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken stock and the rest of the ingredients to the prawns, bring to the boil and immediately add the vegetables back to the wok, stirring to get the sauce mixed through the dish, Serve immediately with plain boiled noodles of your choice - absolutely delicious.

Ingredient Names: prawns, leeks, red chili pepper, fresh ginger, oil, light soy sauce, mirin, chicken broth, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails intact. Step 2: Rinse the leeks well. Step 3: Cut them first into 1 1 / 2 inch lengths and then lengthways into fine shreds Slit open the chilli, remove and discard the seeds and cut the flesh into fine shreds. Step 4: Cut the ginger into fine shreds. Step 5: Heat a little of the oil in a wok and stir-fry the prawns in batches until just pink. Step 6: Remove from the wok. Step 7: Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the leeks, chilli and ginger over high heat for 40 seconds, then push to one side of the wok. Step 8: Return the prawns to the wok and stir-fry for about 1 1 / 2 minutes, or until just cooked through. Step 9: Add the soy sauce and mirin to the pan.

Ingredient Names: scallops, salt, asparagus spears, vegetable oil, bamboo shoots, carrot, fresh gingerroot, white pepper, rice wine, chicken stock, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the scallops with half the salt. Step 2: Let stand for 20 minutes Trim the asparagus, discarding the tough ends. Step 3: Cut into 2-inch pieces and blanch in a large pan of boiling water for 30 seconds. Step 4: Remove and drain on paper towels, set aside. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a preheated wok or deep pan over high heat. Step 6: Add the scallops and stir-fry 30 seconds. Step 7: Remove, drain on paper towels, set aside. Step 8: Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the wok or pan over high heat.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, light soy sauce, dry sherry, fresh ginger, peanut oil, garlic cloves, green onions, kosher salt, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the shrimp, in shells, for about 15 minutes in the soy sauce, sherry, and ginger, drain. Step 2: Stir-fry in a hot pan with the peanut oil and garlic until the color of the shrimp changes to pink. Step 3: Add the green onions, salt and sesame oil. Step 4: Toss until the onions barely wilt. Step 5: Serve hot and let guests remove the shells right at the table!

Dish Name: Stir Fried Shrimp In Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, assorted fresh vegetables, chicken broth, rice wine vinegar, light soy sauce, sesame oil, chili paste, dry sherry, vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, thai chiles, cornstarch, water, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix together chicken broth, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, chile paste and sherry. Step 2: Set aside In another small bowl or cup, stir together the tbsp of cornstarch with the 3 tbsp of water and set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil over medium-high heat in a wok. Step 4: Add ginger and garlic and sizzle briefly, then add vegetables and thai chilies. Step 5: Stir-fry vegetables for approximately 3 minutes, then add the shrimp. Step 6: Cook the shrimp 2 minutes or until it curls and turns opaque or pink. Step 7: Add the sauce mixture and cook 1 minute more. Step 8: Then stir in the thickener and stir-fry until mixture thickens, about 1 minute. Step 9: Serve with hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, lemon juice, rice vinegar, brown sugar, dry sherry, garlic, ground black pepper, cornstarch, large scallop, fresh snow pea, fresh white mushroom, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, onion, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse scallops well, pat dry. Step 2: Wash and remove ends from snow peas, slice mushrooms 1 / 4" thick, cut peppers into 1 / 2" pieces. Step 3: Divide marinade in half. Step 4: Toss scallops with 1 / 2 marinade. Step 5: Heat oil in wok and stir fry scallops about 4-5 mins. Step 6: Remove scallops and set aside. Step 7: Stir fry vegetables until tender crisp About 3-4 mins. Step 8: Place all ingredients back into wok, add remaining marinade. Step 9: Stir until heated through.

Dish Name: Stir Fry Shrimp With Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: soya sauce, water, rice wine, rice vinegar, cornstarch, sugar, sesame seeds, peanut oil, shrimp, broccoli, green onions, garlic, sliced water chestnuts, baby corn
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the sauce ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Heat the wok Toast sesame seeds'til golden. Step 3: Set aside Reheat wok. Step 4: Add oil Swirl to coat, add shrimp. Step 5: Stir fry 2 minutes, set aside.

Ingredient Names: groundnut, fat garlic, red peppers, raw tiger shrimp patted dry, soy sauce, baby spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok until you can feel a good heat rising. Add 2 tbsp oil and, a few secs later, the garlic slices. Stir-fry until they start to turn golden, then using a slotted spoon, spoon onto kitchen paper to drain. Step 2: Toss in the pepper and stir-fry for 1 min or so until softened, then scoop out and set aside. Add the remaining tbsp oil. Heat, then toss in the prawns and stir-fry for another 2-3 mins until cooked and beginning to brown. Add the soy or fish sauce. Step 3: Throw in the spinach and stir-fry until it begins to wilt. Return the peppers and crisp garlic to the wok, then serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, oyster sauce, hoisin sauce, fish sauce, ginger matchsticks, king shrimp, bok choi, straight-to-wok noodles, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large saucepan, bring the stock to the boil. Stir the sauces into the stock, then add the ginger. Simmer for a moment, then add the prawns: if raw, simmer for 2 mins until they turn pink; if cooked, add together with the bok choi, then cook for 2 mins more until just wilted. Step 2: Slip all the noodles into the broth, then gently stir to loosen them. Bring the liquid back to a simmer, then cook for 2 mins more to warm them through. Scatter with spring onions and serve straight from the wok, using tongs for the noodles and a ladle for the broth.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, ketchup, sesame oil, sugar, cornstarch, eggs, flour, panko breadcrumbs, kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, sole fillets, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make the sauce: Set a small saucepan over medium heat and stir together 1 / 4 cup water and the vinegar, soy sauce, ketchup, sesame oil, sugar and cornstarch. Step 2: Bring this to a simmer and cook, stirring, until the sauce thickens - about 1 minute. Step 3: Keep warm Prep the fish: Lightly beat the eggs in a shallow pie dish. Step 4: Spread the flour on one plate and the panko on another plate. Step 5: Season the flour with a pinch each of the salt and pepper. Step 6: Season the sole with a bit of salt on each side and then dip them first into the flour, then into the egg and finally the panko, coating each side evenly You may want to press the panko into the fish with your finger.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Shrimp Fried Rice
Ingredient Names: brown basmati rice, water, sea salt, carrots, red bell pepper, green onion, fresh ginger, fresh pineapple, canola oil, unsweetened coconut, bean sprouts, shrimp, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, stir the rice over medium high heat until lightly toasted. Step 2: Add the water and salt and bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Step 4: Meanwhile, wash, trim and peel the carrots, then cut into slices Halve the bell pepper, remove the seeds, rinse and cut into squares Trim the green onion and cut into thin rings Peel the ginger and cut into very thin strips Peel and halve the pineapple and cut away core and any brown spots. Step 5: Chop flesh of pineapple. Step 6: In a wok or large skillet, heat the oil over medium - high heat.

Ingredient Names: prawns, egg white, fresh lime leaves, sweet chili sauce, corn flakes, rice flour, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place prawn meat, egg white, lime leaves, sweet chili sauce, corn flakes and rice flour in a food processor and process till the mixture is combined, but not smooth With wet hands, shape the mixture into small cakes. Step 2: Heat enough oil in a frying pan over medium heat to shallow fry. Step 3: Add prawn cakes a few at a time and cook for 3 minutes on each side, or till golden brown. Step 4: Place the cooked prawn cakes on kitchen towels to soak up the excess oil. Step 5: Serve with the extra sweet chili sauce.

Ingredient Names: dory fillets, egg white, cornstarch, salt, tomatoes, onion, green pepper, red chili pepper, pineapple chunk, gingerroot, chicken broth, light soy sauce, rice wine, ketchup, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade the fish in the egg white, cornstarch and salt for about 15 minutes Deep-fry until golden brown, then drain on paper towels. Step 2: Fry ginger in 2 tbsp oil for 30 seconds. Step 3: Then add the onions, green pepper, chilli and pineapple cubes Saut well. Step 4: Add tomatoes and saut for 40 seconds. Step 5: Add the sauce mix and pour inches boil and then add cornstarch and water mix. Step 6: Let it boil and thicken a bit. Step 7: Take off the heat and toss fish in, coating it well.

Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, cornflour, egg white, chinese wine, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, spring greens, garlic clove, gingerroot, chili bean paste, dark soy sauce, chicken stock, fresh egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cut fish into bite size pieces and mix with the cornflour, egg white and 1 tablespoon rice wine. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a hot wok and stir fry fish for 1 minute. Step 3: Pour in any remaining marinade and remaining rice wine. Step 4: Add water chestnuts and bamboo shoots and stir-fry for a further 30 seconds. Step 5: Remove the fish mixture, give the wok a quick wipe, then heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and stir fry spring onion, garlic and finger for 20 seconds. Step 6: Add bean paste, soy sauce and chicken stock, cook stirring, for 1 minute, then return fish mixture to the pan. Step 7: Meanwhile cook the egg noodles in a pot of boiling water for 1 minute, drain well, add noodles to the wok and toss well and heat through. Step 8: Serve on a warmed serving platter or in chinese bowls.

Ingredient Names: water, ketchup, soy sauce, cornstarch, honey, crushed red pepper flakes, ground ginger, vegetable oil, green onion, garlic cloves, cooked shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, stir together water, ketchup, soy sauce, cornstarch, honey, crushed red pepper, and ground ginger, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Stir in green onions and garlic, cook 30 seconds. Step 4: Stir in shrimp, and toss to coat with oil, stir in sauce. Step 5: Cook and stir until sauce is bubbly and thickened.

Ingredient Names: mixed vegetables, water, large shrimp, chicken-flavored ramen noodles, shrimp flavor ramen noodle soup
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, combine frozen vegetables and contents from sauce packet from meal starter, water and shrimp. Step 2: Cook over high heat until vegetables and shrimp are thawed, stir occasionally, bring to a boil. Step 3: Add noodles and contents of seasoning packet from chicken soup mix. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium and simmer 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Step 5: Sprinkle each serving with peanuts from meal starter.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti noodles, large raw shrimp, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, dark sesame oil, snow peas, red bell pepper, carrot, ginger, water, cornstarch, green onion, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain, keep warm. Step 2: Combine shrimp, soy sauce and red pepper flakes in a small bowl, toss to coat, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in large non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add snow peas, bell pepper, carrots, ginger and garlic. Step 5: Stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 6: Remove shrimp from bowl, reserving soy sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, pork steak, vegetable oil, onion, bell peppers, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Rehydrate mushrooms for 20 minutes then drain cut pork into thin strips. Step 2: Heat oil in large pan. Step 3: Add pork and stir fry quickly for 3-5 minutes or until cooked through. Step 4: Add chopped mushrooms, onions and bell peppers and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add oyster sauce and cook for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Serve over white rice If the pan looks on the dry side at the end of cooking time, i'll add a few more ounces of oyster sauce and stir to heat it through That way, there's plenty of sauce for my rice I don't have a wok, so i cook this in my electric frying pan-i've found that if i cover the pan after adding the vegetables and oyster sauce, and lower the heat, there tends to be more sauce, so i can use just the 8 oz Also-you can rehydrate the mushrooms in advance to save on actual prep time when it's time to cook dinner if time is an issue.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, ground ginger, garlic cloves, green onions, fresh cilantro, sesame oil, soy sauce, fish sauce, maple syrup, slivered almonds, salt and pepper, banana leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper to taste, mix thoroughly. Step 4: Place a fillet on each banana leaf or a piece of parchment paper and divide mixture evenly amongst them, spreading the mixture over the top of each fillet. Step 5: Fold each banana leaf, or the paper, over to form a packet around each fillet and seal the edge of each packet with a small piece of aluminum foil, crimping it tightly. Step 6: Place on a baking sheet in the middle of the oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Step 7: Remove from oven and the wrapping Lightly brush off most of the topping and sprinkle a few slivered almonds on top of each fillet for garnish if desired. Step 8: Serve with stir-fried chinese vegetables.

Dish Name: Tofu And Shrimp Stir Fry Xia Ren Dou Fu
Ingredient Names: salt, pepper, shrimp, oil, garlic cloves, tofu, chili pepper, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Salt and pepper the shrimp. Step 2: Put in 1 tablespoon oil and 1 garlic clove. Step 3: When golden, add shrimp. Step 4: When pink take out. Step 5: Add oil and garlic. Step 6: When golden, add tofu Lightly brown. Step 7: Add shrimp garlic mixture, add chili pepper, add soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: fresh crabmeat, cream cheese, steak sauce, garlic powder, wonton wrappers, egg yolk, oil, chinese mustard, chinese red sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine crabmeat with cream cheese, steak sauce and garlic powder in medium bowl and blend to a paste. Step 2: Place heaping teaspoon on each won ton Gather four corners of won ton together at top Moisten edges with egg yolk and pinch or twist together gently to seal. Step 3: Heat oil in wok, deep fryer or electric skillet to 375 degrees. Step 4: Add won tons in batches and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Step 6: Serve hot with chinese mustard and / or red sauce for dipping.

Ingredient Names: triple sec, soy sauce, thyme, chinese five spice powder, garlic cloves, salmon fillets, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-sized bowl, mix together the triple sec, soy sauce, thyme, five spice, and garlic. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 375. Step 3: Prepare a large baking dish by thinly spreading the olive oil on the inside Thinly slice the onion and peppers. Step 4: Place the salmon fillets inside of the baking dish, arrange the onions and peppers on top of each fillet, and then season them with the salt and pepper. Step 5: Pour the triple sec mixture over the top of the fillets. Step 6: Cover and bake in the oven for 20-30 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Dish Name: Tsr Version Of P F Chan Gs Shrimp Dumplings By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: water, soy sauce, granulated sugar, rice vinegar, green onion, chili oil, raw shrimp, carrot, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, salt, sugar, wonton wrappers, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Make dipping sauce by simmering ingredients over medium heat for a minute. Step 2: Remove the sauce from the heat and sit it aside to cool. Step 3: Make shrimp filling for the dumplings by pureeing the shrimp in a food processor until it makes a smooth paste. Step 4: Add carrot, green onion, ginger, garlic, salt and sugar and pulse it to mix all ingredients Measure a heaping tbsp of the filling into the center of the wonton wrapper. Step 5: Brush beaten egg on each of the four edges, bring two oppostie corners up to meet in the middle and press together over the filling, then bring the other two corners up and pinch all the edges together making a square package with sealed edges. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining ingredients and let the dumplings sit in the refrigerator for about ten minutes so that the"egg glue" sets up. Step 7: Prepare the steamer with hot water. Step 8: When the water is simmering nicely, drop in the dumplings and steam for 12-15 minutes. Step 9: Serve immediately if you want steamed dumplings.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, egg, garlic clove, onion, broccoli floret, red bell pepper, chicken broth, tuna, sesame oil, cooked white rice, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and cook the egg until it forms a pancake. Step 2: Take it out of the skillet and cut it into strips. Step 3: Add the rest of the oil to the pan and stir-fry the garlic, onion, broccoli and red pepper for 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken broth and cook, covered, until the broccoli is tender. Step 5: Remove the cover, add the tuna, sesame oil, rice and cooked egg. Step 6: Raise the heat and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the soy sauce and cook, stirring, 2 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, sesame oil, large shrimp, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, pea pods, bean sprouts, eggs, converted white rice, mushroom broth, soy sauce, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick skillet or wok, heat oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Add some of the grated garlic and ginger for 30 seconds Next add shrimp and cook quickly until they turn pink. Step 3: Remove and set aside If needed, add a little more canola oil to wok. Step 4: Add beaten eggs I swirl the wok to coat the bottom with the egg It will cook very quickly. Step 5: Once eggs are set, you can chop them up smaller pieces. Step 6: Then remove from the pan and set aside as well.

Ingredient Names: halibut fillets, dried shiitake mushrooms, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, scallions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, light soy sauce, rice vinegar, chicken stock, sesame oil, peanut oil, salt, shaoxing wine, egg whites
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together marinade, and mix together cornstarch paste. Step 2: Cut the fish into 1 / 2-inch slices and put in a bowl with marinade. Step 3: Mix well and set aside. Step 4: Drain and squeeze the mushrooms. Step 5: Remove the stems and slice the caps. Step 6: Cut the red and green peppers into 3 / 4-inch strips, and then diagonally into lozenge shapes. Step 7: Cut the scallion greens into bite-sized pieces. Step 8: Heat the wok over high heat, then add some peanut oil. Step 9: When hot, add the fish and stir with chopsticks to separate the slices. Step 10: When they are white but not fully cooked, remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.

Ingredient Names: fresh broccoli, medium shrimp, egg whites, water, cornstarch, all-purpose flour, salt, white pepper, vegetable oil, peanut oil, fresh ginger, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, dry white wine, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Wash broccoli, remove and discard the stems. Step 2: Cut the florets into small bite-sized pieces, about 2 inches in length. Step 3: Place on a plate and set aside. Step 4: Beat the egg whites and water together in a small bowl. Step 5: Combine the cornstarch and flour in another bowl. Step 6: Season to taste with salt and white pepper. Step 7: Heat a deep pan or fryer with 3 inches of vegetable oil to a temperature of 375 degrees. Step 8: Meanwhile, dip the shrimp into the egg whites and then coat completely with the cornstarch flour mixture Lay the shrimp out in a single layer on a sheet lined with waxed paper Test oil by dropping in a few drops of cold water.

Ingredient Names: sole fillets, fish stock, rice wine, fresh ginger, watercress leaves, tomatoes, salt, white pepper, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into thin strips across the grain. Step 2: Bring the stock slowly to a boil. Step 3: Add the rice wine or sherry and the ginger, and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the watercress and tomatoes, salt and pepper and bring back to a boil. Step 5: Simmer for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add the pieces of fish to the soup. Step 7: Remove pan from heat, cover, and leave for about 4 minutes, until the fish turns white and is lightly cooked. Step 8: Season with the soy sauce and sesame oil, stir in the onion and serve.

Dish Name: Whole Red Snapper In Szechuan Hot Sauce
Ingredient Names: red snapper fillets, soy sauce, dry white wine, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, green onions, fresh ginger, chili bean sauce, tomato paste, sugar, white vinegar, water, cornstarch, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rub the fish with soy sauce and dry wine mixture. Step 2: Let the fish fillets marinated in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet, saute the fish fillets for about 3 minutes on each side. Step 4: Remove the fillets, add garlic, green onion, ginger, chili bean sauce, tomato paste, sugar, vinegar and water. Step 5: Bring the mixture to a boil before adding the fish fillets back to the skillet Braise the fish in the sauce for about 4 to 5 minutes. Step 6: Mix the cornstarch with 2 tsp of water, stir in the sauce and cook for another minute. Step 7: Sprinkle with sesame oil and serve immediately with steamed rice and your favorite steamed vegetables.

Dish Name: Wok's Happening Jimmy's Kitchen Hong Kong Style Curried Fish
Ingredient Names: fish fillets, salt, egg, cornflour, peanut oil, sesame oil, garlic, spring onions, dry sherry, soy sauce, sambal oelek, curry powder, coconut milk, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Take the fish fillets and sprinkle them with the salt on both sides, allow them to sit for about 15 minutes Whilst the fish is being salted, prepare the curry sauce. Step 2: Heat the sesame oil in a wok or frying pan until hot and then fry the spring onions and garlic for about 1 to 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the remaining curry sauce ingredients and turn the heat down, allow the sauce to simmer for about 2 to 4 minutes - then check the heat and seasoning and adjust to taste If the sauce is too thick, add more coconut milk or some water. Step 4: When you are ready to fry the fish, beat the egg in a large bowl, then dip the fish fillets in the cornflour and then into the beaten egg, making sure they are well coated on both sides. Step 5: Heat up the groundnut oil in a large wok or frying pan until it is hot, and then shallow fry the fish fillets, in batches, until they are golden brown This takes about 4 to 8 minutes on each side, depending on the type of fish you use and the thickness of the fillets. Step 6: Drain the cooked fish fillets on kitchen paper To serve, place the freshly fried fish fillets on to a large serving platter or individual plates and pour the hot curry sauce over the top.

Ingredient Names: wonton wrapper, extra virgin olive oil, butter, salt and pepper, mushroom, garlic cloves, smoked salmon, brie cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Trim the won ton wrappers to approximately 2 1 / 2 inch squares with scissors Spray a miniature muffin tin with olive oil and spray the won ton wrappers lightly and put into muffin tin. Step 2: Bake for approximately 7 minutes. Step 3: Remove from oven and cool. Step 4: Cover and store at room temperature. Step 5: In a large frying pan, melt butter and saute the mushrooms, garlic, salt, and pepper until there is no more liquid left. Step 6: Remove from heat and cool. Step 7: Spoon into prepared won ton baskets For each won ton basket, pinch off a small piece of brie cheese and place it on top of the mushrooms.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, lean pork, water chestnuts, green onions, cornstarch, salt, sesame oil, white pepper, wonton skins, egg white, water, chicken breast, chinese pea pods, mushrooms, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Peel shrimp. Step 2: Make a shallow cut lengthwise down the back of each shrimp, wash out vein. Step 3: Chop shrimp finely. Step 4: Mix shrimp, pork, water chestnuts, 2 green onions, 1 tsp Cornstarch, 1 / 2 tsp Salt, 1 / 4 tsp Sesame oil and dash of white pepper. Step 5: Place 1 / 2 tsp Shrimp mixture in center of wonton skin.

Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, dried chinese mushrooms, bamboo shoots, prawns, green onions, pork, salt, light soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: If using dried mushrooms soak them in hot water for 30 minutes, squeeze out the moisture, discard stems and chop finely. Step 2: Combine remaining ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Put a small amount of filling, about a 1 / 2 tsp, on each wonton wrap Moisten the edges of the wrap with water and fold over to form a triangle, points should be slightly overlapping and press together. Step 4: Then bring the two ends together, dab with a little of the filling mixture where they join and seal You may now deep fry them over medium heat for about 2 minutes or until golden or you may add them to soup and cook them for about 5 minutes in the soup& serve Or you may steam them by placing them in a steamer do not layer them, and stem for about 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Wontons With Spring Onion Ginger And Vinegar Dressing
Ingredient Names: prawns, cilantro, spring onion, ginger, shaoxing wine, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, sesame oil, wonton wrapper, spring onions, ketjap manis, malt vinegar, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: For the dressing, combine all ingredients in a bowl and set aside For the wontons, peel and de-vein prawns, then dice meat - you should end up with about 150gm diced prawn meat. Step 2: Combine meat with rest of wonton ingredients, excluding wrappers, and cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 3: Fill and shape the wontons as desired Seal by running a finger dipped in water around the edges. Step 4: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil and drop wontons, in batches, into the water and cook for 2 minutes or until just cooked - test one to be sure. Step 5: Remove wontons with a slotted spoon and drain. Step 6: Arrange wontons on a platter and serve immediately, drizzled with plenty of dressing.

Dish Name: Ww Stir Fried Shrimp And Snow Peas In Orange Sauce
Ingredient Names: scallions, ginger, orange zest, garlic cloves, snow peas, sliced mushrooms, shrimp, bean sprouts, orange juice, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Coat a large nonstick wok or saute pan with cooking spray. Step 2: Heat to smoking over high heat, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Toss in scallions, ginger, orange zest and garlic. Step 4: Stir and toss constantly over the heat for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add snow peas and mushrooms Continue tossing until crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add shrimp Continue cooking, tossing all the while, until shrimp are pink and firm, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Add sprouts, orange juice, soy sauce and honey. Step 8: Toss until bubbling, about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: white flour, yeast, sugar, salt, warm water, ground pork, shrimp, fresh gingerroot, egg, garlic cloves, green onions, star anise, chilies, szechuan peppercorns, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a large bowl Slowly add warm water Use as little as possible. Step 2: Cover the dough with a hot, moist towel, and put it somewhere warm to rise Flavor the cooking oil in a wok by adding the chilies, anise, and peppercorns. Step 3: Add the garlic slices and saute until cooked Throw away the chilies, star anise and peppercorns. Step 4: Put the ground meat in a bowl. Step 5: Pour the flavored oil and garlic onto the meat and mix the ginger, onions and egg together. Step 6: Add soy sauce and salt to taste.

Dish Name: Xihongshi Jiang Stir Fried Shrimp In Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, salt, egg white, cornstarch paste, tomatoes, garlic clove, scallions, peanut oil, tomato paste, sugar, light soy sauce, rice wine, chicken stock, sesame oil, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the shrimp with a pinch of the salt, the egg white, and about half the cornstarch paste. Step 2: Heat some peanut oil in a preheated wok or pan. Step 3: Stir-fry the shrimp for about 1-1 / 2 minutes, remove with a strainer and drain. Step 4: Pour off the excess oil, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the wok or pan. Step 5: Stir-fry the garlic, the tomatoes and white parts of the scallions for about 30 seconds, then add the remaining salt together with the tomato paste, sugar, soy sauce, rice wine and stock. Step 6: Blend well and bring to the boil. Step 7: Add the shrimp with the green parts of the scallions. Step 8: Blend well and thicken the sauce with the remaining cornstarch paste. Step 9: Sprinkle the sesame oil and serve hot, garnished with cilantro leaves.

Dish Name: Kung Pao Tofu With Vegetables Recipe
Ingredient Names: corn flour, soy sauce, green bell pepper, honey, water, tofu, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, dry red chilies, spring onion greens, red bell pepper, capsicum, roasted peanuts, black pepper corns, rice, green beans, carrots, onion, black pepper powder, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To make the Kung Pao Sauce; in a bowl, add all mix all the ingredients until well combined and keep aside. Step 2: For Kung Pao Tofu; heat the sesame oil in a wok on medium high heat; add in the ginger, garlic, red chillies, green and red peppers and spring onions. Saute on high heat until the peppers have slightly softened. Step 3: Stir in the roasted peanuts, the crushed black peppercorns, tofu and the kung pao sauce. Step 4: Keep stirring the sauce with the vegetables, until you notice the sauce is thickening. Step 5: Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste. Give the Kung Pao with Tofu and Vegetables a quick boil and turn off the heat. For the Fried Rice, heat oil in a pan; add the ginger, spring onion, beans, carrots, green bell peppers and salt. Sauté on high heat for 3 to until the vegetables become slightly tender and have a firm bite. Add the cooked rice, black pepper, and salt. Step 6: Mix well and stir fry the chinese fried rice for 2 more minutes. Step 7: Check the salt and seasonings and adjust to suit your taste. Turn off the heat and transfer the fried rice to a serving bowl and serve hot. Now that all the elements are ready, it's time for serving. In a serving bowl like a cereal bowl/ salad bowl/ soup bowl. Step 8: Spoon a portion of rice at the bottom. Step 9: Add a ladle full of the Kung Pao Tofu on one side of the bowl and serve hot. Voila, your Rice bowl is ready to be served. Step 10: Serve Kung Pao Tofu With Vegetables Recipe with brown rice or fried rice like above along with Cherry Tomato and Orange Salad Recipe and Toffee Banana Recipe for a complete weekend meal with family and friends.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, salt, sesame seed oil, seasoned rice vinegar, basil leaves, red chili flakes, sesame seed
Instructions: Step 1: Prep the cucumbers: Peel the cucumbers. Step 2: Cut them into quarters, lengthwise. Step 3: (If the seeds are bitter, scrape out the seeds and discard.) Cut the cucumbers again, crosswise, into 1/2-inch thick pieces. Step 4: Toss the salad: Place cucumbers into a serving bowl. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt. Step 6: Toss with sesame oil, seasoned rice vinegar, basil (if using), and chili flakes. Step 7: Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds if using.

Ingredient Names: low sodium soy sauce, dark sesame oil, rice vinegar, chili oil, honey, bottled water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl Will keep indefinitely if stored in the refrigerator.

Dish Name: Asian Pork Balls With Napa Cabbage
Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, soy sauce, water chestnuts, onion, sesame oil, ginger, salt and pepper, chicken broth, sherry wine, napa cabbage, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the first seven ingredients and form into golf-ball sized balls. Step 2: Place the pork balls on a baking sheet and bake at 375f for 25 minutes. Step 3: Place the pork balls in a large pot with the 1 cup of chicken broth, the 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the 1 tablespoon sherry and bring to a boil. Step 4: Cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 5: Add the napa cabbage, cover, and simmer for 10 more minutes Dissolve the 1 tablespoon cornstarch in the 2 tablespoons cold water. Step 6: Remove the pork balls and cabbage from the liquid and arrange on a serving platter. Step 7: Stir the cornstarch slurry into the remaining liquid and bring it back to a boil. Step 8: Once the sauce has thickened, pour it over the pork balls and cabbage.

Dish Name: Asian Stuffed Eggplant With Hawaiian Style Pork Or Turkey Hash
Ingredient Names: ground pork, eggs, green onions, water chestnuts, garlic cloves, ginger powder, pepper, sesame oil, oyster sauce, sugar, soy sauce, japanese eggplants, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork or turkey, eggs, green onions water chestnuts garlic, ginger powder, pepper, sesame oil, oyster sauce, sugar and soy sauce in a large bowl, mix well. Step 2: Cut a wedge out of the eggplant. Step 3: Stuff the pork mixture into the newly created pocket If desired, put the wedge back on top of the eggplant This can be made into "pork hash" burgers or made into pork hash To make pork hash, place about 1 tablespoon of the mixture on to the middle of a wrapper. Step 4: Wrap up the sides, leaving the top open and unsealed. Step 5: Put stuffed eggplant and pork hash into a steamer, and steam for about 30 minutes. Step 6: Serve with soy sauce mixed with dry powdered mustard, or sweet and thick teriyaki sauce or chinese black bean sauce.

Ingredient Names: bacon, whole chestnuts, ketchup, peach baby food, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut bacon strips lengthwise and then halfwise. Step 2: Wrap each chestnut, secure with a toothpick. Step 3: Place in an ungreased 1392 baking pan. Step 4: Bake uncovered for 25 minutes at 350 Can turn if needed. Step 5: In a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Step 6: Drizzle over water chestnuts. Step 7: Bake 25 to 35 minutes longer or until bacon is crisp.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic, ground ginger, soy sauce, dry sherry, salt, ground black pepper, vegetable oil, cabbage, water, white sugar, egg roll wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 3: Drain and discard grease. Step 4: Add onion, garlic, ginger, and 1/2 of each of the following ingredients: soy sauce, sherry, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Sauté just until onion is tender, 4 to. Step 6: Transfer to a bowl. Step 7: Heat oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Step 8: Add cabbage, water, and sugar, plus remaining soy sauce, sherry, salt, and pepper. Step 9: Cook and stir until cabbage is crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Return beef mixture to the pan; cook and stir until well combined and heated through, 2 to. Step 11: Remove from the heat. Step 12: Heat oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 13: While the oil is heating, lay one egg roll wrapper out like a diamond. Step 14: Place approximately filling across the center going from left to right. Step 15: Moisten the top two edges with water. Step 16: Fold the bottom corner up and over the filling, fold both sides in toward the center, and roll upwards to seal. Step 17: Repeat to make remaining egg rolls. Step 18: Fry a few egg rolls at a time in the preheated oil until golden brown, 2 to per batch. Step 19: Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

Dish Name: Beijing Style Pork Shrimp Jiaozi Chinese Dumplings
Ingredient Names: ground pork, raw shrimp, garlic cloves, green onions, cabbage, ginger, salt, soy sauce, sugar, egg, sesame oil, five-spice powder, red pepper powder, dumpling wrappers, water
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the cabbage, chop it, and put it in a large non-reactive pot with salt set it aside and let it sweat out water for 45 min or so If you're using a meat grinder, feed the shrimp, pork, garlic, onions, and ginger through the meat grinder, getting everything to be a smooth, yet chunky mixture If you're using a food processor, you're going to half way freeze the meat, and chop each ingredient on it's own, and then mix them in a pasta bowl Traditionally, all these ingredients are minced and chopped using a large cutting board and a cleaver However you do it, it's up to you. Step 2: Put the meat and veggie mixture into a a large bowl. Step 3: Add the salt, soy sauce, egg and sugar to the mixture. Step 4: In a heavy skillet, heat up the oil. Step 5: Add the spice powders and toast the spices. Step 6: Pour this mixture hot over the meat mixture in the bowl, and stir inches.

Ingredient Names: baby back ribs, salt, pepper, ketchup, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, chinese five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Cut ribs into single rib portions. Step 2: Place ribs in a foil-lined large shallow baking pan. Step 3: Bake, uncovered, in a 425-degree oven for 30 minutes, turning once halfway through baking. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine ketchup, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce and five-spice powder. Step 5: Drain fat from ribs. Step 6: Place ribs in bowl with ketchup mixture. Step 7: Toss to coat ribs thoroughly. Step 8: Return to baking pan To continue cooking, reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. Step 9: Bake 15 to 25 minutes longer or until tender.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 4 Moo Shoo Pork
Ingredient Names: lean pork, soy sauce, oil, eggs, mushrooms, scallions, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix pork with the soy sauce and rest. Step 2: Put 6 tbsp of oil in a skillet and heat to very hot. Step 3: Pour in the eggsand stir fry until set. Step 4: Remove eggs to a platter and cut into thin strips. Step 5: Add remaining oil to pan, heat. Step 6: Add pork, mushrooms, scallions. Step 7: Stir fry until pork is cooked. Step 8: Add egg and sugar mix well, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: pork spareribs, garlic cloves, thick soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, vegetable oil, sesame oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix all the ingredients together stirring to dissolve the sugar. Step 2: Arrange pork in an oven proof dish and pour the sauce over the ribs. Step 3: Cover with aluminum foil and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 5 hours, rotating ribs occasionally. Step 4: Preheat oven to 375f Roast covered for 25 minutes, remove foil and continue cooking until the sauce is just a sticky glace on the ribs You may now serve them or freeze them for later use To freeze, place them on a cookie sheet and freeze individually. Step 5: Once frozen put them in a large freezer proof bag for later use. Step 6: When you want to serve them spread them on a cookie sheet and place frozen ribs in 350f oven for about 15 minutes or until hot through.

Dish Name: Bergy Dim Sum 6 Steamed Sweet Bean Buns
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, caster sugar, lard, water, white vinegar, sweet bean paste, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: --------instructionsfor dough---------- Sift flour and baking powder into a bowl add sugar and mix, rub in the lard with your finger. Step 2: Add water and vinegar together and knead until a fairly soft dough. Step 3: Shape into a ball and let it rest, covered, for 30 minutes ----------tomake the buns----------- Divide the dough into10 portions Mould each into a smooth ball. Step 4: Roll each out on a lightly floured surface to a circle about 4 inches across. Step 5: Put a heaping teasp of filling in the centre and gather the edges inward, folding and pleating to make a neat join Twist dough to seal.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, boiling water, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put unsifted flour in a bowl. Step 2: Pour in all the boiling water at once stirring with the handle of a wooden spoon. Step 3: When the dough is cool enough to handle knead for 10 minutes Whether you do this by hand or with the mixer the mixture is ready when it is a smooth, soft dough. Step 4: Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes. Step 5: Roll dough into a cylindrical shape and cut into 10 equal pieces. Step 6: Keep covered with plastic wrap to prevent drying out. Step 7: Take one slice at a time and cut in two equal pieces On a lightly floured board roll each piece into a 3" circle. Step 8: Brush one side of one of the 3" circle pancakes with sesame oil, brush the oil right to the edge.

Dish Name: Bon Bon Pork Ribs Thunder Bay Style
Ingredient Names: pork ribs, five-spice powder, sugar, salt, msg, water, potato starch, white breadcrumb
Instructions: Step 1: Cut short style pork ribs between bones into pieces. Step 2: Mix 1 tablespoon five-spice powder, sugar, salt, msg, water, and potato starch. Step 3: Let stand in refrigerator for 5 hours, add 2 eggs, mix. Step 4: Dip in more potato starch then bread crumbs Deep fry in older oil 375 degrees fahrenheit until dark spots of blood seep out of bones or until golden Dry on paper towels Spritz with lemon juice This was given to me by a cook who only makes 10 pounds at a time so adjust as needed.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, baby back ribs, garlic, cinnamon sticks, orange zest, sherry wine, anise seed, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, tomatoes, dried thyme, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large dutch oven. Step 2: Add ribs, garlic, cinnamon, zest, and anise seed. Step 3: Cook quickly, searing both sides, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add sherry, soy sauce, vinegar, tomato and thyme. Step 5: Cover, reduce to low and simmer 15 minutes. Step 6: Add 1 / 4 c stock, cover and cook on low heat 45 mins-1 hour, turning every so often so the sauce gets on both sides If it gets too thick or sticks add more broth. Step 7: Remove the ribs from the pan and deglaze it with the remaining 1 / 2 c stock. Step 8: Return the ribs to the pan, coat with the sauce, serve.

Ingredient Names: ground round, ground pork, oatmeal, milk, water chestnut, garlic clove, worcestershire sauce, onion salt, tabasco sauce, sugar, cider vinegar, water, paprika, cornstarch, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients for meatballs. Step 2: Mix well Form into bite size meatballs. Step 3: Bake in 9 x 13-inch glass pans in a 375 oven until brown, approximately 1 hour, turning once. Step 4: Cool and drain on paper towels. Step 5: Combine ingredients for sauce in large saucepan. Step 6: Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add more cornstarch mixed with water if needed, simmer 30 minutes. Step 8: Add meatballs to sauce.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, white sugar, warm water, active dry yeast, baking powder, shortening, pork, light soy sauce, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, cornstarch, sesame oil, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve 1 / 4 cup sugar in 1 3 / 4 cups warm water, and then add the yeast. Step 2: Let stand for 10 minutes, or until mixture is frothy Sift the flour and baking powder into a large bowl. Step 3: Stir in 2 tablespoons shortening and the yeast mixture, mix well. Step 4: Knead the dough until smooth and elastic. Step 5: Place the dough in a greased bowl, and cover it with a sheet of cling wrap. Step 6: Let the dough rise in a warm place for about 2 hours, or until it has tripled in bulk. Step 7: Cut the pork into 2 inch thick strips Use fork to prick it all over.

Dish Name: Char Siew Puffs Char Siew Sow Dim Sum
Ingredient Names: dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, caster sugar, water, cornstarch, peanut oil, shallot, barbecued pork, all-purpose flour, baking powder, custard powder, icing sugar, butter, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare filling: combine soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, sugar and water and stir until sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Stir in cornstarch. Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, once hot, fry shallot till fragrant Slowly pour in the sauce mixture and cook until sauce thickens. Step 4: Add diced char siew to the sauce, stir to coat well. Step 5: Prepare dough: sift all-purpose flour, baking powder, custard powder and icing sugar into a mixing bowl Rub in the butter until mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Step 6: Stir egg into the flour mixture to make a pliable dough. Step 7: Wrap dough in a large plastic bag and chill for at least 30 minutes. Step 8: Remove dough from fridge and roll it out to obtain a 8 x 12" rectangle.

Dish Name: Char Siu Bao (Steamed BBQ Pork Buns)
Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin roast, barbecue sauce, chicken broth, shallots, dark soy sauce, vegetable oil, white sugar, chinese steamed bun dough
Instructions: Step 1: Mix pork, barbecue sauce, broth, shallots, soy sauce, oil, and sugar together in a glass or ceramic bowl. Step 2: Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Step 3: About three hours before the meat has finished marinating, follow Steps 1 through 4 in the Chinese Steamed Buns recipe to make dough. Step 4: (This should take about 10-12 minutes, so the dough will be ready when the pork has been cooked and shredded.). Step 5: When pork has finished marinating, preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Step 6: Cut 24 small squares of waxed paper. Step 7: Remove pork from marinade and shake off excess. Step 8: Discard remaining marinade. Step 9: Cook pork on the preheated grill until an instant-read meat thermometer reaches 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), 10 to. Step 10: Allow to cool, then shred or finely chop meat. Step 11: Shape dough into 24 balls. Step 12: Roll each ball into a circle and place pork in the center. Step 13: Wrap dough up and over filling, then pinch to seal the edges. Step 14: Place each bun, seam-side down, onto a waxed paper square; let stand until doubled in volume, about 10 minutes. Step 15: Bring water to a boil in a wok over high heat. Step 16: Reduce the heat to medium and maintain a boil. Step 17: Insert a steamer basket or place a steamer plate onto a small wire rack in the middle of the wok. Step 18: Working in batches and leaving the outer 2 inches of the steam basket uncovered, place buns (on waxed paper) into the steamer basket, spacing them 1 to 2 inches apart. Step 19: Cover the wok and steam for 15 to. Step 20: Remove the lid, then turn off the heat. Step 21: (If you remove the lid after turning off the heat, condensation from the lid will drip onto the surface of the buns, causing yellowish blisters.). Step 22: Remove buns from the wok. Step 23: Repeat Steps 6 and 7 to steam remaining buns, adding more water to the wok as needed.

Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, chili paste, soy sauce, iceberg lettuce, cooked chicken, rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 3 ingredients and set aside Separate 6 nice lettuce leaves, keeping them as whole as possible On each leaf place some chicken, some sauce and some of the crunchy noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, plain flour, self-rising flour, salt, potato starch, water, vegetable oil, green capsicum, onion, egg, tomato ketchup, brown sauce, sugar, chinese five spice powder, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place tomato ketchup, brown sauce, sugar, chinese 5 spice, soy sauce and cup of water in a saucepan and boil until sugar has desolved. Step 2: Stir, then turn heat down and simmer for 30 mins. Step 3: Add extra water if mixture starts to thicken. Step 4: Put sauce to one side. Step 5: In a small glass mix corn starch with 5 tsps water. Step 6: Slice onion and capsicum in strips and put to one side. Step 7: Wash and dry wings, remove wing. Step 8: Cut wings in two at the joints and put at one side. Step 9: In a bowl large enough to hold the wings put the beaten egg, plain flour, self raising flour and salt and mix until all ingrediants are smoothly combined.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, salt, white pepper, chinese five spice powder, sherry wine, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate pork in salt, pepper, five spice powder, sherry, soy sauce, food coloring, and hoisin sauce for at least 2 hours Pre-heat oven to 350. Step 2: Bake pork on roasting pan rack for 25 minutes on each side. Step 3: Slice into 1 / 8" thick slices. Step 4: Serve hot or cold with toasted sesame seeds and hot mustard or soy sauce To make hot mustard: mix 2 oz Dry mustard, 1 / 2 teaspoons salt, 2 oz Boiling water and 2 teaspoons oil Work all ingredients into a smooth paste.

Ingredient Names: milk, white sugar, butter, all-purpose flour, active dry yeast, egg, fresh coconut, nonfat dry milk powder, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place milk and ⅓ cup sugar in a small saucepan; stir until sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Add ¼ cup butter; gently heat mixture until butter melts and mixture is warm but not hot — no more than 100 degrees F (40 degrees C). Step 3: Whisk 2 ½ cups flour and yeast together until well combined; stir in milk mixture. Step 4: Beat 1 egg in a small bowl; stir into flour mixture until forms a sticky, wet dough. Step 5: Turn dough out onto a well-floured surface; knead for about 8-10 minutes, gradually kneading in more flour, or as needed, to make a smooth, elastic dough. Step 6: Form dough into a round ball, place into an oiled bowl and turn to coat. Step 7: Cover bowl with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour. Step 8: Beat ½ cup sugar and remaining ¼ cup butter in a bowl until light and fluffy; stir in coconut, milk powder, and remaining ½ cup flour until smooth and combined. Step 9: Set filling aside. Step 10: Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Step 11: Punch down dough on a floured surface; cut into 2 equal pieces. Step 12: Cut each piece into 8 equal-sized pieces (total). Step 13: Form each piece into an oblong shape; flatten with a floured rolling pin. Step 14: Spoon about filling in center of 1 flattened dough piece. Step 15: Pull and pinch edges of dough together to enclose filling; place buns seam-side down onto a prepared baking sheet. Step 16: Repeat with remaining filling and flattened dough pieces. Step 17: Cover buns with a cloth; let rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Step 18: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 19: Beat remaining 1 egg in a bowl; brush on each bun for a glossy coating. Step 20: Sprinkle each bun with sesame seeds. Step 21: Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to. Step 22: Cool before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, napa cabbage, dandelion greens, bamboo shoots, green onions, bok choy leaves, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger root, white sugar, kosher salt, white pepper, egg whites, wonton wrappers, vegetable oil, hoisin sauce, balsamic vinegar, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork, cabbage, dandelion greens, bamboo shoots, 4 minced green onions, bok choy, soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, minced ginger, sugar, salt, and white pepper in a large bowl. Step 2: Cover the bowl; refrigerate to overnight. Step 3: Beat egg white with water in a small bowl; set aside. Step 4: Place 1 wonton wrapper on a flat work surface (cover additional wrappers with a moist towel to prevent drying); place pork mixture in center of wrapper. Step 5: Brush edges of wrapper with egg white. Step 6: Fold wrapper around filling and seal edges with a moistened fork. Step 7: Repeat with remaining wrappers, pork mixture, and egg white. Step 8: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; add dumplings, in batches, seam-sides up. Step 9: Cook until dumplings are slightly brown, 30 to 60 seconds. Step 10: Pour ½ cup water into the skillet; cover. Step 11: Gently steam dumplings until they begin to sizzle and water evaporates, 7 to. Step 12: Flip dumplings; continue cooking until bottoms begin to brown, 3 to. Step 13: Repeat with remaining dumplings. Step 14: Combine ½ cup soy sauce, hoisin, vinegar, chopped green onion, remaining sesame oil, chili oil, remaining minced garlic, remaining minced ginger, and remaining sugar in a large bowl for the dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: gyoza skins, water, cornstarch, peanut oil, ground chicken, tamari, sherry wine, sugar, green onions, ginger, garlic cloves, carrot, sesame oil, egg, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Either type of meat will work However, we prefer equal parts of both ground chicken and ground pork Dipping sauce: in a small non-reactive bowl combine the dipping sauce and set aside to marinate Best prepared several hours in advance Meat filling: in a large bowl combine the filling ingredients. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour To make a simple paste for sealing the wrappers, in another small bowl combine a few tablespoons of water and roughly 1 teaspoon cornstarch, stir to blend. Step 3: Place about 3 / 4 tablespoon of the meat mixture on one dim sum wrapper. Step 4: Using your fingers or a pastry brush, add a little bit of the water / cornstarch mixture to the edge of the wrapper.

Ingredient Names: flour, eggs, vegetable oil, cold water, chinese chives, ground pork, soy sauce, cornstarch, ginger juice, chicken bouillon powder, sesame oil, garlic, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: For dough: Place flour in a bowl and make a well Crack eggs in a separate bowl and lightly whisk. Step 2: Add eggs, oil, and half the water and mix together to make a dough. Step 3: Add more water as needed The dough should not be sticky. Step 4: Knead dough on a floured surface for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Cover and set dough aside to rest for 1 / 2 hour For filling: Mix the rest of the ingredients in a bowl to combine.

Ingredient Names: baby back ribs, chinese five spice powder, salt, fresh ground black pepper, hoisin sauce, plum sauce, apple cider, cider vinegar, tomato paste, honey, pickled ginger, garlic clove, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f rub the ribs all over with the five-spice powder then salt and pepper to taste, set aside. Step 2: Stir together the hoisin and plum sauces in a small bowl. Step 3: Brush evenly over the ribs then cut the ribs into 3-5 rib sections. Step 4: Place the ribs in a large, oiled roasting pan. Step 5: Cover the pan tightly with foil. Step 6: Bake until the meat is tender enough to be pierced easily with a fork, about 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 7: Remove foil and remove ribs to a platter. Step 8: Pour the liquid from the roasting pan into a degreaser or bowl Skim off the fat.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, plum jelly, water, dry sherry, garlic cloves, five-spice powder, pork baby back ribs
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, whisk together soy sauce, plum jelly, water, sherry, garlic, and five-spice powder until jelly dissolves. Step 2: Allow mixture to cool slightly. Step 3: Pour mixture into a resealable plastic ziplock bag, and add ribs Seal bag and coat ribs with sauce, and allow to marinate 3-6 hours, or overnight. Step 4: Place ribs on a foil-lined baking pan, and cover with foil Reserving marinade. Step 5: Bake ribs at 450f for 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove ribs from oven, and discard top foil. Step 7: Drain liquids from baking pan, and turn ribs. Step 8: Bake ribs at 350f for 15-30 minutes more, or until ribs are cooked through, basting several times with reserved marinade.

Dish Name: Chinese Latkes With Tangy Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: potatoes, green onions, egg, cornstarch, salt, vegetable oil, sesame seeds, garlic, green onion, soy sauce, white vinegar, sesame oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Grate potatoes and mix togehter with green onions. Step 2: In a small bowl, lightly beat eggs. Step 3: Stir in cornstarch and salt. Step 4: Pour egg mixture into potatoes, coating potatoes well. Step 5: Heat 1 tbsp Oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Drop potato mixture by tablespoonfuls into pan and flatten slightly with spatula. Step 7: Cook 3-4 minutes each side or until golden. Step 8: Drain For sauce, toast sesame seeds in dry skillet over medium-high heat until lightly browned, stirring pan often.

Dish Name: Chinese Minced Pork In Lettuce Cups
Ingredient Names: ground pork, onion, ginger, garlic, rice wine, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, water chestnut, cilantro, pine nuts, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut lettuce ahead of time into cup shapes to have it ready Choose leaves towards the center of the head of lettuce Use kitchen shears to cut any shapes needed, if necessary. Step 2: Set aside to chill. Step 3: Saute pork in a large skillet until it is browned. Step 4: Remove meat from skillet and drain off any fat. Step 5: Add onions to skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until tender, then stir in garlic and ginger. Step 6: Add wine and pork to the skillet and stir until wine reduces. Step 7: Add hoisin, oyster and soy sauces, stirring to mix well. Step 8: Stir in water chestnuts and cilantro and heat through.

Ingredient Names: sweet rice, dried chinese mushrooms, lean pork, egg, soy sauce, sugar, gingerroot, water chestnuts, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice in water to cover for 4 hours, drain and pat dry. Step 2: Soak the mushrooms in 1 / 2 cup warm water for 1 hour. Step 3: Drain and discard the tough stems.
