Step 4: Chop the caps finely. Step 5: Mix together all the ingredients, except the rice, until well blended Your hands are best for this job Form balls 1 inch in diameter. Step 6: Spread the rice on a baking sheet One at a time, roll the pearl balls in it, coating completely.

Ingredient Names: white cabbage, brown sugar, soy sauce, wine vinegar, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Discard tough outer leaves and core of cabbage. Step 2: Cut into 1 inch cubes. Step 3: Combine brown sugar, soy sauce, vinegar and salt, heat 2 tblsp Oil. Step 4: Add cabbage and stir-fry until translucent but still crisp. Step 5: Transfer to a bowl. Step 6: Heat remaining 1 tblsp Oil. Step 7: Add brown sugar-soy mixture and cook, stirring, until sugar dissolves.

Ingredient Names: brown bean sauce, cilantro, spring onion, oyster sauce, garlic cloves, ginger, chicken stock, sugar, pepper, chili, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil Saut ginger till brown. Step 2: Add garlic, bean sauce and coriander Continue to saut. Step 3: Now add chicken stock and oyster sauce. Step 4: Simmer till reduced by half. Step 5: Add sugar to reduce the saltiness and pepper to taste Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, water, light brown sugar, kosher salt, chinese five spice powder, kikkoman soy sauce, dry sherry, yellow miso, fresh garlic, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Place the porkloin in a large ziploc freezer bag. Step 2: In a small bowl, stir together the rest of the ingredients until the sugar has dissolved. Step 3: Pour into the ziploc bag. Step 4: Remove as much air as possible and seal shut. Step 5: Refrigerate from 6 to 36 hours. Step 6: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 7: Remove porkloin from the marinade. Step 8: Place on wire rack in a shallow baking pan. Step 9: Insert meat thermometer Roast about 1 hour or until the internal meat temperature reaches 165 degrees.

Ingredient Names: lima beans, peanut oil, salt, sugar, chicken broth, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Remove limas from package and let defrost a little and separate them with your fingers. Step 2: Heat a skillet over high heat until hot. Step 3: Add the peanut oil, swirl, heat for 30 seconds Scatter in the beans. Step 4: Stir-fry briskly for 30 seconds until the color turns icy green. Step 5: Sprinkle in the salt and sugar and stir rapidly for another 30 seconds to season them evenly. Step 6: Add the stock or water, even out the beans, turn heat to medium-low to maintain a strong simmer. Step 7: Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes. Step 8: Uncover, turn heat high and stir rapidly until the remaining liquid has evaporated. Step 9: Add the sesame oil, stir to distribute evenly and pour into serving dish.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, cold water, dried shrimp, chinese bacon, vegetable oil, daikon radish, rock sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine rice flour and cold water in a large, heatproof mixing bowl. Step 2: Mix until smooth and velvety; set aside. Step 3: Soak dried shrimp in cold water in a small bowl until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Drain and dry shrimp, then finely chop and set aside. Step 5: Boil enough water to immerse bacon in a small pot, and cook to soften, 3 to. Step 6: Remove from heat and pat dry. Step 7: Finely chop and set aside. Step 8: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat. Step 9: Add shrimp and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes, add bacon. Step 10: Cook for another 3-4 minutes. Step 11: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 12: Clean the wok and heat remaining oil over medium-high heat. Step 13: Stir-fry daikon and rock sugar for 3-4 minutes. Step 14: Add water, cover the wok, and steam daikon until just cooked, about 10-12 minutes, remove from heat. Step 15: Add hot daikon mixture to the reserved rice flour mixture, mixing until daikon is well incorporated. Step 16: Add bacon, shrimp, and salt; stir until evenly distributed. Step 17: Pour into a 10-inch round cake pan and smooth out the top. Step 18: Bring some water to a boil in a wok. Step 19: Place the cake pan on the wok rack, making sure the bottom half of the pan is immersed. Step 20: Cover and reduce heat to medium. Step 21: Steam until a toothpick goes cleanly through the center, about 10-12 minutes. Step 22: Check the water level regularly and replenish, if necessary, with boiling water. Step 23: Remove pan and allow to cool on a rack for about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pork spareribs, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, honey, dry sherry, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Place ribs in shallow glass dish. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients and spoon over ribs. Step 3: Refrigerate overnight. Step 4: Remove ribs from marinade, set marinade aside. Step 5: Arrange ribs on a foil lined broiler pan, meaty sides up. Step 6: Brush with marinade, cover and cook for 1 hour at 325 deg. Step 7: Uncover, and brush with marinade. Step 8: Cook uncovered for approx 45 minutes, or until done, occasionally brushing with marinade. Step 9: Brush with marinade before serving.

Ingredient Names: fresh mushrooms, ground pork, turnip, soy sauce, water chestnuts, salt, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Remove stems from mushrooms and discard or save for another use. Step 2: Wipe caps clean with a dry towel. Step 3: In a bowl, combine the pork, turnip, soy sauce, water chestnuts, salt, and sugar until thoroughly mixed. Step 4: Spoon stuffing tightly into mushroom caps. Step 5: Arrange in a steamer basket, stuffing side up, over boiling water. Step 6: Cover, and cook for 10 minutes, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, carrots, celery, green onions, wonton wrappers, water, oil, sweet and sour sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and vegetables in a bowl Separate wonton skins. Step 2: Place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the center of the wonton. Step 3: Brush water on 2 borders of the skin, covering 1 / 4 inch from the edge. Step 4: Fold skin over to form a triangle, sealing edges Pinch the two long outside points together. Step 5: Heat oil to 450 degrees and fry 4 to 5 at a time until golden. Step 6: Drain and serve with sauce.

Ingredient Names: eggs, black tea bags, soy sauce, salt, sugar, star anise, cinnamon stick, black peppercorns, orange peel
Instructions: Step 1: Put eggs in a medium-sized pot with enough water to cover the eggs. Step 2: Bring water to boil, then lower heat to simmer for 3 minutes. Step 3: Remove eggs from heat and allow them to cool a bit before handling. Step 4: Take the back of a knife and crack eggs evenly all around. Step 5: Return eggs to the pot and add the rest of the ingredients. Step 6: Bring liquid to boil again, then simmer for 1 to 3 hours, longer for a more intense flavor and color, adding water if level gets too low. Step 7: Remove from heat, and serve as a snack or addition to rice or noodles.

Dish Name: Classic Manapua Steamed Buns Hawaiian Style
Ingredient Names: dry yeast, water, warm water, cooking oil, sugar, salt, sifted flour, sesame oil, cornstarch, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, catsup, oyster sauce, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle yeast over 3 tablespoons lukewarm water and allow to stand until yeast softens To remaining water, add oil or shortening, sugar and salt, stirring until melted or dissolved, cool, add yeast mixture. Step 2: Place flour in a large mixing bowl or a heavy-duty mixer and add most of the liquid. Step 3: Combine until flour incorporates liquid and starts to become a ball. Step 4: Add remaining liquid to make a very heavy dough Begin kneading the dough in the bowl Continue kneading until you have a smooth ball that is beginning to show signs of long strands on the outside, indicating that the gluten has fully developed. Step 5: Remove dough from bowl and rinse out bowl.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, crabmeat, dark soy sauce, fresh ginger root, fresh cilantro, dried parsley, garlic, wonton wrappers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cream cheese, crabmeat, soy sauce, ginger, cilantro, parsley, and garlic together in a bowl. Step 2: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet or deep fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C). Step 3: While the oil is heating, place 1/cream cheese mixture into the center of a wonton wrapper. Step 4: Moisten the wrapper edges and pull two corners together over filling to make a triangle. Step 5: Pull two remaining corners up to join them, then press firmly to seal. Step 6: Repeat to make remaining wontons. Step 7: Place prepared wontons under a slightly moist paper towel until oil is hot. Step 8: Working in batches, fry 3 or 4 wontons at a time in hot oil until golden brown and crispy, 1 to, flipping halfway through. Step 9: Transfer wontons to a paper towel-lined plate to drain, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, fresh ginger, green onions, water chestnuts, soy sauce, ground black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, garlic powder, egg, wonton wrappers, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients except the egg, won ton wrappers and the oil. Step 2: Mix in 1 tbsp of the beaten egg. Step 3: Preheat oil for deep fat frying. Step 4: Put 1 / 2 tbsp of the turkey mixture into the center of each won ton wrapper. Step 5: Brush half of the edge of each wrapper with a bit of the beaten egg and fold in half Seal the edges by pressing firmly together Deep-fry the won tons in batches in the hot oil for 3 to 5 minutes or until brown. Step 6: Drain well on paper towels. Step 7: Serve with a sauce for dipping, such as plum sauce or sweet and sour sauce.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Sweet And Sour Kielbasa
Ingredient Names: kielbasa, apricot preserves, sweet and sour sauce, crushed pineapple, chunk pineapple
Instructions: Step 1: Slice kielbasa and place in crock pot. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients and add to kielbasa. Step 3: Stir till kielbasa is coated well. Step 4: Cook on low until heated thoroughly, about 2-3 hours.

Ingredient Names: glutinous-rice flour, potato flour, salt, sugar, boiling water, minced beef, ground pork, salt & pepper, paprika, ground ginger, chili, green chili, brown onion, savoy cabbage, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Make pastry first. Step 2: Mix flours, salt, sugar and add boiling water. Step 3: Mix well, knead on floured bench Rest before using, make filling. Step 4: Mix meat, and seasonings by hand or pulse in a food processor Do not over process. Step 5: Add vegetables and mix by hand. Step 6: Roll pastry until thin & cut into rounds I use an egg-ring.

Dish Name: Din Tai Fung Style Xiao Long Bao Soup Dumplings
Ingredient Names: water, chicken parts, smoked ham, green onion, fresh ginger, dried shiitake mushroom, garlic clove, soy sauce, shaoxing wine, unflavored gelatin, ground pork, shrimp, sugar, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Three days before, combine 10 cups water and all remaining soup ingredients except gelatin in large pot. Step 2: Bring to boil, spooning off any foam that rises to surface. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until chicken pieces are very soft and beginning to fall apart, adding more water by cupfuls if necessary to keep chicken submerged, about 2 hours 30 minutes, strain soup, discard solids. Step 4: Return broth to same pot. Step 5: Boil until reduced to 2 cups, about 35 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Pour 3 tablespoons water into small bowl. Step 8: Sprinkle gelatin over.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, honey, granulated sugar, chinese five spice powder, hoisin sauce, fresh ginger, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dry sherry, chinese hot mustard, toasted sesame seeds, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the outside of pork removing all fat and silver skin. Step 2: Mix marinade ingredients together, reserving 1 / 4 cup of marinade for basting while the pork is cooking. Step 3: Place pork in remaining marinade. Step 4: Refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours If you marinade less then 24 hours the full flavors will not develop If you marinade for over 48 hours the marinade will desiccate the pork and the texture will suffer. Step 5: Arrange pork on a broiler pan or a wire rack fitted into a sheet pan. Step 6: Fill with 1 / 2 inch of water. Step 7: Place in 325 oven It will take 25 to 30 minutes to cook the pork, basting every 7 to 9 minutes and rolling pork over to baste all sides evenly.

Ingredient Names: spareribs, brown sugar, water, garlic cloves, light soy sauce, dry mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Step 2: Cut the ribs apart in large or small pieces as you wish. Step 3: Add the spareribs to the boiling water, cover, and allow to simmer for 30 minutes until tender While the spareribs are simmering, mix together the sauce ingredients. Step 4: Remove the spareribs from the pot If you like, set aside the pork broth to use in another recipe Clean out the pot. Step 5: Add the sauce ingredients to the pot and bring to a gentle boil. Step 6: Add the spareribs, bring back to a boil, and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggs, soy sauce, chop suey vegetables, green onions, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the eggs, soy sauce, vegetables, and green onions together, set aside. Step 2: Mix the sauce ingredients in a saucepan over medium high and stir continuously with a whisk until until clear and thickened. Step 3: Keep the sauce warm and set aside. Step 4: Heat oil in a skillet Scoop out about 1 / 2 cup of mixture and place in oil to form a patty. Step 5: Cook over medium heat a few minutes on each side till firm The first side usually takes about 2 minutes, then second about a minute. Step 6: Pour the warm sauce over the finished patties and serve!

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, lean boneless pork, cabbage, carrot, green bell pepper, onion, garlic, fresh ginger root, cornstarch, soy sauce, molasses, oil, egg roll wrappers, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in large wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Stir-fry pork for 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Transfer pork to paper towel-lined plate and set aside. Step 4: In a large bowl, mix the cabbage, carrot, green bell pepper, onion, garlic and ginger. Step 5: In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch, soy sauce, and molasses until smooth, heat oil in wok. Step 6: Stir in cabbage mixture in batches, cooking each batch 3 to, just until tender. Step 7: Return vegetables to bowl, and mix in pork. Step 8: Stir in the cornstarch mixture. Step 9: Prepare a work surface for rolling the egg rolls. Step 10: Lay several egg roll wrappers in a row. Step 11: Place the water in a small bowl; you'll use this for sealing. Step 12: Place about filling on each egg roll wrapper. Step 13: Dip a finger in the water and run it along the edge of the wrapper. Step 14: Fold one corner of wrapper over filling. Step 15: Fold wrapper sides over filling. Step 16: Roll wrappers to form egg rolls. Step 17: Heat 1 quart oil in a deep fryer to 365 degrees F (185 degrees C). Step 18: Fry egg rolls in batches in the hot oil until golden brown. Step 19: Drain on paper towels and serve with sweet and sour sauce.

Ingredient Names: coleman's dry mustard, warm water, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Put dry mustard into a small bowl add warm water, stir Slowly add in the rice wine vinegar or chili oil until desired consistency It takes about 10 minutes to mature Be careful and use sparingly it is hot!

Ingredient Names: ground pork, green onions, hoisin sauce, low sodium soy sauce, water chestnuts, egg, wonton wrappers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork mince, green onions, hoisin sauce, soya sauce, water chestnuts and egg into a bowl. Step 2: Stir until combined Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and brush a little water around the edge of the wrapper. Step 3: Place 2 teaspoons of the pork mixture in the middle of the wrapper. Step 4: Fold over to enclose the filling in a trangle shape and pinch the edges together to seal. Step 5: Repeat with the remaining mixture and wonton wrappers If air is in the wrapper, when they are deep fried, they will open up. Step 6: Heat the oil in a pan, and deep fry the dumpling till golden brown You can serve this with sweet chilli sauce.

Ingredient Names: seasoned rice vinegar, soy sauce, fresh ginger, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in small bowl Can be made 2 days ahead Cover Refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, shortening, glutinous rice flour, baking powder, ice cold water, white sesame seeds, lotus seed paste, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar and shortening in a bowl to make a paste. Step 2: Add rice flour, baking powder, and ice water and mix everything into a dough ball. Step 3: Wrap in plastic film and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 4: Remove dough from fridge and separate into 6 equal portions. Step 5: Roll into balls and flatten the balls into thin disks. Step 6: Portion lotus paste into 6 equal parts and roll into small balls. Step 7: Set a lotus paste ball in the center of the flattened dough disks and wrap dough around the lotus paste. Step 8: Roll between the palms of your hands until all the seams are gone and no lotus paste is showing. Step 9: Pour sesame seeds onto a saucer and roll finished balls in the sesame seeds. Step 10: Roll balls between your palms one more time to make sure sesame seeds stick. Step 11: Pour oil into a pot and heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 12: Drop balls into the hot oil and fry until golden brown, 5 to. Step 13: Remove from the hot oil with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel-lined plate to absorb the excess oil Serve - be careful! Step 14: The lotus paste inside the balls will be very hot.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, hot water, cold water, scallions, salt, ground black pepper, butter, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place flour in a bowl. Step 2: Add hot water in a slow, steady stream while mixing constantly. Step 3: Add cold water; mix until no dry spots remain. Step 4: Transfer dough to a flat surface; knead lightly by hand until a ball is formed. Step 5: Place dough in an oiled resealable plastic bag; seal the bag and let dough rest for 10 minutes. Step 6: Place scallions in a bowl; season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Turn dough out onto a floured work surface; roll into a thin rectangle using a rolling pin. Step 8: Spread butter over dough to cover; sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper. Step 9: Spread scallions over dough, leaving top edge empty. Step 10: Roll dough up from the opposite edge, keeping scallions in place and pulling dough a little with every roll to make it tight. Step 11: Cut roll into 3- to 4-inch-long pieces; pinch and seal ends of each piece. Step 12: Lightly flatten each piece into a circular pancake. Step 13: Heat oil in a nonstick skillet; cook pancakes until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 14: Crush 2 sides of the pancakes with spoons or ladles until flaky.

Ingredient Names: gyoza skins, boneless pork loin, scallion, garlic clove, carrot, cabbage leaves, egg, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil, sesame oil, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: While still mostly frozen, and using a very sharp knife, mince the pork loin until it resembles ground pork. Step 2: In a medium mixing bowl mix all ingredients until thoroughly combined On a dry surface lay out a gyoza wrapper and place a teaspoonful of pork mixture in the center Wet just the. Step 3: Fold over and pinch the sides together so it looks like a semi-circle. Step 4: Repeat until the pork mixture is gone. Step 5: In a large non-stick frying pan with a lid heat a teaspoonful of oil and place 10-12 gyoza in the pan. Step 6: Cook for two minutes without touching them. Step 7: Pour a half cup of water into the pan and cover immediately. Step 8: Cook for 5-7 minutes, undisturbed, or until all water is gone.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, hoisin sauce, fish sauce, sugar, chili paste, chicken broth, dry-roasted unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm the oil. Step 2: When it is hot, add the garlic and cook, stirring, until lightly browned, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the hoisin sauce, fish sauce, sugar and chili paste, stir well and simmer for 15 seconds. Step 4: Stir in the chicken broth The mixture should have a thick, creamy consistency, add the peanuts. Step 5: Let cool and serve!

Ingredient Names: spring roll wrappers, cornstarch, carrots, cucumbers, lettuce, turnips, french beans, shallots, garlic, small shrimp, eggs, salt, sweet chili sauce, red chilies, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: To make filling: heat oil and fry garlic till fragrant. Step 2: Add in french bean, carrot and turnip, braised with stock till soft. Step 3: Add seasoning and reduced till gravy is almost dry. Step 4: Remove cooked vegetables and strain to separate gravy stock Sauces / condiments Sweet sauce: Fresh red chili paste. Step 5: Fry chopped garlic till golden brown Crushed peanuts To roll popiah: spread sweet sauce onto skin, followed by chilli.

Ingredient Names: flour, tapioca flour, baking powder, corn oil, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Sift together the dry ingredients. Step 2: Mix in the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: Knead the dough It should have a bouncy texture, and should stick to your hand. Step 4: Heat up a wok, without oil, and make sure to use a non stick pan, as it is easier. Step 5: When the wok is hot, spread the dough around the wok in a thin layer Size is about 6 inches. Step 6: Remove when cooked.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, white sugar, garlic, salt, dried red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring vinegar to a boil in a small, nonreactive pot. Step 2: Stir in sugar until dissolved. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, simmer for 15-20 minutes, and remove from heat. Step 4: Mash garlic and salt in a mortar and pestle to a smooth paste. Step 5: Add paste to sweetened vinegar in the pot. Step 6: Stir in red pepper flakes. Step 7: Cool to room temperature before using. Step 8: Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

Dish Name: Hunan Dumplings With Peanut Butter Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork, soya sauce, salt, pepper, sesame seed oil, wonton wrappers, smooth peanut butter, hot water, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, oil, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the pork with the soya sauce, salt, pepper and sesame oil. Step 2: Put about a tsp of filling in the center of each wonton skin and enclose the filling to make a ball shape or a triangle, sealing with a little water. Step 3: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 4: Put the dumplings, in batches into the water until they rise to the surface. Step 5: Remove with a slotted spoon. Step 6: Mix hot water with the peanut butter until well combined and then add the soya sauce, rice vinegar, oil, garlic and chilies. Step 7: Serve on top of the dumplings.

Ingredient Names: millet flour, soy milk, vegetable oil, water, chinese black bean sauce, chile pepper sauce, egg, green onion, fresh cilantro leaves, fried wonton crisps
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk millet flour, soy milk, and vegetable oil together in a bowl to make a batter with the consistency of heavy cream. Step 2: Add a teaspoon of water to thin the batter, if necessary. Step 3: Mash black bean sauce in a small bowl with water to make it easy to spread. Step 4: Mix hot chili sauce with water in a separate small bowl. Step 5: Set both sauces aside. Step 6: Spray a large skillet generously with cooking spray, and heat over medium-low heat. Step 7: Pour batter into the skillet, and spread evenly to make a thin crêpe; cook until firm, about 1 to. Step 8: Pour egg evenly over crêpe; cook an additional 1 to, until egg is set. Step 9: Sprinkle crêpe with green onion slices and cilantro leaves, pressing them firmly into cooked egg. Step 10: Flip crêpe and spread with bean sauce and chili sauce. Step 11: Place crackers in the center of crêpe, leaving about of space between the two crackers. Step 12: Flip top third of crêpe down over crackers; flip the bottom third up, and then fold the crêpe in half so the crackers are stacked on top of each other in a tidy package, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, cabbage, green onions, carrot, garlic clove, soy sauce, ground ginger, sesame oil, wonton wrappers, vegetable oil, chicken broth, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 8 ingredients Lay several wonton wrappers on a flat surface and place 1 tsp of filling in the center of wrapper. Step 2: Make a paste of constarch& water. Step 3: Fold& seal into a triangular shape. Step 4: Then fold all three"points" in making sure to seal all seams with paste. Step 5: In a large nonstick skillet with a tight fitting lid, place 2 tbs of veggie oil. Step 6: Heat oil& fry dumplings, a few at a time, until golden brown on both sides. Step 7: Add about 1 / 3 cup chicken broth to skillet, cover& steam about 8 minutes. Step 8: Repeat, adding oil& broth as needed, until all stickers are done Dipping sauce: reduce a mixture of brown sugar, soy sauce and minced garlic until it is thick enough for dipping.

Ingredient Names: soya sauce, peanut butter, vegetable oil, straw mushrooms, white sugar, chili oil, ground pork, salt, sesame oil, white pepper, wonton skins
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a small bowl If i'm short on time, i buy some potsticker dumplings from our local dumpling shoppe. Step 2: When i have time, i prepare make at home dumplings: Finely chop ground pork. Step 3: Combine pork, soya sauce, salt, white pepper and sesame oil. Step 4: Put a small amount of filling in centre of wonton skin, enclose to make a ball-like shape, sealing the skins with a little water. Step 5: Leave one corner flap extended like a "tail" Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 6: Put a batch of dumplings in water and boil them until they pop to the surface. Step 7: Remove with a slotted spoon and serve with dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: ketchup, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, pineapple juice, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix juice and cornstarch. Step 2: Heat oil in a small saucepan and add remaining ingredients and cornstarch mixture. Step 3: Cook over medium to medium high heat, stirring until sauce thickens.

Ingredient Names: oil, green onion, pork, cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, cooking sherry, salt, cabbage, bamboo shoot, bean sprouts, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or frying pan. Step 2: Stir-fry green onion 30 seconds or until aroma comes, add pork. Step 3: Stir-fry 1 minutes until color changes. Step 4: Add 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon sugar, and 1 tablespoon cooking sherry, cook 1 minute, remove. Step 5: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or frying pan. Step 6: Stir-fry cabbage and bamboo shoots 1 minute, remove.

Ingredient Names: eggs, soy sauce, salt, star anise, five-spice powder, tea leaves, peppercorns, orange peel
Instructions: Step 1: Hard boil the eggs by covering with water and bringing to a boil. Step 2: Cover, turn off the heat, and let sit for 15 minutes. Step 3: Cool completely in cold water This loosens the shell. Step 4: Using the back of a spoon, gently crack the egg shells Do not peel! Step 5: Put the eggs in water just to cover and add the broth ingredients. Step 6: Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 1 hours. Step 7: Remove from the heat and place eggs and tea broth in a covered container. Step 8: Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

Ingredient Names: oil, pork spareribs, salt, garlic cloves, soy sauce, vinegar, water, cayenne pepper, cornstarch, dark brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, brown the spare ribs and garlic in oil, mashing the garlic in with a fork as it takes on color. Step 2: Add salt, soy sauce, vinegar and water. Step 3: Bring to a boil for 1 minute, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Stir sauce ingredients together and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Step 5: Toss with ribs before serving.

Ingredient Names: plum jam, garlic, dry white wine, dijon-style mustard, mustard powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan, stirring, bring to a simmer and cook until the jam has melted Serve with your oriental goodies.

Ingredient Names: duck breasts, salad leaves, cherry tomatoes, scallions, garlic clove, fresh ginger, soy sauce, honey, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 400f Score the skin of the duck breasts and season. Step 2: Heat a non-stick frying pan over a high heat, add the duck, skin side down and cook for 4 mins or until the skin is crisp. Step 3: Turn over and quickly brown the underside then transfer to a baking tray. Step 4: Mix the dressing ingredients together and spoon all but 2 tbs of it over the duck Roast the duck for 10 mins for pink or longer if you prefer. Step 5: Remove from the oven and allow to rest for 4 mins then slice into strips. Step 6: Toss together the salad leaves, tomatoes and scallions with the duck slices. Step 7: Drizzle over the remaining dressing and serve.

Ingredient Names: distilled white vinegar, rice wine vinegar, dried hot peppers, szechuan peppercorns, fresh ginger, sugar, garlic granules, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Roast szechuan peppercorns in a small dry saucepan over medium heat for about 5 minutes, unil fragrant. Step 2: Add all remaining ingredients, except the cabbage, and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 3: Pour over cabbage in a bowl with a fitted lid. Step 4: Remove peppers unless you want the cabbage to be really hot. Step 5: Refrigerate overnight, at least, until ready to use. Step 6: Serve with any oriental meal, or eat as a snack anytime Keeps in the fridge for a couple weeks or longer.

Ingredient Names: dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, sherry wine, ketchup, garlic, sugar, aluminum foil, spareribs
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except meat and pour into a heavy-duty plastic reclosable bag, add spareribs. Step 2: Marinate overnight, turning several times. Step 3: Line a shallow pan with aluminum foil. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 Roast spareribs 45 minutes. Step 5: Turn heat to 325 Roast 15 minutes longer. Step 6: When shrinkage occurs, ribs are done.

Dish Name: P F Changs Sauce For Fried Green Beans Appetizer
Ingredient Names: japanese mayonnaise, hot chili sauce, green onions, garlic cloves, prepared horseradish
Instructions: Step 1: Place ingredients in blender or food processor and mix til smooth For the veggies: Make a tempura batter and dredge your green beans, asparagus or any veggie in it and either flash fry in oil on the stove or in the oven for a healthier spin.

Dish Name: Pan Steamed Vegetable Dumplings With Soy Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic clove, sugar, sesame oil, pepper, canola oil, garlic cloves, shiitake mushroom, chinese cabbage, sake, scallions, carrot, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients for dipping sauce and set aside. Step 2: Prepare the dumplings by heating a large, non-stick wok over medium-high heat Swirl in the canola and sesame oils and add ginger and garlic. Step 3: Stir fry for about 10 seconds and stir in mushrooms and cabbage for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the sake and cook, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes until liquid evaporates Next add the scallions and the carrot and stir-fry about 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and add soy sauce. Step 6: Allow mixture to cool. Step 7: Place 1 teaspoon of the vegetable mixture in center of a wrapper Moisten edges of wrapper with water and fold unto half circles.

Ingredient Names: salt, warm water, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, asian toasted sesame oil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve salt in warm water, and mix in flour to make a soft dough. Step 2: Turn the dough out onto a well-floured work surface, and knead until slightly springy, about 8-10 minutes. Step 3: If the dough is sticky, knead in vegetable oil. Step 4: Divide the dough into 8 equal-size pieces, and keep the pieces covered with a cloth. Step 5: In a bowl, mix flour with vegetable oil to make a mixture like fine crumbs. Step 6: On a floured work surface, roll a piece of dough out into a thin square about 5x7 inches in size, brush the dough with toasted sesame oil, and sprinkle lightly with about the flour-oil mixture. Step 7: Sprinkle about chopped green onion onto the dough, and spread the onion out evenly. Step 8: Starting with a long end, roll the dough up into a rope shape, and pinch the seam and the ends closed. Step 9: Roll the rope shape into a flat spiral, and press lightly with your hands to compact the spiral and keep it from unrolling. Step 10: Place the spiral down onto the floured work surface, and gently roll it out into a pancake with the onions folded inside, turning the pancake over often as you roll it out. Step 11: Roll gently and turn often to avoid making holes in the pancakes. Step 12: Finished pancakes should be about 5 inches in diameter. Step 13: Repeat with the rest of the dough pieces, making 8 onion pancakes. Step 14: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, and brush with vegetable oil. Step 15: Pan-fry each pancake in the hot skillet until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 16: Cut into wedges and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, baking powder, white pepper, cayenne, chicken stock, chinese sausage, scallion, water chestnut, raw shrimp, vegetable oil, chinese red vinegar, dark soy sauce, fresh ginger, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Chinese sausages are available in most asian markets They keep for a long time in the refrigerator and even longer in the freezer There isn't really a substitute but, if you're unable to find it, try a little ground pork instead Another alternative would be to omit it from the recipe- which i've done for my non meat eating daughter in law The pancakes are still super delicious. Step 2: Combine the flour, baking powder, salt, pepper and cayenne. Step 3: Then stir in enough of the stock to make a batter just a little thinner than for regular old pancakes. Step 4: Stir in the rest of the ingredients and refrigerate until ready to use Use a heavy skillet. Step 5: Heat it to very hot, then adjust the flame down so the pancakes cook evenly and not too quickly.

Ingredient Names: duck, salt, vodka, honey, water, fresh ginger, mandarin pancake, green onion, hoisin sauce, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Wash& dry the duck inside and out Rub salt into the cavity. Step 2: Put duck on a large plate spoon the vodka over the duck& rub all over, turn the duck and make sure you rub the vodka all over the bird leave it for 4 hours Dissolve the honey in the water and rub all over the duck Do not miss any area truss the bird and tie a cord around it's neck and hang it in front of an electric fan leave it to dry for at least 4 hours. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 4: Place the ginger inside the duck. Step 5: Place duck on a rack in a pan with water in it The duck must be well above the water. Step 6: Cook for 30 minutes then turn heat down to 300f degrees and continue roasting for about 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: green beans, fresh ginger, garlic, cooking oil, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, szechuan peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and trim green beans, set aside. Step 2: Mix sauces in a bowl well. Step 3: Pour water in wok, heat over high heat until bubbling, boil green bean for 3-5 minutes until crispy tender, remove and drain. Step 4: Heat cooking oil hot in wok over high heat, stir in ginger and garlic until aromatic, combine green bean, stir constantly until beans are soft about 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Combine sauce mixture, stir around until the sauce is thicken and glazes the bean. Step 6: Transfer and serve spicy green bean with cooked rice.

Dish Name: Pickled Asian Pears Wor Mei Lei
Ingredient Names: pears, chinese white rice vinegar, water, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, wash, and dry the pears. Step 2: Place all the remaining ingredients in an oversize glass jar. Step 3: Mix well to ensure all the ingredients are dissolved. Step 4: Add the pears to the jar, mix again, and cover tightly. Step 5: Keep in refrigerator, undisturbed, for at least 3 days before use These pears will keep refrigerated for at least 6 months.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, diced onion, garlic, minced ginger, garlic chives, ground pork, silken tofu, hoisin sauce, salt and pepper, dumpling wrappers, egg, water, all-purpose flour, salt, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan with a lid, heat the canola oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions, garlic, ginger, and garlic chives and cook for 8 minutes. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and let cool Wipe out the pan for frying the dumplings. Step 4: In a large bowl, combine pork, tofu, and hoisin sauce with the chive mixture Test-fry a small portion of the pork mixture and adjust seasoning Holding dumpling wrapper flour side down, place a teaspoonful of pork mixture onto the middle of the wrapper. Step 5: Dip your index finger into the beaten egg and rub it over half of the outer edge of the dumpling. Step 6: Fold dumpling in half, crimping it in the middle and sealing along the egg-moistened edge, taking care not to leave any air pockets. Step 7: Repeat procedure until all dumplings are made.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, frozen chopped spinach, green onion, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, fresh ginger, salt, sugar, gyoza skins, vegetable oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except gyoza wrappers, vegetable oil and water in large bowl 2. Step 2: Place scant 1 tablespoon filling in center of each gyoza wrapper Lightly moisten outside edge of wrapper with a bit of water. Step 3: Fold wrapper in half to enclose filling, pinching center and each end to make a tight seal Holding wonton in hand, seal remaining edges, pinching dough towards center, forming a couple of small pleats. Step 4: Press sealed edge down lightly to plump up dumpling and make it stand up straight 3 place dumplings in rows on baking sheet so they dont touch. Step 5: Heat 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 6: Add 1 tablespoon of the oil.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, ginger, garlic, green onions, napa cabbage, water chestnut, soy sauce, cornstarch, olive oil, wonton wrappers, egg white, peanut oil, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook cabbage for 1-2 minutes in enough water to cover the bottom of the pan. Step 2: Remove from heat and drain water. Step 3: Saute pork in olive oil until cooked. Step 4: Add ginger, garlic, sesame seeds, onions, chestnuts, cabbage, soy, corn starch and mix until blended and remove from heat. Step 5: Brush wonton wrapper with egg white and add one spoonful of meat mixture. Step 6: Fold bottom of wrapper over top and seal into a half crescent Tighten seal with fingers Shallow fry dumplings in peanut oil at medium heat flipping over once, until browned on one side. Step 7: Serve with dipping sauce To make dipping sauce: mix together and serve with dumplings.

Dish Name: Pork Loin In A Garlic Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork loin, garlic, light soy sauce, red chili oil, sesame oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, place pork and add enough cold water to cover. Step 2: Bring to a rolling boil Skim froth from the surface of water, then cover pot and simmer for 25 to 30 minute. Step 3: Remove pot from heat and leave pork in the undrained pot to cool for at 1 to 2 hours. Step 4: Remove meat from pot cover lightly and cool completely in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Step 5: Cut the meat in small thin slices across the grain. Step 6: Arrange on serving plate in an overlapping pattern. Step 7: In a small bowl, mix all the other ingredients, then pour the sauce over the meat If you wish, you might garnish with cilantro and green onions Enjoy!

Dish Name: Rou Jia Mo Spicy Pork Sandwiches
Ingredient Names: pork sausage, green onion, garlic cloves, sake, chili oil, szechuan peppercorns, balsamic vinegar, sugar, refrigerated biscuits
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375f. Step 2: Cook sausage into ground bits and drain grease While pork is cooking, chop onions and garlic, add to sausage. Step 3: Add white wine and vinegar, add sugar, stir well. Step 4: Add chili oil and peppercorns, stir well. Step 5: Once most of liquid has been absorbed by meat, prepare dough.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage links, pineapple chunks, brown sugar, banana
Instructions: Step 1: Cook sausage until done Add pineapple and brown sugar Heat through Add banana Toss to coat and serve.

Ingredient Names: string bean, oil, garlic, soy sauce, hot pepper sauce, stock, sugar, sherry wine, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Toast sesame seeds until they are golden Pan fry beans at medium heat until they are wrinkled. Step 2: Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Step 3: Pour off most of the oil from the pan, add the garlic. Step 4: Cook until it becomes fragrant. Step 5: Add the green beans and the sauce ingredients. Step 6: Allow to cook until most of the liquid has dried up. Step 7: Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, water, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, garlic, green onion, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken wings into 3 portions. Step 2: Combine chicken, water, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, garlic, and green onion in a large skillet. Step 3: Stir together and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 4: Add sesame oil and simmer for another 15-20 minutes over low heat. Step 5: Bring mixture to a boil and add a dash of sesame oil. Step 6: Remove from heat, let cool, and serve.

Dish Name: Shanghai Spring Rolls Or Egg Rolls
Ingredient Names: pork, chicken breast half, raw small shrimp, cabbage, dried chinese mushrooms, scallions, chicken stock, salt, dry sherry, sugar, vegetable oil, cornstarch, sesame oil, egg, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Use the highest flame for the stir frying process. Step 2: Stir fry pork in 2 t oil until no longer pink. Step 3: Add chicken& do the same thing Follow with shrimp, remove to a sieve. Step 4: Add a little more oil to the wok if needed and stir fry the scallions for a few seconds, then add the mushrooms& cabbage. Step 5: Stir fry to wilt cabbage, 2- 3 minutes, stir in sauce. Step 6: When it boils, thicken it with the binder. Step 7: Stir cooked meats back in, followed by sesame oil.

Dish Name: Simple and Tasty Chinese Steamed Buns
Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, warm water, all-purpose flour, white sugar, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the yeast over warm water in a large bowl. Step 2: The water should be no more than 100 degrees F (40 degrees C). Step 3: Let stand for 10 minutes until the yeast softens and begins to form a creamy foam. Step 4: Combine the flour, sugar, and baking soda in a small bowl. Step 5: Stir half of the flour mixture into the yeast mixture until no dry spots remain. Step 6: Stir in the remaining flour, a at a time, mixing well after each addition. Step 7: When the dough has pulled together, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8-10 minutes. Step 8: Lightly oil a large bowl, then place the dough in the bowl and turn to coat with oil. Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, water, boiling water, salt, ground pork, scallions, cabbage, ginger, dry sherry, soy sauce, sesame oil, scallion, garlic

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, scallions, fresh ginger, light soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, wonton wrappers, lettuce leaf

Instructions: Step 1: Place wonton wraps on a nonstick cutting board and lightly brush each with water, lay one small scoop of filling into the center of wrap and fold closed, pressing ends tightly Mist with seasme oil and sautee in skillet ten minutes. Dish Name: Tibetan Momo A Dim Sum Dumpling From Tibet

Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour with enough cold water to make a fairly stiff dough. Step 2: Knead it well and roll small pieces into thin rounds, about 3 1 / 2 inches in diameter. Ingredient Names: rice flour, turnips, chinese sausage, shrimp, dried chinese mushrooms, shallot
Instructions: Step 1: Cook shredded turnip with 1 cup of water for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add some sugar if turnip is bitter. Step 3: Heat 1 tspn of oil, stir fry chinese sausage / ham, dry shrimp, mushrooms, shallots until done. Step 4: Add black or white pepper if desired. Instructions: Step 1: Stir-fry tofu and ginger in a large skillet until brown. Step 2: Add cabbage, bean sprouts, green onions, and carrots. Step 3: Cook for two minutes more. Ingredient Names: cucumber, carrot, mint leaf, pickled ginger, baby dou miao, chives, enoki mushrooms, rice paper sheet, lime juice, thai fish sauce, garlic, red chilies, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Soften rice paper sheets by soaking in warm water. Step 2: When soft and pliable, remove and place on a clean cotton cloth Lay a small amount of the filling along the centre top of the rice paper. Step 3: Fold one side in towards the centre, then fold the bottom up towards the top. Step 4: Roll the wrap over towards the remaining side to make a neat roll. Step 5: Repeat the process until the rice paper and filling are used up. Step 6: Combine all dipping sauce ingredients into a bowl. Step 7: Serve with rice paper rolls.

Ingredient Names: unbleached flour, salt, egg, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Combine flour and salt and mound on pastry board. Step 2: Make an indentation in center of mound, add egg and mix with fingers Gradually add water to form dough. Step 3: Knead 10 minutes and form into a ball. Step 4: Cover with a dampened tea towel and let rest 20 minutes. Step 5: Roll out in several batches to desired thickness, in most cases as thinly as possible. Step 6: Cut in 4-inch squares or 3-inch rounds. Step 7: Dust dough pieces lightly with cornstarch, stack and cover with cloth to prevent drying out until ready to fill Yield: 1 pound, approximately 40 skins Regional cooking of china.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, cooked shrimp, green onions, fresh ginger root, water chestnuts, cornstarch, garlic salt, white sugar, dry sherry, chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, wonton wrappers, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium heat until no longer pink. Step 2: In a large mixing bowl, combine the shrimp, ground pork, green onions, ginger, and water chestnuts. Step 3: Mix in the cornstarch, garlic salt, and sugar. Step 8: Carefully place won tons into boiling water without crowding. Step 9: (Work in batches if necessary.) When the wontons float to the surface, add a cup of cold water and allow the water to come to a boil again. Step 10: Then remove from the boiling water.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, green onions, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, garlic, wonton wrappers, vegetable oil cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the sausage, green onions, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and garlic. Step 2: Place 8 wonton wrappers on a clean surface and brush edges with water. Step 3: Place 1 tablespoon of pork mixture in center of each wrapper Gather edges of wrapper together over filling. Step 4: Press edges of wrapper together, enclosing the filling completely. Step 5: Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Step 6: Place a collapsible metal steamer rack in a large wide pot. Step 7: Fill pot with 1 / 2-inch water Spray steamer rack with nonstick spray. Step 8: Bring water to a simmer.

Dish Name: Zhejiang Style Crispy Five Spice Powder Spring Roll Recipe
Ingredient Names: button mushrooms, sweet corn, onion, garlic, ginger, chinese five-spice powder, hoisin sauce, all purpose flour, butter, salt, spring roll wrappers, oil for frying
Instructions: Step 1: We begin making the Zhejiang Style Crispy Five Spice Powder Spring. Step 2: Roll Recipe by kneading the dough for the spring roll wrapper, knead it to a soft but not a sticky dough. Step 3: Keep it for some time. Heat a nonstick pan, add oil and sauté the ginger and garlic. Step 4: Add the chopped mushroom and sweet corn. Step 5: Sauté till it is cooked. Finally add a tablespoon of the 5 spice powder, hoisin sauce and season it well with salt and pepper, keep it aside. Step 6: Pre-heat the oven to 180 degree Celsius to. In order to make the spring roll wrapper, divide the dough into small balls and roll it onto a board. Step 7: Roll the dough very thin making sure it does not break or create a hole. Place a teaspoon of the filling on one of the sides, making sure that it does not overspill outside. Fold on either left or right sides over the mixture so that they come close to each other but do not touch or overlap. Step 8: This will help in preventing from the filling not to spill out. Start folding the bottom wrapper over the filling and keep rolling it till it completes the other end, seal the open end by dabbing some water and pressing lightly. Place these rolls on a tray greased with oil, by using a pastry brush apply some oil on the spring rolls as well. Serve the Zhejiang Style Crispy Five Spice Powder Spring Roll Recipe for a Party appetizer and relish it with a dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, water, salt, soya chunks, oil, garlic, onions, capsicum, chili sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, pepper powder, chili, sesame seeds, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, separate the leaves of cabbage without tearing apart. Step 2: Soak the leaves in hot water for 10 minutes. this helps leaves to turn flexible. Step 3: After 10 minutes, take a cabbage leaf and trim off the hard part. else it will be difficult to roll. keep aside. Step 4: Firstly, in a large vessel take enough water. add 1 tsp salt and get to a boil. Step 5: Now add 1 cup soya chunks and boil for 8 minutes or until the soya softens. Step 6: Drain off and rinse in cold water. Step 7: Squeeze off the water from soya chunks and transfer to the mixi. Step 8: Pulse and blend to get the minced texture. keep aside. Step 9: In a large kadai, heat 2 tbsp oil, add 2 clove garlic, 1 onion and 4 tbsp capsicum. Step 10: Stir fry on high flame until onions shrink slightly. Step 11: Now add 2 tbsp chilli sauce, 2 tbsp vinegar and 2 tbsp soy sauce. stir fry until the sauces are well combined. Step 12: Further add minced soya, ¼ tsp pepper powder and ¼ tsp salt. Step 13: Saute for a minute or until the soya gets almost cooked. soya stuffing is ready. keep aside. Step 14: Take the cabbage leaf and place 2 tbsp of prepared soya stuffing in the centre. Step 15: Fold and roll to form a spring roll shape. Step 16: Now place the roll into the steamer. Step 17: Steam for 15 minutes or until the roll is cooked completely. Step 18: Firstly, in a pan heat 3 tsp oil. saute 2 clove garlic and 2 chilli for a minute. Step 19: Now add 1 tsp sesame seeds and saute well. Step 20: Further, add 2 tbsp soy sauce and stir fry on high flame. Step 21: Also, add ¾ cup water, 2 tbsp spring onion and mix well. Step 22: Once the sauce comes to a boil, it ready to serve. Step 23: Finally, pour the sauce over stuffed cabbage roll and enjoy.

Dish Name: Asian Mushroom Barley And Vegetable Soup
Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, leeks, garlic clove, gingerroot, celery, carrot, chicken stock, light soy sauce, pearl barley
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dried mushrooms in 1 1 / 2 cups boiling water for 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain but reserve the liquid. Step 3: Discard mushroom stems and thinly slice the cups. Step 4: Heat a small amount of oil in saucepan Over medium heat saute the leeks, garlic, ginger, celeray and carrots for 5 minutes until leek is softened. Step 5: Add stock, soy sauce and barley, sliced mushrooms and reserved mushroom liquid. Step 6: Boil gently for 30 minutes until the barley is plump.

Dish Name: Bok Choy Soup With Mushrooms and Ginger
Ingredient Names: funghi porcini, water, sunflower oil, shallots, garlic, vegetable broth, thumb sized ginger, soy sauce, bok choy, chinese mixed spice, chili powder, rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dry porcini mushrooms in 250 ml of hot water for 5 - 10 minutes. Drain, but save the water. Step 2: In a large pot over medium heat sauté shallots and garlic in the oil for 3 - 4 minutes until onions are translucent and garlic is fragrant. Step 4: Add bok choy and cook for 5 minutes, until tender. Step 5: Before serving stir in Chinese spice mixture and chili powder. Step 6: Meanwhile, prepare the rice noodles according to the instructions on the package. Drain and divide noodles among four bowls. Add bok choy soup to the noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, water, chinese rice wine, fresh ginger, creamed corn, salt, cornstarch, egg whites, oriental sesame oil, cooked ham

Ingredient Names: lean pork, oil, soy sauce, pepper, ground ginger, chicken broth, chinese cabbage, chow mein noodles

Dish Name: Chinese Chicken Soup with Bok Choy

Step 8: Place chicken into the pot of broth. Step 9: Simmer until chicken is heated through, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Pour soup over noodles to serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, sherry wine, cornstarch, water, sesame oil, peanut oil, chicken stock, fresh ginger, corn, creamed corn, salt, pepper, eggs, green onions

Step 7: Then add this chicken mixture to the simmering stock mixture. Step 8: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.

Dish Name: Chinese Dried Fig Apple And Almond Soup

Step 3: In a 4-quart saucepan, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil over high heat. Step 4: Add pork and return to a boil, skimming any scum that forms. Step 5: Add the apple wedges, dried figs, almonds and their soaking water. Step 6: Return to a boil over high heat. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer 3 hours, serve piping hot.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cornstarch, eggs, rice wine vinegar, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan bring broth to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Whisk cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup water in a small cup until smooth And then whisk mixture into broth. Step 5: Heat peas according to package directions and then divide into 4 bowls Ladle soup over the peas.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, frozen green peas, egg, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken broth and peas to a boil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Slowly add egg to the boiling broth, stirring constantly. Step 3: Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, fresh lemongrass, fresh ginger root, garlic, skinless boneless chicken breast halves, shrimp, peeled and deveined, lime juice, fish sauce, jalapeno pepper, fresh cilantro, bean thread noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Soak bean threads in a large bowl of hot water to cover until soft, about 5 minutes; drain then cut into bite-sized lengths. Step 2: Divide noodles among 4 serving bowls. Step 5: Add chicken and shrimp; simmer until chicken is cooked through, 3 to. Step 6: Stir in lime juice and fish sauce. Step 7: Ladle soup over noodles; top with jalape帽o slices and cilantro.

Dish Name: Chinese Hand-Pulled Noodles in Beef Broth
Ingredient Names: water, boneless beef shoulder, fresh ginger, szechuan peppercorns, dried tsaoko, dried mandarin orange peel, bay leaves, salt, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, daikon radish, green garlic, fresh cilantro, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Step 2: Add beef, ginger, Szechuan peppercorns, dried tsaoko, dried mandarin peels, and bay leaves; bring soup back to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes. Step 3: Discard whole spices. Step 4: Season beef broth with salt to taste. Step 5: Cover and keep warm. Step 6: Place flour in a large bowl and gradually mix in water. Step 7: Mix until dough comes together; knead until smooth, 15 to. Step 8: Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 10 minutes. Step 9: Knead dough again for 8-10 minutes; cover and let rest for 10 minutes. Step 10: Knead dough one more time for 8-10 minutes. Step 11: Divide into 4 equal pieces. Step 12: Roll each piece into a 3/8-inch-thick sheet. Step 13: Brush both sides of each sheet with oil. Step 14: Stack sheets together; cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 10 to. Step 15: Fill a large saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Step 16: Add sliced daikon and cook for 10 to. Step 17: Remove using a slotted spoon and drain well; set aside. Step 18: Save water to cook the noodles. Step 19: Place 1 sheet of dough on a cutting board and slice into 1/8-inch-wide strips. Step 21: Fold it into thirds and stretch again to the same length; shake and slap against the counter several times to lengthen it to 2 to 3 yards. Step 22: Drop it into the boiling water. Step 23: Add 2 to 3 more strips of noodles to the boiling water; cook until tender, 5 to. Step 24: Transfer drained noodles to a serving bowl. Step 25: Repeat the process with the remaining sheets of dough. Step 26: Pour beef broth on top of the drained noodles and top with cooked beef, daikon, chopped green garlic, cilantro, and chili oil.

Dish Name: Chinese Hot And Sour Pork Soup

Step 6: Bring back to simmer and pour the eggs in a very thin stream over the surface. Step 7: Let stand for 10 sec Before stirring in the sesame oil. Dish Name: Chinese Hot And Sour Soup Lite
Ingredient Names: fat-free chicken broth, garlic and red chile paste, soy sauce, shiitake mushroom, straw mushroom, white vinegar, bamboo shoot, firm tofu, water chestnut, cornstarch, egg beaters egg substitute
Instructions: Step 1: Using an 8-qt dutch oven, bring 8 cups of fat-free chicken broth to a simmer. Step 2: Add the soy sauce, mushrooms and chile paste and simmer for about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the vinegar, julienned bamboo shoots, sliced water chestnuts, and tofu and simmer for an additional 10 minutes. Dish Name: Chinese Hot And Sour Soup Szechwan House
Ingredient Names: pork loin, soy sauce, dried black mushrooms, dried black fungus, red wine vinegar, kosher salt, sugar, peanut oil, bamboo shoot, chicken broth, firm tofu, eggs, cornstarch, garlic and red chile paste
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the pork with 1 tablespoons of soy sauce. Step 2: Let it sit for 30 minute As that sits reconstitute the dried black mushrooms and black fungus. Step 4: Pour enough water over them to cover them If you have extra chicken broth you can use it If not water will do fine. Step 5: Let the mushrooms and fungus hydrate for about 20-30 min over a low boil. Step 6: Combine the vinegar, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, salt, and sugar in a small bowl If you have not mixed the corn starch and water do so in a small bowl.

Dish Name: Chinese Hot Pots Gluten Free And Low Carb
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, water, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, boneless chicken thighs, bean thread noodles, green onion, mung bean sprouts, mushrooms, baby bok choy, garlic and red chile paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, bring the chicken stock, water, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger and garlic to a boil. Step 4: Meanwhile chop all the veggies and place in serving bowls. Step 5: When ready to serve, allow each person to fill their bowls with fresh vegetables and a bit of chile sauce. Step 6: Then ladle the scalding hot soup over the veggies and let them sit for 5 minutes, mix and eat!

Ingredient Names: water, chicken flavor instant bouillon, pork loin, chinese five spice powder, salt, ginger, mushrooms, carrot, fresh cilantro, corn oil, sesame oil, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Rub five spice powder on pork and salt liberally. Step 2: Fry the pork and ginger in a wok with a little oil till cooked through. Step 3: Transfer pork onto a cutting board and slice into thin strips. Step 4: Add 6 cups of water to the wok and bring to a boil The wok does not need to be rinsed out unless you used too much oil. Step 5: Add granuled chicken flavoring, mushrooms and carrots. Step 6: Boil till the vegetables are cooked, turn heat off. Step 7: Add pork strips and sesame oil to taste Lime juice can be added, too, if you want the soup to be a little sour.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, salt, cooking oil, cold water, boneless skinless chicken thighs, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the jasmine rice in cold water. Step 2: Transfer to a large stock pot. Step 3: Sprinkle the 2 tsps Salt and shake mildly to combine. Step 4: Add the 10 cups of cold water and 1 / 2 cup cooking oil and partially cover. Step 5: Turn on stove to high and bring the rice / water mixture to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium to medium / low and cook for 3 hours, stirring occasionally the soup will thicken over time If too thick for your taste, add water and continue cooking. Step 7: Meanwhile, combine chicken, 1 / 2 tsp salt, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch and cooking oil and stir to cover chicken with marinade. Step 8: Let chicken sit for at least 30 minutes to marinate.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger, small shrimp, shelled and deveined, chicken stock, tofu, frozen peas, salt, black pepper, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger; cook until fragrant and lightly browned. Step 3: Add shrimp; stir-fry until cooked. Step 4: Transfer to a bowl; set aside. Step 5: Add chicken stock to the saucepan; bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium. Step 7: Add tofu and peas; season with salt and black pepper. Step 8: Return to a simmer. Step 9: Mix cornstarch with a little water to form a thin paste; stir into soup and continue to simmer until clear and thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Return shrimp to soup; stir and serve.

Ingredient Names: baby shrimp, skinless boneless chicken, egg, cornstarch, vegetable oil for frying, chicken broth, mushrooms, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, fresh green beans, salt, sherry, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the shrimp, chicken, egg, and cornstarch. Step 2: Heat the oil in wok. Step 3: When it is hot, add shrimp and chicken mixture. Step 4: Cook for 1/ and drain. Step 5: Place above mixture in pot with the broth, mushroom, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, and green beans, bring to a boil. Step 6: Add salt and sherry, return to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and allow to simmer. Step 8: Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil until it is hot. Step 9: Add rice and brown quickly. Step 10: Drain and add to soup, serve and.

Dish Name: Chinese Spicy Hot And Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: dried wood ear mushrooms, dried shiitake mushrooms, dried tiger lily buds, chicken stock, bamboo shoots, lean ground pork, soy sauce, white sugar, salt, ground white pepper, red wine vinegar, cornstarch, water, firm tofu, egg, sesame oil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dried mushrooms and tiger lily buds in warm water for 30 minutes. Step 2: After trimming off any tough stems, slice the mushrooms. Step 3: With the fingers, shred the tiger lily stems. Step 4: Place the mushrooms, tiger lily buds, stock, bamboo shoots, and shredded pork into a saucepan. Step 5: Bring to a boil, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Stir in soy sauce, sugar, salt, white pepper, and vinegar. Step 7: Combine cornstarch with water. Step 8: Add a little of the hot soup to the cornstarch, and then return all to the pan. Step 9: Heat to boiling, stirring. Step 10: Add the bean curd, and cook 1 to. Step 11: Just before serving, turn off the heat. Step 12: Stir the egg in gradually. Step 13: Mix in sesame oil. Step 14: Sprinkle each serving with scallions.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, pork spareribs, cold water, gingerroot, scallions, rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from the chicken and ribs and chop them into large pieces. Step 2: Place them in a large pot with the water. Step 3: Add the ginger and scallion knots. Step 4: Bring to a boil, and skim off the scum from the top. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for at least 2-3 hours. Step 6: Strain the stock, discarding the chicken, pork, ginger and scallions and return broth to the pot. Step 7: Add the wine and return to a boil, simmer for 2-3 minutes.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Egg Drop Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, cold water, eggs, scallions, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sauce pot, bring the chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil over medium high heat. Step 2: Boil for 2 minutes. Step 3: Taste and add more soy if needed. Step 4: Meanwhile, trim roots / Slice the scallions to approximately 1 / 8 thick slices. Step 5: Combine the cornstarch with the cold water and mix well Slowly add cornstarch mixture to the boiling broth while constantly stirring to desired consistency. Step 6: Stir while boiling for 2 minutes. Step 7: Reduce heat to a low boil, add white pepper and then "drizzle" the beaten eggs "slowly" into the broth while stirring constantly The eggs should be forming into small streams of ribbons.

Dish Name: Chinese Take Out Hot And Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, chicken stock, bamboo shoot, pork tenderloin, firm tofu, cider vinegar, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, chili-garlic sauce, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cornstarch, cold water, egg, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the mushrooms in 1 / 3 cup boiling water for 15 minutes With a slotted spoon, lift the mushrooms from the liquid and set aside. Step 2: Strain the liquid through a coffee filter-lined strainer to remove the grit and set aside. Step 3: Discard the tough stems from the mushrooms. Step 4: Squeeze the mushrooms dry. Step 5: Cut into thin slices. Step 6: Pour the mushroom liquid and chicken stock into a large stockpot set over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add the mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and meat. Step 8: Bring the mixture to a simmer and add the tofu, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and chili sauce. Step 9: Taste the soup and adjust the seasonings to taste.

Ingredient Names: chicken backs and necks, chicken stock, peppercorns, fresh ginger, onion, carrot, celery, bay leaf, boneless pork shoulder, green onions, green onion, dry white wine, soy sauce, five-spice powder, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To make the stock: in a large stockpot, combine the chicken, stock, peppercorns, ginger, onion, carrot, celery and bay leaf. Step 2: Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Step 3: Reduce the heat to low and continue to simmer the stock uncovered 30 minutes, skimming the froth from the top every now and then and discarding it. Step 4: Strain the stock into another large pot, discarding the bones and vegetables Skim and discard the fat from the top of the stock with a large spoon Depending on how aggressively your stock has cooked, it may have reduced somewhat. Step 5: Taste the stock If it is a little salty, add water in 1 / 4 cup increments until a balance has been achieved To make the wontons: in a large bowl, combine the pork, 2 tblsp of green onion, the wine, soy sauce, five-spice powder, and pepper, mix thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ripe tomatoes, water, eggs, green onion, sesame oil, white sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add tomatoes; saute until mostly melted, 5 to. Step 3: Add water; bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low; cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors are well blended, 5 to. Step 5: Add eggs, stirring slowly and constantly for 1 hour. Step 6: Add green onion; cook for 30 seconds. Step 7: Stir in sesame oil, sugar, and salt.

Ingredient Names: pork neck bones, water, potatoes, tomatoes, onion, carrot, white sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork neck bones into a large pot; cover with water. Step 2: Bring to a boil and skim scum off the surface with a slotted spoon, drain. Step 3: Return bones to the pot. Step 4: Add water, potatoes, tomatoes, onion, and carrot, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and simmer soup until flavors combine, 1 1/2 to. Step 6: Season with sugar and salt.

Dish Name: Dan Dan Noodles With Pickled Mustard Greens
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, brandy, hoisin sauce, cornstarch, ground pork, sesame paste, balsamic vinegar, chili oil, sesame oil, garlic clove, chicken stock, vegetable oil, baby bok choy, asian noodles, pickled mustard greens
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce with the brandy, hoisin sauce and cornstarch. Step 3: Blend the mixture into the ground pork. Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk the sesame paste with the vinegar and the remaining 2 tablespoons of soy sauce until smooth. Step 5: In a small saucepan, heat the chili and sesame oils. Step 6: Add the garlic and cook over high heat for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add the sesame paste mixture and simmer for 1 minute. Step 8: Add the stock and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until reduced slightly, about 3 minutes. Step 9: In a small skillet, heat the vegetable oil. Step 10: Add the seasoned ground pork and cook over moderately high heat, breaking up the meat with a spatula, until cooked through, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cream style corn, low-sodium chicken broth, cornstarch, water, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Combine corn and chicken broth in a saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Mix together cornstarch and water in a small bowl or cup; pour into the boiling corn soup, and continue cooking for about 10 minutes, or until thickened. Step 4: Gradually add beaten egg while stirring the soup. Step 5: Remove from heat and serve.

Dish Name: Egg Drop Soup (Better than Restaurant Quality!)
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, water, cornstarch, egg, yellow food coloring, ground white pepper, salt, chopped fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine chicken broth, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a small saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil. Step 3: Combine water and cornstarch in a small bowl until cornstarch is dissolved; stir into boiling broth. Step 4: Stir in food coloring. Step 5: Slowly pour in beaten egg, stirring constantly in one direction to form thin egg ribbons. Step 6: Season soup with white pepper and salt. Step 7: Serve hot, garnished with fresh chives.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cornstarch, egg, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium stock pot, mix cold chicken broth with cornstarch. Step 2: Slowly heat over medium heat, stirring frequently. Step 3: Pour beaten egg into soup, and stir once around stock pot very gently, in order to break up egg. Step 4: Remove soup from heat immediately, divide into four portions and garnish with green onions.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, ground ginger, fresh chives, salt, cornstarch, eggs, egg yolk
Instructions: Step 1: Reserve 3 / 4 cup of chicken broth, and pour the rest into a large saucepan. Step 2: Stir the salt, ginger and chives into the saucepan, and bring to a rolling boil. Step 3: In a cup or small bowl, stir together the remaining broth and cornstarch until smooth, set aside. Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and egg yolk together using a fork. Step 5: Drizzle egg a little at a time from the fork into the boiling broth mixture Egg should cook immediately. Step 6: Once the eggs have been dropped, stir in the cornstarch mixture gradually until the soup is the desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, white pepper, sesame oil, egg, peas, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the chicken broth, white pepper, and sesame oil to a boil in a saucepan. Step 2: While stirring slowly in one direction to get the soup moving, pour the beaten egg into the soup in a slow but steady stream. Step 3: Gently stir in the peas. Step 4: Ladle into serving bowls; sprinkle with green onion to serve.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, chicken stock, ginger, light soy sauce, chili bean sauce, superfine sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put the stock in a saucepan and bring to simmering point. Step 2: Add the ginger, soy sauce, chili bean sauce, sugar and the tomatoes. Step 3: Simmer for 2 minutes and serve immediately. Step 4: Add a dash of lemon juice for a south-east asian touch or serve at room temperature on particularly hot, summer days.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, cabbage leaves, gluten-free soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic cloves, fresh ginger, salt, egg, gluten-free flour, green onions, green onion, beef bouillon cubes, onions, rice vermicelli
Instructions: Step 1: Put pork and chopped suey choi in a large glass bowl Don't let any pork drippings get in the bowl. Step 2: Add 5 tb soy sauce, 1 tb sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and salt. Step 3: Stir until seasonings and cabbage are evenly mixed, add egg and mix. Step 4: Add flour and mix Meat mixture should be holding together like for meatballs. Step 5: Add more flour if needed. Step 6: Bring about 4 cups of water to boil. Step 7: Add 1 bouillon cube.

Dish Name: He Jia Tuan Yuan (Tofu Ball Soup for Lunar Chinese New Year)
Ingredient Names: soft tofu, ground pork, cornstarch, egg, chicken bouillon granules, salt, water, vegetable oil, pea vine shoots, dried shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Mash tofu in a large bowl into a paste with a spoon; stir in pork, cornstarch, egg, bouillon granules, and salt until well combined. Step 2: Bring water and oil to a boil in a large saucepan. Step 3: Reduce heat to a lively simmer but not a full boil. Step 4: Pinch off about tofu mixture, using gloved hands; roll it into a ball and carefully lower into water. Step 5: Repeat forming and adding tofu balls to water with remaining tofu mixture. Step 6: Simmer tofu balls until they rise to the top without stirring, about 1 hour. Step 7: Off heat, stir in pea vine shoots, dried shrimp, remaining bouillon granules, and remaining 录 teaspoon salt.

Ingredient Names: boiling water, dried shiitake mushrooms, firm tofu, water chestnuts, ground pork, green onions, garlic, fresh ginger, rice wine, dry sherry, soy sauce, brown sugar, egg, kosher salt, cayenne pepper, cornstarch, napa cabbage, chicken broth, sesame oil, hot chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pour boiling water over shiitake mushrooms, and let sit until soft enough to slice, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the meatball mixture: Combine tofu and chestnuts in a large bowl. Step 3: Add ground pork, green onions, garlic, and ginger. Step 4: Pour in rice wine, soy sauce, brown sugar, egg, salt, and cayenne. Step 5: Dust with cornstarch. Step 6: Mix with a clean hand until thoroughly combined. Step 7: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Step 8: Form mixture into 6 large meatballs with wet hands. Step 9: Set an oven rack about 8 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Step 10: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and oil lightly. Step 11: Place meatballs on the prepared baking sheet. Step 12: Broil in the preheated oven until browned, 8 to. Step 13: Remove from the oven and let cool while prepping the pot. Step 14: For the cooking liquid: Trim off the bottom of the head of cabbage and slice 1/2 of the head. Step 15: Arrange sliced cabbage on the bottom of a large soup pot or Dutch oven. Step 16: Arrange remaining cabbage leaves on top. Step 17: Slice and scatter mushrooms on top of cabbage; reserve shiitake liquid. Step 18: Nestle meatballs into cabbage leaves and pour juices over. Step 19: Strain reserved shiitake liquid into a bowl. Step 20: Add chicken broth, soy sauce, sherry, sesame oil, brown sugar, cornstarch, and sesame oil. Step 21: Whisk until dissolved. Step 22: Add to the pot, pouring over each meatball. Step 23: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 24: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes. Step 25: Uncover and increase heat to medium-high. Step 26: Continue cooking, basting meatballs often, until liquid reduces slightly and meatballs are no longer pink in the center, about 15-20 minutes. Step 27: Taste for seasoning. Step 28: Ladle into serving bowls and arrange cabbage over meatballs. Step 29: Top with green onions and chili oil.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, egg, cornstarch, sesame oil, fresh ginger root, msg, salt, green onions, vegetable oil, napa cabbage, low-sodium chicken broth, water, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ground pork, egg, cornstarch, sesame oil, ginger, monosodium glutamate, salt, and half of the chopped green onions together in a bowl. Step 2: Use your hands to mix until the ingredients are evenly distributed, set aside. Step 3: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 4: When the oil is hot, fry the napa cabbage, stirring constantly, until cabbage begins to wilt, 2 to. Step 5: Pour in the chicken broth, water, and soy sauce. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to medium. Step 7: Use a spoon to form the meat mixture into balls. Step 8: Drop them into the boiling soup. Step 9: When the last ball has been added, cover with a lid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Taste, and adjust salt before serving. Step 11: Garnish with remaining green onions and a drizzle of sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: oxtail, onion, tomatoes, potatoes, carrot, celery ribs, cabbage, garlic cloves, bay leaf, salt and pepper, beef bouillon cubes, paprika, tomato paste, ketchup, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ox tail in oil Add tomato paste Add spices Add onion Add celery Add carrots Add garlic Add water Add bouillon cubes Simmer for 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, chicken broth, orange juice, boneless pork, sliced water chestnuts, soy sauce, salt, tofu, white wine vinegar, tabasco sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl pour enough boiling water over mushrooms to cover. Step 2: Let stand up to 30 minutes. Step 3: Drain In large saucepot combine mushrooms, broth, orange juice, pork, carrots, water chestnuts, soy sauce and salt, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes or until pork is cooked. Step 5: Add tofu, vinegar and tabasco sauce. Step 6: Combine cornstarch and water until smooth, add to soup. Step 7: Stir constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat and boil for one minute.

Dish Name: Hot And Sour Soup Betty Foo Hunan Restaurant
Ingredient Names: dried lily buds, dried mushroom, firm tofu, pork, eggs, bamboo shoot, cornstarch, water, distilled white vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, salt, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the dried day lilies, soak them in warm water for about 20 minutes. Step 2: Cut off the hard, tough Clean and soak the wood ear mushrooms in warm water for about 20 minutes, then cut into small pieces To clean, just wipe with a damp cloth -- don't soak or wash! Step 3: Bring the chicken broth to a boil and then add the pork, skimming the surface of any fat. Step 4: Cook the pork for 3-4 minutes, until the broth comes to a boil again. Step 5: Add the tofu, mushroom pieces, bamboo shoots, and day lilies. Step 6: Let the pot return to a boil, then reduce heat to maintain a low boil. Step 7: Add the soy sauce, spices, vinegar, salt and sugar. Step 8: Taste the soup, adjusting the vinegar for the "sour" and salt for balance.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, fresh mushrooms, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, gingerroot, pepper, cornstarch, cold water, cooked turkey, bok choy, pea pods, egg, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, mushrooms, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, gingerroot and pepper, use a large saucepan, bring to boiling. Step 2: Meanwhile, stir together cornstarch and cold water. Step 3: Stir into broth mixture. Step 4: Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Step 5: Cook and stir for 2 minutes more.
