Step 6: Stir in turkey, bok choy and pea pods. Step 7: Pour the egg slowly, into the soup, in a steady stream while stirring 2 or 3 times to create shreds, remove from heat. Step 8: Stir in green onions.

Ingredient Names: dried shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, seasoned rice vinegar, ground white pepper, sesame oil, cornstarch, water, vegetable oil, fresh ginger root, green onions, chicken broth, carrot, red bell pepper, bamboo shoots, tofu, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Soak dried shiitake mushrooms in hot water, stirring occasionally, until soft, 15 to. Step 3: Drain well and slice into thin strips. Step 4: Whisk soy sauce, vinegar, ground white pepper, and sesame oil together in a small bowl for hot and sour mixture; set aside until needed. Step 5: Whisk cornstarch and water together in another small bowl for slurry; set aside until needed. Step 6: Heat vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add ginger, sliced green onions, and shiitake mushrooms. Step 8: Cook, stirring, for about 5 minutes. Step 9: Pour in chicken broth and bring up to a simmer. Step 10: Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 11: Stir in carrot, red pepper, bamboo shoots, tofu, and the hot and sour mixture. Step 12: Let simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Raise heat to medium-high and bring to a boil. Step 14: Stir the soup slowly with a spoon while transferring in the beaten eggs in a steady stream to create thin ribbons. Step 15: Keep stirring until the soup comes back to a boil. Step 16: Reduce heat to medium. Step 17: Stir the cornstarch slurry to make sure it's well blended, then slowly drizzle it into the soup while stirring constantly. Step 18: Soup should thicken up within 1 to. Step 19: Turn off heat, taste for seasoning, and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, garlic cloves, gingerroot, black pepper, tamari, shiitake mushrooms, firm tofu, napa cabbage, carrot, frozen peas, rice vinegar, mirin, cornstarch, cold water, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Bring stock to a boil over medium-high heat in a 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart saucepan. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, black pepper, and tamari. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Step 4: Add mushrooms, tofu, cabbage, carrots, peas and meat. Step 5: Stir and let simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Step 6: Stir in vinegar, mirin and cornstarch mixture Continue cooking until soup is thickened, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add chile paste / sauce to taste. Step 8: Remove soup from heat Slowly pour in beaten egg and stir.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, salt, white pepper, garlic powder, egg, medium firm tofu, tomatoes, spinach, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring stock to boil, seasoned to taste with salt, pepper, garlic powder. Step 2: Stir in the spinach and tofu. Step 3: Bring back to boil Slowly stir in egg to form egg drop. Step 4: Stir in the tomato. Step 5: Put a few drops of sesame oil in each bowl Ladle soup into bowls.

Dish Name: Kennett Square Shitake Ginger And Pork Pot Sticker Soup
Ingredient Names: shiitake mushrooms, canola oil, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, bok choy, soy sauce, low sodium chicken broth, ground pork, cilantro, green onion, wonton wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Mushroom soup base: Chop sliced shiitake mushrooms into small pieces. Step 2: Heat canola oil over medium heat in a 4-quart pan. Step 3: Add sesame oil, garlic, ginger and bok choy stems. Step 4: Cook, stirring constantly, for about 1 minute. Step 5: Add soy sauce and mushrooms. Step 6: Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 8-10 minutes. Step 7: Remove 1 cup of cooked mushroom mixture, and reserve for later. Step 8: Add chicken broth Adjust heat to maintain low simmer, and cover.

Dish Name: Linda's Hot And Sour Soup Chinese
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, lean pork, garlic, red chili paste, soy sauce, white pepper, eggs, cornstarch, bamboo shoot, water chestnut, dried chinese mushrooms, firm tofu, white vinegar, sesame oil, dried black fungus
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the stock to a simmer. Step 2: Add soy sauce, pork, mushrooms and chile paste. Step 3: Simmer for about 10 minutes. Step 4: Add white pepper, vinegar, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, fungus, tofu, and simmer 5 minutes. Step 5: Mix cornstarch with 5 t Water and add to soup. Step 6: Bring back to simmer, and pour the eggs in a very thin stream over the surface, stirring in one direction as you add the eggs. Step 7: Let stand for 10 seconds, then stir in the sesame oil. Step 8: Serve with a chopped scallions on top.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cabbage, lean pork tenderloin, fresh ginger root, chicken broth, soy sauce, green onions, chinese egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add cabbage and pork; stir-fry until pork is no longer pink inside, about 3-4 minutes, stir in ginger. Step 3: Add chicken broth and soy sauce to the skillet; bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low; simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Stir in onions and add noodles. Step 6: Cook until noodles are tender, 2 to more.

Dish Name: Low Cal Chinese Chicken Corn Soup
Ingredient Names: canned chicken broth, creamed corn, cooked chicken, cornstarch, cold water, egg whites, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, corn and chicken in large saucepan. Step 2: Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Blend cornstarch with cold water and add to soup Continue cooking, uncovered, for 3 minutes. Step 4: Beat egg whites until foamy, stir into soup. Step 5: Reduce heat and cook until foam is gone. Step 6: Garnish with parsley, serve hot.

Dish Name: Low Carb Chinese Hot Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, white button mushrooms, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, white pepper, cornstarch, bamboo shoots, sliced water chestnuts, shiitake mushroom caps, silken tofu, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Add chicken broth, soy sauce, garlic chili sauce and both kinds of mushrooms to dutch oven. Step 2: Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 3: Add bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, tofu, white pepper, sesame oil and cornstarch mixture. Step 4: Simmer 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Low Fat Egg Drop Soup My Way
Ingredient Names: low-fat chicken broth, splenda sugar substitute, egg whites, fresh spinach, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large deep saucepan heat the broth to a boil. Step 2: Lower the heat to low and slowly add the egg white to the broth while stirring. Step 3: Add the splenda, spinach and green onion and immediately remove from the heat and stir lightly. Step 4: Cover pan and allow it to stand for 2-3 minutes, serve.

Dish Name: Madame Wong's Hot And Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: dried black mushrooms, dried black fungus, boiling water, lean pork, bamboo shoot, salt, cornstarch, oil, chicken stock, light soy sauce, pepper, vinegar, water, firm tofu, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Put mushrooms and fungus into separate bowls. Step 2: Cover each with boiling water. Step 3: Let soak 3-4 hours, or overnight. Step 4: Remove stems from mushrooms. Step 5: Remove woody parts from fungus Separately cut mushroms, fungus, pork and bamboo shoots to fine julienne. Step 6: Mix pork with salt and cornstarch in a bowl. Step 7: Heat wok and add a dash of oil, stir-fry pork until color changes. Step 8: Bring chicken stock to a boil in a large pot. Step 9: Add mushrooms, fungus, pork and bamboo shoots.

Dish Name: Mandarin Hot And Sour Pork Soup
Ingredient Names: soup stock, square bean curd, dried black mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, ham, chili oil, salt, sugar, eggs, pork, bamboo shoot, button mushrooms, green onions, vinegar, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring soup stock to a boil, add Shredded pork, black mushrooms and wood ears, cook 2-3 minutes. Step 2: Add remainder of ingredients and seasonings reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes Thicken with cornstarch and turn off heat Slowly pour in beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring, serve immediately. Step 3: Garnish with green onion If soup is to be prepared ahead of time, do not add cornstarch and eggs until serving time Otherwise the egg will be overcooked and spoil the appearance.

Dish Name: Mandarin Soup Peiping T Ang Soup
Ingredient Names: pork, oil, carrot, celery, mushroom, chicken stock, spinach, egg, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the pork of all fat. Step 2: Cut into match stick like pieces, heat oil. Step 3: Saute pork for 5 minutes, add carrots, add celery, add mushrooms. Step 4: Cook for 2 minutes. Step 5: Stir in chicken stock and spinach, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, medium shrimp, shiitake mushroom, carrot, garlic cloves, savoy cabbage, pot stickers, scallions, tamari, black pepper, chicken stock, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: In a soup pot heat 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil over medium-high to high heat. Step 2: Add either the shrimp, chicken or pork and stir-fry: cook shrimp until just pink, about 2 minutes Or cook chicken or pork until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, carrots and garlic, and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Then add the cabbage and cook until it is wilted, 5 minutes While the cabbage cooks, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a skillet and arrange the pot stickers in it. Step 5: Add 2 / 3 cup of water and turn the heat to medium-high. Step 6: Cook for 8 minutes to evaporate the water, then let the pot stickers brown for another minute While the pot stickers cook, add the scallions, tamari, and black pepper to the soup pot that has the cabbage and meat in it, and stir to combine. Step 7: Add the stock and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: lean boneless pork, soy sauce, baby spinach leaves, salt, dried wood ear mushrooms, white pepper, eggs, sesame oil, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork into fine slivers. Step 2: Wash the spinach well, drain, and cut into 1 1 / 4 inch slices Blanch spinach in boiling water briefly and drain Break the wood ears into small pieces. Step 3: Heat the stock in a pot. Step 4: Add the pork, wood ears, soy sauce, salt, and pepper and bring to a boil. Step 5: Pour in the eggs in a steady stream, stirring the stock with a circular motion so the egg covers the surface. Step 6: Sprinkle the sesame oil and the spinach on top. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: egg, salt, tapioca flour, cold water, chicken broth, ground ginger, fresh garlic, green onion, asian toasted sesame oil, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the egg and salt together in a bowl until well mixed. Step 2: In a separate bowl, combine the tapioca flour with the cold water and stir to dissolve. Step 3: Bring the chicken broth, ginger, and garlic to a full rolling boil, remove from the heat, and stir in the dissolved tapioca starch. Step 4: Boil until the soup has thickened and is no longer cloudy, about 15-20 minutes; remove from the heat. Step 5: Pour the egg into the soup in a thin line, and gently stir the egg in a figure 8 shape, making sure not to overmix the egg too much. Step 6: Sprinkle the soup with the chopped onions, sesame oil, and white pepper, and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, fresh gingerroot, whole black peppercorn, green onions, sweet red pepper, button mushroom, bamboo shoot, rice wine vinegar, chili powder, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large cooking pot, add chicken broth, sliced ginger root, peppercorns and bring to boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Step 3: Strain broth and discard ginger root and peppercorns. Step 4: Return strained broth to cooking pot. Step 5: Add sliced green onions, sliced red sweet pepper, sliced mushrooms, bamboo shoots, rice wine vinegar, chili powder and sesame oil. Step 6: Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are just tender crisp. Step 7: Serve in soup bowls If desired, serve this soup over cooked white or brown rice.

Dish Name: Paigu Luobo Tang Chinese Pork Rib And Daikon Soup
Ingredient Names: water, ginger, fine sea salt, pork spareribs, daikon radish, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Stove top method: Place pork ribs, ginger, and water in a large pot. Step 2: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 3: Turn down to a simmer and skim scum off the top Continue simmering covered for 60 minutes, until almost completely tender In the meantime, peel the daikon and cut it into 1 thick rounds, then quarter the rounds. Step 4: Add the daikon to the soup, and simmer 30-45 minutes more, until pork and daikon are both completely tender Adjust the seasoning, and serve, garnished with fresh cilantro or green onion. Step 5: Serve as part of a chinese meal Slow cooker method:.

Dish Name: Panda Express Copycat Hot And Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, button mushroom, chili-garlic sauce, white pepper, cornstarch, cold water, egg, tofu, green onions, distilled white vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a 3-quart saucepan. Step 2: Add soy sauce, sliced button mushrooms, chili garlic sauce and white pepper. Step 3: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 4: Combine 3 tbsp of cornstarch with 3 tbsp of cold water in a cup. Step 5: Stir until mixture is smooth. Step 6: Add cornstarch mixture to hot soup and stir well. Step 7: Simmer for 3 or 4 minutes until soup is thickened. Step 8: Beat egg in a cup until yolk and white are combined. Step 9: Pour beaten egg slowly, in a fine stream, into soup. Step 10: Stir soup slowly several times.

Dish Name: Plain Hotpot Broth Sichuan Bai Tang Lu
Ingredient Names: shaoxing wine, low sodium chicken broth, salt, tomatoes, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Place your wok on the stovetop under low heat / simmer. Step 2: In a separate bowl, pour in the chicken stock. Step 3: Add the wine and stir. Step 4: Season to taste with salt. Step 5: Put about 2 quarts of the stock / wine mix into the wok Just before you place the hotpot before your guests, add the tomato and scallions Enjoy! Step 6: =============== You will add the rest of the chicken stock to top up the hotpot as the meal progresses.

Ingredient Names: lean pork ground meat, soy sauce, cornstarch, chinese five-spice powder, water chestnuts, chicken stock, hoisin sauce, thumb-sized ginger, carrots shaved potato peeler, chinese leaves part, beansprout, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the mince into a bowl with the soy, cornflour, five-spice, chopped water chestnuts and some black pepper. Work everything together, then shape into 12 meatballs. Step 2: Pour the stock into a wide, deep pan and stir in the hoisin and ginger. Add the meatballs, then cover and poach for 5 mins. Drop in the carrots, Chinese leaves, beansprouts, spring onions and sliced chestnuts, then put on the lid and simmer for 5 mins. Ladle into bowls, then serve scattered with spring onion tops.

Dish Name: Real Easy And Real Tasty Egg Drop Soup
Ingredient Names: cornstarch, cold water, chicken broth, fresh ginger, scallion, eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cornstarch and cold water in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Put chicken broth, ginger and scallions in a pot and bring to a full boil. Step 3: Turn off heat once boiled. Step 4: Add beaten eggs to the broth and immediately start stirring with a fork Eggs should not be forming lumps If they are, it is because the eggs were not stirred quickly enough after pouring into the broth Eggs should have a silky texture and appearance. Step 5: Add cornstarch mixture and turn heat on low until broth thickens slightly, turn heat off.

Ingredient Names: dried black mushrooms, boneless skinless chicken breast, fresh ginger, barbecued pork, shrimp, bamboo shoot, water chestnut, chicken stock, mushroom liquid, dark soy sauce, rice wine, salt and pepper, sesame oil, rice, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Soak mushrooms in hot water for about 20 minutes. Step 2: Strain the liquid and reserve 1 cup for the soup. Step 3: Cut mushrooms into quarters. Step 4: Cut the water chestnuts and bamboo shoots into thin slices. Step 5: Bring a pot of water to boil. Step 6: Add the chicken and ginger and briefly blanch the chicken, just until it changes color. Step 7: Drain and cut the chicken into thin slices. Step 8: Bring the chicken stock or broth and the reserved mushroom liquid to a boil. Step 9: Add the chicken and pork, shrimp and the vegetables. Step 10: Let simmer for a few minutes, then add the soy sauce, sherry, and the salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Spicy Hotpot Broth Sichuan Hong Tang Lu
Ingredient Names: fermented black beans, shaoxing wine, fresh ginger, dried hot red chili pepper, peanut oil, dripping, szechuan hot bean sauce, beef stock, rock sugar, rice wine, salt, szechwan pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Make a paste out of the black beans and 1 tbsp shaoxing rice wine, using either a mortar and pestle or a food processor. Step 2: Wash the ginger and cut it into slices about the thickness of a coin. Step 3: Using a scissors, snip the chiles into 1 inch sections and remove the seeds. Step 4: Heat 3 tbs of the oil in a wok over a medium flame so it's hot but not smoking. Step 5: Stir fry the chiles to flavor the oil You want the oil to sizzle around the chiles, making them crisp and fragrant, but not burning. Step 6: Using a slotted spoon remove them and set aside. Step 7: Rinse out and dry the wok, the put on a simmer / low heat. Step 8: Add the rest of the oil and the beef drippings. Step 9: Once the drippings have melted completely, turn up the heat to medium.

Dish Name: Spicy Tan Tan Soup (Tantanmen or Dan Dan Noodles)
Ingredient Names: sesame oil, doubanjiang, shallots, garlic, fresh ginger, ground pork, soy sauce, tahini, sake, miso paste, tianmianjiang, chicken stock, rice vinegar, chili oil, fresh spinach, ramen noodles, green onions, red thai chile pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat; add doubanjiang. Step 2: Cook and stir shallots, garlic, and ginger until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add ground pork; cook and stir until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Mix soy sauce, tahini, sake, miso paste, and tianmianjiang into pork mixture until evenly combined. Step 5: Add chicken stock; bring to a boil. Step 6: Mix rice vinegar and rayu into pork mixture; add spinach. Step 7: Simmer soup over low heat for 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Put noodles in a bowl of hot water to separate; drain. Step 9: Mix noodles into soup and garnish with green onions and Thai chile peppers.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, fresh mushrooms, celery, carrot, vegetable oil, chicken broth, fresh spinach, cornstarch, cold water, egg, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a 3 quart saucepan, stir-fry pork, mushrooms, celery and carrots in oil until pork is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Step 2: Add broth and spinach. Step 3: Combine cornstarch and water to make a thin paste, stir into soup, return to a boil. Step 4: Boil for 1 minute Quickly stir in egg, add pepper. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, vegetable oil, water, beef broth, green onions, soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, garlic, chile peppers, chile paste, fresh ginger, star anise pods, five-spice powder, baby bok choy, udon noodles, pickled mustard greens
Instructions: Step 1: Place beef in a stockpot and cover with water; bring to a boil. Step 2: Remove from the heat and drain. Step 3: Pour vegetable oil into a slow cooker; add beef, water, broth, green onions, soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, garlic, chile peppers, chile paste, ginger, star anise, and five-spice powder. Step 4: Cover and cook on Low for 8 to. Step 5: Transfer beef to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Step 6: Strain broth into a bowl; discard solids. Step 7: Return broth to the slow cooker; keep on Warm until needed. Step 8: Bring a pot of water to a boil; add bok choy and cook for 30 seconds. Step 9: Remove with a slotted spoon and run under cold water. Step 10: Drain, then roughly chop. Step 11: Add udon noodles to boiling water; cook until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes, drain. Step 12: Divide noodles among serving bowls and top with beef, bok choy, and hot broth. Step 13: Garnish with mustard greens.

Ingredient Names: butter, gingerroot, garlic, onion, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, instant mashed potatoes, water, tofu, frozen chopped spinach, white vinegar, soy sauce, salt and pepper, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large heavy soup pot. Step 2: Add ginger, garlic, and onion. Step 3: Cook and stir over medium heat until onion is tender. Step 4: Add turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala Continue cooking and stirring for one more minute. Step 5: Remove pan from heat. Step 6: Stir in half of the potato flakes until blended, then half the water until smooth. Step 7: Repeat with other half of potato flakes and water. Step 8: Return pan to medium heat and bring to a boil. Step 9: Add spinach and tofu.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, salt, frozen peas, tomatoes, tofu, cornstarch, water, eggs, sesame oil, green onions, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken broth, salt, and peas to a boil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add tomatoes and tofu and cook 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 3: Mix cornstarch with water and stir into the soup. Step 4: Beat eggs lightly in a small bowl. Step 5: Stir soup slowly with a spoon in one direction With other hand, slowly pour beaten egg onto the surface of the soup, allowing it to form threads Quickly remove from heat. Step 6: Add sesame oil, green onion, and pepper before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, cornstarch, cilantro leaves, soy sauce, white sugar, garlic, fresh ginger, eggs, water, winter melon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle pork with cornstarch, cilantro, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger. Step 2: Mix eggs into pork until completely incorporated and the mixture becomes sticky. Step 3: Combine water, winter melon, ginger, salt, and sugar in a large saucepan. Step 4: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, form -sized meatballs out of the pork mixture. Step 6: Gently drop meatballs into simmering soup; simmer 8 to more until meatballs have cooked.

Ingredient Names: winter melon, chicken broth, chinese black mushrooms, ginger, ham, salt and pepper, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Clean winter melon Add all ingredients to pot and simmer for about 20 min, until melon is tender Season to taste Garnish and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, shrimp, egg, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil, green onions, celery rib, garlic cloves, gingerroot, wonton skins, beef broth, green onion, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: For the won tons: Mix all won ton filling ingredients together in a medium bowl. Step 2: Spoon about a teaspoon of filling onto each won ton skin and, wetting the edges, fold in half to seal, or into whatever dumpling shape you prefer. Step 3: Repeat until all filling is used. Step 4: Heat 3 quarts lightly salted water to a boil in a large soup pot. Step 5: Boil won tons about 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through Test by cutting one in half with a knife, if unsure, to ensure filling is cooked through For the broth: In a medium sauce pot heat broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onion and garlic to a boil. Step 6: Add spinach and cook until wilted.

Ingredient Names: water, wontons, chicken broth, broccoli stem, gingerroot, straw mushrooms, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan bring water to boiling. Step 2: Drop wontons, one at a time, into boiling water. Step 3: Simmer, uncovered, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and rinse wontons with cold water, drain thoroughly. Step 5: Set aside In the same large saucepan bring the chicken broth to boiling. Step 6: Add the broccoli strips, the halved mushrooms and the grated ginger root. Step 7: Simmer, uncovered for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add wontons and green onions to the saucepan.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, chile-garlic sauce, salt, water, wontons
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, chile-garlic sauce, and salt in a large pot over medium heat; bring to a simmer and cook until hot, about 15-20 minutes. Step 2: While the broth simmers, bring water to a boil in a separate pot. Step 3: Cook wontons in boiling water until heated through, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from water with a slotted spoon and add to the soup.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, cornstarch, oyster sauce, sesame oil, lean ground pork, raw shrimp, green onion, wonton wrappers, egg, chicken stock, soy sauce, bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together sugar, cornstarch, oyster sauce, and sesame oil in a large bowl; add the ground pork, shrimp, and 1 chopped green onion and mix to combine. Step 2: Lay one wonton skin like a baseball diamond in front of you. Step 3: Using your finger, brush beaten egg around the outer edge of the wonton skin. Step 4: Place pork mixture onto the middle of the wonton skin. Step 5: Fold 'home run' corner to '2nd base' corner and press down creating a triangle. Step 6: The meat filling lump is at the bottom of the triangle. Step 7: Brush egg mixtures at the '1st base' and '3rd base' corners of the triangle. Step 8: Fold each base corner over the meat filling lump and over each other. Step 9: Brush egg mixture at the '2nd base/homerun' corner of the triangle and fold behind the meat filling lump. Step 10: This is one wonton. Step 11: Repeat until there are no more mixture or wrapper skins. Step 12: Keep the wontons covered with a wet towel to prevent from drying." Mix together the chicken stock, soy sauce, sesame oil, and reen onions in a pot over medium-high heat. Step 13: Bring this to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 14: Add the bok choy and return to a boil until the bok choy is tender, about 10 minutes. Step 15: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil; boil wontons for 3 to, stirring occasionally to prevent wontons from sticking to each other or to the edges of the pot. Step 16: Place wontons in a soup bowl and ladle soup over wontons to serve. Step 17: Garnish with chopped green onions.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, cooked shrimp, shrimp, pork chop, chicken breast, sliced mushrooms, sliced water chestnuts, gingerroot, egg, hard-boiled eggs, sherry wine, soy sauce, sesame oil, flat-leaf italian parsley, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 2: Add ground pork and brown until no longer pink. Step 3: Add ginger root, soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, sherry, beaten egg, 2 tablespoons minced flat-leaf parsley, garlic powder, 4 thinly sliced scallions, salt and pepper to taste Continue cooking 3 to 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the cooked chopped shrimp. Step 5: Remove from heat, mix thoroughly and allow to cool slightly That is your filling for the wontons. Step 6: Place a small amount of water into a small bowl to use for sealing the wontons. Step 7: Place a tablespoon or more of the filling into the center of each wrapper Moisten edges with water, fold up corner of wrapper over the filling and press firmly to seal.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, pork tenderloins, pork-flavored ramen noodles, water, red bell peppers, broccoli florets, green onions, parsley, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat skillet or wok over med-high heat; add oil and rotate skillet to coat. Step 2: Add pork and stir fry 5 min or until no longer pink. Step 3: Gently break apart noodles; add to skillet along with water, seasoning packet, and remaining ingredients. Step 4: Heat to boiling; boil 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally until noodles are softened. Step 5: Diet exchanges: 2 starch, 3 lean meat, 1/2 fat.

Dish Name: 2Bleu S Sweet Thai Chili Sauce Super Easy
Ingredient Names: thai chiles, serrano peppers, green onion, rice vinegar, apple cider vinegar, sesame oil, salt, sugar, honey, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: To a small saucepan, add all ingredients and stir to combine. Step 2: Heat and gently simmer over med-low heat, stirring occasionally, until reduced by half or when it is the consistency of a thick maple syrup, about 15-20 minutes Be sure to keep an eye on it so it does not overcook or burn. Step 3: Remove from heat, let cool slightly, then use an immulsion blender or a mini food processor to chop everything up 'fine' If using, add food coloring to show level of heat. Step 4: Serve warm over fish, pork, chicken, vegetables, etc. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate any extra It will last 6 months or more in the fridge This will get hotter the longer it is stored! Step 6: Canning: please follow your canning booklet for sterilization instructions.

Ingredient Names: eggs, vegetable shortening, onion, celery, carrot, garlic cloves, cooked rice, ground ginger, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Scramble the eggs in a wok. Step 2: Remove and set aside. Step 3: Add one tablespoon of shortening to hot wok and add onions. Step 4: Saute onions to your preference. Step 5: Add to wok the celery and carrot. Step 6: Saute for about ten minutes, stirring often. Step 7: Add garlic and saute for another four to five minutes. Step 8: Add remaining two tablespoons of shortening to wok and add cold rice. Step 9: Cook for about fifteen minutes, stirring every three to four minutes. Step 10: Mix ginger and soy sauce together, toss in with rice.

Ingredient Names: pasta, garlic cloves, gingerroot, tahini, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, onion, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta 3 to 5 minute then remove from heat, drain, rinse in cold wate, drainr. Step 2: Mix tahini, soy and sesame, garlic, ginger, add to pasta. Step 3: Add cilantro and onion. Step 4: Serve cold or at room temperature Adjust all ingredients to taste.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, green onion, mushroom, broccoli, cooked rice, soy sauce, eggs, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook veggies in oil or spray in non-stick frying pan. Step 2: Add rice, and stir-fry a couple of minutes. Step 3: Add soy sauce or braggs seasoning to taste Push everything to the side of the pan, and, tilting pan, cook eggs separately, combining when mostly cooked. Step 4: Season with pepper.

Dish Name: Aromatic Vegetable Fried Rice Su Cai Chao Fan
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic clove, cooked long-grain rice, salt, sesame oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, celery, green beans, carrot, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, spring onions, green capsicum, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbs peanut oil in a saucepan and saut the chopped garlic for 10 seconds. Step 2: Add the cooked rice and salt and toss to mix. Step 3: Heat through, remove from heat and set aside. Step 4: In a separate saucepan, heat th 2 tbs sesame oil and 1 tbs peanut oil and saute the ginger and grated garlicfor 15 seconds over medium heat. Step 5: Add the celery, green beans and carrot and stir-fry over high heat for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add the bean sprouts and bamboo shoots and stir for 1 minute. Step 7: Stir in the rice, spring onions and green capsicum and toss to mix. Step 8: Stir-fry for one minute. Step 9: Add the vegetable stock, soy sauce and salt Continue to stir over high heat for 1-2 minutes until the stock is absorbed, garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: water, dried shiitake mushrooms, scallion top, carrot, daikon radish, fresh gingerroot, olive oil, onions, garlic, cabbage, chili paste, soy sauce, hijiki seaweed
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pan, bring 2 cups of water and the mushrooms to a boil. Step 2: Remove from heat and soak for 15-20 minutes until softened. Step 3: Strain the soaking liquid into a 2 quart pot and set the shiitake mushrooms aside. Step 4: Add the remaining 4 cups water, scallions, carrots, radish, and ginger to the soaking liquid. Step 5: Cover, bring to a simmer and cook gently for about 30 minutes. Step 6: Strain and return the stock to the soup pot While the stock is simmering, heat oil in a heavy skillet and add the onions. Step 7: Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the onions are browned well. Step 8: Add the garlic and saute for 3 minutes. Step 9: Mix in ginger, cabbage, and carrots.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, granulated sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, chinese rice wine, chili sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, water, vegetables, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauces, rice wine or sherry, chili sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl, stirring to combine. Step 2: In a separate small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in the water. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat in a saucepan. Step 4: Add the garlic and cook, stirring until aromatic Quickly restir the sauce, add it into the saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring Re-stir the cornstarch / water mixture and add it to the sauce, stirring to thicken. Step 5: Refrigerate after use.

Dish Name: Asian Green Beans In A Snap
Ingredient Names: cut green beans, onion, garlic clove, soy sauce, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the onion and garlic in a little oil until tender Add the soy sauce and green beans, and cook until hot, stirring frequently Stir in bacon and serve.

Ingredient Names: water, soy sauce, cornstarch, red peppers, carrots, snow pea pods, walnuts, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In a custard cup stir together 1/4 c water, soy sauce, cornstarch, and crushed red pepper. Step 2: Micro-cook, uncovered, on 100% power for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or till thickened and bubbly, stirring every 30 seconds.(You can also just put this mixture in a saucepan and thicken it.). Step 3: Saute carrot in a little oil over medium heat. Step 4: Add snow peas and walnuts. Step 5: Saute till the vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 6: Add soy sauce mixture and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, dark sesame oil, tamari soy sauce, rice wine, rice vinegar, garlic clove, onions, fresh gingerroot, water, hot chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: For best results, tofu should be "pressed" in order to remove excess liquid and absorb the flavors of the marinade. Step 2: Press tofu block between two plates, weighted down with a cast iron pan, large bowl of water, or heavy cans, for about 30 minutes Halfway through, you may dump the plate of water and flip the tofu block To make marinade, simply whisk together the ingredients in a bowl. Step 3: After tofu is pressed, cut the block into small cubes or triangles. Step 4: Place pieces of tofu into baking dish, and cover with the marinade The tofu can sit overnight in the marinade, or can be prepared right away. Step 5: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 6: Bake tofu about 35-45 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed Tofu can be eaten by itself, or added to stir-frys, salads, soups or sandwiches.

Ingredient Names: green beans, edamame, canola oil, rice wine vinegar, apricot preserves, sugar, gingerroot, black beans, scallions, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the green beans and frozen edamame into a steamer basket and steam for 4 minutes. Step 2: Drain well, then transfer to a large bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. Step 3: In a small bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, apricot preserves, sugar, and ginger. Step 4: Add the black beans and scallions to the green bean mixture and drizzle with dressing. Step 5: Toss to coat and season with salt. Step 6: Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Ingredient Names: honey, prepared stir-fry sauce, red pepper flakes, peanut oil, fresh broccoli florets, mushrooms, onions, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, combine honey, stir fry sauce and crushed red pepper flakes; set aside. Step 2: In wok or large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat; add vegetables and toss while cooking, about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 3: Add honey sauce, stir until all vegetables are glazed and sauce is bubbly hot, about 1 minute. Step 4: Serve as a vegetable side dish or over steamed rice or noodles for a main dish.

Ingredient Names: astragalus root, broccoli, tomatoes, shiitake mushrooms, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the broccoli and cut into little florets. Step 2: Wash the mushrooms and cut in half. Step 3: Wash the tomato, remove the skin by scoring the skin with a knife and blanch the tomato with hot water and cold water The skin should shrink from the fruit making it easy to remove. Step 4: Cut the fruit into quarters. Step 5: Bring the astragalus and water to boil. Step 6: Lower the heat and cook for 10 minutes. Step 7: Strain off the root and keep the broth then add the rest of the ingredients to the broth. Step 8: Add the tomato and mushrooms and cook a further 15 minutes Lastly, add the broccoli, turn up the heat and cook till broccoli is done.

Ingredient Names: green mango, avocado, red onion, red chile, fresh lime juice, red wine vinegar, lite olive oil, of fresh mint, salt, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine mango, avocado, onion, chili, lime juice, vinegar, oil& mint. Step 2: Add salt& hot sauce to taste. Step 3: Cover and let stand, at room temperature, for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Step 4: Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh ginger, baby bok choy, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium-high heat and cook ginger for about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add bok choy, soy sauce, and sugar. Step 3: Stir-fry 3-5 minutes until cooked to desired tenderness. Step 4: Remove ginger slices, add sesame oil and serve.

Dish Name: Baby Bok Choy Stir Fry With Beans Onions
Ingredient Names: baby bok choy, onion, fresh green beans, salt, pepper, light vegetable oil cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the white part of the bok choy into 1-inch pieces and coarsely chop the greens, keep separate. Step 2: Heat non stick skillet lightly sprayed with veggie oil. Step 3: Stir fry the bok choy white stems, onions and green beans, over medium high heat for approx 6-7 minutes. Step 4: Add bok choy greens and stir fry 1 minute longer until the greens are just wilted and heated through Enjoy.

Dish Name: Banana Wontons With Coconut Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: bananas, sugar, ground cinnamon, sweetened flaked coconut, whole milk, unsweetened coconut milk, egg yolks, wonton wrapper, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make the filling: stir the bananas, sugar, cinnamon, and coconut together in a small bowl, lightly mashing the bananas as you mix The mixture should still be a little chunky. Step 2: Make the sauce: in a small sauce pan, bring the milk and coconut milk to a boil then remove from the heat. Step 3: Beat the egg yolks and sugar together in a medium bowl until pale yellow and smooth, 2 to 3 minutes Stirring constantly, gradually pour half of the hot milk mixture into the egg yolk mixture, then stir the yolk mixture into the milk mixture remaining in the pan Over medium heat, stir the milk mixture constantly until thickened, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Strain the sauce into a medium bowl For extra coconut flavor, add the 1 / 2 cup flaked coconut. Step 5: Let cool to room temperature, then cover the bowl and chill until cold Wontons: place a heaping teaspoonful of the filling in the center of one of the wonton wrappers.

Dish Name: Basic Oriental Fried Rice Stephen Yan
Ingredient Names: cooked rice, peanut oil, eggs, salt, dark soy sauce, wine, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Into a hot wok, add 1 tablespoon of peanut oil. Step 2: When oil is hot, gently pour egg into wok and cook with medium-high heat for 2 minutes. Step 3: Turn over to cook the other side of the egg. Step 4: Cook for another 2 minutes and remove from wok to a cutting board and shred egg into slivers. Step 5: Using medium heat, add 3 tablespoons of peanut oil into wok until smoke begins to rise. Step 6: Put in cooked rice, salt, wine, and dark soy sauce, stirring until the rice is hot. Step 7: Add egg slivers, and green onions. Step 8: Stir for another minute and serve hot The specific name is called when a specific kind of ingredient, mostly meat is added to the basic fried rice Fried rice can be made ahead of time and kept warm in oven.

Ingredient Names: water, kelp, dried shiitake mushrooms, fresh ginger, miso, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the water to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan. Step 2: Add the kelp or kombu and dried mushrooms. Step 3: Let simmer for about 1 hour. Step 4: Remove the sea vegetable and mushrooms, dice, and return to pot. Step 5: Add ginger and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the miso and garnish with the scallions. Step 7: Serve as is, or use as stock.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, garlic powder, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, milk, honey, lemon juice, sherry wine, fresh gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Mix eggs, salt, garlic, flour, cornstarch, and milk to make a smooth batter. Step 2: Mix honey, lemon juice, sherry and ginger together and marinate shrimp, lobster, chicken, or thin-sliced pork for at least 15 minutes. Step 3: Fry dipped pieces in peanut oil until light brown Option: Cool fried pieces after frying, then refrigerate, if desired, and later redip in batter, refry until golden brown Even crunchier, and great as appetizers for a party that you can prepare ahead and still serve hot at the last minute! Step 4: It makes enough batter for 1 lb Of shrimp, lobster meat, chicken or pork.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, vegetable stock, dry sherry, soy sauce, sesame oil, scallion, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic cloves, broccoli, salt, medium firm tofu
Instructions: Step 1: Put cornstarch into a cup and slowly add 1 / 4 cup of the vegetable stock and mix well. Step 2: Add wine, soy sauce and sesame oil, mix well. Step 3: Cut scallion into 1 1 / 2-inch lengths. Step 4: Heat vegetable oil in a wok over medium heat. Step 5: When hot, put in ginger and garlic. Step 6: Stir fry for 10 seconds. Step 7: Put in scallion and broccoli, fry for 1 minute. Step 8: Add 1 / 2 cup vegetable stock and the salt.

Ingredient Names: spinach, bean sprouts, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Pour boiling water over spinach in colander. Step 2: Rinse immediately with cold water. Step 3: Drain thoroughly and place in medium serving b owl. Step 4: Repeat process with bean sprouts and place in same bowl. Step 5: Combine sugar, vinegar, soy sauce and sesame seeds. Step 6: Pour over veggies and toss to combine. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: bean sprouts, carrot, green onions, soy sauce, oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: If using fresh bean sprouts, pour boiling water over them. Step 2: Let stand 2 minutes If using canned bean sprouts, wash them in running water, drain in colander. Step 3: Combine carrot, onion, soy sauce, oil, and sesame oil. Step 4: Pour over bean sprouts, mix.

Ingredient Names: red onion, ginger, shiitake mushroom, white cabbage, carrot, garlic sprouts, white pepper, sesame oil, cilantro, wonton skins, salt, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large saute pan, add a little oil and saute onions and ginger. Step 2: Add the mushrooms and stir. Step 3: Add the cabbage, carrots and chives, season. Step 4: When mixture is soft, place in colander to drain. Step 5: Add the sesame oil and cilantro when mixture is cooled. Step 6: Check for seasoning. Step 7: Using the gyoza skins, make half moon dumplings keeping the bottom flat. Step 8: In a hot non-stick pan, coat with oil and place dumplings. Step 9: When bottom gets brown, add 1 / 4 cup of water and immediately cover.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Corn Wontons With 3 Cheese Sweet Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: canned black beans, salsa, frozen whole kernel corn, green onions, ground cumin, wonton skins, sweet red peppers, cottage cheese, beer, garlic, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, water, vegetable oil cooking spray, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mash together beans and salsa. Step 2: Stir in corn, onions and cumin. Step 3: Place bean mixture evenly in centers of 10 wonton skins. Step 4: Brush edges of wontons with water, top with remaining skins, and seal by press edges firmly together, pushing out air Trim edges with a fluted pastry wheel, and cover with a damp towel until ready to cook. Step 5: Combine red pepper, cottage cheese, beer, and garlic in an electric blender, cover and process until smooth, stopping once to scrape down the sides. Step 6: Transfer pepper mixture to a saucepan, and add the mozzarella and parmesan. Step 7: Cook until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Step 8: Remove from heat and keep warm. Step 9: Bring water to a boil in a dutch oven.

Ingredient Names: red bird's eye chili, gingerroot, garlic cloves, peanut oil, sesame oil, black bean paste, bok choy, black-eyed peas, soy sauce, black pepper, cooked brown rice, toasted sesame seeds, green onions, orange zest, orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saut peppers, ginger root and garlic in peanut And sesame oil until peppers are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Stir in black bean paste and bok choy and cook, covered, over medium heat until bok choy wilts, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain black-eyed peas and add to skillet with the soy sauce. Step 4: Cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Season to taste with black pepper, serve over rice. Step 6: Squeeze orange juice over top if desired. Step 7: Garnish with sesame seeds, green onions and orange zest, if desired Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: raw peanuts, dried chilies, star anise, gingerroot, szechuan peppercorns, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put peanuts, spices, salt, and roughly 1 / 4 cup soy sauce in a pot and cover with water. Step 2: Cover pot and bring to boil. Step 3: Let simmer for 30-40 minutes, stirring every 7-10 minutes. Step 4: When done, leave peanuts to soak in the brine while they cool. Step 5: When cool, drain pot and discard spices. Step 6: Toss peanuts with a little more soy sauce and sesame oil and serve cold.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, ginger, garlic, baby bok choy, soy sauce, tapioca starch, water, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl mix the tapioca starch, water and chili oil. Step 2: Heat wok to smoking add oil and swirl around the edges of the pan. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger and toss for 5 seconds or until the garlic starts to turn golden on the edges. Step 4: Add boc choi and 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce, toss to coat with oil and cover for 3 minutes stirring occasionally You want the boc choi to turn bright green, but stay crisp. Step 5: When the boc choi is ready, stir the starch mixture, pour over the boc choi and quickly toss until the sauce turns transparent, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: bok choys, vegetable oil, ginger, water, cornflour cornstarch, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, chinese cooking wine, sesame oil, cooking salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cutting - Trim the base of the bok choy then separate all the leaves. Leave the delicate baby bok choy in the centre intact, it's precious! Cut giant stems in half lengthwise so they are all roughly the same size. Rinse in colander, shake off excess water (don't need to dry fully). Step 2: Sauce - Stir Sauce ingredients except water in a jug until cornflour is dissolved. (Easier to make lump free with less liquid). Then stir in water. Step 3: Gingery oil - Put the ginger and oil in a large non-stick pan. Turn onto medium heat. Once the ginger starts sizzling, sauté for 1 minute until it turns light golden and is a bit floppy. Add bok choy then use 2 spatulas to toss the ginger for around 15 seconds to coat. Step 4: Steam - Turn heat up to medium, pour water over. Cover with lid and steam for just 45 seconds. Step 5: Sauce - Remove lid (bok choy will still be a bit underdone), pour in sauce, toss for 30 seconds until sauce changes from murky to clear, and thickens. Bok choy should be just floppy but still soft crunch, not mushy. If your sauce gets too thick, add a tiny splash of water and mix. Step 6: Serve - Pour the bok choy and all the sauce onto a serving plate, then eat!

Dish Name: Bok choi with oyster sauce & chilli
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, bok choi split half, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, long red chili
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok, add the garlic and fry for 2 mins. Step 2: Tip in the bok choi and stir well over the heat for 4 mins until it wilts. Step 3: Pour in the oyster sauce, soy and 50ml water. Step 4: Simmer for a further 3 mins, then scatter over the chilli to serve.

Dish Name: Broad Beans Fava Beans Stir Fried With Szechuan Pepper
Ingredient Names: broad beans, vegetable oil, szechwan pepper, caster sugar, soy sauce, rice wine, rice vinegar, chili bean paste, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook broad beans in simmering salted water for 4 minutes. Step 2: Drain, reserving a ladleful of cooking water Refresh the beans under cold running water and drain again Gently shell beans. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok over high heat, add beans and toss for 1 minute. Step 4: Add szechuan pepper, sugar, soy sauce, rice wine, vinegar and bean paste, tossing well. Step 5: Add 2-3 tablespoons of the bean cooking water and cook for 2 minutes, tossing over high heat The beans should be tender and lightly coated with the sauce. Step 6: Serve scattered with sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, garlic, ginger, dried shiitake mushrooms, vegetarian oyster sauce, light soy sauce, cabbage, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, bamboo shoots, carrot, bean sprouts, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil in a preheated wok and stir-fry onion until translucent. Step 2: Toss in garlic, ginger, and mushrooms and stir-fry for another minute. Step 3: Add oyster sauce and 2 tablespoons soy sauce and cook for another 30 seconds. Step 4: Remove wok contents to a bowl and set aside. Step 5: Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil in the hot wok and stir-fry cabbage, bell peppers, bamboo shoots, and carrot for 3 minutes. Step 6: Toss in bean sprouts, sugar, cup reserved mushroom water, salt, and pepper and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Add onion and mushroom mixture, rice wine, and sesame oil and stir to combine well. Step 8: Cook noodles in plenty of water at a rolling boil for about a minute. Step 9: Drain thoroughly, rinse under cold running water, and drain again. Step 10: Toss noodles with remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce and remaining 1 teaspoon peanut oil.

Ingredient Names: peas, cooked long-grain rice, onion, dark soy sauce, brown sugar, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook yellow peas along with brown sugar in rice cooker with water filled up to 4 cup mark for rice Partially cover the rice cooker with lid to prevent overflowing during cooking It will take about 45 min to cook. Step 2: Set wok or heavy skillet on medium heat. Step 3: Slice onion thinly and fry in peanut oil until golden and fragrant stirring continuously to prevent burning. Step 4: Add cooked rice to wok and stir-fry for 5 minute. Step 5: Add dark soy sauce to rice Scatter 1 cup of cooked yellow peas over rice and stir-fry for another 5 minute. Step 6: Serve hot accompanied by sweet milk tea Remaining cooked peas can be packed and frozen for later use.

Ingredient Names: egg roll wraps, oil, sugar, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut egg roll wrappers in half. Step 2: Place 2 wrappers on top of each other. Step 3: Cut a 3 1 / 2 " long slit in the centre of each You make the butterflies by lifting one end and placing it through the centre cut and flipping over to the other side Don't pull all the way through or you'll have to start over Deep fry the butterflies in hot oil over medium high heat until golden brown. Step 4: Drain and set aside. Step 5: Make the syrup by combining the sugar and 1 1 / 2 tbsp oil and heating it in a heavy skillet over medium low heat until the sugar is completely dissolved. Step 6: Keep hot Coat the fried butterflies with hot, running syrup by placing the butterflies in the skillet and turning them until coated.

Ingredient Names: coleslaw mix, ramen noodles, slivered almonds, onions, oil, sugar, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Break up ramen while still in the bag. Step 2: In a dry frying pan, at medium heat, toast ramen pieces and almonds for 5-6 minutes. Step 3: Put coleslaw and onion in mixing bowl and add ramen mixture to the bowel. Step 4: Mix dressing, shake well and add to the cabbage mixture I prefer to put it in immediately and let the ramen and cabbage marinate in the vinaigrette.

Ingredient Names: carrots, garlic cloves, green onions, green cabbage, peanut oil, white pepper, cayenne pepper, stir-fry sauce, rice wine, spring roll wrappers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the 1 t of oil in a large pot. Step 2: Add the garlic, onions, and carrots and cook for five minutes on medium heat. Step 3: Add the cabbage, spices, and stir-fry sauce. Step 4: Cook until cabbage is reduced and limp, approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Add the rice wine and cook until no longer sizzling, just a few minutes. Step 6: Allow to cool partially before stuffing spring rolls The dough for spring rolls is different than the dough for egg rolls I had to find spring roll wrappers at an asian grocery store They are vegan but if you can't find any and don't worry about consuming eggs, egg roll wrappers will work as well. Step 7: Stuff the rolls according to the directions on the package, or by following these simple instructions.

Dish Name: Cai Bao Filling Vegetable Tofu Bun Filling Sesame Flavored
Ingredient Names: onion, firm tofu, fresh spinach leaves, mushrooms, canola oil, sesame oil, light soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Step 2: Add onions, garlic, and a splash of the sesame oil and soy sauce. Step 3: Stir fry for 1 3 minutes to bring out flavor. Step 4: Add tofu and stir fry until golden If cubes are too large, break them during frying. Step 5: Add mushrooms and another splash of sesame oil and soy sauce. Step 6: Stir fry for 3 5 minutes. Step 7: Add remaining sesame oil, soy sauce, and the vinegar. Step 8: Add the spinach immediately. Step 9: Stir fry until spinach is well wilted, 4 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: st. germain elderflower liqueur, dry champagne, lychee
Instructions: Step 1: Chill champagne flutes. Step 2: Pour 2 ounces of st Germain in to each glass. Step 3: Top with champagne. Step 4: Garnish with a lychee Optional: If using canned lychee`s you might want to add some of the juice to each drink for more sweetness.

Dish Name: Ch Ing Ts Ai Ma Ku T Ang Mushroom And Cabbage Soup
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh mushrooms, bok choy, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a cook and serve pot until hot. Step 2: Add oil and mushrooms and stir fry until mushrooms begin to soften then add the bok choy and stir fry for 2 more minutes. Step 3: Add water and bring to boil. Step 4: Cook uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes or until bok choy is soft, season and serve. Step 5: Add 10 to 12 pieces of wheat gluten for a more stubstantial meal and perhaps 2 ounces cellophane soaked noodles.

Dish Name: Chiang Yu T Ang Soy Sauce Soup
Ingredient Names: braggs liquid aminos, dark sesame oil, scallions, msg, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: In soup bowl add soy sauce, oil scallion and msg Add the boiling water Examples are: cooked wontons, chopped or shredded vegetables.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, red chili pepper, garlic clove, vegetable oil, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water for steamer. Step 2: Put broccoli in steamer for 4 minutes until slightly soften. Step 3: Heat oil in pan on medium heat and fry chili and garlic for a minute. Step 4: Turn up heat to high, add broccoli and stir occasionally for a minute. Step 5: Add soy sauce, stir, cover and cook for a minute.

Ingredient Names: tofu, cornstarch, oil, onions, garlic, green chilies, red capsicum, vegetable stock, salt, white pepper powder, soy sauce, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To start with, cut tofu into 1 inch diamond shaped pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok. Step 3: Roll tofu pieces in cornflour. Step 4: Now, deep fry them in hot oil on medium flame until the edges start to turn brown. Step 5: Remove from wok, drain onto absorbent paper and keep aside. Step 6: Blend 1 tbsp cornflour (this much will be leftover) in quarter cup of water, keep aside. Step 7: Peel onions and cut'em into thick slices. Step 8: Peel, wash and crush garlic. Step 9: Slice green chillies. Step 10: Wash, halve, de-seed and cut capsicum into thick strips, heat 2 tbsps, oil in a wok. Step 11: Add garlic and stir-fry for a minute. Step 12: Add green chillies, onions and capsicum. Step 13: Saute for a few minutes, add tofu, stir in stock. Step 14: Add salt, pepper powder, soy sauce and chilli sauce, stir well. Step 15: Stir in the blended cornflour. Step 16: Cook on high flame, stirring until the sauce thickens to coat the tofu and vegetables. Step 17: Serve rightaway with hot rotis or naan or parathas or even kulchas!, enjoy your meal!

Ingredient Names: broccolini, olive oil, garlic cloves, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Steam or blanch broccolini for 2-3 minutes until just tender, drain & refresh. Step 2: Heat oil in large pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add garlic & chilli. Step 4: Cook for 1 -2 minutes until garlic just starts to colour. Step 5: Add broccolini, season well with s & p, then toss to warm through.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, sugar, milk, egg, vegetable oil, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Put the yeast and 1 tablespoon of the sugar in a small bowl. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 cup of the warm milk. Step 3: Let stand 5 minutes, then stir to dissolve It should foam and bubble If it does not, discard and use a fresh package of yeast. Step 4: Stir in the egg, oil and remaining milk. Step 5: Put the flour and remaining sugar in the work bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade Process 2 seconds With the machine running, pour the warm milk mixture down the feed tube in a steady stream Process until it forms a rough ball.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, garlic, ground ginger, crushed red pepper flakes, apple juice, brown sugar, ketchup, apple cider vinegar, water, low sodium soy sauce, flour, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the tofu, and then remove excess moisture by cutting it in half lengthwise and microwaving on high, uncovered, for two minutes Gently squeeze out and wipe off excess moisture, then throw tofu in the freezer for one or two hours before removing to thaw in the fridge -- this will give the tofu a slightly heavier texture. Step 2: Cut tofu into bite-sized pieces. Step 3: Combine garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, apple juice, brown sugar, ketchup, apple cider vinegar, water, and soy sauce in a small bowl. Step 4: Pour half of the mixture over the tofu and reserve the other half for later Marinade tofu for at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Drain any excess marinade from tofu Coat tofu pieces in flour. Step 6: Heat oil over medium heat in a large frying pan and fry tofu until golden brown on all sides. Step 7: Add reserved marinade to pan, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: low sodium soy sauce, dark sesame oil, rice vinegar, sugar, extra firm tofu, broccoli florets, carrots, broccoli stem, canola oil, green onions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, snow peas, baby corn, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients, tossing to coat. Step 2: Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour. Step 3: Drain in a colander over a bowl, reserving marinade. Step 4: Cook broccoli florets, carrot, and broccoli stems in boiling water 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 5: Drain these vegetables Plunge into ice water, drain. Step 6: Heat canola oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add tofu. Step 7: Stir-fry 5 minutes or until lightly browned on all sides.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, green onions, garlic clove, fresh ginger, carrot, red pepper, ramen noodles, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, sliced almonds, butter, sugar, oil, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Chop cabbage in medium pieces, garlic, ginger, green onions, carrot and red pepper Brown noodles, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, & almonds in butter. Step 2: Boil sugar, oil, sesame oil, vinegar, and soy sauce, cool completely I`ve also skipped the boiling and just mixed with no problem! Step 3: Toss everything together just before serving Doesn't stay crunchy if kept overnight!

Dish Name: Chinese Cabbage Snow Pea And Mushroom Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, ketjap manis, sesame oil, caster sugar, peanut oil, white onion, almonds, ginger, oyster mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, snow peas, chinese cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce, kecap manis, sesame oil and sugar. Step 2: Heat peanut oil in wok over high heat. Step 3: Add onion and almonds stir-fry 1 minute. Step 4: Add ginger, mushrooms and stir fry 2 minutes. Step 5: Add snow peas, cabbage and sauce mixture. Step 6: Stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 7: Serve with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, boiling water, soy sauce, sugar, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the asparagus into slices diagonally. Step 2: Place in a saucepan and pour the boiling water over the asparagus. Step 3: Return to a boil and cook for two minutes. Step 4: Drain and cool under running cold water. Step 5: Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over the asparagus. Step 6: Chill for 1 / 2 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, scallion, sliced water chestnuts, carrot, chow mein noodles, cashews, toasted sesame seeds, oil, cider vinegar, sugar, instant minced onion, garlic powder, salt, dry mustard, tarragon
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix together all salad ingredients except sesame seeds. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk together all dressing ingredients. Step 3: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat well. Step 4: Sprinkle top w / sesame seeds and serve.

Ingredient Names: celery hearts, soy sauce, salt, sesame oil, sugar, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together soy sauce, salt, sesame oil, sugar and hot sauce, set aside. Step 2: Slice celery on a slight diagonal and scald in a pot of boiling water for 2 minutes. Step 3: Drain and put celery in ice cold water for 1 minute. Step 4: Drain again and pour the sauce over the celery.

Ingredient Names: bean sprouts, scallion, carrots, bamboo shoot, mushrooms, vegetable oil, salt, light brown sugar, light soy sauce, rice wine, egg roll wraps, cornstarch paste, flour, oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Shred vegetables to the same size and shape as bean sprouts. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok and stir-fry vegetables for 1 minute. Step 3: Add salt, sugar, light soy sauce, and rice wine. Step 4: Stir-fry 2 minutes more. Step 5: Drain and cool To make a spring roll, cut the wrapper in half diagonally. Step 6: Place 1 tbsp of veggie mixture one-third of the way down the wrapper, then turn the wrapper so the small. Step 7: Fold the wide edge of the wrapper over the filling and roll over one time. Step 8: Fold in the sides, and roll the wrapper away from you one time more. Step 9: Brush the upper edge of the wrapper with cornstarch paste.

Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, shallots, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, superfine sugar, fresh ginger, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all the sauce ingredients in a bowl and stir well until combined. Step 2: Cover and chill in the refrigerator, to allow the flavors to infuse, for at least 1 hour prior to serving.

Ingredient Names: green beans, garlic, ginger, scallions, chili paste with garlic, chili paste, soy sauce, sugar, salt, pepper, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Aheat 1 t of oil in a wok over medium heat It is very important to use a wok and to heat the oil first or this wont cook right. Step 2: Add the green beans and stir fry until they pucker and begin to brow. Step 3: Drain the green beans in a colander. Step 4: Heat the other 1 t of oil and add ginger, garlic and scallions, stir fry for a minute. Step 5: Add chili sauce and siracha and stir fry for a minute. Step 6: Add beans, soy sauce, sugar, salt and pepper and mix to combine, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Chinese Eggplant And Tofu In Black Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: eggplant, tofu, black bean sauce, oil, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Coat eggplant cubes in flour Fry in oil 4 minutes Add tofu Fry for 4 minutes until golden Add black bean sauce to coat Done.

Ingredient Names: eggs, green onion, oil, tomatoes, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Scramble the eggs in a non-stick pan, keeping them fairly chunky. Step 2: When eggs are just about done, remove from the skillet and set aside. Step 3: Add the oil to the skillet, and cook the tomatoes for a few minutes. Step 4: Add salt and sugar to the tomatoes. Step 5: Put the eggs back in the skillet, and mix everything together Voila!

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, almond extract, chinese five spice powder, banana, mango, kiwi fruits, peach, strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the sugar & almond extract, then stir in the five-spice powder & set aside. Step 2: In a bowl, lay banana slices in a ring around the edge, then lay kiwi slices in the middle, & sprinkle a bit of the sugar mixture over the fruit. Step 3: Spread mango slices over the top of the bananas & kiwi, & sprinke another bit of the sugar mixture over that Lay peach slices around the edge of the dish & sprinkle that with the sugar mixture. Step 4: Finally lay the strawberries in the middle & sprinkle the berries with the remaining sugar mixture. Step 5: Cover & chill before serving.

Ingredient Names: aubergine, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, hoisin sauce, spring onions, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the aubergine if you hate the skin, or leave it on if you like the texture and think it looks pretty. Step 2: Cut lengthways into oblong pieces about the size and length of 2 fingers side by side. Step 3: Boil 1 cm of water in a wide frying pan, then add the aubergine and cook, stirring occasionally and adding more water as needed, until aubergines are softened to your satisfaction, and very little water remains. Step 4: Remove the aubergine to a bowl, then heat another 1cm water in the pan. Step 5: Add garlic, ginger and hoisin sauce, then simmer briskly for 10 minutes, stirring and adding more water as needed. Step 6: Add the soy sauce and spring onions to the pan, then add the cooked Aubergine, with a little more water if needed. Step 7: Cook over a low heat for 5 minutes, stirring to coat the aubergine with the sauce. Step 8: Serve hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: short-grain rice, fresh ginger, toasted sesame oil, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice in strainer and drain. Step 2: In a saucepan, heat the oil and saut the ginger over medium heat until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes, stir in the rice. Step 3: Add the water and salt, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to a simmer. Step 5: Cook covered until water is absorbed, about 12-15 minutes. Step 6: Stir once and allow to stand until ready to serve.

Dish Name: Chinese Green Bean Salad By Dr Andrew Weil
Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, fresh gingerroot, red onion, mustard powder, cold water, reduced sodium soy sauce, rice, sesame oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Trim and cut the green beans into 1-inch lengths. Step 2: Cook in rapidly boiling water, about 5 minutes or until crunchy-tender. Step 3: Drain beans, immerse in cold water to stop the cooking until they are cool, then drain well At this point you can set them aside and refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 4: Mix the dressing ingredients in a small bowl with a whisk until well blended. Step 5: Toss the green beans with the ginger root, red onion and dressing. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, vanilla, whole almond, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, mix well. Step 2: Roll desired sized balls with your palms and press them onto a cookie sheet They not expand that much, so be specific. Step 3: Bake at 350f for 13 - 15 minutes, depending on your preference.

Ingredient Names: dry mustard, sugar, boiling water, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine mustard and sugar Stir in water and oil Let stand 8 hours before serving Stor in fridge.

Dish Name: Chinese Mandarin Cabbage Salad With Ramen Noodles Vegetarian
Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, peanuts, coleslaw mix, green onions, red bell pepper, salt and black pepper, mandarin orange segments, white sugar, vegetable oil, cider vinegar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degreesplace the broken noodles and peanuts on a baking sheet and toast until golden brown. Step 2: Cool to room temperature. Step 3: In a bowl place the coleslaw, green onions, red bell pepper, toasted ramen noodles and peanuts, toss to combine. Step 4: In a bowl mix the dressing ingredients together until well combined. Step 5: Pour over the salad, then toss to combine. Step 6: Top salad with mandarin orange segments.

Dish Name: Chinese Mushroom Smothered Bean Curd Aka Tofu
Ingredient Names: bean curd, dried chinese mushrooms, oil, scallion, gingerroot, dry sherry, dark soy sauce, sugar, mushroom liquid, dark sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Quarter your bean curd squares then cut into 2 triangles. Step 2: Turn each on longest side and cut thru to make 3 thin triangles from each, set aside. Step 3: Cover mushrooms with 3 / 4 cup boiling water and soak 1 hour Lightly squeeze to let liquid drain back into bowl [ The soaking water not the rinse step] then rinse briefly and squeeze dry Destem and cut cap into 1 / 2 inch wide slices. Step 4: Place scallions, ginger, mushrooms and curd on work tray Measure mushroom liquid if you are short 1 / 2 cup add some stock or water. Step 5: Heat large heavy skillet over high until hot.

Ingredient Names: orange, granulated sugar, ground cinnamon, refrigerated buttermilk biscuits, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place zest, sugar and cinnamon in a paper bag and shake to combine. Step 2: Place oil in a deep pan until it comes about halfway up the side of the pan. Step 3: Heat oil to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Step 4: Slice biscuit dough in quarters and roll into balls to form 24 donut holes Working in batches, place donut holes in hot oil and fry until golden, about 6 to 8 minutes. Step 5: Transfer hot donuts to the paper bag and shake to coat with orange sugar. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, boiling water, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the flour, boiling water and 1 tsp of oil. Step 2: Knead to form a firm dough. Step 3: Divide the dough into 2 and roll each portion into a long sausage. Step 4: Cut each sausage into 6 pieces, and press each piece into a flat circle. Step 5: Brush six of the twelve pancakes with the rest of the oil and place the other six on top. Step 6: Using a rolling pin roll each pancake sandwich into a 6-inch circle on a floured surface. Step 7: Heat an ungreased pan over a high heat, reduce the heat and add a pancake. Step 8: When small brown spots appear on the underside turn the pancake and cook until it starts to puff up with air bubbles Peel apart the two layers, and repeat the procedure for the remaining pancakes.

Dish Name: Chinese Quick Pickled Radish Salad With Garlic
Ingredient Names: red radish, soy sauce, rice wine, fresh coriander leaves, garlic granules
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the radishes finely. Step 2: Add all the other ingredients, leaving some coriander leaves for a garnish and mix thoroughly. Step 3: Put the radish pickle into an attractive serving dish and just before serving scatter the remaining coriander leaves over the top as a garnish. Step 4: Serve with all types of chinese and oriental food Keeps for up to 24 hours in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: radish, carrot, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, honey, peanut oil, hot pepper sauce, alfalfa sprouts, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine radishes and carrot in a shallow container. Step 2: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, honey, oil and hot pepper sauce together in a small bowl. Step 3: Pour over the radishes and carrot. Step 4: Cover and marinate in fridge for 1 hour minimum Just before serving, place the alfalfa sprouts on a small serving dish and arrange the radishes and carrots on top Salt and pepper to taste Enjoy!, serves 4.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, salt, garlic powder, fresh ground black pepper, cornstarch, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the tofu: place several paper towels on a cutting board. Step 2: Place the tofu on the cutting board, and then place a heavy object such as a plate or book on top. Step 3: Drain the tofu for at least 15 minutes, changing the paper towels as required. Step 4: Cut the tofu into cubes. Step 5: Mix together the tofu with the salt, garlic powder, and black pepper, and allow to marinate for 1-2 hours in the refrigerator. Step 6: Toss the tofu cubes with cornstarch to coat. Step 7: Heat oil in wok or large skillet Carefully add the tofu to the wok, add fry in small batches until tofu is golden. Step 8: Drain on paper toweling, and serve hot. Step 9: Serve with asian condiments, if desired.

Ingredient Names: pastry flour, salt, baking powder, superfine sugar, butter, egg, vanilla, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl, in a larger bowl. Step 2: Beat the sugar, butter, egg and vanilla. Step 3: Add your dry ingredients to the wet mixture and form a smooth dough. Step 4: Roll your dough into a cylinder about 12-inches long. Step 5: Divide the dough into two and cover with wax paper. Step 6: Place both pieces of dough in the refrigerator for approximately 6-8 hours You must do this step. Step 7: After refrigeration time is over, and you wish to make your cookies, preheat the oven to 350f. Step 8: Cut your dough into rounds about 1 / 3 of an inch thickness.

Ingredient Names: oil, carrots, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, black pepper, firm tofu, bok choy, chinese cabbage, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan, saute the carrots, onion, ginger and garlic in oil until onion is tender. Step 2: Add the water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and pepper. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally While soup is simmering, prepare tofu. Step 4: Remove excess water and slice tofu into three large slabs. Step 5: Fry in oil until both sides are browned. Step 6: Drain on a paper towel. Step 7: Cut tofu slabs into 1 / 2 inch cubes. Step 8: After soup has simmered for 15 minutes, add tofu cubes, bok choy, cabbage and snow peas. Step 9: Simmer for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic clove, fresh ginger, green onion, carrots, green bell pepper, asparagus, chinese cabbage, soy sauce, sliced mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oil, garlic, ginger and onion in 2 quart glass casserole. Step 2: Cook uncovered on hi for 1 minute. Step 3: Add carrots and green pepper, stir, cover with lid. Step 4: Cook on hi for 2 to 3 minutes more. Step 5: Stir in asparagus, cabbage, soy sauce, cover. Step 6: Cook additional 2 to 3 minutes on hi. Step 7: Toss in mushrooms.

Dish Name: Chinese Style Mock Duck With Noodles
Ingredient Names: noodles, chinese eggplant, zucchini, vegetarian duck, fresh ginger, garlic clove, scallions, red chili pepper flakes, vegetable oil, preserved black bean, soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare noodles according to package directions ). Step 2: Rinse "duck" thoroughly Dry with a paper towel and slice into bite-size pieces. Step 3: Heat oil and black beans in a large pan on medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the eggplant, zucchini, and "duck" Stir-fry for about three minutes, until vegetables start to soften. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic, scallions, and chili flakes Continue to stir-fry until the vegetables are cooked. Step 6: Meanwhile combine sauce ingredients in a 2 c measuring cup, adding enough water to make a total of 3 / 4 cups sauce.

Ingredient Names: pickling cucumber, salt, sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the cucumber wedges with the salt and let them stand in a bowl for 20 minutes. Step 2: Drain the cucumbers in a colander, rinse them under cold water, and pat them dry on paper towels. Step 3: In a bowl dissolve the sugar in the vinegar, stirring, add the cucumbers, and toss them to coat them with the mixture. Step 4: In a small skillet heat the sesame oil and the vegetable oil over moderately high heat until the oil is just smoking, add the gingerroot and the redpepper flakes, and stir fry the mixture for 5 - 10 seconds, or until the red pepper flakes are several shades darker. Step 5: Remove the skillet from the heat and let the oil cool to room termperature. Step 6: Pour the spiced oil over the cucumbers, toss the mixture well and let it marinate at room temperature for 1 hour. Step 7: Refrigerate and cover, stirring occasionally Use within 5 days.

Ingredient Names: oil, gingerroot, garlic, red bell peppers, mushrooms, green onions, tofu, red miso, water, soy sauce, honey, smooth cashew butter, rice wine vinegar, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok. Step 2: Saute gingerroot, garlic, and red peppers for 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add mushrooms and onion whites and saute another 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add onion greens and tofu cubes and saute for a minute or so. Step 5: Combine the miso, soy sauce, honey, cashew butter, and vinegar in a bowl or small glass, mixing well. Step 6: Pour this mixture into the wok. Step 7: Let it simmer for about a minute while stirring the sauce into the tofu and vegetables. Step 8: Stir in the dissolved cornstarch, letting it simmer until it thickens. Step 9: Serve hot with rice.

Ingredient Names: silken tofu, light soy sauce, cilantro roots, fresh ginger, scallions, ketjap manis, malt vinegar, chili oil, sesame oil, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Invert tofu into a shallow bowl. Step 2: Slice widthways into 8 slices. Step 3: Mix all other ingredients well and pour over tofu. Step 4: Sprinkle with sichuan pepper and salt and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, vegetable oil, large eggs, sesame seed oil, chicken bouillon powder, sugar, pepper, salt, spring onions, jasmine rice, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: You can use chicken broth in place of the chicken bouillon powder. Step 2: Add broth followed by cornstarch dissolved in 1 tablespoPrepare the tomatoes: Slice the tomatoes in half. Step 3: Remove the tough stem from each half that connects to the vine. Step 4: Cut each half into equal thirds (you’ll get from each tomato). Step 5: Make the soft scrambled eggs: In a cold, 8 to 10-inch nonstick skillet, add the vegetable oil and beaten eggs. Step 6: Turn the heat to medium. Step 7: Once a thin layer of eggs is just beginning to cook on the bottom, push the eggs in one direction to create layers of scrambled eggs. Step 8: Cook, gently stirring the whole time, until the scramble eggs are mostly set but still slightly wet and shiny, 2 to. Step 9: Remove the eggs to a plate and, if needed, wipe out the pan. Step 10: Stir-fry the tomatoes and seasonings: Add the sesame oil to the pan followed by the tomatoes and stir-fry over medium heat until the tomatoes are softened but not mushy, about 3-4 minutes.
