Step 11: Add the chicken bouillon powder, sugar, and white pepper. Step 12: Toss until combined and the sugar and bouillon have dissolved, about 5 minutes. Step 13: Add eggs, stir-fry, and garnish: Add the eggs back to the pan with the tomatoes. Step 14: Stir-fry for about to heat through and combine. Step 15: Taste, adding salt only if needed. Step 16: Sprinkle with the green onions and serve with steamed rice.on of water, plus salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: red cabbage, red chilies, ginger, star anise, garlic, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, green onions, sesame seeds, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Tip all the ingredients, except the spring onions, sesame seeds and oil, into a large pan with a lid, and bring to a simmer. Cook over a low heat for 25-30 mins until all the liquid has evaporated and continue to cook, stirring regularly, until the juices become really sticky and glaze the cabbage. Step 2: Stir through half the spring onions and sesame seeds and pile into a bowl. Serve scattered with rest of the spring onions and sesame seeds and drizzled with the sesame oil.

Ingredient Names: carrots, leeks, celeriac, celery, red onions, red yellow pepper, red chile, ginger, fat garlic, cilantro picked, flatleaf parsley leaves picked, olive oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, mung beansprout, sesame seeds, spring roll wrappers, egg whites, groundnut, draining juices from vegetables, sweet chili sauce, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Make the filling. Slice the carrot into long, thin lengths. Then cut into long, thin ‘julienne’ sticks. Cut the leek into three, halve, then cut into sticks. Slice the celeriac and celery, then cut into julienne sticks as before. Step 2: Halve the onion lengthways, then slice thinly. Slice the peppers into sticks. Cut the chilli into thin shreds. Cut the ginger into small julienne sticks and chop the garlic. Mix everything together in a bowl with half the picked herb leaves. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a wok until very hot and add half the veg. Toss for 30 secs to wilt, then remove from the heat, season and toss in soy and sesame oil. Drain in a colander set over a bowl. Repeat with remaining veg. Mix in bean sprouts, sesame seeds, remaining herbs and extra soy, if liked. Step 4: When the filling has cooled, peel off a spring roll wrapper – it will feel slightly sticky. Cover the remainder with a tea towel. Lay the wrapper on a board and brush the edges with egg white. Spoon a sixth of the vegetables in a line on the top third of the wrapper. Step 5: Fold over the top of the wrapper and press well down all round. Fold in the sides, then roll up firmly, pressing the end in well. The roll should be about 18cm long. Repeat process with the remaining filling and wrappers. The rolls can be chilled at this point for up to 3 hrs, uncovered, in the fridge, until ready to cook. (You should only cook the rolls just before you’re ready to serve, so that they remain crisp.). Step 6: Heat a deep fat fryer or large pan a third full of oil to 180C (or until a cube of bread crisps and turns brown). Deep-fry two rolls at a time for 5 mins until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towel. Mix ingredients for the sauce and pour into 1 larger or six very small bowls. Trim the ends off the rolls, then cut in half diagonally. Serve on one large or six small plates with sauce. Garnish with herb leaves or salad.

Dish Name: Chow Gai Laan Jade Green Broccoli
Ingredient Names: sugar, cornstarch, light soy sauce, oil, salt, garlic clove, broccoli, sherry wine
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together sugar through soy sauce plus 1 / 2 cup water and put aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a skillet or wok over medium heat and add the garlic. Step 3: When garlic is golden brown, add the broccoli. Step 4: Turn the heat up and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 5: Add sherry, cover quickly and cook 2 minutes Lift cover& add the soy sauce mixture. Step 6: When sauce thickens, remove and serve.

Ingredient Names: choy sum, vegetable oil, garlic, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch the choy sum in a llarge pan of boiling water for 30 seconds, drain ans set aside. Step 2: In a preheated wok or deep pan, heat oil and stir fry garlic until fragrant. Step 3: Add the choy sum and toss for 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in the oyster sauce and serve.

Dish Name: Chun Yao Bang Fried Scallion Pancake
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, cold water, crisco, salt, scallions, oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the flour and water until a dough is formed On a lightly floured surface, knead the dough for a few minutes. Step 2: Place in a bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and set aside for 30 minutes. Step 3: Divide dough into 4 pieces. Step 4: Roll out the dough to a 1 / 8 inch thickness. Step 5: Spread a thin layer of crisco on the top, sprinkle with salt, and then press a layer of green onions into the dough. Step 6: Roll the pancake like a rug, roll it up like a snail, then roll onto a floured surface to a 1 / 8 inch thickness, pushing any green onions that escape back into the dough. Step 7: Fry in 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a skillet. Step 8: Cook for approximately 3 minutes on one side then flip and cook for 2 more minutes before placing the pancake onto a paper towel-lined plate. Step 9: Repeat with remaining quarter dough pieces.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, lemon juice, hot chili sauce, molasses, rice wine vinegar, ginger powder, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a two quart saucepan, combine all ingredients except cornstarch and water. Step 2: Place over medium high heat and stir occasionally until mixture begins to simmer. Step 3: Blend cornstarch into water and add to sauce. Step 4: Bring to a full boil, stirring often, for at least one minute or until thickened. Step 5: Remove from heat and serve over the vegetables, noodles and protein of your choice.

Dish Name: Cold Chinese Noodles In Peanut Sesame Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut butter, water, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, tahini, dark sesame oil, sherry wine, rice wine vinegar, honey, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, hot pepper oil, hot water, chinese noodles, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in large pot of boiling unsalted water over medium heat until barely tender and still firm. Step 2: Drain immediately and rinse with cold water until cold. Step 3: Drain well and toss noodles with dark sesame oil so they don't stick together For dressing: Combine all ingredients except hot water in a blender or food processor fitted with steel blade and blend until smooth Thin with hot water to consistency of whipping cream For carrot curls: peel flesh of carrot in short shavings about 4" long. Step 4: Place in ice water for 15 minutes to curl Just before serving, toss noodles with sauce. Step 5: Garnish with cucumber, peanuts, green onion, and carrot curls.

Dish Name: Cold Eggplant With Spicy Asian Peanut Dressing
Ingredient Names: japanese eggplants, peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chinese rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, salt, garlic and red chile paste, ginger, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Quarter the eggplants and cut them crosswise into 3-inch sections. Step 2: Steam over high heat until tender, 10-15 minutes, using a bamboo steamer or steamer basket. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine all other ingredients for the sauce, except the cilantro, and mix well. Step 4: When eggplants are tender, gently mix into the sauce in a serving dish. Step 5: Sprinkle with the cilantro. Step 6: Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Dish Name: Cold Spicy Sesame Noodles With Crisp Vegetables
Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, peanut oil, shallot, garlic clove, dark sesame oil, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sugar, sambal oelek, chinese egg noodles, cilantro, snow peas, red bell pepper, daikon radishes, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Up to 2 days before you plan to serve, make the dressing: Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Spread the sesame seeds out on a baking sheet and toast until fragrant, about 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once Immediately remove the seeds from the baking sheet. Step 3: When cool, transfer to a blender. Step 4: Heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the shallots and garlic and cook, stirring, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 6: Let cool slightly and add to the sesame seeds in the blender. Step 7: Add the remaining 6 tablespoons peanut oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and sambal oelek, and blend at high speed just until a thick paste forms Stop blending as soon as most of the seeds have broken up.

Dish Name: Cool Chinese Noodle In Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, dark sesame oil, peanut butter, water, soy sauce, tahini, sesame oil, sherry wine, rice wine vinegar, honey, garlic, fresh ginger, hot sauce, hot water, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in a large pot of boiling water over medium heat. Step 2: Cook until barely tender and still firm. Step 3: Drain immediately and rinse with cold water until cold. Step 4: Drain well and toss noodles with dark sesame oil so they don't stick together For dressing: combine all ingredients except hot water in a blender and blend until smooth Thin with hot water to consistency of whipping cream For garnish, peel flesh of carrot in short shavings about 4" long Just before serving, toss noodles with sauce. Step 5: Garnish with cucumber, green onion, and carrot, serve cold.

Ingredient Names: creamed corn, water, tofu, eggs, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cream corn, tofu and water together and bring to a boil, stir constantly simmer under low heat, add the egg and stir briefly If you want a thicker soup, stir in some cornflour paste. Step 2: Stir constantly and simmer under low heat for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, cornstarch, vegetable oil, white onion, yellow bell pepper, broccoli floret, carrot, sliced water chestnuts, sweet and sour sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Press moisture out of the tofu and cut into cubes. Step 2: Place tofu in a gallon-sized plastic bag with the corn starch Shake bag to coat tofu. Step 3: Fry tofu in vegetable oil over medium heat until it has a crunchy coating, about 15 minutes on each side. Step 4: Put tofu and vegetables into the crock-pot. Step 5: Pour bottle of sweet & sour sauce over the top. Step 6: Add a tablespoon of water to the "empty" jar Shake and pour over the top of the tofu & vegetables, stir to combine. Step 7: Cover and cook on low for 3 hours.

Ingredient Names: tempeh, onion, green bell pepper, red bell peppers, mixed mushrooms, carrots, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, vegetable broth, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, worcestershire sauce, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients, except cornstarch and water, together in crockpot. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 6 hours Dissolve cornstarch in water and stir into crockpot to thicken sauce into a glaze. Step 3: Cover and cook another 20 minutes or until sauce thickens, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, chili pepper, sugar, fresh ginger, dark soy sauce, rice vinegar, white wine, sesame oil, garlic clove, toasted sesame seeds, cucumber, hot water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation of cucumber: Half washed but unpeeled cucumber lengthwise. Step 2: Remove the seeds with a spoon and discard. Step 3: Slice into ca 1 / 2 cm / 1 / 5 inch pieces, put into a bowl. Step 4: Mix hot water and salt and pour it over the cucumber pieces. Step 5: Leave cucumbers in water for ca 20 minutes Dressing: Heat oil in a medium skillet. Step 6: Add chilli and cook for 1-2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, water, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the ginger using a sharp-edged teaspoon -- yep that is the easiest way, just scrape it toward you and all comes off In the joints just break apart the pieces to get all the peeling. Step 2: Now slice it in 1 / 4-inch-thick slices -- i used the cuisinart since i was doing so much but you can use a mandoline or sharp knife. Step 3: Place the slices in a large nonreactive saucepan with cold water to cover, bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes. Step 4: Drain, cover with fresh cold water, boil, and again cook 15 minutes. Step 5: Repeat this blanching process 2 more times, for a total of 4 blanchings in all. Step 6: After the last blanching, drain and cover with 6 cups of fresh cold water and 3 cups of sugar Slowly bring the syrup to a boil, stirring often, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the ginger is translucent and the syrup is thickened, about 20-30 minutes Watch carefully, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, firm tofu, garlic, canola oil, vegetable broth, crystallized ginger, soy sauce, sweet potato, green pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a shallow dish, combine flour, salt and black pepper Dredge tofu in the seasoned flour Shake off excess. Step 2: In a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat, cook garlic in hot oil about 10 seconds. Step 3: Add tofu and stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes, or until light golden. Step 4: Remove tofu to a plate. Step 5: Add broth, ginger, soy sauce and sweet potato to the wok and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 10 minutes, or until potato is just tender. Step 7: Return broth to a boil. Step 8: Add green pepper and tofu and cook, stirring, 2 minutes or until tofu is just cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, rice wine vinegar, peanut oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, red pepper flakes, sugar, cucumbers, red onions, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the rice vinegar, peanut oil, soy sauce, sesame oil and crushed red pepper and sugar (if using) and whisk well. Step 2: Add cucumbers and red onion, and toss them in dressing. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for an hour or up to 24 hours. Step 4: To serve, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and chopped cilantro. Step 5: Can be served chilled or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: sea salt, chinese five spice powder, sugar, white pepper, garlic, tofu, peanut oil, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix salt, 5 spice powder, sugar, pepper and garlic. Step 2: Add tofu 1 at a time and turn over to coat evenly, let stand 1 hour. Step 3: In a wok, heat oil until smoking. Step 4: Add tofu and deep fry for 5 minutes until puffy and golden. Step 5: Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with green onions.

Dish Name: Dh's Sauce That Won Me Over To Asparagus
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, soy sauce, lemon juice, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix it all up! Step 2: Alter amounts of ingredients to personal taste Dip your lightly steamed asparagus Grind up leftovers for your baby.

Dish Name: Dofu Cai Mian Tofu Vegetable Noodle Soup Two Versions
Ingredient Names: frozen leaf spinach, frozen broccoli florets, frozen carrots, sliced mushrooms, water chestnut, bamboo shoot, lite silken extra firm tofu, fresh garlic, fresh ginger, chinese five spice powder, sesame oil, soy sauce, vegetable stock, cooked whole wheat noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Bring stock to a roiling boil. Step 2: Add spices to taste For a hotpot style soup, use ginger, garlic, szechuan sauce or chili paste, and chili oil For a darker, sweet-spicy taste, use ginger, garlic, five spice powder, sesame oil, and some extra soy sauce. Step 3: Add noodles and cubed tofu, simmer a few minutes to allow flavors to blend and noodles to cook partway while you get vegetables together. Step 4: Add all vegetables, excluding spinach, simmer. Step 5: Add spinach, simmer until just tender, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: seasoned rice vinegar, water, sugar, plum sauce, soy sauce, fresh ginger, garlic clove, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vinegar in a non-reactive pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add water and sugar, and bring to a boil. Step 3: When sugar is dissolved, remove from heat. Step 4: Add plum sauce, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil. Step 5: Refrigerate overnight.

Ingredient Names: peanuts, peanut oil, leek, szechuan peppercorns, gingerroot, garlic cloves, green cabbage, cucumber, carrot, bean sprouts, tofu, black vinegar, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put peanuts in medium skillet & heat using med-low heat for about 7 minutes, shaking them to avoid burning, until they are fragrant and visibly darkened. Step 2: Cool completely Coarsely chop them. Step 3: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat until you see oil shimmer. Step 4: Add the leek, peppercorns and ginger root, if using, and garlic. Step 5: Cook for 10 to 15 seconds, being careful not to let the leek or garlic burn. Step 6: Remove from the heat and strain into a small heatproof bowl, discarding the solids, let cool slightly. Step 7: Combine the cabbage, cucumber, carrot, peanuts, bean sprouts, tofu, black vinegar, minced garlic, salt, sugar and the infused oil in a large bowl. Step 8: Toss to mix well, then serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, chinese chili sauce, soy sauce, pickled ginger, lemon juice, rice vinegar, granulated sugar, kosher salt, chinese egg noodles, lemon, black sesame seeds, scallion, red radish, black sesame seed
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl combine the oil, chili sauce, soy sauce, pickled ginger juice, lemon juice, rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Step 2: Whisk to blend and set the bowl aside. Step 3: In a colander fluff the noodles to separate and untangle the strands. Step 4: Bring a large saucepan of water to a rolling boil. Step 5: Add the noodles and swish them gently with chopsticks. Step 6: Let them cook for 2 minutes or until the noodles are tender but still have some bite. Step 7: Drain them, plunge them briefly into ice water, then drain again Shake the colander to remove excess moisture and transfer the noodles to a bowl. Step 8: Whisk the dressing again to combine it. Step 9: Toss the noodles with just enough of the dressing to moisten them well, using your fingers to coat and separate the strands.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, creamy peanut butter, firm tofu, zucchini, yellow squash, peanut oil, hot chili oil, garlic cloves, fresh spinach leaves, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk soy sauce into peanut butter in small bowl. Step 2: Press tofu lightly between paper towels. Step 3: Cut into 3 / 4" squares or triangles. Step 4: Place in single layer in shallow dish. Step 5: Pour soy sauce mixture over tofu. Step 6: Stir gently to coat all surfaces. Step 7: Let stand at room teperature for 20 minutes. Step 8: Cut zucchini and yellow squash lengthwise into 1 / 4" thick slices. Step 9: Cut each slice into 2x1 / 4" strips. Step 10: Heat nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: plum, apricot, cider vinegar, water, brown sugar, white sugar, lemon juice, fresh ginger, onion, serrano pepper, garlic cloves, salt, mustard seeds, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: Combine plums, apricots, cider vinegar and water. Step 2: Cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Step 4: Combine the cider vinegar, brown sugar, white sugar and lemon juice. Step 5: Boil for 10 minutes. Step 6: Combine the chopped ginger, onion, pepper, garlic cloves, salt, mustard seed and cinnamon stick. Step 7: Combine the above three sets of ingredients and simmer for 45 minutes, remove cinnamon. Step 8: Puree in food processor. Step 9: Return to kettle and simmer until thick.

Ingredient Names: apple jelly, pineapple jelly, chinese mustard, horseradish, orange marmalade, currant jelly
Instructions: Step 1: Empty jellies of desired sauce into large bowl. Step 2: Mix jellies together with mixer. Step 3: Add and mix mustard and horseradish by teaspoonfuls to desired hotness and taste. Step 4: Pour the sauce in the saved cleaned jars and put in refrigerator until ready to use.

Ingredient Names: palm, soy sauce, shaohsing wine, star anise, cinnamon, long red chili split down centre, skinless duck breasts, peanut butter, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the sugar, soy, Shaohsing or sherry, star anise, cinnamon, chilli and 100ml water into a pan. Bring to the boil, then remove from the heat and cool. Slice the duck into thin strips, about 5mm wide, and place in the marinade. Leave in the fridge overnight. Step 2: Remove the duck from the marinade. Pour 100ml of the marinade into a small pan along with the peanut butter. Finely chop half the marinated chilli, or pound to a paste using a pestle and mortar, and place in the pan. Cook over a low heat, letting it bubble for at least 5 mins. Add a little water if it starts to dry out. The sauce can be made up to 2 days ahead and kept in the fridge. Step 3: To cook the satay, thread the duck strips onto 20 wooden skewers that have been soaked in water for 1 hr. Mix 4 tbsp of the peanut sauce with the oil and brush all over the duck. Heat a griddle pan until really hot, then cook the duck for about 10 mins, turning until golden all over. You will have to do this in batches, so keep some warm in a low oven or make a day ahead and reheat in the oven. Serve with peanut dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: green beans, garlic cloves, scallions, ground ginger, vegetable oil, red pepper flakes, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop garlic, ginger and scallions together. Step 2: Place in 14 x 11 x 2 dish, cover with vegetable oil. Step 3: Cook on high for 3 minutes Removed dish from microwave oven, stir in soy sauce and rice wine vinegar. Step 4: Add green beans, stirring to distribute sauce. Step 5: Cook, uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring 3-4 times during cooking. Step 6: Serve hot or cold Can be made ahead and reheated for serving.

Ingredient Names: cooked white rice, sesame oil, carrots, yellow sweet onion, sweet corn, green pepper, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, black pepper, ground ginger, garlic powder, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: In a large wok or saute' pan, stir fry the carrots, onion, corn, and green peppers for about 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, black pepper, ginger, garlic powder, and rice, toss to combine. Step 3: Make a well in the center of the rice and scramble the eggs. Step 4: Toss to combine and remove from heat You can add chopped chicken, pork, beef, or even tofu to this recipe for a twist Serving suggestions: my recipe for light lemon chicken, beef and broccoli, egg rolls, and sesame chicken.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, onion powder, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, honey, olive oil, carrots, snow peas, salt, black pepper, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together chicken broth, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, red pepper flakes and honey, set aside. Step 2: Fill a 5-quart pot 2 / 3 full of water, salt if desired and bring to a rolling boil. Step 3: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Step 4: Drizzle olive oil into a large skillet, and bring to medium-high heat. Step 5: Once the oil is glistening and fragrant, add snow peas and carrots. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Step 8: Remove from heat and cover. Step 9: Once pasta is cooked, drain as much water as possible from the noodles.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, salt, sugar, white pepper, sesame seed oil, peas, mushrooms, cornstarch, water, spring onions, egg
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok add chicken broth and wait for it to boil. Step 2: Next add salt, sugar, white pepper, sesame seed oil. Step 3: When the chicken broth is boiling add the vegetables to the wok. Step 4: To thicken the sauce, whisk together cornstarch and water in a bowl and slowly add to your soup until it's the right thickness. Step 5: Next add 1 egg slightly beaten with a knife or fork and add it to the soup slowly and stir for 8 seconds. Step 6: Serve the soup in a bowl and add the green onions on top.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt and pepper, five-spice powder, sunflower oil, green onions, garlic, green pepper, fresh bean sprouts, jasmine rice, light soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Season the eggs and beat in the five spice powder, if using. Step 2: In a wok or large frying pan, heat one tablespoon of the oil and when quite hot, pour in the egg. Step 3: Cook rather like an omelette, pulling the mixture away from the sides and allowing the rest to slip underneath. Step 4: Cook the egg until firm and then. Step 5: Chop the'omelette' into small strips. Step 6: Heat the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion, garlic, pepper and bean sprouts for about 2 mins, stirring and tossing continuously. Step 7: Mix in the cooked rice and heat thoroughly, stirring well. Step 8: Add the soy sauce and sesame oil then return the egg and mix in well. Step 9: Serve immediately, piping hot.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, eggs, basmati rice, tomatoes, light soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat your wok until smoking before adding 1tbsp groundnut oil. Step 2: Add the eggs and scramble for 1-2 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a warm plate and put to one side Wipe any excess oil from the wok with a kitchen towel then bring back up to temperature before adding the remaining groundnut oil. Step 4: Add the rice, stirring well, then add the tomatoes and cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the egg and season to taste with pepper, sesame oil and soy sauce, then stir through the onion before serving.

Ingredient Names: oil, eggs, tomatoes, soy sauce, cooked rice, salt, pepper, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, then scramble eggs until set. Step 2: Add tomatoes and mix with eggs for 1 minute to steam, add soy sauce. Step 3: Cover and let steam for 1 minute. Step 4: Mix in leftover rice. Step 5: Add salt, pepper, chili sauce to taste.

Dish Name: Egg With Tomatoes Chinese Home Style
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, eggs, olive oil, sesame oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, green onion, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs together. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper, and add the"white" part of the green onion and sesame oil, mix well. Step 3: Add oil to the pan, turn up the heat. Step 4: Add the egg mixture Break the egg into pieces. Step 5: Toss and cook until the eggs are almost done Less then 2 min, take out the egg.

Ingredient Names: black rice, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything in 3 quart or larger glass or ceramic casserole, or large microwave rice cooker. Step 2: Cover Microwave on high 10 minutes, then on half power 25 minutes, or until tender and liquid is absorbed Fluff with a fork and serve hot!

Ingredient Names: asparagus, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Leaving spears whole blanch asparagus for 1-2 minutes or you can microwave on high for 1 minute In the meanwhile combine oyster, soy, vinegar and sugar in a saucepan. Step 2: Bring to the boil or alternatively heat in the microwave. Step 3: Pour over asparagus and sprinkle with sesame seeds, serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh lotus root, soy sauce, white vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil, cilantro, black sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Boil about 3 quarts of water in a pot. Step 2: Rinse lotus roots with cold water Trim and discard both ends of the bulb and peel the skin Diagonally cut the root into 1 / 8 inch thick slices and immediately put them into acidulated water. Step 3: Drain the roots and put them into the boiling water. Step 4: Take pot off heat and cover pot with lid. Step 5: Let sit for 5 minutes. Step 6: Drain and rinse with cold water Pat dry and put in a shallow bowl. Step 7: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, tapioca starch, wheat starch, salt, water, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the rice flour, tapioca starch, wheat starch, salt and water, stir until smooth. Step 2: Then strain the batter through a fine strainer and stir in the oil. Step 3: Let the batter sit for 30 minutes Have ready an oiled baking sheet. Step 4: Then oil two 8-inch square pans or two 9-inch square pans. Step 5: Then place an 8-inch round cake rack in a wok and add water to just below the rack. Step 6: Boil the water and have a kettle of hot water available to replenish the water in the wok. Step 7: Stir the batter very well and add 5 to 6 tablespoons to one pan, allowing the batter to cover the bottom of the pan. Step 8: Set the pan on the cake rack, cover the wok, and steam over high heat for 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Fried Bean Curd Tofu With Soy Sauce By Sy
Ingredient Names: tofu, peanut oil, scallions, hot green peppers, sesame seeds, soup stock, soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place oil in a pan and use low to medium heat. Step 2: Fry half the bean curd until golden brown, turn as needed and then remove to a serving plate. Step 3: Fry and remove the balance of the bean curd. Step 4: Place the sliced scallions and peppers on top of the fried bean curd In the wok with a little oil remaining, add sesame seeds fry briefly. Step 5: Then add the stock, soy sauce, sesame oil. Step 6: Stir once until heated and then pour over the tofu in the serving plate Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, water, green onions, cooking oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil 1 cup of water. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 cup of cold water to the boiled water. Step 3: Put 3 cups of flour into a large bowl Slowly pour approximately 1 cup of the hot water into the flour and stir the bowl while you pour. Step 4: Knead until all of the flour in the bowl has joined the dough. Step 5: Cover the ball of dough with 2 layers of moist paper towels. Step 6: Leave covered for at least 1 hour. Step 7: After an hour or so, the dough should have transformed from gray to white Have your chopped onions and cooking oil ready in small bowls. Step 8: Make sure your rolling pin and rolling board are floured.

Ingredient Names: fresh snow peas, sesame oil, minced garlic cloves, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok on medium-hi heat. Step 2: Add oil get it hot, dump in peas About 1 minute after stir frying add garlic and seasoning Quick fry just till bright green and still crisp Cooking time is an estimate -- do not over cook or they will turn a dull green and go limp. Step 3: Remove and serve while still hot.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, ginger, water, tamari soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, sriracha sauce, broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400. Step 2: Toss tofu cubes with 1 tbsp corn starch and place on a greased baking sheet. Step 3: Bake 20-25 minutes, or until slightly brown While the tofu bakes, cook garlic and ginger in a medium saucepan for about two minutes. Step 4: Add water, vegetable oil, hoisin, rice vinegar, brown sugar and sriracha and cook for about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add corn starch and water mixture slowly, stirring constantly, until sauce reaches desired consistency. Step 6: Toss baked tofu with sauce. Step 7: Serve over brown rice or quinoa with piles of freshly steamed broccoli Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, potato starch, salt and pepper, canola oil, mushroom broth, minced garlic cloves, minced ginger, tamarind paste, brown sugar, tamari, rice vinegar, thai red chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Drain, rinse and pat tofu dry. Step 2: Cut into 1" cubes 2. Step 3: Heat oil on medium-high 3. Step 4: Combine 3 t potato starch with salt and pepper Dredge tofu and fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Step 5: Let rest on paper towel 4.

Ingredient Names: savoy cabbage, lite olive oil, garlic, salt & pepper, ginger, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok or large skillet medium high heat, wait until oil is hot. Step 2: Add cabbage and stir fry until cabbage just starts to wilt. Step 3: Add garlic, salt and pepper cook 1 minute. Step 4: Add ginger cook 1 minute. Step 5: Drizzle with lime juice and serve.

Ingredient Names: boiling water, fresh ginger, soft brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the water in a pan with the ginger Bring to the boil then add sugar Simmer for five minutes, then strain into a cup to serve.

Ingredient Names: acorn squash, olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, yellow onion, fresh gingerroot, russet potatoes, vegetarian chicken broth, soymilk, white miso, dry sherry, garlic granules, ground ginger, ground nutmeg, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the acorn squash in half, crosswise Scoop out seeds and discard. Step 2: Place cut side down in 9 x13 baking pans and add about one inch of water, bake for an hour. Step 3: Remove from pans and set aside to cool If the squash are rather small, it might take as many as five squash to make the required six pounds Simply quarter some of the smaller squash to fit the baking pans Warm the oil and crushed pepper in a five-quart saucepan, over medium-high heat for one minute. Step 4: Add the garlic, onion, and ginger. Step 5: Cook for three minutes, add potatoes and cook mixture, stirring frequently for five minutes or until the potatoes soften.

Dish Name: Glazed Chinese Long Beans Or Green Beans
Ingredient Names: long beans, butter, scallions, minced ginger, garlic, red pepper flakes, vegetable stock, honey, sesame oil, cracked black pepper, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling water, blanch long beans for 2 minutes until slightly tender. Step 2: Allow to cool If you like your beans crunchy, skip the blanching. Step 3: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add butter. Step 4: Add scallions, ginger and garlic, mix together. Step 5: Add red pepper flakes and long beans. Step 6: Allow to cook for a few minutes. Step 7: Stir in stock, honey and sesame oil. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper, to taste, and add sesame seeds, if desired.

Dish Name: Gourmet Magazine's Asian Cucumber Ribbon Salad
Ingredient Names: seasoned rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, english cucumbers
Instructions: Step 1: Bring vinegar and sugar to a simmer, stirring until sugar is dissolved, then cool to room temperature. Step 2: Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil. Step 3: Cut cucumber lengthwise into 1 / 8-inch-thick ribbons using a mandoline or other manual slicer. Step 4: Toss cucumber with dressing and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: green beans, fresh broccoli florets, water, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, honey, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk dressing ingredients together and set aside. Step 2: If using frozen green beans and/or broccoli, follow microwave directions on packaging. Step 3: Microwave fresh green beans with water in covered bowl on HIGH for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir the green beans and add the fresh broccoli. Step 5: Cover and microwave together on HIGH for 2 minutes. Step 6: Drain green beans and broccoli. Step 7: Mix in dressing while vegetables are still warm. Step 8: Let vegetables chill in refrigerator until ready to serve, or at least 5 to 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, shiitake mushroom caps, chinese cabbage, chives, spring onion, firm tofu, soy sauce, salt, cornflour, wonton wrappers, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, heat the 1 tbs sesame oil and 1 tbs vegetable oil and saut the garlic and ginger for 1 minute of medium heat. Step 2: Add the shiitake, cabbage, chives, spring onion and tofu. Step 3: Turn the heat to high and stir fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add the soy sauce and the salt and continue to stir over high heat for a further 2-3 minutes until the excess liquid has been absorbed. Step 5: Sprinkle in the corn flour and mix quickly. Step 6: Transfer to a dish to cool. Step 7: Put a teaspoon of the vegetable mixture in the centre of each wonton wrapper and moisten the edges of the wrapper with water. Step 8: Fold to make a moon shape, making a few pleats to seal. Step 9: Heat the 2 tsp sesame oil in a saucepan, then put in 10-12 gyoza. Step 10: Cook both sides for 2-3 minutes over medium heat until well browned.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, cornstarch, water, chinese cabbage, carrots, shiitake mushrooms, celery, fresh ginger, low-sodium tamari, green onions, fat-free egg-roll wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray Dissolve one tablespoon of the cornstarch into 1 / 4 cup water and set aside Lightly spray a wok or large saute pan with cooking spray and heat over low heat. Step 2: Combine cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, celery and ginger in the pan. Step 3: Cook for five to seven minute or until vegetables begin to wilt, stirring constantly to keep from burning. Step 4: Stir in cornstarch mixture and soy sauce. Step 5: Cook until the sauce thickens. Step 6: Add green onions at very end to keep them crisp Dissolve the remaining tablespoon of cornstarch in 1 / 4 cup water. Step 7: Brush onto egg-roll wrappers and fill with vegetables.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, cornstarch, boiling water, cold water, sesame oil, scallions, salt, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly mix flour and starch in a bowl. Step 2: Using a fork, mix in the boiling water. Step 3: Add the cold water and mix with your hands until all the flour is incorporated. Step 4: Let the dough rest, covered, for 20 minutes. Step 5: Roll the dough into a long rope. Step 6: Cut the rope into 8 piecess. Step 7: Cover all pieces but one On a floured surface, roll the piece of dough as thin as possible without tearing. Step 8: Brush with sesame oil, sprinkle with scallions and salt. Step 9: Roll up jellyroll-style.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, green onion, shiitake mushroom, celery, frozen peas and carrot, ginger, minced garlic cloves, cooked white rice, reduced sodium soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large skillet or wok, add oils, onions, mushrooms and celery. Step 2: Stir fry for about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add peas and carrots, garlic and ginger stir fry 4 more minutes. Step 4: Add rice, soy sauce and vinegar stir fry about 8 minutes until heated through.

Ingredient Names: beets, sugar, vinegar, cornstarch, cloves, ketchup, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Drain all the liquid from the beets except 1 1 / 2 cups. Step 2: Pour the 1 1 / 2 cups beet liquid into a medium saucepan. Step 3: Add all of the other ingredients except the sliced beets, mix well, add the beets. Step 4: Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until liquid thickens, allow to cool, refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, ginger, cabbage, straw mushrooms, firm tofu, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, water, all-purpose flour, sesame oil, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: - in a cup, combine the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, water, sesame oil and flour - in a wok, heat oil and fry the garlic and ginger - add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes - add the bokchoy and the mixture and simmer for 3 minutes - add the tofu and simmer again for another 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, black bean paste, honey, white vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, sesame oil, hot sauce, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a mason jar and shake until it emulsifies Use no more than 2 tablespoons, but please, start with one tablespoon Work with mortar and pestle the fresh garlic and jalapeno until it forms a paste.

Dish Name: Honey Chilli Potato Recipe - Street Style with Secret Tips
Ingredient Names: potato, water, salt, cornstarch, all-purpose flour, pepper powder, oil, ginger, garlic, chili, green onions, sesame oil, onions, capsicum, tomato sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, chili sauce, chili powder, corn flour slurry, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, peel the skin of the potato and chop it into the size of french fries. Soak in water to remove starch. Step 2: Drain off the water and half boil in salt water for 3 minutes. Step 3: Drain off and cool completely. Step 4: In a large bowl, take half-boiled potato. Step 5: Add ½ tsp salt, 2 tbsp corn flour, 2 tbsp maida, and ½ tsp pepper powder. Step 6: Mix well making sure all the spices are well combined. Step 7: Fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium. Step 8: Stir occasionally, and fry till the potato is crunchy and golden brown. Step 9: Drain off and keep aside. Step 10: In a large wok, heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 inch ginger, 4 cloves garlic, 2 chilies, 2 spring onions, and 1 tsp sesame. Stir fry until they turn aromatic. Step 11: Now add ½ onion, ½ capsicum and stir fry on high flame. Step 12: Now add 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp vinegar, 2 tsp chilli sauce, ½ tsp chilli powder, and ½ tsp salt. Stir fry on high flame till the sauce turns aromatic. Step 13: Further, add 3 tbsp corn flour slurry and mix well making sure it turns glossy. Step 14: Add in fried potato, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp honey, and spring onion. Step 15: Mix well till the sauces are coated well. Do not cook more as it turns soggy. Step 16: Finally, enjoy Honey Chilli Potato Recipe topped with toasted sesame.

Ingredient Names: napa cabbage, scallion, seasoned rice vinegar, ginger, sugar, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Put cabbage and scallion in a bowl Heat remaining ingredients to boil and lower heat, cook until sugar is dissolved Pour over cabbage, toss to combine.

Ingredient Names: napa cabbage, coarse salt, minced ginger, red pepper flakes, red wine vinegar, rice wine vinegar, sugar, salt, dried red chilies, szechuan peppercorns, peanut oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Remove core from cabbage Shred Shred cabbage. Step 2: Place cabbage in a colander in the sink and sprinkle with coarse salt. Step 3: Allow to sit until the cabbage weeps, about 45 minutes, then rinse thoroughly and let drain. Step 4: In a small saucepan heat ginger, red pepper flakes, vinegars, sesame oil, salt, and sugar / splenda to a boil. Step 5: Heat oil in small skillet on medium-high heat on stove, add szechuan peppercorns and chilies. Step 6: Stir until very fragrant. Step 7: Add cabbage to skillet and cook for a few minutes. Step 8: Pour dressing in and cook until the liquid reduces somewhat.

Ingredient Names: onion, ginger, dried chili, olive oil, water, apple cider vinegar, low-sodium tamari, arame seaweed, lemon, carrot, rice vermicelli, green pepper, red pepper, button mushroom, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Broth: in a medium-sized pot, saut the onion, ginger, and chilli in 1 tablespoon of olive oil until the onion is transparent. Step 2: Add water and all additional ingredients and let simmer for 10 to 30 minutes while you prepare the veggies. Step 3: In a serving pot or bowls, arrange the hot pot ingredients in small clusters. Step 4: When ready to serve, pour the hot broth over the hot pot ingredients and let sit for several minutes Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: dried mushroom, water, vegetable stock, dry sherry, bamboo shoots, tofu, frozen peas, white wine vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, white pepper, sesame oil, egg, green onions, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cover mushrooms with water and let stand for 30 minutes, remove mushrooms. Step 2: Cut off and discard stems Thinly slice mushrooms and set aside Measure soaking water and add enough stock to make a total of 4 cupcs liquid. Step 3: Place in a 2-quart pan and add sherry, bamboo shoots, and sliced mushrooms. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add tofu, peas, white vinegar, and soy. Step 7: Heat for 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, salt, dry mustard, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In blender, put flour, sugar, salt, and mustard, blend well. Step 2: Add vinegar and mix well, scraping sides a few times. Step 3: Pour into a jar and keep refrigerated Better if it ages a day or two Very hot!

Ingredient Names: eggs, cold water, salt, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, liquid smoke
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the room temperature eggs by place in saucepan with cold water and bring water just to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Cook for 4 minutes. Step 3: Pour off water Tap all eggs with spoon just enought to crack them Refill pan with cold water and add eggs Carefully crack the eggs and remove shells then set aside soft boiled eggs. Step 4: Combine marinade ingredients and mix well. Step 5: Add eggs and let stand for an hour or more. Step 6: Turn eggs several times to coat evenly. Step 7: Then cut egg in half lenghtwise and serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: green tea bags, sugar, lemon zest, water, fresh lemon juice, fresh edible flower, fresh lemon rind, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Place the water in the reserve of the coffee maker In the coffee filter place an unbleached filter then place sugar, zest and the tea bags All the sugar will dissolve and the lemon zest flavor will be picked up as the heated water goes through. Step 2: Pour the tea into a pitcher and cool. Step 3: Add the lemon juice and fill pitcher with ice cubes. Step 4: Pour into ice filled tall glasses and garnish with jasmine flower or lemon rind or mint leaves Enjoy and stay cool!

Dish Name: Kombucha Scoby To Start Your Own Kombucha Brew
Ingredient Names: kombucha, black tea, sugar, white sugar, fruit juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the bottle of kombucha and sweetened tea into a large glass jar. Step 2: Cover jar with a towel or coffee filter secured with a rubber band so the brew can breathe but still be protected from insects and other contaminants. Step 3: Let it sit for a week. Step 4: Put it in a room temperature area that is dark With time, a new scoby will start to form on top of the liquid It will appear first as a thin film, then slowly fill in and thicken up. Step 5: Once its about 1 / 4 inch thick, its ready to go You can let it sit longer and get even thicker, but thats really not necessary If you see any mold - discard it and start over It will look like bread mold.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sherry wine, hoisin sauce, chile sauce with garlic, arrowroot, vegetable broth, vegetable oil, sesame oil, carrot, sugar snap pea, red bell pepper, onion, extra firm tofu, scallions, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Assemble vegetables. Step 2: Meanwhile, bring broth and water to boil, add rice and cover. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes. Step 4: Whisk together sauce ingredients in a small bowl In medium wok or large skillet, heat vegetable and sesame oils under medium-high setting. Step 5: Add carrots and stir-fry 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Add snow peas and stir-fry 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Add pepper and onion and stir-fry 1-2 minutes. Step 8: Add meat substitute or meat and stir-fry 1-2 minutes. Step 9: Pour sauce over vegetable mixture.

Ingredient Names: tofu, five-spice powder, canola oil, water, oyster sauce, cornstarch, broccoli florets, yellow bell pepper, red bell pepper, fresh ginger, garlic, unsalted dry roasted peanuts, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pat tofu dry and cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes. Step 2: Combine with half of the five-spice powder in a medium bowl. Step 3: Heat the canola oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add tofu and cook, stirring every 1 to 2 minutes, until golden brown, 7 to 9 minutes total Tranfer to a plate. Step 5: Meanwhile, wisk water, oyster sauce, cornstarch and the remaining five-spice powder in a small bowl. Step 6: Add broccoli, yellow and red bell pepper to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally until beginning to soften, about 4 minutes. Step 7: Add ginger and garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Return the tofu to the pan along with the peanuts and stir to coat with sauce. Step 9: Stir in hot sesame oil.

Dish Name: Laquered Tofu Triangles With Green Beans And Cashews
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, red bell pepper, green beans, szechuan peppercorns, mushroom soy sauce, soy sauce, light brown sugar, garlic cloves, water, peanut oil, scallions, roasted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the tofu. Step 2: Cut it crosswise into slabs about 1 / 2 inch wide. Step 3: Cut each slab in half lengthwise, then cut into triangles Blot well with paper towels. Step 4: Cut the bell pepper in half lengthwise, removing veins and seeds, then cut each half into three long strips. Step 5: Cut each strip into triangles Snip the ends off beans and cut them into 2-inch lengths Toast the szechuan peppercorns in a dry skillet until aromatic, then grind to a powder and set aside. Step 6: Combine the next five ingredients in a small bowl and stir to dissolve the sugar. Step 7: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a wide nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: broccoli stems, water, baking soda, salt, sugar, braggs liquid aminos, dark sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Do not use light cooking sesame oil You want the dark smoky kind Peel tough outer layer from the stalks and rinse. Step 2: Now cut off flowerets including 1 inch of the stem in the cut Use the flowerets in another dish, now the stems. Step 3: Cut into 1 1 / 2 x 1 / 2 x 1 / 2 inch strips [or close] or 1 / 4 inch diagonal slices to make about 2 cups In sauce pan boil the water then add stems and soda Parboil for 1 minute. Step 4: Drain and rinse in cold water.

Dish Name: Lo Han Jai Buddhist Vegetarian Stew
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chinese black mushrooms, dried black fungus, bamboo shoot, water chestnuts, carrot, napa cabbage, vegetable broth, rice noodles, firm tofu, snow peas, fresh bean sprouts, soy sauce, cornstarch, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 10 minutes. Step 2: Squeeze out the excess water. Step 3: Then remove stems and leave the mushrooms whole Reserve the soaking water. Step 4: Soak the cloud ears in warm water until soft, then cut into smaller pieces. Step 5: Boil the bean thread in water to cover for 5 minutes, then drain To prep the snow peas, remove the strings, then cut into thin slivers. Step 6: Mix the water and cornstarch to form a slurry for thickening The cornstarch will continue to settle out, so you'll need to stir this again just before you use it. Step 7: Heat wok until smoky.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, oil, baby carrots, onions, creamy peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Break noodles and boil in water for three minutes Do not add seasoning packet. Step 2: Drain when done and set aside in serving bowl Immediately return pot to stove over med, heat. Step 3: Add oils, soy sauce, carrots, garlic, onion, and peanut butter. Step 4: Stir well and let cook for just a few seconds with a fork. Step 5: Toss noodles back in and stir to coat. Step 6: Make sure noodles are well-coated and blended well with the garlic and veggies. Step 7: Return to serving bowl and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: rice, yukon gold potato, oil, canola oil, red onion, wheat gluten, aji yellow paste, tomatoes, parsley, cilantro, balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, paprika, ground cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the rice and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil to 325, cut potatoes into french fries and fry for 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from oil Reheat oil to 375 and resume cooking fries for about 2-3 more minutes until golden brown, crispy, and cooked through, keep warm. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in pan over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add onion, gluten strips or mushrooms and fry until browned. Step 6: Add aji, tomatoes, parsley, cilantro, vinegar, soy sauce, and spices and cook for 2 minutes until tomatoes are softened If desired, sprinkle pisco on top of the dish and ignite. Step 7: Squeeze lime juice over pan, add french fries, and quickly toss together.

Dish Name: Lychee And Pineapple Stir Fry Sauce
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, lychee juice, sesame oil, fresh garlic, ground ginger, pineapple juice, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, combine lychee juice, pineapple juice, oil, garlic and ginger over medium heat. Step 2: Combine 2 tablespoons of pineapple juice and corn starch in a separate bowl and stir until the corn starch dissolves. Step 3: Add cornstarch to saucepan and turn heat to high. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil, stirring often. Step 5: Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer mixture for 4 -6 minutes or until thick. Step 6: Add to meat or vegetables that are 75% cooked in a wok and stir to coat.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, boiling water, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl put the flour, and gradually stir in the water, mixing to make a thin batter. Step 2: When cool enough to handle, work the dough on a lightly floured surface until smooth. Step 3: Place the dough in a bowl, cover with a dish towel and let rest for 30 minutes. Step 4: Place the sesame oil in a small bowl. Step 5: Place the dough on a lightly floured surface and roll out to 1 / 4-inch thickness. Step 6: Cut into rounds with a 3-inch cutter With your fingers, daub a small amount of oil on top of 1 round. Step 7: Place another round on top and press together. Step 8: Roll the 2 rounds together to form a circle about 6 or 7-inches in diameter. Step 9: Cover with a damp kitchen cloth until ready to cook, and repeat with the remaining dough.

Ingredient Names: marco polo noodles, fresh snow peas, green onions, fresh bean sprouts, carrots, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, fire oil, sesame oil, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare noodles as package instructions and toss with other salad ingredients. Step 2: Mix dressing ingredients and pour over salad and toss till well mixed. Step 3: Let salad marinate in refer at least 2 hours Lightly toss the salad a couple of times to redistribute salad dressing during marination. Step 4: Garnish with reserved whole pea pods.

Dish Name: Martin Yan's Golden Chinese Baked Buns Baos
Ingredient Names: warm water, sugar, active dry yeast, all-purpose flour, bread flour, milk, unsalted butter, egg yolk, water, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Stir the 1 / 4 cup warm water, 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast together in a large bowl until the sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Set aside until the mixture begins to bubble, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Stir the all-purpose flour and bread flour together in a medium bowl. Step 4: Stir the warm milk, 1 / 2 cup water, 1 / 2 cup plus 1 tablespoon sugar, butter and yolk mixture into the yeast mixture until well blended. Step 5: Stir in the flour mixture, half at a time, and mix until you have a soft dough, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in a warm location. Step 7: Let the dough rise, until roughly doubled in size, 2 to 3 hours. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 9: Turn the dough onto a floured cutting board With a sharp knife, divide the dough into 15 roughly equal pieces.

Ingredient Names: brewed green tea, sugar, water, pearl tapioca, honeydews, ice cubes, orange juice, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine green tea with sugar and set aside. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, bring water to boil over high heat. Step 3: Add tapioca pearls. Step 4: Stir lightly and let pearls float to top. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, 25 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and let pearls sit in water 25 minutes until chewy and translucent. Step 7: Drain and rinse under cold water. Step 8: Combine in medium bowl with sweetened tea. Step 9: Refrigerate until needed Blending in 2 batches, combine melon, ice cubes, orange juice and coconut milk in blender or food processor.

Ingredient Names: oil, garlic, dried chinese mushrooms, fresh mushrooms, chinese wine, vinegar, coriander leaves, noodles, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and fry garlic and dried mushrooms till fragrant. Step 2: Add fresh mushrooms and cooked until soft. Step 3: Add wine, vinegar and half the coriander leaves and simmer until liquid reduces by half. Step 4: Add noodles and soy sauce, mix well. Step 5: Garnish with remaining coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: tamari, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, water, firm tofu, peanut oil, yellow onion, carrots, green onion, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a baking dish, combine tamari, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce, sesame oil and water. Step 2: Chop tofu in medium strips and add. Step 3: Stir well, making sure the tofu is thoroughly covered in sauce. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 / 2 hour, up to one hour, prepare rice. Step 5: When rice is cooked, leave covered and begin to prepare 'beef' Fry onion and carrots in peanut oil in a frying pan over medium heat until onion is translucent. Step 6: Add 'beef' and sauce the beef was in to frying pan. Step 7: Fry 5-10 minutes, until heated through. Step 8: Serve over rice, topped with chopped green onion.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrot, scallions, white mushroom, peanut oil, vegetable stock, garlic, ginger, low sodium soy sauce, hoisin sauce, moo shu pancakes
Instructions: Step 1: Warm pancakes as directed on package. Step 2: Heat wok over high heat until almost smoking. Step 3: Add 1 teaspoon of oil and stir fry mushroom until softened. Step 4: Remove mushrooms from wok. Step 5: Add remaining oil to the wok along with the garlic and ginger. Step 6: Stir-fry spices 30 seconds, add cabbage and carrots Continue cooking 2 minutes add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and taste. Step 7: Add additional soy sauce if desired. Step 8: When cabbage is close to crisp-tender, return mushrooms to the wok and add scallions If the vegetables begin to stick, drizzle sparingly a little water or vegetable broth.

Dish Name: Moo Shu Vegetables With Chinese Pancakes
Ingredient Names: sesame seed oil, green onions, bok choy, red bell pepper, carrot, mushroom, mung bean sprouts, reduced-fat firm tofu, fresh ginger, garlic, tamari, chinese pancakes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 f degrees. Step 2: Wrap pancakes in foil and place in oven to warm, about 8 minutes. Step 3: Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet until very hot. Step 4: Add green onions, bok choy, red bell pepper, carrots and mushrooms. Step 5: Stir-fry vegetables 3 to 4 minutes until crisp tender. Step 6: Add sprouts, tofu, ginger and garlic and continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes until sprouts are soft. Step 7: Stir in tamari and extra hoisin sauce To eat, drizzle a spoonful of hoisin sauce across center of pancake. Step 8: Top with generous helping of vegetables and roll up burrito style.

Ingredient Names: peanut sauce, napa cabbage, leeks, carrots, flour tortillas, peanut oil, fresh shiitake mushroom, bean sprouts, firm tofu, reduced sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, fresh ginger, cornstarch, sesame oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation of cabbage: Discard any wilted or bruised outer leaves of the cabbage. Step 2: Cut cabbage into halves and cut halves into quarters, remove core. Step 3: Cut cabbage into thin shreds until you have 4 cups Preparation of leeks: Remove any withered outer leaves. Step 4: Cut off leaf tops down to where the dark green begins to pale and discard, cut off roots. Step 5: Cut leeks lengthwise in half.

Dish Name: Mul Kimchi Water Kimchi Or Summer White Kimchi
Ingredient Names: radish, water, garlic cloves, sugar, dried red pepper, salt, scallions, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large jar or large container, combine all ingredients, except red bell pepper cover, and let sit at room temperature for 2 days. Step 2: Serve cold with the red pepper garnish The kimchi may be stored, chilled, for up to 1 week.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, dried shiitake mushrooms, mung bean sprouts, green onions, bean thread noodles, minced ginger, garlic cloves, sesame oil, salt, soy sauce, dumpling wrappers
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water and revive the mushrooms by putting them in a capped container with the hot water. Step 2: When they're revived, cut them into small strips Soften the bean thread noodles with some hot water Use the remaining hot water to blanch the mung bean sprouts. Step 3: Cut up the tofu into small cubes. Step 4: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl, except for the wrappers Optionally add a beaten egg to make it stick together better. Step 5: Make the dumplings: put a small quantity of this mixture in dumpling wrappers, and then pinch the sides together, sometimes a little cold water will help them stay stick together. Step 6: Boil a pot of water and throw small batches of the dumplings into the water They're ready when they float.

Dish Name: Noodle Pancake With Stir Fried Broccoli And Tamari Walnuts
Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, sesame oil, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, salt, oil, ginger, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, broccoli, walnuts, tamari
Instructions: Step 1: Tamari walnuts: To make the tamari walnuts, heat the oil in a medium skillet. Step 2: Add the walnuts and stir-fry until fragrent, about 10 seconds. Step 3: Sprinkle with tamari or soy sauce and stir-fry until coated and crisp, about 20 seconds Do not overcook. Step 4: Spoon onto a plate to cool Pancake and broccoli: Cook the noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again. Step 6: Place the noodles on a clean kitchen towel and blot to remove excess moisture.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dark sesame oil, sugar, white vinegar, cucumbers, vermicelli, scallions, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: in a small bowl combine soy sauce, oil, sugar and vinegar. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine cucumbers, noodles and sauce, stir. Step 3: Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with scallions and sesame seeds To give it more flavor you might stir in minced garlic and some chili sauce Also play around with the amount of ingredients to you likings.

Dish Name: Noodles With Stir Fried Tofu And Broccoli
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, udon noodles, canola oil, broccoli florets, stir-fry sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu into 1 / 2 inch thick slices Dry by blotting between layers of paper towels or, preferably, clean tea towels. Step 2: Cut blotted tofu into 1 / 2 inch dice. Step 3: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or extra large skillet With heat on medium high, stir fry tofu until golden on most sides, remove from pan. Step 5: Combine broccoli with 1 / 4 cup of water in the pan. Step 6: Cover and steam until tender crisp. Step 7: Add tofu, cooked noodles and stir fry sauce to pan.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, carrot, fresh shiitake mushrooms, fresh bean sprouts, spring onions, gingerroot, garlic clove, soy sauce, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the stems from the mushrooms and slice finely. Step 2: Heat the tbsp oil and fry the carrot and mushroom for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add ginger, garlic, onion and beansprouts and cook for another 2 minutes. Step 4: Season with the soy and set aside. Step 5: Beat together the eggs with the 1 tsp oil. Step 6: Heat a medium frying pan and add a little egg Swirl in the pan and then flip when the edges become golden. Step 7: Remove from pan and repeat until you have 6 pancakes. Step 8: Cut each pancake in half In the centre of the half moon place a spoonful of vegetable filling.

Dish Name: Orange Zest And Honey Pot Sticker Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: tamari, water, honey, ginger, garlic, toasted sesame oil, red pepper flakes, toasted sesame seeds, green onion, orange zest
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together tamari, honey, ginger, garlic, orange zest, sesame oil and red pepper flakes in a small bowl, cover, chill. Step 2: Then stir in sesame seeds and green onions Best served chilled "this is my twist off a food network recipe" By: chef travis w Holland.

Ingredient Names: cereal, chow mein noodles, cashews, vegetable oil, soy sauce, garlic powder, onion powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 250 degrees f. Step 2: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a 13x9 pan, set aside. Step 3: Combine remaining 4 ingredients in a small bowl Quickly pour over the cereal mixture and stir to coat. Step 4: Bake 1 hour Stirring every 20 minutes, cool and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: baby spinach leaves, sesame oil, sugar, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, dijon mustard, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place washed and dried spinach in a large bowl. Step 2: Combine sesame oil, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, mustard and sesame seeds, pour over spinach, toss to coat, let set 5 minutes, toss again, serve.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, peanut oil, broccoli, water, teriyaki sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the minced garlic in the oil for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the broccoli and water. Step 3: Stir fry 4 to 6 minutes until broccoli is bright and tender crisp. Step 4: Toss with teriyaki sauce.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, tamari soy sauce, fresh ginger, garlic, honey, sesame oil, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Step 2: Place the cornstarch into a bowl. Step 3: Whisk the liquid mixture into it. Step 4: Set aside, but keep the whisk handy, as you will need to whisk the sauce again just before you use it. Step 5: Add this sauce to a wok, full of vegetables, meat, or seafood about 2 / 3 of the way through cooking. Step 6: Stir well to ensure a thorough coating.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix with an electric mixer until well blended and sugar is dissolved Chill Serve over polar bear tartare.

Dish Name: P F Chang's Stir Fried Spicy Eggplant
Ingredient Names: eggplant, garlic, cornstarch, vegetable oil, vegetarian oyster sauce, light soy sauce, water, white vinegar, granulated sugar, sambal oelek chili paste, ground bean sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all spicy sauce ingredients and mix well. Step 2: In a wok or large frying pan, deep-fry eggplant at 350 degrees f for 1 minute. Step 3: Remove eggplant and drain on paper towels. Step 4: Meanwhile remove all but 1 / 2 teaspoon of oil from wok On high heat, stir-fry garlic for 5 seconds then add spicy sauce. Step 5: Reduce heat and let sauce simmer 20 seconds. Step 6: Add eggplant and mix well. Step 7: Simmer for another 10 seconds. Step 8: Stir in cornstarch paste a little at a time until desired consistency. Step 9: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, red chile, garlic, light soy sauce, rice vinegar, fresh sweet basil leaves, sesame oil, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise and then, with the knife at an angle, cut each half into slanted, almost semicircular slices about 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: Heat the wok over a high flame until smoke rises, then add the oil and swirl around. Step 3: Add the cucumber and fry for a few minutes until the slices are tinged a little golden. Step 4: Spread the slices out so they cover as much as possible of the bottom of the wok, turning from time to time. Step 5: Add the chili and garlic to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant, adding the soy sauce as you go Splash the vinegar around the side of the wok and mix well. Step 6: Add the herbs and stir a few times. Step 7: Then, off the heat, stir in the sesame oil and serve.

Dish Name: Pan Fried Tofu With Spicy Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, cornstarch, salt and pepper, oil, peanut butter, skim milk, garlic powder, soy sauce, chili sauce, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Drain tofu. Step 2: Cut into bite-sized cubes. Step 3: Toss with cornstarch, coating the cubes. Step 4: Sprinkle a little salt and pepper, heat some oil. Step 5: Fry the tofu cubes in batches, making sure all sides are lightly browned. Step 6: Drain on paper towels, then sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired Sauce: heat the milk in small saucepan. Step 7: Add peanut butter, stirring well. Step 8: Add other seasonings, according to personal taste.

Ingredient Names: dark sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger, vegetable broth, chunky peanut butter, hoisin sauce, honey, soy sauce, scallions, rice vinegar, hot chinese chili paste, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet on medium high heat, heat the oil. Step 2: Add the ginger and garlic, and saute for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in the broth, peanut butter, hoisin sauce, honey, soy sauce, scallion, vinegar, and chili paste. Step 4: Bring the sauce to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Whisk in the dissolved cornstarch, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens slightly The sauce can be made ahead and kept refrigerated for up to 1 week Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: pasta, broccoli florets, peanut butter, vegetable stock, soy sauce, rice vinegar, safflower oil, garlic clove, dry red pepper, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large pot of water to boil. Step 2: Cook pasta until al dente While pasta is cooking, steam broccoli florets. Step 3: In a med mixing bowl, whisk together peanut butter and stock or water until smooth. Step 4: Stir in remaining dressing ingredients. Step 5: When pasta is done, drain well. Step 6: Pour sauce over pasta, toss to coat well. Step 7: Add broccoli and tomatoes, toss again.

Dish Name: Peanut Noodles With Gingered Vegetables And Tofu
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh ginger, broccoli, carrot, celery, green onions, zucchini, crookneck yellow squash, red bell pepper, dry sherry, firm tofu, spaghetti, roasted peanuts, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add ginger and stir 30 seconds. Step 3: Add broccoli, carrot and celery and saute 5 minutes. Step 4: Add white parts of green onions, zucchini, yellow squash, bell pepper and sherry and saute until vegetables are crisp-tender, about 3 minutes longer. Step 5: Add tofu and stir gently until heated through, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Season to taste with salt and pepper Chinese peanut sauce: mix peanut butter, soy sauce and garlic in medium bowl. Step 7: Whisk in 1 / 2 cup hot water. Step 8: Add remaining ingredients, whisk to blend.

Ingredient Names: fresh peas, water, zucchini, red peppers, butter, salt, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, simmer peas in water until crisp tender, drain. Step 2: Add zucchini, red pepper, butter, and salt. Step 3: Stir fry until zucchini is also crisp tender. Step 4: Sprinkle with parsley.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, tofu, onion, red bell pepper, sliced mushrooms, broccoli florets, carrot, sugar snap pea, coconut milk, soy sauce, curry powder, brown sugar, rice vinegar, cornstarch, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the tofu, cube and fry in 1 tbsp canola oil until brown. Step 2: Set aside (see this thread: i recommend freezing the tofu first to firm up the texture Separately blanch or steam the broccoli, carrots and sugar snap peas until tender-crisp in plain boiling water. Step 3: Heat a wok or wide skillet over high heat until hot. Step 4: Add 1 tbsp canola oil, swirl to glaze the pan, then add the onions and bell pepper. Step 5: Stir-fry until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add the mushrooms and stir until hot, a few minutes more. Step 7: Add the blanched vegetables and and tofu, toss to mix.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, white sugar, sea salt, white vinegar, malt vinegar, fish sauce, of fresh mint, scallion, red chile, roasted sesame seeds, szechwan pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the cucumbers in half lengthwise, then slice into 1 / 8" slices on the bias. Step 2: Add 3 tsp sugar and 3 tsp salt, mix well, and let stand 30 minutes. Step 3: Combine 1 / 4 cup sugar and vinegar in a small saucepan. Step 4: Heat until sugar dissolves, then simmer until reduced to 1 / 4 cup, about 2 minutes, set aside to cool. Step 5: Squeeze the excess liquid out of the cucumbers and put into a bowl. Step 6: Add the slightly cooled syrup, and remaining ingredients except szechwan pepper and salt. Step 7: Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with szechwan pepper and salt. Step 8: Serve the same day.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic clove, gingerroot, unsweetened pineapple chunks, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, brown sugar, rice wine vinegar, ketchup, light soy sauce, seitan, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger. Step 2: When onion begins to get translucent, add pineapple, peppers, sugar, vinegar, ketchup, and soy sauce. Step 3: When this comes to a boil, add the seitan and the dissolved cornstarch. Step 4: Cook over high heat until the sauce thickens and the seitan is heated through. Step 5: Serve over brown rice.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, boneless skinless chicken, curry powder, tahini paste, spring onion, coleslaw mix, green peppers, oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta and drain, set aside. Step 2: Cut spring onions into 1 inch pieces While pasta is boiling, brown meat in pan if starting from scratch with 1 tbsp of the oil If using leftovers, quick fry the coleslaw mix and the veggies in the oil. Step 3: Add the curry and the tahini paste. Step 4: Heat up the meat at this point. Step 5: Stir in the pasta, and the remaining oil to help coat the noodles in curry. Step 6: Add the dash of soy sauce.

Ingredient Names: carrots, green pepper, sweet onion, cabbage, zucchini, pea pods, canola oil, soy sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat canola oil in wok to high heat. Step 2: Add all prepared veggies and stir every minute for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add soy sauce and stiry-fry one minute more. Step 4: Remove from heat and drizzle sesame oil on top. Step 5: Serve with alone or with steamed rice Alternatively you could add cooked chicken, beef, or tofu for more protein.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, dried thai chiles, potatoes, scallion, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok or heavy skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add oil and swirl to coat bottom of pan. Step 3: Add chiles and cook, stirring, until they begin to puff up, about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add potatoes and stir-fry for about 3 minutes, pressing them against the pan to brown them. Step 5: Add scallions and salt and stir-fry another 2 minutes I prefer to remove the chiles before serving. Step 6: Serve hot, cold or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: water, seasoning, salt, egg whites, milk, green onion, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add 3 cups water to a pot, and 3 teaspoons of broth seasoning. Step 2: Add salt and pepper in the broth. Step 3: Set heat on high Crack two eggs, and pour into your hand over a bowl. Step 4: Let the egg white drop into bowl The yolk should be in your hand not busted. Step 5: Repeat with another egg. Step 6: Once done add 3 tablespoons of milk in egg whites, stir together. Step 7: Once the broth starts to boil, add your egg whites in, dump the whole bowl in, immediately stirring with a fork constantly until whites form shreds.

Dish Name: Really Quick Authentic Chinese Egg And Tomato Stir Fry That Actually Tastes Good
Ingredient Names: eggs, tomatoes, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Take a pan and put it on medium high heat to dry water off of it, if there is any If not, let the pan heat up a bit and put some oil in the pan so there is just enough to cover the bottom of the pan Wait about 3-4 minutes, put the chopped green onions in the hot oil and stir fry just until its aroma permeates the air Quickly pour the eggs into the pan in a circle, so that it is spread out in the pan. Step 2: Allow the eggs to cook for 1-2 minute and then stir fry until the eggs are well done Try to cut the eggs into small pieces with the spatula as you stir fry. Step 3: Put the tomatoes in the pan and stir fry for 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Put a few dashes of salt into the pan and stir fry again until the juice comes out of the tomatoes. Step 5: Taste a small piece of egg to see if it is salty enough If not add more salt.

Dish Name: Red Cabbage Touched With Asian Flavors
Ingredient Names: olive oil, red cabbage, minced garlic cloves, red pepper, onion, sesame oil, soy sauce, fresh ginger, mirin, sesame seeds, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil add cabbage garlic, pepper, onion, stir fry 5 minutes Add rest of ingredients and cook a couple more minutes Garnish with seeds and acallions.

Ingredient Names: white rice, water, salt, eggs, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine rice, water and salt in a saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Step 3: Let simmer for anywhere from 30-45 minutes, stirring occasionally to keep the rice from sticking to the bottom. Step 4: When the consistency is to your liking, crack the two eggs into a cup and whisk well to combine whites and yolks Slowly pour a thin stream of egg into the rice. Step 5: Stir the rice quickly for a well-combined, custard-like porridge or slowly for thin ribbons of cooked egg, like an egg drop soup. Step 6: Simmer another minute or two until the egg is cooked thoroughly, drizzle soy sauce and / or sesame oil on top then serve.

Dish Name: Sa Cha Tofu With Broccoli And Cauliflower
Ingredient Names: barbecue sauce, soy sauce, chinese rice wine, sugar, salt, broccoli floret, cauliflower floret, garlic, water, firm tofu
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the sa cha sauce with soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, and salt. Step 2: Stir until sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Heat a wok over high heat until hot. Step 4: Add the broccoli, cauliflower, garlic, and water. Step 5: Cover the wok and steam until vegetables are tender, about 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add the tofu and sauce. Step 7: Cook for 1-2 minutes until the tofu is heated through. Step 8: Serve with jasmine or plain white rice.

Ingredient Names: sago, sugar, butter, milk, coconut milk, cornflour, custard powder, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Soak sago well in water for a few hours. Step 2: Pour sago into a pan of boiling water and simmer until transparent. Step 3: Wash under running tap. Step 4: Drain and set aside. Step 5: Put 1 litre water and sugar in a saucepan Slowly bring to boil and add butter, milk and sago, stirring until well blended. Step 6: Mix coconut milk with cornflour and custard powder Gradually stir into boiling sugar mixture Continue stirring until thickened, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, scallion, bean sprouts, spinach, fresh mushrooms, firm tofu, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, water, sesame oil, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: - in a cup, combine the mixture of water, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil, set aside - in a wok, heat canola oil and add the garlic and the scallions - add the mushrooms and 1 / 2 portion of the mixture and simmer for 3 minutes or until mushrooms are already cooked and tender - stir-fry the vegetables and put the remaining mixture - add the tofu and simmer for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: green cabbage, vegetable oil, sesame oil, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok. Step 2: When shimmering, add cabbage and saut until crisp-tender, about 8 minutes In the last minute of cooking, add sugar, sesame oil and salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: flour, water, vegetable oil, salt, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Put flour on a board. Step 2: Make a well in the center and add the water. Step 3: Mix into a soft, smooth dough and divide into 2 portions. Step 4: Roll each portion very thin. Step 5: Brush each with 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 6: Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt. Step 7: Spread half the scallions evenly on each sheet. Step 8: Roll each portion up like a jelly roll Coil it up so it's lying flat on the board in a spiral Flatten with a rolling pin until it is 7-inches in diameter.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sesame seeds, brown sugar, boiling water, glutinous-rice flour, bean paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or deep-sided, heavy saucepan, pre-heat the oil for deep-frying to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Make sure that there is at least 3 inches of oil in the wok.
