Step 3: Spread the sesame seeds over a piece of wax or parchment paper. Step 4: Place a small bowl of water beside the sesame seeds Dissolve the brown sugar in 1 cup of the boiling water. Step 5: Place the rice flour in a large bowl. Step 6: Make a "well" in the middle of the bowl and add the dissolved sugar and water mixture. Step 7: Stir until you have a sticky, caramel-colored dough, adding as much of the remaining 1 / 3 cup of boiling water as needed Pinch off a piece of dough roughly the size of an average golf ball Push your thumb into the dough to make an indentation.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, agave nectar, scallion, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and agave Top with scallions and sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh broccoli, inches ginger, sesame seeds, water, soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over high heat and add the peanut oil. Step 2: When it smokes, add the broccoli and toss well. Step 3: Cook until the broccoli starts to colour. Step 4: Add the ginger and sesame seeds and keep cooking for about 20 seconds, then add the remaining ingredients. Step 5: Cover wok and cook on high for only another minute. Step 6: Eat right away, or cold as a salad.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, red onion, canola oil, toasted sesame oil, salt, fresh ground pepper, tahini, reduced sodium soy sauce, pure maple syrup, cider vinegar, sugar snap peas, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Toss tofu, onion, canola oil, sesame oil, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Step 3: Spread on a large baking sheet and roast until the tofu is lightly golden on top and the onions are browning in spots, 15 to 20 minutes. Step 4: Whisk tahini, soy sauce, maple syrup and vinegar in a small dish until combined. Step 5: Remove the tofu from the oven, add snap peas and drizzle with the maple sauce, stir to combine. Step 6: Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Step 7: Return to the oven and continue roasting until the peas are crisp-tender, 8 to 12 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: natural-style peanut butter, sesame oil, light soy sauce, sherry wine, rice vinegar, sugar, red pepper flakes, udon noodles, napa cabbage, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together peanut butter, sesame oil, soy sauce, sherry, vinegar, sugar and red pepper flakes in saucepan In separate pot, cook noodles according to pkg directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, place cabbage in colander over sink Warm sauce over medium-low heat. Step 3: Drain noodles over cabbage in colander to wilt cabbage. Step 4: Transfer noodles and cabbage to serving bowl, add sauce and toss to combine well. Step 5: Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, whole wheat flour, fresh shiitake mushroom, fresh thyme, vegetable stock, soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a 2-quart saucepan. Step 2: Add flour and stir with a wooden spoon until the mixture becomes the consistency of wet sand. Step 3: Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes more. Step 4: Pour in stock and soy sauce. Step 5: Bring to a slow boil and cook 20 to 30 minutes until thickened Adjust seasoning with apple cider vinegar, sea salt and black pepper.

Ingredient Names: asian eggplants, peanut oil, chicken stock, sugar, soy sauce, sichuan pepper, ginger, garlic, cornstarch, apple cider vinegar, scallions, cilantro, chili-bean paste
Instructions: Step 1: This recipe calls for asian eggplants, or Japanese eggplants. Step 2: They are long and thin compared to a European or globe eggplant, and much more tender and delicate. Step 3: If you can't find them you can substitute globe eggplant, but the dish is really best with the asian eggplant. Step 4: *A lot of grocery stores have Asian ingredient aisles now. Step 5: You should be able to find chili-bean paste, a mixture of preserved chilies mixed with mashed soybeans, there or at any Asian market. Step 6: (Do not confuse with black bean paste or chili-garlic paste.) **Sichuan peppercorns are available at some stores and online for quite cheap. Step 7: They aren't spicy like other peppers but rather have a citrusy flavor and induce a tingly, numbing sensation like a carbonated drink. Step 8: Prep eggplant, chili sauce, cornstarch slurry, vinegar and scallions: Begin your mise en place. Step 9: Quarter the eggplant lengthwise and chop into large batons and set aside. Step 10: In a small bowl, mix together the chicken stock, sugar, and soy sauce and set it aside. Step 11: In a second bowl, mix together the chili bean paste, garlic, ginger, and sichuan peppercorns and set it aside. Step 12: In a third bowl, mix together the cornstarch with a tablespoon of water and set it aside. Step 13: Lastly, in a fourth bowl, mix together the scallions and vinegar and set it aside. Step 14: Sauté eggplant: Place the oil in a wok or large sauté pan over medium-high heat until the oil is almost smoking. Step 15: Add the eggplant and sauté, allowing it to sit for a few seconds each time you move it to allow it to brown and blister. Step 16: If the eggplant absorbs all the oil and some pieces don't get any then add a little more oil. Step 17: Add the chili bean paste, garlic, ginger, and sichuan peppercorns and sauté: until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 18: Add the chicken stock mixture: turn the heat to medium-low and simmer for 90 seconds. Step 19: Add the cornstarch mixture: and stir together until the sauce thickens a bit. Step 20: Add the scallions and vinegar: and cook for 15 seconds to diffuse their harsh flavors a bit. Step 21: Garnish with cilantro and serve.

Dish Name: Sichuan Style Stir-Fried Chinese Long Beans
Ingredient Names: chinese long beans, peanut oil, dried chilies, sichuan pepper, salt, sugar, sesame seed oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Chinese long beans can be found in both green and purple varieties. Step 2: Both have similar flavors and textures, and either kind can be used for this recipe. Step 3: If you don't have a wok, use a sturdy, large sauté pan that has at least a two-inch lip.

Dish Name: Silken Tofu with Sesame Soy Sauce
Ingredient Names: silken tofu, soy sauce, chinese sesame sauce, scallions, sesame seed
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the tofu: Drain the tofu and gently remove it from its packaging onto a large plate. Step 2: Carefully slice the tofu into 1/2-inch slabs widthwise. Step 3: With the palm of your hands, gently push the sliced tofu sidewise so that they fan out over the plate. Step 4: Garnish with toppings and serve: Drizzle the soy sauce and sesame sauce on top. Step 5: Then garnish it with scallions and sesame seeds, and serve. Step 6: Tightly cover leftovers and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Step 7: You can enjoy it cold straight out of the fridge or you can reheat it by microwaving in 30-second increments until warmed through.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, salt, peanut oil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Step 2: Cut off and discard cauliflower leaves and cut out the core; cut the cauliflower into florets. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon of salt to boiling water; bring back to a boil and add the cauliflower; stir gently as water comes back to a boil, boil for about 1 minute, or till cauliflower is tender but still firm; drain and set aside. Step 4: Heat a large wok over high heat; add the oil and swirl to coat; add the garlic and stir-fry until it starts to turn golden, 15-20 seconds; add the cauliflower and stir-fry for 30 seconds to 1 minute; press it against the side of the wok to sear it but don't mash it. Step 5: Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt, stir-fry briefly and serve.

Ingredient Names: sugar, dry sherry, reduced sodium soy sauce, water, white wine vinegar, creamy peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything except the peanut butter in a small saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium high heat while stirring constantly. Step 3: Boil 1 minute or until sugar dissolves. Step 4: Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Step 5: Allow sauce to cool to room temperature.

Ingredient Names: tamari, hoisin sauce, mirin, water, peanut oil, garlic clove, fresh ginger, baby bok choy, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine the tamari, hoisin, mirin and water, set aside. Step 2: Spread the oil in the bottom of a 5 5-6 quart slow cooker and turn on high. Step 3: Add the garlic and ginger and arrange the baby bok choy on top. Step 4: Sprinkle with the scallions and pour the tamari mixture over all Change the heat setting to low, cover and cook for four hours, or until the bok choy is tender, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, salt, chilies, garlic, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, chili oil, peanut oil, dried chili pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place the cucumber on a cutting board and whack hard, several times, with the flat of a cleaver blade, so the vegetable splinters and opens up with jagged cracks, then chop it into bite-size pieces, place in a bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and leave about 30 minutes. Step 3: When the time is up, drain off the water in the bowl To make version 1, add the chopped salted chiles, garlic, vinegar, sugar and salt to taste. Step 4: Mix well and leave for a few minutes to let the flavors blend Just before serving, add the sesame oil and chili oil to taste. Step 5: Toss and serve To make version 2, add the garlic and vinegar to the cucumber with more salt to taste, mix well and set aside for a few minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate. Step 6: Heat the oil in a wok over a high flame until smoking.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh ginger, snow peas, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil in a 10- or 12-inch skillet, preferrably non-stick, over high heat A minute later, add the ginger and peas and stir and toss occasionally, until they are lightly browned and their green color is vivid, about 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the soy sauce and transfer to a platter. Step 3: Add the sesame oil to the same pan and heat for about 10 seconds. Step 4: Pour over the snow peas, season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Soba Noodle Salad With Orange Peanut Dressing
Ingredient Names: soba noodles, cucumbers, carrot, red bell pepper, white sesame seeds, tamari, orange juice, rice vinegar, peanut butter, smooth cashew butter, ginger, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Boil soba noodles according to package directions, drain, and rinse with cold water to cool. Step 2: Using a vegetable peeler, stripe cucumber by partially peeling, then cut in half lengthwise and remove seeds with a spoon Next, slice cucumbers 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 3: Make dressing by blending last 7 ingredients together until smooth. Step 4: Toss noodles, with vegetables, soy sauce, dressing and sesame seeds until mixed well. Step 5: Refrigerate a few hours before serving, if possible.

Ingredient Names: hardboiled egg, sunflower oil, onion, red chilies, water, tamarind pulp, maggi seasoning, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Pierce hard boiled eggs 2 or 3 times with a toothpick. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok, and fry eggs until golden, drain. Step 3: Cut eggs in half and place on a serving dish. Step 4: Pour off all of the oil except 1 tablespoons fry the onion and chilies until golden, drain. Step 5: Combine sugar, water, tamarind pulp and liquid seasoning in wok and simmer for 5 min till thickened. Step 6: Spoon onion and chilies over eggs. Step 7: Pour sauce over all, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: soybeans, water, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the soya beans in water overnight. Step 2: Make sure that the water can always totally cover the beans Whirl the beans with water in a blender little by little until a smooth mixture is obtained Filter the mixture with muslin-made bag. Step 3: Pour the mixture into a pot. Step 4: Cook the mixture and add the sugar. Step 5: Remove the foam floating on the surface whenever necessary. Step 6: Take the pot away from heat when it has just boiled You can enjoy the soya milk whether immediately or freeze it.

Ingredient Names: onion, oil, celery, mushroom, soybeans, green onion, soy sauce, vegetable broth, brown sugar, black pepper, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the pan, add oil. Step 2: Saute onion until you can smell the onion. Step 3: Add the celery and mushroom. Step 4: Saute all for about 2 more min. Step 5: Add the soybeans and green onion. Step 6: In a separate bowl, combine the soy sauce, broth, brown sugar and pepper. Step 7: Pour the yummy sauce over the frying pan. Step 8: Cook until the veggies are tender. Step 9: Serve over lo-mein or rice.

Dish Name: Spicy Gai Lan And Bean Curd Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, ginger, dark sesame oil, low sodium soy sauce, gai lan, red chile, low-fat extra-firm silken tofu, scallions, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth, ginger, sesame oil, and soy sauce to a boil in a large sauce pan. Step 2: Add sliced gai lan and chopped chillies, return to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 4-6 minutes until crisp-tender Gently add tofu and chopped scallions to soup, stirring without breaking tofu. Step 3: Cook 2-3 minutes on low heat or until soup is heated though. Step 4: Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, soy sauce, rice wine, balsamic vinegar, cornstarch, sugar, garlic, minced ginger, red pepper flakes, canola oil, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, firm tofu, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine first six ingredients. Step 2: In a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat, cook garlic, ginger and red pepper flakes in hot oil about 10 seconds. Step 3: Add bell peppers and stir-fry 1 minute, or until peppers begin to soften. Step 4: Add tofu and broth mixture. Step 5: Stir-fry 15 seconds. Step 6: Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 2 minutes, or until tofu is heated through and sauce has thickened slightly. Step 7: Add salt and stir-fry 30 seconds. Step 8: Sprinkle with peanuts if desired, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: udon noodles, water, fresh ginger, garlic, green onion, fresh shiitake mushrooms, vegetable broth, soy sauce, sambal oelek, lite silken extra firm tofu, bok choy, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Add the noodles and cook until tender 8 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: Meanwhile, place the 1 / 3 cup water, ginger and garlic in a large soup pot. Step 5: Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the onions and mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the broth, soy sauce, and chili paste. Step 8: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 9: Add the tofu and bok choy and cook for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: linguine, creamy peanut butter, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, chili paste, sugar, red bell pepper, cucumber, green onions, cilantro, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine according to package. Step 2: Meanwhile, combine peanut butter, 1 / 4 cup water, soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste and sugar in large bowl. Step 3: Whisk until blended. Step 4: Add linguine, bell pepper, cucumber and green onions and toss well. Step 5: Sprinkle with cilantro. Step 6: Serve with lime wedges if desired.

Ingredient Names: tom yam broth cubes, vinegar, water, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve cubes in water, then add vinegar, sugar and pepper Add vegetables, put in jar for at least one day.

Ingredient Names: seitan, water, red chilies, chili peppers, soy sauce, garlic and red chile paste, rice wine vinegar, sherry wine, cider vinegar, honey, seasoning, ginger, cayenne, garlic, hot chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the diced chilies, soy sauce, chili garlic paste, vinegars, and honey until well blended. Step 2: Add the szechuan seasoning, ginger, cayenne, and garlic, stir to mix. Step 3: Add the oils, mix, and then water down to desired spiciness. Step 4: Marinate the seitan / chicken / tofu for at least 2 hours, preferably 4-6 Shake or turn occasionally to ensure even flavor distribution. Step 5: Heat the oil in your wok. Step 6: Add scallions, garlic, and chilies and stirfry to season, 1-2 minute. Step 7: Turn on the fan above your stove Trust me.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic, gingerroot, asian chili sauce, hoisin sauce, fresh lime juice, water, salt, noodles, scallion, roasted unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients in blender until smooth. Step 2: Transfer to a jar with a tight-fitting lid To use: boil 1 lb asian noodles or spaghetti until al dente. Step 3: Toss with cup of sauce, finely chopped scallions and chopped peanuts In summer i rinse under cold water, cool and drain and serve them as a spicy noodle salad, often adding shredded bok choy, carrots, snowpeas, lots more of the peanut sauce, etc.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, sesame oil, red pepper flakes, fresh ginger, garlic clove, fresh scallions, firm tofu, soy sauce, cabbage kimchi, water, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up the olive oil and sesame oil. Step 2: After it is nice and hot at a high flame, throw in the red pepper flakes, ginger, garlic and scallions Saut them for two minutes. Step 3: Toss in the tofu, saut it for two minutes. Step 4: Pour in the soy sauce and oyster sauce Saut for two more minutes. Step 5: Toss in the pureed kimchi and water. Step 6: Bring it to boil Crack the egg open in the mixture and stir it inches when the egg is cooked, your food is done, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, chili-garlic sauce, minced garlic cloves, sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, rice wine, ginger, low sodium vegetable broth, mushroom, red pepper, green onion, napa cabbage, fresh cilantro, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cube tofu into approximately 1 by 2 inch pieces. Step 2: Set on top of paper towels and press on the top with more paper towels to rid the tofu of excess moisture. Step 3: Mix: chili garlic sauce, minced garlic, 1 t sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, rice wine, ginger, and chicken / veg stock. Step 4: Add tofu into chili sauce mixture. Step 5: Make sure all pieces are in contact with the liquid. Step 6: Let soak for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 7: Put frying pan over med-high heat. Step 8: Once pan has heated, add 1 t sesame oil. Step 9: Put marinated tofu in pan, brown all sides. Step 10: Remove tofu and set aside.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, tofu, cornstarch, green onions, snow peas, mushrooms, fresh carrots, shrimp, poblano pepper, rice vinegar, sweet sour sauce, sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put cornstarch in pie pan. Step 2: Add tofu and coat on all sides. Step 3: Heat 2 TB oil in pan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add tofu and cook until brown (be careful it turns very easily). Step 5: Remove and transfer to bowl. Step 6: Add remaining 2 TB oil to pan. Step 7: Saute vegetables (green onions- pepper) over medium heat until cooked through (10 minutes). Step 8: Add shrimp (if using) and continue cooking 5 minutes or until shrimp is pink. Step 9: Mix vinegar, sweet n' sour sauce and hot sauce in measuring cup. Step 10: Add sauce mixture and tofu to pan and cook 5 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: fresh spinach, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, sea salt, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Put spinach in a salad spinner and dry well. Step 2: Remove stalks if any If using large leaves, roll up tightly and cut crossway in wide strips. Step 3: Heat wok to medium heat. Step 4: Add sesame seeds, and dry fry stirring constantly for 1-2 minutes until golden brown. Step 5: Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Step 6: Add oil to wok and swirl around. Step 7: When hot, add the salt, spinach and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the spinach just wilts a bit and the leaves are coated with oil. Step 8: Sprinkle over dry-heated sesame seeds and serve immediately I love this with some naan bread.

Ingredient Names: fresh spinach, peanut oil, garlic clove, onion, water chestnuts, wonton wrappers, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the spinach thoroughly and trim any tough stems or bad spots on the leaves. Step 2: Drain the spinach and pat dry with a paper towel Coarsely chop the spinach Assemble all of your prepared ingredients beforehand as the cooking is quick. Step 3: Place a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: When the pan or wok gets smoking hot, add the peanut oil with the garlic and onion. Step 5: Stir fry the onion and garlic for 30 seconds, the add the spinach and water chestnuts Continue to cook an additional 3 minutes, allowing the water from the spinach to cook off. Step 6: Transfer the vegetables from the wok or pan to a bowl. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: milk, palm sugar, star anise, cinnamon stick, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Place milk, sugar, star anise and cinnamon in a saucepan over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 2: Strain mixture and place in a bowl. Step 3: Beat eggs lightly and whisk into milk mixture. Step 4: Pour mixture into 6-8 chinese tea cups and place tea cups in a steamer. Step 5: Place steamer over rapidly simmering water for 20 minutes or until custards are just set Affects the texture of the custard. Step 6: Steam would be lost once the lid is opened before they are ready.

Dish Name: Steamed White Seitan Fake Chicken Or Pork
Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, garlic cloves, olive oil, vital wheat gluten, chickpea flour, nutritional yeast, dried thyme, sweet paprika, cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a jug whisk together broth, garlic, olive oil. Step 2: In a large bowl combine wheta gluten, chickpea flour, nutritional yeast, thyme, paprika, cumin, and salt Form a well in centre of dry ingredients and stir well with rubber spatula until dough leaves side of the bowl. Step 3: Knead for 2-3 mins to develop gluten I cheat at this stage and use the kenwood chef to do the kneading on power 1 or 2. Step 4: Leave dough to rest for 10 min, knead again for 30 seconds. Step 5: Place dough on cutting board and cut into 4 equal pieces Tear off 4 x12 inch pieces of foil and place piece of dough in centre of foil, fold the short sides of the foil over the loaf, the fold over the ends the foil should be secure but loose allowing for it to expand. Step 6: Place in steamer basket and steam for 30 minutes allow the dough to cool to the touch before chilling in fridge or overnight. Step 7: Store seitan in the fridge tightly sealed in a plastic bag for up to 2 weeks or freeze, defrost before use.

Ingredient Names: dark soy sauce, cooking wine, clear honey, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, garlic clove, chinese five spice powder, shiitake mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the first seven ingredients together in a large bowl. Step 2: Add the mushrooms and stir well until they are coated in the marinade. Step 3: Cover and leave to marinate in a cool place for at least 1 hour. Step 4: Drain the marinade into a small pan and simmer for 1-2 mins until syrupy. Step 5: Thread the mushrooms on to skewers then cook over hot barbecue coals or griddle or under a hot broiler for about 10 mins, turning frequently and brushing with more of the marinade, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red pepper flakes, chinese cabbage, garlic, rice wine, soy sauce, sesame oil, gingerroot, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together rice wine, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger root in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add red pepper flakes and minced garlic, and stir-fry until it becomes aromatic but not scorched. Step 4: Add shredded cabbage and stir-fry until limp, but not mushy. Step 5: Add contents of seasoning bowl and cook, stirring, 1-2 minutes more, until liquid is almost absorbed. Step 6: Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh green beans, garlic, fresh gingerroot, kosher salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, black bean sauce, white sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large wok, heat oil with red pepper flakes over medium-high heat. Step 2: Stir in green beans. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in garlic and ginger. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper, and then stir in black bean sauce. Step 7: Cover and continue cooking until green beans are tender, about 10 minutes. Step 8: Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Potato With Black Vinegar
Ingredient Names: potatoes, peanut oil, black vinegar, light soy sauce, sea salt, chili flakes, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to the boil. Step 2: Cut potatoes into 5mm thick slices, then finely julienne. Step 3: Add the potato to the boiling water and cook for 1 minute, using a pair of long chopsticks to separate the pieces. Step 4: Drain well and lay out to dry for a few hours on a clean tea towel. Step 5: Heat a wok over high heat and add the oil, swirling to coat the wok. Step 6: Add the potato and stir fry for 6 minutes, or until golden brown. Step 7: Add the vinegar and soy sauce and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the sea salt. Step 8: Stir fry for 2-3 minutes or until the potato slices have darkened and all liquid has evaporated. Step 9: Sprinkle the remaining salt over the top and garnish with coriander and chilli flakes.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Spiced Cabbage La Pai Ts Ai
Ingredient Names: chinese cabbage, sugar, white vinegar, soy sauce, salt, cayenne pepper, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: With a sharp knife, trim the top leaves of the cabbage and wash them. Step 2: Cut the cabbage into 1 by 2 inch pieces. Step 3: In a small bowl, combine the sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, salt, and cayenne pepper and mix thoroughly. Step 4: Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat for about 30 seconds. Step 5: Pour in the oil, swirl it in the pan, and heat for about another 30 seconds. Step 6: Turn the heat down to moderate, add the cabbage, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Make sure all the cabbage is coated with the oil. Step 8: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the soy-vinegar mixture. Step 9: Transfer the cabbage to a serving platter and let cool to lukewarm before serving May be served chilled, if you prefer.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Tofu With Mushrooms Sugar Snap Peas And Green Onion
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, oriental sesame oil, dry crushed red pepper, extra firm tofu, water, cornstarch, vegetable oil, fresh shiitake mushrooms, sugar snap peas, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk first 5 ingredients in medium bowl to blend. Step 2: Add tofu and stir to coat. Step 3: Let marinate 30 minutes. Step 4: Drain, reserving marinade in small bowl. Step 5: Whisk 1 / 4 cup water and cornstarch into marinade. Step 6: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add tofu and saut until golden, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Using slotted spoon, transfer tofu to plate. Step 9: Add remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil to skillet. Step 10: Add mushrooms and stir-fry until tender, about 3 minutes.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Vegetables Cabbage Chinese Mushrooms And Broccoli
Ingredient Names: dried chinese mushrooms, broccoli florets, napa cabbage, jicama, bamboo shoots, peanut oil, fresh ginger, water, sesame oil, rice wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix together the sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 2: Soak the mushrooms in hot water until they soften. Step 3: Rinse under cold running water to remove any sand and squeeze out excess water to drain With a sharp knife, remove the stems & discard Finely shred the caps. Step 4: Set aside Blanch broccoli in boiling water and drain. Step 5: Chop cabbage into long shreds, about 1 / 4-inch wide. Step 6: Preheat wok or large skillet over high heat until it is hot. Step 7: Add oil, wait until the oil gets very hot, almost smoking.

Dish Name: Stir Fry Snow Peas Water Chestnuts
Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, snow peas, sesame oil, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the broth to a boil in a wok or skillet. Step 2: Toss in the peas cover and cook for 1-2 minutes, shake the pan a couple of times The peas should be crisp and bright green. Step 3: Add sesame oil and water chestnuts, continue to cook for 2 more minutes. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Super Easy Chinese Style Stir Fried Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, ginger, garlic, fresh shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, green onion, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or stir-fry pan. Step 2: Add ginger, and garlic. Step 3: Cook, stirring Constantly, just until fragrant. Step 4: Toss in sliced mushrooms and cook several minutes or until mushrooms soften and start to brown. Step 5: Drizzle in the soy sauce and seasme oil, stirring until most of liquid evaporates off. Step 6: Remove from heat and garnish with sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, mixed vegetables, hoisin sauce, vegetable broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Add angel hair pasta and mixed veggies to pot Continue to cook for 5 minutes While the pasta is cooking, prepare the sauce. Step 3: Combine the hoisin sauce, broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, and ginger in a small bowl. Step 4: When pasta is done, drain well. Step 5: Transfer back into the pot, or into a serving dish. Step 6: Combine with the sauce mixture, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, sesame oil, low sodium soy sauce, garlic clove, fresh ginger, crushed red pepper flakes, firm tofu, mushrooms, orange bell pepper, lettuce leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, oil, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and red pepper, blend well. Step 2: Place tofu, mushrooms and bell pepper in a bowl. Step 3: Add the marinade you made in. Step 4: Stir gently to coat veges well. Step 5: Chill at least 1 hour, but use within 3 days To serve, placed lettuce leaves on chilled serving plates. Step 6: Top them evenly with salad. Step 7: Garnish with fresh cilantro.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Sauce For Dipping Egg Rolls And More
Ingredient Names: pineapple preserves, vinegar, pineapple juice, soy sauce, ketchup, cornstarch, mild paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Place pineapple preserves in a small saucepan. Step 2: Whisk together the remaining ingredients and stir in. Step 3: Heat over low heat, stirring, until preserves melt and mixture thickens slightly and is well blended. Step 4: Remove from heat and cool before using.

Ingredient Names: tofu, pineapple chunks, brown sugar, cornstarch, vinegar, soy sauce, onion, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Drain tofu in a colander, then weigh down tofu with something heavy. Step 2: Let it sit in the sink while preparing the sauce. Step 3: Combine brown sugar, cornstarch, vinegar, soy sauce and juice from the pineapple in a saucepan. Step 4: Bring to a boil until thick and clear. Step 5: Slice tofu into cubes and add to sauce. Step 6: Marinate while rice cooks or 1 hour. Step 7: Slice onion and pepper into thin strips. Step 8: Combine with tofu and sauce and pineapple chunks. Step 9: Heat until vegetables soften, then serve over rice or chinese noodles.

Dish Name: Sweet Chili Glazed Tofu With Bok Choy
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, fresh ginger, cornstarch, vegetable oil, bok choy, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu planks into 2 x 1 inch pieces. Step 2: Arrange on paper towel lined plate. Step 3: Let drain 15 minutes. Step 4: Whisk together chili sauce, soy sauce, ginger and 1 / 2 t Cornstarch in bowl. Step 5: Heat 1 t Oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking. Step 6: Add bok choy stems and cook until just tender, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add greens and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Drain in colander.

Ingredient Names: mung beans, coconut milk powder, water, white sugar, pandan leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the beans, drain. Step 2: Put beans in saucepan with lid, cover with water. Step 3: Cover with lid, simmer for about 15 minutes over low heat. Step 4: Add pandan leaves, continue to simmer for another 15 minutes. Step 5: After the beans are very soft and some are split, turn off heat and remove leaves add sugar Just before serving, add the coconut milk, serve hot.

Dish Name: Sweet N Sour Sauce For Meatballs And Wings
Ingredient Names: brown sugar, cornstarch, pineapple chunks in juice, vinegar, soy sauce, green pepper, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sugar and starch Add all ingredients in a medium saucepan except the peppers Heat slowly to a boil, stirring often Add peppers Simmer 3-5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dried lentils, vegetable stock, apple cider, apple cider vinegar, sugar, molasses, ground cloves, bay leaves, scallion, cayenne, fresh ginger, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the lentils in 3 cups of stock or water. Step 2: In a small saucepan combine the stock, cider, vinegar, sugar and molasses. Step 3: Add in the cloves, bay leaves, scallions, cayenne and ginger. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil, boil 2 minutes. Step 5: Combine with cooked lentils and their liquid. Step 6: Add the salt and cook until hot and bubbling You may serve with basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: onion, apple cider vinegar, sugar, catsup, salt, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the onions. Step 2: Put sliced onions into large non-reactive saucepan over moderately-high flame. Step 3: Add vinegar, sugar, catsup, salt and the water. Step 4: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce to a low flame and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 6: Combine cornstarch with an additional 1 / 4 cup water. Step 7: Mix well and stir into saucepan, heat and. Step 8: Stir until thickened remove from heat and serve.

Ingredient Names: water, carrots, sliced mushrooms, onion, water chestnuts, green bell pepper, cornstarch, unsweetened pineapple juice, minced garlic clove, ketchup, low sodium soy sauce, unsweetened pineapple chunks, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, bring 1 / 4 cup water to a boil on high heat. Step 2: Add the carrots, mushrooms, water chestnuts, onion, and bell pepper. Step 3: Cover and cook on high for 1 minute. Step 4: Remove the cover and cook vegetables until tender If pot goes dry, you may add 1 ttbs water in at a time. Step 5: Set aside and keep warm In small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in pineapple juice In small saucepan, over low heat, combine the garlic and water, bring to boil. Step 6: Stir in the ketchup, pineapple juice, soy sauce and vinegar.

Dish Name: Swiss Chard Stir Fried With Feta Cheese
Ingredient Names: pine nuts, peanut oil, shallots, red swiss chard, feta cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok heat the oil, add shallots. Step 2: Stir fry 1 minute or until just beginning to brown. Step 3: Add swiss chard, toss and cover, cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Remove cover and cook about another minute If there is any liqiud drain it off. Step 5: Stir in the feta cheese, cook 30 seconds or until it starts to melt. Step 6: Add pine nuts and season. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: black-eyed peas, green bell pepper, red onion, jalapeno pepper, garlic clove, avocado, lemon juice, olive oil, red wine vinegar, szechuan sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Toss together black-eyed peas, bell pepper, onion, jalapeno pepper, and garlic in large bowl. Step 2: Toss avocado with lemon juice in a separate bowl. Step 3: Then add the avocado to the black-eyed pea mixture. Step 4: Whisk together oil, vinegar, szechuan sauce, and sugar in bowl used for avocado. Step 5: Toss black-eyed pea mixture with szechuan sauce dressing.

Ingredient Names: baby bok choy, peanut oil, gingerroot, red chili paste, hoisin sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok, stir-fry bok choy in oil for 3 minutes Add ginger and 1 / 4 tsp of salt Stir-fry 2 minutes more Add paste and hoisin sauce Stir-fry 1 minute more.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, rice vinegar, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, sesame oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place cucumber slices in medium serving bowl, set aside. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine rice vinegar, sugar, red pepper flakes, salt and sesame oil, mix well. Step 3: Pour dressing over cucumber slices and toss well. Step 4: Cover and let rest at room temperature up to 4 hours, drain cucumbers. Step 5: Garnish with cilantro, if desired, before serving.

Ingredient Names: soba noodles, sesame oil, cooking oil, green beans, garlic cloves, chili flakes, soy sauce, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pan with water and bring to the boil. Step 2: Add the soba noodles and cook for 5 minutes drain the noodles, refresh in cold water and set aside. Step 3: Heat up a dry wok and add the sesame seeds, gently swirl them until they become golden and aromatic. Step 4: Remove the seeds and set aside In the same pan heat the oils over a medium high heat Trim the ends from the green beans and cut into bite size pieces. Step 5: Add the beans to the pan and saut for 3 mins, turn the heat down and cook for a further 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the garlic and desired amount of chilli flakes and cook for a further 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the noodles to the pan and toss to coat. Step 8: Pour on the soy sauce and serve sprinkled with the sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: oil, long beans, soy sauce, hot red chili peppers, ginger, shaoxing wine, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok on high. Step 2: Add oil, until hot. Step 3: Add long beans in batches and stir fry until softened, set aside. Step 4: Drain all but 2 tbsp oil in wok. Step 5: Add all ingredients until sauce thickens. Step 6: Add long beans and serve.

Dish Name: Szechuan Style Eggplant And Tofu In Chili Bean Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic clove, fresh ginger, eggplant, water, chili bean sauce, light soy sauce, tofu, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok with the oil over a high heat. Step 2: Stir-fry the garlic and ginger for about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the eggplant to the wok and continue frying for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Pour over 500ml of water, followed by the chilli bean sauce, soy sauce and tofu. Step 5: Simmer for another 1-2 minutes, garnish with spring onions and serve immediately with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: water, jasmine rice, hoisin sauce, sherry wine, honey, crushed red pepper flakes, dark sesame oil, scallion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red bell pepper, carrots, snow peas, baby corn, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: In medium covered saucepan, bring water to a boil. Step 2: Add rice, reduce heat and simmer until all of water is absorbed and rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, in small bowl, stir together hoisin sauce, sherry, honey, red pepper flakes, and 1 / 2 cup water. Step 4: Set aside In large nonstick skillet, heat sesame oil over medium heat. Step 5: Add scallions, garlic and ginger, and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Stir in bell pepper and carrots, and saute until vegetables are crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Add snow peas, baby corn and water chestnuts, and cook, stirring frequently, until snow peas are crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Add hoisin mixture and tofu, bring to a boil and cook until tofu is hot, about 1 minute. Step 9: Stir in cornstarch mixture, bring to a boil and boil until sauce is lightly thickened, about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, cilantro, unsalted creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, granulated sugar, rice wine vinegar, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mince garlic and cilantro in food processor, scraping until fine. Step 2: Put in stainless bowl mix in remainder of ingredients. Step 3: Let sit for 1 hour at room temperature tightly covered.

Dish Name: The Raffles Hotel Original Singapore Gin Sling Cocktail
Ingredient Names: gin, cherry heering, cointreau liqueur, benedictine, pineapple juice, lime juice, grenadine, bitters
Instructions: Step 1: Shake with ice. Step 2: Strain into an ice filled collins glass. Step 3: Garnish with cherry and slice of pineapple Singapore sling The singapore sling was created at raffles hotel at the turn-of-the-century by hainanese-chinese bartender, mr Ngiam tong boon In the hotel's museum, visitors may view the safe in which mr Ngiam locked away his precious recipe books, as well as the sling recipe hastily jotted on a bar-chit in 1936 by a visitor to the hotel who asked the waiter for it Originally, the singapore sling was meant as a woman's drink, hence the attractive pink colour Today, it is very definately a drink enjoyed by all, without which any visit to raffles hotel is incomplete.

Dish Name: Tibetan Cabbage Stir Fry Logo Petse
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, paprika, garlic cloves, ginger, tomatoes, carrots, cabbage, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare all the veggies for a stir-fry, cut carrots and bell peppers into juilienne strips, about 1 / 8 inch thick. Step 2: Cut cabbage into 1 / 4 inch slices. Step 3: In a wok, fry the onion over high heat with the paprika, garlic, and ginger until browning begins. Step 4: Stir in the tomato and stir-fry briefly. Step 5: Add carrots and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Place the cabbage slices on top of the mixture without stirring. Step 7: Cover tightly and continue cooking for one minute only. Step 8: Stir in the bell pepper slices, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: onion, oil, tomatoes, jalapeno, blue cheese, paprika, garlic, fresh ginger, ground sichuan pepper, water, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in oil until brown and soft. Step 2: Add the paprika, garlic and ginger and fry briefly. Step 3: Add the chili, stir, then turn the heat down and add the cheese. Step 4: When the cheese has melted, add the tomato and water. Step 5: Mix the cornstarch in a 1 / 4 cup of water and pour into the soup while stirring. Step 6: Bring to the boil while stirring. Step 7: Remove from the heat as soon as the soup had thickened. Step 8: Serve with bread or tsampa.

Dish Name: Tibetan Green Beans With Potatoes Tema
Ingredient Names: green beans, potatoes, red bell pepper, onion, oil, garlic cloves, paprika, fresh ginger, jalapeno pepper, tomatoes, soy sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the green beans diagonally into 1 1 / 2-inch pieces. Step 2: Cut the potatoes like french fries, about the same size as the beans. Step 3: Slice the red bell pepper very thinly. Step 4: In a wok or skillet, saute the onion in oil over high heat until softened, add the garlic, paprika and ginger and saute a few minutes more. Step 5: Add the potatoes, jalapeno and tomato, and stir-fry until the tomato cooks dry. Step 6: Add the green beans and stir-fry until just tender, about 8 minutes. Step 7: Add the soy sauce, red-pepper and salt stirring in quickly.

Dish Name: Tibetan Greens With Tofu Tse Tofu
Ingredient Names: swiss chard, green onions, paprika, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, firm tofu, green peas, oil, garlic clove, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the swiss chard and tear it into pieces, removing the stems. Step 2: Heat a little oil in a frying pan, and stir-fry the green onions, along with the paprika, ginger, and 2 cloves of garlic. Step 3: Stir in the soy sauce, tofu, and peas. Step 4: In a separate frying pan, heat a tablespoon of oil until it's very hot. Step 5: Stir in the black pepper. Step 6: Add the swiss chard, still slightly wet, and toss to coat with the oil and pepper. Step 7: Cover the pan and let it steam for 30 seconds. Step 8: Spread the greens on a serving platter and pour the tofu mixture on top.

Ingredient Names: dried lentils, water, vegetable oil, onions, garlic, chili pepper, carrot, potato, ground coriander, canned tomatoes, fresh cilantro, salt, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the lentils and water to a boil, then reduce the hear, cover and simmer until tender- about 20 minutes meanwhile, heat oil and saute the onions, garlic and chile for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the carrots, potatoes, coriander and cumin and saute for another minute, stirring to prevent sticking. Step 3: Remove from the heat and set aside when lentils are tender, coarsely chop the tomatoes right in the can and stir them into the soup pot. Step 4: Add the chopped cilantro, salt, and sauteed vegetables. Step 5: Cover and simmer for about 10-15 minutes, until all of the vegetables are tender.

Ingredient Names: red potatoes, bean thread noodles, dried wood ear mushrooms, onion, tomatoes, vegetable oil, paprika, turmeric, ginger, garlic, green peas, red bell pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cover the noodles in very hot water and allow to sit for 20 minutes, or until soft In another bowl, pour boiling water over the wood ears and allow them to sit for 20 minutes also. Step 2: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes, then drain. Step 3: When able to handle, slice the potatoes like fries At the end of twenty minutes, drain the wood ears and cut into thin slices. Step 4: Saute the onion with the oil in a large pan until it is tender. Step 5: Add the tomato, ginger, garlic, paprika, and turmeric, stirring to mix. Step 6: Add the potatoes and stir to coat them with the spices. Step 7: Then add the peas, sliced wood ears, bell pepper, and water. Step 8: Cook, stirring, until the potatoes are fork-tender, adding small amounts of water if needed.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, fenugreek seeds, oil, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, coriander, cumin, curry powder, turmeric, tomatoes, dried hot pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Precook the potatoes in water until almost, but not quite, done. Step 2: Drain thoroughly While the potatoes are cooking, saute the fenugreek seed in the oil on medium heat until light brown, being careful not to burn them. Step 3: Add the onion and continue cooking for five minutes. Step 4: Add the ginger and garlic and cook another five minutes. Step 5: Add the spices and saute briefly to release their flavors. Step 6: Add the tomato, the dried whole peppers, and a little water. Step 7: Simmer until the flavors meld together, about 30 minutes Gently add the potatoes, stir, and reduce heat. Step 8: Cook until potatoes are tender, adding water if the sauce gets too dry.

Dish Name: Tofu And Bok Choy Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: low sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, oriental sesame oil, cornstarch, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, dry crushed red pepper, bok choy, green onions, extra firm tofu
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl, mix well. Step 2: Heat vegetable oil until very hot in heavy large wok or skillet over high heat. Step 3: Add garlic, ginger and crushed red pepper. Step 4: Stir-fry until aromatic, about 30 seconds. Step 5: Add bok choy and stir-fry until just wilted, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Mix in water chestnuts and green onions and stir-fry until onions are tender, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add tofu and lightly stir-fry until tofu is just heated through, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Pour over soy mixture. Step 9: Stir-fry until liquid boils and thickens, about 1 minute.

Dish Name: Tofu And Broccoli Stir Fry Martha Stewart
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, broccoli, coarse salt, vegetable oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, cornstarch, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange tofu in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with several layers of paper towels. Step 2: Top with more paper towels and another baking sheet Weight with canned goods. Step 3: Let tofu drain, about 20 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook broccoli in a large pot of boiling salted water until bright green, 2 minutes, drain, set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, add tofu. Step 6: Cook until golden brown, turning gently halfway through, 10 to 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ginger, vegetable oil, tofu, shiitake mushroom, soy sauce, scallions, cornstarch, water, oyster sauce, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: First cover the mushrooms in roughly four cups of boiling water and soak while you're preparing the rest of the ingredients Mince the ginger, slice the tofu into 1 inch cubes, julienne the scallions. Step 2: Mix the thickener in a small bowl. Step 3: Heat a nonstick frying pan or wok on the stove. Step 4: When it's hot add the oil and then the ginger. Step 5: When the ginger starts to turn golden then add the tofu and shitake mushrooms Almost immediately add about a cup of the mushroom soaking liquid and soy sauce. Step 6: Cook for 5 minutes turning once. Step 7: Toss the scallions on top, stir in the thickener and cook until the arrowroot turns clear. Step 8: Serve with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: fresh shiitake mushrooms, celery ribs, leek, water chestnuts, oil, extra firm tofu, soy sauce, black salt, flour, baking powder, green onion, vegetable broth, sugar, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Drain and rinse the tofu, wrap in paper towels and place a heavy weight on top. Step 2: Press for about an hour While the tofu is pressing, chop the vegetables, heat a wok to hot. Step 3: When hot, add the oil and swirl to coat the wok. Step 4: Add the celery and leeks, saut for a few minutes, add the mushrooms and water chestnuts and cook for another minute or so. Step 5: Place in a bowl and set aside. Step 6: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Crumble the tofu, add the rest of the ingredients and blend well together Scoop out a 1 / 4 cup of the mixture and shape into a patty on a oiled baking sheet.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, peanut oil, garlic clove, sweet onion, baby bok choy, fresh shiitake mushrooms, carrot, dark soy sauce, sugar, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large non-stick skillet, heat peanut oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cut onion in half and place onion cut-side down on cutting board. Step 3: Slice 1 / 2-inch thick slices across the short way. Step 4: Then cut once across the slices, creating two rows. Step 5: Put onions into skillet with the grated garlic and saute for approximately 3 minutes. Step 6: Add cubed tofu into pan and saute over high heat, adding oil as needed. Step 7: Turn a few times with spatula until cubes brown slightly. Step 8: Remove the tofu and onions onto a plate. Step 9: Add bok choy and mushrooms to pan, stirring in 2 teaspoons of sugar, adding a little peanut oil if needed, and saute vegetables for 2 to 3 minutes Push vegetables to the sides of the pan and add tofu into the center, sprinkling 2 tablespoons of dark soy sauce over cubes.

Dish Name: Tofu Simmered In Hoisin Sauce By Deborah Madison
Ingredient Names: soft tofu, peanut oil, hoisin sauce, thin soy sauce, rice wine, garlic clove, fresh ground black pepper, water, black sesame seeds, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: If using soft tofu, it is easier to crumble it and heat it up as part of the sauce in If using hard tofu, drain it, wrap it in a towel and press while assembling the ingredients for the sauce. Step 2: Slice it crosswise to a scant 1 / 2 inch thick, then into triangles Blot with paper toweling. Step 3: Heat a nonstick skillet, brush with 2 teaspoons of peanut oil, then add the cut up hard tofu. Step 4: Fry over medium-high heat until golden, then turn, adding another 2 teaspoons of peanut oil, and browning the other side. Step 5: Combine the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, rice wine, garlic, pepper and remaining 1 teaspoon of peanut oil. Step 6: Stir in the water or stock, then pour the mixture over the tofu and shuffle the pan back and forth to distribute it evenly. Step 7: Cook over medium heat until bubbling and slightly reduced, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced scallions.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, fresh broccoli, garlic, red chile, green onions, soya bean, pak choi, marinated tofu, hoisin sauce, reduced-salt soy sauce, cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a non-stick wok. Step 2: Add the broccoli, then fry on a high heat for 5 mins or until just tender, adding a little water if it begins to catch. Step 3: Add the garlic and chilli, fry for 1 min, then toss through the spring onions, soya beans, pak choi and tofu. Step 4: Stir-fry for 2-3 mins. Step 5: Add the hoisin, soy and nuts to warm through.

Dish Name: Vegan Egg Foo Yung Tofu Yung
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, canola oil, tamari, toasted sesame oil, celery rib, water chestnut, green onions, bean sprouts, sliced mushrooms, garlic cloves, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp of the canola oil in a wok or large pan over medium heat Saut the garlic, celery, mushrooms, onions, and water chestnuts until the onions begin to soften. Step 2: Add the bean sprouts last and stir constantly for 2 minutes then remove from heat. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 4: Put the tofu, 2 tbsp of canola oil, sesame oil and tamari in a food processor and blend until smooth Scrape the mixture into a bowl and fold in the vegetables. Step 5: Grease a baking sheet with more canola oil or oil spray and drop large spoonfuls of the tofu mixture onto the pan, as big or small as you want. Step 6: Bake in the oven for at least 25 minutes, or until the tofu browns While the tofu is cooking, make the gravy and rice. Step 7: Remove and let the tofu yung rest for 5 minutes before serving over rice with brown gravy.

Dish Name: Vegan Vegetarian Pf Chang's Mongolian Beef Tofu
Ingredient Names: sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic, low sodium soy sauce, water, dark brown sugar, extra firm tofu, cornstarch, green onions, red bell pepper, mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Remove tofu from water and thoroughly pat with paper towels to dry. Step 2: Slice tofu in half lengthwise, then quarter it by cutting it in half along the narrow sides You will have four rectangles. Step 3: Keep them together, then begin slicing 1 / 4" slices from the narrow end You should end up with lots of pieces that measure just over 1" long and about 3 / 4" wide. Step 4: Put these pieces on a plate, sandwiched between paper towels, and press them dry This should get most of the water out. Step 5: Heat sesame oil in a deep skillet over low / medium heat. Step 6: Add ginger and garlic to the pan and lightly sautee for about 30 seconds Do not scorch the garlic.

Ingredient Names: rice, vegetable broth, light soy sauce, cornstarch, peanut oil, red peppers, frozen edamame, broccoli florets, carrot, gingerroot, cashews, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, prepare rice according to package directions If the cashews are unroasted, preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit, sprinkle cashews on cookie sheet and toast for about 10-12 minutes or until they start to turn brown. Step 2: Meanwhile, rinse edamame under cold water and drain. Step 3: In a cup, stir together the broth, soy sauce and cornstarch. Step 4: Heat the oil in a large wok or deep skillet over high heat. Step 5: Add the red pepper, edamame, asparagus, carrots and ginger and stir fry for 3-4 minutes, or until asparagus is crisp-tender. Step 6: Add the cashews and scallions and stir fry for 2 more minutes. Step 7: Stir the broth mixture to recombine and add to the vegetables. Step 8: Bring to a boil, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring, or until sauce is thickened and bubbly and the mixture is heated through, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, carrots, bell peppers, snow peas, mushrooms, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare a sauce by whisking together soy sauce, a splash of water, sesame oil and a little cornstarch. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add the harder vegetables like carrots and broccoli first, stir-frying for a couple of minutes. Step 3: Add the remaining vegetables along with garlic and ginger, cooking until everything is crisp-tender. Step 4: Pour in the prepared sauce and toss quickly until it thickens and coats the vegetables. Step 5: Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.

Dish Name: Vegetables Oriental Style Asparagus Broccoli Or Cauliflower
Ingredient Names: margarine, slivered almonds, frozen asparagus, celery, sliced mushrooms, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown almonds in margarine over low heat. Step 2: Remove almonds and set aside. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients to margarine, cover, and simmer over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Top with almonds and serve.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, toasted sesame oil, carrot, celery, white button mushrooms, bell pepper, red cabbage, zucchini, mung bean sprouts, green beans, snow peas, bamboo shoot, sliced water chestnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger, stirring, in the oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the carrots and celery, and cook, stirring, 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, peppers, cabbage and zucchini, and cook 3 minutes more. Step 4: Add the bean sprouts, green beans, snow peas, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts and tomatoes, and cook 3 minutes more. Step 5: Stir together the water, soy sauce and cornstarch. Step 6: Stir gently into the vegetable mixture. Step 7: Cook until the sauce is thickened and all the vegetables are tender-crisp Salt and pepper to taste, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: noodles, celery, bamboo shoots, peanut oil, garlic cloves, onion, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, fresh ginger, vegetable stock, sugar, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: If you are using fresh noodles, blanch them first in a large pot of boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes If you are using the dried noodles, cook in boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain the noodles, then put them into cold water until required String the celery and slice diagonally Shred the bamboo shoots. Step 3: Heat a wok or large frying-pan and add the oil. Step 4: When moderately hot, add the garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds. Step 5: Add the onion, celery, and bamboo shoots and stir-fry for about 5 minutes. Step 6: Drain the noodles thoroughly and put into the wok Continue to stir-fry for 1 minute then add the rest of the ingredients except the bean sprouts.

Dish Name: Vegetarian Cream Style Corn Soup China
Ingredient Names: corn oil, garlic cloves, shallots, vegetable stock, fish sauce, dry sherry, creamed corn, eggs, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium heat in a large saucepan, heat the oil, then add garlic & shallots, cooking 3 to 5 minutes, until softened, & stirring occasionally. Step 2: Add vegetable stock & bring to a boil. Step 3: Stir in fish sauce, wine & corn, & while stirring, pour in the eggs in a slow stream so they cook in thin strands. Step 4: Garnish, if you like, with the chopped cilantro & serve immediately.

Dish Name: Vegetarian Ema Datshi Bhutan Chili Cheese Stew
Ingredient Names: green chili, sweet onion, water, feta cheese, vegetable oil, tomatoes, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Remove seeds and ribs from chilis and cut chilis lengthwise into 1 / 2" slices. Step 2: Place chilis and onion in water with vegetable oil, boil 10 minutes. Step 3: Add tomato and garlic and simmer for 2 more minutes. Step 4: Add cheese and simmer on low for 2 more minutes - enough to blend the cheese without completely melting it. Step 5: Add cilantro and stir. Step 6: Serve with bhutanese red rice or brown rice.

Dish Name: Vegetarian Hawaiian Fried Rice With Ham
Ingredient Names: sliced mushrooms, celery, carrot, onion, canola oil, soy ham, cooked brown rice, green onions, soy sauce, chicken-flavored vegetarian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Get out a large skillet or wok On high heat, stir fry the celery, carrots, mushrooms and onion in oil, about 3 minutes or until tender. Step 2: Add in the vegetarian "ham" Stir fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add in soy sauce, seasoning and green onions Continue stir frying until hot--approximately 4 minutes You may serve with other side dishes such as the teriyaki veggies i will post Or eat alone, it is really good!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: dried lily buds, dried mushroom, vegetable broth, bamboo shoot, fresh ginger, salt, red wine vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, cornstarch, water, egg, egg white, black soy sauce, firm tofu, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In separate bowls, cover the lily buds and tree ear mushrooms with hot water. Step 2: Let soak until softened, about 30 minutes. Step 3: Drain and thoroughly rinse the lily buds and mushrooms Trim the tough ends from the buds and halve them crosswise. Step 4: In a large pot, combine the broth, lily buds, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, ginger and salt. Step 5: Cover and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 6: Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the vinegar and 1 tsp red pepper and boil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes. Step 8: Beat the cornstarch mixture into the soup in a steady stream. Step 9: In a bowl, combine the egg and egg white and beat into the soup.

Ingredient Names: limes, lime, dijon mustard, brown sugar, grapeseed oil, thai basil, bean sprouts, red bell pepper, carrot, smoked tofu, rice paper sheets, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl whisk together juice, lime, mustard and sugar. Step 2: Whisk in the oil and season. Step 3: Toss with all the vegetables and tofu. Step 4: Check for seasoning Lay out 1 wrapper and place a small mound of mix near the bottom. Step 5: Roll bottom towards the middle. Step 6: Fold in both sides and continue rolling Finish roll and let rest Individually wrap each roll with plastic wrap Will hold for 2 hours in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, onion, salt, fresh snow peas, stir-fry sauce, fresh tomatoes, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu into 1 / 2-inch cubes. Step 2: Drain well on several layers of paper towels. Step 3: Heat oil in hot wok or large skillet over high heat, add ginger. Step 4: Stir-fry 30 seconds or until fragrant. Step 5: Add onion and salt. Step 6: Stir-fry 2 minutes, add snow peas, stir-fry 1 minute. Step 7: Add stir-fry sauce, tomatoes and tofu.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, white rice, eggs, green onions, garlic cloves, soy sauce, salt, ground pepper, peas, carrot, corn kernel
Instructions: Step 1: Whip eggs until they are frothy Scramble, then set aside. Step 2: Steam carrots until slightly soft If using frozen peas & corn, run under hot water to thaw Break up any clumps in the rice Over medium-high heat, heat oil in a large pan or wok. Step 3: Add rice and stir for about 1 minute, until heated through. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Add soy sauce, garlic, salt & pepper. Step 6: Stir-fry for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: head of cabbage, oil, dried red chili peppers, salt, sugar, cornstarch, cider vinegar, soy sauce, dry sherry
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain the cabbage mix sauce ingredients in a bowl heat the wok until it's hot then add the oil and peppers. Step 2: Cook them until the peppers turn a deep red. Step 3: Add the cabbage and cook for 2 minutes until it turns bright green, but is still a bit crisp. Step 4: Add the sauce and stir until the starch turns translucent, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: green beans, oriental sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, golden brown sugar, ground black pepper, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook green beans in large pot of boiling water until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes, drain. Step 2: Transfer green beans to large bowl of ice water to cool. Step 3: Drain again Pat green beans dry Toast sesame seeds: heat the seeds in a dry pan over medium heat, or on a sheet in a 275f oven, until golden and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in heavy large wok or nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 5: Add green beans and stir-fry until heated through, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and pepper. Step 7: Stir-fry until sauce reduces slightly and loosely coats green beans, about 2 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: duck breasts, oyster sauce, bok choi, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Score the skin of the duck, place them skin-side down in a cold heavy-based frying pan. Turn the heat to high and let the duck slowly warm; this will render the fat from the skin, so you get a better texture and flavour, about 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, bring a pot of water to the boil and add a dash of the oyster sauce to it. Boil the bok choi for 2 mins until wilted, drain and set aside. Reduce the heat under the duck, cook for a few more mins, then remove from the pan. When cool enough to handle slice the duck thinly. Step 3: Pour 1 tbsp of the fat from the duck into a wok with the oil and place over a high heat. Throw the duck in to the hot fat and let it cook for 3 mins until coloured. Add the bok choi and oyster sauce, stir well, simmer for 2 mins and serve.

Ingredient Names: vodka, cranberry juice, strawberry
Instructions: Step 1: Chill a cocktail glass with ice or in the freezer. Step 2: Pour absolut ruby red and cranberry juice into a shaker. Step 3: Fill the shaker with ice cubes and shake it until the shaker is very cold Empty the cocktail glass from ice and water. Step 4: Strain the drink into the cocktail glass. Step 5: Garnish with a whole strawberry.

Dish Name: Xiang Luo Bu Si Sounding Radish Slivers
Ingredient Names: daikon radish, salt, red chile, scallions, light soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, peanut oil, cornstarch, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the radish and cut into 2 1 / 2-inch sections. Step 2: Cut each section first into very thin slices, and then into fine slivers. Step 3: Combine with 3 / 4 teaspoon salt, then set aside for 15 minutes. Step 4: Discard the stems and seeds of the chili, and cut into fine slivers to match the radish. Step 5: Cut the scallion greens into similar slivers. Step 6: Drain the radish slivers and squeeze dry, set aside. Step 7: Mix the cornstarch and water into a paste. Step 8: Heat the wok over a high flame until smoke rises, then add the peanut oil and swirl around. Step 9: Add the chili and sizzle for a few seconds before adding the radish slivers.

Ingredient Names: self-rising flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda, water, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Step 2: Stir in water Lightly knead dough Loosely cover for about 20 minutes, or enough time for the dough to rise On floured surface, roll the dough into 2 inch wide and 14 inch long strips Twist together in pairs, pinching the ends Holding each end of twists, pull until 9 inches long Deep fry each twist in peanut oil until golden brown, let cool and eat.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, tofu, green onions, garlic cloves, sesame oil, oil, ground pork, chili bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar, salt, rice vinegar, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggplant in half then in about 2 inch chunks Deep fry until golden Deep fry tofu until golden. Step 2: Stir fry green onions and garlic in sesame oil and oil. Step 3: Add ground pork if you are using meat. Step 4: Mix chili bean paste, soy sauce, sugar, salt, rice vinegar in a bowl, add to veggies. Step 5: Add eggplant and tofu, stir. Step 6: Add cornstarch mixed with water.

Ingredient Names: roast, fresh ground pepper, extra virgin olive oil, bay leaf, garlic cloves, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rub the beef generously with freshly ground pepper, and place in a heavy bottomed pot large enough to hold the meat. Step 2: Drizzle the olive oil over the meat and turn the meat over to coat with the oil. Step 3: Add the bay leaf and garlic cloves and marinate for 15 minutes. Step 4: Remove the bay leaf Brown the meat over medium-high heat, turning to brown evenly This step will take about 15-20 minutes, depending on the size of the roast. Step 5: When the garlic begins to color remove it with a slotted spoon. Step 6: When the roast is well browned on all sides and ends return the browned garlic cloves to the pot, remove the pot from the heat, and cover. Step 7: Let the meat rest for 15-30 minutes The internal temperature will be 140 degrees.

Ingredient Names: hamburger, italian sausage, onion, green bell pepper, garlic cloves, basil, oregano, thyme, bay leaf, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stock pot brown burger and drain Brown sliced sausage and drain Saut onions and bell pepper for a few minutes. Step 2: Add garlic, seasonings and bay leaf Saut 1 more minute. Step 3: Add all meat back to the pot. Step 4: Add tomato sauce and diced tomatoes. Step 5: Stir to mix well and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat, cover and simmer 1 hour. Step 7: Add the tomato paste and cook and stir a few more minutes.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, ground beef, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, salt, oregano, basil, thyme, peppercorns, green pepper, broccoli, zucchini, mushrooms, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the garlic Grind the garlic, peppercorns, salt, thyme, basil, and oregano together with a mortar and pestle Start frying these ground ingredients in a large frying pan with a little oil. Step 2: Fry for a few seconds. Step 3: Add the ground beef. Step 4: Now boil some water. Step 5: Add the lasagna noodles. Step 6: Chop the mushrooms, onions, and any vegetables up. Step 7: Add to the frying meat. Step 8: When the beef is fully cooked, add the spaghetti sauce, tomatoes, and tomato paste.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, salt and pepper, egg, soft breadcrumbs, tomato sauce, italian seasoning, garlic powder, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix beef, salt and pepper, egg, crumbs, and 1 / 2 cup tomato sauce Form into 4 loaves. Step 2: Mix remaining cup tomato sauce with italian seasoning, garlic powder, and brown sugar. Step 3: Place in small casserole dish. Step 4: Bake, uncovered at 375 for 20 minutes. Step 5: Spoon remaining sauce over loaves and bake 10 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: crushed tomatoes, water, tomato paste, garlic powder, salt, italian sausage, ground beef, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the sausage in a medium pan. Step 2: Strain the tomatoes and finely crush what's left into the sauce pan. Step 3: Add the water and the meatballs and simmer for at least 2 hours. Step 4: Chill, then remove the fat as one layer Reheat and serve over your favorite pasta or on hoagie buns for meatball subs-- freezes well.

Ingredient Names: egg noodles, vegetable oil, ground beef, onion, garlic clove, dried oregano, salt, condensed tomato soup, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook noodles following package directions, drain and reserve. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat oil on medium-high in a nonstick skillet. Step 4: Add ground beef, onion and garlic. Step 5: Cook over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until beef is no longer pink. Step 6: Drain off excess liquid. Step 7: Stir in oregano, salt, soup, 1 / 3 cup water and noodles. Step 8: Take off heat and add half of the cheese. Step 9: Spoon into 11 x 7-inch baking dish and sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, italian sausage, onion, garlic cloves, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, dried parsley flakes, dried oregano, dried basil, whole tomatoes, ricotta cheese, eggs, pepper, parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground meat, onion and garlic. Step 2: Add salt, pepper, parsley, oregano, basil, chopped tomatoes with juice Stirring until well mixed. Step 3: Cover and simmer 1 hour. Step 4: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Step 5: Drain and set aside Spray a 13 x 9" baking pan with cooking spray. Step 6: Combine riccota cheese, eggs, pepper, 2 tablespoons parsley, parmesan cheese and 1 / 2 1lb of mozzarella cheese. Step 7: In a lasagna pan, layer noodles, meat sauce, and cheese mixture, repeat.

Ingredient Names: lean hamburger, italian sausage, green pepper, onion, garlic, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, velveeta cheese, pizza dough
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the burger, sausage, green pepper, onion, and garlic until the meat is fully cooked While this is cooking, spread / pat / roll your crust unto a greased jelly roll pan, pushing the dough up the sides to make an edge Prebake the crust in a 400 oven for 7-10 minutes or until it just begins to color. Step 2: Top the hot crust with the desired amount of pasta sauce. Step 3: Add the meat mixture, spreading evenly. Step 4: Top with the sliced velveeta cheese, leaving about 1 / 2 inch between slices. Step 5: Add the mozzarella cheese in an even layer. Step 6: Bake at 400 for about 20 minutes, or until the top layer of cheese begins to brown. Step 7: Allow to sit for 5 minutes before cutting into 12 squares.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, fresh parsley leaves, breadcrumbs, onion, eggs, parmesan cheese, salt, ground black pepper, tubetti, mozzarella cheese, provolone cheese, olive oil, minced garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, crushed tomatoes in puree
Instructions: Step 1: Read directions all the way through first meat crust: mix ground beef, parsley, bread crumbs, onion, eggs, 1 / 2 cup parmesan, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper in a bowl very gently Do not overmix. Step 2: Put mixture into lightly greased 10-inch pie plate or 11" x 7" casserole dish. Step 3: Shape crust so that it's about 1" thick Tomato basil sauce: In large pot, cook garlic and red pepper flakes in oil on low heat for 4 minutes only. Step 4: Add tomatoes, paste, water, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt, 1 teaspoon black pepper, sugar and basil leaves, bring to boil. Step 5: Reduce to low heat. Step 6: Add chunk of romano cheese and cook for 1 1 / 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, olive oil, black olives, fresh mushrooms, prosciutto, mortadella, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, italian seasoning, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Rub the flank steak on both sides with olive oil. Step 3: Sprinkle the mushrooms and olives over the steak, if using. Step 4: Place a layer of prosciutto, then a layer of mortadella, mozzarella, and then pepperoni. Step 5: Season with some of the Italian seasoning. Step 6: Roll the steak up around the filling, and tie with butcher's string. Step 7: Rub the outside of the roll with remaining Italian seasoning, garlic powder and steak seasoning. Step 8: Heat a large cast iron skillet over high heat. Step 9: Sear the roast over the entire outside. Step 10: Then leave the roast in the skillet, and place the skillet in the oven. Step 11: Roast for in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees F (70 degrees C) when taken in the center of the roast. Step 12: Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, sugar, garlic clove, onion, dried basil, parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt and pepper, baking soda, meatballs, ground chuck, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all meatball ingredients, roll in to balls and brown in skillet. Step 2: Cool and refrigerate until 1 hour prior to serving Olive oil may be needed to brown these if using very lean beef In the skillet, add chopped onions and cook until tender but not soft. Step 3: Add garlic and can of tomatoes If using whole tomatoes, i mash them briefly in the skillet with a potato masher. Step 4: Cook until mixture comes to a boil. Step 5: Put in to a large dutch oven or sauce pan. Step 6: Add remaining ingredients except for baking soda, parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt and pepper. Step 7: Bring to a quick boil and immediately reduce the heat to medium low as this sauce will burn.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, basil, salt, dried oregano, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, grated parmesan cheese, large eggs, dried parsley, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Cook and stir ground beef, onion, and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes; drain fat. Step 3: Mix in diced tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, basil, salt, and oregano. Step 4: Simmer meat sauce, stirring occasionally, for 30 to. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 6: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 7: Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes; drain. Step 8: Lay noodles flat on towels; blot dry. Step 9: Mix together ricotta, Parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley, and remaining salt in a medium bowl. Step 10: Layer 1/3 of the noodles in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 11: Cover with 1/2 of the ricotta mixture. Step 12: Cover the ricotta mixture with 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese, and 1/3 of the meat sauce, repeat. Step 13: Top with remaining noodles and meat sauce. Step 14: Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the top. Step 15: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 16: Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: blade steaks, parmesan cheese, hard-boiled eggs, garlic cloves, parsley flakes, extra virgin olive oil, string
Instructions: Step 1: Drizzle the olive oil on top of each steak Rub it in a little With your fingers, put the crushed garlic here and there on top of the steaks Rub the garlic in lightly. Step 2: Sprinkle the parsley and parmesan on top of the steaks Lay 1 boiled egg half in the middle on top of each steak. Step 3: Roll up each steak. Step 4: Wrap kite string around each steak to keep it closed. Step 5: Drop the braciole into your already cooking "tomato gravy" I just let it cook until my tomato gravy is done, about 1 1 / 2 hours on low.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, egg, milk, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, salt, fresh ground pepper, fresh italian parsley, fresh basil, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put sauce in a large pot on the oven to simmer. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients, except for sauce, in a large bowl until blended, but be careful not to overmix. Step 3: Roll meat mixture into meatballs of your preferred size. Step 4: Drop them into the simmer sauce and cover. Step 5: Simmer for 1 to 3 hours. Step 6: Serve with additional parmesan cheese, to taste.

Dish Name: Arancini Di Riso Italian Rice Balls
Ingredient Names: rice, saffron, parmigiano, eggs, ground beef, tomato paste, garlic, onion, dried funghi porcini, olive oil, dry red wine, mozzarella cheese, fresh peas, flour, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Begin by preparing the filling: finely slice the onion and mince the garlic, and saut the mixture in the olive oil until it wilts. Step 2: Stir in the ground meat, continue cooking until it is well browned, and then stir in the wine While it's evaporating, dilute the tomato paste in a ladle of warm water and stir it in. Step 3: Season the mixture to taste, and simmer it over a very low flame for a couple of hours, adding more warm water or broth as necessary to keep it from drying out Towards the end of the cooking time, steep the dried mushrooms in boiling water for a few minutes and coarsely chop them. Step 4: Stir them into the sauce too. Step 5: Cook it for 15 minutes more and it's done While the meat's cooking, simmer the peas until they're tender. Step 6: Then remove them from the fire, drain them, and let them cool Dice the mozzarella into half-inch squares and combine it with the cool peas.

Dish Name: Arancini Sicilian Style Sicilian Rice Balls
