Ingredient Names: rice, boiling water, beef, chicken livers, olive oil, garlic, onion, mushroom, tomato paste, water, salt, pepper, butter, parmesan cheese, egg yolks
Instructions: Step 1: Wash rice and cook in 4 cups boiling, salted water until tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, place chopped beef, chicken livers, oil, garlic and onion in saucepan and brown gently. Step 3: Add mushrooms and cook 1 minute more. Step 4: Add tomato paste and 1 cup warm water and cook 30 minutes. Step 5: Add salt and pepper. Step 6: Drain rice, add butter and grated cheese and cool a bit To this, add the egg yolks and the tomato gravy, holding aside the meat and mushrooms, mix rice well. Step 7: Make little balls of rice, place inside each ball some of the meat, liver, mushroom mixture. Step 8: Dip rice balls into lightly beaten egg, roll in bread crumbs and fry in hot olive oil until golden brown all over.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, ground pork, dry red wine, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese, fennel seed, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, dried thyme, fresh ground black pepper, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the ingredients in a mixing bowl Preheat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat Cook the mixture until browned, stirring to crumble it Drain.

Dish Name: Authentic Bolognese Sauce Sugo Alla Bolognese
Ingredient Names: onions, carrots, celery ribs, garlic clove, bacon, extra virgin olive oil, salt, fresh ground pepper, dried basil, dried oregano, dried thyme leaves, ground veal, dry white wine, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chopped onions, carrots, celery, and garlic clove in a food processor Pulse the motor until the vegetables are finely chopped. Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy saucepan set over medium heat. Step 3: Add the chopped vegetables and chopped bacon. Step 4: Stir in the salt, pepper, basil, oregano, and thyme. Step 5: Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the ground veal to the pot with the vegetables. Step 7: Cook over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon, until the meat is no longer pink, about 6 minutes. Step 8: Stir in the wine, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, and the milk. Step 9: Add the pinch of ground nutmeg.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, ground veal, ground beef, romano cheese, italian parsley, garlic, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, eggs, breadcrumbs, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients until completely combined If the mix is dry add cold water It should be moist, but not wet Have a large quantity of homemade marinara sauce very hot on the stove. Step 2: Turn the sauce to very low heat Form mixture into meatballs, and add raw meatballs to sauce (add them gently, as the pan will be crowded. Step 3: Cover and walk away for three hours. Step 4: Return, gently stir, cover, walk away for three more hours. Step 5: Stir, and degrease the top. Step 6: Cover, leave cooking for two more hours.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, eggs, milk, breadcrumbs, salt, fresh parsley, garlic powder, fresh ground pepper, locatelli cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl by hand Use your bare hands for best results. Step 2: Roll meatballs to about the size of a golf ball. Step 3: Drop raw meatballs into large pot of sauce. Step 4: Simmer for about 3 hours.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, ground pork, eggs, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, oregano, garlic clove, onion, sweet basil, salt and pepper, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together Form about the size of golf balls Make or pour tomato sauce into a deep pot drop meat balls in sauce Simmer for at least 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: fat-free chicken broth, yellow onion, garlic cloves, flat-leaf italian parsley, lean ground beef, ground lean pork, lean ground veal, panko breadcrumbs, egg whites, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, red pepper flakes, salt, marinara sauce, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken stock, onion, garlic and parsley in a blender of food processor and puree. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the pureed stock mix, meat, bread crumbs, eggs, parmigiano-reggiano, red pepper flakes and salt. Step 3: Combine with both hands until mixture is uniform Do not over mix. Step 4: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Step 5: Put a little olive oil on your hands and form mixture into balls about the size of golf balls If you prefer bigger or smaller, it will only affect the browning time. Step 6: Place 2 teaspoons of extra virgin olive oil a baking sheet. Step 7: Add the meatballs to the pan. Step 8: Place the meatballs in the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, butter, yellow onion, carrots, celery ribs, garlic cloves, pancetta, ground meat, dry white wine, milk, san marzano tomatoes, beef stock, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place a 12" skillet over medium heat and melt butter in the oil. Step 2: Add the onion, carrot, celery, and garlic with some salt and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 3: Add the pancetta or bacon and cook for 10 minutes, until vegetables are soft Increase the heat to high and add meat a third at a time. Step 4: Make sure to add meat gradually as this allows the water to evaporate and the meat will brown. Step 5: Cook until meat is no longer pink. Step 6: Once this happens, set timer for 15 minutes and allow meat to caramelize stirring occasionally It is okay for meat to stick to the bottom of the pan Over medium heat, pour the white wine into pan to deglaze Scrape all the brown bits at the bottom of the pan.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic clove, onion, sugar, salt, pepper, ground beef, tomato sauce, spaghetti noodles, cream cheese, sour cream, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Optional: mushrooms, tabasco sauce and tony's cajun seasoning to spice it up Sautee' butter, chopped garlic, sugar, salt, and pepper in a skillet. Step 2: Add meat and brown. Step 3: Add tomato sauce and simmer 20 minutes. Step 4: Cook and drain noodles. Step 5: Add cream cheese, sour cream, and onion. Step 6: Mix well and layer in the bottom of a casserole dish. Step 7: Top noodles with the meat mixture and top with grated cheese. Step 8: Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Step 9: Allow 10 minutes to cool before serving.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, lean ground beef, onions, garlic, season salt, pepper, pasta sauce, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350°F. Step 2: Grease a 13 x9-inch casserole dish. Step 3: Cook the rigatoni until firm-tender (do not overcook as it will cook more when baked) toss with 2 tbsp oil to prevent drying out; set aside. Step 4: Cook beef with onions, garlic, seasoned salt and pepper until beef is done and no longer pink; drain off fat. Step 5: Stir in pasta sauce; simmer 20 minutes. Step 6: In a bowl, combine ricotta cheese, 1 cup mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and eggs. Step 7: On the bottom of the casserole dish spread 1-1/2 cups meat sauce. Step 8: Top with half each, the cooked rigatoni, ricotta cheese mixture and meat sauce. Step 9: Repeat layer ending with meat sauce. Step 10: Top with remaining cheese. Step 11: Bake uncovered until hot and bubbly, about 30-35 minutes. Step 12: Let stand for 15 minutes before serving. Step 13: Note: canned sliced mushrooms may be added to meat sauce if desired.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, ground beef, onion, garlic clove, sliced mushrooms, salt, dry red wine, spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, tomato sauce, lasagna noodles, egg, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat and onion in large skillet, drain off excess fat. Step 2: Add garlic, mushrooms, salt, wine, spaghetti sauce, paste, and tomato sauce to the meat mixture, mix well, set aside. Step 3: In a medium bowl, combine egg, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese and parsley flakes, set aside Spray crock pot with cooking oil. Step 4: Layer the bottom of a 5 to 6 quart crock pot with 4 noodles, broken into pieces to fit. Step 5: Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles. Step 6: Top with 1 / 4 of the meat mixture and 1 / 4 of the shredded cheese. Step 7: Top with 4 noodles, remaining cheese mixture, 1 / 4 of the meat mixture and 1 / 4 shredded cheese.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, pasta sauce, egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Put chuck roast in crock pot, pour both jars of pasta sauce over meat and turn on low Cook for minimum 8-10 hours Serve over cooked egg noodles or pasta Yum!

Ingredient Names: onions, celery, green pepper, garlic, olive oil, lean ground beef, tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, dried oregano, italian seasoning, water, eggs, cream-style cottage cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions, green peppers and garlic in 2 tbsp oil. Step 2: Add celery to very tail end of this. Step 3: Add beef, breaking apart Brown the beef, if you are using extra lean ground beef, there is no need to drain any excess fat. Step 4: Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, dried oregano, italian seasoning and water. Step 5: Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Step 6: In a separate bowl, mix 1 egg with cottage and parmesan cheese, 1 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Step 7: Beat second egg and toss with noodles Assemble lasagna in a lasagna pan in the following order: 1 / 2 meat mix, 1 / 2 noodles, cheese / egg mix, 1 / 2 noodle mix, 1 / 2 meat mix. Step 8: Bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground beef, ground sausage, frozen chopped spinach, manicotti, ricotta cheese, eggs, spaghetti sauce, butter, all-purpose flour, chicken bouillon granule, half-and-half, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Saute onions, garlic, ground sausage, and beef until meat is well browned and crumbled. Step 3: Prepare manicotti shells as per package directions except cut the cook time in half. Step 4: Drain and cover with cool water to stop the cooking process and prevent the shells from cracking To the ground pork / beef mixture add the spinach and ricotta cheese. Step 5: When the mixture is cool, add the beaten eggs. Step 6: Spread 1 / 4 cup spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish Gently drain the manicotti shells and carefully stuff each one with the meat and cheese mixture. Step 7: Place shells in prepared dish. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350f.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, ground veal, onions, garlic clove, parsley, dried oregano, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, egg, olive oil, onion, whole tomatoes, tomato paste, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Meatballs: In med bowl, combine the first ten ingredients. Step 2: Toss lightly to mix well With teaspoon, shape mixture into 30 balls, each 3 / 4 inch in diameter Sauce: In hot oil in large, heavy skillet, brown meatballs, remove. Step 3: Add the rest of the onions and garlic, saute 5 minutes. Step 4: Add rest of sauce ingredients, with 1 / 2 c water and meatballs.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, tomato sauce, beef gravy, half-and-half, grated parmesan cheese, garlic, dried oregano, dried basil, shredded mozzarella cheese, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Step 3: Heat a large frying pan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cook and stir ground beef in the hot pan until browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 5: Add tomato sauce, gravy, half-and-half, Parmesan cheese, garlic, oregano, and basil. Step 6: Simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 8: Stir in ziti, bring back to a boil, and cook pasta over medium heat until tender yet firm to the bite, 10 to, drain. Step 9: Stir ziti into meat sauce, then spread into the prepared baking dish. Step 10: Sprinkle top with mozzarella cheese. Step 11: Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 20 to.

Dish Name: Baked Pork Sausages With Potatoes And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: italian sausages, bell peppers, onion, baking potatoes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, olive oil, tomatoes, pecorino cheese, oregano, crusty italian bread
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients from the sausages up to and including the potatoes into an oiled baking dish or pan. Step 2: Season well with salt and pepper, and drizzle with the olive oil. Step 3: Turn the oven to 350f and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add the tomatoes, pecorino or provolone, and oregano, stir, and cook for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Serve hot with bread.

Ingredient Names: ground sausage, italian-style tomato sauce, cannellini beans, rigatoni pasta, garlic, italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, romano cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees In dutch oven over medium-high heat, cook sausage with the minced garlic until sausage is not longer pink and crumbled, drain. Step 2: Stir in tomato sauce, beans and italian seasoning. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook rigatoni according to package directions, just until al dente. Step 5: Drain and lightly butter. Step 6: Add cooked pasta to the meat sauce and toss until well coated Spray a 13x9x2-inch baking dish with pam. Step 7: Pour half of the pasta mixture in pan.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green pepper, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, sliced mushrooms, salt, dried basil, garlic powder, oregano, dry crushed red pepper, rotini pasta, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook first 3 ingredients in a large skillet over medium heat, until beef is no longer pink. Step 2: Drain and return to skillet. Step 3: Stir in crushed tomatoes and next 7 ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes. Step 5: Stir in rotini and cheese. Step 6: Spoon into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Step 7: Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: venison steak, fresh breadcrumb, parmesan cheese, garlic salt, italian seasoning, egg, salt and pepper, butter, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic salt and italian seasoning in a small bowl. Step 2: Beat egg with salt and pepper in a second bowl. Step 3: Dip meat in egg, then coat well with crumbs. Step 4: Place steaks on a plate and refrigerate 20 minutes to set crumbs. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 6: Melt butter in a 9x13 pan till hot in oven, add steaks to pan. Step 7: Bake 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Flip steaks, spoon spaghetti sauce over the meat and bake another 15-20 minutes until meat is tender. Step 9: Top with mozzarella, baking 5 more minutes or until cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, ground pork, onion, garlic cloves, egg, romano cheese, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, thyme, rosemary, oregano, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f Generously spray cookie sheet with non-stick spray I prefer using a sprayed broiling rack so the grease separates from the meatballs. Step 2: Mix all ingredients Should be 'moist' but not 'sloppy' -- add a bit more breadcrumb if necessary Form into meatballs, about inch and a half across or so Plan ahead! Step 3: Slightly flatten a dozen meatballs so they don't roll away when you make sandwiches -- Place on sprayed sheet or rack close together without touching. Step 4: Bake 15-20 minutes or until done through. Step 5: Serve on top of pasta with favorite sauce.

Ingredient Names: pasta, olive oil, onion, rosemary, garlic, ground beef, italian sausage, spaghetti sauce, salt, cottage cheese, sour cream, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook pasta in boiling water for 8 to, or until al dente; drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Cook onion in oil until tender. Step 5: Stir in rosemary and garlic. Step 6: Transfer to a small bowl. Step 7: Place ground beef and sausage in the skillet. Step 8: Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Step 9: Stir in the onion mixture and the spaghetti sauce, season with salt. Step 10: Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 11: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 12: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 13: In the prepared dish, layer 1/2 of the cooked pasta, provolone cheese, sour cream, cottage cheese, and a little less than 1/2 of the meat mixture. Step 14: Then layer the rest of the pasta, mozzarella cheese, remaining meat mixture, and Parmesan cheese. Step 15: Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to, or until heated through and cheeses are melted.

Dish Name: Baked Ziti With Fire Roasted Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, sweet onion, garlic cloves, zucchini, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, oregano leaves, salt, pepper, ziti pasta, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 Spray 2 quart rectangular glass baking dish. Step 2: In a 10 inch non stick skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic over medium heat, stirring frequently, until cooked. Step 3: Add zucchini, cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper, heat to boiling, toss with pasta, spread in dish, cover with foil, bake 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Ziti With Hot Italian Sausage Fresh Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, hot italian sausage links, white wine, san marzano tomatoes, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, fresh mozzarella cheese, wine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook ziti until it is al dente. Step 3: Rinse in cold water, drain and pour into a 7"x11" glass baking dish. Step 4: Meanwhile, begin cooking sausage. Step 5: Puree san marzano tomatoes, crushed red pepper flakes and salt in a blender until smooth. Step 6: When sausage is done, remove from pan and add 1 / 2 cup wine to reserved drippings from sausage and bring to a simmer scraping any bits from the bottom of the pan and stirring with wine While wine is simmering, slice sausage at a slight diagonal about 1 / 2" thick. Step 7: Add pureed sauce and sliced sausage to wine and stir. Step 8: Bring to a boil and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Step 9: Meanwhile thinly slice and chop the fresh mozarella balls.

Dish Name: Baked Ziti With Thick Rich Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: pasta sauce with meat, ziti pasta, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, dried parsley, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare sauce and keep under a low flame. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350. Step 3: Mix the cheese mixture together. Step 4: Mix pasta with 1 / 3 - 1 / 2 of the cheese mixture till creamy and gooey. Step 5: Place 1 1 / 2 cups sauce in bottom of a 10x13 casserole dish. Step 6: Top with 1 / 2 of the pasta. Step 7: Spread the remaining cheese on the pasta. Step 8: Top with 2-3 cups of the meat sauce. Step 9: Top with remaining pasta 1 cup sauce.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, onion, mushroom, garlic cloves, tomato puree, italian-style tomatoes, dry red wine, salt, bay leaf, dried oregano, pepper, fresh parsley, egg, soft breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce. Step 2: Melt butter and oil in lg Pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and mushrooms and cook until soft. Step 4: Add garlic, tomato puree, tomatoes and their liquid, wine, salt, bay leaf, oregano, pepper and parsley: bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat and simmer until sauce is reduced to about 5 cups. Step 6: Remove bay leaf Meatballs. Step 7: Melt 1 / 2 tbsp each butter and oil in large frying pan over medium heat. Step 8: Add onion and cook until lightly browned: transfter to mixing bowl and cool.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, egg, salt, pepper, onion powder, worcestershire sauce, saltine crumbs, ketchup, mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl Spray an 8x4 glass loaf pan with cooking spray. Step 3: Press mixture into pan. Step 4: Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees Also: i prefer a 2 parts ketchup to 1 part mustard mixture, but my recipe says "to taste" The ketchup and mustard mixture can also be substituted with bbq sauce or cocktail sauce.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, olive oil, onions, celery & leaves, carrots, italian-style tomatoes, salt, oregano, pepper, garlic powder, pasta noodles, frozen chopped spinach, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in enough oil to keep meat from sticking, about 5 minutes, drain fat. Step 2: Add onions, celery, carrots, and cook another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add tomatoes, salt, oregano, pepper, and garlic powder. Step 4: Bring sauce to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and let simmer for 1 hour. Step 5: Meanwhile, cook your pasta, timing it so that it is ready when the sauce has finished simmering. Step 6: Mix pasta, sauce and spinach all together, then pour into 2 greased 9x13" casseroles. Step 7: Sprinkle each casserole with parmesan cheese and bake at 350 f for about 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: no-boil lasagna noodles, eggs, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, ground beef, spaghetti sauce, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 In bowl, combine beaten eggs, ricotta cheese and two cups of the mozzarella cheese and parmesan If you choose not to use the parmesan, just add more mozzarella, set aside. Step 2: In a 13x9x3 pan, spread 1 cup of sauce on bottom of pan. Step 3: Layer in the order, 4 uncooked lasagna noodles, then 1 / 3 part of the ricotta cheese mixture, half the browned meat, 1 cup mozzarella cheese, and 1 cup of spaghetti sauce Next layer, 4 uncooked lasagna noodles, 1 / 3 part of the ricotta cheese mixture, and 1 1 / 2 cups sauce Next layer, 4 uncooked lasagna noodles, remaining ricotta mixture and remained meat, 1 cup of sauce For top layer, 4 uncooked lasagna noodles, remaining sauce, and remaining 1 cup mozzarella. Step 4: Bake covered with foil for 50-60 minutes.

Ingredient Names: egg, dry breadcrumbs, onions, salt, pepper, lean ground beef
Instructions: Step 1: Beat egg in a bowl with a fork. Step 2: Add the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: Shape into 20 small balls. Step 4: Bake on a large baking sheet covered with parchment paper at 190c for 15 minutes Meetballs should be all the same size and cooked through.

Dish Name: Bbq Italian Sausage Pepper On A Bun
Ingredient Names: italian sausages, olive oil, red wine vinegar, dried oregano, basil, sugar, hot pepper sauce, red peppers, yellow peppers, green peppers, italian bread, honey mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Prick the sausages, cover with water and simmer 5-6 minutes, cool in cold water, pat dry and slice in half leaving them joined in the center. Step 2: Heat bbq medium-hot. Step 3: Combine olive oil, vinegar, oregano, basil, sugar& hot pepper sauce. Step 4: Grill the sausages and the pepper quarters basting with the oil mixture Bbq until the sausages and peppers are rich golden color 14-18 minutes Split the buns / bread in half and if using bread cut into serving sizes, leaving them joined at the middle and brush with the oil mixture. Step 5: Remove sausages and keep warm Bbq the oiled bread toast 2-3 minutes Slip a sausage in the bun and a piece of each of the peppers, some mustard and mmmmm.

Ingredient Names: beef eye round, olive oil, butter, bacon, salt, pepper, nutmeg, anchovy fillets, parsley, beef stock
Instructions: Step 1: Put beef in large saucepan with oil, butter, chopped bacon, salt, pepper, nutmeg and brown slowly, but thoroughly. Step 2: When meat is well browned, add the chopped anchovies, parsley and the stock or water. Step 3: Reduce heat, cover the pan and cook slowly about 1 1 / 4 hours, or until the meat is tender. Step 4: Add water to pan drippings, if necessary, to make gravy. Step 5: Slice beef and serve covered with gravy.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lean ground beef, chili powder, dried italian seasoning, beef stock, pasta sauce, red kidney beans, corn kernels, green bell pepper, spaghetti, parmesan cheese, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet, then brown the beef with chili powder and herbs for about 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in beef stock and pasta sauce and bring mixture to boil. Step 3: Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add beans, corn and pepper, then cook for another 5 minutes While the sauce is simmering, prepare the pasta according to the package instructions. Step 5: Drain pasta and serve hot with the sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle with grated parmesan and fresh herbs, if desired, just prior to serving.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, yellow onion, green pepper, hot sauce, italian spices, eggplant, italian tomatoes, cornbread stuffing mix, cream of celery soup, milk, salt and pepper, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: In a skillet, brown ground beef, chopped onion and green pepper, drain well. Step 3: Add italian seasonings to meat mixture. Step 4: Add diced tomatoes, mix lightly. Step 5: Blend cream of celery soup, hot sauce to taste, and 1 cup milk. Step 6: Spread about 1 / 4 cup of meat sauce in oil-sprayed baking dish. Step 7: Then layer eggplant, meat mixture, stuffing and top with half of soup mix, repeat.

Dish Name: Beef And Pasta Bake The Best
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, bacon, carrot, minced beef, condensed tomato soup, tomato paste, tomato sauce, oregano, spiral shaped pasta, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180. Step 2: Heat oil in large pan. Step 3: Cook onion, garlic, bacon and carrot, stirring, til carrot is just tender - about 8 minutes. Step 4: Add mince and cook, stirring, til mince changes colour. Step 5: Then add undiluted soup, tomato paste, sauce and oregano and simmer, covered, about 15 mins or til mixture has thickened slightly While beef mixture is simmering, cook pasta and drain. Step 6: Stir pasta into beef mixture, then spoon into an oiled deep 8 cup capacity ovenproof dish and sprinkle with cheese. Step 7: Bake, uncovered, for 15 mins or until browned slightly If you want to, you can add a stick of chopped celery along with the onion etc or add some mushrooms just before the mince.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, lean ground beef, onion, water, garlic powder, italian seasoning, italian tomato paste, red wine, instant beef bouillon, salt and pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 f. Step 2: Cook beef and onion in large saucepan, stirring occasionally, until beef is no longer pink. Step 3: Add water, tomato paste, wine, bouillon, and seasonings. Step 4: Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 15 minutes or until flavors are blended. Step 5: Layer ingredients as follows in 13 x 9-inch baking dish sprayed with non stick cooking spray: 1 / 2 pasta, 1 / 2 sauce and 1 / 2 cheese, repeat layers, cover. Step 6: Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted. Step 7: Season with salt For freeze ahead: prepare as above.

Ingredient Names: yellow onions, garlic cloves, celery, carrot, olive oil, salt & fresh ground pepper, ground beef, beef broth, dry red wine, dry white wine, tomato sauce, ketchup, bay leaves, fresh thyme, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, pulse the onions, garlic, celery and carrots until finely chopped. Step 2: In a dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion mixture with a pinch each of salt and pepper. Step 4: Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the ground beef and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the broth and the red and white wines and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Add the tomato sauce, ketchup, bay leaves, thyme, oregano, 1 t Salt and 1 / 2 t Black pepper. Step 8: Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef round steak, prosciutto, pignolis, pecorino romano cheese, garlic, parsley, olive oil, italian tomatoes, tomato puree, bay leaves, fresh basil leaves, yellow onion, carrots, celery, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Place each slice of beef between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat pounder until 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt& pepper Lay a slice of prosciutto on each one and sprinkle evenly with with the pignoli beans, pecorino romano cheese, garlic and parsley. Step 3: Roll up the slices, tucking in the ends and tie with kitchen string. Step 4: Heat 1 / 4 cup of the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat Dredge the braciole in flour shaking off any excess, then place in the pan. Step 5: Cook until browned on all sides, about 15 minutes. Step 6: Heat the other 1 / 4 cup of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 7: Add the onion, carrots, and celery. Step 8: Cook, stirring until tender but not browned, about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck roast, anise seed, juniper berries, bay leaf, red wine, salt, fresh ground black pepper, unbleached all-purpose flour, extra virgin olive oil, unsmoked bacon, onion, carrot, celery ribs, vegetable broth, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat, anise seeds, juniper berries and bay leaf in a large bowl. Step 2: Pour wine over the top. Step 3: Marinate, refrigerated, turning occasionally, for at least 1 hour or overnight. Step 4: Remove meat from marinade Pat dry and season with salt and pepper, dust with flour. Step 5: Strain marinade into a bowl through a fine mesh sieve, discard solids. Step 6: Heat oil in a wide 4- to 5-quart pot over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking Brown meat on all sides, about 10 minutes total, reducing heat if necessary to prevent scorching.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin, arugula, vinaigrette, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap the tenderloin in plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 2 hours. Step 2: After 2 hours, unwrap the tenderloin and thinly slice the beef into approximately into 1 / 8 to 1 / 4-inch pieces Lay out sheets of plastic wrap and place each slice onto the plastic. Step 3: Top with another piece of plastic and gently pound the meat with a meat mallet until paper thin. Step 4: Repeat until all of the meat is sliced and pounded. Step 5: Divide the meat evenly among 4 chilled plates. Step 6: Serve with greens tossed with vinaigrette, salt, pepper and / or parmesan.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, onion, green chilies, carrot, cheddar cheese soup, chunky salsa, low-fat cheddar cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, no-boil lasagna noodles, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Brown meat in a large nonstick frying pan or wok, at medium high. Step 2: Stir until meat is no longer pink. Step 3: Add onions and saute for 3 minutes, until translucent. Step 4: Add chilies, carrot, soup, salsa and first 1 / 2 cups of cheddar and mozzarella cheeses to cooked meat. Step 5: Stir until well mixed and just barely heated. Step 6: Layer in a rectangular lasagna or cake pan in this order: 1 / 3 dry noodles and 1 / 3 sauce Do this 2 more times. Step 7: Drizzle water all over and top with last of grated cheeses.

Ingredient Names: sea salt, ground red pepper, rump roast, butter, olive oil, vidalia onions, garlic cloves, white sugar, brown sugar, espresso, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 300f. Step 2: In a large, lidded, oven-safe stockpot, over low heat, melt the butter. Step 3: Add the corn oil and stir to mix. Step 4: Add sliced onions, and cook for 30 minutes, stirring to avoid burning as necessary While onions are cooking, rub the salt and pepper over the roast. Step 5: Remove onions to a bowl. Step 6: Turn heat to medium, brown roast in the stockpot, turning about every five minutes to brown all sides. Step 7: Add wine, cook for five minutes. Step 8: Stir sugars into coffee, add to stockpot. Step 9: Return onions to stockpot.

Ingredient Names: beef liver, onions, flour, extra virgin olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Cover bottom of very large skillet with olive oil. Step 2: Slice the onions 1 / 8 of an inch thick & place into skillet. Step 3: Add 1 / 4 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp paprika & 1 tsp curry Saut on low heat & covered about 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours. Step 4: Cut liver into 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch cubes. Step 5: Place the cubed liver into a plastic bag with 4 tbsp flour, 1 / 2 tsp salt & 1 / 2 tsp pepper Shake the bag to fully coat all of the liver. Step 6: In a clean skillet, cover bottom with olive oil & on high heat get the oil very hot! Step 7: Place the liver into the extremely hot oil & sear the liver on both sides Add a little more salt, pepper & curry if needed.

Ingredient Names: ground round, parmesan cheese, dry breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, tomato sauce, dry mustard, dried italian seasoning, salt, red pepper, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Shape mixture into balls about 1 1 / 2" Place on broiler pan that is coated with cooking spray. Step 3: Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until done.

Ingredient Names: oil, garlic, chuck roast, onion soup mix, tomato paste, all-purpose flour, chili powder, oregano, water, whole tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In dutch oven or heavy saucepan, heat oil and brown garlic until golden. Step 2: Add meat and brown well. Step 3: Stir in onion recipe soup mix, tomato paste, flour, chili powder, oregano, water and tomatoes. Step 4: Bring to boil while stirring, then simmer, covered, 2 to 2-1 / 2 hours, or until meat is tender If desired, serve with hot, buttered noodles and grated parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Beef Mushroom Ragu Over Fresh Cheese Ravioli
Ingredient Names: olive oil, mushrooms, onion, garlic, lean ground beef, tomatoes, tomato paste, italian seasoning, sugar, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cheese ravioli, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add mushroom, onions and garlic and saut 6 minutes or until onions are soft. Step 3: Remove mixture from the skillet and set aside. Step 4: Add the lean ground beef to the skillet and cook about 6 minutes or until no longer pink. Step 5: Add the mushroom mixture, tomatoes, tomato paste, italian seasoning, sugar and salt and pepper to the beef mixture. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have had chance to blend While cooking the sauce, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 7: Add ravioli and cook according to package directions. Step 8: Drain and return to pot, adding 1 tbsp olive oil and toss to coat. Step 9: Spoon ravioli into a serving dish and top with sauce.

Ingredient Names: chuck steaks, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic, fresh italian parsley, oregano, onion, white button mushrooms, green pepper, italian plum tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Coat the bottom of a large pan with olive oil. Step 2: Using your hands, crush the canned tomatoes and add about half of them to the bottom of the pan. Step 3: Add half of the salt, pepper, garlic, parsley, oregano and onions to the pan. Step 4: Place the meat on top of this mixture. Step 5: Cover the meat with remaining crushed tomatoes, salt, pepper, garlic, parsley, oregano, mushrooms and onions. Step 6: Cover pan tightly and cook over a low flame for about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours. Step 7: Add the green peppers to the pan for the last 15 minutes of cooking time To prepare this in the oven instead of stove top, use a shallow roasting pan,, cover pan tightly and bake at 325-350f for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours. Step 8: Serve with potatoes or rice and a green salad.

Ingredient Names: salt, lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, beef broth, fresh oregano, pepper, orzo pasta, frozen chopped spinach, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle salt into a 10 to 12 inch frying pan over medium-high heat Crumble beef into pan and cook, stirring often, until meat begins to brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium, stir in onion, and continue to cook, stirring, until onion is soft but not brown, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Spoon off and discard excess fat. Step 4: Add garlic, tomatoes and their liquid, broth, oregano, and pepper. Step 5: Bring mixture to a boil then stir in pasta. Step 6: Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently until pasta is tender to bite, 10 to 12 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, squeeze as much liquid as possible from spinach. Step 8: Stir spinach into pasta mixture just until heated through. Step 9: Serve with cheese to add to taste.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, beef chuck roast, ground black pepper, kosher salt, yellow onion, garlic, harissa, tomato paste, red wine, crushed tomatoes, bay leaf, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high. Step 2: Season chuck roast with pepper and salt. Step 3: Sear meat until browned on every side, working in batches if necessary, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Remove from Dutch oven and transfer to a large plate. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and stir in onion. Step 6: Cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Stir in harissa and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, until caramelized, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Pour in wine and cook, scraping the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon to loosen any browned bits, until reduced by two thirds, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Stir in tomatoes, bay leaf, chuck roast, and remaining salt. Step 11: Reduce heat to medium-low and cover. Step 12: Cook, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender, sauce has thickened, and flavors meld, about 2 1/. Step 13: Remove and discard bay leaf. Step 14: Transfer meat from Dutch oven to a cutting board and shred using 2 forks. Step 15: Return meat to pot and stir in pappardelle. Step 16: Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Beef Rolls In Red Wine Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: top sirloin steaks, garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, prosciutto, parmesan cheese, olive oil, dry red wine, carrot, onion, celery, canned tomatoes, salt & pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Pound each piece of the beef into thin slices. Step 2: Spread a little bit of the minced garlic, chopped rosemary and grated cheese over each slice. Step 3: Cover this with a slice of prosciutto, and roll up into a small bundle, securing each with toothpicks. Step 4: Heat the oil in a large skillet and brown all of the bundles well on all sides, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Transfer to a separate dish, and add the onion, carrots, and celery to the skillet. Step 6: Cook until the vegetables are tender. Step 7: Add the wine, and cook up until it is reduced by half, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Step 8: Add the tomatoes, and season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Cook over medium heat, until the sauce has begun to thicken, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Remove the toothpicks from the bundles, and return them to the skillet.

Dish Name: Beef Rolls With Parmesan Pine Nuts Olives And Capers
Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, garlic, salt, black pepper, olive oil, green olives, capers, pine nuts, fresh breadcrumb, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, fresh flat-leaf parsley, beef top round steak
Instructions: Step 1: Make tomato sauce: cook tomatoes with garlic, salt, and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper in 2 tablespoons oil in a 2-quart heavy saucepan over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes have broken down and sauce is thickened, 8 to 12 minutes. Step 2: Make filling: while tomatoes are cooking, pulse olives, capers, and 2 tablespoons pine nuts in a food processor until coarsely chopped and transfer to a bowl. Step 3: Stir in bread crumbs, cheese, 2 tablespoons parsley, 1 tablespoon oil, and remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper Pulse tomato sauce in cleaned processor until coarsely pured, then return to saucepan and keep warm. Step 4: Make beef rolls: pound meat between 2 sheets of plastic wrap with flat side of a meat pounder or with a rolling pin until 1 / 8 inch thick, then cut each piece in half crosswise. Step 5: Sprinkle 1 piece of beef evenly with one fourth of filling Starting with a long side, roll up beef, then tie in 3 places with kitchen string. Step 6: Season beef roll well with salt and pepper. Step 7: Make 3 more rolls with remaining beef and filling. Step 8: Heat remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over moderately high heat until just beginning to smoke, then cook beef rolls, turning, until well browned on outside, 3 to 4 minutes for medium-rare.

Dish Name: Beef Rotini Salad With Tomato Basil Dressing
Ingredient Names: minced garlic cloves, cornstarch, balsamic vinegar, sugar, salt, vegetable oil, sirloin beef, extra virgin olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, tomatoes, green onions, basil, rotini pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef and marinade ingredients. Step 2: Let sit, covered, at room temperature for at least 1 hour. Step 3: Cook rotini until al dente. Step 4: In a medium-size bowl, combine together balsamic vinegar, olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, sugar, tomato, green onion, and basil Brown meat in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Drain and toss with warm rotini and dressing. Step 6: Sprinkle generously with parmesan cheese The dressing will flavor this salad better if the pasta is warm when dressed Leftover roast beef can also replace the sirloin.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, fresh spinach, greek olives, green onion, italian salad dressing, cream cheese, pita bread rounds, deli roast beef
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredient, toss, let stand 5 minutes. Step 2: Spread 1 1 / 2 tbs cream cheese inside each bread half, fill each with equal portions of salad mixture and roast beef Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, beef short ribs, salt and pepper, pancetta, onion, fennel, baby carrots, garlic cloves, portabella mushrooms, red wine, hot red pepper flakes, dried oregano, crushed plum tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a large stovetop-to-oven-to-tabletop casserole, 12 by 2 inches deep Rub the ribs with salt and pepper and brown them in batches Do not crowd the ribs or they will steam instead of brown As they brown, transfer them to a dish If there is a lot of fat in the pan, drain off most of it, leaving about 2 tablespoons Brown the pancetta. Step 3: Stir in the onions, fennel, and carrots and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften. Step 4: Stir in the garlic and cook 2 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the mushrooms and cook 2 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, pepper, boneless beef round steak, vegetable oil, dry red wine, water, garlic, pitted ripe olives, carrots, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour, salt, and pepper Pound into the steak on both sides. Step 2: Cut steak in 6 pieces. Step 3: Heat oil in 10 inch skillet. Step 4: Cook and brown beef for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Add wine, garlic, and water, heat to boiling. Step 6: Reduce heat, cover and simmer 1 hour. Step 7: Add olives, carrots, and onions. Step 8: Cover and simmer until beef and carrots are tender, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, lean ground beef, taco seasoning, egg whites, ricotta cheese, cheddar cheese, chunky salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink, drain. Step 3: Stir in taco seasoning. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine egg whites and ricotta cheese. Step 5: Drain noodles In each of two 13-in X 9-in X 2-in Baking dishes, layer four noodles, 3 / 4 cup ricotta mixture, half of the beef mixture and 1-1 / 3 cups cheddar cheese.

Ingredient Names: rump steak, pepperoni, oil, onion, tomato paste, water, red wine, salt & pepper, cannellini beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and add the onion, beef & sausage, saute over high heat, stirring constantly until the beef juices run. Step 2: Pour in the tomato paste, water & wine & season with salt & pepper. Step 3: Bring to the boil & cover & simmer for 45 minutes. Step 4: Add the beans & cook uncovered for a further 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, olive oil, onions, garlic, passata basil, sugar, cannelloni tubes, butter, flour, milk, soft cheese garlic herbs, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: For the filling, dry-fry the beef in a non-stick pan on a medium-high heat, breaking up with a wooden spoon until browned – about 10 mins. Remove and set aside. Add the oil and cook the onion for 5 mins, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 min more, then tip in the beef and 1½ jars of the passata sauce and the sugar. Simmer for 20 mins while you make the white sauce. Step 2: Heat the butter in a small pan. When foaming, stir in the flour for 1 min. Add the milk gradually, stirring all the time to achieve a lump-free sauce, then bubble for 2 mins while stirring. Remove from the heat and stir in the soft cheese with seasoning until dissolved. Set aside, covered with cling film to stop a skin forming. Step 3: To assemble, pour the remaining tomato sauce into the base of 2-3 large baking dishes or 12 individual ovenproof dishes or foil containers. Spoon the beef into the cannelloni tubes using a teaspoon and lay on top of the sauce. Pour on the white sauce, then sprinkle with Parmesan. If freezing, allow to cool, then freeze wrapped well in cling film. To eat straight away, heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and cook for 40-45 mins until the pasta is tender and topping golden. Defrost frozen cannelloni thoroughly, then cook as above for 50 mins-55 mins.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, ravioli, shredded mozzarella cheese, monterey jack cheese, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Step 2: Crumble the ground beef into a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook and stir until no longer pink. Step 4: Drain grease, then stir in the spaghetti sauce and tomatoes. Step 5: Spread 1/3 of the sauce in the bottom of an 11x7 inch baking dish. Step 6: Arrange 1/2 of the ravioli over the sauce. Step 7: Sprinkle 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese and 1/2 of the Monterey Jack cheese over the ravioli. Step 8: Repeat layers, ending with the last of the sauce on top. Step 9: Cover with aluminum foil. Step 10: Bake for in the preheated oven. Step 11: Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the top before serving.

Ingredient Names: egg noodles, ground beef, onion, tomato sauce, garlic powder, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, cream cheese, cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, green onion, green pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles according to pkg. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook beef and onion, drain. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, garlic powder, italian seasoning, salt and pepper In bowl, mix cream cheese, cottage cheese, parmesan, onion and pepper, drain noodles. Step 4: Put half the noodles in a sprayed 13x9 baking pan. Step 5: Top with half the meat and half the cheese mix, repeat layers. Step 6: Cover and bake at 350 for 35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef, frozen cut green beans, onion, spaghetti, garlic clove, parsley flakes, beef stock, salt, olive oil, pepper, mushroom, bay leaf, tomato sauce, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a large dutch oven, brown the ground beef, onion and garlic in the olive oil, drain. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients to the dutch oven. Step 3: Simmer approximately 20 minutes or until spaghetti is done Individual bowls of soup may be topped with some freshly grated parmesan cheese if desired.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, parsley, garlic clove, milk, eggs, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together and shape into balls ~ about the size of a golfball Brown the meatballs by placing in a shallow baking dish and baking at 350 for 15 minutes until golden brown. Step 2: Place hot meatballs into sauce and let simmer while your pasta cooks Here's how i freeze the meat spheres ~ i make them up and cook them as above I let them cool a bit, place on a cookie sheet in the freezer and when they are frozen, transfer to a ziplock I take out the amount i need for dinner and put them in a pan with a jar of sauce and let them simmer for 30 minutes at least ~ no need to defrost them first ~ until they are cooked!, very simple!

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, onion, lean ground beef, spaghetti sauce, provolone cheese, sour cream, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add ziti pasta, and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes, drain. Step 3: In a large skillet, brown onion and ground beef over medium heat. Step 4: Add spaghetti sauce, and simmer 15 minutes. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f Butter a 9 inch baking dish. Step 6: Layer as follows: 1 / 2 of the ziti, provolone cheese, sour cream, 1 / 2 sauce mixture, remaining ziti, mozzarella cheese and remaining sauce mixture. Step 7: Top with grated parmesan cheese. Step 8: Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until cheeses are melted.

Ingredient Names: mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs, italian seasoning, spaghetti sauce, lasagna noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix up cheeses reserving about 4 cups to top lasagna. Step 2: Add eggs and italian seasoning I do this with in two batches. Step 3: Now you are ready to assemble lasagna. Step 4: Pour small amount of sauce in bottom of pan just enough to cover. Step 5: Layer noodles over sauce. Step 6: Spoon cheese mixture as evenly as you can over noodles and smooth with spoon. Step 7: Layer noodles over cheese then pour on sauce to cover. Step 8: Repeat with noodles, cheese, noodles, sauce again and then top with cheese. Step 9: Then: i cover loosely with foil to prevent cheese from over browning.

Dish Name: Best Ever Slow Cooker Italian Beef Roast
Ingredient Names: beef chuck roast, onion, beef broth, au jus mix, italian dressing mix, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chuck roast in a slow cooker; scatter onion quarters around roast. Step 2: Pour beef broth over roast; sprinkle au jus mix, dressing mix, salt, and black pepper over roast, cover cooker. Step 3: Cook on Low until meat very tender, 6 to.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, ketchup, italian seasoning, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic salt, diced tomatoes, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Mix ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, and ketchup in a large bowl until well combined. Step 4: Season with Italian-style seasoning, oregano, basil, garlic salt, diced tomatoes, and cheese. Step 5: Press into a 9x5-inch loaf pan, and cover loosely with foil. Step 6: Bake in the preheated oven until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees F (70 degrees C), about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, egg, stale bread, oregano, parmesan cheese, sugar, salt, pepper, whole tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, bell pepper, garlic, bay leaf, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put all sauce ingredients into large pot and cook for 2 hours. Step 2: Mix egg with bread crumbs and mix remaining ingredients with salt and pepper to taste Form into balls and add to sauce. Step 3: Cook one more hour. Step 4: Serve over spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: light olive oil, chuck roast, garlic cloves, fresh parsley, bay leaf, dried thyme, italian stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil until hot in a dutch oven large enough to accomodate the roast. Step 2: Season the trimmed beef with a little salt and pepper. Step 3: Place the roast in the dutch oven and sear the roast on both sides. Step 4: Once the roast is browned on both sides, turn down the heat and add the garlic, parsley, baf leaf, thyme, tomatoes, tomato paste and red wine, cover with water. Step 5: Cover and cook for one hour and check for liquid level The roast not be dry, if so, add more water until it is covered, check again in anohter hour for tenderness Again, if the roast is dry, add water to cover The roast should be finished cooking and fall apart tender in a sauce in 3 hours. Step 6: Serve with spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, celery, carrot, dried porcini mushrooms, chicken broth, marsala wine, water, veal shanks, flour, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, combine dried mushrooms and hot water Allow mushrooms to reconstitute, making sure to save the liquid! Step 2: Season veal with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, shaking off excess. Step 3: Heat oil over medium high heat in deep skillet, and brown veal shanks on both sides, adding more oil as needed. Step 4: Remove veal from pan, add diced vegetables and mushrooms, cook for for 5-10 minutes or until browned, adding more oil if needed. Step 5: Return veal to pan, add wine and reduce for 5 minutes Be sure to scrape up any brown bits off the bottom of the pan--that's where the flavor is! Step 6: Add mushroom water, tomato sauce, and chicken broth. Step 7: Simmer on very low heat for at least 45 minutes, or bake at 325 degrees for 1 and 1 / 2 hours, or until veal is fork tender. Step 8: Serve over creamy polenta, rice, mashed potatoes, or egg noodles.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumbs, eggs, dried parsley flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, milk, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Crumble the beef into a large bowl. Step 2: Mix in the grated parmesan, bread crumbs, parsley flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper. Step 3: Mix in eggs, one at a time If your eggs are jumbo, you probably only need 3 eggs If they are smaller, you'll want 4 eggs. Step 4: Add about 1 / 4 cup milk to help moisture Use a little more or less as needed You want the meat to be able to stick together when you form balls, but it shouldn't be so wet it is mushy Lightly grease 2 912 baking dishes Form meat mixture into balls.

Ingredient Names: beef t-bone steaks, olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, lemons, garlic cloves, butter, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the steaks with a little oil, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice Oil the bbq or grill and seal one side of the steaks, then turn the steaks over and sprinkle them with salt and a little more oil and lemon juice Vigorously rub the cut side of the garlic along the bone and cook the steaks on a high heat, covered, for about 7-8 minutes, turning the steaks a couple of times. Step 2: Mix together the butter, the juice of the 1 / 2 lemon and the parsley, and serve the steaks with a dollop of the butter mixture on top and steamed spinach or your choice of vegetables on the side.

Dish Name: Bistecca Alla Pizzaiola Steak With The Pizzaiolos Wifes Sauce
Ingredient Names: beef t-bone steaks, salt and pepper, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, tomatoes, red pepper flakes, fresh oregano, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare tomato sauce place about a tbsp of oil and a crushed clove of garlic in a medium size pot. Step 2: Let garlic turn slightly golden but remove from pot before it becomes too brown. Step 3: Add tomatoes with their liquid and simmer until there is little to no more liquid on top of the sauce, set aside. Step 4: Season steaks on both sides with salt and pepper. Step 5: Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 6: Add garlic and saute for 1 minute then add steaks Quickly brown 1 minute on both sides then transfer to a plate. Step 7: Add the red pepper flakes and oregano to the pan the steaks were cooked in, then add the wine and cook stirring until the liquid is slightly reduced. Step 8: Add tomato sauce, stir then return steak to pan.

Ingredient Names: porterhouse steak, rosemary, olive oil, sea salt, pepper, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Press chopped rosemary onto both sides of porterhouse steak; set onto a plate and allow to marinate at room temperature for 2 hours. Step 2: Start an outdoor grill using hardwood charcoal, such as hickory. Step 3: When coals are white and glowing, arrange for high heat. Step 4: Gently brush or rub olive oil onto steak, then season to taste with sea salt and pepper. Step 5: Place steak onto grill, and cook until a dark, golden brown (not burnt) crust forms, 5 to depending on thickness of meat. Step 6: Turn over, and continue cooking until golden on the other side, 5 to more. Step 7: When finished, place steak onto a platter, and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Step 8: To serve, remove the two pieces of meat from the bone, and replace the bone onto the serving platter. Step 9: Trim any unwanted fat from the round (tenderloin) steak, slice into 6 equal pieces at an angle to the grain, and fan out on one side of the bone. Step 10: Slice the rectangular (loin) steak into 1/4-inch slices at an angle to the grain. Step 11: Fan out on the other side of the bone. Step 12: Finish by garnishing the platter with lemon wedges and a sprinkle of additional sea salt.

Ingredient Names: porterhouse steak, mushroom, mixed greens, red onion, mandarin orange sections, blue cheese, salt and pepper, raspberry balsamic vinegar, onion, garlic, soy sauce, salt, pepper, light olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together all the dressing ingredients, except the oil Slowly whisk in the oil to incorporate, pour about 2 large tablespoons of the vinaigrette over the steak and mix. Step 2: Refrigerate the rest until needed. Step 3: Heat a medium saut pan over high / medium-high heat with a little oil in it. Step 4: Add the mushroom slices, season with salt and pepper, and brown on both sides. Step 5: Add the steak and saut until browned. Step 6: Place the european mixed greens on a large plate or bowl, sprinkle the onions over the top, pour the steak and mushrooms in the center, places the mandarin orange sections around the steak and mushrooms, sprinkle with blue cheese and salt and pepper, pour on dressing Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: bacon, sweet italian sausage, ground beef, onion, carrot, celery ribs, garlic cloves, olive oil, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, red wine, beef broth, milk, mixed italian herbs, cracked black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon until crisp in large dutch oven or pan, remove grease. Step 2: Add olive oil add onion celery carrot and garlic and saute til soft 10 minutes. Step 3: Remove casings from sausage and add to pot along with ground beef. Step 4: Cook until no longer pink. Step 5: Add tomato paste and stir til blended. Step 6: Add red wine and 1 cup beef broth cook until reduced to thick paste. Step 7: Add milk, crushed tomato's1 cup beef broth and all herbs, salt and pepper. Step 8: Simmer on low heat 2-3 hours.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, pancetta, onion, garlic cloves, carrots, celery ribs, dried thyme, salt, pepper, fennel seed, milk, whole tomatoes, crushed tomatoes, red wine, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a large dutch oven, saute beef over medium-high heat, breaking up with spoon, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes, drain off any fat. Step 2: Add pancetta, onion, garlic, carrots, celery, thyme, salt, pepper and fennel seeds. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are softened, about 8 minutes, add milk. Step 4: Simmer until almost all liquid has evaporated, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add tomatoes, crushed tomatoes, wine, bay leaf and sugar, breaking up tomatoes with potato masher, bring to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer until thickened and mixture can mound on spoon, about 1 hour, discard bay leaf.

Dish Name: Bolognese Made By A Polish Girl
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, red bell pepper, carrot, celery rib, mushrooms, chianti wine, fresh italian parsley, ground beef, ground pork, worcestershire sauce, italian spices, red pepper flakes, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy bottom pot on medium heat, heat up the olive oil, add the garlic, onion, pepper, carrot, celery, and mushrooms cook allowing them to soften about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add chianti and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add 1 / 2 the parsley, meats, mix everything together breaking up and cook over a gentle flame until the meat has changed color. Step 4: Add worcestershire sauce, italian seasonings, red pepper flakes, basil, tomato puree, diced tomatoes, and paste. Step 5: Simmer gently for half an hour and season to taste with salt and black pepper Be sure to stir not to burn this rich thick sauce If the mixture is dry add a little more olive oil, some vodka, or tomato puree. Step 6: Serve over pasta, topped with parmesan cheese and remaining fresh parsley to garnish.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, onion, bacon, carrot, celery, garlic clove, lean ground beef, salt and pepper, red wine, milk, plum tomatoes, bay leaf, fresh thyme leave, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the butter and oil in a heavy saucepan. Step 2: Add the onion, and cook over moderate heat for 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add the bacon and cook until the onion is translucent. Step 4: Stir in the carrot, celery and garlic. Step 5: Cook 3-4 minutes more. Step 6: Add the beef and crumble it into the vegetables with a fork. Step 7: Stir until the meat loses its red color. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Pour in the wine, raise the heat slightly, and cook until the liquid evaporates, 3-4 minutes. Step 10: Add the milk and cook until it evaporates.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, bacon, garlic, lean ground beef, ground pork, plum tomatoes, fresh mushrooms, tomato sauce, carrots, celery, dry white wine, chicken stock, dried basil, dried oregano, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Warm oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Saut茅 onion, bacon, and garlic in hot oil until bacon is browned and crisp, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Use a slotted spoon to transfer bacon mixture to a paper towel-lined plate to drain; set aside. Step 4: Place the same large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Cook and stir ground beef and pork in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 6: Drain and discard grease. Step 7: Stir bacon mixture, tomatoes, mushrooms, tomato sauce, carrots, celery, wine, stock, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper into meat mixture, bring to a boil. Step 8: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer sauce for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 9: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 10: Add pasta and cook in boiling water until al dente, 8 to; drain. Step 11: Serve sauce over hot pasta.

Dish Name: Bolognese Sauce Traditional Italian Meat Based Sauce For Pasta
Ingredient Names: pancetta, extra virgin olive oil, unsalted butter, green pepper, carrots, celery & tops, yellow onion, whole mushrooms, garlic cloves, lemon, italian sausage, ground beef, salt, dry red wine, whole milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a nonstick skillet saute' the pancetta until brown and crisp. Step 2: Remove from pan and drain on paper towels, set aside. Step 3: Put the pepper, carrots, celery, onion, mushrooms and garlic in a food processor Pulse until finely chopped Over a medium flame, heat the olive oil and butter in a large, deep saute' pan with a thick, heavy bottom To the pan add the chopped vegetables and lemon zest, saute' for 6 or 7 minutes - until the onions turn clear and the garlic starts to "dance" Pour all ingredients into a large bowl Reserve for later Continuing to cook over a medium flame, add the sausage links to the saute' pan, breaking into bite-sized clumps with a fork while it cooks.

Ingredient Names: pancetta, carrots, celery, onions, extra-virgin olive oil, lean ground beef, ground pork, dry white wine, tomatoes, ground nutmeg, salt, crushed red pepper, beef stock, heavy cream, grated parmesan cheese, tagliatelle
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pancetta in a pan over medium heat until it has released its fat and is crisp, 7 to. Step 2: Add carrots, celery, and onions; cook until vegetables soften and onions are translucent, 7 to, set aside. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a 4-quart pot over medium heat. Step 4: Break ground beef and pork into small chunks and add them to the pot; cook, stirring lightly, until browned, 7 to. Step 5: Stir pancetta-vegetable mixture into ground meat, add wine. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low and stir, breaking up meat until finely ground, until wine has evaporated and the pot is almost dry, 13 to. Step 7: Add tomatoes, nutmeg, salt, and red pepper. Step 8: Use the back of a spoon to break up tomatoes and continue to break down meat mixture into tiny bits, about 2 minutes. Step 9: Pour beef stock and heavy cream into the pot and reduce heat to lowest setting. Step 10: Simmer, partially covered and stirring occasionally, for at least 15-20 minutes. Step 11: Meanwhile, fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 12: Cook tagliatelle at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Step 13: Reserve pasta water and drain well. Step 14: Stir pasta into Bolognese sauce and mix well, adding a little reserved pasta water if needed to develop a satiny coating. Step 15: Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, salt, ground black pepper, chopped fresh parsley, grated parmesan cheese, garlic, hard-boiled egg, flank steak, toothpicks, tomato sauce, tomato, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion; cook and stir until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Combine parsley, Parmesan cheese, garlic, hard-boiled egg, salt, and black pepper in a bowl; drizzle in about olive oil, stirring continuously, until a sticky consistency is reached. Step 5: Spread parsley filling in a thin layer on flank steak. Step 6: Roll steak in a jelly-roll style; fasten closed with toothpicks to contain filling. Step 7: Add remaining olive oil to skillet with onion mixture over medium heat, then add steak roll, turning until browned on all sides, 2 to per side. Step 8: Add tomato sauce, chopped tomato, and sugar; simmer over very low heat until steak cooked through and sauce slightly reduced, 1 to 1 1/.

Dish Name: Braciola Braciole Italian Stuffed Beef Rolls
Ingredient Names: top round steak, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt and pepper, olive oil, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the steak very thin and cut into 4 pieces. Step 2: Place a slice of mozzarella on each piece, then top with parmesan, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Step 3: Roll each piece up tightly and secure with a string. Step 4: Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet and brown the rolls evenly on each side. Step 5: Drop them in your favorite pasta sauce and allow them to simmer for 2 hours or until tender and cooked through. Step 6: Remove the strings and serve.

Dish Name: Braciola Braciole With Tomato And Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: round steaks, garlic cloves, soft breadcrumbs, bacon, hard-boiled eggs, oregano leaves, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, salt, pepper, olive oil, crushed tomatoes, onion powder, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Place steaks between waxed paper or plastic wrap- pound until very thin. Step 2: Cut steaks into serving size pieces, or you can roll the whole thing and tie with string combine garlic, crumbs, egg, bacon, 1 1 / 2 tsp oregano, cheese, parsley flakes, 1 / 2 tsp salt 1 / 8 teaspoons pepper, 1 tbs Olive oil. Step 3: Spoon equal amounts of this mixture on steaks. Step 4: Roll steak and tie with string, or secure with toothpicks. Step 5: Heat oil in skillet and brown rolls. Step 6: Transfer to oven proof casserole. Step 7: Add tomatoes, onion powder, 1 tsp oregano, 1 / 2 tsp salt, 1 / 8 tsp black pepper. Step 8: Simmer, covered for 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 9: Add water if necessary- add wine and cook another 10 minute.

Dish Name: Braciole Courtesy Of Giada De Laurentiis
Ingredient Names: breadcrumbs, garlic cloves, fresh parmesan cheese, provolone cheese, fresh parsley, marjoram, thyme, basil, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil, salt, pepper, flank steaks, dry white wine, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Stir the the bread crumbs, cheeses, garlic and herbs together with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil Pound the flank steak as thin as possible. Step 2: Add the mixture of herbs and cheese to the flank steak and spread evenly on the work surface Starting at one end, roll up the flank steak like for a jelly roll, and tie off with butcher's twine or toothpick. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 4: Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a heavy large ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add the flank steak and cook until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes. Step 6: Add the wine to the pan and bring to a boil. Step 7: Stir in the tomato sauce. Step 8: Cover partially with foil and bake until the meat is almost tender, turning the braciole and basting with the sauce every 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: top round beef, white bread, dried parsley, pine nuts, garlic, fennel seeds, prosciutto di parma, currants, egg, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, extra virgin olive oil, chunky marinara sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Get butcher to pound the meat thin, or you can have the butcher slice it thin on an electric slicer If you are getting your meat from a store that does not have a butcher to pound the meat slices thin, then place a slice between 2 pieces of waxed paper and pound it yourself with either a heavy skillet or a mallet. Step 2: Combine filling ingredients and the prosciutto di parma and mix together very thoroughly with a spoon or your hands. Step 3: After the ingredients are mixed together, add the pieces of bread and mix again, lightly. Step 4: Cut each slice in half to make 4 pieces and top with 2 slices of mozzarella or fontina cheese and 2 slices of the prosciutto di parma per braciole. Step 5: Then spread ingredients on top. Step 6: Fold in the sides and roll them up longways very tightly, as you would an egg roll, securing the rolls with string or wooden toothpicks Each roll will be about 5 inches long and about 1 1 / 2 inches thick. Step 7: Pour olive oil into a large and very hot skillet Brown beef rolls on all sides in the hot olive oil.

Dish Name: Braciole Stuffed Beef Rolls In Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless beef round steak, garlic cloves, pecorino romano cheese, flat leaf parsley, salt, pepper, prosciutto, olive oil, dry red wine, tomato puree, fresh basil leaves, ziti pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Place beef between two pieces of plastic wrap Pound gently with a meat pounder or mallet to 1 / 4-1 / 8 inch thickness. Step 2: Remove and discard plastic wrap. Step 3: Place one slice of the prosciutto on each beef slice. Step 4: Sprinkle beef slices with the finely chopped garlic, cheese, parsley, salt and pepper. Step 5: Roll each of the beef slices into a tight roll and secure with a toothpick. Step 6: Heat the olive oil in a large pot. Step 7: Add the braciole and crushed garlic. Step 8: Cook, turning the meat occasionally, until it is browned on all sides and the garlic is golden. Step 9: Add the red wine and simmer for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Braised Beef And Tortelloni Olive Garden Copycat
Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless beef short rib, garlic clove, tomatoes, fresh mushrooms, marsala wine, flour, italian seasoning, tortellini
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil on high heat in a large nonstick pan. Step 2: Toss short ribs in flour, add to pan, and sear on all sides. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and add garlic. Step 4: Cook and stir for about 1 min. Step 5: Add tomato, mushrooms, marsala wine, and italian seasoning one at a time, allowing about 1-2 min between each for liquid to evaporate. Step 6: Cover pan and braise for 3 hr or until very tender, checking and stirring every 30 min to make sure liquid has not evaporated away Increase heat to medium high and heat thoroughly. Step 7: Serve over tortelloni.

Dish Name: Braised Beef In Red Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: beef eye round, olive oil, onion, bacon, tomato paste, bay leaves, whole cloves, rosemary, dry red wine, low sodium beef broth, italian tomato, polenta, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Season beef. Step 2: Heat oil in large dutch oven over high heat. Step 3: Add beef and brown on all sides, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Transfer beef to platter. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium. Step 6: Add onion and bacon to pot Saut until onion is golden, about 8 minutes. Step 7: Mix in tomato paste, bay leaves, cloves and rosemary, add wine. Step 8: Return meat and any juices.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck roast, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, celery ribs, carrots, onion, garlic cloves, red wine, crushed tomatoes, thyme, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Step 2: Place it in a wide, deep baking pan. Step 3: Preheat the broiler, and put the rack 4" from the heat, or enough room to allow for the pan. Step 4: Put the meat under the broiler and leave the door ajar so the element stays lit Broil for about 15 min, or until a deep brown. Step 5: Turn it over, and broil for 5 min more As the meat cooks, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add the onion, celery, and carrot Increase the heat to high and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 min, or until softened If the vegetables begin to burn or stick, turn the heat down.

Ingredient Names: veal shanks, all-purpose flour, olive oil, onion, carrot, celery rib, garlic clove, water, dry white wine, salt, dried basil, dried thyme, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Trim excess fat from veal shanks Coat veal with flour. Step 2: Heat oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Cook veal in oilabout 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until brown on all sides, drain. Step 4: Place veal in 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Step 5: Mix remaining ingredients, pour over veal. Step 6: Cover and cook on low heat setting 8-10 hours or until veal is very tender and pulls away from bones. Step 7: Remove veal and vegetables from cooker, using slotted spoon.

Ingredient Names: peppercorn, red onion, butter, brandy, demi-glace, heavy cream, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a small sautee pan add onions, peppercorns and butter Sautee until somewhat soft Add 1 / 2 cup of brandy and reduce until its almost gone It will catch fire! Step 2: Add the rest of the brandy, demi-glace, cream, and reduce until thick enough to pour over steak, salt to taste Best with filet!

Ingredient Names: rump roast, breadcrumbs, eggs, water, garlic powder, salt, cheese, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Have your butcher slice the rump roast on the lunch meat slicer This recipe is nice because it's sliced thin, it's always tender so you can get away with using a little cheaper piece of meat If you can't get it sliced this way, freezer meat for a few hours and slice thin slices. Step 2: Mix the eggs and water in a large bowl On a large sheet of foil--mix bread crumbs, garlic powder, salt and grated cheese. Step 3: Dip raw sliced beef in egg and than bread crumbs If you run out of egg or bread crumb mixture just make a little more. Step 4: Heat oil in large frying pan, put 2-3 slices in pan and fry until just browned. Step 5: Drain on paper towels. Step 6: Add more oil to the pan as needed.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic, carrots, tomatoes, dried basil, white sugar, salt, nutmeg, thyme, cabbage, cottage cheese, grated parmesan cheese, parsley, oregano, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook and stir ground beef, onion, and garlic in the hot skillet until meat is browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 3: Drain and discard grease. Step 4: Add carrots and mushrooms. Step 5: Add tomatoes and break up using a fork. Step 6: Add basil, sugar, salt, thyme, and nutmeg. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer meat sauce for 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 9: Immerse cabbage in the boiling water and carefully break off leaves. Step 10: Cook until leaves are limp, about 10 minutes, drain. Step 11: Combine cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, and oregano in a bowl and set aside. Step 12: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 13: Coat a 9x13-inch baking pan with cooking spray and place a layer of cooked cabbage leaves flat in the bottom. Step 14: Reserve meat sauce. Step 15: Layer 1/2 the remaining sauce on top of the cabbage leaves in the baking pan. Step 16: Layer 1/2 the cottage cheese mixture followed by 1/2 the mozzarella cheese. Step 17: Add a second layer of cabbage leaves, followed by remaining 1/2 of meat sauce, remaining cottage cheese mixture, and mozzarella cheese. Step 18: Sprinkle reserved meat sauce on top and finish with Parmesan cheese. Step 19: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 20: Remove from the oven and let sit before slicing.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, herbes de provence, worcestershire sauce, tomato soup, salt, black pepper, frozen mixed vegetables, pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the beef and onion until browned. Step 2: Add the herbes de provence, worcestershire sauce, tomato soup, salt, black pepper and mixed vegetables. Step 3: Bring to boil, stirring. Step 4: Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the cooked pasta and simmer for a further minute. Step 6: Serve garnished with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: capellini, bacon, onion, veal cutlet, flour, chablis, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, salt, dried oregano, dried thyme, tomatoes, ripe olives, prosciutto, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Set aside and keep warm. Step 3: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until it is transparent. Step 4: Add the onion, and cook, stirring constantly, until the bacon is crisp and the onion is tender. Step 5: Sprinkle the veal with the flour. Step 6: Add the veal to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until the veal is lightly browned. Step 7: Stir in the wine and the next 5 ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 8: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until veal is almost tender.

Dish Name: Capers Sun Dried Tomato Pasta Sauce
Ingredient Names: capers, italian-style peeled tomatoes, tomato paste, ground beef, ground pork, onion, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, basil, oregano, salt, sun-dried tomatoes, fresh basil, fresh oregano, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions and garlic in olive oil until fragrant in large fry pan. Step 2: Add beef, pork and salt to pan and brown over medium high heat Before beef and pork are completely cooked through, reduce heat to low and add plum tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, oregano, and capers with brine. Step 3: Chop sun dried tomatoes and add to pan. Step 4: Add any optional ingredients, if desired. Step 5: Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lean ground beef, hot italian sausage, onion, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, brown sugar, fennel seed, dry basil, dried thyme, dry oregano, salt, black pepper, dried parsley, eggs
