Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a heavy pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion, garlic, half of the ground meat, and the italian sausage Brown for 10 minutes. Step 4: Drain the meat mixture, if needed. Step 5: Add the tomato sauce, brown sugar, 1 tablespoon parsley, and 1 / 2 teaspoon each of the fennel seed, basil, thyme, oregano, black pepper and salt Gently stir, cover, and let simmer over low heat for 1 hour While the sauce is cooking, prepare the meatballs, ricotta cheese mixture, and lasagna noodles First, beat 1 egg in a large bowl. Step 6: Add the oatmeal, 1 / 2 cup of parmasan, and the rest of the ground meat, black pepper, fennel seed, basil, thyme, oregano, and salt.

Ingredient Names: pork necks, hot italian sausage, beef stew meat, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, beef broth, dried oregano, dried basil, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, brown the pork neckbones in a little olive oil. Step 2: Set aside Brown hot italian sausage, then add stew meat and brown, set aside. Step 3: Pour off some of the grease, then return all meats to the pot, with the 5 cloves of minced garlic. Step 4: Cook garlic briefly with the meats. Step 5: Add the two 28 ounce cans of crushed tomatoes, the 6 oz Can of tomato paste, beef broth, oregano, basil and pepper. Step 6: Simmer, partly covered for at least two hours- the longer, the better! Step 7: Stir occasionally to loosen a little meat from the pork neckbones.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, oregano, salt, black pepper, tomato soup, cooked elbow macaroni, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with onions and seasonings, drain fat. Step 2: Combine beef mixture, soup, and cooked noodles in a 1 5 quart casserole dish. Step 3: Sprinkle cheese over top of casserole. Step 4: Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, salt, onion, tomato sauce, water, sugar, oregano, nutmeg, noodles, spinach, ricotta cheese, sour cream, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef. Step 2: Add salt and onion, cook 5 minutes. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, water, sugar and spices, set aside. Step 4: Cook noodles until barely tender, drain. Step 5: Add meat sauce mixture. Step 6: Squeeze dry spinach and chop coarsley In 3-quart casserole dish, layer half of meat sauce mixture, add next layer of spinach, then remainder of meat sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, pork sausage, onion, green pepper, pepperoni slices, crushed tomatoes, spaghetti sauce, mild salsa, sliced mushrooms, pepperoncini peppers, shell pasta, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the beef, sausage, onion and green pepper until brown. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Mix the pepperoni, tomatoes, spaghetti sauce, salsa, mushrooms and salad peppers. Step 4: Stir into the meat mixture. Step 5: Add the cooked pasta shells. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 2 of the mixture into 2 greased 11x7 inch baking dishes. Step 7: Combine the two cheeses and divide the amount in half. Step 8: Take one half of the cheese and sprinkle on top of the meat in each dish. Step 9: Take the remaining 1 / 2 of the meat mixture and cover the cheese in the two dishes. Step 10: Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, salt, meatballs, campbell's cheddar cheese soup, italian salad dressing, barbecue sauce, ketchup, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat stove top on medium In medium sized sauce pan, put in cheddar cheese soup and meatballs, stir. Step 2: Put dressing, bbq sauce, ketchup and butter into meatball mix. Step 3: Stir on top of stove for 12-14 minutes or until meatballs are cooked. Step 4: When the mixture is ready, put spaghetti over stove on med-lo and add mixture. Step 5: Stir for 5 minutes. Step 6: Serve into big bowl, and top with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, water, diced tomatoes with garlic and olive oil, tomato paste, mafalda pasta, italian seasoning, pepper, croutons, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook, beef, onion and garlic in dutch oven over medium heat until beef is browned and onion is tender, drain. Step 2: Stir in water, diced tomatoes and tomato paste until blended. Step 3: Stir in remaining ingredients except croutons and cheese. Step 4: Heat to boiling then reduce heat. Step 5: Cover and simmer about 10 minutes until pasta is tender, set oven to broil. Step 6: Pour hot soup into 6 oven-proof soup bowls or casseroles. Step 7: Top each with 1 / 4 cup croutons. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: mostaccioli pasta, ground beef, cheddar cheese soup, spaghetti sauce, ground black pepper, italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a large bowl combine the 1st 6 ingredients and 2 cups of the mozzarella, saving 1 cup for the top of the dish. Step 3: Place mixture in casserole and add remaining 1 cup cheese to top, bake 25 minutes.

Dish Name: Cheese Stuffed Bacon Meatballs Aaron Mccargo Jr
Ingredient Names: apple-smoked bacon, ground chuck, worcestershire sauce, onion soup mix, panko breadcrumbs, coarse black pepper, beef stock, bite-size fresh mozzarella cheese balls
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Arrange the bacon slices on a sheet pan. Step 3: Put in the oven and bake until crisp, about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove the bacon from the pan to a cutting board and chop, set aside. Step 5: In a large bowl, mix together the beef, worcestershire, onion soup mix, bread crumbs, black pepper, stock and the chopped bacon Form portions of the meat around the mozzarella to make smooth balls. Step 6: Arrange the meatballs on a sheet pan with a rack and bake until thoroughly browned, about 10 to 15 minutes. Step 7: Serve with pasta and marinara sauce.

Dish Name: Cheese Stuffed Manicotti In Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: manicotti, spaghetti sauce, ground beef, eggs, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preaheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil. Step 3: Add salt if desired. Step 4: Place noodles in water and boil for 9 minutes. Step 5: Drain and rinse in cold water to prevent sticking While noodles are boiling, brown meat in a large skillet. Step 6: Drain and add spaghetti sauce. Step 7: Set simmer for 5 minutes, then turn off heat. Step 8: In a bowl, combine eggs, 1 cup mozzarella, half of the ricotta, parmesan and seasonings. Step 9: Pour a layer of meat sauce in the bottom of a baking dish, using half of what you have.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, ground pork, milk, breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, eggs, garlic cloves, kosher salt, ground pepper, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, tomato sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the milk and bread crumbs Whip eggs in separate bowl. Step 2: Then add to larger bowl along with the meats, parsley, garlic and pepper. Step 3: Mix ingredients briefly with hands Form into 2 inch balls Seal cheese cube into center of each meatball. Step 4: In a large skillet set on medium-high, heat oil to almost-smoking, browing meatballs for about a minute or so. Step 5: Transfer meatballs to tray. Step 6: Discard oil and place tomato sauce in skillet, heating to medium-high until it starts to simmer. Step 7: Add meatballs, cover and reduce heat to medium-low.

Dish Name: Cheeseburger Calzone Beef And Cheese Foldover
Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, barbecue sauce, american cheese, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, brown meat and onions over medium heat, drain. Step 2: Stir in sauce, then set aside Pre-heat oven to 375f On an ungreased cookie sheet, unroll crescent rolls into 4 triangles, overlapping on the long sides Firmly press perforations and edges to seal, and pat to form 15x13" rectangle. Step 3: Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4" wide strip down the center of dough to within 1" of ends. Step 4: Top meat with cheese. Step 5: Fold sides and ends of dough 1" over filling. Step 6: Bring long ends over, crimping the edges.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, mozzarella cheese, italian style breadcrumbs, parsley, egg, pepper, salt, spaghetti sauce, burgundy wine, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare macaroni shells according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Cook ground beef, onion, and garlic in a large skillet until beef is browned, drain excess fat. Step 4: Stir in next 6 ingredients, set aside. Step 5: Combine spaghetti sauce and wine. Step 6: Spoon one-fourth of sauce into a lightly greased oblong baking pan. Step 7: Set aside remaining sauce. Step 8: Stuff macaroni shells with beef mixture, and place in baking dish.

Ingredient Names: macaroni and cheese mix, ground beef, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Prepare dinner according to package directions. Step 3: Meanwhile, brown meat in large skillet, drain. Step 4: Add spaghetti sauce to meat, mix well. Step 5: Layer half each of the meat mixture and prepared dinner in 8-inch square baking dish, repeat layers. Step 6: Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Bake 15 minutes or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: shell pasta, rotini pasta, ground venison, ground pork, mixed italian herbs, spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, mushrooms, green chili peppers, sharp cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta according to package instructions, drain and pour into 13x9 pan While pasta is cooking, brown the meats. Step 2: Sprinkle with herbs, mixing well, remove from heat. Step 3: Mix spaghetti sauce with meat. Step 4: Add mushrooms and peppers. Step 5: Pour over pasta in pan. Step 6: Sprinkle on the grated cheeses. Step 7: Cover with foil or lid. Step 8: Bake for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, carrot, onion, garlic cloves, passata, tomato paste, water, lean ground beef, fresh breadcrumb, flat leaf parsley, egg, salt & freshly ground black pepper, low-fat cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy based casserole dish and add only half the carrot, onion, and garlic. Step 2: Cook over low heat for 2 minutes until softened. Step 3: Stir in passata, tomato paste and water, simmer for 5 minutes For the meatballs: combine the remaining carrot, onion and garlic with mince, breadcrumbs, parsley, egg and seasonings. Step 4: Knead thoroughly with your hands until the mixture is very sticky, shape the mixture into golf ball sized balls and stuff each with one cube of cheddar ensuring that the cheese is fully enclosed. Step 5: Drop the meatballs into the simmering sauce, cook over low heat, covered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Serve meatballs sprinkled with parsley and parmesan, over spaghetti or just accompanied with seasonal vegetables or a salad.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, garlic cloves, dried oregano leaves, spaghetti sauce, tomatoes, lasagna noodles, low fat cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f Brown meat with garlic and oregano in medium saucepan. Step 2: Stir in spaghetti sauce, simmer 5 minutes, remove from heat, stir in tomatoes. Step 3: Spread 1 / 2 cup of the sauce mixture in a 13x9-inch baking dish. Step 4: Layer 3 noodles, 1 cup of the cottage cheese, 1 / 2 cup of the mozzarella cheese, and 1 cup of the remaining sauce mixture in dish, repeat layers. Step 5: Top with remaining 3 noodles and remaining sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, saltine crackers, egg, ground pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f lightly oil a baking sheet, mix well. Step 2: Cook a small amount of mixture taste and adjust salt / pepper and cheese Form into 15 meatballs place on baking sheet bake for 10 minutes on one side turn meatballs w / spatula and bake another 10 minutes More freshly ground pepper may be added when still hot out of the oven if you wish.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, macaroni and cheese mix, milk, pizza sauce, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook the beef until no longer pink, drain. Step 2: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to package directions, using 1 / 3 cup milk and omitting margarine. Step 3: Spread 1 / 2 the pizza sauce into a 11x7 inch baking dish. Step 4: Layer with half the beef, half the macaroni and cheese and half the cheddar and mozzarella cheeses, repeat layers. Step 5: Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, wonton wrappers, tomato soup, water, tomato sauce, sugar, dried parsley, cheddar cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all of the ravioli ingredients into a small sauce pan, except the wonton wrappers, and turn the heat to low. Step 2: Cook the meat for about 10 minutes, or until browned You much stir this constantly and sometimes vigorously to keep the mixture smooth, no lumps! Step 3: Wet the edges of a wonton wrapper and place 1-1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture in the center. Step 4: Top with another wonton skin and press all of the air out of the ravioli while you are pressing the edges together to make a tight seal. Step 5: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 6: Place all of the sauce ingredients in a medium saucepan except the cheese and bring to a boil. Step 7: Add the ravioli to the boiling water and boil them, stirring occasionally for 5-8 minutes. Step 8: Remove the sauce from the heat and add the cheddar cheese and salt and pepper to taste. Step 9: Toss the ravioli and sauce together in a large bowl and serve.

Ingredient Names: beef top sirloin steaks, bread crumbs, garlic, olive oil, raisins, grated parmesan cheese, salt, ground black pepper, fresh oregano, egg, water, red pepper flakes, bay leaf, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place steaks between heavy plastic; pound meat about 1/4-inch thick using a meat pounder. Step 2: If a piece of meat breaks off, use it to patch a thinner area. Step 3: Place bread crumbs into a mixing bowl and stir in garlic, olive oil, raisins, Parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, oregano, and egg until thoroughly combined. Step 4: Season steak with salt and pepper; place half the bread crumb stuffing onto the bottom 2/3 of a steak, leaving the top third of the steak without stuffing. Step 5: Lightly press the stuffing onto the meat and roll the steak up into a tight roll, starting from the stuffed end. Step 6: Tie kitchen string around the roll to hold it together. Step 7: Trim ends of string. Step 8: Repeat with remaining steak and stuffing. Step 9: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Step 10: Pan-fry the steak rolls in the hot oil until well browned on all sides, 2 to per side. Step 11: Pour in water and dissolve pan juices and browned bits of food in the water. Step 12: Season steak rolls with salt and pepper; add red pepper flakes and bay leaf to the water. Step 13: Spread tomato sauce onto rolls. Step 14: Pan liquid should cover the rolls about halfway up. Step 15: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes; turn rolls over and cook covered about 10 more minutes. Step 16: An instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the center of the stuffing should read at least 145 degrees F (65 degrees C). Step 17: Remove from pan, transfer to a platter, and let them rest for 10 minutes. Step 18: Raise heat to medium, bring sauce to a boil, and cook, stirring often, until sauce has reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 19: Slice the rolls crosswise. Step 20: Serve arranged on a little sauce and drizzle more sauce on top.

Ingredient Names: bread crumbs, milk, olive oil, onion, ground beef, ground pork, eggs, grated parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, garlic, salt, ground black pepper, dried oregano, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Cover a baking sheet with foil and spray lightly with cooking spray. Step 3: Soak bread crumbs in milk in a small bowl for 30 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add onion; cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and continue cooking and stirring until onion is very tender, about more. Step 7: Gently stir beef and pork together in a large bowl. Step 8: Add onions, bread crumb mixture, eggs, Parmesan cheese, parsley, garlic, salt, black pepper, Italian herb seasoning, and red pepper flakes; mix together using a rubber spatula until combined. Step 9: Cover and refrigerate for about one hour. Step 10: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 11: Form mixture into balls about 1 陆 inches in diameter; arrange in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Step 12: Bake in the preheated oven until browned and cooked through, 15 to. Step 13: Serve with your favorite tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, garlic, ground beef, milk, ricotta cheese, parsley, large egg, kosher salt, ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, bread crumbs, water, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Saut茅 onion in olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Stir garlic into onion and turn off heat. Step 3: Transfer onion mixture to a large mixing bowl. Step 4: Stir ground beef, ricotta cheese, parsley, egg, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper with onion mixture until almost combined; stir in bread crumbs and continue to mix until thoroughly blended. Step 5: Roll about mixture into a 1-inch ball for each meatball. Step 6: Pour remaining olive oil in same skillet used to cook onions. Step 7: Place skillet over medium heat and brown meatballs on all sides in hot oil, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Hold a crumpled paper towel in tongs and use it to remove excess grease from skillet. Step 9: Pour marinara sauce and water over meatballs in skillet. Step 10: Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Step 11: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through and no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin steaks, salt and pepper, olive oil, sliced fresh mushrooms, butter, salt, garlic, white wine, dried oregano, tomato, fresh oregano, balsamic vinegar, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Season steak medallions with salt and black pepper on both sides. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Step 3: Add steaks and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 4: Transfer to a plate. Step 5: Reserve oil in skillet. Step 6: Place mushrooms and butter into the skillet and season with salt; cook and stir until mushrooms are softened and beginning to brown, 5 to. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium; add peppers and cook and stir until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Stir in garlic and cook for 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Pour in wine and sprinkle in dried oregano. Step 10: Increase heat to medium-high and cook until the wine is nearly evaporated, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Stir tomato concass茅 into the mushroom mixture and simmer until tomato is softened, 3 to. Step 12: Add fresh oregano, balsamic vinegar, and red pepper flakes; stir to combine. Step 13: Adjust salt and black pepper to taste. Step 14: Place steaks back into the skillet with the mushroom mixture and cook until warmed through and cooked to desired doneness, 4 to.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, yellow onion, garlic, flat-leaf italian parsley, ground beef, ground pork, ground veal, plain breadcrumbs, eggs, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, red pepper flakes, salt, extra virgin olive oil, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken stock, onion, garlic, and parsley in a blender or food processor and puree. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the pureed stock mix, meat, bread crumbs, egg, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, red pepper flakes, and salt. Step 3: Combine with hands until mixture is uniform, do not overmix. Step 4: Put a little olive oil on your hands and form mixture into balls a little larger than golf balls. Step 5: Pour about 1 / 2 inch of extra virgin olive oil in straight sided, 10-inch-wide saute pan and heat over medium-high flame. Step 6: Add the meatballs to the pan, working in batches if necessary, and brown meatballs, turning once This should take about 10-15 minutes While meatballs are browning, heat the marinara sauce in a large pot. Step 7: Transfer the meatballs to the pot with the marinara sauce and simmer for one hour. Step 8: Serve alone or over your favorite pasta.

Ingredient Names: rump roast, beef consomme, good seasonings italian salad dressing mix, pepperoncini pepper, giardiniera, sweet green peppers, french bread
Instructions: Step 1: Cook first 5 ingredients in a crockpot on low for 18 hours. Step 2: Turn over at the 6th and 12th hour interval At the 17th hour cut sweet green peppers into 1 / 8 ths lengthwise and cook in water on low heat until soft. Step 3: Cut bread into 6 inch lengths and slice on the side lengthwise Pull roast apart with a fork, and using tongs, pile bread with meat and juice Lay strips of green pepper on top of the meat Salt to taste Open wide and enjoy the most wonderful taste sensation May be frozen when cooked.

Ingredient Names: fast-rising active dry yeast, warm water, vegetable oil, olive oil, cornmeal, flour, mozzarella cheese, whole canned tomatoes, lean ground beef, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic cloves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: With a kitchenaid mixer, mix the yeast with the warm water and dissolve yeast completely. Step 2: Add the vegetable oil, olive oil, cornmeal and 1 / 2 of the flour. Step 3: Beat for 10 minutes Attach the dough hook and mix in the remaining flour. Step 4: Knead with the mixer for several minutes. Step 5: Place dough on clean countertop and cover with a large metal bowl to allow to rise double in bulk Punch down and allow to rise again Punch down a 2nd time and the dough is ready Oil a deep-dish pizza pan. Step 6: Place some dough in the pan and push it out to the edges using your fingers.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck, salt, ground black pepper, vegetable oil, garlic, white vinegar, dried oregano, dried thyme, dried rosemary, bay leaf, red pepper flakes, chicken broth, parsley, sandwich rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Season beef with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Step 2: Heat vegetable oil in a heavy pot over high heat. Step 3: Cook and stir beef in hot oil until browned, 5 to. Step 4: Stir garlic, vinegar, oregano, 1 陆 teaspoons salt, thyme, rosemary, black pepper, bay leaf, and red pepper flakes into beef. Step 5: Pour enough chicken broth into beef mixture to cover the meat by and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Cover the pot with a lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer until meat is very tender and easily pulls apart with a fork, about 1 to. Step 7: Transfer meat with a strainer or slotted spoon to a separate pot; pour about meat broth into pot. Step 8: Use a wooden spoon to gently break meat into smaller chunks. Step 9: Cover pot with a lid or aluminum foil and keep warm. Step 10: Skim excess grease from top of broth remaining in the first pot; season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 11: Cover pot with a lid or aluminum foil and keep broth warm. Step 12: Lay halves of a roll out on a work surface and spoon meat broth over each half. Step 13: Top bottom half of roll with a generous portion of meat and a spoonful of pickled vegetables. Step 14: Place tops on sandwich. Step 15: Repeat with remaining buns, broth, meat, and pickled vegetables to make 3 more sandwiches. Step 16: Spoon hot meat broth into ramekins and top each ramekin with parsley. Step 17: Serve sandwiches with hot broth for dipping.

Ingredient Names: minced beef, onion, breadcrumbs, nutmeg, salt, pepper, tomato ketchup, eggs, cinnamon, ground cloves, oil, garlic clove, tomato sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix mince, onion, breadcrumbs, ketchup, eggs, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, salt and pepper together, shape into balls. Step 2: Heat oil in a large frying pan and brown the meatballs and the garlic. Step 3: Combine the tomato sauce and water and add to frying pan. Step 4: Cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Cook spaghetti noodles. Step 6: Serve garnished with cheese and parsley.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat bread, water, lean ground beef, parmesan cheese, egg white, dried oregano, fresh onion, garlic powder, black pepper, pasta sauce, cayenne pepper, salt, thyme, frankfurter buns, italian cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Meatballs: combine bread crumbs and water to moisten. Step 2: Add beef, cheese, egg white, oregano, onion, garlic powder, and pepper. Step 3: Mix by hand until just completely combined, but do not overmix. Step 4: Shape into 26 meatballs and place in foil lined, greased baking dish. Step 5: Bake at 425 degrees for 12 minutes or until completely cooked through Sauce: while meatballs are cooking, combine sauce, black pepper, cayenne, salt, and thyme in saucepan. Step 6: Heat over medium-low heat As soon as meatballs are done cooking turn oven onto broil Pat off extra grease from outside of each meatball and place into saucepan with sauce. Step 7: Stir and cover each meatball completely with sauce.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, carrot, italian-style tomatoes, tomato soup with basil, water, garlic cloves, dried basil, dried oregano, beef bouillon granules, salt, pepper, chili powder, kidney beans, italian cut green beans
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef and onion in a large dutch oven over medium heat, until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender, drain. Step 2: Stir in carrots, and next 10 ingredients, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 3: Simmer, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes. Step 4: Stir in kidney beans and next 2 ingredients. Step 5: Simmer, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes, stir in pasta. Step 6: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper, if needed.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, green bell pepper, salt, ground black pepper, granulated sugar, dried parsley flakes, dried basil leaves, dried oregano, garlic salt, paprika, tomato sauce, tomato paste, mushroom stems and pieces, cooked spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven or large pot, brown the ground beef, onion, and green peppers, drain off fat. Step 2: Add the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Cover, and simmer until heated through. Step 4: Serve with cooked spaghetti and parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: pepperoni, muenster cheese, flour, eggs, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Grease a 9 inch pie dish. Step 3: In a small bowl, add the ingredients in the order listed Use a slotted spoon to stir the ingredients until the batter is smooth. Step 4: Pour into the pie dish and bake 30-35 minutes or until the center is firm. Step 5: Let rest 5-10 minutes, cut into wedges and serve.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, meatless sauce, chicken broth, dried oregano leaves, ziti pasta, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a large skillet, cook ground beef, onions, and garlic over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until beef is browned Stirring frequently. Step 3: Stir in spaghetti sauce, chicken broth, and oregano. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Stir 1 cup of the sauce into the cooked ziti noodles. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 2 of the ziti mixture into a 13x9x2-inch baking dish. Step 7: Sprinkle with 1 1 / 2 cups mozzarella cheese and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese. Step 8: Top with 2 cups sauce, then remaining ziti mixture and remaining sauce. Step 9: Cover and bake 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, butter, onion, celery, carrot, ground beef, salt, black pepper, whole milk, nutmeg, dry white wine, chopped tomatoes, pasta, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil, 3 tbsp butter and chopped onion in the pot, turn the heat to medium and cook, stirring the onion until it becomes translucent. Step 2: Add the celery and carrot and stir for two minutes while cooking to coat them well. Step 3: Add the ground beef, a large pinch of salt and a few grindings of black pepper. Step 4: Cook the beef while crumbling it with a fork until the beef has lost its red colour. Step 5: Add the milk and let it simmer gently, stirring frequently until the milk has completely bubbled away, add the nutmeg. Step 6: Add the wine and let it simmer until it has evaporated. Step 7: Add the tomatoes and stir well. Step 8: When the tomatoes start to bubble turn the heat down so that it is just simmering with the occasional bubble breaking the surface. Step 9: Cook uncovered for 3 hours, stirring from time to time.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, italian sausage, tomato sauce, sliced mushrooms, garlic salt, dried oregano, dried thyme, dried basil, salt and pepper, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, eggs, grated parmesan cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Cook ground beef and sausage in a large pot over medium heat; drain. Step 3: Stir in tomato sauce, mushrooms, garlic salt, oregano, thyme, and basil; season with salt and black pepper, simmer. Step 4: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 5: Cook lasagna noodles with olive oil in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to, drain. Step 6: Meanwhile, combine ricotta cheese, eggs, and Parmesan cheese in a bowl. Step 7: Cover bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish with a thin layer of meat sauce; layer 3 lasagna noodles over top. Step 8: Spread about 1/3 ricotta cheese mixture over noodles; sprinkle about 1/4 mozzarella cheese over top. Step 9: Spoon about 1/3 meat sauce over mozzarella cheese. Step 10: Repeat layering twice more, finishing with remaining mozzarella cheese. Step 11: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese melts and sauce bubbles, about 25-30 minutes. Step 12: Cover lasagna with foil if cheese begins to get too dark. Step 13: Let sit before serving for 10 to.

Dish Name: Classic Lasagna With Meat Sauce Tomatoes And Bechamel Sauce L

Instructions: Step 1: For the meat sauce: Heat oil in a heavy- bottomed pot over high heat and brown veal for 5 minutes, add salt to taste. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, celery, peppers, dried tomatoes, tomato paste and seasonings. Step 3: Reduce heat and cook for 15 minutes Break up whole tomatoes with the back of the spoon and stir sauce occasionally. Step 4: Add the grated orange zest and cook another 5 minutes. Step 5: Cook sausages in a frying pan. Step 6: Remove, slice and set aside For the bechamel sauce:.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, lean ground beef, garlic, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, ground black pepper, cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Add lasagna noodles and cook for 8-10 minutes or until al dente; drain. Step 4: Meanwhile, place ground beef, garlic, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir until beef is crumbly and evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Mix cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, and eggs together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Step 6: Lay 4 noodles side by side on the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking pan; top with a layer of prepared tomato-basil sauce, a layer of ground beef mixture, and a layer of cottage cheese mixture. Step 7: Repeat layers twice more, ending with a layer of sauce; sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. Step 8: Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Step 9: Bake in the preheated oven until the lasagna is bubbling and the cheese has melted, about 25-30 minutes. Step 10: Remove foil and bake until cheese has begun to brown, about 10 more minutes. Step 11: Allow to stand at least before serving.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, tomato paste, beer, ricotta cheese, egg, fresh mushrooms, onion, parmesan cheese, ground beef, italian seasoning, seasoning salt, garlic powder, butter, lasagna noodles, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine sauce, paste, beer and italian seasoning in saucepan over low heat. Step 3: Simmer about 5 minutes In large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon butter and saute meat or shrimp with 1 teaspoon garlic and 1 teaspoon seasoned salt. Step 4: Stir into sauce In same skillet, melt 1 tablespoon butter, and add onions, 1 teaspoon garlic, and 1 teaspoon seasoning salt. Step 5: Cook until onions are translucent, stir into sauce. Step 6: Melt remaining butter and saute mushrooms, remaining garlic and remaining seasoning salt. Step 7: Cook about 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, ground beef, parmesan cheese, ground black pepper, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat chicken broth to boiling. Step 2: Meanwhile, combine beef, cheese and pepper. Step 3: Knead lightly to mix but don't overdo it. Step 4: Roll into 1 inch meatballs. Step 5: Drop meatballs into boiling broth and reduce heat to simmering. Step 6: Cook for 10 minutes. Step 7: Add spinach and cook for 10 more minutes. Step 8: Serve with french bread if you have it.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, pizza sauce, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Unroll crescent dough and separate into 8 rectangles Seal seams. Step 2: Divide sauce, cheese, and pepperoni among the 8 pieces. Step 3: Fold over and pinch edges together. Step 4: Place seam side down on greased baking sheet. Step 5: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, tomato paste, water, dried basil, salt, pepper, dried oregano, cayenne pepper, meatballs, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, add first 8 ingredients. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Lower heat and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, add meatballs. Step 4: Simmer and occasionlly stir for 20 additional minutes. Step 5: Serve over hot cooked spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion powder, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, salt, pepper, oregano, italian seasoning, cream cheese, ricotta cheese, eggs, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven or very large skillet, brown the meat. Step 2: Add the onion powder and garlic and cook a couple of minutes more. Step 3: Stir in the tomato sauce, paste, water and seasonings. Step 4: Cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally for 30 minutes With mixer or food processor, mix the cream cheese, ricotta and eggs. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350, and spray a large lasagna pan with cooking spray. Step 6: Layer half the noodles in the bottom of the pan, breaking the noodles as needed. Step 7: Add half of the meat sauce, and spread evenly over the noodles Gently spread the cream cheese / ricotta mixture evenly over the sauce Lay the sliced mozzarella on top of the cream cheese layer, covering completely.

Ingredient Names: green onion, garlic, mushroom pieces, butter, spaghetti, spaghetti sauce, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In lg skillet saute onions, garlic, and mushrooms in butter. Step 2: Add spaghetti, 1 cup sauce, 1 / 2 cup shredded cheese, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt and pepper, mix well. Step 3: Put into a greased shallow casserole dish. Step 4: Bake, uncovered at 350 for 20 minutes. Step 5: Spread with remaining cup sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle with remaining shredded cheese. Step 7: Bake, uncovered for 10 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, veal schnitzels, garlic cloves, tomato paste, chicken stock, marsala wine, cream, penne pasta, button mushrooms, flat leaf parsley, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and olive oil in a large non stick frying pan. Step 2: Add the veal and cook on medium high for 2-3 minutes stirring continually. Step 3: Add garlic and cook a further 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add chicken stock, marsala and cream and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Drain cooked pasta. Step 7: Melt putter in the pasta pot, add button mushrooms and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring continually. Step 8: Return drained pasta to the pot along with parsley and black pepper and toss all the ingrediants together well. Step 9: Arrange the mushroom pasta into your bowls. Step 10: Spoon over the veal mixture and serve with a sprinkle of pepper.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, dried oregano, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink, drain. Step 2: Remove from the heat. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese and oregano. Step 4: Mix well Separate crescent dough into eight rectangles, pinching seams together. Step 5: Place about 3 tablespoons of meat mixture along one long side of each rectangle. Step 6: Roll up, jelly-roll style, starting with a long side. Step 7: Cut each roll into three pieces. Step 8: Place, seam side down, 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, mozzarella cheese, spaghetti sauce mix, tomato sauce, cornstarch, sharp cheddar cheese, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet or crock-pot with a browning unit, cook beef until crumbly. Step 2: Pour off excess fat In the crock-pot, combine beef with dry spaghetti sauce mix, tomato sauce, cheddar and mozzarella cheeses. Step 3: Cover and cook on low for 2 hours Dissolve cornstarch in the wine. Step 4: Turn control to high. Step 5: Add dissolved cornstarch. Step 6: Heat on high for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 7: Dip chunks of italian bread into the fondue while keeping the mixture hot in the crock-pot.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Italian Beef Philly Cheese Steak Garlic Bread Sandwich
Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, onion, pepperoncini peppers, beef stock, garlic salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, dried parsley, dried onion, paprika, parmesan cheese, celery seed, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put the beef in the crock pot and sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper. Step 3: Cut garlic clove in half and rub on 4 slices of bread and then spread butter on them. Step 4: Spread mayonnaise on the remaining 4 slices, top with cheese Broil all the slices of bread until cheese is melted. Step 5: Spoon meat and peppers with juices on to garlic-buttered bread slices. Step 6: Top with cheese-mayo bread slices.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, dried basil, salt & pepper, cottage cheese, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, egg, garlic salt, dried parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onion in olive oil until tender. Step 2: Add ground beef and cook until browned. Step 3: Add garlic, salt and pepper. Step 4: Drain fat from pan. Step 5: Add tomato paste and cook approximately 5 minutes. Step 6: Add crushed tomatoes, basil and more salt to taste. Step 7: Let simmer while you prepare the cheese mixture. Step 8: Combine cottage, ricotta, parmesan, and mozzarella chesses with egg, garlic salt and parsley, mix well. Step 9: Spoon a layer of sauce into crock pot.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Meatballs Penne In Red Sauce
Ingredient Names: breadcrumbs, milk, ground beef, onion, egg, salt, pepper, water, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, fresh basil, sugar, penne
Instructions: Step 1: For meatballs-mix all meatball ingredients together, make into tsp size balls, and place on cookie sheet. Step 2: Bake at 350f for 25 minutes or until cooked and drain. Ingredient Names: tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, beef consomme, red wine, bay leaves, italian herb seasoning, garlic cloves, onion, carrot, celery, salt and pepper, veal shanks, vegetable oil, seasoned flour
Instructions: Step 1: Add first 10 ingredients to your crock pot and set on low for 6- 8 hours. Step 5: When finished serve over white rice and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: pam cooking spray, onion, clove, ground sirloin, ground cumin, salt and pepper, diced tomatoes, beef broth, water, carrot, celery, red kidney beans, navy beans, oregano, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Heat nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: When hot, use pam to coat the pan. Ingredient Names: beef mince, carrots, chopped tomatoes, onion, celery, red capsicums, garlic cloves, beef stock, dried oregano, fresh basil leaves, dried bay leaves, fresh ground black pepper, salt

Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian sausage, green pepper, onion, garlic cloves, italian-style diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, sugar, italian seasoning, dried basil, dried marjoram, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, over medium heat, cook ground beef, sausage, onion, garlic, salt and pepper until meat is no longer pink. Step 2: Drain and transfer to crock pot. Step 3: Add all other ingredients, mix well and cook on low up to 8 hours.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Spaghetti Sauce Mmmm Oamc

Instructions: Step 1: Spray the inside of a 4 quart crock pot with cooking spray If beef is tied, remove strings and netting. Ingredient Names: onions, frozen beef ravioli, meatballs, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 5-1 / 2 to 6-quart crockpot with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Add 1 cup of the spaghetti sauce, 1 package of the ravioli, and add all the meatballs. Ingredient Names: crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, meatballs, onion, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, salt, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, sugar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in crock pot Cook on high for 3-5 hours or low for 6-8 hours Serve over spaghetti or pasta of choice.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, garlic clove, basil, salt, canned tomato, tomato paste, lasagna noodles, eggs, fresh ricotta, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Remove sausage skins and break up the sausage in frying pan Brown meat slowly and spoon off excess fat. Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, whole wheat bread crumbs, egg, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, red pepper flakes, dried basil, dried oregano, sea salt, aluminum foil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Place all ingredients except olive oil into a large bowl and mix together using your hands. Instructions: Step 1: In a large sauce pot, cook the prosciutto until crispy. Step 2: Add all vegetables and garlic and cook until soft. Step 3: Add wine and reduce by half. Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, hot italian sausage, ricotta cheese, spaghetti sauce, wine, lasagna noodle, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and sausage, drain well. Step 2: Return to skillet, add spaghetti sauce& wine and heat thoroughly. Step 3: Remove from heat and add container of ricotta cheese, mix well. Step 4: Layer a 9x13 casserole dish with noodles, then meat mixture, then cheeses, repeat layers. Step 5: Bake in 350 oven until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian breadcrumbs, garlic, eggs, italian bread, garlic powder, ground black pepper, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, mix the ground beef, garlic powder, italian bread crumbs, eggs, chopped garlic, ground black pepper and soaked italian bread Also make sure that the bread is very soft before you mix it in. Step 2: Mix all ingredients together well using hands. Step 3: Make sure mixture is smooth. Step 4: Preheat oil in large frying pan Start rolling your meatballs i usually make them large For large meatballs about 5 to 8 minutes. Step 5: When meatballs are done, take them out of hot oil and place on to paper toweled plate, serve warm Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: ground chuck, ground pork, italian bread, parmesan cheese, parsley, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, egg, low-fat milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Place bread in large mixing bowl. Step 3: Soak with milk for 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Squeeze milk out of bread, discard milk Crack egg into bowl and mix with fork. Step 5: Add cheese, parsley and remaining spices. Step 6: Mix thoroughly with a fork until all ingredients are well blended. Step 7: Place parchment paper on an 11" x17" cookie sheet. Step 8: Add beef and pork to mixture, and mix with hands until combined nicely Don't overdo it!

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodle, lean ground beef, onions, green peppers, fresh mushrooms, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, cream cheese, tomato puree, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, oregano, sweet basil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil lasagna noodles, according to package directions Saut beef, then add salt, pepper, and some of the pureed tomatoes Saut the veggies in olive oil, then add garlic powder and oregano powder. Step 4: Add a layer of mixed cheese, then a layer of sauce. Step 5: After that, add a layer of shredded mozzarella.

Dish Name: Don T Cook The Pasta Manicotti
Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, tomato juice, tomato paste, sugar, oregano, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, frozen chopped spinach, eggs, parmesan cheese, manicotti
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, brown meat with and garlic, drain well. Step 2: Stir in 2 c tomato juice, tomato paste, sugar and seasonings. Ingredient Names: hamburger, hot sausage, italian seasoning, salt, romano cheese, garlic cloves, breadcrumbs, parsley, pepper, eggs, italian bread, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: To start soak the bread in milk or water enough to cover it. Step 2: Mix the hamburger, parsley, italian seasoning, pepper, salt, hot sausage, cheeses, eggs and garlic. Step 4: Then add the bread crumbs, 1 cup at a time until mixture holds its shape Form into balls and put into a preheated 400 oven for about 20 to 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, lean pork sausage, fresh breadcrumb, basil, oregano, parmesan cheese, eggs, salt, cracked black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Combine all ingredients Roll into balls Place on baking sheet fitted with cooling racks Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees.

Dish Name: Easy Baked Rigatoni With Ground Beef And Mushrooms

Step 7: Add in the cooked pasta and toss again. Step 8: Transfer the mixture to a greased casserole dish.

Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add spaghetti, and cook for 8 to, or until al dente. Step 3: Drain, and set aside. Dish Name: Easy Beef Liver With Onion And Tomato

Instructions: Step 1: Melt 1 1 / 2 tablespoons butter in skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add tomato, onion and basil. Step 4: Melt remaining butter in frying pan over low heat and cook liver 3 minutes and turn over and season with salt and pepper and cook for another 2 minutes. Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian sausage, black olives, water, minced garlic, dried oregano, dried onion flakes, garlic powder, ground black pepper, dried sage, basil, marinara sauce, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook ground beef and Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned and crumbled; drain excess grease. Dish Name: Easy Grilled Burgers Italiano For The Bbq
Ingredient Names: ground beef, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, kaiser rolls

Dish Name: Easy Italian Beef Stew Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck roast, onions, sweet red pepper, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from roast and cut into 1" cubes. Step 2: Layer beef, onions, and peppers in crock pot. Step 3: Pour spaghetti sauce on top. Step 4: Cover and cook on low 9-10 hours. Step 5: Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Dish Name: Easy Italian Roast Beef For Sandwiches Crock Pot

Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Combine meatballs and pizza sauce in a large saucepan. Dish Name: Easy Peasy Meatballs Over Buttered Noodles
Ingredient Names: condensed cream of celery soup, condensed french onion soup, sour cream, frozen meatballs, egg noodles, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In a large slow cooker, mix together the cream of celery soup, french onion soup, and sour cream. Step 2: Stir in the meatballs. Step 3: Cook on high heat for 3-4 hours. Step 4: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 5: Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente, drain. Step 6: In a large bowl, toss the pasta with butter. Step 7: Serve meatballs and sauce over the cooked pasta.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic clove, italian seasoning, olive oil, spaghetti sauce, rotini pasta, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, onion, garlic and seasoning in oil. Step 2: Drain While beef is browning, cook pasta according to the packaging. Step 3: Stir in pasta, spaghetti sauce and 3 cups cheese. Step 4: Place mixture in 2 greased 9x13x2 inch baking pans or 4 square pans. Step 5: Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella. Step 6: Top with pepperoni. Step 7: Cover and freeze up to 3 months To cook now: bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes, until heated through To bake frozen casserole: thaw in refrigerator overnight and bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes, till hot.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, bread crumbs, yellow onion, garlic, chopped fresh parsley, egg, spaghetti sauce, crushed tomatoes, tomato puree
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Place ground beef, bread crumbs, onion, garlic, parsley, and egg in a large bowl. Step 3: Mix well until evenly combined; shape into 16 meatballs. Step 4: Pour spaghetti sauce and crushed tomatoes into the slow cooker; stir in tomato puree. Step 5: Place the meatballs into the sauce mixture. Step 6: Cover and cook on Low for 6 to.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, eggs, parmesan cheese, sour cream, cottage cheese, spaghetti sauce, hamburger, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Break pasta into 2 inch pieces and cook according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and rinse with cold water. Step 3: In a large bowl mix eggs, parmesan cheese, sour cream & cottage cheese. Step 4: Add pasta and mix thoroughly. Step 5: Put pasta mixture in a lightly greased 9x13 pan. Step 6: Mix spaghetti sauce and cooked hamburger. Step 7: Spread on top of the pasta mixture. Step 8: Bake in 375 degree over for 30-45 minutes until hot and set in the middle. Step 9: Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: butter, spaghetti, grated parmesan cheese, eggs, lean ground beef, onion, green bell pepper, garlic, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, white sugar, dried oregano, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease a 10-inch pie plate with butter. Step 3: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 4: Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain spaghetti through a colander and return to the pot. Step 6: Stir Parmesan cheese, beaten eggs, and butter into hot spaghetti until well combined. Step 7: Press mixture evenly on the bottom and up the sides of prepared pie plate to form a sturdy crust. Step 8: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 9: Cook and stir beef, onion, bell pepper, and garlic in the hot skillet until beef is crumbly and browned, 5 to. Step 10: Drain off fat and stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, and oregano. Step 11: Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Step 12: Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti crust, then pour in beef-tomato mixture. Step 13: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 14: Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the top of pie and continue baking until cheese is melted, about more. Step 15: Let pie stand briefly before slicing to allow layers to set.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, large zucchini, spaghetti sauce, grated parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, black olives, garlic, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 4: Drain and discard grease. Step 5: Transfer beef into a large mixing bowl. Step 6: Slice zucchini in half lengthwise, then use a spoon to scoop out the flesh, leaving a 1/2-inch-thick shell all around zucchini. Step 7: Chop scooped-out zucchini flesh and add to beef in the mixing bowl. Step 8: Stir spaghetti sauce, Parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, black olives, and garlic into beef-zucchini mixture until well combined. Step 9: Lightly stuff both halves of zucchini with filling. Step 10: Place filled zucchini halves into a baking dish; cover tightly with foil. Step 11: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 12: Remove the baking dish from the oven; turn on the broiler and adjust an oven rack to within 6 inches of the broiler's heat source. Step 13: Uncover the baking dish; sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over each zucchini half. Step 14: Broil until cheese is browned and bubbling, about 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, oregano, mushrooms, onion, garlic salt, red wine, butter, angel hair pasta, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ground beef and oregano and saute together at 325. Step 2: Cook for 25 minutes or until done mix the mushrooms, onion, garlic salt, red wine, and butter together and saute in another pan at 250. Step 3: Cook for 25 minutes now mix both of these pans together and cover in the ragu sauce. Step 4: Cook at 250 for 1 / 2 hour. Step 5: Once you do that, start boiling the angel hair pasta in water for 20 minutes. Step 6: When finished, drain the pasta, serve on a plate with pan full of ingredients on top.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, large eggs, water, grated parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, salt, ground black pepper, eggplant, ground beef, tomato sauce, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Grease 2 baking sheets and a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil. Step 3: Whisk eggs and water together in a shallow dish. Step 4: Combine Parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper in a separate shallow dish. Step 5: Dip eggplant slices into egg mixture, then press into bread crumb mixture. Step 6: Gently tap off any excess crumbs. Step 7: Arrange breaded eggplant slices on the prepared baking sheets. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until the bottoms are golden brown, 20 to. Step 9: Flip eggplant and continue baking until tender, 20 to, set aside. Step 10: Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 11: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Step 12: Stir in ground beef; season with salt and pepper. Step 13: Cook and stir until beef is browned and crumbly, about 3-4 minutes. Step 14: Drain excess grease. Step 15: Stir tomato sauce into ground beef; bring to a simmer, then set sauce aside. Step 16: Place 1/3 of the eggplant slices on the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Step 17: Pour 1/3 of the meat sauce on top of eggplant layer. Step 18: Sprinkle 1/3 of the mozzarella cheese on top of sauce layer. Step 19: Repeat this more times, finishing with a layer of mozzarella cheese. Step 20: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling, 10 to. Step 21: Cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

Ingredient Names: white bread, milk, ground beef, eggs, romano cheese, dried parsley, salt, ground black pepper, olive oil, onion, garlic, italian sausage, beef short ribs, pork neck bones, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, red wine, water, bay leaves, ground cinnamon, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: To make the meatballs: Combine bread and milk in a medium bowl. Step 2: Mix in ground beef, eggs, Romano cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper; form into meatballs and place into the freezer to firm up. Step 3: To make the sauce: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion; cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Add garlic and 1 sausage link; cook about more. Step 6: Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, brown beef chunks and pork neck bones; set aside. Step 7: When onions and garlic are done, turn heat down to low. Step 8: Add tomato paste and cook for a few minutes. Step 9: Stir in the browned beef and pork, crushed tomatoes, wine, bay leaves, cinnamon, parsley, basil, and salt and pepper. Step 10: Bring sauce to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 3 to. Step 11: Heat remaining olive oil in a large skillet; Brown meatballs and remaining sausage links in batches. Step 12: Add to sauce and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 13: When sauce is nearly ready, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 14: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain. Step 15: Remove pork neck bones from the sauce; discard. Step 16: Serve meatballs and sauce over hot pasta.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, chopped fresh parsley, minced garlic, onion powder, salt, ground black pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 3: Combine ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley, garlic, onion powder, salt, black pepper, oregano, and basil in a large bowl; form into 2-inch meatballs. Step 4: Wrap 1 half-slice bacon around 1 meatball; turn meatball 45 degrees and wrap 1 half-slice bacon around meatball to enclose. Step 5: Repeat with remaining bacon and meatballs, forming 12 meatballs, wrapping each with 2 half-slices bacon. Step 6: Place meatballs onto the prepared baking sheet, seam sides down. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until meatballs no longer pink inside and bacon crisp, about 25-30 minutes. Step 8: An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C). Step 9: Pour off excess grease.

Ingredient Names: milk, egg, bread crumbs, ground beef, onion, fresh parsley, garlic, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Beat milk and egg together in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix in bread crumbs until a paste forms. Step 3: Add ground beef, onion, parsley, and garlic; mix with your hands until just combined. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 5: Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Step 6: Scoop meat mixture using an ice cream scoop; roll into balls with dampened hands. Step 7: Place meatballs on the prepared baking sheet. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until meatballs are no longer pink in centers and an instant-read thermometer inserted into centers reads at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C), about 5 minutes. Step 9: Meanwhile, heat tomato sauce in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 10: Add baked meatballs to sauce; simmer, uncovered, for 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, olive oil, tomato, italian herbs, gnocchi, reduced-fat mozzarella, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the mince in the oil for a few mins. Tip in the tomatoes and herbs. Fill one of the empty cans with water, add this to the beef, then bring to the boil. Simmer for 20 mins. Step 2: Tip half the spinach into a colander and pour over boiling water to wilt, then repeat with the second half. Squeeze out as much moisture from the spinach as you can, then leave to drain in the colander. When the beef is almost ready, cook the gnocchi, then drain. Heat the grill to high. Step 3: Stir the gnocchi and spinach into the beef, season, then tip into a large ovenproof dish. Tear the mozzarella into chunks, scatter over, then grill until golden and bubbling.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, carrots, zucchini, fresh button mushrooms, garlic, tomatoes, worcestershire sauce, lean beef, fresh basil leaves, gravy granules, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and add the onion. Cook gently for a few mins, then add the carrots, courgettes and mushrooms and fry for 5 more mins. Stir in the garlic with 1 min to go. Step 2: Tip in the tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce and 300ml boiling water, then season to taste. Bring to the boil, cover, then simmer for 15 mins until tender. Meanwhile, heat a non-stick pan and add the mince. Break it up with a wooden spatula and cook for 10 mins, stirring until browned all over. Step 3: Add the basil leaves (reserve a few) to the veg sauce, then put a stick blender into the pan and blend until smooth. Pour the sauce and gravy granules into the mince, then stir to thicken. Cover and simmer for 15 mins. Step 4: Meanwhile, boil the pasta. Reserve a small cup of the cooking water, then drain. Mix the spaghetti with the sauce and reserved water, then serve, topped with a few more basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, marinara sauce, water, salt, lasagna noodles, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the ground beef in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until browned and no longer pink, about 3-4 minutes; drain fat. Step 2: Stir in the marinara sauce, water, and salt, bring to a boil. Step 3: Remove sauce from heat. Step 4: Arrange 6 noodles in a 9x13-inch baking dish, breaking if necessary to fit. Step 5: Spoon 1/2 of the sauce over noodles. Step 6: Top with 1/2 of the cottage cheese and 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Repeat layers with remaining noodles, sauce, cottage cheese, and mozzarella cheese. Step 8: Top with Parmesan cheese. Step 9: Cover tightly with foil; refrigerate overnight. Step 10: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 11: Bake lasagna, covered, until noodles are soft, cheese is melted, and sauce is bubbly, about 8-10 minutes. Step 12: Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Grandma's Best Ever Sour Cream Lasagna
Ingredient Names: italian sausage, ground beef, garlic, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, dried parsley, dried basil, dried oregano, white sugar, lasagna noodles, sour cream, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese, green olives, large eggs, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Cook sausage, ground beef, and garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 3: Drain any excess grease. Step 4: Stir in diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, parsley, basil, oregano, and sugar. Step 5: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 6: When the sauce has simmered for about 15-20 minutes, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 7: Add lasagna noodles and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain. Step 8: Stir sour cream, 1/2 of the mozzarella, Parmesan, olives, eggs, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. Step 9: Assemble the lasagna: Spread a thin layer of meat sauce evenly over the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 10: Cover with 1/3 of the lasagna noodles, 1/3 of the remaining meat sauce, and 1/3 of the cheese mixture; repeat layers two more times with remaining noodles, sauce, and cheese mixture. Step 11: Sprinkle remaining mozzarella evenly over top. Step 12: Bake in the preheated oven until sauce is bubbly and the cheese is golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: bread crumbs, romano cheese, chopped fresh parsley, salt, ground black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, water, eggs, ground beef
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients and preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Mix bread crumbs, Romano cheese, parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder together in a large bowl; stir in water and eggs. Step 3: Add ground beef and mix until well combined. Step 4: Form mixture into balls and place on a nonstick baking sheet. Step 5: Bake in the preheated oven cooked through and evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes, serve and.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onions, green peppers, celery, tomatoes, tomato puree, oregano leaves, fresh basil leaves, salt, pepper, elbow macaroni
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef, onion, green pepper and celery in a large frying pan until beef is browned and onion is clear, drain. Step 2: Break up large pieces of tomatoes. Step 3: Add tomatoes, tomato puree and seasonings to beef mixture. Step 4: Simmer 15 minutes to blend flavors. Step 5: Stir in macaroni and heat to serving temperature.

Ingredient Names: green onions, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, ground beef, bread, cream cheese, mayonnaise, italian seasoning, ground black pepper, shredded mozzarella cheese, spaghetti sauce, water, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Step 3: Mix onions, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, and ground beef together in a bowl. Step 4: Roll mixture into even-sized meatballs, about in diameter; place in a baking pan. Step 5: Bake in the preheated oven until beef is no longer pink, 15 to. Step 6: Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 7: Arrange bread cubes in a single layer in an ungreased 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 8: Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise, Italian seasoning, and black pepper together until smooth. Step 9: Spread this mixture over each bread cube. Step 10: Sprinkle with the grated mozzarella cheese. Step 11: Mix spaghetti sauce, water (if using), and garlic together in a large bowl. Step 12: Gently stir in meatballs; pour over bread and cheese mixture in the baking pan. Step 13: Sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese evenly over the top. Step 14: Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 25-30 minutes, or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: garlic, fresh oregano, basil, chopped fresh parsley, chopped fresh rosemary, kosher salt, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, white pepper, boneless beef steak
Instructions: Step 1: Place the garlic, oregano, basil, parsley, rosemary, and salt into a mortar or small bowl, and mash into a coarse paste. Step 2: Stir in the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and white pepper until evenly blended. Step 3: Scrape half of the mixture into a separate small bowl; set aside. Step 4: Spread the remaining half of the herb mixture evenly over the steaks. Step 5: Set aside to marinate for 2 hours. Step 6: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Step 7: Cook the steaks on the preheated grill for 8-10 minutes, then turn over, and coat with the reserved herb mixture. Step 8: Continue cooking more for medium-well, or until your desired degree of doneness has been reached.

Dish Name: Italian Sausage with Tomatoes and Penne
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, italian sausages, beef broth, yellow squash, grape tomatoes, fresh basil, green onions, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Spray a large skillet with non-stick cooking spray. Step 3: Over medium heat, cook sausage for 4-6 minutes or until browned. Step 4: Add in broth and stir; cover and cook 5 minutes. Step 5: Add in squash, tomatoes, and 2 tablespoons of the basil. Step 6: Bring to a boil, lower heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes, stir occasionally. Step 7: Add in onions; simmer uncovered for 1 minute. Step 8: Check seasoning to taste, add salt/pepper if desired. Step 9: In a big mixing bowl, add cooked penne, oil, and remaining basil; toss to coat. Step 10: Spoon pasta into individual serving plates or bowls; top with sausage mixture. Step 11: Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, bread crumbs, dried parsley, grated parmesan cheese, ground black pepper, garlic powder, egg, onion, garlic, olive oil, tomatoes, salt, white sugar, bay leaf, tomato paste, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, bread crumbs, parsley, Parmesan, black pepper, garlic powder and beaten egg. Step 3: Mix well and form into 12 balls. Step 4: Store, covered, in refrigerator until needed. Step 5: In a large saucepan over medium heat, saute onion and garlic in olive oil until onion is translucent. Step 6: Stir in tomatoes, salt, sugar and bay leaf. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer. Step 8: Stir in tomato paste, basil, pepper and meatballs and simmer more, serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, large egg, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, dried basil, onion powder, chicken broth, escarole, orzo, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, basil, and onion powder in a bowl. Step 2: Shape beef mixture into 3/4-inch balls and place on a parchment-lined tray. Step 3: Heat broth in a large pot over medium-high heat until boiling. Step 4: Stir in escarole, orzo, carrot, and meatballs and return to boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and cook at slow boil, stirring frequently to prevent sticking, until pasta is tender yet firm to the bite, about 8-10 minutes, serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, ground beef, italian sausage, onion, celery, garlic, green bell pepper, salt and pepper, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Lightly grease a 7x11-inch casserole dish with cooking spray. Step 3: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 4: Add rotini and cook until tender yet firm to the bite, 6 to; drain. Step 5: Run cold water over pasta to stop it from cooking further. Step 6: While the pasta is cooking, cook ground beef and sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until completely browned and crumbly, 7 to. Step 7: Add onion, celery, garlic, and bell pepper; cook and stir until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Remove from the heat and stir in tomato sauce and diced tomatoes. Step 10: Let cool for 10 minutes. Step 11: Spread pasta over the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Step 12: Sprinkle Italian cheese blend over rotini, then pour meat sauce over top. Step 13: Cover the dish with heavy-duty aluminum foil. Step 14: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 15: Remove the foil and sprinkle Cheddar cheese over the casserole. Step 16: Continue to bake until Cheddar has melted, about 25-30 minutes. Step 17: Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, ground beef, pizza sauce, tomato sauce, sliced mushrooms, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite,, drain. Step 4: Cook and stir ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until meat is crumbly and browned, about 3-4 minutes; drain excess grease. Step 5: Mix cooked ground beef, macaroni, pizza sauce, tomato sauce, and mushrooms in a bowl. Step 6: Layer half the macaroni mixture into a 9x12-inch baking dish; top with 1/2 the mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Layer remaining macaroni mixture over the top; sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese over macaroni mixture. Step 8: Cover dish with aluminum foil. Step 9: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese has melted and casserole is bubbling, about 25-30 minutes. Step 10: Let cool for 3 to before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, eggs, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumbs, garlic, salt, ground black pepper, milk, oregano, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Step 2: Shape into small meatballs (at this point you can place on a jelly-roll/baking sheet and freeze to use later, or cover with plastic wrap refrigerate up to 24 hours before using). Step 3: Drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce, do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs. Step 4: Continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes (depending on how fast your sauce is simmering 40 minutes total should fully cook the meatballs). Step 5: After the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired. Step 6: **note** you may also bake the meatballs at 350 degrees F for 25 minutes or until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic powder, dried oregano, tomato sauce, white sugar, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, large egg, chopped fresh parsley, grated parmesan cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir ground beef, onion, garlic powder, and oregano in a large skillet over medium heat until onion is tender and beef is browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 2: Add tomato sauce and sugar; simmer until sauce is heated through, about 15-20 minutes. Step 3: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 4: Cook lasagna in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, 8 to, drain. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 6: Grease a 9x13-inch casserole dish. Step 7: Mix ricotta cheese, egg, parsley, and Parmesan cheese together in a bowl. Step 8: Place a lasagna noodle on a work surface. Step 9: Spoon one layer ricotta cheese mixture, one layer meat sauce, and one layer mozzarella cheese atop lasagna noodle; top with another lasagna noodle. Step 10: Roll up the stuffed lasagna noodles in the jelly-roll style; place in the prepared casserole dish. Step 11: Repeat with remaining lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese mixture, meat sauce, and mozzarella cheese. Step 12: Spread a spoonful of meat sauce atop each lasagna roll; top with remaining mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Step 13: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbling, 30 to.

Ingredient Names: garlic, onions, green bell peppers, olive oil, lean ground beef, dry red wine, no-salt-added tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, italian parsley, fresh basil, oregano, tap marjoram, thyme, fresh bay leaf, fresh fettuccine
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan or skillet, sauté the garlic, onion and green pepper in oil over moderate heat. Step 2: When the vegetables begin to sizzle, crumble the beef into the pan and sauté it, stirring with a wooden spoon, until it begins to brown, about 5-7 minutes. Step 3: Add the wine and stir and scrape well to deglaze the pan. Step 4: Add the tomatoes, breaking them up with your wooden spoon. Step 5: Stir in the remaining ingredients. Step 6: Simmer until sauce is thick but still slightly liquid, 20-25 minutes. Step 7: Discard the bay leaf. Step 8: Spoon over fettucine or shells.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, water, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, ground black pepper, white sugar, cottage cheese, grated parmesan cheese, egg, lasagna noodles, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot over medium heat, cook beef until brown. Step 2: Drain off all fat. Step 3: Add onion and cook until translucent. Step 4: Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, water, oregano, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and sugar. Step 5: Stir until combined and cook over medium heat until boiling. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 7: While sauce is simmering, blend cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, and egg until smooth, set aside. Step 8: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 9: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain. Step 10: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 11: Spread sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 12: Cover sauce with 3 noodles. Step 13: Cover noodles with 1/3 of the remaining sauce. Step 14: Top with 1/2 of the mozzarella. Step 15: Place another layer of noodles and one of sauce over the mozzarella; top that with the cottage cheese mixture. Step 16: Top with remaining 3 noodles and remaining sauce. Step 17: Bake in preheated oven. Step 18: Sprinkle remaining mozzarella on top and bake more, until golden and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni, ground beef, italian sausage, spaghetti sauce, mushrooms, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to. Step 4: Drain and set aside. Step 5: Meanwhile, brown ground beef and Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium heat; transfer to a baking dish using a slotted spoon. Step 6: Stir spaghetti sauce, mushrooms, and rigatoni into beef and sausage mixture. Step 7: Sprinkle mozzarella cheese and pepperoni over top. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is brown and bubbly, about 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, cottage cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese, egg whites, dried oregano, manicotti shells, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente, drain and cool, reserve. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a large skillet brown beef on medium heat, drain and cool. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 5: Combine beef, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, egg whites and oregano, mix well. Step 6: Stuff shells with mixture. Step 7: Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 8: Pour enough spaghetti sauce in dish to cover the bottom. Step 9: Place stuffed noodles in the dish. Step 10: Cover with spaghetti sauce and top with the remaining mozzarella cheese. Step 11: Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, fresh spinach, grated parmesan cheese, dried parsley, bread crumbs, olive oil, large egg, garlic salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir in the ground beef. Step 2: Cook and stir until the beef is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Step 3: Drain and discard any excess grease. Step 4: Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 to. Step 5: Remove from heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Step 6: Transfer the beef mixture to a bowl. Step 7: Add the Parmesan, parsley, bread crumbs, olive oil, egg, garlic salt, and pepper and mix well. Step 8: Run the filling through a grinder until smooth (or puree in a food processor until smooth). Step 9: The filling can be kept in the refrigerator for up to four days or in the freezer for up to three months.

Ingredient Names: garlic bread, spaghetti sauce, frozen meatballs, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 2: Heat garlic bread with spread side up on a baking sheet in the preheated oven until warm and golden brown, 10 to. Step 3: Set aside to cool. Step 4: Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 5: Bring spaghetti sauce to a boil in a large pot. Step 6: Place frozen meatballs into sauce.
