Step 7: Reduce heat to low and simmer until meatballs are heated through, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Tear garlic bread into bite-size pieces and spread into bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 9: Pour spaghetti sauce and meatballs over garlic bread, coating bread with sauce and distributing meatballs evenly. Step 10: Spread mozzarella cheese over top in a layer, followed by a layer of Parmesan cheese. Step 11: Bake casserole until cheese has melted, 20 to.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, basil most leaves, worcestershire sauce, olive oil, half passata onions garlic, potato, milk, basil pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the mince with half the chopped basil, the Worcestershire sauce and some seasoning, then use your hands to shape into 16 meatballs. Heat a non-stick frying pan, add the oil, then fry the meatballs, turning, for 5 mins until browned. Tip in the passata and remaining chopped basil. Simmer gently for 10 mins until the meatballs are cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil potatoes for 10-15 mins until tender. Drain well, then return to the saucepan over a low heat and mash – leaving the heat on will help to dry out the potatoes for a fluffier mash. Stir in the milk, then marble through the pesto. Pile the mash onto 4 plates, spoon over meatballs and serve scattered with the reserved basil.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian sausage, egg, green bell pepper, onion, cereal, milk, worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 2: Chop sausage finely. Step 3: In a large bowl combine beef, sausage, egg beat, bell pepper, onion, cereal, milk, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Step 4: Mix together and press into a loaf pan. Step 5: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through. Step 6: Drain grease from loaf pan periodically during baking. Step 7: Let stand before serving.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, bacon, onion, celery, carrot, dried oregano, garlic, lean ground beef, balsamic vinegar, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, white sugar, salt, ground black pepper, basil, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Stir in spaghetti and return to a boil. Step 3: Cook spaghetti uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes; drain. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; add bacon. Step 5: Cook, turning occasionally, until crisp, 8 to. Step 6: Add onion, celery, carrot, and oregano to bacon; continue cooking until vegetables begin to soften, 8 to. Step 7: Add garlic; cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Crumble in ground beef; cook and stir until no longer pink and completely cooked, 8 to. Step 9: Pour vinegar over ground beef mixture; simmer until liquid evaporates, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and sugar; bring to a boil, season with salt and black pepper, then remove from heat, stir in basil. Step 11: Spoon sauce over spaghetti; top with Parmesan cheese to serve.

Dish Name: More veg, less meat summer Bolognese
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, carrots, celery, zucchini, garlic, ground beef, tomato puree, tomato, fresh fettuccine, peas, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in large deep frying pan. Add the onions, carrots, celery, courgettes and garlic. Cook for about 10 mins or until soft, adding a few splashes of water if the mixture begins to stick. Turn up the heat and add the mince. Fry for a few mins more, breaking up the mince with the back of a spoon. Stir in tomato purée, pour over the chopped tomatoes and add a can of water. Simmer for 15 mins until the sauce is thick, then season. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the fettuccine following pack instructions. Step 3: Tip the peas into the sauce and simmer for 2 mins more until tender. Stir through the drained pasta and parsley, then serve.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, spaghetti sauce, italian seasoning, garlic salt, cheese ravioli, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Spray an 8-inch glass baking dish with non-stick spray Measure 1 / 2 cup spaghetti sauce from jar and spread evenly on bottom of dish Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Drain and return to skillet. Step 3: Add remaining spaghetti sauce, italian seasoning and garlic salt. Step 4: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Layer half of ravioli on the sauce in the dish. Step 6: Spread half of the beef mixture over the ravioli and top with 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Repeat layers one more time, ending with cheese.

Dish Name: One pot creamy tomato beef pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, onions, ground beef ground beef, italian herbs, tomato paste, tomatoes, red pepper flakes, cooking salt kosher salt, fresh black pepper, chicken stock broth, fusilli, thickened heavy cream, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Sauté - Heat the oil on high heat in a large heavy-based pot. Cook garlic and onion for 1 1/2 minutes. Step 2: Cook beef & seasonings - Add beef and cook, breaking it up as you go, until you can no longer see red meat. Add the Italian herbs and cook for 30 seconds, then add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to cook out the raw flavour. Step 3: All in - Add crushed tomato, chicken stock, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes, if using. Stir, then add the pasta. Step 4: Cook 15 min - Bring the liquid to a simmer, then cook for 15 minutes, stirring every couple of minutes then more frequently towards the end (ensure pasta doesn't stick to base) until the pasta is just about cooked. Step 5: Creamy - Add cream, then simmer for a further 1 to 2 minutes. It will still be quite saucy - this is what you want! Pasta absorbs liquid quickly, so it will still be nice and oozy when you start eating. Step 6: Serve - Remove from the stove. Give it a good stir then ladle into bowls. Serve with parmesan and parsley.

Ingredient Names: beef roast, italian dressing mix seasoning, water, pepperoncini peppers, bread rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Place roast into a slow cooker and rub dressing mix over top. Step 2: Pour water around roast. Step 3: Cover and cook on High until meat is tender and can be easily pulled apart with a fork, 5 to. Step 4: Remove meat and shred with two forks. Step 5: Return meat to the slow cooker; add pepperoncini and as much pepperoncini juice as you like for additional flavor. Step 6: Cover and cook for 1 more hour, serve on buns.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, veal shanks, butter, olive oil, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, tomato sauce, water, dried basil, dried thyme, parsley, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a shallow dish, stir together flour, salt, and black pepper. Step 2: Dredge meat in seasoned flour. Step 3: In a large skillet, melt butter with oil over medium heat, brown meat. Step 4: Remove meat from pan, and set aside. Step 5: Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic to drippings in pan. Step 6: Cook and stir for about 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in tomato sauce, water, basil, thyme, parsley, and bay leaf. Step 8: Return meat to pan. Step 9: Bring to a boil, and reduce heat to simmer. Step 10: Cover, and cook for 2 1/.

Ingredient Names: beef oxtail, olive oil, salt, ground black pepper, yellow onion, garlic, tomato sauce, chicken broth, sherry, vinegar, fresh oregano, rosemary, kosher salt, red chili flakes, thyme
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 2: Lightly oil a baking pan large enough to hold oxtails in a single layer. Step 3: Rub oxtail sections with olive oil; season with salt and black pepper. Step 4: Place onion and garlic in prepared pan; place oxtails on top. Step 5: Roast in the preheated oven. Step 6: Flip oxtails; continue roasting until well browned, 20 to more. Step 7: Add tomato sauce, chicken stock, vinegar, thyme, oregano, rosemary, kosher salt, and red pepper flakes to the baking pan; stir and transfer mixture to a large pot. Step 8: Place over medium-high heat until sauce begins to simmer. Step 9: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer over low heat until oxtails very tender and easily separate from bones, 4 to. Step 10: Skim off fat before serving.

Ingredient Names: quantity beef red wine carrots, tomato, pappardelle pasta, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: First make the Beef with red wine & carrots. You will need half the finished stew for this recipe. Step 2: Put the stew in a large pan and use 2 forks to roughly shred the beef. Add the tomatoes, bring to a simmer, then gently cook for 15 mins. Meanwhile, cook the pasta. Step 3: Spoon some sauce onto each portion of pasta, or stir through and top with Parmesan to serve.

Ingredient Names: beef shank, kosher salt, garlic, tomato paste, whole black peppercorns, ground black pepper, sage leaves, rosemary, bay leaves, red wine, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle all sides generously with kosher salt. Step 3: Place chopped garlic and a pinch of salt in a mortar and mash with pestle until pastelike. Step 4: Add tomato paste; mash until blended. Step 5: Transfer mixture into bowl with beef and rub onto all sides of meat. Step 6: Add crushed peppercorns and ground pepper. Step 7: Distribute evenly over all sides of beef. Step 8: Transfer to a deep skillet or Dutch oven bone side down. Step 9: Tuck sage leaves, rosemary, and dry bay leaves between pieces of meat. Step 10: Carefully add wine along the side of the pan to avoid washing over the top of the meat. Step 11: Place pan over high heat and bring to a simmer; reduce heat to low, cover tightly. Step 12: Cook until meat is fork tender, turning pieces every or so, about 3 1/. Step 13: Transfer pieces of meat to a warm bowl. Step 14: Increase heat to high and bring braising liquid to a boil. Step 15: Simmer until liquid is reduced by about half or until slightly thickened, 8 to. Step 16: Remove bones from meat. Step 17: When sauce is thickened, transfer meat back to skillet. Step 18: Reduce heat to medium-low and spoon sauce over meat. Step 19: Cook until until heated through, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, egg noodles, shredded mozzarella cheese, spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, sliced mushrooms, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until no longer pink, breaking into crumbles as it cooks, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rapid boil. Step 4: Cook egg noodles at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain. Step 5: Combine beef, noodles, 1/2 mozzarella cheese, spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, mushrooms, and black olives in a large bowl; transfer to a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 6: Top with remaining 1/2 mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is bubbling, 30 to.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, garlic, garlic powder, salt, ground black pepper, italian seasoning, dried basil, dried oregano, pasta sauce, ravioli, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook and stir beef, garlic, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in the hot skillet until meat is browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 3: Drain and discard grease. Step 4: Stir pasta sauce, Italian seasoning, basil, and oregano into ground beef mixture. Step 5: Ladle a generous layer of meat sauce into the bottom of a slow cooker; add a layer of ravioli. Step 6: Ladle another layer of meat sauce over ravioli layer; alternate with remaining ravioli and meat sauce until all ingredients are used. Step 7: Cook on Low for 3 to. Step 8: Sprinkle ravioli mixture with mozzarella cheese and continue cooking until cheese is melted, to more.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, salt, beef chuck, kosher salt, celery, carrot, ground black pepper, white wine, tomato paste, bay leaf, red onions, rigatoni, pecorino cheese, marjoram, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add pancetta and cook until most of the fat is rendered, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a plate with a slotted spoon. Step 4: Add beef chuck and salt to the pot. Step 5: Increase the heat to high; cook and stir until browned and any liquid released begins to evaporate, 10 to. Step 6: Reduce the heat to medium-high. Step 7: Add cooked pancetta, celery, carrots, remaining salt, and pepper; cook and stir for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add white wine, tomato paste, and bay leaf; cook and stir for 2 to, scraping up the drippings from the bottom of the pan. Step 9: Add yellow and red onions. Step 10: Reduce the heat to medium, cover, and cook for without stirring. Step 11: After, stir onions and meat until well mixed. Step 12: Cover again and cook for 30 more minutes. Step 13: Stir, then reduce the heat to low. Step 14: Keep uncovered and cook, occasionally stirring and skimming off any fat, until beef and onions seem to melt into each other, 8 to. Step 15: If the sauce is reducing too much, add water or broth as needed to maintain a sauce-like consistency. Step 16: When the sauce is almost finished, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 17: Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until just barely al dente, 10 to, drain. Step 18: Add rigatoni to the sauce and cook until heated through. Step 19: Garnish with Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, marjoram, and cayenne.

Ingredient Names: beef tomatoes, olive oil, risotto rice, green onions, zucchini, chestnut mushroom wiped, vegetable stock, mixed italian herbs, fresh basil leaves, parmesan, arugula leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the tops off the tomatoes and set aside. Scoop out the seeds and pulp from the tomatoes with a teaspoon, but be careful not to cut through to the base. Chop the pulp and keep the seeds, but discard the hard, central cores. Step 2: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan and tip in the rice. Fry gently over a low heat for 2 minutes, stirring frequently to stop the rice from browning, then add the spring onions, courgette and mushrooms and fry gently for 2 more minutes. Step 3: Preheat the oven to fan 170C/conventional 190C/gas 5. Pour in the stock then stir in the dried herbs, tomato pulp and seeds – the seeds will add fibre, and won’t be noticeable in the finished dish. Cook gently for about 15-20 minutes, stirring frequently until the rice is tender and the stock has been absorbed – add extra stock or water if necessary. Turn off the heat, tear the basil leaves into the pan and scatter with Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper and stir well. Step 4: Put the tomatoes in an ovenproof dish and fill each one generously with the risotto. Replace tomato tops and bake, uncovered, for 15-20 minutes until the tomatoes are tender. Cool for 5 minutes, then serve with a few rocket leaves on top.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, soy sauce, olive oil, steak seasoning, provolone cheese slices, bacon, fresh spinach, crimini mushrooms, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the flank steak on a cutting board with the short end closest to you. Step 2: Starting from one of the long sides, cut through the meat horizontally to within of the opposite edge. Step 3: (You can also ask your butcher to butterfly the flank steak for you instead of cutting it yourself.). Step 4: Mix the soy sauce, olive oil, and steak seasoning together in a gallon-sized resealable plastic bag. Step 5: Marinate flank steak in the refrigerator to overnight. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 7: Grease a glass baking dish. Step 8: Lay out the flank steak flat in front of you with the grain of the meat running from left to right. Step 9: Layer the provolone across the steak, leaving a 1-inch border. Step 10: Arrange the bacon, spinach, red pepper, and mushrooms across the cheese covered steak in stripes running in the same direction as the grain of the meat. Step 11: Roll the flank steak up and away from you, so that when the roll is cut into the pinwheel shape, each of the filling ingredients can be seen. Step 12: Roll firmly, but be careful not to squeeze the fillings out the ends. Step 13: Once rolled, tie every 2 inches with kitchen twine. Step 14: Place in prepared baking dish, and bake in preheated oven for one hour, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees F (65 degrees C). Step 15: Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 to before cutting into slices. Step 16: Be sure to remove the twine before serving!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, beef cheeks, onions, celery, fresh carrot, garlic, stems thyme, bay leaves, beef stock, red wine, salt, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the beef cheeks: cut off any large, fatty membrane. Pat dry then use 1 tsp of salt and black pepper to season the beef all over. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large heavy based pot over high heat. Sear half the beef cheeks on each side until nicely browned. Remove beef cheeks onto a plate, repeat with remaining cheeks. Step 3: Turn down the heat to medium high and heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil. Add garlic and onion. Sauté for 3 minutes until onion is becoming translucent. Step 4: Add the celery and carrot,s sauté for a further 3 minutes. Step 5: Follow directions for your chosen cooking method below. Step 6: Pour the onion mixture into the slow cooker and place the beef cheeks on top. Step 7: Pour the wine into the pot and return to heat. Turn the heat up to high, bring to simmer and let it simmer for 1 minute (to cook out the wine a bit). Scrape the brown bits off the bottom of the pan so it mixes in with the wine. Step 8: Pour the wine into the slow cooker, then all the remaining ingredients, starting with a pinch of salt and pepper (add more to taste later). Step 9: Cook in the slow cooker on Low for 8 hours or High for 6 hours for 250g/8oz size beef cheeks or Low for 10 - 12 hours or High for 8 hours for 350g/12oz beef cheeks. Step 10: Open the slow cooker and remove the beef cheeks. Discard the thyme stems and bay leaves. Step 11: Use a handheld stick blender to puree the braising liquid into a smooth Sauce - it will change from a dark brown to a lighter brown colour. Step 12: Transfer liquid into saucepan, simmer on stove on medium high until the Sauce turns a darker brown colour and reduces by about 1/4 to 1/3, to a gravy consistency - about 10 minutes. Step 13: Do a taste test and adjust the seasoning (salt and pepper) to your taste. Step 14: Remove from heat, return beef cheeks to the Sauce, cover and keep warm until ready to serve. Step 15: Follow the Slow Cooker directions but cook on high in your pressure cooker for 1 hour on high for small cheeks (around 250g/8oz each). Step 16: Pour the wine into the pot / casserole dish (with the onion mixture) and stir to scrape the brown bits off the bottom of the pot. Bring wine to simmer for 1 minute. Step 17: Add remaining ingredients, starting with a pinch of salt and pepper (add more to taste later), the place lid on. Step 18: Stove: Simmer on medium low for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until the cheeks are very tender, turn at least once during cooking. Step 19: Oven: 160C/320F for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Step 20: Remove the beef cheeks from sauce. Discard the thyme stems and bay leaves. Step 21: Use a handheld stick blender to puree the braising liquid into a smooth Sauce - it will change from a dark brown to a lighter brown colour. Step 22: Bring the Sauce to simmer over medium heat and simmer until it turns a darker brown colour and reduces by about 1/4 to 1/3, to a gravy consistency - about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 23: Do a taste test and adjust the seasoning (salt and pepper) to your taste. Step 24: Remove from heat, return beef cheeks to the Sauce, cover and keep warm until ready to serve. Step 25: Serve beef cheeks on Paris. Step 26: Mash (ultimate creamy mashed potato!) or Creamy Mashed Cauliflower, drizzled with a generous amount of Sauce. Garnish with finely chopped parsley if desired.

Ingredient Names: water, italian salad dressing mix, dried oregano, dried basil, dried parsley, onion salt, garlic powder, bay leaf, salt, ground black pepper, beef rump roast
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water, salad dressing mix, oregano, basil, parsley, onion salt, garlic powder, bay leaf, salt, and black pepper in a saucepan. Step 2: Stir well, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Place rump roast in a slow cooker; pour hot herb mixture over the meat. Step 4: Cover and cook on Low for 10 to, or on High for 4 to. Step 5: Remove bay leaf; shred beef with a fork and serve with some of the hot gravy.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, minced garlic, tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, dried oregano, shredded mozzarella cheese, cottage cheese, grated parmesan cheese, lasagna noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Cook ground beef, onion, and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat until the meat is browned. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, and oregano and stir until well combined and heated through. Step 4: Stir mozzarella, cottage cheese, and Parmesan together in a large bowl. Step 5: Spoon a layer of the meat mixture onto the bottom of a slow cooker. Step 6: Add a double layer of uncooked lasagna noodles, breaking noodles to fit into cooker as needed. Step 7: Top noodles with a portion of cheese mixture. Step 8: Repeat the layering of sauce, noodles, and cheese until all the ingredients are used. Step 9: Cover and cook on Low until lasagna noodles are tender, about 4 to.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, garlic, lean minced beef, mushrooms, dried herbs, tinned tomatoes, beef stock, tomato puree, worcestershire sauce, spaghetti, parmesan, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the onion and oil in a large pan and fry over a fairly high heat for 3-4 minutes. Step 2: Add the garlic and mince and fry until they both brown. Step 3: Add the mushrooms and herbs, and cook for another couple of mins. Step 4: Stir in the tomatoes, beef stock, tomato ketchup or purée, Worcestershire sauce and seasoning. Step 5: Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in a large pan of boiling, salted water, according to packet instructions. Step 7: Drain well, run hot water through it, put it back in the pan and add a dash of olive oil, if you like, then stir in the meat sauce. Step 8: Serve in hot bowls and hand round Parmesan cheese, for sprinkling on top.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, onions, fresh carrot, celery ribs, tomato, chicken stock broth, thyme, chili flakes, ground beef, spinach, beef bouillon cubes, pepper, worcestershire sauce, cannelloni tubes, mozzarella cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan or pot over medium high heat. Add garlic and onion, cook 2 minutes. Add carrot and celery, cook 5 minutes. Step 2: Add remaining Sauce ingredients then stir. Bring to simmer, lower heat to medium, cover with lid and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 3: Use a stick blender to blitz until smooth (or cool slightly and use blender or food processor). Set aside. Step 4: Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add onion and garlic, cook 2 minutes. Step 5: Add beef and cook, breaking it up as you go, until it all changes from red to brown. Step 6: Stir in spinach, then add crumbled beef cube, Worcestershire sauce, pepper and 1 cup of Cannelloni Sauce. Stir, cook 2 minutes. Step 7: Remove and cool slightly. Step 8: Preheat oven to 180°C/350°F. Step 9: Transfer Beef Filling into a piping bag with a wide nozzle. Stand cannelloni tubes upright in a container, then pipe filling in. (Or do this step with teaspoon/finger/dinner knife!). Step 10: Spread about 1 1/4 cups Sauce in a 23x33cm / 9x13" dish. Lay the cannelloni on top, then pour over remaining Sauce. Step 11: Sprinkle with cheese, loosely cover with foil. Step 12: Bake 25 minutes, remove foil then bake a further 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbly with some golden spots. Step 13: Remove from oven, sprinkle with parsley if using then serve!

Ingredient Names: ground beef, ground veal, ground pork, parmesan cheese, eggs, garlic, parsley, salt, ground black pepper, bread crumbs, water, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine beef, veal, and pork in a large bowl. Step 3: Mix in cheese, eggs, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Add bread crumbs and slowly mix in water, at a time, until mixture is moist but still holds its shape (I usually use about water); shape into meatballs. Step 5: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add meatballs in batches, spacing them slightly apart so they brown instead of steam. Step 7: Cook, turning occasionally, until evenly browned on all sides, slightly crisp on the outside, and cooked through in the center, about 10 to. Step 8: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 160 degrees F (71 degrees C). Step 9: Drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, onions, carrots, celery, garlic, ground sirloin, ground pork, dry red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, salt, ground black pepper, parsley, fresh basil, heavy cream, cheese tortellini, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, deep skillet, over medium heat, heat olive oil. Step 2: Add bacon and cook until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Drain grease. Step 3: Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic and cook, stirring often, until onion is softened. Step 4: Break up ground sirloin and pork and add to skillet. Step 5: Cook until no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add half the wine and half of the beef broth. Step 7: Cook over medium-high heat until liquid is almost absorbed, about 15 minutes. Step 8: Lower heat and stir in the tomato paste, salt, black pepper, parsley, and basil. Step 9: Pour in remaining wine and beef broth. Step 10: Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Step 11: While sauce is simmering prepare tortellini according to package directions. Step 12: After sauce has simmered 20 minutes, stir in the heavy cream and heat through. Step 13: Spoon sauce over tortellini and garnish with freshly grated Parmesan cheese. Step 14: {Note:I use a food processor to finely chop the bacon, onion, carrots, and celery for a smoother textured sauce, and to save an abundance of time}.

Dish Name: You Ll Never Miss The Noodles Lasagna
Ingredient Names: ground beef, sweet italian sausage link, onion, green bell pepper, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, tomato paste, dried basil, dried oregano, dried rosemary, water, whole milk ricotta cheese, eggs, fresh parsley, mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the meat and sausage in a large frying pan. Step 2: When meat is about half done, add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic and continue cooking until the onion is transparent. Step 3: Add the tomato sauce, paste, water and seasonings, mix well. Step 4: Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Beat the eggs and ricotta together. Step 6: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 7: Preheat oven to 325 and spray a 9x13-inch pan with olive oil cooking spray. Step 8: Spread 1 / 2 of the meat mixture in the bottom of the pan. Step 9: Top with sliced zucchini.

Dish Name: Balsamic Strawberries With Whipped Mascarpone Cheese
Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, sugar, lemon juice, mascarpone cheese, whipping cream, vanilla extract, strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, 2 teaspoons sugar, and lemon juice in heavy small saucepan. Step 2: Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Step 3: Boil until syrup is reduced to scant 1/4 cup, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to small bowl; cool completely. Step 5: (Can be made 2 days ahead. Cover and refrigerate.) Combine mascarpone, cream, vanilla, and 2 tablespoons sugar in medium bowl. Step 6: Whisk until thick soft peaks form. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate up to 4 hours. Step 8: Combine berries and remaining 2 tablespoons sugar in large bowl; drizzle with balsamic syrup and toss to blend. Step 9: Let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 10: Divide berries and syrup among 6 goblets. Step 11: Top with mascarpone mixture.

Dish Name: Berry semifreddo with warm chocolate sauce
Ingredient Names: egg whites, powdered instant coffee, golden sugar, hazelnuts, cartons cream, mixed berry, cream, golden syrup, dark chocolate, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to fan 90C/ conventional 110C/gas 1⁄4 and cover a baking sheet with baking parchment. Tip the egg whites into a large bowl, sprinkle in the coffee powder and whisk until the whites are stiff. Add half the caster sugar and whisk in well, then tip in the remaining sugar and the chopped hazelnuts and whisk until blended and standing in stiff peaks. Step 2: Spread the meringue mixture to a depth of about 2cm on the baking parchment (any shape will do as you’re going to break it up later). Bake for 3 hours until crisp right through. Remove and cool. Step 3: Cut out a 28cm circle of baking parchment and make 10cm cuts towards the centre all the way round. Use this to line the bottom and sides of a loose-bottomed 20cm round cake tin. Step 4: Pour the cream from both cartons into a bowl and whip until it just holds its shape. Break the meringue into smallish pieces with your hands. Set aside about a third of the meringue for the top of the cake, and mix the rest into the cream. Spread out about a third of the cream mixture in the bottom of the tin and cover with half the frozen berries. Repeat these layers once more, then cover with the remaining cream mixture and top with the reserved meringue. Cover the cake with cling film and compress evenly with a small plate that fits inside the tin. Wrap in foil, label and freeze for up to a month. Step 5: Make the sauce. Put the cream and golden syrup in a small pan with 3 tbsp water. Heat until just bubbling, then turn the heat down to low and add the chocolate and butter. Heat gently, stirring occasionally, until the chocolate melts and the mixture becomes smooth and glossy. Pour into a freezer container, cool, seal, label and freeze for up to a month. Step 6: On the day transfer the cake and the chocolate sauce from the freezer to the fridge 8 hours before you plan to serve. After 2-3 hours, take out the cake. Unwrap it and carefully balance the cake tin on a jam jar or can, then push down on the sides of the tin to release. Peel away the baking parchment from the sides. Now lift the cake off the base of the tin, discarding the parchment underneath (a wide palette knife or fish slice will help here) and stand the cake on a serving plate. Return to the fridge for 5 hours before serving with the chocolate sauce. Step 7: To warm the chocolate sauce, pour it into a heatproof bowl over a pan with a little hot water in the bottom and heat gently, stirring occasionally, until warm, smooth and glossy.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, golden sugar, flour, half lemon, assorted crystallised fruit, plain chocolate one, ricotta as as possible, powdered sugar, lemon juice, milk, green food colouring, rounded apricot jam, grand marnier cointreau, crystallised fruits candied peel angelica
Instructions: Step 1: The day before, preheat the oven to 160C/Gas 3/fan oven 140C. Brush a 25cm/10in springform cake tin with the melted butter and then dust with flour. Step 2: Make the sponge. Using an electric mixer fitted with balloon whisks, beat the eggs with the sugar until pale and airy. The mixture should be thick enough to leave a ribbon trail on the surface when the whisks are lifted – it takes about 8-10 minutes to get to this stage. Gently fold in the flour and lemon zest using the whisks or a spoon, trying not to deflate the beaten eggs and sugar. Step 3: Working quickly, transfer to the prepared cake tin and bake for about 30 minutes until firm to the touch (the cake should not have risen). Stand the tin on a wire rack and leave to cool, then remove the cake from the tin. Step 4: Make the ricotta cream. Finely chop the crystallised fruits and frozen chocolate. Mix the ricotta with the sugar and gently incorporate the fruit and chocolate. Place in the fridge until you are ready to assemble the cake. Step 5: Make the icing just before assembling the cake. Mix the icing sugar with the lemon juice and 1 tablespoon milk, then add a drop of green food colouring to give the icing a subtle green tinge, and beat vigorously. You should have a spreadable paste with a thick, non-liquid consistency – you may need a little extra milk. Step 6: Assemble the cake. Melt the jam with 1 tablespoon liqueur and 1 tablespoon water. Slice the sponge in half horizontally. Place the less perfect half on a flat serving plate and spread with half the jam mixture. Spread all the ricotta mixture on top. Spread the remaining jam mixture on the remaining sponge, then turn it over and put it jam side down on the ricotta cream. Spread the icing evenly across the top and smooth over with a palette knife, then place in the fridge for at least 1 hour (or for up to two days). Step 7: On the day, a few hours before serving decorate the top of the cake with crystallised fruits, peel and angelica as the fancy takes you.

Ingredient Names: pasta, half-and-half, parmesan cheese, garlic, butter, fresh black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water for pasta. Step 2: In a large frying pan (a steep-sided wok is ideal) melt butter on very low heat. Step 3: Start cooking pasta. Step 4: In frying pan, combine half and half, Parmesan, garlic, salt and pepper with melted butter. Step 5: Mix thoroughly and turn the heat up to medium (just hot enough to begin melting cheese). Step 6: Pasta should be nearly done by now; drain and pour into frying pan with sauce ingredients. Step 7: Toss together and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: flour, easy-blend yeast, golden sugar, milk, eggs, vanilla extract, butter, cranberries, candied peel, white chocolate chunks, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the flour, yeast and 1 tsp salt into the food processor fitted with a dough blade. Mix briefly, then add the sugar and mix again. Warm the milk to hand hot and, in a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the vanilla extract. Add both the milk and eggs to the dry ingredients and mix to a soft dough. Work the dough in the processor for 2 mins, then leave in the machine until doubled in size, about 1 hr. Step 2: Cut softened butter into the processor, pulse until incorporated, leave for a further 1 hr to rise again. Add the cranberries, candied peel and white chocolate to the machine, then pulse gently to mix evenly. Step 3: Butter and base line a 20cm deep cake tin. Make a 10cm collar with double thickness baking paper and line the sides of the tin. Tip the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead briefly to shape into a ball. The dough will be very soft, so flour your hands well before handling it and work quickly. Drop the dough into the tin and leave to rise for 30 mins. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Step 4: Brush top of the dough liberally with beaten egg and scatter over almonds. Bake for 45-50 mins until the well risen and deep golden brown. Turn out of the tin and cool on a wire rack. Cut into wedges to serve. Will keep for 2 weeks wrapped in foil, or freeze on the day of making for up to 1 month.

Ingredient Names: linguine, cooking chorizo, capers, lemons, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the linguine following pack instructions. Meanwhile, put the chorizo in a cold frying pan over a low heat, then gradually increase it. Enough oil will be released by the chorizo to brown it without adding extra. Step 2: Stir and fry the chorizo until it is completely frazzled, then lift it out onto a plate. Step 3: Add the capers to the frying pan and cook for 1 min. Scoop them out and discard any excess oil. Step 4: Drain the pasta and add the chorizo and capers along with the lemon juice and rocket. Season and toss everything together.

Ingredient Names: garlic, parsley, fresh chives, pine nuts, parmesan, juice lemon, olive oil, gnocchi
Instructions: Step 1: Place the garlic, herbs, pine nuts, cheese and lemon zest in a small bowl, season well, then stir in the olive oil and lemon juice. Set aside. Step 2: Cook the gnocchi in a pan of salted boiling water following pack instructions, then drain well. Tip into a serving bowl and toss through the pesto. Serve with extra grated Parmesan, if you like.

Dish Name: Griddled polenta with corn & green salsa
Ingredient Names: polenta, sweetcorn, red chile, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, avocados chunks, cucumber chunks, green onions, fresh cilantro, limes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 1.5 litres of water to the boil in a large saucepan. While stirring the water constantly with a wooden spoon, tip in the polenta in a steady stream. Lower the heat so the polenta isn’t spluttering too much, then cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins. Meanwhile, line a 40 x 30cm tray with baking parchment. Stir the corn, chilli and grated cheese into the polenta with 2 tsp salt, then spoon out onto the tray. Spread to a rough rectangle, making sure the polenta is packed tightly and there are no gaps. Cover with another sheet of baking parchment and a flat baking tray, then top with some cans or jars to press and flatten the polenta while you chill it in the fridge for at least 2 hrs, or up to a day. Step 2: Before barbecuing, mix together the avocado, cucumber, spring onions, coriander, lime and 2 tbsp oil with seasoning. Step 3: Heat the barbecue (or a griddle pan), trim the edges off the set polenta to neaten, then slice into 12 wedges. Brush both sides of each wedge with a little of the remaining oil and barbecue or griddle for 5 mins on each side until charred and hot through. Serve a couple of wedges per person, topped with a generous spoon of the chunky green salsa.

Dish Name: Griddled rump steak with watercress, hazelnut & red chilli pesto
Ingredient Names: blanched hazelnuts, red chile, watercress, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, rump steak
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Place the hazelnuts in a baking tray, then toast in the oven for 5-10 mins until golden (you can roast the garlic for the mash at the same time). Leave the nuts to cool a little. Put the cooled nuts, chilli, 50g of the watercress, 1½ tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp balsamic and some seasoning in a food processor, then blitz until finely chopped. The mixture shouldn’t be too smooth – there should still be some texture to the nuts. Set aside. Step 2: Heat a griddle pan until smoking hot. Rub the steaks with a little oil, then season both sides with salt. Cook the steaks on the griddle for 2 mins on each side – this will give you medium rare (cook for 3 mins for medium or 4 mins for well done, if you prefer). Remove from the griddle, then sit on a plate for 5 mins to rest. Stir any juices from the resting steak into the pesto – they’re delicious and shouldn’t be wasted. Step 3: To serve, divide the Roasted garlic mash (recipe, below) between 2 plates, top with a little watercress, then sit a steak across it. Top the steaks with a large tbsp of the pesto and drizzle the rest of the balsamic over.

Dish Name: Hazelnut gelato with rich chocolate sauce
Ingredient Names: hazelnuts, cream, full-fat milk, light muscovado sugar, egg yolks, instant coffee, plain chocolate, hazelnut liqueur
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the nuts in a dry pan for 5 mins until golden. Leave to cool. Roughly chop 25g and set aside. Heat the cream, milk and sugar in a pan until nearly boiling. Whisk together the eggs yolks in a small bowl. Pour a little of the hot cream over the eggs and whisk together. Step 2: Pour the egg mix to the pan and gently cook for about 8-10 mins until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Set a medium-size bowl over another bowl of iced water. As soon as the custard has thickened, strain into the bowl, then stir through the 150g hazelnuts. Leave to cool a little, then pour the mixture into a blender and whizz until smooth. Freeze according to your ice-cream maker’s instructions. Will freeze for up to 1 month. Step 3: For the sauce, heat the cream with the coffee in a pan until boiling. Take off the heat, stir the chocolate until melted, then stir in the liqueur, if using. Serve scoops of ice cream in bowls with some sauce drizzled on top and the reserved chopped nuts scattered over.

Ingredient Names: round steaks, italian stewed tomatoes, oregano, parsley, onion salt, fresh black pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, olive oil, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350°F (325°F is using glass baking dish). Step 2: Place steaks, in one layer, in a 9x13-inch baking pan. Step 3: Mash up tomatoes and pour on top of steaks, spreading to cover steaks. Step 4: Sprinkle with oregano, parsley, onion salt, black pepper, crushed red pepper, and minced garlic. Step 5: Drizzle olive oil on top and bake, uncovered for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Step 6: Take steaks out of oven; sprinkle tops with shredded Mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Return to oven and bake until cheese is melted. Step 8: *NOTE* If you want to use the sauce over pasta, you might want to add 1 (8 oz.) can of tomato sauce along with the can of stewed tomatoes to make it go a little further.

Dish Name: Italian turkey steaks with garlicky bean mash
Ingredient Names: lemons juice from, olive oil, garlic, oregano, turkey steaks, cherry, broad bean
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and bring a pan of water to the boil. Mix most of the lemon zest with the lemon juice, oil, garlic and seasoning. Set aside two-thirds, then mix the oregano into the rest. Pour this over the turkey steaks on a plate and turn them to coat. Step 2: Fry the turkey steaks in a non-stick frying pan for 1-2 mins on each side to brown, then transfer to a roasting tin. Scatter the tomatoes around, then roast in the oven for 4-8 mins, depending on the thickness of the turkey, until the steaks are just cooked through. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the beans in the boiling water for 4-5 mins until tender. Tip a ladle of the cooking water into a food processor, then drain the beans and tip into the processor with the reserved lemon dressing. Whizz to a mash, then divide between 4 plates and top with a turkey steak, scattering over remaining lemon zest. Shake the tin so the tomatoes roll around in the cooking juices, then serve with the turkey.

Dish Name: Marinara Sauce of Alan Leonetti (2 Servings) (((The Best)))
Ingredient Names: hunts chunky tomatoes, hunts tomato paste, stewed tomatoes, virgin olive oil, garlic, garlic juice, shallots, oregano, italian seasoning, fresh basil, splenda granular, salt, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Empty Hunts chunky crushed tomatoes and Hunts tomato paste into the pot. Step 2: Add the extra-virgin olive oil to the pot. Step 3: Slice the cloves of garlic crosswise into either halves or thirds or pieces, and dump them into the pot. Step 4: Dice the shallot, and dump that into the pot. Step 5: Add the rest of the ingredients, and stir to mix well with a large long handled wooden spoon. Step 6: Do not strain, as the pulp adds to make this a thick and wonderful sauce. Step 7: Cover and cook on medium heat, stirring every 10 minutes for about an hour or until it bubbles and is completely heated throughout. Step 8: Reduce heat to simmer, and continue to simmer, stirring every 10 or 15 minutes to keep from burning or sticking to the bottom of the pot for 1 or 2 hours. Step 9: Remove from heat and give it one last stir. Step 10: Serve over spaghetti, ravioli, pasta or use for chicken parmesan, veal parmesan, or anything that calls for a marinara sauce. Step 11: NOTE: Use only Hunts Chunky Crushed Tomatoes and Hunts Tomato Paste.

Dish Name: Pan-fried sea bass with puttanesca sauce & celeriac chips
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, chili flakes, tomato, capers, green olives, celeriac, kale, butter, lemon juice, sea bass fillets, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a frying pan. Tip in the onion, garlic and chilli flakes and cook over a low heat for 10 mins until soft. Add the tomatoes and ¼ can of water and cook for 8 mins until thick, then stir through the capers and olives. Can be done earlier in the day and chilled. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat oven to 220C/200C fan/ gas 7. Put the celeriac on a non-stick baking sheet. Add another 1 tbsp oil, season and mix with your hands. Spread into a thin layer and roast for 25 mins, stirring once, until golden and tender. Step 3: Put the kale in a steamer and cook for about 5 mins until tender. When done, pop a knob of butter on top, squeeze over a little lemon juice and season. Step 4: Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan. Season the fish fillets, then put in the pan, skin-side down. Cook for 3-4 mins until the skin is golden and the fish is almost cooked through. Turn and cook for 1-2 mins more, depending on the thickness of the fillets. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat the sauce through, season and add the parsley. Spoon the sauce onto 2 plates, top with the fish and serve with the celeriac chips and kale.

Dish Name: Pot-roast loin of pork with celeriac, shallots & pancetta
Ingredient Names: british pork loin, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice only, fennel seeds, oregano, shallots, celeriac, twin-pack cubetti di pancetta, full-bodied red wine drink remainder
Instructions: Step 1: Using a small, sharp kitchen knife, stab through the fatty side of the pork loin to make about 30 fairly deep, randomly spaced incisions. Insert a sliver of garlic into each stab mark, pushing the garlic well into the meat and smoothing over the fat to close up the entry points. Reserve a few slivers to push in cuts made on the flesh-side of the joint. Step 2: Put 5 tablespoons of the olive oil, the juice of the lemon, tbsp of fennel seeds and the leaves stripped from 4 oregano sprigs in a large non-reactive dish (a non-porous dish, such as glass or stainless steel, which won’t react with acidic foods and alter the flavour). Grind in plenty of black pepper, then swish everything into a sludge with one clean hand. Put the joint into the dish and massage the marinade into every nook and cranny. Leave the pork to marinade for 6-24 hours in a cool place or the fridge. Step 3: When you are ready to start cooking, preheat the oven to 170C/Gas 4/fan oven 150C. Put the 300g of shallots in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 2 minutes to loosen the skins, then tip the shallots into a large sieve or colander and rinse under cold water. Trim off the root end, then peel the shallots, breaking any large ones into their natural segments. Halve the 4 celeriac wedges, then cut into large, bite-sized chunks. Step 4: Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Toss in the 130g pack of pancetta and fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly frazzled. Transfer the cubes to a large casserole big enough to take the pork, using a slotted spoon so the fat drains back into the pan. Throw the shallots and celeriac into the frying pan and sauté them for 3-4 minutes until coloured, turning frequently. Transfer them to the casserole, again draining off the oil. Step 5: Pull the frying pan to one side. Quickly scrape off any excess marinade from the pork loin, then season the meat with fine sea salt. Replace the frying pan over a medium-high heat and brown the pork on all sides, including the ends. Place the loin on the vegetables in the casserole. Stuff the remaining 4 sprigs of oregano around it. Step 6: Pour off and discard all the fat in the frying pan, raise the heat and pour in the 600ml of wine. Bring to the boil, scraping up all the tasty bits from the bottom of the pan. Let the wine bubble and reduce for 3 minutes, then pour into the casserole. Step 7: Place the casserole over a high heat and bring the juices up to a bubble. Immediately put the lid on the casserole and transfer it to the oven. Cook the loin for 1 hour 45 minutes, turning it halfway through. Remove the casserole from the oven and leave the pork to rest in a warm place for 15-30 minutes, still covered, before carving.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash cm-thick, olive oil, chili, red onions, red peppers, arugula leaves, lemons, ball light mozzarella, pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Place the squash on a large baking tray. Toss with 2 tsp of the oil, chilli and seasoning. Bake for 15 mins. Step 2: Take tray out of the oven and turn the squash. Scatter the onion and peppers over the top and return to the oven for a further 25 mins or until vegetables are tender and lightly charred. Step 3: Toss the rocket leaves with the remaining oil, lemon juice and some pepper. Pile onto plates and divide the squash, onion and peppers on top. Tear the mozzarella over the salads and spoon over the pesto. Serve warm.

Dish Name: Sage & prosciutto pork with rich mushroom ragout
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, prosciutto, sage leaves, lemons, shallots, porcini mushroom, olive oil, chestnut mushrooms, marsala, tomato puree, flatleaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare Ahead: Cut each tenderloin in half and split almost in half down length. Open out the pork and bat out with a rolling pin. Put 3 slices of prosciutto overlapping lengthwise on a board and put one pork tenderloin on top. Season all over with salt and pepper, put three sage leaves on top and sprinkle with a little lemon juice. Roll up like a swiss roll and tie with two pieces of string or secure with cocktail sticks. Repeat with the remaining pork. Put in a roasting tin, cover and chill for up to 24 hours until ready to cook. Step 2: Peel and finely chop the shallots. Tip the dried mushrooms into a measuring jug and pour over boiling water to reach the 300ml/1⁄2 pint mark. Leave for 20 minutes. Heat the oil in a pan, add the shallots and gently cook for 5 minutes without colouring. Drain the mushrooms, reserving the soaking liquid, chop and add to the pan with the fresh mushrooms. Season and cook until the mushrooms are softened, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Splash in the Marsala and cook until the liquid is almost gone. Add the soaking liquid, tomato purée, salt and pepper and bubble up for 2 minutes. Set aside for up to 2 hours until ready to serve. Step 4: On the day: Preheat the oven to 190C/Gas 5/fan oven 170C. Roast the pork rolls for 25-30 minutes, until the prosciutto is crisp and the pork feels firm to the touch. Gently reheat the mushroom ragout then serve each pork parcel, cut in half with a little mushroom ragout on the side. Scatter over a little chopped parsley.

Ingredient Names: penne, olives, sausage, chunky chestnut mushroom, cherry tomato, fresh rosemary leaves, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to pack instructions. Step 2: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan, then fry the sausages and mushrooms for 5 mins until golden. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and cook for about another 3 mins on a high heat until the tomatoes pop and start to form a sauce. Step 4: Season to taste, then add the herbs and drained pasta and stir well.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, sirloin steaks, tomatoes, oregano, boiled new potatoes, arugula leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a heavy-based frying pan over a high heat, then add the olive oil and garlic. Season the meat; then, two at a time, quickly brown the steaks on both sides. Step 2: Put all 4 steaks in the pan, add the tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, then turn down the heat. Sprinkle the oregano over the meat and tomatoes, partially cover the pan, then simmer gently for 10 mins. Step 3: Lift the tender pieces of meat from the pan, cover with foil, then set aside. Increase the heat, then simmer the tomato sauce for about 10 mins, until it has reduced by half. Spoon the sauce over the steak and serve with new potatoes and a handful of rocket.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, sirloin steak, vine-ripened tomato, fat garlic, extra-virgin olive oil, oregano, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Make the sauce. If using fresh tomatoes, roughly chop them. Place in a pan with the garlic, oil, oregano or marjoram and season to taste. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 mins, stirring once or twice. Take off the heat, stir in the basil, then set aside. Step 2: When ready to serve, heat a heavy-based frying pan until you can feel a strong heat rising. Smear the oil on both sides of the steak and season each side. Slap the steak into the centre of the pan and adjust the heat to medium-high. Cook for 6 mins, turning halfway through – this is for medium rare. For a medium steak, allow 7-8 mins in total, allow 8-10 mins for well done. Step 3: Remove from the pan to a warm platter and leave to stand for 5 mins. Cut in two and serve drizzled with any juices and topped with the sauce.

Ingredient Names: strong coffee preferably using ground, golden sugar, marsala, sponge fingers, cornflour, semi-skimmed milk, eggs, vanilla pod split, half-fat creme fraiche, light mascarpone, light soft cheese, cocoa powder, fresh raspberry
Instructions: Step 1: First make the coffee soaking liquid for the sponge fingers. Stir the coffee and sugar together, then pour into a shallow heatproof dish. Stir in the Marsala and leave to cool. Step 2: Meanwhile, prepare the filling. Put the sugar and cornflour into a medium saucepan, preferably non-stick. Stir in 1 tbsp of the measured milk to make a thin, smooth paste. Separate the egg, putting the white into a medium bowl and setting it aside, and dropping the yolk into the saucepan. Beat the yolk into the cornflour paste, then stir in the rest of the milk. Scrape the seeds from the vanilla pod into the pan, then drop in the pod. Cook over a medium-low heat for about 8-10 mins without letting the mixture boil, stirring all the time, until the mixture thickly coats the back of a wooden spoon. Remove from the heat, then stir in the crème fraîche and the 1 tbsp of Marsala. Transfer the mixture to a bowl, cover the surface with cling film and leave until cold. Step 3: To assemble, line a 23 x 13 x 6cm deep loaf tin with cling film, leaving an overlap at the top. Beat together the mascarpone and soft cheese, then stir into the rest of the cold filling. Whisk the egg white to stiff peaks and gently fold into the filling using a large metal spoon. Step 4: Dip one of the sponge fingers in the coffee mixture, rolling it around briefly, for a few secs only, to coat and soak in, then lift it out before it has a chance to get too soggy. If left in the coffee, it will disintegrate. Lay it lengthways in the bottom of the tin. Do the same with 5 more of the sponge fingers, trimming to fit if necessary, so that they cover the bottom of the tin. Spoon over half of the filling, spreading it to cover the biscuits, then repeat the biscuit dipping with 6 more of them. Spoon and spread over the rest of the filling, then dip and lay the rest of the sponge fingers over the top. Bring the cling film overhang over to cover. Chill overnight. Step 5: To serve, turn out onto a serving plate and carefully peel off the cling film. Dust the top with cocoa and scatter with raspberries, if using. Slice and serve the same day.

Ingredient Names: dark chocolate cocoa, cream, coffee liqueur, cocoa powder, cantuccini
Instructions: Step 1: Put the chocolate into a bowl. Mix the cream with the coffee liqueur, reserve 2 tbsp, then tip the rest into a saucepan and bring just to the boil. Remove from the heat and tip straight over the chocolate, stirring until the chocolate melts. Divide between 2 small glasses and allow to cool slightly. Whip the remaining cream until slightly thickened, then spoon over the cooled chocolate mix. Chill for at least 1 hr to set. While you’re waiting, cut a heart shape from a piece of thick card. Step 2: When ready to serve, set the card over the glass and sift over a dusting of cocoa powder. Lift off carefully and do the same with the other glass.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, vanilla paste, mascarpone, cream, kahl, very strong coffee, sponge fingers, cocoa powder, mild oil like sunflower, clear honey, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the egg yolk with the caster sugar and vanilla paste until pale. Add the mascarpone and cream, then beat with an electric whisk until smooth and thick. Step 2: Put the Kahlua and coffee in a bowl and dip in enough sponge fingers to cover the bottoms of 2 small bowls or ramekins. Cover with half the creamy mixture, repeat with some more soaked biscuits, topping with more creamy mixture, until your dishes are full. Dust with a little cocoa powder and chill for at least 2 hrs or overnight. Step 3: For the honeycomb, oil a baking tray or tin or line with a non-stick mat. Gently heat the sugar and honey with a splash of water in a heavy-based pan until melted. Increase the heat and bubble to a good caramel colour, then lift off the heat, whisk in the bicarb and tip onto the baking tray to cool. Once cold, crush with a rolling pin or thinly slice into shards, and scatter a little over the tiramisus to serve. Leftover honeycomb will keep for a week in an airtight tin.

Ingredient Names: virgin olive oil, squeezed lemon juice, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, boneless steaks, loosely arugula, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the 5 tblsps olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, oregano and a pinch each of salt and pepper in a small bowl until smooth. Step 2: Heat the 1 tsp olive oil in a large, cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until smoking. Step 3: Meanwhile, season the steaks liberally with salt and pepper. Step 4: Lay the steaks in the pan and cook, without moving, until a well-browned crust forms, about 5 to 6 minutes. Step 5: Using tongs, flip the steaks. Step 6: Reduce the heat to medium. Step 7: Cook 3 to 4 minutes more for rare or 5 to 6 minutes for medium-rare. Step 8: Divide the arugula evenly among 4 individual plates. Step 9: Cut each steak crosswise into thin strips and arrange the steak over the arugula. Step 10: Drizzle any juices that have collected from the meat over the greens. Step 11: Rewhisk the dressing and drizzle it over the steak and greens. Step 12: Sprinkle with the Parmesan and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, olive oil, garlic powder, provolone cheese, pepperoni, italian sausage, spinach, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f Spray with cooking spray a large cookie sheet or a jelly roll pan Unroll the pizza crust onto the cookie sheet Do not stretch it. Step 2: Brush the crust with olive oil and then sprinkle with garlic powder Lay half of the slices of cheese across one side of the crust, then layer half of the pepperoni on top of it, then half of the cooked sausage, then half of the spinach. Step 3: Repeat the layers of cheese, pepperoni, sausage, and spinach. Step 4: Fold the crust over and pinch all around to seal the edges. Step 5: Bake at 400f for 15 minutes of until crust is a light golden brown. Step 6: Serve with marinara sauce, if desired.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic powder, italian seasoning, dried oregano, pepper, italian cheese blend, french bread
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients and 1 / 3 cup of cheese. Step 2: Spread mixture evenly on cut sides of bread. Step 3: Sprinkle evenly with remaining 2 / 3 cup of cheese. Step 4: Place on a baking sheet. Step 5: Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and golden. Step 6: Let stand 2 to 3 minutes before slicing and serving.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, french bread, parsley flakes, aluminum foil
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350f Mince garlic and stir into butter. Step 2: Slice bread into thick slices, about 3 / 4" Spread one side of each slice with butter mixture, then sprinkle with parsley flakes Re-arrange slices into loaf. Step 3: Wrap with aluminum foil. Step 4: Bake for 15-20 minutes.

Dish Name: Aromatic Herbed Bread Filled With Prosciutto
Ingredient Names: warm water, olive oil, bread flour, salt, fast rising yeast, sugar, prosciutto, milk, herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the bread ingredients except prosciutto in the bread machine pan in the order suggested by the manufacturer Select dough cycle and start machine At end of cycle take dough out and punch dough down and flatten. Step 2: Roll to a rectangle. Step 3: Place prosciutto over in a single layer then roll up as a jelly roll Score top. Step 4: Place loaves on greased cookie sheet, cover. Step 5: Let rise until double, about 40 hour. Step 6: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: warm water, active dry yeast, egg, salt, granulated sugar, bread flour, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Step 2: Let sit, undisturbed for about 10 minutes You should see little bubbles appear This tells you that the yeast is active. Step 3: In a large bowl, mix oil, eggs, salt, sugar and water and yeast mixture together till blended. Step 4: Add flour one cup at a time, mixing well after each addition. Step 5: Knead till smooth and elastic. Step 6: Let rise till doubled, about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Step 7: Repeat the kneading and rising Punch down.

Dish Name: Bacon And Cheese Bread Pull Aparts
Ingredient Names: bacon, frozen bread dough, oil, mozzarella cheese, ranch dressing mix
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon until half done. Step 2: Drain on paper towels. Step 3: Roll out dough to 1 / 2 inch thick, brush with 1 t oil. Step 4: Cut into 1 inch pieces, place in large bowl. Step 5: Add bacon, cheese, dressing mix, and remaining oil, toss to coat. Step 6: Arrange pieces in a 9in by 6in oval on a greased baking sheet, layer as needed. Step 7: Cover and let rise until doubled. Step 8: Bake at 350 for 15 minutes, cover with foil and bake 8 minutes more, until golden.

Ingredient Names: bread mix, flour for rolling, tomato pasta sauce, fresh basil leaves, cherry tomatoes, ball mozzarella, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Make up the bread dough following pack instructions, and transfer to an oiled bowl to rise for about 1 hr. Step 2: Knock back in the bowl by squashing all the air out of the dough with your fist. Divide the dough into 6 and roll each one on a lightly floured surface to a circle about 18cm in diameter. Put dough you’re not using under a damp tea towel or oiled cling film to stop it drying out. Step 3: Put the pizza bases on large oiled baking sheets – you may need 2 or 3. Spread 1 tbsp sauce or passata on each base, then scatter on the basil, tomatoes, mozzarella and Parmesan (or whatever you fancy). You can freeze the pizzas now, if you like, on the baking sheet, wrapped in cling film. Or if eating straight away, heat oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 9. Cook for 8-12 mins, until crisp and golden. To cook from frozen, remove the cling film and heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Bake for 10-14 mins until crisp and golden.

Dish Name: Banana Muffins With Mascarpone Cream Frosting Or Spread
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, bananas, cream cheese, unsalted butter, mascarpone cheese, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Line 18 muffin cups with paper liners. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 325f. Step 3: Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a medium bowl to blend. Step 4: Beat the sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl to blend. Step 5: Stir in the banana. Step 6: Add the dry ingredients and stir just until blended. Step 7: Divide the batter among the prepared muffin cups. Step 8: Bake the muffins on the middle rack until the tops are golden brown and a tester inserted into the center comes out with no crumbs attached, about 25 minutes. Step 9: Transfer the muffins to a rack and cool slightly The muffins may be eaten warm or cooled completely and frosted.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, olive oil, bread
Instructions: Step 1: Split the garlic, and rub it into the bread slices If the bread is soft in the middle rub the garlic into the crust edges. Step 2: Spoon most of the olive oil into a pan set at medium high heat. Step 3: Grill the bread until brown, turn, add the rest of the olive oil, and brown Do not let the bread dry out. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: baguette, garlic cloves, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut baguette in diagonal slats. Step 2: Mix the garlic into the oil in a bowl. Step 3: Pour and spread a little of the mixture into each slat and over top of bread. Step 4: Wrap in aluminum foil and bake in oven 400 degrees for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, water, unbleached all-purpose flour, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Biga: mix the yeast and water together, and then slowly start adding the flour, mixing well. Step 2: Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for up to 6 hours, or refrigerate overnight Bread: place the water in a large bowl, sprinkle the yeast over top and mix well. Step 3: Let sit 10 minutes until bubbly. Step 4: Add the biga, flour, and salt and stir with a wooden spoon until everything is mixed The dough will be fairly wet and sticky at this point. Step 5: Cover and let stand in a warm spot for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours until doubled in volume Punch down the dough, folding it over on itself two or three times, cover and let rise once more until doubled, about 1 hour To bake the following day, refrigerate the dough at this time and leave it overnight. Step 6: Turn out your dough onto a floured baking sheet, and without overworking it too much, shape into one large or two smaller round or oval shaped loaves, using as much extra flour as needed to keep it from sticking.

Dish Name: Basic Italian Bread By Emeril Lagasse
Ingredient Names: water, cake yeast, bread flour, dark brown sugar, olive oil, salt, egg white, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Place the water and yeast in the bowl of an electric mixer and allow the yeast to bloom for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Using a dough hook attachment, add the flour and sugar to the water and mix on low speed until a dough starts to form. Step 3: Drizzle the oil and salt into the dough and beat on medium speed for 8 to 10 minutes, or until a smooth, firm, elastic dough is formed. Step 4: Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl and spray the dough with a thin coating of cooking spray. Step 5: Wrap the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside to proof in a warm, draft-free place for 11 / 2 hours or until doubled in size. Step 6: Remove the plastic wrap, punch down and flatten the rounded dough with the heel of your hand. Step 7: Roll the dough up tightly, sealing the seam well after each roll The dough should be elongated and oval-shaped, with tapered and rounded ends. Step 8: Preheat the oven lined with a pizza stone to 425 degrees f Alternately, an inverted baking sheet may be used in place of a pizza stone.

Ingredient Names: dried yeast, water, sugar, flour, salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the yeast into a small bowl and sprinkle with the sugar. Step 2: Add 125 ml of lukewarm water, then stir to dissolve the yeast and sugar. Step 3: Cover with a clean tea towel and prove in a warm spot for 30 minutes Sift the flour into a large bowl. Step 4: Make a hollow in the centre and pour the yeast mixture, salt, olive oil and 5-7 tbsp of water into it. Step 5: Knead everything into a smooth silky dough, shape into a ball. Step 6: Dust the ball with a little flour, cover and set for an hour or until the dough doubles in volume.

Ingredient Names: french bread, fresh basil leaves, unsalted butter, olive oil, romano cheese, garlic cloves, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Step 3: Place bread cut sides up on baking sheet Process basil in food processor or blender until finely chopped. Step 4: Add butter, oil, cheese, and garlic Process until smooth. Step 5: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Spread basil butter evenly over each bread half. Step 7: Bake until golden, 10-12 minutes. Step 8: Cut bread into 4-inch lengths and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, instant yeast, warm water, eggs, vegetable oil, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour and salt in a large mixing bowl with a wooden spoon In another large bowl, empty the yeast package, then slowly add the warm water, mixing with a fork to fully dissolve the yeast. Step 2: When the yeast mixture forms some bubbles, add the mixture to the flour / salt, then add the three eggs. Step 3: Mix the batter, then set the bowl on top of your refrigerator, cover with damp dish towel. Step 4: After 20 minutes, check the dough for rising, mix again and let rise for another 20 minutes. Step 5: In a saucepan, heat the oil to medium heat. Step 6: Add the dough by the spoonful experiment with the first batch to make sure the oil is not too hot. Step 7: Remove when golden brown and place on paper bags to absorb the oil. Step 8: Place warm zeppoles in a paper bag with powdered sugar and shake You want them well covered with the powdered sugar.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, warm water, water, unbleached flour
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle yeast onto the 1 / 4 cup warm water and let stand approximately 10 minutes until creamy. Step 2: Add rest of water, stir. Step 3: Add flour, one cup at a time and stir. Step 4: Mix with wooden spoon for approximately 4 minutes Oil a bowl three times as large as the mixture's volume and scrape dough into that bowl. Step 5: Cover with plastic wrap and let rise 8-24 hours in a cool room or until triple in volume The longer it sits, the more character it develops If you let it go too long, it will take on sour overtones similar to sourdough starter as a result of the acidic by-products of yeast metabolism If the room is cool enough--60-65 deg.

Ingredient Names: plums, milk, oil, vanilla, eggs, flour, sugar, baking powder, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f, grease muffin pan. Step 2: Wash and dry the plums. Step 3: Cut them in half and remove the pits. Step 4: Mix the flour, oil, sugar and baking powder. Step 5: Add milk, eggs and vanilla, mix well. Step 6: Add 2 tbsp of batter to each muffin cup. Step 7: Place plum half in the center of each muffin. Step 8: Divide remaining batter evenly among muffins to cover the fruit. Step 9: Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in muffin comes out clean.

Dish Name: Bobby Flay's Chicago Deep Dish Pizza Dough Throwdown Recipe
Ingredient Names: dry yeast, warm water, vegetable oil, olive oil, yellow cornmeal, all-purpose flour, kosher salt, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve the yeast and water in the bowl of a mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Step 2: Add the oils and mix for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the cornmeal, 3 cups of the flour and salt and. Step 4: Beat for 5 minutes Switch to the dough hook and mix in the remaining 2 1 / 2 cups of flour and knead, using the dough hook for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the butter and knead until incorporated The dough is a very moist dough so do not add more flour unless absolutely needed. Step 6: Place the dough in a large bowl lightly oiled with vegetable oil, cover with plastic wrap or clean kitchen towels and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 45 minutes Punch down the dough and allow to double in size again. Step 7: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.

Dish Name: Bread Machine Focaccia With Sun-Dried Tomato
Ingredient Names: water, bread flour, powdered milk, white sugar, salt, margarine, active dry yeast, sun-dried tomato, olive oil, parmesan cheese, rosemary, garlic salt, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place water, flour, powdered milk, sugar, salt, butter or margarine, tomatoes, and yeast into bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer. Step 2: Set to Dough cycle, and start the machine. Step 3: Dough will be 1/2 pound. Step 4: When the bread machine has finished the Dough cycle, take the dough out. Step 5: Knead for 1 minute by hand. Step 6: Place in an oiled bowl, and turn a few times to coat the surface of the dough. Step 7: Cover with a damp cloth, and let rise for 15 minutes in a warm place. Step 8: Dust a 10 x 15 inch baking tray with cornmeal. Step 9: Roll out dough to fit the pan. Step 10: Make indentations in the dough with your finger tips. Step 11: Brush top surface with oil, and cover with a damp cloth. Step 12: Allow to rise for 30 minutes. Step 13: Sprinkle with parmesan, rosemary, garlic salt, and mozzarella. Step 14: Bake at 400 degree F for 15 minutes, or until nicely browned. Step 15: Cool slightly, and cut into squares for serving.

Ingredient Names: yeast, white bread flour, salt, black pepper, dried rosemary, olive oil, water, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, oil-cured black olive, cream cheese, oil, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients in the machine in the order according to the manufacturer's instructions and program for "manual" or "dough", and press "start" Add just enough extra water, if necessary, to make a soft, slightly tacky dough At the end of the final knead, remove the dough from the machine to a lightly floured work space. Step 2: Knead the dough several times, adding just enough flour to keep it from sticking to the surface. Step 3: Cover it with a clean cloth while you prepare the filling To finish the focaccia Spray a 9- or 10-inch springform pan with nonstick vegetable spray or coat it lightly with vegetable oil. Step 4: Cut the dough in half and stretch or roll one half in a circle large enough to fit the 9- or 10-inch bottom of the springform pan, and place it in the bottom of the prepared pan. Step 5: Sprinkle the tomatoes, the olives, and pinches of the cream cheese over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border of dough around the circumference Moisten the outer edge of the dough with water.

Ingredient Names: warm water, olive oil, flour, salt, oregano, powdered milk, yeast, dry parmesan cheese, garlic powder, garlic salt, onion powder
Instructions: Step 1: Add the dough ingredients to the bread machine in the order given, and set to first rise. Step 2: When this has finished, roll the dough out into a rectangle which is 1 / 2-3 / 4 inch thick With a pizza cutter, cut the dough into 1x4 inch strips. Step 3: Place on greased cookie sheets and allow the bread sticks to rise until doubled. Step 4: Meanwhile, stir the topping seasonings together with the parmesan cheese. Step 5: Brush the breadsticks heavily with olive oil. Step 6: Sprinkle with the topping I use an empty spice bottle to shake it on evenly. Step 7: Bake the bread sticks at 350f for 12 to 15 minutes until golden. Step 8: Serve warm with dipping sauce - pizza hut style posted on this site.

Dish Name: Brie bruschetta with tomato, herbs & Serrano ham
Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, cream, fresh chives, white bloomer-style bread, tomatoes, leftover brie, serrano ham, arugula leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a saucepan and gently cook the chopped shallots for 2 mins until soft but not coloured. Pour in the cream, bring it to a simmer, then reduce by about half. The cream will look like a thick sauce at this point. Stir in the chives. Step 2: Heat grill to high. Brush the remaining olive oil over the bread and grill on both sides until toasted. Top each slice with some tomato, then cheese, then Serrano ham, and finally spread over about 1 tbsp of the thickened cream to cover the ham. Place back under the hot grill until the cream starts to colour and glaze and the cheese has begun to melt. Serve with rocket leaves scattered over the top.

Ingredient Names: water, unsweetened applesauce, salt, all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, bread machine yeast, olive oil flavored cooking spray, broccoli, red potatoes, lemon juice, garlic, dried basil, dried oregano, kosher salt, low-fat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Load ingredients for pizza dough into abm per your manufacturer's instructions. Step 2: Set on dough cycle. Step 3: Remove when dough has completed second kneading While dough is being processed, make calzone filling: place peeled and diced potatoes in saucepan with desired amount of kosher salt and steam just until tender As soon as potatoes are tender, drain thoroughly and return to saucepan to "dry out" for a couple of minutes. Step 4: Then, while still hot, add lemon juice, basil, oregano, and garlic While potatoes are steaming, place broccoli pieces in a wide saucepan. Step 5: Sprinkle with kosher salt to taste Use a measuring cup to drizzle hot water over top of broccoli, just enough to cover the bottom of the pan, cover tightly.

Ingredient Names: white bread mix, olive oil, butternut squash, red onions, rosemary, sugar, balsamic vinegar, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Make the bread dough according to pack instructions, knead for a few mins, then, using a little flour to stop it sticking, roll out into 2 large rounds and lift onto baking sheets. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, then fry the squash with the onion and chopped rosemary for 5 mins until beginning to soften and brown. Splash in about 200ml water, then cook over a fierce heat for 10 mins, stirring until the squash is tender and almost all the liquid has gone. Heat oven to 220C/ fan 200C/gas 7. Step 3: Stir the sugar, vinegar and some seasoning into the squash mix, then spread it all over the pizza dough. Top with a few small rosemary sprigs, crumble over the feta, then drizzle with a little more oil, if you like. Bake 1 at a time for 15 mins or until the pizzas are golden and crisp. Serve with a salad.

Ingredient Names: strong white bread flour, yeast, olive oil, semolina, chorizo, garlic, kale cavolo nero, balls mozzarella, walnut-size lump parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Put the flour, yeast, 1 tbsp oil, 300ml lukewarm water and a big pinch of salt in a bowl and mix to a soft, wettish dough. Knead in a mixer or by hand, lifting the dough as you work it to keep it light, until the dough is smooth – about 10 mins. Try not to add any more flour; it will get less wet as you work it, but should still be very soft when you finish kneading. Put in a bowl, cover and leave to rise for 2 hrs. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put a pizza stone or heavy baking sheet in the oven. Cut any central tough veins out of the greens, then finely shred the leaves. Step 3: Divide the dough into 2 pieces. Roll one piece out into the largest rectangle that you can, then layer half the chorizo onto one half of it leaving a border around the edge. Sizzle the garlic in a little oil in a pan, then add the greens and toss. Tip half onto the chorizo, then add half the mozzarella and grate over lots of Parmesan. Fold the dough over, fold in and pinch the sides together, and slide onto a baking sheet dusted with semolina. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling, then bake for 15-20 mins or until puffed up and browned.

Ingredient Names: passata, middle eastern flatbreads, spinach, garlic, balls mozzarella patted dry, eggs, nutmeg, fresh basil, shaved parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to as high as it will go. Spread 1-2 tbsp of passata over each flatbread. Squeeze as much water as you can from the spinach (this will prevent your pizzas from being soggy), then scatter on top, leaving a gap in the centre. Divide the garlic and mozzarella between the pizzas, seasoning generously as you go. Step 2: You will probably only be able to bake 2 pizzas at a time.
