So put 2 on a baking tray, carefully crack an egg into the middle of each, and season with nutmeg and some of the basil. Bake for 7 mins until the cheese has melted and the egg is cooked to your liking. Step 3: Repeat with the remaining pizzas and ingredients. Serve, garnished with a little more basil and some Parmesan. Cut into slices and share between everyone.

Ingredient Names: sharp cheddar cheese, butter, scallions, garlic cloves, kosher salt, black pepper, bread
Instructions: Step 1: Place an oven rack in the center of the oven. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Step 3: In a food processor, combine the cheese and butter Process until the mixture is smooth. Step 4: Add the scallions and pulse until combined. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Step 6: Spread the cheese mixture on the cut sides of the bread. Step 7: Place on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden. Step 8: Remove from oven and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, baking powder, butter, eggs, milk, olive oil, green peppers, streaky bacon, green onions, tomato ketchup mixed tomato puree, cherry tomatoes, mature cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Mix the flour, salt and baking powder in a bowl, then rub in the butter until it disappears. Mix the eggs and milk together, then stir into the dry ingredients to make a soft dough. Shape into a round on a lightly floured surface, lift onto a non-stick baking tray, then press out to a circle about 24cm across to make the pizza base. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan, then stir-fry the pepper and bacon until the pepper is soft. Take off the heat, then stir in the spring onion. Step 3: Spread the ketchup over the pizza base, then evenly tip over the pepper and bacon mixture. Scatter over the tomatoes, followed by the cheese. Bake for 15 mins until golden. Serve with a salad or coleslaw.

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, bread flour, bread machine yeast, salt, italian spices, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Add the water, oil, bread flour, salt, yeast and italian seasonings into the bread machine in the order specified by your manufacturer. Step 2: Set and run it on the dough cycle Very, very finely mince the garlic You may add some olive oil to the garlic to make it more spreadable after it is minced. Step 3: Divide the dough into two equal sized balls and place each one on a well oiled baking tray Stretch them out into a rectangle shape. Step 4: Spread half the garlic, parmesan, and mozzarella cheese on each dough rectangle. Step 5: Roll the dough up and tuck the ends under to make sure the ends are sealed Gently shape into a loaf shape Loosely cover and let rise until nearly doubled in size, 20 - 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, all-purpose flour, parmesan cheese, egg yolk, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 In large bowl or food processor, cut butter into the flour until the mix resembles coarse meal. Step 2: Add cheese& egg yolk, mix well. Step 3: Add just enough water to form a dough that will hold together in a cohesive ball. Step 4: Divide dough into 2 equal portions for rolling On floured surface, roll each into a rectangle about 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 5: Cut out individual crackers about 2 inches across with cookie cutter or sharp knife. Step 6: Place them on ungreased baking sheet, & prick each 2 or 3 times with a fork. Step 7: Bake 10 minutes, & turn the crackers over. Step 8: Bake another 5-10 minutes, or until medium brown.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, pizza base mix, tomato-based pasta sauce, cheddar for grating, ball mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: Ask your helper to turn the oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Cut the courgette into chunks then thin slices using a rotary grater or small knife. Step 2: Tip the pizza base mix into a bowl and add the amount of water it says on the packet. Mix with a spoon. Step 3: Tip the dough onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Step 4: Roll the dough out to make 1 big pizza. Stretch it as you roll to help make it bigger. Lift the dough onto a baking sheet and spread it out flat. Step 5: Spoon the pasta sauce into the middle and spread it around. Arrange the courgettes on top. Step 6: Grate some cheddar and sprinkle on top. Pull the mozzarella into pieces and dot over the top. Ask your grown-up helper to put the pizza in the oven for 25 mins.

Ingredient Names: bread mix, olive oil, parmesan, dolcelatte cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Make up a bread mix following packet instructions, stirring in olive oil and parmesan. Step 2: Roughly roll out the dough on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Press all your fingers randomly into the dough, push dolcelatte into the holes, then drizzle over a little extra olive oil. Bake for 25 mins until golden and cooked through. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions, balsamic vinegar, ready made pizza base, goat's cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and add the oil. Cook the onions with the lid on for 10 mins, stirring every now and again, until soft and caramelised. Stir in the balsamic vinegar. Season well. Step 2: Put the pizza base on a baking sheet. Spoon the caramelised onions over the base and top with slices of goat’s cheese. Bake in the oven for 5-8 mins, until the goat’s cheese has melted and the base is crisp.

Ingredient Names: white bread, olive oil, cherry tomatoes, ball mozzarella, pancetta, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Empty the pizza dough into a bowl. Shred or chop the basil and stir half of it into the mixture along with 200ml warm water. Knead vigorously for 5 mins, then roll out into a 30cm round shape. Step 2: Transfer to a floured baking sheet, rub the surface with olive oil and leave for 15 mins until risen. Push the cherry tomatoes, cut-side up, into the dough so the pizza is studded with them. Step 3: Dry the mozzarella very thoroughly with kitchen paper, then cut into cubes. Scatter over the pizza along with the pancetta or bacon, then bake for 20 mins until risen, bubbling and golden. Tear over the remaining basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, salt, sugar, all-purpose flour, active dry yeast, garlic powder, butter, whipping cream, parmesan cheese, garlic cloves, oregano, thyme, basil, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingrediants for the dough into the bread maker, starting with liquids. Step 2: Set on the dough setting, and let it go. Step 3: Once it's finished turn out onto lightly greased pizza pan. Step 4: Melt the butter for the sauce in a small saucepan on low heat. Step 5: Once melted add in the garlic and simmer until brown. Step 6: Add in cream, stir with a whisk until butter and cream no longer separate. Step 7: Stir in the cheese and spices until all cheese is melted Continue to cook on low heat for about 10-15 minutes. Step 8: Spread desired amount of sauce on the dough. Step 9: Sprinkle the cheese on top of the sauce, then add the diced chicken on top of that.

Ingredient Names: pizza base mix, tomato pizza sauce, cooking chorizo, capers, cherry tomatoes, arugula, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make up the pizza base following pack instructions and put on a baking sheet. Spread over the tomato pizza sauce. Leave to rise in a warm place for 5 mins. Step 2: Heat oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 9. Put the chorizo in a cold frying pan over a low heat, then gradually increase it – the chorizo should give off enough oil so that you don’t need to add any more. Cook for 2-3 mins until it releases its oil and starts to crisp. Step 3: Scatter the chorizo, capers and tomatoes over the pizza base. Cook for 12-15 mins or until the base is crisp, scatter with the rocket,.

Ingredient Names: fast rising yeast, warm water, flour, milk, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Sponge: in a mixer bowl, add the yeast to the water, allow to stand for 3-4 minutes, stirring gently Sift the flour and add to the yeast. Step 2: Combine ingredients well, cover and let stand at room temperature for 12 hours Dough: add the yeast to the milk, stir and let it stand 3-4 minutes to be sure the yeast is working. Step 3: Add the yeast mixture, water and oil to the sponge and mix with a dough hook. Step 4: Add 2 cups of flour and the salt and knead for 2 minutes at low speed. Step 5: Add the remaining flour slowly and knead for 3 more minutes, adding more water, until the dough begins to pull from the sides of the bowl The dough should be quite soft and wet - a lot like a thick mud - this is why it cannot be kneaded by hand. Step 6: Add the last of the flour slowly. Step 7: Add a little more water, if necessary.

Ingredient Names: unbleached all-purpose flour, salt, active dry yeast, warm water, olive oil, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: You will need a baking stone or 2 jelly roll pans that fit side by side in the oven, plus a cookie sheet with no sides or a piece of stiff cardboard to slide the loaves into the oven In the bowl of an electric mixer, stir together the flour and salt In another bowl, whisk the yeast into the water. Step 2: Then stir the yeast mixture into the flour Fit the mixer with the paddle attachment and mix the dough for 1 minute on lowest speed Stop the mixer and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Step 3: Beat the dough again on medium speed, until smooth and elastic, about 2 to 3 minutes Oil a 3-quart bowl and scrape the dough into it. Step 4: Turn the dough over so that the top is also oiled. Step 5: Press plastic wrap against the surface of the dough and let the dough rise at room temperature until it is doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.

Dish Name: Ciabatta With Hints Of Rosemary Bread Machine
Ingredient Names: water, bread flour, fast-rising active dry yeast, buttermilk, olive oil, fresh rosemary, salt, sugar, yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Biga: Place the biga ingredients in machine according to your manufactures directions My machine calls for wet first then top with dry. Step 2: Set machine for dough cycle, press start and let kneed for 5 minutes Shut machine off and let rise over night at least 12 hours Dough: Place the wet ingredients over the biga then top with flour and rosemary. Step 3: Place salt, sugar and yeast in separate corners. Step 4: Set machine to basic dough setting press start. Step 5: When finished remove dough to two bowls covered with an oiled plastic wrap.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, leaves from rosemary, peppadew peppers from, black olives, ciabatta, gruy res
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6 and heat the oil in a large, lidded frying pan. Add the onions, garlic and rosemary with a splash of water, cover, then cook for about 10 mins until soft. Remove the lid, turn up the heat, then cook for a few more mins. Step 2: Stir in the peppers, olives and some seasoning. Place the ciabatta halves, facing upwards, on a baking tray. Divide the mixture over the bread, spreading a little to cover. Sprinkle over the cheese, then bake for 10 mins or until the cheese is bubbling. These are delicious with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: garlic sauce, garlic powder, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees Open box of breadsticks. Step 2: Discard garlic sauce Lightly grease a cookie sheet Unroll breadsticks across pre-made perforation so that you have 2 even sets of 5 breadsticks. Step 3: Place both sets of breadsticks flat on cookie sheet and bake for 6-8 minutes, or until the top turns a light golden brown. Step 4: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Step 5: Add the garlic powder and stir until dissolved You might want a little more or a little less garlic, depending on your tastes. Step 6: Remove breadsticks from oven.

Ingredient Names: baby zucchini, olive oil, butter, onions, garlic, zucchini, orzo, glass white wine if you have it, quarter vegetable stock, parmesan, white bread whizzed to crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 9. Toss the baby courgettes with half the oil in a roasting tin and roast for 10 mins, until the courgettes are starting to colour. Step 2: Reduce oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat the remaining oil and butter in your largest frying pan and soften the onions and garlic gently. Add the grated courgettes, and turn up the heat. Cook until softened. Stir in the orzo and wine, if using, for a minute, then turn off the heat and stir in the stock, most of the Parmesan and some seasoning. Step 3: Transfer to a baking dish and arrange the baby courgettes on top. Bake for 15 mins, take out of the oven and scatter with breadcrumbs and the remaining Parmesan and bake for 10 mins more. Eat immediately.

Ingredient Names: italian bread, extra virgin olive oil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Position rack in the upper part of oven and preheat to 450 degrees. Step 2: Using a bread knife, cut bread on the diagnal into slices 1 / 2 inch thick. Step 3: Brush each side lightly with olive oil and place on baking sheet. Step 4: Bake, turning once until lightly golden Watch carefully and do not allow crostini to toast til hard This is no time to watch tv. Step 5: Remove from oven and rub with the garlic clove Crostini can be topped with a lot of things like fresh herbs, anchovy spreads, olives, artichoke, ricotta-- etc--.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, olive oil, fresh parsley, fresh thyme, fresh marjoram, paprika, parmesan cheese, italian bread
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine the garlic and oil, mix well In another bowl, combine parsley, thyme, marjoram and paprika, add parmesan, mix well. Step 3: Cut each loaf crosswise into diagonal slices, without cutting all the way through. Step 4: Brush cut sides of slices with garlic oil. Step 5: Sprinkle herb mixture between slices. Step 6: Wrap each loaf in foil, place on a baking sheet. Step 7: Bake until heated through, about 10 to 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, active dry yeast, unbleached all-purpose flour, active starter, kosher salt, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Biga: mix all the ingredients together in a medium bowl and stir vigorously with a wooden spoon for 2 to 3 minutes, until a smooth, somewhat elastic batter has formed The batter will be very stiff It gets softer and more elastic after it has proofed You may find it easier to mix the sponge using electric mixer, with a paddle or a dough hook, on medium speed for 1 to 2 minutes Scrape the sponge into a 2-quart clear plastic container and cover with plastic wrap At this point you have two options: if you plan to make your dough later that same day, let the sponge rest at room temperature until it has risen to the point where it just begins to collapse This may take from 6 to 8 hours, depending on the temperature of the sponge, the temperature of the room, and the strength of the yeast The sponge will triple in volume and small dents and folds will begin to appear in the top as it reaches its peak and then begins to deflate The sponge is now in perfect condition to be used in a dough It's best if you have already weighed or measured out all of your other recipe ingredients before the sponge reaches this point so you can use it before it collapses too much.

Ingredient Names: french bread, butter, garlic clove, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400. Step 2: Slice the bread almost all the way through in 1" - 1-1 / 2" slices. Step 3: Place bread in a jelly roll pan on a large enough sheet of aluminum foil that you can fold the sides up to contain the wine / butter mixture. Step 4: Place a sliver of garlic between each slice. Step 5: Melt butter in glass cup measure in microwave. Step 6: Stir in an equal amount of red wine to the cup. Step 7: Drizzle the wine / butter mixture between each slice and pour remainder over the top If you double the recipe, you'll want to mix it again mid-pour as the wine & butter tend to separate. Step 8: Bake at 400 for about 20 minutes Bread is done with the top and especially the bottom of the bread is crusty.

Ingredient Names: yeast, sugar, warm water, unbleached flour, olive oil, salt, parmesan cheese, dried rosemary, cornmeal, kosher salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In medium size bowl, dissolve the yeast and sugar in 3 / 4 c warm water. Step 2: Set aside for 15 minutes untl very foamy. Step 3: Stir 1 cup flour into the yeast. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap and let this sponge proof in a warm place until tripled in volume and very bubbly, about 2 hours. Step 5: Put sponge in bowl of kitchenaid mixer, add remaining 1 / 2 c warm water, 2 tbl Olive oil, 1 / 2 teaspoons regular salt, parmesan cheese and rosemary. Step 6: Add remaining flour. Step 7: Mix on speed 2 of mixer for 7 minutes Oil a large bowl. Step 8: Place the dough in the bowl, covered loosely with oiled plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 1 / 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, red onions, garlic, olive oil, spinach, salt, pepper, ricotta cheese, pizza cheese, fresh flat-leaf parsley, red pepper flakes, roma tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425°F. Step 2: Lightly coat a 12-inch heavy oven-proof pan or cast-iron skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Step 3: Unroll 1 package of pizza dough and shape into a circle. Step 4: Press dough into prepared skillet; shape onto bottom and halfway up sides. Step 5: Bake 5 minutes, remove from oven. Step 6: In a large skillet sautee onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons of oil about 5 minutes, or until tender. Step 7: Add spinach, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Step 8: Cook and stir until spinach is heated through. Step 9: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 10: In a small bowl combine ricotta cheese, 1/4 cup of pizza cheese, parsley, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and the red pepper flakes. Step 11: Spread the spinach mixture evenly over the bottom of partially baked crust. Step 12: Spread the ricotta mixture over the spinach layer. Step 13: Top with the sliced tomatoes and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Step 14: Sprinkle with 3/4 cup of the pizza cheese. Step 15: Unroll remaining pizza dough and form into a 12 to 13 inch circle. Step 16: Place dough on top of layers. Step 17: Brush with remaining olive oil. Step 18: Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until top is golden. Step 19: Top with remaining pizza cheese. Step 20: Bake 2 to 3 minutes, until cheese is melted. Step 21: Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

Dish Name: Diabetic Italian Parmesan Cheese Bread For Bread Machine
Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, parmesan cheese, water, salt, italian seasoning, ground rosemary, green onion, black olives, parsley flakes, garlic powder, yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients in order suggested by bread machine manufacturer. Step 2: Add 3 cups flour, spices, olives, & onion, and then add the last cup of flour before making the hole for the yeast. Step 3: Bake on basic, medium crust, 2# loaf Baking time is machine time.

Ingredient Names: warm water, white sugar, active dry yeast, milk, butter, eggs, salt, all-purpose flour, egg, water, candy sprinkles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yeast, water, and 1 teaspoon of the sugar in a small bowl and let sit for 10 minutes In another bowl, mix milk, salt, butter, 2 eggs, and remaining 1 / 2 cup of sugar. Step 2: Add about half of the flour and beat until very smooth, then pour in the yeast mixture. Step 3: Add the remaining flour, making a stiff dough - can add additional flour if necessary. Step 4: Place dough on a floured board and knead until smooth and elastic. Step 5: Put dough into greased bowl, cover bowl and let the dough rise until doubled in size Punch the dough down, place on a floured board and divide it into 6 equal pieces. Step 6: Roll each piece with your hands to form a 1-inch thick rope and then shape rope into a "u" shape. Step 7: Put a whole, raw egg into the inside of the "u", twisting the rope to form a fishtail at the bottom. Step 8: Brush each "baby" with the beaten egg, shake on some of the colored sprinkles and place on a greased cookie sheet.

Ingredient Names: unsifted flour, water, sugar, fleischmann's margarine, fleischmann's active dry yeast, eggs, milk, colored sprinkles
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl throughly mix 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and undissolved fleischmann's active dry yeast. Step 2: Combine milk, water and fleischmann's margarine in a saucepan. Step 3: Heat over low heat until liquids are very warm Margarine does not need to melt Gradually add liquids to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Step 4: Add 3 eggs and 3 / 4 cup flour. Step 5: Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally. Step 6: Stir in enough additional flour to make a soft dough. Step 7: Turn out onto lightly floured board. Step 8: Knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Easter Bread In The Bread Machine
Ingredient Names: milk, warm water, fresh lemon juice, lemon, fresh orange juice, orange, vanilla extract, eggs, egg yolk, butter, granulated sugar, salt, active dry yeast, flour, anise seed
Instructions: Step 1: Mix according to your manufactures instructions Adding the anise seeds after first kneading and signal. Step 2: Add flour if needed or drop of milk if needed upon mixture, to form a nice soft ball of dough. Step 3: Place on sweet bread setting dark crust.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, yeast, salt, olive oil, warm water, baking powder, parmesan cheese, rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the ingredients, beat for 5 minutes at medium speed, let rest at room temp, covered, for 1 hour Scoup the sticky dough into a lightly greased 9x13 pan. Step 2: Cover the pan, let the dough rise for 1 hour until it looks bubbly. Step 3: Bake the focaccia in an oven preheated to 400f for 25 minutes, or until its golden brown. Step 4: Sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan cheese and / or fresh rosemary about 5 minutes before the end of the baking time. Step 5: Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack.

Ingredient Names: dry active yeast, water, all-purpose flour, kosher salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dough: dissolve the yeast in the warm water and set aside. Step 2: Put the flour and salt in a food processor fitted with the steel blade Process briefly to mix With the machine running, add the water-yeast mixture in a steady stream. Step 3: Turn the processor off and add the oil Pulse a few times to mix in the oil. Step 4: Divide the dough: scrape the soft dough out of the processor and onto a lightly floured surface With lightly floured hands, quickly knead the dough into a mass, incorporating any bits of flour or dough from the processor bowl that werent mixed in. Step 5: Cut the dough into four equal pieces with a knife or a dough scraper. Step 6: Roll each piece into a tight, smooth ball, kneading to push the air out.

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, salt, parmesan cheese, oregano, bread flour, nonfat dry milk powder, yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in order in your bread machine using the regular bread cycle. Step 2: If you want pizza dough, use the"dough" setting and roll out flat on a floured surface. Step 3: Preheat your oven to 400. Step 4: Spray your cooking pan with Pam. Step 5: You can also sprinkle a little cornmeal on the pan if you wish. Step 6: Lay dough out on your pan and cover with cling film OR apply a little extra olive oil over the surface of the dough. Step 7: Let rise for 1/2 hour. Step 8: Bake for 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Remove from oven, apply toppings and continue baking until toppings are done. Step 10: If you wish to make a freeform loaf: Preheat oven to 350°F. Step 11: Form loaf on a prepared baking sheet, cover with cling and let rise until doubled. Step 12: Bake until golden brown and sounds hollow when thumped (about 30 minutes). Step 13: Remove to a cooling rack and lightly coat with butter while still hot for a tender crust.

Ingredient Names: butter, shallots, full-fat creme fraiche, parmesan, fresh figs, ball buffalo mozzarella, arugula, prosciutto, extra-virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, strong white bread flour, fast-action yeast, salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dough, mix the flour, yeast and salt in a bowl. Measure 250ml hand-warm water into a jug, add the oil, then tip into the flour mixture. Mix together with a wooden spoon, followed by your hands, to make a wet dough – add a splash more warm water if needed. Cover with oiled cling film and leave somewhere warm-ish to rise for 1 hr or until doubled in size. Heat the butter, then soften the shallots and set aside. Step 2: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Tip the dough onto a floured surface, knead briefly to smooth, then divide into 6-8 balls. Roll out each to a thin circle, then arrange on flour-dusted baking sheets. Mix the crème fraîche, Parmesan and shallots with a little salt and lots of black pepper. Spread over the dough and bake for 10-15 mins until crisp at the edges and slightly puffed up. Step 3: Toss the figs and mozzarella with the rocket. Sprinkle over the pizzettas with the prosciutto. Mix the oil and vinegar, drizzle over the pizzettas and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, spinach, toppings choice anchovies, eggs, fresh basil leaves, arugula, lemons, strong white flour, fast-action yeast, coarse
Instructions: Step 1: To make the base, tip the flour into the bowl of a table-top mixer (or food processor with a dough attachment). Add 1 tsp salt to one side of the bowl and the yeast to the other. Add 275ml lukewarm water and mix on slow until a sticky dough forms. Turn up the mixer for 5-6 mins until an indent pushed into the dough pops out quickly. Put the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, then cover and leave in a warm place to prove until doubled in size. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and sizzle the garlic for a few secs, then tip in the tomatoes, season and simmer for 5 mins until the sauce has thickened. Step 3: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Knead the dough for a few mins, then halve and roll each half as thinly as possible. Lay each base on a baking sheet dusted with the semolina. Divide the tomato sauce between the pizzas, spreading almost to the edge. Dot over the spinach, add your toppings and drizzle with a little oil. Cook for 5 mins, then crack an egg onto each pizza. Swap the baking sheets, then cook for 10 mins more or until bases are cooked through. Drizzle the basil and rocket with a drop of oil and the lemon juice. Scatter over the pizza before eating.

Ingredient Names: gluten-free flour, salt, olive oil, fast-action yeast, rosemary, ground black pepper, water, tomato bruschetta topping, mozzarella, avocados, arugula, cherry tomato, parma ham, ham, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Put the flour, salt, olive oil, yeast, rosemary and pepper into a food processor. Pulse until well mixed. With the motor running, add enough water to bring the flour to a soft, but not sticky dough. Tip onto a work surface and knead until it comes together. Step 2: Halve the dough. If you only have one shelf in your oven and are cooking in batches, wrap one half in cling film. Roll out each half directly onto lightly oiled baking sheets into very thin 25cm/10in rounds. Do not form a rim at the edge. Spread the tomato topping over each piece of dough, almost to the edge. Leave to stand for 15 mins. Bake in the hot oven for 12-15 mins or until the dough is crisp. Step 3: Lift each round onto a plate and serve warm. Pass the toppings around and let each diner assemble their own pizza.

Ingredient Names: yellow peppers, zucchini, red onions, flour, olive oil, tomato pasta sauce, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Place the pepper, courgette and red onion on a large non-stick baking tray and drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil. Season well and toss to combine. Roast in the oven for 20 mins until soft and beginning to brown. Set aside. Step 2: Heat the grill to medium. Season the flour well and, in a large bowl, mix with the remaining oil and 4-5 tbsp water to form a soft dough. Knead briefly, then roll out on a floured surface to a rough 20cm circle. Transfer the dough to a large ovenproof, non-stick frying pan and fry over a medium heat for 5 mins, until the underside begins to brown. Turn over and cook for a further 5 mins. Spread the tomato sauce over the base, scatter with the roasted veg, then sprinkle with cheddar. Grill the pizza for 3-4 mins until cheese has melted. Serve immediately, sliced into wedges, with a large green salad.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, water, sugar, bread flour, envelope savory herb garlic soup mix, parmesan cheese, virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, sprinkle the yeast over the water and stir in the sugar. Step 2: Let the mixture stand until it bubbles, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Place the flour, soup mix, and cheese in a large mixing bowl or food processor fitted with a steel blade. Step 4: Add the yeast mixture and oil and stir with a wooden spoon or process until the mixture forms a ball If mixing by hand, turn the dough out onto a floured board and knead it until it is smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Oil the inside of a medium mixing bowl and turn the dough into the bowl, coating it with the oil. Step 6: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the dough rise in a warm, dry spot until it is doubled in bulk, about 60-90 minutes Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Step 7: Coat 2 pizza pans with olive oil. Step 8: Punch the dough down, cut it in half, and form it into two balls. Step 9: Working on a floured counter, flatten each piece of dough with a rolling pin, rolling it out into a 12" circle. Step 10: Place each dough round on a prepared pizza pan Top the dough with your favorite toppings and bake the pizza until the crust is crispy, about 20-25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: strong white flour, fast-action yeast, salt, olive oil, butter, garlic, mozzarella, tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, extra-virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Tip all of the base ingredients into a mixing bowl. Pour over 300ml warm water – not too hot. Stir quite hard with a spoon until the mixture comes together. Step 2: Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead 2-3 times until the mixture forms a ball. Divide dough into 8 equalsize pieces. Take 1 piece, leaving the remainder loosely covered with oiled cling film. Lightly flour the surface again and use a rolling pin to roll out dough into a round about 15cm diameter or as thin as you can. Put pizza on a baking sheet. Step 3: Mix together the butter and crushed garlic, then spread a little over the pizza. Tear the mozzarella into thin strips and scatter over. Repeat for the remaining pieces of dough. You should be able to fit 2 pizzas per baking sheet; depending on how many baking sheets you have, you may have to cook in batches. Step 4: Heat oven to 240C/fan 220C/gas 9. Bake pizzas for 12-15 mins until crisp and cooked through. Meanwhile, mix together the remaining ingredients, then season well. When the pizza comes out of the oven, top with the tomato mixture and serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: tomato pasta sauce, pizza bases, ham, ricotta, pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Place a flat baking sheet in the oven to heat up. Spread 2 tbsp tomato sauce on each pizza base. Carefully slide the bases onto the baking sheet and cook following pack instructions. Step 2: Five mins before the cooking time is up, scatter over the ham, dot the ricotta on top in spoonfuls and continue cooking. Season and drizzle the pesto over each pizza.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, garlic, tomato sauce, garlic salt, italian herb seasoning, sugar, red onions, genoa salami, mozzarella cheese, mixed mushrooms, oregano, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the beef and the garlic and press into a 12-inch pizza pan. Step 2: Mix the tomato sauce through the sugar and spread on top of the beef. Step 3: Layer the onion, salami, mozzarella cheese and mushrooms on the pizza in the order listed. Step 4: Sprinkle with oregano and parmesan. Step 5: Bake at 400ï¿½ about 15 minutes or until the beef is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: bread dough, cornmeal, pizza sauce, bulk italian sausage, mozzarella cheese, oregano, green pepper ring
Instructions: Step 1: On a lightly floured surface, roll and stretch dough into a 9 inch circle. Step 2: Cover with plastic wrap; let rest for 10 minutes. Step 3: Roll and stretch the dough into a 12 in circle. Step 4: Sprinkle corn meal into a greased 9 inch springform pan. Step 5: Place dough in pan and press 1 inch up the sides of pan. Step 6: Spread pizza sauce over crust. Step 7: Top with sausage, 1 cup cheese, oregano and green pepper. Step 8: Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 9: Bake at 425 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Step 10: Remove to a wire rack; let stand for 5 minutes before removing sides of pan.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, olive oil, oregano, flatbread, chili tomato pasta sauce, salami, emmental
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7 and place a griddle pan over a high heat. Toss the courgette slices in a bowl with the olive oil, oregano and seasoning. Lay the courgette slices on the griddle and cook for a few mins each side until just tender. Step 2: Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and spread with the pasta sauce. Arrange the courgette slices on top, before scattering over salami and cheese. Step 3: Place in the oven and bake for 8 mins until cheese has melted and the bread’s edges are crisp.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, italian ground sausage, panko breadcrumbs, red onions, garlic, italian seasoning, sea salt, fresh black pepper, provolone cheese, hamburger buns, roma tomato, pepperoncini peppers, fresh basil, virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, hot Italian ground sausage, panko, onions, garlic, Italian seasoning, sea salt and freshly ground black pepper; mix well. Divide meat into 4 equal portions and form patties. Place them in a plate, cover with plastic wrap and chill for 2 hours. Step 2: Later on, take meat out and let it rest on the counter while making the slaw. In a small bowl, combine tomato, pepperoncini, basil, oil, vinegar, sea salt and freshly ground black pepper; stir well and set aside. Step 3: Fire up the BBQ and place patties when the grill reaches high temperature. Close the lid and cook about 5 to 6 minutes per side, flipping once. About 2 to 3 minutes before cooking is done, place hamburger buns on the top grill as well as a couple slices of cheese per patty. Step 4: Just before serving, scoop a good amount of tomato slaw on top of the meat. Makes 4 burgers.

Ingredient Names: water, oil, salt, sugar, tomato paste, bread flour, powdered milk, fresh basil, active dry yeast, stuffed green olives
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients into breadmachine pan in order recommended by manufacturer. Step 2: Choose basic cycle, and press start. Step 3: Add olives at the add-in beep, or 5 minutes before the end of the final knead.

Dish Name: Italian Peasant Bread for Bread Machine
Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, flour, salt, sugar, rosemary, yeast, additional rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Place ingredients, according to manufacturer's directions into your bread machine. Step 2: (some call for all liquids, or all dry ingredients first, so know your machine). Step 3: Set machine to "dough cycle" and wait. (This takes most machines about an hour and a half for a full cycle). Step 4: Remove from machine when cycle is complete and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Step 5: Shape dough by hand, into a rectangular mound, spreading kind of thin, maybe an inch or two of thickness. Step 6: Cover and let rise in a warm place for about an hour or until doubled in size. (This is a good time to go ahead and turn the oven on to preheat and help warm the kitchen). Step 7: Brush with a little olive oil, sprinkle with rosemary and salt if desired. (This is the way its done at Macaroni Grill). Step 8: Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until crust is golden and crispy. Bread is meant to be a flatter shape and not a high rising bread. Step 9: Have everyone tear their pieces of bread with their hands,and serve with olive oil flavored with fresh ground pepper.

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, garlic, oregano leaves, fresh basil leaves, romaine lettuce, tomatoes, red onions, olives, fat-free italian salad dressing, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425* Roll out dough into desired shape. Step 2: Press garlic over dough and spread. Step 3: Sprinkle with oregano and basil. Step 4: Place on bottom rack of oven for 12-14 minutes or until golden brown. Step 5: While crust is cooking, place lettuce, onion, tomato,olives, and dressing into a large bowl and toss to coat. Step 6: When you remove the crust from the oven, immediately sprinkle with mozzarella and 1/2 of the parmasean cheeses. Step 7: While still warm top with salad mixture. Step 8: Use remaining cheese to top salad. Step 9: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: bloomer, olive oil, sundried tomato paste, provolone cheese, ham, selection pizza toppings, ball mozzarella, crisps, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Split the loaf through the middle, leaving it attached at one side, and open it up like a book. Scrape away some of the soft bread inside (use to make breadcrumbs), then drizzle generously with olive oil. Spread the tomato paste over both sides, then start layering up your fillings on top. Start with the provolone and ham, then add any of your favourite pizza toppings, if you like, finishing with the mozzarella. Scatter with oregano, season with salt and pepper, then carefully close the sandwich and squash it down with your hands to flatten. Wrap tightly in foil. Can be made up to a day ahead and chilled. Step 2: To serve, heat oven to 180C/160C fan/ gas 4. Place the foil-wrapped sandwich onto the oven shelf and bake for 30 mins from room temperature or 35 mins from the fridge. Lift onto a board, unwrap, then slice into roughly 6 sandwiches. Serve with bowls of crisps, gherkins and pickled onions and let everyone help themselves.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated pizza dough, genoa salami, pepperoni, provolone cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Lightly grease a large baking sheet. Step 3: Roll pizza crust dough into an approximately 10x14 inch rectangle on the baking sheet. Step 4: Layer with Genoa salami, pepperoni and provolone cheese. Step 5: Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese to within 1/2 inch from edges of the dough. Step 6: Roll jelly roll style. Step 7: Seal the edge with a fork. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Step 9: Slice into 1 inch pieces to serve.

Ingredient Names: keto cauliflower crust for pizza crust, no-sugar-added tomato sauce, low-moisture full fat mozzarella cheese, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, fresh basil leaves, oregano, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F. Step 2: On one baked cauliflower crust evenly spread the tomato sauce. Top the sauce with the shredded mozzarella, fresh mozzarella, pepperoni, oregano and red chili flakes. Bake in the oven 6-8 minutes or until the cheese is melted and just beginning to brown. Cut and serve immediately. Step 3: Nutrition Info Per Serving, calories: 203. Step 4: Total Fat: 14 grams. Step 5: Saturated Fat: 5 grams. Step 6: Total Carbohydrate: 10 grams, sugars: 4 grams. Step 7: Protein: 12 grams. Step 8: Sodium: 1,740 milligrams. Step 9: Cholesterol: 113 milligrams, fiber: 4 gram. Step 10: Net Carbs: 6 grams.

Ingredient Names: keto cauliflower crust for pizza crust, cherry tomatoes, fresh carrot, yellow bell peppers, red onions, extra-virgin olive oil, kosher salt, no-sugar-added tomato sauce, low-moisture full fat mozzarella cheese, oregano, red pepper flakes, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F. Step 2: Place the tomatoes, sliced carrot, bell pepper and red onion on a sheet tray in four separate rows. Drizzle the oil over the vegetables and season with salt. Roast the vegetables in the oven for 10-15 minutes, or until softened and just beginning to brown. Set aside to cool. Step 3: Spread the tomato sauce over the cauliflower pizza crust and top with the shredded mozzarella. Evenly spread the onions over the pizza followed by the carrot, peppers, and then tomatoes. Season with dried oregano and crushed red pepper and put the pizza back in the oven and bake 6-8 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Step 4: Remove from oven and garnish with parsley. Cut and serve immediately. Step 5: Nutrition Info Per Serving, calories: 302. Step 6: Total Fat: 23 grams. Step 7: Saturated Fat: 7 grams. Step 8: Total Carbohydrate: 13 grams, sugars: 5 grams. Step 9: Protein: 15 grams. Step 10: Sodium: 3,328 milligrams. Step 11: Cholesterol: 119 milligrams, fiber: 4 gram. Step 12: Net Carbs: 9 grams.

Ingredient Names: mozzarella cheese, cream cheese, almond flour, eggs, italian seasoning, mayonnaise, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Add the mozzarella and cream cheese to a microwave safe bowl and microwave for 1 minute. Stir to combine and return to microwave until cheese has melted, about 30 more seconds. Step 3: Stir in the almond flour, egg, salt, and Italian seasoning to combine. Step 4: Place the dough on a large sheet of parchment paper. Top with a second sheet of parchment. Step 5: Roll the dough out into a 12 inch diameter circle. Step 6: Remove the top piece of parchment and transfer the bottom sheet with the dough on it to a pizza pan. Step 7: Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown. Step 8: Remove from the oven and spread with the mayonnaise. Sprinkle on the lettuce, tomatoes, bacon.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, eggs, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, fresh chives, italian seasoning, wet garlic, mozzarella cheese, pizza sauce, pizza toppings
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Step 2: Beat together cream cheese and eggs until smooth. Step 3: Add cream, parmesan, chives, Italian seasoning and garlic. Step 4: Spray 9X13 pan with cooking spray or oil. Step 5: Place 2 cups mozzarella cheese in bottom of pan. Step 6: Pour egg mixture over cheese. Step 7: Bake for 30 minutes. Step 8: Remove from oven and spread sauce over baked mixture. Step 9: Add toppings of choice. Step 10: Cover with remaining mozzerella cheese. Step 11: Bake until bubbly and brown. Step 12: Let stand for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: live mussels, tomatoes, olive oil, red wine, garlic, salt, pepper, linguine, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: If using live mussels, dump into colander and rinse well. Step 2: Any mussel that does not close (at least a little) when sprayed with water is no good and should be discarded. Step 3: Remove any"beards" remaining. Step 4: Put mussels into a heavy skillet and add tomatoes, oil, wine, garlic, and seasoning. Step 5: Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Mussels are done when the shells open up (discard any that remain shut). Step 7: If using frozen mussels, cook until completely heated through. Step 8: Serve over linguine with crusty bread to sop up the juice. Step 9: Accompany with remaining wine and a salad.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, pizza sauce, mozzarella cheese, red bell peppers, yellow bell peppers, green bell peppers, red onions, zucchini, mushrooms, pepperoni
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Working with one at a time, unroll pizza dough onto a cutting board with the longest side parallel to the edge of the counter. Cut in half vertically, then use a sharp knife to cut out the numbers 2 and 0. Transfer numbers to a prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough, cut out the numbers 1 and 9 and transfer to second baking sheet. Step 2: Bake for 6 minutes, remove from oven and top each number with pizza sauce, spreading to cover dough to the edges. Top sauce with shredded mozzarella, diced red, yellow and green peppers, onions, zucchini, mushrooms and pepperoni. Step 3: Bake for 8-10 minutes longer until crust is golden and toppings are cooked. Serve on a large platter or cutting board with the numbers 2019 next to each other.

Ingredient Names: new potatoes, olive oil, rosemary, pizza bases, port-salut
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Heat a pan of water, tip in the potato slices and simmer for 5 mins until just cooked through. Drain really well. Tip into a bowl with the olive oil and rosemary. Mix together well so that the potatoes are completely coated in the oil. Step 2: Place the pizza bases on a baking sheet. Scatter the cheese over the pizza base, then arrange the potato mixture on top. Season with salt and pepper, then bake for 20 mins, until the pizza base is golden and the potatoes are starting to brown.

Ingredient Names: flour, olive oil, onions, garlic, cherry tomatoes, passata, fresh basil leaves, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan, then add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 mins. Tip in tomatoes and passata, and simmer for 5-10 mins or until the tomatoes are soft. Remove from the heat, stir in the basil, season, then allow to cool. Step 2: Put the flour into a bowl. Make a well in the centre, add the olive oil then add 6-7 tbsp warm water or enough to make a soft dough. Tip the dough onto a lightly floured surface and roll out to fit a 22cm frying pan or make 2 small ones. Heat a glug of olive oil in the frying pan, then press the dough into the pan and cook over a medium heat for 8-10 mins or until the base is golden. Step 3: Heat grill to hot. Spread the pizza base with the tomato sauce, scatter on the cheese and grill until it has melted and the base is golden at the edges. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, tomato paste, vegetable oil, oregano, fennel seeds, mild paprika, fresh basil, garlic powder, salt, sugar, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F. Step 2: Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil and coat lightly with oil. Step 3: Grind fennel seed, oregano and basil into a powder using a spice mill or mortar and pestle. Step 4: Wash, peel and slice potatoes into thin french fry shapes. Step 5: Combine ground spices, tomato paste, garlic powder, salt, sugar and oil in a small bowl until smooth. Step 6: Place potatoes and seasoning paste in a large ziplock or plastic bag. Step 7: Using your hands, move the potatoes around in the bag until they are evenly coated with the seasoning paste. Step 8: Place potatoes in a single layer on the baking sheet. Step 9: Bake for 25 minutes at 400°F. Step 10: Using a spatula, turn potatoes over and sprinkle with parmesan cheese (if using). Step 11: Bake for 10-20 minutes more or until fries become golden and start to crisp (time may vary with size of fries). Step 12: Serve with marinara sauce or ketchup, if desired.

Ingredient Names: sultana, glace pineapple, mixed peel, rum, compressed yeast, sugar, water, eggs, egg yolks, flour, salt, fresh lemon rind, butter, oil, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the sultanas, finely chopped glace pineapple, chopped mixed peel, and rum. Step 2: Allow to stand for about 1 / 2 an hour. Step 3: Combine the yeast, sugar and lukewarm water in a small bowl, and mix well. Step 4: Allow to stand in a warm place for about 5 minutes or until frothy. Step 5: Beat the eggs, and extra yolks lightly. Step 6: Add the extra sugar, and beat until combined Sift the flour and salt into a large bowl. Step 7: Add the grated lemon rind, butter and oil. Step 8: Stir in the egg mixture and lukewarm milk. Step 9: Then add the yeast mixture and the undrained fruit mixture.

Ingredient Names: crusty french bread, virgin olive oil, garlic, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400°. Step 2: Brush one side of each slice of bread with the olive oil; toast in the oven until lightly golden, about 5 minutes; remove from oven and rub the cut side of garlic on the oiled sides of slices; sprinkle with cheese. Step 3: Return to oven; bake until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: bread crusts, olive oil, parmesan cheese, thyme, salt, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180C/350F. Step 2: Place bread crusts in bowl. Drizzle over olive oil, tossing the bread crusts as you go (with your other hand) so as to distribute the olive oil as evenly as possible. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and use hands to toss through the bread crusts. Step 4: Spread out over 2 baking trays. Do a taste test to make sure it is seasoned to your liking - adjust if required. Step 5: Bake for 5 to 8 minutes until golden brown and crunchy (check the ones in the middle of the tray). The tray on the top shelf will be ready first. The bottom tray will take a couple of minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: recipe pizza dough, mozzarella cheese, pineapple, walnuts, fresh basil, deli ham, feta cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Use a well-seasoned heavy cast iron skillet, at least 12" in diameter. Step 2: Preheat oven to 450 F (very HOT). Step 3: Toss grated mozzarella cheese with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Step 4: Drizzle 2 tablespoons olive oil into skillet. Step 5: Press dough into pan. Step 6: Spread mozzarella over crust then follow in this order with: pineapple, ham, basil, walnuts, feta. Step 7: Drizzle remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil on top. Step 8: Put into very hot preheated oven - bake for about 20 minutes. Step 9: Use a spatula to lift edge of crust to check that it is golden and crisp. Step 10: Remove when done to your liking, transfer to platter, slice and serve.

Ingredient Names: pitta breads, tomato puree, mixed herb, tomatoes, salami, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill. Step 2: Spread each pitta bread with 1 tbsp tomato purée, sprinkle over the mixed herbs, then lay on the tomato slices. Step 3: Divide the salami between the pittas, sprinkle over the cheese and grill until the cheese is golden and bubbling.

Ingredient Names: yeast, sugar, italian flour, olive oil, balls mozzarella, fresh basil, onions, garlic, italian tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the yeast and sugar with 250ml warm water and leave to sit for 10 mins. Place half the flour in a table-top mixer with a dough hook, pour in the yeast mixture and beat at medium speed for 10 mins (or mix in a bowl, then knead with oiled hands in the bowl for 5-10 mins). Step 2: Leave somewhere warm for 10 more mins, then add the remaining flour and oil. Beat or knead to a dough for a further 5 mins. Put in a well-oiled bowl, cover with a cloth and place somewhere warm to double in size – about 1½ hrs. Step 3: For the sauce, heat the oil in a pan over a moderate heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 mins, stirring constantly. Add the garlic, 1 tsp sea salt and 1 tsp ground black pepper and cook for 2 mins more. Add the tomatoes and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for a good 20 mins, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Once your dough has doubled in size, slap it down on a lightly floured surface and knead for 4 mins until soft but not too elastic. Divide into 6 pieces, roll into balls and leave to rest for 10 mins. Heat oven to the highest temperature possible (270C fan in the Good Food test kitchen) and place a flat baking sheet in the oven. Step 5: With a well-floured rolling pin, roll out each ball of dough as thinly as possible. Remove the baking sheet from the oven, oil or dust with flour, then carefully transfer the dough base onto it. Spread over some of the tomato sauce (I like to apply it in the quantity that you would spread Marmite on toast, or the base will be soft and fall to bits), then the cheese and any toppings you desire. Step 6: Cook for between 5-10 mins depending on your oven temp, until the base is crisp and the cheese melted. Scatter with basil.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, pizza sauce, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, italian seasoning, pepperoni, fresh basil, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Unroll pizza dough onto work surface with the long side parallel to the edge of the counter. Cut into 12 equal strips, about 1 ½-2 inches wide. Spread pizza sauce over dough, then sprinkle over parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese and Italian seasoning. Step 2: Working with one strip at a time, place 7-8 slices pepperoni down each strip of dough, overlapping slightly. The top of the pepperoni should stick out over the top of the dough. Roll the dough into a cylinder to look like a rose bud and transfer to a 12-well muffin tin with the pepperoni edge up. Step 3: Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and and crisp. To serve, place a skewer in the bottom of each pizza rose and tie together.

Dish Name: Pizza Dough for Thin Crust Pizza
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, active dry yeast, salt, water, olive oil, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Mix a little sugar into the warm water. Step 2: Sprinkle yeast on top. Step 3: Wait for 10 minutes or until it gets all foamy. Step 4: Pour into a large bowl. Step 5: Add flour, salt, olive oil, combine. Step 6: Knead for 6-8 minutes until you have a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic (add a bit more flour if you need to). Step 7: Cover and let rest for 20-30 minutes. Step 8: Lightly grease two 12-inch pizza pans. Step 9: Sprinkle with a little bit of cornmeal. Step 10: Divide dough in half. Step 11: Place each half on a pizza pan and pat it with your fingers until it stretches over the whole pan. Step 12: Try to make it thicker around the edge. Step 13: If desired, pre-bake at 425 F for 10 minutes (I don't always do this). Step 14: Then spread with pizza sauce and use the toppings of your choice. Step 15: Bake at 425 F for 10-20 minutes longer or until bubbly and hot. Step 16: Makes 2 12-inch pizzas. Step 17: If you don't want to use all the dough, you can freeze it. Step 18: Take a portion of dough, form into a ball, rub olive oil over it and place it in a freezer bag (the oil makes it easier to take out of the bag). Step 19: When you want to make a pizza, take dough out of freezer and allow to thaw before using.

Ingredient Names: strong bread flour, instant yeast, salt, olive oil, passata, fresh basil, garlic, ball mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Make the base: Put the flour into a large bowl, then stir in the yeast and salt. Make a well, pour in 200ml warm water and the olive oil and bring together with a wooden spoon until you have a soft, fairly wet dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 mins until smooth. Cover with a tea towel and set aside. You can leave the dough to rise if you like, but it’s not essential for a thin crust. Step 2: Make the sauce: Mix the passata, basil and crushed garlic together, then season to taste. Leave to stand at room temperature while you get on with shaping the base. Step 3: Roll out the dough: if you’ve let the dough rise, give it a quick knead, then split into two balls. On a floured surface, roll out the dough into large rounds, about 25cm across, using a rolling pin. The dough needs to be very thin as it will rise in the oven. Lift the rounds onto two floured baking sheets. Step 4: Top and bake: heat the oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 8. Put another baking sheet or an upturned baking tray in the oven on the top shelf. Smooth sauce over bases with the back of a spoon. Scatter with cheese and tomatoes, drizzle with olive oil and season. Put one pizza, still on its baking sheet, on top of the preheated sheet or tray. Bake for 8-10 mins until crisp. Serve with a little more olive oil, and basil leaves if using. Repeat step for remaining pizza.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, yeast, oil, water, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, pour in the hot water, add yeast, oil, salt and flour. Step 2: Mix well and if needed you can add up to 2 more cups of flour. Step 3: Knead and divide dough into 40 pieces. Step 4: Roll each piece into a 8- 10 inch rope and shape into pretzel. Step 5: Place onto greased large cookie sheets, let rise. Step 6: Just before baking spread about 1+ tsps spaghetti sauce and about 1 T mozzarella cheese on each one. Step 7: Bake at 400 degF for 10- 15 minutes. Step 8: Remove from baking sheets and cool on racks.

Ingredient Names: eggs, oregano, olive oil, tomato passata sauce, black olives, vegetarian cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Beat the eggs with the oregano and some salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large ovenproof frying pan, then tip in the eggs. Cook over a low-ish heat for 4 mins, stirring occasionally until the eggs are practically set. Step 2: Place under the grill until set and puffed up. Spread the sauce over, scatter with cheese and olives, then grill again until cheese is melted. Cut into wedges and serve with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: crusty bread rolls, tomato puree, ham, tomatoes, balls mozzarella, oregano, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Cut the tops off the rolls and scoop out the insides. Spread the rolls with tomato purée, then fill with ham, tomatoes and finally the mozzarella. Scatter with dried oregano and top each with an olive, if you like. Step 2: Place the rolls on a baking tray and bake for 15 mins until the rolls are crusty brown and the cheese is bubbling. Leave to rest for a min, then serve hot with a side salad.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, soda farls split, garlic, spinach cubes, red peppers, ball mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a frying pan on medium; add the butter and a little of the oil. Once it stops sizzling, add the soda farl slices and cook for 1 min on each side until lightly golden – you’ll have to do this in batches. Set aside. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 secs, then add the spinach and cook for 1-2 mins until hot, stirring often. Season to taste. Step 3: Heat the grill to medium. Spoon the spinach mixture onto each toasted farl, then pile the peppers and mozzarella on top. Season and lightly drizzle with olive oil. Pop under the grill and cook for 1-2 mins, until the cheese is bubbling. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: scallions, olive oil, mushrooms, garlic, pizza dough, prosciutto, bottled artichoke hearts oil, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: In a frying pan, heat 2 tbsp of the oil. Step 3: Saute the scallions, mushrooms and garlic over moderate heat until all the juices have evaporated. Step 4: Salt and pepper lightly, let cool. Step 5: Brush the pizza dough with 1 tbsp oil. Step 6: Arrange the prosciutto, mushrooms and artichokes on top. Step 7: Sprinkle the Parmesan over, then drizzle the remaining oil over and season again lightly with salt and pepper. Step 8: Bake for 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Serve immediately!

Ingredient Names: batch white bread dough, olive oil, red onions, rosemary, sea salt flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Make the basic dough, adding 2 tbsp olive oil and only a pinch of salt. While the dough is rising, cook onions in 1 tbsp olive oil for 5 mins until soft, then set aside. Step 2: When the dough has risen, knock it back and stretch it to fit an oiled Swiss roll tin about 25 x 35cm. Leave the dough to prove for about 20 mins. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Spread the onions over the dough and scatter with the rosemary. Press your fingers into the dough to make dimples, drizzle the remaining oil over and scatter over the salt, then bake for 30 mins until golden. Leave to cool, then serve cut or torn into squares.

Ingredient Names: onions, yellow peppers, olive oil, tomatoes, mixed grain, flour, cherry tomatoes, ricotta, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 6. Soften the onion and peppers in the oil in a large pan for a few mins. Pour in the tomatoes, season, then simmer for 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, make up the bread mix according to pack instructions, then bring the dough together and knead a couple of times. Flour a large baking sheet and roll out the dough into a rectangle roughly 25 x 35cm. Bake for 5 mins on a shelf at the top of the oven until firm. Step 3: Remove from the oven, spread with the sauce, add the cherry tomatoes, then dollop over spoonfuls of the ricotta. Bake for 10 mins more until the base is golden and crisp. Scatter with basil and serve straight away with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: portabella mushrooms, virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, sea salt, ground black pepper, pesto sauce, wheat bread, mozzarella cheese, tomatoes, margarine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350*. Step 2: Rub mushrooms with olive oil and vinegar. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Place mushrooms flesh side down on a baking tray and roast for 10-12 minutes, or until soft. Step 5: Thinly slice mushrooms once cooled. Step 6: Do not turn off oven. Step 7: Spread pesto on all 8 pieces of bread. Step 8: Divide mozzarella on 4 pieces of bread. Step 9: Put tomato slices on top of cheese. Step 10: Place portobello slices on top of tomato and put remaining 4 slices of bread on top to complete sandwiches. Step 11: Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat, melt margarine. Step 12: Add sandwiches, two at a time, and cook until browned on one side (place a heavy object on each sandwich to help it brown evenly). Step 13: Turn over and brown the other side. Step 14: Each side should take 2-3 minutes to brown. Step 15: Place sandwiches on a baking sheet and finish cooking in the oven for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: strong flour, salt, easy blend yeast, water, olive oil, red peppers, leeks, tomato passata, light mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, peas, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 220C/Gas 7/fan oven 200C. Tip the flour, salt and yeast into a bowl and mix well. Add the warm water and mix to a soft dough. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 2-3 minutes, then roll out to a 30cm/12in round. Brush a large baking sheet with a thin slick of oil, then add the pizza base. Cover with a clean tea towel. Step 2: Cut the peppers into rings and slice the leek. Toss the leek and red peppers in the oil, salt and pepper. Spread over a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes. Step 3: Spread the pizza base with the passata. Scatter over the leek and red pepper. Thinly slice the mozzarella and arrange over the vegetables. Scatter over the whole cherry tomatoes and peas and sprinkle with the parmesan. 4 Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the crust is crisp and lightly browned. To serve, cut into four wedges.

Ingredient Names: baby plum tomatoes, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, thyme, bread, ball mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Lay tomatoes, cut side up, in a roasting tray and drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, the balsamic vinegar and thyme. Season and cook for 30 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, toast bread until golden. Divide between 2 plates and top with the tomatoes. Scatter on mozzarella, basil leaves and rocket. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.

Ingredient Names: water, milk, olive oil, sugar, salt, rosemary, parmesan cheese, bread flour, yeast, sun-dried tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients except tomatoes to bread machine in the order listed, making a little indention in the flour for the yeast. Step 2: Turn on machine (use white bread setting). Step 3: If tomatoes are packed in oil, first blot them dry with a paper towel. Step 4: Cut or snip tomatoes into small pieces-- but do not add them until after the first knead. Step 5: If your machine has a fruit& nuts setting, add them when that beeper goes off.

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, bread flour, granulated sugar, salt, active dry yeast, cornmeal, egg whites
Instructions: Step 1: Add flour, oil, salt, sugar, yeast and water to your bread machine according to its instructions. Step 2: Set on dough setting. Step 3: Always follow your machines instructions, when mixing open it and keep check on the dough. Dough should be in a nice round soft sticky to the touch ball. If it is not add more water, or add flour which ever is needed. Step 4: Remove when signal beeps and cycle is done. Step 5: Preheat oven to 375Ã‚°F. Step 6: Sprinkle cornflour or cornmeal onto a baking sheet. Step 7: Punch dough down and form into a long or oval loaf. Step 8: Cover and let rise for 25 more minutes. Step 9: It should be doubled again by this time. Step 10: Uncover and slash the top with a sharp knife or razor. Step 11: Brush all over with the beaten egg white. Step 12: Bake 25 minutes to 35 minutes, until hollow sounding when tapped on bottom, cool.

Ingredient Names: bread mix, flour, pizza tomato sauce, salami, pickled cherry peppers, red onions, chili flakes, mozzarella, oregano leaves picked
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Mix the bread dough following pack instructions, keeping it light and sticky. Knead it for a few mins, then place in a covered, oiled bowl for 30 mins to rise at room temperature. Step 2: Take the dough out and squash to knock out the air. Roll out on a floured surface to fit the largest baking tray you have. Sprinkle flour or semolina over the tray, then place the dough on top. Spread the tomato sauce over the dough, then scatter with the salami, pickled cherry peppers, onion, chilli flakes, mozzarella and oregano. Bake for 12-15 mins or until the dough turns crusty and golden.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions, garlic, passata, sugar, pizza base, sausage, cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Heat the olive oil, then fry the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 mins. Season the passata with a pinch of sugar, salt and pepper. Step 2: Put the pizza base onto a baking sheet and spread over the passata, leaving a border around the edge. Top with the onions, sausages and, finally, the cheese. Cook in the oven for 10 mins until crisp. Scatter with basil, if using.

Ingredient Names: mild italian sausage, onions, green bell peppers, red bell peppers, virgin olive oil, salt, fresh black pepper, oregano, white wine, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, provolone cheese, hoagie rolls, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Poach raw sausages in 1/2 cup water in a covered skillet, simmering until almost done. Step 2: This takes about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Sautè onions and peppers with olive oil, salt, pepper and oregano 4 minutes on medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the wine, cover and cook 4 minutes more. Step 5: Uncover and cook until moisture is absorbed. Step 6: On either a grill or in a skillet with a little extra-virgin olive oil, cook the poached sausages over medium-high heat 7 to 10 minutes, turning often to ensure even browning. Step 7: In a large baking dish or pan, place the opened rolls. Step 8: Fill the rolls with 1 sausage in each roll and evenly distribute the onions and peppers. Step 9: Mix the 3 shredded cheeses and evenly sprinkle that on top. Step 10: Place in oven, uncovered, on 400°F or until the cheese is melted. Step 11: Remove from oven, top with some Marinara sauce, close the sandwiches and serve. Step 12: NOTE: See my recipe for Marinara Sauce #84217.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, water, milk, olive oil, salt, sugar, flour, bulk italian sausage, spinach, low-fat small-curd cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, parsley, pepper, cornmeal, mushrooms, onions, additional olive oil, garlic salt, pizza sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, dissolve yeast in water& milk. Step 2: Add oil, salt, sugar and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth. Step 3: Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Step 4: Turn onto a floured surface& knead until smooth& elastic- approx, 6-8 minutes. Step 5: Place in greased bowl, turning once to grease the top. Step 6: Cover& let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Step 7: Meanwhile, in a skillet, cook sausage until no longer pink; drain. Step 8: Add spinach, cheeses, parsley& pepper; mix well. Step 9: (mushrooms, onions, etc. can be added at this point) Punch down dough; divide into six pieces. Step 10: On floured surface, roll each piece into 8" circle. Step 11: Top each w/ 2/3 c, filling. Step 12: Fold dough over filling; pinch to seal. Step 13: Place on greased baking sheets that have been sprinkled with cornmeal. Step 14: Brush tops lightly with oil; sprinkle with garlic salt. Step 15: Bake at 400 for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Step 16: Serve with pizza sauce.

Ingredient Names: fast-action yeast, sugar, water, strong white bread flour, salt, olive oil, pork sausages preferably fennel-flavoured, tomato sauce, ricotta, provolone cheese, fresh breadcrumb
Instructions: Step 1: First, make the dough. Mix the yeast and sugar with the warm water. Place the flour and salt in a mixer with a dough hook, or in a bowl, make a well in the middle and pour in the liquid and oil. Mix by hand for 10 mins or 5 mins in the mixer, until dough is silky. Tip into a well-oiled bowl, cover with a cloth and place somewhere warm for about 40 mins or until doubled in size. Step 2: Tip the dough onto a work surface and knead for 2 mins, knocking out any air pockets. The dough should be soft but not too elastic. Step 3: Dust a 25 x 16cm baking tray with a little flour and place the dough in the centre. Using the palms of your hands and tips of your fingers, push the dough to the edges of the tray. Leave it for 30 mins to rise. While the dough is rising, fry the sausage in a dry pan until crumbly. Step 4: Heat oven to 230C/210C fan/gas 8. Spread the tomato sauce over the base, followed by the sausage, ricotta, provolone and dried breadcrumbs. Finally, drizzle with olive oil. Put in the oven for 5 mins, then turn down the heat and cook at 200C/180C fan/gas 6 for 20-25 mins, until golden brown. Leave to cool slightly, then cut into 6 chunks and serve.

Ingredient Names: strong white bread flour, yeast, olive oil, semolina
Instructions: Step 1: Put the flour, yeast and 1 tsp salt into a large bowl. Stir in 500ml of slightly warm water and the oil. You should end up with a wettish dough that is rough and lumpy. Scrape down the sides of the bowl, cover with a tea towel and if your kitchen is cool keep it out, but if it’s warm put it in the bottom of the fridge. Leave dough to rise for at least 6 hrs or until doubled in size. Step 2: When ready to cook, bring the dough to room temperature. Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Dust 2-4 baking sheets with semolina. Dust the work surface with flour, then divide the dough into 2 or 4 pieces. Knead each piece on the floured surface, incorporating enough flour to stop the dough being sticky. Step 3: Roll each piece into a pizza shape and lift onto baking sheets. Leave to rise for 10 mins while you sort toppings. Top the bases with your chosen ingredients, drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and bake following the timings for each topping (18 mins for a large pizza or 12 mins for an individual) or until the crust is crisp and the topping is bubbling.

Ingredient Names: sugar, salt, fast rising yeast, unbleached flour, water, olive oil, butter, garlic powder, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor or mixer, combine the sugar, 3/4 tsp. Step 2: Salt, yeast and 2 c, flour. Step 3: Mix well 5-10 seconds. Step 4: While processing, gradually add warm water and oil in a steady stream. Step 5: Mix for 1 minute or until smooth and elastic. Step 6: Check dough; add 1 to 2 Tbsp. Step 7: Of water or flour if needed. Step 8: Turn onto a floured surface. Step 9: Roll into a 15" x 12" rectangle. Step 10: Cut into 12 strips. Step 11: Fold each strip in half lengthwise; twist each strip several times. Step 12: Pinch ends to seal. Step 13: Place 2" apart on a greased baking sheet. Step 14: In a bowl, combine butter, garlic powder and remaining salt. Step 15: Brush some over dough. Step 16: Sprinkle with Italian seasoning or Parmesan Cheese if desired. Step 17: Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 25 minutes. Step 18: Bake at 425 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until golden brown. Step 19: Brush with remaining butter mixture.

Ingredient Names: strong white strong wholewheat flour, water, tomato juice, cherry tomatoes, zucchini using peeler, mozzarella, capers brine, green olives, garlic, olive oil, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flours and yeast with a pinch of salt in a food processor fitted with a dough blade. Pour in the water and mix to a soft dough, then work for 1 min. Remove the dough and roll out on a lightly floured surface to a round about 30cm across. Lift onto an oiled baking sheet. Step 2: Spread the canned tomatoes over the dough to within 2cm of the edges. Arrange the cherry tomatoes and courgettes over the top, then scatter with the mozzarella. Mix the capers, olives and garlic, then scatter over the top. Drizzle evenly with the oil. Leave to rise for 20 mins. Heat oven to 240C/ fan 220C/gas 9 or the highest setting. Step 3: Bake the pizza for 10-12 mins until crisp and golden around the edges. Scatter with the parsley to serve.

Ingredient Names: italian bread, garlic, olive oil, onions, tomatoes, oregano, ground pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Toast bread. Step 2: Rub one side of hot toast with cut side of garlic. Step 3: Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat; add onion and cook, stirring until tender. Step 4: Add tomato, oregano and pepper, stir. Step 5: Spoon tomato mixture over garlic side of hot toast and serve immediately. Step 6: Alternatively, sprinkle with Parmesan and broil for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: from ciabatta bread mix, olive oil, fresh basil leaf, avocados, lemon juice, ball reduced-fat mozzarella, mixed tomato kitchen paper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to its highest setting, about 240C/fan 220C/gas 9. Tip the bread mix into a large bowl, pour over 125ml lukewarm water and 1 tbsp olive oil, then mix well to a sticky dough. Knead for a few mins, using some of the extra dry mix to stop it sticking. Place in an oiled bowl, cover with a tea towel and leave in a warm place for 15 mins. Step 2: While the dough is rising, put the remaining oil in a small blender with most of the basil, then whizz until the leaves are finely chopped. Toss the avocado in the lemon juice, then tear the mozzarella into rough pieces. 3 Using a little more of the dry bread mix to help you, roll and stretch the dough out to a rough 25 x 30cm rectangle on a large baking sheet. Brush over the basil oil, scatter with the mozzarella and tomato slices, then bake for 10-12 mins until the base is crisp and the cheese melted. To serve, scatter with the avocado slices and remaining basil leaves, then season with freshly ground.

Ingredient Names: italian bread, water, eggs, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, ground turkey, salt, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Leave bread out all day so it is dry. Step 2: Put in bowl and pour water over it. Step 3: Let water soak in. Step 4: Squeeze out excess water and discard. Step 5: Break up bread with fingers. Step 6: Add eggs, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, meat, salt, and oregano. Step 7: Mix it together with your hands, taste for salt. Step 8: Roll into small 2" balls and put on cookie sheet (spray with non-stick spray first) and bake in 350 degree oven for 20-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: strong white flour, coarse semolina, salt, pkt fast-action yeast, olive oil, tepid water, plum tomato, plump garlic, tomato puree, balls buffalo mozzarella, two handfuls basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix flour, semolina, salt and yeast. Make a dip in the middle, pour in oil, water, then stir and squeeze everything together (hands are easiest for this). The dough should feel very sticky (pic 1). When it is well mixed, cover and leave for 15 mins. Step 2: Tip the dough on to a lightly oiled work surface and rub your hands and the inside of the bowl with oil. Knead the dough about 12 times only, giving it a quarter turn each time you knead. Tuck the ends under so it is the shape of a ball and lay it in the bowl, seam side down. Cover and leave for 10 mins. Repeat the kneading and leaving for 10 mins again, then knead and leave for 15 mins, oiling the surface and your hands each time. Step 3: In between kneadings make the sauce for the topping. Drain the tomatoes and tip them into a bowl. Snip them into small pieces with scissors (pic 2). Stir in garlic, tomato purée, and seasoning. Set aside. Brush a baking sheet with oil and sprinkle with a little semolina. Heat oven to 240C/fan 220C/gas 9. Step 4: When the dough is ready, cut in half and put one half onto a lightly fl oured surface. Knead 4-5 times to squash out any air bubbles, then roll it out. At the point where it just keeps springing back, brush off the flour from the work surface and rub on a little oil. This makes it easier to roll. Continue to roll out until you have a 28cm circle, pulling it into shape as well. Lift it onto the baking sheet (it’s easier if you drape it over a rolling pin). Step 5: Drain the mozzarella, then pat dry with kitchen paper. Brush the dough with olive oil, then spread half the sauce over, almost up to the edge. Scatter over half the basil, then tear up one mozzarella ball and scatter over the basil (pic 3). Grate over pepper and drizzle with a little oil. Bake for 12-15 mins, until the topping is bubbling and the dough is going brown. Repeat with the remaining dough and toppings. To serve, scatter with parmesan shavings, rocket leaves and drizzle with oil.

Ingredient Names: water, active dry yeast, brown sugar, milk, butter, olive oil, salt, cornmeal, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Directions for electric mixer: Add water, brown sugar and yeast to a bowl and stir. Step 2: Let sit 5 minutes until creamy. Step 3: Add milk, butter, oil, salt and corn meal to yeast mixture and mix for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add 2 1/2 cups of flour and mix with paddle for 5 minutes on speed 2. Step 5: Scrape the sides of the bowl and form dough into a ball. Step 6: Pour remaining flour (1/2 cup) around the outsides. Step 7: Use dough hook and mix for for 5 minutes on speed 2. Step 8: Remove dough from mixer and place in well greased glass bowl. Step 9: Place damp towel on top of bowl and let rise in warm spot for 1 hour or until double in size.

Ingredient Names: cashews, water, nutritional yeast, salt, apple cider vinegar, garlic, tapioca starch, all-purpose flour, yeast, tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, oregano, olive oil, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: For the mozzarella:. Step 2: Soak the cashews in water overnight or place in a pot of boiling water and boil on the stove for 15 minutes to soften. Drain. Step 3: Add the soaked cashews to the jug of a high speed blender along with the rest of the mozzarella ingredients. Blend until completely smooth. Step 4: Pour into a medium pot and place on the stove over a medium-low heat. Cook until thickened, about 5-10 minutes, then pour into a bowl and set aside – this will thicken as it cools. Step 5: For the pizza dough:. Step 6: Mix the water and yeast in a large bowl. Let sit for 10 minutes to activate the yeast then pour in the flour and salt. Stir to get a shaggy dough.
