Pour a bit of oil into the bowl then lift up the dough and turn it over to coat it completely in oil. Cover with a damp towel and leave somewhere warm for 2-3 hours until doubled in volume. Step 7: For the tomato sauce:. Step 8: In a bowl, combine the tomato sauce ingredients. Stir together and set aside. Step 9: To make the pizzas:. Step 10: Split the dough into quarters and roll into balls – set aside for 30 minutes to rest, this will make the dough easier to work with. Step 11: Lightly flour a countertop and place a ball of dough onto it. Dust with more flour. Use your hands to pat the dough down and then roll out into a large circle about 1/4-inch thick. You can use your hands to help gently stretch the dough until it’s thin enough. Transfer the circle of dough to a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes until golden. Repeat with the rest of the dough so all your bases are baked. Step 12: Spread a few tablespoons of tomato sauce onto each pizza base. Top with dollops of the ‘mozzarella’ and drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle on some salt and black pepper then place each pizza back into the oven, one at a time, for 5-10 minutes until the crust is golden and the 'cheese' is starting to brown. Top with fresh basil and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: flour, baking powder, butter, milk, olive oil, semi-dried tomatoes, zucchini, chargrilled artichoke oil, ball vegetarian mozzarella, mature cheddar, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Mix the flour, baking powder and ½ tsp salt in a large bowl, then rub in the butter. Add the milk and bring together to make a soft, slightly sticky dough. Brush a 25cm x 36cm baking tray with a little olive oil and press the dough into it, making sure it goes right to the corners. Step 2: Arrange the tomatoes, courgettes and artichokes over the base. Scatter over the cheeses, drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with the oregano. Season with pepper. Bake for 25 mins until nicely browned. Can be cooled, sliced in the tin and frozen for up to a month. Defrost before wrapping in foil and reheating in a low oven.

Ingredient Names: olive oil for tray, flour, easy-blend yeast, sugar, water, passata, mozzarella half, parmesan, basil half, side salad
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 9. Oil a 20 x 24cm baking tray. Mix the flour, yeast, ¼ tsp salt and the sugar in a bowl, then stir in the water. Bring the mixture together, knead until smooth, then press into the oiled tray. Step 2: Spread passata over the dough, leaving a thin border round the edge. Season the passata, then sprinkle with the chopped basil, the mozzarella and the Parmesan, and bake for 15-20 mins or until cooked through. Scatter with the remaining basil and serve with a side salad.

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, sugar, salt, oregano, fresh basil, garlic powder, all-purpose flour, wheat flour, active dry yeast
Instructions: Step 1: In bread machine pan, place the ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer. Step 2: Select dough setting. Step 3: (Check dough after 5 minutes of mixing; add 1 to 2 Tbsp of water or flour if needed.) When the cycle is complete, turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Step 4: Punch down, cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Step 5: Divide dough in half. Step 6: Pressed each portion into a greased 12 in pizza pan. Step 7: Add sauce, cheese, and favorite toppings. Step 8: Bake at 400 degrees for 18-20 minutes or until crust and cheese are lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: pepperidge farm puff pastry, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese, olives, green peppers, oregano leaves
Instructions: Step 1: THAW pastry sheet at room temperature 30 minutes. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400°F. Step 3: UNFOLD pastry on lightly floured surface. Step 4: Roll into 15" x 10" rectangle. Step 5: Cut in half lengthwise and place on 2 baking sheets. Step 6: Prick thoroughly with fork. Step 7: Sprinkle with garlic, bake 10 minutes. Step 8: TOP with cheese, olives, pepper and oregano. Step 9: Bake 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, garlic cloves, onion, mushrooms, italian seasoning, salt, black pepper, alfredo sauce, broccoli florets, carrot, roasted red peppers, part-skim ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, fresh parsley, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Spray non-stick cooking spray in a large skillet. Step 2: Saute' chicken with garlic, onions, mushrooms, italian seasoning, salt and pepper, cook until done. Step 3: Remove from heat and transfer to a large bowl And one 16 oz jar of alfredo sauce, set aside. Step 4: Mix together steamed broccoli, carrots, and roasted red peppers, set aside. Step 5: In a medium bowl mix ricotta and mozzarella cheese, parsley, and egg set aside. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350f pour 1 / 2 of the remaining jar of alfredo sauce in bottom of a deep 9x13-inch casserole dish, spreading out evenly.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaf, roma tomatoes, garlic clove, salt, olive oil, chicken breast, lemon juice, italian spices, button mushrooms, purple onion, roasted garlic alfredo sauce, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, penne pasta
Instructions: Step 1: 2t lemon juice, 1 t olive oil and italian seasonings together, pour over chicken and place in a plastic bag or a marinator container. Step 2: Let marinate for 30 minutes to a couple hours Start bruscetta mixture too Just mix altogether and cover in the fridge until dinner is ready to serve. Step 3: Heat grill and cook chicken on a medium heat until chicken is completely done Start to cook your pasta on stove according to package directions. Step 4: Meanwhile heat 2 tsp olive oil over med-high heat in a heavy skillet and cook mushrooms and onions until tender. Step 5: Turn off skillet Empty jar of alfredo sauce into skillet and add drained cooked pasta Chicken is done.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, alfredo sauce, milk, eggs, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, flour, paprika, cayenne pepper, margarine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Place margarine in a 9x13-inch pan and then place pan in oven while preheating to melt the margarine. Step 3: Rinse chicken and cut off excess fat. Step 4: Combine alfredo sauce, milk and eggs in one bowl, and bread crumbs, flour, paprika, and cayenne in another. Step 5: Dip chicken breasts in alfredo mixture, then bread crumb mixture Double bread if you would like. Step 6: When you have breaded all of the chicken, place it in the hot pan with the melted butter, coating both sides of the chicken If you don't like wasting the alfredo mixture, you can add it to the pan with the chicken at this point. Step 7: Bake the chicken for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through Save the bread crumb mixture for next time--put it in a freezer bag and tuck it away in your freezer.

Dish Name: Alfredo With Angel Hair Pasta And Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken breast tenders, heavy whipping cream, butter, parmesan cheese, romano cheese, cracked black pepper, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Boil angel hair pasta until al dente and set aside, keeping warm. Step 2: Boil chicken tenders until done and dice after cooled In large saucepan melt 1 1 / 2 sticks butter, reserving other 1 / 2 stick for thickening. Step 3: Add heavy cream and all cheeses to saucepan stirring constanty over medium heat. Step 4: In a microwavable dish, melt remaining butter. Step 5: Add 3-4 tbs Flour being sure to smooth out any lumps. Step 6: Add butter and flour mixture to saucepan and stir until sauce thickens just a bit Salt the sauce to taste. Step 7: Stir diced chicken into sauce and serve over the angel hair pasta.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, fine breadcrumbs, romano cheese, olive oil, italian-style diced tomatoes, garlic cloves, kalamata olives, capers, balsamic vinegar, red pepper flakes, fresh basil leaves, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together breadcrumbs and romano cheese Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 4" or so. Step 2: Using large, deep-sided frying pan, heat olive oil Don't allow to smoke as you'll need it for moisture in the sauce. Step 3: Add thinly sliced garlic and begin to soften and flavor the oil. Step 4: Rinse chicken with tap water, then dredge through breadcrumb / cheese mixture Use fingers to mash mixture onto chicken so that every surface is breaded and all of mixture is used. Step 5: Fry breasts 'til lightly browned and remove to a plate, keep warm. Step 6: Add additional oil as needed- it's good for you!

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, butter, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, garlic powder, italian seasoning, black pepper, chicken meat
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Step 2: Combine the minced garlic with the melted butter in a bowl In another bowl combine bread crumbs, parmesan, parsley, garlic powder, italian seasoning, and pepper. Step 3: Dip chicken pcs into garlic butter, then into crumb mixture to coat. Step 4: Place coated chicken pieces on to a 9x13 baking dish Try to leave a little room between each piece. Step 5: Drizzle with remaining garlic butter. Step 6: Bake uncovered 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear The chicken will be much more browned on the bottom than on the top.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, seasoned flour, clarified butter, amaretto, chicken stock, milk, red pepper, brown sugar, olive oil, onion, carrot, celery, salt and pepper, toasted almond, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in half-inch cubes Dredge in seasoned flour. Step 2: Saute in clarified butter on high heat Deglaze with 1 / 2 cup amaretto and put to the side. Step 3: Make mirepoix: saute onion in olive oil until translucent. Step 4: Add carrot and celery. Step 5: Saute until soft and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Heat chicken stock and add the mirepoix. Step 7: Add the milk or cream. Step 8: Cook until is has reduced by 25% and then add sugar, 1 / 2 cup amaretto and the chicken cubes.

Dish Name: America's Test Kitchen Ragu Alla Bolognese
Ingredient Names: low sodium chicken broth, beef broth, unflavored gelatin, onion, carrot, celery rib, pancetta, mortadella, chicken livers, olive oil, ground beef, ground veal, ground pork, sage, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth and beef broth in bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle gelatin over top and set aside Pulse onion, carrot, and celery in food processor until finely chopped, about 10 pulses, scraping down bowl as needed. Step 3: Transfer to separate bowl Pulse pancetta and mortadella in now-empty food processor until finely chopped, about 25 pulses, scraping down bowl as needed. Step 4: Transfer to second bowl Process chicken livers in now-empty food processor until pureed, about 5 seconds. Step 5: Transfer to third bowl. Step 6: Heat oil in large dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering. Step 7: Add beef, veal, and pork.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, vegetable oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, lemon, peppercorn, celery salt, worcestershire sauce, tabasco sauce, boneless skinless chicken breasts, butter, all-purpose flour, chianti wine, beef stock
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade: in a medium bowl whisk together oils, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, lemon zest, peppercorns, celery salt, worcestershire sauce and tabasco. Step 2: Add chicken breasts and place in refrigerator to marinate for several hours For the brown sauce: in a medium saucepan, over mediium heat, melt butter. Step 3: Add flour and whisk together over heat for 1- 2 minutes. Step 4: Add chianti and beef stock, whisking constantly. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer about 10 minutes For the chicken: remove chicken breasts from marinade and pat dry Coat each breast first with flour, shaking out excess, then in egg wash. Step 6: Then in bread crumbs.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, vidalia onions, garlic cloves, water, fresh spinach, crushed red pepper flakes, plum tomatoes, cooked chicken breasts, cooked bacon, balsamic vinegar, angel hair pasta, asiago cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion Saut 2 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic Saut 1 minute. Step 4: Add water, crushed red pepper & spinach. Step 5: Cover and cook 2 minutes or until spinach wilts. Step 6: Stir in tomato, chicken, bacon, and vinegar. Step 7: Cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated, serve over pasta.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Chicken And Veggies
Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, green peppers, onion, mixed vegetables, garlic, angel hair pasta, chicken broth, dried basil, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp Oil in medium skillet over medium heat, add chicken. Step 2: Cook, stirring, until chicken is cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Step 3: Remove from skillet and drain on paper towel Begin heating water for pasta. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in same skillet and add onion and green pepper. Step 5: Cook for about 3 minutes. Step 6: Add frozen vegetables and garlic. Step 7: Cook, stirring, for 5-7 minutes.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Herbed Chicken
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onions, carrot, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, dried basil, dried oregano, dried thyme, ground black pepper, broccoli florets, evaporated skim milk, angel hair pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet. Step 2: Add the onion and carrot and cook them, stirring over medium heat until the onion is soft but not browned, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add some water if it is dry. Step 4: Add the chicken to the skillet and cook, stirring just until it is no longer pink. Step 5: Sprinkle with the basil, oregano, thyme, and pepper. Step 6: Add the broccoli, cover, and steam for 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the milk and warm it, but don't let it boil cook pasta until al dente, drain well. Step 8: Stir the pasta into the sauce mixture, then add the cheese. Step 9: Cover the pan until the sauce has thickened slightly, 3-5 minutes, serve.

Dish Name: Another Chicken Parmesan The One I Like
Ingredient Names: italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, egg, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, mozzarella cheese, onion, garlic, fresh tomatoes, tomato paste, bay leaf, sugar, dry oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Combine bread crumbs and parmesan cheese in a shallow dish. Step 2: Place egg in another shallow dish. Step 3: Dip chicken first in egg, then dredge in bread crumb mixture to coat. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350. Step 5: In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 6: Add coated chicken breasts. Step 7: Cook, turning once, about 5 minutes a side, until lightly browned. Step 8: Arrange chicken cutlets in a single layer on an ovenproof serving platter or baking dish. Step 9: Pour tomato sauce over chicken. Step 10: Top with mozzarella cheese.

Ingredient Names: focaccia bread, tapenade, cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts, marinated artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, roasted red pepper, prosciutto, fontina cheese, pepperoncini peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Spread bottom half of focaccia with olive paste. Step 2: Arrange chicken on top of paste. Step 3: Arrange artichokes, tomatoes, peppers, and prosciutto over chicken. Step 4: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 5: Top with top half of focaccia, press gently. Step 6: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Add sandwich to pan. Step 8: Place a cast-iron or heavy skillet on top of sandwich. Step 9: Press gently to flatten.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, italian salad dressing, penne pasta, alfredo sauce, italian cheese, tomatoes, basil, garlic cloves, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Chop chicken and marinade in italian dressing for 30 minute. Step 2: Chop tomatoes, add oil chopped garlic and basil to make bruschetta, set aside. Step 3: Cook penne in boiling water. Step 4: Grill or broil chicken. Step 5: Divide pasta between two microwavable bowls. Step 6: Pour alfredo sauce Over the pasta in each bowl. Step 7: Layer on bruschetta. Step 8: Add a layer of chicken.

Ingredient Names: ciabatta, olive oil, apricot preserves, crushed red pepper flakes, fontina cheese, roasted chicken breast, prosciutto, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Slice the bread into 10 slices, each about 1 / 2-inch thick. Step 3: Brush the bread slices with the olive oil and arrange on a baking sheet. Step 4: Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until crisp and golden. Step 5: Cool to room temperature. Step 6: Spread each slice of the toasted bread with the apricot preserves then place a slice of the cheese on top. Step 7: Arrange the sliced chicken on top of the cheese. Step 8: Cut each piece of prosciutto in half and place on top of the chicken. Step 9: Transfer the bruschetta to a serving platter. Step 10: Drizzle with the extra-virgin olive oil and serve at room temperature, that's what makes it so great!

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, prego spaghetti sauce, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, dry parmesan cheese, pre-shredded mozzarella cheese, spaghetti noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Pour bread crumbs onto plate and combine with parmesan cheese Coat chicken with bread crumb mixture and then placed onto greased baking sheet and cook for 25 minutes. Step 3: Pour a bit of prego sauce into 13x9" baking pan. Step 4: Place chicken into pan and then cover with remaining prego sauce, then spread mozzarella cheese on top. Step 5: Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top. Step 6: Return to oven and cook uncovered for a further 25 minutes. Step 7: Remove from oven and serve over cooked spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: pasta, olive oil, onion, green pepper, cooked chicken, italian-style diced tomatoes, artichoke hearts, black olives, italian seasoning, salt and pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Spray 2 quart casserole with cooking spray. Step 2: Cook pasta according to directions, drain and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Add onion and pepper, cook and stir 1 minute. Step 5: Add pasta and remaining ingredients, except cheese. Step 6: Stir until combined. Step 7: Place half of the chicken and pasta mixture in dish, sprinkle half the cheese. Step 8: Top with remaining chicken mixture and cheese. Step 9: Bake, covered, for 35 minutes.

Dish Name: Artichoke Pesto Sun Dried Tomato Pizza With Three Cheeses
Ingredient Names: pizza dough, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, chicken breast, artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomato, ricotta cheese, red pepper flakes, basil pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450. Step 2: Prepare your pizza: top the crust with mozzarella, parmesan, chicken, artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes, in that order Dollop the ricotta cheese all over the pizza. Step 3: Sprinkle pizza with red pepper flakes, if using. Step 4: Bake for 8-12 minutes, or until cheese is melted and pizza is warm. Step 5: Remove pizza from oven and drizzle with little dollops of pesto sauce, serve.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, fresh asparagus, garlic, arborio rice, chicken broth, cream, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in the pan and add the onions on medium-low heat. Step 2: Cook for 4 minutes, then add the garlic. Step 3: Cook for 1 minute, then add the rice. Step 4: Stir until well coated. Step 5: Add 1/2 cup of stock to the rice, stirring until absorbed. Step 6: Then add the asparagus. Step 7: Continue adding the stock in 1/2 cup increments, stirring after each addition until the stock has been absorbed. Step 8: (Should take about 20-25 minutes.) Add the cream, cheese, and basil stirring gently to combine.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, marsala wine, sliced mushrooms, chicken stock, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the flour, salt, oregano, and pepper Pound the chicken breasts gently. Step 2: Roll the chicken in this until well coated On medium-high, heat up the olive oil in a frying pan and brown the chicken on both sides, then set aside chicken on a plate Carefully pour wine into the oil and warm, then mix in the mushrooms, chicken stock and juice of the lemon. Step 3: Add chicken, turning the chicken over to get it well coated with the sauce. Step 4: Simmer for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, garlic, thyme, oregano, basil, salt, black pepper, eggs, milk, extra virgin olive oil, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and pat-dry each chicken breasts. Step 2: Cut any visible fat from each chicken breast. Step 3: Pour olive oil into frying pan, and turn the heat up to medium-high. Step 4: Mix all of the following ingredients in a medium-large mixing bowl: parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, basil, salt, black pepper, oregano, thyme In another mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk until it is slightly foamy More milk, approximately 1 / 4 cup, can be added to make the milk-egg mixture less thick. Step 5: Dip a chicken breast into the milk-egg mixture. Step 6: Remove the chicken breast once it is well coated and allow the excess to drip off into the bowl for a second or two. Step 7: Place the chicken breast into the breading mixture. Step 8: Roll chicken around to thoroughly coat all sides of chicken.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, red bell pepper, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, oregano, basil, thyme, all purpose greek seasoning, pepper, bay leaf, onion powder, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly brown chicken in a frying pan, cut each breast into a few pieces and place in a large casserole dish Saut onion, peppers and garlic in olive oil until soft. Step 2: Sprinkle over the chicken in the casserole dish. Step 3: Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over chicken mixture. Step 4: Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Step 5: Serve over whole wheat pasta, brown rice or couscous.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, streaky bacon, chestnut mushroom, risotto rice, chicken stock, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion and bacon for 5 mins to soften. Add the mushrooms and cook for a further 5 mins until they start to release their juices. Stir in the rice and cook until all the juices have been absorbed. Step 2: Add the stock, a ladleful at a time, stirring well and waiting for most of the stock to be absorbed before adding the next ladleful – it will take about 20 mins for all the stock to be added. Once the rice is cooked, season and serve with the grated Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, butter, white wine, yellow onions, chicken breast halves, salt and pepper, olive oil, blue cheese, fresh rosemary, bacon, parmesan cheese, garlic salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Begin by cooking the pasta per package instructions. Step 2: In a large sauce pan over medium heat add 3 tablespoons butter and, if desired, a splash of white wine. Step 3: Add to the sizziling butter the sliced onions, stirring every 5 minutes for a total of 25 minutes, or until they turn a caramel color. Step 4: Season breasts with salt and pepper Broil chicken breasts halves about 12 minutes, flipping halfway through until cooked Careful not to overcook Breasts may, also, be grilled or pan fried. Step 5: When the pasta is cooked, drain and place in a large bowl while hot. Step 6: Stir in the olive oil Over the pasta, evenly sprinkling the blue cheese letting the cheese melt.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, fine breadcrumbs, italian salad dressing, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, chopped tomato, dried italian seasoning, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Heat olive oil in large frying pan. Step 3: Dip chicken in salad dressing, then in bread crumbs Brown in oil. Step 4: Transfer to shallow baking dish. Step 5: Spoon marinara sauce over chicken. Step 6: Top with sliced mozzarella, then chopped tomato. Step 7: Sprinkle with herbs and a generous shake of parmesan cheese. Step 8: Bake for 45 minutes If tomatoes begin to burn, cover loosely with foil.

Ingredient Names: part-skim ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, garlic powder, fresh parsley, salt, black pepper, cooked chicken, lasagna noodles, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Mix first eight ingredients, reserving 1 / 4 cup mozzarella Lay a large piece of plastic wrap on countertop Lay noodles flat atop plastic wrap, top each noodle with a layer of the ricotta mixture and 1 / 4 cup chicken Starting at one end, roll one noodle at a time. Step 3: Fill the bottom of a baking dish with 1 / 2 cup tomato sauce Lay rolls seam side down, cover with remaining tomato sauce and sprinkle with reserved 1 / 4 cup mozzarella cheese. Step 4: Bake for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Chicken Lemon And Pea Risotto
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breast fillets, leeks, lemon zest, arborio rice, chicken stock, frozen peas, lemon juice, parmesan cheese, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200c 400f. Step 2: Heat a fry pan over high heat add oil and chicken and cook for 3 mins each side or until well browned, set aside. Step 3: Add leeks and zest to the pan and cook for 5 mins until leeks are golden. Step 4: Place leek mix, rice and stock in a baking dish, cover tightly with lid or foil and bake for 20 mins. Step 5: Add chicken and peas to the risotto and cover tightly and bake for further 20 mins The risotto will be quite liquid at this stage. Step 6: Stir the parmesan, lemon juice, mint and salt and pepper through the risotto. Step 7: Stir for 2 mins to thicken then serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, butter, prepared mustard, fresh breadcrumb, parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Melt butter in skillet and remove from heat and mix in mustard On a plate, combine crumbs, cheese, parsley, salt and pepper. Step 3: Dip chicken in butter / mustard and then pat crumbs on the chicken. Step 4: Place the chicken in a 9" x 13" baking dish and bake for 45 minutes-.

Dish Name: Baked Chicken With Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, oil, fresh basil leaf, parmesan cheese, garlic, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 500f. Step 2: Line a 13x9" baking pan with foil. Step 3: Arrange chicken in the pan. Step 4: Combine the sun-dried tomatoes, 2 tbsp Of the oil, basil, parmesan cheese, garlic, and pepper in a food processor Whirl until smooth. Step 5: Spread about half of the pesto over the chicken. Step 6: Bake about 15-20 minutes, or until juices run clear. Step 7: Remove pan from oven, heat the broiler.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, onions, garlic, italian-style tomatoes, italian seasoning, ground black pepper, ziti pasta, nonfat cottage cheese, nonfat mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a large nonstick skillet with Pam; heat. Step 2: Add the chicken and cook, turning as needed, until lightly browned, 5-6 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a plate. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 375. Step 5: Spray the same skillet with more Pam. Step 6: Add the onion and garlic; cook, stirring as needed, until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the tomatoes, Italian seasoning and pepper; bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring as needed, until the mixture is thickened slightly, 8-10 minutes. Step 9: Meanwhile, cook the ziti according to package directions. Step 10: Drain and mix with the ricotta cheese. Step 11: Pour half of the tomato mixture into a 13x9" baking pan, layer with the ziti mixture, the chicken and the remaining tomato mixture. Step 12: Sprinkle with the cheeses. Step 13: Bake until hot and bubbling and the cheese is melted, 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, arborio rice, onions, pumpkin, garlic, dry white wine, vegetables, sage leaves, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, butter, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180C/350F. Step 2: Melt 1 tbsp / 20g butter in ovenproof pot (preferably with a lid) over medium high heat. Step 3: Add garlic and onion and cook until onion is translucent. Step 4: Add chopped sage and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add rice and stir so all the rice grains are coated with the butter and semi translucent. Step 6: Add white wine and cook until the the liquid evaporates - about 1 minute. Step 7: Add pumpkin and broth, stir. Let the liquid heat up but do not bring to simmer. Step 8: Put lid on (or cover tightly with foil) and place in oven for 25 minutes, until rice is just cooked (firm but not raw) - don't worry if there's excess liquid. If rice is still uncooked, return to oven for 5 minutes. Step 9: Add remaining butter and parmesan cheese. Step 10: Stir vigorously until the pumpkin turns into a puree and blends into the risotto. If it's too thick then add a splash of hot tap water. Should have a porridge like consistency so it sags a bit when served, rather than staying in a tall, firm pile. Step 11: Spoon into serving bowls. Garnish with crispy sage, 1 or 2 teaspoons of brown butter and parmesan cheese. Devour immediately! Step 12: Melt butter in a small pan over medium high heat. Once foaming, add sage leaves and stir gently. Step 13: Cook for 1 1/2 minutes or until crispy. Step 14: Immediately remove sage onto paper towel lined plate and pour butter into a heat proof jug (butter should be brown by now).

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, white wine, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, garlic cloves, olive oil, pasta sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Lightly spray a casserole dish with non-stick spray. Step 2: Place onion evenly in bottom of the casserole dish and then place the chicken on top of the onions. Step 3: Pour the wine over everything. Step 4: Sprinkle the italian seasoning, salt and pepper all over the chicken and then lay the sliced garlic evenly on top of the chicken and drizzle with the olive oil. Step 5: Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Step 6: Pour the pasta sauce over the chicken and top with the mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake for another 30 minutes. Step 8: Serve with spaghettini noodles and top with parmesan cheese if desired.

Dish Name: Baked Garlic Chicken Mozzarella With Pasta Fazoli's Copy
Ingredient Names: olive oil, biscuit mix, parmesan cheese, basil, oregano, garlic powder, pepper, boneless chicken breast halves, tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce, garlic cloves, mozzarella cheese, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat frying pan to medium high. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350. Step 3: Grease 13x9 pan with 1 t Of the olive oil. Step 4: In a medium bowl, combine biscuit mix, parmesan, basil, oregano, garlic and pepper Pull "tenders" from breast halves Dredge all pieces in the biscuit mixture Pressing it on as necessary. Step 5: Add remaining oil to hot frying pan, and brown the chicken pieces, turning to brown all sides. Step 6: Remove pan from heat.

Dish Name: Baked Garlic and Fontina Chicken Spaghetti
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, butter, yellow onions, baby bella mushrooms, garlic, all-purpose flour, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, low sodium chicken broth, milk, tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, fontina cheese, parsley, chicken, asiago cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Lightly grease a 9X13-inch glass or ceramic dish with cooking spray and set aside. Step 2: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water a few minutes short of al dente (the noodles will finish cooking in the oven). Drain and toss with a tablespoon of olive oil to prevent sticking and set aside. Step 3: In a large, nonstick 12 inch skillet, heat the butter and olive oil until rippling and hot. Add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 6-7 minutes, until the onions are translucent and the mushrooms are golden and have given up most of their liquid. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds or so until fragrant. Step 4: Sprinkle the flour over the onions and mushrooms along with the salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. Whisk or stir constantly for a minute or so over medium heat. The mixture will be a bit crumbly; that’s ok. Step 5: Gradually add the chicken broth and milk, whisking quickly and constantly to avoid lumps. Stir, bringing the mixture to a simmer, and cook until slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes. Add the diced tomatoes and heat through. Step 6: Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the mozzarella and fontina cheeses, one handful at a time, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth and creamy. Stir in the parsley and add any additional salt and pepper to taste, if needed. Add the cooked chicken and stir to combine. Step 7: Toss the sauce and cooked pasta together and spread evenly in the prepared dish. Sprinkle the Asiago and Parmesan cheeses over the top. Cover the dish with lightly greased aluminum foil and cook for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes more, until the edges are golden and bubbling. Step 8: Let the casserole rest for for 10 minutes or so before serving.

Ingredient Names: fryer, butter, italian breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, parsley, garlic, basil, oregano, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken pieces Pat dry. Step 2: Place butter in shallow dish. Step 3: Mix remaining ingredients in shallow dish. Step 4: Dip pieces in butter, then in breadcrumb mixture. Step 5: Place on baking sheet. Step 6: Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, grated parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, salt, skinless chicken thighs, garlic powder, olive oil, shredded mozzarella cheese, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Combine ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, and salt in a small bowl; set aside. Step 3: Season chicken thighs on both sides with garlic powder and salt. Step 4: Heat olive oil in an oven-proof skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Cook chicken thighs, smooth-side down, in hot oil until the bottoms are browned, 3 to. Step 6: Flip thighs over and remove the skillet from heat. Step 7: Top each thigh with an equal amount of ricotta cheese mixture. Step 8: Spoon marinara sauce on top and around chicken thighs. Step 9: Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes. Step 10: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the centers of thighs should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 11: Top each thigh with mozzarella cheese and continue baking until cheese is melted, 2 to. Step 12: Garnish with parsley to serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken tenderloins, parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, italian seasoning, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Beat eggs in a bowl. Step 3: Combine cheeses, bread crumbs and spices in a separate bowl. Step 4: Dip chicken pieces in egg, then bread crumb mixture, then egg, then bread crumb mixture again. Step 5: Place chicken on a cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. Step 6: Serve over pasta with marinara sauce and mozzarella Or place chicken on a hoagie roll with marinara and mozzarella for a chicken parmesan sub Also great for dipping with marinara or ranch.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast half, butter, parmesan cheese, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, oregano, parsley flakes, paprika, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400 degrees f Spray baking pan with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Combine all dry ingredients minus the butter. Step 3: Dip chicken in butter then coat with combined dry ingredients. Step 4: Place in prepared pan. Step 5: Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

Dish Name: Baked Spaghetti With Chicken And Spinach
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, garlic cloves, red onion, fresh spinach, stewed tomatoes, dried basil, dried tarragon, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti, al dente, drain and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in large saucepan. Step 3: Add garlic and onion, cook until soft, but not browned. Step 4: Add chicken, brown on all sides, turning often, until no longer pink Sauce: in a blender or food processor, add stewed tomatoes, basil, tarragon, salt, chili flakes, parsley, garlic and cheese Pulse until just chunky, not smooth. Step 5: Add sauce to chicken mixture. Step 6: Stir and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 7: Line an oven proof casserole with the spinach Lay the spaghetti over the spinach.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, balsamic vinegar, white sugar, italian seasoning, garlic, skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Whisk chicken broth, balsamic vinegar, sugar, Italian seasoning, and garlic together in a bowl. Step 3: Place chicken breasts in marinade; let marinate for 2 hours on each side. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Remove chicken from marinade; reserve marinade. Step 6: Place chicken in the hot skillet and cook until browned and no longer pink inside, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 7: Pour marinade into the skillet. Step 8: Cook until sauce thickens slightly, turning chicken breasts over once or twice, about 3-4 minutes. Step 9: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of a chicken breast should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, balsamic vinaigrette, tomatoes, fresh mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaf, balsamic vinegar, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a shallow dish or large resealable plastic bag. Step 2: Pour the dressing over it, cover or seal, and marinate in the refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours Coat a large skillet with cooking spray or oil, and set over low heat. Step 3: Remove the chicken from the marinade and discard the marinade. Step 4: Fry chicken breast halves over low heat for about 30 minutes, or until juices run clear. Step 5: Arrange chicken on a serving platter. Step 6: Place a generous slice of fresh mozzarella on top of each piece. Step 7: Place a leaf of basil on top of the cheese, and cover with a slice of tomato Dash balsamic vinegar over the platter, and season with salt and pepper, serve!

Ingredient Names: italian salad dressing, balsamic vinegar, honey, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil, chicken breasts, asparagus, carrot, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together salad dressing, vinegar, honey and crushed red pepper in a small mixing bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a large frypan. Step 3: Add chicken, cook over medium high heat for 5 to 6 minutes or till chicken is tender and no longer pink, turning once. Step 4: Transfer from frypan to a serving platter, cover and keep warm. Step 5: Add asparagus and carrot to skillet. Step 6: Cook and stir for 3 to 4 minutes or till asparagus is crisp tender, transfer to serving platter. Step 7: Stir dressing mixture, add to frypan. Step 8: Cook and stir for 1 minute, scraping up browned bits. Step 9: Drizzle dressing over chicken and veggies.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, shallots, garlic, skinless chicken breasts, pearl barley, white wine, mixed wild chestnut mushroom, thyme leaf, chicken stock, parmesan, fresh chives, parmesan shavings
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy saucepan, heat the butter and oil. Sauté the shallots and garlic with some seasoning for 5 mins, then stir in the chicken and cook for 2 mins. Step 2: Add the barley and cook for 1 min. Pour in the wine and stir until it is absorbed. Add the mushrooms and thyme, then pour over ¾ of the stock. Cook for 40 mins on a low simmer until the barley is tender, stirring occasionally and topping up with remaining stock if it looks dry. Remove from the heat and stir in the grated Parmesan. Serve immediately, with chives and Parmesan shavings scattered over, if you like.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, salt, garlic powder, ground black pepper, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, marsala wine, chicken broth, fresh basil leaf, onion powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken between two sheets of wax paper and pound to approximately 1 / 4-inch thick. Step 2: In a large bowl or plastic bag, combine flour with next 3 ingredients. Step 3: Add chicken to flour mixture, toss to coat. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat Saut chicken 3-5 minutes per side or until done. Step 5: Remove from skillet. Step 6: Add mushrooms and remaining oil, if needed Saut 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in wine and remaining 3 ingredients. Step 8: Stir to loosen any browned particles.

Dish Name: Basil Pesto Stuffed Chicken Breasts With Sun Dried Tomato Cream
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, prosciutto, pesto sauce, lemon juice, garlic cloves, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, fresh basil, garlic clove, pine nuts, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, shallot, butter, dry white wine
Instructions: Step 1: For pesto, wash basil and remove stems In food processor mix basil, garlic, pine nuts, pepper and parmesan. Step 2: Blend until smooth and slowly add oil Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 4 inch thickness. Step 3: Place one slice prosciutto and 1 t Pesto on chicken breast Tuck in ends and roll jelly style Secure with toothpicks. Step 4: Drizzle with 2 t Lemon juice, chopped garlic and olive oil.

Dish Name: Belinda's Version Of Carino's Chicken Scaloppini
Ingredient Names: lemon juice, white wine, heavy cream, butter, chicken tenders, olive oil, flour, cooked bacon, roma tomatoes, onion, thin spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta. Step 2: Drain Chicken: dredge chicken in seasoned flour. Step 3: Melt about 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons olive oil in large skillet. Step 4: Cook chicken until lightly browned and just cooked through. Step 5: Remove from pan, and keep warm Veggies: saute the onions until fairly tender. Step 6: Then add bacon and tomatoes, and toss until heated through. Step 7: Remove from pan, and add to drained spagetti noodles Sauce: heat the lemon juice and wine to a boil.

Ingredient Names: cooked pasta, spaghetti sauce, bell pepper, onion, cooked chicken, baby tomatoes, olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Freeze the pasta sauce in an ice cube tray Do not fill it full, you want half-full ice cubes. Step 2: Combine sauce cubes, pasta, veggies, and chicken in a freezer bag Freeze To cook: heat olive oil in large skillet. Step 3: Add meal straight from freezer. Step 4: Cook covered on medium for 10 minutes or until sauce is melted and the vegetables look done. Step 5: Add cheese and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, ground black pepper, italian seasoning, dry onion soup mix, condensed cream of mushroom soup, milk, water, green peas, parmesan cheese, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, over medium-high heat, heat olive oil and saute garlic for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add chicken, pepper and italian seasoning, and cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is no longer pink In medium bowl, stir together onion soup mix, cream of mushroom soup, milk and water. Step 3: Add to chicken mixture. Step 4: Add peas and parmesan to chicken, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally While sauce is simmering, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 5: Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente, drain. Step 6: Toss pasta with sauce to serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, italian dressing, italian seasoning, romaine lettuce, tomatoes, provolone cheese, hamburger buns, mayonnaise, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: If chicken is frozen, thaw before beginning. Step 2: Combine mayonnaise, 1 tsp italian seasoning, and 1 / 4 tsp garlic powder. Step 3: Place chicken on one half of cellophane and cover with the other half Tenderize with a mallet until entire piece of chicken is close to the same thickness throughout Rub italian dressing on both sides of chicken, then sprinkle italian seasoning on one side only. Step 4: Let marinate for approximately 15 minutes. Step 5: Preheat frying pan or griddle to 325 degrees. Step 6: Cook chicken until no longer pink in the center. Step 7: Prepare lettuce and slice tomato Thinly spread mayonnaise on bottom and top bun.

Ingredient Names: garlic powder, onion powder, dried thyme, dried oregano, paprika, dried tarragon, ground nutmeg, salt, ground red pepper, black pepper, olive oil, worcestershire sauce, boneless skinless chicken breasts, butter, dry fettuccine
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 12 ingredients in a zip lock bag. Step 2: Add the chicken and seal. Step 3: Put in refrigerator and marinate for 8 hours, turning the bag occasionally. Step 4: Remove the chicken from the bag. Step 5: Discard the marinade. Step 6: Cook the chicken in the melted butter in a large skillet over medium high heat for 5 minutes on each side or until well browned. Step 7: Remove the chicken and reserve the drippings. Step 8: Slice the chicken diagonally and set aside. Step 9: Cook the pasta according to the package, drain well.

Dish Name: Bow Tie Pasta With Sausage Spinach Tomatoes Cream
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, boiling water, olive oil, chicken-spinach sausages, onion, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, balsamic vinegar, tomato soup, basil, fat-free half-and-half, margarine, salt, white pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In stockpot add water and 1 tblsp olive oil. Step 2: When boiling, add pasta In frying pan, add 2 tblsp olive oil, add sausages, chopped onion, garlic italian seasoning, balsamic vinegar. Step 3: Saute until onion, sausages and garlic start to brown. Step 4: Turn heat to simmer In separate bowl, add tomato soup, basil and half and half Wisk to mix. Step 5: Cook pasta until ala dente, about 10 -12 minutes. Step 6: Drain in colandar Save 1 cup water.

Dish Name: Bow Ties With Chicken And Asiago Cheese Sauce
Ingredient Names: butter, all-purpose flour, evaporated milk, milk, chicken broth, asiago cheese, olive oil, boneless chicken breast, fresh parsley, garlic clove, salt, black pepper, bow tie pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add the flour and stir just until mixed. Step 3: Add the evaporated milk, regular milk and chicken broth and cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens and begins to simmer. Step 4: Remove from heat and add the asiago cheese, stirring just until the cheese melts smoothly into the sauce, set aside. Step 5: Heat the olive oil in a large, preferably non-stick, skillet. Step 6: Add the cubed chicken, parsley and garlic, and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the chicken is opaque and cooked through 8 to 10 minutes. Step 7: Add the asiago sauce and season with salt and pepper, stir to combine. Step 8: Meanwhile, cook the bow tie pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender but not mushy.

Dish Name: Bow Ties With Chicken And Spinach
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, chicken breast, olive oil, onion, red pepper, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, chicken broth, spinach, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta until done. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the chicken in oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the onion, red pepper, garlic, salt, and pepper with the chicken Continue to cook and stir 5-7 minutes until chicken is almost cooked through. Step 4: Add the broth and spinach then cook until spinach is wilted and chicken is done. Step 5: Combine chicken mixture with hot drained pasta and toss well. Step 6: Top with cheese and parsley then serve.

Dish Name: Braciola Braciole Di Pollo Chicken With Prosciutto
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, prosciutto, parsley, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, eggs, provolone cheese, basil leaves, fresh rosemary, garlic cloves, olive oil, roma tomatoes, basil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven 450 degrees f Lay chicken on flat surface season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Place slices of ham over breasts until all is used In bowl- mix parsley, bread crumbs, cheeses, eggs, basil and rosemary. Step 3: Layer some filling on each chicken breast on the smaller end roll up the chicken tightly and secure with butchers twine or toothpicks. Step 4: Place in foil pouches and bake 15-20 minutes in shallow pan. Step 5: Make sauce while roasting chicken in large pot saute garlic in olive oil for about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add tomatoes, basil and salt let cook for about 45 minutes at a slow boil. Step 7: When chicken comes out quickly brown them in a little olive oil, top with sauce and serve over pasta.

Dish Name: Braised Chicken In Sun Dried Tomato Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, oil, garlic cloves, dry white wine, heavy whipping cream, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, red bell pepper, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and pat dry chicken, sprinkly with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat oil from tomatoes in a heavy skillet, over medium heat. Step 3: Add chicken to skillet and saute until golden, about 4 minutes per side. Step 4: Add garlic and stir 30 seconds--do not brown garlic. Step 5: Add white wine, cream, pepper, and tomatoes, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until chicken is just cooked through, about 3-5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer chicken to plates. Step 8: Add most of basil to sauce in skillet Increase heat and boil until sauce thickens enough to coat spoon, and peppers and tomatoes are soft-about 2-5 minutes. Step 9: Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper, spoon over chicken and top with fresh basil and serve.

Dish Name: Braised Chicken Thighs With Bell Peppers Olives And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, yellow bell peppers, red bell peppers, onion, garlic cloves, canned whole tomatoes, spanish olives, dried bay leaf, paprika, dried thyme, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven, warm oil over medium heat. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper, and cook until browned, about 3 minutes per side. Step 3: Transfer to a plate. Step 4: Add bell peppers, onion, and garlic to pot. Step 5: Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5-7 minutes If using whole tomatoes, gently crush tomatoes with your hands. Step 6: Add them to the pot along with their juice If using canned crushed tomatoes, empty can into pot. Step 7: Add the pitted and quartered olives, the bay leaf, paprika, thyme, and water to the pot, bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Braised Chicken With Tomato And Rosemary
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken thigh fillets, rosemary, red onion, garlic cloves, anchovy fillets, chopped tomatoes, capers, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half of the oil in a large frying pan on medium. Step 2: Cook chicken for 3-4 minutes each side until browned. Step 3: Add half of the chopped rosemary and stir to combine. Step 4: Transfer chicken to a plate. Step 5: Heat remaining oil and cook onion for 3-4 minutes until soft. Step 6: Add garlic, anchovy and remaining rosemary. Step 7: Cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Step 8: Add tomatoes, capers and red wine or water, bring to the boil. Step 9: Return chicken to pan, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, wild rabbit jointed, smoked streaky bacon, red onions, fresh carrot, garlic, rosemary, tomato puree, white, chicken stock, pappardelle pasta, oranges, dijon mustard, cream, fresh flat-leaf parsley, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. When hot, add the rabbit, brown on all sides, then remove from the pan and set aside. Step 2: Add the bacon, onion and carrot to the pan and cook for 10 mins until soft. Add the garlic, rosemary and tomato purée, stir for 1-2 mins, then pour in the wine and chicken stock. Step 3: Return the rabbit to the pan, season, cover with a lid and cook over a low heat for 1 hr until the rabbit is really tender. Step 4: Remove the rabbit from the pan and shred the meat using 2 forks. Be careful to remove all small bones. Meanwhile, increase the heat under the pan and boil the liquid for 5 mins until reduced by half. Add the shredded meat and reduce the heat to low. Cook the pasta in a large pan of salted water following pack instructions. Drain, reserving a little pasta water to thin the sauce if necessary. Step 5: Stir half the orange zest, mustard, cream and parsley into the rabbit sauce. Add the cooked pasta to the pan, toss everything well to coat and heat through for 1-2 mins. Serve in bowls with grated Parmesan, parsley leaves and the remaining orange zest.

Dish Name: Broccoli And Lemon Pepper Chicken Alfredo With Bow Tie Pasta
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, broccoli, bow tie pasta, lemon pepper, olive oil, lemon juice, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, parmesan cheese, salt, paprika, mustard powder
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta to desired firmness and drain While the pasta boils, fry chicken with oil, lemon juice and lemon pepper until thoroughly cooked Seat aside. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, cover the bottom of the pan with water and bring to a boil. Step 3: Add broccoli, cover and boil 5 minutes, drain well, set aside. Step 4: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Step 5: Stir in flour until smooth Slowly stir in milk until smooth and hot. Step 6: Reduce heat and add cheese.

Ingredient Names: no-salt-added diced tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, pepperidge farm stuffing, garlic, basil, oregano, boneless skinless chicken breasts, reduced-fat italian salad dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Put tomatoes with their juice, 1 / 2 c cheese, seasonings, and dry stuffing mix in a large bowl and mix. Step 3: Put bowl aside and prepare chicken If the chicken breasts are small, put a breast between sheets of plastic wrap and pound the chicken with a heavy can, rolling pin or meat mallet until chicken is 1 / 4 inch thick If the chicken breasts are large and very thick, cut them in two by cutting through the thickness of the breast, then pound as described above. Step 4: Repeat for all the chicken breasts. Step 5: Place the chicken, two breasts at a time, smooth side down on a plate. Step 6: Spread evenly with stuffing mixture Starting at the narrow end, roll the chicken as tightly as possible around the stuffing mixture. Step 7: Place, seam-sides down, in an oiled 13x9 inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: flour, eggs, boneless skinless chicken breasts, parmesan cheese, dry breadcrumbs, butter, tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, fresh basil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place flour and lighlty beaten eggs in separate containers that are large enough to accommodate each chicken breast. Step 2: Dip chicken in flour then in egg and place in greased 9x13 pan. Step 3: Combine the cheese, breadcrumbs & butter and sprinkle over chicken. Step 4: Loosely cover dish with foil & bake at 375 for 20 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients. Step 6: Uncover the chicken and bake an additional 5-10 minutes longer until top is browned. Step 7: Spoon tomato mixture over chicken, return to oven for 3-5 minutes or until just heated through. Step 8: Plate each breast and garnish with 2 or 3 whole basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, flour, white wine, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, alfredo sauce, sun-dried tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Step 2: Heat oil on medium high heat. Step 3: Season the chicken breast with salt and lightly dust with flour. Step 4: Saute the chicken breast until browned. Step 5: Turn over and brown the other side as well. Step 6: Remove the chicken breast from the pan and pour off all oil. Step 7: Add wine to the pan and return the chicken breasts to the pan as well. Step 8: Cover and cook the chicken breasts in the pan, turning once, until an internal temperature of 165 degrees is met. Step 9: Transfer the chicken breasts to a pan and hold. Step 10: Add the garlic, crushed red pepper, and the alfredo sauce to the wine left in the pan.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Chicken Marsala Copycat
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken cutlets, low-sodium bacon, flour, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper, dry marsala wine, heavy cream, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Coat large skillet lightly with olive oil and set over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add bacon and cook just until crisp and lightly browned. Step 3: Remove with a slotted spoon, set aside, leave fat in the pan. Step 4: Put flour on a plate Pat cutlets dry, season lightly with salt and pepper, dredge in flour. Step 5: Heat pan with bacon fat over medium-high heat, add touch more olive oil if necessary to make approximately 2 tablespoons. Step 6: When fat is hot shake excess flour off cutlets and place in pan. Step 7: Saute, turning once until browned on both sides Thin cutlets should only take a few minutes per side. Step 8: Remove cutlets, pour excess fat from pan.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, prosciutto ham, fresh sage, olive oil, all-purpose flour, artichoke hearts, capers, white wine, fresh lemon juice, heavy cream, butter, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly salt chicken breasts. Step 2: Sprinkle evenly with chopped sage. Step 3: Place sliced prosciutto on top the chicken and pound it into the breast until the thickness of the chicken measures 3 / 8-inch. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a saute pan Lightly flour chicken pressed with prosciutto. Step 5: Place in heated oil, prosciutto side down Brown one side, turn and brown the other side. Step 6: Drain off excess oil, and deglaze with 4 ounces of white wine. Step 7: Add artichokes, fresh lemon juice, cream and butter and cook until sauce is thickened On a large platter, place chicken breasts topped with reduced sauce and garnish with capers.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Cornish Game Hens With Spinach Sauce Or Chicken B
Ingredient Names: cornish hens, olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, rosemary, oregano, salt, heavy cream, garlic cloves, spinach, pepper, butter
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the hens, split open the back of each cornish game hen with a sharp knife or poultry shears. Step 2: Remove giblets, rinse under cold water and pat dry with a paper towel Flatten leaving hens in one piece. Step 3: Place olive oil, crushed red pepper, rosemary, oregano and salt in a large bowl and mix well. Step 4: Add hens to the mixture and marinate for approximately 2 hours, turning the hens from time to time. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 6: Place the hens on a large sheet pan, skin side down. Step 7: Spoon some of the marinade over the hens. Step 8: Bake for approximately 45 minutes, turn the hens skin side up and continue baking for another 30 minutes, or until the meat is done and skin is golden brown and crisp. Step 9: Remove the hends from the oven, place on serving dishes and top with spinach sauce.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Little Hat Pasta With Spicy Chicken
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, boneless skinless chicken breasts, broccoli florets, zucchini, salt, orecchiette, tomatoes, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sautepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and crushed red pepper cooking until aromatic, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the chicken and saute until brown. Step 4: Add broccoli, zucchini and salt. Step 5: Cook until tender and brown, about five minutes, set aside. Step 6: In a large pot of boiling water cook the pasta until al dente Prior to draining the pasta, take 1 / 4 cup of the hot water and add it to the sauce along with the tomato. Step 7: Drain the pasta very well. Step 8: Place the pasta back into the pot with the sauce and the cheese.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Macaroni Rosa Copycat
Ingredient Names: macaroni, olive oil, mushrooms, cooked chicken breast strips, peas, marinara sauce, cream, broccoli, basil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic, red onions, roma tomato, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Add all the ingredients together listed for brushetta, set aside. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large saut pan. Step 3: Add mushrooms and chicken tenders Saut until chicken starts to brown along the edges. Step 4: Add marinara and cream and reduce by a third. Step 5: Add 4 oz of bruschetta mix and peas. Step 6: Cook for three minutes. Step 7: Drop macaroni and broccoli buds in boiling water for three seconds. Step 8: Drain and toss in sauce along with romano cheese and serve on a large platter.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, green onions, garlic, chicken tenders, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, white wine, artichokes, cream, butter, penne pasta, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the root from the green onions and cut the green onions into 1 / 4 inch rings and portions to 5 ounces. Step 2: Cut the raw chicken tenders in half lengthwise, portion to 16 ounces Portion the drained quartered artichoke hearts to 10 ounces. Step 3: In a large saute pan, heat the olive oil, add the green onions and chopped garlic. Step 4: Saute for 3-4 minutes, until the garlic and onions are slightly browned. Step 5: Add the chicken tenders, salt and the crushed red pepper. Step 6: Cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through Deglaze the pan with white wine. Step 7: Add the quartered artichokes and cream. Step 8: Reduce the sauce until it starts to thicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, pasta sauce, parmesan cheese, tomato paste, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken pieces in crock pot, top with sauce and sprinkle with cheese. Step 2: Cover and cook on high 4-6 hours or on low 8-10 hours. Step 3: Remove chicken to a serving dish, for a thicker sauce stir in tomato paste and spoon over pasta.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breasts, reduced-fat chicken broth, green bell pepper, mushrooms, tomatoes seasoned with basil garlic & oregano, penne pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Advance prep---cook chicken, cut into cubes. Step 2: Slice green pepper Halve mushrooms. Step 3: Cook pasta according to package directions until just tender. Step 4: Rinse in cold water. Step 5: Place in large pan of cold water. Step 6: Store in refrigerator until ready to use Preparation---in large skillet combine broth, sliced green bell pepper, mushrooms, and tomatoes. Step 7: Cook over medium-hign until green pepper slices are tender and cooked through.

Ingredient Names: pizza crust, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, tasty cheese, chicken pieces, mushrooms, onion, garlic clove, oil, whole tomatoes, bay leaf, red wine, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken cacciatore: Slice mushrooms and onion, crush garlic. Step 2: Heat oil in pan, fry chicken pieces until golden brown. Step 3: Remove from pan, drain well. Step 4: Add onion, mushrooms and garlic to pan, saute until onion is tender. Step 5: Return chicken to the pan, add ndrained, mashed tomatoes, bayleaf and wine. Step 6: Cook slowly, covered, for 45 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Step 7: Remove bay leaf and leave cacciatore to cool. Step 8: Remove chicken from the bones and shred. Step 9: Stir back into the sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken cutlets, salt, pepper, eggs, flour, breadcrumbs, butter, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, fresh spinach, white mushrooms, italian parsley, fresh basil leaf, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the chicken thin. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, make an egg wash of the eggs seasoned with salt, pepper, a tbsp of of paremesan cheese and parsley mixed well Coat the cutlets in the egg wash then in flour and bread crumbs. Step 3: Saute the cutlets in butter until golden brown, then place in a 350 degrees oven to finish In another pan, saute the olive oil and garlic. Step 4: Add the spinch, season with salt and pepper and throw in the mushrooms. Step 5: Cook through then transfer to a bowl and let it cool. Step 6: Reduce oven heat to 300 degrees. Step 7: Put the ricotta in a strainer to drain, then mix with the cooled spinach mixture, worcestershire sauce and the rest of the paremesan cheese. Step 8: Take the chicken pan out of the oven and spoon a layer of spinach-and-cheese mixture on top of each piece.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cajun seasoning, spinach, butter, flour, milk, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt and pepper, mostaccioli noodles, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put noodles on to boil, and boil according to package directions In the meantime, make sauce. Step 2: In a medium sauce pan, melt butter. Step 3: Add flour and blend well Gradually whisk in milk, spinach, cheese, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Step 4: Cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring frequently, cover and reserve. Step 5: Heat oil over medium high heat in large fry pan. Step 6: Sprinkle chicken liberally with cajun seasoning, and sear chicken on both sides, reduce heat to medium and cook thoroughly, turning occasionally. Step 7: Serve noodles on plate, top with a chicken breast and spoon sauce over.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, diced tomatoes with garlic and olive oil, tomato sauce, fresh basil, dry penne pasta, eggs, breadcrumbs, garlic powder, salt, pepper, chicken cutlet
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 4 cup of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the garlic, and saute for a few minutes. Step 3: Sprinkle in the red pepper flakes, and saute for another minute. Step 4: Pour in the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce, and add the basil. Step 5: Simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 7: Add penne pasta, and cook for 8 minutes, or until tender, drain. Step 8: In a small bowl, whisk eggs with a fork. Step 9: Place bread crumbs in a separate bowl.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless chicken breast, condensed cream of mushroom & garlic soup, campbell's condensed chicken broth, water, carrot, green onions, parmesan cheese, long-grain white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In medium skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Step 2: Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring often. Step 3: Add soup, broth, water, carrot, green onions and cheese, heat to a boil, stir in rice. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Cover and cook 25 minutes until chicken and rice are done and most liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally.

Dish Name: Canadian Bacon And Chicken Pasta Bake
Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, nonstick cooking spray, chicken breast, onion, garlic, green pepper, zucchini, tomatoes seasoned with basil garlic & oregano, tomato paste, crushed red pepper flakes, fat-free ricotta cheese, canadian bacon, light mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook pasta according to package directions without added fat or salt. Step 3: In a large skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray saut chicken, onion, garlic, green pepper for 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Add zucchini, tomatoes, tomato paste and red pepper. Step 5: Cover and simmer 10-15 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 6: In a prepared 9-x 13-inch baking dish layer pasta, ricotta cheese, canadian bacon and sauce. Step 7: Sprinkle with mozzarella and parmesan cheese. Step 8: Bake uncovered 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted and dish is warmed throughout.

Ingredient Names: cannelloni tubes, salt, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, fresh thyme, dry vermouth, kale, chicken broth, low-fat ricotta cheese, low fat cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper, ground nutmeg, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl combine chicken cubes, onion, thyme and vermouth. Step 2: Allow to marinate for at least 30 minutes In the meantime, in a large saucepan with 2 cups of water, add kale and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain and cover kale with cold water, set aside. Step 4: Strain the marinade into a large frying pan or skillet. Step 5: Set aside the chicken and onions. Step 6: Add chicken broth to the frying pan and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add chicken / onion to frying pan and poach until the chicken is no longer pink at the center, about 4 minutes With a slotted spoon, remove the chicken cubes to a food processor, reserving the poaching liquid.

Dish Name: Capellini Alla Campagnola Rustic Angel Hair Pasta Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, flour, baby portabella mushrooms, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, dry white wine, diced tomatoes, lemon, fresh basil, fresh oregano, fennel seed, capers, kosher salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 4-1 / 2-inch thickness between sheets of plastic wrap. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper, then dredge chicken in flour and shake off excess. Step 3: Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet and add chicken breasts, cooking over medium heat until golden on both sides and cooked through. Step 4: Drain chicken and set aside. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat boiling salted water in a pasta pot and cook angel hair pasta al dente, drain. Step 6: Heat remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil in another deep skillet and add mushrooms, garlic and red pepper. Step 7: Cook mushrooms until tender then add wine and cook for 3-5 minutes or until alcohol burns off. Step 8: Pour in tomatoes, lemon juice, basil, oregano, fennel, capers, salt and pepper. Step 9: Simmer over low heat for 15-20 minutes, adding tomato juice or broth if necessary.

Dish Name: Caprese Style Chicken Breasts And Mixed Pepper Medley
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, kosher salt, black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh lemon juice, roma tomatoes, fresh mozzarella cheese, basil, bell peppers, green olives, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat the oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a large, wide, oven proof skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add the garlic and chicken. Step 5: Cook the chicken for five minutes per side, turning once, or until golden. Step 6: Sprinkle the crushed red chili flakes over the chicken and squeeze the lemon juice over the top. Step 7: Top each piece of chicken with four roma tomato slices and of the shredded mozzarella. Step 8: Transfer to the oven and bake until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is golden. Step 9: Remove from the oven and top with fresh basil To make the mixed pepper medley:.

Ingredient Names: uncle ben herbed risotto rice, bacon, boneless chicken breasts, salt, pepper, garlic, heavy cream, baby peas, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package directions. Step 2: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp, remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Step 3: Season chicken with salt and pepper, brown on all sides in 2 tbls of the bacon drippings. Step 4: Add garlic and cream, simmer until cream begins to thicken. Step 5: Add peas and simmer until peas are heated through. Step 6: Reduce heat to low, add 3/4 of the cheese, stir until melted, add the remaining cheese if needed to thicken the sauce. Step 7: Serve over risotto, top with bacon and extra cheese if desired.

Dish Name: Carmela's Chicken Rigatoni Copycat Romano's Macaroni Grill
Ingredient Names: butter-flavored oil, mushrooms, grilled chicken, salt and pepper, basil, caramelized onion, cooking wine, heavy cream, rigatoni pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a hot saut pan add butter flavored oil, mushrooms, chicken, basil, caramelized onions, salt and pepper and saut for approximately 60 to 90 seconds. Step 2: Add the wine and saut for 60 seconds. Step 3: Add the heavy cream and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 4: Dip pre-cooked pasta in boiling water for 10 seconds, drain thoroughly. Step 5: Put pasta in saut pan and saut until well incorporated. Step 6: Toss briefly over fire, add parmesan cheese and continue to toss until cheese is completely incorporated. Step 7: Transfer to plate, garnish with parsley.

Ingredient Names: butter, prosciutto, shallots, garlic, fresh mushrooms, dry marsala wine, chicken stock, cornstarch, fresh parsley, heavy cream, salt, ground black pepper, dried oregano, dried thyme, dried parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter over low heat in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Turn heat up to medium high to saut the prosciutto in the melted butter for about 2 to 3 minutes Be careful not to burn butter, add shallots and mushrooms and saut for about 5 minutes until vegetables are tender then add the garlic and saute another 30 seconds. Step 3: Add marsala wine, simmer for another 30 seconds or so, then add black pepper. Step 4: Simmer over medium high heat for 5 minutes Dissolve corn starch in chicken stock. Step 5: Add stock to saucepan and simmer for an additional 5 minutes. Step 6: Add parsley and cream to the sauce and simmer 3 to 4 minutes or until thick. Step 7: Remove from heat, cover until needed. Step 8: Preheat barbecue grill on high heat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, sweet onions, green peppers, celery, carrots, potatoes, garlic cloves, chicken stock, boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomatoes, parsley, white pepper, black pepper, salt, ditalini
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stockpot heat olive oil under fairly low to medium heat "sweat" onion, celery, green pepper and some salt for perhaps 30 minutes -- this is lower than browning, and makes the veggies somewhat translucent I covered, and mixed every few minutes to prevent browning. Step 2: Add carrots, garlic, some white pepper and some black pepper, and continue to heat under "sweat" conditions while mixing now and then. Step 3: Add chicken stock, chicken breasts, tomatoes and potatoes -- and of course some more white pepper and black pepper. Step 4: Cover and simmer on low heat for 1 5 to 2 hours. Step 5: Remove chicken and let cool and stand to shred. Step 6: Add chopped parsley and return the shredded chicken to the soup Salt to taste at this point, and add more white and black pepper if your tongue is not twitching a bit when you sample.

Dish Name: Cheesy Chicken And Potatoes With Shallot Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, red potatoes, butter, garlic, shallot, flour, chicken broth, white wine, half-and-half, prepared yellow mustard, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Poach chicken breasts in chicken broth or seasoned water until cooked through, cool thoroughly and shred. Step 2: Place potato slices into salted, boiling water and cook until just tender. Step 3: Remove and place in the bottom of a greased casserole dish. Step 4: Top with shredded chicken. Step 5: In a saute pan, melt butter and cook garlic and shallot until soft. Step 6: Add flour and broth and whisk well. Step 7: Add wine and half and half, bring to a boil. Step 8: Add mustard and mayo and remove from heat. Step 9: Add cheese and stir till melted.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, butter, onion, frozen broccoli, cooked chicken, light cream, mozzarella cheese, sour cream, egg, instant chicken broth, pepper, flour, milk, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Cook shells as directed--don't overcook because they will cook in oven again. Step 3: Cool shells in a large bowl of cold water. Step 4: Set aside for now Saut onion in 2 tablespoons of butter until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Combine broccoli, onion, mozzarella cheese, sour cream, egg and chicken, set aside. Step 6: Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in saucepan. Step 7: Stir in flour, instant bouillon and pepper. Step 8: Stir in milk and cream.

Ingredient Names: chicken, reduced-fat chicken broth, angel hair pasta, onions, mushrooms, pimientos, bell peppers, spicy cheese soup, evaporated milk, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Grease 9 x 13 glass dish. Step 2: Bring chicken broth to boil, add can chicken, and pasta, cook till pasta done and most of the broth is absorbed, dO NOT DRAIN. Step 3: Pour into glass dish. Step 4: Sauté in butter, onion, bell pepper, pimentos, and sliced mushrooms till onions and mushrooms wilted. Step 5: Spread over chicken and pasta. Step 6: Mix with wire whisk over low heat cheese soup, evaporated milk, stirring till heated, then pour over vegetables covering top of casserole. Step 7: Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: virgin olive oil, onions, garlic, chicken broth, orzo pasta, parmigiano, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an 8-inch pot with a tight fitting cover over moderate heat. Step 2: Add oil, onion and garlic and saute for 2 or 3 minutes. Step 3: Add broth to the pan and bring to a boil. Step 4: Stir in orzo and return to boiling. Step 5: Cover pot and reduce heat to simmer. Step 6: Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until liquid is absorbed and orzo is tender. Step 7: Remove lid and stir in cheese. Step 8: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Cheesy Roasted Garlic And Tomato Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, head of garlic, cherry tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, basil leaves, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, balsamic vinegar, white wine, provolone cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Cut off the top of the head of garlic just until the cloves are exposed. Step 3: Drizzle with evoo and wrap in foil. Step 4: Put tomatoes on a baking sheet and drizzle with evoo and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes Roast tomatoes and garlic Roast tomatoes about 20 minutes, until they burst and roast garlic about 40-45 minutes until tender and golden brown While the tomatoes and garlic are roasting, season chicken breast with salt and pepper and drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Step 5: Let the chicken marinate until the tomatoes and garlic are done. Step 6: Preheat a large skillet and about 2 tb evoo over medium high heat. Step 7: Cook chicken about 8 minutes on each side, until browned.

Dish Name: Chef Boy I Be Illinois Baked Chicken Parmesan
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, reduced-fat sour cream, dijon mustard, worcestershire sauce, anchovy paste, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dry breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, dried oregano, olive oil flavored cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Whisk together the sour cream, dijon, worcestershire sauce and anchovy paste in a wide, shallow bowl The mixture will be quite thick, but that helps it adhere to the chicken and for the crumbs to adhere as well. Step 3: Combine breadcrumbs, cheese, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, pepper, and oregano in another wide shallow bowl. Step 4: Season both sides of breasts with remaining salt and pepper Coat both sides of each breast first in the sour cream mixture, then in the bread crumb mixture.
