Step 5: Place on a wire rack that is over a foil lined baking sheet that will accommodate the size of your rack Spray both sides of each breast with olive oil cooking spray. Step 6: Bake for 30 minutes at 450f until coating is nicely browned, then turn down to 400f and continue baking for approximately 30 minutes until a meat thermometer registers 165f You can use the time your chicken is baking to make some polenta to go along with it, and maybe some nice cauliflower gratin recipe #360354.

Dish Name: Chef Boy I Be Illinois Pesto Chicken Bundles
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, boursin cheese, pesto sauce, tomato sauce, sliced mushrooms, dry white wine, dry oregano, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 4 inch thickness. Step 2: Combine cream cheese and pesto. Step 3: Spread cream cheese mixture on chicken breasts. Step 4: Roll chicken breasts up lengthwise, tucking in the ends and secure with toothpicks Salt and pepper to taste, roll in flour Brown chicken breasts on all sides Deglaze pan with the wine, add tomato sauce, oregano and mushrooms. Step 5: Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes until chicken bundles are cooked through Some of the cream cheese mixture will melt and drip out of bundles, making the sauce very rich.

Ingredient Names: olive oil flavored cooking spray, chicken schnitzels, pasta sauce, cheese, dried parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Spray olive oil on a heated non-stick pan. Step 2: Place chicken on pan and panfry the pre-made chicken schnitzels until both sides are golden brown. Step 3: Once it is cooked place the cooked chicken schnitzel into an greased ovenproof dish and repeat steps until all the schnitzels are cooked. Step 4: Spread your favourite pasta sauce individually on to the chicken. Step 5: Then sprinkle your chosen cheese on the chicken to cover the top of the chicken. Step 6: Garnish it lightly it with a sprinkle of dried or fresh parsley. Step 7: Bake at 160 degrees celsius uncovered until cheese is melted and lightly browned. Step 8: Serve with a green salad or seasonal vegetables and garlic bread.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken, streaky bacon, onions, rosemary, plum tomatoes, red, sugar, chicken stock, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large casserole dish. Brown the chicken, a few pieces at a time, until skin is golden on all sides. As each piece is done, lift out onto a plate. Turn the heat down and add the bacon. Cook gently so some of the fat melts into the pan and keep going until the bacon crisps. Lift out with a slotted spoon and put with the chicken pieces, then add the onions and rosemary to the casserole. Fry for 5-10 mins until the onions have softened, then return the chicken and bacon, along with the tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, stock and seasoning. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 40-50 mins until the chicken is tender – check one of the thigh or leg joints as they will take longer to cook. Stir in the parsley, if using, check the seasoning again and serve with mash, pasta or rice if eating straight away. Otherwise, cool and chill for up to 24 hrs. Or freeze for up to 3 months. Defrost overnight in the fridge, then bring out to room temperature the next day if not fully defrosted. Tip back into a saucepan, bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and gently cook until chicken is piping hot. Don’t boil or the chicken may toughen up.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, tagliatelle, broad beans, reduced-fat creme fraiche, lemons, parmesan, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Put the chicken onto a roasting tray, coat with the oil, season, then grill for about 12 mins, turning halfway through the cooking time. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the pasta, adding the beans for the final 3 mins, then drain, reserving 150ml of the cooking water. Step 3: Shred the cooked chicken and put into the pasta pan with the crème fraîche, lemon juice, 4 tbsp Parmesan and the reserved cooking water. Heat gently, season to taste, then stir in the parsley and pasta. Serve sprinkled with the remaining Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: pasta shapes, green beans, olive oil, green onions, ready-roasted chicken breasts, pesto, cream, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta following pack instructions, adding green beans for the final 6 mins of cooking time. Drain and reserve a few tbsps of the cooking water. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large frying pan. Add spring onions and cook for 1-2 mins until soft, then set aside. Step 3: Add the shredded chicken in the pan and heat through. Stir through pesto and cream. Pop pasta and beans in with the chicken mix and stir to coat, adding a little of the cooking water. Season and sprinkle with Parmesan.

Dish Name: Chicken (or mushroom or tofu) tortellini filling
Ingredient Names: butter, chicken breast fillets, pancetta, parmesan cheese, nutmeg, eggs, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter in a frying pan, add chicken (or tofu or mushrooms or whatever) until golden brown, then drain. Step 2: Process this in food processor (along with the pancetta, if you choose to include it) until finely chopped. Step 3: Transfer to bowl and add cheese, nutmeg, egg and salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Fill pasta and seal edges with egg whites (use a pastry brush to apply this, or your impeccably clean hands).

Dish Name: Chicken Agrodolce An Italian Sweet And Sour Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, olive oil, garlic, bay leaves, allspice berries, honey, balsamic vinegar, dry white wine, orange juice, lemon juice, salt and pepper, cayenne pepper, pignolis
Instructions: Step 1: In a large plastic bag, combine flour and chicken breasts, toss to coat. Step 2: In a large skillet, saute floured chicken breasts in olive oil with the whole garlic, bay leaves and allspice berries until chicken is browned. Step 3: Remove chicken to a plate To the skillet, add honey, vinegar and wine. Step 4: Cook to reduce slightly, about 10 minutes on medium-high heat. Step 5: Return chicken to skillet, add orange and lemon juices, salt and pepper, and cook about another 20 minutes or until chicken is done and sauce is reduced slightly. Step 6: Remove garlic, bay leaves and allspice berries from sauce. Step 7: Add pignoli and heat through, another 5 minutes or so Delicious with angel hair pasta or a nice risotto.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, spinach, wine, linguine, cornstarch, chicken broth, butter, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: I usually cut chicken into thinner pieces first, they cook faster. Step 2: Cook linguini, drain, set to side Sautee chicken I use butter, and oil together, just enought oil to barley cover the bottom of pan During sauteing, i add some wine, for flavor set cooked chicken aside. Step 3: Cook spinach, drain, set aside. Step 4: Put chick, broth in lq pot, bring to boil, reduce heat, add some wine, use some corn starch to make this broth thicker, like a real thin gravy, arrange plate. Step 5: Put some linguini first, add some spinach, then top off with chicken -- the idea is to make it pleasing to look at. Step 6: Spoon some thickend broth on top of layered linguini, spinach and chicken.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, alfredo sauce, chicken, oregano, garlic salt, mozzarella cheese, butter, cream cheese, heavy cream, garlic powder, garlic, salt & freshly ground black pepper, dried oregano, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: To make the garlic alfredo sauce: in a medium to large saucepan melt the butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add fresh minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Step 3: Add the cream cheese and whisk to smooth and melted. Step 4: Whisk in the heavy cream. Step 5: Season with the garlic powder, salt and pepper. Step 6: Bring to a simmer and whisk frequently until sauce thickens, around 15 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the cheese and when melted, remove from heat Makes 2 1 / 2 cups To assemble: spray an 8x8 pan with non-stick spray and pour 1 / 2 cup alfredo sauce, or just enough to cover the bottom of the pan. Step 8: Boil 8-10 cups water in a large pot, cook lasagne noodles until al dente.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, chicken breast, seasoned salt, pepper, butternut squash, broccoli, mushrooms, red pepper, onion, garlic, red pepper flakes, white wine, milk, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, bowtie pasta, kosher salt, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Season both sides of each chicken breast with seasoned salt and a pinch of pepper. Step 3: Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Step 4: While the chicken is cooking, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 5: Season the boiling water with a few generous pinches of kosher salt. Step 6: Add the pasta and give it a stir. Step 7: Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, about 8-10 minutes. Step 8: Reserve pasta water before draining the pasta. Step 9: Remove the chicken from the pan and transfer it to a cutting board; allow it to rest. Step 10: Turn the heat down to medium and dd the remaining butter and olive oil to the same pan you used to cook the chicken. Step 11: Add the veggies (minus the garlic) and red pepper flakes to the pan and stir to coat with the oil and butter (refrain from seasoning with salt until the veggies are finished browning). Step 12: Cook, stirring often, until the veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 13: Add the garlic and a generous pinch of salt and pepper to the pan and cook for 5 minutes. Step 14: Deglaze the pan with the white wine. Step 15: Continue to cook until the wine has reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 16: Stir in the milk, heavy cream, and reserved pasta water. Step 17: Bring the mixture to a gentle boil and allow to simmer and reduce for 15-20 minutes. Step 18: Turn off the heat and add the Parmesan cheese and cooked pasta. Step 19: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 20: Garnish with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley, if desired.

Dish Name: Chicken Alfredo With Mushrooms And Asparagus
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, fresh mushrooms, onion, garlic clove, dried marjoram, dried thyme, fresh ground black pepper, chicken breast, alfredo sauce, dry white wine, frozen asparagus cuts, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large, heavy skillet over moderate heat 2 minutes. Step 2: Add mushrooms, onion, garlic, marjoram, thyme, and pepper and cook, stirring often, until the juice released from the mushrooms evaporates, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken, alfredo sauce, and wine Adjust heat so mixture bubbles gently, then cook, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add asparagus, cover and cook just until crisp-tender, 2-3 minutes No longer or asparagus will become mushy. Step 5: Serve over hot fettuccini, with fresh grated parmesan on top.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken legs, salt, onion, olive, plum tomatoes, capers, chicken broth, dried rosemary, fresh lemon juice, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet over med -high heat until very hot. Step 2: Add chicken pieces and salt and cook until chicken is golden brown on all sides, transferring chicken to a plate as it browns. Step 3: Add onion to skillet and cook until golden, stirring frequently. Step 4: Stir in olives, tomatoes, capers, chicken broth, rosemary, lemon juice, and 1 / 3 cup water. Step 5: Return chicken to skillet and bring to boiling over high heat. Step 6: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes. Step 7: Spoon olive mixture over chicken and stir occasionally while chicken is cooking Chicken is done when juices run clear when pieces are pierces with a knife To serve, arrange chicken on a platter, spoon olive mixture over chicken, and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, butter, chicken, all-purpose flour, onion, mushroom, garlic cloves, oregano, basil, rosemary, whole tomatoes, salt and pepper, madeira wine, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the artichoke hearts, reserving the marinade. Step 2: Set artichokes aside. Step 3: Place the marinade and butter in a large skillet. Step 4: Cook over low heat for 10 minutes Dredge the chicken in flour Brown the chicken in the butter mixture over medium-high heat. Step 5: Transfer the chicken to a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish, reserving the butter mixture in the skillet. Step 6: Saute the onion, mushrooms, garlic, oregano, basil, and rosemary in the reserved butter mixture until the vegetables are tender. Step 7: Stir in the reserved artichokes, tomatoes, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 8: Pour the tomato mixture over the chicken.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breast, garlic cloves, onion, white wine, salt and pepper, red pepper flakes, artichokes, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, corkscrew macaroni
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to directions. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large skillet on medium-high. Step 3: Add onions, cook 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken and cook 2-3 minutes, until browned. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook another minute. Step 6: Add wine, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, and artichokes. Step 7: Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook about 5-8 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through The sauce will thicken a bit as it cooks. Step 8: Turn the heat off and stir in the cheese and basil. Step 9: Serve over the cooked pasta or toss it all together if you'd rather.

Dish Name: Chicken And Broccoli Alfredo Or Asparagus
Ingredient Names: pasta, broccoli, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt and pepper, garlic clove, red bell pepper, sun-dried tomato, whipping cream, parmesan cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Season with salt and pepper the chicken breasts strips. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and saute chicken strips in batches until cooked through and golden. Step 3: Transfer chicken to bowl and keep warm. Step 4: Add sliced minced garlic and red bell pepper to skillet and saut until tender. Step 5: Reduce heat to low. Step 6: Add cream, 1 cup parmesan cheese and all of monterey jack cheese. Step 7: Simmer until sauce thickens slightly. Step 8: Add chicken strips and any juices in bowl to sauce. Step 9: Stir in sun-dried tomatoes, and steamed broccoli florets and warm through. Step 10: Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour, milk, chicken broth, eggs, parmesan cheese, lasagna noodle, onion, garlic, chicken, broccoli, parsley, mozzarella cheese, salt, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: melt butter, stir in flour. Step 2: Add milk, whisk until smooth, stir in broth. Step 3: Cook, stirring constantly, until thick. Step 4: Beat eggs in separate bowl, add small amount of sauce. Step 5: Then combine egg mix with all sauce. Step 6: Stir in cheese and seasonings, cook noodles. Step 7: Saute chicken in butter with onion and garlic. Step 8: Stir in broccoli, cook 5 min.

Dish Name: Chicken And Broccoli Salad With Gorgonzola Dressing
Ingredient Names: broccoli florets, farfalle pasta, boneless chicken breasts, gorgonzola, white wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, fresh sage, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook broccoli in a large pot of boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Step 2: Remove to a colander using a slotted spoon, rinse with cold water, drain and dry on paper towels. Step 3: Bring the cooking water back to a boil and cook the pasta according to package directions, drain in a colander and rinse with cold water. Step 4: In a large bowl, whisk together the mashed cheese, vinegar, oil, and sage, season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Add pasta, chicken and broccoli, toss to combine.

Dish Name: Chicken And Capers In Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: whole chicken, flour, seasoning salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, button mushroom, green bell peppers, onion, fresh garlic, dried oregano, crushed red pepper flakes, marinara sauce, chicken broth, dry red wine, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken pieces with seasoning salt and pepper. Step 2: Place the flour in a heavy plastic bag. Step 3: Add in chicken pieces and coat completely with flour. Step 4: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet or dutch oven over medium heat. Step 5: Add in the chicken pieces to the skillet and brown for about 4 minutes on each side. Step 6: Transfer to a plate. Step 7: Pour off some of the fat, and leave a little in the skillet. Step 8: Add in mushrooms, green bell peppers, chopped garlic, onion, crushed red pepper flakes and oregano. Step 9: Saute until onion is tender. Step 10: Add / mix in marinara sauce, chicken broth, wine and capers.

Ingredient Names: chunky tomato pasta sauce, ground chicken, ricotta cheese, chicken stock powder, garlic clove, fresh herb, cannelloni tubes, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, cheddar cheese, cracked pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180c Lightly grease a deep rectangular baking dish. Step 2: Spoon pasta sauce into the baking dish and set aside. Step 3: Place chicken, garlic, ricotta, stock powder and herbs into a bowl and mix well. Step 4: Spoon or pipe the chicken mixture into the cannelloni tubes and place in a single layer over the pasta sauce. Step 5: Melt butter in a small pan. Step 6: Add the flour and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Remove from heat and gradually add the milk. Step 8: Return to heat and cook for 3- 4 minutes, or until thick and smooth. Step 9: Stir in half the cheese.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, egg, egg white, water, plain breadcrumbs, parsley, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, chicken breasts, olive oil, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees, spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Step 2: In a pie plate, whisk together the egg, egg white and water. Step 3: In a second pie plate stir together the bread crumbs, parsley, cheese and italian seasoning. Step 4: Dip the cut eggplant in the egg wash and then in bread crumbs, place on prepared baking sheet and lightly spray with cooking spray. Step 5: Place in preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes, turn and spray second side lightly with cooking spray. Step 6: Return to oven and bake and additional 10 minutes or until done While eggplant slices are baking, place the chicken breasts in a resealable bag with a teaspoon of water Pound with a meat mallet to 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 7: Dip the chicken into the remaining egg wash and then in bread crumbs. Step 8: Allow crumb mixture to set for a few minutes while oil heats.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, onion, carrot, celery, garlic cloves, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, bay leaf, chicken broth, gnocchi, spinach leaves, lemon rind, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Fry the chicken, onion, carrot, celery, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper and bay leaf, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken broth and 1-1 / 2 cups water, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce the heat to medium. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, add the gnocchi. Step 6: Simmer, uncovered, until the gnocchi float to the top and are firm to the touch, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Discard the bay leaf To make the gremolata, combine in a bowl the spinach, lemon rind and juice, oil and garlic.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, fresh ground black pepper, flour, mushrooms, marsala wine, low sodium chicken broth, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large, non-stick skillet While the oil is heating, season the chicken with salt and pepper and dredge it in flour Saut the chicken over medium-high heat until golden brown, about 2 minutes on each side. Step 2: Remove the chicken to a platter and keep warm. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender. Step 4: Add the wine, stir with a wooden spoon to release any caramelized bits that may be stuck to the pan and cook until the wine is almost completely evaporated. Step 5: Add the chicken broth, chicken and any juices that have accumulated on the platter. Step 6: Simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Remove the chicken to a clean serving platter and keep warm. Step 8: Simmer the broth mixture until it has reduced by half, about 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken And Mushroom Pasta Bake Spaghetti Tetrazzini
Ingredient Names: dried porcini mushrooms, olive oil, chicken thighs, salt & freshly ground black pepper, garlic cloves, fresh mushrooms, white wine, spaghetti, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f. Step 2: Put your porcini mushrooms in a bowl and pour over just enough boiling water to cover them. Step 3: Put to one side to soak for a few minutes. Step 4: Heat a saucepan big enough to hold all the ingredients, and pour in a splash of olive oil. Step 5: Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper and brown them gently in the oil. Step 6: Strain the porcini, reserving the soaking water, and add them to the pan with the garlic and fresh mushrooms. Step 7: Add the wine, with the strained porcini soaking water, and turn the heat down. Step 8: Simmer gently until the chicken pieces are cooked through and the wine has reduced a little. Step 9: Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in plenty of boiling salted water according to the packet instructions and drain well. Step 10: Add the cream to the pan of chicken, then bring to the boil and turn the heat off.

Dish Name: Chicken And Pasta In White Wine Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, water, dry white wine, diced tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, sliced mushrooms, white onion, oregano, thyme, rosemary, basil, bay leaf, garlic, linguine, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces. Step 2: Combine chicken in large skillet with water, olive oil, mushrooms, onion, garlic, and spices. Step 3: Cook until onion is tender. Step 4: Add tomatoes, wine, salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer about 15 minutes while preparing pasta, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Drain pasta al dente, place into serving dish and toss with olive oil. Step 7: Pour chicken mixture over pasta. Step 8: Serve with fresh salad and garlic toast I am very generous with my spices when i make this dish and usually add more than the recipe calls for 5 minutes, but it is quite delicious as written.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, potato, onion, pesto sauce, italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 tbsp pesto with potatoes and onions. Step 2: Place into casserole dish. Step 3: Top with chicken Evenly rub 1 tbsp pesto on top of the chicken breasts. Step 4: Season with salt, pepper, garlic and italian seasonings, top with cheese. Step 5: Bake at 400f for 40 minutes If the cheese begins to brown too fast, loosely cover w / foil then remove foil during the last 5-10 minutes. Step 6: Serve with garlic bread and a salad Enjoy!

Dish Name: Chicken And Roasted Red Bell Pepper Ciabatta Pizzas
Ingredient Names: ciabatta, red bell peppers, olive oil, pizza sauce, sun-dried tomato paste, cooked chicken breast, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f or 180c. Step 2: Remove the tops and seeds from the red bell peppers and cut the flesh into strips. Step 3: Put the peppers on a baking tray, drizzle over the olive oil and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, until soft and slightly blackened around the edges. Step 4: Meanwhile, prepare the rest of the pizzas- cut the ciabatta loaf in half and then halve again lengthwise You should now have four bases to work with. Step 5: Mix the pizza sauce with the sundried tomato paste and spread evenly over the ciabatta bases Share 1 / 2 cup of the mozzarella cheese between the bases. Step 6: Top with the chicken and, when cooked, the red peppers. Step 7: Top with the remaining cheese. Step 8: Bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes, until warmed through and the cheese has completely melted.

Ingredient Names: rotelle pasta, chicken breast, raw shrimp, flour, salt, pepper, paprika, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, fresh basil, chicken broth, white wine, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rotelli pasta according to box directions. Step 2: Slice chicken in thin chunks. Step 3: Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika on a plate Dredge chicken in flour mixture. Step 4: In a large frying pan, heat oil and brown chicken, 2 minutes each side. Step 5: Set chicken aside on a platter Into the same frying pan that you cooked the chicken, sautee onion and garlic until onion is transluscent, about 4 minutes. Step 6: Add tomatoes and basil. Step 7: Cook another minute. Step 8: Add chicken broth, wine and cream.

Ingredient Names: salad oil, boneless chicken breast, green onion, roasted red peppers, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro leaves, whole tomatoes, red pepper flakes, green pepper, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, over medium-high heat, heat salad oil, add Chicken. Step 2: Cook with 1 / 2 cup green onion 5 minutes, or until chicken is lightly Browned. Step 3: Meanwhile, in food processor, puree red peppers, garlic, and cilantro. Step 4: Add puree, tomatoes and pepper flakes to chicken, bring to boiling. Step 5: Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes or until thickened, add green pepper.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless chicken breast, onion, green pepper, water, tomatoes with garlic, tomato sauce, cheese-filled egg tortellini
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in frying pan over med high heat. Step 2: Add chicken, onion, and peppers, cook and stir until chicken is browned. Step 3: Add water, tomatoes, and tomato sauce and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add tortellini, making sure that tomato mixture covers it completely. Step 5: Cook 15 to 20 minutes until sauce is thickened and chicken is cooked through. Step 6: Stir frequently during cooking.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, carrots, peas, garlic, onion, celery, chicken broth, tortellini, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil chicken until done remove bones cut into chunks. Step 2: Add broth to chicken& broth from cooked chicken. Step 3: Slice carrots, celery, onion& garlic add to broth& cook till done. Step 4: Add peas& tortellini's cook until tortellini's are done Salt& pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, ground black pepper, olive oil, butter, wild mushrooms, garlic cloves, shallots, dry white wine, heavy whipping cream, fresh thyme, lemon zest, swiss cheese, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with 1 / 2 t salt and 1 / 2 t pepper In large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chicken, and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 4 minutes, or until chicken is browned and cooked through. Step 3: Remove chicken from pan. Step 4: Set aside, and keep warm. Step 5: Add butter to skillet, and melt over medium heat. Step 6: Add mushrooms, garlic, and shallots. Step 7: Cook for 4-5 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender, add wine. Step 8: Cook for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, flour, mushrooms, sun-dried tomato, garlic, white wine, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil, salt, granulated garlic, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 Dredge chicken breast in flour, then heat the oil in a heatproof aluminum saute' pan Brown chicken breasts for 2 minutes on one side, then turn. Step 2: Add mushrooms and garlic and saute' for one-and-a-half minutes. Step 3: Add pinch of flour. Step 4: Mix well and add white wine, sun-dried tomatoes and seasonings. Step 5: Let sauce thicken and reduce. Step 6: Top with parmesan cheese. Step 7: Bake in the pan for 10 minutes at 375. Step 8: Serve with your choice of fresh vegetable and a side of pasta.

Ingredient Names: italian bread, basil pesto, prosciutto, artichoke hearts, roasted red peppers, cooked chicken, provolone cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f Lightly spread pesto on one side of each bread slice. Step 2: Top slices with prosciutto, artichoke slices, red pepper strips, and chicken strips. Step 3: Place sandwiches on a large foil lined cookie sheet. Step 4: Cover loosely with foil. Step 5: Bake about 8 minutes or till nearly heated through. Step 6: Uncover sandwiches and sprinkle with cheese. Step 7: Bake 4 to 5 minutes more or till cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: egg, water, dry breadcrumbs, dried basil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, prosciutto ham, asiago cheese, nonstick cooking spray, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f Coat an 8 x 8 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: In a shallow bowl, beat egg with just enough water to thin it a little, set aside. Step 3: Place bread crumbs in another shallow bowl, and stir in dried basil, set aside. Step 4: Place 1 chicken breast between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a mallet until about 1 / 4 inch thick, being careful not to pound holes in chicken. Step 5: Repeat with 2nd breast. Step 6: Remove plastic wrap and place 1 slice of ham on each breast. Step 7: Place one piece of cheese on the narrow end of each breast.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, fresh ground pepper, dry oregano leaves, garlic salt, boneless skinless chicken breast, extra virgin olive oil, scallion, sliced mushrooms, spaghetti sauce, pimento stuffed olive, asiago cheese, wide egg noodles, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix together the flour, pepper, oregano, garlic salt in a baggie. Step 3: Cut the chicken into one bite chunks and toss them in the flour mix. Step 4: Heat the two oils in a skillet and saute the vegetables. Step 5: Remove them and add the chicken, lightly browning it. Step 6: Drain the chicken on paper towels Into a medium baking dish, pour half the spaghetti sauce, topping it with the chicken chunks, vegetables, olives then the rest of the sauce. Step 7: Sprinkle on the cheese and put in the oven. Step 8: Cook the egg noodles in water with salt according to package directions, then drain and toss with olive oil. Step 9: Heat the chicken / cheese dish only until the cheese melts, about 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pepper, flour, butter, cooking oil, prosciutto, fontina cheese, parmesan cheese, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with pepper Dredge in flour and shake off excess. Step 2: Melt butter with the oil in a heavy skillet Brown the chicken 2 minutes per side til light golden. Step 3: Transfer to a buttered 8 in square pan. Step 4: Place slice of prosciutto and fontina cheese on each piece of chicken. Step 5: Sprinkle with parmesan and drizzle with broth over each piece. Step 6: Bake uncovered at 350 for 10-20 minutes, til cheese in melted and lightly browned and chicken is no longer pink. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, ground chicken, salt, fresh ground black pepper, white onion, carrots, celery rib, garlic cloves, tomato paste, dry white wine, tomatoes, chicken broth, fresh oregano, fresh thyme, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add 1 t Of the olive oil, heat 1 minute, add the chicken. Step 3: Cook, stirring and breaking up pieces, until lightly browned, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Season with 1 / 2 teaspoons of the salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Transfer chicken with a slotted spoon to a colander to drain, set aside. Step 6: Heat the remaining 2 t.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, boneless chicken breasts, salt, black pepper, olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, pasta sauce, heavy whipping cream, fresh basil, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f start cooking pasta according to directions and drain While pasta is cooking -- Cut chicken into strips, bites, or pieces. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add the chicken to skillet and cook until no longer pink, about 6 minutes. Step 5: Remove chicken from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 6: Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until onion is softened stir in pasta sauce and increase heat to high. Step 7: Bring sauce to a boil, reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the chicken, cream and basil to the skillet and mix well.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, asparagus, chicken breast, parmesan cheese, dried parsley, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta according to directions on package. Step 2: Add asparagus one or two minutes before fully cooked, drain. Step 3: Place pasta, asparagus and chicken in a 13"x9" baking pan. Step 4: Mix in remaining ingredients Broil for 5 minutes or until top is crispy.

Ingredient Names: pine nuts, pecorino romano cheese, nutmeg, chicken legs, salt and pepper, fresh tomatoes, black olives, capers, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, hot red pepper flakes, dried currants
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 f. Step 2: In a mixing bowl combine 1 cup of the pine nuts, the pecorino, and nutmeg. Step 3: Place the chicken legs skin side down on a cutting board and season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Divide the pine nut mixture among the chicken legs, filling them as full as possible. Step 5: Fold the meat up and around the mixture and tie tightly with butchers twine. Step 6: Place the legs in a small roasting pan, flap side down Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, or until browned and crispy and cooked through. Step 7: Remove from oven and allow to cool. Step 8: In a medium bowl, mix the chopped tomatoes, olives, capers, olive oil, vinegar, red pepper flakes, and currants. Step 9: Place 1 piece of chicken on each plate and spoon some over each piece of chicken and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flour, butter, sliced mushrooms, marsala wine, chicken broth, fontina, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken between 2 sheets wax paper Flatten to 1 / 4 inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin Dredge chicken lightly in flour. Step 2: Place 4 pieces at a time in 2 tbs of melted butter in a large skillet. Step 3: Cook over low heat 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Step 4: Place chicken in a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking pan, overlapping edges. Step 5: Repeat procedure with remaining chicken, adding 2 tbs Butter, reserve remaining drippings Saut mushrooms in the remaining 1 / 4 cup butter. Step 6: Sprinkle evenly over chicken.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast Stuffed With Spinach And Ricotta
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, sugar, water, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, frozen chopped spinach, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, salt and pepper, dried red pepper flakes, garlic powder, flour, egg whites, whole milk, seasoned bread crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the salt and sugar with water, soak pounded chicken breasts for about an hour. Step 2: Drain, dry and lay flat between sheets of parchment While the chicken is brining prepare the filling by mixing all the filling ingredients in a bowl and seasoning to taste. Step 3: Heat your oven to 325 degress f. Step 4: Prepare a sheet pan with a large cooling rack on top Lay out a large piece of parchment or wax paper, cut 12 pieces of butchers twine about 8" long. Step 5: Place a heavy pan or cast iron skillet over medium / medium high heat, add two tablespoons of oil The oil should be just below the smoke point Have a splatter guard nearby! Step 6: Wisk milk and egg in bowl then pour into a deep plate.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast With Basil Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillets, unsalted butter, green onions, dry white wine, light cream, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cover each chicken breast with plastic wrap and lightly flatten with a rolling pin. Step 2: Season well with freshly ground pepper. Step 3: Melt butter in a large frying pan on medium. Step 4: Cook chicken breasts for 3 minutes each side, until golden and almost cooked through. Step 5: Remove to a platter and keep warm. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and add onion. Step 7: Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until soft Increase heat to medium and add wine. Step 8: Simmer for 1 minute, stir in cream.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast With Prosciutto and Quince Paste(Improved Version
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, balsamic vinegar, sugar, chili powder, salt, pepper, chicken breast fillets, fennel seeds, quince paste, prosciutto, dry white wine, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a heavy pan, and cook the onion for about 20 minutes or until well softened and golden brown. Step 2: Add the balsamic vinegar, sugar, chili powder and season with salt and pepper; cook for a further 5 minutes or until caremelised. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 475f. Step 4: Place half a teaspoon of fennel seeds and half a tablespoon of quince paste on each chicken fillet. Step 5: Wrap 2 prosciutto slices around each fillet, tucking underneath. Step 6: Pour the wine over the onions, place the wrapped fillets on top of them, then tuck a bay leaf under each. Step 7: Bake for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast With Red Pepper Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, red bell peppers, heavy cream, salt & freshly ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, dry white wine, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium heat, warm 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Step 2: Add the bell peppers and 1 / 2 cup of water, and bring to a simmer. Step 3: Cook for 10 minutes, or until peppers are tender. Step 4: Transfer to a blender or food processor, and add the cream. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper, and puree until smooth. Step 6: Keep warm In another skillet warm the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 7: Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper, and add them to the skillet. Step 8: Saute until golden, add the wine and cook for 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through. Step 9: Spoon the pepper sauce onto a serving platter, and top with the chicken.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast With Rosemary Fontina And Prosciutto
Ingredient Names: fresh rosemary, skinless chicken breasts, prosciutto ham, fontina cheese, butter, olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, plain flour, dry white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the needles from the rosemary and chop finely. Step 2: Take the bare woody rosemary stem and sharpen the thickest point to create a skewer Flatten the chicken slightly with a meat mallet or rolling pin, then season with salt and freshly ground black pepper and sprinkle with the chopped rosemary needles. Step 3: Place one slice of fontina on top of each chicken piece, followed by the prosciutto Secure the stack with the rosemary branch as you would with a skewer or wooden toothpick. Step 4: Dust the bare side of the chicken with plain flour and shake off any excess. Step 5: Heat the butter and olive oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Step 6: When the butter is foaming add the chicken, flesh-side down first and cook on a medium heat for about two to four minutes, or until golden-brown, then turn the breast over and cook for one minute on the prosciutto side, until golden. Step 7: Turn the chicken breast over again and add the wine to the pan. Step 8: Heat to boil and reduce the liquid until almost entirely evaporated.

Dish Name: Chicken Breasts In Aeolian Island Aromatics
Ingredient Names: olive oil, scallion, shallots, fresh mint leaves, fennel seed, ground ginger, orange juice, lemon juice, dry sherry, sugar, boneless skinless chicken breasts, orange zest, lemon zest, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a small saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add scallions, shallots and half of the mint. Step 4: Saute for 2 or 3 minutes until the shallots and scallions are softened, not browned. Step 5: Stir the fennel, ginger into the sauce pan. Step 6: Pour in the orange juice, lemon juice and sherry and 1 teaspoon sugar. Step 7: Bring to a boil, lower heat to a soft simmer and cook uncovered until the sauce is reduced in half -- about 10 minutes. Step 8: Place the chicken breasts on a cutting board and butterfly each breast cutting horizontally without separating the pieces Open each breast and massage in a quarter of the the lemon and orange zests. Step 9: Season with salt and white pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Chicken Breasts In Sun Dried Tomato Cream
Ingredient Names: butter, garlic cloves, all-purpose flour, chicken broth, heavy cream, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, oil, dried thyme, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, sliced mushrooms, boneless skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sun-dried tomato oil over medium-high heat Saut chicken in oil 8 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked though. Step 2: Transfer to a plate To skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add mushrooms and saute until they are lightly browned and have released most of their liquid. Step 4: Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Step 5: Stir in flour and cook 1 minute. Step 6: Stir in broth, cream, tomatoes, thyme, salt, pepper flakes and mushrooms. Step 7: Bring to boil and cook 1 minute. Step 8: Add chicken just to heat through.

Ingredient Names: fresh mushrooms, butter, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flour, marsala, chicken broth, salt, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cook mushrooms in 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet, stirring constantly, just until tender, remove from heat, set aside. Step 2: Cut each chicken breast half in half lengthwise. Step 3: Place each piece of chicken between two sheets of wax paper Flatten to 1 / 8" thickness, using a meat mallet or rolling pin Dredge chicken pieces in flour. Step 4: Place 5 or 6 pieces of chicken in 1 to 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Step 5: Cook over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until golden. Step 6: Place chicken in a lightly greased 13x9" baking dish, overlapping edges.

Dish Name: Chicken Breasts Over Rigatoni With Gorgonzola Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt & freshly ground black pepper, onion, heavy cream, fresh sage leaves, fresh parsley, rigatoni pasta, salt and pepper, dry white wine, gorgonzola, fresh parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken marinade: lightly pound each chicken breast between 2 pieces of plastic wrap. Step 2: In a non-reactive dish, combine the lemon juice, 1 tablespoon of the oil and 1 teaspoon of the garlic and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Marinate, covered and refrigerated, for not more than 2 hours For the sauce: in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Step 4: Add the onion and remaining teaspoon of garlic and cook stirring, over low heat, for 5 minutes or until the onion is tender. Step 5: Add the cream and bring to a simmer, add the sage and parsley and remove from the heat. Step 6: Set aside The chicken: remove the chicken from the marinade and pat dry. Step 7: Dip the chicken lightly in the seasoned flour on both sides. Step 8: In a 12-inch skillet over medium heat, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil and cook the chicken for about 5 minutes per side or until completely cooked through.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, ham slices, swiss cheese, all-purpose flour, parmesan cheese, salt, dried sage, pepper, vegetable oil, condensed cream of chicken soup, dry white wine, cornstarch, water, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breast halves until thin between two sheets of waxed paper or foil. Step 2: Place a slice of ham and cheese on each chicken piece. Step 3: Roll up and tuck ends in Secure with small skewers or wooden picks. Step 4: Combine flour, parmesan cheese, salt, sage and pepper in a shallow bowl Coat chicken rolls in flour mixture. Step 5: Refrigerate chicken at least 1 hour. Step 6: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 7: Add chicken rolls and cook, turning, until browned on all sides. Step 8: Place browned chicken in a slow cooker.

Dish Name: Chicken Breasts Stuffed With Spinach And Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, toothpick, frozen chopped spinach, butter, mushroom caps, garlic cloves, shallot, salt and pepper, part-skim ricotta cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, ground nutmeg, extra virgin olive oil, flour, white wine, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: You will also need: large plastic food storage bags or waxed paper. Step 2: Place breasts in the center of a plastic food storage bag or between 2 sheets of waxed paper Pound out the chicken from the center of the bag outward with a mallet or a heavy skillet Be firm and controlled with your strokes Defrost spinach in the microwave. Step 3: Transfer spinach to a kitchen or a piece of cheese cloth Twist towel around spinach and wring it out until the spinach is very dry. Step 4: Transfer the spinach to a medium size mixing bowl. Step 5: Place a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 6: When skillet is hot, add the butter, mushrooms, garlic and shallot.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, seasoned bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, egg, shallot, olive oil, portabella mushrooms, parsley, black pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f. Step 2: Mix together bread crumbs and parmesan cheese in a shallow dish. Step 3: In a small bowl, beat egg. Step 4: Dip chicken in egg and then breadcrumb mixture. Step 5: Place chicken in baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Step 6: Heat olive oil over medium high heat in skillet. Step 7: Add shallot and saute until soft. Step 8: Add mushrooms, parsley, and pepper and cook about 5 minutes, turning once. Step 9: Top chicken with mushroom mixture evenly divided over each piece. Step 10: Place mozzarella slice evenly over each piece.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, salt and pepper, black pepper, onion, heavy cream, romano cheese, butter, broccoli, egg yolks
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large frying pan. Step 2: Cut chicken into large strips saut in the butter. Step 3: Add onions until golden brown. Step 4: Add broccoli and saut for one minute. Step 5: Add heavy cream and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add cheese and egg yolk. Step 7: Mix well Serves 4 people.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, butter, flour, low sodium chicken broth, half-and-half cream, parmesan cheese, water, broccoli, boneless chicken breasts, white pepper, salt, nutmeg, bow tie pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy stockpot over medium heat, saut onion and garlic in butter for 2-3 minutes. Step 2: Add flour and cook, stirring, for another 2-3 minutes until bubbly Gradually whisk in chicken broth and half & half. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, until thickened. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a separate pan, add water to broccoli and bring just to boiling then remove from heat Do not drain cooking water from broccoli. Step 5: Add parmesan cheese to soup-base in stockpot. Step 6: Cook over low heat, stirring, just until cheese is melted. Step 7: Add cooked broccoli along with its cooking water, chicken, seasonings, and bow tie pasta to the stockpot, heat through.

Ingredient Names: garlic, yellow onion, butter, dry white wine, lemon juice, sun-dried tomatoes, fresh basil, kosher salt, white pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, extra virgin olive oil, salt, black pepper, caprino cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic and onion in 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat until tender. Step 2: Stir wine and lemon juce into skillet, increase heat to medium-high, and simmer to reduce by half. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and stir in cold butter, one slice at a time. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes, basil, kosher salt, and white pepper. Step 5: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 6: Brush chicken breasts with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Step 7: Grill chicken over hot coals 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through A couple of minutes before chicken is done, place equal amounts of cheese on each breast. Step 8: Spoon prepared sun-dried tomato sauce over chicken.

Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, skinless chicken breast halves, onion, garlic, mushrooms, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, dried rosemary, ground black pepper, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, black olives, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Place half the artichoke marinade into a large skillet over medium-high heat, and brown the chicken pieces until the liquid has almost evaporated, 8 to. Step 3: Remove the chicken pieces with a slotted spoon, and place into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 4: Pour the remaining marinade into the same skillet, and cook and stir the onions, garlic, mushrooms, oregano, basil, salt, rosemary, and black pepper until the onions are translucent, 5 to. Step 5: Mix in diced tomatoes with their juice, tomato sauce, black olives, and chopped artichoke hearts. Step 6: Stir the sauce well, and pour over the chicken in the baking dish. Step 7: Cover the dish with foil. Step 8: Bake the chicken until the sauce is bubbling, about 25-30 minutes. Step 9: Uncover, and drizzle the Madeira wine over the dish; top with mozzarella cheese. Step 10: Return to oven, uncovered, and bake until the cheese is melted, about 10 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, rice flour, almond flour, peanut oil, onion, green pepper, zucchini, garlic cloves, red wine, balsamic vinegar, fresh parsley, fresh oregano, fresh thyme, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and pat the chicken dry. Step 2: Mix the almond and rice flour in a plastic bag and add the chicken. Step 3: Roll the chicken around to get it good and coated. Step 4: Heat the oil in a dutch oven type pan until you can smell it, but it isn't smoking. Step 5: Cook the chicken in the oil, flipping pieces frequently to brown on all sides and remove from pan In the same pan, saute the onion, green pepper, garlic and zucchini until the onion is tender. Step 6: Add the red wine, vinegar and spices to the veggies and simmer for 5 minutes, allowing the liquid content to concentrate and reduce slightly. Step 7: Add tomatoes and tomato sauce. Step 8: Stir all this up and add the cooked chicken. Step 9: Cover the pot and cook for 45 minutes over low to medium heat.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chicken broth, salt, black pepper, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, capers, oregano leaves, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy saute pan, heat the 3 tablespoons of chicken broth over a medium-high flame. Step 2: Add the chicken pieces to the pan and saute just until brown, about 5 minutes per side. Step 3: Add more broth as it evaporates, if needed If all the chicken does not fit in the pan, saute in 2 batches or more. Step 4: Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside. Step 5: Add the onion and garlic to the same pan and saute over medium heat until the onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Add the remaining broth and simmer until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the tomatoes with their juice, capers, oregano and about half of the basil. Step 9: Return the chicken pieces to the pan and turn them to coat in the sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, garlic cloves, green bell pepper, white wine, mushrooms, skinless chicken breast halves, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, pitted black olives, fresh parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a 4-quart or larger cooker. Step 2: Add the shallots and bell pepper and cook over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, until the shallots soften slightly, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the wine and boil until about half evaporates Scrape up any browned bits sticking to the bottom of the cooker. Step 4: Stir in the mushrooms and garlic. Step 5: Set the chicken on top. Step 6: Cover the chicken with crushed tomatoes Do not stir Plop the tomato paste on top Lock the lid in place.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken, onion, garlic cloves, button mushroom, dry red wine, diced tomatoes with juice, oregano, anchovies, fusilli, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over moderate-high heat until hot but not smoking, and brown chicken. Step 2: Transfer chicken as it is browned to a bowl. Step 3: Pour off and discard all but 3 tblsps oil and cook onions and mushrooms over medium-high heat until onion is golden. Step 4: Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Step 5: Add tomatoes, wine and chicken. Step 6: Add anchovy paste and oregano and simmer mixture, covered, stirring occasionally, for 30-35 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Step 7: Cook fusilli until al dente. Step 8: In a large bowl, toss it with chicken and garnish with parsley.

Dish Name: Chicken Cacciatore in a Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, sliced fresh mushrooms, yellow onion, green bell pepper, garlic, dried oregano, dried basil, ground black pepper, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Place chicken in a slow cooker. Step 3: Stir in spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, mushrooms, onion, bell pepper, garlic, oregano, basil, black pepper, and red pepper flakes. Step 4: Cover and cook on Low until chicken is tender, 6 to.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, cream of celery soup, water, caesar salad dressing, linguine, tomatoes, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and brown chicken. Step 2: Stir in soup, water, and salad dressing- heat to a boil and stir occasionally. Step 3: Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through- about 5-10 minutes. Step 4: Toss together in linguine and tomato. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, basil pesto, ham, olive oil, white wine, tomato sauce, fresh basil, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Split or butterfly the chicken breasts. Step 2: Layer prosciutto, a teaspoon of pesto, and 1 tablespoon of sun dried tomatoes. Step 3: Roll up the chicken breasts while tucking in the sides to completely envelop the filling. Step 4: In a deep skillet, brown the chicken rolls on both sides In the same skillet, add the wine, the tomato sauce and the basil Salt and pepper as needed and simmer 30 minutes. Step 5: Serve with rice or polenta.

Dish Name: Chicken Campanelle Pasta With Roasted Garlic Cream
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, grilled chicken breast, sun-dried tomatoes, shiitake mushroom, white wine, rich chicken broth, heavy cream, campanelle pasta, fresh basil, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the roasted garlic cream recipe. Step 2: Grill the chicken or roast the breasts and dice them into bite sized pieces. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat Saut the onion, garlic, mushrooms and chicken. Step 4: When the onions are heated through, deglaze the pan with the white wine. Step 5: Add the chicken stock and cream and reduce by half its volume or until the sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon Sir in the roasted garlic cream and add the cooked pasta. Step 6: Add basil and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 7: Pour into a large serving bowl and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese and more fresh basil Roasted garlic cream:.

Dish Name: Chicken Cannelloni With Or Without Spinach
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, onion, chicken broth, dry white wine, thyme, frozen spinach, low-fat ricotta cheese, low fat cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, nutmeg, white pepper, butter, flour, milk, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, simmer the chicken breasts, onion, broth, wine, and thyme, until chicken is done. Step 2: Remove the chicken breasts to a plate and allow them to cool slightly While the chicken breasts are cooling, strain the chicken broth to remove the onions and thyme Reserve the broth into a large saucepan. Step 3: Put the onions and thyme into your food processor. Step 4: Chop or tear the chicken into big chunks, and put into food processor with the onions and thyme Pulse the chicken in the food processor until finely chopped. Step 5: Prepare spinach, if using. Step 6: Wash well, chop, and lightly saut in a saucepan with 2 tbs olive oil until done to your preference I personally don't like "mushy" spinach.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, garlic cloves, chicken thighs, salt and pepper, flour, dry white wine, chicken broth, whole cloves, fresh rosemary, dried sage, bay leaves, red pepper flakes, lemon juice, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven 325f. Step 2: Remove leaves from rosemary and mince. Step 3: Keep both leaves and stem. Step 4: Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in 12 inch ovensafe skillet over medium heat until oil is shimmering. Step 5: Add pancetta and cook until just starting to brown, about 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add garlic slices and cook, stirring until garlic is golden brown Do not burn. Step 7: Remove pancetta and garlic using slotted spoon and keep for later In the same pan, increase the heat to medium high and add 2 tsp olive oil and heat until just smoking Pat chicken dry with paper towel and sprinkle both sides with generous amount of pepper and bit of salt.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, all-purpose flour, eggs, italian style breadcrumbs, olive oil, roma tomatoes, basil, fresh mozzarella balls
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Chop roma tomatoes into bite size pieces and put in a bowl Tear or chiffonade basil and add to tomatoes, stirring to combine. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and set aside. Step 4: Rinse and dry chicken. Step 5: Slice each breast in half. Step 6: Place each half between two pieces of plastic wrap or wax paper and pound with a meat mallet or heavy can to 1 / 4 inch in depth Dredge each breast in flour and let dry on a rack for about 10 minutes Re-dredge each piece in flour again and then dip in egg wash and then in bread crumbs. Step 7: Let the chicken dry on a rack for another ten minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, marinade, fresh mozzarella cheese, tomatoes, fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, fresh garlic, accent seasoning, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade chicken using the balsamic marinade and grill. Step 2: Put fresh basil in food processor and chop. Step 3: Put 1 / 2 chopped basil in a bowl, add garlic, accent, and evoo, not pasty. Step 4: Add salt and pepper to taste Dice mozzarella and tomatoes Dice grilled chicken. Step 5: Serve buffet style, letting each person make their own bowl Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: pancetta, butter, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, heavy cream, milk, cornstarch, parmesan cheese, smoked gouda cheese, fresh rosemary, salt, artichokes, pepper, mushrooms, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: In a 3-qt sauce pan or large pot, saut pancetta over medium / high heat until crisp and golden. Step 2: Lower heat, add butter and melt. Step 3: Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes Saut for approximately one minute stirring frequently. Step 4: Whisk in cream, milk and cornstarch. Step 5: Raise heat to medium / high. Step 6: Whisk in parmesan and gouda. Step 7: Once cheese melts, add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil stirring continuously. Step 8: Remove from heat and let stand uncovered.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, salt, pepper, flour, butter, garlic cloves, thyme, sage, white wine, swanson chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up all chicken breasts into bite sized cubes. Step 2: Melt 3 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet. Step 3: Mix together the flour and the salt and pepper meant for the batter Carefully coat all chicken cubes and brown in skillet. Step 4: Remove and place in a shallow dish and cover. Step 5: Melt down the rest of the butter. Step 6: Mix in garlic, and all spices. Step 7: Add chicken back into the mix and coat throughly. Step 8: Add in white wine, allow to come to a boil for 5-7 minute. Step 9: After the wine has cooked down, add in chicken broth, bring to a boil and then simmer for an additional 5-7 minute.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, flour, salt, milk, chicken broth, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, onion, basil, oregano, pepper, lasagna noodles, cream-style cottage cheese, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Heat margainr in 2 qt saucepan over low heat until melted, add garlic. Step 2: Stir in flour and salt. Step 3: Cook, stirring constantly until bubbly. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in milk and broth. Step 5: Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Step 6: Stir in mozzarella, 1 / 2 cup parmesan, onion, basil, oregano and pepper. Step 7: Cook over low heat stirring constantly until cheese is melted. Step 8: Spread 1 / 4 of sauce in ungreased 13x9" dish and top with 3 or 4 noodles, overlapping if necessary. Step 9: Spread 1 / 2 of cottage cheese over noodles.

Dish Name: Chicken Con Broccoli Olive Garden Style
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, extra virgin olive oil, fettuccine pasta, heavy cream, butter, garlic, cornstarch, broccoli floret, parmesan cheese, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: First, cook the broccoli. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, cook the chicken in the olive oil, letting each side brown. Step 3: Leave remaining oil drippings in pan, setting the chicken aside for now In salted walter, boil the pasta, not quite all the way, Drain the pasta, and place it back into pot In the remaining olive oil from chicken, over medium, brown the garlic. Step 4: When caremelized, add the heavy cream & cornstarch and stir well. Step 5: Stir once in a while, allowing the sauce to thicken. Step 6: When prepared, add the sauce to the pasta combining fettuccini pasta. Step 7: Chop the chicken into cubes, toss in into pasta, add broccoi.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, unsalted butter, canned chicken breast meat, pimientos, mixed vegetables, cream of mushroom soup, kosher salt, pepper, chicken broth, sharp cheddar cheese, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 Break pasta into 2" long pieces & cook in boiling water 5 minutes, stirring occasionally or until partially tender. Step 2: Meanwhile cut butter into small pieces while placing in medium bowl. Step 3: Set aside to soften. Step 4: Combine in micro-safe bowl: chicken, pimentoes, trinity mix, soup, salt, pepper, & broth until well blended. Step 5: Cover and microwave on high 2-3 minutes or until mixture is hot and veggies begin to soften. Step 6: Drain pasta and stir into veggie mixture. Step 7: Transfer mixture evenly into 2qt baking dish. Step 8: Stir cheese & bread crumbs into butter, mix with finger.

Dish Name: Chicken Crostina Olive Garden New Dish
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, salt, pepper, italian seasoning, roasted garlic, white wine, heavy cream, extra virgin olive oil, linguine, parmesan cheese, roma tomato, parsley, seasoned bread crumbs, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Potato crust preparation: -- using a spoon, thoroughly mix all ingredients in a large bowl -- cover and set aside until ready to use Chicken crostina preparation: -- in a shallow dish, mix 1 1 / 2 cups flour, salt, pepper and italian seasoning Dredge chicken breasts in the mixture, shaking off any excess -- heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet. Step 2: Cook chicken breasts two at a time over medium-high heat until golden brown and crisp, add more olive oil for each batch as necessary -- place cooked chicken breast on a baking sheet or dish and top with the potato crust mixture. Step 3: Transfer the baking sheet to a pre-heated broiler until golden brown.

Dish Name: Chicken Cutlets With Spicy White Beans Kale
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, all-purpose flour, kosher salt, black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, diced onion, fresh rosemary leaf, low sodium chicken broth, cannellini beans, kale leaf, chili-garlic sauce, fresh parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breast halves, one at a time, between 2 sheet of plastic wrap, until each piece of chicken is 1 / 8-inch thick. Step 2: Stir together the 2 tablespoons flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow container. Step 3: Heat a large saute' pan over high heat Dredge chicken in flour mixture, shaking and removing any excess. Step 4: Saute' chicken in 2 tablespoons oil in the hot pan until browned, about 2 minutes per side. Step 5: Transfer chicken to a warm plate, cover with foil to keep warm until ready to serve In the same pan used to cook the chicken, saute' onion in the remaining 2 tbsp oil over medium heat until translucent, 3-5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the 2 teaspoons flour and rosemary. Step 7: Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly Deglaze the pan with broth, bringing liquid to a boil and cooking until mixture is slightly thickened.

Dish Name: Chicken Cyril With A Tomato Basil Sauce
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, cashews, baby spinach leaves, phyllo pastry sheets, mozzarella cheese, egg, seasoned dry bread crumb, italian seasoning, butter, garlic, olive oil, diced tomatoes, white wine, basil leaves, light cream
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 180c / 375f. Step 2: Mix seasoned breadcrumbs with italian seasoning in a shallow bowl. Step 3: Dip chicken into beaten egg, then into breadcrumb mixture, thoroughly coating. Step 4: Heat olive oil in frying pan. Step 5: Cook chicken, around 7 -10 minutes depending on breast thickness. Step 6: Set aside on paper towel. Step 7: Return pan to heat Lightly toast chopped cashews and toss through spinach til wilted. Step 8: Put cashew-spinach mix in a bowl and stir through mozzarella. Step 9: Mix melted butter and minced garlic together.

Ingredient Names: chicken drumstick, olive oil, white wine vinegar, fresh parsley, garlic clove, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, whisk together 5 tablespoons olive oil, the vinegar, parsley, garlic, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Pour over chicken and allow to marinate 10 minutes or so. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet heated over medium heat Brown chicken on all sides, reduce heat to low and add marinade from. Step 4: Cover pan and cook until juices run clear, about 15 - 20 minutes, turning at least once. Step 5: Remove cover and cook until sauce is desired consistency. Step 6: Squeeze the juice of one lemon over top, stir gently, and serve.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, chicken cutlet, egg, seasoned bread crumbs, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, salt and pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees Spray baking pan with veg Oil Peel and slice eggplant 1 / 4" Combine bread crumbs, parsley, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper. Step 2: Dip eggplant into egg then crumb mixture. Step 3: Place on baking sheet drizzle with olive oil and bake for 25 minutes While the eggplant is cooking make some pasta and cook the cutlets in a skillet w / olive oil. Step 4: Dip in the egg / crumb mixture Before frying.

Dish Name: Chicken Emil From Rich N Charlies
Ingredient Names: butter, all-purpose flour, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, dry breadcrumbs, chicken stock, mushroom, broccoli floret, prosciutto, garlic clove, red pepper flakes, lemon, dry white wine, provolone cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Melt 1 / 4 cup butter, set aside 2. Step 3: In a bowl, combine the remaining 1 / 2 cup butter with flour, using the back of a fork or a pastry blender to mix until creamy 3. Step 4: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Step 5: Cut each piece of chicken in half Coat chicken with bread crumbs, pressing firmly.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, garlic cloves, cream of chicken soup, cheddar cheese, spinach, milk, butter, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper, flour, eggs, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine flour, milk, eggs, butter and salt in a bowl. Step 2: Beat until all the flour lumps are gone The consistency will be like thin pancake batter. Step 3: Set aside Saut chicken and garlic on butter until golden brown. Step 4: Pour in milk and cream of chicken, simmer. Step 5: Reduce to low to medium heat. Step 6: After simmer, put the spinach and cheese inches keep stirring until the cheese completely melts Salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breast, frozen chopped spinach, fresh mushrooms, onion, lowfat mozzarella cheese, low-fat ricotta cheese, egg, parmesan cheese, lasagna noodles, white sauce, flour, skim milk, butter, nutmeg, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-cook your lasagna noodles according to the package directions, set aside. Step 2: Saute onions and mushrooms in the butter until all the liquid from the mushrooms has evaporated and the onions have softened. Step 3: Add the flour and cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Add the skim milk and cook over low heat stirring frequently until the sauce has thickened. Step 5: Add salt, pepper, nutmeg and 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese. Step 6: Stir until cheese has melted and add chicken breast and spinach, set aside. Step 7: In a small bowl mix ricotta, 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese, 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese and egg until well blended Begin to layer the lasagna.

Ingredient Names: chicken, bisquick, paprika, salt, pepper, eggs, oil, butter, chicken broth, lemon juice, parsley, garlic, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Preheat oil in frying pan. Step 3: In a bowl, add bisquick, paprika, salt and pepper In another bowl, the 2 eggs. Step 4: Dip the chicken in the eggs, then coat with the bisquick mixture Brown the chicken in the oil While the chicken is cooking, get a medium size pot and add the lemon juice, chicken broth, parsley and butter, melt together. Step 5: When chicken is done, place in a deep pan / glass pyrex dish. Step 6: Place the chicken in the pan, and pour the sauce over it.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, milk, breadcrumbs, pecorino romano cheese, fresh parsley, olive oil, butter, salt, pepper, lemon, white wine, lemon juice, chicken broth, grand marnier
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the tenderloin from each chicken breast half Fillet each chicken breast half into two slices Yield 12 pieces Pound each piece, including the tenderloins, to thickness. Step 2: Soak the chicken in milk for 30 minutes. Step 3: Mix breadcrumbs, cheese, and parsley Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture, making sure each piece is well coated. Step 4: Heat olive oil in large skillet Quickly saut breasts on each side till lightly browned Do not overcook.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, condensed chicken broth, white wine, lemon, eggs, parmesan cheese, flour, garlic clove, parsley, unsalted butter, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Dust chicken with flour. Step 2: In a flat container mix together eggs and enough parmesan cheese to create a thick batter. Step 3: Dip breasts in batter and cook at medium to med-high heat in a little olive oil, brown a little on both sides. Step 4: Remove all chicken to a platter- keep warm In same skillet increase heat to a med-high and quickly brown the garlic then deglaze pan with wine and let"boil" a few minutes. Step 5: Add broth, butter and let cook until butter has melted. Step 6: Add parsley, quickly whisking together. Step 7: Add lemon juice 1 / 4 at a time until desired taste Thicken if desired Ladle over chicken and pasta on individual plates, with a garnish of lemon wedges and parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, italian seasoning, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, unsalted butter, extra virgin olive oil, shallot, baby bella mushrooms, frangelico, chicken stock, worcestershire sauce, fresh italian parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken in lengthwise & pound to inch thick Rince the chicken under cold water them pat dry with paper towel On a plate combine the flour and italian seasoning and stir to combine thoroughly. Step 2: Season the chicken with salt and pepper then dredge in flour mixture. Step 3: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 1 tablespoons butter and 1 tablespoons oil Working in batches, sear the chicken until golden brown, about 3 min, per side. Step 4: Remove and set aside. Step 5: Drain the fat from the skillet and return the skillet to the heat. Step 6: Add 2 tablespoons butter when it is melted, add in the shallots. Step 7: Cook, stirring, until wilted, about 3 minute add the mushrooms.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, onions, fresh rosemary, fresh sage leaves, olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, dry white wine, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Put the chicken pieces in a 12-inch skillet with a lid, along with the chopped onions, rosemary, and sage. Step 2: Stir well to coat the chicken with the onion and herbs. Step 3: Add enough olive oil to coat all of the chicken pieces, but not so much that it pools in the skillet. Step 4: Sprinkle with 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper. Step 5: Set the skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Cook until the onions are very soft and the chicken and onions have turned golden brown, about 20 minutes If the onion begins to brown too fast, turn down the heat. Step 7: Add the wine and bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce the heat, cover the pan, and simmer gently until the chicken is tender, about 20 minutes. Step 9: Squeeze the lemon over, taste for salt and pepper, and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, olive oil, white wine vinegar, celery, carrots, garlic, oregano, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken pieces in a glass dish, 9 x 13. Step 2: In a medium bowl, mix together all marinade ingredients. Step 3: Pour marinade over chicken pieces and marinate for at least 1 / 2 day or overnight. Step 4: Put everything, marinade and all, in a 350 oven and bake for 45 minutes. Step 5: After 45 minutes, put under broiler to crisp chicken on all sides. Step 6: Serve w / pan drippings and mash potatoes.

Dish Name: Chicken In A Mushroom Dill Cream Sauce Excellent
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast halves, salt & freshly ground black pepper, unsalted butter, vegetable oil, cremini mushroom, shallot, dry white wine, heavy cream, chicken stock, dijon mustard, dill
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Step 2: In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in the vegetable oil. Step 3: Add the chicken breasts, skin side down, and cook over moderately high heat until lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Cover the skillet and cook the chicken over moderate heat until the skin is crisp, about 4 minutes. Step 5: Uncover, turn the chicken and cook over moderately low heat until the meat is just white throughout, about 6 minutes. Step 6: Transfer the chicken to a large plate and cover loosely with foil. Step 7: Pour off the fat from the skillet and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Step 8: Add the mushrooms and shallot and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until softened, about 4 minutes. Step 9: Add the wine and simmer over moderately high heat until almost dry, about 3 minutes. Step 10: Add the cream and stock and simmer until thickened, about 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red bell pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, button mushrooms, garlic, dry white wine, half-and-half, blue cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, spaghetti, scallions, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 2: Add pepper and chicken and cook over medium heat until lightly browned. Step 3: Add mushrooms and garlic and cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Add wine, bring to a boil then reduce heat to low. Step 5: When mixture is no longer boiling, add half and half and cheese, stir until melted and season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Spoon mixture over pasta and sprinkle with scallions and parsley.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, mayonnaise, italian breadcrumbs, italian dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Put mayonnaise on chicken breasts, then coat with italian bread crumbs. Step 2: After you get chicken coated with mayonnaise and bread crumbs, put in a 9x13-inch baking dish and then add wishbone italian dressing just enough to cover the bottom of the baking dish after half way through the baking of the chicken then baste the chicken with italian dressing continue baking Total baking time is 45 minutes at 325f. Step 3: Cover chicken while baking with foil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, olive oil, marsala wine, heavy cream, dill, potatoes, garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: With a meat mallet, beat the chicken breasts between two sheets of clingfilm on a board until the breasts are 1 / 2in thin Lightly dust the breasts with flour. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a medium frying pan and fry the chicken for about 1 minute on each side. Step 3: Add the marsala and flame for about 15 seconds, allowing the alcohol to evaporate. Step 4: Add the cream and the dill, season with salt and pepper and cook, uncovered, over a low heat for about 4 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken. Step 5: Meanwhile, slice the potatoes about 1 / 2in thick. Step 6: Heat the remaining oil in a second frying pan, fry the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute, then add the potatoes. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes or until golden on both sides. Step 8: Place a chicken breast on each plate and surround with sauted potatoes. Step 9: Drizzle some of the sauce over the chicken and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Chicken In Olive Red Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, garlic cloves, pepper, fresh rosemary, fresh thyme, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, spanish olives with pimento, dry red wine, seasoned croutons, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, cook bacon with onion, garlic, pepper, and rosemary over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until bacon is crisp. Step 2: Remove bacon with slotted spoon, set aside. Step 3: Add chicken to pan. Step 4: Cook, turning frequently, until chicken is browned. Step 5: Add olives, wine, and bacon. Step 6: Cover and cook until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut. Step 7: Place chicken on serving platter. Step 8: Sprinkle with croutons and parsley.

Ingredient Names: free-range chicken, red wine vinegar, chicken stock, red ripe tomatoes, fresh parsley, butter, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the seasoned chicken in batches in the butter with a bit of oil as well to stop it burning. Step 2: Drain fat from skillet and return chicken to skillet Slowly pour the vinegar into the hot pan to deglaze Stand back from fumes! Step 3: Over med-high heat, reduce the vinegar by about half, turning chicken periodically to bathe it. Step 4: Add tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer gently until flavours melded and mingled, about 20 minutes. Step 5: Remove the pan from heat, set aside the chicken and keep warm In the pan, whisk in a knob of butter for a beautiful shiny sauce.
