Step 6: Pour the sauce over the chicken and then strew with herbs Enjoy with a potato gratin or creamy mash and steamed green beans.

Dish Name: Chicken In Sweet And Hot Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: sweet red peppers, garlic, slivered almonds, red chili pepper, cayenne pepper, onion, chicken stock, evaporated milk, chicken breasts, olive oil, zucchini, salt and pepper, basil leaves, pine nuts, penne pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first 6 ingredients in your blender or food processor and process into a paste / pulp. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan or dutch oven, when hot enough pour the pepper paste in and on a medium high heat fry for 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the milk and chicken stock. Step 4: Then add the chicken and stir, add the zucchini a few minutes later. Step 5: Bring to the boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer for 10- 15 minutes or until the chicken is tender In the meantime cook the pasta according package instructions, drain when cooked, and put in a large warm dish. Step 6: Check the seasoning of the chicken dish, if you find the sauce too thick you can add some more chicken stock, it depends how much moisture the zucchini will release, add half of the basil, mix and put half of the chicken on top of the pasta, mix, then pour over the remaining. Step 7: Sprinkle the rest of the basil on top together with the pine nuts, serve.

Dish Name: Chicken In White Wine Poulet Scarpariello
Ingredient Names: chicken, flour, salt & freshly ground black pepper, olive oil, butter, garlic cloves, dry white wine, lemon, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Dredge the chicken in flour on all sides and season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat the oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add chicken in one layer and cook 10 minutes each side, uncovered, until golden brown The chicken should be done. Step 4: Cook a few minutes more, if necessary. Step 5: Drain fat from skillet. Step 6: Add butter and when hot, add garlic. Step 7: Add wine and heat to boiling. Step 8: Cover and cook 3 minutes. Step 9: Squeeze lemon juice over chicken and sprinkle with parsley.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, chopped tomatoes, worcestershire sauce, garlic cloves, red chile, basil, parsley, oregano, salt, black pepper, white wine, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, red onion, mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200c / 400f. Step 2: Rinse the chicken and remove any excess fat and skin and set aside. Step 3: Mix the ingredients for the sauce and set aside. Step 4: Mix all the chopped veggies in a roasting pan and pour the sauce over top Lay the chicken pieces on top of the sauce, skin side down and cover with foil. Step 5: Cook for 25 minutes. Step 6: Remove the pan from the oven, take off the foil and turn the chicken pieces over so that they are now skin side up. Step 7: Return to the oven, uncovered, and continue to cook for 20-25 minutes until chicken is done and skin is crispy I served this with boiled potatoes that had been thickly sliced You may want to try this with mashed potatoes, noodles or rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, low-fat ricotta cheese, dried oregano, salt, ground black pepper, garlic powder, extra virgin olive oil, crushed tomatoes, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Oven 350. Step 2: Heat skillet with 2 tbsp olive oil. Step 3: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and garlic powder Brown chicken in oil for 6 minutes per side. Step 4: Remove to oven-safe baking dish. Step 5: Combine ricotta with oregano and 1 cup crushed tomatoes. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 4 cup of cheese / tomato mixture onto chicken. Step 7: Sprinkle 1 / 2 oz of mozzarella ontop of chicken, bake 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Legs With Ricotta And Bacon Stuffing
Ingredient Names: chicken legs with thigh, butter, bacon, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, ricotta cheese, egg, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumb, fresh parsley, fresh chives, fresh tarragon, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: To make the stuffing: remove the rind from the bacon and chop finely. Step 2: Fry in a dry pan until crisp. Step 3: Remove cooked bacon and set aside In the same pan, heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic until soft. Step 4: Put the ricotta, egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, parsley, chives, tarragon, bacon, onion, garlic and nutmeg in a large bowl. Step 5: Mix together, lightly, to combine ingredients. Step 6: Preheat oven to moderate- 350 degrees f. Step 7: Using your fingers, ease the skin away from the thigh and leg of the chicken, being careful not to pierce the skin Gently push the stuffing mixture evenly under the skin Draw the skin back over the stuffing.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, lemons, cream cheese, olive oil, salt, herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken breast in small pieces, Put olive oil in a pan, Add the chicken in the pan, Brown the chicken for 15 min, Pour the lemon juice, Let it evaporate and Slowly add cream cheese mixing. Step 2: After it has thickened, Place in serving dish and. Step 3: Sprinkle with the herbs.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, linguine, garlic, shallots, butter, olive oil, white wine, sea salt, white pepper, half-and-half, flour, basil, oregano, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine in boiling salted water until al dente, usually about 12 minutes. Step 2: In a large skillet saute garlic, shallots and chicken together in butter and olive oil over medium-low heat until chicken is cooked through and tender Do not let garlic brown. Step 3: Add wine, salt and pepper. Step 4: Simmer together for about 3 minutes then whisk in flour. Step 5: Stir in half& half, basil and oregano until heated through. Step 6: Serve chicken over cooked linguine and sprinkle liberally with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, distilled white vinegar, olive oil, garlic, manicotti shells, butter, heavy cream, ground nutmeg, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese, salt, ricotta cheese, egg, fresh oregano, marjoram, basil, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large resealable plastic bag, marinate chicken with vinegar, olive oil, and garlic for at least 2 hours. Step 2: Saute in a little olive oil until done, set aside. Step 3: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Step 4: Drain, and set aside. Step 5: Meanwhile, melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add heavy cream, salt, nutmeg, and ground black pepper, and stir until sauce thickens. Step 7: Reduce heat to low. Step 8: Add grated Parmesan cheese, and stir until the cheese melts. Step 9: Set Alfredo sauce aside. Step 10: In a large bowl, mix together ricotta cheese, egg, oregano, marjoram, and basil. Step 11: Mix in cooked chicken. Step 12: Stuff cooked manicotti shells with chicken and ricotta mixture. Step 13: Cover the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with half of the Alfredo sauce. Step 14: Place stuffed shells on top of sauce. Step 15: Pour remaining sauce over shells. Step 16: Top with one cup shredded mozzarella cheese. Step 17: Cover with aluminum foil. Step 18: Bake at 350 degree F (175 degree C) oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 19: Let stand before serving.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, dried oregano, skinless chicken breast halves, butter, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, marsala wine, cooking sherry
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: In a shallow dish or bowl, mix together the flour, salt, pepper and oregano. Step 3: Coat chicken pieces in flour mixture. Step 4: In a large skillet, melt butter in olive oil over medium heat. Step 5: Place chicken in the pan, and lightly brown. Step 6: Turn over chicken pieces, and add mushrooms. Step 7: Pour in wine and sherry. Step 8: Cover skillet; simmer chicken, turning once, until no longer pink and juices run clear, serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, italian salad dressing, flour, margarine, chicken broth, marsala, sliced mushrooms, fresh parsley, pepper, garlic powder, italian seasoning, paprika, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken in italian dressing several hours or overnight In large bowl or zip-lock bag, combine flour, pepper, garlic powder, italian seasoning and paprika. Step 2: Remove chicken from marinade and coat with flour mixture In large non stick skillet, heat margarine and olive oil until hot Brown chicken and transfer to baking dish and set aside for a few minutes Deglaze same skillet with the wine and chicken stock and bring to hard boil. Step 3: Add sliced mushrooms and cook for a few minutes. Step 4: Pour over chicken and sprinkle with fresh, chopped parsley. Step 5: Bake in 450 degrees oven for 15 minutes Eat with your favorite pasta and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, button mushroom, angel hair pasta, garlic powder, paprika, italian seasoning, flour, sweet marsala wine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat water for the angel hair spaghetti if that's what you will be having with this meal You want the water ready for the angel hair at a certain point in the chicken preparation Timing will be important to have everything come together correctly. Step 2: Prepare the chicken breast What you want are chicken pieces that are about a quarter inch thick You can pound a breast down to that thickness if you wish I prefer to use a partically thawed breast from the freezer and slice it to the proper thickness This produces two or three slices from a typical large breast It's easier to slice the breast if it's still partially frozen It doesn't slide around as much.

Ingredient Names: chicken, flour, butter, mushrooms, holland house marsala cooking wine, water, fresh parsley, rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken until thin Dredge lightly on both sides with flour In large skillet, melt butter and saute mushrooms over medium heat until browned, about 10 minutes. Step 2: Remove and set aside. Step 3: Add chicken to skillet and cook through, 4 minutes on each side. Step 4: Remove to serving platter. Step 5: Return mushrooms to pan, stir in marsala, water, parsley and rosemary. Step 6: Heat and pour over chicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, flour, salt and pepper, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, red onion, sweet marsala wine, demi-glace, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil to saut pan and put on medium heat Salt and flour chicken breast, pat off excess flour. Step 2: When oil is hot, saut chicken breast until browned on both sides, remove breast Leaving oil in pan, add mushrooms and onions, and a pinch of salt and pepper Saut. Step 3: When mushrooms and onions are sauteed add marsala, demi glace, and cream, and another pinch of salt. Step 4: Reduce until bubbles start to slow and sauce thickens, add chicken breast for one minute and turn off heat, flip the chicken breast in the sauce and serve when ready, pour sauce over chicken breast.

Ingredient Names: chicken ravioli, olive oil, butter, sliced mushrooms, prosciutto, asparagus, sea salt, cracked black pepper, heavy cream, marsala wine, fresh basil, parmesan cheese, basil sprigs
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken ravioli in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes or according to package directions. Step 2: In a heated saut pan, add oil and butter, cooking the smoked prosciutto until lightly browned. Step 3: Add mushrooms, asparagus, sea salt, black pepper and saut for 1-2 minutes, or until mushrooms and asparagus are cooked through. Step 4: Add marsala wine, heavy cream, grated parmesan, julienned basil and simmer for about 2 to 4 minutes or until sauce has reduced. Step 5: Remove chicken ravioli from water and drain well. Step 6: Add ravioli to saut pan and toss until coated with sauce. Step 7: Place ravioli on platter, pillow side up. Step 8: Pour sauce evenly over ravioli. Step 9: Garnish with fresh fresh basil sprigs and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, portobello mushroom caps, garlic, all-purpose flour, beef broth, marsala wine, kosher salt, ground black pepper, skinless chicken breast halves, browning sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Melt butter and heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Cook and stir the mushroom slices in the skillet until tender. Step 4: Remove pan from heat and set aside. Step 5: Melt butter and heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 6: Stir in the garlic and cook until tender, then gradually whisk in flour. Step 7: Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Step 8: Increase heat to high, and whisk in the beef broth, Marsala, and browning sauce. Step 9: Season sauce with salt and pepper. Step 10: Bring sauce to a boil, and reduce heat to low. Step 11: Mix in the cooked mushrooms; you'll use the skillet to cook the chicken. Step 12: Cover saucepan and remove from heat. Step 13: Season chicken with salt and pepper, and dredge chicken breasts in the flour. Step 14: Over medium heat, melt remaining butter in the skillet used to cook the mushrooms. Step 15: Cook the chicken per side, until browned. Step 16: Arrange the chicken in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover with the sauce and mushroom mixture. Step 17: Cover baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven, or until chicken juices run clear.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, carrot, evaporated milk, frozen peas, salt, fresh ground black pepper, feta, fresh sage leaf, ground chicken, fresh white breadcrumbs, fresh chives, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water until tender, drain. Step 2: Cover to keep warm To make the meatballs, combine the chicken, garlic, fresh breadcrumbs, chives, basil, parmesan and egg in a bowl, season to taste with salt and pepper, mix well and with floured hands, and shape the mixture into 12-16 meatballs, depending on the size of meatball you fancy. Step 3: Place the meatballs on a tray, cover loosely and chill for 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat the butter in a non-stick pan, over a medium heat, and saut the meatballs, turning occasionally, for 6-8 minutes, or until they are lightly golden-brown all over and fully cooked. Step 5: Remove from the pan and cover to keep the meatballs to keep them warm. Step 6: Heat the oil in the pan, add the onion, garlic and carrot, and saut until they have softened. Step 7: Add the milk and peas and bring to the boil, add the pasta.

Ingredient Names: eggs, kosher salt, ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, bread crumbs, skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil for frying, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C). Step 3: Beat eggs with salt and pepper in a shallow dish. Step 4: Spread flour in another dish and bread crumbs in a third dish. Step 5: Working with one piece at a time, gently press chicken into flour to coat and shake off any excess. Step 6: Dip into beaten eggs, then press into bread crumbs. Step 7: Gently toss between your hands so excess bread crumbs can fall away. Step 8: Place breaded chicken onto a plate while breading the rest; do not stack. Step 9: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 10: Pan-fry chicken in batches of 2 or until golden brown and no longer pink in the center, 2 to per side. Step 11: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 12: Transfer cooked chicken to a baking sheet and keep warm in the preheated oven while cooking remaining chicken. Step 13: Serve with lemon wedges.

Dish Name: Chicken Milanese With Slow Roasted Cherry Tomatoes And Arugula
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, milk, breadcrumbs, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried oregano, extra virgin olive oil, cherry tomatoes, coarse salt, arugula, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To make the slow roasted cherry tomatoes & arugula: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Put the tomatoes on a rimmed cookie sheet and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and a pinch of salt Roast for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes are split and blistered Which means they are super sweet While the chicken is cooking, toss the arugula with the remaining tablespoon of olive oil, the vinegar and pinch of salt. Step 3: Fold the tomatoes into the arugula Chicken: Put the chicken breasts in between two sheets of wax paper and pound them with a mallet, until they are very, very thin - you should be able to almost see through them - about 1 / 6 inch thick. Step 4: Mix the oregano, salt and pepper into the bread crumbs or panko and set on a plate.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, chicken broth, heavy cream, skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, vegetable oil, basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan over low heat, melt butter; add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Step 2: Add the tomatoes and the chicken broth; increase to medium heat and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 15-20 minutes or until the tomatoes are tender. Step 4: Add the cream and bring to a boil; stirring. Step 5: Simmer over medium heat until the sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Step 6: Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides. Step 7: In a large skillet over medium heat, warm oil and saute chicken. Step 8: Press on chicken occasionally with a slotted spatula. Step 9: Cook for about 5 minutes per side or until the meat feels springy and is no longer pink inside. Step 10: Transfer to a board; cover and keep warm. Step 11: Discard the fat from the skillet. Step 12: In the same skillet, over medium heat, bring chicken broth to a boil; stirring the pan juices. Step 13: Reduce slightly and add to the cream sauce; stir in basil and adjust seasonings to taste. Step 14: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 15: Add fettuccine and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain, transfer to a bowl and toss with the sauce. Step 16: Cut each chicken breast into 2 to 3 diagonal slices. Step 17: Reheat the sauce gently if needed. Step 18: Transfer the pasta to serving plates; top with chicken and coat with the cream sauce; serve.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, cheddar cheese, olive oil, chicken breasts, mushrooms, onion, garlic cloves, thyme, basil, flour, butter, milk, cheese, nutmeg, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a saucepan, add chicken and onion, stirring until just cooked. Step 2: Add mushrooms, garlic, thyme, and basil. Step 3: Cook until mushrooms are tender, set aside. Step 4: Combine butter and flour, cook for 2 minutes Gradually add flour, stirring continuously. Step 5: When sauce starts to thicken, season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, and stir in cheese. Step 6: Spread a thin layer of the chicken mixture in the bottom of a lasagne dish. Step 7: Top with a layer of noodles. Step 8: Add a layer of bechemal sauce, and another layer of noodles.

Ingredient Names: butter, fresh mushrooms, skinless chicken breast, chicken stock, arborio rice, dry white wine, onion, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, cream, fresh parsley, oil, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot heat oil and add mushrooms and chicken and cook through until cooked, remove from pot. Step 2: Using the same pot, add butter and saute onions and garlic in butter and leftover oil mixture until translucent. Step 3: Add the rice and stir until the rice turns opaque - about two minutes. Step 4: Add the wine, salt and pepper to the rice and stir frequently until the wine has been absorbed into the rice. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup of the heated chicken stock and stir frequently until absorbed The rice and broth should bubble gently Continue to cook the rice, adding chicken stock 1 / 2 cup at a time and allowing the rice to absorb it before adding the next 1 / 2 cup. Step 6: Cook rice this way until tender which should take about 25-30 minutes Just before the last batch of stock has been absorbed into the rice, add the chicken and mushroom mixture back into the pot.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, olive oil, onion, mushroom cap, frozen chopped spinach, cooked chicken breasts, italian-style diced tomatoes, chive & onion cream cheese, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Prepare rigatoni according to package directions, when ready drain and save about 1 / 4 cup of cooking water. Step 3: Meanwhile, spread oil on bottom of an 11"x7" baking dish. Step 4: Add onion & mushrooms, if using, in a single layer. Step 5: Bake for 15 minutes or just until tender. Step 6: Transfer onion & mushrooms to a large bowl, and set aside. Step 7: Drain chopped spinach well, pressing between layers of paper towels. Step 8: Stir rigatoni or other pasta, spinach, chicken, and next 5 ingredients into onion & mushrooms in bowl. Step 9: Spoon mixture into baking dish, and sprinkle evenly with shredded mozzarella cheese. Step 10: Bake, covered, for 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Noodle Tetrazzini A Little Healthier
Ingredient Names: whole wheat noodles, light margarine, all-purpose flour, skim milk, fat-free chicken broth, black pepper, ground thyme, frozen peas, nonfat plain yogurt, parmesan cheese, fresh mushrooms, cooked chicken breasts, salt, seasoned bread crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Cook egg noodles according to package directions. Step 2: Drain, cover and set aside. Step 3: Preheat oven to 425. Step 4: Melt margarine in medium saucepan. Step 5: Blend in flour until smooth. Step 6: Cook for 1 minute but don't let it brown Slowly whisk in milk, chicken broth, thyme and black pepper. Step 7: Cook sauce over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Step 8: Stir in peas, yogurt and two tablespoons of parmesan cheese. Step 9: Mix together noodles, mushrooms, sauce and chicken.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, white wine, lemons, fresh parsley, capers, flour, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dust fillets with salt and pepper and dredge in flour. Step 2: Heat olive oil in pan over med heat Brown chicken / fish in oil About 2 minutes per side, or until cooked through and browned. Step 3: Remove from pan Deglaze with wine and add butter and capers. Step 4: Cook for 2 minutes until alcohol has cooked off. Step 5: Add lemon juice add salt to taste. Step 6: Add chicken / fish back into pan, add parsley.

Ingredient Names: medium pasta shells, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, tomatoes, bell pepper, scallion, cooked chicken, fresh basil, salt and pepper, feta cheese with herbs, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta with salt according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and place hot pasta in mixing bowl. Step 3: Pour olive oil and balsamic vinegar over pasta. Step 4: Add tomatoes, bell peppers, scallions, and chicken, toss well. Step 5: Add basil, salt, pepper, feta, and parmesan cheese. Step 6: Toss well and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, salt, ground black pepper, large eggs, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, all-purpose flour, olive oil, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Step 3: Place chicken breasts between two sheets of heavy plastic (resealable freezer bags work well) on a solid, level surface. Step 4: Firmly pound chicken with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a thickness of 1/2-inch. Step 5: Season chicken thoroughly with salt and pepper. Step 6: Using a sifter or strainer, sprinkle flour over chicken breasts, evenly coating both sides. Step 7: Beat eggs in a shallow bowl and set aside. Step 8: Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese in a separate bowl, set aside. Step 9: Dip a flour-coated chicken breast in beaten eggs. Step 10: Transfer breast to the bread crumb mixture, pressing crumbs into both sides. Step 11: Repeat for each breast. Step 12: Let chicken rest for 10 to. Step 13: Heat of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it begins to shimmer. Step 14: Cook chicken in batches, so you do not overcrowd the pan, until golden, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 15: The chicken will finish cooking in the oven. Step 16: Transfer chicken to a baking dish. Step 17: Top each breast with tomato sauce. Step 18: Layer each chicken breast with equal amounts of mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, and provolone cheese. Step 19: Sprinkle remaining Parmesan over top and drizzle each with olive oil. Step 20: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is browned and bubbly and chicken breasts are no longer pink in the center, 15 to. Step 21: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 22: Let chicken rest briefly before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, parmesan cheese, italian breadcrumbs, eggs, tomato sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, italian seasoning, sugar, black pepper, salt, olive oil, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts 1 / 4" thick. Step 2: Combine bread crumbs& parmesan cheese, beat eggs. Step 3: Place crumb mix& eggs on separate dishes for easy dipping Coat breasts in egg then bread crumbs For the sauce: combine all ingredients in saucepan and cook low on stovetop for approximately 20 minutes. Step 4: Heat olive oil in deep fryer to 350 degrees Deep fry chicken in single layers for 2-3 minutes and place in paper towel lined dish To serve: place chicken breasts on plate& place some sauce on top. Step 5: Sprinkle with extra parmesan cheese, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, marinara sauce, tomatoes, garlic cloves, yellow onion, butter, olive oil, dried oregano, breadcrumbs, flour, egg wash, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Cut chicken into cubes Lay out flour, egg wash, and bread crumbs in an assembly line. Step 3: Season bread crumbs with some oregano, salt, and pepper Coat chicken cubes in flour, egg, and bread crumbs respectfully Coat the bottom of your pan in olive oil and fry until done. Step 4: Saute onion and garlic in the tablespoons of olive oil and butter in a medium sauce pan. Step 5: Add the jar of sauce. Step 6: Heat until simmering. Step 7: Add the can of tomatoes, perhaps some canned or jarred mushrooms, and the oregano.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, hot red pepper flakes, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, marinara sauce, fresh basil, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic-flavored croutons
Instructions: Step 1: In a 9x13" baking pan, add the 2 tablespoons olive oil. Step 2: Add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes. Step 3: Spread it around so it covers the bottom of the pan. Step 4: Place chicken breasts in the pan. Step 5: Pour the sauce on top of the chicken. Step 6: Sprinkle basil on top. Step 7: Sprinkle half of the cheeses on top of the basil Dump all the croutons over mixture and finish it off with the other half of the cheese. Step 8: Bake at 350 degrees for 45- 55 minutes until breasts are cooked through, remove from oven.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, almond meal, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, egg, mozzarella cheese, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f 2. Step 2: Line a baking sheet with foil 3. Step 3: Slice chicken breasts in half to make thinner pieces 4. Step 4: Mix almond meal / flour, grated parmesan, and italian seasoning 5. Step 5: Whisk the egg in a separate bowl.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, low-fat italian salad dressing, breadcrumbs, italian seasoning mix, spaghetti sauce, parmesan cheese, low fat mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: Remove any clinging fat from the chicken and discard. Step 2: Wash and pat dry Lay chicken between sheets of waxed paper- i save cereal box liners for this purpose Gently pound with the fleshy part of your fist to flatten slightly Rub all over with italian dressing& let it sit while measuring out the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Combine bread crumbs and seasonings on a piece of wax paper Spray a large non-stick frying pan with cooking spray and place over medium heat. Step 4: When hot, dredge dressing coated breasts through the bread crumb mixture and saut until golden, about 5- 8 minutes per side. Step 5: Spoon some spaghetti sauce on top of each breast, sprinkle with parmesan& top with mozzarella. Step 6: Cover pan and continue to cook over medium heat until sauce is hot and cheese melts, about 3-5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, egg, breadcrumbs, dried basil, dried thyme, dried oregano, garlic clove, onion, salt, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, pasta sauce, italian cheese blend, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Lightly grease a loaf pan with cooking spray, set aside. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, egg, breadcrumbs, thyme, oregano, basil, garlic, onion, salt, pepper and parmesan cheese To not over handle the mixture otherwise it will get tough. Step 3: Place the mixture in the greased loaf pan and form into a loaf. Step 4: Top the meatloaf with pasta sauce. Step 5: Place filled loaf pan on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes. Step 6: Remove the meatloaf from the oven and sprinkle the top with the remaining shredded cheese. Step 7: Place the meatloaf back in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted. Step 8: Remove the meatloaf from the oven and allow to rest for 5-10 minutes before serving / slicing.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat penne, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, poultry seasoning, fresh ground black pepper, salt, garlic cloves, red onion, grape tomatoes, basil, baby arugula, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pasta pot with water and place it over high heat. Step 2: Once the water comes up to a boil, salt it and drop in the pasta. Step 3: Cook the pasta to al dente according to package directions Before draining the pasta, reserve a mugful of starchy cooking water, then drain and reserve While the water is coming up to a boil, place a large skillet over high heat with 3 tablespoons of olive oil. Step 4: Season the chicken pieces with the poultry seasoning, salt and pepper then add it to the preheated skillet. Step 5: Cook the chicken until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Step 6: Once the chicken is brown, add the garlic and onions to the pan, and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the tomatoes and cover the pan with a lid. Step 8: Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes burst open and begin to release their juices, about 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Parmigiana Courtesy Of Bobby Flay
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt & freshly ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, salt and pepper, eggs, water, panko breadcrumbs, vegetable oil, tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Season chicken on both sides with salt and pepper Dredge each breast in the flour and tap off excess, then dip in the egg and let excess drip off, then dredge on both sides in the bread crumbs. Step 3: Divide the oil between 2 large saute pans and heat over high heat until almost smoking. Step 4: Add 2 chicken breasts to each pan and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Step 5: Transfer to a baking sheet and top each breast with some tomato sauce, a few slices of the mozzarella, salt and pepper, and a tablespoon of parmesan. Step 6: Bake in the oven until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is melted, about 5 to 7 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the oven and garnish with basil or parsley leaves.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, eggs, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, chunky marinara sauce, provolone cheese, oil, kaiser rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Pound chicken with tenderizer until thin Coat chicken with flour, egg mixture, and bread crumbs Pan or deep fry chicken until fully cooked. Step 2: Place cooked chicken on cookie sheet or shallow baking dish. Step 3: Spread marinara sauce on top of chicken. Step 4: Top chicken with provolone cheese. Step 5: Place in oven, heat until cheese is completely melted. Step 6: Remove from oven, place chicken on roll, and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil flavored cooking spray, garlic cloves, crushed tomatoes, low-fat ricotta, low fat mozzarella, salt, pepper, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry Spray a non-stick baking pan with olive oil arrange breasts on the pan, then cover with the tomatoes and ricotta. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with the garlic, mozzarella, and basil. Step 4: Bake for 35 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through, the ricotta is bubbling hot, and the mozzarella turns golden brown.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, eggs, italian dressing, tomato soup, water, sliced mushrooms, extra virgin olive oil, parsley flakes, italian seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese, salt and pepper, spaghetti noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Saute mushrooms in oil with salt. Step 2: Remove mushrooms and set aside. Step 3: Whisk eggs and italian dressing. Step 4: Dip chicken in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumbs. Step 5: Cook chicken in same skillet mushrooms were cooked in over medium heat. Step 6: When chicken juices run clear, remove chicken and set to side. Step 7: Mix soup, water, and seasonings in a bowl. Step 8: Pour into same skillet, making sure to scrap bottom of skillet. Step 9: Return chicken to same pan sauce is in and let simmer, covered, for 12-15 minutes. Step 10: Pour cheese on top of mixture and simmer over low heat for 15-20 minutes and additional 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh garlic cloves, onion, red pepper, chicken breast, broccoli florets, sun-dried tomato, dried basil, salt & pepper, red pepper flakes, chicken broth, white wine, butter, farfalle pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Using a large frying pan on medium high heat. Step 2: Saute garlic in oil- do not burn. Step 3: Add onion and pepper- cook 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken breast cook for a few minutes until all pieces look white on the outside about 3-5 minutes. Step 5: Add broccoli, tomatoes, seasonings- cook about 3-5 minutes. Step 6: Add broth, wine & cook 10-15 mins. Step 7: Add butter mixing to melt. Step 8: Toss with pasta, let set for a few minutes & serve with cheese sprinkled on top.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, sun-dried tomato, chicken broth, heavy cream, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, pepper, olive oil, basil, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Step 2: Add the minced garlic and cook for about a minute. Step 3: Add tomatoes and 3 / 4 cup of chicken broth Increase heat to medium and bring mixture to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Add cream and bring to a boil again, stirring frequently. Step 6: Simmer over medium heat until sauce is thick. Step 7: Sprinkle salt and pepper over both sides of chicken. Step 8: Heat the olive oil in a skillet, then add chicken and saute until chicken is no longer pink inside. Step 9: Remove chicken from skillet, drain fat from skillet.

Dish Name: Chicken Pasta Salad with Creamy Dressing
Ingredient Names: macaroni elbow pasta, salt, chicken, bacon, celery, red capsicum bell pepper, green onions, carrots, cheese, avocados, mayonnaise, sour cream, cider vinegar, dijon mustard, sugar, garlic powder, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta: Bring a large pot of water to the boil. Add salt, then cook pasta per packet directions. Drain well, let cool. Step 2: Dressing: Mix Dressing ingredients in a bowl. Set aside 10 minutes+. Step 3: Cook bacon: Place bacon in a cold non-stick skillet. Turn stove on to medium high, then cook bacon until golden. Drain on paper towels. Step 4: Toss! Place cooked pasta in a large bowl along with all the Pasta Salad ingredients, reserving some bacon for garnish. Pour over Dressing, then toss well. Step 5: Set aside for 20 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl, sprinkle with remaining bacon. Serve! Step 6: Storage: Keeps for 3 - 4 days in the fridge. Best to bring to room temp before serving!

Ingredient Names: green onions, flour, seasoning salt, chicken tenders, butter, roasted garlic, sliced mushrooms, fettuccine pasta, white wine, heavy whipping cream, pecan pieces, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Equipment: 1 large ziploc bag. Step 2: Bring water to boil for pasta. Step 3: Combine flour and seasoned salt in zip-top bag shake to mix. Step 4: Add chicken and shake to coat. Step 5: Preheat large saute pan on medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add butter and swirl to coat. Step 7: Add garlic and chicken. Step 8: Cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally to brown. Step 9: Stir mushrooms into chicken. Step 10: Cook 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until tender.

Dish Name: Chicken Penne With Mozzarella And Tomato
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, garlic powder, penne pasta, diced tomatoes, butter, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f. Step 2: Cook pasta to al dente. Step 3: Saute chicken in olive oil until done. Step 4: Add garlic powder during cooking. Step 5: Heat tomatoes in saucepan to boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook 5-8 minutes until liquid has evaporated. Step 6: Melt butter in 9x12 glass dish in oven. Step 7: When pasta is cooked, reserve 1 cup of starch water. Step 8: Drain pasta and transfer to glass dish. Step 9: Toss pasta until coated in melted butter Slowly add parmesan cheese and starch water until alfredo sauce is made.

Ingredient Names: multigrain bread, mayonnaise, fresh basil, chicken, roasted sweet red pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an electric sandwich press, a covered indoor grill, a grill pan, or a 12-inch skillet To assemble sandwiches, spread one side of each bread slice with the mayonnaise. Step 2: Layer basil, chicken, and roasted sweet peppers on 4 of the bread slices. Step 3: Top with remaining bread slices, mayonnaise sides down. Step 4: Brush both sides of each sandwich with oil. Step 5: Place sandwiches in the sandwich press or indoor grill. Step 6: Cover and cook about 6 minutes or until bread is toasted (if using a grill pan or skillet, place sandwiches on grill pan Weight sandwiches down and grill about 2 minutes or until bread is lightly toasted. Step 7: Turn sandwiches over, weight down, and grill until remaining side is lightly toasted.

Ingredient Names: chicken, pepperoni slice, olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 400f degrees. Step 2: Wash and dry chicken Loosen skin from body in areas of the neck, armpits and legs Evenly slide pepperoni pieces between skin and body, starting at the top, working down Salt and pepper bird, tuck the wings in Slide chicken onto roasting stand, brush with oil. Step 3: Place in 400 oven for 20 minutes. Step 4: Lower heat to 325 and finsh out the hour. Step 5: Remove from oven, let rest 15 minutes Carve into 8's.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomato sauce, pesto sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spoon a little tomato sauce in a baking pan to cover the bottom and lay chicken breasts on top. Step 2: Add more sauce around breasts as desired, but only enough to come a little way up the sides of the chicken - make sure the top is uncovered! Step 3: Divide and spread pesto on each chicken breast, adjusting the quantity depending on how much you like pesto - i use a lot! Step 4: Bake at 350 for 30-40 minutes until chicken is done The exact amount of time will vary depending on the size / thickness of your chicken, so you have to watch them About 5-10 minutes before chicken is done, top each breast with shredded cheese. Step 5: Serve chicken breasts with or without pasta, spooning sauce from the pan around or on top of chicken.

Ingredient Names: pesto sauce, pizza crust, cooked chicken breast, artichoke hearts, fontina cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Step 2: Spread pesto sauce over the pizza crust. Step 3: Arrange chicken pieces and artichoke hearts over the sauce, and sprinkle with cheese. Step 4: Bake for 8 to in the preheated oven, until cheese is melted and lightly browned at the edges.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, yellow bell pepper, onion, zucchini, balsamic vinegar, mushroom, basil, mozzarella cheese, pesto sauce, cherry tomatoes, hoagie rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl, toss to coat. Step 2: Heat a large pot or dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add chicken mixture and cook, stirring frequently, until chicken begins to brown, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add yellow bell pepper, onion, zucchini, and balsamic vinegar and cook until onion begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir mushrooms and 1 tablespoon basil into chicken mixture and cook until mushrooms have softened, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add mozzarella cheese and pesto sauce, toss to coat. Step 7: Stir in cherry tomatoes and cook until warmed through, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 8: Spoon chicken mixture into toasted buns and top each sandwich with 1 / 4 cup feta cheese and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons basil.

Dish Name: Chicken Piccata A Delicious Italian Chicken Dish
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg, flour, parmesan cheese, paprika, kosher salt, ground black pepper, unsalted butter, extra virgin olive oil, white onion, shallot, garlic cloves, sweet vermouth, bouillon, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly wash and pat dry chicken Pound chicken flat - 1 / 2 inch. Step 2: Beat the egg in a bowl large enough to hold chicken. Step 3: In a shallow pie plate, combine flour, parmesan, paprika, salt and pepper. Step 4: Dip chicken in egg, then in flour mixture until well coated. Step 5: Heat a wide skillet and melt the butter, then add the olive oil. Step 6: When hot, add the chicken Quickly brown the chicken on both sides, adding more butter and oil as needed. Step 7: Remove chicken to serving platter, keep warm In the drippings, saut' the onion, shallot, and garlic for about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, all-purpose flour, olive oil, shallots, garlic cloves, chicken broth, fresh lemon juice, sherry wine, salt, white pepper, dried basil, pimento stuffed olive, sour cream, potato starch, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly dust chicken pieces with flour In pressure cooker, heat oil. Step 2: Add chicken breasts, two at a time, and saute in hot oil until brown on all sides, using long-handled tongs to turn, set aside. Step 3: Add shallots and garlic and saute in oil, scraping bottom of pan to loosen browned particles remaining from chicken. Step 4: Stir in broth, lemon juice, sherry, salt, pepper, basil, and olives, mix well. Step 5: Add chicken pieces skin side down Secure lid Over medium-high heat, develop steam to high pressure.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, dry sherry, capers, extra virgin olive oil, margarine, paprika, fresh parsley, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the chicken pieces to flatten them slightly. Step 2: Season them with salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Heat an empty pan on high heat, then add the oil and one tablespoon of the margarine and allow that to get hot. Step 4: Then carefully add the chicken, making sure the oil doesn't splatter Doing this process will prevent the chicken from sticking If you heat the oil and pan together, or if the pan isn't hot enough, the chicken will stick Saut the chicken pieces for 1 minute on each side, or until they are cooked through. Step 5: Transfer the chicken with tongs to a platter and cover it loosely to keep it warm. Step 6: Pour off any remaining fat and oil from the skillet. Step 7: Return it to the stovetop and add the remaining 1 tablespoon margarine, the sherry, and the lemon juice, and bring the mixture to a boil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, salt, pepper, butter, olive oil, mushroom, chicken broth, lemon juice, capers, parmesan cheese, parsley, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Between 2 pieces of plastic wrap flatten chicken breasts to 1 / 4" thickness. Step 2: Mix together salt, pepper and flour Dredge in mixture Shake off excess flour and set aside. Step 3: Heat butter and oil in large skillet until sizzling. Step 4: Saute breasts app 15 minutes being careful not to overcook. Step 5: Remove from skillet and keep warm in low oven. Step 6: Add mushroom and saut a few minutes scraping the pan. Step 7: Add remaining ingredients and cook on med high heat for 5 minutes. Step 8: Return the breasts to the pan and reduce sauce until thickened.

Dish Name: Chicken Piccata With Summer Vegetable Pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil flavored cooking spray, red bell pepper, onion, zucchini, yellow squash, cherry tomatoes, garlic cloves, spaghetti, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, flour, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat Coat with cooking spray. Step 2: Add bell pepper and onion. Step 3: Saute 8 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Remove from pan and keep warm Recoat pan with cooking spray. Step 5: Add zucchini and yellow squash, saute 4 minutes or until crisp tender. Step 6: Add tomatoes and garlic, saute 2 minutes more. Step 7: Add squash mixture to onion mixture, keep warm.

Dish Name: Chicken Piccata with Angel Hair Pasta
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, ground black pepper, paprika, skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, garlic, butter, dry white wine, chicken broth, lemon juice, capers, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Whisk flour, pepper, and paprika together in a shallow dish. Step 3: Dredge chicken in flour mixture until evenly coated. Step 4: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add garlic; cook and stir until golden and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes; transfer to a plate. Step 6: Melt butter in the same skillet. Step 7: Add chicken and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side; transfer to a plate. Step 8: Pour wine into the hot skillet and bring to a boil over high heat, scraping the browned bits from the bottom and sides of the pan with a wooden spoon. Step 9: Boil until wine is reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Whisk in chicken broth, reserved garlic, lemon juice, and capers; cook for 5 minutes. Step 11: Stir in parsley and remaining butter. Step 12: Reduce the heat to medium, return chicken to the skillet, and continue cooking until sauce thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 14: Cook angel hair pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 4 to, drain well. Step 15: Transfer chicken pieces to a serving dish and drizzle with a few tablespoons sauce. Step 16: Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with remaining sauce. Step 17: Portion noodles onto serving plates and top with chicken.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, italian seasoning, skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, garlic, onion, white wine, chicken broth, lemon juice, capers, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the flour, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning on a plate. Step 2: One by one, dredge the chicken pieces lightly in the prepared flour mixture. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cook the chicken pieces for 5 minutes per side, or until nicely browned. Step 5: Remove from the skillet and set aside. Step 6: Using the same skillet, cook and stir the garlic and onion until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Pour the white wine into the skillet, turn the heat to high, and cook until the wine reduces by half, 4 to. Step 8: Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, artichoke hearts, reserved artichoke liquid, and browned chicken to the skillet. Step 9: Reduce the heat to medium and cook until the sauce thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Stir in the capers and butter.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, all-purpose flour, butter, olive oil, white wine, lemon juice, capers, minced garlic, salt, ground black pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Place each chicken breast between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap. Step 2: Pound breasts to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet or small heavy skillet. Step 3: Spread flour into a wide, shallow dish. Step 4: Press chicken into flour to coat completely. Step 5: Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; cook chicken in hot butter mixture until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 3 to per side. Step 6: Remove chicken to a serving platter and cover with a lid to keep warm. Step 7: Pour white wine, lemon juice, capers, and garlic into the skillet. Step 8: Bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food from the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spoon; cook at a boil until slightly thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper. Step 10: Drizzle sauce over and around chicken; garnish with parsley.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, butter, olive oil, egg, flour, italian breadcrumbs, brandy, garlic clove, shallot, heavy cream, mushroom, fresh spinach, gorgonzola, fontina, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dust chicken breast in flour, then dip in egg, followed by a coating of breadcrumbs Pan fry lightly on medium / high heat with olive oil and butter for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown. Step 2: Stir in garlic, shallots, brandy, spinach, mushrooms, heavy cream, salt and pepper. Step 3: Simmer to reduce for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add gorgonzola, then turn off heat. Step 5: Place chicken breast in heat-resistant dish and pour sauce over the chicken. Step 6: Top with fontina or mozzarella and bake at 350 degrees for 6-8 minutes, or until cheese is melted and golden. Step 7: Serve with steamed asparagus.

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, chicken breast, limes, white wine, cracked black pepper, garlic, olive oil, baby spinach leaves, fresh basil, red potatoes, mozzarella cheese, gorgonzola
Instructions: Step 1: Slice raw chicken breasts to 1 / 8 inch thinkness The breasts may be cut in to cubes if preferred. Step 2: Marinate chicken in the juice of two limes, wine, pepper and garlic for at least 30 minutes. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350f oil 9x9 pan with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Step 4: Place marinated chicken in oiled pan. Step 5: Bake 30 minutes or until done. Step 6: Turn oven temperature up to 400f. Step 7: Brush pizza crust with remaining olive oil. Step 8: Sprinkle spinach then basil over the crust. Step 9: Arrange chicken and potatoes over greens.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, zucchini, pepperoni, green peppers, onions, garlic, oregano, fresh basil, salt, pepper, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a big mixing bowl, add the chicken pieces, olive oil, zucchini, pepperoni, green pepper, onion,garlic, oregano, basil, and salt and pepper; toss to combine. Step 2: Coat 4 (12-inch square) pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil with non-stick cooking spray. Step 3: Place one-fourth of the chicken mixture onto the center of each piece of foil. Step 4: Fold foil around chicken mixture and seal tightly. Step 5: Grill, covered, over medium-hot coals for 15-20-25 minutes or until chicken juices run clear. Step 6: Open each packet (carefully) and sprinkle with tomatoes and cheeses; seal loosely. Step 7: Grill 2 minutes more or until cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breasts, salt, black pepper, potatoes, onion, green bell peppers, dried oregano, red pepper flakes, italian-style diced tomatoes, tomato paste, low sodium chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Season the chicken on both sides with the salt and pepper. Step 4: Saute the breasts until browned on both sides. Step 5: Transfer the chicken to a large plate, and cover. Step 6: Add the potatoes, onion, peppers, oregano, and pepper flakes to the skillet. Step 7: Saute for 10 to 15 minutes, until just tender. Step 8: Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, and broth. Step 9: Bring it to a boil, and remove from the heat. Step 10: Add the chicken breasts to the skillet, cover tightly, and place in the oven.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flour, salt, pepper, vegetable oil, vodka, low sodium chicken broth, fresh lemon juice, tomatoes, heavy cream, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts between 2 pieces of thick plastic wrap and pound until meat is 1 / 4" thick. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet. Step 3: Season chicken with salt& pepper, then dust with flour. Step 4: Saute chicken in oil till golden then remove to a platter. Step 5: Pour off fat from pan. Step 6: Remove pan from heat and add vodka, stir, return to heat and cook stirring until vodka is nearly gone to deglaze the pan. Step 7: Add broth and lemon juice to pan. Step 8: Return chicken to pan, cook each side 1 minute then transfer to a warm platter. Step 9: Add tomatoes and cream to pan. Step 10: Heat through, then pour over the chicken.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodle, boneless chicken breast, fresh mushrooms, carrot, spring onion, frozen green pea, thyme, salt, all-purpose flour, skim milk, dry sherry, red pepper, low-fat ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, lowfat swiss cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta according to package directions Spray a dutch oven or large skillet with cooking spray. Step 2: Place over medium-high heat until hot. Step 3: Add chicken and saute 4 minutes or until cooked through. Step 4: Drain well and set aside Recoat dutch oven with cooking spray and place over medium-high heat until hot. Step 5: Add mushrooms, carrots and onions, saute 6 minutes, set aside. Step 6: Place flour in a medium saucepan.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, red wine vinegar, garlic cloves, salt and pepper, rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up the chicken breasts into bite sized pieces. Step 2: Heat pan to medium heat and add olive oil. Step 3: Fry chicken until golden brown. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and add garlic cloves, rosemary, salt and pepper, and red wine vinegar. Step 5: Cook on low for 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaves, salt and pepper, prosciutto, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken on cutting board Holding sharp knife horizontal to board, cut a 3-in -deep pocket lengthwise in each breast. Step 2: Stuff each pocket with one slice of mozzarella cheese and two basil leaves. Step 3: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Step 4: Wrap two slices prosciutto around each chicken breast. Step 5: Heat oil in a large ovenproof skillet. Step 6: Add chicken and cook over medium-high heat until browned, about 3 minutes each side. Step 7: Transfer chicken in skillet to oven. Step 8: Bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes or until juices run clear.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, provolone cheese, genoa salami, fresh basil leaf, olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, heavy whipping cream, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta and set aside Butterfly chicken breasts. Step 2: Place boned side up and pound thin. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper Lay provolone, salami and torn basil leaves on one side of the butterflied breasts. Step 4: Fold breast in thirds In nonstick skillet heat a little olive oil along with red pepper flakes Brown chicken. Step 5: Cook over medium-low heat, covered, until juices run clear While chicken is cooking, melt butter in saucepan and add 1 cup heavy cream.

Ingredient Names: linguine, chicken breasts, extra virgin olive oil, hot red pepper flakes, salt and pepper, dry white wine, onion, garlic, shiitake mushroom caps, tomato paste, chicken broth, red bell pepper, water, saffron, diced tomatoes with basil and garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Put a pot of water on to boil for cooking linguine. Step 2: Cut chicken breasts into strips. Step 3: In a bowl toss chicken with 1 teaspoon oil, 1 / 8 teaspoon red pepper flakes and salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Heat a 12-inch non-stick skillet over moderately high heat and saute in 2 batches until lightly browned and cooked through, stirring, for 5 minutes on each side, transferring as cooked to a plate To skillet add wine and boil until most is evaporated. Step 5: Add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil, onion, garlic, mushrooms, remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon red pepper flakes and salt and pepper to taste and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until onion is softened and mushroom liquid is gone. Step 6: In a bowl whisk together tomato paste, chicken broth and lemon zest. Step 7: Add to skillet along with the red pepper. Step 8: Simmer mixture, covered, 5 minutes. Step 9: Add tomatoes, lemon juice, and simmer5 minutes - add lemon juice and spinach, bail, and parsley.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, tomato paste, water, tomato sauce, whole tomato, ground cloves, allspice, pepper, salt, cinnamon, rosemary, dried parsley, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, brown chicken on each side for about 5 minutes, remove from pan and set aside. Step 2: In a large pot break up the whole tomatoes, add the onions, tomato sauces, water and mushrooms. Step 3: Bring to a boil, turn down heat and add chicken and spices. Step 4: Cook uncovered for about 2 hours or until chicken is done and sauce thickens Crockpot- if you prefer, brown the chicken and put everything together into a crockpot to cook, but allow more time for cooking This is good served with noodles- rigatoni or otherwise.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, parmesan cheese, garlic clove, butter, prosciutto, mozzarella cheese, white wine, olive oil, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f Pound chicken breasts flat. Step 2: Sprinkle parmesan cheese on both sides. Step 3: Place a pinch of minced garlic and 1 teaspoon butter in the center of each breast. Step 4: Cover each breast with a layer of prosciutto and mozzarella cheese. Step 5: Roll up each chicken breast, and secure with toothpicks. Step 6: In a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine white wine and olive oil. Step 7: Arrange chicken rolls in dish. Step 8: Place a small piece of prosciutto on top of each roll, and sprinkle with pepper. Step 9: Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink, an juices run clear.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, smoked ham, tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, spaghetti, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, low sodium chicken broth, olive oil, garlic powder, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350 lightly season chicken with garlic powder and black pepper. Step 2: Heat olive oil in large skillet on m-high Quickly sear chicken and remove from pan Saut mushrooms in skillet until about half cooked add chicken stock Spray casserole dish with no-stick spray. Step 3: Place chicken in casserole dish. Step 4: Add a layer of tomato to each chicken breast followed by a layer of ham and a layer of mushrooms, add stock, cover with foil and bake for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Step 5: Add cheeses to top of each breast and return to oven uncovered. Step 6: Bake until cheeses are melted. Step 7: Serve chicken on bed of pasta with some of juice from pan.

Dish Name: Chicken Roulades With Apricot Stuffing Apricot Nectar
Ingredient Names: stuffing cubes, onion, celery, fresh basil leaf, dried apricots, raisins, unsalted margarine, chicken broth, apricot nectar, dijon mustard, boneless skinless chicken breast, cornmeal, olive oil, dry white wine, arrowroot
Instructions: Step 1: In a 10 inch skillet, cook onion, celery and basil in the margarine over moderate heat 5 minutes, until onion is softened. Step 2: Stir in apricots, raisins and 1 / 4 cup broth and cook until almost all liquid is evaporated, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Add mixture to bread cubes with salt and pepper to taste and toss until combined well. Step 4: Let stuffing cool Stuffing may be made a day ahead and refrigerated. Step 5: In a measuring cup, whisk together the apricot nectar, mustard and remaining cup of broth, and reserve Gently pound chicken breasts 1 at a time, between 2 sheets of plastic wrap until about 1 / 4 inch thick, trying not to make any holes in them. Step 6: Discard plastic and season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 7: Spoon stuffing down a long side of each cutlet, leaving a 1 / 2-inch border along the edge. Step 8: Roll up cutlets tightly to enclose stuffing, and secure top and seams, openings at both ends and any holes with wooden toothpicks.

Ingredient Names: bacon, skinless chicken thighs, salt and pepper, all-purpose flour, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, crushed tomatoes, oregano, dry red wine, fresh parsley, kalamata olive, cannellini beans, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Instructions: brown bacon in large deep pan. Step 2: Remove bacon, leaving 1-2 t Drippings in pan. Step 3: Dust chicken pieces with flour, salt and pepper Brown chicken pieces 4 minutes each side in bacon fat. Step 4: Remove to platter when browned both sides. Step 5: Make sauce: heat oil, add chopped onion Saut over low heat 6-8 minutes. Step 6: Add garlic, saut 2 more minutes. Step 7: Add all other sauce ingredients and mix.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh mushrooms, chicken broth, dry red wine, spicy brown mustard, plum tomatoes, artichoke hearts, hot pepper flakes, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, dried parsley flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large nonstick skillet over med-high heat. Step 3: Cook chicken for 5 minutes or until browned on both sides. Step 4: Remove and set aside. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in same skillet oven med-high heat until hot. Step 6: Add mushrooms, cook and stir for 5 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Step 7: Stir in broth, wine and mustard, and pepper flakes. Step 8: Return chiken to skillet. Step 9: Add tomatoes, artichoke hearts, heat to boiling.

Ingredient Names: shallot, red wine vinegar, dijon mustard, garlic clove, salt, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, tomatoes, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, egg, dry breadcrumbs, unsalted butter, baby arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the shallot, vinegar, mustard, garlic paste, and a large pinch of pepper in a large bowl. Step 2: Add 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a slow steady stream, whisking constantly, until the dressing emulsifies. Step 3: Add the tomatoes to the vinaigrette and set aside until ready to serve, up to 2 hours. Step 4: Mix 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and pepper in a small cup Pound the chicken to 3 / 8 inch thick between two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Step 5: Season with some of the salt and pepper. Step 6: Beat the egg in a wide shallow bowl until smooth. Step 7: Spread the breadcrumbs on a plate. Step 8: Dip a chicken breast into the egg, coating thoroughly and shaking off any excess. Step 9: Then dip it into the breadcrumbs, patting on the crumbs so both sides are well coated and shaking off any excess.

Ingredient Names: chicken cutlets, salt, black pepper, sage leaves, prosciutto, olive oil, dry white wine, low-sodium chicken broth, butter
Instructions: Step 1: If cutlets are thick, lay them between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound to 1/2-inch thickness using the flat side of a meat mallet or the bottom of a small, heavy skillet. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Place 2 large sage leaves on top of each cutlet, then wrap prosciutto crosswise around each cutlet, holding sage in place. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add 4 cutlets and cook until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes per side. Step 6: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).聽Transfer to a platter; tent with foil to keep warm. Step 7: Repeat with remaining olive oil and remaining 4 cutlets. Step 8: Pour wine into the same skillet; simmer, scraping up any browned bits with a wooden spoon, about 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Pour in broth and simmer until slightly reduced, 4 to. Step 10: Remove from heat; add butter and swirl the skillet until butter has melted and sauce is creamy. Step 11: Spoon sauce over each cutlet to serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, salt and pepper, prosciutto, spinach, olive oil, parmesan cheese, lemon, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Put spinach in a bowl and season with olive oil, salt and pepper to taste, set aside. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper Lay chicken flat and top each piece of chicken with one slice of prosciutto. Step 3: Top each chicken with a thin layer of spinach. Step 4: Sprinkle each chicken with parmesan cheese. Step 5: Roll each chicken and pin with two toothpicks, roll them as tight as you can. Step 6: Heat olive oil in pan and place chicken in pan cook for about three minutes per side. Step 7: Add chicken broth squeeze a little bit of the lemon into pan. Step 8: Turn heat to medium low and simmer for ten minutes. Step 9: Remove chicken from pan turn heat to low until sauce thickens up just a little bit,.

Ingredient Names: parmesan cheese, seasoned dry bread crumbs, salt, pepper, butter, ham, mozzarella cheese, crepes, chicken, plum tomatoes, seasoning salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine Parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, and salt and pepper to taste in a shallow bowl, place melted butter in small bowl, and set conveniently by work area. Step 2: Place a slice of ham and a slice of cheese on each crepe. Step 3: Top with a little diced chicken and chopped tomato, and sprinkle generously with seasoned salt or poultry seasoning (seasoned salt is actually best). Step 4: Roll up crepes, folding in ends as you go. Step 5: Dip each rolled crepe in butter, then in bread crumb mixture, pressing on breadcrumbs to make them adhere. Step 6: Place in a shallow baking dish. Step 7: Drizzle with any remaining butter and sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Step 8: Bake at 350 degrees F for 30-40 minutes or until heated through and lightly browned on top.

Ingredient Names: lemon, chicken broth, cornstarch, butter, boneless skinless chicken thighs, fresh sage leaves, salt, asparagus, prosciutto
Instructions: Step 1: From lemon, grate 1 teaspoons peel and squeeze 1 tablespoons juice. Step 2: In a 2-cup liquid measuring cup, combine broth, cornstarch, and lemon juice. Step 3: In a nonstick 12-inch skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken, sage, salt, and lemon peel and cook 4 to 5 minutes or until chicken just loses its pink color throughout. Step 5: Transfer chicken to a medium bowl In same skillet, cook asparagus 3 to 4 minutes or until just tender crisp, stirring frequently. Step 6: Transfer asparagus to bowl with chicken. Step 7: Stir broth mixture and add to skillet. Step 8: Heat to boiling, stirring, boil 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: prosciutto, olive oil, chicken breasts, garlic clove, artichoke hearts, fresh sage, lemon, capers, white wine, chicken broth, cream, pine nuts, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large sauce pan. Step 2: Add 1 tablespoons of olive oil and gently brown the proscuitto over medium heat until almost crisp The prosciutto will crisp up when cool Careful, it does burn easily. Step 3: Remove from pan and cool In the prosciutto drippings brown chicken that is seasoned with salt and pepper. Step 4: When chicken is almost done, add garlic and saute for 1 minute Keeping chicken in the pan, deglaze with white wine. Step 5: Cook for 2 minutes then add chicken broth, capers, sage and lemon zest. Step 6: Cook until juice is reduced a little then add artichokes and cream.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, butter, garlic, skinless chicken breast halves, salt, ground black pepper, sliced mushrooms, white wine, lemon juice, chopped fresh parsley, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Place flour into a shallow dish. Step 2: Mix butter and garlic together in a small bowl until well combined. Step 3: Use a very sharp knife to slice horizontally through the thick part of each chicken breast to about from the thinner edge; be careful not to cut all the way through. Step 4: Open each breast like a book and place onto a work surface. Step 5: Gently pound each breast to a uniform thickness, then dredge on both sides with flour. Step 6: Melt garlic butter in a large skillet over medium heat until it stops foaming. Step 7: Add chicken and cook until golden brown, 6 to per side. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Remove to a platter and cover to keep warm. Step 10: Cook mushrooms in remaining butter in the skillet until beginning to turn brown at the edges, 5 to. Step 11: Stir in wine, demi-glace, lemon juice, and capers. Step 12: Reduce the heat to a simmer, season with salt and pepper, and stir in parsley. Step 13: Transfer chicken to plates and spoon sauce over top. Step 14: Garnish with lemon slices.

Ingredient Names: butter, lemon juice, white wine, garlic, spaghetti, chicken, chicken breasts, flour, roma tomato, sliced mushrooms, cooked bacon, salt, pepper, garlic powder, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lemon butter ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat at a medium speed until a smooth consistency in the batter is formed. Step 2: Once combined, keep refrigerated until needed. Step 3: Put spaghetti on to boil & prepare as you usually would, to al dente While it is cooking: Butterfly each chicken breast, or place between 2 pcs of plastic wrap, flatten with a mallet. Step 4: In a warm saute pan, melt butter Dredge chicken in flour. Step 5: Saute chicken in butter until it is golden browned & just done. Step 6: Remove to a warm plate or warming plate or oven To pan, add tomatoes, mushrooms, bacon, and spice mixture.

Dish Name: Chicken Scaloppine With Hazelnut Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, butter, canola oil, shallot, madeira wine, heavy whipping cream, hazelnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Remove tenderloins from chicken breast halves. Step 2: Slice each chicken breast half on diagonal into 4 cutlets. Step 3: Place cutlets and tenderloins between 2 pieces of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Step 4: Using mallet, pound each piece to about 1 / 3-inch thickness. Step 5: Sprinkle pounded chicken with salt and pepper on both sides. Step 6: Melt butter with oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat Working in batches, add chicken to skillet and saut until lightly browned and cooked through, about 1- 1 / 2 minutes per side. Step 7: Transfer chicken to plate. Step 8: Cover to keep warm. Step 9: Add shallot to same skillet and saut until tender, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, dijon mustard, egg, fresh breadcrumbs, rosemary, thyme, marjoram, sage, fresh ground black pepper, kosher salt, garlic powder, olive oil, butter, chicken broth, limoncello
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk mustard and egg in a small bowl. Step 2: Put bread crumbs on a large shallow plate and top with equal big pinches of rosemary, thyme, marjoram and sage and a few cranks of the pepper mill Literally pinch the herbs to help release the flavor. Step 3: Sprinkle with a pinch of kosher salt and garlic powder. Step 4: Mix thoroughly with your fingers. Step 5: Heat oil and butter in a large saute pan on medium-high heat. Step 6: Dip the breasts in egg / mustard mixture and dredge in crumbs. Step 7: Cook chicken for 3-4 minutes a side, or until it is no longer pink inside and the crumbs are a nice golden color. Step 8: Remove and transfer to a plate to keep warm. Step 9: Add broth and limoncello to the empty pan and scrape the brown bits with a rubber spatula.

Dish Name: Chicken Scaloppine With Prosciutto Mozzarella And Marsala
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, prosciutto, eggs, flour, unsalted butter, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, dry marsala, low sodium chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts between pieces of waxed paper and pound them with a mallet until about 1 / 4" thick Lay out slices of prosciutto side by side on counter, with the length of the slice facing away from you. Step 2: Place one of the chicken cutlets on top of 3 or 4 prosciutto slices. Step 3: Fold the upper and lower edges of the prosciutto slices in and over the chicken cutlet The cutlet will be partially covered by the prosciutto. Step 4: Flip the cutlet over and it will be totally covered. Step 5: Repeat with all 4 cutlets Break eggs into a wide shallow bowl and beat well. Step 6: Place enough flour to dust the chicken in another wide shallow bowl. Step 7: Dip each cutlet into the egg, coating well.

Dish Name: Chicken Scaloppine With Sage And Fontina Cheese Giada
Ingredient Names: chicken cutlets, salt, fresh ground pepper, sage leaves, fontina cheese, olive oil, garlic clove, white wine, whole tomatoes, red pepper flakes, toothpicks
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken cutlets on clean work surface with narrow end facing you. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Place one sage leaf crosswise on each piece of chicken. Step 4: Sprinkle each piece of chicken with about 2 tbs Of fontina cheese. Step 5: Roll up chicken and secure with one or two toothpicks Warm olive oil and halved garlic clove in large skillet over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken and brown on all sides, about 3 mins per side. Step 7: Remove chicken and remove and discard garlic halves. Step 8: Add wine and simmer for about 2 mins, while scraping up brown bits from bottom of pan with wooden spoon.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, old bay seasoning, flour, butter, olive oil, garlic cloves, scallions, white wine, fresh lemon juice, fresh parsley, salt and pepper, red pepper flakes, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and towel dry chicken. Step 2: Mix old bay and flour together Coat chicken pieces with old bay and flour mixture, set aside. Step 3: Heat butter and oil in large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Saute garlic 1 minutes to soften. Step 5: Add chicken, green onions, and brown on one side. Step 6: Add wine and lemon juice. Step 7: Cook chicken on the other side. Step 8: Add chopped parsley.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, egg, breadcrumbs, romano cheese, onion, olive oil, garlic, arborio rice, white wine, chicken broth, butter, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Beat egg in a large bowl. Step 2: Add chicken pieces and toss to coat. Step 3: Combine bread crumbs with 1 / 4 cup grated cheese in a large bowl. Step 4: Add chicken and toss well. Step 5: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a large, non-stick skillet over medium high heat. Step 6: Add half of chicken and stir fry about 5 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Step 7: Drain on paper towels. Step 8: Repeat with remaining chicken and 3 more tablespoons oil In same skillet, heat remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium high heat. Step 9: Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is softened, but not browned.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, buttermilk, butter, onions, garlic, bacon, salt, pepper, marsala wine, flour, italian parsley, dried sage, dried rosemary, philadelphia cream cheese
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare chicken: use a whole breast with the back removed, split lengthwise at the breast bone. Step 2: Remove skin, salt and pepper each piece. Step 3: Place in a large bowl. Step 4: Add 2 cups buttermilk to tenderize for about an hour. Step 5: In a black iron skillet on the stovetop, over medium heat, melt 1 / 2 stick of butter. Step 6: Add onions, garlic and bacon. Step 7: Cook just until onions are translucent about 7 minutes. Step 8: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 9: Place buttermilk-coated pieces of chicken in hot skillet to quickly get some color. Step 10: Remove and repeat with the remaining chicken.

Ingredient Names: broiler-fryer chickens, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, garlic, fresh parsley, dried rosemary, dry white wine, whipping cream, parmesan cheese, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and dry chicken pieces. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet Brown chicken over high heat, add garlic. Step 4: Lower heat and saute for 10 minutes, drain off fat. Step 5: Add parsley, rosemary and wine. Step 6: Simmer about 15 minutes or until wine evaporates and chicken is done. Step 7: Remove chicken to a platter.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken, italian sausage, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, cherry peppers, onion, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried rosemary leaves, chicken broth, dry white wine, all-purpose flour, fresh lemon juice, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat oil. Step 2: Add chicken and sausage in batches Brown on all sides Removing pieces to a plate as they brown. Step 3: Discard all but 2 tablespoons drippings from pan To hot drippings, add the mushrooms, red bell peppers, sliced cherry peppers, onion, potatoes, and garlic. Step 4: Saute until tender. Step 5: Return chicken and sausage to skillet. Step 6: Add salt, black pepper, the rosemary, the broth, the wine, and lemon juice, bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Chicken Scarpariello Roast Chicken In Lemon Wine
Ingredient Names: roasting chickens, all-purpose flour, salt & pepper, oregano, olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, fresh rosemary, chicken broth, white wine, lemon, unsalted butter, flour, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Mix together the flour and oregano, and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Rinse and dry the chicken pieces, and then dredge them lightly in the seaoned flour mixture. Step 4: In a heavy, ovenproof skillet, large enough to hold all of the chicken pieces, heat the olive oil, and then brown the chicken well on all sides over medium heat Be careful not to burn the oil by using too hot of a heat. Step 5: Once all of the pieces are well browned, remove them to a plate. Step 6: Pour out the left over oil in the pan, leaving just a tablespoon or two with the browned bits at the bottom. Step 7: Add the onion and cook until soft, and then add the garlic As soon as the garlic begins to sizzle, add the wine, and stir the browned bits at the bottom while you reduce the wine by half over medium high heat. Step 8: Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, italian sausage, chicken, bell pepper, red pepper, yellow onion, garlic, chicken broth, dry white wine, sweet bell pepper, cherry pepper, vinegar, dried oregano, salt and pepper, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Saute sausage until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Step 2: Drain and set aside.
