Step 3: Heat oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat Pat chicken dry and saute for about 15 minutes or until almost cooked through. Step 4: Stir in peppers, onion, and garlic and saute for about 5 minutes, or until veges are tender and beginning to brown. Step 5: Drain off all excess oil. Step 6: Add sausage to the pan. Step 7: Add wine and chicken broth to chicken, sausage, and vegetables and bring to a boil. Step 8: Stir in hot vinegared peppers, vinegar, oregano and salt and pepper to taste. Step 9: Bring all to a boil, lower heat and simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes until sauce is reduced.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, olive oil, green pepper, red pepper, onions, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, dried oregano, italian seasoning, salt and pepper, cooked linguine
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick frying pan, heat oil and brown chicken breasts over medium heat. Step 2: Remove chicken from heat and set aside In the same pan, saut peppers and onions until slightly limp. Step 3: Add garlic and stir As soon as you smell the garlic, add crushed tomatoes and tomato sauce. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients Spices can be increased, decreased or altered to taste. Step 5: Return chicken to pan. Step 6: Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Step 7: Serve over linguine.

Ingredient Names: chicken, chicken back, carrots, celery ribs, onions, flat leaf parsley, black peppercorns, salt, orzo pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the chicken and chicken parts. Step 2: Set aside giblets for another use. Step 3: Place chicken and chicken parts in a 6-quart pot. Step 4: Add cold water to cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low and cook 30 minutes Skim off foam and fat that rises to the surface. Step 6: Add vegetables, parsley, peppercorns and salt to taste. Step 7: Simmer 1 1 / 2 hours or until chicken is tender If needed, add more water to keep the chicken submerged. Step 8: Remove the chicken from the pot and set the pot aside.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour, chicken broth, half-and-half, sour cream, parmesan cheese, dry white wine, garlic, lemon juice, dry mustard, salt, pepper, chicken breasts, spaghetti, paprika, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a saucepan and add flour stirring constantly. Step 2: When mixture thickens, add chicken broth, half and half, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, wine, garlic, lemon juice, dry mustard and salt and pepper. Step 3: Stir over medium heat until mixture again starts to thicken. Step 4: Add chicken and spaghetti noodles and stir well. Step 5: Place in a baking dish and sprinkle with paprika and extra Parmesan cheese. Step 6: Bake for 30 minutes at 350°. Step 7: Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, brown onion, carrot, celery ribs, garlic cloves, chicken, tomato sauce, dried basil, dried thyme, flat leaf parsley, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, carrot, celery and garlic. Step 3: Cook, stirring often, for 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Step 4: Add chicken and cook, stirring for 8-10 minutes or until browned. Step 5: Add passata, basil, thyme, and half of the parsley. Step 6: Stir until well combined and mixture comes to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 8: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water according to packet directions. Step 9: Serve pasta topped with the bolognaise sauce and remaining parsley.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, lemon juice, basil leaves, garlic cloves, red pepper, fresh coarse ground black pepper, salt, parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, dried basil, dried oregano, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken and cut each breast into 8 pieces. Step 2: Mix olive oil with lemon, fresh diced basil, garlic, red pepper flakes, black pepper and salt Reserve 1 / 4 cup of oil mixture. Step 3: Marinate chicken in remaining oil mixture in the refrigerator overnight --next day-- bring water to a boil for pasta. Step 4: Drain the chicken and roll the chunks in a mixture of breadcrumbs, dried basil, oregano and parmesan cheese Skewer and put chicken on the grill, turning until done Or fry the chicken in olive oil until browned on all sides. Step 5: Toss the cooked fettuccine noodles or penne with the reserved oil mixture and serve.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, frozen spinach, onion, garlic cloves, butter, chicken strips, dijon mustard, coarse grain mustard, light cream, parmesan cheese, salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic bread
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in a pan of boiling, salted water until al dente, and drain. Step 2: Mix the mustards and cream in a small bowl until they are well-combined Thaw and drain spinach, squeeze out moisture and chop coarsely Saut the onion and garlic in butter over a medium heat until it has just softened but not browned, add chicken. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes or until it has changed colour and is clearly cooked through. Step 4: Add the mustards and cream mixture and increase the heat so that the mixture just comes to the boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat slightly and stir in the cheese and spinach, mixing until everything is well-combined. Step 6: Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste. Step 7: Stir in the pasta, and make sure that everything is well-combined.

Ingredient Names: gnocchi, chicken broth, garlic cloves, unsalted butter, sugar, baby spinach leaves, cooked chicken, fresh ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a medium saucepan of cold water to a boil over high heat, then salt. Step 2: Add the gnocchi and cook, stirring occasionally for three minutes. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: Meanwhile, put l / 4 cup of the chicken broth, garlic, butter and sugar in a large saucepan over medium-low heat. Step 5: Bring it to a simmer, and cook uncovered, until under garlic is tender, about 1 minute. Step 6: Add the spinach and let it wilt for about 30 seconds. Step 7: Add the remaining 3 l / 4 cups chicken broth and the chicken. Step 8: Add salt, but be careful because the cheese is salty, and a generous amount of pepper, to taste Ladle the soup into warmed shallow bowls and shower each with some freshly grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, baby spinach, kraft shredded three cheese with a touch of philadelphia, philadelphia original cooking creme, parmesan cheese, green onions, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, manicotti, low-fat alfredo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Step 3: Cook manicotti per package directions. Step 4: Drain and rinse pasta with cool water Spray 2 13 x 9 casseroles w / cooking spray and place well-stuffed manicotti in casseroles Coat manicotti with alfredo sauce. Step 5: Garnish with additional parmesan and red pepper flakes if desired. Step 6: Cover casseroles with foil and bake at 400 of for 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Stuffed Shells With Tomato Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: pasta shells, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt and pepper, olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, carrots, celery, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh spinach, ricotta cheese, egg, romano cheese, fresh parsley, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook shells according to package directions. Step 2: Take 6 minutes off of cooking time. Step 3: Drain well, cool under cold running water, and toss with a minimal amount of olive oil to prevent sticking. Step 4: Meanwhile, season chicken on both sides with salt and pepper. Step 5: Cut into small pieces. Step 6: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Cook chicken until golden brown on both sides. Step 8: Drain on paper towels In same skillet, cook garlic, onion, carrot, celery and red pepper flakes, cook 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pancetta, olive oil, skinless chicken thighs, tomatoes with onion and garlic, orzo pasta, garlic cloves, water, kalamata olive, fresh basil, baby spinach leaves, garlic and herb goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a 5 to 6 quart dutch oven, cook pancetta until browned. Step 2: Remove pancetta, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings drain meat on paper towels & set aside Brown chicken in drippings about 10 minutes, turning to brown evenly, drain off fat. Step 3: Add undrained tomatoes, orzo, garlic & 1 cup water. Step 4: Bring to a boil & reduce heat. Step 5: Simmer, covered, 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken is done & orzo is tender If necessary, cook an additional 2-3 minutes uncovered to thicken the pan sauce. Step 6: Stir in pancetta, olives and basil & heat through To serve, divide spinach among 6 plates.

Dish Name: Chicken Tortellini Soup With Mushrooms And Spinach
Ingredient Names: butter, carrot, celery, onion, garlic, fresh thyme, mrs. dash seasoning mix, sliced mushrooms, low sodium chicken broth, cheese tortellini, cooked chicken, baby spinach leaves, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat the butter until melted. Step 2: Add the carrots, celery, onions, and garlic. Step 3: Saute until tender, about 8 minutes. Step 4: Add the mushrooms, fresh thyme, and mrs dash. Step 5: Saute another 5-8 minutes. Step 6: Add the broth and heat to almost boiling. Step 7: Add the tortellini and chicken and simmer until the tortellini are cooked through. Step 8: Add the spinach leaves and simmer for 5 minutes until the spinach is wilted. Step 9: Serve hot, topped with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, flour, salt and pepper, eggs, romano cheese, canola oil, parsley, mushrooms, garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Butterfly chicken breasts so they are thin Lightly season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Dust chicken breasts with flour. Step 3: Combine whole eggs and romano cheese to form a batter. Step 4: Fry chicken and mushrooms until golden brown. Step 5: Add garlic and saute 1 minute. Step 6: Season with additional salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Transfer chicken to platter. Step 8: Add butter to the skillet. Step 9: When melted add wine and lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, skinless chicken breast halves, unsalted butter, fresh mushrooms, dry white wine, chicken stock, chopped fresh parsley, ground white pepper, prosciutto, fontina cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly flour chicken breasts, shaking off excess flour. Step 2: In a large skillet over low heat, melt butter/margarine. Step 3: Add chicken and saute until lightly browned, about each side. Step 4: Remove with slotted spatula and set aside. Step 5: Increase heat to medium low. Step 6: Add mushrooms and saute until juices are rendered, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add wine and simmer until reduced by 1/4, about 3 to. Step 8: Increase heat to medium high. Step 9: Add stock, parsley and pepper and simmer until sauce reduced to, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Reduce heat to low. Step 11: Top each chicken breast with a slice of prosciutto and a slice of fontina cheese. Step 12: Return chicken to skillet and cook just until cheese melts. Step 13: Transfer chicken to individual plates and top each with some of the mushroom sauce before serving.

Ingredient Names: healthy request cream of mushroom soup, low-fat milk, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, mixed vegetables, chicken breasts, mozzarella cheese, whole wheat linguine, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil chicken breast until done, drain and allow chicken to cool, chop into cubes, set aside. Step 2: Steam vegetables, set aside. Step 3: Combine soup, milk, both cheeses, and garlic power and bring to simmer, boil pasta. Step 4: Add vegetables to soup mixture coat well and cover for ~10 minutes, add chicken. Step 5: Drain pasta once al dente. Step 6: Add pasta to mixture, simmer ~5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, butter, sliced mushrooms, garlic, light cream, salt and fresh pepper, parsley, frozen peas, fresh snow pea, parmesan cheese, provolone cheese, prosciutto ham, capellini
Instructions: Step 1: Saute chicken cubes in 2 tbsp butter. Step 2: Remove with slotted spoon and set aside. Step 3: Saute mushrooms in same skillet. Step 4: Remove with slotted spoon and set aside. Step 5: Add 1 / 4 cup butter, garlic, cream, salt, pepper, & parsley. Step 6: Boil on high heat just till slightly thickened, add frozen peas, cook 5 minutes. Step 7: Add chicken, mushrooms, parmesan, and snow peas. Step 8: Heat through until snow peas are just tender.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomatoes, artichoke hearts, onion, white wine, red pepper flakes, oregano, parsley flakes, lemon juice, seasoning salt, fresh ground black pepper, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f Spray shallow 2-quart casserole or baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Add ingredients in order given, mix gently. Step 3: Cover and bake 40 min, or until chicken breasts are tender to fork For thicker sauce, remove cover for the last 15 min of cook time May be made earlier in the day and stored in refrigerator until time to cook Also freezes for up to 6 wks.

Dish Name: Chicken With Balsamic Tomato Sauce And Goat Cheese
Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, garlic cloves, crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, dried oregano, dried basil, dried parsley flakes, balsamic vinegar, sugar, goat cheese, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Cook the bacon until some of the fat is rendered and add the onions. Step 3: Cook until the bacon is crispy and the onions are just caramelized. Step 4: Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds to 1 minute. Step 5: Remove the pan from the burner. Step 6: Add the cans of tomatoes, the oregano, basil, parsley, balsamic vinegar, and sugar to the bacon, onions, and garlic, mix to blend well. Step 7: Put the chicken in a glass baking dish. Step 8: Pour the sauce over the chicken. Step 9: Bake for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flour, salt and pepper, butter, fresh basil, red wine vinegar, parmesan cheese, sugar, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Flatten breasts, dip in flour, salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat butter in 12in skillet. Step 3: Add breasts, cook for 4 minutes each side until browned and juices run clear, remove from pan. Step 4: Mix basil with remaining ingredients. Step 5: Add to pan, cook and stir for 3 minutes, thicken with a little flour if needed. Step 6: Serve over chicken.

Dish Name: Chicken With Capers And Italian Olives
Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, salt, pepper, olive oil, dry white wine, italian olives, capers, bay leaf, chicken stock, whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken with salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Heat a non-stick frying pan and add oil Brown both sides and remove. Step 3: Transfer to a 4-6 quart pot. Step 4: Add the remaining ingredients, except cream, bring to a simmer. Step 5: Cook covered for 40 minutes. Step 6: Remove the chicken to a warm platter. Step 7: Add the cream to the pot simmer for 2-3 minutes to reduce and thicken Salt and pepper to taste, pour sauce over chicken.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, rosemary, salt, shallot, garlic, balsamic vinegar, plum tomatoes, chicken broth, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet. Step 2: Sprinkle both sides of the chicken with the rosemary and salt and add to the skillet. Step 3: Saute the chicken until browned and cooked through and remove to platter. Step 4: Then add the shallot and garlic to the same skillet. Step 5: Cook 2 minutes till softened, add the vinegar and stir to scrape up browned bits. Step 6: Cook till almost evaporated. Step 7: Stir in tomatoes and chicken broth, bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until the tomatoes just begin to soften, abouth 3 minutes. Step 9: Stir in basil, spoon sauce over chicken.

Dish Name: Chicken With Olives And White Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, chili-flavored olive oil, salt, pepper, capers, garlic cloves, green olives, black olives, white wine, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the skin from all chicken and wash well Pat chicken dry and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat chilli oil in the pot If you do not have chilli oil, you can make some easily You will need to take olive oil and heat it up. Step 3: Add lots of red pepper flakes and let it simmer for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Once the mixture is cool, that's chilli oil. Step 5: Add the chicken to the pot with the meatiest parts on the bottom Brown the chicken for about 10-12 minutes, making sure it doesn't stick to the pot or burn. Step 6: Turn over if necessary.

Ingredient Names: lemon, roasting chicken, orange, fresh gingerroot, salt, black pepper, margarine, fresh lemon juice, fresh orange juice, honey, orange section
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an oven to 350f degrees. Step 2: Cut the lemon into quarters Rub the outside of the chicken with one of the lemon quarters, then discard. Step 3: In a small bowl, stir together the lemon and orange zests and 1 tablespoon of the grated ginger Rub this mixture evenly in the cavity. Step 4: Put the lemon and orange quarters inside the bird. Step 5: Place the chicken on a rack in a roasting pan. Step 6: Sprinkle it with salt and pepper In the now-empty small bowl, combine the melted margarine or olive oil, lemon and orange juices, honey, and the remaining 2 tablespoons ginger, mix well.

Dish Name: Chicken With Prosciutto Rosemary And White Wine
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breast halves, chicken legs, chicken thighs, prosciutto, garlic, fresh rosemary, dry white wine, chicken broth, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Step 2: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper and brown in olive oil, about 4 minutes per side. Step 3: Remove chicken to platter. Step 4: Add prosciutto, garlic and rosemary to same pan and stir for one minute. Step 5: Add wine, chicken broth and tomatoes. Step 6: Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Step 7: Return chicken to pot, arranging in single layer. Step 8: Bring to a boil, remove from heat, cover and place in oven. Step 9: Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Step 10: Transfer chicken to serving platter.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, olive oil, mushrooms, fresh basil, garlic, prosciutto, plum tomatoes, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Step 2: Season chicken lightly w/salt and pepper. Step 3: In large nonstick skillet, brown chicken, half at a time, in olive oil 2-3 minutes per side. Step 4: Transfer chicken to 3 quart rectangular baking dish In same skillet, cook and stir mushrooms, basil and garlic until mushrooms are tender, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in proscuitto and tomatoes. Step 6: Bake chicken breasts uncovered for 20 minutes. Step 7: Spoon some of the mushroom mixture over each breast. Step 8: Sprinkle w/cheese. Step 9: Return to oven and bake 5 minutes more.

Dish Name: Chicken With Roasted Lemon And Rosemary Sauce
Ingredient Names: tiny new potatoes, lemons, extra virgin olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, boneless chicken breasts, garlic, low sodium chicken broth, fresh rosemary, fresh flat-leaf parsley, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Fill a pot with cold salted water, add potoates and bring to a boil for about 20 minutes or just until tender. Step 3: Drain and let cool, but do not peel. Step 4: Cut in half and set aside. Step 5: Preheat the broiler. Step 6: Cut a small slice off both ends of each lemon, then cut in half crosswise. Step 7: Place lemons, flesh side up, in a flameproof baking dish, brush with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper Broil lemons 6 inches or more from the heat until browned and soft, about 10 minutes, let cool. Step 8: Squeeze the lemon halves over a sieve suspended over a bowl.

Dish Name: Chicken With Sun Dried Tomato Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, olive oil, garlic cloves, sun-dried tomato, hot red pepper flakes, dry white wine, vegetable broth, heavy cream, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Pat dry chicken and season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat oil in a heavy skillet over moderately high heat and brown chicken, turning once, for about 6 minutes. Step 3: Transfer chicken to a plate. Step 4: Add garlic, tomatoes and pepper flakes to the skillet and saute until garlic is pale gold, approximately 1 minute. Step 5: Add broth, cover, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add chicken to skillet, cover and simmer for 4-5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer chicken to a platter with tongs and keep warm Loosely cover with foil. Step 8: Stir cream and 2 tbsp basil into sauce in skillet and bring to a simmer. Step 9: Transfer sauce to a heatproof bowl and puree with a hand blender.

Dish Name: Chicken With Tomato And Chorizo Sauce
Ingredient Names: chopped tomatoes, butter beans, honey, chorizo sausage, dried basil, chicken stock cube, sweet pepper, water, boneless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: In a pan add all the ingredients except for the chicken. Step 2: Simmer gently approx 20 minutes until beans are soft and sauce is thick. Step 3: Meanwhile roast the chicken pieces in the oven until cooked Approx 30 minutes. Step 4: Place 3-4 tablespoons of sauce onto a plate and arrange a breast of chicken on top This dish can be served with rice, pasta or potatoes.

Dish Name: Chicken With Tomato Sauce And Bacon Pollo Alla Campagna
Ingredient Names: chicken, salt, fresh ground black pepper, flour, butter, olive oil, lean bacon, shallot, firm ripe tomatoes, dry white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Pat the chicken completely dry with paper towels. Step 2: Sprinkle the pieces on all sides with the salt and a few grindings of pepper. Step 3: Then coat the chicken with flour and shake each piece vigorously to remove any excess. Step 4: In a heavy 10- to 12-inch skillet, melt 3 tblsp Of the butter with 2 tblsp Of the olive oil over high heat. Step 5: When the foam begins to subside, brown the chicken in the hot fat, 4 pieces at a time Start the pieces skin side down and turn them frequently with tongs or a slotted spoon until they are richly and evenly colored As they brown, transfer the pieces to a plate and brown the rest of the chicken similarly, adding the remaing butter and oil to the pan if necessary. Step 6: Pour off the fat remaining in the skillet and in its place add the bacon.

Dish Name: Chicken With Tomato Sauce And Egg Noodles
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomatoes, lipton onion soup mix, mushroom stems and pieces, egg noodles, sour cream, poppy seed
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken on stove with a little olive oil While cooking cut into 2-inch chunk sized pieces. Step 2: Once cooked all the way through, add the tomatoes, mushrooms, and soup mix, let simmer. Step 3: Serve over cooked egg noodles with sour cream. Step 4: Sprinkle with poppy seeds.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, butter, onion, garlic, tarragon, italian-style tomatoes, red wine vinegar, capers, dry white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with salt& pepper. Step 2: Heat oil and butter in skillet. Step 3: Add chicken and saute over medinm-high heat, turning often to lightly brown. Step 4: Put chicken into baking pan. Step 5: Saute onions and garlic, add tomatoes, tarragon, vinegar, capers& wine. Step 6: Pour over chicken and bake in 350 degress oven for 30 to 45 minutes, depending on size of chicken breast.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, beefsteak tomatoes, onion, garlic, bell pepper, red wine, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion, garlic and pepper, season chicken. Step 2: Add chicken, tomatoes, and wine. Step 3: Cook on medium-low flame, covered, for about 20 minutes or until inside of chicken is no longer pink Serving suggestion is white rice.

Dish Name: Chicken Wrapped Sausages With Mushroom Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: italian sausage, boneless skinless chicken breasts, unsalted butter, white wine, salt and pepper, uncooked rice, chicken broth, pine nuts, onions, scallions, garlic cloves, fresh mushrooms, green bell peppers, red bell peppers, tomato puree
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large pot of water to boil over high heat. Step 2: Add sausages and boil until cooked through, about 15 minutes, let cool. Step 3: Remove casings Flatten chicken breasts by rolling or pounding between two pieces of waxed paper Carefully wrap 1 chicken breast around each sausage, securing with toothpicks. Step 4: Melt 1 / 3 cup butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add chicken and brown on all sides. Step 6: Add wine with salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium and cook, turning frequently, until chicken is done, about 10 to 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, garlic cloves, crushed tomatoes, pepper, italian seasoning, ziti pasta, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 f Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray, heat. Step 2: Add chicken and cook, turning as needed, until lightly browned, or about 5-6 minutes. Step 3: Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Step 4: Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring as needed, until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add tomatoes, italian seasoning and pepper, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring as needed, until the mixture is thickened slightly, 8 - 10 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, cook ziti according to package directions.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, butter, italian salad dressing mix, white wine, condensed condensed golden mushroom soup, cream cheese chives, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F. Step 2: In a large suacepan, melt butter over low heat. Step 3: Stir in the package of dressing mix. Step 4: Blend in wine and golden mushroom soup. Step 5: Mix in cream cheese, and stir until smooth. Step 6: Heat through, but do not boil. Step 7: Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 8: Pour souce over chicken. Step 9: Bake for 60 minutes in the oven. Step 10: Twenty minutes before the chicken is done, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Step 11: Cook pasta until al dente, as directed on package instructions, drain. Step 12: Serve chicken and sauce over pasta.

Ingredient Names: linguine, broccoli, butter, skinless chicken breast, condensed cream of chicken soup, milk, grated parmesan cheese, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine according to package directions. Step 2: Add broccoli for last of cooking time, drain. Step 3: Heat butter in skillet. Step 4: Cook chicken until browned, stirring often. Step 5: Add soup, milk, cheese, black pepper and linguine mixture and heat through. Step 6: Serve with additional Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, skinless chicken breast halves, onion, garlic, diced tomatoes, fresh broccoli florets, salt and pepper, dried oregano, penne pasta, basil leaves, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium heat, warm oil and add chicken; cook until slightly brown. Step 2: Add onion and garlic to cook for about 3-4 minutes or until garlic is golden and onions are translucent. Step 3: Add tomatoes, broccoli, salt, pepper and oregano; stir well and bring to a boil. Step 4: Cover and turn down heat to simmer for about 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until tender; drain and add back into pot. Step 7: Pour chicken sauce into pot and mix well. Step 8: Add basil and toss well; top with Parmesan cheese, serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, butter, all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, chicken broth, heavy cream, sherry, sliced mushrooms, cooked chicken, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 3: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 4: Add spaghetti, and cook for 8 to, or until al dente; drain. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Step 6: Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Step 7: Cook, stirring, until smooth. Step 8: Remove from heat, and gradually stir in chicken broth and cream. Step 9: Return to heat, and bring to a low boil for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 10: Add sherry, then stir in cooked spaghetti, mushrooms, and chicken. Step 11: Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish, and top with Parmesan cheese. Step 12: Bake in the preheated oven, until bubbly and lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless chicken breast halves, minced garlic, italian seasoning, shrimp, peeled and deveined, bacon, linguine, cream, grated parmesan cheese, large egg, salt, ground black pepper, onion, sauvignon blanc wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chicken, garlic, and Italian seasoning; cook and stir until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 6 to. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl. Step 4: Heat oil and garlic in the same skillet until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Add shrimp and cook until bright pink on the outside and the meat is opaque, 2 to per side. Step 6: Transfer to the bowl with chicken. Step 7: Cook bacon in the same skillet until just crispy (not crunchy), about 5 minutes. Step 8: Drain on a paper towel-lined plate; leave grease in the skillet. Step 9: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 10: Add linguine and remaining oil; cook until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Drain and keep warm. Step 12: Mix cream, Parmesan cheese, egg yolks, remaining Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. Step 13: Saut茅 onion in bacon grease over medium heat until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 14: Add wine, increase the heat, and bring to a boil. Step 15: Add cream mixture, reduce the heat, and simmer until sauce begins to thicken, 3 to. Step 16: Stir in chicken, bacon, and shrimp until coated, then serve over linguine.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, onions, butter, cornstarch, chicken breast halves, fresh basil, garlic powder, ground nutmeg, skim milk, spinach, part-skim ricotta cheese, eggs, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender. Step 2: Stir in cornstarch, basil, garlic powder and nutmeg. Step 3: Add milk all at once. Step 4: Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly; stir in spinach. Step 5: In medium bowl, stir in together Ricotta and egg. Step 6: Add mozzarella and half of parmesan; mix well. Step 7: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 8: Arrange three of the uncooked lasagna pieces in bottom of a greased 12x7 rectangular baking dish. Step 9: Top with half of spinach mixture, half the cooked chicken and half the Ricotta mixture, repeat layers. Step 10: Top with remaining Parmesan cheese. Step 11: Now tent the baking dish with foil and seal well (you don't want the foil touching the top of the lasagna). Bake for 60 minutes or until mixture is bubbly. Step 12: Let stand 10 minutes (with this method you will never need to precook lasagna noodles again).

Ingredient Names: eggs, water, all-purpose flour, salt, ground chicken, fresh spinach, onion, butter, asiago cheese, garlic powder, ground nutmeg, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the eggs, water, flour, and salt. Step 2: Gradually mix in the remaining flour until smooth. Step 3: Divide dough into 2 parts. Step 4: Cover, and set aside in the refrigerator. Step 5: In a skillet over medium heat, cook the ground chicken until evenly brown; drain. Step 6: In a food processor, mix the chicken, spinach, and onion. Step 7: Transfer to a bowl, and mix with butter, Asiago cheese, salt, garlic powder, nutmeg, and pepper. Step 8: On a lightly floured surface, roll out each part of the dough to thickness, cut into squares. Step 9: Place about the chicken mixture in the center of 1/2 the squares, and top with remaining squares. Step 10: Seal the edges of the squares with a moistened fork to form the ravioli. Step 11: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and cook the ravioli in small batches for about 10 minutes, or until al dente. Step 12: Drain, and rinse under cold water. Step 13: Place the marinara sauce in a saucepan, and cook until heated through. Step 14: Serve ravioli topped with marinara sauce and remaining Asiago cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic bulb, red chilies, red wine, chicken stock, tomato, tomato puree, thyme, skinless chicken legs, parsley, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large heavybased pan. Add the onions and whole garlic cloves. Fry, stirring frequently, for 10 mins, adding the chillies for the final min. Step 2: Pour in the wine, turn up the heat and allow it to bubble for 1 min to cook off the alcohol. Stir in the stock, tomatoes, tomato purée and thyme with some seasoning. Add the chicken legs, pushing them under the liquid, then part-cover the pan and leave to simmer gently for 45 mins. Step 3: Remove the lid and cook for a further 15 mins until the chicken is tender and the sauce has reduced a little. Serve scattered with parsley, if you like, and pasta or mash.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast fillets, fresh basil leaves, prosciutto, olive oil, marsala, chicken stock, potato, milk, parmesan, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Make the mash: boil the potatoes in salted water for 15-20 mins until tender. Drain and mash well. Stir in the milk, then the Parmesan and basil. Season with black pepper and keep warm. Step 2: Meanwhile, sit the chicken breasts on a board and cut through them horizontally leaving one side attached. Open them up like a book and lay a basil leaf on top of each, topped with a slice of prosciutto. Secure with a cocktail stick. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large, non-stick frying pan and add the chicken breasts, hamside down. Cook for 2-3 mins until golden, then turn over and cook for 2 mins more. Pour over the Marsala and allow to bubble for 1 min. Add the stock and simmer for 5 mins until the chicken is cooked. Lift the chicken out, cover to keep warm, then boil the pan juices to reduce a little. Serve with the basil mash and a green salad on the side, if you like.

Ingredient Names: mascarpone, rosemary, garlic, chicken breasts skin, prosciutto, olive oil, half lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Mix the mascarpone with the rosemary, garlic and seasoning. Place the chicken breasts on a board and lift, but don’t detach, the skin. Put a spoonful of the mascarpone mix under the skin of each breast. Wrap 2 slices of prosciutto around each, as neatly and tightly as you can, to keep the filling enclosed. Step 2: Heat a non-stick frying pan, add the olive oil and quickly brown the chicken on both sides. Transfer to a roasting tin, then finish off in the oven for 15-20 mins until just cooked. Step 3: Add the lemon juice to the roasting tin and stir over the heat, scraping off any crispy bits. Spoon the juices over the chicken and serve with potatoes and green beans.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, smoked lardon, dry white wine, petits pois, cream, penne
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep nonstick frying pan, then add the chicken breasts and scatter round the lardons. Leave to cook over a high heat for 4 minutes while you gather the other ingredients together. Step 2: Turn the chicken over in the pan, give the lardons a stir, then pour in the wine and let it bubble over a high heat until it has virtually evaporated. Now add the petit pois, the cream and penne, season, then stir well. Cover the pan and cook for 4 minutes more until the chicken is cooked all the way through. Serve straight away.

Dish Name: Chicken, Spinach, and Cheese Pasta Bake
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, olive oil, onion, cooked chicken, diced tomatoes, spinach, cream cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Saut茅 onion in hot oil until tender, 5 to. Step 5: Mix penne pasta, onion, chicken, diced tomatoes, spinach, and cream cheese together in a 9x13-inch baking dish until the cream cheese melts and coats everything. Step 6: Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the pasta mixture. Step 7: Cover baking dish with aluminum foil. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 9: Remove foil and continue baking until heated through and beginning to brown along the edges, about more.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, italian style breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, egg, mozzarella cheese, italian-style tomatoes, tomato sauce, onion, olive oil, garlic, thyme, basil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dip the chicken in egg, then in the mixture of parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Step 2: Fry in the oil until tender and brown on all sides In an overlapping fashion lay your finished chicken pieces in a baking dish. Step 3: Cover with 1 / 2 the sauce. Step 4: Cover the eintire surface of the dish with cheese slices. Step 5: Top with the remaining sauce. Step 6: Top the sauce with any leftover crumb-parmesan mixture. Step 7: Bake for 1 1 / 2 hr At 325 To make the sauce: saute onions and garlic in oil.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, onions, tomatoes, lettuce, provolone cheese, french bread
Instructions: Step 1: Grill the chicken. Step 2: Place on a slice of french bread. Step 3: Slice the tomotos, onions, and lettuce and place on chicken. Step 4: Slice the cheese and put on the bread. Step 5: Put the other slice on top of the sandwich.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, peanut oil, garlic cloves, cracked pepper, fresh basil, red chilies, chives, penne, crushed tomatoes, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to boil in saucepan and add penne. Step 2: Cook for 12 minutes, heat oil in wok. Step 3: Cook chicken in batches until lightly browned. Step 4: Return chicken to wok. Step 5: Stir in garlic, chilli, chives, tomatoes and cracked pepper. Step 6: Bring to boil and reduce heat and simmer until sauce begins to thicken. Step 7: Stir in basil and simmer until thickened, stir in parsley, serve over penne.

Dish Name: Chopped Liver Italian Style Fegato Alle Uova Sode
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, chicken livers, dry white wine, hard-boiled eggs, salt and pepper, bread
Instructions: Step 1: Using 2 saut pans, divide the oil or fat between them. Step 2: Add the onions to one pan and saut over medium heat until they are dark, golden brown, 15-20 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, in the other pan, saut the livers over medium heat until they are medium cooked, 5-7 minutes There should still be quite a bit of pink, but they should not show any signs of blood During the last few minutes of cooking, add the white wine and allow most of it to evaporate. Step 4: Remove from the heat and chop the livers coarsely Reserve the pan juices Peel and chop the eggs. Step 5: In a bowl, combine the warm onions, livers, and eggs. Step 6: Add all of the pan juices, salt and pepper and mix well.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, salt, black pepper, sweet corn, sweet red pepper, zucchini, olive oil, butter, fresh garlic cloves, onion, carrot, celery ribs, oregano, basil, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts into thin strips, place in bowl. Step 2: Season with salt, pepper and 2 cloves of pressed garlic. Step 3: Set aside covered for 1 / 2 hours. Step 4: In a large fry pan, over med-high heat, brown chicken strips in olive oil. Step 5: Remove chicken with slotted spoon from pan and set aside into a clean bowl In the same fry pan, lightly saut onions and 2 cloves of garlic for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add cumin, hot pepper flakes and stir for 2 minutes more just to release flavor of cumin and heat of pepper flakes. Step 7: Add corn, celery, red peppers, brown sugar, worcestershire and vinegar stirring to loosen chicken flavor bits in the pan and to "deglaze" the pan and cook for 2 minutes more. Step 8: Add tomato sauce, grated carrot, black olives, garlic powder, onion powder, dried basil, oregano and return chicken to the pan along with any juices left from the chicken in the bowl.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, fresh basil leaf, salt, fresh ground pepper, butter, shallots, cream, fresh mushrooms, frozen english peas, fresh fettuccine, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut breasts in half and place side by side on a platter. Step 2: Drizzle with the vinegar and oil. Step 3: Cut basil leaves and sprinkle over the breasts. Step 4: Sprinkle salt and pepper. Step 5: Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Step 6: Grill the breasts or bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes. Step 7: Set aside Peel and finely chop shallots. Step 8: Saute in butter 1 minute. Step 9: Add cream, salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, prosciutto, fontina cheese, clarified butter, garlic cloves, sweet onion, dry white wine, unsalted butter, white pepper, salt, cremini mushrooms, fresh basil, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Open chicken breasts and lay open side down on a hot grill. Step 2: Grill 3-5 minutes on each side until cooked, remove from grill. Step 3: Stuff one of the butterflied sides with 1 slice prosciutto and 1 / 8 cup cheese and fold to sandwich the filling inside Hold folded breast with wooden picks. Step 4: Set on a warmed platter and cover. Step 5: In a large skillet saute the onions and garlic in the clarified butter until tender Deglaze the pan with the white wine. Step 6: Add the butter, salt, and pepper, and mushrooms and cook until tender. Step 7: Add basil and lemon juice and swirl pan to combine.

Dish Name: Copycat Cheesecake Factory Pasta Di Vinci
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, red onion, mushroom, garlic, chicken breast, butter, flour, salt, madeira wine, water, heavy cream, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta following the direction on pasta package. Step 2: Saute onions, mushrooms and garlic in 1 tablespoon of the butter until tender. Step 3: Remove the onions, mushrooms and garlic and set them aside In the same pan, cook the chicken, stirring frequently. Step 4: Remove the chicken and set aside until later To the same pan, add 2 tablespoons butter and melt over a low-medium heat. Step 5: Sprinkle the flour over the butter and stir to make a roux Slowly add in the wine, water and heavy cream, stirring constantly. Step 6: Cook over a medium heat until thickened, stirring often. Step 7: Add the parsley and let simmer for a few minutes.

Dish Name: Copycat Tgi Friday's Lemon Chicken Scaloppine
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, lemons, heavy whipping cream, artichokes, parsley, angel hair pasta, pancetta, capers, fresh lemon juice, chablis, butter, whipping cream, thyme
Instructions: Step 1: For the chicken: heat a saut pan over medium heat, add oil and heat. Step 2: Add chicken pieces to the saut pan and saut on each side for one minute. Step 3: Add the sliced mushrooms to the saut pan and saut with the chicken for an additional minute. Step 4: When the mushrooms are cooked, squeeze the juice from the lemons into the saut pan and coat the chicken with the juice. Step 5: Add the cream to the pan and stir to incorporate. Step 6: Add the lemon sauce and stir to incorporate- do not return to heat / flame! Step 7: For the lemon sauce: boil the chablis to reduce to 2 cups. Step 8: Add the lemon juice and butter and melt slowly. Step 9: Add the whipping cream and simmer on low heat until thickened.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic clove, olive oil, basil, bay leaf, dried breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, garlic powder, oregano, chicken tenderloins
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, add the tomatoes, bay leaf, and garlic. Step 2: Bring to a simmer and cook, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Step 3: Stir in dried basil and add salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a large resealable plastic bag, combine the bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, garlic powder, and oregano. Step 5: Add chicken Seal bag and shake to coat. Step 6: Refrigerate if making for a future cooking day. Step 7: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 8: In a large nonstick skillet coated with non-stick cooking spray, cook half of the chicken in 1 tsp oil for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the is breading is browned and no longer adheres to the pan when lifted gently with a spatula. Step 9: Remove to an oven-safe dish and place in the oven to cook thruough.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, garlic cloves, fresh mushrooms, low-fat alfredo sauce, roasted red pepper, great northern beans, reduced-sodium chicken broth, pesto sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a nonstick dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Saute chicken 2 minutes, then reduce heat to medium. Step 3: Add onion, garlic and mushrooms and saute 2 minutes. Step 4: Add alfredo sauce, red peppers, beans, and chicken broth. Step 5: Cover and simmer over low heat 10 minutes To serve, spoon chowder into soup bowls. Step 6: Top each serving with a small dollop of pesto, if desired.

Ingredient Names: penne, broccoli florets, onion, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, sun-dried tomato, chicken broth, heavy cream, balsamic vinegar, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook penne to package directions Sir in broccoli flowerets for last 2 minutes In the meantime, saute onion in olive oil in large skillet for approximately 6 minutes, until softened. Step 2: Add chicken strips and saute for 4 minutes. Step 3: Stir in sun-dried tomatoes, heavy cream, chicken broth, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper and simmer 4 minutes. Step 4: Drain pasta, broccoli. Step 5: Toss with chicken mixture and top with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Creamy Chicken And Ravioli With Bacon
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, olive oil, garlic cloves, chicken broth, cheese ravioli, half-and-half, bacon, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in skillet and cook chicken over high heat, turning occasionally, until brown, 3-5 minutes. Step 2: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about one minute or less. Step 3: Add the broth and ravioli to the skillet, and reduce heat. Step 4: Cook uncovered, about 4-6 minutes or until the ravioli are tender and almost all the broth has evaporated. Step 5: Stir in half and half and simmer, uncovered, about 4 minutes or until hot and of a consistency you like. Step 6: Serve hot, sprinkled with bacon, cheese, and parsley.

Ingredient Names: butter, skinless chicken breast halves, garlic, italian seasoning, onion, sliced mushrooms, all-purpose flour, salt, ground white pepper, milk, fettuccine, grated parmesan cheese, plum tomatoes, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add chicken, 1/2 of the garlic, and Italian seasoning. Step 4: Cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear. Step 5: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 6: Remove from the skillet and set aside. Step 7: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 8: Cook fettuccine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to, drain. Step 9: Meanwhile, melt remaining butter in the skillet. Step 10: Add onion, mushrooms, and remaining garlic; saut茅 until onion is transparent, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Stir in flour, salt, and pepper; cook for 5 minutes. Step 12: Slowly add milk and half-and-half; cook and stir until smooth and creamy. Step 13: Stir in both cheeses until melted. Step 14: Stir in chicken mixture, tomatoes, and sour cream. Step 15: Serve over cooked fettuccini.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, skinless chicken breast halves, shredded mozzarella cheese, cream cheese, hot water, chicken bouillon cube, alfredo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 4: Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside. Step 6: Meanwhile, place chicken in a saucepan with enough water to cover; bring to a boil. Step 7: Cook until chicken is no longer pink and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Remove chicken from the saucepan and shred. Step 9: Combine shredded chicken, mozzarella cheese, and cream cheese in a large bowl. Step 10: Dissolve hot water and bouillon in a liquid measure; pour over chicken mixture and stir until well combined. Step 11: Spread 1/3 of the spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 12: Cover with 1/2 of the chicken mixture and top with 3 lasagna noodles; repeat. Step 13: Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese. Step 14: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, serve and.

Ingredient Names: linguine, chicken breast fillets, olive oil, butter, garlic clove, onions, chicken stock cube, water, cream, green onions, pecorino cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil, butter and garlic in a pan. Step 2: Add chicken and cook on both sides until tender. Step 3: Remove fillets from pan, cut diagonally into thin slices and cover to keep warm To the same oil mixture add onion and cook, stirring, until onion is soft. Step 4: Add crumbled stock cube and water and allow to simmer, uncovered, until reduced by half. Step 5: Add cream, green onions and cheese and stir until cheese melts. Step 6: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Step 7: Add the pasta and cook till just tender, drain well. Step 8: Transfer to a serving dish and arrange chicken mixture over the pasta and top with sauce.

Dish Name: Creamy Chicken Or Pork Cacciatore In Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, celery ribs, green pepper, mushroom, carrot, olive, skinless chicken pieces, tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried oregano leaves, dried basil, old bay seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients in slow cooker except chicken and instant potatoes. Step 2: Stir together to combine. Step 3: Add chicken and push into in the juice. Step 4: Cook at high for 5 hours or at low for longer. Step 5: When it is cooked remove some of the juice and mix with the instant potatoes Slowly blend this in the chicken cacciatore. Step 6: Let cook for another 10 minutes. Step 7: Serve on your choice of pasta. Step 8: Sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan cheese If you are making it with pork, brown it before adding to other ingredients.

Ingredient Names: onion, celery, butter, chicken broth, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, mushrooms, spaghetti, cooked chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and stir onion and celery in butter in a large skillet on medium heat until tender. Step 2: Add broth, cream cheese and 1 / 2 cup parmesan. Step 3: Cook on low heat until cream cheese is melted, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add all remaining ingredients except 1 / 4 cup parmesan, mix lightly. Step 5: Transfer to 13x9 inch baking dish. Step 6: Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup parmesan. Step 7: Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: linguine, onions, garlic, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic powder, fresh black pepper, pesto sauce, half-and-half, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and garlic in oil in skillet. Step 2: Season chicken strips with garlic powder and black pepper and add to skillet with onion/garlic mixture. Step 3: When chicken is done, stir in pesto sauce, then add cream and parmesan cheese. Step 4: Cook over medium heat until thickened. Step 5: Drain cooked linguine and serve chicken and sauce over top. Step 6: Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired.

Ingredient Names: fresh fettuccine, pasta cooking water, bacon, chicken breasts, salt, pepper, unsalted butter, garlic, onions, heavy cream thickened cream, parmesan, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta per packet minus 2 minutes, reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining. Cook bacon, then chicken, sauté garlic and onion, simmer with cream, 3/4 cup pasta water, parmesan, salt and pepper. Toss with pasta 1 1/2 minutes, TASTE to check for salt. Serve with parmesan. Step 2: Cook pasta - Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for time per packet MINUS 2 minutes (finishes cooking in Sauce). Step 3: RESERVE water (important!) - SCOOP OUT 1 cup (250ml) of pasta cooking water, then drain. Step 4: Cook bacon - Meanwhile, heat the oil in a non-stick pan and cook bacon until golden. Remove and drain on paper towels, reserve bacon fat in pan. Step 5: Cook chicken - Season chicken on both sides with the salt and pepper. Cook in the bacon fat for 2 minutes on each side. Remove, then cut into thick slices when cool enough to handle (do this while sauce is simmering). Step 6: Wipe pan (optional) using paper towels to keep sauce pretty and white, and for a buttery clean tasting sauce rather than very bacon-y. Step 7: Sauté onion - Over medium heat using the same pan, melt the butter. Add garlic and onion, cook for 3 - 4 minutes until onion is light golden and soft. Step 8: Make sauce - Add cream, about 3/4 cup pasta water, parmesan, salt and pepper. Stir, then simmer for 2 minutes until it reduces slightly - the sauce will still be a too thin, don't worry, it thickens in the next step. Step 9: Add pasta and toss gently in the sauce for about 1 1/2 minutes, still on the stove. The sauce will thicken and coat the pasta rather than pooling in the pan. Do this step until you get the sauce consistency you want. If your sauce gets too thick, add a splash of pasta water. Step 10: Toss and taste - Toss through bacon and chicken. Taste and add more salt if needed (depends on bacon saltiness). Step 11: Serve - Serve immediately, garnished with parmesan and parsley!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, zucchini, philadelphia italian cheese and herb cooking creme, chopped tomato, cooked orzo pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken and zucchini in large nonstick skillet on medium heat 6 to 7 minute or until chicken is done. Step 2: Add cooking creme and tomatoes. Step 3: Cook and stir 2 minute. Step 4: Serve over pasta Substitute: substitute 2 cups frozen cut green beans for the zucchini Nutrition information per 1-1 / 4 cup serving: 410 calories, 13g total fat, 7g saturated fat, 100mg cholesterol, 600mg sodium, 38g carbohydrate, 2g dietary fiber, 6g sugars, 34g protein, 20%dv vitamin a, 8%dv vitamin c, 10%dv calcium, 15%dv iron.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, dried rosemary, water, extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper, flour, salt, black pepper, italian seasoning, butter, olive oil, garlic, apple juice, half-and-half, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken: Heat the rosemary in 1 / 8 cup water by microwave or stove to draw out the taste. Step 2: Mix rosemary with 1 / 4 cup olive oil, and add salt and pepper. Step 3: Marinate the chicken slices in this rosemary-olive oil mixture for at least 1 hour, up to 24 hours Do not rinse or drain the marinade - it's not much liquid to begin with. Step 4: When you're ready to prepare the meal, begin heating 1 / 3 inch of olive oil in a large skillet or pot. Step 5: Meanwhile, combine the flour, salt, pepper, and italian seasoning, and mix this in with the marinated chicken so that the pieces become slightly coated with flour They do not need to be dry or perfectly dredged. Step 6: When the oil is hot, add all of the chicken pieces They do not need to be in a single layer.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, low-fat milk, mild chili powder, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breast, frozen chopped spinach, cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Place the flour in a large saucepan over medium heat, and gradually whisk in the milk. Step 2: Bring to a boil and whisk in the chili powder, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Cook, whisking constantly, until the mixture slightly thickens, about 5 minutes, remove from heat. Step 4: In a large nonstick skillet, heat the oil until hot but not smoking over medium heat. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook, stirring frequently, for about 1 minute. Step 6: Add the chicken and cook until slightly browned, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the spinach, stirring to coat. Step 8: Stir in the milk mixture, cheddar, and parmesan and cook until the cheddar has melted and the chicken is cooked through, about 2 minutes longer. Step 9: Meanwhile, cook the rigatoni in boiling water until just tender.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, skinless chicken thighs, kosher salt, ground black pepper, onion, garlic, dry white wine, sun-dried tomatoes, low-sodium chicken broth, italian seasoning, baby spinach, parmesan cheese, heavy cream, lemon juice, farfalle
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Step 2: Season both sides of chicken thighs with salt and pepper. Step 3: Place seasoned chicken into hot skillet; cook until golden and thighs are no longer pink in the center, and the juices run clear, 8 to per side. Step 4: An instant-read thermometer inserted near the center should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 5: Remove chicken thighs from pan; set aside. Step 6: Reduce heat to low; add onion and garlic to skillet. Step 7: Cook and stir until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Pour in white wine and use a wooden spoon to scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Step 9: Cook until wine is almost evaporated, 3 to. Step 10: Add in sundried tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Step 11: Stir in chicken broth and Italian seasoning. Step 12: Bring to a simmer, and cook until mixture has slightly reduced, about 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Add spinach to skillet and cook until wilted, 1 to. Step 14: Reduce heat to low; stir in Asiago and heavy cream until well combined. Step 15: Stir in lemon juice. Step 16: Season to taste with salt and ground black pepper. Step 17: Return chicken thighs to skillet; heat until warm, 5 to. Step 18: Turn off heat; allow pan to sit off heat while cooking the pasta. Step 19: Sauce will thicken as it cools. Step 20: Meanwhile, fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 21: Stir in mini farfalle; return to a boil. Step 22: Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 7 to; drain. Step 23: Divide pasta between four bowls, and top each with chicken thighs and sauce to serve.

Dish Name: Creamy Tuscan Tomato Pasta With Chicken
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, whole boneless skinless chicken breast, fusilli, sun-dried tomatoes, dry white wine, lemon juice, diced tomatoes, italian seasoning, black olives, dried chili pepper flakes, salt and pepper, light cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Step 2: Chop chicken into bite sized pieces Brown chicken in oil in a deep frying pan, set aside and keep warm. Step 3: Fry onion and garlic in oil until soft and fragrant. Step 4: Chop semi-dried tomatoes and olives into small pieces, add to onion and garlic. Step 5: Add can of tomatoes, lemon juice and white wine. Step 6: Mix in dried italian spices, salt and pepper and chili flakes. Step 7: When pasta is done add to tomato sauce with the chicken. Step 8: Stir in cream and warm through, do not boil.

Ingredient Names: pasta shapes, red peppers, cherry tomatoes, chicken breasts, basil pesto, low-fat creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix the red pepper with the cherry tomatoes and chicken. Step 3: Mix the pesto and crème fraîche. Step 4: Drain the pasta, then stir it through. Step 5: Toss through the veg and chicken and eat immediately, or pack into a container for lunch.

Ingredient Names: boneless, homemade pesto, mascarpone, olive oil, breadcrumbs preferably made from day-old bread, baby tomatoes vine, pine nuts, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Use a small sharp knife to make a slit along the side of each chicken breast to form a pocket. Mix together the pesto and mascarpone, then carefully spoon a quarter of the mixture into each chicken breast and smooth over the opening to seal. Step 2: Brush a little oil, about 1 tsp, all over each chicken breast and season well. Tip the breadcrumbs onto a large plate and season. Place each breast on the plate and press all over with the breadcrumbs. Place in a lightly oiled shallow baking dish along with the tomatoes (kept together on the vine in a couple of bunches). Drizzle over the remaining oil. Step 3: Cook in the oven for 20-25 mins until the chicken starts to turn golden and is cooked through. Scatter over the pine nuts and cook for 2 mins more. Sprinkle with basil leaves and serve with new potatoes or crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: red wine vinegar, italian dressing, spaghetti sauce, boneless chicken breasts, rotini pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 10' frying pan. Step 2: Put on 2 quarts of water to boil in saucepan. Step 3: Add vinegar to frying pan. Step 4: Add italian dressing to frying pan. Step 5: Place the chicken breast in the frying pan Sear chicken - 5 minutes per side, cover frying pan. Step 6: Lower heat to med / low simmer for 20 minutes. Step 7: Add rotini to boiling water - stir often. Step 8: Place chicken breasts on a cutting board.

Ingredient Names: ready-to-use polenta, parmesan, skin-on boneless chicken breast fillets, cherry tomatoes, leaves from rosemary, garlic, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Using your fingers, roughly break up the polenta into small chunks and scatter in the bottom of a small roasting tin. Tip in the parmesan and mix. Sit the chicken breasts, cherry tomatoes, rosemary and garlic on top of the polenta, drizzle with olive oil, then season to taste. Step 2: Roast for 25 mins until the chicken skin is crisp and golden, and the polenta and cheese are turning crusty around the edges. Serve with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: onions, chicken pieces, tomatoes, tomato paste, mushroom pieces, bay leaf, salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic powder, dried oregano leaves, dried basil, white wine, liquid gravy browner, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place onion and chicken in slow cooker. Step 2: Combine remaining ingredients well in a large bowl. Step 3: Pour mixture over chicken. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours. Step 5: Discard bay leaf before serving.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast halves, tomatoes, carrot, dried oregano, salt, green pepper, celery rib, bay leaf, dried basil, garlic clove, red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except grated cheese Put in a crock pot Cook on low for 6-8 hours Sprinkle with grated cheese before serving Serve over rice or pasta.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg, salt, black pepper, dry breadcrumbs, butter, eggplant, pizza sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut whole chicken breasts into halves In bowl, beat egg, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Dip chicken into egg then coat with crumbs In large skillet, saute chicken in butter or margarine. Step 3: Arrange chicken and eggplant in crock pot with eggplant on bottom. Step 4: Pour pizza sauce over chicken. Step 5: Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Step 6: Add mozzarella cheese 15 minutes before serving. Step 7: Top with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, herbes de provence, salt, garlic cloves, pepper, boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, sun-dried tomato, beef consomme, dry vermouth, greek olive, orange peel, cornstarch, cold water, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix butter, herbs, salt and pepper, and garlic Rub on chicken pieces. Step 2: Put into crock pot. Step 3: Add onion, tomatoes, consomm and vermouth, cover. Step 4: Put on low for 4-5 hours. Step 5: Add olives and peel Recover. Step 6: Put on high for 30 minutes. Step 7: Remove chicken and keep the pieces warm.

Ingredient Names: garlic powder, seasoning salt, black pepper, skinless chicken pieces, oil, spaghetti sauce mix, italian seasoning, white wine, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the garlic powder, seasoning salt and pepper Rub this mixture into the skinned chicken pieces. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat Brown the chicken on all sides, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Combine chicken in crock pot with the spaghetti sauce mix, italian seasoning, and white wine or chicken broth. Step 4: Cover and cook on lo for 7 to 8 hours. Step 5: Add zucchini during last hour of cooking. Step 6: Serve over prepared thin spaghetti or as desired.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Italian Chicken And Fettuccine
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, green beans, onion, stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, dried italian seasoning, garlic cloves, fresh mushrooms, fettuccine, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into about 1 in pieces, set aside. Step 2: Place green beans, onion, and mushrooms in your slow cooker. Step 3: Place chicken pieces over veggies. Step 4: In a sm bowl combine undrianed tomatoes, tomato paste, italian seas, and garlic, pour over chicken. Step 5: Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 5-6 hour Or on high-heat setting for 2 1 / 2-3 hours. Step 6: Serve over hot cooked fettuccine. Step 7: Sprinkle w / parm cheese.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Saucy Italian Chicken Thighs
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, italian-style diced tomatoes, tomato paste, white onion, garlic, dried italian seasoning, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in 4 quart crock pot. Step 2: Combine tomatoes and next 6 ingredients, stir well. Step 3: Pour sauce over chicken. Step 4: Cover and cook on high for 1 hour then reduce heat to low and continue to cook for 4-5 hours or until chicken is tender. Step 5: Serve with bread, pasta, or a green salad.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, lawry's seasoned salt, lemon pepper, garlic salt, teriyaki sauce, dry pasta, alfredo sauce, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Put on water for pasta to boil first. Step 2: When i'm cooking for company, i like to use different shaped pasta It's a bit more festive Anything you like works well. Step 3: Cut chicken breasts into small, bite-size pieces, and season chicken breast with season salt, lemon pepper, and garlic salt. Step 4: Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Step 5: Add chicken breast pieces and let them cook until white on both sides. Step 6: Turn down to medium low, add teriayki sauce and let chicken finish cooking while the teriayki is absorbed. Step 7: Turn down to low, add the alfredo sauce and stir well to mix everything. Step 8: Allow it to simmer until the pasta is ready.

Dish Name: Darlene's Italian Herb Crock Pot Chicken
Ingredient Names: tomatoes with onion and garlic, tomato sauce, italian seasoning, orzo pasta, boneless skinless chicken breasts, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken breasts in crock pot. Step 2: Pour can of tomatoes and tomato sauce over chicken. Step 3: Sprinkle italian seasoning over top. Step 4: Pour orzo on top and add water Give a good stir and cook on low till done to your satisfaction.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, flour, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, garlic salt, eggs, water, olive oil, cheese, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts to about 1 / 4 inch thin between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and set aside. Step 2: Put flour in a dish big enough to coat chicken cutlets. Step 3: Mix the eggs and water together and put in a dish large enough to fit cutlets. Step 4: Mix flour, parmesan cheese and garlic salt in a dish large enough to coat cutlets Coat the chicken in flour on both sides and shake to remove excess flour. Step 5: Dip the chicken in egg on both sides Coat the chicken in bread crumbs on both sides and shake to remove excess. Step 6: Set aside once all the cutlets are coated. Step 7: Heat oil in pan on medium until hot enough and fry cutlets about 2 minutes on each side until browned, then put on paper towels to absorb the grease. Step 8: Put cooked cutlets in a pan, top with tomato sauce then cheese mixture and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 15 minutes until cheese has melted.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, eggs, italian style breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, meatless sauce, mozzarella cheese, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry. Step 3: Combine bread crumbs and 1 / 2 of the parmesan cheese into small bowl, mix well. Step 4: Dip chicken breasts into egg and coat. Step 5: Then, dip into bread crumb and cheese mixture. Step 6: Heat oil and fry breaded chicken on both sides for about 5 minutes. Step 7: Pour spaghetti sauce into a 13x9 baking dish, top with chicken, cover with foil.

Ingredient Names: chicken, eggs, fresh lemon juice, salt and pepper, fresh rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the chicken If the chicken is soaked, drain and pat dry on paper towels. Step 2: Place the cut up chicken pieces in roast pan Use no liquid or oil Lightly shake salt and pepper to taste and add the sprig of rosemary. Step 3: Cover roast pan and place in 350 degree preheated oven for 1 hr this step can be completed up to an hour ahead of finishing. Step 4: Remove the chicken from roasting pan and place on a wire rack until it is thoroughly drained coat and finish the spitzad. Step 5: In a mixing bowl whisk the eggs until they begin to thicken slightly. Step 6: Add lemon juice slowly while continuing to whisk vigorously until all of the lemon juice is incorporated.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, butter, chicken breasts, season salt, emerils essence southwest seasoning, garlic powder, parsley, salt, pepper, whipping cream, crisp bacon, grape tomatoes, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Start preparing the bow tie pasta according to the package directions. Step 2: In a saucepan melt butter over medium heat. Step 3: Add chicken breasts, and then sprinkle seasonings equally over both. Step 4: Let chicken brown on one side, then turn over and brown on the other side. Step 5: Take chicken out of saucepan and cut into cubes. Step 6: Add back into pan and then add whipping cream. Step 7: Bring to a boil, and then turn down heat and let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Then add bacon and tomatoes (if using) and let simmer for another 2-3 minutes. Step 9: Add parmesan and let melt. Step 10: Drain pasta and put into a serving bowl. Step 11: Pour sauce over and serve immediately. Step 12: May garnish with additional parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, parmesan cheese, dijon mustard, olive oil, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in skillet to a medium heat. Step 2: Cut each chicken breast into manageable pieces, about three pieces to each breast Coat the chicken, first with the mustard then the parmesan. Step 3: Once the oil is hot add the chicken to your pan and cook until there is no more pink, turning once. Step 4: Remove the chicken and serve with warmed tomato sauce if desired.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, butter, garlic, dill weed, french bread, cream cheese, lemon juice, lettuce leaves, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken to flatten In 12 in skillet melt 3 t butter, add garlic and 1 / 2 t dill. Step 2: Add chicken, cook until done. Step 3: Spread both sides of bread with remaining butter. Step 4: Fry bread in fresh skillet until golden brown on both sides. Step 5: Mix cream cheese, lemon juice and remaining dill. Step 6: Spread on one side of bread. Step 7: Place lettuce, chicken, and tomato on top. Step 8: Top with remaining slices.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt & pepper, seasoned dry bread crumbs, boneless chicken breasts, olive oil, tomato and basil pasta sauce, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: One at a time, place the chicken breasts in a gallon sized freezer bag, and pound to about 1 / 2 inch. Step 2: Place the eggs in a large bowl and whisk with salt and pepper. Step 3: Place the bread crumbs in a large bowl and mix with the parmesan cheese Pre-heat the oven to 350f. Step 4: Dip each chicken breast in the egg, then the crumb mixture Re-dip in the egg and then the bread crumbs for a second time. Step 5: In a large heavy skillet heat the olive oil over medium heat Brown the double dipped chicken in the hot oil for about 4 minutes each side, until golden brown. Step 6: Remove the chicken and place in a large baking dish. Step 7: Divide the tomato sauce and spread evenly over each chicken breast.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, salt, black pepper, pitted prunes, pimento-stuffed green olives, capers, dried italian seasoning, garlic cloves, bay leaves, chicken broth, honey, cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a large slow cooker. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Add plums, olives, capers, italian seasoning, garlic and bay leaves. Step 4: Pour broth, honey and vinegar over all in the cooker. Step 5: Cover and cook for 5 to 6 hours. Step 6: Serve with hot cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, asiago cheese, olive oil, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, dried bay leaves, white onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Spray a baking pan lightly with cooking spray. Step 2: Wrap each chicken strips around each cheese cube and secure with a toothpick. Step 3: Dip chicken in olive oil and then roll in bread crumbs. Step 4: Place chicken in the baking pan. Step 5: Top with bay leaves and sliced onions. Step 6: Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until chicken is fully cooked through, and cheese has melted, and bread crumbs are golden brown, serve.

Dish Name: East Side Mario's Hell's Kitchen Chicken Pollo Italian
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, dried basil, dried tarragon, salt, fresh ground pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, margarine, garlic clove, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh parsley, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour tomatoes into blender or food processor. Step 2: Add basil, tarragon, salt, pepper and crushed red pepper. Step 3: Puree until smooth. Step 4: Melt margarine in large frypan. Step 5: Saute garlic over medium heat 1 minute. Step 6: Add chicken breasts, saute, turning once or twice until golden on both sides. Step 7: Turn chicken fleshy side down and cover with tomato mixture. Step 8: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes until tender. Step 9: Remove chicken and place fleshy side up, in a warm oven proof dish. Step 10: Stir parsley into sauce and spoon over chicken breasts.

Dish Name: Easy Authentic Tasting Chicken Parmesan Parmigiana
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, salt and pepper, eggs, milk, italian style breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, provolone cheese, spaghetti sauce, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper in a shallow bowl or pie plate. Step 2: Combine bread crumbs and parmesan cheese in a shallow bowl, plate or pie plate. Step 3: Dip each chicken cutlet in egg mixture and then coat completely with bread crumb mixture. Step 4: Heat half inch of oil in a pan over med-high heat. Step 5: Fry each cutlet and turn over when golden brown. Step 6: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Step 7: When cutlets are crispy and golden on both side and juices run clear, place them on a baking sheet. Step 8: Place a slice of provolone cheese on top of each cutlet and place in the oven In the meantime, heat sauce in the microwave or on the stove top. Step 9: When cheese is melted, remove cutlets from oven and spoon some sauce nicely over each one.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, spaghetti sauce, breadcrumbs, mozzarella cheese, parsley, parmesan cheese, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Coat chicken breast with bread crumbs until fully coated. Step 2: Bake 1 hr at 425-450f, depending on you oven in 9x13" baking dish While chicken is baking, boil noodles until tender. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: When chicken is done, remove chicken from baking dish and set on plate. Step 5: Put cooked noodles in baking dish and place chicken on top of noodles. Step 6: Sprinkle chicken with parsley to taste and a bit of grated parmigiana cheese Smother chicken with spaghetti sauce and cover some noodles if desired and top with mozzarella cheese As much as you like. Step 7: Place baking dish back in oven and bake until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: fresh fettuccine, condensed cream mushroom soup, cream cheese, canned mushrooms, whipping cream, parmesan cheese, butter, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese, swiss cheese, chicken, seasoned bread crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Grease a 2-1/2-quart baking dish. Step 3: Cook fettuccine in a large pot of boiling salted water until eldente. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine soup, cream cheese, mushrooms, whipping cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, butter and garlic powder. Step 5: Stir in cheeses; cook until melted. Step 6: Drain the pasta well and add to the sauce. Step 7: Transfer the mixture to prepared baking dish. Step 8: Combine all topping ingredients then sprinkle over chicken mixture. Step 9: Cover and bake for 25 minutes. Step 10: Uncover, bake 5-10 mins longer or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, egg, milk, breadcrumbs, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Place bread crumbs in a wide, shallow bowl. Step 3: Whisk together egg and milk in another wide, shallow bowl Dredge chicken breasts one at a time in the egg mixture first and then in the bread crumbs. Step 4: Place coated breasts side-by-side in a baking dish Dividing evenly, top each breast with 3 / 4 cup mozzarella and then follow with 1 / 3 cup parmesan. Step 5: Divide spaghetti sauce evenly and spoon over each breast. Step 6: Top each breast with remaining mozzarella and parmesan in the same order as above. Step 7: Bake for 30 minutes or until juices from chicken breasts run clear and cheese topping is lightly browned During last 15 minutes of chicken's cooking time, prepare spaghetti per package instructions.

Dish Name: Easy Cheesy Chicken Veggie Gnocchi Bake
Ingredient Names: leeks, carrot, canola oil, cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic powder, dried parsley, fat-free condensed mushroom soup, gnocchi, reduced-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put a pot of water on to boil for the gnocchi when it is time and preheat your broiler / grill. Step 2: Heat a nonstick pan and add the oil.
