Step 3: Put the leeks and carrots in with the oil and cook over a medium heat, stirring frequently, for about five minutes or until the leeks have softened By this time your water should be boiling So, put the gnocchi in the water and cook according to package instructions The brand i use only takes two minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, add the cooked chicken to the pan with the leeks and carrots and just stir through. Step 5: Add the can of mushroom soup to the pan along with the garlic powder and parsley and stir to combine. Step 6: Add the cooked and drained gnocchi and softly stir so the that gnocchi is coated in the other ingredients. Step 7: Transfer to an oven proof dish.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, garlic cloves, artichoke hearts, diced tomatoes, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, rotelle pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare chicken breasts by trimming any extra fat pound out gently between two sheets of plastic wrap to flatten and thin breast to a 1 / 4" Cut into 1" cubes. Step 2: Toss with salt& pepper, set aside. Step 3: Drain artichoke hearts and slice them into 1 / 8's, slice garlic thin. Step 4: In a deep saucepan over medium-high heat, pour in olive oil and add chicken Brown cubed chicken till lightly golden, lower heat. Step 5: Add garlic and cook with chicken for 1 minute or just until slightly tan.

Ingredient Names: white meat chicken, bacon, garlic, onion, red bell pepper, sliced mushrooms, butter, liquid smoke, alfredo sauce, angel hair pasta, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with minced garlic, salt, pepper and liquid smoke for about an hour or two in the fridge. Step 2: Melt 3 tbs Of butter in frying pan and add your marinated chicken and cook until done. Step 3: Set aside in a dish. Step 4: Melt 2 tbs Butter in the same frying pan and add in the onions and cook until halfway done. Step 5: Add in your mushrooms next and cook the liquid out of them. Step 6: When the mushrooms are halfway done add in your red bellpepper. Step 7: Set this mixture aside in a bowl. Step 8: Fry your bacon until done.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, garlic powder, italian seasoning, chicken breast tenders, manicotti, sliced mushrooms, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spread 1 / 3 of the spaghetti sauce in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 2: Sprinkle garlic and italian seasoning over chicken. Step 3: Insert chicken into manicotti shells. Step 4: Place shells in baking dish. Step 5: Pour remaining sauce evenly over manicotti shells, covering completely. Step 6: Sprinkle with mushrooms and cheese. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours to help soften pasta. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 9: Bake for approximately 1 hour or until pasta is tender. Step 10: Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, parmesan cheese, italian breadcrumbs, garlic powder, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, egg, olive oil, salt and pepper, spaghetti noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste, set aside. Step 2: Dip chicken into beaten egg, then in bread crumb mixture and coat well Brown coated chicken on both sides in heated oil. Step 3: Heat spaghetti sauce. Step 4: Place a thin layer of sauce on bottom of casserole dish with part of the sauce, then place browned chicken on the sauce and spoon a little sauce on each chicken breast Reserve remaining sauce for spaghetti. Step 5: Cover and bake in a 325f oven for 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove from oven and top with mozzarella cheese, place back in oven for another 10-15 minutes. Step 7: Serve with spaghetti and additional sauce.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, margarine, garlic powder, lemon juice, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken in margarine Add garlic powder, lemon juice and white wine Simmer 10 minute Serve over rice or pasta.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, olive oil, eggplants, prosciutto, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Saute' chicken breast in olive oil. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Set aside on a plate. Step 5: Then saute' eggplant until tender. Step 6: Set aside on another plate Next, saute' prosciutto for just a few minutes then add to plate In large baking dish brushed with olive oil, arrange starting with layer of chicken with a layer of eggplant on top, then layer ham, and cheese. Step 7: Bake for 15 minutes. Step 8: Serve with grated parmesan cheese over pasta if desired.

Ingredient Names: onion rings, garlic cloves, chicken breasts, red bell pepper, sliced mushrooms, tomato paste, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, burgundy wine, thyme, basil, parsley, oregano, bay leaf, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place onion rings in bottom of 4 quart crockpot. Step 2: Place whole chicken pieces on top of onion rings or, if preferred, slice so that each serving consists of 2 chunks of meat. Step 3: Place sliced red bell pepper rings atop chicken pieces. Step 4: Place sliced mushroom pieces atop bell pepper and chicken In separate large bowl place the tomato paste amount you will use. Step 5: Pour 2 cups chicken broth over tomato paste and blend with a fork. Step 6: Add 15 oz diced plum tomato to bowl mixture and blend. Step 7: Add 1 cup sweet red burgundy wine to bowl mixture. Step 8: Add bay leaf and seasonings to bowl mixture and stir so mixed. Step 9: Pour bowl mixture over chicken and bell pepper mixture in crockpot, add 1 teaspoon oil if you wish, cover, turn on low, and cook 6-8 hours as you prefer.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, deli ham, provolone cheese, pesto sauce, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350. Step 2: Put evoo in baking pan. Step 3: Place well rinsed chicken breasts in pan. Step 4: Place ham slice on top of each breast. Step 5: Place cheese slice on top of each ham slice. Step 6: Place 1 tbs of pesto / sundried tomato sauce / condiment on top of each cheese slice Scatter capers around pan. Step 7: Bake for 40 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked Toppings of ham, cheese and sauce will be a little crispy.

Dish Name: Easy Italian Chicken And Potato Slow Cooker Recipe
Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, portabella mushroom, boneless skinless chicken, mozzarella cheese, red potatoes, chicken broth, diced onion, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, red pepper, crushed tomatoes, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, spaghetti sauce, potatoes, onion, red pepper, crushed tomatoes, basil, chicken and mushrooms into a slow cooker. Step 2: Stir to mix all ingredients. Step 3: Cook in the slow cooker on low for 8 hours or on high for 4 hours. Step 4: Add the of the mozzarella cheese and gently stir. Step 5: Top with the remaining mozzarella cheese and parmigiano-reggiano cheese and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, potatoes, roma tomatoes, onion, olive oil, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken and pat dry, skin if you prefer. Step 2: Wash and cut potatoes and tomatoes into bite-sized chunks. Step 3: Cut onion into wedges. Step 4: Combine all ingredients in 9x13 baking dish. Step 5: Pour olive oil over all. Step 6: Sprinkle italian seasoning evenly over all. Step 7: Mix to ensure that all pieces are coated. Step 8: Bake uncovered in 450 degree oven, 1 hour, or until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are fork tender Variation: i have also added one large zucchini cut into bite sized chunks before baking Delicious in the summer!

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, chicken broth, water, penne pasta, great northern beans, diced tomatoes with garlic and olive oil, corn, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Heat broth and water to boiling. Step 2: Add pasta as soon as boiling begins. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in skillet and add chicken breasts, cook until browned. Step 4: Add can of tomatoes to chicken and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Lower pasta and broth temp to medium. Step 6: Add canned ingredients, italian seasoning and chicken to broth. Step 7: Simmer on medium for about 15-20 minutes or until pasta is the way you like it.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, garlic, good seasonings italian salad dressing mix, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Place chicken breasts in casserole dish. Step 3: Sprinkle chopped garlic over chicken breasts. Step 4: Sprinkle packet of dry good seasons over garlic. Step 5: Pour balsamic vinegar evenly over chicken breasts. Step 6: Bake at 350 for about 45 to 50 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: salad dressing, boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, rosemary, wine
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken dressing and rosemary in a container with a lid and marinade overnight or as long as you can The longer the better 2. Step 2: Heat up some olive oil in the grill pan until nice and hot 3. Step 3: Place chicken in and pour maranade over all the chicken in pan 4 Thouroghly cook through about 15 mins on each side. Step 4: Cut open if needed to see if it is white inside -- white inside means done.

Dish Name: Easy Penne With Chicken Spinach And Tomato Alfredo Soooo Good
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, boneless chicken breasts, classico alfredo with sun dried tomatoes, frozen spinach, italian tomatoes, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw spinach completely in a colander lined with a few paper towels This may take a few hours. Step 2: Squeeze spinach completely dry, set aside. Step 3: Cut up chicken into bite size pieces Brown in a skillet, keep warm. Step 4: Cook penne according to package. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a medium sauce pan, add both jars of sauce, tomato and spinach. Step 6: Bring to a simmer on low heat, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, milk, flour, eggs, dry breadcrumbs, olive oil, butter, salt, pepper, garlic salt, pasta sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pound each chicken half until about 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 2: Season with salt, pepper and garlic salt. Step 3: In a 9x13 pan put the jar of pasta sauce and even out In 4 separate bowls put beaten eggs, flour, milk and crumbs. Step 4: Season eggs with salt, and crumbs if unseasoned with salt, pepper and garic salt. Step 5: Heat oil in pan to med-high heat-- then lower to about med. Step 6: Dip chicken in milk, flour, egg then crumbs. Step 7: Fry until golden brown-approx 5 minutes per side transfer to sheet lined with paper towel, drain. Step 8: Put each breast half in pan of sauce and top with a slice of mozza and a good sprinkling of parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Easy Tortellini With Creamy Chicken And Onion Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, morton nature seasons seasoning blend, cheese tortellini, butter, flour, skim milk, lipton onion soup mix
Instructions: Step 1: Cook tortellini according to package, strain, and set aside. Step 2: In a large saut pan, melt one tablespoon butter over medium-high to high heat. Step 3: Meanwhile toss the chicken with the morton's natural seasoning. Step 4: After the butter has melted, add the chicken to the pan and brown. Step 5: Remove chicken from the pan and set aside. Step 6: Turn the heat to medium and add the remaining butter and the flour to the same pan. Step 7: Stir constantly and cook roux for about 3-5 minutes or until it smells nutty. Step 8: Whisk in the milk and soup mix and bring to a simmer for 5 minutes. Step 9: Add the chicken and simmer for another 5 minutes. Step 10: Serve sauce on top of tortellini or toss tortellini in sauce and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, part-skim mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, fat-free cottage cheese, yellow onions, olive oil, lasagna noodles, yellow bell peppers, fresh basil leaves, parsley, spaghetti sauce, coarse garlic salt, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: In 1 T olive oil saute the onion and bell pepper until translucent. Step 3: Add chicken and set aside. Step 4: Spray a 9x13" pyrex dish with cooking spray and spoon about a half cup of the spaghetti sauce on the bottom. Step 5: Mix the fresh herbs, garlic salt, and cayenne straight into the container of cottage cheese. Step 6: Layer 4 uncooked lasagna noodles, 1/3 cottage cheese mixture, 1/3 chicken mixture, 1/3 of the remaining sauce, 1/3 mozzerella and 1/3 parmesan. Step 7: Repeat this process until finished. Step 8: Cook, uncovered, for about 45 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown on top.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, black sesame seeds, poppy seeds, onion flakes, garlic flakes, kosher salt, unsalted butter, garlic, heavy cream, chicken, everything bagel seasoning, parmesan cheese, cream cheese, fettuccini noodles, fresh broccoli florets, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To make Everything Bagel seasoning, in a medium bowl, stir to combine toasted sesame seeds, poppy seeds, onion flakes, garlic flakes and salt. Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute, then stir in the heavy cream. Bring to a simmer and stir in the chicken and 2 teaspoons everything bagel seasoning. Simmer for about 6-8 minutes until chicken is just cooked through, then stir in 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese. Step 3: Continue to cook at a simmer for 3-4 minutes, then stir in the cream cheese, fettuccini and broccoli. Stir to coat and top pasta with 1 tablespoon Everything Bagel Seasoning, 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese, salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, shredded cheddar cheese, dried parsley, dried oregano, ground black pepper, salt, skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, and cook the garlic until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: In a shallow bowl, mix the bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, Cheddar cheese, parsley, oregano, pepper, and salt. Step 4: Dip each chicken breast in the garlic butter to coat, then press into the bread crumb mixture. Step 5: Arrange the coated chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 6: Drizzle with any remaining butter and top with any remaining bread crumb mixture. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni, salt, skinless chicken breasts, tapioca starch, italian seasoning, ground black pepper, olive oil, sliced fresh mushrooms, sun-dried tomatoes, minced garlic, heavy cream, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot with water and salt to a boil. Step 2: Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain and reserve pasta water. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine tapioca starch, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Step 5: Add chicken pieces and toss to coat. Step 6: Heat olive oil in a skillet until it shimmers. Step 7: Add chicken pieces and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: You might be tempted to add more olive oil or butter, don't do this. Step 9: Pour in reserved pasta water and add mushrooms, artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomatoes, and garlic. Step 10: Cook about 5 minutes. Step 11: Mix in white wine, cream and Cheddar cheese. Step 12: Whisk until sauce is slightly thickened. Step 13: Add rigatoni and toss to combine. Step 14: Add rigatoni and toss to combine. Step 15: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: white wine vinegar, olive oil, lemon juice, fresh mint, garlic, white sugar, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken thighs, skewers, italian-style hoagie buns
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, olive oil, lemon juice, mint, garlic, sugar, oregano, basil, salt, red pepper flakes, and black pepper in a blender. Step 2: Puree until liquefied, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Place chicken thighs in a large resealable plastic bag, pour in marinade and massage to coat. Step 4: Squeeze out excess air and seal the bag. Step 5: Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour, turning occasionally. Step 6: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Step 7: Remove chicken and place on the skewers, season with salt. Step 8: Pour the marinade into a small saucepan. Step 9: Bring to a simmer and cook until reduced slightly, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Place skewers on the preheated grill and cook for 5 to, turn and cook until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 5 to 6 more minutes. Step 11: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 12: Remove from grill and rest the meat for a few minutes. Step 13: Toast hoagie rolls and spread each with some of the reserved marinade. Step 14: Place a skewer on each roll and carefully remove the skewer, leaving the chicken in the bun.

Dish Name: Herby lemon chicken with Tuscan beans
Ingredient Names: chicken, juice lemon, olive oil, thyme, cubetti di pancetta, celery, fat garlic, butter beans, glass white wine, chicken stock, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: First, spatchcock the chicken. Sit the chicken on a board, breast-side down with the wing-end away from you. Use a strong pair of kitchen scissors to cut along either side of the backbone to remove it, cutting through the ribs as you go. Open out the chicken like a book, flip so it is now breast- side up, then press down on the breasts with the heel of your hand to flatten slightly – you are trying to get an even thickness across the whole joint. If you have any long skewers, diagonally criss-cross two, skewering through the legs and breast to hold in position. Sit the chicken in a dish or roasting tin. Mix the lemon zest and juice, olive oil and thyme with some pepper, rub all over the chicken, then cover and chill for up to a day. Step 2: Get the beans ready by gently frying the pancetta in a pan – you shouldn’t need any extra oil if you start it slowly. When the pancetta is golden and crisp, lift it out with a slotted spoon, then add the celery and garlic to the remaining fat in the pan. Gently cook for 10-12 mins until soft. Scrape into a medium-size deep roasting tin or baking dish with the pancetta, butter beans, thyme, wine, stock and plenty of seasoning. Set aside until ready to cook. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Transfer the chicken to a rack, breastside up, that will rest above the beans (sit the beans on a large baking sheet if the chicken overhangs at all, to keep your oven clean). Season the chicken with salt and roast for 40-50 mins until the chicken is cooked through – cut into one of the legs to check. Lift the chicken out to rest for 10 mins. If the beans are a bit soupy, transfer to the hob and simmer for a minute to reduce some of the juices – they should still be nice and wet though. Step 4: To serve, cut the legs, thighs and wings from the chicken, then thickly carve or tear off the breast in chunks. Check the beans for seasoning, then stir through the parsley and serve with the chicken.

Ingredient Names: bone-in chicken thighs, olive oil, sliced fresh mushrooms, celery, onion, garlic, stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, salt, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Rinse chicken thighs and pat dry with paper towels. Step 3: Heat oil in the pot of an electric pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot) on Saut茅 mode; add chicken. Step 4: Cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 5: Transfer chicken to a plate, reserving drippings in the pot. Step 6: Place mushrooms, celery, and onion in the pot; cook and stir until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add garlic; cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Place chicken back in the pot; add tomatoes and tomato paste. Step 9: Sprinkle with herbes de Provence. Step 10: Top with water and bouillon. Step 11: Close and lock the lid. Step 12: Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions. Step 13: Allow 10 to for pressure to build. Step 14: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 15: Release pressure carefully using the quick-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Step 16: Unlock and remove the lid carefully, turning it away from you. Step 17: Test chicken for doneness; an instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 18: Season to taste with red pepper flakes and black pepper.

Dish Name: Instant Pot Pasta with Italian Sausage
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, bell peppers, chicken sausage, garlic, marinara sauce, water, fresh spinach, penne pasta, basil, italian seasoning, shredded italian cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Turn on a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot) and select Saute function. Step 2: Add oil and allow to heat. Step 3: Add onion and peppers to hot oil; cook until they begin to get tender, 3 to. Step 4: Add sausages and cook, breaking them up with a wooden spoon, until lightly browned, 4 to. Step 5: Add garlic and saute for 1 to. Step 6: Add marinara sauce, water, spinach, pasta, basil, and Italian seasoning; mix to combine. Step 7: Cancel Saute function. Step 8: Close and lock the lid. Step 9: Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 5 minutes. Step 10: Allow 10 to for pressure to build. Step 11: Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions,. Step 12: Then release pressure carefully using the quick-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Step 13: Unlock and remove the lid. Step 14: Stir in shredded Italian cheese until combined. Step 15: Serve with remaining cheese sprinkled on top.

Ingredient Names: italian salad dressing, garlic powder, salt, skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk salad dressing, garlic powder, and salt together in a shallow baking dish; add chicken breasts and turn to coat. Step 2: Cover the dish with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator, to overnight. Step 3: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Step 4: Remove chicken from marinade and shake off excess; discard remaining marinade. Step 5: Cook chicken on the preheated grill until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 7 to on each side. Step 6: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breast half, marinated artichoke hearts, red peppers, black olives, salt, pepper, tricolor fusilli, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent, stirring and taking care not to brown the garlic, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken strips and stir until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Mix in artichoke hearts and peppers with their liquid and olives and heat through. Step 5: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Pour over pasta and toss well. Step 7: Serve, passing parmesan separately.

Dish Name: Italian Chicken With New Orleans Spaghetti Bordelaise
Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, salt, ground black pepper, ground cayenne pepper, garlic, olive oil, dry white wine, lemons, fresh basil, oregano, bay leaves, italian parsley, angel hair pasta, green onions, thyme, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Season thighs with salt, black pepper and cayenne. Step 3: Peel 4 heads of garlic and crush half leaving the remaining cloves whole. Step 4: Heat 1/2 cup olive oil in a roasting pan large enough to hold the chicken in 1 layer, over 2 burners on medium-high heat. Step 5: Add chicken and brown on both sides, setting aside when brown. Step 6: Add crushed garlic and cook, stirring about 1 minute. Step 7: Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients, stirring to mix well. Step 8: Place chicken in roaster, cover tightly and cook for 1 hour. Step 9: Remove cover and roast until the chicken is brown and tender, about 30 minutes, basting occasionally. Step 10: Remove and set aside. Step 11: Spaghetti Bordelaise:. Step 12: In large pot bring salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente, about 10 minutes, drain well. Step 13: In medium saucepan heat oil over medium heat. Step 14: Add minced garlic and green onions and cook stirring until fragrant and starting to turn golden, about 2 minutes. Step 15: Add the wine, basil, oregano, thyme, salt, pepper and cayenne and cook 2 minutes. Step 16: Add the butter and parsley and cook for another 2 minutes. Step 17: Pour sauce over drained spaghetti, tossing to coat. Step 18: Place in large serving bowl and coat with Parmesan Cheese. Step 19: Place Spaghetti Bordelaise on plate and top with chicken thigh.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onions, garlic, fresh basil, tomato sauce, chicken broth, macaroni, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: In a large nonstick frying pan, brown ground beef. Step 2: Add onion, garlic and basil. Step 3: Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add tomato sauce and broth, bring to a boil, add macaroni. Step 5: Reduce heat, cover and allow to cook for 5-7 minutes. Step 6: Stir in zucchini or green beans. Step 7: Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-10 minutes or until macaroni and zucchini are tender. Step 8: If needed, add more broth.

Dish Name: Italian chicken with ham, basil & beans
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs bone, prosciutto, olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, dry white wine, cannellini beans, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken thighs all over with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Pinch off 8 sprigs from the basil (about 3 leaves each per sprig) and lay one on top of each chicken thigh. Wrap each thigh in a piece of ham, with the ends tucked underneath. Step 2: Heat oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3. Heat the oil in a large roasting tin over two of the burners on the hob. Add the chicken and fry for about 4 mins or until the ham is just crisped and the chicken is lightly golden. Turn and repeat. Step 3: Meanwhile, cut the garlic bulbs in half around the middle and halve the tomatoes if small, quarter them if they’re big. Pick the leaves from the rest of the basil. Once the chicken has browned on both sides, add all of the tomatoes, half of the basil and the wine. Season then cover with foil and leave to cook slowly in the oven for 40 mins. Step 4: Take out of the oven and turn the heat up to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Remove the foil from the pan and stir the beans into the tomatoey juices. Return to the oven, uncovered, for 30 mins until the tomatoes, chicken and garlic are starting to crisp around the edges and the chicken is very tender. Just before serving, tear the remaining basil roughly 5 minutes then stir through or scatter over the pan.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, skinless boneless chicken breast fillets, red onions, orange peppers, garlic, long grain rice, tomatoes, chicken stock, ready-made pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Heat the oil in a large, shallow ovenproof pan, add the chicken and cook for 3-4 mins until golden all over. Remove from pan and set aside. Step 2: Add the onion and peppers, and cook for 3 mins or until lightly golden. Tip in the garlic and fry for a min. Stir in the rice, then the tomatoes, stock and reserved chicken. Turn up the heat and bring to the boil before transferring to the oven to cook, uncovered, for 20 mins. Season to taste and drizzle over the pesto before serving.

Ingredient Names: olives, garlic, mixed herbs, full-fat soft cheese, plump boneless, tomatoes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Beat the olives or sundried tomatoes, garlic and almost all the herbs into the cheese, then season. Cut a slit along the side of each chicken breast, then use your knife to open it out into a pocket. Step 2: Stuff each breast with a quarter of the cheese mix, then press to close. Lift onto a greased baking tray. Season the top of the chicken, then overlap tomato slices over the top of each piece of chicken. Season, then scatter with the remaining herbs. Drizzle with olive oil. Step 3: Roast for 20 mins until the chicken is golden around the edges and the tomatoes look a little shrivelled. Serve with a green salad and crusty bread to mop up the juices.

Ingredient Names: ready-cooked polenta, olive oil, chicken breasts, fresh breadcrumbs, parmesan, ball mozzarella, ciabatta, salad leaves, sunblush tomatoes, basil pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Cut the polenta into thick chips and rub all over with a little oil. Spread out over a baking sheet and cook for 20 mins until golden. Cut each chicken breast in half, lightly flatten using a rolling pin or heavy can, then rub all over with oil. Spread the breadcrumbs and Parmesan out on a plate, then dip in the chicken to coat. Step 2: Place the chicken on another baking sheet and cook for 10-12 mins until just crisp and cooked through. Place a mozzarella slice on top and return to the oven until starting to melt. Pile the burgers onto buns with some salad leaves, tomatoes and a dollop of pesto. Serve with the polenta chips.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, olive oil, streaky smoked bacon, leeks, risotto rice, white wine, parmesan, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Keep the stock hot in a saucepan. Heat the oil in another large pan and fry the bacon until crisp. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 2: Stir in the leeks and soften for 5-7 mins. Add the rice and cook for 1 min. Pour in the wine and keep stirring until it is absorbed. Add the stock, one ladle at a time, stirring and waiting for the rice to absorb the liquid before adding more. Continue for about 20 mins until the rice is just cooked and the risotto has a creamy consistency. Season, then stir through the bacon along with most of the Parmesan and chives, saving a little of each to scatter over before serving.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, salt and pepper, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, garlic, chicken broth, lemon, lemon juice, capers, butter, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C). Step 2: Place a serving platter into the oven to warm. Step 3: Season chicken breast pieces with salt and pepper and dredge them in flour. Step 4: Shake off excess flour. Step 5: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet; pan-fry the chicken pieces until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 6: Work in batches and do not crowd skillet, adding oil as needed. Step 7: Place chicken pieces onto the warmed platter in the oven. Step 8: When finished with all of the chicken, drain most of the oil from the skillet, leaving a thin coating on the surface of the pan. Step 9: Cook and stir minced garlic in the skillet until fragrant, about 20 seconds. Step 10: Pour in chicken broth; scrape and stir any brown bits from the bottom of the skillet. Step 11: Stir in lemon slices and bring the mixture to a boil. Step 12: Let cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce reduces to about 15-20 minutes, 5 to. Step 13: Add lemon juice and capers; simmer until sauce is reduced and slightly thickened, about more. Step 14: Drop butter into the skillet and swirl it into sauce by tilting the skillet until butter is melted and incorporated. Step 15: Add parsley; remove from heat and set aside. Step 16: Arrange chicken medallions on serving plates and spoon sauce over each portion to serve.

Dish Name: Light Penne With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Chicken
Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomato, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, white wine, italian seasoning, shallots, baby mushrooms, peas, dry penne pasta, cooking spray, garlic, flour, evaporated skim milk, ground nutmeg, red pepper flakes, fresh basil, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: If using cellophane wrapped sundried tomatoes, reconstitute in a small bowl with the boiling water. Step 3: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil while cooking the rest of the recipe. Step 4: Place the chicken and wine in a shallow baking dish, and sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Step 5: Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until meat is no longer pink and juices run clear. Step 6: Shred chicken and reserve cooking juices. Step 7: Drain the sundried tomatoes and chop them fine. Step 8: Pour the chicken cooking juices into a small saucepan. Step 9: Add the shallot, mushrooms, peas, and tomatoes. Step 10: Saute on low a few minutes until liquid is absorbed and vegetables are wilted. Step 11: Remove pan from heat. Step 12: Cover to keep veggies warm. Step 13: Add Penne to the boiling water and cook to desired consistency, 8-10 minutes. Step 14: While pasta is cooking, preheat a heavy small saucepan on medium for 1 minute, then coat twice with cooking spray. Step 15: Add garlic and flour, then whisk in evaporated skim milk. Step 16: Add the nutmeg and red pepper flakes. Step 17: Whisk constantly and bring to a boil. Step 18: Continue to cook another 5 minutes, whisking constantly, until thickened. Step 19: Reduce heat to low and add basil. Step 20: Drain cooked pasta and place in a large bowl. Step 21: Add chicken, veggies, and sauce. Step 22: Toss and garnish with black olives.

Ingredient Names: bacon, skinless chicken breast halves, salt, ground black pepper, garlic, white wine, grated parmesan cheese, large eggs, spaghetti, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Remove bacon from skillet with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel-lined plate. Step 3: Drain fat from skillet, reserving the bacon drippings. Step 4: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 5: Heat bacon drippings in the skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Cook chicken breast halves in the bacon drippings until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes per side. Step 7: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Step 8: Transfer to cutting board and tent with foil. Step 9: Rest chicken for 10 minutes before slicing; set aside. Step 10: Heat remaining tablespoon bacon drippings in skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Step 11: Cook and stir garlic and ground black pepper in skillet until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 12: Pour wine into skillet; cook at a simmer until thickened, about 15-20 minutes, remove from heat. Step 13: Whisk Parmesan cheese and eggs together in a bowl. Step 14: Slowly stream wine mixture into the Parmesan mixture while whisking continually. Step 15: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Step 16: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 17: Remove the water from the pot for later use. Step 18: Put the peas in a large colander. Step 19: Drain the pasta in the colander with the peas. Step 20: Return drained pasta and peas to the pot. Step 21: Stir bacon, chicken, and wine mixture into the spaghetti. Step 22: Thin sauce with reserved pasta water as desired.

Ingredient Names: plain pork rinds, mayonnaise, heavy cream, eggs, parmesan cheese, garlic salt, parsley flakes, chicken cutlets, victoria caponata, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, nonstick cooking spray, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F. Step 2: As written by Lv2Sun, in a small bowl combine the mayo, eggs and cream. Step 3: Be sure that the mayo is blended well and doesn't clump. Step 4: Crush bags of pork rinds and then, in a separate bowl, combine them with cheese, parsley and garlic salt. Step 5: Take each cutlet and dip in the egg mixture and then rind mixture. Step 6: Place the cutlets in a sprayed glass dish. Step 7: Drizzle with lemon juice. Step 8: Top the cutlets liberally with the sauce and then with the cheese, . Step 9: Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes. Step 10: You can place under the broiler for 2-3 minutes if you like the bubbly look, tastes fabulous. Step 11: You can't tell that it is low carb!

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, large egg, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, garlic powder, tomato sauce, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Grease a baking sheet. Step 3: Chicken breasts to 1/2-inch thickness or less. Step 4: Place beaten egg in a bowl. Step 5: Combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder in another bowl. Step 6: Dip each chicken breast in egg, then roll in bread crumb mixture to coat evenly. Step 7: Place on the prepared baking sheet. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 9: Turn and continue to cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, about more, let cool, 20 to. Step 10: Freeze in a 1-gallon resealable bag with smaller bags of tomato sauce and mozzarella cheese. Step 11: To serve: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight. Step 12: Reheat chicken at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) until heated through and crispy, 15 to. Step 13: Top chicken with tomato sauce, sprinkle with mozzarella cheese, and bake until cheese is melted, an additional.

Dish Name: Makes Your House Smell Amazing Chicken Parmesan
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, eggs, milk, italian breadcrumbs, oregano, fresh basil, italian spices, olive oil, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 325. Step 2: Mix breadcrumbs and all seasonings. Step 3: Dip dip chicken into egg mixture and then into breadcrumb mix, coat generously. Step 4: Heat olive oil in frying pan. Step 5: Fry chicken until fully cooked, try not to over cook since it still goes in the oven. Step 6: Place chicken side by side in shallow baking dish. Step 7: Pour sauce over chicken. Step 8: Sprinkle cheese over top. Step 9: Bake covered for 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Remove cover until cheese is bubbly.

Ingredient Names: white wine, olive oil, skinless chicken breast halves, garlic, onion, diced tomatoes, thyme, basil, chopped fresh parsley, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat white wine and oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken and cook until golden, about 4 to on each side. Step 3: Remove chicken from skillet and set aside. Step 4: Add garlic to pan drippings; saut茅 for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add onion; cook and stir until onions are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and add white wine; simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Add thyme and basil and simmer for 5 more minutes. Step 9: Return chicken to skillet, cover, and cook over low heat until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside. Step 10: Add olives and parsley; cook for 5 minutes. Step 11: Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium vegetable broth, white wine, butter, mixed mushrooms, leeks, arborio rice, ground pepper, tarragon, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, bring broth and wine to a simmer. Step 2: Melt 1 Tbs of the butter in heavy large saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add mushrooms; cook 3-5 minutes or until softened, stirring frequently. Step 4: Remove mushrooms from saucepan with slotted spoon; set aside. Step 5: Add remaining 1 Tbs butter and leeks to saucepan; cook until softened, stirring frequently. Step 6: Add rice and pepper; cook about 1 minute, stirring, until rice is coated. Step 7: Add all but 1/2 cup of the simmering broth mixture. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium-low; cook 18-20 minutes or until rice has absorbed most of the liquid and is tender, stirring frequently. Step 9: Stir in tarragon and mushrooms. Step 10: Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 11: Add cheese; stir to blend. Step 12: If necessary, add remaining broth for a creamy consistency.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, chicken, vegetable oil, onion, green bell pepper, garlic, diced tomatoes, white wine, dried oregano, fresh mushrooms, salt and pepper, basil leaves for garnish
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a plastic bag; add chicken pieces and shake until coated in flour. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet (that has a lid) over medium-low heat. Step 4: Add floured chicken pieces and cook in hot oil until browned on both sides, about 6 to. Step 5: Transfer chicken pieces onto a plate; set aside. Step 6: Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the same skillet; cook and stir over medium-low heat until onion is softened and slightly browned. Step 7: Return chicken pieces to the skillet; add tomatoes, wine, and oregano. Step 8: Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Add mushrooms and salt and pepper to taste. Step 10: Simmer until chicken is cooked through and tender, about more. Step 11: Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil leaves.

Dish Name: Mushroom-stuffed chicken with lemon thyme risotto
Ingredient Names: porcini mushroom, olive oil, onions, baby button mushroom, thyme, white wine, skin-on chicken breasts, butter, celery, risotto rice, chicken stock, zest lemon, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. First, make the stuffing. Finely chop the soaked porcini and set aside. Heat the oil in a shallow pan, then gently cook the onion for 5 mins, stirring occasionally. Add the porcini, button mushrooms and thyme leaves, season, turn the heat up, then cook for another 5 mins until the mushrooms have softened. Step 2: Add the wine to the pan, then reduce fiercely until nearly dry. Add 50ml of the porcini soaking liquid, then continue to reduce for a couple of mins until you have a syrupy sauce. Allow to cool for a couple of mins, then carefully spoon between the skin and the flesh of the chicken breasts. Can be made a day ahead and chilled, or frozen for 1 month. Defrost in fridge before cooking. Season, place on a baking tray, skin-side up, then cook in the oven for 20 mins, until the chicken is cooked through and golden. Step 3: While the chicken is cooking, make the risotto. Heat the butter and olive oil in a saucepan. Add the celery and onion, then cook over a medium heat for 5 mins until softened. Add the rice, coat it well in the oil, then cook for 1 min. Gradually add the stock a ladleful at a time, stirring with each addition until absorbed. Continue adding the stock and stirring until the risotto is oozing and thick – about 20 mins. Stir in the thyme, lemon juice, zest and Parmesan. Step 4: When the chicken is cooked through and golden, remove from the oven. Spoon the risotto onto serving plates, sprinkle with the extra Parmesan and top with a chicken breast. Spoon over the juices from the chicken pan, then serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: milk, ricotta cheese, walnuts, grated parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, dried oregano, boneless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Lightly grease a large baking dish. Step 4: Mix ricotta cheese, walnuts, Parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, and oregano in a bowl. Step 5: Loosen the skin on the chicken breasts to form a pocket, and stuff with the ricotta cheese mixture. Step 6: Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in the prepared baking dish, and brush with oil. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear, about 25-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, milk, eggs, parmesan cheese, plain breadcrumbs, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, fresh basil, fresh black pepper, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a baking sheet with non-stick spray. Step 2: In a shallow dish, combine milk and egg. Step 3: In a plastic zipper bag, combine Parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, basil, pepper and paprika. Step 4: Dip chicken strips first in milk mixture, then toss to coat evenly in the breadcrumb/cheese mixture. Step 5: Place on baking sheets and bake at 400 degrees F for 20 minutes or until golden.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, smoked back bacon, leeks, risotto rice, chicken, peas, soft cheese, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Tip the oil into an ovenproof casserole dish. Add bacon and fry for 2 mins. Add the leeks and cook until soft, but not coloured, for about 4-5 mins. Tip in rice and cook for 1 min more. Pour over stock. Cover and place in the oven for 20 mins, stirring halfway. Step 2: When rice is just tender and all liquid is absorbed, remove from oven and stir in peas. Place back in oven for 2 mins more. Remove and stir in cheese. Add zest and season.

Ingredient Names: smoked bacon, onions, butter, risotto rice, half glass white wine, cherry tomatoes, chicken stock, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Fry the bacon pieces in an ovenproof pan or casserole dish for 3-5 mins until golden and crisp. Stir in the onion and butter and cook for 3-4 mins until soft. Tip in the rice and mix well until coated. Pour over the wine if using and cook for 2 mins until absorbed. Step 2: Add the cherry tomatoes and the hot stock, then give the rice a quick stir. Cover with a tightly fitting lid and bake for 18 mins until just cooked. Stir through most of the parmesan and serve sprinkled with the remainder.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, pepper, mayonnaise, fresh basil, garlic, pine nuts, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: If not using prepackaged chicken, preheat oven to 375°F. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper and place in baking dish. Step 3: Roast about 35 minutes, or until juices run clear, cool. Step 4: Cut chicken into bite size pieces (about 1 inches by 1/2 in.) and place in medium bowl. Step 5: In a food processor, puree mayo, basil, garlic, and pine nuts. Step 6: Add to chicken and toss with cheese.

Ingredient Names: egg whites, parmesan, boneless, new potatoes, peas, baby spinach leaves, white wine vinegar, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to medium and line the grill pan with foil. Beat the egg white on a plate with a little salt and pepper. Tip the parmesan onto another plate. Dip the chicken first in egg white, then in the cheese. Grill the coated chicken for 10-12 mins, turning once until browned and crisp. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the potatoes for 10 mins, adding the peas for the final 3 mins, then drain. Toss the vegetables with the spinach leaves, vinegar, oil and seasoning to taste. Divide between four warm plates, then serve with the chicken.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast halves, kosher salt, ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, olive oil, butter, dry white wine, capers, chicken stock, lemon juice, lemon zest, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts in half lengthwise and lightly pound to 1/2-inch thick. Step 2: Season evenly on both sides with salt and pepper. Step 3: Dredge each piece in flour to coat the surface and shake off any excess flour. Step 4: Heat oil and 1 陆 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until just beginning to smoke. Step 5: Add 1/2 of the chicken and cook, undisturbed, until browned and easily released from the skillet, 2 陆 to. Step 6: Flip and cook for 2 more minutes. Step 7: Remove from the skillet. Step 8: Add remaining oil to the drippings and repeat the cooking process with remaining chicken. Step 9: Reserve all chicken on a plate. Step 10: Reduce heat to medium and melt remaining 1 陆 tablespoons butter in the skillet. Step 11: Add wine and capers and stir, scraping to release any browned bits from the skillet; bring to a simmer. Step 12: Cook for to slightly reduce. Step 13: Add chicken stock, lemon juice, and lemon zest; stir to combine. Step 14: Bring to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes. Step 15: Return chicken to the skillet and cook, turning occasionally in the sauce, until chicken is no longer pink in the center, the juices run clear, and the sauce has thickened slightly, 3 to. Step 16: Remove from heat and sprinkle with parsley to serve.

Dish Name: Pesto chicken kebabs with roasted veg pasta
Ingredient Names: butternut squash around, zucchini, onions, red peppers, thyme, olive oil, boneless, lemons, pesto, cherry tomatoes, penne pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/ gas 6. Put the vegetables into a large roasting tin. Scatter with the thyme and season. Drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil and roast for 40 mins, turning halfway. Step 2: Meanwhile, soak 8 wooden skewers. Put the chicken into a shallow dish, then mix with the lemon juice and pesto. Step 3: Thread the chicken and tomatoes onto the skewers, then put onto a roasting tray. Drizzle with the rest of the olive oil and roast for 20 mins, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through. Boil the pasta. Toss half of the roasted vegetables and pasta together, then serve with the pesto chicken kebabs.

Dish Name: Pesto chicken stew with cheesy dumplings
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken thighs skin, smoked bacon lardon, onions, celery, leeks, flour, white wine, chicken stock, bay leaves, peas, sundried tomato, pesto, fresh basil, butter, parmesan, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large casserole dish. Brown the chicken until golden on all sides – you might have to do this in batches – remove the chicken from the pan as you go and set aside. Step 2: Add the lardons to the pan and sizzle for a few mins, then add the onion, celery and leeks, and cook over a medium heat for 8-10 mins until the vegetables have softened. Stir in the flour, season and cook for a further 2 mins. Step 3: Gradually stir in the wine and allow it to bubble away, then stir in the stock. Return the chicken to the pan with the bay leaves and cover with a lid. Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 1½ hrs or until the chicken is tender. The stew can now be cooled and frozen if you’re making ahead. Just defrost thoroughly, then gently warm through back in the pan before continuing. Step 4: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Add the peas, sundried tomatoes, pesto and basil to the stew. To make the dumplings, rub the butter into the flour until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. Mix in the grated cheese and add 150ml water, mixing with a cutlery knife to bring the crumbs together to form a light and sticky dough. Break off walnut-sized lumps and shape into small balls. Roll the tops of the dumplings in the pine nuts so a few stick to the outside, then place the dumplings on top of the stew and scatter with any remaining nuts. Put the dish in the oven and bake for 25 mins until the dumplings are golden brown and cooked through. Serve with mashed potato and extra veg if you like.

Ingredient Names: bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, salt, ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, egg, lemon juice, skinless chicken breast halves, shredded mozzarella cheese, pepperoni
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 2: Combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl; place flour into a second bowl. Step 3: Whisk egg and lemon juice together in a third bowl. Step 4: Dip each chicken breast in egg mixture and dredge in flour; dip again in egg mixture and dredge chicken in crumb mixture until coated. Step 5: Place coated chicken breasts into a baking dish. Step 6: Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is heated through and crumbs are golden, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Spoon pizza sauce onto each chicken breast, sprinkle each with half the mozzarella cheese, and top each with half the pepperoni slices. Step 8: Bake until chicken is no longer pink inside and the juices run clear, about 10 more minutes. Step 9: An instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a breast should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, cubetti di pancetta, garlic, thyme, ready-cooked polenta cubes, parmesan, single, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. In a large frying pan, gently fry the onion in the oil until soft, about 8-10 mins. Stir in the pancetta, garlic and thyme, and cook until the pancetta is browned and crisp. Stir in the polenta and half the cheese and cook for a few mins – don’t worry if the polenta breaks up. You can prepare up to this stage up to a day ahead. Step 2: Add the cream and stock to the pan, mix thoroughly, then pour into an oiled baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over and bake for 40 mins or until browned on top. Allow to stand for 10 mins before serving.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, onions, olive oil, chicken stock, creme fraiche, parmesan, chicken breasts, bacon, spinach, peas
Instructions: Step 1: Potato gratin with chicken and bacon greens: a gratin always seems more effort and more indulgent than ordinary boiled or roasts, but it doesn't have to take, it's nice for a change and you can control the calorie content by going with full fat to low fat creme fraiche. Step 2: (It's always tastes better full fat though obviously!) to serve 4: use potatoes, finely slice and boil in a pan for about till firmish, not soft. Step 3: Finely slice 3 onions and place in an oven dish with p of olive oil and chicken stock. Step 4: Cook till the onions are soft then drain the potatoes and pour onto the onions. Step 5: Season and spoon over cream or creme fraiche till all is covered but not swimming. Step 6: Grate Parmesan over the top then finish under the grill till nicely golden. Step 7: Serve with chicken and bacon, peas and spinach.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, salt, diced tomatoes, water, minced garlic, stuffing mix, shredded mozzarella cheese, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 3: Spray a 9x13-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Step 4: Stir tomatoes, water, garlic, and stuffing mix in a large bowl; set aside to soften. Step 5: Toss cubed chicken with salt in a large bowl; transfer onto the bottom of the baking dish. Step 6: Sprinkle cheese and Italian seasoning on top of chicken. Step 7: Spread the softened stuffing mixture on top. Step 8: Bake uncovered until chicken is cooked through and casserole is golden brown on top, about 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breast halves, cayenne pepper, salt, ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, olive oil, white wine, lemon juice, unsalted butter, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts between 2 sheets of heavy plastic on a solid, level surface. Step 2: Firmly pound chicken breasts with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a 1/2-inch thickness. Step 3: Season both sides of chicken breasts with cayenne, salt, and black pepper; dredge lightly in flour and shake off any excess. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Place chicken in the pan, reduce heat to medium, and cook until browned and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side; transfer to a plate. Step 6: Cook capers in reserved oil, smashing them lightly to release brine, until warmed through, about 30 seconds. Step 7: Pour white wine into the skillet and bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food off the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Step 8: Cook until reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Stir lemon juice, water, and butter into the reduced wine mixture; cook and stir continuously to form a thick sauce, about 2 minutes. Step 10: Reduce heat to low and stir parsley through the sauce. Step 11: Return chicken breasts to the pan and cook until heated through, 1 to. Step 12: Serve with sauce spooned over the top.

Dish Name: Red wine risotto with duck & garlicky mushrooms
Ingredient Names: butter, onions, carrots, celery, garlic, thyme, risotto rice, red wine, chicken stock, leftover duck, chestnut mushroom, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a wide saucepan, then add the onion, carrots and celery. Cover, then gently cook for 10 mins until soft. Tip in two-thirds of the garlic, fry for 1 min, turn up the heat, then add the thyme and rice. Stir for a few mins, then add the wine and let it reduce to almost nothing. Step 2: Stir in the stock over a medium heat, ladle by ladle, waiting for each addition to absorb before adding the next. Keep the heat on medium – too hot and the stock will evaporate rather than be absorbed by the rice. When the rice is creamy and justcooked, take off the heat, add the duck, then cover for 5 mins to heat through. Step 3: Melt the remaining butter in another wide pan, add the mushrooms, then fry them on a high heat for about 3 mins until golden. Add the remaining garlic, fry for 1 min more, then season. Stir the mushrooms into the risotto, then scatter with parsley and serve.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, salt and pepper, onion, chopped fresh rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Season chicken all over with salt and pepper, including cavity. Step 3: Stuff cavity with onion and rosemary. Step 4: Place chicken in a 9x13-inch baking dish or roasting pan. Step 5: Roast in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 2 to 2 1/. Step 6: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of chicken near the bone should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, risotto rice, glass white wine, stock, chicken breasts from roast chicken, thyme leaf, peas, creme fraiche, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pan and cook the onion and garlic for 5 mins. Stir in the rice and cook for 1 min more, until it starts to look transparent. Pour in the wine and keep stirring until all the liquid is absorbed. Step 2: Add the stock and simmer until the rice is just tender. Stir through the chicken, thyme and peas, then cook for 2 mins or until the chicken is warmed through. Add the crème fraîche and parmesan with some seasoning, then remove from the heat. Cover with a lid and leave to stand for 2 mins before serving with extra parmesan, if you like.

Dish Name: Roast chicken with pancetta & ricotta stuffing balls
Ingredient Names: chicken, extra-virgin olive oil, bread, parsley, ricotta, parmesan, thyme, fresh basil, garlic, eggs, pancetta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Season the chicken inside and out, then place in a large roasting dish. Rub all over with the oil. Place in oven, then cook for 1 hr 30 mins, spooning oil and juices over the bird a few times during cooking. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the stuffing. Whizz the bread and parsley in a food processor or grate the bread on the biggest holes of a grater. Mix with the rest of the stuffing ingredients, apart from the pancetta or bacon, in a large bowl. Use your hands to shape into 12 balls, then wrap a slice of pancetta or bacon around each. Step 3: Test if the chicken is done by inserting a skewer into the thigh meat; when the juices run clear, remove from the roasting dish. Place on a serving plate and loosely cover with foil. While the chicken is resting, pour away any excess fat from the dish and tip in the stuffing balls. Cook for 20 mins until crisp and golden. Serve alongside the chicken.

Dish Name: Roasted Chicken with Risotto and Caramelized Onions
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, balsamic vinegar, arborio rice, dry white wine, chicken broth, cooked chicken, butter, salt, pepper, parsley for garnish
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Saut茅 onion in hot oil until dark golden brown, 15 to. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in balsamic vinegar; set aside. Step 4: Heat remaining olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Cook and stir rice in hot oil for 5 minutes. Step 6: Pour in wine while stirring. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 8: Pour in hot broth; cook and stir until broth is absorbed. Step 9: While stirring constantly, continue adding remaining broth, at a time, until all broth is absorbed and rice is tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Stir in reserved onion mixture until heated through, remove from heat. Step 11: Stir in chicken and butter; season with salt and pepper. Step 12: Garnish each serving with thyme.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless, rosemary, red onions, garlic, anchovy fillets, tomatoes, capers, red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a non-stick pan, then brown the chicken all over. Add half the chopped rosemary, stir to coat, then set aside on a plate. Step 2: In the same pan, heat the rest of the oil, then gently cook the onion for about 5 mins until soft. Add the garlic, anchovies and remaining rosemary, then fry for a few mins more until fragrant. Pour in the tomatoes and capers with the wine, if using, or 75ml water if not. Bring to the boil, then return the chicken pieces to the pan. Cover, then cook for 20 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Season and serve with a crisp green salad and crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken leg portions, red peppers, red chile, glass red wine, quantity tomato sauce, black olives, flatleaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat the oil in a deep, ovenproof roasting pan that’s big enough to fit the chicken in a single layer. Season the chicken pieces all over, then place the pan on the hob and cook on a medium heat for 7-10 mins on each side until well browned. Scoop out the chicken with a slotted spoon and put to one side. Step 2: Add the peppers and chilli to the pan (there should still be plenty of fat left in it) and cook for 10 mins until soft and beginning to brown at the edges. Pour away any excess fat, then pour in the wine and stir well for 1-2 mins as it bubbles up. Tip the tomato sauce into the pan and stir again. Add a little water (up to 150ml) to achieve a thick, pouring consistency. Nestle the chicken into the sauce and scatter with the olives. Cover, bake for 30 mins, then uncover and cook for 15-20 mins more to allow the chicken to crisp up. Spoon off any fat that has risen to the surface, scatter with parsley and serve with some rice, mashed potato or polenta.

Dish Name: Stuffed Chicken Breasts with Pesto Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast halves, fresh asparagus, colby cheese, plain breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, pine nuts, eggs, salt, pepper, pesto sauce, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts to an even 1/4 inch thickness and set aside. Step 2: Snap off tough bottoms of asparagus. Step 3: Place in boiling water and cover for 1 minute. Step 4: Drain, rinse with cold water; then pat dry. Step 5: Cut asparagus 3 inch lengths. Step 6: Cut cheese into sticks 1/2 inch high x 1/2 inch wide by 3 inches long, set aside. Step 7: Combine bread crumbs, parmesan and pine nuts in a bowl. Step 8: In another bowl beat eggs with a fork. Step 9: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Step 10: Place a stick of colby and an asparagus spear next to one long edge of each breast. Step 11: Roll breast around ingredients tucking in ends to form a neat package. Step 12: Secure with a toothpick if necessary. Step 13: Dip each package in egg and then in breadcrumb mixture. Step 14: Make a double coating by dipping again into egg then crumbs. Step 15: Place packages in a baking dish and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 400 degrees F. Step 16: While the chicken is baking combine pesto and cream in a small saucepan. Step 17: Bring to a boil and reduce 2 minutes until lightly thickened. Step 18: Serve pesto cream sauce over stuffed chicken breasts.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, grated parmesan cheese, garlic powder, bread crumbs, skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 3: Mix mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, and garlic powder together in a bowl. Step 4: Place bread crumbs in a separate bowl. Step 5: Dip each chicken breast into the mayonnaise mixture, then into the bread crumbs to coat Arrange breaded chicken on a baking sheet. Step 6: Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the coating is golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, skinless chicken breast halves, marinara sauce, basil, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese, garlic croutons
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Coat the bottom of a 9x13-inch casserole dish with olive oil, and sprinkle with garlic and red pepper flakes. Step 3: Arrange chicken breasts in the bottom of the dish. Step 4: Pour marinara sauce over chicken. Step 5: Sprinkle basil over marinara sauce, and top with 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese, followed by 1/2 of the Parmesan cheese, and croutons. Step 6: Top with remaining mozzarella cheese and remaining Parmesan cheese. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese and croutons are golden brown and the chicken is no longer pink inside, about to an hour, depending on the shape and thickness of your chicken breasts. Step 8: An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a chicken breast should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C), serve hot and.

Dish Name: Tomato & anchovy risotto with crispy crumbs
Ingredient Names: anchovy fillets olive oil, red onions, garlic, risotto rice, chicken, cherry tomato, white breadcrumb, fresh basil leaves, shaved parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil from the anchovies in a saucepan. Add the anchovy fillets and onion and cook for 5 mins to soften. Add the garlic and cook for 1 min more. Tip in the rice, stir to coat in the oil, then cook for 2 mins until the grains turn translucent. Step 2: Add the stock, a ladle at a time, making sure the liquid is absorbed before you add the next and stirring continuously while cooking. Once you’ve added half the stock, tip in the tomatoes. Step 3: Continue cooking and adding the stock until the rice is cooked but still has a little bite – the risotto should be oozy but not soupy. Season to taste, turn off the heat, put a lid on and leave for 5 mins. Step 4: Heat the remaining anchovy oil in a frying pan, add the breadcrumbs and toss until evenly golden. Serve the risotto in bowls with the crispy crumbs, basil leaves (if you like), and shaved Parmesan scattered on top.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, italian herb mix, garlic powder, cooking salt kosher salt, fresh black pepper, olive oil, onions, garlic, sun tomatoes, cherry, butter beans, chardonnay, flour all-purpose flour, chicken stock broth, thickened cream heavy cream, parmesan, baby spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken, sear. Sauté onion and garlic. Deglaze with wine, stir in flour, then stock. Add beans and sun dried tomato, simmer 7 minutes. Add cream, parmesan and cherry tomatoes, simmer 8 minutes. Stir in spinach, serve! Step 2: Season and sear chicken - Sprinkle chicken with the seasoning and toss to coat. Heat the oil on high in a 30 cm / 12" non stick pan until very hot. Add the chicken, spread it out, then leave it for 30 seconds or so until golden. Then start stirring, leaving it for 20 seconds every now and then to get colour on the pieces, until most of the pieces are light golden. Step 3: Sauté onion - Lower heat to medium high. Add onion and garlic then cook for around 2 minutes until the onion is wilted. Step 4: Deglaze and add flour - Turn the heat back up to high. Add the wine and let it simmer for 1 - 2 minutes until reduced by half. Add flour and stir until it is mixed in. Step 5: Make sauce - Slow pour in a third of the stock, mixing as you go. The flour will make the liquid turn into a thick sauce quite quickly. Then add the rest of the stock, beans and sun dried tomato, and stir well. Step 6: First simmer 7 minutes - Bring to a simmer. Lower heat to medium or medium high so it's simmering, not too rapidly. Simmer 7 minutes, stirring every now and then. Step 7: Second simmer 8 minutes - Add cherry tomatoes, cream and parmesan. Mix and simmer for 8 minutes. The sauce should be reduced and thicken into a gravy consistency. Step 8: Wilt spinach - Stir spinach in to make it wile (~ 30 seconds). Ladle into bowls, garnish with extra parmesan and chilli flakes if desired. Serve with warm crusty bread for dunking!

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, butter, onion, garlic, all-purpose flour, chicken broth, milk, salt, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese, dried basil, dried oregano, ground black pepper, ricotta cheese, chicken, spinach, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients and preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Add lasagna noodles and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain and rinse with cold water. Step 4: Meanwhile, melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat; stir in onion and garlic. Step 5: Whisk in flour until lightly browned and onion is tender, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken broth, milk, and salt; cook, whisking continuously, for 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in mozzarella and Parmesan until well combined. Step 8: Season with basil, oregano, and black pepper; remove from heat and set aside. Step 9: Spread 1/3 of the sauce mixture in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 10: Layer with 3 lasagna noodles, ricotta, and chicken. Step 11: Arrange 3 lasagna noodles over the chicken and layer with 1/3 of the sauce mixture, spinach, remaining mozzarella, and Parmesan. Step 12: Arrange remaining noodles over cheese and spread remaining sauce evenly over noodles. Step 13: Sprinkle with parsley and remaining Parmesan. Step 14: Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to, serve and.

Ingredient Names: porcini mushroom, chicken stock, dessert chestnut mushrooms, smoked streaky bacon, butter, onions, risotto rice, glass white wine, parmesan, leftover roast chicken, parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dried mushrooms in 500ml boiling water for 20 mins, then drain the liquid into the stock. The mushrooms will have absorbed a lot of the liquid; you should have 1.5l in total. Chop the soaked mushrooms and add to the chestnut mushrooms. Step 2: Make the risotto: start by frying the bacon in half the butter, then add the onion. When they are soft, add the mushrooms and continue to cook for a few mins until soft. Stir through the rice and continue as in the basic recipe. When you add the final ladle of stock, stir through the chicken to reheat. Add the chopped parsley with the Parmesan and remaining butter, leave to rest for a few mins, then stir through and serve.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, white sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, eggs, butter, almond extract, vanilla extract, whole almonds, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 300f Spray large baking sheet with pam or oil If using whole, unblanched almonds, boil 2 cups water in microwave and place almonds in water for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Remove skins and chop coarsely. Step 3: Combine all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt and set aside Cream sugars and butter until creamy and smooth using an electric mixer. Step 4: Add eggs, almond and vanilla extracts, stir until well mixed. Step 5: Add the dry ingredients, including the almonds and mix well Dough should be very thick and sticky If it is too sticky to hold a shape you can use powdered sugar to thicken it - just be sure to mix the powdered sugar into the dough thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: vanilla ice cream, brewed espresso, brandy, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put the scoop of ice cream in a pretty glass, bowl or coffee cup Combine the hot espresso with the brandy and sugar and pour over ice cream Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, marsala, whipping cream, mascarpone cheese, brewed espresso, brandy, vanilla, savoiardi cookies, cocoa powder, chocolate curls
Instructions: Step 1: Zabaglione cream: in the top part of a double boiler, beat eggs and sugar together until the mixture is pale yellow in color In the bottom part of the double boiler, bring water to a boil then reduce heat to simmer. Step 2: Place egg yolk mixture over water and gradually add marsala, beating continously Scrape bottom and sides of pan occasionally and cook 6 to 10 minutes or until soft mounds can be formed. Step 3: Transfer to bowl, cover and refrigerate 30 minutes Whip cream with 2 tbsp Sugar until soft peaks form. Step 4: Fold in mascarpone and zabaglione and mix until well blended. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Step 6: In a separate bowl, mix espresso, 2 tbsp.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, cornmeal, baking powder, salt, sugar, eggs, lemon zest, whole almond
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Step 2: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, and salt In another large bowl, beat the sugar and eggs until pale yellow, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Mix in the lemon zest and then the flour, and beat until just blended. Step 4: Stir in the almonds. Step 5: Let the dough rest for 5 minutes. Step 6: Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 7: Divide the dough evenly into 2 equal mounds and place on the baking sheet With moist hands, space the dough evenly apart and form into 2 logs. Step 8: Bake for 35 minutes until lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: butter, caster sugar, lemon zest, eggs, all-purpose flour, baking powder, almond meal, pears, cinnamon, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a 30cm flan tin or a pie plate that you can directly slice and serve from. Step 2: Preheat oven to 18oc. Step 3: Using electric beaters, beat butter, sugar and lemon zest until creamy and pale in colour Continu beating and add the eggs, one at a time. Step 4: Fold in the flour, baking powder and almond meal. Step 5: Fold in the xanthan or guar gum at this point if you are using gluten-free flour that does not already contain a gum. Step 6: Spoon half of this mixture into the flan tin. Step 7: Spread to cover Reserve the remaining half of the mixture. Step 8: Arrange the pear slices over the base.

Ingredient Names: butter, white sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, almond extract, orange zest, soy flour, rice flour, potato starch, tapioca flour, xanthan gum, ground nutmeg, salt, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f cover baking sheet with parchment paper or grease and flour baking sheet Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Step 2: Add eggs, extracts, and orange zest. Step 3: Combine flours together in a bowl Slowly blend dry ingredients into creamed mixture, stir in almonds. Step 4: Add water if dough is too dry Consistency should be similar to play dough. Step 5: Roll half of mixture into a log approximately 12 inches long. Step 6: Place on baking sheet and smooth into loaf about 1 / 2 thick and still 12 inches long.

Ingredient Names: raisins, dark rum, white bread, unsalted butter, whole milk, eggs, sugar, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Place raisins in a small bowl with the rum and allow to soak. Step 2: Remove the crusts from the bread Determine how much bread you will need by lining the sides bottom and top of a 8 or 9 inch loaf pan and use all the butter to coat both sides of the slices of bread. Step 3: Line the sides and bottom with the buttered bread slices and set aside the slices that will go on top. Step 4: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and heat it over low heat till you see steam rising when it is stirred - do not boil While the milk is heating, put the eggs and 4 t of sugar in the bowl of a mixer. Step 5: Beat at high speed till the mixture is pale yellow and forms ribbons on the beaters when lifted With the mixer at low speed, slowly add the hot milk. Step 6: When about half of the milk has been incorporated, you can add the rest more quickly. Step 7: Place the almonds and remaining 3 t sugar in a food processor and pulse until the reach the consistency of coarsely ground black pepper.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, caster sugar, butter, lemon zest, egg yolks, fresh ricotta, eggs, blanched almond, sliced almonds, icing sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Pastry: Combine the flour, sugar and a pinch of salt in a large bowl. Step 2: Make a well in the centre and add the butter, zest and egg yolks Work the flour into the ingredients until a smooth dough forms. Step 3: Wrap in plastic and chill for 1 hour Filling: Beat the ricotta and sugar with electric beaters Gradually add the eggs, beating well after each addition. Step 4: Stir in the zest and the chopped almonds. Step 5: Preheat oven to 180c.

Ingredient Names: butter, cream cheese, amaretto, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place all in a food processor and pulse till smooth Drizzle or spread on whatever you like.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, blanched almond, whipping cream, brandy
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly grease a baking sheet, set aside. Step 2: Melt butter in a small skillet over low heat, add sugar. Step 3: Cook until golden brown, stirring constantly, stir in almonds. Step 4: Spread almond mixture on greased baking sheet. Step 5: Cool completely Crush into crumbs. Step 6: In a medium bowl, whip cream until stiff.

Ingredient Names: chocolate chips, butter, fat-free sweetened condensed milk, almond liqueur, almonds, cocoa
Instructions: Step 1: Melt chips and butter in microwave oven. Step 2: Add the condensed milk and almond liqueur and stir to combine. Step 3: Refrigerate till solid Scoop or slice pieces Rolling into a size of a large marble, set aside. Step 4: In a food processor pulse almond till fine add cocoa and pulse to just mix. Step 5: Place in a storage bag. Step 6: Add a couple truffles at a time and shake. Step 7: Remove and reshape place into cute little candy cups.

Ingredient Names: eggs, granulated sugar, vegetable oil, lemon zest, anise seeds, baking powder, vanilla extract, salt, all-purpose flour, whole almond, coarse sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the eggs, sugar, oil, lemon zest, aniseeds, baking powder, vanilla and salt, whisk to blend. Step 3: Add the flour and almonds and stir until a dough forms. Step 4: Turn out onto a lightly floured work surface and knead until smooth, about 10 turns. Step 5: Divide the dough in half Form each half into a log 2 inches in diameter Carefully transfer the logs to an ungreased baking sheet, spacing them well apart, and pat to even the shapes. Step 6: Sprinkle the tops with coarse sugar. Step 7: Bake until firm to the touch, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sugar, unsalted butter, lemon, vanilla sugar, large eggs, almond flour, ricotta cheese, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 2: Grease an 8-inch springform pan and line with parchment paper. Step 3: Bean sugar and butter in a large bowl with an electric mixer until creamy, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla sugar; mix until well combined.
