Step 5: Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 6: Fold in almond flour and ricotta cheese with a silicone spatula. Step 7: Wash and dry the beaters. Step 8: Beat egg whites in a glass, metal, or ceramic bowl until foamy. Step 9: Gradually add sugar, continuing to beat until stiff peaks form. Step 10: Fold stiff egg whites into almond-ricotta batter; pour into the prepared pan. Step 11: Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Step 12: Bake on the center rake of the preheated oven until edges of the cake are lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 13: Cake will still be a little wobbly in the middle. Step 14: Remove from the oven and let cake cool completely in the pan before transferring to a cake platter, about 5 minutes. Step 15: Dust with confectioners' sugar before serving.

Ingredient Names: apricots, orange zest juice, golden sugar, mascarpone, vanilla custard, amaretti biscuit, dark chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Tip the apricots into a roasting tin, toss with the orange zest, juice and sugar and roast for 15-20 mins until soft. Remove the skins if you like. Tip into a bowl to cool. Step 2: Whisk the mascarpone and custard together until completely blended. Step 3: Tip the biscuits into a large glass bowl, then top with the apricots and custard. Scatter generously with the grated chocolate, then cover and chill until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: vanilla cream-filled sandwich style cookies, almond extract, butter, cream cheese, eggs, sweetened condensed milk, pure vanilla extract, amaretto, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 9 inch spring form pan with a cooking spray, the bottom and sides. Step 2: Place cookie crumbs in a large bowl. Step 3: Add the 1 / 8 tsp almond extract and the melted butter. Step 4: Combine well until crumbly Pack onto bottom and up the sides of prepared pan, set aside. Step 5: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Step 6: In a mixer bowl place 24 ounces cream cheese and beat until thick and fluffly. Step 7: Add in the can of sweetened condensed milk and combine well. Step 8: Add in the eggs one at a time, beating well to combine after each egg.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, eggs, pure vanilla extract, amaretto liqueur, sliced almonds, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Cream together butter and sugar with an electric mixer. Step 2: Add eggs, vanilla, and amaretto liqueur, mix well. Step 3: Add flour, baking powder, and salt. Step 4: Mix on low speed until just blended. Step 5: Add almonds and stir. Step 6: Divide dough into two equal pieces. Step 7: Roll each piece into a loaf about 12 inches long on a well floured surface, and place on a large baking sheet about 3 inches apart. Step 8: Bake for about 20- 25 minutes, until golden.

Ingredient Names: white cake mix with pudding, eggs, vanilla yogurt, vegetable oil, amaretto liqueur, almond extract, semisweet chocolate, heavy whipping cream, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Grease and flour your pans. Step 2: Set the oven to 350 degrees. Step 3: Mix the cake mix with the next five ingredients. Step 4: Pour the batter in your pan and bake for 27 minutes for layers or 45+ minutes for a bundt pan. Step 5: Check the cake with a toothpick to see if it is done. Step 6: Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes and then remove to finish cooling on a cooling rack For the ganache: Unwrap the squares of chocolate and place them in a bowl. Step 7: Pour the whipping cream in a pan and bring to a boil. Step 8: Pour the hot cream on the chocolate and stir it until it is smooth and glossy.

Ingredient Names: semi-sweet chocolate chips, light corn syrup, sugar, instant coffee, hot water, amaretto, almond cookie, walnuts, unsweetened cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chocolate chips, corn syrup, sugar, instant coffee and water in a heavy saucepan. Step 2: Heat over low flame until chocolate is melted, stirring constantly, remove from heat. Step 3: Stir in amaretto, cookie crumbs and walnuts. Step 4: Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Step 5: Shape chilled mixture into 1-inch balls, roll in cocoa. Step 6: Store tightly covered in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, mascarpone cheese, heavy cream, almond extract, vanilla extract, brewed espresso, egg whites, ladyfingers, cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl set over but not touching a pan of simmering water, beat the egg yolks and sugar until the mixture is pale yellow and thick ribbons fall from the whisk. Step 2: Transfer the mixture to the bowl of an electric mixer. Step 3: Add the mascarpone cheese and beat until smooth and creamy. Step 4: In a chilled large mixing bowl, beat the cream to stiff peaks. Step 5: Add the almond, vanilla and the 2 tablespoons of espresso and beat until smooth. Step 6: In a clean mixing bowl, beat the egg whites to stiff peaks With a rubber spatula, gently fold the mascarpone mixture into the cream until blended and smooth. Step 7: Add about 1 cup of the beaten egg whites and fold gently until blended. Step 8: Add the remaining egg whites and fold gently until the mixture is smooth and blended One at a time, submerge each ladyfinger into the remaining espresso, then it on the bottom of a 6-quart glass or ceramic baking or serving dish.

Ingredient Names: bay leaves, eggs, ricotta cheese, honey, grated orange zest, lemon juice, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 2: Pour some water into a small, oven proof bowl, and place into the oven. Step 3: Arrange the bay leaves over the bottom of the springform pan to cover. Step 4: Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl, then mix in ricotta cheese, honey, orange zest, and lemon juice. Step 5: Sprinkle in the flour, and stir until evenly combined. Step 6: Gently pour the batter over the bay leaves, being careful not to disturb them too much. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 35 to. Step 8: Run the tip of a paring knife around the edges of the pan, and release from the springform pan. Step 9: Invert onto a serving plate, and serve warm or chilled.

Ingredient Names: sugar, vegetable shortening, eggs, lemon extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, confectioners' sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f For cookies, cream together sugar and shortening. Step 2: Add eggs and lemon extract and beat well. Step 3: Add flour, baking powder and salt. Step 4: Mix well The dough should be soft and sticky With a small cookie scoop, drop dough onto a slightly greased cookie sheet or baking stone, spacing them about 2-inches apart. Step 5: Bake for about 12-15 minutes, or until firm and lightly brown. Step 6: Remove cookies from cookie sheet and allow to cool completely on wire racks For frosting, combine confectioners' sugar, water and lemon extract and mix until smooth.

Dish Name: Anise Easter Bread Bread Machine Loaf
Ingredient Names: whole milk, eggs, egg yolk, vanilla extract, anise flavoring, salt, granulated sugar, butter, all-purpose flour, gluten, active dry yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Place in order of your manufacturers instructions for your bread machine. Step 2: Place on sweet bread setting, light crust Checking as mixing that it forms a smooth slight tacky ball of dough If dough is sloppy, add a tsp, flour at a time If dough is too hard like, add a tsp milk, at a time Although at this time i did not have to adjust my dough upon mixing. Step 3: Remove when completed baking, to a wire rack. Step 4: Cool thoroughly before cutting with a serrated bread knife, or before storing.

Ingredient Names: margarine, sugar, eggs, cinnamon, anise oil, anise flavoring, vanilla, baking powder, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Melt and cool margarine. Step 2: Beat eggs until foamy. Step 3: Add sugar, cinnamon, flavorings, oil, and margarine, mix well. Step 4: Add flour mixed with baking powder gradually. Step 5: Cook on iron following manufacturers instructions.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, butter, white sugar, eggs, anise extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a bowl; set aside. Step 3: Grease 2 baking sheets. Step 4: Beat butter and sugar with an electric mixer in a large bowl until fluffy. Step 5: Beat in one egg until completely incorporated, then another 2 minutes. Step 6: Beat in last egg along with the anise extract. Step 7: Mix in flour until just incorporated. Step 8: Divide dough into two 12-inch long logs, 1/2-inch thick; place on prepared baking sheets. Step 9: Bake in the preheated oven until golden and firm to the touch, 20 to. Step 10: Remove from the oven, and allow to cool,. Step 11: Cut into 3/4-inch thick slices using a serrated knife, and place cut-side-down onto the baking sheets. Step 12: Bake 5 to until the bottoms turn golden brown. Step 13: Turn cookies over, and continue baking until golden brown on the other side, 5 to more. Step 14: Cool completely on a wire rack before serving.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, flour, sugar, almonds, anise extract, baking powder, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Step 2: Add extract Gradually add dry ingredients and knead until a soft uniform dough is formed. Step 3: Divide dough in half. Step 4: Turn dough out onto a well-greased cookie sheet and form dough into a log about 9-inches long Gently press down to flatten alittle. Step 5: Brush with milk and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 20 minutes. Step 6: Remove from oven and with a serated knife cut the biscotti into 1 / 2" diagonal slices Lay the cookie flat side down and return to oven until light gold in color, cool.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, baking soda, salt, dried apricot, toasted almond, eggs, egg whites, margarine, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Step 2: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, apricots and almonds. Step 3: Make a well in centre of flour mixture. Step 4: Drop in eggs, egg whites, margarine and almond extract, whisk until blended. Step 5: Stir in dry ingredients until combined Form dough into a ball. Step 6: Place on a baking sheet With slightly wet hands, form dough into a 16 inch long log Flatten log to 1 inch thickness. Step 7: Bake until light brown and cracked on top, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, ground almonds, dried apricot, light rum, almond paste, sugar, eggs, all-purpose flour, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Butter a 9 inch tube pan generously, and dust with ground almonds. Step 2: Combine apricots with rum and set aside. Step 3: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter with almond paste and 1 / 2 cup sugar. Step 4: Add egg yolks and beat until light and fluffy. Step 5: Mix in apricots in rum and almond extract until well blended. Step 6: Mix in flour until well blended, but don't over mix In another bowl beat egg whites until fluffy Into the egg whites, gradually beat in remaining 1 / 2 cup of sugar until stiff and shiny. Step 7: Mix 1 / 3 of the egg whites into the creamed mixture.

Dish Name: Artichoke & broad bean tart with watercress pesto
Ingredient Names: shortcrust pastry, broad bean, ricotta, creme fraiche, eggs, parmesan, lemons, watercress, pine nuts, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Roll out the pastry and line a 28cm tart tin. Chill for 30 mins. Meanwhile, make the pesto. Place the watercress, pine nuts, Parmesan, olive oil and lemon juice in a food processer and blitz to a thick sauce. Season to taste and set aside. Step 2: Cook the broad beans for 1 min in a pan of boiling water. Drain and refresh under cold water, then peel off the outer layer. Place the peeled beans to one side. Step 3: Line the tart with greaseproof paper and fill with baking beans. Bake for 10 mins, remove the paper and beans and cook for 15 mins more until light golden. Remove from the oven and reduce temperature to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Set aside the pastry while you make the filling. Step 4: Mix the ricotta and crème fraîche with the beaten eggs. Stir in the cheese and lemon zest, then fold in the broad beans, taking care not to break or crush. Spread over the tart case, then place artichoke hearts on top. Bake for 30-40 mins, remove and serve warm with the watercress pesto.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, egg, anise extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, milk, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Beat butter and sugar together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Step 3: Beat in egg and anise extract until combined. Step 4: Sift flour, baking powder, and salt together into a bowl. Step 5: Stir into butter mixture until well incorporated. Step 6: If you are using a stand mixer, mix dough another minute to add lightness. Step 7: The dough will be soft, but will hand roll easily. Step 8: Off pieces of dough slightly smaller than a walnut; roll into small logs. Step 9: Dip in milk, then roll in sesame seeds. Step 10: Place cookies one inch apart on a baking sheet. Step 11: Cookies will not spread very much. Step 12: Bake in the preheated oven until bottom and sides of cookies are lightly toasted, 17 to. Step 13: Transfer cookies to wire racks to cool. Step 14: Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: eggs, baking powder, sugar, vegetable oil, anise seed, flour, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs, sugar, and oil. Step 2: Mix in flour, baking powder, vanilla, and anise. Step 3: Spread in greased metal ice cube trays or loaf pans If using loaf pans, only fill 1 / 3 full This recipe makes about 3 trays or pans worth. Step 4: Bake 20-25 minutes at 350 degrees. Step 5: Remove from oven and cut in slices crosswise. Step 6: Place slices on baking sheet and brown under broiler, then flip slices and brown on other side Watch the cookies carefully, it is easy to burn them in this step Normally the best idea is to broil with oven door open a crack and watch as they go.

Ingredient Names: eggs, olive oil, sugar, anise seed, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f grind the anise seed in a coffee grinder reserved for spices, or with a mortar and pestle By hand or with a mixer lightly beat eggs, then mix in the oil, sugar and anise. Step 2: Stir in the flour, baking powder, salt and almonds and mix to combine The dough will be smooth but slightly sticky to the touch. Step 3: Divide the dough into six pieces, lightly flour and roll each into a log 2" in diameter. Step 4: Place on two greased or parchment lined baking sheets and bake until they just begin to brown and the center is cooked, about 25 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the oven, immediately slice 1 / 2" thick diagonally and place back on baking sheet. Step 6: Bake 10 minutes, flip and bake another 10 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp If you wish them to be very hard for dunking in coffee turn the oven to 250f when the biscotti finish browning and let dry to your taste.

Ingredient Names: milk, rice, white sugar, vanilla extract, salt, eggs, egg yolks, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Mix milk, rice, 1/2 of the sugar, vanilla extract, and salt together in a saucepan over medium-high heat, bring to a boil. Step 2: Blend remaining sugar with whole eggs and yolks in a bowl to make a creamy custard. Step 3: Reduce heat of the milk mixture. Step 4: Let simmer, uncovered, until thickened, 30 to. Step 5: Fold in the custard. Step 6: Heat until thickened again, about more. Step 7: Beat cream in a chilled glass or metal bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Step 8: Remove the milk and custard mixture from heat. Step 9: Let cool, about 10 minutes. Step 10: Fold in the whipped cream. Step 11: Pour pudding into a serving dish, cover, and refrigerate until chilled, at least.

Ingredient Names: ladyfingers, mascarpone cheese, eggs, sugar, espresso coffee, bitter cocoa powder, marsala wine
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange savoiardi "forno bonomi" in rectangular serving dish, lightly soak with coffee and the marsala wine While gradually adding sugar, beat egg yolks until very stiff and egg yolks appear pale in color, add mascarpone cheese and fold gently. Step 2: In a separate bowl, beat egg whites with a wire wisk or electric beater until very stiff and gently fold egg whites into the mascarpone mixture. Step 3: Cover savorardi with this cream mixture, use all the ingredients to obtein more layers. Step 4: Sprinkle the top with bitter cocoa powder. Step 5: Refrigerate at least one hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, butter, eggs, baking soda, all-purpose flour, buttermilk, walnuts, flaked coconut, cream cheese, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease and flour three 9-inch round cake pans. Step 3: Beat white sugar, butter, and egg yolks together in a bowl with an electric mixer. Step 4: Beat in flour, alternating with buttermilk, beating briefly after each addition. Step 5: Beat in baking soda, then beat in walnuts and coconut. Step 6: Beat egg whites in a glass, metal, or ceramic bowl with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form; fold into batter. Step 7: Divide batter evenly among the prepared pans. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, 20 to. Step 9: Cool cakes in pans, 5 to, before turning out onto wire racks to cool completely, 25 to. Step 10: Meanwhile, beat confectioners' sugar, cream cheese, remaining butter, and vanilla extract together in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Step 11: Spread frosting onto cooled cake layers. Step 12: Stack layers; frost sides if desired. Step 13: Place remaining walnuts on top cake.

Dish Name: Baci Di Dama Orange Almond Cookies
Ingredient Names: blanched almond, sugar, candied orange peel, all-purpose flour, milk, semisweet chocolate piece
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven 350f. Step 2: Put ground almonds in bowl with sugar, orange peel & all but 1 t of flour. Step 3: Mix well, then stir in enough milk to give a smooth, firm dough. Step 4: Roll into small balls, place well apart, on a baking sheet lined with greased wax paper. Step 5: Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tbsp flour. Step 6: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Step 7: Transfer to a wire rack to cool. Step 8: When cold, sandwich cookies together in pairs with the melted chocolate. Step 9: Chill in the fridge for 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, white sugar, baking powder, salt, mashed banana, vegetable oil, vanilla, egg, pecans
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Lightly grease your cookie sheet Sift flour and baking powder into a bowl. Step 2: Add sugar and salt and stir together In another bowl combine all the wet ingredients: banana, oil, vanilla and egg. Step 3: Pour dry ingredients into wet ones along with pecans. Step 4: Stir together Flour a board and turn dough out onto it Form two 8-inch logs. Step 5: Put onto cookie sheet and pat down to 1 / 2 inch thickness.

Ingredient Names: jumbo egg yolks, sugar, dark rum, brewed espresso, mascarpone cheese, ladyfingers, bittersweet chocolate, confectioners' sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the egg yolks and sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed for about 5 minutes, or until very thick and light yellow. Step 2: Lower the speed to medium and add 1 / 4 cup rum, 1 / 4 cup espresso, and the mascarpone. Step 3: Whisk until smooth. Step 4: Combine the remaining 1 / 4 cup rum and 1 1 / 4 cups espresso in a shallow bowl. Step 5: Dip 1 side of each ladyfinger in the espresso / rum mixture and line the bottom of a 9 by 12 by 2-inch dish. Step 6: Pour half the espresso cream mixture evenly on top. Step 7: Dip 1 side of the remaining ladyfingers in the espresso / rum mixture and place them in a second layer in the dish. Step 8: Pour the rest of the espresso cream over the top Smooth the top and cover with plastic wrap. Step 9: Refrigerate overnight.

Ingredient Names: blanched almonds, flour, granulated sugar, salt, baking soda, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Spread almonds on a baking sheet and toast them in oven until lightly golden. Step 3: Let cool Coarsely chop half the nuts Butter 2 large baking sheets. Step 4: Mix flour, sugar, salt and baking soda. Step 5: Beat in eggs, then whole and chopped nuts. Step 6: Mix to obtain a firm dough. Step 7: Knead briefly, then divide dough into 2 pieces On a floured work surface, roll each piece under your hands into a cylinder 15 inches long and about 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter.

Ingredient Names: pine nuts, butter, parmesan cheese, dried basil, lemon zest, eggs, milk, all-purpose flour, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Toast pine nuts in pie pan, in oven for 8-10 minutes. Step 2: Beat together butter, parmesan, basil, lemon zest, eggs and milk. Step 3: Mix in flour and baking powder, add pine nuts. Step 4: Line a baking sheet with waxed or parchment paper. Step 5: Shape dough in a 15 inch long, 1 / 2 inch thick rectangle. Step 6: Place on baking sheet and bake 15 minutes. Step 7: Turn oven down to 325f. Step 8: Remove dough from sheet and cut into 1 / 2 inch wide slices.

Ingredient Names: cream, fresh basil, shortcrust pastry, flour for rolling out, broad bean podded, petits pois, pancetta, eggs, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the cream to the boil in a small saucepan, then take off the heat and drop in half the bunch of basil, making sure all the leaves and stems are fully immersed. Leave to infuse for at least an hour. Transfer to a lidded container and chill once cool, if preparing the day before. Meanwhile, roll the pastry out on a floured surface to about the thickness of 2 x £1 coins and use to line a 23cm loose-bottom tart tin. Chill on a baking sheet until ready to use. Step 2: Blanch the broad beans in a pan of boiling water for 1 min. Add the peas, bring back to the boil for another min, then drain and cool quickly under the cold tap. Drain, then dry on kitchen paper. Set aside. Heat grill to medim and cook the pancetta until it is crisp and golden, setting aside on kitchen paper to absorb any fat. Can be prepared up to this stage a day ahead. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6 and put a second baking sheet in the oven. Line the pastry case with parchment and fill with baking beans. Slide the tin onto the hot baking sheet and bake blind for 15 mins, then lift out the paper and beans and cook for 5 mins more, until the pastry feels sandy. Meanwhile, strain the cream through a sieve, pressing the basil against the mesh with a non-metallic spoon or spatula to extract as much of the flavour as possible. Step 4: Turn oven down to 150C/fan 130C/gas 2. Beat the eggs into the cream, stir in the parmesan and season to taste. Tear the pancetta and sprinkle into the case, along with the peas and beans. Pour in the egg and cream mix. (You may have a little left, depending on the depth of your tin.) Bake for about 50 mins-1 hr or until the custard is just set in the middle. Serve warm or cold, topped with shavings of parmesan and the remaining basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, espresso, kahlua, heavy cream, pure vanilla extract, mascarpone cheese, lady savoiardi, cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: For the syrup: Combine water and sugar in a small saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a simmer to dissolve the sugar. Step 3: Remove from the heat and cool. Step 4: Add coffee and kahlua For the filling: Whip the heavy cream, vanilla and sugar until soft peaks form. Step 5: Fold cream into the softened mascarpone cheese. Step 6: Place a layer of the lady fingers in the bottom of a shallow 2 quart baking dish. Step 7: Spoon half of the coffee syrup over the lady fingers, making sure they are all evenly coated.

Ingredient Names: berries, balsamic vinegar, mascarpone cheese, milk, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Divide berries among six individual dessert dishes. Step 2: Sprinkle each serving with 1 teaspoon of the balsamic vinegar. Step 3: Stir together the mascarpone cheese and milk. Step 4: Spoon mascarpone mixture over berries. Step 5: Drizzle 1 teaspoon honey over each serving.

Ingredient Names: mixed berries, sugar, fresh lemon juice, cinnamon, salt, unsalted butter, blanched almonds, eggs, vanilla, mascarpone, fresh lemon zest, heavy cream, unsweetened cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Make berry sauce: bring all sauce ingredients just to a boil in a 1 1 / 2 to 2 quart heavy saucepan over high heat, stirring occasionally, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes. Step 2: Transfer to a shallow bowl and cool to romm temperature stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes. Step 3: Chill, covered, until cold about two hours. Step 4: Make almond layers: Put oven racks in upper and lower thirds of oven and preheat to 350f Butter cake pans and line bottom of each with a round of parchment or was paper, then butter paper Pulse almonds with 1 / 4 cup sugar in a food processor until finely ground. Step 5: Beat together eggs and remaining 1 1 / 4 cups sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed until pale, fluffy, and tripled in volume, about 6-8 minutes. Step 6: Beat in vanilla and salt until combined well. Step 7: Stir together ground almonds and melted butter.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, anise extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 3: Grease two cookie sheets or line with parchment paper. Step 4: Beat sugar, oil, eggs, and anise extract together in a medium bowl until well-blended. Step 5: Combine flour and baking powder in a separate bowl; stir into egg mixture to form a heavy dough. Step 6: Divide dough into two equal pieces. Step 7: Form each piece into a log the length of a cookie sheet. Step 8: Place one log on each of the prepared sheets; and press dough down to 1/2-inch thickness. Step 9: Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 25 to. Step 10: Transfer logs to wire racks; let sit until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Step 11: Slice each log crosswise into about eighteen 1/2-inch-thick slices. Step 12: Place slices cut-sides up back on the cookie sheets. Step 13: Bake until lightly toasted and golden brown, 6 to per side, serve and.

Ingredient Names: eggs, anise extract, sugar, salt, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Combine the eggs, extract, sugar and salt in a mixingbowl or the bowl of an electric mixer and whip with a hand mixer set at high speed or in a heavy duty mixer fitted with the whip Continue whipping until the mixture is very light and increased in volume, 6-7 minutes While the egg mixture is whipping, combine the flour, cornstarch and baking powder and stir to mix. Step 3: Remove the whipped eggs from the mixer and sift over the flour mixture in three additions, folding it in after each addition with a rubber spatula The batter will lose most of its air and become rather stiff Pipe the batter, using a pastry bag with a 3 / 4-inch opening, but no tube, onto a jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper or buttered wax paper Pipe two logs about 1 1 / 2 inches wide and the length ofthe pan. Step 4: Bake the logs about 20 minutes, until they are well risen and golden. Step 5: Remove from oven and place logs on a cutting board to cool about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: hot cocoa mix, water, biscotti liqueur, whipped cream, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Heat one cup of water til boiling Stir in hot cocoa mix Add biscotti liqueur Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon Sip!

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, water, unbleached all-purpose flour, sugar, unsalted butter, anise seed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In the bowl of an electric mixer proof the yeast in the water for 5 minutes, or until the mixture is foamy. Step 2: Whisk in the flour and let the sponge stand, covered with plastic wrap, for 30 minutes or until it is foamy To the sponge, add the sugar, the water and the butter and stir the mixture until it is combined well. Step 3: Add the flour, the aniseed, and the salt and with the electric mixer fitted with the dough hook knead the dough for 3 minutes, or until it is smooth but still sticky. Step 4: Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl, turning it to coat it with the oil, and let it rise, covered tightly with plastic wrap, for 1 1 / 2 hours, or until it is double in bulk. Step 5: Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, halve it, and with floured hands form each piece of dough into a flattish log 15 inches long and 2 inches wide. Step 6: Transfer the logs to a buttered and floured baking sheet and let them rise, covered with a kitchen towel, for 2 hours, or until they are double in bulk. Step 7: Bake the logs in the middle of a preheated 350f oven for 30 minutes, or until they are golden brown, and let them cool on the baking sheet on a rack for 10 minutes On a cutting board cut the logs crosswise on the diagonal into 1 inch thick slices, arrange the biscotti, cut sides down, on the baking sheet and bake them in the 350f oven for 10 minutes on each side, or until they are pale golden. Step 8: Transfer the biscotti to racks to cool and store them in airtight containers.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, eggs, anise seeds, vanilla, flour, baking powder, blanched almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl place the butter and sugar, and cream them together One at a time add the eggs and beat them in. Step 2: Add the anise seeds and mix them in. Step 3: Add the vanilla and anisette and beat them in. Step 4: In a mixing bowl place the flour and baking powder, and mix them together. Step 5: Add the flour to butter mixture. Step 6: Combine the ingredients together well. Step 7: Add the almonds and stir them in well Form the dough into a flat loaf. Step 8: Cover it and place it in the refrigerator overnight.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, eggs, vanilla, almond extract, whole almonds, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Egg wash 1 egg, large 1 tsp water in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment blend the flour, the sugar, the baking powder, and the salt until the mixture is combined well. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk together the whole eggs, the yolks, the vanilla and the almond extract, add the mixture to the flour mixture, beating until a dough is formed, and stir in the almonds. Step 3: Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, knead it several times, and divide it into fourths Working on 2 large buttered and floured baking sheets, with floured hands form each piece of dough into a flattish log 11 inches long and 2 inches wide, arrange the logs at least 3 inches apart on the sheets, and brush them with the egg wash. Step 4: Bake the logs in a preheated 350f oven for 35 minutes and let them cool on the baking sheets on racks for 10 minutes On a cutting board, cut the logs crosswise on the diagonal into 3 / 4" inch slices, arrange them the biscotti, cut sides down, on the baking sheets, and bake them in the 350f oven for 5 to 7 minutes on each side, or until they are pale golden. Step 5: Transfer the biscotti to racks to cool and store them in airtight containers.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, unsalted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, orange zest, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Butter two baking sheets, or place silicon baking sheets on them. Step 2: In a large bowl, stir together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt With an electric mixer on low speed, add the butter until blended. Step 3: Whisk together the eggs, zest and vanilla, and add this to the flour mixture, and continue beating on low until you have a smooth dough Pinch off a small piece of dough about the size of a small golf ball and roll it into a log about 2 inches long. Step 4: Roll the log into the sesame seeds, pressing them so seeds stay on. Step 5: Place the cookie on the prepared baking sheets keeping the cookies two inches apart. Step 6: Bake for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Step 7: Cool, and store in airtight containers.

Ingredient Names: blackberries, golden sugar, egg yolks, vanilla pod, marsala
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, lightly crush the berries with 25g of the sugar. Add a spoonful to the bottom of 6 small glasses, then set the rest of the berry mixture aside. Step 2: Bring some water to a gentle simmer in a medium-size saucepan and tip the egg yolks into a large heatproof bowl. Halve and scrape the seeds from the vanilla pod into the egg yolks and add the remaining sugar. Using an electric whisk, beat until light and airy. Splash in the Marsala, place the bowl over the pan of simmering water, then whisk your heart out for 10-12 mins until the egg yolks are thick and foamy and the whisk leaves a defined trail. Drain off some of the juice, then ripple the remaining berries through the mousse and spoon into the glasses.

Dish Name: Blueberry And Lemon Ricotta Cheesecake Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: gluten-free oats, almond meal, coconut sugar, butter, eggs, almond extract, ricotta cheese, lemon, fresh blueberries
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ground oats, almond meal and 1 tbsp sugar in a bowl. Step 2: Add melted butter or coconut oil and mix well. Step 3: Press onto the bottom of a 7-inch springform pan and keep the pan in the freezer Separate eggs into two bowls Whip egg whites until stiff peaks form and set aside Zest a lemon and then cut the lemon in half and juice it. Step 4: Preheat oven to 325f / 165c degrees In another bowl, mix egg yolks, sugar, and almond extract. Step 5: Add ricotta cheese, and lemon zest and juice and mix well. Step 6: Fold in the egg whites and mix gently.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, sugar, flour, baking powder, salt, lemon, eggs, slivered almonds, blueberries, anise seed
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Line baking sheet with parchment or wax paper In the bowl of your mixer, beat the butter and sugar on medium speed until combined, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add flour, baking powder, salt and lemon zest and beat just until combined. Step 4: Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition and scraping down the bowl as necessary. Step 5: Add the nuts blueberries and anise seeds and mix until combined. Step 6: Transfer the dough to a lightly floured work surface and shape it into a 12-inch-long log. Step 7: Transfer log to the prepared baking sheet with a spatula. Step 8: Bake for 30 minutes, or until the top is firm to the touch. Step 9: Allow log to cool on baking sheet for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: egg whites, salt, cream of tartar, sugar, semisweet chocolate, water, whipping cream, fresh strawberries, strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Step 2: Beat egg whites with salt until foamy. Step 3: Add cream of tartar and beat until soft peaks form Gradually beat in sugar until meringue is stiff and glossy. Step 4: Line baking sheet with waxed paper and trace 3 circles 8 inches in diameter Evenly spread or pipe meringue into circles, bake 1 hour. Step 5: Turn off heat and let meringues dry in oven for another hour. Step 6: Remove from oven and carefully peel off waxed paper. Step 7: Let cool completely on wire racks.

Ingredient Names: fresh rosemary, fresh figs, liquid honey, lemon juice, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Strip the leaves from the bottom of the rosemary stems, leaving about 1 1 / 2 inches of leaves at the. Step 2: Place the stems in a bowl and add cold water to cover. Step 3: Soak for at least 30 minutes Skewer fig halves crosswise on each rosemary stem. Step 4: Arrange the skewers on a plate with the cut sides of the figs facing up. Step 5: In a small bowl, mix together honey and lemon juice. Step 6: Brush the honey / lemon mixture over the cut side of the figs. Step 7: Preheat the broiler to high Broil the figs cut side up until they are lightly browned and softened, about 1 to 2 minutes. Step 8: Top with cheese and place back under broiler for 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: mascarpone cheese, espresso, rum, ladyfingers, cocoa powder, biscotti, egg yolks, egg, sugar, marsala wine
Instructions: Step 1: Whip mascarpone cheese until light and airy. Step 2: Dip ladyfingers in espresso rum mixture and place in serving bowl 3 inches deep by 7 inches wide. Step 3: Top with 1 oz of zabaglione. Step 4: Using a 3 oz scoop, layer one-third of whipped mascarpone over ladyfingers. Step 5: Repeat process 2 more times with remaining ladyfingers, zabaglione and mascarpone. Step 6: Chill in refrigerator Prior to serving, sprinkle with cocoa powder and crumbled biscotti Espresso rum mixture: mix espresso and rum together Zabaglione: whisk egg yolks and whole egg together with sugar until eggs are thick and lemon colored. Step 7: Whisk in marsala wine.

Ingredient Names: ricotta, egg yolks, egg whites, flour, sugar, cinnamon, lemon, dark rum, icing sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the ricotta and beat well with the egg yolks, stir in the flour, sugar, cinnamon, grated lemon rind and the rum and mix well. Step 2: You can do this in a food processor. Step 3: Beat the egg whites until stiff, fold in and pour into a buttered and floured cake tin. Step 4: Bake in the oven at 180ºC/160ºC fan/gas 4 for about 25-30 minutes, or until it is firm. Step 5: Serve hot or cold dusted with icing sugar.

Dish Name: Budino Di Ricotta Cream Cheese Custard
Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, milk chocolate, walnuts, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cream the ricotta, add the chocolateand nuts and blend thoroughly, add cream as needed for desire consistency. Step 2: Serve in small glasses I would be tempted to try a darker chocolate and to add a little amaretto or walnut liquor.

Ingredient Names: parchment paper, unsalted butter, sugar, light brown sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, butterscotch chips, pecans, shortening
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Step 3: Beat butter and sugars at high speed until blended. Step 4: Add eggs and vanilla and continue to beat until the sugar grains are dissolved and the batter forms ribbons when falling off the beaters. Step 5: Stir together flour, baking powder and salt in a separate bowl Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet ingredients until smooth, stiff and a little sticky. Step 6: Using a wooden spoon, mix in 1 cup butterscotch chips and 1 cup pecans. Step 7: Divide dough into fourths. Step 8: Take each quarter and shape into logs about 8 inches long Smooth the dough so that the logs have a uniform thickness from top to bottom, square off the.

Ingredient Names: whipping cream, sugar, vanilla extract, gelatin, buttermilk
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, combine the cream, sugar, and vanilla. Step 2: Heat until warm or until vanilla has had enough time to steep and sugar is dissolved While cream is heating, dissolve the gelatin in about 1 / 4 cup of room temperature water, in a medium bowl. Step 3: Once cream has heated sufficiently, pour the mixture over the gelatin in the bowl and stir until fully dissolved. Step 4: Stir in the buttermilk slowly, until just combined. Step 5: Divide into 8 ramekins, and chill for 2 hours, or until set.

Dish Name: Buttermilk Panna Cotta With Sweetened Strawberries
Ingredient Names: sugar, water, whipping cream, unflavored gelatin, vanilla bean, buttermilk, strawberries, golden brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place six 3 / 4-cup custard cups on small baking sheet. Step 2: Combine 1 / 3 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons water in heavy small saucepan. Step 3: Stir over medium-low heat until sugar dissolves Increase heat and boil without stirring until syrup turns deep amber, occasionally brushing down sides of pan with wet pastry brush and swirling pan, about 8 minutes Immediately pour caramel into custard cups, dividing equally Tilt cups to cover bottoms evenly. Step 4: Cool until caramel is set. Step 5: Pour 1 / 4 cup whipping cream into small bowl. Step 6: Sprinkle gelatin over. Step 7: Let stand until gelatin softens, about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dark brown sugar, kosher salt, water, unsalted butter, heavy cream, milk, whole egg, egg yolks, cornstarch, rum
Instructions: Step 1: Combine brown sugar, salt, and water in a deep, heavy-bottomed saucepan and place over medium-high heat. Step 2: Bring to a boil; cook until caramel is very dark, and bubbles appear, 7 to. Step 3: Immediately turn off the heat. Step 4: Carefully whisk in butter; pour in heavy cream and continue to stir. Step 5: Be careful, as mixture may boil up in the pan. Step 6: Stir over medium-low heat until sugar dissolves, whisk in milk. Step 7: Whisk whole egg, egg yolks, and plus cornstarch together in a mixing bowl. Step 8: Slowly whisk in hot cream mixture to temper egg mixture. Step 9: Whisk egg mixture into the saucepan and increase heat to medium-high. Step 10: Bring to a simmer, and cook, whisking, until mixture thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 11: Remove from heat and pour into a fine-mesh strainer set over a bowl to remove any lumps, whisk in rum. Step 12: Pour into serving glasses. Step 13: Let cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes, before wrapping in plastic wrap and refrigerating until thoroughly chilled, 3 to.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, unsweetened cocoa, unsweetened chocolate, eggs, sour cream, baking soda, baking powder, all-purpose flour, orange-flavored liqueur
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Step 2: In a bowl, beat 1 cup butter, 1 cup sugar, cocoa, and chocolate with a mixer until fluffy. Step 3: Add eggs and sour cream. Step 4: Beat until well mixed. Step 5: Mix together baking soda, baking powder, and 2 cups flour. Step 6: Stir into batter, then beat to blend well Butter and flour-dust a 10- to 12-cup tube pan or bundt pan Scrape batter into pan and spread level. Step 7: Bake until cake just begins to pull from pan sides and center springs back when lightly pressed, about 1 hour. Step 8: Meanwhile, in a medium sauce pan over high heat, stir 2 cups sugar with 1 cup water until sugar dissolves.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, coffee beans, sugar, egg yolks, heavy cream, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine milk and ground coffee in a medium saucepan and bring to a low simmer. Step 2: Cook for 20 minutes. Step 3: After 20 minutes, remove the milk from the heat and let stand for 30 minutes. Step 4: Strain the milk through a fine-meshed strainer. Step 5: Heat until bubbling, then cover to keep hot and remove from heat. Step 6: Blend sugar and egg yolks in a blender or food processor until thick and smooth Gradually add the hot milk until the mixture is combined. Step 7: Pour the mixture into a saucepan and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens and will coat the back of a spoon. Step 8: Remove the pan from heat and place in a bowl of ice water. Step 9: Stir until mixture is cool.

Ingredient Names: double cream, honey, nutella, brewed espresso, hazelnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly whisk the cream & honey until thickened. Step 2: Pour nutella into a warmed martini glass and pour espresso over the top. Step 3: Top with the honey cream & hazelnuts, serve with biscotti.

Dish Name: Cake And Cannoli Custard Cream Filling
Ingredient Names: egg yolks, white sugar, flour, whole milk, vanilla extract, instant lemon pudding mix, whipped topping, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, flour and salt in a pot. Step 2: Whisk to combine well. Step 3: Add milk gradually to get no lumps. Step 4: Stir over medium heat until it thickens and comes to a low boil, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Beat yolks in a bowl. Step 6: Add some hot mixture into the bowl just a little to bring to a warm temperature. Step 7: Add all back into the pot of mixture on the stove and continue to low cook until thick, do not boil. Step 8: Remove and blend in the vanilla and pkg of dry pudding mix. Step 9: Stir well until blended. Step 10: Cool two hours, covered with saran or until cold.

Ingredient Names: white cake mix, instant vanilla pudding, water, eggs, canola oil, pecans, flaked coconut, butter, cream cheese, cream, confectioners' sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large mixer bowl add the cake mix, vanilla pudding, water, eggs and oil With electric mixer, beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Step 3: Fold in the chopped nuts and coconut. Step 4: Pour the batter into a 9 x 13 inch pan that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray or lightly greased and floured. Step 5: Bake for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted off center comes out clean. Step 6: Cool completely before frosting. Step 7: In a medium sized mixer bowl, blend the butter and cream cheese. Step 8: Add the confectioners' sugar and enough cream to make it a smooth spreading consistency Frost cake with frosting and sprinkle with coconut.

Ingredient Names: chocolate cookie crumbs, sugar, butter, sour cream, eggs, white flour, vanilla, peppermint extract, cream cheese, peppermint candy
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 2: Combine cookie crumbs, sugar and butter, and press into a 9 inch springform pan. Step 3: Blend sour cream, sugar, eggs, flour and peppermint and vanilla extracts until smooth. Step 4: Add cream cheese and 2 tablespoons butter. Step 5: Stir in crushed candy. Step 6: Pour into the crust and bake on lowest rack of oven for 50-60 minutes or until firm. Step 7: Allow to cool and refrigerate overnight The top may crack, but that's okay! Step 8: Remove from pan and serve Top with sweetened whip cream and garnish with candy cane if desired Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, white sugar, ground cinnamon, shortening, marsala wine, water, distilled white vinegar, egg, egg yolk, egg white, oil for frying, ricotta cheese, sugar, semisweet chocolate, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Mix flour, sugar, and cinnamon together in a medium bowl; cut in shortening until crumbly. Step 3: Make a well in the center; add Marsala wine, water, vinegar, egg, and egg yolk. Step 4: Mix with a fork until the dough becomes stiff; finish kneading by hand on a clean surface, adding a bit more water if needed for about 5 minutes. Step 5: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to. Step 6: Divide cannoli dough into three balls; flatten each one just enough to get through the pasta machine. Step 7: Roll 1 ball of dough through successively thinner settings until reach the thinnest setting. Step 8: Dust lightly with flour if necessary. Step 9: Place dough sheet on a lightly floured surface; cut out 4 to 5-inch circles using a cutter or large glass. Step 10: Lightly dust dough circles with flour. Step 11: This will help you later in removing the shells from the tubes. Step 12: Roll dough around cannoli tubes, sealing edges with a bit of egg white. Step 13: Repeat with remaining dough balls. Step 14: Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep skillet to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 15: Fry shells on the tubes in hot oil, a few at a time, until golden, 2 to; turn as needed using tongs. Step 16: Remove shells carefully using tongs; place on a cooling rack set over paper towels. Step 17: Cool just long enough that you can handle the tubes, then carefully twist tubes to remove shells. Step 18: Using a tea towel may help you get a better grip. Step 19: Wash or wipe off the tubes; use them for more shells. Step 20: Place cooled shells in an airtight container for up to 2 months. Step 21: You should only fill them up to before serving. Step 22: Mix ricotta cheese and confectioners' sugar together in a large bowl until well combined; fold in chocolate and lemon zest. Step 23: Transfer filling mixture to a pastry bag; pipe into shells, filling from the center to one end, then repeating on the other side. Step 24: Dust with confectioners' sugar to serve, if you like.

Ingredient Names: low-fat ricotta cheese, powdered sugar, mini chocolate chips, maraschino cherry, vanilla, cinnamon, flour tortillas, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Slice tortillas into eight wedges and place on sprayed cookie sheet Spray tops with cooking spray then use fingers to sprinkle wedges with cinnamon. Step 2: Place in oven to broil until golden brown and crispy While these are cooking, mix ricotta, sugar, chocolate chips, cherries, vanilla and cinnamon, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, semi-sweet chocolate chips, candied orange peel, creme de cacao, sugar, confectioners' sugar, cinnamon, unsweetened chocolate, vanilla, candied citron peel, glace cherries
Instructions: Step 1: Cannoli filling # 1:: Cream drained ricotta until very smooth. Step 2: Add chocolate chips, liqueur, orange peel and sugar, mix very well. Step 3: Chill filling until needed. Step 4: Using a very small spoon or pastry bag, fill cannoli shells. Step 5: Refrigerate until ready to serve Cannoli filling # 2: In a bowl, sift together the sugar, cinnamon and cocoa. Step 6: Mix ricotta well with sifted dry ingredients.

Dish Name: Cannoli Ice Cream No Ice Cream Maker Needed
Ingredient Names: low-fat ricotta cheese, fat-free sweetened condensed milk, fat-free half-and-half, cinnamon, heavy cream, slivered almonds, semi-sweet chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Place ricotta in blender or food processor container & blend till smooth. Step 2: Add the condensed milk, half & half & cinnamon & blend till combined. Step 3: In a 2 quart metal bowl, whip the cream till soft peaks form. Step 4: Add ricotta / milk mixture, almonds & chocolate. Step 5: Fold gently till combined. Step 6: Cover bowl & place in freezer for 2 hours or until edges start to harden. Step 7: Stir & put back in the freezer for another 2 hours or until firm To serve, let stand at room temp till soft enough to scoop.

Ingredient Names: strawberry, amaretto, heavy cream, confectioners' sugar, ricotta cheese, ground cinnamon, pistachios, amaretti cookies, miniature semisweet chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the strawberries and amaretto. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Step 3: In a large bowl, whip the cream with the confectioners' sugar until soft peaks form. Step 4: In a medium bowl, stir half of the whipped cream into the ricotta to lighten it Gently fold in the remaining whipped cream and cinnamon. Step 5: Fold the pistachios into cream mixture. Step 6: Place a layer of crushed amaretti cookies in each of 4 parfait glasses. Step 7: Top each with a layer of strawberry slices and then cannoli cream. Step 8: Repeat layering If desired, top with miniature chocolate chips.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt, shortening, eggs, white vinegar, cold water, egg white, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sift together flour, sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Step 2: Cut shortening in with a pastry blender until the pieces are the size of small peas, stir in eggs. Step 3: Blend in the vinegar and cold water. Step 4: Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add additional flour, if needed, to get a smooth dough. Step 6: Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes. Step 7: Set out 6 aluminum cannoli tubes. Step 8: Heat oil in a deep saucepan to 360 degrees f. Step 9: Cut an oval shaped pattern from cardboard about 6x4-inches.

Dish Name: Cannoli Shells And Ricotta Cream Filling
Ingredient Names: whole milk ricotta cheese, powdered sugar, granulated sugar, vanilla extract, cinnamon oil, milk chocolate candy bars with almonds, eggs, ice water, flour, salt, unsweetened cocoa powder, ground cinnamon, crisco shortening, egg white, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Three or more days in advance of making the cannoli shells set the ricotta in a colander inside of a large bowl Scrape the ricotta into the colander and cover with plastic wrap. Step 2: Let the ricotta drain in the refrigerator for two days, until it is dry To make the dough for cannoli shells: in a small bowl put eggs, beat eggs. Step 3: Add vanilla and ice water to eggs. Step 4: In a large bowl, use your hands to combine the flour, sugar, salt, cocoa, and cinnamon. Step 5: Add the shortening and mix until crumbly. Step 6: Make well in dry mixture and add wet mixture. Step 7: Using your hands mix together, if it is dry, add more ice water.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, ground cinnamon, whole unblanched almonds, eggs, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: You will also need: 2 cookie sheets or 2 jelly roll pans covered with parchment paper or 2 aluminum foil. Step 2: Set a rack in the middle level of the oven and preheat to 350 degrees. Step 3: In a bowl combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, and cinnamon and stir well to mix. Step 4: Stir in the almonds In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the vanilla then use a rubber spatula to stir into the dry ingredients Continue to stir until a stiff dough forms Scrape the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and divide it in half. Step 5: Roll each half under the palms of your hands into a cylinder a little shorter than your baking sheet. Step 6: Place the logs of dough on the baking sheet, making sure they are neither too close to each other nor to the sides of the pan. Step 7: Press down gently with the palm of your hand to flatten the logs.

Ingredient Names: egg whites, granulated sugar, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, cream of tartar, instant coffee powder
Instructions: Step 1: Also need a 10-inch round cake pan with sides at least 3 inches high or a 10 x 4-inch tube pan. Step 2: Check that one rack is in the middle of the oven and heat the oven to 325 degrees If the pan has a removable bottom, do nothing to it If it does not, lightly butter the bottom. Step 3: Line the bottom with waxed paper or parchment paper cut to fit, and lightly butter the paper Thoroughly mix 1 / 4 cup of the sugar and the flour in a small bowl. Step 4: Mix the 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon in a small dish Have all ingredients and tools at hand. Step 5: Pour the egg whites into the bowl in which you will be making the batter. Step 6: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed for about 2 minutes, until frothy and well broken up.

Ingredient Names: graham crackers, unsalted butter, sugar, whipping cream, instant espresso powder, vanilla extract, cream cheese, eggs, all-purpose flour, semi-sweet chocolate chips, chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Mix crackers, butter and 1 / 4 cup sugar in medium bowl. Step 3: Press onto bottom of a 9-inch springform pan with 2 3 / 4-inch high sides. Step 4: Bake crust 10 minutes. Step 5: Cool Maintain oven temperature. Step 6: Combine cream, espresso powder or coffee and vanilla in small bowl, set aside. Step 7: Using electric mixer, beat cream cheese in large bowl until smooth Gradually beat in remaining 1 1 / 4 cups sugar, then eggs 1 at a time.

Ingredient Names: coffee, milk, sugar, caramel syrup, artificial vanilla flavoring, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: To make a strong coffee, you can brew a ratio of 3 heaping tbsp of coffee to 6 cups water. Step 2: Add vanillin to the coffee grinds before making the coffee, that way it will infuse while brewing. Step 3: Once coffee is done brewing, place milk in a large cup and microwave until hot. Step 4: In a tall glass combine the coffee, milk, and caramel syrup and stir well. Step 5: Add sugar in small increments until desired sweetness is achieved, don't forget that the caramel will sweeten this beverage as well. Step 6: Top with whipped cream and drizzle caramel Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: flour, brown sugar, salt, egg whites, vanilla, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour, salt and sugar. Step 2: Fold egg whites into dry ingredients. Step 3: Add vanilla and cashews. Step 4: Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a parchment covered cookie sheet at least 1-1 / 2 inches apart. Step 5: Bake in a 350 oven about 20 minutes Will be golden and crisp.

Dish Name: Caramelised red onion, prosciutto & mushroom tart
Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions, thyme, balsamic vinegar, puff pastry, prosciutto, open mushrooms, firm goat's cheese, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a frying pan, add the onion and gently cook until softened, about 10 mins. Add the thyme, vinegar, salt and pepper and cook for 5 mins more, stirring occasionally to stop them burning. Set aside to cool. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Roll out the pastry, trim to a 28cm round, then put on a non-stick baking sheet (or one lined with baking paper). Fork the pastry all over. Step 3: Spread the onion over the pastry to within 3cm of the edge. Tear the prosciutto into strips and arrange over the onion in a rippled effect. Arrange the mushrooms on top and brush them with the reserved oil. Slice or crumble the cheese and arrange over the tart. Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Push the side of the tart up with your fingers to form an edge. Bake for 30-35 mins until the pastry edges have puffed up and the mushrooms are tender. Cool for a few minutes, then scatter with rocket just before serving.

Dish Name: Caramelized Apple Tart By Fiaschetteria Toscana
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, salt, unsalted butter, egg yolks, golden delicious apples
Instructions: Step 1: To make crust, whisk flour, 1 / 2 cup sugar, and salt in large bowl. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 cup chilled butter cubes and egg yolks. Step 3: Using finger Gently knead crust in bowl until ball forms, about 4 minutes Flatten ball into disk. Step 4: Wrap in plastic and 1 hour. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350 For filling, scatter 1 / 2 cup butter cubes over bottom of a 12-inch ovenproof skillet. Step 6: Sprinkle 1 cup sugar on top. Step 7: Arrange apple halves, cut side up, over sugar.

Dish Name: Carrot Pine Nut Cake From Parma
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, ground cinnamon, salt, pine nuts, sugar, fennel seed, lemon, carrots, mascarpone cheese, butter, eggs, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 2: In a medium bowl sift together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt, set aside. Step 3: Place the pine nuts, 1 / 2 cup sugar, and fennel seeds in a food processor and pulse to mince the nuts. Step 4: Add the lemon zest, lemon juice, and the carrots Pulse to mince the carrots. Step 5: Add the mascarpone cheese and pulse until the cheese is incorporated If you can't find mascarpone, cream cheese is a good substitute. Step 6: In a large bowl, using a hand mixer, cream together the butter and remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar. Step 7: Add the eggs one at a time, beating well between adding each additional egg.

Ingredient Names: whole milk ricotta cheese, confectioners' sugar, ground cinnamon, vanilla extract, miniature semisweet chocolate chips, cake flour, baking powder, salt, eggs, cold water, white sugar, cream of tartar, water, light rum, unflavored gelatin
Instructions: Step 1: Line a fine-mesh strainer with a double layer of wet cheesecloth. Step 2: Put the ricotta in a strainer and set it over a bowl. Step 3: Fold the cheesecloth over the top of the ricotta. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, up to overnight. Step 5: Discard the whey which collects in the bowl. Step 6: In a stand mixer outfitted with the paddle attachment, beat the confectioners' sugar, cinnamon, vanilla and chocolate chips into the thickened ricotta on low speed until well combined. Step 7: Transfer to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and chill until needed. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 325f grease and flour two 9" cake pans Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt, set aside.

Dish Name: Cassata Gelata I Molded Ice Cream
Ingredient Names: vanilla ice cream, chocolate ice cream, pistachio ice cream, heavy cream, powdered sugar, hazelnuts, bittersweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Soften the chocolate ice cream Coat the inside of a two-quart bowl with the chocolate ice cream. Step 2: Place the bowl in the freezer and allow the chocolate layer to harden While the chocolate is hardening, soften the vanilla ice cream. Step 3: When the chocolate layer is frozen, take the bowl from the freezer and coat the inside with the vanilla ice cream Replace the bowl in the freezer and take out the pistachio ice cream and let it soften. Step 4: When the vanilla ice cream is hard, take out the bowl and coat the inside with the pistachio ice cream Replace in the freezer Whip one cup of the cream with two tablespoons of the sugar. Step 5: Fold the nuts into the cream mixture and place the cream / nut mixture into the center of the bowl.

Ingredient Names: all-butter shortcrust pastry, cavolo nero, pancetta, milk, cream, eggs, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Roll out the pastry and use to line a deep 20 x 30cm loose-bottomed tart tin or 23cm round tin. Prick the base and line with greaseproof paper and baking beans. Sit the tin on a baking sheet and bake for 15 mins, then remove beans and parchment and return to the oven for a further 5-10 mins until pale golden. Lower the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Step 2: Meanwhile, trim the cabbage and separate the leaves. Cook in a pan of lightly salted boiling water for 4-5 mins, until tender. Cool and drain well then squeeze out any excess water. Pat dry with kitchen paper. Step 3: Arrange the cabbage leaves and pancetta slices in the tart case. Beat together the milk, cream and eggs until well blended. Stir in the Parmesan and some freshly ground black pepper then pour into the tart case. Bake for 25 mins until just set. Step 4: Leave to sit in the tin for 10 mins then carefully lift out, cut into slices and serve while still warm.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, ground cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, salt, ground allspice, ground cardamom, chai tea, egg, egg white, milk, vanilla extract, walnuts, miniature semisweet chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, all the spices, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk the tea, egg, egg white, milk and vanilla. Step 3: Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until combined. Step 4: Stir in the nuts and chocolate chips. Step 5: Divide dough in half and wrap each portion in plastic wrap and refrigerate one hour On a baking sheet coated with cook spray shape each half into a 10x2-inch rectangle. Step 6: Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Step 7: Place pans on wire racks. Step 8: When baked dough is cool enough to handle transfer to a cutting board and using a serrated knife cut diagonally into 3 / 4-inch slices. Step 9: Place cut side down on the baking sheets.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, unsalted butter, white sugar, olive oil, large eggs, vanilla extract, almond extract, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Place butter, plus sugar, and olive oil in a separate mixing bowl. Step 3: Mix together thoroughly until mixture has a creamy texture. Step 4: Add 1 egg; mix into butter/sugar mixture. Step 5: Whisk in 2nd egg, vanilla extract, and almond extract; whisk until smooth. Step 6: Add flour mixture. Step 7: Mix until flour is incorporated. Step 8: Add whole almonds and chopped almonds; mix in evenly. Step 9: Cover bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate. Step 10: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 11: Line a rimmed baking sheet with a silicone mat. Step 12: Divide dough in half. Step 13: Place each half on a length of plastic wrap and shape into a log. Step 14: Wrap with the plastic wrap and press into a shape about 3 or 4 inches wide and about high. Step 15: Transfer both pieces to prepared baking sheet leaving about 3 or 4 inches of space between them to allow for spreading. Step 16: Bake in center of preheated oven until turning golden and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 3-4 minutes. Step 17: Let cool before slicing. Step 18: Reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 19: Cut each piece at a slight angle into 1/2- to 1 -inch thick slices with a serrated knife. Step 20: Transfer pieces back to baking sheet in a single layer. Step 21: Bake; remove from oven and flip pieces over. Step 22: Return pan to oven and bake until biscotti are golden brown and crunchy, about 3-4 minutes. Step 23: Transfer biscotti to a cooling rack; let cool to room temperature.

Ingredient Names: strawberries, white sugar, greek yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla extract, balsamic vinegar, salt, heavy cream, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Line 10 ramekins with plastic wrap and place them onto a baking sheet. Step 2: Hull strawberries with the tip of a knife. Step 3: Place strawberries in a food processor. Step 4: Add sugar, Greek yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and balsamic vinegar. Step 5: Sprinkle in a tiny pinch of salt. Step 6: Pulse on and off to combine; finish pureeing on high until smooth. Step 7: Whisk heavy cream in a bowl until soft peaks form. Step 8: Add the strawberry puree. Step 9: Stir and fold with a spatula until most of the major streaks disappear. Step 10: Fill ramekins 1/4 to from the top with the strawberry mixture. Step 11: Tap baking sheet against the counter to settle the tops. Step 12: Cover ramekins in plastic wrap and freeze until mostly firm, about 1 1/. Step 13: Meanwhile, place cookies in a resealable plastic bag. Step 14: Seal; crush cookies through with a rolling pin to get crumbs. Step 15: Place crumbs into a bowl; add butter and mix well. Step 16: Divide the cookie crumb mixture among the ramekins and smooth out with the back of a spoon. Step 17: Cover again and freeze until completely frozen, about 1 hour. Step 18: Toss diced strawberries with sugar in a bowl. Step 19: Let rest at room temperature until a syrup forms below the strawberries, about 5 minutes. Step 20: Warm up each ramekin in your hands to help unmold the semifreddo; invert onto a plate. Step 21: Top with the strawberries in syrup. Step 22: Thaw for 10 to before serving.

Ingredient Names: strawberries, white sugar, large egg yolks, marsala wine
Instructions: Step 1: Gently stir the strawberries and sugar together in a bowl. Step 2: Cover and let sit at room temperature until juices release, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Divide fruit between 2 small, clear serving bowls or stemmed cocktail glasses. Step 4: Place egg yolks, sugar, and marsala into metal mixing bowl. Step 5: Set over burner on low heat. Step 6: Hold rim of bowl with a potholder. Step 7: Whisk until mixture forms loose peaks, 7 or. Step 8: Mixture should feel warm to the touch. Step 9: Spoon custard over the strawberries. Step 10: Serve while custard is still warm.

Dish Name: Cherries Amaretto Sour Cream And Brown Sugar
Ingredient Names: fresh cherries, light sour cream, amaretto, powdered sugar, light brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sour cream and amaretto. Step 2: Add more amaretto to taste if needed If desired, add powdered sugar to mixture. Step 3: Place sour cream mixture into small "dipping" dish. Step 4: Place brown sugar into second small "dipping" dish. Step 5: Dip cherries in sour cream and then the brown sugar Eat and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, splenda sugar substitute, sugar, mascarpone cheese, whipped cream, almond extract, brewed espresso, amaretto liqueur, ladyfingers, slivered almonds, fresh cherries
Instructions: Step 1: Mix egg yolks, sugar and splenda in a metal bowl, and whisk until thick and pale yellow It may not come together immediately, and may look too thick, but keep stirring, it does work after a few seconds. Step 2: Place bowl over a saucepan of simmering water, and reduce heat to low. Step 3: Cook, stirring constantly for 8 to 10 min, or until mixture is smooth, and falls in ribbons from the whisk, set aside to cool. Step 4: When egg yolks are cooled to room temperature, thoroughly beat in mascarpone, followed by about 2 / 3 of the whipped cream, and almond extract. Step 5: Mix amaretto and espresso or coffee. Step 6: Line the bottom of a 3 quart casserole dish with half of the lady fingers, and brush with amaretto coffee. Step 7: Layer on half of the egg yolk mixture, and half of the cherries, repeat layers. Step 8: Top with remaining whipped cream and slivered almonds.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, orange juice, orange zest, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, walnuts, baking powder, salt, dried tart cherry, egg white, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 3 / 4 cup sugar and eggs in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Beat with an electric mixer at medium speed, scraping bowl often, 2 to 3 minutes, or until thick and pale yellow in color. Step 3: Add oil, orange juice, orange peel and vanilla. Step 4: Beat 1 to 2 minutes, or until well mixed. Step 5: Combine flour, walnuts, baking powder and salt Gradually add to egg mixture. Step 6: Mix on low speed 1 to 2 minutes, or until well mixed. Step 7: Stir in cherries by hand. Step 8: Turn dough onto lightly floured surface Lightly sprinkle with additional flour.

Ingredient Names: reduced-sugar white cake mix, egg whites, water, canola oil, brewed coffee, splenda brown sugar blend, mascarpone cheese, powdered sugar, almond extract, whipped topping, fresh cherries, baker's semi-sweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees Spray two 8' round cake pans with non-stick cooking spray In mixer bowl, combine cake mix, egg whites, water & oil. Step 2: Mix on low for 30 seconds, then on medium for 2 minutes. Step 3: Pour evenly into prepared pans & bake at 350 degrees for 27-32 minutes or til toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Step 4: Cool in pans on wire rack. Step 5: Meanwhile, in small bowl or liquid measuring cup, combine hot coffee & splenda. Step 6: Set aside to dissolve. Step 7: Slice 2 cups of cherries in half, removing & discarding pit, then chop into 1 / 2 inch pieces, set aside.

Ingredient Names: flour, butter, sugar, salt, lemon, egg yolks, cherry jam, sweet cherries, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare crostata dough: sift 2 1 / 2 cups flour. Step 2: Place flour, butter, sugar, salt, and lemon zest in food processor Pulse until mixture is moistened and crumbly. Step 3: Add egg yolks and pulse until mixture just begins to form a ball of dough. Step 4: Remove dough and flatten into a disk. Step 5: Wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 45 minutes. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350f Unwrap dough and place it on a floured work surface I have a little better luck rolling out the dough if i let it come back to room temperature a bit. Step 7: Roll out crust into a circle about 12 inches in diameter.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, lime peel, baking powder, butter, dried tart cherry, eggs, pistachio nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Oven to 350 degrees Lightly grease a large cookie sheet. Step 2: In a food processor, process flour, sugar, lime peel and baking powder until blended. Step 3: Add butter and cherries Pulse until cherries are coarsely chopped. Step 4: Spoon off and reserve 1 tablespoon of beaten eggs. Step 5: Add remaining eggs and pistachios and pulse until dough is evenly moistened. Step 6: Turn dough out onto on a well-floured surface. Step 7: Divide dough in 1 / 4s With hands, roll each portion into a 9" log.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, confectioners' sugar, sour cream, coffee liqueur, shortbread cookies, cherry pie filling, chocolate, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ricotta cheese, confectioners' sugar, sour cream and coffee liqueur in a large mixing bowl, mix well. Step 2: Set aside In the container of an electric blender or food processor, process cookies, in small batches, until finely crushed. Step 3: Remove 6 cherries from cherry filling Reserve for garnish To assemble dessert, spoon 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese mixture into six 8-ounce parfait glasses. Step 4: Add 2 tablespoons cookie crumbs to each glass. Step 5: Top each with 2 tablespoons cherry filling. Step 6: Repeat ricotta, crumb and cherry layers.

Ingredient Names: block dessert pastry, fresh cherries, unsalted butter room temperature, golden sugar, ground almonds, eggs, disaronno, mascarpone, juice lemon, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface to just thinner than a £1 coin. Use to line a 22cm loose-bottomed tart tin, leaving an overhang on the sides. Leave to chill in the fridge on a baking sheet. To make the frangipane, whizz everything together in a food processor until combined. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line the tart case with baking parchment and beans. Bake for 20 mins, then remove parchment and beans, lightly prick the base with a fork and continue to bake for 10 mins until pale biscuity. Spread the frangipane over the base and return to the oven for 15 mins until cooked. Remove from the oven, trim the sides of the pastry and leave to cool completely. Step 3: Beat the mascarpone with the lemon zest and juice and the icing sugar. Spread over the frangipane. Arrange the cherries on top, dust heavily with icing sugar, remove from the tin and serve.

Ingredient Names: sugar, water, lemon juice, orange juice, lime, vanilla, lemon, orange
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar and water in a small pot, bring to a boil reduce and simmer just until sugar is dissolved, let cool. Step 2: Stir together all the juices, zests and vanilla, add in cup of sugar syrup, taste and add more until desired sweetness is reached With a cup of syrup, this is a tart and refreshing sorbetto which makes a perfect palate cleanser. Step 3: Add more syrup for a sweeter flavor, especially if serving children. Step 4: Transfer to an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufactures instructions Every ice cream maker is different Follow the general directions for yours My gelato machine allows me to only have to slightly cool the syrup, you may have to chill syrup & juice blend before mixing You may serve the sorbetto right away, or pack in a freezer container and allow to ripen With cup syrup this makes a scant pint.

Ingredient Names: sliced almonds, butter, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, salt, eggs, almond extract, all-purpose flour, semi-sweet chocolate chips, white chocolate chips, shortening
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Lightly grease a cookie sheet and set aside. Step 2: Place 3 / 4 cup of toasted almonds in a food processor and pulse until ground. Step 3: Beat butter in large bowl for 30 seconds, then add sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Step 4: Beat until combined. Step 5: Beat in eggs and almond extract. Step 6: Beat in as much of the flour as you can with mixer By hand, stir in remaining flour, the ground almonds and the remaining 3 / 4 cup of sliced almonds On pieces of wax paper, shape dough into two 14 inch long rolls. Step 7: Place rolls on prepared cookie sheet at least 5 inches apart, flatten slightly.

Ingredient Names: butter-flavored cooking spray, bittersweet chocolate, slivered almonds, amaretti cookies, unsalted butter, sugar, orange peel, eggs, unsweetened cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f Spray a 9-inch springform pan the nonstick spray. Step 2: Refrigerate Microwave the chocolate until melted and smooth, stirring every 20 seconds, for about 1 minute. Step 3: Combine the almonds and cookies in processor Pulse until the almonds and cookies are finely ground. Step 4: Transfer the nut mixture to a medium bowl. Step 5: Add the butter and sugar to the processor and blend until creamy and smooth. Step 6: Add the grated orange peel and pulse briefly, until incorporated. Step 7: Add the eggs 1 at a time.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, salt, butter, sugar, eggs, egg white, hazelnuts, bittersweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 375f. Step 2: Line two baking trays with parchment paper and set aside Sift together flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda and salt into a large bowl and set aside In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat butter for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add sugar and beat on medium speed until light and fluffy. Step 4: Add 2 eggs, one at a time and beat until incorporated. Step 5: Add flour mixture gradually and mix until combined. Step 6: Add the chopped hazelnuts and chocolate and mix with a wooden spoon Flour your hands and turn out dough onto a lightly floured surface. Step 7: Cut in half and shape each piece into a 12 inch log.

Ingredient Names: flour, unsweetened cocoa, baking powder, sugar, brown sugar, butter, eggs, white vanilla chip
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit Spray cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray In medium bowl, combine flour, cocoa and baking powder. Step 2: Mix well In large bowl, combine sugar, brown sugar and butter. Step 3: Beat until blended, add eggs, beat well, add flour mixture, mix well.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, cocoa, flavoring, egg substitute, baking powder, salt, liquor
Instructions: Step 1: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and baking baking powder Separately, mix flavoring and eggs, combine. Step 2: Add splash of liquor or water as needed to have a sticky consistency If the mixture is too stiff, it won't spread out properly. Step 3: Put this glob on a greased cookie sheet and arrange it into a log about 15 inch es long and 1 1 / 2 - 2" wide. Step 4: Bake at 350 for 25 minutes. Step 5: Remove from oven, let cool a few minutes, then slice diagonally into 1 / 2- 3 / 4" slices I got 18 pieces from mine. Step 6: Place the slices on their side and put back in the oven for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, unsweetened baking chocolate, eggs, olive oil, orange juice, rum, orange rind, vanilla, semi-sweet chocolate chips, pecans, white chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugars, baking powder and salt. Step 2: Add melted unsweetened chocolate, eggs, oil, juice, rum, peel and vanilla, stir to combine. Step 3: Add baking chips and nuts. Step 4: Mix until dough is well blended Quarter dough. Step 5: Shape into 4 logs, each about 2 1 / 2" wide by 14" long. Step 6: Place 2 logs on each of 2 lightly oiled baking pans. Step 7: Bake logs at 350 degrees just until firm to touch, about 20 min. Step 8: Cool logs slightly in pans.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, sugar, flour, cocoa, baking powder, nuts, dark chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Cream together the eggs with a pinch of sugar until frothy using an electric mixer. Step 2: Spoon in the sugar little by little to make a pale yellow batter Sift together flour, cocoa and baking powder. Step 3: Fold carefully into the egg mixture. Step 4: Fold in nuts and chocolate. Step 5: Chill for about 20 minutes Flour hands and divide the dough into two Form into logs in the length of an oven tray. Step 6: Bake for 5 minutes in a 175c oven. Step 7: Lower the temperature to 150c and bake for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: semisweet chocolate, unsalted butter, brewed espresso, ricotta cheese, confectioners' sugar, orange zest, chocolate, chocolate pound cake, orange liqueur
