Instructions: Step 1: Frosting: place chocolate, butter and espresso in a small heatproof bowl or the top of a double boiler. Step 2: Set over gently simmering water, with the bottom not the touching water. Step 3: Stir until melted, smooth and combined. Step 4: Remove from heat and refrigerate until firm, stirring every 15 minutes, about 1 hour Filling: in a bowl, stir together the ricotta, sugar and orange zest. Step 5: Using a grater, grate the chocolate chunk into the bowl and fold into the ricotta Assembly: using a serrated knife, slice the pound cake horizontally to form 3 equal layers. Step 6: Place 1 layer on a flat plate and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons orange liqueur. Step 7: Spread 1 / 2 of the ricotta mixture on top. Step 8: Top with second layer layer, sprinkle with remaining orange liqueur and spread with the rest of the ricotta.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, sugar, orange, eggs, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, dried ancho chile powder, salt, semisweet chocolate, walnuts, dried cherries
Instructions: Step 1: Position the racks in the top third and center of the oven and preheat to 350 f. Step 2: Using a hand-held electric mixer set at high speed, beat the butter, sugar, and orange zest in a large bowl until well combined, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Beat in the eggs, one at a time, then the vanilla. Step 4: In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, chili powder, and salt to combine. Step 5: Using a wooden spoon, gradually beat in the butter mixture Work in the chocolate, walnuts, and cherries. Step 6: Divide the dough in half. Step 7: Using lightly floured hands on a floured work surface, form the dough into two 10 x 2-inch logs. Step 8: Place the logs on an ungreased large baking sheet, at least 2 inches apart. Step 9: Bake on the center rack until set and golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, almond extract, dried tart cherry, semi-sweet chocolate chips, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Lightly spoon flours into dry measuring cups, and level with a knife. Step 2: Combine flours and salt in a bowl. Step 3: Stir well with a whisk. Step 4: Beat sugar and eggs with a mixer at high speed until thick and pale. Step 5: Add oil and extracts, beating until well-blended. Step 6: Add flour mixture, beating at low speed just until blended. Step 7: Stir in cherries and chocolate chips. Step 8: Divide dough in half. Step 9: Turn out onto a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, sugar, vanilla, flour, cornstarch, baking soda, nuts, chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix together butter, eggs, sugar, and vanilla. Step 3: Add flour, cornstarch, and baking soda, blending well. Step 4: Add chocolate chips and nuts Form dough into two loaves on cookie sheet. Step 5: Bake 30-40 minutes. Step 6: Remove from oven, cut into slices, and arrange on cookie sheet side-down and not touching. Step 7: Return to oven for 10 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: eggs, vegetable oil, sugar, all-purpose flour, lemon rind, baking powder, semisweet mini chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Beat the eggs, then add the next 5 ingredients when well combined, stir in the chocolate chips until well mixed If the dough is too soft and sticky, add a bit more flour until the dough can be formed into logs. Step 3: Shape the dough into eight 2-1 / 2 inch wide logs, then place them on 4 ungreased cookie sheets. Step 4: Bake for 18-20 minutes or just until golden in colour. Step 5: Remove the logs from the oven and at an angle, cut them into 1 inch slices. Step 6: Place the cookies back on the cookie sheets, and return to the oven for an additional 10 minutes per side to toast slightly.

Dish Name: Chocolate Chip Cannoli Filling W Kahlua Creme De Cacao
Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, sugar, creme de cacao, kahlua, semi-sweet chocolate chips, cannoli shells
Instructions: Step 1: Mix up cheese and sugar in a large bowl. Step 2: Pour liquors into a shot glass and add slowly and check consistency as you add it ensuring that mixture stays thick and not soupy. Step 3: Stir in chocolate chips. Step 4: Serve inside cannoli shells or use as a dip for pizzelles or other crisp wafer like cookies.

Ingredient Names: unbaked pie shells, water, cinnamon sugar, ricotta cheese, sweetened condensed milk, confectioners' sugar, vanilla extract, milk chocolate chips, whipped topping
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Brush pie shell very lightly with water Generously sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Step 3: Stir ricotta cheese, sweetened condensed milk, confectioners' sugar and vanilla in medium bowl until blended. Step 4: Stir in chocolate chips. Step 5: Pour into pie crust. Step 6: Bake 45-50 minutes or until crust is golden brown Filling will appear slightly soft. Step 7: Cool completely on wire rack. Step 8: Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, yellow cornmeal, baking powder, salt, eggs, sugar, orange zest, lemon zest, semi-sweet chocolate chips, unsweetened cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Step 2: Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 3: Stir the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Step 4: Using an electric mixer, beat the eggs and sugar in another large bowl until pale yellow and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the orange and lemon zests to the dry ingredients. Step 6: Add the flour mixture to the eggs and sugar and beat just until blended. Step 7: Let stand for 5 minutes. Step 8: Using a rubber spatula, transfer the dough to the prepared baking sheet, forming two mounds spaced evenly apart Moisten your hands with water and shape the dough into two 11 by 4-inch logs. Step 9: Bake until lightly brown, about 35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, unsweetened cocoa powder, salt, butter, eggs, milk, honey, egg white, oil, heavy whipping cream, eggnog, ricotta cheese, nutmeg, candy sprinkles
Instructions: Step 1: Chocolate cannoli shells: In a medium bowl, stir together all-purpose flour, sugar cocoa powder, and salt. Step 2: Using a pastry blender, cut in butter into flour mixture until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Step 3: In a small bowl, stir together eggs, milk, and honey. Step 4: Add egg mixture to flour mixture. Step 5: Stir just until mixture forms a ball. Step 6: Divide dough in half On a lightly floured surface, roll each dough portion into a 16-inch square. Step 7: Cut each square into sixteen 4-inch squares. Step 8: Wrap each square lightly around one end of greased metal cannoli cylinders.

Ingredient Names: cake flour, unsweetened cocoa powder, baking powder, salt, eggs, granulated sugar, instant espresso coffee powder, vanilla extract, confectioners' sugar, heavy whipping cream, mascarpone cheese, semisweet chocolate, brown sugar, dark chocolate shavings
Instructions: Step 1: Cake: heat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Line a 15 1 / 2-10 1 / 2-inch jelly roll pan with nonstick foil. Step 3: Combine cake flour, cocoa powder, baking powder and salt in a small bowl. Step 4: In a large bowl, beat egg whites with a handheld mixer on medium high speed until foamy Gradually beat in 1 / 2 cup of the sugar until incorporated Continue to beat on high speed just until stiff yet billowy peaks form. Step 5: Using same beaters, beat egg yolks in a large bowl with the remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar, coffee powder and vanilla until thickened, about 3 minutes At low speed, beat in flour mixture until blended. Step 6: Stir one quarter of the beaten whites into mixture to loosen. Step 7: Fold in remaining whites until incorporated.

Ingredient Names: egg, flour, unsweetened cocoa, baking powder, salt, sugar, milk, butter, vanilla, cocoa, bittersweet chocolate, mascarpone cheese, whipping cream, powdered sugar, kahlua
Instructions: Step 1: Biscuit-allow egg to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, grease a 9 x 9 inch baking dish, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 3: Line the bottom of baking pan with parchment paper, grease and flour paper, set aside. Step 4: In a small bowl, stir together the flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt. Step 5: In a medium bowl, beat egg with an electric mixer on high speed about 3 minutes or until thick and lemon colored Gradually add sugar, beating on medium speed for 4 minutes or until light and fluffy. Step 6: Add the flour mixture. Step 7: Beat on low to medium speed just until combined. Step 8: In a small saucepan, combine milk and butter.

Ingredient Names: flour, baking powder, salt, butter, cream cheese, granulated sugar, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, sweetened condensed milk, bittersweet chocolate, walnuts, confectioners' sugar
Instructions: Step 1: For cream cheese filling dough: in medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt In large bowl, with mixer on medium speed, beat butter and cream cheese until well blended Gradually add the sugars and beat 3 minutes or until light and creamy. Step 2: Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition, beat in vanilla. Step 3: Reduce speed to low Gradually beat in flour mixture just until blended. Step 4: Place level 3 / 4 cup dough on sheet of plastic wrap. Step 5: Repeat to make 8 more 3 / 4 cupfuls. Step 6: Wrap each with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

Ingredient Names: unsweetened cocoa powder, sugar, sea salt, milk, eggs, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy sauce pan whisk together the cocoa sugar and salt. Step 2: Whisk in milk and eggs. Step 3: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until steaming hot and starting to thicken, about 6-8 minutes. Step 4: Whisk in cream and remove from heat. Step 5: Transfer into your freezing container and chill for 8-12 hours. Step 6: When ready to freeze, follow your manufacturer's directions.

Dish Name: Chocolate Gelato Without Ice Cream Maker
Ingredient Names: chocolate, sugar, egg yolks, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Melt chocolate in a double boiler. Step 2: Beat egg yolk and sugar together. Step 3: Heat the milk in low heat and remove from heat just before it starts to boil. Step 4: Add the milk to the yolk mixture little by little mixing thoroughly. Step 5: Heat the mixture again stirring occasionally until it boils and remove from heat. Step 6: Add melted chocolate and mix thoroughly. Step 7: Transfer to a chilled metal container and freeze. Step 8: Stir it every 45 minutes to break any ice lumps and put it back in the freezer Continue to do this 2 more times. Step 9: After about 7 hrs of freezing, put it through a food processor.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, heavy cream, sugar, egg yolks, vanilla extract, chocolate hazelnut spread, toasted hazelnuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan combine the milk, cream, and 1 / 2 cup sugar on medium heat. Step 2: Cook until sugar dissolves, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a medium bowl whip the egg yolks with the remaining sugar using an electric mixer until the eggs have become thick and pale yellow, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Pour 1 / 2 cup of the warm milk and cream mixture into the egg mixture and stir. Step 5: Add the mixture back into the saucepan. Step 6: Cook over very low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture becomes thick enough to coat the back of a wooden spoon, about 7 to 10 minutes. Step 7: Put a strainer over a medium bowl and pour the warm custard mixture through it. Step 8: Stir in the vanilla and hazelnut spread until it dissolves. Step 9: Chill the mixture completely before pouring into an ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's instructions to freeze To serve, scoop gelato into serving bowls and top with hazelnuts.

Dish Name: Chocolate Hazelnut Phyllo Dessert Fit For Queens
Ingredient Names: phyllo dough, nutella, light corn syrup, cinnamon sugar, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f Measure nutella, corn syrup, and cinnamon sugar in measuring cups. Step 2: Set aside the measuring cups. Step 3: Melt butter and set aside with a pastry brush in it Unroll 1 sleeve of defrosted phyllo dough on work space. Step 4: Grease a square baking pan with butter. Step 5: Now pick up a sheet of phyllo dough and put it into the bottom of the pan Try to work fast because it's easy Use up 5 of the sheets this way. Step 6: Layer the next 5 sheets by sprinkling cinnamon sugar on top of the butter.

Ingredient Names: chocolate hazelnut spread, semisweet chocolate, heavy cream, chocolate syrup, fresh strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: Line 8x4 inch loaf pan with plastic wrap, extending the wrap at the sides and ends of the pan. Step 2: In a bowl, mix hazelnut spread and melted chocolate. Step 3: In a second bowl, beat cream just until stiff peaks form. Step 4: Stir a large spoonful of whipped cream into the chocolate mixture. Step 5: Fold the remaining cream into the chocolate mixture, half at a time. Step 6: Pour mixture into the prepared pan and smooth the top Freeze for 1 hour. Step 7: Remove from freezer and cover top with plastic wrap, and freeze overnight until firm To serve: remove plastic wrap from top and invert semifreddo on to a platter. Step 8: Remove remaining plastic wrap.

Ingredient Names: bittersweet chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar, flour, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325. Step 2: Combine chocolate and butter in the top of a double boiler, stirring until all is melted and combined Whip eggs& sugar until light and fluffy. Step 3: Mix flour into chocolate mixture Gently fold the chocolate mixture into the whipped eggs being careful to not lose all the wonderful volume from the eggs Spray either 12 muffin tins or 12 ramekins / souffle dishes wtih non-stick spray. Step 4: Pour batter into prepared pans / dishes. Step 5: Bake at 325 degrees for 9-12 minutes. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: mascarpone, confectioners' sugar, cocoa powder, cinnamon, grand marnier, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place mascarpone in a large bowl Sift the sugar, cocoa, and cinnamon over the mascarpone then mix well. Step 2: Stir in the grand marnier and mix until combined Gently fold in 1 / 3 of the whipped cream, repeat 1 / 3 at a time. Step 3: Spoon into 4 individual serving dishes and chill.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, unsweetened cocoa, baking soda, salt, mint chocolate chips, slivered almonds, eggs, egg white, creme de menthe
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl, set aside. Step 2: Combine eggs, egg white and crme de menthe, stirring well with a wire whisk Slowly add egg mixture to flour mixture, stirring by hand until dry ingredients are moistened Mixture will be very stiff. Step 3: Sprinkle 1 tablespoon flour evenly over work surface. Step 4: Turn dough out onto floured surface and knead lightly about 7 or 8 times. Step 5: Divide dough in half. Step 6: Shape each half into an 8-inch log. Step 7: Place logs, 4 inches apart, on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ground cloves, strong coffee, milk, egg, vanilla, walnuts, semi-sweet chocolate chips, dried cranberries
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large bowl, whisk together all dry ingredients. Step 3: In a small bowl, whisk egg. Step 4: Add coffee, milk and vanilla, mix well. Step 5: Add egg mixture to dry ingredients If resulting mixture is too dry, add a little more coffee. Step 6: Add chips, nuts and cranberries. Step 7: Turn dough onto well-floured board and with floured hands, form into 2 logs, each about 13-14 inches long and 3 1 / 2 inches wide. Step 8: Bake on greased and floured baking sheet for 20-25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, unsweetened cocoa powder, baking powder, ground cinnamon, orange zest, fine salt, eggs, granulated sugar, unsalted butter, vegetable oil cooking spray, confectioners' sugar, semisweet chocolate, mint extract
Instructions: Step 1: Cookies: Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking powder, cinnamon, orange zest, and salt together in a large bowl In another medium bowl, briskly whisk the eggs, sugar and melted butter together until smooth and evenly combined. Step 2: Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the egg mixture Gradually whisk the liquid into the flour to make a thick batter. Step 3: When the pizzelle batter starts to clump up in the whisk, switch to a rubber spatula to finish mixing it together. Step 4: Preheat a pizzelle iron until a drop of water sizzles on the hot surface, about 10 minute Lightly spray the hot surface with nonstick cooking spray Pipe or spoon about a tablespoon of the batter into the center of each cookie imprint Close the iron and cook until whiffs of steam comes from the iron, about 30 to 45 seconds.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, butter, chocolate hazelnut spread, semi-sweet chocolate chips, milk chocolate chips, white chocolate chips, hazelnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Position the oven rack on the bottom of the oven and preheat to 450f. Step 2: Line a heavy large baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 3: Roll out the dough to a 9-inch-diameter round. Step 4: Transfer the dough to the prepared baking sheet. Step 5: Using your fingers, make indentations all over the dough. Step 6: Brush the dough with butter, then bake until the crust is crisp and pale golden brown, about 20 minutes Immediately spread the chocolate-hazelnut spread over the pizza then sprinkle all the chocolate chips over. Step 7: Bake just until the chocolate begins to melt, about 1 minute. Step 8: Sprinkle the hazelnuts over the pizza. Step 9: Cut into wedges and serve.

Dish Name: Chocolate Red Wine Cupcakes With Mascarpone Icing
Ingredient Names: unsweetened cocoa powder, chocolate, water, butter, granulated sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder, salt, full-bodied red wine, mascarpone cheese, confectioners' sugar, red grapes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f line 2 muffin pans with muffin cups or coat with nonstick spray. Step 2: In a medium, heatproof bowl, combine cocoa powder with chocolate pieces. Step 3: Whisk in the boiling water until chocolate is melted and mixture is combined. Step 4: In a large bowl, cream butter and granulated sugar together. Step 5: Beat in the eggs one at a time, until fully blended Sift in flour, baking powder, and salt, and mix until just combined Alternating, add the chocolate mixture and wine in batches, mixing well between each addition. Step 6: Repeat this until batter is smooth. Step 7: Divide mixture among muffin cups, filling each about 3 / 4 of the way full. Step 8: Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, about 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: milk, flour, semisweet chocolate, sugar, unsalted butter, ground cinnamon, brioche bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, stir 1 / 2 cup milk and the flour until smooth. Step 2: In a saucepan bring 4 1 / 2 cups milk to a simmer over medium heat. Step 3: Place chocolate in a small bowl, and ladle 1 cup of the simmering milk over the chocolate and whisk to dissolve it. Step 4: Stir the dissolved chocolate into the simmering milk Slowly add the flour mixture to milk in the saucepan, then stir in sugar, butter, and cinnamon, and return to the simmer. Step 5: Cook, stirring until thick and smooth - about 5 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat, and let rest about a minute Ladle soup into warm bowls, and pass the brioche, panettone, or cookies for dunking into the soup.

Ingredient Names: chocolate hazelnut spread, poundcake, fresh strawberries, butter-flavored cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a panini grill to medium according to the manufacturer's instructions. Step 2: Spread the chocolate-hazelnut spread over 1 side of all of the pound cake slices. Step 3: Arrange the sliced strawberries over 6 cake slices. Step 4: Cover with the remaining cake slices, chocolate side down Spray panini grill with nonstick spray and grill each panino until the pound cake is crisp and golden and the fillings are warm, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Cut each panini in half and serve.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, eggs, egg whites, canola oil, cold water, vanilla, mascarpone cheese, milk chocolate, kahlua, brewed espresso, rum
Instructions: Step 1: Methods-- syrup. Step 2: Place all syrup ingredients into saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 3: Remove from the heat and let cool-- set aside. Step 4: In a bowl over simmering hot water melt the chopped milk choolate -- remove And set aside to cool Filling In large mixer bowl, beat mascarpone until fluffy. Step 5: In a large bowl over simmering hot water, whisk egg yolks, with 1 / 4 cup of the sugar-- until when touched with finger it is warm to hot to the touch and has slightly doubled and pale yellow-- whisking continually remove the yolks from heat and add into the mascarpone mixture On low speed add the cooled chocolate-- and mix well In large mixer bowl beat the egg whites to soft peaks.

Dish Name: Chocolate Topped Almond One Layer Cake
Ingredient Names: almonds, sugar, unbleached white flour, butter, vanilla extract, almond extract, salt, eggs, semi-sweet chocolate chips, powdered sugar, slivered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Lightly grease and flour a 9" round cake pan. Step 2: Place almonds in a small baking dish and place in oven until lightly toasted. Step 3: Place toasted almonds and 2 t sugar in a food processor or blender Grind to a powder in a few short bursts. Step 4: Stir in flour and set aside. Step 5: Combine butter with remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar, extracts, and salt in a medium size bowl. Step 6: Beat with mixer until creamy. Step 7: Add one egg at a time, beating well after each. Step 8: Using a spatula and a light hand, gently fold in the almond flour mixture.

Ingredient Names: bittersweet dark chocolate, eggs, superfine sugar, vanilla extract, ground almonds, butter, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 350f. Step 2: Grease the sides of a 9 1 / 2" springform pan, then line the base with non-stick baking paper. Step 3: Chop the chocolate finely with a large knife, or process until finely chopped, but still retaining some texture. Step 4: Using a mixer, beat the egg yolks with the sugar and vanilla extract until the mixture is pale and thick With a rubber spatula, fold in the chocolate, the almonds and melted butter. Step 5: In a clean, dry bowl, beat the egg whites until they form soft peaks. Step 6: Fold the beaten egg whites into the chocolate mixture. Step 7: Spoon into the prepared cake tin and bake for between 50-60 minutes, until just firm to the touch. Step 8: Leave to cool for 20 minutes before turning out To serve, dust with powdered sugar.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, flour, cocoa, baking powder, demerara sugar, espresso, egg yolks, marsala, white chocolate half, mascarpone, dark chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: For the cakes, heat oven to 180C/ 160C fan/gas 4. Butter and line 2 x 20cm sandwich tins. Melt the butter and allow to cool slightly. Put the eggs, sugar and vanilla into a bowl and whisk for about 8 mins or until the mixture is pale, thick and has trebled in volume. Step 2: Sift the flour, cocoa, baking powder and a pinch of salt over the egg mixture, then gently fold together. Pour the cooled butter around the edge of the bowl and fold in until fully incorporated. Divide the batter between the prepared tins and bake for 10-12 mins or until a skewer inserted into the middle of the cakes comes out clean. Allow to cool in the tins for a few mins, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Step 3: Meanwhile, make the filling. Dissolve the sugar in the coffee and set aside. Put the egg yolks, sugar and Marsala into a heatproof bowl, then set over a large pan of simmering water. Whisk for 5 mins until the mixture is thick and has trebled in volume – make sure the mixture is really thick. Remove from the heat and take the bowl off the pan. Keep whisking until the mixture is cool. Step 4: Melt the chopped white chocolate in the microwave on Low and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, beat the mascarpone until smooth, then fold into the egg mixture with the cooled white chocolate. Step 5: Slice the cakes in half horizontally. Place one layer in the bottom of a 20cm springform tin. Brush with the coffee syrup and spread with 3 tbsp of the mascarpone mixture. Scatter with 1 tbsp grated dark chocolate, then repeat until you end with the fourth layer of cake. Cover with cling film and chill for at least 2 hrs along with the remaining mascarpone mixture. Step 6: Remove the tin and put the cake on a serving plate, then cover with the remaining mascarpone mixture. Mix the remaining dark chocolate with the grated white chocolate and press carefully onto the sides of the cake. Dust the top with cocoa.

Ingredient Names: eggs, whole wheat flour, white sugar, baking powder, vegetable oil, water, lemon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Sift togather flour, salt and baking powder, set aside With an electric mixer beat eggs with sugar until light and fluffy. Step 2: Add oil to eggs and gradually beat in flour and lemon peel At last add water gradually until consistency is right You may need more or less water depending on type of flour and ambient conditions Avarage measure is 200ml. Step 3: Beat until batter is smooth. Step 4: Grease and flour a 9-10 inches tube pan. Step 5: Pour batter in the prepared pan and bake in the oven for about 50 min.

Ingredient Names: butter, white sugar, large eggs, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, baking powder, salt, hazelnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease a cookie sheet or line with parchment paper. Step 3: In a medium bowl, cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Step 4: Beat in eggs and vanilla. Step 5: Sift together flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt; mix into egg mixture. Step 6: Stir in hazelnuts. Step 7: Shape dough into two 12-inch long logs; place on the prepared baking sheet and press down to 1/2-inch thickness. Step 8: Bake for about in the preheated oven, or until the edges are golden and the center is firm. Step 9: Remove from oven to cool on the pans. Step 10: When logs are cool enough to handle, use a serrated knife to slice the logs diagonally into 1/2-inch-thick slices. Step 11: Return the slices to the baking sheet. Step 12: Bake for an additional, turning over once. Step 13: Cool completely, and store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: butter, brown sugar, white sugar, instant espresso, eggs, vanilla, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, ground cinnamon, pecans, miniature semisweet chocolate chips, cinnamon baking chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f on convection bake setting. Step 2: Combine butter, sugars and espresso or coffee granules in a large bowl and beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Step 3: Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 4: Add vanilla and mix briefly. Step 5: Add flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and mix until well blended. Step 6: Fold in pecans, chocolate morsels and cinnamon chips. Step 7: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper Scoop dough out onto paper and form into a large rectangle, -inch thick. Step 8: Bake 25 minutes, or until firm. Step 9: Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Cioccolato Paradiso Italian Chocolate Paradise Biscotti
Ingredient Names: almonds, butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, orange, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, milk chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Place nuts in a shallow pan and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 5 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown, let cool. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and 1 / 2 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Step 3: Beat in egg yolks, vanilla and orange zest. Step 4: In a bowl combine the flour, baking powder and salt. Step 5: Add to the creamed mixture, mixing just until crumbly. Step 6: In a separate bowl, beat egg whites until stiff soft peaks form and beat in remaining sugar, beating until stiff but not dry. Step 7: Fold meringue into the crumbly dough, mixing until it clings together. Step 8: Cut nuts into halves or thirds and fold in along with chocolate. Step 9: Divide dough in half.

Dish Name: Cipriani's Chocolate Ice Cream With Bitter Orange Sauce
Ingredient Names: sugar, milk, unsweetened cocoa powder, bittersweet chocolate, egg yolks, orange zest, fresh orange juice, orange preserves, cointreau liqueur, fresh raspberry, mint sprig
Instructions: Step 1: For the gelato: In a dry 3 quart saucepan, cook 1 / 4 cup of sugar, undisturbed, over moderate heat until it begins to melt Continue to cook, stirring with a fork, until sugar is completely melted and becomes deep golden brown in color. Step 2: Remove from heat and dip pan briefly into an ice water bath to stop cooking. Step 3: Cool pan about 5 minutes, then return to moderate heat, add milk and whisk until caramel is melted and milk is incorporated. Step 4: Whisk in cocoa and keep whisking till mixture is well combined. Step 5: Keep warm while you prepare chocolate and custard base. Step 6: Melt chocolate in a bowl over barely simmering water. Step 7: In a bowl, beat the eggs and the remaining 3 / 4 cup of sugar until the mixture is thick and pale. Step 8: Whisk the caramel mixture and the chocolate into the yolk mixture, pouring them in in streams and whisking all the while.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, white sugar, mascarpone cheese, heavy cream, unsweetened cocoa powder, semisweet chocolate, ladyfingers
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine egg yolks and sugar in the top of a double boiler, over boiling water. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, and cook for about 15-20 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 4: Remove from heat and whip yolks until thick and lemon-colored. Step 5: Add mascarpone to whipped yolks. Step 6: Beat until combined. Step 7: In a separate bowl, whip cream to stiff peaks. Step 8: Gently fold into yolk mixture and set aside. Step 9: Split the lady fingers in half, and line the bottom and sides of a large glass bowl. Step 10: Brush with coffee liqueur. Step 11: Spoon half of the cream filling over the lady fingers. Step 12: Repeat ladyfingers, coffee liqueur and filling layers. Step 13: Garnish with cocoa and chocolate curls. Step 14: Refrigerate several hours or overnight, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: clementines, water, lemon, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub & rinse clementines, place in water in a large soup pot. Step 2: Squeeze lemon - reserve juice Bundle the lemon seeds with cheesecloth and tie it off. Step 3: Add bundle of seeds and the halved lemon to pot. Step 4: Cover the pot and simmer for 2-3 hours until fruit is soft. Step 5: Remove pot from heat, cool overnight. Step 6: Discard bundle of lemon seeds, do not strain liquid Scoop fruit out of the liquid into a large bowl Halve the clementines, scoop pulp and seeds into a strainer set over the pot that was used to boil the fruit Save all peels.

Ingredient Names: sugar, butter, vanilla, eggs, shredded coconut, flour, baking powder, toasted almond, milk chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large bowl cream together sugar and butter. Step 3: Add vanilla, eggs and coconut. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 cup flour and baking powder, mix well. Step 5: Add remaining flour. Step 6: Stir in nuts if desired On a large sprayed cookie sheet divide dough in half and shape into two logs. Step 7: Bake for 20-25 minutes. Step 8: Reduce oven temp to 300. Step 9: Cool for 5-10 minutes remove logs from cookie sheets to a cooling rack.

Ingredient Names: unbleached all-purpose flour, baking powder, table salt, unsalted butter, light brown sugar, eggs, pure vanilla extract, sweetened flaked coconut, semisweet mini chocolate chips, toasted almond
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, and salt. Step 2: In a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing on medium speed after each addition until incorporated. Step 4: Mix in the vanilla and then the coconut until well combined With the mixer on low speed, gradually add the flour mixture and mix just until combined The dough will be sticky With the mixer still on low, mix in the chocolate chips. Step 5: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 350f. Step 6: Line a large cookie sheet with parchment.

Ingredient Names: coconut, flour, sugar, eggs, egg white, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Step 2: Line cookie sheets with parchment paper. Step 3: Drop 1 tablespoon of mixture onto parchment paper making a round cookie. Step 4: Bake until golden brown at top.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, egg yolks, sugar, espresso, espresso beans, orange zest
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs lightly, whisk into milk and sugar. Step 2: Heat mixture over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Step 3: Remove the resulting custard from heat, and pour into chilled bowl. Step 4: Stir in espresso, orange zest, and coffee grounds. Step 5: Chill for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight Freeze mixture according to ice cream maker instructions. Step 6: Transfer to a freezer-safe container, press plastic wrap across the surface of the gelato, snap on lid, and place in freezer to hard-freeze To serve, place gelato in fridge approximately 20 minutes before serving to soften.

Ingredient Names: brewed coffee, sugar, orange zest, vanilla extract, lightly sweetened whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-size bowl, stir the hot coffee, sugar, and orange zest until the sugar dissolves, cool. Step 2: Stir in the vanilla. Step 3: Transfer the liquid to a shallow bottomed bowl or square metal cake pan and place in the freezer Wait about 30 to 40 minutes, until the sides start to freeze, then stir the mixture gently with a wooden spoon, especially around the edges. Step 4: Put the granita back in the freezer and repeat the stirring every 20 to 30 minutes, until the mixture is grainy-frozen. Step 5: Transfer to well-chilled bowls the chilled bowls are important, especially in summer, to prevent it from melting In fact, chill your spoons too. Step 6: Serve, garnished with whipped cream if desired.

Dish Name: Coffee Shop Style Easy Cake Mix Biscotti
Ingredient Names: cake mix, all-purpose flour, eggs, margarine, vanilla extract, nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Step 2: Pour the cake mix into a mixing bowl. Step 3: Stir in sifted all purpose flour. Step 4: Make a well in the centre and add the eggs, margarine and vanilla extract With an electric beater mix on medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes until the dough does not stick to the sides of the mixing bowl It will look and feel like play dough! Step 5: On a lightly floured board, divide dough into two halves. Step 6: Roll each half into a log about 1" in diameter. Step 7: Roll each log gently to the edge of the board and then continue rolling it onto a lightly sprayed 11 x 15 baking sheet Flatten the top of each cookie log until it is about 3" wide.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, zucchini, ricotta, eggs, fresh basil, nutmeg, parmesan, garlic, ready-rolled puff pastry, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan. Cook the courgettes for 5 mins until golden around the edges, then remove from the pan and set aside. Mix the ricotta with the eggs, most of the basil, the nutmeg, Parmesan and garlic. Set aside. Step 2: Unroll the pastry on a lightly floured surface – roll it out lightly to give an even surface. Line a baking tray with baking parchment and lay the pastry on top. Step 3: Spread the pastry with the ricotta mix, leaving a border of 1cm around the edge, then press the courgette slices into the ricotta. Bring the pastry sides up over the edge of the filling and pinch so that none seeps out the sides. Step 4: Bake for 30 mins until the tart is puffed up and golden. Serve warm, scattered with the remaining basil.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, baby zucchini diagonal, garlic, chili flakes, sugar, red wine vinegar, plum tomatoes, linguine, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan. Cook the pancetta or bacon until crisp, add the courgettes, then sizzle for 4 mins until golden. Add the garlic and chilli to the courgettes, cook for 1 min, then sprinkle with sugar and splash in the vinegar. Tip over the canned tomatoes, turn up the heat, season with salt and pepper, then simmer for 10 mins. Step 2: While the sauce is simmering, cook the linguine, then drain. Toss the pasta through the sauce, then scatter with parsley and drizzle with a little more olive oil.

Ingredient Names: sundried tomato paste, garlic, ready-rolled puff pastry, ball mozzarella, mushrooms, zucchini, olive oil, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Mix the tomato paste and garlic together. Place the pastry on a baking sheet and score a border about 1cm in from the edge. Prick the pastry within the border all over with a fork, then spread with the tomato mixture. Step 2: Top with the cheese, mushrooms and courgette, drizzle with olive oil, then evenly scatter over the oregano along with a little salt and pepper. Bake for 20 mins until risen and golden, then slice and serve with salad.

Ingredient Names: eggs, sugar, orange rind, vanilla, unbleached all-purpose flour, baking soda, salt, dried cranberries, hazelnuts, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Line large baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 3: Beat eggs and sugar in bowl until thick. Step 4: Beat in peel and vanilla Slowly beat in flour, baking soda and salt. Step 5: Beat in cranberries and nuts. Step 6: Using floured hands, divide dough into 2 balls Flatten each to 1 inch thickness. Step 7: Brush beaten egg whites. Step 8: Sprinkle with additional sugar.

Dish Name: Cream Cheese Crostata With Orange Marmalade
Ingredient Names: cake flour, sugar, egg yolk, unsalted butter, cream cheese, mascarpone cheese, orange marmalade, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: For crust: Mix flour and sugar together on work surface and make a well in center of mixture. Step 2: Add egg yolk and scatter butter cubes over flour mixture. Step 3: Using your hands, gently mix the ingredients together until well blended and dough forms Flatten into disk, wrap in plastic, and chill at least 1 hour or overnight. Step 4: Preheat oven to 400f and spray 9-inch tart pan with removable bottom with nonstick spray. Step 5: Press dough onto bottom and up sides of pan. Step 6: Bake until golden brown and cooked through, pressing with back of fork if crust bubbles, about 18 minutes. Step 7: Cool crust in pan on rack For filling:.

Dish Name: Cream Of Sweet Potato Soup Crema Di Papata Dolci E Gabretti
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, butter, garlic cloves, leek, sweet potatoes, carrots, chicken broth, cumin, ground cinnamon, whipping cream, salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh chives, crouton
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oil and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and leeks. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, until they release their flavors, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add sweet potatoes, carrots, broth, cumin and cinnamon. Step 5: Heat to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer. Step 6: Cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Puree until smooth in a blender or food processor. Step 8: Return soup to saucepan. Step 9: Stir in cream, salt and pepper to taste. Step 10: Garnish with chives and croutons.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, parsnip, carrots, risotto rice such as arborio, fresh bay leaf, vegetables, peas, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large shallow pan. Tip in the onion, parsnip and carrots, cover and gently fry for 8 mins until the onion is very soft. Step 2: Stir in the rice and bay leaf, then gently fry for another 2-3 mins until the rice starts to turn see-through around the edges. Add 300ml of the stock and simmer over a gentle heat, stirring until it has all been absorbed. Carry on adding the hot stock, a ladleful at a time, letting it be absorbed before adding more. Continue until the rice is just cooked and all the stock has been used, adding a little more water or stock if needed. This will take 18-20 mins. Step 3: Remove the bay leaf from the cooked risotto and stir in the peas. Heat through for a few mins, then add most of the Parmesan and season to taste. Sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan and serve.

Dish Name: Crema Fritti Fried Cream Lidia Bastianich
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, table salt, whole milk, egg yolks, vanilla extract, eggs, plain breadcrumbs, canola oil, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together flour, sugar and salt. Step 2: Heat milk to almost simmering Whisking constantly, add flour-sugar mixture. Step 3: Cook 5-6 minutes, until thick. Step 4: Beat egg yolks and vanilla. Step 5: Add hot pudding, 1 / 4 cup at a time, until egg yolks are hot to the touch. Step 6: Pour egg yolk mixture into pot and whisk vigorously over heat 2-3 minutes It should be quite thick Thicker than a typical pudding. Step 7: Pour cream into ungreased quarter-sheet pan and spread out evenly.

Ingredient Names: superfine sugar, egg yolks, whole milk, vanilla, heavy cream, creme de menthe
Instructions: Step 1: Set aside a large bowl of ice water. Step 2: In a saucepan, bring milk and half of sugar to a simmer, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Add crme de menthe In another bowl, mix or whisk yolks and remaining sugar until thick and pale To this add hot milk slowly, whisking, and pour mixture back into saucepan when finished. Step 4: Cook over moderately low heat, stirring constantly, for approx 20 minutes Do not allow mixture to boil! Step 5: Pour custard through a fine sieve into a freezer container, stir in cream and set in the bowl of ice water to cool. Step 6: Chill in refrigerator until cold. Step 7: Press plastic wrap to the surface of the mixture and cover container with a lid.

Dish Name: Crisp prosciutto, pea & mozzarella salad with mint vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: prosciutto, peas, ball buffalo mozzarella, oranges, olive oil, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a frying pan. Without adding any oil, fry the prosciutto slices until wrinkled and crisp. Place on a sheet of kitchen roll, leave to cool, break into large shards, then set aside. Step 2: Boil the peas in a pan of salted water for 2 mins until just tender. Meanwhile, mix all the vinaigrette ingredients together, season, then set aside. If making ahead, do not add the chopped mint until ready to serve, as it will discolour. When the peas are cooked, drain, then run them under cold water until completely cool. Pat dry with kitchen paper. Step 3: To serve, divide the mozzarella between 2 plates, scatter the peas over and sit the prosciutto shards on top. Drizzle the dressing over and around, and scatter with the mint leaves.

Ingredient Names: croissant dough, nutella, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven according to package directions Unroll croissant dough, and separate individual rolls. Step 2: Spread a scant teaspoon of nutella at the widest end of each roll, being careful to stay away from the edge. Step 3: Roll croissants up, and bake according to package directions. Step 4: Brush with butter and sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired Enjoy with a cup of coffee.

Dish Name: Crostada Di Mela E Fischi Apple And Fig Tart
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, salt, unsalted butter, egg, egg yolk, lemon, fresh lemon juice, apples, fig preserves, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, black pepper, butter, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Directions for butter based dough: In a food processor or in a bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, and salt. Step 2: Add the butter and pulse, or cut in with a pastry blender, until the mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Step 3: Add the egg, egg yolk, lemon zest, and juice through the feed tube, or stir in, and pulse or mix just until a dough starts to form Gather the dough into a ball and wrap in wax paper. Step 4: Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 5: Combine the apple slices in a large bowl with the fig jam, and lemon juice. Step 6: In a smaller bowl, mix together the sugar, cinnamon, cloves, pepper and salt. Step 7: Pour the sugar mixture over the apple mixture and coat them well. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 375f.

Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, lemons, garlic, extra-virgin olive oil, parmesan, fresh chives, baguette, parmesan shavings
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the tin of artichoke hearts and put them in a food processor with a good squeeze of lemon, the crushed garlic clove, 1 tbsp of the extra virgin olive oil, the Parmesan, a good pinch of salt and plenty of black pepper. Pulse to a chunky purée, scraping down the sides once or twice. Stir in a few snipped chives. This can be made a day ahead and chilled. Step 2: Grill 12 slices of the baguette on each side until golden, rub lightly with the cut garlic clove and brush with the rest of the extra virgin olive oil. Spread generously with artichoke mix, scatter over Parmesan shavings and remaining chives, grind over pepper and serve.

Dish Name: Crostini with pea purée, rocket & broad beans
Ingredient Names: double-podded broad bean, peas, butter, yogurt, leaves from mint, ciabatta, fresh dill, couple handfuls arugula, radish, pecorino cheese, extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the broad beans in a pan of boiling water for 4 mins until just tender. Drain, cool under cold running water, then drain and set aside. In the same pan, fry the peas in half the butter until just cooked. Allow to cool, then blitz with a hand blender or in a food processor with the mint, yogurt and seasoning until smooth. Step 2: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Melt the rest of the butter in a small pan, stir in the dill, then brush over the slices of bread. Bake for 10-12 mins until the bread is crisp and golden. Step 3: Spread some pea purée onto each slice, then top with rocket, broad beans and radishes. Use a potato peeler to shave pecorino on top. Drizzle with olive oil, if you like, before serving.

Ingredient Names: butter, granulated sugar, salt, milk, egg, egg yolk, dark rum, lemon peel, lemon juice, orange peel, all-purpose flour, cooking oil, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, combine butter, granulated sugar, and salt. Step 2: Cover and process until smooth. Step 3: Add milk, egg, egg yolk, rum, lemon peel, lemon juice, and orange peel. Step 4: Cover and process until smooth Scrape bowl, add flour. Step 5: Cover and pulse with several on / off turns until dough is smooth and thoroughly combined. Step 6: Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface and knead, adding additional flour as needed until dough is soft but not sticky Form dough into a ball and wrap in plastic wrap. Step 7: Chill for at least 30 minutes or until dough is easy to handle.

Ingredient Names: dried figs, maraschino cherry, pecans, amaretto, flour, baking powder, sugar, butter, eggs, vanilla, milk, powdered sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: In blender, blend figs, cherries, pecans and amaretto, set aside. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Step 3: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, baking powder and sugar. Step 4: Cut in butter with a pastry blender or a fork. Step 5: Add eggs, vanilla and milk, mix well. Step 6: Roll out strips of dough and cut into 2x4-inch rectangles. Step 7: Place a teaspoonful of filling onto each rectangle. Step 8: Roll so that short ends make the seam and place seam side down on a baking sheet.

Dish Name: Cucidati Fruit And Chocolate Filled Cookie Rolls
Ingredient Names: semisweet chocolate, dried figs, raisins, dried apricots, honey, ground allspice, cinnamon, butter, sugar, egg, lemon, all-purpose flour, baking powder, oranges, water
Instructions: Step 1: For filling: coarsely chop chocolate in processor or food grinder. Step 2: Add all dried fruit and orange peel and chop finely. Step 3: Blend in honey and spices. Step 4: Refrigerate in airtight container 2 hours For pastry: cream butter and sugar with electric mixer. Step 5: Beat in egg and lemon peel. Step 6: Mix in flour and baking powder until smooth dough forms, wrap with plastic. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. Step 8: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: unbleached all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, vegetable shortening, egg, pure vanilla extract, milk, dried fig, dried dates, raisins, honey, cinnamon, orange marmalade, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: For cookie dough, sift flour, baking powder, and salt into a large bowl. Step 2: Add sugar and stir well. Step 3: Cut in the shortening with a fork or pastry blender and work the mixture until it looks like corn meal. Step 4: In a bowl, beat egg, vanilla and milk together. Step 5: Add egg mixture to the flour mixture and mix with an electric mixer for about 3 minutes until well blended Dough will be soft. Step 6: Divide the dough into four pieces and wrap each piece with plastic wrap. Step 7: Refrigerate dough for 45 minutes To make the filling, grind figs, dates and raisins in a food processor until coarse. Step 8: Place chopped figs, dates and raisins in a bowl.

Ingredient Names: sugar, butter, semi-sweet chocolate chips, eggs, vanilla, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, hazelnuts, shortening
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine sugar and butter in large bowl. Step 3: Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until well mixed. Step 4: Add 2 cups melted chocolate chips, eggs and vanilla Continue beating until well mixed. Step 5: Reduce speed to low. Step 6: Add flour, baking powder and salt. Step 7: Beat until well mixed. Step 8: Stir in nuts by hand. Step 9: Divide dough in half.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, heavy cream, sugar, unsweetened cocoa powder, bittersweet chocolate, extra-large egg yolks, coffee liqueur, pure vanilla extract, kosher salt, candies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the milk, cream, and 1 / 2 cup sugar in a 2-quart saucepan, until the sugar dissolves and the milk starts to simmer. Step 2: Add the cocoa powder and chocolate and whisk until smooth. Step 3: Pour into a heat-proof measuring cup. Step 4: Place the egg yolks and the remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and beat on high speed for 3 to 5 minutes, until light yellow and very thick With the mixer on low speed, slowly pour the hot chocolate mixture into the egg mixture. Step 5: Pour the egg and chocolate mixture back into the 2-quart saucepan and cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened A candy thermometer will register about 180f don't allow the mixture to boil! Step 6: Pour the mixture through a sieve into a bowl and stir in the coffee liqueur, vanilla, and salt. Step 7: Place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of the custard and chill completely. Step 8: Pour the custard into the bowl of an ice cream maker and process according to the manufacturer's directions.

Ingredient Names: butter, splenda granular, baking powder, baking soda, salt, egg white, vanilla, almond extract, all-purpose flour, anise seed, fennel seed, dried cranberries, pistachios, dried apricot, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Beat butter in a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Step 2: Add baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Step 3: Beat until combined. Step 4: Beat in the 3 / 4 cup egg whites, vanilla, and almond extract until combined. Step 5: Beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer, adding the splenda with the first two flour additions. Step 6: Stir in any remaining flour The anise and fennel seeds And the cranberries, pistachios, and apricots with a wooden spoon. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or till dough is easy to handle. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: amaretto di saronno liqueur, bacardi limon, cranberry juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour all ingredients into a shaker of cracked ice Strain into a martini glass and garnish with a cherry or lemon slice Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: eggs, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, salt, sugar, instant coffee, chocolate chips, hazelnuts, white chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f Lightly whisk together the eggs and the vanilla extract, set aside. Step 2: Combine the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, salt, sugar, coffee granules, chocolate chips and hazelnuts in the bowl of an electric mixer With the paddle attachment, slowly add the egg mixture on low speed. Step 3: Mix just until the dough comes together With your hands, scrape any dry ingredients from the bottom of the bowl and mix them into the dough On a lightly floured board, roll the dough into 2 logs, each about 12 inches long. Step 4: Place them on a baking sheet. Step 5: Bake until side are firm and the tops are cracked and no longer wet looking, about 20 minute cool to room temperature.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, granulated sugar, pure vanilla extract, whole milk ricotta cheese, all-purpose flour, baking powder, confectioners' sugar, preserves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan or deep fryer, heat 2" of vegetable oil to 375. Step 2: Cover a wire rack with paper towels and place on a baking sheet near your heated oil While the oil is heating, in a large bowl, beat eggs, granulated sugar and vanilla with a wooden spoon. Step 3: Add ricotta and blend until smooth. Step 4: Add flour and baking powder and combine until just blended. Step 5: Using a very small ice cream scoop, melon baller or 2 teaspoons, slide 8 walnut-size balls of fritter batter into the hot oil. Step 6: Fry until deep golden and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 7: Transfer fritters to rack with a slotted spoon to drain Continue frying in batches of 8. Step 8: Arrange on a platter and dust well with confectioners' sugar and / or cinnamon sugar and serve with your favorite preserve.

Ingredient Names: light cane sugar, egg white, almond flour, almond essence, whole pecans
Instructions: Step 1: Stir sugar and egg white until sugar has dissolved Stir in amond flour and almond essence, but be careful: this mixture is too tough for a handmixer! Step 2: I just dump everything in my bread machine and run the 'dough' program for a while until the dough is mixed evenly A good food processor might do the job too -) or just mix it thoroughly with a rubber spatula. Step 3: Spoon the mixture into a cookie press to shape small round cookies or use a small ice cream scoop to form little balls. Step 4: Place cookies 1 / 2 inch apart on greased cookie sheet or silpat. Step 5: Bake for approximately 30 minutes at 300, place on lowest rack setting in your oven for the first 10 minutes Cookies are done when they start to turn lightly golden They will be chewy right after baking but will become very crisp overnight.

Ingredient Names: unbleached all-purpose flour, sugar, salt, active dry yeast, whole milk, unsalted butter, eggs, egg white, egg yolk, lemons, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix together 1 cup flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Step 2: Heat butter and milk to 125-130f With mixer on low, beat warm liquid into flour mixture until well blended Increase speed to medium and continue beating for 2 minutes. Step 3: Beat in 2 eggs, 1 egg white and 1 / 2 cup flour Continue beating for 2 more minutes By hand, stir in lemon peel and 1 to 1 1 / 4 cups flour. Step 4: Place dough on a lightly floured board, and knead for about 5 minutes adding about 1 / 2 to 1 cup flour while kneading. Step 5: Shape dough into a ball and place in a well greased bowl, turn dough to grease the top. Step 6: Cover and let rise in a warm draft free place until doubled.

Ingredient Names: coffee liqueur, cream cheese, powdered sugar, whipped topping, vanilla wafers, cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Whip the cream cheese and then add the liquer and whip some more Next, add the sugar and mix really well Gently stir in the whipped topping. Step 2: Line an 8" dish with nilla wafers and spoon over them some of the cream cheese mixture. Step 3: Keep layering until you've used all the cream cheese mixture Lastly, dust with the cocoa and refrigerate for several hours.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, sour cream, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: Cream butter and sugar together. Step 2: Beat each egg in well one at a time. Step 3: Add sour cream and vanilla. Step 4: Combine dry ingredients in a separate bowl mix well and add to creamed mixture. Step 5: Mix until a dough is formed. Step 6: Turn out onto floured surface, lightly knead and divide into 3 loaves 8-in X 2-1 / 2-in X 3 / 4-in. Step 7: Line two baking sheets with aluminum foil and grease, place loaves onto baking sheets and bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Step 8: Allow loaves on foil to cool on wire rack for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vanilla wafers, hot water, instant coffee, prepared vanilla pudding, whipped topping, cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Crush wafers coarsely into 2 dessert dishes. Step 2: Stir hot water into coffee granules. Step 3: Drizzle over wafers. Step 4: Top each with contents of 1 pudding snack, whipped topping and cocoa powder. Step 5: Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: almonds, unsalted butter, brown sugar, honey, vanilla extract, salt, all-purpose flour, semisweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Line a baking sheet with a silicone liner (such as Silpat®). Step 3: Place almonds into the bowl of a food processor; alternate pulsing and running at full speed every few seconds until finely chopped and crumblike. Step 4: Be careful not to go too far; you don't want them too fine and pasty. Step 5: You can chop the almonds by hand if you prefer but it will take a lot longer. Step 6: Combine butter, brown sugar, and honey in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 7: Stir a few times and cook until melted and dissolved. Step 8: Bring to a boil, then carefully remove from the heat. Step 9: Add vanilla extract, salt, and flour, and whisk until smooth. Step 10: Add chopped almonds and mix with a spatula until everything is combined. Step 11: Drop eight uniformly sized, rounded spoonfuls of batter (each about 5 minutes, or ) onto the prepared sheet. Step 12: Fine-tune the cookie shapes and make sure they are evenly spaced. Step 13: Place in the center of the preheated oven and bake until golden brown and a bit darker around the outsides, 10 to, rotating the pan halfway through. Step 14: Remove from the oven and slide the silicone liner off the baking sheet and directly onto the countertop. Step 15: Allow to sit until cool and crisp, 3 to, then gently peel cookies off the liner. Step 16: Repeat to bake remaining batches. Step 17: Spread melted chocolate over the flat side of one cookie. Step 18: Place a second cookie, flat-side down, on top to make a sandwich and press very gently to seal. Step 19: Repeat to form remaining cookies. Step 20: Let sit until chocolate has firmed up, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, spinach, ricotta, grating nutmeg, ready-rolled puff pastry, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, then drain and thoroughly squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Mix with the ricotta, nutmeg and plenty of seasoning. Step 2: Lay the pastry on a baking sheet and pinch up the edges to form a lip all round. Prick the base all over with a fork, so the pastry doesn’t puff up too much. Bake for 15 mins or until the pastry is light brown. Step 3: Remove from oven and press the pastry down if it has puffed up. Pile in the spinach mix, leaving four clear areas for the eggs to go into. Carefully crack an egg into each space. Season and pop back in the oven for a further 10-15 mins until the white is set and yolk is still a little runny, or to your taste.

Ingredient Names: ripe strawberries, water, white sugar, lemon juice, balsamic vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse strawberries with cold water, then drain. Step 2: Place berries into a blender with water, sugar, lemon juice, balsamic vinegar, and salt. Step 3: Pulse several times to get the mixture moving, then blend until smooth, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Pour into a large baking dish; the mixture should only be about deep in the dish. Step 5: Place the uncovered dish into the freezer until the mixture barely begins to freeze around the edges, about 1 hour, it will still be slushy in the center. Step 6: Keeping the mixture in the freezer, use a fork to lightly stir the frozen crystals from the edges in towards the center; mix thoroughly. Step 7: Close the freezer and continue to chill until granita is nearly frozen, 30 to 40 more minutes. Step 8: Mix lightly again with a fork as before, scraping the crystals loose. Step 9: Repeat freezing and stirring with the fork three to four more times until the crystals are separate and the granita looks dry and fluffy. Step 10: Portion granita into small serving bowls to serve.

Dish Name: Fusilli With Sausage Sun Dried Tomatoes and Vermouth Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, sweet italian sausage links, sun-dried tomatoes oil, sage, kosher salt, ground black pepper, sweet sweet vermouth, chicken broth, heavy cream, fusilli, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: You will need a deep saute pan that can hold the sauce, and the pasta. Step 2: Have all your ingredients ready to go before beginning to cook. Step 3: Heat the oil over medium-high heat and cook the sausage, breaking it up as it cooks, until done. Step 4: Add the sundried tomatoes and toss to combine. Step 5: Season with the salt and pepper. Step 6: Let cook about a minute, then add the sage, toss, and cook another minute. Step 7: Add the Vermouth to the pan and toss with the other ingredients. Step 8: Let reduce about half (about 2-3 minutes), then add the chicken stock. Step 9: Toss and let this reduce about half (about 2 to 3 minutes). Step 10: Add the cream, then let this mixture reduce slightly. Step 11: Taste, adjust for pepper and salt. Step 12: Add the pasta and 1/2 of the cheese to the pan and toss to combine everything thoroughly. Step 13: Serve with the remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: milk, heavy cream, egg yolks, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Mix milk and cream in a medium saucepan. Step 3: Warm until foam forms around the edges, remove from heat. Step 4: Beat egg yolks and sugar until frothy in a large bowl. Step 5: Gradually pour warm milk into egg yolks and sugar, whisking constantly. Step 6: Return mixture to saucepan; cook over medium heat, stirring with a wooden spoon until the mixture gels slightly and coats the back of the spoon. Step 7: If small egg lumps begin to show, remove from heat immediately. Step 8: Pour the mixture through a sieve or fine strainer into a bowl. Step 9: Cover, and chill for 1 hour to overnight. Step 10: Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker, and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions. Step 11: Transfer to a sealed container, and freeze until firm, at least.

Ingredient Names: egg whites, cream of tartar, white sugar, butter, egg yolks, flour, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease a 10-inch cake pan. Step 3: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Step 4: Add sugar gradually, beating until very stiff. Step 5: Cream butter and sugar in a large bowl with an electric beater until light in color. Step 6: Add egg yolks, and beat until thick and fluffy. Step 7: Sift flour, baking powder, and salt over batter; fold in. Step 8: Gently fold in egg whites. Step 9: Pour batter into prepared pan. Step 10: Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 50 to. Step 11: Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then remove to a wire rack to cool completely.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, molasses, all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, ground ginger, baking powder, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 3: Grease a cookie sheet. Step 4: Combine sugar, eggs, oil, and molasses in a large bowl. Step 5: Combine all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, ground ginger, baking powder, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, and ground nutmeg in a separate bowl; stir into sugar mixture until a stiff dough forms. Step 6: Divide dough in half; shape each into a roll the length of the cookie sheet. Step 7: Place rolls on the prepared cookie sheet; pat down to flatten dough until ½-inch thick. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 9: Set aside to cool. Step 10: When cool enough to touch, cut into ½-inch thick diagonal slices. Step 11: Place sliced biscotti on the cookie sheet; bake until toasted and crispy, 5 to on each side.

Dish Name: Granita di Caffe con Panna (Italian Coffee Granita)
Ingredient Names: water, white sugar, espresso coffee, vanilla extract, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water and sugar to a boil in a small saucepan; simmer until a candy thermometer reads 250 degrees F (120 degrees C), about 5 minutes. Step 2: Remove saucepan from heat; add coffee and vanilla. Step 3: Pour into a metal bowl and mix well. Step 4: Cool granita mixture to room temperature, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Freeze for 1 hour. Step 6: Stir the granita vigorously to break up ice crystals. Step 7: Repeat freezing and breaking up process 4 to 5 more times, 2 to 2 1/ total. Step 8: Drop spoonfuls of whipped cream into 4 short glasses. Step 9: Divide granita mixture evenly among the glasses. Step 10: Top with remaining whipped cream.

Ingredient Names: hazelnuts, cream, golden sugar, egg yolks, sweet marsala, chocolate hazelnut spread, instant coffee dissolved water
Instructions: Step 1: Put all sauce ingredients into a small pan, bring to the boil, whisking, then let it cool completely to a silky, thickened sauce. Step 2: Whizz all but 1 tbsp of the nuts in a small food processor until fine. Very roughly chop the rest, then set aside. Softly whip the cream with 1 tbsp sugar. Put the rest of the sugar into a pan, add 100ml water, then slowly heat until the sugar has dissolved. Turn up the heat, boil for 1 min, then take off the heat. Step 3: Line two individual pudding basins or ramekins with cling film. Put the egg yolks and Marsala into a large bowl over a pan of hot water, then whisk until it starts to thicken and get foamy. Keep the beaters running and trickle the sugar syrup into the mix. Keep beating for about 5 mins until the mixture is thick and holds a trail. Take off the heat, then whisk until cooled. Add the cream, whisk again, then fold in the ground nuts with a metal spoon. Step 4: Ripple half the sauce through the mix, spoon into the moulds, then fold the cling film over. Freeze the remaining mix in a tub or make more individual puds, if you like. Freeze for at least 4 hrs or overnight to set. Step 5: Turn onto plates, then let ices sit for 10 mins to soften a little. Scatter over the chopped nuts, then pour a little sauce over to serve.

Ingredient Names: buttermilk, baking soda, butter, shortening, white sugar, large eggs, vanilla extract, flaked coconut, baking powder, all-purpose flour, cream cheese, sugar, heavy cream, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease and line three 9-inch round cake pans with parchment. Step 3: To make the cake: Combine buttermilk and baking soda together in a small bowl; set aside. Step 4: Beat butter, shortening, and sugar together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Step 5: Mix in eggs, buttermilk mixture, vanilla, coconut, baking powder, and flour; stir until just combined. Step 6: Pour batter into the prepared pans. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean, 30 to. Step 8: Cool in the pans for 10 minutes; transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely, 20 to. Step 9: To make the frosting (while cakes are cooling): Beat cream cheese, butter, vanilla, and confectioners' sugar in a medium bowl with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Step 10: Beat in cream, a little at a time, to attain the desired consistency. Step 11: Stir in walnuts and coconut. Step 12: Spread frosting between the cake layers and on the top and sides of cooled cake.

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, italian bulk sweet sausage, olive oil, butter, garlic, mushrooms, flour, chicken stock, heavy cream, italian cheese blend, tomatoes, sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Brown and crumble the sausage. Step 3: Drain on paper towels. Step 4: Return pan to heat and add olive oil, butter, garlic and mushrooms. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Saute 3 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Preheat broiler to high. Step 8: To mushrooms, add flour and stir, cooking 2 mnutes. Step 9: Whisk in stock, then stir in cream. Step 10: Bring cream to a buble, then stir in two cups of 4 cheese blend. Step 11: When cheese has melted, add tomatoes. Step 12: When sauce comes to a buble, remove from head and adjust seasonings, adding hot sauce if desired. Step 13: Combine cheese sauce with sausage and pasta, transfer to a baking dish. Step 14: Sprinklge remaining 1/2 cup 4 cheese blend and the grated Parmesan over the top and brown under hot broiler.

Ingredient Names: almond meal, caster superfine sugar, lemon zest, natural almond extract, salt, fresh cherries, egg whites, honey, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 190°C/375°F (170°C fan). Line 2 trays with baking/parchment paper. Step 2: Combine Dry Ingredients: Place the almond meal, sugar, zest, almond extract and salt in a bowl. Whisk together until zest and almond extract is evenly distributed. Add the cherries and set aside. Step 3: Beat eggs whites: Using an electric mixer or a whisk, beat the egg whites and honey to soft peaks. About 2 minutes on Speed 8 of a handheld beater, or 1 1/2 minutes on Speed 6 of a stand mixer. Step 4: Fold the beaten egg whites gently into the almond mixture. You will seemingly knock most of the air out of the meringue, that's ok! (You actually haven't:) ). Step 5: Place Extra egg white in a small bowl and whisk with a fork until foamy. Place flaked almonds in another bowl. Step 6: Form 2.5cm/1" balls: Scoop up about 1 tablespoon of the mixture and shape into a rough ball (2.5cm/1" ball). I do this using 2 eating spoons - we don't need perfect balls here. Step 7: Coat in egg whites: Drop the ball into foamy egg whites. Use 2 forks to turn to coat, then pick up and place in the flaked almonds. Step 8: Almond coating: Coat cookies with the almonds, pressing them on to cover as completely as you can. Don't worry if you get some double layers or pieces sticking out - no need to be neat or thorough here! Step 9: Bake 13 minutes: Place on prepared tray 2.5cm / 1" apart. Bake for 13-15 minutes until golden brown. Start checking at 12 minutes to be sure the nuts aren’t burning. Step 10: Cool: Transfer to rack to cool completely before serving. Step 11: Store: Store in an airtight container. They last up to 10 days in a storage container or can be frozen.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, white sugar, baking powder, vegetable oil, milk, large eggs, anise extract, confectioners' sugar, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Grease or line cookie sheets. Step 3: Combine flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a large bowl. Step 4: Make a well in the center and add oil, milk, eggs, and anise extract; mix together to form a workable dough. Step 5: Roll dough into walnut-sized balls, flatten slightly, and place apart onto prepared cookie sheets. Step 6: Bake in the preheated oven until edges are golden, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, make the icing: Mix confectioners' sugar, hot water, and anise extract together until smooth. Step 8: Spoon or drizzle over warm cookies and allow to cool completely.

Ingredient Names: confectioners' sugar, butter, egg, vanilla extract, almond extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease a baking sheet. Step 3: Beat together confectioners' sugar and butter with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth. Step 4: Add egg, vanilla, and almond extract; beat until well combined. Step 5: Stir together flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl and mix into butter mixture until just incorporated. Step 6: Shape dough into 1-inch balls and arrange 2 inches apart on the prepared baking sheet. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until firm, about 25-30 minutes. Step 8: Let cookies sit on the sheet for 25-30 minutes before removing to a wire rack to completely cool. Step 9: Spread confectioners' sugar on a plate; roll cooled cookies in confectioners' sugar to coat.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, unsalted butter, white sugar, large eggs, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Grease two baking sheets. Step 4: Combine flour and baking powder in a bowl. Step 5: Beat butter and sugar in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Step 6: Mix in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition, mix in vanilla. Step 7: Gradually stir in flour mixture until well blended. Step 8: Roll walnut-sized portions of dough into small ropes. Step 9: Shape each rope into a loop and press the ends to seal. Step 10: Place 2 inches apart onto the prepared baking sheets. Step 11: Bake in the preheated oven until firm and golden at the edges, 8 to. Step 12: Remove from the oven and cool on a wire rack.

Dish Name: Italian Cream Cheese and Ricotta Cheesecake
Ingredient Names: cream cheese, ricotta cheese, large eggs, white sugar, butter, flour, cornstarch, lemon juice, vanilla extract, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Lightly grease a 9-inch springform pan. Step 4: Mix cream cheese and ricotta cheese together in a mixing bowl until well combined. Step 5: Add eggs, sugar, butter, flour, cornstarch, lemon juice, and vanilla; mix to combine. Step 6: Stir in sour cream and pour into the prepared pan. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 8: Turn the oven off; allow cheesecake to cool in the oven with the door closed for more to prevent cracking. Step 9: Cool cheesecake completely in the refrigerator before serving.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, butter, eggs, milk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, almond extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, sugar, red food coloring, candy sprinkles
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Lightly grease cookie sheets. Step 3: To make the cookies: Beat sugar and butter in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Step 4: Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 5: Stir in milk, oil, vanilla, and almond extract. Step 6: Combine flour and baking powder; stir into milk mixture to form a dough. Step 7: Roll dough into 1-inch balls; roll the balls out on a lightly floured surface into 5-inch long ropes. Step 8: Bring one end over the other, then underneath and through the middle, like a loose knot; place cookies apart on the prepared cookie sheets. Step 9: Bake in the preheated oven until the bottoms of the cookies are golden brown, about on the bottom shelf, then on the top shelf. Step 10: Transfer cookies to a wire rack to cool completely. Step 11: To make the icing: Beat confectioners' sugar, butter, vanilla, and almond extract with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth; beat in milk, one tablespoon at a time. Step 12: Add food coloring and stir until well combined. Step 13: Dip cooled cookies upside down into the icing then sprinkle with candy sprinkles.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, butter, eggs, all-purpose flour, baking powder, vanilla extract, salt, milk, dried figs, raisins, orange, apple, pecans, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dough: Beat sugar and butter together in a medium bowl until light and fluffy. Step 2: Add eggs, vanilla, and salt; mix well. Step 3: Blend in flour and baking powder by hand, then knead dough until smooth and workable. Step 4: Add enough milk to reach a soft, workable consistency. Step 5: (This takes time and effort, but you'll know the dough is ready when it becomes smooth). Step 6: To make the filling: Place chopped figs, raisins, chopped orange, and chopped apple in a food processor; pulse until the mixture is finely chopped but still has texture. Step 7: If the mixture is too dry or thick, mix in up to water, if desired. Step 8: Transfer to a bowl and stir in chopped pecans, ½ cup sugar, and cinnamon, then knead everything together by hand until combined. Step 9: The mixture will be sticky. Step 10: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 11: Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Step 12: Roll out a portion of the dough into a thin sheet on a lightly floured surface. Step 13: Spoon a line of fig mixture down the center. Step 14: Dampen the edges of the dough with water and fold over the filling, sealing fig filling inside. Step 15: Cut the filled strip into 2-inch pieces or to your desired length. Step 16: Make 2 or 3 slits in the top of each cookie to allow steam to escape. Step 17: Arrange cookies on prepared baking sheets; repeat with remaining dough and filling. Step 18: Bake cookies in the preheated oven until edges are golden brown, about 10 to. Step 19: Cool on baking sheet briefly before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, eggs, milk, extra virgin olive oil, unsalted butter, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, lemon zest, grated orange zest, grapes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) with rack in center position. Step 2: Generously butter and flour a 9-inch springform pan, tapping out any excess flour. Step 3: Whisk sugar and eggs together in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment until thick and lemon-colored, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Whisk in milk, olive oil, melted butter, and vanilla extract until blended. Step 5: Sift 1 ½ cups flour, baking powder, and salt into a large bowl; toss in lemon zest and orange zest until evenly coated. Step 6: Stir flour mixture into sugar mixture with a wooden spoon until thoroughly blended. Step 7: Scrape down the sides of the bowl; stir once more.
