Step 8: Set batter aside to allow flour to absorb liquids, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Stir grapes into batter until incorporated; spoon batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth top with a spatula. Step 10: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 11: Sprinkle reserved grapes over top. Step 12: Continue baking until top is a deep golden brown and cake feels quite firm when pressed with a fingertip, about more. Step 13: Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes. Step 14: Run a knife along sides of the pan to loosen cake. Step 15: Release and remove sides of springform pan, leaving cake on the pan base. Step 16: Cool to room temperature. Step 17: Cut into thin wedges to serve.

Ingredient Names: cake mix, milk, vegetable oil, eggs, butter, vanilla extract, cream cheese, confectioners' sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Coat the bottom of a 10-inch springform pan with cooking spray. Step 3: Reserve cake mix for crumb topping; place remaining in a large bowl. Step 4: Add plus milk, oil, and eggs to bowl; beat using an electric mixer until batter thoroughly combined, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Pour into the prepared pan. Step 6: Whisk melted butter and vanilla extract together in a bowl; stir in reserved cake mix until crumbly. Step 7: Sprinkle over cake batter. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 30 to. Step 9: Cool in the pan until room temperature. Step 10: Beat cream cheese, confectioners' sugar, lemon juice, and lemon zest together in a bowl until smooth and creamy. Step 11: Beat cream and remaining confectioners' sugar together in a separate bowl using an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Step 12: Fold cream cheese mixture into whipped cream. Step 13: Remove cake from springform pan. Step 14: Cut cake into 2 layers, horizontally, using a serrated knife. Step 15: Spread cream filling onto bottom cake layer; place top layer over filling. Step 16: Refrigerate cake for at least 1 hour. Step 17: Dust cake with more confectioners' sugar before serving.

Ingredient Names: cake mix, water, eggs, vegetable oil, ricotta cheese, white sugar, vanilla extract, whipped topping
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 3: Combine cake mix, water, 3 eggs, and oil in a large bowl; beat with an electric mixer until well combined, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Pour batter into prepared baking dish, set aside. Step 5: To make the ricotta cheese layer: Combine ricotta cheese, sugar, vanilla, and remaining 4 eggs in a separate bowl; blend well. Step 6: Spread ricotta mixture evenly over the top of the cake batter. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until or toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, about if using a glass baking dish, or 1 ½ hours if using a metal pan. Step 8: Allow cake to cool completely before topping. Step 9: To make the topping: Blend pudding mix and milk until thickened. Step 10: Blend in whipped topping. Step 11: Spread over cooled cake.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, kosher salt, baking powder, baking soda, large eggs, white sugar, extra-virgin olive oil, milk, honey, grated orange zest
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Line the bottom of a springform pan with a round piece of parchment paper and generously grease with olive oil. Step 4: Grease the sides of the pan with olive oil as well. Step 5: Combine flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in a bowl; whisk together until evenly combined. Step 6: Combine eggs, sugar, olive oil, milk, honey, and orange zest in a second bowl. Step 7: Starting slowly at first, whisk together until mixture is smooth. Step 8: Stir in flour mixture until everything is just mixed together and flour has disappeared, do not overmix. Step 9: Pour batter into the prepared pan and tap pan a few times against the work surface to remove any air bubbles. Step 10: Bake in the preheated oven until the cake is browned on the surface and a wooden skewer inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean, 60 to. Step 11: Make sure to not overbake. Step 12: Transfer cake to a wire rack and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Step 13: Loosen edge of the cake by running a knife around the sides of the pan. Step 14: Remove from the pan and allow to cool completely, another 10 minutes. Step 15: Dust with powdered sugar if desired, serve and.

Ingredient Names: butter, white sugar, eggs, ricotta cheese, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, milk, lemon zest, candy sprinkles
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Grease cookie sheets. Step 3: Beat butter and sugar together in a large bowl until light and fluffy. Step 4: Beat in eggs, one at a time, then stir in ricotta cheese and vanilla. Step 5: Combine flour, baking powder, and baking soda; stir into ricotta mixture. Step 6: Drop cookie dough by rounded spoonfuls 2 inches apart onto prepared cookie sheets. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until edge of cookies are golden brown, about 8 to. Step 8: Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet briefly before removing to a wire rack to cool completely. Step 9: To make the frosting: Warm milk, butter, and shortening in a small saucepan. Step 10: Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until solids are melted. Step 11: Remove from heat and gradually stir in the confectioners' sugar and lemon extract. Step 12: Dip each cookie into the icing then dip in colored sugar or sprinkles.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, butter, egg yolks, water, ricotta cheese, lemon rind, orange rind, vanilla, eggs, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To make crust, mix flour and salt in medium bowl. Step 2: Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Step 3: Stir in egg yolk and water. Step 4: Roll out, place crust in 10" glass pie plate and flute the edges. Step 5: For filling, combine ricotta cheese, flour, salt, lemon and orange rinds and vanilla. Step 6: Beat in eggs and add sugar gradually. Step 7: Pour filling into crust and bake at 350° until firm and light brown (approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes).

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, confectioners' sugar, salt, ground almonds, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 3: Place butter, confectioners' sugar, and salt in a large bowl; beat with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy, about 2 to. Step 4: Mix in ground almonds and vanilla. Step 5: Blend in flour gradually until well-combined. Step 6: Shape into balls (or crescents) using about for each cookie; place apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until the edges of the cookies are just browned, 15 to. Step 8: Let sit until slightly cooled, about 10 minutes. Step 9: Roll cookies in remaining confectioners' sugar.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, skinless chicken thigh fillets, pancetta, butternut squash, onions, garlic, marjoram, italian red wine, flour, italian plum tomato, redcurrant, garlic herb, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large flameproof casserole and cook the chicken over a medium to high heat until lightly browned. Lift out on to a plate with a slotted spoon. Tip the pancetta, squash and onion into the pan and cook over a high heat for about 8 minutes, stirring occasionally until beginning to brown. Return the chicken to the pan, add the garlic and marjoram and cook for 1 minute. Keep back 2 tbsp of the wine then pour the rest into the pan and let it bubble for 5 minutes. Step 2: Blend the flour with the reserved wine until smooth. Stir this into the pan with the tomatoes and their juice, the jelly and some salt and pepper. Lower the heat, half-cover with a lid and simmer gently for 30-40 minutes until the squash is just tender. (To prepare ahead, cool then chill at this point up to a day before. You can also freeze it for up to a month. To serve, heat through in the casserole, then continue with step 3.). Step 3: Preheat the oven to 220C/gas 7/fan 200C. Cut the ciabatta into very thin slices and arrange on top of the casserole, so they casually overlap. Drizzle the last tablespoon of olive oil over the ciabatta and sprinkle with the parmesan and a good grinding of black pepper. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve straight from the casserole.

Ingredient Names: floury potatoes, butter, parmesan, pancetta, oregano, quantity beef red wine carrots
Instructions: Step 1: First make the Beef with red wine & carrots. You will need half the finished stew for this recipe. Step 2: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Cook the potatoes in boiling, salted water for 10 mins until almost done. Drain well, then mix with the butter and half the Parmesan. Step 3: In a large saucepan, fry the pancetta or bacon until golden. Stir in the fresh oregano leaves or dried oregano, then add the beef stew and heat through. Tip into an ovenproof dish and top with the cheesy potatoes, overlapping. Sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan and bake for 20 mins until golden and crisp on top. Serve with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, unflavored gelatin, heavy cream, white sugar, lemon zest, orange liqueur
Instructions: Step 1: Place lemon juice in a small bowl and sprinkle the unflavored gelatin over it. Step 2: Let stand for about 10 minutes until gelatin softens. Step 3: Combine heavy cream, sugar, and lemon zest in a saucepan over medium-low heat; bring to a simmer. Step 4: Whisk in gelatin mixture until dissolved. Step 5: Remove from heat and stir in orange liqueur. Step 6: Strain the cream mixture into a medium bowl and divide evenly among small glass bowls or ramekins. Step 7: Place uncovered panna cottas into the refrigerator until set, at least. Step 8: If time permits, cover the bowls with plastic wrap and chill overnight. Step 9: Garnish with remaining lemon zest before serving.

Ingredient Names: from baguette angle, olive oil, garlic, red chile, raw king shrimp butterflied, lemons, fresh cilantro, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the bread and keep warm. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok, then cook the garlic and chilli until sizzling. Step 3: Turn the heat up, add the prawns, then cook until pink. Step 4: Remove from the heat, then add the lemon juice and coriander. Step 5: Season, then serve piled on toast with rocket leaves.

Ingredient Names: ready-made shortcrust pastry, unwaxed lemons, cream, ground almonds, eggs, butter, limoncello liqueur, plums, golden sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Roll out the pastry and use to line a loose-bottomed tart tin, 25cm diameter and about 3.5-4cm deep. Chill for at least half an hour. Step 2: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Line the pastry with greaseproof paper, fill with baking beans and bake blind for 15 mins. Remove beans and paper. Step 3: Put the lemon zest and juice, cream, almonds, sugar, eggs and melted butter in a large bowl and whisk until smooth then stir in the limoncello. Step 4: Put the plums in the pastry case then pour the custard mixture over. Bake for about 20-30 mins until the custard is just set. Allow to cool then dredge with icing sugar before serving.

Ingredient Names: from baguette angle, butter, fig chutney, prosciutto, bocconcini balls, sage leaves, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Spread each slice of baguette with butter. On an un-buttered side, spread over half the chutney, top with a piece of prosciutto and 2 bocconcini halves. Top with a second slice of bread, buttered-side up, then top with a sage leaf and press down slightly. Repeat to make a second sandwich. Step 2: Add a drizzle of oil and a knob of butter to a small pan. Fry the sandwiches over a low heat, turning, until golden and crisp, and the cheese is just melting. Eat immediately.

Dish Name: Mozzarella peppers with chunky Italian dressing
Ingredient Names: red peppers, sundried tomatoes olive oil, olives, anchovy oil, fresh basil leaves, balls buffalo mozzarella, balsamic vinegar, selection antipasti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Cut the peppers in half, scoop out the seeds and white membranes with a spoon and discard. Drizzle the peppers with a little olive oil from the tomato jar, rub all over and season generously. Roast for 20 mins until softened and starting to char. Step 2: Roughly chop the tomatoes and olives, then mix in a small bowl with 2 tbsp oil from the jar. Cut 4 anchovies lengthways, giving 8 thin strips, then add to the bowl along with the basil leaves. Season with black pepper. Keep the rest of the anchovies in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week. Step 3: Take the peppers out of the oven and turn the grill to High. Pour any juice out of the peppers, then spoon in a little of the olive mix. Snuggle a mozzarella half into each pepper and return to the roasting tin. Grill for about 3 mins until the top of the cheese has just softened, but not melted. Put the antipasti on a serving platter and add the peppers. Spoon over the rest of the olive mix and splash with a little balsamic vinegar. Enjoy with bread and a glass of wine.

Ingredient Names: store-bought pie crust, roma tomatoes, italian cheese blend, mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper, fresh basil leaves, walnuts, garlic, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prebake a 9" pie crust according to the package directions until barely golden brown. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400 degree farenheit. Step 3: Remove from oven and add the shredded cheeses, let cool. Step 4: Prepare pesto by grinding together all the ingredients and adding enough oil to form a coarse,thick paste. Step 5: Core tomatoes and slice into 1/2 inch thick rings. Step 6: Salt the slices liberally and place them on paper towels for 30 minutes. Step 7: Press slices to extract all the liquid and wipe off as much salt as possible. Step 8: Assemble the pie: Place the sliced mozzarella onto the cooled pie shell (arrange enough slices to closely fit into the shell). Step 9: All the slices you may have might not be needed. Step 10: Spread the pesto over the mozzarella in a thick layer to coat the cheese well. Step 11: Arrange sliced tomatoes on top and season with salt and pepper. Step 12: Bake for 15 min until cheese melts and pie is golden brown.

Ingredient Names: ciabatta bread mix, garlic butter, eggplants, chestnuts, fresh basil leaves, ready-made tomato pasta sauce, balls mozzarella patted dry
Instructions: Step 1: Make the dough following pack instructions, reserving a few tbsp of the mix for dusting. Heat 2 tsp of the garlic butter in a large frying pan, then cook the aubergine rounds, in batches, for 1-2 mins each side, until golden. Remove and season, then set aside. Add a little more butter and fry the mushrooms until soft, then remove and set aside. Step 2: Lightly butter an 18cm round cake tin, about 4cm deep. Dust a flat surface with the reserved bread mix and roll out two-thirds of the dough to come over the sides of the tin. Line the tin and press the dough into the corners. Leave the sides hanging over. Step 3: Layer up the ingredients, starting with half the aubergine, basil, pasta sauce, mozzarella and mushrooms. Repeat with the remaining ingredients, pushing down well. Roll out the remaining dough to form a lid and put it on top. Pinch together the lid and the sides, twisting them together to form a crusty edge. Wrap well and freeze. Defrost at room temperature for about 8 hrs. Step 4: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Cook pie for 30 mins. Remove from the tin and place on a baking sheet. Brush with garlic butter, then cook for 20 mins more, brushing again with butter before serving.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, ricotta cheese, white sugar, eggs, butter, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, vanilla extract, sour cream, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C) with an oven rack in the middle position. Step 2: Beat cream cheese, ricotta cheese, and sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer until well combined. Step 3: Beat in eggs, one at a time. Step 4: Add butter, flour, cornstarch, and vanilla extract; beat until well combined. Step 5: Fold in sour cream and lemon juice; pour into an ungreased 10-inch springform pan. Step 6: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 7: Turn off oven; leave cheesecake inside the oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 8: Remove cheesecake from the oven; cool completely. Step 9: Run a thin spatula around edges of pan before opening pan to remove cheesecake. Step 10: Serve cold or at room temperature; refrigerate leftovers.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, unsalted butter, dark chocolate, chestnuts, salt, cayenne pepper, vanilla extract, brandy, confectioners' sugar, milk, red food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Cream sugar and butter together with a spatula until light and creamy, set aside. Step 2: Heat an inch of water in a pot set over low heat. Step 3: Melt dark chocolate in a heat-proof bowl placed over the pot. Step 4: Stir with a small spatula. Step 5: Place chestnuts in a food processor; pulse on and off until very finely ground. Step 6: Add chestnuts to the sugar-butter mixture and stir until combined. Step 7: Add salt, cayenne pepper, vanilla extract, and brandy, stir well. Step 8: Pour in the melted chocolate and mix again until filling is well blended. Step 9: Scoop filling onto a silicone-lined baking sheet and smooth out if necessary. Step 10: Cover the balls in plastic wrap and refrigerate while you prepare the white chocolate coating. Step 11: Reserve about 20% of the white chocolate to stir in later. Step 12: Melt the rest in a heat-proof bowl over a pot of simmering water until an instant-read thermometer inserted in to the chocolate reads 105 degree F (41 degrees C). Step 13: Add the reserved white chocolate and stir until melted. Step 14: Place 1 chocolate truffle on a fork and hold it up above the white chocolate coating. Step 15: Spoon on the white chocolate until ball is well coated. Step 16: Use another fork to push the truffle onto a lined baking sheet. Step 17: Repeat with the remaining truffles and coating. Step 18: Place the bowl of coating back over hot water if it chocolate starts to harden. Step 19: Mix confectioners' sugar with enough milk to make a very thick paste that will hold together well. Step 20: Dye it pink with red food coloring. Step 21: Transfer into a piping bag and pipe a small dot on top of each truffle. Step 22: Serve truffles in paper candy cups.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, golden sugar, eggs, polenta, flour, baking powder, juice oranges, orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Line the base and sides of a round 23cm cake tin with baking parchment. Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time and mix thoroughly. Once the mixture is combined, add all the dry ingredients and the zest and juice after you have measured off 100ml for the glaze. Step 2: Transfer the mixture to the tin, spread evenly, then cook for about 45 mins or until a skewer inserted into the centre of the cake comes out clean. Remove from the oven and turn out onto a wire rack to cool. Step 3: To make the glaze, put the juice and sugar in a medium saucepan and bring to the boil. Let it simmer for 5 mins, then remove from the heat and allow to cool. Drizzle the orange glaze over the top of the cooled cake. Serve with Lemon ice cream, below.

Ingredient Names: boxed fruity panettone, mascarpone, oranges, sugar, silver balls, grand marnier
Instructions: Step 1: Make the syrup first. Gently heat all the ingredients together until the sugar dissolves, then boil for 1 min or until just thickened. Leave to cool. Step 2: Meanwhile, trim the rounded top off the panettone (this is cook’s perks for later!), then cut the rest into 4 horizontal slices using a serrated knife. Beat the mascarpone, orange zest and caster sugar together. Step 3: Stack up the slices, drizzling a little of the orange syrup over each piece as you go, and using about 2 tbsp of the mascarpone to sandwich each layer together. Once you’ve finished stacking, cover with the rest of the mascarpone in swirls and whirls – a palette knife is the best tool for the job. Scatter with a few silver balls if you like, then serve straight away, or chill for up to 2 hrs, then scatter with the balls at the last minute.

Ingredient Names: milk, gelatin powder, heavy cream, white sugar, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Pour milk into a small bowl. Step 3: Sprinkle gelatin powder over milk and stir until combined, set aside. Step 4: Stir heavy cream and sugar together in a saucepan. Step 5: Set over medium heat and bring to a boil; watch carefully as the cream can quickly bubble up and boil over. Step 6: Immediately stir gelatin mixture into boiling cream, stirring until completely dissolved. Step 7: Cook and stir for 5 minutes. Step 8: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in vanilla. Step 9: Pour cream mixture into 6 individual ramekins. Step 10: Leave to cool, uncovered, until no longer warm, about 10 minutes. Step 11: When cool, cover with plastic wrap. Step 12: Refrigerate until set, at least but preferably overnight.

Dish Name: Panna Cotta With Fresh Strawberry Sauce
Ingredient Names: milk, gelatin, heavy cream, white sugar, vanilla extract, strawberries, water
Instructions: Step 1: Pour milk into a bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle gelatin over top; let sit until gelatin softens, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Combine cream and ¼ cup sugar in a saucepan over medium heat; stir in gelatin mixture. Step 4: Cook and stir until gelatin completely dissolves, about 5 minutes; add vanilla extract. Step 5: Divide mixture among 6 ramekins; cover and chill at least. Step 6: Combine strawberries, remaining ¼ cup sugar, water, and remaining vanilla extract in a saucepan over medium heat, crushing strawberries with a potato masher while sauce cooks. Step 7: Simmer until sugar has dissolved and sauce has thickened, about 15-20 minutes; cool. Step 8: Remove chilled panna cotta from the refrigerator shortly before serving. Step 9: Dip bottoms of ramekins in warm water to help loosen the custard. Step 10: Run a thin-bladed knife around the inner edge of each ramekin to loosen; invert onto a dessert plate to unmold. Step 11: Spoon strawberry sauce over panna cotta.

Dish Name: Parmesan-baked ricotta with tomato, olive & basil salad
Ingredient Names: ricotta, eggs, parmesan, tomatoes mix colours looks, black olives stones, olive oil, extra-virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, sugar, garlic, basil leaves only
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Beat the ricotta and eggs together, fold in most of the Parmesan, then season to taste. Line a 900g/2lb loaf tin with parchment, then scoop the ricotta into the tin. Level the top, scatter with the remaining cheese, then bake for 35 mins or until set and golden. Let cool, then turn it out. You can do this a day ahead. Step 2: Slice the tomatoes fairly thickly, then very roughly chop the olives. Whisk the olive oils, vinegar, sugar, garlic, olives and seasoning together. Just before you serve, roughly chop a few of the basil leaves and stir most into the dressing. Step 3: To serve, slice the ricotta and put onto plates. Toss the tomatoes with most of the basil and a little dressing. Serve alongside the ricotta, drizzle dressing over and scatter with remaining basil.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, vegetable stock, risotto rice, white wine, parmesan, handfuls pea shoots, extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a large pan, add the onion and gently sweat for about 10 mins until really soft. Meanwhile, put 100g peas into a food processor with a ladleful of stock and whizz until completely puréed. Step 2: Stir the rice into the onion, increase heat to medium and sizzle the rice for 1 min. Pour in the wine, then bubble and stir until completely absorbed. Continue cooking like this, adding a ladleful of stock at a time, and stirring continuously until the rice is tender and has a good creamy consistency – this will take 20-30 mins. Step 3: Stir in the puréed peas, remaining peas, Parmesan and some seasoning, then turn off the heat and leave to stand for a few mins. Give the risotto a final stir, spoon into shallow bowls and top with some pea shoots and a drizzle of olive oil, if you like.

Ingredient Names: basic massoni pizza base for pizza dough, vodka sauce, shucked english peas, penne pasta, additional mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta until al dente- strain and cool down. Step 2: Once pasta is cooled, toss in a bowl with vodka sauce and 1 cup of blanched peas, for the Pizza:. Step 3: Top pizza with pasta mixture and an additional 4oz mozzarella. Step 4: Bake as directed in recipe #537146.

Ingredient Names: almond paste, white sugar, confectioners' sugar, egg whites, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 3: Line 2 cookie sheets with foil; lightly grease the foil with cooking spray. Step 4: Place almond paste and white sugar in a food processor; blend until combined. Step 5: Add confectioners' sugar and 2 egg whites; blend until smooth. Step 6: Whisk remaining 2 egg whites in a small bowl. Step 7: Place pine nuts on a shallow plate. Step 8: With lightly floured hands, roll dough into 1-inch balls. Step 9: Coat balls in egg whites, shaking off excess, then roll in pine nuts, pressing lightly to stick. Step 10: Arrange balls on cookie sheets, and flatten slightly to form a 1 1/2-inch round. Step 11: Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 15 to. Step 12: Let stand on cookie sheets briefly, then transfer to a wire rack to cool.

Ingredient Names: olive oil for, bread mix, flour, mature cheddar, tomato puree, fresh basil, pepper from, pepperoni, ball mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: Oil a 25cm springform tin. Make up the bread mix following pack instructions. Step 2: Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and roll out to an oblong 35 x 22cm using a rolling pin. Spread the tomato purée over the dough (leaving a border of dough plain all the way round), then scatter with the basil, pepper, pepperoni and mozzarella. Step 3: Carefully and firmly roll up from the longest side to make a Swiss roll, then slice evenly into 8 thick pinwheels. Arrange 7 around the edge of the tin and put the eighth in the centre. Cover the tin with cling film and leave in a warm place until well risen. Depending on the heat in the room, this can take up to 1 hr. Step 4: Heat oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 7. Remove the cling film, scatter with the cheddar and bake for 12-15 mins until golden.

Ingredient Names: eggs, white sugar, butter, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Beat eggs and sugar in a large bowl until thick. Step 3: Stir in melted butter and vanilla. Step 4: Sift together flour and baking powder, and blend into the batter until smooth. Step 5: Heat the pizzelle iron, and brush with oil. Step 6: Drop about one tablespoon of batter onto each circle on the iron. Step 7: You may need to experiment with the amount of batter and baking time depending on the iron. Step 8: Bake for 20 to 45 seconds or until steam is no longer coming out of the iron. Step 9: Carefully remove cookie from the iron and repeat with remaining batter. Step 10: Cool completely before storing in an airtight container, serve and.

Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, instant polenta, parmesan, thin-stemmed broccoli, ready mozzarella, semi-dried tomato, garlic, italian pork sausages skins split bite-sized chunks
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. In a large saucepan, bring the stock to the boil. Slowly pour in the polenta, a little at a time, until completely absorbed. Lower the heat, stir quickly for 5 mins, then remove from the heat altogether. Stir in 1 tbsp of the Parmesan, then spread the polenta out on a large parchment-lined baking sheet, so that it’s 2-3cm thick. Step 2: Cook the broccoli in salted water for 2 mins, drain, then rinse under cold water. Step 3: Sprinkle the mozzarella and remaining Parmesan over the polenta, then top with the tomatoes, garlic, broccoli and sausage. Bake for 20 mins until the sausage is browned and the sides of the polenta crisp.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, raw tiger shrimp, olive oil, lemons, garlic, avocados, cherry tomato, green onions, arugula, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in boiling water for 10-11 mins. Just before the end, add prawns and cook through. Drain, cool under cold water, drain and transfer to a big bowl. Step 2: Put the oil, lemon juice and zest, garlic, avocado, tomatoes and spring onions in a separate bowl, then mix well – don’t mash the avocado. Season. Gently toss the mix into the pasta, with the rocket and basil.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, ciabatta focaccia, olive oil, garlic, lemons, parsley leaves, skewers
Instructions: Step 1: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 1 hr before using. If the skewers are really long, use kitchen scissors to halve. On each skewer, thread the tail of the prawn, then a cube of bread, then the top of the prawn so the prawn loops the bread. If the prawns aren’t big enough, just alternate prawns and bread, so each skewer has 2 of each. Drizzle with olive oil and scatter with garlic. The skewers can now be kept in the fridge for several hrs. Step 2: Cook over the hot coals until the bread is toasted. While still on the barbecue, squeeze over the lemon. Then remove, season, drizzle with a bit more oil and scatter with parsley. Arrange on a plate or in a small jar sticking up, with a glass of something light, cold and very fizzy.

Ingredient Names: confectioners' sugar, pumpkin, mascarpone cheese, ricotta cheese, pudding mix, pumpkin pie spice, heavy cream, cannoli shells
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Stir confectioners' sugar, pumpkin, mascarpone cheese, ricotta cheese, pudding mix, and pumpkin pie spice together in a bowl until smooth. Step 3: Beat cream in a chilled bowl with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Step 4: Fold into pumpkin mixture. Step 5: Spoon pumpkin mixture into a resealable plastic bag and snip a 3/4-inch hole in the corner. Step 6: Pipe pumpkin mixture into each cannoli shell. Step 7: Garnish the ends with sprinkles and confectioners' sugar.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, cream, mascarpone, vanilla extract, marsala, sponge fingers, fresh raspberry, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place a heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water with the egg yolks and the sugar in, whisk until pale, creamy and doubled in volume. Remove from the heat and whisk for another 1 min until cool. Step 2: In another bowl beat the cream, mascarpone and vanilla until combined, thick and creamy. Fold or very gently whisk this mixture into the creamy yolks. Step 3: Dip half the sponge fingers into the marsala and arrange over the bottom of a serving dish. Pour over half of the creamy mixture, then top with most of the raspberries. Repeat the layers, then finish by dotting over the remaining raspberries. Cover and chill for at least 2 hrs. Step 4: Dust the tiramisu with icing sugar just before serving in big bowls.

Ingredient Names: unbleached white flour, salt, eggs, water, ricotta cheese, romano cheese, prosciutto, nutmeg, pepper, italian flat leaf parsley, cinnamon, lean ground beef, ground veal, butter, garlic, spinach, loose sweet italian sausage link
Instructions: Step 1: MAKING THE FILLING: Ricotta Filling#1: In a large bowl, blend all filling ingredients together until smooth, set aside filling until needed. Step 2: Ricotta Filling#2: In a large bowl, blend all filling ingredients together until smooth, set aside filling until needed. Step 3: Beef and Spinach Filling: Brown beef and veal in butter with the whole clove of garlic. Step 4: Remove garlic and let meat mixture cool. Step 5: Mix spinach, parsley, eggs, cheese and nutmeg into cooled meat until well blended, set aside filling until needed. Step 6: Sausage Filling: Brown sausage in frying pan, drain fat and allow sausage to cool. Step 7: When sausage has cooled, mix in eggs and cheese, set aside filling until needed. Step 8: MAKING THE RAVIOLI DOUGH: Sift flour and salt together. Step 9: Place flour mixture on a board, making a well in the center of the flour. Step 10: Drop eggs into the flour well, using your hand or a fork, break the yolks and beat eggs slightly. Step 11: Combine the eggs and flour together, gradually adding enough warm water to make a stiff dough. Step 12: Knead dough well, until smooth; cover the dough and let it rest for 15 minutes. Step 13: Cut dough in half and roll each half of the dough out on a floured board, into a very thin sheet (about 1/16 to 1/8 inch thick). Step 14: FILLING THE RAVIOLI: Drop about 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoonfuls of filling about 1 1/2 inches apart all along the dough. Step 15: When the sheet of dough is fully dotted with dabs of filling mixture, cover filling with other sheet of dough. Step 16: Using your fingers, gently press dough between each dab of filling to seal it. Step 17: Cut ravioli into squares with a (zig-zag edged) pastry cutter, or very sharp knife. Step 18: DRYING THE RAVIOLI: Allow ravioli to dry for one hour before cooking. Step 19: COOKING THE RAVIOLI: Drop ravioli into 6 to 8 quarts of boiling, salted water and cook for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until dough is tender. Step 20: Remove cooked ravioli from pot carefully with a skimmer or a large slotted spoon, and drain well. Step 21: Place drained ravioli on a serving platter in layers, alternating layers with your favorite sauce and a sprinkling of grated cheese between each ravioli layer, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butternut squash, garlic, vegetarian parmesan style cheese, lemons, white breadcrumb, sage leaves, cheese-filled ravioli, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the squash for 10 mins until golden, turning the cubes now and then. Add the garlic and fry for 1 min until softened. Add 300ml water, the grated Parmesan, chilli flakes and lemon zest. Stir well, turn the heat down and cook for 3-4 mins. Mash well and season to taste. Step 2: In a small pan, heat the rest of the oil, then stir in the breadcrumbs. Fry until golden, stirring every so often. Stir in the sage. Step 3: Cook the ravioli according to pack instructions (they usually only take a few mins). Drain, then spoon into bowls. Pour over the squash sauce, then sprinkle with sage breadcrumbs.

Ingredient Names: fl chicken, butter, onions, round grain risotto rice such as arborio, red wine merlot is ideal, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the stock in a saucepan and keep it warm at the side of the stove. Melt half the butter in a shallow saucepan or casserole, add the onion with salt and pepper and sauté for 5-7 minutes until soft, but not browned. Stir in the rice and sauté it, stirring constantly, until it absorbs the butter, about 2 minutes. Step 2: Stir in about half the wine with a little salt and pepper and simmer, stirring, until the rice starts to dry, 5-7 minutes. Add a couple of ladlefuls of hot stock and continue simmering, stirring gently but constantly. When the rice dries again and needs more liquid, add the remaining wine. Step 3: Continue cooking, stirring all the time and adding more stock in batches. At the end of cooking, the rice should be tender, still slightly al dente (chewy) and creamy from the starch that has begun to leach from the grains. This will take 25 to 35 minutes and don’t hesitate to use plenty of stock. Step 4: Take the risotto from the heat, add the remaining butter in pieces, and stir it into the rice as it melts. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve the risotto in shallow bowls or on deep plates with a sprinkling of Parmesan. It is best served at once, though it can be kept warm for a few minutes. If necessary, soften it with a little more stock just before serving.

Ingredient Names: yogurt, eggs, canola oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, sugar, limoncello, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Prepare an 8-inch cake pan with cooking spray. Step 3: Whisk together the yogurt, eggs, canola oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, sugar, and limoncello in a large bowl. Step 4: In a separate large bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Step 5: Gently stir the dry ingredients into the wet. Step 6: Do not over mix or the cake will be tough. Step 7: Pour batter into prepared pan. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Step 10: Stir the powdered sugar and limoncello together in a small bowl until smooth. Step 11: Poke small holes all over the top of the still-warm cake with a fork or toothpick. Step 12: Spoon the glaze over the cake and spread with the back of a spoon. Step 13: The glaze will seep into the cake and add moisture.

Ingredient Names: eggs, white sugar, vanilla extract, ricotta cheese, semisweet chocolate chips, all-purpose flour, baking powder, shortening, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: To make the filling: Beat eggs, sugar, and vanilla together in a large bowl. Step 3: Stir in ricotta cheese and chocolate chips; set aside. Step 4: To make the crust: Combine flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a large bowl; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Step 5: Mix in beaten eggs and vanilla. Step 6: Divide dough into 4 balls, wrap in plastic, and chill for at least 1 hour. Step 7: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 8: Grease two 9-inch, deep-dish pie plates. Step 9: Working with 1 dough ball at a time (keeping remaining dough chilled), roll out 2 dough balls and use them to line the bottoms and sides of the prepared pie plates. Step 10: Try not to make the crust too thick, as it will expand during cooking. Step 11: Working with 1 dough ball at a time (keeping remaining dough chilled), roll the remaining 2 dough balls out into 10-inch circles for the lattice tops, chilling dough for about if it becomes difficult to handle. Step 12: Pour ricotta filling evenly into pie crusts. Step 13: Start with the longest strips of dough and lay the first 2 in an X in the center of the pie. Step 14: Alternate horizontal and vertical strips, weaving them in an over-and-under pattern. Step 15: Use the shortest strips for the edges of the lattice. Step 16: Fold the ends of the lattice strips under the edge of the bottom crust and flute the crust; brush lattice top with milk. Step 17: Arrange foil on edges of crust. Step 18: Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to; remove foil. Step 19: Rotate pies on the rack so they will bake evenly. Step 20: Continue to bake until a knife inserted in the center of each pie comes out clean, 25 to more. Step 21: Cool completely on wire racks. Step 22: Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Dish Name: Ricotta toasts with rocket & pine nut salsa
Ingredient Names: anchovy fillets from, wild arugula, basil leaves only, capers brine, lemon half, extra-virgin olive oil, pine nuts, ricotta, sourdough bread
Instructions: Step 1: Put the anchovies, garlic, rocket, basil leaves, capers, lemon zest, juice and olive oil into a food processor and pulse until you have a slightly chunky, bright green sauce. Stir most of the pine nuts through the sauce, spoon into a serving bowl and scatter the remaining pine nuts over the top. Step 2: Put the ricotta into a mixing bowl, season, then whisk until it becomes billowy and soft. Spoon into a serving bowl, drizzle over a little olive oil and add a grind or two of black pepper. Step 3: When you’re ready to eat, heat the grill to high. Cut thin slices of bread, each big enough for a couple of bites. Spread evenly over a baking sheet and grill for 2 mins on each side until golden and crisp. Drizzle a little oil over each piece of toast, sprinkle with a little flaky sea salt, then serve with the ricotta and salsa.

Ingredient Names: sourdough bread, olive oil, ricotta, fresh figs, prosciutto, clear honey
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a griddle pan to hot. Brush sourdough with olive oil, then grill for 1-2 mins on each side until lightly charred. Step 2: Spread the toasts with ricotta. Top with figs and prosciutto. Drizzle with honey before serving, if you like.

Dish Name: Rustic courgette, pine nut & ricotta tart
Ingredient Names: olive oil, zucchini, ricotta, eggs, fresh basil leaves, grating nutmeg, parmesan, garlic, block puff pastry, flour, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan. Sizzle the courgettes for 5 mins until golden around the edges, then set aside. In a bowl, beat the ricotta with the eggs, basil, nutmeg, half the Parmesan and the garlic. Set aside. Step 2: Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface to a rough round about 40cm wide, then transfer to a baking tray. Spread the pastry with the ricotta mix, leaving a 4cm border. Press the courgette slices into the ricotta, then scatter over the pine nuts and remaining Parmesan. Step 3: Bring the sides up over the edge of the ricotta, pinch to encase the filling, then bake for 30 mins until the filling is puffed up and golden. Leave to cool slightly and enjoy warm or cold with a crisp green salad.

Ingredient Names: eggs, white sugar, vanilla extract, salt, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Line three jelly roll pans with parchment paper. Step 3: Prepare a pastry bag with a size 6 tip (). Step 4: Separate the eggs. Step 5: Whisk the egg yolks with 1/2 of the sugar and all of the vanilla. Step 6: Beat until very light colored. Step 7: This will take about 2 minutes. Step 8: In a clean bowl, beat the egg whites until they hold soft peaks. Step 9: While beating, slowly add the salt and the remaining sugar until combined. Step 10: Gently fold the beaten egg whites into the egg yolk mixture. Step 11: Sift the flour over the egg mixture and gently fold it in. Step 12: Fill the pastry with half of the batter and pipe 3 fingers, 1 1/2 inches apart, in rows on the parchment paper. Step 13: Continue with the second half of the batter in the same manner. Step 14: Bake at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for about 25-30 minutes until firm to the touch and golden. Step 15: Remove the paper and fingers from the baking sheet and place on racks to cool. Step 16: After cooling, remove fingers from the paper and use, or store between layers of wax paper in a airtight container. Step 17: These freeze well.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, eggs, white sugar, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, baking powder, vegetable oil for frying, honey, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ricotta, eggs, sugar, and vanilla together in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix flour and baking powder together in a small bowl; fold into ricotta mixture. Step 3: Add enough remaining flour to make a thick batter. Step 4: Let rest for 10 minutes. Step 5: Heat oil in a large, heavy saucepan over high heat until a small amount of batter dropped in oil sizzles and starts to color. Step 6: Working in batches if necessary, drop teaspoonfuls of batter into hot oil and deep-fry until golden. Step 7: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Step 8: Stack sfingi on a serving platter in a pyramid. Step 9: Drizzle stack with honey and dust with confectioner's sugar.

Ingredient Names: bread flour, semolina flour, kosher salt, water, honey, ricotta cheese, white sugar, large egg, candied orange peel, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, unsalted butter, lard, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Make the dough: Mix bread flour, semolina flour, and kosher salt together in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix in water and honey; the dough will be very dry, like pasta. Step 3: If there is still dry flour after a few minutes of mixing, add up to more water to ensure all flour is moistened. Step 4: Turn dough out onto a work surface and knead for a few minutes until smooth, firm, and not tacky. Step 5: While you want a firm dough, it must still be workable. Step 6: Divide dough into four pieces and flatten. Step 7: Cover dough with plastic wrap when not working with it. Step 8: Run each piece through a pasta machine on its widest setting a dozen or so times, folding it in half and rotating the sheet 45 degrees each time. Step 9: Dust with flour very sparingly, only if needed to prevent tearing. Step 10: Repeat with remaining dough pieces. Step 11: Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 12: Meanwhile, make the filling: Blend ricotta cheese in a food processor until smooth. Step 13: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan, then stir in sugar. Step 14: Sift in semolina flour, whisking to avoid clumping; it will immediately thicken up. Step 15: Reduce the heat to low, fold in blended ricotta, and cook for 2 more minutes, stirring constantly. Step 16: Remove from the heat and transfer filling to the food processor. Step 17: Add egg yolks, one at a time with the processor running, until fully combined. Step 18: Add orange peel, vanilla, and cinnamon, then pulse to mix. Step 19: Transfer filling to a bowl and cool to room temperature. Step 20: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Step 21: Divide each dough piece into four smaller pieces and cover with plastic wrap. Step 22: Place clean kitchen towels over a work surface so you can lay each sheet of dough on the towels while you roll out the remaining sheets. Step 23: Run each piece of dough through a pasta machine on progressively smaller settings until dough is as thin as possible. Step 24: After running it through the machine, stretch each sheet as wide as you can without tearing. Step 25: Dough sheets should stretch to three times their original width and be so thin you can see through them. Step 26: Melt butter and lard in a saucepan. Step 27: Place a sheet of parchment paper onto a work surface, and place the first sheet of pastry onto the parchment. Step 28: Brush pastry with butter mixture. Step 29: Place the second sheet above the first, overlapping or so. Step 30: Roll sheets up into a tight cylinder, leaving about to overlap the next sheet. Step 31: Place the third dough sheet onto the parchment, overlapping the second sheet, and brush with butter mixture. Step 32: Continue rolling up the log of dough, repeating until all dough pieces are brushed with butter mixture and rolled. Step 33: Wrap dough log in the parchment sheet, then wrap entirely with plastic wrap. Step 34: Refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 35: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 36: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 37: Transfer chilled filling to a pastry bag or a 1-gallon zip-top bag with the corner snipped off. Step 38: Cut dough log into 1/2-inch slices; you should have. Step 39: Holding it in both hands, use your thumbs to flatten each slice from the center outwards, then shape it into a cone. Step 40: Pipe some filling into the center, close partially, and repeat to form remaining pastries. Step 41: Bake in the preheated oven until dough turns golden brown and starts to peel back from the pastries, 20 to, basting a couple of times with any leftover butter mixture if desired. Step 42: Serve warm pastries dusted with confectioners' sugar.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, cherry tomato if, fresh basil leaves, capers, olives, olive oil, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions. Step 2: Scoop out a small cup of the cooking water, then drain the pasta. Step 3: Tip the remaining ingredients into the cooking pan, then toss together with spaghetti and loosen with a little of the cooking water, if needed.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, garlic, thyme, olive oil, nutmeg, up to flour, parmesan, butter, sage leaves, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Tip the squash into a roasting tray. Toss with the garlic, thyme and olive oil, then season. Cover the dish with foil and roast for 40 mins until soft. Leave to cool slightly. Step 2: When the squash is cool enough to handle, remove the flesh and use a spatula to force it through a fine sieve. Tip into a clean pan, then gently cook for 30-40 mins until reduced to a dense mass that comes away from the sides of the pan. Leave to cool. Step 3: You will have around 175g once cooked down. Tip purée into a bowl, then season with the nutmeg, salt and pepper. Mix in the egg, flour and 65g of the parmesan. You should have a soft pliable dough so, if it’s too wet, add more flour until it’s the right consistency. Step 4: Take a third of the dough and, on a floured surface, roll into a long strip about the thickness of your thumb. Cut the strip into little pillows about 3cm long, then press each one gently with the back of a fork. repeat with the remaining dough. Step 5: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, then drop in the gnocchi in batches. Cook until they float, then give them a minute more before scooping out and putting them in a bowl of iced water. When they’re all cooked, drain well. Step 6: To serve, heat a grill to high. Melt the butter in a large pan until sizzling, then throw in the chilli and sage – sizzle for a minute before throwing in the gnocchi and tossing through. tip into a heatproof dish, scatter with parmesan, flash under the grill until browned, then serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: eggs, white sugar, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, baking powder, all-purpose flour, honey, rainbow nonpareil sprinkles
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Beat eggs, white sugar, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract together in a bowl; stir in baking powder. Step 3: Slowly stir flour into egg mixture, about at a time, adding more flour if needed, until the dough is firm enough to roll into balls. Step 4: Roll dough into small balls. Step 5: Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) or until you see little waves on the bottom of the saucepan. Step 6: Working in small batches, fry dough balls in hot oil until lightly browned, 2 to per batch. Step 7: Transfer struffoli to a paper towel-lined plate using a slotted spoon. Step 8: To make the sweet glaze: Heat honey in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Step 9: Slowly mix sugar, a few tablespoons at a time, into honey until sugar is melted and glaze is smooth, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Transfer struffoli to a large bowl and pour glaze on top; toss quickly to evenly coat before glaze hardens. Step 11: Arrange struffoli into a tower shape or Christmas tree shape on a serving plate. Step 12: Sprinkle nonpareil sprinkles over struffoli.

Ingredient Names: trompetti, olive oil, onions, plump garlic, pickled cherry peppers, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan, then fry the onion over a medium-high heat for 5-6 mins, stirring occasionally, until golden and softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for a further 2-3 mins. Drain the peppers, reserving their juice, then stir into the onion. Cook for 2-3 mins to heat through. Blitz the mixture in a food processor, with 75ml/2½fl oz reserved juice from the peppers and 75ml/2½fl oz cooking liquid from the pasta, to make a chunky sauce. Step 3: Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Add the pepper mixture, then season to taste. Toss with the rocket or watercress while still hot, so it just begins to wilt, then serve.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, pumpkin seeds, goat's cheese, semolina, chili oil, pasta flour, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: For the filling, bake, steam or microwave the potatoes, then roughly mash. Mix with the pumpkin seeds and goat’s cheese. Step 2: For the pasta, place the flour and a pinch of salt in a food processor and crack in the eggs. Pulse until mixture forms sticky-looking crumbs. Turn the mixture out onto a lightly floured surface and bring together to form a firm dough. Knead for 5 mins until the dough feels smooth, wrap in cling film and chill for 30 mins. To make by hand, shape flour into a ‘ring’ on a work surface, crack eggs into the middle, then gradually work the flour into eggs using your fingers. Step 3: Cut the pasta into quarters, then roll out each piece using a pasta machine. Dust with flour as you go and move it down a notch onto a thinner setting every second roll. Continue until you get to the penultimate setting. If you like your pasta very thin and delicate, you can go for the thinnest setting. If you don’t have a machine, use a heavy rolling pin to roll the dough as thinly as possible. Step 4: Stamp out rounds using a ravioli cutter or a 6cm biscuit cutter – work quickly so the pasta doesn’t dry out. Lay the circles on a semolina-dusted surface and cover with cling film as you cut the rest. Step 5: Place a small tsp of filling in the centre of each round. Dampen the edges with water, then sandwich another round on top. Use your fingertips to seal the edges, trying to expel all the air as you go. Lay the ravioli on a semolina-dusted tea towel to dry for a few mins. Step 6: Cook ravioli in a large pan of gently boiling salted water for 4-5 mins. Do not use a full rolling boil as it is likely to make ravioli split. Drain, and serve with a little chilli oil, Parmesan and pumpkin seeds.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, white sugar, milk, heavy cream, vanilla extract, mascarpone cheese, rum, unsweetened cocoa powder, ladyfingers
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Whisk egg yolks and sugar together in a medium saucepan until well blended. Step 3: Whisk in milk and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil. Step 4: Boil gently for 10 minutes, then remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Step 5: Cover tightly and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Step 6: Beat cream and vanilla in a medium bowl with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Step 7: Remove egg yolk mixture from the refrigerator; add mascarpone cheese and whisk until smooth. Step 8: Combine coffee and rum in a small bowl. Step 9: Split ladyfingers in half lengthwise and drizzle with the coffee mixture. Step 10: Arrange 1/2 of the soaked ladyfingers in the bottom of a 7x11-inch dish. Step 11: Spread 1/2 of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers, then spread 1/2 of the whipped cream over top. Step 12: Repeat layers once more. Step 13: Sprinkle cocoa powder over top. Step 14: Cover and refrigerate until set, 4 to.

Ingredient Names: cake mix, water, egg whites, vegetable oil, instant coffee, mascarpone cheese, sugar, heavy cream, unsweetened cocoa powder, semisweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Gather the ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Grease and flour three 9-inch pans. Step 4: To make the cake: Beat cake mix, water, egg whites, and oil in a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until well combined, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Divide 2/3 of the batter between 2 prepared pans. Step 6: Stir instant coffee into remaining batter; pour into the remaining prepared pan. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of cakes comes out clean, 23 to. Step 8: Cool cakes in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely. Step 9: To make the syrup: Combine brewed coffee and coffee liqueur in a measuring cup; set aside. Step 10: To make the filling: Beat mascarpone, confectioners' sugar, and coffee liqueur in a medium bowl with an electric mixer on low speed until smooth. Step 11: Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator to keep cool. Step 12: To make the frosting: Beat cream, confectioners' sugar, and coffee liqueur in a medium bowl with an electric mixer on medium-high speed until stiff. Step 13: Fold frosting into chilled filling until combined. Step 14: Store frosting and filling, covered, in the refrigerator to keep cool. Step 15: To assemble the cake: Place 1 plain cake layer on a serving plate. Step 16: Using a thin skewer, poke holes in cake, about apart. Step 17: Pour 1/3 of the coffee syrup over cake, then cover with 1/2 of the filling. Step 18: Top with coffee-flavored cake layer; poke holes in cake. Step 19: Pour another 1/3 of the coffee syrup over cake and cover with remaining filling. Step 20: Top with remaining cake layer; poke holes in cake. Step 21: Pour remaining coffee syrup on top. Step 22: Spread sides and top of cake with frosting. Step 23: To garnish the cake: Place cocoa powder in a sieve and lightly dust top of cake. Step 24: Run a vegetable peeler down the edge of chocolate square to form curls. Step 25: Scatter chocolate curls over cake. Step 26: Chill cake in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

Dish Name: Tiramoussa Semifreddo – Frozen Italian Coffee Dessert
Ingredient Names: egg yolks, instant dark roast coffee, marsala wine, white sugar, salt, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine egg yolks, instant dark roast coffee, marsala wine, and sugar in a metal bowl and whisk together until smooth. Step 3: Place bowl in the top of a double boiler over lightly simmering water. Step 4: Whisk constantly until mixture thickens and drippings from the whisk form ribbons on the surface that are visible for 1/2 second to 1 second, about 5 minutes. Step 5: If you are "brave", you can set the bowl directly over medium-low heat and thicken the egg cream that way, but you have to be careful so you don't end up with scrambled eggs. Step 6: This last method is slightly faster and will take about 6 to. Step 7: Beat egg whites in a glass, metal, or ceramic bowl until foamy. Step 8: Gradually add salt and continue to beat until stiff peaks form, set aside. Step 9: Beat heavy cream in a chilled glass or metal bowl with an electric mixer until medium-stiff peaks form. Step 10: Using a spatula, fold in egg yolk mixture until combined. Step 11: Add half of the egg whites and fold in until combined. Step 12: Then fold in remaining egg whites until well combined. Step 13: Transfer mixture into small jam jars and close with lids. Step 14: Freeze for 1 hour or overnight, garnish and.

Ingredient Names: almonds, pistachios, honey, white sugar, large egg whites, salt, lemon zest, vanilla extract, wafer paper
Instructions: Step 1: Line an 8x11-inch baking dish with plastic wrap, allowing ends to hang over the sides. Step 2: Place 1 sheet wafer paper in the bottom of the lined dish. Step 3: Place almonds and pistachios in a warm place to make them easier to mix in at the end. Step 4: Pour honey into a heavy-bottomed pot. Step 5: Add plus sugar; cook over low heat with a spatula, stirring constantly, until mixture turns from grainy to silky and smooth, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Remove the pot from heat. Step 7: Place egg whites and salt in a mixing bowl. Step 8: Whisk until whites form soft peaks, 3 to. Step 9: Place the pot with honey mixture back on low heat. Step 10: Gradually whisk 1/4 of the whipped egg whites into honey mixture; whisk in remaining egg whites in 3 more batches. Step 11: Continue cooking over low heat, stirring constantly with a spatula, until mixture turns a brighter white and a ribbon of mixture sits on the surface for 4 or 5 seconds before it disappears, about 5 minutes. Step 12: You can add a few drops of mixture to a small bowl of ice cold water to test the consistency; ideally it should feel like firm clay. Step 13: Whisk in lemon zest and vanilla. Step 14: Add warm almonds and pistachios; stir to incorporate evenly. Step 15: Transfer nougat mixture to the prepared baking dish; smooth the top with a clean, oiled spatula. Step 16: Top nougat with remaining sheet wafer paper, shiny-side up. Step 17: Lay plastic wrap over the top and press down evenly, tamping mixture down gently but firmly. Step 18: Remove top plastic wrap. Step 19: Allow nougat to sit at room temperature until cool, firm, and ready to cut, 1 or. Step 20: Lift the edges of overhanging plastic wrap to release nougat from the baking dish. Step 21: Invert and remove plastic wrap from the bottom. Step 22: Trim off the edges if plastic wrap is hard to remove. Step 23: Cut torrone into 1-inch squares using a sharp serrated knife.

Ingredient Names: dark chocolate, unsalted butter, almond flour, unsweetened cocoa powder, coffee liqueur, kosher salt, cayenne pepper, large eggs, granulated sugar, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Generously grease an 8-inch cake pan with butter, and place a round piece of parchment paper in the bottom. Step 3: Dust the inside and sides with cocoa powder and knock out excess, set aside. Step 4: Place chocolate and butter in a mixing bowl, and place on top of a saucepan filled with of water. Step 5: Place on low heat until the butter and chocolate have melted. Step 6: Remove from heat, and stir together with a spatula. Step 7: Stir in almond meal, cocoa powder, coffee liqueur, salt, and cayenne until fully combined, set aside. Step 8: Combine eggs and sugar in a second bowl, and beat with an electric mixer, or whisk by hand until very thick and pale colored. Step 9: Pour chocolate mixture into the egg mixture; fold in gently with a spatula until just combined. Step 10: Transfer batter into the prepared pan. Step 11: Tap pan on the counter to settle the mixture. Step 12: Bake in the preheated oven until a wooden skewer inserted near the center comes out almost clean, 25 to. Step 13: Let cool for in the pan before turning out onto a plate. Step 14: Let cool to room temperature, before wrapping and transferring into the fridge to chill before serving. Step 15: Before cutting, the top can be dusted with cocoa and/or powdered sugar if desired. Step 16: Serve with unsweetened whipped cream and fresh raspberries.

Dish Name: Trio of Bruschetta: Lemon Cannellini Bean
Ingredient Names: crusty bread like sourdough, garlic, virgin olive oil, cannellini beans, half lemon, lemon juice, parsley, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a griddle pan or barbecue (grill side, not hotplate side) on high. Step 2: Place bread on the barbecue or griddle pan, and cook each side until nicely toasted and golden brown with char lines. You can also toast the bread in a toaster or grill/broil. Step 3: Remove from heat and rub the surface of the bread lightly with the garlic. Step 4: Combine ingredients in a small bowl. Mash about half the beans with a fork - leave some of the beans whole for a bit of texture. Step 5: Taste first before seasoning with salt and pepper (saltiness of beans depends on brand). Step 6: Spread topping onto bread. Garnish with extra parsley, drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: mini ciabatta, garlic, butter, parsnip, truffle oil, olive oil, arugula leaves, parmesan shavings
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a griddle pan and toast the bread for about 2 mins on each side until golden and marked. Rub the cut side of the garlic clove over each piece. Step 2: Heat the butter in a large frying pan. Add the parsnips, season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, then cook over a medium heat, shaking regularly until golden and softened, about 20 mins. Add a splash of water if you need to. Remove from the heat and whizz to a purée in a food processor with both of the oils. Season to taste. Set aside at room temperature if serving on the day. Can be chilled up to two days ahead. Step 3: To serve, top the toasts with the truffled parsnip mix (it should be room temperature), scatter with rocket leaves and parmesan shavings, then drizzle with a little more olive oil or truffle oil.

Dish Name: Walnut & stilton orzotto with roasted squash & Port sauce
Ingredient Names: walnut halves, vegetable stock, sunflower oil, unsalted butter, banana shallots, garlic, pearl barley, champagne, stilton, banana shallot, juniper berries, cinnamon half, star anise, black, nutmeg, tawny port, redcurrant jelly, butter, butternut squash, ground cinnamon, light muscovado sugar, watercress leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the 100g walnuts in water overnight. Strain through a sieve, put in a pan and cover with 300ml water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 15 mins. Strain again, return to the pan with the stock and bring to the boil. Pour into a blender, blend on medium for 5 mins, then strain back into the pan. Set aside until step 4. Step 2: Make the sauce: soften the shallot in the oil over a gentle heat for 10 mins. Stir in the spices and stock, increase the heat and reduce by three-quarters. Pour in the Port and gently simmer for 20 mins. Strain into a clean pan and reduce over a high heat until thickened, about 10 mins. Set aside. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Step 3: For the squash, heat the butter in an ovenproof pan. Fry the squash for 3-4 mins, then stir in the walnuts with the cinnamon, sugar and a pinch of salt. Roast for 15-20 mins or until tender. Keep warm. Step 4: Meanwhile, make the orzotto. Warm the walnut stock. Heat the oil and 25g butter in a large, deep pan, add the shallots and soften for 10 mins, but don’t colour. Stir in the garlic and cook 3-4 mins more. Remove from the pan, set aside, then wipe the pan clean. Increase the heat, tip in the barley and toast for 2-3 mins, keeping it moving so it doesn’t burn. Quickly stir the shallots and garlic back into the pan with the barley, then pour in the Champagne. Stir well and add a ladleful of warm walnut stock. Lower the heat a little and keep adding stock when the orzotto looks ‘thirsty’, stirring occasionally to prevent it from sticking to the pan. (You’ll need about 500ml stock in total. Make up the amount with vegetable stock if necessary.) Cook until the barley is tender – 35-40 mins (you have a lot more grace with this than with rice, as it retains its bite for longer). Step 5: When cooked, add another half ladle of stock (to stop the orzotto from thickening as it cools), then stir in the stilton and a knob of butter. Stir and season, remembering stilton can be very salty. Step 6: To serve, reheat the sauce, adding a little more Port if it is too thick, then stir in the redcurrant jelly until dissolved and finish with the butter. Spoon some sauce over each plate and top with a few spoonfuls of orzotto. Garnish with the roasted squash and walnut halves, a few small pieces of stilton and leaves.

Ingredient Names: tortellini, sweet butter, westphalian ham, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, fresh chives, peas, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare tortellini according to directions on package. Step 2: In a sauce pan, melt butter. Step 3: Add ham and saute for one minute. Step 4: Add the rest of the ingredients, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Add cooked tortellini and mix well. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, golden sugar, white wine not too dry, marsala, cream, panettone, black cherry well, cocoa powder for sifting, holly
Instructions: Step 1: For the zabaglione cream, put the egg yolks and sugar into a large bowl. Whisk with an electric hand beater for 2 mins until lighter in colour and falling in thick ribbons. Continue to beat while gradually pouring in the wine, then the marsala. Pour this into a medium, preferably non-stick saucepan. Stir over a lowish heat until it thickens. It takes 5-7 mins, by which time it should thickly coat the back of the spoon and be light and frothy. Pour into a bowl and chill for 45 mins, or better still, overnight. Step 2: Meanwhile, slice the panettone and lay it in overlapping slices on the bottom (not up the sides) of a 20cm loose-bottomed, round cake tin (5.5cm deep), pressing the slices down so they completely line the base (you are creating a panettone layer). Drizzle over the 3-4 tbsp of marsala, so each slice gets a little bit, and let it soak in. Tip the drained cherries onto kitchen paper and pat dry (if they are too wet the panettone will go soggy when it thaws), then halve each one to make it easier to cut later. Step 3: Whip the cream into soft peaks and fold it into the cold marsala mixture. If it all seems a bit lumpy, give it a quick beat with a wire whisk. Pour the zabaglione cream over the cherries and give it a few swirls so it is slightly undulating on top. Step 4: Open-freeze until firm, then cover with cling film and foil, and freeze for up to 1 month. Step 5: When ready to use, unwrap and thaw in the fridge for about 2-2½ hrs (it should be quite moussey), then serve, generously dusted with sifted cocoa powder and topped with holly. Serve cut in wedges.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, italian sausage, olive oil, white onion, bottled garlic, sugar, paprika, dried parsley, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic powder, bay leaves, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown sausage in pan, crumbling with spatula, until no pink remains, drain and rinse. Step 2: Put into a 5 quart crockpot. Step 3: Saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent and golden but not brown. Step 4: Add all the spices and mix well. Step 5: Turn off the heat and let the spices mingle for about 10 minutes The heat will let the oils release from the dried herbs. Step 6: Add the tomato sauce and spice mixture to the meat in the crockpot and stir to mix. Step 7: Cook on high for 1 hour and then low for 7-8 hours Use over pasta.

Ingredient Names: pepperoni, ground beef, mild italian sausage, butter, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, mozzarella cheese, provolone cheese, pizza sauce, kaiser rolls
Instructions: Step 1: To a food processor, add the sliced pepperoni. Step 2: Mix until most of the pepperoni is ground up, pulsing as you go. Step 3: Add the ground beef and sausage Form meat into 4 patties To a large skillet over medium / med-high heat, melt the butter and olive oil until butter is melted If using mushrooms, saute them until done, 1-2 minutes. Step 4: Remove with slotted spoon and set aside. Step 5: Add the patties to the pan and cook 4-5 minutes per side until cooked thru Pat the burgers down with the spatula as needed to retain a wide burger. Step 6: When burgers are just about done, place mushrooms on burgers, then 1 slice each of the cheeses on top of each burger.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, black olives, white onion, red bell pepper, pepperoni, portabella mushrooms, mozzarella cheese, pizza sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cover the top of your pizza stone or, if you dont have one, the inside of a cookie sheet with a good dusting of flour 2 Pre-heat your oven to 425 degrees f 3. Step 2: Pour 3 tablespoons of evoo into a small bowl 4. Step 3: Cut out a chunk of your 5-minute bread dough, big enough to be the size somewhere in between a baseball and a softball 5 With your fingers flatten the dough to fit on top of your pizza stone or cookie sheet.

Ingredient Names: powdered milk, ground cinnamon, sugar, cocoa powder, bittersweet chocolate, marshmallows
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the dry ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Step 2: Take the bittersweet chocolate and roughly chop it up to give a chunky but consistent size. Step 3: Mix well with a wooden spoon and then store in a dry airtight container To make the hot chocolate, simply add 1 cup of water per 1 / 2 cup of hot cocoa mix. Step 4: Heat in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring with a whisk. Step 5: Heat until hot, but do not boil, about 6 to 7 minutes. Step 6: Serve with marshmallows.

Ingredient Names: vanilla vodka, amaretto liqueur, cointreau liqueur, tia maria, espresso
Instructions: Step 1: Shake all ingredients in a shaker of ice Pour into a chilled martini glass Garnish with three floating espresso beans Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: rosemary sprigs, sage leaves, garlic clove, juniper berries, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Strips the green leaves off the rosemary sprigs and add them to the rest of the ingredients, except the pepper, on a chopping board and chop very fine. Step 2: Place the mixture in a bowl, add pepper to taste and mix well If storing, make sure the container is tightly covered This can be made with dried herbs, but it really isn't the same You can leave out the juniper berries, but they give a lovely layer of flavor.

Ingredient Names: flour, egg yolks, egg whites, cooked pot roast, pork loin, mild sausage, chicken, unsalted butter, cabbage leaves, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, eggs, nutmeg, salt, meat broth, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Make the dough from the flour and the eggs and put it in a bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it sit until it has risen In the mean time, blanch the cabbage, drain it, squeezing well to extract moisture, and mince it. Step 2: Then saut it until done in the butter. Step 3: Take out the cabbage and set aside Brown the sausage and when brown add cooked meats together and heat until hot Mince the cooked meats quite finely. Step 4: Combine all the ingredients of the filling in a bowl and mix them thoroughly with your fingers to obtain a homogenous mixture, seasoning it to taste with salt, pepper and nutmeg. Step 5: Take the pasta dough and roll it out dime-thin. Step 6: Cut the sheet into two equal-sized pieces, dust one lightly with corn meal, roll it up, and cover it so it stays moist Dot the half of the sheet still on your work surface with blebs of filling about the size of a small hazelnut, putting the dots in rows that are about an inch apart.

Ingredient Names: butter, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Step 2: Add heavy cream and whisk continuously until blended Slowly add parmesan, whisking continuously. Step 3: Allow sauce to bubble a little until it thickens, add white pepper, stir, then remove from heat Enjoy on top of pasta, veggies, meats, or rice.

Ingredient Names: butter, cream cheese, flour, heavy whipping cream, whole milk, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the cream cheese and butter over medium heat. Step 2: Remove from heat and add the flour and the whipping cream, mix well. Step 3: Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups whole milk and whisk until smooth. Step 4: Return to medium heat and add parmesan cheese and 1 cup whole milk. Step 5: Stir until warm and serve over pasta.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, bay leaves, garlic cloves, basil, oregano, onion powder, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in a skillet. Step 2: Put into a large stock pot with the tomato sauce, paste, and diced tomatoes. Step 3: Add most of the required amount of all the spices. Step 4: Let simmer on low, stirring enough to keep it from burning to the pan bottom, for an hour or so. Step 5: Taste a spoonful and add the rest of the spices to taste The thicker the metal of your stock pot, the less you have to stir. Step 6: Cover it to prevent splatters, but not airtight The longer it simmers, the thicker it gets The sauce is also very good without the beef.

Ingredient Names: slivered almonds, amaretto, brewed coffee, whipped cream, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a coffee cup, stir together the coffee, amaretto, and brown sugar. Step 2: Stir to dissolve sugar. Step 3: Top with a dollop of whipped cream and sprinkle with almonds, if desired.

Ingredient Names: water, white sugar, brown sugar, vodka, almond extract, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water and sugars in a very large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Heat until the mixture is boiling and all sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and continue to simmer for approximately 2 hours until mixture is thickened and syrupy and lightly coats a spoon. Step 4: Remove pan from heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add vodka and extracts and stir well. Step 6: Pour into a bottle and seal.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, anchovies packed in oil, garlic cloves, onion, black olives, green olives, capers, dried basil, italian seasoning, black pepper, tomatoes, tomato paste, water, marsala, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan combine olive oil and anchovies. Step 2: Cook over medium heat, stirring to mash anchovies, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic and onion and cook until tender, 5 minutes or so. Step 4: Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Arugula And Asparagus
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, pine nuts, olive oil, diced onions, asparagus spears, canned mushrooms, garlic cloves, limes, diced tomatoes, dried italian herb seasoning, evaporated milk, baby arugula, fresh basil leaves, parmesan-romano cheese mix
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan toast pine nuts, remove from pan set aside. Step 2: Add olive oil to pan, when hot add the onions and saute 3 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, asparagus, mushrooms, lime juice, diced tomatoes, and dried herbs, simmer 20 minutes. Step 4: Stir in evaporated milk, arugula, basil. Step 5: Toss in hot angel hair and grated cheese. Step 6: Add some pasta water if needed Plate in a large serving bowl and top with pine nuts. Step 7: Garnish with additional extra virgin olive oil drizzled over pasta and grated cheese Heartly enjoy!

Ingredient Names: onion, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, olive oil, lean pork sausage, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan or pot, saute onions in olive on medium heat for five minutes or until onions are tender. Step 2: Add bell pepper and garlic and saute 2 minutes or until fragrant. Step 3: Add gr Sausage to vegetables and brown, drain excess fat. Step 4: Add diced tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, and oregano. Step 5: Bring to a boil, and then cover and simmer on med Low heat for 15-30 minute Salt to taste and serve with pasta.

Ingredient Names: whole tomatoes, olive oil, salt, red pepper flakes, dried oregano, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Crush the tomatoes well Do not drain. Step 2: Stir in the rest of the ingredients Sauce can be made a day in advance and refrigerated I usually make it in the morning and let it sit This is enough sauce for 3-4 pizzas, depending on how saucy you like it!

Dish Name: Apple Cider Vinegar Marinade For Chicken Barbaja W
Ingredient Names: cold water, salt, apple cider vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Remove chicken from package (or if living in a country where chicken is really fresh, remove feathers, entrails head, feet and wing. Step 2: In a large bowl or clean sink put the chicken or cut up pieces of meat then pour on cold water until covered then add 1 / 2 cup of table salt or use less and 1 / 2 cup of apple cider vinegar Move the chicken around gently in this mixture for 10 to 15 minutes Less time is ok if you see that the skin hangs loose on the meat You can add sugar or brown sugar, molasses, honey, karo syrup, pancake syrup or artificial sweetner to the soak, but that and the salt are a matter of taste. Step 3: Rinse gently with more clean cold water. Step 4: Now you are ready to cook stovetop, oven, crock pot, campfire or whatever Even an old elderly bird will usually be tenderized My grandma also used this on game to make it tender and moist Remember to use a sink cleanser that contains bleach on the sink, because chicken is a funny meat.

Dish Name: Approximately Aurelio's Pizza And Pasta Sauce
