Ingredient Names: tomato puree, beer, white sugar, garlic powder, dried basil, dried oregano, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan Bring to a boil over medium-high heat Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: apricot halves, apricot nectar, sugar, ice, sparkling wine, mint sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Process half each of apricot halves, apricot nectar, and sugar in a blender until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides. Step 2: Repeat with remaining apricot halves, nectar, and sugar. Step 3: Serve over crushed ice with sparkling wine / champagne or ginger ale / lemon-lime soda. Step 4: Garnish, if desired Be sure and do this just before serving.

Ingredient Names: long-grain rice, chicken broth, butter, eggs, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, dried breadcrumbs, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, combine rice, broth, and butter or margarine. Step 2: Bring to a boil, stir to blend. Step 3: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes, set aside to cool. Step 4: Stir in egg yolks and parmesan In small bowl, beat egg whites until frothy, set aside. Step 5: Cover and freeze rice mixture for 15 minutes to make them firmer to handle. Step 6: Roll them with your hands to form balls Push a small cube of mozzarella into center of each arancini, lightly pressing to seal each ball.

Dish Name: Aromatic Pork With Baby Zucchini And Figs
Ingredient Names: ground cumin, garlic cloves, paprika, whole black peppercorn, pork tenderloin, white pearl onions, cardamom seed, bay leaf, zucchini, olive oil, fresh figs
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl combine cumin, garlic, paprika, pepper, and 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt. Step 2: Cut tenderloin crosswise into -inch thick slices Rub the cumin mixture over surfaces of tenderloin and set aside In large nonstick skillet, combine onion, cardamom, bay leaf, 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt and 1 / 2 cup of water. Step 3: Bring to boil over high heat, reduce heat. Step 4: Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add zucchini and cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until zucchini and onion are just tender. Step 6: Transfer mixture to a bowl and keep warm Wipe skillet clean.

Ingredient Names: fresh mushrooms, olive oil, garlic, salt & pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Slice mushrooms fairly thickly. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Step 3: Stir in the garlic, after about 2 minutes, the mushrooms. Step 4: Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Season with salt& pepper, and stir in the parsley. Step 6: Cook for 5 minutes more, and serve at once.

Dish Name: Artichoke & roasted red pepper soufflé omelette
Ingredient Names: eggs, artichoke hearts, pepper from, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, fresh basil leaves, butter, virgin rapeseed
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, lightly beat together the 5 egg yolks and 2 whole eggs. In a separate bowl, use an electric whisk to beat the egg whites until stiff. Add whites to the yolks and fold together carefully, keeping it light and fluffy. Fold in the artichokes, pepper, half the cheese, the basil, salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat grill to high. Heat a medium non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the butter and oil. When the butter has melted, add the omelette mixture and spread evenly. Cook until golden underneath, about 5 mins. Scatter over remaining cheese, then place the pan under the grill and cook for a further 2 mins. Slide the omelette onto a board or serving plate. Cut into wedges and serve.

Dish Name: Artichoke And Red Pepper Frittata Ww 4 Points
Ingredient Names: olive oil flavored cooking spray, onion, garlic clove, potato, artichoke hearts, roasted red pepper, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, egg whites, eggs, crushed red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly coat a 10-inch nonstick, ovenproof skillet with cooking spray over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and saut for a minute. Step 3: Add garlic, cooked potatoes, artichokes and peppers Saut an additional two minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: In a medium bowl, beat together red pepper flakes, oregano, salt, pepper, egg whites and eggs. Step 5: Pour over vegetable mixture. Step 6: After a minute, gently lift egg mixture to let uncooked egg portion run to bottom of skillet. Step 7: Cook frittata over medium heat until eggs begin to set, about 5 minutes. Step 8: When almost set, sprinkle with cheese. Step 9: Place skillet under broiler 3 to 4 inches from heat until cheese melts, about one minute.

Ingredient Names: boboli thin pizza shell, olive oil, red bell pepper, dried basil, dried oregano, garlic, artichoke hearts, mushrooms, part-skim mozzarella cheese, fresh cracked pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a nonstick skillet, simmer ingredients until tender Place on boboli shell and top with cheese Bake at directions on boboli package.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes with juice, artichoke heart, white wine, garlic, onion soup mix, tomato paste, fresh parsley, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in skillet and cook garlic and scallions about 2 minutes. Step 2: Add parsley and cook one minute. Step 3: Place garlic and parsley in saucepan, add wine, and cook until fluid reduces by about half. Step 4: Stir in tomato paste, artichokes, diced tomatoes, and onion soup mix. Step 5: Cook another five minutes and serve over pasta.

Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, parmesan cheese, onions, garlic powder, mayonnaise, baguette
Instructions: Step 1: Chop artichokes well. Step 2: Mix artichokes, onion, and Parmesan cheese. Step 3: Add just enough mayonnaise to make spreadable. Step 4: Add garlic powder, mix well. Step 5: Spread baguette slices with artichoke spread and place on a cookie sheet. Step 6: Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes, or until topping starts to bubble and brown.

Dish Name: Artichoke Hearts With Garlic Olive Oil And Parsley
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, italian parsley, frozen artichoke hearts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and 1 tablespoon parsley, stir 30 seconds. Step 3: Add artichokes and stir to coat. Step 4: Cover skillet, simmer until arichokes are tender, about 12 minutes. Step 5: Uncover, simmer until juices thicken and coat artichokes, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper, transfer to bowl. Step 7: Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon parlsley.

Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, garlic cloves, eggs, pecorino romano cheese, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, ground black pepper, light cream, pie crusts
Instructions: Step 1: Cut artichoke hearts into quarters, or large dice In frying pan over low heat, add oil, saute whole garlic cloves for a minute or so. Step 2: Add artichoke hearts and saute them until they start to brown. Step 3: Remove garlic cloves, and let the artichokes cool. Step 4: In a bowl, beat the eggs, add the cream, romano and mozzerella cheeses and pepper, mixing well. Step 5: Add the artichokes and the oil from the pan to the egg mixture, mix well. Step 6: Spoon mixture into pie crust. Step 7: Bake in preheated 350f oven for 35 minutes or until filling is set and just starts to brown.

Dish Name: Asparagus Bundles With Prosciutto Goat Cheese
Ingredient Names: asparagus spear, prosciutto, olive oil, salt, black pepper, roasted red peppers, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Line a 15-inch x 10-inch baking pan with foil. Step 3: Wrap asparagus spears in bundles of 3 or 4 spears with strips of prosciutto around the middle. Step 4: Place bundles in a single layer on baking pan tucking under ends of prosciutto. Step 5: Drizzle with olive oil. Step 6: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 7: Top with roasted red peppers. Step 8: Bake for 8-10 minutes or until asparagus is crisp tender. Step 9: Sprinkle with cheese and continue baking for 5 minutes or until cheese is soft.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, leeks, gorgonzola, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, sage, whipping cream, extra virgin olive oil, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly clean the asparagus, cutting the tougher edge off Bind them in small bunches and blanch, let cool. Step 2: Meanwhile, grease a baking pan and place the asparagus with the edges to the center of the pan Finely slice the leek. Step 3: Heat some olive oil in a pan, pour the leek in and gently saut over medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 4: Add the sage, the whipping cream and the gorgonzola cheese and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce begins to thicken. Step 5: Pour the gorgonzola sauce on the asparagus, dust with a mixture of grated parmigiano and breadcrumbs and broil under the grill for 10 minutes. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: almond milk, granulated sugar, coffee, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Place milk in 2-cup glass measuring cup. Step 2: Heat in saucepan on stovetop until hot but not boiling. Step 3: Place hot milk and sugar in a blender container. Step 4: Cover with a vented lid and blend until frothy, about 1 minute To serve, divide coffee among 4 cups. Step 5: Top each with frothy milk. Step 6: Sprinkle with cinnamon or grated chocolate Sip and enjoy!

Dish Name: Athens Pork Tenderloin With Goat Cheese
Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, mushrooms, onion, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, kalamata olive, goat cheese, dried oregano, pork tenderloin, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Add olive oil and butter to a 10- or 11-inch skillet and set heat to medium-high. Step 3: When butter melts, add mushrooms, onion, tomatoes, and olives. Step 4: Saute for 5 to 6 minutes until mushrooms are softened, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in the cheese and dried oregano until well combined Butterfly each tenderloin by slitting lengthwise, cutting to but not through the other side. Step 6: Place each between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap Pound with a meat mallet or a small heavy skillet Thickness should be approximately 1 / 4- to 1 / 2-inch.

Dish Name: Auberge Chorizo Goat's Cheese And Onion Pizza Thin Crust
Ingredient Names: dry yeast, sugar, water, bread flour, salt, chorizo sausage, goat's cheese, red onion, tomatoes, tomato paste, capers, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, mozzarella cheese, fresh ground black pepper, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the dry yeast, 1 / 2 teaspoon of sugar and 3 / 4 cups of lukewarm water. Step 2: Mix a little and let sit for 6-8 minutes. Step 3: Combine 1 3 / 4 cups of unbleached strong plain bread flour with 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt in a bowl or food processor. Step 4: Pour the water combination into the bowl and mix until ready to knead If using a bowl, mix with a spoon, and your hands until you have a neat ball. Step 5: Prepare a lightly sprinkled surface with flour. Step 6: Turn out dough and knead for around 2-3 minutes Lightly cover your finger. Step 7: Roll out by hand for a 12'' base. Step 8: Place in 12'' lightly oiled oven pan.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, salt, fennel seeds, red peppers, casing
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare casings: let casings soak in cool water about five minutes to remove salt on outer surface and flush salt from the inside by placing one end on faucet nozzle and turn on cold tap water. Step 2: Remove casing from faucet and gently squeeze out water. Step 3: Cover rinsed casings and refrigerate until ready to use First grind meat coarsely, incorporate seasonings evenly, and re-grind. Step 4: Fill the casings using the sausage horn attachment and make links by twisting the sausage where you wish the links to be Four inches is a good size for a regular serving, smaller links may be made for appetizer servings To cook, place the sausage in large saucepan or dutch oven in a single layer. Step 5: Add a little water or broth, cover and heat To a low simmer Maintain a low simmer until the sausage is heated through and cooked thoroughly, approximately 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: crushed tomatoes in puree, garlic cloves, spanish onion, extra virgin olive oil, fresh ground black pepper, fresh basil, fresh parsley, bay leaves, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: In large pan over medium heat saute chopped garlic and onion in olive oil until translucent. Step 2: Add cans of tomato. Step 3: Sprinkle on black pepper, add bay leaves. Step 4: Let sauce simmer for about 30 minutes to reduce and intensify flavors stirring occassionally. Step 5: Add basil and parsley and stir well. Step 6: Allow sauce to simmer at least another two hours stirring occassionally. Step 7: After two hours taste sauce, if acidic or if you want more sweetness add 1 / 2 tsp baking powder to cut acidity Only do this if necessary Pull out both bay leaves before serving / storing.

Ingredient Names: flat leaf parsley, capers, anchovy fillets, garlic cloves, dijon mustard, extra virgin olive oil, fennel bulbs
Instructions: Step 1: For the salsa verde, whiz all ingrdients except the fennel in a food processor to a coarse paste and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Meanwhile, slice the fennel into 2-3 cm wedges and cook in a saucepan of salted boiling water for 8-10 minutes until just tender. Step 3: Drain, then place on a clean tea towel until dry, yet still warm To serve, arrange fennel wedges in a bowl and drizzle with the salsa verde. Step 4: Serve as part of an an.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, eggs, cream, parsley chives, parmesan, butter for
Instructions: Step 1: On the day, reheat the oven to 180C/Gas 4/fan oven 160C. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Tip in the pancetta and fry for 4 minutes until crisp. Drain and cool on kitchen paper. Step 2: Whisk the eggs with the cream and plenty of salt and pepper. Add the herbs, parmesan and cooled pancetta; mix again. Step 3: Butter a 12-hole muffin tin. Ladle in the mixture to two-thirds fill each hole (you’ll have leftovers for another batch). Bake for 20-25 minutes until firm. Transfer to a rack. Cool while cooking the remaining frittatas. Make up to 4 hours ahead. Step 4: To serve, heat through, loosely wrapped in foil, in a preheated oven at 180C/Gas 4/fan oven 160C, for 10-15 minutes. Serve hot, warm or cold.

Ingredient Names: bacon, potatoes, eggs, milk, pepper, salt, parmesan cheese, green onion, fresh basil, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Using a large, nonstick skillet, cook bacon pieces until crisp Reserve 2 t Of bacon drippings. Step 2: Drain bacon pieces on paper towel. Step 3: Add potato slices to skillet with reserved bacon drippings. Step 4: Cover and cook over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes until tender and lightly browned. Step 5: Turn potato slices over and turn down heat to prevent over-browning In large bowl, beat eggs, milk, pepper, and salt until combined. Step 6: Stir in cheese, green onion, and basil, set aside.

Ingredient Names: bacon, olive oil, onions, tomatoes, eggs, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In medium, broilerproof, nonstick skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Step 2: Using slotted spoon, transfer bacon to paper towels to drain. Step 3: Pour off all but 1 tblsp drippings from skillet. Step 4: Add olive oil to skillet. Step 5: Add sliced onion and cook over medium-high heat until golden, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 7: Add chopped tomatoes and cook until almost all liquid evaporates, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes, preheat broiler. Step 8: Whisk eggs in large bowl until frothy. Step 9: Whisk in bacon, basil and season to taste. Step 10: Pour into skillet with vegetables. Step 11: Cook over medium heat until bottom is just golden and top is still unset, occasionally lifting edges of frittata and tilting pan to let uncooked egg run underneath, about 10 minutes. Step 12: Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese. Step 13: Broil frittata until top puffs and turns golden, about 3 minutes. Step 14: Slide frittata onto platter. Step 15: Serve warm or at room temperature, cutting into wedges.

Ingredient Names: frozen artichoke hearts, eggs, half-and-half, salt, pepper, ground nutmeg, fontina cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook artichoke hearts according to package directions and drain well. Step 2: Spread artichokes evenly in a well greased, shallow 1 1 / 2 - 2 quart baking dish. Step 3: Beat eggs with half and half, salt, pepper and nutmeg. Step 4: Stir in fontina cheese and pour over artichokes. Step 5: Bake uncovered in 350 oven for 30 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle evenly with parmesan then return to oven and bake for 5-8 minutes more or until frittata is puffed and lightly browned, serve at once.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, salt water, oil, cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Cover cauliflower with salted water and boil 15 minutes or until partly done, drain. Step 3: Cut into flowerets and deep fry in oil until golden brown. Step 4: Arrange in shallow oven proof dish. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese and salt. Step 6: Bake until cheese is melted 5-10 minutes. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Baked Cheese Crepes Giada De Laurentiis
Ingredient Names: eggs, whole milk, salt, fresh ground black pepper, butter, fontina cheese, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaf, marinara sauce, parmesan cheese, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f Butter a 13x9x2-inch baking dish, set aside. Step 2: In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper Over medium-low temperature, heat a 6-inch non-stick skillet. Step 3: Brush the bottom of the skillet with butter. Step 4: Place 3 tablespoons of the eggs in a cup then pour all at once into the skillet and swirl to evenly coat the bottom of the pan. Step 5: Cover the skillet and cook until the eggs set, about 1 minute, then turn the skillet upside down over a plate to drop the crepe out of the pan. Step 6: Cover crepe with a piece of wax paper. Step 7: Repeat steps with remaining melted butter and egg mixture until you've used it up and made 10 crepes, putting wax paper in between each stacked crepe on the plate. Step 8: Take a crepe and place it on a flat surface, then put some of the fontina and mozzarella in the center, sprinkle with basil, and roll up the crepe.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, mozzarella cheese, prosciutto, basil, marjoram, parmesan cheese, butter, flour, milk, salt, pepper, onion, garlic cloves, canned tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Begin by making a tomato sauce. Step 2: Heat the 4 t Olive oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic and cook until beginning to soften about 5-7 minutes. Step 4: Add the canned and fresh tomatoes, and the next 5 ingredients. Step 5: Simmer for 15-20 minutes, until reduced slightly. Step 6: Meanwhile, prepare the white sauce. Step 7: Heat the 2t of butter in a skillet over medium heat. Step 8: After foam has subsided, add 2t flour. Step 9: Stir continually, and cook 2-3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fennel bulbs, milk, olive oil, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumb, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees Clean the fennel, removing the upper fronds, and slice lengthwise into 1 / 2 inch slices. Step 2: Set the feathery leaves aside to garnish the completed dish. Step 3: Place in a saucepan and cover with milk. Step 4: Simmer for about 10 minutes or until the fennel can be easily pierced with a fork. Step 5: Remove the fennel and pat dry. Step 6: Layer in a baking dish, drizzle with two tablespoons of the oil and add salt and pepper. Step 7: Bake for about 20 minutes. Step 8: Mix the remaining oil with the cheese and breadcrumbs, and sprinkle over the dish and continue baking until golden brown This dish is great hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: red potatoes, olive oil, onion, green pepper, garlic cloves, frozen chopped broccoli, eggs, parmesan cheese, water, dried basil, salt, pepper, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saut potato in oil in large skillet for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add onion, green pepper and garlic, saut until tender, add broccoli. Step 3: Cook and cover 5 minutes. Step 4: Arrange mixture in an 11x7x1-inch baking dish. Step 5: Combine eggs and next five ingredients. Step 6: Beat until blended. Step 7: Pour over potato mixture. Step 8: Sprinkle with monterey jack cheese. Step 9: Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes or until set.

Ingredient Names: hoagie rolls, italian dressing, salami, deli turkey, deli ham, provolone cheese, tomatoes, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 2: Brush the cut sides of the rolls with the italian dressing. Step 3: Layer the bottom halves with the salami, turkey, ham, cheese, tomato, and onion and replace the tops. Step 4: Place each on a piece of aluminum foil and wrap tightly. Step 5: Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted Carefully remove the aluminum foil and serve.

Ingredient Names: idaho potatoes, extra virgin olive oil, coarse salt, ground black pepper, lemons, italian parsley, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f Peel potatoes and cut into 3 / 8-inch thick slices cut again into 3 / 8-inch thick fries. Step 2: Place the potatoes into a bowl with cold water Just before cooking, drain water and place potatoes on paper towel, pat dry completely, put in a bowl. Step 3: Add olive oil, salt & pepper. Step 4: Toss well and lay out in 1 layer on nonstick baking sheets. Step 5: Bake until light brown, approximately 30 to 40 minutes, turning frequently until golden brown, remove from oven. Step 6: Add lemon zest, parsley, garlic & more salt and pepper if desired.

Dish Name: Baked Manicotti With Pepperoni Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: pepperoni, lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, spaghetti sauce, salt and pepper, ricotta cheese, italian cheese blend, provolone cheese, eggs, no-boil lasagna noodles, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 375 degrees Meat pulse the pepperoni in a food processor until ground. Step 2: Add beef and pulse until thoroughly combined. Step 3: Transfer beef mixture to large saucepan. Step 4: Add the onion, garlic, and spices and cook over medium heat, breaking up mixture with wooden spoon, until beef is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Using slotted spoon, transfer 1 cup beef mixture to paper towel-lined plate and reserve Sauce: add spaghetti sauce to the meat in the saucepan and simmer until heated through. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper to taste Begin making noodles and filling while sauce is simmering Noodles pour 2 quarts very hot tap water into 13x9 inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian sausage, penne, pasta sauce, yellow onion, green pepper, red pepper, mushroom, carrot, spinach, diced tomatoes, shredded cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix the ground beef and ground sausage thoroughly together You'd like to have a little bit of each in every bite. Step 3: Place your peppers, onions, mushrooms, spinach, and carrots in a pan, with a little olive oil. Step 4: Once browned, add tomato sauce and diced tomatoes, Let simmer for about 5 minutes, slowly add cheddar & salt and pepper, to taste. Step 5: Stir in the cheddar until it lightens your sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle sugar in to taste, until your sauce is no longer tart. Step 7: Add meat into sauce and let simmer for 10 minutes. Step 8: Boil water with butter and salt.

Ingredient Names: bell peppers, breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, garlic clove, olive oil, salt, black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the peppers in half lengthwise. Step 2: Remove the seeds and pith. Step 3: Slice into 1 / 2 wide strips Coat a roasting pan with the olive oil. Step 4: Add the peppers and remaining ingredients. Step 5: Toss to coat Roast at 400 degrees for 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: low sodium chicken broth, water, milk, garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, salt, polenta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f Butter a 2 quart souffl dish. Step 2: Bring first 6 ingredients to boil in a large, heavy saucepan Gradually add cornmeal, whisking until smooth. Step 3: Reduce heat to low. Step 4: Cook until cornmeal is very soft and mixture is thick and creamy, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and stir in 6 tablespoons parmesan cheese, season with pepper, if desired. Step 6: Transfer to prepared baking dish. Step 7: Sprinkle 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese over polenta. Step 8: Cool, cover and chill.

Ingredient Names: flour, potatoes, butter, salt and pepper, nutmeg, mozzarella cheese, tomato sauce, white sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, make a well in the flour. Step 2: Add potatoes, butter, seasonings and nutmeg Pinch to form a soft dough. Step 3: Knead lightly on a floured board. Step 4: Divide ball of dough into 4. Step 5: Roll each section into a long rope approximately 1 inch in diameter. Step 6: Cut into 1 / 2 inch slices. Step 7: Drop slices into salted simmering water. Step 8: Cook 4-5 minutes Gnocchi is cooked when it rises to the surface.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, sweet italian sausage link, onion, garlic, ricotta cheese, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook sausage until brown on all sides, remove from pan. Step 3: Slice into thin pieces. Step 4: Return meat to pan. Step 5: Add onion and garlic. Step 6: Cook until onion is tender, drain. Step 7: Stir in hot pasta and ricotta cheese.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, hot italian sausage, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, kalamata olive, basil, rigatoni pasta, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Cook pasta according to directions, making sure to keep it al dente. Step 3: Drain and place back in cooking pot, set aside. Step 4: Meanwhile, in skillet cook sausage and onions until sausage is done. Step 5: Drain well and set aside In same skillet add olive oil and garlic and cook 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Return sausage and onion to pan with garlic. Step 7: Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, and water, stir well.

Ingredient Names: red potatoes, olive oil, onion, green pepper, garlic cloves, frozen chopped broccoli, eggs, parmesan cheese, water, dried basil leaves, salt, black pepper, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the potatoes in the oil in a large skillet for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add the onion, green pepper, and garlic. Step 3: Saute until tender, add broccoli. Step 4: Cover and cook 5 minutes. Step 5: Arrange the vegetable mixture in an 11 x 7 x 1 1 / 2 inch baking dish. Step 6: Combine the eggs, parmesan cheese, water, basil, salt and pepper. Step 7: Beat until blended. Step 8: Pour over the vegetable mixture. Step 9: Sprinkle with the monterey jack cheese.

Dish Name: Baked Stuffed Polenta Polenta Al Forno
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, polenta, butter, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, salami, sun-dried tomato, black olives, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a lrg saucepan, bring chicken stock to a boil & gradually whisk in the polenta. Step 2: Reduce heat to simmer & cook 15 min or till very thick. Step 3: Remove pan from heat & stir in butter, 1st measure of parmesan cheese + parsley. Step 4: Allow to cool slightly. Step 5: Then press polenta mixture into an oiled 8 x 12-in lamington pan. Step 6: Cool to rm temp & refrigerate several hrs till firm. Step 7: Turn polenta out of pan, slice horizontally in half, return bottom half to pan & set top half aside Evenly distribute sliced salami over the half in the pan, overlapping as necessary. Step 8: Then evenly distribute the chopped tomatoes & black olives over the salami slices. Step 9: Combine mozzarella cheese, 2nd measure of parmesan cheese & fresh basil.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, onion, red bell pepper, garlic clove, reduced-calorie margarine, egg whites, low-fat milk, salt, italian seasoning, monterey jack cheese, fat-free parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400f. Step 2: Grease two 10-oz Custard cups or individual baking dishes In 8-inch skillet over medium low heat, saut zucchini, onion, red pepper and garlic in margarine until tender. Step 3: Let cool slightly In medium bowl, beat eggs, half-and-half and seasonings until combined. Step 4: Stir in zucchini mixture. Step 5: Pour into prepared custard cups or baking dishes. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheeses. Step 7: Bake, uncovered, at 400f for 14 to 17 minutes or until top is puffy and light golden brown.

Ingredient Names: flour, black pepper, salt, chicken breasts, olive oil, mushrooms, garlic cloves, balsamic vinegar, chicken broth, bay leaves, dried thyme, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together flour, pepper, and salt Dredge chicken in to make light dusting. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat, add cut up chicken, saut until chicken is light brown, about 6 minutes. Step 3: Add mushrooms and garlic to chicken, saut until mushrooms are almost done, stirring for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add vinegar, broth, bay leaves, and thyme, cover, simmer over medium low heat, cover, stir occasionally, for about 10 or until chicken is done. Step 5: Transfer chicken to warm plate, cover with foil. Step 6: Uncover skillet, raise burner to medium high for about 7 minutes to thicken. Step 7: Remove bay leaves and add butter, stir, pour over chicken, and serve with your favorite pasta.

Dish Name: Balsamic Pancetta Green Beans With Shallots
Ingredient Names: pancetta, shallot, balsamic vinegar, fresh green beans, coarse salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pancetta in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring frequently until crisp, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Remove pancetta with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels Reserve drippings in pan. Step 3: Add shallots to the skillet drippings. Step 4: Cook over medium-high heat until golden brown, about 6 minutes. Step 5: Add balsamic vinegar and cook for 1 minute, remove from heat. Step 6: Place green beans in large pot of lightly salted, boiling water. Step 7: Cook until just crisp-tender, 5-6 minutes. Step 8: Drain immediately and add green beans to shallot mixture.

Ingredient Names: red onion, potatoes, butter, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh sage leaves, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Melt butter in a large skillet, add onions and potatoes and toss to coat. Step 3: Cook over medium heat, turning occasionally until vegetables are golden brown. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper, add sage and 1 / 2 the vinegar and mix. Step 5: Place in an ovenproof dish, cover and bake 20 minutes. Step 6: Add remaining vinegar, bake uncovered 20-30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, balsamic vinegar, dijon mustard, garlic, boneless pork loin chops, green olives, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the oil with vinegar, mustard and garlic. Score the meat on both sides, season, then put into a dish. Pour over the balsamic mixture and leave to marinate for 5 mins. Step 2: Heat a griddle pan until very hot. Lift the pork from the marinade, scraping off any garlic, then cook for 4 mins on each side. Remove the meat and keep warm. Pour the marinade into the pan with the olives, cook for 2 mins, then stir in the basil. Pour any juices from the pork into the pan, drizzle the sauce over the pork and serve with pasta.

Ingredient Names: eggs, all-purpose flour, shortening, milk, salt, egg, italian parsley, locatelli cheese, sweet italian sausage links, mozzarella cheese, prosciutto, provolone cheese, ham, genoa salami
Instructions: Step 1: Crust preparation: mix flour and salt together, cut in shortening with 2 knives or pastry cutter. Step 2: Add beaten eggs to flour mixture slowly, incorporating very well. Step 3: Add milk to hold mixture together as it is kneaded. Step 4: Shape pastry into two balls. Step 5: Chill for 30 minutes or until ready to begin making the pie Preparation for filling: remove the sausage meat from the casings. Step 6: Set aside in small bowl In another small bowl, place all the mozzarella, cut into 1 / 4-inch cubes. Step 7: Set aside In another small bowl, place all the provolone, cut into 1 / 4-inch cubes.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaves, parmesan cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place basil leaves in small batches in processor until well chopped. Step 2: Add about 1 / 3 the nuts and garlic, blend again. Step 3: Add about 1 / 3 of the parmesan cheese. Step 4: Blend while slowly adding about 1 / 3 of the olive oil, stopping to scrape down sides of container Process basil pesto it forms a thick smooth paste. Step 5: Repeat until all ingredients are used, mix all batches together well.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, green pepper, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, brown sugar, bay leaves, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and pepper in oil until soft. Step 2: Add tomatoes, tomato paste, garlic, spices and brown sugar Adjust seasoning and sugar to taste. Step 3: Simmer on low for 1-2 hours. Step 4: Add chopped fresh basil just before serving.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, spanish onion, garlic, fresh thyme leaves, carrot, whole tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a 3-quart saucepan, heat theolive oil oover medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and garlic and cook until soft and light golden brown, about 8-10 minutes. Step 3: Add the thyme and the carrot and cook 5 minutes more, until the carrot is quite soft. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and juice and bring to a boil, stirring often. Step 5: Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes, until as thick as hot cereal. Step 6: Season with salt and serve This sauce holds one week in the refrigerator or up to 6 months in the freezer.

Dish Name: Basic White Sauce Salsa Di Besciamella
Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, unbleached all-purpose flour, milk, fine sea salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over med-low heat Do not let the butter brown. Step 2: Whisk in the flour, and cook it until a uniform paste is formed, and no streaks of flour remain Slowly whisk in the milk in a steady stream. Step 3: Cook about 10 minutes, stirring slowly until the sauce coats the back of a wooden spoon. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, vidalia onions, elephant garlic, fresh chives, virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fresh basil, oregano, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients above and refrigerate for several hours, check for taste and season accordingly. Step 2: (If you find it to vinegary for your taste simply add some sugar and olive oil). Step 3: Serve on garlic bread with some parm cheese (the fresh, block kind you grate your self) or bake on the bread with a little feta or assagio cheese for a change of pace, enjoy.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, onion, butter, eggs, salt & pepper, prosciutto, basil, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet, and cook the onions until they are golden and soft. Step 2: Add this mixture to the potatoes. Step 3: Add in the ham and mix well. Step 4: Beat the eggs together, and then pour this mixture into the bowl with the potatoes. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper, add in the cheese and basil and mix well. Step 6: Heat the remaining butter in a nonstick skillet on medium. Step 7: Once it is foaming, add the potato egg mixture into the pan. Step 8: Turn the heat to low and once the eggs have set, and the only remaining moistness is in the center, place the skillet under the broiler until the top is set and golden.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaves, fresh mint leaves, walnuts, parmesan cheese, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the basil, mint and nuts coarsely. Step 2: Add them along with the parmesan cheese and garlic to a food processor Gradually add the olive oil through the feed tube and process until pesto is well-blended. Step 3: Transfer to bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Cover tightly and chill. Step 5: Bring to room temperature before using Yield is estimated.

Ingredient Names: part-skim ricotta cheese, fresh basil, green onion, roasted red pepper, parmesan cheese, chicken broth, olive oil, white wine, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl Season to taste with salt and pepper Toss through with your favorite pasta.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, oil, onion, chicken broth, great northern beans, romaine lettuce, salt, black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Wash lettuce well and chop leaves in half. Step 2: Saute onion and garlic in oil in medium size pot until slightly brown, slowly add chicken broth stirring well. Step 3: Add one can of beans with juice and one can without, lettuce and salt and pepper. Step 4: Cover and simmer 20 minutes on med-low heat. Step 5: Serve in bowls and top with cheese. Step 6: Serve with fresh bread for dipping.

Ingredient Names: margarine, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, french bread, parsley, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Combine the margarine, parmesan, and garlic powder in a small bowl. Step 3: Spread the mixture over the bread slices. Step 4: Place the bread slices on a cookie sheet. Step 5: Sprinkle a little parsley over all of the pieces. Step 6: Sprinkle one dash of paprika onto the center of each piece. Step 7: Bake in the oven for a few minutes, until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, all-purpose flour, milk, salt, ground black pepper, dried oregano, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Whisk in the flour, stirring constantly, about 2-3 minutes Gradually add in the milk, stirring constantly, until thoroughly incorporated into butter mixture. Step 3: Add salt, pepper, oregano, and minced garlic. Step 4: Stir frequently until thickened.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic, carrots, celery, mushrooms, italian herb seasoning, salt, pepper, red wine, tomato paste, tomatoes, fresh parsley, mozzarella cheese, water
Instructions: Step 1: Polenta: in a large saucepan, bring water and salt to boil over high heat. Step 2: Reduce heat to low Gradually whisk in cornmeal. Step 3: Cook, stirring often with a wooden spoon, until thick enough to mound on spoon, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Stir in parmesan cheese. Step 5: Spoon into greased 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish, set aside. Step 6: In a large pot, saute beef over medium heat, breaking up with spoon, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes, drain off any fat. Step 7: Add onion, garlic, carrots, celery, mushrooms, herb seasoning, salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Beef Ragu With Pumpkin And Sage
Ingredient Names: dry red wine, garlic, oregano, flat leaf parsley, beef, olive oil, onion, carrot, celery, prosciutto, crushed tomatoes, sugar, salt, pepper, pumpkin
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the meat: in a glass or ceramic bowl, combine the first group of ingredients. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Step 3: Make the ragu: heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a thick-bottomed frying pan. Step 4: Add the onion, carrot, celery and prosciutto and cook for 6 8 minutes until soft, then remove and put into a heavy saucepan Wipe the frying pan clean. Step 5: Drain the beef, reserving the marinade. Step 6: Add another tablespoon of oil to the pan, then brown the beef on all sides. Step 7: Add the reserved marinade, tomatoes and sugar and cook for a few minutes. Step 8: Then add this to the vegetables in the saucepan. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper, cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, bratwursts, beer, cheddar cheese, sweet red peppers, onion, garlic cloves, fresh basil, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Add oil, garlic, sweet peppers and onions in a 9x13 baking dish and roast in oven for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally While roasting vegetables, remove casing from brats, crumble and brown in a skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Drain brats and blot with towel to remove excess grease. Step 4: Return brats to skillet and add beer, simmer. Step 5: Cook pasta as directed, drain, but keep 1 / 2 cup of pasta water. Step 6: Remove vegetables from oven. Step 7: Add, brats, basil, 1 / 2 cup of cheese to vegetables and mix throughly, add some pasta water if it seems to dry. Step 8: Top with remaining cheese and serve!

Dish Name: Beet Onion Pizza W Goat Cheese
Ingredient Names: cooked beets, yellow sweet onion, garlic clove, butter, goat cheese, fontina cheese, pizza dough
Instructions: Step 1: In a sauce pan or skillet, melt the butter and then saute the garlic until slightly brown 2. Step 2: Reduce to low heat and add beets and onions. Step 3: Cook until onions become soft, stirring regularly 3. Step 4: Remove the beets & onions from the pain with a slotted spoon, leaving the leftover butter in the pan 4. Step 5: Prepare your pizza dough on a floured surface, stretching it very thin, then transfer to a pizza peel dusted lightly with semolina flour 5.

Ingredient Names: hot italian sausage link, onion, green pepper, garlic cloves, pesto sauce, eggplant, zucchini, fresh mushrooms, dry red wine, crushed tomatoes, tomatoes and green chilies, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Remove casings from sausage links and slice. Step 2: In a large stockpot over medium high heat, brown the sausage. Step 3: Drain off grease if desired I usually don't. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Add onion, green pepper, garlic, pesto, eggplant, zucchini, and mushrooms. Step 6: Simmer for an additional 10 -15 minutes - it doesn't have to be done, just softened The eggplant will start to get mushy - it will eventually become the thickening agent for the sauce, so don't worry if it starts looking weird! Step 7: Add the wine, tomatoes, and spaghetti sauce Stir until all ingredients are blended.

Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, red onion, extra virgin olive oil, ciabatta rolls, garlic-infused olive oil, salt and pepper, prosciutto, provolone cheese, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saute pan over medium heat saute pepper and onion in 1 tsp olive oil until onion is translucent and pepper is softened. Step 2: Brush each cut side of the rolls with garlic olive oil and lightly salt and pepper Assemble sandwiches using prosciutto, cheese, arugula, and sauteed vegetables Lightly brush outside of assembled sandwiches with remaining olive oil. Step 3: Cook until done, about 4-8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, flour, salt and pepper, cooking spray, tomato sauce, tomatoes, oregano, basil, garlic cloves, ricotta cheese, chives, egg, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven 350 degrees fahrenheit. Step 2: Mix salt, pepper and flour in a dish. Step 3: Dip eggplant slices into flour mixture. Step 4: Cover bottom of a fry pan with cooking oil spray. Step 5: Fry slices of eggplant until light brown on both sides over low-medium heat careful not to burn them. Step 6: When ready, remove from pan on paper towels to drain and set aside. Step 7: In a bowl combine the tomato sauce, tomatoes, oregano, basil, and garlic In another bowl combine ricotta cheese, chives, and the beaten egg. Step 8: Spoon one third of the tomato mixture into the bottom of a lasagne or casserole dish. Step 9: Place a layer of eggplant and cover with part of the grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, garlic paste, mozzarella cheese, asiago cheese, part-skim ricotta cheese, white truffle oil, arugula, olive oil, salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Spread the pizza crust with the garlic paste, then top with the mozzarella and asiago, and spoon dollops of the ricotta over all. Step 3: Bake for 10-12 minutes or until cheese is melted. Step 4: Remove from the oven. Step 5: Drizzle the arugula lightly with olive oil and toss, then place immediately on top of pizza. Step 6: Return to the oven for one minute only, just for the heat to wilt the arugula. Step 7: Drizzle the truffle oil over the top and season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Slice and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, dried oregano, salt, dried basil, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan. Step 2: Saute onions and garlic until tender. Step 3: Add rest of ingredients, heat to boiling, reduce heat. Step 4: Simmer, partially covered, for 2 hours, stir occasionally. Step 5: After it has simmered, cool completely and store in freezer bags or containers in increments that you find best for your family Or process in a boiling covered canner for 35 minutes Favorite ingredients can be added like sliced mushrooms, cooked / drained sausage, hamburger, etc.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, onions, garlic cloves, mushroom, black olives, cooking sherry, celery salt, brown sugar, honey, roma tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, artichoke hearts, oregano, basil, rubbed sage
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce: Brown 1 / 2 lb of the sausage in sauce pan. Step 2: Mix tomato sauce, onions, minced garlic cloves, mushrooms, olives, cooking sherry, celery salt, brown sugar, honey, tomatoes, olive oil, artichoke hearts, oregano, basil, sage, red peppers, black pepper, thyme, cilantro, savory and half lb of sausage into large pot. Step 3: Let sauce come to a simmer. Step 4: Cover, and simmer for 6 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 5: After sauce has simmered, refrigerate overnight Brown two lbs hot italian sausage, set aside. Step 6: Mix dough ingredients and knead for several minutes You will need to repeat the dough recipe five times in order to make 40 calzones.

Ingredient Names: cornmeal, pizza dough, extra virgin olive oil, pancetta, ricotta cheese, pecorino romano cheese, egg yolks, garlic clove, pepper, provolone cheese, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450. Step 2: Sprinkle a little cornmeal on a pizza pan or baking sheet. Step 3: Place the pizza dough on the pan and stretch into a large round or rectangle. Step 4: Drizzle the dough with evoo and partially bake until puffed and golden, about 8 minutes. Step 5: In a small skillet, heat a drizzle of evoo over medium heat. Step 6: Add the pancetta and cook, stirring often, until crisp, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer to a bowl and let cool. Step 8: Add the ricotta, pecorino romano, egg yolks and garlic to the pancetta. Step 9: Season with pepper and stir to combine. Step 10: Spread the ricotta mixture over the partially baked pizza dough, leaving a 1 / 2-inch border all around.

Ingredient Names: baby spinach, bacon, shallots, mashed potatoes, milk, butter, blue cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Remove large stems from spinach Saut bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crisp. Step 2: Remove and drain bacon, reserving drippings in skillet. Step 3: Add shallots to skillet, and saut until tender. Step 4: Remove from skillet. Step 5: Add spinach, and saut 4 to 5 minutes or until wilted, set aside. Step 6: Combine mashed potatoes, milk, and butter in a 2-quart microwave-safe bowl Microwave at high 15 minutes, stirring once. Step 7: Let stand 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, fresh spinach, eggs, part-skim mozzarella cheese, blue cheese, plum tomatoes, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet coated with cooking spray, cook onion and garlic over medium heat for 3 minutes or until tender. Step 2: Remove from the skillet. Step 3: Add spinach to skillet in batches, cooking for 1 minute or until wilted. Step 4: Remove from the heat. Step 5: In a large bowl, beat the eggs / egg substitute until frothy. Step 6: Stir in the onion mixture, cooked spinach, mozzarella, blue cheese, tomatoes and nuts. Step 7: Place in a 10-in Ovenproof skillet coated with cooking spray. Step 8: Bake, uncovered, at 400 for 30-35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.

Ingredient Names: gnocchi, baby spinach, fl creme fraiche half-fat if preferred, parmesan, soft blue cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the gnocchi in a large pan of boiling water according to pack instructions. Plunge the spinach into the same pan, then immediately drain through a colander and shake off any excess water. Step 2: Put the crème fraîche in a small ovenproof dish with the grated parmesan. Add the hot, drained gnocchi and spinach and give everything a good stir. Crumble the blue cheese over and season with ground pepper. Step 3: Slide the dish under a hot grill until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: gin, campari, ruby red grapefruit juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour in campari, gin and grapefruit juice into a highball glass filled with ice cubes Garnish with a grapefruit slice.

Ingredient Names: ham, bouquet garni, onions
Instructions: Step 1: The night before the gammon is to be cooked place it in a bowl of cold water and allow to soak This removes some of the salt and tenderises it a little bit. Step 2: Place in a large cooking pot,, cover with cold water, add the onions and bouquet garni and bring to the boil. Step 3: Turn the heat right down so the water is barely bubbling and put on the lid. Step 4: Cook for 20 minutes per pound of meat. Step 5: Once the cooking time is up leave the meat in the liquour until cooled This stops it tensing up, and drying out, and makes it lovely and tender.

Ingredient Names: bolognese sauce, prepared pizza crust, red capsicum, mushrooms, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place one pizza base on a pizza or oven tray. Step 2: Spread with meat sauce to within 1 25cm of edge, top with capsicum, mushrooms & half the cheese. Step 3: Place second pizza base on top pressing down slightly, sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 4: Bake in a hot oven for 20-30 mins or until cheese is golden and base of pizza is cooked through. Step 5: Serve with a crisp tossed salad.

Dish Name: Bolognese Sauce Probably The Best Outside Of Italy
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, brown onion, carrot, celery, olive oil, lean ground beef, beef stock, red wine, roma tomatoes, passata, sugar, parsley, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: - chop the garlic, onion, carrot, celery rather fine - fry on low-medium heat in quite a bit of olive oil for about 5-10 minutes until soft. Step 2: Put aside - fry the meat in some olive oil over high heat until really brown and the liquid has evaporated - pour over the red wine, let it cook for about a minute, then add the stock, cans of tomato, sugar and the vegetables. Step 3: Add half the parsley and some pepper, as well as some more olive oil - simmer on low-medium heat covered for about 1 5 - 2 hours - adjust seasoning, probably it needs a bit more salt, and add the remaining parsley - serve with spaghetti and freshly shaved parmesan.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, lean ground beef, italian-style tomato sauce, olive oil, prepared pizza crust, ricotta cheese, egg, italian cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Combine italian sausage and ground beef Brown meat mixture in skillet over medium heat until cooked through. Step 3: Add tomato sauce to meat mixture, remove from heat. Step 4: Brush sides and bottom of 13 x9 baking pan with olive oil Unroll dough into pan, pressing into rectangular shape to form crust. Step 5: Combine ricotta cheese and egg, and then spread mixture onto crust. Step 6: Top with meat sauce and shredded cheese. Step 7: Bake for 20- 25 minutes until top is golden brown.

Ingredient Names: japanese-style bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, eggs, boneless pork chops, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsely crush the panko and place in a large shallow bowl. Step 2: Stir the cheese into the panko Lightly beat the eggs in another large shallow bowl. Step 3: Sprinkle the pork generously with salt and pepper. Step 4: Dip the pork, 1 piece at a time, in the egg, then dredge the pork in the crumb mixture, patting to coat completely. Step 5: Heat 1 / 4 cup of oil in a heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add the pork to the hot oil and cook until golden brown and just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Step 7: Transfer to paper towels to drain. Step 8: Transfer the pork to plates and serve with lemon wedges.

Dish Name: Boursin Cheese And Sun Dried Tomato Pizza
Ingredient Names: pizza crust, pesto sauce, boursin cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, roasted red peppers, salami, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spread pesto sauce over the pizza base Distribute the salami evenly over the pizza Roughly chop the sun-dried tomatoes and peppers and distribute evenly over the pizza Crumble the boursin cheese and distribute over the pizza. Step 2: Sprinkle the mozzarella sparingly over the pizza. Step 3: Transfer to the preheated pizza maker machine and cook until the crust is crisp and golden, rotating it 180 degrees half way through cooking to ensure it's cooked evenly. Step 4: When the pizza is ready, remove, cut into pieces and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: top round steak, parmesan cheese, garlic cloves, raisins, salt and pepper, olive oil, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pound steak thin with a mallet or side of a cleaver. Step 2: Sprinkle cheese, garlic, and raisins on steak. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Roll tightly and tie securely with string. Step 5: Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat Brown on each side. Step 6: Drop into your favorite simmering red sauce for 2 hours or until tender. Step 7: Remove from sauce, cool slightly and remove strings before serving.

Ingredient Names: beef round steak, garlic clove, pecorino romano cheese, fresh flat-leaf parsley, salt and pepper, prosciutto, olive oil, garlic cloves, dry red wine, tomato puree, fresh basil leaves, ziti pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Place the beef between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound gently with a meat pounder or rubber mallet to a 1 / 4- to 1 / 8-inch thickness. Step 2: Sprinkle the beef with the garlic, cheese, parsley, and salt and pepper. Step 3: Cover with the prosciutto slices. Step 4: Roll up each piece like a sausage and tie it with kitchen string. Step 5: Heat the oil in a large pot. Step 6: Add the braciole and garlic. Step 7: Cook, turning the meat occasionally, until it is browned on all sides and the garlic is golden. Step 8: Add the wine and simmer for 2 minutes. Step 9: Remove and discard the garlic. Step 10: Stir in the tomato puree and basil.

Ingredient Names: lentils, onion, olive oil, ham, saffron strand, powdered saffron, dry white wine, hot chicken stock, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak lentils for about 6 hours Peel and halve the onion and place into a saucepan with 3 tablespoons oil and the ham. Step 2: Drain the lentils and add them to the saucepan, brown breifly, then moisten with the wine. Step 3: Add the saffron strands and powdered saffron. Step 4: When the wine has evaporated, pour just enough hot stock to cover the lentils. Step 5: Bring to a boil, lower the heat and cover and cook for 20 minutes. Step 6: Taste and add salt if necessary, then discard the onion and serve hot.

Dish Name: Braised Pork Roast With Garlic And Rosemary
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, sea salt, black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, boneless pork roast, whole milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f. Step 2: In a small bowl combine garlic, rosemary, sea salt, pepper and 3 tablespoons of the olive oil into a paste, set aside. Step 3: In a dutch oven or other oven-proof pot, heat remaining olive oil over medium heat Brown the pork roast on all sides, about 2 minutes per side. Step 4: Remove the pot from the heat and stir the milk into the pan juices. Step 5: Spread the garlic-rosemary paste over the top of the roast and cover the pot. Step 6: Place the pot in the oven and cook, basting occasionally with the pan juices, for 45 minutes. Step 7: Check the temperature of the roast It is ready when the thermometer regesters 155f.

Ingredient Names: rabbit, light olive oil, celery, garlic clove, dry white wine, rosemary, salt, fresh ground black pepper, warm water, bouillon cube, tomato paste, sugar, polenta
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rabbit pieces in cold water and pat dry. Step 2: In a deep wide skillet with a lid, put the oil, celery, garlic, and the rabbit in a single layer. Step 3: Cover and simmer over low heat for about 2 hours. Step 4: Turn the meat once or twice If some of the ingredients begin to scorch, add a little water. Step 5: After 2 hours, the rabbit may have thrown off a lot of liquid. Step 6: Uncover the pan, turn the heat up to medium, and cook until the liquid has evaporated, turning the meat from time to time. Step 7: Add the wine, rosemary, salt and pepper. Step 8: Simmer, uncovered, until the wine has evaporated Dissolve the bouillon cube, tomato paste, and sugar in the warm water.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour, heavy cream, garlic, onions, fresh bay leaf, parmesan cheese, lemons, salt, pepper, brandy
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in sauce pan. Step 2: Stir in the flour and let cook for 1-2 minutes over medium-low heat. Step 3: Chop garlic and add to roux (flour and butter mixture). Step 4: Whisk in the cream. Step 5: Pin the bay leave to the onion using the clove. Step 6: Place it in the cream and let steep (not simmer) for about 20 minutes. Step 7: Bring to a simmer then immidiatly remove from heat. Step 8: Stir in cheese,the juice of the lemon and the brandy. Step 9: Add salt and pepper to taste, be generous.

Ingredient Names: butter, red onions, red peppers, jalapeno pepper, eggs, parmesan cheese, tabasco sauce, salt, pepper, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in frying pan over medium heat Add onion and stir for 2 min add red pepper and jalepeno cook 2 minute more. Step 2: Remove from heat In a large bowl whisk eggs stir in cheese tabasco and seasoning add onion mixture. Step 3: Bake in oven at 350 degrees whisk before pouring in to 9 inch pie plate sprayed with Pam. Step 4: If making ahead wait until the onion mixture has cooled before adding cover and refridgerate overnight if desired.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red skin white potato, red bell pepper, green onions, sliced mushrooms, canadian bacon, egg substitute, milk, mozzarella cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Using medium shredder blade of food processor, shred the potato Warm olive oil in non-stick skillet, add potato, bell pepper, green onions, mushrooms and bacon. Step 2: Cook and stir until potato is lightly browned and other vegetables are crisp tender. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste, pour egg mixture over vegetables. Step 4: Cook until eggs are almost set, running spatula around edges and allowing uncooked egg to run to bottom of pan. Step 5: When eggs are almost set, invert onto a dinner plate and then slip back into pan allowing the bottom to cook completely The last few minutes top with shredded cheese and cover until cheese melts. Step 6: Cut in half and slip onto serving plates.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, yellow mustard, capers, fresh mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees Salt and pepper chicken breasts to taste. Step 2: Heat a small amount of olive oil in a skillet and brown chicken on both sides. Step 3: After browning, place chicken breasts in a 9 x 11 inches baking dish and brush with yellow mustard and sprinkle capers over the breasts. Step 4: Bake for 35 minutes, the last five minutes top with mozzarella cheese. Step 5: After cheese has melted remove and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: broccoli rabe, italian sausage, mushroom, eggs, garlic cloves, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Wash, cut into 2 inch pieces and blanch broccoli rabe in boiling water, drain. Step 2: Remove casings from sausage and cut into small pieces and cook till done. Step 3: Add mushrooms and garlic saute until lighty brownd. Step 4: Add broccoli rabe and cook for 2 minutes. Step 5: Beat eggs and add to pan. Step 6: Cook over medium / high heat till eggs are done. Step 7: Sprinkle cheese over and serve.

Ingredient Names: cavatelli, olive oil, butter, garlic cloves, chicken broth, broccoli, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook cavatelli according to package directions. Step 2: Drain Slowly melt butter in olive oil. Step 3: Add garlic and saut until lightly golden. Step 4: Add chicken broth and bring to boil. Step 5: Add broccoli, cover, simmer 6 to 8 minutes until broccoli is tender. Step 6: Place cooked cavatelli in bowl. Step 7: Add broccoli mixture and toss with parmesan cheese, serve.

Ingredient Names: broccolini, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, anchovy fillets, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the broccolini into long stalks and bring a large pot water to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large saut pan over medium-low heat. Step 3: Add the garlic and anchovies and cook 5 minutes, stirring often, until just golden brown and very fragrant While the garlic and anchovies cook, plunge the trimmed broccolini into the boiling water and cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Drain the broccolini well and add it to the pan with the garlic and anchovies. Step 5: Cook the broccolini over low heat until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Step 6: Remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, red onion, basil, salt, black pepper, oregano, virgin olive oil, italian bread
Instructions: Step 1: Dice onions and tomatoes in small pices, add salt pepper, oregano, olive oil chop basil. Step 2: Mix well refridgerate for 10 minutes. Step 3: Slice bread in 1 / 2inch slices toast lightly One tablespoon of bruscetta mix per slice.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Red Peppers And Goat's Cheese
Ingredient Names: red sweet peppers, yellow sweet pepper, extra virgin olive oil, salt and black pepper, fresh basil leaf, country bread, garlic, goat's cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 2: Put peppers on an unoiled baking pan and roast them in oven f or 20-30 minutes, until they start to collapse and the skins blacken. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and cover to trap moisture. Step 4: Leave for about 10 minutes until the skin loosens Peel the peppers, cut open and remove the stem and seeds Tear pepper flesh into strips Dress with olive oil, salt and black pepper, and basil Rub hot bread with the garlic cloves and sprinkle with salt, black pepper and olive oil Lay the peppers on top and crumble the goat's cheese over them Dribble over a little more olive oil and serve.

Ingredient Names: brussels sprout, bacon, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut sprouts off the stalk, if not on a stalk cut off any stem that remains on the sprout. Step 2: Slice the sprouts in half through the stem. Step 3: Fry bacon in skillet over medium high heat until crispy and fat is rendered. Step 4: Remove bacon to paper towels with slotted spoon. Step 5: Add sprouts to bacon fat and saute until just starting to brown, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add balsamic vingar to pan, cover and cook until the vinegar is reduced to syrup consistency, about another 5 minutes. Step 7: Sprinkle reserved bacon over sprouts and serve.

Ingredient Names: brussels sprouts, olive oil, prosciutto, butter, shallot, salt, fresh ground black pepper, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet over med-high heat. Step 2: Add prosciutto to skillet, half at a time, and cook until crisp. Step 3: Remove from skillet. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Add butter and shallots to skillet. Step 6: Cook and stir about 2 mins or until shallots begin to soften. Step 7: Add brussels sprouts, salt, and pepper and cook for 6-8 mins or until heated through. Step 8: Add vinegar and stir to coat. Step 9: Transfer brussels sprouts to a serving bowl, top with prosciutto and serve.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Chicken With Lemon
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, salt, flour, olive oil, white wine, lemons, unsalted butter, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Cut three lemons in half and use for fresh lemon juice. Step 2: Pour the juice through a fine strainer. Step 3: Cut the last lemon into wedges for garnish Begin to heat the olive oil in a 12 inch saut pan on med-high Pound the chicken to about 1 / 4 inch thickness While oil is getting hot, lightly season both sides of the chicken breast with salt Lightly dust the chicken breast in the flour, shake off excess flour. Step 4: Place chicken in the saut pan. Step 5: When the chicken is golden brown, turn over and brown the other side as well It is important to brown both sides to insure the chicken is completely cooked through.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Porchetta Rustica Copycat
Ingredient Names: pork loin, olive oil, salt, pepper, rosemary, butter, shallots, red wine, brown sugar, cinnamon, filberts, blueberries, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Place the pork loin in baking pan, fat side down. Step 2: Combine salt, pepper and rosemary in small bowl Rub pork with olive oil, then season both sides with seasoning mixture. Step 3: Bake pork loin, fat side up, in a 350 convection oven with the wind on Rotate pork after 30 minutes. Step 4: Cook pork another 20 minutes and check internal temperature The pork is done when the thickest part of the loin reaches an internal temperature of 140. Step 5: When pork is almost done, place the butter in a saut pan and melt over medium heat Do not allow butter to burn. Step 6: Add shallots and saut until they are translucent.

Dish Name: Butter Me Up Baked Butter Bean Bacon And Thyme Cassoulet
Ingredient Names: smoked bacon, onions, fresh thyme leaves, butter beans, creme fraiche, tomato puree, red wine, sugar, salt, pepper, olive oil, fresh breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, garlic granules, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat the oven to 200c / 400f lightly grease an ovenproof gratin dish with a little olive oil Topping: mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese and garlic together. Step 2: Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Step 3: Set aside Cassoulet: fry the bacon pieces in a large frying pan until crisp. Step 4: Take the bacon pieces out and add the chopped onions - fry them gently in the bacon fat until the onion is soft but not coloured. Step 5: Add the fresh thyme leaves and mix through. Step 6: Add the bacon to the onion and thyme mixture and then gently mix the butter beans through the mixture. Step 7: In a large bowl, add the crme fraiche, tomato paste, wine and sugar - mix thoroughly. Step 8: Season with pepper and a little salt, as the bacon is already quite salty.

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce leaves, tomatoes, bacon, caesar salad dressing, parmesan cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lettuce, tomato, bacon and salad dressing in large bowl, add cheese, toss. Step 2: Spoon mixture evenly onto tortillas. Step 3: Roll up tortillas burrito-style. Step 4: Wrap sandwiches in plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time.

Ingredient Names: golden rum, almond liqueur, brown sugar, espresso, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Warm liquors in a heat-proof cup, stir in sugar, and add espresso Stir again, top with cream, and serve.

Ingredient Names: amaretto, brandy, galliano, hot coffee
Instructions: Step 1: Grab your favorite coffee mug and add 3 / 4 oz of amaretto, 3 / 4 oz of brandy and 3 / 4 oz of galliano Fill your cup with hot coffee and serve.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, warm water, bread flour, sugar, salt, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve the yeast in the water and let it proof for 5 to 10 minutes The yeast should have a little island of fizz / bubbles before you start. Step 2: In a separate bowl mix all of the dry ingredients and create a little well in the middle Dump your yeast mixture and the olive oil into the well and stir with either your fingers or a wooden spoon. Step 3: Once a lumpy kind of dough forms lightly oil your hands and start to knead the ball. Step 4: Knead it for at least 5 minutes, until the dough is smooth but slightly tacky Lightly coat the ball in olive oil and place in an airtight container, allow to rise at room temperature for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours You can use the dough at this point, but for a finer texture and a nice, mellow sort of tang do the following: deflate the dough, bunch it back up into a ball, put it back into the container, and stow it in your refrigerator overnight About 2 hours before you're going to make your pizza remove the dough from the refrigerator, deflate again, and split into 2 equal portions. Step 5: Roll both portions into balls, sealing any cracks as tightly as possible.

Ingredient Names: french bread dough, ground beef, pepperoni, onion, green pepper, mozzarella cheese, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f On a lightly floured surface, roll out each ball of dough into rounds with 1 / 6 inch thickness On one side, add the fillings of your choice. Step 2: Fold over the other side and pinch to close the edges. Step 3: After pinching, roll the edges back to further seal the crust. Step 4: Transfer calzone to a lightly greased cookie sheet or jelly roll pan Lightly brush the calzones with olive oil or butter. Step 5: Bake calzones for 15 minutes or until crust is brown all over. Step 6: Serve with a side your favorite canned or homemade red sauce.

Ingredient Names: flour, eggs, salt, fresh ricotta, scamorza cheese, egg yolks, fresh mint leaves, prosciutto, salt and pepper, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation: Make the dough first. Step 2: Combine the flour, eggs, and salt, and knead well until the mixture is firm and elastic It will be quite firm, and if you can't incorporate all the flour add a little water to the mixture. Step 3: Then make the filling. Step 4: Place the ricotta in a medium mixing bowl and add the scamorza cheese, egg yolks, mint, and prosciutto and mix well. Step 5: Season the mixture to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Roll the dough out into a 1 / 8th in thick sheet and cut it into 4-inch squares. Step 7: Divide the filling up among the squares, setting it in the middle of each, and fold them over the filling, crimping the edges to seal them. Step 8: Place the oil in a deep fry pan and heat to 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: recipe pizza dough, olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, sun-dried tomato, fresh parsley, prosciutto, capacola ham, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare dough. Step 2: In a small skillet heat the 1 tbsp olive oil and saute the onion and garlic. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the parsley. Step 4: In a medium bowl mix together the ricotta and tomatoes. Step 5: Add the onion mixture and set aside. Step 6: Divide the dough into 4 pieces and roll each out into 10 to 12 inch rounds. Step 7: Spread even amounts of the ricotta mixture on 1 / 2 of each dough ruond, leaving 1 / 2 inch edge. Step 8: Divide meats equally among the round and place on top of ricotta, top with mozzarella. Step 9: Fold the plain side over top of calzone and press down lightly to remove some of the air Moisten the edges with water and crimp or seal with a fork.

Ingredient Names: part-skim ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, ham, oregano leaves, ready-to-bake refrigerated buttermilk flaky biscuits
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f and spray baking sheet with cooking spray In bowl combine first four ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Roll each biscuit between 2 sheets of floured wax paper, forming four 6-inch circles. Step 3: Spoon 1 / 4 of cheese mixture onto center of each Moisten edges of dough slightly, then fold each circle in half over the cheese filling. Step 4: Bake ten minutes or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: cannellini beans, garlic cloves, lemon juice, salt, fennel seed, dried rosemary, black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, pizza dough, frozen spinach, provolone cheese, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Place beans, garlic, lemon juice, salt, fennel seeds, rosemary, pepper and olive oil in a food processor and process until smooth. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl. Step 4: Grease or spray 1 large or 2 small cookie sheets Unroll pizza dough on a lightly floured work surface and press each into a 12 inch square. Step 5: Cut each into 4, 6-inch squares. Step 6: Combine spinach, provolone and olives. Step 7: Spread bean mixture over half of each dough square, dividing evenly, and then top with spinach mixture. Step 8: Fold other half of dough over filling, stretching slightly to fit. Step 9: Press edges with fork to seal well.

Ingredient Names: frozen orange juice concentrate, campari, sparkling water, ice cube, orange rind twists
Instructions: Step 1: Stir the orange juice concentrate and campari in a pitcher to blend. Step 2: Stir in the sparkling water. Step 3: Fill 6 tall glasses with ice. Step 4: Pour the campari mixture over. Step 5: Garnish with the orange peel twists and serve.

Dish Name: Canned Pizza Sauce For A Year
Ingredient Names: tomato paste, tomato juice, vegetable juice, chili powder, salt, dried cilantro, paprika, italian seasoning, garlic powder, dry mustard, dry parmesan cheese, celery ribs, white onions, white pepper, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In large stockpot add the first 10 ingredients. Step 2: Stir and cook on low heat. Step 3: Chop onions and celery, add to 3 cups of water in a separate pot, cook until tender. Step 4: Put the onions and celery in the blender Pulse until pureed. Step 5: Add to sauce ingredients. Step 6: Add parmesan cheese, white pepper and sugar, stir. Step 7: Heat to a boil and stir so that it will not scorch.

Ingredient Names: caperberries, fresh sweet basil leaves, fresh flat-leaf parsley, fresh mint leaves, pine nuts, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pick the stalks off the caperberries and blend with the mint pesto. Step 2: Place into an air-tight container and store in the fridge Mint pesto: pick the leaves of the herbs. Step 3: Place the basil, parsley and mint, pine nuts, garlic and parmesan in a fast liquidizer, pulse till blended Stop and scrape down the sides frequently while blending With the motor running slowly pour in the olive oil until it is thoroughly combined. Step 4: Season to taste with the salt and freshly ground pepper.

Ingredient Names: brewed espresso, milk, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Using an espresso machine or cappuccino maker, brew 2 shots of espresso. Step 2: Steam 1 cup milk, generating a good amount of thick froth for crema. Step 3: Divide espresso into 2 serving mugs. Step 4: Divide steamed milk between the 2 as well, then top each with half of the thick foam. Step 5: Dust with cinnamon and / or freshly grated nutmeg, if desired& serve.

Dish Name: Caprese Salad Tomatoes Italian Marinated Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil, salt, dried basil, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together and set on counter stirring occasionally The salt will bring out the juice of the tomatoes. Step 2: Taste and add more seasonings to your personal taste You can use fresh basil or oregano if preferred, just remember to chopped finely and use a little less than dried Uses: serve with almost any meal as a side On top of a green salad Use as a topping for bruschetta--just chop tomatoes instead of slicing Use for caprese salad--add sliced buffalo mozzarella and you're done Have some leftover juice: place some sliced chicken breasts and marinate over night, then carefully remove the chicken and quickly saut them until done. Step 3: Add remaining juice and tomatoes, boil for 1-2 minutes and then add cooked penne pasta, toss, and simmer for 5-6 minutes.

Ingredient Names: whipping cream, caramel topping, vanilla extract, brewed coffee
Instructions: Step 1: Beat whipping cream, caramel topping and vanilla extract with an electric mixer on low speed until soft peaks form. Step 2: Divide the caramel-whipped cream into 2 mugs then pour hot brewed coffee over the top.

Ingredient Names: golden sugar, water, panettone, unsalted butter, eggs well, milk, cream
Instructions: Step 1: To make the caramel, put the sugar and hot water into a small, heavy pan over a low-medium heat. Stir occasionally until the sugar has dissolved then raise the heat and boil, without stirring, until the caramel is golden brown. Step 2: Immediately remove the pan from the heat and quickly pour the caramel into a wide, fairly deep, 1.5 litre/2¾ pint ovenproof dish, swirling it around to cover the base. Set aside. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 160C/Gas 3/fan oven 140C. Cut the panettone into 1cm/½in thick slices then remove the dark brown, bottom crust. Butter one side of the slices generously. Put in a single layer, butter-side-up, in the dish. Step 4: Using an electric whisk or food mixer, beat the sugar and eggs in a large bowl for 2 minutes, or until thickened. Heat the milk and cream in a saucepan to just below simmering point, then pour on to the egg mixture and stir to combine. Step 5: Pour this custard over the panettone, pressing the slices into the liquid. Soak for 10 minutes. Step 6: Put the dish on to the middle shelf of the preheated oven, and bake for 55-60 minutes. The pudding is ready when the top is pale gold and dry-looking and the custard set to a just-firm shiver – it should not be completely solid as the custard continues to set as it cools. Leave it to rest for 30 minutes before serving with cream.

Ingredient Names: dried oregano, maple syrup, worcestershire sauce, chili paste, red wine vinegar, ponzu sauce, tomato ketchup, olive oil, chicken drumsticks, sweet onions, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the marinade ingredients in a bowl large enough to fit the chicken in a single layer, whisk to combine. Step 2: Place the chicken in the marinade for 20 to 30 minutes, spooning it over top a few times. Step 3: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 4: Place the chicken, onions, and tomatoes in a baking dish in a single layer. Step 5: Pour the marinade over top. Step 6: Bake until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 to 30 minutes The chicken should be browned on top, the onions brown around the edges, and the tomatoes should have burst.

Ingredient Names: onion, extra virgin olive oil, caster sugar, eggs, parmesan cheese, fresh thyme leave, fresh parsley, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onions very gently in half the olive oiluntil very soft and golden brown This will take about 30 minutes. Step 2: Sprinkle over the sugar and cook for a further 3-5 minutes, until caramalized, leave to cool. Step 3: Beat the eggs with the parmesan, thyme, parsley, salt & pepper, stir in the onion. Step 4: Heat the remaining oil in a heavy based frying pan. Step 5: Pour in half the mixture, making sure it gets its proper complement of onion. Step 6: Reduce the heat to moderate and cook until almost set through Lift out of the pan and invert the fittata back into the pan, uncooked side down.

Dish Name: Caramelized Onion Frittata With 3 More Variations
Ingredient Names: butter, oil, onions, eggs, cream, black pepper, cheddar cheese, thyme leaves
