Instructions: Step 1: Place butter and oil in a 23 cm non stick frypan over low heat and cook until butter has melted, add onions to pan. Step 2: Cook onions, stirring occasionally, for 10-15 minutes or until onions are golden brown, soft and caramelized. Step 3: Place eggs, cream and pepper in a bowl and whisk to combine. Step 4: Pour egg mixture over onions in frypan and sprinkle with cheese and thyme and cook frittata for 5-6 minutes or until it is almost set To finish cooking, place frittata under a preheated hot grill for 1 minute. Step 5: Cut into wedges and serve with hot buttered toast or with a spicy chutney Pumpkin frittata - add 1 / 2 cup mashed pumpkin or sweet potato when whisking eggs Blue cheese and potato frittata - when onions have cooked in the pan, sprinkle 1 cup cooked cubed potato over them, pour in egg mixture and sprinkle blue cheese instead of cheddar over eggs An.

Ingredient Names: red onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, pita bread rounds, tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan cook the onions and garlic in hot olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Cook, covered for 10-15 min or until the onion is very tender, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Set the onions aside. Step 4: Heat grill to medium heat Toast one side of each bread round directly over the heat for 1-2 minute. Step 5: Remove from the grill. Step 6: Top the toasted side of each bread round with the onion mixture, sliced tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, and romano cheese. Step 7: Return bread rounds to the grill, over indirect heat. Step 8: Cover the girll and cook for 5-10 min or until the cheese is melted and toppings are heated through. Step 9: Remove from the grill and top with basil before serving.

Dish Name: Caramelized Onion Sun Dried Tomato Pizza
Ingredient Names: pizza dough, dried tomato, olive oil, sweet onions, salt & pepper, garlic cloves, anchovy paste, dried oregano, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In medium bowl, cover dried tomatoes with boiling water and soak until soft, about 45 minutes. Step 2: Remove from bowl, squeeze out excess liquid If desired, reserve liquid for another use. Step 3: Now, heat 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add onions and reduce heat to medium-low Saut until slightly softened, a bout 5 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle salt and pepper Continue to saut until a rich golden brown color, about 20 minutes. Step 6: Add whole garlic cloves during last 10 minutes so they caramelize, keeping separate from onions when stirring. Step 7: Heat oven as needed to bake pizza for crust.

Dish Name: Carrabba's Italian Grill Sausage And Peppers
Ingredient Names: sweet italian fennel sausages, marinara sauce, pepper sauce, red pepper, yellow pepper, green bell pepper, red onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes, pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine peppers, red onion and garlic. Step 2: Cook for 5 minutes until al dente. Step 3: Add pepper, salt and crushed tomatoes. Step 4: Cook until sauce reduces to stew texture. Step 5: Spoon 8 ounces fresh pepper sauce with marinara sauce in pan. Step 6: Reduce to stew texture. Step 7: Grill links over grill until thoroughly cooked. Step 8: Spoon the sauce on a plate and top with sausage links.

Ingredient Names: butter, carrot, sugar, salt, marsala wine
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a medium saucepan, and add the carrots. Step 2: Stir well to cover with the butter. Step 3: Add the sugar and salt, and mix well. Step 4: Stir in the marsala, and simmer for 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Pour enough water to barely cover the carrots. Step 6: Cover the pan and cook over low to moderate heat until the carrots are tender. Step 7: Remove the cover, and cook until the liquids reduce almost completely, serve hot.

Dish Name: Cauliflower And Tofu Pizza Crust Gluten Free Low Carb
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, cauliflower, egg, mixed italian herbs, salt, pizza sauce, pizza toppings, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place a block of tofu in a bowl and top with a heavy weight to drain water as much as possible. Step 2: Place cauliflower florets in a food processor and process until a rice-like texture is achieved. Step 3: Fill a medium pan with an inch of water and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add the processed cauliflower and cook about 4 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain water and cool. Step 6: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Step 7: Place the cooled cauliflower in a nut milk bag or wrap with cheesecloth and squeeze excess water out as much as possible. Step 8: In a bowl, place drained tofu and use your hands to mash it well. Step 9: Add cauliflower, beaten egg, herb, and salt and mix well. Step 10: Press the dough out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

Ingredient Names: butter, cauliflower florets, eggs, heavy cream, whole milk, parmesan cheese, nutmeg, cayenne pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange a rack at the center position, and heat the oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Grease four 6-ounce ramekins or souffles. Step 3: Cover the bottom of each with a parchment circle cut to fit, and grease the parchment. Step 4: Place the ramekins in a baking pan large enough to hold them comfortably. Step 5: Fill a medium-size saucepan 2 / 3 full with lightly salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 6: Add the cauliflower florets and cook until very tender when pierced with a knife, for about 10 minutes. Step 7: Drain the florets well in a colander and pat dry with a clean kitchen towel. Step 8: Puree the cooked florets in a food processor until almost smooth. Step 9: In a medium-size bowl, whisk together the eggs, cream, milk, 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, nutmeg and cayenne pepper. Step 10: Add the cauliflower puree and whisk well.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, lemon, olive oil, butter, garlic clove, gorgonzola, mascarpone, milk, flour, salt, pepper, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven at 170c Clean and cook the cauliflower florets in salted water with the lemon juice, until done. Step 2: Mix the gorgonzola with the mascarpone. Step 3: Melt 30 g butter in a pan, add flour. Step 4: Mix and add the milk. Step 5: Mix in the cheese as soon as the mixture starts to cook. Step 6: Keep stirring over low heat with a wooden spoon, until thickened. Step 7: Add salt, pepper and nutmeg to taste. Step 8: Fry the garlic with the 10 g of butter and the olive oil, add the cauliflower and bake for 3-4 minute pepper and salt to taste. Step 9: Put the cauliflower in an ovenproof dish, put sauce on top and bake 15 minute in the oven until it starts to brown.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, tomatoes, garbanzo beans, artichoke hearts, garlic, dried basil, dried oregano, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except salt and pepper in a large saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Reduce ragu to desired consistence. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Serve with brown rice or pasta.

Ingredient Names: celery ribs, water, instant chicken bouillon, margarine, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Place celery, water, and bouillon in med saucepan, bring to boil. Step 2: Reduce heat, cover and cook approx 15 minutes or until celery is crisp-tender. Step 3: Drain, add butter, cover and let stand until butter melts. Step 4: Sprinkle with cheese and parsley.

Ingredient Names: simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes, egg, mozzarella cheese, prosciutto ham, ready-made pie crust
Instructions: Step 1: Bake pie crust according to directions Separate cheese 1 / 2 cup-1 / 4 cup. Step 2: Combine- egg, ham, 1 / 2 cup cheese - Mix in potatoes. Step 3: Pour in baked pie shell. Step 4: Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove from oven and put remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese on top. Step 6: Cook for another 20 minutes. Step 7: Remove and let sit for 10 minutes and serve.

Dish Name: Charcoal Makers Vermicelli Vermicelli Alla Carbonara
Ingredient Names: cooked ham, bacon, white onion, butter, extra virgin olive oil, eggs, fresh mushrooms, pecorino romano cheese, vermicelli, garlic salt, onion salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pasta: Place a couple of quarts of water in a large pot. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic salt and onion salt and bring to a rolling boil. Step 3: Add vermicelli, allow it to return to a boil then reduce to simmer for eight to nine minutes. Step 4: When a string of the cooked, vermicelli flung at the porcelain steel refrigerator door adheres to the door without dropping to the floor, the pasta is al dente Empty into a collander to drain, then place on the plate Coordinate with sauce to bring both to completion immediately before serving Sauce: Place 4 tbsp olive oil and butter in a small sauce pan over medium-low heat. Step 5: Add ham, bacon, onion and mushrooms and saut until onions are translucent.

Dish Name: Chard Onion Gruyre Panade Bread Casserole
Ingredient Names: yellow onions, olive oil, garlic cloves, salt, green swiss chard, water, bread, chicken stock, fontina
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare onions: place the onions in a deep saucepan and drizzle and toss with oil to coat, about 1 / 4 cup. Step 2: Set over medium-high heat and, shimmying the pan occasionally, cook until the bottom layer of onions is slightly golden around the edges, about 3 minutes, stir and repeat. Step 3: Once the second layer of onions has colored, reduce heat to low and stir in garlic and a few pinches of salt Stew, stirring occasionally, until the onions are a pale amber and tender but not mushy, about another 20 minutes If at any point the onions dry, cover them to trap some moisture. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 325f To prepare chard: place a few handfuls of leaves in a large saute pan or skillet with a drizzle of oil, a sprinkling of water, and a few pinches of salt. Step 5: Set the pan over medium heat until the water begins to steam, then reduce the heat and stir and fold leaves until just wilted, 3 to 4 minutes (leaves should be uniformly bright green, the white veins pliable.

Ingredient Names: dates, almonds, raisins, apples, oranges
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl Stir, cover and refrigerate Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: warm water, vegetable oil, yeast, all-purpose flour, heavy cream, butter, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Step 2: In a bowl, mix the water, oil, and yeast, stir in the flour. Step 3: Roll into a ball, and transfer to a well-oiled bowl. Step 4: Allow to rise 1 hour in a warm location, or until doubled in size Thoroughly grease a deep dish pizza pan Punch down dough, and transfer to the pan. Step 5: Cover dough with a cloth, and allow crust to rise 25 minutes, until puffy. Step 6: In a saucepan over low heat, mix the cream, butter, and cream cheese, stirring constantly, until melted and well-blended. Step 7: Mix in parmesan cheese and garlic powder.

Ingredient Names: turkey bacon, margarine spread, onion, red bell pepper, zucchini, plum tomatoes, fresh basil, ground black pepper, liquid egg substitute, low fat cottage cheese, low-fat milk, lowfat mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook turkey bacon per directions on package until crisp. Step 2: Set aside Crumble when cool Coat an ovenproof 10" skillet with cooking spray. Step 3: Melt the spread in the skillet. Step 4: Add the onion, bell pepper, and zucchini, and saute over medium-low heat until the vegetables are tender, 2 - 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, basil, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine. Step 6: Cook until the flavors are blended, 2 - 3 minutes, and remove from the heat. Step 7: Preheat the broiler. Step 8: In a blender, combine the egg substitute, cottage cheese, and milk and process until smooth.

Ingredient Names: italian sausages, onion, mozzarella cheese, french bread, mushrooms, tomato sauce, green peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the sausage links to 1 inch pieces, then cut each in half In skillet, on medium heat, brown sausage. Step 2: Drain, saving 1 tb of drippings In the fat, saute the mushrooms, green peppers and onion. Step 3: Then add the sausage and sauce. Step 4: Reduce the heat, simmering for 45 minutes Plit the bread loaves in half. Step 5: Spoon the meat mixture upon each half, sprinkling with the cheese. Step 6: Put loaves on baking sheet. Step 7: Let broil until cheese has melted.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, low-fat ricotta cheese, hamburger, parmesan cheese, egg, italian spices, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f spray two cookie sheets with non-stick spray In one bowl, beat the egg until well incorporated In another bowl, put your parmesan cheese along with any italian seasonings you like, and salt and pepper. Step 2: Slice eggplants into 1 / 2 inch slices. Step 3: Dip each slice in the egg, then into the parmesan cheese until covered. Step 4: Place on cookie sheet. Step 5: Cook at 425 for 20 minutes, turning the eggplant slices half way through. Step 6: Meanwhile, brown the hamburger. Step 7: Lower the oven temperature to 350f once the eggplant slices have finished cooking Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, italian turkey sausage, onion, fresh mushrooms, italian tomatoes, pasta sauce, dried basil leaves, turkey pepperoni, reduced-fat italian cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350f In 5-quart dutch oven, cook pasta as directed on package, omitting salt, drain. Step 2: Return to dutch oven. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a non sticl skillet crumble sausage and brown. Step 4: Add onion and mushrooms to sausage in skillet. Step 5: Cook 7 to 8 minutes, stirring frequently, or until vegetables are tender, stir in tomatoes, heat to boiling, reduce heat.

Ingredient Names: half-and-half, parmesan cheese, gorgonzola, white pepper, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sautee pan bring the half and half to a boil, be careful it will spill over if you don't stop it in time. Step 2: Remove from heat and sprinkle in the gorgonzola, pepper and lemon zest, stir once. Step 3: Add the parmesan a handful at time and whisk until the cheeses are fully melted and the sauce is thickend adding more parmesan if needed. Step 4: Return to very low heat if the cheeses did not melt all the way, do not bring back to a boil.

Dish Name: Chef Jeffs Sunday Gravy Spaghetti Sauce
Ingredient Names: italian sausage, olive oil, onion, bell pepper, garlic cloves, curry powder, dry mustard, whole bay leaf, oregano, tomato sauce, tomato paste, olives, tomato soup, water, mushroom
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in 1 tbs olive oil and drain. Step 2: Return meat to your sauce pot and add the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: Simmer for 2 or 3 hours. Step 4: Remove bay leaf before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground beef round, ground pork, italian sausage, onions, garlic cloves, carrots, celery, capers, roma tomatoes, fresh portabella mushrooms, whole canned tomatoes, olive oil, hunts tomato paste, water, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a sieve over a medium non-reactive saucepot, strain the tomatoes of their juice into the sauce pot. Step 2: Add the sherry vinegar, sugar, red pepper flakes, oregano, and basil to the tomato juice. Step 3: Stir and cook over high heat. Step 4: Once bubbles begin to form on the surface, reduce to a simmer. Step 5: Allow liquid to reduce by 1 / 2 or until liquid has thickened to a loose syrup consistency. Step 6: Squeeze each tomato thoroughly to ensure most seeds are removed. Step 7: Cut carrot, onion, and celery into uniform sizes and combine with olive oil and garlic in a non-reactive roasting pan over low heat Sweat the mirepoix until the carrots are tender and the onion becomes translucent, 15 to 20 minutes. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and capers to the roasting pan. Step 9: Place roasting pan on the middle rack of the oven and broil for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic clove, fresh parsley, salt, fresh black pepper, cherry tomatoes, lemon zest, sugar, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat oil at medium-low heat. Step 2: Add garlic, half of the parsley, salt and pepper and cook, while stirring, for about 2 minutes or until garlic begins to smell. Step 3: Add cherry tomatoes, lemon zest and sugar and keep on cooking at medium-high heat, stirring, for about 2 minutes or until cherry tomatoes have softened. Step 4: Add lemon juice and remaining of parsley and stir.

Dish Name: Chicken Bocconcini With Delicious Chunky Sauce
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic cloves, chicken, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, carrot, celery, fresh basil leaves, mixed italian herbs, salt & pepper, bocconcini
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pan and saute onions & garlic and brown chicken. Step 2: Add the tomatos, paste and vegetables. Step 3: Add all herbs and seasoning. Step 4: Bring sauce to a boil and then simmer for 20-30 minutes. Step 5: Once sauce is set to simmer, prepare pasta. Step 6: When water for pasta is boiling, add the bocconcini to the sauce and stir through You're aiming for the cheese to be a little melty but still hold most of it's shape. Step 7: When pasta is ready, serve and enjoy!, belissimo!

Dish Name: Chicken Breasts Smothered In Tomatoes And Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, onion, garlic, italian stewed tomatoes, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler Pound chicken with flat side of mallet to 1 / 4" thickness. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add chicken and cook turning once until no longer pink in center. Step 4: Transfer to plate, cover and keep warm. Step 5: Heat remaining oil in same skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add onions and garlic, cook and stir 5 minute. Step 7: Add tomatoes: bring to a simmer. Step 8: Return chicken to skillet, spooning onion and tomato mixture over chicken. Step 9: Sprinkle cheese over top.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, campbell's tomato soup, fresh parsley, mushrooms, plum tomato, mozzarella cheese, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken, cut into bite size pieces, cook thoroughly season to taste. Step 2: Mix in tomato soup, parsley, mushrooms, white wine, and tomato in with chicken, let sit on medium heat until the sauce bubbles, mix well. Step 3: Remove dish from burner, add mozzarella cheese Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt & freshly ground black pepper, all-purpose flour, unsalted butter, shallots, garlic, dry white wine, whipping cream, fresh italian parsley, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper Dredge the chicken in the flour to coat lightly Shake off any excess flour. Step 2: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a heavy large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add the chicken and cook until brown, about 5 minutes per side. Step 4: Transfer the chicken to a plate and tent with foil to keep it warm. Step 5: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in the same skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Add the shallots and garlic and saute until the shallots are translucent, stirring to scrape up any browned bits on the bottom of the skillet, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add the wine Increase the heat to medium-high and boil until the liquid is reduced by half, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, salt, pepper, dried oregano, oil, butter, fresh mushrooms, marsala wine
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts between sheets of plastic wrap until about 1 / 4" even-thickness. Step 2: Mix the flour, salt, pepper and oregano Dredge chicken pieces in the flour mixture, and shake off excess. Step 3: Heat both oil and butter in pan over medium heat. Step 4: Cook the breasts on medium for 2 two minutes on the first side, just until lightly brown. Step 5: Flip breasts over and add the mushrooms. Step 6: Cook for 2 more minutes and stir the mushrooms. Step 7: Add the marsala, cover and simmer for about ten minutes. Step 8: Transfer to serving plate.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, fresh rosemary, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, worcestershire sauce, garlic cloves, shallots, roma tomatoes, tomato paste, fresh basil, kosher salt, butter, parmesan cheese, thyme, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Thin chicken breasts to 1 / 2 inch either by cutting down or using a meat mallot. Step 2: In a ziplock bag, combine 1 / 4 cup olive oil, rosemary, balsamic vinegar, worstershire and chicken breasts Shake to cover and remove excess air. Step 3: Place in refrigerator to marinade at least 1 hour. Step 4: In a saute pan combine 1 / 4 cup olive oil shallots and garlic. Step 5: Saute for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add diced tomatoes, and tomato paste & simmer 20 min add fresh diced basil and simmer an additional 3 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat, place in food processor or blender and puree for 3-5 seconds Replace in saute pan over low heat until chicken is ready. Step 8: Cook lingune separately.

Ingredient Names: cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, oregano, basil, tomato paste, cream, water, eggs, pepper, chicken, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200 C Spread cottage cheese on the bottom of a glass pie plate and then sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Step 2: Mix chicken & 3 / 4 cup mozzarella cheese with the herbs & tomato paste and then add eggs. Step 3: Mix cream with water and add to the chicken mixture. Step 4: Pour into pie plate and bake for 25-30 mins. Step 5: Top with remaining mozzarella and bake for 5 mins more.

Ingredient Names: mixed mushrooms, balsamic vinegar, red bell peppers, tomatoes, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, italian rolls, pesto sauce, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate mushrooms in balsamic vinegar for at least 24 hrs under refrigeration, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Discard any excess marinade when ready to assumble sandwiches. Step 3: Slice peppers into 1 / 4-in wide strips. Step 4: Slice tomatoes into 1 / 4-in thick slices Trim any fat or rib meat from the chicken breasts & grill till done To assemble sandwich: slice 1 roll in half lengthwise. Step 5: Spread 1 oz of pesto on the bottom of the roll, then crumble 1 oz of feta on top of pesto, covering the entire surface. Step 6: Place a chicken breast on top of the feta, then 1 / 2 oz of mushrooms on the chicken, 1 oz of roasted red pepper strips on top of the mushrooms & finish w / 3 tomato slices & the top of the roll. Step 7: Insert 2 toothpicks, slice on the diagonal & serve.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, onion, spaghetti sauce, spinach, cheese, sour cream, ricotta cheese, crescent rolls, parmesan cheese, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit In large skillet, brown chicken and onion then drain. Step 2: Return meat to pan. Step 3: Add spaghetti sauce. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a medium bowl combine mozzarella cheese and sour cream. Step 5: Pour hot meat into an ungreased 12 x 8 inch dish. Step 6: Spoon cheese mixture over meat Unroll crescent roll dough over the top of the mixture. Step 7: Mix parmesan cheese and butter together, then spread over the top of the dough. Step 8: Bake 18-25 minutes or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: whole tomatoes, garlic cloves, pitted black olives, fresh oregano, sugar, fresh ground black pepper, sherry wine, extra virgin olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a bowl and use a fork to poke holes all over it. Step 2: Pour sherry over the chicken and let it marinate about 30 minutes You can chop things and prepare the sauce while you're waiting for the chicken to marinate For sauce: in a medium-sized saucepan, simmer the tomatoes, with their juice, and the garlic for 10 minutes Use a spoon to break up the tomatoes. Step 3: Add olives and oregano. Step 4: Cook 5 more minutes. Step 5: Add sugar and pepper and test for seasoning, adding in more if necessary. Step 6: Cover and keep warm while the chicken is cooking For chicken: heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken, boneless pork loin, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, egg yolks, nutmeg, salt, onions, flour, milk, chicken broth, diced tomatoes with juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees Filling. Step 2: In a medium heavy skillet over medium heat cook the onion and garlic in the extra virgin olive oil until translucent, about 7 minutes Do not brown While the onion mixture is cooking cut the chicken and pork into 1 inch cubes. Step 3: Add to onion mixture, stir frequently and cook until done, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Let the mixture cool for 15 minutes. Step 5: In a food processor combine the meat mixture with the ricotta cheese or cottage cheese Pulse until coarsely chopped. Step 6: Add the parmesan, egg yolks, nutmeg, and salt.

Dish Name: Chicken Stuffed With Potatoes And Olives
Ingredient Names: red potatoes, stuffed green olives, parsley, garlic cloves, capers, olive oil, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, place potatoes, olives, parsley, garlic, capers and olive oil Salt and pepper the chicken inside and out. Step 2: Toss the ingredients in the bowl gently and use to stuff the chicken Don't stuff too tightly. Step 3: Bake at 375 degrees for 75 minutes Quarter and serve the bird.

Dish Name: Chicken Vino Bianco Tastes Just Like Olive Garden
Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour, onion, garlic cloves, white wine, salt, pepper, sliced mushrooms, butter, roma tomato, cooked linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in skillet on med-high heat Lightly dredge chicken breats in flour, season with salt and pepper and brown sides in skillet and remove onto plate until later. Step 2: Stir in onions, garlic, and butter, cook until tender. Step 3: Then add mushrooms and cook until golden. Step 4: Stir in wine and bring to a simmer. Step 5: Return chicken to the pan, and cook over med-high heat until chicken is done. Step 6: Add tomatoes and cook until tender. Step 7: Serve over cooked fetticuine or liguine noodles.

Dish Name: Chicken With Peppers Zucchini And Tomatoes On Angel Hair
Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomato, all-purpose flour, salt, ground red pepper, chicken tenders, olive oil, garlic cloves, vermouth, italian tomatoes, zucchini, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, fresh thyme leave, water, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Place sundried tomatoes in small bowl and cover with boiling water for 5-10 min or until soft. Step 2: Drain and cut into slivers. Step 3: Combine flour, salt, and red pepper in a large bowl. Step 4: Add chicken and toss until evenly coated. Step 5: Heat oil in large skillet. Step 6: Add chicken and cook without stirring until golden. Step 7: Turn chicken and cook 3 minutes longer. Step 8: Add garlic and cook, stirring, 1 minute more. Step 9: Add vermouth and stir, scraping up cooked bits from sides of pan. Step 10: Add dried tomatoes, canned tomatoes, zucchini, bell peppers, thyme and water.

Dish Name: Chicken With Tomato Sweet Fennel Sausage And Polenta
Ingredient Names: boiling water, dried porcini mushrooms, chicken legs with thigh, salt, pepper, unsalted butter, olive oil, sweet italian sausage, dry coppa, leeks, onion, carrot, celery, garlic cloves, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Pour water over mushrooms in small bowl. Step 2: Cover and soak until soft, about 30 minutes. Step 3: Strain soaking liquid through fine sieve, reserving soaking liquid, rinse mushoorms. Step 4: Cut out any tough stems Pat chicken dry. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 6: Melt butter with oil in heavy dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add chicke and brown on all sides. Step 8: Transfer to plate.

Ingredient Names: potato, egg, salt, butter, onion, flour, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potato in salted water about 25 minutes until tender. Step 2: Drain and cool Peel the potato and rice it into a bowl, cool completely. Step 3: Beat the egg with the salt and optional onion and add it to the potato with the melted butter, mix, add the flour. Step 4: Mix well Lay a sheet of wax paper on your work surface Working with a heaping tablespoon of the dough at a time, roll it between your hands until it is 3-4 inches long and a half inch thick.

Ingredient Names: dark roast coffee, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, ice cubes, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: In blender container, combine condensed milk and vanilla, blend well. Step 2: Add coffee and gradually add ice, blending until smooth, serve immediately. Step 3: Top with whipped cream, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chives, cognac, fresh parsley, dijon mustard, worcestershire sauce, beef broth, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat skillet over medium high heat. Step 2: Add chives and cook about 10 seconds. Step 3: Add cognac and stir. Step 4: Add parsley, mustard, and worcestershire sauce. Step 5: Add beef broth and stir Swirl in 1 tablespoon butter and serve.

Ingredient Names: butter for, golden sugar, eggs, dark chocolate, cream, hard nougat, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Butter and line a 900g/2lb loaf tin with cling film. Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer. Put the sugar and eggs in a heatproof bowl, then place over the simmering water and whisk until pale, thick and doubled in volume. Remove from the heat, plunge the bottom of the bowl into cold water and continue whisking until the mixture is cool. Step 2: Melt the chocolate in the microwave on Low, stir, then fold into the egg mixture. Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold into the chocolate egg mixture with the nougat and pistachios. Step 3: Pour the mixture into the loaf tin, smooth the surface with a spoon, then cover and freeze until firm. This can be done up to 2 weeks ahead. To serve, turn out onto a serving dish, remove the cling film and leave in the fridge for 15 mins to soften slightly before slicing.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, cocoa powder, espresso powder, water, eggs, olive oil, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Step 2: Grease a large rectangular baking pan with a light coating of olive oil. Step 3: Sift all dry ingredients together. Step 4: In small bowl, dissolve espresso powder in 1/3 cup water. Step 5: Add eggs and olive oil and beat with a whisk until well-combined. Step 6: Pour wet ingredients into dry, add pistachios and (yes, I do this by hand) start mixing the flour gently into the liquids until all the ingredients have been incorporated and you have a malleable dough. Step 7: If the dough is a bit sticky, sprinkle over 1 tablespoonful of flour and turn dough into the flour to coat. Step 8: Knead the flour in. Step 9: The dough should now be malleable without being sticky. Step 10: If it is still sticky, repeat with another tablespoonful of flour. Step 11: Cut dough into 3 equal pieces and shape into logs that are about 12 inches long and 2 ½ inches wide (every person’s logs are slightly different – they will spread while baking so have a good distance between them). Step 12: Bake for 30 minutes. Step 13: The biscotti will have risen only slightly, spread out some, and have a cracked surface, cool completely. Step 14: Preheat oven to 300 degrees F. Step 15: With a serrated bread knife and a straight, downwards motion, cut biscotti at just under ½ inch intervals on the diagonal. Step 16: (this will leave you with 6 not-so-nice-looking end pieces that you can munch on there and then) Place the pieces, cut side down, back in the baking pan. Step 17: Not all the pieces may fit, in which case you’ll have to bake a second pan's worth after the first. Step 18: Staggering two pans is not suggested unless you have a convection oven and can use that feature to make sure there is even heat distributed within the oven. Step 19: Bake 15 minutes, turn pieces over, bake 15 minutes longer. Step 20: Cool completely and keep in an airtight container.

Dish Name: Chops Or Chicken With Prosciutto And Artichoke In Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, mushrooms, olive oil, onion, pepper, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, oregano, white wine, prosciutto, boneless pork chops, heavy cream, romano cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except for the cream and cheese in the crockpot. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Step 3: Remove the porkchops from the crockpot. Step 4: Mix the cream and cheese with the juices and vegetables remaining in the pot. Step 5: Return the chops to the pot and coat with sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, red bell peppers, garlic, crushed tomatoes, dry red wine, dried italian herb seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, fennel seed, bay leaves, salt, black pepper, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a dutch oven. Step 2: Saute onions, peppers and garlic, stirring often, until soft. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer gently, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring often Makes about 4 cups I usually make one pizza and freeze the other half for next time.

Dish Name: Ciabatta Deli Sandwiches A Hearty Italian Style Sandwich
Ingredient Names: ciabatta rolls, mayonnaise, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, red onion, green pepper, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaves, black olives, hard salami, vinaigrette, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Spread desired amount of mayonnaise on each ciabatta's top and bottom. Step 2: Layer the ciabatta bottoms with shredded lettuce, salt and peppered tomato slices, onion and pepper rings, mozzarella, basil leaves, the deli meats, and sliced olives. Step 3: Drizzle with vinaigrette and sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Step 4: Cover with the ciabatta tops. Step 5: Cut the ciabatta sandwiches in half on the diagonal and wrap in plastic wrap or waxed paper. Step 6: Take a few books and set on top of the sandwiches to weigh them down and soak in the vinaigrette Unwrap and enjoy! Step 7: Italian vinaigrette: 1 / 2 cup olive oil, 1 / 4 cup vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 / 2 teaspoon italian seasoning, 1 / 8 teaspoon coarse ground black pepper, and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt. Step 8: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl with wire whisk until well blended, cover.

Ingredient Names: eggs, fresh basil, parmesan cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, pancetta, potato, olive oil, cipollini onions, garlic cloves, spinach, roasted peppers, provolone cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Whisk together eggs, basil, parmesan, 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper in a large bowl. Step 3: Cook pancetta in a 10-inch heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring, until crisp. Step 4: Transfer with a slotted spoon to a large bowl then pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat. Step 5: Add potatoes and 1 / 4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper to skillet, and saut over medium-high heat until golden, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Cover skillet and continue to cook over medium-low heat, stirring a few times, until potatoes are just tender, about 3 minutes more. Step 7: Transfer the potatoes with a slotted spoon to bowl containing the pancetta. Step 8: Add 1 tablespoon oil to skillet and saut onion and garlic over medium-high heat until pale golden, about 4 minutes, then add spinach and saut until just wilted Gently add the potatoes and pancetta, the roasted peppers, and remaining tablespoon of oil into onion mixture, spreading it evenly. Step 9: Pour egg mixture evenly over vegetables and cook over medium-high heat, lifting up cooked egg around edges with a heat-proof spatula to let uncooked egg flow underneath, 2 to 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, baking powder, salt, sugar, unsalted butter, eggs, egg yolks, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325*F. Step 2: Mix flour, 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon, baking powder and salt in medium bowl to blend. Step 3: Beat 1 cup sugar and butter in a large bowl until fluffy. Step 4: Add 1 egg; beat well. Step 5: Add egg yolk; beat well. Step 6: Mix in vanilla, then dry ingredients. Step 7: Transfer dough to work surface and divide in half. Step 8: Shape each half into 9-inch long, 1 1/2 inch wide log. Step 9: Transfer logs to prepared baking sheets that you have lined with parchment paper. Step 10: Beat remaining egg in small bowl. Step 11: Brush logs with egg. Step 12: Bake until golden and firm to touch (dough will spread) about 50 minutes, cool on sheets. Step 13: Maintain oven temperature. Step 14: Mix remaining 3 TBS sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in small bowl to blend. Step 15: Using serrated knife, cut logs into 1/2 inch wide diagonal slices. Step 16: Place biscotti, cut side down, on baking sheets. Step 17: Sprinkle 1/4 tsp cinnamon sugar mixture over each biscotti. Step 18: Bake until pale golden, about 20 minutes. Step 19: Store airtight at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: cocoa powder, sugar, plain flour, whole milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the dry ingredients in a thick sauce pan. Step 2: Mix in the milk, a tbsp at a time until it becomes smooth and then add the rest of the milk at a faster pace. Step 3: Heat mixing all the time for about 5 minutes until thick. Step 4: Pour into 2 cups and serve steaming hot with a spoon on the side.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, sugar, balsamic vinegar, water, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the butter in a pan large enough to hold the onions. Step 2: Cook the onions in the butter for a few minutes while stirring. Step 3: Sprinkle on the sugar, the vinegar and enough water to barely cover the onions and bring to a boil. Step 4: Simmer until the liquid is completely gone, stirring occasionally, 15-20 minutes, watching carefully to avoid scorching. Step 5: Sprinkle with lemon juice & serve.

Ingredient Names: simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes, green onion, goat cheese, eggs, egg yolk, all-purpose flour, bacon, garlic cloves, frozen spinach, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare potatoes per package instructions. Step 2: Add onions and 4oz of goat cheese Reserve 2 cups of the mashed potatoes to make your gnocchi. Step 3: Add 1 large egg yolk and 1 cup of flour to the mashed potatoes. Step 4: Add more flour if needed and a pinch of salt The mixture should be a dough consistency. Step 5: Turn dough out onto a board and knead very little, just enough to get everything mixed together. Step 6: Cut dough into 4 pieces. Step 7: Roll each of the 4 pieces into log shapes about the size of your index finger. Step 8: Cut each log into 1 / 2" pieces.

Dish Name: Coconut panna cotta with pineapple salsa
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, full-fat milk, sugar, vanilla pod, powdered gelatine, coconut chips, ginger, pineapple, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the coconut milk and milk into a saucepan, then add the sugar. Split the vanilla pod in half and scrape out the seeds, then add to the pan with the empty pod. Bring to the boil, then remove from the heat and leave to infuse for 5 mins. Step 2: Spoon 200ml of the hot mixture into a small bowl. Shake over the gelatine and whisk into the mixture until dissolved. If you have difficulty dissolving the gelatine, return the mixture to a gentle heat for 1-2 mins. See know-how below). Stir into the rest of the coconut mixture, discarding the vanilla pod. Pour into 6 x 200ml metal dariole moulds and place in the fridge for at least 2 hrs until firm with a slight wobble. Can be made up to 2 days ahead. Step 3: For the salsa, tip the sugar and ginger slices into a small saucepan and pour over 100ml water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for another 5-10 mins until it turns slightly syrupy and light golden. Leave to cool, then discard the ginger slices. The syrup can be made up to 1 week in advance. Step 4: To serve, dip each dariole mould into boiling water for a moment to loosen the panna cotta, then turn onto a serving late. Arrange the sliced pineapple beside each panna cotta and scatter with chopped chilli. Drizzle with ginger syrup to finish.

Dish Name: Copycat Olive Garden Chicken San Remo
Ingredient Names: green peppers, yellow onions, mushrooms, olive oil, garlic, crushed tomatoes in puree, thyme, marjoram, black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, white wine, chicken bouillon granules, flour, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pot over medium high heat. Step 2: Add peppers, onions, mushrooms and saute, stirring constantly for 15-20 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes, herbs, wine and bouillon. Step 5: Lower heat and let simmer while preparing chicken. Step 6: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a lrage non-stick skillet Dredge chicken in flour and saute until golden As pieces brown, add to tomato-pepper sauce. Step 7: When all pieces have been added, cover and simmer for 10 minutes to finish cooking chicken. Step 8: Serve sauce over pasta.

Ingredient Names: eggs, fresh basil, olive oil, frozen whole kernel corn, zucchini, green onions, roma tomato, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the eggs and basil, set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large oven proof skillet. Step 3: Add the corn, zucchini, and green onions. Step 4: Cook and stir for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add tomatoes and cook uncovered over medium heat about 5 additional minutes or until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 6: Pour the egg mixture over vegetables in skillet and cook over medium heat As the mixture sets, run a spatula around edge of skillet, lifting egg mixture so uncooked portion runs underneath Continue cooking and lifting edges until egg mixture is almost set, the surface of the frittata will be moist. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese and place the skillet under broiler 4 to 5 inches from heat.

Dish Name: Costolette Di Maiale Con Salvia Pork Chops With Sage
Ingredient Names: potatoes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, pork chops, fresh sage leaves, bulb of garlic, prosciutto, butter, dried apricots, extra virgin olive oil, flour, pancetta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425f put your potatoes into a pot of salted water and bring to a boil Give them 3 or 4 minutes - you only want to parboil them - then drain them and allow them to steam dry Lay your pork chops on a board and insert a small paring knife horizontally into the side of each chop to make a hidden pocket. Step 2: Make sure the Be careful -watch your fingers! Step 3: Set aside 8 of the largest sage leaves. Step 4: Add 8 more leaves to your food processor with a peeled clove of garlic, the prosciutto, butter, apricots, and a pinch of salt and pepper and give it a whiz This is now a beautifully flavored butter that can be divided between the pork chops and pushed into the pockets Dress the 8 large sage leaves that you set aside with a little oil and press one side of them into some flour. Step 5: Press a leaf, flour side down, onto each side of the chops.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, tagliatelle, streaky bacon, red chile, egg yolks, parmesan, cream, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsely grate the courgettes, then place in a sieve over a bowl. Press to squeeze out all the liquid – this may take a few mins, but try to drain away as much as you can. Step 2: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water following pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat a large, non-stick frying pan, then dry-fry the bacon, stirring often, until crisp. Add the chilli and cook for 1 min more, then tip in the courgettes and cook on a high heat for 2-3 mins. Step 3: Mix together the egg yolks, cheese, cream and lemon zest. When the pasta is cooked, drain it, reserving a little of the cooking water. Tip everything back into the pasta pan and toss together. Divide into bowls to serve, with extra Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, fresh garlic, roma tomatoes, oregano leaves, salt, fresh ground black pepper, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the garlic in the olive oil in a nonstick pan, over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until the garlic's just starting to be translucent. Step 2: Add the remainder of the ingredients except for the tomato paste, reduce heat slightly and cook, stirring frequently, until the tomato juices evaporate. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in tomato paste.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic cloves, plain flour, sour cream, half-and-half, lemon juice, zucchini, parmesan cheese, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in saucepan. Step 2: Cook minced garlic in butter for 3-4 minutes or until soft, stir in flour. Step 3: Cook for one minute, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add sour cream, milk, and lemon. Step 5: Cook until heated through. Step 6: Add zucchini, and cook just until bubbly, add to pasta. Step 7: Add parmesan and black pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: lemons, vodka, low-fat milk, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the zest from the lemons with a vegetable peeler The fruit can be put aside for another use. Step 2: Make sure to scrape off any white pith from the zest. Step 3: Soak zest in vodka for 4 days. Step 4: Strain vodka through a fine-meshed sieve, discarding the zest. Step 5: Transfer vodka to a glass bottle. Step 6: Simmer milk and sugar over medium low heat, uncovered, until reduced to about 4 cups Should be about 25-30 minutes Skim off any foam. Step 7: Cool sweetened milk completely and then add to vodka.

Ingredient Names: butter, spring onions, mushrooms, chicken stock, double cream, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and mushrooms and cook while stirring until mushrooms are soft, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Stir in stock, cream and black pepper to taste, bring to a gentle boil and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until sauce reduces and thickens slightly. Step 4: Toss with your choice of pasta, sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve.

Dish Name: Creamy Oven Roasted Polenta With Chives
Ingredient Names: cornmeal, chicken broth, milk, salt, chives, parmesan cheese, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Grease a 3-qt Non-stick ovenproof skillet. Step 3: Pour in the cornmeal, milk, and chicken broth and stir with a fork until blended Also, try to avoid using very fine cornmeal - it does not come out as well. Step 4: Bake uncovered for 40 minutes. Step 5: Stir the polenta once, taste, add salt if needed, and bake for another 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove from the oven and let the polenta rest in the pan for 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in butter, cheese, and chives and serve.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, heavy cream, white vinegar, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the milk and cream in a pot over medium high heat. Step 2: Using an instant-read thermometer, warm the milk until it reaches 185 degrees Do not let the milk boil. Step 3: Remove the pot from the heat and add the vinegar. Step 4: Stir gently for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add salt and stir another 30 seconds. Step 6: Cover the pot with a towel and let stand at room temp for about 2 hours. Step 7: Line a large colander with a few layers of cheesecloth. Step 8: Set the colander over a large bowl or over the sink. Step 9: Transfer the curds to the colander with a slotted spoon.

Ingredient Names: floury potatoes, milk, butter, parmesan, flat-leaf parsley basil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15-20 mins until tender, then drain. Step 2: Put the milk and butter in the pan, bring to the boil, add the potatoes, then mash until creamy. Step 3: Stir in the cheese, season, then fold in the herbs.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, eggs, salt, fresh breadcrumb, parmesan cheese, cornstarch, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel eggplant and slice into 1 / 4 inch slices. Step 2: Add salt to egg and beat. Step 3: Add cheese to breadcrumbs. Step 4: Dip eggplant slices into cornstarch and shake off excess, dip into egg. Step 5: Press breadcrumb onto slices. Step 6: Fry till golden Salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, italian seasoning, vegetable oil cooking spray, rotini pasta, tomato sauce, onion, green pepper, mushroom stems and pieces, mozzarella cheese, turkey pepperoni, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray crock-pot with vegetable cooking spray. Step 2: Sprinkle ground beef with italian seasoning, mix well, set aside. Step 3: Place 1 cup dry pasta in crock-pot that has been sprayed with vegetable oil cooking spray. Step 4: Cover with 1 can tomato sauce. Step 5: Add 1 / 3 cup onion, 1 / 3 cup green pepper, 1 / 3 can mushrooms. Step 6: Spread 1 / 3 the seasoned ground beef over vegetables. Step 7: Top with 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese and 16 pepperoni halves. Step 8: Repeat, layering ingredients two more times. Step 9: Garnish with 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Crock Pot White Kidney Beans With Rosemary
Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, red onion, garlic cloves, potato, dried rosemary, fresh parsley leaves, salt, fresh ground black pepper, tomatoes, white kidney beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat and add pancetta. Step 2: Cook until it just begins to brown then place in your slow cooker. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and add onion to pan. Step 4: Cook, stirring, often softened. Step 5: Add garlic, grated potato, rosemary, parsley, salt and pepper to pan. Step 6: Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 7: Stir in tomatoes and bring to a boil. Step 8: Cook, stirring, until liquid is reduced by about 1 / 3, which will take about 2 minutes. Step 9: Add mixture to slow cooker, along with the beans. Step 10: Stir well, then add just enough water to barely cover mixture.

Dish Name: Crusty Meatball Pasta Low Fat Hi Energy
Ingredient Names: passata, dark muscovado sugar, garlic cloves, lemon, chili, parsley, white bread, ground lean pork, egg, pasta, chili flakes, dried oregano, garlic powder, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the passata, sugar, oregano, garlic powder and chilli flakes in a large pan and heat gently. Step 2: Put the fresh garlic, chilli, parsley and lemon rind into a processor and whizz together until finely chopped. Step 3: Add the bread and whizz to make crumbs, then add the pork mince, egg and seasonings, and pulse briefly until well blended-don't over do it though! Step 4: Shape the mixture into about 20 small meatballs and drop them into the sauce and simmer about 20 minutes. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees. Step 6: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions, then drain and toss with the sauce. Step 7: Transfer to an ovenproof dish and scatter with the parmesan and some freshly ground black pepper. Step 8: Bake for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: instant coffee, water, sugar, pure vanilla extract, alcohol
Instructions: Step 1: Steep 1 3 / 4 ounces of instant coffee in 4 cups of boiling water. Step 2: Make a syrup by putting 6 cups of sugar in 5 cups of boiling water- allow to cool- then add 2 ounces of pure vanilla extract. Step 3: Mix syrup with coffee mixture then add 1 3 / 4 pints of 190 proof ethyl alcohol. Step 4: Let cool and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, eggs, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, pizza cheese, garlic powder, pizza sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Beat together cream cheese and eggs till smooth. Step 2: Add cream, parmesan cheese and spices Spray a 9-inch or larger glass baking dish with oil. Step 3: Put the cups pizza cheese in dish and pour egg mixture over it. Step 4: Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until eggs are set. Step 5: Spread on pizza sauce, mozzarella cheese and favorite toppings. Step 6: Bake until bubbly and browning. Step 7: Let stand 10 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: warm water, sugar, all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, olive oil, cornmeal, onion, garlic, plum tomatoes, fresh ground black pepper, hot red pepper flakes, fresh spinach, part-skim mozzarella cheese, swiss cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Crust: proof yeast in water with sugar. Step 2: In a food processor or in a bowl, mix 2 cups of the all-purpose flour, whole-wheat flour and salt. Step 3: Add oil to bubbly yeast mixture and stir or process into flour mixture until dough pulls away from sides of bowl Scrape dough onto floured work surface and knead until smooth and elastic, using up to 1 / 4 cup more all-purpose flour, if needed, to keep dough from sticking. Step 4: Place dough in oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise, in warm place, until doubled Punch dough down, wrap it well and refrigerate until needed Sauce: in a skillet, saute onion and garlic in oil until soft. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and add tomatoes and their liquid Break up the tomatoes slightly and add the salt, sugar, pepper, and pepper flakes. Step 6: Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until very thick, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic, salt, sugar, sweet pepper flake, fresh coarse ground black pepper, dry mustard, paprika, celery seed, vinegar, salad oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, whirl the first 10 ingredients until in fine particles Into a screwtop jar, pour the vinegar, water, and seasoning mixture Shake well. Step 2: Store in fridge and shake when ready to use.

Dish Name: Delicious Veal And Pork Bolognese Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, onion, fresh garlic, celery, carrots, dried thyme, dried basil, dried red pepper flakes, bay leaves, tomato paste, ground veal, ground pork, dry red wine, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add in the diced bacon and saute until beginning to brown. Step 3: Add in the onion, celery, carrot, garlic, thyme, basil, dryed pepper flakes and bay leaves. Step 4: Saute for about 5-6 minutes. Step 5: Add in tomato paste. Step 6: Cook stiring with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes. Step 7: Then add in the ground veal and pork. Step 8: Cook until cooked through and well browned. Step 9: Add in the wine then simmer for about 8 minutes uncovered. Step 10: Add in the broth and crushed tomatoes.

Dish Name: Diabetic Italian Sausage And White Bean Stew
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic clove, green pepper, onion, celery, italian turkey sausage, dried oregano, dried thyme, dried basil, cannellini beans, italian tomatoes with juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Add the green pepper, onion, and celery. Step 3: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add in sausage and cook until browned. Step 5: Add in rest of ingredients and bring to a boil. Step 6: Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer the tomato sauce with the seasonings for about 20 minutes You may alter the amounts of the seasonings to suit your tastes Use with bread sticks - pizza hut style posted on this site.

Dish Name: Dirty Your Deep Dish Pan Pizza
Ingredient Names: baking potato, unbleached all-purpose flour, instant yeast, salt, warm water, extra virgin olive oil, tomato sauce, pesto sauce, chicken sausage, sun-dried tomato, onion, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, pine nuts, hot pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Crust: Bring 1 quart water and the potato to a boil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook until tender 10 - 15 minutes. Step 3: Drain the potato and and cool until it can be handled. Step 4: Press potato through a potato ricer or grate on the large holes of a box grater Measure 1 1 / 3 cups lightly packed potato. Step 5: Discard the remaining potato Adjust an oven rack to the highest position and the other rack to the lowest position. Step 6: Heat the oven to 200 degrees. Step 7: Once the temperature reaches 200 degrees, maintain the heat for 10 minutes then turn off the heat.

Dish Name: Dom's Sausages With Peppers And Onions
Ingredient Names: italian sausages, olive oil, garlic cloves, onions, sweet red peppers, green bell peppers, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Pierce each sausage in several places and place in a heavy frying pan with 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 2: Cook over medium-low heat, turning occasionally, until well-browned While sausages are cooking, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and saute the garlic and onion. Step 3: Stir in peppers and oregano and cook until onions are lightly browned and the peppers are tender.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, garlic, fresh parsley, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mince garlic and parsley seperatly in a food proccesor. Step 2: Fold into mayo until evenly distributed. Step 3: Add olive oil and salt and whisk and whisk and whisk and whisk I usually use a little -- it makes great and easily spreadable garlic butter, and put the rest back in the mayo jar.

Ingredient Names: cherries stones, cream, powdered sugar, eggs, wafers
Instructions: Step 1: Set aside a handful (about 50g) of the pitted cherries. Place the remainder in a large pan set over a medium heat with the cream and 50g icing sugar. Bring up to the boil, then gently simmer for 5 mins until the cherries start to soften. Carefully whizz in a blender, then pass through a sieve. Step 2: Pour a little of the hot cherry cream over the egg yolks, whisk well, then pour back into the pan. Cook for about 5 mins more or until the mixture has thickened a little and will coat the back of a wooden spoon. Pour through a sieve into a bowl, cover the surface with cling film, then leave to cool completely. Step 3: Whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form, then whisk in the remaining 50g sugar, 1 tbsp at a time. Keep whisking until the mixture is stiff and resembles shaving foam. Stir a third of the mixture into the cooled cream, mix until it is well incorporated, then gently fold through the remaining mixture in 2 goes. Step 4: Line a 900g loaf tin with cling film. Pour the mixture into the tin, then cover with cling film and place in the freezer for about 3 hrs until just starting to freeze. Stir the whole cherries into the semi-frozen mixture, then return to the freezer for at least 8 hrs or preferably overnight. Serve cut into slices with some berries, or sandwiched between wafers.

Dish Name: Drink From The Bowl Spaghetti Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, red pepper flakes, onion, garlic cloves, mushrooms, crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, water, dried basil, italian seasoning, dried parsley, brown sugar, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat evoo in pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Sprinkle red pepper flakes and move pot to distribute the oil evenly for 1 minute. Step 3: Add onion and saute for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and saute for 1 minute. Step 5: Add any extra veggies or continue on to. Step 6: Add the next 11 ingredients and mix thoroughly. Step 7: Let sauce come to a boil and stir in the red wine. Step 8: Lower heat and allow to simmer for 1-2 hours. Step 9: Make sure to stir every 15-20 minutes to prevent the sauce from burning on the bottom of the pan Optional: can add uncooked meatballs to simmering sauce, just make sure to simmer for at least 45 minutes to an hour.

Ingredient Names: campari, fresh lemon juice, sparkling wine
Instructions: Step 1: Shake campari and lemon juice well over ice in a shaker Strain into a champagne flute, fill with prosecco and serve.

Ingredient Names: beer, warm water, oil, whole wheat flour, white flour, yeast, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar with yeast and warm water, allow to sit until frothy, about 5-7 minutes. Step 2: Combine dry ingredients. Step 3: Mix in the oil, beer, and yeast mixture. Step 4: Knead the dough well, adding flour as needed until the dough is no longer sticky but is still soft and pliable. Step 5: Allow the dough to rise in a warm place I usually stick it into a slightly warmed oven covered with a clean tea towel. Step 6: Allow to rise for whatever amount of time you have, i usually let it rise just as long as it takes me to cut toppings and grate cheese for the pizza Role the dough for your pizza pans, your dough should be about 1 / 2cm thick. Step 7: Allow to rise on the pans for about 10-20 minutes before topping your pizzas. Step 8: Bake in a hot oven for about 10 minutes or until the cheese in golden brown and the underneath of the crust is golden brown.

Ingredient Names: frozen bread dough, mozzarella cheese, ham, provolone cheese, genoa salami, swiss cheese, capicola, parmesan cheese, eggs, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Oil bottom & sides of lasagna size pan. Step 2: Knead & roll doughs 2 inches longer than pan. Step 3: Place dough in pan, stretch it 2 inches past sides. Step 4: Layer ingredients, meat, cheese, meat, cheese. Step 5: Pour the beaten eggs over the top of layers. Step 6: Cover top with other kneaded, rolled, stretched dough Pinch together, all around pan. Step 7: Brush top with egg wash. Step 8: Bake 375 degrees 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: salted butter, half-and-half, milk, white flour, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, black pepper, nutmeg, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a sauce pan. Step 2: Whisk in 1 / 4 cup each of parmesan cheese, and flour. Step 3: Cook about 2-3 minutes, be sure to stir all the while Slowly whisk in the remaining 1 / 2 and 1 / 2. Step 4: Add in your garlic powder, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Step 5: Whisk slowly for about 3-5 minutes If too thick thin out with milk You can also add at the very end some spinach, or whatever you'd like to add more flavor. Step 6: Serve over pasta of your choice or as a white pizza sauce.

Ingredient Names: pizza crusts, barbecue sauce, beef steaks, cheese, green pepper, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450. Step 2: Spread crust with barbecue sauce. Step 3: Add steak strips, cheese, pepper and onion to pizza. Step 4: Place on cookie sheet. Step 5: Bake for 8-10 minutes or until cheese is melted Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, ricotta cheese, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Line a 12 inch pizza pan with foil and spray with nonstick spray coating. Step 3: Press dough onto foil in pan forming a 12-inch circle. Step 4: In a large mixing bowl stir together cheeses then spoon 1 / 2 of mixture onto dough. Step 5: Fold dough over filling to form a half-circle Seal edges, then use the edge of a spoon to make decorative edge, if desired. Step 6: Cut slits for escape of steam. Step 7: Repeat for the other package of dough. Step 8: Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or till filling is heated through and cheese is melted. Step 9: Cover with foil after 10 minutes of baking to prevent over-browning.

Ingredient Names: onion, red bell pepper, olive oil, ramen noodles, water, salt, tomato sauce, italian seasoning, pepperoni, sliced ripe olives, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a small saucepan, add onion and pepper, and cook until slightly softened. Step 2: Add water, bring to a boil. Step 3: Add salt, add ramen to pot, and boil until softened. Step 4: Drain pasta, onions and peppers, add tomato sauce, italian seasoning, pepperoni, olives, and cheeses. Step 5: Mix well and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: cornmeal, ground beef, flour, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, milk, eggs, onion, mushrooms, pizza sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 425. Step 2: Grease a 12-inch pizza pan Lightly sprinkle with cornmeal. Step 3: In a skillet, brown the ground beef, drain off fat. Step 4: In a medium bowl, combine flour, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, milk & eggs. Step 5: Blend until smooth. Step 6: Pour batter in pizza pan, tilting to cover bottom evenly. Step 7: Spread beef over batter. Step 8: Top with mushrooms & onions.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, salt, olive oil, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the eggplants and cut them into 1 / 4 inch thick slices. Step 2: Layer the slices in a colander, sprinkling each layer with salt. Step 3: Let drain for 30 minutes. Step 4: Rinse the eggplant and pat dry. Step 5: Pour about 1 / 2 inch oil a large deep skillet and heat over medium heat. Step 6: Fry the slices, in a single layer, turning once, until browned on both sides. Step 7: Drain on paper towels. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 350. Step 9: Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce in a shallow baking dish. Step 10: Make a layer of eggplant slices, overlapping them slightly.

Ingredient Names: ketchup, red wine vinegar, ground mustard, garlic powder, cajun seasoning, cayenne pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, paprika, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except for the oregano in a saucepan and simmer on low heat to combine flavors This should only take about 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the oregano and cook for another 30 seconds If the smell of the oregano is not coming through, add another 1 / 4 tsp of oregano and paprika and cook for another 30 seconds If the ketchup gets too thick, you can add some water to thin it. Step 3: Take the ketchup off the heat and cool before using.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, salt, sugar, water, olive oil, garlic powder, basil, rosemary, thyme, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve 1 / 2 cup salt and sugar with water in large bowl Submerge pork, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients in a teacup and let sit at room temperature I've substituted italian seasoning for the herbs and it works very well. Step 3: Rinse roast under cold water and pat dry with paper towels Rub herb mixture over entire pork loin. Step 4: Place in loaf pan and cook at 325f for 90 minutes Tent pork and let rest for 10 minutes. Step 5: Slice and serve with stuffing or mashed potatoes and gravy.

Dish Name: Easy Low Carb Pizza Sauce And Pasta Sauce Base
Ingredient Names: tomato paste, water, italian seasoning, granulated garlic, ground paprika, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place tomato paste in a small mixing bowl. Step 2: Add water, using some of the water to rinse the last of the paste out of the cans, stir well 2. Step 3: Add seasonings and stir again You will have a very thick pizza sauce. Step 4: Add more water if you like a thinner sauce 3. Step 5: Refrigerate leftovers up to one week.

Ingredient Names: whipping cream, butter, parmesan cheese, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a 1 quart dish, micro-cook cream and butter at high for 2-3 minutes or until very hot. Step 2: Stir in parmesan cheese and pepper and toss with hot cooked pasta I usually top with fresh parsley to dress it up Variations: mushrooms, tomatoes, broccoli, shrimp and / or chicken can all be added but must be cooked before hand.

Ingredient Names: pita bread, spaghetti, mozzarella cheese, spices, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Brush on a little olive oil on the pita. Step 2: Spread sauce on top of the pita. Step 3: Sprinkle on the shredded cheese. Step 4: Sprinkle on pinches of desired herbs and spices, and add any toppings you'd like. Step 5: Place on baking sheet, bake for 5-7 minutes at 400, or until cheese is melted. Step 6: Slice with pizza cutter and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, green bell pepper, eggplant, zucchini, mushrooms, oregano, basil, red wine, canned tomatoes, tomato sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot heat oil. Step 2: Add garlic, onion, bell pepper, eggplant, zucchini and mushrooms. Step 3: Saute, uncovered, until vegetables are softened About 10minutes. Step 4: Add oregano, basil, salt and pepper. Step 5: Simmer for 1 minute. Step 6: Add wine and bring to boil. Step 7: Add tomatoes and tomato sauce and bring to a simmer. Step 8: Simmer uncovered over low heat for 30-40minutes. Step 9: Serve topped with parmsean cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless veal steaks, mushroom, olive oil, vegetable broth, marsala wine, butter, flour, salt and pepper, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: When the oil is hot, dredge both sides of the veal in flour, shake off extra and place in pan. Step 3: Add the mushrooms and saute veal and mushrooms until veal is lightly browned on both sides, drain oil and return to heat. Step 4: Turn the heat to high, add the marsala wine, and scrape loose all the little browned bits. Step 5: Add butter and vegetable broth and sprinkle with a little flour to thicken sauce. Step 6: Cook until until the liquid is reduced by half. Step 7: Transfer the veal to warm serving plates, pour sauce over them and serve over noodles if desired.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, tomato sauce, salt, dried oregano, dried basil, pepper, zucchini, cream-style cottage cheese, egg, all-purpose flour, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink, drain. Step 2: Add tomato sauce and seasonings, bring to boil. Step 3: Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, cut zucchini into 1 / 4-in Slices In small bowl, combine cottage cheese and egg. Step 5: In a greased 3-qt Baking dish, place half of the zucchini.

Ingredient Names: eggs, plain breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, garlic, salt and pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs in medium sized bowl until "frothy" Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Step 2: Heat olive oil in frying pan. Step 3: Drop batter by spoonful into oil and fry on both sides about 3 minutes, until golden. Step 4: Once you turn the egg cakes over, they will start to puff up a little. Step 5: Serve with pasta and tomato sauce.

Ingredient Names: dried yeast, caster sugar, plain flour, salt, olive oil, eggs, tomato paste, ham, reduced-fat tasty cheese, green onions, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 210c / 190c fan-forced. Step 2: Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Step 3: Combine yeast, sugar and 1 cup lukewarm water, in a large jug. Step 4: Using a fork, stir. Step 5: Cover, then let stand in a warm place for 5 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface Sift flour and salt into large bowl. Step 6: Add yeast mixture and oil, mix to combine. Step 7: Turn out dough onto a lightly floured surface. Step 8: Knead for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, eggs, red bell pepper, black olives, pepperoni, italian seasoning, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese, roma tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Spray oven-proof skillet with cooking spray and pre-heat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Prepare ramen noodles according to directions. Step 3: Drain noodles and spread into the bottom of skillet In mixing bowl, beat eggs. Step 4: Stir in pepper, olives, italian seasoning, and garlic powder. Step 5: Pour egg mixture over noodles. Step 6: Place pepperoni slices evenly over eggs and noodles. Step 7: Bake in oven for 15 minutes. Step 8: Remove skillet from oven. Step 9: Top with mozzarella cheese and tomato slices.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, eggs, english muffin, garlic, parmesan cheese, marinara sauce, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat marinara sauce in microwave until warmed, or heat in sauce pot until warmed. Step 2: Drain sauce, in paper toweled colander to get extra juice out of sauce, set aside. Step 3: In a heavy small skillet over medium heat, warm olive oil Gently crack each egg into warmed skillet. Step 4: Add dash of salt and pepper. Step 5: Cover skillet and cook until the whites are cooked Toast muffins and while still warm, rub the garlic on muffin and add parmesan cheese. Step 6: Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of sauce as desired. Step 7: Place cooked egg carefully atop the sauce covered toasted english muffin.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, tomatoes, green bell peppers, red bell peppers, scotch bonnet pepper, celery, fresh italian parsley, tomato paste, warm water, dried oregano, dried thyme, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and slice the eggplant. Step 2: Sprinkle well with some salt in a strainer and let sit for 30 minutes. Step 3: Rinse salt off well, and pat dry on towelling. Step 4: Heat the first amount of oil in a fry pan and saute each slice of eggplant just until golden with brown colourings. Step 5: Arrange eggplant in the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking pan Hint: sometimes i brush oil on my eggplant and place on a cookie sheet, and bake in the oven turning once to brown each side, maybe a total of 12 minutes, instead of the frying Also with the pan frying you might have to add more oil, as the eggplant will absorb the oil. Step 6: After layering into your baking dish set oven to 350 degrees f. Step 7: Heat the second tablespoon on olive oil in a skillet and saute onion, peppers, and celery for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and cook two minutes.

Dish Name: Eggplant Aubergine Rollatini With Three Cheeses
Ingredient Names: eggplants, feta cheese, whole milk ricotta cheese, egg, parmesan cheese, fresh lemon juice, fresh parsley leaves, scallion, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the eggplant slices lightly with salt on both sides and let them drain in a colander for 30 minutes. Step 2: In a food processor chop fine the feta, add the ricotta, the egg, 1 / 2 cup of the parmesan and the lemon juice and blend the mixture until it is smooth. Step 3: Add 1 / 4 cup of the parsley and the scallion and process the mixture for 10 seconds. Step 4: Transfer the eggplant slices to paper towels and pat them dry. Step 5: Arrange one third of the eggplant slices in one layer on a jelly-roll pan, brushed with the oil, and brush the tops with the oil. Step 6: Cook the eggplant slices under a preheated broiler about 4 inches from the heat, turning them once and brushing them again with the oil, for 8 to 10 minutes, or until they are browned lightly on both sides. Step 7: Transfer them to paper towels to drain and cook the remaining slices in the same manner. Step 8: Put 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture at a short end of each slice and roll up the slices to enclose the filling. Step 9: Spread 1 / 4 cup of the sauce in a 10-by-7-inch baking pan and arrange the eggplant rolls in one layer on the sauce. Step 10: Pour the remaining sauce over the rolls and sprinkle it with the remaining 1 / 4 cup parmesan.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, onions, mushrooms, spinach, eggs, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in an oven proof skillet. Step 2: Add garlic, onions and mushrooms cooking until onions are translucent. Step 3: Add spinach, sautee for 2 minutes. Step 4: Beat eggs, salt& pepper together. Step 5: Pour over mixture in skillet, stirring to combine. Step 6: Cook eggs for about 4 minutes, eggs will be almost but not quite set still moist on top. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese and put in oven. Step 8: Broil 6" from heat for 3-4 minutes or until eggs are set and cheese is lightly browned.

Dish Name: Frittata with Asparagus, Tomato, and Fontina
Ingredient Names: eggs, whipping cream, salt, ground black pepper, olive oil, butter, fresh asparagus, tomatoes, fontina
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the broiler. Step 2: Whisk the eggs, cream, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and pepper in a medium bowl to blend, set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil and butter in a 9 1/2-inch-diameter nonstick ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add the asparagus and saute until crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Raise the heat to medium-high. Step 6: Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and saute 2 minutes longer. Step 7: Pour the egg mixture over the asparagus mixture and cook for a few minutes until the eggs start to set. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 9: Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the frittata is almost set but the top is still runny, about 2 minutes. Step 10: Place the skillet under the broiler. Step 11: Broil until the top is set and golden brown on top, about 5 minutes. Step 12: Let the frittata stand 2 minutes. Step 13: Using a rubber spatula, loosen the frittata from skillet and slide the frittata onto a plate.

Ingredient Names: flour, baking powder, mixed spice, golden sugar, eggs, oranges, raisins, cherry, blanched almonds, pistachios
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Line 2 baking sheets with baking paper. Put the flour, baking powder, spice and sugar in a large bowl, then mix well. Stir in the eggs and zest until the mixture starts forming clumps, then bring the dough together with your hands – it will seem dry at first but keep kneading until no floury patches remain. Add the fruit and nuts, then work them in until evenly distributed. Step 2: Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and divide into 4 pieces. With lightly floured hands, roll each piece into a sausage about 30cm long. Place 2 on each tray, well spaced apart. Bake for 25-30 mins until the dough has risen and spread and feels firm. It should still look pale. Remove from the oven, transfer to a wire rack for a few mins until cool enough to handle, then turn down the oven to 140C/fan 120C/gas 1. Step 3: Using a bread knife, cut into slices about 1cm thick on the diagonal, then lay the slices flat on the baking sheets. The biscuits can be cooled and frozen flat on the sheet at this point, then bagged and frozen for up to 2 months. Bake for another 15 mins (20 mins if from frozen), turn over, then bake again for another 15 mins until dry and golden. Tip onto a wire rack to cool completely, then store in an airtight tin for up to one month, or pack into boxes or cellophane bags if giving as gifts straightaway.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, butter, fresh basil, ciabatta, parmesan, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill to high. Step 2: Beat together the mayonnaise, butter and garlic cloves until smooth. Step 3: Chop basil, stir through and season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Put the halves of the ciabatta, sliced lengthways, on a baking tray and spread with the butter. Step 5: Sprinkle with grated Parmesan, then grill for 2-3 mins.

Dish Name: Gnocchi with courgette, mascarpone & spring onions
Ingredient Names: gnocchi, olive oil, red chile, zucchini, green onions, lemons, mascarpone, parmesan, dressed mixed leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the gnocchi following pack instructions. Drain, reserving a ladle of the cooking water, and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Cook chilli and courgette for 3 mins until soft. Add spring onions, zest, mascarpone, half the Parmesan and cooking water. Mix until smooth, add gnocchi and heat through. Step 3: Season, divide between 2 ovenproof dishes and scatter with the remaining Parmesan. Grill for 2-3 mins until bubbling and serve with the dressed mixed leaves.

Dish Name: Gnocchi with creamy tomato & spinach sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomato, mascarpone, gnocchi, baby spinach, fresh basil leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan. Fry the garlic until golden, then add the tomatoes. Season, then simmer for 10 mins. Stir in mascarpone, then cook for 2 mins more. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the gnocchi according to pack instructions. Add the spinach for the final min of cooking. Drain well, pour back into the pan, then stir the sauce through. Mix well and serve immediately with basil leaves and Parmesan shavings scattered over, if you like.

Dish Name: Grilled Pork Tenderloin With Italian Rub
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, rosemary, garlic, oregano leaves, thyme, rubbed sage, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat grill for indirect cooking. Step 2: Finely chop together rosemary and other spices. Step 3: Rub into surface of pork tenderloins.
