Step 4: Place tenderloins on grill over medium indirect heat. Step 5: Grill for 25-35 minutes or until internal temperature of the meat reaches 155 degrees. Step 6: Let the tenderloins rest for about 5 minutes; slice and serve!

Ingredient Names: butterflied sardines, salt, pepper, smoked paprika, virgin olive oil, panko breadcrumbs, garlic, pinenuts, anchovies fillets, baby capers, lemon zest, pecorino cheese, oregano, red onions, red chile, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Mix Crust: Mix the Italian Crust ingredients in a bowl. Spread on a small plate. Step 2: Mix Topping: Mix the Topping together in another small bowl. Step 3: Prepare sardines: Pat sardines dry with paper towel. Sprinkle both sides of each sardine with the salt and pepper. Sprinkle the skin side only with the paprika. Step 4: Crust flesh side: Press flesh side only firmly into the breadcrumbs - it won't completely cover, that's what we want. Place on plate, breadcrumb side up. Repeat with remaining sardines. Step 5: Pan fry sardines: Heat oil in a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Place sardines in, skin side down. Cook for 60 seconds, then carefully turn. Cook the crust side for 90 seconds or until golden and crispy. Step 6: Topping & oil drizzle: Remove sardines onto plate, crust side up. Sprinkle with Topping. Pour remaining hot oil over sardines - enjoy the sizzle! Step 7: Serve immediately! Ideal served with crostini for the ultimate sardines on toast. See in post for side salad pairings.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, milk, italian sausages, bell peppers, onions, provolone cheese, parmigiano
Instructions: Step 1: Saute pepper and onions. Step 2: Scramble eggs, pour into buttered skillet. Step 3: Cook to your disired doneness. Step 4: Top with sauted vegetables and cheese. Step 5: Fold egg over toppings, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: oil spray, shortcut pastry, olive oil, garlic, onions, italian sausages, eggs, milk, mixed italian herbs, salt, fresh black pepper, cheddar cheese, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180C/350F. Step 2: Lightly spray a 9"/23cm quiche flan or pie dish with oil. Step 3: Line with the pastry, trimming the excess. Use the extra 1/2 sheet to fill in any gaps as 1 sheet of pastry is slightly too small for a standard flan. Press to seal well. Step 4: Cover pastry with parchment (baking) paper, then fill with raw rice or dried beans to weigh it down. Step 5: Place in the oven and bake for 20 minutes, then remove parchment paper and rice/beans. Return to the oven for a further 10 minutes until golden. Remove from oven. Step 6: Heat oil in a fry pan over high heat. Add the garlic and onions and sauté for 2 minutes. Then add the sausage and cook, using a spatula to break it up into pieces. Cook until the sausage is browned, then remove the pan from the stove (sausage can stay in the pan). Step 7: Whisk the eggs, milk, herbs, salt and pepper in a bowl until combined. Step 8: Scatter half the cheese in the pie crust, then most of the sausage mixture. Pour over the egg mixture, top with remaining cheese and sausage. Then gently place the cherry tomatoes on the surface (cut side down). Step 9: Carefully transfer to the oven. Bake for 40 minutes until golden brown on top and the filling has set. Step 10: Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: spinach, eggs, garlic, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place drained spinach in non-stick skillet and heat well. Step 2: Add garlic and egg and stir until egg is set. Step 3: Add Parmesan cheese, cover and remove from heat. Step 4: Let sit for a couple of minutes for the cheese to melt, stir and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomato, sugar, butter beans, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Fry the garlic for 1 min, then add the tomatoes, sugar and some seasoning. Step 3: Tip in the beans and a splash of water. Step 4: Cover and simmer for 5 mins, then stir in the basil and serve.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, onions, garlic, cherry tomatoes, green olives, fresh basil leaves, ball vegetarian mozzarella, fresh white breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Slice the aubergines in half lengthways, leaving the stem intact. Using a small knife, cut a border inside each aubergine about ½-1cm thick. Using a teaspoon, scoop out the aubergine flesh, so that you have 4 shells. Brush these with a little of the oil, season and place in a baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 20 mins. Chop the flesh and place to one side. Step 2: Meanwhile, add the remaining oil to a non-stick frying pan. Tip in the onion and cook until soft. Add the chopped aubergine flesh and cook through. Tip in the garlic and tomatoes and cook for 3 mins more. Stir in olives, basil, mozzarella and seasoning. Step 3: When the aubergine shells are tender, remove from the oven and reduce heat to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pile stuffing into shells, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and drizzle with a little more oil. Bake for 15-20 mins, until the cheese is gooey and the breadcrumbs are golden. Serve with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, salt, ground black pepper, spinach, manicotti, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees F. Step 2: Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Step 3: In a skillet, saute onion (if using) in oil for about 4 minutes or until softened (adding in the garlic the last 2 minutes). Step 4: In a mixing bowl combine the ricotta cheese, 1-1/2 cup mozza cheese, cream cheese, 6 tablespoons Parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning; beat with a wooden spoon until smooth and well combined. Step 5: Season with white salt or seasoned salt and black pepper to taste. Step 6: Stir in onion mixture and spinach; mix well to combine. Step 7: Spoon into cooked and cooled manicotti shells. Step 8: Pour half of the pasta sauce into the prepared baking dish. Step 9: Arrange shells over sauce (at this point you may cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours, or continue with the recipe as follows). Step 10: Top with the remaining sauce, use a spoon to spread the sauce over the shells (the sauce does not have to cover the shells completely). Step 11: Sprinkle about 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (or to taste) over the sauce. Step 12: Cover and bake for 25 minutes. Step 13: Uncover and top with mozzeralla cheese (any amount desired). Step 14: Bake 5 mins longer, or until cheese is melted. Step 15: Let stand 10 mins before serving. Step 16: Note; If desired the spinach can be omitted completely.

Ingredient Names: linguine, virgin olive oil, garlic, chili pepper flakes, flat leaf parsley, salt, ground black pepper, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook Linguine following the package directions. Step 2: Saute sliced garlic cloves (Adding more garlic if you like)in olive oil, over medium heat until golden brown, remove garlic, and set aside. Step 3: Add dry pepper flakes cook for an additional minute. Step 4: Add parsley and salt, cook 1 more minute. Step 5: Add cooked linguine, toss in garlic, arrange on heated serving platter, and sprinkle with black pepper. Step 6: Serve with grated cheese and a nice loaf of Crusty Italian bread.

Dish Name: Malfatti (Italian Spinach Ricotta Dumplings in Napoli Sauce)
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, onions, tomato, tomato paste, water, basil stem, white sugar, salt, fresh black pepper, baby spinach, eschallot, ricotta, fresh basil leaves, eggs, egg yolks, parmesan, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic and onion: Heat oil in a small pot or large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and onion and cook for 3 minutes until onion is softened. Step 2: Simmer sauce: Add remaining ingredients plus the stem of basil. Bring to a simmer, then reduce stove to low and cook, stirring every now and then, for 20 minutes. It should be fairly thick rather than a loose runny sauce. Step 3: Drain ricotta, if needed: The ricotta should be the dry and fairly crumbly type rather than wet, soft and almost spreadable. If it's wet, see Note 1 for removing excess water (wet ricotta makes Malfatti hard to shape and cook!). Step 4: Sweat spinach: Toss spinach with 1/2 tsp salt in large colander. Leave for 20 minutes. Roll up in tea towel and squeeze tightly to remove excess liquid. Roughly chop. Step 5: Sauté garlic, eschalot and spinach: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic and eschalot, cook for 1 minute until translucent. Add spinach and cook until just wilted. Transfer to large bowl, allow to cool. Step 6: Malfatti mixture: Add ricotta and all remaining Malfatti ingredients into the bowl. Mix well to combine. It should be too wet to roll with hands without sticking, but still firm enough to shape into dumplings. Step 7: Form dumplings: Using 2 dessert spoons, scoop up about 1 1/2 tablespoons of mixture then shape into a football (quenelle) using the two spoons. Place on a paper-lined tray. You should get about 24-30. Step 8: Boil dumplings: Bring a large pot of water to the boil, then carefully put 6 dumplings in. Cook for 2 minutes, they should float to the surface. Remove with slotted spoon on to paper towel lined tray. Repeat for remaining Malfatti. Step 9: Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F. Step 10: Assemble: Pour Napoli Sauce into a baking dish, then top with Malfatti. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil. Step 11: Bake 15 minutes or until the Malfatti has a faint blush of gold on the surface. Step 12: Serve! Sprinkle baked Malfatti with parmesan and basil leaves (tear large leaves). Spoon into bowls and served as-is. No starchy side is required, think of these as like gnocchi. Just add a leafy green salad with Italian Dressing or Balsamic Dressing!

Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, half-and-half cream, ricotta cheese, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy-bottomed saucepan whisk egg yolks, sugar and cream; simmer over low heat for 2-3 minutes then cool. Step 2: Fold in ricotta cheese and whipped cream until blended.

Ingredient Names: eggs, vanilla paste, flour, easy-bake yeast, sugar, milk, soft butter, mixed fruit, mixed candied peel, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the eggs and yolk with the vanilla. In a large bowl, mix the flour, yeast, sugar and ½ tsp salt. Add the warm milk and egg mixture, then beat to a very soft, sticky dough with a wooden spoon. Cover with cling film and leave in a warm place until the dough has doubled in size. Step 2: Drop large muffin wraps into 10 clean, 200g size cans (or use a muffin tray), or line them carefully with baking parchment so that the paper comes well above the cans to make a collar. Step 3: Blend the butter, fruit and peel into the risen dough, preferably with your hands. Cut into 10 equal pieces and drop a piece into each prepared can. Cover again and leave until they are very well risen. Step 4: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Gently brush the panettone with milk, scatter over the almonds and bake for 25-30 mins until golden. Eat within 3 days, or freeze for up to 6 weeks.

Ingredient Names: ciabatta, provolone cheese, genoa salami, ham, tomatoes, sweet onion, green olives, kalamata olive, fresh basil, capers, garlic, brine, oregano leaves, olive oil, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything in food processor Chop fine for spread Refrigerate until ready to use.

Dish Name: Not Yo' Mama's Italian Style Pork Chops
Ingredient Names: olive oil, pork chops, green bell peppers, yellow onions, artichoke hearts, tomato sauce, italian seasoning, garlic, red pepper flakes, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chops in oil in a skillet. Step 2: Place chops in the bottom of the crockpot. Step 3: Cover chops with peppers, onions, and artichoke hearts. Step 4: Stir together remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Step 5: Pour mixture over vegetables in the crockpot. Step 6: Cover crockpot and cook on high for 3-3 1/2 hours on high or on low for 5-8 hours or until pork chops are just cooked through and tender (your time may vary with your appliance so check!). Step 7: Serve with cooked noodles, rice, or crusty Italian bread, if desired (I also sprinkled with Parmesan and red pepper flakes).

Ingredient Names: veal shanks, flour, olive oil, butter, onion, carrots, celery, fennel, garlic, orange zest, marjoram, bay leaf, dry white wine, chicken stock, tomatoes with juice, parsley, lemon zest, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 300 degrees. Step 2: Dredging the shanks: pour the flour into a shallow dish (a pie plate works nicely). Step 3: Season the veal shanks on all sides with salt and pepper. Step 4: One at a time, roll the shanks around in the flour coat, and shake and pat the shank to remove any excuses flour. Step 5: Discard the remaining flour. Step 6: Browning the shanks: put the oil and the butter in a wide Dutch oven or heavy braising pot (6 to 7 quart) and heat over medium-high heat. Step 7: When the butter has melted and the oil is shimmering, lower the shanks into the pot, flat side down; if the shanks won’t fit without touching one another 5 minutes, do this in batches. Step 8: Brown the shanks, turning once with tongs, until both flat sides are well caramelized, about 5 minutes per side. Step 9: If the butter-oil mixture starts to burn, lower the heat just a bit. Step 10: Transfer the shanks to a large platter or tray and set aside. Step 11: The aromatics: pour off and discard the fat from the pot. Step 12: Wipe out any burnt bits with a damp paper towel, being careful not to remove any delicious little caramelized bits. Step 13: Ad the remaining butter to the pot and melt it over medium heat. Step 14: When the butter has stopped foaming, add the onion, carrot, celery, and fennel. Step 15: Season with salt and pepper, stir, and cook the vegetables until they begin to soften but do not brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 16: Stir in the garlic, orange zest, marjoram, and bay leaf, and stew for another minute or two. Step 17: The braising liquid: add the wine, increase the heat to high, and bring to a boil. Step 18: Boil, stirring occasionally, to reduce the wine by about half,. Step 19: Add the stock and tomatoes, with their juice, and boil again to reduce the liquid to about total, about 15-20 minutes. Step 20: The braise: Place the shanks in the pot so that they are sitting with the exposed bone facing up, and pour over any juices that accumulated as they sat. Step 21: Cover with parchment paper, pressing down so the parchment nearly touches the veal and the edges hang over the sides of the pot by about an inch. Step 22: Cover tightly with the lid, and slide into the lower part of the oven to braise at a gentle simmer. Step 23: Check the pot after the first, and if the liquid is simmering too aggressively, lower the oven heat by 10 or 15 degrees. Step 24: Continue braising, turning the shanks and spooning some pan juices over the top after the first, until the meat is completely tender and pulling away from the bone, about 5 minutes. Step 25: The gremolata: While the shanks are braising, stir together the garlic, parsley, and lemon zest in a small bowl. Step 26: Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a cool place (or the refrigerator, if your kitchen is very warm.) The finish: When the veal is fork-tender and falling away from the bone, remove the lid and sprinkle over half of the gremolata. Step 27: Return the veal to the oven, uncovered, for another to caramelize it some. Step 28: Using a slotted spatula or spoon, carefully lift the shanks from the braising liquid, doing your best to keep them intact. Step 29: The shanks will be very tender and threatening to fall into pieces, and the marrow will be wobbly inside the bones, so this can be a bit tricky. Step 30: But if they do break apart, don’t worry, the flavor won’t suffer at all. Step 31: Arrange the shanks on a serving platter or other large plate, without stacking, and cover with foil to keep warm. Step 32: Finishing the sauce: Set the braising pot on top of the stove and evaluate the sauce: if there is a visible layer of fat floating on the surface, use a large spoon to skim it off and discard it. Step 33: Taste the sauce for concentration of flavor. Step 34: If it tastes a bit weak or flat, bring it to a boil over high heat, and boil to reduce the volume and intensify the flavor for 5 to. Step 35: Taste again for salt and pepper. Step 36: If the sauce wants more zip, stir in a teaspoon or two of the remaining gremolata. Step 37: Portioning the veal shanks: if the shanks are reasonably sized, serve one per person. Step 38: If the shanks are gargantuan or you’re dealing with modest appetites, pull apart the larger shanks, separating them at their natural seams, and serve smaller amounts. Step 39: Be sure to give the marrow bones to whomever prizes them most. Step 40: Serving: Arrange the veal shanks on warm dinner plates accompanied by the risotto, if serving. Step 41: Just before carrying the plates to the table, sprinkle on the remaining gremolata and then spoon over a generous amount of sauce – the contact with the hot liquid will aromatize the gremolata and perk up everyone’s appetite with the whiff of garlic and lemon.

Ingredient Names: gelatine, soya milk, lemons, vanilla pod split, rum brandy, golden sugar, apricots, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the gelatine onto 3 tbsp water and soak for 5 mins. Scrape the seeds out of the vanilla pod into the pan and put the pod into the milk. Put the soya milk, zest, vanilla pod, sugar and rum into a pan. Heat until the liquid just comes to the boil (if using veggie gelatine, you’ll need to bring it to the boil – check pack instructions), then remove from the heat and stir in the gelatine. Cool for 10 mins. If the gelatine clumps together, whisk thoroughly. Strain the milk mixture, then divide between 4 ramekins. Cover and refrigerate until set (approximately 2 hrs). Step 2: Halve and stone the apricots. Put the sugar and 150ml water into a pan, then heat until the sugar has dissolved. Add the apricots and cook over a gentle heat for 12-15 mins or until the apricots are soft, then leave to cool. Serve in a dish alongside the panna cotta.

Ingredient Names: firm pears unpeeled, clear honey, port, red wine, french b ton, extra-virgin olive oil, gorgonzola room temperature, mustard cress
Instructions: Step 1: Halve and core the pears, then cut each one into 12 small wedges. Place in a heavy-based saucepan with the honey, port and wine. Cook for 5-10 minutes or until the pears are just tender when pierced with the tip of a sharp knife (they shouldn’t be soft). Step 2: Carefully tip the pears into a sieve set over a small saucepan and allow them to drain thoroughly. Step 3: Reduce the liquid in the saucepan by two-thirds – it should have a syrupy consistency like runny honey. This will take 10-12 minutes. Pour the syrup into a small bowl and allow to cool while you prepare the bruschettas. Step 4: Preheat the grill to hot. Cut the bread into 24 slices and brush both sides of each slice with olive oil. Grill until the bruschettas are golden on both sides. This only takes a minute, so keep watch. Step 5: Spread each bruschetta with a little gorgonzola and top with a poached pear wedge. Arrange the bruschettas on a serving plate and drizzle with the port syrup using a teaspoon. Sprinkle over a little mustard and cress. Step 6: Prepare ahead: you can poach the pears the day before and serve them cold – they’re just as nice. Take them out of the syrup and reduce, then store the pears and syrup in separate plastic containers in the fridge. If the syrup is too thick the next day, add a little warm water, and if it is too thin, you can reduce it by simmering for a minute or two.

Dish Name: Penne With Roasted Asparagus and Balsamic Butter
Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, olive oil, salt, fresh black pepper, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, penne, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400. Step 2: Snap the tough ends off the asparagus and discard them. Step 3: Cut the spears into 1 inch pieces. Step 4: Put the aspargus on a baking sheet and toss with the olive oil and 1/4 tsp. Step 5: Each of the salt and pepper. Step 6: Roast until tender, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, put the vinegar in a small saucepan, simmer until 3 T, remain. Step 8: Stir in the brown sugar and the remainig 1/4 tsp, pepper, remove from heat. Step 9: Cook the penne in a large pot of boiling, salted water just until done, about 13 minutes. Step 10: Drain the pasta and toss with the butter, vinegar, asparagus, Parmesan and the remaining 1 3/4 tsp, salt. Step 11: Serve with additional Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: penne, fresh broccoli, virgin olive oil, garlic, water, salt, parmesan cheese, red pepper flakes, scallions, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Put broccoli in a saucepan with the olive oil, garlic, water and salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil,lower heat, cover tightly, and let steam until the broccoli is bright green and very crunchy about five minutes. Step 3: Add pasta to broccoli, mix in cheese. Step 4: Top with red pepper flakes, scallions and pine nuts.

Dish Name: Penne with Artichokes, Pancetta, and Thyme
Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, butter, onions, pancetta, salt, pepper, thyme, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, penne
Instructions: Step 1: Put your water to boil and cook pasta. Step 2: Drain the can of artichokes and slice into slivers. Step 3: Melt butter in a large skillet over a medium heat. Step 4: Add the onion and cook until it softens and turns a rich gold color. Step 5: Add the pancetta and continue sauteing until the pancetta is nicely browned but not crisp Once the pasta is almost done, return the sauce to the heat. Step 6: Add the artichoke hearts, salt, black pepper and thyme and boil away any excess liquid, leaving just a little moisture. Step 7: When the pasta is cooked al dente, drain it and toss it with the sauce, adding the grated cheese. Step 8: Taste for salt and pepper and serve at once with extra fresh grated parmigiano to top if desired.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaves, rock salt, fluid olive oil, garlic, pine nuts, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Holding the basil by it's stalks, gently swish the leaves in a bowl of cold water. Step 2: Pick off the leaves from the stalks and dry them n kitchen paper without bruising them. Step 3: Now you need to reduce the leaves and salt to a smooth puree-use a pestle and mortar or a food processor for this. Step 4: If using a pestle and mortar (wood is best) press and grind the basil against the sides, rather than bashing downwards, and work from the edges inward. Step 5: Salt will be your friend at this stage; it's grittiness helps you with the pounding. Step 6: Once you have the leaves gently but reasonably mushed, add the oil. Step 7: Begin to pour in the oil slowly and stir until you have a smooth creamy texture. Step 8: Now work in the garlic, add just enough so that it can be tasted without being over powering. Step 9: Tip in the pinenuts and cheese and blend in these. Step 10: Keep going until the mixture is smooth and no longer stringy. Step 11: Season to taste with salt and pepper to taste, bearing in mind that parmesan is quite salty and that raw garlic already gives a hot sensation in your mouth.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil, parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, garlic, french baguettes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the basil, cheese, mayonnaise and garlic in a bowl and mix well. Step 2: Arrange the baguette slices in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Step 3: Broil the slices until light brown. Step 4: Turn the slices and spread with the mayonnaise mixture. Step 5: Return to under the broiler and broil until light brown and heated through. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, fresh yeast, plain flour, salt, olive oil, passata, mozzarella, oregano, basil leaves, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Preheat the oven to. Step 2: 2 Add the sugar and crumble the fresh yeast into warm water. Step 3: 3 Allow the mixture to stand for 10 – in a warm place (we find a windowsill on a sunny day works best) until froth develops on the surface. Step 4: 4 Sift the flour and salt into a large mixing bowl, make a well in the middle and pour in the yeast mixture and olive oil. Step 5: 5 Lightly flour your hands, and slowly mix the ingredients together until they bind. Step 6: Enerously dust your surface with flour. Step 7: 7 Throw down the dough and begin kneading for 8-10 minutes until smooth, silky and soft. Step 8: 8 Place in a lightly oiled, non-stick baking tray (we use a round one, but any shape will do!) 9 Spread the passata on top making sure you go to the edge. Step 9: 10 Evenly place the mozzarella (or other cheese) on top, season with the oregano and black pepper, then drizzle with a little olive oil. Step 10: 11 Cook in the oven for 10 – until the cheese slightly colours. Step 11: 12 When ready, place the basil leaf on top and tuck in!

Ingredient Names: purple plum, sugar, egg whites, cream, disaronno liqueur, soft amaretti biscuit up
Instructions: Step 1: Line a 30 x 20cm tray with cling film. Put the plums in a pan with 2 tbsp water and 110g of the sugar. Cover with a lid and stew over a medium heat for 10 mins until soft. Allow to cool slightly, then blitz with a hand blender. Pass through a sieve to remove the plum skins. Allow to cool. Step 2: Put the remaining sugar in a pan with 150ml water, and dissolve over a low heat. Boil for 5 mins or until the mixture reaches 120C on a cooking thermometer. Step 3: To make the meringue base, whisk the egg whites until stiff. With the beaters running, carefully pour the sugar mixture onto the egg white, whisking until thick. In another bowl, softly whip the cream, then gently fold in the liqueur, plum pulp, biscuits and the meringue. Pour into the tin, cover with cling film and freeze for a few hrs until set. To serve, remove from the freezer 5 mins before scooping into balls.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, bulb fennel, chili flakes, fennel seeds, pork ground meat
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan, add onion and fennel and cook for 8 mins until soft. Add chilli flakes and fennel seeds and cook for a further 2 mins. Remove from the heat and allow to cool, then mix in pork mince with some seasoning. Form into bite-sized balls. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan. Add the meatballs and cook for 10-15 mins until golden and cooked through. Serve at room temperature with cocktail sticks.

Ingredient Names: flour, eggs, salt, ricotta cheese, pumpkin, parmesan cheese, pepper, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour onto the work surface and make a well. Step 2: You may want to oil your hands first to prevent sticking. Step 3: Add the eggs one at a time, then add the salt. Step 4: Mix the eggs, then add a little flour at a time from the well, until all the flour has been used. Step 5: Knead for about 5 minutes, adding flour if dough is too sticky. Step 6: Dice the pumpkin and cook in boiling water for 10 minutes. Step 7: Strain and leave to cool. Step 8: In a large bowl, soften the ricotta. Step 9: When the pumpkin has cooled, mash with a fork and add to the ricotta. Step 10: Add the parmesan, egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper to taste. Step 11: Mix the ingredients together until they have a uniform texture. Step 12: Roll out a thin sheet of pasta. Step 13: Use the smallest setting on the pasta machine. Step 14: Or roll by hand (watch out- it won't be easy!). Step 15: Pasta should be very very thin at the final stage. Step 16: If you have a ravioli attatchment for your machine, this should be easy from here on inches. Step 17: Using a spoon, piping bag or fingers, place filling at equal distance apart along one side. Step 18: Fold over the sheet of pasta or place another sheet on top. Step 19: Be sure to try not to let much air be in with the filling or your ravioli will burst during cooking. Step 20: Cut out the individual ravioli shapes using pastry cutter or shape cutter. Step 21: Be sure to seal edges well with water and perhaps a fork. Step 22: Cook 5-6 minutes in boiling water.

Ingredient Names: rabbit, flour seasoned salt, pepper, olive oil, onions, garlic, parsley, white wine, cherry tomatoes, green olives, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the rabbit in the flour. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large, shallow pan and brown the rabbit in 3 batches, adding another tbsp oil for each batch. Lift out all the rabbit onto a plate and set aside. Add the onions and garlic to the pan with the remaining oil, then gently cook for 15 mins until softened. Add most of the parsley and cook for a few mins more. Return the rabbit to the pan and pour in the wine. Turn up the heat and bubble the wine until half-reduced, then stir in the cherry tomatoes. If the rabbit isn’t completely covered, add a splash of water. Step 2: Cover the pan and simmer for 40 mins until the rabbit is tender – the timing can vary, but if it’s still tough just continue to cook, adding more water if needed, and the meat will eventually start to come away from the bone. When the meat is ready, throw in the olives, cover and simmer for 5-10 mins more. Season with sugar, salt and pepper, then scatter with the remaining parsley to serve. Serve with polenta, mash or a buttery, flat pasta, such as tagliatelle.

Dish Name: Ravioli With Peas, Tomatoes And Sage Butter Sauce
Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, butter, sage leaves, parsley, lemons, baby peas, tomato, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large, deep skillet. Step 2: Add sage and parsley and cook over medium heat until butter starts to brown, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add cooked ravioli and lemon zest and toss to coat. Step 4: Add peas and tomatoes and toss until heated through. Step 5: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Add parmesan cheese and toss to combine.

Dish Name: Ravioli with Prosciutto, Roma Tomato and Sage
Ingredient Names: meat ravioli, butter, prosciutto, sage, roma tomatoes, ground black pepper, heavy cream, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put a pot of salted water on to boil. Step 2: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium to medium/high heat. Step 3: Add prosciutto and let cook for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add chopped roma tomatoes and cook for 4 more minutes. Step 5: Add chopped sage and pepper. Step 6: Add your ravioli to the boiling water. Step 7: Add heavy cream to your tomato/prosciutto mixture and stir well. Step 8: Bring just to a boil and lower heat to a high simmer. Step 9: As ravioli begin to float, scoop them out of the pot and add to the skillet with the sauce mix. Step 10: Add cheese and gently toss to coat. Step 11: Serve with a green salad and garlic breadsticks.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, celery, carrot, garlic, butter, olive oil, lean ground beef, ground pork, beef consomme, dry white wine, crushed tomatoes, salt, black pepper, rubbed sage
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven or medium size pot, heat butter and olive oil over medium heat until butter begins to froth. Step 2: Add onion, celery, carrot, garlic, and bacon. Step 3: Cook until onions are translucent. Step 4: Remove bacon and remove fat. Step 5: Chop lean portions of bacon in small pieces and return to pot. Step 6: Add ground beef and ground pork, and cook until meat loses red, raw color. Step 7: Raise heat and add wine and consomme. Step 8: Cook sauce until wine and consomme are mostly evaporated. Step 9: Turn heat down to simmer and add oregano, salt, pepper, sage, red pepper flakes, and nutmeg. Step 10: Let cook for approximately 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dry white wine, thyme, red pepper flakes, garlic, red snapper fillets, flour, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large zip-lock bag; add fish. Step 2: Marinate in the fridge for about 30 minutes, turning occasionally. Step 3: Remove fish from bag and discard the marinade. Step 4: Combine the flour, Parmesan, salt & pepper in another zip-lock bag. Step 5: Add the fish; seal and shake to coat the fish with the flour mixture. Step 6: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and add the olive oil. Step 7: Heat over medium until hot. Step 8: Add the fish and cook for about 7 minutes on each side or until it flakes easily.

Ingredient Names: eggs, salt, white pepper, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, marjoram, garlic, olive oil, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler Beat eggs with 3/4 teaspoon salt and white pepper to taste. Step 2: Stir in cheeses, marjoram and garlic. Step 3: Heat oil and butter in 8- or 10-inch skillet. Step 4: Add egg mixture and lower heat. Step 5: Cook until set, about 12 minutes, then brown under broiler. Step 6: When done, slide frittata onto plate, serves 6.

Ingredient Names: polenta, parmesan, nutmeg, parsnips core, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Mix together the polenta, Parmesan and nutmeg, and set aside. Bring a pan of salted water to the boil, tip in the parsnips and cook for 6 mins or until just tender. Drain. While parsnips are still hot, toss with the Parmesan mixture to coat. Step 2: Set a roasting tin over the hob and heat the oil. Add the parsnips and turn to coat in the oil. Put the tin in the oven and roast for 15 mins, then turn the parsnips over and cook for 15 mins more until golden.

Dish Name: Roast red mullet with tarragon & pancetta
Ingredient Names: red mullet scaled gutted, fresh tarragon leaves, olive oil, garlic, pancetta, red onions, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Slash the red mullet through the flesh to the bone 3-4 times on each side. Mix the chopped tarragon with 2 tbsp of the oil and the garlic, season lightly, then brush over the fish, taking care to push some of the tarragon into the slashes of the fish. Marinate for 10 mins. Step 2: Put the pancetta and red onion into a large roasting tin, drizzle with remaining oil and cook in the oven for 5-7 mins or until beginning to soften. Arrange the fish on top and drizzle with the vinegar. Roast in the oven for 12-15 mins or until the fish is cooked; the eye will be white and the flesh will flake when prodded.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh basil, pine nuts, garlic, olive oil, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Halve the tomatoes and arrange them in a single layer, cut side up in a roasting tin. Step 2: To make the pesto: put the basil, pine nuts and garlic in a food processor and whizz to a paste. With the motor running, drizzle in the oil. Transfer to a bowl, stir in the parmesan, then season to taste. Spoon about 2 tsp pesto over each tomato, then roast for 20 mins, until the tomatoes are tender. Serve with grilled lamb and a crisp green salad.

Dish Name: Roasted pork meatballs with garlic mushrooms
Ingredient Names: pork preferably organic, onions, parsley, lemons, open mushroom, garlic, olive oil, sherry, creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Tip the pork, onion, half the parsley and the lemon zest into a food processor with lots of pepper and some salt if you wish, then pulse until well mixed. Step 2: Shape the meat into 25-30 balls and put in a large roasting tin. Arrange the mushrooms in a separate flame-proof roasting tin, sprinkle with garlic and drizzle with the oil, salt and pepper. Roast the meatballs for 25 mins, adding the mushrooms on the shelf below after 10 mins. Step 3: Transfer mushroom tin to hob. Stir in sherry and crème fraîche and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in the meatballs, then spoon it all onto a large warm dish. Serve sprinkled with the remaining parsley, roughly chopped.

Ingredient Names: milk, ground nutmeg, semolina, eggs, parmesan cheese, butter, cream, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Line a deep corning ware dish (12x8 inch) with parchment paper. Step 2: In a sauce pan place milk, half the nutmeg and some salt and pepper (to desired taste) and bring to a boil stirring occasionaly. Step 3: Cook for 5-10 minutes or until the semolina is very stiff. Step 4: Remove the pan from the heat source. Step 5: Add the beaten egg and 1 cup of Parmesan cheese and stir the mixture well. Step 6: With a spatula spread the mixture in the corning ware pan and place in the refrigerator for 1 hour or until firm. Step 7: Preheat the oven to 350F. Step 8: Using a biscuit cutter, flour it and cut the semolina into rounds. Step 9: Place then evenly in a greased shallow casserole dish. Step 10: Place the butter over the top and then the cream. Step 11: Combine the remaining parmesan and mozzarella cheese and sprinkle over top. Step 12: Finally sprinkle the remaining nutmeg. Step 13: Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden.

Ingredient Names: cheese-filled egg tortellini, olive oil, garlic, dry white wine, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook Tortellini as directed on package. Step 2: Drain; rinse with hot water. Step 3: In large skillet, sauté garlic in oil 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in wine, salt, pepper and Tortellini. Step 5: Simmer over low heat 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Step 6: Toss with 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, if desired.

Ingredient Names: young spinach, parsley leaves, garlic, ricotta, flour, eggs, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, nutmeg, olive oil arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the kettle. Place the spinach in a large bowl and pour boiling water over it. Leave for 2 mins until wilted, then drain thoroughly. Leave to cool, then wrap a clean tea towel around the spinach. Hold it over the sink and squeeze out as much water as possible. Finely chop. Step 2: Place the spinach, parsley, garlic, ricotta, flour, eggs, cheese and a generous grating of nutmeg into a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Use a fork to stir very thoroughly until everything is completely mixed. Using wet hands, form the mixture into walnut-size balls. Place on a large plate or tray and refrigerate for at least 30 mins. Step 3: When ready to cook, heat the oven to warm and bring a large pan of water to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and drop in batches of about 8-10 gnocchi at a time. They will sink to the bottom, and when they rise to the top give them about 1 min more, then remove with a slotted spoon and keep warm while you cook the rest. Serve the gnocchi on warm plates drizzled with olive oil and scattered with rocket and more cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, onions, spinach, ground nutmeg, ricotta, egg yolks, parmesan, all-butter puff pastry, flour, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Melt half the butter with the oil in a sauté pan. Add the onion and cook for 10 mins until softened. Remove to a bowl. Step 2: Add a few handfuls of spinach to the pan and cook for a few mins until it has wilted down. Remove from the heat and drain in a colander. Repeat until all the spinach is cooked. Press with the back of a spoon to remove any excess liquid. Now roughly chop and tip into the bowl with the onion. Stir in the nutmeg, ricotta, egg yolks, Parmesan and some seasoning and mix well. Step 3: Roll out one pack of pastry on a lightly floured surface to a 25 x 30cm rectangle, then lay on a large baking sheet. With the longest side facing you, pack the spinach mixture down the middle of the pastry, leaving a 5cm border all the way around. Brush the pastry all the way round with some beaten egg. Step 4: Roll out the second pack of pastry to a rectangle slightly larger than the first. Drape over the top and gently press down the edges to seal both pastry layers together. Trim the edges to neaten and crimp with your fingers, or seal down with a fork. Step 5: Brush all over with beaten egg and, if you like, lightly score the pastry with the back of a knife in a criss-cross fashion, making sure you don’t cut all the way through. Bake for 40 mins. Leave to rest for 10 mins before serving.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, onions, red bell peppers, green bell peppers, garlic, fresh basil, oregano, red pepper flakes, tomatoes, tomato paste, flour, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: To press tofu: For best results, tofu should be"pressed" in order to remove excess liquid and absorb the flavors of the marinade. Step 2: Press tofu block between two plates, weighted down with a cast iron pan, large bowl of water, or heavy cans, for about 30 minutes. Step 3: Halfway through, you may dump the plate of water and flip the tofu block. Step 4: For an even meatier texture, place the pressed tofu slices in the freezer until ready to use. Step 5: For the cacciatore: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 6: Coat a large, non-stick skillet with cooking spray, and heat over medium low. Step 7: Add onion and bell peppers and cook until softened, about 5-8 minutes. Step 8: Add garlic, oregano, basil and crushed red pepper, if using, and stir to coat the vegetables evenly. Step 9: Next, add the diced tomatoes, and tomato paste. Step 10: Mix well and bring sauce mixture to a boil. Step 11: Reduce heat to low, and simmer the sauce covered for about 15 minutes. Step 12: While sauce simmers, cut the block of pressed tofu into ½ inch thick slices. Step 13: Mix flour with a good pinch of salt and pepper. Step 14: Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray, and place over medium low heat. Step 15: Dredge the tofu slices in the seasoned flour; be sure to tap off the excess. Step 16: Place slices into skillet, and cook until lightly browned on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Step 17: Watch that the pan doesn’t get too hot, and lower the heat if necessary. Step 18: This step needs to be done in two batches. Step 19: Be sure to re-coat the pan with spray for the second batch. Step 20: As the tofu slices are finished browning, place them in a baking dish in a single layer. Step 21: Pour tomato pepper sauce over tofu, sprinkle generously with Parmesan or Romano cheese if desired, and cover dish with foil. Step 22: Bake until heated through (about 45 minutes to 1 ½ hours) The longer the tofu bakes, the more flavor it will absorb, serve hot.

Dish Name: Tortellini With Baby Spinach and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: cheese tortellini, tomatoes, sun-dried tomato oil, garlic, baby spinach, red pepper flakes, fresh basil, salt, pepper, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Heat a large deep skillet or saucepan over medium/medium high heat. Step 3: Add sun dried tomatoes and saute for about 30 seconds. Step 4: Next, add garlic and crushed red pepper and cook for about 45 more seconds, careful not to let the garlic burn. Step 5: Add tomatoes and stir together. Step 6: Let sauce come to a boil, reduce heat to low, then cover and let simmer while pasta water comes to a boil. Step 7: Boil pasta according to package directions (about 6-8 minutes). Step 8: While pasta finishes cooking, add spinach to the sauce. Step 9: I end up using about 1/2 of a 10 oz bag. Step 10: Give spinach leaves a stir and then place lid back on the sauce to let the leaves wilt slightly. Step 11: As pasta finishes cooking, ladle a couple scoops of sauce into serving bowl. Step 12: Drain tortellini, and add to bowl with a couple more ladles of sauce overtop, toss to combine. Step 13: I always have some sauce left over which I keep on the side for dunking in bread. Step 14: Top tortellini with grated cheese and serve!

Ingredient Names: tortellini, olive oil, bacon, green onions, sun-dried tomato oil, cream, sour cream, water, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: ADD pasta to large pan of boiling water; Boil uncovered until just tender; Drain. Step 2: HEAT oil in pan, add bacon; Cook, stirring until bacon is crisp; Add onions and tomatoes; Cook stirring until onions are just tender; Remove and reserve half the bacon mixture for serving. Step 3: STIR cream, sour cream, water, cheese and basil into remaining bacon mixture in pan; Stir until heated through. Step 4: COMBINE tortellini and cream mixture; Toss well; Serve sprinkled with reserved bacon mixture.

Dish Name: Vanilla panna cotta with caramelised orange
Ingredient Names: gelatine leaves, milk, oranges, vanilla pods split, golden sugar, cream, sugar, grand marnier, oranges segmented
Instructions: Step 1: Place the gelatine and milk in a pan, then leave it to one side to soak. Meanwhile, place the orange zest, vanilla pods and sugar in a pan. Add 800ml of the cream, then bring to the boil. Simmer until the mixture is reduced by one-third. While the cream is reducing, remove the gelatine from the milk, set aside, then warm the milk. When it is warm, add the soaked gelatine and stir until completely dissolved. Add to the warm cream, pass through a sieve, then leave to cool. Step 2: Lightly whip the remaining cream, then fold into the setting mixture. Pour the mixture into a 1-litre pudding bowl, then place in the fridge to set for at least 5 hrs. Step 3: While the panna cotta is setting, make the sauce for the orange salad. Tip the sugar into a non-stick pan, then place on the heat to cook down to a caramel. Pour in the Grand Marnier and orange juice – this will make the caramel harden, so just simmer on a low heat, stirring, until it’s dissolved to a syrupy consistency. Remove from the heat. Step 4: Take the panna cotta out of the fridge, slide a knife around the edge of the bowl and dip very briefly in hot water to loosen. Tip the panna cotta into the middle of a plate, then arrange the orange segments around it. Spoon the orangey sauce over the panna cotta and oranges, then scatter over the zest.

Dish Name: Veal chops with sage & creamy squash polenta
Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, sage leaves, british rose veal chops, chunk butternut squash, milk, polenta, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. For the polenta, toss the squash and oil with a little salt, then roast for 40 mins until really tender. Whizz squash to a purée with the milk. Leave the oven on. Cook polenta following pack instructions. Once soft and creamy, stir in the purée and Parmesan with seasoning. Keep warm. Step 2: Heat the butter and oil in an ovenproof pan (if you have one) until sizzling. Press a few sage leaves onto the chops, season generously, then fry over a high heat for 2 mins on each side until golden and crisp. Transfer to the oven for 5 mins to finish cooking (tip everything into a small roasting tin if your pan isn’t ovenproof). Check the veal is just cooked through but still juicy, then rest for a few mins while you dish up the polenta and salad. If the polenta has firmed up too much, loosen with a splash more milk, then divide between two plates. Top each with a chop and spoon over any pan juices.

Ingredient Names: whole tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, dried basil, ground cinnamon, beef stock, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium sized saucepan heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, basil, salt, pepper, and cinnamon. Step 3: Cook mixture until onion and garlic are translucent, 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Reduce heat if onions and / or garlic start to brown Empty the tomatoes into a separate bowl. Step 5: Using your hands, squeeze and crush each tomato. Step 6: Add the tomatoes and juice to the onion and garlic mixture. Step 7: Add the cup of beef stock Over medium heat, continue cooking uncovered until sauce reduces by 1 / 3, stirring occasionally to make sure sauce doesn't burn Use the sauce in a meaty lasagna or sub it for any other sauce in any other recipe for a change.

Dish Name: Zucchini, Onions & Tomatoes With Parmesan Cheese
Ingredient Names: zucchini, tomatoes, red onions, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, pepper, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Using a casserole baking dish, place zucchini into layers; next place the onion slices over zucchini, place tomatoes over the top of the onions. Step 2: Drizzle the olive oil over the tomatoes, onions, zucchini that have been layered; Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, pepper and basil OR thyme. Step 3: Bake in a 375°F oven for 25 or until zucchini is almost tender, Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake another 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggs, parmesan cheese, salt, ground black pepper, fresh chives, virgin olive oil, zucchini, vidalia onions, tomatoes, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Step 2: In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper and chives, set aside. Step 3: In a 10-inch ovenproof non-stick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Step 4: Cook half the zucchini slices until tender, about 3 minutes, then move them to a small bowl. Step 5: Repeat with the rest of the zucchini and reserve. Step 6: Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet and cook the onions, tomato and garlic for 5 minutes, or until the onions are tender. Step 7: Return the zucchini to the skillet, evenly distributing it. Step 8: Add the egg mixture, and cook for 3 minutes, or until the bottom of the frittata is just set. Step 9: Place the frittata in the oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until it is completely set and golden brown. Step 10: Invert it onto a plate, cut into slices and serve.

Dish Name: Agnello Alla Cacciatore Lamb Hunter's Style
Ingredient Names: boneless leg of lamb, onion, garlic, fresh sage leaves, olive oil, dry white wine, diced tomatoes, salt and pepper, red pepper flakes, egg yolks
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in heavy casserole and saute onion until soft. Step 2: Add garlic and sage, saute a minute or two more. Step 3: Add lamb and brown on all sides. Step 4: Raise heat and add wine scrape pan and let boil for 20 seconds or so. Step 5: Lower heat and let reduce for 5 minutes or so. Step 6: Add tomatoes and season with salt, pepper, and pepper flakes. Step 7: Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Step 8: When the meat is cooked and soft remove the pan from the heat. Step 9: Beat the egg yolks into the sauce. Step 10: Serve hot and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: puff pastry, egg, plain flour, lamb shanks, olive oil, red onions, garlic cloves, red wine, beef stock, rosemary, red currant jelly, salt, cracked black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Season flour with good pinch of salt and plenty of pepper dust the lamb shanks in seasoned flour. Step 2: Heat oil in a large heavy based casserole dish and brown shanks all over getting good coloring on all sides, add remaining flour, onions and garlic and stir well. Step 3: Pour in wine to deglaze followed by stock, rosemary, redcurrant jelly and a healthy grind of pepper. Step 4: Bring to the boil, cover and turn down heat to cook at a very gentle simmer for around 2 hours until meat falls off the bone and the sauce is rich and thickened. Step 5: Remove bones reserving 3 of them and flake meat into small pieces. Step 6: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Step 7: Fill a two litre pie dish with the lamb filling. Step 8: Roll pastry to about 3mm think and around 2 5cm larger than the dish. Step 9: Cut a 2cm stripe from the pastry.

Dish Name: Braised Lamb Shanks With Fresh Rosemary
Ingredient Names: lamb shanks, olive oil, onions, carrots, garlic cloves, dry red wine, diced tomatoes with juice, low sodium chicken broth, beef broth, fresh rosemary, fresh thyme, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle lamb with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat oil in heavy, large pot over medium-high heat Working in batches, add lamb to pot and cook until brown on all sides, about 8 minutes, transfer to bowl. Step 3: Remove all but about 2 tablespoons of oil from pan. Step 4: Add onions, carrots, and garlic to pot and saut till golden, about 10 minute. Step 5: Stir in all remaining ingredients. Step 6: Return lamb to pot, pressing down to submerge. Step 7: Bring liquid to boil, reduce heat to medium low, and cover. Step 8: Simmer until meat is tender, about 2 hours.

Dish Name: Braised Lamb With Anchovy Sauce Abbacchio Alla Cacciatora
Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless lamb shoulder, garlic, dried rosemary, salt, fresh ground black pepper, flour, red wine vinegar, chicken stock, anchovy fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 500. Step 2: In a heavy 10- to 12-inch skillet, heat the olive oil until a light haze forms over it. Step 3: Add the lamb, 4 or 5 chunks at a time, and brown it over moderately high heat As the chunks become richly colored on all sides, transfer them to a heavy 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart flameproof casserole. Step 4: Then pour off all but a thin film of fat from the skillet and set the pan aside. Step 5: Season the lamb with garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper, and sprinkle it with flour, tossing the meat with a wooden spoon to coat the chunks as evenly as possible with the seasonings and flour. Step 6: Place the casserole in the upper third of the oven and brown the lamb uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes, turning it 2 or 3 times. Step 7: When no trace of gummy flour remains and the chunks of lamb are lightly crusted, remove the casserole from the oven and reduce the oven heat to 350. Step 8: Pour the vinegar into the waiting skillet and boil it briskly over high heat for a minute or two, scraping in any browned bits clinging to the bottom and sides of the pan. Step 9: Add the chicken stock to the vinegar, bring to a boil, and pour the liquid over the lamb in the casserole.

Dish Name: Bucatini Lamb Eggplant Bucatini Melanzane Ed Agnello
Ingredient Names: eggplant, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, milk, ground lamb, egg, salt, fresh ground black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, italian seasoning, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, mushroom marinara sauce, oregano, romano cheese, bucatini pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Step 3: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 4: Sprinkle eggplant with salt. Step 5: Allow to drain in a colander for 30 minutes. Step 6: Combine milk and breadcrumbs in a bowl. Step 7: Allow to rest for 10 minutes. Step 8: Mix lamb, egg, breadcrumbs, salt, black ground pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, italian seasoning, oregano, and parsley in a large bowl. Step 9: Roll into 1 inch balls. Step 10: Place on prepared baking sheet.

Dish Name: Goat's cheese & garlic linguine with crisp pancetta
Ingredient Names: garlic bulb, extra-virgin olive oil, onions, thyme leaves, pancetta, linguine, firm goat's cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Loosely wrap the garlic cloves in some foil with 1 tsp oil. Place in a roasting tin and cook for about 20 mins until soft. Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp oil and fry the onions until caramelised, about 15 mins, adding the thyme for the final 5 mins. Step 2: In a separate pan, dry-fry the pancetta until golden and crisp, then set aside. Cook the pasta. Pop the roasted garlic out of their skins, add to the onions, then stir in the remaining oil. Drain the pasta, then toss through the onions, adding a good splash of cooking water. Crumble over the cheese and lightly stir. Season, then pile onto plates. Scatter with parsley, drizzle with some more oil and top with pancetta slices.

Dish Name: Lamb meatballs with rosemary tomato sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, ready-made lamb meatballs, onions, garlic, fresh rosemary leaves, tomatoes, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tsp oil in a large frying pan. Add the meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned. Remove from the pan. Step 2: Tip the onions into the pan with the remaining oil and a pinch of salt and cook until very soft, 10-15 mins. Add the garlic and rosemary and cook for 2 mins more. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and return meatballs to the pan. Simmer for 10 mins until the sauce has thickened and the meatballs are cooked through. Season and serve with the pasta, sprinkle with rosemary.

Ingredient Names: pizza base mix, olive oil, mixed mushrooms such as chestnut, fat garlic, chili flakes, fresh rosemary leaves, half-fat creme fraiche, goat's cheese, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Make up the pizza dough following pack instructions. Meanwhile, make the filling. Heat 1 tsp oil in a large frying pan and fry the mushrooms until golden, about 8 mins. Add garlic, chilli and rosemary and cook for 1 min more. Stir in crème fraîche and 1 tbsp water and remove from heat. Step 2: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Roll out the dough to a 30cm-diameter circle. Spread the mushroom mix across half of the circle, leaving a 2cm border from the edge, and scatter on the goat’s cheese. Fold over and press to seal. Step 3: Brush with remaining oil, transfer to a baking sheet and cook for 15-20 mins until risen and golden. Cut in halves and serve with rocket, if you like.

Ingredient Names: squash, beetroot using rubber gloves, shallots water for mins, extra-virgin olive oil, garlic flat, thyme rosemary, butter for browning, sesame seeds, spinach, vegetable stock, quick-cook polenta, butter, vegetarian-style parmesan cheese, nutmeg, log goat's cheese kind rind, madeira, clear honey, balsamic vinegar, tamari soy sauce, olive oil extra-virgin olive oil, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: For the spinach, boil a kettle and put half the spinach into a colander. Pour over the hot water until it wilts, then cool completely under cold water. Tip into a clean tea towel, then wring out every last drop of water you can. Repeat with the other half. Step 2: For the polenta, bring the stock to the boil in a large pan, then stir in the polenta in a fine, steady stream, so to avoid any lumps. Keep cooking for 5 mins, stirring all the time, until thick. Stir in the butter, Parmesan, half of the spinach, the nutmeg and plenty of seasoning, then leave to cool for a few mins. Step 3: Meanwhile, slice each cheese into three rounds. Tear off six pieces of cling film, about 30cm across, then, while the polenta is still soft, spoon a sixth onto each square. Nestle the slices of cheese on top, then draw the edges of the cling film around and twist, to make burgershaped polenta cakes with the cheese completely sealed in the middle. Cool and chill for up to 2 days. Step 4: Cut the squash and beetroot veg into finger-tip-wide chunks. Keeping the beetroot separate, put the squash, shallots, 2 tbsp extra virgin oil and half of the garlic and herbs into a large bowl, then rub well and leave to marinate for 1 hr. Do the same with the beetroot, remaining herbs and garlic and 1 tbsp oil. Step 5: Heat a small knob of butter in a large non-stick frying pan, then fry the beetroot, herbs and garlic, for 10 mins on a medium heat, stirring often till starting to colour. Tip into one end of a large roasting tin. Wipe out pan, then repeat with the squash and shallots in a little more butter, browning one-third at a time for 5 mins, until tinged golden. Tip into the other end of the tin. Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Transfer the roasting tin to the oven and roast for 40 mins. The veg can be cooled to room temperature at this stage, then covered for up to 24 hrs and crisped up in a hot oven for 15 mins on the day. Step 6: After 40 mins scatter the sesame seeds over the roasted veg, then tip the veg into a large bowl and keep warm. With the roasting tin over a low heat, splash in the Madeira, bubble it down to 2 tbsp, then stir in the honey, balsamic, soy sauce and a little butter. Simmer until just starting to make a syrupy sauce, then stir in the olive oils. Can be made ahead and re-heated. Step 7: Fifteen mins before serving, heat a little oil and remaining butter in a large non-stick frying pan. Once sizzling, add the polenta cakes and fry on both sides for 5 mins until golden. Fry in 2 batches and keep warm. Re-heat the remaining spinach in a pan for a few secs, with a grating more nutmeg and a good pinch of seasoning. Step 8: Sit the polenta cakes on warmed plates, and top with some spinach. Stir parsley into the dressing. Toss the roasted veg with a few tsp, then pile the veg on top of the polenta. Drizzle a little more dressing over and around, then serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fennel sausages, onion, fennel, smoked paprika, garlic, fennel seeds, red wine, tinned chopped tomatoes, sugar, water, black olives, rigatoni, pecorino, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large saute pan for which you have a lid. Step 2: Add the sausage pieces and fry on a medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring regularly, until golden-brown all over. Step 3: Transfer the sausages to a plate, then add the onion and fennel to the hot pan and fry for 3-4 minutes, stirring once in a while, until soft and caramelised; if the pan goes a bit dry, add a teaspoon or so of extra oil. Step 4: Stir in the paprika, garlic and half the fennel seeds, fry for two minutes more, then pour on the wine and boil for 30 seconds, to reduce by half. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, sugar, water, the seared sausage and half a teaspoon of salt, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes; remove the lid after, and cook until the sauce is thick and rich. Step 6: Remove from the heat, stir through the olives and remaining fennel seeds and set aside until you’re ready to serve. Step 7: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, add the pasta and cook for (or according to the instructions on the packet), until al dente. Step 8: Meanwhile, reheat the sauce. Step 9: Drain the pasta, return it to the pot, stir in a tablespoon of oil, then divide between the bowls. Step 10: Put all the pesto ingredients except the basil in the small bowl of a food processor. Step 11: Add a tablespoon of water and blitz to a rough paste. Step 12: Add the basil, then blitz until just combined (the pesto has a much better texture if the basil is not overblended). Step 13: Spoon over the ragù and top with a spoonful of pesto. Step 14: Finish with a sprinkling of chopped fennel fronds, if you have any, and serve at once.

Dish Name: Roast red wine lamb with Italian beans
Ingredient Names: leg lamb, garlic, thyme, olive oil, half red wine, lemons, lamb stock, red onions, balsamic vinegar, rosemary needles, sunblush tomato, cannellini beans, flatleaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Using a sharp knife, cut small slashes all over the lamb, then push a slice of garlic into each. Put half the thyme, 3 tbsp olive oil, wine, lemon zest and a good grinding of black pepper into a large freezer bag. Addthe lamb, tie the bag tightly and refrigerate for at least 4 hrs, preferably overnight. Step 2: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Put the rest of the thyme into the bottom of a roasting tin then lift the lamb out of the marinade and sit on top of the thyme. Roast for 20 mins, then toss onions into the pan, drizzle with a little oil, then turn the oven down to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Roast for 15 mins/450g for medium. Meanwhile, strain the marinade into a pan, add most of the stock and boil until reduced by two thirds (this will take about 20 mins). Set aside. Gravy can be made ahead or the day before if necessary, as long as the meat has marinated for 4 hrs. Step 3: Once the lamb is ready, take out and rest on a board, wrapped in a tent of foil to keep warm. Set the onions aside in a bowl. Put the roasting tin onto a low heat and add the balsamic vinegar to the tin with a splash more stock and scrape all the meaty bits from the bottom. Tip into the jug with the gravy. Step 4: For the beans, add 2 tbsp oil to the roasting tin. Add the rosemary and tomatoes, and fry for 1 min until the rosemary smells aromatic. Tip in the beans, the red onions and the final splash of stock, then warm through. Season, then stir in the parsley just before serving. Serve on a platter, topped with the lamb.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, golden sugar, red wine vinegar, oregano, tomato, spinach, soft rindless goat's cheese, parmesan, nutmeg, cannelloni tubes, ball mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: First make the tomato sauce. Heat the oil in a shallow pan, then fry the garlic for 1 min until fragrant. Add the sugar, vinegar and oregano. Simmer for a moment, then tip in the tomatoes and season. Simmer sauce for 20 mins, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have cooked down to a thick sauce. Turn off heat and set aside. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Put the spinach in a large colander, then pour over a kettle of hot water to wilt it (you may need to do this twice). Pour over cold water to cool it down. Squeeze the spinach, then place it in a clean tea towel and wring out the water really well. Step 3: Tip the spinach into a food processor and pulse to chop, then crumble in the goat’s cheese and half the Parmesan. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg, then blitz until everything is finely chopped. Using a piping bag, or a plastic food bag with the corner cut off, squeeze the mix into the cannelloni tubes, then lay them, side by side, in a baking dish. Pour over the tomato sauce and top with the mozzarella and remaining Parmesan. The cannelloni can now be frozen for up to 1 month – defrost completely before cooking. Bake for 25-30 mins until golden and bubbling, then remove and leave to stand for 5 mins. Serve from the dish.

Dish Name: 10 Minute Tomato Sauce From America's Test Kitchen
Ingredient Names: onion, butter, dried oregano, salt, garlic cloves, crushed tomatoes, sugar, olive oil, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 cup grated onion, saute 2 minutes. Step 3: Add oregano and 1 / 2 tsp salt. Step 4: Cook with stirring 3 minutes until onions begin to brown. Step 5: Add crushed garlic, cook 30 seconds. Step 6: Add crushed tomatoes and sugar. Step 7: Turn heat to high and cook with stirring until simmering. Step 8: Turn heat to medium low.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, ricotta cheese, italian cheese blend, mexican blend cheese, parmesan-romano cheese mix, eggs, parsley flakes, dried italian seasoning, salt, ground pepper, spaghetti sauce, ground beef, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta as directed on box. Step 2: Combine cheeses, eggs, and seasonings, mix well. Step 3: Fill each pasta shell with about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture. Step 4: Spread thin layer of sauce in bottom of 13x9 baking pan. Step 5: Place pasta in pan. Step 6: Cover with remaining sauce Spinkle mozzarella cheese on top. Step 7: Cover with aluminum foil. Step 8: Bake at 350 for approx 35 mins or until hot and bubbly, take foil off and bake additional 15 minutes makes 18-24 servings.

Dish Name: 3 Cheese Bake Elbows Plus Al Forno Con Salsa Ai Tre Formaggi
Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, unsalted butter, fontina cheese, parmesan cheese, provolone cheese, half-and-half cream, eggs, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Cook pasta 5 to 6 minutes, drain, place in large bowl and toss with melted butter. Step 3: Add half of all cheeses to the pasta. Step 4: Combine eggs, half & half, salt and pepper in a small bowl and mix well. Step 5: Add mixture to pasta and mix well. Step 6: Pour half of pasta mixture into baking dish. Step 7: Sprinkle with half of remaining cheese. Step 8: Add remaining pasta, and top with remaining cheese. Step 9: Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until bubbling around the edges.

Ingredient Names: manicotti, mozzarella cheese, chive & onion cream cheese, spaghetti sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook shells according to the package directions. Step 2: Rinse well in cool water and dry While the pasta is cooking, mix together the cream cheese and 3 cups of mozzeralla cheese. Step 3: Stuff shells with cream cheese mixture put a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 13 by 9 baking dish. Step 4: Place manicotti in dish and cover with remaining sauce. Step 5: Sprinkle 1 cup of mozzarella over the top. Step 6: Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes at 375. Step 7: Uncover, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and bake for 15 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, olive oil, garlic cloves, red onion, mushroom, italian sausage, basil, sugar, red wine vinegar, penne pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the sausage well, crumbling with a fork. Step 2: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 3: Remove excess grease. Step 4: In a large skillet, heat olive oil. Step 5: Add onion and cook to desired tenderness. Step 6: Add mushrooms and garlic and cook 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add peppers and cook to desired tenderness. Step 8: When the veggies are at your desired tenderness, add the red wine vinegar and sugar If using sausage, add the meat back to the skillet If i am using fresh basil, i add it last.

Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Place 1 / 2 of the ravioli in a greased 8x8 glass dish. Step 3: Pour half of the sauce on and stir until mixed well. Step 4: Make sure ravioli are spread evenly over dish. Step 5: Place pepperoni slices in a single layer over ravioli and sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle parmesan cheese evenly over entire dish. Step 7: Place remaining ravioli in single layer on top of cheese. Step 8: Spoon remaining sauce over ravioli, making sure ravioli are well-coated. Step 9: Place remaining pepperoni in a single layer on top of ravioli and sauce. Step 10: Sprinkle mozarella over top.

Ingredient Names: carrots, cabbage, celery rib, onion, garlic clove, vegetable oil, water, italian-style diced tomatoes, beef bouillon cubes, fresh spinach, cooked elbow macaroni, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan saute carrots, cabbage, celery, onion, and garlic in oil for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add water, tomatoes, and bouillon. Step 3: Bring to a boil and reduce heatt. Step 4: Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Step 5: Stir in spinach, cooked macaroni, and pepper, heat through. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: 4 Cheese Macaroni With A Little More
Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, onion, olive oil, mushroom, bacon, white wine, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, four cheese blend, salt, red chili pepper flakes, breadcrumbs, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain and place in large mixing bowl. Step 2: Saute onion, mushrooms and bacon in olive oil until carmelized. Step 3: Add wine and reduce. Step 4: Let cool and stir this mixture into cooked macaroni. Step 5: Prepare white sauce by melting butter and adding flour, cook until bubbly, then slowly add milk At medium low heat, stirring constantly, cook until velvety and thickened. Step 6: Add cheese and stir until completely melted and smooth. Step 7: Add sauce to macaroni, stir well and season with parsley, salt and pepper and chili flake, if using. Step 8: Spoon into ungreased baking dish, spread breadcrumbs evenly over surface - bake at 350 f for about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic cloves, sugar, salt, fresh ground pepper, romano cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the garlic cloves in the olive oil Mix in rest of ingredients and saute while crushing all together Cook 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Absolutely Delicious And Simple Tomato Basil And Garlic Pasta
Ingredient Names: spaghettini, scallions, garlic cloves, cherry tomatoes, parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaves, salt & freshly ground black pepper, olive oil, fresh mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, tender but still firm to the bite, stirring often, about 8 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, combine the next 7 ingredients in a food processor Pulse just until the tomatoes are coarsely chopped. Step 3: Drain the pasta, reserving some of the pasta water. Step 4: Toss the pasta with the tomato mixture and fresh mozzarella in a large bowl. Step 5: Add some of the reserved pasta water if the sauce looks dry. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, butter, white onion, garlic cloves, grape tomatoes, canned tomato sauce, garlic salt, cracked black pepper, dried oregano, crushed red pepper flakes, ricotta cheese, pesto sauce, prosciutto, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter on high heat. Step 2: Add onions, garlic and tomatoes and sautee, stirring occasionally until onions and garlic begin to brown. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and stir in tomato sauce, remaining butter and olive oil until butter is melted. Step 4: Stir in garlic salt, cracked pepper, crushed red pepper, and oregano. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients, stir until incorporated and turn off heat immediately You don't want the proscuitto to cook too long since it is already a smoked meat I served this over orecchiette, but it would be nice over penne or farfale as well.

Dish Name: Ace's Den Meatballs In San Marzano Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground pork, onion, white bread, milk, fresh parsley, garlic cloves, kosher salt, pepper, pecorino romano cheese, eggs, san marzano tomatoes, fresh basil, fresh oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce Chopped onion and garlic for tomato sauce Open the canned tomatoes add 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil to a pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add a teaspoon of both salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook onion and garlic until see through then add the tomatoes. Step 4: Bring to a boil and then bring the heat down to low and simmer while you make the meatballs Meatballs First remove the crust from each slice of bread. Step 5: Then pour 1 / 2 cup of milk into a bowl and add the bread to soak up the milk As the bread soaks in the bowl add extra virgin olive oil to a pan over medium head and add chopped onion and garlic.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, hot red pepper flakes, lemon, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Fill large stock pot 2 / 3 full with cold water, add salt to taste and about 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and bring to a boil. Step 2: When water boils add pasta While water is heating, combine half of the olive oil, 2 / 3 of the garlic and salt in a large skillet and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until garlic browns. Step 3: Remove from heat and add remaining garlic, red pepper, lemon juice and 2 or 3 tablespoons of the pasta cooking water and stir. Step 4: When pasta is cooked al dente, reserve 2 tablespoons of cooking water and drain. Step 5: Transfer pasta and garlic mixture to a large bowl and toss to combine. Step 6: Transfer pasta and garlic mixture back to skillet, add salt, reserved cooking water and remaining olive oil and cook over medium heat for about 1 minute, tossing and stirring constantly. Step 7: Transfer back to large bowl and serve. Step 8: Serve with grated parmesan or romano cheese.

Dish Name: Aglio E Olio Spaghetti With Garlic And Olive Oil
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, salt, olive oil, garlic cloves, anchovy fillets, chili, lemon, soft breadcrumbs, parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to the boil. Step 2: Add 2 tablespoons salt, add spaghetti. Step 3: Cook for 14 minutes exactly, then drain About half-way through the cooking time for the spaghetti, heat the olive oil in a large frypan over a medium heat. Step 4: Add the garlic, anchovy and chilli - i pound these three ingredients in a mortar and pestle for a minute or so first, but this is not absolutely necessary. Step 5: Cook the garlic, anchovy and chilli mixture in the oil for a couple of minutes until the garlic is soft but not brown. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and add lemon juice, breadcrumbs, salt and half the parsley and stir to combine With the pan still on the heat, add the drained spaghetti and toss with a pair of tongs or two forks to combine thoroughly. Step 7: Serve sprinkled with grated or granulated parmesan cheese and the rest of the parsley.

Dish Name: Aglio Olio Garlic And Oil Pasta
Ingredient Names: linguine, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, extra virgin olive oil, anchovy fillets, flat leaf parsley, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta to desired done-ness. Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the garlic and pepper flakes until they start making noise. Step 3: Add the anchovies and stir them in the oil until they are no longer visible. Step 4: Toss with the cooked and drained pasta Adjust salt and pepper if needed, serve.

Ingredient Names: prosciutto ham, onion, cooked spaghetti, egg, parmesan cheese, parsley, oregano, red pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dice 1 / 3 cup prosciutto ham, add chopped onion and saute in 2 tbsp Olive oil In the meantime, cook up a generous helping of spaghetti for one Spice the prosciutto and onions with the parsley, oregano and red pepper and stir fry until golden, then add the cooked spaghetti and stir fry to blend. Step 2: Add a beaten egg and continue to stir. Step 3: Add parmesan cheese and serve.

Dish Name: Alfredo Fettuccine A La Olive Garden
Ingredient Names: cream cheese, parmesan cheese, butter, milk, nutmeg, dry fettuccine
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan combine cream cheese, parmesan, butter and milk. Step 2: Stir constantly, cooking gently over med / low heat, until smooth and thickened. Step 3: Add nutmeg, if desired. Step 4: Toss pasta lightly with sauce, coating well, serve.

Dish Name: Alfredo Fettuccine With Chicken And Broccoli
Ingredient Names: chicken tenders, onion, red pepper, olive oil, alfredo sauce, broccoli florets, fresh ground pepper, parmesan cheese, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Get olive oil hot in 12" frying pan. Step 2: Saute onion and pepper until tender. Step 3: Add chicken and cook until done. Step 4: Turn heat to low and add alfredo sauce. Step 5: Boil broccoli until done. Step 6: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 7: Once broccoli is done, add to the prepared sauce. Step 8: Once noodles are done, place into bowl and cover with sauce. Step 9: Top with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh mushrooms, alfredo sauce, cheese ravioli, red bell pepper, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f. Step 2: Melt butter in 12-inch skillet until sizzling. Step 3: Add chicken pieces. Step 4: Cook over medium-high heat until chicken is lightly browned. Step 5: Add mushrooms Continue cooking until chicken is no longer pink and mushrooms are tender Do not drain. Step 6: Spread 1 / 2 cup sauce into greased 13x9-inch baking dish. Step 7: Arrange single layer of frozen ravioli over sauce. Step 8: Drizzle 3 / 4 cup sauce evenly over ravioli.

Ingredient Names: butter, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles or fettuccine according to package directions. Step 2: Heat butter and cream in saucepan until butter is melted, remove from heat. Step 3: Add 1 cup parmesan cheese, salt and pepper. Step 4: Stir until sauce is blended and fairly smooth. Step 5: Add to drained noodles and toss until they are well coated. Step 6: Sprinkle with remaining cheese Variation: add cooked shrimp, crab or mushrooms.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, yellow onion, vegetable oil, arborio rice, water, sugar pumpkin, chicken bouillon cube, nutmeg, gorgonzola, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve boullion cube in the water Saut the onion and chopped garlic in vegetable oil in a wide-bottomed pan, add the rice. Step 2: Add the water / bouillon mixture. Step 3: Add the pureed pumpkin. Step 4: Stir the pumpkin into the rice. Step 5: Cook for about 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add gorgonzola cheese at the last minute and stir.
