Step 7: Serve with grated parmesan cheese to sprinkle on top.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, garlic, tomato sauce, tomato paste, tomato juice, water, salt, chili powder, oregano, pepper, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook first 3 ingredients on the stove, stirring until beef crumbles and is no longer pink, drain well. Step 2: Stir in tomato sauce and next 8 ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring often, 30 minutes. Step 4: Add uncooked pasta, cover and simmer another 20-30 minutes (or longer, if desired). Step 5: Serve with Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: farfalle pasta, butter, parmesan cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta in at least 2 quarts of water until it is tender, but not falling apart. Step 2: Drain well in a colander and return right away to the warm cooking pot. Step 3: Cut up the butter into the pasta and add the grated parmesan cheese. Step 4: Add the salt, less if desired. Step 5: Toss carefully and serve when butter and cheese have fully melted.

Ingredient Names: cooked lasagna noodles, hamburger, spaghetti sauce mix, tomato paste, water, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, dried parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook lasagna noodles as directed Brown hamburger. Step 2: Add spaghetti mix, tomato paste and water to the browned hamburger. Step 3: Mix well and simmer for 15 minutes While sauce is cooking, mix cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese and parsley together. Step 4: Layer sauce, noodles and cheese mixture in this order in a 9 x 13 baking dish End with sauce on the top. Step 5: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and place in a 350 oven. Step 6: Bake for 30 minutes. Step 7: Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: fusilli, frozen baby peas, black olives, genoa salami, green onion, celery, fresh parsley, italian salad dressing mix, mayonnaise, sour cream, milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook pasta until al dente, rinse under cold water and drain. Step 2: In a medium bowl combine mayonnaise, sour cream, milk and italian dressing mix. Step 3: Whisk together until smooth, set aside. Step 4: In a large salad bowl combine cooked and cooled pasta, peas, olives, salami, green onions, celery and parsley. Step 5: Mix in dressing last, reserving 1 / 2 cup. Step 6: Let sit over night in fridge. Step 7: Stir before serving. Step 8: Add extra dressing if pasta appears dry.

Dish Name: Amy's Lasagne With A White And Red Sauce
Ingredient Names: butter, flour, milk, heavy cream, ground nutmeg, ground beef, spaghetti sauce, lasagna noodle, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a 9x13 or larger baking dish, spray with pam or grease. Step 2: Cook & cool lasagna noodles, or use the non-cook kind. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 4: Combine the flour and butter in a saucepan over medium heat until you have made a roux, cook until blond. Step 5: Add milk, heavy cream and nutmeg to the roux. Step 6: Beat with wire whisk until smooth. Step 7: Bring to a soft boil until thickened, remove from heat. Step 8: Cook meat and add spaghetti sauce to meat and heat through. Step 9: Layer: noodles, red sauce, white sauce, mozzarella cheese 1-2 cups.

Dish Name: Amy Truong Zucchini Low Carb Lasagna
Ingredient Names: ground buffalo meat, white onion, roma tomatoes, tomato paste, garlic clove, dried oregano, dried basil, dried thyme, water, black pepper, eggs, cottage cheese, crushed red pepper flakes, sriracha sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees Oil pan with garlic infused olive oil. Step 2: Fry meat and onions until meat is brown and onions are tender, drain fat. Step 3: Return meat and onions to pan and add next eight ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat Occasionally stirring. Step 5: Beat egg in a small bowl. Step 6: Add cottage cheese, red pepper flakes, sriracha sauce, 1 cup of mozzarella and flour.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, penne, egg, ricotta cheese, reduced-fat cream cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper, fresh parsley, extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground beef, pepperoni, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare spaghetti sauce in advance. Step 2: Set aside to cool I do mine the night before and place in the refrigerator to cool overnight If using the recipe for my grandma's spaghetti sauce, see recipe below. Step 3: Boil noodles al dente. Step 4: Drain and give a quick rinse in cold water to stop the cooking. Step 5: Stir the pasta into the spaghetti sauce, set aside. Step 6: In a separate bowl, combine egg, ricotta, mozzarella, romano, salt, pepper and parsley. Step 7: In a foil-lined and greased 10x13-inch casserole pan, spread half of the pasta / meat mixture into the bottom of the pan.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, fresh broccoli florets, butter, sun-dried tomato pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to boil in large pot. Step 2: Stir pasta into boiling water, boil for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in broccoli and boil for 4 more minutes, stir occasionally, drain well. Step 4: Add butter to saucepan using residual heat to melt butter. Step 5: Stir in pesto and pasta and broccoli. Step 6: Toss to mix and serve.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta W Garlic Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, olive oil, sun-dried tomato, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in boiling water for 3-5 minutes, drain. Step 2: In a small saucepan, heat olive oil until warm. Step 3: Add sundried tomatoes& garlic. Step 4: Saute for 4 minutes. Step 5: Add italian seasoning and saute for 1 more minute. Step 6: Toss drained pasta with desired amount of sauce. Step 7: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Anchovy Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic clove, anchovy fillet, fresh ground black pepper, angel hair pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium low heat, add garlic and cook about 30 seconds. Step 2: Add anchovies along with the oil in the can, stir, cook 2 minutes. Step 3: Season with pepper to taste and pour over pasta and toss. Step 4: Top with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Basil Tomato Sauce And Chicken
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, shallot, roma tomatoes, salt and pepper, fresh basil, whole wheat angel hair pasta, water, parmesan cheese, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Saut garlic and shallot in oil over medium heat until garlic golden and shallot wilted. Step 2: Add tomatoes and season with salt, pepper, and basil. Step 3: Chop cooked chicken into bite size pieces. Step 4: Add pasta, water, and chicken to sauce, stir gently in to coat Move to serving platter, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and serve.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Basil Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, fresh garlic, roma tomatoes, fresh basil leaf, light butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, spray 10-inch nonstick skillet with no-stick cooking spray, add garlic. Step 4: Cook over medium heat 1 minute. Step 5: Add tomatoes and basil Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Step 6: Toss together hot pasta, tomato mixture and light butter in large serving bowl. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Chicken And Garlic
Ingredient Names: whole wheat angel hair pasta, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, salt, black pepper, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, chicken strips
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the past according to package directions, drain. Step 2: In a large saucepan, under low heat, mix olive oil and chopped garlic, stirring constantly until garlic start browning. Step 3: Turn off the heat, add angle hair, toss. Step 4: Add salt, if necessary, and black pepper to taste. Step 5: Serve with grilled chicken strips and lots of grated mozzarella and parmesan cheese on top Use extra virgin olive oil. Step 6: When heating the olive oil with garlic be very careful so you don't burn the garlic.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Prosciutto And Peas
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, olive oil, salt, fresh ground pepper, butter, shallot, cream, white wine, green peas, prosciutto, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain, reserving a small amount of cooking water. Step 2: Return pasta to pot, tossing with olive oil, salt and pepper. Step 3: Melt butter in large, non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add shallot and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in cream and white wine, bring to boil. Step 6: Add peas and cook until tender, 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in prosciutto and parmesan, cook for 1 minute. Step 8: Add pasta and toss to coat well. Step 9: Top with additional parmesan if desired.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Prosciutto And Wild Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: wild mushroom, tomatoes, prosciutto, salt and pepper, olive oil, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, rosemary sprigs, angel hair pasta, whipping cream, butter, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the mushrooms and pat dry. Step 2: Cut off and reserve stems. Step 3: Cut the mushroom caps into thin strips You should have about 4 cups of mushrooms. Step 4: Cut the tomatoes into 1 / 2 inch cubes. Step 5: Cut the prosciutto into very thin strips. Step 6: Heat oil in skillet and add mushrooms, rosemary, pepper, and crushed red pepper and salt. Step 7: Cook, stirring for about 3 minutes, then add the garlic and prosciutto for another 1-2 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, cook pasta in boiling water to desired doneness Reserve 1 / 2 cup of the cooking liquid, drain pasta, and return to pot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, fresh carrot, celery, links italian sausage, salt, pepper, oregano, parsley, red wine, tomatoes, ziti pasta, mozzarella cheese, eggs, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown sausage links well. Step 2: Remove and cut into 1/2 inch rounds, put aside. Step 3: Make sauce by heating the oil. Step 4: Add onion, garlic, carrot, celery, saute until soft. Step 5: Add wine and reduce to half. Step 6: Add tomatoes, salt, pepper, oregano, sausage, and parsley. Step 7: Simmer for 60 minutes until thickened. Step 8: Cook pasta until al dente. Step 9: Drain and add to sauce and mix well. Step 10: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Step 11: Using a buttered ovenproof dish, put in 1/3 of pasta mix. Step 12: Sprinkle with diced mozzarella. Step 13: Repeat layers twice more. Step 14: Pour beaten eggs over top of pasta. Step 15: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Step 16: Bake until bubbly. Step 17: Let stand a few minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: bell peppers, garlic cloves, olive oil, sweet italian sausage, tomato sauce, rotelle pasta, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f In large heavy skillet, saute peppers and garlic in hot oil until peppers are tender. Step 2: Remove with slotted spoon to large bowl and set aside. Step 3: Add sausage to pan and brown thoroughly. Step 4: Remove with slotted spoon and add to bowl with peppers. Step 5: Add tomato sauce and cooked pasta and combine. Step 6: Bake 45 minutes until heated through. Step 7: Sprinkle with parmesan and mozzarella and bake an additional 5-10 minutes until cheese is melted and golden. Step 8: Remove from oven and allow to sit 5 minutes before serving Enjoy with crusty italian bread and a salad.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parsley, salt, black pepper, eggs, spaghetti sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f in a large bowl, mix ricotta and mozzarella cheeses, parsley, salt, pepper, and eggs thoroughly. Step 2: Pour a little more than half the sauce in a 9x13x2" pan. Step 3: Fill shells with cheese mixture generously, and place into the pan with the sauce. Step 4: Drizzle remaining sauce lightly over the top of the shells. Step 5: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Step 6: Bake 30-40 minutes until bubbly. Step 7: Let stand a few minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Anthony's Favorite Stuffed Shells Lite Bleu
Ingredient Names: low-carb pasta, part-skim ricotta cheese, fat-free cottage cheese, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, fresh parsley, salt, black pepper, eggs, spaghetti sauce, fat-free parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f in a large bowl, mix ricotta, cottage, and mozzerella cheeses, parsley, salt, pepper, and eggs thoroughly. Step 2: Pour 2 cups of the sauce in a 9x13x2" pan. Step 3: Fill shells with cheese mixture generously, and place into the pan with the sauce. Step 4: Drizzle remaining sauce lightly over the top of the shells. Step 5: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Step 6: Bake 30-40 minutes until bubbly. Step 7: Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat pasta shells, giardiniera, fresh broccoli florets, mozzarella cheese, hard salami, deli ham, turkey pepperoni, green pepper, sliced ripe olives, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, italian seasoning, fresh coarse ground black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, drain giardiniera, reserving 3 / 4 cup liquid. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine giardiniera, broccoli, mozzarella, salami, ham, pepperoni, green pepper and olives. Step 4: Drain pasta and rinse in cold water. Step 5: Stir into meat mixture For dressing, in a small bowl, whisk the oil, vinegar, lemon juice, italian seasoning, pepper, salt and reserved giardiniera liquid. Step 6: Pour over salad and toss to coat. Step 7: Refrigerate until serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, unsalted butter, onions, white rice, apples, dry white wine, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, salt, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the chicken broth in a small saucepan until boiling Adjust the heat to a steady simmer. Step 2: Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a heavy, large saucepan over low heat. Step 3: Add onion and saute for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the rice and 1 cup of the apples. Step 5: Saute, stirring for 3 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the wine and boil, stirring, until wine is reduced by half. Step 7: Add enough hot broth to just cover the rice. Step 8: Simmer and cook, stirring constantly, until almost all of the broth has been absorbed, about 3-4 minutes Continue adding hot broth in 1 / 2 cup incriments, stirring constantly, until all broth is absorbed and rice is pulling away from the pan.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, italian-style stewed tomatoes, crushed red pepper flakes, penne pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, saute garlic in olive oil until garlic is lightly browned. Step 2: Add italian style stewed tomatoes and crushed red peppr. Step 3: Simmer for approx 20 minutes on low. Step 4: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 5: When both arrabiata sauce and pasta are done, toss together. Step 6: Toss in cheese while sauce is hot so it will melt.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, chopped tomatoes, olive oil, onion, garlic clove, chili flakes, basil, salt and black pepper, sugar, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, gently cook the onion and garlic in the olive oil until the onion has softened. Step 2: Add the chopped tomatoes with the juice, chilli flakes, basil and sugar. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and simmer, stirring frequently for 40-45 minutes until its rendered to a nice thick sauce. Step 4: Cook the pasta in plenty of salted water until cooked 'al dente', and then drain the pasta. Step 5: Add the pasta to the sauce and mix in well. Step 6: Serve with grated parmesan. Step 7: Add slightly more chilli if a hotter flavour is required.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, dried chili pepper flakes, fresh basil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, sugar, ground pork, streaky bacon, thyme leaves, flat leaf parsley, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a frying pan until hot, then add the tomatoes and olive oil and bring to a gentle simmer. Step 2: Add the garlic, chili and half of the basil and cook for 10 minutes, until reduced and thickened. Step 3: Season, to taste, with salt, freshly ground black pepper and a little sugar. Step 4: Place the ground pork, bacon, thyme and parsley into a bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 5: Season with a little salt and plenty of freshly ground black pepper. Step 6: Divide the mixture into 16 and shape each portion into a small ball, using your hands. Step 7: Place the meatballs into the tomato sauce and simmer for 5-8 minutes, or until the meatballs are completely cooked through. Step 8: Meanwhile, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Step 9: Add the spaghetti and cook according to packet instructions. Step 10: Drain the spaghetti, then add to the tomato and meatball sauce.

Ingredient Names: butter, mushroom, garlic cloves, frozen artichoke hearts, dry vermouth, all-purpose flour, whole milk, parmesan cheese, ground nutmeg, no-boil lasagna noodles, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: For filling:melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add mushrooms and garlic Saut until mushrooms release juices and begin to brown, about 7 minutes. Step 3: Add artichokes and vermouth. Step 4: Cook until liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper For bchamel sauce:melt butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium-high heat, add flour. Step 6: Stir 1 minute Gradually whisk in milk.

Ingredient Names: dry penne pasta, artichoke hearts, fresh parsley leaves, walnuts, lemon, garlic clove, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor combine the artichokes, parsley, walnuts, lemon zest and juice, garlic, salt, and pepper Run the machine to finely chop all the ingredients, stopping the machine a few times to scrape down the sides. Step 2: Then, with the machine running, drizzle in 1 / 2 cup extra-virgin olive oil. Step 3: Toss the mix with pasta, fold in parmesan.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, flour, chicken broth, garlic cloves, canned artichoke hearts, lemon juice, fresh parmesan cheese, linguine, capers, sliced ripe olives, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook oil, butter, flour, chicken broth until it thickens. Step 2: Add garlic, artichoke hearts, lemon juice, and cheese Continue cooking until flavors blend Ad capers and parsley. Step 3: Toss with linguini cooked al dente. Step 4: Top pasta dishes with small sliced black olives.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, juice lemon, olive oil, parmesan, artichoke heart from, black olives, wild arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. While it cooks, mix together the lemon zest and juice, oil and Parmesan. Step 2: Drain the pasta, reserving 3 tbsp of the cooking water, then return to the pan with the lemon mix, cooking water, artichokes and olives. Heat through briefly, season well, stir through the rocket, then serve.

Dish Name: Arugula And Walnut Pesto With Penne
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic, arugula, walnut pieces, nutmeg, salt and pepper, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, penne rigate, fresh green beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan over medium heat cook garlic in oil 5 minutes, then remove pan from stove top. Step 2: Fill the food processor with arugula, loosely packed. Step 3: Add walnuts and 1 / 2 of the warm oil and all 3 cloves of garlic to the arugula in the processor. Step 4: Add nutmeg, salt and pepper to the processor bowl, set lid in place and pulse grind the mixture into a thick paste. Step 5: Add any remaining arugula to the processor and grind into the paste by pulsing the processor again. Step 6: Transfer arugula paste to a large pasta bowl. Step 7: Stir in the remaining oil and the cheese. Step 8: Taste pesto sauce and adjust seasonings While cooking penne to package directions for al dente, watch the time. Step 9: After about 6 minutes, add green beans to the pasta pot.

Ingredient Names: arugula, capers, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt and pepper, spaghetti, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Boil spaghetti in water as directed, drain. Step 2: Add arugula, capers, cheese, oil, garlic, salt& pepper in processor, pulse until a paste is formed. Step 3: Add to hot spaghetti, top with tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, bacon, asparagus, garlic, parmesan cheese, egg yolks, yogurt, salt, ground black pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-low heat and cook bacon in the hot skillet, stirring occasionally, until browned, 5 to. Step 4: Transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate using a slotted spoon. Step 5: Remove all but bacon fat from the skillet. Step 6: Add asparagus to bacon fat in the skillet and cook and stir until asparagus begins to brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Transfer asparagus and garlic to the plate with bacon. Step 9: Reserve Parmesan cheese for garnish. Step 10: Whisk together remaining Parmesan cheese, egg yolks, Greek yogurt, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until well combined. Step 11: Drain spaghetti, setting aside about the cooking water, and return spaghetti to the pot. Step 12: Stir in egg yolk mixture and toss for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 13: Return the pot back to low heat and cook, adjusting consistency with reserved cooking water if necessary, 1 to. Step 14: Turn off heat, pour in half-and-half, and stir well. Step 15: Mix in bacon and asparagus until evenly distributed. Step 16: Garnish with reserved Parmesan cheese and parsley.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, olive oil, sun-dried tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, parmesan cheese, pancetta, onion, garlic cloves, asparagus, whole milk ricotta cheese, salt, fresh ground black pepper, mozzarella cheese, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add 1 teaspoon olive oil. Step 3: Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 to 10 minutes for dried pasta or 2 to 3 minutes for fresh pasta, drain pasta. Step 4: In a food processor combine the sun-dried tomatoes and basil Pulse until the mixture is combined. Step 5: Transfer to a small bowl. Step 6: Stir in 1 / 2 cup parmesan, set aside. Step 7: In a large skillet brown the pancetta until crisp.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper, leeks, arborio rice, chicken broth, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, lemon zest, lemon juice, coarse black pepper, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Roast asparagus: place asparagus in a single layer on a baking s heet. Step 2: Brush evenly with 1 t Olive oil Lightly sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Step 3: Bake, uncovered, in 450-degree oven about 10 minutes or until crisp-tender, cool slightly. Step 4: Cut two-thirds into 2-inch pieces. Step 5: Set aside all asparagus While the asparagus is roasting, cook leeks in a large saucepan in 1 t Olive oil until tender.

Ingredient Names: asparagus spear, linguine, olive oil, garlic cloves, fresh ground black pepper, fresh button mushrooms, reduced-sodium chicken broth, salt, butter, fresh basil, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Snap off and discard woody base of fresh asparagus. Step 2: Rinse Bias-slice asparagus into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces, set aside. Step 3: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add garlic and black pepper. Step 6: Cook and stir for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add asparagus, mushrooms, chicken broth or wine, and 1 / 4 t salt, bring to boiling.

Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, chicken broth, asparagus, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil, fresh sage leaf, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place pasta and broth in a 4-5 quart pan over high heat, cover, and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium-high, cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add asparagus and cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is barely tender to bite, 8-10 minutes, stir in cheese. Step 4: Remove pan from heat. Step 5: Meanwhile, cook oil in a medium frying pan over medium heat, 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add sage leaves, stir often until edges begin to curl, 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat With a slotted spoon, lift sage to a towel Reserve oil.

Ingredient Names: pasta noodles, asparagus, garlic, olive oil, onion, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: --------------pesto------------- Saute garlic, and onion in olive oil until the garlic and onion turns light brown Do not over cook. Step 2: Set aside and keep warm. Step 3: Prepare the pasta of your choice according to package directions except for the following: add 1-2 cups additional water just before water begins to boil, add the asparagus or the vegetables of your choice. Step 4: When the water begins to boil add the pasta and cook according to directions drain the pasta and vegetable mixture and pour the saute mixture and basil over the top, tossing lightly to coat. Step 5: Top with parmesan cheese and serve with french bread This pesto recipe makes 2-4 servings depending on appetite.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, butter, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, button mushrooms, prosciutto, fresh basil, fresh oregano, fresh rosemary, plum tomatoes, salt, black pepper, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse asparagus, break off tough ends and discard. Step 2: Cut asparagus into 3 / 4 inch lengths and place in a bowl filled with cold water and set aside. Step 3: In a large frying pan, heat butter and oil over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add garlic and saute' for about 3 minutes. Step 5: Drain asparagus and add to frying pan, cover and cook for 2 minutes, stirring at least once. Step 6: Add mushrooms, proscuitto, basil, oregano and rosemary, mix well and cook covered until asparagus is tender crisp, about 5 minutes, stir frequently. Step 7: Stir in chopped diced tomatoes, salt and pepper and cook for another 3 minutes, stirring frequently If mixture appears too dry, add more butter. Step 8: Meanwhile, in a pasta cooking pot or a large pot, fill 3 / 4 full with water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 9: Add 1 tablespoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of olive oil.

Ingredient Names: mint, ricotta, parmesan, farfalle, asparagus tips
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, briefly whizz the mint leaves, ricotta and grated Parmesan until you have a smooth green pesto. Season well. Step 2: Boil the pasta, dropping in the asparagus tips 2-3 mins before the cooking time is up. When you drain the pasta, keep back a few tbsp of the water, then return the pasta, asparagus and water to the saucepan. Step 3: Quickly stir in the mint pesto, divide between 4 plates, then shave over the remaining Parmesan to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, eggplants, smoked streaky bacon, garlic, red chile, tomatoes, pasta, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Add the aubergine and cook for 8 mins until soft. Add the bacon and fry until cooked through, adding the garlic and chilli for the final min. Tip in the tomatoes, increase the heat and cook for 10 mins until thickened, stirring regularly. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta. Drain well, then stir through the sauce. Serve with a scattering of Parmesan, if you like.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, carrot, rice, chicken broth, dry white wine, reduced-fat parmesan cheese, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Keep broth in a saucepan over low-medium heat On another burner, heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and saute onion and carrot for about 3 minutes, add rice and stir. Step 2: Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and stir And stir And stir! Step 3: You should never stop stirring for more than a minute at a time. Step 4: When you are stirring and you notice that the rice doesn't cover the bottom of the pot right away, it is time to add another cup of hot broth. Step 5: Keep repeating this procedure. Step 6: Taste the rice after about 30 minutes and see if the "crunch" is gone The rice should be tender and the consistency of the dish should be creamy.

Ingredient Names: bacon, cream, paprika, egg, egg yolk, parmesan cheese, butter, pepper, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Remove rind from bacon, cut bacon into thin strips. Step 2: Place bacon into frying pan over low heat, cook gently until crisp. Step 3: Drain off any bacon fat from the pan, leaving approximately 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in the pan. Step 4: Add cream and paprika, stir until combined. Step 5: Place egg, egg yolk and 30g of parmesan cheese into bowl, mix until combined. Step 6: Cook fettucine in large saucepan of boiling water as per directions on packet until just cooked. Step 7: Drain pasta, return to pan with butter, toss over low heat until combined. Step 8: Add bacon / cream mixture to pasta, toss until combined. Step 9: Add egg mixture, toss until combined. Step 10: Season with pepper.

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, fresh mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, extra virgin olive oil, sweet italian sausage, hot italian sausage, onion, garlic cloves, san marzano tomatoes, tomato paste, fresh thyme, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce. Step 2: Remove the sausage casings and crumble the sausage. Step 3: Add 2 teaspoons of olive oil to a pan, and brown the sausage. Step 4: Puree the tomatoes in a blender. Step 5: Add onions and garlic to now-browned sausage. Step 6: Cook for a few more minutes until transparent. Step 7: Add your tomato puree to the sausage. Step 8: Add thyme and basil to sauce. Step 9: Add some salt and pepper to taste. Step 10: Add a generous pinch of the pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: fresh tomatoes, olive oil, fresh garlic, fresh basil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: To cook sauce, heat olive oil over medium heat in a large iron skillet or heavy saucepan. Step 2: Add garlic and cook until tender. Step 3: Add fresh tomatoes and cook until heated through. Step 4: Stir in basil, crushed red pepper, black pepper and salt. Step 5: Serve sauce over cooked spaghetti or other italian pasta and top with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: carrots, celery ribs, white onion, olive oil, ground beef, red wine, crushed tomatoes, salt, pepper, rigatoni pasta, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Put the olive oil into a pan. Step 2: Add the chopped veggies and saute until the celery softens. Step 3: Add ground beef or veal and saute until meat browns. Step 4: Add your favorite red wine. Step 5: Add the crushed tomatoes, salt and pepper to taste and allow this to simmer over low heat for at least an hour until sauce thickens. Step 6: Boil rigatoni in hot, salted water To plate the dish, put the rigatoni in a bowl, pour some sauce on top and garnish with some fresh parsley.

Ingredient Names: cabbage leaf, porcini mushroom, unsalted butter, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, rosemary, water, red wine, all-purpose flour, whole milk, nutmeg, pecorino cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, no-boil lasagna noodles, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Cut cabbage into thin strips. Step 3: Pour boiling water over porcini mushrooms and let soak for 30 minutes or until softened. Step 4: Drain and chop porcini mushrooms. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon of the butter and the oil in a large skillet over moderately low heat. Step 6: Add garlic, mushrooms and rosemary and cook until garlic is golden, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add cabbage and cook over low heat, covered for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add wine and simmer until the wine is evaporated. Step 9: Add 1 / 4 cup of water and cook over low heat until cabbage is tender, about 6 minutes. Step 10: Discard garlic and rosemary and season cabbage with salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Autumn Pasta With Pumpkin And Sausage
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, sweet italian sausage link, garlic, onion, bay leaves, fresh sage, dry white wine, chicken stock, canned pumpkin, heavy cream, cinnamon, ground nutmeg, salt and pepper, penne, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet to mh heat. Step 2: Add 1 t olive oil, then brown sausage. Step 3: Transfer sausage to plate lined with paper towels to drain fat, set aside. Step 4: Drain fat from skillet, return skillet to stove. Step 5: Add 1 t olive oil, garlic and onion. Step 6: Saute 3-5 minutes, until tender. Step 7: Add bay, sage, and wine to the pan, stir and incorperate sausage drippings from bottom of the pan. Step 8: Reduce wine by half, then add stock and pumpkin, stir. Step 9: When mixture comes to a bubble, add sausage to pan, reduce heat and add cream. Step 10: Season with cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, avocados, bacon, fresh basil, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ground black pepper, salt, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large bowl combine the avocados, bacon, basil, lemon juice,olive oil, garlic, pepper, and salt. Step 3: Add the hot pasta and toss to combine. Step 4: Transfer to a serving bowl. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: bucatini pasta, pancetta, avocado, pecorino romano cheese, egg yolks, ground black pepper, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook bucatini in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Step 4: Add pancetta and cook on until tender and the fat has rendered, remove from heat. Step 5: Ladle pasta cooking water into a bowl; set aside. Step 6: Puree avocado in a bowl using a hand blender. Step 7: Add Pecorino Romano cheese, egg yolks, black pepper, and lemon juice. Step 8: Stir well until sauce is creamy. Step 9: Use spaghetti tongs to add the pasta directly from the water to the pan with the pancetta, allowing a bit of pasta water to help thin the sauce. Step 10: Toss the pasta in the skillet to coat the pasta with the pancetta. Step 11: Add avocado sauce to the pasta, stirring constantly. Step 12: Mix in reserved pasta water if necessary. Step 13: Divide pasta between 2 plates. Step 14: Top with the remaining cheese and black pepper. Step 15: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: bulk italian sausage, ground beef, onion, carrot, garlic cloves, chicken stock, tomatoes, tomato sauce, bay leaf, basil, campanelle pasta, fresh parsley, part-skim ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown sausage and beef until cooked through, breaking it up as it cooks, drain off any fat. Step 2: Add onion, carrot and garlic. Step 3: Cook until vegetables are soft. Step 4: Add chicken stock and deglaze pan. Step 5: Then add crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, bay leaf and basil. Step 6: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Bring to a boil then turn down and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 8: Cook pasta as directed in salted water until just al dente, drain.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, water, garlic clove, italian seasoning, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley, ground black pepper, lasagna noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 In large pan, brown italian sausage, drain. Step 2: Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, water, garlic and italian seasoning. Step 3: Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes In medium bowl, combine ricotta, 2 cups of the mozzarella, parmesan, eggs, parsley and pepper, mix well. Step 4: Pour about 1 cup of the sauce on bottom of 9x13 pan. Step 5: Arrange 3 uncooked lasagna noodles over sauce. Step 6: Cover with about 1 cup sauce.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, butter, garlic, onions, flour, thyme, nutmeg, fresh black pepper, half-and-half cream, parmesan cheese, swiss cheese, tomatoes, spinach, fresh breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Grease a 13" x 9" baking pan. Step 3: Cook the pasta only to firm-tender (don't overcook, as the pasta will cook more when baked in the oven) according to package directions (omit the salt in the water); drain, set aside. Step 4: In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, melt the butter over med-high heat. Step 5: Add in the chopped onion (if using) and the garlic; saute for 5 minutes. Step 6: Whisk in the flour, thyme, nutmeg and black pepper; cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 7: Gradually whisk in the half and half; cook for 4 minutes, until thick and bubbly. Step 8: Add in the grated Swiss cheese, and the Parmesan cheese; mix well over low heat, until the cheese has melted, and the sauce is hot and bubbly; remove the saucepan from the heat. Step 9: In a large bowl, combine the cream/cheese sauce, 1/2 cup of the remaining Swiss cheese (it is not necessery to add the remaining 1/2 cup cheese, you may omit if desired), chopped tomato, and the spinach; stir well. Step 10: Spoon the mixture into a prepared greased baking pan. Step 11: In a small bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, melted butter and the Parmesan cheese. Step 12: Sprinkle the mixture over the casserole in the baking pan. Step 13: Bake for 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Step 14: Note: this recipes calls for NO salt, as the grated Parmesan cheese produces enough salty taste, but if you do choose to add salt, add just a small amount (to taste with the cream sauce) at a time, otherwise it tends to get too salty.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, grated parmesan cheese, eggs, egg yolk, salt, ground black pepper, elbow macaroni, garlic, cherry tomatoes, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add bacon; cook, stirring occasionally until crisp and fat has rendered, 5 to. Step 3: Remove bacon using a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 4: Pour bacon fat into a small bowl and set aside, but do not wash the skillet. Step 5: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Mix Parmesan cheese, eggs, egg yolk, and black pepper together in a bowl. Step 7: Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Drain into a colander set over a large, heatproof bowl. Step 9: Reserve the cooking water and pour the rest out, keeping the now-heated bowl in place. Step 10: Return reserved bacon fat to the large skillet over medium heat. Step 11: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 12: Cook 30 seconds more and add tomatoes. Step 13: Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through but not falling apart, about 5 minutes, stir in spinach. Step 14: Add cooked bacon, cooked tomato mixture, and cooked pasta to the heated bowl. Step 15: Whisk the reserved cooking water into the egg mixture. Step 16: Pour this over the pasta mixture in the bowl and toss for 2 minutes. Step 17: Thin sauce if necessary by adding additional reserved cooking water. Step 18: Season with salt and pepper. Step 19: Serve immediately with additional Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: flour, baby food, cold water
Instructions: Step 1: By hand: put flour into a mixing bowl making a well in the center for the baby food Incorporate flour into baby food by mixing in the well slowly pulling in the flour If using a kitchen aide mixer use the dough mixer and it will do this for you You should get a ball after a while It should feel like play dough If it does not start to ball you may need to add more water If it is too sticky add more flour By food processor: put flour into a food processor bowl add the wet ingredients and 1 tsp oil to the flour in the food processor. Step 2: Turn on the processor and mix until ingredients are evenly distributed Mixture will be sandy and crumbly.

Ingredient Names: shaped pasta, fresh broccoli, smoked bacon, pesto, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the pasta according to pack instructions. About 3 mins before the pasta is cooked, throw in the broccoli. When everything is done, drain, reserving about 100ml of the cooking water. Step 2: While the pasta is cooking, grill the bacon for 6-7 mins until crisp, then cut into bite-size pieces. Tip everything into the pasta pan, toss together well and loosen with a little of the cooking water, if needed. Sprinkle over the Parmesan and serve.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, chestnuts, streaky bacon, pesto, fat creme fraiche, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in boiling water in a large non-stick saucepan according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, slice the mushrooms and snip the bacon into bite-size pieces with scissors or a sharp knife. Step 2: Reserve a few drops of the cooking water in a cup or bowl, then drain the pasta and set aside. Fry the bacon and mushrooms in the same pan until golden, about 5 mins. Keep the heat high so the mushrooms fry in the bacon fat, rather than sweat. Step 3: Tip the pasta and reserved water back into the pan and stir over the heat for 1 min. Take the pan off the heat, spoon in the pesto and crème fraîche and most of the basil and stir to combine. Sprinkle with the remaining basil to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, onions, butter, pumpkin, sage, pasta, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a heavy-based saucepan, add 1 tbsp olive oil and pancetta or bacon, then cook for a few mins. Add remaining oil and the onion. Cook for 5 mins, until the onion softens and the pancetta is crispy. Step 2: Stir in the butter, then tip in the pumpkin or squash and sage. Mix well to combine, then season. Cover and cook for 6-8 mins, stirring occasionally until the pumpkin is soft, but not falling apart. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Drain and add to the pumpkin mixture. Stir in the parmesan and season. Serve in pasta bowls sprinkled with extra parmesan.

Ingredient Names: bacon, spaghetti, parmesan cheese, eggs, italian parsley, garlic cloves, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring some salted water to the boil in a large pot for cooking the spaghetti. Step 2: In a medium bowl lightly break and stir eggs with a fork and fold in about 1-1 / 4 cups of cheese. Step 3: Slice the bacon rashers into small cubes or thin strips if you prefer Use the edge of a knife to crush the garlic cloves without breaking them up too much. Step 4: In a large skillet over a medium high heat pour the olive oil and add the garlic While the garlic's cooking use a wooden spoon to press down on the cloves to release the flavour. Step 5: After a minute or two add the chopped bacon and cook for about 5 minutes. Step 6: When the bacon's cooked remove garlic cloves and turn down to a low heat. Step 7: Cook spaghetti to packet instructions and drain In the same pot add a little olive oil and return the cooked spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onions, garlic cloves, green pepper, sweet red pepper, stewed tomatoes, linguine, jalapeno pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Step 2: Remove bacon with slotted spoon and set aside, reserving the drippings. Step 3: Saute onions and garlic in drippings for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add peppers, cook and stir for 3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in tomatoes and heat through. Step 6: Add bacon and mix well. Step 7: Serve over pasta Cooking time does not reflect time to cook pasta.

Dish Name: Bacon And Tomato Sauce For Pasta
Ingredient Names: streaky bacon, chopped tomatoes, onion, pimiento, garlic cloves, bay leaf, olive oil, tabasco sauce, black pepper, fresh basil leaf, sun-dried tomato, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Chop streaky bacon crosswise into small strips and fry until almost crispy, remove from pan. Step 2: Chop onion and pimento, add to frying pan with olive oil and fry until soft I prefer to give a high heat initially to slightly caramelise. Step 3: Add finely chopped or pressed garlic into pan for last 5minutes. Step 4: Add bacon back into pan, together with tomatoes, bay leaf, tabasco, sun-dried tomato. Step 5: Simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in herbs and black paper for last minute or so. Step 7: Serve with pasta and with grated cheddar cheese on top.

Ingredient Names: pasta, ground beef, bacon, condensed tomato soup, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to directions on package. Step 2: In a skillet, cook ground beef over medium heat until no longer pink, drain and set aside. Step 3: In same skillet, cooked diced bacon until crisp, drain and discard drippings. Step 4: To skillet, add pasta, ground beef, bacon, and soup, heat through. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese, cover and cook until the cheese is melted, serve.

Dish Name: Bacon Tomato Pasta With A Kick
Ingredient Names: olive oil, salt, coarse salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes, tabasco sauce, tomatoes, bacon, parsley, garlic cloves, lemon, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Put water on to boil in pot with table salt, Put diced tomatoes in a bowl. Step 2: Squeeze lemon over top. Step 3: Add in coarse ground salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes, and parsley. Step 4: Stir up to mix flavors. Step 5: Heat olive oil on medium / high for a couple minute on a pan. Step 6: Once pan is hot, adjust temperature down to medium and add garlic and bacon pieces. Step 7: Fry for about 3 minutes. Step 8: Pour tomato mixture into pan. Step 9: Add in 1 tsp tabasco sauce & stir thoroughly.

Dish Name: Bacon, Mushroom & Sun Dried Tomato Pasta Sauce
Ingredient Names: wheat linguine, bacon, mushrooms, chili pepper, fresh basil, sun-dried tomatoes oil, mild salsa, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook Pasta according to instructions, plan to have it ready just as the sauce is finished. Step 2: Fry chopped bacon until almost crisp, drain fat. Step 3: Add mushrooms and saute for apprx 5 minutes. Step 4: Add Chilies, basil, sundried tomatoes and saute until heated through apprx 5 minutes. Step 5: Add salsa heat until bubbling. Step 6: Pour over drained cooked pasta & toss. Step 7: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese & I hope enjoy.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, vegetable oil, onions, smoked back bacon, vegetable stock, peas, gorgonzola, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan, then add the onion and cook for 3 mins until starting to soften. Add the bacon, cook for a further 5 mins, then pour in the hot stock and bring to the boil. Simmer for a few mins until the liquid has reduced slightly. Step 2: Stir in the peas, followed by the gorgonzola, until the cheese has melted and the peas are defrosted. Quickly stir through the spinach to wilt. Drain the pasta and mix with the sauce, then serve.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, flat-leaf italian parsley, garlic cloves, fresh ground black pepper, anchovies packed in oil, pine nuts, capers, red chili pepper flakes, extra virgin olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rigatoni according to package instructions While pasta is cooking, combine remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor and process to form a paste. Step 2: Pour paste into a large skillet and cook 4-5 minutes. Step 3: When pasta is done, reserve 1 / 2 cup cooking water and add to skillet. Step 4: Drain pasta and add to skillet. Step 5: Add cheese, stirring well until liquid has almost evaporated. Step 6: Remove from heat and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: passata, chicken stock, onion, arborio rice, artichokes, pesto sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200c. Step 2: Heat passata and stock in pot - bring to boil. Step 3: Cook onion in olive oil till softened in frypan. Step 4: Add rice and artichokes to onion and stir for 1 -2 minutes. Step 5: Add pesto to hot tomato liquid - stir to combine. Step 6: Put contents of both pots into a casserole with lid, bake 35 minutes. Step 7: Remove lid and stir a few times then re-cover and bake 5 -10 mins more. Step 8: Season and add some grated parmesan and serve.

Dish Name: Baked Asparagus And Spinach Risotto Cooking Light
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, arborio rice, fresh spinach leaves, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, salt, ground nutmeg, fresh parmesan cheese, asparagus
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and cook 4 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Add rice and stir well, then stir in spinach, broth, salt, and nutmeg. Step 5: Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook 7 minutes. Step 6: Stir in 1 / 4 cup cheese. Step 7: Cover and bake at 400 for 15 minutes. Step 8: Stir in asparagus and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup cheese. Step 9: Add the additional cup of broth if needed. Step 10: Cover and bake an additional 15 minutes or until liquid is almost absorbed.

Dish Name: Baked Butternut Squash Raisin And Pine Nut Lasagna
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, fat-free evaporated milk, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, table salt, white pepper, dry lasagna noodles, winter squash, part-skim mozzarella cheese, golden seedless raisins, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Prepare lasagna noodles as directed on the package To prepare the squash, peel and remove seeds, trimming into 1 or 2 inch cubes. Step 3: Place in a pot of boiling water and cook until just tender. Step 4: Remove water and mash by hand. Step 5: Place flour in a small saucepan over low to medium heat and very gradually whisk in milk and garlic Warm milk slurry, stirring constantly, until sauce simmers and is thickened, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese, salt and pepper? Step 7: Spread 1 / 3 cup of cheese sauce over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass or metal pan and cover with 3 lasagna noodles.

Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, tomatoes, fresh mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the ravioli according to package directions. Step 2: Let cool to room temperature. Step 3: Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425f and chop the basil. Step 4: Place ravioli on a parchment lined baking pan. Step 5: Layer each ravioli with a slice of tomato, then season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Then continue with with the basil then the cheese. Step 7: Bake for about 15 minutes. Step 8: Drizzle with the olive oil and serve.

Dish Name: Baked Farfalle With Prosciutto And Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, prosciutto, onion, garlic cloves, cremini mushrooms, dried basil, ground black pepper, salt, white wine, canned tomatoes, tomato paste, whipping cream, farfalle pasta, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat and saute the prosciutto until golden, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the onion, garlic, mushrooms, basil, pepper and salt. Step 3: Saute until the mushrooms are golden, about 8 minutes. Step 4: Add the wine and boil until almost no liquid remains, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, breaking up with a spoon. Step 6: Stir in the tomato paste and bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 8: Add the cream and simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes. Step 9: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the farfalle until tender but firm, about 10 minutes. Step 10: Drain and return to the pot.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic clove, mushrooms, gnocchi, four cheese pasta sauce, mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Saute' ground beef, onion and garlic in a nonstick pan and fry gently for 5-6 minutes, stirring often. Step 3: Stir in the mushrooms and cook another 5-6 minutes until the meat is browned. Step 4: Pour in marinara sauce & bring to the boil, season with salt & pepper, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, prepare gnocchi per package directions & drain well Next, spoon half the bolognese mixture into a large baking or casserole dish, then top with the gnocchi. Step 6: Add the remaining bolognese sauce and then spoon the formaggio cheese sauce over the top. Step 7: Sprinkle with the mozzarella to coat top. Step 8: Bake on the top shelf of the oven for 30-35 minutes, until golden and bubbling. Step 9: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, garlic, parsley, dried basil, salt, tomatoes, tomato paste, dry lasagna noodles, cottage cheese, eggs, pepper, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat slowly. Step 2: Add next 6 ingredients to meat. Step 3: Add one tomato paste can of water. Step 4: Simmer uncovered until thick or about 45 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile combine cottage cheese with eggs, salt, pepper, parsley and parmesan. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate until ready to use Also meanwhile, cook lasagna noodles in boiling water until tender. Step 7: Drain and rinse with cold water Spray a 13x9x2 baking pan with vegetable oil spray. Step 8: Place 1 / 2 of the noodles in the bottom of the pan.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, onion, garlic clove, tomatoes, tomato paste, parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, pepper, basil, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly saute onions, garlic in oil. Step 2: Add meat and cook until brown. Step 3: Add tomatoes, tomato paste, parsley, basil, salt, pepper and 3 t grated parmesan. Step 4: Mix well and simmer for 45 minute. Step 5: Cook lasagne noodles in 6 qts of boiling water for 20 minutes or until tender. Step 6: Put a couple of spoonfuls of sauce of bottom of 13 x 9 pan. Step 7: Arrange half of noodles on next. Step 8: Spread 1 / 2 the ricotta or cottage cheese and 1 / 2 the mozzarella over noodles. Step 9: Top with 1 / 2 the sauce. Step 10: Then repeat the layers.

Ingredient Names: sweet italian sausage link, ziti pasta, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 Pan brown sausage until tender, drain and cool, then crumble coarsely. Step 2: Cook pasta until just tender, 2 minutes less than package directions. Step 3: Drain, rinse in cold water and rinse again. Step 4: Combine sausage, ricotta, 1 cup of mozzarella, 1 / 4 cup grated parmesan or romano and 1 / 2 cup pasta sauce and mix well. Step 5: Mix this into the drained pasta. Step 6: Cover the bottom of a large baking pan or casserole with a layer of pasta sauce, then a third of the pasta mixture and a sprinkle of mozzarella. Step 7: Repeat layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with the last of the mozzarella cheese and the grated parmesan or romano. Step 8: Bake in a preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes until cheese on top is light brown and bubbling.

Dish Name: Baked Macaroni and Cheese With Meatballs
Ingredient Names: italian meatballs, macaroni cheese dinner mix, milk, sour cream, tomatoes, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350°. Step 2: Place meatballs on a foil lined baking sheet and bake 15-20 minutes or according to package directions. Step 3: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain. Step 4: Add milk, cheese sauce packets and sour cream, stir to combine. Step 5: Place meatballs in the bottom of an oven proof casserole, top with macaroni, cover with tomato slices sprinkled with parmesan. Step 6: Bake uncovered 25-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic clove, italian tomatoes, tomato paste, parsley, salt, sugar, oregano leaves, basil leaves, ground pepper, eggs, all-purpose flour, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Make sauce: in hot oil in 5-quart dutch oven, saute onion and garlic 5 minutes. Step 2: Mix in rest of sauce ingredients and 1-1 / 2 cups water, mashing tomatoes with fork. Step 3: Bring to boiling, and reduce heat. Step 4: Simmer mixture, covered and stirring occasionally, 1 hour. Step 5: Make manicotti: in medium bowl, combine 6 eggs, the flour, 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, and 1-1 / 2 cups water With electric mixer, beat just until smooth. Step 6: Let stand 1 / 2 hour or longer Slowly heat an 8-inch skillet. Step 7: Pour in 3 tablespoons batter, rotating the skillet quickly to spread batter evenly over bottom. Step 8: Cook over medium heat until top is dry but bottom is not brown.

Dish Name: Baked Noodles With Sausage Tomatoes And Spinach
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, diced tomatoes, water, pasta, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, mild italian sausage, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Take sausage out of its casing and brown in a skillet over medium high heat. Step 2: Take out of pan and set aside. Step 3: Add olive oil to the same skillet in which you browned the crumbled sausage. Step 4: Add garlic, red pepper flakes and the pasta. Step 5: Stir over medium-high heat till combined. Step 6: Add tomatoes and water and bring to a boil. Step 7: Cook for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring every few minutes. Step 8: Preheat oven to 475 degrees. Step 9: Then add the spinach and cook till soft. Step 10: Add cream, cheeses and sausage back to pan.

Ingredient Names: pasta, tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, white onion, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, half-and-half cream, basil pesto, garlic, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 375 Butter a 9 x 13 casserole dish. Step 2: Cook pinwheel pasta in salted wated until ''al dente'', reserve Finely chop the onion, reserve In food processor, puree the tomatoes until smooth In large bowl, mix together the pureed tomatoes, garlic, onions, basil pesto and the cooked pasta. Step 3: Add salt & pepper to taste. Step 4: Transfer to buttered casserole. Step 5: Grate mozzarella cheese and parmesan cheese. Step 6: Add cheeses on top of casserole.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, garlic cloves, onion, salami, dried basil, olive oil, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper, fresh breadcrumb, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees. Step 2: Mix tomatoes, garlic, onion, salami, basil, oil and red pepper flakes in an oven proof dish. Step 3: Mix bread crumbs and cheese and sprinkle over the tomato mixture. Step 4: Bake, uncovered for 30 minutes. Step 5: Serve over your favorite pasta without mixing so the crunchy bits stay crunchy.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With Asparagus Pasta Al Forno Con Asparagi
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, asparagus, butter, chicken stock, salt and pepper, ricotta cheese, olive oil, parmesan cheese, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Wash asparagus. Step 2: Remove any tough stalks and cut into short lengths You may want to split the length in half. Step 3: Melt about 3 tbs of butter in pan and cook the asparagus over a low heat for about 20 min Every so often, add a little chicken stock to keep it moist. Step 4: When the asparagus is done, season to taste While the asparagus is cooking, process the ricotta cheese with the oil. Step 5: Cook the pasta for half the time stated on the package. Step 6: Drain and immediately toss in the remaining butter and half the parmesan Butter a deep oven dish.

Ingredient Names: farfalle pasta, aubergines, salt, flour, olive oil, butter, mozzarella cheese, onion, garlic cloves, italian plum tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice off both ends from the aubergines and discard. Step 2: Slice the aubergines thinly. Step 3: Arrange the slices in layers on a cutting board, sprinkling each layer with salt. Step 4: Place the cutting board on a draining board, raised and supported on one side so that any liquid resulting from the purging process will drain into the sink. Step 5: Then cover the slices of aubergine with a heavy weight and leave for a couple of hours During this time a somewhat bitter liquid will drain from the aubergines -- this is the purging process, as it's referred to in italy. Step 6: After 2 hours rinse the slices and pat dry Lightly flour the slices to prevent them from absorbing too much oil when they are fried While the aubergines are 'purging' prepare the tomato sauce. Step 7: Heat the oil in a frypan and gently fry the chopped onion and garlic until softened.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With Sausage And Tomato Pesto
Ingredient Names: hot italian sausage, onion, garlic cloves, marinara sauce, pesto sauce, salt & freshly ground black pepper, penne, smoked gouda cheese, parmesan cheese, baby spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large dutch oven over medium-high heat, add the sausage and onion. Step 2: Cook, breaking sausage up with a spoon, for about 5 minutes, or until softened, stirring frequently to cook onion evenly. Step 3: Add garlic and cook for 1 more minute. Step 4: Add marinara sauce and reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Simmer for 10 minutes, or until sauce begins to thicken. Step 6: Stir in pesto and season with salt and pepper to taste, set aside. Step 7: Cook penne in a large pot of salted boiling water for about 10 minutes, or until al dente, drain well. Step 8: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With Sausage And Zucchini
Ingredient Names: italian style breadcrumbs, zucchini, salt, sweet onion, celery, carrot, pancetta, olive oil, garlic, italian sausage, red wine, tomato sauce, beef broth, rigatoni pasta, smoked mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil Generously butter a 9x12-inch casserole pan and coat with half the bread crumbs. Step 3: Place the zucchini in a colander and sprinkle with the salt. Step 4: Cover with a plate, weighted down with a heavy object The salt will draw the liquid from the zucchini The plate will help squeeze it out. Step 5: Allow the zucchini to sit for about 20 minutes. Step 6: Place the onion, celery, carrot and pancetta or bacon in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until the mixture is chopped into tiny pieces. Step 7: In a large, deep saut pan, heat 2 tablespoons of the oil over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, spaghetti sauce, cream cheese, milk, parmesan cheese, spinach, nutmeg, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling water until done. Step 2: Meanwhile whisk cream cheese and milk until smooth. Step 3: Add spinach and Parmesan cheese to cream cheese mixture--stir to combine. Step 4: Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper (set aside). Step 5: Drain cooked pasta and mix with spaghetti sauce. Step 6: Layer half the pasta in a 9x13 baking dish---spread cream cheese mixture over pasta layer. Step 7: Top with remaining pasta. Step 8: Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes. Step 9: Remove foil sprinkle with mozzarella and bake an additional 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With White Mushroom Sauce
Ingredient Names: milk, olive oil, onion, spring onions, garlic, refined flour, mushroom, ham, black pepper, salt, fettuccine pasta, cheddar cheese, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a pan and fry onion, spring onions and garlic lightly. Step 2: Add flour and fry it for a few seconds before adding milk, pepper and salt. Step 3: Then add sliced mushrooms. Step 4: Then add 1 / 2 of the diced ham or sausage and cook sauce for 2 minutes brush the bottom of a baking tray with a little olive oil. Step 5: Spread 1 / 2 the white sauce in the tray layer the other 1 / 2 of the sausage or ham over the white sauce. Step 6: Layer boiled pasta and the rest of the white sauce over this. Step 7: Finally sprinkle cheese small pieces of butter over the last layer. Step 8: Bake till cheese turns slightly golden in an oven with moderate heat.

Ingredient Names: dry penne pasta, mild italian sausage, onion, white wine, olive oil, tomato sauce, tomatoes with garlic, tomato paste, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente, drain. Step 4: Place sausage and onion in a large, deep skillet. Step 5: Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown, drain excess fat. Step 6: Pour in wine, and cook for 1 minute, stirring, to deglaze the pan. Step 7: Stir in tomato sauce, diced tomatoes and tomato paste. Step 8: Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Dish Name: Baked Penne With Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: sausage, onion, garlic cloves, zucchini, red pepper, roasted red peppers, tomato sauce, italian seasoning, salt and pepper, cumin, red pepper flakes, ricotta cheese, egg, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray pan with cooking spray, add sausage, cook until brown, drain fat, set aside In same pan add onion, garlic, zucchini, red pepper, saute until softened. Step 2: Puree roasted red pepper in blender, add to veggies. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, sausage, spices, simmer for 30 minutes. Step 4: Cook and drain penne. Step 5: In a large casserole add sauce to cover bottom. Step 6: Add remaining sauce to penne, stir. Step 7: Add half of penne to casserole. Step 8: Mix ricotta and egg, spread over penne. Step 9: Top with 1 c mozzarella and some parmesan.

Dish Name: Baked Penne With Sausage And Ricotta
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, mild italian sausage, tomato puree, water, sugar, bay leaf, ground fennel, salt, fresh ground black pepper, penne pasta, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a large saucepan, heat 1 tablespoons of olive oil. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Step 4: Add the sausage and cook, breaking up the meat, until browned, about 8 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomato puree, water, sugar, bay leaf, and fennel. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Step 7: Simmer over low heat until thickened, about 30 minutes. Step 8: Remove the garlic, mash it to a paste and stir it back into the pot, discard the bay leaf. Step 9: Meanwhile, cook the penne in a larg pt of boiling water until al dente. Step 10: Drain the pasta and return it to the pot.

Dish Name: Baked Penne With Sausage And Spinach Oven Or Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, italian sausage, garlic cloves, red wine, crushed tomatoes, water, pesto sauce, penne pasta, baby spinach leaves, fresh mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Grease a deep lasagna pan Crockpot instructions are at the bottom Sauce: in a large deep saucepan, heat oil. Step 3: Add onion and saute slowly until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add sausage to pan Continue to saute and break up sausage into bite size pieces. Step 5: When sausage is just about done, add garlic for a minute or two. Step 6: Finally, pour red wine into pan and bring wine to a boil to evaporate alcohol and eliminate most of the liquid. Step 7: Add tomatoes to other ingredients.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic cloves, coarse salt, pepper, dried thyme, whole tomatoes, crushed tomatoes, cheese ravioli, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f. Step 2: Heat oil in saucepan over medium high heat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic, season with salt and pepper and cook until onions are softened. Step 4: Add thyme and tomatoes and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer, breaking up the tomatoes. Step 6: Reduce sauce until it is about 5 cups. Step 7: Cook ravioli in a pot of boiling water just until they float, drain. Step 8: Toss sauce and ravioli together in a casserole dish, top with cheeses.

Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, meatballs, pasta sauce, mozzarella cheese, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 9-inch by 13-inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Place cooked ravioli in baking dish. Step 3: Top with meatballs. Step 4: Pour pasta sauce evenly over it all. Step 5: Sprinkle on italian seasoning and shredded cheese. Step 6: Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, green pepper, whole tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, sliced mushrooms, garlic, bay leaf, sugar, oregano, salt, pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a big skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Cook onion and green pepper until tender. Step 3: Add next 12 ingredients. Step 4: Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes, remove bay leaf. Step 5: Toss rigatoni with butter. Step 6: Mix eggs, ricotta and parmesan cheese. Step 7: Stir into the rigatoni mixture and transfer to a 13x9 inch casserole dish. Step 8: Top with tomato mixture. Step 9: Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes or until heated well.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, butter, flour, milk, tomato sauce, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Make bechamel sauce using 6 tablespoons butter, flour and milk. Step 2: Stir in tomato sauce. Step 3: Add salt and pepper. Step 4: Cook pasta until al dente. Step 5: Drain, mix well with sauce and 1 / 2 of the parmesan cheese. Step 6: Turn into buttered oven dish. Step 7: Mix remaining cheese with breadcrumbs. Step 8: Top casserole with this mixture, then dot with remaining butter. Step 9: Bake at 425 degrees for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, all-purpose flour, whole milk, fresh nutmeg, sea salt, white pepper, fontina, prosciutto, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f Bechamel sauce: in a 2 quart saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add the flour and whisk until smooth, about 2 minutes Always stirring, gradually add the milk and continue to whisk until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Step 3: Simmer until it is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon This will take approximately 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in nutmeg, 1 / 2 cup fontina, prosciutto and season with salt and white pepper, set aside. Step 5: In a large pot, bring to a boil 6 quarts of salted water. Step 6: Add the rigatoni and cook for about 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Rigatoni With Cauliflower In A Spicy Pink Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, whole tomatoes, yellow onion, kosher salt, garlic cloves, heavy cream, flat leaf parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, rigatoni pasta, cauliflower florets, fontina cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 450 degrees. Step 2: Bring well-salted water to boil in a large pot with a pasta insert. Step 3: Grease a 9x13" baking dish with 1 tablespoons olive oil. Step 4: Pour off 1 cup of juice from 1 of the cans of tomatoes and discard it. Step 5: In a blender or a food porcessor, puree both cans of tomatoes with their remaining juice and set aside. Step 6: Heat remainin 2 tablespoons olive oil in a 6-8 quart dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 7: When oil is shimmering, about 1 minute, add onions and 1 / 4 teaspoons of salt and cook, stirring occasionally, unti nicely browned, 5-10 minutes Push the onion to the side of the dutch oven and add the garlic. Step 8: Cook until it just starts to sizzle and becomes fragrant, about 10 seconds. Step 9: Add pureed tomates and cream, plus remaining 1 teaspoons salt.

Dish Name: Baked Rigatoni With Eggplant And Sausage
Ingredient Names: kosher salt, extra virgin olive oil, italian sausage, eggplant, onion, garlic cloves, whole tomatoes, basil, rigatoni pasta, fresh mozzarella cheese, fresh ground black pepper, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat for the pasta Oil a 9x13 pan with olive oil. Step 2: Heat a 3 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the sausages and toss in the hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes, you want them nicely browned on the outside but still rare on the inside. Step 4: Put the sausages in the baking dish. Step 5: Turn the heat down to medium. Step 6: Add 1 / 3 cup of oil to the skillet and get it hot. Step 7: Add as many eggplant pieces as you can comfortably fit in a single layer and sprinkle well with salt. Step 8: Cook, turning, for 7 to 8 minutes, until the eggplant is nice and browned, crisp on the outside and soft on the inside Use a spatula to put the eggplant into the baking dish with the sausage.

Ingredient Names: butter, extra virgin olive oil, italian sausage, garlic cloves, all-purpose flour, whole milk, fontina cheese, mozzarella cheese, romano cheese, provolone cheese, rigatoni pasta, parsley, basil, fresh ground black pepper, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with butter. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large stock pot over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the suasage and saute until crisp and golden brown, about 20 minutes. Step 5: Remove sausage from pan and set aside If there is less than 1 / 4 cup drippings in the pan, add more oil. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium. Step 7: Add garlic and saute until light brown. Step 8: Add the flour and stir for 2 minutes Gradually add in the milk, stirring with each addition.

Dish Name: Baked Rigatoni With Ham And Feta
Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, cooked ham, plum tomatoes, garlic, feta cheese, mozzarella cheese, dried thyme, half-and-half, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray 13x9x2 glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Pour cooked, drained pasta into dish. Step 3: Mix in ham, tomatoes, cheeses and thyme. Step 4: Pour half& half over. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt and pepper and toss to blend. Step 6: Make sure you mix the cheeses in well, cover with foil. Step 7: Bake pasta at 375 for 30 minutes. Step 8: Uncover, sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake additional 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, crushed tomatoes, sugar, water, whole wheat penne, salt, heavy whipping cream, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In oven proof skilled cook garlic, olive oil, and red pepper flakes for 5 minutes or until garlic is browned. Step 2: Pour in crushed tomatoes, sugar, water, penne, and salt. Step 3: Cook on medium heat for 15-18 minutes If penne gets too dry add a little water. Step 4: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 5: Once penne is cooked, stir in cream, parmesan, basil, and pepper. Step 6: Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and bake in oven for 10-15 minutes until top is crispy. Step 7: Serve with a nice salad and some garlic bread on the side.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, red onion, yellow peppers, olive oil, salt, onion, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, fennel seed, crushed tomatoes, fresh ground pepper, sugar, thyme, parsley, ziti pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 450f. Step 2: Toss eggplant, red onion, peppers, oil and salt in shallow pan Roast 30 minutes stirring once or twice until vegetables begin to brown Sauce: heat oil in saucepan. Step 3: Add onions& cook covered over medium heat 10 min. Step 4: Stir in garlic, red pepper and fennel cook 30 seconds. Step 5: Add tomatoes salt pepper sugar and thyme. Step 6: Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes Stirr in parsley Makes 3 cups.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil cooking spray, ziti pasta, part-skim ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, meatless sauce, fresh basil leaf, garlic powder, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Spray rectangle baking dish with vegetable cooking spray In large mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese, 1 / 2 of the mozzarella cheese, and 1 cup of the sauce, with the basil, garlic powder, and pepper. Step 3: Add in cooked, drained ziti, and mix well. Step 4: Spoon pasta mixture into casserole dish. Step 5: Spread remaining sauce over top of the casserole, then top with remaining mozzarella cheese. Step 6: Sprinkle parmesan on top and cover and bake for approximately 20 minutes. Step 7: Uncover and continue to bake an additional 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tofu shirataki noodles, ground buffalo meat, onion, green pepper, garlic cloves, fresh ground black pepper, pasta sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, fat-free cheddar cheese, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Lightly grease a 8x8 baking dish. Step 2: Set aside Tofu noodles: bring pot of water to boil, add well drained tofu noodles and return to boil. Step 3: Boil for two minutes and leave to drain in colander until needed Or just rinse and drain noodles, then microwave for one minute and place in colander to drain while preparing remaining ingredients. Step 4: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, cook ground meat, onions, green pepper, garlic and black pepper over medium heat until meat is browned, drain fat. Step 5: Add pasta sauce, crushed red pepper & italian seasoning and cook until mixture is hot, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Meanwhile, cut tofu noodles into manageable pieces.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, italian sausages, tomatoes, dried oregano, dried basil, ricotta cheese, salt, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese, ziti pasta, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 440f. Step 2: In a large saucepan heat olive oil add yellow onion and cook until tender. Step 3: Add sausage, continue to cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add tomatoes, oregano and basil. Step 5: Simmer sauce on low in a large bowl, combine ricotta cheese, salt, parsley and parmesan cheese, set aside. Step 6: In a large pot of boling salted water, cook pasta until it is not quite al dente. Step 7: Drain pasta and combine with ricotta cheese mixture. Step 8: Remove sauce from heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Step 9: After cooling, add sauce to pasta / ricotta mixture and mix well.

Dish Name: Baked Ziti With Spinach Sausage And Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: hot italian turkey sausage, onion, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, pesto sauce, ziti pasta, fresh spinach leaves, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Heat heavy large saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add sausage, onion, and garlic, and saute until sausage cooked through, about 10 minutes, breaking up meat with back of spoon. Step 4: Add tomatoes with juice to pan. Step 5: Simmer until sauce thickens slightly, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in pesto sauce. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper Lightly oil 13 x 9 glass baking dish. Step 8: Combine pasta, spinach, mozzarella, and 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese in large bowl. Step 9: Stir in hot tomato sauce.

Dish Name: Baked Ziti With Tomato Mozzarella And Sausage
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, hot italian sausage, salt & freshly ground black pepper, dry red wine, plum tomatoes, tomatoes, fresh marjoram, ricotta cheese, pecorino cheese, nutmeg, flat leaf parsley, ziti pasta, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit Lightly oil a large, shallow baking dish. Step 2: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 3: In a large skillet, heat about 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat. Step 4: Add the onion and saute until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the garlic and crumbled sausage. Step 6: Saute until the sausage begins to brown.
