Step 7: Season with salt and pepper If the sausage renders a lot of fat, pour most of it off leaving a little to add flavor to the sauce, add the red wine.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, tomato paste, butter, water, balkan style yogurt, garlic, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti until al dente. Step 2: Return the spaghetti to the still-hot saucepan and toss it, with two forks, with a tablespoonful of butter See that every strand of spaghetti is coated with the butter. Step 3: In a small pan, heat the oil and fry the chopped garlic in it for a minute or two, then add the tomato paste, and season with salt and a good grate of black pepper. Step 4: Take the pan off the heat, add the yogurt and pour the mixture over the spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: penne rigate, mild italian sausage, hot italian sausage, olive oil, shallots, button mushroom, salt and pepper, white wine, heavy whipping cream, fresh parsley, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Step 2: Cook the pasta until al dente. Step 3: Drain, reserving some of the cooking water. Step 4: Meanwhile, remove the sausages from the casings and cook them in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat as it cooks. Step 5: When the sausages are cooked through, transfer them to a strainer and let the fat run off Wipe the skillet with a paper towel and return it to the heat. Step 6: Add the olive oil to the skillet and cook the shallots, stirring occasionally, until tender Push the shallots aside and add the mushrooms. Step 7: Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Step 8: Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are reduced in size and most of the moisture is gone from the pan.

Ingredient Names: barley, garlic clove, olive oil, margarine, white mushrooms, red onion, carrot, chicken broth, dried thyme, dry oregano, dry basil, parmesan cheese, sour cream, cherry tomatoes, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place barley in a large pot, fill pot with water near the top and bring to a boil, lower heat and cook until, halfway done, skim off foam as needed. Step 2: Drain barley in cold water and set aside. Step 3: In a pan add olive oil, 2 tablespoon margarine / butter, garlic and saut briefly, then add mushrooms, 1 / 4 cup onions, carrots and stir fry until mushroom & carrots are half cooked, remove to a dish and set aside In the same pan add the barley and some chicken broth and stir until the liquid is absorbed, continue to add more broth and the barley is "al dente"! Step 4: Add to the pan 2 tablespoon margarine / butter, the reserved mushroom / carrots, thyme, oregano, basil, parmesan cheese and sour cream, stir and cook for a few minutes. Step 5: Add lemon juice and salt & pepper to taste. Step 6: Add tomatoes, toss and remove to a dish. Step 7: Add 1 / 4 cup red onions on top of the barley for a nice pleasing look to this dish Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, pearl barley, parsnip, carrots, cauliflower floret, broccoli floret, bell peppers, fresh ground black pepper, seasoning salt, chili powder, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, pecans
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic Saut 4 minutes or until browned. Step 4: Add 3 cups broth and barley, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and barley is al dente. Step 6: Meanwhile, combine parsnip, carrots, cauliflower, broccoli, bell pepper, remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil, black pepper, seasoned salt, and chili powder on a jelly-roll pan coated with cooking spray, and toss well to coat. Step 7: Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring after 10 minutes. Step 8: Add the remaining 1 cup broth to the barley, 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring constantly until each portion of broth is absorbed before adding the next.

Dish Name: Basic Garlic And Oil Sauce For Perfect Pasta Rachael Ray
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, anchovy fillets, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, black pepper, water, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pot of water to rolling boil, then add spaghetti While that is working, heat anchovies with oil in a large skillet over medium heat The anchovies will "melt" in the oil, use the. Step 2: Lower heat and add garlic pieces and pepper seasonings. Step 3: Let garlic cook in anchovy oil, stirring frequently Watch carefully to avoid garlic over-cooking! Step 4: When pasta is almost "al dente, " dip out one cup of the water, and pour into the pan with the anchovy-garlic. Step 5: Stir in, then add parsley, set aside. Step 6: Drain water from pasta.

Dish Name: Basic Italian White Cream Sauce Like An Alfredo Or Bechamel
Ingredient Names: heavy cream, butter, flour, parmigiano, garlic powder, prosciutto, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in small saucepan cooking over low to medium heat, stirring for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add flour and stir until the butter and flour are well combined. Step 3: Pour in cream & remaining ingredients, stirring constantly as it thickens. Step 4: Add more cream or flour depending on desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: crushed tomatoes, garlic cloves, onion, dry red wine, dried oregano, basil leaves, salt, pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: On low light, put tomatoes in saucepan. Step 2: In a frying pan, fry garlic in extra virgin olive oil, just enought to coat the pan. Step 3: Once they start to sizzle, add to tomatoes and stir If using the onion, saute in olive oil as well and add to tomotoes and stir. Step 4: Add wine to frying pan and scrape pan with a wood spoon. Step 5: Once wine starts to boil, about 30 seconds, add to tomatoes and stir. Step 6: Once the gravy starts to bubble, add and stir oregano, then the basil, then season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Simmer on low light for about 45 minutes, stirring frequently The sky is the limit, serve over any pasta you wish Can be used in lasagnas and parmigianas too.

Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the cornmeal, salt, and water in a slow cooker Cove and cook on high for 2 hours. Step 2: Stir the polenta If it seems too thick, add in a little water, milk, broth, or cream. Step 3: Cook for 30 to 60 minutes more, until thick and creamy.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, dry white wine, butter, olive oil, onion, arborio rice, herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Brodo: bring the broth to a steady simmer in a saucepan Soffritto: heat the butter and oil in a heavy 4 quart pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and saute for 1 to 2 minutes until it begins to soften Do not brown the onion Riso: add the rice to the soffritto using a wooden spoon and stir for 1 minute, making sure the grains are well coated Begin to add the brodo, starting with the 1 / 2 cup of wine and then adding the broth 1 / 2 cup at a time. Step 3: Stir frequently and wait until each addition is almost completely absorbed before adding the next 1 / 2 cup Condimenti: after about 20 minutes, when the rice is tender but still firm, add the reserved broth and the condimenti. Step 4: Stir until the cheese is melted, herbs are combined, etc. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, olive oil, shallots, celery, salt and black pepper, garlic cloves, risotto rice, dry white vermouth, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Stage 1, heat the stock. Step 2: Then in a separate pan heat the olive oil add the shallot or onion celery and a pinch of salt and sweat the vegetables for about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic and after another 2 minutes when the vegetables have softened add the rice. Step 4: Turn up the heat now At this crucial point you can`t leave the pan and anyway this is the best bit While slowly stirring continuously you are beginning to fry the rice You don`t want any colour at any point You must keep the rice moving. Step 5: After 2 or 3 minutes it will begin to look translucent as it absorbs all the flavours of your base.

Ingredient Names: cornmeal, chicken stock, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the stock to a boil in a medium sauce pan Slowly add cornmeal to the pot whisking constantly to prevent clumping. Step 2: Return to a simmer while continuing to whisk. Step 3: Reduce heat to as low as possible, cover, and cook for 30-50 minutes stirring ever 2-4 minutes. Step 4: Serve as is or pour polenta into a rectangular baking dish, chill for several hours to set the polenta, cut into wedges or circles, bake, saut, or fry the pieces of polenta until golden brown and crisp.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, ground beef, onions, garlic, tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, parsley flakes, italian seasoning, fresh basil, thyme, fresh black pepper, red peppers, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and olive oil over medium heat in saucepan. Step 2: When butter is melted, add onions and garlic; cook until onions are soft. Step 3: Add beef and brown, drain if desired. Step 4: Add all remaining ingredients and simmer for 30-45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Serve over cooked pasta of your choice.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, eggs, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour and salt in a bowl Create a well with the flour and salt. Step 2: Whisk together the three eggs, oil and water thoroughly. Step 3: Add wet ingredients little by little to center of flour well, mixing gradually until dough becomes a ball. Step 4: Turn onto a lightly floured surface, and knead until ball is smooth and elastic. Step 5: Add more water if necessary. Step 6: Allow to rest for thirty minutes in a lightly oiled bowl, covered with plastic wrap. Step 7: After thirty minutes, cut dough into circles that are approximately 2 inches in diameter. Step 8: Place 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 tsp of filling in center of dough circle, fold over into a half moon shape, and then join edges around your finger, forming a circle shape. Step 9: Cook tortellini in 2-3 batches, in hot salty boiling water for 6 minutes or until firm.

Ingredient Names: flour, butter, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the flour and butter with a balloon whisk and cook gently for about a minute or two to cook the flour It will turn into a sort of ball. Step 2: Add the milk and keep whisking, turn the heat up slightly and keep going with the whisk until bubbles come, then stop or the bottom of the saucepan will burn You can now take it off the heat and add whatever, cheese / mushrooms / use for lasagne etc etc For large quantities just mul.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, stone-ground yellow cornmeal, bay leaf, pepper, olive oil, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat broth, cornmeal, bay leaf and pepper in saucepan to a boil, stir in oil. Step 2: Cook and stir 10 minutes or until mixture thickens, remove bay leaf. Step 3: Stir in basil and hceese. Step 4: Pour mixture into greased 9" pie plate. Step 5: Cover and chill 2 hours or until firm. Step 6: Cut polenta into 6 wedges To grill: brush wedges on both sides with olive oil. Step 7: Place on hot grill and cook 4 minutes, turning once.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil, all-purpose flour, egg, olive oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Using a food processor, process basil leaves until chopped very fine. Step 2: Add 1 1 / 2 cups of flour and pulse two or three times, or until combined. Step 3: Add egg, 1 teaspoon oil, and the water until dough forms a ball shape If dough seems dry, add a bit more water. Step 4: Wrap dough in a piece of plastic wrap which has been coated in a few drops of olive oil. Step 5: Refrigerate dough for 2 hours. Step 6: Remove dough from refrigerator, and cut into 6 equal size portions Run pasta though pasta machine, or roll with rolling pin to desired thickness Use the additional flour to coat pasta while rolling. Step 7: Allow pasta to dry for one hour prior to cooking if making noodles.

Ingredient Names: linguine, olive oil, fresh basil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large saucepan filled with 3 to 4 quarts of water to a boil. Step 2: When watercomesto a boil, add pasta and cook 3 minutes for fresh or 9 minutes for dried. Step 3: Drain, leaving about 2 tbl pasta water with the pasta. Step 4: Add olive oil to pasta and toss well. Step 5: Add basil and salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, pancetta, olive oil, garlic clove, marinara sauce, dry white wine, half-and-half cream, basil leaves, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook penne as directed, drain and return to pot While pasta cooks, heat pancetta in large skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Remove pancetta from skillet and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in same skillet. Step 4: Saute garlic for 30 seconds. Step 5: Stir in marinara and wine, bring to boil. Step 6: Simmer 4 minutes over low heat, remove from heat. Step 7: Stir in half and half, then 1 / 2 cup basil, salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Basil Rice Soup Minestra Di Riso E Basilico
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, celery, onion, carrot, fresh basil, long-grain rice, chopped tomatoes, chicken broth, water, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in 4-quart dutch oven over medium-low heat. Step 2: Stir in garlic, celery, onion, carrot and basil. Step 3: Cover and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Stir in rice and tomatoes. Step 5: Cook uncovered over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese, heat to boiling, reduce heat. Step 7: Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until rice is tender. Step 8: Serve with cheese.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, onion, garlic cloves, basil leaves, thyme leaves, dried oregano, salt, granulated sugar, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large pot over medium high heat. Step 2: Add the onions and saut until softened. Step 3: Add smashed garlic and cook for about two minutes. Step 4: Turn the heat down to medium low, and add the fresh and dry herbs. Step 5: Cook for two or three minutes. Step 6: Add the canned tomatoes and salt and simmer over low heat, stirring often. Step 7: When the sauce has reduced by a quarter, remove the pot from the heat and blend the sauce with an immersion blender until smooth, add the sugar. Step 8: Taste and adjust for salt if required.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, parmesan cheese, dry basil, pepper, salt, garlic, black olives, sun-dried tomato, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice Put cooked basmati into large mixing bowl Toss hot rice with remaining ingredients using wooden spoons to avoid breaking grains Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Basmati Sun Dried Tomato Rice Pilaf
Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, basmati rice, sun-dried tomato, salt, fresh ground pepper, chicken stock, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in medium saucepan over medium heat until hot. Step 2: Add shallots Saut 1 to 2 minutes or until soft, add rice. Step 3: Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and stock, mix well, cover, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to low.

Ingredient Names: ground chuck, smoked sausage, onion, garlic cloves, sharp cheddar cheese, ricotta cheese, parsley flakes, egg, pepper, chili powder, ground cumin, corn tortillas, picante sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a frying pan, brown ground chuck and drain. Step 2: Slice the sausage into piece about 1 / 2 inch long. Step 3: Add onion, garlic, sausage, pepper, chili powder, cumin to the meat and cook for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the picante sauce to the meat mixture. Step 5: Heat then set aside In another bowl, add the ricotta cheese, egg and parsley flakes. Step 6: Mix together well Spray the bottom of a baking dish with non-stick cooking spray Lay four tortillas in the dish forming a single layer It is ok if they overlap.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, olive oil, onions, celery, carrots, garlic, tomatoes, chicken stock, macaroni, cannellini beans, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Snip the ends off the sausages and squeeze out the meat. Roll into rough walnut-sized meatballs. Heat half the oil in a large, wide pan and fry until browned, around 10 mins. Remove from pan and set aside. Step 2: Add the rest of the oil to the pan. Tip in the onions, celery and carrots and fry for 10 mins until soft. Add garlic and cook for 1 min more. Tip in the tomatoes and stock. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 mins. Step 3: Stir in the macaroni and return the meatballs. Simmer for about 10 mins until pasta is cooked and meatballs are cooked though. Stir in beans and heat until piping hot. Season, mix in parsley and serve.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, apples, tomatoes garlic herbs, passata, borlotti beans, red pesto, leftover pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan and gently fry the onion for 3 mins. Stir in the apple and cook for 2-3 mins until both have softened. Stir in tomatoes, passata and beans. Step 2: Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 10 mins. Stir in the pesto and pasta, mixing well until the pasta is heated through. Serve in bowls with crusty bread.

Dish Name: Beat The Blues Blue Cheese Risotto
Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, leeks, garlic cloves, smoked bacon, arborio rice, dry white wine, chicken stock, fresh sage, lemon, blue cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Nb: i like to use a fairly strong flavoured, but creamy blue cheese, like gorgonzola, but stilton is also nice Stock-wise, you may need a little more or less than in the ingredients list. Step 2: Bring stock up to a simmer Halve the leeks and remove any gritty bits from inside the rings. Step 3: Cut the leek into fine strips rather than semi-circles, of approx 1-2 inches in length. Step 4: Melt half the butter with the olive oil and cook the leeks for approx 10 minutes over a low-medium heat until soft and tinged with brown. Step 5: Add bacon to pan and cook for about 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in garlic and rice, cook for a further minute or two, stirring the rice until it's coated in the butter and oil and starts to go slightly translucent. Step 7: Add the wine to the pan, turning up the heat to bubble most of it away. Step 8: Add a ladleful of hot stock to the leek and rice mixture at a time, stirring more or less constantly.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, spaghetti sauce, frozen chopped spinach, mozzarella cheese, cheese ravioli
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 f degrees. Step 2: Cook ravioli as instructed on package, drain In skillet, brown ground beef and drain. Step 3: Stir spaghetti sauce and spinach into ground beef. Step 4: Spread half of beef mixture into 2 quart baking dish. Step 5: Layer ravioli over beef mixture. Step 6: Spoon rest of beef mixture over ravioli. Step 7: Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheese and bake uncovered for an additional 10 minutes until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly hot.

Ingredient Names: manicotti, extra lean ground beef, egg, part-skim mozzarella cheese, bread, low-fat milk, salt, pepper, meatless spaghetti sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef & drain. Step 2: Cook manicotti using package directions Do not drain Run cold water over it until water in pan is cold. Step 3: Leave manicotti in water until needed. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine ground beef, egg, mozzarella, bread, milk, salt & pepper. Step 5: Stuff each manicotti shell. Step 6: Place in greased 13x9x2" baking pan. Step 7: Pour spaghetti sauce over top, cover with foil & bake in 350 degree oven for 50 minutes Pass grated parmesan cheese when serving.

Dish Name: Berks County Bread Machine Pizza Crust
Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, flour, salt, active dry yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Add the ingredients to the bread machine in the order given by the manufacturer Process on the "dough" cycle for 1 1 / 2 hours then turn out onto a floured surface. Step 2: Divide into equal sized dough balls. Step 3: Knead each ball in your hands for a few minutes, then set under a towel for 15-20 minutes to rest Stretch or roll each dough ball separately into a 14-inch circle, and prebake on a lightly oiled pizza pan, or cornmeal dusted pizza stone for approximately 5 minutes in a 375 degree oven. Step 4: Refrigerate crusts up to a week Freeze for even longer if necessary.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, boneless chicken breasts, kosher salt, chicken stock, water, minced garlic cloves, cracked black pepper, white onion, carrot, green onion, celery, fresh spinach leaves, fresh parsley leaves, basil leaves, oregano leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large stock pot. Step 2: Add diced chicken pieces to pot to brown chicken, and cook for 5-10 minutes. Step 3: Add onions, celery, garlic and carrots and saute so everything begins to "sweat" Add all seasonings and cook for a few more minutes. Step 4: Add chicken stock to mixture in pot and stir. Step 5: Add spinach leaves to stock and stir. Step 6: Bring this to a boil, uncovered. Step 7: Reduce to simmer and cook for about 15-20 minutes, seasoning broth to taste. Step 8: Add 1 cup of water to pot, bring to boil again. Step 9: Add the bag of noodles directly to pot and cook for another 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Best Creamy Marsala Wine Sauce Over Mushroom Ravioli
Ingredient Names: portabella mushroom ravioli, marsala wine, heavy cream, low-fat milk, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, diced onion, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with about 4 quarts of water. Step 2: Set the burner to high and boil. Step 3: Add frozen ravioli to boiling water for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally The ravioli are done when they float to the top of the water At the same time you are boiling the water, heat a large skillet with the olive oil. Step 4: Add onions and mushrooms and saut until tender, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the marsala wine and bring to a boil. Step 6: Boil for 2-4 minutes, adding salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Stir in cream and milk and simmer for 5 minutes until heated. Step 8: Serve in a recessed pasta plate.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, butter, garlic, heavy cream, egg yolks, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add fettucine pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente and drain Melt butter in a large skillet and add chopped garlic. Step 3: Cook on low for about 5 minutes, stirring often, making sure not to burn the garlic Pour about 1/4 cup of the heavy cream into a small bow. Step 4: Add the egg yolk and beat together and put aside. Step 5: Pour the remaining cream into the frying pan. Step 6: Increase the heat to medium-high. Step 7: As the cream starts to boil, mix rapidly using a whisk. Step 8: Slowly add the cream/egg mixture. Step 9: You do not want the egg to cook. Step 10: Continue beating the cream mixture until all mixed together. Step 11: Add 1 cup of Parmesan cheese and continue to mix the cream. Step 12: Pour in remaining Parmesan and parsley and mix until smooth. Step 13: Immediately remove from stove. Step 14: Serve over cooked pasta.

Ingredient Names: water, active dry yeast, bread flour, light brown sugar, olive oil, salt, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Stir the yeast into lukewarm water and set aside. Step 2: Combine 5 cups flour, sugar and salt in the bowl of an electric mixer. Step 3: Add the yeast mixture, remaining water and olive oil. Step 4: Using a dough hook attachment, mix on lowest speed of electric mixer until a dough starts to form, adding more flour as needed. Step 5: Knead on low speed for 7 minutes. Step 6: Transfer dough to lightly floured surface and need by hand for 1 to 2 minutes, or until a smooth, firm, elastic dough is formed. Step 7: Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl and spray the dough with a thin coating of cooking spray. Step 8: Wrap the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside to proof in a warm place for 1 hours or until doubled in size I usually put mine in a slightly warmed oven. Step 9: Remove the plastic wrap, punch down and flatten the rounded dough with the heel of your hand.

Dish Name: Better Homes And Gardens Lemon Chicken Pasta Toss
Ingredient Names: penne, boneless skinless chicken breasts, all-purpose flour, olive oil, shallot, garlic cloves, chicken broth, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, capers, italian parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Return pasta to hot saucepan. Step 3: Cover and keep warm. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a bowl toss together chicken and flour until chicken is lightly coated. Step 5: In a large skillet cook and stir chicken in 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Step 6: Remove chicken from pan, set aside. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium. Step 8: Add remaining oil to skillet.

Dish Name: Better Than Olive Garden Pasta Pomodoro
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, tomatoes, fresh basil leaf, extra virgin olive oil, parmesan cheese, pasta, fresh ground pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil over high heat and add garlic. Step 2: Saute for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Saute for another 30 seconds, stirring constantly, remove from heat. Step 5: Add cooked pasta and chopped basil, toss gently. Step 6: Turn into serving bowl / dish, add 1 / 2 grated cheese, and toss again. Step 7: Serve immediately and pass the last 2 oz Of grated parmesan.

Ingredient Names: instant potato flakes, water, salt, egg, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Use only betty crocker potato buds. Step 2: Make only 1 batch at a time Do not double recipe Use no milk, no butter. Step 3: Bring water to a boil with a little salt added. Step 4: Stir in potato buds, let cool a little, add 1 egg and mix. Step 5: Add flour and mix well. Step 6: Roll into pencil strips and cut.

Ingredient Names: scallions, garlic clove, butter, vodka, half-and-half, tomato sauce, pecorino romano cheese, basil, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet saute butter and finely chopped garlic and scallions until tender. Step 2: Remove from heat Ignite and let vodka cook down, In a sauce pot add tomato sauce, half and half, pecarino romano, basil, and garlic powder. Step 3: Then add vodka and chopped scallion and garlic butter mixture into the sauce. Step 4: Cook over medium heat, stirring. Step 5: Pour over cooked rigatoni. Step 6: Garnish with fresh parsley I recommend pouring the sauce over each individual dish it goes further.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic, yellow onion, milk, heavy cream, ground nutmeg, salt, black pepper, cornstarch, water, parmesan cheese, asiago cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a sauce pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add pureed garlic and diced onions. Step 3: Cook about five minutes until the onions are tender and translucent. Step 4: Whisk in milk, cream, nutmeg, salt, and pepper Slowly bring the mixture up to a boil stirring frequently to prevent sticking Dissolve cornstarch in water. Step 5: Mix well so that there are no lumps Slowly add cornstarch mixture just as the sauce comes to a boil and whisk well. Step 6: Allow mixture to come back to a boil. Step 7: Turn off heat and stir in the cheeses.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, olive oil, egg, white flour, sugar, skim milk powder, yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Put ingredients in machine in order above. Step 2: Set to"dough" setting. Step 3: When it is ready, cut the dough in half, spread into circles on baking sheets or pizza pans. Step 4: Brush lightly with olive oil. Step 5: Sprinkle on: garlic powder, onion powder, parsley flakes, basil, rosemary, feta or parmesan cheese and a little coarse salt. Step 6: Bake in an oven preheated to 450f for 10- 12 minutes Enjoy with soup, cheese or italian style with balsamic vinegar and olive oil swirled in a saucer.

Dish Name: Billy's Red White And Bleu Pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, onion, black olives, garlic, capers, flour, half-and-half cream, blue cheese, tomato paste, salt and pepper, red pepper flakes, basil, parsley, fettuccine
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Melt butter and olive oil over medium heat, then add onions, garlic, and capers Break up the onions with a spoon as you saute them and cook until softened and slightly browned. Step 3: Sprinkle the flour over the top and stir constantly for 1 minute Slowly add the half & half while stirring to combine. Step 4: Let it come to a boil, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Turn the heat to low and add the cheese, stirring until completely melted. Step 6: Add the tomato paste and olives and stir to combine. Step 7: Add red pepper flakes, basil, and parsley. Step 8: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, spaghetti sauce, whole milk ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, dried parsley flakes, lasagna noodle, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Meat mixture: to a large skillet, add all meat ingredients except sauce. Step 2: Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until cooked through. Step 3: Place the 2 jars of spaghetti sauce in a large food processor. Step 4: When meat is done, strain in a collander, then put in the food processor with the sauce. Step 5: Blend for 30 seconds or so. Step 6: Place meat mixture in a bowl and set aside Processing the meat helps to keep layers thin and flavorful Cheese mixture: mix all cheese ingredients and set aside Noodles: bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 7: Add 2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground sausage, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, green bell pepper, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, shredded cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, lasagna noodle, pepperoni, fresh mushrooms, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Meat mixture: to a large skillet, add oil, sausage, garlic, italian seasoning, and crushed red pepper flakes. Step 2: Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until just about cooked through. Step 3: Add bell pepper and continue to cook 2-3 minutes longer until sausage is fully cooked. Step 4: Place the 2 jars of spaghetti sauce in a large food processor. Step 5: When meat is done, strain in a collander, then put in the food processor with the sauce. Step 6: Blend for 30 seconds or so. Step 7: Place meat mixture in a bowl and set aside Cheese mixture: mix all cheeses together and set aside Noodles: bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 8: Add 2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh garlic, shallot, mushroom, red pepper, green pepper, andouille sausages, chicken breasts, white wine, heavy cream, sage, red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese, penne pasta, asiago cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic and shallots. Step 2: Add all ingredients except parmesan cheese, asiago cheese, green onions and cajun spice. Step 3: Simmer until reduced to half- slightly thickened. Step 4: Add parmesan cheese and cajun spice, mix well. Step 5: Top with asiago cheese, green onions and grilled chicken breast Unless you are the only one eating you are going to want to double or triple this recipe according to how many you are serving.

Ingredient Names: butter, dark brown sugar, baking powder, salt, eggs, unsweetened cocoa powder, all-purpose flour, toasted hazelnuts, bittersweet chocolate, dark chocolate, vegetable shortening
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f Lightly grease a cookie sheet and set aside. Step 2: Beat the butter in a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. Step 4: Beat until combined, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Step 5: Beat in the eggs and cocoa powder. Step 6: Beat in as much flour as you can with the mixer. Step 7: Stir in any remaining flour, the hazelnuts, and 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate with a wooden spoon. Step 8: Divide the dough in half. Step 9: Shape each portion into a 9" long roll.

Ingredient Names: onions, mushrooms, garlic, sweet red peppers, olive oil, black beans, tomatoes, olives, fresh basil, salt, pepper, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute first 4 ingredients in hot oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until tender. Step 2: Add beans and next 5 ingredients. Step 3: Bring to a boil; reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain well. Step 5: Place spaghetti on serving platter; top with tomato mixture. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: oil, red onions, garlic, celery, red chile, lean ground beef, worcestershire sauce, glass red wine, tomato, penne pasta, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan, then add the onion, garlic, celery and chilli. Cook gently for 5-10 mins until soft. Step 2: Up the heat and throw in your beef mince. Cook until just coloured, then add the Worcestershire sauce, red wine or stock and tinned tomatoes. Slowly cook the bolognese for 30 mins-1 hr – depending how much time you have, but longer will taste better. Step 3: Boil some water, add in your pasta and cook according to pack instructions. Drain, then throw the pasta into the pan with the sauce and mix it all together. Dish up and serve with lashings of grated cheese over the top. Heaven!

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, butter, onions, garlic, sage, stilton, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta according to pack instructions. Step 2: In a saucepan, melt the butter, then gently fry the onion until golden. Step 3: Add the garlic and sage, fry for a further 2 mins, then remove the pan from the heat. Step 4: Drain the pasta and reserve some cooking water. Step 5: Stir through the buttery onions, stilton and 2 tbsp cooking water, then sprinkle with the toasted walnuts to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, onion, celery, carrot, garlic, fresh thyme, ground beef, ground pork, dry red wine, bay leaves, beef broth, tomato puree, pappardelle pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in heavy large pot over medium high heat. Step 2: Add bacon Saut until beginning to brown, about 6 minutes. Step 3: Add onion, celery, carrot, garlic, and thyme Saut 5 minutes. Step 4: Add beef and pork Saut until brown and cooked through, breaking up meat with back of fork, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Add wine and bay leaves. Step 6: Simmer until liquid is slightly reduced, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Add broth and tomato puree.

Ingredient Names: cooked penne, extra virgin olive oil, dry basil, dry oregano, dried thyme, roma tomatoes, tomato puree, onion, garlic cloves, green pepper, fresh parmesan cheese, sugar, lean ground beef, mozzarella cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a frying pan, fry beef in 1 tbsp of olive oil until brown and season with salt and pepper, set aside. Step 2: In a deep saucepan, heat oil and fry onions, peppers, garlic and herbs until onions are lightly colored. Step 3: Preheat oven at 400f. Step 4: Stir in canned tomatoes and tomato puree, and season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Simmer in low heat for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add grated parmesan cheese and ground beef and simmer for 2 more minutes In an oven-safe glass dish, layer pasta and bolognese beef. Step 7: Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden brown. Step 8: Take out of the oven, and let it stand for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, spaghetti sauce, italian salad dressing mix, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and then drain pasta. Step 2: In a bowl, combine the spaghetti sauce and salad dressing mix. Step 3: Add pasta and toss to coat. Step 4: Transfer to a greased shallow 2-qt baking dish. Step 5: Sprinkle with all of the cheese. Step 6: Bake, uncovered, at 400 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until heated through.

Dish Name: Bow Ties With Creamy Artichoke Sauce
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, alfredo sauce, canned artichoke hearts, garlic clove, fresh tomato, fresh rosemary, salt and pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bow tie pasta as directed on packaging, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, place alfredo sauce, artichokes, garlic, tomatoes, rosemary, salt and pepper in a saucepan and simmer over low heat, strirring occasionally, until hot. Step 3: Pour sauce over pasta, toss and sprinkle with parsley.

Dish Name: Bravo Ristorante Italiano Rigatoni Alla Buttera
Ingredient Names: italian sausage, tomato sauce, chicken broth, peas, heavy cream, rigatoni pasta, salt and pepper, parmigiano
Instructions: Step 1: Cook sausage in a large frying pan, until well browned, drain fat. Step 2: Pour tomato sauce and broth on top of sausage and cook for 3 minutes on medium heat. Step 3: Add peas and cream and cook for 1 1 / 2 minutes more. Step 4: Fill a large saucepan 2 / 3 full with salted water, bring to a boil, add rigatoni. Step 5: Bring water back to a boil and cook uncovered until rigatoni is al dente. Step 6: Place a single serving of pasta on a plate, and top with as much sauce as you like! Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: water, milk, butter, granulated sugar, salt, vanilla extract, lemons, eggs, unbleached flour, yeast, egg, confectioners' sugar, non-pareils
Instructions: Step 1: Add in order given above to bread machine Process for dough cycle. Step 2: Roll and shape into braided rings, let rise. Step 3: Bake at 340 degrees for approximately 20-25 minutes This bread can also have colored raw eggs put in the braids before baking They will cook to hard boiled egg stage. Step 4: After baking, cool and frost with 2 cups powdered sugar mixed with approximately 1 / 4 cup milk and 1 / 2 teaspoons vanilla extract, then sprinkle with non-pareils.

Dish Name: Bread Maker Italian Herb Bread 1 5 Lbs
Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, sugar, salt, dried basil, bread flour, yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients to break maker pan in the order listed Use white bread cycle with a light or medium crust setting.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, chili flakes, breakfast sausage, unsalted butter, flour, chicken broth, milk, eggs, hash browns, spinach, sharp cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, oven-ready lasagna noodles, fresh chives, kosher salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil; set aside. Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat, warm 2 tablespoons olive oil. Add onions and cook until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add a pinch chili flakes and sausage and cook, stirring occasionally to break into pieces, until sausage is cooked through and browned. Step 3: Add 2 tablespoons butter to the skillet to melt, then stir in the flour until completely combined. Stir in chicken stock and milk, increase heat to bring to a boil, and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then remove from heat and set aside to cool. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add eggs and cook, stirring often, to scramble. Remove from heat and set aside. Step 5: To assemble lasagna, spoon 1/2 cup gravy, without sausage pieces, into the bottom of the baking dish and spread to coat. Place 4 lasagna noodles over the bottom of the pan, then top with half of the eggs, half of the spinach, 1/3 of the sausage gravy, 1/2 cup shredded cheddar, 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella and 1/3 of the hashbrowns. Repeat with another layer of noodles, the remaining eggs, remaining spinach, sausage gravy, 1/2 cup shredded cheddar and 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella. Top final layer of noodles with remaining sauce, cheeses and hash browns. Step 6: Cover and bake 30 minutes, the uncover and bake 10 minutes more. Let rest 10 minutes before slicing. Garnish with chopped chives to serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, bacon, green onion, minced garlic, large eggs, salt, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion, tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Step 3: Pasta should still be firm, drain. Step 4: At the same time, place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Drain bacon slices on paper towels and crumble when cool enough to handle. Step 6: Reserve bacon drippings in the skillet. Step 7: Return crumbled bacon to the skillet with green onion and garlic; cook in the drippings over medium heat until onion starts to soften, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Add drained spaghetti and mix well. Step 9: Slowly add beaten eggs and scramble with the spaghetti mixture for 1 to. Step 10: Season with salt and pepper. Step 11: Add Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, and onion powder; continue to scramble until all ingredients are combined. Step 12: Stir in diced tomatoes and serve.

Ingredient Names: salt, dry fettuccine, broccoli florets, butter, parmesan cheese, cayenne pepper, nutmeg, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the salt in a large pot of water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add the fettuccine and cook according to the package directions for al dente During the last 3 minutes of cooking, add the broccoli. Step 3: Drain in a colander, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water, set aside. Step 4: Place the butter in the pot, reduce heat to medium-low, and stir until melted. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup of the reserved pasta water, then stir in 1 / 3 cup of the parmesan. Step 6: Add the fettucine and broccoli and the cayenne and nutmeg, toss. Step 7: Remove from heat and sprinkle with another 1 / 3 cup of the parmesan and the pepper.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, lite olive oil, white wine, chicken broth, broccoli floret, cooked pasta, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft. Step 2: Add wine, broth& broccoli. Step 3: Cover and cook for 3 minutes. Step 4: Toss pasta with broccoli and cook until both are heated through. Step 5: Season to taste, put on a dinner plate and sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: penne, broccoli, extra virgin olive oil, pancetta, garlic cloves, chili flakes, parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put penne in boiling water. Step 2: When half cooked add the broccoli. Step 3: Heat a frying pan on medium heat, add a tbsp of oil and cook the pancetta until crispy. Step 4: Add the garlic and chilli and stir through, remove from heat. Step 5: When penne is cooked, drain Broccoli should be soft and broken into pieces. Step 6: Add penne and broccoli to pan of pancetta and oil. Step 7: Stir ingredients together and add remaining oil, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 8: Serve with parsley and parmesan.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, scallion, butter, half-and-half, dried basil, garlic clove, parmesan cheese, gorgonzola, cayenne, linguine, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water for 3-4 minutes or until tender. Step 2: Drain and refresh under cold, running water, and pat dry. Step 3: Cook scallion in butter until softened. Step 4: Add cream, basil and garlic, simmer, stirring. Step 5: Add cheeses and stir until well-combined. Step 6: Stir in broccoli and cayenne and salt and pepper to taste and cook until heated through. Step 7: Serve sauce over linguine and sprinkle with toasted walnuts.

Ingredient Names: spiral shaped pasta, butter, flour, milk, parmesan cheese, salt, garlic powder, nutmeg, thyme, sharp cheddar cheese, fresh broccoli, mushrooms, swiss cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Note: drain broccoli and mushrooms very well. Step 2: Steam broccoli until tender-firm. Step 3: Slice mushrooms, set aside. Step 4: Cook pasta until tender-firm, drain well. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, melt butter in microwave; mix in flour, stir in milk. Heat in microwave pausing to stir occasionally until mixture boils and thickens. Step 6: Add parmesan cheese, salt, garlic, nutmeg, thyme and cheddar cheese; stir. Step 7: Return drained pasta to a large pot, add cheese mixture, cooked broccoli and mushrooms; mix well. Step 8: Pour into greased 9x13 casserole dish. Step 9: Sprinkle with grated cheese. Step 10: Bake uncovered in 350 degree oven for about 20 minutes. Step 11: Note: if refrigerated before baking, bake 5-10 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: orecchiette, fresh broccoli, sweet italian sausage links, garlic, cayenne pepper, butter, chicken broth, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil and add pasta. Step 2: Meanwhile heat olive oil over medium high heat and quickly cook the sausage. Step 3: Add the broccoli, garlic, butter and chicken broth. Step 4: Bring to a boil, reduce to medium high and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, reducing sauce. Step 5: Drain pasta and pour into a serving bowl. Step 6: Add the broccoli mixture and cheese, tossing well, serve.

Dish Name: Broccoli, walnut and blue cheese pasta
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, fresh broccoli florets, olive oil, walnuts, blue cheese such as dolcelatte, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook penne; 4 mins before the end of cooking, throw in broccoli florets. Meanwhile, heat olive oil, add a handful chopped walnuts and fry gently for 1 min. Step 2: Drain the pasta, adding 4 tbsp cooking water to the walnuts. Return the pasta to the pan, add the walnuts and creamy blue cheese. Gently stir on the heat, just to melt the cheese. Squeeze over lemon juice to serve.

Ingredient Names: wide egg noodles, cream mushroom soup, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, broccoli cuts, cooking spray, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350. Step 2: Spray a 9x13" baking dish with cooking spray, set aside. Step 3: In large cooking pot, cook noodles, drain and set aside. Step 4: Using the same pot, add soup, cheeses& frozen broccoli. Step 5: Season to taste and stir to combine. Step 6: Pour into baking dish, and bake about 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: brussels sprouts, salted butter, extra virgin olive oil, onion, arborio rice, dry white wine, vegetable stock, saffron thread, salt, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil a pot of salted water and throw in brussels sprouts, blanching them whole This may take 3-5 minutes depending on size. Step 2: Drain and plunge them into a bowl of iced water for 5 minutes, then drain again. Step 3: Slice each sprout lengthwise into 3-4 pieces and keep in a bowl. Step 4: In a large, wide pan heat butter and oil, add onion and lightly fry until transparent. Step 5: Add rice and stir until grains become transparent Deglaze with wine, allowing it to evaporate completely. Step 6: Add a ladle full of boiling stock and the saffron, stirring until liquid is almost entirely incorporated. Step 7: Add stock a ladle full at a time until risotto is almost cooked, 15-20 minutes depending on the rice. Step 8: Add brussels sprouts and stir through.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Rigatoni Positano Copycat
Ingredient Names: fresh basil, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, romano cheese, chicken breast, garlic, olive oil, eggplant, rigatoni pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil. Step 2: Add eggplant and saute until brown and soft. Step 3: Add chopped garlic and saute. Step 4: Add sliced chicken breast, and marinara, reduce heat. Step 5: Toss cooked rigatoni pasta with sauce. Step 6: Then romano cheese, fresh chopped basil, and fresh mozzarella cheese.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, bacon, red onion, garlic cloves, hot red pepper flakes, tomato sauce, bucatini pasta, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot, and add 2 tablespoons salt. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a 10- to 12-inch saut pan, combine the olive oil, garlic, and red pepper flakes. Step 3: Set over low heat and cook until the onion is softened and the guaniciale has rendered much of its fat, about 12 minutes. Step 4: Drain all but cup of the fat out of the pan. Step 5: Add the tomato sauce, turn up the heat, and bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer and allow to bubble for 6 to 7 minutes While the sauce simmers, cook the bucatini in the boiling water for about a minute less than the package directions, until still very firm, drain. Step 6: Add the pasta to the simmering sauce and toss for about 1 minute to coat. Step 7: Divide the pasta among four heated bowls and serve immediately, topped with freshly grated pecorino.

Ingredient Names: bacon, garlic cloves, onion, extra virgin olive oil, diced tomatoes, salt, black pepper, bucatini pasta, parmigiano
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet saut onion and garlic in a sufficient amount of olive oil. Step 2: When they are well cooked, add the crumbled bacon and tomatoes, season with salt and pepper If you are using the tinned tomatoes, mush them up in small pieces. Step 3: Bring to boil and cook for several minutes until the flavours are well blended and some of the extra liquid is evaporated. Step 4: Meanwhile cook the pasta al dente, and drain. Step 5: Toss the tomato mixture together with the pasta, serve with plenty of freshly grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: bucatini pasta, olive oil, onions, pancetta, canned tomatoes, bocconcini, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Add pasta to large pot of boiling water. Step 2: Boil uncovered until tender, drain. Step 3: Heat oil in pan, add onions and pancetta. Step 4: Cook, stirring until onions are soft. Step 5: Add tomatoes, stir over heat for 2 minutes then add cheese and pasta. Step 6: Stir until heated through. Step 7: Top with chopped green onion.

Dish Name: Bucatini With Pancetta Cheese And Eggs
Ingredient Names: bucatini pasta, butter, pancetta, egg yolks, milk, pecorino cheese, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta until al dente. Step 2: Heat the butter and fry the pancetta until lightly browned. Step 3: Set aside Lightly beat the egg yolks and the milk in a bowl, add the cheese. Step 4: Pour the egg mixture into the bacon and add the pasta Warm through, but do not cook the eggs. Step 5: Toss well adding plenty of black pepper.

Ingredient Names: bucatini pasta, anchovy fillets, basil, onion, cherry tomatoes, capers, oil, chili pepper, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the chilli. Step 2: Wash the capers and anchovies from excess salt, dry on a paper towel and chop roughly 5 minutes, together with the peppers. Step 3: Chop the onion and saute in the oil. Step 4: Add the chilli and the pepper mixture. Step 5: Cook for 5 minutes stiring from time to time. Step 6: Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 15 minutes more, season as needed. Step 7: Cook the pasta, then toss with the mixture, adding the orn basil leaves, serve.

Ingredient Names: hamburger, tomato sauce, spices, cottage cheese, eggs, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodles, ice cream buckets
Instructions: Step 1: I cook a large package of hamburger, drain. Step 2: Place it back in the pan i cooked it in, and add tomato sauce and spices as you like it In another large bowl, mix two large containers of cottage cheese, four eggs, and salt and pepper A third bowl has a large quantity of shredded mozzarella Open two packages of lasagna noodles, either no-bake or regular I prefer the regular, they are thicker--he no bake kinda disappear in my lasagna because they are so thin. Step 3: Place all the ingredient bowls and pans in a row on the counter. Step 4: Then i take 6 ice cream buckets or similar container. Step 5: Layer as follows: noodles, sauce, cheese and repeat til done That is it! Step 6: You end up with six lasagnas, and only 3 dirty pans.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, buckwheat groats, water, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop onion. Step 2: In a pot with tightly fitting lid melt butter and saute chopped onion until translucent. Step 3: Add 4 cups water and bring to a boil. Step 4: Stir in 1 cup buckwheat grits or groats. Step 5: Reduce heat to very low, close the lid of the pot and let simmer for about 30 minutes until buckwheat reaches polenta consistency I found that sometimes it already thickens after about 10 minutes, so have a look at it after 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in ground parmesan cheese, serve hot.

Dish Name: Buddy Valastro's Grandma Maddalena's Sausage Lasagna
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, ground beef, ground veal, ground pork, hot italian sausage, garlic, dried oregano, tomato paste, whole canned tomatoes, tomato puree, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh ricotta, flat leaf parsley, basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: In a large heavy bottomed pot, heat the olive oil, add the beef, pork, veal and sausage and cook until browned. Step 2: Add garlic and oregano and cook until fragrant. Step 3: Stir in the tomato paste and cook until the meat is coated. Step 4: Add tomatoes with their juices and the tomato puree, season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Step 5: Simmer over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened about 1 1 / 2 hours Ricotta: In large bowl, combine the ricotta with the parsley, basil, 1 cup of the parmesan, 1 pound of the shredded mozzarella and beaten eggs. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper Noodles:.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, olive oil, fettuccine, frozen chopped spinach, diced tomatoes, onion, garlic cloves, dried basil, dried oregano, red pepper flakes, cracked pepper, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Add four cups of vegetable broth to a large pot Break the fettuccine in half to make stirring easier later, and then add it to the pot Also add the canned tomatoes, olive oil, frozen spinach, onion, garlic, basil, oregano, red pepper, and some freshly cracked black pepper. Step 2: Make sure the ingredients are submerged under the liquid, place a lid on top of the pot, and then turn the heat on to high. Step 3: Allow the pot to come up to a full, rolling boil over high heat then remove the lid and turn the heat down to medium. Step 4: Allow the pot to continue to boil over medium heat, without a lid, for 10-15 minutes, or until the pasta is cooked and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Step 5: Stir the pot every few minutes as it cooks to prevent the pasta from sticking to the bottom, but avoid over stirring which can cause the pasta to become sticky and mushy The pot must be boiling the entire time. Step 6: After the pasta is cooked, crumble the feta cheese over top and serve.

Ingredient Names: pasta, butter, sage leaves, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: When the butter foam subsides and the butter is golden but not brown tear the sage leaves into 2 or 3 pieces and add to the butter It is important that the butter reach this point Resist the desire to add the sage too soon. Step 3: Cook for about a minute while stirring, careful not to let the sage burn but it should take on a little color. Step 4: Toss the with hot cooked pasta Pass the cheese at the table.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, olive oil, garlic cloves, butternut squash, arborio rice, saffron, butter, parmesan cheese, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook for 15 seconds. Step 3: Add squash and rice and cook for 1 or 2 minutes, stirring Slowly and carefully ad 1 / 2 cup of the hot broth and the saffron, stirring constantly Continue to cook and stir over medium heat until broth is absorbed Continue adding broth, 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring constantly until the broth has been absorbed but mixture is creamy, remove from heat. Step 4: Stir in butter, the 2 tablespoons of cheese and the pepper. Step 5: Spoon into a serving bowl. Step 6: Sprinkle with additional parmesan.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, vanilla, butternut squash, butter, white onion, arborio rice, white wine, parmesan cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot: Simmer broth and vanilla. Step 2: Add squash and simmer until tender. Step 3: Remove squash and cover to keep warm, keep broth on low heat. Step 4: In a separate pan: Melt 2 tbsp butter and add onions. Step 5: Cook onions until transparent, do not caramelize. Step 6: Add rice and toast for about 3 minutes, making sure to coat with butter / onions. Step 7: When rice is toasted, add white wine and stir until almost evaporated. Step 8: Add 1 / 2 cup of broth, stir until absorbed.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, ground nutmeg, ginger, gruyere cheese, salt and pepper, fresh cilantro, unbleached flour, salt, eggs, water
Instructions: Step 1: Steam squash until easily pierced with a fork. Step 2: Mash squash, and add spices, cheese and salt and pepper. Step 3: Cool, and prepare dough For dough: mix flour and salt together. Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix the cilantro, eggs, and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 5: In a food processor, pulse cilantro mixture until the cilantro is fine. Step 6: Add flour mixture gradually until well mixed. Step 7: Add water if necessary to obtain a stiff dough. Step 8: Knead dough by hand, and leave rest in a covered bowl for 20 minutes. Step 9: Knead again, and roll dough into a thin sheet, approximately 1 / 8 inch.

Dish Name: Butternut Squash Ravioli With Pancetta And Sage
Ingredient Names: dried porcini mushrooms, olive oil, pancetta, butternut squash, dry breadcrumbs, fresh parmesan cheese, lemon rind, salt, ground nutmeg, egg, wonton wrappers, fresh sage, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pour boiling water over mushrooms in a bowl. Step 2: Cover and let stand 30 minutes or until tender, and drain. Step 3: Squeeze mushrooms to remove excess moisture, chop mushrooms. Step 4: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, add pancetta, cook until crisp. Step 5: Remove half of pancetta from pan with a slotted spoon, and place in a medium bowl, reserving remaining pancetta and drippings. Step 6: Add the mushrooms, squash, breadcrumbs, cheese, rind, salt, nutmeg, and egg to bowl, stirring to combine Working with 1 won ton wrapper at a time, spoon about 1 tablespoon squash mixture into center of each wrapper.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, fresh sage, vegetable stock, butternut squash, olive oil, caramelized onion, arborio rice, fresh rosemary, dry white wine, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt 4 tbs Of the butter. Step 2: Add 1 tbs Of the sage and heat until the butter browns. Step 3: Strain the butter into a small bowl and discard the sage. Step 4: Cover the bowl to keep the butter warm. Step 5: In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, whisk together the stock and squash puree. Step 6: Bring just to a simmer, 8 to 10 minutes Maintain over low heat. Step 7: In a large saucepan or risotto pan over medium heat, warm the olive oil.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, cooking spray, chicken broth, water, pancetta, onions, oil, garlic cloves, arborio rice, parmesan cheese, salt, ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 475 Lightly coat large cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Step 2: Arrange squash in one layer. Step 3: Bake until tender, turning once. Step 4: Reduce oven temp to 325. Step 5: Combine broth and water in a saucepan, bring to a simmer and keep warm over low heat. Step 6: Cook pancetta over medium-high heat in a dutch oven until crisp. Step 7: Drain on paper towel and discard pan drippings. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium, add onion and oil to pan, saute until onion is tender. Step 9: Add garlic and saute another minute.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, arborio rice, cabernet sauvignon wine, chicken stock, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, kosher salt, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the butter and olive oil together in a large saucepan over low heat. Step 2: When the butter is melted, add the onion and garlic, and saute until transparent, 7-8 minutes. Step 3: Add the rice, and stir with a wooden spoon until each grain begins to turn a milky white, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the wine, and continue to stir until it is completely absorbed by the rice Keeping the stock hot over low heat, add the stock, 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring after each addition until nearly all the liquid is absorbed Continue to add stock and stir until the rice is tender but not mushy, a total of 18-20 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the tomatoes and cheese, taste again, and season with salt, pepper, and if you like, more cheese. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Camp David Spaghetti with Italian Sausage
Ingredient Names: italian sausage links, lean ground beef, yellow onion, garlic, olive oil, tomato sauce, tomatoes, fresh oregano, salt, dried basil, bay leaf, ground black pepper, spaghetti, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Slice sausages lengthwise, leaving links attached along one side; lay flat in a large skillet. Step 3: Cook over medium heat until browned and cooked through,, flipping once. Step 4: Transfer to a plate; set aside. Step 5: Add ground beef, onion, garlic, and olive oil to the same skillet over medium heat; cook and stir until onion is translucent and beef is browned and crumbly, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Drain all but drippings from the skillet. Step 7: Stir in tomato sauce, tomatoes, oregano, salt, basil, bay leaf, and black pepper; simmer, uncovered, over low heat until flavors have blended, about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Remove and discard bay leaf. Step 9: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 10: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 11: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to, drain. Step 12: Stir spaghetti into sauce. Step 13: Divide spaghetti and sauce among individual oven-safe baking dishes or plates; top each with a cooked half sausage and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Step 14: Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and begins to brown, 5 to.

Ingredient Names: cannelloni tubes, extra virgin olive oil, onion, button mushroom, tomato sauce, worcestershire sauce, dried oregano, dried basil, fresh parsley, water, margarine, all-purpose flour, whole milk, frozen spinach, ricotta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook cannelloni tubes according to package direction. Step 2: Drain and set aside to cool Sauce-------------- In a medium size saucepan, heat olive oil on medium-high heat. Step 3: Add chopped onion and saute' until just softened, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Add chopped mushrooms and continue to saute' for another 3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in tomato sauce, worcestershire sauce, oregano, basil, parsley and water and bring to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally Filling-------------- In another medium-size saucepan, melt margarine or butter on medium heat.

Ingredient Names: capellini, onion, parsley, dry white wine, heavy cream, white pepper, parmigiano
Instructions: Step 1: Set pasta water to heat, salt it when it reaches a boil, and cook the pasta In the meantime, wilt the onion in a pan with a little water and the wine, then blend the mixture with the cream and check seasoning. Step 2: Heat the cream and add the minced parsley, timing things so you reach this step when the pasta is ready to be drained. Step 3: Drain the pasta, stir the sauce into it, garnish with the reserved parsley sprigs, and serve with grated parmigiano on the side.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, penne pasta, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, green olives, balsamic vinegar, flat-leaf italian parsley, capers, dried basil, basil sprig, pine nuts, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put pasta water on to boil. Step 2: In a large saute pan stir-fry eggplant and garlic in 4 tablespoons olive oil, until tender and a little brown. Step 3: Put pasta in boiling water. Step 4: Remove eggplant mixture from pan and set aside. Step 5: Saute onion and pepper in remaining oil for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add eggplant mixture and all other ingredients to onion and pepper, cover and cook over low heat for about 7 minutes. Step 7: Toss hot, drained al dente pasta together with eggplant sauce, garnish with a sprig of fresh basil, and serve with grated parmesan cheese. Step 8: Add additional vinegar, if desired. Step 9: Serve warm or at room temperature Serves 4.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, thai basil, mozzarella balls, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Combine cherry tomatoes, mozzarella balls, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, and Thai basil in a large mixing bowl; mix well. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Drain pasta and top with cherry tomato mixture.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, prosciutto, mushroom, garlic, black olives, white wine, chicken broth, parsley, egg, parmesan cheese, cooked spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in skillet. Step 2: Add prosciutto, mushrooms, garlic and olives Saut until mushrooms are tender. Step 3: Add the wine and chicken broth and bring to a boil. Step 4: Simmer over high heat until liquid is reduced by half. Step 5: Add parsley Break egg into mushroom mixture and stir until egg is cooked. Step 6: Add parmesan cheese and mix well. Step 7: Add cooked spaghetti and toss.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, cream, pancetta, bacon, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, fresh ground pepper, eggs, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the bacon and pancetta finely and place it in a skillet Sautee on low heat until nearly crisp. Step 2: Add the garlic and continue to cook until the bacon is to the desired doneness. Step 3: Stir in the cream and simmer. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook the pasta to the manufacturer's directon. Step 5: Beat the eggs in a large bowl. Step 6: When the pasta is done cooking, drain it, but do not rinse Dump it into the bowl with the eggs and stir. Step 7: Add the sauce from the skillet and continue to stir. Step 8: Remove from the heat and add the cheese.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, extra virgin olive oil, pancetta, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, dry white wine, egg yolks, romano cheese, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta. Step 2: Heat large skillet. Step 3: Add olive oil and pancetta Brown pancetta 2 minutes. Step 4: Add red pepper flakes and garlic and cook 2-3 minutes more. Step 5: Add wine and stir up all the pan drippings. Step 6: In a separate bowl, beat yolks, then add about 1 / 2 cup of the pasta cooking water This tempers the eggs and keeps them from scrambling when added to the pasta. Step 7: Drain pasta well and add it directly to the skillet with pancetta and oil. Step 8: Pour the egg mixture over the pasta.

Dish Name: Carrabba's Cavatappi Amatriciana Side Dish Pasta
Ingredient Names: cavatappi pasta, onions, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, olive oil, dry white wine, diced tomatoes with juice, salt and pepper, pecorino romano cheese, pancetta
Instructions: Step 1: Cook cavatappi according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Saute onions, garlic, and red pepper flakes in olive oil over medium heat till onions are soft and translucent. Step 3: Add white wine and cook till nearly evaporated. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes with their juice till slightly thickened. Step 5: Taste, and add salt and pepper as desired. Step 6: Mix into cooked cavatappi, toss with cheese. Step 7: Add cooked pancetta.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, italian sausage, yellow onion, garlic, red bell pepper, dry white wine, whole canned tomatoes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, basil leaves, pecorino romano cheese, goat cheese, pappardelle pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Remove sausage from the casing and break into coarse pieces. Step 2: Pour olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add sausage and cook until the sausage has browned slightly. Step 4: Add onion and red bell pepper and cook until soft and onion turns a rich golden color. Step 5: Add the wine and let evaporate for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add garlic, and cook 1 minute more. Step 7: Add the tomatoes and season lightly with salt and pepper and crushed red pepper flakes. Step 8: Raise heat and bring sauce to a boil, stirring frequently. Step 9: Reduce heat and let simmer until the sauce has thickened. Step 10: Stir in basil and set sauce aside.

Ingredient Names: milk, flour, butter, dijon mustard, mature cheddar, blue cheese, nutmeg, penne, cauliflower, spinach, pine nuts, garlic, extra-virgin olive oil, tomato passata
Instructions: Step 1: For the tomato sauce, cook the sliced garlic in the oil for 1 min, then add the passata. Season, half-cover the pan and simmer for 20 mins until rich. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the cheese sauce. Put the milk, flour and 50g butter into a pan. Heat, whisking non-stop, until smooth, then bubble for 3 mins, stirring to make sure any flouriness is lost. Cool for 5 mins, then stir in the mustard, most of the cheddar, half the blue cheese and half the nutmeg. Step 3: Boil the penne and cauliflower for 8 mins in salted water until the pasta is almost cooked and the cauli is tender. Keep 2 tbsp water from the pan, then drain. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a pan, add the whole garlic clove, spinach, remaining nutmeg, salt and lots of black pepper. Stir for 2 mins, then remove the garlic clove. Step 4: Set aside 300ml cheese sauce and mix the rest into the cauli and pasta. Divide half the tomato sauce between 6 dishes and top with some spinach. Fill with cauli mix, top with more spinach, then the rest of the tomato sauce. Top with the cheese sauce, cheeses and pine nuts. Cover with cling film, cool and chill for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 1 month. To cook, defrost if frozen. Heat oven to 200C/ 180C fan/gas 6. Cook on a baking sheet for 18-20 mins until golden and bubbling. Good with green salad or garlic bread.

Dish Name: Cavatappi Casserole With Prosciutto And Three Cheeses
Ingredient Names: cavatappi pasta, prosciutto, butter, all-purpose flour, low-fat milk, salt, fresh ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, gruyere cheese, gouda cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 3: Drain and set aside Lightly grease a 13x9" baking dish, and set aside. Step 4: Cook prosciutto in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, stirring often, 6 minutes or until browned and crisp, set aside. Step 5: Melt butter in a dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add flour, and cook, whisking constantly, 1 minute Slowly whisk in milk, and cook, whisking constantly, 5 minutes or until smooth mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Step 7: Whisk in salt, black pepper, and, if desired, red pepper or hot sauce.

Ingredient Names: cavatappi pasta, cooking spray, garlic clove, fresh parsley, extra virgin olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, italian seasoning, prosciutto, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to the package directions, omitting salt and fat. Step 2: Drain in a colander over a bowl, reserving 3 tablespoons cooking liquid. Step 3: Heat pan over medium heat Coat pan with cooking spray. Step 4: Add garlic to pan, and saut 1 minute, remove from heat. Step 5: Add reserved 3 tablespoons cooking liquid and pasta to pan. Step 6: Let stand 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in parsley, oil, salt, pepper, italian seasoning and prosciutto. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheese.

Dish Name: Cavatappi With Spinach Beans And Asiago Cheese
Ingredient Names: spinach leaves, cavatappi pasta, olive oil, salt, pepper, cannellini beans, asiago cheese, fresh ground black pepper, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta Combine all ingredients in a large bowl Toss well Sprinkle with fresh ground pepper, if desired.

Dish Name: Cavatelli With Sausage And Broccoli Rabe
Ingredient Names: bulk italian sausage, broccoli rabe, cavatelli, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place sausage in a large skillet over medium heat and, using a wooden spoon, cook until brown and crumbly. Step 2: Meanwhile, bring at least 4 quarts of lightly salted water to boil and add broccoli rabe and cavatelli. Step 3: Cook until pasta is done, approximately 11 minutes Before draining, reserve approximately 2 cups of pasta cooking water. Step 4: When sausage is done, remove from skillet with a slotted spoon. Step 5: Add extra virgin olive oil to skillet drippings and cook over medium heat until warm. Step 6: Add sliced garlic, and red pepper flakes and cook until lightly golden. Step 7: Add about 1 cup of pasta cooking water to skillet and cook for 1 minute more. Step 8: Then add drained pasta and broccoli rabe to skillet. Step 9: Stir to combine and add reserved sausage.

Ingredient Names: linguine, frozen peas, bacon, garlic, milk, cream cheese, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes, adding peas in the last minute of cooking. Step 3: Drain and keep warm in a bowl. Step 4: Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Transfer bacon to paper towels, reserving drippings in the skillet. Step 6: Add garlic to the skillet; saute for 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and stir in milk and cream cheese until blended. Step 8: Crumble bacon and add to the linguine along with sauce and Parmesan cheese; stir to coat.

Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, oregano, lean smoked back bacon, tomatoes rich juice, fresh basil leaves, egg lasagne, milk, butter flour, grating nutmeg, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onions in the oil for about 15 mins until golden. Add the oregano and bacon and fry for 5 mins more, stirring frequently. Tip in the tomatoes, season and bubble uncovered for 5 mins. Remove from the heat and stir in the basil. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the white sauce. Pour the milk into a pan and tip in the butter and flour. Whisk continuously over a moderate heat to incorporate the flour, then simmer, stirring until thickened. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg. Step 3: Spoon a third of the tomato sauce on the base of a lasagne dish. Top with a third of the lasagne sheets. Then top with a third sauce, a third lasagne, the last of the tomato sauce and finally the last sheets of lasagne. Pour over the white sauce and scatter with the cheese and an extra grating of nutmeg. Chill. If eating straight away, bake at 190C/170C fan/gas 5 for 40 mins until golden and bubbling. Scatter with basil, if you like, and serve with a salad and garlic bread. Step 4: To freeze, cool completely, then wrap in cling film, then foil. Will store for 3 months. To serve, thaw for 6 hrs in a cool place. Unwrap and bake at 190C/170C fan/gas 5 for 50-60 mins until thoroughly heated through.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, mixed peppers, garlic, button mushrooms, passata, vegetable stock, oregano, kalamata olives, zucchini, penne, milk, butter, flour, nutmeg, mature cheddar, hunk old bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large, wide pan or wok, then stir-fry the peppers for 5 mins. Add the chopped garlic and mushrooms, and cook for 5 mins more. Step 2: Pour in the passata and stock, then stir in the oregano, olives and courgettes with plenty of black pepper. Leave to simmer, stirring frequently, for 10-15 mins until the vegetables are just tender and the sauce has reduced a little. Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions. Step 3: To make the cheese sauce, pour the milk into a large pan and add the butter, flour, nutmeg and seasoning. Heat, stirring or whisking all the time until smooth and thickened. Stir in half the cheese and allow it to melt into the sauce. Step 4: Drain the pasta and add to the tomato mixture. Pile into 2 or 3 baking dishes, pack down well, then pour over the cheese sauce (it helps to let the sauce cool and thicken a little before using so that it stays as a layer). Scatter with the remaining cheese and the bread. Step 5: If eating now, bake at 200C/180C fan/ gas 6 for 40 mins until bubbling and golden. Serve with a salad.

Ingredient Names: manicotti, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, parsley, salt, pepper, nutmeg, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta as directed on package, drain. Step 2: Rinse with cold water, drain and arrange in single layer to fill. Step 3: Meanwhile, mix ricotta cheese, 1 1 / 2 cup of the mozzarella cheese, 1 / 4 cup of the parmesan cheese the egg, parsley, salt, pepper and nutmeg. Step 4: Spoon mixture into manicotti shells, using at least 1 / 3 cup per shell. Step 5: Place filled manicotti shells in a single layer in greased 13x9 inch baking pan. Step 6: Pour spaghetti sauce over manicotti shells. Step 7: Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese, bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until hot.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, salt, dry mustard, pepper, onion, green pepper, cheese, eggs, milk, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat to boil first 5 ingredients, stirring once. Step 2: Reduce heat and cover, simmering for 14 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and fluff rice, then cover for another 5-10 minutes to allow it to steam In greased 9x13 pan, layer half of the ingredients in this order:rice, onion, green pepper, and your choice cheese repeat previous step. Step 4: Mix together eggs and milk, pour over the rice mix. Step 5: Sprinkle with parmesan. Step 6: Cook uncovered at 325 degrees until set, approx 50 minutes. Step 7: Let stand for 10-15 minutes, then cut into squares and serve! Step 8: Ifyou want to prepare it ahead of time, simply stop after you sprinkle on the parmesan, cover and stick it in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: manicotti, vegetable oil, ricotta cheese, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, pepper, dried parsley, salt, egg, spaghetti sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients except spaghetti sauce and water. Step 2: Stuff uncooked manicotti shell with cheese mixture. Step 3: Pour half of the sauce in baking dish. Step 4: Place filled shells on sauce. Step 5: Pour remaining sauce over shells Freeze To serve: thaw, bake covered for 1 hour at 350 degrees. Step 6: Then Uncovered for 25-30 minutes and additional 15 minutes. Step 7: Sprinkle some cheese on top.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, bacon, butter, onion, garlic, diced tomatoes, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, colby-monterey jack cheese, ricotta cheese, italian seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, parsley, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook pasta until al dente according to package directions. Step 3: In a large saucepan or grill pan, cook bacon until very crisp. Step 4: Remove bacon from pan and chop into small pieces. Step 5: Using the same pan, add onion and garlic and saut until browned. Step 6: In a large bowl, mix the mozzarella, colby jack, and ricotta cheeses.
