Step 7: Remove and reserve cup of the cheese mix In the same large bowl, add bacon, diced tomatoes, onion and garlic mix, marinara and all spices, blend well. Step 8: Add drained pasta and toss completely.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, marinara sauce, mascarpone cheese, fresh parsley, fresh thyme, cheese tortellini, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Lightly oil an 8 x 8" baking dish. Step 2: Whisk the sauce, mascarpone cheese, parsley and thyme in a large bowl to blend. Step 3: Cook tortellini in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender, about 2 minute drain. Step 4: Add tortellini to the sauce and toss to coat. Step 5: Transfer the tortellini mixture to the prepared baking dish. Step 6: Top the mixture with the mozzarella and parmesan. Step 7: Cover and bake until the sauce bubbles and the cheeses on top melt, about 30 minute.

Ingredient Names: penne, boneless chicken breasts, olive oil, garlic, marinara sauce, fresh basil, onion, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with water and cook penne according to directions on box. Step 2: Meanwhile, chop the thawed chicken into bite-size strips, set aside. Step 3: When the penne is done, drain and set aside. Step 4: Heat the pot with the olive oil and let the oil get really hot. Step 5: Add just under 1 tbsp of fresh minced garlic and add basil and onion. Step 6: Stir around a bit and add the chicken. Step 7: Sprinkle with salt and then sprinkle a lot of garlic salt. Step 8: Add a little ground black pepper. Step 9: Stir fry until chicken is no longer pink, around 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: manicotti, fat free cream cheese, fat-free ricotta cheese, fat free mozzarella cheese, fat free egg substitute, fresh parsley, pepper, fat free spaghetti sauce, fat free parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook manicotti shells according to package directions and drain well. Step 2: Blend the cream cheese until smooth. Step 3: Mix with the ricotta cheese. Step 4: Stir the mozzarella, egg substitute, parsley and pepper into the cheese mixture. Step 5: Fill each manicotti shell with 1 / 4 cup cheese filling. Step 6: Pour 1-1 / 4 cups spaghetti sauce over the bottom of a microwave safe baking dish. Step 7: Place filled manicotti shells on top of sauce. Step 8: Pour remaining sauce over the shells. Step 9: Cover with vented plastic wrap. Step 10: Cook on medium heat 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: pasta, spaghetti sauce, ground turkey, mushrooms, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sauce, meat, parmesan, mushrooms and pasta in a greased or sprayed 9x13 pan Top with mozzarella and bake at 375f for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: wagon wheel macaroni, cherry tomatoes, green onion, italian salad dressing, american cheese, pepperoni, dried italian seasoning, fresh coarse ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta to directed. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and drain. Step 3: Combine pasta and remaining ingredients in large bowl, tossing well to coat. Step 4: Cover and chill until cold, 2-3 hours, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: whole milk, chicken broth, kosher salt, polenta, fresh ground black pepper, unsalted butter, sharp white cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, herbs
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot, combine milk, broth, salt and cornmeal. Step 2: Place over medium-high heat and whisk constantly until liquid is boiling. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 20 minutes until creamy, stirring every 3-4 minutes to prevent sticking and burning, remove from heat. Step 4: Stir in pepper, butter, cheeses and optional herbs.

Ingredient Names: mushrooms, garlic cloves, spinach, part-skim ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, provolone cheese, reduced-fat cream cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, manicotti, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f spray a 9x13 pan with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Set aside Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Step 3: Add mushrooms and garlic. Step 4: Cook 5 minutes on medium heat, stirring frequently, remove from heat. Step 5: In a large bowl, mix thoroughly the mushroom mixture, spinach, ricotta cheese, provolone, cream cheese, half of parmesan cheese, and the eggs. Step 6: Spoon about 2 tbsp of filling mixture into the manicotti shells and then place them into the 9x13 pan. Step 7: Drizzle remaining sauce over top. Step 8: Top with remaining parmesan cheese and bake 55 minutes or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: cheese tortellini, frozen meatballs, italian stewed tomatoes, chili sauce, kalamata olive, sliced mushrooms, romano cheese, feta cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook tortellini in large sauce pan according to package directions Spray a medium saute pan with pam. Step 2: Place meatballs in saute pan and cook over medium high heat until lightly browned Stirring frequently. Step 3: Add tomatoes and chili sauce. Step 4: Stir and continue cooking until hot and bubbly, about 5 minutes, add olives. Step 5: Drain tortellini and return to pan. Step 6: Add meatball-tomato mixture to tortellini. Step 7: Stir and cook over medium heat until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, cherry tomatoes, garlic cloves, sweet onion, salt, fresh ground black pepper, chicken stock, water, cheese ravioli, fresh basil leaf, italian seasoning, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large, deep skillet with a tight-fitting lid, or a dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Stir in the cherry tomatoes and garlic and onion. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Cover the pan and cook, shaking the pan occasionally, until the tomatoes burst and a thick sauce forms, 7-8 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken stock and water and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cook for a couple of minutes, then add the ravioli and cook until tender, 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the heat and stir in the basil and italian seasoning to wilt. Step 8: Serve the soup and top with the cheese. Step 9: Serve with crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, white wine vinegar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place pasta in large pan of salted boiling water and cook until al dente Halve the tomatoes and place in a large bowl with the herbs, olive oil, garlic and vinegar season to taste Squash some of the tomatoes with the back of a spoon. Step 2: When cooked, drain the pasta and while still hot mix well with the tomatoes.

Dish Name: Cherry tomato, kale, ricotta & pesto pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, chili flakes, cherry tomatoes, penne, kale, ricotta, pesto, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the garlic and cook for 2 mins until golden. Add the chilli flakes and tomatoes, season well, and simmer for 15 mins until the sauce is thick and reduced. Step 2: While the sauce is cooking, cook the pasta following pack instructions – add the kale for the final 2 mins of cooking. Drain well and stir into the sauce, then divide between 4 bowls. Top each with a dollop of ricotta, a drizzle of pesto and shavings of Parmesan, if you like.

Dish Name: Chicago Style Deep Dish Sausage Pizza Real Deep Dish
Ingredient Names: water, granulated sugar, sea salt, active dry yeast, corn oil, all-purpose flour, nonstick cooking spray, mozzarella cheese, italian sausage, crushed tomatoes, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Making the dough: in a mixing bowl, dissolve sugar and salt into the lukewarm water. Step 2: Add yeast, corn oil, and a small amount of the flour. Step 3: Mix until you have a thick batter, then add the rest of the flour and continue mixing until combined. Step 4: Knead until the dough comes together into a smooth ball, then stop Dont over-knead Total mixing / kneading time should be no more than 2 - 3 minutes. Step 5: Place the dough in a bowl, lightly oil / spray the dough ball. Step 6: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in a warm place. Step 7: Let the dough rise for 1 to 2 hours. Step 8: After the rise, you can use the dough immediately or punch down the dough and let it rise again until youre ready to use the dough or place it into a plastic zip-top bag and into the refrigerator for 6 to 24 hours.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, fettuccine, heavy cream, butter, parmesan cheese, garlic, black pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper and sear in a skillet until golden and cooked through, then slice and set aside. Step 2: Cook fettuccine in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, reserving some pasta water. Step 3: In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté minced garlic until fragrant. Step 4: Pour in heavy cream and simmer gently until it starts to thicken. Step 5: Whisk in grated parmesan until the sauce is smooth, adding a splash of reserved pasta water if needed. Step 6: Toss the cooked pasta and sliced chicken in the sauce until well coated, and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

Ingredient Names: bacon, penne pasta, extra-virgin olive oil, unsalted butter, onion, sliced fresh mushrooms, minced fresh garlic, italian seasoning, salt, ground black pepper, white wine, chicken stock, chicken, peas, all-purpose flour, grated parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 2: Drain bacon slices on paper towels and crumble when cool enough to handle. Step 3: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 4: Add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Step 6: At the same time, heat olive oil and butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat until butter is melted and oil is hot. Step 7: Add onion and cook, stirring often, until tender, 3 to. Step 8: Add mushrooms and cook, stirring often, until soft, 3 to. Step 9: Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 10: Stir in Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper and evenly distribute the contents in the skillet. Step 11: Stir in wine and bring to a boil, about 10 minutes. Step 12: Pour in chicken stock, add cooked chicken and peas, and bring to a boil. Step 13: While mixture is coming to a boil, place flour in a pint jar with a lid. Step 14: Slowly add remaining chicken stock to the jar, stirring briskly to break up any lumps. Step 15: Place the lid on the jar and shake until well blended. Step 16: Slowly pour flour-stock mixture into the boiling mixture and stir to prevent lumps. Step 17: Return to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 18: Remove from the heat and stir in Parmesan cheese until melted. Step 19: Pour the hot sauce onto the pasta, add parsley and crumbled bacon, and stir to combine. Step 20: Serve in individual bowls with additional Parmesan, if desired.

Dish Name: Chicken And Cheese Rotolo With Many Cloves Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, reduced-fat ricotta cheese, garlic cloves, dried marjoram, thyme, salt, pepper, lasagna noodles, olive oil, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, dry white wine, chicken broth, flour, parsley, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chicken, cheese, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper. Step 2: Spread 3 to 4 tablespoons mixture on each noodle. Step 3: Roll up and place, seam sides down, in 13x9-inch baking dish For sauce, cook garlic in oil in medium skillet, covered, over medium-low heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Mash cloves slightly with a fork. Step 5: Add 1 1 / 2 cups broth and wine to skillet and heat to boiling. Step 6: Mix flour, parsley and remaining 1 / 4 cup broth and stir into boiling mixture. Step 7: Boil until thickened, about 1 minute. Step 8: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 9: Spoon many cloves garlic sauce over rotolo.

Dish Name: Chicken And Sun Dried Tomato Orzo
Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, water, sun-dried tomato, plum tomato, garlic clove, fresh marjoram, red wine vinegar, olive oil, chicken breast, salt, fresh ground pepper, frozen artichoke hearts, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook orzo in a large saucepan of boiling water until just tender, 8 to 10 minutes or according to package directions, drain and rinse. Step 2: Meanwhile, place 1 cup water, 1 / 4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, plum tomato, garlic, 2 teaspoons marjoram, vinegar and 2 teaspoons oil in a blender. Step 3: Blend until just a few chunks remain. Step 4: Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides. Step 5: Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add the chicken and cook, adjusting the heat as necessary to prevent burning, until golden outside and no longer pink in the middle, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Step 7: Transfer to a plate Tent with foil to keep warm. Step 8: Pour the tomato sauce into the pan and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, manicotti, ricotta cheese, cottage cheese, parmesan-romano cheese mix, garlic cloves, garlic salt, italian cheese blend, heavy cream, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into small cubes. Step 2: Chop garlic very fine. Step 3: Cook chicken and garlic with olive oil and garlic salt. Step 4: When done set aside. Step 5: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 6: Boil water and cook manicotti according to box directions. Step 7: Mix ricotta, cottage cheese, 1 / 2 cup parmesan mix and salt to taste. Step 8: Add cooked chicken. Step 9: Take manicotti pasta and stuff with mixture. Step 10: Set in non-stick bake pan in rows.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground chicken, carrot, red onion, garlic cloves, white wine, tomato sauce, tomato juice, chicken stock, thyme, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Step 2: Add ground chicken and cook until browned, about 7-8 minutes. Step 3: Add carrots, onion, and garlic and cook 8-10 minutes on medium-high heat until veggies are soft. Step 4: Add white wine and cook until evaporated, scraping the bottom of the pan while stirring, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add tomato sauce, tomato juice, chicken stock, thyme, and oregano and stir to combine. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken sauce. Step 7: Serve with favorite pasta, i've found that long noodles like linguini or spaghetti work best.

Ingredient Names: chicken meat, butter, cream, parmesan cheese, water, salt, fettuccine pasta, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cream the butter in a bowl with a wooden spoon until it is light and fluffy. Step 2: Beat in the cream a little at a time, and then beat in 1 / 2 cup grated parmesan cheese, a few tbsp at a time. Step 3: Cover the bowl and set it aside. Step 4: Prepare the chicken and keep it warm You can use leftover chopped cooked chicken, or dice skinless, boneless chicken meat and saute in olive oil or butter a few minutes until cooked but still tender. Step 5: Season as you like. Step 6: Set a large pasta bowl or casserole in a 250 oven to heat while you cook the fettucine. Step 7: Bring the water and salt to a rolling boil in a large stock pot. Step 8: Drop in the fettuccine and stir gently with a wooden spoon or fork for a few moments to prevent strands from sticking. Step 9: Boil, stirring occasionally until the pasta is tender.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, butter, parmesan cheese, milk, dry fettuccine, chicken breasts, italian spices, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the fettuccine noodles in water with a tsp of olive oil While the noodles are boiling season your diced chicken breast with the garlic powder onion powder black pepper and italian seasonings and if you like some seasoning salt. Step 2: Drain the noodles dont rinse them Brown the diced chicken breast in a saucepan until fully cooked, set chicken aside. Step 3: In a large pot, put the cream cheese, butter, milk, and parmesan cheese and mix together with a whisk until creamy. Step 4: When the mixture is creamed together add the chicken to the mixture and mix well. Step 5: Add the fettuccine to the cream cheese and chicken and mix well and cook on low heat for 3 minutes Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: part-skim ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, garlic powder, fresh parsley, salt, black pepper, cooked chicken, cooked lasagna noodles, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Mix together first 8 ingredients, reserving 1 / 4 cup of mozzarella for baking, set aside Lay a large piece of plastic wrap on counter top Lay noodles flat atop wrap, top each noodle with a layer of ricotta mixture and 1 / 4 cup chicken Starting at one end, roll up one noodle at a time. Step 3: Spread 1 / 2 cup spaghetti sauce on bottom of a lightly greased baking dish Lay rolls seam side down, cover with remaining spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese. Step 4: Bake for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, cream, white wine, italian cheese blend, pasta, italian salad dressing, chicken breasts, lemon juice, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken breasts in zip lock bag with italian dressing and marinate for at least 2 hours. Step 2: Boil pasta per directions on the box. Step 3: Melt butter under medium low heat, add cream and wine, stir and slowly add cheese to melt add lemon juice after cheese is melted. Step 4: Grill or pan fry chicken breasts. Step 5: Spoon sauce over chicken and pasta, garnish with lemon slices.

Dish Name: Chicken Manicotti With Chive Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: manicotti, cream cheese, milk, romano cheese, chicken, frozen chopped broccoli, red sweet peppers, pepper, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Cook manicotti according to package directions and also cool manicotti shells according to package directions, drain shells. Step 2: Rinse with cold water, drain again. Step 3: Meanwhile, for sauce, in small heavy saucepan melt cream cheese over medium-low heat, stirring constantly Slowly add milk, stirring until smooth. Step 4: Stir in romano or parmesan cheese. Step 5: Remove from heat For filling, in a medium mixing bowl stir together 3 / 4 cup of sauce, the chicken, broccoli, red sweet peppers or pimento and pepper. Step 6: Using a small spoon, carefully fill each manicotti shell with about 1 / 3 cup of filling.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, pasta sauce, parmesan cheese, dried italian seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, ricotta cheese, frozen chopped spinach, salt, pepper, cooked chicken breasts, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, in large skillet over medium heat cook sauce with parmesan, seasoning and pepper flakes until hot. Step 3: Combine ricotta, spinach salt and pepper. Step 4: Stir chicken and noodles into skillet. Step 5: Top with spoonfuls of ricotta mixture. Step 6: Sprinkle with mozzarella, cover. Step 7: Cook until heated through and cheese is melted 6-7 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, sliced mushrooms, onion, green pepper, baby spinach, fresh oregano, salt, fresh ground black pepper, cottage cheese, penne pasta, roasted chicken breast, sharp cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, milk, condensed cream of chicken soup
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Heat olive oil in large nonstick skillet. Step 3: Add mushrooms, onion, and green pepper, saute for 5 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Add spinack, oregano, salt and pepper, saute 4 minutes or until spinach wilts. Step 5: Place cottage cheese in food processor and process until smooth. Step 6: Combine spinach mixture, cottage cheese, pasta, chicken, 3 / 4 cup cheddar cheese, 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese, milk, and soup in a 2 quart buttered baking dish. Step 7: Sprinkle with remaining cheddar and parmesan cheese. Step 8: Bake for 25 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: penne rigate, chicken tenders, garlic and onion pasta sauce, rosemary, thyme, parsley, oregano, basil, onion, green pepper, olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in 12-inch skillet. Step 2: Add onion and pepper and cook until tender. Step 3: Add chicken and cook throughly. Step 4: Add sauce and spices. Step 5: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 6: Once all is done, add pasta to large bowl or dish and cover with sauce. Step 7: Top with fresh ground parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Chicken Pesto And Sun Dried Tomato Pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breasts, penne, sun-dried tomato, basil pesto, light cream, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Season chicken with salt and pepper, add to pan and cook for 5-7 minutes each side or until cooked through. Step 3: Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm. Step 4: Cook pasta according to packet direction, drain and return to saucepan. Step 5: Heat remaining oil in pan, add tomatoes and toss for a minute Thinly slice chicken and return to pan. Step 6: Add pesto and cream and toss over low heat til well combined. Step 7: Add pasta and mix well, season with salt and pepper if desired. Step 8: Serve accompanied with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Chicken Sausage Pasta With Basil And Wine
Ingredient Names: chicken sausage, pasta, olive oil, garlic, onion, white wine, fresh basil, cherry tomatoes, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper, butter, water, fresh mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Start to cook pasta according to directions on the box. Step 2: In a non stick sauce pan, start to heat the olive oil. Step 3: Remove the sausage casing and then cut sausage into quarters length wise, and then into inch long pieces. Step 4: Add onion, garlic and sausage to the hot pan and cook thoroughly. Step 5: Add wine and cook a few minutes longer, adding the cayenne, salt, pepper and butter. Step 6: Stir till butter has melted. Step 7: Add enough pasta water so that you have enough sauce to coat all the pasta. Step 8: Drain pasta when cooked al dente. Step 9: Toss pasta with the sauce, adding the basil, tomatoes and mozzarella. Step 10: Serve with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, egg, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, vegetable oil, linguine, butter, garlic cloves, lemon juice, fresh parsley, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into bite size pieces. Step 2: Dip the chicken in the beaten egg, then into the bread crumbs, which have been mixed with the grated cheese, tsp salt, and tsp pepper. Step 3: Spread the coated chicken pieces on a rack or a platter This can be done several hours ahead and refrigerated. Step 4: Heat cup oil in large skillet. Step 5: Add 1 / 3 chicken pieces Saut until golden brown. Step 6: Remove chicken with a slotted spoon, and repeat with remaining chicken. Step 7: Discard oil from skillet, and wipe clean, cook the pasta.

Dish Name: Chicken Spinach Mushroom Cheese Lasagna Casserole
Ingredient Names: frozen chopped spinach, butter, skinless chicken breasts, onion, mushrooms, cream of mushroom soup, cream cheese, sour cream, pepper, salt, cheddar cheese, no-boil lasagna noodles, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Drain spinach well, pressing between paper towels. Step 3: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and mushrooms, and onion Saut 10 minutes or until chicken is done and mushrooms are tender, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in cream cheese, spinach, soup, and remaining ingredients, fold in cheese. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 4 of chicken mixture in a lightly greased 8- x 8-inch baking dish. Step 7: Arrange 2 noodles on top of mixture. Step 8: Repeat layers twice.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, white mushroom, onion, garlic cloves, fresh thyme, dry white wine, flour, whole milk, chicken broth, heavy cream, ground nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 Use 1 tablespoon of the butter to grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. Step 2: In a large, nonstick frying pan, melt 1 tablespoon of the butter and the oil. Step 3: Sprinkle the chicken with 1 / 2 teaspoon each of salt and pepper. Step 4: Add the chicken to the pan and cook until pale golden. Step 5: Transfer the chicken to a plate to cool slightly. Step 6: In a large bowl, shred the chicken into bite size pieces. Step 7: Add the mushrooms to the same frying pan. Step 8: Saute until the liquid evaporates and the mushrooms become pale golden, about 12 minutes. Step 9: Transfer the mushroom mixture to the bowl with the chicken.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat spaghetti, cooked chicken, fat-free cream of mushroom soup, garlic, fat-free parmesan cheese, mushrooms, nonfat sour cream, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook spaghetti and drain. Step 3: Combine pasta, chicken, soup, cheese, garlic and mushrooms, mix well. Step 4: Stir in sour cream Spray a baking dish with nonstick spray. Step 5: Pour mixture into dish and bake for 30 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle with additional parmesan cheese before serving, if desired.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, garlic, red wine, farfalle, skinless chicken breasts, skinless chicken thighs, olive oil, dried basil, ground nutmeg, ground black pepper, large eggs, heavy cream, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned but not crispy, 8 to. Step 2: Drain on paper towels, then transfer to a bowl. Step 3: Add onion to the drippings and saute over medium heat for 2 to. Step 4: Add garlic and saute until onion is tender, 3 to more. Step 5: Pour in wine and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until wine evaporates. Step 6: Add mixture to the bacon. Step 7: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 8: Cook bow-tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to. Step 9: Meanwhile, coat chicken in just enough oil to moisten. Step 10: Place in the same skillet that was used for the bacon. Step 11: Heat over medium heat and cook, sprinkling chicken with 1/2 of the basil, a pinch of nutmeg, and pepper, until browned, 5 to. Step 12: Turn chicken and repeat seasoning on the other side. Step 13: Continue to cook until no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, 5 to more. Step 14: Stir bacon mixture into the chicken and keep warm until pasta is done. Step 15: Combine eggs, cream, Parmesan cheese, and remaining nutmeg in a jar or shaker. Step 16: Cover and shake until well combined. Step 17: Drain pasta and set aside in a bowl. Step 18: Dump chicken mixture and all drippings into the pasta pot, away from the heat. Step 19: Add pasta and toss well. Step 20: All at once, pour egg mixture into the pot, tossing quickly and thoroughly to cook, but not curdle, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, tomato paste, water, pasta, chickpeas, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Add olive oil to a small sauce pan over medium high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and crushed red peppers and cook until slightly golden and fragrant. Step 3: Add tomato paste and water. Step 4: Simmer, uncovered, for 1 / 2 hour. Step 5: Add more water, if necessary. Step 6: Stir frequently to be sure it doesn't burn. Step 7: Cook pasta according to directions, drain but reserve one cup of cooked pasta water). Step 8: Add the sauce and drained chickpeas to the pasta and add the reserved cooking water slowly until you reach your desired consistency. Step 9: Serve with fresh grated parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: spinach rotini pasta, chickpeas, fresh carrot, celery, red bell peppers, green onions tops, balsamic vinegar, mayonnaise, prepared grain mustard, salt, fresh black pepper, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in boiling water until firm-tender drain, and rinse under cold water until cool; drain again well. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine the cooked pasta, chick-peas, carrot, bell pepper and green onions. Step 3: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, mayo, mustard, black pepper, salt and Italian seasoning until well blended (adding more spices to taste); pour over the salad; toss to coat evenly. Step 4: Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavors.

Ingredient Names: ditalini, milk, butter, parmesan cheese, minced garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the ditalini until al dente according to the box directions Warm the milk in the microwave for 20 seconds Mix all the ingrediants and serve.

Ingredient Names: linguine pasta, sugar snap peas, olive oil, garlic clove, red chili, king prawns, cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, lettuce leaves, bread, fromage frais, lime, caster sugar, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the dressing ingredients in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper, set aside. Step 2: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Step 3: Add the sugar snap peas for the last minute or so of cooking time. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan, toss in the garlic and chilli and cook over a fairly gentle heat for about 30 seconds without letting the garlic brown. Step 5: Tip in the prawns and cook over a high heat, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes until they turn pink. Step 6: Add the tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes until they just start to soften. Step 7: Drain the pasta and sugar snaps well, then toss into the prawn mixture. Step 8: Tear in the basil leaves, stir, and season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Serve with salad leaves drizzled with the lime dressing, and warm crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, eggs, rum extract, almond extract, pure vanilla extract, maraschino cherry juice, maraschino cherry, pecans, cocoa, chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients together. Step 2: Make into a 1 / 2 inch thick loaf on a wax paper. Step 3: Place wax paper on a cookie sheet. Step 4: Bake for 45 minutes on 300f. Step 5: Cut loaf into pieces. Step 6: Bake 12 minutes on each flat side. Step 7: Brush top of biscotti with extra almond flavoring, serve.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, romaine lettuce, fresh basil, fresh tomato, cucumber, salami, feta cheese, olive oil, red wine vinegar, mixed italian herbs, sugar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook shells in plenty of boiling water according to package directions, being careful not to overcook them. Step 2: Rinse in cold water, set aside. Step 3: Chop all salad ingredients, making sure you have all the pieces quite small so that you can easily stuff the salad into the shells, make dressing. Step 4: Pour over salad and toss lightly. Step 5: Add salt and pepper if desired. Step 6: Stuff salad into cooled shells. Step 7: Refrigerate up to 4 hours before serving Advance preparation.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, carrots, onion, celery rib, salt, red wine, marinara sauce, diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic, penne pasta, frozen peas, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, cook beef, carrots, onion, celery and salt, stirring occasionally, until browned, 6-7 minutes If desired add wine, cook 1 minute. Step 2: Stir in sauce and tomatoes, cover. Step 3: Bring to boil Over low heat, cook 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Step 5: Stir peas into sauce. Step 6: Cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pork sausage, garlic, white wine, tomato puree, tomatoes, rigatoni, fresh basil leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a heavy-based pan (preferably not non-stick) and add the sausages. Fry for about 8 mins until golden and cooked through. Tip in the garlic and fry for 1 min. Pour in the white wine and boil until it has reduced by half. Step 2: Stir in the tomato purée and tomatoes, and season to taste. Simmer for 15 mins until the sauce is rich and thick. Step 3: While the sauce cooks, boil the pasta according to pack instructions and drain. Stir in the basil if using, and cooked pasta into the sauce, then serve in bowls with grated or shaved Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, water, bread flour, milk, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Make sponge: stir together, warm water and yeast. Step 2: Let stand 5 minutes, until creamy. Step 3: Transfer yeast mixture to another bowl and add room-temp water and flour. Step 4: Stir for 4 minutes. Step 5: Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Step 6: Let stand at cool room temp at least 12 hours and up to 1 day. Step 7: Make bread: stir together yeast and milk in small bowl and let stand 5 minutes, until creamy In bowl of standing electric mixer, with dough hook, blend together milk mixture, sponge, water, oil and flour at low speed until flour is moistened. Step 8: Beat on medium for 3 minutes. Step 9: Add salt and beat for 4 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: water, chicken broth, heavy cream, cilantro, butter, shrimp, onion, garlic clove, arborio rice, tomatoes, parmesan cheese, green onion, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water and broth in 2 quart saucepan over medium heat until it comes to a simmer. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine cream and cilantro in small saucepan. Step 4: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until mixture is reduced in half, about 20 to 30 minutes. Step 5: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large saucepan over medium high heat, add shrimp. Step 6: Cook until pink, about 2 to 3 minutes Do not overcook. Step 7: Remove from saucepan, keep warm.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, lemons, olive oil, fresh basil, grape tomatoes, sea salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Grill chicken or sautee in olive oil until done while chicken is cooking, squeeze juice from citrus into bowl, add cut tomatoes, and other ingerdients. Step 2: Stir, let sit while chicken cooks. Step 3: Cook pasta, or use no pasta-- this dish tastes great alone! Step 4: Cut chicken up when it is cooked Toss all together, and eat.

Ingredient Names: lemon, orange, heavy cream, half-and-half, cognac, salt & pepper, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Zest the lemon and orange. Step 2: Add cream, zests and half and half to skillet and reduce about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add cognac In boiling salted water cook linguine until al dente. Step 4: Add drained pasta to sauce, add cheese and cook until sauce thickens, 1 minute.

Dish Name: Classic Bolognese Sauce A K A Ragu
Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, onions, garlic, celery ribs, carrot, lean ground beef, salt, dry red wine, milk, nutmeg, dried oregano, fresh ground pepper, italian tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In order to prevent the ragu from reducing too quickly, use the heaviest, deepest pot that you own. Step 2: Melt butter& oil and saute onion& garlic over medium heat until just translucent. Step 3: Add celery& carrot and cook gently for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the ground beef, crumbling it in the pot with a fork, stir in salt. Step 5: Cook only until the meat loses its raw, red colour. Step 6: Add the wine, turn heat up to medium high and cook, stirring occasionally, until all the wine evaporates. Step 7: Turn the heat down to medium, add the milk& nutmeg and cook, stirring frequently, until all the milk evaporates. Step 8: Add oregano, pepper& tomatoes and stir thoroughly. Step 9: When the tomatoes have started to boil, turn the heat down until the sauce cooks at the laziest simmer- just the occasional bubble.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine, boiling water, salt, heavy cream, butter, fresh ground black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in salted water according to package directions, approx 10-15 minutes. Step 2: Drain well and place in a container large enough to allow enough room to toss slippery noodles without accident. Step 3: Place over low heat or sterno. Step 4: Add butter in several hunks to the noodles and stir gently until it melts and coats them well. Step 5: Add the cream and stir in a generous amount of black pepper. Step 6: Add the cheese, saving a small amount for later use on top of portions. Step 7: Stir as mixture thickens and clings to noodles. Step 8: Serve immediately Pass the remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, artichoke hearts, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, provolone cheese, carrot, red onion, pitted black olives, salami, extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar, dry mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all salad ingredients in a serving bowl. Step 2: Whisk first 6 dressing ingredients together. Step 3: Add basil to dressing. Step 4: Pour over pasta and toss to coat, season to taste. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Step 6: Toss again before serving.

Dish Name: Classic Risotto Plus Tips For Perfect Risotto
Ingredient Names: water, chicken broth, butter, onion, arborio rice, dry white wine, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, sun-dried tomato, salt, white pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water and broth in 2-quart saucepan over medium heat until it comes to a simmer. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, melt 2 tbsp butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and cook until soft. Step 5: Add rice and stir for 2 to 3 minutes, add wine. Step 6: Stir until absorbed Increase heat to medium-high. Step 7: Stir in 1 cup water-broth mixture. Step 8: Cook uncovered, stirring frequently, until liquid is absorbed.

Ingredient Names: pancetta, fresh ground black pepper, eggs, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, penne pasta, fresh parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large saut pan, until hot. Step 2: Add pancetta and saut until golden brown and crispy, about 5 minutes, remove pan from heat. Step 3: In a medium bowl, beat the eggs and cream. Step 4: Season with pepper. Step 5: Stir in 1 cup of parmesan, reserving cup for garnish. Step 6: In a large pot, boil 6 quarts of salted boiling water. Step 7: Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 8: Drain pasta in a colander Do not rinse with water You want to retain the pasta's natural starches so that the sauce will stick.

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, turkey sausage, dried onion flakes, garlic cloves, salt, black pepper, spaghetti sauce, italian seasoning, cooking spray, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Cook pasta according to package directions, but stop short by 2 minutes. Step 3: Drain the pasta, and run under cold water to stop cooking, set aside Crumble and cook sausage, onion, and garlic in skillet until browned, stirring frequently. Step 4: Add the salt, pepper, and spaghetti sauce, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce to a simmer, cover and let cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Combine cooked pasta, sauce and seasoning. Step 7: Place half of the mixture in a casserole coated with cooking spray. Step 8: Top with half of mozzarella and half of parmesan, repeat layers.

Dish Name: Cooking with kids: Spaghetti & meatballs with hidden veg sauce
Ingredient Names: pork sausage, lean ground beef, onions, fresh carrot, oregano, parmesan, eggs, olive oil, zucchini, garlic, tomato puree, sugar, red wine vinegar, tomato, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Children: Squeeze all the sausage meat out of the sausage skins into a large bowl and add the mince. Tip all the rest of the meatball ingredients, except the olive oil, into the bowl and season with black pepper then squish everything together through your hands until completely mixed. Keep an eye on younger children to make sure they don’t taste any of the raw mix. Step 2: Children: Roll the meatball mix into walnut-sized balls and place them on a plate – this is a job children as young as 2 can help with and a great job to help teach older children basic division. Step 3: Grown ups: While the children are rolling the meatballs make the sauce. Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Add the courgette and garlic and cook for 5 mins until soft and mushy. Stir in the tomato puree, sugar and vinegar leave for 1 min then tip in the tomatoes and simmer for 5 mins. If your children like courgettes then you can leave the sauce chunky. But if, like mine, they hate courgettes then blitz the sauce with a hand blender – either way continue to simmer sauce gently while you cook the meatballs. If your child is confident with heat, from 7+ they can cook the sauce with supervision. Step 4: Grown ups: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and, working in batches, brown the meatballs on all sides then pop them into the sauce – continue to simmer the sauce for 15 mins, stirring very gently until the meatballs are cooked through. Serve with cooked spaghetti, extra grated Parmesan and a few torn basil leaves your child has picked and torn.

Dish Name: Courgette & basil pasta with pesto crumbs
Ingredient Names: penne, zucchini, olive oil, garlic, onions, creme fraiche, parmesan, basil reserve leaves for garnishing, chunk ciabatta, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Slightly undercook the pasta, then drain, reserving a ladleful of cooking water. Rinse the pasta with cold water to cool. Drain again, toss in a little oil to stop it sticking together and set aside while you get the rest of the bake ready. Step 2: Fry the courgettes in oil for about 10 mins to drive off most of the liquid; they should reduce down a lot. Add the garlic and onion to the pan, cook for 2 mins more, then season really well and add to the pasta. Stir in most of the crème fraîche and half the Parmesan with seasoning, then tip into an ovenproof dish. Dollop the rest of the crème fraîche over the top. Step 3: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Whizz nearly all of the basil, remaining cheese, bread and pine nuts together to make pesto crumbs, then scatter all over the top. Finish with a few more pine nuts. Bake for 20 mins until the topping is crisp and bubbling at the edges. Serve with a few more basil leaves scattered over.

Ingredient Names: linguine, zucchini, olive oil, garlic, unwaxed lemon, chilies, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the linguine following the pack instructions, then drain quickly so some cooking water is still clinging to the strands. Step 2: Tip back into the cooking pan with the grated courgettes, olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, chillies and most of the basil. Season generously, then use tongs to toss everything together. Scatter with remaining basil leaves and add an extra drizzle of oil, if you like.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, zucchini, garlic, pasta shapes, basil most, lemons, parmesan, pine nuts, ricotta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the shallot and courgettes for 8 mins until softened. When they are just beginning to colour, add the garlic and cook for 2 mins more. Step 2: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Drain, reserving a little of the water. Tip the pasta into the courgette pan with the basil, lemon zest, Parmesan and pine nuts. Season, dot over the ricotta and mix gently so that you don’t break it up too much. Serve sprinkled with extra Parmesan, if you like.

Dish Name: Courgette Zucchini Pasta With Chili Garlic Parmesan
Ingredient Names: courgettes, garlic cloves, red chilies, parmesan cheese, penne pasta, butter, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan of salted water, put the pasta on to boil. Step 2: Grate the courgettes / zucchini, chop or mince the garlic, finely chop the chilli and grate the parmesan. Step 3: Melt the teaspoon of butter in a large frying pan and add the garlic. Step 4: Cook for a couple of minutes and then add the chilli and courgette / zucchini. Step 5: Leave to cook for 10-15mins stirring occasionally Nb You want to cook everything but not really brown any of it off. Step 6: Remove from the heat and stir in the parmesan. Step 7: When the pasta is cooked to your liking, drain well and stir through a tablespoon of olive oil if desired Plate up the pasta and serve with the courgette / zucchini mixture on top.

Ingredient Names: orecchiette pasta, blanched almonds, garlic, fresh basil, olive oil, rounded parmesan, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling salted water according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, finely chop the almonds, chop the courgette into small chunks, crush the garlic and strip the basil leaves from the stalks. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the courgette for 2-3 mins until starting to soften, then throw in the garlic and half the basil and cook for 1 min more. Step 2: Drain the pasta and add to the courgettes, along with the almonds, the rest of the basil, the Parmesan, salt, pepper and lemon juice. Toss everything together and serve with extra Parmesan on the side.

Ingredient Names: garlic, lemons, parsley, fresh broccoli, pasta bows, olive oil, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: To make the gremolata, mix the garlic, lemon zest and juice with the parsley and some seasoning. Step 2: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, add the broccoli and cook for 2-3 mins until just tender. Use a slotted spoon to remove, then set aside. Bring the water back to the boil, add the pasta and cook following pack instructions. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan, add the courgettes and cook over a high heat for 3-4 mins until starting to turn golden, tip in the broccoli and continue to cook for 1 min until warmed through. Step 4: Drain the pasta, reserving about 2 tbsp of the cooking water, then add pasta and cooking water to the pan with the vegetables and the gremolata. Mix well and serve.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, sausage, garlic cloves, fresh tomatoes, basil, chicken broth, couscous, feta cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan over medium high heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook until it softens, about 4-5 minutes. Step 3: Add the crumbled sausage and cook until it is mostly browned, about 7-9 minutes. Step 4: Add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium. Step 6: Add the tomato and basil and cook until tomato softens, about 3 to 4 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat and set aside Quick now, cook the couscous: bring broth to a boil, add couscous. Step 8: Remove from heat and let stand for 2 minutes. Step 9: Stir and fluff with a fork.

Dish Name: Crabzilla's Spicy Chunky Garlicky Spaghetti Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, fresh mushrooms, dried basil, oregano, black pepper, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, crushed tomatoes, whole canned tomatoes, tomatoes and green chilies, tomato paste, dry red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large, deep pot. Step 2: Saute onion, garlic, and mushrooms until soft and slightly browned. Step 3: Add basil, oregano, black pepper, salt, and crushed red pepper flakes. Step 4: Saute for an additional 10 minutes, stirring frequently, being careful not to burn the herbs. Step 5: Add all the canned tomatoes, tomato paste, stir real well, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Boil for about 10 minutes and use a potato masher to crush the whole tomatoes. Step 7: Add red wine and continue to boil for another 2 minutes. Step 8: Turn down to a low simmer, and simmer for at least 6 hours, stirring now and then I usually put a lid on to partially cover the pot for the first 3 hours and then remove it for the last 3 hours to let the sauce reduce, it should end up a nice deep, rich red color. Step 9: Serve over your favorite pasta and fix up a nice green salad and crusty loaf of bread to make a complete meal.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, yeast, salt, warm water, vegetable oil, margarine, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yeast into warm water In separate bowl, combine flour and salt. Step 2: Add the oil to the water, and add these liquids to the dry ingredients. Step 3: Knead for 7 or 8 minutes, then let rest for about 10. Step 4: Keep it under a cloth while resting, in a warm place While it's resting you can make the garlic sauce. Step 5: Melt the margarine, and mix in the rest of the ingredients, put to the side. Step 6: Roll dough out into a rectangle shape. Step 7: Cut into strips of desired length, and brush on garlic sauce.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, whole wheat pasta, low-fat sour cream, reduced-fat cream cheese, egg, spaghetti sauce, onion, garlic, italian cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Cook pasta according to directions on the box, set aside Brown the ground beef, onion, and garlic until cooked through. Step 3: In a bowl, combine 8 ounces softened cream cheese, 1 cup sour cream, and one egg, blend thoroughly. Step 4: Add spaghetti sauce to the cheese mixture, blend thoroughly. Step 5: Add one cup shredded italian cheese, mix together. Step 6: In a casserole dish, combine 13.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, pancetta, olive oil, garlic, eggs, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. Meanwhile, fry pancetta in oil in a frying pan for a few mins until golden and crisp. Add garlic, fry for 1 min, then turn off the heat. Briefly whisk egg and yolks with most of the parmesan and some seasoning. Step 2: Drain pasta, reserving a little of the cooking water. Add eggs and a tbsp of cooking water, then mix until pasta is coated and creamy. The heat from the pasta will gently cook the sauce. Stir in the pancetta and garlic then serve, topped with the remaining parmesan.

Ingredient Names: macaroni, velveeta cheese, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs, half-and-half, butter, flour, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil noodles until done. Step 2: While noodles are cooking, grease a rectangular glass casserole dish. Step 3: After noodles are drained and have cooled for a few minutes, put them in casserole dish and mix with beaten egg, set aside. Step 4: In a medium saucepan, melt butter on medium-low heat and add flour to make a paste. Step 5: Add half and half and bring to a boil on medium-high heat. Step 6: Reduce heat and add velveeta and cream cheese in small chunks. Step 7: Stir and add seasonings (last four ingredients). Step 8: After all the cheese is melted and the sauce has a medium thick consistency (you may need to play around with the half and half or milk to get the consistency you prefer), pour it over the noodles. Step 9: Stir noodles with sauce until they are combined. Step 10: Sprinkle parmesan over the top. Step 11: Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 30-45 minutes (I wait until it's a little browned).

Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, butter, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine 4 cups of water, cornmeal, butter, salt and pepper in a 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish. Step 3: Bake uncovered, on the top shelf of the oven for 40 minute. Step 4: Remove the polenta from the oven, give it a stir, and bake for another 10 minute. Step 5: Remove it from the oven again and this time stir in the provolone and salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Let it stand for 5 min before serving. Step 7: Serve topped with the parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, olive oil, garlic, fresh broccoli, parmesan cheese, half-and-half, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350°. Step 2: Cook penne in boiling salted water until al dente. Step 3: Drain pasta and place in large bowl. Step 4: Heat olive oil over medium heat and saute garlic for about 1 minute. Step 5: Combine garlic, broccoli, Parmesan cheese and cream with penne. Step 6: Spoon mixture into a large baking dish and top with mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Bake, covered for 20 to 30 minutes. Step 8: Note: Can be made up until baking point and refrigerated until dinner time.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, broccoli, milk, parmesan cheese, butter, spaghetti, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta el dente Boil broccoli el dente Puree broccoli, chicken broth, butter, cheese and milk Toss with pasta Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, garlic, condensed cream of chicken soup, condensed cream of mushroom soup, evaporated milk, dried thyme leaves, dried parsley flakes, cooked chicken, cooked spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon until crisp at medium heat in large skillet. Step 2: Drain bacon on paper towel. Step 3: Remove all but 1 tbsp fat from skillet. Step 4: Add onion and garlic to skillet. Step 5: Stir fry until onions are translucent- about 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in mixture of soups, milk, parsley and thyme, stir in chicken. Step 7: Bring to a boil, stirring often, stir in bacon. Step 8: Reduce heat to low.

Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, butter, onion, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese, light cream, fresh parsley, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the orzo according to the package directions, drain well. Step 2: In a large skillet melt the butter over medium heat. Step 3: Add in the onion and saute until just softened. Step 4: Add in fresh garlic and chili flakes the last 2 minutes of cooking. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low and add in the cooked orzo, parmesan cheese, milk or cream, parsley and salt. Step 6: Toss to heat through. Step 7: Season with fresh ground black pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Creamy Garlic Pasta With Mushrooms And Prosciutto
Ingredient Names: low sodium chicken broth, whipping cream, garlic cloves, dry crushed red pepper, parmesan cheese, butter, cremini mushrooms, penne, frozen green peas, prosciutto
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth, cream, garlic, and crushed red pepper to boil in medium saucepan. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer until liquid is reduced to 3 / 4 cup, about 20 minutes, remove from heat. Step 3: Mix in 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese. Step 4: Cover and keep warm. Step 5: Melt butter in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add mushrooms. Step 6: Saute until brown and tender, about 8 minutes, remove from heat. Step 7: Meanwhile, cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite.

Dish Name: Creamy Goat Cheese And Asparagus Farfalle
Ingredient Names: farfalle pasta, olive oil, red onion, asparagus spear, crushed red pepper flakes, lemon juice, lemon peel, goat cheese, chives, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot of boiling water, blanch asparagus for 2 minutes. Step 2: Drain, rince with cold water and set aside In another large pot, cook pasta as directed, drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a deep skillet, heat olive oil. Step 4: Add onion and cook until softened. Step 5: Add asparagus and red pepper flakes to onion in pan and saute for 4 minutes. Step 6: Add pasta, lemon juice, and lemon peel to skillet and mix well. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 8: Add goat cheese and chives and toss to combine well.

Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, cremini mushroom, half-and-half, canned peas, parmesan cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add the orzo and cook until tender but still al dente, stirring often, about 8 minutes. Step 3: Drain, saving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat oil in large frying pan over medium heat. Step 5: Add onion, mushrooms and garlic, and saute until tender, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the half and half and peas. Step 7: Add the orzo and toss to coat. Step 8: Remove pan from heat. Step 9: Add parmesan to pasta mixture. Step 10: Stir pasta mixture until the sauce coats the pasta thickly, adding enough reserved cooking liquid to maintain a creamy consistency.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, rice, asparagus, chicken broth, cream cheese spread, lemon peel, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium heat, add onion. Step 2: Cook and stir 2 minute or until tender. Step 3: Stir in rice, asparagus and broth, bring to boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, simmer 5 minute. Step 5: Add cream cheese spread, lemon peel and juice. Step 6: Stir until well blended.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, heavy cream, lemon, fresh fettuccine, parmesan cheese, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large covered pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a small skillet or saucepan on low heat, melt the butter. Step 3: Stir in the cream and heat gently. Step 4: Stir in the lemon juice and zest, turn off the heat. Step 5: When the water boils, cook the pasta until al dente Reserve 1 cup of the hot pasta-cooking water and drain the pasta. Step 6: Place the hot drained pasta in a large serving bowl, add the lemon cream sauce, and toss If the sauce is too thick, add some or all of the reserved hot pasta water. Step 7: Toss in the grated parmesan.

Ingredient Names: fresh fettuccine, unsalted butter, olive oil, mushrooms, garlic, white wine, chicken broth stock, cream, parmesan, salt, pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in salted water for 1 minute less than time per packet (start this mid mushroom cook). Just before draining, scoop out 1 cup cooking water, then drain. Step 2: Melt butter and heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Step 3: Add mushrooms and cook, stirring regularly. When they start to sweat, add a pinch of salt and pepper. Step 4: When pretty golden (about 4 - 5 minutes), add garlic and cook until garlic is golden and mushroom is golden. Step 5: Stand back and add wine (it will be steamy!!), stir, scraping the bottom of the skillet. Simmer rapidly until wine is mostly evaporated and winey smell is gone. Step 6: Add broth, cream, parmesan, salt and pepper. Stir to dissolve parmesan and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring regularly. Step 7: Transfer pasta into sauce, toss for 1 - 2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats pasta. If sauce gets too thick, add a splash of reserved pasta cooking water. Step 8: Garnish with parsley and serve immediately with extra parmesan!

Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, parmesan cheese, eggs, heavy cream, salt, pepper, spinach, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Cook orzo according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Mix parmesan, beaten egg and cream and add to hot orzo. Step 3: The heat will cook the egg mixture. Step 4: Heat oil in skillet, add garlic, sauté until soft. Step 5: Add spinach in batches until wilted. Step 6: Season with red pepper, salt, pepper, stirring. Step 7: Drizzle with a drop of balsamic. Step 8: Top orzo with spinach, serve with additional parmesan if desired.

Ingredient Names: fat-free half-and-half, fat free cream cheese, margarine, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half and half, cream cheese, margarine, parmigiano-reggiano cheese and pepper in a saucepan, stirring constantly Cook over medium heat until smooth.

Ingredient Names: salt, fettuccine pasta, heavy cream, lemon, flat leaf parsley, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, pistachio nut, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, salt it, add the pasta and cook until al dente. Step 2: Drain While the pasta is working, in a small saucepan, warm the cream and lemon peel over medium heat. Step 3: Using a food processor, puree the parsley, cheese, nuts and garlic. Step 4: Mix in the lemon juice With the machine on, blend in the olive oil until combined. Step 5: Place the pesto in a large pasta bowl. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Stir in the hot cream mixture, add the pasta and toss.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage link, olive oil, garlic, canned tomato sauce, heavy cream, salt and pepper, parsley, pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Take sausage out of casings and crumble. Step 2: Put olive oil and chopped garlic in a skillet and turn the heat to medium. Step 3: When the garlic becomes pale gold, add the sausage. Step 4: Turn from time to time, until nicely browned all over, about 15 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomato and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, adjusting the heat if necessary so it will cook at a gentle simmer. Step 6: After about 20 minutes, when the fat separates from the other juices and floats free, add the cream and turn up the heat. Step 7: Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until the cream is reduced. Step 8: Add salt and a liberal grinding of pepper. Step 9: Turn off the heat and stir in the chopped parsley. Step 10: Cook pasta in pot of boiling salted water.

Dish Name: Creamy Pasta Tomato With Italian Sausage
Ingredient Names: italian sweet sausage, kraft macaroni and cheese, water, chicken broth, juice, tomato soup, tomatoes, evaporated milk, margarine, garlic powder, onion powder, italian seasoning, italian cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in skillet, drain and set aside. Step 2: In a large sauce pan, mix chicken broth and water, bring to a boil. Step 3: Add 2 tablespoons of margarine, macaroni and cook 6 to 8 minutes or until pasta is firm but not hard. Step 4: Drain pasta and set aside In large sauce pan melt 2 tablespoons of margarine. Step 5: Add evaporated milk and cheese package and mix well. Step 6: Add v8, dice tomatoes, tomato soup and spices mix well. Step 7: Add macaroni and meat to sauce mixture and cook for 5 minutes, sauce will slightly thicken. Step 8: Top with additional cheese if you like and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, butter, extra virgin olive oil, all-purpose flour, fresh garlic, salt, dried basil, crushed red pepper flakes, half-and-half, chicken broth, water, parmesan cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, melt butter. Step 3: Stir in the oil, flour, garlic and seasonings until blended Gradually add the half and half, broth and water, bring to a boil. Step 4: Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until slightly thickened, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in cheese and sour cream. Step 6: Drain pasta and toss with the sauce.

Dish Name: Creamy Penne Pasta With Ham And Peas
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, peas, ham, milk, flour, butter, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, fresh pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large pot of water to boil and add pasta, cooking to al dente. Step 2: Add peas last 2-3 minutes to pasta Scoop out 1 cup pasta water, then drain, and place in a large serving dish. Step 3: Whisk flour into milk till mixed well In skillet, pour olive oil in and add ham, cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until ham is crispy. Step 4: Remove to paper towel to drain In sauce pan, melt butter and saute garlic over medium low for about 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Whisk in milk / flour mixture and add chipped cream cheese, whisking till melted into sauce smoothly. Step 6: Add parmesan cheese and whisk till incorporated In large dish with pasta and peas, toss in crispy ham, and any other vegetables you want.

Ingredient Names: frozen cheese tortellini, zucchini, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, fat-free half-and-half, pesto sauce, ham
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water until al dente For the last 2 minutes of cooking, add zucchini and peppers, drain in colander. Step 2: Add half-and-half, pesto, and ham to pot. Step 3: Heat over medium-high heat for 3 minutes. Step 4: Return pasta and vegetables to pot. Step 5: Toss with sauce to coat, remove from heat. Step 6: Let stand for 10 minutes to thicken slightly before serving.

Dish Name: Creamy Pink Vodka Sauce With Penne
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, virgin olive oil, onions, garlic, tomatoes, pepper flakes, vodka, salt, pepper, parsley, heavy cream, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put the olive oil into the pan and add the onions and garlic. Step 2: Turn on the heat to medium-low and gently cook for a few minutes. Step 3: Add the red pepper flakes cook 1 minute add crushed tomatoes. Step 4: Raise the heat to medium and bring the mixture to a boil. Step 5: Add the vodka and a pinch of salt and pepper simmer uncovered for about 8 minutes over medium-low heat. Step 6: Add the cream and lower the heat, add drained pasta and toss in parsley. Step 7: Stir to coat well and grate a generous amount of parmesan into the pasta using our microplane grater. Step 8: Serve immediately sprinkled with more parmesan, and red pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, nonfat milk, cornmeal, shredded cheddar cheese, cream cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pour chicken stock, fat free milk and coarse ground corn into a cold pot. Step 2: Turn burner on medium / medium-high. Step 3: Bring contents of pot to a simmer. Step 4: Simmer until contents are no longer "wet" - corn has absorbed most of the liquid. Step 5: Turn burner off and add cheddar cheese, cream cheese, salt and pepper, whisk to combine, serve warm.

Dish Name: Creamy Polenta Soup With Spinach Paparot
Ingredient Names: polenta, all-purpose flour, hot chicken broth, garlic cloves, butter, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, spinach leaves, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: 1 First, whisk the polenta and flour in a saucepan 2 Starting with 1 cup of broth, whisk the broth and polenta-flour mixture and remove any lumps. Step 2: Add the butter and salt and stir 3 Continue adding broth while whisking and place on medium-high heat to bring to a boil. Step 3: Lower to medium heat and simmer soup for 25 minutes, stir gently 4.

Ingredient Names: ravioli, italian stewed tomatoes, sun-dried tomato, cream, pesto sauce, dijon mustard, gouda cheese, feta, fresh parsley, red chili pepper flakes, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook ravioli according to package directions. Step 2: Drain In medium sauce pan, add next four ingredients. Step 3: Cook over medium heat until bubbly Continue cooking until liquid is reduced and starts to thicken. Step 4: Add next four ingredients. Step 5: Cook until heated through and cheese is melted, fold in ravioli, heat through. Step 6: Stir in pinenuts and season with salt and pepper, to taste.

Ingredient Names: water, chicken broth, butter, onion, arborio rice, dry white wine, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water and broth in 2-quart saucepan over medium heat until it comes to a simmer. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, melt 2 tablespoons butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and cook until soft. Step 5: Add rice and stir 2 to 3 minutes, add wine. Step 6: Stir until absorbed Increase heat to medium-high. Step 7: Stir in 1 cup water-broth mixture. Step 8: Cook uncovered, stirring frequently, until liquid is absorbed.

Ingredient Names: sweet bulk sausage, onion, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, italian-style stewed tomatoes, half-and-half, rotini pasta, fresh basil, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy large skillet, cook the sausage, onion, garlic, and red pepper over medium heat until sausage is cooked through, stirring to break up pieces of sausage. Step 2: Drain off excess fat. Step 3: Stir in undrained tomatoes. Step 4: Boil gently, uncovered, for 5 to 7 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated. Step 5: Add half-and-half or light cream. Step 6: Simmer 4 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly. Step 7: Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 8: Return to saucepan. Step 9: Add sauce to pasta.

Ingredient Names: milk, whipping cream, tiny pasta, eggs, parmesan cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy-bottomed saucepan bring the milk and whipping cream to a boil. Step 2: Add in the tiny pasta and cook over med-low heat, stirring constantly until at-dente, and the milk / cream is thickened to a creamy consistancy. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the eggs, parmesan cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: broccoli florets, zucchini, red peppers, snow peas, butter, half-and-half cream, pepper, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute broccoli, zucchini, red pepper and snow peas in butter until crisp-tender. Step 2: Add half& half and black pepper. Step 3: Cook on medium heat briefly (2 to 4 minutes) until cream is slightly reduced. Step 4: Toss with pasta and sprinkle with parmesan.

Dish Name: Creamy Spaghetti And Beans Rachael Ray
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, extra virgin olive oil, butter, pancetta, garlic cloves, spaghetti, onion, carrots, fresh bay leaf, fresh thyme, roman beans, salt & freshly ground black pepper, dry white wine, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Place the stock in a sauce pot and warm it over medium heat then reduce to simmer. Step 2: Heat the extra-virgin olive oil and the butter in a large, deep skillet over medium to medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the pancetta to brown slightly Next add the garlic and spaghetti and toast the noodles lightly, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 4: Add onions and carrots, bay and thyme and season with salt and pepper Soften veggies a bit, 5 minutes. Step 5: Add wine and allow it to be completely absorbed. Step 6: Add beans then add a few ladles of stock and stir the pasta. Step 7: Keep adding stock a few ladles at a time allowing liquids to be mostly absorbed before adding more, as if you were preparing a risotto. Step 8: When liquids are absorbed and spaghetti is cooked to al dente, 12-15 minutes, stir in cheese.

Dish Name: Creamy Spaghetti With Beef And Veggies
Ingredient Names: onion, green pepper, butter, tomatoes with juice, mushrooms, olives, dried oregano, ground beef, spaghetti, cream of mushroom soup, water, shredded cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions and green peppers in butter in skillet until tender. Step 2: Add tomatoes, mushrooms, olives, oregano, and beef. Step 3: Simmer for 10 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to slow cooker, add spaghetti, mix well. Step 5: Combine soup and water. Step 6: Pour over casserole. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheeses, cover.

Ingredient Names: broccoli floret, zucchini, fresh mushrooms, carrot, olive oil, spaghetti, onion, garlic, butter, flour, chicken bouillon, thyme, milk, swiss cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In lg skillet, saute broccoli, zucchini, mushrooms, and carrots in oil until crisp-tender, set aside. Step 2: Cook spaghetti according to pkg directions In another saucepan, saute onion and garlic in butter for 30 seconds. Step 3: Stir in flour, boullion and thyme Slowly add milk, bring to a boil. Step 4: Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Step 5: Reduce heat to low, stir in cheeses, add vegetables.

Ingredient Names: frozen cheese tortellini, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, frozen spinach, tomatoes, fresh basil, salt, pepper, whipping cream, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on the package. Step 2: Drain and keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat oil in large skillet over medium heat until hot. Step 4: Add onion and garlic. Step 5: Cook until tender and lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Step 6: Add spinach, salt, and pepper. Step 7: Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Stir in the whipping cream and cheese. Step 9: Cook until the mixture just comes to a boil. Step 10: Reduce heat to low stir in cooked tortellini.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, part-skim ricotta cheese, pesto sauce, eggs, parmesan cheese, frozen chopped spinach, alfredo sauce, white wine, part-skim mozzarella cheese, italian seasoned breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375 degrees Coat 13x9-inch baking dish with cooking spray In large bowl combine ricotta, pesto, eggs and parmesan, stir in spinach. Step 3: Combine alfredo sauce with wine. Step 4: Arrange 3 noodles, overlapping slightly, in bottom of baking dish. Step 5: Top with 1 / 2 of ricotta mixture, 1 cup mozzarella and 1 / 3 of sauce. Step 6: Repeat with 3 noodles, remaining ricotta mixture, 1 cup mozzarella and 1 / 2 of the remaining sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, diced fire-roasted tomatoes, campbell's tomato soup, milk, fresh basil leaves, chicken broth, italian-style tomato paste, light cream, parmesan cheese, cheese tortellini
Instructions: Step 1: Coat soup pan with olive oil. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and saute till soft. Step 3: Add canned diced tomatoes, basil, tomato soup and two cans milk, stir till blended. Step 4: Add chicken broth and stir in tomato paste till blended. Step 5: Simmer for 20 minutes. Step 6: Add light cream and parmesan cheese. Step 7: Add tortellini and cook till tender.

Ingredient Names: plum tomato, marsala wine, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, pepper, fettuccine, fresh mushrooms, onion, olive oil, garlic cloves, cream cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, combine the first 6 ingredients. Step 2: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Step 3: Cook fettuccine according to package instructions. Step 4: In a skillet, saute mushrooms and onion in the oil until tender. Step 5: Add garlic and saute 1 minute longer. Step 6: Stir cream cheese into the tomato mixture until cream cheese is melted. Step 7: Add mushroom mixture. Step 8: Drain fettuccine, top with the sauce and parmesan cheese Penne pasta would work well also.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, baby carrots, celery ribs, ready-to-serve chicken broth, black pepper, frozen cheese tortellini, deli ham, heavy cream, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and cook to 5 minutes or until softened, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add carrots, celery, chicken broth, 6 and black pepper, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, or until carrots are tender. Step 5: Meanwhile, cook tortellini according to package directions. Step 6: Drain, transfer to a large serving bowl, and cover to keep warm. Step 7: Stir ham and cream into carrot mixture and cook over low heat until just heated through. Step 8: Pour cream mixture over tortellini, add parmesan cheese, and toss to combine.

Ingredient Names: dry penne pasta, pasta sauce, tuna in vegetable oil, cream, baby spinach leaves, basil leaves, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to packet directions. Step 2: Drain pasta and return to pot. Step 3: Add sauce, tuna, cream, spinach and basil. Step 4: Cook about 5 minutes till heated through and spinach is wilted. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Serve topped with parmesan.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomato, kraft shredded mozzarella cheese with a touch of philadelphia, kraft grated parmesan cheese, philadelphia cream cheese, milk, garlic powder, basil, lasagna noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine chicken, artichokes, tomatoes, 1 cup mozzarella and parmesan. Step 3: Beat cream cheese, milk, and garlic powder with mixer until well blended. Step 4: Stir in 2 tablespoons basil. Step 5: Mix half with the chicken mixture. Step 6: Spread half of the remaining cream cheese sauce onto bottom of 13x9-inch baking dish. Step 7: Cover with 3 noodles and 1 / 3 of the chicken mixture. Step 8: Repeat layers of noodles and chicken mixture twice. Step 9: Top with remaining cheese sauce and mozzarella, cover.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, smoked pancetta cubes, garlic, eggs, cream, grana padano
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large, deep pan of salted water to the boil. Plunge the spaghetti into the water, stir well and cook, following pack instructions. Aim for 'al dente': cooked, but retaining some bite in the middle. Take a few strands out of the water with a spaghetti spoon or tongs 1-2 mins before the end of the cooking time and bite into it. Repeat until you think it is properly cooked. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a frying pan. When hot, tip in the pancetta. Fry over a medium heat until the fat in the meat has melted down into the pan and the meat has turned lightly golden. Be careful not to crisp the pancetta too much; it will be cooked a little bit more later on in the recipe. Remove from the heat and set aside. Step 3: Crack two of the eggs into a mixing bowl. Separate the yolk from the third egg: gently crack the side of the shell and, using both hands, slowly open it into two halves over a separate bowl - you want to keep the yolk in one of the halves. Tip the yolk from one shell half to the other and repeat until all the egg white has fallen into the bowl below, taking care not to crack the yolk on any rough shell edges. Tip the yolk in with the other eggs and beat together, along with the double cream, parmesan and some seasoning. Step 4: Add the garlic to the pancetta and return the frying pan to hob. Fry over high heat for 1 min or until garlic is cooked and pancetta warmed through. Meanwhile, drain the spaghetti. Tip back into the hot saucepan off the heat. Pour egg mixture over pasta, followed by hot pancetta, garlic, any fat and oils. Toss quickly and thoroughly with spaghetti spoon or tongs. Mix until it has thickened to a smooth, creamy sauce. Serve with extra cheese and freshly ground pepper.

Ingredient Names: macaroni, sundried tomato oil, creme fraiche, tomato puree, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. Meanwhile, in a small food processor, blitz together the tomatoes, crème fraîche and tomato purée into a sauce. (If you don’t have a small processor, finely chop the tomatoes, then mix everything together.). Step 2: Drain the pasta, saving a little of the cooking water, then return to the pan with the tomato sauce and half the cheese. Mix together until all the pasta is coated, then serve as a side dish, sprinkled with the remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, zucchini, garlic, parmesan, low-fat creme fraiche, tagliatelle
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan and sizzle the pancetta or bacon for about 5 mins until starting to crisp. Turn up the heat and add the grated courgette to the pan. Cook for 5 mins or until soft and starting to brown then add the garlic and cook for a minute longer. Season and set aside. Step 2: Cook the tagliatelle according to the pack instructions and scoop out a cupful of cooking water. Drain the tagliatelle and tip into the frying pan with the bacon and courgette. Over a low heat toss everything together with the crème fraiche and half the Parmesan adding a splash of pasta water too if you need to loosen the sauce. Season to taste and serve twirled into bowls with the remaining Parmesan scattered over.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni, zucchini, half zest lemon, cheese garlic herbs, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil, then cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a frying pan, then add the courgettes. Cook for 5 mins until softened and lightly golden. Reduce the heat, then add the lemon zest. Gently cook for a further min, add the soft cheese and milk, then mix together until the cheese melts. Season to taste. Step 3: Drain the pasta and return to the pan. Add the contents of the frying pan and stir well. Serve immediately.
