Dish Name: Creamy lemon & cabbage pasta with garlic crumbs
Ingredient Names: chunky breadcrumbs, olive oil, garlic, short pasta such as twists, onions, white wine, lemons, creme fraiche, savoy cabbage very
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs with half the oil and 1 garlic clove, and season well. Spread out on a large baking tray and bake for 8 mins, until crisp and golden. Remove and set aside. Step 2: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water until al dente. Meanwhile, pour the remaining oil into a frying pan, add the onion and remaining garlic, season and cook for about 4 mins until golden, then add the wine and lemon zest. Reduce for a few mins, then add the crème fraîche. Remove from heat but keep warm. Step 3: Add the cabbage to the pasta water for the last 3 mins of cooking time. Drain and return to the pan, add the creamy sauce to the pasta and toss together. Divide between 2 bowls and top with the crumbs.

Dish Name: Creamy linguine with ham, lemon & basil
Ingredient Names: linguine, prosciutto, olive oil, lemons, egg yolks, creme fraiche, fresh basil leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the linguine. Meanwhile, tear the ham into small pieces and fry in the olive oil until golden and crisp. Step 2: Drain the pasta, reserving a little of the cooking water, then return to the pan. Tip in the cooked ham. Mix together the lemon juice, egg yolks and crème fraîche, then add this to the pan along with the basil and Parmesan. Mix in with tongs, adding a little of the cooking water, if needed, to make a creamy sauce that coats the pasta. Serve with extra Parmesan grated over the top, if you like.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, streaky bacon, chestnuts, baby spinach, gorgonzola
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, then cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, fry the bacon in a large frying pan for 5 mins, until starting to crisp. Tip in the mushrooms, then fry for 3 mins until cooked. Drain the pasta and tip into the frying pan along with the spinach and cheese. Toss everything together over a low heat until the spinach has wilted and the cheese melted.

Ingredient Names: fusilli, asparagus spear woody ends, peas, juice lemon, soft cheese chives
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following the pack instructions. Two minutes before the end of the cooking time, add the asparagus and peas. Boil everything together for the final 2 mins, then scoop out and reserve a cup of the cooking liquid from the pan before draining the pasta and veg. Step 2: Return the pasta and veg to the pan and add the lemon zest, soft cheese and seasoning. Add a squeeze of lemon juice to taste and stir in 2-3 tbsp of the cooking liquid to loosen the sauce.

Ingredient Names: penne, peas, garlic, watercress tough, mascarpone, tarragon, juice lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following packet instructions. Meanwhile, cook the peas and garlic in a separate pan of boiling salted water for 3-5 mins, until tender. Drain well, keeping some of the water. Step 2: Put the peas, garlic and watercress in a food processor with 2 tbsp of the pasta cooking water. Whizz to a very rough purée. Step 3: Return the pasta to the pan. Stir in the pea mixture, mascarpone, tarragon and lemon zest and juice. Season with salt and pepper and serve with crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, linguine, arugula, red chilies seeds, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Squeeze the sausagemeat out of the skins, breaking into grape-size chunks. Heat the oil in a frying pan. Fry the chunks for about 8 mins until crisp and golden. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta and chop most of the rocket. Add the chilli to the sausages, fry for 30 secs, then tip in the cream and chopped rocket. Season and heat until the rocket has just wilted. Step 3: Drain the pasta, reserving some of the cooking liquid, then mix the pasta through the sauce with a splash of cooking water. Top with remaining rocket.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fennel, fennel seeds, garlic, tagliatelle, lemon zest squeeze juice, mascarpone, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Add the oil to a non-stick frying pan. Tip in the fennel and cook for 10 mins until soft and slightly golden, adding the fennel seeds and garlic for the final 3 mins of cooking. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions, reserving a few tbsp of the cooking water for the sauce. Step 3: Stir the lemon zest, juice, mascarpone and most of the parsley into the fennel mixture. Heat through then toss in the cooked pasta and a few tbsp of the cooking water. Give everything a good stir and season. Scatter over the remaining parsley and serve.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, oil, salt, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare one 16 ounce package lasagna noodles as package directs. Step 2: Drain well and blot excess moisture with paper towels. Step 3: Cut each lasagna crosswise into about six 2-inch pieces In electric skillet, heat about 1-inch oil to 370 degrees. Step 4: Fry cooked lasagna until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain well on paper towels. Step 6: Sprinkle fried lasagna lightly with salt and your favorite topping or use a flavored salt.

Dish Name: Crispy Bacon And Garlic Cream Cheese Pasta
Ingredient Names: bacon, cream cheese with garlic and herbs, low-fat whipping cream, sweet peas, pasta, garlic salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in salted boling water according to packet instructions. Step 2: Grill the bacon until crisp, then chop into little pieces. Step 3: In a small pan on a low heat, mix together garlic cream cheese and cream, stirring until smooth, add garlic salt and black pepper Adding more or less for personal taste. Step 4: Add bacon and peas to sauce mix, and keep stirring on a low heat till peas are warm. Step 5: Set aside to thicken for 2 minutes, drain pasta. Step 6: Mix pasta and the sauce together, and serve.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated cheese ravioli, italian style breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, sour cream, milk, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 degrees F. Step 2: In medium bowl, combine bread crumbs and cheese. Step 3: In small bowl, combine sour cream and milk. Step 4: Dip ravioli in sour cream mixture, then in bread crumb mixture to coat evenly. Step 5: Place ravioli on nonstick baking sheet. Step 6: Bake for 12-14 minutes or until ravioli are crisp and lightly browned. Step 7: Serve immediately with pasta sauce.

Ingredient Names: flour, water, salt, yeast, sugar, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine flour, water and salt and let rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Add sugar and yeast and knead on high speed for 8 minutes until smooth and glossy. Step 3: Pour 2 t Of oil into a bowl and coat the sides. Step 4: Turn the dough into the bowl and add 1 t Of oil to the top. Step 5: Let rise for 2-2 5 hours. Step 6: Preheat oven for 1 hour at 450 degrees Pout 2 t.

Ingredient Names: beef ravioli, pasta sauce, tomato sauce, water, red peppers, italian spices, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour about half of the pasta sauce in the bottom of crock pot. Step 2: Add frozen ravioli. Step 3: Pour additional pasta sauce, tomato sauce, water, and red pepper over ravioli. Step 4: Sprinkle italian seasonings over sauces. Step 5: Sprinkle cheese on top. Step 6: Turn crock pot on low and cook for 4-5 hours.

Ingredient Names: italian turkey sausage link, onion, tomato sauce, italian seasoning, salt, fat-free ricotta cheese, low-fat parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodles
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook sausage and onion over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until sausage is no longer pink, stirring occasionally, drain. Step 2: Add tomato sauce, basil and salt, mix well. Step 3: In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, parmesan and 1 1 / 2 cups of the mozzarella cheese. Step 4: Spoon a quarter of the sausage mixture into a 3 1 / 2 to 5 quart slow cooker. Step 5: Top with noodles 3-4, broken into pieces to fit. Step 6: Top with half of the cheese mixture and 1 / 4 of the sausage mixture. Step 7: Top with 3-4 noodles, remaining cheese mixture and a quarter of the sausage mixture. Step 8: Top with remaining noodles and sausage mixture.

Dish Name: Crushed Red Pepper And Pancetta Pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, onion, crushed tomatoes, dried red pepper flakes, spaghetti, salt, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large pot of water to boiling for pasta. Step 2: Heat oil in medium skillet over medium-low heat. Step 3: Add pancetta and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Using slotted spoon, transfer pancetta to small bowl. Step 5: Add onion to skillet and cook over medium-low heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in tomatoes with liquid and red pepper flakes. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, salt boiling water, add pasta, and cook until tender but still firm to the bite. Step 9: When pasta is almost done, stir pancetta into tomato mixture and heat through, 1-2 minutes. Step 10: Drain pasta and transfer to pasta bowl.

Ingredient Names: shiitake mushroom, oyster mushroom, cremini mushroom, white button mushrooms, garlic cloves, butter, fresh ground black pepper, sea salt, onion powder, garlic powder, beef broth, olive oil, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, mixed mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: The filling. Step 2: Melt butter in pan. Step 3: Add olive oil to melted butter, add mushrooms. Step 4: Let mushrooms sweat until they release their juices. Step 5: Add pepper, salt, and onion / garlic powder. Step 6: Add 1 / 8 cup beef broth and let mixture reduce. Step 7: Once reduced, remove from heat and let cool. Step 8: Add cheeses to blender / food processor. Step 9: Add cooled mushroom mixture to cheese.

Dish Name: Dairy Free Chicken Pasta Primavera Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: oil, rice flour, pasta, olive oil mayonnaise, chicken stock, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, frozen baby peas, mixed mushrooms, organic carrots, chicken breasts, sweet paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil reserving 2 tbs. Step 2: Add rice flour and stir until bubbling and cook just 1 minute over medium-high heat Gradually add the chicken stock 1 / 4 cup at a time whisking with each addition until a sauce like consistency is reached, may or may not use all stock as amount was approximate. Step 3: Remove from heat and add helmans olive oil mayonnaise to be soy free. Step 4: Mix and return to heat whisking for 1 / 2 -1 minute. Step 5: Remove from heat and adjust seasoning with sea salt. Step 6: Heat remaining 2 tbs oil in a frying pan and brown chicken peices lightly adding sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Step 7: Add frozen peas to chicken and cook a minute or 2 until no longer frozen. Step 8: Steam carrots and mushrooms individually in salted water until cooked to desired tenderness, mix all together.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, mild italian sausage, onion, spaghetti sauce, no-salt-added tomato sauce, no-boil lasagna noodles, alfredo sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, diced tomato, mixed mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat over med-high heat with onion until thoroughly cooked, stirring frequently. Step 2: Season with a little salt and pepper. Step 3: Drain well Spray 4-5 quart crockpot with non-stick cooking spray. Step 4: Spread 3 / 4 cup of spaghetti sauce in bottom of crockpot with diced tomato. Step 5: Stir remaining spaghetti sauce, mushrooms, add no-salt tomato sauce into ground beef Lay out one layer of lasagna noodles evenly over sauce in crockpot, breaking noodles as necessary. Step 6: Top with 1 / 3 of the alfredo sauce, spreading evenly. Step 7: Sprinkle with 1 c of mozzarella cheese. Step 8: Top with 1 / 3 of the meat mixture, spreading evenly.

Ingredient Names: cooked pasta, sausage, beef, breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, onions, garlic, salt, egg, milk, dandelion greens, tomato sauce, dried oregano, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch greens for 3 minutes and set aside Brown meats, onion and garlic, add bread crumbs, parsley, dried herbs, salt, pepper, egg, and milk. Step 2: Squeeze dandelion greens of all moisture. Step 3: In a buttered casserole alternate layers of dandelions, pasta, crumbled browned meat mixture and tomato sauce. Step 4: Top with cheese and bake 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes. Step 5: Garnish with hot pepper flakes and parmesan cheese and serve with crisp fresh bread.

Ingredient Names: peas, bacon, scallions, extra virgin olive oil, oil, salt, sugar, cooked rice, cooked shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Cook peas until almost done, drain into a colander, and rinse under a light spray of lukewarm water, allow to drain, heat oil in pan. Step 2: Cut the 2 slices of bacon into cubes and place in the pan. Step 3: Cut the 2 scallions into thin rounds and add into pan. Step 4: Cook on medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, cook rice. Step 6: Fold sugar into cooked rice, add the peas and 1 / 2 pound of shelled cooked shrimp, bacon and scallions, fluff with a fork, and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pancetta, onion, celery, garlic cloves, dried oregano, red chili pepper flakes, diced tomatoes, parmesan rind, cannellini beans, low sodium chicken broth, water, salt, pasta, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat, then add the pancetta and saute until lightly browned. Step 2: Add the onion and celery, continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, oregano, and pepper flakes, saute on minute. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and deglaze the bottom of the pan. Step 5: Add cheese rind, beans, and simmer 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the stock and water, bring to a boil, then add pasta and cook until tender, according to package directions. Step 7: Remove from heat and discard cheese rind. Step 8: Add parsley and black pepper, adjust seasoning, and serve in individual bowls, drizzled with a small amount of extra-virgin olive oil.

Dish Name: Dark Tuscan Bread Pane Toscano Scuro
Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, warm water, unbleached all-purpose flour, water, whole wheat flour, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Starter, stir the yeast into the water and let it stand for 10 minutes, until creamy. Step 2: Add the flour and stir with 100 strokes of a wooden spoon, or w / the paddle of an electric mixer for 1 minute. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until tripled, 6 hours to overnight Dough, stir yeast into the warm water and let it stand for 10 minutes, until creamy. Step 4: Add the room temp water and the starter. Step 5: Stir vigorously or squeeze the mixture between your fingers to break the starter up. Step 6: Stir in the flours, half at a time, until thoroughly mixed. Step 7: Knead dough on floured work surface until firm and resilient, 8 to 10 minutes. Step 8: Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let rise until doubled, 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 9: Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and punch it, then shape it into a large round loaf, or 2 oval loaves.

Ingredient Names: chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, beef bouillon cubes, italian seasoning, minced garlic clove, olive oil, parmesan cheese, pepper, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium pot, saute garlic in olive oil, if desired If you choose not to, go on to. Step 2: Combine all the ingredients except for the red pepper flakes. Step 3: Simmer over medium heat until sauce boils Smash tomatoes during simmering. Step 4: Simmer until it reaches desired consistency. Step 5: Add red pepper flakes in the last five minutes of cooking. Step 6: Serve over favorite pasta or freeze Roasted red peppers, onions, and mushrooms are particularly tasty additions The longer you simmer the sauce, the tastier it becomes.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti noodles, parmesan cheese, butter, egg, ricotta cheese, salt and pepper, spaghetti sauce, italian sausage, meatballs, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: While noodles are still hot, combine with cheese, butter and one egg. Step 2: Pour half noodles into a greased 9x13 casserole. Step 3: Combine ricotta, one egg, salt and pepper. Step 4: Layer some sauce on noodles. Step 5: Spoon ricotta over sauce. Step 6: Add sliced sausage and meatballs. Step 7: Top with more sauce, remaining noodles and mozzarella cheese. Step 8: Bake@ 350 for 45-60 minutes.

Dish Name: Defrost Chops In The Morning Want Spaghetti In The Evening A Culinary Compromise
Ingredient Names: pork chops, onion, cajun seasoning, flour, marsala wine, stewed tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, butter, fresh basil, salt and pepper, cooked spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle pork chops with cajun seasoning Coat each chop with flour. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Step 3: Place pork chops in skillet and brown evenly. Step 4: Add onions and garlic. Step 5: Cook until veggies are translucent, then add marsala to deglaze the pan. Step 6: Allow alcohol to cook out. Step 7: Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Step 8: Stir in butter and basil. Step 9: Cook for 15 minutes on low heat.

Ingredient Names: penne rigate, salami, mozzarella cheese, black olives, cherry tomatoes, mayonnaise, pesto sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta until al dente, according to package directions - drain. Step 2: Combine pesto and mayo, salt and pepper. Step 3: Add the mayo mixture to the warm pasta. Step 4: Add the rest of the ingredients, toss well I prefer serving this at room temperature it's also good straight from the refrigerator.

Dish Name: Delicious And Easy Herbed Garlic Bread
Ingredient Names: butter, thyme, rosemary, oregano, basil, french bread, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Place first 5 ingredients in small saucepan and warm over low heat until butter is melted. Step 2: Slice bread Generously brush herbed butter on each slice. Step 3: Sprinkle with minced garlic, parmesan cheese, and parsley. Step 4: Place in very hot oven or broiler for a few minutes until slightly browned Enjoy!

Dish Name: Delicious And Easy Turkey And Veggie Spaghetti
Ingredient Names: ground turkey breast, green bell pepper, yellow onion, garlic cloves, zucchini, olive oil, salt, black pepper, fresh basil leaves, fresh oregano, ground cinnamon, pasta sauce, vermicelli
Instructions: Step 1: Saut garlic and bell peppers in olive oil until bell peppers are soft. Step 2: Add onion and zucchini, continue to cook until all veggies are tender. Step 3: In a separate pan brown turkey meat, add salt, pepper, basil, oregano and cinnamon Saut until turkey is cooked through. Step 4: Combine turkey mixture with cooked vegetables. Step 5: Add pasta sauce, simmer for 5-10 minutes or until all flavors are well combined. Step 6: Boil water for pasta. Step 7: Cook pasta al dente. Step 8: Combine sauce with pasta and serve with parmesan or romano cheese.

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, egg, fresh parsley, mushroom, pasta sauce, hot italian sausages
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer the pasta sauce and sausage in a small saucepan on the lowest heat possible for simmering In the meantime, cook the pasta according to package directions While pasta is cooking, whip together ricotta, mushroom, egg, and parsley in a medium bowl. Step 2: When pasta is done, drain. Step 3: In a 9 by 9-ish deep casserole, spread about 1 / 2 cup of the pasta sauce / sausage mixture. Step 4: Layer on half of the ziti. Step 5: Put about 5 or 6 evenly spaced spoonfulls of ricotta on top of the ziti. Step 6: Put on half remaining sauce. Step 7: Sprinkle 1 cup of the mozzarella on the sauce. Step 8: Layer on remaining ziti.

Ingredient Names: butter, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, italian bread
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cheese, butter, & seasoning. Step 2: Cut bread in half lengthewise. Step 3: Spread cheese / butter mixture evenly on bread. Step 4: Place bread on baking sheet & bake at 350f for 5-7 minutes or until slightly browned but not burnt. Step 5: Serve with pasta & enjoy!

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, garlic cloves, anchovy paste, kalamata olive, capers, tomatoes, dried basil, dried oregano, dried red pepper flakes, pecorino romano cheese, cracked black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti to very al dente. Step 2: Drain, and set aside To the empty pasta pot, add the olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes and anchovy paste. Step 3: Heat on medium heat, stirring occasionally until garlic starts to sizzle and anchovy paste begins to melt into the oil. Step 4: Add the olives and capers, stirring occasionally until heated through and fragrant. Step 5: Add the tomatoes and stir, allowing them to heat through. Step 6: Add the basil, oregano, pecorino, and freshly cracked black pepper. Step 7: Stir to combine and let simmer for about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the reserved pasta, toss to heat-through, and serve with additional grated cheese. Step 9: Then enjoy an authentic italian meal!

Dish Name: Delicious Penne Vodka With Fresh Mushrooms Mozzarella Olives
Ingredient Names: mushrooms, diced tomatoes, olives, vodka sauce, penne, fresh mozzarella cheese, garlic powder, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water and cook penne Also heat vodka sauce in medium sauce pot. Step 2: Meanwhile, saut mushrooms over medium-low heat in 2 tablespoons of the olive oil until lightly golden brown then set aside. Step 3: Drain tomatoes very well then saut in remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil and garlic powder to taste over medium heat until heated well through and remaining water cooks out, drain again in colander, set aside. Step 4: When pasta is cooked, drain well and return to pot. Step 5: Add sauce, mushrooms and tomatoes, gently stir in olives and fresh mozzarella pearlini. Step 6: Transfer to large serving bowl and serve immediately. Step 7: Serve with grated parmesan cheese on hand at table, but not directly on pasta dish as it alters the final taste and it's just so delicious that it really doesn't need it.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, mushroom, frozen peas, chicken broth, butter, salt and pepper, linguine, parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onion in olive oil over low heat until translucent. Step 2: Add the mushrooms, peas and chicken broth and cook for about 10 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender. Step 3: Add the butter, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Cook the linguine until almost al dente, drain. Step 5: Add the linguine to the mushrooms and cook for a couple of minutes, stirring a couple of times. Step 6: Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and basil.

Ingredient Names: gluten flour, salt, sugar, warm water, active dry yeast, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the warm water, salt, sugar Yeast and olive oil in a bowl and mix well. Step 2: Add flour and begin kneading immediately, using a mixing machine or by hand Dough has proper moisture content when it is sticky to the touch but does not stick to your hand--add extra water or flour to achieve this. Step 3: After kneading about 15 minutes by hand or a few minutes in the mixer, form the dough into a ball and let it rise, covered or in a large plastic freezer bag about two hours at room temperature Gently deflate and refrigerate up to 24 hours before freezing or baking Your dough is now ready to be used in your favorite way I roll mine out very thin and bake at the highest temperature the oven will allow.

Ingredient Names: hot italian sausage, onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms, garlic cloves, dry white wine, chicken broth, chopped tomatoes, tomato sauce, fresh spinach, fresh mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, lasagna noodle, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large soup pot brown sausage over medium heat, add onion, celery, carrots and cook for five minutes. Step 2: Add the mushroom and garlic and cook for five more minutes. Step 3: Add white wine and cook for a few more minutes. Step 4: Add the broth, chopped tomatoes and sauce bring to a boil and taste for seasoning Break up the pasta and add to the soup, cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the spinach and cook for a few minutes To serve place mozzarella cheese in the bottom of the soup bowl pour prepared soup on top, sprinkle with parmesan cheese and basil. Step 6: Serve with a crusty bread and salad.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, dry basil leaves, romano cheese, fresh italian parsley, garlic cloves, eggs, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, salt, ground black pepper, olive oil, pork chop, garlic clove, salt & pepper, yellow onion, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Meatballs: Combine all dry ingredients. Step 2: Combine meat and eggs. Step 3: Add all dry ingredients to the meat mixture. Step 4: Add more breadcrumbs or eggs if needed. Step 5: Heat olive oil in frying pan on medium heat. Step 6: Take about 1-2 tablespoons of meatball mixture and roll into balls until all are done. Step 7: Put as many meatballs in the frying pan as possible Brown on each side, drain oil.

Ingredient Names: milk, water, corn kernel, polenta, butter, parmesan cheese, prosciutto
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water, milk and corn kernals in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil Gradually whisk in polenta until well incorporated. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until thickened, 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the butter, parmesan cheese and prosciutto.

Ingredient Names: duck, duck stock, dried porcini mushrooms, fresh rosemary leaves, sage leaves, garlic cloves, onion, celery, duck fat, white wine, parsley, pappardelle pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 1 cup of stock to boil and pour over dried porcinis. Step 2: Allow to stand for 30 minutes. Step 3: Remove rehydrated porcinis, squeeze dry and chop, reserving liquid. Step 4: Strain through cheese cloth, to remove any grit that might be in the porcinis Roughly chop onion and celery and puree finely in food processor with sage, rosemary, and 1 / 2 cup of parsley. Step 5: Heat duck fat in skillet, then add pured mixture Finely mince garlic and add to sauted mixture. Step 6: Then add your rehydrated porcinis and saut a few more minutes Deglaze pan with white wine, then add stock and reserved porcini liquid and simmer for about half an hour or until reduced to desired consistency. Step 7: Add shredded duck, heating well and allow all flavors to marry, adjusting with salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: arborio rice, chicken stock, chicken breasts, sliced mushrooms, frozen peas, zucchini, pumpkin, baby spinach, brown onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt & pepper, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200c. Step 2: Heat fry pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add small amount olive oil You can add a small amount of butter to fry pan at this time but as you need to add it later, i prefer not to. Step 4: Saute onions until translucent then add garlic. Step 5: Add sliced chicken and brown lightly. Step 6: Then add your veggies Remember you are not actually cooking the veggies at this point, you are just allowing them to soak up the flavour of the other ingredients. Step 7: In a baking dish with lid, add 41 / 2 cups chicken stock, 11 / 2 cups arborio rice, and the content of your pan. Step 8: Put it in the oven for 40 minutes and do something else for a while.

Ingredient Names: pasta sauce, olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, zucchini, carrots, vegetables, lean ground beef
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the beef, drain fat, and set aside. Step 2: Saute onion, celery and garlic in a little oil till onion softens. Step 3: Add carrots, zucchini, and other veggies. Step 4: Saute for 3 - 5 minutes. Step 5: Return beef to pan with veggies. Step 6: Add pasta sauce If you are using a plain sauce, then season with salt, pepper, basil, and oregano If you are using a commercial sauce that already has flavourings added, you should be able to get by without it. Step 7: Simmer for 30 minutes, or more if you have the time Or less if you don't!

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic clove, bacon, mushrooms, broccoli, mushroom soup, carnation instant milk, salt and pepper, cooked pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly fry onion, garlic and bacon until onion is translucent and bacon is cooked through. Step 2: Stir in mushrooms and saut until lightly browned. Step 3: Add the broccoli and cook through for a few minutes. Step 4: Add the can of soup and heat through and simmer for 3-4 minutes Lastly add in the carnation milk or cream and season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Serve with cooked spaghetti or penne pasta and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: butter, boneless skinless chicken breasts, half-and-half, parmesan cheese, green onion, garlic, fresh parsley, cracked black pepper, fettuccine
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in skillet and saute chicken which has been cut into 2 inch chunks. Step 2: When chicken begins to take on color, add garlic and green onions. Step 3: Saute a few minutes being careful not to burn garlic add remaining ingredients except parsley, cover and simmer over low heat until mixture thickens and chicken is tender and cooked all the way through. Step 4: Serve over cooked and drained fettuccine. Step 5: Sprinkle with fresh parsley, lots of cracked black pepper and additional parmesan cheese if desired.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, parmesan cheese, half-and-half, vodka, fettuccine pasta, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the futtuccini in a large pot of boiling water While pasta is cooking bring tomato sauce, 1 / 4 cup parmesan and half and half to a simmer in a 8-10 inch sautee pan. Step 2: Add the vodka stir and simmer for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain pasta, portion out into four pasta bowls, top with the sauce. Step 4: Garnish with the remaining parmesan cheese and parsley.

Dish Name: Easy Gnocchi With Brown Butter And Sage 5Fix
Ingredient Names: simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes, flour, egg, butter, sage
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil on the stove and set up a large ice bath near the pot. Step 2: Place the mashed potatoes on a clean surface and make a well in the center of the potatoes Distribute the flour evenly over the potatoes Crack the egg into the well, and beat with a fork The egg will slowly start to pull the flour and potato mixture into the center Continue beating until the egg is no longer separate from the flour and potato mixture. Step 3: Roll entire mixture into a ball and knead for 4 - 5 minutes until dry Use additional flour sparingly if mixture remains too moist Separate dough into 4 equal portions and roll each portion into a long rope about 3 / 4" in diameter. Step 4: Cut each rope into 1" segments and pinch each segment slightly for texture.

Ingredient Names: part-skim mozzarella cheese, fat-free cottage cheese, frozen spinach, parmesan cheese, dried oregano, salt, pepper, manicotti, tomato and basil pasta sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Combine 1 1 / 2 cups of the mozzarella, cottage cheese, and next five ingredients in medium bowl. Step 3: Fill and stuff each shell Spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish with non-stick. Step 4: Pour 1 / 2 of sauce on bottom. Step 5: Arrange shells on top in single layer. Step 6: Pour remaining sauce over shells. Step 7: Pour water into dish. Step 8: Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella. Step 9: Cover tightly with foil.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, fresh asparagus, butter, olive oil, shallot, garlic clove, mascarpone cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, frozen peas, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Drain, reserving 1 / 2 cup of the pata water. Step 3: Cut asparagus into 1 inch peices, disgaurding woody ends. Step 4: In a large skillet saute asparagus in butter an oil for 5-6 minutes. Step 5: Add shallots and garlic and cook 2 minutes longer. Step 6: Add pasta and mascarpone and reserved pasta water, stir to combine. Step 7: Stir in mozzarella, parmesan, and peas. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: dry pasta, salami, black olives, sun-dried tomato, yellow bell pepper, olive oil, red wine vinegar, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, cut the salami into strips. Step 3: Slice the black olives and dice the sundried tomatoes and bell pepper. Step 4: Set all these ingredients aside. Step 5: In a large salad bowl, mix the olive oil and red wine vinegar. Step 6: Whisk with a fork until they are completely blended and the dressing is a uniform colour throughout. Step 7: Add the parmesan cheese, salt and pepper to the dressing and mix. Step 8: When the pasta is cooked to your liking, remove it from the heat. Step 9: Drain it and rinse it in cold water until the pasta is cold, drain it again.

Ingredient Names: penne, lean ground beef, onion, carrot, pasta sauce, italian seasoning, hot pepper flakes, light ricotta cheese, egg, part-skim mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta until tender but firm, drain. Step 2: In a large skillet, cook beef over medium-high heat until browned. Step 3: Add onions and carrots. Step 4: Cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in pasta sauce and italian seasoning. Step 6: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 7: In a bowl, combine ricotta cheese, egg and 1 / 2 cup of the mozzarella cheese. Step 8: Set aside To assemble: spread half of the meat mixture on bottom of greased 13x9-inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, chopped tomatoes, spaghetti sauce, lasagna noodles, part-skim ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Grease a 9x13 baking pan. Step 3: In a large frying pan, brown ground beef, drain. Step 4: Combine drained meat with tomatoes and spaghetti sauce. Step 5: Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of the greased pan. Step 6: Arrange half the uncooked noodles over the sauce. Step 7: Spread half the ricotta cheese over the noodles. Step 8: Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella cheese. Step 9: Add another layer, using up the remaining noodles, sauce, ricotta cheese, and mozzarella cheese.

Ingredient Names: penne, alfredo sauce, tomato sauce, mushroom, broccoli, garlic, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta as directed, but add broccoli the last few minutes of cooking, just until slightly tender and bright green in color. Step 2: Meanwhile saute garlic and mushrooms, then add the sauces and heat. Step 3: After pasta is drained toss it all together and serve We like a little parmesan cheese on top.

Ingredient Names: white flour, eggs, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place flour on a flat surface. Step 2: Make a well in the centre of the flour. Step 3: Pour lightly beaten eggs one at a time into the well. Step 4: Mix the eggs with a fork until they are blended with the flour. Step 5: Using your hands kneed the mixture until it become smooth and consistant. Step 6: Add water if too dry or flour if too wet The dough should not stick to your hands or the working surface. Step 7: Divide dough into three portions For best results refrigerate the dough for at least 1 hour prior to shaping If shaping by hand place dough between two sheets of baking paper and flatten with rolling pin to about 3mm.

Ingredient Names: white kidney beans, diced tomatoes with juice, whole wheat pasta, parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaves, extra virgin olive oil, onion, celery, carrot, garlic, ground fennel, dried rosemary leaves, kosher salt, ground black pepper, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic, onions, celery and carrot in olive oil until tender. Step 2: Add tomatoes, beans and spices. Step 3: Add 2 cups water and tomato paste. Step 4: Bring to a boil, taste a small amount and adjust seasoning to taste. Step 5: Add pasta and cook for about 15 minutes more until pasta is cooked through. Step 6: Top with fresh basil and parmesan cheese This is so yummo served with fresh homemade bread. Step 7: When you reheat this for left overs or lunches, you may have to add a little water, because the pasta absorbs the liquid It is still yummy though A.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, alfredo sauce, pesto sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: While the fettuccini is cooking, put the alfredo sauce and pesto in a saucepan. Step 2: Place pan over medium high heat and cook 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Combine the sauce with the hot pasta and serve with grated parmesan, if desired.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, large eggs, egg yolks, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese, ranch dressing mix, olive oil, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add spaghetti and cook until al dente, 10 to, drain. Step 3: While the pasta is cooking, whisk the eggs, yolks, Hidden Valley庐 Original Ranch庐 Salad Dressing and Seasoning. Step 4: Mix, a small pinch of black pepper, and cheese together in a mixing bowl, set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in a large skillet set over medium heat. Step 6: Add the bacon and saute for about about 5 to, until beginning to crisp. Step 7: Drain pasta, reserving the pasta water. Step 8: Add pasta to the skillet with the bacon over low heat. Step 9: Stir to coat the pasta. Step 10: Transfer pasta and bacon to a bowl, add the egg mixture and a small amount of the reserved pasta water for creaminess. Step 11: Toss well to coat. Step 12: Serve immediately with extra cheese for garnish.

Ingredient Names: hamburger meat, sausage drippings, spaghetti sauce, brown sugar, spaghetti, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet heat the sausage drippings, then brown your hamburger meat. Step 2: Drain meat and return to skillet. Step 3: Add spaghetti sauce and brown sugar, heat on low while spaghetti cooks. Step 4: When pasta is ready, put in warmed bowls, top with sauce, add three tablespoons of ricotta to each bowl, stir ricotta into the sauce and top with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Easy Sausage Tomato Farfalle Bow Ties In Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, sweet italian sausage, dried red pepper flakes, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, whipping cream, salt, farfalle pasta, parsley, parmesan cheese, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Begin to boil water for pasta & add dash of olive oil & salt to water. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in large frying pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add sausage and pepper flakes. Step 4: Cook until sausage is no longer pink, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Add onion and garlic to sausage in pan and cook until onion is tender and sausage is light brown, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in tomatoes, cream, garlic powder, grated cheese, parsley and salt & simmer on low until mixture thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Cook pasta until "al dente" drain immediately & top with sausage mixture & additional grated cheese if desired, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, garlic, olive oil, fresh parsley, onion, tomatoes, bay leaves, salt, pepper, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti according to box directions, drain well. Step 2: Meanwhile, in lg saucepan, over med heat, saute garlic in oil for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add parsley, onion, tomatoes, bay leaves, salt and pepper, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Step 5: Add basil, serve over spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, frozen chopped spinach, fresh parmesan cheese, part-skim ricotta cheese, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, spaghetti sauce, fat-free cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook noodles according to the package directions. Step 3: Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again, set aside. Step 4: Stir together spinach, 1 / 2 cup of the parmesan cheese, ricotta cheese, garlic, pepper flakes, salt and pepper. Step 5: Spread about 1 / 4 cup of the spinach mixture along entire length of each noodle, roll up noodles. Step 6: Place a thin layer of spaghetti sauce in a 8x8 baking dish Stand rolled noodles on end and slightly apart in dish. Step 7: Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over noodles.

Dish Name: Easy Uncooked Tomato Sauce For Pasta
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, fresh basil, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly drain the tomatoes. Step 2: Place tomatoes in a bowl, large jar, or sealable container If the tomatoes are whole you should crush them up with a fork or dice them You can also use diced tomatoes. Step 3: Add the remaining ingredients except pasta I use either fresh basil or dried oregano, alot of it By crushing the garlic rather than chopping you will get more garlic flavor so don't be tempted to use too much more than what i have listed unless it is from a jar or diced. Step 4: Cover container and place in the fridge for at least 3-6 hours The longer it sits the better it is. Step 5: Remove the garlic clove from the sauce and take out of the fridge just b4 cooking the pasta you want it to be someplace between cold and room temperature if it is too warm you will not have as big a flavor burts when the hot pasta meets the sauce if too cold it will cool the pasta too much.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, lasagna noodles, mushroom, fresh spinach leaves, red bell pepper, fat-free ricotta cheese, nutmeg, lowfat mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Spray 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Combine ricotta and nutmeg, set aside. Step 3: Layer ingredients as follows: spread about a cup of the sauce on bottom of dish 3 noodles over sauce to cover Another cup of the sauce Ricotta mixture and vegetables 1 / 2 of the mozzarella Remaining 3 noodles Remaining sauce.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, spaghetti sauce, cottage cheese, egg, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In 13x9 pan, spoon a little of the sauce. Step 2: Place 3 lasagna noodles on the sauce. Step 3: Mix cottage cheese, egg, and parmesan cheese in a bowl. Step 4: Spread 1 / 3 of this over noodles. Step 5: Add 1 / 3 of the sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle with 1 cup mozzarella. Step 7: Now, add 3 more noodles, 1 / 3 more cottage cheese mixture, 1 / 3 more sauce. Step 8: Add 1 cup more mozzarella cheese One more time, do the layers. Step 9: Bake in 350f oven for about 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fusilli, leeks, peas, red peppers, eggs, semi-skimmed milk, thyme leaves, mature vegetarian cheddar, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Grease a 1.2 litre baking dish with the olive oil. Step 2: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water in a large pan for 8 mins. Add all the vegetables and cook for another 2-3 mins until the pasta is tender and the vegetables slightly softened. Drain, then tip into the baking dish and mix well. Step 3: Beat together the eggs and milk in a jug and add the thyme. Mix the two cheeses together and add most of it to the egg mixture, then season. Pour into the baking dish, stir gently, then scatter the rest of the cheese on top. Bake for 35-40 mins until set and golden. Cool for a few mins, then serve with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, eggplants, baby plum tomato, garlic skin, olive oil, penne, pancetta, parmesan, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Put the vegetables and garlic in a large roasting tin, toss with the oil and season. Spread out in a single layer and roast for 35 mins until tender, stirring after 20 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions. Reserve some of the cooking liquid, then drain. Step 3: Pop the pancetta, with a drizzle of oil, into the pan you cooked the pasta in. Cook for 2-3 mins until golden, crisp and cooked though. Toss in the drained pasta, Parmesan, roasted veg and a couple tbsps of the reserved cooking liquid. Tear in most of the basil leaves and stir. Serve sprinkled with remaining basil leaves and extra Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, olive oil, brown sugar, onions, garlic powder, oregano, fresh basil, parsley, paprika, fresh bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 15-30 minutes. Step 2: Serve over spaghetti. Step 3: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Edith's Low-Salt Spaghetti Sauce for One
Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, yellow onions, mushrooms, garlic, canned no-salt-added tomatoes, italian herb seasoning, red wine vinegar, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In oil, brown meat. Step 2: Add onion through garlic and cook until soft. Step 3: Stir in the tomatoes. Step 4: Add the Italian seasoning and a generous sprinkling of vinegar and continue cooking to heat through. Step 5: Serve over a single serving of fettucini or other pasta. Step 6: Shake parmesan over top.

Dish Name: Egg Free Spaghetti Pie Baked Pasta
Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, pasta sauce, stewed tomatoes, basil, oregano, sugar, salt, sour cream, cream cheese, water, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, green onion, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the meat and onions together, break up the beef so there are no lumps. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook until fragrant. Step 3: Add the pasta sauce, tomatoes, basil, oregano, sugar and salt. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer while the pasta is cooking. Step 5: Prepare the pasta but, slightly undercook as it will be baked and will continue to cook in the oven, Prepare the cheese sauce by adding the softened cream cheese, the sour cream, parmesan cheese and the parsley or spring onions and mix Spray a 10 cup baking dish with oil, place the almost cooked pasta on the bottom. Step 6: Cover with spoonfuls of the cheese sauce, place a spoonful in each corner and continue until all used and the pasta is covered. Step 7: Top with the prepared meat sauce and finally the mozzarella cheese. Step 8: Bake at 180oc for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: white flour, egg, egg yolks, salt, vegetable oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl combine flour and salt, make a well. Step 2: Mix together the wet ingredients and pour into well, mix well. Step 3: Turn out onto a floured board and knead until firm, shiny and elastic At this point cover and chill for 1 hour, up to 24 hours. Step 4: When ready to use follow instructions for manual pasta machine or cut into manageable pieces and roll out to desired thickness, cut into desired shape.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, coarse salt, corn oil, greek oregano, cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Using a vegetable peeler, peel eggplant lengthwise. Step 2: Slice crosswise 1 / 2-inch-thick. Step 3: Layer slices in a colander, sprinkling each layer generously with salt. Step 4: Set colander over a bowl and weight with a heavy object. Step 5: Transfer to refrigerator, and let stand overnight. Step 6: Preheat the oven to 400. Step 7: In a large cast iron skillet, heat 1 / 2-inch oil over high heat. Step 8: Remove eggplant from colander, and pat dry with paper towels Working in batches, add eggplant to skillet. Step 9: Cook until golden brown, turning once.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, salt, ziti pasta, oil, garlic clove, black pepper, part-skim ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, dried basil, oregano, hot red pepper flakes, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the eggplant with salt. Step 2: Place the eggplant in a colander, and let it drain for 30 minutes. Step 3: Rinse the eggplant, and pat it dry. Step 4: Cook the ziti al dente according to the package directions. Step 5: Drain and rinse the pasta, and set it aside. Step 6: Combine the oil and garlic, and smear it on the eggplant slices. Step 7: Then sprinkle the slices generously with pepper Broil the eggplant slices about 4 inches from the heat, turning them once, for a total of about 5 minutes. Step 8: In a large bowl, combine the ricotta or cottage cheese, all but 2 tablespoons of the parmesan, the parsley, basil, oregano, and pepper flakes. Step 9: Toss the cheese mixture with the ziti.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomato, mini mozzarella balls, fresh basil, green tagliatelle, tomato sauce, pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the cherry tomatoes and use a small, sharp knife or a teaspoon to remove the seeds. Cut the mozzarella balls in half. Place one half inside each tomato, trimming the edges if necessary to fit it in. Either cut the smallest circles you can from a basil leaf or finely chop the leaves and scrunch into small circles. Place one at the centre of each mozzarella ball. Step 2: Boil the pasta. Meanwhile, heat through the tomato sauce. When the tagliatelle is cooked, drain and stir through the pesto and any remaining basil, chopped finely. Divide between 4-6 serving bowls. Spoon over some tomato sauce, then arrange the stuffed tomato eyeballs on top.

Ingredient Names: pasta shapes, peas, parsley, fresh chives, juice lemon, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for final 2 mins cooking time. Step 2: Drain, rinse with cold water to cool, then drain again. Step 3: Tip into a bowl with the chopped herbs, lemon zest and juice, olive oil and plenty of seasoning and mix well. Step 4: Cover and chill, spooning out portions as and when. Step 5: If you're making this for one person, by days 3 and 4 you'll need to stir in a little olive oil or something creamy to loosen the pasta.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, bacon, onion, garlic, fettuccine, parmesan cheese, heavy cream, egg yolks, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Saut shallots until softened. Step 3: Stir in bacon and onion; cook and stir until bacon is evenly browned. Step 4: Stir in garlic when bacon is about half done, remove from heat. Step 5: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente. Step 7: Drain pasta, then return it to the pot. Step 8: Whisk Parmesan, cream, and egg yolks together in a medium bowl. Step 9: Pour bacon mixture over pasta; stir in cream mixture. Step 10: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: smoked pancetta, fresh fettuccine, runner bean diagonal, creme fraiche, chives, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Put a large pan of water on to boil for the pasta. Meanwhile, separate the rashers of pancetta and cook them in two batches (without oil) in a large non-stick frying pan until the fat on the pancetta is golden. Lift out onto a plate to crisp up. Step 2: When the water is boiling, add salt and the pasta to the pan and boil for 6 mins. Tip in the beans, quickly return to the boil and cook for about 4 mins more until both the pasta and beans are just tender. Step 3: Drain and tip into a large serving bowl. Toss with the crème fraîche, chives or basil and plenty of seasoning, then quickly tear in the crisp pancetta (keeping it quite chunky). Serve with the Parmesan, if you like, a simple tomato salad and some crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: clotted cream, butter, cornflour, parmesan cheese, nutmeg, black pepper, fettuccine, salt, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, stir the clotted cream, butter and cornflour over a low-ish heat and bring to a low simmer. Step 2: Turn off the heat and keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, put the cheese and nutmeg in a small bowl and add a good grinding of black pepper, then stir everything together (don’t add any salt at this stage). Step 4: Put the pasta in another pan with salt, pour over some boiling water and cook following pack instructions (usually ). Step 5: When cooked, scoop some of the cooking water into a heatproof jug or mug and drain the pasta, but not too thoroughly. Step 6: Add the pasta to the pan with the clotted cream mixture, then sprinkle over the cheese and gently fold everything together over a low heat using a rubber spatula. Step 7: When combined, splash in the cooking water. Step 8: At first, the pasta will look wet and sloppy: keep stirring until the water is absorbed and the sauce is glossy. Step 9: Check the seasoning before transferring to heated bowls. Step 10: Sprinkle over some chives or parsley, then serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: pasta, olive oil, chestnut mushroom, garlic, spinach cheese sauce, vegetarian parmesan style cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta for 10 mins, drain, then tip back into the pan. Meanwhile, heat grill to medium. Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the mushrooms, then cook over a high heat for 5 mins until lightly golden. Reduce the heat, add the garlic, then fry for another min until softened. Season and spoon into a large, shallow baking dish. Step 2: Tip the spinach sauce and half the cheese into the pasta, then put back on the heat for a few mins until heated through. Season to taste, then spoon the pasta over the mushrooms in an even layer. Scatter the remaining cheese over the top and grill for about 5 mins until the cheese is golden and the sauce is bubbling.

Ingredient Names: bacon, penne pasta, olive oil, butter, minced garlic, ground black pepper, skinless chicken breasts, cream, cheese, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Drain bacon slices on paper towels. Step 4: Chop into small pieces when cool enough to handle. Step 5: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Add penne and olive oil; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 7: While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a large, deep skillet over low heat. Step 8: Add chopped bacon, garlic, and pepper; saut茅 until fragrant, 2 to. Step 9: Increase heat to medium, add chicken, and cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 5 to. Step 10: Add whipping cream, Parmesan-Romano cheese, and remaining pepper to the skillet. Step 11: Stir and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 12: Add Colby-Jack cheese and stir until melted. Step 13: Stir in beaten eggs and bring to a simmer. Step 14: Add drained pasta and stir until coated with sauce.

Ingredient Names: penne, olive oil, red chile, green onions, cherry tomato, golden sugar, lemons, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the penne according to the pack instructions. While the pasta is cooking, heat the oil very gently and add the chilli, if using, and the spring onions. Slowly cook the spring onion until wilted, then add the cherry tomatoes and sprinkle with the sugar. Turn up the heat and cook until the tomatoes are blistered. Step 2: Drain the pasta and tip into a large bowl. Toss with everything from the tomato pan and the lemon juice. Serve in pasta bowls with grated parmesan.

Dish Name: Fusilli with glorious green spinach sauce
Ingredient Names: fusilli pasta spirals, baby spinach, garlic, mascarpone, lemons, parmesan, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Meanwhile put half the spinach in a food processor with the garlic, mascarpone, lemon juice and Parmesan, then whizz to a smooth sauce. Step 2: Drain the pasta thoroughly and return to the pan over a low heat. Stir in the sauce, pine nuts and remaining spinach, until the spinach has just wilted. Season and serve with extra Parmesan sprinkled over.

Ingredient Names: mozzarella, no cook lasagne, block parmesan, olive oil, onions, garlic, mixed herbs, bay leaves, beef, tomatoes, ketchup, glass red wine, butter, flour, milk, gratings nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Make the meat sauce: heat the oil in a large saucepan and gently cook the onions for 10 mins until golden. Add the garlic, herbs and bay, then cook 2 mins more. Heat a large frying pan. Crumble in a quarter of the beef, cook until brown, then add to the onions. Continue to fry the beef in batches and add to the onions until all the meat is used up. Tip the tomatoes and ketchup in with the onions and beef. Rinse the cans out with the red wine, if you have some, or with a little water, then add to the pan. Season and bring to a simmer. Gently cook for 30 mins until thick and saucy, then set aside. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the white sauce. Tip everything into a pan, season, then bring to a simmer, whisking continuously. Don’t worry if it’s lumpy – if you whisk enough the sauce will come together. Simmer for 5 mins, whisking, until smooth and thickened, then remove from the heat. If not using straight away, cover with cling film and set aside. Step 3: Make sure you divide everything up so that you can make two lasagnes. Place a thin layer of meat sauce in an ovenproof baking dish, drizzle with a little white sauce and scatter with a little mozzarella. Cover with a layer of lasagne sheets, then top with more of both sauces, more mozzarella and more lasagne sheets. Repeat once more, then cover the top layer of lasagne in just white sauce. Finally scatter over some Parmesan. The lasagnes can now be chilled in the fridge for a day ready to be cooked, or frozen for up to 3 months – see tips, below. Step 4: To cook, heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Cook for 35-40 mins until brown on the top and crisp around the edges. Leave to settle for 10 mins before cutting into squares and serving with a green salad and some garlic bread, if you like.

Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, garlic, olive oil, parsley, salt, pepper, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Cook orzo in boiling salted water until done. Step 2: Warm oil in large skillet over low heat, add garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Step 3: Stir in orzo, parsley, salt and pepper to taste and butter, toss well.

Dish Name: Garlic Butter Cauliflower Pasta with Pangritata
Ingredient Names: to bread, oil spray, unsalted butter, olive oil, garlic, cauliflower, fresh fettuccine, red onions, to red chili flakes, lemons, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the bread into small pieces - you want (at least!) 1/2 cup. Spray generously with oil. Step 2: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the bread crumbs and saute for about 2 minutes until golden brown. Remove from the skillet into a bowl and sprinkle with salt. Step 3: Return the skillet to the stove. Melt the butter then add the oil. When hot, add the smashed garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Step 4: Add the cauliflower. Cook, stirring occasionally, for around 3 minutes, then add the red onion and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Continue cooking for another 5 minutes, until the cauliflower is beautiful golden brown but still a bit firm. Step 5: Remove the smashed garlic cloves. Step 6: Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted boiling water - 1 minute less than the recommended cooking time on the packet! Step 7: RESERVE 1/2 cup of the pasta cooking water. Then drain the pasta or use tongs to transfer it directly to the skillet. Step 8: Pour the reserved pasta cooking water into the skillet along with the red chili flakes, a good pinch of salt and pepper. Gently toss the pasta for 1 to 2 minutes, until the water evaporates - you will be left with a luscious coating of sauce on each strand of pasta (this is called emulsification) and the cauliflower will finish cooking. Step 9: Remove from the stove. Grate over zest of 1/2 the lemon and drizzle over about 2 tbsp of lemon juice. Toss quickly. Step 10: Serve, sprinkled with Pangrattato with freshly grated parmesan and parsley, if using.

Ingredient Names: linguine, savoy cabbage, olive oil, garlic, anchovy olive oil, chili flakes, white breadcrumb, parsley, pecorino
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the linguine in a large pan of boiling, salted water following pack instructions, adding the cabbage for the final 4 mins of cooking time. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a very small saucepan and gently cook the garlic. As soon as it starts to turn golden, lift out with a fork and set aside – it’s very important that the garlic does not brown or it will spoil the flavour of the oil. Step 3: Add the anchovies and their oil, and cook for 1-2 mins, mashing with a fork. Add about 150ml of hot water (take a ladle or two from the pasta pan) and simmer very gently until the pasta is ready. Step 4: To make the crumbs, heat the oil in a large pan and cook the bread and parsley, stirring frequently, for 5 mins until crisp and golden. Mix in the cheese. Step 5: Drain the pasta quite lightly and return to the pan. Add the anchovy sauce, garlic, chilli and plenty of black pepper. Toss well to combine, then divide between bowls, scatter with the hot crumbs and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, red peppers, garlic, tomatoes, gnocchi, fresh basil leaves, half ball mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan, then soften 1 chopped onion and 1 finely chopped red pepper for 5 mins. Step 2: Stir in 1 crushed garlic clove, fry for 1 min, tip in 400g chopped tomatoes and 500g gnocchi, then bring to a simmer. Step 3: Bubble for 10-15 mins, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is soft and the sauce has thickened. Step 4: Season, stir through a handful of torn basil leaves, then transfer to a large ovenproof dish. Step 5: Scatter with torn chunks of half a 125g mozzarella ball, then grill for 5-6 mins until the cheese is bubbling and golden.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, marinated mozzarella balls, gnocchi, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, sugar, plum tomatoes, parsley, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Open marinated mozzarella balls and measure out the oil. Step 2: Pour oil into a heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook gnocchi in batches in the hot oil until golden and heated through. Step 4: Divide gnocchi evenly amongst ratin dishes. Step 5: Add garlic and red chili flakes to the oil in the same skillet. Step 6: Cook until garlic is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 7: Stir in salt and sugar, pour in tomatoes. Step 8: Use a wooden spoon to break up and crush the tomatoes. Step 9: Bring sauce to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer tomatoes for 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Step 11: Taste sauce and adjust seasonings if desired. Step 12: Spoon tomato sauce over the gnocchi. Step 13: Top each dish with 3 marinated mozzarella balls and set on a baking sheet. Step 14: Add baking sheet to oven and broil until mozzarella balls are melted and golden browned, 3 to. Step 15: Garnish with parsley or basil if desired and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Greg's Good As Gold Spaghetti Sauce
Ingredient Names: virgin olive oil, onions, garlic, mushrooms, ground beef, italian sausages, italian tomatoes, tomato puree, tomato paste, black olives, dry red wine, fresh basil, oregano, parsley, red pepper flakes, thyme, paprika, sugar, salt, fresh bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large Dutch over or stock pot with heat set at medium. Step 2: Add the diced garlic, diced onions and sliced mushroom and brown. Step 3: Add the ground beef and Italian sausage with the skins peeled off it links. Step 4: Crumble the meat as you are browning over a medium to medium high heat. Step 5: Brown till there is no pink on meat. Step 6: Add the cans Italian tomatoes, tomato puree a tomato paste and the sliced olive and mix well. Step 7: Use a little water to clean cans and add to sauce. Step 8: Add the dry red wine. Step 9: Add the basil, oregano, parsley, red peper flakes, thyme, paprika, sugar, salt and bay leaf. Step 10: Allow the spices to cook in and let simmer on medium-low heat covered. Step 11: I normally let sauce simmer for 2 to 4 hours. Step 12: Boil water and cook thin spaghetti per instruction. Step 13: Remove the bay leaf Garnish the top with grated Romano or parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: leeks chunks, vegetable stock, wafer-thin ham, lasagne, half-fat creme fraiche, wholegrain mustard, strong cheddar, fresh breadcrumb
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Simmer the sliced leeks with the stock in a covered pan for 5 mins until tender. Drain the leeks, reserving the stock, then mix them with the ham and some seasoning. Divide the mixture into 8, spoon along the middle of each lasagne sheet, roll up, then tuck into an ovenproof dish, joined sides down. Step 2: Mix 300ml of the reserved stock with the crème fraîche, mustard and most of the grated cheese. Season, then pour over the cannelloni. Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese, then bake for 20 mins until the top is golden and crisp, and the leek filling is piping hot. Great with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: parmesan, eggs preferably organic, peas, spaghetti, olive oil, lean back bacon fat, plump garlic, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil with a pinch of salt. Then get everything ready. Grate the cheese and beat the eggs in a bowl with a little pepper. Cook the peas in boiling water for 2-3 mins, drain and set aside. Step 2: Cook the spaghetti to al dente following pack instructions. While the spaghetti is cooking, heat the oil in a large, deep frying or sauté pan. Fry the bacon for several mins until it starts to go crisp. Stir in the garlic and cook briefly until pale brown. Tip in the peas and if the spaghetti isn’t quite ready, keep warm over a very low heat. Step 3: When the pasta is done, take the pan with the bacon in off the heat. Lift the spaghetti out of its pan with a pair of tongs and drop it into the frying pan with the garlic, bacon and peas. Mix most of the cheese into the eggs, keeping back a handful of cheese for sprinkling over each serving. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese, lifting and stirring with the tongs so everything mixes well and the spaghetti gets coated. Ladle in some more of the pasta water, enough to coat the spaghetti and create a bit of sauce in the pan. Step 4: Spoon or twirl the pasta into shallow serving bowls using a long pronged fork. Serve immediately with a sprinkling of the reserved cheese, some snipped chives and a grating of black pepper.

Ingredient Names: fresh breadcrumb, milk, turkey ground meat, oregano, flatleaf parsley, olive oil, onion garlic passata, sugar, pasta shapes
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the crumbs into a large bowl, then stir in the milk until the crumbs have absorbed the liquid. Add the mince, 1 tsp oregano and half the parsley, then season and mix with a fork. Use wet hands to shape into 30 meatballs. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan, then brown the meatballs for 5 mins, turning to cook all over. Pour in the passata, sugar, remaining oregano and most of the remaining parsley. Stir well, then simmer for 8-10 mins until the meatballs are just cooked through. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Season the sauce, spoon the meatballs and sauce over the pasta, then sprinkle over any remaining parsley.

Ingredient Names: field, wholegrain mustard, garlic, vegetable stock, penne pasta, fresh flat-leaf parsley, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mushrooms, mustard, garlic and vegetable stock into a frying pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 mins or until the stock has nearly all evaporated and the mushrooms are soft. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Drain and toss with the mushrooms, parsley and lemon zest. Season to taste and serve straightaway.

Ingredient Names: new potatoes, pasta shapes, green beans, creme fraiche, mixed herbs, olive oil, garlic, lemons, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil and cook the potatoes for 5 mins. Add the pasta and cook following pack instructions. Add the green beans 3 mins before the end. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a mini chopper or small food processor, blitz the pesto ingredients until roughly chopped. Step 3: When the pasta is cooked, drain and tip back into the pan. Toss through the pesto and crème fraîche and divide into bowls. Serve with shaved Parmesan on top.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, lean ground beef, onion, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, chopped fresh parsley, garlic, dried basil, salt, dried oregano, white sugar, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, grated parmesan cheese, large eggs, ground black pepper, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Combine pork and ground beef in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to. Step 3: Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, fresh parsley, garlic, basil, salt, oregano, and sugar. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes. Step 6: While the sauce is simmering, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 7: Cook lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to. Step 8: Drain and set aside. Step 9: While the noodles are cooking, preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 10: Mix cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, eggs, remaining fresh parsley, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until combined. Step 11: Assemble lasagna: Spread a spoon or two of sauce over the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish just to to coat it. Step 12: Place two layers of noodles over the sauce to cover. Step 13: Layer with 1/2 of the cheese mixture, 1/2 of the remaining sauce, and 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese. Step 14: Repeat layers once more using the remaining noodles, cheese mixture, sauce, and mozzarella. Step 15: Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil. Step 16: Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to. Step 17: Remove the foil and bake until cheese is golden brown, 5 to 10 more minutes. Step 18: Remove from the oven and let stand for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, italian-style tomatoes, garlic, onions, butter, serrano pepper, mushrooms, red wine, fresh basil, oregano, fresh bay leaf, italian sausage links
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large frying pan. Step 2: Add onion and garlic, cook until done but not brown. Step 3: Add both cans of tomatoes, spices, mushrooms, wine, meat (if using) and peppers to the onion and garlic mixture; simmer while pasta cooks and until peppers are dark green. Step 4: Cook pasta according to instructions; drain well. Step 5: Serve sauce over penne.

Dish Name: I Lost My Noodles! Low Carb/South Beach Eggplant Lasagna
Ingredient Names: eggplants, cooking spray, salt, pepper, turkey breast, olive oil, onions, garlic, red peppers, mushrooms, italian seasoning, fennel seeds, red pepper flakes, spinach, red wine, tomato sauce, tomatoes, low-fat ricotta cheese, eggs, green onions, lowfat mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Spray cookie sheet, arrange eggplant slices and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook slices 5 minutes on each side. Step 4: Lower oven temp to 375. Step 5: Brown meat, onion and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add red pepper and mushrooms, and cook 5 minutes. Step 7: Add spinach, tomatoes, tomato sauce, spices and wine and simmer for 5-10 minutes. Step 8: Blend ricotta, egg and Green onion. Step 9: Blend together Mozzarella and Parmesan Cheese. Step 10: Spread 1/3 of meat sauce in bottom of 9” x 13” glass pan. Step 11: Layer ½ eggplant slices. Step 12: Dollop and Spread ½ ricotta. Step 13: Layer 1/3 mozzarella/parmesan mixture, rEPEAT. Step 14: Add last layer of sauce, then mozzarella/parmesan mixture on top. Step 15: Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Step 16: Remove foil and bake or broil another 5-10 minutes until cheese is browned. Step 17: Let it rest 10 minutes before slicing, if you can wait that long!

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, fat sausages, olive oil, spinach, pine nuts, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, squeeze the sausages from their skins, then roughly break the meat into 12 pieces. Roll into balls. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the sausage balls, then cook over a medium heat until golden, about 5 mins. Pile the spinach on top of the sausage balls and cook, stirring frequently, for 2-3 mins until completely wilted. Season with a little salt and plenty of ground black pepper, then toss in the toasted pine nuts. Step 3: Add the drained pasta to the sausages and spinach, then toss well, adding half the parmesan. Serve spooned into individual serving bowls with the rest of the parmesan scattered on top.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, italian sausages, onions, green bell peppers, garlic, tomatoes, kalamata olives, tomato paste, capers, anchovy paste, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain well. Step 2: Meanwhile, remove casings from sasage and saute with onion, pepper and garlic over medium-high heat, stirring and crumbling sausage until sausage is done and vegetables softened (about 7 or 8 minutes). Step 3: Remove from heat and drain off fat. Step 4: Add tomatoes, olives, tomato paste, capers and anchovy paste to pan and bring to a boil. (I like to give the tomatoes a couple of pulses in the food processor to break them up a little). Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, remove from heat. Step 6: Add pasta and stir to combine. Step 7: Spray 8-inch square casserole dish with non-stick spray. Step 8: Spoon mixture into casserole and sprinkle evenly with Parmesan cheese. Step 9: Bake at 400°F for about 15 minutes until cheese melts and begins to brown.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, italian sausages, chicken stock, penne pasta, carrots, onions, celery, green beans, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the sausages until brown all over. Pour in the hot chicken stock and simmer with a lid on for 10 mins. Step 2: Add the pasta to the pan, mix well and bring to the boil. Stir in the carrots and onions, cook for 5 mins, then add the celery and beans, and cook for a further 4 mins. Check that the pasta is cooked – if not, cook for a few minutes longer. Finally, stir in chopped parsley, season, and serve in large bowls.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, fresh breadcrumb, milk, ground beef, italian sausages, parsley, red wine, tomatoes, macaroni, butter, flour, tasty cheese such as mature cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Make the white sauce. Melt the butter in a medium pan, then stir in the flour. Keeping the heat high, whisk in the milk and bring to the boil, whisking until smooth and thickened. Season with a good pinch of salt and some pepper, then stir in most of the grated cheese and set aside, with the surface covered with cling film to stop if forming a skin. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large, heavy-based casserole or frying pan, then add the onions and garlic and a real good grind of black pepper and salt. Cook slowly and gently until the onions are soft but not coloured. Take half the mix out and mix with the breadcrumbs and milk in a large bowl. Using a slotted spoon, lift the rest of the onions out of the pan, leaving the oil behind, and set aside. Step 3: Mix the mince and sausagemeat, chopped parsley and lots of salt and pepper into the breadcrumbs. Mix really well with your hands until the whole thing becomes pasty rather than lumpy. Shape into the size of ping-pong balls, then heat the pan again and brown the Simply serve with a fresh green salad balls in batches in the leftover onion oil. Remove the final batch, then return the reserved onions to the pan with the wine. Bubble over a high heat, scraping the bottom of the pan, then stir in the tomatoes and meatballs. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 mins. Can be made up to 2 days ahead or frozen. Step 4: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and boil the macaroni according to pack instructions. Drain well, then mix with the meatball sauce. Tip into the largest ovenproof dish you have. Top with the white sauce (warm it a bit if it is slightly solid), then scatter with the remaining cheese. Bake for 35-40 mins until bubbling and golden.

Ingredient Names: penne, olive oil, red chili seeds, garlic, anchovies, young kale, lemons, parmesan half
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. While it’s cooking, heat half the oil in a saucepan, then sizzle the chilli, garlic and anchovies. Add the kale, then gently fry until tender, adding a drop of water if needed. Step 2: Drain the pasta, reserving a few tbsp water, then toss the pasta and water through the kale, adding the rest of the olive oil, lemon juice and grated Parmesan. Serve scattered with the Parmesan shavings.

Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, zucchini, salt, olive oil, yellow onions, garlic, italian seasoning, ground beef, fresh black pepper, marinara sauce, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, eggs, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Step 2: Use a mandolin to cut the zucchini into strips, about 1 cm thick. Add the strips to a colander and toss with 1 teaspoon of salt. Let drain for 10 minutes. Layer the zucchini strips between layered sheets of paper towels on a baking sheet. Let dry while you make the filling. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onions, garlic and Italian seasoning and cook until translucent, about 7-10 minutes. Step 4: Add ground beef and and cook until browned, breaking up with a wooden spoon. Drain any fat and season with salt and pepper. Stir in 2 cups of the marinara sauce and remove from heat. Step 5: Add cottage cheese, 2 cups mozzarella, eggs, garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper to a bowl and stir to combine. Step 6: Spread about 3/4 cup of meat sauce into the bottom of the baking dish. Add a layer of zucchini strips to cover the entire area, slightly overlapping. Spread over 3/4 cup of the cottage cheese mixture. Repeat four more times, ending with the cottage cheese layer. Step 7: Spread the remaining marina sauce over the top and sprinkle with remaining shredded mozzarella. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Place the dish on top of a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes. Step 8: Uncover and bake another 25-30 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and browned. Step 9: Let cool 10 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti squash, bacon, minced garlic, eggs, grated parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 2: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; place squash on top, cut-side down. Step 3: Bake in the preheated oven until skin is easily pierced with a fork, about 25-30 minutes. Step 4: While squash is cooking, fry bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crisp, 5 to. Step 5: Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate, reserving grease in skillet. Step 6: Crumble bacon when cool enough to handle. Step 7: Cool baked squash until easily handled. Step 8: Scrape flesh into noodles using a fork. Step 9: Place noodles and garlic in the skillet with the reserved bacon grease. Step 10: Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes; reduce heat to low. Step 11: Whisk eggs and Parmesan cheese together in a small bowl; add to skillet and stir continuously for 5 minutes. Step 12: Remove from heat and stir in cooked bacon pieces, parsley, salt, and pepper. Step 13: Serve immediately.
