Ingredient Names: italian sausage, ground beef, garlic, dried basil, salt, whole tomato, tomato paste, ricotta cheese, cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, eggs, ground black pepper, lasagna noodle, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the sausage and ground meat and drain all the fat. Step 2: Add all the other ingredients for the meat filling and simmer on the stove, uncovered, for about 1 / 2 hour I usually add a bay leaf or two. Step 3: Mix up the cheese filling and set aside in fridge until ready to use. Step 4: Put the noodles in salted water and cook until soft when poked with a fork. Step 5: When the noodles are done, drain the noodles and rinse off with cold water so they can be handled easily Spray the baking pan with a non-stick spray and put a layer of noodles down on the bottom of the pan It is ok to cut some of the noodles to fit into the pan if they do not fit whole. Step 6: Spread half the cheese filling over the noodels, then half of the mozarella cheese on top of that, then half of the meat sauce over the grated mozarella cheese. Step 7: Repeat layers and then top with more mozarella cheese.

Dish Name: Kittencal's Italian Tomato Pasta Sauce and Parmesan Meatballs
Ingredient Names: prepared meatballs, olive oil, onions, garlic, fresh bay leaf, oregano, fresh basil, salt, ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, tomato paste, dry red wine, tomatoes, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the meatball recipe as directed on the recipe; transfer to a plate cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use (the meatballs may be prepared up to 1 day in advance). Step 2: Drain the diced tomatoes over a strainer. Step 3: Coat bottom of large heavy-bottomed pot with olive oil, heat over medium heat. Step 4: Saute onion with bay leaf, oregano, basil, salt, black pepper and crushed chili peppers for about 5-7 minutes or until the onions are transparent. Step 5: Add in fresh garlic; cook stirring for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the tomato paste;mix and stir for about 2 minutes or until well combined with the onion mixture. Step 7: Add in the wine; stir well to combine. Step 8: Add the 2 cans crushed tomatoes (can use 3 cans if you are freezing some sauce) and the drained diced tomatoes, stir and bring to a light boil; boil for 5-8 minutes then reduce heat to low. Step 9: Add in uncooked meatballs to the sauce (if you are adding the meatballs uncooked do not stir for 30 minutes or you may run the risk of them falling apart in the simmering sauce). Step 10: Simmer uncovered on low heat for about 3-5 hours (the longer you simmer uncovered the thicker and richer your sauce will be so don't be afraid to simmer even 6 hours!) adding more salt if desired. Step 11: Skim off any fat that might gather on top of sauce. Step 12: Allow to cool to room temperature then refrigerate (with the meatballs in the sauce) a minimum of 1 day or up to 4 days before using. Step 13: Use as much as desired then freeze the rest for another meal, just reheat the sauce on top of the stove or heat in microwave (this will freeze well for up to 6 months). Step 14: Note: if desired, you can bake the meatballs in the oven before adding to the sauce.

Ingredient Names: wheat lasagna noodles, onions, garlic, ground turkey, mushrooms, green peppers, tomatoes, tomato sauce, oregano, fresh basil, parsley, ground black pepper, spinach, fat-free ricotta cheese, fresh chives, part-skim mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350°F. Step 2: Spray a large nonstick frying pan with vegetable cooking spray. Step 3: Cook onion and garlic for several minutes stirring constantly. Step 4: Add turkey and cook (crumbling the meat fine) until barely done about 4 minutes (if using precooked rinsed meat you don't need to cook for 4 minutes, just go to the next step). Step 5: Add the mushrooms and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add the green pepper, tomato, tomato sauce, oregano, basil, parsley and pepper and simmer 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Remove frying pan from heat. Step 8: While the sauce is cooking, cook noodles in a large pot of boiling water that has been sprayed with vegetable cooking spray until al dente. Step 9: Drain noodles and rinse with cold water and drain. Step 10: In a bowl, combine ricotta and chives, mix in spinach. Step 11: Spray a 9x13-inch baking pan with vegetable cooking spray. Step 12: Arrange 3 lasagna noodles on the bottom of the pan. Step 13: Spread evenly with one third of the ricotta mixture, then one third of the turkey mixture, and sprinkle with one third of mozzarella. Step 14: Repeat twice with remaining ingredients. Step 15: Bake for about 25 minutes or until cheese bubbles. Step 16: Cool at least 5 minutes before cutting.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, onion, celery, carrots, garlic, beef mince, tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, honey, lasagne sheets, creme fraiche, mozzarella balls, parmesan cheese, basil leaves, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Use kitchen scissors to snip the bacon into small pieces, or use a sharp knife to chop it on a chopping board. Step 3: Add the bacon to the pan and cook for just a few mins until starting to turn golden. Step 4: Add the onion, celery and carrot, and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook for 3-4 minutes, then tip in the mince and cook, stirring and breaking it up with a wooden spoon, for about 5 minutes until browned all over. Step 6: Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 3-4 minutes, mixing in well with the beef and vegetables. Step 7: Tip in the chopped tomatoes. Step 8: Fill each can half full with water to rinse out any tomatoes left in the can, and add to the pan. Step 9: Add the honey and season to taste. Step 10: Simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 11: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas To assemble the lasagne, ladle a little of the ragu sauce into the bottom of the roasting tin or casserole dish, spreading the sauce all over the base. Step 12: Place 2 sheets of lasagne on top of the sauce overlapping to make it fit, then repeat with more sauce and another layer of pasta. Step 13: Repeat with a further 2 layers of sauce and pasta, finishing with a layer of pasta. Step 14: Put the crème fraîche in a bowl and mix with water to loosen it and make a smooth pourable sauce. Step 15: Pour this over the top of the pasta, then top with the mozzarella. Step 16: Sprinkle Parmesan over the top and bake for 25– until golden and bubbling. Step 17: Serve scattered with basil, if you like.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, raw shrimp if, juice lemon, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan, add the prawns, then quickly fry until they are evenly pink. Step 2: Throw in the lemon zest and juice, parsley, 2 tbsp of the pasta cooking water and salt and pepper, then heat through. Step 3: Drain the spaghetti, add to the pan, then toss everything together. Serve with lemon wedges, if liked.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, grated parmesan cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, ground black pepper, salt, frozen peas, basil, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Step 3: Add shrimp and cook for 3 more minutes, drain. Step 4: Whisk Parmesan cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, pepper, and salt in a large bowl. Step 5: Add spaghetti, shrimp, and peas to sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle with basil and lemon zest; toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: puy, fresh fettuccine, butter, onions, garlic, juice lemon, cilantro stems, greek yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the lentils in a sieve and place in a medium saucepan. Cover with plenty of water and bring to the boil, then simmer for about 30 mins until tender, adding salt to taste 10 mins into cooking time. Drain thoroughly and keep warm. Step 2: Cook the pasta, then drain and return to the pan. Meanwhile, melt the butter in a frying pan over a medium heat and add the onion. Cook until lightly golden, then add the garlic and cook until fragrant. Stir the lentils, onion and garlic, lemon zest and juice, coriander and yogurt through the cooked pasta. Finish with plenty of freshly ground black pepper and serve on warm plates.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, fresh basil, margarine, paprika, unbleached flour, fresh black pepper, vegetable stock, fresh broccoli florets, milk, sweet red peppers, cheddar cheese, mushrooms, parmesan cheese, scallions, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil; cook pasta until al dente. Step 2: While pasta is cooking, in med saucepan, melt 2 T of the margarine. Step 3: Remove from heat; add flour and stir until blended. Step 4: Whisk in stock and milk, stirring over med heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Step 5: Reduce heat to low. Step 6: Stir in cheeses and seasonings. Step 7: Continue stirring until cheese is melted. Step 8: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 9: In a large skillet, melt remaining 1 T margarine. Step 10: Add remaining ingredients. Step 11: Cook vegetables, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes, until tender/crisp. Step 12: Reduce heat to low. Step 13: When noodles are done, drain well. Step 14: Toss with vegetables; stir in cheese sauce. Step 15: Garnish with scallion curls.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese, large eggs, dried parsley, salt, ground black pepper, manicotti shells, spaghetti sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 3: Cook manicotti in boiling water until al dente, about 10 to; drain and rinse with cold water. Step 4: Mix ricotta, mozzarella, Parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until well combined. Step 5: Pour spaghetti sauce into an 11x17-inch baking dish. Step 6: Stuff each manicotti shell with cheese mixture, and arrange over sauce. Step 7: Pour remaining sauce over the top of the shells and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Step 8: Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 25-30 minutes, serve and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, garlic powder, eggs, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, ground black pepper, maple syrup, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large, high-sided skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally and sprinkling with garlic powder, until browned and crispy, 7 to. Step 3: Meanwhile, beat eggs in a separate bowl. Step 4: Mix in Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese and black pepper. Step 5: Remove bacon onto paper towels to drain, reserving the oil and bacon grease in the pan. Step 6: Return bacon to the pan, stir in maple syrup, and bring to a simmer. Step 7: Quickly turn heat down to low and let simmer for 1 to. Step 8: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 9: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Drain pasta in a strainer set over large glass bowl. Step 11: Pour the pasta water into the skillet with the bacon; stir. Step 12: Add pasta and toss until coated. Step 13: Pour remaining pasta water out of the large bowl. Step 14: Drop the coated noodles into the bowl. Step 15: Pour in the egg mixture and quickly toss with the pasta until cheese has melted and sauce is creamy and smooth, 1 to.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, eggs, fresh breadcrumbs, milk, romano cheese, fresh basil, oregano, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix spices with breadcrumbs and grated cheese. Step 2: Thoroughly combine with remaining ingredients, by hand, shape into balls. Step 3: Brown in olive oil on all sides, or alternatively, bake in 400 degree oven for approx. Step 4: 20 to 30 minutes, till browned but not cooked through. Step 5: The meatballs maintain their shape better using the oven method. Step 6: Add to spaghetti sauce and simmer for 30 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, garlic, passata, oregano, sugar, red wine vinegar, fresh basil leaves, parmesan, ball mozzarella, lasagne, fresh breadcrumb
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Arrange the aubergine slices on a baking sheet, brush with oil and season well. Grill for 2-3 mins each side until golden brown, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a saucepan. Fry the garlic for 1 min then pour in the passata. Simmer for 10 mins with the oregano, sugar and vinegar, then season and stir in the basil. Step 3: Assemble the lasagne in a roughly A4-sized baking dish. Spread a few tbsp of the tomato sauce over the base of the dish, followed by a layer of aubergine. Scatter over some Parmesan and mozzarella, then cover with a layer of lasagne. Repeat, finishing with a topping of Parmesan and mozzarella, and sprinkle on the breadcrumbs. Step 4: Allow to cool at this point for freezing, or heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and cook the lasagne for 25-30 mins until golden and bubbling.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, tomato puree, mixed vegetables, vegetable stock, pasta shapes, baked beans, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and gently fry the onion for a few minutes until it starts to soften. Stir in the tomato purée, then tip in the frozen vegetables and pour in the stock. Step 2: Bring to the boil, add the pasta and stir. Cover and simmer for 12-14 minutes or until the pasta is cooked. Step 3: Stir in the beans and heat through, then taste for seasoning. Serve hot, with a bowl of grated cheddar for sprinkling over the top.

Ingredient Names: sausages skin meat out, bacon, mushrooms, pasta shapes, parmesan, egg yolks, parsley, half-fat creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Dry-fry the sausage meat in a non-stick pan for 8-10 mins until browned, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, then remove and set aside. Fry bacon and mushrooms for 5-8 mins until golden, return the sausage meat and keep warm. Step 2: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Make the sauce by beating together the Parmesan, egg yolks, most of the parsley and the crème fraîche. When the pasta is cooked, drain, reserving a ladle of the cooking water. Step 3: Combine the pasta and meat mixture over a low heat and add the sauce. Season and quickly mix, adding a splash of cooking water if it’s a little thick. Spoon into bowls and eat with the extra Parmesan shavings and remaining parsley on top.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, sliced fresh mushrooms, olive oil, garlic, eggs, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, place mushrooms in a dry skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Cook until they begin to brown and release moisture, 3 to. Step 5: Add oil and garlic. Step 6: Fry until softened, about more. Step 7: Beat eggs together in a bowl. Step 8: Add 1/2 of the Parmesan cheese. Step 9: Mix well and stir into cooked mushroom mixture. Step 10: Serve spaghetti topped with mushroom sauce and remaining Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: grape tomatoes, olive oil, salt, pepper, cremini mushrooms, butter, spaghetti, garlic, red pepper flakes, reserved pasta water, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the tomatoes onto the sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Season liberally with salt and pepper. Roast your tomatoes for 10-12 minutes. Transfer the pan to a wire rack and set aside. Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat melt 3 tablespoons butter. Add in the mushrooms and cook for 6-7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic, crushed red pepper and season well with salt and pepper. Continue cooking for another 3 minutes. Step 3: While the mushrooms are cooking, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Reserve 3/4 cup pasta water, and drain pasta. Step 4: Add the remaining 3 tablespoons butter to the mushrooms and melt. Add in the drained pasta, pasta water, and 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Mix thoroughly to coat pasta and melt cheese. Step 5: Sprinkle with parsley and fold in roasted tomatoes. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: fresh carrot, onions, mushrooms, olive oil, tomato, mixed herbs, tomato ketchup, vegetable stock concentrate, vegan ground meat, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the carrot and cut into small dice. Halve and peel the onion, then finely chop. Thickly slice the mushrooms. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the onion and carrots and cook over the heat, stirring frequently, for about 10 mins until the onion is soft. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for a few mins more. Step 3: Tip the tomatoes into the pan with half a can of water, the herbs, ketchup and stock, then stir well to make a sauce. Step 4: Stir the vegan mince into the sauce, season with salt and pepper, then cover and simmer for 12 mins until the vegetables are cooked and the mixture is saucy rather than wet. Step 5: Meanwhile, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Add the spaghetti and boil according to pack instructions – usually about 9-10 mins – until just tender. Step 6: Drain the spaghetti and pile into 4 bowls. Spoon the sauce on top, then generously grate over the cheese. Serve with crusty or garlic bread and a salad.

Ingredient Names: ground chuck, garlic, parsley flakes, oregano, eggs, plain breadcrumbs, milk, spanish onion, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients. Step 2: Shape into balls (i use my Pampered Chef med scoop) Place in baking pan, bake@ 325* deg. Step 3: For 20-30 min, until done.

Ingredient Names: basil, garlic cloves, balsamic vinegar, flat leaf parsley, lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, tomatoes, fettuccine, romano cheese, pine nuts, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Start by toasting your pine nuts Use a dry skillett and put pine nuts on over low heat Do not move away from the pan because they can burn easily. Step 2: Keep moving them around until they are golden and their aroma becomes strong. Step 3: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 4: In a blender or bowl of food proccesor combine basil, garlic, vinegar, parsley, and lemon juice With the machine running slowly add olive oil until thick. Step 5: Add tomatoes and blend 5 seconds. Step 6: Place sauce in a large bowl and set aside. Step 7: Cook pasta according to directions on package, drain.

Dish Name: Off The Boat Sicilian Pasta Sauce
Ingredient Names: fresh onion, olive oil, tomato sauce, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chop your 1 / 2 medium onion. Step 2: Take a medium size pot and simmer together your chopped onions and oil over medium heat until onions are tender. Step 3: Pour in your tomato sauce and stir well. Step 4: Let your sauce come to a boil for at least a half an hour. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 6: Stir in your desired amount of salt and pepper. Step 7: Cook for an additional half an hour. Step 8: After at least an hour of cooking, bring a pot of water to a boil for your pasta. Step 9: Let the sauce cook until pasta is drained and ready Scoop some sauce into your drained pasta to coat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, onions, ground beef, tomato passata, worcestershire sauce, italian herbs, beef bouillon cubes, to salt, fresh black pepper, water, orzo risoni, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large skillet/fry pan (or pot) over medium high heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes or until translucent. Step 2: Add the mince and turn the heat up to high. Cook the mince, breaking it up as you go. Step 3: When the mince is browned, add the remaining ingredients except the orzo. When the liquid comes to a simmer (it might bubble and spit slightly) add the orzo/risoni. Step 4: Give it a quick stir then turn the heat down to medium low. Step 5: Cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently towards the end to ensure the orzo/risoni doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan. If your liquid is evaporating too quickly, just add a slosh of hot water (tap or boiling). Step 6: Remove the risoni from the heat. The risoni should be a teeny bit hard still and it should be very saucy when you take it off the stove. Step 7: Check for seasoning (salt), then give it a good stir. Step 8: Serve immediately, while it's piping hot and nice and saucy, garnished with freshly grated parmesan and parsley, if desired.

Dish Name: Open ravioli with squash & porcini mushrooms
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, butter, grating nutmeg, vegetarian parmesan style cheese, porcini mushroom, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, saffron, chestnut mushrooms, fat garlic, baby spinach, lasagne, shavings parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Put the squash and butter in a pan with 5 tbsp water. Tightly cover pan and cook for 15 mins until the squash is just tender, but not coloured. Roughly mash with seasoning, nutmeg and Parmesan. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the dressing. Put the chopped porcini in a small bowl with 3 tbsp boiling water. Cover with cling film and cook for 1 min in the microwave on High, then leave to cool. Mix 1 tbsp oil with the vinegar and soy, then add the soaked mushrooms with almost all of the liquid (leave the last drop behind as it might contain grit). Step 3: To serve, boil a pan of water with the saffron and some salt for 5 mins to extract some colour and flavour. Meanwhile, fry the mushrooms in the remaining oil. When they are nearly cooked, add the garlic so that it browns and crisps, but doesn’t burn. Pierce the bag of spinach and wilt in the microwave for 1 min. Reheat the squash in the microwave, too. Step 4: Boil the lasagne for 1 min until just tender, then drain. Put 3 little piles of spinach on 2 warm serving plates. Top each with a square of lasagne, then a spoonful of squash – spread it out a little, add a few spinach leaves, then top with another square of pasta. Continue these layers until you end up with a stack of 4 layers of pasta on each plate, then top each with a spoonful of squash. Scatter round the garlicky mushrooms, Prepare ahead. Step 5: The squash can be mashed and the dressing made up to 2 days ahead; keep them both covered in the fridge. To serve, reheat the squash in a pan or in the microwave and take the dressing out to come to room temperature generously spoon over the dressing, or allow guest to help themselves at the table, and sprinkle over some Parmesan shavings, if you like.

Dish Name: Pasta & meatball soup with cheesy croutons
Ingredient Names: olive oil, ready-made mini meatballs, tomatoes, milk, oregano, pasta shapes, wholemeal baguette, cheddar, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large, deep frying pan and fry the meatballs for 5-10 mins until browned. Tip in the tomatoes, milk, 200ml water and oregano and simmer for 10-15 mins, until the soup thickens a little. Step 2: Pour in the pasta shapes and simmer until cooked – follow pack timings. Meanwhile, make the cheesy croutons. Heat grill to High, pop the baguette slices on a baking tray and top with the cheese. Grill until melted, keep warm. Step 3: When the pasta is cooked, remove the soup from the heat and stir in the basil. Divide between bowls and serve with the basil and cheesy croutons on top.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, extra-virgin olive oil, unsalted butter, yellow onion, garlic, pancetta, prosciutto, chicken, cream, cheese, large egg, basil, parsley, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 10 to, drain. Step 3: While the pasta is cooking, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat; stir in onion and garlic. Step 4: Cook and stir until the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Add pancetta and prosciutto; saute until crisp and brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken and saute until heated through, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the heat and set aside to cool slightly. Step 8: Whisk cream, Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, egg yolks, basil, and parsley together in a large bowl until blended. Step 9: Return chicken mixture to the stove over medium-low heat. Step 10: Add drained penne and cream mixture; toss over medium-low heat until penne is thickly coated, about 5 minutes; do not let it boil or the eggs will scramble. Step 11: Taste and season with salt and pepper if necessary. Step 12: Transfer to a large, wide serving bowl and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: eggs, olive oil, salt, flour
Instructions: Step 1: I just add flour salt oil and eggs to bread machine turn it on to dough setting and let it do the work for 10 minutes then cut into 8 chunks and feed it through the pasta maker. Step 2: Cook in salted boiling water for 3 miutes and serve with your sauce of choice. Step 3: It too simple and the taste is great, very light, best of all most people have everything you need in the kitchen.

Ingredient Names: linguine, white mushrooms, zucchini, broccolini, snow peas, green asparagus, green peas, cherry tomatoes, garlic, unsalted butter, thickened heavy cream, parmigiano reggiano, virgin olive oil, pasta cooking water, cooking kosher salt, fresh black pepper, fresh basil leaves, pinenuts
Instructions: Step 1: Broccolini - Cut off florets then cut in half lengthwise. Then slice the stems diagonally into 2.5 cm / 1" lengths. Step 2: Snow peas - Remove the tough string running down the "seam" of the pea. Stack several peas and slice on the diagonal about 1cm / 0.4" wide. Step 3: Asparagus - Snap the base off the asparagus, it will naturally break where the woody stem stars. Cut tips off, leave whole and set aside. Slice the stems diagonally into 2.5 cm / 1" lengths. Step 4: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Add cream and Parmigiano reggiano. Stir, and once the cream starts simmering gently, stir until the cheese melts then take it off the stove and set aside. Step 5: Bring a large pot of water to the boil over high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of salt and add the pasta. Cook for the time per the packet minus 1 minute. Meanwhile, cook vegetables. Step 6: Reserve pasta water: Just before draining the pasta, scoop out a mug of pasta cooking water and set aside. Drain the pasta. Step 7: Mushrooms: Heat half the olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook mushrooms for 4 minutes until golden, remove to a plate. Step 8: Veg: Heat remaining oil in the same skillet. Cook broccolini, snow peas and asparagus for 2 minutes. Add zucchini, tomato, green peas, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook for a further 3 minutes. Add mushroom back in, toss, then remove from heat. Step 9: Toss! Return pasta into the now-empty pot. Add vegetables, cream sauce and 1/3 cup pasta water. Toss over medium heat using 2 wooden spoons until the sauce thickens and clings to the pasta strands rather than pooling in the base of the pot, about 1 to 2 minutes. (If at any stage the pasta gets too thick, add a splash more pasta water and toss on stove). Step 10: Basil & pine nuts - Quickly toss through basil. Divide between 4 bowls. Sprinkle with pine nuts. Devour immediately!

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, parmesan cheese, unsalted butter, onions, garlic, zucchini, spinach, ricotta cheese, eggs, salt, pepper, nutmeg, parsley, plum tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: FILLING: Melt butter over medium heat in a large, heavy dutch oven. Step 2: Add onions& garlic; cook until onions are tender& wilted, stirring occasionally. Step 3: PREPARE ZUCCHINI: Wash well, taste a bit of the skin from each& peel only if it tastes bitter. Step 4: Grate& place in a colander in the sink. Step 5: Sprinkle with about 2 tsps of salt& let excess liquid drain for 30 minutes. Step 6: Rinse with cold water to remove most of the salt& then toss on a clean tea towel (or paper towels) to dry before cooking. Step 7: Add drained zucchini to dutch oven& cook until any moisture evaporates. Step 8: PREPARE SPINACH: Wash well& trim off tough stems. Step 9: Place leaves, with water from washing still clinging to them, in a large pot. Step 10: Cook for a few minutes or just until leaves have wilted. Step 11: Let cool, then wring dry in a clean tea towel& chop. Step 12: Add spinach to the dutch oven and combine thoroughly. Step 13: Remove from heat& allow the mixture to cool. Step 14: Drain off excess liquid. Step 15: Beat eggs in a medium sized bowl; add ricotta& beat until smooth. Step 16: Add Parmesan and seasonings; mix well. Step 17: Combine with vegetable mixture in the dutch oven, mix thoroughly; set aside. Step 18: SAUCE: Melt butter in large, heavy pot; cook onions& garlic until tender and wilted. Step 19: Add tomatoes, including their liquid, breaking up the tomatoes with a wooden spoon. Step 20: Cook for 30- 45 minutes or until sauce has thickened. Step 21: Purée and test for seasonings, set aside. Step 22: Pasta: Cook shells in a large pot of salted water, according to package directions until"el dente". Step 23: Drain well and rinse with cold water to stop cooking and prevent sticking. Step 24: Using a colander, gently shake shells to drain excess water. Step 25: Lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch casserole dish. Step 26: Spoon some of the filling into each shell& arrange, stuffed side up, in the casserole dish. Step 27: Pour sauce over the shells& sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Step 28: (If you can only find small shells, just layer them on the bottom of the casserole dish, cover with a layer of filling, a layer of sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan). Step 29: Bake at 350°F for 40-50 minutes or until heated through and bubbling.

Dish Name: Pasta With Roasted Garlic and Cherry Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, garlic, virgin olive oil, fresh basil, salt, pepper flakes, ground pepper, bucatini pasta, parsley, shaved parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl toss sliced tomatoes, sliced garlic, oil, basil, salt, hot pepper flakes and ground pepper. Step 2: Place in a 9 X 13 metal cake pan and roast at 400°F for approximately 30 minute. Step 3: The tomatoes should be shriveled and the garlic tender. Step 4: Cook pasta in a pot of salted boiling water while tomatoes and garlic are cooking. Step 5: Drain and return pasta to pot. Step 6: Add garlic tomato mixture and parsley, tossing to coat. Step 7: Serve with sprinkle freshly grated Parmesan cheese. Step 8: If you don't have any fresh Parmesan try other sharp hard cheeses such as Romano or Asiago.

Dish Name: Pasta With Sardine Sauce (Pasta Con Sardine Siciliano)
Ingredient Names: sardine fillet, virgin olive oil, garlic, tomato paste, seedless raisin, oregano, fresh basil leaves, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cut fish into 1" pieces. Step 2: Saute garlic in olive oil over medium heat until golden. Step 3: Add sardines and continue to saute and stir until almost a paste (approximately 7 minutes). Step 4: Add tomato paste and 3 to 5 tomato paste cans of water to the fish and bring to boil. Step 5: Add herbs (leaves only)and raisins. Step 6: Reduce heat, add salt and pepper; simmer until thick. Step 7: Place cold water into large pot and start to the boil. Step 8: Boil pasta until al dente, drain and toss with sauce. Step 9: Serve with grated cheese on the side.

Dish Name: Pasta With Spinach, Sun-dried Tomatoes & Artichoke Hearts
Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomato, pasta, onions, garlic, olive oil, mushrooms, soy sauce, ground black pepper, artichoke hearts, kalamata olives, pine nuts, spinach, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the sun-dried tomatoes in hot water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain, and slice into thin strips. Step 3: At the same time, take the spinach from the freezer and allow to semi-defrost in a colander. Step 4: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 5: Saute onion and garlic in oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat 2 to 3 minutes. Step 6: Add mushrooms, soy sauce, and pepper and saute for another 3 minutes until vegetables are tender. Step 7: Add tomatoes, artichoke hearts, olives and pine nuts, mix well. Step 8: Add spinach, mixing well until everything is combined and heating through. Step 9: Add vegetable mixture to drained pasta. Step 10: Add feta, and mix well, serve!

Ingredient Names: fresh broccoli, orecchiette pasta, olive oil, garlic, anchovy oil, red chile, half lemon, parmesan shavings
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling water for 3 mins, then drain, reserving the cooking water. Cook the pasta in the same water as the broccoli according to pack instructions. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan, then fry garlic until lightly golden. Remove garlic, then set aside. Add anchovies, chilli and half a cup of pasta cooking water to the pan. Cook for 2 mins, until the liquid has reduced by half and the anchovies have broken down. Stir in the broccoli and a squeeze of lemon juice, then cook for 1 min, until the broccoli has warmed through. Drain the pasta then toss everything together. Serve scattered with parmesan.

Dish Name: Pasta with Roasted Butternut Squash and Sage
Ingredient Names: pasta, butternut squash, sage, fresh breadcrumbs, garlic, parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the squash into half-inch cubes, and toss with olive oil and a dash of salt and pepper. Step 2: Place on a greased baking sheet. Step 3: Heat the oven to 350°, and roast the squash until soft. Step 4: Roasting time will vary from 15 to 25 minutes, depending on the age of the squash. Step 5: Remove from the oven and toss the squash with the chopped sage to infuse the flavor, let cool. Step 6: In a hot skillet, toast the breadcrumbs. Step 7: (If desired, sauté a little garlic in oil until brown, then add the breadcrumbs and continue toasting.) In a large pot, bring water to a boil and add the pasta. Step 8: Cook until the pasta is al dente (meaning it has a bit of resistance when bitten into). Step 9: Drain the pasta, then toss with the squash, breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 10: (If the pasta seems too dry, toss with a little chicken or vegetable stock, or a bit of the pasta water.). Step 11: Garnish with fried sage leaves and Parmesan cheese shavings.

Dish Name: Pasta with Scallops and Lemon Butter Mustard Sauce
Ingredient Names: dry white wine, lemons, bay scallops, dijon mustard, low-fat butter, pasta, fresh chives, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer wine and lemon zest in medium saucepan. Step 2: Add scallops and cook and stir for 1 minute. Step 3: Take out scallops, raise heat and reduce wine to about 1/4 cup. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, whisk in mustard, then butter, in small pieces. Step 5: Add scallops and any juice and heat through. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Put sauce over cooked pasta-angel hair is good, and sprinkle on chives.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, chili flakes, wholemeal penne pasta, tomato, red wine, oregano, young spinach leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and gently fry the onion, garlic and chilli flakes, stirring regularly, for 5 mins (add a little water if they begin to stick). Step 2: Cook pasta following pack instructions. Add the tomatoes, wine and oregano to the frying pan and stir to combine. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins. Step 3: Shake the spinach into the pan and cook for 1-2 mins until wilted. Drain the pasta and tip into the pan with the sauce. Toss to combine, sprinkle with cheese and serve.

Ingredient Names: pasta, fresh broccoli florets, soya beans, peas, mange tout, mascarpone, juice lemon, parmesan, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in a very large pan following the pack instructions, adding broccoli florets, frozen soya beans, frozen peas and mange tout for the final 3 mins of cooking time. Step 2: Drain, saving a ladleful of the cooking water first, then tip everything back into the pan. Stir in mascarpone or soft cheese, zest and juice 1 lemon, grated Parmesan, a handful basil leaves, some seasoning and a splash of cooking water.

Ingredient Names: pasta, walnut halves, garlic, fresh basil leaves, parmesan, butter, extra-virgin olive oil, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. Meanwhile, put the walnuts and garlic in a food processor and whizz until finely chopped. Add the basil, cheese, butter and oil and pulse a few more times. Season. Step 2: Pour the cream into a pan and warm through. Add two-thirds of the pesto, then gently heat to loosen it. When the pasta is ready, drain, reserving 2 tbsp of the cooking water, then mix both with the sauce. Serve immediately, sprinkled with the extra Parmesan and basil, if using. The leftover pesto will keep in the fridge for up to a week, or frozen for up to a month.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, leeks, garlic, spinach, creme fraiche, orecchiette, blue cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the leeks and garlic and let them soften for 15 mins. Stir in the spinach or kale for final few mins to wilt. Add the crème fraîche, stir and remove from the heat. Step 2: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water. Drain the pasta, put it back in its saucepan, then stir the leek sauce into it. Serve in bowls with crumbled blue cheese on top.

Ingredient Names: tagliatelle, fresh flat-leaf parsley, hazelnuts, parmesan, juice lemon, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in salted, boiling water according to pack instructions. Step 2: Put the parsley, hazelnuts, Parmesan and lemon zest and juice into a food processor and whizz to a paste. With the motor still running, gradually drizzle in the olive oil. Season, if you like, with salt and pepper. Step 3: Drain pasta, return to pan and stir in pesto. Divide pasta between serving bowls and serve.

Ingredient Names: pasta shapes, baby spinach, walnuts, wild arugula, flat-leaf parsley leaves, sage leaves, fresh chives, basil tarragon, olive oil, parmesan, pine nuts, garlic, fresh basil, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the pesto ingredients to a paste in a pestle and mortar or food processor. Step 2: Cook the pasta. Drain, return to the pan with the pesto and stir over a low-ish heat for 2-3 mins – not any longer or the sauce will go grey. Add the spinach and stir well for 1 min until it wilts. Add the walnuts, rocket, parsley, sage, chives, basil and tarragon, if using, and oil. Take off the heat and stir well before serving sprinkled with grated Parmesan.

Dish Name: Pasta with pine nuts, broccoli, sardines & fennel
Ingredient Names: extra-virgin olive oil, bucatini, purple sprouting broccoli if very, red onions, garlic, fennel bulb very, salted sardine, pine nuts, raisins, zest lemon, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, with a splash of oil, then add the pasta. Cook following pack instructions, adding the broccoli for the final 5 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, gently heat the oil in a large pan. Add the onions and sliced garlic, and cook slowly for 2 mins. Add the fennel and cook for a couple more mins, until softened. Flake the sardines into the pan and stir around for a few more mins to break them up. Step 3: Tip the pasta and broccoli into the pan with the pine nuts, raisins and lemon juice. Toss together to let the pasta absorb the oil, season well and serve immediately, scattered with lemon zest and chilli flakes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, celery, bacon, green lentils, tomatoes, bay leaves, thyme, chicken stock, macaroni, parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large heavy bottomed casserole. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, celery and bacon. Step 3: Cook stirring over low heat for 10-15 minutes until vegetables soften. Step 4: Add lentils and stir well to coat in oil. Step 5: Add fresh and canned tomatoes, bring to boil. Step 6: Add bay leaves, thyme and stock. Step 7: Simmer for about 40- 60 minutes or until the lentils are cooked. Step 8: Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente, drain. Step 9: Serve the soup in bowls, garnish with parsley and sprinkle with parmesan.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, fresh broccoli florets, olive oil, garlic, red onions, mushrooms, zucchini, chicken broth, oregano, red pepper flakes, tomatoes, spinach, lemon rind, salt, fresh black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Step 2: Add broccoli for the last 2 minutes of cooking pasta. Step 3: Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a large frying pan, add olive oil, garlic, onion and mushrooms and saute' for about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Now add sliced zucchini and continue to saute' for another 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add chicken broth, oregano and red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium, add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Stir in spinach and lemon rind; cook covered for 2 minutes or until spinach is tender. Step 9: When done, add cooked mixture to pasta/broccoli and toss to coat well. Step 10: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 11: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Step 12: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Pesto & tomato pasta with crispy crumbs
Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, olive oil, tomatoes, sugar, basil pesto, capers, white bread stale, pine nuts, parmesan, butter, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Gently cook the onion and half the garlic in 2 tbsp olive oil for 10 mins until soft. Stir in the tomatoes and sugar and simmer for 15-20 mins until saucy. Stir in half the pesto, some seasoning and a few capers or olives, if you have them. Cover and keep warm. Step 2: While the sauce is simmering, heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Toss the crumbs in a large baking tray with the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil, the rest of the garlic, the pine nuts and Parmesan, if Simple yet special storecupboard supper using. Bake for 10 mins, stirring a few times, until golden. Dot over the butter and return to the oven for 2 mins more. Step 3: Meanwhile, bring a pan of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta. Drain, reserving a little cooking water. Stir through the sauce with a splash of cooking water to loosen, if you need to, ripple through the remaining pesto and serve scattered with golden crumbs.

Ingredient Names: pasta, pesto, olive oil, onion, salt, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 3: Stir in pasta and return to a boil. Step 4: Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to. Step 5: Drain; transfer into a large bowl. Step 6: Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Step 7: Add onion; cook and stir until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Stir in pesto, salt, and black pepper until warmed through. Step 9: Stir pesto mixture into hot pasta; stir in grated cheese to coat.

Dish Name: Pesto and Tomato Angel Hair Pasta
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, garlic, fresh basil leaves, pine nuts, parmesan cheese, salt, fresh black pepper, virgin olive oil, tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Cook angel hair pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Turn on food processor and drop garlic down feed tube. Step 3: Stop the processor and add basil, nuts, cheese and salt and pepper. Step 4: Pulse until finely chopped, then with motor running, add oil gradually through tube until blended. Step 5: Drain pasta and reserve some of cooking water. Step 6: Toss pasta with the pesto, then add tomatoes. Step 7: If mixture is too thick, add a little cooking water. Step 8: Can be served hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, onion, garlic, red chili, tomato puree, pilchards, black olives, shaved parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Step 2: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and cook the onion, garlic and chilli for to soften. Step 3: Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 3-4 minutes, then add the pilchards with their sauce. Step 4: Cook, breaking up the fish with a wooden spoon, then add the olives and continue to cook for a few more mins. Step 5: Drain the pasta and add to the pan with the cooking water. Step 6: Toss everything together well, then divide between plates and serve, scattered with Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: dry penne pasta, olive oil, prosciutto, onions, red pepper flakes, dry white wine, tomatoes basil oregano garlic, cornstarch, half-and-half, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta per directions on package. Step 2: Meanwhile, prepare sauce. Step 3: Heat olive oil in large skillet. Step 4: Add chopped prosciutto, onion, and dried red pepper flakes and saute until onions are golden (about 5 minutes). Step 5: Remove pan from burner and add wine. Step 6: Return pan to burner and stir, loosening up any browned bits from bottom of the pan and reducing liquid by half (about 2 minutes). Step 7: Add tomatoes and bring to a boil reducing juices slightly (about 2 minutes). Step 8: In a separate bowl, dissolve cornstarch in half and half and stir into the sauce. Step 9: Simmer 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened slightly. Step 10: Drain pasta, toss with sauce, and sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, onions, mushrooms, green peppers, pepperoni, pasta sauce, oregano, fresh basil, garlic, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saute vegetables. Step 2: Cook until soft, stirring often. Step 3: Stir in sauce (leave a small amount separate to place in the bottom of the pan) and spices, and finely chopped or grated pepperoni. Step 4: Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch pan. Step 5: Top with 5 overlapping noodles, then 1/3 of the sauce mixture and 1/3 of the cheese. Step 6: Repeat layers twice. Step 7: Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes. Step 8: Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Step 9: *You can also add additional pizza toppings if you wish such as bacon, cheddar cheese, ham, tomatoes, etc*. Step 10: To freeze: wrap well, label and freeze. To serve: defrost overnight and bake as directed.

Ingredient Names: pasta, red wine vinegar, oil, dry pizza seasoning, salt, grape tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, black olives, red onions, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to directions. Step 2: Drain; rinse with cold water. Step 3: In small bowl, combine vinegar, oil, seasoning and salt. Step 4: In large bowl combine pasta, tomatoes, mozzarella, pepperoni, olives, onion, parmesan and basil. Step 5: Add dressing; toss. Step 6: Cover; refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 8 hours. Step 7: Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, pork fillet medallions, flour, eggs, fresh breadcrumbs, fresh basil, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan, then fry the garlic for a few secs. Add the chopped tomatoes and balsamic vinegar and bubble for about 15-20 mins until the sauce is thick. Step 2: Meanwhile, lay the pork medallions between two layers of cling film and bash with a rolling pin until they are about 1cm thick. Mix the flour with some seasoning in one bowl, put the egg in another 2 minutes and the breadcrumbs in a third. Dip the pork in the flour, then the egg, then the breadcrumbs. Heat a grill to hot, then cook the pork for 3 mins on each side, until golden and cooked through. Keep warm. Step 3: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Stir through the tomato sauce and the chopped basil, divide the pasta between 4 plates, put the crispy pork on top and eat immediately.

Ingredient Names: pork ground meat, apples, garlic, fresh white breadcrumbs, olive oil, spaghetti, onions, tomato, red peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Put the pork mince in a bowl and stir in the apple, garlic, breadcrumbs and some salt and pepper. Shape the mixture into 16 balls, cover and chill for 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the sauce. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan and add the onion. Cook for 2-3 mins, until softened, then tip in the tomatoes and half a can of water. Stir in the peppers along with some salt and pepper. Partially cover and simmer for 15 mins. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan and add the meatballs. Cook for 5-6 mins, stirring occasionally until they are browned all over. Set aside and keep warm. Step 4: Using a hand-held blender, whizz the tomato sauce until smooth. Carefully add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 5 mins, until cooked through. Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti following pack instructions, drain, then divide between serving plates. Top with the meatballs and sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, pumpkin, tomatoes, vegetable stock, spaghetti, mixed beans mild chili sauce, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a saucepan, then fry onions for 8 mins, until softened and just beginning to brown. Add the garlic and pumpkin, then fry for a further 5 mins, stirring occasionally. Stir in the tomatoes and stock. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 15 mins, until the pumpkin is tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in a large pan of boiling water according to pack instructions. Step 3: Add beans to the sauce, cook for 3-4 mins, until heated through, then season. Drain spaghetti well, return to pan, then stir in the sauce. Divide between serving bowls, then serve sprinkled with the cheese.

Ingredient Names: pasta, bacon, cream cheese, frozen peas, milk, grated parmesan cheese, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta as directed on the package. Step 2: Drain pasta and set aside. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Step 4: Drain bacon on paper towels. Step 5: Reserve drippings in the skillet. Step 6: Add cream cheese, peas, milk, Parmesan cheese, and garlic powder to reserved drippings. Step 7: Cook on low heat until cream cheese is melted and mixture is heated through. Step 8: Place pasta in a large bowl. Step 9: Add cream cheese sauce and bacon; mix lightly.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, onions, garlic, green peppers, mushrooms, salt, pepper, spaghetti sauce, tomatoes, parsley, fresh basil, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil, for the pasta. Step 2: Scramble fry the ground beef in olive oil, with garlic, salt and pepper. Step 3: Add the onions, peppers and mushrooms, and saute until onion is soft. Step 4: Add the spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, parlsey and basil. Step 5: Simmer for 20 minutes, or up to 1 hour. Step 6: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 7: Return to large pot. Step 8: Stir the sauce into the pasta, or serve separately. Step 9: Serve with freshly grated parmesan, mozzarella or cheddar cheese, homemade biscuits and a green salad. Step 10: Variation: For a beef stroganoff type of dish, use 2 cans of mushroom soup and 1 can of milk instead of the tomatoes and spaghetti sauce, and 1 package of egg noodles, instead of pasta, kids love this!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, mushrooms, thyme leaves, spinach, light soft cheese, parmesan, lasagne
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the garlic and cook for 1 min. Add the mushrooms and thyme, then cook for 3 mins until they start to soften. Throw in the spinach and stir until the heat of the pan wilts the leaves. Remove from the heat and stir in the soft cheese, 1 tbsp of the Parmesan and some seasoning. Step 2: Put a quarter of the spinach mix on the bottom of a medium-sized baking dish, lay 2 pasta sheets on top, then repeat until you have used all the pasta. Finish with the final quarter of the spinach mix, sprinkle over the rest of the Parmesan, then bake for 35 mins until golden and the pasta is tender.

Ingredient Names: sausages skins, fennel seeds, mushrooms, red wine, tomato pasta sauce, penne
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large, wide frying pan, then crumble in the sausage meat and fennel seeds (there’s no need to add any oil). Fry for a few mins until golden and the fat is released, stirring well to break up the meat. Add the mushrooms and fry for a few mins until beginning to soften. Stir in the wine now, if using, bubble for 1 min, then add the tomato sauce and heat through until bubbling. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the penne. When ready, drain and tip into the sauce. Mix well until completely coated, then divide between four plates, finishing with a little parmesan.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, garlic powder, onion powder, beef broth, tomatoes, italian seasoning, corkscrew macaroni, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook ground beef in skillet until browned. Step 2: Pour/drain off fat. Step 3: Add garlic powder, onion powder, broth, tomatoes& Italian Seasoning, bring to a boil. Step 4: Stir in uncooked pasta. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium heat& cook for 10 minutes or until pasta is done, stir in cheese. Step 6: Serve with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, ramen noodles, frozen peas, egg, parmesan cheese, kosher salt, red pepper flakes, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Transfer to paper towels to drain. Step 3: Add onion to bacon drippings in skillet; cook until tender, 3 to. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook ramen in a saucepan according to package directions, adding peas the last minute of cooking. Step 5: Reserve cooking water; drain. Step 6: Whisk together egg, Parmesan, onion and drippings, salt, and red pepper in a bowl. Step 7: Add hot ramen and cooked bacon. Step 8: Toss to coat, adding enough reserved cooking water to make a creamy consistency. Step 9: Top servings with parsley.

Ingredient Names: short pasta, fresh broccoli, cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, virgin olive oil, parmesan, garlic, mixed herbs, red pepper flakes, sugar, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta: Boil a large pot of water with 2 tsp salt, add pasta. Step 2: Chop broccoli: Chop broccoli into small florets. Step 3: Cook broccoli: Add broccoli into water 1 - 2 minutes before pasta is cooked. Step 4: Sauce ingredients in jar: Place Sauce ingredients in a jar with lid. Step 5: Reserve pasta water: SCOOP OUT 1 cup pasta cooking water just before draining. Then drain and return pasta back into same pot on turned off stove. Step 6: Add pasta water into Sauce: Add 1/2 cup pasta water to Pasta Sauce jar, shake well. Step 7: Add Sauce & Cheese to pasta: Pour Sauce and add cheese into pot with pasta. Step 8: Stir then serve! Stir vigorously, adding more pasta water if required. Add more salt and pepper if required. Serve immediately, garnished with parmesan.

Dish Name: Rigatoni Al Forno (Baked Rigatoni) with Roasted Asparagus and On
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, rigatoni pasta, fresh asparagus, salt, balsamic vinegar, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375°; put a large pot of water on to boil. Step 2: Pour olive oil into a 9x13 glass baking dish; break up onion chunks, add to pan and stir to coat in oil; leave pan uncovered, place in oven and roast onions 5 minutes. Step 3: Add pasta to boiling water. Step 4: After onions have roasted 5 minutes, add asparagus; stir and sprinkle with the salt; spread it all in a single layer and roast 5 more minutes. Step 5: Drain pasta when al dente; stir into vegetables and add vinegar, pepper and parmesan; mix well; sprinkle bread crumbs on top; cover with foil and return to oven. Step 6: Bake until bread crumbs are brown and crisp, 10-15 minutes. Step 7: Serve hot with a cruet of balsamic vinegar.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onions, garlic, italian plum tomatoes, tomato paste, anchovies oil, black olives, capers, fresh basil, oregano, red pepper flakes, fresh coarse ground black pepper, rigatoni pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy saucepan. Step 2: Add onion and garlic; cook over low heat for10 to 15 minutes, or until vegetables are wilted. Step 3: Crush tomatoes slightly; add to the saucepan along with their liquid. Step 4: Stir in tomato paste; cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Step 5: Coarsely chop the anchovies and add to the saucepan along with their oil. Step 6: Stir in olives, capers, basil, oregano, red-pepper flakes and black pepper. Step 7: Stir gently and simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: While sauce simmers, bring a large pot of water to a boil with remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Step 9: Add pasta and cook until just tender (al dente); for rigatoni, allow 10 to 12 minutes. Step 10: Drain pasta and serve topped with puttanesca sauce. Step 11: Pass the Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, olive oil, onions, fresh carrot, red wine, vegetable stock, tomato puree, butter, flour, milk, nutmeg, rigatoni, spinach, mature cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Slit the sausages and remove them from their skins, then chop them into small pieces. Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and fry for 5 minutes, until softened and lightly browned. Stir in the sausages and fry until lightly coloured. Add the carrot, then stir in the wine, stock, tomato purée, and season. Step 2: Bring to the boil, then simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes until thickened. Taste and season. Set aside. Step 3: Put the butter, flour and milk in a pan. Gently heat, whisking, until thickened and smooth. Add a sprinkle of freshly grated nutmeg, season, then simmer for 2 minutes. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 190C/Gas 5/fan 170C. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Add the pasta, stir well, then cook, uncovered, for 10-12 minutes, until tender. Remove from the heat, stir in the spinach and, when just wilted, drain well. Step 5: Tip half the pasta into a shallow ovenproof dish, about 2.2 litre/4 pint, and level. Spoon over the sausage sauce, then cover with the remaining pasta. Pour the white sauce evenly over the top and sprinkle with the cheddar. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown. Leave for 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni, olive oil, red onions, chestnut mushrooms, thyme, beef consomme from, tomato puree
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water, according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and fry gently for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the mushrooms and thyme, then add the consommé and tomato purée and bring to the boil. Step 2: Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 mins until the mushrooms are tender. Drain the pasta, return to the pan and stir in the mushroom sauce.

Ingredient Names: crown prince pumpkin, olive oil, spinach, butter, nutmeg for grating, lasagne, parmesan, onions, celery, garlic, cherry tomato, light muscovado sugar, full-fat milk, peppercorns, fresh bay leaf, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Halve the pumpkin or squash, peel, deseed, then slice into 1cm slices. Toss with the oil in a roasting tin, season, then roast until tender and slightly charred at the edges. This can take up to 40 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the tomato sauce. In a pan, soften the onion in the oil for 5 mins, then add the celery and garlic and cook for 1 min more. Add the tomatoes and sugar, then leave to simmer, uncovered, for 30 mins. Stir from time to time. You should be left with a thick purée. Season to taste. Step 3: Put the spinach in a saucepan with the water that still clings to it after washing, cover and put over a medium heat. Wilt the spinach for about 4 mins – you’ll need to turn it over with tongs every so often to make sure it all comes in contact with the heat at the bottom of the pan. When completely wilted, leave until cool enough to handle, then squeeze the water out with your hands. Chop and put in a pan with the butter. Gently heat, tossing together so the spinach is coated in butter, then season with salt, pepper and a generous grating of nutmeg. Step 4: For the béchamel sauce, bring the milk to the boil in a pan with the peppercorns, onion and bay leaf. Set aside for 5 mins to infuse, then strain the milk into another pan. Add the flour and butter, then gently heat, whisking all the while, until you have a thick, smooth sauce. Step 5: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and assemble the lasagne. Butter a large gratin or baking dish, roughly 1.4 litres in capacity. Put a layer of pumpkin in the bottom followed by a layer of tomato sauce. Lay lasagne sheets on top of this, cutting them to fit if necessary (you don’t want any overlapping). Now add a layer of béchamel followed by a scattering of spinach and half the cheese. Top with more lasagne sheets, pumpkin, tomato sauce, more lasagne and a final layer of béchamel sauce. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top. Bake for 40 mins, or until the lasagne is golden and bubbling.

Dish Name: Roasted asparagus, pancetta & cherry tomato pasta
Ingredient Names: penne, asparagus spears, olive oil, pancetta, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Boil the pasta in salted water. Put the asparagus into a roasting tin, then toss with the oil and pancetta. Roast for 10 mins until the pancetta starts to crisp up, stir in the tomatoes, then cook for 5 mins more. Step 2: Drain the pasta, then add to the roasting tin along with the torn basil leaves and seasoning. Stir well until everything is glistening, then serve in bowls, scattered with grated Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, fat garlic unpeeled, cherry tomato, balsamic vinegar, sugar, fresh basil leaves, pasta such as penne
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Toss the aubergine chunks with the oil and whole garlic cloves in a roasting tin with some seasoning. Roast for 10 mins, add the tomatoes, vinegar and sugar, then cook for another 5 mins. Meanwhile, cook the pasta, then drain. Step 2: When the veg is tender remove the garlic cloves, snip off their ends and squeeze the roasted garlic onto a board. Mash with a fork, then stir this garlic paste back into the veg with the basil leaves – squashing most of the tomatoes as you go. Tip in the cooked pasta, stir everything together in the roasting tin, divide between 2 bowls, then scatter with a few more basil leaves to serve.

Ingredient Names: tagliatelle, runner bean, prosciutto, olive oil, rounded half-fat creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the tagliatelle in a large pan of boiling, salted water according to pack instructions. Four mins before the end of the cooking time, add the runner beans. Step 2: Meanwhile, cut each slice of prosciutto into 5-6 pieces. Heat the oil in a frying pan, add the ham, then fry quickly until crisp. Drain the pasta and return to the pan with the crème fraîche, prosciutto, pan juices and plenty of black pepper, tossing everything together until the pasta is well coated.

Dish Name: San Francisco Vegetable Soup over Angel Hair Pasta
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, beef broth, san francisco style mixed vegetables, green beans, summer squash, fresh basil leaves, red pepper flakes, garlic salt, tomatoes, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Combine, in a large sauce pan, the beef broth, all the frozen and fresh vegetables, and spices through the garlic salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer covered for about 7-8 minutes. Step 3: Add the pureed tomatoes and cook till heated through. Step 4: Cook the pasta while the soup is heating, according to the package directions. Step 5: Place pasta in 6 soup bowls, dividing evenly, and ladle the soup mixture over it. Step 6: Sprinkle the cheese and parsley on top of the soup.

Ingredient Names: pasta shapes, purple sprouting broccoli, extra-virgin olive oil, garlic, fennel seeds, red chilies, italian-style pork sausages skins meat, parmesan shavings
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the pasta until nearly al dente. Throw in the broccoli and cook for 2 mins more. Drain, saving 1-2 tbsp of the water. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and add the garlic, fennel seeds, if using, and chillies. When they start to colour a bit, add the sausage and cook until golden and cooked through. Tip in the pasta and broccoli with the reserved water and toss. Serve hot with the Parmesan shavings.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pork sausage, onions, garlic, chili powder, tomatoes, short pasta such as fusilli
Instructions: Step 1: Put a large pan of water on to boil. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan and fry chunky pieces of 8 pork sausages on a fairly high heat until they are golden brown all over. Step 3: Now turn the heat down and add 1 large chopped onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves, cooking them until they have softened. Step 4: Stir in 1 tsp chilli powder and 400g chopped tomatoes with the sausages, bring the sauce to the boil then turn the heat down and let it bubble for about 10 minutes while you cook the pasta. Step 5: Drop 300g pasta into the pan of boiling water and cook according to the pack instructions. Step 6: Drain the pasta, then tip it into the frying pan with the sausage sauce, mixing well to coat. Dish up immediately with crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, passata garlic herbs, oregano, pasta shapes, spinach, ready-made cheese sauce, nutmeg, parmesan, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan and brown the sausages, using a wooden spoon to break up the meat. Pour off any fat from the pan, stir in the passata, bring to the boil, then add the oregano and season. Simmer for 10 mins. Step 2: Cook the pasta for 2 mins less than the pack says, reserve some cooking water, then drain, cool under cold water and drain again. Meanwhile, pour a kettle of boiling water over the spinach in a colander to wilt, then squeeze out all the water. Mix the pasta with the cheese sauce and some of the reserved water, to loosen. Season. Step 3: In a large dish, add the meat sauce, then the spinach, some nutmeg and seasoning. Next, add a third of the Parmesan, the cheesy pasta, more nutmeg and finally the rest of the cheese. Wrap and freeze. Defrost at room temperature for about 8 hrs. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bake for 40-45 mins, until the dish is piping hot and golden.

Ingredient Names: sausagemeat, white breadcrumb, thyme, olive oil, passata, sundried tomato paste, fusilli, savoy cabbage, ball mozzarella, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Put the sausagemeat, breadcrumbs and thyme or rosemary in a bowl and mix to combine. Shape into 20 small balls. Step 2: Heat oil in a wide pan and cook the sausageballs for 10 mins until nicely browned. Add passata and tomato paste, cover and simmer gently for 20 mins. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook pasta following pack instructions, adding the cabbage for the final 5 mins of cooking time. Drain cabbage and pasta, toss with the sauce and spoon into a heatproof dish. Step 4: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Push mozzarella cubes into the top of the pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan and bake for 15-20 mins until bubbling and crusty.

Ingredient Names: russet potatoes, garlic, onions, ground beef, salt, fresh black pepper, butter, flour, milk, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, heavy cream, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Step 2: After peeling the skin, make scalloped potatoes using a mandolin. Step 3: Place one layer of the thin potatoes in a greased 9"-by-9" sized baking pan. Step 4: In a hot, oiled skillet, cook chopped garlic and onions until soft then add ground beef; season with salt and black pepper. Step 5: Add a layer of the meat mixture over the layer of scalloped potatoes. Step 6: In another pan, melt butter then add flour, milk, parmesan cheese until it's mixed and melted. Step 7: Spoon some of the butter-cheese mixture over the ground beef in the baking pan. Step 8: Sprinkle on mozzarella cheese. Step 9: Add a second layer of scalloped potatoes, the ground beef mixture, the milky cheese, and more mozzarella cheese. Step 10: Top everything with a handful of shredded parmesan cheese, pour over heavy cream. Step 11: Bake for 1 hour covered with aluminium foil, and then 25 minutes uncovered. Step 12: After the dish cools a little, sprinkle on chopped chives and serve.

Ingredient Names: sea scallops, pepper, salt, shallots, white wine, oil, chicken broth, butter, spinach, cherry tomatoes, parsley, lemons, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle scallops with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp oil in skillet; add scallops and cook about 2 minutes each side, until browned; remove from skillet and keep warm. Step 3: In same skillet, heat remaining oil and add shallot and cook until softened; about 1 minute; stir in wine and cook until reduced by half; about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add broth, simmer. Step 5: Stir in butter and pasta and toss until heated thru. Step 6: Add spinach, cherry tomatoes, parsley and lemon zest, toss until spinach wilts, add scallops and serve.

Ingredient Names: pasta shells, cherry tomato, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, balls mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Drain, reserving a few tablespoons of water in the pan. Return pasta to the pan over a medium heat and add the tomatoes, oil and balsamic vinegar. Step 2: Cook for 1-2 mins, then season and stir through mozzarella and basil. Serve with grated parmesan.

Ingredient Names: linguine, butter, extra-virgin olive oil, shallots, garlic, red pepper flakes, shrimp, peeled and deveined, kosher salt, pepper, dry white wine, lemon, parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Gather ingredients. Step 2: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil; cook linguine in boiling water until nearly tender, 6 to, drain. Step 3: Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add shallots, garlic, and red pepper flakes; cook and stir until shallots are translucent, 3 to. Step 5: Season shrimp with kosher salt and black pepper. Step 6: Add to the skillet; cook until pink, stirring occasionally, 2 to. Step 7: Transfer shrimp to a plate; keep warm. Step 8: Add white wine and lemon juice to the skillet; bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food off of the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spoon. Step 9: Melt remaining butter in skillet; stir in olive oil and bring to a simmer. Step 10: Toss linguine, shrimp, and parsley in butter mixture until coated; season with salt and black pepper. Step 11: Drizzle with olive oil to serve, serve hot and.

Dish Name: Sicilian aubergine, pine nut & raisin fusilli
Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions, garlic, red chile, oregano, eggplants cubes, raisins, tomatoes, tomato puree, baby capers, red wine vinegar, fusilli, mint, pine nuts, aged ricotta
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy based pan, heat ½ tbsp of oil and gently cook the onion, garlic and chilli until soft with half the oregano. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat 3-4 tbsp of oil in another frying pan and start browning the aubergines. Once cooked, add to the onion mixture. Fry the raisins in another ½ tbsp oil and, when they have puffed up, add to the aubergine mix. Add the tomatoes, purée and rest of the oregano. Cook on a medium heat for 15-20 mins so all the flavours come together. Step 3: Finally add the capers and the vinegar and leave on a low heat while you cook the pasta in plenty of boiling, salted water. If the mixture becomes very thick add 100ml of water. Toss the pasta through the aubergine sauce and sprinkle with fresh mint and the pine nuts. Let everyone grate over their own cheese.

Ingredient Names: red peppers, red onions, mild red chilies, garlic coarsley, golden sugar, olive oil, tomatoes, pasta, basil leaves parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: To roast the veg, preheat the oven to 200C/gas 6/fan 180C. Scatter the peppers, red onions, chillies and garlic in a large roasting tin. Sprinkle with sugar, drizzle over the oil and season well with salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes, toss in the tomatoes and roast for another 15 minutes until everything is starting to soften and look golden. Step 2: While the vegetables are roasting, cook the pasta in a large pan of salted boiling water according to packet instructions, until tender but still with a bit of bite. Drain well. Step 3: Remove the vegetables from the oven, tip in the pasta and toss lightly together. Tear the basil leaves on top and sprinkle with Parmesan to serve. If you have any leftovers it makes a great cold pasta salad – just moisten with extra olive oil if needed.

Ingredient Names: ricotta spinach tortellini, peas, broad beans, olive oil, lemons, ricotta
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil. Step 2: Tip in the pasta, cook for 3-4 mins. Step 3: Add the frozen peas and broad beans, then cook for 1 min more to heat through. Step 4: Drain well, then toss through the olive oil and lemon zest. Step 5: Place on plates, dollop over the ricotta.

Ingredient Names: tomato puree, water, salt, olive oil, red chili flakes, spaghetti, garlic, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Step 3: Add garlic and sizzle until it starts to turn golden and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Stir in tomato puree, water, and salt. Step 5: Bring to a simmer on medium-high. Step 6: Once simmering, reduce to low heat and keep warm. Step 7: Pour olive oil into a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, season with chili flakes and heat until chili flakes start to sizzle, for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add raw spaghetti and toss until well coated with chili oil. Step 9: Pour in about tomato broth and, using tongs, move pasta from side to side to evenly distribute tomato broth. Step 10: Cook, occasionally moving pasta from side to side with tongs, all facing the same direction, until most of the broth has been absorbed or evaporated, and the spaghetti starts frying in the pan. Step 11: Turn spaghetti over with tongs, and evenly arrange in the pan. Step 12: Keep cooking until the pasta starts to brown, and even lightly chars. Step 13: Add about 2 more cups of tomato broth, and repeat the process. Step 14: Continue cooking until the spaghetti is as charred as you like, and cooked to your desired doneness. Step 15: More broth can be added at the end of the process for a saucier version, as shown in the video, or it can be served relatively dry. Step 16: Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and more chili flakes if desired.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaves, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan cheese, olive oil, kosher salt, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, milk, ground beef, parsley, italian seasoning, eggs, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese, spaghetti, pesto sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To make the pesto:. Step 2: Combine basil leaves, pine nuts, garlic, 1/3 cup parmesan cheese, olive oil and a pinch salt in a food processor. Puree until almost smooth. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Lightly spray a 12-cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. Step 4: To make meatballs:. Step 5: In a large bowl, mix to combine breadcrumbs and milk. Add the ground beef, parsley, Italian seasoning, grated parmesan cheese, egg, salt and pepper. Divide into 12 equal balls. Flatten into patties and place a mozzarella cube in the center, then close the meat around to make a ball. Step 6: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium. Working in batches if necessary, brown the meatballs, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from skillet and seat aside on a plate. Step 7: To make spaghetti cups, combine cooked spaghetti with 1/2 cup pesto, 2 beaten eggs, 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese and 1 cup grated mozzarella. Divide spaghetti into prepared muffin tin and make a well in the center of each. Step 8: Place a meatball in the center of each spaghetti nest. Top with 2 teaspoons of grated mozzarella cheese. Bake for 15 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, bacon, garlic, ground beef, bell peppers, tomato paste, red wine, tomatoes, beef broth, oregano, fresh basil, thyme, mixed pumpkin spice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large fry pan over a medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and bacon and cook until the onion is golden and tender. Step 3: Add the minced garlic and cook a couple of minutes more. Step 4: Add the mince and cook, breaking up with a fork, until the meat has all changed colour. Step 5: Add the bell pepper and cook for a minute or two. Step 6: Now add the tomato paste and"cook it out" for another minute or two before adding the wine. Step 7: Allow the wine to reduce a little, before adding the remaining sauce ingredients. Step 8: Simmer until reduced and a deep rich red/ brown. Step 9: *You could call this "cooked" in 30 minutes, but I like to let it simmer about 2 hours, stirring regularly to make sure it's not catching. Step 10: Add a little more broth or water if it looks like doing so.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper, parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 3: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 to. Step 4: Drain and transfer to a pasta bowl. Step 5: While the pasta is cooking, combine olive oil and garlic in a cold skillet. Step 6: Cook over medium heat to slowly toast garlic, about 1 hour. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-low when olive oil begins to bubble. Step 8: Cook and stir until garlic is golden brown, about another 3-4 minutes, remove from heat. Step 9: Stir red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper into pasta. Step 10: Pour in hot olive oil and garlic, and sprinkle on Italian parsley and half of the Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese; toss until combined. Step 11: Serve pasta topped with the remaining Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, egg yolks, egg, pecorino-romano cheese, guanciale, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Stir in spaghetti and return to a boil. Step 3: Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Reserve a little pasta water, then drain. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium heat; add guanciale, cook and stir until crisp, 5 to. Step 6: Whisk egg yolks and whole egg together in a bowl; whisk in 戮聽cup Pecorino-Romano cheese, salt, and pepper until combined. Step 7: Stir in guanciale. Step 8: Add spaghetti; toss until evenly coated. Step 9: Season to taste with extra cheese, salt, and pepper; serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, bacon, onion, garlic, dry white wine, large eggs, grated parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain, toss spaghetti with olive oil, and set aside. Step 4: Place diced bacon in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir until evenly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Drain bacon on paper towels, reserving bacon fat in the skillet. Step 6: Add olive oil to bacon fat in the skillet.
