Step 7: Add chopped onion and cook over medium heat until onion is translucent. Step 8: Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 9: Add wine and cook more. Step 10: Return cooked bacon to the skillet; add cooked spaghetti. Step 11: Toss to coat and heat through, adding more olive oil if it seems dry or sticks together. Step 12: Add beaten eggs and cook, tossing constantly with tongs or a large fork, until eggs are barely set. Step 13: Quickly add Parmesan cheese and toss again. Step 14: Season with salt and pepper (remember that bacon and Parmesan are very salty). Step 15: Serve warm with chopped parsley sprinkled on top and extra Parmesan cheese at the table.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, bacon, eggs, grated parmesan cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Step 4: Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Step 5: Drain, reserving some of the drippings, crumble and set aside. Step 6: Scramble eggs in bacon drippings. Step 7: Place spaghetti in a large bowl. Step 8: Pour in olive oil, and mix well; use enough to just moisten spaghetti. Step 9: Stir in bacon, eggs, and Parmesan cheese. Step 10: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti squash, eggs, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, pepper, tomato sauce, pepperoni, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Place a pizza stone in the oven and preheat to 400 degrees F. Step 2: Squeeze liquid from the spaghetti squash and add to a bowl. Add remaining spaghetti squash pizza crust ingredients and mix with a fork until combined. Step 3: Dump the mixture onto a piece of parchment paper. Dampen hands to prevent sticking and shape into a 9” circle about 1/4-inch thick. Step 4: Transfer the crust on the parchment to the pizza stone and bake 15-20 minutes until browned around edges. Step 5: To make your favorite pizza, we've provided some ideas, top crust with sauce and desired toppings and bake for 5-7 minutes.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti squash, panko breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, eggs, fresh chives, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Step 2: Squeeze as much moisture as possible from the spaghetti squash. Add to a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped. Step 3: Transfer spaghetti squash to a bowl and add remaining ingredients. Mix to combine. Step 4: Scoop mixture onto the prepared baking sheet using a ½ tablespoon measure. Shape into a small tot. You should have about 18 tots. Step 5: Bake 10 minutes. Then flip over and bake for 2 more minutes until golden brown. Step 6: Serve with ketchup.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, egg yolks, salt, pancetta, pecorino, parmesan, black pepper, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Put a large saucepan of water on to boil. Step 2: Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind. Step 3: Finely grate pecorino cheese and parmesan and mix them together. Step 4: Beat the 3 large eggs in a medium bowl and season with a little freshly grated black pepper. Step 5: Set everything aside. Step 6: Add salt to the boiling water, add spaghetti and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until al dente (just cooked). Step 7: Squash 2 peeled plump garlic cloves with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it. Step 8: While the spaghetti is cooking, fry the pancetta with the garlic. Step 9: Drop unsalted butter into a large frying pan or wok and, as soon as the butter has melted, tip in the pancetta and garlic. Step 10: Leave to cook on a medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring often, until the pancetta is golden and crisp. Step 11: The garlic has now imparted its flavour, so take it out with a slotted spoon and discard. Step 12: Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. Step 13: When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta. Step 14: Don’t worry if a little water drops in the pan as well (you want this to happen) and don’t throw the pasta water away yet. Step 15: Mix most of the cheese in with the eggs, keeping a small handful back for sprinkling over later. Step 16: Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat. Step 17: Now quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Step 18: Using the tongs or a long fork, lift up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated. Step 19: Add extra pasta cooking water to keep it saucy (several tablespoons should do it). Step 20: You don’t want it wet, just moist. Step 21: Season with a little salt, if needed. Step 22: Use a long-pronged fork to twist the pasta on to the serving plate or bowl. Step 23: Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper. Step 24: If the dish does get a little dry before serving, splash in some more hot pasta water and the glossy sauciness will be revived.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, clams shells, tomatoes, olive oil, fat garlic, white wine, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Put the water for the spaghetti on to boil. Rinse the clams in several changes of cold water. Discard any that are open or damaged. Cover the tomatoes with boiling water, leave for 1 min, then drain and slip off the skins, Remove the seeds and chop the flesh. Step 2: Cook spaghetti according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan, add the garlic and chilli, then fry gently for a few seconds. Stir in the tomatoes, then add the clams and a splash of wine, salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Cover the pan and cook for 3-4 mins, until the clams are open. Drain the pasta, then tip into the pan with the parsley and toss together. Serve in bowls with bread for mopping up the juices.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, sugar, fresh oregano, bay leaf, salt and pepper, bread crumbs, chopped fresh parsley, eggs, grated parmesan cheese, spaghetti, ground beef
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion; cook and stir until lightly brown. Step 3: Mix in garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, sugar, 1/2 the oregano, and bay leaf. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer while preparing meatballs. Step 7: Mix ground round, bread crumbs, remaining oregano, remaining garlic, parsley, eggs, and cheese in a large bowl. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Roll into balls, and drop into the sauce. Step 10: Cook in the sauce, or until internal temperature of meatballs reaches a minimum of 160 degrees F (72 degrees C), remove bay leaf. Step 11: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and stir in the spaghetti. Step 12: Cook 8 to, until al dente; drain. Step 13: Serve meatballs and sauce over cooked spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: butter, spaghetti, tomato pasta sauce, eggs, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Butter 6 holes of a muffin tin with butter or oil. Cook the spaghetti following the pack instructions, then cool under cold running water and drain. Divide most of the spaghetti between the 6 holes, creating nest shapes. Top with tomato sauce, then crack an egg on top of each. Step 2: Wrap the remaining spaghetti around the egg yolks and gently tap the tin to allow the egg whites to seep through the spaghetti. Bake for 20 mins until the egg whites are set and the yolk a little runny. Carefully remove from the tin with a blunt knife and serve, topped with basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, onions, zucchini, fresh flat-leaf parsley, cheese sauce, spaghetti, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a medium non-stick frying pan and add the garlic and onion. Cook for 2-3 mins, until softened. Using your hands, squeeze out as much moisture from the courgettes as possible. Add them to the pan and cook for a further 3-4 mins, until tender. Spoon the vegetables into a large bowl. Step 2: Stir in the parsley, cheese sauce and spaghetti and season. Beat the eggs and stir into the mixture. Step 3: Heat remaining oil in the frying pan and tip in the spaghetti mixture. Level it out with the back of a spoon and cook over a medium heat for 3-5 mins, until almost set. Step 4: Transfer to a hot grill for 2-3 mins, until golden. Leave to cool in the pan for 5 mins, then cut into wedges and serve.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, spaghetti, olive oil, bacon, garlic, soft rindless goat's cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Pour boiling water over the tomatoes to cover, leave for 1 min, then drain and slip off the skins. Quarter and seed the tomatoes, then chop the flesh. Step 2: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, add the spaghetti and give it a stir. Boil for the timing given on the pack. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a frying pan, add the bacon and fry until starting to crisp up. Add the garlic, tomatoes, the rest of the oil and pepper and salt, if using. Heat through for 1-2 mins until just simmering. Step 4: Drain the spaghetti and add to the pan, tossing in the sauce until lightly coated. Divide between two warm soup plates, crumble over the cheese and scatter over the herbs. Serve with crusty bread and a glass of red wine.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, italian sausages, onions, red bell peppers, salt, garlic, canned tomatoes, low-sodium chicken stock, dry vermouth, flat leaf parsley, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan, heat the oil over moderate heat. Step 2: Add the sausage and cook, turning, until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes, remove from pan. Step 3: When cool enough, cut into 1/2 inch slices. Step 4: Add the onion, peppers and 3/4 teaspoon of the salt to the pan. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently until the vegetables begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Cover and cook, stirring occasionally until the vegetables are soft, about 3 minutes longer. Step 7: Add the garlic and cook, stirring, for about 30 seconds. Step 8: Add the tomatoes, broth, vermouth, the reserved sausage and any accumulated juices, the parsley and the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, and bring to a simmer. Step 9: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the spaghetti until just done, about 12 minutes. Step 10: Drain and toss with the sausage and pepper mixture and the Parmesan. Step 11: Serve with more Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, virgin olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, spaghetti, parmigiano
Instructions: Step 1: Pile up 2 or 3 layers of paper towels on a work surface. Step 2: Working on the paper towels, shred zucchinis using a grater holding the zucchini at an angle. Step 3: Heat a large skillet over moderate heat. Step 4: Add extra-virgin olive oil to the pan Add chopped garlic to the oil. Step 5: When garlic starts sizzling in oil, add shredded zucchini. Step 6: Season zucchini with salt and pepper. Step 7: Saute shredded zucchini 7 to 10 minutes. Step 8: Add hot, drained pasta to the pan. Step 9: Toss spaghetti with zucchini and garlic oil. Step 10: Add a couple of handfuls of grated cheese to the pan. Step 11: Adjust seasoning and serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, peas, olive oil, leeks, basil pesto, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions, adding the peas for the final 2 mins. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan, add the leeks, then gently cook for about 5 mins until softened. Stir in the pesto and 3 tbsp of the pasta cooking water, then simmer for a few mins. Step 2: Drain the pasta and peas, then add to the frying pan, tossing everything together. Divide between 2 warm bowls and sprinkle with a little grated Parmesan, if using.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, garlic, chili flakes, tomato, skinless boneless sardines tomato sauce, black olives, capers, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti in a large pan of boiling salted water according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Heat the oil in a medium pan and cook the garlic for 1 min. Add the chilli flakes, tomatoes and sardines, breaking up roughly with a wooden spoon. Heat for 2-3 mins, then stir in the olives, capers and most of the parsley. Mix well to combine. Step 2: Drain the pasta, reserving a couple of tbsp of the water. Add the pasta to the sauce and mix well, adding the reserved water if the sauce is a little thick. Divide between 4 bowls and sprinkle with the remaining parsley.

Ingredient Names: wholewheat spaghetti, leaf spinach, olive oil, garlic, red wine vinegar, pine nuts, parmesan half, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, boil the kettle and tip the spinach into a large colander. Pour on boiling water until it’s completely wilted (you may need 2 kettles of water), then cool under cold water and press the spinach into a ball, squeezing out all the water. Roughly chop the spinach and set aside. Step 2: Very gently heat the oil and garlic in a small pan for a few mins until it just starts to brown, then add the vinegar. Bubble for 1 min, then turn off the heat. When the spaghetti is cooked, reserve some of the water, then drain. In a large bowl, toss the spaghetti with the garlicky oil, spinach, pine nuts and the grated Parmesan. Add enough water to loosen everything. Serve in bowls along with the Parmesan shavings and chilli flakes, plus more olive oil for drizzling.

Ingredient Names: garlic, walnuts, mint, punch parsley, juice lemon, wholeweat spaghetti, raisins, baby spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz the garlic, walnuts, herbs, lemon zest and juice with some seasoning in a food processor until finely chopped. Step 2: Cook the spaghetti following pack instructions, then drain reserving a little of the cooking water. Return to the pan and stir in the pesto, raisins and spinach with a splash of cooking water. Serve with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, if you like.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, onions, raisins, chicken, parmesan, walnuts, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in boiling water, following pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onions until soft and golden brown – about 8-10 mins. Step 3: Add the raisins and stock and cook for 2-3 mins until hot through. Step 4: Toss with the pasta, Parmesan, walnuts and parsley.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions, red chile, plum tomato, vegetable stock, spaghetti, black olives, capers, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large heavy-based saucepan. Add the onion and chilli, then cook for 10 mins until softened. Stir in the tomatoes, breaking up with a spoon as you go, then pour in the stock. Cover, bring to the boil, remove the lid, then simmer for 5 mins. Step 2: Add the spaghetti, then simmer for 6-8 mins until it is just cooked. Stir in the olives, capers and basil or pesto, then serve drizzled with olive oil.

Ingredient Names: spinach, wheat lasagna noodles, tomato sauce, goat cheese curds, lentils, fresh basil, oregano, old cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and pick over the spinach, and steam it until just limp. Step 2: Drain it and chop it. Step 3: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, and boil the lasagne noodles until soft enough to work with. Step 4: Rinse them under cool water, and drain well. Step 5: Spread the bottom of a 9"x13" lasagne pan with several spoonfuls of the tomato sauce. Step 6: Lay down 3 lasagne noodles over it, and cover them with more sauce. Step 7: Sprinkle with one third of the cheese curds, one third of the lentils and one third of the chopped spinach. Step 8: Sprinkle over 1/2 teaspoon each of the basil and oregano. Step 9: Continue layering noodles, sauce, cheese, lentils, spinach and seasonings. Step 10: Finish with a layer of noodles, covered in sauce, then sprinkle over the grated cheeses, and the last of the basil and oregano. Step 11: Bake at 350°F for 30 to 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rotini noodles, olive oil, garlic, onions, thyme, mixed mushrooms, all-purpose flour, milk, spinach, fresh basil, salt, ground pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large non-stick pan over med-high heat, cook garlic, onion& thyme in oil for about a minute. Step 2: Add mushrooms, cook about 8 minutes, stirring often, until the mushrooms begin to brown& their juices begin to run. Step 3: Sprinkle with flour& stir about one minute, then slowly begin to add the milk, and bring to the boil, stirring constantly for about 3 minutes, or until the sauce thickens. Step 4: Stir in the spinach, basil, salt& pepper& cook until the spinach begins to wilt. Step 5: Toss sauce with cooked pasta& grate fresh parmesan cheese over individual servings.

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, mozzarella cheese, ricotta, parmesan cheese, garlic, spinach, salt, pepper, virgin olive oil, tomato passata, onion garlic powder, italian mixed herbs, chili flakes, sugar, fresh black pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350F/180C. Step 2: Pasta Sauce: Pour out about 1/4 cup of the passata (to make room to add flavourings). Add the remaining Pasta Sauce ingredients into the bottle, screw the lid on and give it a shake. Step 3: Cook pasta for time per packet MINUS 1 minute. Step 4: SCOOP OUT 1 mugful pasta cooking water, drain and set aside. Step 5: Ricotta Mixture - Mix Ricotta Mixture ingredients in a very large bowl. Use a splash of pasta cooking water if needed to make it creamy. Step 6: Add pasta and stir to combine. Transfer to a heatproof baking dish. Step 7: Top with Pasta Sauce, top with cheese. Loosely cover with foil. Step 8: Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the cover and bake for a further 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Step 9: Serve while hot and fresh!

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, spinach, ricotta cheese, sour cream, eggs, parmesan cheese, fresh dill, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Butter a 4-quart baking dish. Step 3: Cook pasta in boiling water, until firm-tender; drain. Step 4: Place the cooked pasta in the casserole dish. Step 5: In a large pot of boiling water BLANCH the spinach (don't overcook!); cool, squeeze out excess liquid, then roughly chop the spinach. Step 6: In a bowl combine spinach, ricotta, sour cream, eggs, Parmesan cheese, dill, pepper and salt. Step 7: Spoon mixture over the pasta in the casserole dish; toss lightly to combine. Step 8: Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown. Step 9: Let stand for 5 minutes before serving Cut in wedges--.

Dish Name: Spinach and Ricotta Cheese Sauce for Pasta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, spinach, thyme, ricotta cheese, nutmeg, pine nuts, salt, ground black pepper, vegetable stock, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion on a gentle heat until soft but not browned. Step 2: Add the thyme, garlic (if using) and spinach. Step 3: Continue to cook on low heat until the spinach leaves have wilted, approximately 2-3 minutes. If you're spinach was very wet and there is a lot of water in the pan, drain some off otherwise the sauce will be very runny. If you're not sure drain it into a separate bowl you can always add some later if you feel it's too thick. Step 4: Add the ricotta cheese and mix, using a wooden spoon, until it forms a smooth sauce. Step 5: Season, using nutmeg (I use more than stated above, but then I really like nutmeg), salt, freshly ground pepper and powdered vegetable stock to taste. Step 6: Sprinkle with toasted pine nuts and serve straight away on your favourite pasta.

Ingredient Names: fusilli, spinach, garlic, olive oil, reduced-fat feta-style cheese, pine nuts, nutmeg, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, boil a kettle of water, then slowly pour over the spinach in a colander until it wilts. Shake off the excess water, then put the spinach into a food processor. Step 2: Add the garlic, oil, half of the cheese and most of the pine nuts to the processor with the spinach, then pulse to a pesto-like sauce. Season with the nutmeg and salt and pepper. Stir through the hot, drained pasta and serve topped with the olives and the remaining crumbled cheese and pine nuts.

Ingredient Names: pork ground meat, onions, garlic, lemons, parmesan, olive oil, spaghetti, cream, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the mince, onion, garlic and zest with half the Parmesan and some seasoning, then shape into 16 walnut-sized meatballs. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the meatballs for 10-12 mins until golden. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions, drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking liquid. Add the cream and 100ml pasta water to the meatballs, scraping the bottom of the pan to get all the sticky bits off. Bubble until thick and the meatballs are cooked through. Step 3: Add the peas, cook for a further 2 mins, then add the parsley. Stir through the pasta with a splash more pasta water to make the whole thing saucy. Sprinkle over the remaining Parmesan and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, half butternut squash, garlic, sage leaves, mushrooms, pasta any shape, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan, then fry the squash, garlic and sage for a few mins until beginning to brown. Splash in some water, then cook fiercely for about 15 mins until the squash is softening and the pan looks dry. Add the mushrooms, then fry for 5 mins more, stirring every so often, until everything begins to caramelise. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta. Drain, then add to the squash mix with a little of the pasta water. Toss with most of the Parmesan and serve in bowls, sprinkled with the remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: squash weighing, olive oil, creme fraiche, parmesan, ricotta, sage leaves, lasagne
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Toss the squash together with the olive oil in a roasting tin. Roast the squash for 30 mins until soft and golden. While the squash is roasting, mix the crème fraîche with half the Parmesan, then set aside. Step 2: When squash is ready, leave to cool slightly, then peel the skin away from the flesh. In a separate bowl, beat the ricotta with the chopped sage and remaining Parmesan and fold through the squash with some seasoning, trying not to break it up too much. Step 3: Assemble the bake by spreading a little of the crème fraîche mix over a gratin dish. Then lay some of the lasagne sheets over and splodge some of the ricotta and squash mix over the pasta with more crème fraîche. Use all the ricotta mix to fill the bake, but make sure you keep some crème fraîche for the top. Finally, spread the crème fraîche over the top layer of lasagne, then scatter with the whole sage leaves. The bake can now be frozen; defrost thoroughly before cooking. Bake for 25 mins until bubbling and golden, then serve cut into squares.

Dish Name: Stove Top Macaroni and Cheese With Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: chunky tomato sauce, fat-free cream mushroom soup, onion flakes, mushrooms, low-fat cheddar cheese, parsley flakes, pepper, elbow macaroni
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan mix the tomato sauce, soup, onion flakes and mushrooms. Step 2: Stir in the cheese, parsley, and pepper. Step 3: Cook over medium heat, stirring ofte, until the cheese melts. Step 4: Add the elbow macaroni and mix it well. Step 5: Lower the heat and cover. Step 6: Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, peas, olive oil, lemon juice, wholegrain mustard, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the spaghetti according to pack instructions and, when you have just 2 mins cooking time left, throw in the peas. Step 2: Meanwhile, whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and mustard together, then season with salt, if you like, and pepper. Drain the pasta, reserving a couple of tbsps of the cooking water and return to the pan. Stir the reserved cooking water, olive oil mixture and mint through the pasta, then serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fat garlic, red chile, lemons, pasta, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan and cook the garlic and chilli for a couple of mins until very lightly golden. Stir in the zest. Step 2: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the final 2 mins. Drain, then tip everything back into the saucepan. Tip in the garlic, chilli and lemon, scraping in any bits stuck to the pan. Tear in the basil, season and add the remaining olive oil. Stir well.

Dish Name: Sun-Dried Tomato & Fresh Mozzarella Pasta Salad
Ingredient Names: olive oil, sun-dried tomato oil, red wine vinegar, capers, garlic, pasta shells, cherry tomatoes, water-packed mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaf, parmesan cheese, kalamata olives
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a food processor, make dressing: combine all dressing ingredients. Step 3: Process until sun dried tomatoes are coarsely chopped. Step 4: Transfer to small bowl and set aside. Step 5: Add one teaspoon of salt and pasta to boiling water, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Step 6: Cook until pasta is tender (about 11 min.) and drain well. Step 7: Transfer to a large serving bowl. Step 8: Add dressing to hot pasta and toss to coat. Step 9: Let cool, stirring occasionally. Step 10: Add tomatoes, mozzarella,basil, Parmesan, and olives. Step 11: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 12: Toss to mix and serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, sunblush, tomato puree, olives, oil from tomatoes, vegetarian parmesan style cheese, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, roughly chop the tomatoes. Drain the spaghetti, reserving a cupful of the cooking water in the bottom of the pan. Step 2: With the pan still on the heat, stir the tomatoes, tomato purée, olives, oil and half the cheese into the water and bring to the boil. Simmer for a few mins to make a loose sauce, then season to taste. Toss the pasta and pine nuts through the sauce and serve sprinkled with the rest of the cheese.

Ingredient Names: pasta, celery, tomatoes, italian salad dressing, mayonnaise, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Step 3: Drain and pour pasta into a large dish. Step 4: Stir in the celery and tomatoes. Step 5: In a separate bowl, whisk together the salad dressing and mayonnaise, then pour this mixture over the salad and toss again, to coat. Step 6: Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: italian salad dressing, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, garlic, black olives, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Place basil, garlic, salad dressing and cheese in blender. Step 2: Blend until smooth. Step 3: Make adjustments to spices as necessary. Step 4: Toss with olives and pasta. Step 5: Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to mix. Step 6: Overnight is good. Step 7: Serve with a sprinkle of cheese on top.

Ingredient Names: lardon, sunflower oil, extra-dry vermouth, tagliatelle, chicken stock concentrate, creme fraiche, tarragon, gem lettuce, green onions angle long shreds
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the lardons or bacon in the oil in a large, deep frying pan for 1 min. Pour in the Vermouth and allow to bubble up. Meanwhile, put a large pan of salted water on to boil, add the fresh tagliatelle, then cook according to pack instructions. Step 2: Tip the peas in with the bacon, then pour in 100ml water, the stock and crème fraîche. Stir well, then add the tarragon, lettuce and spring onions. Cover the pan and cook for 3-5 mins until the lettuce is tender, but not wilted. Drain the pasta when ready, then add to the pan and toss together until well mixed.

Ingredient Names: pasta, fresh carrot, onions, celery, plum tomato, oregano, red pesto, raspberry vinegar, parmesan basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to the pack instructions. Meanwhile, add everything else apart from the parmesan and basil to a food processor and whizz together until you get a smooth paste. Step 2: Tip into a saucepan and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and leave to cook for 5 mins. Step 3: Drain the pasta, toss together with the tomato sauce, then serve with the parmesan and basil leaves.

Dish Name: That Zucchini Spaghetti Stanley Tucci Loves (Spaghetti alla Nerano)
Ingredient Names: zucchini, sunflower oil for frying, spaghetti, olive oil, salt, basil leaves, unsalted butter, pecorino cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place sunflower oil in a deep fryer and heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Slice zucchini into 1/8-inch rounds. Step 3: Add some zucchini to the hot oil and deep-fry until lightly browned, 4 to. Step 4: Transfer to a single layer on paper towels to drain and repeat to cook remaining zucchini. Step 5: Let zucchini cool to room temperature. Step 6: Transfer cooled zucchini to a bowl. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate, to overnight. Step 8: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 9: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until it's away from being tender yet firm to the bite, 9 to. Step 10: As you are cooking the spaghetti, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 11: Add zucchini and salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to release juices, soften, and break down, 3 to. Step 12: Add a couple splashes of the pasta water to the zucchini, but don't overdo it. Step 13: Break zucchini into small pieces with the edge of a spoon or spatula. Step 14: Reduce heat to low and toss in basil and butter; stir until butter melts. Step 15: Grab spaghetti with tongs and transfer it right into the sauce; stir until coated. Step 16: Mix in Pecorino Romano and Parmigiano-Reggiano cheeses. Step 17: Add a final splash of pasta water and adjust salt if needed. Step 18: Serve with more grated cheese and fresh basil.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, tomatoes, green peppers, red peppers, onions, black olives, kraft sun-dried tomato salad dressing, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to directions, about 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 2: While pasta is cooking, chop tomato, peppers and onion into very small pieces. Add olives and mix. Step 3: Drain Rotini; rinse with cold water for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Mix pasta with tomato, peppers, onion and olives. Step 5: Refrigerate for about 1/2 an hour. Step 6: Add salad dressing; mix well. Step 7: Add Parmesan cheese; mix well. Step 8: Serve immediately. Step 9: If you have left overs, you will have to "re-wet" salad by adding a little more salad dressing the next day, especially if you substitute the dressing with a fat-free dressing.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, carrots, plump garlic, lean rump steak fat, lean pork, red wine, tomato puree, plum tomato, ground nutmeg, fresh basil leaves, spinach, eggs, ricotta, fresh flat-leaf parsley, wide no pre-cook lasagne, ball mozzarella preferably buffalo, parmesan, cherry tomato vine, basil leaves green salad leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Make the meat sauce: heat oil in a large sauté pan, then tip in onion and fry for 5 mins until golden. Add carrots and garlic, then fry for 2 mins more. Stir in both meats, breaking up the pork with a wooden spoon. Cook over a high heat until the meat is no longer pink and the juices are released. Pour in wine, scrape the bottom of the pan as you stir, then cook for 1-2 mins until the liquid is reduced. Tip in tomato purée, tomatoes and 2 tbsp water, then stir to break up tomatoes. Add ½ tsp nutmeg and some pepper, cover, then simmer for 1 hr, stirring occasionally. Taste and add salt if you like. Mix in torn basil. Sauce can be chilled for up to 1 day. Step 2: While the sauce is simmering, prepare the other layers. Tip the spinach into a large bowl and pour over boiling water. After 30 secs, tip spinach into a colander and put under cold running water briefly to cool. Squeeze to remove excess water. Beat the egg in a bowl, then mix with ricotta, parsley, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Soak the lasagne sheets in a single layer in boiling water for 5 mins. (Although the packet says no pre-cook, I find soaking improves the texture.) Drain well. Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Step 3: Start layering. Spread a few big spoonfuls of sauce to barely cover the base of an ovenproof dish (20 x 29 x 6cm deep). Cover with 2 sheets of lasagne, then spread over half the remaining sauce. Cover with 2 more lasagne sheets, then scatter spinach evenly over. Spread the ricotta mixture on top and cover with 2 more lasagne sheets. Spread with remaining sauce, then scatter over mozzarella and Parmesan to almost cover meat. Top with cherry tomatoes and some pepper, then cover loosely with foil. Step 4: Bake for 35 mins, then remove foil and bake 5-10 mins more. Leave for a few mins, then scatter with basil and serve with salad.

Ingredient Names: semi-skimmed milk, cornflour, english mustard powder, garlic, chilies, mature cheddar such as davidstow, parmesan, fresh breadcrumbs, mix tomatoes such as cherry vine tomatoes, green onions ends, macaroni, buttermilk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 tbsp of milk with the cornflour and mustard, set aside. Heat the rest of the milk with the garlic until just coming to boil. Remove from the heat, sprinkle in the crushed chillies and leave to infuse. Step 2: Get everything else ready. Coarsely grate both cheeses, keeping them separate. Mix a handful of the cheddar into the breadcrumbs with a grinding of pepper. Thickly slice the medium tomatoes and halve the cherry. Finely slice the spring onions. Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Step 3: Bring a pan of water up to the boil, tip in the macaroni, give it a stir so it doesn’t stick, then cook for 6 mins, stirring occasionally. Stir in the spring onions and cook for another 2 mins. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Stir the cornflour mix into the warm milk. Return the pan to the heat, then bring to the boil, stirring, until thickened and smooth. Remove from the heat and stir in the Parmesan, most of the remaining cheddar and some pepper to taste. Stir in the buttermilk. Step 4: Tip the macaroni into a colander, drain, then hold under a very hot tap to keep it all separate. Drain well, then stir into the sauce. Pour into an ovenproof dish, about 30 x 20 x 5.5cm deep. Lay the tomatoes over the top then scatter over the cheesy breadcrumbs, the rest of the cheese and a grating of pepper. Bake for about 15 mins until starting to bubble around the edges. Grill for about 5 mins until the top is crisp and well browned. Let sit for a few mins to settle before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, mushrooms, garlic, parsley, oregano, sage, fresh basil, pepper, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot (I use cast iron), quickly and thoroughly brown the ground beef. Step 2: Drain and add mushrooms, followed by garlic (I use at least a tablespoon in this step), parsley (a lot), oregano, sage, and basil. Step 3: Add tomatoes, sauce, and paste; stir together. Step 4: Cook on med-high for 5-10 minutes, then reduce heat to med-low. Step 5: Allow to simmer covered about one hour, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add garlic, pepper, basil, oregano, sage, and parsley to taste (also sugar). Step 7: Cook covered on med-low for 2 hours. Step 8: Add more seasoning to taste. Step 9: Cook covered on med-low for another 30 minutes-1 hour. Step 10: At this point, the sauce should be thick, cooked down about halfway. Step 11: Serve with your favorite pasta or on slices of bread with parmesan or cheddar.

Ingredient Names: onions, fresh button mushrooms, olive oil, manicotti, ricotta cheese, fresh basil, chipotle chiles adobo, pasta sauce, water, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan and sauté the onions and mushrooms until they are soft and browned. Step 2: Put the cooked mushrooms and onions in a mixing bowl along with the ricotta and basil. Step 3: Open the can of chipotle peppers and take out 2 peppers. Step 4: Chop them finely and add to the cheese mixture. Step 5: Mix and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Now take another two chipotles and the remaining sauce in the tin and add them to the pasta sauce. You may have some chipotles left over and you can add them, to your taste. If you are worried about the spice, this is where you can cut back a bit. Step 7: Use a hand blender to purée the chipotles in with the rest of the sauce. Step 8: Add the water and pour 1/3 of the mixture on the bottom of a baking dish (about 9 x 13 or slightly smaller). Step 9: Start stuffing the uncooked manicotti with the ricotta cheese mixture, placing each shell in the baking dish as you go. Step 10: When all the shells are stuffed pour the rest of the sauce over. Step 11: It should be fairly watery and enough to cover the shells. Step 12: Cover with tinfoil and bake in a 200 C fan oven for 30 minutes. Step 13: If you don't have a fan oven, you will need to increase the heat by about 20°C. Step 14: After 30 minutes, take the tinfoil off and cook for a further 15 minutes. Step 15: Sprinkle the parmesan on top and lay the mozzarella over the pasta as well. Step 16: Grill for 3-4 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbling. Step 17: Let rest for 10-15 minutes and then serve.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, yellow onion, kosher salt, italian seasoning, garlic, ground beef, veal, pork, basil, marinara sauce, spaghetti, heavy cream, grated parmesan cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese, crushed red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Melt the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onion and the salt; cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Add Italian seasoning and garlic; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant,. Step 5: Add ground meat mix and the salt; cook, stirring occasionally to crumble, until well browned and cooked through, 6 to. Step 6: Add marinara sauce and basil; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 8: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 9: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Drain and set aside. Step 11: Meanwhile, melt remaining butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 12: Add remaining garlic; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 13: Add heavy cream; cook, whisking often, until thickened and coats the back of a spoon, 8 to. Step 14: Remove from heat and gradually whisk in Parmesan cheese and remaining salt. Step 15: Transfer pasta and cream mixture to a greased 13x 9 baking dish; toss gently to combine. Step 16: Spread meat sauce evenly over pasta and sprinkle with mozzarella and crushed red pepper, if desired. Step 17: Bake in preheated oven until bubbly and mozzarella is lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 18: Let stand before serving. Step 19: Recipe developed by Ali Ramee.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, tomatoes, pine nuts, spinach, nutmeg, silken tofu, lasagne, fresh breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a pan, add onion and 1/3 of the garlic and fry for 4 mins until softened. Pour in tomatoes, season and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and cook for 10 mins until sauce thickens. Step 2: Heat half remaining oil in a frying pan and cook another 1/3 of garlic for 1 min, then add half the pine nuts and the spinach. Wilt spinach, then tip out excess liquid. Whizz tofu in a food processor or with a hand blender until smooth, then stir through the spinach with the nutmeg and some pepper. Remove from the heat; allow to cool slightly. Step 3: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pour half tomato sauce into a 20 x 30cm dish. Divide spinach mix between lasagne sheets, roll up and lay on top of sauce. Pour over remaining sauce. Bake for 30 mins. Step 4: Mix crumbs with remaining garlic and pine nuts. Sprinkle over top of dish, drizzle with remaining oil and bake for 10 mins until crumbs are golden.

Ingredient Names: pasta shapes, olive oil, eggplants, garlic, sugar, tomatoes, capers, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta according to pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the aubergine for 5 mins, season to taste. Step 3: Add garlic and sugar, and fry for another 2 mins until the garlic is softened. Step 4: Tip the tomatoes, capers and parsley into the pan, warm through briefly then fold through the cooked, drained pasta.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, chili powder, spaghetti, fresh basil leaves, mozzarella, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat the oil in large pan, add the garlic and fry for 1 min. Add the tomatoes, chilli and seasoning, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti, then drain. Mix the spaghetti with the tomato sauce and basil, then spoon half into a large ovenproof dish. Arrange half the mozzarella over the top and sprinkle with half the Parmesan. Repeat the layers, then bake for 15-20 mins until lightly browned on top. Scatter with extra basil and serve with a big green salad.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, vegetable stock powder, tomato puree, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a pan, add the garlic clove, then gently fry for 1 min. Step 2: Tip in the chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock powder, tomato purée and 1 tsp sugar, then bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, then simmer uncovered for 5 mins, stirring occasionally. Step 3: To finish, tear a few basil leaves, then stir into the sauce.

Ingredient Names: butter, cooked ham, half-and-half, grated parmesan cheese, onion, frozen green peas, tortellini, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in onion and ham and saute for 3-4 minutes, or until onion is translucent. Step 3: Pour in half-and-half and cheese, stirring frequently, until sauce starts to thicken and bubble. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste and set aside. Step 5: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add tortellini and cook to desired doneness, or according to package directions. Step 7: Add peas to boiling tortellini in the final minute of cooking. Step 8: Drain from water and toss with ham and sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: filled tortellini, lean back bacon, walnuts, lemons, parmesan, olive oil, salad spinach, ricotta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill. Boil the pasta according to pack instructions, then tip into a colander and cool under gently running water. Meanwhile, grill the bacon on a baking tray until golden and crisp at the edges. When almost ready, tip the walnuts onto the tray to toast a little. Snip the bacon into strips. Step 2: Mix the lemon zest and juice, Parmesan and oil in a large bowl. Season with pepper, then tip in the spinach, tortellini, bacon and walnuts. Toss well, add the ricotta in small blobs, then gently toss. Season to taste, then serve with a drizzle more oil and more Parmesan, if you like.

Dish Name: Turkey meatballs in tomato & fennel sauce
Ingredient Names: turkey ground meat, fresh white breadcrumbs, garlic, olive oil, onions, fresh carrot, fennel seeds, tomatoes, tomato puree, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mince in a mixing bowl with the breadcrumbs and half the garlic. Season and mix well to combine. Using your hands, shape the mixture into 12 balls, then chill for 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Add the onion, carrot and remaining garlic. Cook for 5-6 mins until softened. Add the fennel seeds and cook for a few secs. Tip in the tomatoes with half a can of water, then stir in the tomato purée. Season and simmer for 15 mins until thickened. Using an electric hand blender, whizz until roughly smooth. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry the meatballs for 8-10 mins until cooked through. Transfer to the sauce and simmer until piping hot. Serve with spaghetti.

Ingredient Names: fusilli, dry white wine, whipping cream, tabasco sauce, mature vegetarian cheddar, vegetarian stilton, sage, thyme, plum tomatoes, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the pasta according to pack instructions until almost tender. Drain and rinse under cold water, drain again, then set aside. Step 2: In a heavy-based pan combine the wine, cream and Tabasco sauce, then gently heat. Gradually add half the cheddar and half the stilton, whisking constantly. Whisk in the sage and thyme and a good sprinkling of black pepper. When the mixture is smooth remove from the heat. Step 3: Place the pasta in a buttered 1.4 litre/2½ pint ovenproof dish. Pour the cheese and cream mixture over and sprinkle the remaining cheese on top. Step 4: Cover with foil and bake for 30 mins. Remove the foil and arrange the tomato slices on top. Bake, uncovered, for 10 mins until the tomatoes are softened, the pasta is tender and the sauce has all been absorbed into the pasta. Serve immediately with a crisp winter salad and crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: mature cheddar such as denhay, gruy re, parmesan, white bread crusts off, tomatoes, macaroni, full-fat milk, butter, flour minus, rounded dijon mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Making macaroni cheese is a bit of a juggling act, so it’s easier if you get a few things prepared ahead. Finely grate all the cheeses, keeping them separate. Tear the bread into pieces and whizz in a food processor to coarse crumbs. Mix 25g of the cheddar and one-third of the parmesan into the breadcrumbs. Toss the rest of the cheeses together and set aside. Thickly slice the tomatoes. Butter a dish, about 30 x 20 x 5.5cm. Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Step 2: Put a pan of water on to boil. Tip the macaroni into the boiling water, stir and bring it back to the boil. Simmer for 8 mins, or cook according to pack instructions, stirring occasionally to stop it sticking. While this is cooking, start the sauce. Step 3: Warm the milk in a jug in the microwave (or in a pan). Melt the butter in a pan (big enough to take the macaroni as well), then stir in the flour. Cook for 1 min, stirring, then take off the heat. Pour in one-third of the warm milk and beat well with a wooden spoon until smooth – it is quite thick at this stage. Add another third – it may go a bit lumpy, but keep beating well and it will go smooth again. Pour in the final third of milk and keep beating until smooth. Step 4: When the macaroni is done, tip it into a colander and put it briefly under very hot running water to keep it separate. Drain. Put the pan of sauce back on the heat and cook, stirring, until thickened and smooth. Lower the heat and simmer for about 4 mins until glossy, stirring every now and then. Remove from the heat and stir in the cheese and mustard, then beat in 5 tbsp milk, or enough to give a slack coating consistency. Taste and season (you shouldn’t need much salt). If the macaroni is sticking at all, put it under the hot tap again, then stir to separate. Drain well, then gently mix it into the sauce and stir to coat completely. If necessary, adjust the consistency again with milk. There should be enough sauce to coat the macaroni thickly and liberally. Step 5: Tip the macaroni cheese into the buttered dish, scatter over the cheesy crumbs and lay the tomatoes casually over the top. Heat through in the oven for 12-15 mins until beginning to bubble around the edges. Grill for 3-5 mins to brown the crumbs. Let it all settle for 1-2 mins, then serve while still piping hot.

Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, salt, fresh black pepper, tabasco sauce, sharp cheddar cheese, swiss cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, fluid italian plum tomatoes, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cook elbow macaroni according to package instructions, al dente', about 15 minutes; drain well and set aside. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Step 3: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt 4 tablespoons of butter. Step 4: Stir in flour to form a paste; DO NOT LET IT BURN OR GO LUMPY. Step 5: Slowly whisk in milk and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly until sauce begins to thicken. Step 6: Add salt, pepper and Tabasco or Red Hot Sauce. Step 7: Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup of grated sharp cheddar cheese, stirring until blended. Step 8: Butter a 9" x 9" ovenproof casserole dish. Step 9: In a bowl, mix together elbow macaroni, cheese sauce and half of the tomatoes with juice. Step 10: Transfer macaroni to the prepared casserole dish. Step 11: Sprinkle top with remaining 1 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese, Swiss cheese and Parmesan cheese. Step 12: Add remaining 4 tablespoons of butter in dollops on top. Step 13: Bake uncovered in preheated 350 F oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly and golden. Step 14: Serve with the reamining crushed tomatoes and a sprinkle of chopped onions or chopped green onions.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, onions, olive oil, garlic, vegan cream cheese, vegetable broth, salt, soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, nutritional yeast, fresh black pepper, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the cauliflower into medium florets. Add to a pot of salted, boiling water and let simmer for 10 minutes until very soft. Drain and tip into the jug of a blender. Step 2: Meanwhile heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over a medium-low heat. Add the onion and cook until softened and slightly golden – about 15 minutes. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute then from from the heat. Tip into the jug of the blender along with the vegan cream cheese, vegetable broth, salt, soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, nutritional yeast and a generous pinch of black pepper. Blitz until silky smooth. Step 3: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water according to the directions on the packet. Drain and return to the pot. Pour in the cauliflower sauce and stir together. Taste and add more salt and pepper if needed. Divide between bowls and serve with a drizzle of olive oil on top.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red peppers, green peppers, yellow peppers, orange bell pepper, onions, thyme, tomatoes, butter, flour, milk, chicken broth, dry white wine, salt, pepper, nutmeg, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Pasta: Cook lasagna noodles, according to package directions, until el dente; drain & dry well on a clean tea towel or paper towels and set aside. Step 2: Veggies: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat, saute onions& peppers until limp (about 10 minutes); stir in thyme, remove from heat& set aside. Step 3: Bechamel Sauce: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan & stir in flour; Gradually whisk in milk, broth, wine, salt& pepper. Step 4: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth & thickened; remove from heat, add nutmeg & 1/2 cup of the grated Parmesan, stir & set aside. Step 5: Assembly: Grease a 9 x 9 inch baking dish& assemble in this order: layer of noodles;layer 1/2 of the chopped tomatoes; layer of noodles;layer 1/2 of the pepper mixture; layer 1/2 of the Mozzarella; layer of noodles; layer rest of the diced tomatoes; layer of noodles; the rest of the pepper mixture; the rest of the mozzarella. Step 6: Spread the Bechamel sauce over the top& sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan. Step 7: Bake, uncovered, at 375F for 45 minutes; tent with foil & let stand for 15 minutes before cutting.

Ingredient Names: dry linguine, canned tomatoes, great northern beans, virgin olive oil, garlic, parsley, oregano, green olives, feta, salt, course black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Start water in large pot to boil noodles. Step 2: Heat oil in a wide/deep skillet (or pot large enough for all ingredients except noodles),blade crush and mince garlic, add when oil is hot. Step 3: Dice fresh tomatoes or open cans quickly so the garlic doesn't burn; slightly brown is fine, but garlic needs only a brief period to release aroma. Step 4: Add tomatoes, parsley, oregano, and I add pepper now too if coarse black pepper is available; if not, just add some fine black to taste when serving. Step 5: When tomato mixture begins to bubble, cover and reduce heat to simmer (about 3 min). Step 6: Now is a good time to drain noodles if you haven't already. Step 7: Make sure you drain off all excess water, and please don't add oil to noodles. Step 8: Time to add beans and olives to tomatoes, cook 1 minute. Step 9: Serve as common noodles by pour over or mixing, sprinkle with cheese or salt/pepper to taste. Step 10: If you used fresh parsley and have any left over you can sprinkle that on top, how versatile.

Dish Name: Vegetarian Pasta e Fagioli (Pasta and Beans)
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, celery, fresh carrot, fresh basil, oregano, thyme, rosemary, red pepper flakes, tomatoes, vegetable stock, cannellini beans, pasta, parsley, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy pot, heat olive oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Stir in onion with a pinch of salt and pepper, and cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add dried herbs and red pepper flakes into the oil and toss to coat to bring out some of the dried herbs' flavors. Step 4: Stir in garlic, and then celery, and carrots and cook for about 3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in tomatoes and stock and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Step 7: If necessary add an additional cup of stock or water and stir in beans and tiny pasta. Step 8: Simmer for 6-8 minutes or until pasta is tender. Step 9: Stir in parsley and serve hot with grated parmesan and freshly ground black pepper.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, duck legs, onions, garlic, ground cinnamon, plain flour, red wine, tomatoes, chicken stock cube, rosemary, bay leaves, sugar, milk, paccheri pasta, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. Step 2: Add the duck legs and brown on all sides for about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Remove to a plate and set aside. Step 4: Add the onions to the pan and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook for a further 3-4 minutes, then stir in the cinnamon and flour and cook for a further min. Step 6: Return the duck to the pan, add the wine, tomatoes, stock, herbs, sugar and seasoning. Step 7: Bring to a simmer, then lower the heat, cover with a lid and cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring every now and then. Step 8: Carefully lift the duck legs out of the sauce and place on a plate – they will be very tender so try not to lose any of the meat. Step 9: Pull off and discard the fat, then shred the meat with 2 forks and discard the bones. Step 10: Add the meat back to the sauce with the milk and simmer, uncovered, for a further while you cook the pasta. Step 11: Cook the pasta following pack instructions, then drain, reserving a cup of the pasta water, and add the pasta to the ragu. Step 12: Stir to coat all the pasta in the sauce and cook for more, adding a splash of cooking liquid if it looks dry. Step 13: Serve with grated Parmesan, if you like.

Ingredient Names: red onions, olive oil, pasta shapes, balsamic vinegar, sultana, caper well, pine nuts, spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Start frying the onions in the oil in a non-stick frying pan – you’ll need to cook them for about 10 mins until they’re very soft. Meanwhile, boil the pasta. Step 2: Stir the vinegar, sultanas, capers and most of the pine nuts into the soft onions with some seasoning, then cook for 1 min more to soften the sultanas. Stir in the spinach with a splash of pasta water. Drain the pasta, then toss with the onion mix – the spinach should wilt as you do. Divide between 2 bowls, scatter with the remaining pine nuts and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless venison loin steaks, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumbs, eggs, salt, pepper, olive oil, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together 3 Tbsp. Step 2: Parmesan cheese with 1 cup bread crumbs. Step 3: In bowl, beat 2 eggs, salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Dip venison in eggs, then bread crumbs, heat 6 Tbsp. Step 5: Olive oil in skillet till hot. Step 6: Fry venison 5 mins. Step 7: Each side till brown. Step 8: Then place venison on a cookie sheet, spoon spaghetti sauce over venison and bake in 325 degree oven till tender, I usually bake 15 or 20 mins. Step 9: Then add mozzeralla cheese and bake till cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, spinach, eggs, sun-dried tomato oil, oregano, garlic powder, fresh black pepper, ground nutmeg, alfredo sauce, no-boil lasagna noodles, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit. Step 2: In a large bowl combine ricotta, spinach, eggs, sun dried tomatoes, oregano, garlic powder, pepper and nutmeg. Step 3: Spread 3/4 cup Alfredo sauce in ungreased 13 X 9 baking dish; top with 3 noodles (crosswise). Step 4: Spread with 1/3 of ricotta mixture; repeat layering twice with noodles and ricotta mixture, ending with noodles. Step 5: Pour remaining Alfredo sauce over pasta. Step 6: Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Step 7: Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes; remove foil and bake another 10 minutes. Step 8: If desired, place lasagna under broiler for 2 minutes to brown cheese. Step 9: Let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Whole30 Twice Baked Spaghetti Squash Bolognese
Ingredient Names: extra-virgin olive oil, ground pork, ground beef, kosher salt, yellow onions, carrots, celery, garlic, parsley leaves, sage leaves, fresh basil leaves, tomatoes, organic beef broth, red pepper flakes, red wine vinegar, spaghetti squash, virgin olive oil, flaky sea salt, store-bought cashew ricotta cheese, fresh sage leaf
Instructions: Step 1: To make the Bolognese: While the squash is baking make the Bolognese sauce. In a large bowl mix together the pork and beef and season with 1 tablespoon kosher salt. Continue to lightly mix until the meat is combined and evenly seasoned. Step 2: In a large, high-sided sauté pan or Dutch oven over high heat add the olive oil. When the oil is smoking, add the pork and beef mixture in batches to the hot pan and cook until the meat is seared on all sides. Remove the seared meat to a paper towel lined sheet tray, leaving behind any rendered fat in the pan, and continue to sear the remaining meat in batches, ensuring that you do not overcrowd the pan and steam the meat. Set the seared meat aside. Step 3: In the same pan, over medium heat, add the onion and cook 5 minutes or until beginning to caramelize. Then add in the carrots, celery, 1 teaspoon kosher salt, garlic, parsley, sage and 1/4 cup basil. Cook for 5-6 minutes or until the vegetables are soft and just beginning to caramelize. Add the meat back to the pan along with the crushed tomatoes and beef broth. Bring the mixture to a boil and reduce to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Season with additional kosher salt to taste and crushed red pepper flakes. Continue to simmer for at least 1 hour or until the sauce has thickened. You can continue to cook the sauce for longer, if you have time; the longer you cook the sauce the deeper the flavor. While the sauce simmers roast the spaghetti squash. Step 4: To make the spaghetti squash: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Step 5: Cut the squash in half lengthwise and discard the seeds. Season each squash half with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon kosher salt and 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper. Add two large basil leaves to the cavity of each squash and then turn the squash cavity side down on a half sheet tray. You will need two half sheet trays to hold all six halves. Roast the squash for 40 minutes or until the squash is fork tender and easily shreds when you run a fork over the flesh. Remove from oven and let cool 10-15 minutes. Step 6: When the squash is cool enough to handle scoop the squash away from the skin and place back on the sheet tray. You can discard the squash skin at this point. Spread the squash evenly on the sheet tray and shred it lightly with a fork so it looks like spaghetti. Place the sheet trays back in the oven and cook an additional 15 minutes or until the excess liquid has evaporated and the squash has just begun to crisp and lightly brown. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and season with flaky sea salt. Step 7: To serve: When ready to serve, stir in the remaining basil and vinegar to the Bolognese sauce. Taste and add additional seasoning as necessary. Step 8: Add spaghetti squash to a serving bowl and top with the sage and basil Bolognese sauce. Serve each portion with a 1/4 cup of cashew ricotta, fresh sage leaves, crushed red pepper and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Step 9: Nutrition Info Per Serving, calories: 1080. Step 10: Total Fat: 81 grams. Step 11: Saturated Fat: 20 grams. Step 12: Total Carbohydrate: 38 grams, sugars: 16 grams. Step 13: Protein: 50 grams. Step 14: Sodium: 3626 milligrams. Step 15: Cholesterol: 159 milligrams, fiber: 9 grams.

Dish Name: Wild mushroom lasagne with a parmesan cream
Ingredient Names: olive oil, wild mushrooms, unsalted butter, flour, milk, egg yolks, gruy re, cheddar, pasta, cream, butter, parmesan, mixed peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large pan and fry the mushrooms for a few mins until lightly browned. Drain, return to the pan with the knob of butter, toss through, then season and set aside. Step 2: Melt 50g butter in a small pan until foaming, add the flour, stirring well, and cook for 1 min. Stir in the milk and cook for about 4 mins, stirring continuously, until thickened. Whisk in the egg yolks and heat until bubbling. Remove from heat, stir in gruyère and cheddar, season, then fold through the mushrooms. Step 3: To assemble, line a terrine or loaf tin (about 12 x 20cm) with cling film. Place a sheet of cooked pasta onto the base and spread over half of the mushroom mix. Add another sheet of pasta, pressing down firmly, before spreading remaining mushroom mix on top and covering with the last sheet of pasta. Cover with cling film, directly onto the pasta, and sit something flat on top to weigh down. Chill for at least 2 hrs or overnight. Step 4: For the parmesan cream, bring the cream and butter to the boil, then remove from the heat and whisk in the parmesan. Cover with cling film and chill. If it gets too thick, thin with a bit of milk. Step 5: For the confit peppers, put the pepper slices into a deep pan and add just enough olive oil to cover and a pinch of salt. Cook gently on a low heat for about 20 mins until soft, then drain. Step 6: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Tip the lasagne out onto a board, remove the cling film and cut into 6 slices. Space portions out on a baking tray, drizzle 1 tbsp of parmesan cream over each and bake for 12-20 mins until hot. Serve with another drizzle of parmesan cream, the confit peppers and a salad.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, lean ground beef, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, white sugar, chopped fresh parsley, dried basil leaves, salt, italian seasoning, fennel seeds, ground black pepper, lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, egg, mozzarella cheese, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all your ingredients. Step 2: Cook sausage, ground beef, onion, and garlic in a Dutch oven over medium heat until well browned. Step 3: Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, and water. Step 4: Season with sugar, parsley, basil, salt, Italian seasoning, fennel seeds, and pepper. Step 5: Simmer, covered, for about 1 陆 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 7: Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water for 8 to. Step 8: Drain noodles, and rinse with cold water. Step 9: In a mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese with egg, remaining parsley, and salt. Step 10: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 11: To assemble, spread 1 陆 cups of meat sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 12: Arrange 6 noodles lengthwise over meat sauce, overlapping slightly. Step 13: Spread with 1/2 of the ricotta cheese mixture. Step 14: Top with 1/3 of the mozzarella cheese slices. Step 15: Spoon 1 陆 cups meat sauce over mozzarella, and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Step 16: Repeat layers, and top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Step 17: Cover with foil: to prevent sticking, either spray foil with cooking spray or make sure the foil does not touch the cheese. Step 18: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Step 19: Remove the foil and bake for an additional. Step 20: Let the lasagna rest at room temperature for about 10 minutes before cutting; this helps it set and firm up.

Dish Name: Ww Watch Your Weight Lasagna With Meat Sauce
Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, fennel seeds, olive oil, lean ground beef, onions, red bell peppers, zucchini, refrigerated marinara sauce, fat-free ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package directions. Step 2: Drain, rinse with cold water and set aside. Step 3: Toast and grind the fennel seeds by placing them in a small dry skillet over medium-low heat. Step 4: Cook, shaking the pan and stirring constantly until lightly browned and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Watch them carefully- they will burn quickly! Step 6: Remove from pan and grind to a powder. Step 7: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 8: Add the oil, then add the beef, onion, bell pepper and zucchini. Step 9: Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef browns. Step 10: Stir in the marinara sauce and fennel, bring to a boil. Step 11: Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until slightly thickened and the flavors blend, about 10 minutes. Step 12: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Step 13: Spread one-fourth of the meat sauce in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Step 14: Top with 3 of the noodles; spread with 1/2 cup of ricotta. Step 15: Repeat the layering twice, ending with the meat sauce. Step 16: Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Step 17: Remove the foil and sprinkle with the mozzarella and Romano. Step 18: Bake until heated through and cheeses are lightly browned, abut 20 minutes longer. Step 19: Let stand about 10 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Ziti Al Forno (From the Sopranos Family Cookbook)
Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, salt, pasta sauce, meatballs meatballs, romano cheese, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ziti in a large bowl. Step 2: Toss ziti with 3 cups of the gravy and half of the grated cheese. Step 3: Spoon half of the ziti into a casserole dish. Step 4: Spread the ricotta over the top of the ziti. Step 5: Sprinkle with the mozzarella and rest of grated cheese. Step 6: Pour on 1 cup of sauce. Step 7: Top with remaining ziti and rest of sauce (it will be almost overflowing) sprinkle with more grated cheese. Step 8: Bake covered with foil for 45 minutes and then uncovered for 15 minutes. Step 9: Let stand 15 minutes. Step 10: Tell me immediately how it was!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, eggplants, red bell peppers, garlic, tomato paste, tomatoes, capers, salt, ground black pepper, fresh basil, ziti pasta, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the bell pepper and garlic, and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, capers, and salt and black pepper to taste, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes to reduce slightly and the flavors. Step 6: Add the basil and keep warm over low heat. Step 7: Cook the ziti i a large pot of salted boiling water, stirring occasionally, until it is al dente, about 8-10 minutes. Step 8: When the pasta is cooked, drain it and place in a shallow serving bowl. Step 9: Add the sauce, sprinkle with grated cheese, and toss gently. Step 10: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: eggs, egg yolk, pecorino cheese, olive oil, pancetta, zucchini noodles, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk eggs and egg yolk together in a bowl. Step 2: Add Pecorino cheese and mix well. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium heat; cook and stir pancetta until cooked through but not crispy, 2 to. Step 4: Add the zucchini noodles (zoodles); cook and stir until zoodles are warmed but not soft and pancetta is slightly crispy, 3 to. Step 5: Remove wok from heat. Step 6: Pour egg mixture over zoodles and stir until evenly coated. Step 7: Top zoodles with Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese and black pepper.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, olive oil, penne pasta, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, mixed herbs, chili flakes, cheese, garlic, onions, tomato puree, tomato sauce, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, in a large vessel take enough water. Step 2: Add 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp olive oil and get the water to a boil. Step 3: Now add 2 cup penne pasta and give a good stir. this helps to prevent pasta from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Step 4: Boil for 9 minutes or check the package instruction to cook the pasta until al dente. Step 5: Drain off the water and keep the boiled pasta aside. Step 6: Firstly, in a pan heat 1 tsp butter, 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tbsp maida. Step 7: Roast on low flame until the maida turns aromatic. Step 8: Now add 1½ cup milk and stir continuously. make sure the milk is chilled, else you may have lumps in the sauce. Step 9: Keep stirring until the sauce thickens up slightly. Step 10: Now add ¼ tsp mixed herbs, ¼ tsp chilli flakes, ¼ tsp salt and 3 tbsp cheese. Step 11: Give a good mix. white sauce for pasta is ready. do not overcook as the sauce thickens and turns to paste consistency. Step 12: Firstly, in a large wok heat 3 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp butter, 3 clove garlic, ½ tsp mixed herbs and ½ tsp chilli flakes. Step 13: Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic. Step 14: Now add 1 onion and saute until the onions sweat slightly. Step 15: Further, add 1½ cup tomato puree and cook on medium flame until the puree thickens slightly. Step 16: Also add 2 tbsp tomato sauce, ½ tsp chilli powder and ½ tsp salt. Step 17: Continue to cook until the sauce thickens. red sauce is ready for the pasta. Step 18: Now combine prepared white sauce with the red sauce. add as required, as this white sauce makes the pasta creamy. Step 19: Now you can see the colour of the pasta sauce has been changed to pink. pink sauce is ready to prepare pasta. Step 20: Add in boiled pasta and give a good mix. Step 21: The pasta is so creamy and saucy. Step 22: You can also add 3 tbsp cheese, ¼ tsp chilli flakes and ¼ tsp mixed herbs. Step 23: Mix well combining everything well. Step 24: Finally, enjoy pink sauce pasta with more cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions wedges, red peppers, rosemary needles, arborio risotto rice, white wine, low-salt vegetable stock, artichoke heart water, parmesan, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan or wok. Cook the onions gently for 6-7 mins until softened and browning. Add the peppers and rosemary and cook for a further 5 mins. Add rice and stir well. Step 2: Pour in the wine and of the stock. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat and simmer gently, stirring occasionally until almost all the liquid is absorbed. Step 3: Stir in another of the stock and simmer again, until it’s all absorbed. Add the final with the artichokes and simmer again until rice is tender. Step 4: Season and stir in the Parmesan and ½ the pine nuts. Scatter over the remainder and serve.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, olive oil, sage leaves picked, vegetable stock, butter, onions, risotto rice, glass white wine, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Toss the squash in 1 tbsp oil together with the chopped sage. Scatter into a shallow roasting tin and roast for 30 mins until brown and soft. Step 2: While the squash is roasting, prepare the risotto. Bring the stock to the boil and keep on a low simmer. In a separate pan, melt half the butter over a medium heat. Stir in the onions and cook gently for 8-10 mins until soft but not coloured, stirring occasionally. Stir the rice into the onions until completely coated in the butter, then stir continuously until the rice is shiny and the edges of the grain start to look transparent. Step 3: Pour in the wine and simmer until completely evaporated. Add the stock, a ladleful at a time, and stirring the rice over a low heat for 25-30 mins, until the rice is cooked al dente (with a slightly firm, starchy bite in the middle). The risotto should be creamy and slightly soupy. Step 4: At the same time, gently fry the whole sage leaves in a little olive oil until crisp, then set aside on kitchen paper. When the squash is cooked, mash half of it to a rough purée and leave half whole. When the risotto is just done, stir through the purée, then add the cheese and remaining butter and leave to rest for a few minutes. Serve the risotto scattered with the whole chunks of squash and the crisp sage leaves.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, butternut squash, sage, carnaroli, vegetable stock, chestnuts, butter, parsley, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the onion and garlic, and cook for 5 mins. Add the squash, sage and rice, and cook for a further 2 mins. Step 2: Pour in the stock and cook, stirring regularly, for 15 mins. Add the chestnuts and cook for a further 5 mins or until the rice is tender and the stock has been absorbed. Step 3: Stir in the butter, parsley and Parmesan. Divide risotto between bowls, scatter with extra Parmesan, season and serve.

Ingredient Names: beetroot, olive oil, butter, onions, garlic, risotto rice, white wine, vegetable stock, parmesan, sour cream, fresh dill
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Peel and trim the beetroots (use kitchen gloves if you don’t want your hands to get stained) and cut into large wedges. Place on a large sheet of foil on a baking sheet. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, season, then cook for 1 hr until the beets are soft. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the remaining olive oil with the butter in an ovenproof pan with a lid. Tip in the onion and garlic, then cook for 3-5 mins until translucent. Stir in the rice until well coated with the butter and oil. Pour over the white wine, then let the mixture bubble away for 5 mins. Step 3: Stir well, then pour over the stock. Stir again, cover and place in the oven. Cook for 15 mins until the rice is soft. Remove the beetroots from the oven. Whizz ¼ of them to make a purée, then chop the remainder into small pieces. Stir most of the Parmesan, the beetroot purée and chopped beetroot through the risotto, then serve with some soured cream dolloped over and the dill and extra Parmesan scattered on top.

Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, butter, streaky bacon, risotto rice, vegetable stock, peas, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop 1 onion. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan, add the onions and fry until lightly browned (about 7 minutes). Step 2: Add 6 chopped rashers streaky bacon and fry for a further 5 minutes, until it starts to crisp. Step 3: Add 300g risotto rice and 1l hot vegetable stock, and bring to the boil. Stir well, then reduce the heat and cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes until the rice is almost tender. Step 4: Stir in 100g frozen peas, add a little salt and pepper and cook for a further 3 minutes, until the peas are cooked. Step 5: Serve sprinkled with freshly grated parmesan and freshly ground black pepper.

Ingredient Names: fennel bulb base, butter, onions, garlic, risotto rice, white wine, vegetable stock, lemons, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Chop any green leafy fennel fronds and set aside. Cut off the stalk-like fennel top, remove the outer layers and finely chop both. Heat 1 tbsp butter in a frying pan and cook the onion, garlic and chopped fennel until soft but not coloured. Step 2: Add the rice and stir for 1 min. Pour over most of the wine and simmer until evaporated. Add 500ml of the hot stock, a ladleful at a time, stirring between each addition until it is absorbed. Step 3: Meanwhile, slice remaining fennel and fry in knob of butter until browned. Add remaining stock and wine and cook until tender. Step 4: When the rice is cooked, stir in the zest, Parmesan and some seasoning. Take off the heat and set aside, covered, for 2 mins. Serve in bowls, topped with the fennel fronds and cooked fennel, stirring the prawns through if using.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, olive oil, green onions ends, fresh basil, chives, mint, lemons, vegetable bouillon, shallots, plump garlic, carnaroli, dry white wine, parmesan, arugula leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the woody ends off the asparagus, then slice the stems into 5cm diagonal lengths. Heat half the oil in a large, wide non-stick frying pan. Tip in the asparagus and stir-fry over a medium-high heat for about 4 mins or until nicely browned all over (Step 1). Stir in the spring onions and fry for 1-2 mins with the asparagus until browned. Remove, season with pepper and set aside. Cook the peas and beans separately in a little boiling water for 3 mins each, then drain each through a sieve. When the broad beans are cool enough to handle, pop them out of their skins. Set the peas and beans to one side. Mix the basil, chives, mint and lemon zest together in a small bowl and season with pepper (Step 2). Set aside. Step 2: Pour the stock into a saucepan and keep it on a very low heat. Pour the remaining oil into a large, wide sauté pan. Tip in the shallots and garlic, and fry for 3-4 mins until soft and only slightly brown. Stir in the rice and continue to stir for 1-2 mins over a medium-high heat. As it starts to sizzle, pour in the wine and stir again until the wine has been absorbed. Start to stir in the hot stock, 1½ ladlefuls at a time (Step 3), so it simmers and is absorbed after each addition. To tell when it is ready to have the next 1½ ladlefuls added, drag the spoon across the bottom of the pan and it should leave a clear line. Keep stirring the whole time, to keep the risotto creamy. Continue adding the stock as above – after 20 mins the rice should be soft with a bit of chew in the middle. If it isn’t, add more stock – you should still have at least a ladleful of stock left at this point. Season with pepper, you shouldn’t need to add any salt. Step 3: Take the pan off the heat. Pour over a ladleful of the remaining stock to keep the mixture fluid, then scatter over all the vegetables, a grinding of pepper, half of the herb mix (Step 4) and half the cheese. Cover with the pan lid and let the risotto sit for 3-4 mins to rest. Gently stir everything together, if necessary adding a drop more remaining stock for good consistency. Ladle into serving dishes and serve topped with a small pile of rocket and the rest of the herbs and cheese scattered over.
