Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, butter, onions, risotto rice, glass white wine, parmesan, olive oil, soft herbs, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the stock to the boil and keep on a low simmer. In a separate pan, melt half the butter over a medium heat. Stir in the onions and sweat gently for 8-10 mins until soft but not coloured, stirring occasionally. Stir the rice into the onions until completely coated in the butter, then stir continuously until the rice is shiny and the edges of the grain start to look transparent. Step 2: Pour in the wine and simmer until totally evaporated. Add the stock, a ladleful at a time, stirring with each addition until absorbed. Continue adding stock a ladleful at a time and stirring the rice over a low heat for 25-30 mins, until the rice is cooked al dente (with a slightly firm, starchy bite in the middle). The risotto should be creamy and slightly soupy. When you draw a wooden spoon through it, there should be a wake that holds for a few moments but not longer. Step 3: When the rice is cooked, turn off the heat, stir in the grated Parmesan, the remaining butter, half the oil and the chopped herbs, then season with salt and pepper. Cover with a lid and leave the risotto to rest for a few mins. Now make your herb salad. Roughly chop the chives, then mix with the whole herb leaves, remaining olive oil and the balsamic vinegar. Give the risotto a final stir, then serve in bowls topped with some of the herb salad and some shaved Parmesan.

Dish Name: Leek & sage risotto with crisp bacon
Ingredient Names: olive oil, leeks, sage leaves, risotto rice, glass white wine, vegetable stock, streaky bacon, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan, add the leeks and sage and fry for 2 mins until the leeks are starting to soften. Stir in the rice and cook for 1 min, stirring. Add the wine and stock and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 10-12 mins until the rice is tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, grill the bacon until golden and crisp. Remove the rice from the heat, then stir in 2 tbsp of the Parmesan and freshly ground pepper. Spoon onto a plate, sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan and top with the bacon.

Ingredient Names: risotto rice, vegetable stock, butternut squash, parmesan, sage leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the rice into a large bowl, then add 500ml of the hot vegetable stock. Cover with cling film and microwave on High for 5 mins. Meanwhile, peel and cut the squash into medium chunks. Stir the rice, then add the squash and the rest of the stock. Re-cover with cling film, then microwave for another 15 mins, stirring halfway, until almost all the stock is absorbed and the rice and squash are tender. Step 2: Leave the risotto to sit for 2 mins, then stir in the parmesan and sage. Serve topped with more grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chestnut mushrooms, quinoa, low salt vegetable stock, risotto rice, thyme leaves, parmesan, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium pan, sauté the mushrooms for 2-3 mins, then stir in the quinoa. Add a ladle of the stock at a time and stir until absorbed. Stir in the rice and repeat again with the stock, until all the stock has been used up and the rice and quinoa are tender and cooked. Step 2: Stir in the thyme leaves, then divide between four plates or bowls. Serve topped with grated parmesan and rocket leaves.

Ingredient Names: porcini mushroom, olive oil, onions, garlic, thyme leaves, risotto rice, vegetable stock, white wine, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mushrooms in a bowl, pour 425ml boiling water over and leave to soak for 10 mins. Meanwhile, heat the oil in an ovenproof pan and fry the onion for 2 mins until starting to soften. Add the garlic and cook for another min. Step 2: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Drain the mushrooms, reserving the liquid, and chop. Add the mushrooms, thyme and rice to the pan, then stir well. Strain over the mushroom liquid, pour in the stock and wine and bring to the boil. Step 3: Season to taste, cover and bake for 25 mins or until the rice is just cooked and all the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the grated Parmesan, check the seasoning and sprinkle with extra thyme leaves and Parmesan shavings to serve.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, risotto rice, white wine, tomato, pepper, vegetable stock, fresh flat-leaf parsley, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Heat the oil in an ovenproof pan, then fry the onion for a few mins until softened. Turn up the heat, tip in the rice, stir, then fry for 1 min more. Pour in the wine, if using, stirring until absorbed, then pour in the tomatoes, peppers and 400ml of the stock. Cover and bake in the oven for 25 mins until the rice is tender and creamy. Step 2: Stir in the remaining stock and parsley, season and scatter with Parmesan, if you like.

Ingredient Names: converted rice, chicken broth, olive oil, red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, heat olive oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Add crushed red pepper and rice. Step 3: Stir well to coat rice with oil. Step 4: Cook for a minute or two until rice starts to look translucent. Step 5: Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until all broth is absorbed. Step 7: Remove lid, fluff rice with a fork. Step 8: Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and black pepper. Step 9: Cover just until cheese melts, serve.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, garlic, risotto rice, vegetable stock, peas, tarragon, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a saucepan, then add the onion and garlic. Cook for 4-5 mins until softened, then stir in the rice. Step 2: Pour in a ladleful of stock and simmer until all the liquid has been absorbed, stirring occasionally. Continue adding the stock in this way, until it has all been used up and the rice is tender. Stir in the peas and tarragon, then heat through for 2 mins. Check seasoning, then stir in the Parmesan and serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: pumpkin, olive oil, garlic, green onions, butter, risotto rice, ground cumin, vegetable stock, parmesan, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/ gas 4. Chop up the pumpkin or squash into 1.5cm cubes (kids- ask for help if it’s slippery). Put it on a baking tray, drizzle over some oil, then roast for 30 mins. Step 2: While the pumpkin is roasting, you can make the risotto. Put the garlic in a sandwich bag, then bash lightly with a rolling pin until it’s crushed. Step 3: Cut up the spring onions with your scissors. Step 4: Heat 1 tbsp oil with the butter in your pan over a medium heat – not too hot. Add the spring onions and garlic. Once the onions are soft but not getting brown, add the rice and cumin. Stir well to coat in the buttery mix for about 1 min. Step 5: Now add half a cup of the stock, and stir every now and then until it has all disappeared into the rice. Carry on adding and stirring in a large splash of stock at a time, until you have used up all the stock – this will take about 20 mins. Step 6: Check the rice is cooked. If it isn’t, add a splash more stock, and carry on cooking for a bit. Once the rice is soft enough to eat, gently stir in the grated cheese, chopped coriander and roasted pumpkin.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, onions, risotto rice, white wine, vegetable stock, parmesan, peas podded, broad beans podded
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and 25g of the butter in a large pan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 4-5 mins. Stir in the rice and cook for a further 2 mins. Turn up the heat and add the wine, let it bubble to evaporate the alcohol. Step 2: Once the wine has reduced, begin adding the hot stock a ladle at a time over a medium heat, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding the next and stirring continuously. The rice should always be moist, but not swimming in liquid. The process of adding and stirring should take about 16-20 mins, depending on what kind of risotto rice you use. Step 3: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil and blanch the peas and beans for 2-3 mins. Drain and set aside. Remove the risotto from the heat and stir in the remaining butter, Parmesan, peas and beans with some seasoning before serving.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, light olive oil, vegetable stock, unsalted butter, onions, celery, garlic, fresh bay leaf, thyme leaves picked, risotto rice, white wine, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Peel the squash and separate the bulbous seed-bearing section from the slender end. Chop the slender end into 2cm cubes, toss in half the oil, season lightly and roast in the oven, stirring occasionally, until golden brown on the outside and soft in the centre, about 30 mins. Cut the bulb in half and scrape out the seeds with a spoon – you can keep these to toast in the oven and sprinkle over salads. Chop the flesh into 2cm pieces. Warm the vegetable stock in a small pan, set over a low heat. Drop in squash and leave to gently poach. Step 2: While the squash is roasting, warm a medium-size frying pan over a gentle heat. Add the remaining olive oil and half the butter, followed by the onion. Cover and cook for 3 mins until the onion turns translucent. Stir in the celery, garlic, herbs and a few turns of pepper (no salt at this stage). Cover again and cook for a further 2 mins. Increase the heat slightly and stir in the rice. Stir, uncovered, for about 5 mins – this will help to develop the toasty aroma of the rice without burning the veg. Step 3: Turn up the heat, stir in the wine and let it bubble away to almost nothing. Reduce the heat and start adding the stock. Add one ladle at a time, stirring gently but constantly during each addition. The idea is to encourage the rice to absorb the liquid and soften, but also give up its starch to thicken the remaining broth. Don’t stir too aggressively or you will end up with a pan of mush. When the stock has been absorbed, it’s time to add the next ladleful and so on. It will take about 15 mins to reach the final ladle of stock. By this time the squash in the stock should have softened. Mash it up with the remaining stock and stir into the risotto. Step 4: Turn off the heat, dot the top of the risotto with remaining butter and most of the Parmesan, cover, leave to rest for 2 mins, then stir through and check the seasoning. Spoon the risotto into shallow bowls and sprinkle the roasted squash and leftover Parmesan on top. Serve with crusty bread and Sautéed spinach (below).

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, risotto rice, white wine, vegetable stock, smoked mackerel, green onions, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the butter in a large frying pan. Tip in the onion, then fry gently for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the rice and mix until coated in the butter, then pour in the wine and let it bubble until it’s almost all disappeared. Step 2: Pour in half the stock, give it a good stir, then leave to gently cook for 10 mins. Add half of the remaining stock, stir again and cook for 5 mins more. Keep adding stock and cooking until the rice is tender. Step 3: Peel the skin off the mackerel, scrape away any dark brown flesh, then flake. Stir into the rice with the spring onions and spinach, then cook just until the spinach has wilted slightly. Serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, zucchini, paprika, onions, garlic, plum tomato, red chile, sugar, saffron-flavoured risotto rice, water, basil leaves vegetarian parmesan-style cheese shavings, arborio rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan, then add the courgettes and fry for 3-4 mins until browned. Sprinkle with paprika, drain, then transfer to a shallow ovenproof baking dish. Step 2: Add the remaining oil to the frying pan and fry the onion and garlic for 5 mins, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned. Step 3: Add chopped tomatoes, chilli, sugar and seasoning, then cook for a further 2 mins. Spoon sauce over the courgettes, then put in the oven on a low shelf. Step 4: Put the risotto rice into a casserole dish with the boiling water, then season. Cover and cook in the oven, above the courgettes, for 20 mins until the rice and courgettes are tender. Step 5: Fluff up the rice with a fork, then spoon onto warmed serving plates. Top with the courgette mixture and garnish with fresh basil leaves and cheese.

Dish Name: The ultimate makeover: Risotto with squash & sage
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, low-salt vegetable stock, porcini mushroom, olive oil, onions, garlic, sage leaves, thyme, carnaroli rice, dry white wine, flatleaf parsley, parmesan, light mascarpone
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the squash lengthways, then scoop out the seeds. Peel, then cut the flesh into about 2.5cm pieces. Pour the stock into a pan, add the porcini, then bring to a gentle simmer. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a heavy, wide pan. Add the onion, garlic, sage, thyme and squash, then gently fry for about 10 mins until the squash is almost tender, stirring occasionally, so it doesn’t stick or burn. With the heat on medium, tip the rice into the squash. Keep stirring for 3-4 mins to toast it without colouring. Pour in the wine and stir everything for 1 min. Step 3: Start to add the hot stock (leaving the porcini behind) – this process should take 18-20 mins, so put a timer on if it helps. Stir in 1½ ladles and adjust the heat so it simmers. Keep stirring and scraping down the sides. Once the first lot of stock has been absorbed, add another ladleful, continuing to stir to keep the risotto creamy. Continue adding and stirring in a ladleful of stock as each previous one is absorbed (it’s ready for more when you drag the spoon across the bottom of the pan and it leaves a clear line). Step 4: As the last of the stock goes in (keep a little back) check if the rice is ready – it should be soft with a bit of chew in the middle – and the consistency fluid. Season with pepper. Step 5: Take the pan off the heat. Add a splash of the stock to keep the risotto moist, scatter over the parsley and half the Parmesan, then spoon on the mascarpone. With the lid on, let the risotto sit for 3-4 mins to rest. Step 6: Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a small frying pan. Add the sage leaves, then fry for a few secs until starting to colour. Transfer to kitchen paper with a slotted spoon to drain. Spoon the risotto into bowls, then scatter over the rest of the Parmesan and the crisp sage leaves.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, brown onion, fresh basil, long grain white rice, chicken broth, tomato paste, paprika, sugar, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic and onion, cook until translucent, 2 - 3 minutes. Add basil and cook for 20 seconds - don't let it burn. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients except basil. Mix until tomato paste is dissolved. Step 3: Crush basil sprig in hand, drop on surface then push in (leave on surface, don't stir). Step 4: Cover and bring to simmer, then immediately turn down heat to medium low (or low if stove is strong) and cook for 15 minutes or until liquid is fully absorbed - tilt saucepan to check. Step 5: Remove from heat and set aside, covered, for 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove basil sprig. Fluff with fork, taste for salt. Then leave to stand for another 5 minutes, uncovered. Stir through fresh basil. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion garlic, tomatoes, carnaroli, rosemary, vegetable stock, zucchini, peas, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. Cook the onion and garlic for 5 mins until the onion has softened. Add the tomatoes and cook for 3-4 mins until softened and pulpy, then add the rice and rosemary. Step 2: Pour in half the stock and leave to cook for 10 mins or until the liquid has evaporated, stirring from time to time. Add the rest of the stock, then continue to cook for a further 5 mins. Step 3: Stir in the courgettes and peas, then cook for another 5 mins or so, stirring until the rice is tender, but the mixture is still a bit saucy. Can be frozen at this stage for up to 1 month. Season with plenty of black pepper, then add the basil and stir until wilted. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, olive oil, chicken broth, rice, zucchini, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, saute onion and garlic in oil until tender. Step 2: Add broth and rice and bring to a boil. Step 3: Simmer, covered about 10 minutes, then stir in zucchini, salt and pepper. Step 4: Simmer, uncovered about 15 minutes until zucchini is tender. Step 5: Beat together egg, cheese and parsley and gradually whisk into hot soup.

Ingredient Names: mushroom, salt water, artichoke hearts in brine, garlic cloves, green onion, green olives, roasted red pepper, olive oil, white wine vinegar, dry sherry, salt, oregano, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wipe mushrooms with moist paper towel to clean Trim and cut into bite sized pieces. Step 2: Drop into boiling, salted water. Step 3: Boil 3 minutes, drain and place in bowl. Step 4: Add artichokes, including brine, to mushrooms. Step 5: Stir in onions, olives and red pepper. Step 6: Combine oil, vinegar, sherry, salt, oregano, pepper until well blended. Step 7: Cover and let sit at least 4 hours in refrigerator. Step 8: Stir once an hour to ensure even absorbtion.

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, olive oil, fresh ground black pepper, anchovy fillets, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients Salt should not be needed because of the anchovies.

Ingredient Names: red beets, blood orange juice, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, baby greens, burata cheese, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Wrap the beets in aluminum foil and bake them for one hour Unwrap them, cool slightly and peel. Step 3: Slice the beets thin on a mandoline. Step 4: Place them in a medium bowl and set aside To make the dressing, pour the blood orange juice into a small bowl, add the salt and pepper and whisk Slowly whisk in the olive oil in a stream Dress the beets with 1 to 2 tablespoons of the dressing. Step 5: Toss gently to combine. Step 6: In a large bowl, toss the baby greens with 1 to 2 tablespoons of dressing.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red wine vinegar, garlic clove, dill, lemon juice, oregano, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all ingredients together Let sit over night in a covered container in the refrigerator to get full flavor.

Dish Name: Anthony's House Salad With Italian Dressing
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, dijon mustard, garlic cloves, black pepper, salt, blue cheese, romaine lettuce, red leaf lettuce, carrots, red cabbage, crouton
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, mustard, garlic, pepper, and salt until well blended. Step 2: Fold in cheese Break the leaves off of both heads of lettuce, tear them by hand, wash and drain. Step 3: In a large wooden bowl, toss lettuce with shredded carrots and cabbage. Step 4: Garnish with croutons and top with dressing to taste.

Ingredient Names: mixed salad greens, hard salami, mozzarella cheese, chickpeas, pitted black olives, cucumber, roma tomatoes, pepperoncini peppers, lemon, balsamic vinegar, dried oregano, garlic clove, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the lettuce mix on large platter. Step 2: Slice salami into quarters Scatter evenly over lettuce. Step 3: Cut cheese into bite-size squares and scatter over lettuce. Step 4: Rinse and drain chickpeas. Step 5: Drain olives Scatter over salad Peel and thinly slice cucumber and arrange on salad. Step 6: Cut each tomato into quarters and place evenly around outer edge of plate. Step 7: Place the pepperoncini at even intervals.

Ingredient Names: chopped tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, pepperoni, zucchini, salad greens, parmesan cheese, italian dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, mushrooms, pepperoni and zucchini. Step 2: Add dressing and marinate for at least 2 hours. Step 3: Drain, reserving marinade. Step 4: Toss marinated items with greens. Step 5: Serve with reserved marinade and parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, asparagus, salt water, egg, heavy cream, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Drain and chill artichokes Break off tough ends of asparagus and cut into 3 inch pieces. Step 2: Cook in lightly salted water until bright green and tender Be careful not to overcook. Step 3: Remove asparagus from the water reserving 2 tablespoons of asparagus water. Step 4: Drain asparagus well on paper towel and chill Right before serving Whip cream and fold in mayo. Step 5: Add chilled asparagus water to taste. Step 6: Chop egg and add to cream mixture.

Ingredient Names: fennel bulbs, artichoke hearts, tomatoes, brine-cured black olives, anchovy fillet, olive oil, fresh lemon juice, dried oregano, dried thyme, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the feathery tops from the fennel bulbs, reserving several for garnish, and trim the stalks to the point where they meet the bulb, reserving them for another use Quarter the bulbs, discarding the core, and slice the quarters thin crosswise. Step 2: In a large Bowl combine the fennel, the artichoke hearts, the tomatoes, and the olives. Step 3: In a bowl whisk together the anchovy paste, the oil, the lemon juice, the organo, and the thyme. Step 4: Toss the fennel mixture with the dressing, season it with the pepper and salt, and. Step 5: Garnish the salad with the reserved fennel tops Serves 6.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, avocados, mozzarella cheese, marjoram, extra virgin olive oil, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the avocado into medium thick slices. Step 2: Sprinkle the avocado slices with lemon juice to prevent browning. Step 3: Cut the mozzarella into cubes. Step 4: Cut the tomatoes into quarters. Step 5: Place all the ingredients into a salad bowl and toss with olive oil, pinch of fresh majoram and salt until the desired taste is achieved. Step 6: Serve at room temperature Use firm ripe tomatoes and firm avocado to achieve best results.

Ingredient Names: shallots, balsamic vinegar, sugar, salt, fresh ground black pepper, low sodium chicken broth, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, flat-leaf italian parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a jar and cover Shake well. Step 2: Leave at room temperature at least one hour, and preferably overnight Shake occasionally during this period. Step 3: Strain using a coffee filter in a strainer. Step 4: Put the liquid in a food-quality spritzer bottle Before using, each time, shake well. Step 5: Then spritz on the salad greens or vegetables of your choice.

Ingredient Names: dijon mustard, shallot, salt, champagne vinegar, lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-sized mixing bowl, combine the mustard, shallots, and salt Slowly whisk in the vinegar, lemon juice, and olive oil until the mixture is emulsified. Step 2: Stir in the basil, cover, and chill for at least 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, fresh basil leaf, purple onion, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic salt, romano cheese, asiago cheese, fresh mozzarella cheese, french bread
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: In a large bowl, add all ingredients from tomatoes through garlic salt, set aside. Step 3: Slice french bread into 1 / 2 inch wide slices and place in the oven for about 4 minutes. Step 4: Top each slice of bread with a small piece of mozzarella cheese and place under the broiler for an additional 3-4 minutes, keep your eye on it! Step 5: Put 4 or 5 slices of bread on a plate and top with some of the tomato mixture making sure to scoop some of the juices too. Step 6: Sprinkle with asiago and romano cheese Eat!

Dish Name: Big John's Killer Caesar Salad Dressing
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, egg substitute, parmesan cheese, water, olive oil, lemon juice, anchovy paste, garlic cloves, sugar, black pepper, salt, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl Whisk for 1 minute Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: green beans, potatoes, carrots, pickle, peas, tomatoes, mayonnaise, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix in a big bowl the green beans, the potatoes, the carrots, the cucumbers and the peas, mix them well. Step 2: Add the parmesan cheese. Step 3: Add the mayo and mix the salad. Step 4: Put on the top the tomato slices.

Ingredient Names: crusty bread, plum tomatoes, fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, salt, dried rosemary, hot pepper flakes, white wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine bread, tomatoes and basil in large bowl In food processor with metal blade, chop garlic and salt. Step 2: Add rosemary, hot pepper flakes and vinegar. Step 3: Add olive oil in a stream to emulsify. Step 4: Toss bread mixture and dressing. Step 5: Allow to stand for at least 20 minutes so the bread can absorb the dressing.

Ingredient Names: orzo, peas, podded broad bean, half-fat sour cream, lemons, parmesan, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta following pack instructions, then drain and rinse under cold running water. Drain again. Cook the peas and beans in another pan of boiling water for 3 mins, before draining and cooling. Peel the beans, if you have time, and stir the vegetables through the pasta. Step 2: Mix the soured cream, lemon juice and Parmesan, and season. Mix through the pasta then, just before serving, scatter with the lemon zest and basil.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, cauliflower, champagne vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, spring onion, pine nuts, currants
Instructions: Step 1: Cook vegetables in boiling salted water until tender, then drain. Step 2: Combine vinegar, olive oil and spring onions in a bowl, season to taste and whisk well. Step 3: Combine vegetables, pinenuts and currants, pour dressing over and toss well. Step 4: Serve with veal and leek scallopine.

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce, olive oil, garlic cloves, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, anchovy paste, tabasco sauce, fresh lemon juice, coddled egg, fresh ground pepper, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix olive oil and garlic, worcestershire, mustard, anchovy, tabasco, pepper and lemon juice. Step 2: Mix well into romaine. Step 3: Add croutons Break, and mix in coddled egg, mix in parmesan. Step 4: Add more pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: lemon rind, parmesan cheese, oregano, dry mustard, black pepper, garlic powder, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Spread the lemon rind on a paper towel and microwave on high for 4 to 4 1 / 2 minutes or until it's dry, stirring several times. Step 2: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container May be stored for up to one month in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce, sliced almonds, eggs, lemon, garlic, dijon mustard, parmesan cheese, worcestershire sauce, olive oil, anchovy paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place lettuce in large sald bowl. Step 2: Make dressing by putting all ingredients in blender While blending, add 3 / 4 cup salad oil, blend til smooth. Step 3: Refrigerate at least 8 hours. Step 4: Pour over romaine lettuce and toss. Step 5: Top with sliced almonds or croutons.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic cloves, fresh basil, salt, pepper, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the tomatoes into large, but bite size pieces keeping the seeds and juice. Step 2: Place into a medium bowl. Step 3: Add the other ingredients except the olive oil, mix well, add olive oil, mix well again. Step 4: Marinate at room temperature for at least one hour.

Ingredient Names: garlic, shallots, dijon mustard, dried oregano, dried parsley, ground black pepper, kosher salt, red wine vinegar, olive oil, parmesan cheese, iceberg lettuce, romaine lettuce, basil, mozzarella cheese, garbanzo beans
Instructions: Step 1: For salad, toss together the ingredients in a large bowl and chill in your refrigerator For dressing, whisk together ingredients in a small bowl and chill for an hour Just before serving, toss dressing with salad and serve on small individual plates Can serve 4 for a main dish or 8 for small side salads.

Ingredient Names: cantaloupe, salt and pepper, extra virgin olive oil, white wine vinegar, fresh chives, soppressata
Instructions: Step 1: With a melon baller scoop out 1 inch balls from the melon and place into a medium bowl Toss with remaining ingredients and serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh lemon juice, salt, fresh ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, tomatoes, fresh mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the lemon juice, 1 / 2 t salt, and 1 / 4 t pepper in a medium bowl Gradually whisk in the oil to blend. Step 2: Set the dressing aside. Step 3: Cut the regular tomatoes into 1 / 2-inch thick slices, and the plum tomatoes into wedges. Step 4: Cut the cherry, grape, and teardrop tomatoes in half. Step 5: Arrange the tomatoes and mozzarella on a platter. Step 6: Drizzle the dressing over. Step 7: Sprinkle with the basil and additional salt and pepper to taste, and serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh tomatoes, fresh mozzarella cheese, red onion, black olives, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fresh basil, fresh oregano, salt & fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice mozzarella cheese into small slices. Step 2: Slice tomatoes thick Be sure to remove all of the core and the bottom little black dot. Step 3: Combine tomatoes and cheese with the remaining ingredients. Step 4: Toss well and make sure everything is coated. Step 5: Chill for 1 hour, although you don't want to leave in the refrigerator too long -- you don't want it to become mushy. Step 6: When ready to serve, arrange tomatoes on a large platter, put some of the cheese slices / chunks on each tomato slice Work in olives and onions to make it pretty Drizzel remaining dressing over this. Step 7: Garnish with fresh basil leaves and oregano leaves.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, romaine lettuce, red pepper, green pepper, bacon, garlic-flavored croutons, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, anchovies, red wine vinegar, oregano, pepper, salt, garlic clove, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Toss lettuces, peppers, bacon, mozzarella, and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese into large mixing / salad bowl, set aside To prepare dressing, combine anchovies, vinegar, oregano, salt, pepper, garlic, sugar, cornstarch, and remaining parmesan cheese into blender. Step 2: Mix in blender, slowly adding 1 cup oil. Step 3: Refrigerate until ready to use. Step 4: Combine salad, croutons, and dressing, serve.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, stuffed green olive, ripe olives, red pepper, banana pepper ring, pine nuts, lemon juice, cider vinegar, sugar, pepper, olive oil, mixed italian herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Combine dressing ingredients Set aside Cut and drain all vegetables Place in a large bowl and add dressing Toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, lemon juice, lettuce, roma tomatoes, red onion, pepperoncini peppers, minced fresh garlic cloves, eggs, parmesan cheese, hard salami, prosciutto, pepperoni
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all salad ingredients above, except eggs and cheese, in bowl Let sit, covered, for 30 min - 1 hour Just before serving, add eggs, cheese Toss with dressing.

Dish Name: Chop Salad With Dried Cranberries And Ricotta Salata
Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, celery, red onion, grape tomatoes, cucumber, dried cranberries, walnuts, ricotta salata
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all salad ingredients in a large bowl Pour desired amount of dressing and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce, pepperoni, pimiento, red onion, canned artichoke hearts, red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, parmesan cheese, pepperoncini pepper, provolone cheese, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Ln a large salad bowl, combine first 5 ingredients along with any optional ingredients, toss to combine. Step 2: Add vinegar, oil, salt, pepper, and parmesan to the bowl. Step 3: Toss thoroughly to combine the ingredients.

Dish Name: Chopped Italian Salad With Italian Vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, dijon mustard, salt, black pepper, basil, oregano, thyme, olive oil, romaine lettuce, roasted red peppers, salami, red onion, black olives, provolone cheese
Instructions: Step 1: For the vinaigrette, combine vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper and herbs in a food processor or blender and process on high speed until the mixture is well blended With the motor running, carefully pour olive oil in a steady stream. Step 2: Store in the refrigerator after use For the salad, combine all the salad ingredients and toss Dress with italian vinaigrette just before serving.

Ingredient Names: red wine vinegar, parmesan cheese, shallot, garlic clove, dried oregano, red pepper flakes, mayonnaise, sour cream, fresh basil, olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk vinegar, parmesan, shallot, garlic, oregano and pepper flakes in small bowl Microwave until cheese is melted and mixture is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 2: Let cool Process mayo, sour cream, basil, and vinegar mixture in food processor until smooth With motor running, slowly add oil until incorporated, about 1 minute. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper, serve.

Ingredient Names: salad potatoes, parmesan cheese, ricotta cheese, garlic, red onion, olive oil, cider vinegar, salt and pepper, fresh parsley, leaf oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until just tender While potatoes cook, combine remaining ingredients, except last two. Step 2: Drain potatoes While potatoes are still hot, stir in cheese mixture. Step 3: Cover, chill Just before serving, stir in parsley and oregano.

Ingredient Names: cornstarch, anchovy paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, sugar, oregano, oil, red wine vinegar, iceberg lettuce, parmesan cheese, pimentos, green onion, cooked bacon, crouton
Instructions: Step 1: Mix corn starch, anchovy paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, sugar, oregano with oil and red wine vinegar, blend well. Step 2: Toss with romaine and iceberg lettuce, provalone cheese, parmesan cheese, pimento, green onion. Step 3: Garnish with 6 slices cooked crumbled bacon, and croutons.

Ingredient Names: curly endive lettuce, belgian endive, salted anchovies, garlic clove, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash greens and cut into bite sized pieces Bone anchovies if needed and mash together with the garlic with a mortar and pestle into a paste. Step 2: Blend in the vinegar and let sit about 5 minutes. Step 3: Toss the greens with the anchovy mixture. Step 4: Add olive oil and salt and pepper. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, eggplants, red pepper, green pepper, red onions, garlic, capers, anchovy fillets, balsamic vinaigrette, brown sugar, tomato puree, basil, oregano, salt and pepper, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat about 1 / 4 inch of oil in a large saute pan Brown the eggplant in the oil in small batches. Step 2: Set aside in a stainless steel bowl. Step 3: Heat more oil Saut peppers until soft. Step 4: Add sauted peppers to bowl with the eggplant. Step 5: Cook onions and garlic until onions are tender. Step 6: Add brown sugar and vinegar and cook 2 minutes more. Step 7: Add tomato puree and green olives and cook until you have a thick, brown sweet-and-sour sauce. Step 8: Pour sauce over eggplant and peppers and toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: yellow peppers, red peppers, green beans, cherry tomato, capers, black olives, olive oil, red wine vinegar, basil leaves picked
Instructions: Step 1: On the barbecue, under the grill or over a flame, blacken the peppers all over, then pop into a bowl and cover with cling film. Once cool, peel, deseed and cut into strips, keeping any juices. Step 2: Cook the beans in boiling salted water until crunchy but not squeaky, then drain and drop straight into iced water. To serve, toss everything together, adding the shredded basil at the last minute, and scattering with the small basil leaves to finish.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, extra-virgin olive oil, mixed salad, fresh white breadcrumbs, pine nuts, green onions, garlic, sundried tomatoes oil, thyme leaves, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Place the courgettes in a single layer in a shallow ovenproof dish, fairly tightly together, cut-side up. Brush lightly with 1 tsp oil and bake for 20 mins. Step 2: To make the stuffing, mix all the ingredients together in a bowl and season with lots of black pepper. Step 3: Sprinkle the stuffing on top of the courgettes and drizzle with the remaining olive oil. Bake for a further 10-15 mins or until the courgettes are softened and the topping is golden and crisp. Serve hot with a mixed salad.

Ingredient Names: prosciutto, turkey breast steaks, pepperonata antipasto, ball reduced-fat mozzarella, basil leaves only, ciabatta, salad leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Lay the prosciutto out on a large baking sheet and sit a turkey steak on top, crossways. Spread the turkey with the pepperonata, then top with 2 slices of mozzarella, a few basil leaves and some seasoning. Fold the ends of the prosciutto around the cheese to enclose. Grill for 10 mins until golden and cooked through. Leave to rest for 2 mins. Step 2: Cut the ciabatta into 4 or the rolls in half, then toast under the grill. Top with salad leaves, then sit the turkey on top and serve.

Ingredient Names: fine green bean, fresh figs, shallots, ball mozzarella ripped chunks, hazelnuts, fresh basil leaves, balsamic vinegar, fig jam, extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan of salted water, blanch the beans for 2-3 mins. Drain, rinse in cold water, then drain on kitchen paper. Arrange on a platter. Top with the figs, shallots, mozzarella, hazelnuts and basil. Step 2: In a small bowl or jam jar with fitted lid, add the vinegar, fig jam, olive oil and some seasoning. Shake well and pour over salad just before serving.

Ingredient Names: white sandwich bread, virgin olive oil, salt, red wine vinegar, parmesan, sugar, garlic powder, fresh basil, chili flakes, cooking kosher salt, fresh black pepper, cos romaine lettuce, tomatoes, green capsicum bell pepper, red onions, kalamata olives
Instructions: Step 1: Croutons: Preheat oven to 200°C/390°F (180°C fan). Toss bread with oil and salt. Spread on a tray and bake 15 minutes, stirring twice, until golden and fully crisp. Cool on tray. Step 2: Dressing: Shake ingredients in a jar. Step 3: Make salad: Set aside some parmesan for garnish. Place croutons and all remaining salad ingredients in a large bowl. Pour Dressing over, toss well. Step 4: Serve: Transfer salad into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with reserved parmesan. Serve immediately!

Ingredient Names: corkscrew shaped pasta, white cheese, black olives, cherry tomatoes, pepperoni, red onions, marinated artichoke hearts, fresh broccoli, olive oil, red wine vinegar, worcestershire sauce, salt, mustard powder, garlic, lemon juice, ground pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all veggies, cheese, and meat in a very large bowl with cooled pasta. Step 2: In a blender, combine all dressing ingredients, using only 4 Tbsp of the vinegar and 1/4 cup Parmesan to start; blend until smooth. Step 3: Pour dressing over veggies and toss well. Step 4: Taste and add more vinegar, Parmesan, salt etc to taste as needed- this will vary greatly depending upon your preferences. Step 5: Chill at least 1 hour, then toss and test for seasonings again, adding more if needed, serves a crowd!

Ingredient Names: orzo, fresh basil, extra-virgin olive oil, parmesan, garlic very, pine nuts, bocconcini, semi-dried tomatoes very, wild arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the orzo for 8 mins until tender, then drain and cool under cold water. Drain again, then tip into a large bowl. Meanwhile, tear the basil, stalks and all, into a food processor. Add the oil, Parmesan, garlic and half the pine nuts, then whizz to a thick pesto-like dressing. Step 2: Stir the dressing through the orzo, then season. The dressing will seem quite thick, but keep stirring and it will eventually coat all the grains. Add the bocconcini, tomatoes and a handful of the rocket. Scatter with the remaining pine nuts and a little more Parmesan, if you like. Top with more rocket, then serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, cherry tomatoes, spinach leaves, fresh basil leaves, ricotta, eggs, salad
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat oil in a large non-stick frying pan and cook the onion for 5-6 mins until softened and lightly golden. Add the tomatoes and toss for 1 min to soften. Step 2: Remove from the heat, add the spinach leaves and basil, and toss together to wilt a little. Transfer all the ingredients to a greased 30cm x 20cm rectangular baking tin. Take small scoops of the ricotta and dot over the vegetables. Step 3: Season the eggs and beat well, then pour over the vegetables and cheese. Cook in the oven for 20-25 mins until pale golden and set. Serve with salad.

Ingredient Names: juice lemon, parsley half leaves kept, garlic, fennel bulb fronds, pine nuts, raisins, green olives, olive oil, sardines scaled gutted
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the lemon zest, chopped parsley and garlic together, then set aside. Pick the fronds from the fennel and set aside. Halve the fennel bulb and finely slice. Make the salad by mixing the sliced fennel and fronds with the pine nuts, raisins, olives, and whole parsley leaves. Dress with the olive oil and lemon juice. Step 2: Heat the griddle pan or barbecue. Season the fish with rock salt (this stops them sticking). Griddle for 2-3 mins on each side until the eyes turn white. Sprinkle the fish with the parsley mix and lift onto plates. Drizzle with oil and serve with the salad.

Dish Name: Squash & barley salad with balsamic vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, olive oil, pearl barley, tenderstem broccoli, sunblush tomato, red onions, pumpkin seeds, capers, black olives, fresh basil, balsamic vinegar, extra-virgin olive oil, dijon mustard, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Place the squash on a baking tray and toss with olive oil. Roast for 20 mins. Meanwhile, boil the barley for about 25 mins in salted water until tender, but al dente. While this is happening, whisk the dressing ingredients in a small bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Drain the barley, then tip it into a bowl and pour over the dressing. Mix well and let it cool. Step 2: Boil the broccoli in salted water until just tender, then drain and rinse in cold water. Drain and pat dry. Add the broccoli and remaining ingredients to the barley and mix well. This will keep for 3 days in the fridge and is delicious warm or cold.

Dish Name: Turkey patty & roasted root salad with Parmesan dressing
Ingredient Names: carrots, potato, celeriac, olive oil, parmesan, white wine vinegar, dijon mustard, yogurt, turkey ground meat, fresh basil leaf, fennel seeds, watercress spinach arugula salad
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Put the carrots, potato and celeriac in a roasting dish. Pour over half the olive oil and some seasoning, then cook for 45-50 mins, turning occasionally, until tender and golden. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the patties. Put the mince, basil and fennel seeds in a bowl, add some seasoning and shape into little patties. Heat a griddle pan to hot, brush the patties with oil and cook for 5-6 mins on each side, or until cooked through. Step 3: To make the dressing, mix the remaining oil, Parmesan, vinegar, mustard and yogurt with some seasoning. Lay the roasted veg and patties over the salad, then drizzle over the dressing and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, couscous, plum tomatoes, green onions, cucumbers, parsley, parmesan cheese, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt, fresh black pepper, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to a boil in a saucepan; add couscous, remove from heat, cover and let stand for about 5 minutes, until couscous has absorbed broth. Step 2: Let cool, then place in a bowl and fluff with a fork. Step 3: Add tomato, green onions, cucumber, parsley and Parmesan cheese to the couscous. Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt and peppers. Step 5: Pour over the salad, mixing well. Step 6: Refrigerate salad for at least 2 hours; bring to room temperature to eat.

Dish Name: Warm Potato Salad With Italian Dressing
Ingredient Names: red potatoes, light italian dressing, shallots, parsley, red bell peppers, yellow bell peppers, salt, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil whole potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes or until tender, drain. Step 2: Rinse under cold water until just cool enough to handle, drain again. Step 3: Cut potatoes into 1. Step 4: 5 cm pieces and place in a salad bowl. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients and pepper to taste to the potatoes. Step 6: Toss lightly and serve with a warm smile.

Dish Name: Warm Spinach, Fig, and Prosciutto Salad with Honey Balsamic Vina
Ingredient Names: spinach, olive oil, shallots, garlic, julienned red onion, prosciutto, honey, chicken stock, balsamic vinegar, virgin olive oil, fresh figs, kosher salt, ground white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and rinse the spinach leaves and keep them in the fridge until ready to use. Step 2: In a medium saute pan over medium high heat, add the olive oil, shallots and garlic. Step 3: Cook, stirring, 45 seconds. Step 4: Add the red onion and cook, stirring, one minute longer. Step 5: Add the proscuitto and toss just until hot. Step 6: Add the honey, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the chicken stock and vinegar to the pan to deglaze, scraping up any flavorful bits stuck to the bottom of the pan. Step 8: Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer until the luquids are reduced by one quarter, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Remove the pan from the heat, drizzle in the extra virgin olive oil, add the sliced figs and salt and pepper to taste, and stir. Step 10: Distribute the spinache leaves among the serving places. Step 11: Spoon some of the warm ham and fig vinaigrette over each serving.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic, white wine, butter, frozen shrimp, salt & pepper, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Start salted water boiling for pasta, heat olive oil. Step 2: Saute garlic& onions over high heat till onions start to turn clear. Step 3: Add wine, turn to medium heat& reduce for 5 minutes add shrimp till warmed through. Step 4: Stir in butter till melted. Step 5: Turn heat to lo / warm Salt& pepper to taste. Step 6: Cover till pasta is ready, serve together.

Dish Name: 5 Cheese Crab Lasagna With Roasted Garlic And Vegetables
Ingredient Names: garlic, extra virgin olive oil, dry white wine, fresh asparagus, cooking spray, garlic salt, salt & freshly ground black pepper, red bell peppers, fresh basil, dry lasagna noodles, roma tomatoes, dried oregano, parmesan-romano cheese mix, butter, sweet onion
Instructions: Step 1: Roast garlic: place oven rack on second notch. Step 2: Turn oven to 375 degrees f. Step 3: Cut tops off of the heads of garlic and discard excess skin. Step 4: Place garlic on a sheet of aluminum foil and drizzle 1 tsp olive oil over the tops. Step 5: Fold up edges of foil and add 2 tsp white wine to the bottom Seal packet tightly and place in oven. Step 6: Bake 40-45 minutes or until garlic is tender when pierced Open packet carefully to let cool and set aside Roast asparagus: turn up heat to 400 degrees f Holding at the end, gently bend each asparagus spear and snap off where it gives naturally.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, sliced mushrooms, mixed italian herbs, garlic clove, salt, red pepper flakes, fresh ground black pepper, diced tomatoes, dry red wine, white fish fillets, roasted red peppers, crabmeat, cooked shrimp, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil over medium-high heat in a dutch oven and add the onion. Step 2: Cook, stirring, until softened, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the mushrooms, italian herbs, garlic, salt, red pepper flakes, and black pepper and cook until the mushrooms have softened, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the tomatoes and wine and heat to a boil. Step 5: Cut the fillets into chunks and stir into the soup, making sure all pieces are submerged. Step 6: Reduce heat to a slow boil and cook until the fish is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the crabmeat, roasted red peppers and shrimp, if using Continue to cook until just heated through, about 3 minutes. Step 8: Taste - if acidic, add the sugar. Step 9: Serve garnished with the parsley.

Ingredient Names: littleneck clams, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, canadian bacon, hot pepper flakes, dry white vermouth, bottled clam broth, baking potato, spaghetti, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot for cooking pasta Scrub The clam shells under cold water with a stiff bristle brush. Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook over a medium heat until fragrant but not brown, about 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in the bacon and pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add vermouth and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add the clam broth, and bring to a boil. Step 7: Stir in the potatoes and clams, tightly cover the pan, and cook until the shells open and the potatoes are tender, about 8 minutes. Step 8: Cook the spaghetti in the boiling water until al dente, about 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: calamari tubes, green onions, garlic, cooked shrimp, cooked crabmeat, lemon juice, butter, cream cheese, milk, grated parmesan cheese, ground black pepper, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Rinse the calamari tubes and pat dry. Step 3: In a large bowl, stir together the onions, garlic, shrimp, crabmeat and lemon juice. Step 4: Spoon some of this mixture into each squid tube and seal the ends by 'sewing' with a toothpick. Step 5: Arrange in a single layer in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish, set aside. Step 6: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 7: Stir in cream cheese and garlic. Step 8: Cook and stir until cream cheese has melted. Step 9: Gradually whisk in the milk. Step 10: Cook until heated through and then remove from the heat and stir in the Parmesan cheese and pepper. Step 11: Pour over all of the calamari tubes in the baking dish. Step 12: Sprinkle about Romano cheese on top of each one. Step 13: Bake uncovered until the cheese is browned and sauce is bubbly. Step 14: While the calamari is baking, Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 15: Add linguine pasta, and cook until al dente, about 8-10 minutes, drain. Step 16: Serve the stuffed calamari and sauce over a bed of linguine.

Ingredient Names: arborio rice, sweet peppers, shrimp, instant clear broth, hot water, white wine, oil, parmesan cheese, garlic, pepper, basil, oregano, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Get a large, deep frying pan and heat oil. Step 2: Put rice into pan and fry for a couple minutes, then add 1 cup water and wine. Step 3: Stir occasionally, until water is nearly absorbed, then add another 1 / 2 cup water, stock cube, vegetables and shrimp or chicken, if using. Step 4: Repeat, stirring and adding water until rice is cooked This may take more or less than 4 cups, so taste occasionally and add water until you're happy. Step 5: Add garlic and herbs in the last five minutes, to taste. Step 6: Spoon onto plates and sprinkle parmesan cheese over dish For vegetarian do not use meat, seafood, or poultry Do not use a broth made from these.

Dish Name: Al Lewis Spinach Fettuccine With Crab Sauce
Ingredient Names: spinach fettuccine, olive oil, shallots, crabmeat, butter, fresh tomatoes, heavy cream, chablis, dried parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a large pot of lightly salted, rapidly boiling water for 3 to 6 minutes and drain. Step 2: Heat the oil in a saucepan over moderate heat. Step 3: Add the shallots and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the remaining ingredients and cook, stirring, for about 3 minutes more. Step 5: Divide the pasta among bowls and pour the sauce over it. Step 6: Garnish with parsley and cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, minced garlic, shallots, beef broth, jalapeno pepper, red chili pepper, fresh tomatoes, basil leaves, white wine, cornstarch, cream, mussels
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large stockpot over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and shallots, and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned. Step 3: Add a splash of the beef broth, jalapeno, and red chile pepper, and simmer for a few minutes to blend the flavors. Step 4: Add the tomatoes, basil leaves, white wine, and remaining beef broth, bring to a boil. Step 5: Dissolve cornstarch in a small amount of the light cream, and pour it and the rest of the cream into the stock pot. Step 6: Return to a boil, and add the mussels. Step 7: Cook until all of the shells have opened, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, spaghetti, tomatoes, tomato paste, dried oregano, bay leaf, white sugar, shrimp, clams, lemon juice, butter, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a lg frying pan and add onion and garlic. Step 2: Fry over medium heat for 6-7 minutes, until onions have softened. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in lg saucepan of boiling salted water for 10-12 mins or until al dente. Step 4: Stir the strained tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, bay leaf and sugar into the onions. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 2-3 mins. Step 6: Add the shellfish& lemon juice. Step 7: Stir well, then cover and cook for 6-7 minutes Do not over cook. Step 8: Meanwhile, drain the spaghetti when it is ready and add butter to the pan. Step 9: Return spaghetti to the pan and toss in the butter.

Ingredient Names: white bread, virgin olive oil, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, parmesan cheese, mushrooms, anchovy paste, anchovy fillets, stuffed olives, red pepper, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut 2" circles from the bread. Step 2: Brush both sides of the bread with the olive oil. Step 3: Place on a cookie sheet and bake in moderate oven for 10 min or until golden brown. Step 4: Melt butter in a frypan. Step 5: Add flour, mixing well and cook for 1 minute. Step 6: Add milk and stir over moderate heat until it boils& thickens, remove from heat. Step 7: Add 3 tbsp parmesan, salt& pepper& mushrooms, mix well. Step 8: Add anchovy paste and stir through The mixture looks a bit loose but it will bake perfectly.

Ingredient Names: anchovy, olive oil, garlic, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute' garlic in oil. Step 2: Add anchovies and cook / saute for a few minutes. Step 3: Put mixture in blender or food processor and puree. Step 4: Spread onto sliced french, sour dough or italian bread. Step 5: Cover each slice with desired amount of cheese. Step 6: Place under broiler until the cheese becomes bubbly.

Ingredient Names: anchovies, creme fraiche, leeks, pizza dough
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Mash anchovies together with creme fraiche, slice leeks. Step 3: Roll out pizza dough Smear on anchovy-creme fraiche mixture as evenly as possible, leaving about 2 inches clear at all edges. Step 4: Sprinkle about a handful of sliced leeks over all. Step 5: Roll up like a strudel. Step 6: Bake for about 30 minutes. Step 7: Cool and slice like pinwheels Serves about 4 people as an appetizer, 2 as an entree.

Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, anchovy fillets, garlic cloves, tomatoes, salt & pepper, hot sauce, asiago cheese, lite olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the bread and very lightly paint with the olive oil and toast the slices in the oven 300f for approx 20 minutes or until the slices are crisp dried I do this well in advance and keep the dried toasts in an air tight container so you always have some on hand, or you can buy ready made ones In your food processor or hand held chopper attachment put in: sun dried tomatoes, anchovies, garlic salt& pepper, and hot sauce. Step 2: Chop until you have a very fine spreadable mixture, let stand for at least 1 / 2 hour I make mine up a few hours in advance. Step 3: Spread the mixture on the dry toasts. Step 4: Top with fresh chopped tomato. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese of your choice. Step 6: Place in 375f oven for approx 15 minutes or until heated through and the cheese is golden.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta And Crab With Alfredo Sauce
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, alfredo sauce, lump crabmeat, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta according to package directions Heat sauce and crabmeat in medium saucepan until hot Add pasta, heat through Top with cheese.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Goat Cheese Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, onion, medium shrimp, baby portabella mushrooms, garlic, tomato paste, dry white wine, angel hair pasta, salt and pepper, soft fresh goat cheese, fresh italian parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Put large pot of salted water on to boil for pasta. Step 2: Drain sun-dried tomatoes, reserving oil. Step 3: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add 2 tablespoons oil from sun-dried tomatoes. Step 5: Add onion, shrimp and mushrooms. Step 6: Saute until shrimp is pink, stirring often. Step 7: Stir in garlic and saute for about 1 minute. Step 8: Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring. Step 9: Add wine and sun-dried tomatoes. Step 10: Simmer until liquid is reduced by half, about 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, shrimp, salt, lemon juice, dry white wine, butter, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Put olive oil and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat and cook slowly to infuse the oil with the garlic, but do not burn garlic. Step 2: Add red pepper flakes. Step 3: Raise the heat to medium high. Step 4: Add shrimp and season with a little salt. Step 5: Cook until shrimp is almost done. Step 6: Add wine, cook until alcohol is burned off, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add the lemon juice and butter to finish. Step 8: Garnish with parsley.

Ingredient Names: tuna, red onion, cannellini beans, garlic clove, celery rib, whole grain mustard, dried oregano, red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the vinegar, oil, oregano, mustard,, salt and pepper together in a bowl until combined and fairly viscous If the dressing is too thick, thin it out with some of the reserved bean liquid. Step 2: Mix the tuna, beans, red onion, celery and garlic into the dressing, breaking the tuna up. Step 3: Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving, but serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: green peppers, carrots, pitted black olives, green olives, pickling onions, pimientos, sweet pickles, cauliflower, olive oil, garlic, ketchup, hot ketchup, red wine, tomato paste, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Chop green peppers, cut carrots into julienne strips. Step 2: Chop ripe olives, green olives, pickled onions, pimento, sweet pickle and set aside Break cauliflower into bite sized pieces. Step 3: Put 2 oz of olive oil into frying pan and add 2 cloves garlic, add cauliflower and saute. Step 4: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 5: In a large pot add remaining olive oil and saute the remaining 3 cloves of garlic, add ketchup, wine, tomato paste and oregano. Step 6: Add chopped vegetables, pickles, olives, artichokes, pimento, cauliflower and mushrooms. Step 7: Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add anchovies and tuna to mixture and bring to a boil, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Step 9: Serve for use immediately, refrigerate for up to 2 weeks, place in containers for freezing or place immediately in hot sterilized jars.

Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, marinated mushrooms, caponata, green olives, black olives, pepperoni, provolone cheese, sweet peppers, pepperoncini peppers, celery hearts, fresh tomatoes, anchovy fillets, mozzarella cheese, genoa salami, prosciutto
Instructions: Step 1: Sliced meats may be rolled up. Step 2: Arrange your choices attractively on a large platter, serve with thin slices of italian bread and bread sticks on the side A cruet of olive oil and vinegar near by is a nice touch.

Dish Name: Artichoke And Ripe Olive Tuna Salad
Ingredient Names: chunk light tuna, canned artichoke heart, ripe olives, mayonnaise, lemon juice, fresh oregano, fresh parsley, tomatoes, lettuce leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tuna, artichokes, olives, mayonnaise, lemon juice, oregano and parsley, if using, in a medium bowl, stir to mix well. Step 2: Place salad in a mound on lettuce leaves along with sliced tomatoes and serve This also makes a great sandwich on french bread!, enjoy!

Dish Name: Asparagus Risotto With Crab And Orange Gremolada
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, water, asparagus, butter, vegetable oil, onion, arborio rice, dry white wine, salt, crabmeat, orange zest, garlic cloves, fresh parsley, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the broth and water to a simmer in a medium pot. Step 2: Cook the asparagus in the broth until just done, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Remove with a slotted spoon. Step 4: Put in a colander, rinse with cold water and drain. Step 5: Keep the broth at a simmer. Step 6: In a large pot, melt 1 tablespoon of the butter with the oil. Step 7: Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the rice and stir until it begins to turn opaque, about 2 minutes. Step 9: Add the wine and salt. Step 10: Cook, stirring, until the wine is absorbed.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, olive oil, fresh parsley, garlic, dry red wine, tomato sauce, salt, dry mustard, oregano, pepper, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cook oil and garlic 1 minute. Step 2: Add all other ingredients except shrimp. Step 3: Place shrimp in large ziploc freezer bag and pour sauce over. Step 4: Marinate 2 hours in refrigerator. Step 5: Cook 10 minutes under broiler or until shrimp is done. Step 6: Serve over angel hair pasta.

Ingredient Names: dried salt cod fish, olive oil, all-purpose flour, fresh parsley, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Cut soaked, skinless and boneless cod into into bite size pieces so they can cook all together quickly in the pan. Step 2: Heat oil in pan, use 1 / 2 cup or try for 1 / 2inch at least in pan While cod is moist but not dripping wet, dredge well in flour Shake off excess and don't worry if patches of flour look to thick With hot oil, fry cold without crowding the pan and turn pieces when lightly golden. Step 3: Drain well on rack or paper towels. Step 4: Serve almost immediately or at room temperature. Step 5: Fry parsley by putting into hot oil for a few seconds or till it becomes crisp. Step 6: Place fish on serving platter with parsley and lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: littleneck clams, parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, garlic, onion, dried oregano, paprika, dried mustard, italian parsley, butter, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large saute pan. Step 2: Add onions, garlic, oregano, paprika and pepper. Step 3: Cook until onions soften. Step 4: Add mustard and bread crumbs, stir. Step 5: Remove to bowl, add parmesan and parsley. Step 6: Chop clams in 4 or 5 pieces, mix with stuffing. Step 7: Put mixture into shells. Step 8: Bake at 400 degrees for 7-8 minutes Seve with lemon wedges and parmesan.

Dish Name: Baked Cod Or Halibut With Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, dry white wine, flat leaf parsley, cod steaks, dried breadcrumbs, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and cook the onion for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, wine and seasoning. Step 4: Bring the sauce just to a boil, then reduce the heat slightly and cook, uncovered, for 15-20 minutes, until thick. Step 5: Stir in the parsley. Step 6: Grease an ovenproof dish, put in the fish and spoon an equal amount of the tomato sauce onto each piece. Step 7: Sprinkle the dried bread crumbs over the top. Step 8: Bake for 20-30 minutes, basting the fish occasionally with the sauce until the fish is tender and cooked through and the bread crumbs are golden and crisp, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: haddock fillet, bay scallops, jumbo shrimp, white wine, lemon juice, butter, ritz cracker crumbs, garlic powder, black pepper, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f, line a roasting pan with parchment Lay fish fillets in a single layer on the bottom of the dish, then top with scallops and shrimp. Step 2: Pour the white wine and lemon juice overtop of the seafood. Step 3: In a bowl, toss butter, cracker crumbs, garlic powder, black pepper and lemon zest. Step 4: Sprinkle over the seafood. Step 5: Bake 15 minutes, then turn the broiler to hi and broil 2 minutes, until browned.

Ingredient Names: fine dry breadcrumb, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, large shrimp, fresh garlic, seasoning salt, fresh ground pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine breadcrumbs, cheese, and parsley in a shallow dish. Step 2: Set aside Peel shrimp, leaving tails intact, and devein, if desired. Step 3: Place in a large bowl. Step 4: Sprinkle shrimp with garlic, seasoned salt, and pepper. Step 5: Drizzle with olive oil. Step 6: Toss gently Dredge each shrimp in breadcrumb mixture. Step 7: Arrange shrimp in an even layer in 2 greased 15- x 10-inch jellyroll pans. Step 8: Bake at 400 for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring twice.

Ingredient Names: bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, romano cheese, salt, garlic powder, orange roughy fillets, butter, chopped fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 2: Coat a medium baking dish with nonstick spray. Step 3: Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, Romano cheese, salt, and garlic powder together in a shallow bowl. Step 4: Brush orange roughy fillets on both sides with melted butter, then dredge in the bread crumb mixture. Step 5: Arrange fillets in a single layer in the prepared baking dish and sprinkle with parsley. Step 6: Bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, 10 to.

Dish Name: Baked Oysters With Bread Crumbs And Garlic Ostriche All Italia
Ingredient Names: butter, fresh white breadcrumbs, garlic, fresh parsley, oysters, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 Choose an ovenproof platter or a shallow baking dish that is just large enough to hold the oysters in one layer Butter the dish generously. Step 2: In a heavy 6-8" skillet, melt 2 tblsp Of butter over moderate heat. Step 3: When the foam subsides, add the fresh, white bread crumbs and the garlic, and toss them in the butter for 2-3 minutes, or until they are crisp and golden. Step 4: Stir in the fresh parsley. Step 5: Spread about 2 / 3 cup of the bread-crumb mixture in the bottom of the buttered baking dish, and arrange the oysters over it in one layer. Step 6: Mix the rest of the bread-crumb mixture with the grated cheese and spread the combination on the oysters Dot the top with the tiny bits of butter.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, peeled and deveined, unsalted butter, white wine, lemon juice, dried parsley, cayenne pepper, minced garlic, bread crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Place shrimp into a saucepan, cover with water to a depth of 2 inches over shrimp, and bring to a boil. Step 2: Cover pan and cook until shrimp are pink, 2 to; drain. Step 3: Combine butter, white wine, lemon juice, parsley, cayenne pepper, and garlic in a 2-quart casserole dish. Step 4: Place casserole dish in oven and preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 5: When butter is melted, lightly toss shrimp in butter mixture until coated. Step 6: Sprinkle bread crumbs over shrimp. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until bread crumbs are lightly golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Shrimp and Orzo With Chickpeas, Lemon, and Dill
Ingredient Names: jumbo shrimp, kosher salt, pepper, olive oil, fennel bulbs, garlic, red pepper flakes, orzo pasta, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, fresh dill, lemons, dry white wine, low sodium chicken broth, feta
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Dry shrimp with paper towels and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to a large, ovenproof skillet over high heat. Swirl to coat. When shimmering, add shrimp in an even layer. Cook, turning once, until lightly seared, about 1 ½ minutes per side. Add additional 1 tablespoon olive oil halfway through cooking if skillet is dry. Remove shrimp to a plate. Reduce heat to medium-high and add 2 tablespoons olive oil. Add fennel, garlic, chile flakes. Season with salt and pepper and cook until softened and golden in spots, about 4 minutes. Add orzo, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, olives, dill, and lemon zest. Stir to combine. Add white wine and let reduce for 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, stir to combine, and return shrimp to skillet, nestling them into as even a layer as possible. Bring to a boil and transfer to oven. Bake 4 minutes, stir gently, and continue baking until orzo is cooked through, about 4 minutes more. Step 4: Serve immediately, drizzled with olive oil and topped with additional dill, lemon wedges, and feta.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, extra virgin olive oil, fresh thyme, tomatoes, green olives, hot red pepper flakes, capers, garlic cloves, red onion, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Lightly oil a shallow baking dish large enough to hold the fillets in one layer. Step 2: In a bowl stir together the oil, the thyme, the tomatoes, the olives, the red pepper flakes, the garlic, the onion, and the lime juice In the prepared baking dish arrange the fillets, skin sides down, season them with salt, and spoon the tomato mixture over them. Step 3: Bake the fish, uncovered, in the middle of the oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until it just flakes.

Ingredient Names: trout, olive oil, garlic, fresh ground black pepper, salt, fresh mushrooms, butter, fine dry breadcrumbs, green onions, lemons, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: To cook trout, wash and dry the fish inside and out and coat sides with a little olive oil. Step 2: Slice mushrooms and place half in the bottom of a shallow baking dish Salt and pepper fish, inside and out, to taste and place in dish on top of mushrooms. Step 3: Sprinkle bread crumbs over fish along with the minced parsley, chopped garlic and the green onion If using fresh lemons, squeeze 1 or 2 directly over the entire trout including the inside. Step 4: Meanwhile melt butter, add to olive oil and the juice of 2 lemons. Step 5: Pour slowly over fish saving about half of the mixture. Step 6: Bake for 20-25 minutes at 375 degrees or until they are tender and bread crumbs are light brown Fish is done when the meat flakes easily when a fork is inserted into the flesh and lifted up slightly Just before the fish are done, saute 1-2 minutes, the remaining mushrooms in the sauce that is left and pour over top after placing trout on a serving plate.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, eggplants, passata, dry white wine, capers, sugar, mascarpone, milk, pesto, eggs, salmon fillets, lasagne, spinach, parmesan, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onions for 10 mins, until starting to turn golden. Stir in the aubergines, then fry 5 mins more to soften them. Step 2: Pour in the passata and wine, then stir in the capers, sugar, 1 tsp salt and some black pepper. Cover and cook for 20 mins. Step 3: Meanwhile, spoon 250g mascarpone into a bowl with the milk, pesto and eggs, and beat until smooth. Step 4: Halve each salmon fillet to make 2 long pieces. Spread 1 tbsp of the remaining mascarpone over each pasta sheet, add a piece of salmon, then season and roll up. Step 5: Wash and wilt the spinach in a large pan (you don’t need to add oil), then squeeze as much liquid as you can from it – this is important as otherwise the pasta bake will be too wet. Step 6: Spread the spinach on the base of a large lasagne dish or roasting tin, measuring approx 27 x 35cm. Arrange the salmon and lasagne parcels on the spinach, then pour over the tomato and aubergine sauce. Now carefully pour over the pesto and mascarpone layer. If freezing, cover the surface of the lasagne with cling film, then overwrap the dish with cling film and foil. To defrost, thaw overnight in the fridge. Step 7: To cook and serve, heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5, scatter the Parmesan over the mascarpone and bake for 40 mins until bubbling. Allow to settle in the dish for 5-10 mins before serving scattered with basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: bay scallop, sweet onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, broccoli floret, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, italian seasoning mix, pasta, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan, heat half the oil. Step 2: Add the onions and saute until just translucent but still crisp. Step 3: Add the peppers, broccoli and garlic, cover and simmer for about three minutes. Step 4: Remove the mixture from the heat, stir in the italian seasoning and set aside. Step 5: Stir the pasta into the boiling water. Step 6: When the pasta has been on for about five minutes, return the vegetables to the heat, stir in the scallops and the remaining oil, cover and simmer on low until the pasta is done. Step 7: Drain the cooked pasta and put it in a large pasta bowl. Step 8: Check that the scallops are cooked through and stir the mixture with the pasta, tossing well A great side for this is a good garlic bread---.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, bay scallop, garlic cloves, fresh lemon juice, white wine, capers, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, flat-leaf italian parsley, lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy-bottomed skillet, heat the oil and half of the butter over medium-high heat until mixture starts to brown. Step 2: Make sure the pan and oil mixture is very hot - transfer half of the scallops to the skillet and cook without moving until seared: about 20 - 30 seconds Gently flip and sear on other side for another 20 - 30 seconds. Step 3: Remove from skillet. Step 4: Add remaining scallops and butter. Step 5: Cook in the same manner as the first batch. Step 6: Once the second batch of scallops is finished cooking, return the first batch to the skillet and give a quick, gentle toss. Step 7: Remove skillet from heat. Step 8: Add the garlic, lemon juice, wine and cappers. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: cherrystone clams, butter, onion, celery, red pepper, garlic clove, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, red pepper flakes, black pepper, breadcrumbs, bacon, rock salt
Instructions: Step 1: Under cold running water, rinse clams and scrub with a soft-bristled brush to remove as much sand as possible In an oven-proof shallow dish, pour in rock salt. Step 2: Cover bottom of dish evenly with rock salt until 1 / 4-inch thick. Step 3: Steam clams until shells begin to open Carefully remove each clam from steamer and set aside, reserving as much of the juice as possible in the bottom half of each shell. Step 4: Allow clams to cool until manageable to handle. Step 5: Then carefully break off top half of shell With a knife, gently separate meat from where it is attached to shell. Step 6: Then nestle the half of the shell with clam and juice into rock salt, arranging in the best way possible to fit into the baking dish. Step 7: Preheat oven to 500 degrees.

Ingredient Names: scungilli, celery, red onion, italian parsley, pitted black olives, best olive oil, lemon, sea salt, ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Ok real easy. Step 2: Rinse the canned scungilli well. Step 3: Take a medium mixing bowl. Step 4: Add all the above ingredients. Step 5: Toss until mixed well. Step 6: Refrigerate for 30 minutes to let the flavors meld and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, paprika, olive oil, butter, garlic cloves, white wine, salt, black pepper, fresh parsley, seasoned bread crumbs, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Dry shrimp on a layer of paper towels to remove excess moisture. Step 2: Place shrimp in a bowl and toss with paprika, set aside. Step 3: Heat oil and butter in a large saute pan over med-high heat. Step 4: Add garlic and saut for 1 minute. Step 5: Add wine, salt and pepper and reduce by half. Step 6: Add shrimp and cook on one side about 2-3 minutes to sear Do not shake the pan at this point and it's important not to overcrowd the shrimp to sear and caramelize properly. Step 7: After one side is seared, begin to shake the pan and toss shrimp to continue cooking another minute or two. Step 8: Sprinkle with parsley and saute' / toss one more minute.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, hot italian sausage, onions, tomatoes with garlic, dry white wine, fresh mushrooms, tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes, bottled clam juice, garlic cloves, fresh basil leaf, parsley, littleneck clams, shrimp, sea scallops
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large dutch oven or flameproof casserole over medium heat. Step 2: Add sausage, mushrooms and onions and cook, stirring frequently and breaking up sausage with a fork until sausage loses pink color, about 10 minutes, stir in tomatoes. Step 3: Bring mixture to boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes. Step 5: Pour in wine and clam juice. Step 6: Return mixture to boil. Step 7: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Add basil and garlic and cook 5 minutes longer Stock can be prepared ahead to this point.

Dish Name: Bow Tie Salad With Scallops Black Olives Oranges And Mint
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, sea scallops, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, navel oranges, lemon juice, kalamata olives, red onion, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the bow ties until just done, about 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain thoroughly. Step 3: Meanwhile, season the scallops with 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon of the pepper. Step 4: In a large nonstick frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over moderately high heat Sear the scallops, in two batches if necessary, until brown and just done, 1 to 2 minutes per side, let cool. Step 5: Using a stainless-steel knife, peel the oranges down to the flesh, removing all of the white pith. Step 6: Cut the sections away from the membranes and put them in a large glass or stainless-steel bowl. Step 7: Squeeze the juice from the membranes into the bowl. Step 8: Add the remaining 4 tablespoons oil, the lemon juice, olives, onion, mint, and the remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper.

Dish Name: Bow Ties Or Farfalline With Tuna And Artichoke Hearts
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, salt, olive oil, onion powder, garlic powder, italian seasoning, marinated artichoke hearts, black olives, tomatoes, string bean, tuna in water, coarse black pepper, fresh parsley
