Instructions: Step 1: Bring 5 quarts of water to boil, add salt and bowties or farfalline or any other small pasta. Step 2: Cook until al dente, about 6 minutes. Step 3: Drain and place in large bowl. Step 4: Toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, stir in artichoke hearts, olives, tomatoes, and string beans, toss well. Step 5: Add tuna crumbled with a fork. Step 6: Season with salt, freshly ground pepper, onion & garlic powder, italian seasoning and remaining olive oil. Step 7: Toss and garnish with fresh parsley, serve and enjoy!

Dish Name: Bow Ties With Tuna And Artichoke Hearts
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, salt, extra virgin olive oil, marinated artichoke hearts, black olives, tomatoes, string bean, tuna in olive oil, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 5 qts of water to a boil, add the salt and paste. Step 2: Cook until al dente, about 6 minutes. Step 3: Drain and place into a large bowl. Step 4: Toss with 1 tbs of the olive oil. Step 5: Stir in the artichokes, olives, tomatoes, and string beans. Step 6: Toss well and add the tuna, crumbled with a fork. Step 7: Season with the remaining olive oil, salt, and pepper, toss and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onion, salt, ground black pepper, whole branzino fish, lemon wedges, rosemary, white wine, lemon juice, fresh oregano, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Step 2: Drizzle olive oil into a large baking pan; add red onion and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Place 2 whole branzino fish into the baking pan. Step 4: Stuff each cavity with 1 lemon wedge, 1 rosemary sprig, and some of the red onion in the pan. Step 5: Pour white wine and lemon juice over fish and sprinkle with oregano. Step 6: Drizzle remaining olive oil over fish. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, about 25-30 minutes. Step 8: Gently slide a spatula between the bones to separate fish; remove all the bones. Step 9: Serve fish on a platter; garnish with parsley and 2 lemon wedges.

Dish Name: Bread Salad With Tuna And Capers
Ingredient Names: bread, scallion, red wine vinegar, salt, extra virgin olive oil, tuna in water, tomatoes, celery hearts, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the bread. Step 2: Cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes. Step 3: Set aside Reserve 2 tablespoons of the dark green scallion stems. Step 4: In a large bowl, whisk the vinegar and salt. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup oil and whisk to combine. Step 6: Add the tuna, tomato, all the chopped scallions except reserved stems, celery, 4 tablespoons capers, and bread. Step 7: Toss and set aside for 15 to 30 minutes at room temperature, toss occasionally. Step 8: Taste a bread cube.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat linguine, unsalted butter, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, kosher salt, red pepper flakes, old bay seasoning, dried basil, dried oregano, lemon juice, canned baby clams, white wine, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions While pasta cooks, heat butter and olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and saute about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add seasonings and saute 1 more minute. Step 4: Add lemon juice, clams with their liquid, and wine, simmer 5 minutes. Step 5: Toss pasta with with clam sauce mixture. Step 6: Garnish with parmesan and parsley.

Dish Name: Bucatini Pasta with Shrimp and Anchovies
Ingredient Names: bucatini, anchovy fillets with oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, zucchini, tomatoes, dried oregano, dried basil, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Stir in bucatini and return to a boil. Step 3: Cook bucatini, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to; drain. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine anchovies, reserved anchovy oil, garlic, and red pepper flakes in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir, breaking up anchovies while stirring, until garlic begins to sizzle. Step 5: Add zucchini; cook until begins to soften, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Stir in grape tomatoes; continue cooking until zucchini is tender and tomato skins begin to pop, more. Step 7: Season with oregano and basil. Step 8: Add shrimp; cook and stir until shrimp turn pink and are no longer translucent. Step 9: Serve over bucatini.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, shrimp, salt, black pepper, garlic cloves, fresh oregano, italian parsley, breadcrumbs, pecorino romano cheese, lemons, cooked linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Add the oil, butter and garlic to a large saute pan and heat to medium. Step 2: When oil is hot and the garlic fragrant, add the shrimp, and a couple pinches of salt and black pepper. Step 3: After 2-3 minutes add oregano and parsley and saute. Step 4: Keep turning the shrimp so both sides cook evenly and the shrimp is pink and cooked through. Step 5: When shrimp is done, a couple minutes longer, add the breadcrumbs and cheese, turn to coat well. Step 6: Add the lemon juice, stirring all to combinee well. Step 7: Serve over linguini.

Ingredient Names: fresh lemon juice, dijon mustard, extra virgin olive oil, hot sauce, chives, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, tuna in olive oil, celery ribs, butter beans, capers, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk the lemon juice with the mustard & a drop or two of hot sauce, then slowly whisk in the olive oil. Step 2: Stir in the chives and season the lemon-mustard vinaigrette with salt and pepper. Step 3: In a large bowl, gently toss the drained tuna with the sliced celery, butter beans and capers. Step 4: Add the lemon-mustard vinaigrette and toss to coat the salad. Step 5: Season the salad with salt and pepper and serve at once.

Dish Name: Cabbage Stuffed With Orzo And Shrimp
Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, shrimp, fresh dill, cilantro, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, coarse black pepper, orzo pasta, cabbage leaves, white wine, lemon, fish stock, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Saute onion and garlic in the olive oil until softened. Step 3: Add shrimp and cook until they just turn pink Do not cook through. Step 4: Remove from heat and add dill, cilantro, crushed red pepper flakes, pepper, salt, and orzo. Step 5: Mix well and adjust seasoning. Step 6: Place a blanched cabbage leaf on a work surface, concave-side up. Step 7: Place 2 tb of the orzo mixture in the hollow of this leaf. Step 8: Fold sides of the leaf over the filling and starting with the stem end roll the leaf up around the filling. Step 9: Place the wrapped cabbage leaf seam-side down in a casserole.

Dish Name: Cajun Shrimp Crab With Alfredo Sauce
Ingredient Names: noodles, butter, yellow onion, garlic, rotel, cayenne pepper, seasoning, heavy whipping cream, shrimp, lump crabmeat, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In your main saucepan, saut garlic and 1 / 2 yellow onion with butter do not burn. Step 2: Cook until onions become transparent. Step 3: In a separate pot, cook down your can of rotel until soft. Step 4: Then add to main saucepan. Step 5: Stir in whipping cream, reduce heat to low and continue stirring about 2 minutes, add shrimp & crab. Step 6: Cook till shellfish is done. Step 7: Season to your liking I used slap ya mama cajun seasoning and salt & pepper. Step 8: Add parmesan cheese, stirring after about 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: orecchiette, butter, shallot, garlic, green onion, cajun seasoning, cracked black pepper, white wine, plum tomato, medium shrimp, baby spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add orecchiette pasta, and cook for 9 to 11 minutes, until almost al dente, drain. Step 3: Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Stir in shallots, garlic, and green onion. Step 5: Season with cajun seasoning and pepper, and cook about 2 minutes. Step 6: Mix in wine, tomatoes, and shrimp Continue to cook and stir until shrimp are opaque. Step 7: Mix in the pasta and spinach, cover, and simmer 3 to 5 minutes, until pasta is al dente and spinach has wilted.

Ingredient Names: firm white fish fillets, black peppercorns, fennel seeds, smoked paprika, red chili flakes, nutmeg powder, caster superfine sugar, cooking kosher salt, virgin olive oil, tomato paste, linguine pasta, garlic, tomato passata, parsley, parmesan cheese, stale bread like sourdough
Instructions: Step 1: Toast & grind - Preheat a large deep skillet or pot over medium heat, no oil. Toast black peppercorn and fennel for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until it smells fragrant and the fennel is lightly browned. Transfer to a mortar and use a pestle and grind to a powder while still hot. Step 2: Coat fish - Transfer to a medium bowl with remaining Calabrian spiced fish ingredients. Stir well with a spatula until combined. Set aside. Step 3: Cook pasta - Boil 3 litres of water with the cooking salt. Cook pasta per packet directions minus 1 minute. Just before draining, scoop out 1 1/2 cups pasta cooking water. Then drain in a colander and leave until ready to use. Step 4: Calabrian fish ragu - While the pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in the same skillet you used to toast the fennel on medium high. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the fish. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring regularly. Add tomato passata. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add 1 cup of the reserved pasta cooking water and simmer for 2 minutes. Step 5: Toss pasta - Add pasta and 3/4 of the parsley. Toss for 1 minute to coat the pasta with the sauce. Most of the fish will break up into flakes but some will remain in larger chunks - this is good! We don't want disintegrated mush, nor giant chunks. Once the pasta turns red and the sauce and fish bits are clinging to the pasta straws, remove from heat and divide between bowls immediately. Step 6: Serve - Sprinkle with parsley, pangrattato and parmesan. Eat immediately! Step 7: Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F (160°C fan-forced). Step 8: Toss bread, oil and salt in a small bowl. Spread on a tray and bake for 10 minutes, tossing at the 5 minute mark, or until light golden and fully crisp.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, all-purpose flour, salt, dried oregano, black pepper, squid, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a deep-fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Mix together flour, salt, oregano, and pepper in a medium bowl. Step 3: Dredge squid in flour mixture. Step 4: Fry squid in hot oil until light brown, 2 to. Step 5: Do not overcook, or squid will be tough. Step 6: Drain squid on a paper towel-lined plate. Step 7: Serve with lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: squid, olive oil, parsley, crushed tomatoes, red wine, garlic cloves, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Clean squid and cut into strips. Step 2: Heat oil in sauce pan and brown garlic. Step 3: Add squid, and saute about 10 minutes. Step 4: Add salt, pepper, and wine, and cook about 10 minutes more and add tomatoes and parsley. Step 5: Cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, serve over pasta.

Ingredient Names: squid, olive oil, white wine, lemon, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, flour, fat
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the squid, separate the tentacles, and cut the tubes into 1 / 2 inch pieces. Step 2: Mix together the olive oil, lemon juice, and white wine. Step 3: Put the cut squid into it and let it sit for two hours in refrigerator. Step 4: Drain the squid and tentacles in colander Pat all dry. Step 5: Toss all in flour with salt and pepper mixed in, shaking off excess In batches, drop all into hot fat for 30-45 seconds. Step 6: Drain all on paper towel. Step 7: Keep warm in oven while you cook the rest. Step 8: Serve with hot marinara or sauce of your choice.

Ingredient Names: calamari, onion, garlic, capers, roma tomato, kalamata olives, salt and pepper, red chili pepper flakes, olive oil, basil chiffonade, red wine, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil, onion, garlic, capers, olives, tomatoes, salt and pepper, and chili flakes, saut. Step 2: Once sauted, add calamari, and continue to saut until calamari begins to curl. Step 3: Now add the red wine, continue tossing calamari. Step 4: Add marinara sauce and basil and heat until calamari is cooked, which means tender, don't cook until it's chewy! Step 5: Add salt and pepper if need for extra taste Serve as an appetizer, or make a little extra sauce and toss with some pasta, make sure you have some fine red wine!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, serrano chile pepper, garlic, anchovy filet, red pepper flakes, kosher salt, dry white wine, clam juice, plum tomatoes, dried oregano, squid, parsley, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Drizzle olive oil into a saucepan. Step 2: Add onions, chile pepper, garlic, anchovy filet, red pepper flakes, and salt; place over medium-high heat. Step 3: Stir and cook until onions and garlic just start to turn golden, 3 or. Step 4: Stir in wine and simmer until wine is reduced by about half, 3 to. Step 5: Add clam juice, tomatoes, and oregano. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer gently for about 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Gently stir in calamari and simmer until tender, 35 to, remove from heat, stir in parsley. Step 8: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 9: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain. Step 10: Stir some sauce into the hot, drained pasta. Step 11: Serve in warm bowls topped with more marinara sauce and grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: squid, garlic cloves, parsley, celery, onions, breadcrumbs, virgin olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove tenticles and leave the body whole. Step 2: Saute the onion, celery and garlic in half the olive oil. Step 3: Chop the tentacles fine and saute them for a few minutes. Step 4: Add the parsley and bread crumbs, mixing well. Step 5: Taste and season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Stuff the squid, but not too much, and close the opening with a toothpick They will shrink during the cooking and if stuffed too full they'll split open. Step 7: Saute them in the bottom of a heavy pot in a little olive oil on all sides. Step 8: Pour your favorite marinara sauce over and cook for about 45 minutes, over very low heat, until tender You can make this ahead and reheat it - it gets even better.

Ingredient Names: squid, fresh lemon juice, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, salt, fresh ground black pepper, red onion, kalamata olive, cherry tomatoes, celery ribs, flat leaf parsley, fresh basil, feta
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse all the squid under running water and pat dry. Step 2: Cut the tentacle bunches in half, and cut the bodies into 1 / 4 to 1 / 3-inch wide rings. Step 3: Cut the wings from the bodies. Step 4: Fill a 5 or 6 quart pot full of water, add a couple teaspoons of salt, and bring it to a boil. Step 5: Prepare a bowl of ice water. Step 6: Cook all the prepared squid pieces in the boiling water until just opaque, a brief 40 to 60 seconds, then remove from pot and immediately plunge into the ice water to halt the cooking. Step 7: When squid has cooled, transfer to a colander, let drain, and pat dry, set aside. Step 8: In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, vinegar, oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. Step 9: Add in onion, stir, and let the dressing stand for 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Calamari in a Creamy White Wine Sauce
Ingredient Names: linguine pasta, olive oil, garlic, squid, white wine, cherry peppers, cornstarch, cream, basil, crushed red pepper flakes, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to; drain. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add garlic, cook and stir until golden brown. Step 5: Add squid; cook until it turns white. Step 6: Stir in white wine and cherry peppers; bring to a simmer and cook until wine is reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Stir cornstarch into cream in a small bowl, then add to simmering calamari mixture; season with basil, pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. Step 8: Stir until sauce is thickened. Step 9: Add linguine to sauce; toss until evenly coated. Step 10: Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: fresh mussels, baguette, olive oil, white wine, bay leaf, unsalted chicken stock, garlic cloves, tomatoes, capers in brine, black olives, sea salt, ground pepper, flat-leaf italian parsley, lemons, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 250f Pick all mussels, tap all the opened ones and discard those that do not close up after tapping. Step 2: Arrange bread slices on a cookie sheet, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, turn and drizzle on the other side with another 1 tablespoon of oil. Step 3: Place in the oven until lightly toasted, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from oven and let cool. Step 5: In a medium pot with a lid bring white wine, bay leaf and chicken broth to a boil and cook for about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add garlic slices and let cook for another minute. Step 7: Add all mussels at once to boiling pot, and follow with tomatoes, capers and olives. Step 8: Season with some freshly ground pepper. Step 9: Reduce heat to medium.

Ingredient Names: smoked salmon, sweet unsalted butter, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, lemon juice, pitted black olives, bread
Instructions: Step 1: Process all ingredients except olives and bread in a food processor. Step 2: Spread the mixture over the slices of bread, and garnish with a black olive slice or two in the center It also looks nice to put a thin slice of smoked salmon on top and then an olive piece.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, olive oil, dry white wine, water, bottled clam juice, bay leaf, onions, tomato paste, garlic cloves, fresh thyme, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, diced tomatoes, cannellini beans, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp, reserving shells. Step 2: Cover and chill shrimp. Step 3: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add reserved shrimp shells to pan Saut 3 minutes or until shells turn pink, stir in wine, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes or until liquid almost evaporates. Step 6: Stir in 2 cups water, clam juice, and bay leaf. Step 7: Simmer 12 minutes or until liquid is reduced by half.

Dish Name: Capellini Al Gamberetti Angel Hair Pasta With Shrimp
Ingredient Names: capellini, olive oil, large shrimp, garlic cloves, mushroom, diced tomato, artichoke, kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat a large skillet or saute pan over medium high heat and add the olive oil, shrimp and garlic. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently until the shrimp just turns opaque, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the mushrooms, tomatoes, and artichokes and keep cooking until the mushrooms are softened, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Toss with pasta and garnish with fresh parsley.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic cloves, dried red pepper flakes, salt, diced tomatoes, heavy cream, medium shrimp, fresh basil, capellini
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, melt 3 tablespoons of the butter over moderately low heat. Step 2: Add the onion, garlic, red pepper flakes and salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, until thick, about 45 minutes. Step 5: Stir occasionally during cooking During the last 10 minutes of cooking, put a large pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil, getting ready for the pasta. Step 6: Mash the tomatoes with a potato masher until all large pieces are broken up. Step 7: Add the heavy cream and bring the sauce to a boil over moderate heat. Step 8: Add the shrimp and basil and cook just until the shrimp are pink, about 4 minutes. Step 9: Add salt to the pot of boiling water, then add the pasta.

Dish Name: Celebrity Chef Celestino Drago's Lobster Spaghetti
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, lobsters, olive oil, garlic, shallot, white wine, brandy, tomato puree, extra virgin olive oil, italian parsley, salt, chili flakes, vegetable broth
Instructions: Step 1: Cut lobster in two, under running water and remove dark membrane from inside the head. Step 2: In a saut pan, add garlic, shallots, chili flakes, olive oil and lobster Saut for a few minutes. Step 3: Add white wine and brandy. Step 4: Let evaporate then add tomato, salt and vegetable broth. Step 5: Cover and cook for about 5 minutes. Step 6: In a pot with boiling salted water cook spaghetti al denté About 6 minutes. Step 7: Drain and add to sauce. Step 8: Let pasta cook into sauce for about 1-2 minutes.

Dish Name: Cheat's Easy Salmon Risotto Rice Cooker
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, arborio rice, dry white wine, lemon juice, chicken stock, parmesan cheese, shallot, capers, dill, balsamic vinegar, fresh salmon, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chuck garlic, onion, rice, white wine, lemon juice and chicken stock in the rice cooker. Step 2: Stir well Hit "cook" Meanwhile, cover salmon with balsamic and marinate About 3 / 4 of the way through the cooking, open the rice cooker and stir the mix. Step 3: Put the steamer rack on top of the rice and put the salmon in the steamer. Step 4: Once the rice cooker stops cooking, leave it on 'keep warm' Open it, take out the salmon, add the cheese, stir the rice and close the rice cooker again Flake the salmon into small chunks. Step 5: Cut the shallot into small slices.

Dish Name: Cheese Crostini With Anchovy Herb Butter
Ingredient Names: butter, anchovy fillets, fresh italian parsley, fresh thyme leave, garlic, lemon zest, crushed red pepper flakes, baguette, provolone cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Melt butter in heavy small skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add anchovies and stir until they dissolve, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in herbs, garlic, lemon zest, and red pepper. Step 5: Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet. Step 6: Brush with anchovy mixture. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 8: Bake until cheese melts and bread is golden, about 10 minutes. Step 9: Cut bread slices in halves and serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, angel hair pasta, diced tomato, garlic cloves, shallot, heavy cream, dry white wine, olive oil, fresh basil, parmesan cheese, parsley, milk, all-purpose flour, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pour enough olive oil in a large sauce pan to cover the bottom, turn to medium high heat This is the only pot you'll need for the sauce so it should be big. Step 2: Soak the shrimp in milk and combine the dry ingredients Coat the shrimp with the dry ingredients and let them fry in the olive oil, about 2 minutes per side until golden brown The flour that falls off the shrimp will add great flavor and consistency to the sauce. Step 3: Add more oil as necessary, between batches of shrimp Dab the shrimp with a paper towel, cover and set aside on range top to keep warm. Step 4: Add the garlic to the oil, stir for a few minutes, then turn the heat to medium low. Step 5: Now add the wine and bring it to a boil. Step 6: Then turn the heat to low and cover, let the wine reduce, about 10-15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: penne, yellowfin tuna olive oil, basil pesto, cheddar, cherry tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta. Meanwhile, tip the tuna and its oil into a large bowl with the pesto. Mash together with a wooden spoon. Stir in a third of the cheese and all of the tomatoes. Heat the grill to high. Step 2: When the pasta is cooked, drain and toss through the pesto mix. Tip into a shallow baking dish and scatter with the remaining cheese. Place the dish under the grill for 3-4 mins until just melted, then serve with a green salad and garlic bread.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic, chicken broth, red pepper flakes, cannellini beans, anchovy fillet, fresh oregano, lemon zest, salt, ground black pepper, kale
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic; cook and stir until bubbling and sizzling, about 20 seconds. Step 3: Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil. Step 4: Cook until liquid is reduced by half, 6 to. Step 5: Stir in a pinch of red pepper flakes. Step 6: Stir in cannellini beans and bring to a boil. Step 7: Cook until you can see the tops of the beans just below the surface of the liquid, 6 to. Step 8: Stir in anchovy fillet, oregano, and lemon zest; simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Add escarole and reduce the heat to low. Step 10: Cook and stir until escarole wilts, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Season with salt and pepper, then drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and add another pinch of red pepper flakes.

Dish Name: Chef John's Pasta con le Sarde
Ingredient Names: bucatini, extra-virgin olive oil, bread crumbs, saffron, white wine, yellow onion, fennel, salt, raisins, garlic, pine nuts, red pepper flakes, sardines
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add bread crumbs; cook and stir until crispy and toasted, 2 to. Step 3: Transfer bread crumbs to a bowl. Step 4: Grind saffron threads with a mortar and pestle; pour white wine into the mortar and stir to combine. Step 5: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Cook bucatini in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until almost fully cooked through but still firm to the bite, 10 to. Step 7: Drain, reserving the pasta water. Step 8: Heat remaining olive oil in large skillet over medium heat. Step 9: Add onion, fennel, and salt; cook and stir until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Add raisins, garlic, and anchovy; cook and stir until heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Pour wine mixture into the skillet and cook until almost evaporated, about 2 minutes. Step 12: Pour 1 ladleful reserved pasta water into the skillet and bring to a simmer. Step 13: Stir in pine nuts and red pepper flakes; simmer until flavors combine and sauce is reduced, about 15-20 minutes. Step 14: Stir bucatini and sardines into the skillet. Step 15: Increase the heat to high and cook, stirring frequently and adding more reserved pasta water as necessary, until sauce and pasta are heated through, about 8-10 minutes. Step 16: Remove from the heat. Step 17: Ladle into bowls and top with fennel fronds and toasted bread crumbs.

Ingredient Names: extra large shrimp, peeled and deveined, olive oil, red pepper flakes, salt, aleppo pepper flakes, yellow onion, garlic, dried oregano, white wine, crushed tomatoes, parsley, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine shrimp, olive oil, red pepper flakes, salt, and Aleppo pepper flakes in a bowl; toss to coat shrimp completely in oil and spices. Step 2: Heat a large skillet over high heat until very hot. Step 3: Cook shrimp in a single layer in the hot skillet until the bottoms are browned, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Turn shrimp and cook until browned on the other side, about more. Step 5: Transfer shrimp to a clean bowl. Step 6: Heat the same skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Cook and stir onion with a pinch of salt in the hot skillet until onions are slightly golden and translucent, 2 to. Step 8: Add garlic and oregano; cook and stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds. Step 9: Pour white wine into onions; bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food off of the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Step 10: Add crushed tomatoes and lower heat to medium-low. Step 11: Cook and stir until tomato mixture thickens and flavors blend, 10 to. Step 12: Return shrimp to the skillet along with any accumulated juices in the bowl. Step 13: Cook until shrimp are reheated, 2 to. Step 14: Stir parsley and basil into sauce; season with salt, red pepper flakes, and Aleppo pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, anchovy fillets, capers, garlic, dry white wine, dried oregano, red pepper flakes, plum tomatoes, salt, ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, tuna, parsley, spaghetti, extra-virgin olive oil, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Cook and stir anchovy and capers in hot oil until anchovy crumbles, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Pour white wine, oregano, and red pepper flakes into the skillet and increase heat to high; cook until mixture reduces and about liquid remain, 2 to. Step 5: Stir tomatoes into the skillet and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Season tomato mixture with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium and simmer until slightly reduced, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Stir tuna and parsley into tomato sauce, breaking up tuna with a wooden spoon while stirring. Step 9: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 11: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until almost cooked through and still slightly firm to the bite, 9 to. Step 12: Drain and transfer spaghetti back to the pot. Step 13: Pour tomato sauce over spaghetti into the pot; stir to combine, cover the pot with a lid, and let sit until spaghetti is cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. Step 14: Ladle spaghetti into bowls, drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil, and sprinkle Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese and parsley over the top.

Ingredient Names: canned chick-peas, salt, fresh ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, tuna in olive oil, red onions, red wine vinegar, fresh italian parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, gently toss together the chickpeas, the tuna, onion slices, the olive oil, vinegar, chopped parsley and lots of freshly ground black pepper. Step 2: Add more olive oil, vinegar, or salt and pepper as you like, serve chilled.

Dish Name: Chock Full Of Clam Sauce With Farfalle
Ingredient Names: farfalle pasta, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, baby clams, dry breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, salt, clams
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds Do not let it brown! Step 4: Stir in tomatoes with their juices, canned clams with their juices, breadcrumbs, parsley, salt, and fresh clams. Step 5: Cook for just 2 minutes to allow flavors to blend. Step 6: Stir in pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until the fresh clams open and mixture is hot, about 3-5 minutes. Step 7: Discard any clams that do not open.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, salt, whole canned tomatoes, vegetable oil, dry white wine, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, dried oregano, anchovy fillets, fresh basil, fresh italian parsley, pepperoncini peppers, pepperoncini juice, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp Reserve shrimp shells for. Step 2: Check the ingredients listing on the shrimp bag If shrimp have been treated with salt, go directly to Otherwise, toss shrimp with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and set aside until. Step 3: Pour tomatoes into a colander set over a large bowl Release the tomato juice from the tomatoes by piercing the tomatoes with the edge of a rubber spatula. Step 4: Stir briefly to release juice. Step 5: Transfer drained tomatoes to small bowl, until Reserve tomato juice for.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, fresh parsley, garlic, tomatoes, chicken broth, white wine, water, bay leaves, dried basil, dried thyme, dried oregano, cod, large shrimp, peeled and deveined, scallops, clams, mussels, crabmeat
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large stockpot over medium-low heat. Step 2: Add onions, parsley, and garlic. Step 3: Cook and stir until onions are softened, 3 to. Step 4: Add tomatoes to the pot (break them into chunks as you add them). Step 5: Stir in chicken broth, wine, water, bay leaves, basil, thyme, and oregano. Step 6: Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Stir in cod, shrimp, scallops, clams, mussels, and crabmeat. Step 8: Bring to boil; lower heat, cover, and simmer until clams open up, 5 to. Step 9: Ladle soup into bowls and serve.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, tilapia fillet, cod, eggplant, celery, onion, stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, garlic cloves, salt and pepper, oregano, basil, tarragon, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a stock pot and saut celery, onions, and garlic for about 3-4 minute. Step 2: Add stewed tomatoes and tomato sauce. Step 3: Add 1 cup water and allow to simmer and for celery to soften a bit more. Step 4: Add eggplant chunks and cook until slightly translucent May need more water. Step 5: Add shark or cod and stir gently If too thick, add more water at 1 / 2 cup increments. Step 6: Once simmering again add tilapia. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to taste along with a bit more of olive oil if it appears to be too 'dry' Add seasonings, oregano, and taste to check levels of salt and spices.

Ingredient Names: onions, green pepper, garlic, olive oil, tomatoes with basil, tomato paste, red wine, lemon, parsley, basil, oregano, salt, fresh ground black pepper, sea bass, lobsters
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onion, green pepper and garlic in olive oil in large pot. Step 2: Add the tomatos, tomato paste, wine, lemon, one half cup or the parsley and all the seasonings. Step 3: Bring to boil and simmer 20 minutes. Step 4: Add the fish, lobsters and shrimp and simmer, covered 15 minutes. Step 5: Add clams and mussels and simmer another 10 minutes more or until the clams and mussels open. Step 6: Sprinkle remaining parsley on top. Step 7: Serve in soup plates from the pot it was cooked in A nice touch is a piece of garlic bread in each soup plate as a blotter Have plenty more bread to pass.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic, canned baby clams, cayenne pepper, dried oregano, lemon juice, fresh parsley, linguine, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan over medium heat, heat olive oil. Step 2: Add chopped garlic and saute gently until just golden, about 1 to 2 minutes: do not brown. Step 3: Add clams including liquid, cayenne, oregano and lemon juice and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Add chopped parsley and continue to simmer for 1 minute longer. Step 5: Cook linguine according to package directions. Step 6: Drain and transfer cooked linguine to a large serving bowl. Step 7: Pour prepared sauce over pasta and toss to coat. Step 8: Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and toss lightly. Step 9: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, red chile, cherry tomatoes, white wine, clams, spaghetti, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a heavy-based saucepan. Step 2: Add in the garlic, chili and cherry tomatoes and fry, stirring now and then, for 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Pour in the white wine, then add in the clams, mixing together. Step 4: Cover and cook for 3-5 minutes until the clams have opened. Step 5: Place the drained spaghetti in a serving bowl and top with the clam mixture. Step 6: Sprinkle over the parsley and serve at once.

Ingredient Names: littleneck clams, diced tomato, green onion, fresh basil, garlic, olive oil, black pepper, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Wash clams thoroughly under cold running water and set aside. Step 2: Combine tomatoes, onions, basil, garlic, oil and pepper in large sauce pan. Step 3: Place clams on top of mixture and simmer on medium heat until clams open. Step 4: Add pasta and mix thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, plum tomatoes, fresh oregano, small clams, breadcrumbs, fresh lemon zest
Instructions: Step 1: Cook garlic in oil in a deep 4 to 6 quart heavy pot over moderately low heat, stirring, until garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 2: Stir in tomatoes and 1 tablespoon oregano and cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes break down, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Season with pepper. Step 4: Add clams, stirring well to coat, then cover pot tightly and increase heat to moderately high. Step 5: Cook, stirring once, until clams open, 5 to 7 minutes While clams are cooking, toss together bread crumbs, zest, and remaining tablespoon oregano. Step 6: Divide clams and pan juices among clam shells, then sprinkle with bread crumbs. Step 7: Serve immediately Serves 8 That's it!

Dish Name: Clams With Garlic And Almonds Tapas
Ingredient Names: littleneck clams, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, sliced almonds, dry white wine, lemons, scallions, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub and drain cockles and set aside. Step 2: In a 12-inch to 14-inch saute pan, heat oil until smoking. Step 3: Add garlic and almonds and saute until golden brown. Step 4: Add clams, wine and lemon juice and zest and bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover and cook until clams open, about 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Uncover, add scallions and parsley and serve.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, littleneck clams, dry white wine, tomato sauce, scallions, fresh basil leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large and wide heavy casserole or dutch oven, over a medium flame, heat 3 tablespoons of the olive oil. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook until golden brown, stirring for approximately 2 minutes. Step 3: Add crushed red pepper flakes, stir, than add the clams and wine. Step 4: Place a lid on the pot, turn flame to high, and cook shaking the pot occasionally for approximately 7 minutes or until clams begin to open. Step 5: Pour in tomato sauce, add scallions and basil. Step 6: Stir well and bring mixture to a boil. Step 7: Using a slotted spoon, transfer clams to a serving platter and discard any unopened shells. Step 8: Spoon sauce over the clams and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Cod Fish With Pine Nut Brown Butter
Ingredient Names: butter, lemon juice, pine nuts, cod fish fillets, greens, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat, till it is light golden in colour. Step 2: Add lemon juice and pine nuts and saute for 1 minute. Step 3: Add fish to pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side, or till it is cooked to your liking. Step 4: Serve fish on steamed greens with the brown pine nut butter as a sauce. Step 5: Serve with a lemon wedge.

Ingredient Names: onion, red wine, balsamic vinegar, sugar, salt, cod, heavy cream, egg white, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325. Step 2: In a pan over medium heat, combine onion, wine, vinegar, salt, pepper. Step 3: Simmer 15 minutes until reduced, remove from heat Spray 4 ramekins. Step 4: Put cod, cream, egg white, salt& pepper in a blender, process until smooth pour into ramekins until half full. Step 5: Place ramekins into a large baking dish, fill with water halfway up the sides bake for 20 minutes or until set. Step 6: Spoon some onion onto 4 plates Unmold flans on top of onions. Step 7: Garnish with more onions and fresh sprigs of herbs.

Ingredient Names: bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, cornmeal, olive oil, italian seasoning, garlic powder, ground black pepper, egg white, cod fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Step 2: In a small shallow bowl, stir together the bread crumbs, cheese, cornmeal, oil, italian seasoning, garlic powder and pepper; set aside. Step 3: Coat the rack of a broiling pan with cooking spray. Step 4: Place the cod on the rack, folding under any thin edges of the filets. Step 5: Brush with the egg white, then spoon the crumb mixture evenly on top. Step 6: Bake in a preheated oven for 10 to or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork and is opaque all the way through.

Dish Name: Conchiglie Puttanesca Based On Sopranos Family Cookbook
Ingredient Names: water, salt, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, fresh oregano, fresh basil, fresh thyme, conchiglie, black olives, capers, anchovy fillets, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 6 quarts of water to boiling. Step 2: Add salt to water, if desired In the meantime, in a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add garlic and saute until golden, being very careful not to overcook it. Step 4: Add tomatoes, oregano, basil, thyme, and salt. Step 5: Simmer for 15 minutes or until sauce thickens somewhat. Step 6: Once water is boiling, add conchiglie and cook until "al dente" or according to package directions, draining well. Step 7: Add olives, capers, and anchovies to sauce. Step 8: Simmer for 2 minutes. Step 9: Remove from heat and stir in red pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: tuna in vegetable oil, extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, fresh ground pepper, salt, tomatoes, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, cucumber, red onion, garlic clove, fresh basil, fresh flat-leaf parsley, romaine lettuce leaves, hard-cooked eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Turn tuna out onto saucer without flaking. Step 2: Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon each oil and lemon juice and season lightly with 1 / 4 teaspoon each of the salt and pepper. Step 3: Let stand at room temperature to marinate Just before serving, combine tomato, bell peppers, cucumber, onion, garlic, and herbs in mixing bowl. Step 4: Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon each oil and lemon juice and season with remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Step 5: Toss gently to combine. Step 6: Add tuna and toss once. Step 7: Make a bed of romaine leaves on serving platter and spoon salad on center. Step 8: Arrange eggs around edge and sprinkle with olives and cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, yellow onions, roux, milk, heavy cream, shrimp stock, old bay seasoning, white wine, garlic cloves, olive oil, mushroom, linguine, fresh parsley, shrimp, crawfish
Instructions: Step 1: Portofino sauce: Start by getting your ingredients ready Dice the onion. Step 2: Make the roux The amount of oil is about equal to the amount of roux required by the recipe For instance, the original recipe calls for 2 oz of roux So 4 tbsp oil and 4 tbsp white flour, set aside. Step 3: Melt butter on medium heat. Step 4: Add diced onion and garlic, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mussels, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, white wine, fish stock, anisette, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium heat add olive oil and onions, cook until tender. Step 2: Stir in garlic and cook stirring until golden. Step 3: Stir in mussels, wine and broth and let simmer for 2-5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes and anisette and let simmer for 5 minutes or so. Step 5: Pour into bowls to serve.

Dish Name: Cozze Umbro Mussels In Italian Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, fresh garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh mussels, dry white wine, chicken stock, tomato sauce, lemon, salt, pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan, heat the oil and toss in the pepper flakes and the garlic. Step 2: Add in the mussels and toss over a medium heat for one minute. Step 3: Pour in the wine and simmer until it is reduced by half. Step 4: Pour in the stock, lemon juice, tomato sauce. Step 5: Add the salt and pepper at this time also. Step 6: Cook for another two to three minutes until all the mussels have opened. Step 7: Discard any that do not open. Step 8: Pour into a warm serving bowl and garnish with the fresh parsley.

Ingredient Names: pasta, butter, garlic, all-purpose flour, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, cream cheese, grated parmesan cheese, crabmeat
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain. Step 3: Keep warm and covered. Step 4: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 5: Add the minced garlic and cook until garlic releases its aroma, about 5 minutes, being careful not to let the garlic brown. Step 6: Stir in the flour, salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper. Step 7: Reduce heat, and cook, stirring constantly for about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Add the half-and-half and stir over medium heat until slightly thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Add the cream cheese and Parmesan cheese to the sauce and stir until cheeses melt and mixture is smooth. Step 10: Mix in the crabmeat and continue cooking until crabmeat is heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 11: Divide the fettucine between 2 plates or bowls and top with the crab sauce.

Dish Name: Crab And Or Prawn Calzones With Ranch Dip Rsc
Ingredient Names: pizza dough, all-purpose flour, crabmeat, spinach, mushrooms, black olives, garlic cloves, lemon juice, italian cheese, hidden valley original ranch dips mix, marinara sauce, greek yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ranch dip with the greek yogurt and refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 2: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 3: Roll out the pizza dough until it is a rectangle approximately 10 inches by sixteen inches. Step 4: Place on a sheet of parchment paper on a cookie sheet On one half of the dough rub with garlic then sprinkle with the flour, leaving 3 / 4 inch edges clean of this and all further ingredients. Step 5: Layer with the spinach leaves, mushrooms, olives, crab, and lemon juice. Step 6: Top with grated cheese. Step 7: Fold the other half of the dough over the layers, stretching gently Pinch the edges closed. Step 8: Transfer to hot oven and bake 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pasta shells, whole milk ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, egg yolk, fresh basil leaves, crabmeat, salt, fresh ground black pepper, bechamel sauce, unsalted butter, all-purpose flour, whole milk, fresh ground white pepper, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8-10 minutes, drain pasta. Step 3: In a large bowl, mix together ricotta, 3 / 4 cup parmesan, egg yolk, basil or parsley, crab, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 5: Fill the cannelloni with the crab mixture and place in buttered baking dish. Step 6: Make the bechamel sauce: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Step 7: Add the flour and whisk until smooth, about 2 minutes Gradually add the warm milk, whisking constantlyuntil the sauce is thick, smooth and creamy, about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, all-purpose flour, milk, salt, nutmeg, white crab meat, chard leaves, cottage cheese, black pepper, cannelloni tubes, tomato sauce, dried parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Start preparing the bechamel sauce by melting butter in medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Step 2: Whisk in flour and cook 3 minutes. Step 3: Whisk in milk and bring to boil, stirring. Step 4: Add salt and nutmeg. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer until the same consistency as thickened cream. Step 6: Refrigerate the sauce for 30 minutes or more. Step 7: Combine all filling ingredients in a bowl and mix well with 1 / 2 cup of the bechamel sauce. Step 8: Fill cannelloni tubes with the mixture. Step 9: Spread pasta sauce evenly over the bottom of a small baking dish. Step 10: Place the cannelloni tubes over the top in the dish.

Ingredient Names: no-boil lasagna noodles, onion, butter, cornstarch, lump crabmeat, dried basil, old bay seasoning, garlic clove, half-and-half, frozen chopped spinach, part-skim ricotta cheese, egg, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, cook onion and in butter until tender. Step 2: Add garlic and saut to release flavor. Step 3: Stir in cornstarch, old bay, and basil. Step 4: Add cream all at once. Step 5: Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly In medium bowl, stir in together, ricotta / sour cream and egg. Step 6: Add half of mozzarella and half of parmesan, mix well. Step 7: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 8: Arrange lasagna pieces in bottom of a greased 12x7 rectangular baking dish.

Ingredient Names: lump crabmeat, saltine crackers, portabella mushrooms, egg, unsalted butter, all-purpose flour, milk, cream sherry, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, garlic powder, parsley flakes, old bay seasoning, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place crabmeat into large mixing bowl. Step 2: Add, egg, butter, flour, milk, cream sherry, salt, pepper, garlic powder, mayonnaise, baking powder, cracker crumbs, worcestershire sauce, old bay seasoning and parsley flakes. Step 3: Mix well with large spoon Form the mixture between the palms of your hands into 2 large balls, gently squeezing out excess juice, then somewhat or lightly flattening and forming the balls into the cakes. Step 4: Place crab cakes on top of each portabello mushroom in a baking dish or baking pan Slightly flatten the crab cakes so that they spread out to cover the mushrooms. Step 5: Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Step 6: Preheat oven to 380 degrees. Step 7: Bake for 15 minutes. Step 8: Then place under the broiler for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, chicken broth, chardonnay wine, tomato paste, marjoram leaves, dried basil, oregano leaves, thyme leaves, white pepper, red pepper flakes, cayenne, dungeness crabs, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in 6-quart pan over medium high heat, when oil ripples and is fragrant, add onion and garlic. Step 2: Saute until translucent. Step 3: Add spices, stir one minute till fragrant. Step 4: Add broth, wine and tomato paste, bring to a boil, stirring often. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer 25 to 30 minutes to blend flavors, adjust seasonings Soup may be made ahead to this point Break crabs apart and clean, cut body in fourths and crack legs. Step 6: Add to hot soup and simmer until hot.

Dish Name: Crab Linguine With Broccoli And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, crab delights imitation crab, fresh broccoli, tomatoes, dry linguine, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles according to package directions If using fresh broccoli, steam until tender-crisp If using frozen broccoli, defrost. Step 2: Chop tomatoes While noodles are cooking, heat oil in medium nonstick pan, add garlic- saute until light brown and crispy. Step 3: Add crab and broccoli, saute 2 min. Step 4: Add tomatoes, cook until just heated through. Step 5: Toss with cooked noodles. Step 6: Season with salt, pepper and parmesan cheese if desired.

Dish Name: Crab Shrimp Ravioli With Saffron Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, egg yolks, sea salt, olive oil, water, flour, ricotta cheese, lump crabmeat, shrimp, butter, garlic cloves, fresh parmesan cheese, salt & pepper, thyme, saffron
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare ricotta cheese. Step 2: Refrigerate 2 On a clean surface, make a mound with flour and create a well in the middle for the eggs 3. Step 3: Pour egg yolks into the well of flour, along with olive oil, salt and water 4 Gradually beat flour towards the middle until all flour is incorporated into eggs. Step 4: Add up to 3 additional tablespoons of water if too dry.

Ingredient Names: linguine, extra-virgin olive oil, red chile, garlic, crab picked, lemons, flat-leaf parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and add the linguine. Give it a good stir and boil for 1 min less than the pack says. Stir well occasionally so it doesn’t stick. Step 2: While the pasta cooks, gently heat 3 tbsp of olive oil with the chilli and garlic in a pan large enough to hold all the pasta comfortably. Cook the chilli and garlic very gently until they start to sizzle, then turn up the heat and add the white wine. Simmer everything until the wine and olive oil come together. Then take off the heat and add the brown crabmeat, using a wooden spatula or spoon to mash it into the olive oil to make a thick sauce. Step 3: When the pasta has had its cooking time, taste a strand – it should have a very slight bite. When it’s ready, turn off the heat. Place the sauce on a very low heat and use a pair of kitchen tongs to lift the pasta from the water into the sauce. Step 4: Off the heat, add the white crabmeat and parsley to the pasta with a sprinkling of sea salt. Stir everything together really well, adding a drop of pasta water if it’s starting to get claggy. Taste for seasoning and, if it needs a slight lift, add a small squeeze of lemon. Serve immediately twirled into pasta bowls and drizzled with the remaining oil.

Ingredient Names: louis kemp crab delights imitation crab, angel hair pasta, butter, garlic, oregano, tomatoes, mushrooms, light cream, green onions, swiss cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook Pasta according to pkg. Step 2: Instructions; drain well. Step 3: While pasta is cooking, cook garlic, mushrooms and Oregano in butter in a saucepan for about 1 1/2 minutes, stiring frequently. Step 4: Add tomato and continue cooking till tomato is cooked-- about three minutes. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Step 6: Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently until cheese is melted and sauce is hot. Step 7: Pour sauce over hot cooked Angel Hair. Step 8: Make sure to pass extra Parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Crabby Veggie Bake It Like Lasagna
Ingredient Names: frozen crab, fresh carrot, roma tomatoes, asparagus spears, fresh broccoli, fresh zucchini, cremini mushrooms, garlic cloves, ricotta cheese, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, fresh italian parsley, fresh tarragon, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Scrape carrot, shred and set aside Skin and slice tomatoes To skin tomatoes, drop individually, into very hot water for a few seconds Skin should slip off easily, by hand. Step 2: Remove core and discard. Step 3: Slice tomatoes thinly, and set aside. Step 4: In a small saucepan, boil about one cup of water. Step 5: Remove stems from broccholi and drop the florettes into the boiling water. Step 6: Cook for about 2 minutes, until the water returns to boil. Step 7: Remove florettes and dunk in ice water immediately to stop the cooking.

Dish Name: Crabmeat Frittata With Tomatoes And Herbs
Ingredient Names: eggs, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic, shallots, olive oil, tomatoes, basil, fresh thyme leaves, fresh lump crabmeat
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, whisk the eggs until frothy and season with half the salt and pepper. Step 2: In a nonstick 10-inch skillet, cook the garlic and shallots in the olive oil for 1 minute over moderate heat. Step 3: Add the tomatoes, basil, and thyme, raise the heat, and continue cooking until most of the water from the tomatoes has evaporated. Step 4: Stir in the crabmeat, season with the remaining salt and pepper, and cook 1 minute to heat through. Step 5: Stir the eggs into the skillet Over high heat, continue stirring with a wooden spoon while simultaneously shaking the pan back and forth over the flame The eggs will begin to form small curds Continue stirring and shaking until the eggs are set but still somewhat soft on top Loosen the frittata from the skillet with a rubber spatula and slide it onto a large dinner plate. Step 6: Cover the frittata with another dinner plate and invert the plates.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, fresh parsley, dried thyme, crabmeat, dry white wine, clam juice, plum tomatoes, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a saute pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and the parsley. Step 3: After 1 minute add the garlic, dried thyme and the crab meat. Step 4: Cook for one minute more. Step 5: Pour in the wine and clam juice. Step 6: Raise the heat to high, to cook off the wine. Step 7: Add the canned plum tomatoes. Step 8: Cook the tomato sauce for 25-30 minutes, to reduce. Step 9: Stir occasionally to help the crab disintergrate.

Dish Name: Cream Of Spinach N Shrimp Over Pasta
Ingredient Names: shrimp, frozen spinach, soup mix, linguine, milk, water, butter, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Substitute for shrimp or combine any or all for a great seafood dish. Step 2: Combine with a salad and loaf of bread. Step 3: Boil pasta Defrost but do not drain spinach In saucepan, combine milk, water, butter, spinach & knorr cream of spinach to a boil then reduce heat to low to keep warm. Step 4: Add parmesan cheese and stir Salt, pepper & tabasco to taste. Step 5: When pasta is ready, add fully cooked seafood to sauce, then serve over pasta.

Ingredient Names: no-boil lasagna noodles, olive oil, onion, bulb of garlic, chipotle chile in adobo, white wine, dried oregano, tomatoes, raw shrimp, butter, flour, heavy cream, nutmeg, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Heat oil in a large pan, add onions and cook for 5 minutes, add garlic and chipotles cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add wine to onions and deglaze pan, reduce to till almost no liquid remains. Step 4: Add oregano and tomatoes cook for 5 minutes then add shrimp and just toss to coat ingredients. Step 5: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 6: Meanwhile melt butter in a microwave oven add flour and mix till smooth. Step 7: Add the cream and microwave for 4 -5 minutes, whisking every minute till thick. Step 8: Add nutmeg to cream sauce. Step 9: Mix in parmesan and set aside. Step 10: Mix together ricotta, mozzarella, egg and parsley, and black pepper set aside.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, frozen cooked shrimp, ground cayenne pepper, milk, parmesan cheese, butter, pepper, salt, lime juice, sugar, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a medium-hot skillet and add garlic. Step 2: Let that cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Now add the shrimp and sprinkle with the cayenne pepper. Step 4: Cook, moving them in the pan for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the sugar to the lime juice and mix, set aside. Step 6: Add the milk, cheese, butter and lime juice blend and stir constantly for about 5 minutes more, making sure cheese and butter are melted and sauce is well blended. Step 7: Taste for seasonings. Step 8: Serve over linguine and sprinkle with some black pepper and garnish with scallions.

Ingredient Names: linguine pasta, butter, heavy cream, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese, shrimp, peeled and deveined
Instructions: Step 1: Gather ingredients together. Step 2: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 3: Stir in linguine and return to a boil. Step 4: Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 to; drain. Step 5: Meanwhile, melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Stir in cream and season with pepper; cook, stirring constantly, for 6 to. Step 7: Stir Parmesan cheese into cream sauce until thoroughly mixed. Step 8: Stir in pesto and cook until thickened, 3 to. Step 9: Stir in shrimp and cook until they turn pink, about 3-4 minutes. Step 10: Serve sauce over hot linguine, serve hot and.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, flour, milk, pepper, linguine, parmesan cheese, pesto sauce, large shrimp, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water for the pasta. Step 2: Melt the butter and olive oil in a non-stick frying pan. Step 3: Stir in the flour until smooth and then add the milk, stirring constantly. Step 4: Season with pepper. Step 5: Add the linguine to the boiling water and cook for 10 minutes or to your own taste. Step 6: Stir the parmesan cheese into the cream sauce. Step 7: Blend in the pesto and cook for a few minutes on low until thickened Thin the sauce with more milk if it gets too thick. Step 8: Stir in the shrimp and red pepper flakes to heat the shrimp through. Step 9: Serve over hot linguine.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, butter, fresh spinach, shallot, heavy cream, breadcrumbs, mozzarella cheese, kosher salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a hot saute pan, add butter and as it begins to smoke, add salmon, spinach and shallots and cook on medium to low heat for 3 minutes. Step 2: Flip salmon over and add heavy cream. Step 3: Cover and reduce cream by half. Step 4: In a small bowl, mix bread crumbs with mozzarella. Step 5: When cream is reduced by half, after 8-10 minutes, salt and pepper salmon to taste. Step 6: Remove salmon from pan and top with spinach, then with the crumb-cheese mixture. Step 7: Put fish on broiler pan and reserve cream sauce. Step 8: Place under boiler until the cheese is melted Finish with the remaining cream sauce and serve.

Dish Name: Creamy Seafood With Angel Hair Pasta
Ingredient Names: seafood, angel hair pasta, fresh mushrooms, green onion, dry white wine, garlic, reduced-calorie stick margarine, flour, skim milk, nonfat sour cream, parmesan cheese, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat, drain well. Step 2: Set aside and keep warm. Step 3: Combine mushrooms, green onions, white wine and garlic in a large nonstick skillet, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered until liquid evaporates. Step 5: Add margarine, stirring to melt. Step 6: Add flour and cook stirring constantly for 1 minute Gradually stir in milk. Step 7: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and begins to boil.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, shrimp, cauliflower rice, shallots, garlic, chicken broth, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, nutmeg, parsley, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a small heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoon butter and let melt. Add shrimp and season with salt and pepper. Stir occasionally with a wooden spoon and cook until just cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Transfer cooked shrimp to a plate, cover with aluminum foil and set aside. Step 2: Add 3 tablespoons of butter of the pot and let melt. Add shallot and garlic and season with salt and pepper. Let cook until translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the cauliflower rice and cook 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add 1 cup of the chicken broth and simmer on medium high until the moisture has been absorbed by the cauliflower. Add 1/2 cup of broth and let absorb. Repeat without remaining 1/2 cup broth. Step 4: Lower heat to medium and add the cream cheese, parmesan and a pinch of freshly grated nutmeg. Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the cooked shrimp and parsley. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes until heated through. Step 6: Garnish with more parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: tuna, fettuccine, butter, olive oil, garlic, fresh mushrooms, sour cream, milk, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Drain and flake tuna. Step 2: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 3: Heat butter and oil, add garlic and mushrooms Saut until mushrooms are browned. Step 4: Blend in sour cream, milk, and cheese. Step 5: Fold in tuna and heat through. Step 6: Place pasta on plate, spoon sauce over. Step 7: Sprinkle with parsley.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, arugula, creme fraiche, parmesan, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, then cook the linguine according to pack instructions. Reserve a little pasta cooking water, then tip in the prawns, just to heat through, before draining. Step 2: Return the prawns and pasta to the pan, then tip in the rest of the ingredients. toss everything together, adding a little of the cooking water if the pasta is dry. Serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: fusilli pasta, sugar snap peas, salmon steaks, juice lemon, reduced-fat creme fraiche, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta, adding the sugar snaps to the water 2 mins before cooking time is up. Cool under running water, then drain. You can steam the salmon over the pasta pan for about 7 mins if you have a steamer basket, or put onto a heatproof plate and microwave on High for 2-3 mins until the flesh flakes easily. Peel away any skin, break into large flakes, then allow to cool. Step 2: Mix the lemon zest, juice and crème fraîche together, then season to taste. If you need to, loosen with a few tbsp of water to make the consistency of double cream. Toss the pasta, peas and rocket into the dressing, flake in the salmon, then gently turn in the bowl a few times.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, mixed italian herbs, garlic granules, tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, sweetcorn, cream cheese, tuna, pasta, butter, breadcrumbs, bacon bits
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and fry the onion for 2-3 minutes until soft. Step 2: Add the italian herbs and garlic granules and fry for a further minute. Step 3: Add the tomato paste, tomatoes and sweetcorn and cook gently for 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the cream cheese, tuna and pasta, heat through. Step 5: Transfer to a serving dish. Step 6: Heat the butter in a frying pan and fry the breadcrumbs and bacon bits until crispy. Step 7: Sprinkle over the tuna mixture.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillet, plain breadcrumbs, garlic, fresh italian parsley, onions, cayenne pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine breadcrumbs, garlic, parsley, minced onion, cayenne pepper, and a little olive oil. Step 3: Drizzle a little olive oil in a shallow, metal baking dish and place the salmon fillet on top. Step 4: Sprinkle breadcrumb mix over the salmon You do not have to use all of it Any extra mix should keep in the refrigerator for a few weeks. Step 5: Bake for about 15 minutes depending on thickness of the fish Salmon should break apart easily when fully cooked.

Ingredient Names: linguine, chicken broth, clam, medium shrimp, crabmeat, lobster, sliced mushrooms, butter, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta until al dente In the meantime, simmer rest of ingredients 5 minutes. Step 2: Add fish mixture to drained pasta and simmer additional 3 minutes. Step 3: Sprinkle liberally with parmesan.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, onion, roma tomatoes, lemon, black pepper, dry tarragon, oregano, parmesan cheese, red wine, large shrimp, pasta, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic slices stirring constantly, until golden brown. Step 3: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 4: Add chopped onion and stir until clarified. Step 5: Add chopped tomatoes with their juice. Step 6: Return garlic to mixture. Step 7: Squeeze lemon juice by hand into mixture. Step 8: Bring to a slow simmer and mix well. Step 9: Add tarragon, oregano and parmesan cheese Grind pepper from mill, to taste.

Dish Name: Eagles Grilled Shrimp Wrapped In Patriots Prosciutto
Ingredient Names: shrimp, prosciutto, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, lemon, parsley, salt and pepper, mesclun
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat grill or stove-top grill pan. Step 2: Place all ingredients for dressing in large bowl and whisk to combine Reserve small amount in separate bowl as final garnish. Step 3: Set both aside Lay out prosciutto on work surface and cut each in half crosswise. Step 4: Place a shrimp at one end of each slice and wrap with the prosciutto. Step 5: Place on grill and cook about 3-4 minutes per side until done. Step 6: Toss shrimp in dressing to coat well To serve, arrange the colorful greens in the center of a large platter and surround with the shrimp. Step 7: Drizzle the reserved dressing over shrimp and greens.

Ingredient Names: linguine, butter, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, shallot, flour, oregano, parsley, canned clams, white wine, heavy cream, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: 20oz canned clams is equal to 2-10oz cans of chopped clams with juice. Step 2: Cook linguine as instructed, drain. Step 3: Meanwhile melt butter in skillet. Step 4: Add garlic, shallot and red pepper flakes Sautee for 4 minutes until vegetables are cooked. Step 5: Add flour, oregano and parsley to mixture and stir until incorporated. Step 6: Keep stirring for at least 1 minute. Step 7: Add clams with juice and wine. Step 8: Stir constantly for 8minutes or until thickened.

Ingredient Names: linguine, tuna fish, red onion, olive oil, spaghetti sauce, garlic cloves, parmigiano
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta as directed on the box but don't drain until the sauce is done and your ready to serve! Step 2: Drain the water from the two cans of tuna and set aside Warm a large skillet over med-low with olive oil. Step 3: Once the oil is hot add your chopped garlic and onions and saute. Step 4: Add both cans of tuna to the skillet, and allow to brown stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon or similar tool. Step 5: Add your spaghetti sauce to the skillet and fold the onions and tuna into the sauce so that it is evenly coated. Step 6: Once the sauce begins to bubble turn your flame down to low and cover, let simmer for 2min. Step 7: Drain pasta and return to pot, add the sauce from the skillet and the parmigiana cheese Bon apetite!

Ingredient Names: fettuccine, medium shrimp, butter, fresh parsley, garlic cloves, lemon juice, chicken broth, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute shrimp in butter for 4 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Step 3: Add the parsley, garlic, lemon juice, broth, salt and pepper. Step 4: Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until garlic is tender, drain fettuccine. Step 5: Top with shrimp mixture.

Ingredient Names: linguine, butter, extra-virgin olive oil, shallot, milk, smoked salmon, reduced-fat cream cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Cook linguine in boiling water until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain, reserving pasta water. Step 3: Melt butter with olive oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat; when mixture begins to bubble, add shallots and cook until softened. Step 4: Stir milk, salmon, and cream cheese into shallots. Step 5: Mix in reserved pasta water until incorporated. Step 6: Transfer salmon mixture to a large serving bowl. Step 7: Add linguine; toss until evenly combined.

Dish Name: Easy Tilapia with Wine and Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, salt and pepper, butter, garlic, fresh basil leaves, large tomato, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a grill for medium-high heat. Step 2: Place the tilapia fillets side by side on a large piece of aluminum foil. Step 3: Season each one with salt and pepper. Step 4: Place one tablespoon of butter on top of each piece of fish, and sprinkle garlic, basil and tomato. Step 5: Pour the wine over everything. Step 6: Fold foil up around fish, and seal into a packet. Step 7: Place packet on a cookie sheet for ease in transportation to and from the grill. Step 8: Place foil packet on the preheated grill, and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Step 9: Open the packet carefully so as not to get burned from the steam, and serve.

Dish Name: Easy White Clam Sauce With A Kick
Ingredient Names: minced clams, garlic cloves, onion, extra virgin olive oil, whipping cream, hot pepper flakes, dried parsley flakes, pasta, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet, add onions and chile pepper flakes, and sweat until onion is soft. Step 2: Add garlic and parsley and saute for another minute or two, until garlic aroma is apparent. Step 3: Add reserved clam juice, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Add whipping cream and simmer over low heat until hot, but do not let come to a boil. Step 5: Add drained clams and heat until warm Do not overcook at this point or your clams will get tough and rubbery - cook just until until well heated. Step 6: Serve over pasta and top with shredded parmesan Asiago works as well! Step 7: Enjoy with your crusty bread dipped in the juice!

Ingredient Names: fusilli pasta, peas, butter, flour, milk, dijon mustard, tuna, green onions, sweetcorn, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook, following pack instructions, until tender. Add the peas for the final 3 mins cooking time. Step 2: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a pan over a medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 2 mins. Add the milk, whisking constantly, then slowly bring to the boil, stirring often, until sauce thickens. Remove from the heat, add the mustard and season well. Step 3: Heat the grill to medium. Drain the pasta and peas, then return to the pan and stir in the tuna, spring onions, sweetcorn and sauce. Tip into a shallow baking dish, top with the cheddar and cook under the grill for 5 mins or until golden and bubbling.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, eggplant, red peppers, mozzarella cheese, onion, garlic, stewed tomatoes, basil, fresh oregano, balsamic vinegar, red wine vinegar, brown sugar, tomato paste, anchovy fillets, capers, salt, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large heavy skillet. Step 3: Saute eggplant until each piece becomes saturated with oil. Step 4: Use eggplant to line the bottom of a 3 quart casserole dish. Step 5: Saute the red peppers until tender, and layer over eggplant in casserole dish. Step 6: Top with mozzarella. Step 7: Heat remaining olive oil, and cook onions and garlic until lightly browned and caramelized. Step 8: Stir in stewed tomatoes, basil, and oregano and simmer. Step 9: Add balsamic vinegar, red wine vinegar, brown sugar, and tomato paste. Step 10: Simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 11: Add anchovy fillets, if using, and capers. Step 12: Season with salt and pepper. Step 13: Pour over the mozzarella cheese in the casserole dish. Step 14: Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top of sauce. Step 15: Bake in preheated oven for 20 to, or until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, diced tomatoes, black olives, chopped fresh parsley, dry white wine, fish fillets
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Saute onions and garlic in olive oil until softened. Step 3: Stir in tomatoes, olives, parsley, and wine. Step 4: Simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Place fillets in sauce. Step 6: Simmer for about 5 more minutes, or until fish turns white.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic, italian seasoning, white wine, lemon juice, basil, grated parmesan cheese, flounder fillets
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 2: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Step 3: Plunge tomatoes into the boiling water and immediately remove to a medium bowl of ice water; drain. Step 4: Remove and discard skins from tomatoes. Step 5: Chop tomatoes and set aside. Step 6: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; saute onion until tender, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Stir in tomatoes, garlic and Italian seasoning; cook until tomatoes are tender, 5 to. Step 8: Mix in olives, wine, capers, lemon juice, and 1/2 the basil. Step 9: Reduce heat, blend in Parmesan cheese, and cook until the mixture is reduced to a thick sauce, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Place flounder in a shallow baking dish. Step 11: Pour sauce over the fillets and top with remaining basil leaves. Step 12: Bake in the preheated oven, until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine, garlic, sweet onion, fresh oregano, olive oil, tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper, spinach, cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook until tender, about 8-10 minutes, drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine garlic, onion, and oregano in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until finely chopped. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add onion mixture; cook and stir until fragrant and almost golden. Step 6: Mix in tomatoes, basil, salt, and pepper. Step 7: Simmer for about while pasta is cooking, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Mix in spinach until wilted. Step 9: Just before pasta is done, stir in shrimp and cook until heated through. Step 10: Toss together shrimp mixture and pasta in a large serving bowl. Step 11: Mix in mozzarella cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, crushed red pepper, white wine, clam juice, marinara sauce, basil, salt, linguine, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, scallops, mussels, chopped fresh parsley, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour olive oil into a large pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook until fragrant, 30 to 40 seconds. Step 3: Pour in white wine and increase heat to medium-high. Step 4: Let wine reduce by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Add clam juice and reduce heat to medium-low. Step 6: Pour in marinara, basil, and salt. Step 7: Let simmer to let flavors marry, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 9: Cook linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Step 10: Drain and set aside. Step 11: Add shrimp, scallops, lobster, mussels, and clams to the sauce and cook until clams and mussels open, scallops are opaque, shrimp is pink, and lobster is red on the outside and opaque on the inside, 8 to. Step 12: Toss linguine in sauce until it's thick enough to coat the noodles (it will still be a relatively thin sauce), about 8-10 minutes. Step 13: Plate noodles and load up with seafood and sauce. Step 14: Garnish with parsley, and serve immediately with Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, olive oil, creole seasoning, butter, garlic, alfredo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Step 2: Brush the tilapia fillets with oil on both sides, season with Creole seasoning to taste, then place into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Step 3: Bake in the preheated oven until the flesh is no longer translucent, and the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Step 5: Stir in the garlic, and cook until the garlic has softened and the aroma has mellowed, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the Alfredo sauce and bring to a simmer. Step 7: Reduce the heat to low, and keep warm until the fish is ready. Step 8: Pour the sauce over the fish to serve. Step 9: Sprinkle with additional Creole seasoning if desired.

Ingredient Names: tagliatelle, garlic, lemon juice, parsley, arugula, extra-virgin olive oil, butter, raw shrimp, chili flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a large pan of salted boiling water following pack instructions until al dente. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the gremolata. In a food processor (or by hand), finely chop the garlic with the zest, parsley (include the stalks) and rocket. Season generously, add the oil and lemon juice, and mix to make a juicy paste. Set aside. Step 3: Melt the knob of butter with a small splash of oil in a frying pan, add the prawns and fry quickly on each side. Add the chilli flakes and cook for 1 min or so more until the prawns are cooked. Step 4: Drain the pasta and return to the pan. Add the gremolata and the chilli prawns, toss well to coat and check the seasoning. Divide.

Ingredient Names: oil, zucchini, red chile, passata onion garlic, seafood mix if, lasagne, parmesan, fresh breadcrumbs, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a griddle and brush a little oil on the courgettes. Cook in batches until lightly charred. Season and scatter on the chilli, then set aside.
