Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pour a little passata in a medium-sized ovenproof dish. Place half the seafood over it, then season and top with a third of the courgettes. Step 3: Top with 2 sheets of pasta, then more tomato sauce, seafood, courgettes, another layer of pasta, more tomato sauce and finish with the rest of the courgettes. Mix the Parmesan and breadcrumbs, then scatter on top and cook for 25-30 mins until golden. Steam or boil the green beans and serve with the lasagne.

Ingredient Names: salmon steaks, dried thyme, italian seasoning, rosemary, salt and pepper, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate. Step 2: Season one side of each steak with the Italian seasoning, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Lay the steaks with the seasoned-side down on the prepared grill. Step 4: Cook on grill until the flesh flakes, turning once, 7 to. Step 5: Sprinkle each steak with lime juice to serve.

Dish Name: Hot-smoked salmon with creamy pasta & pine nuts
Ingredient Names: trofie pasta, white wine, cream, parmesan, hot-smoked salmon skin chunks, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, bring the wine to the boil in a large frying pan, then simmer for 1 min. Reduce the heat, stir in the cream and season well. Step 2: When the pasta is cooked, drain briefly and tip into the frying pan with the sauce. Add the Parmesan and flaked salmon pieces, and mix gently together. Pile into bowls, sprinkle with pine nuts and serve with the watercress salad (recipe below) alongside.

Ingredient Names: pasta shells, salt, lump crabmeat, mayonnaise, buttermilk, green onions, lemons, onion powder, garlic powder, old bay seasoning, parsley, pepper, lettuce leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente, 10 to 12 minutes. Step 2: Rinse, drain and set aside. Step 3: Pick through crab discarding any pieces of shells. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the crab, mayonnaise, buttermilk, onions, lemon juice, onion powder, garlic powder Old bay, parsley and pepper to taste. Step 5: Add the pasta shells and mix again. Step 6: Cover and chill overnight. Step 7: Serve on lettuce leaves.

Ingredient Names: scallops, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, salt, ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, dry white wine, lemon, fresh parsley, fish stock, butter, olive oil, shallot, arborio rice, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: For the shellfish: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic; cook and stir until starting to sizzle, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in scallops and cook for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add shrimp and season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Step 5: Cook over high heat until shrimp are bright pink on the outside and the meat is opaque, 3 to. Step 6: Pour white wine into the skillet and let the alcohol evaporate. Step 7: Scrape the bottom of the skillet to deglaze; cook until the liquid is reduced, 2 to. Step 8: Remove from heat, add lemon juice, and sprinkle with 1/2 of the parsley, discard garlic. Step 9: Cover the skillet to keep shellfish warm. Step 10: To make the risotto: Pour fish stock into a saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer. Step 11: Melt butter in a skillet over low heat. Step 12: Add olive oil and shallot. Step 13: Cook until shallot is soft and translucent, but not brown, 3 to. Step 14: Increase heat and add rice; cook until rice has absorbed the oil and butter and has a nutty aroma, stirring often, about 1 to. Step 15: Make sure not to burn the shallot and reduce the heat if the skillet gets too hot. Step 16: Pour white wine into the skillet and stir until alcohol has evaporated. Step 17: Add 1 ladleful of fish stock, stir, and cook until rice has absorbed the stock. Step 18: Add another ladleful and repeat the process until rice is tender, 15 to in total. Step 19: Add shellfish with their juices to the risotto pan before the end of cooking; stir and cook until shellfish are warmed through, adding stock if needed, remove from heat. Step 20: Stir in remaining parsley and extra-virgin olive oil. Step 21: Let risotto stand briefly before serving.

Ingredient Names: flounder fillets, butter, salt and pepper, lemon juice, tomato, dried basil, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: Arrange flounder in a medium baking dish. Step 3: Dot with butter, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with lemon juice. Step 4: Top with tomato, basil, and garlic powder. Step 5: Cover, and bake in the preheated oven, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

Ingredient Names: tuna sunflower, pine nuts, lemons, parsley leaves, fresh breadcrumb, eggs, spaghetti, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Flake the tuna into a bowl, then tip in the pine nuts, lemon zest, parsley, breadcrumbs and egg. Season and mix together with your hands until completely combined. Roll the mix into 12 walnut-size balls. Put a large pan of salted water on to boil, then cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions. Step 2: Heat a little of the tuna oil in a large non-stick frying pan, then fry the tuna balls for 5 mins, turning every minute or so until completely golden. Drain on kitchen paper. Heat the tomato sauce, then toss together with the pasta and tuna balls.

Ingredient Names: waxy potato such as charlotte, sea bass fillets, cherry tomato, black italian olives, fish stock, dry white wine, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170/gas 5. Slice the potatoes and boil for 6-8 mins until just tender, then drain. Step 2: Butter or oil one large or two smaller shallow ovenproof dishes that will fit the fish fillets in one layer (a couple of roasting tins would work well). Scatter the potatoes over the base of the dishes, then halve the tomatoes and scatter on top, along with the olives. Set the fish fillets among the other ingredients then pour over the stock and wine, then season to taste. Step 3: Cover the dishes with foil and seal the edges. Bake for 15 mins until the fish is tender. Serve each portion on warm plates and scatter with basil.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, fresh broccoli, shallots, green olives, capers, tuna oil, juice lemon, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the spaghetti in salted water for 6 mins. Add the broccoli and boil for 4 mins more or until both are just tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix the shallots, olives, capers, tuna and lemon zest and juice in a roomy serving bowl. Drain the pasta and broccoli, add to the bowl and toss really well with the olive oil and lots of black pepper. Serve with a little extra olive oil drizzled over.

Ingredient Names: linguine, shrimp, peas, egg yolks, juice lemon, parmesan, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the linguine for 8 mins. Three minutes before the time is up, tip in the prawns and peas. Reserve a cup of cooking water, then drain the pasta and return to the pan. Step 2: Add the egg yolk, lemon zest and juice, most of the Parmesan and some soured cream, if you like. Stir everything together, adding a little of the pasta cooking water to loosen the mixture. Step 3: Serve sprinkled with Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp their shells, olive oil, red chile, fish stock, butter, onions, risotto rice, glass white wine, peas, juice lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the prawns, keeping the heads and shells. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large saucepan and fry the prawn shells and heads with the sliced chilli until they have toasted and changed colour. Pour in the stock and bring to the boil, then turn down to a simmer. Step 2: Bring the stock to the boil and keep on a low simmer. In a separate pan, melt half the butter over a medium heat. Stir in the onions and sweat gently for 8-10 mins until soft but not coloured, stirring occasionally. Stir the rice into the onions until completely coated in the butter, then stir continuously until the rice is shiny and the edges of the grain start to look transparent. Step 3: Pour in the wine and simmer until totally evaporated. Add the stock, a ladleful at a time, stirring with each addition until absorbed. Stir through the prawns and peas. Continue adding stock a ladleful at a time and stirring the rice over a low heat for 25-30 mins, until the rice is cooked al dente (with a slightly firm, starchy bite in the middle). The risotto should be creamy and slightly soupy. When you draw a wooden spoon through it, there should be a wake that holds for a few moments but not longer. Cook until the prawns change colour. Stir through the chopped chilli, lemon juice and remaining olive oil. Let the risotto rest for a few mins, then serve, topped with the lemon zest.

Ingredient Names: short pasta shapes, fresh broccoli, shrimp, creme fraiche, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions, scooping out a bit of the cooking water as it cooks. Three mins before the pasta is done, add the broccoli to the pan and cook for the 3 mins more. Drain, then tip back into the pan. Step 2: Reduce the heat to very low and gently stir through the prawns, crème fraîche, lemon juice and some seasoning. Add a splash of the reserved pasta water if it looks too thick, then serve when everything is really hot.

Ingredient Names: extra-virgin olive oil, flatleaf parsley, garlic, red chile, ginger, creamed tomatoes, tuna olive oil, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the sauce: Heat the oil in a medium pan. Toss in 2 tbsp of the parsley, the garlic, chilli and ginger and fry for a few minutes until slightly soft. Tip in the tomatoes and cook for another few minutes. Fold in the tuna and season the sauce generously. Leave the sauce to simmer for 10 minutes. Step 2: Boil the pasta: Meanwhile, cook the pasta for 8-10 minutes, or as directed on the pack. Drain, then return to the pan. Pour the tuna sauce into the pasta and toss well. Sprinkle over the remaining parsley, divide between four bowls and serve.

Ingredient Names: salmon, lemon juice, linguine, fresh broccoli, reduced-fat ricotta cheese, reduced-fat parmesan cheese, skim milk, garlic, fresh black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brush salmon fillets evenly with lemon juice, and bake for 10-20 mins (depending on thickness of fillets) at 400 F, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Step 2: Let cool slightly, and crumble fish into bite sized pieces. Step 3: Meanwhile, put ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, milk, garlic and pepper into a blender and blend until smooth. Step 4: Then pour into a saucepan over low heat until warmed (do not let boil.) If sauce seems too thick, add small amounts of milk until it reaches desired consistency. Step 5: Steam broccoli chopped into small pieces until just tender, and stir into cheese sauce. Step 6: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until el dente. Step 7: Toss pasta and cheese/broccoli mixture until well mixed. Step 8: Gently stir in salmon pieces, or if desired, sprinkle on top of individual plates before serving. Step 9: Serve Immediately.

Dish Name: Lobster Ravioli in Tomato Cream Sauce with Shrimp
Ingredient Names: shrimp, yellow onion, celery with leaves, lemon, dried basil, dried oregano, dried thyme, whole black peppercorns, parsley, water, unsalted butter, shallot, garlic, lemon zest, kosher salt, ground black pepper, white wine, diced tomatoes, heavy cream, salt, lobster ravioli
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp, reserving shells and heads. Step 2: Chop shrimp into bite-sized pieces. Step 3: To make shrimp stock, combine shrimp shells and heads, onion, and celery in a large pot. Step 4: Squeeze lemon juice into the pot, then add lemon halves as well. Step 5: Add dried basil, oregano, thyme, peppercorns, parsley, and water. Step 6: Cover the pot and bring it to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15-20 minutes, skimming away any foam or impurities that have risen to the surface. Step 8: Strain shrimp stock and set aside. Step 9: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 10: Cook shrimp pieces until pink and almost cooked through, 1 to. Step 11: Remove and set aside. Step 12: Add shallots to the pan; cook and stir until shallots have softened and turned translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Step 13: Stir in garlic, lemon zest, salt, and ground pepper. Step 14: Cook for thirty seconds, then add white wine. Step 15: Bring to a boil and cook until white wine is reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 16: Add shrimp stock to the pan, bring it to a boil, and simmer until sauce is reduced by half, about 15-20 minutes. Step 17: Meanwhile, fill a large pot with heavily salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Step 18: Once water is boiling, stir in ravioli, and return to a boil. Step 19: Cook uncovered, occasionally stirring, until ravioli float to the top and filling is hot, 3 to. Step 20: Drain well, reserving a little pasta-cooking water to thin sauce, if necessary. Step 21: Stir diced tomatoes and cream into shrimp sauce and heat through. Step 22: Return shrimp to the pan, taste sauce, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 23: Fold ravioli into sauce. Step 24: Place four ravioli onto each of the four warmed pasta bowls or plates and top with sauce. Step 25: Garnish pasta with chopped parsley and lemon zest.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, chicken broth, shallot, garlic, arborio rice, white wine, honey, butter, cream, paprika, cayenne pepper, sherry, lobster, parmesan cheese, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients, Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions; cook and stir until caramelized and very tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot; reduce heat to low and keep at a simmer. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in a large, flat-bottom pan over medium-high heat. Step 5: Cook and stir shallot and garlic in the hot oil until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add Arborio rice to shallot mixture; cook and stir until rice begins to brown, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Add wine and cook for 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Stir chicken broth into rice mixture; cook, stirring constantly, until broth is absorbed. Step 9: Repeat adding broth, at a time, until all the broth is used, stirring constantly until broth is absorbed each time, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Stir honey into onions; cook and stir, more. Step 11: Stir butter into rice mixture until melted. Step 12: Add cream and stir until rice mixture thickens, about 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Add paprika and cayenne pepper; stir well. Step 14: Add sherry and mix well. Step 15: Stir lobster meat into rice mixture and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Step 16: Mix Parmesan cheese into rice mixture until melted. Step 17: Add onion mixture and mix well; season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, extra-virgin olive oil, cherry tomatoes, garlic, dried basil, bread crumbs, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water. Step 2: Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 15-20 minutes, drain. Step 3: Cover with cold water and allow to sit until cool, draining and replacing the cold water as needed. Step 4: Peel and slice the potatoes thinly. Step 5: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 6: Grease a casserole dish with the olive oil. Step 7: Line the casserole dish with an even layer of potato slices; top with a layer of sardine fillets. Step 8: Scatter the diced tomatoes over the sardines. Step 9: Sprinkle the garlic, basil, and bread crumbs over the tomatoes. Step 10: Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 25-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mozzarella balls, tomatoes, basil leaves, farfalle pasta, olive oil, green olives, tuna, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil Add the pasta, stir once and cook for about 8-10 minutes or as directed on the packet. Step 2: Meanwhile, wash the tomatoes and cut into quarters, slice the olives, wash the basil. Step 3: Put the tomatoes into a salad bowl and tear the basil leaves over them. Step 4: Add a tablespoon of olive oil and mix. Step 5: When the pasta is ready, drain into a colander and run cold water over it to cool it quickly. Step 6: Toss the pasta into the salad bowl with the tomatoes and basil. Step 7: Add the sliced olives, drained mozzarella balls, and chunks of tuna. Step 8: Mix well and let the salad rest for at least half an hour to allow the flavours to mingle. Step 9: Sprinkle the pasta with a generous grind of black pepper and drizzle with the remaining olive oil just before serving.

Ingredient Names: new potato, fresh broccoli, skinless salmon fillets, olive oil, mint, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes in a large pan for 10-12 mins, adding the broccoli pieces for the final 4 mins until everything is tender. Drain well. Meanwhile, place the salmon fillets in a microwaveable dish, splash with a little water, then cover in cling film and microwave on High for 2½ mins until the fish flakes. Step 2: Heat the grill. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan. Cut the potatoes into chunky slices, then quickly cook in the pan over a high heat until golden on the edges. Flake the salmon into large chunks and poke amongst the potatoes with the broccoli. Stir the mint and some seasoning into the eggs, then pour into the pan. Leave for 6 mins over a low heat until the sides are set and just the centre is a little wobbly, then flash under the grill to set completely and brown. Serve in wedges with a big green salad on the side.

Dish Name: Old Bay Shrimp and Pasta Alfredo
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, shrimp, peeled and deveined, seafood seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, alfredo sauce, lemon juice, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over low heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add shrimp and sprinkle with seafood seasoning; toss until completely coated. Step 4: Stir in red pepper flakes and cook until shrimp are bright pink on the outside and the meat is opaque, 10 to. Step 5: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Cook angel hair pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 4 to, drain pasta. Step 7: Add pasta to the skillet and toss with shrimp and olive oil to combine. Step 8: Stir in Alfredo sauce and drizzle with lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: tuna steaks, garlic, thyme, red pepper flakes, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Let tuna rest at room temperature for 10 to. Step 2: Combine garlic, thyme, and red pepper flakes in a heavy skillet. Step 3: Pour olive oil into the skillet to reach a depth of. Step 4: Heat oil over medium heat until garlic and thyme begin to sizzle, 5 to. Step 5: Place tuna steaks gently in hot oil and reduce heat to low; cook, spooning oil over the top of tuna steaks constantly until white and hot, 5 to. Step 6: Remove from heat and transfer tuna steaks into a baking dish; pour hot oil and herbs on top. Step 7: Cool tuna and oil to room temperature. Step 8: Wrap the baking dish tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate tuna steaks for 1 hour; remove from oil and sprinkle sea salt on top.

Dish Name: Oven Baked Fish Fillets With Parmesan Cheese
Ingredient Names: fresh breadcrumbs, parsley, garlic, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, lemon rind, red snapper fillets, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together, EXCEPT fish and melted butter. Step 2: Rinse fish fillets and pat dry; Rub with butter and dip each side into bread crumb mixture. Step 3: Bake in 325 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes (uncovered) until fish flakes when pressed with a fork.

Dish Name: Pan-fried salmon with watercress, polenta croutons & capers
Ingredient Names: polenta either bought ready-made, flour, olive oil, boneless, watercress, capers brine, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the polenta into approximately 1.5cm cubes, toss in flour and fry in a little oil until slightly coloured. Keep warm. Step 2: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan and fry the salmon portions for 1 min on each side until lightly golden, then transfer to a non-stick baking tray and cook in the oven for 8-10 mins. Test the fish to see if it is cooked by pushing a cocktail stick into the top of it. If the fish offers resistance, then it is not fully cooked and will need further cooking. When cooked, remove from the oven and set to one side. Step 3: Dress the watercress with a little olive oil and a few drops of lemon juice. Scatter the polenta croutons and capers over each salmon fillet and serve with the watercress.

Dish Name: Pan-fried white fish with polenta & orange crust
Ingredient Names: flour, fine polenta, oranges, thyme leaves, sustainable white fish fillets, eggs, butter, olive oil, baby spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the flour, polenta, orange zest and thyme leaves together with some seasoning. Dip the fillets in the beaten egg then roll in the polenta mix to coat. The fish can now be chilled for a few hours before you're ready to cook. Step 2: Heat the butter and olive oil in a large frying pan until foaming, add the fillets and lower the heat. Cook for 3 mins on each side. Meanwhile, wilt the spinach in a large pan, drain off the excess water, season and divide between 4 plates. Serve with the fish fillet on top.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, garlic, sardines, bread crumbs, grated parmesan cheese, chopped fresh parsley, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add spaghetti and cook until al dente, 8 to. Step 3: Drain and rinse under cold water. Step 4: Toss with olive oil; cover and keep warm. Step 5: Place olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Stir in garlic; cook just until golden, 2 to. Step 7: Add sardines; cook more. Step 8: Stir in bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Step 9: Stir in remaining olive oil if necessary to give mixture a crumbly texture. Step 10: Stir in parsley and pepper and remove from heat. Step 11: Serve sardine mixture over spaghetti and garnish with additional Parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Pasta With Shrimp, Oysters, and Crabmeat
Ingredient Names: pasta, butter, olive oil, minced garlic, chopped fresh parsley, lemon juice, crushed red pepper, salt and pepper, shrimp, peeled and deveined, oysters, crabmeat
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter and olive oil together in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in the garlic, and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the parsley, and cook for more. Step 4: Season with lemon juice, crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper; set aside. Step 5: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 6: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain. Step 7: Meanwhile, bring a few cups of water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Step 8: Stir in the oysters and turn off the heat. Step 9: Allow the oysters to stand for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside. Step 10: Melt butter and olive oil together in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 11: Stir in the shrimp, and cook until they turn pink and begin to firm. Step 12: Add the crab meat and drained oysters; continue cooking until the shrimp have turned opaque in the center, and the crab is hot. Step 13: Toss the seafood with the drained pasta, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 14: Pour in the sauce, and toss gently to coat. Step 15: Sprinkle with remaining chopped parsley before serving.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine, olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, lemon, tomato sauce, sardines, grated parmesan cheese, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Cook fettuccine at a boil until almost tender, about 10 minutes. Step 3: While the pasta is cooking, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and cook until starting to soften, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Pour in sardines and tomato sauce, stir to combine, and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Reduce the heat to low and keep at a simmer. Step 8: Drain pasta, add to sauce, and stir to combine. Step 9: Cover, turn off the heat, and let stand for 10 minutes. Step 10: Squeeze lemon over top and divide onto four serving plates. Step 11: Garnish with Parmesan and red pepper flakes.

Dish Name: Pasta salad with tuna, capers & balsamic dressing
Ingredient Names: orecchiette pasta, msc approved tuna spring water, capers, peppadew peppers from, celery hearts, yellow, balsamic vinegar, extra-virgin olive oil, arugula leaves, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions, then drain and rinse in cold water. Step 2: After draining again, transfer to a large bowl. Step 3: Add the remaining ingredients except the basil, season well, and toss to combine. Step 4: Scatter with basil and serve.

Dish Name: Pasta with Spicy Shrimp and Sun-dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: olive oil, shrimp, shallots, sun-dried tomato oil, kalamata olives, garlic, lemons, dry red pepper, tomatoes, fresh basil, linguine, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add shrimp and sauté until pink, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Using slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to medium bowl. Step 4: Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to same pot. Step 5: Add shallots, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, garlic, lemon peel, and crushed red pepper. Step 6: Sauté until shallots are soft, about 4 minutes. Step 7: Add canned tomatoes and simmer until sauce thickens, about 3 minutes, mix in basil. Step 8: Return shrimp and any juices to sauce; stir to heat through, about 1 minute. Step 9: Meanwhile, cook pasta in pot of boiling salted water until tender, but still firm to bite, drain. Step 10: Add pasta to sauce. Step 11: Toss over medium heat until sauce coats pasta. Step 12: Season with salt and pepper. Step 13: Transfer to bowl; top with cheese.

Ingredient Names: butter, lemons, raw shrimp, tagliatelle, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter, then add the zest and infuse for about 15 mins. Add a little of the butter to a pan, then fry the prawns for 2-3 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the tagliatelle according to pack instructions. Drain, return to the pan, then add the butter, prawns and rocket. Toss together, season and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: pasta preferably wholemeal, peas, broad bean podded if you like, fresh broccoli, shrimp, lemon zest juice, light mascarpone, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta following pack instructions, adding the vegetables 4 mins before the end of the cooking time, and the prawns just as the cooking time is up. Reserve a mug of the water, then drain everything and tip back into the pan. Step 2: Tip in the lemon zest and juice, and the mascarpone, and heat through, adding enough of the pasta water to create a creamy sauce. Scatter in the shredded mint or basil, a good grinding of black pepper and a little salt. Divide between 2 warmed pasta bowls, scatter over the herb leaves and serve with lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: peas, garlic herb soft cheese, juice lemon, garlic, spaghetti, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz 300g of the peas with the soft cheese, lemon zest and juice, and the garlic. Add some seasoning, then set aside. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook pasta following pack instructions. Tip in the remaining peas 2 mins before the pasta is cooked, then drain everything and return to the pan. Stir through the pea pesto and some seasoning. Divide between 4 plates and serve with the prawns and extra lemon wedges, if you like.

Ingredient Names: linguine, peas, shrimp, juice lemon, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat a non-stick pan, then gently cook the peas, prawns, lemon zest and juice for 3-4 mins until prawns are hot and peas tender. Step 2: Season well, stir in the cream and 2 tbsp of the pasta water, then bubble for 1 min. Drain the linguine and return to the saucepan with the sauce, tossing well to coat. Serve in bowls.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, olive oil, red onion, garlic, white wine, diced tomatoes, shrimp, peeled and deveined, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook for 8 to or until al dente; drain. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Stir in onion and garlic, and cook until onion is tender. Step 5: Mix in wine and tomatoes, and continue cooking, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Mix shrimp into the skillet, and cook, or until opaque. Step 7: Toss with pasta and top with Parmesan cheese to serve.

Ingredient Names: ciabatta rolls, pepper, tomato puree, parsley, tuna, ball mozzarella
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to medium. Split the panini rolls in half and lightly toast on each side. Slice the peppers into strips and mix well with the tomato purée, parsley and some seasoning. Spread over the toasted bread. Step 2: Flake the tuna over the pepper mixture, then scatter with cheese. Grill for 3-5 mins until the cheese is golden and bubbling.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, butter, extra-virgin olive oil, onion, red bell pepper, portobello mushrooms, garlic, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, alfredo sauce, cream, cayenne pepper, salt, ground black pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to; drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, melt butter with olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion; cook and stir until softened and translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in bell pepper, mushrooms, and garlic; cook over medium-high heat until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add shrimp; cook until firm and pink. Step 7: Stir in Alfredo sauce, Romano cheese, and cream; bring to a simmer, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 8: Season with cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, stir in penne. Step 9: Sprinkle servings with parsley.

Ingredient Names: linguine, olive oil, onion, garlic, butter, all-purpose flour, milk, salt, pepper, cheese, basil, cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, mushrooms, roma plum tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Stir in linguine and return to a boil. Step 3: Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 to; drain. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Saut茅 onion until tender and translucent. Step 6: Stir in garlic and butter; saut茅 until garlic is soft and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Dissolve flour in milk; stir into onion mixture. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper; simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 9: Add cheese and stir until melted, stir in pesto. Step 10: Add shrimp, mushrooms, and tomatoes; cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through. Step 11: Add pasta and toss until evenly coated.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaves, white breadcrumb, pine nuts, parmesan cheese, garlic, crisp bacon bits, virgin olive oil, salt, pepper, salmon fillets, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: To make the crust: Combine all ingredients except the olive oil, salt and pepper in a food processor. Step 2: With the processor running, slowly pour in the oil and process until incorporated. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper if desired. Step 4: To prepare the salmon: Preheat the oven to 400 F. Step 5: Spread the pesto crust 1/8-inch thick on the salmon fillets. Step 6: In a dry nonstick ovenproof sauté pan or skillet over high heat, heat the olive oil and sear the salmon, crust-side down. Step 7: Turn the fillets over and place in the oven for 5 to 6 minutes, until cooked through.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, basil leaves, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, sugar snap peas, shrimp, peeled and deveined, crushed red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes; drain. Step 3: Blend basil, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and salt in a blender until smooth. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Cook and stir sugar snap peas in hot oil until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add shrimp and red pepper; continue to cook until the shrimp are bright pink on the outside and the meat is no longer transparent in the center, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir basil sauce into the shrimp mixture and remove from heat; spoon over spaghetti to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, tomato paste, balsamic vinegar, distilled white vinegar, honey, anchovy, green onions, garlic, rosemary, kosher salt, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper, boneless pork shoulder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (160 degrees C). Step 2: Brush a baking dish with olive oil. Step 3: Whisk tomato paste, vinegar, honey, mashed anchovy, green onions, garlic, rosemary, salt, red pepper flakes, and black pepper together in a large bowl to make the agrodolce. Step 4: Cut pork shoulder into roughly 3-inch pieces. Step 5: Add to the bowl of agrodolce and mix by hand until coated. Step 6: Transfer pork and sauce to the prepared baking dish. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven, flipping pieces over halfway through, until pork is very tender, 2 1/2 to. Step 8: Add a splash of water if pork appears too dry. Step 9: Skim off fat as desired.

Ingredient Names: linguine, butter, raw shrimp preferably tiger shrimp, garlic, white wine, lemon juice, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat a small knob of the butter in a frying pan. When it starts to sizzle, add the prawns and fry for 1 min until they start to change colour. Add the garlic and sizzle for 1 min more, splash in the wine, then bring to the boil. Swirl in the rest of the butter, season with salt and pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice, then stir in the chopped parsley. Step 2: When the pasta is just cooked, drain and toss through the prawns. Divide the pasta between 2 bowls, pour over any excess sauce and serve straightaway.

Ingredient Names: chunky white fish fillets, prosciutto, creme fraiche, basil pesto, parmesan, pine nuts, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Season the fish all over, then wrap each fillet in a slice of ham. Put into a large baking dish. Dot the crème fraîche between the fillets and over the exposed ends of the fish. Dot the pesto around the fish, too. Scatter with the cheese. Step 2: Bake the fish for 15-20 mins, adding the pine nuts halfway through, until the crème fraîche has made a sauce around the fish, and the cheese and ham are turning golden. Serve with plenty of crusty bread to mop up the sauce.

Dish Name: Rigatoni with spiced prawns, tomatoes & chorizo
Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, chorizo sausage, tomatoes, rigatoni, shrimp shells tails if necessary, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil, shallots and a good grind of pepper in a large, cold frying pan. Place over a low heat and slowly cook for 10 mins, stirring regularly, until softened. Step 2: Add the chorizo to the shallots, turn up the heat (but not too much) and colour a little. When the orange oil is released into the pan, add the tomatoes and a good pinch of salt. Stir over a medium heat – the tomatoes should literally melt in about 10 mins. If the sauce is not bubbling, turn up the heat a little. Add 100ml water and bring to the boil. Gently simmer for a few mins more. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the pasta. Add the prawns to the sauce, bring back to the boil and cook for 1 min until the prawns change colour. Drain the pasta and stir into the sauce with the spring onion whites. Cook and stir for 1 min. Serve sprinkled with the spring onion greens.

Ingredient Names: mussels, clams, medium shrimp, water, tomato, onion, carrot, celery, salt, ground black pepper, extra-virgin olive oil, rice, white wine, garlic, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Soak mussels, clams, and shrimp in separate bowls of salted cold water for 5 minutes, drain. Step 2: Clean and devein shrimp, reserving heads and shells. Step 3: Combine shrimp heads and shells, 2 quarts water, tomato, quartered onion, carrot, and celery in a large pot; bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until flavors combine, to. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Strain stock through a fine-mesh sieve, discarding solids. Step 7: Keep warm over low heat. Step 8: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Step 9: Add chopped onion; cook and stir until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 10: Stir in rice until translucent and coated with oil, 2 to. Step 11: Increase heat to medium-high; pour in white wine. Step 12: Simmer until alcohol has evaporated, about 15-20 minutes. Step 13: Reduce heat to medium and stir in 1 ladle of stock until rice has absorbed the liquid. Step 14: Repeat with remaining stock, stirring after each addition, until rice is creamy and almost tender, about 5 minutes. Step 15: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 16: Add garlic and cook until golden, 1 to. Step 17: Add mussels and white wine; cover and cook until mussels open, about 5 minutes. Step 18: Remove from heat; discard garlic and any mussels that did not open. Step 19: Remove shells and keep mussels warm. Step 20: Strain cooking liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl. Step 21: Heat olive oil in the same saucepan over medium heat. Step 22: Add garlic and cook until golden, 1 to. Step 23: Add clams and white wine; cover and cook until opened, about 5 minutes. Step 24: Remove from heat; discard garlic and any clams that did not open. Step 25: Remove shells and keep clams warm. Step 26: Strain cooking liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl. Step 27: Heat remaining olive oil in the same saucepan. Step 28: Add garlic and shrimp; cook and stir until shrimp turn pink, about 3-4 minutes. Step 29: Remove from heat and discard garlic. Step 30: Pour some of the mussel and clam cooking water over the rice; cook for 3 to more. Step 31: Remove rice from heat. Step 32: Fold in mussels, clams, and shrimp. Step 33: Sprinkle parsley on top. Step 34: Let stand before serving, about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: penne, fresh broccoli, butter, flour, milk, mascarpone, sundried tomatoes, capers to remove excess salt, anchovy fillets, fresh basil leaves, skinless salmon fillets, mature cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 190C/gas 5/fan 170C and get out an ovenproof dish (measuring 20 by 30cm, and about 5cm deep). Meanwhile, put a large pan of water on to boil for the pasta. When it is boiling rapidly, tip in the pasta with a generous sprinkling of salt. Give it a stir, return to the boil and cook for 6 minutes. Add the broccoli, then return the water to the boil and cook for 4 minutes more, until the broccoli is on the firm side of just tender. Drain well. Step 2: While the pasta is cooking, put the butter, flour and milk in a large pan and heat, whisking or stirring continuously, until it thickens to make a smooth sauce. Remove from the heat and stir in the mascarpone, sun-dried tomatoes, capers (if using), anchovies (if using) and basil, then add the pasta and broccoli and season well. Step 3: Halve the salmon fillets widthways then place the pieces in a single layer on the base of the ovenproof dish. Spoon the broccoli mixture on top, then scatter with the grated cheddar. (You can chill this for up to 4 hours if you want to get ahead.). Step 4: Bake for 30 minutes until the mixture is just starting to bubble round the edges and the mixture is pale golden – don’t let it go too dark or the fish will overcook.

Ingredient Names: oil, salmon fillets, tagliatelle, arugula, creme fraiche, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a non-stick pan and cook the salmon, skin-side down, for 5 mins. Turn over and continue to cook for 4 mins more until the salmon is cooked through. Remove from pan, leave to cool, then flake the fish into large chunks, discarding skin. Step 2: Cook tagliatelle according to pack instructions. Scoop out half a cup of cooking water, then drain and return to the pan. Toss in the salmon and remaining ingredients, loosening with cooking water, if the mixture is too thick. Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, risotto rice, white wine, vegetable stock, lemon, king prawns, salmon, asparagus, ground black pepper, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a thick-based pan and gently cook the onion without colour until it is soft. Step 2: Add the rice and stir to coat all the grains in the butter. Step 3: Add the wine and cook gently stirring until it is absorbed Gradually add the hot stock, stirring until each addition is absorbed. Step 4: Keep stirring until the rice is tender Season with the lemon juice and zest, and pepper to taste. Step 5: (there will probably be sufficient saltiness from the salmon to not need to add salt). Step 6: Stir gently to heat through. Step 7: Serve scattered with the Parmesan and seasonal vegetables. Step 8: Grill the salmon and gently place onto the risotto with the prawns and asparagus.

Dish Name: Sauteed Shrimp With Lemon Caper Cream Sauce on Angel Hair Pasta
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, deveined shrimp, heavy cream, white wine, lemons, capers, garlic, parsley, olive oil, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the shrimp in the olive oil for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the garlic and capers and saute for 30 seconds more. Step 3: Add the white wine (or water) and lemon juice and simmer until sauce is reduced by 1/2. Step 4: Add the cream and simmer until sauce is reduced by 1/3. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: If desired, add fresh or dried parsley. Step 7: Pour sauce over pasta, and.

Ingredient Names: linguine, butter, olive oil, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, garlic, large shrimp, peeled and deveined, dry white wine, clam juice, lemon juice, chopped fresh parsley, heavy cream, crushed red pepper flakes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Reserve pasta water; drain linguine well in a colander set in the sink. Step 4: Melt butter with 1 陆 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add bell peppers and garlic; cook and stir until peppers have softened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Stir in shrimp; cook and stir until shrimp are opaque and pink, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer shrimp to a bowl and set aside, leaving peppers and garlic in the skillet. Step 8: Stir wine, clam juice, and lemon juice into the skillet; bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 9: Add remaining butter and remaining 1 陆 tablespoons olive oil; return shrimp to the skillet. Step 10: Stir in reserved pasta water, parsley, cream, pepper flakes, and salt. Step 11: Add cooked linguine; toss lightly to coat. Step 12: Simmer scampi over medium-low heat to let linguine absorb some sauce, about 5 minutes; serve hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fennel bulbs, garlic, red chile, cleaned squid rings, fresh basil leaves, tomato, white wine, mussels, raw shrimp, sea bass fillets, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, then add the fennel, garlic and chilli. Fry until softened, then add the squid, basil stalks, tomatoes and wine. Simmer over a low heat for 35 mins until the squid is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly, then season. Step 2: Scatter the mussels and prawns over the sauce, lay the sea bass fillets on top, cover, turn up the heat and cook hard for 5 mins. Serve scattered with the basil leaves and fennel fronds, with crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, crabmeat, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic, parsley, olive oil, pizza dough
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic in olive oil for several minutes. Step 2: Add shrimp and crabmeat, mixing well with garlic and olive oil, add parsley. Step 3: Sprinkle 1/2 cup mozzarella on pizza crust. Step 4: Place crab/shrimp mixture on crust. Step 5: Cover with remaining cheeses. Step 6: Bake according to your pizza crust directions (typically, bake pizza until crust is golden brown and cheese is melted and bubbling, about 15 minutes). Step 7: Cut and serve with cocktail sauce.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, cannellini beans, virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, red pepper flakes, rosemary, fresh basil leaves, garlic, salt, pepper, crusty italian bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2-4 tbsp olive oil over low heat in a small saucepan. Step 2: Add 1 clove of the thinly sliced garlic to the oil, and warm over the low flame until the oil is infused, about 5-7 minutes. Step 3: Brush the slices of crusty bread with the garlic oil, and place under the broiler until they just begin to turn golden and crunchy, about 4-5 minutes. Step 4: Warm the remaining olive oil in a sauté pan over medium heat. Step 5: Add garlic, rosemary, and crushed red pepper and cook for a couple minutes, until the smell of rosemary fills the air. Step 6: Next add the beans and balsamic vinegar (if using), stir to coat beans with the warm oil. Step 7: Increase the heat to medium high, and add the shrimp pieces. Step 8: Stir to coat shrimp with olive oil, and cook until they turn pink. Step 9: Top each of the toasted bread slices with equal parts of the bean and shrimp mixture. Step 10: Garnish with shredded fresh basil. Step 11: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine, butter, cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, garlic, half-and-half, grated parmesan cheese, chopped fresh parsley, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Step 2: Cook fettuccine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes, drain. Step 3: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Cook and stir shrimp and garlic in butter for 5 minutes. Step 5: Pour in half-and-half; stir. Step 6: Add Parmesan cheese, at a time, stirring constantly. Step 7: Mix in parsley; season with salt. Step 8: Simmer, stirring frequently, until sauce is thickened. Step 9: Stir fettuccine into sauce until evenly coated; serve hot.

Ingredient Names: butter, extra-virgin olive oil, zucchini noodles, yellow onion, garlic, kosher salt, shrimp, peeled and deveined, baby spinach, lemon juice, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and olive oil together in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add zucchini noodles (zoodles), onion, chopped garlic, and salt; cook and stir until zoodles are tender and onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl. Step 4: Melt remaining butter in the skillet. Step 5: Add shrimp and minced garlic; cook and stir until shrimp are just pink, 3 to. Step 6: Add spinach, lemon juice, red pepper flakes, black pepper, and remaining salt; cook and stir until spinach begins to wilt, 3 to. Step 7: Add zoodle mixture; cook and stir until heated through, 2 to.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallot, garlic, red pepper flakes, fire-roasted diced tomatoes, tomato paste, dry white wine, shrimp, peeled and deveined, dried parsley, dried basil, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook and stir shallot and garlic in hot oil until tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add red pepper flakes; cook and stir to release flavor, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir fire-roasted tomatoes and tomato paste into the shallot mixture. Step 5: Thin the sauce by stirring white wine into the mixture; cook and stir until sauce becomes thick and bubbly, 4 to. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 7: Add shrimp to the tomato mixture; cook and stir until shrimp are pink and cooked through, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Season with parsley, basil, and black pepper.

Ingredient Names: orzo pasta, pesto, extra-virgin olive oil, cooked shrimp, diced red bell pepper, capers, dried oregano, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, salt, ground black pepper, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook orzo in boiling water, occasionally stirring until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain and transfer to a bowl; mix pesto and extra-virgin olive oil into orzo. Step 4: Heat remaining tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil in a skillet; cook and stir shrimp, red bell pepper, and capers in hot oil until shrimp is heated through, 3 to. Step 5: Stir remaining teaspoon pesto, oregano, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper into shrimp mixture; cook and stir until combined, 1 to. Step 6: Mix orzo into shrimp mixture; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and drizzle with olive oil.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, shrimp, asparagus spears, garlic, olive oil, mushrooms, chicken broth, plum tomato, salt, red pepper flakes, fresh basil, oregano, thyme, parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute the shrimp, asparagus and garlic in oil for 3-4 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, broth, tomato, salt and pepper flakes; simmer, uncovered, for 2 minutes, drain pasta. Step 4: Add the pasta and seasonings to skillet; toss to coat. Step 5: Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: linguine, olive oil, butter, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, mushrooms, garlic, marinated artichoke hearts, lemon, capers, dry white wine, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain. Step 3: Heat olive oil and butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add shrimp, mushrooms, and garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, 1 to. Step 5: Add artichokes, lemon juice, capers, and white wine. Step 6: Cook and stir until shrimp is tender and mixture is bubbling, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Spoon shrimp piccata over individual beds of pasta. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, zucchini, yellow squash, green bell pepper, sliced fresh mushrooms, crushed tomatoes, dried oregano, dried basil, red pepper flakes, salt, ground black pepper, shrimp, peeled and deveined
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain. Step 3: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir onion and garlic until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add zucchini, yellow squash, bell peppers, and mushrooms; continue cooking and stirring until vegetables are tender, about more. Step 5: Pour tomatoes into skillet and season with oregano, basil, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper; bring to a simmer. Step 6: Cook shrimp in vegetables sauce until they are bright pink on the outside and the meat is no longer transparent in the center, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Serve shrimp and sauce over rigatoni.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, olive oil, green onions, garlic, marinated artichoke hearts, diced tomatoes, capers, chipotle chile powder, shrimp, peeled and deveined, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook the rotini at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir green onions and garlic until onions are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add artichokes, tomatoes, capers, and chipotle chile powder; bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer. Step 5: Place shrimp into sauce; cook and stir until they are bright pink on the outside and the meat is no longer transparent in the center, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Divide pasta evenly into 4 bowls and top with shrimp and tomato sauce. Step 7: Scatter goat cheese over sauce.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, linguine, garlic, butter, olive oil, white wine, lemon juice, red pepper flakes, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside. Step 2: Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet and sauté minced garlic and red pepper flakes until fragrant. Step 3: Add the shrimp and cook until they turn pink, about two minutes per side, then remove and set aside. Step 4: Pour white wine into the same pan and let it reduce slightly, then stir in lemon juice. Step 5: Return the shrimp to the pan along with the cooked linguine, tossing everything together in the sauce. Step 6: Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, parsley flakes, italian dressing, salt, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper, dry pasta, half-and-half, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the shrimp in the other ingredients until you are ready for them. Step 2: Thirty minutes before you are ready to serve, start heating the pasta water and place the half-and-half and butter in a large serving bowl to soften (sometimes I nuke it in the microwave for a minute or two). Step 3: Put a large skillet over high (or medium high) heat to get it really hot. Step 4: When the pasta is about three minutes away from being done (done=al dente), dump the shrimp and marinade into the hot skillet. Step 5: Toss the shrimp around as they cook. Step 6: Once the shrimp are pink and curled-up (about three minutes), remove the skillet from the heat. Step 7: Drain the pasta and dump it into the serving bowl with the half-and-half and butter. Step 8: Add the Parmesan cheese, a pinch of salt and a few grinds of black pepper and toss together gently (the residual heat from the pasta melts everything together). Step 9: Pour the shrimp and sauce over the top and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, white wine, shrimp, garlic, parsley, red pepper flakes, butter, angel hair pasta, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling salted water. Step 2: While pasta is boiling, heat the oil in a sauté pan, add onion, and sauté 2 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, sauté 1 minute. Step 4: Add shrimp; cook 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add butter, wine, red pepper, salt, and pepper. Step 6: When pasta is done, drain and place on plate and pour shrimp mixture over it.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper, fettuccine, shrimp, peeled and deveined, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Separate asparagus tips from remaining pieces. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Cook and stir garlic in hot oil until it begins to turn brown, 3 to. Step 4: Stir in asparagus (not the tips); season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook and stir until tender but still bright green, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add asparagus tips; cook and stir for 5 minutes. Step 7: While the asparagus is cooking, fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Step 8: Stir in fettuccine and return to a boil. Step 9: Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain well. Step 10: Return fettuccine to the pot. Step 11: Drizzle olive oil over noodles; toss to coat. Step 12: Cover to keep warm. Step 13: Use a slotted spoon to transfer asparagus from the skillet to a plate; leave excess oil in the skillet. Step 14: Pat shrimp dry with paper towels, then place into the hot skillet. Step 15: Sprinkle shrimp with seafood seasoning and cook over medium-high heat until bright pink on the outside and opaque in the center. Step 16: Stir in asparagus and cook until heated through, 2 to 3 more minutes. Step 17: Stir shrimp and asparagus into the cooked fettuccine. Step 18: Add Parmesan cheese and toss to coat, adding more olive oil if needed to generously coat all ingredients.

Ingredient Names: warm water, active dry yeast, kosher salt, white sugar, olive oil, all-purpose flour, onions, salt, red pepper flakes, ground black pepper, tomato paste, dried oregano, anchovy fillets, water, bread crumbs, pecorino cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour warm water into the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook. Step 2: Sprinkle yeast on top and let bloom. Step 3: Add salt, sugar, olive oil, and flour. Step 4: Knead, scraping down sides as necessary, until dough is very elastic and sticky, 6 to. Step 5: Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Step 6: Heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 7: Add onions and salt. Step 8: Saute, stirring occasionally, until onions soften, sweeten, and turn translucent, 6 or. Step 9: Add red pepper flakes, black pepper, tomato paste, oregano, and anchovies; mix until anchovies dissolve. Step 10: Add marinara sauce, rinse out the container with water, and add the water. Step 11: Stir and let simmer on medium-low heat until flavors come together, about 15-20 minutes. Step 12: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 13: Combine bread crumbs and Pecorino Romano cheese in a bowl; toss together with a fork. Step 14: Add the reserved anchovy oil and olive oil. Step 15: Mix until bread crumbs are well moistened. Step 16: Generously coat a rimmed 13x18-inch sheet pan with up to olive oil. Step 17: Oil your hands and turn dough out onto pan. Step 18: Pull, stretch, and press it to the sides of the pan, pausing to let dough rest whenever it shrinks back too quickly. Step 19: Spoon sauce over the dough and spread up to about from the edges. Step 20: Add mozzarella and provolone cheeses. Step 21: Sprinkle bread crumb mixture evenly on top; do not press down. Step 22: Drizzle remaining olive oil on top. Step 23: Bake in the preheated oven until pizza is well browned is bottom is cooked, about 3-4 minutes. Step 24: Bake for as as long as you can without the crumbs on top burning so that the crust cooks as much as possible. Step 25: Slide pizza onto a cooling rack to prevent the bottom from getting soggy. Step 26: Transfer to a cutting board once cooled.

Ingredient Names: linguine, olive oil, garlic, low-fat creme fraiche, white crabmeat, arugula, lemons, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the linguine following pack instructions, reserving a little cooking liquid before you drain it. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a frying pan. Add the garlic and cook gently to soften, but don’t brown. Stir in the crème fraîche, crabmeat, chopped rocket and lemon zest, and gently heat through. Step 3: Tip in the cooked pasta and a little cooking liquid to help the sauce coat the pasta. Season and give everything a stir. Sprinkle with the pine nuts and remaining rocket leaves.

Ingredient Names: smoked salmon, onion, garlic, sliced fresh mushrooms, pesto sauce, basil, tomato paste, olive oil, water, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, 8 to. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms and cook until onion is transparent and mushrooms are tender. Step 5: Stir in smoked salmon, pesto sauce, tomato paste, fresh basil, and water; cook gently until desired consistency is achieved, 5 to. Step 6: Serve salmon pesto sauce over noodles.

Ingredient Names: butter, leeks, risotto rice such as arborio, fish, full-fat milk, undyed smoked haddock, creme fraiche, baby spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat the butter in a large ovenproof dish over a medium heat. Cook the leek for 4-5 mins, stirring regularly, until just tender. Add the rice and stir for a further 2 mins. Step 2: Add the stock and milk, bring to the boil and bubble for 5 mins before sitting the haddock on top. Cover with a lid or foil and bake in the oven for 18 mins until the rice is tender. Step 3: Fold in the crème fraîche and spinach, season with plenty of black pepper, then cover the pan again and leave to rest out of the oven for 3 mins before serving – the steam will soften the spinach.

Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, risotto rice such as arborio, garlic, vegetable stock, smoked salmon three-quarters, mascarpone lite, fresh flat-leaf parsley, lemon zest, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 mins. Add the rice and garlic, then cook for 2 mins, stirring continuously. Pour in a third of the stock and set the timer to 20 mins. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the stock has been absorbed, then add half the rest of the stock and carry on cooking, stirring a bit more frequently, until that has been absorbed. Step 2: Pour in the last of the stock, stir, then simmer until cooked and creamy. Take from the heat and add the chopped salmon, mascarpone, parsley and lemon zest. Grind in some black pepper, but don’t add salt as the salmon will be salty enough. Leave for 5 mins to settle, then taste and add a little lemon juice if you like. Serve topped with reserved salmon (roughly torn) and some rocket.

Ingredient Names: quick-cook spaghetti, butter, garlic, cream, eggs, parmesan, smoked salmon trimmings, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti. Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small pan, add the garlic and gently sizzle for 1 min. Remove from the heat. Step 2: Lightly beat the cream, eggs, softened garlic and half the Parmesan in a bowl. Stir in the smoked salmon trimmings. Step 3: Drain the pasta well and return to the pan. Add the salmon mixture and the chives, then toss well so the heat from the pasta lightly thickens the sauce. Serve scattered with the remaining Parmesan and plenty of black pepper.

Ingredient Names: water, spaghetti, shrimp, eggplants, olive oil, garlic, canned tomatoes, honey, red pepper flakes, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Salt the water and bring to a boil in a kettle; add the spaghetti and cook to the desired degree of doneness and/or according to package directions, then drain and set aside. Step 2: While pasta is cooking, peel and devein the shrimp and set aside. Step 3: Trim the ends of the eggplant and peel it. Step 4: Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a saucepan and add the garlic. Step 6: Cook, stirring, without browning. Step 7: Add the tomatoes, honey, pepper flakes, basil (flat Italian parsley can be substituted), salt and pepper. Step 8: Stir to blend, cover and simmer, stirring frequently, about 15 minutes. Step 9: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large nonstick skillet and when it is very hot, add the eggplant, salt and pepper. Step 10: Cook the eggplant, tossing it, until it's nicely browned. Step 11: Drain and add the eggplant to the tomato sauce. Step 12: Stir and cover and cook for 15 minutes or until well blended with the sauce. Step 13: Meanwhile, in the same nonstick skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and add the shrimp, salt and pepper. Step 14: Cook over high heat for one minute, stirring. Step 15: Add the shrimp to the sauce, blend well and cook for one minute. Step 16: Toss the cooked and drained spaghetti with the shrimp and eggplant mixture, and serve immediately with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Spaghetti with crab, cherry tomatoes & basil
Ingredient Names: extra-virgin olive oil, garlic, chili flakes, cherry tomatoes, juice lemon, white crab meat, spaghetti, capers, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan, heat the olive oil. Add the garlic and chilli flakes. Cook until just pale golden, then add the tomatoes. Cook 3 mins more on a high heat until the tomatoes start to break down a little. Add the lemon juice and cook for 1-2 mins. Remove from the heat and stir in the crab to warm through – not too much or it will break up. Step 2: Boil the pasta in a large pan of salted water following pack instructions then drain. Mix the pasta in the warm pot with the sauce, lemon zest and capers, and toss the basil through.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, long red chilies, extra-virgin olive oil, wild arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water according to pack instructions. Step 2: While the spaghetti is cooking, split the chillies down the centre lengthways. Using a teaspoon and starting at the top, scoop the seeds from the flesh - add these if you like your food hot. Using a sharp knife, cut the chillies in thin strips, bundle them together and cut across to make squares. Step 3: Drain the spaghetti, toss with a drizzling of olive oil and set aside. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan or sauté pan over a high heat and add the prawns. Stir in the chillies, season, then add the spaghetti. Remove from the heat, fold through the rocket and stir.

Dish Name: Spaghetti with tomato, chilli & tuna salsa
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, red onions, tomato, olive oil, red chile, tuna brine
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti in plenty of boiling water according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and tomatoes and put in a large pan with the oil. Halve, deseed and finely chop the chilli, then add to the pan. Gently heat through for a few mins, stirring well. Step 2: Drain the pasta and add to the sauce, then break up the tuna and add to the pan. Season if you like, then toss well and serve.

Ingredient Names: tuna spring water, green onions, eggs, vegetable oil, tomato chili sauce, arugula, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Squeeze excess water from the tuna, place in a bowl with the spring onions and egg, then stir together. Use your hands to shape into small walnut-size balls – you should get about 12. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan, tip the tuna balls in, then cook for 5-10 mins until golden all over. Pour over the tomato & chilli sauce, then cook for 5 mins more, adding a little boiling water if the sauce looks dry. Step 3: Meanwhile, boil the pasta, then drain. Stir through the sauce and most of the rocket. Serve in bowls with the tuna balls and a little extra rocket on top.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, lemon, white wine, pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly oil a baking pan large enough to accommodate the fish. Step 2: Place salmon in pan skin-side down. Step 3: Squeeze juice of 1 lemon and white wine over salmon; set aside to marinate for 2 hours. Step 4: Set an oven rack about 9 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Step 5: Spread a 1/4-inch thick layer of pesto on top of salmon. Step 6: Cook under the preheated broiler until a crust forms and fish flakes easily with a fork, about 8 to. Step 7: Remove salmon and set aside for a few minutes. Step 8: Squeeze juice from 1/2 lemon over fish. Step 9: Slice the remaining 1/2 lemon into thin slices; arrange on salmon.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, large onion, tuna steaks, red wine vinegar, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Cook and stir onion in hot oil until softened and translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 4: Continue to cook and stir until onion is very tender and dark brown, 15 to more. Step 5: Remove onion to a plate. Step 6: Place tuna steaks in the same skillet over medium-high heat and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 7: Remove tuna steaks to a serving tray; keep warm. Step 8: Stir together vinegar and sugar in the same skillet until sugar is dissolved. Step 9: Return onion to the skillet and simmer until liquid reduces and is slightly thickened, about 15-20 minutes. Step 10: Return tuna steaks to the skillet and cook for 3 to. Step 11: Place tuna on the warm serving tray and top with onion and sauce.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, dried basil, tomato, olive oil, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Step 2: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil; coat with cooking spray. Step 3: Place salmon fillets on foil; sprinkle with basil. Step 4: Top with tomato slices, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Step 5: Bake in the preheated oven until salmon opaque in center and Parmesan lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tuna olive oil, tomato garlic herbs, pasta shapes, fresh broccoli florets, light soft cheese, cheddar, fresh breadcrumb, salad
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the reserved oil from the tuna in a very large saucepan. Tip in the tomatoes plus 200ml water and simmer while you cook the pasta, following pack instructions. Add the broccoli for the final 3 mins, then drain, reserving some of the cooking water. Step 2: Heat the grill. Stir the soft cheese into the tomato sauce until melted, then mix with the pasta, broccoli and drained tuna, along with a little of the reserved cooking water if the sauce looks a bit thick. Season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Tip into an ovenproof dish and sprinkle on the cheddar and crumbs. Grill, not too close to the heat, for about 4-6 mins until golden and bubbling. Serve with a big side salad, if you like.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, large zucchini, salt, italian herbs, red pepper flakes, marinara sauce, water, tuna, elbow macaroni, grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic; cook and stir until softens, about 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add zucchini, salt, Italian herbs, and pepper flakes; cook and stir until zucchini begins to soften, about 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Add marinara sauce and water; bring to a boil. Step 5: Stir tuna into sauce; simmer until zucchini are almost tender, 7 to. Step 6: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 7: Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until still firm, about 10 minutes, drain well. Step 8: Stir elbow macaroni into tuna mixture until thoroughly combined; season with salt. Step 9: Turn off the heat, cover the skillet, and let pasta and sauce stand for exactly and 15 seconds. Step 10: Pasta will soak up sauce and become more tender. Step 11: Sprinkle servings with Parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red yellow pepper, garlic, chilies, tomatoes, mixed olives, sugar, wholemeal pasta shapes, tuna steak spring water, wholemeal breadcrumbs, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and fry the peppers for about 5 mins until starting to caramelise. Add the garlic and chillies, cook for 30 secs, then tip in the tomatoes and olives (if using). Season, add a pinch of sugar, bring to the boil, then simmer, uncovered, for 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Heat the grill. Drain the pasta and mix into the tomato sauce, along with the tuna. Tip into a large ovenproof dish. Mix the breadcrumbs and Parmesan together and scatter over the top. Grill for 3-4 mins or until the topping is crisp and golden. Serve with a green salad, if you like.

Ingredient Names: part-baked baguettes, red peppers, green peppers, sweetcorn, tuna, cheddar, tomato puree
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Halve the 2 part-baked baguettes lengthways and cook directly on the oven shelf for 8 mins. Meanwhile mix the diced peppers, sweetcorn, tuna, and 75g of the grated cheddar. Step 2: Transfer the baguettes to a baking tray, spread each with 1 tbsp tomato purée, divide the tuna mix over, then sprinkle with the remaining grated cheddar. Bake for 12 mins until melting and golden.

Ingredient Names: pasta, butter, onion, lemon juice, garlic, chopped fresh parsley, dry white wine, salt, black pepper, worcestershire sauce, medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, parmesan cheese, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook pasta in boiling water until tender yet firm to the bite, 2 to; drain. Step 3: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, white wine, salt, pepper, and Worcestershire sauce; cook and stir until mixture bubbles. Step 5: Increase heat to medium-high and stir in shrimp. Step 6: Cook and stir until shrimp turn pink and opaque, about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Serve shrimp scampi over pasta. Step 8: Sprinkle with Asiago cheese and avocado to serve.

Ingredient Names: squid, spaghetti, dry white wine, tomato sauce, parsley, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, hot water, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Separate tentacls and the body of the calamri, then gut them, setting aside the ink sak. Step 2: Wash calamari under cold water, dice the body into rings, and chop the tentacles. Step 3: Heat garlic in oil without browning. Step 4: Add parsley, ground pepper. Step 5: Cover and let it simmer for 45min. Step 6: Check from time to time If it's sticking, add some hot water. Step 7: Once it has simmered, mix the tomato sauce with the white wine and add it to the pot. Step 8: Simmer for 20 minutes more, uncovered, then dilute the sauce with a little hot water and simmer for a half hour more, covered 30 minutes before meal, cook pasta al dante.

Dish Name: Zuppa Di Pesce Fra Di Avolo
Ingredient Names: olive oil, sea scallops, shrimp, peeled and deveined, calamari rings, mussels, littleneck clams, crushed tomatoes, water, yellow onion, red pepper flakes, garlic, dried oregano, dried parsley, salt, linguine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir sea scallops, shrimp, and calamari rings in the hot oil until scallops and calamari are opaque and shrimp are pink, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Bring a separate pot of water to a boil and add mussels and littleneck clams to the boiling water; cook until shells have opened, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove shellfish and rinse with hot water. Step 5: Pour crushed tomatoes, water, chopped clams, olive oil, onion, red pepper flakes, garlic, oregano, parsley, and salt into a large pot and bring to a boil. Step 6: Stir cooked scallops, shrimp, calamari, mussels in shells, and littleneck clams in shells into tomato mixture. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 8: About 15-20 minutes before serving, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook the linguine at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes; drain and rinse pasta in hot water to prevent sticking. Step 9: Serve seafood and sauce over pasta.

Ingredient Names: sweet italian sausage link, onion, red pepper, fresh mushrooms, black pepper, fresh sage leaves, wonton wrappers, flour, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, cook sausage meat over med heat for 15 minutes, drain fat. Step 2: Add onions, peppers, mushrooms, pepper, and sage, and saute over low heat for 10 minutes. Step 3: Set aside Lay won-ton wrappers on a well-floured surface. Step 4: Brush tops with water. Step 5: Fill each skin with 1 tsp of mixture, then fold in half diagonally. Step 6: Press edges to seal Spray a steamer basket with nonstick cooking spray. Step 7: Place as many dumplings as possible in basket and steam, covered, for four to five minutes.

Ingredient Names: banana peppers, bacon, onions, garlic, mozzarella cheese, tasty cheese, mixed italian herbs, oregano, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut head off capsicum and de-vein and de-seed, keep the head. Step 2: Put bacon, onion, garlic and both herbs in a frying pan and saute in small amount of olive oil. Step 3: Cook until onion is soft. Step 4: Mix in cheeses and above mixture in bowl off the heat. Step 5: Stuff capsicums with the mixture Replace head and wrap capsicums in foil and put under a medium giller for fifteen minutes, turn and for a further 10 minutes Enjoy! Step 6: For a vegan option- omit the cheeses and bacon and try "soy cheese", leek and mushrooms.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, anchovies, butter, olive oil, parsley, tabasco sauce, baguette
Instructions: Step 1: Peel garlic cloves, slice off the ends of each clove and set aside. Step 2: Slice cloves 1 / 8 inch thick Pass the ends through a garlic press and measure 1 / 4 teaspoons save any leftovers for later use. Step 3: Place pressed garlic in a small bowl with anchovy fillets. Step 4: Add parsley, butter, 1 tsp oil, and tabasco, mash into a paste. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate. Step 6: Heat about 1 / 4 cup olive oil in a saute pan, add garlic slices, and saute to a light golden brown Watch closely, burns easily. Step 7: Remove to paper towel to drain.

Dish Name: Antipasto Of Prosciutto Cheese Strawberries And Balsamic Onion
Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onions, balsamic vinegar, prosciutto ham, strawberries, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: The day before serving, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat in a large skillet. Step 2: Add the onions and quickly saut just until they begin to soften, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Stir in 2 tbls Of the vinegar, stirring to coat. Step 4: Transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate Two hours before serving, remove the onions from refrigeration and stir in the remaining vinegar. Step 5: Roll each slice of prosciutto loosely and arrange at one end of a large platter Pile the strawberries in the center and the onions at the other end Tuck the slices of cheese around the platter and serve.

Ingredient Names: pita pockets, pizza sauce, parmesan cheese, salami, eggplants, artichoke hearts, roasted red peppers, kalamata olive, mozzarella cheese, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 220c. Step 2: Grease 2 baking trays. Step 3: Place pita bread on prepared trays and spread with pizza sauce and then sprinkle with parmesan and then top with salami, eggplant, artichoke, capsicum and olives. Step 4: Arrange mozzarella pieces over pizzas and then bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until bases are crisp. Step 5: Serve sprinkled with basil Variations - use grated tasty cheese instead of mozzarella or you could use any marinated vegetables, such as mushrooms, zucchinis and sun-dried tomatoes and could be made on garlic bread or bruschetta instead of pita pockets.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, garlic, dried basil, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl melt butter in microwave. Step 2: Using a garlic press, or food processor, mince and pulp garlic You can use more or less garlic according to taste. Step 3: Combine melted butter, basil, orgegano, and garlic. Step 4: Whisk in 1 / 3 cup olive oil. Step 5: Brush or spoon on to your favorite bread, bake to re-heat bread Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: pork sausage, italian breadcrumbs, mozzarella cheese, button mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Break out the stem from the mushrooms and place on cookie sheet In frying pan, cook sausage over medium heat until brown, then drain grease. Step 2: Add breadcrumbs and mozzarella cheese and stir to mix. Step 3: Stuff into mushroom caps. Step 4: Bake 10-15 minutes until cheese starts to brown on top and the mushrooms are sizzling.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, celery, fennel bulb, garlic cloves, golden raisin, white wine vinegar, sugar, capers, lemon peel, salt, black pepper, tomato sauce, frozen artichoke hearts, flat leaf parsley
