Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large non stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onions, celery, fennel and garlic. Step 3: Saute 5 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Stir in raisins and next 8 ingredients. Step 5: Bring to a simmer and cook over medium-low heat 5 minutes or until liquid is almost evaporated. Step 6: Sprinkle with parsley and serve chilled or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: baguette, marinated artichoke hearts, hearts of palm, mayonnaise, sour cream, parmesan cheese, garlic, tabasco sauce, creole seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients, except bread, in a blender or food processor. Step 2: Blend to combine, i like to leave it kind of chunky. Step 3: Spread toasted slices with mixture. Step 4: Place on cookie sheet Broil until golden. Step 5: Sprinkle with creole seasoning, or old bay.

Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, romano cheese, plum tomato, red onion, baby spinach, mayonnaise, garlic clove, french baguette
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the first seven ingredients. Step 2: Cut baguette into 30 slices. Step 3: Top with artichoke mixture. Step 4: Place on ungreased baking sheets Broil 3-4 inches from from the heat for 3-4 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, spinach, mayonnaise, parmesan cheese, green chilies, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Spray a 1-1 / 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Combine the artichoke hearts, spinach, mayonnaise, parmesan cheese, green chilies, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a large bowl and mix well. Step 3: Transfer to the casserole dish and bake 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips, crackers and or assorted vegetables.

Dish Name: Asiago Pepper Frico Crispy Cheese Wafers
Ingredient Names: asiago cheese, fresh ground black pepper, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Step 3: Mix cheese, black pepper, and cayenne pepper in small bowl. Step 4: Spoon cheese mixture by generous tablespoons in 6 mounds on each prepared baking sheet, spacing 3 inches apart. Step 5: Using fingers, spread each mond evenly to 2 1 / 2" round. Step 6: Bake frico until deep golden brown and crisp, about 12 minutes. Step 7: Remove from oven Slide parchment with frico onto ork surface and cool 5 minutes Slide thin metal spatula under frico to loosen. Step 8: Cool frico completely on parchment.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, butter, eggs, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus. Step 2: Cook in boiling salted water until just crisp-tender, approximately 4 to 5 minutes for thick stalks. Step 3: Remove from heat and remove asparagus with a slotted spoon. Step 4: Drain on several thicknesses of paper toweling until ready to serve Remember that the asparagus will continue to cook from their own heat as they stand and cool, so if you like very firm asparagus, time them accordingly. Step 5: Divide cooked asparagus among 4 individual serving plates. Step 6: Sprinkle with grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese. Step 7: In a medium-size frying pan over medium heat, heat the butter until just hot enough to sizzle a drop of water Break and slip eggs into the pan. Step 8: Reduce heat to low and cook approximately 2 to 3 minutes or until whites are set but yolks are still runny.

Dish Name: Asparagus With Butter And Parmesan Cheese
Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, water, parmesan cheese, butter, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus and discard. Step 2: Wash the asparagus thoroughly, put the. Step 3: Cut these trimmings into 1-inch pieces. Step 4: Place them in a covered casserole with the water. Step 5: Cook in the microwave oven for 2 to 3 minutes, depending upon their toughness. Step 6: Add the remaining asparagus, putting the butt end toward the outer edges of the baking dish. Step 7: Cover and cook until barely tender. Step 8: Remove asparagus to a serving dish, putting the cut pieces in the bottom of the dish and placing the spears attractively on top. Step 9: Melt the butter in a small container in the microwave oven.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, egg yolks, lemon juice, butter, salt, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: ---------spears----------- To cook asparagus spears, heat 1 inch salted water to boiling in deep narrow pan or coffee pot. Step 2: Place upright in pan and boil for approximately 5 minutes. Step 3: Cover and cook 7-10 minutes longer or until stalks are crisp-tender. Step 4: Drain --------pieces------- For cooking pieces of asparagus, cook lower stalk cuts in 1 inch of boiling salted water for approximately 5 minutes, add. Step 5: Drain ----------hollandaisesauce---------.

Ingredient Names: prosciutto, asparagus, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place prosciutto on a working surface, place 1 piece of cheese on each slice then lay spears on cheese. Step 2: Roll each up and place on a platter Finger food that is wonderful!

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, spinach, ricotta, grating nutmeg, tomato sauce, fresh breadcrumb, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Brush both sides of the aubergine slices with oil, then lay on a large baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 mins until tender, turning once. Step 2: Meanwhile, put the spinach in a large colander and pour over a kettle of boiling water to wilt. Cool, then squeeze out the excess water, so that it is dry. Mix with the ricotta, nutmeg and plenty of seasoning. Step 3: Dollop a spoonful of the cheesy spinach mix in the centre of each aubergine slice, fold over to make a parcel and lay, sealed-side down, in an ovenproof dish. Pour over tomato sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and cheese, and bake for 20-25 mins until golden and piping hot.

Ingredient Names: avocado, garlic cloves, sweet onion, chili flakes, fresh lime juice, roma tomatoes, parmesan cheese, baguette, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a mini chopper, chop the onion, garlic, chili flakes and lime juice until very fine Mixed the garlic etc with the fork mashed avocado. Step 2: Meanwhile lightly paint the baguette slices with olive oil on both sides and broil one side then the other until light golden. Step 3: Spread the avocado mixture on the toasted baguette slices. Step 4: Top with the chopped tomatoes and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350f heat for 10 minutes finish under the broiler for 2 more minutes or until the parmesan is golden.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, salt, olive oil, cornmeal, unbleached all-purpose flour, baking powder, bread machine yeast, vegetable oil, pizza dough, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Directions. Step 2: Add dough ingredients to machine bread pan in order as per 1 Manufacturer's instructions. Step 3: Set to"dough" mode. Step 4: Pour equal parts of vegetable oil and olive oil into a large frying pan to reach a depth of 2 inches. Step 5: Heat the oil over medium heat until a deep-fry thermometer registers 375 degrees f. Step 6: Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to 1 / 2-inch thickness. Step 7: Using a floured 2-inch cookie cutter, cut out doughnut rounds. Step 8: Using a floured 1-inch cookie cutter, cut out a hole in the center of each doughnut Gather the dough scraps and re-roll to cut out more doughnuts.

Dish Name: Bacon Mozzarella Topped Portabella Mushroom With Pesto
Ingredient Names: bread, pesto sauce, portabella mushroom, bacon, cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drizzle a reasonable amount of olive oil onto a baking tray and place the mushroom on the tray, cap down, drizzle a little oil onto the mushroom. Step 2: Bake in the oven, on 400, for 8 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, fry the bacon in olive oil and add any favourite herbs or seasoning. Step 4: Remove the portabella mushroom from the oven and top with bacon and cheese Alternate each so that you would put one slice of cheese, then one slice of bacon, then cheese, bacon, cheese, bacon etc. Step 5: Put the bacon and cheese topped mushroom back into the oven. Step 6: Cut out 2 circles, around the same size as the mushroom from the bread - a pint glass or large cookie cutter will do nicely Toast the bread rounds until golden, remove, spread with pesto and put on top of each other. Step 7: Remove the mushroom from the oven again and place on top of the toasted croutons and pesto, serve & enjoy.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, olive oil, anchovy fillets, butter, milk, bell pepper, carrot, zucchini, cherry tomatoes, cauliflower, broccoli floret, celery, button mushroom, green beans, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, cook garlic paste and sliced garlic in olive oil with anchovies over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes. Step 2: Stir butter and milk into mixture and transfer to a fondue pot. Step 3: Serve warm with accompanying vegetables.

Dish Name: Bagna Cauda Olive Oil Garlic Butter And Anchovy Sauce
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, butter, anchovies
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in an oven casserole, cover and bake at 275f for 1 1 / 2 hours Serve with bread and / or vegetables.

Ingredient Names: whipped butter, olive oil, anchovy fillets, garlic cloves, whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Brown garlic in oil in a deep skillet. Step 2: Add anchovies and butter, stirring until hot, reduce heat. Step 3: Stir in cream and heat just til warm. Step 4: Serve immediately, with any raw veggies or italian bread for dipping.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, smoked mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, dried basil, garlic clove, kosher salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven broiler. Step 2: Grease a small ovenproof dish with 1 / 2 teaspoon olive oil. Step 3: Layer half of the mozzarella, all the tomatoes, season with basil, garlic, salt, & pepper, top with rest of mozzarella. Step 4: Drizzle with 1 / 2 teaspoon virgin olive oil. Step 5: Place on the middle rack under your broiler for 5-7 minutes or until the mozzarella is melted and bubbly around the edges, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: feta cheese, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the oil and vinegar till well blended Crush the feta cheese into the oil & vinegar mixture, blending well Serve with bread.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, garlic cloves, shallot, fresh basil leaf, fresh lemon juice, sea salt, black pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Seed and chop tomatoes Combine with all other ingredients Let sit a room temperature for at least an hour for flavors to blend Serve with toasted bread slices.

Ingredient Names: eggs, water, flour, salt, vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender add eggs, water, flour, and salt and process until smooth Scrape down sides of container and process again for several seconds Lightly oil a skillet using a paper towel Ladle the batter 1 / 4 cup at a time into the pan and quickly swirl the pan around, coating the bottom with the batter Do not turn crepe over until it is dry on the top, about one minute. Step 2: Cook until browned lightly and not too dry Be sure the pan doesn't become too hot As time passes, you may need to reduce heat slightly. Step 3: Flip crepe over briefly and cook 20-30 seconds longer. Step 4: When done, remove from pan and store with wax or parchment paper separating each crepe until ready to fill.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, unsalted butter, fresh basil leaves, parmesan cheese, olive oil, pine nuts, cheesecloth
Instructions: Step 1: With electric mixer, beat cream cheese and butter until smooth, scraping sides of bowl as needed, set aside. Step 2: Prepare pesto: in a blender or food processor, whirl to a paste the basil, parmesan or romano cheese, and olive oil, stir in pine nuts, set aside. Step 3: Cut cheesecloth squares about 10-12" square to line custard cups If you use the really loose weave stuff, you'll need two pieces per custard cup Moisten the cheesecloth with water, wring dry and lay two sheets out flat on top of each other Smoothly line your custard cups with the cheesecloth With your fingers or a flexible rubber spatula, spread a thin layer of the cheese mixture in a lined custard cup.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic cloves, olive oil, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tomatoes in half lenghtwise. Step 2: Arrange the tomatoes cut side up in a shallow baking pan. Step 3: Sprinkle with the basil and garlic. Step 4: Drizzle with the olive oil. Step 5: Bake at 200 degrees for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours The tomatoes are done when shriveled but still moist. Step 6: Cool to room temperature. Step 7: Season with salt to taste just before serving.

Ingredient Names: italian bread, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, cream cheese, tomato paste, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Place tomato paste in a mixing bowl, stir in italian seasoning until well blended. Step 2: Add cream cheese and basil. Step 3: Slice bread into 1 / 4 inch thick slices. Step 4: Place on an ungreased baking pan Broil 6-8 inches from heat, turn after 1 minute. Step 5: After browned on both sides remove bread slices from broiler. Step 6: Spread 2 tablespoons of sauce on each toast slice Thinly slice mozzarella and layer a slice over the sauce Broil the little pizzas 6-8 inches from the heat source for 2 minutes or until the cheese is melted These look beautiful served with a dash of black pepper on top with a basil leaf for garnish.

Ingredient Names: butter, basil pesto, garlic cloves, plum tomatoes, parsley, italian bread, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Step 2: Mix together butter, pesto and garlic. Step 3: Spread butter mixture over bread slices. Step 4: Mix together tomatoes and parsley. Step 5: Top bread slices with tomato and parsley mixture. Step 6: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 7: Place on a baking sheet and cook for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic salt, italian bread, garlic powder, parsley, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: For the bruchetta: Mix together tomatoes, basil, garlic, and cheese. Step 2: Drizzle olive oil and vingar over the tomato mixture You don't want to skimp but you don't want to go over board either For 3 cups of tomato mixture i would reccomend about a cup of liquid Appx 3 / 4 cup of oil and a 1 / 4c of vinigar but this is just an estimate Go by your own preference. Step 3: Stir the ingredients. Step 4: Taste it and add more oil, vinigar, as needed You can also ad a little garlic salt if you think it needs salt.

Ingredient Names: mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic, fresh basil, eggs, all-purpose flour, lemons, salt, pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients except the oil into a bowl and mix well to combine. Step 2: Shape the mixture into 12 small patties and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large non-stick fry pan on medium high heat and fry the fritters for a few minutes on each side until they are nice golden colour. Step 4: Drain on paper towel and keep warm in a low oven while cooking the remaining fritters.

Ingredient Names: olive, olive oil, garlic cloves, lemon juice, flat leaf parsley, yellow onion, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To pit the olives, you can use a cherry / olive pitter, but i've found that the olives frequently slip through the holes instead of just the pits Another way to pit olives is to put them inside a folded kitchen towel and then bang on them with a mallet, cutting board, small frying pan, or whatever suits your fancy Sure the olives get bruised, but what do you think is going to happen in the food processor? Step 2: Mixing raw garlic and olive oil provides an ideal breeding ground for the anaerobic bacteria which cause botulism If i'm going to keep the paste around for a number of days, which i usually do, i'll mince the garlic, add it to the oil and then heat both in the microwave I try not to cook the garlic too much in this manner- you just need to heat the oil and garlic up to 140 or 150 degrees for a while. Step 3: Mix all of the ingredients in food processor.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, basil leaves, salt and pepper, crusty italian bread, olive oil, garlic clove, ovolini
Instructions: Step 1: Topping. Step 2: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Step 3: Mix thoroughly to incorporate ingredients and set aside to marinate for at least one hour Bread, preheat grill. Step 4: Brush both sides of each slice of bread with olive oil and rub each side with garlic clove. Step 5: Grill each slice of bread on both sides until lightly toasted Assembly: Spoon tomatoes over each slice of bread, top with a slice of fresh mozzarella and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: fennel bulbs, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, anchovy fillets, dried red chili pepper, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring pot of water to a rolling boil. Step 2: Drop in fennel quarters or whole "baby" bulbs. Step 3: Return to boil and cook, uncovered, for about 10 minutes, until the fennel is tender. Step 4: Drain and set aside. Step 5: In a frying pan large enough to hold all the fennel, heat olive oil over medium-low heat and add garlic, anchovies and chile pepper. Step 6: Cook gently until garlic has softened. Step 7: Mash the anchovy bits into the oil to make a paste. Step 8: Add fennel and continue cooking, stirring to coat the fennel with the garlicky, peppery oil. Step 9: Cook together, stirring occasionally, for an additional 5 minutes. Step 10: Spoon fennel from pan onto a serving plate, and sprinkle with freshly ground pepper.

Ingredient Names: basil, italian parsley, garlic, dried thyme, dried oregano, ground black pepper, kosher salt, rosemary, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except olive oil. Step 2: Put in a food processor and chop briefly until all ingredients are about the same size To serve: combine 1 1 / 2 teaspoon spice blend to 3-4 tablespoons olive oil on a small dish.

Ingredient Names: bresaola, marinated mushrooms, italian parsley, grana padano, extra virgin olive oil, fresh ground black pepper, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange bresaola slices, slightly overlapping on a large platter Scatter mushrooms over bresaola, then sprinkle with parsley. Step 2: Using a vegetable peeler, shave thin slivers of the cheese over bresaola. Step 3: Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with black pepper. Step 4: Serve with lemon wedges or squeeze lemon over all.

Ingredient Names: bresaola, tomatoes, feta, basil leaves, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange bresaola and tomatoes on a platter in alternate layers. Step 2: Sprinkle with feta, then finely shredded basil leaves and sprinkle with olive oil Great served with campari and soda.

Dish Name: Brie Topped With Pesto And Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: brie cheese, pesto sauce, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place brie on a platter, top with pesto Decorate with tomatoes Serve with crackers or fresh crisp italian bread.

Ingredient Names: ciabatta, sun-dried tomato paste, mozzarella cheese, dried oregano, olive oil, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each ciabatta loaf on the diagonal into 12-15 slices, discarding the ends Toast lightly on both sides. Step 2: Preheat oven to 425f spread sun-dried tomato paste on one side of each slice of toast. Step 3: Cut the mozzarella into small pieces and arrange over the tomato paste. Step 4: Put the toasts on baking sheets, sprinkle with oregano Lightly season with pepper, then drizzle olive oil on top. Step 5: Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes or until the mozzarella has melted and is bubbling. Step 6: Let the toasts stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, plum tomatoes, basil leaves, extra virgin olive oil, lemon, salt & pepper, baguette, garlic-infused olive oil, asiago cheese, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: For balsamic glaze: combine balsamic vinegar w / brown sugar, mix well & set aside For basil-marinated tomatoes: combine all ingredients in a bowl & marinate for at least 1 hour For bread: preheat oven to 350f slice baguette into 1-in slices. Step 2: Using a pastry brush, lightly brush both sides of ea slice w / the garlic-infused olive oil Quarter ea slice, place on a baking sheet & bake till crisp To serve sundaes: divide toasted baguette cubes among 4 appy serving plates. Step 3: Pour off any excess liquid from the marinated tomatoes, add the balsamic glaze to the tomatoes mixture & mix well. Step 4: Divide tomatoes among the 4 plates & top w / asiago cheese + basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: red ripe tomato, fresh white garlic, fresh basil leaf, hot red chili pepper flakes, sea salt, extra virgin olive oil, country bread
Instructions: Step 1: Pulse all ingredients, except bread, in processes to make coarse pesto. Step 2: Taste and correct seasoning Can be left in refrigerator to intensify flavors or use immediately on grilled bread Ammogghiu, is a sicilian sauce for grilled fish.

Ingredient Names: baguette, olive oil, butter, garlic, tomatoes, onion, salt, pepper, basil, oregano, fresh basil, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, onion, 5 teaspoons of olive oil, salt, pepper, basil, and oregano and mix - cool in fridge while preparing the rest. Step 2: Combine butter or olive oil with garlic and spread evenly over the baguette. Step 3: Make sure the baguette is covered right up to the edges, or else they will burn much quicker than the middle Broil baguette open-faced until lightly toasted or until desired doneness. Step 4: Add tomato and onion mixture on top. Step 5: Slice baguette diagonally into desired size and sprinkle the basil on top, serve If desired, before slicing add grated cheese on top and warm in the oven at 375 degrees until cheese melts. Step 6: Slice, serve, and enjoy You may sprinkle more basil on top at this point if so desired or wait until this point to add the basil at all.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Ricotta And Olive Tomato Relish
Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomato packed in oil, shallots, italian parsley, oregano, red wine vinegar, lemon zest, crushed red pepper flakes, extra virgin olive oil, baguette, garlic clove, ricotta cheese, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine tomatoes with shallot, parsley, oregano, vinegar, lemon zest, red pepper and the 2 tablespoons of oil, season with salt. Step 3: Brush bread slices on both sides with oil and bake for about 10 minutes, until golden and crisp Rub lightly with garlic clove. Step 4: Preheat broiler and position a rack 6" from heat. Step 5: Spread ricotta in a shallow medium gratin dish in a 3 / 4" thick layer. Step 6: Drizzle with oil and brown for about 10 minutes, turning the dish occasionally, until ricotta is bubbling and brown. Step 7: Remove from oven, spoon relish on, and top with chopped olives. Step 8: Serve with garlic toasts.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Sweet Peppers And Fresh Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, orange bell pepper, garlic cloves, garlic clove, salt, fresh ground black pepper, balsamic vinegar, italian bread, fresh mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Step 2: Add the pepper strips and saut until lightly browned at the edges and beginning to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Reduce the heat to medium low, stir in the minced garlic, cover and continue cooking until soft, about 8 minutes longer, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Remove from heat and stir in the vinegar. Step 6: Grill the bread over a medium heat, turning once, until golden brown on both sides, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 7: Place the toast slices on a large platter, rub the peeled garlic over the tops, and brush with the remaining olive oil. Step 8: Place a few slices of mozzarella cheese on each toast. Step 9: Cover with a portion of the sauted peppers, the top with a sprinkling of basil. Step 10: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Butter With Rosemary Or Other Edible Flowers
Ingredient Names: salted butter, fresh edible flower, white pepper, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Remove butter from refrigerator and let it soften at room temperature. Step 2: Chop your fresh picked flowers with a knife. Step 3: Stir it with a fork and add the flowers and white pepper. Step 4: Mix well and form again a stick with butter. Step 5: Wrap it in silicone foil and if you want shape it round, as triangle or as you like. Step 6: Cool in refrigerator for a day. Step 7: Cut it into thin slices and serve as desired.

Ingredient Names: low-fat buttermilk, low-fat milk, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients in a non-reactive saucepan and place over medium heat. Step 2: Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture smells "cheesy" and visibly separates. Step 3: Line a fine mesh strainer with at least 4 layers of cheesecloth and place over a bowl Carefully pour the contents of the pot into the strainer, allowing the liquid to drain out. Step 4: Allow cheese to sit in the cheesecloth-lined strainer for 30 minutes, then bring up the ends of the cloth and loosely tie it around a spoon set over a bowl. Step 5: Let drain another 10-15 minutes, depending on your texture preference. Step 6: Keep in the fridge up to 1 week.

Ingredient Names: water, unsalted butter, salt, all-purpose flour, basil leaves, eggs, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop basil leaves and set aside. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 400. Step 3: Bring water, butter and salt to a rolling boil in a medium-sized saucepan. Step 4: When butter has melted, add flour, all at once, and whisk vigorously over medium heat until mixture forms a smooth thick dough that pulls away from sides of the pan. Step 5: Transfer dough to the mixing bowl of a heavy-duty electric mixer. Step 6: Using the paddle attachment, beat mixture on medium until slightly cool. Step 7: Add basil and mix until incorporated and dough is bright green. Step 8: Add eggs, one at a time, to mixture and beat until smooth Continue to mix for one minute. Step 9: Add cheese and proces until incorporated.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, popcorn, butter, pecorino romano cheese, ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large heavy pot, combine 3 t vegetable oil and popcorn kernels. Step 2: Cover and cook over high heat shaking the pot often, until the popping stops, 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Add the butter and toss Dump the popcorn into a large paper bag and toss with 1 cup cheese and pepper Makes 8 cups.

Ingredient Names: margarine, white bread, pepperoni, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, fresh tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Get your briquettes hot in the charcoal grill or use campfire coals Lay the pie iron in the coals to pre-heat it on both sides. Step 2: When the pie iron is hot, remove it from the coals and butter the interior with the margarine, using a cooking brush. Step 3: Make sure to butter the edges as well, where the two halves of the pie iron clamp together It will smoke some as you brush on the margarine but that's fine Lay one side of the greased pie iron face up and lay a slice of bread on it, pushing it in a bit to fit The edges will extend beyond the perimeter of the pie iron slightly but that's okay On the bread, sprinkle on a good bit of mozarella cheese, then layer on about 10-12 thin slices of pepperoni Next, pour on just a little of the tomato sauce,, and then top it with a tomato slice. Step 4: Cover this with another slice of bread and close the pie iron with the greased top half of the unit.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the stem ends off the tomatoes, and hollow them out with a small spoon. Step 2: Cut mozzarella into small cubes. Step 3: Wrap each cube of cheese in a leaf of basil, and stuff into a tomato. Step 4: Drizzle tomatoes with oil and vinegar, and sprinkle with salt and pepper Try not to eat the whole tray before guests arrive.

Ingredient Names: black olives, green olives, garlic, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drain liquid from olives and chop fine. Step 2: Combine with the rest of the ingredients and let marinate. Step 3: Serve smothered on top of warm crusty french bread Excellent with pasta!

Ingredient Names: italian bread, extra virgin olive oil, minced garlic cloves, roma tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the bread into 1 / 2 inch thick slices and drizzle olive oil over each piece. Step 2: Sprinkle on the garlic. Step 3: Place the tomato slices on the bread and sprinkle on the cheese and last the basil. Step 4: Now you can broil it for 3 minutes or eat it as is -- This is for you to enjoy mom.

Ingredient Names: butter, oregano, basil, rosemary, salt, fresh ground pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together herbs and spices Place on a saucer Add crushed garlic and mix well Add melted butter Pour olive oil over mixture Use as a dip for italian bread.

Ingredient Names: oregano, basil, rosemary, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together your dry spices Add crushed garlic to the dry spices Place on small saucer Pour olive oil over mixture Dip with your favorite hot french bread.

Ingredient Names: asparagus spears, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Remove woody ends of asparagus. Step 2: Toss asparagus in a bowl with olive oil. Step 3: Heat a griddle, or barbeque and cook the asparagus for about 10 minutes, until al dente. Step 4: Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and sprinkle with parmesan shavings to serve.

Ingredient Names: mushrooms, green onion, garlic cloves, butter, dry breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, basil, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove mushroom stems and chop finely. Step 2: In a small pan, cook stems, green onions, garlic and butter over medium heat til tender, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and add all remaining ingredients except caps. Step 4: Fill caps with mixture, place in baking dish. Step 5: Bake 350f for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, pizza sauce, green peppers, green onions, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and italian seasoning. Step 2: Spread in an ungreased 9-inch microwave-safe pie plate. Step 3: Combine mozzarella and parmesan cheeses. Step 4: Sprinkle half over the cream cheese. Step 5: Top with the pizza sauce, remaining cheese mixture, green pepper and onion Microwave, uncovered, on high for 3-4 minutes or until cheese is almost melted, rotating a half turn several times. Step 6: Let stand for 1-2 minutes. Step 7: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: eggs, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, butter, milk, marinated artichoke hearts, mushrooms, asparagus, sweet green pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: You can also add your own veges to this as well. Step 2: In a small bowl whisk the two eggs and milk together and put them aside. Step 3: Using medium-high heat, in a saute pan or small skillet, saute the artichokes, green peppers, asparagus and mushrooms in the extra virgin olive oil, and balsamic vinegar-- When through, put them aside On medium high heat, melt the butter in a ten inch skillet and then pour the egg mixture inches be sure it is even as it cooks. Step 4: When the surface of the eggs looks firm, put the sauteed veggies and parmesan cheese on half of the egg mixture, fold the side without veggies and cheese over onto the side that does. Step 5: Cook for another 1-2 minutes and get ready to eat something special.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fresh basil, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried oregano, dried parsley, italian bread, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, basil Oregano and parsley. Step 2: Mix in tomatoes and let stand 15 to 30 minutes. Step 3: Take 12 bread slices and drizzle with a little olive oil and a little small dash of balsamic vinegar Toast bread lightly in toaster oven, pull bread from oven rub crushed garlic cloves on toasted bread, layer with provolone cheese and place back in oven for a minute or two until cheese lightly melts. Step 4: Remove bread from oven and place on platter, top toasted bread with tomato mixture then sprinkle parmesan cheese and serve.

Ingredient Names: cherry peppers, provolone cheese, prosciutto ham, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Clean peppers by cutting the pepper around the stem, and cleaning out the seeds. Step 2: Cut cheese in small squares. Step 3: Wrap small strips of ham around diced cheese cubes. Step 4: Place each cube into a pepper. Step 5: Place finished peppers into the jar. Step 6: Pour olive oil over peppers enough to cover, refrigerate.

Dish Name: Cherry Tomato Bocconcini And Basil Bruschetta
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt & freshly ground black pepper, bocconcini, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaf, country bread, garlic, arugula leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together three tablespoons of the olive oil and the balsamic vinegar in a bowl. Step 2: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 3: Stir in the cheese, tomatoes and basil leaves, set aside. Step 4: Grill the bread on both sides until lightly browned and crisp Rub one side of each slice of bread with the garlic, then sprinkle with olive oil. Step 5: Cover each slice of bread with several arugula leaves. Step 6: Spoon the tomato and cheese mixture over the arugula. Step 7: Sprinkle each bruschetta with additional olive oil, then top with basil leaves. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Chickpea Pesto Dip Or Pesto Hummus Dip
Ingredient Names: chickpeas, pesto sauce, garlic clove, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Process all ingredients in food processor till smooth Serve with a hearty cracker or breadstick.

Ingredient Names: bocconcini, breadcrumbs, lemon zest, dried chili pepper flakes, mixed italian herbs, black pepper, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Season breadcrumbs with lemon zest, dried chilli, italian herbs & black pepper Deep fry briefly in hot oil Drain & serve.

Dish Name: Cipolline In Agrodolce Sweet And Sour Onions
Ingredient Names: onion, extra virgin olive oil, fat, garlic clove, sugar, bay leaf, white wine vinegar, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place onions in a bowl of cold water for 10 minutes to loosen skins then peel the papery skins off Mince one of the onions and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a heavy skillet, large enough to hold all the onions in one layer, over medium heat. Step 3: Add prosciutto fat and stir until melted. Step 4: Add garlic and the one minced onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 8 minutes. Step 5: Add onions in one layer, add sugar, bay leaf, vinegar, salt and 1 cup of water or enough to just barely cover the onions. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and gently simmer until the onions are tender, about 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 7: Allow to cool to room temperature in the pan juices before serving.

Dish Name: Classic Italian Bruschetta With Fresh Herbs
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh basil, sea salt, garlic cloves, olive oil, fresh oregano, fresh thyme, french bread, fresh mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes and 1 / 2 cup fresh basil in a colander, sprinkle with salt and toss to coat, let drain 1 hour. Step 2: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 3: In a large bowl combine the drained tomato / basil mixture with the minced garlic, 1 / 4 cup olive oil, remaining 1 / 4 fresh basil, oregano and thyme. Step 4: Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes to allow flavors to blend During this time brush french bread slices lightly with the remaining olive oil Toast "lightly" in the oven Pull out and place a small amount of tomato mixture on top of the lightly toasted french bread slices. Step 5: Top each piece with a small amount of mozzarella Toast in the oven until cheese has melted and its golden brown.

Dish Name: Copycat Olive Garden Spinach Artichoke Dip
Ingredient Names: frozen chopped spinach, artichoke hearts, sour cream, cream cheese, salad dressing mix, parmesan cheese, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw and squeeze excess water from spinach. Step 2: Drain and chop artichoke hearts. Step 3: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl More sour cream can be added at this point for a smoother dip. Step 4: Chop cherry tomatoes. Step 5: Spread spinach mixture in a 13x9'' casserole dish, garnish with cherry tomatoes. Step 6: Bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, garlic, red pepper flakes, green olives, peanut oil, all-purpose flour, eggs, fine breadcrumbs, extra virgin olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove sausage from casing and place it in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add garlic, a pinch of salt, and red pepper flakes. Step 3: Mix to evenly distribute the ingredients. Step 4: Drain the olives and rinse them under cold water. Step 5: Remove the pimento stuffing, if necessary Stuf each olive with 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 teaspoons of the sausage mixture. Step 6: Heat oil in a deep fryer or stock pot to 375 degrees. Step 7: Spread flour on a dinner plate Break eggs into a shallow bowl and beat lightly. Step 8: Spread bread crumbs on another dinner plate and sprinkle with salt and peppr.

Ingredient Names: mascarpone cheese, parmesan cheese, marjoram, salt, pepper, french baguette
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Mix cheeses and add marjoram Salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Slice baguette in thin slices. Step 4: Spread cheese mixture on slices. Step 5: Place prepared slices on a baking sheet and put sheet into preheated oven. Step 6: Bake for a few minutes until hot an bubbly Watch closely--don't let the bread get too brown Bon apptit!

Dish Name: Crostini With Cheese Torta And Marinated Bell Peppers
Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, fresh parsley, fresh basil, capers, garlic clove, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cream cheese, feta cheese, goat cheese, pine nuts, crostini
Instructions: Step 1: Take cheeses out of refrigerator to bring to room temperature Roast bell peppers. Step 2: Place pepper on a foil lined broiler pan Broil turning as sides begin to char. Step 3: Wrap tightly in the foil and let cool This will steam them so the skin removes easily. Step 4: When cool, remove stems, skins and seeds Dice peppers and add vinegar, oil, herbs, capers and garlic. Step 5: Add salt and pepper. Step 6: Allow to marinate for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: french baguette, olive oil, honey, gorgonzola
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the baguette about 1 / 4" thick. Step 2: Place slices on a baking sheet. Step 3: Drizzle well with olive oil and toast under the broiler. Step 4: Turn over, drizzle generously with honey. Step 5: Toss on a dollop of the cheese and pass back under the broiler, heating until the cheese melts This is wonderful warm, but make sure you make enough to have some left over. Step 6: Cool, bag, and refrigerate.

Dish Name: Crostini With Sun Dried Tomato Jam
Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, olive oil, onion, garlic clove, sugar, red wine vinegar, water, chicken broth, fresh thyme leave, salt, fresh ground black pepper, baguette, goat cheese, fresh thyme leaves
Instructions: Step 1: For the sun-dried tomato jam: place a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, 1 tablespoon of the reserved sun-dried tomato oil, olive oil, onion, and garlic. Step 3: Stir and cook until the onions are soft and beginning to brown at the edges, about 5 to 7 minutes. Step 4: Add the sugar, vinegar, water, chicken broth, thyme, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Bring the liquid to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove the cover and continue simmering until most of the liquid is reduced and the mixture is the consistency of jam, about 5 to 10 more minutes. Step 7: Remove from the heat and set aside For the crostini: preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Step 8: Line a baking sheet with foil. Step 9: Place the baguette slices on the baking sheet.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, garlic cloves, olive oil, lemon juice, lemon pepper, fresh basil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all together and refridge at least 2 hrs, longer is preferable Serve with fresh or toasted french bread.

Ingredient Names: butter, worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, tabasco sauce, garlic cloves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients well You can divide this into individual servings, or just leave it in one dish For a more robust garlic flavor, melt the butter with the crushed garlic in it.

Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomatoes, minced garlic cloves, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fresh basil, salt, ground black pepper, french baguette, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven on broiler setting 2. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the roma tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, basil, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes 3. Step 4: Cut the baguette into 3 / 4-inch slices On a baking sheet, arrange the baguette slices in a single layer Broil for 1 to 2 minutes, until slightly brown 4.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, sweet onion, olive oil, fresh oregano, fresh basil, fresh parsley, italian bread, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine tomatoes, onion, olive oil, oregano, basil and parsley. Step 3: Place bread on a baking sheet and top with tomato mixture. Step 4: Sprinkle with parmesan. Step 5: Bake in preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until bottom of bread has browned. Step 6: Allow to cool about 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: olive salad, rolls, cheese slices, ham slices, genoa salami
Instructions: Step 1: Spread 1 tablespoon olive salad evenly over each cut side of roll bottoms. Step 2: Top each with 1 swiss cheese slice, 1 ham slice, 1 tablespoons olive salad, 1 provolone cheese slice, 1 salami slice and 1 tablespoon olive salad. Step 3: Cover with roll tops and wrap sandwiches together in a large piece of aluminum foil. Step 4: Place on a baking sheet. Step 5: Bake at 350 for 14 to 16 minutes or until cheeses are melted.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, spaghetti sauce, pizza toppings, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, butter, oregano, garlic salt, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place a flour tortilla on a large plate or cutting board and spread with a thin layer of spaghetti sauce. Step 2: Season with oregano, garlic salt, parmesian, pepper flakes, or whatever herbs you prefer. Step 3: Add a thin layer of shredded mozarella cheese. Step 4: Layer your pizza toppings of choice. Step 5: Add another thin layer of mozarella. Step 6: Place another tortilla on top. Step 7: Melt butter, parmesian, oregano, and garlic salt together in a Microwavable dish. Step 8: Brush the top tortilla with the herb butter and invert onto a grill with the butter side down. Step 9: Brush the other side and cover the grill.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onions, tomatoes, tomato paste, balsamic vinegar, ricotta cheese, milk, fresh chives, lemon thyme, lemons, chargrilled eggplants, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius and lightly grease a square baking dish. Step 2: Heat oil in a fry pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic, cook for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add tomatoes, tomato paste, balsamic vinegar and salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until sauce is thick. Step 6: Combine, ricotta, milk, chives, thyme and lemon rind (add salt and pepper if required). Step 7: Spread ricotta mixture evenly over slices of eggplant, then roll up lengthways. Step 8: Spoon sauce into baking dish and top with eggplant rolls. Step 9: Cover and bake for approximately 25 minutes or until sauce is bubbling.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, salt, tomatoes, fresh basil, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place eggplant slices in a colander over a plate. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt and gently toss. Step 3: Let stand about 30 minutes. Step 4: Rinse and drain well Coat both sides of each slice with nonstick cooking spray. Step 5: Place on a broiler pan. Step 6: Top eggplant with tomatoes, basil and cheeses Broil until eggplant is tender and cheese is golden and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, onions, extra virgin olive oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, garlic cloves, celery, chopped tomatoes, pitted black olives, capers, fresh flat-leaf parsley, wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Step 2: Wrap the eggplants in aluminum foil and place onto baking sheet. Step 3: Bake until soft and the skin is charred, about 1 hour. Step 4: Slice open the eggplants and scoop out all of the insides, placing it into a large bowl. Step 5: Chop the eggplants with a fork& add the chopped onions, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt and pepper. Step 6: Mix well with a fork. Step 7: In a large pan add a few tablespoons of extra-virgin olive oil and cook the celery and garlic for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and cook another 10 minutes, or until the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is thick. Step 9: Add the eggplant mixture, olives, capers, parsley and wine vinegar to the tomato mixture, and cook on low for 15 minutes. Step 10: Check seasonings and allow to come to room temperature before serving.

Ingredient Names: focaccia roll, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, peppers from, olive tapenade, chunks, fresh basil leaves, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the focaccia through the middle, then drizzle both cut sides with a little balsamic and oil. Brush a large square of foil with a little more oil, then sit the foccacia base in the middle. Top with a slice of pepper, roughly the same size as the bread, then spread with half the tapenade. Layer half the courgettes on top, scatter with a few basil leaves and half the pine nuts. Repeat the layers again, then finish with a third layer of roasted pepper. Top with the other bread half, then wrap tightly in the foil. Make up to a day ahead – or freeze now. Step 2: To cook, place the wrapped stack directly on the coals (or on the rack if you are using a gas barbecue) and bake for 10 mins on each side or 15 mins each side from frozen.

Dish Name: Kmt's Low Fat Ricotta Spinach Rolls
Ingredient Names: lasagne pasta, low-fat ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, spinach, carrots, parsley, fresh basil, eggs, salt, pepper, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Start chopping basil and parsley. Step 3: (Use dried if you REALLY feel lazy!) Prepare Lasagna pasta according to package Lay a few sheets of wax paper on the kitchen table. Step 4: In a mixing bowl, combine Riccota, 1/2 of the mozzarella (reserve rest for later), Parsley, Basil, spinach (hopefully you really squeezed it out dry!),salt,pepper, egg and carrots, mix well by hand. Step 5: Lay cooked Lasagna on wax paper Spread a thin layer of spinach mixture down the length of the lasagna. Step 6: You may have leftover pasta and/or spinach filling. Step 7: Just store it or chuck it. Step 8: Spread a little sauce on the bottom of large shallow casserole dish. Step 9: Roll each filled lasagna and place in casserole dish. Step 10: Spoon the pasta sauce onto Spinach roles. Step 11: Top with remaining mozzarella cheese. Step 12: Bake for 20-30 minutes. Step 13: Serve hot with a crusty garlic bread and salad.

Ingredient Names: fire-roasted tomatoes, roma tomatoes, celery, onion, minced garlic clove, chicken broth, italian seasoning, ground beef
Instructions: Step 1: Brown and drain your ground beef. Step 2: Set it aside in a covered bowl until ready to use. Step 3: Chop your onions, celery, and garlic finely. Step 4: Slice your tomatoes discarding the end pieces Lightly spray the bottom of a 5 quart stewpot with cooking spray. Step 5: Saute your onions, celery, and garlic until the celery is fork-tender. Step 6: Add your chicken broth If you prefer your soup with a thicker consistency, reduce the amount of chicken broth, or increase the amount of fire roasted tomatoes. Step 7: Bring to a gentle boil, then add all other ingredients except the ground beef Continue to boil about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: sweet italian sausage, diced tomatoes, beef broth, onion, green pepper, zucchini, minced garlic cloves, dried parsley, dry basil, dry oregano, water
Instructions: Step 1: Fry sausage in a soup pan, drain. Step 2: Add all other ingerdients except water. Step 3: Add water in a cup at a time, i add 2 cups, then if after cooking the soup looks a bit thick, i add more. Step 4: Reduce heat and allow the soup to simmer 2-3 hours, or until the zucchini is tender and transparent. Step 5: Serve with a yummy crusty italian bread, or garlic bread!

Ingredient Names: pearl barley, green cabbage, onion, carrot, celery, zucchini, tomatoes, baking potato, fava beans, garlic clove, vegetable stock, fresh ground black pepper, fresh basil leaf, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Place the barley in a pan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Step 2: Cook for 25-30 minutes until tender, then drain. Step 3: In a large pot, combine all vegetables with the stock and bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are just tender To make pesto, place the basil and garlic in a blender. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 cup of the vegetable cooking liquid and blitz to a smooth puree. Step 5: Add the puree to the soup, stir until combined, then add the cooked barley. Step 6: Season with black pepper and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, tomatoes, onion, oregano, cannellini beans, garlic cloves, fresh basil, olive oil, salt and pepper, ditalini, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, bring chicken stock to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Add tomatoes, onion and oregano and simmer about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add beans and continue cooking until onion is tender, about another 10 minutes In blender or food processor, finely chop the garlic and basil. Step 4: Add olive oil and process until combined. Step 5: Using a slotted spoon, transfer half the beans and veggies to the basil mixture Process until smooth, then stir puree back into the soup. Step 6: Cook pasta, reserving 1 cup of cooking water. Step 7: Stir the pasta into the soup and season with salt and pepper If the soup is too thick, thin out with the pasta cooking water.

Ingredient Names: sweet italian sausage links, olive oil, onion, fennel bulb, chicken broth, cannellini beans, diced tomatoes, thyme, pepper, bay leaf, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Bake sausage links at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, remove and slice into coin size pieces If using loose sausage meat, saute until done and drain well. Step 2: Saute onions and fennel in oil in a skillet until soft. Step 3: Combine onions, fennel, broth, beans, tomatoes and seasonings in a slow cooker. Step 4: Cook on high for 2 hours, or low for 4 to 5 hours Can also be made in a regular soup pot on the stove if desired, remove bay leaf. Step 5: Add spinach and cook until wilted, or if using frozen until heated through.

Dish Name: Better Than Olive Garden's Zuppa Toscana
Ingredient Names: mild italian sausage, russet potatoes, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil, yellow onion, garlic cloves, bacon piece, water, chicken base, fresh kale, heavy cream, salt and pepper, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot on medium-high heat add the ground sausage and crushed red pepper flakes. Step 2: Using a spatula, break up the sausage until it is fully cooked through. Step 3: Pour the cooked sausage into a large bowl and set aside In the same pot add the olive oil, chopped onion, and real bacon pieces until the onions become translucent and begin to brown. Step 4: Add garlic and cook for an additional 3 minutes. Step 5: Add 2 cups of water to the pot and stir well to get all the sweet onion flavor from the bottom of the pan. Step 6: Add the chicken concentrate and stir to combine. Step 7: Add the remaining 8 cups of water. Step 8: Add potatoes and cook until fork tender You may wish to add more salt, but be careful because the chicken base is very salty.

Ingredient Names: italian turkey sausage links, broccoli florets, mostaccioli pasta, water, dried basil leaves, fennel seed, pepper, diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic, french onion soup
Instructions: Step 1: Cook sausage in 4-quart dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until brown, drain. Step 2: Stir in remaining ingredients, breaking up tomatoes, heat to boiling. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 4: Cover and cook about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mostaccioli is tender.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic cloves, yellow squash, zucchini, carrot, fresh corn, chicken broth, ditalini, great northern beans, baby spinach, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chop onions. Step 2: Heat oil in dutch oven over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion to pan and saute until softened - about 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Add oregano, basil and garlic, saute about 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in squash, zucchini, carrot and corn. Step 6: Saute until veggies are tender -- about 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir in broth bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer about 20 minutes. Step 8: Add pasta and beans to pan. Step 9: Cook about 10 minutes or until the pasta is tender, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, broccoli florets, low sodium chicken broth, mascarpone cheese, cayenne pepper, fresh chives, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add shallots Saut 3 minutes. Step 3: Add broccoli Saut 1 minutes, add broth, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium-low and cover. Step 5: Simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes, cool slightly.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Italian Wedding Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, chicken breasts, meatballs, escarole, italian pastina, eggs, romano cheese, red pepper, salt, pepper, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Sausage meatball procedure: preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Roll 5 oz Of sausage into miniature meatballs. Step 3: Place on a well-oiled cookie sheet and bake in oven for 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove and let cool. Step 5: Set aside Pastina procedure: bring 6 cups of water to a boil, add 1 lb Pastina. Step 6: Cook until al dente.

Ingredient Names: anchovies, cream of mushroom soup, garlic cloves, whipping cream, half-and-half, real butter
Instructions: Step 1: This is a single batch As our family is enormous, we will do triple or quad batches to feed everyone. Step 2: Melt butter in a big pot. Step 3: Saute garlic and anchovies Anchovies should melt away They add the salty taste to this dish. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients, and cook on med-low for approximately 45 minutes Do not let boil Our family will buy french bread or your favorite italian bread, cut into chunks, and dip it into the soup We usually have a plate of veggies such as cauliflower, broccoli, celery, green peppers and carrots to use for dipping.

Ingredient Names: dried kidney beans, olive oil, garlic clove, onion, canned tomato, shelled peas, fava beans, parsley, celery, carrot, raw potatoes, soup stock, salt & pepper, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dried beans overnight, drain. Step 2: Pour oil into soup pot. Step 3: Add garlic, onion, & vegetables. Step 4: Cover pot & simmer 15 minutes, stirring often. Step 5: Add soaked beans, soup stock, & seasonings. Step 6: Cover & simmer until beans are tender, about 1 1 / 4 hours. Step 7: Add spaghetti or rice, & simmer 15 minutes longer, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Serve hot with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, fennel, celery, italian sausage, garlic cloves, fresh sage, fresh rosemary, dry sherry, chicken stock, cannellini beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, slowly cook onion, fennel and celery in oil until softened. Step 2: Add sausage, garlic and herbs, then cook another 1-2 minute Deglaze with sherry and reduce by half, add the stock. Step 3: Add beans and simmer until very soft.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, diced onions, garlic, celery, carrots, salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh rosemary, chicken broth, cooked chicken breasts, asiago cheese, parmesan cheese, pasta, fresh spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In large pot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Step 2: Add onions and garlic and saute until light brown. Step 3: Lower heat and add celery, carrots, salt and pepper. Step 4: Saute until vegetables are tender. Step 5: Add rosemary and cook briefly. Step 6: Add broth and cooked chicken. Step 7: Stir in asiago and parmesan cheeses. Step 8: Simmer 10 minutes Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper if needed. Step 9: Serve immediately or cool in refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, artichoke hearts, vegetable broth, sour cream, fresh thyme leaves, sun-dried tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Warm the olive oil in a large saucepan and saute the onion and garlic just until they are softened, but not browned. Step 2: Add the artichoke hearts and vegetable broth to the mixture. Step 3: Bring to the boil, then reduce the temperature to a simmer Partially cover the pan and allow to simmer for 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat, and puree the mixture with a hand blender until smooth. Step 5: Return to the saucepan and allow to cool completely. Step 6: After it is cooled, add the sour cream and the thyme. Step 7: Place in the refrigerator, covered, for 3-4 hours before serving. Step 8: When serving, garnish each bowl with sun-dried tomato strips, if desired.

Dish Name: Chilled Canned Or Fresh Pea And Mint Soup
Ingredient Names: fresh peas, butter, onion, milk, chicken stock, mint sprigs, mint, caster sugar, salt, pepper, single cream
Instructions: Step 1: Shell the fresh peas. Step 2: Melt butter in a saucepan and gently saute the onion until it is soft but not brown. Step 3: Remove the onion mixture from the heat and mix in the milk, stock, peas, 2-3 mint sprigs, sugar, salt and pepper. Step 4: Bring to the boil, stirring regularly. Step 5: Simmer, covered for about 30 minutes or until the peas are really tender. Step 6: Let it cool just a little bit, then pure the mixture using a food processor, blender or by rubbing though a fine sieve. Step 7: Add fresh cream to the pure, mix well and then chill for 2 hours. Step 8: Serve chilled, garnished with sprigs of fresh mint.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, celery, garlic, dried lentils, beef broth, frozen chopped spinach
Instructions: Step 1: In large stock pot, heat olive oil and saut onion, celery, and garlic until limp. Step 2: Add lentils and broth, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 1 hour or until lentils are tender, cool slightly. Step 4: Using blender, puree soup in batches. Step 5: Return to stock pot. Step 6: Rinse spinach in colander and squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Step 7: Add spinach to soup, stirring to combine completely. Step 8: Place in non-reactive container and chill, covered, in refrigerator.

Dish Name: Chunky root vegetable soup with cheesy pesto toasts
Ingredient Names: butter, shallots, garlic, white wine, leeks, parsnip, fresh carrot, swede, vegetable stock, mature cheddar, ciabatta, fresh flat-leaf parsley, fresh chives, vegetarian parmesan style cheese, pine nuts, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a large heavy-based saucepan. Add the shallots and cook for 5 mins until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 1 min more. Pour in the wine and simmer until reduced, then add the vegetables and cook for 2-3 mins. Step 2: Pour in the stock, bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for about 20 mins until the vegetables are soft. Meanwhile, to make the pesto, mix all the ingredients together with enough olive oil to make a thickish paste. Season. Step 3: To make the toasts, put the grated cheese in a bowl and mix together with 2-3 tsp of the pesto. Heat grill. Put the ciabatta slices under the grill and toast on both sides. Remove, top with the herby cheese mixture, then grill until melted. Step 4: Season the soup well and serve with the cheesy pesto toasts and remaining pesto, for drizzling.

Ingredient Names: pork fat, boiling potatoes, green cabbage, swiss chard leaf, red onion, garlic, water, red kidney beans, ham hock, tomatoes, elbow macaroni, salt, fresh ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large casserole or soup pot, cook the pork fat over medium-high heat until there is some fat in the bottom of the pot, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 2: Then add the potatoes, cabbage, chard, onion, and garlic until the greens are wilted, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Pour in the water, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, add the beans, ham or smoked bacon, and tomato, and cook until the beans are tender, 2 to 3 hours. Step 4: Add the elbow macaroni and continue to cook until a spoon can stand straight up in the center of the soup, and the pasta is tender--about 15 minutes. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper, drizzle with olive oil, and serve.

Ingredient Names: hot italian sausage, bacon, red onion, garlic, kale, heavy cream, red potatoes, chicken stock, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large soup kettle: 1 Brown sasage and crumble - set aside 2. Step 2: Cut bacon into 1 / 2" strip and cook in kettle - remove put aside 3. Step 3: Drain off most of the fat and saute the onion and garlic in the kettle 4. Step 4: Add the chicken stock and bring to a boil 5.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, carrots, celery, onion, chickpeas, cannellini beans, tomatoes, chicken stock, conchiglie, fresh rosemary, salt and pepper, garlic clove, rosemary, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the the vegetables in the heated oil in a saucepan over a rather low heat. Step 2: Stir often for about 5 minutes, then add the beans. Step 3: Stir well and then mix in the tomatoes. Step 4: Cook, stirring for a few minutes, then add 2 cups of the stock, the rosemary, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Now bring this to a boil. Step 6: Lower the heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour. Step 7: Pour in the rest of the stock and the pasta, bring to a boil. Step 8: Lower the heat and simmer for 7-8 minutes You want your pasta al dente.

Ingredient Names: dried cranberry beans, onion, celery, carrots, pancetta, garlic cloves, tomatoes, parsley, spaghetti, salt, black pepper, garlic clove, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the beans in cold water to cover overnight. Step 2: Drain and place beans in a large saucepan with the onion, celery, and carrots. Step 3: Cover with water, bring to a boil, lower the heat, and simmer until the beans are almost done, about 1 hour. Step 4: Meanwhile, saute the pancetta until it renders its fat. Step 5: Add the garlic cloves and saute. Step 6: Add the tomatoes and parsley and cook for 15 minutes. Step 7: Remove 2 cups of beans from the saucepan and puree them in a food mill or food processor. Step 8: Stir the puree back into the soup. Step 9: Add the tomato mixture and the spaghetti to the soup. Step 10: Taste and season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, celery, garlic clove, white kidney beans, chicken broth, ground black pepper, dried thyme, water, fresh spinach, hot pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat oil. Step 2: Cook onion and celery in oil for 5 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Step 3: Add garlic, and cook for 30 seconds, continually stirring. Step 4: Stir in beans, chicken broth, pepper, thyme and 2 cups water. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and then simmer for 15 minutes With slotted spoon, remove 2 cups of the bean and vegetable mixture from soup and set aside In blender at low speed, blend remaining soup in small batches until smooth, once blended pour soup back into stock pot and stir in reserved beans. Step 6: Bring to a boil, occasionally stirring. Step 7: Stir in spinach and cook 1 minute or until spinach is wilted. Step 8: Stir in lemon juice and pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: leek, chicken broth, potatoes, onion, heavy cream, pepper, salt, dried thyme, celery seed, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to a boil and reduce to medium. Step 2: Add leeks, potatoes, and onion. Step 3: Simmer, covered, 25-30 minutes. Step 4: Add seasonings and cream. Step 5: Simmer 5 minutes more Slightly mash with a potatoe masher to desired consistency. Step 6: Serve with salad and crusty bread A snap to make, but tastes gourmet!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, carrots, garlic cloves, fresh thyme leaves, roasted red peppers, low sodium chicken broth, russet potato, dry white wine, sugar, salt, coarse black pepper, baguette, mascarpone cheese, fresh parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onion, carrots, garlic and thyme and saute till onions are translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the broth, red peppers, potatoes, wine & sugar. Step 4: Bring to a simmer over high heat Decrease heat to medium-low Partially cover and simmer until potatoes are very tender, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes. Step 5: Cool soup slightly. Step 6: Puree soup in a blender or food proccessor taking care with "hot" liquids, season to taste. Step 7: Heat remaining oil in large skillet over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: minced garlic cloves, olive oil, onion, merlot, pasta sauce, half-and-half, frozen cheese tortellini, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: In large stockpot simmer garlic, olive oil, onion and merlot for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add pasta sauce and half n half, cook on medium heat. Step 3: Cook soup until warm, do not allow it to come to a boil or simmer While soup is heating cook tortellini according to pkg directions. Step 4: Add tortellini and spinach to heated soup and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, diced onion, carrot, green pepper, garlic cloves, cannellini beans, vegetable broth, orzo pasta, frozen chopped spinach, fresh parsley, sage, thyme, sea salt, fresh cracked pepper, half-and-half
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy-bottomed saucepan heat the olive oil and saute the onion, carrot, green pepper, and garlic until softened on low-medium heat, about 5-7 minutes. Step 2: Add the beans, broth, orzo, spinach, parsley, sage, thyme, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Simmer for 25 minutes. Step 4: Taste and re-season with salt and pepper if desired, add half and half. Step 5: Bring back up to a simmer. Step 6: Remove from heat and serve with a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and parmesan.

Ingredient Names: dried porcini mushrooms, olive oil, butter, vidalia onion, shallots, garlic, wild mushrooms, chicken stock, fresh thyme, cream, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Soak porcinis in 1 c warm water for 30 minutes, strain and reserve the liquid heat the oil and butter until foaming, then add onion, shallots and garlic and saute for about 5 minutes add fresh mushrooms to the pan and stir until softened. Step 2: Add stock and bring to a boil. Step 3: Add the porcinis, liquid, thyme and salt and pepper. Step 4: Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally Process 3 / 4 of the soup in a blender. Step 5: Add cream and heat through Correct seasonings if necessary and garnish with fresh thyme and cracked black pepper.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, green onion, garlic, zucchini, chicken broth, chicken soup base, canned plum tomatoes, potato, fresh cilantro, fresh basil, buttermilk, whole milk, salt, white pepper, hungarian paprika
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy bottom cooking pot, add olive oil, green onions and garlic and sautee' for 3 minutes. Step 2: Add zucchini, 1 / 2 cup of chicken broth and chicken soup base and cook on medium-high heat for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add tomatoes, diced potatoes and cook for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Step 4: Add cilantro and basil and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Puree' soup in a food processor or blender in batches and return to cooking pot. Step 6: Stir in buttermilk, whole milk, salt and pepper and bring to boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently Adjust seasonings to taste. Step 8: Serve sprinkled with paprika.

Ingredient Names: crusty italian bread, carrots, celery ribs, garlic cloves, olive oil, onion, dry white wine, crushed tomatoes in puree, dried oregano, water, heavy cream, fat free sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cut enough bread into 3 / 4" cubes to measure about 3 cups and arrange in one layer on cookie sheet Toast bread until golden and crisp, 10-15 minutes or more depending on your oven Finely chop carrots, celery, onion and garlic. Step 3: In a heavy 4 to 5 quart pot, cook the vegetables and garlic in olive oil with salt and pepper to taste over moderately low heat, stirring until tender but not browned, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Add wine and boil 3 minutes. Step 5: Add tomatoes, oregano and 1 cup water and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes. Step 6: Remove pot from heat and whisk in heavy cream and sour cream. Step 7: Cool soup for 10 minutes. Step 8: In a blender, puree soup in batches transferring pureed mixture to a large bowl.

Ingredient Names: italian dressing, italian sausage, chicken broth, stir fry vegetables, cannellini beans, italian-style diced tomatoes, macaroni, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat dressing in saucepan on medium heat. Step 2: Add sausage and cook 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally and breaking up sausage. Step 3: Add broth, veggies, beans and tomatoes, bring to boil, stir in macaroni. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium & simmer 8-10 minutes Ladle into 8 bowls and top with cheese.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, orzo pasta, frozen chopped spinach, egg, cheese, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot bring chicken broth to a boil on high heat, stir in orzo. Step 2: Cook approximately 10 minutes until tender but slightly firm. Step 3: Stir in spinach, salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Cook approx 5 minutes. Step 5: Add in beaten egg to soup stirring constantly Immediatly serve in a large bowl or individual bowls, sprinkle with cheese before serving.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, fresh carrot, celery, olive oil, cubetti di pancetta, fresh bay leaf, vegetables, pasta shapes, mixed runner, spring cabbage, pesto, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion, garlic, carrot and celery in the olive oil in a large saucepan until tender but not browned. Scoop out and set aside. Fry the pancetta, if using, you won’t need to add any more oil but keep the heat low until it starts to give off fat. Fry until browned but not too crisp. Tip into a sieve and drain off any excess fat. Put the carrot mixture back into the pan with the pancetta and add the bay leaf, plenty of seasoning and the stock. Bring to a simmer, add the pasta and cook for 5 mins. Step 2: Top and tail the green and runner beans, slice both into lengths that will easily fit on a spoon and add to the pot with the broad beans. Cook for 3 mins, then add the cabbage. Bring back to a simmer and cook for 2 mins. Spoon the pesto onto the top of the soup just before serving and serve with the bread.

Ingredient Names: white sandwich bread, onions, ground beef, ground pork, eggs, parsley, garlic, parmigiano-reggiano, salt, fresh black pepper, olive oil, chicken broth stock, water, passata, canned tomato, italian mixed herbs, garlic powder, red pepper chili flakes, spaghetti, fresh basil leaves, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place the bread and onion in a large bowl. Mix to combine so the onion juice soaks the bread. Step 2: Add all the remaining Meatball ingredients. Use you hands to mix well. Step 3: Roll a slightly heaped tablespoon of mixture into a ball. Repeat with remaining mixture. Should make around 24. Refrigerate meatballs for 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium high heat. Add the meatballs in a single layer and brown all over (still raw inside) - I do this in 2 batches. Remove meatballs onto a plate and set aside. Step 5: If the pot is looking dry, add a touch more olive oil. Add onion and garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken broth, bring to simmer and scrape the bottom of the pot to mix the brown bits into the liquid. Step 7: Add remaining Soup ingredients except spaghetti. Bring to simmer, turn heat down to medium and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, scraping the bottom of the pot. Step 8: Take the lid off and add spaghetti. Use tongs to push it all under the liquid as it starts to soften. Once the spaghetti is submerged, add the meatballs. Cook for around 12 minutes, or until spaghetti is just cooked but still firm (al dente). Remove from stove. Step 9: If using cheese, sprinkle on the surface of the soup after you take it off the stove, put the lid back on and let the heat melt the cheese (~2 minutes). Step 10: Ladle soup, spaghetti and meatballs into bowls. Garnish with basil leaves and serve with Parmigiano-Reggiano, if using.

Dish Name: Italian Sausage and Peppers Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: olive oil, italian sausages, red onions, garlic, sweet red peppers, yellow sweet pepper, sweet orange bell pepper, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan. Step 2: Add onions and garlic and fry till golden brown. Step 3: Add sausages and cook till almost done. Step 4: Add peppers and seasoning. Step 5: Cook until veggies are tender.

Ingredient Names: hillshire farm smoked sausage, onions, olive oil, tomatoes, water, pasta shells, chicken bouillon cube, kidney beans
Instructions: Step 1: In large deep skillet or Dutch oven, over medium-high heat, brown sausage and onions in oil, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add tomatoes with their juice, water, pasta, and boullion, bring to a boil, add beans. Step 3: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until pasta is tender, about 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Ladle into bowls and serve.

Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium chicken broth, potato, onions, fresh carrot, celery, peas, fresh bay leaf, italian seasoning, pepper, shell pasta, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, combined the first nine ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 3: Add the pasta and tomatoes; heat through. Step 4: Discard bay leaf before serving.

Dish Name: Italian White Bean Soup With Greens (Sbd)
Ingredient Names: escarole, chicken broth, garlic, white beans, kosher salt, white pepper, parmesan cheese, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Boil greens for about 5 minutes, just till tender, and then plunge into water to stop cooking. Step 3: Squeeze out as much water as possible and set aside (you can do this step before you make the rest of the soup.). Step 4: Bring broth to simmer in large pot over med-high heat. Step 5: Add garlic and greens, and beans (if using canned, rinse and drain to rid the excess sodium!) Simmer gently for about ten minutes, partially covered. Step 6: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 7: Ladle soup into bowls. Step 8: Pass cheese and pepper flakes at table.

Dish Name: Italian sausage stew with rosemary garlic mash
Ingredient Names: pork sausage, olive oil, carrots, celery, onions, rosemary, garlic, green lentils, tomatoes, stock, potatoes, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the sausages in 1 tbsp oil in a casserole dish until brown. Remove. Tip in the carrots, celery and onion and cook for 10 mins, adding the chopped rosemary and half the garlic for the final min. Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Return the sausages, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 20 mins. Remove the lid and cook for a further 10-15 mins until lentils are soft. Season. Step 2: Meanwhile, boil the potatoes until tender. In another pan, heat the milk, remaining garlic and rosemary until just about to boil, then turn off heat. Drain the potatoes well. Step 3: Sieve the hot milk over the rest of the potatoes and mash with the remaining oil, then season. Serve with the stew.

Ingredient Names: escarole, chicken broth, carrots, tubetti, ground beef, eggs, very onion, plain breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Trim and clean the escarole. Step 2: Stack the leaves and cut them crosswise into 1 inch strips. Step 3: You should have about 4 cups. Step 4: In a large pot, combine the escarole, broth and carrots. Step 5: Bring to a simmer and cook until the escarole is almost tender, about 30 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, mix together the meatball ingredients. Step 7: Shape the mixture into tiny balls, less than 1 inch in diameter. Step 8: When the escarole is cooked, stir in the pasta and return the soup to the simmer. Step 9: Drop the meatballs into the soup. Step 10: Cook over low heat, stirring gently, until the meatballs and pasta are cooked, about 20 minutes. Step 11: Taste for seasoning. Step 12: Serve hot with more grated Parmesan.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, bacon, onions, garlic, tomato, chicken stock broth, water, tomato paste, worcestershire sauce, canned kidney beans, salt, pepper, pasta, parmesan, celery ribs, fresh carrot, zucchini, potato, green beans, baby spinach, parsley, crusty bread for dunking
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over high heat in a very large pot. Step 2: Add bacon, cook until starting to turn golden (~2 min) then add garlic and onion. Step 3: Cook until onion is translucent and bacon is light golden ~ 2minutes. Step 4: Add carrot, celery and zucchini. Stir for 1 minute to coat in flavour. Step 5: Add crushed tomato, chicken stock, water, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, kidney beans, salt and pepper. Step 6: Stir, bring to simmer, then place lid on and adjust heat so it's simmering gently. Step 7: Simmer 20 minutes, then add potato and beans. Step 8: Simmer 5 minutes, then add pasta. Cook for time per pasta packet MINUS 1 1/2 minutes. Step 9: Remove from stove, stir through parmesan and baby spinach. Taste and adjust for salt and pepper. Step 10: Serve, garnished with extra parmesan and a sprinkle of parsley if desired. Warm crusty bread on the side would certainly be the cherry on top!

Dish Name: Quick & Easy Tortellini Soup With Spinach and Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, tomatoes, garlic, cheese-filled egg tortellini, spinach, onions, red wine, oregano, fresh basil, parmesan cheese, ground black pepper
