Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, combine all ingredients except the tortellini and parmesan cheese, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes. Step 3: While the tomato and spinach mixture simmers, prepare tortellini according to the package. Step 4: Do not overcook- I prefer to undercook the pasta by a minute or two so it stays firm, drain. Step 5: Add tortellini to the tomato and spinach mixture and simmer for another 5 minutes. Step 6: Serve the soup in bowls, topped with the parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: very tomatoes, golden sugar, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, onions, fresh carrot, thyme bay leaves, garlic, sundried, vegetable stock, mascarpone cheese, extra-virgin olive oil, thyme
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 170C/150C fan/gas 3 - 4. Bring a pan of water to the boil and get a bowl of iced water at the ready. Cut a small slit in the bottom of each tomato then plunge into boiling water in batches for 10 secs then lift out into the iced water. Drain and peel the tomatoes then halve and place on a baking tray cut side up. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and the sugar. Drizzle with the vinegar and 1 tbsp of the olive oil. Roast the tomatoes for 1hr until semi-dried and set aside. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil in a large saucepan and cook the onion and carrot gently for about 10 mins until very soft. Add the tied herbs and garlic and cook for a minute more. Stir in the tomato purée then tip in the roasted tomatoes and any juices from the tray. Pour over the stock and season with salt and pepper. Bring to the boil then turn the heat down and simmer for 10 mins. Step 3: Remove the tied herbs and discard. Add the mascarpone then take off the heat, blitz well with a hand blender. If you want a smoother soup then it can be sieved but this isn’t really necessary. The soup can now be cooled and kept for 3 days in the fridge or frozen for up to 1 month. For a dinner party, serve the soup with a sprig of thyme and a drizzle of good quality olive oil.

Ingredient Names: strong vegetable stock, spinach ricotta tortellini, spring greens, peas, pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the stock to the boil in a large pan. Tip in the pasta and cook following pack instructions, throwing in the spring greens and peas and pesto (reserving a little to serve) with 1-2 mins to go. Step 2: When the vegetables are tender, pasta is cooked and broth is piping hot, spoon into bowls. Top with a dollop of remaining pesto, a good grind of black pepper and serve.

Ingredient Names: virgin olive oil, onions, water, zucchini, fresh carrot, canned cannellini beans, celery, fresh basil, oregano, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, fluid canned plum tomatoes, garlic, ditalini
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chopped onion and sauté for 4 minutes or until just lightly browned. Step 3: Add water, zucchini, carrots, canellini beans, celery, basil, oregano salt, pepper, tomatoes and garlic. Step 4: Bring to boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer on medium-low heat for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add macaroni, cover and cook an additional 10 minutes. Step 6: Adjust spices to suit your taste, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, unsmoked lardons, carrots, celery, potato, garlic, tomatoes, vegetable stock, sage leaves, cabbage leaves, haricot bean, parsley, crusty bread, pesto
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large pan, add the onion and lardons or bacon and fry for about 5 mins until the onion is starting to brown. Tip in the carrots, celery, potato and garlic, stir well and cook for a few minutes. Step 2: Add the tomatoes, stock and sage, and bring to the boil, stirring. Reduce heat to simmer and cook partly covered for 30 mins, stirring in the cabbage after 15 mins. Drain and rinse the beans and add to the pan with the parsley. Season and serve with pesto croûtes, see right, or crusty bread. Step 3: For the pesto croûtes: Cut 3-4 slices of crusty bread into chunks, about 2cm thick. Tip into an ovenproof pan. Mix the olive oil and pesto, then add to the bread, tossing it with your hands until the croûtes are evenly coated. Bake in a moderate oven for about 10 mins until crisp.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, lemon rind, arborio rice, chicken broth, fresh asparagus, spinach, nutmeg, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add onions and saute for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add rind and cook 2 minutes more add rice and cook 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in chicken broth, bring to boil. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in asparagus, spinach, nutmeg. Step 7: Cook for 2 minutes until asparagus is tender. Step 8: Ladle into serving bowls, sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese, serve.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, all-purpose flour, fast rising yeast, sugar, salt, water, olive oil, pizza sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, five cheese blend, italian herb seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Mix batter ingredients in a 9-1 / 2-inch deep dish pie plate that has been coated with cooking spray. Step 2: Top dough with the pizza sauce Evenly distribute fresh mozzarella slices on sauce and top with shredded cheese. Step 3: Sprinkle with italian herb seasoning. Step 4: Bake by placing in a cold oven. Step 5: Set temperature to 350f bake for 30 minutes or until done Proceed as directed above.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, warm water, sugar, semolina, extra virgin olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the salt into the warm water and pour into the bread machine pan Next, add the olive oil, flour, sugar and the yeast last If necessary, add 1 / 2 teaspoon ascorbic acid to help the yeast feed. Step 2: Set the bread machine to a 2 lb size and white light, white medium, white dark, whole wheat or french settings Push start and come back in 3 1 / 3 to 4 hours:-).

Dish Name: 15 Minute Creamy Sun Tomato Basil Cashew Pasta
Ingredient Names: roasted cashews, garlic cloves, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, grape tomatoes, fresh basil, fresh oregano, fresh parmesan cheese, crushed red pepper flakes, pepper, pappardelle pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil In the bowl of a food processor add the cashews and process 1 - 2 minutes or until the cashews start to become powdery. Step 2: Add the garlic and process another minute. Step 3: Add the sun-dried tomatoes and 1 / 2 cup of grape tomatoes and pulse until the sauce is a thick paste and red in color. Step 4: Add the basil and pulse until finely chopped and combined. Step 5: Drop the pasta in the boiling water and boil according to package directions Just before draining the pasta use a heat safe glass measuring cup and scoop out 1 1 / 2 cups of boiling pasta water. Step 6: Drain the pasta With the food processor running slowly stream in the hot boiling pasta water until the paste becomes a sauce Be careful not to add too much water all at once so you don't end up with a thinner sauce than you want.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, water, bay leaves, dried oregano leaves, ground marjoram, salt, pepper, tofu, mozzarella cheese, cottage cheese, dried parsley, fresh spinach, lasagna noodle, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Bring spaghetti sauce and water to a boil. Step 3: Add next 5 seasonings if desired, and reduce heat to a simmer While sauce is simmering, combine tofu, mozzarella, cottage cheese and parsley in a large mixing bowl and stir Assemble the lasagna as follows: spray the bottom of two 13"x9"x2" casserole pans with pam and spoon in just enough sauce to cover the bottom place a layer of noodles on top of the sauce spread 1 / 4 of the cheese mixture evenly over the noodles in each pan sprinkle 1 / 4 of the spinach over the cheese pour 1 / 4 of the sauce evenly over the top. Step 4: Repeat layers ending with sauce, and top with parmesan cheese. Step 5: Cover tightly with aluminum foil, and bake at 350f for 1 hour.

Dish Name: 3 Cheese Spinach Roasted Red Pepper Calzones
Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, ricotta cheese, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese, frozen chopped spinach, garlic cloves, red peppers, prosciutto, fresh basil, nutmeg, olive oil, salt and pepper, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Roll the dough to 12x12-inch square and then cut into 4 equal squares. Step 3: In a medium bowl, mix all remaining ingredients except egg and water. Step 4: Place filling a little off center on each dough square. Step 5: Wrap dough around filling by bringing one side over to meet other, forming a triangle Round off corners to form a semi-circle and press edges with fork, sealing. Step 6: Place on baking sheet and brush top of each calzone with egg wash. Step 7: Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Step 8: Remove from oven and let set about 7 minutes, serve hot!

Dish Name: 3 Cheese Tortellini Roasted Pepper Zucchini Spinach
Ingredient Names: cheese tortellini, extra virgin olive oil, onion, zucchini, roasted red pepper, baby spinach, fresh tomato, fresh ground black pepper, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Cook tortellini according to directions on package While tortellini cooks: Saut onion in oil for 5 minutes in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add zucchini and pepper, cook for 3 minutes. Step 4: Season with salt & crushed red pepper, if desired. Step 5: Add red peppers and baby spinach and saut for 1 additional minute. Step 6: Drain tortellini and mix with sauce in skillet. Step 7: Stir in tomatoes and serve Parmesan cheese for serving, if desired.

Ingredient Names: frozen spinach, cottage cheese, egg yolk, salt, pepper, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodle, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine spinach, cottage cheese, egg yolk, pepper, salt, 1 / 4 cup tomato sauce, and 2 cups mozzarella cheese. Step 2: Layer lasagna in greased pan the following manner: sauce, noodles, spinach mixture, sauce, mozzarella cheese. Step 3: Top layer: noodles, spinach mixture, parmesan cheese, sauce, mozzarella cheese. Step 4: Bake covered for 50 minutes in a 375 degree oven, then uncover and cook for an additional 5-10 minutes or until top is brown.

Ingredient Names: italian style breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, fresh italian parsley, dried oregano, salt and pepper, cayenne pepper, half-and-half, ziti pasta, unsalted butter, onion, garlic, flour, provolone cheese, bel paese cheese, fontina cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 375. Step 2: Mix first 4 ingredients with a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl, set aside. Step 3: Cook pasta al dente, drain and rinse under cold water, set pasta aside. Step 4: Heat 4 tablespoons of the butter, add onions and saute, stirring until onions are translucent. Step 5: Add garlic, stir until garlic is fragrant, add flour. Step 6: Lower heat and cook, stirring frequently. Step 7: Add half and half a 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring after each addition, until sauce thickens.

Ingredient Names: linguine, zucchini, cheese, tomatoes, garlic cloves, parsley, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta. Step 2: Add zucchini during last 2 minutes of cooking. Step 3: Drain and then return to saucepan. Step 4: Add half the cheese to pasta, mix. Step 5: Combine tomatoes, garlic, parsley and basil. Step 6: Stir into pasta mixture. Step 7: Garnish with remaining cheese. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: half-and-half, water, salt, cornmeal, unsalted butter, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan bring the half-and-half and the water to a boil. Step 2: Add the salt and then gradually add the polenta while stirring. Step 3: Reduce the heat to maintain a simmer, stirring constantly The polenta should be smooth and large bubbles will pop on the surface. Step 4: Cook until very thick but not stiff, about 5 to 7 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and add butter, cheese and pepper. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: A New Yorker's Real Italian Cheesecake
Ingredient Names: graham crackers, sugar, butter, ricotta cheese, cream cheese, eggs, flour, sour cream, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 2: Wrap the outside of a 10-inch springform pan with foil to prevent water from seeping in while baking. Step 3: Mix sugar, crumbs, and melted butter together well to form crust. Step 4: Press this mixture into the bottom of the springform pan and up the sides until you run out. Step 5: Bake crust for about 7-10 minutes or until golden brown. Step 6: Cool on wire rack while preparing the batter With a mixer, cream together ricotta cheese, cream cheese, flour, and sugar until very smooth. Step 7: Mix in the eggs one at a time, blend well but do not over mix the batter! Step 8: Stir in the sour cream and vanilla by hand Pour mixture into cooled crust.

Dish Name: A Refreshing Salad To Usher In Summer
Ingredient Names: watermelon, mint leaf, feta, limes, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove skin, seed and the white part from the watermelon. Step 2: Cut into bite size pieces. Step 3: Place watermelon in a serving bowl. Step 4: Drizzle lime juice over and season with a little salt and freshly ground black pepper. Step 5: Add feta, mint and lime zest. Step 6: Garnish with whole sprigs of mint A rich blue-veined cheese.

Dish Name: A Simple Cherry Tomato And Mozzarella Salad
Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, salt, fresh basil, olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl This will keep in the refrigerator for about two days.

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, white bread flour, salt, dried yeast, poppy seed, coarse sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the water and olive oil in the bread machine pan, sprinkle over the flour, make sure you cover the water completely. Step 2: Add the salt in corner of the pan, make a small dent in the flour and add the yeast Select the basic dough setting and press start Ligtly oil two or more baking sheets. Step 3: When dough cycle has finished, remove from the machine and knock it back on a lightly floured surface. Step 4: Roll out into a rectangle of approx 9x8 inch. Step 5: Cut into three 8 inch long strips, cut the strips widthways into ten. Step 6: Roll and stretch each piece to 12 inch approx if you like them crispy, make them shorter / thicker if you like more bread structure If using the poppy seeds or salt, scatter some on the work area and roll them into the dough, this is best done halfway through the rolling process, later on they do not want to stick Be careful with the salt, its quickly too much.

Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, eggplant, courgettes, red onion, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fresh ground black pepper, dry oregano, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Chop all vegetables into large pieces. Step 3: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Step 4: Place in an oven safe tray, be sure vegetables are evenly coated with oil and vinegar Roast for 50 minutes, or until veggies start to char. Step 5: Serve at room temperature for tapas Or combine with freshly cooked pasta and crumbled feta on top.

Ingredient Names: acini di pepe pasta, extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, kosher salt, grape tomatoes, pine nuts, radicchio, red onion, basil leaves, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Cook the pasta for about 6 minutes or until tender. Step 3: Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Step 4: Toss the pasta with the olive oil, red wine vinegar, and salt. Step 5: Fold in the tomatoes, pine nuts, radicchio, onion, and basil. Step 6: Sprinkle with the feta cheese. Step 7: Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: squash, minute brown rice, frozen mixed vegetables, vegetable stock cube, water, pepper, chinese five spice powder
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the squash and cut into 1" cubes. Step 2: Put them under the broiler to toast. Step 3: Boil the rice with liquid and flavoring. Step 4: Heat up a large fry pan and scold the mixed veg on it with no liquid. Step 5: When the squash is browned to your taste put it in the microwave with a couple of spoons of water and zap until tender- takes about 4 5 minutes While the squash is zapping mix the cooked rice in with the mixed veg. Step 6: Stir in whatever seasoning you feel like using It should now be on a low heat- just to keep everything warm. Step 7: When the squash is done toss it in and mix it up- and serve.

Ingredient Names: chocolate ice cream, bittersweet chocolate pieces, brewed espresso, dark rum
Instructions: Step 1: Divide ice cream among 4 dessert bowls or coffee cups Spoon 2 tablespoons each of chocolate, espresso and rum over the ice cream and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Aglio Olio E Peperoncino Garlic Oil And Chilli Pasta Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, red chile, garlic clove, cooked spaghetti, flat leaf parsley, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-low heat. Step 2: Add the chili and garlic, and gently fry for about 1 minute, until the garlic is just beginning to colour. Step 3: Take care not to let it burn. Step 4: Add the cooked pasta and the parsley, and season to taste. Step 5: Toss well and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Albicocche Al Forno Baked Apricots With Amaretti
Ingredient Names: apricots, amaretti cookies, sugar, egg yolk, amaretto, white wine, butter, blanched almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Please If you decide to make it, please have some extra apricots ready. Step 2: Preheat oven to 180c. Step 3: Put amaretti cookies into a small bowl and pour the amaretto over it. Step 4: Wash apricots and cut them in halves, discard the stone. Step 5: Using a spoon, take out some of the fruit flesh without hurting the skin Roughly chop the fruit flesh. Step 6: Add sugar, egg yolk and chopped apricot flesh to the amaretti cookies and mix While mixing, crush the cookies with a spoon.

Ingredient Names: butter, cream cheese, garlic powder, milk, parmesan cheese, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a medium, non-stick saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add cream cheese and garlic powder, stirring with wire whisk until smooth. Step 3: Add milk, a little at a time, whisking to smooth out lumps. Step 4: Stir in parmesan and pepper. Step 5: Remove from heat when sauce reaches desired consistency Sauce will thicken rapidly, thin with milk if cooked too long. Step 6: Toss with hot pasta to serve.

Ingredient Names: mango, carrot juice, pineapple juice, fresh orange juice, fresh lemon juice, ice cube, mineral water, orange slice, maraschino cherry
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mango pieces in a blender, add the other ingredients, except the water. Step 2: Blend until smooth. Step 3: Fill a goblet with ice and pour blended mixture in until the glass until is 3 / 4 full. Step 4: Add the water to dilute the mixture a little, stir. Step 5: Garnish with a slice of orange and a maraschino cherry. Step 6: Serve with a straw.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, ground aniseed, unbleached all-purpose flour, salt, baking powder, toasted almond
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, beat butter, sugar and eggs on med Speed for 1 minute. Step 2: Add vanilla and anise seeds and beat until combined. Step 3: Mix in almonds, coarsely chopped. Step 4: Stir in combined flour, salt and baking powder. Step 5: Shape the dough in a 16-inch long log on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet Flatten the log until about 2-inches thick. Step 6: Bake the log for 25 minutes in a 350f preheated oven. Step 7: Cool for 10 minutes. Step 8: Using a serrated knife, cut into 1-inch thick slices.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, eggs, baking powder, salt, vanilla, almonds, dried cranberries
Instructions: Step 1: Pour flour into large mixing bowl. Step 2: Make a well in the center and place sugar, 3 eggs, all yolks, baking powder, salt, and vanilla into well Work the flour into the ingredients in the well until smooth. Step 3: Knead in almonds and cranberries throughly for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Grease and flour 2 baking sheets that are at least 15 inches long. Step 5: Divide dough in half. Step 6: Roll each piece of dough on floured surface into 2-1 / 2 inch wide place the logs 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheets. Step 7: Beat remaining egg white and brush over tops of logs, heat oven to 350f, bake 50 minutes.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, baking powder, lemon zest, salt, unblanched whole almonds, crystallized ginger, eggs, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, 3 / 4 cup sugar, baking powder, lemon zest, salt, almonds and ginger. Step 3: In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and vanilla. Step 4: Stir into flour mixture. Step 5: Transfer dough to a lightly floured work surface. Step 6: Knead until smooth. Step 7: Divide dough in half. Step 8: Shape into two logs, each about 1 inch high and 3 inches wide. Step 9: Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Step 10: Sprinkle with remaining sugar.

Ingredient Names: penne, frozen peas, blanched almond, salt, lemon, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil a large pot of salted water, and cook pasta according to directions. Step 2: When there are about 2 minutes left on pasta, add one of the packages of peas. Step 3: Drain the pasta except for about 1 cup of water, and then return the pasta and water to the pot. Step 4: In a food processor grind the almonds. Step 5: Now add the lemon zest and juice to the to almonds, along with the remaining package of peas, and the salt Process again You might have to scrape it down the sides after a minute to make sure it mixes evenly If the taste is too strong, add more peas. Step 6: Add the olive oil and process again. Step 7: Now add the the sauce to the pasta, tossing it well and adding water as needed.

Ingredient Names: peaches, amaretti cookies, superfine sugar, butter, egg yolk, fresh lemon rind, sliced almonds, light cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Scoop a little flesh from center of each peach half, and put in a bowl. Step 2: Add the cookie crumbs, sugar, and 2 tablespoons softened butter, yolk, lemon rind, beat until smooth. Step 3: Divide the mixture among the peach halves, evenly-- shaping the mixture into a'mound' shape. Step 4: Top with flaked almonds if you desire to, and dot with remaining tablespoon of butter. Step 5: Arrange in a buttered ovenproof dish and bake for 25-35 mins. Step 6: Serve warm or cold with light cream.

Ingredient Names: bread, butter, cabbage, ground nutmeg, fresh ground black pepper, salt, vegetable broth, fontina cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Step 3: Spread the bread cubes evenly in a 9"x13" casserole dish or 2 quart ovenproof dish If the cubes aren't dry, toast them quickly in the oven. Step 4: Melt 3 tbsp of the butter and drizzle over the bread, set aside. Step 5: When the water boils, blanch the cabbage just until tender, about 2 minutes, drain well. Step 6: Spread cabbage over the bread. Step 7: Melt the remaining 2-3 tbsp butter and stir in nutmeg, pepper, and salt.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, olive oil, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, tomatoes, heavy cream, basil chiffonade, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel each eggplant, leaving 1" of skin unpeeled at the top & bottom. Step 2: Slice the eggplant thinly lengthwise, about 1 / 4" thick Evenly sprinkle each slice with salt & lay out for 30 minutes on a sheet pan fitted with a wire rack. Step 3: Rinse with cold water & roll in paper towels. Step 4: Slice the pieces into thin fettucine-like strips. Step 5: Heat the oil in a large saute pan over a medium heat. Step 6: Add the garlic & crushed red pepper, & cook until garlic is golden & aromatic. Step 7: Add th eggplant 'pasta' & toss to coat. Step 8: Add the tomatoes & cook for 3 minutes. Step 9: Add the cream & increase the heat to thicken the sauce.

Ingredient Names: peaches, red currant jelly, amaretti cookies
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Place the peaches cut side up in a 7 by 11 inch baking dish. Step 3: Spoon 1 teaspoon red currant jelly into each hollow. Step 4: Spoon 1 crushed amaretti cookie into each hollow. Step 5: Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes or until tender.

Ingredient Names: fresh fruit, amaretto, cream cheese, eggs, milk, butter, sour cream, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the fruit with one tablespoon amaretto and set aside This is the topping. Step 2: Beat together the cream cheese and 2 tablespoons of the amaretto until smooth. Step 3: Set aside This is the filling. Step 4: Whisk the eggs, milk and remaining 2 tablespoons amaretto in a small bowl until frothy. Step 5: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a medium saute or omelet pan over high heat Coat the pan with butter. Step 6: When the foam subsides, pour half the egg mixture into the pan Swirl to distribute to eggs.

Ingredient Names: garlic, olive oil, butter, mayonnaise, dried oregano, dried basil, parsley flakes, salt, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, italian bread
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Take a piece of foil and place whole garlic cloves in it, coating with a generous amount of olive oil, wrap tightly. Step 3: Bake until done, 20 min to 1 / 2 hour Cloves will be done when sweet smelling, soft and golden brown Split bread lengthwise. Step 4: Remove excess dough. Step 5: Mash roasted garlic with all other ingredients except cheeses. Step 6: Spread cut surfaces of bread with butter mixture. Step 7: Sprinkle with parmesan and layer bottom half with mozzarella.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, diced tomatoes with basil and garlic, black olives, olive juice, fresh parsley, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Directions - Cook 1 angel hair pasta according to package directions and drain About 5 minutes and make sure your water is boiling with a touch of salt and some olive oil so it doesn't stick And rinse pasta immediately with cool water so it doesn't continue cooking! Step 2: In a medium saucepot, heat diced tomatoes with basil and garlic, olives and olive liquid, and crushed red pepper to taste over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until hot. Step 3: Season with salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste. Step 4: Place pasta in a large serving bowl. Step 5: Add tomato mixture and 1 / 4 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley. Step 6: Toss together with tongs and serve immediately garnished with shredded parmesan cheese, if desired Please.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta In Garlic Sauce
Ingredient Names: capellini, olive oil, fresh parsley, garlic, parmesan cheese, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta as directed on package. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Saute parsley and garlic in oil. Step 4: Drain pasta well and mix with garlic mixture, top with cheese. Step 5: Serve with pepper.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Creamy Asparagus Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, garlic, vermouth, fresh basil, flat leaf parsley, fresh oregano, cream, sweet pepper, parmesan cheese, angel hair pasta, asparagus
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and add the garlic and shallots, cook until tender. Step 2: Add vermouth and herbs. Step 3: Simmer uncovered for about 5 minutes until the liquid is almost all evaporated. Step 4: Add cream and peppers and simmer about 5 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the heat and stir in parmesan. Step 6: Steam the asparagus until just tender and add to the sauce. Step 7: Cook the angel hair pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Step 8: Drain the pasta and add it to the asparagus sauce. Step 9: Toss it through gently until well combined.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Creamy Mushroom Sauce
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, sliced mushrooms, onion, butter, cream cheese, salt, pepper, milk, chives
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, for sauce, in a medium saucepan cook the mushrooms and onion in the butter until vegetables are tender. Step 3: Stir in cream cheese, salt and pepper. Step 4: Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted Gradually stir in milk and chives, heat through. Step 5: Pour sauce over pasta, toss to coat. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Lemon Garlic And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, fresh basil, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, dry white wine, fresh lemon juice, tomatoes, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in several quarts of salted water. Step 2: Place it in a large serving bowl, add the basil and parmesan cheese and toss to mix While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet and saute the garlic for a minute or so until it just begins to change color. Step 3: Add the wine and cook until it has been reduced by about half. Step 4: Stir in the lemon juice and tomatoes and remove the sauce from heat until the pasta is ready. Step 5: Pour lemon-tomato sauce over pasta mixture, add salt and pepper to taste and toss to mix. Step 6: Serve with extra parmesan on the side, if desired.

Ingredient Names: pine nuts, clarified butter, heavy whipping cream, butter, ground nutmeg, salt, fresh ground white pepper, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Toast pine nuts slowly in a skillet, watching carefully not to burn. Step 2: Remove from skillet when nuts are tan in color. Step 3: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, drain. Step 4: Combine heavy cream, clarified butter, 2 1 / 3 tablespoons butter, nutmeg, salt and pepper in a saucepan, heat thoroughly. Step 5: Add pasta to the heated sauce. Step 6: Let sauce reduce to a creamy consistency. Step 7: Top with nuts and serve.

Dish Name: Angel Hair Pasta With Simple Garlic Basil
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, dry white wine, lemon, tomatoes, sea salt, angel hair pasta, fresh basil, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil over high heat. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the olive oil up a large saute pan over medium heat. Step 3: Once warm add the garlic and cook until it just begins to brown -- too long or too high and the garlic will burn. Step 4: Remove the pan from the heat and deglaze by pouring in the wine. Step 5: Return the pan to the heat and cook for a few minutes The wine should reduce by about half. Step 6: Add in lemon juice, chopped tomato, and sea salt to taste. Step 7: Stir once or twice then remove the pan from the heat again and set it aside to wait for the pasta. Step 8: Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook until desired tenderness, following package directions. Step 9: Drain, then add the cooked pasta to the pan with the garlic & tomato mixture, along with the basil and some freshly ground pepper.

Ingredient Names: garlic, olive oil, diced tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried basil, angel hair pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Open the can of tomatoes Do not drain, but dump the whole thing in a non-metallic bowl. Step 2: Stir in the balsamic vinegar, black pepper, basil, and salt if you really think you need it Most canned tomatoes have enough salt for this, and if you're using no-salt tomatoes, its probably because you're not supposed to have the salt So drop the salt shaker, buddy. Step 3: Let the tomatoes, et al, stand about 10 minutes Saut garlic in olive oil until translucent Do not brown. Step 4: Remove skillet from the burner, leaving garlic and oil in pan, set aside.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, salt, olive oil, onion, celery ribs, green pepper, garlic cloves, green olives, capers, salt and pepper, sugar, red wine vinegar, tomato sauce, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place eggplant in a colander in the sink and sprinkle lightly with salt. Step 2: Let sit for 2 hours and rinse. Step 3: Heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil in large skillet over medium heat and saute eggplant until it is soft and translucent, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Remove from skillet with slotted spoon and reserve. Step 5: Heat remaining 1 / 4 cup olive oil in skillet, then saute onion, celery, green pepper, and garlic until soft and translucent, about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add reserved eggplant, olives, capers, salt and pepper to taste, sugar, vinegar, sauce and red pepper flakes. Step 7: Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Let cool, then refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, tomato paste, dried parsley, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic, salt, black pepper, olive oil, onion, red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomato sauce and paste, parsley, oregano, basil, salt and pepper. Step 2: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil in a large saucepan until transparent, but do not brown. Step 3: Add the tomato sauce blend and the red wine. Step 4: Simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Step 5: Stir occasionally.

Dish Name: Ann's Almond Chocolate Ice Cream Dairy Free
Ingredient Names: almond milk, vanilla extract, amaretto, egg yolks, semisweet chocolate, slivered almonds, chocolate-covered almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor or mixer beat the egg yolks until light and fluffy Gradually pour the hot almond milk into whipped egg yolk mixture making sure you keep whisking constantly so the eggs don't curdle. Step 2: Place the bowl over a saucepan of simmering water and, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, cook until the custard thickens enough that it coats the back of a spoon Immediately remove the custard from the heat and continue to stir the custard for a few minutes so it does not overcook At this point stir in the chocolate till melted, vanilla extract and the amaretto. Step 3: Cover and let cool to room temperature and then refrigerate the custard until it is completely cold. Step 4: Transfer the cold custard to the container of your ice cream machine and process according to the manufacturer's instructions Just before removing ice cream add toasted nut to mix inches then transfer the ice cream to a chilled container and store in the freezer If the ice cream becomes too hard place in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes before serving so it can soften. Step 5: Garnish with chocolate covered almonds.

Dish Name: Antipasto Of Asparagus With Freshly Grated Parmigiano Cheese
Ingredient Names: asparagus, red leaf lettuce, cherry tomatoes, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, extra virgin olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In wide skillet, place asparagus, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Step 2: Cook until crisp-tender, about 4 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain and set aside to cool On platter, arrange lettuce, and when asparagus stalks are cool, arrange them on top in center with all of the spears pointing in one direction Scatter tomatoes about 5 minutes and sprinkle with cheese, olive oil and salt.

Ingredient Names: water, tomato juice, long grain white rice, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, artichoke hearts, roasted red peppers, black olives, parsley, lemon juice, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water, tomato juice, rice, basil, oregano, and salt in a 2 to 3 qt Saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, stirring once or twice. Step 3: Reduce heat and cover. Step 4: Let simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Step 5: Add the artichokes, red peppers, olives, parsley, lemon juice, and black pepper. Step 6: Cook 5 minutes more, or until thoroughly heated, top with cheese.

Ingredient Names: roasted red peppers, garlic clove, fresh ground black pepper, marinated artichoke hearts, focaccia bread, goat cheese, black olive paste, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Combine red peppers, garlic, black pepper and 2 tbs Reserved artichoke marinade in mixing bowl. Step 2: Toss to coat Split focaccia or ciabatta loaves in half horizontally using a serrated knife. Step 3: Brush insides with some remaining artichoke marinade. Step 4: Spread goat cheese on bottom halves and black olive paste on top halves. Step 5: Layer red pepper mixture, artichokes and arugula over goat cheese Replace bread tops. Step 6: Using serrated knife, cut each loaf into 4 portions.

Ingredient Names: navy beans, red bell pepper, artichoke hearts, red onion, kalamata olive, hearts of palm, fresh parsley, mint leaf, basil, extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all vegetable and herb ingredients in a bowl, mix well. Step 2: Toss with the vinegar, olive oil, salt and pepper. Step 3: Refrigerate several hours, mixing occasionally to blend flavors.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, carrots, broccoli florets, olive, extra virgin olive oil, white wine vinegar, fresh parsley, dry oregano, dried thyme, crushed red pepper flakes, provolone cheese, lettuce, salami
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes, in lightly salted water, until almost tender, add carrots during last three minutes. Step 2: Drain and cool slightly Quarter the potatoes. Step 3: In a large ziplock bag or a large bowl combine the potatoes, carrots, broccoli and olives. Step 4: Set aside ---------marinade------------ Combine oil, vinegar, parsley, oregano, thyme and red pepper. Step 5: Whisk until well mixed. Step 6: Pour 3 / 4 of the marinade over the vegetable mixture close bag and place in refrigerator In another bag put in the cheese and pour the remaining marinade over the cheese, seal bag and refrigerate.

Dish Name: Aoc's Long Cooked Cavolo Nero Tuscan Kale
Ingredient Names: cavolo nero, olive oil, white onion, rosemary, dried arbol chile, garlic cloves, salt, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch the cavolo nero in a large pot of salted, boiling water just until softened slightly, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 2: Drain the cavolo nero and immediately place it in a bowl of ice water to cool. Step 3: Drain again and set aside. Step 4: In a large, heavy-bottom saucepan heated over medium-high heat, add the olive oil, onions, rosemary and chile de rbol Gently saut for 2 minutes, then add the garlic and season with one-fourth teaspoon salt Continue to cook until the onions are transparent and just beginning to color, an additional 8 to 10 minutes. Step 5: Stir the cavolo nero into the pan and cook over medium heat, stirring often, for 30 to 40 minutes As it cooks, the cavolo nero will turn a deep dark green, almost black color, and the texture will go from soft to almost a little crisp from caramelizing on the bottom of the pan This is good and will enhance the flavor If the cavolo nero becomes too dry, add a little stock or water to moisten the bottom of the pan.

Ingredient Names: whole grain bread, honey mustard, apples, mild cheddar cheese, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat panini press on medium heat Lightly spread honey mustard evenly over each slice of bread. Step 2: Layer apple slices and cheese over 4 slices of bread, using about apple and 2 ounces of cheese for each sandwich. Step 3: Top each with remaining bread slices Lightly coat panini press with cooking spray(or coat skillet. Step 4: Grill each sandwich for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese has melted and bread has toasted. Step 5: Remove from pan and allow to cool slightly before serving Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: unsweetened apple juice, mint leaves, unsweetened applesauce, sugar, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix apple juice and mint leaves and allow to combine overnight in refrigerator. Step 2: Strain mint leaves out of apple juice. Step 3: Place a shallow metal pan in freezer. Step 4: In a nonreactive saucepan, combine applesauce, mint flavored apple juice, sugar, lemon juice and salt. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered about 20 minutes. Step 6: Cool to room temperature. Step 7: Pour apple mixture into chilled pan, return to freezer. Step 8: Stir every 20 minutes until it thickens into coarse crystals, about 1 hour. Step 9: Stir granita and mound into small cups.

Ingredient Names: whole milk ricotta cheese, heavy whipping cream, splenda sugar substitute, rum extract, apple
Instructions: Step 1: Slice apple and set aside in bowl Beat on med-high, ricotta cheese, heavy cream, splenda and extract till very well combined Pour over apple and enjoy! Step 2: Makes 1 or 2 servings.

Dish Name: Arrosto Insalata Di Cavolfiore Italian Cauliflower Salad
Ingredient Names: anchovies, black olives, capers, cauliflower, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, herbs, olive oil, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Toss cauliflower, peppers and garlic with just enough olive oil to coat and season with pepper and herbs Can salt but take care because the anchovies, olives, and capers have salt Roast on a cookie sheet pan until crisp-tender about 20 minutes. Step 3: Cool about 20 minutes to room temperature Roughly chop the anchovies, olives and capers. Step 4: Stir in the oil and vinegar. Step 5: Pour over the roasted veggies.

Dish Name: Artichoke And Broccoli Frittata Crustless Quiche
Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, marinated artichoke hearts, fresh broccoli florets, garlic cloves, onion, salt, ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, fresh dill, breadcrumbs, sharp cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Chop the artichoke hearts coarsely. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a heavy 10-inch oven-safe cast iron pan over medium flame. Step 4: Add onions and cook until they are translucent. Step 5: Add garlic and broccoli. Step 6: Saute until the onions have begun to brown and the broccoli is cooked through but still crisp, remove from heat. Step 7: In a large bowl, combine eggs, herbs and spices and milk. Step 8: Whisk until well beaten. Step 9: Add parmesan, breadcrumbs, artichokes, and half of the cheddar cheese.

Ingredient Names: garlic, onion, pepperoncini peppers, olive oil, dry white wine, plum tomatoes, marinated artichoke hearts, kalamata olive, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet cook garlic, onion and peperoncini in oil over moderately-low heat, stirring, until onion is softened, add wine and boil 3-5 minutes, or until wine is almost evaporated. Step 2: Add tomatoes and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes, or until the sauce is thickened. Step 3: Stir in artichokes and olives and simmer sauce for 5 minutes and stir in parsley and season to taste Enough for 1 lb of pasta, such as penne.

Ingredient Names: artichoke heart, pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, parmesan cheese, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh tarragon leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Pulse the first 7 ingredients together in a food processor Stir in the tarragon and season to taste with more salt and pepper, if needed Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, red bell pepper, artichoke heart, olive oil, onion, arborio rice, dry white wine, parmesan cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat broth to near boil and keep hot in saucepan. Step 2: Cook bell pepper and artichoke hearts in 2 tbs Broth, remove. Step 3: Cook onion in 2 tbs Broth until softened. Step 4: Add oil and rice and cook 1 minute, add wine. Step 5: Cook until wine is almost gone. Step 6: Add broth just to cover rice.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, marinated artichoke hearts, lemon, parmesan cheese, basil, olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the spaghetti following pack instructions. Step 2: Put the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil, season really well and mix. Step 3: Drain the pasta, keep 2 tbsp of the cooking water, then toss everything together.

Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, mayonnaise, onion, parmesan cheese, bread
Instructions: Step 1: Combine artichoke hearts, mayo, onion, and 1 / 3 of cheese. Step 2: Combine until well mixed. Step 3: Spread mixture on untoasted sides of bread cutouts. Step 4: Sprinkle lightly with remaining cheese Broil until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: pasta shells, artichoke hearts, butter, mushroom, red onion, parmesan cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, white wine, oregano leaves, seasoning salt, paprika, pepper, garlic powder, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Rinse under cold water and drain well. Step 3: Mix pasta with artichoke hearts. Step 4: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter until soft. Step 5: Mix together pasta and artichoke mixture with mushrooms, parmesan cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, white wine and seasonings. Step 6: Pour mixture into a medium casserole dish. Step 7: Top with tomato slices. Step 8: Cook casserole at 350f for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot. Step 9: Garnish with fresh oregano if desired You can also microwave this dish.

Ingredient Names: dried oregano, pepperoncini pepper, fire-roasted tomatoes, no-salt-added tomato sauce, provolone cheese, feta, fat free cream cheese, fresh ground black pepper, frozen artichoke hearts, frozen chopped spinach, garlic cloves, pasta shells, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan. Step 3: Place over medium heat. Step 4: Cook 12 minutes or until slightly thick, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Remove from heat, set aside. Step 6: Combine 1 / 2 c provolone and the next 6 ingredients in a medium bowl. Step 7: Spoon or pipe about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cheese mixture in each pasta shell. Step 8: Place stuffed shells in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Step 9: Spoon tomato mixture over shells. Step 10: Sprinkle with remaining provolone.

Ingredient Names: small shell pasta, water-packed artichoke hearts, tomatoes, black olives, bell pepper, onion, white wine, pepperoncini pepper, olive oil, garlic, fresh parsley, fresh basil, fresh oregano, feta cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Step 2: Drain and set aside While pasta cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add garlic and onion and saute for about 1 minute. Step 4: Add olives, bell pepper, pepperoncini, and white wine and cook for about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add artichokes with their liquid and tomatoes, cook for another 3 minutes, or until liquid reduces, remove from heat. Step 6: Stir in pasta, herbs, salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Step 7: Top with feta cheese and serve.

Dish Name: Arty Choke Horses Doovers With Balsamic Garlic
Ingredient Names: marinated artichoke hearts, garlic, fresh rosemary, crushed red pepper flakes, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the artichoke hearts in half and transfer to a bowl. Step 2: Add all of the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Stir well and refrigerate To serve, bring to room temperature, and then place on a serving plate and serve with toothpicks or cocktail sticks.

Ingredient Names: arugula, fresh basil, garlic cloves, pine nuts, parmesan-romano cheese mix, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients but the oil in food processor and pulse till chopped Pour oil through feed tube while processing till creamy.

Ingredient Names: asiago cheese, kalamata olives, extra virgin olive oil, rotini pasta, vidalia onion, sun-dried tomato, oregano leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Set aside to cool In large bowl, combine pasta with remaining ingredients and toss well. Step 3: Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, sliced mushrooms, garlic clove, eggs, fresh parsley, black pepper, asparagus, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet with an ovenproof handle, heat 1 tablespoons each of the butter and olive oil over high heat. Step 2: Cook the mushrooms and garlic, stirring often, for about 2 minutes or until the mushrooms are softened With a slotted spoon, remove to a bowl and set aside. Step 3: Drain the liquid from the skillet. Step 4: Heat the remaining butter and olive oil over medium heat, swirling to coat the pan. Step 5: Combine the eggs, parsley and pepper. Step 6: Pour into the skillet. Step 7: Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until the top is almost set. Step 8: Sprinkle with the mushroom mixture. Step 9: Arrange the asparagus like wheel spokes on top.

Dish Name: Asparagus And Pea Gnocchi With Toasted Onion
Ingredient Names: gnocchi, asparagus, frozen peas, olive oil, brown onion, cream, salt and pepper, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a small frypan, heat the oil. Step 2: Add the onion and cook until brown The idea here is to caramelise it and then crisp it up a bit, so don't turn the heat up too high right at the start. Step 3: When suitable browned, remove the onion from the pan and cover it to keep it warm. Step 4: Add cream to the pan and season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Simmer for 5 minutes or so until it reduces a bit. Step 6: Meanwhile, cook the gnocchi for a few minutes in a pot of salted boiling water About two minutes before the gnocchi is done add the asparagus and peas to the boiling water. Step 7: Drain the gnocchi and greens in a colander and return to the pot. Step 8: Stir in the onion and cream and cook until just heated through.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, salt & freshly ground black pepper, seedless cucumber, cherry tomatoes, tomatoes, red onion, kalamata olive, capers, country bread, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Break off and discard the tough ends of asparagus. Step 2: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil. Step 3: Prepare an ice bath. Step 4: Cook asparagus until bright green and just tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Transfer immediately to ice bath, drain. Step 6: Place on a clean kitchen towel. Step 7: In a large bowl, combine asparagus, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olives, capers, and bread, toss to combine. Step 8: In a small bowl, whisk together red-wine vinegar and olive oil.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, salt, chopped tomatoes, thyme, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly grease a shallow baking dish. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 3: Steam asparagus until crisp tender. Step 4: Arrange in baking dish Saut onion and garlic in olive oil in saucepan until golden. Step 5: Add tomatoes, salt and thyme. Step 6: Simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Step 7: Pour sauce over asparagus. Step 8: Place slices of mozzarella cheese over top. Step 9: Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Asparagus Peas And Basil Piselli Con Asparagi E Basilico
Ingredient Names: shallot, unsalted butter, asparagus, fresh peas, fine sea salt, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook shallots in butter in a 12-inch heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until just tender, about 4 minutes. Step 2: Stir in asparagus, peas, sea salt, and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper, then seal skillet with foil. Step 3: Cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender but still slightly al dente, about 8 minutes. Step 4: Stir in basil and sea salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, olive oil, garlic clove, asparagus, cherry tomatoes, frozen peas, vegetable stock, parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Drain the pasta, reserving about 1 / 2 cup of the pasta water. Step 4: In a large saute pan, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 6: Add the asparagus, season with the salt and pepper, and cook for 3 minutes until slightly soft. Step 7: Add the cherry tomatoes and peas. Step 8: Cook for 2 minutes. Step 9: Pour the stock into the pan and bring the mixture to a simmer. Step 10: Cook until the tomatoes start to burst and the stock is reduced by half, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, onion, arborio rice, white wine, fresh rosemary, italian parsley, minced garlic clove, parmesan cheese, whipping cream, pine nuts, asparagus, vegetable broth, water
Instructions: Step 1: On medium heat, add butter and olive oil to pan and swirl until entire pot is coated At the same time, bring broth to a simmer in a separate pot. Step 2: Add onion and stir Saut for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add chopped rosemary, italian parsley, and pine nuts Saut for 3 more minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and rice and saut for 1 more minute Be sure not to let the garlic brown. Step 5: Add the wine and cook until absorbed, about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add of the simmering broth and stir.

Dish Name: Asparagus Sundried Tomato And Orzo Salad
Ingredient Names: asparagus, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, sea salt, orzo pasta, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, fresh basil, fresh parsley, tomatoes, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 430 f. Step 2: Wash asparagus, trim off woody ends, and then cut asparagus spears into 1 inch pieces. Step 3: Combine in a baking dish with olive oil, garlic, and salt Roast asparagus in oven for ~15 minutes, until just fork tender, let cool slightly. Step 4: Cook orzo in salted water, according to package directions. Step 5: Cut tomatoes into small pieces or slices. Step 6: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, garlic clove, hazelnuts, flat-leaf italian parsley, lemon zest, fresh lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot fitted with a steamer basket, bring about 1 inch water to a boil. Step 2: Add the asparagus, cover, and steam until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Remove from the pot. Step 4: In a large bowl, combine the asparagus, garlic, chopped parsley, hazelnuts, 1 / 4 teaspoon lemon zest, lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Step 5: Toss well to mix and coat. Step 6: Arrange the asparagus neatly on a serving platter and garnish with parsley sprigs and lemon zest. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: asparagus, olive oil, red wine vinegar, plum tomatoes, scallions, fresh parsley, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large stockpot filled with salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Prepare an ice-water bath and set aside. Step 3: Add the asparagus to boiling water and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes, depending on thickness. Step 4: Drain and transfer to ice-water bath for 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain well and transfer to shallow serving platter or long serving dish. Step 6: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the oil and vinegar. Step 7: Stir in the tomatoes, scallions, parsley, salt and pepper. Step 8: Add the sauce to the asparagus, tossing gently to combine. Step 9: Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, water, bread flour, yeast, sugar, salt, diced tomatoes, garlic cloves, dry oregano, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Spread the 2 tablespoons of olive oil over a jelly roll or large baking pan. Step 2: Combine the water and olive oil together in a measuring cup. Step 3: Mix all of the dry ingredients for the crust together and place in a mixer With the dough hook, start mixer on low and begin to add the liquid mixture until the wet and dry ingredients are incorporated Increase the speed to medium and mix for 10 minutes The dough should be sticky unlike regular pizza dough. Step 4: Drop the dough onto the oiled pan and turn over once to coat the dough with oil. Step 5: Press out into a 6 x 10" rectangle cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 60 to 90 minutes The dough should double. Step 6: Uncover and press the dough out to the sides of the pan.

Dish Name: Attack Of The Killer Tomato Sauce With Penne
Ingredient Names: garlic, olive oil, fresh tomatoes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, hot red pepper flakes, penne, italian parsley, vodka, heavy cream, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsely chop the garlic Find a sauce pan or skillet that will be large enough for all the cooked pasta and sauce at the end. Step 2: Heat the oil the saucepan over medium heat and when the oil is warm add the chopped garlic and saute for 3 minutes If using fresh tomatoes, cut them into 1-inch pieces. Step 3: Add the fresh or canned tomatoes to the pan and cook for 20 minutes. Step 4: Season to taste with salt and pepper, then add the red pepper flakes. Step 5: Bring a large pot of cold water to a boil. Step 6: Meanwhile, place the pan with the sauce over low heat and let it simmer while you cook the pasta. Step 7: Add coarse salt to the boiling water, then add the pasta and cook for 8 to 11 minutes How long it cooks really depends on the brand of pasta.

Dish Name: Auberge Spiced Olives With Garlic Orange And Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, green olives, orange, garlic cloves, bay leaves, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up a dry heavy based frying pan over a medium heat and add the coriander seeds. Step 2: Toss them around briefly until they start to release their fragrance. Step 3: Remove them and put to one side. Step 4: Mix all the other ingredients together, and then add the toasted coriander seeds and mix again. Step 5: Store them in a covered jar or container for 24 hours before serving, to allow to flavours to infuse. Step 6: Bring them to room temperature if they have been stored in a very cool or cold area - as the olive oil may have congealed. Step 7: Serve with toasted pitta bread, cocktail bread or mini toasts, bread, cocktails, aperitifs or assorted hors d'oeuvres These can be made up to 3 days in advance.

Dish Name: Aubergine Tomato Parmesan Bake Melanzane Alla Parmigiana
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, chopped tomato, tomato puree, aubergines, parmesan cheese, basil, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 360f. Step 2: In a shallow pan, mix together the garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, and 4 tbsp of the olive oil. Step 3: Cook over a high heat for 3 mins, pour in the tomatoes, then simmer for 8 mins, stirring every now and then. Step 4: Stir in the tomato pure. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat a griddle pan until very hot. Step 6: Brush a few of the aubergines with a little oil, then add to the pan. Step 7: Cook over a high heat until well browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Step 8: Turn them halfway through cooking Lift onto kitchen paper and do the next batch. Step 9: When all the aubergines are cooked, lay a few of them in the bottom of an ovenproof dish, then spoon over some sauce.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, egg, parsley, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, salt & pepper, breadcrumbs, flour, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cold sticky rice with 1 egg beaten, parsley, parmesan, mozzarella, salt and pepper Use ice cream scoop to scoop up a rice ball Hand roll ball, roll in flour. Step 2: Dip in beaten egg and roll in bread crumbs. Step 3: Heat 1" cooking oil in pan on stovetop over medium-high heat and brown until golden. Step 4: Drain on paper towels and serve warm Leftovers do well in microwave.

Ingredient Names: tomato puree, plum tomatoes, garlic, onion, cloves, basil, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, sugar, extra virgin olive oil, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, saut onion and garlic in olive oil Empty plum tomatoes into large bowl and squash with your hands. Step 2: Add all ingredients to pot and simmer for 3 hours.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, green olives, black olives, roma tomato, garlic clove, oregano, black pepper, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together the night before serving Spread on your choice of sliced bread and toast at 350 degrees until melted and slightly browned on top.

Ingredient Names: low-fat sour cream, part-skim ricotta cheese, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, herb with garlic soup mix, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients well Place in a casserole dish and bake at 350 for 25 - 30 minutes Serve with sliced italian bread or soft italian breadsticks.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, onion, garlic, dried basil, dried rosemary, oregano, sugar, olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil over medium heat in medium-sized saucepan. Step 2: Saute onions and garlic until brown. Step 3: Add tomato sauce and stir. Step 4: Lower heat to medium-low While stirring, add rosemary, basil and oregano. Step 5: Allow sauce to bubble. Step 6: Sprinkle with sugar and mix again. Step 7: Season to taste with salt and pepper Use immediately, or transfer to plastic container for storage.

Dish Name: Baby Spinach With Nut Crusted Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: pecans, seasoning salt, all-purpose flour, egg, milk, fresh mozzarella cheese, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, yellow onion, red onion, scallions, garlic, rice wine vinegar, honey
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, finely chop the pecans. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 teaspoon seasoned salt and 1 / 2 cup of the flour to form a coarse meal, set aside. Step 3: In a shallow bowl, combine the remaining 1 cup flour with the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon seasoned salt. Step 4: Set aside To make the egg wash, whisk the egg and milk together in another shallow bowl, set aside. Step 5: Season both sides of the cheese slices with salt and pepper Dredge each slice in the flour, lightly shaking off any excess, then dip each slice in the egg wash, allowing any extra to drip off. Step 6: Then dredge the slices in the pecan meal to coat both sides.

Ingredient Names: onion, roma tomatoes, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, mushroom, basil, garlic, cooked spaghetti, olive oil, sausage, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a sausepan until it is just starting to smoke. Step 2: In a heavy metal strainer over a heavy metal bowl, put spaghetti noodles. Step 3: Top with the onion, tomatoes, peppers, mushrooms, basil, and garlic. Step 4: Pour the hot oil over the veggies and pasta slowly, being sure to pour oil directly on all veggies. Step 5: Toss veggies and pasta, lift strainer to get rid of excess oil. Step 6: Divide pasta and veggies between two plates, top with sausage and shredded cheese.

Dish Name: Baguettes Do Try This At Home
Ingredient Names: water, active dry yeast, unbleached bread flour, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Water for dough: use 1 cup water in summer, 1 1 / 4 cups water in winter, and somewhere in between the rest of the year, or if your house is climate controlled Directions. Step 2: Make the starter by mixing the yeast with the water, then mixing in the flour to make a soft dough. Step 3: Cover and let rest at room temperature for about 14 hours Overnight works well The starter should have risen and become bubbly If it hasn't, your yeast may not be working Dissolve 1 / 4 teaspoon of yeast in 1 tablespoon lukewarm water with a pinch of sugar, and wait 15 minutes If nothing happens, replace your yeast, and begin the starter process again If you're using active dry yeast, mix it with the water, then combine with the starter, flour, and salt.

Dish Name: Baguettes With Scallion Olive Oil Spread
Ingredient Names: scallions, extra virgin olive oil, french baguettes, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the chopped scallions in cold water to remove their raw heat. Step 2: Drain well and mix with olive oil Toast the baguettes. Step 3: Spread the scallion olive oil on top, and season with salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Baked Butternut Squash And Parmesan Cheese Gratin
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, parmesan cheese, fresh breadcrumbs, pecans, fresh thyme leaves, butter, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the peeled and seeded butternut squash into 1" cubes or chunks and place them in to a well buttered gratin dish. Step 2: Season the butternut squash generously with black pepper and a little salt. Step 3: Mix the grated parmesan cheese with the fresh bread crumbs, nuts and chopped thyme and then sprinkle over the top of the butternut squash Dot the butter all over the cheese and nut topping. Step 4: Bake it in a pre-heated oven, 200c / 400f / gas 6, for about 35 to 45 minutes, until the butternut squash is soft and the topping is golden brown Serves 2 as a main course and 4 as a vegetable accompaniment. Step 5: Serve piping hot with crusty bread and salad, if serving as a main course.

Dish Name: Baked Butternut Squash Gratin Giada De Laurentiis
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, salt and pepper, parmesan cheese, basil pesto, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f Lightly butter an 8-inch baking dish and set aside. Step 2: Fill a large pot with enough water to come 2 inches up the sides of the pot. Step 3: Set a steamer rack in the pot, cover, and bring the water to a boil over high heat. Step 4: Add the squash and steam over medium heat until the squash is very tender, about 20 minutes. Step 5: Transfer the squash to a food processor and blend until smooth and creamy. Step 6: Season the squash to taste with salt and pepper. Step 7: Spoon half of the squash evenly over the prepared baking dish Dollop half of the pesto all over the squash in the dish. Step 8: Sprinkle half of the cheese over the squash.

Dish Name: Baked Cherry Tomatoes With Parmesan Topping
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, cherry tomatoes, salt, ground black pepper, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour oil into 13x9x2-inch broilerproof ceramic baking dish. Step 2: Add tomatoes, turn to coat with oil. Step 3: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 4: Top with parsley and cheese. Step 5: Preheat oven to 400. Step 6: Bake tomatoes just until plump and shiny but not split, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Preheat broiler Broil until tomatoes begin to split and cheese begins to color, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Serve hot or warm.

Ingredient Names: unseasoned breadcrumbs, fresh basil, parmesan cheese, salt, egg, eggplants, olive oil, buns, pasta sauce, part-skim mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Step 2: Combine breadcrumbs, basil, parmesan and salt in shallow bowl. Step 3: Whisk egg in another shallow bowl and dip eggplant slices, then coat each slice in the breadcrumb mixture. Step 4: Place eggplant on parchment paper-lined baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil and bake for 15 minutes. Step 5: Transfer baked eggplant to clean plate and discard parchment paper. Step 6: Set toasted buns halves, cut side down, on baking sheet. Step 7: Divide eggplant slices evenly among bun halves, spoon on sauce and top with cheese. Step 8: Place under broiler for 2 minutes until cheese is bubbling.

Dish Name: Baked Eggplant With Mushroom And Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: eggplant, cooking spray, onion, dried italian seasoning, salt, garlic cloves, mushrooms, black pepper, no-salt-added tomato sauce, part-skim mozzarella cheese, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Arrange the eggplant slices on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray Broil 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375. Step 4: Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat. Step 5: Add onion and next 4 ingredients. Step 6: Cover and cook 7 minutes or until tender, stirring mixture occasionally Increase heat to medium-high. Step 7: Uncover and cook for 2 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Step 8: Spread half of mushroom mixture in bottom of a 1 1 / 2-quart round baking dish coated with cooking spray.

Dish Name: Baked Eggplant With Tomato Sauce And Three Cheeses
Ingredient Names: eggplants, pam cooking spray, bell peppers, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, flour, milk, cayenne pepper, tomatoes, basil leaves, skim milk ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, egg yolk, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 425f. Step 2: Cut off both ends of the eggplants and cut into 24 slices, about 1-inch thick each Coat 2 sheet pans lightly with spray olive oil and place the eggplant slices on the oiled sheet pans along with the bell pepper halves and spray the vegetables with olive oil. Step 3: Bake in the oven for 25 minutes, turning halfway through the baking Dice the bell peppers and set aside. Step 4: In a medium saucepan, over moderate heat, in 2 tablespoons of the oil cook half the onion until softened. Step 5: Add half the garlic and flour and cook for another minute, stirring constantly. Step 6: Add the milk in 3 additions stirring the sauce until smooth with the each addition. Step 7: Add the cayenne, season with salt and pepper, and cook for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally and set aside to cool. Step 8: Meanwhile, in another saucepan, over medium heat, cook the remaining onion in 2 tablespoons of the remaining olive oil until softened.

Ingredient Names: farfalle pasta, broccoli floret, garlic cloves, butter, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saut garlic and butter in pan Slightly brown, do not overcook. Step 2: Steam broccoli until bright green and soft. Step 3: Cook farfalle according to packing instructions. Step 4: When using barilla cook 11 minutes for al dente. Step 5: Combine all above ingredients in bowl. Step 6: Mix in grated cheese. Step 7: Place into oven safe dish and bake for 5-10 minutes at 350f.

Ingredient Names: feta, tomato sauce, cayenne pepper, fresh basil, focaccia bread, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Spray small glass or ceramic baking dish with cooking spray for easy cleanup. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 3: Pour tomato sauce in the baking dish, stir in cayenne. Step 4: Top with crumbled feta. Step 5: Bake for about 15-20 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly in the center and the feta is softened. Step 6: Top with julienned basil and drizzle with olive oil. Step 7: Serve with toasted or warmed focaccia.

Ingredient Names: fresh lemon juice, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, tomatoes seasoned with basil garlic & oregano, feta cheese, crusty bread, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Combine lemon juice, red pepper, garlic and tomatoes in a bowl Coat a shallow baking dish with cooking spray Crumble feta into the baking dish. Step 3: Top with tomato mixture. Step 4: Bake for 20 minutes. Step 5: Remove from oven, stir and serve as a spread or dip for the bread.

Dish Name: Baked Goat Cheese And Roasted Winter Squash Over Garlicky Pasta
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, red bell pepper, onion, olive oil, salt, dried rosemary, black pepper, goat cheese, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, fettuccine, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Place squash, bell pepper and onion in a large bowl. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon oil, toss well. Step 4: Arrange vegetables in a single layer on a jelly-roll pan coated with cooking spray. Step 5: Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, rosemary, and black pepper. Step 6: Bake at 425 for 40 minutes, stirring once. Step 7: Place goat cheese in freezer 10 minutes. Step 8: Cut cheese crosswise into 4 equal rounds. Step 9: Place breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, extra virgin olive oil, dried basil, dried oregano, garlic salt, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Cut each potato in half length wise and then quarter each half to make potato edges. Step 3: Arrange the wedges on a baking tray with the skin side down. Step 4: In a bowl mix together the oil, herbs and garlic salt. Step 5: Brush the oil mixture onto each potato wedge. Step 6: Sprinkle the grated cheese over the wedges. Step 7: Put in the oven and bake for about 25 to 35 minutes or until done depending on the thickness of your wedges, serve.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, parmesan cheese, asiago cheese, pesto sauce, roasted garlic, mozzarella cheese, roasted red pepper, parma ham, small white beans, black olives, marinated artichoke hearts, red onion, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a bowl, cream together the cream cheese, parmesan, and asagio. Step 3: Spread into the bottom of a 9-inch deep-dish pie dish. Step 4: Mix together the pesto and roasted garlic. Step 5: Spread in a layer over the cheeses on the dish. Step 6: Spread the shredded mozzarella over the pesto layer, then sprinkle with the roasted red pepper. Step 7: Mix together the parma ham or prosciutto and the cooked white beans. Step 8: Set aside To arrange the last layer, mentally divide the contents of the dish into three equal"pie slice" shaped sections, then: over one section, arrange the black or green olives, over another section, arrange the artichoke hearts, and over another layer the parma and bean mixture. Step 9: Sprinkle the entire dish with the onion and parsley, and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 20 minutes and it's bubbly.

Ingredient Names: panko breadcrumbs, mozzarella string cheese, egg substitute, cooking spray, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add 1 / 3 cup panko to pan, and cook for 2 minutes or until toasted, stirring frequently. Step 4: Remove from heat, and place the panko in a shallow dish. Step 5: Cut mozzarella sticks into 1-inch pieces Working with one piece at a time, dip cheese in egg substitute Dredge in panko. Step 6: Place cheese on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Step 7: Bake at 425 for 3 minutes or until the cheese is softened and thoroughly heated. Step 8: Pour the marinara sauce into a microwave-safe bowl.

Ingredient Names: black olives, garlic, rosemary, thyme, red pepper flakes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drain oilves. Step 2: Place in shallow round baking dish. Step 3: Put garlic and herbs, tucking herbs in and around olives. Step 4: Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes, stirring every now and then. Step 5: Store in refridgerator in glass jar, covering with olive oil so that olive are submerged in the oil.

Ingredient Names: penne, tomatoes in puree, olive oil, onion, celery, garlic cloves, navy beans, vegetable broth, black pepper, frozen spinach, romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Heat large covered saucepot of water to boiling. Step 3: Add pasta and cook 2 minutes less than label directions. Step 4: Drain and reserve 1 / 4 cup cooking water. Step 5: Return pasta to saucepot. Step 6: Meanwhile, drain tomatoes, reserving puree Coarsely chop tomatoes In 4-quart saucepan, heat oil over medium heat until hot. Step 7: Add onion and celery and cook 9-10 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With Asparagus Lemon And Mascarpone
Ingredient Names: olive oil, asparagus, scallions, lemons, lemon, fresh thyme, salt, butter, flour, milk, mascarpone cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, allspice, cayenne, fresh breadcrumb
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450f Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Step 2: Heat a large pot of water to boil. Step 3: Add asparagus and cook 2 minutes, remove with a slotted spoon and run under cold water to stop cooking process, drain well. Step 4: Add fettuccine to boiling water and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes While fettuccine is cooking, heat oil in a skillet, add scallions and saute 1 minute. Step 5: Add asparagus, saute 1 minute. Step 6: Remove from heat and add half the zest, lemon juice, thyme, salt, pepper, mix well, set aside.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With Sun Dried Tomatoes And Ricotta Cheese
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, sun-dried tomato, diced tomatoes, paprika, salt, ground black pepper, penne pasta, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and saut for 4 minutes or until starting to brown. Step 3: Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes Saut 3 more minutes. Step 4: Add tomatoes, paprika, salt and pepper. Step 5: Stir well, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 7: Cook pasta for 7 minutes or until tender and still a bit firm. Step 8: Drain and toss with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Step 9: Preheat oven to 350f.

Dish Name: Baked Pasta With Zucchini And Mozzarella
Ingredient Names: fusilli, zucchini, salt and pepper, italian plum tomatoes, black olives, parmesan cheese, fresh rosemary, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large frying pan, heat oil. Step 3: Saute zucchini until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Transfer to an oiled shallow casserole dish. Step 6: Cook pasta in boiling salted water, when pasta is almost cooked, drain and add to zucchini. Step 7: Add tomatoes, olives, parmesan, rosemary and 1 / 2 of the mozzarella. Step 8: Sprinkle with a little more salt and pepper If desired Gently mix together.

Dish Name: Baked Penne With Roasted Vegetables Courtesy Giada De La
Ingredient Names: red peppers, zucchini, summer squash, cremini mushrooms, yellow onion, extra virgin olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried italian herb seasoning, penne pasta, marinara sauce, fontina cheese, smoked mozzarella cheese, frozen peas, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f On a baking sheet, toss the peppers, zucchini, squash, mushrooms, and onions with olive oil, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper, and dried herbs Roast until tender, about 15 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Add the pasta and cook for about 6 minutes Since you will be cooking the pasta a second time in the oven, you want to make sure the inside is still hard. Step 4: Drain in a colander. Step 5: In a large bowl, toss the drained pasta with the roasted vegetables, marinara sauce, cheeses, peas, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper. Step 6: Using a wooden spoon, gently mix, until all the pasta is coated with the sauce and the ingredients are combined. Step 7: Pour the pasta into a greased 9 by 13-inch pan.

Dish Name: Baked Peppers With Ricotta And Basil
Ingredient Names: yellow bell peppers, olive oil, ricotta cheese, fresh basil, green onion, italian parsley, salt and pepper, eggs, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Singe the peppers quickly over a gas flame, grill or under the broiler The peppers should char all over, but do not cook them so long that they turn limp. Step 2: Remove them from heat and cool them in a plastic bag, then slide off the charred skins. Step 3: Cut the peppers in half lengthwise, remove the stems, ribs and seeds Drizz Le the halves with olive oil. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 350. Step 5: In a medium bowl, mix the ricotta, basil, green onions, parsley, salt and pepper, beat in the eggs. Step 6: Fill the pepper halves with the ricotta mixture and place them in a baking dish.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, cornmeal, olive oil, garlic cloves, dried sage, parmesan cheese, butter, mushrooms, coarse black pepper, fontina cheese, fresh parsley leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f In medium saucepan, bring the water and 1 teaspoon salt to a boil. Step 2: Add the cornmeal in a slow stream, whisking. Step 3: Whisk in tablespoon of the butter 1 / 4 teaspoon of the sage. Step 4: Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until vey thick, about 20 minutes.
