Step 5: Stir in 3 tablespoons of the parmesan. Step 6: Meanwhile, butter an 8"x12" baking dish. Step 7: In a large frying pan, melt 1 tablespoon of the butter and 1 tablespoon of the oil over moderately high heat. Step 8: Add half the mushrooms, 1 / 2 of garlic 1 / 4 tsp each of the salt and sage and 1 / 4 tsp of the pepper. Step 9: Cook, stirring frequently until the mushrooms are golden, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ziti pasta, evaporated skim milk, skim milk, egg whites, dijon mustard, salt, green onions with top, black pepper, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 Spray 9-inch square baking pan with nonstick cooking spray, set aside. Step 2: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt, drain. Step 3: Place in bottom of prepared pan, set aside. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine evaporated milk, skim milk, egg whites, mustard and salt in food processor or blender Process until smooth. Step 5: Sprinkle green onions over pasta.

Ingredient Names: rigatoni pasta, olive oil, butter, shallot, garlic cloves, all-purpose flour, white wine, milk, ground nutmeg, salt, ground black pepper, baby spinach, ricotta cheese, eggs, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Cook the rigatoni for 5 minutes in a pot of boiling, salted water. Step 3: Drain and toss with the olive oil. Step 4: Set aside To make the bechamel sauce, melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat and add the shallots and garlic Sweat the shallots and garlic for a few minutes until softened but not coloured. Step 5: Add the flour and stir until a smooth paste forms Gradually whisk in the wine and then the milk. Step 6: Bring the mixture to a simmer, whisking constantly and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Baked Ricotta With Italian Parsley Salad
Ingredient Names: whole milk ricotta cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, eggs, italian parsley, cherry tomatoes, red onion, garlic clove, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Put ricotta in a large sieve or colander lined with a double thickness of cheesecloth. Step 2: Cover the ricotta with the cheesecloth, set the sieve or colander over a bowl to catch the draining whey, and set a plate with a weight on top of the ricotta to speed draining. Step 3: Refrigerate for several hours or overnight Ricotta pie: Preheat the oven to 375 Butter a 10-in pie pan. Step 4: In a large bowl, stir together the ricotta and parmigiano-reggiano. Step 5: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Stir in the eggs, beating well. Step 7: Transfer the mixture to a prepared pan spreading it evenly.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, salt, swiss cheese, parmesan cheese, green olives, black olives, meatless sauce, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375f. Step 2: Prepare spaghetti sauce. Step 3: Cook pasta for 1 / 3 of its preparation time in oiled and salted water Pasta should be chewy and a little hard in the middle. Step 4: Drain all but about 1 / 4 cup of the water. Step 5: Stir in sauce Mixture should be very wet because the spaghetti will continue to cook and absorb moisture. Step 6: Grease a large baking dish and put a layer of spaghetti, then a layer of one-third of the cheese, then a layer of one-half of the olives, repeat, then more spaghetti. Step 7: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake for 30 minutes or until warmed through. Step 8: Garnish with the remaining grated cheese and raw parsley.

Dish Name: Baked Squash With Garlic And Parmesan
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut peeled squash into 1" pieces. Step 2: Place olive oil in a large bowl along with the garlic. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Toss well and place into a greased shallow oven proof baking dish. Step 5: In a small bowl, combine breadcrumbs and cheese and sprinkle over squash. Step 6: Bake at 375f for 35-45 minutes or until squash is tender and the topping is light brown.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, ricotta cheese, eggs, nutmeg, black pepper, garlic powder, dried parsley, spaghetti sauce, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In an 8 quart pot, bring water to a boil and cook shells for 8 minutes or until al dente. Step 2: Drain and cool immediately with cold water. Step 3: Drain and place open side down on paper towels. Step 4: In a medium bowl, combine the rest of ingredients except the spaghetti sauce Reserve the 1 / 4 cup of mozzarella. Step 5: Place a thin layer of spaghetti sauce into the bottom of a 12 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Step 6: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Step 7: Spoon the cheese mixture into each pasta shell and place open side up, in a single layer, in prepared pan. Step 8: Pour the rest of sauce over the stuffed shells Loosely cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Tomatoes With Orzo And Olives
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, orzo pasta, olive, garlic, basil, pine nuts, olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees or grill Halve and hollow tomatoes, place in a baking dish. Step 2: Mix the rest of the ingredients except the cheese together in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste Carefully stuff the tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Step 3: Bake for 20 minutes and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, all-purpose flour, low-fat milk, fontina cheese, ground nutmeg, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cheese tortellini, fine dry breadcrumb, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f coat 6 individual gratin dishes or a 1 1 / 2-quart shallow baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Put a large pot of water on to boil for cooking pasta. Step 3: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add flour and cook, whisking constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 5: Add hot milk and bring to a simmer, whisking, until smooth and slightly thickened, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and add 1 / 4 cup fontina and nutmeg, stirring to melt the cheese. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Meanwhile, cook tortellini until just tender, 6 to 8 minutes or according to package directions. Step 9: Drain and rinse well. Step 10: Combine the tortellini with the cheese sauce and toss.

Ingredient Names: pizza crust, diced tomatoes, dried basil, dried parsley, dried oregano, ziti pasta, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 550, or the highest your oven goes Dump the can of tomatoes in a blender and pureed I like to use zesty jalepeno, for a little kick! Step 2: Add spices and bring to a simmer. Step 3: Reduce to the consistency you prefer for your pizza. Step 4: Cook ziti according to package directions While the ziti is cooking, prepare your pizza crust on a peel or in a pizza pan, dusted with cornmeal. Step 5: When ziti is done, drain well. Step 6: Combine about 3 / 4 of the sauce with the ziti, ricotta, and about 3 oz of the mozzarella It's best to do this while everything is hot, so the cheeses will melt together.

Ingredient Names: butter, all-purpose flour, milk, nutmeg, salt, pepper, gruyere cheese, fontina, parmesan cheese, ziti pasta, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter over moderately-low heat, stir in flour and cook 3 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat and whisk in hot milk. Step 3: Return pan to heat, bring to a boil, whisking, for 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in nutmeg, tsp of salt and tsp of pepper. Step 5: In a small bowl, combine 1 cup of the gruyere, cup of the fontina and cup of the parmesan. Step 6: Whisk cheese into the sauce, cup at a time, until cheese is melted, season to taste. Step 7: Preheat oven to 390 degrees f. Step 8: Boil ziti until al dente. Step 9: Drain well and turn into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2 inch pyrex baking dish.

Dish Name: Baked Ziti With Vegetables And Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, portabella mushrooms, garlic cloves, dried basil, salt, black pepper, stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce, spinach, ziti pasta, cooking spray, part-skim ricotta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onion and bell peppers, and saut 5 minutes. Step 4: Add mushrooms and garlic Saut 2 minutes. Step 5: Stir in basil, salt, black pepper, tomatoes, and tomato sauce, and bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 6: Simmer 5 minutes or until slightly thick, stir in spinach. Step 7: Cook 1 minute or until spinach wilts.

Ingredient Names: romano peppers, olive oil, wholegrain bread, pine nuts, parmesan, red, capers, parsley, young spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Put peppers in a roasting tin, then drizzle with a tsp of oil and a little pepper. Bake for 20 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, toast the bread, then blitz into rough crumbs in the food processor. Mix with the pine nuts, Parmesan, chilli, capers, parsley and remaining oil. Boil the kettle. Put the spinach in a colander, then pour over the boiling water to wilt the leaves. Press out as much liquid as possible. Step 3: Divide the spinach between the peppers, then top with the crumbs. Return to the oven for 15 mins.

Dish Name: Baked turkey meatballs with broccoli & crispy potatoes
Ingredient Names: onions, fresh carrot, garlic, fresh rosemary leaves, turkey ground meat, potatoes skin, olive oil, cherry tomatoes, parmesan, thin-stemmed broccoli, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. In a large bowl, combine the onion, carrot, half the garlic and half the rosemary with the turkey and some seasoning. Shape into 16 meatballs and put in a small baking tray. Toss the potatoes with the remaining garlic, rosemary and the oil, place in a baking tray, then cook both for 20 mins, with the potatoes on top shelf. Step 2: After 20 mins, drain juices off the meatballs, pour cherry tomatoes over, sprinkle with the Parmesan and season. Toss the potatoes, and swap to bottom shelf with the potatoes on top. Cook for another 20 mins until the potatoes are crisp and the meatball sauce is bubbling. Step 3: When the potatoes and meatballs are almost done, cook the broccoli for 3-4 mins, until tender. Sprinkle the basil on top of the meatballs and serve with the crispy potatoes and broccoli.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients together thoroughly. Step 2: Serve with your favourite hearty, crusty bread. Step 3: Store unused portion in an airtight container and refrigerate it will last at least 6 months.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt and pepper, sugar, oregano, eggplants, onion, garlic, dry white wine, stewed tomatoes, fresh tomato, fresh basil, lowfat mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Combine vinegar, oil, oregano, 1 / 2 tsp each salt, pepper and sugar Coat large cookie sheet with vegetable cooking spray. Step 3: Brush both sides of eggplant with vinegar mixture and arrange in single layer on cookie sheet. Step 4: Bake 15 minutes per side or until fork-tender. Step 5: Combine onions, garlic, and 2 tbsp of wine in large non-stick skillet, stirring over medium-high head until onions are soft, approximately 5 minutes. Step 6: Stir in stewed tomatoes with their liquid, chopped tomato, basil, remaining 2 tbsp wine, 1 / 2 tsp salt and 1 / 4 tsp sugar. Step 7: Bring to boil over high heat. Step 8: Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally to break up tomatoes, 10 minute Makes approximately 2 1 / 2 cup sauce.

Ingredient Names: brown sugar, balsamic vinegar, sweet oranges
Instructions: Step 1: Peel oranges removing all of the pith from the outside. Step 2: Cut across grain into 1 / 4 inch slices, removing seeds. Step 3: Place sugar and vinegar in a small saucepan and bring to boil. Step 4: Stir constantly with a large spoon. Step 5: Allow it to continue with a low boil until volume is halved. Step 6: Divide orange slices evenly between 4 plates. Step 7: Drizzle with glaze.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, dry sherry, honey, extra virgin olive oil, fresh thyme, fresh basil, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, wine, honey, oil, and half of the herbs in a small saucepan, heat to boiling. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Step 3: Stir in remaining half of herbs. Step 4: Season to taste with freshly ground black pepper. Step 5: Allow to cool to room temperature. Step 6: Brush on meat or fish during last minutes of grilling.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, olive oil, gilroy garlic, hot pepper flakes, ground aniseed, onion, celery seed, basil
Instructions: Step 1: I never make this quite the same way twice but man is it good to keep on hand. Step 2: Mix everything together in a bowl and pour into a nice glass container I get wide mouth ones at ross, but they have them everywhere. Step 3: Let it sit for a few hours and shake it up lots to mix all the flavors together I keep it on my counter and use it for about a million things from boneless chicken thighs braise to salad dressing If you get a really great loaf of crusty french bread and put a bit of this into fancy little dishes, you can serve it with any meal allowing each person his own dipping sauce It's addictive and sooooo easy to make and keep on hand Enjoy!

Dish Name: Balsamic Onions Asparagus Goat Cheese Pizza
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, balsamic vinegar, granulated sugar, asparagus, tomatoes, dried basil, salt and pepper, whole wheat pizza crust, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: In a frying pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Saute onion and garlic until softened and golden, about 8 minutes. Step 4: Add vinegar and sugar, stir, add asparagus. Step 5: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add tomato, basil, salt, and pepper, cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Spread asparagus mixture over whole-wheat pizza crust.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, balsamic vinegar, broccoli, red onion, cremini mushrooms, spinach, butter, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil a large pot of water for pasta, cook according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and toss with 3 t butter. Step 3: In a small saucepan, bring balsamic vinegar to a boil over medium-low heat. Step 4: Boil, stirring constantly about 5-10 minutes or until balsamic has become the consistency of maple syrup There should only be about 3-4 t left Be careful not to burn, Meanwhile, place 1 t of butter in a skillet with onions and salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Stir fry onions over medium heat until transparent. Step 6: Add broccoli and mushrooms along with 1 / 3 cup water. Step 7: Cook, stirring every now and then for about 5 minutes or until broccoli is tender and water has evaporated.

Dish Name: Balsamic Roasted Asparagus With Fleur De Sel And Parmesan
Ingredient Names: asparagus spear, olive oil, fine sea salt, fresh ground pepper, balsamic vinegar, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Wash the asparagus and break the tough ends off. Step 3: Place the asparagus in a roasting pan and drizzle on the oil and sprinkle with the pepper Shake the pan to coat the asparagus evenly with oil. Step 4: Place in the oven and roast until asparagus is softened but retains a little crunch, about 10 to 12 minutes Watch it carefully! Step 5: It's so sad to overcook it! Step 6: Remove from oven, arrange on a serving platter and top with the balsamic vinegar, fleur de sel and freshly grated parmesan Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Balsamic Strawberries Just A Little Bit Different
Ingredient Names: strawberries, balsamic vinegar, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place the prepped berries into a medium-sized bowl and pour the flavored vinegar over them. Step 2: Place in the fridge for about 30 minutes Use a slotted spoon to divide the berries amongst 4 champagne glasses. Step 3: Let as much or as little vinegar into the glass as desired. Step 4: Top with a spoonful of whipped cream, serve cold.

Ingredient Names: pasta, fresh basil, fresh tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, balsamic vinegar, parmesan cheese, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Prep the tomatoes, garlic, etc-- before boiling the pasta. Step 2: Boil pasta while making the rest of the dish. Step 3: Saute garlic in olive oil. Step 4: Add tomatoes and cover, simmering for 7-10 minutes with the balsamic vinegar and seasonings until tomatoes fall apart. Step 5: Cut basil leaves and toss all ingredients together, including parmesan cheese. Step 6: Serve additional parmesan on the side, if desired.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, dried basil, garlic clove, honey, parmesan cheese, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-mince clove of garlic and add to food processor. Step 2: Add balsamic vinegar, olive oil, basil, honey, and parmesan cheese to the food processor Pulse ingredients until blend is emulsified. Step 3: Taste dressing-- add pinch of salt or additional honey or cheese to taste. Step 4: Store leftovers in a jar in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: dry yeast, water, sugar, bread flour, salt, olive oil, tomato puree, tomato paste, garlic clove, fresh basil, fresh mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Dough: In a glass or plastic bowl, combine yeast, water, and sugar. Step 2: Stir to dissolve the yeast and let the yeast "bloom" for 15 minutes. Step 3: Stir in 1 cup flour, add salt, and then stir in another cup of flour Dump mixture onto kneading board and work in last cup of flour, kneading until dough is soft and elastic, but not sticky Form dough into a ball In another bowl, pour in the 1 tbsp olive oil and spread around Coat ball of dough with oil and cover bowl with a damp towel and let dough rise for 40 minutes Punch down dough and knead on board about 2 minutes Dough is now ready to spread in the pan.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, water, cornmeal, kosher salt, scallion, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan over high heat, bring the vegetable broth and the water to a boil Slowly pour the cornmeal into the hot liquid, wisking constantly, stir in the salt. Step 2: Lower the heat to cook the mixture at a gentle simmer. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, until the cornmeal is creamy and not grainy, about 30 minutes. Step 4: Remove the polenta from the heat and stir in scallion Polenta can be served soft, or poured into a baking pan to cool. Step 5: Once cooled, polenta can then be cut into solid squares.

Ingredient Names: garlic, olive oil, fresh basil leaves, extra virgin olive oil, fresh italian parsley, pine nuts, parmesan cheese, lemon wedge, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Cut top 1 / 3 off of garlic head Peel away paper skin to thin layer or 2 surrounding the cloves. Step 3: Place in small ovenproof dish. Step 4: Drizzle top with 2 teaspoons of olive oil. Step 5: Cover with foil and bake in preheated oven for 70 minutes, allow to cool. Step 6: Squeeze garlic out of the paper skin into a small bowl, set aside. Step 7: Place half the basil in a blender.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, basil leaves, parsley, garlic cloves, whole green onion, salt, pepper, ciabatta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients except the bread and cheese in a food processor, and process until smooth. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Cut open the loaf of bread and spread both halves with the basil butter. Step 4: Put the halves together and wrap in aluminum foil. Step 5: Bake for in a 400f oven for 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove the bread, separate the halves and load them up with parmesan cheese. Step 7: Return them to the oven and either crank up the heat to 500f or put them under the broiler. Step 8: Cook until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and starting to get brown, serve!

Ingredient Names: water, olive oil, salt, all-purpose flour, bread machine yeast, basil, fresh garlic, parmesan cheese, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients into breadmaker in the order suggested by your breadmachine manufacturer Process on dough setting. Step 2: Sprinkle cornmeal on pizza pan. Step 3: Turn dough out onto floured board, and knead in any flour necessary to make the dough easy to handle. Step 4: Roll out dough and place on pizza pan. Step 5: Top as you prefer, and bake at 425 for 15 to 25 minutes or until done - edges of crust should be golden, and cheese bubbly.

Ingredient Names: butter, plain flour, potatoes, sea salt, fresh basil, olive oil, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Peel potatoes, then steam or boil them til cooked through and tender While potatoes are cooking, blend the basil leaves and olive oil in a food processor. Step 2: Mash the potatoes with a fork, add butter and salt & pepper to taste and mash til butter is melted. Step 3: Set aside for a few minutes til potatoes are not too hot to handle but still warm. Step 4: Stir in basil / oil mixture. Step 5: Add flour and work into the potato mix til you have a dough. Step 6: Turn onto a floured workbench and knead gently for 5 minutes, adding more flour as needed - dough should be soft, pliable and not sticky. Step 7: Divide dough into quarters and roll each piece to make a long, thin sausage, then cut sausage into short lengths, whatever size you want your gnocchi to be. Step 8: Fill a very large saucepan with water and bring to the boil, add some salt. Step 9: When the water is boiling, add half the gnocchi.

Ingredient Names: basil, garlic cloves, pine nuts, parmesan cheese, lemon juice, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together in food processor except the oil and lemon. Step 2: Once everything is mixed well, drizzle with lemon and oil. Step 3: Mix until well blended. Step 4: Serve on pasta or just about anything that needs a pick me up Will keep in refrigerator for 2-3 days Enjoy!

Dish Name: Basil Pesto Farfalle W Roasted Pine Nuts
Ingredient Names: farfalle pasta, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, garlic, olive oil, pine nuts, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil farfalle according to instructions Al dente works the best. Step 2: Meanwhile: add 2 cups parmesan cheese, 2 packages fresh basil, garlic, salt, and 1 / 2-package pine nuts in food processor Slowly pour the olive oil while blending all ingredients together. Step 3: Set aside Toast the remaining pine nuts in a splash of olive oil until golden brown, set aside, rinse pasta. Step 4: Stir in the cheese / basil mixture. Step 5: Blend in the remaining 2 cups parmesan and the toasted pine nuts.

Ingredient Names: pine nuts, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, fresh basil leaves, parmesan cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add nuts and garlic to blender and pulse until minced. Step 2: Add olive oil, pulse a few time more. Step 3: Add basil leaves, cheese, salt and blend until smooth Scrape sides of blender as you go to make sure everthing mixes well. Step 4: Serve with your favorite pasta.

Ingredient Names: unbleached flour, dried yeast, salt, sugar, basil leaves, red capsicums, water, olive oil, plastic wrap
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the 1 5 kg flour, yeast, salt and sugar. Step 2: Add the basil, roasted capsicum, lukewarm water and oil. Step 3: Mix well and then knead to form a softish dough, adding a little more water if needed. Step 4: Then knead the dough on a lightly floured workbench. Step 5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm spot to rise for about 2 hours or until it has doubled in size. Step 6: Turn the dough out onto a floured workbench and divide it in half Form the into loaves and place them on a lightly oiled oven tray. Step 7: Brush them with water and set them aside for about another hour, or until they have increased in size by about 50%. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 200c.

Ingredient Names: basil leaves, olive oil, walnuts, garlic, parmesan cheese, butter, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place basil, olive oil, walnuts, garlic and salt in food processor. Step 2: Blend until thoroughly combined. Step 3: Add parmesan and butter and blend 5-10 seconds more Just before serving, add 2 tbsp of hot pasta water from cooked pasta. Step 4: Serve over pasta with bread and salad.

Ingredient Names: kosher salt, extra virgin olive oil, tomato paste, hot red pepper flakes, tomatoes, penne pasta, coarse sea salt, parmigiano-reggiano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot, and add 3 tablespoons kosher salt. Step 2: Meanwhile, put 4 tablespoons olive oil in a large saut pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add the tomato paste and pepper flakes. Step 4: Reduce the heat to low and stir just until fragrant, about 4 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the tomatoes, and remove from the heat. Step 6: Drop the pasta into the boiling water, and cook until al dente. Step 7: Drain the pasta, reserving 1 / 4 cup of the pasta water. Step 8: Add the pasta and the reserved pasta water to the tomato sauce, stir and toss over medium heat until the pasta is well coated. Step 9: Season with salt if necessary, then add 4 tablespoons olive oil, tossing well. Step 10: Serve immediately, with freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese on the side.

Dish Name: Bean And Olive Pate With Eggs
Ingredient Names: eggs, kalamata olives, cannellini beans, garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, dried thyme, dried basil, lemon juice, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, crusty bread, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the eggs in a pan of boiling water for 8 minutes, drain, then cover with cold water and allow to cool While the eggs are cooking, finely chop the olives Peel and crush 3 of the cloves of garlic and set aside the other clove of garlic Peel the eggs and cut them into quarters and set aside. Step 2: Put the well-drained beans, crushed garlic, rosemary, thyme, basil and lemon juice in a food processor, season with salt and pepper and blend until smooth With the food processor still running, gradually add the oil, and continue to process until the oil has been blended into the rest of the ingredients If serving as an appetiser or entre, transfer the pat into 4 ramekins and, distributing them between the four ramekins, stir just over a quarter of the olives into the pat, then sprinkle the rest of the olives on top If serving as a pat to accompany dips, do the same but simply use one serving bowl Toast the bread, and rub the whole garlic over one side of the toast slices, drizzle with a little olive oil and season with pepper. Step 3: Serve the pat, garnished with parsley, with the eggs and toast.

Dish Name: Beet Risotto With Goat Cheese And Walnuts
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, arborio rice, fresh ginger, fresh rosemary, dry white wine, beets, water, fine sea salt, vegetable broth, goat cheese, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat, add onion, saute 3 minutes. Step 2: Add rice, ginger, and rosemary, saute 1 minute, add wine. Step 3: Cook 3 minutes or until liquid is nearly absorbed, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add beets, water, salt, and broth, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes or until beets are tender, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: oil, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, button mushroom, dried tarragon, salt, fresh ground black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Saute bell peppers and mushrooms 8-10 minutes or until vegetables are tender & there is no more liquid. Step 3: Add garlic powder and onion powder. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Stir in tarragon and cook for about another minute.

Ingredient Names: white onion, garlic cloves, celery rib, basil leaves, parsley sprigs, extra virgin olive oil, roma tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the onion, garlic, celery, basil, and parsley in the olive oil in a large saucepan for 15 minutes over medium-low heat, or until all vegetables are soft, and the onion is see-through. Step 2: Make sure the vegetables dont stick to the bottom of the saucepan Next fold in the diced tomatoes and season with however much salt you crave. Step 3: Bring to a calm boil over medium heat. Step 4: Place a lid on the saucepan and simmer until a thick sauce is formed, about 30 minutes Enjoy with any pasta type, or with any recipe needing tomato sauce:).

Dish Name: Berry Salad With Balsamic Vinegar And Honey
Ingredient Names: blueberries, strawberries, honey, balsamic vinegar, raspberries, orange, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place cleaned blueberries and strawberries in a medium bowl. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk honey and balsamic vinegar together, pour over berries. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours To serve, quickly rinse and drain raspberries. Step 4: Add raspberries and orange zest to the salad. Step 5: Toss gently and serve with a dollop of sour cream or yogurt, if you like Enjoy!, serves 6 to 8.

Ingredient Names: frozen chopped spinach, olive oil, garlic clove, salt, eggs, fresh parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw spinach and squeeze out excess water. Step 2: Now, squeeze some more and set aside. Step 3: In a saute skillet, over medium heat, add olive oil and garlic. Step 4: Cook until garlic is golden brown. Step 5: Add spinach and seasonings, saute for 3-4 minutes Break in eggs and continue to saute and stir until eggs are cooked and thoroughly mixed into the spinach. Step 6: Drain any excess oil and transfer to serving platter. Step 7: Sprinkle grated paremesan cheese over the top, amount to your liking.

Dish Name: Best Ever Pizza Crust Bread Machine
Ingredient Names: plain flour, dry yeast, water, olive oil, parmesan cheese, garlic clove, mixed italian herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Place ingredients in your bread machine, in the order suggested in your manual. Step 2: Set to dough setting. Step 3: When done, divide in 3, and roll each piece into a circle shape, on a piece of baking paper. Step 4: Top with your favourite toppings, and bake at 180c for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pita pocket bread, toasted sesame seeds, fresh thyme leaves, poppy seeds, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Split pita breads through the middle and carefully open them out. Step 2: Mix sesame seeds, chopped thyme and poppy seeds in a mortar Crush them lightly with a pestle to release the flavor. Step 3: Stir in the olive oil. Step 4: Spread the mixture over the cut slices of pita. Step 5: Grill until golden brown and crisp Break into pieces and serve with baba ganoush, guacamole, hummus, etc.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onion, garlic, fresh basil leaf, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in oil until translucent. Step 2: Add garlic, saute about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add basil, salt, and pepper to taste. Step 4: Simmer about 5 minutes You can also add a pinch of sugar, if you like it sweeter, or a splash of balsamic vinegar, or a little white wine, or oregano and / or rosemary, or whatever you like, but it's delicious as is Also, it's fantastic if you make meatballs, and when they're done, make this sauce in the same pan after draining out most of the grease.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, fresh basil, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Drain tomatoes very well in a strainer and place in a large bowl. Step 2: Stir in the rest of the ingredients and let sit for at least an hour. Step 3: Serve chilled or room temperature on toasted baguette slices Enjoy!

Dish Name: Biscotti Di Pepe Taralli Italian Pepper Biscuits
Ingredient Names: dry yeast, warm water, flour, salt, black pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve yeast in water Sift flour salt and pepper onto mixing board. Step 2: Make a well in the center and add yeast and oil. Step 3: Blend together and gradually incorporate into flour The dough will be stiff, knead 10 minutes. Step 4: Place in oiled bowl, turn to coat, cover with towel and let rise until doubled in bulk. Step 5: Preheat oven to 375 Break off small pieces of dough and roll into ropes about 6 inches long Form a ring and pinch edges together.

Ingredient Names: ready-to-bake refrigerated buttermilk flaky biscuits, egg, fresh parmesan cheese, pizza seasoning, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 375 degrees f Lightly grease a baking or cookie sheet Open the biscuit package and separate into 10 biscuits Split each biscuit in half to make 20 rounds. Step 2: Arrange the rounds on the baking sheet. Step 3: Brush with the egg, and top with the cheese and the pizza seasoning. Step 4: Bake for about 8-12 minutes, or until the cheese has melted. Step 5: Remove from the oven and serve.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, ricotta cheese, frozen chopped spinach, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, egg, onion, bell pepper, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, black beans, refried black beans, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch baking pan and set aside. Step 2: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook noodles until al dente, according to package directions While water is coming to a boil, in a small bowl, blend the ricotta, spinach, basil, oregano, salt, pepper and egg Spray a large skillet with cooking spray or use a tsp or so of oil and heat over medium heat. Step 3: Saute onion, bell pepper, and garlic until tender. Step 4: Add red pepper flakes if using and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in beans, refried beans, and tomato sauce and cook until heated through. Step 6: Spread about 1 / 4 cup of sauce on bottom of baking dish and top with three lasagna noodles. Step 7: Layer ricotta mixture, sauce and mozzarella cheese.

Ingredient Names: pitted black olives, extra virgin olive oil, dried oregano, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Using a can opener, open the can of pitted olives partway Holding the cover shut to keep the olives inside, drain all of the liquid into a sink. Step 2: Remove the cover and empty the olives out into a bowl You can skip this step if you want and just go to the next one It's up to you Anyway, on a plate or cutting board, begin cutting the olives into small slivers You will want to cut every olive in the can - this may take a little while! Step 3: Each olive should make 3 or 4 slivers. Step 4: Once you're done cutting all the olives, return them to the bowl. Step 5: Using a dough blender, push down hard on the olives in the bowl to break them up into smaller bits If you don't have a dough blender, you can use a large fork and press the prongs down against the olives instead.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, pitted black olives, flat leaf parsley, mayonnaise, fresh lemon juice, salt, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the garlic cloves into the bowl of a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Step 2: Add the olives and parsley and pulse again until the mix is almost a puree. Step 3: Add the mayonnaise, lemon juice and salt and pulse until just combined With the processor running, add the olive oil in a stream. Step 4: Pour into a bowl and chill until ready to use Great served with sandwiches, over toast, flatbread, pita chips, etc.

Dish Name: Bleu Cheese Walnut And Cranberry Crostini
Ingredient Names: baguette, walnut oil, walnuts, blue cheese, shallots, dried cranberries, frisee, vinegar, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet. Step 3: Brush the bread slices on the top with 2 tablespoons of the walnut oil. Step 4: Bake until crisp, about 5 minutes. Step 5: In a medium bowl, combine the toasted walnuts, bleu cheese, 4 tablespoons of shallots, and dried cranberries. Step 6: Spread the mixture on the toast slices. Step 7: Bake until cheese melts, approximately 4 minutes. Step 8: In a separate, non-reactive bowl combine the frisee, 2 tablespoons shallots, 2 tablespoons walnut oil and the vinegar. Step 9: Season with sea salt and toss. Step 10: Serve with crostini.

Ingredient Names: fennel bulbs, olive oil, blue cheese, mixed seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat the oven to 350f Trim the green tops of the fennel bulbs and cut the bulbs in half Use a little of the oil to grease a baking dish. Step 2: Arrange the bulbs in the dish, with the flat sides uppermost Use a pastry brush to "baste" the fennel with the remaining oil This will stop it from burning during roasting. Step 3: Mix the seeds together and grind well Crumble the cheese and mix with the seeds It will form a kind of paste Smooth of the paste on top of each fennel half.

Dish Name: Bollito Misto Di Verdure Boiled Mixed Vegetables
Ingredient Names: potatoes, carrots, beet, zucchini, string bean, olive oil, capers packed in salt, parsley, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil or steam all the vegetables keeping in mind they cook at different rates so you'll either have to do them in batches or different pots. Step 2: Cook them to your taste Some i like crisp-tender, others well done. Step 3: Drain them and let them cool enough to handle them Peel the beets and chop all the vegetables into bite-size pieces and combine them in a bowl If you are using capers, stir them in now. Step 4: Season with olive oil to taste, keeping in mind that the vegetables shouldn't be dry, but they shouldn't be swimming either. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper and the herbs to taste and chill for at least an hour.

Ingredient Names: fresh parsley, anchovy fillets, garlic cloves, tomato paste, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, toss together the parsley, anchovies and garlic. Step 2: Whisk the tomato paste, vinegar and olive oil then add to the parsley mixture. Step 3: Let rest at least 12 hours. Step 4: Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, marinara sauce, low fat cottage cheese, sour cream, frozen chopped spinach, scallion, salt, black pepper, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to directions, omitting salt and undercooking by 2 minutes. Step 2: Drain meanwhile, heat oven to 375 f degrees. Step 3: Grease 12 cup oven-proof casserole. Step 4: Mix pasta, sauce, cottage cheese, sour cream, spinach, scallions, salt, pepper in a bowl. Step 5: Spoon into casserole and top with cheese. Step 6: Bake, covered for 20 minutes, uncover and continue baking for about 10 minutes or until temperature registers 150 f degrees.

Dish Name: Boxing Day Festive Roast Pumpkin And Cheese Lasagne Lasagna
Ingredient Names: olive oil, unsalted butter, sage leaves, onions, garlic cloves, pumpkin, vermouth, water, chopped tomatoes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, sugar, sea salt, pepper, goat's cheese, cream cheese with garlic and herbs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200c / 180c fan / 400f / gas 6, slipping in a baking sheet as you do To make the pumpkin filling: heat the oil and butter in a shallow casserole dish or roasting tin and fry the sage leaves over a gentle heat for about 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and fry very gently for another 10 minutes or so. Step 3: Add the pumpkin pieces, turn well in the oniony oil and then add the vermouth, the water and chopped tomatoes Roast in a pre-heated oven for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Taste for seasoning i tend to add quite a bit of salt here and leave to cool For the tomato sauce: simply pour the chopped tomatoes and water into a large jug or bowl, and stir in the sugar, salt and pepper, whisking it all together To make up the cheese layer: in a separate bowl beat the goats cheese, cream cheese, cheddar and ricotta with the eggs, nutmeg, and salt and pepper to taste To assemble the lasagne, begin by putting 500ml of the cold tomato sauce in the bottom of a roasting tin. Step 5: Then layer with a third of the lasagne sheets, overlapping them well.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red pepper, green pepper, onion, garlic clove, salt, fresh ground black pepper, tomato sauce, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a medium size skillet saute the peppers and onion in the oil over medium heat for 4- 5 minutes. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Transfer the peppers and onion to an ovenproof casserole dish and sprinkle with the garlic. Step 5: Pour tomato sauce over and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Step 6: Place the casserole dish, uncovered, in the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes This is lovely served with grilled steak.

Ingredient Names: garlic-infused balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, parmigiano, asiago cheese, italian bread, cracker
Instructions: Step 1: Grate your asaigo cheese. Step 2: Pour on a plate with a lip, both oils, balsamic vinegar oil and evoo. Step 3: Add parmigiano cheese and grated asaigo cheese. Step 4: Mix with a fork Apply to bread or crackers We had this last night for new years eve Very light and different Taken from a wegmans' add with recipes.

Dish Name: Bread Dipping Olive Oil Similar To Bravo
Ingredient Names: olive oil, sun-dried tomato paste, dried basil, dried thyme, dried rosemary, garlic, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pour olive oil in a bowl and add sun dried tomato paste. Step 2: Pour basil, thyme, and rosemary into the palm of your hand and then crush the spices by rolling them in between your thumb and pointer finger. Step 3: Add to the oil mixture. Step 4: Add the garlic and pepper. Step 5: Using a fork, stir / mix the spices into the oil. Step 6: Allow to sit at room temp for about 4 hours for the flavors to start to blend if you have time Otherwise, go ahead and serve it right away.

Dish Name: Bread Machine Abm Rustic Style Ciabatta
Ingredient Names: warm water, active dry yeast, sugar, kosher salt, bread flour, whole wheat flour, olive oil, cornmeal, flour, dried rosemary, marjoram
Instructions: Step 1: In the bread machine's basin, proof the yeast by pouring in the warm water and dissolving the pinch of sugar in it then sprinkling the yeast on top-- if you don't have a 1 / 8 teaspoon size or a sliding measuring spoon, just leave few millimeters of leeway in a 1 / 2 tsp size spoon. Step 2: Let the yeast proof for 10 minutes with the bread machine's lid open. Step 3: Add the flours and salt and blend well by hand or slowly with a dough hook until the flour has completely absorbed the water If you want add rosemary or other herbs, add them now too and blend. Step 4: Pour on the olive oil around the bin but don't blend it in by hand Close the bread machine and set it for a 2-lb loaf at the dough cycle Kick back and let it do its work! Step 5: When the dough cycle ends, leave it in the machine, covered, for 20-30 minutes to rise. Step 6: After the rise is complete, preheat the oven to 425f. Step 7: Grease an 11 x 7 pan with the 1 / 2 tsp olive oil-- not a loaf pan.

Ingredient Names: egg substitute, dried breadcrumbs, low-fat parmesan cheese, dried basil, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, zucchini, olive oil flavored cooking spray, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Prepare baking sheet with heavy spray of non-stick cooking spray. Step 3: Place eggs or egg substitute in shallow bowl, set aside. Step 4: Mix together dry ingredients in another shallow bowl, set aside. Step 5: Cut zucchini into fingers 3 / 8"x3" Dip zucchini into egg substitute, then roll in bread crumbs, coating thoroughly. Step 6: Place on baking sheet Lightly spray tops of zucchini with non-stick spray.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, broccoli, garlic cloves, brie cheese, walnuts, kosher salt, capers
Instructions: Step 1: In a 6-quart kettle bring 5 quarts salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add spaghetti and cook until al dente Reserve 1 / 3 cup cooking liquid and drain pasta in a colander. Step 3: Return pasta to kettle with reserved liquid While pasta is cooking, in a large heavy skillet heat oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and cook broccoli with salt to taste, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and cook, stirring, until golden, about 30 seconds. Step 5: Add broccoli mixture, brie, and walnuts, tossing until cheese is just melted If desired, season with salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Broccoli Aglio Olio With Garlic And Olive Oil
Ingredient Names: broccoli floret, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Steam broccoli over a pot of boiling water, or in a veggie steamer, for about 5 minutes Feel free to steam more or less, depending on how your family likes their veggies cooked. Step 2: Keep in mind that you will also be sauting the broccoli in the next step. Step 3: In a large saute pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 4: Add the garlic and saute for about 45 seconds to impart its flavors into the oil Before the garlic begins to brown, add the red pepper flakes and broccoli to the pan and cook for another 5 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Ingredient Names: frozen broccoli, pizza dough, green onions, part-skim ricotta cheese, gorgonzola, fontina cheese, parmesan cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, flour, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425. Step 2: In a med bowl, mix the broccoli, green onions, ricotta, gorgonzola, parmesan and fontina. Step 3: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 4: Sprinkle a large baking sheet with flour Unfold the dough and gently stretch and / or roll the dough to an 11-inch square. Step 5: Cut the dough in half diagonally, forming 2 triangles. Step 6: Place half of the filling in the center of each traingle. Step 7: Fold one side of each triangle over the filling, forming 2 triangle calzones. Step 8: Press the edges of the dough to seal. Step 9: Cut 3 slits in the top of each to allow steam to escape.

Dish Name: Broccoli Cauliflower With Garlic Lemon Italy
Ingredient Names: broccoli, cauliflower, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a steamer cook the broccoli & cauliflower for 8 minutes or until just tender, then drain & run under cold water to stop the cooking. Step 2: Drain again & set aside. Step 3: Put 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the garlic & cook for 3 minutes, or until it is golden, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add drained vegetables & turn heat to high, cooking & stirring only when necessary, until vegetables begin to brown. Step 5: Add lemon zest & cook another minute. Step 6: Add remaining tablespoon of olive oil & the lemon juice, then taste & adjust seasoning. Step 7: Serve hot or at room temperature.

Dish Name: Broccoli Florets With Sun Dried Tomatoes Over Penne
Ingredient Names: penne pasta, olive oil, broccoli florets, onion, garlic, sun-dried tomato, chipotle pepper, dried italian seasoning, water, fresh basil, cheese, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pan add broccoli stir fry 2 minutes: add onions and stir fry 1 minute. Step 2: Add garlic, sundried tomatoes, chipotle, and italian herbs stir fry one minute. Step 3: Add cup of broth bring to boil and lower heat. Step 4: Cover and simmer till broccoli is tender about 5 minutes. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper if needed and top with fresh basil and sprinkle with grated cheese of your choice & or pine nuts.

Ingredient Names: broccoli floret, tomato sauce, plum tomatoes, italian stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, burgundy wine, fresh basil leaves, garlic, bay leaves, lasagna noodles, firm tofu, scallion, garlic cloves, broccoli, nutritional yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Blanch broccoli florets for 30 seconds in boiling water, then place broccoli in ice water to stop cooking process, set aside. Step 2: Stir tomato ingredients together in saucepan over med-low heat, add wine and stir. Step 3: Add spices and simmer. Step 4: Cook noodles and rinse in cool water. Step 5: Place tofu in a mixing bowl and mash with hands, potato masher or whisk. Step 6: Add all remaining ingredients except basil for garnish and stir, creating a ricotta-like mixture. Step 7: Drain noodle and cover a 9x13 pan with tomato sauce mixture.

Dish Name: Broccoli Pasta In A Fresh Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: pasta, broccoli floret, water, tomatoes, onion, dried basil, oregano, dried parsley, olive oil, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook for about 5-8 minutes. Step 3: Stir in broccoli and cook 5-8 minutes more, or until pasta is al dente. Step 4: Drain, reserving 1 / 2 cup of the water. Step 5: Heat oil in a medium saucepan and saute the chopped onion until translucent. Step 6: Add the chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper, and 1 / 2 cup of the pasta-broccoli water. Step 7: Cover the saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Uncover, increase the flame to high, and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the most of the water has evaporated. Step 9: Remove from heat and season with basil, parsley and oregano. Step 10: Stir in the cooked pasta-broccoli mixture and mix well to coat.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, broccoli, garlic, lemon, chili flakes, pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta aaccording to packet instructions. Step 2: Boil broccoli for 4 minutes, drain and return to the pan. Step 3: Mash the broccoli and add the grated garlic and the zest of the lemon, add the chilli and pine nuts. Step 4: Drain the pasta and add the pesto. Step 5: Cut the lemon in half and squeeze over the juice. Step 6: Pour in the olive oil and season to taste. Step 7: Add the cheese, toss the pasta and serve.

Dish Name: Broccoli Rabe With Garlic And Pasta With Vegetarian Sausage
Ingredient Names: broccoli rabe, garlic, dried hot peppers, extra virgin olive oil, salt, vegetarian italian sausages, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Cut broccoli rabe all the way down to end of stems. Step 2: Cut in about 1 / 2 inch sections on top and get smaller as you go down. Step 3: When stems get very tough towards bottom stop cutting and discard. Step 4: Wash thoroughly and drain. Step 5: Place in large pot cover with water add salt. Step 6: Bring to boil uncovered and then reduce heat. Step 7: Simmer until all is soft about 45 minutes. Step 8: Drain when cooked set aside At the same time broccoli is cooking, cook pasta in rapidly boiling salted water. Step 9: Drain when cooked and put aside.

Dish Name: Broccoli Rabe With Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: rapini, sun-dried tomatoes, olive oil, garlic cloves, water, salt and pepper, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the rapini in lots of water, removing any loose dirt & the bottom portion of the stems which appear tough. Step 2: Cut into 4-inch lengths. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large saute pan over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the garlic and saute until slightly softened, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add the rapini, just enough water or stock to add moisture to the bottom for cooking, sun-dried tomatoes, salt and pepper. Step 6: Cover and simmer until desired tenderness, about 15-30 minutes adding extra water if needed. Step 7: Remove the lid and allow the water to evaporate. Step 8: Garnish with crushed pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: fresh broccoli, garlic cloves, olive oil, black pepper, water, salt, spaghetti, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the broccoli fine and add it to a sauce pan. Step 2: Add garlic, olive oil, pepper and the water and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for 30 minutes Break up the broccoli as it cooks so that the end result is a mushy, slightly chunky green sauce You may need to add more water or oil to keep it at a 'wet', pourable consistency if the liquid evaporates too quickly You basically want it to be the thickness of a tomato pasta sauce. Step 4: Add salt to taste I only add the salt at the end, because if you do so earlier on, the saltiness may become more intense when the mixture reduces. Step 5: Serve over cooked spaghetti. Step 6: Sprinkle with parm if desired.

Dish Name: Broccoli With Garlic And White Wine
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, broccoli, dry white wine, red chili pepper flakes, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saute pan, heat the olive oil and garlic until just sizzling. Step 2: Add the broccoli and cook, tossing regularly for 8 to 10 minutes, until the stem is tender Use the wine to slow the cooking down if the garlic begins to brown. Step 3: When the broccoli is tender, add the chile flakes and zest and place on a platter.

Dish Name: Broccoli With Garlic And White Wine Broccoli Con Aglio E Frasca
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, broccoli, dry white wine, red chili pepper flakes, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a 12 to 14 inch saute pan, heat the olive oil and garlic until just sizzling. Step 2: Add the broccoli and cook, tossing regularly for 8-10 minutes, until the stem is tender Use the wine to slow the cooking down if the garlic begins to brown. Step 3: When the broccoli is tender, add the chili flakes and zest. Step 4: Place on platter and enjoy!

Dish Name: Broccoli With Sun Dried Tomatoes And Roasted Garlic
Ingredient Names: frozen broccoli florets, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil with herbs, olive oil, roasted garlic, red pepper flakes, onion flakes, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In microwave proof bowl cook broccoli till heated through about 4 minutes Mix remaining ingredients and toss to coat broccoli heat 1 minute in microwave.

Dish Name: Broiled Polenta With Mushrooms And Cheese
Ingredient Names: boiling water, dried porcini mushrooms, water, salt, cornmeal, olive oil, mushrooms, garlic clove, dry white wine, mozzarella cheese, smoked cheddar cheese, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: If you use the porcini mushrooms, pleace them in a bowl, cover with the boiling water, and set aside for about 10 minutes. Step 2: In a saucepan, bring the 3 cups water and salt to a rapid boil. Step 3: Add the cornmeal in a thin, steady stream, whisking to prevent lumps. Step 4: Lower the heat to simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking until the polenta thickens While the polenta cooks, strain the porcini mushrooms and rinse them. Step 5: Heat the oil in a skillet and saute the 1 1 / 2 cups mushrooms, garlic, and porcini on medium heat until the oil is absorbed, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Stir in the wine and add salt. Step 7: Simmer gently for another minute or two. Step 8: Preheat the broiler. Step 9: Spread the polenta in and oiled pie plate or casserole dish.

Dish Name: Brown Bag Ideas Ciao Down Sandwich
Ingredient Names: chive & onion cream cheese, dried basil, italian bread, red pepper, green pepper, olive
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cream cheese& basil Spread on slice of bread Top with peppers, olives& second slice of bread Cover with plastic wrap.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, olive oil, asparagus, red pepper, yellow pepper, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the rice according to the directions on the package. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium hear. Step 3: Add asparagus and peppers and saut 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Step 4: Stir in pine nuts and rice and heat through. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper and top with parmesan cheese is desired.

Ingredient Names: fudge brownie mix, ground almonds, all-purpose flour, baking powder, egg, egg whites, almond extract, sliced almonds, white baking chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the brownie mix, ground almonds, flour and baking powder. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk egg, egg whites and extract. Step 3: Add to brownie mixture. Step 4: Stir until combined. Step 5: Divide dough into thirds On a greased baking sheet, shape each portion into a 7 inch X 3-1 / 2 inch rectangle. Step 6: Bake at 350 for 24 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the oven. Step 8: Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, coarse salt, country bread, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: In a bowl, combine the tomatoes, basil, olive oil, vinegar, and salt, toss well. Step 3: Place the bread on a baking sheet and broil, turning once, until lightly toasted on both sides, about two minuted total. Step 4: Remove from the broiler and immediately rub one side of each slice with the garlic cloves. Step 5: Arrange the grilled bread, garlic side up, on a serving platter, and spoon on the tomatoes, dividing evenly, serve at once.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, parmesan cheese, italian dressing, mozzarella cheese, bread
Instructions: Step 1: Toast bread Combine everything else and top on bread Broil for a few minutes to melt cheese.

Ingredient Names: baguette, roma tomatoes, fresh parmesan cheese, olive oil, garlic clove, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Mix fresh pressed garlic and olive oil in a bowl. Step 2: Cut baguette or sourdough loaf into individual slices. Step 3: Using basting brush, brush oil mixture onto one side of each slice. Step 4: Place a slice or two of roma tomato onto the oiled side of each piece of bread. Step 5: Sprinkle fresh shredded parmesan cheese over top. Step 6: Add italian seasoning to taste. Step 7: Place all slices of bread on a cookie sheet or toaster oven pan & broil until cheese is bubbling I've also used chopped roma tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: other italian pasta, red onion, garlic clove, tomatoes, salt, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in boiling water and drain Dice onion, garlic and tomatoes. Step 2: Mix tomato mix in bowl with salt and add balsamic vinegar, soak. Step 3: Mix pasta with tomato mix. Step 4: Drizzle olive oil and mix.

Dish Name: Bruschetta Topped With Tomatoes And Capers
Ingredient Names: italian bread, olive oil, tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic cloves, small capers, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Place bread slices on ungreased cookie sheet. Step 3: Drizzle 1 teaspoon oil on each slice bread. Step 4: Bake about 8 minutes or until golden brown While bread is toasting, mix remaining ingredients. Step 5: Spoon tomato mixture onto bread slices. Step 6: Serve at at room temperature.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Caramelized Onion And Fresh Basil
Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, onion, sugar, fresh basil, french baguette, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven on broil. Step 2: Heat the butter and olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion and sugar. Step 4: Cook 15-20 minutes or until very soft and golden brown Stirring frequently, remove from heat. Step 5: Cool mixture slightly then stir in the fresh basil. Step 6: Cut baguette into 1 / 2" slices. Step 7: Place bread slices on a baking sheet Broil the bread for 2 minutes or until toasted.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Honey And Gorgonzola Cheese
Ingredient Names: baguette, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, gorgonzola, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f. Step 2: Arrange the sliced baguette on a baking sheet Rub garlic clove over bread and then brush with olive oil. Step 3: Bake until the bread is pale golden and crisp, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Arrange the cheese on the toasts and bake until the cheese is melted, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Drizzle the toasts with honey. Step 6: Place on a serving platter and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh oregano, garlic, italian bread, olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix chopped tomatoes, oregano& garlic. Step 2: Let stand 10 minutes at room temperature. Step 3: Brush bread slices with oil. Step 4: Place about 4 tsp tomato mixture on top of each bread slice& sprinkle with cheese. Step 5: Place on baking sheet& bake at 350f for 5 minutes Broil for a couple of minutes or until golden brown& cheese melts.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Pesto Mozzarella And Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: french baguette, olive oil, garlic cloves, mozzarella cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, basil leaves, parmesan cheese, pine nuts, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the olive oil and the garlic in small bowl and let sit for at least 1 / 2 an hour. Step 2: Preheat the broiler. Step 3: Spread the bread slices on a baking sheet and then brush both sides with the olive oil Broil until golden on both sides. Step 4: Place the tomatoes in a cup and cover with boiling water. Step 5: After about 5 minutes, remove, pat dry and cut into long thin strips. Step 6: Spread cooled brushetta with pesto of your choosing, a slice of mozzarella and a strip of sun-dried tomato To make red pesto: place all ingredients except oil in food processor Process adding oil gradually until it forms a paste To make basil pesto: place all ingredients except oil in food processor.

Dish Name: Bruschetta With Roasted Garlic And Cherry Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: italian bread, garlic clove, basil leaves, jalapeno, tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, capers, carrots, red onion, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Toast bread in broiler or on grill Rub with raw garlic clove. Step 2: Mix the topping ingredients together and place in a bowl. Step 3: Serve topped with garlic rubbed bread or let everyone help themselves to top their own.

Dish Name: Brussels Sprouts With Almonds And Lemon Rind
Ingredient Names: brussels sprout, almonds, lemon rind, plain breadcrumbs, butter, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and chop the hard ends off the brussels sprouts. Step 2: Cut each brussels sprout in half, then, with flat surfaces down, sliver each brussels sprout into three to five parts If you're running low on time, leave brussels sprouts whole and steam them while you are preparing the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: Using a food processor or a knife, roughly chop almonds so that pieces are no smaller than corn kernels. Step 4: Using a peeler, peel several strips of rind off a carefully washed lemon Mince strips. Step 5: In a medium saucepan, melt butter. Step 6: Once fully melted but not smoking, add almonds, lemon rind, and plain bread crumbs Sautee until golden brown. Step 7: Add brussels sprouts to pan with a dribble of water, olive oil, or a mixture of the two so ingredients do not burn.

Dish Name: Buca Di Beppo Red Wine Vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: red wine vinegar, dried oregano, dry mustard, salt, black pepper, red onion, garlic, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender container, combine the red wine vinegar, oregano, dry mustard, salt and pepper. Step 2: Stir in the onion and garlic. Step 3: Blend together while slowly adding the olive oil. Step 4: Allow to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: pasta, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, shallot, chili flakes, olive, capers, chickpeas, flat leaf parsley, mint leaf, salt and black pepper, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Toast bread and turn into crumbs by tearing up and blending it in a blender. Step 2: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 3: Cook bucatini for about 8 minutes, until al dente. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat oil in a very large skillet. Step 5: Add garlic and shallots and saute until soft. Step 6: Add chili flakes, olives, capers and chickpeas and cook another minute or so. Step 7: Cook until ingredients are warm and remove from heat. Step 8: Drain pasta and reserve about 1 cup water. Step 9: Add pasta, parsley and mint to skillet. Step 10: Return to low heat and toss well.

Dish Name: Bucatini Alla Lipari Bucatini With Nut Pesto And Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, tomatoes with juice, salt and pepper, garlic cloves, hot red pepper flakes, extra virgin olive oil, mixed nuts, fresh mint leaves, pepper, salt, pasta, mint leaf, pecorino cheese
Instructions: Step 1: For tomato sauce: heat oil and saute onion until translucent. Step 2: Add garlic and tomatoes with their juices, breaking up the tomatoes with a wooden spoon. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Simmer uncovered until most of the juices have evaporated, 20-30 minutes For pesto: in a food processor or blender, combine garlic, hot pepper flakes, olive oil, nuts and mint Pulse to make a coarse paste. Step 5: Season with black pepper to taste and set aside For pasta: bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Step 6: Add bucatini and cook until al dente. Step 7: Set aside 1 / 2 cup pasta water and drain pasta.

Ingredient Names: pancetta, olive oil, red onion, hot red pepper flakes, italian tomatoes, kosher salt, pasta, unsalted butter, ricotta salata
Instructions: Step 1: If using, cut pancetta into i / 4 inch dice. Step 2: Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium-low heat. Step 3: Add pancetta and cook, stirring, until it crisps and renders its fat, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove pancetta and set aside Break into small pieces when cooled. Step 5: Remove all but about 1 tablespoon of fat from the pan and discard. Step 6: Add oil and onion and cook, stirring often, until tender and translucent, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Add red pepper flakes then add tomatoes and crush against the pan if using whole. Step 8: Cook, stir and crush tomatoes into small bits, for 5 minutes. Step 9: Simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Dish Name: Buckwheat Cake Torta Di Grano Saraceno
Ingredient Names: whole almond, buckwheat flour, salt, cinnamon, lemon, baking powder, unsalted butter, sugar, milk, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f / 175c spread the almonds on a baking sheet and toast until golden and fragrant, about 10-12 minutes, cool completely. Step 2: Grease a 9-inch / 23cm springform pan and set aside. Step 3: In a food processor or clean coffee grinder, grind the almonds as finely as possible with 1 / 4 cup of the sugar. Step 4: In a medium bowl, stir together the ground almonds, buckwheat flour, salt, cinnamon, lemon zest and baking powder In another bowl, beat the butter and 1 cup of the sugar until fluffy. Step 5: Add the egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 6: Beat in the dry mixture alternately with the milk until everything is well combined. Step 7: In a clean mixing bowl and using spotlessly clean beaters, whip the egg whites with the remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar until they form stiff, glossy peaks. Step 8: Stir one-quarter of the whites into the cake batter to lighten it, then gently fold in the rest.

Dish Name: Butternut Squash And Potatoes With Rosemary Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: potatoes, butternut squash, garlic cloves, salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, rosemary sprigs, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients except the water into the slow cooker and toss to combine. Step 2: Add the water and cook on high until the vegetables are tender, about 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours.

Ingredient Names: butter, olive oil, onions, garlic, butternut squash, vegetable broth, orzo pasta, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep skillet, melt butter with oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and cook for about 6 minutes, or until tender and starting to brown. Step 3: Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add squash and stir. Step 5: Add 1/2 cup chicken broth and simmer over medium heat until liquid is absorbed and squash is barely tender. Step 6: While it is simmering, bring the remaining broth to a boil. Step 7: Add orzo and cook for about 8 minutes, until cooked al dente. Step 8: Drain any excess liquid. Step 9: Combine squash mixture with orzo and heat together for a few minutes, until the squash is tender. Step 10: Pour into a bowl and toss with basil and cheese. Step 11: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Butternut Squash Risotto With Spinach And Toasted Pine Nuts
Ingredient Names: olive oil, butternut squash, table salt, ground black pepper, vegetable broth, water, baby spinach, unsalted butter, onions, garlic cloves, arborio rice, dry white wine, parmesan cheese, fresh sage leaves, fresh nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Step 2: Add about 3 1 / 2 cups squash in even layer and cook without stirring until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until squash is tender and browned, about 5 minutes longer. Step 4: Transfer squash to bowl and set aside. Step 5: Return skillet to medium heat. Step 6: Add reserved squash fibers and seeds and any leftover diced squash. Step 7: Cook, stirring frequently to break up fibers, until lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Step 8: Transfer to large saucepan and add vegetable broth and water. Step 9: Cover saucepan and bring mixture to simmer over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low to maintain bare simmer.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, basil leaves, butternut squash, fine sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the pistou: Put the olive oil, garlic, basil leaves and a pinch of salt in a small food processor. Step 2: Blend well and transfer to a small bowl To prepare the squash: Preheat the oven to 400f Trin the stem, then cut the squash lengthwise Scoop out the seeds. Step 3: Put the squash halves cut side up in a roasting pan. Step 4: Sprinkle the cut sides with salt. Step 5: Brush generously with the pistou, and let some well up in the seed cavity.

Ingredient Names: king edward potato, clarified butter, butternut squash, swede, pumpkin, olive oil, unsalted butter, onions, garlic, rosemary, sage, butter, chestnuts, vegetable stock, flour, cornflour, sparkling water, vegetable oil, sage leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice the potato lengthways. You need about 15 slices – make extra in case you break a few. Trim the sides to make 6 x 12cm rectangles. Blanch in salted boiling water for 1 min, then remove and set aside. Blanch the 25g each squash, swede and pumpkin for 1 min. Refresh in cold water, drain and set aside. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan. Cook the remaining swede for a few mins until slightly coloured, then add the remaining squash and pumpkin and fry until lightly browned. Add the 25g butter and onion and cook for 5 mins, then add the garlic, rosemary, sage and some seasoning. Cover and cook for 5-10 mins until the veg are soft. Set aside. Step 3: For the chestnut purée, heat the butter in a pan until foaming, then cook the chestnuts until golden and caramelised. Remove a few for the garnish, then add the stock and bring to the boil. Blend until smooth, then season. Step 4: To assemble cannelloni, brush potato slices with clarified butter on both sides. Place a spoonful of squash mix on one end of each slice and roll up. (Don’t overfill or they won’t hold their shape.) Sit them on a tray lined with baking parchment, seam-side down, cover, set aside or chill. Step 5: To serve, heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Cook cannelloni on the tray for 10-12 mins, then brown under a low grill. Step 6: Meanwhile, for the tempura sage, whisk together the flour, cornflour and sparkling water. Heat a layer of vegetable oil in a small, deep saucepan. Dip the sage leaves in the batter, then fry until crispy. Remove to kitchen paper, lightly season and keep warm. Step 7: Heat the remaining tbsp olive oil and fry the reserved vegetables until golden. Season, add a little butter and the reserved chestnuts, and keep warm. Reheat the chestnut purée, then spread onto 2-3 plates. Arrange some cannelloni, vegetable mix and tempura sage on top.

Dish Name: Cabbage Casserole With Leeks And Pine Nuts
Ingredient Names: cabbage leaves, cooking spray, olive oil, leeks, vegetable broth, lemons, garlic cloves, chopped tomatoes, fresh parsley, low fat cottage cheese, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch cabbage leaves in a large pot of boiling salted water 7 minutes, or until softened. Step 2: Drain, pat dry, and set aside. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350f Coat 8" square baking dish with cooking spray. Step 4: Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Step 5: Add leeks and broth. Step 6: Season with salt, if you like. Step 7: Place lemon slices on top and bring to a simmer. Step 8: Cover, reduce heat to medium low and cook 25 minutes. Step 9: Drain in colander, remove lemon, pat leeks dry and set aside.

Ingredient Names: fresh garlic, lowfat silken tofu, water, lemon juice, white miso, dijon mustard, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, vegetarian worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place garlic in a food processor and chop fine Scrape down sides, add all ingredients, and process until smooth (to make vegan add a parmesan substitute like soy cheese or nutritional yeast).

Ingredient Names: fresh yeast, apple juice concentrate, plain flour, whole wheat flour, extra virgin olive oil, salt, pasta sauce, fresh parsley, artichoke hearts, mushrooms, water, baby spinach, ricotta cheese, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Mix yeast and apple conc with 1 tbsp warm water. Step 2: Mix flours and make a well in the centre Into it put the oil, salt, yeast and water. Step 3: Knead to form a soft dough Rest for 15 minutes. Step 4: Preheat oven to 200c / 400f. Step 5: Divide dough in four and roll into a 8 inch circle. Step 6: Spread 1 tbsp tomato sauce on the dough and sprinkle with 1 / 2 parsley. Step 7: Arrange the mushrooms, spinach and artichoke on one side of the pizza. Step 8: Mix the ricotta with the egg and spoon 1 / 4 over the fillings.

Ingredient Names: flour tortilla, part-skim mozzarella cheese, garlic powder, basil leaves, oregano leaves, crushed red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese, tomato sauce, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet on medium-high, add olive oil. Step 2: When skillet is heated, put tortilla in pan. Step 3: Add mozzarella cheese, then herbs, spices and optional ingredients to one half of tortilla. Step 4: Fold tortilla over onto ingredients Use a lid from a large pot or skillet to cover. Step 5: Cook for about 30-45 seconds, or until tortilla starts to get light brown spots. Step 6: Flip tortilla, cover and cook for an additional 30-45 seconds, also until light brown spots, serve hot.

Dish Name: Campari Sorbetto Intermezzo From The Hags
Ingredient Names: pink grapefruits, caster sugar, campari, angostura bitters
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients until sugar dissolves Churn in an ice cream maker, according to manufacturer's instructions.

Ingredient Names: seitan, whole wheat flour, olive oil, shallot, yellow onion, capers, garlic, dry white wine, fresh lemon juice, low sodium vegetable broth, fresh parsley, vegan margarine, salt, ground black pepper, caper berries
Instructions: Step 1: Dredge seitan cutlets in flour, shaking off excess. Step 2: Heat 1 to 2 tablespoons olive oil in skillet over high heat Saut cutlets in oil 30 seconds per side, or until crisp and golden brown. Step 3: Remove seitan from skillet, and drain on paper-towel-lined plate. Step 4: Add remaining olive oil to skillet, and return to high heat. Step 5: Add shallots, onion, capers, and garlic, and saut 1 to 2 minutes, or until softened, stirring frequently. Step 6: Whisk in wine and lemon juice, and cook 3 to 5 minutes more. Step 7: Add broth, and bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium, and simmer 1 minute to combine flavors. Step 9: Whisk in parsley, margarine, salt, and pepper.

Dish Name: Cannellini Beans With Crushed Red Pepper
Ingredient Names: cannellini beans, dried red pepper flakes, olive oil, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a serving bowl, combine the beans, red pepper flakes, olive oil and salt to taste Mash the beans a little bit, leaving some whole Gently stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, green bell pepper, onion, garlic clove, cannellini beans, reduced-sodium vegetable broth, tomatoes, orange juice, orange peel, fresh rosemary, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, warm the oil. Step 2: Add the green peppers, onion, and garlic, and saute for 4 minutes or until the peppers are soft. Step 3: Add the beans, broth, tomatoes, orange juice, orange peel, and rosemary. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Uncover, sprinkle with black pepper, and cook stirring occasionally for about 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, frozen chopped spinach, egg, parmesan cheese, dried basil, salt, pepper, cannelloni tubes, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ricotta, spinach, egg, 1 / 2 the parmesan and seasonings, mix well. Step 2: Fill cannelloni tubes with this mixture. Step 3: Spread 1 / 2 the pasta sauce in a baking pan and arrange stuffed cannelloni in single layer over it cover the cannelloni with the remaining sauce, making sure to cover all pasta sprinkle with remaining parmesan. Step 4: Cover with foil and bake at 350 for about 45 minutes.

Dish Name: Cannelloni Two Ways Spinach Ricotta Beef Ragu
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh thyme, bay leaf, ground beef, dry red wine, whole tomatoes, salt and pepper, egg, fresh spinach, ricotta cheese, cheese, shallot, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Make the beef ragu first, it's the longest step: Heat the oil over a medium heat. Step 2: Add the onions and saut for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, thyme and bay leaf and saut for a further 5 minutes until the onions and garlic are soft but not browned. Step 4: Add the ground beef and saut for 5 minutes until the beef is almost cooked through but still a bit pink. Step 5: Stir in the red wine. Step 6: Add the tomatoes with their juices and bring to a gentle simmer uncovered over medium to low heat, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour Sauce should thicken. Step 7: Remove bay leaf and thyme sprig and season to taste. Step 8: Allow the ragu to cool before rolling it up in the lasagna sheets.

Dish Name: Capellini Alla Piemontese Angel Hair Piemontese Style
Ingredient Names: fresh italian parsley, walnuts, fresh thyme leave, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, red bell peppers, orange bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, onions, angel hair pasta, fontina cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine parsley, walnuts, thyme and garlic cloves in bowl of food processor and blend until finely chopped With machine running, gradually add 1 / 2 cup olive oil processing until well blended. Step 2: Season the pesto with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the peppers, onions and finely chopped garlic and saute until the peppers are crisp tender, about 15 minutes. Step 5: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 6: Add angel hair pasta and cook until tender but firm to the bite, stirring often to prevent the pasta from sticking, about 4 minutes. Step 7: Drain, reserving 2 cups of cooking liquid. Step 8: Toss the pasta with pesto, bell pepper mixture and cheese in a large bowl to combine, adding enough reserved cooking liquid to moisten.
