Step 9: Season the pasta to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, plum tomatoes, fresh basil, olive oil, fresh parmesan cheese, angel hair pasta, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil and add garlic, cook until garlic turns white. Step 2: Add diced tomatoes and pepper. Step 3: Heat through stirring constantly About 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and add basil and half of the cheese. Step 5: Toss gently with the pasta. Step 6: Serve at once and top with remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, garlic, yellow bell pepper, zucchini, fresh mushrooms, carrot, vegetable broth, fresh basil, black pepper, diced fire-roasted tomatoes, parmesan cheese, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta"al dente" in boiling water. Step 2: Drain and set aside While pasta is cooking, coat a large skillet with olive oil cooking spray or drizzle a tsp Or so in and swirl, heat on medium. Step 3: Add the garlic and saute for a minute or so, or just until the garlic starts to release fragrance Do not scorch garlic. Step 4: Add the mushrooms, broth, and basil to the skillet. Step 5: Cover and cook over medium-low heat for about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the zucchini, bell pepper, and carrots to the skillet.

Dish Name: Capellini With Tomato And Arugula Rocket
Ingredient Names: sea salt, capellini, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, roma tomatoes, salt & fresh ground pepper, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 5 litres water to boil, add salt and pasta cook until al dente. Step 2: Meanwhile heat olive oil in pan and fry garlic until lightly browned. Step 3: Add tomatoes and pinch of salt. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes on high heat. Step 5: Reduce heat and addrocket leaves and cook further 2 minutes. Step 6: Drain pasta reserving a little liquid. Step 7: Return pasta to saucepan, add liquid and stir through tomato sauce. Step 8: Season to taste and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Capellini With Tomatoes Garlic And Basil
Ingredient Names: olive oil flavored cooking spray, garlic, fresh tomatoes, fresh basil leaf, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, capellini, olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly coat a heavy nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Step 2: Place over medium heat and add the garlic slices. Step 3: Cook slowly until garlic is lightly and evenly browned. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and add tomatoes, basil, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Cook just until the tomatoes are heated through, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, cook capellini according to package directions to al dente. Step 7: Drain and place on a pasta plate or in a large bowl. Step 8: Drizzle pasta with olive oil and toss to evenly coat. Step 9: Arrange the hot tomato mixture on top and sprinkle with parmesan cheese shavings. Step 10: Serve at once, tossing the mixture as you serve.

Dish Name: Caponata Eggplant And Lots Of Good Things
Ingredient Names: rosemary oil, eggplant, celery, onion, garlic cloves, diced tomato, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, black olives, capers, salt, sugar, pine nuts, balsamic vinegar, fresh basil, fresh oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a large hot pan heat oil and stir fry eggplant till golden brown about 10 minutes add celery, onions, garlic, and tomatoes cook till tender about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes Stirring occasionally! Step 3: Jar or place in a sealed container and refrigerate over night Serve cooled Season with salt and pepper if needed.

Dish Name: Caponata From Loni Kuhn's S F Cooking Class
Ingredient Names: eggplants, onions, olive oil, celery, bell peppers, garlic cloves, tomatoes, red wine vinegar, salt, sugar, fresh basil, tomato paste, fresh italian parsley, fresh ground black pepper, stuffed green olive
Instructions: Step 1: Cut unpeeled eggplant into 1-inch cubes. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a 5- or 6-quart enameled cast iron casserole or dutch oven. Step 3: Add eggplant and onions and saute for 5 minutes until lightly golden (this step can be eliminated to save calories, although the recipe will not be as authentic If you like, just place raw eggplant and onions in casserole and proceed. Step 4: Add the remaining ingredients to casserole. Step 5: Stir gently but thoroughly and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Remove lid and simmer for about 10 minutes more or until thick. Step 7: Serve at room temperature in a bowl surrounded by sliced french or italian bread or as a salad on romaine leaves Will keep, under refrigeration, for 3 weeks.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, celery, eggplant, salt & freshly ground black pepper, red bell pepper, sun-dried tomatoes, onion, diced tomatoes, raisins, dried oregano leaves, balsamic vinegar, sugar, capers, ciabatta, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 4 cup of the oil in a heavy large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the celery and saute until crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the eggplant and saute until beginning to soften, about 2 minutes, season with salt. Step 4: Add the red pepper and cook until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the onion and saute until translucent, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the diced tomatoes with their juices, raisins, and oregano. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Step 8: Simmer over medium-low heat until the flavors blend and the mixture thickens, stirring often, about 20 minutes. Step 9: Add the vinegar, sugar, and capers.

Dish Name: Caponata With Poblanos And Roasted Garlic
Ingredient Names: garlic, oil, poblano chiles, olive oil, eggplants, yellow squash, celery, diced onions, diced tomatoes, black olives, capers, pine nuts, raisins, basil, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Place garlic in foil cut side up, drizzle with oil and wrap in foil. Step 2: In a very hot oven as hot as it can go place the poblano's and wrapped garlic on a cookie sheet. Step 3: Let chili`s crisp and brown turning. Step 4: Remove poblano`s and place in a bowl with a cover. Step 5: When cool enough to handle remove skin, seeds and stem Dice. Step 6: Turn oven off and leave garlic in oven. Step 7: In a large pot place oil to heat add eggplant and brown about 10 minutes, add squash, celery, onions, and tomatoes cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add remaining ingredients bring to a boil then simmer for 15 minutes If garlic wasn`t tender add now squeezing it into the mix of veggies.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, tomatoes, capers, red pepper flakes, balsamic vinegar, white bread, pesto sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, sea salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add tomatoes, capers, and pepper flakes Saut until just starting to break down, about 3 minutes Off heat, add vinegar. Step 3: Brush oil on one side of each slice of bread. Step 4: Spread the other sides with 1 tablespoon pesto. Step 5: Arrange mozzarella and tomato mixture on two slices of bread, then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 6: Top with another slice of bread, oiled side up Toast sandwiches in a skillet or panini press.

Ingredient Names: fresh mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, fresh basil, garlic clove, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl or jar, combine all of the vinaigrette ingredients and whisk or shake well to combine. Step 2: Set aside On long toothpicks, spear two mozzarella balls and two cherry tomatoes. Step 3: Arrange all of the picks on a platter. Step 4: Drizzle vinaigrette over the top and serve.

Ingredient Names: green beans, tomatoes, garlic clove, part-skim mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaves, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Parboil green beans in a pot of salted, boiling water for about 3 minutes, or until just slightly tender. Step 2: Strain and place beans in bowl of cold water to keep beans from cooking further and to bring them to room temperature On a large serving platter, cover bottom with a layer of green beans. Step 3: Then place the tomato slices in a single layer on top. Step 4: Cover each tomato with a thin slice of mozzarella. Step 5: Sprinkle the minced garlic and chopped basil on top. Step 6: In a small container, mix the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and salt until combined. Step 7: Drizzle over the salad and serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh mozzarella cheese, tomatoes, salt & fresh ground pepper, extra virgin olive oil, lemon, capers, fresh basil leaf, arugula leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Use a serrated knife to slice each ball of mozzarella into 4 slices. Step 2: Repeat with the tomatoes, cutting each into 4 slices Stack 2 slices of tomato and 2 slices of mozzarella, alternating as you stack, on each of 4 serving plates As you stack, season each tomato slice with a pinch of salt and pepper, set aside. Step 3: In a blender, combine the olive oil, lemon juice and [half] of the capers. Step 4: Puree until smooth. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Step 6: Drizzle a bit of the dressing over each mozzarella-tomato stack Scatter basil ribbons, a few of the remaining capers and a bit of the lemon zest over each stack.

Dish Name: Caramelized Onion And Goat Cheese Pizza
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, pizza crust, pizza sauce, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, goat cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add onion. Step 3: Cover and cook for 3 minutes. Step 4: Uncover and cook for 11 minutes or until golden brown, stirring frequently. Step 5: Place the pizza crust on a baking sheet. Step 6: Combine the sauce and tomatoes. Step 7: Spread sauce mixture over pizza crust. Step 8: Top with onion and cheese. Step 9: Bake at 450 for 10 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

Dish Name: Caramelized Onion And White Bean Flatbread
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onions, mushrooms, salt, whole wheat pizza dough, fresh oregano, coarse black pepper, white beans, water, white wine vinegar, plum tomatoes, smoked gouda cheese, nonstick cooking spray, pepitas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Place oven rack in the lowest positions. Step 3: Combine 2-1 / 2 tablespoons oil, onions and salt in a medium saucepan. Step 4: Cover and cook over medium-high heat, stirring often, until the onion is softened, about 7-9 minutes. Step 5: Now add 1-1 / 2 tablespoons more of oil, a little bit at a time, and add mushrooms and cook about 4 minutes longer Liquid needs to be absorbed. Step 6: Cook for another 5-7 minutes reducing heat to medium-low, uncovered and stirring occasionally, until very soft and golden. Step 7: Meanwhile, roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to the size of the baking sheet. Step 8: Bake until puffed and lightly crisped on the bottom, 8-10 minutes. Step 9: Stir oregano and pepper into the onion-mushroom mixture.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, garlic cloves, green zucchini, mint leaf, parmesan cheese, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta in a saucepan of salted boiling water for 10-12 minute3s or until al dente. Step 2: Drain, return to saucepan and keep warm. Step 3: Heat a medium non-stick frying pan over high heat. Step 4: Add the oil and the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Reduce the heat to low, add the zucchini and cook for 10 minutews or until soft and caramelized. Step 6: Add to the pasta with the mint, parmesan and tomatoes and toss to combine.

Ingredient Names: pasta, olive oil, onion, swiss chard, basil leaves, garlic cloves, serrano chili, pecorino romano cheese, cracked black pepper, eggs, bacon bits
Instructions: Step 1: Place olive oil and or bacon fat or butter in a large pan over medium high heat, add onions and saute for 3 minutes. Step 2: Add the sliced swiss chard stem and saute for 2 more minutes, add garlic and pepper flakes saute for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add swiss chard greens or baby spinach and basil and 1 / 2 cup pasta water to wilt. Step 4: Fill a small pot with boiling pasta water with at least 4 inches and a 1 / 2 teaspoon white vinegar Break each egg one at a time in to a small bowl then into the simmering water cover and poach for 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile toss cheese, black pepper and pasta in the vegetable mixture. Step 6: Add additional pasta water and or olive oil to your liking Plate the pasta mixture on to 4 plates. Step 7: Remove eggs from water with slotted spoon place one on each plate of pasta. Step 8: Garnish with bacon bits, additional pepper, cheese and basil if desired.

Ingredient Names: artichokes, lemon, breadcrumbs, pecorino cheese, flat-leaf italian parsley, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Remove as many as the outer leaves of the artichokes as look tough, bruised or split Don't worry about taking off too many There are plenty under there Trim the stem, but not too far, and create a flat bottom for the artichokes. Step 2: Cut off about 1 / 2 inch of the tops with a sharp blade. Step 3: Rinse each artichoke under water, and place in a large bowl of water into which you have squeezed half the lemon This acidulated water will keep them from turning brown on their cut edges. Step 4: Drain the artichokes upside down on a clean dish cloth, while you prepare the filling. Step 5: Put all the rest of the ingredients, except the olive oil, in a bowl and mix well. Step 6: Now, hold each trimmed artichoke over the bowl, and spread the leaves with the fingers of one hand, while filling the gaps with a teaspoon and the bread crumb mixture.

Ingredient Names: yellow onion, garlic, celery, carrots, mushroom, broccoli, tomato sauce, dried oregano, basil, chili flakes, salt, spaghetti, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put several tablespoons olive oil in a frying pan. Step 2: Add onions, celery, carrots and mushrooms and cook until almost soft At this point, add the broccoli and cook until all is al dente or soft. Step 3: Add garlic immediately and cook for a few minutes. Step 4: Add remaining sauce, herbs and salt and let simmer, covered. Step 5: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water. Step 6: Drain and combine with sauce.

Ingredient Names: carrots, zucchini, pesto sauce, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the carrots and zucchini into long, fine strands or ribbons by drawing a vegetable peeler down the length of them. Step 2: Pour 1 / 2 inch of boiling water into a saucepan and add the carrots. Step 3: Cover the pan, and half-boil, half-steam the carrots over moderate heat for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add the zucchini and cook for 1-2 minutes longer, drain. Step 5: Transfer the vegetables to a bowl, add the pesto and a little seasoning, mix well, and serve at once.

Ingredient Names: carrot, olive oil, garlic clove, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice carrot in to rounds. Step 2: Steam carrots till tender While steaming, mince garlic and tops Saut tops and garlic in oil. Step 3: Add carrots to tops saut, season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower florets, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, almond milk, nutritional yeast, fresh lemon juice, onion powder, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Rremove outer leaves and cut tough stem from cauliflower. Step 2: Steam in a large pot until fork tender, drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, add the oil into a skillet and saute the minced garlic over low heat for 4-5 minutes until softened and fragrant, but not browned. Step 4: In a high speed blender, add the cooked and drained cauliflower, sauteed garlic, milk, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Blend until a super smooth sauce forms. Step 6: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 7: Add your desired amount of pasta and boil for the time instructed on the package. Step 8: Drain pasta, reserving about a half cup of the water. Step 9: Add water, pasta and the cauliflower sauce into the pot and add the drained pasta.

Ingredient Names: leek, head cauliflower, low sodium vegetable broth, water, unsalted butter, rice, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash leek well in a bowl of cold water, then lift out and drain Blanch leek and cauliflower in a 4- to 5-quart pot of boiling salted water, uncovered, 1 minute. Step 2: Drain in a sieve and transfer to a bowl of cold water to stop cooking, drain well. Step 3: Bring broth and water to a boil in a 2- to 3-quart saucepan and keep broth at a bare simmer, covered. Step 4: Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a 4-quart heavy pot over moderately high heat until foam subsides, then saut cauliflower and leek, stirring, 2 minutes. Step 5: Add rice and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Step 6: Add 1 cup simmering broth and cook at a strong simmer, stirring, until absorbed, about 2 minutes Continue simmering and adding broth, about 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring frequently and letting each addition be absorbed before adding the next, until rice is just tender and creamy looking, 20 to 25 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat and stir in cheese, remaining tablespoon butter, and salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Cauliflower In Red Sauce Over Pasta
Ingredient Names: head cauliflower, onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, dried basil, crushed tomatoes, water, dry pasta, salt, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook according to package directions, make sure that your pasta is a little undercooked as you will finish it with the 'sauce' While the pasta is cooking, trim medium sized florets from large head of cauliflower Sautee onion, garlic and dried basil in olive oil till translucent and soft. Step 2: Add cauliflower florets and continue sauteeing another 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add crushed tomato, cover and simmer until cauliflower is tender. Step 4: Drain pasta, return to large pot, pour tomato / cauliflower mixture over the pasta and return to heat. Step 5: Allow the pasta to soak up some of the sauce while it finishes cooking. Step 6: Remove from heat, stir in 1 / 4 grated parmesan or locatelli and fresh basil. Step 7: Serve with additional gated cheese if desired.

Ingredient Names: head cauliflower, olive oil, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, low sodium vegetable broth, salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a medium stockpot filled with salted water to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add the cauliflower and cook until just tender, 4-5 minutes. Step 3: Drain well and set aside. Step 4: Place the oil in a stockpot and heat over medium heat. Step 5: Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Step 6: Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the cauliflower. Step 7: Cook, stirring often until just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the broth, salt and black pepper. Step 9: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 10: Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Parboil the cauliflower for five minutes in salted water then break it into florets. Step 2: Put the garlic and oil into a large pan or flameproof dish, heat through and then add the cauliflower, turning it over gently. Step 3: When it is well softened add the pured tomatoes and then cover. Step 4: Cook together gently for five minutes so that the flavours combine. Step 5: Taste for salt, remove the garlic and serve hot.

Dish Name: Celery With Tomatoes Olives And Capers
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, celery, diced tomato, capers, olives, fresh basil, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the oil on medium heat until shimmery. Step 2: Add the onion, stir well to coat with oil, let cook while preparing the celery Trim the celery ends, cut ribs in thirds lengthwise, then into two-inch lengths. Step 3: Add the celery, stir well, then let cook undisturbed for 4 minutes. Step 4: Stir, then pour in tomatoes, turn down the heat to medium low, cover and let cook until celery is tender, about 20 minutes. Step 5: Uncover and stir in capers and olives and cook til warmed through and tomato juice cooks almost all the way down, stir in basil, season to taste. Step 6: Serve immediately Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: new potatoes, olive oil, salt, black pepper, bamboo skewers
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until just tender, 15 minutes. Step 2: Cut in half and toss with oil, salt and pepper. Step 3: Thread potato halves on to skewers If grilling outdoors on the barbeque over medium coals, turning regularly, until lightly charred, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Serve hot If doing indoors, preheat broiler Broil, turning regularly, until lightly charred, 10 minutes Planning ahead: Pre-cook potatoes up to 1 day in advance. Step 5: Cut in half, toss in oil and skewer up to 2 hours in advance.

Ingredient Names: red onions, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, red wine vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, pitted black olives, oregano leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place onion halves cut sides down in shallow pan. Step 2: Bake at 425f for 30 minutes or until onions are slightly soft when squeezed and their cut sides are blackened. Step 3: When cool enough to handle, remove onion skins and trim stems. Step 4: Place onions in a food processor with olive oil, vinegars and red pepper flakes Process in two or three 2-second pulses or until coarsely chopped. Step 5: Add olives and oregano and process 2 to 4 seconds just until chopped.

Ingredient Names: mascarpone, custard, tia maria, instant coffee, water, sponge cake fingers, cocoa powder
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the water and dissolve the coffee in it, set aside to cool. Step 2: Beat the mascarpone and custard together. Step 3: Stir the tia maria into the coffee and dip sponge chunks into the liquid. Step 4: Divide a third of the mixture into four serving dishes. Step 5: Spoon over a third of the mascarpone / custard mix, and keep layering, finishing with the mascarpone / custard mix. Step 6: Sprinkle with cocoa and chill for 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: white bread, butter, garlic powder, italian seasoning, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Lay out each piece of white bread and cut off crusts. Step 2: Cut each piece of bread in half vertically. Step 3: Set bread aside and discard crusts. Step 4: In a small bowl mix together butter, garlic powder, italian seasoning and salt to taste. Step 5: Spread butter mixture thinly over one side of each slice of bread. Step 6: Place bread buttered side up on a small baking sheet and place in the broiler. Step 7: Let bread toast for about 3 or 4 minutes or until golden brown. Step 8: Remove from broiler and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, carnaroli rice, onion, leek, red pepper, dry white wine, vegetable bouillon cubes, mushrooms, frozen petits pois, sharp cheddar cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a very large frying pan. Step 2: Add the rice and saut it gently for about 3 - 4 minutes, until it looks glossy. Step 3: Add the onion, leek and pepper and cook gently, stirring often, for a few more minutes. Step 4: Add the wine to the frying pan and allow it to bubble up, then cook gently until it has been absorbed, stirring frequently Ladle about one quarter of the stock into the rice, stir, then let the rice simmer gently until the liquid has been absorbed. Step 5: Add the mushrooms to the risotto with another ladleful of stock. Step 6: Cook gently, adding more stock as needed until the rice is tender, it will take about 20 - 25 minutes to cook in total. Step 7: Stir in the peas and cheddar cheese, season to taste with salt and pepper, stir well and serve, garnished with basil.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, eggs, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, walnuts, fresh parsley, salt, fresh ground black pepper, ground nutmeg, pasta sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta shells according to package directions, drain shells. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and drain again. Step 3: Place shells aside. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 5: Meanwhile, to make filling: In a large bowl stir together the eggs, ricotta cheese, 1 cup of the mozzarella, 3 / 4 cup of the parmesan cheese, the walnuts, parsley, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Step 6: Spread 1 cup of the pasta sauce in bottom of a 3-quart baking dish. Step 7: Spoon a heaping tablespoon of filling into each cooked shell. Step 8: Arrange filled shells in the baking dish.

Ingredient Names: lasagna sheets, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, salt & pepper, ground sage, white wine, italian plum tomatoes, tomato paste, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, cheese, fresh nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a skillet, and add the chopped onion and garlic. Step 2: Cook over medium-high heat until softened, then add the salt, pepper and sage. Step 3: Stir in wine, allow most liquid to boil off. Step 4: Stir in the undrained tomatoes and tomato paste, simmer 15 minutes until thickened. Step 5: Put the ricotta, 1-1 / 2 cups mozzarella, and grated cheese blend in a bowl. Step 6: Grate in the nutmeg, and mix well with a fork. Step 7: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 8: Boil and drain noodles on kitchen towels. Step 9: Spread half the sauce in the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish, and cover with a single layer of noodles. Step 10: Layer half the ricotta mixture over the noodles.

Ingredient Names: marinara sauce, vegetable stock, olive oil, red onion, yellow zucchini, green zucchini, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, eggs, basil pesto, dry lasagna noodles, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 350f. Step 2: Saute finely chopped onion in 2 tbl Olive oil. Step 3: Add shredded zucchinis into pan and saute until soft Salt and pepper lightly. Step 4: Add 1 cup of stock to vegetables. Step 5: Set aside 4 oz Of mozzarella. Step 6: Mix ricotta cheese, 8 oz Of mozzarella and eggs in a separate bowl.

Dish Name: Cheese Ravioli With Fresh Tomato And Artichoke Sauce
Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, olive oil, roma tomato, marinated artichoke hearts, scallion, garlic cloves, salt, fresh ground black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven or large saucepan bring salted water to a boil and cook ravioli according to package directions Over a medium high flame, heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large nonstick skillet Stirring occasionally, add tomatoes, artichokes and liquid, scallions, garlic, salt and pepper and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables are warmed through, remove from heat. Step 2: Drain pasta well and transfer to a large bowl. Step 3: Toss with 1 teaspoon of oil and add half of the sauce to the ravioli, tossing gently to mix. Step 4: Transfer ravioli to a large serving platter, pour on remaining sauce and garnish with parmesan cheese. Step 5: Serve immediateley.

Dish Name: Cheese Ravioli With Pumpkin Sage Sauce
Ingredient Names: four-cheese ravioli, dry white wine, green onion, butter, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh sage leaves, pumpkin puree, fresh italian parsley, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare ravioli according to package directions. Step 2: Drain the ravioli and set aside, keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a skillet saute the green onions in the wine and butter over medium heat until the onions are softened and the butter is melted and begins to foam. Step 4: Stir in the pumpkin and heat through. Step 5: Remove from heat and blend in the cream, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, and the sage leaves, stirring well to combine To serve: Spoon the warm sauce over the ravioli. Step 6: Garnish with parmesan cheese, snipped parsley and toasted pine nuts.

Dish Name: Cheese Ravioli With Pumpkin Sage Sauce Semi Homemade
Ingredient Names: dry white wine, shallot, alfredo sauce, pumpkin puree, fresh sage, cheese ravioli, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta according to package directions In the meanwhile, cook wine and shallots in medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until reduced to about 1 tablespoon. Step 2: Stir sauce, pumpkin and sage into the shallots / wine. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Step 4: When pasta is finished cooking, drain, reserving cup cooking water. Step 5: Stir reserved water into sauce, toss with pasta. Step 6: Sprinkle with green onion and freshly grated parmesan cheese if you like. Step 7: Season with ground black pepper.

Ingredient Names: breadcrumbs, frozen spinach, onions, garlic powder, nutmeg, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs, butter, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Defrost spinach, drain and squeeze dry. Step 2: In a large bowl combine all the ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Using teaspoons full, roll spinach into 1-inch round bite-size balls. Step 4: Place on a cookie sheet coated with a non-stick cooking spray and bake for 20 minutes in a 350 degree oven.

Ingredient Names: manicotti, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, provolone cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, parsley, salt and pepper, prego spaghetti sauce, water, cream cheese, garlic, basil, onion, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In medium bowl combine ricotta, mozzarella, provolone, parmesan, eggs, parsley, salt and pepper, and any optional ingredients. Step 2: Stuff shells by repeatedly twisting uncooked noodles against the bottom of the bowl. Step 3: Place stuffed manicotti in 9x13 inch pan In small bowl empty jar of prego. Step 4: Fill empty prego jar with about 1 cup of water and shake to grab remaining sauce from jar and pour into bowl. Step 5: Stir sauce then pour over manicotti noodles. Step 6: Cover with foil and freeze, heat oven to 375. Step 7: Cook for 45 minutes covered and 45 minutes uncovered, or until the sauce is bubbling on the sides.

Dish Name: Cheese Tortellini With Basil Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: shallots, garlic cloves, flour, butter, white wine, cream, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, fresh basil leaves, cheese-filled tortellini
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, saut shallots and garlic in butter until softened, add flour. Step 2: Cook and stir one minute, stir in wine. Step 3: Cook one minute more Slowly add cream, mixing until smooth, add cheese. Step 4: Cook over medium heat until smooth and thick, add fresh basil. Step 5: Mix well and pour over hot, cooked tortellini.

Dish Name: Cheese Tortellini With Roasted Cauliflower Filberts
Ingredient Names: cauliflower, olive oil, bacon, salt, pepper, filberts, shallots, fresh thyme leaves, tortellini, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f and bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine cauliflower, olive oil and bacon. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and mix well. Step 4: Spread mixture out in a large roasting pan and roast, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is golden and bacon is crisp, Stir in nuts, shallots and thyme. Step 5: Return pan to oven and roast 3 to 5 minute longer. Step 6: Cook tortellini according to package directions, drain well and toss gently with the roasted cauliflower mixture. Step 7: Taste and adjust seasonings, if necessary, garnish with chives and serve.

Ingredient Names: italian bread, butter, italian seasoning, garlic powder, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Cut bread at 1 inch intervals, but don't cut all the way through Just carefully cut down to the bottom crust and stop. Step 3: Mix together butter, garlic powder and italian seasoning Separating gently, spread some of the butter mixture on both sides of each slice of bread. Step 4: Stuff some cheese down in between slices, but try to do it evenly, not all stuffed down into the bottom or all at the top. Step 5: Wrap loaf in foil and place on a baking sheet. Step 6: Bake for about 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted all the way through.

Dish Name: Cheesy Italian House Salad With Parmesan Dressing
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, italian salad dressing, parmesan cheese, fresh garlic, salt and pepper, head romaine lettuce, artichoke heart, pitted ripe olives, roma tomatoes, red onion, provolone cheese, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: For the dressing. Step 2: Whisk all the ingredients together, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Cover and chill for 2 hours before serving For the salad. Step 4: Place the first 6 ingredients in a large glass bowl, toss to combine. Step 5: Serve with dressing on the side.

Dish Name: Cheesy Stuffed Shells W Semi Homemade Sauce
Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, eggs, garlic powder, italian seasoning, salt and pepper, olive oil, garlic clove, italian-style stewed tomatoes, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions While water boils combine ricotta cheese, 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese, 1 cup mozzarella cheese, eggs, garlic powder, italian seasoning, and salt and pepper. Step 2: Place in refrigerator In medium saucepan cook garlic in olive oil once softened add stewed tomatoes. Step 3: Simmer 8-10 minutes. Step 4: Add jar of marinara sauce to saucepan. Step 5: Cover and reduce heat to low. Step 6: Once cooked pasta has cooled, preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Step 7: Drizzle baking pan with olive oil, and ladle a small amount of sauce into bottom. Step 8: Stuff pasta with cheese filling.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, ravioli, low sodium chicken broth, heavy cream, basil pesto, goat cheese, plum tomatoes, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Adjust oven rack to upper middle position and heat broiler. Step 2: Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat. Step 3: Add ravioli and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in broth and cream and cook, covered until ravioli are nearly tender, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Remove lid and continue to cook until sauce is slightly thickened and ravioli are completely tender, about 3 minutes Off heat, stir in pesto and 1 / 4 cup cheese into pan with ravioli. Step 6: Transfer to broiler safe 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish. Step 7: Arrange tomatoes over ravioli and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 8: Sprinkle with remaining cheese and broil until surface is spotty brown, about 3 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, dried breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, firm tofu, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f Coat a 9-by-13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Spread 1 / 2 cup of spaghetti sauce evenly around bottom of dish On a plate, combine bread crumbs and parmesan cheese, set aside. Step 3: Slice tofu in half lengthwise, then cut each half lengthwise into thirds. Step 4: Cut each piece lengthwise again into halves to create 12 sticks Coat each stick in crumb / cheese mixture, and place in baking dish. Step 5: Cover the sticks with remaining spaghetti sauce and top with mozzarella. Step 6: Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, fat free mozzarella cheese, zucchini, fat-free ricotta cheese, fat-free parmesan cheese, meatless sauce, whole wheat lasagna noodles, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 Spray rectangular baking dish, 11x7x1-1 / 2 inches with nonstick cooking spray Reserve 1 / 2 cup of the mozzarella cheese. Step 2: Mix remaining mozzarella cheese, the zucchini, ricotta cheese and parmesan cheese. Step 3: Spread 3 / 4 cup of the spaghetti sauce in prepared baking dish. Step 4: Top with 3 of the noodles. Step 5: Spread half of the cheese mixture over noodles in dish. Step 6: Top with 3 / 4 cup of the spaghetti sauce. Step 7: Repeat with 3 noodles, remaining cheese mixture and 3 / 4 cup of the spaghetti sauce. Step 8: Arrange remaining 3 noodles on top.

Dish Name: Chef Boy I Be Illinois Cavatappi With Swiss Chard
Ingredient Names: swiss chard, cavatappi pasta, cannellini beans, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil and season with salt Trim swiss chard, removing tough center ribs, and slice into 1 inch strips. Step 2: Add pasta and chard to boiling water and boil 10 minutes. Step 3: Drain pasta and chard, and add beans. Step 4: Add all to the lemon-wine sauce from tuscan chicken in lemon-wine sauce. Step 5: Sprinkle cheese and stir to incorporate Recipe # 206632.

Dish Name: Chef Boy I Be Illinois Ligurian Pasta
Ingredient Names: pasta, french style green beans, potatoes, pesto sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Dice potatoes into 1 inch cubes and saute in olive oil until crisp and brown on the outside and easily pierced with knife Salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Add the drained green beans to warm through. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to directions on box. Step 4: Add the pesto to the vegetables and mix thoroughly. Step 5: Add cooked and drained pasta to vegetables and mix thoroughly Can add some of the pasta water if necessary. Step 6: Serve with a side salad, crusty bread and freshly grated parmesan to pass.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, bay leaf, fresh basil, zucchini, red capsicum, mushrooms, squash, tomatoes, frozen spinach, ricotta cheese, cream, salt and pepper, small shell pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan fry the onion, garlic, bay leaf, basil, chilli, zuccini, capsicum, mushrooms, and squash for 5-10 minutes, until slightly softened. Step 2: Add in the tomatoes and spinach, cover and let simmer for 40 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the ricotta, cream, salt and pepper. Step 4: Add sauce to cooked pasta shells and stir through. Step 5: Serve topped with parmesan cheese Bellissimo!

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, fast-rising active dry yeast, water, olive oil, red onion, mushrooms, garlic, black olives, cherry tomatoes, dried oregano, dried basil, feta cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl. Step 2: Stir in the salt and yeast, then the warm water and olive oil. Step 3: Mix as best you can, either with your hands or with a dough hook attachment on your mixer, eventually forming into a ball. Step 4: Dust a work surface with flour and knead the dough for several minutes, until smooth and springy. Step 5: Cover and leave in a warm place for 30 minutes, while you prepare the filling. Step 6: Heat the oil in a frying pan and soften the onions, garlic and mushrooms. Step 7: Add the whole tomatoes, oregano, dried basil and chopped olives to the pan and cook for about five minutes, stirring often, until the tomatoes are soft but whole. Step 8: Remove from the heat. Step 9: Take out the risen dough and break into four pieces. Step 10: Roll out one section of the dough on a floured surface until you have a circle about 20cm across.

Dish Name: Cherry Tomato And Kalamata Olive Penne
Ingredient Names: penne rigate, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olive, parmesan cheese, flat-leaf italian parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, dried oregano, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, add pasta. Step 2: In a medium bowl add halved cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, crushed red pepper flakes, oregano, salt and pepper, set aside. Step 3: Add garlic and olive oil to a medium skillet and saute on low heat until garlic is translucent and soft but not brown, about 4 minutes Increase heat to medium low, add tomato and olive mixture and saute 1- 3 minutes just until the tomatoes begin to release their juices, tomatoes should be hot but still firm, be careful not to overcook them. Step 4: Drain pasta when al dente and return to pan, toss with fresh chopped parsley. Step 5: Mix in the tomato and olive mixture gently. Step 6: Add parmesan cheese and toss gently, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, zucchini, cherry tomatoes, green onions, balsamic vinegar, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh basil, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add zucchini and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 3: Add cherry tomatoes, green onions and balsamic vinegar. Step 4: Cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes or until zucchini is crisp-tender and tomatoes are heated through. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Sprinkle with basil and pine nuts and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, olive oil, garlic clove, red chili pepper, cherry tomatoes, capers, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the spaghetti. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a small non-stick pan, add the garlic and fry, stirring all the time, until golden. Step 3: Add the chili, tomatoes and capers and fry for a further 3-4 mins until the tomatoes start to break down. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp of the pasta cooking water to the tomatoes, then drain the pasta and return to the pan. Step 5: Pour in the tomato sauce and toss everything together well. Step 6: Serve as it is or sprinkled with freshly grated parmesan.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, neufchatel cheese, pesto sauce, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cut off tops of tomatoes and scoop out seeds and pulp. Step 2: Rinse under cold running water to remove all traces and let drain, cut side down, on paper towels While tomatoes are drying, prepare filling. Step 3: Combine cheese and pesto. Step 4: Blend well With pastry tube, fill each tomato with pesto cheese mixture. Step 5: Garnish with parsley. Step 6: Serve at room temperature May make a day ahead and store covered in refrigerator. Step 7: Allow 1 / 2 hr to warm to room temp before serving.

Ingredient Names: chestnut flour, all-purpose flour, eggs, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Add eggs and start kneading. Step 3: Knead until dough is smooth and shiny You might need a bit of lukewarm water according to size of eggs. Step 4: Let dough rest for about an hour. Step 5: Shape in your favourite pasta type and either cook at once or let dry for a couple of days. Step 6: Store in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, sugar, warm water, vegetable oil, flour, olive oil, garlic, crushed tomatoes in puree, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, frozen chopped spinach, mozzarella cheese, fresh mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Crust: dissolve yeast and sugar in water in a large bowl. Step 2: Let stand until bubbly. Step 3: Stir in oil then stir in 4 cups of the flour until smooth. Step 4: Add additional flour as needed to form a stiff dough Lightly flour the work surface. Step 5: Knead dough until smooth and elastic, about 7 to 10 minutes. Step 6: Put into a greased bowl. Step 7: Turn to coat top then let rise, covered, in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour Sauce: heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 8: Add garlic, cook 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, pesto sauce, olive oil, lemon juice, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Drain and wash chick peas. Step 2: In a bowl, whisk pesto, olive oil, and lemon juice together. Step 3: Add chick peas and red onions and toss together Best served at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, salt, fresh ground black pepper, ricotta cheese, nutmeg, all-purpose flour, butter, olive oil, asiago cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Step 2: Meanwhile, place chickpeas into a food processor and season with salt and fresh ground black pepper Process until they are as smooth as you can get them Scoop chickpea mash into a large bowl. Step 3: Add ricotta and nutmeg into the chickpeas, stirring until well combined. Step 4: Add about 1 / 4 cup flour and stir until incorporated - add enough extra flour until a dough forms that you can easily handle Scoop mixture out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly for less than a minute. Step 5: Divide the mixture into 4 pieces and roll each out into a robe that is about 1 / 2" thick. Step 6: Cut the ropes into 1" lengths - be gently and try to handle them as little as possible As you cut them, transfer the pieces to a baking sheet lined with parchment or wax paper.

Dish Name: Chickpea Stew Scented Wtih Lemon And Cumin
Ingredient Names: water, instant polenta, butter, olive oil, onion, garlic, lemon juice, ground cumin, black pepper, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, green onion, reduced-fat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan Gradually add polenta, stirring constantly with a whisk. Step 2: Reduce heat, and simmer 3 minutes, stirring frequently, remove from heat, stir in butter. Step 3: Cover and set aside While polenta cooks, heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add onion and garlic Saut for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add lemon juice, cumin, black pepper, chickpeas, and tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, butter, olive oil, parsley, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, dried thyme, bay leaf, basmati rice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cook water, rice, thyme, and bay leaf and set aside. Step 2: Heat olive oil and half of the butter in a skillet and then add chickpeas. Step 3: When chickpeas start to lightly brown add parsley and the sun-dried tomatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Step 4: Add oregano, basil, salt, and pepper and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and mix rice and chickpeas together until rice is a golden color. Step 6: Mix in remaining butter and parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Chickpeas With Onion Ceci E Cipolle
Ingredient Names: dried garbanzo beans, salt, onions, balsamic vinegar, fresh rosemary, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the chickpeas and place in a saucepan. Step 2: Cover with cold water and simmer for 2 hours or until tender Salt to taste near the end. Step 3: Drain and place in a salad bowl. Step 4: Mash the chickpeas a little with a fork In the meantime, steam the onions whole until tender. Step 5: Slice and add to the chickpeas. Step 6: Mix together the vinegar, rosemary and oil with some salt in a bowl. Step 7: Pour over the chickpeas, mix well and serve.

Dish Name: Chilled Italian Style Mushrooms Very Simple Very Delicious
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, lemon zest, red wine vinegar, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried basil leaves, dried oregano leaves, onion powder, dry mustard, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, mushrooms, flat-leaf italian parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except mushrooms and parsley, in a large zip top plastic bag Seal bag and shake well. Step 2: Add the mushrooms to the marinade Seal bag and turn over several times. Step 3: Refrigerate no longer than 2 hours. Step 4: Drain mushrooms and sprinkle with snipped parsley.

Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, red chili pepper, pine nuts, tomatoes, tabasco sauce, garlic clove, fresh basil leaves, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sun-dried tomato paste, olive oil, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Grill both the chilli and red pepper under a very hot grilluntil the skin blackens and blisters. Step 2: Allow to cool for a few minutes Peel the chilli and pepper and remove the seeds Roughly chop With a large pestle and mortar crush the garlic together with the toasted pine nuts One at a time, add the red pepper, chilli, basil, sundried tomato and tomato paste, squashing together until everything is roughly blended. Step 3: Stir in the grated pecorino or parmesan. Step 4: Stir in the oil, stirring until everything has become a paste, but still retains a little of it's own identity. Step 5: Add tabasco to taste.

Ingredient Names: linguine, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, zucchini, broccoli floret, asparagus, sugar snap peas, shallots, garlic, butter, olive oil, fresh cilantro, thai basil, salt and pepper, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large pot with water and begin heating it for the pasta. Step 2: In a large skillet or wok, heat oil and butter and stir-fry vegetables, onion and garlic about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add cilantro and basil and cook another minute, or until vegetables are done to your taste, leaving them a little crunchy. Step 4: Season vegetables with salt and pepper and mix with soy sauce. Step 5: When the water boils, add linguine and cook al dente, according to package directions, drain. Step 6: Toss vegetables with pasta and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: chocolate cake mix, egg, cold water, part-skim ricotta cheese, almond extract, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Grease and flour 9x9 or 6 jumbo muffin pan. Step 3: Mix cake mix, egg and water together and pour into prepared pan. Step 4: Mix ricotta, almond extract and sugar until well blended with hand mixer. Step 5: Place by spoonfuls on top of batter as close together and evenly as possible, or 2 tablespoons into each muffin. Step 6: Bake for 30-40 minutes. Step 7: Serve with berries or cherries.

Dish Name: Chocolate Hazelnut Tart The Best You Ever Had
Ingredient Names: sugar, all-purpose flour, eggs, toasted hazelnuts, bittersweet chocolate chips, corn syrup, butter, vanilla extract, salt, frozen pie crust
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325f. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix together the sugar and the flour. Step 3: Add the eggs, hazelnuts, chocolate chips, corn syrup, butter, vanilla, and salt, stir well. Step 4: Pour the mixture into the pie crust, bake for 1 hour. Step 5: Cool the tart for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: egg substitute, vanilla, sugar, popped popcorn, flour, unsweetened cocoa powder, baking powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 300 f. Step 2: Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray. Step 3: Combine egg substitute, vanilla, and 1 cup sugar in large bowl and mix well. Step 4: Add popcorn, flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder and mix well Dough will be stiff but continue mixing until all ingredients are well combined. Step 5: Sprinkle remaining sugar on work surface. Step 6: Divide dough into 3 equal pieces. Step 7: Roll dough into 8" x 4 by " logs and roll in sugar lightly on all sides. Step 8: Transfer logs to baking sheet, leaving a space between them. Step 9: Bake 25-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fresh tomatoes, onion, garlic clove, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all of the ingredients together. Step 2: Cover and let them meld in the refrigerator overnight Shake the container occasionally to mix a little This can be eaten right away if you wish, but it does taste better if it marinates for a while before you eat it Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: carrots, onion, celery ribs, olive oil, garlic cloves, potatoes, tomato paste, vegetable broth, salt and pepper, chopped tomatoes, butter beans, spaghetti, savoy cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, whizz the carrots, onion and celery into small pieces. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan, add the processed vegetables, garlic and potatoes, then cook over a high heat for 5 mins until softened. Step 3: Stir in the tomato paste, broth and tomatoes. Step 4: Bring to the boil, then turn down the heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Step 5: Season to taste and serve with crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, kalamata olive, canned artichoke heart, green pepper, mozzarella cheese, red onion, fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, artichokes, olives onions and cheese in medium bowl. Step 2: Sprinkle on the basil, olive oil and lemon juice. Step 3: Toss to blend well. Step 4: Season salad to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: water, salt, white sugar, olive oil, bread flour, bread machine yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Place ingredients into the pan of the bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer Select the dough cycle, and start Dough will be quite sticky and wet once cycle is completed, resist the temptation to add more flour. Step 2: Place dough on a lightly floured board, cover with a large bowl, and let rest for 15 minutes Lightly flour or use parchment lined baking sheets. Step 3: Divide into 2 pieces, and form each into a 3x14 inch oval. Step 4: Place loaves on prepared sheets, dimple surface, and lightly flour. Step 5: Cover, and let rise in a draft free place for approximately 45 minutes. Step 6: Preheat oven to 425f Dimple dough for a second time, and then place loaves in the oven, positioned on the middle rack.

Dish Name: Ciambella Della Nonna Italian Breakfast Cake
Ingredient Names: flour, margarine, sugar, salt, eggs, baking powder, vanilla, liqueur, lemon zest, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven at 220c. Step 2: Grease your mold and dust with four Work all the ingredients with the kneading machine until smooth. Step 3: Spread the batter in the mold, top with sugar. Step 4: Bake for 30 minutes at 220c.

Ingredient Names: pecorino romano cheese, fresh cilantro, pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, black pepper, lemon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients in food processor. Step 2: Puree until ingredients are fully combined and the pesto has a smooth texture with no significant lumps You may add additional olive oil if you like May be served hot or at room temperature Leftovers can be frozen in small tupperware containers or ice cube trays and thawed when you're ready to use.

Ingredient Names: rice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, citrus juice, citrus zest, sugar, citrus fruit, red onions, of fresh mint, parmesan cheese, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in abandant salted water, as you would pasta, until it's just done White will take 10-15 minutes, brown 30 minutes or more. Step 2: Drain, rinse in cold water, drain again, then put in a large bowl. Step 3: Combine the olive oil, citrus juice, zest, sugar or honey, salt and pepper in a blender and turn the machine on A creamy emulsion will form within 30 seconds. Step 4: Taste and add more citrus juice a teaspoon or two at a time until the balance tastes right to you. Step 5: Drizzle vinaigrette over rice Use 2 big forks to combine, fluffing rice and tossing gently to separate grains. Step 6: Stir in citrus flesh, onion and mint. Step 7: Taste, and adjust the seasoning or moisten with a little more dressing.

Ingredient Names: whole almonds, granulated sugar, light brown sugar, ground cinnamon, baking powder, all-purpose flour, jumbo eggs, pure vanilla extract, orange, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Position oven racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Step 2: Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper. Step 3: Place almonds in a single layer on a baking sheet and toast in the 350-degree oven for 10 minutes, or until light golden and aromatic. Step 4: Remove and set aside. Step 5: In a large bowl, hand mix toasted almonds, sugars, cinnamon, baking powder and flour. Step 6: In a small bowl, whisk eggs. Step 7: Add the vanilla and orange zest and whisk until well-blended. Step 8: Add to the flour mixture Work the batter together with lightly floured hands.

Dish Name: Classic Pumpkin Pie With Maple Whipped Cream And Walnuts
Ingredient Names: deep dish pie shell, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, salt, eggs, pumpkin, flour, evaporated milk, whipping cream, pure maple syrup, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Combine sugar, spices and salt in a medium bowl. Step 3: Beat eggs lightly and blend in pumpkin, spice mixture, flour and evaporated milk. Step 4: Pour into pie shell and bake at 425 for 15 minutes. Step 5: Reduce temperature to 350 f and bake 25 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean, cool. Step 6: Prepare topping by beating cream and syrup in a chilled bowl until soft peaks form Dollop with cream and sprinkle with walnuts.

Ingredient Names: medium firm tofu, soymilk, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, lemon juice, garlic, onion, spinach, tomato sauce, lasagna noodle, soy cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a blender or food precessor, blend the tofu, milk, oregano, basil, salt, lemon juice, garlic, and onions together until it achieves the consistancy of cottage cheese If the mixture is too thick, add a little water. Step 3: Stir in the chopped spinach and set aside. Step 4: Cover the bottom of lasagna pan with a thin layer of tomato sauce, then a layer of noodles. Step 5: Sprinkle half of the tofu mixture and 1 / 2 cup of the optional cheese. Step 6: Cover this with noodles and a layer of sauce. Step 7: Add the remaining filling, 1 / 2 cup of cheese, and a layer of sauce. Step 8: Add one more layer of noodles, and cover with sauce. Step 9: Top with remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: cocoa, sugar, milk, eggs, mascarpone cheese, cookies
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve cocoa and sugar in 1 / 2 cup boiling water. Step 2: Mix in 1 / 2 cup milk and set aside to cool. Step 3: Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Step 4: In a separate bowl, beat egg yolks and sugar until smooth and light colored. Step 5: Beat in marscapone cheese until well mixed. Step 6: Fold in egg whites gently. Step 7: Pour the cocoa mix into a small bowl that's big enough to fit one of the cookies laying flat. Step 8: Take half of the cookies, individually dip them the in cocoa mix and then arrange in the bottom of a casserole dish. Step 9: Spread half of the marscapone mixture over the cookies. Step 10: Repeat with the rest of the cookies and then cover with the remaining marscapone mixture.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, italian parsley, short-grain rice, dark seedless raisins, salt, broth, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 2: Add garlic, parsley and rice. Step 3: Cook over high heat stirring with a wooden spoon until garlic begins to discolor. Step 4: Add raisins and salt. Step 5: Add broth or water 1 / 4 cup at a time and continue to cook uncovered over high heat until rice is done-about 15 minutes. Step 6: Taste and add salt and pepper if necessary. Step 7: Serve hot or at room temperature.

Dish Name: Colorful Rice Salad With Lemon Dressing
Ingredient Names: green onions, garlic cloves, summer squash, tomatoes, red bell pepper, spinach leaves, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, carrot, lentil sprouts, fresh lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, cooked brown rice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Toss prepared vegetables together in a large bowl. Step 2: Place lemon juice in a small bowl. Step 3: Drizzle in olive oil while whisking, to emulsify the liquids. Step 4: Add to the vegetables. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate for an hour. Step 6: Add cooked, cooled rice. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 8: Refrigerate until serving time Delicious with grilled or broiled steak, chicken or fish.

Dish Name: Columella Salad Or Ancient Roman Salad
Ingredient Names: of fresh mint, fresh coriander, fresh parsley, leek, fresh thyme, cheese, vinegar, pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Directions: addito in mortarium satureiam, mentam, rutam, coriandrum, apium, porrum sectivum, aut si non erit viridem cepam, folia latucae, folia erucae, thymum viride, vel nepetam, tum etiam viride puleium, et caseum recentem et salsum: ea omnia partier conterito, acetique piperati exiguum, permisceto Hanc mixturam cum in catillo composurris, oleum superfundito Oh yes, ahem if you don't read latin: Put savory in the mortar with mint, rue, coriander, parsley, sliced leek, or, if it is not available, onion, lettuce and rocket leaves, green thyme, or catmint Also pennyroyal and salted fresh cheese This is all crushed together. Step 2: Stir in a little peppered vinegar. Step 3: Put this mixture on a plate and pour oil over it Nuts can be added if you like.

Ingredient Names: spinach leaves, shiitake mushroom, red potatoes, onions, basil leaves, white wine, olive oil, fresh oregano, water, salt and pepper, heavy cream, basil sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Tear the spinach leaves coarsely. Step 2: Chop the mushrooms, potatoes and onions into 1 / 2 inch pieces. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy bottomed soup pot. Step 4: Toss in the spinach, mushrooms, potatoes and onions. Step 5: Saute over medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 6: Toss in the basil leaves and the oregano, saute for another 1 minute. Step 7: Add the white wine. Step 8: Cook for another minute. Step 9: Add enough water to just cover the vegetables, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, crushed tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh garlic cloves, vodka, half-and-half, fresh parsley, fresh parmesan cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saute olive oil, crushed red pepper and garlic in a large pan over medium heat to lightly brown the garlic. Step 2: Add the tomatoes, season to taste with some salt & pepper, and cook 30 minutes, lowering the heat some to keep from burning. Step 3: Add vodka and heat 2 minutes. Step 4: Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss. Step 5: Stir in the half and half and heat through, just a few minutes Give the sauce a taste and depending upon how you like the consistency, you might wish to add a little bit of the pasta cooking liquid, then taste again and add as much salt as you feel it needs and pepper as well, if you feel pepper is needed for a bit more kick. Step 6: Toss with parsley, sprinkle with additional red pepper flakes if desired and a hearty grating of fresh parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: whole tomatoes, tomato paste, olive oil, fennel bulb, sugar, basil leaves, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Using a food processor, process tomatoes until mostly smooth A few small chunks are ok Crush the garlic using a garlic press, or finely chop Clean the fennel well, then slice into 1 / 4" slices and dry the pieces with a paper towel. Step 2: Add the oil to a large, heavy stock pot. Step 3: When shimmering, add the fennel and saute until it's starting to lightly brown. Step 4: Add the garlic and stir just until it's fragrant Immediately add the processed tomatoes. Step 5: Add the tomato paste, basil, and spices. Step 6: Cook for an hour, uncovered, with the sauce just barely simmering, and stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, semisweet mini chocolate chips, maraschino cherry, pecans, sugar, whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the cheese until smooth. Step 2: Stir in the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Spoon into individual dessert dishes or custard cups. Step 4: Refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 5: Top with whole cherries, if desired.

Dish Name: Copycat Olive Garden Minestrone Soup By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: olive oil, white onion, zucchini, italian cut green beans, celery, garlic, vegetable broth, red kidney beans, small white beans, diced tomatoes, carrot, fresh parsley, dried oregano, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat three tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat in a large soup pot. Step 2: Saute onion, celery, garlic, green beans, and zucchini in the oil for 5 minutes or until onions begin to turn translucent. Step 3: Add vegetable broth to pot, plus drained tomatoes, beans, carrot, hot water, and spices. Step 4: Bring soup to a boil, then reduce heat and allow to simmer for 20 minutes. Step 5: Add spinach leaves and pasta and cook for an additional 20 minutes or until desired consistency Makes about eight 1 1 / 2 cup servings.

Dish Name: Copycat Trader Joe's Arrabbiata Sauce Vegan Friendly
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic clove, tomato paste, red sweet bell pepper, extra virgin olive oil, anchovy paste, salt, fresh italian parsley, dark brown sugar, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Step 2: Taste for any seasoning correction Delicious warm served over fresh pasta or spooned on bruschetta slices! Step 3: Yield is estimated.

Ingredient Names: cornmeal, fresh pasta, creamed corn, mascarpone cheese, soft fresh goat cheese, fresh tarragon, fresh ground black pepper, egg, unsalted butter, corn kernel, lemon zest, salt, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle baking sheet with some cornmeal and set aside. Step 2: Cut the ball of pasta dough into 8 equal pieces. Step 3: Shape each piece into a rectangle about the size of a deck of cards Corver the dought with plastic wrap while you are working. Step 4: Roll a rectanle of dought through the widest setting of a pasta machine 3 times, until it is smooth Continue rolling it through, decreasing in setting each time until you have reached the thinnest setting. Step 5: Sprinkle the sheet light with cornmeal, gently fold it and set it on the cornmeal-lined baking sheet. Step 6: Cover with plastic wrap Continue rolling out the rest of the pasta until all 8 pieces have been rolled out. Step 7: In a medium bowl, mix together the drained cream corn, mascarpone cheese, goat cheese, taraagon and pepper.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, carrots, sweet red pepper, salt, dried oregano, black pepper, arborio rice, boiling water, corn kernels, milk, egg, all-purpose flour, asiago cheese, sun-dried tomato packed in oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Step 2: Cook the onion, red pepper, carrots, salt, oregano and pepper, stirring, for 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the rice for 1 minute. Step 4: Pour in the boiling water and the corn, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed. Step 6: In a bowl, whisk together the milk, egg and flour. Step 7: Stir into the rice mixture. Step 8: Stir in the asiago cheese and sun-dried tomatoes. Step 9: Spread into a greased 8-inch square casserole dish.

Ingredient Names: fast rise yeast, warm water, sugar, all-purpose flour, yellow cornmeal, fresh rosemary, salt, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, diced tomatoes, garlic clove, parmesan cheese, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine rapid-rise yeast, warm water and sugar in a small bowl and let stand 5 minutes. Step 2: Stir together 2 cups flour and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Step 3: Stir in yeast mixture and 2 tablespoons oil until well blended. Step 4: Turn dough out onto a well-floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Step 5: Place in a well-greased bowl, turning to grease top. Step 6: Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 15 minutes. Step 7: Sprinkle cornmeal onto well greased baking sheet. Step 8: Place dough on baking sheet and roll into a 12-inch square, sprinkling with flour as needed to prevent sticking. Step 9: Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in warm place, free from drafts for 45 minutes. Step 10: Preheat oven 400 degrees.

Dish Name: Couldn T Be Easier Margherita Pizza
Ingredient Names: burrito-size flour tortilla, tomatoes, garlic, basil leaves, fresh mozzarella cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Place cast iron skillet, that has been slightly brushed with olive oil, in oven for a few minutes to heat. Step 3: Meanwhile, assemble pizza using tortilla as the base, top with tomatoes, garlic, cheese, basil leaves I top with basil last because i love crispy basil If you don't like basil this way, put under the cheese. Step 4: Place tortilla in hot skillet It should sizzle, cook until done.

Ingredient Names: parmesan cheese, lemon, extra virgin olive oil, black pepper, spaghetti, courgettes, pine nuts, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: Grate the parmesan and mix with the lemon juice, olive oil and black pepper, set aside. Step 2: Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Step 3: Grate the courgettes and dry fry the pine nuts. Step 4: When nuts are golden add the courgettes, lemon rind and parmesan mix and turn off the heat. Step 5: Toss together the pasta and parmesan mix, serve.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, olive oil, zucchini, eggs, mint leaves, cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes for 6 mins or until just cooked, then drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a large, deep, ovenproof frying pan and fry the courgettes for 4-5 mins until golden. Tip in the potatoes and fry for 1 min with the courgettes. Step 2: In a bowl, beat together the eggs and mint, then season. Pour into the frying pan and stir briefly. Cook for 5 mins over low heat. Crumble over the cheese and finish under a hot grill for 5 mins, until the eggs are just set and the cheese is browned. Cut into wedges and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, courgettes, balsamic vinegar, capers, fresh parsley, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan and add zucchini tossing to coat. Step 2: Add vinegar, mix well cover and cook for five minutes until the courgettes are tender crisp. Step 3: Remove lid and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes until liquid has evaporated. Step 4: Remove from heat and capers, parsley and lemon juice. Step 5: Toss to coat and season if desired, serve warm.

Dish Name: Creamless Penne Pasta Primavera With Olive Oil And Garlic
Ingredient Names: water, sea salt, penne pasta, broccoli florets, carrot, extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic, red bell pepper, frozen green pea, frozen sweet corn, beef broth, fresh basil, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 4 quarts of water with 2 tablespoons salt to a boil in a large pot and cook dry penne pasta to desired doneness per package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, precook broccoli florets and carrots If boiling in water, boil for 3-5 minutes and check for doneness with fork Otherwise, vegetables can be steamed. Step 3: Once cooked, transfer vegetables to ice water to halt cooking and preserve bright color, then drain, set aside until. Step 4: In a large heavy skillet, heat the olive oil 1 minute or until hot and saute the onion and garlic until lightly golden, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the vegetables and saute until the peppers are soft, about 2 minutes Deglaze with the beef broth, if using, or just a splash of dry white wine. Step 6: Add the drained penne noodles and basil and season to taste.

Ingredient Names: water, avocado, cucumbers, chopped tomatoes, serrano chili, garlic clove, mint leaf, lemons, salt, maple syrup, mint leaves, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the ingredients in a blender in the order listed Start blender on low speed for a few seconds, then switch to high. Step 2: Blend until creamy and smooth, about 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 3: Pour into 2 soup bowls Dice reserved avocado and gently drop them into the center of the bowl. Step 4: Add a mint leaf and sprinkle diced avocado with paprika if desired Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: brown rice, olive oil, yellow onion, mixed mushrooms, white wine, red bell pepper, vegetable broth, water, parmesan cheese, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, truffle oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan over medium-high, combine the rice and 2 cups water. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Step 3: Remove the pan from the heat, leaving it covered The rice will not be completely cooked and there will be some water in the pan, set aside. Step 4: In a large skillet over medium-high, heat the oil. Step 5: Add the onion and mushrooms, then saute until just starting to brown, about 3 to 4 minutes. Step 6: Add the wine and stir vigorously for 1 to 2 minutes to deglaze the pan. Step 7: When the wine comes to a simmer, add the bell pepper and the rice along with any liquid in the pan, stir well.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, olive oil, garlic cloves, butternut squash, arborio rice, ground turmeric, white wine, butter, parmesan cheese, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to boiling. Step 2: Cover and reduce heat until broth just simmers. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat, add garlic. Step 4: Cook and stir for 15 seconds. Step 5: Add squash cubes and rice. Step 6: Cook and stir 1 more minute Slowly add 1 / 2 cup of the hot broth and the turmeric or saffron to rice mixture, stirring constantly Continue to cook and stir over medium heat until broth is absorbed Continue adding broth, 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring constantly until the broth has been absorbed but mixture is creamy.

Dish Name: Creamy Goat Cheese And Asparagus Orecchiette
Ingredient Names: orecchiette, extra virgin olive oil, red onion, asparagus spear, red pepper flakes, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh goat cheese, chives, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the orecchiette until just al dente. Step 2: Drain the orecchiette, reserving 2 / 3 cup of the cooking water. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a large, deep skillet, heat the olive oil until shimmering. Step 4: Add the onion and cook over moderately low heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the asparagus and crushed red pepper and cook over moderate heat until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the orecchiette and the reserved cooking water to the skillet along with the lemon juice and zest season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Cook, stirring, until the orecchiette is al dente and the asparagus is just tender, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the goat cheese and chives and stir until melted. Step 9: Transfer the pasta to bowls and serve with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: low-fat plain yogurt, low-fat mayonnaise, low-fat milk, italian seasoning, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt, mayonnaise and skimmed milk Add the dried italian seasoning and garlic powder and stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic cloves, low sodium chicken broth, polenta, ground black pepper, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: 1 in a medium-large pot melt the butter over medium high heat until the foam subsides, add the garlic, cook for a minute, add the broth. Step 2: Turn the heat to high and bring to a boil 2 Slowly sprinkle in the polenta, whisking as you pour. Step 3: Turn the heat to medium and cook for 20 to 25 minutes stirring frequently until the polenta is thickened and soft to taste 3. Step 4: Turn off heat and stir in pepper and parmesan.

Dish Name: Creamy Pea Chive Pearl Barley Risotto Reduced Fat
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, pearl barley, vegetable stock, peas, fat-free cream cheese with chives, chives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large, deep pan, then gently fry the onion for 3-4 minutes. Step 2: Stir in the pearl barley, sizzle for a few mins, then pour in about a third of the stock. Step 3: Simmer fiercely for 20 mins, stirring occasionally, adding more stock gradually as it is absorbed With 5 mins to go, stir in the peas. Step 4: After 20 mins there should be some liquid left and the barley should be cooked through. Step 5: Turn the heat off under the risotto and let it sit for a min, then stir in the cream cheese and most of the chives. Step 6: Season well and serve scattered with the rest of the chives.

Ingredient Names: yellow onions, white mushroom, garlic, dried porcini mushrooms, olive oil, fresh basil, fresh oregano, vegetable stock, polenta, salt and pepper, heavy cream, asiago cheese, wild mushrooms, basil sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the onions, white mushrooms, garlic and the porcini in 4 fl oz of olive oil until lightly colored. Step 2: Add basil, oregano and stock. Step 3: Bring to a boil Slowly stir in polenta. Step 4: Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often The polenta should be thick and creamy. Step 5: Add more stock if needed Adjust the seasonings and keep warm Just before serving, add cream and cheese and stir vigorously Saut the wild mushrooms in the remaining olive oil until tender, about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, spinach, alfredo sauce, jarlsberg cheese, italian-style diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to directions, during last minute of cooking add spinach to pasta. Step 2: Drain Position oven rack so that top of 8-cup baking dish is about 2" from heat source, preheat broiler. Step 3: In a pot over med heat combine sauce and 1 cup cheese and stir until melted. Step 4: In a bowl combine tomatoes, pasta, spinach and the sauce, toss to coat. Step 5: Transfer to baking dish and sprinkle with remaining cheese Broil until cheese is lightly browned.

Dish Name: Creamy Ravioli With Squash Lemon And Chives
Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, olive oil, shallot, summer squash, salt and black pepper, heavy cream, lemon zest, pecorino cheese, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the pasta according to the package directions Reserve 1 / 2 cup of the cooking water. Step 2: Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add the shallot and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 5: Add the squash and 1 / 4 tsp each salt and pepper to the skillet. Step 6: Cook, tossing often, until the vegetables are just beginning to soften, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the cream and lemon zest and cook until the vegetables are tender and the cream is slightly thickened, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the squash mixture, pecorino, 1 / 4 cup of the reserved cooking water, and 1 / 2 tsp salt to the pasta and toss gently to coat. Step 9: Serve sprinkled with the chives and additional pecorino.

Dish Name: Creamy Rice With Lemon Herbs And Parmesan
Ingredient Names: water, arborio rice, onion, fresh parsley, butter, fresh basil, fresh lemon juice, lemon, parmesan cheese, basil sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 4 quarts water to boil in large pot over high heat. Step 2: Add rice and onion. Step 3: Boil until rice is just tender, about 16 minutes. Step 4: Drain, reserving 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid. Step 5: Mix parsley, butter, basil, lemon juice, and lemon peel in large bowl. Step 6: Add hot rice mixture, stir to melt butter. Step 7: Add reserved 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid and 1 cup cheese, stir. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese.

Dish Name: Creamy Spinach And Pine Nut Gnocchi
Ingredient Names: cream, tomatoes, garlic cloves, sun-dried tomato, black olives, gnocchi, spinach, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cream, canned tomatoes and garlic in large pan and bring to the boil. Step 2: Simmer until sauce slightly thickens. Step 3: Add sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Step 4: Simmer for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add gnocchi to saucepan of boiling, salted water and cook until gnocchis rise to the top of the saucepan. Step 6: Drain Gently toss gnocchi, spinach and pine nuts in pan with sauce until spinach wilts.

Dish Name: Creamy Sun Dried Tomato Roasted Red Pepper And Artichoke Pasta
Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, olive oil, garlic, onion, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, roasted red peppers, basil, green onions, water-packed artichoke hearts, asiago cheese, whipping cream, red pepper flakes, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bowties according to package directions Reserve 1 cup of the cooking water. Step 2: Heat oil in a large pan. Step 3: Add garlic and onion, cook until translucent. Step 4: Add tomatoes and roasted peppers. Step 5: Cook for 3 minutes. Step 6: Stir in red pepper flakes. Step 7: Add artichoke hearts and cook for 3 minutes. Step 8: Add whipping cream and asiago cheese. Step 9: Allow to simmer until it starts to thicken.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, plum tomatoes, black pepper, ground oregano, ground basil, ground thyme, cream cheese
