Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat and cook onions for about 3 minutes or until softened. Step 2: Add tomatoes and spices and bring up to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until thickened. Step 4: Whisk in softened cheese until mixture is smooth and is softly bubbling. Step 5: Toss with cooked pasta and serve with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: raw cashews, whole canned tomatoes, tomato paste, extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, dried thyme, dried oregano, dried rosemary, dried basil, red pepper flakes, salt, sugar, tomatoes, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Place cashews, canned tomatoes and tomato paste in a blender and puree until very smooth This can take a few minutes, depending on the strength of your blender. Step 2: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and saute until golden. Step 4: Add garlic and saute for another 12 minutes, making sure not to burn it. Step 5: Stir in the pureed tomato mix and bring to a simmer. Step 6: Add herbs, salt and sugar and simmer gently for 1520 minutes, until sauce has slightly thickened. Step 7: Taste and adjust seasoning as needed If desired, stir in fresh diced tomato shortly before serving and simmer until heated through. Step 8: Mix with, or serve over, your favorite cooked pasta and garnish with fresh basil.

Dish Name: Cremini Mushroom Pasta With Wilted Arugula And Goat Cheese
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, extra virgin olive oil, cremini mushrooms, salt, garlic cloves, arugula, goat cheese, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, but before draining, reserve 1 / 2 cup cooking water While the pasta is cooking, heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add mushrooms and salt and cook, stirring frequently, 2 or 3 minutes or until mushrooms are soft. Step 3: Add garlic and cook another 2 or 3 minutes until garlic is soft and most of the liquid has evaporated. Step 4: Toss pasta with mushrooms, arugula, and goat cheese. Step 5: Stir in reserved cooking liquid until cheese becomes creamy. Step 6: Toss in parsley and season to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, french bread, garlic cloves, olive oil, basil leaves, kosher salt, butter, dried oregano, granulated garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in small sauce pan, spoon over sliced bread. Step 2: Place bread in baking pan sprayed with non stick spray. Step 3: Sprinkle granulated garlic, salt and oregano over buttered bread. Step 4: Bake bread in oven at 400 for approximately 10 minutes until toasty In mixing bowl, mix tomatoes, garlic, basil, remaining salt, and olive oil. Step 5: When bread is done, spoon tomato mixture over bread.

Ingredient Names: sun-dried tomato, goat cheese, pine nuts, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375f In medium bowl, stir together sun-dried tomatoes, goat cheese and pine nuts Separate dough into 8 triangles. Step 2: Place about 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomato mixture down the length of each triangle. Step 3: Roll up each, starting at shortest side of triangle and rolling to opposite point. Step 4: Place rolls, point side down, on ungreased cookie sheet. Step 5: Bake 16 to 19 minutes until golden brown Enjoy!

Dish Name: Crespelle With Ricotta And Marinara Crepes
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, eggs, milk, unsalted butter, olive oil, ricotta cheese, parsley, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, fresh ground pepper, marinara sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Make the crespelle: In a medium bowl, whisk the flour with the salt. Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk. Step 3: Whisk the egg mixture into the flour mixture until smooth. Step 4: Whisk in the melted butter until just blended. Step 5: Cover the batter and refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 6: Heat a 10-inch nonstick skillet over moderately high heat With a paper towel, rub the skillet with olive oil. Step 7: Pour in 1 / 4 cup of the crespelle batter and tilt the skillet to distribute the batter. Step 8: Cook the crespella until golden brown on the bottom, 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, arugula, mint, scallions, parsley, chili flakes, olive oil, oil, lemon, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Start by deep frying the chickpeas. Step 2: When they are golden brown, dry on paper towels and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: In a separate bowl make a simple salad by combing arugala, torn mint leaves, sliced scallions, parsley, and chili flakes Dress salad with olive oil, salt and pepper. Step 4: Add the zest and juice of 1 lemon. Step 5: Combine chickpeas with salad and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: macaroni, butter, plain flour, mustard powder, milk, sharp cheddar cheese, potato chips, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f Use a large saucepan to cook the macaroni in lightly salted boiling water according to pack instructions. Step 2: Drain carefully in a colander. Step 3: Melt the butter in another saucepan and stir in the flour and mustard to make a paste. Step 4: Cook over a low heat for 1 minute, stirring all the time Slowly whisk in the milk a little at a time until smooth, then simmer the sauce until thickened. Step 5: Stir two-thirds of the cheese into the sauce, then mix in the macaroni and season to taste. Step 6: Transfer the macaroni cheese to a baking dish, scraping out all the sauce with a wooden spoon, then level the top flat. Step 7: Sprinkle over the crushed chips. Step 8: Cover with the remaining cheese and cook in the oven for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Spinach Stuffed Pasta Shells
Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, spaghetti sauce, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, onion, italian seasoning, frozen spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Cook jumbo shells according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Pour 1 / 2 of spaghetti sauce into crock pot. Step 4: In a medium bowl, combine spinach and remaining ingredients, mixing well. Step 5: Stuff each pasta shell with spinach mixture and layer in crock pot. Step 6: Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over shells. Step 7: Cook on low for 4 hours.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, tomato paste, tomato sauce, salt, pepper, mushrooms, dried oregano, ricotta cheese, fresh spinach, parmesan cheese, no-boil lasagna noodles, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan over medium heat, heat olive oil and add onions and garlic. Step 2: Cook over medium heat until tender, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add mushrooms, oregano, salt and pepper to taste and cook for another 3 minutes, stirring often. Step 4: Add tomato paste and stir mixing thoroughly. Step 5: Add tomato sauce, stir and cook sauce stirring occasionally for another 6-8 minutes or until heated through. Step 6: Remove sauce from heat and set aside In crock pot, cover bottom with enough sauce to just cover. Step 7: Add two layers of lasagna noodles, breaking them where needed. Step 8: Spread noodles with one tub of the ricotta cheese and salt and pepper. Step 9: Add two layers of lasagna noodles.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, carrots, onions, celery ribs, garlic cloves, zucchini, fresh kale, barley, chickpeas, fresh parsley, dried thyme, dried oregano, italian tomatoes, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except cheese in slow cooker Cover Cook on low 6-8 hours or until vegetables are tender Serve topped with grated cheese.

Dish Name: Crudites With Roasted Garlic And Red Bell Pepper Dip
Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, roasted garlic, feta cheese, extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, fresh basil leaves, fresh oregano, red pepper flakes, fresh parsley leaves, zucchini, jicama, sliced mushrooms, baby carrots, cucumber, asparagus spear
Instructions: Step 1: Roasted garlic: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Place the garlic on foil-lined baking sheet and rub 1 teaspoon of oil into the top of each head. Step 3: Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper and place cut sides down, on baking sheet. Step 4: Bake until the cloves are soft and golden, about 1 hour. Step 5: Remove from the oven and let sit until cool enough to handle. Step 6: Squeeze each head of garlic expel the cloves into a bowl, mash into a paste. Step 7: Set aside until needed, prepare dip:.

Ingredient Names: almond flour, sugar, eggs, orange marmalade, lemon rind, confectioners' sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Beat 6 eggs into a batter and put aside. Step 2: Combine flour, sugar, marmalade, and lemon rind and mix well Form cigar-shaped cookies and dip into egg batter. Step 3: Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and lay them in a buttered pan, shaping them into an "s" Bake at 360 until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: water, light brown sugar, ground ginger, salt, bread flour, whole wheat flour, active dry yeast, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: ----forbread machine---- Add all ingredients except cornmeal to bread machine pan in the order recommended by your machine's manufacturer Select dough cycle and start machine ----conventionalmethod---- In large bowl, dissolve yeast, brown sugar, and ginger in warm water. Step 2: Let stand 5 minutes until yeast foams. Step 3: Add salt and bread flour, beat well. Step 4: Stir in whole wheat flour to make a stiff dough. Step 5: Turn out onto lightly floured board and knead 10 minutes or until dough is springy, smooth and satiny.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, garlic-infused olive oil, kalamata olive, sea salt, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Split the dough into 5 or 7 ounce balls and roll out very thin-- to 10 inches if you are using 5 ounces of dough and 13 inches for a 7 ounce ball. Step 2: Brush with the olive oil, then spread the olives and a bit of salt over the skin. Step 3: Sprinkle a baking sheet with cornmeal and bake for about 10 minutes in a 400 f oven or until lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, fresh dill, lemon juice, olive oil, black olives, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the cucumber slices in a colander, sprinkle with a little salt and leave to drain for 30 minutes. Step 2: Rinse the cucumbers, drain, pat dry and put in a salad bowl. Step 3: Sprinkle with dill, drizzle with lemon juice and oil. Step 4: Add the olives, season with salt if necessary and toss. Step 5: Leave to stand for a few minutes, then serve.

Dish Name: Cunetto's Spaghetti Con Broccoli Actual Recipe
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, half-and-half cream, butter, broccoli floret, sliced mushrooms, parsley, garlic, black pepper, salt, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cream, butter, broccoli, mushrooms, parsley and seasonings in a sauce pan over medium heat for 3-5 minutes Increase the heat of the cream sauce slightly and bring to a boil. Step 2: When cream sauce boils, add cooked and drained spaghetti noodles to the sauce. Step 3: Reduce over medium heat until cream sauce clings to the spaghetti. Step 4: Remove from heat and toss in parmesan cheese, a little at a time until desired sauce consistency is achieved.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, half-and-half, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook fettucine according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and toss with a little olive oil. Step 3: In a wok or large pan, heat half and half until barely boiling Slowly add parmesan while whisking. Step 4: Turn off heat and continue to whisk until cheese dissolves. Step 5: Toss in pasta Variation: for fettucine carbonara, add cooked peas and crumbled bacon.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic clove, plain soymilk, all-purpose flour, nutritional yeast, oregano, salt, black pepper, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium heat in a large skillet. Step 2: Add minced garlic and lightly saute just until fragrant. Step 3: Stir in the flour and stir for about one minute This will be thick Slowly pour in the milk. Step 4: Add salt, pepper, oregano and nutmeg. Step 5: Stir until creamy and thick. Step 6: Turn off the heat and stir in nutritional yeast. Step 7: Serve over your choice of pasta.

Ingredient Names: dates, blanched almonds, walnuts, red wine, honey, pepper, cheese, coarse sea salt, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: With a sharp knife, make a small cut lengthwise in the top of each date and remove the pit Lightly toast the almonds and walnuts over medium-low heat. Step 2: Using a teaspoon, fill the datees with the nut mixture. Step 3: Simmer the wine, honey and pepper over medium heat for about 15 minutes. Step 4: Place the dates, cut side up, in the pan and continue to simmer until warm or about 5 minutes. Step 5: Serve the warm dates with the cheese wedges and top with a sprinkle of sea salt and lemon zest.

Ingredient Names: capellini, extra virgin olive oil, red pepper, garlic, pepper, salt, tomatoes, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Add olive oil to large skillet, warm using medium heat. Step 2: Saute garlic and crushed red pepper together about 5 minutes until garlic is golden. Step 3: Add tomatoes, pepper, and salt, continue to cook until tomatoes are tender 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Add fresh basil cook 5 additional minutes Pasta should be cooked"al dente" and well drained. Step 5: Combine all ingredients and serve hot topped with 1 / 2 oz of imported shredded parmesan cheese Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: ricotta cheese, sugar, cream, bittersweet chocolate, pie crusts, pears, water, apricot jam
Instructions: Step 1: Refrigerate ricotta cheese in a strainer over night so that excess moisture is removed. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, blend ricotta cheese and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons sugar with a hand mixer until it becomes a velvety consistency. Step 3: In a separate bowl, whip 35% whipping cream with 1 / 2 tablespoon of sugar Gently fold whipped cream into ricotta mixture along with bittersweet chocolate. Step 4: Spread filling into piecrust. Step 5: In a saucepan, heat sugar and 2 cups of water. Step 6: Once the sugar has dissolved, add pears and let cook until soft and caramelized. Step 7: Remove pears from pan and let cool. Step 8: Cut pears into slices and fan the slices on top of the pie filling until the surface of the pie is covered. Step 9: Fill in gaps with extra pieces of pear if necessary.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, chopped tomato, roasted red pepper, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, black olives, feta cheese, mushrooms, fresh spinach, fresh basil, pine nuts, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a pizza stone in a 425 f oven for one hour before use Peel and slice all garlic cloves and place in olive oil to perfume it This is the oil you will use for the rest of the recipe. Step 2: Brush rimmed baking sheet with some olive oil to coat. Step 3: After pizza dough has rested 30 minutes, per recipe, punch down and dump into baking sheet With oiled fingers, dimple and stretch / push dough to fill sheet, with edges being a bit higher for crust. Step 4: Brush with olive oil and spread garlic over dough, leaving 3 / 4 inch crust. Step 5: Place baking sheet on pizza stone and bake for 7-10 minutes, until very light tan / brown. Step 6: Remove from oven and spread a layer of crushed / chopped tomatoes. Step 7: Add the rest of the ingredients in any order that appeals to you!

Dish Name: Deep Fried Eggplant Croutons With A Salad
Ingredient Names: canola oil, all-purpose flour, eggs, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, eggplant, salt, red wine vinegar, garlic, dijon mustard, olive oil, oregano leaves, basil leaves, fresh coarse ground black pepper, spring greens, romaine lettuce hearts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a fryer to 375 degrees f In separate shallow dishes add flour, egg and bread crumbs Coat the eggplant cubes in the flour, then the egg and finally through the bread crumbs Carefully add the cubes to the fryer and fry until crisp and golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 2: Remove from the fryer to a paper towel lined platter to drain. Step 3: Sprinkle with salt and set aside Vinaigrette: In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, garlic and mustard Slowly whisk in the olive oil to combine and emulsify. Step 4: Add the herbs, salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: button mushrooms, walnuts, pine nuts, olive oil, fresh basil, garlic cloves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place mushroom caps top side down on a plate. Step 2: Blend all stuffing ingredients in a food processor until smooth Scoop a small amount of stuffing into each mushroom cap Dehydrate at 105 degrees for 5-6 hours or until soft.

Dish Name: Delicious And Simple Ricotta And Tomato Pasta Sauce
Ingredient Names: fresh ricotta, crushed tomatoes, yellow onion, garlic, tomato paste, parmesan cheese, salt, coarse ground pepper, olive oil, fresh basil, pasta
Instructions: Step 1: Firstly, put on a large pot of salted water and bring to the boil, add pasta to water and cook until'al dente' approximately 8- 10 minutes While pasta is on the go, finely dice your onion and crush your garlic. Step 2: In a saucepan, put in the olive oil, when the oil is warm, add your garlic and onion and gently saute these until they are transparent. Step 3: Add the ricotta to the pan, and stir through the onions and garlic well At this stage, add your salt and pepper, parmesan, crushed tomatoes and tomato paste. Step 4: Mix well and let simmer gently for 10 minutes, drain pasta. Step 5: Turn the ricotta sauce off from the heat, add your fresh basil leaves, roughly torn, into the sauce Dish up some pasta into a bowl, put some of the ricotta sauce on top of the pasta, and finish off with some extra shavings of parmesan if desired.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggplant, eggs, dry breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prehat oven to 350 degrees f Lightly brush or spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with vegetable oil. Step 2: Wash the eggplant but don't peel it. Step 3: Cut it crosswise in 1 / 4 inch thick slices. Step 4: In a pie plate, lightly beat the eggs On a plate, combine the bread crumbs with 1 / 2 cup of the parmesan cheese, mixing well Working with 1 eggplant slice at a time, coat it on both sides with the egg and allow the excess to drip off. Step 5: Put it in the bread crumbs and coat both sides. Step 6: Transfer to a plate Continue with the rest of the slices.

Dish Name: Delicious Low Fat One Dish Pasta Dinner
Ingredient Names: pasta, spaghetti sauce, part-skim ricotta cheese, fat-free cottage cheese, garlic cloves, parmesan cheese, black pepper, zucchini, onion, olive oil, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, water, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in boiling salted water for 1-2 minutes less than the package directions say. Step 2: Drain and return to the pan. Step 3: Toss with about 2 / 3 of the can of spaghetti sauce, set aside to cool. Step 4: Meanwhile, mix together ricotta, cottage cheese, parmesan and pepper, stir til smooth. Step 5: Set aside Next, saute the zucchini, onion, and garlic in the olive oil. Step 6: Add oregano, basil, salt and water. Step 7: Cook until water has evaporated and zucchini is tender-crisp.

Dish Name: Delicious Low Fat Pasta Primavera Sauce
Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, tomato paste, fresh broccoli florets, carrot, onion, zucchini, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, garlic, bay leaves, olive oil, dried basil, dried rosemary, dried oregano, dried thyme
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot combine combine all the ingredients-- yep, all of them together in one go! Step 2: Heat to just boiling, cover and reduce heat to simmer. Step 3: Cook until all vegetable are tender, approximately 45 minutes, stir occasionally. Step 4: Serve with cooked pasta of your choice!

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, pizza sauce, part-skim mozzarella cheese, reduced-fat ricotta cheese, dried oregano, vegetable oil cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Open dough can and place on a work surface. Step 2: Roll out and cut two 6-inch circles Rework scraps, roll out, and cut out another two 6-inch circles for a total of 4 circles. Step 3: Discard remaining scraps. Step 4: Place the dough circles on the work surface. Step 5: Spread each circle with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce to within 1 / 4 inch of the edge. Step 6: Place 1 / 4 cup of the mozzarella cheese near the center of each circle. Step 7: Top each with 1 tablespoon ricotta cheese and sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon oregano Dampen the edges of each circle with a little water. Step 8: Fold circles in half, enclosing the cheese filling.

Ingredient Names: tomato and basil pasta sauce, lasagna noodles, carrot, broccoli floret, zucchini, summer squash, onion, mushrooms, sweet bell pepper, sliced ripe olives, baby spinach leaves, fresh basil, lowfat mozzarella cheese, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Pour enough sauce to cover the bottom of an 8x8" baking dish About 1 / 3 of the jar. Step 3: Sprinkle grated carrot and chopped onion over sauce in bottom of dish. Step 4: Top sauce with two of the barilla noodles. Step 5: Layer the slices of zucchini, summer squash, and mushrooms and spinach over the noodles. Step 6: Sprinkle the broccoli, bell pepper, fresh basil and sliced olives over the spinach leaves. Step 7: Top with half cup of the mozzarella cheese. Step 8: Pour 1 / 2 of the remaining sauce over the mozzarella cheese and top with the last two lasagna noodles. Step 9: Pour the last of the pasta sauce over the top noodles and spread out evenly.

Ingredient Names: red wine vinegar, dijon mustard, vegetable oil, olive oil, sour cream, dill weed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk the ingredients together Chill for 30 minutes Serve over crisp green salad of your choice.

Ingredient Names: russet potato, cider vinegar, olive oil, dried dill weed, garlic cloves, dijon mustard, ground black pepper, salt, onion, tomatoes, eggs, plain yogurt, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Soak potatoes in cold water 10 minutes to remove excess starch, drain and pat dry. Step 2: Whisk together vinegar, 2 tbs Olive oil, 1 tbs Dill, 3 teaspoons garlic, mustard, pepper, and salt in large bowl. Step 3: Cook potatoes in large pot of boiling water 5 minutes, or until tender. Step 4: Drain, and toss with the vinegar dill mixture from. Step 5: Preheat oven to broil. Step 6: Heat remaining oil in ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Saute onion and tomato 5 minutes, or until soft.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, fresh ground pepper, fresh rosemary, garlic cloves, salt, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients to blend in a bowl or a pour bottle Dip bread and enjoy Refrigerate any left over.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaves, pine nuts, fresh garlic clove, parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt, baby portabella mushrooms, provolone cheese, roasted red peppers, black olives, artichoke heart, prepared pizza crust
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Prepare pesto sauce by combining basil, pine nuts, garlic and parmesan in blender or food processor. Step 3: Blend well Slowly drizzle olive oil in blender or processor while blending, until thick. Step 4: Season to taste with salt, set aside. Step 5: Heat a little olive oil in skillet and saute mushrooms a few minutes to increase flavor, cool slightly. Step 6: Spread pesto sauce over pizza crust Evenly distribute provolone, red bell peppers, black olives and artichokes over pesto.

Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, olive oil, lemon juice, capers, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Spread aluminum foil over the bottom of a broiling pan. Step 3: Place peppers on foil and broil until skin becomes blistered and charred, turning to char all sides, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Remove peppers from oven Lift corners of foil and fold them together to seal in the peppers. Step 5: Cover with a dish towel and let stand 30 minutes Unwrap foil carefully. Step 6: Remove and discard stems, seeds, and charred skin, but save all the liquid. Step 7: Put the saved liquid in a mixing bowl. Step 8: Cut peppers into 1 / 2" strips and place in bowl.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, sugar, salt, instant yeast, extra virgin olive oil, warm water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, stirring vigorously. Step 2: Set aside to rest five minutes, and then stir again for three to five minutes. Step 3: Add additional water or flour to achieve a smooth, sticky dough. Step 4: Divide into four pieces and place each one into an oiled freezer bag At this point, dough can be refrigerated or frozen. Step 5: Allow to rise at room temperature and then punch down Stretch each piece onto a ten inch pizza pan and allow to rest a few minutes. Step 6: Top as usual, and then bake at 450f until crust is crisp and cheese has melted.

Dish Name: Don Giovanni Salad B O G Salad
Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaf, baby spinach leaves, fennel bulb, fresh cilantro leaves, radicchio, extra virgin olive oil, white wine vinegar, fresh ground black pepper, garlic clove, fennel leaves, parmesan cheese, lemon wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Begin by cutting the garlic clove in half and taking one half and rubbing along the inside of serving bowl. Step 2: Toss the basil leaves, baby spinach leaves, diced fennel bulbs, cilantro leaves and radicchio together lightly in a salad bowl Mince the two garlic halves, adding to the salad along with the olive oil, white wine vinegar, fennel fronds and parmesan if using, toss lightly. Step 3: Serve salad with lemon wedges, a good bottle of wine and of course crusty italian bread Don't forget the freshly ground black pepper for the final touch!

Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, egg whites, unsalted butter, onion, all-purpose flour, whole milk, bay leaf, fresh thyme, whole black peppercorns, kosher salt, ground nutmeg, mascarpone cheese, taleggio, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, pecorino romano cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f butter ten to twelve 10-oz Ovenproof bowls or ramekins, set aside. Step 2: Bring a large pot of water with 1 tablespoon of salt to boiling. Step 3: Add pasta, stir just until water returns to boiling. Step 4: Cook pasta according to package directions just until tender to the bite. Step 5: Drain, shaking well. Step 6: Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl beat egg whites with electric mixer to stiff peaks In dutch oven, melt butter over medium-low heat. Step 7: Add onion and cook until softened.

Ingredient Names: vegetarian bacon, whole grain bread, mayonnaise, green leaf lettuce, tomatoes, salt, pepper, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the bacon and place on paper towels. Step 2: When cool, break each slice in half Toast the bread slices. Step 3: Spread mayonnaise on 2 slices of bread. Step 4: Now lay lettuce leaf, tomato slices, and 3 pieces of the broken veggie bacon on one slice. Step 5: Top with other bread slice, mayonnaise side up Lay lettuce leaf, tomato slices and 3 pieces of broken bacon on bread. Step 6: Top with additional slice of bread. Step 7: Repeat for remaining three sandwiches. Step 8: Slice diagonally and serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, water, fresh mushrooms, onion, sliced water chestnuts, salt, pepper, basil, dried italian seasoning, olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Wash beans, trim ends and remove strings. Step 2: Combine beans and water in a dutch oven, bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover, reduce heat and simmer 6 to 8 minutes until crisp-tender. Step 4: Drain Plunge into ice water to stop the cooking process. Step 5: Drain beans and set aside. Step 6: Saute mushrooms and next 7 ingredients in oil in a dutch oven. Step 7: Stir in beans and cook until thoroughly heated. Step 8: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, italian salad dressing, dry white wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, combine all ingredients Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, or until broccoli is tender.

Ingredient Names: plain breadcrumbs, parsley flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, sugar, oregano, pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Take 12 slices of stale bread and let air dry Crumble and grate until into crumbs Let dry again Add rest of the ingredients.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, dry white wine, garlic cloves, olive oil, kalamata olive, linguine, fresh parsley, fresh basil, hot sauce, tomato sauce, balsamic vinegar, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add tomatoes, wine, garlic and olives. Step 3: Cook until sauce begins to thicken, stirring often, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until just tender. Step 5: Add pasta, parsley, basil, hot sauce, tomato sauce and vinegar to sauce in skillet. Step 6: Toss over medium heat until sauce coats pasta. Step 7: Season to taste with salt and pepper Mount pasta in bowl and sprinkle with feta cheese.

Ingredient Names: flour, warm water, olive oil, fast rising yeast, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Throw all ingredients into a bowl and mix together with a food processor or by hand The dough will be fairly sticky but don't add any more flour Instead scrape it into an oiled bowl, cover with a cloth and leave to rise for 30 minutes or until doubled in size I like to let my dough rise in an ever-so-slightly warmed oven or in an airing cupboard. Step 2: When dough is finished rising, pre-heat oven to 400 f degrees. Step 3: Turn onto a floured surface and work in a bit more flour until the dough loses its stickiness -- you shouldn't need too much -- then roll out to desired size, keeping the dough about 1 / 2 inch thick. Step 4: Leave to rise for about 10 minutes, before topping with your favourite ingredients. Step 5: Put on a baking sheet sprinkled with flour or cornmeal and bake for 10-15 minutes in a very hot oven until lightly browned Our standard is 230-240 c in a fan oven for 10 minutes on a top shelf.

Dish Name: Easiest Pasta With Tomato Basil Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, salt and pepper, basil, rotini pasta, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rotini in salted, boiling water according to package directions, reserving a 1 / 2 cup of the pasta water at the end of cooking. Step 2: In a heavy saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium and add onion. Step 3: Cook for a minute or so and add garlic Before garlic takes on color, add the tomatoes. Step 4: Turn heat up to high, wait for sauce to begin to bubble, then turn back down to medium. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper and add basil. Step 6: Cook for another minute or two and remove from heat. Step 7: Add cooked pasta and about 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup of hot pasta water to desired wetness of sauce. Step 8: Top with parmesan, to taste, and serve immediately.

Dish Name: East Meets West Vegetable Soba Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: soba noodles, broccoli, yellow squash, green onions, garlic cloves, soy sauce, plain soymilk, vegan butter, paprika, cayenne pepper, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Wash & chop all the vegetables, place the onions & garlic in a medium sauce pan & saute on medium-high heat with 12 tablespoon of the butter for one minute until slightly tender. Step 2: Pour in 12 cup of the soymilk & one tablespoon of the soy sauce & stir until it bubbles. Step 3: Then add all of the vegetables & the rest of the soymilk & simmer still on medium-high heat until once again it bubbles. Step 4: Add the paprika, cayenne & black pepper & the other tablespoon of soy sauce & butter & reduce to medium heat & simmer for ten minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Meanwhile, salt & put the water on to boil & cook the soba until tender & drain. Step 6: Serve the stir-fry sauce over the noodles & top with salt & pepper Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: pasta sauce, no-boil lasagna noodles, part-skim ricotta cheese, vegetables, part-skim mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 9"x13" casserole. Step 3: Cover with a layer of noodles. Step 4: Place ricotta in a bowl and add about 1 / 4 cup of water, stirring until blended. Step 5: Spread 1 / 3 of this mixture over the pasta. Step 6: Spread 1 / 3 of the remaining pasta sauce over the cheese. Step 7: Spread 1 / 3 of the vegetables over the sauce. Step 8: Sprinkle 1 / 3 of the mozzarella over the veggies. Step 9: Repeat twice starting with the noodles and ending with the mozzarella. Step 10: Cover and bake until the noodles are tender.

Dish Name: Easy And Awesome Pizza Base Recipe
Ingredient Names: dry yeast, brown sugar, warm water, plain flour, extra virgin olive oil, sea salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm water and leave for 5 minutes While waiting, sift the flour into your mixing bowl. Step 2: Add the salt & oil. Step 3: Once a foam has formed on the yeasty water pour it in and start mixing. Step 4: Add more water as required until the dough feels like a young woman's breast I was taught this by a baker many years ago and while it sounds rude, it really is the easiest way to describe how a good dough should feel. Step 5: Now clean your mixing bowl This next part, while not vital, does make a noticeable difference Rub oil around the surface of the dough, put it in your clean mixing bowl and stick it in the fridge. Step 6: Leave it there for as long as possible.

Ingredient Names: water, oil, salt, all-purpose flour, active dry yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Load all ingredients into the bread machine in order listed making a small well in the flour for the yeast. Step 2: Set machine to dough cycle and start. Step 3: After about ten minutes add a bit of water if the dough seems dry You may also add spices and dried herbs to the dough. Step 4: Add them after the salt but before the flour. Step 5: Roll dough onto pizza pan, top and bake at 400 degrees for 15- 20 minute.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil leaf, capers, olive oil, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: On a large platter arrange tomato slices and mozarella slices Sprinkle with basil and capers Season with salt Drizzle with olive oil Serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti sauce, lasagna noodles, fat-free ricotta cheese, vegetables, lowfat mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray 11x7 baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Spread 1 / 3 of the sauce on bottom of dish. Step 3: Arrange 3 noodles over the sauce. Step 4: Top with another 1 / 3 of sauce, all of the riccota cheese and the vegetables, and 1 / 2 the mozzerella cheese. Step 5: Top with remaining 3 noodles and the remaining sauce. Step 6: Cover dish with foil. Step 7: Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Step 8: Remove foil and sprinkle with remaining cheese, bake for another 5 minutes. Step 9: Let stand 5 minutes before cutting I cut the lasagna in 6 pieces, wrap them in seran wrap and freeze them.

Dish Name: Easy Cream Walnut Sauce For Ravioli
Ingredient Names: ravioli, walnuts, unsalted butter, olive oil, parmesan cheese, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Grind up the nuts in a food processor completely. Step 2: Add the butter and olive oil and pulse a few times until a nice paste forms. Step 3: Add the cheese and pulse 2-3 times. Step 4: Add the cream gradually and keep it on a continual blend until smooth. Step 5: Put the cooked ravioli onto plates, and pour equal amounts of the sauce over it The hot ravioli will heat up the sauce on its own after a few minutes.

Dish Name: Easy Creamy Low Calorie Butternut Squash Lasagna
Ingredient Names: no-boil lasagna noodles, butternut squash, fresh spinach, frozen butternut squash puree, part-skim ricotta cheese, asiago cheese, mozzarella cheese, skim milk, garlic powder, dried garlic flakes, dried shallots, italian herb seasoning, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Components Butternut squash. Step 2: Put butternut squash in a microwave save bowl. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste and stir. Step 4: Cover and microwave 6-10 minutes or until fork tender Squash "marinara" Wilt fresh spinach in the microwave using a covered microwave safe bowl. Step 5: Add thawed squash puree. Step 6: Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder Ricotta mixture.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, eggs, seasoned dry bread crumbs, olive oil, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange a layer of eggplant slices in a colander. Step 2: Sprinkle generously with salt Continue layering and salting all eggplant slices. Step 3: Let stand 30 minutes, rinse and pat dry. Step 4: Dip each eggplant slice in beaten egg, and dredge with breadcrumbs. Step 5: Heat oil in a heavy skillet Over medium high heat fry eggplant in hot oil about 2 minutes per side until golden. Step 6: Drain on absorbent paper. Step 7: Preheat oven to temperature 350f arrange half the eggplant slices in the bottom of baking dish sprayed lightly with nonstick spray.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, feta cheese, fresh basil leaves, olive oil, garlic cloves, salt and pepper, french baguette, pam cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up feta cheese. Step 2: Add olive oil Mince garlic and add to cheese and oil Finely chop basil and add to mixture. Step 3: Stir mixture well Dice tomatoes and add to mixture. Step 4: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Cover and refridgerate for 1 hour. Step 6: Slice baguette on an angle and put on a cookie sheet Spray with pam.

Ingredient Names: water, white bread flour, sugar, salt, fast rise yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Load ingredients into your machine in the order given Reset the machine after the first knead for the crispy crust of french bread. Step 2: Bake using the regular or rapid bake cycle.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, pasta sauce, zucchini, roma tomatoes, red bell pepper, red onion, white button mushrooms, head of broccoli, basil, mozzarella cheese, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, fat-free ricotta cheese, eggs, garlic cloves, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: In a large bowl combine spinach, ricotta cheese, eggs, garlic, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: In a deep 9x13 lasagna pan, add a few oz of the pasta sauce to lightly coat the bottom. Step 4: Add 3 lasagna noodles to cover the bottom of the pan with out overlapping the noodles. Step 5: Add half the ricotta / spinach mixture by dolloping it onto the noodles, sprinkle zucchini, tomato slices, broccoli, onion, mushrooms and bell pepper slices. Step 6: Add 20 or so oz, covering the veggies On the next layer, add 3 more lasagna noodles, the other half of the spinach and ricotta mixture, the rest of the veggies, and half a jar of pasta sauce. Step 7: Then, to finish it off, layer the remaining lasagna noodles, the rest of the pasta sauce, and the parmigiano-reggiano cheese as well as the mozzarella. Step 8: Bake in the oven for 40-50 minutes until cheese begins to brown and bubble. Step 9: Let sit for 10 minutes after removing from oven to allow liquids to be reabsorbed by veggies.

Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, ricotta cheese, frozen chopped spinach, egg yolk, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Filling: In a large bowl mix ricotta, spinach, egg yolk and parmesan cheese Salt and pepper to taste Ravioli: Place 1 / 2 tablespoon of filling in the center of the wonton wrapper Moisten edges of wonton wrapper with water. Step 2: Fold into a triangle. Step 3: Press edges to seal. Step 4: Bring large pot of salted water to boil. Step 5: Drop 12 ravioli into boiling water at a time.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, salt, olive oil, bread flour, active dry yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Place all the ingredients in bread machine pan Process on dough setting At the end of the cycle, remove dough from machine. Step 2: Place it on parchment paper Punch down dough. Step 3: Shape dough into baguete-shaped loaf about 12 inches long. Step 4: Place loaf on cornmeal-coated cookie sheet and with sharp knife, make 1 deep lenghtwise slash in top of loaf, cover. Step 5: Let rise in warm place for about 1 hour. Step 6: Brush loaf with egg white, if desired.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat bread, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees on bake. Step 2: Cut bread into 3 / 4 inch wide strips and lay them flat on an aluminum pan. Step 3: Drizzle olive oil onto bread, sprinkle herbs and cheese Pop into the oven for 15-20 minutes If you want to make mini croutons for salad, cut the bread into small cubes and follow same procedure.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, vinegar, vegetable oil, parmesan cheese, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix by hand, and serve! Step 2: Add more parmesan if desired.

Ingredient Names: mostaccioli pasta, light pasta sauce, mozzarella cheese, mushrooms, yellow squash, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: Mix mostaccioli, sauce, 1 cup of the cheese and vegetables. Step 2: Spoon into 13x9-inch baking dish. Step 3: Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 4: Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

Dish Name: Easy Marinara Dipping Sauce For The Lazy
Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, olive oil, basil, oregano, onion powder, garlic clove, sugar, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all the ingredients together in a food processor or blender To gently heat, pour 1 / 4 cup into a microwave-safe ramekin or container, and put a paper plate over it so tomato splats won't get all over the microwave Nuke for 30 seconds on 50% power You may have to adjust up or downward depending on microwave strength.

Ingredient Names: prepared pizza crust, pesto sauce, artichoke heart, sun-dried tomato, spinach leaves, kalamata olive, feta cheese, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, pine nuts, chicken breast, fresh basil, bell pepper, pepperoni
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Brush pizza shell with olive oil. Step 3: Spread pesto sauce thoroughly over the surface of the shell, leaving the edge as a crust. Step 4: Top with olives, sundried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, wilted spinach leaves and cover with cheeses. Step 5: Place pizza directly on oven rack for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted from centre to edge. Step 6: Allow to cool for 5 minutes before slicing.

Dish Name: Easy Pasta With Bell Pepper And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: pasta, water, olive oil, onion, fresh tomatoes, green bell pepper, dried basil, oregano, salt, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pot of 1 1 / 2 cups of lightly salted water to a boil, add pasta, and cook for about 10-12 minutes, or until pasta is al dente, drain. Step 2: Heat oil in a saucepan on a medium flame, add the onions and saute until soft and translucent. Step 3: Now add the diced tomatoes and bell-pepper strips, salt, basil, oregano and saute for about 5 minutes until the bell-peppers soften a bit If you like it crispier, saute only for a couple of minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat, toss well with cooked pasta and serve hot with a sprinkling of cheddar cheese!

Ingredient Names: warm water, active dry yeast, honey, olive oil, kosher salt, whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, place the warm water in first then the honey. Step 2: Sprinkle the yeast on top, agitate the bowl slightly if you have to so the yeast gets immersed in the water Wait 10-15 minutes or until foamy. Step 3: Add the oil and salt. Step 4: Blend in the flours and knead until elasticy, about 5 minutes or so. Step 5: Cover with parchment paper or a dish towel and let rise for 20-30 minutes Spray a cookie sheet, pizza stone, or round baking dish with cooking spray and put some dough in and you're set! Step 6: I get about 4-5 8" mini pizzas out of this Maybe more if i really rolled it out to make thin-crust.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, boca meatless ground burger, onion, tomato sauce, dried basil, garlic cloves, italian seasoning, mushroom, bell pepper, garlic, refrigerated biscuits, part-skim mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees In skillet, stir together boca crumbles, onion, tomato sauce, basil, garlic, and italian seasoning. Step 2: Add any of the optional veggies that you want, just make sure they are zero points. Step 3: Add quartered biscuit dough. Step 4: Stir gently until biscuits are covered with sauce Spray a 9x13" casserole dish with cooking spray. Step 5: Bake for 25 minutes. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese and bake an additional 10 minutes or until biscuits are done. Step 7: Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Easy Pizza Dough For Bread Machine
Ingredient Names: water, extra virgin olive oil, salt, bread flour, sugar, bread machine quick-acting active dry yeast, dried herbs, semolina
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients to pan in order listed, set bread machine on"dough" and walk away. Step 2: After the cycle is completed, lightly coat dough ball in flour and roll or slap out to desired size. Step 3: Top with desired sauce, cheeses, meats and / or veggies and bake at 450 until cheese is golden brown Will make a 9-10" pizza of average thickness, or a 13-14" thin crust pizza For best results, bake on a preheated baking stone sprinkled with corn meal I've used 3 / 4 cup flat beer and 1 / 4 water with excellent results A teaspoon of semolina may be added as well -- it provides a nice crunchiness to the dough when baked Corn meal can be substituted for the semolina.

Ingredient Names: instant vanilla pudding, cream cheese, dark rum, brewed espresso, sugar, ladyfingers, whipped topping, semisweet baking chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pudding according to box direction. Step 2: Add cheese and coffee liqueur and beat until smooth. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and chill 1 hour. Step 4: Fold in whipped topping. Step 5: In a small shallow dish, stir sugar into coffee and dip each ladyfinger in for only 4-5 seconds. Step 6: Line bottom of 8 cup trifle bowl with 1 / 2 of the lady fingers, spread 1 / 2 of pudding mixture over cookies and sprinkle with 1 / 2 of the chocolate, repeat layers. Step 7: Cover tightly and chill for 4 hours or overnight.

Dish Name: Easy Ravioli With Basil And Sun Dried Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: cheese ravioli, crushed tomatoes, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, fresh basil, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Cook and drain ravioli as directed on package While ravioli is cooking, mix crushed tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes and basil. Step 3: Pour 1-1 / 2 cups of the tomato mixture in an ungreased rectangular baking dish, 11x7x1-1 / 2 inches, top with ravioli. Step 4: Pour remaining tomato mixture over the ravioli. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 6: Bake uncovered about 20 minutes or until hot.

Dish Name: Easy Ricotta And Spinach Tortelloni In Tomato Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh basil, tomatoes, spinach leaves, low-fat ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, ground nutmeg, wonton wrappers, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 teaspoons oil in large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and half garlic, saute 5 minutes. Step 3: Add tomatoes and 3 / 4 cup basil. Step 4: Cook 15 minutes to blend flavors, stirring often and adding water if dry. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 7: Add garlic and saute 1 minute. Step 8: Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Squeeze out extra liquid, if any.

Dish Name: Easy Roasted Red Pepper And Mushroom Lasagna
Ingredient Names: no-boil lasagna noodles, roasted red peppers, button mushrooms, frozen chopped spinach, spaghetti sauce, part-skim ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Combine ricotta, spinach, 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese, and egg in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: Spread 1 cup of sauce on bottom of baking pan. Step 4: Layer 4 uncooked lasagna noodles, 1 / 3 of ricotta mixture, 1 / 2 of sliced mushrooms, 1 / 2 of roasted red peppers, and 1 cup of sauce. Step 5: Layer 4 uncooked noodles, 1 / 3 of ricotta mixture, and 1-1 / 2 cup sauce. Step 6: Layer 4 uncooked noodles, the rest of the ricotta mixture, remaining mushrooms and roasted red peppers, and 1 cup of sauce. Step 7: Layer 4 uncooked noodles, remaining sauce, and parmesan and remaining mozzarella. Step 8: Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 50-60 minutes. Step 9: Remove foil and continue baking until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: blanched almond, icing sugar, all-purpose flour, egg whites, granulated sugar, almond extract
Instructions: Step 1: In food processor, blend almonds and 1 / 4 cup of the icing sugar until finely ground. Step 2: Blend in remaining icing sugar and flour In bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form Gradually beat in granulated sugar until stiff glossy peaks form. Step 3: Fold in the nut mixture and the almond extract. Step 4: Grease baking sheet and preheat oven to 300f. Step 5: Using a pastry bag, pipe biscuit mixture into 1 1 / 2 inch wide mounds about 1 1 / 2 inches apart. Step 6: Bake in 300f oven for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Step 7: Turn off the oven and allow the biscuits to dry inside the oven for 20 minutes. Step 8: Remove from oven and cool on racks.

Ingredient Names: pasta, garlic clove, herbed feta cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, olive oil, fresh basil, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta in salted water. Step 2: Drain, reserving the liquid, set aside. Step 3: Put oil in the bottom of a serving dish Crush garlic and place in oil. Step 4: In a separate bowl, break up feta cheese until it's crumbly. Step 5: Add enough pasta water to make it into a lumpy mixture. Step 6: Place in serving dish. Step 7: Chop or cut sun-dried tomatoes into small pieces and add to the cheese. Step 8: Mix in toasted pine nuts, pecans or walnuts.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, firm tofu, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, spaghetti sauce, parsley, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large bowl crumble in the drained and rinsed hard tofu. Step 3: Add 12 oz of the shredded mozzarella, ricotta cheese, and spices. Step 4: Fold together everything in the bowl with a large spoon- set aside. Step 5: In a 9" x 13" pan, spoon a layer of spaghetti sauce. Step 6: Then add a layer of lasagne noodles. Step 7: Spoon on a layer of filling, then a layer of sauce, then a layer of noodles Continue layering like this until you run out of ingredients. Step 8: Top with remaining 4 oz mozzarella and some parsley. Step 9: Cook for 45 min to 1 hr, or until hot and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, red onion, mozzarella cheese, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In container with lid, combine all ingredients Close lid and shake vigorously. Step 2: Serve atop toasted italian bread, melba toast or crostini Do not leave cheese in leftover bruschetta! Step 3: The vinegar soaks in and makes the cheese taste sour.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes with juice, garlic, wine, dried basil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Puree tomatoes and garlic together. Step 2: Heat puree and wine in medium saucepan until gently boiling. Step 3: Cook for 20 minutes to 30 minutes over medium heat or until desired consistency is reached. Step 4: Stir in basil and seasonings.

Dish Name: Easy Tomato Sauce With No Peeling
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic, italian seasoning, brown sugar, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Core and chop tomatoes into chunks and toss into pot on the stove as you go. Step 2: Add garlic and seasoning. Step 3: Simmer 1-2 hours, occasionally pressing tomatoes against side of pan with wooden spoon. Step 4: Add brown sugar to taste. Step 5: Add tomato paste to thicken Can be made in a crockpot-cook on low for 6-8 hours depending on amount. Step 6: Cool and freeze for summer taste in winter.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, marinara sauce, firm silken tofu, soymilk, nutritional yeast, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat marinara sauce in a saucepan over low to low-medium heat. Step 3: Blend tofu, soy milk, and nutritional yeast in blender or food processor until smooth You may also add about a tablespoon of olive oil or additional soy milk, until the consistency is like thick alfredo sauce. Step 4: Add tofu mixture to the saucepan with the marinara sauce. Step 5: Stir in vinegar or vodka. Step 6: Add salt and pepper and any other seasonings you like, to taste Continue to simmer over low heat until pasta is ready. Step 7: Toss with drained pasta and enjoy! Step 8: Serving suggestions: add sauteed veggies or your favorite meat subsitutes.

Ingredient Names: wonton wrapper, extra firm tofu, fresh spinach, mushrooms, red bell pepper, chives, sunflower seeds, sun-dried tomatoes, baby carrots, nutritional yeast flakes, rosemary, garlic cloves, lemon juice, fresh cracked pepper, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mill sunflower seeds into meal consistency then set aside. Step 2: Drain sundried tomatoes and finely chop. Step 3: Blend chopped tofu, lemon juice, sea salt, nutritional yeast until ricotta like consistency It is best not to use a blender for this or you get tofu paste. Step 4: Add chopped tomatoes, red peppers, and chives. Step 5: Blend by hand until well mixed. Step 6: In a small bowl combine tofu mixture with remaining ingredients and mix until thoroughly combined. Step 7: Place 1 tbsp of mixture in center of wonton wrapper Wet, crimp and seal edges of wrapper securely or the wrapper will open in the pan and contents will spill out Spray the bottom of a steamer with a bit of oil.

Dish Name: Easy Vegan White Bean Au Pistou
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, crookneck yellow squash, navy beans, vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, fresh spinach, spaghetti, pesto sauce, black pepper, portabella mushroom, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Place the olive oil in a 4 qt saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Saute the onions, garlic, and squash for approximately 4 minutes. Step 3: Add the beans, broth, tomatoes, spinach, and the olives and mushrooms, if using. Step 4: Boil, then lower heat and simmer while covered for 15 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the pesto and pasta Continue to simmer for about another 5 minutes, until pasta is ready. Step 6: Season with black pepper to taste Salt probably won't be necessary, as canned vegetables tend to have enough sodium added.

Ingredient Names: onion, celery, carrots, garlic, vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, beans, tomato paste, italian seasoning, black pepper, parmesan cheese, basil pesto, macaroni
Instructions: Step 1: Put all of the ingredients except for the macaroni in the bowl of a slow cooker. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours Just before serving, cook the macaroni in boiling, salted water until al dente, about 7 minutes. Step 3: Drain the macaroni and stir it into the soup. Step 4: Serve topped with parmesan cheese.

Dish Name: Easy Vegetarian Lasagne Some Assembly Required
Ingredient Names: tomatoes with juice, garlic cloves, vinegar, red wine, sugar, salt, olive oil, bow tie pasta, silver beet, italian parsley, cottage cheese, colby
Instructions: Step 1: Get a big pot heating up for the pasta, make sure you salt it well, i think it's amazing how much better the pasta tastes when you've put a good tablespoon of salt in there, or more! Step 2: ) chuck in your pasta when it starts boiling. Step 3: Make sure you keep an eye on it and drain it and cool it with some cold water when it's tender but still has some bite. Step 4: Combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a new saucepan. Step 5: Keep this cooking while you prepare the rest of the food. Step 6: Cut up your silverbeet into thin strips (don't need to be fussy, just so that it can be sprinkled into layers. Step 7: Cut up your rocket, parsley, or other herbs It's time to layer I used a deep small casserole dish So, now put half the silverbeet in the bottom of your baking dish, then some dollops of cottage cheese, then some tomato and some rocket and parsley, then half of the pasta. Step 8: Repeat those layers once more.

Dish Name: Egg Salad With Capers And Olives
Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, red onions, mayonnaise, dijon mustard, red bell peppers, kalamata olives, parsley, capers, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop eggs and move to a bowl Add the remaining ingredients Salt and pepper to taste, mixing well Enjoy!

Dish Name: Eggless Semolina Pasta Dough From Bob's Red Mill
Ingredient Names: semolina flour, white flour, sea salt, water, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: On a flat work surface combine flours and salt in a mound From a little well in the middle for your wet ingredients. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 cup water and 1 tbs oil, pouring into the well formed by your dry ingredients. Step 3: Mix to make a stiff dough. Step 4: Add one tablespoon of water at a time while combining mixture, until desired consistency is achieved. Step 5: Knead 10 minutes or until dough is elastic. Step 6: Wrap dough in towel or place in plastic bag and let rest for 20 minutes On a lightly floured surface roll out to desired thickness and cut as desired To cook: bring a large pot of water containing 1 / 2 teaspoon olive oil to a boil. Step 7: Add pasta and cook until tender.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, tomatoes, garlic cloves, parsley, salt, pepper, extra virgin olive oil, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Clean the eggplant with cold water and then slice length wise into slices about the thickness of a finger, making horizontal and vertical incisions into the flesh of the vegetable Salt these slices and place them in a colander with a plate on top to weight them down. Step 2: Leave them for about half an hour Clean the tomatoes, remove any seeds and dice them. Step 3: Rinse the eggplant under cold water and dry them with some kitchen towel. Step 4: Arrange a layer of eggplant in an oven dish, scatter some of the diced tomatoes, some crushed garlic, parsley and a little salt and pepper. Step 5: Drizzle with olive oil. Step 6: Repeat this process with other layers until all of the ingredients are finished. Step 7: Place in a pre heated oven at 350f / 180c and cook for half an hour.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, light olive oil, mozzarella cheese, basil pesto, tomato puree, virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200dc. Step 2: Heat oil in a large pan until almost smoking and cook eggplant in 3 or 4 lots until golden on both sides. Step 3: Drain well in kitchen towel On a lightly oiled baking tray, reform the eggplants into a stack, putting a little pesto, tomato puree& cheese between the slices Rest for 15 minutes to develop the flavours and then put in the oven for 15 minutes. Step 4: Place eggplant on 4 plates, sprinkle with oil and balsamic and garnish with basil If you want to make it really fancy put some pesto and tomato pure in a couple of squeeze bottles and make an attractive pattern on the plate with a little of each.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, salt, pizza dough, tomato sauce, part-skim mozzarella cheese, mushroom, fresh oregano, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle eggplant with salt and let sit in a colander for 30 minutes, rinse and pat dry. Step 2: Arrange eggplant slices in a single layer on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake in a preheated 400 degree oven for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until the eggplant is tender and lightly browned, let cool. Step 3: Divide pizza dough in half to form two pizzas, or just make one large pizza Follow directions for dough. Step 4: Spread tomato sauce over each pizza round and sprinkle cheese over the top, dividing if necessary for two smaller pizzas. Step 5: Arrange mushrooms and several eggplant slices over the cheese and sprinkle with fresh or dried oregano. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper Follow baking directions for pizza dough.

Dish Name: Eggplant Aubergine Crepes With Spinach Filling
Ingredient Names: eggplant, oil, dried basil, salt & pepper, marinara sauce, baby spinach, water, ricotta cheese, italian cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the broiler Peel and cut the eggplant into eight 1 / 4-inch slices. Step 2: Brush each slice with oil and sprinkle with 1 teaspoons basil, salt, and pepper Broil 5 minutes. Step 3: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Step 4: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine washed spinach and the water. Step 5: Cook 3 minutes or until wilted. Step 6: Rinse with very cold water and drain very well. Step 7: Mix with ricotta cheese and the 1 / 2 cup italian blend cheese. Step 8: Spread 1 cup of the marinara sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, olive oil, garlic cloves, white onion, whole tomatoes, oregano, basil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: On medium heat, cover the bottom of a large skillet with the olive oil, add garlic and cook until slightly browned. Step 2: Add onions and saute until soft and transparent. Step 3: Add eggplant, salt and fresh ground pepper to taste, cook approx 12 min, until soft and brown add can of whole tomatoes, oregano, and basil, reduce heat and simmer until thickens slightly, about 15 minute. Step 4: Serve over pasta, linguine is best, or use as a side dish Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, tomato sauce, zucchini, onion, tomatoes, portabella mushroom, bell pepper, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, italian seasoning, red cayenne pepper, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f and place the eggplant slices on a lightly-greased baking sheet. Step 2: Bake the eggplant 8-10 minutes on each side, depending on how thinly sliced they are While the eggplant is baking, combine the zucchini, onion, tomato, portobello mushroom, and bell pepper in a lightly oiled large frying pan. Step 3: Cook for a few minutes until soft. Step 4: Pour the tomato sauce over the vegetables, and add the garlic, cilantro, italian seasoning, red cayenne pepper, and salt and pepper. Step 5: Simmer covered on low for a few minutes to let the flavors mix. Step 6: Pour a thin layer of the tomato sauce mixture in a medium sized greased caserole dish, and layer eggplant over the top. Step 7: Pour about half the tomato sauce over the eggplant, and finish the layer with half the mozzarella and parmesan cheeses. Step 8: Repeat with another layer of eggplant, sauce, and cheese. Step 9: Bake the casserole at 400f for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, polenta, olive oil flavored cooking spray, onion, garlic cloves, fresh basil leaves, tomato puree, salt and pepper, part-skim mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh rosemary
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse eggplant and trim off and discard both ends. Step 2: Cut eggplant crosswise into 8 equally thick slices. Step 3: Cut polenta crosswise into 8 equal rounds Lightly coat a 14- by 17-inch baking sheet with olive oil spray or brush with olive oil. Step 4: Arrange eggplant and polenta slices in a single layer on sheet Lightly coat slices with more olive oil. Step 5: Bake in a 425 degree regular or convection oven until eggplant is soft when pressed and polenta is heated through, 20 to 25 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, in a 8-to 10 inch nonstick frying pan over medium-high heat, stir onion, garlic, and basil occasionally until onion is lightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Add tomato puree and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 8: Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until flavors are blended, 5 to 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, flour, water, breadcrumbs, firm tofu, frozen spinach, garlic cloves, pasta sauce, vegan mozzarella cheese, nutmeg, salt, pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a food processor process till smooth: tofu, spinach, garlic, nutmeg, salt / pepper to taste and set aside. Step 3: Place flour, water or soymilk, bread crumbs each in separate bowls. Step 4: Heat olive oil in med frying pan. Step 5: Dip eggplant slices into flour then into water or soymilk and finally into breadcrumbs. Step 6: Place 4 slices at a time, into olive oil in frying pan. Step 7: Fry eggplant on each side or until golden brown. Step 8: Place on paper towels to drain excess oil. Step 9: In a lasagna baking dish, spread about 2-4 tablespoons pasta sauce onto bottom of pan to evenly cover. Step 10: Layer eggplant, tofu-spinach mixture and sauce.

Ingredient Names: penne, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, eggplant, chopped tomatoes, tabasco sauce, sugar, basil leaves, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the pasta according to pack instructions. Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan, then gently fry the onion and garlic for about 5 mins until softened. Step 3: Add the eggplant, cook for 3 mins more, then. Step 4: Add a few drops of tabasco if desired. Step 5: Bring to the boil, simmer for 5 mins, then stir through the basil and goat cheese. Step 6: Toss with the drained pasta and serve.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, ground turkey, parmesan cheese, garlic, panko breadcrumbs, fresh basil, red pepper flakes, ground pepper, salt, olive oil, spaghetti sauce, muenster cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place the diced, peeled eggplant in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Step 2: Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until eggplant is tender. Step 3: Meanwhile, mix together the turkey, 1/2 cup parmesan, garlic, bread crumbs, basil, red pepper, pepper, salt for the meatballs. Step 4: Drain the eggplant. Allow to cool for a few minutes. Step 5: Mash the eggplant, salt lightly, and sop up additional water with paper towel. Mix it into the turkey mixture. Step 6: Form into 18 meatballs. The meatballs will be large. Step 7: Heat oil in large frying pan, and brown the meatballs in batches. Turn heat down, cover, and cook the meatballs through. Step 8: Place the sauce in the bottom of a large baking dish. Step 9: Set the meatballs in the sauce. To with the grated cheese and finally with the thickly sliced cheese. Step 10: Bake in an oven at 375 degrees for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Step 11: Serve as is, or with noodles cooked in eggplant water.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, unsalted butter, pancetta, ground pork, beef, kosher salt, pepper, onions, carrots, celery, garlic, tomato paste, ground fennel, red pepper flakes, thyme, dry red wine, one san marzano tomatoes, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat Instant Pot to saute setting. Add olive oil and butter and swirl to coat. Add pancetta, pork, and beef. Season generously with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid evaporates from meat and begins to brown, about 10 minutes. Add onion, carrots, celery, garlic, tomato paste, fennel seeds, red pepper flakes, and thyme sprigs. Season with salt and pepper and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add red wine and cook until reduced by three-fourths, about 6 minutes. Add chopped tomatoes, stir to combine, and season to taste with salt and pepper before topping with lid. Set pressure to high and cook 35 minutes before releasing pressure naturally for 10 minutes. Release pressure automatically. Open lid and return Instant Pot to saute setting. Add heavy cream and stir to combine. Cook until slightly reduced, stirring frequently, about 15 minutes more. Season to taste with salt and pepper and use as desired.

Ingredient Names: russet potatoes, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, microwavable spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender and drain in a colander reserving 1/4 cup of liquid. Step 2: Let potatoes steam 3 minutes, shaking once, then remove to a serving dish. Step 3: While potatoes are cooking, place oil, garlic and red pepper flakes in a small skillet and cook slowly over low heat until garlic is lightly browned. Step 4: When potatoes are ready, cook spinach according to package directions. Step 5: Add spinach, garlic-pepper oil (and some reserved liquid if needed) to potatoes, toss, season with salt and pepper and serve at once.

Dish Name: Italian Sausage and Vegetables with Gorgonzola Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: butter, flour, milk, cream, gorgonzola, parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, pepper, sweet onions, bell peppers, italian sausages, fresh asparagus, portabella mushrooms, penne pasta, virgin olive oil, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sauce pan melt butter over medium heat. Step 2: Add minced garlic to sauce pan cook for a few minutes but do not brown. Step 3: Whisk in the flour to make reux- cook for 3 to 5 minutes whisking constantly- do not let it brown. Step 4: Whisk in milk and heat until boiling- whisk often, add some fresh ground pepper. Step 5: Once sauce is thickened remove from heat and set aside (well get back to the this later). Step 6: In a large frying pan over medium-high heat add 3 Tbs olive oil add onions and slice the remaining garlic into pan sautee for 3 minutes until onion starts to soften. Step 7: Add peppers, Italian seasoning cook for 5 minutes until Peppers begin to soften. Step 8: Add cooked Sausage and warm through. Step 9: Just before vegetable and meat mixture is finished- heat White sauce and stir in the cream, bring up to almost a boil and stir in parmesan and gorgonzola. Step 10: Stir sauce until most of the gorgonzola is incorportated (lumps of cheese left in the sauce is a good thing!). Step 11: Check cream sauce for salt add if necessary. Step 12: In pasta bowls place Penne followed by Pepper onion meat mixture, then spoon on the Gorgonzola sauce, arrange mushrooms and asparagas on top.

Dish Name: Italian pork patties with potato wedges
Ingredient Names: baking potatoes unpeeled, olive oil, juice lemon, fresh breadcrumb, pork ground meat, parmesan, parsley, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss potato wedges in a large roasting tin with 1 tbsp oil and lemon juice. Spread out in a single layer. Bake for 35-45 mins, turning halfway, until golden brown and crisp. Step 2: Meanwhile, place the breadcrumbs in a mixing bowl and moisten with 2 tbsp cold water. Add the mince, Parmesan, parsley, garlic and lemon zest. Season, mix well, then shape into 4 large, flat patties. Step 3: Heat remaining oil in a pan and cook the patties for 7 mins on each side, or until they have a golden crust and are cooked through (alternatively, cook on the barbecue). Serve with the wedges and a tomato and rocket salad, if you like.

Ingredient Names: garlic, tomato, oregano leaves, chili flakes, baby, zucchini, red peppers, beef tomatoes, fresh basil, baguette, balls mozzarella, green salad
Instructions: Step 1: Put the slow cooker onto the High or the browning setting and tip in the crushed garlic, canned tomatoes, half the oregano leaves, chilli and some seasoning. Cook, covered, while you chop the rest of the vegetables. Step 2: Tip out most of the sauce and start layering up half the vegetables and herbs with seasoning – the aubergines, courgettes, red peppers, tomatoes, basil and remaining oregano. Layer in half the bread, rubbed with the whole garlic clove, half the mozzarella and half the tipped-out tomato sauce. Repeat vegetable, herb and tomato sauce layers, followed by the bread and mozzarella. Push everything down well to compress, then cook on high for 5-6 hrs. Step 3: Flash under the grill before serving if you like (and your slow cooker pot is suitable), until golden and bubbling. Serve with the leftover basil leaves on top and a big salad on the side.

Ingredient Names: rotini pasta, olive oil, tempeh, mushroom, green pepper, red pepper, white wine, garlic clove, spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, herbs, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 and spray a square glass baking dish. Step 2: Cook the pasta al dente, drain, drizzle with a little oil and set aside. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat the rest of the oil over medium in a skillet and saute the tempeh and peppers a couple minutes While these are cooking sprinkle herbs over them and stir. Step 4: Add the wine, if using. Step 5: Let it all sizzle and add the mushrooms and garlic, stir, and cook until tender--do not overcook. Step 6: Turn off the heat and pour in the sauce. Step 7: Mix the sauce mixture, pasta and mozzarella and pour it into the baking dish. Step 8: Sprinkle parmesan and parsley over top. Step 9: Bake 25-30 minutes, cover if the cheese starts to brown.

Dish Name: Linguine With Portabella Mushrooms and Broccoli
Ingredient Names: linguine, olive oil, garlic, broccoli florets, portabella mushrooms, dry white wine, no-salt-added tomatoes, red pepper flakes, salt, packaged basil leaf, pasta water, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the pasta to al dente, according to package directions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet. Step 3: Add the garlic, broccoli, and mushrooms. Step 4: Cook over high heat, stirring for 2 minutes, until mushrooms begin to wilt. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and add the wine, tomatoes, and crushed red pepper flakes. Step 6: Cook, simmering slowly for 2 minutes, stirring twice. Step 7: Add the basil and stir. Step 8: Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Step 9: Add to the sauce, increase heat and boil for 1 minute to reduce slightly. Step 10: Divide the pasta between 4 plates. Step 11: Top with sauce and sprinkle with the cheese. Step 12: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Linguine With Potatoes, Green Beans and Pesto
Ingredient Names: fresh basil leaf, flat-leaf italian parsley, pine nuts, garlic, virgin olive oil, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, pecorino romano cheese, linguine, new potatoes, green beans, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: In food processor or blender, combine basil, parsley, pine nuts, garlic, and salt. Cover and blend until finely chopped. Gradually add the olive oil and process until well combined. Add the cheese and process with the on/off switch until just combined. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a 6 quart Dutch oven, cook the pasta according to the package, except add the potatoes and green beans during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Drain the pasta mixture well. DO NOT RINSE. Step 3: In a very large bowl, combine the cooked pasta mixture, pesto, and butter. Toss gently until the pasta and vegetables are well coated. Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Linguine With White Beans and Vegetables
Ingredient Names: linguine, canned white beans, garlic, chicken stock, broccoli florets, zucchini, fresh asparagus, mushrooms, red peppers, plum tomatoes, olive oil, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and toss with 2 tbsp (25 mL) of the olive oil. Set aside. Step 2: In a small saucepan, heat chicken stock and garlic. Add beans and stir gently. Cover and simmer gently over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Set aside. Step 3: In a large wok or skillet, heat remaining 2 tbsp (25 mL) of olive oil over medium-high heat. When hot, add all vegetables except tomatoes; stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Sprinkle with water. Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender-crisp. Step 5: Lower heat and stir in bean and stock mixture. Step 6: Remove from heat and transfer vegetables to a large serving bowl. Step 7: Add tomatoes and linguini to bowl and toss all ingredients until well mixed. Add cheese and toss gently. Season with salt and pepper and top with fresh or dried basil.

Dish Name: Lobster Ravioli With a Light Tomato Vodka Sauce
Ingredient Names: dozen lobster ravioli, italian plum tomatoes, virgin olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, vodka, heavy cream, fresh basil, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Bring salted pasta water to a boil in a large stock pot over high heat. Step 2: For the sauce: Pour the tomatoes and their liquid into a food processor, and pulse until tomatoes are finely chopped. Step 3: Or finely chop the tomatoes by hand if no food processor is available. Step 4: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add the crushed garlic cloves to the hot oil to coat the garlic cloves. Step 6: Cook until garlic is lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Next, carefully add the finely chopped tomatoes. Step 8: Bring tomatoes to a boil and add salt to taste, and crushed red pepper. Step 9: (don't be shy here, a little heat is nice!) Let the tomato mixture cook about 2 minutes more, then add the vodka. Step 10: Lower the heat and simmer the sauce for about 6 minutes, or until the pasta is finished cooking, then add the cream. Step 11: Stir in the fresh basil. Step 12: Cook the lobster ravioli, (or pasta of your choice) in the boiling salted water until al dente. Step 13: If your choose, remove the garlic cloves from the sauce. Step 14: Drain pasta and mix in a serving bowl with 3/4 of the sauce. Step 15: Note: I find that I have a portion of the sauce leftover when I make 3 dozen ravioli. Step 16: Please sauce your pasta of choice to taste, and enjoy the leftovers! Step 17: Pasta may be topped with grated cheese and chopped parsley before serving.

Ingredient Names: french baguettes, butter, garlic powder, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, tomatoes, olive oil, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut baguette into slices. Step 2: Butter and then sprinkle garlic powder each piece, and bake till lightly golden brown. Step 3: Mix garlic powder, Parmesan cheese, and salt in the ricotta cheese, till a lovely blended taste. Step 4: Dice tomatoes in small cubes, add Olive Oil, and small strips of fresh basil leaves, cut into thin strips. Step 5: Spread the ricotta mixture, generously on the cooled garlic bread slices. Step 6: Top with tomato mixture and bake at 350F for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: heavy whipping cream, garlic, white wine, parmesan cheese, ground black pepper, cream cheese, water, spaghetti noodles, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat whipping cream in large saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 2: Add garlic, wine, parmesan, and black pepper to cream, stirring until smooth and unfiorm. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low and add cream cheese, 4 oz At a time, until melted, stirring constantly. Step 4: Keep sauce on low heat while cooking noodes Noodles: in a large stockpot, bring water to a rapid boil, add sea salt and noodles. Step 5: Cook noodles for 8 - 12 minutes, until soft when bitten Briefly drain and rinse noodles, then toss with sauce in saucepan. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: ground meat substitute, minced garlic cloves, milk, parmesan cheese, egg, basil, oregano, parsley, caraway seed, fennel seed, breadcrumbs, pine nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk eggs and milk, add other ingredients except meat. Step 2: Add meat, mix well w / hands--size how you want. Step 3: Place on greased baking sheet or broiler pan. Step 4: Bake for 10-20 minutes at 400f.

Ingredient Names: fresh broccoli florets, butter, parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Drop the broccoli florets into a pan of boiling salted water. Bring back to the boil, cook for 3-5 mins until tender, then drain. Step 2: Melt the butter in a large frying pan and, once sizzling, add the broccoli. Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle in as much of the parmesan as you want to use. Gently stir the florets in the cheese and butter. Scatter on a little more grated parmesan to serve.

Dish Name: Polenta, roasted vegetables & peppered Parmesan crisps
Ingredient Names: butternut squash, raw beetroot, red onions, olive oil, lemons, fine polenta, salt, butter, cheese, arugula, picked thyme leaf, parmesan
