Instructions: Step 1: To make the crisps, turn the oven down to 200C/ 180C fan/ gas mark 6. Season the grated Parmesan with a large pinch of black pepper and scatter evenly over a baking tray covered with a silicone sheet or lightly oiled greaseproof paper and bake for 5 minutes, until golden but not browned. After cooling for five minutes, break into crisp pieces with your fingers. Step 2: Turn the oven up to 220C/ 200C fan/ gas mark 7. Toss the squash and beetroot chunks in the lemon juice and oil, season lightly with salt and pepper, and bake in a roasting tin for 20 minutes. Add the onion wedges and continue to bake for a further 25 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile bring a litre of water, salt and half the butter to a simmer in a large pot, then slowly add the polenta in a fine stream, stirring all the time. Continue to simmer over a low heat for 35 minutes (or according to the instructions if using quick cook polenta), stirring often to prevent it sticking to the bottom. The polenta should be thickened but still soft at this point. If it starts to dry out too much, add a cup of water. When cooked, stir through the rest of the butter, the Parmesan and Taleggio and a pinch of white pepper. Step 4: To serve, spoon the polenta over a board or onto plates, scatter over the vegetables and any roasting juices, then the rocket and thyme. Tuck the parmesan crisps in between the veg, and eat hot.

Ingredient Names: pork escalopes, prosciutto, fresh carrot, runner bean, leeks, olive oil, half-fat creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Season the pork, then lay a slice of prosciutto on each and secure with a cocktail stick. Put the carrots into a pan with a small glass of water, then season if you like. Bring to the boil, cover and cook for 5 mins, then add the beans and leeks. Give everything a stir and cook, covered, for 5 mins more. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the pork and fry quickly for 2-3 mins on each side until cooked. Stir the crème fraîche into the vegetables until it is warmed through, then serve alongside the pork.

Dish Name: Potato Gnocchi in Burnt Butter Sauce
Ingredient Names: potato gnocchi, salt, butter, sage leaves, garlic, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: TO COOK GNOCCHI Bring a large pan of water to the boil, add salt, add gnocchi. Step 2: Cook gnocchi just until it floats to the top- DO NOT OVERCOOK, this will only take a couple of minutes. Step 3: Drain and divide gnocchi into serving bowls. Step 4: TO COOK SAUCE Start preparing the sauce while the water for the gnocchi is coming to the boil. Step 5: Melt butter in a small frypan over a medium heat. Step 6: When the butter starts to foam, tip the pan often to check the colour of the butter. Step 7: As soon as the butter begins to take on a golden brown tinge, add the garlic and sage. Step 8: Give the mixture a stir, then remove the pan immediately from the heat. Step 9: The sage and garlic will continue to cook in the heat of the butter and the pan, while you drain the gnocchi and divide it into serving bowls. Step 10: Spoon the burnt butter sauce over the gnocchi, distributing the pieces of garlic and sage evenly. Step 11: Using a spoon, turn the gnocchi over lightly in each bowl so that it is evenly covered with sauce. Step 12: Sprinkle over parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Ravioli Baked With Broccoli and Spinach
Ingredient Names: spinach, olive oil, garlic, fresh broccoli, salt, pepper, butter, flour, vegetable stock, skim milk, parmigiano-reggiano cheese, nutmeg, mozzarella cheese, cheese ravioli
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler or oven to 500 Bring large stockpot of water to a boil. Step 2: Steam broccoli for about 5 minutes until bright green and slightly tender. Step 3: As water heats up to a boil, heat a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add olive oil and chopped garlic, and saute for about 1 minute. Step 5: Next, add drained spinach to the pan, along with the steamed broccoli. Step 6: Toss vegetable well with garlic oil to coat evenly. Step 7: Sauté for about 5 minutes. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper, remove from the heat into a bowl, and set aside. Step 9: For the sauce: In the same skillet, melt the butter and whisk in the flour into the butter and cook for about 1-2 minutes. Step 10: Add stock, raise heat and bring mixture to a boil, whisking the entire time. Step 11: Slowly whisk in milk and parmesan, and let mixture bubble for about 2 more minutes until thickened. Step 12: Season sauce with nutmeg (if desired) and salt and pepper. Step 13: For the pasta: When pasta water is boiling add salt, stir, and add ravioli. Step 14: Cook for about 4 or 5 minute, until slightly underdone. Step 15: The ravioli will finish cooking with sauce under the broiler. Step 16: Place a thin layer of the white sauce in an oven proof casserole dish, drain ravioli. Step 17: Layer ½ of the ravioli in the baking dish. Step 18: Next add ½ of the broccoli/spinach mixture Add a couple ladles of the sauce to cover this first layer, a little more than half of it. Step 19: Add the rest of the vegetable mixture, then the remaining half of the ravioli. Step 20: Spoon the remaining sauce over the top (a little less than half of it) and top with grated cheese of your choice. Step 21: Place casserole dish under the broiler or in oven about 8 or so inches from the element. Step 22: Broil about 5 minutes until cheese melts and is bubbly and starting to brown.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, cannellini beans, tinned tomatoes, water, rosemary, thyme, kale, wholegrain bread, red onions, grated parmesan, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: When it’s hot, add onion, carrot, celery and garlic; sprinkle with salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft, 5 to. Step 3: Heat the oven to 500 degrees. Step 4: Drain the beans; if they’re canned, rinse them as well. Step 5: Add them to the pot along with tomatoes and their juices and stock, rosemary and thyme. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat so the soup bubbles steadily; cover and cook, stirring once or twice to break up the tomatoes, until the flavors meld, 15 to. Step 7: Fish out and discard rosemary and thyme stems, if you like, and stir in kale. Step 8: Taste and adjust seasoning. Step 9: Lay bread slices on top of the stew so they cover the top and overlap as little as possible. Step 10: Scatter red onion slices over the top, drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with Parmesan. Step 11: Put the pot in the oven and bake until the bread, onions and cheese are browned and crisp, 10 to. Step 12: (If your pot fits under the broiler, you can also brown the top there.) Divide the soup and bread among 4 bowls and serve.

Ingredient Names: veggie crumbles, garlic clove, tomato paste, mushrooms, stewed tomatoes, onion, parsley flakes, basil, thyme, oregano, mild salsa, fat-free cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodles, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saut meat and garlic in a large frying pan. Step 2: Blend the mushrooms and stewed tomatoes and add to pan. Step 3: Add the rest of the sauce ingredients, and simmer for 20 minutes covered. Step 4: Cook the noodles and rinse in cold water to let cool. Step 5: Layer beginning with sauce then noodles then cheese mixture repeat until out of ingredients. Step 6: Top with the parmesan cheese. Step 7: Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: garlic, olive oil, cauliflower, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Grease large casserole dish. Step 3: Place olive oil and garlic in large resealable bag. Step 4: Add cauliflower and shake to mix. Step 5: Pour into prepared casserole dish. Step 6: Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring halfway through. Step 7: Top with Parmesan and parsley and broil for 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pumpkin seeds, onions, garlic, butter, risotto rice, white wine, vegetable stock, wensleydale cheese, fresh chives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the squash in the oil in a roasting tin and roast for 15-20 mins until tender and golden. With 4-5 mins to go, toss the pumpkin seeds with a little salt, make a little space amongst the squash and spread out the seeds, then finish roasting. Remove half the squash and purée or mash, and keep the rest warm in a very low oven until ready to serve. Step 2: Meanwhile, soften the onion and garlic in the butter in a frying pan. Stir in the rice for 1-2 mins. Add the wine and cook, stirring, until the wine has evaporated. Add the hot stock, a ladleful at a time, stirring until each addition is almost completely absorbed. Once all the stock has been added, the rice should be tender and creamy. Stir in the puréed or mashed squash until warm, then season if you like. Serve in shallow bowls, scatter over the reserved roasted squash, crumbled cheese, chives and pumpkin seeds.

Ingredient Names: penne rigate, olive oil, garlic, tinned chopped tomatoes, red chili flakes, italian seasoning, salt, pepper, basil leaves, parmigiano-reggiano
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Add kosher salt to the boiling water, then add the pasta. Step 3: Cook according to the package instructions, about 8-10 minutes. Step 4: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the olive oil and heat until the oil starts to shimmer. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1 to. Step 6: Add the chopped tomatoes, red chile flakes, Italian seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: Remove from the heat and add the chopped basil. Step 9: Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce. Step 10: Garnish with Parmigiano-Reggiano flakes and more basil and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, caster sugar, red wine vinegar, tinned chopped tomatoes, basil leaves, mascarpone, milk, parmesan, mozzarella, spinach, ricotta, nutmeg, cannelloni tubes, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: First make the tomato sauce. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the garlic for 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add the sugar, vinegar, tomatoes and some seasoning and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick. Step 4: Add the basil and divide the sauce between 2 or more shallow ovenproof dishes, set aside. Step 5: Make a sauce by beating the mascarpone with the milk until smooth, season, then set aside. Step 6: Put the spinach in a large colander and pour over a kettle of boiling water to wilt it (you may need to do this in batches). Step 7: When cool enough to handle squeeze out the excess water. Step 8: Roughly chop the spinach and mix in a large bowl with Parmesan and ricotta. Step 9: Season well with salt, pepper and the nutmeg. Step 10: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas Using a piping bag or plastic food bag with the corner snipped off, squeeze the filling into the cannelloni tubes. Step 11: Lay the tubes, side by side, on top of the tomato sauce and spoon over the mascarpone sauce. Step 12: Top with Parmesan and mozzarella. Step 13: You can now freeze the cannelloni, uncooked, or you can cook it first and then freeze. Step 14: Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbling. Step 15: Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, garlic, olive oil, linguine pasta, sage, parmesan, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas Put the squash and garlic on a baking tray and drizzle with the olive oil. Step 2: Roast for 25-30 minutes until soft, season. Step 3: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Step 4: Drain, reserving the water. Step 5: Use a stick blender to whizz the squash with cooking water. Step 6: Heat some oil in a frying pan, fry the sage until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper. Step 7: Tip the pasta and sauce into the pan and warm through. Step 8: Scatter with sage.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, leeks, celery, zucchini then, garlic, vegetable stock, asparagus woody ends, peas, broad bean double-podded if you have time, basil most, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the leeks and celery, and cook for 8 mins until soft. Add the courgettes and garlic. Cook gently for 5 mins more. Step 2: Pour in the stock and simmer, covered, for 10 mins. Add the asparagus, peas and broad beans, and cook for a further 4 mins, until just cooked through. Stir in the chopped basil and season well. Scatter with basil leaves and serve with crusty bread.

Ingredient Names: onions, celery, carrots, garlic, tomato puree balsamic vinegar, vegetables, red lentil, tomatoes basil, tagliatelle, shaved parmesan
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the onion, celery and carrots into a large non-stick saucepan and add 2-3 tbsp water or stock, if you have some. Cook gently, stirring often, until the vegetables are soft. Step 2: Add the garlic, tomato purée and balsamic vinegar, cook on a high heat for 1 min more, add the diced veg, lentils, tomatoes, then bring up to the boil. Step 3: Turn to a simmer, then cook for about 20 mins. Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions, then drain. Season the ragu and serve with pasta and Parmesan on top, if you like.

Ingredient Names: green or red lentils, carrots, onion, zucchini, coriander, spinach, lasagne sheets, vegan butter, flour, soya milk, mustard, vinegar, salt, pepper, stock cube
Instructions: Step 1: 1) Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Step 2: 2) Boil vegetables for 10 minutes, until soft. Step 3: Add lentils and bring to a gentle simmer, adding a stock cube if desired. Step 4: Continue cooking and stirring until the lentils are soft, which should take about 5 minutes. Step 5: 3) Blanch spinach leaves for a few minutes in a pan, before removing and setting aside. Step 6: 4) Top up the pan with water and cook the lasagne sheets. Step 7: When cooked, drain and set aside. Step 8: 5) To make the sauce, melt the butter and add the flour, then gradually add the soya milk along with the mustard and the vinegar. Step 9: Cook and stir until smooth and then assemble the lasagne as desired in a baking dish. Step 10: 6) Bake in the preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, red onions, mushrooms, fresh broccoli, eggs, milk, mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees F In a 9 inch oven proof skillet, warm oil on med, heat. Step 2: Add garlic and onion; saute' for 1 minute. Step 3: Add vegetables; saute' for 5 minutes. Step 4: Beat eggs with milk, add 1/2 cup cheese, salt, and pepper. Step 5: Add egg mixture to skillet with vegetable mixture. Step 6: ***Place in oven on upper rack. Step 7: Bake until golden brown, approximately 30 minutes. Step 8: Remove from oven and sprinkle on remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Step 9: Slice into wedges and serve. Step 10: ***you may also use a 9-inch baking dish if you do not have an oven proof skillet.

Ingredient Names: parsnip, red onions, red peppers, butternut squash, olives, basil pesto, salad spinach leaves, pine nuts, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 230C/fan 210C/gas 8. Rub the sliced veg with the oil, garlic, salt and black pepper, then place in a roasting tin in an even layer. Roast for 30 mins until golden and soft. Step 2: Allow to cool slightly, then tip into a large bowl. Mix with the basil pesto, spinach leaves and toasted pine nuts, then serve.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, olive oil, marinara sauce, red wine, garlic, fresh basil leaves, oregano, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute zucchini in 3 Tablespoons olive oil until lightly browned; drain. Step 2: Place in 1-1/2 quart casserole. Step 3: Combine marinara sauce, wine, remaining oil, garlic, basil and oregano in small saucepan; stir well. Step 4: Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Spoon sauce over zucchini; mix well. Step 6: Sprinkle cheese over sauce; cover. Step 7: Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes. Step 8: Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, butter, lemon pepper, garlic, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Must have large frying pan. Step 2: Slice zucchini 1/4 slices. Step 3: Melt butter in pan according to taste. Step 4: Add zucchini and cover each slice with lemon pepper, garlic& parmesan. Step 5: Flip over and let cook until browned approximately 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Repeat on other side. Step 7: Small tip- wipe out frying pan between batches, to avoid to much blackening.

Ingredient Names: chili with beans, instant rice, water, cheese, salsa, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat chili in saucepan. Step 2: Once heated, add uncooked rice and water. Step 3: Stir together and let simmer over medium heat about 10-15 minutes until rice is cooked Don't forget to stir! Step 4: Once cooked throughout, turn heat down. Step 5: Place about 1 / 3 cup mixture on tortilla and top with 1-2 tablespoons shredded cheese and a few tablespoons salsa and roll up. Step 6: Once all burritos have been made, zap in microwave for 30-60 seconds to melt cheese and reheat.

Ingredient Names: hamburger, yellow onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, black pepper, salt, cumin, cayenne pepper, pinto beans, crushed tomatoes, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef with onion and garlic in 5-quart dutch oven or large skillet over med high heat for 5 to 6 minutes. Step 2: Add seasonings, and stir to combine, heat 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in pinto beans, broth and tomatoes. Step 4: Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes uncovered. Step 5: Garnish with onion and cheddar cheese.

Ingredient Names: stewing beef, stewing pork, white onion, bell peppers, habanero pepper, garlic, beans, chunky salsa, tomato paste, beef broth, tortilla chips, chicken bouillon cube, beef bouillon cube, sazon goya, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a 7-quart crockpot It might be easier to combine in a larger vessel, mix, and then transfer to your crockpot. Step 2: Cook on "high" for 5 hours, or "low" for 8 hours I typically serve the chili over a bed of whole tostito chips, with a layer of shredded cheese in between.

Ingredient Names: corn tortilla, chili beans, cheddar cheese, ground beef, taco seasoning, water, yellow onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Brown the meat and onion in a skillet. Step 2: Add the taco seasoning and water, and let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 3: In a baking dish, put one layer of tortillas, then 1 / 3 meat mixture on top, followed by layer of beans and layer of cheese. Step 4: Repeat two more times, ending with cheese. Step 5: Bake for 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted and beginning to brown.

Dish Name: Adobo Beef Tacos With Pickled Red Onions
Ingredient Names: steaks, corn tortillas, queso fresco, fresh cilantro, red onion, white wine vinegar, salt, honey, smoked paprika, adobo seasoning, ground chipotle chile pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pickled red onions ingredients in medium bowl, stir well. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate while preparing beef. Step 3: Combine seasoning ingredients in small bowl. Step 4: Press evenly onto beef steaks. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes to 2 hours. Step 6: Place steaks on grid over medium, ash-covered coals. Step 7: Grill, covered, 10 to 14 minutes for medium rare to medium doneness, turning once, remove from grill. Step 8: Let stand 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef brisket, beef bouillon cube, lean pork, budweiser beer, onion, water, wesson oil, chili powder, cayenne, garlic cloves, cumin, green chilies, dry mustard, tomato sauce, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a large kettle or dutch oven, brown the beef, pork and onions in hot wesson oil. Step 2: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients, stir well. Step 4: Cover and simmer 3 to 4 hours, until meat is tender and chili is thick and bubbly. Step 5: Stir occasionally.

Ingredient Names: bacon, beef, onions, green bell peppers, salt, pepper, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: On a hot skillet, fry bacon & remove excess fat. Step 2: Add beef fajitas and cook until medium rare. Step 3: Add onions, peppers, salt & pepper Finish cooking and serve on tortillas, spice up with hot salsa.

Ingredient Names: beef tamales, onion, corn, tomato sauce, chili powder, cheddar cheese, olive
Instructions: Step 1: Slice tamales in half crosswise and arrange in bottom of greased crock-pot. Step 2: Sprinkle chopped onion over tamales, add corn. Step 3: Mix tomato sauce and chili powder. Step 4: Pour into crock-pot. Step 5: Top with shredded cheese and sprinkle with sliced ripe olives. Step 6: Cover and cook on low setting for 5 to 7 hours or on high setting for 2 hours Double recipe for 5-quart crock-pot.

Ingredient Names: short-grain white rice, water, vegetable oil, white onions, ground pork, ground beef, egg, ground cumin, dried oregano, salt, fresh ground pepper, garlic clove, zucchini, carrots, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place the rice in a heatproof bowl. Step 2: Bring the water to a boil and pour it over the rice. Step 3: Let soak for 40 minutes, then drain, set aside. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a saut pan over medium heat, warm 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil. Step 5: Add 1 of the diced onions and saut until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Remove from the heat and let cool. Step 7: In a bowl, combine the pork, beef, cooled onion, soaked rice, egg, cumin, oregano, 3 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the pepper. Step 8: Using your hands, mix well and form into 1-inch balls. Step 9: In a large soup pot over medium heat, warm the remaining 2 tablespoons vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic clove, olive oil, tomatoes, chili powder, beans
Instructions: Step 1: Add a tablespoon or so of oil to a skillet Brown the ground beef, onions if used, and garlic in the skillet, breaking up the ground beef as it browns. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and cook over mediuim low heat for 20 minutes This chili is delicious if topped with cheese or sour cream and served with crackers.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, russet potatoes, carrots, mexican blend cheese, burrito-size flour tortillas, enchilada sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil diced carrots and potatoes in water until tender, drain. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix together ground beef, potatoes, carrots and 2 cups of cheese Salt to taste. Step 3: Place the tortillas in between two damp paper towels. Step 4: Place in the microwave for 15-30 seconds until soft With a large serving spoon, place one heaping spoonful of meat / veggie / cheese mixture in the center of each tortilla. Step 5: Roll each tortilla up tightly and place in a 9 x 13 casserole dish This will be a tight fit, but squeeze them together so they all fit. Step 6: Pour both cans of enchilada sauce over the enchiladas, making certain each tortilla is covered in sauce.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, chopped tomato, sliced ripe olives, chili powder, salt, pepper, cornmeal, flour, baking powder, hot water, butter, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat, drain. Step 2: Add onion, tomato, olives and seasonings. Step 3: Cook until onion is tender. Step 4: Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and baking powder. Step 5: Add water and butter or margarine, mix until smooth. Step 6: Stir in 1 cup cheese and olives. Step 7: Pour cornmeal mixture into greased 9-inch pie plate. Step 8: Spoon meat mixture into center of cornmeal mixture and press down gently.

Ingredient Names: oranges, lemons, limes, canola oil, soy sauce, beer, garlic cloves, black pepper, skirt steaks
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all marinade ingredients well. Step 2: Pour over meat and marinate at least 1 hour, but no more than 2 hours. Step 3: Cook over hot coals for 5- 6 minutes, or to taste. Step 4: Remove and let sit 5-10 minutes before slicing across the grain. Step 5: Serve with warm tortillas, pico de gallo, guacamole, and grilled onions To freeze: place marinade ingredients in a large freezer bag. Step 6: Add meat of choice, seal, label and freeze To serve: thaw in fridge and grill as instructed in recipe.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, garlic, olive oil, tequila, fresh lime juice, coarse salt, ground cumin, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together garlic, olive oil, tequila, lime juice, salt, cumin and black pepper. Step 2: Place flank steak in zip lock bag and pour in marinade. Step 3: Chill at least 1 hour Turning often.

Ingredient Names: skirt steaks, onion, garlic cloves, adobo seasoning, cumin, pico de gallo, beer
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the skirt steak until it's flat or instead, ask the butcher to run it through the machine that flattens it out Doing this works best. Step 2: Season meat with adobo, cumin, and pico de gallo I use the adobo that has cumin already in it and it works great Rub seasoning into the meat. Step 3: Layer meat, onions, and garlic in a deep pan or bowl and cover with beer by placing portion of meat on the bottom, top with onions, chopped garlic, then repeat until all meat is used. Step 4: Fill with beer of choice until everything is covered. Step 5: Let sit for several hours or overnight. Step 6: Cook meat on grill. Step 7: Serve with heated corn tortillas and what ever taco toppings you prefer.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, flour, salsa, green chilies, onion, garlic clove, sugar, ground cumin, basil, oregano, salt and pepper, corn tortillas, chicken, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Grease 9x13 baking pan, set aside In saucepan, blend chicken broth and flour. Step 3: Cook, stirring, until broth thickens. Step 4: Add salsa, chilies, onion, garlic, sugar and seasonings, mix well Soften tortillas by dipping them into the hot mixture. Step 5: Place a spoonful of chicken and a slice of cheese in each tortilla. Step 6: Roll and place in the greased 9x13 baking pan. Step 7: Repeat with remaing tortillas. Step 8: Add sour cream to hot mixture, mix well.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, salsa, plain breadcrumbs, monterey jack pepper cheese, hamburger buns, tomatoes, avocados, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In medium mixing bowl, combine ground beef, salsa and bread crumbs. Step 2: Mix well and shape into 12 hamburger patties No bigger than 4 inches in diameter and 1 / 4 inch thick On 6 patties, sprinkle cheese on top of each patty. Step 3: Place the remaining patties on top of the cheese covered patties to form a hamburger Seal ends together by pressing the ends shut, place on grill. Step 4: Grill each side for 11 to 15 minutes or until your liking. Step 5: Place cooked hamburger on bun topped with tomato, avocado, salsa and 1 tablespoon sour cream. Step 6: When doubling recipe, i found i needed to add more bread crumbs so the meat was the right consistency for a hamburger.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, white vinegar, soy sauce, garlic cloves, garlic powder, chili powder, dried oregano, ground cumin, paprika, lime, olive oil, salt, white pepper, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together ingredients and pour over steak Marinade, covered for 1 to 8 hours. Step 2: Cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Serve with flour or corn tortillas and choice of salsa.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, masa harina flour, lard, salt, red chili sauce, corn husk
Instructions: Step 1: To make tamales, cook meat by boiling in a large covered pot with enough water to cover completely. Step 2: Add salt to taste and slow boil till completely done. Step 3: Cool meat and save broth. Step 4: When meat has cooled, shred and mix in the chili sauce Clean oujas in warm water. Step 5: Mix the masa, lard, salt and enough broth to make a smooth paste. Step 6: Beat till a small amount will float in a cup of cool water. Step 7: Spread masa on ouja, add a small amount of meat and roll up. Step 8: Fold up ends of ouja and place on a rack in a pan deep enough to steam. Step 9: Add 1 to 2 inches water, cover with a tight fitting lid and steam about 1 1 / 2 hours.

Dish Name: Authentic Sopa De Albondigas Meatball Soup
Ingredient Names: ground beef, of fresh mint, cilantro, white onion, salt, black pepper, eggs, ancho chilies, guajillo chilies, roma tomato, garlic cloves, oil, water, cumin, chicken bouillon cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the meatball ingredients together in a bowl until combined. Step 2: Shape the meatballs into walnut sized balls. Step 3: Place the meatballs on a clean plate, cover with plastic and refrigerate until you are ready to cook them. Step 4: Place the dry chilies, garlic cloves and tomato into a small sauce pan. Step 5: Fill with water until the chilies are completely covered. Step 6: Boil the chilies and tomato on medium high heat for 15 minutes. Step 7: Cover and set aside. Step 8: In a large stock pot, heat the oil. Step 9: Saute the onions for 2 minutes. Step 10: Add in the carrots and stir.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, american cheese, pico de gallo, cheese, vegetable oil, all-purpose flour, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic powder, salt, pepper, water, ground beef, bay leaf, pinto beans
Instructions: Step 1: Make enchilada gravy sauce. Step 2: Heat oil in large stockpot. Step 3: Add flour and cook until browned, stirring constantly, you are making a roux, do not let it burn. Step 4: Stir in chili powder, cumin, garlic, salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook roux, stirring constantly, for at least 2-3 minutes If you do not thoroughly cook the roux it will taste like flour mixed with oil Gradually add the water, stirring until smooth. Step 6: Boil gently for 15 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile make the chili con carne Brown the ground beef in a large skillet.

Ingredient Names: water, long-grain white rice, refried beans, salt, garlic powder, olive oil, onions, beef steaks, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, bring water to a boil. Step 3: Stir in rice, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Place refried beans in a medium saucepan over medium heat, and season with salt and garlic powder. Step 5: Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Step 6: Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat Saut onions until browned and tender On the preheated grill, cook steaks 7 to 10 minutes, to an internal temperature of 145f. Step 7: Spread steaks with refried beans, and top with onions and avocado slices, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, bell pepper, garlic cloves, serrano peppers, taco seasoning mix, cream cheese, enchilada sauce, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef, onions, peppers and garlic in large skillet over medium-high heat until browned and veggies are soft. Step 2: Add taco seasoning and 1 / 2 cup of enchilada sauce, stirring until combined. Step 3: Turn off heat and add cream cheese. Step 4: Stir until cream cheese has melted into mixture. Step 5: Spread 1 / 2 cup of enchilada sauce into the bottom of a greased 13x9 casserole dish. Step 6: Spoon about 1 / 4 cup of meat mixture down the center of each warmed tortilla and roll up. Step 7: Place enchiladas seam side down in dish. Step 8: Top enchiladas with remaining 1 cup of enchilada sauce. Step 9: Then top with monterey jack cheese. Step 10: Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees or until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, yellow onion, garlic salt, salsa, refried beans, jiffy cornbread mix, egg, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Prepare cornbread mix according to package. Step 3: In a medium large skillet over medium high heat, saute onions until translucent. Step 4: Add beef, and saute until browned. Step 5: Stir salsa and beans into beef, and cook over medium to medium high heat until bubbling and starting to thicken. Step 6: Stir as necessary while it cooks. Step 7: Pour beef mixture into 9x9 casserole. Step 8: Pour cornbread mixture over beef. Step 9: Bake in 350f oven uncovered for 30-35 minutes, or until cornbread is cooked and starting to brown.

Ingredient Names: light cream cheese, light sour cream, light mayonnaise, lean ground beef, low-sodium taco seasoning, tomato sauce, salsa, tabasco sauce, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, black olives, jalapeno, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first three ingredients well, spread in layer on a round serving plate and chill in fridge for at least 30 minutes. Step 2: Fry ground beef and drain, on low heat add taco seasoning, tomato sauce, salsa and tabasco till well mixed then cool. Step 3: Spread cooled meat mixture over cream cheese mixture to cover. Step 4: Sprinkle the lettuce, tomato, black olives and jalapenos evenly over the meat layer, to cover. Step 5: Top it all off with the cheese and serve with tortila or nacho chips I usually make this at night for the next day Be prepared, it goes fast!

Ingredient Names: ground beef, bacon, green onions, chili powder, salt, pepper, liquid smoke, ketchup, mustard, taco shells, sharp cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, cook the diced bacon until lightly crisp. Step 2: Pour off all but about a half tablespoon of bacon grease. Step 3: Add ground beef and green onions and cook together until beef is thoroughly cooked through, then stir in chili powder, salt, pepper and liquid smoke and cook together another 10 minutes. Step 4: Combine the"taco sauce" ingredients in a small bowl Assemble tacos: fill taco shells with bacon-ground beef, then a drizzle of the taco sauce then shredded sharp cheddar cheese. Step 5: Heat in an oven or microwave until cheese is melted, then add lettuce, tomato and onion Yum!

Dish Name: Bacon Jalapeno Burgers With Chipotle Mayonnaise
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, chipotle pepper, adobo sauce, ground beef, salt and pepper, garlic powder, red onion rings, colby-monterey jack cheese, cooked bacon, pickled jalapeno peppers, hamburger buns, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: For the chipotle mayonnaise: Mix together ingredients until combined For the burgers: Divide the ground beef into four 1 / 3 pound burgers With a light hand, shape into patties. Step 2: Season both sides with a salt, pepper and garlic powder. Step 3: Set aside until ready to grill May, also, be pan fried. Step 4: Heat grill to medium - medium-high heat and grill for a 4-7 minutes on each side until desired doneness During the last minute of cooking, add a slice of cheese over each burger and close cover until cheese begins to melt.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, butter, lean ground beef, distilled white vinegar, diced green chilies, garlic cloves, dried oregano, ground cumin, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, lettuce, chopped tomato, cheese, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap tortillas in foil and warm in a 300 oven while making the filling Brown ground beef and drain. Step 2: Mix in vinegar and seasonings to the drained meat, but do not cook the mixture further. Step 3: Remove tortillas from oven and increase oven temperature to 500. Step 4: Brush each side of tortilla with melted butter. Step 5: Spoon about 1 / 4 cup ground beef filling onto center of each buttered tortilla. Step 6: Fold in sides, then roll up tortilla from the bottom. Step 7: Place seam-side down on a foil-lined and rimmed baking sheet. Step 8: Bake at 500 for 8-10 minutes, until golden brown. Step 9: Serve on a large bed of shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes.

Dish Name: Baked Mexican Dip For A Crowd
Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, taco seasoning mix, water, refried beans, sour cream, hot salsa, cheddar cheese, tomatoes, black olives, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and onion together. Step 2: Add taco seasoning and water. Step 3: Simmer a few minutes. Step 4: Spread refried beans in the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan. Step 5: Top beans with the meat and onion mixture Dollop sour cream over the beef. Step 6: Pour salsa over the sour cream. Step 7: Top with shredded cheddar cheese, then tomato and lastly the sliced black olives. Step 8: Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Step 9: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: steak, cumin seeds, cinnamon sticks, beef bouillon cube, onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, ground cayenne pepper, salsa, green chilies, colby-monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Put the steak, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, and bullion in a saucepan and cover with water. Step 2: Bring to a boil and allow to simmer until the meat shreds easily with a fork. Step 3: Remove meat from liquid, shred and put aside. Step 4: Strain liquid and set aside Spray a large skillet with non-stick spray and add onions and garlic. Step 5: Cook until the onions are translucent. Step 6: Add chili powder, cumin, cinnamon, and cayenne and mix in well. Step 7: Add salsa, chilies, and shredded meat and combine Measure 1 / 2 cup of the meat cooking liquid and add to the mixture-- allow to simmer until the liquid is almost all absorbed Spray a 13x9-inch glass baking dish with non-stick spray--give it a fairly heavy coating of spray.

Ingredient Names: butter, taco seasoning mix, sirloin tip steaks, refried beans, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, green onions, enchilada sauce, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400f in 10-inch skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in taco seasoning mix, add beef strips. Step 3: Cook 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until desired doneness, drain. Step 4: Meanwhile, place refried beans in microwavable dish Microwave uncovered on high 2 minutes, stirring once or twice. Step 5: Spread each tortilla with refried beans to within 1 / 4 inch of edge. Step 6: Top each with beef, cheddar cheese and onions. Step 7: Roll up, folding in sides.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, kidney bean, ground beef, taco seasoning, onion, green chili pepper, cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, salsa, chopped tomato, lettuce, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in pan with onion, peppers, and kidney beans. Step 2: Add taco seasoning and follow instructions to make taco filling. Step 3: In a separate bowl mix soup, sour cream and salsa together. Step 4: Spread 1 / 2 cup of soup mixture in a 13x9 baking dish To make tacos spread a small amount of the soup mixture on tortilla, fill with meat mixture and top with cheese, roll and place seam side down baking dish top with remaining soup mixture and cheese, cover with foil. Step 5: Bake in 375 degree oven for 15-20 minutes. Step 6: Serve with additional salsa, sour cream, tomatos and shredded lettuce.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, refried beans, flour tortillas, taco seasoning, water, mexican blend cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Brown ground beef until fully cooked, drain. Step 2: Heat refried beans 2. Step 3: Add the seasonings and water, bring to a boil, then simmer 6-10 minutes, until most of the liquid has evaporated 3. Step 4: Preheat oven To 350 f 4 Assembly time.

Ingredient Names: chili beans, yellow onion, garlic, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, water, ground beef, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place yellow onion, garlic, and ground beef in a frying pan on medium heat Break up hamburger into fine pieces with a spatula and cook until hamburger is brown. Step 2: Drain off excess fat. Step 3: Add chili powder, worcestershire sauce, bush's magic chili starter, water and garlic salt. Step 4: Simmer uncovered for about 20 minutes or until thickened to desired consistency. Step 5: Then use as you would like, or can be frozen to use later.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, tomato juice, whole kernel corn, kidney beans, tomato sauce, taco seasoning mix
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot over medium high heat, combine the ground beef and the onions. Step 2: Saute for about 5 minutes or until onions are tender. Step 3: Add the tomato juice, corn, beans, tomato sauce and taco seasoning, stir well. Step 4: Heat throughout, but do not boil.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, refried beans, salt, garlic powder, taco sauce, pitted ripe olives, corn tortillas, salad oil, enchilada sauce, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a wide frying pan over medium-high heat, crumble ground beef. Step 2: Add onion and cook until beef is browned and onion is soft. Step 3: Stir in beans, salt, garlic powder, taco sauce, and olives. Step 4: Heat until bubbly, then set aside. Step 5: Heat about 1 / 8-inch of oil in a small frying pan over medium heat. Step 6: Dip each tortilla into oil for just a few seconds, until it begins to blister and become limp Do not fry until firm or crisp. Step 7: Remove with tongs, drain briefly, and stack, set aside. Step 8: Pour 1 can of the enchilada sauce into a shallow 3-quart casserole or 9 by 13-inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, jalapeno pepper, refried beans, tomato sauce, cumin, flour tortillas, enchilada sauce, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook ground been, onion and jalepeno, drain. Step 2: Add refried beans, tomato sauce and cumin. Step 3: Simmer for 15 minutes Microwave tortillas for 15 seconds to soften. Step 4: Pour 1 / 2 cup enchilada sauce in the bottom of a 9x9 pan. Step 5: Add filling to tortillas, roll up, place in pan seam side down and cover with remaining sauce Freeze To use: thaw overnight, sprinkle with cheese and bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes.

Dish Name: Beef And Chili Stew With Cornbread Dumplings
Ingredient Names: poblano chile, skirt steaks, onions, garlic, tomato paste, beef broth, dried oregano, frozen corn, cornstarch, yellow cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Place chilies in a 10-by-15-inch pan Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat, turning as needed until blackened on all sides, about 15 minutes. Step 2: Then i put them in a plastic bag for about 10 minutes Peel and discard peels, stems, seeds, and viens. Step 3: Cut chilies into about 1 / 2 inch pieces. Step 4: Meanwhile, rinse meat and pat dry, cut into 1 / 2-by 1-inch pieces. Step 5: In a 5 to 6 quart pan over high heat, stir meat, onions, garlic, tomato paste and 1 / 2 cup broth until liquid evaporates and meat and onions are browned, about 25 minutes. Step 6: Add chilies, remaining broth, 2 cups water and oregano, bring to a boil. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until meat is very tender when pierced with a fork.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, celery, garlic, onions, vegetable oil, mild green chilies, tomato sauce, celery salt, cumin, chili powder, pepper, white hominy, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the meat, celery, garlic, and onions in oil until onions are slightly soft. Step 2: Add the chiles, tomato sauce, celery salt, cumin, chili powder, and pepper, and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add drained hominy to the meat mixture and cook until hominy absorbs the color of the sauce. Step 4: Place in serving bowl and top with grated cheddar Makes 6 to 8 servings.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, onion, buckwheat groats, diced tomatoes, green chilies, low-sodium taco seasoning, frozen whole kernel corn, water, reduced-fat cheddar cheese, fresh cilantro, ripe olives
Instructions: Step 1: In a 12" skillet, cook ground beef and onion over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until beef is thoroughly cooked, drain. Step 2: Stir in buckwheat kernels until moistened by beef mixture. Step 3: Stir in tomatoes, chiles, taco seasoning mix, corn and water, heat to boiling, cover. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Simmer 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until buckwheat is tender. Step 6: Sprinkle cheese over buckwheat mixture. Step 7: Cover and cook 2-3 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: beef sirloin steak, olive oil, lime juice, fajita seasoning mix, fresh oregano, red onion, flour tortillas, mangoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place steak in a ziploc bag. Step 2: Stir together oil, lime juice, fajita seasoning and oregano, reserving 2 tablespoons. Step 3: Pour remaining mixture into bag with meat. Step 4: Refrigerate for 4-24 hours, turning bag occasionally. Step 5: Preheat grill to medium. Step 6: Place onions on an 18-inch square of aluminum foil. Step 7: Drizzle with reserved lime mixture. Step 8: Bring up two opposite sides of the foil and seal with a double fold. Step 9: Fold remaining ends to completely enclose, leaving space for steam to expand. Step 10: Wrap tortillas tightly in aluminum foil.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, taco seasoning mix, water, tomato sauce, green chilies, red kidney beans, o'brien frozen potatoes, nacho cheese soup, milk, green pepper, sugar, worcestershire sauce, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Brown beef and 1 / 2 cup onion in skillet, drain fat. Step 2: Stir in taco seasoning, water and tomato sauce. Step 3: Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Step 4: Spread meat mixture into a greased 9 x 13 pan. Step 5: Top with chilies, kidney beans and potatoes In mixing bowl, combine soup, milk, remaining onion, pepper, sugar and worcestershire sauce. Step 6: Pour over potatoes. Step 7: Sprinkle with paprika. Step 8: Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: potato, oil, onion, garlic cloves, dried oregano, ground beef, kosher salt, pepper, fajita-size flour tortillas, lettuce, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and very finely dice the potatoes Russet potatoes can be used but are not recommended because they fall apart too easily. Step 2: Put the diced potatoes in cold tap water to keep them from browning while you prepare the other ingredients. Step 3: Add 1 tbsp of oil to a large skillet over medium heat. Step 4: When the oil is hot, add the onions and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook one minute longer. Step 6: Add the ground beef and break up the meat into small chunks. Step 7: Add 1 tsp kosher salt and tsp of black pepper Brown the ground beef then drain. Step 8: Using a potato masher, smash the ground beef into a very fine crumb.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chili powder, ground cumin, frozen chopped spinach, chunky salsa, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, brown ground beef over medium heat 8-10 minutes or until no longer pink, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Pour off drippings. Step 3: Season beef with chili powder, cumin, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper. Step 4: Stir in spinach and salsa, heat through, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in cheese To serve, spoon approx 1 / 2 cup beef mixture in center of each tortilla. Step 6: Fold bottom edge up over filling. Step 7: Fold sides to center overlapping edges.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, enchilada sauce, tomato sauce, refried beans, evaporated milk, tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Heat medium skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add beef and onion. Step 4: Cook until beef is brown and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Drain the grease off the beef. Step 6: Add enchilada and tomato sauces to skillet, stir well. Step 7: Cook until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Step 8: Spoon beef mixture into a greased 2-quart baking dish. Step 9: Combine beans and evaporated milk in a small bowl.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, dried onion flakes, granulated garlic, cumin powder, red pepper flakes, white pepper, salt, fresh ground black pepper, taco seasoning, refried beans, chili beans, water, tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in olive oil. Step 2: Add the onions, garlic, cumin, white pepper, red pepper flakes, black pepper, and salt. Step 3: Add chipotle powder if used. Step 4: When the beef has browned, add thee taco seasoning and water and stir in well. Step 5: Now add the refried beans and chili beans and mix in well Do not drain the chili beans. Step 6: Simmer for 10 minutes to allow the beans to heat and the flavors to blend Soften tortillas with steam, hot oil, or warm water Coat 8 large ramekins or a muffin pan with large cups with cooking spray. Step 7: Shape the tortillas into cups in the ramekins or muffin pan.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, black beans, taco seasoning, diced tomatoes, taco shells, cheese, corn
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f Brown the ground beef with the chopped onion. Step 2: Once browned, drain well. Step 3: Stir in the black beans, taco seasoning, diced tomatoes and let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 4: Line up 8 taco shells in a 7x11-inch baking dish. Step 5: Spoon meat mixture into the taco shells. Step 6: Top with a pinchfuls of cheese. Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Step 8: Serve beef & bean oven tacos with side of veggies.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, salsa, neufchatel cheese, salt, pepper, cumin, cilantro, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and drain off any excess fat. Step 2: Season with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 tsp black pepper and 1 teaspoons of ground cumin. Step 3: Add 1 1 / 2 cups chuncky salsa I prefer pace medium. Step 4: Stir together and add 4 oz neufchatel cream cheese. Step 5: Stir until melted in and reduce over low heat until thick and creamy. Step 6: Place about 1 / 3 cup burrito mixture onto a warmed flour tortilla. Step 7: Top with fresh chopped cilantro. Step 8: Fold in bottom then sides, rolling into a tight pouch Leaving an opening at the top.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, ground beef, onion, red chili sauce, salt and black pepper, vegetable oil, cheddar cheese, iceberg lettuce, green onions, chopped tomato, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Wrap stacked tortillas in aluminum foil, and heat in oven 15 minutes or until hot To microwave, wrap a stack of tortillas lightly in paper towels and warm on high for 6 or 7 seconds per tortilla. Step 3: In a large frying pan over medium-high heat, brown beef. Step 4: Drain, leaving beef in the pan. Step 5: Add onion, chile or enchilada sauce, salt, and pepper. Step 6: Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until onions are transparent In the center of each warm tortilla, spoon 1 / 6 of meat filling. Step 7: Fold tortilla, tucking in the ends to make a secure fat tube, and fasten with wooden toothpicks. Step 8: In a large pot or deep fryer over medium heat, add at least 4 inches of vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: chili sauce, all-purpose flour, low-sodium tomato puree, mild chili powder, lean ground beef, dried onion flakes, tortillas, sharp cheddar cheese, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: To make the enchilada sauce, in a medium saucepan, stir the flour and cup of the chili sauce together until flour is dissolved Gradually stir in remaining chili sauce, tomato puree and chili powder. Step 2: Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, and then cook, stirring constantly, for about 2 minutes, until slightly thickened. Step 3: Remove from heat and let cool. Step 4: Meanwhile, place large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and add the beef. Step 5: Cook, stirring to break up meat, for about 4-5 minutes, until beef is no longer pink, and then stir in the onion flakes, remove from heat, set aside. Step 6: Preheat oven to 375f degrees Spray a 13 x 9" casserole with nonstick cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: carrots, celery, onions, garlic powder, salt and pepper, corn oil, beef broth, diced tomatoes, rotel diced tomatoes, taco seasoning, corn tortillas, beef brisket, milk, corn tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Saute carrots, onions, celery in corn oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper until tender. Step 2: Add beef broth and bring to boil. Step 3: Add tomatoes, rotel, taco seasoning, and shredded beef. Step 4: Cut tortillas into small pieces and add to broth mixture. Step 5: Let boil for 20 minutes or until tortillas are thoroughly incorporated into soup, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for additional 10 minutes. Step 7: Add milk and simmer for additional 10 minutes If thicker soup is desired, add more diced tortillas and let incorporate into soup. Step 8: Garnish with shredded cheese and broken tortilla chips Substitutions: 1 cup masa harina for 1 12 ct package of yellow corn tortillas.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, cottage cheese, ripe olives, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper, flour tortillas, onion, green pepper, oil, tomato sauce, green chilies, chili powder, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, drain. Step 2: Add next 6 ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Put 1 / 3 cup filling down middle of each tortilla. Step 4: Wrap, place seam side down in 13x9 baking pan For sauce: heat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 5: Saute onion and green pepper in hot oil until tender. Step 6: Add next 4 ingredients, mix well. Step 7: Pour over tortillas. Step 8: Cover and bake 30 minutes. Step 9: Sprinkle with cheese and bake 7 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, velveeta mexican cheese, thick & chunky salsa, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in a large skillet, drain. Step 2: Add half of the velveeta and 1 / 2 cup of the salsa. Step 3: Cook until the velveeta is completely melted, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Spoon slightly less than 1 / 4 cup of the meat mixture down the center of each tortilla, roll up. Step 5: Place tortillas seam side down in a microwavable baking dish. Step 6: Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup of salsa and the rest of the velveeta. Step 7: Cover Microwave on high for 4 to 6 minutes or until the velveeta is melted.

Ingredient Names: rump steak, ancho chilies, pasilla chiles, hot water, garlic cloves, dried oregano, ground cumin, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, onion, flat leaf parsley, sour cream, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put the steak in a deep frying pan and cover with water. Step 2: Bring to boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours, or until very tender. Step 3: Meanwhile, put the dried chillies in a bowl and pour over the hot water. Step 4: Leave to soak for 30 minutes, then. Step 5: Drain the steak and let it cool, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Step 6: Meanwhile, fry the garlic, oregano and cumin in the oil for 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the chili paste and the reserved cooking liquid from the beef Tear one of the tortillas into small pieces and add it to the mixture. Step 8: Bring to the boil, then lower the heat. Step 9: Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened.

Ingredient Names: skirt steaks, cherry tomatoes, cooked rice, cumin, lime juice, garlic clove, pepper, lettuce, onion powder, picante sauce, salt, cheddar cheese, green onion, sliced ripe olives, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lime juice, oil, garlic, onion powder, cumin, salt and pepper in a shallow baking dish. Step 2: Add beef, cover, and marinate in refrigerator, for at least 4 hours. Step 3: Remove beef and cook as desired for 10 to 12 minutes. Step 4: Slice meat diagonally into bite-size pieces. Step 5: Combine rice, tomatoes, cheese, olives and onions in a large bowl. Step 6: Arrange mixture over shredded lettuce, place beef on top. Step 7: Serve with picante sauce and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: beef, safflower oil, onion, garlic cloves, fajita seasoning mix, chili powder, cumin powder, diced tomatoes, black beans, pinto beans, broth, red bell peppers, jalapeno peppers, spinach, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onions until light brown, add garlic. Step 2: Add beef and spices Brown beef. Step 3: Add tomatoes and cook till juice is gone, add broth. Step 4: Cook till beef is almost cooked. Step 5: Add all other ingredients except cilantro. Step 6: Cook for 15 more minutes or until all vegetables are ready, add cilantro.

Ingredient Names: beef broth, olive oil, worcestershire sauce, lime zest, ground cumin, dried oregano, salt, pepper, fresh cilantro, garlic cloves, roast beef, red bell peppers, green bell peppers, onion, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 10 ingredients and add meat, marinate 1 hour. Step 2: Heat pan on medium heat, add marinade, meat & veggies. Step 3: Saute until meat is cooked & veggies are soft. Step 4: Wrap in tortilla & serve with garnish.

Dish Name: Beef Fajitas With Pico De Gallo
Ingredient Names: avocado, tomatoes, jalapeno pepper, red onion, fresh cilantro, light teriyaki sauce, lime juice, skirt steaks, light soy sauce, flour tortilla, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Make pico de gallo: place avocado thru pepper in a bowl. Step 2: Stir in onion thru lime juice. Step 3: Let stand, covered, 2 hours. Step 4: Combine soy sauce & lime juice Use to marinate meat 15 minutes, turning pieces over once Broil or grill meat about 4 inches from heat source 3 minutes or to desired doneness Warm tortillas in 325 oven To assemble, top each tortilla w / meat, pico de gallo and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: sirloin, onion, garlic cloves, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place sliced beef strips in medium saucepan. Step 2: Cut the onion and garlic in quarters. Step 3: Add to the beef in the saucepan. Step 4: Add salt and the water. Step 5: Bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 6: Simmer, uncovered, slowly for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours until the beef is very tender. Step 7: Serve beef with warm soft tortillas and aztec guacamole.

Dish Name: Beef In A Red Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: canola oil, beef, chili powder, kosher salt, ground pepper, onion, anaheim chilies, garlic cloves, tomatoes, flour, beef broth, red chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cube beef then dust with 2 teaspoons chili powder, salt and pepper and set aside. Step 2: Chop all veggies, keep tomatoes separate and set aside. Step 3: Heat a good heavy pot over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, add oil. Step 4: Add the beef in 3 batches and brown on all sides. Step 5: Add all the veggies but the tomatoes. Step 6: Add the last teaspoon of chili powder and stir. Step 7: Add cup beef broth and reduce heat to a simmer. Step 8: Simmer until most of the liquid is gone. Step 9: Add another cup beef broth, the tomatoes and reduce again but only until there is enough liquid to mix the flour into.

Ingredient Names: beef steaks, green onions, red bell pepper, kidney bean, salsa, jalapenos, olive oil, chili powder, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, dried cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice meat into thin strips, slice onions, slice bell pepper. Step 2: Heat oil in non stick skillet. Step 3: Add meat and vegetables and fry until the meat is light brown. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients. Step 5: Simmer 10 minutes or until done. Step 6: Spoon into 2 flour tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck roast, onion, green chilies, beef bouillon cubes, dry mustard, garlic, adobo seasoning, peppercorns, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Place beef in crockpot. Step 2: Cover roast with remaining ingredients except salsa. Step 3: Cover crockpot and cook on low for 8-10 hours or until roast is tender and can be pulled with a fork. Step 4: Remove the beef from the crockpot and set the cooking liquid aside. Step 5: Using two forks, shred beef. Step 6: Mix beef with salsa, and if you like it a little moister, add some of the cooking liquid to the meat Adjust the seasoning and add salt and pepper if necessary Use as a filling for tacos, burritos, enchiladas, chimis, etc.

Ingredient Names: egg, all-purpose flour, salt, fresh ground pepper, fine breadcrumbs, boneless beef steaks, vegetable oil, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Pound boneless steaks thin, inch. Step 2: In a shallow soup plate or pan, beat the egg very well. Step 3: In a second shallow pan mix the flour, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Put the bread crumbs in a third shallow pan. Step 5: Line up the bowls in this order: flour, egg, crumbs. Step 6: Dust the meat lightly with flour, dip into the beaten egg, and coat with bread crumbs. Step 7: Put the breaded meat on a plate lined with wax paper and refrigerate about 1 hour. Step 8: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil to a depth of about inch. Step 9: Fry the meat until brown and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Step 10: Squeeze lime juice over each piece of meat, if desired.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green bell pepper, garlic cloves, frozen whole kernel corn, salsa, unsweetened cocoa powder, ground cumin, salt, dried oregano, cinnamon, monterey jack cheese, fresh cilantro, all-purpose flour, yellow cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f Spray 11"x7" baking dish with nontick cooking spray Brown beef with onion, bell pepper and garlic in large deep skillet or dutch oven over medium heat, drain fat. Step 2: Stir in corn, salsa, cocoa, cumin, 1 tsp salt, oregano and cinnamon, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 4: Simmer uncovered 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in cheese and cilantro.

Dish Name: Beef N Bean Burrito Stack Crock Pot Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: dry enchilada mix, water, tomato paste, black pepper, garlic powder, salt, lean ground beef, onion, bell pepper, jalapeno peppers, flour tortillas, mexican blend cheese, refried beans
Instructions: Step 1: First, make foil "handles " fold a 30-inch long piece of foil in half lengthwise. Step 2: Place in bottom of a slow cooker with both ends hanging over top edge of cooker The foil strip will make it much easier to remove the burrito stack when done Lightly grease crockpot In saucepan, combine the first six ingredients. Step 3: Simmer for 20 minutes over low heat. Step 4: In a large skillet over medium heat, brown ground beef with onion, bell pepper, and minced jalapeno or mild peppers, drain off fat. Step 5: Stir about 1 / 3 of sauce mix into the browned beef mixture.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chunky salsa, whole kernel corn, miracle whip, chili powder, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350. Step 2: Mix browned meat, salsa, corn, miracle whip and chili powder. Step 3: Layer half of this mixture in a 2-quart casserole dish, then half of the chips, and half of the cheese, repeat layers. Step 4: Bake 20 minutes, or until heated through May top with shredded lettuce and tomatoes, if desired.

Dish Name: Beef Or Turkey And Salsa Skillet
Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, chunky salsa, dark red kidney beans, whole kernel corn, tomato sauce, chili powder, bisquick baking mix, water, colby-monterey jack cheese, black pepper, kosher salt, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: In 12-inch skillet, cook beef over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until brown, drain. Step 2: Stir in salsa, beans, corn, tomato sauce and 1 teaspoon of the chili powder, heat to boiling. Step 3: Reduce heat to low In medium bowl, stir bisquick mix, remaining 1 teaspoon chili powder and the water until soft dough forms. Step 4: Drop dough by 6 spoonfuls onto simmering beef mixture. Step 5: Cook uncovered 10 minutes, cover. Step 6: Cook 8 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: beef, creole seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, monterey jack pepper cheese, feta cheese, flour tortillas, nonstick cooking spray, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Add the beef, creole seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder and black pepper to a pan and brown the meat until fully cooked Lay out your four tortillas and evenly divide the pepper jack cheese among them. Step 2: Keep the ingredients on one half of the tortilla so that you can easily fold it later. Step 3: Sprinkle one tablespoon of feta on each tortilla, on top of the pepper jack Evenly divide the beef among the four tortillas, on top of the cheeses Spray a frying pan with non-stick cooking spray. Step 4: Fold each tortilla in half and fry on medium-high heat, flipping until both sides are golden brown. Step 5: Cut in half and serve with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, lard, unsalted butter, salt, ice water, ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, almonds, raisins, plum tomatoes, serrano peppers, limes, black pepper, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: For dough: Put flour and salt in cuisinart, pulse to combine. Step 2: Add cold lard and butter, pulse to form crumbs. Step 3: Add water and pulse until it just comes together. Step 4: Chill at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Roll out and cut out circles Filling: Saute meat, drain fat. Step 6: Saute onions for 2 minutes, add garlic, almonds and raisins and saute for 2 minutes more. Step 7: Place tomato, chiles, lime juice, salt and pepper in blender.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, flour, salt, dried onion flakes, paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, water, tortillas, lettuce, cheese, sour cream, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl combine the beef with the flour, salt, minced onion, paprika, chili powder, garlic powder and onion powder use your hands to mix evenly. Step 2: Heat skillet to med / low heat. Step 3: Add beef mixture and water to the pan Brown the beef, breaking it up as it cooks. Step 4: Heat the tortillas in the microwave, wrapped in damp paper towels. Step 5: Spread meat into tortillas, top with cheese, tomatoes, lettuce and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, cooking oil, water, parsley, salt, pepper, dried ancho chiles, dried pasilla peppers, tomatoes, onion, sesame seeds, garlic cloves, beef bouillon granules, ground cumin, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven brown meat, half at a time, in hot oil. Step 2: Return all meat to dutch oven. Step 3: Add the 3 cups of water, parsley, salt and pepper, cover. Step 4: Simmer 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 5: Cut ancho and pasilla chilies open. Step 6: Discard stems and seeds. Step 7: Cut chilies into small pieced with scissors or a knife. Step 8: Place chilies in bowl. Step 9: Cover with boiling water and let stand 45 to 60 minutes, drain.

Dish Name: Beef Stew With Cactus Carne Guisada Con Nopalitos
Ingredient Names: dried ancho chiles, corn oil, onion, beef stew meat, salt & fresh ground pepper, garlic clove, tomatoes, nopales
Instructions: Step 1: Trim off the glochids and spines from two paddles of prickly pear cactus. Step 2: Cut into 1 / 2 inch dice and cook in boiling salted water until the color changes to olive green. Step 3: Drain and set to the side. Step 4: Fill a small saucepan with water and bring to the boil. Step 5: Add the chiles and cook for about ten minutes or until fork tender. Step 6: Drain well and remove the stems Whirl in a blender and filter through cheesecloth or a mesh strainer to remove seeds, set to the side. Step 7: Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Step 8: Add oil and sautee the onion until transparent.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, tomato soup, chunky salsa, milk, sour cream, fresh corn, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef in skillet until browned, pour off fat. Step 2: Add taco seasoning, add water according to package directions. Step 3: Cook until seasonings are well blended Add soup, salsa, milk, sour cream, corn, tortillas and half the cheese, stir. Step 4: Spoon into a 9X13 baking dish, cover. Step 5: Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot. Step 6: Sprinkle with remaining cheese and allow cheese to melt.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, tomato soup, salsa, water, fritos corn chips, cheese, green chilies, taco seasoning mix, chili powder, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef in a large skillet with onion till done, drain well. Step 2: Return meat to skillet and add everything except the cheese and fritos and heat till hot. Step 3: When meat mixture is hot again add the fritos. Step 4: When serving top each portion with cheese and your favorite taco toppings Variation #1 creamy mexican style. Step 5: Stir in 1 / 2 cup sour cream with the soup, omit the fritos and add torn flour tortillas Variation #2 ranchero style Omit the fritos and add torn corn tortillas or broken taco shells If you bake this.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, diced onion, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, corn, black beans, chili beans, diced green chilies, cumin, oregano, chili powder, garlic powder, masa harina, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saute ground beef and onions together until meat is browned and onions are tender. Step 2: Drain fat from pan. Step 3: Combine meat and onions in stockpot with remaining ingredients, except for masa harina and 3 / 4 cup water. Step 4: Simmer for thirty minutes to blend flavors Shake or stir together masa harina and water to make a smooth paste Gradually stir masa paste into soup. Step 5: Cook and stir soup until slightly thickened. Step 6: Place a small handful of crushed taco chips into each serving bowl, ladle soup over the chips, then top with shredded cheese and a dollop of sour cream.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, meal, red pepper, black pepper, garlic salt, chili powder, paprika, cumin, shortening, salt, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together in order, blending well. Step 2: Take a heaping tablepoon of the mixture & shape with hands & place on the edge of foil. Step 3: Roll about 3 times, twist ends & place in boiling water for about 15 minute Do the same with the rest.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, lean ground beef, salsa, chili powder, salt, pepper, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oven to 400. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion and garlic and cook them for 3 minutes, stirring often. Step 4: Add the beef and use a wooden spoon or a spatula to break it up while it cooks, until it is no longer red, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in 1 / 2 cup of the salsa, the chili powder, and the salt and pepper. Step 6: Cook the mixture over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Step 7: Place the tortillas on a plate and cover them with damp paper towels Microwave them until warm and pliable, about 45 seconds. Step 8: Top each tortilla with 2 tablespoons of the beef mixture, spreading it to an inch from the edges. Step 9: Sprinkle cheese evenly over the beef.

Ingredient Names: green onions, garlic cloves, olive oil, lean ground beef, dry oregano, chili powder, cream cheese, chicken stock, fresh chives, salt and pepper, tortillas, sharp cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f in a saucepan, brown the green onion in oil. Step 2: Add beef and cook at high heat, while breaking it. Step 3: When it's cooked and liquid evaporated, add oregano, chili powder, cream cheese, stock and chives. Step 4: Cook while stirring until creamy. Step 5: Add salt and pepper, set aside. Step 6: Put one tortilla in a large pie plate. Step 7: Cover with 1 / 5 of beef mixture. Step 8: Sprinkle with 1 / 5 of cheddar. Step 9: Repeat, alternating with tortilla, meat and cheese until there is no leftover.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, steak, onion, taco seasoning mix, salt, pepper, water, flour tortillas, avocado, tomatoes, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In 5 quart dutch oven over medium high heat, add 1 t salad oil. Step 2: Once oil is hot, add onions and saut until golden brown. Step 3: Remove onion and set aside. Step 4: Add 1 t more of oil to hot pan to heat. Step 5: Add steak and sear until well browned on both sides. Step 6: Add onion back to dutch oven, taco seasoning mix, salt, pepper, and water over high heat, heat to boiling. Step 7: Reduce heat to low. Step 8: Cover and simmer 1 to 2 hours until meat is very tender and falls apart when tested with a fork. Step 9: When meat is done, remove steak from pan and transfer to a plate Shred meat with a couple of forks.

Dish Name: Beef With Guajillo Sauce Baked In Banana Leaves Mixiote De Car
Ingredient Names: dried guajillo chilies, annatto seeds, cumin seeds, garlic cloves, distilled white vinegar, beef short ribs, banana leaves, turkish bay leaves, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a 2-quart saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, slit chiles lengthwise, then stem, seed, and devein. Step 3: Add chiles to boiling water and remove from heat. Step 4: Let stand, uncovered, until chiles are softened and have turned a brighter red, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, toast annatto and cumin seeds in a dry small heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant and a shade darker. Step 6: Transfer to a bowl to cool, then grind seeds to a powder in a grinder or mini food processor. Step 7: Transfer chiles to a blender, then add 1 1 / 2 cups soaking liquid, ground seeds, garlic, vinegar, and 1 tablespoon salt. Step 8: Blend until smooth, at least 2 minutes. Step 9: Pour sauce into a large shallow container and cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes. Step 10: Sprinkle meat with 2 teaspoons salt, then add to sauce and turn meat to coat using tongs or your hands.

Ingredient Names: broad bean podded if you want, sirloin, olive oil, cheddar, flour tortillas, jalape o pepper, fresh tomato, fresh coriander, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Half-fill a ridged pan or frying pan with water, bring to the boil, then cook the beans for 1 min before draining. Dry the pan. Step 2: Brush steaks with oil and season. Fry in the pan over a high heat for 2-3 mins on each side, then thinly slice. Step 3: Divide the cheese over one half of each tortilla, then top with the steak, broad beans, jalapeños, tomato and coriander. Fold over the other half of the tortilla to make 8 half-moon shapes and press down to seal. Brush the tops with a little more oil. Step 4: Heat the frying pan over a high heat and cook the quesadillas, oiled-side down, in batches for 1-2 mins until crisp. Brush the uncooked sides with remaining oil, then carefully flip over and cook for 1-2 mins more. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa, if you like.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, refried beans, chunky salsa, chili powder, cumin, jalapeno peppers, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with onions and garlic, then drain. Step 2: Add all remaining ingredients except cheese. Step 3: Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 4: Cool mixture to room temperature in the fridge Unassembled: freeze mixture in bags Thaw overnight, then heat meat mixture in a pan before assembling burritos. Step 5: Bake at 250 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes Assembled: spread chilled mixture on tortillas and top with cheese, then flash freeze and wrap individually Microwave: cook on high, 1 at a time for 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lean ground beef, chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, cumin, cocoa powder, sugar, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, crushed tomatoes, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the ground beef, and cook until browned, about 5-8 minutes. Step 3: Drain off excess fat To the pot, add all other ingredients except for last three Be sure to include the can liquid when adding the black beans- it's yummy. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil, then decrease heat to very low & simmer uncovered for 2-3 hours Try to mix the chili every 15-30 minutes, especially near the end of the cooking time Adjust for seasoning near the end as well. Step 5: Add the squash / zucchini, stir and cook for a further 15-20 minutes, or until the vegetables are cooked through. Step 6: When done, remove from heat, then stir in the cilantro and epazote leaves.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, white onion, cooked rice, condensed cheddar cheese soup, taco seasoning, burrito-size flour tortillas, salsa, black beans, corn, cheddar cheese, enchilada sauce, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: In a large skillet, brown ground beef with onion, drain. Step 3: Return beef & onions to hot skillet off of heat and stir in rice, undiluted soup and taco seasoning. Step 4: Mix together well Lightly spray a lasagna pan / 13" x 9" pan with nonstick cooking spray. Step 5: Line bottom of pan with 4 of the tortillas Evenly cover tortillas with half of the meat / rice mixture, then 1 / 2 of the salsa, then sprinkle with half of the corn, half of the black beans and 1 cup of cheese. Step 6: Cover again with 4 more of the tortillas and repeat these layers again. Step 7: Finally, top with the last 4 remaining tortillas.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, pinto beans with jalapeno peppers, taco seasoning, french fried onion rings, cottage cheese, cheddar cheese, eggs, flour tortillas, pace picante sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet-brown meat& drain. Step 2: Add beans& burrito seasoning to meat, simmer 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in 1 / 2 can durkee onion rings. Step 4: In a large bowl-add cottage cheese, eggs and 1 cup cheese. Step 5: Place about 3 flour tortillas in the bottom of a greased 9x13 dish Overlap more tortillas up the sides. Step 6: Spoon meat mixture over tortillas-add the jar of picante sauce. Step 7: Top with another layer of tortillas. Step 8: Top with the cottage cheese mixture.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, ground beef, taco seasoning mix, tomato sauce, cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, onion, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Beat cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth. Step 2: Spread on a 12-14" pizza pan. Step 3: Refrigerate 1 hour Brown beef over meadium heat, drain. Step 4: Add taco seasoning and tomato sauce. Step 5: Cook and stir 5 minutes, cool completely. Step 6: Spread over cream cheese layer, refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, tomatoes, mexican blend cheese, corn muffin mix, eggs, frozen corn, water, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees Spray a 12x8-inch baking dish with no-stick cooking spray. Step 2: In a large skillet, cook ground beef until browned, stirring constantly, drain. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, 1 cup cheese, corn muffin mix, eggs, Tomatoes, corn and chili powder and water Mixing until well blended. Step 4: Spoon mixture into prepared dish. Step 5: Bake 20 minutes, sprinkle with cheese Continue baking 5 minutes or until.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, poblano chile, onion, chili powder, ground beef, tomatoes, tortilla chips, salt, pepper, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the poblano, onion and chili powder and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Add the beef and cook, breaking up the meat, until the meat is just cooked through, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the tomato and tortilla chips and season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Divide the meat mixture among 4 plates and top with the cheese.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, chorizo sausage, egg, garlic cloves, carrot, cooked rice, cilantro leaf, salt, pepper, ground cumin, chicken broth, onion, celery, diced tomatoes, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Make the meatballs first: combine everything and mix thoroughly Form meatballs and roll between your palms You should make around 20 to 24 meatballs, set aside. Step 2: Combine chicken broth, onion, celery, tomatoes and their liquid, cumin, oregano and cilantro leaves in a large pot. Step 3: Bring to boil, and reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 4: Drop meatballs in the soup. Step 5: Return to simmer and cook another 10 minutes. Step 6: Add zucchini and cook 10 minutes. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper, to taste You could top the soup with cooked rice, or just by itself.
