Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onions, red bell peppers, anaheim chili, red jalapeno chiles, garlic, lean ground beef, worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, beef bouillon cubes, light beer, tomatoes, fire-roasted tomatoes, tomato paste, white wine, chili powder, ground cumin, brown sugar, chipotle sauce, fresh basil, smoked paprika, salt, oregano, ground black pepper, dark red kidney beans, sour cream, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Cook and stir onion, bell pepper, Anaheim pepper, jalapeno peppers, and garlic in the hot oil until softened. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Add worcestershire sauce and garlic powder. Step 4: Crumble bouillon cubes over beef and add beer. Continue to cook, scraping any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet, until liquid is hot, about 3 minutes. Stir beef mixture into pepper mixture. Step 5: Stir crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, and wine to the beef mixture. Step 6: Season with chili powder, 2 tablespoons cumin, brown sugar, pepper sauce, basil, paprika, oregano, and black pepper. Step 7: Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer until meat and vegetables are very tender and flavors have developed in the chili, about 90 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Mix kidney beans into beef and vegetables. Continue to simmer until beans are hot, about 30 minutes. Step 9: Blend sour cream, cilantro, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon cumin in a food processor until smooth. Serve sour cream mixture with chili.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, iceberg lettuce, roma tomatoes, green onions, red kidney beans, black olives, cheddar cheese, catalina dressing, plain doritos
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, drain grease, adding taco seasoning and following directions on package, chill. Step 2: When ground beef is cold, place in a large bowl and add all remaining ingredients. Step 3: Mix well and serve.

Ingredient Names: bacon, lean ground beef, sweet onions, chili sauce, barbecue sauce, liquid smoke, baked beans, cocoa powder, chili powder, cumin, red pepper flakes, flour tortillas, tortilla chips, monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Step 2: Drain on paper towel Saut the onions in the bacon fat in the same skillet until soft. Step 3: Add the beef and continue sauting until the beef is browned. Step 4: Add the chili sauce, barbecue sauce, liquid smoke, cocoa powder, chili powder, cumin, beans and red pepper flakes. Step 5: Stir gently until all ingredients are mixed thoroughly. Step 6: Spoon of the mixture onto each tortilla and fold into burritos Generously sprinkle shredded cheese and crumbled chips on top of each burrito. Step 7: Bake in 350 degree oven for 10 minutes, or broil, until the cheese is bubbling. Step 8: Garnish with sour cream or guacamole, if desired.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, beef, water, lime, green chilies, cilantro, garlic clove, chilies, tomatoes, green onion, fresh lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Make the salsa without the lime juice. Step 2: Drop the garlic and chili pieces one at a time into a running food processor, letting each get finely chopped before adding the next. Step 3: Turn off the processor and remove the lid. Step 4: Cut 1 tomato in quarters and add it to the food processor, along with the cilantro Pulse 4 to 6 times, until you have a coarse puree Scrape the mixture into a bowl. Step 5: Cut the other tomato into inch pieces and add to the bowl, along with the green onion. Step 6: Taste and season with lime juice and salt, usually a generous teaspoons this salsa is best if eaten within an hour or two, but it will keep for a number of hours in the refrigerator. Step 7: Heat a wok over medium high heat. Step 8: Drizzle in a little olive oil, then, in 2 batches, stir-fry the steak until lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco sauce, chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, pizza dough, american cheese, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: For filling, cook ground beef in a small skillet until brown, drain off fat. Step 2: Stir in taco sauce, chili powder, onion powder, and garlic powder. Step 3: Set aside Unroll pizza dough. Step 4: Roll dough into a 14x10-1 / 2-inch rectangle. Step 5: Cut into twelve 3-1 / 2-inch squares. Step 6: Divide filling among dough squares. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 8: Brush edges with water.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, black-eyed peas, garlic salt, rotel tomatoes, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, enchilada sauce, sour cream, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and drain onion and beef. Step 2: Add peas, tomatoes, soups, enchilada sauce, sour cream and spices, grease 9 x 13. Step 3: Cut tortillias into 3ights and put l / 3 in bottom of pan. Step 4: Add l / 3 of meat mixture and 1 cup of cheese. Step 5: Repeat layers until all are used making sure that cheese is on top layer. Step 6: Bake 350 for 35 mins or until brown.

Ingredient Names: lean stewing beef, beef broth, oil, diced green chilies, vegetable juice, garlic, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in oil and drain. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients except cheese and simmer over low heat, or cook in a crockpot on low setting, for 3 hours Shred meat with fork. Step 3: Drain excess liquid. Step 4: Serve on tortillas with cheese.

Ingredient Names: beer, canola oil, onion, limes, garlic cloves, worcestershire sauce, skirt steaks, chili powder, black pepper, chipotle hot sauce, ground cumin, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients. Step 2: Marinate overnight. Step 3: Remove meat from marinade and grill Simultaneously grill sliced onions. Step 4: Serve with flour tortillas, grated cheese, pico de gallo, sour cream, etc.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, white onion, breadcrumbs, egg, of fresh mint, ground cumin, salt, fresh ground pepper, canned tomato sauce, salsa, canned beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix all of the ingredients together except the tomato sauce, salsa, and broth With clean hands work mixture together. Step 2: Add just enough tomato sauce to hold mixture together, making it moist but firm Form into small meatballs, 1 1 / 2 inch in diameter. Step 3: In a saucepan, bring the broth to a boil Decrease heat to med-low and add the meatballs. Step 4: Simmer about 25 minutes to completely cook the meatballs. Step 5: Remove the meatballs to a serving dish. Step 6: Place a bowl of fresh salsa on the side. Step 7: Serve with toothpicks.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, onion, green pepper, garlic clove, bacon, eggs, milk, butter, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Melt margarine in skillet Brown the potato, onion, pepper, and garlic in the skillet. Step 2: Add the meat and heat until the meat is heated through. Step 3: Mix the eggs with milk or water, and pour over the meat and veggies. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until the eggs are done. Step 5: Spoon into flour tortillas, along with 1 tablespoon of grated cheese per tortilla. Step 6: Serve with sour cream and salsa on the side.

Dish Name: Broiled Flank Steak No Marinade Mexican Style
Ingredient Names: sour cream, mayonnaise, garlic powder, celery salt, chili sauce, lime juice, red pepper flakes, salt, flank steaks
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and blend. Step 2: Refrigerate until ready to serve In another small bowl, combine the other ingredients for the steak. Step 3: Brush the steak ingredients on one side of the steak and broil 6 inches from the heat, for 10 minutes. Step 4: Turn the steak over and brush the other side with the steak ingredients and broil 6-10 minutes longer, until done to your liking. Step 5: Let meat stand for 5 minutes, after it is done, before thinly slicing the meat across the grain. Step 6: Serve with the chilled sour cream sauce.

Ingredient Names: skirt steak, garlic clove, cumin, fresh cilantro, worcestershire sauce, light soy sauce, liquid smoke, yellow onion, pepper, green pepper, yellow pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from steak Pound lightly to tenderize. Step 2: Place meat in non-metallic container. Step 3: Top with onion rings. Step 4: Combine garlic, cumin, cilantro, worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, liquid smoke, lime juice and pepper. Step 5: Pour over meat and onions. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate overnight. Step 7: Remove meat and onions reserving marinade. Step 8: Place meat on a grill, basting and turning often. Step 9: When the meat is done, slice it into thin strips across the grain.

Dish Name: Buck Em Off Chili Con Carne
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, boneless beef chuck steaks, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, onions, red kidney beans, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, beef broth, mushroom stems and pieces, chili powder, ground cumin, granulated sugar, garlic powder, italian seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Cut rib steaks or roast into 3 / 8" cubes. Step 2: Place into a large bowl and sprinkle with flour, mixing well to coat. Step 3: In a large frying pan, heat olive oil on medium high heat. Step 4: Add coated meat cubes and fry until lightly browned, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Transfer meat cubes to a large cooking pot. Step 6: Add chopped garlic, chopped onions, red kidney beans including liquid, plum tomatoes including liquid, tomato paste, beef broth, mushrooms including liquid, chili powder, ground cumin, sugar, italian seasoning, cayenne pepper, dried oregano leaves, black pepper, salt, sweet red pepper, green pepper and celery and simmer covered, for at least 1 1 / 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Add beer and red wine and continue to simmer covered, for 15 minutes At this time, adjust seasonings to taste. Step 8: In a small bowl, mix together tapioca starch with 1 / 4 cup of water While chili is simmering add tapioca mixture to thicken slightly.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, black beans, tequila, epazote, ancho chilies, taco seasoning, cocoa powder, black pepper, hot sauce, water, sour cream, salsa verde, sharp cheddar cheese, minute rice, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Dump the beans, tequila and epazote into a saucepan and begin simmering over low heat, stir occasionally. Step 2: Mix the taco seasoning, cocoa, and black pepper in a bowl. Step 3: In a large four-quart pot, brown the meat and then add the water and taco seasoning mixture, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to simmer, and add the chopped chilies and hot sauce. Step 5: Stir and simmer for 15 minutes In the meantime, put the beans, sour cream, and salsa into a blender and puree the mixture It should have a smooth consistency when you are done. Step 6: Pour the blender contents into the pot and heat on medium-low.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, mild green chilies, onion, ground beef, sharp american cheese, flour tortillas, lettuce, tomatoes, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beans, 2 tablespoons of the chili peppers, onion and 3 / 4 salt. Step 2: Add beef and mix well Form into 8- 5 inch patties. Step 3: Cut cheese slices in half. Step 4: Place 1 / 2 cheese slice on each beef patty. Step 5: Fold to seal in the cheese, forming a semicircle. Step 6: Grill or fry 5 to 6 minutes. Step 7: Turn and grill or fry 4 to 5 minutes more or until done. Step 8: Serve burgers in warmed tortillas. Step 9: Add lettuce, chopped tomato, salsa and remaining chilies as desired.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, ground cumin, minced garlic cloves, lean ground beef, chili powder, red pepper flakes, kosher salt, low sodium beef broth, tomato paste, condensed tomato soup, flour tortillas, refried beans, salsa, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Add olive oil to skillet over medium heat and heat until hot. Step 3: Add the chopped onions to the pan and saute approximately 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the garlic and ground cumin and cook for another minute. Step 5: Add the ground beef and cook until browned about 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the chili powder and salt, stirring. Step 7: Then add the beef broth and tomato paste and bring to a simmer. Step 8: Cook, uncovered approximately 20 minutes or until most of the liquid is evaporated. Step 9: After beef is cooked, pour 1 can of the tomato soup into a 2 cup measuring cup and add about 1 / 3 can of water, stir well.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, refried beans, salsa, cheddar cheese, sour cream, olive
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix together ground beef and taco seasoning Form mixture into a loaf shape and place in a loaf pan for baking. Step 2: Cook for 30-45 minutes at 375 degrees. Step 3: Remove loaf from pan. Step 4: Drain any drippings or grease from the bottom of the pan In the bottom of the pan spread refried beans. Step 5: Put meatloaf back on top of beans. Step 6: Pour salsa on top of meatloaf. Step 7: Sprinkle top with cheese. Step 8: Return to oven for 10 minutes, until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, refried beans, taco seasoning, tomato sauce, water, flour tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except tortillas in a greased slow cooker. Step 2: Cover and cook on low heat 6-10 hours. Step 3: Spread hot bean mixture on flour tortillas. Step 4: Fill with favorite burrito toppings, fold and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: rump roast, taco seasoning, diced tomatoes, green chilies, onion, bell pepper, flour tortilla, guacamole, sour cream, salsa, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place first 6 ingredients in the crock pot. Step 2: Cook on low for about 8 hours. Step 3: Remove the roast from the crock pot & shred using 2 forks. Step 4: Put the shredded roast in a serving bowl and add enough of the remaining crock pot sauce to moisten. Step 5: Serve burrito-style with flour tortillas, guacamole, cheese, sour cream, and salsa.

Ingredient Names: chili beans, ground beef, jiffy cornbread mix, egg, milk, creamed corn, sour cream, ranch dressing, salsa, lettuce, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 3: Mix beans and ground beef Spray or grease sides of casserole dish. Step 4: Pour beef and bean mixture into 2 2l - 2 6l casserole dish. Step 5: In a bowl make the corn bread as directed on the box Either spread corn over beef and bean mixture, or mix it into the cornbread batter. Step 6: Pour cornbread batter over beef and bean mixture, and spread cornbread mixture evenly (making a little thin in the center is better, so it doesn't end up raw in the middle.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, taco seasoning, pinto beans, salt, onion, flour tortillas, green enchilada sauce, cheddar cheese, avocado, tomatoes, lettuce, hot sauce, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the beef and drain. Step 2: Add taco seasoning and 1 / 2 cup water and cook until all liquid is gone. Step 3: Meanwhile, drain about half of the liquid off of the pinto beans and then heat in a pan. Step 4: When beans start to simmer, lightly mash until you get the desired consistency. Step 5: Season to taste with salt, about 1 teaspoon Lightly heat one tortilla over burner until pliable. Step 6: Spread some beans down the center or tortilla and top with some seasoned meat. Step 7: Sprinkle on some onions and any other options you'd like Tuck in sides of tortilla and then roll up. Step 8: Place seamside down on a microwave safe plate.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, stew meat, flour, potatoes, yellow onions, garlic cloves, green chili peppers, diced tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan. Step 2: Add onions and garlic. Step 3: Cook about 3-5 minutes Lightly coat the stew meat in flour and add to the pan Brown the meat and add green chiles You can use hot or mild chile depending on your tastes. Step 4: Let simmer about 5 minutes and add tomatoes. Step 5: Add one or two cups of water and potatoes. Step 6: Cook covered until potatoes are easily cut with a fork If most of the water has evaporated, add more.

Dish Name: Caldillo New Mexican Green Chile Stew
Ingredient Names: lean beef round, oil, potatoes, onion, garlic clove, salt, green chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Cube meat, sprinkle with salt and fry until brown in oil. Step 2: Add potatoes to browned meat together with onion, garlic, salt, chili and enough water to cover Continue to add water if necessary It will have a soupy consistency.

Dish Name: Caldillo South Of The Border Stew
Ingredient Names: beef, onion, bacon drippings, tomatoes, ancho chili, beef stock, salt, pepper, garlic, ground cumin, potato, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the beef and onions in the bacon drippings. Step 2: Add tomatoes, sliced green chilies, stocks and seasonings. Step 3: Cook over low heat until meat is tender. Step 4: Add cubed potatoes and carrots during last 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: yellow onions, vegetable oil, tomatoes, green chili peppers, beef stock, cumin, salt, pepper, corn tortillas, lean ground beef, egg, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, warm the oil and saute onions over medium low heat. Step 2: Add tomatoes, green chile, 1 quart of beef stock, cumin and salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Simmer the soup over medium low heat for 30 minutes, if soup seems to thick, add some of the additional stock to thin. Step 4: Cut the tortillas into fine silvers and mince. Step 5: In a large bowl, mix the cut tortillas with the ground beef. Step 6: Add the egg, garlic, salt and pepper. Step 7: Shape into tiny meatballs and drop into the pot of soup Continue to cook on medium low until meatballs float to the top. Step 8: Serve in individual bowls garnished with fresh cilantro.

Dish Name: Caldo De Res A Mexican Beef Vegetable Soup
Ingredient Names: beef shank, white onion, onion, salt, pepper, beef stock, stewed tomatoes, corn, baking potatoes, chayotes, carrots, cilantro, water, cabbage, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the beef shank into large chunks, keeping some attached to the bone Saut the beef chunks with the chopped onions, salt, and pepper. Step 2: After the beef is browned, add the beef stock and the stewed tomatoes. Step 3: Bring the mixture to a boil, then simmer just below the boiling point for about one hour, until the beef is spoon tender. Step 4: Wash the vegetables thoroughly, then cut each ear of corn and each potato into quarters. Step 5: Cut equivalent chunks of carrots and chayote. Step 6: Add the vegetables to the soup. Step 7: Chop cup of cilantro and add it to the mixture, then add water to cover the vegetables and bring the mixture to a boil. Step 8: Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 9: Cut the cabbage into and then into thirds, leaving the stem of the cabbage intact.

Ingredient Names: beef shank, tomatoes, potatoes, yellow onion, carrots, cabbage, garlic, fresh cilantro, cayenne, salt, fresh ground pepper, water, fresh lime juice, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot combine the beef, tomato, potatoes, onion, carrots, cabbage, garlic, 5 teaspoons of the cilantro, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Add water to cover and stir well. Step 3: Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours. Step 4: Uncover, stir, and simmer for an additional hour uncovered Just before serving, stir in the cumin, squeeze in fresh lime juice to taste and sprinkle with remaining cilantro. Step 5: Serve and enjoy Corn may also be added to this recipe, as well as a dollop of sour cream as garnish.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, dark red kidney beans, red kidney beans, black beans, peach salsa, diced tomatoes with lime and cilantro, rotel, ro-tel tomatoes and onions, sweet onion, bell pepper, chili powder, ground cumin, southwest seasoning, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Season meat with salt and pepper. Step 2: In a large dutch oven brown ground meat While meat is browning drain and rinse beans. Step 3: Add chopped bell pepper and onion. Step 4: Cook until onion is translucent. Step 5: Add beans and cook for a about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add tomatoes and salsa. Step 7: Bring to a simmer and add spices, start out small until you reach the amount of kick you like Depending on the heat in the salsa and the tomatoes you use, the amount of spice varies. Step 8: Cook at a low simmer for about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, lean ground beef, paprika, ground cumin, dried oregano, chili powder, cayenne pepper, water, tomato paste, romaine lettuce, plum tomatoes, cheddar cheese, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick skillet heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and garlic. Step 3: Cook until onions are translucent, about 4-5 minutes. Step 4: Add the ground beef and turn heat to high Brown meat, stirring constantly, until crumbly, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain off any excess fat. Step 6: Lower heat and add paprkia, cumin, oregano, chili powder, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Add the 1 cup of water and tomato paste, blend well. Step 8: Bring mixture to a boil then reduce to low.

Ingredient Names: garlic, salt, ground cumin, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, dried mexican oregano, sirloin tip roast, extra virgin olive oil, onions, all-purpose flour, dry sherry, bay leaves, worcestershire sauce, bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In mortar or heavy bowl, mash garlic, salt, cumin, and oregano. Step 2: Blend spices into vinegar and lemon juice and mix well Score meat in a cross-hatch pattern with deep cuts Rub spice blend into meat, making sure it gets into cuts. Step 3: Marinate meat 1-4 hours in spice marinade. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 5: Drain marinade from meat and reserve Coat meat in flour and shake away excess In roasting pan over heat on stove, heat onions in olive oil. Step 6: Add meat and brown on all sides.

Dish Name: Carne Asada Arrachera Con Ajo Y Limon A La Parrilla
Ingredient Names: skirt steaks, garlic, olive oil, coarse salt, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: If necessary, trim steak, leaving some fat In shallow dish, rub steaks with garlic and oil. Step 2: Marinate steaks, covered and chilled, at least 30 minutes and up to 1 day, prepare grill. Step 3: Season steaks generously with coarse salt and grill on a rack set 5 to 6 inches over glowing coals 2 to 3 minutes on each side for medium-rare. Step 4: Transfer steaks to a cutting board and drizzle with lime juice. Step 5: Let steaks stand, uncovered, 5 to 10 minutes and with a sharp knife cut diagonally across grain into thin slices. Step 6: Garnish with grilled onions, serve with tortillas, refried beans and rice.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, olive oil, salt & pepper, cumin, garlic powder, frozen beef burger patties, green onions, mayonnaise, salsa, avocado, buns
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 1 / 4 c lime juice, 1 / 4 c olive oil, salt, pepper, cumin, and garlic powder in a large ziplock bag. Step 2: Add beef patties in a single layer and lay flat to marinade Marinade 1-2 hours, turning to marinade both sides evenly. Step 3: Combine 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, cumin, and garlic powder in a small ziplock bag. Step 4: Add green onions Marinade 1-2 hours, shaking now and then. Step 5: Combine salsa and mayonnaise and mix well. Step 6: Refrigerate sauce until needed. Step 7: Grill beef patties over gas or coals until cooked to desired doneness. Step 8: Grill green onions for a couple of minutes, until cooked and just charred around the edges.

Dish Name: Carne Asada Burrito San Diego Style
Ingredient Names: beef, onion, lemon, lime, salt, pepper, tomatoes, onions, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, garlic powder, oregano, chili powder, cumin, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Meat: Lay the meat out flat and season liberally with salt and pepper. Step 2: Cut meat into 1 / 4 inch pieces. Step 3: Place meat in a zip lock bag and add fine diced onions and lemon / lime juices. Step 4: Mix well and refrigerate for at least 30 min, up to 24 hours Pico de gallo: Fine dice all ingredients and mix well. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate, stir occasionally Guacamole:.

Dish Name: Carne Asada Cube Stew Carne Guisada
Ingredient Names: stew beef chunks, beef broth, diced tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, diced green chilies, jalapenos, yellow onion, garlic cloves, russet potatoes, vegetable oil, cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut onion into half-rings. Step 2: Set aside Dice garlic and set aside. Step 3: In a large pot, add vegetable oil to cover bottom, heat on high heat. Step 4: When oil is hot, add cubed beef and quickly stir so that all sides get brown. Step 5: Allow beef to cook in its own juices. Step 6: When beef is a bit brown, lower heat to med-high and add onion and garlic Saut until onion is tender. Step 7: Lower heat to medium and add canned tomatoes, tomato sauce, green chilies, and jalapenos.

Dish Name: Carne Asada Gerardo's Baja Grill California
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, vegetable oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, orange juice, water, garlic, white pepper, salt, ground cumin, chili powder, ground cloves, orange, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all marinade ingredients together to combine. Step 2: Marinate flank steak in the mixture in the refrigerator for one hour or more. Step 3: Remove the steak from the marinade and barbecue meat until done. Step 4: Cut into strips or dice meat, and serve with warm corn tortillas with salsa and guacamole Or, plase in flour tortilla and roll up burrito-style with beans, rice, cheese, and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: lime, lemon, oranges, chili powder, dried oregano leaves, ground cumin, coriander seeds, garlic cloves, soy sauce, jalapeno peppers, onion, skirt steaks
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a 1-gallon ziploc bag. Step 2: Add meat, seal and massage marinade into meat. Step 3: Marinate in bag for up to 24 hours, turning and massaging frequently. Step 4: Grill to medium rare. Step 5: Serve whole, sliced, or diced for tacos or burritos!

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, flour tortillas, tequila, lime juice, lemon juice, orange juice, garlic cloves, onion, pepper, salsa, guacamole, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix juices, garlic, onion, tequila, tabasco and pepper in a bowl. Step 2: Add meat and marinate both sides. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate, turning meat over occasionallt. Step 4: Let sit 4 hours or more, preheat grill. Step 5: Place few drops of water on each tortilla, stack and wrap in foil, place on grill. Step 6: Remove meat from marinade, reserve marinade. Step 7: Place meat on grill. Step 8: Turn steak and tortillas once during cooking.

Dish Name: Carne Asada Sandwiches With Chipotle Mayonnaise
Ingredient Names: red onion, red wine vinegar, garlic, salt, lime juice, olive oil, round steaks, mayonnaise, chipotle chile in adobo, hard rolls, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the onion slices in a strainer under cold running water Pat dry, place in a bowl. Step 2: Cover with the red wine vinegar. Step 3: Set aside for 30 minutes or up to 2 hours Pound the garlic with salt, using a mortar and pestle, to make a paste. Step 4: Add 1 tablespoon of the lime juice and incorporate it into the garlic Slowly add the olive oil, stirring with the pestle to incorporate it. Step 5: Spoon the garlic mixture over the steak, spreading it with the back of a spoon, season with salt.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, skirt steaks, sea salt, ground black pepper, olive oil, flour tortillas, chunky salsa, avocados, onion, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Additional toppings to taste, preheat grill. Step 2: Sprinkle lime juice over steak and season both sides with salt and pepper. Step 3: Grease rack with olive oil before placing steak on grill. Step 4: Grill until desired doneness is reached. Step 5: Transfer to a cutting board to rest Thinly slice across the grain Quickly warm tortillas on grill, about 5 seconds per side. Step 6: Serve meat in tortillas with salsa, avocado, onion and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, vinegar, soy sauce, olive oil, cumin, black pepper, salt, garlic powder, chili powder, paprika, onion powder, oregano, limes, garlic cloves, corn
Instructions: Step 1: In a gallon size ziploc bag, combine all ingredients with flank steak and mix really well. Step 2: Let marinate for at least 6 hours - overnight if you can. Step 3: Grill steak until desired degree of doneness. Step 4: Let sit for at least 5-10 minutes! Step 5: Once the meat has cooled, slice across grain into small chunks Serve on warmed tortillas with toppings of your choice!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, beer, dried oregano, ground cumin, achiote powder, orange juice, sugar, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large ziploc bag, place beer, oregano, cumin, orange juice, sugar and garlic. Step 2: Add salt and pepper to taste, making it a bit on the salty side. Step 3: Add red pepper flakes and achiote powder, if using Achiote gives it a nice color and a subtle taste Zip bag closed and shake or knead to blend all ingredients well. Step 4: Add flank steak, zip closed and combine to saturate all sides of beef. Step 5: Refrigerate at least one hour, turning and shaking bag from time to time Drink rest of beer while meat is marinating. Step 6: Place meat on hot grill, turning only once, about four minutes per side for medium well. Step 7: When done to your liking, place meat on cutting board, let rest for a few minutes, then cut into small 1 / 2 inch pieces.

Dish Name: Carne Asada With Tomato Jalapeno Sauce
Ingredient Names: skirt steak, lime, white vinegar, serrano peppers, onion powder, garlic clove, mexican oregano, cilantro, salt, pepper, fire-roasted tomatoes, jalapeno, sugar, salt & pepper, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Place all of the marinade ingredients, except for the steak, into a food processor and buzz them up. Step 2: Then pour the mixture over the steak in a non-reactive container and marinade for about 15 minutes Any longer and the acid from the lime juice will cook your steak for you! Step 3: Meanwhile prepare the sauce by buzzing the fire roasted tomatoes, jalepeno, garlic, vinegar, sugar, cilantro and salt & pepper in your food processor until you have a fine consistency. Step 4: Place this mixture in a pot over medium heat and cook for about 20 minutes, stiring constantly to make sure the tomatoes don't burn. Step 5: Grill the steak over high heat to your desired doneness It all depends on your heat, so since you're the cook, you decide! Step 6: Top the steak with the sauce and serve Optionally, to do it exactly like they do at el torito, go ahead and roll the jack cheese inside a corn tortilla, which you have baked just until the cheese melts. Step 7: Place this enchilada on top of the steak before you spoon on the sauce.

Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, garlic cloves, onion, cumin, black pepper, tomato sauce, beef bouillon cubes, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Sort through the stew meat, trimming off excess fat, gristle. Step 2: Cut into 1" pieces If necessary In medium-sized, heavy pot, place enough bacon drippings or melted lard to cover the bottom. Step 3: Place stew meat, garlic and onion in the pot and saute until the meat is lightly browned. Step 4: Add water to cover and add two or three tablespoons of beef bouillon, cumin, pepper and tomato sauce, cover. Step 5: Simmer on low heat until meat is tender Toward the end of the cooking time, add flour to thicken and continue simmering, stirring from time to time, for an additional 10 minute. Step 6: Remove from heat and serve with rice and refried beans.

Dish Name: Carne De Puerco En Chile Verde
Ingredient Names: pork, green chilies, onion, boiling water, oil, garlic cloves, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork or beef into small cubes. Step 2: Saute in oil until well browned. Step 3: Drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat. Step 4: Add chopped chiles, garlic, onion, tomato and water and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 5: Cover tightly and simmer 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, potato, onion, tomatoes, green bell pepper, garlic, sazon goya, salt, oil, ketchup
Instructions: Step 1: Boil flank steak, potato, and salt in a covered pot till steak is fully cooked. Step 2: When done, drain and shred the steak. Step 3: Preheat oil in a large skillet over med heat. Step 4: When oil is heated, place all ingredients in oil and saut until the onion is translucent If desired, stir in a little ketchup to give it a little kick. Step 5: Serve with hot rice.

Dish Name: Carne En Su Jugo Estilo Tapatio
Ingredient Names: bacon, beef sirloin tip, beef broth, chipotle chiles in adobo, bay leaves, sea salt, ground pepper, dried beans, cilantro, spring onions, serrano chilies, limes, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: In a frying pan, slowly fry the chopped bacon over medium-low heat until crisp, then remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Step 2: Raise the heat to med-high and cook the beef in the bacon drippings for about 2 minutes. Step 3: Remove the beef with a slotted spoon, and place in a large, heavy pot. Step 4: Put chipotles in a blender with about 1 cup of the beef broth, and blend until smooth. Step 5: Add the chile-beef liquid to the large pot, along with the remaining beef broth, the bay leaves, salt and pepper. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Step 7: Cover and simmer until the meat is tender, approximately 20 minutes Warm the beans over med-low heat. Step 8: When meat is cooked, divide the beans among 4 bowls, then ladle the meat and the broth over the beans. Step 9: Garnish with the bacon and cilantro, and lay 2 onions along the rim of each bow, as well as the avocado slices.

Dish Name: Carne En Su Jugo Meat Cooked In It's Own Juice
Ingredient Names: chuck roast, bacon, onion, garlic cloves, tomatillos, cilantro, limes, chicken bouillon
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan cook all the bacon to a nice crispy texture While the bacon is frying place the onion, garlic, tomatillos, bouillon and cilantro in a blender. Step 2: Squeeze the lime wedges into the blender and mix well so everything inside forms a frothy uniformed consistency. Step 3: Remove bacon from the drippings and sear the roast on all sides in the bacon fat This will ensure that the juices in side the meat are sealed in side So make sure every raw spot is well browned. Step 4: After browning the meat return the bacon to the pan and pour the contents from the blender over the roast Or transfer everything to a crock pot. Step 5: Cover and allow to simmer for 1 hour on the stove If using a crock pot set for 6-8 hours but add 2 cups of water of beef broth.

Ingredient Names: stew meat, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes with green chilies, cumin, chili powder, oregano, cilantro, water, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Dredge stew meat in flour. Step 2: In a large stock pot brown the beef on medium high heat in 2 tbsp of olive oil, remove meat. Step 3: Add in 2 tbsp of olive oil and cook on medium heat. Step 4: Add in the onions until translucent. Step 5: Add the garlic and cook about 1 more minute Throw in the browned meat and add herbs, spices, water and canned tomatoes. Step 6: Turn up heat to high and bring to a boil And turn heat down to low and simmer for 5 hours I sometimes take a short cut and dredge and brown the meat in a skillet then throw everything in a crock pot and let simmer on low for 6-8 hours depending on how tender you like the meat.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, flour, olive oil, onion, garlic, jalapeno peppers, beef stock, tomato paste, cumin, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Toss meat pieces with flour, then brown quickly in oil in an ovenproof dutch oven. Step 3: Add onion, garlic, jalapeo, beef stock, tomato paste, cumin and chili powder. Step 4: Bring to a simmer on the stove. Step 5: Cover dutch oven and place in the preheated oven, baking for about 2 to 2-1 / 2 hours, until meat is extremely tender. Step 6: Serve as is, or on rice, or folded into warm tortillas.

Ingredient Names: flank steak, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, ground cumin, roma tomatoes, onions, beef bouillon cubes, water, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a skillet and saut flank steak until browned. Step 2: Remove from the skillet and saut chopped tomatoes, thinly sliced onions, minced garlic and cumin until veggies are tender. Step 3: Add the flank steak, water, bouillon, salt and pepper. Step 4: Allow to simmer on low until tender and meat pulls apart with a fork Pull the steak apart into bite sized pieces. Step 5: Allow the sauce to cook down to desired thickness for serving on rice, or add more water depending on how much it has cooked down Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: yellow onion, diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, red chili pepper flakes, tabasco sauce, fresh ground black pepper, ground cumin, diced tomatoes with juice, top round beef
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy pan with a lid, over medium heat, saut onions, ro-tel, red chili flakes, tabasco, black pepper and cumin, adding a little water only as needed to keep the mixture from sticking. Step 2: Stir frequently, cooking until the onion is translucent and tender. Step 3: Add tomatoes with their liquid and stir well. Step 4: Cook for 3-5 minutes There won't be much liquid at this point, add beef. Step 5: Reduce heat to simmer, cover pot and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1-1 / 2 hours or until beef is thoroughly tender. Step 6: When beef has cooled, refrigerate overnight The next day, shred beef pieces, using fingers Skim and fat from cooking juices and return beef to pan.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, water, onions, garlic cloves, ground cumin, green chili salsa, salt and pepper, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat in a roasting pan and cover with water You may add the optional ingredients at this point if you wish I generally do. Step 2: Cover the pan and roast it overnight at 250 to 300 degrees In the morning drain the meat, reserving the broth and discarding the onion and garlic if used The meat should be very tender when pierced with a fork. Step 3: Cool the meat for at least 1 hour or until it can be handled easily. Step 4: Using your fingers, shred meat, pulling it apart where the grain allows separation Pull off and discard all fat, bone and gristle. Step 5: Combine the shredded meat with salsa.

Ingredient Names: green tomatoes, bacon, onion, beef stew meat, dried kidney beans, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, chili powder, crushed red pepper flakes, lime, cilantro, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, boil enough water to cover the top of the tomatoes. Step 2: Once water has come to a boil, add tomatoes. Step 3: Boil for 15 minutes or until mushy Leaving water in pot and keep ready to boil, remove tomatoes and put in blender. Step 4: Puree till liquified. Step 5: Add tomatoes back to water. Step 6: Add all seasonings Separately, cook bacon in electric skillet. Step 7: Remove bacon, cook beef and onion in bacon grease till browned. Step 8: Add all meat, onions, and beans into tomato mixture.

Dish Name: Casserole Quiche With Crisp Fried Tortilla Pieces
Ingredient Names: tortillas, vegetable oil, lean ground beef, onion, garlic clove, bell pepper, green chili salsa, dry oregano leaves, ground cumin, chili powder, salt, sharp cheddar cheese, whole green chilies, eggs, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each tortilla into 8 wedges. Step 2: Fry in hot vegetable oil until crisp. Step 3: Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt, if desired. Step 4: Store in an air-tight container Crumble beef into a wide frying pan. Step 5: Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until meat is browned. Step 6: Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper. Step 7: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in salsa, oregano, cumin, and chile powder. Step 9: Season to taste with salt.

Ingredient Names: beef mince, baked beans, diced tomatoes, onion, garlic, tomato ketchup, basil, mexican chili powder, cajun seasoning, potatoes, sour cream, cheese, chives
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Step 2: Saute the onion and garlic Brown the beef mince. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients, and simmer for about 20 minutes If having with baked potatoes, serve the con carne on a baked potato, with garnishes if you wish.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, chunky salsa, tortilla chips, chili powder, salt, hamburger buns, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, tomatoes, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beef, salsa, tortilla chips, chili powder and salt and shape into 4 patties. Step 2: Place the top halves of the buns, cut side up in a shallow metal baking pan top with cheese and cover with foil Bbq grill the burgers 5 minutes per side or until juices run clear. Step 3: After the first 5 minutes, place the bun pan over indirect heat for 5 minutes or until cheese has melted To assemble, place the burgers on the bun bottoms, top each with 1 tbls sour cream, 1 tomato slice, lettuce or cabbage and the other bun halves cheese side down.

Ingredient Names: pork roast, pinto beans, garlic cloves, green chilies, chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a large pot, kettle or crock pot and cover with water. Step 2: Simmer over low heat, adding water if needed. Step 3: After 6 hours, remove bones and break up roast Continue cooking with lid off until thick. Step 4: Serve on tostada shells or tortillas burrito style with shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes and onions Chalupa freezes perfectly!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, green pepper, ground beef, chili powder, oregano, basil, brown sugar, coriander, cumin, worcestershire sauce, fresh tomato, diced tomatoes, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: -heat olive olive oil in sauce pan -add the onion, garlic, green pepper and beef going over medium heat -gradually add spices, sugar and worcestershire -once the meat is browned and onions are clear add everthing else -simmer for one hour -you may need to add more beer to maintain The proper consistency.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, yellow onion, carrots, celery, potatoes, lean ground beef, rice, cilantro, garlic cloves, pepper, seasoning salt, egg
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot combine broth, tomatoes, tomato sauce and water, add vegetables, bring to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in large bowl. Step 3: Mix thoroughly Form into small meatballs. Step 4: Add carefully to soup. Step 5: Cook for 15-30 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, salsa, water, refried beans, diced green chilies, monterey jack cheese, wonton wrappers, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef in large frying pan, drain any grease. Step 2: Add taco seasoning and salsa, mix well. Step 3: Add water as needed to dissolve seasoning and get the right consistency. Step 4: Add refried beans and green chiles. Step 5: Mix well, and heat through 3 or 4 minutes. Step 6: Let cool slightly To assemble:.

Dish Name: Charred Beef Medallions With Poblano Margarita Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, unsalted butter, beef tenderloin, salt and pepper, vidalia onion, poblano peppers, ground cumin, gold tequila, lime juice, beef stock, grand marnier, orange zest, heavy cream, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil and butter in a saute pan over medium heat, season the beef medallions with salt and pepper, and add to the hot pan. Step 2: Turn the heat up to high and char both sides of the beef well To keep the beef rare to medium rare, cook quickly, turning once only after the beef has browned on the first side. Step 3: Remove the beef from the pan, place on a warm platter, and set aside. Step 4: Add the diced onions and poblano peppers to the saute pan, evenly spread out and cook till wilted. Step 5: Add the cumin and combine well to toast the spice again Working carefully away from the flame, add the tequila to the pan, deglaze the pan by swirling the tequila and set back over low heat to reduce. Step 6: Add the lime juice and reduce to almost dry before adding the beef stock. Step 7: Reduce the stock by half over high heat and add the grand marnier and fresh orange zest. Step 8: Cook for 2 minutes and then add the heavy cream.

Dish Name: Charred Corn And Heirloom Tomato Steak Fajitas
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, ground cumin, cilantro, limes, sugar, olive oil, flank steaks, heirloom tomato, cotija cheese, bibb lettuce, salt and black pepper, corn, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine garlic, jalapeno, cumin, cilantro, lime juice, sugar and oil in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Whisk until well combine and transfer to a plastic gallon-size zip top bag, add flank steak and marinate under refrigeration for 1 to 4 hours 2 Assemble tomatoes, cheese, and lettuce leaves on a platter 3. Step 3: Preheat grill to medium-high heat and place 8-inch cast iron pan on directly on the grill or over side burner set to medium-high heat 4. Step 4: Remove steak from marinade, pat dry and season with salt and pepper as desired. Step 5: Grill steak for 6 to 8 minutes per side or to desired doneness.

Ingredient Names: dried pinto bean, tomatoes, green bell pepper, onions, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, parsley, butter, lean ground beef, ground pork, chili powder, salt, pepper, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse beans, put in a bowl and add water so that it extends 2 inches above beans. Step 2: Allow to soak overnight. Step 3: Transfer beans and water to a large stock pot. Step 4: Simmer, covered, in the same water until tender, about 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours. Step 5: Add tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes. Step 6: Heat oil in large skillet and saut green peppers slowly 5 minutes. Step 7: Add onions and cook until tender, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add garlic and parsley. Step 9: In a second large skillet, melt butter and saut beef and pork 15 minutes. Step 10: Add meat to onion mixture, stir in chili powder and cook 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Cheese Cheese Onion Beef Cheese Enchilada Fillings
Ingredient Names: cheese, onion, hamburger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix your ingredients, fill your tortillas with a moderate line of one of the above selections, fold in half twice, place in greased cake pan, sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: dried ancho chile powder, unsalted beef stock, ground beef, onion, garlic, bacon drippings, cumin seeds, oregano, salt, masa harina, mild cheddar cheese, oil, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: To toast the cumin seeds, lay them on a shallow cookie sheet and bake in a 350 degree oven for 5 minutes Grind with a spice grinder or mortar and pestle The toasting will give the cumin a mellower, pleasant flavor. Step 2: In a saucepan, brown the meat with the onion and garlic, drain fat. Step 3: Add bacon drippings if desired. Step 4: Allow drippings to melt. Step 5: Add the stock cumin, oregano, salt, and ground ancho. Step 6: Let simmer 50 min, until meat is tender and liquid has thickened a bit. Step 7: Mix the masa harina in a small bowl with 2 t.

Ingredient Names: beef, onion, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, salt, garlic salt, pepper, red pepper sauce, cheddar cheese, green chilies, red cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients together except the cheese slices and chiles. Step 2: Shape the mixture into 12 thin patties, each about 3 1 / 2-inches in diameter. Step 3: Place 1 cheese slice and 1 tsp of the chiles on each of 6 patties. Step 4: Top with the remaining 6 patties sealing the edges firmly Broil or grill the patties 4-inches from the heat, turning once, until the desired doneness is reached, about 10 to 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, minced garlic clove, butter, pinto beans, white corn, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, picante sauce, cumin, velveeta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the beef, drain. Step 2: Melt butter, add onion and garlic, saute about 5 minute add the rest of the ingredients except cheese, simmer 1 hour. Step 3: Add cheese and heat and stir until melted. Step 4: Serve with sour cream, chopped hot peppers, green onions, black olives, cilantro, shredded cheese, more salsa, chips, tortillas or bread.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, cheddar cheese, corn tortillas, water, tomato soup, chunky salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in skillet, drain fat. Step 2: Add in soup, salsa, water, tortillas, and half of cheese, heat to a boil. Step 3: Cover and let cook for 5 minutes or until hot. Step 4: Add remaining cheese before serving!

Ingredient Names: beef, onion, bell pepper, garlic clove, pinto beans, tomato sauce, picante sauce, cumin, salt, corn tortillas, cheese, lettuce, sour cream, fresh tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat with pepper, onion and garlic, drain. Step 2: Add beans, tomato sauce, picante sauce, cumin and salt, simmer 15 minutes. Step 3: Spoon small amount of meat mixture in 13x9 baking dish. Step 4: Top with 6 tortillas. Step 5: Top with half the remaining meat mixture. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese, repeat. Step 7: Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Step 8: Bake at 350" for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, tomato juice, onion, chili powder, salt & pepper, cheddar cheese, minute rice
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef in large skillet on md / hi & drain fat. Step 2: Add onion & cook for a couple of minutes. Step 3: Sprinkle with salt & pepper. Step 4: Stir in chili powder & mix well. Step 5: Stir in tomato juice & bring just to boil. Step 6: Once boiling add rice & reduce heat to md. Step 7: Cover & cook 10-15 minutes, until rice is tender, stirring a couple times. Step 8: Stir in 1 1 / 2 c of the cheese and remove from heat. Step 9: Sprinkle with remaining cheese and cover 1 min to melt.

Ingredient Names: bulk sausage, eggs, salsa, mexican blend cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet over medium heat, crumble and brown sausage. Step 2: Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Step 3: Return sausage and drippings to skillet. Step 4: Add beaten eggs Scramble until desired doneness. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup salsa and 1 cup of cheese. Step 6: Stir until well blended. Step 7: Spread 1 cup of salsa in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Step 8: Place 1 / 4 cup of meat mixture down the center of each tortilla, roll up.

Ingredient Names: crescent rolls, corn chips, ground beef, tomato paste, water, taco seasoning, sour cream, monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a large skillet cook ground beef until no pink in meat. Step 3: Add tomato paste and use the 6 oz Can to add 1 1 / 2 cans water, also add taco seasoning and simmer on low, uncovered for 5 minutes. Step 4: Grease pan, roll crescent rolls into 9x13 pan up the edges Seal seams It will be long one continuous piece in the pan. Step 5: Spread one cup of the crushed corn tortilla chips on top of the crescent rolls. Step 6: Then spread meat, add sour cream on top of meat, then cheese Last, spread remaining cup of chips on top.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, tomato soup, salsa, cheddar cheese, hamburger buns
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, brown the beef Add in the soup and salsa Combine well Sprinkle cheese on top Serve on buns.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, bell peppers, jalapeno peppers, onion, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder, salt and pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In crockpot add the roast, peppers, onion, garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder and salt. Step 2: Stir until well combined. Step 3: Set crockpot for 8 hours if you have a timer on low and let cook. Step 4: Serve with refried beans and rice! Step 5: If cooking on the stove, add a 28 oz can of water to start with, you may need more or not as the cooking time goes on You may have a faster cook time with this method.

Ingredient Names: meat, olive oil, lime juice, garlic clove, chili powder, cumin, hot pepper flakes, black pepper, salt, flour tortillas, onion, sweet peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Veggies are optional Toppings: salsa, sour cream, shredded cheese, chopped tomatoes. Step 2: Slice meat into thin strips In bowl, mix together 1 tablespoons olive oil, lime juice, garlic, chili powder, cumin, hot hepper flakes, black pepper and salt. Step 3: Add meat, and stir to coat the meat well. Step 4: Let sit to marinate. Step 5: Chop veggies into strips In large non stick skillet over medium high heat, heat remaining tablespoons of olive oil Throw in veggies and sautee until well done and remove from skillet. Step 6: Add meat to skillet, cook, stirring for 3-4 minutes or until they lose their red color.

Dish Name: Chicken Fried South Of The Border Sirloin Steaks
Ingredient Names: milk, steaks, olive oil, white flour, salt, ground cumin, ground red chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large flat pan, pour milk, add steaks. Step 2: Preheat oil in large frying pan. Step 3: Turn over the steaks so both sides are coated with milk. Step 4: Then drain In large flat pan or plate, add flour, salt, cumin and chili pepper. Step 5: Stir to mix Coat each steak with flour mixture both sides. Step 6: Fry medium high heat until coating is medium to yellow brown. Step 7: Turn once until both sides are nice and brown You may have to add more oil depending on the size of the steaks.

Ingredient Names: stew meat, mild enchilada sauce, beef bouillon cubes, refried beans, burrito-size flour tortillas, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put beef, bouillon, and enchilada sauce into a crock pot and cook on low for 7-8 hours, or until meat is very tender. Step 2: When beef is done, taste and add more salt, if desired. Step 3: Heat refried beans in a saucepan. Step 4: Place on tortilla about 1 / 2 cup of the meat, drained by using a slotted spoon, and a spoonful or two of beans. Step 5: Roll into a burrito. Step 6: Place in a baking dish. Step 7: Pour some of the remaining enchilada sauce from the crock pot over the burritos to cover. Step 8: Sprinkle cheddar cheese Broil until cheese is bubbly, about 2-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boiling water, beef bouillon granules, tomato sauce, dried onion flakes, garlic powder, dried ancho chile powder, cumin, cocoa powder, cider vinegar, tabasco sauce, salt and pepper, meatballs
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, stir together the boiling water and bouillon granules until dissolved. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients. Step 3: Pour all into either a crockpot and cook on high for 2 to 3 hours, or a large casserole and bake in preheated 350 degree f oven for 45 minutes Enjoy! Step 4: Serve as part of a mexican-style combination dinner of enchiladas or tamales, rice, and refried beans- the sauce goes really well with other dishes on the plate Another.

Ingredient Names: dried pinto beans, water, salt, ground beef, onions, bell pepper, black pepper, chili powder, crushed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Wash beans thoroughly and place them in a 2 qt saucepan. Step 2: Add cold water to a level of 2 to 3 inches above the beans and soak 12 to 18 hours. Step 3: Drain and discard water. Step 4: Combine beans with 5-1 / 2 c of fresh water and 2 tsp salt and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Step 6: Drain and discard water Brown ground beef, chopped onions and optional peppers in a skillet. Step 7: Drain off fat and add 3 tsp salt, pepper, chili powder, tomatoes and drained cooked beans. Step 8: Simmer 5 minutes Caution: do not thicken.

Dish Name: Chile Con Carne Rojo Sonoran Style
Ingredient Names: beef roast, red chili paste, bay leaves, onion, ground pepper, flour, shortening, garlic powder, dried oregano, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Put the cut-up beef in a dutch oven or similar large kettle, cover with water and boil with salt, pepper, garlic, onion, and 3-4 bay leaves. Step 2: Boil until meat is tender. Step 3: Remove bay leaves and throw them away, remove the meat. Step 4: Pour the liquid into another container. Step 5: Stir the chili paste into the liquid. Step 6: Melt shortening in the bottom of the kettle. Step 7: Add flour and cook until brown, stirring almost constantly. Step 8: Add 10 cups or so of the beef stock / chile mixture gradually, while stirring. Step 9: Reduce heat and add oregano, cumin, more garlic, and salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, jalapenos, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, tomatoes, cumin, chili powder, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, salt & freshly ground black pepper, ground beef, kaiser rolls, lettuce leaf, onion, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Light your grill and when it is heated brush the grate with oil. Step 2: Put the anaheims in a small bowl with olive oil and toss to coat. Step 3: Thread the jalapeos and garlic onto a metal skewer or a wooden one that has been soaked in water and grill until blackened all over. Step 4: Repeat with the anaheims using grill tongs to turn Peel and remove stems and seeds from the chilies and discard Peel garlic. Step 5: Add tomatoes to a small bowl. Step 6: Chop the chiles and garlic and add to the tomatoes. Step 7: Fold in the cheeses, sprinkle with cumin, and chili powder and season with salt and pepper, toss. Step 8: Cut eight 6"squares of wax paper.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, diced tomatoes, cheddar cheese, taco seasoning, elbow macaroni, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Cook macaroni according to directions on the macaroni box. Step 2: Drain and set aside to cool Brown ground beef and add taco seasoning. Step 3: In a large bowl add cooled elbows, ground beef, two cans of diced tomatoes. Step 4: Mix all ingredients. Step 5: Add 3 / 4 of the shredded cheese bag to bowl and mix. Step 6: Transfer ingredients to a large lasagna pan. Step 7: Add remaining cheese and put on top of the casserole. Step 8: Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbling and lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, salt, pepper, green chili peppers, cheddar cheese, eggs, milk, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet, add pepper. Step 2: Press 1 / 2 of chile on bottom of baking dish, sprinkle cheese. Step 3: Top with meat mixture and top with the rest of the chile. Step 4: Combine the eggs, flour, salt and milk, beat until smooth. Step 5: Pour mixture over chile and meat. Step 6: Bake in 350 degree oven for 45-50 minutes or until brown on top.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, pepper, onion, whole green chilies, colby-monterey jack cheese, salsa, ketchup, sandwich buns, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Shape beef into four patties. Step 2: Mix chili powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Step 3: In a skillet over medium heat, brown patties on both sides. Step 4: Top each with mixed spices and then the onion. Step 5: Reduce heat, cover, cook slowly for 5 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Step 6: Top each patty with chilies and a slice of cheese. Step 7: Cover and cook 2 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Step 8: In a small bowl, combine salsa and ketchup. Step 9: Place burgers on buns. Step 10: Serve with the salsa mixture and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, ground beef, poblano chiles, garlic cloves, ground cumin, salt, dried oregano, pepper, cayenne pepper, ro-tel tomatoes, monterey jack cheese, all-purpose flour, skim milk, egg whites
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Heat oil in 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Step 3: Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in beef, breaking up meat into small pieces, and cook until no longer pink, 8 to 10 minutes. Step 5: Using slotted spoon, transfer beef mixture to paper towellined plate. Step 6: Pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat from skillet 2. Step 7: Add poblanos and cook over medium-high heat until browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Step 8: Stir in beef mixture, garlic, cumin, teaspoon salt, oregano, teaspoon pepper, and cayenne and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, ground beef, beef stock, salt, raisins, almonds, ground cloves, ground coriander, garlic cloves, onions, poblano peppers, monterey jack cheese, eggs, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: For the chiles: Cook ground pork and ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat. Step 2: Add onions and cook until tender. Step 3: Drain fat from the meat and onions. Step 4: Add salt, raisins, almonds, cloves, coriander, and garlic. Step 5: Add enough stock to moisten. Step 6: Cook until thick Reserve remaining stock for sauce Roast chilies and remove outer skin Slit each chile down the center, just enough to remove as many seeds as possible and fill chiles with meat.

Ingredient Names: onion, ground beef, chili seasoning mix, water, kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, green chilies, sharp cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Reserve half of onion for filling. Step 2: Cook beef and remaining onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat until beef is no longer pink. Step 3: Drain and return to skillet. Step 4: Stir in seasoning mix, next 4 ingredients, and half of green chiles. Step 5: Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, 8 minutes Reserve 1 cup meat mixture. Step 6: Spoon remaining meat mixture into a 11x7 inch baking dish. Step 7: Stir together 1 1 / 2 cup cheese, reserved onion, and remaining chiles. Step 8: Spoon evenly down centers of tortillas. Step 9: Roll up tortillas.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, black pepper, ground cayenne pepper, dark red kidney beans, red kidney beans, black beans, pinto beans, chickpeas, diced tomatoes with green chilies, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with onions and garlic, drain. Step 2: Stir in chile powder, cumin, salt and peppers. Step 3: Let it simmer about 5 minutes then add all canned ingredients. Step 4: Stir well and simmer until heated through. Step 5: Serve with shredded cheese, taco chips, sour cream and / or diced peppers and onions to taste Can layer crumbled ground beef and diced veggies with spices, canned beans, tomatoes and tomato sauce in crock pot. Step 6: Cook on low for 8 hours Makes great leftovers, if you have any left! Step 7: My husband, sons, daughter and grandsons can make this disappear in one meal!

Ingredient Names: ground beef, wolf brand chili, shredded cheddar cheese, velveeta cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Brown ground beef drain put back in pan. Step 2: Add about 3 / 4 can of chili to ground beef. Step 3: Add i little bit of water to the 1 / 4 chili thats left in the can and stir should be a little runny put aside. Step 4: Add cubed velveeta to ground beef and chili. Step 5: Add about 1 cup of shredded cheese to ground beef, chili and velveeta. Step 6: Heat mix in large skillet on medium until all the cheese is melted. Step 7: Grease lightly a 9 x 13 casserole pan. Step 8: Spoon meat chili cheese mix into tortillas. Step 9: Roll them up and place in casserole dish.

Ingredient Names: ground chuck, spicy bulk sausage, green onion, worcestershire sauce, velveeta cheese, rotel tomatoes, garlic powder, chili powder, cumin, cilantro, white wine vinegar, cream of mushroom soup, simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion
Instructions: Step 1: Brown sausage and ground chuck in skillet, drain well. Step 2: Place meat and all other ingredients into crockpot and cook until cheese is melted and bubbly. Step 3: Stir occasionally Super easy!

Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck roast, boneless pork butt, olive oil, onion, garlic clove, chili powder, ground cumin, bay leaf, salt, tomato puree, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork and beef into strips about 1 / 8 inch thick by 1 / 2 inch wide, trimming away excess fat. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add enough meat to cover the bottom of the pot. Step 4: Cook until browned, about 4 minutes. Step 5: Transfer to a bowl, and continue with another batch of raw meat until all is cooked. Step 6: Return all of the meat to the pot and add all the remaining ingredients. Step 7: Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat for 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 8: Serve rolled in warmed tortillas, with sour cream and salsa.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green pepper, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, pinto beans, chili powder, cumin, beef bouillon, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with onion and green pepper in large skillet or saucepan. Step 2: Drain To beef mixture add tomatoes, tomato sauce, pinto beans and seasonings. Step 3: Simmer, covered, 1 hour. Step 4: Serve with shredded cheese, sour cream, green onions.

Dish Name: Chili Con Carne Casa Rio Recipe
Ingredient Names: pork, beef, jalapenos, fresh garlic, salt, ground cumin, ancho chilies, black pepper, chili powder, masa corn flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: Deseed and clean ancho chili pods. Step 2: Soak for 1 hour in hot water. Step 3: Drain and grind Reserve. Step 4: Place pork and beef cubes into a large stock pot. Step 5: Fill with water to cover meat. Step 6: Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Step 7: Add jalapeos, garlic, salt, cumin, ancho chili pod paste and pepper, bring to a boil. Step 8: Reduce to a simmer and cook until meat is done.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green pepper, tomatoes, tomato sauce, salt, chili powder, cayenne powder, paprika, kidney beans
Instructions: Step 1: In an 8" skillet cook and stir meat, onion and green pepper until meat is brown and onion is tender. Step 2: Drain off fat and stir in remaining ingredients except beans. Step 3: Heat to boiling, reduce heat and cook uncovered for about 30 minutes. Step 4: Stir in beans and stir until bubbly.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, quick-cooking rolled oats, no-bean chili, egg, scallion, salt, fresh ground black pepper, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, oats, 2 / 3 cup chili, egg, 1 / 4 cup scallions, salt and pepper. Step 3: Mix lightly but thoroughly then press the mixture evenly into a 9-inch round metal cake pan. Step 4: Bake for 45-50 minutes or until center of meatloaf registers 160 on an instant-read thermometer. Step 5: Remove from oven and set aside. Step 6: Place remaining chili in a microwave-safe bowl. Step 7: Cover and heat on high for 1-2 minutes. Step 8: Drain any juices from meatloaf and discard. Step 9: Top drained meatloaf with hot chili. Step 10: Sprinkle with cheese.

Dish Name: Chili Con Carne With Chili Cheddar Shortcakes
Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, double-acting baking powder, baking soda, salt, butter, cheddar cheese, jalapenos, sour cream, onions, vegetable oil, garlic, carrots, lean ground beef, chili powder, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Make biscuits: into a bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and the salt. Step 2: Add the butter and blend the mixture until it resembles coarse meal. Step 3: Stir in the cheddar and the chilies. Step 4: Add the sour cream and stir the mixture until it just forms a soft, but not sticky, dough. Step 5: Knead the dough gently for 20 seconds on a lightly-floured surface. Step 6: Roll or pat it out inch thick and with a 3 inch cookie cutter, cut out 8 rounds. Step 7: Bake on an ungreased baking sheet in the middle of a preheated 430f oven for 15-17 minutes, or until they are golden. Step 8: Make the chili con carne: in a saucepan, cook the onions in the oil over moderately-low heat, stirring occasionally, until they are softened. Step 9: Add the garlic and the carrots and cook the mixture, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 10: Add beef and cook over moderate heat, stirring and breaking up any lumps, for 10 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper, tomato soup, chili con carne, chili powder, fritos corn chips, cheese, black olives, green onion, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with onion and green pepper. Step 2: Season to taste with salt and pepper, drain fat. Step 3: Stir in soup, chili and chili powder Dump half the chips into a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Step 4: Top evenly with half the chili mixture, then half of the shredded cheese. Step 5: Repeat the layers with the remaining chips, chili and cheese. Step 6: Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Step 7: Remove from oven and top with olives and green onion slices. Step 8: Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

Ingredient Names: lasagna noodles, lean ground chuck, onion, green pepper, ground cumin, chili powder, salt, pepper, enchilada sauce, egg, ricotta cheese, monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles according to pkg directions, drain. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 Crumble beef into nonstick skillet. Step 3: Add onion, gr pepper, 1 / 2 tsp cumin, 1 / 2 tsp chili pwdr, 1 / 2 tsp salt & pepper. Step 4: Cook, stirring until beef is browned, drain. Step 5: Stir in 3 / 4 cup enchilada sauce. Step 6: Remove from heat In bowl lightly beat egg. Step 7: Stir in ricotta, 1 / 2 cup shredded cheese, remaining cumin, chili pwdr and salt.

Ingredient Names: penne pasta, ground beef, onion, chili powder, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, salsa, diced green chilies, mexican cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta & drain 2. Step 2: Cook meat and onion in a large skillet, drain 3. Step 3: Add chili powder, undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, salsa and chilies, cook 5 minutes 4. Step 4: Toss pasta and sauce. Step 5: Spoon into 13 x 9 inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: chili, saltine crackers, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In an ungreased pie plate place thin layer of crackers, chili, and cheese. Step 2: Repeat layers until all ingredients are used ending with cheese on top. Step 3: Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Step 4: Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes. Step 5: Then slice as you would a pie.

Ingredient Names: pork, beef, green bell pepper, garlic cloves, crushed tomatoes, green chilies, fresh parsley, sugar, ground cumin, whole cloves, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in crock pot Stir to combine Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours Taste for seasoning before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, chili powder, ground cumin, salt and pepper, green chilies, corn tortilla, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onions, meat, and garlic until onions are clear, drain any fat. Step 2: Add tomatoes, spices, salt and pepper and simmer 30 minutes, add diced chilies. Step 3: Cut tortillas into fourths. Step 4: In a 13x9x2-inch pan, layer half of tortillas, overlapping to cover the bottom of pan. Step 5: Cover with half the meat sauce. Step 6: Sprinkle with half the cheese. Step 7: Repeat layers, beginning with tortillas and ending with cheese. Step 8: Bake at 350f about 30-45 minutes, or until bubbling and cheese has melted and started to turn golden.

Dish Name: Chilli Con Carne 21 Day Wonder Diet Day 2
Ingredient Names: brown rice, cooking spray, brown onion, garlic clove, ground beef, ground cumin, dried chili pepper flakes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, beef stock, four-bean mix, yogurt, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in medium saucepan of boiling water until tender, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, spray medium frying pan with cooking oil. Step 3: Cook onion and garlic over heat, stirring, until onon softens. Step 4: Add beef and spices. Step 5: Cook, stirring, until beef is browned. Step 6: Add undrained tomatoes, paste and stock, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 7: Simmer, covered, 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chipotle hot sauce, blue cheese, cooked bacon, hamburger buns, lettuce, tomatoes, pickle
Instructions: Step 1: Grill patties to desired doneness Just before removing from grill brush all sides with chipotle sauce. Step 2: Top with bleu cheese Assemble burgers using buns, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and pickles.

Dish Name: Chipotle Burger Topped With Grilled Onions And Cheese
Ingredient Names: chipotle chile in adobo, ground beef, salsa, olive oil, sweet onion, monterey jack cheese, kaiser rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat grill on high for 10 minute mix peppers, 2 ounces salsa, and beef together then formed into four 1 / 2 inch thick burgers Rub outside of patties with oil Coat grill lightly with vegetable oil. Step 2: Brush onion slices with olive oil and season with salt & pepper, sear on grill 1-2 min each side, remove and set aside. Step 3: Grill rolls, cut side down 30 seconds. Step 4: Remove and set aside Sear meat on grill, about 2 min, until meat has changed color about one-quarter way up from bottom. Step 5: Turn over Sear 1 to 3 minute. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium or low.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, black olives, green chili peppers, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chipotle chiles in adobo, beef broth, chili powder, cumin, white vinegar, flour tortillas, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat, saute the ground beef for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the onion and garlic and saute until the ground beef is cooked While ground beef is cooking, puree the chipotle peppers until smooth. Step 4: Add a bit of water to the chipotles if necessary. Step 5: Drain off any excess fat from the ground beef. Step 6: Mix in the tomato paste with the ground beef Continue cooking about 5 minutes being careful not to burn the mixture. Step 7: Add beef broth, diced tomatoes, olives, green chilies, chipotle peppers, chili powder, cumin and vinegar. Step 8: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Chipotle Carne Guisada Beef Stew Meat Braised W Chipotle
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onions, green bell pepper, fresh cilantro, cooking oil, beef, cumin, black pepper, salt, bouillon, chipotle chiles in adobo, chipotle pepper, achiote, water
Instructions: Step 1: Season the beef stew meat with the cumin, salt and pepper, set aside. Step 2: In a large frying pan, heat oil and add the onions, bell pepper and tomatoes on medium high heat. Step 3: Saute for about 5-7 mins or until translucent. Step 4: Add the seasoned meat and brown for about 7-10 minutes. Step 5: Add 2 cups of hot water to the pan. Step 6: Add the bullion, chipotle sauce / pepper sazon goya and stir. Step 7: Cover and cook on medium high heat for about 45 mins or until most of the liquid is absorbed then uncover and add 1 more cup of water. Step 8: Cover and simmer for another 30 mins or until liquid is almost absorbed. Step 9: Uncover and add another 1 cup of water and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, chipotle chiles in adobo, tomato sauce, garlic cloves, onion, chili powder, salt, flour tortillas, salsa, sour cream, avocado, tomatoes, lettuce, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet to medium high Brown the beef in the skillet for a minute, then add the garlic and onion. Step 2: Once the meat is no longer pink, drain. Step 3: Add the chili powder, chipotles, tomato sauce, and salt. Step 4: Heat over medium until ready to serve on warm tortillas or taco shells with desired toppings.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, marinade, chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic, cilantro, olive oil, red wine, soy sauce, honey, balsamic vinegar, dijon-style mustard, fresh lime juice, allspice, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade flank steak for 4 hours or overnight. Step 2: Remove from marinade and pat dry. Step 3: Grill on bbq until just medium rare. Step 4: Grill time will depend on the size of flank steak. Step 5: Cover loosely with aluminum foil for 7-10 minutes. Step 6: Slice the meat against the grain in about 1 / 4 inch thick slices or as thin as you can reasonably get At last minute pour some of the dipping sauce over the cut up flank steak and serve. Step 7: Put the left over dipping sauce on the table for everyone to enjoy Goes great with grilled corn on the cob and white sticky rice Try pouring a little of the dipping sauce on the rice.

Dish Name: Chipotle Meatballs El Naranjo Restaurant Oaxaca Mexico
Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, white onion, garlic cloves, canned chipotle chiles, ground cloves, vegetable oil, ground beef, ground pork, fresh breadcrumb, egg, dried mexican oregano, salt, fresh ground black pepper, capers
Instructions: Step 1: Puree first 5 ingredients in blender in batches until almost smooth. Step 2: Heat oil in heavy large pot over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add tomato mixture. Step 4: Cover and boil 10 minutes to blend flavors and thicken slightly, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper. Step 6: Combine ground beef and next 6 ingredients in large bowl. Step 7: Add 1 / 2 cup cooled tomato sauce and stir until well mixed. Step 8: Using hands, form 1 rounded tablespoonful meat mixture into ball Optional: insert 1 / 4 t Capers into center of meat.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, salt, pepper, chili powder, cumin, chipotle chiles in adobo, green chilies, salsa verde, onion, garlic, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Place chuck roast in large crock pot and sprinkle with the salt and pepper, chili powder and cumin. Step 2: Add the remaining ingredients and simmer on high for 5 hours or on low for 7-8 hours Shred the meat with a fork and simmer on high for additional 10-15 minutes. Step 3: Serve in enchiladas, tacos or on crusty rolls with the juice for dipping.

Ingredient Names: apple cider vinegar, minced garlic cloves, cumin, oregano, ground black pepper, salt, ground cloves, vegetable oil, chicken broth, bay leaves, lime juice, chipotle chiles in adobo, chuck roast
Instructions: Step 1: To make the adobo sauce combine vinegar, limejuice, chipotles, garlic, cumin, oregano, black pepper, salt and cloves in a blender or processor on high speed until smooth. Step 2: Remove most of the fat from the roast and then cut into large chunks. Step 3: Pour oil into a frying pan and sear all sides of roast on medium-high heat until browned. Step 4: Place meat into crockpot and pour adobo sauce over meat. Step 5: Pour in the chicken broth and add bay leaves. Step 6: Cook on high heat 6 hours or on low all day While still in the crockpot, shred the meat with two forks and turn the heat to warm. Step 7: Serve with hard or soft tortilla shells when ready Typical sides include tortillas, rice, black or pinto beans, cheese, pico de gallo, guacamole, and sour cream Dont forget to make my 5 minute guacamole to go with it.

Dish Name: Chipotle Shredded Beef For Tacos Or Burritos
Ingredient Names: olive oil, beef chuck, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, beef stock, tomato paste, chipotle chile in adobo, onion, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Meanwhile, combine the chili powder, cumin Smoked paprika and salt in a small bowl Rub the spice mix into the beef, covering each side evenly. Step 3: Once the oil is hot, place the beef in the skillet and sear on each side Do not move the meat while it cooks for 2-3 minutes on each side. Step 4: Remove the beef from the skillet and place in the bottom of a slow cooker. Step 5: Leave the pan on the heat and add in the beef stock to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
