Step 6: Add the tomato paste and minced chipotle and whisk into the pan sauce. Step 7: Bring the sauce to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce has reduced and thickened slightly.

Ingredient Names: skirt steaks, onion, garlic cloves, cumin, coriander, salt, pepper, cilantro, chipotle pepper, adobo sauce, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Puree a single chipotle pepper + 2 tsp of the adobo sauce with the onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt and pepper. Step 2: Taste and add more chipotle if needed. Step 3: Stir in the cilantro Throw it all in a zip lock bag with the skirt steak for at least 2 hours, grill medium-rare. Step 4: Cut the skirt steak into thin strips across the grain. Step 5: Serve with taco accompaniments This melts the cheese oh-so-perfectly and chars the tortilla edges just a tiny bit for that crunch Heating it also takes away some of the "rawness" that corn tortillas have when they are straight out of the bag.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, diced green chilies, taco seasoning mix, lean ground beef, diced tomatoes, cinnamon, water, thick & chunky salsa, semi-sweet chocolate chips, slivered almonds, pinto beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cook and stir until onions are tender, just about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add chiles, taco seasoning mix and ground beef. Step 5: Cook beef, stirring often, about 5 minutes or until browned. Step 6: Add tomatoes, cinnamon, water, salsa, chocolate chips and almonds, stir to combine, bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes. Step 8: Stir every 10-15 minutes to combine the flavors.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat tortillas, goat cheese, chorizo sausage, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Brown and break up chorizo in skillet on medium heat. Step 2: Drain, set aside, and wipe out skillet for the quesadillas Use 1 / 2 tablespoon of oil for each quesadilla. Step 3: Heat 1 / 2 tablespoon of oil in skillet to medium or medium-high, depending on your burner. Step 4: When the oil is glistening, it's ready Don't wait until it smokes. Step 5: Place a tortilla in the oil. Step 6: Spread half with softened goat cheese and sprinkle chorizo to your liking and fold in half. Step 7: Let brown for a minute or so, peeking often so as to not burn it Carefully flip it over and brown the other side.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, hot dog buns, mexican blend cheese, salsa, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare your sausages grilled, baked, broiled, on your outdoor grill, or pan-fried A 1 lb package will contain 5 sausages I cooked mine with the onion slices on my george foreman indoor grill Warm up the grill for 5 minutes with the onions inside Always spray your indoor grill with pam prior to the warm-up period. Step 2: Line the sausages up across the grates so you get grill marks on them Close the grill and set your timer for 5 minutes While the sausages are cooking, spread your hot dogs bun, sprinkle a layer of shredded cheese inside, then insert them in your toaster oven until the cheese is slightly melted. Step 3: Insert your cooked chorizo chihuahua dogs into each bun on top of the bed of melted cheese. Step 4: Top with your sliced onions and 2 tablespoons or more of your favorite salsa.

Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, water, garlic cloves, green chilies, chili powder, vinegar, dried oregano, salt, pepper, cumin, flour tortillas, green chili sauce, lettuce, sour cream, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Combine meat, water, garlic, chilies, chili powder, vinegar, oregano, salt, cumin and pepper in a medium saucepan, bring to boil. Step 2: Cover and reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours or until meat is very tender. Step 3: Uncover and boil rapidly for about 15 minutes or until water is almost evaporated Watch closely and stir near end of cooking time so meat doesn't stick, remove from heat. Step 4: Using 2 forks, shred meat very fine. Step 5: Add a little of the green chili sauce to moisten if necessary Warm tortillas wrapped in foil in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes. Step 6: Spoon about 1 / 4 cup meat mixture onto each tortilla, near one edge.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, tomato soup, water, tomato paste, red kidney beans, balsamic vinegar, dry chili pepper, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In medium skillet over medium-high heat, brown beef and onion, stirring to separate meat, spoon off fat. Step 2: Add soup, water, beans, vinegar and chilies. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and heat through Last half hour add tomato paste and heat.

Ingredient Names: butter, green bell pepper, garlic clove, jalapeno, lean ground beef, fiesta nacho cheese soup, diced tomatoes with lime and cilantro, ground coriander, ground red pepper, white vinegar, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet. Step 2: Melt the butter on medium heat and then saute the bell pepper, garlic, and jalapeno until soft. Step 3: Add the beef and cook it until no longer pink, in a medium bowl. Step 4: Mix the soup, ro-tel, coriander, cayenne, vinegar, and brown sugar. Step 5: Drain any fat from the beef. Step 6: Pour soup mix into beef and mix well. Step 7: Cook for about 5 more minutes until heated through and bubbly. Step 8: Serve on buns and garnish with lime and avocado.

Ingredient Names: garlic powder, black pepper, dried mexican oregano, chile powder, kosher salt, beef chuck with bone
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the spices. Step 2: Rinse and dry the chuck roast and rub with the blended spices. Step 3: Prepare the smoker with lighted charcoal. Step 4: Add a small amount of hickory or desired smoke wood. Step 5: Heat smoker to 250f-300f. Step 6: Place the roast on the smoker. Step 7: Once the internal temperature is 160 f, wrap the roast in heavy duty aluminum foil. Step 8: Cook for a couple of more hours or until the meat internal temperature is about 200f Pull the roast, drain liquid, rewrap and let it rest for 30 minutes. Step 9: Using forks, pull the meat apart into shreds.

Dish Name: Coffee And Spice Smoked Tri Tip
Ingredient Names: tri-tip steak, coarse salt, coffee beans, dried ancho chile powder, crushed red pepper flakes, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, maple syrup, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the rub: place the ingredients in a heated heavy skillet Shake together and allow to toast for 1 minute or until mixture begins to release a strong aroma. Step 2: Pour into a spice or coffee grinder and grind to a coarse powder Rub the tri- Place meat in a sealable plastic bag, seal and place in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight. Step 3: Remove the meat from the plastic bag and place on rack of smoker that has been preheated to 225deg. Step 4: Combine the maple syrup and hot sauce Begin basting every 1 / 2 hour after the first hour Smoke the tri- For medium-rare.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, lean ground beef, garlic, canola oil, cooking onion, mushrooms, salt, fresh ground black pepper, ground cumin, dried oregano, cayenne pepper, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Peel broccoli stems and cube, set aside. Step 2: In a large pot, place undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, and sugar, stir to combine. Step 3: In a large skillet, begin to brown the ground beef As meat starts to release its fat, add fresh garlic to pan and stir well. Step 4: Saute until meat is browned. Step 5: Add to tomatoes, leaving fat behind in pan In same skillet, over medium heat, add oil to pan and heat. Step 6: Add onions and saute until softened.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lime rind, lime juice, worcestershire sauce, ground cumin, salt, dried oregano, fresh coarse ground black pepper, garlic cloves, low sodium beef broth, flank steak, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, sweet onion, fat free tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare marinade, combine first 10 ingredients in a large bowl. Step 2: Set aside To prepare fajitas, trim fat from steak and cut against the grain into strips. Step 3: Combine 1 1 / 2 cups marinade and steak in a large zip-top plastic bag Seal and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight, turning occasionally. Step 4: Combine remaining marinade, bell peppers, and onion in a zip-top plastic bag Seal and marinate in refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight, turning occasionally, prepare grill. Step 5: Remove steak from bag, discard marinade.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, water, taco seasoning mix, whole wheat pita bread, reduced-fat cream cheese, nonfat sour cream, salsa, lettuce, tomatoes, reduced-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: In a medium skillet, brown ground beef over medium heat until no longer pink. Step 3: Drain off excess fat. Step 4: Add water and 1 tsp taco seasoning to the beef and simmer for 3 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Step 6: Cut each pita into 8 wedges and place on baking sheet. Step 7: Bake for about 7 minutes or until lightly browned While the beef is cooling, combine the remaining taco seasoning, cream cheese, sour cream and salsa in a small bowl, mix well. Step 8: Divide and spread this mixture evenly on 2 small plates.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, olive oil, onion, green bell pepper, potatoes, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, water, dried oregano, epazote leaves, sugar, cumin, cayenne powder, dried ancho chile powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the water, onions, garlic, bell peppers and potatoes in a stew pot and bring to a boil. Step 2: Turn the temperature to low, cover the pot, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes, bran, and spices to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes While the potatoes are cooking, heat a skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil and brown the meat, crumbling it up as it cooks. Step 4: Add the meat to the stew pot, cover, and simmer 10 to 20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.

Dish Name: Corn Tortilla Casserole Inspired By Zaar Chefs
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, margarine, lean ground beef, chili powder, cheese, chopped tomatoes, lowfat refried beans, picante sauce, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Also, the cheese i used was a prepackaged shredded mix called"casserole mix" It's a mixture of cheddar, colby and monterey jack Feel free to spice this up as you please I deliberately kept this lowkey and mild to please my husband, who would not have liked it if i had added the"firepower" i would have liked to add Also. Step 2: Preheat oven to 325f Have ready an ungreased 13x9 pan. Step 3: Take 1 tortilla, lightly spread a bit of margarine on both sides, and place on a microwave-safe plate I used a small piece of wax paper wadded up into a ball to do the spreading. Step 4: Place the next tortilla on top, lightly spread margarine on it, get the next tortilla, repeat process, and so on and so on, until you have a stack of 18 tortillas.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, enchilada sauce, corn tortillas, ground beef, salt and pepper, paprika, onion salt, cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Brown ground beef and drain. Step 2: Mix in 1 cup salsa. Step 3: Mix in 1 / 2 can of enchilada sauce. Step 4: Season with salt, pepper, onion salt and paprika. Step 5: In a 9x12-inch pan spray bottom with cooking spray. Step 6: Pour 1 / 2 can of enchilada sauce on bottom of pan. Step 7: Make sure bottom is covered in sauce. Step 8: Layer 6 corn tortillas to cover bottom. Step 9: Spoon beef mixture over tortillas.

Ingredient Names: corned beef, green cabbage, onion, carrots, celery, potatoes, au jus mix, season-all salt, ketchup, pepper, garlic powder, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients to crock pot, except potatoes, stir well. Step 2: Cook on high for one hour, turn to low for another 3-4 hours. Step 3: Add potatoes, cook until tender Usually another hour and half You may need to adjust time, depending on crock pot.

Ingredient Names: frozen dinner rolls, ground beef, taco seasoning mix, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place frozen rolls on a greased cookie sheet. Step 2: Let rise until nearly double In the meantime, brown the ground beef, drain, add taco mix and 1 / 4 cup water. Step 3: Heat about 2" cooking oil in skillet or frying pan Stretch the dough quite thin, fry until golden brown, turning once. Step 4: Drain on paper towel. Step 5: Top each taco with seasoned meat mixture, layer with lettuce, tomatoes and cheese You may garnish with black olives, taco sauce and sour cream.

Dish Name: Cowboy This N That Hearty Soup
Ingredient Names: ground beef, tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, salsa con queso, baked beans, corn, taco seasoning, sour cream, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Dump everything but the optional ingredients into a large stockpot or crockpot. Step 2: Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 30 minutes If cooking in crockpot, cook on high four hours or low for eight hours. Step 3: Once bubbly hot, serve. Step 4: Garnish with dollops of sour cream and shredded cheese, if you prefer For freezing or oamc: pour soup into large gallon size freezer bagor other freezer containers. Step 5: Remove as much air as possible, seal and freeze flat Reheat slowly in crockpot or stovetop, adding 1 / 4 water at the beginning.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning mix, salsa, cream cheese, taco shells, lettuce, chopped tomato, green onion, sour cream, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, drain. Step 2: Stir salsa and cream cheese and mix well on medium heat. Step 3: Add 3 teaspoons of taco seasoning - the kind you buy in the packets at the grocery store. Step 4: Simmer on low until mixture has thickened a bit. Step 5: Fill warmed taco shells with beef mixture. Step 6: Top with lettuce, tomato, green onions and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, yellow onion, taco seasoning, flour tortillas, refried beans, taco cheese, cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground meat / turkey & onion, drain. Step 2: Add taco seasoning and stir in refried beans. Step 3: Mix soup and sour cream in a separate bowl. Step 4: Spread 1 / 2 sour cream mixture in the bottom of a casserole dish Tear up 3 tortillas and spread over sour cream mixture. Step 5: Put 1 / 2 the meat bean mixture over that. Step 6: Add a layer of cheese You could put some hot sauce on this now. Step 7: Repeat the layers.

Ingredient Names: enchilada sauce, corn tortillas, green onion, lean ground beef, cream cheese, salsa, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, garlic powder, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook ground beef in skillet until meat is no longer pink- drain. Step 2: Mix in salsa, cream cheese, 3 / 4 cup of each cheese and garlic powder& pepper - set aside. Step 3: Pour 2 cans enchilada sauce into large rectangular baking dish. Step 4: Dip each tortilla in sauce, fill with beef mixture, roll up and place seam side down in the baking dish. Step 5: Top with remaining enchilada sauce, cheese, and green onion. Step 6: Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until tender.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, oil, garlic clove, beans, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, chili, cumin, cinnamon, polenta, boiling water, evaporated milk, egg, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius Brown the beef with the oil and garlic. Step 2: Add the next six ingredients, stir until the mixture boils, then simmer for 15 minutes. Step 3: Spoon the mixture into four 1 cup ovenproof bowls. Step 4: Combine the polenta with the boiling water in a large bowl, add the remaining ingredients, beat to combine and allow to stand for 10 minutes. Step 5: Spoon the mixture evenly over the beef and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown and set.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, paprika, ground cumin, salt, black pepper, cornstarch, water, salt and pepper, sour cream, condensed cream of chicken soup, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the ground beef, until the beef browned While beef is browning, mix together in a small bowl, the chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, paprika, cumin, salt pepper and cornstarch. Step 3: After beef is browned, sprinkle the seasoning mix over the beef and mix well. Step 4: Stir in water and simmer until water has evaporated, about 10 minutes. Step 5: In a medium bowl, mix together sour cream, cream of chicken soup, green chilies and cheese. Step 6: Mix about half of the cheese mixture with the ground beef. Step 7: Divide the meat mixture evenly between tortillas and roll up. Step 8: Place in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Step 9: Repeat for each tortilla.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, taco seasoning mix, water, onion, garlic, taco sauce, cream cheese, corn kernels, olives, fritos corn chips, mexican blend cheese, tomatoes, green onion, sour cream, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the ground beef with the onions and garlic. Step 2: When all the pink is out of the meat add the seasoning mix, water, cream cheese, corn, 1 / 2 the olives and taco sauce. Step 3: Let this simmer for 3 to 4 minutes Crush the fritos chips In an 8x12 casserole dish, layer 1 / 2 of the fritos, then 1 / 2 the meat filling, and then 1 / 2 the cheese. Step 4: Repeat the layers and top with the remaining olives. Step 5: Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes, or until it is warmed completely and the cheese is melted To serve, you can top with shredded lettuce, the diced green onions, diced tomatoes and a shot of the sour cream.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Beef Chili With Chili Creme Fraiche
Ingredient Names: chuck steaks, streaky bacon, onion, garlic cloves, celery ribs, red chilies, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, red kidney beans, oregano leaves, ground cumin, ground coriander, fennel seed, paprika, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add the frying oil to a large pan & fry the ground beef in batches until brown adding each batch as brown to the crock pot. Step 2: Add the streaky bacon to the pan & fry until golden With a slotted spoon remove to the crock pot reserving the bacon fat. Step 3: Add the onions, garlic, celery, chilies and bay leaf to the pan & fry in the bacon fat for 2 or 3 minutes then add the herbs & spices except the cinnamon & black pepper. Step 4: Fry until softened, add to the crock pot. Step 5: Add to the crock pot the tomatoes, beef stock, tomato paste, cinnamon, cocoa powder & black pepper. Step 6: Cover & cook on low setting for 8-10 hours 30 minutes before the end of cooking, stir in the kidney beans. Step 7: Fold in the chopped coriander just before serving. Step 8: Serve with white rice, baked potatoes or both & drizzle over the chili creme fraiche & if you wish a few chopped red onions.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, condensed tomato soup, water, tomatoes and green chilies, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, green onions, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef in 2 batches in large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring to separate meat, pour off fat. Step 2: Mix beef, soup, water, tomatoes and tortillas in a 3 1 / 2- to 5-quart crock pot. Step 3: Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours, stir in cheese. Step 4: Cover and cook 5 more minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle with green onions and serve with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: rump roast, minced garlic cloves, fresh jalapenos, onion, beef stock, tomato paste, salt, cumin, chili powder, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Method 1: if using rump roast, simply place all ingredients into crock pot. Step 2: Whisk corn starch in with a bit of beef stock before adding to the pot. Step 3: Cook on low for 6-7 hours For best results, stir all ingredients about 1-2 hours into cooking Method 2: if using chuck roast, brown both sides of the roast in a pot before putting it in the crock pot My new favorite thing to do is to completely omit the crock pot I brown the chuck roast in a dutch oven, then add remaining ingredients and cook it in a 300 degree oven for about 4 hours, or until the meat is so tender that it pulls apart easily with a fork The tenderness of method 2 is absolutely mouth-watering! Step 4: If using a chuck roast, don't forget to pick out all the pieces of fat before serving You wouldn't want to bite into a piece of that!

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, garlic salt, pepper, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Season roast to taste. Step 2: Place seasoned roast in crock pot. Step 3: Pour salsa over roast and cook on high for 4-6 hours or on low for 8-10 hours, until you can shred meat with a fork If you want a crisper meat, you can place the shredded meat on a cookie sheet and bake at 450 degrees for about 15 to 20 minutes, until it gets crispy around the edges.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil cooking spray, lean hamburger, onion, sweet green pepper, sweet red pepper, jalapeno peppers, garlic cloves, taco sauce, salsa, mushroom, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, green onion, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a large skillet lightly with veggie oil Brown the hamburger, make sure there are no lumps. Step 2: Add onions, garlic, mushrooms, saute until the onions are translucent. Step 3: Add peppers cook 3 minutes. Step 4: Mix the taco& salsa sauces. Step 5: Remove from heat and add 3 / 4 cup taco / salsa sauce Lay out the tortillas and spoon approx 3 / 4 cup of the meat mixture into the middle of each tortilla. Step 6: Sprinkle with a tbsp of cheese. Step 7: Roll the tortillas and fasten with a tooth pick. Step 8: Put 1 cup of the taco sauce on the bottom of your crock pot.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Green Chile Burrito Taco Filling
Ingredient Names: rump roast, onion, taco seasoning mix, dried oregano leaves, garlic powder, diced green chilies, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Layer ingredients, meat first, in crock pot. Step 2: Cook on low for 8-10 hours Do not stir for first 5 hours Shred meat after 7 hours. Step 3: Serve on flour or corn tortillas. Step 4: Top with sour cream, if desired.

Ingredient Names: beef roast, green chili salsa, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place roast in crock pot. Step 2: Pour green chili salsa over it, add cilantro. Step 3: Place lid on crock pot and cook on low 7-9 hours Shred meat and stir into sauce Use in burritos, or on nachos. Step 4: Serve with sour cream, cheese, guacamole.

Ingredient Names: tripe, beef stew meat, hominy, red chili powder, oregano, onion flakes, coriander seed, cumin, red chili pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Add tripe, stew meat, hominy, spices together in crock pot Cover with water or beef stock Cook on low setting for 6-8 hours.

Ingredient Names: boneless round steak, garlic clove, pepper, salt, chili powder, prepared mustard, onion, beef bouillon granules, tomatoes and green chilies, kidney beans
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together garlic, pepper, salt, chili powder and mustard Rub on one side of round steak. Step 2: Cut round steak into strips. Step 3: Place in bottom of crock pot. Step 4: Cover with onion, bouillon granules and tomatoes. Step 5: Cook on low for 6-8 hours. Step 6: Turn crock pot to high for the last half hour of cooking and add beans, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: extra lean ground beef, onion, green bell pepper, kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, taco seasoning, chili powder, instant rice, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and onion in nonstick skillet. Step 2: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker, except rice and cheese. Step 3: Cook on low for 4-8 hours. Step 4: Stir in rice, cover, and cook until tender. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 6: Cover and cook until cheese is melted.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Mexican Chili Con Carne
Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, garlic cloves, celery, onions, chili powder, dried oregano, cayenne pepper, diced tomatoes with juice, red kidney beans, cocoa powder, brown sugar, cloves, white vinegar, black pepper, green pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat combine ground beef, garlic, celery and onions. Step 2: Cook until vegetables are tender and meat is no longer pink. Step 3: Add chilli powder, oregano, an cayenne. Step 4: Cook 1 minute longer With a slotted spoon, transfer mixture to slow cooker. Step 5: Add tomatoes kidney beans, cocoa, sugar, cloves, vinegar and pepper, stir to combine. Step 6: Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours until hot and bubbling. Step 7: Add green pepper and stir to combine. Step 8: Cover and cook 20-25 minutes longer. Step 9: Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, ground cumin, dry oregano, red pepper flakes, paprika, tomatoes, chili pepper, onion, garlic clove, water, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Remove as much fat as possible from roast. Step 2: Place roast in crock pot and cover with remainder of ingredients except tortillas. Step 3: Cook on low for 8-10 hours With fork shred roast and stir well with other ingredients in crock pot. Step 4: Drain meat mixture well and serve in flour tortillas with your favorite toppings Enjoy.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Shredded Beef For Chimichangas
Ingredient Names: boneless beef chuck roast, diced onion, beef broth, diced tomatoes with lime and cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat, diced onions, rotel and beef broth in crock pot. Step 2: Cook on low for 6-8 hours. Step 3: When meat is cook, shred it If continuing on to make chimichangas, follow recipe #28148 Enjoy!

Dish Name: Crock Pot Slow Cooker Enchilada Casserole
Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic clove, salt, pepper, corn tortillas, fresh corn, enchilada sauce, cheddar cheese, sliced ripe olives, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and drain. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cook over medium heat until tender and transparent. Step 4: Add salt and pepper. Step 5: Place 2 tortillas in bottom of crockpot. Step 6: Place a third of the following in layers over the tortillas: meat, corn, sauce, cheese and olives. Step 7: Repeat tortillas and other layers two times. Step 8: Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours serve with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic, chili beans, dark red kidney beans, corn, taco seasoning mix, salsa, diced tomatoes with jalapenos, juice, beef broth, cumin, chickpeas, refried beans, ranch dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Cook, meat, onions and garlic and drain. Step 2: Add all ingredients to crock pot, stir. Step 3: Cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4 hours. Step 4: Keep on low or warm until serving to keep hot I add the following garnishes: Sour cream Shredded cheese Chopped green onions Tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: boneless sirloin, vegetable oil, lemon juice, garlic clove, ground cumin, seasoning salt, chili powder, green bell pepper, onion, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, salsa, guacamole, sour cream, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the steak in oil. Step 2: Place the steak and drippings into the crock pot. Step 3: Add lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt, and chili powder, mix well. Step 4: Cover and cook on high for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours, or until meat is tender. Step 5: Add green pepper and onion. Step 6: Cover and cook for 1 hour more Warm the tortillas. Step 7: Spoon beef and veggies down the center of the tortillas. Step 8: Top each with cheese, salsa, sour cream, lettuce, and tomatoes if desired.

Ingredient Names: beef stew meat, taco seasoning, diced tomatoes, green chilies, tomato sauce, beef bouillon cube, canned red kidney beans, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Roll beef pieces in the taco seasoning. Step 2: Place beef in crock pot. Step 3: Combine remaining ingredients except beans and cheese and pour over beef cubes. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours Fifteen minutes before serving, stir in beans. Step 5: Cover and heat through, Top individual servings with cheddar cheese, if desired.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, refried beans, cheez whiz, green chilies, salsa, taco seasoning, tortilla, corn chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef. Step 2: Melt cheese in crock pot and add mexican chilies and salsa. Step 3: Add meat and refried beans and taco seasoning. Step 4: Mix together and cook on low till refried beans and meat are throughly heated, about 2 hours This can be left on warm until serving time.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chorizo sausage, whole kernel corn, tomatoes, black olives, seasoning salt, taco seasoning mix, egg, milk, cornmeal, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the ground beef and chorizo together. Step 2: Drain most of the fat off Pre-mix the egg, milk and cornmeal Except for the cheese, put all the other ingredients into the crock pot. Step 3: Mix them thoroughly. Step 4: Put the cornflour-egg-milk mix on top. Step 5: Set the crock pot to high or low. Step 6: Cook for 5-6 hours on high or 10-12 hours on low 5 or 10 minutes before serving, cover the top with the grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: chunky salsa, tomato paste, olive oil, garlic cloves, fresh lime juice, fresh ground black pepper, salt, flank steaks, white onion, red bell peppers, flour tortilla, guacamole, plum tomato, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the salsa, tomato paste, olive oil, garlic, lime juice, pepper, and salt. Step 2: Place the flank steak in the slow cooker. Step 3: Pour the mixture over the steak, making sure to coat all exposed surfaces well Lay the onion and bell peppers on top. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours, until meat is tender. Step 5: Remove the steak and vegetables from the juice and transfer to a serving platter. Step 6: Cover with foil and let stand 10 minutes. Step 7: Cut the meat across the grain into 1 / 2-inch slices. Step 8: Serve it heaped over warm tortillas with the peppers and onions on top. Step 9: Garnish with a little guac, chopped tomatoes, and cilantro on top.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic, taco seasoning, pico de gallo, low sodium beef broth, sweet corn, dark red kidney beans, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the ground beef with the onion adding the garlic the last few minutes, drain. Step 2: Stir in pico de gallo and taco seasoning until warm and combined, add to crock pot. Step 3: Add corn and kidney beans and stir Continue to stir in the beef broth. Step 4: Set crockpot to low or medium for 4 hours. Step 5: Garnish with shredded cheddar or other favorite taco garnishes!

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, chili powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, dried oregano, garlic powder, paprika, cornstarch, water, refried beans, flour tortillas, colby-monterey jack cheese, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until no longer pink, drain. Step 2: Stir in the chili powder, cumin, coriander, salt, oregano, garlic powder and paprka. Step 3: Combine cornstarch and water until smooth. Step 4: Stir into beef mixture, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Step 6: Serve with taco shells. Step 7: Garnish with toppings if desired. Step 8: In a small saucepan, cook refried beans over medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes or until heated through.

Dish Name: Dan's Favorite Tex Mex Skillet Dinner
Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, green bell pepper, tomatoes and green chilies, water, long grain rice, taco seasoning mix, salt, lettuce, green onions, tomatoes, avocado, black olives, mexican blend cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Cook first 3 ingredients in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring until beef crumbles and is no longer pink, drain. Step 2: Stir in tomato and green chilies, water, rice, seasoning mix and salt. Step 3: Cook covered, over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Uncover and cook 15 more minutes, then remove from heat. Step 5: Sprinkle lettuce, onions, tomato, avocado, olives and cheese over hamburger mixture Stand tortilla chips around edge of skillet. Step 6: Serve with chips and salsa.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, taco seasoning, water, salsa, corn kernels, shredded cheddar cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, drain. Step 2: Add chopped onions, taco seasoning, water, and salsa. Step 3: Stir well and cook on low for 5 minutes Spray bottom of 9x13 baking dish and make 3 layers of meat mixture, cheese, and chips, ending with cheese. Step 4: Sprinkle corn over the middle layer of meat. Step 5: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Step 6: Remove foil and bake for 5 more minutes. Step 7: Serve with sour cream, chopped green onions, sliced olives, and / or taco sauce if desired.

Dish Name: Darthlaurie's Taco Casserole With Black Beans
Ingredient Names: hamburger, taco seasoning, water, black beans, mexican blend cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown hamburger. Step 2: Rinse hamburger and black beans. Step 3: In a pan, combine hamburger, black beans, water, and taco seasoning. Step 4: Simmer for ten minutes or until the water has mostly evaporated Crush enough tortilla chips to cover the bottom of a 2 quart casserole dish. Step 5: Pour 1 / 3 of the hamburger mixture over the chips in the casserole dish. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese Continue to layer crushed chips, hamburger mixture and cheese in that order until all of the hamburger mixture has been used up. Step 7: Add one more layer of crushed chips and cheese. Step 8: Cook in preheated 350 degree oven for 35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, cheese, lettuce, sour cream, salsa, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, season with taco seasoning, drain. Step 2: Mix all other ingredients together. Step 3: Top with sour cream and salsa May also add- can of beans to meat, olives, onions, taco sauce, tomatoes, guacamole, tabasco.

Dish Name: Deb's Caldillo Mexican Ground Beef Stew
Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, yellow onions, garlic, bacon grease, chicken broth, green chilies, rotel tomatoes, tomato paste, potatoes, vinegar, chili powder, salt, pepper, cumin, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep pot, crumble and brown beef with onion, garlic, cumin, and bacon grease. Step 2: Add chicken broth, salt, pepper, and chili powder, mix together well. Step 3: Add all canned ingredients and stir well. Step 4: Stir in vinegar to desired tartness, add potatoes. Step 5: Simmer on medium low heat for about 1 hour or until potatoes are fork-tender. Step 6: Serve topped with grated cheese and jalapeos, with warm tortillas on the side.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, ground beef, taco seasoning mix, cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef according to taco seasoning directions In bottom of 9x9 baking dish, make 2 rectangles with 4 of the 8 crescents rolls. Step 2: Cover bottom layer of crescent rolls with well drained ground beef mixture. Step 3: Layer with half of the cheese. Step 4: Top cheese with remaining 4 crescent rolls in 2 more rectangles. Step 5: Top with remaining cheese. Step 6: Bake in 350 oven until golden brown, roughly 30 minutes. Step 7: Top with lettuce, tomato and sour cream. Step 8: Serve with taco chips.

Dish Name: Delicious Ground Beef Enchiladas With Homemade Sauce
Ingredient Names: butter, flour, chili powder, cumin powder, garlic powder, chicken stock, salt, cheese, ground beef, onion, pepper, worcestershire sauce, corn tortillas, chopped tomato, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Enchilada sauce: in a medium saucepan heat butter, add flour, smoothing and stirring with a wooden spoon, cook for 1 minute. Step 2: Add chili powder, cumin and garlic powder and cook for 30 seconds Slowly add chicken broth and stir to combine. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes The sauce will thicken and smooth out. Step 4: Add salt and adjust as desired. Step 5: Sprinkle cheese over top of sauce and stir in until melted Enchiladas: while enchilada sauce is simmering, brown ground beef and onion. Step 6: Season with garlic powder, salt, pepper and worchestershire sauce.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, black beans, rotel, mexicorn, salsa, chicken broth, tortilla chips, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef & drain grease if necessary. Step 2: Add all canned ingredients and salsa. Step 3: Simmer for 10 minutes Optional: serve topped with cheese & tortilla chips to scoop it up!

Dish Name: Dia Uno Dos Tres Or Three Day Tacos
Ingredient Names: chili powder, garlic cloves, fresh lime juice, olive oil, ground cumin, beef, crushed tomatoes in puree, beef broth, dark beer, onion, fresh jalapenos, frozen corn, pimento stuffed olives, pimiento, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Day one, uno. Step 2: Mix chili powder, garlic, lime juice, 3 t Oil, cumin in large bowl to form a paste. Step 3: Add beef cubes and mix until coated. Step 4: Refrigerate in a zip bag for 24 hours, mixing it around when you think of it Day two, dos In dutch oven, combine marinated beef with canned tomatoes, broth and beer. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350. Step 6: Bring meat mixture to a boil over high heat on range top. Step 7: Place in oven, covered, and bake 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef, salsa, yellow onion, garlic, jalapeno, poblano chile, red sweet bell peppers, cremini mushroom, monterey jack cheese, phyllo dough, olive oil, guacamole, onion, sour cream, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Except for the dough, oil, and condiments in a large bowl mix together well all of the ingredients Roughly-while still in the bowl divide into 1 / 3's, set aside. Step 2: Divide your phyllo sheets into thirds. Step 3: Pour your oil into a bowl that you can place one hand in flat. Step 4: Take one sheet and lay it out on a clean counter, end to end, not side to side You want it the long way going away from you. Step 5: Now take another sheet and overlap it so that you have 2 and 1 / 2 inches on each side that's not overlaping the dough. Step 6: Dip one hand in the oil, rub it with your other hand and make quick prints on the sheets. Step 7: Take another two sheets and repeat first step, make more hand prints.

Ingredient Names: beef, onion, green pepper, tomato sauce, vinegar, mustard, pepper, basil, garlic powder, water, tortillas, lettuce, tomatoes, carrot, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef, onion, and 1 / 4 cup of green pepper till beef is brown, drain. Step 2: Add next 7 ingredients, bring to boil, reduce heat. Step 3: Simmer 15 minutes Warm foil-wrapped tortillas in a 350f oven for 10 minutes Spray 4 10-ounce casseroles with nonstick spray coating. Step 4: Press 1 tortilla into each. Step 5: Bake in a 350f oven for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, cream of mushroom soup, cheddar cheese soup, ro-tel tomatoes, milk, plain doritos, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown together ground beef and onion until beef is brown and onion is tender, drain well. Step 2: Add the mushroom soup, cheddar cheese soup, ro-tel tomatoes and soup can of milk to beef / onion mixture. Step 3: Stir until well mixed. Step 4: Line a 13x9 baking dish with the doritos. Step 5: Cover with the meat / soup mixture and sprinkle completely with the cheddar cheese. Step 6: Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: crescent rolls, hamburger, taco seasoning, sour cream, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, shredded cheddar cheese, plain doritos
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Brown hamburger and drain 2. Step 2: Add taco seasoning, tomato sauce, a little water, and diced tomatoes. Step 3: Simmer 3 In 9x13 dish, press out crescent rolls and roll them to form crust 4 Here comes the dairy! Step 4: Layer hamburger mixture, sour cream and then cheese 5.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, bacon, garlic cloves, red jalapeno chiles, unsweetened chocolate, tomato sauce, creamy peanut butter, mexican oregano, chiles de arbol, chili pepper, ground cumin, chili pods, yellow onion, mexican chili powder, hot paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the roasts in half thickness and rub with 2 tablespoons of the chili powder Sear the roasts over medium high grill, 5 minutes per side. Step 2: Cut the roasts into 1 inch cubes and place in crockpot In skillet, fry bacon slices over medium heat until crisp, and drain on paper towels Crumble bacon into small pieces and add to crockpot. Step 3: Drain off almost all bacon drippings and return skillet to heat. Step 4: Add onion and garlic to skillet and saute over medium high heat for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add to crockpot with tomato sauce, jalapeno, chocolate, peanut butter, oregano, chili de arbol, minced chili pods, crushed chili pepper, cumin, paprika, and remainder of chili powder. Step 6: Set on low heat and simmer 6 hours, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, salt, black pepper, picante sauce, cheddar cheese, burrito-size flour tortillas, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef, onion, salt, pepper, and picante sauce in a pan, drain. Step 2: Divide meat onto 6 burrito tortillas. Step 3: Top with 1/4 cup of cheese. Step 4: Fold up chimichanga style. Step 5: Deep fry till golden.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, tomato sauce, taco sauce, salt, pepper, tabasco sauce, hot chili pepper, cornmeal, whole kernel corn, sliced ripe olives, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 degrees Brown ground beef and onion over medium heat, drain. Step 2: Stir in tomato sauce, taco or other sauce, salt, pepper, tabasco, chiles, and cornmeal, adjusting for"hot" taste preference and desired thickness. Step 3: Stir in more cornmeal, if desired. Step 4: Stir in corn and olives. Step 5: Transfer mixture to casserole dish. Step 6: Cover and bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until bubbly and heated through. Step 7: Top with cheese immediately on removing from oven so cheese melts. Step 8: Garnish with corn chips just before serving to keep them crisp.

Ingredient Names: shortening, flour, chili powder, oregano, cumin, garlic powder, salt, water, tomato sauce, beef bouillon granules, ground beef, onions, pepper, oil, dozen corn tortilla, olives, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet put in shortening and melt, add flour and cook just until lightly browned (be careful don't do it to long). Step 2: Add seasonings making a paste. Step 3: Add water gradually then add tomato sauce and add beef granules. Step 4: Cook until thick stirring constantly. Step 5: In separate skillet, cook ground beef and onions until done; drain. Step 6: Salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Place 1/2 cup oil in pan and heat. Step 8: Heat the tortillas in oil, one by one. Step 9: Dip the tortillas in the sauce. Step 10: Add 2 or 3 tablespoons ground beef mixture to each tortilla and a sprinkle of olives to each and a little sprinkle of cheese. Step 11: In a 9x13 pan spread a thin layer of sauce on bottom. Step 12: Roll up enchiladas and place in pan. Step 13: Cover enchiladas with remaining sauce and cheese and sprinkle with olives. Step 14: Bake in oven at 350°F degrees for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tortillas, salsa, ground beef, eggs, cheddar cheese, vegetable oil, sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cover bottom of skillet in veggie oil, warm oil over med-high heat until hot. Step 2: Cook tortillas one at a time, about one minute on each side, drain, heat salsa. Step 3: Layer each tortilla with salsa, egg, meat, cheese. Step 4: Sprinkle with hot sauce.

Dish Name: Mexican Ground Beef Casserole with Rice (Beef mince!)
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, ground beef, tomato paste, long grain white rice, chicken broth stock, fresh corn kernels, black beans, capsicum bell pepper, green onions shallots, cheese, cayenne pepper, oregano, cumin, fresh coriander, onion powder, paprika, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pot over high heat. Add garlic and onion, cook 1 1/2 minutes until onion is translucent. Step 2: Add beef and cook, breaking it up as you go, until you no longer see raw meat (about 2 minutes). Step 3: Add Mexican Spices and cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add capsicum and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add tomato paste and broth, stir to mix in. Step 6: Add rice, corn and black beans. Step 7: Stir, bring to simmer then cover and lower heat to medium low (simmering gently). Cook 15 minutes. Step 8: Remove lid, quickly stir through green onion and HALF the cheese. Step 9: Smooth top then sprinkle on remaining cheese. Cover and leave for 1 minute just to melt cheese. Step 10: Remove from stove and serve immediately, garnished with more green onion if desired.

Ingredient Names: rouladen beef, refried beans, salsa, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the rouladen to make them tender, don't beat them to death just a few taps. Step 2: Lay them out on a cutting board and spread 1/2 cup of refried beans and 2-3 tbsp cheese on each. Step 3: Roll up each roulladen and fasten with a toothpick. Step 4: Place them side by side in an oven proof casserole dish, pour over the salsa cover with foil. Step 5: Bake in 375F oven for 30 minutes. Step 6: Uncover, sprinkle on the remaining cheese. Step 7: Return to oven uncovered and continue baking for another 15 minutes. Step 8: Serve with sour cream& Avocado slice on top.

Ingredient Names: chipotle powder, paprika, oregano, all spice powder, coriander powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, olive oil, beef chuck, garlic, onions, orange juice, lime juice, tomatoes, beef, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the Spice Mix ingredients in a bowl. Sprinkle 4 teaspoons over the beef and pat so it sticks. Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy based pot over high heat. Add the beef (in batches if necessary) and brown well on all sides. Remove onto a plate. Step 3: Turn the stove down to medium. If the pot looks dry, add more olive oil. Step 4: Add the garlic and onion and cook for 3 minutes until soft. Step 5: Add the orange juice and lime juice, and scrape the bottom of the pot so the brown bits mix into the liquid. Step 6: Add tomato, beef stock, water and remaining spice mix. Mix, then return beef into pot. Step 7: Put the lid on, bring to a simmer then turn the stove down so it is bubbling gently, not rapidly. Step 8: Cook for 2 hours, then remove lid and simmer for another 30 minutes until beef is tender enough to shred. Step 9: Remove the beef from sauce, shred with 2 forks. Step 10: Leave the sauce to simmer with the lid off for 10 to 15 minutes to reduce and thicken to your taste. Adjust salt to taste. Optional: puree with stick blender to make it smooth (I do this for company). Step 11: Toss beef back into the sauce (can reserve some Sauce for drizzling on tacos if you want, there's plenty). Step 12: Transfer beef into large dish and serve. See notes for suggestions. Step 13: To make tacos, serve the beef with warmed small tortillas, avocado slices, Pico de Gallo, shredded cheese, sour cream, lime wedges and extra cilantro/coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, envelope taco bell taco seasoning mix, eggs, plain breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, peanut oil, salt, pepper, salsa, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ground beef, 1/2 of the taco seasoning package, 1/2 cup salsa, bread crumbs, cheese, egg and salt/pepper to taste. Step 2: Shape mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls and brown in large skillet in the peanut oil. Step 3: Drain meatballs on paper towels. Step 4: In a 2 quart sauce pan, add the tomato sauce, remaining salsa, taco seasoning and meatballs. Step 5: Simmer for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: beef stir-fry, onions very, red peppers, oil, fajita seasoning, tortilla wraps, tomatoes chili herbs, fresh coriander, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill to high and scatter the beef, onions and pepper pieces on a large baking tray. Mix the oil and seasoning in a small bowl, then rub over the meat and vegetables with your hands. Grill for 10 mins, turning halfway, until everything is cooked through and the peppers and onions are starting to blacken at the edges. Heat the tortillas in the microwave or under the grill according to pack instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, tip the tomatoes into a sieve and leave to drain from their juice for 5 mins. Discard the juice, mix the flesh with most of the chopped coriander and season to taste. Wrap the spicy beef and vegetables, salsa and a little of the remaining coriander in the tortillas, topping with a spoonful of soured cream or yogurt, if you like.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, refried beans, cheese, green onion, tortilla chips, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat over to 350 degrees Brown ground beef and drain. Step 2: Add the two packets of taco seasoning to the beef. Step 3: Fill each packet with water and add to the meat and seasoning mixture, stir well. Step 4: Let meat simmer about 15 minutes covered or until water has evaporated and mixture is not soupy In casserole dish spread refried beans evenly on bottom of dish, fully covering. Step 5: Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded cheese over refried beans Next pour meat mixture over beans and cheese, spread evenly.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, sea salt, black pepper, red onions, chipotle chile adobo, garlic, green chilies, taco seasoning, oregano, tortilla chips, red peppers, black olives, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, pickled jalapeno peppers, tomatoes, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet over medium heat, add ground beef and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Break down the meat while cooking until half way done. Add red onions and sauté until soft and translucent, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a colander to drain then return meat mixture back to skillet. Step 2: Add chipotle purée, garlic, green chilies, taco seasoning and oregano. Stir ingredients very well before removing from the heat. Preheat oven to 400ºF. Step 3: To assemble the nachos, cover bottom of a deep dish pizza pan with tortilla chips. Spoon half beef mixture on top followed with ¼ cup red peppers, half can sliced black olives and sprinkle 1 cup each of Monterey Jack and Cheddar cheese. Repeat with the second layer starting with tortilla chips, remaining beef mixture, remaining ¼ cup red peppers and the rest of black olives. Add about 15 pickled jalapeño peppers and cover with the remaining 2 cups of cheeses. Add more jalapeño pepper (about 15 more). Step 4: Transfer dish to preheated oven and bake for 7 minutes or until cheeses are melted and ingredients are heated through. Remove from the heat and garnish with diced tomato and sliced green onions. Serve with salsa, guacamole, refried beans and sour cream. Serve 4 to 6.

Ingredient Names: beef chuck roast, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic, onions, red capsicum bell pepper, beef broth stock, canned red kidney beans, fresh tomato, tomato paste, cumin, cayenne pepper, black pepper, cornflour corn starch
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the beef into four equal sizes. Season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat 1/2 the oil in a heavy based skillet over high heat. Brown beef well all over - about 1 1/2 minute on each side, then remove onto a plate. Step 3: Add a touch more oil if needed. Step 4: Add the garlic, onion and capsicum (bell peppers) and saute until caramelised, around 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Add 1/2 cup beef broth, bring to simmer, scraping the bottom of the skillet to dissolve brown bits into the liquid. Simmer for 30 seconds then scrape it all into the slow cooker. Step 6: In the slow cooker, add the beans, tomato, tomato paste, beef broth and Chili Spices. Stir, then add beef - it won't be fully submerged, beef juices will raise liquid level. Step 7: Cook on low for 8 hours. Step 8: Remove beef from slow cooker and shred with two forks. Step 9: Mix cornflour and 1/4 cup beef stock, then pour into slow cooker. Add beef, then slow cook for a further 20 minutes to allow sauce to thicken. Step 10: Adjust seasoning to taste with salt and pepper. Step 11: Serve with garnishes of choice, such as sour cream, guacamole or diced avocado, grated cheese, coriander/cilantro. Serve either with corn chips or cornbread for dunking, or serve over rice!

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, green peppers, pinto beans, black beans, tomatoes green chilies, water, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, pepper, sharp cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, cook beef, onion, and green pepper until beef is browned and veggies are tender; drain. Step 2: Add the next 8 ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 3: Combine the cheeses. Step 4: In a 5-quart slow cooker, layer about 3/4 cup of beef mixture, one tortilla and about 1/3 cup of cheese; repeat layers. Step 5: Cover and cook on low for 5 to 7 hours or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: tortilla chips, lean ground beef, chorizo sausages, onions, salt, liquid red pepper seasoning, refried beans, green chilies, monterey jack cheese, prepared green taco sauce, avocados, sour cream, green onions, olives, mild red pickled pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Crumble beef and sausage into a wide frying pan over medium-high heat; add onion and cook, stirring to break up meat, until meat is lightly browned. Step 2: Spoon off fat; season to taste with salt and hot pepper seasoning. Step 3: Spread beans in a shallow 10x15-inch baking pan or oven proof dish. Step 4: Top evenly with meat mixture, sprinkle with chiles and cheese, then drizzle with taco sauce. Step 5: Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for 20-25 minutes or until very hot throughout. Step 6: Meanwhile, prepare garnishes of your choice. Step 7: Remove pan from oven and quickly garnish, mounding avocado and sour cream in the center, and adding other garnishes as desired. Step 8: Quickly tuck tortilla chips around edges of bean mixture and serve immediately. Step 9: If desired, keep platter hot on an electric warming tray.

Ingredient Names: fiery chili pesto, lean ground beef, ground cumin, beef stock cube, red peppers, kidney beans, fresh coriander, flour tortillas, avocados, red onions, reduced-fat mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the pesto into a large pan with the mince and cumin, and fry for a few mins. Crumble in the stock cube, add the peppers and kidney beans, then fill the empty can with water and add this to the pan, too. Cover and simmer for 10 mins, then remove the lid and continue to cook for 5-10 mins or until all the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from the heat and stir in the coriander. Step 2: Heat the tortillas following pack instructions and serve with the chilli, avocados, onion and a dollop of mayo.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, flour, chili powder, salt, onions, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, cumin, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl except water. Step 2: Mix well as you would in making a meat loaf. Step 3: Pour water into pan and add meat. Step 4: Stir occasionally breaking up any large chunks. Step 5: Cook for about 5-10 minutes or until done.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, taco seasoning mix, cheddar cheese, water, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, bell peppers, salsa, lettuce, tomatoes, onions, black olives, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook ground beef in large skillet over medium heat 7-9 minutes or until beef is no longer pink; drain. Step 2: Remove pan from heat. Step 3: Stir in taco seasoning mix, cheese and water. Step 4: Preheat oven to 375°F. Step 5: Unroll crescent dough; separate into triangles. Step 6: Arrange triangles in a circle on Classic Round Pizza Stone with wide ends overlapping in center and points toward outside. (There should be a 5 inch diameter opening in center.) I use my Pampered Chef pizza stone, but any flat round pan should work--perhaps even a pizza sheet, but I'd spray it with Pam before adding the crescent rolls. Step 7: Scoop meat mixture evenly onto widest end of each triangles up over filling and tuck under wide ends of dough at center of ring. (Filling will not be completely covered). Step 8: Bake at 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Step 9: Shred lettuce and chop tomato, onion, olives, and bell pepper (if desired). Step 10: If you want to do something fancy, scoop out a bell pepper and fill with salsa and put into center of ring. Step 11: Add your toppings to top of ring and finish with more shredded cheese and sour cream. Step 12: This is great with a salad.

Ingredient Names: jumbo pasta shells, ground beef, olive oil, taco seasoning mix, tomatoes, swiss cheese, tomato puree, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Cook lumaconi or conchiglioni according to package directions. Drain and splash with cold water to stop cooking. Step 2: Meanwhile, sauté ground beef in olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Step 3: Add 3 tablespoons of the Taco seasoning mix, 160 g chopped tomatoes and ½ cup of shredded cheese. Stir well until cheese is melted. Leave to cool slightly. Step 4: Fill each lumaconi with 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture. Step 5: Spoon tomato puree, mixed with ½ tablespoon of the Taco seasoning mix, over bottom of the shallow baking dish. Arrange the filled lumaconi on top. Step 6: Top the filled pasta with 100 g chopped tomatoes and ½ cup shredded Swiss cheese. Step 7: Sprinkle with crumbled tortilla chips. Step 8: Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, chili powder, garlic, salt, onions, prepared white sauce, ground sage, oregano, ground cumin, mild green chilies, cheddar cheese, tomatoes, white flour tortillas, iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and drain. Step 2: Add chili powder, garlic, salt and onion. Step 3: Combine white sauce, sage, oregano, cumin and chiles. Step 4: Simmer over very low heat until warm. Step 5: Reserve 1 cup sauce and 1 cup grated cheese. Step 6: Mix remaining sauce and cheese with meat, lettuce and tomatoes. Step 7: Place this mixture in tortillas, roll and place seam side down in a flat ungreased baking dish. Step 8: Top with reserved sauce and cheese, cover with foil. Step 9: Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, sunflower oil, garlic, oregano, ground cumin, paprika, chili flakes, taco shells
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan until very hot, then brown the mince. Step 2: Remove, then season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Add the oil to the pan and fry the garlic, oregano and spices for 1 min until fragrant. Step 4: Return the beef to the pan and toss well, then cook for 2-3 mins until hot through. Step 5: Warm the taco shells following the pack instructions and serve with the beef.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onions, tomato soup, enchilada sauce, salt, pepper, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cook beef and onion in large skillet over medium high heat until meat is browned, stirring until crumbled; drain and return to skillet. Step 2: Stir soup and enchilada sauce into meat mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spread 1/4 cup meat mixture onto each tortilla; sprinkle tortillas evenly with 1 cup cheese. Roll up tortillas, place, seam side down, into 9x13 pan. Pour remaining meat mixture over tortillas. Step 3: Cover and bake at 350 for 20 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining cheese, bake 10 more minutes. Serve with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, limes juice only, fajita seasoning, green onions, fat garlic, red peppers, pepper, apple, tomatoes, lime juice only, cilantro picked, chili sauce, very avocados stone, cheese, tortillas, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Grown-ups: Put the chicken and marinade ingredients in a bowl and cover. Put in the fridge for at least two hours. Step 2: Children: If your children are 5 or over, you can get them to roughly chop the pepper, roasted pepper, apple and tomatoes for the salsa using a good quality firm plastic knife or cutlery knife. Otherwise do this yourself. Younger children can pick the leaves from the coriander and mix them into the salsa. Step 3: Grown-ups: Tip the salsa ingredients into a food processor, along with the lime juice and a little seasoning and pulse until finely chopped. Take out 2 large spoons of the mixture for younger children, then add chilli sauce, if using, and pulse again to combine. Step 4: Children: Squeeze or spoon the avocado into a bowl and use a potato masher to mash it. Stir in the lime juice and some black pepper with a spoon. Lime juice can sting so grown ups may want to squeeze them for younger children. Step 5: Grown-ups: Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan and pour the contents of the chicken bowl into the pan. Cook for 5- 8 minutes or until the chicken chunks are cooked through. Step 6: Children: Put the grated cheese, salsa (for grown-ups and children), guacamole and sour cream in separate colourful bowls to put on the table. Step 7: Grown-ups: Heat the tortillas according to the pack instructions and put the cooked chicken in a bowl. Show children how to fill and roll their tortilla. Step 8: Children: Lay out your tortilla, choose your toppings, roll them up and eat!

Ingredient Names: black beans overnight, green onions, fresh cilantro, limes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drain, then rinse the soaked beans. Cover with cold water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 45 mins or until tender. Drain again. Step 2: Mix the beans, corn, spring onions, coriander stalks and leaves, lime juice, oil and some seasoning together in a bowl. Cover, then chill for up to half a day until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, garlic, adobo seasoning, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, yellow corn tortilla chips, refried beans, cheddar cheese, avocados, lemon juice, salt, sour cream, scallions, jalapenos, tomatoes, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Brown beef in a large skillet with the 5-6 cloves garlic, adobo/seasoned salt, cumin, and cayenne, breaking up any lumps. Step 2: Continue to cook until beef is cooked through and drain any accumulated fat. Step 3: Heat refried beans, stirring until smooth and creamy; set aside. Step 4: Peel and deseed avocado, and mash with a fork in a bowl along with the extra clove of garlic, lemon juice, and salt to taste (double garlic and lemon juice if using 2 avocados). Step 5: Scatter chips in pretty much a single layer on a micro-wave safe plate. Step 6: Dot with small spoonfuls of refried beans and sprinkle with shredded cheese and seasoned cooked beef. Step 7: Microwave up to 1 minute or until cheese melts (you can also heat beans and cheese on chips in a moderate oven, but will have to transfer them back to the plate). Step 8: Add dollops of avocado (guacamole) and sour cream, then sprinkle with chopped scallions, chopped tomatoes and sliced jalapenos. Step 9: Add some salsa to the top if you desire, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, onions, undrained beans, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the beans in a bowl. Step 2: In a medium skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion and the garlic; cook and stir until onion is deep golden, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the mashed beans and cook for about one minute. Step 5: Add salt to taste. Step 6: Makes about one pint.

Dish Name: Grilled Lime-Marinated Flank Steak With Chipotle-Honey Sauce
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, canned chipotle chiles, garlic, fresh cilantro, vegetable oil, lime juice, honey, peanut oil, balsamic vinegar, brown mustard, ground cumin, salt, cracked black pepper, crusty french bread
Instructions: Step 1: TO MARINATE STEAK: Place the steak in a large dish or baking pan. Step 2: Mix together the chipotle, garlic, cilantro, vegetable oil, and lime juice in a bowl and pour over the steak. Step 3: Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for 4 to 6 hours (do not marinate longer), turning occasionally. Step 4: Prepare the grill. Step 5: FOR SAUCE: Combine the chipotles, honey, peanut oil, vinegar, mustard, lime juice, garlic, and cumin in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Step 6: Stir in the cilantro and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: TO PREPARE STEAK: Remove the steak and season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Grill over high heat for about 5 minutes on each side for medium-rare, 7 minutes on each side for medium, or to the desired doneness. Step 9: Remove the steak from the grill and let it rest for about 4 minutes. Step 10: With a sharp knife, thinly slice the steak across the grain and at a sharp angle. Step 11: TO SERVE: Serve the steak on top of a slice of the French bread and accompany each serving with several tablespoons of the sauce.

Dish Name: Homemade tortilla chips with guacamole & charred tomato salsa
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, vegetable oil, avocados, limes, red onions, fresh coriander, green chilies, chipotle paste, plum tomatoes, green, garlic unpeeled
Instructions: Step 1: To make the tortillas, heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Brush both sides of the tortillas with the oil, then cut into triangles with scissors. Arrange in a single layer on 1 or 2 baking sheets and bake for 7-8 mins. Remove, sprinkle with salt and set aside. Step 2: To make the guacamole, halve and stone the avocados, then spoon the flesh into a bowl. Pour over the lime juice and a sprinkle of salt, then crush with a potato masher until puréed but still chunky. Add onion, coriander, chillies and chipotle paste. Stir through and set aside until needed. Step 3: For the salsa, place the tomatoes, cut-side up, in a shallow baking tray. Season, and place under the grill until blackened, about 15 mins. Meanwhile, in a dry non-stick frying pan, blacken the chillies and garlic. Keep turning to darken on all sides, about 10 mins. When done, peel the garlic and place in a food processor. Place the chillies in a plastic bag to steam for a few mins, then peel, deseed and stem. Add the flesh to the food processor along with the tomatoes, onion, coriander, lime juice and chipotle paste. Season and pulse until chunky.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork roast, olive oil, onions, garlic, limes, orange juice, chicken stock, ground cumin, oregano, bay leaf, chili powder, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In your Instant Pot, or in a saute pan over medium heat on the stovetop, heat the oil until shimmering and brown the pork on all sides, working in batches if needed. (Transfer the pork to the Instant Pot if you browned it on the stovetop.). Step 2: Add all the remaining ingredients. Place the lid on the pot, turn the pot to the "sealing" position, and select Manual mode and set the time for 20 minutes. Once it finishes cooking after 20 minutes, allow the Instant Pot to manually release for 20 minutes. Step 3: Take off the lid (if the steam valve hasn't dropped, make sure you move the steam value away from "Sealing"). Let the pork cool slightly, then use two forks to shred the meat. It may look like you have way too much liquid, but it will absorb it after you shred the pork. Step 4: Once shredded, use the pork however you like. I like to toast a few tortillas and top them with the pork, pineapple salsa, fresh cilantro, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice. Carnitas make a great salad topping, and are also excellent mixed into rice, in a sandwich (try it! trust me!), or reheated until crispy and served with eggs and hot sauce and avocado. Step 5: Note: If the pork is too liquid-y even after shredding and sitting, transfer it to a large pan and cook it on the stovetop until some of liquid evaporates. This is also an excellent way to get the meat golden and crispy (you can also spread it on a sheet pan and broil it for a minute or two)—for tacos and salads, I like to take this extra step to get those crunchy edges.

Ingredient Names: sirloin, sunflower oil, chipotle paste, red pepper from, avocado chunkily, limes, fresh coriander, dollops sour cream, onions, sunflower, ground cumin, paprika, tomato puree, black bean, pinto
Instructions: Step 1: Put the steaks on a plate and rub them all over with the oil, chipotle paste and ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper. Leave at room temperature while you start the beans. Step 2: For the beans, soften the onion in the oil in a frying pan. Once softened, stir in the spices for 2 mins, followed by the tomato purée, chipotle, sugar and vinegar. Tip in all the beans with 1 tsp salt, some pepper and half a can of water. Bubble gently until the water is almost evaporated. Step 3: Heat a griddle or non-stick frying pan (or a barbecue). Season the steaks with salt. Fry, with the peppers alongside, for about 2 mins on each side, until the steaks are cooked to your liking and the peppers are charred. Lift the steaks onto a clean plate to rest for a few mins while you mash two-thirds of the beans. Stir in the whole beans and check the seasoning. Step 4: Slice the steaks. Spread a good pile of beans onto 2 plates, and top with sliced steak and peppers. Add the avocado, a big squeeze of lime juice, some coriander leaves, a good dollop of soured cream and a pinch more paprika, if you like.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, red chile, cajun seasoning mix, oil, refried beans, tomatoes, yogurt, juice lime, arugula, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. In a roasting tray, toss the squash with the chilli, spices, oil and seasoning, then roast for 25 mins until tender. Gently heat the refried beans with the chopped tomatoes until warmed through. Mix the yogurt with lime zest and juice. Step 2: Warm wraps according to pack instructions and spread with a thin layer of beans. Top with squash, some rocket, and a dollop of lime yogurt.

Ingredient Names: soft tortilla wrap, avocados, mustard mayonnaise, watercress arugula spinach salad
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Brush the tortilla with a little oil, then bake on a baking sheet in the oven for 6-8 mins until crisp. Step 2: Meanwhile, rub a little more oil over the steaks and generously season. Heat a griddle or frying pan until hot, then cook the steaks for 1-2 mins each side, depending on the thickness of your steak and how you like it cooked. Remove from the pan and rest on a plate while you get the other ingredients ready. Step 3: Stone and peel the avocado, then thickly slice. Whisk the mustard mayo with the remaining oil, 2 tsp water and the resting juices from the steak. Break the tortilla into pieces and slice the steak, trimming off any excess fat. Divide the salad between 2 plates, top with the avocado, tortilla pieces, sliced steak and finally drizzle with dressing.

Dish Name: Pork tenderloin with chipotle sauce & pickled red onions
Ingredient Names: red onions one one, limes, oregano, fat garlic unpeeled, plum tomatoes, chipotle paste, chili powder, soft brown sugar, pork tenderloin, coriander soft tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Place the thinly sliced onion in a bowl with juice 1 lime, half the oregano and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Set aside. Step 2: Dry-fry the whole garlic in a non-stick pan until blackened on both sides, about 8 mins, then peel. Heat the grill. Arrange the thickly sliced onion on a baking tray with the tomatoes, cut-side up. Season and grill until blackened, about 8 mins. Tip into a bowl with the garlic, chipotle paste, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tbsp sugar and remaining lime juice. Season and whizz in a blender until smooth. Gently heat through in a pan. Step 3: Rub the pork with the remaining chilli powder, oregano, sugar and seasoning. Grill for 5 mins each side until cooked. Serve sliced in warm tortillas with some sauce, the pickled onions and coriander.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, paprika, chili powder, salt, cumin, parsley, oregano, oven pepper flakes, black pepper, bay leaf, garlic, chipotle chile adobo, onions, red peppers, salsa, molasses, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place flank pieces into a ziplock bag follow with the next ingredients including and up to garlic. Step 2: Massage into meat. Step 3: Add everything to crock. Step 4: Cook at low for 8 hours. Step 5: Remove meat and shred with forks. Step 6: Place back into crock. Step 7: Serve over rice, in a bun, or in a tortilla with avocado, cheese, sour cream.

Dish Name: Pulled pork with Mexican almond mole sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, pork shoulder, tomato puree, chicken stock, juice orange, cinnamon, thyme, onions, garlic, cherry tomato, corn tortillas, almonds, raisins, ground coriander cumin, chipotle paste, plain chocolate, radish, avocados, limes, cilantro only, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a casserole dish. Brown the pork for about 10 mins until golden all over, stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 min. Pour over the chicken stock, then add the strips of orange zest and juice, cinnamon and thyme. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, then cover and simmer for 1½ hrs. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the sauce. Heat a non-stick frying pan and dry-fry the onions and whole garlic cloves for about 5 mins, turning often until softened and lightly charred all over. Tip into a blender. Add the tomatoes to the pan. Cook for 3 mins until starting to blister and char, then tip into the blender. Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan. Fry 1 of the tortillas for 1 min on each side until golden. Tear into pieces and tip into the blender. Adding more oil if you need, fry the almonds for 3 mins until golden. Add to the blender. Finally add the raisins, coriander and cumin to the pan and cook for 1-2 mins until the raisins are plump. Add these to the blender along with the chipotle paste and finely chopped chocolate. Whizz together until a rough paste forms. Step 3: Using a slotted spoon, remove the meat from the pan to a board, leave to cool a little, then use forks or your fingers to tear into shreds. Remove the cinnamon, orange zest and thyme sprigs from the pan and discard. Pour a little of the cooking liquid into the blender, then carefully whizz together with the mole sauce. Tip sauce into the pan with the rest of the pork cooking juices. Simmer on the hob for 10-15 mins, then return the shredded pork to the pan and cook for 20 mins more. Season to taste. Can be made up to this point up to 2 days in advance and stored in the fridge or frozen for up to 3 months. Step 4: Just before serving, microwave the tortillas for 1 min to warm them. Toss together all the salsa ingredients and season well. Set everything out on the table. To serve, spoon some of the pork mole onto a tortilla, top with some salsa, then roll up and eat.

Ingredient Names: serrano chilies, tomatoes, red onions, orange juice, yellow bell peppers, fresh cilantro, rice vinegar, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a cast iron skillet over medium high heat cook the seranos until blackened. Step 2: Remove half of the blackened skin and discard, chop the chilies. Step 3: Combine the chopped chilies with the remaining ingredients, let stand 1 hour. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, olive oil, orange juice, cumin, chili powder, liquid smoke, salt, oregano, round steaks, onions, red bell peppers, green bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine lime juice, olive oil, orange juice, cumin, chili powder,liquid smoke, salt and oregano. Step 2: Mix up well and set aside. Step 3: Slice meat into thin strips and put in a gallon ziplock bag or covered bowl and add marinade ingredients and mix well. Step 4: Marinate in Refrigerator overnight, mixing once or twice while in refrigerator. Step 5: Slice bell peppers and onion. Step 6: In a heavy skillet add a little oil and cook steak on high heat until done then add vegetables and cook until slightly tender. Step 7: Serve with flour tortillas and Guacomole.

Ingredient Names: red peppers, tomatoes, garlic, limes, extra-virgin olive oil, chipotle paste, red onions, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Put peppers onto a baking sheet, skin-side up, grill until skins are black, then put into a bowl and cover. Leave until cool, then peel skins away. Step 2: Scoop out and discard tomato seeds. Put tomatoes into a food processor with garlic, lime juice, oil and chipotle paste. Add peppers, then pulse until chunky. Stir onion and coriander through, then serve.

Dish Name: Squash & ricotta wraps with coriander salsa
Ingredient Names: squash, cumin, vegetable oil, green chili, fresh cilantro, juice lime, soft wheat tortillas, ricotta
Instructions: Step 1: Toss together the squash, cumin and 2 tbsp oil in a bowl and season well. Cook on a hot griddle for 3-5 mins on each side until lightly charred and soft. Step 2: Mix together the chilli, coriander, lime zest and a squeeze of juice with the remaining tbsp oil to make a salsa. Toast the tortillas on the griddle for 30 secs on each side. Fold them in half, then halve again to make a pocket. Place some squash slices inside and dollop over some ricotta. Drizzle with the salsa and serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: cherry tomatoes, onions, jalapenos, lime juice, fresh cilantro, corn kernels, salt, ground cumin, black pepper, lean sirloin beef
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler (or grill or however you want to cook the steak) Combine tomatoes, onion, japs, lime juice, cilantro, corn and tsp salt, set aside. Step 2: (I like to make this a few hours early and let it marinate in the fridge) Smash garlic and salt with knife and make a paste; add cumin and pepper and then spread over steak. Step 3: Cook the steak however you like and serve with salsa!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, long-grain rice, fajita seasoning, kidney beans, rump steak, fresh cilantro, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 3 tsp oil in a medium saucepan and cook the onion for 3-4 mins until golden. Stir in the rice and 1 tsp fajita seasoning, then cook for 1 min. Pour in 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt and stir. Cover and simmer for 15-20 mins until all the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Stir in the beans and keep warm. Step 2: Meanwhile, rub the remaining oil, fajita seasoning and salt and pepper over the rump steaks. Heat a griddle pan, then fry the steaks for 2-3 mins each side. Stir the coriander into the rice and serve with the steaks and a dollop of salsa on top.

Ingredient Names: tender steak, garlic, limes, olive oil, white wine vinegar, chili powder, ground cumin, paprika, sugar, green onions, prepared salad greens, black beans, avocados, tomatoes, green chili peppers, fresh cilantro, fresh corn, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Place the steak in a large zip top bag, or nonmetal dish with the garlic, juice from 1/2 of one of the limes, and 3 tbsp olive oil, set aside to marinate while you make the dressing and prepare the salad. Step 2: For the dressing: Combine the juice from 1 whole lime, the remaining 3 tbsp olive oil, vinegar, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and the pinch of sugar, set aside. Step 3: Pan fry the steak, or broil, until browned on the outside and cooked to your liking on the inside. Step 4: Remove from the pan, let it sit for a few minutes, then slice into thin strips. Step 5: Toss the green onions with the salad greens and arrange on seving plates. Step 6: Pour some dressing over the greens, reserving some for topping the salad later. Step 7: Put some beans, avocado, and tomatoes over the greens next, topping with the chile, cilantro and corn. Step 8: Arrange the steak over the greens, then add some crushed chips over that. Step 9: Divide the rest of the dressing over the salads, serve immediately.
