Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, celery salt, ground cumin, garlic salt, onion salt, tomato juice, accent seasoning, flour, taco shells, lettuce, tomatoes, taco sauce, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix beef and seasonings in a frying pan. Step 2: Cover and cook at a low simmer for 12 minutes, stirring often. Step 3: Mix tomato juice, Accent and flour, and add to meat mixture. Step 4: Cook for 10 minutes more, then remove from heat. Step 5: Carefully spoon meat mixture unto shells, top with lettuce, tomatoes, taco sauce, and cheese.

Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, salt, skim milk, vinegar, cream-style corn, egg whites, honey, vegetable oil, cheddar cheese, granny smith apples
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Lightly oil a 10 inch cast iron skillet or spray with a nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, and salt, mix well. Step 3: Place milk in a small bowl. Step 4: Add vinegar and set aside In another bowl, combine corn, egg whites, honey, and oil. Step 5: Beat with a fork or wire whisk until blended Gradually whisk in milk. Step 6: Stir in cheese and apples.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, vegetable shortening, salt, baking powder, warm water
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, sift flour, salt, and baking powder cut in shortening until it resembles fine meal. Step 2: Add water, a little at a time, to flour mixture and kneed until liquid is incorporated Form dough into a ball and kneed on a floured surface until dough is smooth and elastic. Step 3: Divide, and make 12 smaller balls. Step 4: Cover and let stand at least 30 minutes. Step 5: Roll each ball of dough on a floured surface to make 6 or 7 inch size tortillas. Step 6: Place on a pre-heated griddle or cast iron skillet or a regular skillet and cook till medium golden on both sides Stack between towels or wax paper Do not use any oil in skillet while cooking the tortillas the skillet needs to be dry You might need to wipe the skillet from time to time to get rid of any extra flour.

Dish Name: Authentic Bolillos Mexican Bread Rolls For Tortas
Ingredient Names: warm water, salt, sugar, instant yeast, unbleached white flour, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the water, salt, sugar, yeast and 2 cups of the flour to your kitchenaid mixing bowl. Step 2: Set mixer speed to 4 and mix well. Step 3: Add in the flour about a half a cup at a time, mix for a minute or so and add more flour until the dough comes together and doesnt stick to the bowl The dough should form a ball on the dough hook It may become sticky after a few minutes of kneading so keep the flour handy to add more if necessary. Step 4: Knead for 8-10 minutes The final dough should be firm and elastic and a little sticky to the touch Form the dough into a ball and place the dough in a greased bowl. Step 5: Cover the dough with a towel or cloth and leave in a warm place for about an hour. Step 6: Remove dough from bowl onto a smooth counter that has a little flour on top to keep the dough from sticking to the counter.

Ingredient Names: coconut, butter, flour, shortening, baking powder, salt, sugar, raisins, egg, evaporated milk, almond essence
Instructions: Step 1: Grease loaf pans with shortening and pre-heat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, coconut, sugar and the raisins together in a bowl. Step 3: Add egg, evaporated milk, margarine and almond essence and mix together well until you have a firm dough. Step 4: Divide dough in half and fill loaf pans. Step 5: Mix 2 tablespoons of sugar and 1 tablespoon of hot water and brush mixture over the loaves. Step 6: Bake in center of oven for about 1 hour or until skewer inserted into center comes out clean. Step 7: Let cool in the pans.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, vegetable shortening, salt, tap water, spinach, powdered spinach, sun-dried tomato, powdered tomato, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Any optional ingredient is to be added to the flour before you add the salted water. Step 2: In a large bowl combine the fat with the flour using your fingers until completely incorporated. Step 3: Add any optional ingredient now. Step 4: Stir the salt into the water to dissolve and pour around 2 / 3's of a cup over the mixture Working fast begin to stir You should have clumps and not a blob of dough. Step 5: Check to make sure all the dry ingredients are moist and if not continue to add water a bit at a time. Step 6: Turn out and knead until smooth consistency is achieved. Step 7: Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and form into balls. Step 8: Set the balls on a plate, cover with plastic and let rest for 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Blue Cornmeal Muffins With Chile Butter
Ingredient Names: margarine, green chilies, eggs, milk, vegetable oil, blue cornmeal, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare chile butter: Mix margarine or butter with the green chiles until well blended. Step 2: Cover & refrigerate. Step 3: Prepare muffins: Heat oven to 400 Generously grease 18 muffin cups. Step 4: Beat eggs in large bowl. Step 5: Stir in milk, oil and chiles. Step 6: Stir in remaining ingredients, all at once, just until cornmeal is moistened. Step 7: Fill muffin cups about 3 / 4 full.

Dish Name: Blue Mesa Grill Sweet Corn Cake
Ingredient Names: corn husk, vegetable shortening, unsalted butter, masa dough, water, corn, yellow cornmeal, sugar, heavy cream, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Or you can readily purchase masa harina which is dried corn that has been ground and treated It is the basic ingredient used in making tamale dough. Step 2: Soak corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes until pliable, drain. Step 3: Place vegetable shortening and butter in a mixing bowl and beat on medium speed until mixture becomes fluffy and creamy. Step 4: Add masa and mix on low speed for about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add water and mix well on medium speed Grind the corn coarsely in a food processor. Step 6: In a large mixing bowl combine the corn meal, sugar, whipping cream, baking powder and salt. Step 7: Add the masa mixture and the ground corn and mix well.

Dish Name: Boleo Bolillos Authentic Mexican French Bread
Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, sugar, warm water, unbleached all-purpose flour, salt, cold water, cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl sprinkle yeast and sugar over warm water and let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes With a wooden spoon stir in 2 cups flour until combined. Step 2: Stir in salt and 2 cups of the remaining flour until mixture forms a stiff dough On a lightly floured surface knead dough with lightly floured hands for 8 minutes, or until smooth and elastic Adding more flour if needed to keep dough from sticking. Step 3: Transfer to a lightly oiled deep bowl, turning to coast with oil. Step 4: Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 1 1 / 2 hours Punch down dough and form into 8-10 hoagie shaped rolls. Step 5: Place rolls on an lipless baking sheet or pizza paddle lightly dusted with corn meal, cover with lightly floured towel and let rise, until doubled in size, about 30 minutes. Step 6: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, fat-free refried beans, onion, green olives, kalamata olives, salsa, cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place tortilla on microwavable plate. Step 2: Spread refried beans across one end. Step 3: Add onions, olives, and salsa. Step 4: Grate cheese on other half of tortilla Microwave 66 seconds on high. Step 5: Top with sour cream, fold up, and eat.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, sugar, yeast, eggs, buttermilk, canola oil, milk, water, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine the dry ingredients Whisk together the eggs and oil Heat the buttermilk over low heat until warm Do not let boil! Step 2: Stir the buttermilk and egg mixture into the dry ingredients until liquid is incorporated. Step 3: Let stand 15 minutes On a lightly floured work surface, knead dough until smooth. Step 4: Place dough in a oiled bowl, cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 1 / 2 hours Depending on how large you want your rolls, divide the dough into eight or four balls, cover, and let rest 15 minutes. Step 5: Take each ball and flatten it to a disc.

Ingredient Names: flour, yellow cornmeal, baking powder, salt, sugar, cumin, chili powder, canned corn niblets, green chilies, eggs, butter, milk, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 400 degrees Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Step 2: In a bowl combine first 7 ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Add in drained corn and green chilies, mix to combine. Step 4: In a small bowl, mix / whisk together milk, melted butter. Step 5: Add to the corn mixture along with the cheddar cheese. Step 6: Mix well to combine. Step 7: Pour into prepared baking dish.

Ingredient Names: jiffy cornbread mix, egg, butter, milk, rotel, cheddar cheese, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, mix well. Step 2: Pour into a greased 8x8 casserole dish or a greased muffin tin. Step 3: Bake 375 degress 15-20 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown.

Ingredient Names: egg, milk, butter, sugar, self rising flour, green onion, bacon, swiss cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, jalapeno jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 400 f. Step 2: In a bowl, mix egg, milk, butter and sugar Slowly stir in flour. Step 3: Fold in the green onions, bacon, swiss cheese and 1 / 4 cup cheddar cheese. Step 4: Fill muffin compartments 1 / 3 full. Step 5: Place one cube of jalapeno jack cheese in middle of each muffin compartment on top of batter Continue to fill muffin compartments with batter until 2 / 3 full. Step 6: Top with remaining cheddar cheese. Step 7: Bake muffins for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Step 8: Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan.

Ingredient Names: baking soda, baking powder, salt, yellow cornmeal, eggs, plain yogurt, oil, chipotle chiles in adobo, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 425 degrees Spray muffin tins lightly with oil. Step 2: Mix together baking soda, baking powder, salt, and cornmeal in a small bowl. Step 3: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with yogurt. Step 4: Stir in the chipotles& cheese. Step 5: Then gently stir the egg mix into the cornmeal mix just until combined. Step 6: Fill the muffin tins with the batter& bake for 10-15 minutes for regular sized muffins or 7-10 minutes for mini-muffins.

Ingredient Names: cake flour, baking powder, salt, ground nutmeg, vegetable shortening, granulated sugar, eggs, milk, unsalted butter, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Step 2: Grease 3 6-cup muffin pans. Step 3: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg. Step 4: In a large bowl, using an electric mixer on medium speed, beat shortening and 1 cup of the sugar until light and fluffy. Step 5: Beat in eggs, one at a time, until well blended and pale yellow With the mixer on low speed, beat in flour mixture alternately with milk, making three additions of flour and two of milk, until just blended. Step 6: Divide batter equally among prepared muffin cups. Step 7: Bake in preheated oven for 23 to 26 minutes or until tops are golden. Step 8: Let cool in pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack. Step 9: Pour butter into a small bowl.

Ingredient Names: water, white bread flour, sugar, salt, olive oil, cornmeal, creamed corn, green chili, jalapeno pepper, dried cilantro, fast rise yeast
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients in the order given to your bread machine Set for regular or rapid bake cycle.

Ingredient Names: active dry yeast, warm water, milk, granulated sugar, butter, salt, egg, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, vanilla extract, orange zest
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Step 2: Stir in milk, sugar, butter, salt, egg and 2 cups of the flour, beat until smooth. Step 3: Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Step 4: Turn onto a lightly floured surface. Step 5: Knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Place in a large greased bowl, then turn greased side up. Step 7: Cover and let rise in a warm place until double, about 1 1 / 2 hours The dough is ready if it leaves an indentation when touched. Step 8: Meanwhile, prepare flavored topping dough.

Dish Name: Corn Muffins With Jalapenos And Lime Butter
Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic cloves, fresh corn kernels, jalapenos, salt, flour, yellow cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, chili powder, buttermilk, eggs, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic to pan. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add corn, jalapeno and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, cook 2 minutes, remove from heat. Step 6: Add 2 tablespoons butter, tossing to melt. Step 7: Combine flour, remaining 3 / 4 teasopon salt, cornmeal, and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Step 8: Combine buttermilk, eggs and egg white in a large bowl.

Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, milk, vegetable oil, eggs, chorizo sausage, onions, red bell peppers, anaheim chili, fresh cilantro, dried oregano, canned chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f butter 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Step 2: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Step 3: Whisk milk, oil and eggs in medium bowl to blend. Step 4: Add milk mixture to dry ingredients and stir just until blended. Step 5: Transfer batter to prepared dish. Step 6: Bake until tester inserted into center comes out clean, about 25 minutes, cool. Step 7: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 8: Cut enough corn bread into 1 / 2 inch cubes to measure 12 cups. Step 9: Transfer to baking sheet.

Ingredient Names: flour, cornmeal, nonfat dry milk powder, granulated sugar, baking powder, salt, shortening
Instructions: Step 1: Sift dry ingredients together until well mixed. Step 2: Cut in fat until well blended. Step 3: Place in a glass jar. Step 4: Keep tightly closed in a cool place Mixture will keep for 1 to 6 months on the shelf in dry weather In hot and humid weather, store in the refrigerator Cornmeal muffins-grease 8 medium-size muffin cups. Step 5: Combine 2-1 / 4 cups cornmeal mix, 2 / 3 cup water and 1 beaten egg. Step 6: Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients. Step 7: Fill muffin cups 2 / 3 full.

Ingredient Names: coconuts, water, yeast, warm water, butter, sugar, salt, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Directions: grate the coconut and discard any brown skins. Step 2: Add 2 cups water to the coconut and let sit for 30 minutes If using dried grated coconut, add an additional 1 / 4 cup water to compensate for the lack of moisture Dissolve the yeast in 3 / 4 cup warm water. Step 3: Add the sugar and 3 t of the flour and let rise until bubbles form. Step 4: Add all remaining ingredients except flour. Step 5: Add 3 / 4 of the flour If you are using a bread mixer, add additional flour until mixture pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Step 6: Mix for 5 minutes or until elastic If mixing by hand, knead for about 8 minutes continually adding additional flour or until smooth and elastic.

Ingredient Names: butter, white sugar, eggs, buttermilk, baking soda, cornmeal, all-purpose flour, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Grease an 8 inch square pan 2. Step 3: Melt butter in large skillet. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in sugar Quickly add eggs and beat until well blended. Step 5: Combine buttermilk with baking soda and stir into mixture in pan. Step 6: Stir in cornmeal, flour, and salt until well blended and few lumps remain. Step 7: Pour batter into the prepared pan.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno pepper, self-rising cornmeal, self rising flour, eggs, cheddar cheese, vegetable oil, onion, corn niblets, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 Mix ingredients well, with just enough water to mix Pour into oiled iron skillet Bake until done, about 30 minutes.

Dish Name: How to Make Baked Taco Salad Shell Bowls
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, aluminum foil, water, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: If using 10-inch tortillas, set 2 empty food cans 3 to 4 inches apart on a 14x17-inch foil lined baking sheet. Step 2: If using 12 or 13-inch tortillas, set 1 food can on baking sheet. Step 3: Drape a foil square over the top of each can. Step 4: Fill a pizza pan (one that's at least 3/4-inch deep) or another appropriately rimmed container with about 1/2 inch of warm water; add 1/4 teaspoon of olive oil. Step 5: Quickly immerse a tortilla in the water, then lift out and let drain. Step 6: Drape the damp tortilla over the foil on the empty food can (if you place it slightly off-center the shell with have a dramatic higher flair to one edge). Step 7: If you have room on the pan for another tortilla, add another 1/4 teaspoon oil to the water, dip a tortilla, and drape it over the other can. Step 8: Bake the taco salad shells in a preheated 450 degree F oven until they're lightly brown and firm enough to hold their shape, which will take about 4 to 5 minutes. Step 9: Using pot holders, carefully lift the shells off the cans and place them cup-side-up on the pan; the edges on larger tortillas might need support when the shells are inverted so loosely crumple some foil into 4-inch balls and push them against areas that sag. Step 10: Return the shells to the oven and bake until they're crisp, about 2 to 3 additional minutes, let cool on rack. Step 11: Repeat all steps until you have enough shell bowls for your meal.

Ingredient Names: beef, taco seasoning mix, green chilies, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ground beef, taco seasoning mix, green chilies, finely chopped onion. Step 2: Shape into patties and grill, serve with salsa.

Ingredient Names: roma tomato, green onions, lean ground beef, taco seasoning mix, pickled jalapeno peppers, bread, light sour cream, sharp cheddar cheese, sauce, avocados, monterey jack pepper cheese, salsa, fresh cilantro, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine tomatoes with green onions; stir well and set aside. In a large saucepan over medium heat, add ground beef and cook half way before adding taco seasoning; stir well. When the meat is almost cooked, add pickled jalapeños and gently combine. Remove from the heat and transfer into a colander to drain the fat very well to prevent the sandwich from getting soggy. Step 2: To assemble the sandwich, working on only 4 slices bread, spread a thin layer of sour cream and then add about ¼ cup of Cheddar cheese over. Distribute beef mixture evenly on top of the cheese. If you want spicier, add a few drops of hot sauce over the meat. Step 3: Place avocado pieces on top of the meat followed by a ¼ cup of Pepper Jack cheese on each. Spoon tomato mixture over evenly and to hold everything in place, add another ¼ cup sharp Cheddar cheese on top. Add 1 tablespoons salsa per slice and sprinkle with cilantro. Place a slice of bread, press down gently and spread a thin layer of butter, covering the entire surface. Step 4: Place sandwiches on a baking sheet lined with foil and transfer to the oven under the broiler with the rack positioned about 8-inches from the top. When they get nice and brown, remove from the heat, carefully flip them over and butter the other side with a thin layer of butter. Return to the oven and broil until golden brown. Remove from the oven and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Spicy bean burgers with lime yogurt & salsa
Ingredient Names: kidney beans, fresh breadcrumb, mild chili powder, fresh cilantro, eggs, salsa, low-fat yogurt, limes, wholemeal burger buns avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Tip the beans into a large bowl, then roughly crush with a potato masher. Add the breadcrumbs, chilli powder, coriander stalks and ½ the leaves, egg and 2 tbsp salsa, season to taste, then mix together well with a fork. Step 2: Divide the mixture into 6, then wet your hands and shape into burgers. The burgers can now be frozen. Place on a non-stick baking tray, then grill for 4-5 mins on each side until golden and crisp. To cook from frozen, bake at 200C/fan 180C/gas 6 for 20-30 mins until hot through. Step 3: While the burgers are cooking, mix the remaining coriander leaves with the yogurt, lime juice and a good grind of black pepper. Split the buns in half and spread the bases with some of the yogurt. Top each with leaves, avocado, onion, a burger, another dollop of the lime yogurt and some salsa, then serve.

Ingredient Names: ground chuck, jalapeno peppers, salt, pepper, soft corn tortillas, avocados, sharp cheddar cheese, plum tomatoes, fresh cilantro, vidalia sweet onion, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Burgers:. Step 2: Preheat broiler or grill to medium high. Step 3: Using wooden spoon, mix together the ground beef, jalapeno, 1/4 cup of the salsa and salt and pepper in large bowl until the ingredients are well combined. Step 4: Form into 4 patties. Step 5: Broil or grill, flipping once until cooked through, about 4-5 minutes each side. Step 6: Place tortillas in microwave,and cook on high for about 20 seconds. Step 7: Arrange burger on warm totilla and top with avacodo slices, shredded cheese and salsa. Step 8: Wrap like burrito, salsa:. Step 9: Mix all ingredients in small glass bowl. Step 10: Can be used immediately if using for the burgers, if using as dip, let sit in fridge for at least 1 hour. Step 11: Make sure to wear protection on your hands when handling the jalapeno's!

Ingredient Names: turkey ground meat, worcestershire sauce, fresh breadcrumb, fresh coriander, red onions, avocados, chili, limes, ciabatta rolls, sunflower oil, peppadew peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the mince, Worcestershire sauce, breadcrumbs, half each of the coriander and onion, and some seasoning until combined. Form into 4 burgers, then chill until ready to cook. Step 2: To make the guacamole, mash the avocado with the remaining coriander and onion, the chilli and lime juice, and season. Step 3: Heat a griddle pan or barbecue until hot. Griddle the rolls, cut-side down, for 1 min, then keep warm. Brush the burgers with the oil to keep them from sticking. Cook for 7-8 mins on each side until charred and cooked through. Fill the rolls with the burgers, guacamole and peppadews.

Ingredient Names: french bread, avocados, green onions, sour cream, lemon juice, salt, cheddar cheese, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor bowl combine the avocado, green onions, sour cream, lemon juice and salt. Step 2: Cover and process until smooth. Step 3: Spread the avocado mixture on the bottom half of the French bread. Step 4: Cut cheese into slices and lay over the avocado mixture. Step 5: Add a layer of tomatoes. Step 6: Place on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until crisp. Step 7: Cut into 4 servings.

Dish Name: 15 Minute No Fry Chicken Enchiladas Honest
Ingredient Names: green enchilada sauce, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cooked chicken, tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, black olives, green onion, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly mix green chili enchilada sauce, soup, and sour cream in a large bowl. Step 2: Stir in diced, cooked chicken While still in bag, crush chips into smaller pieces and pour into soup mixture, mix well. Step 3: Pour into lightly greased 9x13" baking dish. Step 4: Top with grated cheese. Step 5: Bake at 350-degrees for 25-30 minutes. Step 6: When serving, add toppings of your choice.

Ingredient Names: canned chicken, cream of chicken soup, diced green chilies, sour cream, mexican cheese, green onion, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat tortillas in oil and drain. Step 2: Place 1 t of mixture in the middle and roll up -- line them all up in a casserole and when done -- pour what's left over on top and cover with cheese. Step 3: Bake 350 for 20 minutes. Step 4: Top with salsa or any relish you like P S I make my own soup I melt butter or margarine and add enough flour to make a thin paste and some salt and pepper I cook this about 2 min while stirring with a whisk as it thickens. Step 5: Then i add 1 can of beef broth and some powdered chicken stock and when it gets to the consistency i want i add the 2 cans of chicken & the juice, sour cream and some chopped jalapenos.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes with jalapenos, salsa verde, ground cumin, minced garlic cloves, salt, black pepper, boneless skinless chicken thighs, red pepper, yellow pepper, onion, black beans, corn
Instructions: Step 1: In 5-5-1 / 2 quart slow cooker combine the tomatoes, 3 / 4 cup of salsa, cumin, garlic, salt and pepper. Step 2: Add chicken, peppers, and onion and stir to coat. Step 3: Cover and cook on high for 3-1 / 2 hours or low for 4-1 / 2 hours. Step 4: Remove chicken from slow cooker to cutting board and let cool slightly. Step 5: Strain mixture over a large bowl or measuring cup and set liquid aside. Step 6: Return vegetables to slow cooker. Step 7: Stir in black beans and corn. Step 8: Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes Shred chicken and stir back into slow cooker with the remaining salsa and 1 cup of the remaining liquid Mixture can be used in tacos, quesadillas, burritos, or frozen in batches for quick meals.

Ingredient Names: masa harina flour, chicken broth, corn oil, salt, baking powder, chicken, green tomatillo sauce, corn husk
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the corn husks in warm water until soft. Step 2: Using an electric mixer, blend the masa flour, corn oil, salt, baking powder and the chicken broth to obtain a consistent mixture Shred the chicken and marinate in the green salsa or tomatillo sauce. Step 3: Spread masa evenly over corn husks, and spread a spoonful of marinated chicken on top of the masa. Step 4: Fold the sides of the corn husk to center over the masa so that they overlap to make a long package. Step 5: Fold the empty part of the husk under so that it rests against the side of the tamale with a seam. Step 6: Place the tamales in a steamer and cook tamales for 35-40 minutes. Step 7: Check every 20 minutes The tamale is cooked when it separates easily from the corn husk.

Ingredient Names: corn, black beans, diced tomatoes with green chilies, chicken broth, cooked chicken, shredded cheddar cheese, corn tortilla strips
Instructions: Step 1: Throw all ingredients into a pot, heat, and serve! Step 2: Sour cream, salsa, green onion, and hot sauce are also great toppings I was told canned chicken may be substituted for fresh chicken, although i have not tried it that way before You may use chicken boullion cubes and water instead of chicken broth.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, boneless skinless chicken breasts, bacon, head romaine lettuce, ranch dressing, adobo seasoning, parmesan cheese, cheddar cheese, jalapeno juice, corn tortilla strips
Instructions: Step 1: Drain all liquid from a jar of jalapeos into a medium bowl. Step 2: Marinate bacon in the jalapeo juice for 30 minutes Refill jalapeo jar with water. Step 3: Remove 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 of chipotle chiles in adobo sauce and place on cutting board Dice into fine pieces. Step 4: Mix diced chiles and sauce with ranch dressing in a medium bowl. Step 5: Taste If more spiciness is desired, dice more chiles and add to dressing, set aside. Step 6: Remove bacon from jalapeo juice and discard juice.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, tomato paste, dry enchilada mix, water, monterey jack cheese, black olives, sour cream, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Place skinless chicken thighs in crock pot In separate bowl, mix tomato paste, enchilada sauce mix powder, and water together. Step 2: Pour this mixture over the chicken in the crock pot. Step 3: Cook on low for approximately 8 hours. Step 4: Turn control to high and stir in cheese If sauce is too thick, stir in a little hot water. Step 5: Serve in a shallow casserole dish, garnished with sliced black olives, green onion, and sour cream, if desired For a complete meal, you might serve it on a bed of shredded lettuce, with salsa, and rice on the side Also, makes great burritos served in warm tortillas!

Dish Name: A Different And Delicious Nacho Dip
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, chicken wing sauce, cream cheese, blue cheese dressing, mozzarella cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the chicken in garlic and a little olive oil, drain. Step 2: Combine chicken pieces and hot sauce in saucepan and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add mozzarella cheese and cool 1 minute longer stirring In microwavable bowl add cream cheese and blue cheese and heat for 1 1 / 2 minutes. Step 4: Mix chicken and cheese mixture put in oven proof bowl, chill until set. Step 5: When ready to use heat at 350 degrees until warm, serve with chips.

Ingredient Names: dried chipotle powder, garlic powder, garlic cloves, onion powder, ground cumin, lemon pepper, chili powder, ground allspice, boneless skinless chicken breast half, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 8 ingredients in a gallon-size zipper-top bag and seal the bag Shake the bag to combine the spices thoroughly. Step 2: Cut chicken into 1 / 2 inch wide strips and place in the bag Shake the bag to coat the chicken completely. Step 3: Refrigerate for a minimum of 1hr. Step 4: Heat the skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add the chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned on the first side, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 6: Turn the chicken and cook until no longer pink in the center, another 4 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Serve over rice or salad.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat tortillas, avocado, broccoli coleslaw mix, low-fat ranch dressing, chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Place tortillas on serving plates Lay half of the avocado slices evenly on the middle third of each tortilla, leaving about 2 inches of blank tortilla at the top and bottom. Step 2: Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup of broccoli slaw over each avocado bed. Step 3: Place chicken on avocado broccoli bed. Step 4: Drizzle 2 t ranch dressing over avocado broccoli chicken bed. Step 5: Fold left third of tortilla over mixture, then right third over left third Tuck ends under Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, butter, cooked chicken, cooked bacon, fresh tomato, red onions, cheddar cheese, barbecue sauce, picante sauce, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Butter one side of each tortilla. Step 2: Place one tortilla into a nonstick skillet Evenly sprinkle chicken, bacon, tomatoes, onion. Step 3: Drizzle bar-b-que sauce over all. Step 4: Sprinkle cheese over and top with remaining tortilla On medium heat, cook approximately 3 minutes, watching underside of tortilla for browning. Step 5: Press with spatula while cooking Carefully flip entire tortilla over using spatula. Step 6: Cook approximately 3 minutes until light brown and cheese is melted. Step 7: Remove to a plate and cut into 6 triangle pieces.

Ingredient Names: whipping cream, buttermilk, chicken stock, milk, slivered almonds, dried ancho chiles, garlic clove, salt, chicken pieces, vegetable oil, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the whipping cream and buttermilk to form the "crema" In a saucepan, combine 3 / 4 cup of the crema with the stock, milk, almonds, 2 of the chiles and garlic and bring the mixture just to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Let it sit for 5 minutes for the chiles to soften. Step 3: Transfer the mixture to a blender and puree. Step 4: Add salt to the sauce to taste Salt the chicken lightly Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add the chicken and brown it on both sides It may be easier to brown the chicken in batches, but return all the pieces to the skillet before proceeding A snug fit is desireable.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic clove, olive oil, cooked chicken, taco seasoning mix, diced tomatoes, black beans, whole kernel corn, diced green chilies, chicken broth, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onion and garlic in oil in large saucepan until tender. Step 2: Add cooked chicken, taco seasoning, tomatoes, beans, corn and chilies. Step 3: Blend broth and cornstarch, add to saucepan, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes Stirring occasionally. Step 5: Serve with cornbread for a hearty meal.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breast, dry mustard, flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, salt, low-fat milk, canola oil, egg, black beans, sweet whole kernel corn, green chilies, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f, in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix mustard, flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Step 3: Stir in the milk, oil, and egg then mix until dry ingredients are just moistened. Step 4: Chop 2 of your adobo peppers into little pieces and add them to the mix. Step 5: Stir mix well to blend. Step 6: Pour half the corn meal batter into an 8x8 glass baking dish and spread along the bottom Gently press your mashed black beans on top of the corn meal batter in the dish, in a medium bowl. Step 7: Mix sour cream, 1 / 2 cup of the corn, your third adobo chile, cheese, and green chiles.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, green pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, frozen corn, dry white wine, cumin, chili powder, cayenne pepper, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, non-fat tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onion, garlic, jalapeo and green pepper with olive oil in a large pot until soft. Step 2: Add all the rest of the ingredients to the large pot and bring to a boil. Step 3: After about 15 minutes, remove the chicken breasts and shred. Step 4: Return shredded chicken to the pot and simmer an additional 45 minutes. Step 5: Serve, topped with crushed tortilla chips if desired.

Dish Name: Amazon Fried Chicken Breasts With Cilantro Sauce
Ingredient Names: cilantro leaves, garlic cloves, jalapeno, distilled white vinegar, water, mayonnaise, eggs, all-purpose flour, salt, fresh ground pepper, potato chips, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine the cilantro, garlic, jalapeo, vinegar and water and puree. Step 2: Transfer to a bowl and whisk in the mayonnaise. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate. Step 4: In a shallow bowl, lightly beat the eggs In another shallow bowl, combine the flour, salt and pepper. Step 5: Spread the potato chips in a third bowl Lightly coat the chicken with the flour, shaking off any excess, then dip in the beaten eggs Coat the chicken with the potato chips. Step 6: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet until shimmering. Step 7: Add the chicken and cook over moderately high heat until golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.

Dish Name: Amy's Chicken And Black Bean Enchilada Casserole
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breasts, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, pepper, fresh cilantro, black beans, brown rice, red enchilada sauce, low-fat cream cheese, low-fat sour cream, green chili peppers, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat Saut onion and chicken for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, salt and pepper Continue to saut until chicken is thoroughly cooked through, about 10 more minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a large bowl. Step 4: Add the cilantro, then gently fold in the rice and black beans. Step 5: In a sauce pan over low-medium heat, stir together 1-10 oz Can of enchilada sauce, the cream cheese, sour cream and chili peppers. Step 6: Remove from heat when fully incorporated. Step 7: Add sauce to chicken mixture.

Dish Name: Ancho Chicken Tacos With Cilantro Slaw And Avocado Cream
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, dried ancho chile powder, garlic salt, ground cumin, cooking spray, lime zest, fresh lime juice, sour cream, milk, avocado, coleslaw, green onion, fresh cilantro, canola oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over high heat. Step 2: Sprinkle chicken evenly with chile powder, garlic salt, and cumin Coat pan with cooking spray. Step 3: Add chicken to pan. Step 4: Cook 4 - 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Remove chicken from pan. Step 6: Combine zest, 1 tablespoon juice and sour cream, milk and avocado in a blender or food processor Process until smooth. Step 7: Combine remaining 1 tablespoon lime juice, coleslaw, green onions, cilantro, oil and salt, tossing to coat. Step 8: Heat tortillas according to directions.

Dish Name: Ancho Chile Marinade For Meat Ala Chipotle
Ingredient Names: dried ancho chiles, black pepper, cumin powder, fresh oregano, garlic cloves, red onion, vegetable oil, chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dried chilis overnight in water until soft, remove seeds. Step 2: Add all ingredients, except chicken to a food processor, puree until smooth. Step 3: Spread mixture evenly over chicken and refrigerate at least 1 hour, but up to 24 hours. Step 4: Heat grill to 400f Salt chicken breasts to taste. Step 5: Grill for about 4 minutes per side, until done. Step 6: Garnish with fresh cilantro.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cumin powder, dried ancho chile powder, kosher salt, coconut oil, fresh cilantro, lime wedge, white onion, radish, tomatillo salsa, cotija cheese, red cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Pulse the chicken chunks in a food processor about 6-8 times briefly to chop chicken into small pieces, being careful not to overprocess. Step 2: In a large bowl, stir together the cumin powder, chili powder and salt. Step 3: Place the chopped chicken into the bowl and toss with spices to combine well. Step 4: Heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Step 5: Add chicken in a single layer and cook, undisturbed, about one minute. Step 6: Stir chicken and continue to cook until chicken is cooked through, about five minutes or so, stirring often and breaking up any large chunks with your spoon To serve, spoon chicken mixture onto freshly made tortillas and top with the sides of your choice The menu: tostadas were served with freshly cooked whole black beans, and fresh strawberries.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, vegetable juice, creamed corn, pinto beans, pasta sauce, crushed tomatoes, cooked chicken, onion, chili powder, ground cumin, cayenne, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in butter until soft. Step 2: Chop cooked chicken into small pieces I used leftovers from a roasted chicken Use either spicy v8 juice, regular v8 juice, or tomato juice I used canned beans which had jalapeno pieces Usually, i drain canned beans, but in this recipe i added the beans undrained with their liquid as a thickener Any canned beans will do: white, pinto, black, etc I used green and black olive barilla puttanesca sauce, but any jar of pasta sauce would do Family members did comment, however, that they liked the olive taste of the barilla sauce I used canned fire roasted, crushed tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, limes, sugar, dried oregano, cayenne, cinnamon, onions, red pepper, yellow pepper, green pepper, vegetable oil, parsley, salt, pepper, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Prep the veggies: de-seed the peppers Thinly slice the peppers and onions and set aside on a plate Prep the chicken: slice the chicken on the diagonal into 3 cm strips. Step 2: Make the marinade: grate the rind of one of the limes into a bowl then squeeze the juice of both limes Into this, add the sugar, cayenne, oregano and cinnamon and season with salt and pepper, mix together well. Step 3: Marinate the chicken: add the chicken strips to the marinade and toss until pieces are well coated. Step 4: Let marinate for 30 minutes or longer. Step 5: Cook the chicken: heat the oil in a pan or griddle over high heat until smoking hot. Step 6: Add the chicken and the marinade and cook until tender.

Ingredient Names: roasting chicken, adobo seasoning, water, chipotle chiles in adobo, tomato paste, apple juice, mexican cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in crock pot, and sprinkle liberally with adobo seasoning, cover with water. Step 2: Cook chicken on low for 8 hours or overnight Shred and remove bones, skin, etc On the stovetop, add chicken with the rest of the ingredients For a mild spice, which is how i prepared it, use just 2 tbl of the sauce from the peppers To make it hotter, use more sauce and less tomato paste, or puree the peppers and use them as well. Step 3: Season with more adobo seasoning to taste. Step 4: Stir until blended and cook until juice is absorbed. Step 5: Serve on torillas with rice as a side.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, dry rub seasonings, vegetable oil, salad greens, red bell peppers, green bell peppers, red onions, corn kernels, celery, black beans, corn tortilla strips, smoky tomato vinaigrette, monterey jack pepper cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat Rub chipotle spice over chicken breasts and cook in skillet to a 165 internal temperature While cooking, begin preparation of salad by thoroughly cleaning and sanitizing sink. Step 2: Rinse and wash all vegetables in cold, 40 water with 1 / 2 cup of salt and 1 / 2 cup of white vinegar. Step 3: Drain Clean and sanitize cutting board and knife. Step 4: Chop salad greens into 1x1" squares Trim peppers, onions, celery and dice into 1 / 4" cubes and place into large mixing bowl. Step 5: Add greens, corn, black beans, tortilla strips and dressing and gently mix with a spatula Mound salad onto plate and top with pepper jack cheese.

Dish Name: Aroz Con Pollo Chicken With Rice
Ingredient Names: chicken, cooking oil, long grain rice, onion, garlic, water, tomatoes, instant chicken bouillon granules, salt, pepper, saffron, frozen peas, pimientos
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt Brown chicken in hot oil for about 15 minutes. Step 2: Remove chicken from pan. Step 3: Cook rice, onion, garlic in the same pan with drippings until rice is browned. Step 4: Add water, undrained tomatoes, bouillon, salt, pepper, and saffron, bring to boil, stir well. Step 5: Arrange chicken on top of rice. Step 6: Cover and simmer for 35 minutes or until chicken is tender. Step 7: Add peas and pimiento.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, cooking oil, button mushroom, onion, garlic cloves, salsa, monterey jack cheese, chicken stock, cooked rice, salt and pepper, parsley, cumin, ground cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat then add mushrooms, onion, and garlic. Step 2: Let cook for 2 minutes or so. Step 3: Season chicken with salt, pepper, cumin, and cayenne- add to skillet, cook until chicken is brown on all sides. Step 4: Add salsa and rice stir frequently while the chicken continues to cook. Step 5: Add chicken broth a little bit at a time, like you're making risotto. Step 6: When chicken is cooked through and the surrounding rice is creamy, turn off heat and stir in cheese. Step 7: Top with some chopped cilantro or parsley for a pop of color.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, long grain white rice, taco seasoning, water, tomato sauce, tomatoes, green onion, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, salsa, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: In large deep skillet, add chicken, rice, taco spices & seasonings, water and tomato sauce, bring to a boil. Step 2: Cover, reduce heat to low and cook for 20 minutes. Step 3: Stir in tomato and green onion Scoop 1 / 2 cup filling on each tortilla. Step 4: Fold in sides and roll-up to enclose filling. Step 5: Top each burrito with cheese, if desired, and heat in 350f oven until cheese melts, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Garnish each burrito with salsa and guacamole, if desired.

Dish Name: Arroz Con Pollo Chicken With Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, long grain rice, tomato sauce, chicken bouillon cubes, garlic cloves, green bell pepper, yellow onion, cumin, salt, pepper, shortening, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper Brown chicken in skillet, 2-3 minutes on each side. Step 2: When it's chicken is browned, remove from skillet, set aside. Step 3: Cut into pieces when cool enough In the same skillet, put shortening or lard, let it melt. Step 4: When melted, add green peppers and onion. Step 5: Saute about 2 minutes, add rice. Step 6: Fry rice until golden brown.

Dish Name: Arroz Con Pollo With Salsa Verde Rice And Chicken Casserole
Ingredient Names: salt, fresh ground black pepper, ground cumin, mexican oregano, hungarian paprika, cayenne, olive oil, boneless chicken thighs, chorizo sausage, sweet onion, garlic, red bell pepper, bay leaves, basmati rice, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Mix spice paste in a small bowl. Step 3: Wash chicken, pat dry Rub chicken with spice paste, refrigerate 30 minutes, 60 is better. Step 4: In a dutch oven heat remaining oil over medium heat. Step 5: Fry chorizo'til crisp, remove, dry on paper towel. Step 6: Add chicken, skin side down, brown well on all sides. Step 7: Remove, drain on paper towel. Step 8: Make a sofrito, saute the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and bay leaves'til they are almost disolved. Step 9: Remove bay leaves.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, garlic salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, nonstick cooking spray, long-grain rice, tomatoes and green chilies, chicken broth, refried beans, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken with garlic salt and pepper Spray large skillet with cooking spray. Step 2: Place chicken, skin side down, in skillet Brown on med-hi heat about 7 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Step 3: Remove chicken from skillet. Step 4: Pour rice into skillet Brown rice in chicken fat over med. Step 5: Heat about 2 min, stirring constantly. Step 6: Add tomatoes and chicken broth.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, fat-free italian salad dressing, fresh asparagus, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, onion, garlic, lemon juice, garlic salt, black pepper, whole wheat tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken breast into a bowl and mix with italian dressing. Step 2: Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, turning a few times if possible Spray a non-stick skillet lightly with cooking spray. Step 3: Add chicken and marinade, and garlic and saut for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the vegetables and stir for 8-10 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender to your liking. Step 5: Stir in the lemon juice, garlic salt, and season lightly with pepper. Step 6: Divide evenly between 2 large tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, yellow onion, garlic, flour, water, rotel tomatoes, diced tomatoes, fresh cilantro, sugar, tabasco sauce, cheddar cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onion and garlic in oil. Step 2: Stir in 2 tablespoons flour While simmering, whisk the rest of the flour with water and add to the onion and garlic saut, simmer 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes, cilantro and chicken. Step 4: Cook for 20 minutes on medium heat. Step 5: Stir in sugar and tabasco, simmer 10 minutes. Step 6: Add cheese and let it melt Crumble tortilla chips into soup and let it set for 15 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, chicken broth, white onion, garlic clove, salt, tomatillo, serrano peppers, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, queso fresco, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, combine chicken breast with chicken broth, one quarter onion, a clove of garlic, and 2 teaspoons salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil, and then boil for 20 minutes Reserve broth, set chicken aside to cool, and discard onion and garlic. Step 3: When cool enough to handle, shred chicken with your hands. Step 4: Place tomatillos and serrano chiles in a pot with water, enough to cover them. Step 5: Bring to boil, and continue boiling until tomatillos turn a different shade of green. Step 6: Strain tomatillos and chiles, and place in a blender with another quarter piece of onion, 1 clove garlic, and a pinch of salt. Step 7: Pour in reserved chicken broth, so that liquid just covers the veggies in the blender by about an inch. Step 8: Blend all ingredients until they are completely pureed. Step 9: Pour salsa in a medium saucepan, and bring to a low boil.

Ingredient Names: water, tomatillos, onions, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro, vegetable oil, salt, whole chicken breasts, onion, corn tortillas, creme fraiche, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare sauce: heat water in large pot to boiling. Step 2: Add tomatillos, 2 onion halves, 6 garlic cloves, and 7 serrano chiles. Step 3: Simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Step 4: Let cool slightly, then drain, reserving about 1 cup cooking liquid. Step 5: Place solids in blender or food processor. Step 6: Add remaining onion half, 4 garlic cloves, 3 chiles, the cilantro, and about 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid Process until smooth. Step 7: Heat oil in medium saucepan. Step 8: Add onion slices and saute until lightly browned. Step 9: Stir in sauce and season with salt.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, salsa, canned jalapeno slices, cumin, garlic powder, salt, flour tortillas, american cheese, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Add tomatoes, broth, salsa, jalapeos, cumin, garlic, and salt to a medium size sauce pan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Chop chicken into small bite size pieces and add to boiling sauce. Step 3: Turn heat immediately down to low- medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through You can simmer for longer if you want more flavor infused into the meat. Step 4: Heat 1 / 2 tablespoon of butter into a pan on medium low heat. Step 5: Place cheese slice into center of flour tortilla With a slotted spoon pick up chicken pieces and allow the juice to drain out. Step 6: Place in center of tortilla and fold close. Step 7: Cook tortillas about a minute on each side until golden brown and serve Goes well with a guacamole salad.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chicken broth, epazote, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce, olive oil, onion, carrots, garlic cloves, chickpeas, lime, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer chicken, broth, epazote and chipotle chile in a pan over medium heat until just cooked - 12-15 minutes. Step 2: Remove chicken and set aside. Step 3: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and carrots and saut for approx 5 minutes, until tender. Step 5: Add garlic and saut for a further minute In same saucepan, add broth mixture and chickpeas, then cook for 20 minutes on medium heat with lid on De-bone chicken shred the meat and add to the soup. Step 6: Add juice of 1 lime and adobo, and add salt and black pepper, to taste.

Ingredient Names: tyson fajita chicken strips, onion, olive oil, mccormick white chicken chili seasoning mix, chicken bouillon powder, garlic powder, oregano, ground black pepper, ground cayenne pepper, cumin, white beans, water, light cream, sour cream, mexican-style tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a stock pot, add diced onion and olive oil, saute until clear. Step 2: Add seasoning packet and all other "dry" ingredients Continue to saute dry ingredients for a few minutes, stirring often. Step 3: Whisk in the water and lime juice and heat to boiling. Step 4: Add chicken, beans, rotel, diced chili's, cheese dip, 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 and the sour cream. Step 5: Stir thoroughly and reduce heat to a simmer. Step 6: Let simmer for ~30 minutes and enjoy It's even better the next day.

Dish Name: Awesome And Easy Chicken Enchiladas Reduced Fat
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, cooked chicken breast halves, onion, monterey jack cheese, reduced-fat cream of chicken soup, fat free sour cream, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Divide the shredded chicken, onions and 1 cup of the cheese equally into each tortilla. Step 3: Roll them each tightly and place seam-side down into a greased 9x13 baking dish. Step 4: Prepare the sauce by combining soup, sour cream and green chilis The sauce should be of a thick gravy-like consistency You may need to add a little water to thin it out. Step 5: Pour sauce over the rolled tortillas. Step 6: Bake for about 20 minutes. Step 7: Remove from oven and top with remaining cheese. Step 8: Return to oven until the cheese melts.

Dish Name: Awesome Beef or Chicken Taco Soup
Ingredient Names: browned ground beef, onions, pinto beans, kidney beans, rotel tomatoes, kernel corn, ranch style beans, mexican-style tomatoes, hominy, green chilies, ranch dressing mix, taco seasoning, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients. Step 2: Simmer for 30 minutes. Step 3: Serve with tortilla chips, cheese, and cornbread if desired!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, red bell pepper, corn, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, chili beans, chicken stock, barley, chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt and pepper, cooked chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onion, garlic and bell pepper in olive oil until soft. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients, except chicken, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken and continue cooking for 20 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, red bell peppers, jalapeno pepper, cumin, coriander, chili powder, oregano, frozen corn, chicken breasts, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, fresh lime juice, cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 2: In a large saucepan, brown in a little oil on all sides. Step 3: Remove, and set aside. Step 4: Add onions, garlic, bell pepper, and jalapeno to pan. Step 5: Saute until vegetables have softened. Step 6: Add the cumin, coriander, chili powder, and oregano to pan. Step 7: Cook and stir another minute. Step 8: Add the broth, tomatoes, corn, and chicken. Step 9: Bring soup to a boil, then reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes Just before serving, stir in the lime juice and cilantro.

Dish Name: Baked Chicken Breast Wrapped In Bacon With Chipotle Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, bacon, chipotle chiles in adobo, sour cream, milk, chicken bouillon cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 350f. Step 2: Wrap chicken breast in a slice or two of bacon depending on size of breast vs Size of bacon. Step 3: Place wrapped chicken breast onto a non-stick oven safe baking sheet / dish. Step 4: Cook until completely done, usually takes about an hour, hour and a half. Step 5: When chicken breast lack about 20 mins from being done, you can start preparing the chipotle sauce. Step 6: Combine chipotle peppers in adobo sauce,, with sour cream and milk, blend in the blender until there are little to no chunks left of the peppers. Step 7: Once you have this blended together add to a small sauce pan and simmer on low to medium heat and add the 2 cube of chicken bullion for flavor. Step 8: Add salt and pepper as desired To serve: place chicken on plate and pour chipotle sauce on top.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, cooked chicken breasts, reduced-fat cream of chicken soup, reduced-fat sour cream, green chili peppers, ground chipotle chile pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, fresh cilantro, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Step 2: Mix all above ingredients. Step 3: In a medium size saucepan. Step 4: Heat over medium heat until hot, remove from heat. Step 5: Place about 3 tablespoons of the chicken filling along the edge of a tortilla. Step 6: Roll the tortilla up more tight than loose. Step 7: Put a toothpick through the middle of the flauta to hold in place. Step 8: Place on a sprayed large baking sheet. Step 9: Repeat with the remaining tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, diced tomatoes with green chilies, onion, green pepper, red pepper, canola oil, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a 13x9x2-inch baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray, combine the chicken, tomatoes, onion and peppers. Step 2: Combine the oil, chili powder, cumin and salt. Step 3: Drizzle over chicken mixture, toss to coat. Step 4: Bake, uncovered, at 400f for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Step 5: Spoon onto tortillas, fold in sides.

Ingredient Names: eggs, green chili salsa, salt, fine dry breadcrumbs, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic salt, dry oregano, chicken legs-thighs, butter
Instructions: Step 1: In a shallow bowl, beat eggs, salsa, and salt until blended In another shallow bowl, combine bread crumbs, chili powder, cumin, garlic salt and oregano. Step 2: Dip chicken into egg mixture and roll in crumb mixture. Step 3: Repeat both steps 1 more time. Step 4: In a shallow rimmed baking pan, melt butter as oven preheats to 400. Step 5: Remove pan from oven. Step 6: Add chicken, turn to coat with butter and arrange skin side up. Step 7: Bake, uncovered, until meat near thighbone is no longer pink when slashed. Step 8: Transfer chicken to a warm platter Insulate to transport hot.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, green chili salsa, fresh lime juice, ground cumin, chili powder, onion powder, garlic cloves, cilantro, green onions, cooked chicken, cheese, corn tortillas, kosher salt, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 425f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix the cream cheese, salsa, lime juice, ground cumin, chili powder, onion powder and garlic. Step 3: Once combined, stir in the cilantro and green onions. Step 4: Add the chicken and cheese. Step 5: Mix thoroughly Working with a few tortillas at a time, heat them in the microwave between two paper towels until they are soft enough to roll. Step 6: Spoon 2-3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture onto the lower third of a tortilla. Step 7: Roll the tortilla as tightly as you can. Step 8: Place the rolled tortilla seam side down on the baking sheet. Step 9: Repeat with remaining tortillas until the mixture is gone.

Ingredient Names: chicken, monterey jack cheese, green chili, flour tortillas, hidden valley original ranch dressing, salsa, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, cheese,dressing and chiles together in a bowl. Step 2: Place about 1/2 cup of chicken mixture on each torilla. Step 3: Fold in half to seal. Step 4: Place quesadillas on a baking sheet. Step 5: Bake at 350 F for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Step 6: If desired garnish with salsa and guacamole. Step 7: You can put any kind of cheese you like.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, black beans, cumin, chili powder, garlic cloves, red enchilada sauce, water, white onion, cheddar cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, mash the beans with a potato masher. Step 2: Add the chicken, cumin, chili powder, garlic, enchilada sauce, and water. Step 3: Turn heat to low and simmer until all liquid is absorbed If the mixture is too liquidy, strain through a cheesecloth. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in half cup of cheese and the onions. Step 5: Preheat oven to 400 To prevent cracking, prep the tortillas by wrapping them in a kitchen towel and placing in a metal colander over a covered pan of boiling water until they are hot and pliable. Step 6: Place 1 / 4 cup of filling lengthwise in the tortilla and roll the tortilla around it. Step 7: Place on a greased cookie sheet, seam-side down Spray lightly with canola cooking spray and bake in preheated oven until taco shells are crispy.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, cumin, paprika, sea salt, cilantro, cooked chicken, low sodium chicken broth, tortillas, queso fresco
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f and oil a baking sheet. Step 2: Heat olive oil over medium heat in a skillet. Step 3: Add onions and cook until starting to turn translucent, 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and salt. Step 5: Stir to combine and cook 2 to 3 minutes longer, until fragrant. Step 6: Take from heat and stir in cilantro and chicken. Step 7: Set aside If you are using flour tortillas: Lay tortilla on work surface and spread 2 or 3 tablespoons of chicken mixture over bottom third. Step 8: Top with cheese and roll up.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, ketchup, brown sugar, paprika, garlic, head romaine lettuce, black beans, white corn kernels, tomatoes, red onion, carrot, ranch dressing, cheddar cheese, bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts into three inch strips. Step 2: Place in large, preheated skillet with oil While chicken is cooking, make bbq sauce by whisking ketchup, brown sugar, garlic, and paprika. Step 3: Once chicken is cooked through and slightly browned, turn down heat on skillet and drizzle chicken with sauce and cook until coated and slightly candied. Step 4: Place chicken in fridge to cool For salad, clean romaine and chop in bite sized pieces. Step 5: Layer in bottom of large, shallow serving bowl. Step 6: Sprinkle romaine with beans, corn, onion and carrots. Step 7: Drizzle with ranch dressing You can use more or less dressing as you prefer.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, garlic cloves, peppercorns, jalapeno, water, oil, cilantro, salsa, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken in a large dutch oven or pot. Step 2: Add sliced onion, quartered garlic, peppercorns, and jalepeno. Step 3: Add enough cups of water to cover by about 1 inch. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then let simmer for 45 minutes. Step 5: Take chicken out and set aside. Step 6: Strain cooking liquid, saving water, but throwing away aromatics Shred chicken. Step 7: Put oil in saucepan and saute onion and garlic for a few minutes. Step 8: Add shredded chicken, salsa, cilantro, and chicken broth to cover. Step 9: Cook down an hour and a half until most liquid is gone.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red peppers, onion, garlic cloves, beef sirloin steaks, cumin, chili powder, salt, thick & chunky salsa, fajita-size flour tortillas, sour cream, fresh cilantro, guacamole, cheddar cheese, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Heat vegetable oil in large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Cook meat until done. Step 3: Stir in peppers, onion and garlic. Step 4: Add cumin, chilli powder and salt, stir in salsa, heat through. Step 5: Serve in tortillas. Step 6: Top with sour cream, cilantro, guacamole, cheese and a squeeze of lime juice.

Dish Name: Beef Or Chicken Or Turkey Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: chili powder, salt, cumin, garlic, water, no-added-salt tomato paste, tabasco sauce, flour tortillas, ground beef, onion, cheddar cheese, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees In medium saucepan, combine first 7 ingredients. Step 2: Simmer for 20 minutes In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion, drain excess fat, remove from heat. Step 3: Add 1 cup shredded cheese, 1 cup tomato paste mixture and olives. Step 4: Pour the remaining tomato paste mixture into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish. Step 5: Spoon about 2 heaping tablespoonfuls of beef mixture down center of each tortilla. Step 6: Fold or roll tortilla around filling.

Dish Name: Best Chicken Or Steak Fajitas Ever
Ingredient Names: hot sauce, ground cumin, allspice, chili powder, fresh oregano, thyme, beer, olive oil, steak, onion, green bell pepper, poblano chiles, salt & pepper, tomatoes, serrano peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Mix marinade and set aside Coat meat or poultry and let sit. Step 2: Mix together pico de gallo in small bowl and set aside In saucepan, drizzle with olive oil over med-high heat. Step 3: Add onions, peppers and chiles- toss occasionally and turn off heat once tender In second skillet over high heat, drop meat or poultry in and sear for 2 mins each side. Step 4: Remove from heat, slice thin and return to pan to brown and cook through Warm tortillas according to package, fill with meat, poultry, peppers and pico de gallo- mmmm!

Dish Name: Best Easiest Low Fat Chicken Verde Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce, sweet corn, mexican blend cheese, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the chicken breasts in water until done While the chicken breasts are boiling, coat a frying pan in oil to fry tortillas to medium brown You'll want them firm. Step 2: Drain chicken and shred. Step 3: Add 1 / 2 of the verde enchilada sauce to the chicken and mix. Step 4: Put 4 tortillas on the bottom. Step 5: Spoon 1 / 2 the chicken mixture. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 can of sweet corn. Step 7: Add 1 / 3 bag of cheese. Step 8: Repeat with 4 tortillas,.

Dish Name: Better Than Del Taco Chicken Soft Tacos
Ingredient Names: chicken, limes, garlic cloves, taco seasoning mix, vegetable oil, brown sugar, buttermilk ranch dressing, sour cream, lime juice, garlic powder, salt, iceberg lettuce, roma tomatoes, shredded cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: For sauce combine ranch dressing, sour cream, lime juice, garlic powder and salt and whisk well. Step 2: Refrigerate and store up to 3 weeks Chicken: Cut the chicken into 1 inch pieces. Step 3: In a bowl, add lime juice, garlic, taco seasoning mix, 1 tablespoon of oil and brown sugar. Step 4: Whisk well and add the cut up chicken. Step 5: Cover and marinate for 4-6 hours. Step 6: In a pan over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil. Step 7: Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and cooked through.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, oregano, green chilies, cooked chicken, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, onions, cooking oil, salt, corn tortillas, garlic clove, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat 2 tbsp oil in skillet. Step 2: Saute green chilies with minced garlic & chopped onion in oil. Step 3: Drain and break up tomatoes Reserve 1 / 2 cup liquid. Step 4: Add tomatoes, 1 tsp salt, oregano and reserved tomato liquid. Step 5: Simmer, uncovered until thick, about 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove sauce from skillet and set aside. Step 7: Combine chicken with sour cream, cheese and remaining salt. Step 8: Heat 1 / 3 cup oil. Step 9: Dip tortillas in oil until they become limp.

Dish Name: Black And White Bean Chicken Chili
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic clove, flour, chili powder, cumin, salt, milk, chicken broth, white shoepeg corn, white beans, black beans, cooked chicken, green chilies, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in dutch oven or large saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onions and garlic. Step 3: Cook until onions are tender. Step 4: Stir in flour, chili powder, cumin and salt Gradually stir in chicken broth until thickened. Step 5: Add 2 cups of milk and continue stirring. Step 6: Add remaining ingredients except cilantro, stir to combine. Step 7: Bring to a low boil, but watch for scorching of milk, reduce heat.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, chili oil, tequila, chili powder, blackening seasoning, cayenne pepper, black pepper, paprika, olive oil, flour, low sodium chicken broth, low-fat condensed cream of chicken soup, black beans, cooking spray, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in thin strips that are quite small, bite size! Step 2: Combine with chili oil and tequila in a quart size ziploc and marinate in the refrigerator While it's marinating, measure out the five spices and stir them together in a small dish. Step 3: Put a skillet on your stove's high setting and add the chicken. Step 4: Sprinkle half the spice mix over the top and cook for five minutes total - flipping the chicken and shaking the rest of the spices on top halfway through. Step 5: Remove pan from the heat and turn the heat down to low Move the chicken from the pan to a bowl. Step 6: Return the pan to the heat. Step 7: Add the 1 t olive oil and scrape the blackening spice residue into it, then shake in the flour to create a roux. Step 8: Then carefully pour in the chicken stock, stirring continuously to create a smooth sauce.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, onion, garlic cloves, cooked chicken breasts, black beans, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, salsa de chile fresco, corn tortillas, queso blanco
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450. Step 2: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat Coat pan with cooking spray, add onion. Step 3: Saute 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Step 4: Add garlic, saute 1 minute. Step 5: Add chicken, cook 30 seconds. Step 6: Transfer mixture to a medium bowl, stir in beans. Step 7: Add broth and salsa to pan, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, black beans, salsa, taco seasoning, cheese, flour tortillas, sour cream, guacamole, chili powder, vegetable oil, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Saute chicken and onion over med-high heat until chicken is no longer pink and onions are transparent In food processor or blender, combine black beans, salsa, and taco seasoning and blend until creamy Distribute beans evenly between 5 tortillas and spread to about 1 / 4 inch of the edge Distribute cooked chicken and onion over beans, and sprinkle with cheese. Step 2: Top with the other tortillas and cook quesadillas over med-high heat until golden brown, flipping once You can use vegetable oil or cooking spray when cooking quesadillas While cooking quesadillas, mix sour cream with chili powder and taco seasoning to taste This makes a killer sour cream dip for the quesadillas. Step 3: Serve hot with sour cream dip, guacamole, and salsa Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, chili powder, cumin, black pepper, thyme, tomato sauce, black beans, zucchini, corn niblets, onion, garlic cloves, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken breasts with chili powder, cumin, pepper and thyme. Step 2: Grill 5 minutes on each side, or till cooked thoroughly Shred chicken into small pieces and reserve On stovetop, in a large pot, saute onions, zucchini, corn and garlic in a bit of oil on med-low heat for about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add black beans and spices, and saute another two minutes. Step 4: Add tomato sauce and let simmer, covered, for about 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Stir in chicken and let simer, covered for another 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Blackened Chicken Quesadillas Cranberry Mango Salsa
Ingredient Names: blackening seasoning, boneless skinless chicken breasts, peanut oil, onion, vegetable oil, fresh basil, honey, chicken broth, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese, cranberries, light brown sugar, granulated sugar, water, mango
Instructions: Step 1: For the salsa: Toss the cranberries with the brown sugar then chop coarsley in a food processor, transfer to a heat resistant bowl and set aside. Step 2: In a saucepan, combine granulated sugar and water over medium-high heat. Step 3: Bring to a boil while stirring. Step 4: Once boiling, stop stirring and allow to cook for 3 minutes, then immediately pour syrup over cranberries and allow to cool completely. Step 5: Meanwhile, peel and dice kiwi and mango. Step 6: Combine mango, kiwi, red onion, cilantro, lime juice, serrano chile, garlic and honey. Step 7: Mix well and add to cranberry mixture. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend For the quesadillas:.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, lemon juice, lime zest, pineapple juice, sea salt, sugar, onion, fresh cilantro, serrano peppers, garlic, dried ancho chile powder, dried oregano, ground cumin, nutmeg, allspice berries
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a large non-reactive bowl, then add one gallon of water and stir until the salt and sugar are fully dissolved. Step 2: Pour over the meat and marinate in the fridge for at least 24 and up to 48 hours. Step 3: Make sure the entire bird is covered with the liquid, if not, you will need to turn it every few hours. Step 4: Discard brine after done marinating, and gently pat the bird dry before cooking The bird can be rubbed with oil and seasoned with your favorite spices after, or just cooked 'as is'.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, diced tomatoes, corn, black beans, black olives, sour cream, jalapeno, cilantro, burrito-size flour tortillas, salsa, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sized skillet, cook chicken Open cans and drain all items except the tomatoes. Step 2: After chicken is cooked, add tomatoes, corn, beans, olives, jalapenos, cilantro, cup salsa, and cup sour cream. Step 3: Mix so sour cream is dispersed and let simmer for 10 minutes or until ingredients are heated thoroughly. Step 4: Then w / a slotted spoon, divide skillet mixture and cheese into 6 burrito tortillas. Step 5: Wrap burritos, and place into a 13 x 9 baking dish sprayed with cooking spray. Step 6: Pour remaining liquid from skillet over burritos, top with cheese. Step 7: Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and tortillas have crisped up a bit, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: dried ancho chiles, red chili peppers, sesame seeds, anise seed, cumin seed, coriander seed, whole cloves, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick, cooking oil, raisins, whole almonds, corn tortilla, onion, plum tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the chile, remove stem and seeds. Step 2: Place in a medium bowl and cover with warm water. Step 3: Let stand for 30 minutes While chile is soaking, add the sesame seeds and spices to a large skillet and toast over moderately low heat, stirring until fragrant. Step 4: Place toasted mixture in a grinder and process to a fine powder. Step 5: Set aside In the same skillet add in 1 tablespoon oil and warm slightly. Step 6: Stir in raisins, almonds and tortilla. Step 7: Cook over low heat until almonds are toasted and raisins plump. Step 8: Transfer to a large bowl and set aside.

Dish Name: Breast Of Chicken Oaxaca Fried Chicken In Chipotle Sauce
Ingredient Names: hot water, chicken bouillon granule, chipotle chiles in adobo, low-fat sour cream, lime juice, avocado, boneless skinless chicken breasts, asadero cheese, salt, pepper, flour, egg whites, seasoned bread crumbs, vegetable oil, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: T prepare the sauce: combine first 3 ingredients in a blender Process until smooth, pour into a bowl. Step 2: Stir in sour cream and 1 tablespoon lime juice To prepare the chicken: toss avocado with 1 tablespoon lime juice. Step 3: Cut a horizontal slit through thickest portion of each chicken breast to form a pocket. Step 4: Stuff avocado slice and 2 tablespoons of cheese into each pocket. Step 5: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper, dredge in flour then dip in egg whites and dredge in breadcrumbs. Step 6: Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, add chicken.

Dish Name: Broiled Chipotle Chicken With Creamy Spinach
Ingredient Names: chipotle chiles in adobo, crema, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, chicken stock, spinach, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Marinating the chicken: combine the chopped canned chipotles with 2 tablespoons of the cream Smear over the chicken breasts, cover and refrigerate for several hours, if time permits, for the chilies to season the chicken Finishing the dish: lay the chicken breasts in a broiler-proof baking dish just large enough to hold them comfortably. Step 2: Set 6 inches below a very hot broiler and cook until richly brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Turn the breasts over, drizzle the remaining 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons cream around them and set under the broiler. Step 4: Cook until the chicken is deep golden and no longer squishy feeling when lightly pressed, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 5: Transfer the chicken to 4 warm dinner plates and keep warm in a low oven Scrape the cream mixture into a medium-large saucepan and add the broth and the spinach. Step 6: Bring to a boil over high heat and cook, stirring nearly constantly, until the spinach is wilted and the cream is reduced and thick, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Taste and season with salt, then spoon around the chicken breasts and serve right away.

Dish Name: Buffalo Chicken Burritos A La Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, buffalo wings seasoning blend, water, sour cream substitute, diced green chilies, black beans, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Put everything into crock, except for chicken and tortillas, and mix around. Step 2: Then add chicken in and cook for 6-8 hours. Step 3: Take chicken out and shred. Step 4: Put back in and get all pieces moist. Step 5: Put on table and let people serve themselves.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, vegetable oil, onion, ground cloves, dried oregano, tomatoes with juice, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, wheat flour tortillas, salt, fresh oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to the boil. Step 2: Add the rice and cook for 8 minutes. Step 3: Drain, rinse and then drain again. Step 4: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the onion with the ground cloves and oregano, fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the rice and tomatoes and cook over a low heat until all the tomato juice has been absorbed, set the pan aside. Step 6: Put the chicken breasts in a large saucepan, pour in enough water to cover and bring to the boil. Step 7: Lower the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through Lift the chicken out of the pan, put on a plate and cool slightly. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 325f degrees Shred the chicken by pulling the flesh apart with two forks, then add the chicken to the rice mixture, with the grated cheese.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, calabaza squash, zucchini, yellow squash, tomatoes, yellow onion, cooking oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, cumin, whole kernel corn, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Wash chicken and boil until cooked, set aside. Step 2: Wash all the squash, cut up into cubes, set aside. Step 3: Wash tomato, cut up into cubes, set aside. Step 4: Cut onion into cubes, set aside. Step 5: Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder and cumin in a bowl, set aside Get a large pan, add 2 tbs cooking oil, tomato, cubed squash and cubed onion On medium high heat sautee for approximately 10 minutes or until you can see that everything is nice and tender, add drained corn, add tomato sauce. Step 6: Add dry spice mixture.

Dish Name: Caldo De Pollo Mexican Chicken Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, green cabbage, garlic cloves, chayotes, corn on the cob, carrots, potatoes, celery ribs, bay leaves, water, salt and pepper, cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and dry chicken and place in stockpot. Step 2: Add the corn on the cob nibblers with the chicken. Step 3: Cover with water and season with salt. Step 4: Add onion, bay leaves and garlic and let simmer for about 20 minutes. Step 5: Add the carrots, celery ribs, chayote, and potatoes and cook until vegetables are near tender. Step 6: Add the cabbage, add more salt if needed and add pepper. Step 7: Let simmer for about 5-10 minutes until cabbage is tender. Step 8: Serve and garnish with cilantro, diced onion, and lime wedges Adjust to taste with lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, vegetable broth, chipotle chiles in adobo, white rice, garbanzo beans, cooked chicken, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stockpot, combine chicken broth, vegetable broth and approximately 4 cups water. Step 2: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 3: Add rice and simmer, covered, until rice is done, about 20 minutes Empty can of chipotle peppers with sauce into blender and blend until very smooth. Step 4: Using a small strainer, carefully strain about 1-2 tablespoons of chipotle mixture into soup Be careful with this & test broth as you mix peppers in, it makes broth very spicy!
