Step 5: Add garbanzo beans, chicken meat and simmer 5 minutes more, adding salt to taste Garnish soup with cilantro or epazote leaves and enjoy!

Dish Name: Caldo Tlapeo A Mexican Chicken And Rice Soup
Ingredient Names: whole chicken, cooked rice, carrots, monterey jack cheese, water, avocado, chili, chicken bouillon
Instructions: Step 1: In a water filled, large pot and in advance of all other preparations, boil the chicken. Step 2: After the chicken is cooked thoroughly, remove the chicken from the broth. Step 3: After letting the chicken cool, remove skin and pull all the meat from the bones Skim the chicken fat off of the chicken broth that you created when you boiled your chicken I usually do all of the above the night before, and i refrigerate the chicken meat and hold the chicken broth in reserve Pick or dice the chicken meat into pieces that are no larger than half the spoon the soup will be eaten with. Step 4: Heat broth and add the diced carrots. Step 5: Bring the broth to a boil and then reduce the heat to simmer and cook carrots for 15 minutes Increase heat to medium-low and add prepared rice and chicken In each bowl, and before serving add 8-12 cubes of cheese, of an avocado.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, cheddar cheese soup, chunky salsa, flour tortillas, campbell's condensed chicken broth, water, minute white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f In medium nonstick skillet over medium-heat, cook chicken 5 minutes or until no longer pink and juices evaporate, stirring often. Step 2: Add soup and salsa. Step 3: Heat to a boil, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Place tortillas on 2 baking sheets. Step 5: Top half of each tortilla with about 1 / 3 cup soup mixture. Step 6: Spread to within 1 / 2 inch of edge Moisten edges of tortilla with water. Step 7: Fold over and press edges together, bake 5 min.

Ingredient Names: campbell's cream of chicken soup, sour cream, pace picante sauce, chili powder, cooked chicken, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas, tomatoes, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Stir the soup, sour cream, picante sauce and chili powder in a medium bowl. Step 3: In a large bowl, stir chicken, cheese and 1 cup of picante mixture. Step 4: Spread about 1 / 4 cup chicken mixture down the center of each tortilla. Step 5: Roll up and place, seam down, in a 13x9 baking dish. Step 6: Pour remaining picante sauce mixture over the filled tortillas. Step 7: Cover the baking dish with foil. Step 8: Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes or until the enchiladas are hot and bubbling. Step 9: Top with tomato and green onion and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless chicken breast, green pepper, campbell's cream of mushroom soup, chunky salsa, onion, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In medium skillet over medium-high heat, heat half the oil. Step 2: Add chicken and cook until browned and juices evaporate, stirring often, set chicken aside. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium, add remaining oil. Step 4: Add pepper and onion and cook until tender-crisp, pour off fat. Step 5: Add soup and salsa, heat to a boil. Step 6: Return chicken to pan and heat through.

Ingredient Names: creamy chicken verde soup, water, garlic powder, cooked chicken, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Thoroughly mix the soup, garlic powder, and chicken. Step 2: When mixed, slowly stir in the tortillas. Step 3: Pour the mixture into a 2-qt shallow baking pan. Step 4: Sprinkle the cheese over the mixture. Step 5: Cover and bake for 25 minutes or until hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breasts, yellow onion, garlic cloves, coriander, cumin, chili powder, cashew nuts, tomatoes, chicken stock, spinach, bittersweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken in pieces and fry them in 1 tbsp oil, set aside. Step 2: Fry onion, garlic and spices in 1 tbsp oil 4-5 minutes. Step 3: Chop the cashew nuts in a food processor until powdered. Step 4: Add cashews and chicken stock to the onion and spices. Step 5: Cook for 2 minutes until slightly thickened. Step 6: Add the tomatoes and cook for 20 minutes. Step 7: Add the chocolate and spinach, heat and taste. Step 8: Add salt or more spices if needed.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, light sour cream, canola oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salsa, chicken broth, creamy peanut butter, baking cocoa, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 250f. Step 2: Wrap corn tortillas in foil and place in oven. Step 3: Heat canola oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Step 4: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and add to skillet. Step 5: Cook, stirring often, until brown and no longer pink in the middle. Step 6: Drain fat, if any, and add salsa, chicken broth, peanut butter, baking cocoa, and spices. Step 7: Cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: Serve with tortillas and light sour cream I always serve this with spanish rice as well.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onion, red bell pepper, boneless skinless chicken thighs, green chilies, garlic cloves, tomatoes, frozen corn, taco sauce, green onions, flour tortillas, lettuce, sour cream, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the sunflower oil in a large pan and stir-fry the onion, bell pepper, and chicken thighs over a high heat for 3-4 minutes until well browned. Step 2: Stir in the chiles, garlic, tomatoes, and corn and cook for another 2-3 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Step 3: Stir in the taco sauce and green onions, and set aside to cool a little Warm one of the tortillas in a hot, dry frying pan until soft and flexible. Step 4: Spoon a quarter of the cooled chicken mixture into the center of a tortilla and fold over the edges to form a neat package Pin in place with wooden toothpicks and repeat with the remaining tortillas. Step 5: Heat 1 / 2 inch vegetable oil in a large frying pan and cook chimichangas for 2-3 minutes on each side until crisp and golden brown. Step 6: Drain on paper towels and serve hot with shredded lettuce, sour cream and guacamole.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, green chili peppers, cheddar cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and shred chicken. Step 2: Set aside Tear 8 tortillas into bite-sized pieces. Step 3: Layer into bottom of 13x9" glass pan. Step 4: Layer chicken, then cream of chicken soup, sour cream, chiles, then the rest of the 8 tortillas. Step 5: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese and broil till golden and bubbly!

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, onion, cooked chicken breasts, reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, picante sauce, neufchatel cheese, cumin, green taco sauce, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and saute onions until soft. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix chicken, 1 / 2 c Cheddar, picante sauce and cream cheese Addto onions and cook over low heat until cheese begins to melt. Step 3: Spoon about 1 / 3 cup filling on each tortilla ands roll up. Step 4: Place enchiladas in a 9x13 baking dish. Step 5: Drizzle with taco sauce and remaining cheese If you are going ahead and eating now cover and bake at 350f 15 minutes If you are pulling from the freezer, thaw in the refrigerator then bake.

Dish Name: Cheesecake Factory Chicken Tortilla Soup Copycat
Ingredient Names: whole chicken, water, carrots, celery ribs, onion, garlic, salt, white pepper, black pepper, cayenne pepper, cumin, cilantro, rotel tomatoes, heavy whipping cream, corn
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer chicken in water, 3 carrots, 3 celery, 1 / 2 onion, 2 tbsp garlic, salt and white and black peppers for 2 hours. Step 2: Remove chicken and allow to cool. Step 3: Meanwhile, remove all the excess fat and the vegetables used to simmer the chicken in and discard. Step 4: Add a fresh batch of veggies to the pot. Step 5: Add rotel, cilantro, corn, and cumin to the pot, stir well. Step 6: Remove chicken from the bone and add to the pot. Step 7: Add cream just to get color and thickness. Step 8: Cut tortillas in strips and fry in peanut oil. Step 9: Put tortillas in bottom of bowl, sprinkle with cheese and pour soup on top.

Ingredient Names: condensed cheddar cheese soup, water, salsa, white rice, boneless skinless chicken, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Mix soup, water, salsa, rice and chicken in slow cooker Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours or until done Serve on tortillas.

Ingredient Names: onion, oil, mexican-style stewed tomatoes, oregano, cooked chicken, green chilies, red wine vinegar, flour tortilla, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 In large pan, cook onion in oil until tender crisp. Step 2: Drain the tomatoes and chilies, reserving the liquid. Step 3: Add liquid and oregano to pan. Step 4: Cook at high heat for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Stir in chicken and chilies, remove from heat. Step 6: Spoon mixture onto each tortilla and roll up. Step 7: Place in 9x13-inch pan. Step 8: Chop tomatoes then stir in vinegar.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, black pepper, cheddar cheese, cream cheese, crescent rolls
Instructions: Step 1: In bowl, shred chicken with fork and mix in pepper, cheddar, and cream cheese. Step 2: Mix well If using crescents, unroll and seal together and Flatten with a rolling pin. Step 3: Using about a 3 1 / 2 inch circle cutter, cut out circles from the dough Reroll and recut until all the dough has been used If using biscuits, just flatten. Step 4: Place about 1 tbsp of chicken mixture into center of each circle. Step 5: Fold into a half moon shape and seal edges by pressing down all the way around with a fork Apply a thin layer of butter or spray with butter flavored cooking spray on top of each empanada.

Ingredient Names: chicken, cream of chicken soup, tomato sauce, milk, sour cream, red chili powder, cumin, onion powder, cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a large pot combine chicken, soup, tomato sauce, milk, sour cream, and spices. Step 3: Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally The longer it simmers, the tastier it gets! Step 4: Remove sauce from heat Get out a 13x9 cake pan. Step 5: Put a thin layer of the sauce mix at the bottom of the pan - just enough to coat the bottom. Step 6: Put a layer of corn tortillas on the bottom of the pan. Step 7: Sprinkle about a third of the cheese on top of the tortillas. Step 8: Pour half of the remaining sauce on top of the cheese.

Ingredient Names: onion, cooked chicken breasts, reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, picante sauce, low-fat cream cheese, ground cumin, flour tortillas, green taco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Place a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat until hot. Step 3: Add onion, and saut 6 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Add chicken, 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese, picante sauce, cream cheese, and cumin. Step 5: Cook 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Step 6: Spoon about 1 / 3 cup chicken mixture down center of each tortilla, and roll up. Step 7: Place enchiladas in a 13 9-inch baking dish. Step 8: Drizzle with taco sauce, and sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, salt and pepper, condensed cheddar cheese soup, chunky salsa, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper and cook in lightly greased skillet until cooked through and juices evaporate, stirring often. Step 3: Add soup and salsa and heat through. Step 4: Spread about 1 / 3 cup of mixture on half of each tortilla, leaving a 1 / 2 inch edge Moisten edges with water, fold tortillas over and press edges to seal. Step 5: Place on baking sheets, bake 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, cheddar cheese, monterey jack pepper cheese, diced green chilies, sour cream, garlic powder, chili powder, onion powder, green enchilada sauce, flour tortillas, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Lightly coat with oil or cooking spray a large 9x13 baking dish. Step 2: In a large bowl combine, chicken, 1 1 / 2 cup of cheddar cheese, 1 / 1 / 2 cup of pepper jack cheese, diced green chillies, 2 cups of sour cream, garlic powder, chili powder and onion powder. Step 3: Mix until well combined To assemble, have a large bowl ready with the green enchilada sauce in it and a plate to roll the enchiladas on. Step 4: Take a flour tortilla and dip it into the bowl containing the sauce until it's all covered. Step 5: Then place on the plate and almost on the edge of one side of the tortilla add 1 / 4- 1 / 2 cup of the chicken filling depending on how full you want them to be. Step 6: Take the tortilla with the filling on it and roll it into a tube and lay in greased baking dish. Step 7: Repeat until you have either no room left in your pan or your out of filling With the remaining sauce pour over enchiladas and smooth out on top until there is a thin layer of sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken, hominy, diced green chilies, garlic powder, pepper, dried parsley, velveeta reduced fat cheese product
Instructions: Step 1: Do not drain cans Combine everything except cheese When heated, add cheese and continue breaking it up with spoon while stirring Heat until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: ground black pepper, ground red pepper, paprika, garlic powder, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, butter, green chilies, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the black and red pepper, paprika and garlic powder. Step 2: Sprinkle evenly over chicken. Step 3: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes on each side or until golden brown, remove from heat. Step 5: Top with chiles and cheese. Step 6: Cover and let stand 2-3 minutes or until cheese melts. Step 7: Sprinkle with additional paprika.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cheese, oregano, cornmeal, chili powder, flour, eggs, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breasts until they are about 1 / 8" thick. Step 2: Place 1 / 3 cup cheese in center of chicken, then sprinkle with 1 / 2 tsp Oregano. Step 3: Fold the sides over to seal in the cheese, then roll up and secure with toothpicks. Step 4: Combine cornmeal and chili powder in a shallow dish or plate. Step 5: Place the flour on another plate. Step 6: Beat the eggs slightly and place in another shallow dish Lightly coat the chicken rolls with flour, dip in the egg, then in the cornmeal. Step 7: Chill for about an hour. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: cilantro, tomato sauce, chicken broth, ground cumin, tomatoes, cayenne pepper, poblano peppers, coriander, boneless skinless chicken breasts, smoked paprika, garlic cloves, salt, corn tortillas, black pepper, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200. Step 2: Place tortillas on baking sheet. Step 3: When oven is preheated, place tortillas in oven for 15-20 minutes, flipping once, to dry out. Step 4: When tortillas are dried out, cut into inch wide by 2 inch strips. Step 5: Boil chicken breasts in the chicken broth until they turn white in color and float. Step 6: Chop onion, tomatoes, and garlic, set aside in bowl, chop cilantro. Step 7: Set aside in another bowl. Step 8: Place poblano peppers under broiler or over the flame from a gas stove burner until the skin turns black in color.

Dish Name: Chez Jose Lime Chicken White Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: roasting chicken, onion, dry white wine, chicken broth, garlic cloves, white pepper, dried oregano, salt, limes, half-and-half, cayenne pepper, lime, corn tortillas, sour cream, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken, onion, wine, chicken broth, garlic, white pepper, oregano, 2 teaspoons of salt and the juice from 1-1 / 2 limes, and enough water to cover chicken. Step 2: Simmer until meat falls off the bone. Step 3: Remove chicken from pot, into bowl, with a slotted spoon and allow to cool until you can handle it easily. Step 4: Remove bones from the chicken. Step 5: Discard bones Reserve meat This can even be done the night before Save the stock, it makes into a wonderful chicken soup, later. Step 6: In a small bowl stir sour cream, the half and half, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, a good pinch of cayenne pepper, remaining lime juice and rind together Lightly grease microwave proof casserole dish that is big enough to lay an 8 inch corn tortilla in it flat.

Ingredient Names: chicken thigh, yellow onion, garlic cloves, jalapeno peppers, fresh cilantro, celery rib, carrot, water, olive oil, garlic, corn tortillas, chili powder, ground cumin, dried oregano leaves, fresh tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken thighs, chopped onion, garlic cloves, halved jalapeno, whole cilantro stems, celery, carrot and water in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Reduce the heat to low and simmer gently for 1 hour. Step 4: Strain the stock, reserving the cooking liquid and the chicken thighs separately. Step 5: Discard the other solids. Step 6: When the chicken thighs are cool enough to handle, remove the meat Dice and reserve it. Step 7: Heat the olive oil in a large nonreactive saucepan set over medium heat until it ripples. Step 8: Add the minced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Add the minced garlic and minced jalapeno and cook for 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, shallots, chorizo, chicken breasts, plum tomatoes, soft tortillas, cheddar, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the shallot and chorizo for 5 mins until the shallot is softened. Stir in the chicken and tomatoes. Remove from the heat. Step 2: Put half the tortillas onto baking sheets. Spread a little chicken mixture on each one. Scatter over the cheese and coriander. Sandwich with the remaining tortillas. You can make up to this point 2 hrs ahead. Step 3: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Cook the tortillas for 3 mins. Using a fish slice, turn each one over. Cook for 3 mins more until both sides are golden. Put on a board, slice into wedges and serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomatoes, jalapeno, white onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, chili powder, fresh cilantro, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a medium size skillet, add the garlic and saute for a moment. Step 2: Season the chicken with salt & pepper and brown in the skillet along with the garlic. Step 3: When the chicken is evenly browned on both sides, add the rest of the ingredients and let it simmer for about 15 minutes. Step 4: When all the flavors are combined, serve with spanish rice & warm tortillas.

Ingredient Names: onion, butter, cooked chicken, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, sliced mushrooms, green chilies, oregano, salt, pepper, flour tortillas, sharp cheddar cheese, milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender. Step 2: Stir in chicken, soup, sour cream, mushrooms, green chiles, oregano, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Spoon approx 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture in center of each tortilla. Step 4: Roll up and place seam side down in a lightly greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Step 5: Combine topping ingredients. Step 6: Spoon over tortillas. Step 7: Bake, uncovered at 350f for 35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken pieces, onion, garlic, serrano chilies, salt, black pepper, chicken stock, almonds, cilantro, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken on all sides in oil in a large pot. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, and serranos to the pot. Step 3: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 4: Add stock, then simmer, covered, over low heat, for about 1 hour, or until chicken is tender. Step 5: In a blender or food processor, combine almonds, sliced garlic, and 1 / 2 cup of cooking liquid Process into a coarse paste. Step 6: Remove chicken from pot and add paste to the pot and cook until sauce has reduced and thickened. Step 7: Place chicken on a platter and cover with sauce and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Chicken And Black Bean Guacamole Tostadas
Ingredient Names: avocado, fresh lime juice, canned black beans, green onions, hot pepper sauce, chicken breast halves, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, lime juice, tostadas, lettuce, goat cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Place avocado in medium bowl. Step 2: Add lime juice and mash until almost smooth. Step 3: Mix in beans and green onions. Step 4: Season guacamole to taste with hot sauce, salt and pepper. Step 5: Combine shredded chicken, tomato, cilantro and cumin in small bowl. Step 6: Season chicken mixture to taste with lime juice, salt and pepper. Step 7: Arrange tostada shells on plates. Step 8: Top with lettuce, guacamole and chicken mixture. Step 9: Sprinkle with goat cheese. Step 10: Spoon salsa over and serve.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese, cooked chicken, ground cumin, chunky salsa, vegetable oil, guacamole, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken, cheese and cumin in a small bowl. Step 2: Place about 1 / 4 of the chicken mixture on each tortilla. Step 3: Top with 1 tablespoon salsa. Step 4: Roll tightly and secure with a toothpick, brush with oil. Step 5: Cook filled tortillas over medium heat in a 10 inch skillet 4 to 6 minutes, turning occasionally until filling is hot and tortillas are toasted. Step 6: Remove toothpicks and serve with guacamole and sour cream if desired.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground chicken, salt, ground cumin, taco shells, chorizo sausages, scallions, salt & freshly ground black pepper, tomatoes, iceberg lettuce, cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Heat oil in a nonstick frying pan. Step 3: Add the chicken, salt and cumin and fry over a medium heat until the chicken is cooked through, 5 to 8 minutes. Step 4: Stir frequently to prevent large lumps from forming. Step 5: Meanwhile, arrange the taco shells in one layer on a large baking sheet and heat in the oven for about 8 to 10 minutes, or according to package directions. Step 6: Add the chorizo and the scallions to the chicken mixture and stir to combine. Step 7: Cook until just warmed through, stirring occasionally. Step 8: Add salt and freshly ground black pepper if desired, to taste To assemble the tacos, place 1 to 2 spoonfuls of the chicken mixture in the bottom of a warm taco shell. Step 9: Top with a generous sprinkle of chopped tomato, shredded iceberg and grated cheddar cheese.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, red onions, frozen corn kernels, sour cream, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, monterey jack pepper cheese, salsa, red enchilada sauce, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly oil 15x10x2-inch glass baking dish. Step 2: Mix first 6 ingredients and 1 cup cheese in medium bowl. Step 3: Season chicken filling to taste with salt and pepper. Step 4: Mix salsa and enchilada sauce in large bowl. Step 5: Heat heavy medium skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add 1 tortilla and cook until heated through, about 10 seconds per side. Step 7: Brush tortilla with some of sauce mixture. Step 8: Spoon 1 / 3 cup chicken filling into center of tortilla, roll up. Step 9: Place seam side down in prepared baking dish.

Dish Name: Chicken And Green Chile Enchiladas With Goat Cheese Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: white corn tortillas, chicken breasts, sour cream, goat cheese, diced green chilis, salt, black pepper, monterey jack cheese, half-and-half
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together 1 cup of sour cream, chicken, 1 tbsp of the goat cheese, green chilies, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Place two corn tortillas in glass baking dish. Step 3: Top with 1 / 3 of chicken filling, and then with some of the monterey jack cheese. Step 4: Repeat this process, ending with tortillas. Step 5: Whisk together the remaining sour cream, half and half, and remaining goat cheese. Step 6: Pour over top layer of tortillas and top with remaining monterey jack. Step 7: Cover with foil and bake at 350f for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, green chilies, light sour cream, taco cheese, corn tortillas, red enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Mix chicken, chilies and 1 cup each sour cream and cheese. Step 3: Spoon down centers of tortillas, roll up. Step 4: Spread 1 cup sauce onto bottom of 13x9 pan. Step 5: Add enchiladas, seam-sides down. Step 6: Top with remaining sauce, cover. Step 7: Bake 20 minutes or until heated through. Step 8: Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: green onions, lime juice, salt, chicken, green peas, mayonnaise, carrot, celery, fresh cilantro, orange juice, cinnamon, black pepper, lettuce leaves, oranges, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle green onions with lime juice and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt. Step 2: Cover & refrigerate. Step 3: Mix remaining ingredients except lettuce, oranges & avocados. Step 4: Cover & refrigerate at least 1 hour. Step 5: Spoon chicken mixture onto lettuce. Step 6: Garnish with oranges & avocados. Step 7: Sprinkle with green onions.

Dish Name: Chicken And Poblano Quesadillas With Guacamole
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, fresh basil leaf, extra virgin olive oil, tequila, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, hass avocadoes, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, poblano chiles, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, mince the garlic and jalapeno. Step 2: Add the remaining paste ingredients, process until smooth Smear the paste on all sides of the chicken breasts. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Step 4: In a medium bowl, mash the avocado with the back of a fork and immediately add the lime juice. Step 5: Mix well Roughly chop the garlic, Then sprinkle the salt over the garlic and, using the side of a knife, crush the garlic with the salt until you create smooth paste. Step 6: Add the Garlic mixture, cilantro, and pepper to the bowl.

Ingredient Names: cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, chicken, refried beans, salsa, oil, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine both cheeses. Step 2: Combine chicken, refried beans and salsa. Step 3: Add 3 cups of combined cheeses. Step 4: Heat oil in small skillet Soften each tortilla in oil, approximately 5 seconds per side. Step 5: Dip in enchilada sauce Immediately fill with some of chicken mixture. Step 6: Roll and place in 13x9 pan. Step 7: Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling. Step 8: Top enchiladas with remaining sauce and cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, chili powder, cumin, oil, refried beans, tomatoes, onion, jalapenos, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, pam cooking spray, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Trim breast and pound to 1 / 4 inch cutlets Completely coat cutlets in a 50 / 50 mixture of chili powder and cumin. Step 2: In a large pre-heated oil-coated skillet, fry cutlets until cooked through over med-high heat. Step 3: Let cutlets cool for 10-15 minutes then cut into bite-size strips. Step 4: Heat refried beans over low heat while letting chicken cool and cutting vegetables Dice tomato into bite-size pieces Mince onion and jalapenos. Step 5: When chicken is able to be handled comfortably and beans are heated through, you can begin assembly. Step 6: Spread 1 / 4 of the refried beans on one side of tortilla leaving about a 1 / 2 to 1 inch of uncoated tortilla around the edges. Step 7: Fill the center of bean coated tortilla with chicken, tomatoes, onions, jalapenos, and cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, white rice, water, taco seasoning, salsa, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a 9 x 13 x 2 baking dish add rice, salsa and taco seasoning. Step 2: Layer chicken on top of rice. Step 3: Pour water over everything and bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes. Step 4: Remove from oven and add shredded cheese and bake until cheese is melted. Step 5: Top each serving with a dollop of sour cream, if desired.

Dish Name: Chicken And Rice With Black Bean Salsa
Ingredient Names: salsa, black beans, cheddar cheese, brown rice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 First, start your rice Brown rice can take up to 45 minutes to cook sometimes Time it accordingly so that the rice is finished by the time the main dish is finished. Step 2: Pour the salsa into the bottom of a 13" x 9" glass baking dish You can add extra if you want salsa leftover to mix into the rice Fillet the chicken breasts Lay them on top of the salsa. Step 3: Bake for 25 minutes. Step 4: Remove from the oven and pour the black beans in the baking dish.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, frozen chopped spinach, green onion, light sour cream, plain fat-free yogurt, all-purpose flour, ground cumin, salt, low-fat milk, green chili peppers, flour tortillas, monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, black beans, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a 3-quart saucepan place chicken in enough water to cover, bring to boiling, reduce heat. Step 2: Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Step 3: Remove chicken from saucepan. Step 4: When cool enough to handle, use a fork to shred chicken into bite-size pieces, set aside. Step 5: In a large bowl combine chicken, spinach, and green onions, set aside. Step 6: In a bowl combine sour cream, yogurt, flour, cumin, and salt.

Dish Name: Chicken And Tortillas In Chili Cheese Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, celery ribs, garlic, whole black peppercorns, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, cheese, green chilies, light sour cream, green onions, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Place chicken, chopped onion, celery, garlic slices and peppercorns in medium saucepan. Step 3: Cover with water and bring to boil over high heat. Step 4: Reduce heat and let simmer 20 minutes. Step 5: Remove chicken and cool slightly, shred chicken. Step 6: Toss tortilla strips and oil in large bowl. Step 7: Arrange on baking sheet and bake until crisp let cool slightly. Step 8: Transfer chicken to large bowl. Step 9: Add tortilla strips, cheese and chilis. Step 10: Stir to coat well.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, hass avocado, roma tomato, bacon, green onions, monterey jack cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, fresh cilantro, lime juice, salt, pepper, cumin, garlic powder, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except tortillas and lettuce. Step 2: Chill for 1 / 2 hour. Step 3: Spread 1 / 6 of mixture in each tortilla. Step 4: Top with 1 / 3 c lettuce and fold over to form a wrap.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, enchilada sauce, cream of chicken soup, whole kernel corn, sour cream, chunky salsa, minute rice, cheese, green chilies, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Boil chicken breasts until no longer pink in the middle. Step 3: Place cooked chicken breasts in food processor and give a few pulses to chop up Don't get it too fine If you don't have a food processor then shred the chicken by hand. Step 4: In a large bowl combine all of the ingredients except tortilla strips and 1 cup of cheese Also add in the chopped chicken, mix well. Step 5: Grease a 9x13 backing dish and place one layer of tortilla strips in bottom. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 3 of mixture on strips and spread evenly.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, pinto beans, chipotle salsa, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken and beans in crock pot. Step 2: Pour salsa over chicken and beans. Step 3: Cover and cook on low-heat for 5 to 6 hours or on high for 2 to 3 hours. Step 4: Transfer chicken to cutting board. Step 5: Using two forks, shred the chicken Use a potato masher to mash beans in crock pot. Step 6: Return chicken to cooker, stir in cheese to combine. Step 7: Divide chicken among tortillas, top with lettuce, tomato, sour cream, etc.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, yellow onion, peppercorn, garlic cloves, bay leaves, chicken bouillon cube, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, fresh cilantro, black beans, butter, flour, tomato paste, chili powder, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts in a skillet, cover with water, and add onion, peppercorns, garlic, bay leaves, and bouillon. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked, about 20 minutes, remove from broth. Step 3: Set aside and let cool. Step 4: When the chicken is cool, shred While chicken is cooking, melt 2 tbsp butter in medium sauce pan over medium heat. Step 5: Add flour and cook for 2-3 minutes, until roux starts to turn light brown. Step 6: Add tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and adobo, stir to combine. Step 7: Stir in chicken broth and 1 / 2 cup water.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast And Almond Soup Sopa De Pechuga De Pollo Y Almen
Ingredient Names: blanched almond, butter, onion, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, chicken stock, salt & freshly ground black pepper, nutmeg, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, dry sherry, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the chicken breast halves by simmering them in the chicken stock for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 2: Remove them and set them aside Saut the almonds in the butter over moderate heat until golden. Step 3: Place the almonds, onion, and one of the chicken breast halves in an electric blender or food processor, along with a little of the stock, and blend until pureed. Step 4: Add this mixture to the remaining stock, along with the nutmeg, cumin, and cayenne. Step 5: Add the second chicken breast half, cut into small pieces, and heat over moderate heat, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add the optional sherry just prior to serving. Step 7: Taste and adjust the seasoning. Step 8: Garnish with the chopped parsley.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast With Poblano Chile Strips And Cream
Ingredient Names: poblano chile, boneless chicken breast halves, olive oil, onion, creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Lay chiles on their sides on racks of gas burners, then turn flames on moderately high Roast chiles, turning with tongs, until skins are blistered, 4 to 6 minutes. Step 2: Transfer chiles immediately to a large sealable plastic bag and seal. Step 3: Let steam 10 minutes, then peel or rub off skins and discard stems, seeds, and ribs. Step 4: Rinse chiles and pat dry. Step 5: Cut chiles into 1 / 4-inch thick strips Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Heat 1 / 2 tablespoon oil in a heavy skillet over moderately-high heat until hot but not smoking. Step 7: Saute chicken skin or skinned sides down, until golden, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 8: Turn chicken over and saute 2 minutes more.

Dish Name: Chicken Breast With Roasted Tomatillo Sauce
Ingredient Names: tomatillo, jalapeno chile, olive oil, onion, garlic, chicken broth, brown sugar, cilantro leaf, chicken breast halves, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly oil a rimmed baking sheet or baking pan and roast tomatillos and jalapeno or chilies under a hot broiler, 4 inches or so from the heat source, 3 to 4 minutes, or until they are blistered and splotchy brown with, maybe, a few black spots. Step 2: Turn them and roast on the other side. Step 3: Cool, then transfer tomatillos and chilies to a food processor fitted with the metal blade or blender along with any of the juices on the pan Process or puree until smooth. Step 4: Meanwhile, over medium heat in a heavy-bottomed saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil. Step 5: Add onions and garlic and cook, stirring, about 6 minutes until golden brown. Step 6: Raise heat to medium high, add tomatillo puree and cook 3 minutes until sauce darkens and is very thick. Step 7: Add broth, brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup cilantro. Step 8: Stir, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes or until sauce thickens. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, vegetable oil, honey, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, tortilla chips, salsa, fresh cilantro, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lime juice, oil, and honey in shallow dish. Step 2: Dip chicken in lime mix Coat chicken with tortilla crumbs. Step 3: Place in ungreased 11x7 baking dish. Step 4: Bake, uncovered at 350 for 25 minutes. Step 5: Mix salsa and cilantro, pour over chicken. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 7: Bake for 6 minutes more.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, pepper, butter, oil, onions, whole green chilies, salsa, milk, sour cream, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken breasts with 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Step 2: Melt the butter and oil in a large skillet and saute the chicken lightly over moderate heat for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until they are lightly browned. Step 3: Remove the chicken from the pan In the same pan saute the onion for 5 minutes until soft but not browned. Step 4: Slice the chiles into long strips and add half of them to the pan with the onion. Step 5: Add the salsa and cook over a low flame for 8 - 10 minutes or until the sauce is thickened slightly. Step 6: Meanwhile, place the remaining sliced chiles in the blender with the milk and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt. Step 7: Blend at low speed until smooth. Step 8: Add the sour cream and blend again. Step 9: Place half the chicken on the bottom of a 2 quart casserole.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillets, salt and pepper, all-purpose flour, butter, salsa, chicken broth, garlic clove, cilantro, green chili pepper, ground cumin, sour cream, lettuce, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper to taste, then dredge with flour Shake off the excess. Step 2: Melt the butter in a skillet, then add the chicken and cook over medium-high heat, turning once, until golden but not cooked through-the chicken will continue to cook in the sauce. Step 3: Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. Step 4: Place the salsa, broth, garlic, cilantro, chili, and cumin in a pan and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat to a low simmer. Step 6: Add the chicken to the sauce, spooning the sauce over the chicken. Step 7: Cook for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Step 8: Remove the chicken and sauce from the pan and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 9: Serve with sour cream, lettuce, scallion, and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt & freshly ground black pepper, poblano chile, olive oil, milk, butter, flour, heavy cream, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 degrees Pound chicken breasts flat and season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, rub poblano with olive oil and place on a foil covered baking sheet and roast for 3 to 4 minutes, or until skin blackens. Step 4: Remove from oven and rub off outer skin with a towel. Step 5: Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. Step 6: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan. Step 7: Add flour and stir over medium heat until thick. Step 8: In a blender or food processor, pure'e half of the poblano together with the milk. Step 9: Add to the flour mixture, mix well, and whisk in heavy cream.

Dish Name: Chicken Breasts With Tomatillo Chile Cream
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, unsalted butter, sour cream, salsa, mexican cheese, fresh cilantro, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the chicken under cold running water and pat dry with paper toweling. Step 2: Cut each chicken breast into strips, set aside. Step 3: In a saute pan or skillet, combine the oil and butter and place over medium heat. Step 4: When the butter is melted, add the chicken strips and cook, turning frequently, until opaque on all sides, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the sour cream and salsa, reduce the heat to very low, and cook until the chicken is tender, but still moist inside and the sour cream and salsa have blended into a thick sauce, about 10 minutes To serve. Step 6: Arrange the chicken on warmed plates or tortillas and sprinkle lightly with cheese and cilantro.

Dish Name: Chicken Burrito Bake Easy For Busy Families
Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, green chili salsa, mexican blend cheese, flour tortillas, alfredo sauce, lettuce, avocado, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Place chicken, salsa and 1 / 2 cup cheese in large mixing bowl, stir to combine. Step 3: Spoon about 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture down the middle of a tortilla. Step 4: Fold one edge over and roll up. Step 5: Place, seam down, in a 13-by-9-inch baking dish. Step 6: Repeat with remaining tortillas and chicken mixture. Step 7: Combine pasta sauce and remaining 1 1 / 2 cups cheese in mixing bowl. Step 8: Spread over burritos. Step 9: Bake until sauce is bubbling and browned in spots, 20 to 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, taco seasoning, rotel, pasta sauce, flour tortillas, cheese, lettuce, diced tomato, diced onion, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Take the cooked chicken and tear up / shred and put in a pot. Step 3: Add the can of rotel, package of taco seasoning to the chicken and heat through on the stove Spray non-stick spray on a casserole dish. Step 4: Then, layer the following in the casserole dish -- tortillas, then red sauce, then chicken, then cheese. Step 5: Repeat all layers until you are out of chicken but be sure to end with tortillas with red sauce on top. Step 6: Bake covered for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, taco seasoning mix, refried beans, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, plum tomatoes, onion, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Remove chicken from bones, discarding skin and bones, chop chicken. Step 2: Place chicken and seasoning mix in a large zip-top bag Seal and shake to coat. Step 3: Spread beans evenly down center of tortillas. Step 4: Top with chicken, cheese, tomato, and onion. Step 5: Roll up burrito style. Step 6: Wrap each burrito in foil. Step 7: Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes, serve with salsa.

Dish Name: Chicken Burritos With Cheese And Black Bean Salsa
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast halves, pasta sauce, canned black beans, salsa, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In one small bowl, toss chicken strips with pasta sauce and let marinate 10 minute In another small bowl, combine beans and salsa. Step 2: Place half chicken on half of one tortilla. Step 3: Spread half the beans and salsa over chicken. Step 4: Sprinkle with half the cheese. Step 5: Repeat with second tortilla. Step 6: Roll tortillas up and place, seam side down, in a baking dish. Step 7: Bake at 375f 5 minutes. Step 8: Top with a dollop of sour cream and serve.

Dish Name: Chicken Caramelized Mushrooms Onions Cheese Quesadillas
Ingredient Names: olive oil, mushroom, onions, salt, fresh ground black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, brown sugar, fresh garlic, sherry wine, flour tortillas, cooked chicken breast, arugula, gruyere cheese, jalapeno cheddar cheese, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large nonstick skillet that has been sprayed with cooking spray over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add olive oil to pan Swirl to coat. Step 3: Add mushrooms, sliced onions, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper & sugar to pan Saut 20-25 minutes. Step 4: Stir in garlic, and saut 30 seconds. Step 5: Add vinegar or sherry. Step 6: Cook 30 seconds or until liquid almost evaporates Use rondele spreadable cheese on half of each tortilla. Step 7: Arrange half of mushroom mixture over half of each tortilla.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, roasted chicken meat, cheddar cheese, salsa, green chili salsa, black olives, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Spray large casserole dish with cooking spray Lay two tortillas in bottom of dish, overlapping slightly. Step 2: Top with a layer of chicken, a layer of cheese, and a layer of salsas. Step 3: Repeat layers until dish is full, finishing with a layer of salsa. Step 4: Bake until hot and bubbly. Step 5: Garnish with olives and cilantro, if desired.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, chicken breasts, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, monterey jack cheese, green onions, chili peppers, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine: soup, chili peppers, sour cream and green onions. Step 2: Add the jack cheese. Step 3: Remove 2 cups of mixture and add chicken. Step 4: Spoon chicken into tortillas. Step 5: Roll and place into a buttered 9x13-inch pan The tortillas can be placed on top of each other if necessary. Step 6: Pour the rest of the soup mixture over the tortillas and cover with cheddar cheese Spray foil and cover top of casserole. Step 7: Bake at 350f for 30 to 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: minced garlic cloves, vegetable oil, tomatoes, onions, mild green chilies, garlic salt, oregano, water, cooked chicken, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, shortening, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 325 degrees. Step 2: Saute the minced garlic in oil until tender. Step 3: Add tomatoes, onio N, green chilies, garlic salt, oregano and 1 / 2 cup water. Step 4: Cook over low heat until thickened. Step 5: In a bowl, combine the cubed cooked chicken, grated cheese and sour cream, mix. Step 6: In a frypan, heat shortening or oil. Step 7: Dip the tortillas in oil, just enough to make them limp, drain.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, tomatillos, garlic cloves, jalapenos, onion, cilantro, chicken broth, water, cumin, salt, pepper, cayenne pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Start off by seasoning your chicken on both sides with half of the salt and pepper If your using bone in chicken cut off skin before seasoning your chicken. Step 2: Fill a pot with the water and start to boil. Step 3: Pour oil into a frying pan and start browning chicken on both sides about 4 minute on each side You might want to fry only 4 or 5 at a time for an even color Remember you not cooking the chicken all the way just browning The pot of water should be boiling at this time, put the tomatillos and jalapenos into the boiling water and boil 12-15 minutes While the tomatillos and jalapenos are boiling finish browning all of the chicken. Step 4: Once the tomatillos and jalapenos are ready drain the water and put the tomatillos, jalapenos, cilantro, garlic, and the chicken broth into a blender and start pulsing until all the ingredients are all mixed and then blend for 30-40 seconds. Step 5: Once blended leave in blender until needed.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, onion, mild green chilies, flour tortillas, green enchilada sauce, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken breasts and shred. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 3: Stir together cooked shredded chicken, first 2 cups of cheeses, sour cream, onion and diced green chiles It should be the texture of chicken salad Coat the bottom of a 13x9 baking dish with enchilada sauce Optional: if tortillas are going to crack you can warm them in the oven or dip them in enchilada sauce. Step 4: Place a scant 1 / 2 cup of the chicken mixture on each tortilla. Step 5: Roll up and place seam side down in the baking dish Use 1 / 3 cup of chicken mixture in thin tortillas. Step 6: After all of the tortillas are filled and in the baking dish pour all of the remaining enchilada sauce over them.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, garlic clove, stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce, chili powder, dried oregano, ground cumin, green beans, macaroni, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook chicken with garlic over medium-high heat fro 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Step 2: Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce, chili powder, oregano and cumin, bring to boil. Step 3: Stir in macaroni and green beans. Step 4: Bring back to boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low, until the beans and pasta are tender. Step 6: Season to taste with salt and pepper To freeze: let pasta mixture cool. Step 7: Spoon into freezer containers, seal, label and date Freeze for up to 3 months.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, flour tortillas, onion, garlic clove, oil, green chilies, sour cream, tomato sauce, cumin, butter, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Boil chicken in water until done, about 15 minutes For extra flavor add some onion & garlic, and salt and pepper to the water Shred chicken Saut garlic and onion in the oil about 5 minutes, don't brown. Step 3: Stir together chicken and all the ingredients except for butter, tortillas and cheese. Step 4: Brush tortillas one at a time with melted butter, to the dry side and a spoon a generous scoop of chicken mixture in a line about 1 inch from one edge of the tortilla, tuck in sides as you go and roll up tortilla, and place seam side down on a cookie sheet, repeat until all you mixture is used. Step 5: Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown Option: If you prefer your cheese melted, a few minutes before removing from the oven, sprinkle each chimi with shredded cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, diced green chilies, chunky salsa, chicken base, reduced-fat mexican cheese blend, olive oil, low-fat flour tortillas, sour cream, cilantro, hot pepper sauce, jalapeno, olive, avocado, guacamole, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chicken base ingredients in mixing bowl - set aside to use as filling Warm tortilla's between paper towels for 20 - 30 seconds in microwave to make pliable for folding. Step 2: Place 2oz of chicken mixture and 1oz cheese in center of tortilla - fold burrito style. Step 3: Place on greased baking sheet and rub tops of each with olive oil. Step 4: Bake 400 5 -10 minutes per side or until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Step 5: Serve immediately or refrigerate for a "grab & go" meal For a beautiful presentation. Step 6: Serve topped with a dollop of sour cream chopped cilantro sprinkled over top and avocado slices on the side.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, baking powder, water, evaporated milk, vegetable oil, ground chicken breast, chili powder, ground cinnamon, ground oregano, ground thyme, ground cloves, apple cider vinegar, potatoes, diced onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine flour, salt and baking powder in medium bowl. Step 2: Stir in water, milk and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil until a ball of dough forms. Step 3: Knead dough on a lightly floured surface 3 minutes. Step 4: Cover and let rest 15 minutes. Step 5: Divide sopaipilla dough into four portions. Step 6: Roll each into a 6 to 7-inch circle. Step 7: Heat 1 / 4 cup oil to 375f degrees in a deep fryer or deep skillet. Step 8: Fry each circle, one at a time, 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Step 9: Drain on paper towels. Step 10: Combine chicken, chili powder, cinnamon, oregano, thyme, cloves, salt and vinegar in medium bowl.

Ingredient Names: butter, oil, chicken breasts, chilies, onion, button mushroom, milk, cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, salt and pepper, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken, onion, mushrooms, and 6 chiles into strips, set aside. Step 2: Put milk, soup, and remaining 3 chiles in blender and blend till smooth. Step 3: Whisk in sour cream. Step 4: Melt butter in heavy pan or dutch oven over medium heat and add oil and chicken, season. Step 5: Saute until chicken is done. Step 6: Remove chicken and set aside. Step 7: Add onions to same pot and saute for 3 minutes, then add mushrooms and cook till tender. Step 8: Add chiles and chicken and heat through.

Dish Name: Chicken Country Style Pollo De Hacienda
Ingredient Names: frying chicken, flour, salt, pepper, bacon, carrots, green chilies, parsley, bay leaf, thyme, lemon, tomato juice
Instructions: Step 1: Dredge each piece of chicken thoroughly with seasoned flour. Step 2: Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Step 3: Remove browned chicken to a large baking dish. Step 4: Add bacon, carrots, chiles, parsley, bay leaf, thyme, and any remaining seasoned flour. Step 5: Place lemon slices on top of chicken and pour tomato juice over all. Step 6: Cover and bake in preheated 350 degree oven til chicken is tender, about an hour Will freeze ok I have changed the tomato juice to v-8 and add lots more bacon, and about 5 carrots The lemon slices are very good to eat along with the chicken, so i add 2 lemons We serve this with steamed rice, yummilicious!

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cream cheese, italian salad dressing mix, salt, black pepper, onion, cilantro, cream of chicken soup, creamy chicken verde soup, half-and-half cream, green chili, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the chicken and the italian dressing mix in the crockpot Shred or cube the cooked chicken. Step 2: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Spray a 9 x 13 pan with cooking spray. Step 3: Add the cream cheese, salt and pepper to tase, the minced onion and the cilantro Soften the tortillas using oil, broth, or whatever method you prefer. Step 4: Fill with the chicken-cheese mixture, roll up and place in 9 x 13 pan, seam side down. Step 5: Mix the soups and half-n-half and chilies, if using, and pour over the enchiladas. Step 6: Top with shredded cheese. Step 7: Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes, or until it bubbles.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, fresh bean sprout, fresh mushrooms, leek, onion, carrot, chilies, hot sauce, salt & pepper, cream of mushroom soup, egg roll wraps
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients except egg roll wraps together. Step 2: Put 2 to 2 1 / 2 tbsp of filling in each wrap, fold in the sides and then flip up the top and bottom or do your conventional egg roll fold. Step 3: Line a 9x13 oven proof pan with release foil or lightly spray with oil and place the rolls side by side, single layer I managed to get 20 into the dish and then foil wrapped the remaining 4 and put them in the freezer uncooked Mist the tops of the egg rolls with oil. Step 4: Bake in 350f oven for 20 minutes or until they are golden on top, flip the rolls to brown the bottoms mist the bottoms as well with oil and continue baking for a further 20 minutes. Step 5: Serve hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, chili powder, flour, salt, garlic salt, dried oregano, ground cumin, water, diced tomatoes, chicken breast, garlic, black beans, onion, diced green chilies, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the enchilada sauce ingredients in a saucepan until well blended Over medium heat, gradually stir in the 2 cups water. Step 2: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 3: Simmer 10 minutes and then keep warm while preparing the remainder, heat oven to 350. Step 4: Saute the onion in a little cooking oil until tender. Step 5: Add the diced tomatoes, chicken, minced garlic, black beans and green chilies. Step 6: Cook over medium low heat for 5 minutes, or until heated through Spray a 9" x 13" pan with cooking spray and spread 1 / 3 of the enchilada sauce in the bottom. Step 7: Layer with 1 / 3 of the tortillas, half the filling mixture, and 1 / 3 of the cheese.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchilada Bake With Salsa Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: butter, flour, chicken stock, salt, ground pepper, light sour cream, salsa, corn tortillas, cooked chicken, green onions, black olives, monterey jack cheese, lime wedge, papaya
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium pan over medium heat, melt butter. Step 2: Add flour and blend. Step 3: Whisk in stock, salt and pepper. Step 4: Stir until mixture boils and is thickened, about 2 minutes, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in sour cream and salsa and mix well. Step 6: Cover the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish with 1 / 3 of the sauce Scatter half of the tortilla strips on top Next scatter the chicken, onions, olives and half the cheese, and pour 1 / 3 of the sauce over all. Step 7: Top with remaining tortillas, sauce and cheese.

Ingredient Names: onion, green pepper, butter, cooked chicken, green chili peppers, flour, ground coriander, salt, chicken broth, sour cream, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan cook onion and green pepper in the 2 tablespoons of butter until tender. Step 2: Combine onion mixture in a bowl with chopped chicken and green chili peppers. Step 3: Set aside For sauce, in the same pan melt 3 tablespoons butter. Step 4: Stir in flour, coriander and salt. Step 5: Stir in chicken broth all at once. Step 6: Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly, remove from heat. Step 7: Stir in sour cream and 1 / 2 cup of the cheese. Step 8: Stir 1 / 2 cup of the sauce into the chicken mixture.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, corn, onion, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken and then mix in onion, corn and garlic. Step 2: Pour 1 / 2 cup sauce in the bottom of both pans. Step 3: Mix remaining 3 cups tomato sauce and 2 taco sauce packets into the chicken pan and let simmer for 5 minutes Tear tortillas and completely cover bottom of pans. Step 4: Layer chicken mixture, cheese and tortillas into the pans about 4 layers. Step 5: Top with remaining cheese.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, cumin, cayenne pepper, red pepper flakes, salt, boneless skinless chicken breast, cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, chilies, jalapeno pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up chicken pieces and boil in water with the first 5 ingredients until tender, remove from heat. Step 2: Cool and shred While chicken is cooking, put on latex gloves and finely dice jalapeno. Step 3: In a medium bowl, mix cream cheese, mayo, cheddar cheese, chiles, and jalapeno. Step 4: Add shredded chicken. Step 5: Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish Baked uncovered at 350 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, sour cream, mild enchilada sauce, mild salsa, tomato sauce, black olives, green chili, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Either poach chicken, or for extra flavor, cut it in cubes and cook it in a little oil. Step 2: Season w / cumin, black pepper, chili powder and some minced garlic. Step 3: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a large saucepan and heat through over medium heat. Step 4: Place half the chicken mixture in an ungreased 9 x 12 pan, then half the cheese, then the rest of the chicken mixture, then rest of cheese. Step 5: Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Step 6: Serve over rice for a yummy dinner or with tortilla chips for dipping. Step 7: Dip will thicken as it cools.

Ingredient Names: pasta, cooked chicken breasts, scallion, diced tomatoes, frozen corn, tomato sauce, enchilada sauce, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, monterey jack cheese, cilantro, light sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Lightly grease a 13 x 9 pan, set aside. Step 2: Cook the pasta according to package directions, drain well. Step 3: Return the cooked, drained pasta to the empty pot. Step 4: Stir in the cooked cubed chicken, scallions, tomatoes, corn, tomato sauce, enchilada sauce, cumin, chili powder and garlic powder. Step 5: Mix well and add salt if needed. Step 6: Pour mixture into the 13 x 9 dish Evenly sprinkle with the shredded cheese and then the cilantro or parsley.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, minced garlic clove, flour, ground cumin, pepper, chicken broth, green chilies, dried oregano, salt, corn tortillas, refried beans, boneless chicken breast halves, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cover and cook over low heat until onion is wilted, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Check halfway through to make sure onion and garlic are not browning Increase heat to medium and stir in flour, cumin, and pepper, stirring 2 minutes to cook rawness out of the flour As flour begins to brown, remove pan from heat and gradually add the broth, using a wire whisk to combine. Step 5: Add chilies, oregano, and salt. Step 6: Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Using an 8x8 square dish coated with non-stick vegetable spray, make layers of quartered tortillas, refried beans, chicken, sauce, and cheese to a depth of 1 / 2 inch per layer. Step 8: Repeat 3 times, ending with cheese.

Ingredient Names: pam original no-stick cooking spray, corn tortillas, cooked chicken, ro tel original diced tomatoes & green chilies, ro tel original tomato & green chili sauce, cheddar and monterey jack blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Step 2: Add tortilla pieces and chicken, mix well. Step 3: Cook over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until hot, stirring frequently. Step 4: Pour undrained tomatoes and sauce over chicken mixture in skillet, mix well. Step 5: Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup cheese over chicken mixture, cover skillet. Step 6: Cook 5 minutes or until hot, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, condensed cream of chicken soup, sour cream, chili powder, butter, onion, green chilies, taco seasoning mix, green onion, water, lime juice, onion powder, garlic powder, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: If you didn't use the crock pot method, place the chicken in a large pot and add water to cover. Step 2: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the chicken pieces are no longer pink, about 10 minutes Shred chicken by placing two forks back to back and pulling meat apart. Step 3: Set the shredded chicken aside. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine the cream of chicken soup, sour cream, and chili powder in a saucepan. Step 5: Bring to a simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, then turn off the heat and cover to keep warm. Step 6: Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat, stir in the onion. Step 7: Cook and stir until the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the shredded chicken, chopped green chilies, taco seasoning, half of the bunch of chopped green onion, and water.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, tomatoes, cream of chicken soup, green chilies, onion, cheddar cheese, cumin, garlic powder, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cover chicken with water and simmer for 30 minutes. Step 2: Cool, bone, and cut into strips, set aside. Step 3: Mix tomatoes, onions, soup, chilies, cumin, and garlic powder. Step 4: Dip tortillas into broth left from boiling chicken, place one on a plate. Step 5: Top with 1 / 12 of the chicken, then add 2 tb Of the soup mixture and 1 tb Of cheese. Step 6: Roll up and place seam side down in baking pan. Step 7: After all are filled and rolled, pour remaining soup mixture evenly over enchiladas and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 8: Bake at 350 until cheese is melted.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas In Creamy White Sauce
Ingredient Names: pecans, onion, butter, cream cheese, milk, salt, ground cumin, cooked chicken, salsa, flour tortillas, condensed cream of chicken soup, sour cream, jalapeno peppers, green enchilada sauce, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet cook 1 / 4 cup pecans and onion until onion is tender and pecans are toasted. Step 2: In a bowl combine cream cheese, milk, salt and cumin. Step 3: Add nut mixture and chicken, stir to combine. Step 4: Spoon about 1 / 3 cup chicken mixture onto each tortilla near one edge. Step 5: Roll up and place seam side down in a greased 12x7 1 / 2x2 baking dish In another bowl combine cream of chicken soup, sour cream, green enchilada sauce and jalapeno peppers. Step 6: Pour soup mixture over tortillas. Step 7: Cover with foil and bake in a 350 degree oven for anout 35 minutes. Step 8: Remove the foil and sprinkle enchiladas with cheese and 2 tablespoons chopped pecans.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, flour, chili powder, chicken stock, clove, cinnamon, ground cumin, mexican chocolate, chicken breasts, diced onions, garlic cloves, canned tomatoes, oregano, prepared mustard, salt
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce: put in sauce pan and simmer till it begins to thicken- oil, flour, chili powder, chicken stock, cloves, cinnamon, and 4 tbsp of the cumin and the mexican chocolate For the filling: boil chicken and cube, mix with onions, garlic and tomatos, oregeno, remaining cumin, mustard, salt and pepper To assemble: dip tortillas in sauce, lay on assemby area put several tablespoons of filling in middle of tortilla, add some grated monteray jack, and roll. Step 2: Place in large shallow baking dish-repeat for all 20 tortillas. Step 3: Pour sauce over enchiladas cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes take off foil and sprinkle with remaining cheese bake for 10 more minutes until cheese is melted and begins to brown. Step 4: Serve with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkle of chopped green onions.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas Muy Bien Super Facil
Ingredient Names: red enchilada sauce, cooked chicken, mexican blend cheese, cilantro, pickled jalapeno peppers, corn tortillas, nonstick cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Heat about half of the enchilada sauce in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming, stir in chicken, remove from heat. Step 2: Stir in 1 cup cheese, cilantro and jalapeos. Step 3: Place tortillas on a plate and cover with plastic wrap Microwave on high about 60 seconds, until softened. Step 4: Place about 1 / 2 cup chicken down the center of a tortilla. Step 5: Roll and place seam down in an 11-by-9-inch baking dish Continue with remaining chicken mixture and tortillas Spray tops of enchiladas lightly with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: guajillo chilies, pasilla chiles, tomatoes, onion, garlic, chicken broth, vegetable oil, salt, corn tortillas, cooked chicken breasts, queso fresco, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the chili peppers. Step 2: Remove the seeds and veins. Step 3: Soak in lukewarm water for 20 minutes Roast the tomatoes and peel Roast the quarter of onion and garlic. Step 4: Put soaked guajillos and pasillas in the blender. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, onion, garlic, and chicken broth. Step 6: Blend until smooth Warm up the oil in a frying pan, add the puree and cook for 10-15 minutes on medium heat. Step 7: Season to taste with salt.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, butter, onion, green bell pepper, cheddar cheese, canned diced green chiles, chile salsa, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, salt and black pepper, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, whipping cream, chicken broth, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in pan of boiling water to cover, and simmer 15-20 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat, drain, cool, and shred chicken In skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Step 3: Cook onion and bell peppers until just soft, 5-8 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to large bowl. Step 5: Add chicken, cheddar cheese, green chiles, salsa, cilantro, and cumin. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper to taste and mix well It's pretty tasty just as is without the rest of the recipe, but since you're making a special dinner, read on. Step 7: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 8: Grease 10x15x2-inch baking pan or 2 smaller pans.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, mild green chilies, chile salsa, salt, heavy cream, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, green chiles and green chile salsa and mix well. Step 2: Mix salt and heavy cream in a medium-sized bowl. Step 3: Heat about 1 / 2 inch oil in a small skillet. Step 4: Dip each tortilla into hot oil for about 5 seconds, just to soften. Step 5: Drain on paper towels. Step 6: Dip each fried tortilla into bowl containing cream and salt, coating each side. Step 7: Fill each tortilla with chicken mixture. Step 8: Roll and place in ungreased flat baking dish. Step 9: Pour remaining cream over enchiladas and sprinkle with cheese. Step 10: Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, onion, garlic clove, green chili pepper, cheddar cheese, green enchilada sauce, sour cream, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: You will need: one 9x13 inch pan. Step 2: Place chicken, half of the onion, and garlic in a large pot and just cover with water. Step 3: Simmer on low heat for one hour or until done. Step 4: When the chicken is done, set it aside to cool Finely dice second half of onion and place in a large bowl with the 1 / 2 cup green chile, set aside. Step 5: In a medium bowl, mix 1 can of enchilada sauce with 1 cup of sour cream. Step 6: Remove skin and bones from the chicken By hand, shred the chicken into small pieces and add to the large bowl with the diced onions and chile. Step 7: Add 1 cup of shredded cheese, stir to combine.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas W Poblano Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken, poblano pepper, onion, flour tortillas, cream of chicken soup, monterey jack cheese, garlic salt, black pepper, lettuce, rice
Instructions: Step 1: To roast poblanos, slice in half, seed, flatten halves with palm of hand and place skin-side-up on cookie sheet Broil for about 10 minutes on top rack of oven until skin is brown and bubbly Immediately remove to plastic bag or container and place in refrigerator. Step 2: Meanwhile, season chicken with garlic salt and black pepper. Step 3: Bake at 425 for about 30 minutes. Step 4: Remove chicken from oven and set oven temp at 350. Step 5: Allow to rest to maintain juiciness Reserve cooking juices Shred chicken by lightly pulsing in blender or pulling apart with two forks, set aside.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas With Ancho Chile Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: light sour cream, diced green chilies, green onions, cilantro, cumin, cooked chicken, extra-sharp cheddar cheese, tomatoes, button mushroom, dried ancho chiles, garlic cloves, whipping cream, fresh lime juice, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Ancho chile cream sauce: Bring 2 cups water to boil in small sauce pan. Step 2: Remove pan from heat, add ancho chiles, soak 30 minutes Reserve 6 tbsp of liquid, drain rest of liquid. Step 3: Cut stems off of chiles, cut open and scrape out seeds. Step 4: Combine ancho chiles, reserve liquid and garlic in blender and puree. Step 5: Combine cream and chile puree in heavy skillet. Step 6: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer for 3 minutes. Step 7: Whisk in lime juice, season with salt, strain sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, celery ribs, onion, salt and pepper, chicken stock, tomatillos, serrano peppers, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, oregano, fresh ground pepper, sugar, salt, butter, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken pieces in large pot and cover with 1 1 / 2 quarts water. Step 2: Add celery, onion, salt and pepper and cook until chicken is tender, about 40 minutes. Step 3: Remove chicken from broth and set aside to cool. Step 4: Strain stock and reduce further, if necessary, until 1 quart remains Reserve for sauce For sauce: Combine all ingredients except butter and flour in large saucepan. Step 5: Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, and skimming foam off as it rises to the surface. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce is the consistancy of puree gently piercing tomatillos with a fork as they become soft. Step 7: Strain sauce and return to pan.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas With Roasted Tomatillo Chile Salsa
Ingredient Names: tomatillo, white onion, garlic cloves, jalapenos, ground cumin, salt, cilantro, lime, extra virgin olive oil, onion, all-purpose flour, chicken stock, rotisserie-cooked chicken, fresh ground black pepper, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f For the salsa: On a baking tray, roast tomatillos, onion, garlic and jalapenos for 12 to 15 minutes. Step 2: Transfer the roasted vegetables and any juices on the bottom of the tray to a food processor. Step 3: Add the cumin, salt, cilantro, and lime juice and pulse mixture until well combined but still chunky Enchiladas: Meanwhile heat a 2 count of olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add the onion and cook until soft and caramelized - this should take 5 to 7 minutes. Step 5: Add the garlic and cumin then cook for a further minute. Step 6: Sprinkle on the flour and stir to ensure the flour doesn't burn then gradually add the chicken stock to make a veloute.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas With Tomatillo Sauce Enchiladas Verdes
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, adobo seasoning, white onion, garlic cloves, sour cream, serrano chilies, tomatillos, cilantro, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, queso fresco
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken with adobo. Step 2: Place chicken, onion, garlic in saucepan with enough water to cover. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and let chicken cook in broth Shred chicken meat, approximately 4 cups. Step 5: Mix with sour cream. Step 6: Put chilies in saucepan with enough water to cover, bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes In batches, puree chilies, tomatillos, garlic, onion and cilantro in blender until smooth In skillet on medium-high heat, heat oil until it starts to smoke. Step 7: Add tomatillo sauce and cook, stirring constantly.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breasts, onions, garlic cloves, adobo seasoning, enchilada sauce, fat free tortillas, low-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f, and spray a 7 x 11" baking dish with non stick spray. Step 2: Heat a large non stick frying pan with the oil, then add the chicken. Step 3: Cook turning occasionally until browned for about 8 minutes, then transfer to a plate. Step 4: Add the onions, garlic and seasoning to the pan and cook until the onions are tender, then stir in the chicken and 1 / 2 cup of the enchilada sauce and heat through. Step 5: Wrap the tortillas in foil and warm in the oven for 10 minutes. Step 6: Fill each tortilla with one fourth of the chicken mixture, roll up and place seam side down in the baking dish. Step 7: Spoon over the remaining enchilada sauce and sprinkle with the cheese. Step 8: Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake until the edges of the enchiladas are just beginning to brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly. Step 9: Allow to stand for 5 mins before serving.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, white onions, garlic, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, oil, tomatoes and green chilies, cream of chicken soup, flour tortilla, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil breasts for 20 minutes or until thoroughly cooked. Step 2: Chop chicken into chunks and set aside. Step 3: Saute onions, garlic, peppers, salt& black pepper over medium heat until tender. Step 4: Mix soup, tomatoes-chile& chicken in large bowl Tear tortillas into fourths. Step 5: Layer tortillas on bottom of baking dish, top with soup-chicken-tomatoes-chiles mixture, then top with layer of sauted veggies, then top with layer of cheese. Step 6: Repeat as needed until dish is full to top. Step 7: Bake at 350 for 35 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, fajita seasoning mix, water, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, sliced ripe olives, green onion, tomatoes, guacamole, sour cream, canned jalapeno slices, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, fajita seasoning, and water in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer about 7 minutes. Step 3: In a large, shallow ovenproof platter or pizza pan arrange the tortilla chips. Step 4: Top with the chicken and cheeses Broil in the oven until cheese is melted. Step 5: Top with tomatoes, olives, green onions, salsa, and jalapenos, if desired. Step 6: Serve optional sour cream and guacamole on the side.

Ingredient Names: baking potatoes, red bell peppers, onion, butter, taco seasoning mix, cooked chicken breasts, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, black olives, diced green chilies, salsa, sour cream, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Scrub the potatoes Pat dry and wrap in aluminum foil. Step 2: Bake at 400f for 1 hour or until done. Step 3: Cook the pepper and the onion in the butter in medium saucepan until tender. Step 4: Add the taco seasoning mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Step 5: Remove from the heat. Step 6: Stir in the chicken, cheese, olives, and chilies. Step 7: Cut a lengthwise slit in the top of each potato. Step 8: Press each potato open and spoon the chicken mixture into the potatoes. Step 9: Spoon 1 / 4 cup of salsa over each potato.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, light soy sauce, fresh lime juice, dried basil, dried tarragon, dried rosemary, dried parsley, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, red onion, plum tomatoes, black beans, lime juice, green onion, fat free sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Make marinade from soy sauce, lime juice, and herbs. Step 2: Add chicken and marinate for 4 hours in refrigerator. Step 3: Grate cheddar cheese, set aside. Step 4: Chop green onions, set aside Empty can of black beans into small pot. Step 5: Add lime juice and bring to boil, stirring occasionally, reduce heat to simmer, let simmer about 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat, mash with potato masher, keep warm. Step 7: Remove chicken from marinade and cut into strips Spray heavy skillet with cooking spray and heat at high. Step 8: Add chicken strips and sear till no pick is visible.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, garlic, onion, salt, pepper, wine, green bell peppers, diced tomato, cheddar cheese, guacamole, sour cream, chile, salsa, flour tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Dump the chopped garlic, chopped onion, salt and pepper in either wine or beer to equal about 1 cup and combine well Dump the chicken breast and vegetables in the mixture and marinate for a couple of hours or overnight In an oiled hot iron pan, saut the chicken, peppers, onion slices and diced tomatoes until done. Step 2: Slice the chicken and serve immediately with warmed tortillas. Step 3: Serve with cheese, guacamole, sour cream, chopped chilies and salsa.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, white wine, butter, soy sauce, garlic, fresh ground black pepper, flour tortillas, onions, pico de gallo, guacamole, tomatoes, green bell pepper, beef stock, dried arbol chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the grill or the broiler Pound the chicken breasts to 3 / 4 inch thickness, and set aside. Step 2: Heat a heavy skillet over high heat for 3- 4 minutes. Step 3: Pour the wine into the skillet, and boil it for 1- 2 minutes to evaporate the alcohol. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Stir in soy sauce, garlic, and pepper, and cook until they are just combined, about 1 minute. Step 6: Add butter and stir until just melted. Step 7: Remove skillet from heat. Step 8: Dip the chicken breasts into the sauce, and turn them to coat thoroughly. Step 9: Place breasts 3- 4" from heat source, or on in-door grill.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, canola oil, fresh lime juice, tequila, fresh cilantro, garlic, ground cumin, lime zest, salt, pepper, low-carb flour tortillas, onion, green bell pepper, tomatoes, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken, 1 / 4 cup of the oil, lime juice, tequila, 1 tablespoon of the cilantro, garlic, cumin, lime peel, salt and pepper in a plastic bag and marinate, refrigerated, 4 hours or overnight.
