Step 2: Drain chicken and discard marinade, heat oven to 350f. Step 3: Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven. Step 4: Heat remaining tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook onion 3 minutes, until softened. Step 5: Add pepper strips and cook 2 minutes, until crisp-tender. Step 6: Transfer vegetables to a bowl. Step 7: Add chicken to skillet and cook about 5 minutes per side, until cooked through. Step 8: Stir in vegetables and tomato. Step 9: Cook, stirring, 2 minutes more.

Dish Name: Chicken Fajitas With Grilled Peppers And Onions
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, olive oil, limes, ground cumin, chili powder, boneless chicken breast halves, poblano chiles, yellow bell pepper, red bell peppers, red onions, flour tortillas, salsa, sour cream, cilantro, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare barbecue. Step 2: Puree first 5 ingredients in blender. Step 3: Place chicken in a glass baking dish and pour 1 / 3 of marinade over chicken, turning to coat all sides. Step 4: Arrange vegetables on a rimmed grilling pan or baking pan, pour 1 / 3 of marinade over vegetables. Step 5: Season chicken and vegetables with salt and pepper if desired. Step 6: Grill chicken until cooked through. Step 7: Grill vegetables until tender, turning often. Step 8: Grill tortillas until charred. Step 9: Transfer chicken to work surface and slice cross wise into strips. Step 10: Fill tortillas with chicken and vegetables and drizzle with remaining marinade.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, fresh cilantro, chili powder, ground cumin, red pepper flakes, lemon peel, fresh lemon juice, boneless skinless chicken breasts, flour tortillas, avocado, tomatoes, onions, salt, garlic powder, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Guacamole: Seed and peel avocado. Step 2: In a mixing bowl coarsely mash avocado. Step 3: Add medium tomato, onion, garlic powder, the tablespoon lemon juice and salt. Step 4: Cover the surface of bowl with plastic wrap and chill for up to 4 hours Marinade: In a shallow nonmetallic dish combine oil, cilantro or parsley, lemon peel, 2 tablespons of lemon juice, chili powder, cumin & red pepper flakes. Step 5: Add chicken to marinade, turning to coat. Step 6: Cover and chill about an hour. Step 7: Drain chicken, reserving marinade.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, taco seasoning mix, breadcrumbs, monterey jack cheese, green chilies, sour cream, scallions, cajun-style rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Roll chicken breasts in taco seasoning then breadcrumbs. Step 3: Place in greased baking dish, cover with cheese. Step 4: Combine chiles, sour cream, and scallions, pour over chicken. Step 5: Bake for 45 minutes, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: spring onions, oil, chicken, whole kernel corn, oregano, mexican chili powder, salt, black pepper, low-fat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Trim spring onions and slice finely. Step 2: Heat oil in a saucepan and saute onion for 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken, drained corn, oregano, chilli powder, salt, pepper and sour cream and bring to boil Tacos- fill warm taco shells with filling, grated cheese, shredded lettuce, tomato salsa and guacamole Burritos-brush tortillas with melted butter. Step 4: Heat in the oven or microwave until warm. Step 5: Spread with hot chicken filling, shredded lettuce and tomato salsa. Step 6: Roll up and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: broiler-fryer chickens, water, lard, onion, garlic, cornstarch, salt, pepper, mild green chili, vegetable oil, corn tortilla, sour cream, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken pieces and water to boiling in kettle, lower heat, cover. Step 2: Simmer until fork tender, about 25 minutes. Step 3: Drain Reserve 1 / 2 cup broth. Step 4: Cool chicken until easy to handle Bone and skin chicken Shred meat. Step 5: Heat lard or shortening in a large saucepan until melted.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, onion, garlic clove, cooking oil, cooked chicken, canned black beans, salsa, mexican blend cheese, fresh cilantro, lettuce, guacamole, sour cream, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Wrap tortillas tightly in foil. Step 3: Heat in oven about 10 minutes or until heated through 2. Step 4: Meanwhile, for filling, in a large saucepan, cook onion and garlic in the 1 teaspoon hot oil until tender. Step 5: Stir in chicken, black beans, 1 / 2 cup bottled salsa, the cheese, and 2 tablespoons cilantro 3 For each flauta, spoon about 1 / 2 cup filling across each warm tortilla about 1-1 / 2 inches from one edge. Step 6: Roll up tortillas as tightly as possible.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, lemon juice, cumin, jalapeno, cilantro, garlic cloves, monterey jack cheese, salt and pepper, flour tortillas, oil, avocados, red onion, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Flautas: in a bowl, combine all flauta ingredients. Step 2: Allow to rest about 15 minutes to marry flavors. Step 3: Place about 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture in center of flour tortilla, and roll-up like a cigar Secure with a toothpick Continue with remaining tortillas. Step 4: Keep flautas covered with a damp paper towel to prevent drying out. Step 5: Heat enough oil in skillet to come almost halfway up sides of flautas Quickly fry flautas on all sides until lightly golden brown This happens very quickly, so don't walk away. Step 6: Drain on paper towels and serve with chunky guacamole.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, taco seasoning, dried cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into small pieces, this goes quickly if the meat is half frozen. Step 2: Place the taco seasoning and cilantro into a plastic bag. Step 3: Place the chicken into the bag about 1 cup at a time, coating the meat with the seasoning Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray, then place the chicken pieces into the pan. Step 4: Bake uncovered for 10 min's, stir, then bake another 10 min's. Step 5: Serve in your favourite quesadilla recipe.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cream of mushroom soup, milk, salsa fresca, tomato sauce, red enchilada sauce, diced green chilies, black olives, fresh cilantro, yellow onion, cheddar cheese, frito corn chip, green onion, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine milk, salsa, tomato sauce, enchilada sauce, green chilies, and diced yellow onion. Step 2: Place a layer of chicken then fritos in a 9x13 pan, top with sauce mixture and cheese. Step 3: Keep repeating layers, ending with cheese. Step 4: Bake at 350 until cheese is melted About 25 minutes. Step 5: Garnish with sour cream, diced green onions, olives and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, chicken, chicken breasts, corn tortillas, green enchilada sauce, cream of mushroom soup, monterey jack pepper cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Warm green enchilada sauce and cream of mushroom soup in pot til thoroughly mixed. Step 2: Take off heat and set aside Submerge corn tortilla into hot oil 8-10 on each side to warm and make soft Do not leave in too long or they will get too hard to work with. Step 3: After warming tortilla in oil, place in enchilada sauce and mushroom soup mixture to coat both sides. Step 4: Take out and place on plate. Step 5: Put some shredded chicken and shredded pepper jack cheese into tortilla and roll. Step 6: Place rolled enchilada on cookie sheet or shallow baking pan Continue this until all tortillas are rolled. Step 7: Pour left over enchilada sauce and cream of mushroom soup mixture over rolled enchilada's.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, butter, anaheim chilies, onion, crushed red pepper flakes, light cream, monterey jack cheese, fettuccine pasta
Instructions: Step 1: In a plastic bag combine flour, salt and pepper. Step 2: Add chicken pieces and shake bag to coat evenly. Step 3: In a large skillet heat 2 tablespoons of the butter over medium heat until hot. Step 4: Add coated chicken pieces and cook about 8 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink, and coating is golden brown, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm. Step 6: Heat remaining butter in the same skillet until hot. Step 7: Add chili peppers, onion, and crushed red pepper. Step 8: Cook and stir about 5 minutes or until tender but not brown, stirring up any browned bits. Step 9: Add cream to the skillet and bring just to a low boil. Step 10: Return chicken to skillet, and stir until combined.

Ingredient Names: dried guajillo chilies, onion, garlic cloves, butter, chicken broth, chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onion and garlic in butter Grind chiles and liberally coat chicken breasts. Step 2: Add chicken and broth to onions and garlic. Step 3: Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Step 4: Serve with rice, pasta, or use your imagination.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, butter, salt and black pepper, chili powder, onion powder, chipotle chiles in adobo, adobo sauce, evaporated milk, flour, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Place the chicken pieces in a roasting pan. Step 3: Brush with melted butter, using it all. Step 4: Season with salt, pepper, chili powder and onion powder to taste. Step 5: Bake for 15 minutes. Step 6: Turn chicken over and cover loosely with foil. Step 7: Bake until chicken is no longer pink in center, about 20 minutes longer. Step 8: Meanwhile, in a blender, mix the chipotle chiles and adobo, the evaporated milk and the flour. Step 9: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan. Step 10: Add the blended mixture and cook over low heat, stirring constantly.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, green chilies, monterey jack cheese, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, chili powder, cumin, salt, pepper, butter, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken in ziploc bag and flatten with meat mallet or rolling pin. Step 2: Place chilies and cheese in middle of breast and roll up from short end Secure with toothpicks. Step 3: Combine breadcrumbs, parmesan / romano, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Dip chicken rolls in melted butter then dredge in breadcrumbs. Step 5: Place in greased 9x9 baking dish. Step 6: Cover and chill for 8 hours to combine flavors. Step 7: Bake at 400 for 30-45 minutes or until chicken is done. Step 8: Discard toothpicks, serve with salsa.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, jalapeno, onion, dried oregano, cilantro, garlic cloves, lime juice, egg, ricotta cheese, sour cream, romano cheese, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic powder, paprika, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine roma tomatoes, jalapeno, onion, oregano, cilantro, garlic, and lime juice. Step 2: Mix well and set aside. Step 3: Combine egg, ricotta, sour cream and romano cheese. Step 4: Mix well and set aside. Step 5: Sprinkle oregano, garlic powder and paprika over chicken. Step 6: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 7: Add chicken and cook, stirring, until browned on all sides. Step 8: Add onion and cook until beginning to soften. Step 9: Stir in italian dressing and salsa. Step 10: Cook, stirring often, until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Legs With Easy Mole Sauce
Ingredient Names: onions, vegetable oil, coriander seed, anise seed, chili powder, sugar, cinnamon, ground cloves, unsweetened cocoa powder, peanut butter, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, raisins, garlic cloves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In large, heavy skillet saute onion over moderately high heat until golden brown In motar, crush coriander seeds and aniseed or grind in a spice grinder. Step 2: Stir into onion mixture with chili powder, sugar, cinnamon and cloves. Step 3: Cook mixture over medium heat, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in cocoa powder, peanut butter, 2 cups of broth, tomatoes, raisins, garlic paste and salt, to taste and simmer sauce loosely covered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Step 5: Take the sauce off the heat and let cool while preparing the chicken legs Pat legs dry, season with salt and pepper On oiled rack of a broiler pan, broil skin side up for approximately 10 minutes, turn and broil other side for approximately 10 minutes or until golden brown In blender or food processor puree the sauce in batches, adding remaining broth as necessary to thin. Step 6: Transfer sauce to skillet, add legs, and simmer mixture loosely covered for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, limes, homemade chicken broth, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, celery, carrot, zucchini, tomatoes, salt, fresh cilantro, red onion, jalapeno chile, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Spray olive oil mist over the chicken breasts, then squeeze the juice of 1 lime over them. Step 2: Grill the chicken over medium heat for 5 minutes per side. Step 3: Cool for a few minutes, then dice or shred, set aside. Step 4: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer. Step 5: Add the bell pepper, garlic, celery and carrot. Step 6: Cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the zucchini and cook for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add the reserved chicken, the juice of the remaining limes and the tomato, season with salt.

Ingredient Names: salt, chili powder, garlic powder, oil, fresh lime juice, chicken breasts, garlic, roasted red pepper, pasilla chile, yellow onion, monterey jack cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients for marinade. Step 2: Marinate chicken in mixture for at least 2 hours. Step 3: Drain chicken well and grill until done. Step 4: Allow to cool and shred into 1 / 8 inch by 3 inch pieces. Step 5: Place chicken in bowl and sprinkle with salt and minced garlic, mix well. Step 6: Add red pepper, pasilla, onion, cheese and 1 / 2 ounce lime juice. Step 7: Mix thoroughly To assemble, warm tortilla on griddle until soft and pliable If necessary, add a little oil to the pan to help soften the tortillas.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, vegetable oil, flour tortillas, mango, brie cheese, cilantro, pickled jalapeno peppers, sour cream, lime zest, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Shred chicken into thin strips. Step 2: Set a large non-stick frying pan over medium, brush with oil and lay a tortilla in frying pan Scatter 1 / 4 portion each of chicken, mango, brie, cilantro and jalapeno over half of tortilla. Step 3: Fold tortilla to enclose filling and cook until underside is golden, about 2 minute. Step 4: Flip and continue until other side is golden, about 2 more minute. Step 5: Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling ingredients (keep cooked quesadillas warm in a 350f oven while making the others. Step 6: Stir sour cream with lime zest and juice in a small bowl. Step 7: Slice each quesadilla into 4 wedges and serve with sour cream dip.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, mangoes, taco seasoning, mexican blend cheese, flour tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a few tbsp of olive oil in pan. Step 2: Cut chicken into strips and add to hot oil. Step 3: Cover with taco seasoning and cook chicken throughly Peel and cut mango into strips. Step 4: Add mango to chicken and heat for about 1 min. Step 5: Put mango and chicken into tortillas and cover with cheese, serve warm!

Ingredient Names: southwestern chicken strips, cream cheese, salsa, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a microwavable bowl, microwave the chicken until it is hot. Step 2: When it is hot, shred the chicken with two forks Throw the cream cheese on top of the chicken and microwave on 10 second intervals until the cream cheese is softened and easy to stir, stir in the salsa. Step 3: Stir in the cheese. Step 4: Stir in any additional ingredients that you choose Optional - onion, black beans, cilantro - whatever you like! Step 5: I usually use a red onion, but it tastes just as great without it You can serve this hot or cold I normally use scoops, since the chicken can break thinner chips This makes a small batch of appetizer portions.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic salt, butter, green bell pepper, green onion, picante sauce, cheese spread, rice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with garlic salt. Step 2: Heat butter in 10-inch skillet over medium heat, add chicken, cook 5 minutes, turn chicken. Step 3: Add onion and green pepper around edges of chicken. Step 4: Cook 5 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear. Step 5: Place rice on serving platter. Step 6: Remove chicken from skillet and place over rice, keep warm.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken pieces, cooking oil, onion, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, toasted almond, tortilla chips, water, fresh jalapeno peppers, fresh cilantro, toasted sesame seeds, ground cinnamon, salt, ground cloves, semisweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken Pat dry. Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon of the cooking oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet. Step 3: Add onion and garlic and cook for 3-5 minutes, or till onion is tender but not brown. Step 4: Remove from skillet and cool slightly. Step 5: In a blender container or food processor bowl combine onion mixture, tomatillos, tomato sauce, almonds, tortilla chips, water, jalapeno peppers, cilantro, sesame seeds, cinnamon, salt, and cloves. Step 6: Blend or process till smooth. Step 7: Heat remaining oil in skillet. Step 8: Add chicken and cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning to brown evenly. Step 9: Add tomato mixture.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, mole, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Mix half of a cup of chicken broth with half a cup of the mole. Step 2: Put four half chicken breasts skin side up in a heavy skillet. Step 3: Add the broth and sauce. Step 4: Cover and let it simmer for about an hour until the chicken is tender basting occasionally. Step 5: Mix some of the juice with more of the mole if it needs thickining and pour over the chicken This goes great with rice or shredded and scooped with tortillas.

Ingredient Names: blanched almond, cinnamon stick, coriander seed, anise seed, sesame seeds, whole cloves, dried pasilla peppers, dried new mexico chiles, guajillo chilies, chicken stock, roma tomatoes, mexican chocolate, garlic cloves, sweet white onion, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Combine the almonds, cinnamon stick, coriander, aniseed, sesame seed and cloves on a baking sheet Toast in the oven for 10 minutes or until fragrant and lightly browned. Step 3: Remove and set aside. Step 4: Place chiles on another baking sheet and toast at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Step 5: Check and stir as needed to prevent burning. Step 6: Remove the chiles from the oven and allow to cool. Step 7: When cool, break chiles lightly, and place in in a large glass bowl. Step 8: Pour 2 cups of hot chicken stock over the chiles and allow to sit for about 30 minutes to 1 hour. Step 9: Preheat broiler and place the 2 tomatoes on a cookie sheet and broil for 5 to 7 minutes or until skin cracks and blisters lightly, turning about every 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: unsifted flour, chili powder, salt, pepper, onion, broiler-fryer chickens, vegetable oil, garlic, water, canned tomatoes, green chilies, semisweet chocolate morsel, tomato puree, chicken flavor instant bouillon, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken: in a large bowl or plastic bag, combine flour, 1 measuring tablespoon chili powder, the salt and pepper. Step 2: Add chicken pieces Coat well. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet Brown half the chicken pieces on all sides over medium heat. Step 4: Drain thoroughly on paper towels. Step 5: Repeat with remaining chicken In small skillet, saute onion and garlic until golden. Step 6: Return chicken to skillet, add the water.

Dish Name: Chicken Mole Lasagna Easy And Good
Ingredient Names: mole, chicken broth, cooked chicken, nonstick cooking spray, corn tortillas, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: In a saucepan over medium high heat, stir together mole paste and about half of the broth. Step 3: Once mixture is smooth, stir in remaining broth and chicken. Step 4: Heat until simmering Spray a 9-inch pie plate with non-stick cooking spray. Step 5: Place two tortillas, overlapping, on bottom of pie plate. Step 6: Top with 1 / 4 of the chicken and sauce and 1 / 4 of the cheese Continue layering, ending with sauce and cheese. Step 7: Bake about 25 minutes, until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling. Step 8: Cut in wedges to serve.

Ingredient Names: fat free chicken broth, onion, garlic clove, red chili powder, bittersweet chocolate, walnut halves, ground cinnamon, table salt, black pepper, cayenne, boneless skinless chicken breast, fat free tortillas, romaine lettuce, tomatoes, monterey jack pepper cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 / 4 cup broth in a large skillet. Step 2: Add onion and garlic Saut until tender, about 5 minutes, pour into blender. Step 3: Add remaining broth, chili powder, chocolate, walnuts, cinnamon, cayenne, salt and pepper, blend to a pure. Step 4: Pour mixture into skillet. Step 5: Simmer 10 - 15 minutes until heated through. Step 6: Add chicken strips. Step 7: Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, taco seasoning mix, oil, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese, onion, tomatoes, ranch salad dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breast into strips toss with taco seasoning. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet. Step 3: Add chicken and cook about 6 minutes until done Dividing evenly, layer chicken and remaining ingredients on heated tortillas, roll up, serve.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breasts, refried beans, salsa, onion, cheddar cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, beans, onion and salsa in a saucepan Heat through thoroughly Place in serving bowl, top with cheese Serve with chips.

Ingredient Names: frozen hash browns with cheddar cheese, cooked chicken breasts, healthy request cream of mushroom soup, tomatoes with jalapeno peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Arrange the 4 frozen cheddar browns in bottom of an 8" casserole sprayed with cooking spray. Step 3: Add cooked chicken in an even layer. Step 4: Mix together soup and canned tomato / jalapeno. Step 5: Pour this mixture over chicken. Step 6: Bake 40-45 minutes until potatoes are done and sauce in bubbly hot.

Dish Name: Chicken Or Beef Chimichangas Tex Mex
Ingredient Names: bacon, lard, onion, ground chicken, tomatoes, green chilies, salt, mexican oregano, chili powder, fresh cilantro, flour tortillas, vegetable oil, cheddar cheese, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, saute bacon and onions in lard for 3 minutes. Step 2: Lower heat & add chilies, salt, oregano, chili powder and cilantro, simmer -3 minutes. Step 3: Add cooked & shredded chicken & tomatoes. Step 4: Combine well and simmer 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Place 1 / 2 cup meat filling on each tortilla. Step 6: Fold like a burrito with the ends tucked inside. Step 7: Fry, seam side down, in 1 / 2 inch of hot oil, until mildly crispy and tan. Step 8: Flip and brown other side. Step 9: Drain on paper towels or strainer.

Ingredient Names: corn oil, chicken, onion, green pepper, garlic cloves, corn, tomatoes, tomato sauce, green chilies, chili powder, ground cumin, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese, salsa, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet, over high heat. Step 2: Add chicken, onion, pepper, and garlic. Step 3: Saute, stirring constantly, until meat is browned and onion tender, about 10 minute. Step 4: Drain off fat And stir in corn and remove mixture to large bowl In same skillet, heat stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce, chilies, chili powder and cumin to boiling, stirring to break up pieces of tomato. Step 5: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 2 cup sauce into bottom of shallow 3-quart oval baking pan or 13x9-inch baking dish. Step 7: Stir 1 / 2 cup sauce into meat mixture Working on waxed paper, dip a tortilla in sauce and then fill with 1 / 4 cup meat mixture and 2 tablespoons cheese.

Ingredient Names: onions, butter, cooked chicken, green chili peppers, flour, ground coriander, salt, fat-free chicken broth, nonfat sour cream, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Cook onion in 2 tbs butter until tender. Step 3: Combine onion mixture in bowl with chicken and green chili peppers. Step 4: Set aside For sauce, melt 3 tbs butter and stir in flour, coriander, and salt. Step 5: Stir in chicken broth all at once. Step 6: Cook and stir until thick and bubbly, remove from heat. Step 7: Add sour cream and 1 / 2 cup of cheese. Step 8: Stir 1 / 2 c of sauce into chicken mixture.

Dish Name: Chicken Or Turkey Enchiladas With Sour Cream
Ingredient Names: chicken, sour cream, sharp cheddar cheese, salt, canola oil, corn tortillas, medium hot salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix chicken or turkey, sour cream, 2 cups shredded cheese, and salt. Step 2: Heat oil in an 8-to 10inch frying pan over low heat. Step 3: Dip the tortillas, one at a time, in the hot oil just until limp, about 5 seconds. Step 4: Fill tortillas equally with chicken mixture, roll up, and arrange side by side, slit side down, in a 9-x13 inch baking dish. Step 5: Pour salsa evenly over top. Step 6: Bake in a 350 degree oven until heated through, about 20 minutes If desired sprinkle with more shredded cheese over hot enchiladas before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, onions, garlic cloves, yellow hominy, white hominy, dried red chile pods, lemon, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, black pepper, head iceberg lettuce, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken breasts with salt and black pepper, garlic and onion powders, and chili powder. Step 2: Chop onion and mince garlic cloves. Step 3: Place chicken, onions, and garlic in a large stock pot. Step 4: Cover all with water. Step 5: Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat to a simmer. Step 6: Meanwhile, remove the stems from the dried peppers, and slit each down one side. Step 7: Remove all seeds and the membranes they are attached by from each pepper Immerse the dried peppers into the cooking chicken stock. Step 8: After 20 minutes, remove the peppers to cool Continue cooking chicken for another 20 minutes or so, until chicken is completely done.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, red bell peppers, cayenne pepper, penne pasta, olive oil, onions, garlic, white wine, sun-dried tomato, pesto sauce, half-and-half, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler and place chicken breasts and red pepper strips to baking sheet, sprinkle with cayene Broil until golden brown. Step 2: Set aside, and slice chicken in diagonal pieces Begin cooking pasta until al dente. Step 3: In a saucepan, heat oil and saute' onion and garlic Deglaze pan with white wine and reduce liquid, adding tomatoes & cook 3-4 minutes. Step 4: Then add pesto, cream and seasonings, stir until fully incorporated. Step 5: Add drained pasta to sauce and toss, then divide mixture among 4 warm plates and top each with chicken slices and red peppers. Step 6: Garnish with parmesan and fresh basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: pizza crusts, butter, ground chicken, garlic powder, salsa, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 450f. Step 2: Place pizza crust onto ungreased baking sheet. Step 3: Melt butter in 8-inch skillet until sizzling. Step 4: Add chicken and garlic powder. Step 5: Cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until chicken is no longer pink, stir in salsa. Step 6: Spread evenly onto crust. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 8: Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese is lightly browned and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, chicken, poblano peppers, sour cream, half-and-half, colby-monterey jack cheese, salt, pepper, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Saute onion, garlic and peppers in olive oil until soft. Step 3: Pour all into food processor or blender and blend with half n half and sour cream and seasonings. Step 4: Mix pepper mix with chicken and 1 cup cheese and pour into greased casserole dish. Step 5: Top with remaining cheese. Step 6: Bake for 35 minutes covered, then uncover and bake another 10-15 minutes until golden and bubbly on top.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, carrots, onions, celery ribs, garlic, poblano peppers, salt, pepper, cumin, dried thyme, chicken stock, cilantro, cooked chicken, unsalted butter, flour
Instructions: Step 1: In a large soup pot, saute carrots, onion, celery, garlic, poblanos, salt, pepper, cumin and thyme until vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 2: Add stock, cilantro and chicken and cook several minutes more. Step 3: In a saucepan, melt butter and add flour. Step 4: Cook flour, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, over low heat, but do not brown like a roux. Step 5: Add a cup of the soup to the flour and whisk briskly, then add two more, one at a time, whisking briskly after each addition. Step 6: Pour the mixture into the soup pot and stir, cooking and stirring the soup constantly until the soup thickens, about 3-5 minutes more. Step 7: Blend in the cream and hot sauce, remove from heat, and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, tomato paste, chili powder, dried oregano, reduced-sodium chicken broth, white hominy, cooked chicken, coarse salt, pepper, avocado, radish, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a 5-quart saucepan over medium heat, add onions. Step 2: Cook until translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, tomato paste, chili powder, and oregano. Step 4: Cook, stirring constantly, until evenly distributed. Step 5: Add 4 cups water, broth, and hominy, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until fragrant, about 30 minutes, stir in chicken. Step 7: Season with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, tomato paste, pure chile powder, dried oregano, ground cumin, chicken broth, water, white hominy, cooked chicken, salt and pepper, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large soup pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onions, and cook for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic, chile powder, cumin, oregano, tomato paste and cook for a minute, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add water, chicken broth and hominy, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer about 30 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken and taste soup for seasoning, add salt if needed. Step 7: Season with pepper. Step 8: Cook until heated through Ladle into bowl and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro if desired. Step 9: Add 4 cups water, broth, and hominy.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, yellow onion, garlic clove, diced green chilies, chicken stock, smoked paprika, ground cumin, chili powder, mexican oregano, salt, pepper, cayenne pepper, soft taco-size flour tortillas, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place everything except the tortillas and oil in a crockpot or slow cooker and set to high for three hours or until meat is easily removed from the bone. Step 2: Remove chicken and let cool, leaving sauce in the vessel. Step 3: When cool enough to handle, pull the chicken meat from the bone and shred. Step 4: Add shredded meat back into the sauce. Step 5: Discard chicken skin and bones. Step 6: Reduce crockpot or slow cooker to low and simmer meat in sauce for at least one additional hour. Step 7: Meanwhile, pour vegetable oil into a frying pan until 1 / 4" deep. Step 8: Heat oil to 350 degrees or until a flour tortilla "puffs" up and browns quickly. Step 9: Add one flour tortilla at a time into oil and fry one side until lightly browned. Step 10: Using tongs, fold the tortilla over so that the browned side is on the inside.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, red enchilada sauce, heavy whipping cream, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, red onion, black beans, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Drizzle the chicken with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through. Step 4: Let cool and finely chop. Step 5: In a small bowl, mix the sauce and cream. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 4 of the sauce mix on the bottom of the casserole dish Tear up the tortilla and spread along the bottom on top of the sauce. Step 7: Cover with a third each of the cheese, chicken, onion and black beans. Step 8: Repeat twice-there should be three layers. Step 9: Top with the remaining tortilla, sauce mix and cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, fajita seasoning mix, vegetable oil, green peppers, red peppers, onion, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into thin slices and mix in fajita seasoning. Step 2: In a large skillet add oil and heat. Step 3: Add chicken and cook until no longer pink. Step 4: Add peppers and onion to skillet Slowly cook and stir about 10 minutes or until desired tenderness. Step 5: Heat another skillet over medium heat and spray with cooking spray or use 1 / 2 teaspoon of butter. Step 6: Place your tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheeses and add meat mixture. Step 7: Cover with a lid for about 30 seconds or until the cheese has melted. Step 8: Fold in half and serve immediately with salsa and sour cream. Step 9: Repeat steps 6-9 with remaining tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, chicken broth, bell pepper, onion, garlic clove, salsa, taco seasoning, fat-free refried beans, light cheese, whole wheat tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Saute chicken in broth for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add peppers, onions, garlic, salsa and taco seasoning. Step 4: Cook until veggies are soft. Step 5: Place tortillas on a baking sheet and spread refried beans onto half of each trotilla, top with chicken and veggie mixture and shredded cheese. Step 6: Fold each tortilla over and bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes. Step 7: Serve with fat free sour cream and salsa.

Dish Name: Chicken Salad With Taco Ranch Dressing
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, buttermilk, fresh lime juice, taco seasoning, onion powder, fresh cilantro, kosher salt, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, canola oil, black beans, avocado, plum tomato, romaine lettuce, tortilla chips, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil Taco-ranch dressing: whisk together all the dressing ingredients in a medium bowl. Step 2: Refrigerate until chilled, at least 30 minutes Chicken: mix the taco seasoning, onion powder, and kosher salt in a small bowl. Step 3: Season the chicken on both sides with the spice mixture and brush with the canola oil. Step 4: Place the chicken on the prepared baking sheet and bake until opaque in the center, 15 to 20 minutes Salad: combine the beans, avocado, tomato, and taco seasoning in a large bowl and toss gently. Step 5: Add the lettuce, chips, and cilantro. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 cup of the dressing and toss, adding additional dressing if necessary. Step 7: Divide between 2 plates.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, jalapenos, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, white vinegar, salad oil, salt, pepper, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: After boiling chicken allow to cool and cut into strips or bite size pieces. Step 2: Combine all ingredients and mix well I like to serve the salpicon in a tortilla bowl, lined with lettuce This also makes a great salsa for eating on tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, chicken breasts, red onion, green bell pepper, mild salsa, honey, garlic clove, cumin, ground black pepper, olive oil, light sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Pre heat the oven at 175c. Step 2: Mix together the chicken, red onion, green bell pepper, 100 ml salsa, honey, garlic, cumin, and pepper. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a baking pan. Step 4: Place the mix into the pan and cover with foil. Step 5: Cook for approximately 20 minutes, stir and cook uncovered for a further 10-15 minutes Warm the tortilla wraps. Step 6: Take each wrap and cover with 1 tbls of salsa and 1 tbls of light sour cream. Step 7: Fill each tortilla with an 1 / 8 of the chicken mix, and roll into cylinders.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lemon juice, dried oregano, salt, pepper, chicken tenderloins, plum tomatoes, nonstick cooking spray, scallion, mint, jalapeno pepper, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: For the skewers: heat outdoor grill. Step 2: Mix ingredients in a plastic food bag and seal. Step 3: Marinate for 15 minutes Have ready 8 skewers For the salsa: coat tomatoes with nonstick spray. Step 4: Grill, turning, for 5 minutes or until the skins are charred, remove to a bowl. Step 5: Mash until almost smooth. Step 6: Stir in rest of ingredients. Step 7: Thread chick on skewers.

Ingredient Names: margarine, onion, garlic clove, whole kernel corn, cream-style corn, salt, egg substitute, cornbread mix, cooked chicken breasts, green chili peppers, nonfat sour cream, ground black pepper, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Grease 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 3: Melt margarine in a small skillet over med-high heat. Step 4: Saute onion and garlic until tender, 4 to 6 minutes, set aside. Step 5: In a large bowl, combine corn, cream style corn, salt and eggs. Step 6: Beat in muffin mix. Step 7: Fold in cooked onion mixture. Step 8: Pour into prepared baking dish. Step 9: In a large bowl, combine chicken, green chiles, sour cream, salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flour, garlic powder, cumin, salt, cayenne pepper, eggs, yellow cornmeal, vegetable oil, muenster cheese, green chilies, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chicken breast halves to 1 / 2 inch thickness. Step 2: Combine flour and seasonings in a medium bwl Lightly beat eggs Measure cornmeal into a shallow bowl. Step 3: Dip chicken, first into seasoned flour, then in eggs, then coat with cornmeal, and chill in the fridge. Step 4: Saute coated chicken in vegetable oil over medium heat about 5 to 6 minutes on each side, or until golden. Step 5: Arrange chicken on an oven-proof platter or baking dish, spoon salsa or picante over the chicken, top with chopped chilies, then muenster slices. Step 6: Place in a 350 oven or in the broiler, for about 15 minutes - until the cheese has melted to your tastes.

Ingredient Names: cooked boneless skinless chicken breast, mozzarella cheese, feta cheese, onion, whole wheat tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Spray skillet with cooking spray or lightly coat it with oil and heat to medium high Lightly brown one side of the tortilla and set to the side Re oil or spray pan and place un toasted tortilla in the pan and top with cheeses and chicken, then place toasted tortilla on top Continue cooking until cheese is melted and warmed. Step 2: Slice into wedges and serve with tzatziki sauce Or if you don't like waiting over the stove top, you may bake at 400 for about 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Stir Fry With Roasted Corn And Beans
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, black beans, roasted red peppers, ears of corn, green chilies, onion, taco seasoning mix, water, chicken, tortilla, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Corn -- bring the oven to 450 degrees I shuck the corn and then just drizzle with olive oil and wrap with foil so no clean up. Step 2: Set in the oven for 20-25 minutes I rotate the corn every 5 minutes or so to get evenly roasted. Step 3: Remove and take off the foil and then just let cool before you cut the corn off. Step 4: Now if you are using frozen corn, skip this step I just happen to like the flavor but it can easily be made without it Chicken -- sprinkle a little of the seasoning over the chicken Just let set a few minutes as you prepare the corn Cutting the corn -- now, some chefs use a bunt pan and set the corn on the top center so as the corn cuts it doesn't go all over.

Ingredient Names: margarine, onion, garlic clove, whole kernel corn, cream-style corn, eggs, salt, cornbread mix, chicken, mild green chilies, mushroom stems and pieces, sour cream, pepper, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375. Step 2: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Step 3: Melt butter in small skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add onion and garlic. Step 5: Cook and stir 4 to 6 minutes or until tender, stirring constantly, set aside. Step 6: In a large bowl, combine corn, cream style corn, eggs and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, mix well. Step 7: Add corn muffin mix-mix well. Step 8: Fold in cooked onion mixture.

Dish Name: Chicken Sweet Potato And Quinoa Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: water, quinoa, sweet potatoes, cooking spray, boneless skinless chicken breasts, onions, jalapeno pepper, red bell peppers, garlic clove, ground cumin, frozen peas, low-sodium low-fat chicken broth, fresh cilantro, salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chop up all the vegetables But don't combine them, keep each separate. Step 2: Combine water and quinoa in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until liquid has been absorbed About 12-15 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, add the sweet potato into another small saucepan with enough cold water to cover by 2 inches. Step 5: Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Drain and keep warm I add them to the cooked quinoa, and cover the pot to keep warm. Step 7: Heat a large nonstick frying pan or wok over medium high heat.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, cooked chicken, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, refried beans, cheese, tomatoes, guacamole, sour cream, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Mix taco seasoning and tomato sauce. Step 2: Add shredded chicken and coat it well with tomato mixture. Step 3: Place cooked rice in the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 or disposable baking pan. Step 4: Top with chicken mixture. Step 5: Top with 1-2 cans of refried beans so you have a nice even coating Freeze in the disposable pan or pop out and put in freezer bag. Step 6: Place casserole back in the 9 x 13 x 2 pan. Step 7: After thawing top with grated cheese. Step 8: Bake uncovered for 30 to 45 minutes at 350f or until hot all the way through and the cheese is nice and bubbly. Step 9: Top with your favorite toppings or dip with tortilla chips!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic salt, chili powder, lettuce, cucumber, low-fat cheddar cheese, chunky salsa, tomatoes, green onions, fat free ranch dressing, baked corn tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with garlic salt and chili powder Broil 2 minutes or until done. Step 2: Cool and cut into strips. Step 3: In a bowl, toss lettuce with chicken, cucumber and cheese To serve, top with salsa, tomato, green onions, dressing and crushed tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salsa, fresh thyme, fresh rosemary, fresh parsley, chili powder, cumin, olive oil, salt, pepper, cheddar cheese, limes, lettuce, sour cream, refried beans
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Mix the thyme, parsley, rosemary, chili powder and salt and pepper with 3 tbs Of the oil. Step 3: Spoon or rub this mixture onto the thin pieces of chicken Brown the chicken on both sides in a skillet with the remaining oil. Step 4: Transfer to the oven, so that the insides can cook through. Step 5: Once the chicken has cooked, slice it, and i like to get it extra crispy by browning the sliced chicken pieces again in the same skillet that you cooked the chicken in before Just make sure that the chicken doesn't dry out I made my own salsa by mixing 1 / 4 cup minced white onion, 2 chopped tomatoes, some parsley, lime juice, olive oil, chili powder and cumin But if you want, just use store bought and maybe add a dash each of chili powder and cumin to give it a homemade taste.

Ingredient Names: mexican blend cheese, milk, egg substitute, cumin, red pepper, creamed corn, corn muffin mix, green chilies, cooking spray, red enchilada sauce, cooked chicken, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Combine 1 / 2 cheese and next 7 ingredients in a large bowl, stir until blended. Step 3: Pour mixture into a 13x9 baking dish coated with cooking spray. Step 4: Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until set Pierce entire surface liberally with a fork and then pour enchilada sauce covering top. Step 5: Top with shredded chicken and remaining cheese. Step 6: Bake again at 400 degrees for 15 minutes remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes cut up and serve with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, onion, dried oregano, cream cheese, salt, pepper, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in medium saucepan of lightly salted water. Step 2: Bring to a boil over med-high heat. Step 3: Reduce to low, simmer until chicken is done - but moist Shred into strips In medium skillet, heat 1 tbsp oil over med-high heat. Step 4: Add onion and oregano. Step 5: Cook until onion is tender, remove from heat. Step 6: Stir in cream cheese. Step 7: Add chicken, salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Chicken Taquitos With Warm Tomato Salsa Flautas Con Pollo
Ingredient Names: cotija cheese, cooked chicken, corn tortillas, roma tomatoes, tomatillos, red onion, fresh cilantro, jalapeno chile, mexican oregano, olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 / 4 cup cheese with chicken. Step 2: Heat tortillas one at a time in a very hot, dry pan until soft. Step 3: Fill and roll each tortilla, as its heated, with chicken / cheese mixture Secure with a toothpick. Step 4: Heat a frying pan containing 1 / 2 inch oil to 350f Deep fry flautas until golden and crisp. Step 5: Drain on paper towel. Step 6: Serve topped with warm tomato salsa and crumbled cotija cheese ---salsa--- Mix all salsa ingredients in a sauce pan over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chili powder, pico de gallo, romaine lettuce, onion, reduced-fat monterey jack cheese, radishes, whole wheat bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine chicken, chili powder & 1 cup of pico de gallo. Step 2: In a second bowl, combine lettuce, onion, cheese & radishes. Step 3: Place equal amounts of both the chicken mixture & lettuce mixture on 4 slices of bread. Step 4: Spoon 1 / 4 cup pico de gallo over lettuce & top with a second slice of bread, then serve as soon as possible.

Ingredient Names: rolls, chicken, refried beans, cheese, salsa, sour cream, avocado, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Micro the split rolls a few seconds to make them nice and soft and then pull the doughy centers out of the top and the bottom. Step 2: Spread the bottom with a layer of hot refried beans then sprinkle with shredded cheese. Step 3: Put a pile of hot cooked chicken on top of the cheese then top with sour cream, salsa, a couple slices of avocado then shredded lettuce. Step 4: Top with the other half of the bun and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, garlic, onion, chili powder, adobo seasoning, tomatoes and green chilies, carrots, celery, cooked chicken breasts, white rice, corn tortillas, mozzarella cheese, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Mix broth, garlic, onion, chili powder, adobo seasoning and can of diced tomatoes and chiles in large soup pot. Step 2: Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes for flavors to blend. Step 3: Add carrots, celery, chicken and rice and cook 30 minutes more, or until rice is tender In individual heat-proof bowls, place two tortillas cut into strips Ladle soup over the tortillas and sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup cheese. Step 4: Place under broiler until cheese melts. Step 5: Remove from oven, top with 1 / 2 sliced avocado and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, rotel tomatoes, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, onion, tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In bowl, combine cooked and shredded chicken, rotel tomato / green chilies, soups and onion, set aside. Step 2: Layer bottom of greased 9x13 baking dish with tortillas You may need to cut tortillas, but they don't have to fit perfectly. Step 3: Spread half the chicken mixture on top of tortillas. Step 4: Cover with 1 cup cheddar cheese. Step 5: Repeat layers - tortillas, chicken mixture, cheese. Step 6: Bake, uncovered at 350 for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, romaine lettuce, tortilla chips, pumpkin seeds, queso fresco, avocado, sour cream, mayonnaise, cilantro, ranch dressing mix, green chilies, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken breasts 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through. Step 2: Cut cook chicken into bite-sized pieces. Step 3: Place all dressing ingredients in blender, and process until smooth. Step 4: Place salad ingredients in a large serving bowl, and immediately before serving toss with dressing, starting with 1 cup and adding more dressing as needed.

Ingredient Names: water, green onions, green peppers, yellow squash, zucchini, cheddar cheese, chicken bouillon cubes, fresh carrot, celery, roma tomatoes, serrano chili, cumin, garlic, salt, pepper, white chicken meat, brown rice, black olives, mexicorn, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: First 14 ingredients blend at high speed in Vita-Mix for 4-5 minutes. Step 2: No need to peel any of the vegies, you can even leave the skin of the garlic on. Step 3: Then the last 6 ingredients blend 5-10 seconds on #1 variable speed.

Dish Name: Chicken Tortilla Soup Mix Jar Gift
Ingredient Names: converted long grain rice, tortilla chips, chicken, chicken bouillon granules, lemonade mix, lemon pepper, dried cilantro, garlic powder, ground cumin, salt, dried onion flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a quart sized jar, place rice, pressing down carefully. Step 2: Then add seasoning packet, making sure it can be seen from the edges. Step 3: Then fill the rest of the jar with crushed tortilla chips Close with lid Tape a can of chicken to the top of jar For 12 cups of delicious tortilla soup: Carefully empty tortilla chips from jar and set aside in a bowl. Step 4: Remove seasoning packet and also set aside. Step 5: Pour remaining jar contents into a large pot for cooking rice. Step 6: Add 10 cups of water, seasoning packet and one can of diced tomatoes and green chilies.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breasts, creamed corn, chicken broth, black beans, diced tomatoes with mild green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken, corn, chicken broth, black beans, and diced tomatoes in large sauce pan. Step 2: Simmer on medium heat until chicken is is heated. Step 3: Serve with tortillas on the side.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, onion, flour, dry oregano, chicken broth, green chilies, tortillas, cheese, green chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken pieces-set aside to cool Dice chicken when cooled. Step 2: Saute onion till translucent. Step 3: Put chicken back into skillet- add the flour, stirring till flour disappears. Step 4: Add oregano and cook till aromatic. Step 5: Add chicken broth to mixture to thicken. Step 6: Cook 1-2 minutes-then add the diced green chiles Warm mixture through. Step 7: Put tortillas in microwave and microwave each one about 25-30 seconds. Step 8: Remove tortilla and put the chicken mixture in and fold the tortilla seam side down.

Dish Name: Chicken With Cheddar And Green Chilies
Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, flour, chili powder, salt, ground cumin, celery, onion, garlic, green chilies, chicken broth, sour cream, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Soak top and bottom of clay cooker in water 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain Coat chicken pieces with mixture of flour, chili powder, salt and cumin. Step 3: Combine celery, onion and garlic in cooker. Step 4: Top with chicken and green chilies. Step 5: Pour in chicken broth. Step 6: Place covered cooker in cold oven. Step 7: Set oven to 450 degrees. Step 8: Bake, stirring once or twice, until chicken is tender and brown, about 1 1 / 4 hours. Step 9: Remove chicken from cooker.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillet, garlic cloves, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, chili pepper, cacao, almonds, cumin, cinnamon, ground cloves, brown sugar, orange juice, orange zest, unsweetened chocolate squares
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot heat the olive oil, add the garlic then brown the chicken breasts. Step 2: Remove the chicken and reserve. Step 3: Put in the pot the onion, the pepper and the tomatoes. Step 4: Stir and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Then add the chili, the cacao, the spices, the almonds, the sugar, the zest and the orange juice. Step 6: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the chocolate and the rum. Step 8: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 9: Put the chicken in a casserole dish and then add the sauce from the pot. Step 10: Bake at 350f for 50-60 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken With Fresh Tomato Cilantro Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, potatoes, onion, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, tomato paste, tomatoes, fresh lemon juice, fresh cilantro, butter, olive oil, cream cheese, heavy cream, salt and pepper, adobo seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the sauce: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter and a bit of olive oil in a pan. Step 2: Add chopped onions, pepper, garlic and saut until tender. Step 3: Add 2-3 teaspoons of tomato paste, stir around until all coated. Step 4: Add chopped tomato, stir around, add a bit of water, like cup or so to give some liquid, add lemon juice. Step 5: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Add a tablespoon of cumin. Step 7: Add a few dashes of red hot A turmeric and a dash of dry adobo spice if you are using.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, poblano peppers, evaporated milk, garlic clove, chicken bouillon powder, butter, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Place evaporated milk, poblanos, garlic and bouillon in a blender. Step 2: Blend to desired consistency. Step 3: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Stir in flour, stirring constantly until smooth Gradually stir in the poblano mixture. Step 5: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes just to a boil and thickens Makes about 2 cups To serve: place cooked chicken breasts on individual plates or serving platter. Step 6: Spoon small amount of sauce over each. Step 7: Pour remaining sauce in bowl or small pitcher to pass around the table.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, mexican seasoning, ro-tel tomatoes, tomato paste, red onions
Instructions: Step 1: Season both sides of chicken breasts with mexican seasoning and set aside. Step 2: In a medium bowl, stir together diced tomatoes, tomato paste, and onions. Step 3: Pour half of salsa mixture in the bottom of a 5-quart slow cooker. Step 4: Add chicken and top with remaining salsa mixture. Step 5: Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.

Ingredient Names: tomatillo, skinless chicken, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, olive oil, onion, scallions, jalapeno, fresh lime juice, sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Roast husked, rinsed tomatillos in a cast iron skillet over medium heat until browned on all sides and soft - use tongs to turn. Step 2: Transfer tomatillos to food processor and coarsely grind. Step 3: Wash and dry chicken, season liberally with salt and pepper. Step 4: Saute onions, scallions and jalapeno in olive oil until soft- approximately 4 minutes Increase heat to high and add chicken, cooking until lightly seared, approximately 2 minutes Still in tomatillo, lime juice, and sugar, and simmer until done. Step 5: Stir in cilantro and cook for one minute Correct seasoning, adding salt or sugar to taste. Step 6: Serve with rice or tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, garlic cloves, oregano, ground cumin, orange juice, white vinegar, tabasco sauce, vegetable oil, onion, red bell peppers, canned tomatoes, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into slices 1 / 8-1 / 4" thick. Step 2: Marinate in a mixture of garlic, oregano, cumin, orange juice, vinegar, and hot sauce. Step 3: Allow to marinate 10 minutes up to 24 hours, covered in the refrigerator. Step 4: Meanwhile, chop vegetables. Step 5: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 6: Add oil and heat 30 seconds. Step 7: Add chicken and stir fry about 3-4 minutes. Step 8: Add onions and peppers and stir fry another 1-2 minutes, or until chicken is completely opaque. Step 9: Add tomato and ground pepper and cook just until heated through. Step 10: Serve over brown rice with a side salad.

Dish Name: Chicken fajitas with avocado & Caesar dressing
Ingredient Names: boneless, limes, garlic, ground coriander, chili powder, red peppers, fresh coriander, sunflower oil, romaine lettuce hearts, avocados, flour tortillas, caesar dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the chicken on a board with a sharp knife, then put in a large bowl. Grate in the lime zest and squeeze in the juice. Crush the garlic, then add to the chicken with the ground coriander, chilli powder (if using) and seasoning to taste. Stir well, cover, then chill until ready to cook. You could do this the night before. Step 2: On a clean chopping board, and using a clean knife cut the avocado into quarters. Ease the quarters away from the stone, then peel off the skin. Slice or chop the flesh. Thinly slice the lettuce. Halve the pepper, remove seeds and stalk, then slice or chop the flesh. Step 3: Chop the fresh coriander, then stir it into the chicken. Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan. Add the pepper, then stir, continuously, over a high heat for 2 mins. This is called stir-frying. Add the chicken, then stir-fry over a high heat for 5 mins until the chicken is cooked. Step 4: Heat a large, dry frying pan until hot, then add the tortillas one at a time to heat and brown a little. Turn them over with tongs so that both sides are warmed. Step 5: Take a warm tortilla and spread with some Caesar dressing. Add some lettuce and avocado, then some of the chicken and pepper mixture and a little more Caesar dressing if you like. Step 6: Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then carefully roll up so that the filling is completely enclosed. Alternatively, put the dishes of the salad, chicken and tortillas on the table for the family to make up their own.

Ingredient Names: tortilla chips, skinless chicken breasts, spicy tomato salsa, sour cream, mature cheddar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Crush the tortilla chips. Put the chicken breasts on a non-stick baking tray, season, then slash each 3 times with a knife. Spoon 1 tbsp of salsa on top of each, then 1 tbsp soured cream. Step 2: Sprinkle the chips over the chicken, then the cheese. Roast for 15-20 mins until the topping is golden and melting.

Ingredient Names: plain corn tortilla chips, chicken breasts, green onions, red leicester cheese, red, fresh cilantro, choice salsa pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Layer up the tortilla chips in an ovenproof dish or baking tray with the chopped chicken, spring onions, cheese and pickled jalapeños. Bake for 8 mins or until the cheese is melted. Step 2: To serve, sprinkle with the coriander and eat with your favourite accompaniments.

Dish Name: Chilaquiles For A Crowd From Rick Bayless
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, salsa, chicken broth, tortilla chips, cheese, cooked chicken, mexican crema, queso anejo, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a very large, dutch oven, heat the oil over medium high. Step 2: Add about 2 / 3 of the onions, and cook, stirring often, until richly browned. Step 3: Add salsa and broth and bring to a boil. Step 4: When sauce is at a rolling boil, turn off the heat and stir in the tortilla chips and shredded cheese. Step 5: Press the chips down so that nearly all of the chips are submerged, some may still stick out Strew the chicken over the top, then cover and let stand 3 to 4 minutes Gently stir everything together, then drizzle with the crema and sprinkle with the onion, optional grated queso anejo and cilantro. Step 6: Serve without hesitation.

Ingredient Names: cayenne pepper, dried oregano, ground coriander, ground cumin, chili powder, green enchilada sauce, tomatillos, salsa verde, boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, garlic cloves, mild green chilies, lime, cilantro, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients and place in a crock pot. Step 2: Cook on high for one hour and then switch to low for an additional 4-6 hours - time could be different depending on how hot your crock pot cooks At this point i like to break the meat up with a large spoon so that it is more or less "shredded" Serve in a bowl with cilantro, yogurt or sour cream and tortillas on the side.

Dish Name: Chili And Cheese Stuffed Chicken Breasts
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked wild rice, roasted green chilies, cheddar cheese, green onion, ground cumin, salt, ground black pepper, corn flakes, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together rice, chili, cheese, onion, and cumin. Step 2: Rinse chicken thoroughly, and pat dry. Step 3: Cut a slit in each breast to create a pouch that is open on one side only. Step 4: Stuff each chicken breast with rice filling Coat each stuffed breast with beaten egg, then coat in potato flakes and place in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Bake at 375 degrees f for 40 minutes, or until juices run clear If the breasts dry out too quickly, cover loosely with a piece of foil.

Dish Name: Chili Brown Rice With Chicken Black Beans And Olives
Ingredient Names: olive oil, brown rice, chili powder, ground cumin, dried oregano, water, chunky salsa, salt, black beans, cooked chicken, corn, pitted black olives, avocado, fresh cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Step 2: Add the rice Toast, stirring occasionally, until aromatic, 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Turn heat to low Push rice aside. Step 4: Stir in chili powder to taste, cumin and oregano Toast 15 seconds Gradually stir in water. Step 5: Stir in 2 cups of the salsa and the salt, taste.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, diced onion, garlic clove, chicken stock, masa harina, water, enchilada sauce, velveeta cheese, sea salt, chili powder, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Add oil to a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken to pot and brown 5 minutes per side, set aside. Step 3: Add onions and garlic to potand saute about 2 minutes, add chicken stock. Step 4: Combine masa harina with 2 cups water and whisk until blended add mxture to pot. Step 5: Add remaining water, red sauce, cheese and spices and bring to a boil Shred the chicken into small bite size pieces and add it to the pot. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmerfor 30-40 minutes or until thick. Step 7: Serve with your choice of shredded cheddar cheese, crumbled tortilla chips or pico de gallo.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, water, olive oil, garlic cloves, soy sauce, salt, liquid smoke, cayenne pepper, black pepper, top sirloin steaks, spanish onion, green pepper, red pepper, yellow pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the lime juice, water, oil, garlic, soy sauce, salt, liquid smoke, cayenne pepper, black pepper and either the sirloin or the chicken in a tupperware container, cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 2: Discard leftover marinade. Step 3: Grill meat over medium flame 4-5 minutes on each side. Step 4: Cut meat into thin strips. Step 5: Set aside and keep warm. Step 6: Combine the 2 tbls Water, soy sauce, lime juice, salt, pepper and olive oil, set aside. Step 7: Cook onion and peppers in oil until brown, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: salsa verde, anaheim chilies, boneless skinless chicken breasts, black beans, white beans, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place 2 cups of the salsa verde in the crock-pot. Step 2: Stir in the chilies, add meat. Step 3: Cook on high for 4 hours. Step 4: Take meat out of crock-pot and shred. Step 5: Add back to crock-pot along with remaining 1 / 2 cup salsa and the 2 cans of beans. Step 6: Stir and cook on high for 30 more minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, garlic cloves, fat-free chicken broth, oregano, chili powder, hominy
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken over medium-high heat in saucepan. Step 2: Remove chicken from saucepan, keep warm Reheat saucepan to medium heat and saute onion and garlic until onion in translucent. Step 3: Add cooked chicken, chicken broth, oregano, and chili powder and combine. Step 4: Reduce heat to low cover and cook 15 minutes. Step 5: Add hominy cook 15 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: toasted sesame oil, ginger, garlic, ground chicken, chili-garlic sauce, hoisin sauce, rice wine vinegar, carrots, cilantro, sesame seeds, tortilla chips, muenster cheese, napa cabbage leaves, rice vinegar, mirin
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the sesame oil over medium heat in a large saute pan or wok. Step 2: Stir-fry the ginger& garlic until it starts to soften, approximately one minute. Step 3: Raise the heat to high 3 Break up the ground meat / poultry into chunks and place in pan. Step 4: Stir in chili garlic sauce and the hoisin sauce Continue to cook, stirring and breaking up the mixture until the mixture is dry on the outer surface and the juices have started to evaporate, so the chips dont get soggy. Step 5: Add the sesame seeds. Step 6: Preheat the oven to 475f whle the oven is preheating. Step 7: Toss the remaining ingredients to make an asian slaw.

Ingredient Names: buttermilk, garlic cloves, chipotle chiles, adobo sauce, orange, orange juice, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, chicken wings, agave syrup, garlic clove, tabasco sauce, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, mexican crema
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl or baking dish, add all the ingredients for the wing marinade and mix to combine. Step 2: Add the chicken wings and mix well to make sure all of the wings are coated. Step 3: Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for a couple of hours or overnight Peheat oven to 450 degrees f. Step 4: Place a cooling rack onto a lined rimmed backing sheet and brush the cooling rack with vegetable oil. Step 5: Remove the wings from the marinade and place them directly onto the cooling rack. Step 6: Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, flipping once after 25 minutes, until crisp and browned on all sides While the wings are baking, place a small saucepan over medium heat and add all of the ingredients for the wing sauce And bring to a simmer. Step 7: Whisk to emulsify and combine.

Ingredient Names: chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic cloves, sherry wine, steak seasoning, olive oil, water, salt, lime, white onion, chicken legs, aluminum foil
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients except onion and chicken in a blender. Step 2: Blend until it is a liquid Score chicken to absorb sauce. Step 3: Marinate chicken for a minimum of 2 hours Individually wrap each piece of chicken and put a least 2 tablespoons of the marinade in each wrap and some of the sliced onion. Step 4: Cook in the oven for 40-45 minute at 450 degrees. Step 5: Serve with rice and vegetables.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken thigh, onion, green pepper, garlic cloves, long grain rice, chipotle chile in adobo, tomato sauce, water, pimento stuffed olives, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the oil and add the chicken, cooking until browned. Step 3: Transfer to a plate. Step 4: Add the onion, pepper and garlic to the pan and cook over a medium heat until soft. Step 5: Add the rice, chipotle and cook for about a minute. Step 6: Stir in the chicken, tomato sauce, water and olives, and bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce the heat ans simmer, covered until the chicken is cooked through and the rice is tender. Step 8: Stir in the peas and heat through before serving.

Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, frozen whole kernel corn, frozen cubed hash brown potatoes, diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic, chipotle chiles in adobo, chili powder, ground cumin, dried oregano, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, colby-monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Coat a 2-quart round casserole with nonstick spray. Step 2: Set aside Coat an unheated large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray. Step 3: Heat skillet over medium-high heat, add corn. Step 4: Cook about 5 minutes or until corn begins to lightly brown, add potatoes. Step 5: Cook and stir 5 to 8 minutes longer or until potatoes begin to brown. Step 6: Stir in tomatoes, chipotle peppers, 1 / 2 teaspoon chili powder, 1 / 2 teaspoon cumin, and the oregano, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, boneless skinless chicken breasts, chipotle chile in adobo, chili powder, minced garlic cloves, salt, sugar, fresh cilantro, cheddar cheese, sour cream, avocado, tortillas, corn, black beans, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse basamati rice in cold water and drain. Step 2: Soak basamati rice in water for ten minutes. Step 3: Drain rice and place in low heat skillet. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 cup of minced fresh cilantro, 1 squeezed lime juice and 1 / 2 squeezed lemon juice to the rice in the skillet. Step 5: Add salt and sugar and cook rice on low level heat till aromatic. Step 6: Place rice with two cups of water in rice cooker or in sauce pan covered for 13 minutes or desired cook time. Step 7: Cut chicken into bite sized pieces and set aside. Step 8: In a small mixing owl whisk together minced chipotle peppers, cumin, chili powder, 1 whole lime juice, 3 tbs of minced cilantro and chicken broth Sautee garlic on medium heat till brown and then add bowl of chicken broth and seasonings. Step 9: Cook for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean ground chicken, adobo sauce, tomatillos, yellow onion, fresh cilantro, garlic cloves, ground cumin, corn tortillas, olive oil, red onions, tomatoes, romaine lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Line 2 baking sheets with plastic wrap and set aside. Step 2: Using hands, combine chicken, sauce, tomatillos, yellow onion, cilantro, garlic and cumin in a bowl Form into 16 thin patties. Step 3: Arrange in a single layer on prepared baking sheet and freeze until firm, about 15 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, preheat broiler. Step 5: Using a 4-inch biscuit cutter, cut tortillas into 16 smaller rounds. Step 6: Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet and broil, turning once, until golden and slightly crisp, 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Transfer on baking sheet to a rack to cool. Step 8: Meanwhile, preheat grill and lightly oil rack. Step 9: Grill burgers, turning once, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, serrano peppers, garlic cloves, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, chipotle chile in adobo, cooked chicken, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp oil in large, heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and serrano chile. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and stir-fry 1 minute. Step 5: Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and pepper. Step 6: Transfer to a medium bowl and wipe skillet clean with a paper towel Chope chipotle chile. Step 7: Place in a small bowl with adobo sauce and mash with fork. Step 8: Add to onion mixture in bowl. Step 9: Add chicken and toss.

Ingredient Names: chicken, basmati rice, black beans, dried chipotle powder, ground cumin, dried oregano, garlic cloves, red onion, olive oil, lime juice, skinless chicken breast halves, water, salt, vegetable oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade and chicken: add all marinade ingredients together, except chicken, to a food processor and puree until smooth Rub the marinade into the chicken and marinate at least one hour, up to 4 hours. Step 2: Season the chicken with salt to taste. Step 3: Grill the chicken for about 5 minutes per side or until cooked through. Step 4: Slice into strips For the basmati rice: in a 2-quart heavy saucepan, heat oil or butter over low heat, stirring occasionally until melted. Step 5: Add water and salt. Step 6: Bring to a full rolling boil At boiling, cover, turn down to simmer over low heat until rice is tender and the water is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Step 7: Stir in cilantro and lime juice.

Ingredient Names: balsamic vinegar, olive oil, chipotle chiles in adobo, salt, napa cabbage, carrot, red onion, fresh cilantro, cooked chicken, avocado, queso anejo, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: The filling: in a large bowl, whisk together the vinegar, olive oil and chipotles. Step 2: Season generously with salt, usually about a generous 1 / 4 teaspoon. Step 3: Add the cabbage, carrot, onion, cilantro and chicken. Step 4: Toss everything together and let stand for 15 minutes. Step 5: Taste and season with additional salt if necessary Finishing the dish: scoop the filling into a wide shallow serving bowl, dot with the cubed avocado and dust generously with the cheese. Step 6: Serve with warm tortillas.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken breasts, spanish onions, garlic cloves, chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, avocados, lime juice, green onions, cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken, spanish onions, garlic, and the chipotle in a large soup pot. Step 2: Sprinkle in the salt, and the garlic and onion powders. Step 3: Put in enough water to cover over all. Step 4: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer. Step 5: Cook at a "fast simmer", for about 1 hour, or until chicken is thoroughly done. Step 6: Remove the chicken to cool. Step 7: Keep the broth over low heat in the meantime. Step 8: Taste the broth and adjust the seasonings as desired Peel, pit and chop the avocados into small chunks. Step 9: Pour the lime juice over the avocado chunks and toss.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, margarine, cream cheese, sour cream, milk, chicken bouillon cube, canned chipotle chile
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the chicken cutlets in hot melted margarine on both sides, without getting them browned Process the rest of the ingredients in blender. Step 2: Pour over chicken cutlets in the skillet and let simmer for 5 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, onion, green bell pepper, salt and pepper, adobo sauce, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in a single layer in a large pot and cover with water. Step 2: Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer until cooked, about 7 minutes. Step 3: Drain, transfer chicken onto a bowl or plate, let cool and shred. Step 4: In a large, deep skillet, heat 1 cup oil until it reaches 360 degrees fahrenheit. Step 5: Fry 1 tortilla for about 1 minute or until crisp, flipping the tortilla halfway through. Step 6: Remove tortilla onto a plate. Step 7: Let oil return to 360 degrees and repeat Warm the remaining 1 tablespoons oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Step 8: Add onion and bell pepper, salt and pepper, and cook 7 minutes. Step 9: Stir in adobo sauce and chicken, and saute for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, whole canned tomatoes, chipotle chiles in adobo, vegetable oil, white onion, garlic cloves, chicken broth, salt, mexican crema, cooked chicken, cheese, mozzarella cheese, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the tortilla chips: Preheat oven to 375f Stack tortillas into three piles of four tortillas each. Step 2: Cut each pile like a pie into 8 sections Spray 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray. Step 3: Divide the tortilla chips between the two pans, keeping them in as much of a single layer as possible Mist the chips with cooking spray, and bake them for 10 to 15 minutes, or until crispy and golden. Step 4: Sprinkle with salt, if desired To prepare the sauce: Pour the drained tomatoes and the chipotles into a blender.

Dish Name: Chipotle Grilled Chicken With Avocado Salsa
Ingredient Names: chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, kosher salt, whole chickens, hass avocadoes, lime, white onion, fresh cilantro stems
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, puree the chipotles, garlic, oil, and salt Wipe the chickens with paper towels Thoroughly coat the pieces on all sides with a layer of the chipotle paste. Step 2: Place in a nonreative baking dish or in resealable bags and refrigerate for 2 hours, or as long as overnight. Step 3: Heat the grill to medium With the lid open, grill the chicken on both sides until well marked but not burned- about 7 minutes per side. Step 4: Turn the heat to low, close the lid, and cook the chicken, skin side up, until an instant-read thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the thigh reads 165 degrees. Step 5: Serve with tortillas and salsa Avocado salsa: place the avocados in a bowl. Step 6: Sprinkle with the salt an dlime juice.

Dish Name: Chipotle Grilled Chicken With Avocado Sandwich
Ingredient Names: olive oil, lime juice, dried chipotle powder, chicken breast, monterey jack cheese, hamburger buns, avocado, lettuce, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: In a shallow bowl, stir together the olive oil, lime juice and chipotle chile powder. Step 2: Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of wax paper Use a meat pounder to flatten the breasts to an even thickness of about 1 / 2 inch Trim off excess fat If you are starting with 2 half-pound chicken breast halves, cut each one in half so that you have 4 pieces to better fit the buns. Step 3: Place the chicken breasts in the marinade, turning to coat. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap. Step 5: Let marinate for at least 15 minutes, preferably an hour. Step 6: Remove from marinade and lightly season with salt. Step 7: Heat grill on high heat if you are using a gas grill or prepare coals for direct heat if you are using charcoal.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, chipotle cheddar cheese, chopped pimiento, fresh cilantro, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: Using a sharp, thin knife, cut a parallel slit in the side of each chicken breast, forming a pocket, taking care not to cut through top or bottom of chicken. Step 2: Combine 1 cup cheese, pimientos and cilantro. Step 3: Stuff into pockets of chicken. Step 4: Place chicken on a foil-lined baking sheet. Step 5: Combine chili powder, cumin and garlic salt Rub mixture over both sides of chicken Coat chicken lightly with cooking spray or brush with canola oil. Step 6: Bake in a preheated 400f oven 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Step 7: Sprinkle remaining cheese over chicken Continue baking 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese has melted.

Ingredient Names: black beans, sour cream, diced tomatoes with chiles and cilantro, sweet corn, chicken breasts, mexican rice, fresh cilantro, cumin, adobo seasoning, paprika, taco seasoning, salt, pepper, guacamole seasoning mix, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up chicken and add cumin, taco seasoning salt + pepper, paprika, and adobo, set to the side. Step 2: Cook rice according to the directions on the box. Step 3: In a large saute or frying pan on med-high heat, estimate and add 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil. Step 4: Add chicken While chicken is cooking, peel avacados and make guacamole according to package directions.
