Step 5: Refrigerate Open cans of black beans, corn, diced tomatoes with chiles and cilantro and put in small bowls If you'd like, you can warm, the can of beans and corn Don't warm the can of diced tomatoes, unless you like warm salsa / tomato mixture. Step 6: Once chicken and rice is done, you can start plating.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, tortilla chips, taco cheese, salsa, sliced ripe olives
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange chips on a large microwavable platter. Step 2: Top with 1 cup of cheese, chicken, salsa, olives and remaining cheese Microwave on high 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese is melted, turning platter halfway through cooking time.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, butter, onion, fresh garlic, fresh cilantro, salsa verde, chicken broth, fresh tomato, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and saute until soft. Step 3: Add chicken breasts and saute until golden brown. Step 4: Add salsa verde, chicken broth and cilantro. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Step 6: Serve over rice or couscous and sprinkle with the chopped fresh tomatoes and green onion.

Dish Name: Cilantro Chimichurri Shrimp Or Chicken Rice
Ingredient Names: cilantro leaf, red jalapeno chiles, garlic cloves, red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper, medium shrimp, cooked long-grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat grill or broiler. Step 2: Combine cilantro, jalapenos, garlic, vinegar, 1 / 4 cup oil, salt and pepper in food processor Process until fine texture, set aside. Step 3: Toss shrimp with remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Step 4: Arrange on grill or rack in broiler pan. Step 5: Grill or broil 4 inches from heat source 2 minutes on each side or until opaque in center. Step 6: Combine hot rice with half of the cilantro mixture, mix well, place on platter.

Dish Name: Cilantro Lime Chicken Fajitas With Grilled Onions
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, olive oil, fresh lime juice, ground cumin, dried ancho chile powder, salt and pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, poblano chiles, yellow bell peppers, red onions, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare barbecue. Step 2: Puree first 5 ingredients in processor. Step 3: Season marinade with salt and pepper. Step 4: Place chicken breast halves in 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish. Step 5: Pour 1 / 3 cup marinade over, turn to coat. Step 6: Arrange poblano chiles, bell peppers, and onions on large rimmed baking sheet. Step 7: Pour cup marinade over, turn to coat. Step 8: Sprinkle chicken breasts and vegetables with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, tomato sauce, dried ancho chiles, salt, burrito-size flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, mango, red bell pepper, green onion, mango salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken on lightly oiled grill over medium heat for about 5 minutes on each side or until lightly charred and cooked through. Step 2: Let chicken cool slightly and cut into strips. Step 3: Puree the tomato sauce and dried pepper in food processor or blender. Step 4: Transfer to small saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add grilled chicken to the pan and toss well to coat. Step 6: Season to taste with salt. Step 7: Place flour tortillas on a flat surface. Step 8: Top half of each tortilla with equal amounts of cheese, mango, bell pepper, green onion and chicken. Step 9: Fold over tortilla. Step 10: Cook in large skillet on both sides until cheese is melted and tortilla is crisp.

Dish Name: Cinco De Mayo Chicken Tortilla Soup
Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, green chilies, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, ground cumin, chicken broth, tomato sauce, tomatoes with onion and garlic, white chicken meat, fresh cilantro, lime juice, salt, pepper, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, sate onion in oil. Step 2: Add the canned chilies, garlic jalapeo and cumin. Step 3: Stir in the broth, tomato sauce and canned tomatoes with garlic and onion, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 4: Stir in chicken, and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add cilantro, lime juice salt and pepper. Step 6: Once served top with chips, cheese and sour cream if desired.

Dish Name: Cinco De Mayo Glazed Chicken Wings
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chicken wings, green onions, crushed red pepper flakes, carbonated lemon-lime beverage, green chilies, taco seasoning mix, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In 12-inch nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add chicken wings and onions. Step 3: Sprinkle with pepper flakes. Step 4: Cook uncovered 5 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned, drain. Step 5: Stir in carbonated beverage, green chiles and taco seasoning mix Increase heat to high. Step 6: Cook uncovered 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-high. Step 8: Cook 5 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until chicken wings are completely glazed, small amount of glaze remains in skillet and juice of chicken is clear when thickest part is cut to bone.

Dish Name: Classic Mole Poblano Sauce With Chicken
Ingredient Names: dried pasilla peppers, dried new mexico chiles, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, sesame seeds, almonds, corn tortilla, raisins, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, ground coriander, water, shortening, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chiles, onion, garlic, tomatoes, 1 tablespoon of the sesame seeds, almonds, tortilla, raisins, cloves, cinnamon, and coriander. Step 2: Puree small amounts of this mixture in a blender until smooth. Step 3: Melt the shortening in a skillet and saut the puree for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 4: Add the chicken broth and chocolate and cook over a very low heat for 45 minutes The sauce should be very thick The remaining sesame seeds are used as a garnish. Step 5: Season chicken breasts to taste and grill over low heat for about 25 minutes or until desired doneness Ladle mole sauce over each breast and scatter the tops with warm corn kernels. Step 6: Garnish with cilantro leaves, thin slices of tomatillo.

Ingredient Names: eggs, center-cut bacon, shallots, garlic cloves, red wine vinegar, olive oil, dijon mustard, chicken breasts, mayonnaise, low-fat buttermilk, blue cheese, corn tortillas, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Place eggs in a large saucepan. Step 2: Cover with water to 1 inch above eggs. Step 3: Bring just to a boil, remove from heat. Step 4: Cover and let stand 13 minutes, drain. Step 5: Cool in ice water 5 minutes Peel and dice eggs. Step 6: Cook bacon in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp. Step 7: Remove bacon from pan, reserving drippings in pan.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, unsweetened cocoa powder, chili powder, sugar, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, oranges, orange muscat dessert wine, salt, italian parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Step 2: Cut into 1 1 / 2 inch chunks. Step 3: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and cook, turning occasionally, until lightly browned, about 6-8 minutes. Step 5: Transfer with a slotted spoon to a rimmed plate. Step 6: Add onion, garlic, cocoa, chili powder, sugar, cumin, and cinnamon to pan. Step 7: Cook, stirring often, until onions are limp and spices are fragrant, about 1-2 minutes. Step 8: Add 1 / 2 cup broth to pan and stir to loosen and bits stuck to bottom. Step 9: Simmer until onion is limp, about 5 minutes. Step 10: Return chicken to pan.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, celery ribs, onion, dry white wine, cream cheese, heavy cream, whole green chilies, tomatillos, serrano chilies, drippings, egg, flour tortillas, sour cream, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 375. Step 2: Wash and dry 6-8 chicken breasts. Step 3: Sprinkle with salt and pepper Coarsely cut 2 celery stalks and 1 onion Lay in a roasting pan: first the vegetables and then the chicken, skin side up. Step 4: Add 3 / 4 cup dry white wine. Step 5: Bake at 375 for 1 hour Reserve juice. Step 6: Let chicken cool and shred into thin slivers Cream 8 oz cream cheese with mixer.

Dish Name: Copycat Souper Salad Chicken Enchilada Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, onion, garlic cloves, dry enchilada mix, chicken broth, cream of chicken soup, rotel tomatoes, milk, shredded cheddar cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a non stick skillet over medium heat cook together the chicken, onions and garlic. Step 2: Add the enchilada mix and stir to coat chicken. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and cook on medium for around 40 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking. Step 4: Cut corn tortillas into strips, add to pot and remove from heat. Step 5: Allow to cool and serve.

Dish Name: Copycat Taco Bell Chicken Enchilada Bowl
Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breast, refried beans, cooked rice, enchilada sauce, taco seasoning, cheese, green onion, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly season and cube chicken and cook in a medium pan with a little bit of water, olive oil, and taco seasoning. Step 2: Add 3-4 tbsp of enchilada sauce to cooked rice and mix well. Step 3: Layer in a salad bowl in this order Refried beans on bottom layer, next a layer of rice, chicken, enchilada sauce, green onions, cheese. Step 4: Then microwave for about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Top with sour cream This recipe can be tripled and made in a 8x8 pan to make more servings Hot peppers and tomatoes and lettuce can be added within the layers Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, aluminum foil, frozen whole kernel corn, fresh tomato, thick & chunky salsa, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 Center chicken breast on each foil sheet. Step 2: Top with vegetables. Step 3: Spoon salsa evenly over chicken and vegetables. Step 4: Bring up sides of foil and double fold Double fold ends to form 4 packets, leaving room for heat circulation inside each packet. Step 5: Place packets on cookie sheet and bake for 26-30 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked or internal juices run clear. Step 6: Place contents of packet into individual serving plates. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: lean ground meat, frozen corn, red enchilada sauce, sour cream, garlic powder, salt and pepper, cheese, cornmeal, plain cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, salt, milk, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 If you have a cast iron skillet, use that! Step 2: The one i used was 10" across and about 2" deep Brown meat, seasoning with salt and pepper as desired. Step 3: Add corn, enchilada sauce, sour cream, garlic salt, and anything spicy if you desire, mix well If you don't have a cast iron skillet, then place mixture in a greased casserole dish. Step 4: Mix together the dry ingredients for the cornbread topping. Step 5: Whisk together egg and milk. Step 6: Add to cornmeal mix and mix well. Step 7: Sprinkle cheese over meat mixture Carefully pour cornbread batter over meat and cheese.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, onion, taco seasoning mix, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt, ground black pepper, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, red enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 To make meat mixture: heat oil in medium saucepan, add either cooked shredded chicken or ground beef. Step 2: Add onion and saut and add taco seasoning and prepare according to package directions To make cheese mixture: combine sour cream, cottage cheese, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl To assemble enchiladas: take a bit of the meat mixture, cheese mixture, and shredded cheese and roll. Step 3: Place the enchiladas in a 9x13 baking dish, with folded edge on bottom of pan. Step 4: Top tortillas with any remaining meat or cheese mixture or shredded cheese. Step 5: Pour the enchilada sauce over tortillas. Step 6: Bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes or until bubbly Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cream cheese, green enchilada sauce, mild chiles, burrito-size flour tortilla, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Cube chicken and brown in deep skillet. Step 2: Add the chilies and cream cheese to the pan with the chicken. Step 3: Cook until cheese is thoroughly melted Spray a 9x13" pan with cooking spray. Step 4: Put a little of the green enchilada sauce on the bottom of the 9x13" pan. Step 5: Spoon chicken mixture into tortilla's and roll them up like burritos. Step 6: Place them in the 9x13" pan. Step 7: Pour the rest of the green enchilada sauce over the rolled enchiladas. Step 8: Sprinkle with the shredded cheese.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, onion, butter, chicken broth, half-and-half, cream of chicken soup, salsa, creamed corn, whole kernel corn, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, jalapeno, ground cumin, new mexico chile powder, fajita seasoning mix, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot over med. Step 2: Heat, saute garlic and onions in butter. Step 3: Add broth, cream of chicken soup, and half and half. Step 4: Mix until well combined. Step 5: Add salsa, corn, chicken, cumin, chili powder, and jalapenos. Step 6: Simmer soup for 1 / 2 to 1 hour, stirring often Crumble tortilla chips into individual bowls, and ladle in the soup. Step 7: Top with cilantro, cheese, and more tortillas if desired.

Ingredient Names: condensed cream chicken soup, low-fat sour cream, picante sauce, chili powder, black beans, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, tomatoes, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soup, sour cream, picante sauce, and chili powder. Step 2: In a separate bowl, mix beans, cheese, and 1 cup of sauce mixture. Step 3: Divide bean mixture into tortillas. Step 4: Roll with seam down in a 9x13 pan. Step 5: Pour remaining sauce over top of enchiladas. Step 6: Cover and bake at 350 for 40 minutes. Step 7: (I like to remove cover for last 10 minutes of bake time so that it gets a little crispy.) After baking, top with green onion and tomato.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, sour cream, coriander, chives, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the chicken breast pieces in a little olive oil and butter until almost cooked through. Step 2: Put the chicken in a heatproof bowl to cool. Step 3: Once the chicken has cooled, add the chopped coriander and chives and the sour cream to the chicken and mix all together. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f. Step 5: Using a 9" x 13" oven dish, spoon a little enchilada sauce into the bottom of the dish. Step 6: Spoon a couple of tablespoons of chicken mix onto each tortilla and roll up, placing each rolled enchilada into the oven dish, seam side down. Step 7: Once the oven dish is full, pour the rest of the enchilada sauce over the top and then sprinkle generously with the shredded mozzarella. Step 8: Place the dish in the oven for 25-30 minutes until enchiladas are done.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cream cheese, green chilies, flour tortillas, green enchilada sauce, cheese, pepper, seasoning salt, garlic powder, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400f. Step 2: Cook chicken over medium-high heat until cooked through. Step 3: Add seasonings to chicken while cooking. Step 4: Add cream cheese and chilies. Step 5: Cook and stir until blended. Step 6: Arrange 2 tortillas on the bottom of a greased 8x8-inch pan. Step 7: Sprinkle the tortillas with a small amount of the cheese. Step 8: Pour the chicken mixture over the tortillas. Step 9: Sprinkle small amount of cheese over chicken mixture. Step 10: Arrange remaining tortillas on top.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, black beans, sweet corn, salsa, low-fat cream cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In large pot mix all items except cream cheese and tortillas. Step 2: Once well mixed and hot, add cream chees and let melt on top. Step 3: Stir well and put into corn or flour tortillas.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, skim milk, diced green chilies, jalapeno, onion, flour tortillas, reduced-fat mexican cheese blend, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Boil chicken in water until done. Step 2: Allow to cool and remove the bones and the skin, shredding the chicken If you are using chicken breasts, simply boil them up and shred them. Step 3: In a large bowl, mix the three soups and the can of diced chiles. Step 4: Add about 1 / 2 the soup mixture to the shredded chicken along with the chopped onion The consistency of this mixture should be like chicken salad: make sure not too runny. Step 5: Set the remainder of the soup mixture to the side. Step 6: Place about 2-3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture into a flour tortilla, and sprinkle with a little cheese. Step 7: Roll this into an enchilada, and place into a pan I use a lasagna pan so that i have left-overs.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, green chilies, onions, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, heavy whipping cream, bit butter
Instructions: Step 1: Sauté onion in small amount of butter. Step 2: When transparent, add chicken pieces and can of green chilies. Step 3: Mix well and add cream cheese. Step 4: Cook over low heat until cream cheese melts. Step 5: Put mixture in a 13 x 9 baking pan, top with 1 cup of grated cheese Pour the whipping cream over the top and then put the last cup of grated cheese over that. Step 6: Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or so, checking to make sure the cheese gets bubbly, not burnt.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, linguine, cajun seasoning, flour, butter, green pepper, red pepper, onion, garlic clove, half-and-half, plum tomato, green onion, salt, dried basil, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put water on to boil to cook your pasta, cook pasta while you are making the sauce. Step 2: Combine cajun seasoning and flour in plastic bag and shake to combine. Step 3: Add chicken to bag and shake to coat them You may have to do several batches, and you'll want to set them aside on a plate. Step 4: In a large skillet over medium heat, add the butter and peppers, onions, and garlic. Step 5: Saute until slightly soft - roughly 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the chicken and saute for additional 5-7 minutes or unitl not pink anymore. Step 7: Reduce heat a little and add green onion, half and half, tomatoes, salt, basil, black pepper, and heat through. Step 8: When the cream just starts to bubble, add the parmesan cheese and combine completely. Step 9: Stir until thickened and pour over cooked and drained spaghetti / linguini.

Ingredient Names: rotel tomatoes & chilies, chicken broth, refried beans, corn, cooked chicken breasts, fresh cilantro, corn tortilla strips, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, broth, beans and corn in medium saucepan. Step 2: Stir together and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce and bring to a simmer, add chicken and heat through. Step 4: Turn off heat and stir in cilantro. Step 5: Top each bowl of soup with cheese and crushed tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vidalia onion, mayonnaise, sour cream, chipotle chile in adobo, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken breasts in water with salt & pepper until very tender Shred chicken & put in medium sized bowl. Step 2: Put the diced onion in with chicken, set aside. Step 3: In a blender or food processor mix mayonnaise, sour cream, and between 3 / 4 to the whole can of chipotle peppers until well blended & smooth The amount of peppers depend, of course, on taste. Step 4: Add mayonnaise mixture to shredded chicken & onion. Step 5: Mix well If you like more moisture in a "salad" type dish add more mayo and sour cream in equal parts to get the consistency you like. Step 6: Serve with low-carb bread, pork rinds, or by itself.

Ingredient Names: cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, enchilada sauce, garlic salt, cumin, red wine vinegar, chicken breasts, onion, green chilies, doritos, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Combine soups, enchilada sauce, garlic salt, cumin, and vinegar. Step 3: Stir well and set aside Crush chips and put 2 cups of crushed chips in the bottom of a greased casserole dish. Step 4: Top with chicken strips, onion, green chiles, sauce, remainder of chips, and cheese. Step 5: Bake for 30 - 35 minutes, until cheese is beginning to brown. Step 6: Serve with guacamole, sour cream, salsa, cilantro, whatever you like.

Dish Name: Creamy Dreamy Easy Mexican Chicken Casserole
Ingredient Names: roasting chicken, yellow onion, refried beans, rotel tomatoes & chilies, campbell southwest-style pepper jack soup, sour cream, taco blend cheese, flour tortillas, taco seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Pull apart chicken into bits and / or tiny strips into a large bowl Over medium heat saut onions to desired texture. Step 2: Mix together chicken, taco seasoning, refried beans and rotel tomatoes and onions. Step 3: Mix together southwest style condensed soup & sour cream in medium bowl. Step 4: In a medium casserole dish spread half the sour cream mixture on the bottom. Step 5: Then tear 1 tortilla into pieces on top of sour cream mixture. Step 6: Add 1 / 2 chicken mixture on top of that & then a layer of cheese. Step 7: Repeat layers and sprinkle cheese on top. Step 8: Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until heated through Both the chicken mixture & sour cream mixture can be mixed ahead of time & stored in the fridge.

Dish Name: Creamy Green Chili Chicken Corn Enchilada Style Bake
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, asadero cheese, cheddar cheese, requeson cheese, butter, sour cream, cream cheese, red onion, garlic cloves, mexican oregano, chicken, corn, green chili, scallions, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To make the sauce: Roast tomatillos, onion, green chilis, and garlic together in a 425 degree oven until charred and softened. Step 2: Remove the skin, seeds, and stems from the green chilis. Step 3: Place all ingredients in a blender and puree If needed, season with additional salt / pepper To make the enchilada bake: In a bowl, combine chicken, corn, onion, garlic, sour cream, and cream cheese in a bowl with a bit of salt and pepper and mix well. Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix together 1 / 4 cup of cheddar, 1 / 2 cup queso asadero, butter and requeson cheeses with the oregano and a pinch of salt & pepper to season Spray the bottom and sides of a casserole pan with non-stick cooking spray Scoop a thin layer of the green sauce on the bottom of the pan and layer the tortillas.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, oil, flour, green chilies, taco seasoning, sour cream, black beans, whole kernel corn, tortilla chips, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the onion until it is translucent. Step 2: Stir in the chicken and the flour. Step 3: Cook, stirring until the flour cannot be seen. Step 4: Stir in chilies, taco seasoning, sour cream, beans and corn, and continue to stir until the mixture boils. Step 5: Place mixture into a 9x13-inch pan that has been sprayed with cooking oil spray. Step 6: Mix 1 / 2 cheese with the tortilla chips and sprinkle evenly over the top. Step 7: Bake in a 350 oven about 25 minutes or until bubbly and brown. Step 8: Sprinkle on remaining cheese and bake an additional 10 minutes or until cheese has melted.

Ingredient Names: chicken, chicken broth, cream cheese, pomegranate seeds, poblano chiles, cooked ham
Instructions: Step 1: Blend broth, cream cheese and 3 / 4 cup pomegranate seeds, pour through strainer and reserve strained liquid. Step 2: Fry chicken for 10 min or until brown on both sides. Step 3: Add chiles and ham, fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add creamy mixture, cover and cook for 15 minute. Step 5: When serving add to your plate the rest of the pomegranate seeds on top of the chicken Enjoy the deliciousness!, lol.

Ingredient Names: campbell's creamy ranchero tomato soup, cooked chicken, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 1 / 2 can soup, chicken and 1 / 3 cup cheese. Step 2: Spoon the chicken mixture down center of each tortilla. Step 3: Roll up and place seam-side down in 2-qt Shallow baking dish. Step 4: Mix remaining soup and milk and pour over all. Step 5: Top with remaining cheese. Step 6: Bake at 375f 20 minute or until hot.

Dish Name: Creamy Santa Fe Chicken And Rice
Ingredient Names: fat-free cottage cheese, greek yogurt, low sodium chicken broth, salt, garlic powder, taco seasoning, green chilies, black olives, diced tomatoes, sweet corn, cooked chicken, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package, but instead of water, cook the rice in an equal amount of chicken broth plus the reserved tomato juice While the rice is cooking, mix together the chilies, olives, tomatoes, corn, and cooked chicken in a large bowl. Step 2: Blend cottage cheese, greek yogurt, 1 cup of the chicken broth, salt, garlic powder, and taco seasoning until smooth. Step 3: When the rice is done, fold it into the chicken mixture. Step 4: Then stir in the cottage cheese / greek yogurt mixture. Step 5: Bake at 350 for about 45 min or until it seems to hold together nicely.

Ingredient Names: onion, butter, cooked chicken, salsa, cream cheese, ground cumin, monterey jack cheese, corn tortillas, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in butter until tender but not brown. Step 2: Stir in chicken, 1 / 2 cup salsa, cream cheese, and cumin, heat through, remove from heat. Step 3: Stir in 1 cup shredded cheese. Step 4: Heat about 1 / 2 inch oil in skillet until hot Quickly fry each tortilla in oil to soften. Step 5: Drain on paper towels. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 3 cup mixture down center of each tortilla and sprinkle a little bit of cheese. Step 7: Spread enough picante sauce or salsa to cover bottom of lightly greased 9x13 pan.

Dish Name: Crispy Cheesy Tortilla Chip Pan Fried Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, monterey jack pepper cheese, tortilla chips, flour, salsa, eggs, olive oil, salt, pepper, avocados, fresh jalapenos, sour cream, milk, lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce -- make the avocado sauce ahead of time and set in the refrigerator to chill I like to use my mini food processor for this, or a blender will work fine. Step 2: Add the avocado, milk, lime juice, sour cream, jalapeno and cilantro. Step 3: Blend until smooth. Step 4: Check for seasoning salt and pepper and adjust as needed. Step 5: Remove to a small bowl and cover and chill until ready to serve This sauce is serve cold Chicken -- remove to the counter, along with the salsa and eggs You want them to be room temp or at least have the chill taken off them Tortilla chips -- add the tortillas to the food processor and grind until fine chopped.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, salt and pepper, chicken stock, onion, poblano pepper, green bell pepper, canned tomato, corn tortillas, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken with salt and pepper and roast in oven for about 1 / 2 hour. Step 2: When it's cooked through, remove bones and skin and shred the chicken. Step 3: Heat the chicken stock in a saut pan over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion and peppers and saut until onion is translucent. Step 5: Add tomatoes and shredded chicken and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat, cool and drain any excess liquid Soften tortillas with a bit of chicken stock and place chicken mixture in the center. Step 7: Roll up tightly and seal with two toothpicks Spray lightly with cooking spray. Step 8: Place seam side down on medium flame on grill and turn while cooking until crispy - about 5-7 minutes.

Dish Name: Crispy Fried Tacos Or Tacos Dorados
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onion, garlic, vegetable oil, chicken breasts, salt, corn tortillas, milk, sour cream, guacamole, queso fresco, salsa, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Puree the tomato, onion and garlic in a food processor. Step 2: Heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Cook tomato filling until thick and reduced-around 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the meat of choice and mix well. Step 5: Remove from heat and season with salt. Step 6: Heat the tortillas and place an equal amount of filling on each. Step 7: Roll and secure with toothpicks or assemble all and chill seam side down. Step 8: Heat the oil over medium high heat and when hot begin frying tacos 4 at a time until golden on all sides If you are not using the toothpicks-i dont-place seam side down in the hot oil first. Step 9: Remove and drain-repeat and keep warm in the oven until done.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil cooking spray, extra-light vegetable oil spread, skim milk, dried chives, salt, corn flakes, taco seasoning mix, dried parsley, boneless skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 Spray 9x13 baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray. Step 2: In a shallow bowl, combine melted vegetable oil spread, milk, chives and salt. Step 3: In a separate bowl, combine corn flake crumbs, taco seasoning and parsley. Step 4: Dip chicken breasts, one at a time, into liquid mixture then roll in corn flake crumbs. Step 5: Place in baking dish Spray lightly with vegetable oil cooking spray. Step 6: Bake 20-25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink inside.

Ingredient Names: pico de gallo, chicken breast, frozen corn, green onion, red bell pepper, sharp cheddar cheese, tortillas, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine 1 cup of pico de gallo, chopped chicken breast, corn, onion, bell pepper & cheese On the stovetop or in the microwave oven, soften tortillas, then scoop a rounded 1 / 4 cup of filling onto each tortilla, then roll up tightly & secure each with a toothpick. Step 3: Place rolled tortillas seam side down on a baking sheet & brush each lightly with oil. Step 4: Bake 10-15 minutes or until crisp & lightly browned. Step 5: Place 2 or 3 taquitos on each plate & serve with a side of the remaining 1 cup of pico de gallo These can be frozen for later use.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Cheesy Mexican Chicken And Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, queso sauce, salsa, taco seasoning, garlic powder, chicken stock, rice, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts in the crockpot 2. Step 2: Mix together the salsa, queso dip, chicken stock, taco seasoning, garlic powder and uncooked rice 3. Step 3: Pour the mixture over the chicken 4. Step 4: Cook on low for 4-5 hours adjust cooking time depending on the size of the chicken breasts 5. Step 5: Garnish with sour cream if desired.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chicken Breast In Poblano Cream
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, onion, garlic cloves, poblano pepper, chicken broth, cumin, adobo sauce, salt & pepper, cream cheese, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Step 2: Place onion, garlic, poblano and chicken breast in crock pot. Step 3: Mix together broth, adobe sauce and cumin, pour over chicken. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 3 hours. Step 5: Meanwhile, dice cream cheese and allow to come to room temperature. Step 6: After cooking for three hours, ladle into a small bowl approximately 1 / 2 cup of hot broth from crock pot. Step 7: Whisk in the cream cheese. Step 8: When well incorporated, add cream cheese mixture to crock pot Stirring well.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, vidalia onion, lime juice, garlic cloves, ground cumin, seasoning salt, chili powder, green bell pepper, flour tortillas, shredded cheddar cheese, salsa, sour cream, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken and onions in crockpot. Step 2: Sprinkle spices over all. Step 3: Add the lime juice and stir well. Step 4: Cook on low for 4-6 hours If you start with frozen chicken breast, you might need to cook for longer than 6 hours. Step 5: Serve in warm tortillas with your favorite fajita toppings.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chicken Or Pork Fajitas
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, red bell pepper, onion, lime, taco seasoning, salsa, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Stir to combine all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on high for 3-4 hours Just before serving, heat flour tortillas in foil at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Step 2: Serve fajita mixture with warmed flour tortillas and all your favorite toppings, such as: sour cream, cheese, guacamole, etc Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: taco seasoning, chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Dissolve taco seasoning into chicken broth. Step 2: Place chicken breasts in crock pot and pour chicken broth over. Step 3: Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours With two forks, shred the chicken meat into bite-size pieces To freeze, place shredded meat into freezer bags with the juices. Step 4: Press out all the air and seal.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, chicken breasts, green enchilada sauce, condensed cream of chicken soup, flour tortillas, salsa, onion, cheese, lettuce, chopped tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the skin and excess fat from the chicken pieces. Step 2: Place chicken in crock pot. Step 3: Combine the green enchilada sauce and soup in a bowl and blend well. Step 4: Pour over chicken pieces. Step 5: Cover crock pot and cook on lo 8 hours. Step 6: When tender, remove chicken and shred. Step 7: Add sauce to chicken to moisten nicely. Step 8: Serve on tortillas You can fold over the tortillas like a soft taco, or roll them up like an enchilada or even a burrito. Step 9: Garnish as desired.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, chives, fresh cilantro, garlic clove, low-sodium taco seasoning, lime, tequila, apple cider vinegar, salsa, liquid smoke, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a hot fry pan, quickly sear each chicken breast on each side (about 3-5 seconds on each side. Step 2: Put breasts in crock pot. Step 3: Add the rest of the ingredients and mix with hand until the chicken is covered evenly. Step 4: Turn crock pot on low and cook for 6-7 hours Shred chicken with fork and salt to taste. Step 5: Cook on low for another hour or so. Step 6: Serve with warm flour / corn tortillas, chopped lettuce, tomatoes, onions, avocado, fresh cilantro and hot sauce.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, taco seasoning, onion, minced garlic clove, olive oil, chicken broth, lime juice, tomatoes and green chilies, corn, cumin, chili powder, salt, avocado, sour cream, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Empty the the taco seasoning packets into a plastic bag, and place the chicken in the bag and shake to coat the chicken with the taco seasoning On a contact grill, grill the chicken until fully cooked, about 7 minutes While the chicken is grilling, saute the onion and garlic in a pan with the olive oil, until softened Sliced the chicken into 1 / 2 inch slices and place it into the crock pot along with the onions and garlic. Step 2: Place the following ingredients in the crock pot in this order: chicken broth, tomatoes, corn, and lime juice. Step 3: Add cumin, salt, and chili powder to taste Experiment with what your preferences are, being sure to remember that the flavor will deepen and intensify as the soup cooks In other words, the final result will be stronger, so go light on the seasonings if you don't like it spicy. Step 4: Cook on high for about 6-8 hours, or low for 10-12 hours To assemble the final product, in a shallow bowl, place tortilla strips on the bottom, and then spoon the soup over top.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, chunky salsa, fat-free cream of chicken soup, rotel tomatoes, cheese, sweet onion, black olives, quick-cooking tapioca, flour tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except tortilla, in crock pot Cook on low setting 6-8 hours Shred chicken Spoon onto warmed tortillas and roll.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Mexican Chicken And Spanish Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, water, taco seasoning, salsa, instant rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in to crock pot. Step 2: Mix water, taco seasoning, and salsa together, pour onto chicken. Step 3: Set crock pot to low and let it cook for 3 to 4 hours. Step 4: After chicken is done remove and put rice in leftover liquid While rice is cooking shredded or slice chicken. Step 5: Once rice is done mix chicken in or serve as taco or make enchiladas with the chicken.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Mexican Orange Chicken Pollo Con Naranja
Ingredient Names: frozen orange juice concentrate, garlic cloves, pepper, cumin seed, cayenne, jalapeno, salt, chicken breasts, onion, red potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Set crock pot to high. Step 2: Add orange juice, garlic, pepper, cumin, cayenne, jalapeno and salt to blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Step 3: Place chicken pieces in crock pot and pour orange juice mixture over chicken. Step 4: Top with onions and potatoes. Step 5: Cook for 6 hours on high Internal chicken temperature should reach 160 before serving, and the meat should fall off the bone Great served over rice!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, campbell's tomato soup, chunky salsa, cheddar cheese, sour cream, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put crockpot on high setting & pour in both cans of tomato soup. Step 2: Put chicken in crockpot and top with salsa. Step 3: Cook for about 2-3 hours. Step 4: Put chicken on plate and top with more salsa, shredded cheese, and sour cream, if desired. Step 5: Place 3 cheese cubes together on one edge of chicken for decoration & a great follow-up to a bite of terrific salsa chicken!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, black beans, whole kernel corn, tomatoes and green chilies, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, or any other seasonings you like. Step 2: Place chicken breasts in bottom of crock pot, add corn, add black beans. Step 3: Add diced tomatoes and green chilies. Step 4: Cook on low setting for 8 hours. Step 5: Serve as is or with rice.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, cooked ground beef, enchilada sauce, cumin, light cream cheese, onion, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brown your beef or cook the other meat you are using. Step 2: Mix cooked meat, cumin, cream cheese and onion together Spray inside of crock pot with nonstick spray, then pour a little enchilada sauce on the bottom. Step 3: Place one tortilla in the bottom of the pot. Step 4: Cover with some of the meat mixture. Step 5: Pour a little enchilada sauce on top of meat. Step 6: Sprinkle some cheese on top of sauce. Step 7: Add another tortilla and continue layering until you run out of meat mixture You should still have some cheese and sauce left. Step 8: Top with a tortilla, then pour remaining enchilada sauce over all.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, bell peppers, chicken, chili powder, ground black pepper, salt, green chili peppers, mexican blend cheese, enchilada sauce, black beans, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Spray slow cooker with cooking spray. Step 2: Place 3 tortillas in bottom of slow cooker. Step 3: Top tortillas with the corn, half of the chicken, about half of the seasonings, and half of the chile peppers. Step 4: Sprinkle with half of the shredded cheese and pour about 3 / 4 cup of enchilada sauce over the cheese. Step 5: Repeat with 3 more tortillas, the black beans, remaining chicken, seasonings, chile peppers, and cheese. Step 6: Top with remaining tortillas and enchilada sauce. Step 7: Cover and cook on low setting for 5 to 6 hours. Step 8: Serve with guacamole and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, salsa, corn, tortillas, mexican cheese, taco seasoning, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, salsa, corn, and taco seasoning in a crock pot. Step 2: Cook on low for 6-8 hours Before serving, shred chicken with a fork Spray a skillet with cooking spray and add a tortilla On half, add chicken mixture, top with cheese. Step 3: Fold tortilla over and let brown. Step 4: After 1 minute, flip to other side.

Ingredient Names: onion, black beans, pinto beans, tomato sauce, frozen corn kernels, rotel tomatoes, taco seasoning, cumin, dried chipotle powder, boneless skinless chicken breasts, jalapeno pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beans, onion, chili peppers, corn, tomato sauce, cumin, chili powder and taco seasoning in a slow cooker. Step 2: Place chicken on top and cover. Step 3: Cook on low for approximately 8 hours or on high for 6 hours. Step 4: Check towards end time so as not to overcook Half hour before serving, remove chicken and shred. Step 5: Return chicken to slow cooker and stir. Step 6: Top with fresh cilantro.

Ingredient Names: crepes, boneless skinless chicken breasts, queso fresco, onion, garlic clove, red bell pepper, chili pepper, corn kernel, cilantro, olive oil, butter, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the chicken of any sinew or fat and cut it into strips. Step 2: Chop the garlic and peppers and onion. Step 3: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 4: Saute the chicken over medium high heat in 2 tablespoons of oil for about three minutes. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Add the onion, garlic and peppers and saute for another two minutes. Step 7: Place into a bowl with the corn, cilantro and crumbled cheese and combine. Step 8: Fill and roll the crepes, and place in a buttered baking dish. Step 9: Bake for ten minutes and then serve while hot.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, salsa, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, cheese, pam cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the chicken breasts until they are fully cooked and remove from heat. Step 2: Once the chicken has cooled for a bit, use a fork and shred the chicken into a mixing bowl. Step 3: Add the 1 cup of salsa, and mix the chicken and salsa until the salsa is thoroughly covering the chicken. Step 4: Heat up a frying pan or skillet to a medium to medium high heat. Step 5: Take a flour tortilla and spoon out some of the chicken and salsa mix onto one half of it. Step 6: Add enough grated cheese to your desired taste. Step 7: Fold the filled tortilla in half and place on the greased fry pan or skillet. Step 8: Cook until golden brown and then flip and cook the other side Spray the frying pan between quesadillas to prevent sticking Optional: you can cut the quesadillas into thirds to make it easier to eat.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, mayonnaise, fresh cilantro, olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh basil, sprite, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, red peppers, yellow peppers, tequila
Instructions: Step 1: As i said before, this can be cooked any way you would like Still, i prefer to grill these over charcoals Assemble all ingredients, and dump the chicken inches let meld for at least 3 hours, cook completely. Step 2: Cover with the finely diced peppers, And enjoy! Step 3: This is the first recipe i have ever posted online, so please be kind I hope you enjoy this as much as i do!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, onion, garlic, oregano, basil, parsley, chili powder, salt and pepper, flour tortillas, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Brown chicken in pan. Step 2: Add the onion and garlic and sweat them. Step 3: Add oregano, basil, parsley, and chili powder. Step 4: Add salt and pepper if you wish. Step 5: Stir until well blended. Step 6: Set aside to cool for about 5 minutes. Step 7: Spoon a little filling into each tortilla and add half as much cheese to each. Step 8: Roll up and place into a baking pan. Step 9: Spread the rest of the cheese on the top.

Ingredient Names: real butter, onion, cooked chicken, taco seasoning, hidden valley ranch dressing mix, green chilies, crushed tomatoes, great northern beans, diced tomatoes with green chilies, poultry seasoning, cumin, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large dutch oven, saute butter and onions. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients, including 1 can of water. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and let simmer-- the longer, the better in order to let the flavors combine. Step 4: Serve with sour cream, grated cheese, chips, cracker or cornbread.

Dish Name: Dawn's Yummy Chicken Tortilla Soup Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, bell pepper, white shoepeg corn, crushed tomatoes, salsa, black beans, velveeta cheese, chili powder, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken lightly in butter. Step 2: Put chicken, onion, bell pepper, corn, salsa and crushed tomatoes into crockpot, add 1 cup water. Step 3: Cook on high for 3-4 hours. Step 4: Rinse black beans well until water runs clear, then add to slow cooker. Step 5: Add velvetta, cut into chunks so it will melt more quickly. Step 6: Add salt and pepper to taste, and chili powder for as much heat as you want. Step 7: Cook one more hour on high in slow cooker. Step 8: Serve with tortilla strips or alone.

Ingredient Names: southwestern-seasoned chicken breast, flour tortillas, tomatoes, onion, cheddar cheese, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the chicken in the microwave and cover to keep warm. Step 2: Heat a lightly oiled medium to large skillet over medium heat Lay tortilla in pan and on one half, sprinkle 1 / 4 cup of cheese, some tomatoes and onions and finally about 1 / 3 cup of warm chicken. Step 3: Fold other half of tortilla over and gently press to close. Step 4: After about a minute, flip over. Step 5: Remove from pan after another 2 minutes or so or until cheese is melted and tortilla is justslightly crisp Continue with rest of tortillas. Step 6: Slice each quesadilla into 4 wedges and serve with sour cream and your choice of salsa, for dipping.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, tomatoes, rotisserie-cooked chicken, fat-free refried beans, enchilada sauce, whole wheat tortillas, black olives, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Coat 9-inch square baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Chop cilantro coarsely, place in medium bowl. Step 3: Chop tomato finely, set aside. Step 4: Remove meat of chicken from bones and chop coarsely, add to cilantro. Step 5: Stir in beans and 1 can of the enchilada sauce. Step 6: Spoon chicken mixture equally into center of tortillas. Step 7: Roll tortillas around filling and place, seam side down, in baking dish.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, salsa, fat free chicken broth, quick-cooking barley, water, chili powder, cumin, garlic, black beans, garbanzo beans, canned corn, chicken breasts, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, tomatoes, salsa, broth, barley, water, chili powder, cumin, and garlic, bring to a boil. Step 2: Cover and reduce heat to low. Step 3: Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add beans, corn and chicken Increase heat until chili comes to a boil. Step 5: Cover and reduce heat to low. Step 6: Simmer for another 5 minutes, or until barley is tender If chili becomes too thick, add more chicken broth or water until chili is desired consistency. Step 7: Top each bowl of chili with a little shredded cheddar and a dollop of sour cream.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, lime, yellow onion, poblano peppers, sour cream, whipping cream, monterey jack cheese, butter, salt, pepper, thyme
Instructions: Step 1: Shake pepper and thyme on chicken breasts. Step 2: Melt butter in skillet and brown the chicken. Step 3: Set aside in a baking dish and preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 4: In a saute pan, melt butter and saute onion and poblano peppers till soft. Step 5: Take 3 / 4 of the onion and pepper mixture and place in blender along with a dash of salt. Step 6: Add sour cream and whipping cream to reach a thick consistency. Step 7: Turn on blender and puree, leaving some of the texture- set aside. Step 8: Place chicken breasts in a baking dish, squeeze lime juice on each breast, then pour the pureed mixture over them. Step 9: Take the remainder of the peppers and onion and place them on top of the chickens. Step 10: Cover the top with cheese and lightly sprinkle thyme on top of everything.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cilantro leaf, onion, bay leaf, peppercorns, parmesan cheese, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, green chilies, tomatillos, canned tomatoes, whipping cream, egg, guacamole, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken breasts in large pot, add water to cover add bay leaf, peppercorns and salt to taste. Step 2: Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender. Step 3: Cool and drain Shred chicken and mix with chopped onion parmesan cheese and monterey jack and set aside. Step 4: In a blender combine the green chilies, tomatillos, cilantro, cream and egg, blend. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350f heat oil in fry pan and cook tortillas one at a time. Step 6: Place chicken on top of a tortilla, pressing to make it compact. Step 7: Roll tightly and place seam side down in baking dish. Step 8: Pour the chili cream mixture over each one and top with cheddar.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, oregano, garlic cloves, bay leaves, cumin seeds, marjoram, thyme, peppercorns, oil, onion, chicken bouillon granules, chicken, corn tortillas, avocados, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Boil tomatoes 10 minutes. Step 2: Place tomatoes and next 8 ingredients in blender and blend for 4 minutes. Step 3: Saute onion in oil and add blender contents by pouring through a mesh strainer. Step 4: Add one quart of water to strainer and swirl. Step 5: Put leftover ingredients from strainer in 1 / 2 cup of water, blend well and strain into pot. Step 6: Add one more quart of water. Step 7: Add chicken bouillon and chicken pieces and boil until chicken is cooked. Step 8: Fry tortilla strips in oil until crispy. Step 9: Heat 8-10 oz Of stock for each serving.

Ingredient Names: rotisserie-cooked chicken, picante sauce, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, chili powder, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas, tomatoes, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Mix picante sauce, soup, sour cream and chili powder Reserve one cup of the sauce mixture. Step 2: Mix the reserved picante sauce mixture, chicken and cheese. Step 3: Spread about 1 / 4 cup chicken mixture down center of each tortilla. Step 4: Roll up and place seam-side down in 3-quart shallow baking dish. Step 5: Pour remaining sauce mixture over enchiladas. Step 6: Cover and bake at 350f for 40 minutes or until hot. Step 7: Top with additional picante sauce, tomato and onion.

Ingredient Names: frying chickens, dried mexican oregano, extra virgin olive oil, onion, garlic, bay leaves, dry white wine, tequila, spanish olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano In an ovenproof skillet, heat the olive oil and brown the chicken pieces on all sides. Step 3: Remove the chicken from pan and set aside. Step 4: Reduce the heat, add the onion and garlic, and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the bay leaves, wine, tequila, and olives. Step 6: Return the chicken to the pan, cover, and cook in the oven until tender and browned, about 40 to 45 minutes. Step 7: Remove and serve with spanish rice or mexican rice and other sides of your choosing.

Dish Name: Duck Or Chicken Chile Mole Tostadas
Ingredient Names: dried negro chile, dried ancho chiles, olive oil, french bread, sesame seeds, tomatoes, onions, garlic, chicken stock, whole black peppercorns, cloves, mexican chocolate, salt, chicken, green cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: For the mole: pull the stems off the chiles and shake out the seeds. Step 2: Set the seeds aside Wipe off the chiles with a damp paper towel. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a heavy skillet Working in batches, add the chiles and fry until toasty but not dark brown If they get too dark, they become bitter so watch carefully. Step 4: Add more oil as needed As chiles are done, transfer them to a bowl. Step 5: Add a little oil to the chile-toasting pan and toast the bread slices in it. Step 6: Using the same pan, toast 1 / 4 cup reserved chile seeds until brown but not burned.

Ingredient Names: cream chicken soup, tomatoes mild green chilies, sour cream, cheese, flour tortillas, chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together soup, green chilies, sour cream and 1 1/2 cups of cheese. Step 2: Put 1/3rd of this mixture in separate bowl. Step 3: Add chicken to remaining 2/3rds. Step 4: Place heaping spoonful of chicken and soup mixture on each tortilla shell and place seam side down in greased 9x13 pan. Step 5: Top with remaining soup mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 6: Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 20, 25 minutes or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red onions, garlic, fajita seasoning, kidney beans chili sauce, roast chicken legs meat off bone, sweetcorn, flour tortillas, hard cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion and garlic for 5 mins. Stir in the fajita seasoning and cook for 1 min more before adding the kidney beans, shredded chicken and sweetcorn. Step 2: Divide the mixture between the tortillas, sprinkle over half the cheese, then roll up and place into a baking dish. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese, then bake for 20-25 mins until golden and bubbling.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, corn tortillas, garlic, fresh cilantro, onions, tomatoes, ground cumin, chili powder, bay leaves, chicken stock, salt, cayenne pepper, chicken breast halves, monterey jack cheese, avocados, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the tortillas, garlic, cilantro and onion, cooking for 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add the tomatoes, bringing to a boil. Step 4: Add cumin, chili powder and bay leaves. Step 5: Add chicken stock and return to a boil, reduce heat. Step 6: Add salt and cayenne and simmer for an additional 30 minutes. Step 7: Remove bay leaves and stir in shredded chicken. Step 8: Garnish with Monterrey Jack cheese and avocado, and sour cream and fried tortillas if desired.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, bell peppers, oil, chicken breasts, condensed cream chicken soup, tomato sauce, water, chicken bouillon, worcestershire sauce, oregano, ground cumin, chili powder, fresh corn, tortilla chips, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large pot; onion, garlic, and bell peppers in oil. Step 2: Add chicken, soup, tomato sauce, water, spices, and corn, bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover and simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Crush tortilla chips into each bowl. Step 5: Ladle soup over the top. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: chicken, condensed cream chicken soup, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, green chilies, chicken broth, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, green enchilada sauce, salsa, fresh cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, stir together cooked chicken with cream of chicken soup, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and chopped green chilies; set aside. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350°F. Step 3: Grease bottom of large ovenproof casserole dish. Step 4: Heat chicken broth until it is warm and place in a shallow bowl. Step 5: Immerse corn tortillas one at a time immediately before filling- just until it softens just a tad; do not oversoak. Step 6: Remove tortilla from broth, and add another while filling. Step 7: Place about 3 tablespoons of chicken filling across the center of the tortilla, then roll up. Step 8: Place rolled tortilla into the casserole dish. Step 9: Repeat until all tortillas and filling are used. Step 10: Pour green chile enchilada sauce and tomato salsa over the tops of the rolled tortillas, leaving some of each sauce exposed so it shows red/green. Step 11: Sprinkle with shredded cheese and top with chopped cilantro. Step 12: Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes or so or until dish is warmed through, cheese is melted, and slightly golden on top. Step 13: Serve enchiladas garnished with a spoonful of sour cream.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, ancho chile powder, garlic, kosher salt, mexican oregano, ground black pepper, oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, bacon, poblano chiles, onions, fresh cilantro, limes, oaxaca cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken: Mix lime juice, chile powder, garlic, salt, oregano, and pepper; whisk in oil. Step 2: Place chicken in a large ziploc, add marinade, and refrigerate for no longer than 1 1/2 hours. Step 3: Make the filling: Prepare a medium hot charcoal fire, or place a large, heavy skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes. Step 4: Remove chicken from marinade, allowing excess to drip off. Step 5: Grill chicken (if searing in skillet, use 1 Tablespoon oil), flipping after about 4 minutes, until it's just firm to the touch and cooked, through, about 9 minutes total. Step 6: Let cool, then chop into fine pieces. Step 7: Heat skillet over medium heat, adding 1 Tablespoon of oil and the bacon. Step 8: Cook, stirring frequently, until bacon just begins to brown. Step 9: Turn to medium-high, add chiles and onions. Step 10: Cook, stirring frequently, until they begin to soften. Step 11: Add chopped chicken, cilantro, and lime juice, stirring constantly until chicken is hot. Step 12: Taste, and adjust seasoning with salt. Step 13: Sprinkle grated cheese over the top, remove pan from heat, and allow cheese to melt. Step 14: Serve with soft tacos, salsa, etc.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, corn tortillas, green enchilada sauce, tomatillo salsa, black olives, cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, seasoning salt, water, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot, add water chicken thighs, garlic powder, onion powder and seasoning salt. Step 2: Simmer until chicken thighs are cooked and fork tender. Step 3: Remove chicken thighs from liquid and using 2 forks shred the chicken meat. Step 4: Mix shredded chicken, 1 can of salsa and 1 cup of cheese. Step 5: Grease a baking dish, line 5 tortillas on the bottom then layer the other ingredients; chicken mixture, olives, roughly 1/2 of the enchilada sauce and cheese. Step 6: Repeat layering twice (or until you use up all your ingredients). Step 7: You want your last layers to be sauce and cheese so you get a nice bubbly top on the dish. Step 8: Bake at 375 degrees for 45- 55 min or until cheese is bubbly and the entire dish is warmed through. Step 9: Serve with fresh chopped cilantro (optional) and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: becel oil, onions, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breast half, low sodium chicken broth, avocados, tomatoes, limes, sauce, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium low heat. Step 2: Add onions and garlic and cook for about 3 to 5 minutes or until softened, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add stock and bring to boil. Step 4: Stir chicken in and reduce heat to low. Step 5: Partially cover and simmer very gently for about 10 minutes. Step 6: In a small bowl, gently combine tomato, avocado, lime juice, hot sauce and cilantro; set aside. Step 7: Just before serving, stir in tomato/avocado mixture; serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, chipotles adobo sauce, tomatoes, garlic, oregano, sugar, salt, pepper, olive oil, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Slow Cooker: Place Chicken & Sauce ingredients in the slow cooker and cook for 4 hours on low. The chicken is ready when it can be shredded easily with 2 forks but it should NOT be mushy (i.e. overcooked). Step 2: Pressure cooker: 35 minutes on high. Step 3: Stove: Place Chicken & Sauce ingredients in a medium saucepan and add 1 cup water. Simmer covered on medium low for 40 - 50 minutes, turning chicken occasionally, until chicken can be shredded with 2 forks. Step 4: Remove chicken and shred. Set aside. Step 5: Add lime juice (to taste) and 1 tbsp olive oil to the sauce. Use a stick blender (or transfer to blender) to puree the sauce. Adjust salt and pepper to taste. You should have about 2 cups of sauce. Step 6: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add 1/3 to 1/2 the chicken and fry until dark golden brown on one side, flip and cook the other side very briefly (don't brown), then remove. Use 1 tbsp oil for each batch you fry. Step 7: Toss chicken in the sauce OR serve it on the side. Step 8: Use for tacos (guacamole and Pico de Gallo, enchiladas, burritos, on green Mexican rice, quesadillas, sliders, on tostadas.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, green peppers, sweetcorn, chipotle paste, pouch ready-cooked long-grain wild rice mix, black beans water, low-sodium chicken stock, skinless chicken breasts, fresh coriander, low-fat sour cream reduced fat guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan and cook the onion for 5 mins. Throw in the pepper and cook for 2 mins more, then add the sweetcorn, chipotle paste and rice. Stir well and cook for 1-2 mins. Step 2: Add the black beans and the stock. Bring to the boil, turn down to a simmer, then add half the chicken and coriander. Cool for 2-3 mins, then ladle into bowls. Step 3: Scatter over the rest of the chicken and coriander. Serve with a dollop each of guacamole and soured cream on top if you like.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, dark brown sugar, chipotle paste, tomatoes, skinless, red onion rings, fresh cilantro, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan. Add the onion and cook for 5 mins or until softened and starting to turn golden, adding the garlic for the final min. Stir in the sugar, chipotle paste and tomatoes. Put the chicken into the pan, spoon over the sauce, and simmer gently for 20 mins until the chicken has cooked (add a splash of water if the sauce gets too dry). Step 2: Remove the chicken from the pan and shred with 2 forks, then stir back into the sauce. Scatter with a little red onion, the coriander, and serve with remaining red onion, tortillas or rice. Step 3: If you want to use a slow cooker, cook the onion and garlic as above, then put into your slow cooker with the sugar, chipotle, tomatoes and chicken. Cover and cook on High for 2 hours. Remove the chicken and shred then serve as above.

Dish Name: Mexican chicken stew with quinoa & beans
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, red peppers largish chunks, chipotle paste, tomatoes, skinless chicken breasts, quinoa, chicken stock cubes, pinto beans, coriander most, limes, sugar, yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and fry the onions and peppers for a few mins until softened. Stir in the chipotle paste for a minute, followed by the tomatoes. Add up to a tomato can-full of water to cover the chicken and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the chicken breasts and gently simmer, turning the chicken occasionally, for 20 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Step 2: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil with the stock cubes. Add the quinoa and cook for 15 mins until tender, adding the beans for the final min. Drain well and stir in the coriander and lime juice, then check for seasoning before covering to keep warm. Step 3: Lift the chicken out onto a board and shred each breast using two forks. Stir back into the tomato sauce with the sugar and season. Serve with the quinoa, scattering the stew with some coriander leaves just before dishing up and eating with a dollop of yogurt on the side.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, ancho, ground cumin, plum tomato, chicken stock, chicken breasts, limes, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Add the onion and garlic, soften for 5 mins, then stir in the dried chilli, cumin, tomatoes and chicken stock. Blitz in a food processor in batches, or use a hand blender to purée until smooth. Step 2: Return to the pan, then bring to the boil. Add the chicken, reduce the heat, then simmer for 10 mins until cooked through. Stir in the lime juice and some seasoning, then ladle into bowls. Put the toppings in the middle of the table for everyone to help themselves.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, heavy cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Mix heavy cream and salsa in a casserole. Step 2: Wash the chicken breasts and dry them with a paper towel. Step 3: Lay them into the sauce and cover them with the mixture. Step 4: Bake 1 hour at 400° F or until chicken is tender and cooked through. Step 5: If you don't eat meat you can substitute the chicken with feta and bake it for approx 20 minutes. Step 6: Serve with white wine, pita bread, rice or/ and fresh garden salad.

Ingredient Names: mexicorn, chicken broth, garlic, chunk chicken, black beans, tomatoes mild green chilies, instant rice
Instructions: Step 1: Open the cans of corn, chicken broth, chunk chicken, black beans, and diced tomatoes with green chilies, dO NOT DRAIN! Step 2: Add rice and garlic to this as well. Step 3: Pour everything into a large saucepan or stock pot, cover! Step 4: Simmer over medium heat until chicken is heated through& rice is cooked. Step 5: (5 minutes for instant rice).

Ingredient Names: burrito size flour tortilla, smoked cheddar cheese, mexican blend cheese, boneless skinless chicken breasts, onions, salt, pepper, mexican oregano, cumin, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breast into thin pieces and add spices,tossing to coat, refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Shred cheeses. Step 2: Peel onion and slice in half,then slice the onion thin,place in skillet on med heat with 2T olive oil and caramelize,usually takes about 10-15 minutes. Step 3: In a separate skillet (I like to use my cast iron) add 2T olive oil,put on medium high heat till skillet gets hot,add chicken breasts and sear on both sides till done,you want the chicken to be blackened but not burnt,this should take about 5 minutes,just make sure the skillet is hot. Step 4: To prepare the quesadillas butter one side of flour tortilla and place in skillet or griddle on medium high heat,butter side down. Step 5: Add 1/3- 2/3c mexican blend cheese to tortilla, (sprinkling around the whole tortilla),then add the smoked cheddar,about 1/4c (do not overdo the smoked cheddar because it will be to strong). Step 6: Add the chicken pieces (just handful or however much you like) to one side of the tortilla,like you are making an omelet,then follow suit with the onions,as much as you like. Step 7: Fold tortilla over as in an omelet and"fry" till lightly brown and crispy,then flip over and do the other side. Step 8: Slice into wedges and serve with sour cream,salsa,guacamole. Step 9: This recipe will make 3-4 large tortillas,depending on how much ingredients you use per tortilla,the amount I have posted is only a guideline,use as little or as much as your liking.

Dish Name: Spice-crunch chicken with guacamole salad & tortillas
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, tortilla chips, mild chili powder, eggs, avocados, tomatoes, red onions, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 6. Cover a baking tray with parchment. Lay each chicken breast flat on a board, then halve through the middle so you get 2 breast-sized pieces from each. Step 2: Bash 85g of tortillas into rough crumbs and small flakes, then tip into a shallow bowl with 1 tsp of the chilli powder and some salt. Mix well. Dip each piece of chicken into beaten egg. Mix the remaining egg into the tortilla crumbs. Now dip each chicken piece into the crumbs so you have a patchy crust. Step 3: Roast on the tray for 12 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile, cut the avocado and tomatoes into chunks and thinly slice the onion. Whisk the remaining chilli powder and some seasoning into the lime juice, then mix through the avocado, tomatoes and onion. Serve 2 crispy chicken pieces per person with a spoonful of guacamole salad and a handful of the remaining tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, butter, canned jalapeno, mexican blend cheese, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, cumin, chili powder, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 F. Step 2: Combine bread crumb ingredients in a ziplock bag. Step 3: Dip chicken breast into melted butter then shake in bread crumb mixture. Step 4: Lay chicken pieces flat and put cheese and chopped jalapeno slices on top. Step 5: Fold and fasten with toothpick. Step 6: Place in 13x9 inch baking dish. Step 7: Bake, uncovered for 40 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, ortega anaheim chilies, green chili salsa, salt, heavy cream, corn tortillas, oil, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Step 2: Mix the chicken, chilies, and salsa in a small bowl. Step 3: Mix the salt and cream in a large shallow dish. Step 4: Heat the oil in a frying pan over med-high. Step 5: Fry the tortillas one at a time for a few seconds until they start to blister and turn soft. Step 6: Immediately dip each one in the cream mixture. Step 7: Put a large dollop of the chicken mixture on each tortilla and roll it up. Step 8: Place it in a ungreased baking pan, flap side down. Step 9: When all of the tortillas are done, pour the remaining cream over them and sprinkle the cheese over the top. Step 10: Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or so, until they are thoroughly heated.

Ingredient Names: tortillas, pork carnitas, olive oil, cheese, fresh corn kernels, cherry tomatoes, shallots scallions, limes, salt, pepper, chicken thigh fillets, garlic powder, cumin powder, paprika, oregano, chili powder, black pepper, sour cream, cilantro coriander, jalape os, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180C/350F. Step 2: Prepare either the Pork Carnitas or Quick Mexican Chicken. Step 3: Place the corn tortillas in the oven (I do it directly on the shelf) and bake for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, just to make them a bit stiff but not browned. Step 4: Place a tortilla on a baking tray. Scatter 1/6th of the Pork Carnitas or Quick Mexican Chicken on the tortilla and top with Salsa (reserve some for Topping) then cheese. Place another tortilla on top and repeat, then again (so you end up with 3 layers of meat. Place the 4th tortilla on top. I don't put anything on it, but you could sprinkle some cheese if you want. Step 5: Repeat with remaining 4 tortillas. Step 6: Bake for 10 minutes until heated through and cheese is melted (it does not take long), remove from oven. Step 7: Top with remaining Salsa and Toppings of choice (I used sour cream, avocado, jalapeño and coriander/cilantro). Step 8: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the corn and sauté for a couple of minutes until charred to your liking. (This step is optional). Step 9: Allow to cool slightly, then toss with remaining Salsa ingredients. Step 10: Defrost (if using frozen), then heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large fry pan over high heat. Step 11: Add Pork Carnitas and cooking until the underside is golden brown. Step 12: Remove from pan (scrape up all the brown bits) and set aside. Step 13: Combine all ingredients other than the oil in a bowl and toss to combine. Step 14: Heat the oil in a large fry pan over high heat. Step 15: Add the chicken and sauté until browned and cooked through. Step 16: Remove chicken from the fry pan. Allow to cool then either roughly chop into smaller pieces or use a fork to "shred".

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, honey, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, barbecue sauce, sharp cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Step 2: In a large, deep skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium high heat. Step 3: Slowly cook and stir onion until translucent, mix in honey. Step 4: Stir until onion is golden brown, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 6: Place remaining oil and chicken in the skillet over medium high heat. Step 7: Cook until chicken is no longer pink. Step 8: Stir in barbeque sauce and evenly coat chicken. Step 9: Layer 4 tortillas individually with chicken, onions, Cheddar cheese and Monterey Jack cheese. Step 10: Top with remaining tortillas. Step 11: One or two at a time, place layered tortillas on a large baking sheet. Step 12: Bake uncovered in the preheated oven 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Step 13: Cut into wedges to serve.

Ingredient Names: sugar, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, eggs, egg yolks, vanilla extract, table cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f. Step 2: Bring a tea kettle of water to a boil. Step 3: Make the caramel: have ready a 9-inch glass pie plate and a pair of potholders or oven mitts. Step 4: Pour the sugar into a small, heavy saucepan. Step 5: Set it over medium-low heat until the sugar starts to liquefy and form clumps. Step 6: Stir slowly and constantly The sugar will eventually liquefy completely, then begin to color Pay careful attention to the caramel at this point. Step 7: Once it starts to color it will darken quickly Pull the pan from the heat when the caramel is the color of a bright, shiny penny.

Ingredient Names: milk, rose water, saffron thread, cinnamon stick, dried chili, vanilla, semisweet chocolate, sugar, orange
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-sized pot, mix all the ingredients but the chocolate. Step 2: Bring to a boil and reduce to medium If you aren't a big spice person, remove the chili and cinnamon stick If you like things hot, leave them in. Step 3: Let it simmer for a few minutes, then add the chocolate With a whisk, combine the chocolate, then strain out the floaty things and serve.

Ingredient Names: white rice, water, cinnamon stick, pure vanilla extract, sugar, condensed milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, soak the rice, 1 cup water and cinnamon for 30 minutes. Step 2: Add to blender and liquefy for 3 minutes. Step 3: In a large container, mix the blended rice, 5 cups water, vanilla, sugar, and condensed milk. Step 4: Stir and serve over ice.

Ingredient Names: unflavored gelatin, cold water, egg whites, salt, sugar, almond extract, lime, red food coloring, green food coloring
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare 8x4x2 loaf pan with non stick spray, set aside. Step 2: Add the gelatin to the cold water and stir. Step 3: Place this mixture in a double boiler and heat until the gelatin dissolves. Step 4: Remove from heat and let it cool at room temperature. Step 5: Beat the egg whites until lightly stiff Gradually add the sugar and salt one tablespoon at a time while mixing. Step 6: Then add the cooled gelatin, almond extract and lime zest. Step 7: Mix until well combined Do not add hot gelatin to the egg whites. Step 8: Divide the egg whites into three separate bowls.

Ingredient Names: water, long-grain rice, orange rind, salt, milk, sugar, blanched almond, egg yolks, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the water, rice, orange rind, and salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Step 3: Discard the orange rind and add the milk, sugar, and almonds. Step 4: Cook uncovered over low heat until the milk has been absorbed, 20 to 30 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the egg yolks and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 6: Transfer to a serving dish or individual bowls or cups. Step 7: Serve warm, chilled, or at room temperature, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon.

Ingredient Names: sugar, eggs, egg yolks, whole milk, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, orange juice, pure vanilla extract, dark brown sugar, dried ancho chiles, ancho chili, orange rind, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place the sugar in a small skillet or saucepan with 1 / 2 cup of water. Step 2: Stir with a wooden spoon over medium heat until the sugar dissolves, then let the liquid boil down, becoming an amber colored syrup. Step 3: Pour the hot syrup into an 8-cup flan mold, Let it cool and harden. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f And set a pot of water on to boil. Step 5: Beat together lightly the eggs and egg yolks. Step 6: Add the whole, evaporated, and condensed milk and blend together. Step 7: Stir in the orange juice and vanilla extract. Step 8: Mix in the piloncillo or dark brown sugar, stirring until it dissolves.

Ingredient Names: cocoa, eggs, sugar, kahlua, butter, unsifted flour, baking powder, dried ancho chile powder, salt, semi-sweet chocolate chips, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f Lightly grease a 8 x 8 pan. Step 2: Using a spoon, stir eggs with 3 / 4-cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Step 3: Add melted butter Sift ground chocolate with flour, baking powder, and salt. Step 4: Stir into egg mixture, add nuts, stir in chips. Step 5: Spread into greased pan. Step 6: Bake 20 to 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, walnuts, pecans, semi-sweet chocolate chips, ground ancho chili pepper, pie crusts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat over to 350 degrees. Step 2: Melt butter and allow to cool to room temperature. Step 3: In a medium mixing bowl, beat eggs until well blended. Step 4: Add flour and sugars, mix until smooth. Step 5: Add cooled butter and mix well. Step 6: Fold in nuts, chocolate chips and ground ancho chili pepper. Step 7: Pour mixture into prepared pie crust. Step 8: Bake 30 to 40 minutes until pie tests done. Step 9: Serve warm, topped with fresh whipped cream To grind, soften peppers in water for 30 minutes, drain and grind in a blender.

Ingredient Names: anise seed, rum, butter, white sugar, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, egg, salt, baking powder, ground cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Place the anise seeds in a small bowl with the rum. Step 2: Set aside to marinate overnight. Step 3: In a medium bowl, cream together the butter, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Step 4: Stir in the anise seed and rum, mix in the egg. Step 5: Combine the flour, salt, baking powder and cloves. Step 6: Stir into the butter mixture until well blended. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour. Step 8: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough out to 1 / 8 inch thickness.

Ingredient Names: yellow cake mix, vanilla instant pudding mix, whole milk, canola oil, eggs, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, heavy cream, vanilla, rum, non-dairy whipped topping
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 Spray 9x13 pan generously with vegetable oil spray. Step 2: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, whole milk, oil and eggs in a large bowl with an electric mixer on low for 1 minute Stop mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl Increase mixer speed to medium and beat 2 minutes more, scraping the sides of the bowl as needed. Step 3: Pour batter into prepared pan. Step 4: Bake for 32 to 34 minutes until golden brown. Step 5: Remove from oven and cool for 2 hours on wire rack in the pan. Step 6: After the cake is cooled, poke holes all over the top of the cake with a fork The more holes the better.

Ingredient Names: onions, balsamic vinegar, sugar, dried thyme, dried rosemary, vegetable oil, flour tortillas, tart apples, brie cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet over medium heat, cook the onions, vinegar, sugar, thyme and rosemary in oil for 10 minutes or until onions are golden. Step 2: Spoon the mixture over half of each tortilla and top with apples and cheese, fold over. Step 3: Cook on a griddle over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side or until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: apple pie filling, flour tortillas, water, sugar, margarine, nutmeg, cinnamon, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Using a 9x13 inch cake pan, lightly grease or spray with nonstick cooking spray.
