Step 3: Spread approximately 1 / 4 cup of pie filling on each tortilla and roll up the same as enchiladas Lay each side by side in pan In medium saucepan, combine water, sugar, margarine, nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla. Step 4: Heat over med to high heat until margarine is melted and sugar is dissolved. Step 5: Pour this sauce over the burritos, bake 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove from oven and push burritos down into sauce. Step 7: Cover with foil and bake 15 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: apple, flour tortillas, fat-free american cheese, splenda sugar substitute, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice apple Spray frying pan with cooking spray and saute apple until lightly browned remove apple from pan and re-spray. Step 2: Place in pan 1 flour tortilla and scoop 1 / 2 apple, 1 / 2 splenda, 1 / 2 cinnamon, and 1 cheese slice in center. Step 3: Cover pan and cook on medium heat until underside is golden and cheese melts. Step 4: Fold tortilla in half and remove to serving plate. Step 5: Repeat process for second tortilla. Step 6: Serve warm with fat free whipped topping Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: apple pie filling, raisins, flour tortillas, cinnamon, butter, sugar, light brown sugar, water, whipping cream, vanilla ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Butter a 2-quart baking dish. Step 2: Divide and spoon the pie filling down the center of each tortilla, then sprinkle with raisins. Step 3: Sprinkle the cinnamon lightly over the filling and raisins. Step 4: Roll up tortillas and place seam side down in the baking dish. Step 5: In a saucepan bring butter, white sugar, brown sugar, water and whipping cream to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer, stirring constantly for about 3-4 minutes. Step 7: Pour over the enchiladas in the dish. Step 8: Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking. Step 9: Set oven to 350 degrees f. Step 10: Bake for about 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: apple fruit filling and topping, flour tortillas, cinnamon, butter, sugar, brown sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Spoon fruit filling evenly down centers of tortillas. Step 2: Sprinkle with cinnamon. Step 3: Roll up, and place, seam side down, in a lightly greased baking dish. Step 4: Bring butter and next 3 ingredients to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat, and simmer, stirring constantly, 3 minutes. Step 6: Pour over enchiladas: let stand 30 minutes. Step 7: Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Apple Mexi Crisp With A Twist
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, apple pie filling, cheddar cheese, sugar, cinnamon, red-hot candies
Instructions: Step 1: Take your flour tortillas and fry them in some oil until nice and brown. Step 2: After you fry them immediately sprinkle with the cinnamon and sugar until well coated on both sides. Step 3: Put a nice dollop of the warmed apple pie filling over the tortilla and spread it around and sprinkle some cheese on top. Step 4: Sprinkle red hots all over and enjoy There is something about the cheese, apple pie filling and red hots that just make you feel soooo good.

Dish Name: Arroz Con Leche Rice With Milk
Ingredient Names: rice, evaporated milk, sugar, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Stovetop: place all ingredients in a pot, stir together and cook on medium low for about five minutes stirring occasionally as so it does not scorch This should be somewhat soupy Warms up nicely Microwave: same as above, but in microwave safe bowl, microwave for about 2 minutes stirring occasionally so it doesn't boil over You can add whatever fruits that you want to it, dried fruits are great.

Dish Name: Authentic Mexican Marranitos Molasses Gingerbread Pigs
Ingredient Names: brown sugar, vegetable shortening, baking soda, cinnamon, vanilla, unsulphured molasses, egg, milk, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large mixing bowl, stir together brown sugar, shortening, baking soda, cinnamon and vanilla until the mixture forms a firm paste. Step 3: Add, mixing after each addition until blended, the molasses, egg and milk Gradually add the flour, mixing to form a dough. Step 4: Roll dough out to about 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 5: Cut with a large pig-shaped cutter. Step 6: Place each marranito on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Step 7: In a cup or small bowl, beat egg. Step 8: Using a pastry brush, paint tops of marranitos lightly with beaten egg. Step 9: Bake for 15 to 17 minutes, or until browned.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken, chicken base, water, oil, ancho chilies, pasilla chiles, chilies, prunes, raisins, anise, banana, sesame seeds, unsalted peanuts, cinnamon stick, shortbread cookies
Instructions: Step 1: Place the water, chicken base or cubes and chicken in a stock pot. Step 2: Bring the water to a boil, turn the heat down to a medium simmer, cover and cook the chicken for 1 hour or until fork tender and the meat shreds easily While the chicken is cooking pour the oil into a large saute pan. Step 3: Heat the oil on medium heat. Step 4: Once the oil is hot enough add in all ingredients from the dried chiles to the garlic clove. Step 5: Fry the ingredients for 1 minute or until fragrant making sure not to burn the chiles. Step 6: Strain the ingredients and discard all of the oil except for 2 tablespoons place the strained ingredients possibly working in two batches in the blender. Step 7: When the chicken is done, remove the meat from the broth and add in 2 cups of broth into the blender and half of the fried tortilla. Step 8: Blend on high for 5 minutes. Step 9: Heat the 2 tbsp of reserved oil on medium heat in the large skillet you were using before and pour in the blended mole.

Ingredient Names: semisweet chocolate, salted butter, sugar, cinnamon, espresso powder, dried chipotle peppers, all-purpose flour, dutch-processed cocoa powder, eggs, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 2: Line 8-inch glass baking pan with foil, grease and flour. Step 3: In a glass bowl, melt butter and chocolate in 10 seconds increments If chocolate is well-grated, this should take about 40 seconds-stir after 30 seconds. Step 4: Place sugar, cinnamon, espresso powder, and chipotle pepper in a mixing bowl and stir well. Step 5: Put flour and cocoa in another bowl and mix well Scrape chocolate into sugar mixture and beat on medium speed about 30 seconds Scrape sides and bottom of bowl and beat another 20 seconds or so. Step 6: Add eggs, beat to incorporate, scraping as needed. Step 7: Add vanilla and stir to incorporate.

Ingredient Names: oranges, mixed berries, lime, tequila, orange-flavored liqueur, brown sugar, lime zest
Instructions: Step 1: Use a sharp knife to cut a slice off the top and bottom of each of the oranges, then remove the peel and pith, careful to retain the shape of the oranges Hold oranges on their side and cut horizontally into slices. Step 2: Place oranges in a nonmetallic bowl. Step 3: Cut the lime in half and squeeze over the oranges. Step 4: Sprinkle with the tequila and liqueur then sprinkle over the brown sugar to taste. Step 5: Cover and chill till ready to serve, then transfer to a serving dish, mix gently with the berries and decorate with lime zest Enjoy!

Dish Name: Baked Beans Sweet And Spicy With Pineapple
Ingredient Names: pork and beans, bacon, onion, bell pepper, cherry pepper, chipotle chile in adobo, chunk pineapple, brown sugar, molasses, dried parsley, ground mustard
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a large casserole pan Mix and bake in a preheated 350f oven for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: sugar, ground cinnamon, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 In small bowl mix sugar and cinnamon. Step 2: Set aside Unroll dough Separate into 4 rectangles. Step 3: Press each to 6x4" rectangles, pressing perforations to seal. Step 4: Brush tops of 2 rectangles with melted butter. Step 5: Sprinkle with about half of the sugar mixture. Step 6: Top each with remaining rectagle. Step 7: Press edges lightly brusht tops with melted butter.

Dish Name: Baked Ham Glazed With Pineapple And Chipotle Peppers
Ingredient Names: smoked ham, brown sugar, crushed pineapple, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce, nutmeg, fresh ginger, cornstarch, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cornstarch with a little cold water to dissolve. Step 2: Place all ingredients except for ham in a blender and blend smooth, in a small saucepan over medium heat bring to a boil them simmer till thickened. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375 f. Step 4: Place ham, cut end down, in a large baking pan and score skin. Step 5: Bake ham for 15 minutes. Step 6: Brush glaze over ham and bake for another hour or until internal temperature reads 140 f Baste half way through baking.

Ingredient Names: french vanilla cake mix, water, canola oil, eggs, mashed banana, reduced-fat unsweetened coconut milk, french vanilla flavored coffee creamer, heavy whipping cream, sugar, vanilla, banana, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Grease and flour a non stick 9x13-inch pan. Step 3: Combine cake mix, eggs, water, oil, and bananas in a large mixing bowl With an electric mixer, mix until ingredients are well combined. Step 4: Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until light golden brown Sit aside for 1 hour to cool With an electric mixer, mix all the milks and sugar until well combined. Step 5: Using a fork or straw, make holes all over the cake, the more holes the better the leches will absorb. Step 6: Pour 1 / 2 of the milk over the entire cake slowly Wait about 10 minutes and pour the rest of the cake.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, evaporated milk, whole milk, eggs, vanilla extract, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Lay out 6 flan molds or 8 oz Shallow dishes out in a row, or you may use a single 9" round tart pan or pie plate. Step 2: Now, place sugar in saucepan and place directly over medium heat on the stove top Watch closely and constantly stir The sugar will brown and turn to liquid Watch closely and do not allow the sugar to scorch. Step 3: Remove from heat and distribute the caramelized sugar equally across the bottom of the flan molds The sugar will almost immediately harden, but once it is baked with the custard, it will liquefy and remain liquid. Step 4: In a mixing bowl combine evaporated milk, whole milk, eggs and vanilla and whisk together until the eggs are mixed well While mixing you may add a few tablespoons of sugar or honey to sweeten to taste.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, pepper, ground cumin, chili powder depending how you want chili to be, sweet smoked paprika, kidney beans chili sauce, mixed beans, tomatoes, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the onion and peppers, and cook for 8 mins until softened. Tip in the spices and cook for 1 min. Step 2: Tip in the beans and tomatoes, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 mins or until the chilli is thickened. Season and serve with rice, if you like.

Ingredient Names: sweetened condensed milk, cream cheese, tequila, triple sec, frozen limeade concentrate, tostitos scoops, non-dairy whipped topping, mint sprigs
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sweetened condensed milk and cream cheese until well mixed. Step 2: Stir in tequila, triple sec, and limeade concentrate. Step 3: Spoon one tablespoon of mixture into each corn chip bowl. Step 4: Chill at least two hours Just before serving, top with a dab of whipped cream and a sprig of mint or a sprinkle of lime zest.

Ingredient Names: whole almonds, bittersweet chocolate, orange, cinnamon, eggs, sugar, salt, heavy cream, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Step 2: Line an 8" square baking pan with parchment Finely grind the almonds, 6 ounces of the chocolate, the orange zest and 2 teaspoons of the cinnamon in the food processor. Step 3: In a large bowl, whisk the egg yolks with 3 tablespoons of the sugar until pale yellow and thick. Step 4: Fold in the nut mixture The batter will be very thick In another large bowl, beat the egg whites and the salt until frothy Gradually add the remaining 3 tablespoons of sugar, continuing to beat until peaks form. Step 5: Fold half the beaten egg whites into the almond mixture to lighten it, then gently fold in the other half. Step 6: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.

Ingredient Names: lard, sweet wine, sugar, cinnamon, anise seed, egg yolks, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Beat the lard until creamy. Step 3: Mix the wine or fruit juice with 1 cup of sugar, 1 tablespoon cinnamon and anise seeds. Step 4: Add to lard and mix with a wooden spoon. Step 5: Add the egg yolks Mixing well. Step 6: Add enough flour to make soft dough. Step 7: Roll out to 1 / 2-inch thick and cut in desired shapes and place on greased cookie sheet. Step 8: Bake 15 minutes Checking often to prevent burning.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, onion, black beans, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, salt, whole wheat tortillas, soy cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute sweet potatoes and onion in large skillet with 1 tablespoon oil just until tender. Step 2: Add water or apple juice as needed to prevent sticking. Step 3: Add black beans, spices and salt and cook until heated through. Step 4: Divide bean mixture and cheese among tortillas and roll up. Step 5: Place in 9 x 13 inch baking pan Lightly spray with olive oil if desired. Step 6: Cover pan with foil and bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes. Step 7: Garnish with sour cream, salsa and fresh cilantro or wrap up for a to-go meal.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, onions, sweet pimenton, ground cumin, cider vinegar, brown sugar, tomatoes, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, heat the olive oil and fry the garlic and onions for 5 mins until almost softened. Add the pimenton and cumin, cook for a few mins, then add the vinegar, sugar, tomatoes and some seasoning. Cook for 10 mins. Step 2: Pour in the beans and cook for another 10 mins. Serve with rice and the accompaniments of your choice in small bowls.

Ingredient Names: unsweetened chocolate, unsalted butter, espresso beans, salt, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, pecans, kahlua, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f Butter and flour a 9 by 12 inch baking pan. Step 2: Line bottom of pan with parchment paper Butter and flour paper. Step 3: Combine chocolate, butter, espresso and salt in top of double boiler over simmering water. Step 4: Stir until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth. Step 5: Cool This can also be done in the microwave on 50% power until smooth In large bowl, combine sugar, eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla and whisk until smooth. Step 6: Add melted chocolate mixture and whisk until smooth.

Ingredient Names: flour tortilla, oil, cinnamon, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each flour tortilla in 8 wedges, heat the oil. Step 2: Fry tortillas, a few wedges at a time, in the oil until golden brown. Step 3: Drain on paper towels or paper bags. Step 4: Put drained chips in large paper bag In small bowl, mix sugar and cinnamon thoroughly. Step 5: Pour on top of chips. Step 6: Roll down top of bag, and shake gently to coat Delicious!

Ingredient Names: sugar, cinnamon, ground nutmeg, flour tortillas, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large plastic bag, mixing well, set aside. Step 2: Cut tortillas into 3x2 inch strips, or just into strips. Step 3: Fry a few at a time in 1 inch of hot oil until crisp and golden, turning once. Step 4: Drain on paper towels While still warm, place a few at a time in sugar mixture in bag Shake gently to coat. Step 5: Store in airtight container.

Ingredient Names: prickly pear cactus, granulated sugar, water, orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: Select prickly pear cactus Remove spines and outside layer with large knife I found this at walmart! Step 2: Cut pulp across in slices one-inch thick. Step 3: Soak overnight in cold water. Step 4: Remove from water, cut in 1" cubes and cook in boiling water til tender, drain. Step 5: Heat the sugar and water until sugar is dissolved, then add cactus. Step 6: Cook slowly in the syrup until nearly all the syrup is absorbed.

Dish Name: Caf De Olla Mexican Spiced Coffee
Ingredient Names: water, piloncillo, cinnamon sticks, anise seed, whole cloves, instant coffee, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water, piloncillo, cinnamon sticks, anise and cloves in medium saucepan. Step 2: Heat over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until boiling. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, cover. Step 4: Cook for 15 minutes, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in coffee granules. Step 6: Cover Steep for 5 minutes. Step 7: Heat evaporated milk in small saucepan over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: sweetened condensed milk, milk, light cream, coffee
Instructions: Step 1: Brew the espresso. Step 2: Put brewed espresso into bowl along with other ingredients and mix gently until the condensed milk is incorporated fully. Step 3: Put this mix into the ice cream maker and process for 25 minutes. Step 4: Transfer soft set ice cream to a freezer-appropriate container and freeze at least 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, coffee, coffee ice cream, simple syrup, coffee liqueur, chocolate-covered coffee beans
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the milk, coffee, ice cream, simple syrup and liqueur in a blender. Step 2: Blend until smooth. Step 3: Pour in tall glasses and top with a few chocolate covered espresso beans.

Ingredient Names: milk, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, combine 1 quart of the milk with the sugar and cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until mixture turns golden In the remaining quart of milk, stir in the soda and place in another saucepan. Step 2: Add the cinnamon stick and bring to boil. Step 3: Discard the cinnamon and add the hot milk very gradually to the caramel mixture, stirring constantly. Step 4: When all the milk is incorporated, place over a low heat and cook very slowly until the mixture is thick like melted caramel, cool slightly. Step 5: Then pour into a glass container and chill Please.

Ingredient Names: butter, granulated sugar, fresh orange juice, all-purpose flour, baking powder, orange zest, eggs, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In mixer, cream butter. Step 2: Add sugar and continue beating. Step 3: Add yolks, one at a time, and continue beating until fluffy. Step 4: Add the orange juice and zest, alternating with dry ingredients. Step 5: Beat whites to soft peaks and add Do not beat, just fold them. Step 6: Pour batter into a pre-greased and pre-floured cake pan. Step 7: Bake at 350 for approximately 40 minutes Frost with your favorite chocolate white or butterwhipped frosting.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno peppers, granulated sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pepper lengthwise into four strips, cleaning out white pith and seeds. Step 2: Combine the sugar and water. Step 3: Heat to make a simple syrup. Step 4: Cook the jalapeo strips in the simple syrup for a few minutes, then strain the syrup and let the strips cool for a few minutes. Step 5: Repeat the cooking process three or four times, reusing the syrup, or until the strips are nicely candied.

Ingredient Names: raisins, brandy, white bread, pecans, asadero cheese, hot water, sugar, orange juice, butter, vanilla, cinnamon, clove, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place the raisins in a small bowl and pour the brandy over them, set aside. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 Butter a baking dish Tear the bread into bite size pieces. Step 3: Transfer the bread to the baking dish. Step 4: Add the pecans and the cheese to the bread, mixing both in lightly Scatter the raisins over the top, including any brandy not absorbed by the fruit. Step 5: Pour the sugar into a large, heavy saucepan Warm over medium high heat till the sugar melts and turns a deep golden brown, about 8 - 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: jonathan apples, granulated sugar, ground cinnamon, butter, flour tortillas, caramel ice cream topping, whipped cream, almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, core and thinly slice apples. Step 2: Place in a pan with 1 tablespoon of water, cover and cook until just soft, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Combine sugar and cinnamon in small bowl. Step 4: Melt butter in large skillet over medium-low heat and heat each tortilla until golden. Step 5: Sprinkle heated side of tortilla with cinnamon-sugar mixture and keep warm. Step 6: Place tortilla uncooked-side-up on cutting board and top with cooked apples. Step 7: Fold over and cut in half. Step 8: Place on serving plate. Step 9: Drizzle with caramel topping and top with whipped cream and almonds If you are using your quesadillas maker omit the butter.

Dish Name: Caramel Corn On The Cob Seasoned With Chipotle Peppers
Ingredient Names: white corn, caramel topping, chipotle chile in adobo, butter, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place corn in a very large piece of heavy duty foil or each one can have separate foils. Step 2: Pour butter over corn to coat each cob and to butter the foils. Step 3: Sprinkle minced peppers over some all or none ot the corn. Step 4: Pour caramel evenly over the cobs Seal foil around corn tightly. Step 5: Grill over hot coals for 5-8 minutes turning a couple of times. Step 6: Season with salt and top with additional caramel if you like.

Ingredient Names: sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, vanilla, salt, orange slice
Instructions: Step 1: Place a large, shallow pan, filled with 1 inch of hot water in oven at 350 degrees Caramelize 1 / 2 cup sugar by putting it in a heavy frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: When it starts to melt, stir constantly until smooth and amber in color. Step 3: Pour immediately into a 6-cup ring or loaf pan Evenly coat bottom. Step 4: Beat eggs until just frothy. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 cup sugar, evaporated milk, vanilla and salt, beat to blend. Step 6: Pour mixture into caramel-lined pan. Step 7: Set in pan of water in oven.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, texas sweet onions, sugar, adobo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil over medium high heat. Step 2: Add onions and reduce the heat to medium-low. Step 3: Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and caramelized, about 20 minutes. Step 4: Add the salt and pepper to taste, sugar and adobo sauce stir well to combine.

Ingredient Names: tequila, orange liqueur, martini mix, lime juice, lime wedge, olives
Instructions: Step 1: In a martini shaker, add tequila, orange liqueur, mexican martini mix and lime juice Shake to combine, and serve in a 16 oz Glass over ice. Step 2: Garnish with lime wedge and olives on a pick.

Ingredient Names: butter, margarine, brown sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder, salt, chocolate chips, mixed nuts
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter and margarine While this is melting, cream brown sugar and eggs, then add melted butter and margarine. Step 2: Combine flour, baking powder and salt and stir into sugar mixture. Step 3: Fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Step 4: Pour mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: strong cheddar, tomatoes, green, fresh cilantro, flour tortillas, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put the cheese, tomatoes, chilli and coriander leaves into a bowl with some seasoning, then mix well. Step 2: Warm tortillas in the microwave according to pack instructions – this makes them more bendable. Divide the cheese mix over one half of each tortilla. Fold over the other half to make 8 half-moons, then press down to seal. Step 3: Brush the tops with a little oil, then sit, oil-side down, on a hot area of the barbecue. Cook for a couple of mins until crisp and golden, brush the uncooked side with oil, then flip over for another few mins. Slice into wedges, then pile onto a platter while you cook the rest.

Dish Name: Cheese & jalapeno bites with salsa & mojitos
Ingredient Names: tortilla, reduced-fat creme fraiche, strong cheddar, jalape o peppers, chives, classic tomato salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Cut the tortillas into thirds, like a pie chart, then microwave for 1 min until hot. Roll each piece into a cone shape, then put loose-end down onto a baking sheet so they can’t spring open. Bake for 20-25 mins until crisp and golden. Cool. Will keep in an airtight container for 2 days. Step 2: For the filling, mix the crème fraîche, cheese, jalapeños and most of the chives together. Up to 10 mins before serving, spoon the filling into the cones and scatter with the rest of the chives. Serve with tomato salsa for dipping.

Ingredient Names: cherry pie filling, oranges, flour tortillas, slivered almonds, oil, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Reserve one cup cherry pie filling for topping. Step 2: Mix remaining pie filling with grated orange rind. Step 3: Spoon onto centers of tortillas. Step 4: Sprinkle a few almonds over pie filling. Step 5: Fold in opposite sides of each tortilla and roll up covering pie filling. Step 6: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 7: Fry chimichangas, two at a time, seam-side down, until golden brown. Step 8: Drain on paper towels Sift powdered sugar over each fritter and top with remaining cherry pie filling and almonds before serving.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds, garlic, onions, mutalo chilies, cinnamon, bread, chicken breasts, salted tortilla chips, cheddar, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a small pan on a low heat. Fry the seeds, garlic and onion for a few mins. Remove the stalks from the chillies, and add another 250ml of water to the soaking liquid. In a food processor or blender, blend the chillies and liquid with the onion mix, cinnamon, clove and the bread until smooth. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil in a mediumsize pan and warm the sauce, stirring non-stop until thick and glossy. Heat the grill while you layer up the tortilla chips and shredded chicken in an ovenproof dish. Pour over the sauce and scatter the cheese on. Grill until the cheese has melted and serve with soured cream.

Ingredient Names: cider vinegar, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, seedless watermelon, fresh pineapple, fresh strawberries
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, heat vinegar and sugar until sugar dissolves. Step 2: Stir in crushed red pepper and allow to cool. Step 3: Pour cooled sauce over fruit and stir. Step 4: Chill until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lean ground beef, italian sweet sausage, onions, green bell peppers, jalapeno chiles, bay leaves, garlic, tomatoes puree, chili powder, ground cumin, brown sugar, oregano, fresh basil, lime juice, pepper sauce, monterey jack cheese, red onions, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 T. Step 2: Oil in a large pot over high heat. Step 3: Add beef and sausage; cook until brown, breaking up with spoon, about 8 minutes. Step 4: Transfer meat mixture to bowl. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium high. Step 6: Add remaining oil to pot. Step 7: Add onion, bell pepper, jalapenos and bay leaves. Step 8: Cook until vegetables are soft, stirring frequently. Step 9: Add garlic; sauté 1 minute. Step 10: Return meat mixture to pot. Step 11: Mix in tomatoes and next 7 ingredients. Step 12: Simmer 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 13: Mix in lime juice, season with salt. Step 14: Serve chili in bowls, passing hot sauce, cheese, red onion and sour cream separately.

Ingredient Names: toasted sliced almonds, oranges, seedless raspberry jam, curacao, fresh raspberry
Instructions: Step 1: Peel 4 oranges and cut in cartwheel slices. Step 2: Arrange on individual dessert plates and chill In small saucepan, over low heat, warm jam until it liquefies. Step 3: Cool slightly, add liqueur and stir gently. Step 4: Pour over orange slices. Step 5: Sprinkle with almond. Step 6: Garnish with fresh raspberries.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, bittersweet chocolate, unsweetened cocoa powder, dried ancho chile powder, salt, eggs, sugar, heavy cream, confectioners' sugar, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f Lightly butter the bottom and sides of a 9-inch springform pan. Step 2: Line the bottom with parchment paper and butter the paper. Step 3: Set aside In the top of a double boiler, melt the chocolate and butter over medium-low heat. Step 4: Remove from the heat and whisk in the cocoa, chili powder, and salt. Step 5: In a bowl, whisk together the egg yolks with 1 / 2 cup of the sugar until thick and pale yellow in color. Step 6: Fold the chocolate mixture into the yolks and mix well In another bowl, whisk the egg whites until thick Whisking, add the remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar gradually and continue to beat to form a light meringue.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, unsweetened cocoa powder, egg, egg white, vegetable oil, skim milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all dry ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Add all liquid ingredients and stir until batter is smooth & creamy. Step 3: Let batter rest in the refrigerator until the air is settled, about 2 hours. Step 4: When ready to prepare crepes, heat crepe pan over medium heat & pour a small amount of the batter into the hot pan Rotate the pan until the batter is cooked through & then turn to cook the other side. Step 5: When done remove from pan & let cook on a rack. Step 6: Store until ready to serve May be made 1-2 days in advance. Step 7: Fill with seasonal fresh fruit, sorbet & garnish with flowers from the garden.

Ingredient Names: butter, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, all-purpose flour, nuts, ground cinnamon, chocolate chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 f. Step 2: In a large mixing bowl beat butter and sugar until creamy, beat in vanilla extract Gradually add flour, nuts, and cinnamon. Step 3: Stir in 1 1 / 2 cup of chocolate morsels and stir until dough is well combined. Step 4: Roll dough into one inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheets. Step 5: Bake for approximately 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are set and lightly golden brown on bottom. Step 6: Remove from oven and cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes than place on wire racks to cool completely Microwave remaining chocolate chips in small bowl or heavy-duty plastic bag for 30 seconds. Step 7: Stir chips or knead bag Microwave at 10- to 15-second intervals, stirring or kneading until smooth.

Ingredient Names: sugar, water, milk, eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, salt, fresh coconut, mexican chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 2: Set 2 6 cup savarin molds in large baking pan. Step 3: Pour in enough boiling water to come halfway up sides, set in oven. Step 4: Cook sugar and water in heavy small saucepan until sugar dissolves, swirling pan occasionally Increase heat and boil until syrup caramelizes. Step 5: Pour half of syrup into each mold, tilting to coat sides Quickly return molds to water bath Gently blend milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and salt in large bowl. Step 6: Stir in coconut and chocolate powder.

Ingredient Names: devil's food cake mix, water, oil, eggs, caramel topping, sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, milk, cream cheese, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f Spray a large 12-cup bundt pan with nonstick coating Soften the cajeta in the jar in the microwave and pour into the prepared pan. Step 2: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Step 3: Pour the cake batter into the cake pan over the cajeta To make the flan: pour condensed, evaporated and fresh milks into a blender with the cream cheese, vanilla and eggs, mix well. Step 4: Pour the flan mixture very slowly over the cake batter Spray aluminum foil with non-stick spray. Step 5: Cover the pan tightly with aluminum foil.

Ingredient Names: dark chocolate, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, baking soda, salt, ground cayenne pepper, light brown sugar, granulated sugar, butter, vanilla extract, eggs, milk, powdered sugar, heavy whipping cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 f. Step 2: Grease 12-cup bundt pan For cake: Microwave chocolate in small, uncovered, microwave-safe bowl on high power for 45 seconds. Step 3: Stir If pieces retain some of their original shape, microwave at additional 10- to 15-second intervals, stirring just until melted. Step 4: Mix the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt and cayenne pepper in a small bowl. Step 5: Beat the brown sugar, granulated sugar, butter and vanilla extract in large mixer bowl until creamy. Step 6: Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Step 7: Beat in melted chocolate.

Ingredient Names: pecans, powdered sugar, all-purpose flour, unsweetened baking cocoa, salt, butter, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor or blender, process pecans with 1 / 4 cup of the powdered sugar, until very fine. Step 2: Mix in flour, cocoa and salt & set aside. Step 3: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter with 3 / 4 cup of the powdered sugar. Step 4: Blend until light and fluffy. Step 5: Beat in vanilla until well blended. Step 6: Add flour mixtureslowly, until well mixed. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350f Form dough into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheets. Step 9: Bake until golden, 18 to 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: eggs, light brown sugar, all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, milk, vanilla, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, unsweetened chocolate, heavy whipping cream, semisweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Prepare a cardboard circle using the bottom of cake pan as a guide, set aside. Step 3: Grease two 9-in round cake pans then dust with powdered cocoa, knocking out excess For the cake, in a large bowl combine flour, cocoa and baking powder. Step 4: In a medium size bowl, combine the milk and vanilla, set both aside. Step 5: Place egg whites in a clean bowl and beat at high speed until peaks are formed. Step 6: Turn the mixer down to medium speed and gradually add the sugar to the egg whites. Step 7: Once the sugar is dissolved, add egg yolks and beat for 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: flour, butter, confectioners' sugar, pecans, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven at 350f Cream butter and sugar in a large bowl with a fork. Step 2: Add 2tsp Vanilla flavoring and 1 cup pecans. Step 3: Fold in 2 cups flour with fork till evenly mixed Dough will be crumbly Mold into small balls no bigger than the size of a walnut. Step 4: Roll through powdered sugar. Step 5: Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Step 6: Bake in oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: milk, mexican chocolate, sugar, water, butter, salt, brown sugar, corn oil, vanilla extract, nutmeg, all-purpose flour, baking powder, eggs, powdered sugar, cinnamon sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Chocolate caliente: Bring milk to a boil. Step 2: Add in chocolate and sugar. Step 3: Stir over heat until chocolate is melted and sugar has dissolved. Step 4: Set aside Churros: Heat water, butter, salt, brown sugar, oil, vanilla extract and nutmeg to a rolling boil. Step 5: Mix flour and baking powder together. Step 6: Stir vigorously into water mixture over low heat until mixture forms a ball, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, salt, flour, eggs, lemon, fat, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water, sugar and salt to boil, remove from heat. Step 2: Stir in flour all at once and beat until smooth. Step 3: Beat in eggs one at a time until mixture is smooth. Step 4: Spoon mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a large star point Pipe 3 inch strips onto waxed paper or floured surface. Step 5: Add lemon peel to fry fat and heat to 375 degrees. Step 6: Fry churros a few at a time for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden, turning as necessary. Step 7: Drain on paper towels, roll in sugar.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, orange juice, lime juice, cilantro, poblano chile, wooden skewers, orange, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Toss all the ingredients together and marinate for 30 minutes Alternate the chicken and poblano chile pieces on the wooden skewers and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Step 2: Place the skewers on a pre-heated grill over a moderate flame and cook for 3 minutes on each side or until the chicken is cooked. Step 3: Season once more with salt and pepper and squeeze a fresh orange over the cooked chicken kabobs.

Ingredient Names: sugar, ground cinnamon, yellow cornmeal, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, cream-style corn, egg whites, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat over to 350 degrees Lightly oil an 8 inch square baking pan or spray with a nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Combine topping ingredients in a small bowl or custard cup, set aside. Step 3: In a large bowl, sift together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Step 4: In a blender container, combine remaining cake ingredients. Step 5: Blend until almost smooth. Step 6: Add to dry mixture. Step 7: Mix until all ingredients are moistened. Step 8: Spoon into prepared pan.

Dish Name: Cinnamon Crepes With Caramel Sauce And Pecans
Ingredient Names: milk, cornstarch, baking soda, sugar, cinnamon sticks, butter, pecans, dessert crepes
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine 1 tbls Of the milk, the cornstarch, and baking soda, set aside. Step 2: In a large heavy saucepan, bring the remaining milk to a boil over moderate heat. Step 3: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cornstarch mixture. Step 4: Return to the heat, reduce the heat to low, and stir in the sugar and cinnamon. Step 5: Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Remove the cinnamon stick and continue to simmer, stirring frequently, until the sauce is very thick-about 30 minutes more, set aside. Step 7: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a 7-inch skillet over moderate heat.

Dish Name: Cinnamon Grilled Bananas With Mexican Chocolate
Ingredient Names: bananas, sugar, ground cinnamon, ice cream, mexican chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Slice bananas in half lengthwise and crosswise so each banana yields four pieces, set aside. Step 2: Combine sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle on cut sides of bananas. Step 3: Let bananas sit for 5 minutes. Step 4: Place peeled bananas cut-side down in buttered saut pan. Step 5: Cook for 2 minutes. Step 6: Turn over and let cook 2 more minutes. Step 7: Arrange two banana halves on each serving plate. Step 8: Top each serving with two scoops of your favourite ice cream. Step 9: Sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon crumbled chocolate.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, flour tortillas, granulated sugar, ground cinnamon, chocolate syrup
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a skillet over medium to low heat. Step 2: Cut each tortilla into 8 pieces, place in skillet. Step 3: Fry until light brown, about 2 minutes on each side. Step 4: Drain on paper towel. Step 5: Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon while hot. Step 6: Repeat with remaining tortillas, adding more oil for each batch as needed.

Ingredient Names: eggs, low-fat milk, honey, vanilla, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Combine eggs, milk, 1 / 4 cup honey and vanilla. Step 2: Beat until mixed but not foamy. Step 3: Combine remaining 1 / 4 cup honey and cinnamon in small bowl, mix well. Step 4: Place 4 custard cups in 8-inch square baking dish. Step 5: Spoon 1 tablespoon honey-cinnamon mixture into each custard cup. Step 6: Divide egg mixture into each custard cup. Step 7: Place baking dish on middle rack of oven. Step 8: Pour boiling water into baking dish around custard cups to 1-inch depth. Step 9: Bake at 325 degrees f 30 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.

Ingredient Names: sugar, egg yolks, sweetened condensed milk, almond extract, milk, vanilla extract, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan melt sugar over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until sugar is a dark, caramel-colored liquid. Step 2: Remove from heat and pour into a 4 cup metal ring mold or 8 individual molds Quickly turn mold to coat bottom and sides with the caramel. Step 3: Let cool so caramel hardens, heat oven to 325. Step 4: Put the condensed milk, milk, eggs, egg yolks and flavorings into an electric blender. Step 5: Cover and blend to mix well. Step 6: Pour mixture into mold. Step 7: Put mold in a larger pan filled with water to depth of 1 / 2 inch, bake for 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: sugar, water, cinnamon sticks, flaked coconut, milk, eggs, vanilla, whipping cream, toasted sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In uncovered 2-quart saucepan simmer sugar, water and cinnamon for 10 minutes, strain. Step 2: Discard cinnamon pieces, add coconut. Step 3: Cook, uncovered, about 5 minutes or until syrup is nearly absorbed, stirring frequently. Step 4: Stir in 2 1 / 2 cups of the milk. Step 5: Cook until mixture is hot In bowl beat eggs with remaining 1 / 2 cup milk. Step 6: Stir about 1 cup of the hot mixture into egg mixture. Step 7: Return to saucepan.

Ingredient Names: sugar, cornstarch, fat-free evaporated milk, caramel topping, sugar-free cafe vienna coffee powder, egg whites
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a saucepan, whisk together sugar and cornstarch Gradually stir in milk. Step 3: Bring to a simmer, whisking constantly until slightly thickened. Step 4: Stir in caramel topping and coffee drink mix, remove from heat. Step 5: Whisk egg whites in a large heatproof bowl Very gradually stir hot milk mixture into egg whites. Step 6: Pour about 1 / 3 cup of mixture into each of four 1 / 2-cup ramekins. Step 7: Place ramekins in a shallow baking dish and add enough hot water to rise about 1 inch up sides of ramekins.

Dish Name: Coffee Prune Cream Of Wheat Sweet Tamales
Ingredient Names: milk, sugar, coffee, cream of wheat, butter, egg yolks, egg whites, prunes, banana leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Boil milk with sugar and coffee. Step 2: Once it has started to boil, add the cream of wheat gradually, stirring with a wooden spoon, until it has a compact doughy consistency Withdraw from stove top and add the butter and egg yolks, mixing well Next add the beaten egg whites to soft peak stage, in gradual folding motions Have the banana leaves lightly toasted over a stove top or burner grill, or presoaked corn leaves ready for filling. Step 3: Spread about 1 scant tablespoon of dough on the center of each leaf, placing 2 or 3 chopped prunes in the center. Step 4: Wrap and secure tamales and cook in a tall vapor pot for an hour.

Dish Name: Colombian Arepas With Ham And Cheese
Ingredient Names: masa harina, white cheese, baking soda, warm water, butter, ham, mozzarella cheese, tomatoes, salt, pepper, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Making the arepas: I a large bowl combine masa with cheese, baking soda and salt Slowly pour the warm water in and stir well. Step 2: Using your hands, knead until smooth dough forms Form into 6 even balls, flatten into circles, about 4 inches in diameter. Step 3: In a cast iron skillet or flat top grill, melt half of the butter on medium heat Working in batches, if necessary, cook arepas until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add remaining butter, turn arepas and cook 2-3 minutes until golden. Step 5: Set aside Making the sandwich:.

Ingredient Names: milk, cornstarch, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, corn
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the milk, corn starch, sugar and eggs in blender. Step 2: Put mixture in medium sized pot, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Then add vanilla and corn. Step 4: Mix well, and place in freezer safe bowl. Step 5: Check it in a few hours, when it starts to freeze, stir it Freeze a few more hours, and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: flour, eggs, canned, green onions, avocados, lime rest, fresh cilantro, vegetable oil, refried beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the flour, egg, corn and half the onions with some seasoning, then mix well. Mix the avocado with the remaining onions, lime juice, coriander and seasoning, then set aside. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan. Drop tbsps of the corn mixture into the frying pan, smoothing them down to form cakes. Cook for about 2-3 mins on each side over a medium heat, adding the remaining oil if you need to. Serve hot with the avocado salsa, lime wedges and some warm refried beans.

Ingredient Names: sweetcorn well, fresh cilantro, green onions, mature cheddar, green chili, ready-rolled all-butter shortcrust pastry, eggs, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Make the filling by mixing the corn, coriander, spring onion, cheese and chilli with some seasoning. Step 2: Unroll the pastry sheet, roll a little thinner with a rolling pin, then use a 10cm circle cutter to cut out circles of pastry. (You should get 6 circles, then re-roll the trimmings for 2 more.) Brush edges of the circles with a little of the beaten egg, then spoon a couple of teaspoonfuls of filling mixture onto each. Fold over one half of the pastry, and seal by pinching the edge with your fingers, until you have 8 small pastyshaped empanadas. Arrange on a baking parchment lined baking sheet, brush with the rest of the egg and scatter with sesame seeds. Cover and chill for at least 30 mins before baking. Step 3: To serve, heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6 and bake for 20 mins until golden and crisp.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, butter, apple pie filling, dried cranberries, walnuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Coat a 13-inch oblong baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Brush tortillas on both sides with melted butter. Step 3: Combine apple pie filling, dried cranberries and walnuts. Step 4: Heat 4 tortillas at a time for 25 seconds, in microwave. Step 5: Top tortillas with equal amounts of fruit mixture and fold burrito style. Step 6: Place seam side down in baking dish, bake 10 minutes. Step 7: Turn tortillas over and bake an additional 10 minutes or until crisp. Step 8: Serve hot with whipped cream or ice cream.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, eggs, water, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f In iron skillet, over medium heat, cook and stir the sugar until it is melted and caramel color. Step 2: Divide the sugar into 8 ungreased 6-oz custard cups Tilt to coat the bottom of the cups With a wire whisk, beat eggs in large bowl. Step 3: Stir in the water, milk, vanilla and salt. Step 4: Pour the egg mixture into custard cups. Step 5: Place the filled cups in a large shallow pan filled with 1 inch of hot water. Step 6: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted near centers comes out clean. Step 7: Cool and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

Ingredient Names: heavy cream, brewed coffee, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-sized, heavy saucepan, scald together the cream and coffee. Step 2: Beat the egg yolks with the sugar for 8-10 minutes with the electric mixer until mixture is very thick and lemony-colored Gradually beat in the warm coffee mixture. Step 3: Return to the pan and cook over low heat, stirring, until mixture boils and thickens, stir the vanilla. Step 4: Cool, cover, and chill until very cold Enjoy spooned over a brownie, plain angel food cake, or pound cake for delicious desserts Makes about 2-1 / 2 cups.

Ingredient Names: vanilla bean, whole milk, granulated sugar, water, baking soda
Instructions: Step 1: Place vanilla bean, 3 cups of milk, sugar, water and baking soda in slow cooker, whisk together. Step 2: Cook for 9 hours on high, uncovered. Step 3: Remove vanilla bean and whisk milk mixture gently Use a dull-edged knife to carefully scrape down the crust of sugar that accumulates on sides of the insert Do not skim foam Continue cooking for 1 more hour, stirring every 20 minutes until mixture is a rich medium-caramel color and has thickened to the consistency of melted ice cream In the mean time, warm remaining cup of milk in small saucepan. Step 4: Turn off slow cooker and stir in the warm milk. Step 5: Remove the inset and allow to cool for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, sugar, lemon juice, jalapeno chile
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients into blender, and whirl until smooth Push mixture through a fine strainer set over a 2-cup glass measure. Step 2: Discard any residue / pulp. Step 3: Pour into popsicle molds Freeze 8 hours, or more.

Ingredient Names: pecans, all-purpose flour, salt, unsalted butter, eggs, ice water, pineapple preserves, powdered sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 deg f. Step 2: Chop pecans finely with a heavy knife A chopper can be used, but take care that the nuts don't process so much that they become nut butter. Step 3: Place chopped pecans in a bowl and set aside Sift flour and salt together into a large mixing bowl. Step 4: Cut chilled butter into chunks. Step 5: Using a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into flour mixture until it looks like coarse, crumbly sand. Step 6: Using a fork or a wooden spoon, gently mix in the egg yolks Work in the ice water, a little bit at a time, only adding enough water for the mixture to come together in a dough Be careful not to overmix the dough or add too much water, or the dough will become greasy.

Ingredient Names: sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, almond extract, dark chocolate, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: Make caramel by slowly heating the sugar in a small saucepan until golden and liquid Be careful not to stir too much, as this will cause crystals to form. Step 2: Pour the very hot, molten sugar into the flan mold Be sure to tilt the mold so that the caramel coats the sides. Step 3: In a small saucepan, heat the milk, cinnamon, and chocolate pieces, stirring occasionally to help the chocolate melt. Step 4: Let this cool down to just warm and remove the cinnamon stick. Step 5: Blend the rest of the ingredients together gradually adding the milk mixture. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 7: Pour into caramelized pan and bake in a hot water bath for about 50-55 minutes or until golden Test with a knife or toothpick, it should come out clean.

Ingredient Names: ice cream, eggs, corn flakes, cinnamon, honey, whipped cream, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Form ice cream into balls about the size of a baseball You will need to put each one in the freezer as you make them. Step 2: Roll each in corn flakes then roll in eggs, then once more in flakes to completely coat Immediately put back in freezer to harden. Step 3: Heat enough oil to cover the ice cream as it cooks. Step 4: When oil is hot dip ice cream in for 15 seconds or just till lightly browned. Step 5: Drain on paper towel and sprinkle with cinnamon, put a dollop of cream on top, and drizzle with honey.

Ingredient Names: mango, sweetened condensed milk, ice, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and pit mango Cut into chunks Pulse ingredients in blender or food processor until ice is pureed Add sugar to taste Pour into glasses and serve!, enjoy!

Dish Name: Dessert Peach Or Apple Pie Filling Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: peach pie filling, flour tortillas, cinnamon, butter, sugar, brown sugar, water, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees heat whole package of tortilas in microwave for 30-45 seconds. Step 2: Spoon fruit evenly onto heated tortilas, roll and place seam side down in a lightly greased baking dish in a small sauce pan combine cinnamon, butter, sugars and water. Step 3: Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes, add vanilla. Step 4: Pour sauce over tortilas. Step 5: Cover and bake for 20 minutes, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: eggs, sugar, salt, flour, sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, almond extract, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Whip eggs, sugar and salt until tripled in bulk, fold in flour. Step 2: Pour mixture into 9x11-inch, well buttered pan. Step 3: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Step 4: Set aside to cool Poke holes on top of cake. Step 5: Combine milks and flavoring and pour over cake. Step 6: Allow to soak in at least 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated sugar cookie dough, quick-cooking oats, brown sugar, vanilla, caramels, unsalted butter, sweetened condensed milk, caramel topping, toasted almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Prehaet oven to 350f Break up 1 roll of cookie dough into large bowl. Step 2: Add 3 / 4 cup of the oats, 1 / 3 cup brown sugar, and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Step 3: Mix well With floured fingers, press dough mixture evenly in bottom of ungreased 15x10x1" baking pan to form crust. Step 4: Bake 13-18 minutes or until lightly browned. Step 5: Meanwhile, break up remaining cookie dough into same bowl. Step 6: Add remaining oats, brown sugar and vanilla and mix well In large heavy saucepan, heat caramels, butter and condensed milk over medium-low heat, stirring frequently, until caramels are melted and mix is smooth. Step 7: Remove partially baked crust from oven.

Dish Name: Dulce De Leche Blondies Filled And Topped
Ingredient Names: flour, baking soda, salt, butter, light brown sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, caramels, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Grease a 13x9" baking pan or line it with parchment paper Sift together the flour, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl, set aside. Step 3: Using an electric mixer on medium speed, cream together the butter and brown sugar until creamy. Step 4: Add the eggs and vanilla. Step 5: Beat until smooth Gradually stir in the flour mixture. Step 6: Spread 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 of the batter evenly in the prepared pan. Step 7: Bake for 7-8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dulce de leche ice cream, cake, whipped topping, pecans, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Slice pound cake into two layers Soften ice cream until spreadable. Step 2: Place bottom layer of pound cake in a foil-lined pan the same size as the cake. Step 3: Place two cups of dulce de leche ice cream over the layer and spread evenly. Step 4: Top with remaining pound cake layer and press gently over the ice cream. Step 5: Cover the cake with foil and freeze for 30 minutes or more. Step 6: Remove frozen ice cream cake from foil lined pan and place on a cake platter Ice cake with thawed whipped topping. Step 7: Sprinkle cake with chopped pecans and shredded coconut. Step 8: Keep in freezer until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking soda, butter, sugar, light brown sugar, instant butterscotch pudding mix, syrup, eggs, caramels
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 In small bowl, combine flour and baking soda In separate bowl, cream together butter, sugar, brown sugar, pudding mix and syrup until smooth. Step 2: Beat in eggs until smooth Gradually beat in flour mixture and mix just until fully incorporated. Step 3: Chill dough for 30 minutes. Step 4: Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheet, bake 7-8 minutes. Step 5: Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute then remove to wire cooling rack Immediately top each cookie with chopped caramels by slightly pushing caramel pieces into the top of each cookie.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, cream cheese, eggs, vanilla, heavy cream, dulce de leche
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce combine ingredients in a large heavy saucepan. Step 2: Place over medium heat and cook without stirring until mixture boils, 15 to 20 minutes Briefly remove from heat. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Step 4: When mixture becomes a caramel color and is think enough that you can see the bottom of the pan as you stir, remove it from heat Use at room temperature or cover and refrigerate Yield: 2 cups cheesecake preheat oven to 325 degrees. Step 5: Place cream cheese in food processor and process until soft With machine running, drop in eggs, followed by heavy cream, vanilla then dulce de leche. Step 6: Place mixture in 9 inch pie dish.

Ingredient Names: yellow cake mix, eggs, oil, water, sweetened condensed milk, caramel ice cream topping, heavy whipping cream, powdered sugar, vanilla, pecans
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare cake mix according to directions for a 13 x 9 baking pan, cool completely in pan on wire rack. Step 2: Place sweetened condensed milk in a large, microwave safe bowl Micro on med For 4 minutes, stirring half way through. Step 3: Reduce to med-low power, micro for 16 to 24 minutes, whisking every few minutes, until thick and light caramel color. Step 4: Stir in caramel topping. Step 5: Cool for 15 minutes. Step 6: Spread evenly over cake, cool completely. Step 7: Beat whipping cream in a large mixing bowl until soft peaks form. Step 8: Add sugar and vanilla, beat until stiff peaks form.

Ingredient Names: heavy cream, milk, dulce de leche, egg yolks, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan over medium heat, warm the cream, milk and 2 / 3 cup of the dulce de leche. Step 2: Stir mixture constantly until well blended, about 5 minutes. Step 3: In a heatproof mixing bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, sugar and salt Gradually add the hot cream mixture and whisk until they are fully incorporated. Step 4: Transfer the mixture to a saucepan. Step 5: Cook over medium-low heat, stirring with a wooden spoon or spatula, until the custard thickens, about 10 minutes Do not boil. Step 6: Pour the custard through a cheesecloth lined strainer set over a clean bowl This will strain any lumps and leave a smooth custard Nestle the custard bowl in a larger one filled halfway with ice and water and cool the custard to room temperature.

Ingredient Names: butter, superfine sugar, milk, sour cream, flour, dulce de leche
Instructions: Step 1: Cream the butter and the sugar together with a mixer until creamy. Step 2: Blend in milk, flour, and sour cream. Step 3: Put the dulce de leche into a microwaveable dish and heat it for about 5 to 10 seconds to soften it just a bit. Step 4: Add the dulce de leche to the mix and blend well.

Ingredient Names: microwave popcorn, fat-free sweetened condensed milk, light brown sugar, butterfinger candy bar, instant butterscotch pudding mix, graham cracker crumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Place popped popcorn into a very large bowl, removing any unpopped kernels. Step 2: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, brown sugar, crumbled candy bar and pudding mix. Step 3: Stir Microwave on high 1-1 / 2 minutes or until boiling, stir. Step 4: Cook on high 30 seconds, stir. Step 5: Pour over popped popcorn, mix until well coated Form a ball with your hands that have been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray. Step 6: Roll in graham cracker crumbs, if desired. Step 7: Place on parchment paper or waxed paper.

Ingredient Names: whipping cream, dark brown sugar, sweetened condensed milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine whipping cream and brown sugar in heavy medium saucepan. Step 2: Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Step 3: Boil until mixture is reduced to 1 cup, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in sweetened condensed milk.

Dish Name: Fried green tomatoes with ripe tomato salsa
Ingredient Names: flour, polenta, eggs, green tomatoes, vegetable oil, green onions, fresh mint leaves, green chili, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the flour over a plate. Place polenta into a medium bowl, season and mix well. Place eggs in a small bowl and beat. Lightly coat a green tomato slice first in the flour, dusting off any excess, dip in the egg, then coat in polenta. Repeat with remaining slices. Step 2: Heat a shallow pool of oil in a large frying pan. Fry the coated tomatoes in batches until golden and crisp on both sides, turning them over with a fish slice. As they are done, drain well on kitchen paper and keep warm in a low oven while you fry remaining batches. Step 3: To make the salsa, mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Serve the fried green tomatoes hot, with the salsa spooned over.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground turkey, kosher salt, pepper, yellow onions, poblano peppers, celery, garlic, chili powder, paprika, cumin, fresh coriander, tomato paste, molasses, one san marzano tomatoes, chiles adobo seasoning, sweet potato, fresh corn, beans, low sodium chicken broth, sour cream, fresh cilantro, lime wedges, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat Instant Pot to saute setting. Add 2 tablespoons olive oil and swirl to coat. Add turkey, season generously with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and beginning to turn golden, about 8 minutes. Remove turkey to a bowl. Step 2: Add 2 tablespoons olive oil and add onions, poblanos, celery, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, until golden in spots, about 8 minutes. Step 3: Make a well in the center and add remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Add chile powder, paprika, cumin, and coriander. Stir to coat with olive oil and cook until fragrant and toasted, about 30 seconds. Add tomato paste, molasses, chopped tomatoes, chiles in adobo and sauce, sweet potatoes, corn, dried beans, and chicken broth. Return turkey to pot and stir to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 4: Top with lid and set pressure to high. Cook 30 minutes. Release pressure naturally for 30 minutes before releasing pressure manually. Step 5: Serve, garnished with sour cream, cilantro, lime wedges, and avocado.

Ingredient Names: unbaked pastry pie shell, semi-sweet chocolate chips, whipped topping, cream cheese, milk, cinnamon, chocolate flavor instant pudding pie filling mix
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425°F. Step 2: Bake pie crust 10-12 minutes or until golden brown. Step 3: Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Step 4: Reserve 1 Tbsp chocolate chips for garnish. Step 5: Place remaining chips in small microwavable bowl. Step 6: Heat, uncovered for 1 minute on high, stirring every 10 seconds until smooth. Step 7: Using a small rubber spatula, spread melted chocolate onto cooled pie crust (over bottom and 1 inch up the sides). Step 8: Set aside 1 cup whipped topping for garnish. Step 9: Whisk softened cream cheese in mixing bowl until smooth. Step 10: Gently whisk in milk until blended. Step 11: Add remaining whipped topping and cinnamon; whisk until mixture is smooth. Step 12: Add the pudding mix; whisk until smooth (Mixture will be fairly thick!). Step 13: Spoon chocolate mixture into prepared crust and spread evenly. Step 14: Grate reserved morsels over top of pie. Step 15: Decorate with reserved whipped topping as desired. Step 16: Sprinkle with additional cinnamon, if desired. Step 17: Chill for at least 30 minutes; refrigerate until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: shortening, eggs, cream-style corn, fresh corn, butter, yellow cornmeal, sour cream, monterey jack cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, mild green chilies, salt, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Grease a 10 inch pie plate generously with shortening. Step 2: In a large bowl, beat eggs. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and stir until thoroughly mixed. Step 4: Pour into pie plate and bake uncovered at 350 degrees for about one hour. Step 5: The pie may be baked and kept in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Step 6: Reheat refrigerated pie at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes. Step 7: The pie may also be frozen after baking and kept frozen for up to 3 months. Step 8: Thaw and reheat at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onions, green sweet pepper, garlic, olive oil, ground turkey, chili powder, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, black beans, tomatoes, bottled salsa, refrigerated polenta, monterey jack cheese, fresh tomato, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375°F. Step 2: In a skillet cook onion, sweet pepper,and garlic in 1 tablespoon hot oil until tender. Step 3: Add turkey, chili powder, cumin and cayenne. Step 4: Cook until turkey is no longer pink, stirring to break up meat. Step 5: Add beans, undrained tomatoes and salsa. Step 6: Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Step 7: Simmer gently 15 minutes. Step 8: Meanwhile, grease a 3-quart rectangular baking dish with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Step 9: Cut 1 tube polenta into 1/2-inch cubes; press evenly into prepared baking dish. Step 10: Halve remaining polenta lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices; set aside. Step 11: Sprinkle 1 cup of cheese over polenta in dish. Step 12: Top with meat mixture. Step 13: Arrange sliced polenta over meat; sprinkle with remaining cheese and fresh tomato. Step 14: Bake, uncovered, for 35 minutes or until bubbly. Step 15: Sprinkle with cilantro. Step 16: Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Step 17: Makes 12 servings.

Ingredient Names: eggs, avocados, beans, red onions, cilantro only, cherry tomato, bought dressing, red chile, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Lower the eggs into boiling water and boil for 6½ mins, then put into a bowl of cold water to cool. Step 2: Slice the avocados and place in a large bowl with the beans, onion, coriander and tomatoes. Step 3: Measure 3 tbsp of the dressing into a small bowl, then mix in the chilli and cumin. Step 4: Once the eggs have cooled but are still warm, peel off the shells and cut into quarters. Step 5: Toss the salad with the dressing and nestle in the eggs. Step 6: Serve straight away – delicious with toasted tortillas.

Ingredient Names: basic massoni pizza base pizza dough, boneless skinless chicken breasts, plums, red onions, garlic, red bell peppers, chipotle chiles, fresh cilantro, black beans, cheese sauce, jalapeno peppers, guacamole, ear corn, heavy cream, velveeta cheese, cotija cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Chipotle Chicken:. Step 2: Char onion, tomato, garlic and red pepper. Don’t be afraid to burn a little bit. (a little bit). Step 3: Place vegetable mixture in a pan with the chicken breast. Add the chipotle, cover with foil and slow cook in the oven – 325 till chicken is tender about 20-25 minutes. Step 4: Allow chicken a few minutes to cool off. Remove and pull into decent sized pieces – to your liking. Step 5: In a blender puree the vegetable mixture and cilantro till smooth then marinade. Step 6: This is also just a great technique to make some flavorful chicken. Serve with rice and or a simple salad, for the beans:. Step 7: Soak the beans overnight or at least 3 hours till doubled in size. Step 8: Strain off old water and cover with fresh water. Add some garlic, the other half of the onion and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and let simmer till beans are tender and creamy. Step 9: Season with kosher salt. – your liking. Step 10: For the cheese sauce:. Step 11: Bring 1 cup of heavy cream to a slow boil. Step 12: Whisk in 1/2 cup of shredded Velveeta. Step 13: Add 4 oz pickling solution from Peabody’s pickles, keep warm. Step 14: Also, just a great dip for bread or chips. Fun for everyone! Step 15: Ok Guys! Ready for this super fun Pie?. Step 16: Here it goes. We’re going to make a pizza and treat it like a plate of nachos. WOW! Step 17: The sub recipes are wonderful and versatile. This is how we do it at Massoni but who’s to tell you what you want on your nacho pie?. Step 18: Take a cheesed pizza. Place a bit of the chipotle chicken, corn and black beans all over. Step 19: Bake pizza and top with the nachos, cheese sauce and pickle chilis. You could officially smother the pie in the sauce. Step 20: Sprinkle the cotija over and serve with guacamole and fresh lime. Say goodbye to summer.

Ingredient Names: tomato juice, orange juice, limes, grenadine, worcestershire sauce very healthy shake tabasco, cucumbers, scallops, avocados, shrimp, green onions, tequila, fresh coriander, crackers buttered bread
Instructions: Step 1: In a jug, mix together the tomato, orange and lime juice with the grenadine, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco, ½ tsp salt and pepper. Check the seasoning – you are looking for a nice balance of fire to pep you up, saltiness to season the rest of the ingredients you’ll be adding, a refreshing citrus kick from the orange and lime, and enough sweetness from the grenadine to balance the rest of the flavours. Chill in the fridge for at least 30 mins. Step 2: Cut the cucumber in half lengthways and scoop out the seeds with a small spoon. Finely dice the flesh into 4-5mm cubes. Dice the scallops and avocado into similar sizes and mix everything into the chilled tomato juice along with the prawns and chopped spring onions. Serve in small glasses, drizzled with the Tequila, scattered with coriander, with crackers or buttered bread on the side.

Dish Name: Rice Pudding -- Mexican Style, Arroz Con Leche
Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, water, inches cinnamon, very fine julienne lime peel, salt, milk, eggs, sugar, raisins, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Place the rice in a large saucepan with the water, cinnamon, lime peel and salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil; lower the heat and cook, covered, until most of the water has been absorbed. Step 3: Beat an egg into the milk. Step 4: Stir in the milk, egg mixture and sugar, stirring constantly, over low heat until the mixture thickens. Step 5: Add the raisins and vanilla and cook for 2 minutes. Step 6: Remove from the heat and let cool for 10 to 20 minutes. Step 7: Transfer to a platter or individual bowls and refrigerate. Step 8: Garnish with ground cinnamon if desired.

Dish Name: Steak & onion fajitas with sweetcorn salsa
Ingredient Names: very avocado, limes, sweetcorn from, fresh tomato, fresh coriander, garlic-infused olive oil, red onions, lean beef steak, fajita seasoning, wholemeal flour tortillas, iceberg lettuce jalape o peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Mash together the avocado and lime juice. Stir through the sweetcorn, tomato, half the coriander and seasoning to make a salsa. Set aside, covered with cling film. Step 2: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan or griddle pan and cook the onions for about 8 mins until lightly charred and slightly softened. Remove to a warmed serving dish. Step 3: Dust the steak with the fajita seasoning and some black pepper, then add to the pan. Cook for 2-3 mins, depending on how rare you like it, then add to the onions. Meanwhile, warm the tortillas following pack instructions. Serve the steak and onions with the tortillas, salsa, lettuce, jalapeño peppers and lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, tomato sauce, kidney beans, water, taco seasoning, corn muffin mix, cheddar cheese, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, brown ground beef over medium-high heat; drain. Step 2: Stir in tomato sauce, beans, water and taco seasoning mix. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes. Step 3: Prepare corn muffin mix according to package directions. Drop small spoonfuls of muffin batter over meat mixture in a skillet. Step 4: Cover and cook over medium-low heat 15-17 minutes or until corn bread is done. Step 5: Top with cheese and green onion. Cover and cook over low heat until cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, chipotle paste, sour cream, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the potatoes in the oven and roast for 50 mins until tender when pierced with a knife. Peel off the skins, put the flesh in a bowl and mash until smooth. Step 2: Add the chipotle paste, soured cream and butter, and mix well. Season to taste.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, fresh coriander, block feta cheese, flour tortillas, chorizo
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pierce the potatoes a few times each and put on a baking tray. Cook for 50 mins until really soft. Leave to cool slightly. Step 2: Scoop the sweet potato flesh out of the skins into a bowl. Mash with the coriander, season and gently fold through the feta. This can be done earlier in the day – cover and keep in the fridge. Heat a large griddle pan. Step 3: Spread the sweet potato mixture over half of each tortilla, top with chorizo slices and fold the other side over. Cook on the hot griddle pan for 3 mins each side until golden. Cut each tortilla in half and serve.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, sunflower oil, red onions, cooking chorizo sausages, chickpeas, eggs, green chili rings
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the sweet potatoes for 8 mins until tender, then drain. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large ovenproof pan and cook the onion and chorizo for 5 mins until softened. Add the sweet potatoes and chickpeas and cook for 5 mins more. Roughly break the mixture up with a fork, then flatten it down lightly to form a cake. Cook for a further 8 mins, without stirring, until cooked through, crispy and golden on the bottom. Step 2: Heat grill to high. Break the eggs onto the hash, season, then place the pan under the grill and cook for 2-3 mins until the whites are set. Sprinkle with chilli to serve.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, deep dish pie shell, taco seasoning, refried beans, salsa, cheese, tortilla chips, lettuce, fresh tomato, black olives, sour cream, jalapenos
Instructions: Step 1: Bake the pie crust according to package directions. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350. Step 3: Brown ground beef and drain. Step 4: Add taco seasoning, following package directions. Step 5: Mix the beans and the salsa in a bowl. Step 6: Spread the bean mixture in the bottom of the baked pie crust. Step 7: Add half the ground beef. Step 8: Top with half the tortilla chips. Step 9: Top with half the cheese. Step 10: Repeat ingredient layering to make a second layer. Step 11: Bake at 350 for approximately 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted to your liking. Step 12: Cool for 10 minutes to allow pie to set. Step 13: Slice and top with whatever optional toppings you would like.

Ingredient Names: chili beans, tamales, onions, jalapenos, corn chips, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 4 ingredients in a 2 quart casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Step 2: Bake at 400 degrees for 25 mins or until bubbly. Step 3: Mix corn chips and cheese and sprinkle over casserole. Step 4: Bake for 5 more minutes or until cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: eggs, sugar, all-purpose flour, baking powder, sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, milk, kahlua, vanilla, sweetened softly whipped cream, strawberry
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, with a mixer on high speed (use whip attachment if available), beat eggs and sugar until thick and pale yellow, 5 to 6 minutes. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix flour and baking powder. Step 3: With mixer on medium speed, gradually add flour mixture in small increments and beat until smooth. Step 4: Scrape batter into a buttered 9 by 13 inch baking pan. Step 5: Bake in a 325 degree oven until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 30 to 40 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, in a blender, whirl condensed milk, evaporated milk, regular milk, Kahlua, and vanilla until well blended. Step 7: Pour evenly over hot cake; let cool about 15 minutes, then cover and chill until cake has absorbed all the milk mixture, at least 3 hours, or up to 1 day. Step 8: Cut cake into squares or rectangles, lift out with a wide spatula, and set on plates. Step 9: Top each piece of cake with a spoonful of whipped cream and garnish with strawberries.

Dish Name: Warm Mexican bean dip with tortilla chips
Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, soft brown sugar, wine vinegar, cajun seasoning, mixed beans, tomatoes garlic, cheddar, tortilla chips, serve avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the chopped onion in olive oil until soft. Add soft brown sugar, wine vinegar and Cajun seasoning. Cook for 1 min then add the mixed beans and chopped tomatoes with garlic. Simmer for 10-15 mins until the sauce has thickened then season. Step 2: Scatter handful grated cheddar onto tortilla chips. Microwave on High for 1 min until cheese has melted. Serve alongside the dip (top with some chopped avocado if you like). Make ahead and reheat dip before guests arrive.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast tenders, olive oil, fajita seasoning mix, pepper, onion, lime, cheese, tortilla, pico de gallo, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp oil in your wok until smoking. Step 2: Add the chicken, the 1 tbsp of seasoning mix, and after they get going, squeeze 1 / 2 the lime inches stir fry until barely done, remove to the side and keep warm In the same wok, heat another little tad of oil if you need to and stir fry the onions and peppers with the 1 tsp of seasoning. Step 3: When they're done to your liking, mix in the chicken and squeeze the other 1 / 2 of the lime in and mix up well. Step 4: Serve with the tortillas and the other fixings and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: chili with beans, water, white minute rice, flour tortillas, cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chili and water to boil in medium saucepan, stir in rice, cover. Step 2: Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Step 3: Spoon approx 1 / 2 cup chili mixture onto each tortilla. Step 4: Top with cheese and sour cream, and fold up.

Dish Name: 2 Texans Craving Salsa Far From Home
Ingredient Names: onion, fresh cilantro, whole canned tomatoes, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, lime, jalapenos, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine cilantro, tomatoes, jalapenos, juice of 1 / 2 a lime, blend. Step 2: Add spices and salt The salsa will have a small bite from just the jalapenos, i like to taste it now and then add in minced seeds for heat -- remember to add in small amounts, jalapenos add the kind of heat that sneaks up on you Not to mention one night in the fridge with all those flavors mingling could up the heat substantially Sometimes i use cayenne pepper to build heat bc it dosen't seem to have as strong of staying power on your tounge. Step 3: Then again i'm sure others would disagree and have their own methods for building heat Last add the onions and once this is done put the blender away, otherwise you end up with spicy vegetable pulp, the onions will give it texture Sometimes i leave out the cilantro until i add the onions to give the sauce even more texture Of course you'll want to chop the leaves a little.

Ingredient Names: pork sirloin roast, southwest seasoning, chunky salsa, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Rub southwest seasoning on both sides of pork and place in slow cooker. Step 2: Pour 2 cups salsa over pork, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Step 3: Using two forks, shred pork. Step 4: Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in aluminum foil and heat in a 350-degree oven for 20 minutes or until heated through. Step 5: Spoon pork mixture onto center of each tortilla and top with additional salsa, cheese and cilantro Broil 1 minute or until cheese is bubbly. Step 6: Roll up like a burrito to eat. Step 7: Serve with black beans and spanish rice.

Dish Name: 5 Minute Low Fat Tex Mex Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: fat-free refried beans, fat-free turkey chili, mexican-style corn, mexican tomatoes, fat-free cream of mushroom soup, low-fat mexican cheese blend, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 9x13 pan with pam. Step 2: Preheat oven to 375 Warm the tortillas in the microwave with wet paper towels for about 45 seconds. Step 3: Mix together the chili, beans, corn and 1 / 2 of the cheese. Step 4: Put 1 / 5 of the filling in the middle of each tortilla, fold both sides over and place in pan seam side down. Step 5: Mix together the soup, tomatoes and the rest of the cheese and pour over the enchiladas. Step 6: Bake for about 45 or 50 minutes, until cheese is browning and mixture is hot and bubbly Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: tequila, rum, pineapple juice, grapefruits, fresh pineapple
