Instructions: Step 1: Shake all liquids with ice cubes and serve on the rocks in a collins glass, garnished with pineapple.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, water, green taco sauce, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, barbecue baked beans, sour cream, green onion, sliced ripe olives
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, brown beef, drain fat. Step 2: Stir in taco seasoning and water, add taco sauce. Step 3: Simmer for 5-10 minutes or until slightly thickened. Step 4: Cover the bottom of a 13-in X 9-in X 2-in Baking dish with three tortillas, tearing them into pieces as necessary. Step 5: Spread half of meat mixture over tortillas, then sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup cheese.

Ingredient Names: tequila, lime juice, curacao, creme de cassis, club soda, lime slice
Instructions: Step 1: Into a cocktail shaker, pour tequila, lime juice, curacao, creme de cassis, and plenty of crushed ice Shake until well combined. Step 2: Fill a tall glass half way with ice. Step 3: Strain drink into the glass. Step 4: Pour some club soda on top. Step 5: Stir and garnish with the slice of lime.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, white vinegar, orange juice, lime juice, kosher salt, ground cumin, achiote paste, fresh cilantro stems, boneless pork butt, sandwich buns, asadero cheese, lettuce, roma tomato, guacamole, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender or food processor, combine the garlic, vinegar, juices, salt, and cumin Pulse until well combined Crumble in the achiote and pulse to combine into a very soft paste. Step 2: Add more vinegar by the tablespoon to loosen it up if necessary. Step 3: Blend in the cilantro. Step 4: Cut the meat into lenghtwise slices 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch thick Lay the meat between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound to an even thickness of 1 / 4 inch Coat the slices generously with the paste and refrigerate for at least 6 hours and no more than 12 hours Half an hour before cooking, clrean the grill thoroughly with a brush and wipe it down with an oil-dampened rag. Step 5: Preheat the grill on high.

Dish Name: Adobo Mojado Wet Rub For Meats And Poultry
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fine sea salt, black peppercorns, dried oregano, olive oil, white wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the garlic cloves and salt to a paste using a mortar and pestle. Step 2: Add the peppercorns and oregano, pounding well after each to incorporate them into the paste Come on! Step 3: Really work out those aggressions!, pound! Step 4: Stir in the olive oil and vinegar Slather on chicken, steak, chops, etc Then refrigerate for at least an hour Grill or bake as you prefer.

Ingredient Names: adzuki beans, water, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, bouillon, bay leaf, taco seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Soak beans overnight in 4 cups water, drain and rinse. Step 2: In a large pot, sautee onions and garlic in oil. Step 3: Add beans and 2-4 cups of water, bring to a simmer. Step 4: Add bouillon and bay leaf. Step 5: Cook 1 hour, adding more water if necessary. Step 6: Add taco seasoning and crushed red pepper. Step 7: Cook an additional 30 minutes or until water is reduced, remove bay leaf.

Ingredient Names: kosher salt, lime slices, tequila, agave syrup, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour some kosher salt into a small dish Rub 1 lime slice over half the rim of an old fashioned glass or a coupe glass. Step 2: Dip rim of glass into salt. Step 3: Combine tequila, agave syrup, and juice in a cocktail shaker. Step 4: Fill with ice and shake well. Step 5: Strain into prepared glass. Step 6: Garnish with second lime slice Different variations - Fruity: muddle 3 blackberries with agave syrup in a cocktail shaker until berries are lightly crushed and juices are released Continue with above recipe.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, whole allspice, cinnamon, dried hibiscus flowers
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the water and the spices to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Stir in the sugar and cook for about 1 minute, or until completely dissolved. Step 3: Add the hibiscus flowers and remove from heat. Step 4: Let it steep for about 1 hour at room temperature. Step 5: Strain and chill or serve over ice.

Ingredient Names: water, lime juice, superfine sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Squeeze the limes into a bowl and strain 1 cup of the juice into a jug with the water. Step 2: Add the sugar and more lime juice to taste. Step 3: Fill the jug with crushed ice and serve.

Dish Name: Agua Fresca De Tres Citricos Triple Citrus Agua Fresca
Ingredient Names: limes, oranges, grapefruits, sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Juice all fruits on a citrus juicer, straining out seeds Add sugar and stir well to dissolve Add water and stir Chill for at least an hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, fresh gingerroot, garlic, onion, coleslaw mix, sesame oil, low sodium soy sauce, lime juice, honey, ground coriander, crushed red pepper flakes, flour tortillas, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat, add the pork. Step 2: Cook, crumble and stir for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the pork is no longer pink. Step 3: Add the ginger, garlic, onion, and coleslaw mix. Step 4: Stir-fry with the pork for 2 minutes, or until vegetables are wilted. Step 5: In a small bowl, combine all the remaining ingredients, except the tortillas and cilantro, add to skillet. Step 6: Cook, stirring constantly to blend all ingredients well, for 1 minute. Step 7: Spoon equal portions of the mixture onto warm flour tortillas. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, paprika, cornmeal, cumin, oregano, onion powder, ground coriander, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Carefully mix, by hand, all the spices in a bowl until they are all perfectly melded, should be a light reddish-brown color Yields 3 4 ounces, have an airtight bottle or container ready to store inches Feel free to substitute the onion powder for garlic powder for a hotter taste, and cilantro for coriander, and adjust the cayenne according to how hot you would like it.

Ingredient Names: red onions, almonds, chipotle chiles, dried plum, corn tortillas, pumpkin seeds, mexican chocolate, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, olive oil, fat-free low-sodium chicken broth, fresh tomato, tomato sauce, green bell pepper, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first nine ingredients through cloves in blender and mix until smooth, adding the oil and chicken broth gradually. Step 2: Heat another tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet and add spice paste, cooking on medium heat until fragrant. Step 3: Add tomatoes, sauce, peppers, garlic, broth and seasonings and simmer for five minutes until thickened and creamy. Step 4: Serve over chicken or fish.

Ingredient Names: ancho chilies, cascabel chiles, dried arbol chiles, whole cumin seeds, garlic powder, dried oregano, smoked paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the chiles and cumin seeds in a cast iron skillet for a few minutes Don't let them cook too long and inhale the smoke, because you'll get a nasty chemical burn in lungs, nose and throat. Step 2: Let the chiles and seeds cool. Step 3: Place all the ingredients into a blender and blend on the highest speed you blender can dish out. Step 4: Store in an airtight jar Be sure to wash you blender carafe a few times after doing this or you fruit smoothy or margarita will taste like chiles.

Ingredient Names: flour, chili powder, paprika, salt, dried onion flakes, cumin, cayenne, garlic powder, sugar, ground oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ingredients. Step 2: Pour over browned, ground meat in a pan over medium heat I'm sorry i don't have an amount of water to recommend adding to the seasoning I usually just wing it and then simmer it down if i get too carried away with the water I think about a half cup? Step 3: Simmer until it looks good!, dig it.

Ingredient Names: canned chicken, green chilies, cream cheese, green onions, flour tortillas, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Let cream cheese come to room temperature. Step 2: Drain the canned chicken. Step 3: Mix cream cheese, green chiles, green onion and chicken until well blended. Step 4: Cut two sides of the tortillas so you have two straight sides on each side. Step 5: Spread chicken mixture thinly on 3 / 4 of the tortilla. Step 6: Roll tortilla up starting with the end you spread the chicken mixture on Seal the plain end with water. Step 7: Heat oil to about 375-400 degrees. Step 8: Drop burritos into hot oil and fry for about 2 minutes. Step 9: Keep turning so they fry evenly.

Ingredient Names: pork, ancho chilies, chicken broth, garlic cloves, serranos, white wine vinegar, water, fresh cilantro, fresh savory, fresh basil, fresh oregano, cumin, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients to the blender and blend until smooth Should be thick, if not, cook a little longer in the next step. Step 2: Preheat a skillet to medium high, and add 2 tb oil. Step 3: When it is very hot, but not smoking add the contents of the blender, and fry for 1 minute until slightly reduced, then add the carnitas and stir until well mixed and continue cooking until all pork is coated and warm. Step 4: Serve in burritos, or with rice, and pico de gallo.

Ingredient Names: baking potatoes, olive oil, dried ancho chile powder, sugar, garlic cloves, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, then cut into 1 / 4-inch-thick slabs. Step 3: Cut slabs lengthwise into strips, gently pat strips dry with paper toweling and place on a greased foil-lined baking sheet. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine oil, chile powder, sugar, garlic, salt and pepper. Step 5: Pour mixture over the potatoes, and gently toss to combine using your hands. Step 6: Bake about 30 minutes until tender and golden brown, carefully turning once halfway through.

Ingredient Names: dried ancho chile, vegetable oil, onion, tomato paste, garlic cloves, dry red wine, ketchup, apple cider vinegar, dark brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, ground cumin, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chile in medium bowl. Step 2: Pour enough boiling water over to cover. Step 3: Let soak until soft, about 30 minutes. Step 4: Drain, reserving soaking liquid. Step 5: Heat oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 6: Add onion and saute until soft, stirring often, about 4 minutes, add tomato paste, stir 2 minutes. Step 7: Add garlic and stir 30 seconds. Step 8: Add wine and softened chile.

Ingredient Names: soft taco-size flour tortillas, eggs, cheese, jimmy dean sausage, frozen tater tots, salsa, salt, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to temp as instructed on package. Step 2: Line a baking sheet with foil then spray with cooking spray to prevent sticking Lay tater tots on pan and sprinkle with salt. Step 3: Cook until done, set aside to cool completely Brown sausage in a skillet until done. Step 4: Drain to remove fat then set aside to cool completely Scramble eggs and cook until desired doneness. Step 5: Set aside to cool completely. Step 6: Once all cooked ingredients are cooled completely, begin making burritos Lay sausage, then eggs, then cheese, then tater tots on a tortilla.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sweet onion, jalapenos, garlic cloves, butter, olive oil, flour, sour cream, chicken broth, milk, flour tortillas, cheese, cilantro, lime juice, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter and add olive oil in large saute pan. Step 2: Add onions, garlic and jalapenos and cook till tender. Step 3: Add 1 / 3 of veggie mix to chicken along with 1 / 2 c cheese, 1 c sour cream, and cilantro and lime juice if using. Step 4: Add flour to remaining veggies in pan and stir till coated. Step 5: Add chicken broth and milk to veggies and bring to boil. Step 6: Reduce heat till the sauce is simmering and simmer for 3-5 minutes until slightly thickened. Step 7: Remove from heat and cool till warm. Step 8: Add sour cream and stir till combined Coat a 9x13 pan with cooking spray and place 2 t of sauce on the bottom of the pan and tilt till the bottom is completely coated. Step 9: Place 1 / 8 of the mixture in each tortilla and roll and place seam-down in pan.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, banana pepper, red bell pepper, cream cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cream cheese and peppers in a small bowl. Step 2: Spread tortillas with cream cheese mixture. Step 3: Sprinkle each wrap with grated cheese. Step 4: Fold two sides of burrito wrap inward on ingredients, then roll from the bottom to make a pinwheel shape. Step 5: Cut each wrap on a diagonal to make 4 - 5 pieces. Step 6: Place on greased pan and cook at 350f until lightly browned.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, monterey jack cheese, butter, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, ground cumin, ground black pepper, red bell pepper, green bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut some of the cheese into 8 slices, and reserve part of it for the cheese sauce. Step 2: Place 1 chicken breast between two sheets of wax paper Working from the center to the edges pound with a meat mallet until flat and rectangular shaped. Step 3: Repeat with remaining breasts. Step 4: Wrap the flattened chicken breasts around cheese Secure with wooden picks or uncooked spaghetti noodles. Step 5: Combine the bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, cumin and pepper. Step 6: Roll the secured chicken pieces in the melted butter and then in the bread crumb mixture. Step 7: Place chicken breasts in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, but don't crowd them. Step 8: Drizzle the remaining butter over all eight of the breasts.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, hominy, ancho chilies, guajillo chilies, garlic, black pepper, salt, cabbage, radish, white onion, fresh cilantro, lime, red chili pepper flakes, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot place meat and enough water to cover all the meat and salt to taste. Step 2: Set the stove to medium high Skim off any foam that rises to the surface, after doing this turn down heat to medium / medium-low. Step 3: Let cook for 1 5 to 2 hrs While meat is cooking, in another pot place chiles, garlic, pepper and about 4-5 cups of water for 15 minute. Step 4: Remove from pot and put in a blender and blend with salt to taste. Step 5: Drain and wash hominy. Step 6: When meat is fully cooked add hominy to the sauce and salt to taste. Step 7: Bring to a boil for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: kosher salt, granulated garlic, ground cumin, granulated onion, paprika, fresh ground black pepper, ground turmeric, dried oregano, spanish onion, red bell pepper, poblano pepper, garlic cloves, olive oil, chili oil, chicken thighs
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the adobo seasoning in a small bowl. Step 2: Cut the onion, peppers, and garlic into a small dice and set aside Trim the chicken of any excess fat and season with adobo seasoning. Step 3: Heat the olive oil and the chili oil in a large pot over medium-high heat until very hot. Step 4: Season the chicken with adobo Save the leftovers in an airtight container. Step 5: Place the chicken skin side down in the oil and saute until golden brown. Step 6: Remove chicken to plate. Step 7: Stir in sofrito and saute for 4-5 minutes. Step 8: Add rice, chicken stock and beer and stir well.

Dish Name: Arroz Con Queso Rice With Cheese
Ingredient Names: cooked rice, black-eyed peas, garlic, onion, chilies, ricotta cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, parmesan cheese, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 f. Step 2: Mix cheddar and jack together. Step 3: Mix rice, beans, garlic, onion, and chilies together. Step 4: In a large casserole dish spread 1 / 3 of the rice / bean mixture. Step 5: Top that with 1 / 2 of the cheese mixture. Step 6: Top that with 1 / 2 of the ricotta. Step 7: Then the next 1 / 3 of the rice / bean mixture Followed by the last half of the cheese Followed by the last half of the ricotta. Step 8: Then the last 1 / 3 of the rice / bean mixture.

Ingredient Names: yukon gold potatoes, eggs, curry powder, salt, black pepper, green onion, onion, flour, cornstarch, oil, egg, sour cream, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes for approximately 6-12 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, slice the green onions / cilantro and prep the crispy onions To prep the crispy onions. Step 3: Slice the onion very thinly and coat with flour. Step 4: Heat a small pan filled with the one cup of oil. Step 5: Add the floured onion slices and cook until they possess a deep brown color, meanwhile. Step 6: Heat a large pan with the 1-3 cups oil for the begedil. Step 7: Remove the cooked potatoes fro the water once done, and place in a large mixing bowl Smash until it holds the consistancy of mashed potatoes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, vegetable oil, orange juice, pickapeppa sauce, green onions, garlic clove, fresh coarse ground black pepper, celery salt, jalapeno juice, orange zest
Instructions: Step 1: Combine marinade ingredients in a large, heavy zip-top bag and mix well. Step 2: Remove any fat from the chicken breasts and wipe dry with paper towels. Step 3: Place chicken in the marinade. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least 6 hours, turning often. Step 5: Drain liquid and discard. Step 6: Grill over hot coals. Step 7: Cut chicken breasts into strips and serve with warm flour tortillas.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, garlic cloves, oregano, tomato paste, cumin, black pepper, salt, bay leaf, white onion, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a large pot. Step 2: Fill the pot with water just until the roast is covered in liquid. Step 3: Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 hours covered. Step 4: Take the roast out of the stock once it is fork tender. Step 5: Remove the bone and break the meat into 1 inch chunks keeping the fat attached to the pieces Lay the pieces flat on a baking sheet and bake on 450 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until the pieces are golden brown You can shred or cut the meat and serve as a filling for tacos, enchiladas, on a salad or in flautas Or, keep the meat in chunks and smother with green chile Enjoy!

Dish Name: Authentic Chili Verde Pork And Green Tomatillo Stew
Ingredient Names: pork stew meat, vegetable oil, yellow onions, garlic, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, ground cumin, chicken broth, poblano chiles, fresh jalapeno peppers, yellow bell peppers, tomatillos, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stock pot over high heat sear the pork in the vegetable oil until browned. Step 2: Remove the pork from the pot, reserve 3 tablespoons oil in the pan. Step 3: Saute the chopped onion and garlic seasoned with salt and pepper in the reserved oil until onions are tender. Step 4: Add the cumin, then stir in pork and chicken stock. Step 5: Simmer for 1 / 2 hour. Step 6: Add in poblanos, jalapenos and bell peppers. Step 7: Puree the tomatillos and cilantro in a blender, and add them to the pot. Step 8: Cook for an additional 30 to 45 minutes. Step 9: Serve with mexican / spanish rice and refried beans.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, salt, pepper, baking powder, lard, water, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and baking powder. Step 2: Mix in the lard / margarine with your fingers until the flour resembles cornmeal. Step 3: Add the water and mix until the dough comes together. Step 4: Place on a lightly floured surface and knead a few minutes until smooth and elastic. Step 5: Divide the dough into 24 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball. Step 6: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat Use a well-floured rolling pin to roll a dough ball into a very thin, round tortilla. Step 7: Place into the hot skillet, and cook until bubbly and golden. Step 8: Flip and continue cooking until golden on the other side. Step 9: Place the cooked tortilla in a tortilla warmer.

Ingredient Names: tequila, orange liqueur, lime juice, cranberry juice, ice cube, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place tequila, controy, limejuice and cranberry juice in blender. Step 2: Fill until almost full with crushed ice Shake well or blend until very slushy Wet rim of martini or margarita glass with water and swirl in small dish of salt. Step 3: Pour margarita into the glass Ole and feliz navidad!

Ingredient Names: kosher salt, pure chile powder, dried oregano, granulated garlic, ground cumin, pork shoulder, tomatillos, green chilies, garlic cloves, onion, dark mexican beer, fresh cilantro, tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce, fresh ground black pepper, white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 500 degrees. Step 2: In a small bowl mix the salt, chili powder, oregano, granulated garlic, and cumin Coat the pork on all sides with the rub, massaging the spices into the meat. Step 3: Let the pork sit at room temperature for 20 to 30 before browning. Step 4: In a food processor or blender, pure the tomatillos, canned chiles, garlic, onion, oregano, and beer Brown the roast on a roasting pan for 30 minutes in the oven. Step 5: Remove the pork from the oven and reduce temperature to 250 degrees. Step 6: Place the pork in a 13x9-inch heavy-duty disposable drip pan. Step 7: Pour the tomatillo mixture around the pork so it comes up the sides of the pork by 1 inch or so Seal the pan tightly with foil, and place the pan in the center of the oven.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, lean pork sausage, vegetable oil, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, black beans, poblano pepper, diced onion, garlic cloves, chipotle chile, adobo sauce, cumin powder, chili powder, ancho chili, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare chili: In a large pot brown ground beef, sausage, onion and garlic, breaking meat into small pieces. Step 2: Drain of excess grease. Step 3: Add poblano pepper and cook for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce, 1 cup beer and one can of black beans. Step 5: Add ground cumin, chili powders, chipoltes, adobe sauce, oregeano, and cocoa. Step 6: Bring to a boil, cover and turn down to a simmer and cook for 35 - 45 minutes, adding more beer or broth as needed. Step 7: Drain the remaining can of beans and lightly mash To thicken, add the crushed black beans and adjust spices and liquid as needed. Step 8: Bring to a simmer again for 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Authentic Mexico Garden Fresh Salsa Hot Sauce
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, jalapenos, onion, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro leaves, ground cumin, olive oil, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil tomatoes & jalapeos in large pot of water until tomato skins wrinkle. Step 2: Remove tomatoes & jalapeos from water and carefully remove tomato skins, discard skins. Step 3: Remove stems from jalapeos and depending on desired level of heat desired, you may remove some or all of the seeds and pods inside the peppers. Step 4: Place tomatoes and jalapenos into vitamix or blender. Step 5: Add crushed garlic cloves, cilantro leaves, quartered onion, ground cumin to vitamix or blender Briefly pulse ingredients until desired consistency Do not liquefy, but blend smoother than typical pico de gallo. Step 6: Put large pot back on stove and add 3 tablespoons olive oil. Step 7: Heat oil over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: dried pinto bean, water, bacon grease, garlic powder, chicken bouillon powder, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Put beans and water into dutch oven. Step 2: Soak at least six hours. Step 3: Pour beans into colander and rinse thoroughly. Step 4: Add two cups water back into the dutch oven, along with bacon grease, garlic powder, bouillon and chili powder, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover and reduce heat, simmering for about four to six hours. Step 6: Stir occasionally You'll know when the frijoles are done because they'll be very tender. Step 7: Mash until about only half are left whole.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, serrano chilies, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Remove husk from tomatillos and rinse well. Step 2: Remove top stem and rinse. Step 3: Place ingredients in pot and cover with water. Step 4: Bring to a boil for about 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Remove from boil and place tomatillos and chiles in a blender. Step 6: Blend until smooth, for a couple min or until desired texture occurs. Step 7: Pour into a container add a little salt and and chopped cilantro if desired! Step 8: May enjoy right away or may be placed in fridge for a couple hours to cool down! Step 9: Eat with tacos, enchilads, eggs, tortillas, chips, etc --.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno, fresh cilantro, garlic, onions, salt, olive oil, corn tortillas, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium sized saucepan, sweat out jalapenos, garlic and onion, until soft. Step 2: Add cilantro, cook until it is wilted. Step 3: Add just enough water to cover everything, and simmer about 5 minutes In the meantime, cut the tortillas into small pieces. Step 4: Add the tortilla pieces to the simmering mixture, and allow them to simmer another 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Transfer to food processor, or blender and blend until puree'd, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, serrano chilies, cilantro, tomatoes, avocados, limes, extra virgin olive oil, salt, garlic salt, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with garlic salt and drain. Step 2: Heat a griddle or large skillet on high Lightly coat tortillas with extra virgin olive oil Lightly fry tortillas so that they are still flexible, but slightly browned. Step 3: Drain tortillas on paper towels. Step 4: Put one spoonful of ground beef on each tortilla, top with serranos, onion, tomato, cilantro, avocado, lime juice and salt Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: tomatillo, fresh jalapeno peppers, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the tomatillo's husk and rinse in water. Step 2: Grill or roast the tomatillos and the peppers until the skins appear burned Do not peel the skins. Step 3: In a blender or food processor, combine the garlic, tomatillos and peppers and process until semi-smooth. Step 4: Add the cilantro and salt and process for an additional 8 seconds.

Ingredient Names: avocados, roma tomatoes, red onions, cilantro, garlic, jalapeno pepper, tomato juice, cayenne pepper, tabasco sauce, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel avocadoes and tomatoes and dice into small chunks. Step 2: Mix with onions, cilantro, garlic and jalapeno peppers. Step 3: Add tomato juice, cayenne pepper, tabasco sauce and lemon juice to taste.

Ingredient Names: tortillas, avocados, bacon, tomatoes, jalapeno pepper, sour cream, alfalfa sprout, green onions, salt, cracked black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Lay the tortillas out flat, spread about 1 tablespoon of sour cream in the middle of each tortilla long ways. Step 2: Divide the avocado evenly over top of the sour cream. Step 3: Layer of any optional ingredients: bacon, tomato or jalapeno pepper. Step 4: Add some alfalfa sprouts, green onions, salt and pepper to taste, roll it up.

Ingredient Names: avocado, milk, sugar, ice cube
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, scoop out the pulp, and place in a blender with the milk, sugar and ice cubes. Step 2: Blend until smooth and frothy. Step 3: Taste and add more sugar if you like. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, serrano chilies, cilantro, white onion, water, hass avocado, lime juice, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In food processor or blender, put tomatillos, chiles, cilantro, onions and water. Step 2: Blend until smooth, add avocado flesh. Step 3: Blend until smooth. Step 4: Transfer sauce to serving bowl. Step 5: Season with lime juice, salt, and pepper.

Ingredient Names: stew meat, extra virgin olive oil, jalapeno peppers, poblano peppers, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, onion, garlic, dried ancho chiles, dried chilies, chili powder, cocoa powder, cumin, black pepper, adobo seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Saute meat, in olive oil, until browned, drain the meat. Step 2: Add all the peppers, onions, garlic and spices. Step 3: Saute for 15 minutes or until the onion is translucent. Step 4: Mix the beef base with the water or beer and add to the beef and vegetable mixture. Step 5: Simmer on low for about half an hour. Step 6: Add tomatoes and continue to simmer until the meat is very tender.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, enchilada sauce, diced green chilies, garlic, old bay seasoning, cream cheese, sour cream, monterey jack cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375f Brown ground beef or turkey over medium-high heat with onion. Step 2: Add the chilies, garlic, and seasoning until thoroughly cooked. Step 3: Add 3 / 4 cup of the enchilada sauce, green chilies, minced garlic, old bay seasoning, cream cheese, and sour cream and stir until combined. Step 4: Stir in 3 / 4 cup of each of the shredded cheeses. Step 5: Spoon filling onto tortillas. Step 6: Roll up and place seam-side down in lightly greased 13x9x2-inch baking dish. Step 7: Pour remaining enchilada sauce over top. Step 8: Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 9: Bake at 375f for 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: milk, vanilla beans, red chili pepper, cinnamon stick, bittersweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer milk in a saucepan with vanilla bean, cinnamon and chili. Step 2: Heat through for about a minute. Step 3: Whisk in grated chocolate, and continue to simmer until melted. Step 4: Remove from heat and let 'steep' for another 2 minutes. Step 5: Strain out the spices and serve.

Dish Name: Aztec Corn Bbq D In Husks
Ingredient Names: corn, cilantro, red sweet peppers, jalapeno peppers, green onions, butter, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Carefully peel back the husks from the corn and remove all the silk. Step 2: Remove the cob from the husks without tearing the husks. Step 3: Discard 2 husks and soak the remaining 8 in water for about 20 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile cut the corn from the cobs, discard cobs. Step 5: Mix together the peppers, cilantro onions and corn. Step 6: Heat the butter in a skillet and saute the corn mixture for about 5 minutes The corn should still be crunchy. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Take the husks from the water and dry the inside of the husk with a paper towel. Step 9: Spoon about 1 cup of the mixture into each husk, fold the husk around the corn and tie at the top and around the middle so the husk is securely around the corn mixture.

Ingredient Names: oil, garlic cloves, onions, chili powder, ground cumin, oregano, cinnamon, black pepper, cayenne pepper, salt, ground turkey, diced tomatoes, pinto beans, green peppers, unsweetened chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first ten ingredients in microwave safe dish Microwave on high for 2 and 1 / 2 minutes. Step 2: Stir in 1-2 t water if mixture becomes too dry Microwave on high 2 and 1 / 2 to 3 minutes or till onions are tender crisp. Step 3: Let stand 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in turkey Microwave on high 10-13 minutes or til turkey is partially done, stirring once. Step 5: Add tomatoes, beans, peppers and chocolate. Step 6: Mix well Microwave on medium for 40 minutes, stirring twice.

Ingredient Names: skim milk, sugar, honey, ground ginger, ground cloves, ground red pepper, unsweetened cocoa, vanilla extract, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, combine milk, sugar, honey, ginger, cloves and red pepper. Step 2: Heat to boiling over medium-high heat. Step 3: Reduce to medium and simmer 3 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat With wire whisk, stir in cocoa and vanilla. Step 5: Stir briskly until frothy. Step 6: Serve in warm cups. Step 7: Top with whipped cream.

Ingredient Names: powdered milk, sugar, flour, cocoa, salt, ground cinnamon, ground allspice, hot chocolate powder, water, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Put all of the mix ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth To make the hot chocolate, put 1 / 4 cup of the mix into a mug and add 3 / 4 cup boiling hot water or coffee, stir in a couple of drops of vanilla extract. Step 2: Stir until well mixed Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, eggs, hot dogs, bacon grease, onion
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, fry onion in bacon grease until tender, add diced hot dogs Continue frying until browned. Step 2: Add more bacon grease if needed Tear up tortillas into bite size pieces and add to skillet Continue frying until tortillas are pliable. Step 3: Add more bacon grease if needed Break eggs over entire mixture and stir everything together until eggs are fried This is a delicacy that originated in the refrigerator, better known as left overs Pay day was still a ways off.

Ingredient Names: pork butt, corn oil, onion, garlic, poblano chiles, tomatillos, chicken stock, heavy cream, salt, corn tortillas, gouda cheese, cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Remember that you will need to cook the pork before preparing the rest of the casserole. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons of the corn oil in a saut pan over medium heat and cook the onions until soft. Step 3: Add the garlic, poblano, and tomatillos and let them cook for about 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the poblano is soft. Step 4: Add the chicken stock and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add cream and cook for 5 more minutes Pure the poblano sauce in a blender until smooth, strain, and return to the pan. Step 6: Season with salt and reduce some more if necessary Sauce should coat the back of a spoon. Step 7: Heat a few tablespoons of corn oil over medium-high heat and cook the tortillas in it for no more than 10 seconds. Step 8: Drain on paper towels.

Ingredient Names: lemonade concentrate, vodka, rum, ginger ale, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a pitcher Mix thoroughly and pour into whatever is available, the bigger the better! Step 2: This drink packs a big punch, so don't over do it.

Ingredient Names: lean ground chuck, evaporated milk, cream of mushroom soup, onion, green chilies, red enchilada sauce, velveeta cheese, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 Lightly grease a 13 x 9 baking dish In skillet, brown meat until done, drain. Step 2: Stir in milk, soups, onion, green chiles and enchilada sauce In the baking dish, spread a little of the sauce on the bottom. Step 3: Layer 1 / 2 of the tortillas, meat mix then cheese, repeat Finish with cheese on top. Step 4: Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly!

Ingredient Names: bacon, eggs, whipping cream, baking powder, ground black pepper, salt, butter, cheddar cheese, green onions, tortillas, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet cook the bacon until crisp, remove to a plate. Step 2: In a bowl whisk the eggs with cream, baking powder, salt and pepper until well combined, then add in the cooked bacon. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat until sizzling. Step 4: Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until almost firm but still slightly watery. Step 5: Add in the cheese and cook gently stirring until the eggs are just cooked and the cheese has melted. Step 6: Spoon about 1 / 4 cup or a little more down the center of each warm tortilla, then sprinkle a small amount of green onions over the egg mixture. Step 7: Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling You may place the rolled tortillas in a baking dish, cover with foil and keep warm in the oven until ready to serve, serve with salsa.

Ingredient Names: eggs, flour tortillas, vegetable oil, cheddar cheese, avocado, green onions, bacon, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, beat the eggs. Step 2: Dip one tortilla in eggs. Step 3: In a large skillet, cook tortilla in oil just until egg sets. Step 4: Turn to cook other side. Step 5: Remove and place between paper towels to drain, keep warm. Step 6: Repeat with remaining tortillas, adding more oil if needed. Step 7: Place cheese, avocado, onions and bacon down the center of tortillas. Step 8: Top with salsa, salad dressing or sour cream. Step 9: Fold ends and sides over filling.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, garlic, sugar, jalapeno pepper, oil, black beans, canned chicken broth, seasoning salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy saucepan, cook the chopped bacon until almost crisp. Step 2: Remove to a plate To the same saucepan add in the onion, garlic, 1 teaspoon sugar and jalapeno peppers. Step 3: Cook stirring until transparent. Step 4: Reduce the heat to low and continue to cook until the onions have caramalized and are a deep brown. Step 5: Add the cooked bacon back to the saucepan along with the undrained black beans Roughly mash using a potato masher. Step 6: Add in 1 cup broth and bring to a simmer stirring. Step 7: Simmer uncovered over low heat for 1 hour stirring occasionally adding in more broth if needed to achieve desired consistancy. Step 8: Season with the seasoned salt and black pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: hot dogs, hot dog buns, bacon, mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, tomatoes, onion, jalapeno peppers, pinto beans
Instructions: Step 1: Chop up tomatoes, onions, and jalapeos, put to the side. Step 2: Wrap bacon around each hot dog and put on the skillet and cook until bacon is done the bacon usually sticks to the hot dog if not you could use toothpicks to keep together At the same time warm up the beans. Step 3: Spread mayonnaise on the hot dog buns. Step 4: Put the bacon wrapped hot dog on the bun, at this point you may put the ketchup and mustard as desired. Step 5: Pour about 1 spoonful of beans over the hot dog. Step 6: Put the tomato, onion, and jalapeos over the beans and hot dog If desired you could saut some sliced onion and put on the top instead of the raw onion.

Ingredient Names: ice, strawberry, grenadine, light cream
Instructions: Step 1: To a blender, add all ingredients and blend until smooth Pour into a coupette glass Garnish with a fresh strawberry.

Ingredient Names: bottled chili sauce, spicy brown mustard, worcestershire sauce, chipotle pepper, adobo sauce, maple syrup, boneless pork chops, olive oil, onions, green peppers, water, salt & freshly ground black pepper, red potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Blend together chili sauce, mustard, worcestershire and maple syrup. Step 2: Add pork and toss to coast. Step 3: Place in refrigerator and marinade for 2-5 hours. Step 4: Heat oil in the pressure cooker. Step 5: Cook the onions, stirring frequently for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the peppers and cook for another minute. Step 7: Stir in the water Stirring to dissolve the browned bits in the pan If using sweet potatoes put 4 thin slices of sweet potatoes in the broth The balance of the sweet potatoes should be cut into 2 inch pieces and placed on top of the meat.

Ingredient Names: hamburger, pinto beans, cheese, onion, southwest seasoning, jalapeno, burrito-size flour tortillas, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Brown hamburger, onion, jalapeo and seasoning. Step 2: Add beans and simmer for 15-20 minutes uncovered. Step 3: Pour off any juice To assemble: Place 2 hefty spoonfuls on one end of a tortilla. Step 4: Cover the mixture with cheese - as much as you want. Step 5: Roll up burrito style. Step 6: Place on a cookie sheet, seam down. Step 7: Make sure the burritos don't touch.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, ground cumin, paprika, sea salt, cilantro, chicken meat, gluten-free chicken stock, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f and oil a baking sheet. Step 2: Heat olive oil over medium heat in a skillet. Step 3: Add onion and cook until starting to soften and turn translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic, cumin, paprika and salt. Step 5: Stir to combine and cook 2 to 3 minutes longer, until fragrant. Step 6: Take from heat and stir in cilantro and chicken, set aside. Step 7: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a skillet or pot wide enough to hold tortillas. Step 8: When broth simmers, dip tortillas briefly, one at a time, just to soften, 1 to 2 seconds Lay tortilla on a work surface and spread 2 or 3 tablespoons chicken mixture over bottom third.

Ingredient Names: green chili peppers, monterey jack cheese, eggs, milk, flour, baking powder, salt, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Drain peppers, halve lenthwise, remove seeds. Step 2: Cut cheese in strips to fit inside peppers. Step 3: Wrap each pepper around a strip of cheese. Step 4: Place stuffed peppers in a 10 x 6 x 2 baking dish. Step 5: Combine eggs and milk, then beat in flour, baking powder, and salt until smooth. Step 6: Pour mixture over peppers in the baking dish and sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. Step 7: Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic clove, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, all-purpose flour, salt, sugar, pepper, cream-style corn, eggs, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a 5-quart saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, and bell peppers. Step 3: Cook, stirring, until onion is limp. Step 4: Stir in flour, salt, sugar, and pepper. Step 5: Cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly, remove from heat. Step 6: Add corn, eggs, and milk, stirring until mixture is well blended. Step 7: Pour corn mixture into shallow, buttered 3-quart baking dish. Step 8: Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 55 minutes or until center appears set when dish is gently shaken.

Ingredient Names: ears of corn, salt, black pepper, poblano chiles, queso fresco, scallions, garlic clove, fresh cilantro, currants, nonstick cooking spray, all-purpose flour, liquid egg substitute, unseasoned breadcrumbs, yellow cornmeal
Instructions: Step 1: Advance prep of the corn and peppers: Preheat grill or broiler to high heat Spray corn with nonstick spray and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 2: Grill corn, turning every 2-3 minutes, for 12 minutes or until all kernels are browned. Step 3: Let corn cool and when cool enough to handle, cut off kernels Roast the chiles either on the grill or in the broiler, turning every 3 minutes or until all the skin is charred Immediately pop the peppers into a large, clean paper bag and roll top to seal. Step 4: Let bag sit 15 minutes- when you open the bag, the skins should have loosened up. Step 5: Let peppers cool down enough to handle and peel off charred skins. Step 6: Preheat oven to 400f.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, eggs, cheddar cheese, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Depending on size of tortilla used, break 1-2 eggs into center of tortilla. Step 2: Salt and pepper egg (s) Sprinkle Cheddar all around outer edge of tortilla. Step 3: Bake at 350 until egg is set as desired.

Ingredient Names: butter, onions, garlic, frozen corn kernels, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh cilantro, hatch chiles, queso fresco, sour cream, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Warning: even mild hatch chiles can be pretty warm before cooking, though they should mellow out during cooking Wear disposable rubber gloves while handling, and wash your hands well with soap and warm water when you are done Do not use hot hatch chiles for this recipe unless you are a real chile-head! Step 2: Queso fresco in really too mild Use the goat cheese even though its not authentic! Step 3: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Spray a 9"x13" baking dish with nonstick spray. Step 4: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat, and saute onion and garlic until soft. Step 5: Add corn and salt and pepper to taste, and continue to saute until corn is done. Step 6: Add cilantro, adjust seasoning, and set aside to cool.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, beef broth, butter, onion, garlic, green onion, green chilies, cream of onion soup, enchilada sauce, refried beans, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Using a 12-inch cast-iron skillet, cook beef with taco seasoning and broth over medium heat. Step 3: Drain In the same skillet, melt butter. Step 4: Cook onion, garlic and green onion in butter until tender. Step 5: Add green chilies, soup and meat, stirring well. Step 6: Transfer mixture to a medium bowl Wipe skillet clean with a paper towel Lightly spray skillet with cooking spray, set aside.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic, olive oil, rice, salt, fresh ground pepper, chili powder, button mushrooms, chorizo sausage, chicken broth, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onion and garlic in the oil until soft. Step 2: Add the rice and seasonings and brown th rice lightly. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, sausage and enough boiling stock to come 1 inch above rice. Step 4: Cover with tight lid and bake in a 350 oven until liquid is completely absorbed about 30 to 35 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, cheddar cheese, bacon, green onions, butter, garlic cloves, fresh ground black pepper, salsa, black olives, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In three small bowls combine ingredients for each topping. Step 2: Stir till well-blended. Step 3: Cover and store in refrigerator till ready to use About 3 / 4 hour before use, take them out of the refrigerator If you are using them as a gift, give all three with the potatoes If you are making these for a buffet, you may want to make extra topping to fit your guest list.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, black beans, green chilies, fresh cilantro, chili powder, ground cumin, cheddar cheese, green onions, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large nonstick skillet. Step 2: Stir well, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Cover, reduce heat and simmer the tomato mixture at least 15 minutes-stirring occasionally I like my mixture fairly chunky so you can adjust your cooking time accordingly Split open the baked potatoes and put the mixture inside I normally cut my potato completely open, mash it and put the mixture on top adding the cheese and green onions You can certainly add extra ingredients like sour cream etc My wife and i usually serve this with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, jalapeno chile, garlic cloves, tomatillo, salt, clam juice, shrimp, cheese, cilantro, lime juice, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in the pan you will use for baking. Step 2: Add the onions and jalapenos, cook for 5 minutes on medium-high heat until the onions begin to brown. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook a minute more. Step 4: Add the tomatillos, reduce heat to medium and cook for 10 minutes, until the tomatillos are cooked through, but still hold their shape. Step 5: Sprinkle salt over the tomatillos as they are cooking If using clam juice, add to the pan, turn up the heat and reduce by half If using water, just add the 1 / 4 cup water without reducing. Step 6: Add the cheese and shrimp. Step 7: Cook in a 425 degree preheated oven for 10 minutes. Step 8: Remove pan from the oven.

Dish Name: Baked Turkey And Jack Cheese Chimichangas Weight Watchers
Ingredient Names: cooking spray, ground turkey breast, fat-free refried beans, salsa, green chili peppers, chili powder, scallions, reduced-fat monterey jack cheese, wheat flour tortillas, nonfat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Coat a large skillet with cooking spray Coat a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Add turkey to skillet and cook over medium-high heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain any excess liquid from pan and then add beans, 1 3 / 4 cups of salsa, chili peppers, chili powder and scallions. Step 4: Cook until heated through, about 3 minutes, stir in cheese. Step 5: Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in foil Warm in oven for 10 minutes Assemble chimichangas by spooning about 1 / 2 cup of turkey mixture onto each tortilla.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, sour cream, salsa, cheddar cheese, cooked turkey, corn kernel, cumin, dried oregano, cayenne, salt and pepper, scallions, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Step 2: In a medium bowl cream together the cream cheese and the sour cream. Step 3: Stir in 1 / 2 cup of the salsa. Step 4: Stir in 1 cup of the grated cheese. Step 5: In a second bowl toss together the turkey, the corn, cumin, cayenne, salt, pepper, and 1 / 2 of the scallions. Step 6: Add the turkey mixture to the cheese mixture and stir to combine. Step 7: In a baking dish spread a 1 / 2 cup of the salsa over the bottom. Step 8: Place about a 1 / 3 cup of the filling on a tortilla, roll up and transfer to the baking dish with the seam side down. Step 9: Repeat process for remaining tortillas. Step 10: Pour remaining salsa over enchiladas, spreading to coat all of them.

Ingredient Names: green pepper, onion, fresh mushrooms, vinaigrette dressing, salsa, cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 In large saute pan over medium heat. Step 2: Saute vegetables in the salad dressing until just cooked. Step 3: Add salsa and heat through. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 cup of the cheese. Step 5: Stir until melted Lay tortillas on flat surface. Step 6: Divide veg mixture among them. Step 7: Fold each into burritos. Step 8: Place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, red bell pepper, zucchini, kosher salt, garlic cloves, cumin, red pepper, pepper, tomato sauce, corn, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute' ground beef, chopped red pepper, onion and garlic in medium skillet, until meat is well browned. Step 2: Add zucchini, salt, cumin & pepper, cook over medium heat 8 minutes. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, crushed red pepper and corn or, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 10-15 minutes or until zucchini is beginning to soften If mixture is too thick, add a little water. Step 4: Top each serving with parmesan cheese or cheddar cheese We like parmesan.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, barbecue sauce, green chilies, tomatoes, red onion, fresh cilantro, garlic clove, red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, fat free tortillas, fat-free refried beans, scallions, reduced-fat monterey jack cheese, light sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, barbecue sauce and chiles in a large, nonstick saucepan, bring to boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until chicken is tender and cooked through, about 25 minutes remove from heat and let cool. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine tomatoes Onion, chopped cilantro, garlic, vinegar, oil, and salt in medium bowl until blended, set aside. Step 4: Preheat oven to 425 degrees Spray a large, nonstick baking sheet with nonstick spray. Step 5: Place tortillas on baking sheet. Step 6: Spread each with the beans, then top with then top with the chicken mixture, scallions, and cheese.

Ingredient Names: dried ancho chiles, dried guajillo chiles, cinnamon, clove, garlic cloves, oregano, salt and pepper, cider vinegar, roma tomato, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the chiles in the oven for 2 minutes or until fragrant being careful not to burn. Step 2: Place the toasted chiles in a sauce pan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Step 3: Boil on medium heat covered for 15 minutes. Step 4: Place the chiles in the blender reserving the water they were inches add in all the other ingredients and blend on high to make a fairly thick paste. Step 5: Add some of the reserved water if needed to thin the sauce out. Step 6: Marinate your choice of meat in this paste for 6-8 hours and then grill the meat or you can pour the paste and reserved water in a large stock pot with the meat. Step 7: Add additional water to cover the meat and slow cook it for 3-4 hours in the pot.

Dish Name: Basic Red Sauce Salsa De Chile Rojo
Ingredient Names: ancho chilies, warm water, onion, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, tomato sauce, dried mexican oregano, cumin seed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Soak chiles in warm water until softened, about 30 minutes, drain. Step 2: Strain and reserve liquid. Step 3: Remove stems and seeds and membranes from the chiles. Step 4: Cook and stir onion and garlic in oil in a 2-qt Saucepan until onion is tender. Step 5: Add chiles and 2 cups of the reserved liquid, the tomato sauce, oregano, cumin and salt. Step 6: Simmer uncovered 20 minutes, cool. Step 7: Transfer to blender container.

Dish Name: Batatas Con Huevos Mexican Comfort Food
Ingredient Names: red potatoes, spinach leaves, eggs, salt and pepper, cheese, tomatoes, jalapeno pepper, onion, cilantro, basil, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f Poke the potatoes all over with a fork and nuke in the microwave for 15 minutes Alternatively, you can bake them in the oven for 1 hour. Step 2: Let cool until you can handle them with your bare hands Trust me on this one, you don't want to be playing hot potato. Step 3: Cut each potato in half Pare off a tiny sliver of what will become the bottom of your potato, so it can stand on its own and not roll around Scoop out the flesh and leave just a small layer of potato around the shell Use the scooped out potato to make mashed potato, or save for another use, but you're not going to need it for this recipe. Step 4: Line the 4 potato shells with the wilted spinach leaves.

Dish Name: Bbq Chicken Rice Burrito Cowboy Crunch Burrito
Ingredient Names: whole wheat tortilla, boneless skinless chicken breast, cajun seasoning, long grain brown rice, fat free ranch dressing, barbecue sauce, tortilla chips, lettuce, cheese, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice as directed on bag, or in rice cooker Coat diced chicken with cajun seasoning. Step 2: Cook chicken over medium heat in a skillet You may saute in butter / margarine or in a light cooking oil or spray, your choice. Step 3: Once chicken is cooked, switch to low heat and add barbecue sauce and ranch dressing. Step 4: Mix until chicken is coated in sauces. Step 5: Once rice has finished cooking, add to skillet with chicken mixture Crush tortilla chips and add on top of chicken and rice. Step 6: Mix all ingredients. Step 7: Serve on warm tortilla with lettuce, tomato, and cheese, if desired.

Ingredient Names: pork, white onion, chilies, panela cheese, red enchilada sauce, colby-monterey jack cheese, olive oil, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat to 375 degrees 2 Sautee your onion in a touch of olive oil 3. Step 2: Mix sauteed onions with green chilis in a small bowl and set aside 4 In same frying pan heat up corn tortillas 5. Step 3: In a 9x11 baking dish, cover the bottom with a small layer of enchilada sauce.

Ingredient Names: cooked brown rice, black beans, picante salsa, onion, garlic cloves, fresh jalapeno peppers, chili powder, ground cumin, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saut the veggies in 2-3 tbs of cooking oil I used grapeseed oil. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients except for the tortillas. Step 3: Bring to boil and reduce heat to simmer. Step 4: Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes or until no longer runny. Step 5: Meanwhile fry your tortillas in oil until soft. Step 6: Fold and lightly sprinkle with salt. Step 7: Place about 1 / 4 cup of bean mixture and top with your choice of toppings: shredded cabbage, cheese, avocado, cilantro, sour cream, etc.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic, olive oil, black beans, tomato sauce, ground cumin, jalapeno chiles, fresh coriander, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, guacamole, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Make the filling: in a large heavy skillet cook the onion and the garlic in the oil over moderately low heat, stirring, until the onion is softened, add the beans, and mash about half of them coarse with the back of a wooden spoon. Step 2: Add the tomato sauce, the cumin, the chilies, and salt and black pepper to taste, simmer the mixture, stirring, for 3 to 5 minutes, or until it is thickened slightly, and stir in the coriander Working with 1 warmed tortilla at a time and keeping the others covered, spread about 3 tablespoons of the filling down the center of each tortilla and roll the tortillas, enclosing the filling but keeping the ends open. Step 3: Arrange the burritos, seam sides down, in one layer in a baking dish, sprinkle them with the monterey jack, and bake them, covered with foil, in the middle of a preheated 350f Oven for 10 minutes. Step 4: Serve the burritos with the guacamole and the salsa Makes 12 burritos, serving 6.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, old el paso mild enchilada sauce, flour tortilla, four-cheese mexican blend cheese, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350. Step 2: Take a flour tortilla and put beans down the center with some cheese on it roll it up put on a plate and pour enchilada sauce on top then top with some more cheese and place in the oven until bubbly I usually do one burrito per plate take it out of the oven and top with onions.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, burrito-size flour tortillas, onion, cheddar cheese, pickled jalapeno pepper, picante salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat beans in microwave microwave or warm tortillas until soft. Step 2: Stuff tortillas with beans and onion, add jalepeno and cheddar or squirt cheese. Step 3: Roll up and microwave until heated thru. Step 4: Serve with chips and small jar of salsa.

Dish Name: Bean Egg And Ham Breakfast Tostada
Ingredient Names: low-fat flour tortillas, egg substitute, cheddar cheese, ham, baked beans, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Scramble egg substitute with ham. Step 2: Place tortillas on broiler pan, top each one with 1 / 2 of the cheese, 1 / 2 of egg / ham mixture, 1 / 2 of baked beans Broil 3 in under broiler until cheese is melted and eggs etc are warm. Step 3: Transfer to serving plate, top with salsa and slice into forths.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, onion, garlic cloves, poblano pepper, chipotle chiles, adobo sauce, beef broth, salt, cumin, chopped tomato, guacamole, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spray pan with non-stick cooking oil. Step 2: Add meat, onions and garlic and saute until brown. Step 3: Stir in broth, chilis, adobo sauce and spices. Step 4: Cook until meat is very tender. Step 5: Remove from broth and finely chop. Step 6: Serve rolled with soft flour tortilla and serve with garnishes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic salt, olive oil, flour, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, chili powder, dried basil, ground cumin, dried coriander, black pepper, cayenne pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef with onion and garlic salt just until pink is gone. Step 2: Remove beef from skillet and set aside In the same skillet heat the oil. Step 3: Add the next 11 ingredients and stir over heat until bubbly and spices have released their fragrance. Step 4: Stir in tomato puree, and stir till well blended. Step 5: Stir in broth and water. Step 6: Bring to a boil and lower heat. Step 7: Taste and adjust seasoning. Step 8: Leave to simmer until slightly thickened. Step 9: Preheat oven to 400.

Ingredient Names: roast, onion soup mix, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, picante sauce, onion, corn tortillas, cheese sauce, salsa, sour cream, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Cook roast in roasting pan, pouring onion soup mix, dissolved in 1 cup water, over it. Step 2: Cook at 325f for 34-38 minutes per pound. Step 3: Let cool thoroughly overnight in fridge Finely chop roast beef and mix with cheddar cheese, garlic and onion powder, salt and pepper, picante sauce and onion in a large bowl Portion 1 / 4 cup mixture onto each corn tortilla in the lower 1 / 3 of the tortilla. Step 4: Roll up tortilla To soften tortillas, microwave between two damp paper towels for a few seconds To freeze for later, simply put seam side down on cookie sheets and freeze Flash freeze on wax papered covered cookie sheets. Step 5: When firm, transfer to ziplock freezer bags.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, seasoning salt, garlic powder, fresh coarse ground black pepper, cumin, chili powder, vegetable oil, beef broth, taco seasoning mix, frank's red hot sauce, butter, flour tortillas, refried beans, tomatoes, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Season each side of roast evenly with seasoning salt, garlic powder, pepper, cumin and chili powder using a 1 / 4 teaspoons each per side. Step 2: Heat pressure cooker with vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: When hot, place roast in carefully Brown each side, this should take about 3-5 minutes per side depending on how hot the pot / oil is Just brown each side nicely is all Not a big deal! Step 4: ) Add beef broth and turn heat down to medium Place on top securely, place on regulator Heat til regulator starts rocking.

Ingredient Names: beef round steak, fajita seasoning mix, onion, green peppers, red bell pepper, beer
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse steaks well with cold water Pat dry with paper towels. Step 2: Season both sides of steak with 1 packet fajita seasoning mix. Step 3: Slice into strips, set aside. Step 4: Place peppers and onions in crock pot. Step 5: Sprinkle second packet of fajita mix on top of vegetables. Step 6: Place steak strips on top of vegetables, pour in beer, cover. Step 7: Cook on low for 8-10 hours.

Ingredient Names: yellow onion, garlic, fresh lime juice, chili powder, ground cumin, ground oregano, dark brown sugar, salt and pepper, beer, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in food processor and whir until it's well mixed. Step 2: Marinate fajita strips for at least 30 minutes, preferably overnight This is a really versatile recipe, and you can easily add or subtract amounts of the ingredients to suit your tastes - experiment and enjoy! Step 3: We've used this marinade on chicken, beef, and buffalo:).

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, tomatoes, onion, butter, mozzarella cheddar blend cheese, fajita seasoning mix, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cilantro salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Fry chicken in a pan coated with cooking spray or olive oil. Step 2: After chicken is cooked, add water and seasoning to the pan Sauce will thicken slightly after a few minutes. Step 3: Set the chicken and sauce aside while preparing the other ingredients Butter one side of all the tortillas and set aside Dice the tomato and the onion, mix and also set aside. Step 4: Place a tortilla, buttered side down, on hot pan or griddle. Step 5: Layer ingredient in the following order on the tortilla: cheese, chicken and sauce, tomato / onion mixture, cheese, salsa. Step 6: Top with another tortilla, buttered side up. Step 7: Once the cheese starts to bubble from the sides of the quesadilla it typically is time to flip it.

Ingredient Names: simple syrup, lemon juice, tequila, ice cube, seltzer water
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare a simple syrup combine equal amounts of sugar and water in a small saucepan. Step 2: Heat until the sugar is fully dissolved and the liquid is clear. Step 3: Cool and store in a clean container You can use this for other recipes so make a batch To prepare the drink, mix the syrup, tequila juice and ice cubes in a large glass and stir. Step 4: Fill the glass to the edge with the seltzer water.

Ingredient Names: pork roast, chicken, corn oil, chili powder, garlic powder, ground cumin, black pepper, salt, masa corn flour, paprika, cumin seeds, broth, corn husks
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and shred pork roast: Start with 1 pork roast. Step 2: Cut the roast into fist size chunks. Step 3: Put the chunks into a pan, and cover with water. Step 4: Boil for about 2 1 / 2 hours or until it becomes really tender. Step 5: After the meat is really tender, take it out of the broth to cool. Step 6: After the roast chunks are cool enough to handle easily, shred them with your fingers Try to remove and discard the fat as you go There is no need to throw a lot of fat into the tamales If you have cooked the roast chunks thoroughly, it will be easy to shred into small pieces with your fingers.

Ingredient Names: pinto beans, white onions, fresh jalapenos, garlic cloves, roma tomatoes, fresh cilantro, ham hocks, chili powder, paprika, black pepper, kosher salt, cumin, bacon drippings, chicken stock, dark beer
Instructions: Step 1: Soak your beans. Step 2: Bring beans to boil in 8-10 cups of water. Step 3: Remove from heat covered. Step 4: Let the beans soak for 30-45 minutes until the beans start to swell from the water infusing into them, strain the beans. Step 5: Bring another 8 cups of water to a boil While beans are boiling, trim the ham hocks of fat. Step 6: Leave fat in large pieces. Step 7: Cut the meat into small bite-size pieces, put all into pot.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, butter, vegetable oil, cinnamon stick, garlic cloves, bay leaves, oregano, kosher salt, black pepper, cumin, red pepper flakes, whole milk, coca-cola classic
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the 2 lbs of pork into roughly 2 inch squares and place in the bottom of the slow cooker. Step 2: Pour the stick of melted butter in the slow cooker coating the meat Do the same with the 2 tbs of oil Break the one cinnamon stick in half and place to the sides of the meat Peel 5-6 garlic cloves, cutting the. Step 3: Place the leaves and the garlic in the slow cooker, evenly distributed among the meat. Step 4: Add the 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp kosher salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 2 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp red pepper flakes, sprinkling evenly across the meat. Step 5: Pour the 1 / 3 cup whole milk in the cooker, being careful not to wash away the spices from the meat. Step 6: Add the coca cola, being careful not to wash away the spices from the meat. Step 7: Add enough to just cover the top of the meat.

Ingredient Names: tequila, orange-flavored liqueur, beer, frozen lemonade concentrate, lemon juice, lime juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients and serve on the rocks with salt, straight up, or frozen if you chose to add all ice and no water.

Ingredient Names: pork roast, orange juice, cumin, garlic powder, salt and pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up your pork roast into 1 to 2 inch chunks and put it in a large pot. Step 2: Add the cup of orange juice and your seasonings. Step 3: Add enough water to just cover the meat. Step 4: Bring it to a simmer and let it simmer uncovered for 2 hours I know you'll be tempted but do not stir or touch the meat during these 2 hours You should have enough water / juice in the pot that by the end of the 2 hours you will be down to about an inch or less of liquid. Step 5: When you get to this point turn the heat up to medium high and chop and stir it around until the liquid evaporates and your pork is a mixture of something between chunks and shredded I like to let it brown up a bit even That's it, you're done! Step 6: The best pork ever and the flavor is simple enough that you can do pretty much anything with the meat.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onions, baked beans, ketchup, chunky salsa, brown sugar, ground cumin, red chili pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Fry bacon in frying pan I cut into bite sized pieces with scissors before frying As bacon fries, chop onions. Step 2: When bacon is finished, remove from pan, drain and wrap in paper towels to absorb grease. Step 3: Saute onions in bacon fat til translucent. Step 4: Pour into strainer, but not necessary to rinse or pat with paper towel For me, straining is enough. Step 5: Pour canned beans into 6 qt crockpot. Step 6: Stir in bacon, onions, ketchup, salsa, brown sugar and cumin, mixing very well, stir often.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, yellow onion, garlic, whole tomatoes, vinegar, jalapeno peppers, serrano peppers, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a blender, blend well and serve Really good on tacos or with chips, and very easy to make.

Dish Name: Big Papa Ed's Quick And Tasty Frijoles
Ingredient Names: bacon, garlic cloves, brown onion, jalapeno pepper, salt, water, canned pinto beans
Instructions: Step 1: 1) in large skillet cook bacon until crispy, then remove and sit aside for later 2)place at meduim high heat and saute onions for about 2 mins 3) add garlic and jalapeno and saute with onions until onion are clear, about another 2 minute reduce heat if needed so not to burn 4)add 40oz can of pinto beans with liquid, water, salt, and bacon. Step 2: Bring to full boil for 1min. Step 3: Then reduce heat to high simmer to reduce liquid. Step 4: Stir every so often Do not cover 5)after about 10 min mash and stir the beans with a wire potato masher to a chunky consistesy. Step 5: Simmer for another 6 min stirring every so often.

Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, onion, bread, sausage, eggs, milk, salt, pepper, marjoram, tomatoes, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Boil chilies& onions until semi-tender and drain Coat 9x9" casserole with olive oil. Step 3: Spread croutons on bottom of casserole. Step 4: Spread chilies, onions and sausage over croutons. Step 5: Mix together well eggs, milk, salt, pepper and marjoram. Step 6: Pour mixture over chilies and croutons. Step 7: Put casserole into preheated oven for 35-45 minutes. Step 8: Remove from oven and place tomato slices and sprinkle cheese on top. Step 9: Then bake again for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Cheese Tortilla Pie
Ingredient Names: pie crusts, oil, onion, green pepper, black beans, salsa, jalapeno peppers, chili powder, cayenne pepper, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the onion and green pepper Seed and mince the jalapeno peppers. Step 2: Drain and rinse the black beans. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add onions and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until tender. Step 5: Add beans, salsa, jalapenos, chili powder, and cayenne. Step 6: Simmer 7-10 minutes. Step 7: Line a 9 or 10 inch pie pan with one of the crusts. Step 8: Spoon about 1 / 2 cup bean mixture into crust. Step 9: Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup shredded cheddar.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, garlic cloves, dried oregano, black beans, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce, kosher salt, chicken broth, asadero cheese, corn tortillas, salsa verde, queso fresco, chili peppers, apple cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Enchiladas. Step 2: Preheat oven to 400o. Step 3: Saute onion in oil in a large nonstick skillet aver medium-high heat for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add garlic and oregano, saute i minute. Step 5: Puree half the beans, the chipotle, the sauce, and salt in a food processor. Step 6: Combine onion mixture, remaining whole beans, broth, and shredded cheese with the bean puree. Step 7: Stir in any add-ins as well Assemble enchiladas frying tortillas in 2 t oil until flexible. Step 8: Dip in 1 cup sauce, fill with a generous 1 / 3 cup filling, and roll up.

Dish Name: Black Bean Patties With Corn Relish And Avocado Cream
Ingredient Names: black beans, roasted red peppers, eggs, oregano, cumin, chipotle chile in adobo, onion, cornmeal, salt and pepper, canola oil, corn kernels, garlic clove, jalapeno, tomatoes, lime
Instructions: Step 1: To make the bean patties: place half of the beans in the bowl of a food processor with 1 coarsely chopped bell pepper, eggs, oregano, cumin and chipotle Process until smooth Finely chop the remaining bell pepper. Step 2: In a large bowl, lightly mash the remaining beans. Step 3: Stir in the bell pepper, onion and smooth bean mixture. Step 4: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 5: Stir in the cornmeal or breadcrumbs, a bit at time, mixing lightly just until the mixture firms up. Step 6: Chill the mixture for 30 minutes While the bean mixture is chilling, make the corn relish. Step 7: Heat the canola oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, canned black beans, fresh cilantro leaves, salt, scallion, chopped tomato, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender Process to desired consistency.

Dish Name: Black Bean Spinach And Mushroom Burritos
Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, mushroom, vegetable oil, fresh spinach, garlic cloves, canned black beans, fresh lemon juice, scallions, monterey jack pepper cheese, cheddar cheese, salt, mild enchilada sauce, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon in heavy skillet, crumble and set aside In bacon oil, cook onion and mushrooms over moderate heat, stirring, until golden. Step 2: Add spinach and garlic and cook, until wilted. Step 3: Stir in water, beans, lemon juice, scallions, pepper jack cheese, cheddar cheese, bacon and salt to taste. Step 4: Cook, stirring until cheese is melted. Step 5: Heat tortillas in oven at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Step 6: Place a few tablespoons of filling in center of burrito, fold sides and roll. Step 7: Place 1 / 2 enchilada sauce in bottom of a glass pan. Step 8: Place rolled burritos in pan and place 1 / 2 enchilada sauce over them. Step 9: Cook for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, green pepper, ground turkey, black beans, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, cornmeal, sugar, salt, milk, egg, canned corn, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, saute onions and green pepper in oil. Step 2: Add ground turkey and continue cooking until turkey is cooked through. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in beans, tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Step 4: In a med bowl, combine cornmeal, sugar and salt. Step 5: Stir milk, egg and oil into cornmeal mixture until moistened. Step 6: Then, stir in corn. Step 7: Grease 9" pie pan and press cornmeal into the bottom and sides. Step 8: Spoon turkey and bean mixture into crust. Step 9: Bake at 350 for about 25 minute. Step 10: Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 3-5 more minute.

Ingredient Names: onion, green pepper, ground cumin, pepper, olive oil, garlic cloves, black beans, vegetable broth, frozen corn, green onions, flour tortillas, reduced-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saute the onion, green pepper, cumin and pepper in oil until vegetables are tender, add garlic. Step 2: Cook 1 minute longer. Step 3: Add beans and broth, bring to a boil. Step 4: Cook until liquid is reduced to about 1 / 3 cup. Step 5: Stir in corn and green onions. Step 6: Remove from the heat. Step 7: Place one tortilla in a 9-in Springform pan coated with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, black beans, water, smoked ham hock, bay leaves, parsley, salt, ground cumin, ground black pepper, smoked ham, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium heat, in a heavy kettle or dutch oven, saut onions in oil till soft and transparent. Step 2: Add garlic and saut till fragrant and lightly browned. Step 3: Add more oil as necessary. Step 4: Add water, beans, ham hock bay leaves, parsley, salt and cumin. Step 5: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat Skim surface as required. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered for about two hours, or until several beans test tender. Step 7: Remove ham hock from beans If beans are still watery you can continue to simmer or use an immersion blender or the back of a large spoon to puree some of the beans Dice optional meat and put into beans.

Dish Name: Black Beans Prepared In A Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: smoked ham hocks, dried black beans, water, onion, garlic clove, ground cumin, salt, black pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the dried black beans in cold water and drain. Step 2: Place the dried beans in a five quart slow cooker. Step 3: Cover the beans with all the ingredients. Step 4: Cook on low 10-12 hours. Step 5: Stir and check occasionally to make sure the beans are not getting dry, add water if necessary. Step 6: When the beans are soft it is done. Step 7: Garnish with additional cilantro if you like you can also season it to taste.

Dish Name: Black Beans With Cumin And Garlic
Ingredient Names: black beans, garlic, ground cumin, olive oil, chicken broth, sea salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Drain and rinse black beans. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat and saute garlic and cumin until fragrant. Step 3: Add black beans, broth and salt. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium-low, stirring frequently until beans are heated through Or, after sauteeing the garlic and cumin, you can place everything in a crockpot on low heat for a couple of hours If desired, stir in the cilantro just prior to serving.

Dish Name: Black Eyed Pea And Mexican Chorizo Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chorizo sausage, onion, garlic cloves, diced fire-roasted tomatoes, canned chipotle chile, ground cumin, oregano, ground allspice, black-eyed peas, cilantro, cheese, tortilla chips, lime juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: On medium-low, heat the oil in a skillet and add the chorizo. Step 2: Cook for 10 minutes or until browned, breaking up any large pieces With a slotted spatula, remove the cooked chorizo from the skillet and place in a large pot Leaving the oil in the skillet, add the onions and cook on medium-low heat until translucent, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook for 30 more seconds. Step 4: Transfer the onions and garlic to a blender and add the tomatoes, chipotle chiles, cumin, oregano and allspice. Step 5: Blend until smooth and pour the blender contents into the pot that holds the chorizo. Step 6: Add to the pot the black-eyed peas and their liquid, the chicken broth and the cilantro. Step 7: Bring the pot to a boil and then turn down the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Step 8: Add the shredded cheese and while occasionally stirring, continue to cook until the cheese has melted, about 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Black bean tostadas with avocado salsa
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, olive oil, onions, garlic, smoked paprika, ground cumin, cider vinegar, clear honey, black beans, choose toppings tomatoes, creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Brush the tortillas with a little of the oil and place in a single layer on baking sheets. Cook for 8 mins until crisp. Step 2: In a large frying pan, heat the remaining oil. Add the onion and garlic, and cook for 5 mins. Add the spices, vinegar and honey. Cook for 2 mins more. Add the beans and seasoning, and heat through. Step 3: Remove from the heat and mash the beans gently with the back of your spoon to a chunky purée. Spread some beans over the crispy corn tortillas, scatter with your choice of toppings and add a spoonful of crème fraîche to cool down, or a splash of chipotle Tabasco to spice it up.

Ingredient Names: sweet onion, jalapeno pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, fresh cilantro, orange juice, extra virgin olive oil, fresh strawberries, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender or food processor, briefly process onion, jalapeo, bell peppers, cilantro, orange juice and olive oil. Step 2: Transfer to serving bowl and add sliced strawberries. Step 3: Season to taste with salt and pepper Can make up to four hours ahead.

Ingredient Names: tequila, orange liqueur, limes, lemon, agave nectar, orange juice, ice cube
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine all ingredients except ice. Step 2: Add enough ice to come to the top of the liquid. Step 3: Blend on high until smooth If desired, serve in a salt-rimmed margarita glass or garnished with a lime wedge. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: white tequila, tomato juice, lemon juice, tabasco sauce, worcestershire sauce, celery salt
Instructions: Step 1: Shake above ingredients with ice and strain over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass Garnish with lemon, jalapeno, or a traditional stalk of celery.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, fresh tomatoes, bacon, mayonnaise, pepper, flour tortillas
