Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first five ingredients and mix well. Step 2: Spoon down the center of each tortilla, then fold the ends and side over the filling and roll up. Step 3: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: tequila, blue curacao, lime juice, prepared sweet-and-sour mix, pineapple juice, ice, lime wedge, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Rub rim of margarita glass with lime wedge and dip in granulated sugar Process tequila, blue curacao, lime juice, sweet and sour mix, pineapple juice, and ice in blender until smooth. Step 2: Pour into margarita glass. Step 3: Garnish with lime wedge or a cherry, if desired.

Ingredient Names: cilantro leaf, lime juice, low sodium chicken broth, scallions, garlic cloves, jalapeno, honey, kosher salt, boneless skinless chicken breasts, red onion, bell peppers, avocado, olive oil, ground cumin, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Put the cilantro, lime juice, broth, scallions, garlic, jalapeno, honey, and salt in a blender, puree until smooth Reserve 2 tablespoons Do not wash out the blender. Step 2: Put chicken breasts in a medium bowl and the peppers and onions in another. Step 3: Divide the remaining cilantro puree evenly between the chicken and the peppers and onions. Step 4: Toss well to coat the chicken and vegetables and let stand, at room temperature, for 30 minutes 2. Step 5: Add the avocado, 1 / 2 cup water, and the reserved 2 tablespoons cilantro sauce to the blender. Step 6: Puree until smooth and season with salt.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, jalapeno, cilantro, tequila, garlic cloves, peach, onion, lime, salt, sugar, tomatillos, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Remove husks from tomatillos and cut into halves. Step 2: Place the tomatillos, green chilis and onions cut side down on a foil-lined baking sheet. Step 3: Place vegetables under a broiler for 5-7 minutes or until skins are lightly blackened. Step 4: Remove from oven and cool. Step 5: Remove the outside skin from the tomatillas like you would a tomato. Step 6: Place the tomatillos, onions, green chilis, jalapeno, and garlic into a food processor and pulse 4-5 times. Step 7: Add remaining ingredients and pulse until desired consistency. Step 8: Chill in refrigerator to allow the flavors to meld. Step 9: Serve with tortilla chips of your choice.

Ingredient Names: arbol chile, roma tomatoes, red onion, chipotle chiles, adobo sauce, salt, cumin, water, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place all of the ingredients except for the oil in a large sauce pan. Step 2: Bring to a boil and cook uncovered for 15 minutes. Step 3: Pour the ingredients in a blender and blend on high for 5 minutes or when all of the chiles are completely pureed. Step 4: Heat the oil on medium heat in the sauce pan you were using. Step 5: Pour the chile back into the sauce pan and cook stirring occasionally for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tequila, lime juice, lemon juice, cola
Instructions: Step 1: Add tequila & juices to a glass with ice, top up with cola & garnish with a wedge of lime if desired.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, heavy cream, hot pepper sauce, salt, pepper, diced green chilies, chorizo sausage, muenster cheese, fresh cilantro, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350f Have ready a buttered 8-inch quiche pan. Step 2: Beat the eggs in a bowl with cream, hot pepper sauce, salt and pepper. Step 3: Mix in the remaining ingredients and pour into the quiche pan. Step 4: Bake 40 minutes, or until golden brown on top. Step 5: Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: pinto beans, garlic, onion, cilantro, tomatoes, cumin, oregano, chili powder, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan Bring to a boil Simmer for 30-45 minutes, adding water if mixture gets too thick.

Ingredient Names: dry pinto beans, bacon, seasoning, cilantro, diced tomatoes, beer
Instructions: Step 1: Cook bacon, drain on paper towels and chop when cooled. Step 2: Cook beans according to instructions on package. Step 3: After 1 and 1 / 2 hours of cooking beans, add bacon, bean seasonings, cilantro, tomatoes and beer. Step 4: Cover and continue to cook for an additional 30 minutes or until beans are tender. Step 5: Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight You can add fresh jalapeno at the same time you add the tomatoes for an extra kick! Step 6: I use texas spice company bean seasoning and it is sold only at all heb grocery stores.

Ingredient Names: dried pinto bean, water, dark beer, garlic cloves, kosher salt, onion powder, chili powder, cumin, mexican oregano, jalapeno peppers, bacon, onion, roma tomatoes, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Sort through the beans, looking for small rocks and debris. Step 2: Place in large bowl and rinse several times. Step 3: Remove beans by hand into a clean bowl of water. Step 4: Fill the bowl with the newly rinsed beans with water and soak beans overnight. Step 5: Drain off soaking water. Step 6: In a large soup pot, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil and add beans and dark beer. Step 7: Add garlic, kosher salt, onion powder and chili powder to beans and beer. Step 8: Lower the heat to simmer, cover pan and cook about 2 hours, or until beans are tender. Step 9: When the beans are light brown and soft, add the cumin, mexican oregano and jalapeno peppers. Step 10: In a skillet over medium-high heat, fry bacon pieces and onions until bacon is crisp.

Dish Name: Bourbon Mango Pulled Pork For The Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: mangoes, pork shoulder, ground black pepper, kosher salt, dried chipotle powder, balsamic vinegar, water, honey, bourbon, barbecue sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Peel mangoes and remove pits. Step 2: Place pits into a slow cooker, roughly chop the mango and set aside. Step 3: Place the pork shoulder in the slow cooker and season with salt and pepper and chipotle powder. Step 4: Pour in balsamic vinegar and water. Step 5: Cover and cook on low 5-8 hours until the meat is very tender. Step 6: When done, drain the pork, discard the cooking liquid and pits and shred with two forks Sauce: puree the chopped mango in a blender until smooth, then pour into a saucepan along with the honey, 1 tsp chipotle powder and bourbon, bring to a simmer. Step 7: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring frequently until the mango has reduced and darkened slightly, about 10 minutes. Step 8: Stir in the barbecue sauce and remove from the heat.

Dish Name: Braised Pork With Green Chile Sauce Of Chile Verde
Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, green bell peppers, green chilies, dried oregano leaves, ground cumin, salt, fresh cilantro, wine vinegar, water, tomatoes, cooked rice, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Trim and discard fat and cut pork in 1-inch cubes. Step 2: In a large frying pan, heat oil over mediun-high heat. Step 3: Add meat a few cubes at a time and cook until very brown Push meat to side of pan and add onion, garlic and bell peppers, saute until limp. Step 4: Stir in chiles, oregano, cumin, salt, cilantro, vinegar, and water. Step 5: Cover and simmer until meat is fork tender Skim off fat & discard. Step 6: Serve with rice or make burritos or serve in your favorite way.

Ingredient Names: bratwursts, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, iceberg lettuce, onion, tomatoes, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Grill brats over warm coals until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes Warm tortillas briefly in the microwave, until softened On flour tortilla, place a cooked brat, some of the cheese, lettuce, onion, and tomato, top with salsa, serve at once.

Dish Name: Breaded Cube Steaks A La Portuguese
Ingredient Names: rib eye steaks, seasoned flour, egg, fine breadcrumbs, cooking oil, ham, cheese, butter, onions, green olives, tomato sauce, jalapeno peppers, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Dredge steak with seasoned flour. Step 2: Place 1 slice ham and 1 slice cheese on each lengthwise half of steak. Step 3: Fold steak in half and secure with toothpicks Moisten steak in beaten egg and then coat both sides with Fine bread or cracker crumbs. Step 4: Fry in hot oil until browned on both sides. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and leave a couple of minutes more to make sure it's cooked inside For sauce: Melt butter in skillet Sautee chopped onion and sliced olives.

Ingredient Names: smoked beef sausage, eggs, potatoes, onion, bell pepper, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, flour tortillas, green chili sauce, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pan fry the diced potatoes, salt, pepper and garlic powder in a little shortening, vegetable oil or rendered bacon fat until browned and nearly done. Step 2: Add onions and peppers and continue to cook until potatoes are done and onions and peppers are tender. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in the meat and scrambled eggs. Step 4: Cut the tortillas in half Lay them in a 9 x 13 rectangular pan, placing the cut edges square to the side of the pan, over lapping as needed. Step 5: Spread a 1 / 3 of the meat, potato and egg mixture on top of tortillas. Step 6: Pour 1 / 2 cup of the sauce over the meat, potatoes and egg. Step 7: Sprinkle on 1 / 2 cup of the cheese. Step 8: Repeat layer once more. Step 9: Add one more layer by adding tortillas and meat, potatoes and egg.

Ingredient Names: frozen southern style hash brown potatoes, eggs, half-and-half cream, salt and pepper, onion, green pepper, bulk pork sausage, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large skillet, fry hash browns according to package directions. Step 3: Remove and set aside. Step 4: In a large bowl beat eggs with milk. Step 5: Add chopped onion and green pepper, then season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Pour the mixture into the same skillet. Step 7: Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until eggs are set, remove from heat. Step 8: Add the cooked hash browns and sausage, mix gently.

Ingredient Names: bacon, reduced-fat sausage, home fries, green chilies, eggs, flour tortillas, cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and drain the bacon and sausage Crumble the bacon, set aside. Step 2: Leave a small amount of grease in the pan, and cook the potatoes Be sure the potatoes are comepltely cooked, and properly browned--the texture is funny if you don't. Step 3: Combine eggs and green chilies. Step 4: Add the eggs and green chilies to the potatoes, and stir. Step 5: When eggs are almost done, add the meats, and continue to cook, until eggs are no longer shiny. Step 6: Add cheese, and remove from heat, stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: hash browns, eggs, salsa, bacon, ham, green chilies, cheddar cheese, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together in a very large bowl. Step 2: Roll up in tortillas. Step 3: Wrap each one individually in plastic wrap, then store in a gallon-size freezer bag. Step 4: When you're ready to eat one, just microwave it for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Breakfast Burritos Once A Month Cooking
Ingredient Names: eggs, bulk sausage, chunky salsa, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, green pepper, potatoes, jalapeno, green chilies, garlic clove, onion, tomatoes, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Scramble eggs in large skillet until done. Step 2: Stir in cooked sausage and salsa Warm tortillas in microwave 20-30 seconds or until warm and flexible. Step 3: Place 1 / 2 cup egg mixture into tortilla. Step 4: Roll burrito-style Freeze burritos in single layer on lightly greased cookie sheet. Step 5: When fully frozen, wrap burritos individually. Step 6: Place wrapped burritos in large zip-top freezer bags Freeze To serve: unwrap burritos from foil or plastic wrap that you used for freezing.

Ingredient Names: hot pork sausage, butter, green onions, fresh cilantro, eggs, salt, pepper, cheese sauce, flour tortillas, jalapeno jack cheese, all-purpose flour, milk, cheddar cheese, green chilies, grape tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Enchiladas: cook sausage in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, stirring until sausage crumbles and is no longer pink, remove from pan. Step 2: Drain well, pressing between paper towels. Step 3: Melt butter in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add green onions and cilantro, and saute one minute. Step 5: Add eggs, salt, and pepper. Step 6: Cook, without stirring, until eggs begin to set on bottom Draw a spatula across bottom of pan to form large curds Continue to cook until eggs are thickened, but still moist Do not stir constantly.

Ingredient Names: country sausage, mild chiles, eggs, salt, pepper, sharp cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, piece off and brown sausage, after cooked, do not drain, pull sausage to the sides of pan so that their is an opening circle in the middle, add tsp of butter if you'd like, and put the beaten eggs into the circle and gently fold the sausage into the eggs as the eggs cook. Step 2: Add chilles or jalpenos, cheddar cheese to your liking and salt and pepper to taste 2. Step 3: Take a flour tortilla and with your hand, rinse a little water onto one side and place it in microwave oven for 18 sec And take out. Step 4: Put onto plate, spoon mixture on to the shell and spoon on salsa 3. Step 5: Roll tortilla shell away from you once to cover the mixture then fold in the sides and contiure rolling until you have your rolled burrito.

Ingredient Names: eggs, tabasco sauce, tabasco jalapeno sauce, parmesan cheese, flour tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: In a small mixing bowl, combine eggs and tabasco sauce. Step 2: Add the eggs to a non-stick pan and cook to desired doneness. Step 3: Set aside Lightly grill or heat in a skillet one flour tortilla. Step 4: Spread half of parmesan cheese on grilled tortilla. Step 5: Place scrambled eggs on cheese and sprinkle with remaining cheese on egg. Step 6: Top with the second tortilla and carefully flip the entire quesadilla and cook on the other side until cheese begins to melt. Step 7: Sprinkle with tabasco green sauce and serve.

Ingredient Names: eggs, flour tortillas, cheese, salsa, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Set out bowls containing the fillings, cheese, salsa and cilantro Each person builds their own taco by placing the fillings of their choice in the center of the tortilla, and topping it with cheese, salsa and a little cilantro. Step 2: Fold the taco and eat as is, or if you prefer, fold the filled tortilla and spread some butter on the top half of the folded tortilla and place under the broiler a few minutes to"crisp" the top a bit and melt the cheese inside One of my favorites is scrambled eggs, bacon, cheese, salsa and cilantro Potato, egg and cheese with salsa tacos are popular in my household, too.

Dish Name: Breakfast Wrap Chimichanga Made Your Way
Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, diced onion, sliced mushrooms, red bell pepper, ham, eggs, salt and pepper, flour tortillas, cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium high heat. Step 2: Add onion, mushroom, and bell pepper and saut until softened. Step 3: Add ham, toss and saut until heated throughout. Step 4: Add beaten eggs to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook until just set. Step 6: Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Step 7: Transfer egg mixture to the center of the tortilla, top with cheese. Step 8: Fold in sides, then fold forward tightly to seal. Step 9: Place in a deep fat fryer or skillet and fry in hot oil heated to 350f.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, cumin, tomato sauce, pickled hot peppers, jalapenos, red onion, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese, margarine
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet brown lean ground beef until no longer pink. Step 2: Add tomato sauce, cumin, hot peppers, jalapeos, onion and cook over medium high heat for 5 minutes Butter the flour tortillas 1 at a time. Step 3: Add 1 tortilla to skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Add the ground beef mixture and the pepper jack cheese. Step 5: Fold tortilla and brown both sides of quesadilla until brown. Step 6: Repeat with all 4 flour tortillas until done. Step 7: Serve with tortilla chips and salsa or guacamole.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, fresh broccoli, monterey jack cheese, tomatoes, onion, jalapeno, tomato sauce, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap tortillas tightly in aluminum foil. Step 2: Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes. Step 3: Combine broccoli, cheese, tomato, jalapenos if you want, and onion. Step 4: Spoon mixture evenly in center of each tortilla. Step 5: Roll up each tortilla. Step 6: Place seam side down in a lightly greased 12x8 2-inch baking dish. Step 7: Top with tomato sauce or other tomato variant. Step 8: Cover dish, and bake at 350 degrees f For 45 minutes. Step 9: Spread sour cream over top.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, cumin seed, olive oil, red onion, garlic clove, cider vinegar, salt, fresh ground pepper, unsalted butter
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large skillet or wide deep saucepan of water to a boil. Step 2: Add the broccoli and cook, uncovered, until crisp-tender and still bright green, 6 to 7 minutes While the broccoli is cooking, heat a skillet and toast cumin seeds for 1 to 2 minutes or until very fragrant. Step 3: Remove from heat and crush or grind in a spice grinder. Step 4: Heat the oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Add the onion and garlic, cook while stirring, until the onion is limp, about 4 minutes. Step 6: Add the remaining ingredients, including the cumin, and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Drain broccoli well and transfer to a serving platter or shallow bowl. Step 8: Spoon onions on top, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, hamburger, onion, cumin, chili powder, mexican oregano, ground coriander, garlic powder, salt and pepper, cheddar cheese, red enchilada sauce, sliced ripe olives, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Grate cheddar cheese and set aside in covered container in refrigerator for later use Pre-measure spices and enchilada sauce for later use Dice onion and set aside Brown hamburger without spices yet, plain and the diced onion together until done through and onion translucent. Step 2: Drain off excess hamburger fat but leave hamburger mixture in skillet over low heat. Step 3: Add mexican spices to hamburger mixture (cumin, chili powder, oregano, coriander, garlic salt and pepper and add about a quarter to a half cup of water to hamburger mixture with spices in it. Step 4: Stir around and cover, heating over low simmer for ten minutes This lets spices steam into the hamburger mixture. Step 5: Remove hamburger from heat and set aide for cooling and later use in enchilada filling. Step 6: Heat canned enchilada sauce in a large saucepan but dont boil.

Ingredient Names: buffalo, salt, fresh ground pepper, vegetable oil, butter, yellow onions, garlic, mild green chilies, ground cumin, dried ancho chile powder, salsa verde, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meat into 1 / 2-inch cubes. Step 2: Season cubes with salt and pepper. Step 3: In a large, heavy pan with lid, brown the cubes well in oil and melted butter. Step 4: Add the onion and garlic and saute for about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients, cover, and simmer for at least 90 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 6: Add more water during cooking if necessary to achieve desired sauce texture.

Ingredient Names: dried onion, chili powder, salt, cornstarch, dried garlic, cumin, red pepper flakes, beef bouillon granules, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the ingredients. Step 2: Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place for up to 1 year. Step 3: Add 2 tablespoons to 1 lb cooked and drained beef and 1 / 3-1 / 2 cup water and cook until done.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, flour, chicken broth, tomato sauce, garlic salt, green chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, beat butter and saute onion. Step 2: Blend in flour Gradually add broth, stirring to keep smooth. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, garlic salt and chili. Step 4: Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Step 5: Spoon over your favorite burrito.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, white onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, cumin, jalapenos, long-grain rice, beef broth, garlic powder, salt, refried beans, flour tortillas, jalapeno, sour cream, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Saute diced onions over medium-high heat until soft, add meat. Step 2: Cook meat until nearly done, add minced garlic and turn down the heat to medium-low. Step 3: When all the meat is cooked add half of the can of jalapenos including all of the reserved liquid. Step 4: Cook rice according instructions on the bag except where it calls for water add broth instead. Step 5: Heat up the beans on the stove or in the microwave. Step 6: Place hot beans into a serving bowl, cover and keep warm. Step 7: Wrap all tortillas tightly in between two sheets of aluminum foil, place in oven and turn oven on to 350f. Step 8: Once tortillas are warm the rice should also be done. Step 9: Add spices into the rice and mix gently together. Step 10: Place a little meat, beans, rice and your choice of toppings into each tortilla.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, rice, black beans, sirloin steaks, taco seasoning, shredded cheddar cheese, salsa, sour cream, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare: if making steak or chicken, marinate meat in a ziplock bag overnight in the refrigerator Follow the directions on the packet. Step 2: Cook rice - i use parboiled rice which takes 20 minutes to prepare Follow directions on the bag While rice is cooking, warm up canned beans If using steak or chicken, cut up steak or chicken into bite size pieces or strips While rice and beans are cooking, cook the meat If using ground beef, follow the directions on the taco seasoning packet If cooking steak or chicken, put the steak or chicken in a cast iron skillet and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes or until cooked Assemble: heat wraps in microwave until warm.

Dish Name: Cabrito Barbacoa With Mango Salsa Tex Mex
Ingredient Names: goat meat, water, garlic cloves, jalapenos, onion, mango, fresh cilantro, scotch bonnet peppers, vinegar, sugar, flour, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Trim excess fat off goat roast. Step 2: Place in pressure cooker with water, garlic, jalapenos, and onions Pressure cook for 1 1 / 2 hours till fork tender. Step 3: Remove from cooker, remove excess fat, and shred with fork. Step 4: Keep warm Peel and chop mango. Step 5: Combine mango with onion, cilantro, scotch bonnet, vinegar, and sugar. Step 6: Leave at room temperature till ready to serve For the tortillas: combine flour, salt, and oil, mix till crumbly.

Ingredient Names: goat meat, onion, cumin, red chili powder, flour, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown cabrito in a large pot, use a little oil if it sticks. Step 2: Add salt and pepper and enough water to cover and cook until about half done. Step 3: Add chili powder, onion and comino seed to the mixture. Step 4: When completely done and tender, mix flour in a bit of water to make a paste. Step 5: Stir into pot with cabrito mixture to make a gravy.

Ingredient Names: steaks, eggs, water, unbleached flour, vegetable oil, milk, instant chicken bouillon, jalapeno seasoning salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add the jalapeno seasoning salt to the flour and mix well. Step 2: Dip each steak into the seasoned flour, then dip into the egg wash,, and dip the meat back into the seasoned flour, coating each steak well. Step 3: Heat the vegetable oil to about 350 degrees f. Step 4: In a large skillet Oil should be deep enough to cover the steaks. Step 5: Fry the coated steaks until golden brown, then drain them on paper towels and put on a heated platter that is tented with foil. Step 6: Pour off all but 2 tbls of the oil and the drippings. Step 7: Add 3 tbls of the leftover seasoned flour. Step 8: Mix well and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the oil and flour are golden brown. Step 9: Remove from the heat and add the milk and chicken bouillon or chicken base.

Ingredient Names: water, ground coffee, brown sugar, cinnamon sticks, cloves, semisweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water in a saucepan, then add cinnamon, cloves, sugar and chocolate. Step 2: When the mixture comes to a boil, skim off foam. Step 3: Reduce the heat to a simmer, then add coffee Steep for 5 minutes then serve.

Ingredient Names: water, dark brown sugar, baking chocolate, whole cloves, cinnamon stick, regular grind coffee, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water, brown sugar, chocolate, cloves, and cinnamon to boiling in 3-quart saucepan, reduce heat. Step 2: Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stir in coffee, remove from heat. Step 3: Cover and let stand 5 minutes, stir in vanilla. Step 4: Strain coffee through 4 thicknesses of cheesecloth.

Ingredient Names: white tequila, coffee liqueur, brewed coffee, cinnamon, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a small heatproof snifter, combine the tequila, coffee liqueur and hot coffee. Step 2: Stir in 4 teaspoons of the cinnamon sugar and top with the heavy cream. Step 3: Garnish with a little of the remaining cinnamon sugar.

Ingredient Names: black beans, diced green chilies, green enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for 2 hours Serve on cafe rio pork.

Ingredient Names: pork loin roast, salsa, brown sugar, ketchup, barbecue sauce, chili seasoning mix, beef broth
Instructions: Step 1: Spray crock pot, add pork roast. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients and pour over top. Step 3: Cook in crock-pot on low for 10 hours Can add more beef broth if needed Shred with fork.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, salsa, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Roast in crock pot for 5-6 hours Shred meat Cook one more hour Serve with cafe rio beans, rice, and tomatillo dressing.

Dish Name: Cafe Rio Tomatillo Salad Dressing Copycat
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, sour cream, cilantro, tomatillos, green onions, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, lime, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth Dressing last 2 weeks in frig.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, new mexico chile powder, ground cumin, mexican oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, cocoa powder, ground cinnamon, ground cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients and mix well Cal's mexican seasoning blend is not intended to be spicy hot. Step 2: Add cayenne to increase the temperature as desired You can store this seasoning blend in a dry, sealed container for up to three months, in the freezer for up to a year.

Ingredient Names: shortening, pork chops, serrano chilies, onion, comino, garlic, flour, squash, whole kernel corn, rotel diced tomatoes, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat shortening in dutch oven. Step 2: Fry pork cubes in batches until browned. Step 3: Return all pork to pan. Step 4: Place chilies and onion in food processor container and process until chopped. Step 5: Slice garlic and place with cominos and salt in a mortar and pestle and grind together. Step 6: Add all vegetables to pan with pork and cook over high heat until onion is transparent. Step 7: Sprinkle flour over pork and vegetables and stir to combine. Step 8: Cook a few minutes to remove the raw taste of the flour. Step 9: Add all remaining ingredients plus about 1 tomato can of water--enough so that pork and vegetables are not quite covered with liquid. Step 10: Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cover with a lid.

Ingredient Names: butter, round steaks, zucchini, corn, green chilies, garlic cloves, salt, oregano, ground cumin, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large skillet. Step 2: Add steak cubes, a few at a time and remove to a bowl as they brown. Step 3: Saute zucchini until slightly tender, about ten minutes. Step 4: Return meat to skillet. Step 5: Add corn, chilies, garlic, salt, oregano and cumin. Step 6: Cook, stirring occasionally until meat is tender, about ten minutes, add cheese. Step 7: Stir until blended, serve while hot.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, garlic, chili powder, tomato sauce, sugar, kosher salt, black olives, diced green chilies, corn tortillas, small curd cottage cheese, egg, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Grease a 3qt casserole dish. Step 3: Set aside In large skillet, saute beef with onion and garlic over medium heat and drain. Step 4: Sprinkle chili powder over meat and mix well. Step 5: Add tomato sauce, sugar, salt, olives, and green chiles. Step 6: Simmer over very low heat for 15 minutes. Step 7: Beat cottage cheese and egg together until blended In bottom of 3qt casserole dish, spread 1 / 3 of meat. Step 8: Layer with half of jack cheese, half cottage cheese& egg, half tortillas, then next 3rd of meat.

Ingredient Names: jumbo shrimp, butter, onion, fresh cilantro, chipotle chile in adobo, tequila, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the shrimp, chop onion finely. Step 2: Wash the cilantro in several changes of water, dry it by squeezing it in a towel, and then chop in finely. Step 3: Mash the chiptole chile. Step 4: Heat a saute pan or frying pan over a high flame. Step 5: Add butter, onions and chipotle chile. Step 6: Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Step 7: When pan begins to sizzle, add the shrimp. Step 8: Stir fry until shrimp are almost cooked, approximately 3 minutes. Step 9: Remove the pan from the heat, add the tequila and return it to the flame.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, campbell's cheddar cheese soup, salsa, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Cook chicken until no longer pink, add soup and salsa and heat through. Step 3: Spread about 1 / 3 cup soup mixture on half of each tortilla to within 1 / 2" of edge Moisten edge with water. Step 4: Fold over and seal. Step 5: Place on 2 baking sheets. Step 6: Bake 5 minute or until hot.

Dish Name: Candlelight Inn Guacamole A Work In Progress
Ingredient Names: avocados, vegetable oil, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Mush all ingredients with a fork until silky smooth Write me an email if you know the real recipe:).

Ingredient Names: black beans, crushed pineapple, caribbean jerk marinade, green onion, brown sugar, fresh lime juice, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart shallow casserole dish Bake at 375 degrees, uncovered until dish is heated through.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, fresh pineapple, white onion, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh lime juice, jalapeno, sugar, kosher salt, chili powder, brown sugar, black pepper, olive oil, pork tenderloin, kielbasa, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch tomatillos in boiling water for 5 minutes or until they begin to soften. Step 2: Remove husk, drain and rinse in cold water Pulse tomatillos with pineapple, onion, cilantro, lime juice, jalapeno, sugar, and salt in a processor or blender until finely chopped, cover and chill, blend spices. Step 3: Toss trimmed pork with spice mixture. Step 4: Heat oil in a large saute pan over medium-high heat. Step 5: Saute pork for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Stir in kielbasa and garlic. Step 7: Saute an additional 5 minutes or until kielbasa begins to brown, stirring to keep the garlic from burning.

Dish Name: Caribbean Pork With Avocado Pineapple Salsa
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, olive oil, pineapple in juice, scallions, avocado, light brown sugar, coarse salt, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, ground allspice, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare spice rub first by combining the brown sugar, coarse salt, cinamon, cumin, pepper and allspice. Step 2: Preheat broiler with rack 4 inches from heat. Step 3: Line a broiler pan with aluminum foil and place pork on pan, rub all over with oil Rub the spice mixture all over the pork, coating it evenly Broil, turning occasionally, about 15-20 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, make the avocado-pineapple salsa by draining the juice from the pineapple into a small bowl Finely chop pineapple and add to the bowl of juice along with the scallions and avocado. Step 5: Season with a little salt and pepper, toss gently to combine. Step 6: When pork is finished, slice thinly and serve with the salsa To save the salsa as leftovers, line the bowl with plastic wrap, putting the wrap down into the bowl and directly over the salsa.

Ingredient Names: pork ribs, salt, garlic, whole leaf oregano, blended red chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle meat with salt. Step 2: Add garlic and oregano to blended chili. Step 3: Pour over meat and marinate in refrigerator 6-8 hours or overnight. Step 4: Cook slowly on top of stove or in 350 oven until meat is done, about 1 hour Thick slices of potatoes may be marinated with the meat.

Dish Name: Carne Adovada Red Chile And Pork Stew
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic cloves, flour, salt, ground cumin, fresh ground black pepper, boneless pork shoulder, dried new mexico chile, reduced-sodium chicken broth, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large, heavy-bottomed, ovenproof pot over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onions and garlic and cook, stirring, until onions are golden, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and transfer onions and garlic to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Step 5: In a large bowl, stir together flour, salt, cumin, and pepper. Step 6: Add pork and toss to coat. Step 7: Return pot to medium-high heat, add remaining 1 tablespoons oil, and, working in batches, lightly brown meat on all sides, 5 to 7 minutes per batch. Step 8: Transfer meat to a separate bowl as you go. Step 9: Return onions and garlic to pot. Step 10: Sprinkle with ground chiles and cook, stirring, 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, unsweetened cocoa powder, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients together and generously apply to the meat before grilling.

Ingredient Names: round steaks, garlic salt, black pepper, oil, parsley, rolls, mayonnaise, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the steak into small bite size pieces. Step 2: Add the parsley, garlic salt, and pepper and coat evenly. Step 3: Heat frying pan on high till hot. Step 4: Heat oil for a few seconds and immediately add meat in center of pan and quickly spread meat to one layer. Step 5: Once oil has dissipated and the meat has browned, add a tablespoon of water to pan and quickly scrap pan to coat the meat. Step 6: Set aside once water has evaporated. Step 7: Spread mayonnaise on bolillo rolls and heat mayonnaise side down on pan until toasty golden brown. Step 8: Serve with refried beans, carne asada, shredded lettuce, guacamole and pico de gallo on roll.

Dish Name: Carne Gisada Con Papas Meat Potatoes
Ingredient Names: round steaks, potatoes, tomato sauce, salt, pepper, cumin, garlic, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut round steak into cubes and brown in shortening in heavy skillet or dutch oven Peel and cube potatoes. Step 2: Once meat is slight browned add potatoes and continue to brown (don't worry if it sticks to the bottom of the skillet. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper, cumin powder and garlic. Step 4: Add approcimately one cup of water and simmer until meat and potatoes are tender Potatoes will thicken sauce.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork shoulder, oil, garlic cloves, onion, orange, lime, brown sugar, chili powder, salt, pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat from pork and cut into cubes. Step 2: Heat oil in large pot and add pork, garlic and onions. Step 3: Cook over high heat for 5-10 minutes to brown pork. Step 4: Add orange, lime, brown sugar, chili powder, salt, pepper and water to pot. Step 5: Stir and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours or until pork is tender. Step 7: Remove cover and cook over medium heat for 10-15 minutes or until liquid has cooked off. Step 8: Press with back of spoon to break up meat. Step 9: Serve as you like Suggested on flour tortillas with salsa and beans.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork, black pepper, garlic powder, instant minced garlic, onion powder, dried onion flakes, salt, onion salt, dried oregano, dried cilantro, ground cumin, ground red pepper, fresh cilantro, white onion, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all seasoning in a bowl, mix well Pleace meat in separate bowl and sprinkle seasoning and rub generously over meat - using all seasoning. Step 2: Make foil packet by laying out 2 long sheets of heavy duty aluminium foil and make a cross. Step 3: Place meat on foil. Step 4: Bring up sides of foil and fold making a packet. Step 5: Refrigerate for 6 hours Slow cooked: after marinating, place in a crockpot, cook 4 hours - the meat becomes very tender. Step 6: Then transfer to a plate -- over med-high grill for 5 minutes to get a nice grill mark and crisp Shred and eat in tacos with beans and rice our favorite way to eat them Or add 1 cup of water to the crockpot -- this makes the meat very tender and can be shredded for burritos or tacos.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, garlic cloves, jalapeno, cumin, sea salt, pepper, olive oil, orange juice, lime juice, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees farenheit. Step 2: Stir pork pieces around in garlic, jalapeos, cumin, salt and pepper, then saute in olive oil at medium-high until lightly browned on all sides. Step 3: Transfer to roasting pan and add juices and chicken stock, cover tightly to retain juices while cooking, and bake for 2-2 5 hours, until meat is very tender. Step 4: Allow to cool so pork absorbs remaining juices, pull apart with a fork.

Ingredient Names: lard, pork, white onion, marjoram, fresh thyme sprigs, bay leaves, peppercorns, orange, milk, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the lard in a heavy pan, add the meat, and fry, stirring and turning it over from time to time, until lightly golden-about 8 minutes. Step 2: Add the onion and stir well. Step 3: Cook for 8 minutes longer or until the meat is well browned. Step 4: Add the remaining ingredients, cover the pan, and cook over low heat until the meat is just tender, not falling apart- about 20 minutes, depending on the quality of the meat There should be plenty of pan juices. Step 5: Remove the lid, increase the heat, and fry, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pan, until the juices have been absorbed- about 10 minutes. Step 6: Drain off the extra fat and serve with salsa fresca, guacamole, and tortillas These carnitas may be prepared ahead up to thee point of the final frying, but they should be kept covered so that the meat does not dry out.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork shoulder, orange, orange juice, ground cumin, bay leaves, spanish onion, garlic, beef bouillon, lard, water, corn tortillas, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Start with removing any excess pieces of fat from the pork. Step 2: In a large, heavy saucepan, place the pork along with the orange zest, orange juice, cumin, bay leaves, onion, garlic and bouillon. Step 3: Fill with water just so it barely covers the pork. Step 4: Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for about 2 hours. Step 6: Turn off the heat and allow the meat to cool and any excess fat to raise to the top. Step 7: Remove the excess fat, and place the cooled pork in a large bowl. Step 8: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 9: In a separate fry pan, heat the lard and fry the pork pieces for about 6 minutes, just so they turn golden. Step 10: Allow them to cool.

Ingredient Names: cooked pork, olive oil, vidalia onion, jalapeno, garlic cloves, coriander, cumin, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: In a pan heat oil then add the last 6 ingredients and cook over medium heat till softened about 20 minutes Stirring every couple minutes. Step 2: Mix in shredded pork This can be made ahead up three month in freezer container Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Step 3: Fill your favorite wraps, corn or flour tortillas or tacos garnish as you please with sour cream, salsa, avocado --.

Dish Name: Carnitas Mexican Pork My Way Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: pork roast, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, salt, cumin, seasoning salt, cilantro, water, flour tortilla, cheese, lettuce, avocado, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all of the spices together and sprinkle most on the roast, reserving about 1 tsp. Step 2: Put the roast and water / broth in a crock pot on low for 6-8 hours. Step 3: Now you can do 2 things here: remove the roast, drain the liquid, put the roast back in the crock, shred it with the remaining seasonings and about 1 / 2 cup of water and stir or. Step 4: Remove a little of the liquid from the pot and shred the meat in the remaining liquid and taste and season if necessary If i use a roast with a good amount of fat i usually drain it to drain off some of that grease, if it's lean then i use the liquid it cooked in, serve it up! Step 5: It makes great burritos with all the fixins- including the beans and rice.

Ingredient Names: pork roast, white onion, salt, bacon, lard
Instructions: Step 1: If the roast has skin or bone, leave them on. Step 2: Rinse the roast and place in a large pot. Step 3: Add enough water to barely cover. Step 4: Chop the onion into large pieces and add to the pot, add the salt. Step 5: Bring the water to a boil, then cover and simmer until the roast is tender, but not quite falling apart, about 2 hours. Step 6: Remove the roast and drain, discarding the onion. Step 7: Remove any skin or bones. Step 8: Cut or separate into large cubes of about 4 inches. Step 9: Put the lard in a heavy pot, melt and raise to a medium-high temperature.

Dish Name: Carrot Escabeche Mexican Pickled Carrots And Chilis
Ingredient Names: cider vinegar, flaked sea salt, caster sugar, dried oregano, carrots, jalapenos, onion, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Place the vinegar, salt, sugar, oregano and 75 ml / 2 fl oz / 1 / 4 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring to dissolve the sugar, and bring to the boil. Step 2: Add the remaining ingredients and cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Pour into a bowl and cool to room temperature. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Step 5: Serve cold or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: carrot, garlic cloves, habanero, kosher salt, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Puree carrots, garlic, habanero, salt, lime juice and 1 cup water in a blender on high speed, until completely smooth and no large chunks remain. Step 2: Transfer to a 1-qt Jar or a nonreactive container and cover loosely with plastic wrap and poke a few holes in the plastic to allow the hot sauce to breath. Step 3: Let sit at room temperature for at least 24 hours before serving and up to 3 days Do ahead: hot sauce can be made 1 week ahead. Step 4: Chill after 3 days Cooks If youre new to fermenting, this is an easy recipe to start with, and you can taste the difference in flavor every day Sure, its great as a fresh sauce, but by day 3, youll see what we mean.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, ice cube, apricot, candy
Instructions: Step 1: Set aside 1 / 2 cup mango. Step 2: Place remaining mango in a blender jar with the ice and a bit of sugar if the mango is not very sweet Process until it is smooth, but not so long that it melts. Step 3: In a tall glass, place enough bits of mango to cover the bottom of the glass, then add a few teaspoons or more of chamoy, enough to make a distinctive red layer Next, pour a few inches of mango ice, depending on how tall the glass is, to about halfway On top of that, make another layer of diced mango, then more chamoy. Step 4: Top with more mango ice, almost to the top of the glass. Step 5: Add a final layer of chamoy. Step 6: Add a few pieces of diced mango, then sprinkle some chunks of tamarind candy on top. Step 7: Serve immediately with a fat straw and a spoon.

Ingredient Names: mexican chocolate, water, milk, masa harina, dark brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Process in food processor to fine powder Grind the chocolate to a fine powder I use a cheese grater to grate the chocolate first then whirl the chocolate in a clean coffee mill. Step 2: Put the milk and water in a heavy saucepan, heat on medium, and gradually stir in the masa harina until a smooth paste is formed Use a molinollo or a wire whisk for frothing the liquid. Step 3: Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the mixture to an almost boil, stirring constantly untl the frothy drink thickens. Step 4: Stir in the powdered chocolate, then add the sugar, serve immediately. Step 5: Garnish with a cinnamon stick if desired.

Ingredient Names: water, cinnamon sticks, masa harina flour, brown sugar, unsweetened baking chocolate, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, combine 8 cups of the water and cinnamon, bring to a boil. Step 2: Place the remaining water and masa harina in a blender. Step 3: Cover and blend until smooth. Step 4: Pour the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into the cinnamon-water mixture. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low. Step 6: Cook, stirring constantly with wire whisk for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened. Step 7: Stir in sugar, chocolate and vanilla extract. Step 8: Cook, stirring frequently, for 4 to 5 minutes or until chocolate is melted and flavors well blended.

Dish Name: Champurrado With Honey Mexican Hot Chocolate
Ingredient Names: cinnamon stick, mexican chocolate, masa harina flour, milk, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Add cinnamon, mexican chocolate and two cups of water to a stock pot. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly until chocolate melts. Step 3: In a separate bowl mix the corn dough with a cup of water until smooth. Step 4: Pour corn mixture into the hot chocolate, stirring constantly. Step 5: Add the milk and honey to the pot, let it simmer over low heat, stirring frequently until the milk thickens, being careful not to let milk burn Champurrado should be the consistency of heavy cream, if yours it too thick, just add more milk For authenticity Froth the mixture with a mexican molinillo prior to serving.

Ingredient Names: tequila, orange juice, fresh lemon juice, grenadine, triple sec
Instructions: Step 1: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass Garnish with fresh fruit, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chayotes, white onions, butter, lite olive oil, oregano, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pare and seed the chayote. Step 2: Cut lengthwise into 1 / 2-inch thick slices. Step 3: Cut onions lengthwise into halves. Step 4: Cut halves lengthwise into 1 / 4-inch slices and separate into slivers. Step 5: Heat butter and oil in a skillet over medium heat until foam subsides. Step 6: Add onions and oregano Saut over medium-low heat until onions are golden. Step 7: Add chayote Saut 3 minutes. Step 8: Cover and cook until chayote is crisp tender.

Ingredient Names: lard, chili powder, flour, water, vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, oregano, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, refried beans, monterey jack cheese, cottage cheese, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 3 tblsp Oil, chili powder and flour in a small saucepan to make a paste. Step 2: Add water gradually to make a smooth sauce. Step 3: Add vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and oregano, bring to boiling, lower heat. Step 4: Simmer, uncovered for 3 minutes. Step 5: Pour vegetable oil or melt lard to depth of 1 / 4 inch in a small skillet Holding each tortilla with tongs, quickly dip into hot fat just long enough to soften, 3 to 4 seconds. Step 6: Drain on paper towels.

Dish Name: Cheese And Green Chilies Mini Quiche
Ingredient Names: green chilies, white cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, evaporated milk, paprika, eggs, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees With butter, grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Step 2: Place chilies on the bottom of the dish, distributing evenly. Step 3: In a bowl, mix the cheeses and distribute over the chilies. Step 4: Beat eggs slightly, add milk and tabasco, mix and pour over cheese. Step 5: Sprinkle paprika over the top and bake 35 to 40 minutes, until set and very lightly browned. Step 6: Cut in squares while still warm This freezes well Reheat, covered Makes about 40 squares.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno jack cheese, cheddar cheese, queso fresco, olive oil, sweet onions, ground coriander, ground cumin, hot sauce, salt and pepper, corn tortillas, onion, jalapeno, garlic, chipotle chile in adobo, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Filling: In a saute pan over medium heat, saute diced onion in oil until tender and slightly colored -- 4-6 minutes. Step 2: Season with coriander, cumin, hot sauce and s&p. Step 3: Let onion mix cool to room temperature, and hold to fill enchiladas. Step 4: Combine all the cheese except 2 oz each of the jack and cheddar with the onion mixture, fold together well Slightly warm the tortillas in a warm saute pan to make them flexible, and put about 2 / 3 cup of the cheese mix on each tortilla and roll them up. Step 5: Place the rolled tortillas in a lightly oiled casserole dish in a single layer Sauce: In a 2 quart sauce pot over medium heat, cook onions in oil until tender -- 3-5 minutes. Step 6: Add diced jalapeno and garlic and cook 2 minutes more.

Dish Name: Cheese Enchiladas W Tomatillo Green Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: tomatillo, water, jalapeno chiles, garlic, green onions, mild green chili, spinach leaves, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring first 4 ingredients to boil in large skillet. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until tomatillos are soft, about 15 minutes. Step 3: Transfer mixture to blender. Step 4: Add 2 cups onions, green chilies, and spinach, puree. Step 5: Season sauce with salt and pepper. Step 6: Return sauce to skillet. Step 7: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f Lightly oil 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish. Step 8: Heat about 1 / 4 inch deep vegetable oil in a second skillet and fry 1 tortilla briefly, remove to a paper towel to drain and then coat with sauce.

Ingredient Names: frozen spinach, butter, all-purpose flour, whipping cream, milk, fresh cilantro, green onions, green chilies, ground cumin, ground coriander, dried red pepper, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, mild cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce: cook spinach according to package instructions, drain well, set aside. Step 2: Melt butter in heavy medium skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add flour and stir mixture 2 minutes Do not brown Gradually whisk in whipping cream and milk. Step 4: Simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in spinach, cilantro, green onion, chilies, cumin, coriander and red pepper. Step 6: Puree in batches in processor until almost smooth.

Ingredient Names: mexican blend cheese, onion, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, cooked pork, green enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Reserve 1 / 3 cup cheese. Step 2: Combine 2 1 / 3 cups cheese with onion and set aside. Step 3: In a saucepan, combine cooked pork with green enchilada sauce. Step 4: Heat through then set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in small frying pan Soften tortillas, one at a time, by placing in hot oil for a few seconds on each side. Step 6: Drain tortillas on absorbent paper. Step 7: Divide cheese and onion mixture between tortillas. Step 8: Add 1 / 2 tablespoon sauce to each. Step 9: Roll tortillas tightly and place seam-side-down in a 9x13" baking pan that has been sprayed with no-stick cooking spray.

Dish Name: Cheese Stuffed Breaded Fried Nopales Cactus Paddles
Ingredient Names: maggi seasoning, ham, asadero cheese, nopales, eggs, dry breadcrumbs, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 3 ingredients and place this mixture betwen two nopal slices You can also use just one slice, spreading filling on one side, rolling it and securing ends with a toothpick Pass through beaten egg and then through bread crumbs. Step 2: Fry in hot oil and serve.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, jalapeno peppers, tomatoes, butter, low-fat milk, salt, monterey jack cheese, anaheim chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a large skillet, saute the onion, garlic, jalapeos, and tomato in butter until onions are soft. Step 3: Add the milk and salt and stir. Step 4: Heat until the milk is scalded. Step 5: Turn heat to low, and add cheese slowly, stirring until melted. Step 6: Make a slit along one side of each anaheim chile and stuff it with 4 tablespoons of the cheese mixture Warm in the oven. Step 7: Divide into 6 portions and serve.

Dish Name: Cheesey Potato Hot Sausage Breakfast Sp5
Ingredient Names: simply potatoes southwest style hash browns, hot italian sausage links, eggs, monterey jack pepper cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a 12" skillet add sausage links, poke holes in the links with a fork or toothpick to release some grease, add 2 cups of water and cook on medium heat turning often until water is gone, about 20 minutes Continue cooking & turning until the links are browned on all sides, remove from pan & slice the links 3 / 4" inch and save for next step. Step 2: In a 12" skillet or dutch oven, heat 2 tbls of oil on medium heat. Step 3: Add potatoes and the pre-cooked, & browned, hot sausage slices. Step 4: Mix well, flatten, add salt &pepper and cook on medium heat for about 8 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 tbls of oil drizzled around on top of potatoes and turn with spatula. Step 6: Cook for another 8 minutes or until potatoes are soft and browning. Step 7: Turn them again if you want to brown them more For a few minutes. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium-low.

Ingredient Names: grilled chicken breast strips, garlic cloves, onion, tomatoes, bacon, mozzarella cheese, lime, salsa, sour cream, guacamole, flour tortillas, salt, pepper, garlic salt, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place pan over medium heat. Step 2: Drizzle extra virgin olive oil into pan. Step 3: Place both garlic cloves into pan. Step 4: Let them soak in evoo until browned While letting garlic cloves soak, cut bacon into small strips or into bacon bits. Step 5: Slice onion into strips Dice tomato. Step 6: Once garlic cloves are browned, remove them from pan and discard. Step 7: Place cut bacon strips or bacon bits into pan and start to cook them. Step 8: Once bacon has begun to cook, add onion.

Ingredient Names: hot dogs, cheese slice, chili hot beans, tomato sauce, chili powder, cumin, red cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Cut three 1 / 2-inch diagonal slits into each hot dog. Step 3: Cut cheese into 36 strips. Step 4: Insert a cheese strip in each slit of hot dogs. Step 5: In a ungreased 11-1 / 2 x 7 1 / 2 baking dish mix beans, tomato sauce and seasonings. Step 6: Place the hot dogs over the bean mixture. Step 7: Bake 20-25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, chili powder, no-salt-added tomato sauce, sugar, ground cumin, garlic powder, cayenne, corn tortillas, whole green chilies, green onion, tomatoes, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f In small mixing bowl, combine cheese and 1 teaspoon of chili powder Reserve 1 / 2 cup mixture. Step 2: Set aside In shallow dish, combine remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon chili powder, the tomato sauce, sugar, cumin, garlic powder, and cayenne. Step 3: Dip both sides of 1 tortilla in sauce. Step 4: Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup cheese mixture down center of tortilla. Step 5: Place 1 strip of chili and 1 tablespoon onions over cheese mixture, roll up tortilla. Step 6: Place seam-side-down in 11 x 7-inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: enchilada sauce, cheese, taco seasoning mix, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 taco seasoning mix packet to bag of shredded cheese and shake well. Step 3: Cover bottom of baking dish with thin layer of enchilada sauce. Step 4: Cover sauce with 6 corn tortillas. Step 5: Sprinkle cheese over tortillas. Step 6: Repeat layer of 6 tortillas, sauce and cheese. Step 7: Repeat layers again. Step 8: Cover baking dish with aluminum foil and place on middle rack in oven and bake covered for 35-45 minutes. Step 9: Uncover last 5-10 minutes of baking time.

Dish Name: Cheesy Potato And Green Chili Breakfast Casserole
Ingredient Names: frozen hash brown potatoes, eggs, water, diced green chilies, mild cheddar cheese, salt and pepper, salsa, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Lightly spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Add hash browns to bottom of dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 3: Add 1 / 2 of the cheese and half of the chiles on top. Step 4: In a separate bowl mix the eggs, water and the remaining 1 / 2 of the chiles with a wire whisk. Step 5: Pour over the potatoes and top with the rest of the cheese. Step 6: Bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 55 minutes. Step 7: Check the center for doneness by inserting a knife. Step 8: Serve with salsa and tortillas Another option would be to heat flour tortillas on a skillet and add a spoonful or two to a tortilla and roll it up for a breakfast burrito.

Ingredient Names: green pepper, parmesan cheese, cheddar cheese, green onion, mayonnaise, tortillas, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Step 2: Divide mix into two, and scoop on two tortillas. Step 3: Place the other tortillas on top of the two with the mix. Step 4: Brush corn oil on each side of the quesadilla Throw each one on the barbecue for about 5 minutes, or until each one's cheese is melted, dip in salsa.

Ingredient Names: shredded cheddar cheese, hamburger, taco seasoning, salsa, cheddar cheese, sour cream, avocado, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For shells: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Using a tablespoon, scoop shredded cheese on to parchment and shape into a disk. Step 3: Make sure each cheese disk does not touch the one next to it. Step 4: Bake on a parchment-lined baking sheet for 7 minutes Lift the melted cheese disks off of the parchment paper and press into mini-muffin tins. Step 5: Let the cheese cool for 1-minute in the muffin tin so that they will hold their shape. Step 6: Remove from muffin tin and set aside For the taco filling: Cook hamburger until browned.

Dish Name: Cheesy Tex Mex Enchiladas With Simmered Guajillo Sauce
Ingredient Names: cheese, corn tortillas, chili sauce, white onion, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Set out the cheese and steam heat the tortillas Coat the bottom of a 13x9-inch baking dish with a little sauce. Step 2: Roll 1 / 4 cup of the cheese into each tortilla and fit into the pan Ladle 2 cups of the sauce over top, sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake at 425 degrees f until bubbly and browned. Step 3: Sprinkle with chopped onion and cilantro to taste and serve Cheeses to use - such as chihuahua, asaderos, or quesadilla, a good substitute can be sonoma jack, others - monterey jack or mild cheddar.

Ingredient Names: soft flour tortillas, cheddar, sundried, jalapeno chilies from, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Lay 2 tortillas side-by-side on a grill pan. Step 2: Scatter over all of the ingredients, then top with remaining tortillas. Step 3: Cook under a medium grill for 3 mins until slightly crisp and golden. Step 4: Turn, then cook the other side for 3 mins until the cheese has melted. Step 5: Cut into wedges to serve. Step 6: Great with guacamole or salsa.

Ingredient Names: margarine, masa harina flour, sugar, corn kernels, cornmeal, water, baking powder, salt, milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix the margarine, masa and sugar with mixer until light and fluffy, about 1 minute. Step 2: Blend 1 / 2 the corn kernels with the water in a blender until smooth. Step 3: Combine with margarine mixture, stirring well. Step 4: Add the remaining corn, cornmeal, baking powder, salt and milk. Step 5: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil. Step 6: Pour the mixture into an 8-inch baking dish Tightly cover with plastic wrap and set atop the saucepan of boiling water. Step 7: Keep pan tightly wrapped and steam for 50 minutes to 1 hour. Step 8: Check water level often, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean I have also made this in the oven, setting the pan in a water bath.

Ingredient Names: tequila, cointreau liqueur, orange juice, prepared sweet-and-sour mix, salt, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Put a handful of ice into a shaker. Step 2: Add all ingredients and shake. Step 3: Pour the drink into a 12-ounce margarita glass. Step 4: Garnish with a lime wedge on a toothpick, add a straw, and serve.

Dish Name: Chevy's Watermelon Fresh Fruit Margarita On The Rocks
Ingredient Names: tequila, triple sec, prepared sweet-and-sour mix, watermelon, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Puree watermelon using instructions above. Step 2: Put a handful of ice into shaker. Step 3: Add all ingredients and shake. Step 4: Pour the drink over ice in a 10-ounce margarita glass. Step 5: Garnish with a lime wedge on a toothpick and serve.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, water, ground cumin, oregano, salt, flour tortillas, vegetable oil, tomatoes, black olives, green onions, green chilies, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Fry the ground beef with the water, the cumin, oregano and salt, stirring until the water has evaporated. Step 3: Drain excess grease. Step 4: Cool Rub each tortilla on each side with a bit of vegetable oil. Step 5: Place tortillas on a baking sheet and bake for 4 minutes. Step 6: Remove from oven, and top with the seasoned beef, veggies, then the cheese. Step 7: Bake for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

Dish Name: Chicharrones Con Huevos Pork Cracklins With Eggs
Ingredient Names: pork crackling, light margarine, eggs, salsa, tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet on medium heat add the pork cracklins Lightly fry them just so that they get warmed, set aside. Step 2: In a medium sized bowl beat the eggs. Step 3: Add the butter or margarine to the skillet and melt. Step 4: Add the beaten eggs. Step 5: When the eggs are slightly done add the warm pork cracklins and gently fold into the eggs. Step 6: Once the eggs are about done add the salsa He said his mom uses a mild homemade salsa that she canned over the summer but a good store bought salsa would work well too The more watery it is the better.

Ingredient Names: pork rinds, tomatillo, jalapenos, onion, fresh cilantro, garlic salt, chicken bouillon granule
Instructions: Step 1: To make the salsa, boil the tomatillos, and jalapenos, until the jalapenos change color. Step 2: Put all the tomatillos, and jalapenos in a blender, add some of the water that was used to boil them. Step 3: Add the onion coarsely chopped, along with the cilantro, garlic salt and bouillon To prevent minor burns, either use a clean washcloth instead of the top of the blender to cover, or if your blender top has the little attachment you can remove, remove it before you blend the hot ingredients, blend everything. Step 4: Chop the chicharrones to bite size, and reserve. Step 5: Heat up some oil in a large skillet, add the salsa, and bring it to a boil, before adding the chicharrones. Step 6: Let everything simmer for some 15 minutes before serving. Step 7: Serve hot, with refried beans and flour tortillas.

Ingredient Names: chicken, salt and pepper, oil, onion, garlic clove, fresh tomatoes, lemon juice, sugar, salt, oregano, cinnamon, clove, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper In 12 inch skillet brown chicken in cooking oil about 15 minutes. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cook 5 minutes more. Step 4: Add tomatoes, lemon juice, sugar, salt, oregano, cinnamon, cloves, and 1 / 2 cup water, cover. Step 5: Simmer 30 to 35 minutes or till chicken is tender. Step 6: Remove chicken to platter, keep warm Measure pan juices. Step 7: Add water to make 2 cups.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, chicken breasts, jalapeno pepper, sweet red pepper, black beans, salsa, whole wheat tortillas, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Fry onion, garlic, salt, and pepper until softened, about 3 minute. Step 3: Add chicken, jalapeno, red pepper, beans and salsa. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until chicken is no longer pink inside, about 10 minute, let cool. Step 5: Spoon about 3 / 4 cup of the filling down centre of each tortilla. Step 6: Sprinkle each with 1 / 4 cup of the cheese. Step 7: Fold in bottom edge, then sides, roll up. Step 8: Place, seam down, in greased 13x9 inch glass backing dish, sprinkle remaining cheese over top.

Dish Name: Chicken And Black Bean Green Enchilada Rice Bake
Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, chicken breasts, green enchilada sauce, black olives, diced tomatoes, sour cream, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, ground cumin, black beans, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f And spray a 913-inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Cook rice according to package directions. Step 3: Place chicken, enchilada sauce, olives, tomatoes, sour cream, salt, pepper and cumin into a large bowl, mixing to combine. Step 4: Pour cooked rice into prepared baking dish and layer beans on top of rice. Step 5: Pour chicken mixture over rice and top evenly with cheddar cheese. Step 6: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until cheese is melted and rice is hot.

Ingredient Names: taco seasoning, olive oil, water, boneless skinless chicken breast, monterey jack cheese, fresh cilantro, salt, ricotta cheese, green chilies, egg, chunky salsa, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350 degrees f In resealable plastic bag, mix taco seasoning, oil and 1 / 4 cup of water. Step 2: Add chicken pieces, turn to mix. Step 3: Refrigerate up to 12 hours In medium bowl, mix 2 1 / 2 cups of monterey cheese, cilantro, salt, ricotta cheese, chiles, and egg. Step 4: Heat 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 5: Add chicken with marinade. Step 6: Cook and stir 5 to 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center In ungreased 13x9-inch glass baking dish, mix 1 / 2 cup of the salsa and remaining 1 / 4 cup water.

Ingredient Names: fat-free low-sodium chicken broth, cilantro, fresh lime juice, extra virgin olive oil, jalapeno peppers, skinless chicken breast half, salt, black pepper, onion, fat free tortillas, soft fresh goat cheese, fat free sour cream, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients in blender or food processor until smooth. Step 2: Place chicken in zip-loc bag and add broth mixture Seal and refrigerate for 2 hrs turning bag occasionally, preheat grill. Step 3: Remove chicken from bag, discard marinade. Step 4: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Step 5: Place chicken and onion on grill rack coated with cooking spray. Step 6: Grill onion 3 minutes on each side or until browned. Step 7: Grill chicken 6 minutes per side or until done. Step 8: Cool slightly and cut chicken in very thin slices.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, cooked chicken, light sour cream, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas, diced green chilies, low-fat milk, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, stir together chicken, 1 / 2 cup sour cream, and 1 1 / 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, set aside. Step 2: Saute onion in hot oil over medium-high heat 5 minutes. Step 3: Add to chicken and cheese mixture. Step 4: Spoon chicken mixture evenly at one end of each tortilla, and roll up. Step 5: Arrange, seam side down, in a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish, set aside. Step 6: Whisk together 8 oz green chiles, milk, and flour in a saucepan over medium heat Gradually add remaining cheese, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted. Step 7: Pour sauce evenly over top of enchiladas.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, hot sauce, mustard, butter, lime, salt, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Squeeze the lime juice into a bowl, add hot sauce, mustard and salt, mix until you have a uniform marinating sauce. Step 2: Marinate chicken breast for 45 minutes. Step 3: Fry chicken breast in a pan with butter without marinating sauce. Step 4: Add to chicken marinating sauce for body. Step 5: Let it cook slow for a couple of minutes. Step 6: Remove chicken and place in plate, keep marinating sauce in pan. Step 7: Add sour cream in the pan to the marinating sauce and make a creamy sauce. Step 8: Serve creamy sauce on top of chicken.

Ingredient Names: light italian dressing, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cheddar cheese soup, salsa, flour tortillas, green onions, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pour dressing into shallow nonmetallic dish. Step 2: Add chicken and turn to coat. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes, turning occasionally. Step 4: Remove chicken from marinade, discard marinade. Step 5: Grill or broil chicken 15 minutes or until done, turning once. Step 6: Mix soup and salsa in saucepan, heat through. Step 7: Slice chicken and red pepper into thin strips and place down center of each tortilla. Step 8: Top with onions, avocado and soup mixture.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, garlic cloves, jalapeno, cilantro, vegetable oil, ground cumin, coriander, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cooked chicken, monterey jack pepper cheese, farmer cheese, scallion, tortilla chips, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450. Step 2: In a blender or food processor, puree the tomatillos, garlic, jalapeo and cilantro until smooth. Step 3: In a large saucepan, heat the oil until shimmering. Step 4: Add the cumin and coriander and cook over high heat until fragrant, 30 seconds. Step 5: Add the tomatillo puree, bring to a boil and cook until the sauce loses its bright green color, 3 minutes. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: In a medium bowl, toss the chicken with 3 / 4 cup of the pepper jack, the farmer cheese, scallion and half of the tomatillo sauce. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper In another bowl, toss the tortilla chips with the remaining sauce. Step 9: Spread half of the chips in an 8-by-11-inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, onion, garlic, sour cream, oil, cheddar cheese, ortega chiles, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cook chicken Reserve broth, chop chicken. Step 2: Grate onion and garlic into sour cream. Step 3: Add a little stock to thin cream Soften tortillas in hot oil. Step 4: Drain on paper towels. Step 5: Wrap chicken and all but 1 / 2 cup cheese in tortillas. Step 6: Place enchiladas in large baking dish. Step 7: Mix green chilis into sour cream mixture and spread over enchiladas.

Ingredient Names: spanish chorizo, green bell pepper, garlic cloves, jalapeno chiles, bay leaf, spanish onion, salt & freshly ground black pepper, chicken stock, paprika, fire-roasted tomatoes, tomato sauce, ground cinnamon, boneless skinless chicken, mexican blend cheese, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the chorizo in a large skillet. Step 2: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels Reserve two tablespoons grease from the pan and add bell peppers. Step 3: Saute until browned and softened, about five minutes To the pan, add 2 tablespoons olive oil. Step 4: Add the garlic, chiles, bay leaf, onions, paprika, cinnamon and salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook to soften, about 6 to 7 minutes. Step 6: Add the chicken stock, tomatoes, tomato sauce and simmer to thicken the sauce, about 15 minutes. Step 7: Pour about one-third to one-half of the sauce into a large casserole dish. Step 8: Combine the cooled down chorizo with the chicken and half the cheese.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, onion, garlic cloves, cilantro, ground cumin, mexican oregano, ground pepper, diced green chilies, campbell's cream of mushroom soup, campbell's cream of chicken soup, mixed cheeses, monterey jack pepper cheese, sour cream, milk, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare chicken anyway you would like I place mine in the pressure cooker with chicken broth, onion, garlic, 1 / 2 teaspoon cummin and 1 / 2 teaspoons mexican oregano Shred chicken, dice it or slice it, however you want it, place it in a bowl and combined cummin, pepper, mexican oregano and any other seasonings you would like. Step 2: Mix seasoning well into chicken and set aside. Step 3: In a bowl combine: both soups, diced chilies, sour cream, milk, all remaining seasonings and cilantro, 1 1 / 2 cups mexican mixed cheese. Step 4: Mix well, set to the side. Step 5: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Step 6: In a 13x9 baking dish, cover the bottom of the pan with a thin layer of soup mixture Lay a tortilla shell out and place a tablespoon of soup mixture on the shell spoon the chicken mixture into tortillas, and roll up. Step 7: Place the rolls seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish.

Ingredient Names: olive oil flavored cooking spray, boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes with garlic, chili beans, enchilada sauce, diced green chilies, cumin, fat free sour cream, fresh cilantro, baked corn tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 4-5 quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. Step 2: Mix all ingredients except sour cream, cilantro and baked chips. Step 3: Cover and cook on low 7-8 hours. Step 4: Stir mixture to break up chicken. Step 5: Garnish each serving with sour cream, cilantro, and chips as desired.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchilada Lasagna With White Sauce
Ingredient Names: cream cheese, onion, cheese, minced garlic cloves, cumin, cilantro, cooked chicken, butter, flour, chicken broth, sour cream, green chilies, thyme, pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 and grease 9x13 pan. Step 2: Mix cream cheese, onion and 1 5 cups cheese. Step 3: Mix in garlic, 1 / 4 tsp cumin and parsley, then and chicken In medium saucepan melt butter, then stir in flour Gradually add broth and bring to a boil, 2 minutes or until thick. Step 4: Remove from heat Stur in 1 cup cheese, sour cream, chilies, thyme, salt, pepper and 1 / 2 tsp cumin. Step 5: Spread 1 / 2 cup of cooked mixture into greased pan. Step 6: Top with 6 tortilla halves, 1 / 3 of the cream cheese mixture, and 1 / 4 of the remaining cooked mixture.

Ingredient Names: refrigerated pie crust, eggs, half-and-half, chicken breasts, tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, salsa, green chilies, salt, pepper, sour cream, chunky salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 350f place pie crust in 9- or 9 1 / 2-inch glass deep-dish pie pan as directed on box for one-crust filled pie In medium bowl, beat eggs with wire whisk until blended. Step 2: Beat in half-and-half. Step 3: Stir in chicken, chips, both cheeses, 1 cup salsa, the green chiles and salt. Step 4: Pour into crust-lined pan. Step 5: Sprinkle pepper over top of filling. Step 6: Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until crust is light golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean. Step 7: Let stand 10 minutes before serving, cut into wedges. Step 8: Serve with sour cream and / or salsa.

Ingredient Names: whole chicken breast, water, onion, celery, bay leaf, peppercorns, salt, sour cream, butter, ortega chile, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken and water in pan. Step 2: Bring to boil over high heat Skim off foam Coarsely chop 1 / 2 the onion and all the celery. Step 3: Add onion, celery, bay leaf, peppercorns and salt to chicken. Step 4: Simmer, partially covered, 30 minutes. Step 5: Remove chicken and strain broth. Step 6: Reduce broth to 1 / 2 cup, season. Step 7: Stir in sour cream set aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, enchilada sauce, cheddar cheese, sour cream, refried beans, cilantro, diced green chilies, taco seasoning, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Pre heat oven at 350 degrees. Step 2: Combine the chicken, cheese, sour cream, refried beans, chiles, taco seasoning and cilantro in a mixing bowl. Step 3: Fill each tortilla with 2 spoonfuls of filling mix. Step 4: Fold tortillas and place in baking pan seam side down. Step 5: When the pan is filled, pour enchilada sauce over the top of all the filled tortillas. Step 6: Cover the pan and bake for 20-40 minutes.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas With Sour Cream Green Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: frying chickens, sazon goya, oil, flour, chicken broth, light sour cream, monterey jack cheese, green chilies, cumin, chili-garlic sauce, salt and pepper, garlic powder, cayenne, corn tortillas, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Put chicken on to boil in enough water to cover chicken. Step 2: Mix the sazongoya con azafran seasoning package into the chicken water. Step 3: Boil chicken about 40 minutes till falling off the bone De bone chicken saving all broth for later. Step 4: Chop chicken into bite size pieces. Step 5: Mix oil and flour together and set aside. Step 6: Chop onion and saute in small amount of oil about a tsp till translucent. Step 7: Add in oil and flour mixture stirring constantly for about 4 minutes till flour not raw. Step 8: Add in chicken broth about a cup at a time should have a nice sauce consistency. Step 9: Add in the two cans of green chilis and the sour cream.

Dish Name: Chicken Enchiladas With Sour Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: butter, all-purpose flour, chicken broth, water, sour cream, canned jalapeno peppers, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, cooked chicken, monterey jack cheese, onions, tomatoes, tomato juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter / margarine in a heavy saucepan over low heat. Step 2: Add flour, stirring until smooth. Step 3: Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly Gradually add chicken broth and water. Step 4: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly. Step 5: Stir in sour cream and 2 chopped jalapeno peppers. Step 6: Pour half of the sour cream sauce into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Step 7: Set aside dish and remaining sour cream sauce. Step 8: Fry tortillas, one at a time, in 2 tablespoons oil in a medium skillet 5 seconds on each side or just until tortillas are softened. Step 9: Add additional oil, if necessary.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, vegetable oil, white onion, cilantro, diced green chilies, cumin, sugar, salt, chicken broth, whipping cream, corn tortillas, cooked chicken, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, onion
Instructions: Step 1: To make the sauce, husk the tomatillos and rinse under warm water to remove stickiness and dirt Broil on foil baking sheet 1 to 2 inches from heat, turning once Till soft and slightly charred, about 7 - 9 mintues. Step 2: Heat oil in large skillet over med, heat. Step 3: Add onions and saute about 5 minutes. Step 4: Transfer tomatillos to a blender and add the sauteed onions, cilantro, green chilies, cumin, sugar and salt, puree till smooth. Step 5: Return tomatillo sauce to skillet and cook over med. Step 6: Heat till thickened about 5 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, chicken stock, green pepper, onion, garlic cloves, oil, oregano, cumin, salt, pepper, mexican tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes, red enchilada sauce, diced green chilies, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Poach chicken breasts in stock just until no longer pink. Step 2: Remove, cool and shred with 2 forks. Step 3: Make sauce: saute onions, peppers and garlic in oil just until soft. Step 4: Add oregano, cumin, salt and pepper. Step 5: Add tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes, red enchilada sauce and green chiles.
