Step 6: Spread enough sauce to cover the bottom of a 9" by 15" glass baking dish Microwave 2 tortillas at a time for 15 seconds and assemble before microwaving the next 2 Assemble enchiritos: spread center of a tortilla with about 2 t Beans, add about 3 t Shredded chicken and top with about 1 / 3 cup cheese.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, cider vinegar, honey, water, lemon juice, marinade, garlic cloves, soy sauce, cumin, celery seed, cayenne pepper, paprika, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together all ingredients, pour over chicken. Step 2: Marinate at least 4 hours Do not marinate over 24 hours Cooking options: grill, broil, cut meat into small strips and saute.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, green peppers, onion, salsa, jalapeno, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a medium skillet on medium-high heat. Step 2: When warm, spritz oil over the skillet and brown meat. Step 3: Add sliced veggies and sautee quickly for crunchy, or reduce heat and simmer for tender. Step 4: Add salsa and jalepeno for last 5 mins of cooking. Step 5: Serve in warmed tortillas with your favorite fixings We like sour cream, shredded sharp cheddar, diced tomatoes, and we'll often put spanish rice in the tortilla with the meat and veggies.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, whole green chilies, monterey jack cheese, milk, flour, salt, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Grease 9x9 pan. Step 2: Stuff each chile with shredded chicken Lay stuffed chiles in the greased pan. Step 3: Sprinkle cheese over chiles. Step 4: Mix together remaining ingredients adn pour over cheese. Step 5: Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cheddar cheese, seasoning salt, black pepper, butter, onions, garlic, red bell pepper, chili powder, cooked chicken, mushroom pieces, green chilies, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Grease a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Step 3: In a bowl mix together the undiluted chicken soup, with sour cream, 1-1 / 2 cups cheddar cheese, seasoned salt and black pepper. Step 4: In a saucepan heat butter over medium heat, add in the onion, garlic, red or green bell pepper and chili powder. Step 5: Saute for about 3 minutes. Step 6: Add in the chopped chicken, green chilies mushrooms pieces and about 1 / 2 cup of the soup / sour cream mixture, mix to combine. Step 7: Bring to a boil and simmer for about 5 minutes, then season with more salt and pepper to taste. Step 8: Spread about half of the soup / chicken mixture onto the bottom of the casserole dish. Step 9: Heat the tortilla shells for about 30 seconds in the microwave to soften.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, water, boneless chicken breasts, tomatillo, onion, poblano chiles, jalapenos, garlic cloves, cilantro, oregano leaves, salt & freshly ground black pepper, vegetable oil, white hominy
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot bring the chicken stock and water to a boil. Step 2: Add the chicken breasts and simmer over very low heat until theyre tender and cooked through, about 25 minutes. Step 3: Transfer the chicken breasts to a plate and shred the meat. Step 4: In a blender or food processor combine the halved tomatillos with the quartered onion, poblanos and jalapeos, smashed garlic, chopped cilantro and oregano Pulse until coarsely chopped Stopping occasionally and scraping down the side With the machine on, add 1 cup of the broth and puree until smooth. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: In a large deep skillet, heat the vegetable oil until shimmering. Step 7: Add the tomatillo puree and cook over medium heat, until the sauce turns a deep green, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, olive oil, onion, rotel tomatoes, black beans, tomato sauce, whole kernel corn, chili powder, garlic powder, cumin, oregano, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Cut chicken into small diced pieces, and saute in large skillet with olive oil and onions over medium-high heat until cooked throughout. Step 3: Add rotel, beans, tomato sauce, corn, and spices to chicken. Step 4: Cook for 5 minutes until fully heated Salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: In a 9"x13" greased casserole dish, put just enough of the mixture to cover the bottom of the dish. Step 6: Layer tortillas, half of the remaining mixture, half of the cheese, tortillas, and the remainder of the mixture. Step 7: Cover with the remainder of the cheese. Step 8: Bake for 15 minutes, and then allow casserole to cool 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, cucumber, cheddar cheese, ranch dressing, flour tortillas, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Drain canned chicken, put inot bowl and break up with fork. Step 2: Chop cucumber and add to meat. Step 3: Stir in cheese and dressing, mix well. Step 4: Spoon one-forth of the mixture on edge of tortilla, top with one forth of the lettuce. Step 5: Fold the edge nearest the filling over the filling till it is covered. Step 6: Then roll up the tortillia. Step 7: Repeat to make three more burritos.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, whole kernel corn, black beans, cream of chicken soup, onion, salsa, cooking spray, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Spray skillet with non-stick pan spray. Step 2: Season chicken breasts with garlic powder and anything else you like to use. Step 3: Saute chicken breasts until nicely browned. Step 4: Remove from pan and keep warm Dump remaining ingredients into skillet and stir to combine well. Step 5: Cover and heat through, stirring often. Step 6: Return chicken to pan and let them get coated with the sauce. Step 7: Heat a few more minutes. Step 8: Serve chicken breast with a cup of the corn, bean mixture over top You could serve this with rice or pasta if desired.

Ingredient Names: cream of chicken soup, boneless chicken, green chilies, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, onion, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Boil whole chicken until meat falls off bone Bone chicken Reserve broth. Step 2: Cook chopped onions in butter until translucent. Step 3: Mix all ingredients in large bowl, adding enough broth to moisten I usually add about 1 / 2 cup. Step 4: Bake in 13x9-inch pan at 350f for 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, pepperoncini peppers, onion, cilantro, garlic cloves, black pepper, corn tortillas, sour cream, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Slice onion. Step 2: Chop cilantro Dice garlic. Step 3: Combine everything including the entire jar of peppers, juice and all, but the tortillas into a slow cooker. Step 4: Cook on low 5 hours Shred chicken with 2 forks. Step 5: Mix well with everything in the pot, keep warm. Step 6: Heat tortillas till soft, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, cooked chicken, onion, green chilies, chicken broth, cheddar cheese, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine chicken, chilies, broth, soups& onion, set aside. Step 2: Cut or tear tortillas into 3-4 inch pieces and layer half on the bottom of a greased 13x9 inch pan. Step 3: Top with half the chicken mixture and half the cheese, repeat layers. Step 4: Bake, uncovered 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: roasted red peppers, cooked chicken, cream cheese, buttermilk ranch salad dressing mix, pimento-stuffed green olives, green onions, green chilies, cayenne, black pepper, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Drain the roasted bell peppers well and then place them between sheets of paper towels pressing to remove any excess moisture. Step 2: Chop them and place in a large bowl. Step 3: Add in the cooked chicken, softened cream cheese, dry ranch dressing mixture, chopped olives, green onions and chilies. Step 4: Mix well to combine, season with cayenne and black pepper to taste. Step 5: Cover and chill for a minimum of 3 hours. Step 6: Spoon the mixture evenly over each tortilla and roll up. Step 7: Slice each roll onto 4 slices secure with toothpicks Delicious!

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breasts, whole kernel corn, salsa, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, combine chicken, corn and salsa. Step 2: Cook until heated through. Step 3: Sprinkle cheese over tortillas. Step 4: Place about 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture down the center of each tortilla. Step 5: Roll up Secure with toothpicks. Step 6: Serve with sour cream Variations. Step 7: Add chopped green pepper, red pepper and / or scallions. Step 8: Add hot pepper sauce.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, onion, garlic, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese, green chilies, eggs, buttermilk, salt, fresh ground pepper, cumin, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Heat oil in medium skillet over medium-low heat. Step 3: Add onions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until tender. Step 4: Grease 11x7-inch baking dish. Step 5: Spread half the tortillas along bottom of baking dish. Step 6: Sprinkle half the cheese and 1 can chilies over top. Step 7: Sprinkle onion mixture over chilies. Step 8: Repeat layering with remaining tortillas, cheese and chilies. Step 9: Whisk eggs, buttermilk, salt, pepper, cumin and oregano in medium bowl. Step 10: Pour over casserole.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, poblano chiles, yellow onion, garlic cloves, chicken broth, whipping cream, fresh cilantro, salt and pepper, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, chorizo sausage, onion, monterey jack cheese, crema
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the sauce, combine tomatillos, chiles, chopped onion, garlic, broth and whipping cream in a medium saucepan and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add cilantro, salt and pepper. Step 3: Puree in blender I like mine to have a little bit of texture Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees. Step 4: Cut tortillas into sixths. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 inch of oil to skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Fry tortillas until chewy, but not as crispy as you would for chips. Step 7: Drain on paper towels Create a layer of tortillas in a shallow baking dish.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, lime juice, cumin, steak
Instructions: Step 1: Rehydrate the dried chiles which will take about 30 minutes and puree. Step 2: Whisk the chile puree, the lime juice and cumin together Rub the mixture on the meat, cover and let it marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight if you can. Step 3: Bring to room temperature and cook on a medium hot grill to desired doneness.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, arbol chiles, pork, salt, vegetable oil, water, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into small pieces. Step 2: Place them in a pan with water, add your garlic. Step 3: Simmer on low for 1 1 / 2 hours While the meat is cooking: place the chiles and tomatillos on a separate pan to roast. Step 4: Blend the chile arbol peppers with 1 / 3 cup of wate and 1 tsp salt, place aside when all the water is gone in the pan with the meat pour your oil and fry the pieces of meat slightly First, pour in your tomatillo sauce and mix it Second, pour in your red chile sauce and mix it. Step 5: Simmer for 20 minutes. Step 6: Taste and add more salt if needed. Step 7: Serve with pinto beans and ranchero cheese.

Dish Name: Chile Con Carne With Red Beans
Ingredient Names: dried red kidney beans, extra lean ground beef, salt, cold water, onions, scallions, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, tomatoes, dried thyme leaves, ground cumin, chili powder, bay leaves, cilantro stems, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Sort through the beans, removing and discarding any damaged ones, and rinse in a sieve under cold water. Step 2: Place the beans, beef, salt, and water in a stockpot, and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Reduce the heat to low, cover, and boil gently for 1 hour. Step 4: Add the onions, scallions, garlic, jalapeo, tomatoes, thyme, cumin, chili powder, bay leaves, and cilantro stems. Step 5: Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, reduce the heat to low, cover, and boil gently for an hour To serve, spoon the chili over the rice, and sprinkle the cilantro leaves on top.

Ingredient Names: chiles de arbol, garlic cloves, white onion, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Add the chiles in a sauce pan with the cup of water. Step 2: Cover and bring to a rolling boil for 15 minutes. Step 3: Pour the chiles and cooking liquid into the blender with the rest of the ingredients and blend on high for 5 minutes Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, roma tomatoes, garlic cloves, white onion, dried arbol chiles, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Add water in pan Peel tomatillos and place in pan, also add the roma tomato's, garlic, white onion, chiles de arbol & salt. Step 2: Let boil and you will need to turn the tomatillos after about 10 minutes when they turn slightly brown. Step 3: Let both sides brown. Step 4: Once done place everything in blender and blend until smooth. Step 5: Let cool and serve.

Ingredient Names: cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, chilies, milk, eggs, bisquick
Instructions: Step 1: Combine milk, eggs, and bisquick in a bowl. Step 2: Layer in a greased 9 x 13 baking dish / pan the items in the following order once only Cheddar cheese, 1 can of chilis, jack cheese, 1 can of chilis, egg mixture. Step 3: Bake 350 degrees for about 50 minutes.

Dish Name: Chile Relleno Casserole With Fresh Chiles
Ingredient Names: whole green chilies, onion, cumin, salt, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, evaporated milk, tomato sauce, lean ground beef, garlic cloves, chili powder, eggs, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chiles, open flat and remove seeds. Step 2: Drain on paper towels Brown meat with onion and garlic, and drain fat from pan. Step 3: Add 1 tsp cumin, half of the chili powder, and salt, and stir until well blended. Step 4: In a greased 9x13 pan, layer chiles, beef, and another layer of chiles. Step 5: Combine cheeses and sprinkle on top of layered mixture. Step 6: Beat together eggs, milk, and flour, and pour over layers. Step 7: Mix tomato sauce with 2 tsp cumin and remaining chili powder. Step 8: Pour tomato mixture over all. Step 9: Bake in 350 f oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: diced green chilies, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, eggs, evaporated milk, flour, salt, ground pepper, enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 300 degrees, layer 1 / 3 diced chiles in the bottom of a 4-quart baking dish. Step 2: Cover these with a layer of cheddar cheese. Step 3: Layer in another 1 / 3 of the green chiles. Step 4: Cover this with a layer of jack cheese. Step 5: Layer in the last of the green chiles Separate the eggs. Step 6: Beat the yolks then add the evaporated milk, flour, salt and pepper, mix well. Step 7: In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff. Step 8: Fold the whites into the yolk mixture and pour over the layered chile / cheese mixture.

Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, monterey jack cheese, salsa, pasta sauce, hamburger, refried beans, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Put small t at top of each pepper just below the stem to keep it from exploding To skin peppers - cook at 500 for about 15 to 20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes They will be blistered and dark in spots Seal peppers in plastic freezer bag for about 10 to 15 minutes to finish steaming the skin. Step 2: Using the t you cut at the top, use a spoon to pull out the seeds and then peel the pepper Seeding is much easier if you do it before peeling the pepper Don't worry if they tear too much! Step 3: Brown hamburger, add about 1 / 4 cup salsa and 1 / 4 cup red sauce. Step 4: Place this on bottom of 2 qt casserole dish. Step 5: Mix about 1 / 4 cup salsa and 1 / 4 cup red sauce with refried beans and layer on top of hamburger mixture.

Dish Name: Chile Rellenos The Easy Way Carrie Sheridan
Ingredient Names: green chilies, monterey jack cheese, eggs, butter, salt, fresh ground pepper, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Layer green chiles, halved, in a 1-1 / 2 quart dish. Step 3: Sprinkle grated jack cheese over chiles. Step 4: Whisk together the well beaten eggs, melted butter with the salt, pepper and cumin. Step 5: Pour egg mixture over chiles and cheese. Step 6: Bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes until set.

Dish Name: Chile Rellenos With Ground Pork And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: poblano peppers, monterey jack cheese, egg, whole wheat pastry flour, fresh tomato, ground pork, grapeseed oil, toothpick
Instructions: Step 1: Simply increase your peppers, flour, and egg according to how many peppers you will be stuffing I usually just stuff 2 peppers and then we just eat the leftover stuffing in tacos but sometimes stuff 8 peppers if having guests Roast your peppers on a foil-lined baking sheet at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes or until their skins start to blister and char a little bit. Step 2: Turn them over halfway through. Step 3: Put the peppers into a ziploc bag and keep it sealed for about 30 minutes to allow the peppers to "sweat" Meanwhile, cook your pork in a skillet until no longer pink then drain it and place in a mixing bowl. Step 4: Put your cheese in with the hot pork and mix it around, allowing it to melt a little with the meat. Step 5: After the 30 minutes, carefully remove the skins on your poblanos (as much as you can without tearing up the pepper--it's o K.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, chicken broth, onion, jalapeno peppers, tomatillo, tomatoes, poblano chiles, flour, garlic cloves, ground cumin, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Roast chiles under a broiler, turning every 5 minutes or so, until blackened on all sides. Step 2: Put the chiles into a paper bag or covered bowl and let them steam for a couple of minutes Peel the skin off of the chiles, remove the seeds, and cut them into 1" square strips Finely chop the jalapeo [optional] cut the tomatillos in half and dry roast them in a skillet until they start to pick up some dark spots Coat pork in flour, salt and pepper Brown and set aside. Step 3: Add onions and garlic to pan, cook until onions are golden brown. Step 4: Add chiles, tomatillos, and tomatoes. Step 5: Fry for about 10min.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, soup bones, tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic powder, hot water, green chili peppers, hot pepper, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pork into 1 / 2 inch cubes and with the pork bones, fry over low heat until brown and the meat is slightly dry If pork is very fatty, pour off grease until you only have 4-5 tbsp left. Step 2: Using a colander, strain tomatoes into an 8-qt sauce pan and rough chop the tomatoes. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, garlic, hot water and cooked pork and bones to tomatoes. Step 4: Bring to rapid boil and continue boiling for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 5: Add spices, chopped hot peppers and chopped chili strips and continue to boil for 20 more minutes, stirring frequently. Step 6: Lower heat to medium and continue cooking for 20 minutes. Step 7: Remove bones and ready to serve May be refrigerated for 1 week or frozen for three months.

Ingredient Names: pork roast, tomatillos, jalapeno chiles, serrano chilies, anaheim chilies, fresh cilantro, green chilies, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, chicken broth, oregano, ground cumin, chili powder, all-purpose flour, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In the bowl of a food processor, add the tomatillos, jalapeñ O, serrano and anaheim chiles, if using, and cilantro and puré E them all. Step 2: Add the can of green chiles, diced tomatoes and tomato sauce to the food processor Continue blending until the mixture is a consistent color. Step 3: Pour the mixture into a slow-cooker. Step 4: Add the chicken broth, oregano, cumin and chili powder. Step 5: Turn the slow-cooker on high heat and cover. Step 6: Meanwhile, dust the pork with flour, salt and pepper. Step 7: In a large frying pan over medium heat, warm the oil.

Ingredient Names: cream, queso fresco, sugar, walnuts, pomegranate, cilantro, white onion, cooking oil, ground beef, blanched slivered almonds, cinnamon, cumin, raisins, green olives, dried fruit
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce: in a blender combine first 4 ingredients until smooth The sauce is to be served at room temperature, do not heat For the filling: in a large saut pan cook onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until golden brown. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and cook until beef is done. Step 3: Stuff chiles with meat mixture For the batter: beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Step 4: In a separate bowl beat yolks well. Step 5: Fold yolks into beaten whites. Step 6: Sprinkle about 2 1 / 2 tablespoons of the flour on top and fold it into the egg mixture. Step 7: Sprinkle a plate with a layer of flour and lay each stuffed chile in it.

Dish Name: Chiles En Nogada No Egg Batter
Ingredient Names: ground beef, ground pork, vegetable oil, raisins, walnuts, blanched almond, stuffed green olive, apricots, tomatoes, garlic clove, onion, heavy cream, cream cheese, sweet sherry, poblano chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Chile preparation: If you have a gas stove, roast chiles on the open flame, two at a time Be sure the skin is charred on all sides, but not burned through the chile You'll know when to turn chiles when the skin stops making popping sounds. Step 2: When each chile is thoroughly roasted, place it in a plastic bag and wrap for 5 minutes so chiles "sweat" This will facilitate peeling Peel, but do not open or deseed Pickle: In a sauce pan, heat oil and fry onions until soft. Step 3: Add chopped garlic and herbs.

Ingredient Names: swiss cheese, whole green chilies, eggs, flour, oil, stewed tomatoes, onions, chicken bouillon cube, salt, dried oregano, pepper, sharp cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Insert a strip of cheese into each chile. Step 2: In a medium sized bowl, beat egg whites until they form soft peaks. Step 3: In a small bowl, beat egg yolks slightly Gently fold into egg whites. Step 4: Add 3 tablespoons flour, and fold in just until blended. Step 5: In a heavy saucepan or deep fryer, slowly heat 1 1 / 2 to 2 inches vegetable oil to 400 degrees. Step 6: Roll the chiles in flour With a large slotted spoon dip the floured chiles into the egg mixture, coating liberally Gently place in hot oil, 2 at a time, and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 3 to 4 minutes. Step 7: Preheat oven to 350.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, white onion, tomato sauce, fresh tomatoes, cumin, chicken bouillon, water, onion, poblano peppers, mozzarella cheese, queso fresco, vegetable oil, toothpick, batter, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Blend garlic, tomatoes, cumin, chopped onion, chicken bullion, tomato sauce, and water until its all into liquid form. Step 2: Make sure there are no chunks of any thing, set aside. Step 3: Stuff chilies with cheese and hold together with toothpicks One tooth pick per chile is fine. Step 4: Set aside Batter: With a high speed mixer beat egg whites to stiff foamy peaks are formed and in a separate bowl combine the egg yolks with one tablespoon flour and salt and mix well. Step 5: Then bled the yolks into egg whites and beat until you have a thick paste and its well incorporated. Step 6: Dust chiles in the flour and dip quickly into batter and when completely covered lay in hot oil.

Ingredient Names: white onions, lard, tomatoes with juice, cinnamon, black pepper, chicken stock, poblano peppers, monterey jack cheese, vegetable oil, skewers, eggs, salt, flour, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Brown onions in lard. Step 2: Add tomatoes, cinnamon and pepper. Step 3: Cook briskly until sauce becomes the consistency of a thick tomato sauce. Step 4: Add stock, simmer partially covered for 45 minutes. Step 5: Stuff chiles with cheese and hold together with skewers Batter: beat whites to stiff peaks with 1 / 2 tsp salt. Step 6: Beat in yolks 2 at a time until well incorporated, beat in flour. Step 7: Dust chiles with flour and dip quickly into batter then lay in 350 degree oil Baste tops with hot oil.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, bread, monterey jack cheese, eggs, milk, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Mash chilies with a fork and spread on 3 slices of bread. Step 2: Top with cheese and remaining bread. Step 3: In a shallow bowl, beat eggs and milk. Step 4: Dip the sandwiches in milk mixture. Step 5: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Step 6: Cook sandwiches until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted adding additional butter if necessary.

Dish Name: Chiles Rellenos With Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, anaheim chilies, fresh orange juice, salt, goat cheese, monterey jack cheese, eggs, all-purpose flour, yellow cornmeal, vegetable oil, frozen corn kernels, canned black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat broiler. Step 2: Arrange bell peppers and fresh chiles on broiler pan Broil 4 inches from heat, turning with tongs, until skins are blistered, about 20 minutes. Step 3: Let steam in separate covered bowls 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove charred skin from peppers and chiles, set chiles aside. Step 5: Prepare sauce: cut bell peppers in half. Step 6: Remove stems and seeds. Step 7: Place peppers, orange juice and 1 / 4 t Salt in food processor or blender and process just until smooth.

Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, onion, garlic cloves, bacon, chili powder, salt & freshly ground black pepper, red wine, chicken broth, chopped tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the beans in water overnight. Step 2: Drain and combine with the remaining ingredients in a large pot. Step 3: Bring to a boil and reduce the heat to low. Step 4: Simmer covered for 4 hours, or until the beans are tender and the sauce has thickened, adding more chicken broth if necessary.

Ingredient Names: burritos, chili, oil, cheddar cheese, lettuce, chopped tomato, onion, salsa, sour cream, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large skillet. Step 2: Add the burritos and fry on each side until golden brown and crispy. Step 3: Drain on a paper towel While burritos are frying, heat the chili on stove or microwave To serve: Plate the burrito, top with a ladle of chili, add a handful of lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, and onion. Step 4: Sprinkle a few jalapenos on top Finish with a couple tablespoons of salsa and a dollop of sour cream.

Ingredient Names: chili, green chilies, taco seasoning, rice, water, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, salsa, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chili, green chilies, taco seasoning, rice, and water in a medium sized pot. Step 2: Heat uncovered over low heat about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking to bottom of pan Near the end of cooking time, you will have to stir nearly constantly as the chili will have cooked down to a nice thick consistency. Step 3: Taste and make sure rice is cooked to your preferred softness and check thickness of chili to be sure it will stay in a tortilla Warm tortillas for several seconds in microwave, spread several tablespoons of chili mixture in center of tortillas, add cheese, salsa, and sour cream to taste, and fold into burrito. Step 4: Serve with chips and salsa or green salad.

Ingredient Names: chili, cheddar cheese, eggs, water, salt and pepper, butter, flour tortillas, onion, diced tomato, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Make sure all your ingredients are ready - chili hot, cheese grated, optional ingredients chopped, eggs beaten. Step 2: Heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add butter to pan. Step 3: When butter is melted, add beaten eggs and scramble. Step 4: When eggs are done, remove pan from heat and quickly heat tortillas over open flame, a few seconds on each side To assemble, place half of scrambled eggs on each tortilla. Step 5: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 6: Top with chili And add any optional ingredients Tuck in both sides of tortilla, and roll up, burrito style.

Ingredient Names: jiffy cornbread mix, chili, pam cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to temperature according to cornbread mix. Step 2: Mix jiffy cornbread mix according to directions for 8x8 pan Spray pan with pam cooking spray. Step 3: Spread chili in the bottom of the 8x8 pan, then spread the cornbread batter overtop. Step 4: Bake as directed for cornbread.

Ingredient Names: onion, ground turkey, olive oil, black beans, kidney beans, garbanzo beans, diced tomatoes, cinnamon, cumin, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions in olive oil in very large pan or big pot until soft. Step 2: Add turkey and chunk up and brown. Step 3: Add everything else. Step 4: Let simmer for 10 minutes, or up to a couple hours depending on how thick you want it I like the taste better, but the convenience of the above recipe is great.

Ingredient Names: lard, flour, black pepper, salt, garlic powder, ground cumin, dried oregano, chili powder, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Stir in the flour and continue stirring for 3 to 4 minutes, or until it makes a light brown roux. Step 3: Add all the dry ingredients and continue to cook for 1 minute, constantly stirring and blending ingredients. Step 4: Add chicken broth or water, mixing and stirring until the sauce thickens. Step 5: Turn heat to low and let sauce simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add water to adjust the thickness Makes 2 cups.

Dish Name: Chili Lime Cumin Beef Skirt Steak Skewers
Ingredient Names: skirt steak, tomatillos, anaheim chilies, red onion, olive oil, salt and pepper, fresh lime juice, chipotle chile in adobo, garlic, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef steak crosswise into three equal pieces. Step 2: Combine marinade ingredients in small bowl. Step 3: Place beef and marinade in food-safe plastic bag. Step 4: Turn beef to coat Close bag securely and marinate in refrigerator for one hour. Step 5: Soak twelve 9-inch bamboo skewers in water for one hour, drain. Step 6: Meanwhile, combine tomatillos, anaheim peppers and onion wedges in medium bowl, drizzle with oil, toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, sour cream, green onion, chili powder, turmeric, garlic powder, milk, salt and pepper, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, cover potatoes with water and cook until tender, drain potatoes, mash potatoes. Step 2: Mix in sour cream, green onions, chili powder, turmeric, and garlic powder Gradually mix in milk until potatoes reach desired consistency. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Serve topped with cheese.

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, monterey jack cheese, yellow onion, garlic clove, eggs, salt, creme fraiche
Instructions: Step 1: If making crema fresca equivalent, mix cream and sour cream in medium bowl. Step 2: Cover and let stand at room temperature until thickened, 8 hours or overnight. Step 3: Chill until ready to use Char chilies over gas flame or in broiler until blackened on all sides. Step 4: Wrap in plastic bag and let stand 10 minutes to steam Peel and core chilies Slit one side lengthwise to open, remove seeds. Step 5: Rinse if necessary, pat dry. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, water, whipping cream, butter, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, polenta, mexican crema
Instructions: Step 1: Cut roasted, peeled chilies into thick slices. Step 2: Combine chili, water and whipping cream in a blender. Step 3: Blend until smooth. Step 4: Pour the mixture into a saucepan, heat to a boil. Step 5: Add the butter, salt and pepper Slowly stir in the polenta. Step 6: Turn the heat to low and cook, stirring, until the polenta grains have softened, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Serve with a dollop of the crema as a garnish You can also roast them over an outdoor grill.

Ingredient Names: eggs, water, flour, whole green chilies, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Separate the eggs, beat the whites until stiff then fold in the yolks, water and flour. Step 2: Remove seeds and clean chilies, then stuff with cheese. Step 3: Spoon a portion of the egg mixture onto a heated frying pan then place a chili on top of the mixture. Step 4: Then add another portion of egg mixture on top of the chili Brown one side then the other.

Ingredient Names: pork chops, brown sugar, ground cumin, chili powder, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Trim fat and slash edges at 1 inch intervals In bowl, combine dry ingredients. Step 2: Stir in oil Rub all over chops. Step 3: Grease grill and cook until juices run clear Approx 8 minutes.

Dish Name: Chili's Fajita Recipe Copycat By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: lime juice, olive oil, garlic cloves, soy sauce, salt, liquid smoke, cayenne pepper, black pepper, sirloin steaks, water, spanish onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the lime juice, oil, garlic, soy sauce, salt, liquid smoke, peppers, and either the sirloin or the chicken in a plastic container with cover, or a zipper top plastic bag and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 2: Discard leftover marinade. Step 3: Grill meat over medium flame 4-5 minutes on each side. Step 4: Cut meat into thin strips. Step 5: Set aside and keep warm. Step 6: Combine the 2 tbls Water, soy sauce, lime juice, salt, and pepper, set aside. Step 7: Cook onion and peppers in oil until brown, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, dry mustard, celery, cinnamon sticks, onion, brown sugar, green peppers, salt, clove, cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Scald, then peel tomatoes, cook 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain off half juice. Step 3: Chop remaining vegetables, add tomatoes. Step 4: Simmer about 90 minutes. Step 5: Tie spices in cloth bag. Step 6: Add bag of spices and remaining ingredients to tomato mixture Continue cooking 90 minutes. Step 7: Remove bag of spices.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, enchilada sauce, chili, queso sauce, four-cheese mexican blend cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Warm tortillas for about 30 seconds in microwave, enough to make them soft and pliable. Step 2: Pour enough enchilada sauce to just cover bottom of greased 9 x 12 glass baking dish. Step 3: Fill each tortilla with about 1 / 3 cup chili. Step 4: Roll each tortilla and place seam side down in the sauce-lined pan. Step 5: Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the stuffed tortillas, being sure to completely cover all of them Use a spoon to spread over any exposed areas Warm queso slightly then drizzle lightly over tortillas Finish by topping with shredded cheese. Step 6: Bake at 350f for 30 minutes, until sauce is bubbly.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork shoulder, tomatoes, onions, celery, dry oregano, rubbed sage, dried bay leaves, green bell pepper, anaheim chilies, poblano peppers, cooked rice, fresh cilantro stem
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork in a wide nonstick frying pan. Step 2: Drain about 1 / 2 cup liquid from tomatoes into pan. Step 3: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 4: Then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, uncover pan. Step 5: Add onions, celery, oregano, and sage. Step 6: Cook over high heat, stirring often, until liquid has evaporated and drippings are browned, add bay leaves. Step 7: Cut up tomatoes then add tomatoes and their remaining liquid and stir to scrape browned bits free. Step 8: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, monterey jack cheese, flour, eggs, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Drain and rinse the chilies, and cut a slit down the side of each Gently remove seeds& pith inside. Step 2: Stuff each chili with a 1 / 2-inch square piece of cheese 1-inch shorter than the chili Slightly overlap the cut edges of the chili to hold cheese inside. Step 3: Roll each chili in flour in a shallow pan to coat all over, gently shaking off excess. Step 4: Beat the egg whites into soft peaks Separately beat the yolks with 1 tbs water plus the flour and salt until thick& creamy. Step 5: Fold the beaten whites into the yolk mixture. Step 6: Heat about 1 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Dip the stuffed chilies into the fluffy batter, place them in a saucer, and slide them into the hot oil.

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, colby cheese, eggs, egg whites, low-fat milk, all-purpose flour, dried cilantro, baking powder, salt, cayenne pepper, picante sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 2: Remove stems, seeds, and veins from pepper. Step 3: In a medium-size saucepan, bring a large amount of water to a boil. Step 4: Add peppers and cook, uncovered, for 3 minutes. Step 5: Drain peppers and invert onto paper towels. Step 6: Cut the 4 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese into pieces to fit inside pepper pieces. Step 7: Place cheese inside pepper pieces. Step 8: Arrange pepper pieces in a lightly greased 11"x7"x2" baking dish. Step 9: In a medium-size bowl, whisk together the eggs, egg whites, and milk Whish in the flour, cilantro, baking powder, salt, and cayenne.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, butter, onion, eggs, sour cream, all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, corn tortillas, monterey jack cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f Slit ea chili lengthwise & spread open. Step 2: Place in a single layer in a greased 7x11 inch glass baking dish. Step 3: In a sml skillet, melt butter over med-heat. Step 4: Add onion, cook till tender & remove from heat. Step 5: In a lrg bowl, combine onion mixture, eggs, sour cream, flour, salt & pepper. Step 6: Stir in tortilla pieces + cheese & pour over chilies. Step 7: Bake 25-30 min or till a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Step 8: Serve immediately w / sour cream & salsa -- or cool, cover & refrigerate till ready to serve To serve after refrigeration: cover & bake in a preheated 350f oven for 30-35 min or till heated through.

Ingredient Names: mild green chilies, ground beef, onion, dry sherry, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground cumin, tomatoes, sugar, vinegar, fresh cilantro, toasted almond, all-purpose flour, eggs, water
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the chilies under a preheated broiler until the skin is charred. Step 2: Place in a plastic bag, seal well and let stand for 20 minutes. Step 3: Make a slit in the side of each chili and remove the seeds, leaving the stems intact. Step 4: Set aside Brown the meat and onion together in a heavy-based skillet over a medium heat. Step 5: Pour off any extra fat, then add the garlic and sherry and boil down until it has nearly evaporated. Step 6: Season with salt, pepper, cinnamon, cloves and cumin then add the tomatoes, sugar and vinegar and cook over a medium heat until the tomatoes have reduced into a thick, strongly flavored sauce. Step 7: Stir in the cilantro and almonds and heat through This is the picadillo mixture. Step 8: Stuff as much of the picadillo into the chilies as will fit the dust each with flour and set aside.

Ingredient Names: brewed coffee, cayenne pepper, chocolate ice cream, kahlua, whipped cream, bittersweet chocolate, chocolate, coffee beans
Instructions: Step 1: Pour one cup of coffee into ice cube tray and place in freezer until frozen. Step 2: Mix the remaining cup of coffee with cayenne pepper and pour into a jar and chill in fridge, until the ice cubes are ready to use. Step 3: Put three of the coffee ice cubes into blender, next add coffee, chocolate ice cream and kahlua, puree until all the ice is crushed If you prefer a thicker drink add more of the coffee ice cubes at this point until the desired thickness is achieved. Step 4: Pour into a tall glass and garnish with chocolate whipped cream and sprinkle with bittersweet flaked chocolate and crushed chocolate covered coffee beans.

Ingredient Names: masa dough, pinto beans, red onion, pork, salt, ancho chilies, dried oregano, ground cumin, fresh parsley, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Filling: cook pork with water and salt, 1 1 / 2 hours or until tender. Step 2: Cool and shred In blender or food processor make salsa with chiles, oregano, cumin, parsley and garlic. Step 3: Add to meat and bring to boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer until sauce thickens Gorditas: prepare masa as indicated on package. Step 5: Mix with pinch of salt Form masa into gorditas. Step 6: Cook in comal or skillet until lightly golden. Step 7: Slice each gordita into halves without separating them.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, ground turkey, garlic cloves, onion, chili powder, cumin, red pepper flakes, cayenne pepper, kosher salt, black pepper, oregano, sharp cheddar cheese, sour cream, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Turn oven to 200 degrees. Step 2: Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven to soften and warm. Step 3: In a bowl, combine ground turkey with garlic, onion and spices. Step 4: Mix by hand until well incorporated. Step 5: Cook turkey mixture in skillet over medium heat until meat is done. Step 6: Drain off most of excess fluid. Step 7: Heat oil in skillet on stove on medium-low heat. Step 8: Remove torillas from oven and fill with about 1 / 4 of turkey mixture. Step 9: Wrap torilla envelope-style and set seam side down on platter. Step 10: Repeat until you have 8 burritos.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, fajita seasoning mix, water, canola oil, burrito-size flour tortillas, lettuce, cheese, salsa, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground turkey. Step 2: Add seasoning and water acording to pkg directions. Step 3: Remove meat from pan. Step 4: Heat enough oil in pan to fry, about half full. Step 5: Wrap portion of meat into tortilla, burrito style. Step 6: Fill all torillas till meat mixture is gone With tongs place chimichangas two at a time in heated oil, seam-side down. Step 7: Fry till golden brown on both sides. Step 8: Serve topped with lettuce, cheese, salsa and sour cream Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: beef round steak, salt and black pepper, onion, green bell pepper, ketchup, water, olive oil, worcestershire sauce, garlic, dried oregano, celery seed, chipotle chile
Instructions: Step 1: Place beef in bottom on a 9x13 baking dish. Step 2: Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper. Step 3: Top beef pieces evenly with the onion rings and green pepper rings. Step 4: In a bowl, mix together the ketchup, water, olive oil, worcestershire sauce, garlic, oregano, celery seed and ground chipotle chile. Step 5: Pour the sauce over the beef and vegetables, trying to cover beef as much as possible. Step 6: Place baking dish in oven and roast at 350 for 45-60 minutes, or until beef is done and vegetables are soft If beef dries out during cooking, spoon some of the pan sauce over the beef. Step 7: Serve beef with roasted vegetables on top, and spoon more pan sauce over each serving if you like.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, vegetable oil, cumin seed, onion, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, fresh oregano, whole cloves, bay leaf, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, water, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rub some salt and pepper on the pork shoulder. Step 2: In a dutch oven heat the oil over medium-high heat Sear the pork shoulder on all sides until it is browned. Step 3: Remove the pork and set aside for now. Step 4: Add the cumin seeds to the pan and toast in the hot oil until fragrant. Step 5: Add the chopped onions and saute until lightly browned on the edges. Step 6: Then add the garlic and chopped chipotle peppers and saute until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 7: Add the whole can of tomatoes including the liquid, bay leaves, dried oregano, cloves, chicken stock or some water and scrape up the browned bits on the bottom of the pan. Step 8: Add the pork back to the pan and bring the contents up to a boil then lower to a bare simmer Braise until the pork is fall-apart tender, about 3 - 4 hours.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breast, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, cilantro, lime, red bell pepper, scallions, avocado, butter, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the 2 tbs Oil in a large saut pan over medium-high. Step 2: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and sear for 6 minutes on each side until cooked through and browned all over Move to a cutting board and let sit for 5 minutes. Step 3: Then dice the chicken. Step 4: Transfer bell peppers to pan and cook until they just begin to soften, about 3 minutes remove from pan. Step 5: In a food processor, combine the cilantro, lime juice, chipotle peppers and the adobo sauce Process until smooth. Step 6: Add the chicken back and peppers to the pan, along with the chipotle sauce. Step 7: Toss until combined.

Ingredient Names: ground round, ground venison, pork sausage, onion, garlic, green pepper, tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, chipotle chiles in adobo, adobo sauce, chili powder, cumin, dried oregano, salt, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large dutch oven brown meats till crumbled. Step 2: Drain all but 1 tablespoon of drippings. Step 3: Saute onion, green pepper, and garlic about 10 minutes. Step 4: Add meat back to dutch oven. Step 5: Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, chipotles, adobo sauce and seasonings. Step 6: Stir well and simmer for at least 1 hour. Step 7: Serve with condiments of choice!

Ingredient Names: pork chops, salt, pepper, light olive oil, white onion, garlic cloves, chipotle chiles in adobo, adobo sauce, dried oregano, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Season both sides of the chops with salt and pepper. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large texas skillet on medium heat and brown the chops on both sides for about 1 minute per side. Step 3: Remove the chops to a plate In the same skillet, heat the other tbsp of oil and add the onions, garlic, and chopped chipotle peppers. Step 4: Saute the vegetables until the onions are soft, about 2 or 3 minutes. Step 5: Turn the heat down to low. Step 6: Stir in the oregano, cumin, and adobo sauce. Step 7: Stir all together and heat through, about 2 or 3 more minutes. Step 8: Add the chops back to the skillet and keep the heat on low. Step 9: Spoon the pepper and onion mixture over and around the chops.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, fresh cilantro, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce, fresh lime juice, kosher salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the ingredients in a small bowl and mash together with a fork or wooden spoon until the mixture is well combined Form into a log shape in plastic wrap, parchment, or waxed paper and refrigerate for up to two weeks or freeze for up to three months.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, fresh cilantro, adobo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in small bowl Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, honey, adobo sauce, salt, chipotle peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Puree all ingredients in a blender. Step 2: Pour the marinade into a zip-lock bag. Step 3: Add chicken or pork and marinate 30 minutes in the fridge, occasionally flipping the bag to distribute.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, dried chipotle powder, fresh cilantro, honey, vegetable oil, balsamic vinegar, lime, ground cumin, black pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In blender, mix all ingredients except chicken until smooth. Step 2: Pour mixture over chicken and cover I use a zip-loc. Step 3: Marinate in the fridge 4-5 hours or longer for better flavor. Step 4: Grill chicken over medium high heat for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until no longer pink on the center.

Dish Name: Chipotle Mexican Grill Ancho Chile Marinade For Meat Recipe
Ingredient Names: dried ancho chiles, black pepper, cumin powder, fresh oregano, garlic cloves, red onion, vegetable oil, chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak dry chiles in water overnight or until soft, remove seeds. Step 2: Add all ingredients except chicken in food processor. Step 3: Puree until smooth. Step 4: Spread mixture over chicken breasts and refrigerate at least one hour, up to 24 hours. Step 5: Heat grill to about 400 degrees f, or if cooking inside, heat small amount of oil in skillet or grill pan over high heat Salt chicken breasts to taste. Step 6: Grill chicken breasts about4 minutes per side, depending upon thickness, until done. Step 7: Serve with rice, black beans, or choice of side dish. Step 8: Garnish with fresh cilantro.

Dish Name: Chipotle Mexican Grill Barbacoa Burritos By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: apple cider vinegar, lime juice, chipotle peppers, garlic cloves, cumin, dried mexican oregano, ground black pepper, salt, clove, vegetable oil, chuck roast, chicken broth, bay leaves, tomatoes, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Make adobo sauce by combining vinegar, lime juice, peppers, garlic, cumin, oregano, black pepper, salt and clove in a blender or food processor and puree on high speed until smooth Trim the fat from the meat, and then slice the roast into 6 smaller pieces Sear all sides of the chunks of meat in 2 tablespoons of oil in a large stockpot or dutch oven over medium heat until browned. Step 2: Add the adobo sauce to the meat, pour in the chicken broth, and add the bay leaves. Step 3: Cover the pot, turn your stove to med / low heat and let the meat simmer for 5 to 6 hours or until meat easily flakes apart. Step 4: Turn meat every 30 minutes as it cooks. Step 5: After 4 hours, keep the lid off the pot At the 5-hour mark, you should be able to tear meat apart into bite-size chunks with tongs As soon as your meat is in the pot, make pico de gallo by combining all ingredients in a bowl. Step 6: Cover and chill for several hours while the barbacoa is cooking.

Dish Name: Chipotle Mexican Grill Braised Pork Shoulder Recipe
Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, olive oil, onion, tomatoes, garlic cloves, cumin powder, fresh oregano, whole cloves, bay leaves, dried chipotle chiles, water, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Generously salt and pepper the pork shoulder. Step 2: Let meat come to room temperature, about 2 hours. Step 3: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Step 4: Add olive oil to a large ovenproof pan Sear the pork over medium-high heat until very brown on all sides. Step 5: Remove pork from the pan. Step 6: Let rest on a platter for 10 to 15 minutes Leaving an even coating, drain excess oil from the pan. Step 7: Add onions Sweat over low heat until translucent.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground lean pork, onion, garlic cloves, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, pepper, mild salsa, chipotle peppers, fresh coriander, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese, sweet green pepper, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, heat half of the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Fry pork, breaking up with fork, until no longer pink, about 8 minutes, drain off fat. Step 3: Remove pork and set aside In same skillet, heat remaining oil. Step 4: Fry onion, garlic, cumin, ground coriander, salt and pepper, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Return pork to pan. Step 6: Add salsa and chipotle peppers. Step 7: Simmer, stirring, until thickened and saucy, about 3 minutes. Step 8: Stir in fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, orange juice, salt, butter, shallots, white wine, chicken stock, cilantro, chives, canned chipotle chile
Instructions: Step 1: Put tenderloins in 2 large plastic bags. Step 2: Add 1 c orange juice and 1 tsp salt to each. Step 3: Chill 3 hours or overnight To make the sauce, in a saucepan melt butter, add shallots, saute until soft. Step 4: Add wine, reduce for about 10 minutes. Step 5: Add 4 c orange juice, and chicken stock, bring to boil and cook until reduced to 1 3 / 4 c, about 45 minutes. Step 6: Add cilantro, chives, and chipotles. Step 7: Prepare grill or broiler. Step 8: Remove pork from marinade, wipe dry. Step 9: Grill or broil about 20 minutes, turning often.

Dish Name: Chipotle Pork Tenderloin With Black Bean Salsa
Ingredient Names: chipotle chile, garlic cloves, white onion, fresh lime juice, sherry wine vinegar, mexican oregano, pork tenderloin, black beans, grape tomatoes, fresh cilantro, chipotle chiles, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Make the pork marinade: process chile, garlic, onion, lime juice, vinegar, and oregano in a blender until smooth Rub marinade all over the pork. Step 2: Transfer pork to a dish, and cover with plastic wrap. Step 3: Refrigerate overnight. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 5: Heat a grill pan over high heat. Step 6: Grill pork until seared on all sides, about 2 minutes per side. Step 7: Transfer pan to the oven. Step 8: Cook until an instant-read thermometer inserted into center of meat registers 145 degrees, 20 to 25 minutes. Step 9: Let pork stand at room temperature 5 to 10 minutes before slicing.

Ingredient Names: sweet corn, poblano chiles, red onion, jalapenos, fresh cilantro, lime juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat barbecue grill Roast corn and chilies on the grill Let cool Cut corn off the cob Dice poblano chilies Combine ingredients in a bowl Stir to incorporate.

Dish Name: Chipotle Sauce For Burgers Or Grilled Chicken
Ingredient Names: ranch dressing, ground cumin, chipotle chile in adobo
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the ingredients at least a few hours before using so the flavors have a chance to blend Recipe #2: 1 envelope ranch dressing mix, 2 cups sour cream, 1 / 4 cup fresh cilantro, juice of 1 / 2 of a lime, 1-2 t chipotle pepper in adobo sauce. Step 2: Mix all together Recipe #3: 2 cups ranch dressing, 1 / 2 cup salsa, 1 / 2 t chipotle chili powder or chili powder and cayenne.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, water, crushed red pepper flakes, chipotle chiles in adobo, salt, pepper, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and garlic for 5 minutes or until onion is tender and lightly browned. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, uncovered. Step 4: Serve topped with crumbled mexican cheese, queso blanco, and sliced green onion or maybe even a dollop of pico de gallo.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, chili powder, onion powder, chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic cloves, salt, beer, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chili powder, onion powder, chipotles, garlic, salt, and beer in a small bowl If you are using beans, use 1 cup beer, less if you are not. Step 2: In a skillet over medium heat, pour the spice mixture over the meat and cook until the sauce reaches the consistancy you want--approximately 20 minutes. Step 3: Serve with tortillas, guacamole, roasted red pepper, tomatoes, salsa, etc.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, olive oil, lean ground turkey, yellow onion, green bell pepper, garlic cloves, ground cumin, pinto beans, diced tomatoes, chipotle chiles, adobo sauce, cheddar cheese, fresh cilantro leaves, cornbread mix, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Grease an 8-inch baking dish with the butter and set it aside. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add the ground turkey, the onions, green peppers, and garlic and cook until the turkey is no longer pink and is cooked through, about 8 minutes. Step 5: Drain off any excess fat and sprinkle the meat mixture with the cumin. Step 6: Add the beans, tomatoes, chiles and adobo sauce to the skillet and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 7: Reduce the heat to medium and simmer until heated through and slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Remove pan from the heat and stir in the cheese and cilantro. Step 9: Spread the turkey mixture in the prepared baking dish, pressing down on it with the back of a spoon to make an even, compact layer. Step 10: Combine the cornbread mix with milk and egg and spread the cornbread batter over the turkey mixture and bake until the cornbread is golden-brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat flour, sesame seeds, black pepper, turkey breast cutlets, olive oil, onion, garlic clove, chipotle chiles in adobo, ground cumin, unsweetened cocoa, cinnamon, balsamic vinegar, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Step 2: Sprinkle turkey with mixture. Step 3: Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add turkey. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes on each side or until browned, remove from pan. Step 5: Heat remaining teaspoon oil in pan. Step 6: Add onion and saut 3 minutes until the onions are softened and browned a bit on the edges. Step 7: Stir in the cocoa, cumin, chipotle pepper and cinnamon. Step 8: Add the vinegar, broth and tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: pork, salt, chili powder, vinegar, garlic, oregano, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Grind pork. Step 2: Add one at a time Salt, chili powder, vinegar, garlic, oregano, and cumin, mixing well after each addition Pack in a crock, or glass jar for at least 8 hours but preferably 24 hours. Step 3: Cook as needed in skillet It will look like ground meat May be frozen.

Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, chili powder, mexican oregano, salt, cumin, garlic cloves, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients well It is important that the mixture marinate at least overnight in the fridge to allow the vinegar and spices to correctly flavor the meat Mexican oregano can usually be found in all grocery stores and usually will be in the section where the spices are in bags and hanging on hooks, don't substitute until you have exhausted your efforts I usually fry loosely until browned and then add eggs and serve in warm tortillas. Step 2: Add a little ranch dressing and cheddar cheese and you are in breakfast heaven Or or or eat the chorizo by itself, it is sooo good and you know what is in there Read the ingredient list on store bought chorizo and it will blow your mind Kinda gross actually. Step 3: Now you can enjoy chorizo with peace of mind.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, minced garlic cloves, salt, black pepper, mexican chili powder, oregano, cumin, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, sweet onions, green bell pepper, garlic, black beans, rotel, diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: The night before, make the chorizo by combining the meat and seasonings thru the red wine vinegar. Step 2: Refrigerate and let set overnight Next day, saute the meat in large skillet and drain off grease. Step 3: Set aside In 5 quart cooker, saute onion and green pepper in evoo. Step 4: When onion is translucent, add rest of ingredients, add the chorizo. Step 5: Let simmer for 30 minutes on med Low If you like a thicker chili, mash some of the beans with a hand potato masher.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, onion, garlic cloves, fresh jalapeno pepper, tortillas, cooking oil, monterey jack cheese, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For filling, in a medium skillet cook chorizo or sausage, onion, and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender. Step 2: Drain off fat Pat chorizo mixture with paper towels to remove as much additional fat as possible. Step 3: Stir in jalapeno pepper, set aside. Step 4: Brush one side of 3 tortillas with half of the cooking oil. Step 5: Place tortillas, oiled sides down, on a large baking sheet. Step 6: Spread the chorizo filling over tortillas on baking sheet. Step 7: Combine cheese and cilantro or parsley. Step 8: Sprinkle over filling.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, potato, eggs, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, salt and pepper, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In small pan boil potatoes until soft Time depends on the size of the dice. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Meanwhile, remove casings from chorizo. Step 4: Cook over medium heat in a non stick skillet until browned. Step 5: Drain But do not wipe out skillet You want a small amount of the fat to remain. Step 6: Add cooked sausage back into pan, stir in potatoes.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, eggs, onion, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, hot sauce, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Fry a chopped onion and chorizo together until onion is tender and translucent. Step 2: Add 6 to 8 beaten eggs after everything is nice and brown. Step 3: Keep'em moving until cooked. Step 4: Serve it on a sour cream coated pan-grilled tortilla, add a bit of grated monterrey jack and avocado. Step 5: Serve with more sour cream and hot sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, chorizo sausage, garbanzo beans, diced tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil. Step 2: Remove chorizo from casings and add to the frying pan, breaking it up as you brown it. Step 3: Add canned tomatoes, salt and drained beans. Step 4: Simmer for about 30 minutes. Step 5: Serve over rice or in tortillas You can top with cheese, sour cream, cilantro, or green onion.

Dish Name: Chorizo And White Cheddar Breakfast Burritos
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, eggs, butter, chorizo sausage, salt and pepper, white cheddar cheese, sour cream, black beans, chopped tomato, red onions, fresh cilantro, spicy vegetable juice, garlic, green onions, salt
Instructions: Step 1: For black bean salsa: in a bowl, add all salsa ingredients and stir to mix. Step 2: Let rest 30 minutes so that flavors can blend. Step 3: Store covered in the refrigerator For burritos: wrap tortillas in foil and warm in 350 degree oven for about 2 minutes. Step 4: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, melt 1 tablespoon of butter Scramble eggs until desired degree of doneness. Step 5: Remove skillet from heat. Step 6: Add sausage, salt and pepper to taste and stir to combine. Step 7: Spoon 1 / 4 of the egg-sausage mixture into the center of the tortilla. Step 8: Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese.

Dish Name: Chorizo Black Bean Breakfast Burritos Oamc
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chorizo sausage, green bell pepper, butter, eggs, adobo seasoning, black beans, pico de gallo, chihuahua cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep pan, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add sausage and bell pepper. Step 3: Cook for about 8-10 minutes, crumbling the sausage every now and then. Step 4: When sausage is cooked through, remove from pan and drain of fat Wipe the grease from the pan, then melt the butter over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the beaten eggs and adobo seasoning, and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until the eggs are scrambled and cooked through, remove from heat. Step 6: Add the drained black beans and pico de gallo to the pot. Step 7: Stir to combine well. Step 8: Now, prepare your burritos.

Ingredient Names: potato, eggs, salt, white pepper, asiago cheese, chorizo sausage, onion, green bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water. Step 2: Boil for 4 minutes or until tender. Step 3: Drain and cool slightly. Step 4: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt and pepper. Step 5: Add 1 / 4 cup cheese and set aside. Step 6: In a large non-stick, broiler-proof skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 7: Add sausage and cook, stirring constantly for about 3 minutes. Step 8: Add onion, garlic and bell pepper and saute until soft, about 4 minutes. Step 9: Add potatoes to the pan and continue to cook until golden brown, about 4 minutes. Step 10: Stir in egg mixture and mix well.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, potatoes, onion, green pepper, jalapeno pepper, chorizo sausage, tomatoes, eggs, cheddar cheese, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat flat grill or a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the vegetable oil, potatoes, diced onion, green pepper, jalapeno pepper, if using, and Chorizo. Step 3: Mix together slightly. Step 4: Cook for 4 to 8 minutes, flipping once. Step 5: Add the tomato and eggs. Step 6: Mix together and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes, flipping over once. Step 7: Add cheese and cook until slightly melted. Step 8: Mix hash together to distribute cheese and tomatoes throughout. Step 9: Serve with toast or tortillas.

Ingredient Names: elbow macaroni, milk, cornstarch, shredded cheddar cheese, monterey jack pepper cheese, chorizo sausage, red onion, flour, lime juice, breadcrumbs, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cornstarch with the 2 cheeses in a bowl and set aside The cornstarch will help prevent the cheese from getting too stringy. Step 2: Put the milk into a small saucepan and heat until steamy. Step 3: Keep warm, do not boil. Step 4: Put 2 qts Of water, salted with 1 tblsp Salt, into a large pot and heat to a boil. Step 5: Once the water is at a full boil, add the macaroni. Step 6: Return to a boil, and cook, uncovered for about 2 minutes less than the macaroni package specifies While the macaroni is cooking, prepare the chorizo cheese sauce.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, brown button mushrooms, fresh rosemary, fresh thyme leave
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium heat and add the chorizo and cook, turning occasionally for 5 mins or until golden brown. Step 2: Add the mushroom and cook stirring for 5 minutes or until mushroom softens. Step 3: Stir in the rosemary and thyme and toss until combined. Step 4: Transfer to a warm serving bowl and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, salt, red chili powder, dried red chilies, garlic, dry oregano leaves, whole cumin seeds, fresh ground black pepper, sugar, cider, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat in a large bowl Have everything cool Break up the meat, sprinkle evenly with the rest of the ingredients. Step 2: Make sure everything is evenly mixed by kneading the mixture with your hands At this point the chorizo will keep for at least a couple weeks in your refrigerator, or let it season for a couple days in your refrigerator, then wrap it in small packages,, and it will freeze fine for months It can also be stuffed into casings and smoked like any other pork sausage.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, chunky salsa, cooking spray, flour tortillas, mexican blend cheese, avocado, green onions, fresh cilantro, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler In large skillet crumble and cook chorizo over medium heat until no pink remains. Step 2: Drain in colander In small saucepan, heat salsa over medium heat until heated through Lightly coat large baking sheet with cooking spray. Step 3: Arrange tortillas, two at a time, on baking sheet. Step 4: Top each with equal amounts of cheese Broil 3-4 inches from heat for 2-3 minutes, until cheese is melted. Step 5: Top each pizza with equal amounts of the warm salsa, cooked chorizo, avocado, green onions, and cilantro. Step 6: Serve with lime wedges and enjoy this south of the border treat!

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, white onion, shiitake mushrooms, yukon gold potatoes, salt, fresh cilantro, corn tortillas, tomatillo salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Crumble chorizo in a large nonstick skillet and place over medium heat. Step 2: Cook, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes or until sausage is half cooked Increase heat to medium-high. Step 3: Add onion and mushrooms Continue to cook, stirring almost constantly, for about 3 minutes or until vegetables begin to soften. Step 4: Sprinkle potatoes into skillet. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, for 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are soft. Step 6: Season to taste with salt. Step 7: Transfer mixture into a bowl and top with cilantro. Step 8: Serve in tortillas with roasted tomatillo salsa.

Ingredient Names: tostadas, potatoes, chorizo sausage, lettuce, queso fresco, avocado, salt, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pan fry chorizo until it changes color and gives off some of its oil. Step 2: Add cubed potato and continue sauteeing until potato absorbs chorizo color and flavor. Step 3: Place a portion of this on each tostada. Step 4: Top it with shredded lettuce, crumbled cheese and avocado slices. Step 5: Season with salt to taste and your favorite chile salsa.

Dish Name: Chorizo Quinoa Stuffed Poblano Peppers With Adobo Chile T
Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, garlic cloves, chipotle pepper, sugar, poblano peppers, chorizo sausage, chili powder, oregano, ground cumin, olive oil, yellow onion, tomatoes, cooked quinoa, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Tomato sauce: Put diced tomatoes, garlic, and chipotle peppers into a food processor or blender and blend until relatively smooth. Step 2: Pour sauce into a medium saucepan, add sugar, and bring to bubbling and then simmer on medium-low while you prepare the rest of the recipe. Step 3: Stir occasionally Filling: Brown chorizo sausage in a large saute pan or skillet with 1 t chili powder, oregano, and cumin. Step 4: Remove and set aside. Step 5: Pour olive oil into the same pan over medium-high heat and add onion / bell pepper. Step 6: Saute about 5 minutes, until soft. Step 7: Add diced tomato and cook for about 2-3 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, dried new mexico chiles, dried chile de arbol, boiling water, garlic, dry oregano leaves, ground cumin, fresh ground black pepper, dark brown sugar, cider vinegar, tequila, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Break the colorin chiles into 3 pieces, and put them and the dearbol peppers in a bowl. Step 2: Pour the boiling water over them and let them sit until they're re-hydrated and soft. Step 3: Place the re-hydrated chiles together with the liquid into a food processor and add the garlic, oregano, cumin, black pepper, sugar, vinegar, tequila, and salt, and process until the mixture is smooth. Step 4: Place ground pork and the liquid mixture into a sturdy electric mixer and mix well. Step 5: When secured in a sealed container, this chorizo keeps well in the refrigerator for a couple of weeks I usually let it sit in the fridge for a couple of days to let the flavors meld, then divide it into smaller portions of 3 to 4 ounces and freeze it If you have casings, you can also stuff it into those and smoke it - very tasty!

Dish Name: Chorizo Stuffed Poblano Peppers Can Sub Sweet Peppers
Ingredient Names: poblano peppers, chorizo sausage, onion, garlic cloves, corn kernel, tomato paste, oregano, cilantro, cumin, cotija cheese, monterey jack cheese, salt and pepper, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Saute chorizo for 6-8 minutes, gently breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Step 4: Stir in onions, garlic and corn. Step 5: Cook for 2-3 more minutes, then add tomato paste, oregano, cilantro and cumin. Step 6: Stir until well combined. Step 7: Mix in cotija cheese, then remove from heat. Step 8: Taste and season with salt and pepper as needed. Step 9: Slice poblano peppers lengthwise, keeping the stem intact and remove seeds. Step 10: Spoon chorizo mixture into peppers and sprinkle with shredded cheese.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, salt, red chili powder, dried red chilies, garlic cloves, dry oregano leaves, whole cumin seeds, fresh ground black pepper, sugar, cider vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix well and cook through or add to your favorite recipe This is great mixed up with scrambled eggs!

Dish Name: Chorizo Wraps With Veggies 30 Minute Meal
Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, smoked paprika, onions, bell peppers, corn on the cob, limes, taco sauce, sour cream, lettuce, colby cheese, kalamata olive, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan and add chopped chorizos. Step 2: Saute for 5-10 minutes, until sausages pieces are done You can chop the veggies while the chorizo is cooking. Step 3: Remove chorizos and set aside, and drain off all but one tablespoon of the oil that has cooked out of the chorizos Reheat the oil and add smoked paprika and stir well. Step 4: Add chopped onions and bell peppers and saute for 5 minutes, until softened. Step 5: Add chopped corn kernels and saute for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add lime juice and 1 / 4 cup of the taco sauce and cook for 2 minutes You want the lime juice to mostly evaporate. Step 7: Add cooked chorizos and let everything heat through for another 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, red peppers, marinated artichoke hearts, corn tortillas, garlic, cheese, scallions, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a skillet, then add the chorizo and saute until browned. Step 2: Place the tortillas on a baking sheet. Step 3: Divide the chorizo and artichoke hearts between the 4 tortillas. Step 4: Divide between the 4 tortillas: the garlic, the roasted red pepper, the cheese, and finally the scallions (or shallots). Step 5: Place them under a heated broiler and broil until the cheese melts and starts to sizzle. Step 6: Remove from broiler, and sprinkle with tomato and cilantro. Step 7: Dollop with sour cream if using, then serve hot.

Ingredient Names: serrano chilies, vegetable oil, roasted green chilies, chicken broth, rotel tomatoes & chilies, water, cumin, white pepper, curry powder, season-all salt, fresh cilantro, cayenne pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large stainless kettle, brown pork in bacon fat or vegetable oil. Step 2: Cook on medium heat till meat is slightly pink. Step 3: Add diced onion and garlic, cook till soft. Step 4: Add flour and stir, browning flour as you would a roux. Step 5: Add some of your water if flour is too thick, keep stirring till it bubbles, add chicken broth. Step 6: Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a bubble, then turn heat to low. Step 7: Cook uncovered for 2-3 hours, stirring occasionally If your chile is too thin, add more flour If your chile is too thick, add more chicken broth.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, tomatillos, cilantro leaf, heavy cream, egg, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Blend all ingredients, in blender or food processor Cover whatever you're cooking generously with this sauce, as it soaks in, as it cooks.

Dish Name: Chuy's Hatch New Mexican Green Chile Sauce
Ingredient Names: corn oil, all-purpose flour, onion, garlic, green chilies, beef broth, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In heavy-bottomed sauce pan, saute onions in corn oil until they begin to brown. Step 2: Add garlic and cook another 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir flour in with onions and garlic so that it thickens. Step 4: Add chopped chilies, beef broth and salt and mix well. Step 5: Bring to a boil and simmer 10 to 15 minutes to allow mixture to reduce The sauce should be thick enough to bind chilies and onions together Sauce can be refrigerated for three days, or frozen.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, creme fraiche, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Puree cilantro, creme franche, and lemon juice in blender until smooth. Step 2: Season to taste with salt and pepper Refridgerate at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend.

Dish Name: Cilantro Lime Chicken Tacos With A Mango And Black Bean Salsa
Ingredient Names: limes, olive oil, garlic cloves, cumin, onion powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salt & freshly ground black pepper, fresh cilantro, fat, mangoes, black beans, green onions, jalapeno, lime, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Place first 8 ingredients in a large zip lock back and combine thoroughly. Step 2: Add the chicken breasts and mix until the breasts are evenly coated. Step 3: Place in the refrigerator to marinate for 2-4 hours Peel and chop the mango. Step 4: Rinse and drain the black beans. Step 5: Chop the green onions, jalapeno and cilantro. Step 6: In a small bowl, combine the lime juice and cumin until well mixed. Step 7: Place the mango, black beans, green onions, cilantro, and jalapeno in a large bowl. Step 8: Pour the lime / cumin mixture over and mix gently. Step 9: Taste - add more lime juice if needed.

Dish Name: Cilantro Lime Pork Roll Ups With Caramelized Onions
Ingredient Names: lime zest, fresh lime juice, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil, boneless pork, onions, fat-free refried beans, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese, salsa, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In large resealable food-storage plastic bag, mix lime peel, lime juice, garlic, cilantro, red pepper flakes and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Step 2: Add pork Seal bag and turn to coat with lime mixture. Step 3: Refrigerate 30 minutes to 2 hours to marinate In 12-inch nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat, add onions. Step 4: Cook 7 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until onions turn golden brown. Step 5: Remove onions from skillet, keep warm. Step 6: Heat oven to 375f.

Ingredient Names: minced garlic cloves, salsa verde, lime juice, white vinegar, milk, fresh cilantro, sour cream, mayonnaise, salt, ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients together in a bowl and mix well Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: ground cumin, onion powder, paprika, chili powder, salt, chicken tenders, olive oil, red onion, bell pepper, frozen corn, garlic cloves, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce, rice, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f lightly coat a 13x9 in baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: In a medium bowl combine cumin, onion powder, paprika, salt, and chili powder. Step 3: Add chicken and toss to coat, set aside. Step 4: Heat a 12 inch saute pan over medium high heat and add 2 tbls oil. Step 5: Saute red onion for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add corn and bell peppers saute 5 minutes then add garlic. Step 7: Saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes more. Step 8: Remove from pan and set aside In same pan over medium low heat add chipotle pepper, adobo sauce, remaining olive oil, and rice.

Ingredient Names: tonic water, clam juice, vodka, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix it all together Set on fire Give to your friends if you don't want to be friends with them anymore.

Ingredient Names: milk, bittersweet chocolate, instant coffee powder, ground nutmeg, orange rind
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a heavy medium saucepan. Step 2: Stir over low heat until chocolate melts Increase heat and bring just to boil, stirring often. Step 3: Remove from heat and whisk until frothy. Step 4: Return to heat and bring just to boil again. Step 5: Remove from heat and whisk until frothy. Step 6: Repeat until it is nice and thick. Step 7: Pour hot chocolate into mugs.

Ingredient Names: kahlua hazelnut, dark creme de cacao, butterscotch schnapps, half-and-half
Instructions: Step 1: Pour kahlua, creme de cacao and schnapps in exact order over ice Slowly add half and half The effect is like clouds hanging over a dark sky. Step 2: Stir briskly before drinking.

Ingredient Names: coca-cola, limes, canola oil, green onion, yellow onion, fresh cilantro, jalapeno, garlic clove, crushed red pepper flakes, sea salt, ground cumin, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: I mix all of my ingredients in a bowl and pour over the meat in a shallow dish Refrigerate overnight, turning meat occasionally Grill it up!

Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, achiote paste, garlic cloves, onion, allspice berries, dried mexican oregano, cumin seed, cracked black pepper, bay leaves, worcestershire sauce, limes, orange, apple cider vinegar, habaneros, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork in a freezer bag or other large plastic bag, strong trash bags work well Dry toast mexican oregano & cumin seeds in a hot, heavy skillet one at a time, stirring or shaking the pan to prevent burning They are done when color has deepen and little wisps of smoke are formed. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients, except banana leaves in a blender or food processor pour in with pork, seal bag, and distribute well to coat meat Be careful not to get on hands it will stain them red! Step 3: Marinate at least 2 hours or overnight in frig, overnight is best If banana leaves are frozen, thaw and rinse well in cool water If you can use fresh banana leaves you will need to wilt them over the burner on your stove, be careful not to burn them. Step 4: Heat them until they are pliable. Step 5: Line the bottom of a heavy roasting pan with 2 or 3 banana leaves, long enough to be able to fold over the roast covering it completely.
