Ingredient Names: pork butt, achiote paste cubes, orange, lime, white vinegar, ground allspice, salt and pepper, banana leaves, corn tortilla, red onion, whole allspice, whole black peppercorns, habanero pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To make the marinade: In a large glass or plastic dish use a fork to dissolve the anatto paste in the orange and lime juice and the vinegar, add the all-spice. Step 2: Rinse and pat the pork roast dry. Step 3: Remove and discard any fat lumps Rub the salt and pepper all over the meat and place in the dish with the marinade. Step 4: Turn the meat to cover it in the marinade. Step 5: Let marinate for at least 1 hour, but no more than 6 hours, in the refrigerator, turning occasionally. Step 6: Take the meat out of the refrigerator and preheat the oven to 375 degrees for 20 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, turn on a burner in you stove to low heat.

Ingredient Names: brown sugar, mccormick cocoa chile blend, garlic powder, salt, oregano leaves, pork tenderloin
Instructions: Step 1: Mix brown sugar, cocoa chile blend, garlic powder, salt and oregano in small bowl Coat pork evenly with seasoning mixture. Step 2: Refrigerate overnight for best flavor or at least for a couple of hours before cooking. Step 3: Grill over medium heat 25 to 30 minutes or until desired doneness is achieved, turning occasionally. Step 4: Transfer pork to cutting board. Step 5: Cover loosely with foil. Step 6: Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

Dish Name: Coctel Bandera Mexicana Mexican Flag Cocktail
Ingredient Names: tequila, limes, ice, powdered sugar, banana, thompson seedless grapes, maraschino cherries
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the sugar and lime juice thoroughly, and then pour in tequila Shake with chopped ice and serve in cocktail glasses. Step 2: Drop into each glass a grape, cherry and banana ball.

Ingredient Names: red beans, pork knuckle, vegetable oil, lard, tomatoes, green onion, cumin, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pork knuckle into little pieces, the size of your thumbnail. Step 2: In a non stick pan, fry the pork until the pieces are crisp, and golden brown in colour. Step 3: Remove from pan, and drain. Step 4: Rinse the beans and run them through your hands to make sure that there are no small stones or bits of earth among them. Step 5: Put the beans, pork fritters and lard into the pot and add enough water to cover the beans. Step 6: Boil for about 2 hours stirring occasionally every 20 minutes, covered until they are tender, but not soft. Step 7: In a separate pan, saut the green onions and tomatoes for about 8- 10 minutes, until you get a nice thick sauce and all the tomatoes are dissolved. Step 8: Remove from fire and add the tomato sauce to the bean stew. Step 9: Add the salt, cumin and cilantro, and simmer for another 30 minutes, adding water if necessary, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, italian sausage, green chilies, onion, cumin, chili powder, pepper, cheddar cheese, deep dish pie shell, sour cream, lettuce, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Poke holes in the crust with a fork and pre-bake 10 minutes. Step 2: Fry the sausage with the onion and spices until the onion is tender. Step 3: Layer meat, green chilies and cheese into crust. Step 4: Mix eggs and milk / cream together in a bowl with a bit of salt. Step 5: Pour over meat mixture in the crust. Step 6: Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes or until a knife in the middle comes out clean. Step 7: Cut into wedges and top with lettuce, sour cream and a tomato wedge. Step 8: Serve with salsa if desired.

Dish Name: Copycat El Torito Mexican Corn Cake
Ingredient Names: jiffy cornbread mix, creamed corn, milk, light corn syrup
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together very well. Step 2: Pour into greased 8 inch square pan. Step 3: Bake at 350 f for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, sweet corn, black beans, rotel, shredded cheddar cheese, jiffy cornbread mix, eggs, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees Brown the ground beef. Step 2: Mix corn bread mix, eggs, and milk while the ground beef is cooking, drain ground beef. Step 3: Return to heat ground beef, taco seasoning, corn, black beans, and rotel. Step 4: Once, beef mixture is heated through, pour into baking dish. Step 5: Sprinkle on a layer of shredded cheese. Step 6: Pour corn bread mixture on top and spread around evenly. Step 7: Bake for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Corn Cheese And Chili Tamales With Tomatillo Avocado Salsa
Ingredient Names: tomatillos, onion, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, avocados, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, corn husks, poblano chile, masa harina, unsalted butter, sugar, salt, low sodium chicken broth, frozen white corn
Instructions: Step 1: Salsa: Cook tomatillos, onion, garlic and chilies in heavy large skilllet over high heat until charred in spots but still firm, turning occsionally, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Transfer to food processor or blender. Step 3: Using on / off setting, chop coarsely. Step 4: Add all remaining ingredients. Step 5: Blend to course puree. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Cover and chill Tamales: Selecting 18-20 large clean husks, place in large bowl and fill with warm water.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, flour, milk, mexican blend cheese, chili powder, granulated garlic, fresh corn, olive oil, italian sausage, salsa, jalapenos, sour cream, cilantro leaf, kosher salt, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in the flour until completely combined, then slowly whisk in the milk until smooth. Bring to a simmer and cook until starting to thicken, about 3-4 minutes. Slowly whisk in 8 ounces of shredded cheese until completely melted. Season with chili powder, granulated garlic, salt and pepper. Keep warm over low heat. Step 2: Spread the mini corn dogs in an even layer on a baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes, flipping once. Step 3: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Brown sausage, breaking into pieces, until golden and cooked through, about 5-8 minutes. Remove corn dogs from the oven and top with 4 ounces shredded cheese, then spoon over cooked sausage. Top with another 4 ounces of cheese and return to the oven to bake until cheeses are melted, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from oven and top with pico de gallo, jalapeno slices, sour cream and cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: lard, masa harina, sea salt, baking powder, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the lard until light and fluffy Add remaining ingredients, using just enough liquid until the dough holds together well.

Dish Name: Costillitas En Naranja Mexican Ribs In Orange Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: bacon fat, country-style pork ribs, onions, tomatoes, garlic, ancho chilies, cinnamon, clove, fresh orange juice, dry white wine, unrefined sugar, orange rind, salt, cider vinegar, orange slice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat fat in a 5 quart dutch oven. Step 2: Add ribs in a single layer to brown on all sides 15-20 minutes If necessary remove browned ribs and brown remainder ribs. Step 3: Remove ribs and discard all but 2 tbsp fat. Step 4: Add onions, saute until soft, 4 minutes Process tomatoes and garlic in food processor or blender until smooth. Step 5: Add chilies, cinnamon and cloves to the onions cook& stir for a few seconds. Step 6: Add tomato, cook 5 minutes or until bubbling. Step 7: Add orange juice, wine orange rind, salt and sugar cook until bubbling. Step 8: Lower heat, add ribs, cover and simmer until the ribs are very tender, about 1 1 / 2 hours.

Dish Name: Cottage Cheese Cheddar Enchiladas With Taco Sauce
Ingredient Names: cream-style cottage cheese, old cheddar cheese, fresh garlic, tomatoes, green onions, chili powder, seasoning salt, diced green chilies, corn tortillas, taco sauce, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Step 3: In a bowl mix together cottage cheese, 1-1 / 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, tomatoes, green onions, chili powder, seasoned salt and green chilies. Step 4: Divide the mixture between the 8 corn tortillas. Step 5: Roll up the tortillas and place seasom-side down in the baking dish. Step 6: Drizzle the taco sauce over the tortillas and thne sprinkle with 1 cup grated cheddar cheese. Step 7: Bake for 15-20 minutes or until hot and the cheese has melted.

Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, cooked turkey, whole berry cranberry sauce, black beans, salsa, colby-monterey jack cheese, sour cream, green onions, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, salt, ground black pepper, wheat flour tortillas, bottled hot pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Lightly coat a 3-quart rectangular baking dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Set aside For filling, in a large bowl stir together turkey, half the cranberry sauce, beans, 1 / 2 cup of the salsa, 3 / 4 cup of the cheese, sour cream, green onions, cilantro, cumin, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Spoon about 2 / 3 cup filling on each tortilla. Step 4: Roll up tortillas around filling. Step 5: Place, seam sides down, in prepared dish. Step 6: Set aside For sauce, in bowl stir together remaining cranberry sauce, remaining salsa, and hot pepper sauce. Step 7: Spoon over filled tortillas.

Ingredient Names: tequila, lemon juice, triple sec, cranberry juice, ice cubes, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Moisten rim of margarita or martini glass with lemon juice Hold glass inverted and dust exterior portion with granulated sugar. Step 2: Place ice cubes in cocktail shaker and top with tequila, lemon juice, triple sec, and cranberry juice Replace lid on shaker and shake vigorously. Step 3: Pour into prepared glass and serve Salud!

Ingredient Names: fresh cranberries, celery ribs, white onion, jalapeno chile, fresh cilantro, salt, sugar, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Chop cranberries coarsely, and place in a mixing bowl. Step 2: Add all other ingredients and stir to combine. Step 3: Check salsa for seasoning and spice. Step 4: Cover, and refrigerate several hours to develop flavors fully.

Dish Name: Cream Cheese Stuffed Jalapenos W Bacon
Ingredient Names: jalapenos, cream cheese, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: Devein jalapenos by scraping insides with a potatoe piller, wash well. Step 2: Stuff each jalapeno with approx 1 oz of cream cheese They come with several in a package but each packet is one ounce and you can easily squeese it into the jalapenos this way) Much easier than using a spoon. Step 3: Slice bacon in 1 / 2. Step 4: Top the opening of each jalapeno with 1 / 2 slice of bacon and secure with a tooth pick. Step 5: Cook on grill or open flame until done We prefer the jalapeno to be black in some parts.

Ingredient Names: cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, evaporated milk, onion, chilies, boneless chicken, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except cheese and tortillas, bring to boil. Step 2: Layer tortillas, chicken mixture, and cheese. Step 3: Bake 20-30 minutes at 325. Step 4: Let set 10-15 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, green onions, butter, flour, chicken broth, sour cream, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: For each tortilla, add 1 / 2 cup cheese and 1 tablespoon green onion as filling. Step 2: Roll each individually and place in a shallow 8-inch square baking dish In medium-sized saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Step 3: Add flour, stirring constantly. Step 4: Whisk in chicken broth to make a thick sauce. Step 5: Remove from heat and add sour cream and green chilies, stir until smooth. Step 6: Pour sauce over tortillas and bake at 350 degrees farenheit for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic powder, rotel, cream cheese, cooked chicken breasts, black beans, corn kernel, cumin, flour tortillas, red enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Add vegetable oil to skillet & heat on medium. Step 2: Add diced tomatoes with green chilis to pan along with 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder. Step 3: Stir & bring to a simmer. Step 4: Allow to simmer ~5 minutes or until liquid decreases by half. Step 5: Cut cream cheese into pieces & stir into tomato mix. Step 6: Rinse & drain beans. Step 7: Add beans, corn, chicken & cumin to pan, stir, add salt to taste. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, ancho chili, roma tomatoes, garlic cloves, water, chipotle chile, adobo sauce, chicken bouillon powder, sour cream, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the red chiles, ancho chile, tomatoes, garlic and water in a small sauce pan. Step 2: Bring to a boil Continue boiling for 15 minutes until the red chiles are soft. Step 3: Place the tomato and chile mixture in the blender with the chipotle chile, the reserved adobo sauce and 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Step 4: Blend the mixture on high for 5 minutes. Step 5: Strain the mixture and pour it back into your sauce pan. Step 6: Bring the sauce to a low boil and continue to simmer for 10 minutes If you like your sauce thin you can now add an additional 1 / 2 cup of water or cooking liquid. Step 7: Whisk in the chicken bouillon powder and continue to simmer the sauce another 10 minutes. Step 8: Turn the heat down to low and whisk in your sour cream.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour, garlic cloves, milk, chipotle chiles in adobo, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat. Step 2: Whisk in flour and garlic Whisking constantly, gradually add milk, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and continue to cook, stirring frequently until thickened. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in chipotle puree and salt to taste. Step 5: Serve with stuffed mexican chicken medallions.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, garlic clove, flour, chicken broth, ground cumin, oregano, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: In saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Step 2: Saute onion and garlic until transparent. Step 3: Stir in flour until well-mixed and golden brown Slowly stir in broth and remove lumps. Step 4: Add chiles, cumin, and oregano and stir well. Step 5: Reduce heat to simmer. Step 6: Cook, uncovered, about 15 minutes. Step 7: Serve over burritos or your favorite tex-mex food.

Ingredient Names: butter, green onion, mexican-style corn, green chilies, honey, sour cream, cream cheese, breadcrumbs, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, melt 2 teaspoons butter over medium heat, add onions. Step 2: Cook and stir 1 minute or until tender. Step 3: Add corn and chiles. Step 4: Cook 2-4 minutes or until thoroughly heated Stirring occasionally, stir in honey. Step 5: Add sour cream and cream cheese, mix well. Step 6: Cook 2 minutes or until cream cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly, stirring occasionally.

Ingredient Names: spring onion, garlic cloves, butter, frozen chopped spinach, cottage cheese, sour cream, monterey jack cheese, corn, mild enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pre heat oven to 375f in a medium size sauce pan cook onions and garlic in butter for 2 minutes, add spinach. Step 2: Cook for 3-4 minutes stirring occasionally, remove from heat. Step 3: Stir in cottage cheese, sour cream, 1c of shredded cheese The tortillas need to be gently warmed so that they will not crack when you roll them up. Step 4: Spoon about 1 / 4 cup filling down center of each tortilla and roll up. Step 5: Place seam side down in 13"x9" baking dish. Step 6: Top with enchilada sauce and remaining cheese bake for 15-20 minutes until bubbly I suggest serving with shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, sliced black olives and additional sour cream and chopped spring onions!

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, beef, refried beans, salsa, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat sandwich maker Lightly mist wells with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Place a tortilla in the sandwich maker, top with 1 tbsp Each: meat, beans, salsa, and cheese. Step 3: Top with remaining tortilla Close and cook for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Serve with a dollop of sour cream and some shredded lettuce.

Ingredient Names: mature cheddar, wholemeal tortillas, avocados, cherry tomatoes, red chile, fresh cilantro, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Sprinkle the cheese over the tortillas, then sandwich them together in pairs, so you have 2 tortilla sandwiches. Sit on baking sheets and bake for 8-10 mins until golden, crispy and the cheese is melted. Step 2: Halve the avocado and spoon out chunks onto the 2 tortillas; squash into the tortillas a bit with the back of the spoon. Scatter over tomatoes, chilli, coriander and seasoning. Squeeze over some lime and eat immediately.

Ingredient Names: pork, chili powder, onion, oregano, red wine vinegar, salt, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chile powder with water to form a thick paste. Step 2: Blend paste, one cup onion, oregano, salt and vinegar in a blender. Step 3: Add mixture to pork cubes in ziploc bag, along with 1 / 2 cup onion and bay leaves. Step 4: Marinate pork in mixture overnight. Step 5: Cook in crock pot on "auto" for 8-10 hours.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, onion, fresh jalapeno pepper, orange rind, dr. pepper cola, fajita-size flour tortillas, tomatoes, jalapeno pepper, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh lime juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine pork, onion, jalapeno, orange peel and soda in a crock pot. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Step 3: Uncover and shred the meat using 2 forks. Step 4: Serve on flour tortillas and top with pico de gallo, if desired For pico de gallo: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, seasoning to taste with salt and pepper. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate until ready to use Makes 1 1 / 2 cups The carnitas can be served rolled into flour tortillas or in taco shells Topping options include pico de gallo, guacamole or shredded cheese with a bit of taco sauce.

Ingredient Names: dry pinto beans, pork roast, onion, garlic cloves, chicken broth, chili powder, cumin, oregano, diced green chilies, tapioca, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in crock pot. Step 2: Cook covered, until beans are done and meat falls apart easily About 5-6 hours on high Shred pork and put on tortillas with cheddar cheese You need to buy the quick-cooking tapioca that may come in a little red 8 oz box You would find this by the jello mixes I would guess that you could use cornstarch or flour instead of tapioca but i havent done that before.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, rotel tomatoes, corn tortillas, mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chicken, soup, sour cream and rotel together Spray your crock pot with non-stick spray or use crock pot liner and lay 3 tortillas on the bottom. Step 2: Then layer 1 / 3 of the chicken mixture and 1 / 3 of the cheese. Step 3: Repeat the layers two more times starting with tortillas and ending with cheese. Step 4: Cook on low for 6 hours. Step 5: Serve with chips or cornbread and a salad.

Ingredient Names: oil, white onion, garlic cloves, pork shoulder, whole green chilies, jalapenos, diced tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onion and garlic in oil until fragrant. Step 2: Add cubed meat and brown. Step 3: Put all ingredients in crock pot. Step 4: Cook on high for 3 hours. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and cook for 4-5 hours or until meat is very tender.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, taco seasoning, green enchilada sauce, tomatillos, diced green chilies, condensed cream of mushroom soup
Instructions: Step 1: Put pork roast in crock pot. Step 2: Blend the remaining ingredients together in a bowl and pour over pork roast. Step 3: Cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 6 hours. Step 4: When the roast is done it will be tender and shred easily. Step 5: Serve in tortillas with your favorite taco ingredients.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Chipotle Chicken And Pintos
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, pinto beans, green chilies, chipotle chiles, chicken gravy mix, spanish rice mix, water, olive oil, tomatoes, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken, pinto beans, green chiles, chipotle chiles, and gravy mix in this order in crock pot. Step 2: Cover and cook on low heat setting 8-10 hours About 30 minutes before serving, make spanish rice mix as directed on package, using water and oil. Step 3: Meanwhile, gently stir tomato into chicken mixture To serve, spoon about 1-1 / 4 cups chicken mixture over 1 / 2 cup rice. Step 4: Sprinkle with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: hot water, beef bouillon, cabbage, yellow hominy, mild green chilies, yellow onion, celery, roasted garlic, roasted red peppers, fresh ground black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, chorizo sausage, salt and pepper, fresh cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In the crock pot on high temperature, dissolve the bouillon in the hot water. Step 2: Add the cabbage, hominy, chiles, onion, celery, garlic, bell pepper, and freshly ground black pepper Over a high temperature in a skillet, saute the unskinned chorizo sausage in olive oil until browned, about 7 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Add cooked chorizo to the crock pot. Step 4: Simmer on high for 3 to 4 hours, or until it has reached the texture you prefer. Step 5: Add salt and pepper to taste, add your favorite garnishes, and enjoy. Step 6: Serve along with nice crusty bread or- even better- cornbread!

Dish Name: Crock Pot Fat Free Refried Beans For The Freezer Oamc
Ingredient Names: dried beans, water, brewed coffee, minced garlic cloves, onions, ground cumin, chili powder, oregano, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Drain soaked beans and place in a crock pot along with remaining ingredients except salt. Step 2: Make sure that the beans are covered with liquid by about 1" Stir well, cover and cook on low all day, about 8-10 hours, until tender. Step 3: Keep an eye on them and make sure they don't get dry. Step 4: Add salt Use a potato masher or heat safe jar bottom to mash well and stir with a wooden spoon Continue to mash and stir until desired consistency To freeze, put in a freezer ziploc and flatten into a layer to freeze, or no more than 2" deep in freezer containers.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork, oil, onion, ground cumin, oregano, chicken broth, diced green chilies, mexican-style tomatoes, garlic, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Brown pork cubes in oil. Step 2: Add onions and cook until they are tender. Step 3: Place pork and onions in crockpot, and add remaining ingredients. Step 4: Cook on low until pork is tender, about 8 hours With a large spoon, stir the mix, breaking the pork into large shreds by pressing the meat cubes against the side of the crockpot.

Ingredient Names: butter, monterey jack cheese, milk, sugar, salt, cayenne, flour, frozen corn, green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all, except corn and chilies, together Add corn and chilies, cover and cook 2-3 hours on low Stir occasionally.

Ingredient Names: fat-free chili, fat-free refried beans, whole kernel corn, salsa, fat free cheese, flour tortillas, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Step 2: In a large bowl stir together the chili, beans, corn, and salsa until well mixed Lay one tortilla flat on the bottom of the crock pot. Step 3: Pour one-fifth of mixture on top Continue layering the tortillas and the remaining four-fifths of the mixture until all the ingredients are used up. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 7hrs. Step 5: Using a sharp knife cut through all the layers, making a checkerboard design on top Each cut out should be about 1 inch apart With a large spoon stir the entire dish to mix up the cut up tortilla pieces Or scoop out of crock pot without stirring up for a more formed meal.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin roast, salsa, green chilies, black beans, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4 quart slow cooker, mix together the pork, salsa, and green chilies. Step 2: Cover and cook on low heat setting for 6 to 8 hours or until pork is tender. Step 3: Stir in black beans. Step 4: Turn slow cooker to high and cook an additional 5 to 10 minutes or until beans are heated. Step 5: Sprinkle with monterey jack cheese.

Ingredient Names: turkey legs, green chilies, onion, minced garlic cloves, worcestershire sauce, chili powder, salt and pepper, tomato sauce, flour tortillas, cheese, sour cream, fresh tomato, lettuce, cilantro, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place turkey thighs in crock pot. Step 2: Add tomato sauce, chilies, onion, garlic, worcestershire, chili powder, salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours. Step 4: Remove turkey from crock pot, shred meat and discard the bones. Step 5: Return the meat to the pot and stir to mix sauce and meat thoroughly. Step 6: Spoon meat and sauce into a tortilla and garnish with the tomatoes, lettuce, lettuce and salsa.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin roast, onion, barbecue sauce, salsa, chili powder, mexican seasoning, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Trim off excess fat from pork. Step 2: Place pork in slow cooker and place onions on top of roast. Step 3: Mix remaining ingredients together except tortillas, pour over pork. Step 4: Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 to 10 hours or until pork is very tender, remove pork. Step 5: Place on large platter or cutting board and pull pork apart. Step 6: Place pork in serving bowl and pour sauce on top. Step 7: Spoon filling into tortillas and roll up.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork butt, tomato paste, barbecue sauce, white vinegar, dark brown sugar, lime zest, chili powder, garlic cloves, salt, coleslaw, scallion, taco shells, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork in 3 quart slow cooker. Step 2: Combine next 8 ingredients, spoon over pork. Step 3: Cover On low, cook until very tender, 12 hours, transfer to plate. Step 4: Using 2 forks, shred. Step 5: Return pork to sauce in cooker. Step 6: Toss coleslaw with scallion. Step 7: Serve pork in taco shells with coleslaw and tomato.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Pulled Pork Tacos And Then Some
Ingredient Names: boneless pork shoulder, brown sugar, cajun seasoning, salt, cumin, paprika, fresh ground black pepper, chili powder, mesquite powder, frozen apple juice concentrate, cider vinegar, corn tortillas, sour cream, avocados, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Making the pork: combine brown sugar through mesquite powder. Step 2: Spread over entire roast. Step 3: Refrigerate roast in a ziploc bag for up to 24 hours. Step 4: Place apple juice and vinegar in a crock pot and add the spiced shoulder being careful not to lose the rub. Step 5: Cook on high for two hours, then reduce to low for 10 more hours. Step 6: Remove the roast and let rest for 30 minutes Pull roast apart with two forks Making the tacos: heat oil in small fry pan on medium-high until hot. Step 7: Fry tortillas for about 30 seconds on each side so they're starting to turn crispy but are still quite pliable. Step 8: Drain on paper towels or paper bag.

Ingredient Names: dry pinto beans, onion, garlic cloves, bay leaves, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: The night before you want to cook the beans. Step 2: Rinse beans several times in warm water. Step 3: Put them in a large pot. Step 4: Cover with cold water up to 2-3 inches above beans. Step 5: Let set over night. Step 6: Drain and rinse beans. Step 7: Layer bacon strips on bottom of crock pot. Step 8: Top with remaining ingredients and beans. Step 9: Cover with water about 1 inch or so above beans. Step 10: Add remaining ingredients to pot.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salsa, taco seasoning, sour cream, sweet corn, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Season chicken on both sides with taco seasoning and put it in the crock pot. Step 2: Pour salsa over it. Step 3: Cook on low 7-8 hours Shred chicken in the crock with a fork and stir in the corn, beans and sour cream. Step 4: Cook 30 more minutes. Step 5: Serve in tortillas, over rice, over chips, salad, or use in your favorite mexican recipe!

Ingredient Names: dried black beans, bacon, onion, liquid smoke, dark molasses, brown sugar, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Soak beans over night. Step 2: Drain the black beans from their soaking water and place in a slow cooker. Step 3: Fill with enough fresh water to cover them. Step 4: Cover and set to high. Step 5: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until fat is rendered, add onions. Step 6: Cook and stir until onions are tender. Step 7: Stir this into the beans along with the brown sugar, liquid smoke, molasses and jalapeno. Step 8: Stir to blend, then cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or until beans are tender.

Ingredient Names: turkey breast halves, green chili salsa, garlic cloves, onion, potato, chicken broth, cumin, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Place the turkey breast half in a 3-1 / 2 quart crockpot. Step 2: Combine remaining ingredients, stirring, and pour over the turkey. Step 3: Cover crockpot and cook on lo heat for 8 to 10 hours To serve: cut the turkey into slices and wrap in the warmed tortillas.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, garlic cloves, fresh jalapeno pepper, fresh cilantro, beer, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: With a knife, cut several small slits into the roast. Step 2: Insert pieces of garlic cloves in roast. Step 3: Place in crockpot with whole pepper and half bunch of cilantro which has been chopped, season to taste, pour in beer. Step 4: Cook on high 4 to 6 hours until fork tender, remove meat Shred. Step 5: Serve with warm tortillas, with by your choice of garnishes Suggested garnishes: diced tomatoes, onions, sliced ripe olives, shredded lettuce, sour cream, cheese, salsa, guacamole, and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, taco seasoning, ranch dressing, chicken broth, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Place breasts in crock pot add remaining ingredients except toppings cook on low 3 hours remove chicken and shread return to pot cook 1 / 2 hour longer make tacos as you like.

Ingredient Names: onion, fresh garlic cloves, olive oil, pork tenderloin, beans, dark red kidney beans, black beans, tomato sauce, sweet corn, mild chili powder, cumin, salt, ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in cast iron skillet or your favorite sautee pan Sautee onion and garlic until translucent and garlic is fragrant Do not brown the garlic as it will become bitter. Step 2: Place pork tenderloin and all remaining ingredients in 5 quart crockpot. Step 3: Add sauteed onion and garlic, stir gently. Step 4: Set crockpot on low heat and let cook for 8-10 hours, until pork tenderloin is soft. Step 5: Put toppings in individual dishes or in a lazy suzan. Step 6: Serve chili in bowls and allow guests to choose their toppings This makes a great fun community meal!

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, onion, green bell pepper, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, tomatoes, minced garlic cloves, chili powder, corn tortillas, sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together first 8 ingredients in a large bowl Tear tortillas into 1 inch pieces. Step 2: Divide into thirds. Step 3: Layer one-third of tortilla pieces in a lightly greased 6 quart slow cooker. Step 4: Top with one-third of chicken mixture and 1 cup of cheese. Step 5: Repeat layers twice. Step 6: Cover and cook on low for 3 1 / 2 hours or until bubbly and edges are golden brown. Step 7: Uncover and cook on low 30 minutes. Step 8: Serve with salad and blue corn chips on the side for a pretty presentation.

Dish Name: Crusted Tilapia With Chipotle Lime Dressing
Ingredient Names: sour cream, adobo sauce, lime juice, lime zest, cumin, chili powder, old bay seasoning, salt and pepper, doritos, dried chipotle powder, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, jalapeno, tilapia fillet
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients for the dressing in a small bowl. Step 2: Set in the frig For two hours. Step 3: In a food processor, put doritos, spices and jalapeno and process until finely crushed. Step 4: Place on waxed paper when ready to cook. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 6: In a med Bowl, whisk egg. Step 7: Dip fish into egg and then coat both sides of the fish with crust ingredients Be sure they are well coated.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, jalapeno peppers, tomatillos, garlic cloves, yellow onion, olive oil, flour, ground cumin, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meat into 2 inch pieces. Step 2: In a large stock pot or hot crockpot put oil, garlic and onion cook until lightly browned then add enough of the meat to cover bottom and brown the meat on all sides. Step 3: Remove and do remaining meat as well. Step 4: Return meat to pot after browned and put enough water to just cover the meat you do not want a lot of water in the pot. Step 5: In a small frying pan fry the jalapeo until skin is lightly blackened on all sides then wrap in a cold hand towel to sweat the skin I usually wet a wash cloth and put it in the freezer when i begin frying the jalapeos. Step 6: In a small pot boil the tomatillos for about 20 minutes or until they are very soft, almost watery feeling The skin should just slide off. Step 7: Remove the skin of the jalapeo and slice open removing the seeds and top Smash in a mortar stone or in a blender or food processor until it becomes a paste.

Dish Name: Cuban Grilled Corn With Cotija Cheese
Ingredient Names: corn, sour cream, mayonnaise, cotija cheese, salt, chili powder, cayenne, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the sour cream and mayonnaise in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Grill ears of corn over medium flame until kernels begin to char, 5-10 minutes Apply sour cream / mayonnaise mixture liberally to hot corn. Step 3: Place the grated cotija cheese and salt in a shallow dish. Step 4: Roll the corn in the cheese / salt mixture until it is well covered. Step 5: Sprinkle the corn lightly with chili powder and cayenne for extra heat! Step 6: Serve with slices of lime.

Dish Name: Cuban Style Pork Roast Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, onions, adobo seasoning, bay leaves, dried oregano, black pepper, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: If pork shoulder comes in a netting, remove it Trim of any large pockets of fat, place in crockpot. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients, roll the pork around in the mixture to coat evenly. Step 3: Cook in crockpot for about 3 hours on medium or 5-7 hours on low. Step 4: Take meat out of crockpot and shred and return to broth, serve and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cumin seed, fresh coarse ground black pepper, garlic clove, olive oil, skirt steak, poblano chiles, sour cream, salt, flour tortillas, onion, tomatoes, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Light a grill or preheat a cast-iron grill pan over low heat for about 10 minutes. Step 2: In a small skillet, toast the cumin seeds over moderately high heat until lightly browned and fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Transfer to a mortar to cool. Step 4: Then, using a pestle, coarsely grind. Step 5: Add the black pepper and garlic and pound to a paste. Step 6: Stir in the olive oil Rub the cumin oil on the skirt steak and marinate for at least 10 minutes or refrigerate overnight Roast the poblano chiles directly on the grill or over a gas flame, turning often, until blistered all over Do not overcook or the flesh will burn. Step 7: Transfer the chiles to a paper bag and let steam for about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: salt, triple sec, tequila, lime juice, maraschino cherry juice, powdered sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Rim glass with salt Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth Pour into glass & serve.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, tomato juice, diced tomatoes, chili beans, red kidney beans, sugar, salt and pepper, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a large dutch oven, brown hamburger& onion until no longer pink, drain and rinse. Step 2: Add back to dutch oven and dump in everything else but the spices. Step 3: Heat up your chili and taste. Step 4: Add salt, pepper, and chili powder until you're happy with it. Step 5: Serve with shredded cheese, oyster crackers& sour cream!

Ingredient Names: tequila, grand marnier, lime juice, salt, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients, except salt, into a cocktail shaker half filled with ice Shake ten times and strain into chilled glass with salted rim and ice, both optional. Step 2: Garnish with lime wheel.

Ingredient Names: hamburger, velveeta cheese, rotel tomatoes, vegetable shortening, corn tortillas, mild cheddar cheese, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the hamburger cut velveeta into half-inch cubes and place in saucepan with 2 cans of rotel tomatoes. Step 2: Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until thorughly melted and blended. Step 3: Stir the browned hamburger into the cheese sauce, then set sauce aside Completely, but lightly cover both sides of one tortilla with shortening, then place the tortilla on a microwave-safe plate Completely but lightly cover one side of the next tortilla and place it atop the first tortilla, shortening side up. Step 4: Repeat until all tortillas are stacked, then microwave the entire stack on high for 5 minutes and allow to cool. Step 5: Combine shredded cheese and chopped onion in a bowl and gently mix together using your hands Lightly cover the bottom of a baking dish with some of the cheese sauce. Step 6: Place a generous portion of the cheese / onion mixture onto a tortilla, then roll the tortilla like a cigar. Step 7: Place into the baking dish, seam side down to prevent the enchilada from unrolling.

Ingredient Names: rice milk, almonds, rice, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Blend rice milk, almonds, rice if using, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg for 1 minute Add ice Blend until mixed.

Ingredient Names: milk, honey, unsweetened cocoa, vanilla, chili powder, whipped cream, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Heat milk with honey and cocoa powder When hot, add vanilla Pour into a cup Top with whipped cream and dash cinnamon.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, ground beef, chili powder, garlic powder, kosher salt, chipotle chiles in adobo, black beans, salsa, cheese pizza, cheddar cheese, sour cream, guacamole, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Step 2: Heat a medium skillet over medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Step 3: When the oil is hot, add the ground beef and cook, crumbling it with a wooden spoon, until well browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Drain off and discard any excess fat. Step 5: Return the skillet to the heat, add the chili powder, garlic powder and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and stir to incorporate. Step 6: Add the adobo sauce and 2 tablespoons water. Step 7: Cook 1 minute to blend the flavors, then remove from the heat. Step 8: Meanwhile, combine the beans and salsa in a small saucepan. Step 9: Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened, 4 to 5 minutes, keep warm.

Ingredient Names: bisquick, beer, eggs, vinegar, garlic powder, avocados, flour, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all batter ingredients. Step 2: Dust avocado wedges with flour. Step 3: Put wedges into batter mixture until coated. Step 4: Fry in deep fat fryer until lightly browned-about two minutes. Step 5: Serve with sour cream and salsa.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, taco seasoning, flour tortillas, colby-monterey jack cheese, pinto beans, green chilies, butter, salt, flour, red chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, tomato paste, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: To make the refried beans: place the drained beans, butter, salt and green chilies in a food processor and puree until smooth To make the enchilada sauce: melt butter / margarine in a sauce pan. Step 2: Make a roux by browning flour in melted butter / margarine. Step 3: Add spices and tomato paste. Step 4: Stir until well blended into roux. Step 5: Add water gradually, stirring constantly. Step 6: Heat until boiling. Step 7: Add broth and continue simmering and stirring until desired thickness is achieved To make layers: brown the ground beef with onion, and drain. Step 8: Prepare with taco seasoning as directed on the package.

Ingredient Names: butter, dijon-style mustard, hot pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place butter in microwave-safe bowl & microwave on high power for 1 minute or till melted Blend in mustard & hot pepper sauce to taste.

Ingredient Names: dark rum, pineapple juice, orange juice, cream of coconut, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Pour over ice it tall collins or daiquiri glass, stir well. Step 2: Garnish with tropical fruit and sprinkle with nutmeg You can also shake this in a cocktail shaker if you so desire --.

Dish Name: Doctored Up Refried Beans In The Microwave
Ingredient Names: refried black beans, salsa, scallions, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix refried beans, salsa and scallions in a microwave safe bowl. Step 2: Cover with plastic wrap and heat on high for 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir and add half of cheese and microwave for another minute Depending on your microwave they should be very hot. Step 4: Add remaining cheese to top and heat for another 30 seconds.

Dish Name: Don Pablo's Frijoles A La Charra
Ingredient Names: bacon, jalapenos, onion, pinto beans, tomatoes, garlic powder, fresh ground pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Saute bacon, jalapeno and onion until well browned. Step 2: Add the beans, tomato and spices. Step 3: Bring to a boil and add cilantro. Step 4: Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, sour cream, chili powder, salt, garlic powder, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, plain doritos
Instructions: Step 1: Crush doritos, enough to just cover the bottom of a 2 quart casserole. Step 2: Mix all other ingredients, except cheese, and place on top of doritos Crush another layer of doritos on top. Step 3: Sprinkle cheese over all. Step 4: Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fat-free refried beans, canned black beans, green chili peppers, ground cumin, lettuce leaves, flour tortillas, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the refried beans, black beans, chilies, and cumin. Step 2: Place lettuce leaves over tortillas. Step 3: Spoon about 1 / 2 cup bean mixture near one edge of each tortilla. Step 4: Top with salsa if desired. Step 5: Roll tortilla burrito-style These can be eaten at room temperature or warmed in the microwave, if desired May substitute hotter peppers, such as jalapeno, if desired.

Ingredient Names: olive bread, purple onions, olive oil, tomatoes, gouda cheese, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Brush the bread slices and onion slices with the olive oil. Step 2: Place the onions on a hot griddle. Step 3: Cook over medium heat until light golden brown. Step 4: Place 2 tomato slices on each of 2 slices of the bread. Step 5: Top each with a slice of gouda cheese. Step 6: Place a grilled onion slice on each of 2 more slices of the bread and top each with a slice of chipotle cheddar cheese. Step 7: Place each stack on a griddle. Step 8: Cook over medium heat until the cheese begins to melt Assemble the sandwiches by inverting the chipotle cheddar cheese stack on top of the gouda cheese stack. Step 9: Top each with the remaining bread slices.

Ingredient Names: pork loin roast, dried onion flakes, cumin, beef bouillon powder, garlic salt, paprika, oregano, onion powder, dried chili pepper flakes, cayenne pepper, dried chipotle powder, cracked black pepper, salt, red wine vinegar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Wash your hands! Step 2: Trim excess fat from roast. Step 3: Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl and rub over the entire surface of the pork. Step 4: Place pork in a slow cooker. Step 5: Add water until roast is approximately half submerged. Step 6: Add vinegar and remaining dry ingredients to the water and stir. Step 7: Place slow cooker on low and leave for 6-8 hours, turning occasionally if you can. Step 8: Remove roast from slow cooker At this stage it's easy to remove any membrane that may be attached to the surface Shred the pork using two forks and transfer to a large frying pan.

Ingredient Names: bacon, smoked duck, yellow onion, ground cumin, salt & freshly ground black pepper, zucchini, yellow squash, carrot, jalapeno, garlic, diced tomato, duck stock, white hominy, sweet corn, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place the bacon in a large, 1-gallon stockpot or dutch oven. Step 2: Cook over medium heat until crispy, 10 to 12 minutes. Step 3: Using a slotted spoon, remove the bacon from the pan and set aside on a paper towel lined plate Increase the heat to medium-high and add the smoked duck to the stockpot Sear until caramelized on all sides, about 4 to 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the onions and cumin and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are soft and begin to caramelize, about 4 minutes. Step 5: Season the onions lightly with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Step 6: Stir in the zucchini, yellow squash, and carrots and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the jalapenos and garlic and cook for 1 minute. Step 8: Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes, making sure to scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, bacon, tomatoes and green chilies, mexican blend cheese, green onions, green pepper, red bell pepper, reduced-fat mayonnaise, lime juice, seasoning salt, pepper, chili powder, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 2: Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until tender 2. Step 3: In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until partially cooked but not crisp. Step 4: Remove to paper towels to drain, set aside 3.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, non-fat cooking spray, popcorn salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Lightly spray cookie sheet and set aside. Step 3: Spray each tortilla shell lightly on each side; sprinkle lightly with popcorn salt. Step 4: Using kitchen scissors (or knife), cut into one inch wide strips (if using for tortilla soup) or cut into wedges (if using to dip with). Step 5: Put on cookie sheets in one layer, laying as close to each other as possible without overlapping. Step 6: Bake at 425 degrees for just a few minutes (3 to 4 minutes watching closely for burning) till they turn a very light brown. Step 7: Remove and enjoy hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, onions, jalapenos, garlic, goya pinto beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet, cook chorizo and drain if necessary. Step 2: Add onions, garlic and Jalapeño, sautéing until soft. Step 3: Add beans and let simmer for 1 hour over low heat and serve with tortillas, sour cream and salsa.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, corn tortillas, longhorn cheese, white onions, butter, eggs, lettuce, red chile pods, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare RED CHILE SAUCE:. Step 2: Wash chile and remove stems and seeds. Step 3: Combine chile and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 4: Lower heat and cook for 15 minutes. Step 5: Let cool and blend in a blender a small amount at a time. Step 6: Strain through a sieve and add salt. Step 7: Store 2 cups in refrigerator for immediate use and freeze remainder for later use. Step 8: Prepare ENCHILADAS:. Step 9: Heat chile sauce over low heat. Step 10: Heat oil in frying pan. Step 11: Using tongs, dip each tortilla in the hot oil just long enough to soften it, dO NOT FRY! Step 12: Place 2 tortillas, one at a time, on an oven proof plate. Step 13: Spoon on one or two tablespoons of the red chile sauce. Step 14: Sprinkle with cheese and onion. Step 15: Repeat the process with 2 more tortillas. Step 16: Put plate in a warm oven to melt cheese. Step 17: Repeat the procedure until all four plates are in the oven. Step 18: Melt butter in a frying pan. Step 19: Fry the eggs the way you like them (Over easy works best with for this dish). Step 20: Place one egg on top of each enchilada plate. Step 21: Decorate edges of plate with shredded lettuce and serve.

Ingredient Names: tomato paste, water, vinegar, canned jalapeno slices, chili powder, dried onion flakes, salt, cornstarch, cayenne pepper, sugar, onion powder, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the tomato paste and water in a saucepan. Step 2: Whisk until smooth. Step 3: Add the remaining ingredients to the tomato mixture. Step 4: Heat over medium / high heat until it begins to boil Continue to cook, stirring often, for 4 to 5 minutes, remove from heat. Step 5: When sauce has cooled, pour into a glass airtight container and refrigerate Stores well in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, garlic, ground cumin, tomato puree, pinto beans, zucchini diagonal, cheddar, green chili, fresh coriander, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in half the olive oil for about 5 mins or until soft. Stir through the garlic and cumin. Cook over a low heat for 1 min more. Add the tomato purée, pinto beans and a few tbsp of water. Heat through, then mash up with the back of a fork and season. Step 2: Meanwhile, toss the courgette slices in the remaining oil with some seasoning. Place on a hot griddle pan and cook for a couple of mins each side until tender and grill marked. Place to one side. Step 3: Mix the cheese, chilli and coriander in a bowl. Spread the bean purée over half of the tortillas. Lay over courgette slices and scatter with cheese mixture. Top with the remaining tortillas, pressing the two together. Cook in batches in the hot griddle pan, carefully turning, for about 1-2 mins each side or until the cheese has begun to melt and the tortillas are crisp. Serve in wedges.

Ingredient Names: butter, ham, swiss cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Place 1 tablespoon of butter in a medium frying pan on medium-high heat. Step 2: Place tortilla in to toast. Step 3: Break up swiss cheese and layer over one half of the tortilla. Step 4: Add ham over the cheese and fold tortilla in half. Step 5: Cook to a desired crispiness on both sides. Step 6: Cut into wedges to serve as an appetizer.

Ingredient Names: green peppers, red peppers, onions, butter, eggs, sour cream, salsa, ham, flour tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute vegetables in skillet with butter or oil until tender. Step 2: Remove from pan and add eggs. Step 3: Scramble fry until cooked and then add sour cream and salsa. Step 4: Add rest of the ingredients, saving one cup of cheese for the topping, and heat through. Step 5: Spoon about 1/2 cup of mixture into center of tortilla and roll up. Step 6: Place seam side down in a casserole. Step 7: Repeat until all tortillas are filled. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 350 degrees until cheese is melted about 20 to 30 minutes. Step 9: Serve with salsa and sour cream. Step 10: These do freeze well, but not for an extended period of time. Freeze after step 7. Wrap well, label and freeze. To serve: place frozen enchiladas into baking pan and bake for 30 minutes or until derfrosted. Top with cheese and then bake as directed.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, paprika, chili powder, red wine vinegar, garlic, ground cumin, oregano, salt, olive oil, lime wedges, tortillas, salsa, guacamole, jalapenos
Instructions: Step 1: Pound pork evenly to 1/4-inch thickness (between plastic wrap is good). Step 2: Blend paprika, chili powder, vinegar, garlic, cumin, oregano, and salt, and rub over all sides of pork. Step 3: Rest meat for at least one hour, refrigerated. Step 4: Cut pork into 3-4 serving pieces. Step 5: Pan-fry meat in the oil on both sides, until cooked to your liking. Step 6: Drain meat and season with additional salt (if desired) and lime. Step 7: Serve on warm tortillas with salsa, guacamole, and sliced fresh chiles (if desired).

Ingredient Names: cooked beef, oil, onion, green pepper, black beans, tomatoes and green chilies, ground cumin, garlic salt, chicken broth, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Shred cooked meat and remove any bones or fat. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet. Step 3: Add onion and pepper and saute until tender. Step 4: Add all ingredients except corn tortillas and cheese, stir together, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium or medium-low and boil for one hour, allowing most of the liquid to cook off Watch and reduce heat if necessary. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350 Spray a 9x13 pan with non-stick spray.

Ingredient Names: low-fat tortilla, fat-free refried beans, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, part-skim mozzarella cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Spray a baking sheet with non-stick cooking spray. Step 3: Spread refried beans on tortilla, like pizza sauce on a pizza. Step 4: Sprinkle seasonings on beans, top with cheese. Step 5: Bake until tortilla is crispy, about 2-2 1/2 minutes. Step 6: Serve with salsa, if desired.

Ingredient Names: plain tortilla chip, ham, salsa, cheddar, jalape os, guacamole sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Step 2: Empty the chips into a large ovenproof dish and scatter over the ham or gammon. Step 3: Spoon over the salsa and bake for 5 mins. Step 4: Sprinkle with the cheddar, then return to the oven for a further 5 mins. Step 5: Top with jalapeños and serve with guacamole and soured cream.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, corn tortillas, onions, jalapeno peppers, garlic, tomatoes, oregano, eggs, sharp cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the tortilla pieces and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until they begin to get crisp, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add the onion, jalapeño pepper, and garlic, and saute for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the onion is transparent. Step 4: Stir in the tomato and oregano; mix well. Step 5: Add the eggs and stir to scramble until the eggs are set. Step 6: Remove the skillet from the heat, add the cheese,and stir until the cheese is melted. Step 7: Top with the salsa and serve.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onions, garlic, stewed tomatoes, green chilies, salt, oregano, eggs, monterey jack cheese, fresh cilantro, guacamole, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: In a 10-inch frying pan, cook bacon until crisp. Step 2: Remove from pan with slotted spoon and drain. Step 3: Add onion and garlic to bacon drippings in the pan. Step 4: Cook until onion is soft. Step 5: Stir in tomatoes, chilies, salt, and oregano. Step 6: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: Continue boiling until sauce thickens, about 15 minutes. Step 8: Reduce heat to low. Step 9: Crack eggs and slowly slip into sauce, one at a time. Step 10: Sprinkle cheese and bacon over the top. Step 11: Cover and simmer until eggs are set, about 5 to 7 minutes. Step 12: Sprinkle with the cilantro. Step 13: Serve with guacamole and warmed tortillas on the side of the plate, if desired. Step 14: Note: The sauce can be prepared a day in advance. Step 15: Reheat and slip the eggs in just before serving.

Ingredient Names: portabella mushrooms, poblano chiles, salsa, jalapeno peppers, queso anejo cheese, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Roast poblano: blacken on a comal or under a broiler, then place in a bowl under plastic wrap for 15 minutes; after that, easily remove skin, slit open, and discard seeds and stem. Step 2: Dice poblano and set aside until needed. Step 3: Preheat oven to 375F. Step 4: Scrape out dark gills from the underside of the mushrooms and make sure the mushrooms are clean. Step 5: Put some foil on a baking sheet and spray with oil and place mushrooms gill side up on it. Step 6: Spread 2 tablesoons of salsa (approximate) on each mushroom, smoothing out- if they are big, add just a touch more, etc. Step 7: Divide out the chopped poblanos among the mushrooms and place over the salsa. Step 8: Sprinkle with sliced jalapenos (this will make the mushrooms spicy) over the poblanos. Step 9: Cover each mushroom with about 1/2 cup shredded queso anejo cheese. Step 10: Place pan in oven and bake for about 18-20 minutes or until mushrooms are cooked and tender. Step 11: Garnish mushrooms with chopped cilantro before serving.

Ingredient Names: black beans, fajita seasoning choice, tomatoes chili, tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat a non-stick frying pan, add the black beans and fajita spice mix, stir together and cook for 1-2 mins. Add the tomatoes and simmer over a low heat for 10 mins. Step 2: Cut the tortillas in half. Lightly grease a 2-litre baking dish. Spread a third of the bean mixture over the base of the dish, followed by 3 tbsp of the cheese and a layer of tortillas. Repeat the process, finishing with a tortilla layer on top. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese. Bake for 15 mins until golden.

Ingredient Names: pork butt, onions, garlic, salt, mexican oregano, ground cumin, seasoning salt, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place meat in 3 qrt sauce pan, add water until meat is just covered. Step 2: Smack garlic with a knife to release flavor add to pot along with onion, salt, oregano and cumin. Step 3: Bring to boil, skim skum, reduce heat, cover simmer 2 hours. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350. Step 5: Drain meat, place in baking dish, sprinkle evenly with season salt and garlic powder. Step 6: You have a few options here. Step 7: You can either bake it whole, break into chunks (Dh prefers this) or shred thickly (I prefer) I usually do some chunks and shreds. Step 8: Bake 30-45 minute You do not want it to get to crispy if you shredded it first. Watch carefully as you do not want it to dry out. Step 9: While still warm shred with 2 forks if left whole. Step 10: Serve with warm tortillas and pico de gallo.

Ingredient Names: cheese, cornstarch, evaporated milk, jalape o peppers, sauce, onion powder, garlic powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the cheese and cornstarch together in a saucepan. Step 2: Add all other ingredients, cook over medium heat, whisking often until the cheese is melted and smooth. Step 3: Adjust to your taste if required - with extra hot sauce and salt. Step 4: While hot, it will have a sauce like consistency - perfect for pouring over nachos. Step 5: As it cools, it will thicken and become a dip-like consistency. Whisk occasionally to mix in the skin that forms on the top. Step 6: Stir in additional evaporated (or even normal) milk to achieve the desired consistency if you want to use it as a pourable sauce. Note that when you reheat it, it loosens up.

Ingredient Names: sugar, cocoa, water, cinnamon, nutmeg, milk, pure vanilla extract, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together sugar, cocoa, water, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add milk and cook, stirring, until hot. Step 3: Add vanilla and stir. Step 4: Pour chocolate into serving cups and top with whipped cream (if desired). Step 5: Sprinkle with a little cinnamon and nutmeg and serve with a cinnamon stick (for 5 minutes stirring).

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, onions, garlic, picante sauce, spinach, ground cumin, salt, ground black pepper, cream cheese, tortilla, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, lettuce, black olives, avocados, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 350°F. Step 2: Grease a 13x9-inch baking dish. Step 3: In a large skillet, cook the ground turkey with onions and garlic (if using) until no longer pink, breaking into small pieces with a spoon. Step 4: Add in 1 cup of Pincante sauce, spinach, 1-1/2 tsp cumin, salt, and the diced tomatoes. (tomatoes can be slightly drained for a less thinner mixture). Step 5: Cook, and stir for 5 minutes, or until most of the liquid has evaporated. Step 6: Add in the cream cheese, stirring just until melted and combined. Step 7: Spoon about 1/3 cup of filling down the center of each warmed tortilla; roll up, and place seam-side down in a the prepared baking dish. Step 8: In a bowl combine the remaining 1 cup of Picante sauce and the remaining 1/2 tsp cumin, then spoon over the enchiladas. Step 9: Bake in a 350 degree F oven for 20 minutes or until hot. Step 10: Remove from the oven, and sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese, return to the oven, and bake for 5 minutes more, or until the cheese is melted. Step 11: Top with toppings that are listed, or top with your favorite toppings.

Ingredient Names: pork carnitas, olive oil, tinned black beans, fresh corn kernels, cheese, tortillas, enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350F/180C. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over high heat. Add the pork carnitas and cook until the bottom is nicely browned - about 1 1/2 minutes. Do not turn, just make the bottom crispy (to keep the pulled pork as moist as possible), then remove the pulled pork into a bowl. It does not matter if the top isn't heated through, it will heat in the oven. Step 3: Add the corn, black beans, 1/2 cup enchilada sauce and 1/2 cup cheese into the bowl and mix to combine. Step 4: Spread 1/2 cup of Enchilada Sauce on the bottom of the baking dish. Step 5: Place 1/2 packed cup of filling (from step 3) into a tortilla and roll up and place in the baking dish. Step 6: Pour over the remaining Enchilada Sauce, and bake for 10 minutes. Step 7: Remove from oven and scatter the cheese on, then bake for a further 10 to 15 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Step 8: Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, chili beans, monterey jack cheddar cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep casserole dish or pie plate, spread cream cheese on bottom with spoon. Step 2: Spread chili on top of cream cheese layer. Step 3: Spread shredded cheese on top. Step 4: Bake in a 350 degree oven until cheese on top is completely melted, remove from oven. Step 5: Let dip settle for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, garlic, cumin seeds, pinto, smoked paprika, flour tortillas, cheddar, fresh cilantro, salsa, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and garlic for 2 mins. Add the cumin and cook for 1 min more. Tip in the beans, paprika and a splash of water. Using a potato masher, break the beans down as they warm through to make a rough purée. Season generously. Step 2: Spread the refried beans onto 4 of the tortillas and scatter over the cheese and coriander. Spoon over the salsa, then top with the remaining tortillas to make 4 sandwiches. Wipe the frying pan with kitchen paper and return to the heat or heat a griddle pan. Cook each sandwich for 1-2 mins on each side until the tortillas are crisp and golden and the cheese is melting. Serve warm, cut into wedges, with extra salsa and soured cream for dipping.

Ingredient Names: fresh corn kernels, chili powder, ground cumin, tomatoes, red onions, fresh cilantro, fresh chili pepper, garlic, olive oil, cider vinegar, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine corn, chili powder and cumin and spread on a greased jelly roll pan in a single layer. Step 2: (If you pan is too small do two batches.) Bake at 400 F for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally for even browning, cool. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and toss. Step 4: Serve as a salad or with tortilla chips as a salsa.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, jalapenos, habaneros, white onions, garlic, fresh cilantro, salt, apple cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Place oven rack to highest position and preheat broiler. Step 2: Put tomatoes and peppers on a baking sheet and place under broiler for about 10 minutes. Step 3: Tomatoes and peppers should be blackened in spots. Step 4: Turn tomatoes and peppers over and broil for about another 10 minutes. Step 5: Tomatoes and peppers should be blackened in spots and cooked through. Step 6: Peppers may be done before tomatoes, if so, remove them as they are done. Step 7: Remove from oven and let cool. Step 8: Reduce heat to 425 degrees F. Step 9: Cut onion into 1/4 inch slices and separate into rings. Step 10: Place onion and garlic on a baking sheet and place in oven. Step 11: Cook for about 15 minutes or until onion is wilted and slightly charred and garlic is soft and brown. Step 12: Stir a couple of times during cooking. Step 13: Remove from oven and let cool. Step 14: Remove stems from peppers and tomatoes. Step 15: Put peppers, onion and garlic in a food processor and coarsely chop. Step 16: Scoop into a large bowl. Step 17: Coarsely chop tomatoes and put in bowl. Step 18: Stir together and add salt and apple cider vinegar. Step 19: Chop cilantro and add. Step 20: You may want to use less cilantro. Step 21: Adjust salt and vinegar to taste.

Ingredient Names: eggs, milk, corn tortillas, oil, salt, cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Crack the eggs into a bowl and add milk. Step 2: Beat egg mixture with a fork until blended. Step 3: In a skillet, heat 2 tbs oil over medium heat. Step 4: Add tortilla triangles and lightly sprinkle with salt. Step 5: Saute the tortillas for about two minutes. Step 6: Pour eggs mixture over tortillas, lightly sprinkle with more salt if desired. Step 7: Gently fold egg and tortilla mixture with a spatula about every 30 seconds until eggs are scrambled and set (Do not over cook), turn off heat. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Step 9: Cover skillet with a lid for about two minutes or until the cheese has melted. Step 10: Serve with fresh or prepared salsa.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan. Step 2: Add garlic and cook for 1 min, stirring all the time, add black beans. Step 3: Season and cook for a further 2 mins.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, refried beans, cayenne pepper, kidney beans water, cherry tomatoes, cheddar, green chili, avocados, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to medium-high. Step 2: Put 2 tortillas onto a large baking sheet, then grill for 2 mins. Step 3: In a bowl, mix the refried beans, cayenne pepper, kidney beans and cherry tomatoes, then divide half the mix between the tortillas. Step 4: Scatter with half of the cheese and half of the sliced chilli, then grill again until the cheese melts. Step 5: Lift onto plates and top with half of the avocado and coriander to serve. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining tortillas.

Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, green onions, fresh cilantro, serrano peppers, mayonnaise, prepared mustard, salt, cheddar cheese, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggs in half (crosswise); carefully remove yolks. Step 2: Mash yolks& stir in green onions& next 5 ingredients. Step 3: Spoon into eggwhites; sprinkle with cheese& chili powder, cover& chill.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, onions, garlic, hash brown potatoes, green chilies, tomatoes, salsa, eggs, fresh cilantro, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skilled cook the chorizo over medium heat until browned and done. Step 2: Drain reserving 3 T. Step 3: Drippings, setting sausage aside. Step 4: Return drippings to the pan and over medium heat saute the onions and garlic for 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Add the chiles and stir well. Step 6: Add the potatoes, reduce heat to medium low and cook for 20 minutes, stirring often. Step 7: Add the tomatoes to heat through. Step 8: Spoon onto plates, top with eggs and offer salsa at the table. Step 9: Garnish with chopped cilantro and cheese if you wish.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, green onions, red chile, eggs, milk, olive oil, cheddar, wraps, sour cream guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix the tomatoes, half the spring onions and half the red chilli with some seasoning and set aside. Beat the eggs and milk with a fork with some seasoning. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and fry the remaining spring onion and chilli for 1 min, then pour in the egg mix. Gently scramble the eggs by dragging the egg mixture as it sets into the middle of the pan. Cook to your liking, then take off the heat and throw on the cheese. Stir through, then divide between the wraps. Tuck up the top and bottom of each wrap and roll up, then slice in half and serve with the homemade tomato salsa, soured cream and guacamole, if you like.

Ingredient Names: virgin olive oil, onions, red bell peppers, green peppers, pepper, mushrooms, pressed baked tofu, salt, nonfat wheat tortillas, low-fat sour cream, salsa, fresh tomato, avocados, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, and then add the onions. Step 2: Sauté, stirring, until the onions are translucent. Step 3: Stir in the peppers and mushrooms and sauté until the vegetables begin to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the tofu and stir-fry for 5 minutes more. Step 5: Season with salt to taste and serve in the tortillas. Step 6: Top the fajitas with low-fat sour cream, salsa, chopped fresh tomatoes, avocado, scallions, or a combination of these.

Ingredient Names: butter, sugar, cinnamon, flour tortillas, cream cheese, cool whip, limes, fruit
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a small microwavable bowl. Step 2: Mix sugar and cinnamon in another bowl. Step 3: Brush both sides of tortillas with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar mixture. Step 4: Gently press tortillas into 6 custard cups to form cups, microwave 3 cups at a time on HIGH for 45 seconds. Step 5: Let cool 5 minutes before removing from cups. Step 6: Cups should be firm before removing from cup. Step 7: Beat cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar until blended. Step 8: Stir in lime zest. Step 9: Assemble by filling tortilla cups with filling and top with assorted fresh fruit.

Ingredient Names: limeade, lime juice, tequila, triple sec, lime wedge, grand marnier
Instructions: Step 1: Mix limeade, lime juice, tequila and triple sec in a pitcher and refrigerate. Step 2: Serve in salted glasses with plenty of ice--skip the blender, just serve on the rocks. Step 3: Garnish with lime wedge& a splash of grand marnier.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onions, celery, red peppers, jalapeno peppers, garlic, garbanzo beans, chunky salsa, cumin, chili powder, ground coriander, taco shells, cheddar cheese, iceberg lettuce, salsa, sauce, fresh cilantro, tomatoes, black olives, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In large fry pan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Cook the onion, celery, red or green pepper, jalapeno, and garlic until softened. Step 3: Add garbanzo beans, spices, and a couple tsp of salsa. Step 4: Stir until heated through. Step 5: I like to fit the taco shells in a baking pan, spoon in filling evenly into the shells and bake in a 300°F oven for 5 minutes or so. Step 6: It helps the shells from falling apart when you take the first bite. Step 7: Remove from oven and top with your favorite toppings.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, carrots, chili powder, tomatoes, pulses water, wholemeal tortillas, low-fat yogurt, extra-mature cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the onions and carrots for 5-8 mins until soft – add a splash of water if they start to stick. Sprinkle in the chilli powder and cook for 1 min more. Pour in the tomatoes and pulses and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat and simmer for 5-10 mins, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Remove from the heat and season well. Step 2: Heat grill to high. Spread a spoonful of the bean chilli over a large ovenproof dish. Lay each tortilla onto a board, fill with a few tbsp of chilli mixture, fold over the ends and roll up to seal. Place them into the ovenproof dish. Spoon the remaining chilli on top. Step 3: Mix the yogurt and grated cheese together with some seasoning, and spoon over the enchiladas. Grill for a few mins until the top is golden and bubbling. Serve with a green salad.

Ingredient Names: leg of lamb, red tree chilies, chicken broth, chickpeas, nopal leaves, salt, potatoes, rice, tomatoes, onion, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the tomatoes by half. Step 2: Cut the potatoes by half. Step 3: In a pressure dale, add the potatoes, tomatoes, onion, broth, water, salt, rice, chilies chickpeas. Step 4: Add the nopal leaves like if you were covering the ingredients, like a cap. Step 5: Then add the lamb leg, it wont fit so cut it in pieces, if you cut it cut it in big pieces. Step 6: Put it on the fire for about 45-60 minutes. Step 7: Check the meat if it is very well cooked In mexico this is a very traditional plate, so people eat it in corn tortillas, with salsa, and some drops of lime juice. Step 8: After you take the nopal leaves, and the lamb out of there, you'll see that looks like a soup but very greasy, so you can take the grease out with a spoon, and serve it, without the chillies, the tomato, and the potatoes. Step 9: Add some lime juice and enjoy it.

Dish Name: Barbecued lamb with punchy melon salsa
Ingredient Names: garlic, cumin seeds, lemons, olive oil, lamb leg chops, cantaloupe melon, green onions, fresh coriander, red chile, avocados, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Using a pestle and mortar, mash the garlic and cumin together with a pinch of salt. Stir in the lemon juice and olive oil. Pour over the lamb in a dish, toss to coat, then marinate for about 1 hr. To make the salsa, mix all the ingredients together in a bowl, then set aside. Step 2: Griddle or barbecue the lamb for 4 mins on each side until pink, or a few mins more if you prefer. Leave the lamb to rest for 4-5 mins, then serve on a board or platter with the bowl of salsa for spooning over.

Ingredient Names: onion, lean ground lamb, olive oil, red pepper flakes, dried basil, cumin, cinnamon, garlic, chili powder, dried oregano, unsweetened cocoa powder, white sugar, bay leaf, salt and pepper, diced tomatoes with juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, cook onions and ground lamb in olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: When onions are soft and meat browned, season with red pepper flakes, basil, cumin, cinnamon, garlic, chili powder, dried oregano, cocoa powder, sugar, and bay leaf, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Saute for 1 or 2 minutes to allow flavors to blend and blossom. Step 4: Stir in tomatoes and beans Increase heat to bring soup to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes Load into large bowls and garnish with your choice of toppings.

Ingredient Names: ground lamb, onion, mild chili powder, ground cumin, chopped tomatoes, kidney beans, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the ground lamb in a frying pan for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the onion and cook for 7 minutes until brown. Step 3: Add the chilli powder and cum and cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Reduce the heat, cover and cook for 30 minutes Warm the tortillas in the microwave on high for 45 seconds. Step 5: Spoon the lamb into the center of the tortilla and let everybody add their own extras. Step 6: Fold the edges over to enclose the filling.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, red bell peppers, garlic, cremini mushrooms, button mushrooms, chili powder, black beans, purchased tomatillo salsa, fresh cilantro, flour tortillas, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add next 3 ingredients; saute until onions are brown, about 20 minues. Step 3: Add remaining oil and all mushrooms; saute 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in chili powder. Step 5: Saute until juices evaporate, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add beans and salsa;saute 3 minutes, stir in cilantro. Step 7: Season with salt and pepper. Step 8: Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees, Wrap tortillas in foil heat in oven for 15 minutes. Step 9: (They can be heated in Microwave in paper towels or a tortilla warming pan.). Step 10: Place a tortilla on plate, spoon mushroom mixture down the center of tortilla, sptinkle with Cheese, fold short ends of tortilla over filling, roll up, enclosing filling, enjoy.

Ingredient Names: new mexico red chili sauce, corn tortillas, onions, mild white cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Oil a 9-inch square baking dish. Step 2: Dip tortillas in the red chile sauce, to make pliable, and place 4 on the bottom of the dish. Step 3: Sprinkle with 1/4 cup onions. Step 4: Sprinkle with 1/3 of the cheese. Step 5: Repeat layers 2 more times, ending with cheese, bake at 350ºF. Step 6: For 30 minutes, or until hot and the cheese is golden.

Ingredient Names: rice, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, beef broth, ground cumin, tomato paste, frozen green pea, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in hot oil in 2 to 3 litre saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 2 minutes. Step 2: Stir in onion and garlic. Step 3: Cook, stirring about 1 minute. Step 4: Add broth and cumin, heat to boiling. Step 5: Stir once or twice. Step 6: Lower heat to simmer. Step 7: Cover with tight fitting lid. Step 8: Cook 15 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Step 9: Combine tomato paste and 1 tablespoon water.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, long grain rice, taco seasoning, salsa, corn kernel, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the chicken stock and taco seasoning in a medium pot. Step 2: Once mixture comes to a boil add the rice, salsa, corn and beans (or peas if you prefer, stir a bit. Step 3: Turn heat to low and cover pot. Step 4: Allow to cook on low, undisturbed, for 20 minutes. Step 5: After 20 minutes are up, toss the rice a bit, and serve!

Ingredient Names: onion, long grain rice, lard, chicken broth, tomato juice, diced tomato, parsley, garlic, ground cumin, salt, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onion and rice in lard until browned, 6 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 2: Turn into baking dish In large saucepan, combine broth, tomato juice, tomatoes, parsley, garlic, cumin and salt and pepper and bring to boil, add broth to rice. Step 3: Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until rice is fluffy Use fork to fluff rice.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, water, chili powder, minute rice, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomato sauce water and chili powder in medium saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a full boil, stir in rice. Step 3: Cover remove from heat and let stand for 10 mins. Step 4: Sprinkle with tortilla chips and cheese.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, yellow onion, rice, garlic clove, chicken broth, salt and pepper, chipotle chiles, corn
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium heat, saute onion in oil. Step 2: Add rice and garlic. Step 3: Saute until the rice looks clear. Step 4: Add salt, pepper, and chicken broth and turn heat up to high. Step 5: Stir well and bring to a boil. Step 6: Mix in chipotle diced tomatoes and corn, turn heat to low. Step 7: Cook covered for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mild salsa, water, butter, instant rice
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil. Step 2: Add butter and jar of salsa and bring almost to a boil. Step 3: Add rice and remove from heat and let stand covered per instructions on instant rice box That's it! Step 4: It is super simple and delicious! Step 5: You can substitute with mild salsa but it makes it sort of sweet instead of a spicy taste to it.

Ingredient Names: water, chicken bouillon, converted rice, dried onion flakes, butter, annatto seeds, dried parsley flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Boil water. Step 2: Add bouillon cubes to dissolve, then stir in converted rice and onion flakes. Step 3: Cover and simmer for 20 minutes While rice is cooking, melt butter in small saucepan and add annato seeds. Step 4: Simmer on low for 10 minutes.
