Step 5: When rice is done, pour annato mixture through a strainer and into the rice. Step 6: Add parsley and stir well until color is mixed evenly, serve and enjoy!

Dish Name: Arroz A La Mexicana Mexican Rice
Ingredient Names: rice, onion, garlic cloves, chicken stock, tomatoes, olive oil, green peas, salt & freshly ground black pepper, chili pepper, fresh coriander, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Puree the tomatoes, onion, garlic, and cup of the stock in an electric blender or food processor. Step 2: Heat the oil in a saucepan and saut the rice until it turns golden. Step 3: Add the tomato puree, remaining stock, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Bring to a boil, lower the heat to a simmer, and cover until almost all of the liquid has been absorbed. Step 5: Mix in the peas and continue cooking until all the liquid has been absorbed. Step 6: Garnish with the optional garnishes.

Dish Name: Arroz A La Mexicana Traditional Mexican Rice
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, medium grain rice, onion, garlic, tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, corn, jalapenos, bell pepper, frozen peas, cilantro, carrot, queso fresco
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pan bring the broth to simmering. Step 2: Set a large pan over medium heat-add the oil, then the rice and onion and cook, stirring, until both the rice and onion are light brown-around 10 minutes. Step 3: Mix in the garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the pureed tomato add the broth add the optional ingredients-except cilantro and cheese scrape the rice down and stir well. Step 5: Reduce heat to a medium low, cover and finish cooking-around 20 minutes. Step 6: Remove from heat and toss and either stir in cilantro or offer at the table-i offer at the table because either you love it-like i do-or hate it, and offer the queso fresco or farmers cheese.

Dish Name: Arroz Blanco Con Verduras White Rice W Vegetables
Ingredient Names: milk, cream cheese, rice, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, green onions, fresh mushrooms, serrano chili, water, corn kernel, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, puree 1 / 2 cup milk with the cream cheese and set aside. Step 2: In a medium-size heavy-bottomed saucepan, heat the oil and saute the rice, stirring, until it forms clumps. Step 3: Add the garlic, onion, mushrooms and chile and continue to saute, stirring, until the rice separates into individual grains. Step 4: Add the water or broth, with salt to taste, and bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat and simmer until the water has just been absorbed. Step 6: Add the cup of milk that was not blended with the cheese, cover again, and continue to cook over low heat until the milk has been absorbed. Step 7: Remove from heat, stir in corn, pour the cheese mixture over all, cover and let stand for 15 minutes before serving, stir and serve.

Ingredient Names: white rice, oil, garlic cloves, chicken broth, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Smash the garlic clove lightly with the blade of a large knife, remove the peel. Step 2: Leave small cloves whole and chop larger cloves in half If the broth is not already hot, heat it to a simmer in a pot. Step 3: Heat the oil over medium in a large pot. Step 4: Add the rice and stir for 1 minute. Step 5: Add 2 cups of broth and the garlic, bring to a boil. Step 6: Let simmer until most of the broth is absorbed. Step 7: Add the remaining broth, and return the pot to a boil. Step 8: Cover, and lower heat and cook until the rice is very soft and tender and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, salt, vegetable oil, white rice, white onion, garlic cloves, fresh lime juice, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: In small saucepan or microwave oven, heat broth or water until steaming. Step 2: Stir in about 3 / 4 teaspoon salt if using salted broth, 1 1 / 2 teaspoons if using unsalted broth or water. Step 3: Cover and keep warm In medium saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 4: When hot, add raw rice and onion and stir regularly until grains have turned from translucent to milky-white, 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Add garlic and stir for a few seconds, until fragrant Do not let grains brown. Step 6: Add the warm liquid and lime juice, stir thoroughly, scraping down any grains that are clinging to the side of the pan. Step 7: Cover and cook over the lowest heat for 15 minutes--temperature should be low enough that only the slightest hint of steam escapes lid. Step 8: Remove pan from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: white rice, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Pour hot water over the rice and let stand for about 10 minutes. Step 2: Drain the rice and rinse well in cold water. Step 3: Let the rice drain for a few minutes. Step 4: In a medium size saucepan with a tightfitting lid, heat the oil over a medium low heat. Step 5: Add the onion and garlic and cook until translucent, stirring constantly. Step 6: Add the rice and cook just until the grains are coated with the oil. Step 7: Add the water and cook, uncovered, over a medium heat until the liquid has been absorbed and small air holes appear on the top of the rice Do not stir wrap the lid of the saucepan with a small terry cloth dish towel. Step 8: Place the lid tightly over the saucepan so that none of the steam can escape. Step 9: Set aside in a warm place for about 20-30 minutes, so that the rice can continue to cook and the grains expand.

Dish Name: Arroz Con Chile Verde Green Chile Rice
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, monterey jack cheese, instant rice, sour cream, salt, green chilies, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to boil in medium saucepan. Step 2: Add rice to water and stir. Step 3: Remove water from heat, cover and let stand for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add all remaining ingredients to rice and place in a 2-quart, greased, casserole dish. Step 5: Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Arroz Con Gandules Rice With Pigeon Peas
Ingredient Names: salt pork, cubed ham, rice, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, pigeon peas, food coloring, capers, stuffed green olives, ground cumin, italian seasoning, salt & pepper, fresh cilantro, red pepper, onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, fry salt pork in olive oil until halfway done. Step 2: Add ham and continue frying. Step 3: Add rice and saut until rice is browned. Step 4: Add about cup to 1 cup sofrito, tomato sauce and canned tomatoes. Step 5: Add gandules and 4 cups of water. Step 6: Add olives and capers, cumin, oregano, salt and pepper to taste and bijol. Step 7: Cook uncovered over medium-high heat 10 minutes, then cover, lower heat and continue cooking 1520 minutes until done Sofrito: blend 1 bunch cilantro, 1 red pepper, 1 onion, 1 green pepper and 1 head garlic in blender until smooth.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, rice, fat free chicken broth, onion, green bell pepper, frozen peas, mexican-style tomatoes, carrot, garlic salt, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet and saut rice until golden. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 cup broth, onion and bell pepper and saut for 2 more minutes. Step 3: Stir in remaining broth, peas, tomatoes, carrot and seasonings. Step 4: Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until broth is absorbed.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, garlic clove, carrot, raw rice, dried ancho chile powder, cumin, tomatoes, broth, peas, corn, green peppers, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in oil until soft. Step 2: Add garlic and carrot, cook for 3 minutes. Step 3: Stir in rice, cook until light golden, sprinkle with chili powder and cumin. Step 4: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Step 6: Cover, reduce heat, simmer over low for 20 minutes or until rice is tender.

Ingredient Names: poblano peppers, green bell pepper, long-grain white rice, garlic clove, fresh cilantro, flat leaf parsley, chicken stock, vegetable oil, onion, boiling water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast the poblano peppers and bell pepper in a pan, turning frequently, until skins are blackened but the flesh is not burnt. Step 2: Place them in a strong plastic or paper bag after roasting for about 20 minutes and let the steam loosen the skins. Step 3: Place the rice in a heatproof bowl, and pour in boiling water to cover and let stand for 20 minutes Strip off the leaves from the cilantro and parsley stalks and set them aside. Step 4: Drain the rice, rinse under cold water and drain again Peel the black spots off of the chiles and pepper, remove any stems, then slit them open and scrape out the seeds with a sharp knife. Step 5: Put the roasted vegetables in a food processor, along with the garlic. Step 6: Add the cliantro and parsley, reserving some for garnish. Step 7: Pour in half the chicken stock and process until smooth. Step 8: Add the rest of the stock and process the puree again.

Ingredient Names: white rice, red chili pepper, red chili sauce, chicken broth, garlic cloves, onion, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic, onions and red chile in oil over medium heat for about 1 minute. Step 2: Add in the rice and stir frequently until rice begins to brown. Step 3: Add in the chicken stock and chile sauce and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and bring rice to slow simmer. Step 5: Cook for 18-20 minutes without removing the lid.

Ingredient Names: rice, vegetable oil, tomatoes, onion, garlic cloves, chicken bouillon cube, salt, mixed vegetables, water
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice under cold water until water begins to run clear of starch In saucepan or large skillet with lid heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add drained rice and fry until lightly browned, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burning In the meantime, add next 5 ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Step 3: When rice is done frying, drain excess oil. Step 4: Add tomato pure to rice and continue frying about 5 more minutes, stirring frequently to prevent burning. Step 5: Add water and stir to separate lumps of rice. Step 6: Taste broth to check for salt It should almost taste too salty because the rice will soak up a lot of salt and still come out bland. Step 7: Drain can of vegetables and add to broth.

Ingredient Names: dried black beans, dried red beans, dried black-eyed peas, hot water, sweet brown rice, barley, quinoa, water, olive oil, ground turkey, yellow onion, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, frozen whole kernel corn, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Ahead of time: Prepare dried beans in a slow cooker. Step 2: Cook on high until tender, Prepare grains in rice cooker following directions for 2 cups of grain. Step 3: When beans and grains are cooked: In a very large skillet or sautee pan, heat half of the olive oil and brown the meat. Step 4: Remove the meat to drain. Step 5: Add the remaining oil and then cooking over medium heat, add chopped onions, peppers and garlic. Step 6: Cook these until crisp-tender. Step 7: Stir in corn and red chile paste.

Ingredient Names: mac n' cheese deluxe, chorizo sausage, extra-light vegetable oil spread, low-fat milk, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare mac n cheese according to directions Stop before Crumble chorizo in skillet and cook 7 minutes on medium heat Tilt pan to drain grease off meat. Step 2: Combine macaroni, cheese sauce, and chorizo in loaf pan. Step 3: Sprinkle with shredded cheese and bread crumb topping. Step 4: Bake at 425 degrees for 8 minutes, serve hot!

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic, ground cumin, chili powder, white rice, chicken, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place the oil in a saucepan and cook the onion until translucent. Step 2: Add the garlic, cumin and chilli and fry over a medium heat until fragrant. Step 3: Add the rice, stock and paste, stir to combine. Step 4: When almost to the boil, transfer to a 2 litre capacity oven proof dish with a lid. Step 5: Cover and bake at 180oc for 35-40 minutes. Step 6: Remove from the oven and let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic, olive oil, rice, salt, black pepper, chili powder, button mushrooms, chorizo sausage, beef stock, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the onion and garlic in hot olive oil until just soft. Step 2: Add the rice and seasonings and brown lightly. Step 3: Add the mushrooms and sausage and enough boiling stock to come 1" above the rice. Step 4: Cover with a tight lid and bake in a 350f Oven until the liquid is completely absorbed, about 35 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and serve.

Dish Name: Barley Pozole Mexican Barley And Hominy
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, anaheim chilies, jalapeno chiles, chicken broth, pearl barley, hominy, salsa verde, ground cumin, cheddar cheese, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In large pot with lid, heat oil over medium heat Saut onion and chiles for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Add 4 cups broth and all of barley, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Step 4: Stir in remaining broth, hominy, salsa and cumin. Step 5: Cook for 20 minutes longer Ladle soup into bowls and top with shredded cheese, if desired.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, long grain rice, garlic, white onion, tomatoes, green chili pepper, chicken broth, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the oil and saute the rice over medium high heat until golden brown. Step 2: Stir in the garlic and the onions and saute until onion is golden yellow. Step 3: Stir in the tomatoes, broth and season with salt. Step 4: Bring to a boil uncovered, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes Do not take lid off to peak in! Step 5: Remove lid, toss with a fork to fluff and allow to sit for 5 minutes uncovered before serving.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, converted white rice, onion, green bell pepper, ground beef, canned corn, tomato sauce, ketchup, water, salt and pepper, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan over medium heat, heat the oil. Step 2: Add the rice, onion and bell pepper and saute for 5 minutes, or until onions are tender. Step 3: Add the ground beef and saute until browned. Step 4: Drain excess oil and fat. Step 5: Add the corn, tomato sauce, ketchup and water. Step 6: Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste.

Ingredient Names: white rice, chicken broth, salsa, cumin, garlic salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the rice in the oil for a couple of minutes, until it starts to get lightly browned. Step 2: Add broth, salsa, cumin, and garlic salt. Step 3: Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until done.

Dish Name: Big Batch Crock Pot Mexican Casserole
Ingredient Names: spanish rice, ground beef, cumin, chili powder, corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, chili beans, black beans, pinto beans, frozen corn, tomato sauce, rotel tomatoes, diced green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan, brown the ground beef and drain the fat. Step 2: Add the seasonings, plus salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Drain the beans and add to the meat. Step 4: Add the corn, tomato sauce, rotel tomatoes, and diced green chilies, mix together. Step 5: Cover the bottom of a 6 or 7 quart crock pot with a layer of corn tortillas. Step 6: Add a layer of one-third of the rice followed by a layer of one-third of the meat, bean, and corn mixture. Step 7: Top with one cup of grated cheddar. Step 8: Repeat layers two more times, ending with cheese. Step 9: Cook on low 2-4 hours or until warmed through.

Ingredient Names: onion, celery, red bell pepper, carrots, fat free chicken broth, black beans, instant rice, salsa, garlic salt, oregano, cayenne, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan cook onion, celery, bell pepper and carrots in chicken broth till tender. Step 2: Stir in beans, rice, salsa and seasonings. Step 3: Bring to a boil, turn off heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes.

Dish Name: Black Beans And Rice Arroz Con Frijoles Negros
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, green pepper, garlic, black beans, oregano, water, sazon goya, white wine, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, heat the oil on medium. Step 2: Stir in the onion and pepper, add the garlic. Step 3: Cook until tender or about 8-10 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the remaining ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Serve over the white rice.

Ingredient Names: uncooked rice, wesson oil, onion, green pepper, celery, canned tomatoes, cubed ham
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in oil until lightly browned. Step 2: Chop onion, green pepper and celery, add to rice, stir in tomatoes, heat to boiling, lower heat. Step 3: Cover and cook about 25 minutes until rice is tender. Step 4: Add ham to rice and heat until ham is hot.

Ingredient Names: masa harina flour, water, milk, salt, mexican chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl combine the masa or masa harina with 1 cup of the water-milk mixture, stirring until smooth. Step 2: In a medium saucepan combine the masa mixture, the remaining 4 cups water, and the salt. Step 3: Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Step 4: Reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thickened to the consistency of thin cooked cereal, 15 to 20 minutes. Step 5: Add the chocolate and continue to stir until melted and thoroughly combined Optional: remove from the heat and beat with a whisk, egg beater, handheld electric mixer, or a traditional wooden molinillo Continue to whick until a thick froth forms on top. Step 6: Pour into cups and spoon some foam on top.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, chicken, acini di pepe pasta, red onion, green pepper, garlic, tomato paste, diced tomatoes, black beans, white corn kernels, enchilada sauce, taco seasoning, ranch dressing, chicken broth, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put pasta into a pot large enough to hold the rest of the ingredients when everything is combined. Step 2: Boil according to package directions, drain and return to pot We use whole wheat pasta, but really anything tiny will do While pasta is cooking, brown the ground turkey or beef with the green pepper and onions in a large pan, using salt, pepper and cayenne to taste. Step 3: Add chicken, garlic and packets of taco seasoning and ranch seasoning, cook for two minutes while stirring. Step 4: Stir in undrained diced tomatoes, enchilada sauce and tomato paste, cooking until liquid reduces a little. Step 5: Put entire meat mixture into the pot containing the drained, cooked pasta and stir. Step 6: Add drained corn, beans and chicken soup and bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce heat and cook, stirring occasionally for up to 1 hour You may add more chicken broth if you like more liquid with your chili.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, water, salsa, cheddar cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to your preference. Step 2: When rice is done, quickly add salsa, cheese, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Mix well Additional cheese may be sprinkled on top, serve.

Ingredient Names: butter, masa harina, water, frozen corn, sugar, yellow cornmeal, whipping cream, baking powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: With an electric mixer, beat butter or margarine until fluffy Gradually beat in masa harina On low speed, beat in water. Step 2: Place corn in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until chopped coarse. Step 3: Stir in masa mixture. Step 4: In a small bowl, stir together sugar, cornmeal, cream, baking powder, and salt. Step 5: Stir into corn mixture. Step 6: Spread in a greased, 8-inch-square baking pan, cover with foil. Step 7: Place in a larger pan and pour boiling water half way up the side of the smaller pan.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cream-style sweet corn, red enchilada sauce, green chilies, dark chicken meat, vermicelli, cumin, salt, onion powder, dried oregano leaves, onion, colby-monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In dutch oven or large saucepan, combine broth, corn, enchilada sauce and chiles, mix well. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add all remaining soup ingredients, mix well. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Simmer 8 minutes or until vermicelli is tender, stirring occasionally Ladle soup into individual bowls. Step 6: Garnish each serving with onion and cheese.

Ingredient Names: chili pepper pasta, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, bell peppers, onion, taco seasoning mix, cheese, guacamole, sour cream, salsa, lime wedges, tortilla chips, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Set aside and keep warm. Step 3: Cut chicken into strips, coat with taco seasoning. Step 4: Cut onion and bell pepper into strips. Step 5: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large nonstick pan, over medium high heat. Step 6: Add chicken, and cook through. Step 7: Remove chicken and keep warm If needed, add remaining oil to pan. Step 8: Add onion and peppers, cook until slightly softened Portion pasta onto plates, top with chicken, peppers and onions.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, tomato paste, chili powder, dried oregano, reduced-sodium chicken broth, white hominy, cooked chicken, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a 5-quart saucepan over medium heat, add onions. Step 2: Cook until translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic, tomato paste, chili powder, and oregano. Step 4: Cook, stirring constantly, until evenly distributed. Step 5: Add 2 cups water, broth, and hominy, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until fragrant, about 30 minutes, stir in chicken. Step 7: Season with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, diced green chilies, cooked rice, cheddar cheese, green onions, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Mix sour cream, green onions and chilies. Step 3: Season rice with salt and pepper Spray a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole with cooking spray and cover with half of the rice. Step 4: Add a layer of half of the sour cream mixture and cover with half of the grated cheese. Step 5: Repeat layers starting with rice and ending with cheese. Step 6: Bake in a 350 oven until bubbly and the top is lightly browned, about 30 minutes This can be assembled ahead and baked when ready Increase baking time if refrigerated, covering the top with foil if it browns too quickly.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, ground beef, red chilies, ground cumin, tapenade, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, lentils, red kidney beans, dark chocolate, salt, pepper, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion and garlic for about five minutes in a little olive oil over medium heat Increase the heat and add the ground beef, stirring continuously until browned, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the chilies and cumin and continue to fry for one minute. Step 3: Mix in the chopped tomatoes, tapenade, stock, lentils and beans and bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 30 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the chocolate and season with salt and pepper, if you feel it needs more heat you can add some chili powder or hot sauce While the chili is simmering, cook your potatoes until tender. Step 5: Mash with the milk, turmeric and cilantro, season to taste. Step 6: Place the chili into an ovenproof dish and top with the mash, without smoothing it down too much. Step 7: Place under a preheated grill for 5-10 minutes until the top is golden brown and crisp.

Dish Name: Chili's Margarita Grilled Chicken And Belinda's Mexican Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, margarita mix, tequila, garlic, garlic salt, pepper, white rice, chicken broth, salsa, cumin, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken in margarita mix, tequila, and garlic in refrigerator for several hours, or overnight. Step 2: Remove chicken from marinade, and sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper. Step 3: Preheat george foreman or gas grill. Step 4: Cook chicken just until cooked through. Step 5: Serve with mexican rice and black beans Mexican rice: Cook rice in 1 tablespoon oil, until lightly browned. Step 6: Add chicken broth, salsa, cumin, and garlic salt. Step 7: Cover pan and simmer for about 25 minutes, or until rice is tender.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, fresh cilantro, basmati rice, water, salt, lime
Instructions: Step 1: In a 2-quart heavy saucepan, heat oil or butter over low heat, stirring occasionally until melted. Step 2: Add rice and lime juice, stir for 1 minute. Step 3: Add water and salt, bring to a full rolling boil At boiling, cover, turn down to simmer over low heat until rice is tender and the water is absorbed, about 25 minutes. Step 4: Add in the cilantro and fluff rice with a fork.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, sweet onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, diced fire-roasted tomatoes, chicken broth, chipotle chiles in adobo, black olives, kosher salt, black pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil on medium heat in a saucepan and add chopped onion and minced garlic. Step 2: Cook until tender and slightly golden. Step 3: Add rice, stir fry for about one minute. Step 4: Stir in remaining ingredients. Step 5: Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed. Step 6: Allow to sit undisturbed for 5 minutes Fluff with a fork and serve garnished with cilantro leaves if using.

Ingredient Names: long-grain white rice, olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, whole tomatoes, chicken broth, cilantro, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: Pour chicken broth into a 2 cup measure then add juice from tomatoes to make 2 cups. Step 2: Set aside three whole tomatoes, saving remaining juice and tomatoes for another use. Step 3: Heat olive oil in medium saucepan then stir in rice until well coated. Step 4: Saute till light golden brown, stirring frequently, then add garlic and onion Continue until onions are translucent, stirring frequently Holding a tomato in your hand, squeeze over saucepan to break it up, drop it in pan. Step 5: Repeat with two remaining tomatoes and stir into the rice. Step 6: Stir in the broth mixture and add salt to taste It should be a bit salty, as the rice will absorb it.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, anise seed, cumin seed, garlic cloves, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, water, salt, black beans, masa harina, baking powder, butter, boiling water, fresh cilantro, white wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare soup, heat oil in dutch oven over medium heat, add onion. Step 2: Cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 3: Add aniseed, cumin, and garlic. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 5: Stir in broth, 3 cups water, 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, and beans, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to low, simmer 45 minutes. Step 7: Place half of bean mixture in blender.

Ingredient Names: butter, green onions, red pepper, garlic clove, uncooked rice, tomatoes, tomato sauce, black pepper, salt, ground cumin, chicken stock, chicken bouillon cube, peas
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onions, red pepper and garlic in the butter for about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the uncooked rice and toast for about 2-3 minutes. Step 3: Add the rest of the ingredients, stir and simmer over low heat for 20 30 minutes until most of the liquid is absorbed It should be moist but not runny.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, basmati rice, water, salt, lime, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy saucepan, heat oil / butter over low heat. Step 2: Add rice and lime juice, stir for 1 minute. Step 3: Add water and salt, bring to a full boil. Step 4: Cover, turn down to simmer over low heat until rice is tender and water is absorbed Fluff rice with a fork. Step 5: Sprinkle cilantro.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, chicken bouillon, vinegar, butter, olive oil, red bell pepper, green bell peppers, zucchini, corn kernel, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Saut rice in frying pan over med high heat for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Step 2: Add veggies and continue to saut until rice begins to brown and veggies soften, stirring very often 3-5 minutes or so. Step 3: Add bouillon and vinegar to water and stir to dissolve. Step 4: Pour water into pan with rice and veggies and allow to come to a boil. Step 5: Toss in cilantro, stir and cover tightly. Step 6: Lower heat to simmer and keep covered for 15 minutes exactly Do not lift lid during the 15 minutes- the steam is needed to properly cook the rice. Step 7: Uncover and fluff with a fork.

Dish Name: Cilantro Serrano Pesto With Grilled Chicken And Penne
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro leaves, of fresh mint, parmesan cheese, white balsamic vinegar, fresh ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast, olive oil, salt, pepper, penne pasta, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place cilantro and the next 6 ingredients in a food processor Process until well blended With processor on, slowly pour olive oil through the food chute: process until well blended. Step 2: Place pesto in a large bowl, stir in vinegar and black pepper, grill chicken. Step 3: Heat outdoor grill or grill pan over medium heat Coat chicken with olive oli. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Grill chicken until done. Step 6: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.

Ingredient Names: rice-a-roni, whole kernel corn, sweet creamy butter, salt, pepper, paprika, red cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Pepare either the rice a roni or the rice as directed by the instructions on the box or bag. Step 2: Once the rice, or rice a roni, is fully cooked drain the corn and add it to the rice. Step 3: Add the butter next. Step 4: Then add the salt, pepper, and paprika. Step 5: Add red pepper to taste, the more pepper the spicier the dish will be. Step 6: Stir it all together and then let sit for 5 more minutes on low heat. Step 7: Serve at once or place in fridge for a later meal It will keep for about 4 days in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: masa harina, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine masa harina with water. Step 2: Mix with hands until dough is moist but holds its shape. Step 3: Add more water if needed. Step 4: Let dough rest for 15 minutes. Step 5: Divide dough into 12 balls Dampen dough slightly with water. Step 6: Using a tortilla press or a flat baking dish, press dough between two pieces of waxed paper to a 6 inch round Carefully peel off the top sheet of paper. Step 7: Place tortilla, paper side up, on a hot ungreased griddle or skillet Gently peel off remaining paper.

Dish Name: Cotton Bowl Chicken With Peppers And Corn Chips
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, green pepper, roasted red peppers, mild green chilies, frito corn chips, colby-monterey jack cheese, pam cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: In large mixing bowl, combine chicken, soup, sour cream, green pepper, red pepper strips, green chiles Spray 9 x 13 pyrex baking dish with pam, preheat over 350. Step 2: Spread a layer of frito corn chips on the bottom Carefully spoon, chicken, chile mixture over the chips. Step 3: Sprinkle cheese on top. Step 4: Bake 1 hour This recipe can be doubled or tripled Just use extra 9 x 13 baking pans.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, diced green chilies, whole kernel corn, tomatoes and green chilies, cream of chicken soup, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, taco seasoning, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Mix all ingredients together Place into a greased casserole dish Bake for 30 mins or until hot.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese, sliced mushrooms, cream of chicken soup, tomatoes, green chilies, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle chicken breasts evenly with salt and pepper and place in a lightly greased 11x7 inch baking dish. Step 2: Combine cheese and next 3 ingredients, and pour over chicken. Step 3: Sprinkle with chilies. Step 4: Bake, uncovered at 350 for 35 minutes, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: whole kernel corn, black beans, diced green chilies, onion, red bell pepper, brown rice, boiling water, frozen orange juice concentrate, fresh lime juice, ground cumin, chili powder, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In your crock pot, mix together the corn, black beans, green chilies, onion, bell pepper, rice, boiling water, orange juice concentrate, 1 / 4 cup of the lime juice, the cumin, and the chili powder. Step 2: Cover and cook on the low heat setting 2 3 / 4 to 3 hours. Step 3: Stir in the remaining 2 tbs lime juice, the cilantro, and salt, mix well, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: taco seasoning, salsa, water, minute rice, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the taco seasoning, lemon jucie and salsa into the water Pour into crock pot and add in rice Set on low and cook for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, cheddar cheese, frozen corn, cornmeal, sour cream, sugar, salt, green chilies, parmesan cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Spray a 7-1 / 2" by 11-3 / 4" pan or 2 quart casserole with cooking spray Break the eggs into a medium bowl and beat lightly. Step 2: Add the remaining ingredients except parmesan and mix well. Step 3: Pour into prepared pan and place in oven. Step 4: Bake until firm, about 40 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake for 5 more minutes or until cheese melts. Step 6: Serve with salsa and sour cream.

Dish Name: Drunken Pintos With Cilantro And Bacon Rick Bayless
Ingredient Names: dried pinto beans, water, pork shoulder, bacon, white onion, serrano chilies, salt, tequila, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Beans: Sort and rinse the beans thoroughly Scoop into a 4 quart saucepan, add 5 cups water. Step 2: Remove any beans that float. Step 3: Add the cubed pork and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and gently simmer, partially covered, until tender, about 2 hours. Step 5: Stir gently occasionally, and keep water level a good 1 / 2 inch above the level of the beans Flavorings: In a medium skillet, fry the bacon until crisp.

Ingredient Names: flour, cornstarch, baking soda, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix dry ingredients, add water a little at a time until dough forms a ball Do not over wet. Step 2: Roll out into thin layer and cut into desired shapes. Step 3: Fry, bake or microwave.

Dish Name: Mexican Lasagna With Black Beans and Corn
Ingredient Names: cooking spray, flour tortillas, fresh corn kernels, black beans, tomatoes mild green chilies, tomato sauce, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic powder, sugar, eggs, regular sour cream, mexican blend cheese, green onions, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400 F; Spray a 13-by-9-inch baking pan with cooking oil spray; Set aside. Step 2: Stack the tortillas on a cutting board, and slice through them lengthwise into 3 strips each (The strips will not be uniform because of their circular shape; This is OK), set aside. Step 3: Pour the corn and black beans into a colander, and rinse with warm tap water to begin defrosting the corn and rinse the beans; Set aside to drain. Step 4: In a small bowl, stir together the tomatoes with their juice, the tomato sauce, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and sugar; Spoon about half of the sauce into the bottom of the dish; Cover the sauce with 5 of the tortilla strips (it's fine if they overlap somewhat). Step 5: Break the egg into a medium-size mixing bowl, and beat with a whisk or fork until foamy; Add the sour cream and 1 cup of the cheese; Stir to mix well; Spoon half of the sour cream mixture evenly over the tortilla layer and spread it out with the back of a spoon; Scatter half of the corn and black beans over the sour cream mixture. Step 6: Place 5 more tortilla strips evenly over the corn and black bean layer; Top with the remaining sour cream mixture, and the remaining black beans and corn; Place the remaining tortilla strips over the dish; Pour the remaining tomato sauce mixture over the tortillas, and spread it evenly with the back of a spoon to moisten all of the tortilla strips. Step 7: Cover the dish with foil, and bake for 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Step 8: While the dish bakes, rinse and trim the green onions; Slice the green onions thinly, using all of the whites and enough of the tender green tops to make 1/2 cup; Set aside. Step 9: If using the black olives, drain them well, and set aside. Step 10: After baking lasagna, scatter the green onions and olives, if using, evenly over the dish; Return the dish to the oven, uncovered, for 5 more minutes. Step 11: Remove the dish from the oven, and scatter the remaining cup of Mexican cheese evenly over the dish. Step 12: Return the dish, uncovered, to the oven, and bake until the cheese melts, about 3 minutes. Step 13: Remove the lasagna from the oven, and let it stand 10 minutes; Slice into squares and serve.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, cheddar cheese soup, milk, picante sauce, black olives, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Boil pasta as directed on package. Step 2: Drain and put in large serving bowl. Step 3: Mix picante sauce, milk, and cheese soup in a smaller bowl until creamy. Step 4: Heat in microwave until warm. Step 5: Mix sauce and pasta together and garnish with olives and jalepenos if desired.

Ingredient Names: rice, water, beef bouillon, salt, chili powder, green bell pepper, onion, garlic cloves, chopped tomato, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Using a teflon pan- place olive oil in the pan and when it is hot add rice -- fry until nicely brown. Step 2: Reduce heat -- add bell pepper, onion, garlic and continue to saut. Step 3: After about 5 minutes or so add water, tomato, chili powder and salt. Step 4: Place lid on skillet and turn heat down, simmer gently. Step 5: When the water has all evaporated-10-15 min later- slide the lid off of the skillet about half way so the steam will escape so your rice is not wet, serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, milk, eggs, ground beef, onions, green bell peppers, garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt, pepper, tomato sauce, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti per package direcions. Step 2: Combine milk and egg, mix well. Step 3: Combine drained spaghetti, milk and egg; mix well. Step 4: Pour spaghetti mixture into a buttered 9X13 inch casserole dish. Step 5: Brown ground beef with onion, bell pepper and garlic in a large skillet; drain. Step 6: Return drained meat back into the skillet and add seasonings; Cook for 2 minutes. Step 7: Stir in tomato sauce and cook for 2 more minutes. Step 8: Spread meat mixture over spaghetti. Step 9: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 10: Bake at 425°F for 10 minutes or until cheese melts and is bubbly. Step 11: Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, baby cooking chorizo, garlic, smoked paprika, fresh tomato, basmati rice, stock, lemon zest off, bay leaves, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan with a lid. Add the onion and cook for 5-8 mins until soft and golden. Push to the side of the pan and add the chorizo. Cook until lightly browned and some of the oils are released into the pan. Step 2: Add the garlic and paprika, then the tomatoes. Bubble over a medium heat for 5 mins, then add the rice, stock, lemon zest and bay leaves. Stir everything together well and bring to the boil. Put the lid on and cook over a very low heat for 12 mins. Step 3: Turn off the heat and leave to sit and steam for 10-15 mins. Stir through the parsley and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over.

Dish Name: Meatballs with spicy chipotle tomato sauce
Ingredient Names: pork ground meat, breadcrumbs, eggs, red onions, fresh cilantro stems, vegetable oil, garlic, passata, chipotle paste, potatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix together the pork, breadcrumbs, egg, finely chopped onions and the chopped coriander leaves. Season, mix well and shape into small meatballs. Over a medium heat, add 1 tbsp of the oil to a large frying pan and brown the meatballs on all sides, then remove from the pan and set aside. Step 2: Add the remaining oil, sliced onion, garlic, coriander stems and some salt. Cook for 5 mins, then add the passata and chipotle paste. Pour in 100ml water and stir well, then simmer for 10 mins before adding the meatballs and cooking for a further 5 mins. Serve with potatoes or rice and scatter with the extra coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onions, garlic, poblano peppers, jalapeno chiles, water, white rice, parsley, ground cumin, salt, black pepper, spinach, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Cook& stir onion, garlic& chilis for 5-7 minutes. Step 3: Add water, parsley, cumin, salt& pepper; bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Step 4: Stir in rice, cover, and cook at medium-low for 10-12 minutes. Step 5: Stir in spinach and cilantro; cook on low until rice is tender (4-5 minutes.) Remove from heat, fluff rice, and let stand for 5-10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, white rice, red bell peppers, ground cumin, chili powder, tomato sauce, salt, garlic, powdered saffron, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions in a heavy saucepan until golden. Step 2: Add rice; stir briskly to quickly coat with oil. Step 3: Stir in bell pepper, cumin, chili powder, tomato sauce, salt, garlic, saffron, and water. Step 4: Cover, bring to a boil, and then reduce heat to low. Step 5: Cook for 30 to 40 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed (periodically check to be sure there is enough liquid and to give rice a little stir).

Ingredient Names: white rice, cumin, fresh coriander, oregano, onion flakes, cayenne pepper, spicy cajun seasoning, fresh cilantro, chevre cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix dry rice, spices and dried onions. Step 2: Cook rice according to package directions, either on stove top or in rice cooker. Step 3: Fluff rice with fork. Step 4: Add cheese to warm rice and let melt a bit. Step 5: Add cilantro and combine well.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, mexican salsa, vegetables, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, combine basmati rice and salsa. Step 2: Heat for 2-3 mins, then add stock. Step 3: Mix together, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer over a very low heat. Step 4: Cook for 10-12 mins or until the rice is tender. Step 5: Serve scattered with coriander.

Ingredient Names: basmati wild rice, mixed bean salad, green onions, red peppers, avocados, limes, cajun spice mix, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the rice following pack instructions. Drain, then cool under cold running water until completely cold. Stir in beans, onions, pepper and avocado. Step 2: Mix the lime juice with the Cajun spice mix and some black pepper. Pour over the rice mix, stir in the coriander and serve with extra lime wedges.

Dish Name: Mexican rice with chipotle pork & avocado salsa
Ingredient Names: pork shoulder steak, chipotle paste, ground cumin smoked paprika, sugar, vegetable oil, basmati rice, black bean, avocados, red onions, fresh coriander, limes, pickled jalape os
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Toss the pork with 1 tbsp of the chipotle paste, cumin, paprika, sugar and some seasoning. Spread on a baking tray, drizzle with the vegetable oil and bake for 20 mins until tender. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the rice following pack instructions until just cooked, then drain. Put back in the pan, add the beans and keep warm with a lid on. Step 3: In a small bowl, toss the avocado with the red onion, most of the coriander, remaining chipotle paste and lime juice, then season. Serve the rice and beans with the pork, avocado salsa, jalapeño, lime wedges and remaining coriander.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, brown rice, onions, garlic, mexican-style tomatoes, bell peppers, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat canola oil in a saucepan over medium heat and saute and rice just until golden. Step 2: Add the onions and garlic and saute for a couple of minutes. Step 3: Stir in tomatoes (including juice), the rest of the broth, and bell pepper. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat, cover for 20 to 25 minutes, or until all absorbed.

Ingredient Names: white rice, white onions, garlic, achiote, poblano chiles, cooking oil, chicken broth, salt, fresh cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice and drain well, set apart. Step 2: Process in blender the onion, garlic and achiote in some of the chicken broth (about a cup). Step 3: Heat oil in a skillet and fry rice on medium heat until lightly brown. Step 4: Add the processed liquid and let it reach boiling point. Step 5: At this point add half of the broth (hot) Simmer covered until broth is consumed. Step 6: Fluff rice with a fork from the edges to the center. Step 7: Add the other half of the hot broth, the lime juice, and season with salt or powdered bouillon. Step 8: Lower heat, cover and cook for about 15 more minutes. Step 9: Fluff it again from the edges to the center. Step 10: Uncover just to add the cilantro sprig. Step 11: Cover again and let it stand to finish steaming and absorb the cilantro's flavor. Step 12: Garnish with poblano strips.

Ingredient Names: pouch microwave rice, cajun seasoning, green onions, flour tortillas, refried beans, salsa, fat-free yogurt, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the rice following the pack instructions, then stir in the Cajun seasoning and most of the spring onions. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Spread the tortillas with the refried beans, then top with rice. Spread half the salsa on the base of a baking dish. Roll up the wraps, arrange on top of the salsa, dot over half the yogurt and sprinkle over the cheese. Cook for 30 mins until golden and bubbling. Serve sprinkled with the rest of the spring onions, with the remaining yogurt and salsa on the side.

Dish Name: Rice, and Corn With Chipotle Peppers
Ingredient Names: butter, red peppers, onions, garlic, chipotle chiles, rice, fresh corn kernels, chicken stock, cream, salt, pepper, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large pan. Step 2: Saute onions, peppers, and garlic in butter. Step 3: Add rice stir to coat with the butter. Step 4: Add corn, chipotles, and stock bring to a boil add cream (Liquid should cover all ingredients) and reduce heat to simmer and cook for 20 minute till rice is tender. Step 5: Add more liquid if necessary. Step 6: Plate and garnish with scallions.

Ingredient Names: rice, peppers olive oil, fajita seasoning mix, black-eyed beans, limes, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to pack instructions, then drain. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan. Add the sliced peppers and fajita seasoning, and cook for 1 min until fragrant. Step 2: Stir through the rice and beans, and heat until piping hot. Mix the remaining oil, lime juice, coriander and some seasoning into the pan and serve.

Ingredient Names: chipotle paste, turkey ground meat, long grain rice, kidney bean water, chicken stock, sweetcorn, fresh coriander, taco shells, iceberg lettuce, sour cream, cheese guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the paste in a frying pan with a lid. When hot, add the mince and cook until browned, breaking it up well with a fork. Stir in the rice and beans, and mix well, then add the stock. Step 2: Cover and simmer for 20-25 mins until the rice is tender, then stir in the sweetcorn and scatter over the coriander. Heat the taco shells following pack instructions, then serve with the mince mixture, lettuce and soured cream. Let everyone build their own dinner, adding grated cheese and guacamole.

Dish Name: 4 Pepper Dip Dressing Really Kicked Up
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, low-fat plain yogurt, cumin powder, sweet paprika, cracked black pepper, salt, cilantro, onion, sweet red peppers, sugar, chipotle chile in adobo
Instructions: Step 1: Place all in a blender or vita mix and blend till will pureed Pour lightly over a salad use as a dip or top a grilled chicken, pork or fish.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, avocados, cottage cheese, dried garlic, olive oil, vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a big bowl cut the letuce in pieces by hand Add the rest of the ingredients and mix them carefully!

Ingredient Names: dried black beans, olive oil, fresh lime juice, salt, garlic, cilantro, navel oranges, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Pick through dried beans, discarding any bad ones, rinse beans. Step 2: Place beans in a large pot. Step 3: Add enough water to cover beans by 2 inches. Step 4: Bring to a boil, cook for two minutes, and then turn off the heat. Step 5: Let beans soak in covered pot for one hour. Step 6: Bring to a boil, covered. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Step 8: Drain beans and rinse with cold water Dry beans on paper towel.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lemon juice, sour cream, picante sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and slice each avocado in half, remove seeds. Step 2: Using a small pasty brush, coat each avocado with lemon juice Lay each avocado half on small salad plates. Step 3: Then, using the brush or a small spatula, paint a wide band of sour cream down the middle Paint a narrow band of picante sauce down the center of the sour cream. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, salt, sour cream, mayonnaise, pepper sauce, dijon mustard, garlic, bacon, hard-cooked eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water. Step 2: Add 2 teaspoons salt and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and cook 12 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender, drain and cool. Step 4: Meanwhile in a small bowl, combine sour cream, mayonaise, tabasco sauce, mustard and garlic, mix well. Step 5: Place potaotes in a large bowl with bacon and eggs. Step 6: Add dressing and toss to coat. Step 7: Season to taste with salt. Step 8: Cover and refrigerate.

Dish Name: Baja Chicken Salad With Taco Vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: taco seasoning mix, light brown sugar, olive oil, cider vinegar, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, mixed baby greens, grape tomatoes, red onion, monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, sour cream, avocado, sliced ripe olives, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the taco seasoning mix, light brown sugar, 1 / 2 cup olive oil, and cider vinegar, blend well. Step 2: Place chicken pieces in a medium, shallow bowl. Step 3: Pour 1 / 2 cup of the seasoning mixture over the chicken Reserve remaining mixture for the dressing. Step 4: In a medium skillet, heat 1 to 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat until hot With a slotted spoon, remove chicken from seasoning mixture and discard remainder of mixture. Step 5: Add chicken to the skillet, cooking and stirring for 5-7 minutes or until no longer pink in the center. Step 6: In a large bowl, combine the baby greens, grape tomatoes, and red onion. Step 7: Add reserved seasoning mixture and toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, celery, onion, diced green chilies, cilantro, low-fat cream cheese, jalapenos, salt, white pepper, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and dice potatoes into cubes, boil until fork tender. Step 2: Mix together potatoes, celery, onion, green chilies, and cilantro, set aside. Step 3: In a separate bowl, mix cream cheese with jalapeos. Step 4: Fold cream cheese mixture into the potato mixture. Step 5: Add salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Step 6: Chill before serving.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, head iceberg lettuce, sweet onion, black beans, avocado, cheddar cheese, nacho cheese flavored tortilla chips, taco seasoning, fresh cilantro, thousand island dressing
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, onion, beans, avocado and cheese. Step 2: Toss to combine well. Step 3: Add crushed chips-mix well. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine taco seasoning, cilantro and thousand island dressing and stir well. Step 5: Pour over salad and toss to coat.

Dish Name: Becky's Gourmet Southwestern Taco Salad Or Nachos With Steak
Ingredient Names: beef sirloin, fresh mushrooms, white onion, olive oil, garlic, garlic powder, garlic paste, ground coriander, salt & pepper, mixed salad greens, dark red kidney beans, black olives, green onion, chili pepper, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet or wok. Step 2: Add onion and mushrooms. Step 3: Cook on medium-high heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add beef strips and seasonings to taste, stir well to coat. Step 5: Cook @ 10 minutes longer, stirring occasionally, until desired doneness For taco salad: Serve warm meat atop beds of mixed lettuce, tomatoes, kidney beans, corn, sliced black olives, green onions, avocado slices, squeeze of fresh lime juice, and crumbled chips For nachos: Alternatively, layer meat and your favorite toppings between layers of tortilla chips, top with shredded cheese, and pop into the microwave for a minute, just until cheese is melted.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Mandarin Orange Salad
Ingredient Names: mandarin orange segments, red wine vinegar, olive oil, dijon mustard, cilantro, cumin, pepper, feta cheese, red onion, garlic, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Drain oranges, reserving 1 / 2 tbsp per serving of the liquid. Step 2: Mix well: the reserved liquid, vinegar, oil, mustard, cilantro, cumin, and pepper in a large bowl. Step 3: Add oranges, cheese, onions, garlic and beans and toss well.

Dish Name: Black Bean Corn Salad With Avocado
Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, cayenne pepper, black beans, frozen corn kernels, avocado, red bell pepper, tomatoes, green onions, fresh cilantro, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place lime juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and cayenne in a small jar. Step 2: Cover with lid, and shake until ingredients are well mixed. Step 3: In a large plastic container or bowl with a cover, toss the beans, corn, avocado, bell pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and cilantro together Shake lime dressing again and pour it over the salad. Step 4: Stir salad to coat vegetables and beans with dressing, cover and refrigerate. Step 5: Let this sit for a while to blend flavors If you can, remove the container from the refrigerator every so often and turn upside down and back gently a couple of times to redistribute the dressing.

Ingredient Names: avocado, sour cream, milk, mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic salt, cracked black pepper, hot pepper sauce, lettuce, tomatoes, bacon, crouton
Instructions: Step 1: In food processor, combine all dressing ingredients. Step 2: Beat at low speed just until smooth. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for several hours to blend flavors At serving time, arrange salad ingredients on 6 individual plates or toss in large salad bowl. Step 4: Serve with dressing.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrot, parsley, pickled jalapeno pepper, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cactus pieces, tomatoes, white onion, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, monterey jack cheese, salt, corn oil
Instructions: Step 1: Steam the cactus until softened, drain the cactus. Step 2: Fry all the ingredients except for the monterrey cheese. Step 3: Combine fried ingredients with the cactus and allow to simmer for 15 minutes. Step 4: Top with cheese before serving.

Ingredient Names: salt, nopales, tomatoes, onion, fresh cilantro stems, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, oregano, romaine lettuce leaves, queso fresco, pickled jalapeno peppers, radishes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 6 inches of water and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt to a boil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the cactus and boil, uncovered, until tender, about 20 minutes. Step 3: Drain the cactus and transfer it to a large bowl. Step 4: Add tomato, onion and cilantro, set aside. Step 5: Whisk together the oil, vinegar, oregano and salt. Step 6: Pour over the vegetables and toss. Step 7: Line a platter with lettuce leaves, top with salad. Step 8: Sprinkle with cheese.

Dish Name: Cactus Paddle Salad Relish Or Ensalada De Nopalitos
Ingredient Names: cactus pieces, tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, vegetable oil, cider vinegar, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: If the cactus is in big chunks dice to 1 / 2-1 / 4 inch pieces. Step 2: Toss together with the tomato, onion and cilantro. Step 3: Whisk together the dressing ingredients and toss with the salad, serve.

Ingredient Names: cactus pieces, olive oil, garlic cloves, canned black beans, green onions, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, sugar, ground cumin, dried chipotle powder, tomatoes, lettuce, queso fresco, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Peel thorns from cactus pads with a vegetable peeler, leaving the green skin. Step 2: Cut cactus pads into thin strips. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Add the cactus and garlic, saute 7-8 minutes or until cactus is tender. Step 5: Combine the cactus mixture, beans and the next 7 ingredients. Step 6: Arrange 1 1 / 2 cups lettuce on each of 4 plates, top each with 1 / 2 cup cactus mixture, 1 1 / 2 tbls Cheese, and about 2 teaspoons sour cream Enjoy! Step 7: Yield: 4 servings.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, lettuce, catalina dressing, onions, cheddar cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown the ground beef and drain off the grease and allow to room temperature. Step 2: Make sure you drain the grease off well or it will sift to the bottom of your salad bowl. Step 3: Chop the lettuce to bite sized pieces. Step 4: In a large salad bowl place in the lettuce, cheese, ground beef and onion. Step 5: Crush the tortilla chips lightly onto them and mix it up. Step 6: Add enough catalina to cover your salad. Step 7: I used about half of a bottle for this. Step 8: You want a nice coating though, serve.

Ingredient Names: corn muffin mix, green chilies, cumin, oregano, sage, mayonnaise, sour cream, ranch dressing mix, pinto beans, whole kernel corn, chopped tomatoes, green pepper, green onion, bacon, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400. Step 2: Prepare corn muffin mix per instructions. Step 3: Add next 4 ingredients to batter. Step 4: Spread into 8x8 greased baking pan. Step 5: Bake for 25 minutes, cool. Step 6: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and dressing mix. Step 7: Set aside Crumble half the corn bread into a 13x9 dish. Step 8: Layer with half the beans.

Ingredient Names: ranch dressing, salsa, dried chipotle powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingrediants in a plastic container or jar with a tight lid Shake to mix Chill If you prefer a smoother dressing, use a food processor to blend.

Ingredient Names: cilantro leaf, fresh parsley leaves, green onion, garlic, lime juice, plain yogurt, sour cream, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Add the first five ingredients to the blender or food processor and puree until chopped add the yogurt and sour cream and blend until smooth, adding as much salt and pepper as you like.

Ingredient Names: frozen sweet corn, fresh tomatoes, vidalia onion, fresh cilantro, extra virgin olive oil, lime, black beans, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients and toss to blend Can also add chopped jicama, chopped green onions, chopped jalapeno, chopped red peppers, garlic the possibilities are endless!, cha cha cha!

Ingredient Names: pomegranate, grapefruit, sweet oranges, lime, garlic clove, red wine vinegar, limes, sugar, dry mustard, extra virgin olive oil, avocado, lettuce, salt and pepper, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the pomegranate into quarters, then press back the outer skin to push the seeds out into a bowl. Step 2: Using a sharp knife, cut a slice off the top and bottom of the grapefruit, then remove the peel and pith, cutting downward. Step 3: Cut out the segments from between the membranes, then add to the pomegranate Finely grate the rind of half an orange and set aside. Step 4: Using a sharp knife, cut a slice off the top and bottom of both oranges, then remove the peel and pith, cutting downward and being careful to retain the shape of the oranges. Step 5: Slice horizontally into slices, then cut into quarters. Step 6: Add the oranges to the pomegranate and grapefruit and stir to mix well. Step 7: Combine the orange rind with the lime rind, garlic, vinegar, lime juice, sugar and mustard in a nonmetallic bowl. Step 8: Season to taste, then whisk in the oil. Step 9: Cut the avocado in half lengthwise and twist the 2 halves in opposite directions to separate.

Ingredient Names: salt, garlic, dijon mustard, worcestershire sauce, anchovy paste, fresh lemon juice, egg yolk, canola oil, romaine lettuce, white bread, parmesan cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large wooden or glass bowl mash the garlic into the salt until smooth. Step 2: Add the dijon, worcestershire, and anchovy paste, whisk well. Step 3: Add the lemon juice and whisk well. Step 4: Add the egg yolk and whisk well. Step 5: Add the oil in a slow,, steady stream while whisking like mad. Step 6: Keep whisking until dressing is smooth and creamy looking. Step 7: Add the romaine and toast cubes and toss well. Step 8: Add the parmesan cheese and toss well again, serve right away.

Ingredient Names: avocados, tomatoes, cilantro, onions, lemon, jalapeno, garlic, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the avocado, leaving a few rough chunks. Step 2: Stir in the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Serve within 30 minutes with chips, or as a garnish to other dishes It is best to make just before serving, but if you have to hold longer, place plastic wrap directly on the surface of the guacamole to keep from unsightly darkening.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, extra virgin olive oil, milk, ground cinnamon, lemon juice, fresh cilantro, fresh parsley, rice wine vinegar, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whirl all ingredients in a blender until smooth or use a handheld immersion blender. Step 2: Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary If thinner consistency desired, thin with more milk. Step 3: Store in refrigerator until ready to use Yield is estimated.

Ingredient Names: squeezed orange juice, red wine vinegar, mayonnaise, chipotle peppers, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, lime juice, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan combine the orange juice& vinegar. Step 2: Bring to a boil over high heat; then, reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer vigorously until the liquid is reduced by 2/3, about 25 minutes. Step 3: Remove the liquid from the heat, and allow to cool to room temperature. Step 4: Add the mayonnaise and whisk together until well blended. Step 5: Add the chipotle, cilantro, cumin and lime juice; whisk together well. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, buttermilk ranch salad dressing mix, mayonnaise, buttermilk, fresh cilantro, garlic cloves, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a blender and refrigerate at least one hour For a thicker dressing, reduce mayo to 1 / 2 cup and add 1 / 2 cup sour cream to the mixture.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, white wine vinegar, lime zest, lime juice, sour cream, garlic clove, honey, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients except olive oil in blender and process Add olive oil in a stream while still processing, until mixture thickens Refrigerate.

Dish Name: Day After Thanksgiving Fiesta Turkey Salad Leftover
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, salsa, romaine lettuce, cooked turkey, bacon, tomatoes, diced onion, black beans, olive, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the mayo and salsa Toss with the remaining ingredients before serving.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, salt, ground black pepper, bush's red beans, catalina dressing, water, chili powder, lettuce, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, nacho chip
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet brown ground beef. Step 2: Drain and return to skillet. Step 3: Stir in onion and continue to cook 5 minutes. Step 4: Add seasonings, red beans, salad dressing and water. Step 5: Stir to mix and allow to simmer over medium low heat 15 minutes. Step 6: Place dorito's chips on plate- crush slightly if desired. Step 7: Spoon meat& bean mixture over top and garnish with lettuce, tomatoes& cheese.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, red cabbage, carrots, tomatoes, avocados, lemon juice, green onions, black beans, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese, ranch salad dressing, taco seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Chop lettuce and toss in a large bowl with grated cabbage and carrots. Step 2: Spread mixture into the bottom of a deep glass salad bowl. Step 3: Peel and slice avocado and toss with lemon juice. Step 4: This prevents avocado from turning brown. Step 5: Evenly cover the lettuce with a layer of tomato, followed by a layer of avocado, a layer of green onion, a layer of beans and a layer of chips. Step 6: Pour the dressing over all and sprinkle with the cheese. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate for at least 45 minutes before serving. Step 8: For a spicier dressing mix taco seasoning with Ranch dressing if desired.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, olive oil, cajun, iceberg lettuce, black bean, cherry tomato, avocados, limes, cilantro only
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Place the tortilla pieces on a baking tray, toss with the oil and the seasoning mix, then cook for 10-12 mins until crisp. In a large bowl, toss the iceberg, beans and tomatoes. Toss the avocado in the lime juice and add to the bowl. Step 2: Drizzle over your chosen dressing and toss to coat all the ingredients. Top with the croutons and coriander, then serve.

Ingredient Names: tortilla, olive oil, limes, jalape os, crisp salad leaves, avocados, fresh tomato, red onions, turkey, cheddar, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. To make a tortilla basket, soften the tortilla in the microwave for a few secs, then brush with a little of the oil and gently push the oiled side to line a small ovenproof bowl. Line with foil and weigh with baking beans or a slightly smaller ovenproof bowl. Cook for 8-12 mins until crisp, allow to cool slightly before removing. Step 2: Make the dressing by mixing the oil, lime juice and vinegar, season. Mix the leaves, avocado, tomato, onion and turkey and toss with the dressing. Pile into the bowl and top with the cheese, jalapeños and a dollop of soured cream.

Ingredient Names: morningstar farms grillers burger style recipe crumbles vegetarian ground beef, taco seasoning mix, water, kidney beans, fresh corn kernels, tomatoes green chilies, green leaf lettuce, jalapeno jack cheese, taco shells, nonfat yogurt, salsa, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Put diced tomatoes and taco seasoning mix into a pan on medium-low heat. Step 2: Rinse the diced tomato can with 1/4 cup water and add that to pan. Step 3: Stir taco mix in thoroughly. Step 4: Add the Prime Grillers Crumbles and the corn, and stir occasionally until heated through. Step 5: Add the beans and stir just until heated. Step 6: While mixture is heating, rinse and pat or spin dry the lettuce, and tear it into bite-size pieces. Step 7: Pile the lettuce onto plates, and top with taco mixture. Step 8: Top with grated cheese if desired. Step 9: Crumble two taco shells on top of each salad. Step 10: If you would like extra sauce, make and top with the optional dressing.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sweetcorn well, kidney beans, mixed green salad leaves, plain tortilla chips, sour cream, sugar, juice lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan and, when hot, stir in the sweetcorn. Cook for 3 mins, stirring often until the corn is browned, then remove and leave to cool. Step 2: Toss together sweetcorn, kidney beans, salad leaves and tortilla chips. Mix together the sour cream, sugar and lime zest and juice. Drizzle over salad and serve.

Ingredient Names: crabmeat, monterey jack cheese, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, seafood cocktail sauce, green onion, garlic, tortilla, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Combine crabmeat, monterey jack cheese, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, 1 / 4 cup cocktail sauce, green onions and garlic in medium bowl, mix well. Step 2: Spread about 1 / 2 cup mixture onto 2 tortillas. Step 3: Sprinkle evenly with remaining monterey jack cheese. Step 4: Top with remaining tortillas. Step 5: Melt 1 tablespoons butter on cast iron griddle over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add one quesadilla. Step 7: Cook for 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown, repeat. Step 8: Cut each into eight wedges.

Ingredient Names: grouper fillets, tequila, triple sec, lime juice, sea salt, garlic, olive oil, tomatoes, onion, jalapeno, sugar, cilantro, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place fish in a large dish. Step 2: Combine tequila, triple sec, limejuice, salt, garlic and 1 tablespoon oil and pour over filets and rub into fish. Step 3: Cover and marinate for 1 / 2 hour at room temperature, turning fillets once. Step 4: Combine tomatoes, onions, chiles, cilantro, sugar and salt to taste. Step 5: Heat the grill to very hot. Step 6: Remove fillets from marinade, pat dry and reserve marinade. Step 7: Brush fillets with 1 t Oil and grind pepper to taste over fillets. Step 8: Grill for about 4 minutes per side. Step 9: Meanwhile, boil marinade in saucepan for 2 minutes, remove garlic cloves and spoon a little over fish.

Ingredient Names: onion, olive oil, tuna, egg, milk, tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, stewed tomatoes, chili powder, salt and pepper, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onions in oil, cook until transparent. Step 2: In a large bowl combine drained tuna, onions, tomatoes, chili powder, salt, pepper, eggs and milk, blend. Step 3: Place half of the chips in the botttom of a 2 quart dish, top with half of the cheese, then half the tuna mixture, repeat layers. Step 4: Spread sour cream on top, cook 25-30 minutes in a preheated 350 degree oven until hot and bubbly. Step 5: Garnish with parsley and olives.

Ingredient Names: achiote paste, salad oil, orange juice, garlic cloves, lime, apple cider, worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper, tilapia fillet
Instructions: Step 1: Mix achiote paste together all ingredients down to the salt / pepper. Step 2: Place fish in a shallow baking dish and pour achiote marinade over top. Step 3: Cover dish and place in fridge for 2 hours. Step 4: Remove fish from marinade and place fish on cookie sheet. Step 5: Let stand at room temp for 15 minutes. Step 6: Turn oven broiler to high and let heat up for 3-5 minutes. Step 7: Place fish under the broiler until cooked, approx 5-7 minutes depending upon the heat of oven and the thickness of the fish. Step 8: Serve fillets atop saffron rice or serve in corn torillas for excellent fish tacos.

Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, serrano chilies, limes, cilantro, salt, red onion, cucumber, avocado, tostadas
Instructions: Step 1: You will need to butterfly and devein your shrimp. Step 2: Using a sharp knife, cut each shrimp lengthwise along the back For larger shrimp, cut them cleanly into two halves For smaller shrimp, do not cut all the way through so that the two halves stay together. Step 3: Once open, remove the gray line of guts running through the center of the shrimp. Step 4: In a blender, add the chilies, lime juice, cilantro, and the first teaspoon of salt. Step 5: Blend until the chilies are just broken up Don't worry about making a smooth paste A few chunks of chili are not a problem. Step 6: Cover the shellfish with the blended sauce.

Ingredient Names: tuna, onion, pineapple, salt & pepper, achiote, lime juice, prepared mustard, cooking oil, vinegar, tortillas, cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 175c. Step 2: In a baking dish, place the fish strips, adding the onion, pineapple, salt and pepper. Step 3: Combine dressing ingredients and pour over fish strips. Step 4: Bake in oven until fish is cooked and sauce has thickened-- approx 30 min. Step 5: Make tacos with the tortillas and garnish with cilantro and onion Sprinle a bit of lime juice over taco filling.

Dish Name: Alaska Salmon W Tomatillo Sauce Fresh Corn Poblano Chile
Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, tomatillo, serrano chilies, cilantro, lime juice, corn, heavy cream, poblano peppers, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce: Combine the tomatillos, serrano chilies, cilantro, and lime juice in the blender and puree until very smooth. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper and keep chilled until ready to serve For the corn: Husk the corn and shave the kernels off the cob. Step 3: Place the cream in a pot, cooking down to reduce by 1 / 2 Roast the poblanos under a broiler and place in a bowl to steam, covered, ten minutes. Step 4: When the chilies are cool to handle, peel, seed, and roughly chop. Step 5: Combine the corn, poblanos, and cream and set aside. Step 6: Keep warm until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, white onions, garlic clove, chopped tomatoes, tomato sauce, chicken stock, dry oregano, salt, fresh ground black pepper, carrots, celery, potato, rice, egg, panko breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: For the soup: heat some oil in a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic cook for 3 minutes being careful not to burn. Step 3: Add chopped tomatoes, tomato sauce, stock, oregano, salt, pepper, carrots, potatoes, and celery and bring to a boil. Step 4: When the soup has reached a boil, cover and bring down to low heat. Step 5: Pour some oil into a pan and slightly brown the rice then add to the soup For the albndigas: add the liquid from the canned salmon to the soup and place the salmon in a large bowl Break up the salmon into very small pieces with a fork. Step 6: In a medium bowl, mix the bread crumbs and the egg until well combined. Step 7: Add the onions, garlic, salt pepper, cumin and cilantro. Step 8: Add the salmon and incorporate with the other ingredients.

Dish Name: Aleid's Mexican Fish Roll Up Tortillas
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, fish fillets, sambal tjampoer, soya sauce, desiccated coconut, coconut meat, sugar, cornflour, salt, tomato sauce, white vinegar, soy sauce, tortillas, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the onion in the olive oil in pan, add the soy sauce, sambal and sweet and sour sauce. Step 2: Add the fish and simmer for 15 minutes, add more soy sauce according to preference and the dissicated coconut and the coconut meat. Step 3: Simmer for several minutes more. Step 4: Put spoonfulls into the middle of tortilla's and roll them up, tucking in the ends as you go to make little parcels. Step 5: Line up the packages in an oven dish, sprinkle grated cheese over the top, put into a hot oven for about 20 minutes until hot. Step 6: Serve with fresh crisp salad and white rice If you can't get it i think that most hot pepper / chilli sauces could be used as substitute Yes, you can make this mild enough for the kids to eat too!

Ingredient Names: shrimp, cooked scallops, white crab meat, lemons, limes, firm ripe tomatoes, cilantro, avocados, cucumbers, salt, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare all ingredients as shown above. Step 2: Soak shrimp in the lemon and lime juice until pink. Step 3: Fold in scallops and crab meat. Step 4: Add cucumbers, tomatoes, avocados and cilantro. Step 5: Add salt and hot sauce to to taste If you like it spicy, add 1 to 3 finely diced jalapenos. Step 6: Serve right away on top of tostadas or with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: salmon, cumin, chili powder, olive oil, yellow onion, limes, diced tomatoes with green chilies, fresh cilantro, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Toss cubed salmon in cumin and chili powder, set aside. Step 2: Heat large skillet over medium and cook yellow onion 2 minutes, until it begins to soften. Step 3: Turn heat up to medium high. Step 4: Add salmon to skillet Lightly sear salmon cubes for about 2-3 minutes, turning gently Important: do not over cook the salmon This juicy recipe will keep steaming the salmon The salmon should still be firm in the middle of the cube when you proceed to the next step. Step 5: Return heat setting to medium.

Dish Name: Asian Californian Mexican Faux Crab Salad
Ingredient Names: red pepper, tomatoes, scallions, garlic clove, coriander leaves, hot pepper, fresh lime juice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, avocados, lime juice, sour cream, surimi, toasted sesame seeds, nori, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a glass bowl, toss together the ingredients for the salsa. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper and set aside to let the flavors build Singleguychef says to let it sit for an hour but 30 minutes is also okay. Step 3: Combine the chopped avocado and lime juice, season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Step 4: Set aside In another glass bowl, add all of the ingredients for the faux crab. Step 5: Toss, season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste Okay, now for the combining the three bits: You could make the crab the base, then the avocado, then the salsa, topped with sour cream Or -- you could make the avocado the base, topped with crab, then with salsa, then with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, rice vinegar, parsley, dill weed, salt, onion powder, black pepper, shrimp, green olives, celery, green onion, avocados, paprika, bibb lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Using a medium sized bowl, mix mayonnaise, rice vinegar, parsley, dill weed, salt, onion powder, and pepper until smooth. Step 2: Mix in the shrimp, olives, celery, and onion. Step 3: Allow salad to marinate at least 1 hour Shortly before serving, cut avocados in half lengthwise and carefully remove the pits leaving the skins intact. Step 4: Cut a small sliver of avocado off each half so that it will lie flatter on serving plate Carefully remove several tablespoons of pulp, cut into bite size pieces, and reserve 4 tablespoons of pulp for garnish. Step 5: Mix majority of pulp with shrimp mixture Lay one piece of bibb lettuce on each serving plate, add avocado shell, and spoon shrimp mixture into the avocado halves. Step 6: Sprinkle paprika on. Step 7: Garnish by dividing reserved pulp between portions.

Dish Name: Bacalao A La Mexicana Dried Cod Mexican Style
Ingredient Names: salt cod fish, chile, tomatoes, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, bay leaf, ground cinnamon, fresh ground pepper, roasted red peppers, blanched almond, raisins, pimento stuffed olive, parsley, small potato
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the cod in cold water to cover for 12 hours, changing the water 2 or 3 times, drain. Step 2: Place in saucepan cover with water and bring just to a boil. Step 3: Drain, remove the skin and bones, shred the flesh and set aside. Step 4: Remove the stem and seeds from the chile ancho and soak in hot water for 10 minutes. Step 5: Drain then puree in blender with the tomatoes and strain. Step 6: Heat the oil in a large skillet, add the onion and garlic over low heat until transparent. Step 7: Add the puree and cook over low heat until it thickens. Step 8: Add the cod, bay leaf, cinnamon, pepper, red peppers, almonds, raisins, olives, capers and parsley. Step 9: Stir, then cook over medium heat, covered, for 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Bacon And Egg Ranch Salsa Breakfast Quesadillas
Ingredient Names: eggs, whipping cream, salt and pepper, green onions, bell pepper, pickled jalapeno peppers, butter, ranch dressing, salsa, salt, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, bacon, cooked ham
