Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl stir together the ranch dressing with the salsa. Step 2: Mix to combine then season with a small amount of salt if desired, cover and chill. Step 3: In a bowl whisk together the eggs and whipping cream until well blended. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Add in the green onions, bell pepper and chopped pickled jalapenos, mix to combine. Step 6: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Add in the egg mixture. Step 8: Cook without stirring.

Ingredient Names: lawry baja chipotle marinade, cod, mayonnaise, sour cream, taco-size corn tortillas, green cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Place fish in a large baking dish or resealable plastic bag, pour 3 / 4 cup lawry's baja chipotle marinade with lime juice over the fish. Step 2: Marinate in refrigerator about 30 minutes in covered dish or sealed plastic bag. Step 3: Remove fish from dish or bag and discard marinade. Step 4: Grill or broil fish and baste with 1 / 4 cup baja chipotle marinade. Step 5: Turn fish once and cook until fish flakes easily with a fork While fish is cooking, combine mayonnaise, sour cream, and remaining 2-4 tablespoons of marinade in a small bowl To serve place fish in tortillas, using two tortillas for each taco, top with shredded cabbage and drizzle with sauce.

Ingredient Names: catfish nuggets, dark beer, flour, taco seasoning mix, cilantro, sour cream, lime juice, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, cabbage, chopped tomato, lime wedge, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together the flour, beer, and taco seasoning mix. Step 2: Wash catfish nuggets and pat dry with paper toweling. Step 3: In a food processor or blender, process for a few seconds sour cream, cilantro, lime juice and additional taco seasoning mix to taste You don't want to totally liquify the cilantro. Step 4: Prepare garnishes as you heat about 1 / 2" of oil in a cast iron skillet or heavy frying pan to 360f. Step 5: Dip fish nuggets into batter and place in hot oil with a fork. Step 6: Turn once after about 1 minute and brown the other side for another minute Do this in batches Don't crowd the fish. Step 7: Drain on paper toweling and keep warm in a 200f oven until ready to serve.

Dish Name: Baja Fish Tacos With Fresh Avocado Cream And Cilantro Salsa
Ingredient Names: avocado, plain yogurt, mayonnaise, lime juice, honey, cilantro, kosher salt, water, diced tomatoes, jalapeno, onions, fresh cilantro, garlic powder, tilapia fillets, fish
Instructions: Step 1: For the avocado cream: place all ingredients into a food processor and give it a whirl until smooth. Step 2: Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use Good for one week refrigerated For the salsa: place half of canned tomatoes into food processor. Step 3: Add half of the jalapeno, seeds and all. Step 4: Add the rest of the salsa ingredients Whirl until smooth. Step 5: Taste If youd like more heat, add the rest of the jalapeno pepper and process until smooth. Step 6: Pour into mixing bowl and add the rest of the canned tomatoes.

Dish Name: Baja Fried Fish Tacos A San Diego Surfers Delight
Ingredient Names: dark beer, flour, salt, white fish fillet, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, cabbage, mayonnaise, garlic clove, salsa, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, whisk beer, flour and salt, blending well. Step 2: Rinse fish and pat dry. Step 3: Cut into six oblong pieces. Step 4: In a deep skillet, heat about one inch of oil to 360f Coat fish pieces in beer batter and drain briefly Slide coated fish into oil. Step 5: Turn when golden about one ot two minutes. Step 6: Cook another one or two minutes on the other side and remove from oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Step 7: Mix mayonnaise with a little water to thin, and add the mined garlic To assemble the taco, add one piece of fish to each soft corn tortilla.

Dish Name: Baja Fried Fish Tacos With Spicy Cabbage Slaw
Ingredient Names: salsa, mayonnaise, vegetable oil, beer, all-purpose flour, salt, cod fish fillet, corn tortillas, coleslaw mix, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix salsa and mayonnaise, set aside. Step 2: In a dutch oven or deep skillet, heat oil over medium high heat until it reaches 375 degrees f While the oil heats up, whisk beer, flour and salt in a medium bowl until smooth. Step 3: Using a fork, coat fish pieces in batter Working in 2 batches, slide coated fish into hot oil. Step 4: Fry until golden, about 4 minutes per batch Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain briefly on paper towels, keep warm. Step 5: In a dry hot skillet, warm corn tortillas individually for 1-2 minutes per side.

Ingredient Names: onion, green chili, garlic cloves, olive oil, dry white wine, orange peel, orange juice, sugar, fresh cilantro, dried basil leaves, salt, pepper, dried oregano leaves, whole tomatoes, soft-shell clams
Instructions: Step 1: Cook & stir onion, chiles and garlic in oil in 6-quart dutch oven until onion is tender. Step 2: Stir in remaining ingredients except for seafood. Step 3: Heat to boiling, reduce heat & simmer uncovered 15 minutes, add clams. Step 4: Cover & simmer until clams open, 5-10 minutes Carefully stir in shrimp, cod and crabmeat. Step 5: Heat to boiling, reduce heat, cover & simmer until shrimp are pink and cod flakes easily with fork, about 4-5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, creole seasoning, cabbage, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Spray fillets with pam. Step 2: Season both sides with creole seasoning. Step 3: Preheat a non-stick skillet for a few minutes on medium. Step 4: Add fillets to pan and brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Step 5: After both sides are browned, chop with a spatula or similar instrument into fine pieces Juice the lime over the tilapia pieces, stir, remove from heat, cover and set aside. Step 6: Heat the tortillas of choice, layer with cabbage and fish. Step 7: Top off with tapitio and get on with your bad self!

Dish Name: Baked Salmon With Lime Jalapeno Chive And Sour Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: salmon fillet, fresh lime juice, butter, salt and pepper, jalapeno chiles, sour cream, salt, white pepper, fresh chives, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 500 degrees Butter baking dish. Step 2: Place salmon in dish skin side down. Step 3: Mix lime juice and butter, brush over salmon. Step 4: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 5: Let stand 15 minutes. Step 6: Bake until fish is almost opaque, about 9 minutes per inch of thickness. Step 7: Meanwhile prepare sauce: Melt butter in heavy small saucepan over medium-low heat.

Ingredient Names: sole, lime, salt, pepper, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, bay leaf, dried marjoram, fresh jalapeno peppers, fresh parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Coat large baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Step 2: Arrange the fish fillets in a single layer and season with the lime juice, 1 / 2 tsp of the salt, and 1 / 4 tsp of the pepper. Step 3: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil. Step 4: Add the onion and garlic and cook over medium-high heat until softened, about 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the tomatoes, bay leaf, marjoram and jalapeno peppers. Step 6: Cook until thickened, 5 - 7 minutes. Step 7: Stir in 3 tbsp of the chopped parsley and the remaining salt and pepper and cook 2 minutes. Step 8: Pour the sauce over the fillets and bake until the fish is cooked through and opaque throughout, 8 -10 minutes. Step 9: Sprinkle the remaining chopped parsley over the top and serve.

Ingredient Names: swordfish steaks, salt, pepper, olive oil, green onion, parsley, chopped tomato, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Sprinkle swordfish with salt and pepper. Step 3: Place fish in a single layer in a baking dish and brush with olive oil to coat heavily. Step 4: Sprinkle green onions over the fish. Step 5: Bake uncovered for about 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Step 6: Transfer to platter and sprinkle with parsley and garnish with tomato and lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: tuna in water, celery, green onions, light mayonnaise, dill pickle relish, dijon mustard, salt, black pepper, whole wheat tortillas, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the tuna, celery, green onions, mayonnaise, relish, mustard, salt and pepper. Step 2: Spoon 3 / 4 cup onto the centre of each tortilla. Step 3: Sprinkle each with 1 / 4 cup of the cheese. Step 4: Fold the bottom edge over the filling, then the sides, roll up. Step 5: Bake, seam side down, on a small greased rimmed baking sheet in a 400 degree f oven until golden and the cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: large raw shrimp, chili oil, garlic cloves, limes, papaya, mango, fresh cilantro, red chile, balsamic vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Marinate peeled prawns with combined oil, garlic and juice for 30 minutes Barbecue over a high heat until tender and just cooked ---salsa--- Peel fruits and remove seeds. Step 2: Cut fruit into small cubes. Step 3: Add cilantro, chilli and vinegar and mix well. Step 4: Serve with the shrimp Even though this recipe contains a small amount of oil it is very low fat as the oil mostly remains in the left over marinade and is not eaten.

Ingredient Names: fresh orange juice, fresh lemon juice, salmon fillets, brown sugar, chili powder, lemons, ground cumin, salt, cinnamon, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: In a zip-top plastic bag, combine first 3 ingredients Seal and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour, turning occasionally. Step 2: Remove fish from bag, discard marinade. Step 3: In a small bowl, combine next 6 ingredients. Step 4: Place fillets in the mixture and marinade longer or you can baste the fish with the sauce. Step 5: Place fillets on grill on medium-high heat and cover with grill lid. Step 6: Cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with fork. Step 7: Serve with lemon slice, if desired.

Ingredient Names: bay scallop, limes, cilantro, red onions, fresh basil, green onions, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, stewed tomatoes, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, marinate scallops in lime juice covered overnight in the refrigerator drain lime juice, add remaining ingredients. Step 2: Mix well and marinate for 2 1 / 2 hours in refrigerator. Step 3: Serve chilled with crackers.

Dish Name: Beer Steamed Shrimp With Tomato Salsa
Ingredient Names: coarse salt, plum tomatoes, bell pepper, pickled jalapeno pepper, canned jalapeno peppers, red onion, scallions, garlic clove, fresh parsley leaves, fresh ground pepper, lime, beer, old bay seasoning, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Make salsa: sprinkle salt over tomatoes in colander and toss gently. Step 2: Let drain 10 minutes. Step 3: Combine bell pepper, jalapeo, onion, scallions, garlic, parsley, pepper, and lime juice in mixing bowl. Step 4: Toss gently and stir in drained tomatoes. Step 5: Let stand at room temperature 30-60 minutes. Step 6: Prepare shrimp: heat beer and old bay seasoning to boiling in bottom of steamer. Step 7: Place shrimp in steaming rack and steam, tightly covered, 2 minutes. Step 8: Stir once, then continue to steam just until shrimp turn pink, 1-2 minutes longer. Step 9: Transfer shrimp to serving platter If salsa is too watery, pour off excess liquid.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, fresh lime juice, fresh tomatoes, green sweet pepper, fresh cilantro, salt, jalapeno peppers, white vinegar, onion, green onion, imitation crabmeat
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix together well Best to let it sit in the fridge for a few hours to allow the flavors to fully blend together but can be served as soon as it's made if desired. Step 2: Serve cold either on tostada shells, as a dip with chips, or in a dish to eat alone May be garnished with lettuce, avacado, and black olive if desired.

Dish Name: Bevs Hot And Cheesy Tuna Quesadillas To Die For
Ingredient Names: tuna in water, tomatoes, green onions, mozzarella cheese, dry mustard, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ingredients on 1 / 2 of each tortilla. Step 2: Divide the tuna between the 2 tortillas and sprinkle with the dry mustard. Step 3: Divide the green onions and the tomato slices and put on top of the tuna sprinkle each with 1 / 2 cup cheese. Step 4: Fold each tortilla over and grill on both sides until lightly toasted and crispy.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, lime juice, paprika, salt, ground black pepper, chili powder, tortillas, avocado, cheese, salsa, fresh cilantro, cabbage, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To make the fish: place the fish in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with the lime juice, paprika, salt, black pepper, and chill powder. Step 2: Cover, refrigerate, and marinate for about 30 minutes. Step 3: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat Lightly coat a 24' x 12" piece of foil with olive oil cooking spray. Step 4: Place the fish in a single layer in the center of the foil. Step 5: Fold the foil over the and fold the ends upward to seal in the fish. Step 6: Place the foil packet on the preheated grill. Step 7: Cook for 7 to 10 minutes, or until the fish is opaque. Step 8: Remove from the grill To assemble the tacos: warp the tortillas in foil and place them on the grill to warm for 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: black beans, salmon, vegetable oil, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, shallots, ground cumin, garlic, lime zest, dried red pepper flakes, chili powder, corn tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Place beans and salmon in medium mixing bowl Flake salmon with fork and stir to combine. Step 2: Stir in oil and lime juice, then remaining ingredients except chips. Step 3: Serve at once with tortilla chips or refrigerate until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: buttermilk, mayonnaise, garlic, white vinegar, queso fresco, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, oregano, salt, thyme, ground red pepper, medium shrimp, cooking spray, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Combine paprika and next 6 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag. Step 3: Add shrimp to bag Seal and shake well to coat, remove shrimp. Step 4: Heat a grill pan over high heat Coat pan with cooking spray, add shrimp. Step 5: Cook 2 minutes per side or until done.

Dish Name: Broiled Mexican Style Shrimp With Garlic And Limes
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro, lime juice, butter, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the shrimp, with a very sharp paring knife, split each shrimp down the back through the shell. Step 2: Leave the legs intact Open the shrimp and flatten them The legs will be on the bottom side. Step 3: Arrange the split shrimp in a single layer on a sheet pan. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate until ready. Step 5: Place the garlic in a small saucepot with enough water to cover them. Step 6: Bring the water to a boil, and then lower to a simmer until the garlic cloves are soft. Step 7: Drain the water and refresh the garlic cloves with cold water, allow to cool.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, tilapia fillets, garlic, green onion, jalapeno pepper, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat up oven to 350f, sprinkle ground garlic on fish and place fish fillets on sheet pan -fish might take about 10-15 minutes While fish is cooking, in a pan heat up the olive oil, once hot combine cabbage, green onions, jalapeo and salt on pan. Step 2: Let the vegetables cooked, once cooked, add fish and while mixing it, smashed the fish into small pieces. Step 3: Now the tacos can be eating, in three different ways: eat with warm corn tortilla, make your own taco shell by cooking the tortilla on hot oil, or buy taco shells already done I prefer just to warn up the tortilla to make healthy conscious. Step 4: Place veggie / fish mix in tortilla and top with tartar sauce.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, tequila, mexican oregano, fresh garlic, onion powder, ground cumin, fresh cilantro, yellowfin tuna fillet, corn tortillas, cabbage, lime, chipotle chiles, feta
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together lime juice, tequila, mexican oregano, minced garlic, onion powder, ground cumin, and 1 tablespoon of fresh cilantro in a small bowl. Step 2: Place tuna fillet in a ziploc bag and pour marinade over fish. Step 3: Remove excess air from bag and seal. Step 4: Refrigerate for one hour, while you prepare your grill. Step 5: Prepare grill by spraying grill surface with non-stick cooking spray before applying heat Over medium-hot grill cook tuna, turning once, until cooked through. Step 6: Set aside Briefly heat corn tortillas carefully on grill Do not overcook, or they will get hard Break tuna into small chunks or shredded pieces and place about 1 1 / 2 ounces on a double layer of corn tortilla for each taco.

Dish Name: Caesar Salad With Tequila Lime Grilled Shrimp With Chipotle
Ingredient Names: olive oil, lime juice, tequila, garlic, cilantro, jumbo shrimp, romaine lettuce hearts, tomatoes, corn kernel, mayonnaise, chicken broth, soy sauce, fresh lemon juice, brown sugar, canned chipotle chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade: Stir together ingredients for marinade, add shrimp. Step 2: Set aside to marinade 1 / 2 hour Dressing: Whip to a smooth consistency the dressing ingredients Mayonnaise, broth, soy sauce, lemon juice, chipotle. Step 3: Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Grill shrimp: Remove shrimp from marinade and grill over medium-hot setting for a couple of minutes on each sitde.

Dish Name: California Fish Tacos With Dry Roasted Peppers And Mango
Ingredient Names: cod, mango, jalapeno pepper, cayenne pepper, onion, lemon juice, salsa verde, low-fat sour cream, flour tortillas, vegetable broth
Instructions: Step 1: Microwave the cod until the ice is melted, but the fish isn't fully cooked On a frying pan on medium heat, pour in the lemon juice and then the fish Saut until the fish is almost cooked through, then turn off the heat On a cutting board, dice the mango into 1 inch cubes Also cut up the jalapeo pepper. Step 2: Put both of these, along with the onion wedges, in a roasting pan, and set in the oven at medium-high heat. Step 3: Cook for 15 minutes, or until mango and onions caramelize slightly. Step 4: Take the vegetables out of the oven and place them in a frying pan along with the fish. Step 5: Add the vegetable broth Saut for about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, olive oil, chili powder, coriander powder, salt, red snapper fillets, green cabbage, scallions, red onion, fresh cilantro, corn tortillas, avocado, lime, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a 7x11-inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Step 2: Stir together the lime juice, oil, chili powder, ground coriander, and salt in a cup. Step 3: Place the fish in the prepared baking dish in one layer and brush with the lime juice mixture. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap and vent one corner Microwave on high until the fish is just opaque in the center, about 3 minutes Break the fish into flakes. Step 5: Stir together all the remaining ingredients except the tortillas in a medium bowl. Step 6: Top each tortilla with about 2 tablespoons of the cabbage mixture, 2 tablespoons of the fish, and another 1 tablespoon of the cabbage mixture. Step 7: Fold the tortillas in half. Step 8: Serve a plate of dressed avocado wedges alongside.

Dish Name: California Style Shrimp Potato Tacos With Cilantro Crema
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, vegetable oil, simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion, sour cream, taco seasoning, lime juice, fresh cilantro, salt, medium shrimp, ground cumin, green onions, baby spinach, tomatoes, hass avocado, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the tortillas, wrap loosely in a damp kitchen towel and place in a preheated 250 degree oven. Step 2: Heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat in a large, non-stick skillet. Step 3: When the oil is hot, add the entire package of simply potatoes diced potato with onion, spread out evenly. Step 4: Cover and cook the potatoes for 10 minutes, stirring every 2-3 minutes, ensuring that the potatoes are browning evenly While the potatoes are cooking, combine the sour cream, about of the taco seasoning, 2 tablespoons lime juice, half of the chopped cilantro and the salt in a blender or food processor Process until smooth and set aside. Step 5: Toss the remaining taco seasoning and ground cumin with the shrimp. Step 6: After the potatoes have been cooking for 10 minutes and are nice and brown, add the seasoned shrimp, green onions and the remaining chopped cilantro and stir gently Continue cooking the potato-shrimp mixture for an additional 3-5 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally, or until the shrimp is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, adobo seasoning, lemon, olive oil, onion, chicken broth, fresh cayenne peppers, salt and pepper, garlic cloves, rotel, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Squeeze out juice from lemon over shrimp and sprinkle with adobo I like to do this for at least 2 hours, but its not necessary In large skillet fry onion, garlic and peppers in olive oil slowly for 3-5 minutes. Step 2: Add rotel and tomato sauce. Step 3: Cook for an additional 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Add shrmip and chicken broth and cook for 25 minutes At the end, test soup If not spicy enough, add more peppers, if too spicy add more broth and cook on high 5 minutes. Step 5: Serve with tortillas, rice or pasta.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, onion, garlic cloves, oil, butter, worcestershire sauce, chicken consomme, ancho chilies, anaheim chili, serrano peppers, tomatoes, garlic clove, white wine, salt and pepper, catsup
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the peppers in a small amount of water and grind them in a blender with the tomatoes and whole garlic clove. Step 2: Strain and set aside. Step 3: In a large skillet heat the butter and oil and saut the minced garlic and onion until the onion is translucent. Step 4: Add the shrimp and cook until they turn bright pink, then add the consomm and worcestershire, salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Add the sauce, cover and simmer for a few minutes, then add the white wine and allow to simmer a few minutes more Saut the chili strips in the oil for a few minutes, remove and drain, then use as a garnish.

Dish Name: Camarones En Salsa Shrimp In Sauce
Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, butter, onion, garlic cloves, tomato sauce, ketchup, light brown sugar, red wine vinegar, mustard, chili powder, paprika, cumin, red pepper flakes, lemon zest, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Shell, de-vein and rinse shrimp, drain and set aside. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp butter in skillet over medium-high heat and saute onions and garlic. Step 3: Add the shrimp and cook until mostly pink. Step 4: Add the lemon zest and lemon juice from one lemon and stir. Step 5: Cook for about a minute. Step 6: Add the tomato sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, red wine vinegar, mustard, chili powder, paprika and cumin. Step 7: Cook over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes or until hot You can place cooked rice on individual plates and shrimp mixture over or you can combine them together in one pan and serve. Step 8: Top with fresh chives if desired.

Dish Name: Camarones Enchipotlados Shrimp In Chipotle Sauce
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, lime juice, olive oil, white onion, tomatoes, chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic clove, dry white wine, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Line a small shallow pan with foil. Step 2: Add the tomatoes Broil 2-inches from the heat, turning occasionally, until skin blistered and browned and flesh inside is mushy, set aside to cool. Step 3: Season the shrimp with salt, pepper and lime juice. Step 4: Set aside to marinate for about 30 minutes. Step 5: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Step 6: Drain the shrimp, reserving liquid. Step 7: Add shrimp and onions to hot oil in frying pan. Step 8: Saute for 3 minutes stirring and turning frequently.

Ingredient Names: seafood, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, jalapenos, avocados, vinegar, limes, seafood stock, vegetable juice, ketchup, cumin, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Boil seafood mix in 4 to 5 cups of water for 5 to 10 minutes. Step 2: Drain, setting aside broth. Step 3: Cool both seafood and broth. Step 4: Prepare tomatoes, onions, cilantro, cucumbers and jalapenos. Step 5: In a large bowl, mix well, add seafood mix. Step 6: Add vinegar and juice from limes, broth, ketchup and vegetable juice. Step 7: Season with cumin, and salt and pepper to taste, add avocados. Step 8: Serve with tostadas or saltine crackers.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, green chili peppers, crabmeat, cheddar cheese, red onion, fresh cilantro, heavy cream, eggs, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Grease an 8 inch square pan. Step 3: Layer 4 of the quartered tortillas covering the bottom of pan completely. Step 4: Combine peppers, crab, 1 c Cheese, onion, and the cilantro. Step 5: Whisk together cream and eggs: stir into crab mixture. Step 6: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 7: Pour over tortillas. Step 8: Top with remaining quartered tortillas and remaining cheese. Step 9: Bake for 45 minutes.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic, tomato sauce, water, salt, bay leaf, carrots, cabbage, garlic powder, white fish fillets, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large saucepan. Step 2: Add onion and garlic and cook until tender, about 2 to 3 minutes. Step 3: Add tomato sauce, water, salt, bay leaf, carrots and cabbage, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add fish and simmer 5 minutes or until fish is cooked. Step 6: Garnish each serving with parsley, if desired.

Ingredient Names: jalapenos, albacore tuna in water, cilantro, tomatillo, tomatoes, lemons, sea salt, corn tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together and allow to chill for 20 minutes Serve with corn tortilla chips.

Dish Name: Catfish Tacos With Tomato And Avocado Salsa
Ingredient Names: plum tomato, avocado, fresh lime juice, green onions, fresh cilantro, jalapeno peppers, catfish fillet, garlic cloves, corn tortillas, leaf lettuce, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Mix tomatoes, avocado, 2 tablespoons lime juice, onion, cilantro, and 2 teaspoons jalapeos in small bowl. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Place fish in single layer on small rimmed baking sheet. Step 5: Mix garlic, 3 tablespoons lime juice, and 1 teaspoon jalapeos in another small bowl. Step 6: Drizzle half of lime juice mixture over fish Reserve remainder. Step 7: Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper. Step 8: Let stand 15 minutes. Step 9: Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in foil, enclosing completely.

Ingredient Names: fish, onions, lemon juice, celery, cilantro, salt, hot pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into bite-size pieces and place in a glass bowl or container of at least 2 inches high. Step 2: Add all the other ingredients, mixing well The lemon juice should cover the fish. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator. Step 4: Allow one day for fish to cook in the lemon juice and onions. Step 5: Serve with crackers or bread.

Ingredient Names: bay scallops, shrimp, white fish fillet, spices, cilantro, red onion, serrano peppers, tomatoes, celery rib, garlic clove, limes, olive oil, salt & pepper, avocado, corn
Instructions: Step 1: Seafood should be cut up the same size to ensure even cooking around to inch pieces Fine dice or mince celery, onion, peppers, garlic, tomato and cilantro. Step 2: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish preferable a glass one The lime juice should just about cover the mixture and place in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Step 3: Serve with corn / tostada chips, crackers and once again im not saying this because i am one or fried banana / plantain chips and an ice cold beer And if you happen too have a few too many beers. Step 4: Take a shot of the juice from the ceviche in the morning.

Dish Name: Ceviche De Pescado Fish Salad Cooked In Lime Juice
Ingredient Names: fish fillets, salt, fresh lime juice, garlic clove, fresh chili pepper, parsley, cilantro, onion, lettuce leaves, corn, sweet potato, yucca root
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into strips 1 inches long by inch wide. Step 2: Soak the strips in lightly salted water for 1 hour to tenderize, drain well. Step 3: Put the fish in a bowl and fold in the lime juice carefully. Step 4: Add the salt, garlic, and aji and refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes Just before serving, mix in the parsley, cilantro, and onion To serve, line a bowl or large platter with the lettuce. Step 5: Place the ceviche in the center Surround it with 3 separate mounds Corn pieces at the top of the platter, sweet potato slices on one end, yucca on the other.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, garlic, shallots, green onions, roma tomatoes, cilantro leaf, hot sauce, jalapeno pepper, salt, pepper, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, mix thoroughly. Step 2: Store in a covered glass or plastic container, lime juice should cover all ingredients If not, add more lime juice. Step 3: Refrigerate for 2-3 hours. Step 4: When done, the seafood should be totally opaque. Step 5: Stir before serving. Step 6: Serve with tortilla chips or chop avocado and place in a dish. Step 7: Spoon ceviche on top of avocado.

Ingredient Names: red snapper fillets, lemon juice, onions, tomato puree, tomato juice, salt, green olives, worcestershire sauce, tabasco sauce, jalapenos, tomatoes, cilantro, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into 1 inch cubes. Step 2: Marinate in 2 cups lemon or lime juice in the refrigerator for 6 hours. Step 3: In a bowl, mix 2 cups chopped onion, 1 / 2 cup tomato puree, 1 / 2 cup tomato juice, 1 tbsp salt, 16 chopped green olives, 2 tbsp worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp tabasco, 2 chopped jalapenos, 3 chopped peeled and seeded tomatoes, and 2 tbsp cilantro or parsley. Step 4: After 6 hours, remove the fish from the refrigerator. Step 5: Pour off 1 cup of the lemon or lime juice and add the above sauce to the fish and remaining juice. Step 6: Mix well and let stand in the refrigerator overnight. Step 7: Garnish with avocado if desired.

Ingredient Names: white fish fillet, limes, red onion, tomatoes, green chili pepper, fresh coriander, corn, tabasco sauce, worcestershire sauce, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Skin and cut the fish into 1 inch pieces. Step 2: Put into a glass bowl and pour the juice over it. Step 3: Make sure the fish is completely covered as it will cook in the juice. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Drain the fish, reserving the juice. Step 6: Add the onion, tomato, chili, and coriander to the fish and mix. Step 7: Make a vinaigrette with the oil and 2 tbsp of the reserved juice, adding the tabasco and worcestershire sauces. Step 8: Pour over the fish and mix. Step 9: Serve on a bed of lettuce on individual plates. Step 10: Garnish with corn.

Dish Name: Ceviche Style Shrimp And Avocado Tacos
Ingredient Names: limes, tomatoes, avocado, cilantro, salt, black pepper, cooked shrimp, jalapeno, garlic clove, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Finely grate rind from limes to measure 1 tbls Juice limes to measure 1 / 4 cup. Step 2: Place rind and juice in a large bowl. Step 3: Add tomato and remaining ingredients this is where i also added a jalapeno -- chopped really fine! Step 4: Toss well to combine. Step 5: Cover and chill for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, heat tortillas. Step 6: Once again -- recipe says it will feed 6 -- embarrassed to say -- it didn't! Step 7: Update I really enjoyed this mixture on a bed of lettuce! Step 8: Made a great salad!

Ingredient Names: limes, tomatoes, avocado, cilantro, salt, pepper, garlic cloves, medium shrimp, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Finely grate rind from limes to measure 1 tablespoon Juice limes to measure 1 / 4 cup. Step 2: Place rind and juice in a large bowl. Step 3: Add tomato, avocado, cilantro, salt, pepper, garlic and shrimp If you want, you can add some chopped onion and fresh jalapenos. Step 4: Toss well to combine. Step 5: Cover and chill for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, heat tortillas. Step 6: Spoon about 1 / 2 cup of shrimp mixture down the center of tortilla, fold and eat.

Ingredient Names: fish fillet, lime juice, salt, dried oregano, fresh basil, flat leaf parsley, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh mint leaves, jalapeno, garlic clove, sugar, manzanilla olives, white onion, olive oil, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Put the raw mahi-mahi into a tall, narrow glass or stainless-steel container. Step 2: Stir the lime juice, salt and oregano together in a bowl and pour over fish. Step 3: Refrigerate for 1 hour. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine ingredients for sauce with 1 cup water in a blender until smooth, adding more sugar to taste if necessary. Step 5: Drain the fish and place in a medium mixing bowl. Step 6: Discard the marinade. Step 7: Pour the basil sauce over the ceviche. Step 8: Stir in olives, onion, olive oil and lime juice. Step 9: Taste and add salt and more lime juice if necessary. Step 10: Let stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes, but not longer than 1 hour.

Ingredient Names: fresh ahi tuna, fresh mango, avocado, red onions, tomatoes, serrano pepper, fresh lime juice, fresh orange juice, tomato juice, tabasco sauce, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Some traditional recipes use ketchup which can be substituted for the tomato juice and sugar. Step 2: Chop tuna into 1 / 4 inch cubes. Step 3: Toss with 1 / 2 juices, and all ingredients with exception of mango and avocado cubes. Step 4: Let sit to marinate as desired in refrigeration Before serving, chop mango and avocado and separate. Step 5: Toss separately in the rest of the juices On a large serving plate, place a small ring mold in the center of the plate. Step 6: Spoon an equal portion of mango into bottom of a small ring mold. Step 7: Add an equal portion of avocado and top with equal portion of ahi mixture. Step 8: Press down and remove mold.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno peppers, shrimp, bacon, monterey jack cheese, simply potatoes shredded hash browns, cumin, taco seasoning, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Remove stem, cut in half and clean seeds and membrane from jalapeno peppers Blanche peppers in hot water for two minutes and set aside. Step 3: Cook the bacon for two minutes in the microwave, until half cooked. Step 4: Drain and set aside Finely chop simply potatoes shredded hash browns and combine with butter, cumin and taco seasoning Pan fry on low heat until lightly brown and sticky in texture. Step 5: Set aside until cool While potato mixture is cooling, clean and peel shrimp, leaving the tails on and shred the cheese. Step 6: Then slice bacon strips lengthwise.

Dish Name: Charred Prawns Shrimp With Capsicum Mayonnaise
Ingredient Names: large raw shrimp, garlic cloves, lime juice, ground cumin, fresh coriander leaves, lime wedge, red capsicum, olive oil, mayonnaise, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails intact. Step 2: Combine the garlic, lime juice, cumin and coriander in a bowl, place the prawns in the marinade and mix well. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours To make the capsicum mayonnaise, preheat the oven to 190c. Step 4: Cut the capsicum into quarters and remove the seeds and membrane. Step 5: Place on a baking tray with the garlic and drizzle with the olive oil. Step 6: Cook for 20-30 minutes or until the skin blisters on the capsicum and the garlic is soft but not burnt. Step 7: Place in a plastic bag until cool, then peel the skin off the capsicum and garlic. Step 8: Place in a food processor with the mayonnaise and process until fairly smooth. Step 9: Place in a bowl and stir through the lemon juice.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, cheddar cheese, imitation crabmeat, flour tortillas, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine the cream cheese and cheddar cheese, stir in the crab. Step 3: Spoon down the center of each tortilla. Step 4: Roll up tightly and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Step 5: Bake for 20 minutes or until heated through, serve with salsa.

Ingredient Names: ear of corn, cooked shrimp, diced onions, salt, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, goat cheese, cabbage, salsa verde, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the husk and silk from your ear of corn, wash it off, wrap it in a paper towel and cook it in the microwave for 3 minutes, then cut the kernels off the cob and set aside In the meanwhile, saute the onion in about 1 tsp of olive oil for about 3 minutes on med-high until opaque. Step 2: Add the salt, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder and shrimp, stir, cook for 30 seconds, cover and turn over the heat On each tortilla, spread 1 / 8 of the goat cheese, top with 1 / 8 of the shrimp, sprinkle with some corn kernels, top with a little cabbage and spoon about 1 tsp of salsa over the cabbage. Step 3: Serve with more salsa on the side.

Dish Name: Chef Boy I Be Illinois Salmon Tacos
Ingredient Names: salmon, carrots, low-fat sour cream, onion, limes, dried ancho chile powder, ground cumin, cilantro, sea salt, pepper, taco shell, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Rub salmon with salt and 2 teaspoons of ancho chili powder. Step 2: Cook salmon until it easily flakes. Step 3: Allow to cool until can handle then flake. Step 4: Meanwhile, combine sour cream, lime juice, 1 tablespoon ancho chili powder, ground cumin, cilantro, salt and pepper in serving bowl. Step 5: Add the flaked salmon, cabbage, and onion. Step 6: Combine well and refrigerate for 30-45 minutes to allow cabbage to macerate This does not keep well, so don't allow it to sit too long. Step 7: Serve with your choice of tacos or tortillas, and sides of condiments to include salsa, sour cream, avocado, green onion, etc.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour, white pepper, lobster base, low-fat milk, white wine, monterey jack cheese, baby shrimp, imitation crabmeat, flour tortillas, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce: melt butter in a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, add flour. Step 2: Cook and stir for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add 1 / 2 tsp white pepper. Step 4: Stir in 2 tbsps lobster base and cook for an additional minute, add milk & wine. Step 5: Add 2 oz Of the cheese Continue to cook until thickened For the crab mix: lightly chop the flaked imitation crab.

Ingredient Names: pure chile powder, cayenne, cornmeal, salt and pepper, corn oil, shrimp, fresh cilantro leaves, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chile powder, cayenne, cornmeal, salt and pepper in a bowl. Step 2: Put the oil in a large skillet over med / high heat. Step 3: Toss the shrimp in the spice mixture to coat. Step 4: When the oil in hot, toss in about half the shrimp or whatever number will fit in one layer. Step 5: Turn the heat to high and cook until brown on one side. Step 6: Then turn and brown the other side, adjusting the heat so the shrimp brown without burning, 4-5 minutes total. Step 7: Repeat with the remaining shrimp. Step 8: Garnish and serve with the lime or lemon.

Dish Name: Chili Roasted Salmon With Cilantro Cream
Ingredient Names: nonstick cooking spray, fresh lime juice, garlic cloves, chili powder, ground cumin, olive oil, salmon fillets, frozen corn kernels, red bell pepper, poblano pepper, red onion, salt, fresh ground black pepper, light sour cream, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Mist 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray. Step 2: In a small baking dish, mix together 2 tablespoons lime juice with garlic, chili powder, cumin, and 1 teaspoon olive oil. Step 3: Add salmon and turn to coat, let sit. Step 4: In a medium bowl, toss corn, bell pepper, poblano pepper, and onion with remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil. Step 5: Transfer corn mixture to one of the baking sheets. Step 6: Spread into a single layer. Step 7: Remove salmon from marinade and arrange on second baking sheet. Step 8: Drizzle corn mixture with remaining salmon marinade.

Ingredient Names: salsa verde doritos, chili powder, cumin, chipotle pepper, salt, garlic powder, tilapia fillet, lime, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Beat eggs in a platter. Step 2: Place doritos, spices, and chipotle pepper in food processor until until chips are finely crushed Coat tilapia with egg and place in chip mixture until well coated on both sides. Step 3: Squeeze lime juice over fish Spray cookie sheet with no stick spray. Step 4: Bake at 350f for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, brown sugar, garlic cloves, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce, rum, water, salt, tamarind paste, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel shrimp, leaving tails on, devein and thread 4 shrimp on each skewer. Step 2: Cook brown sugar in a small saucepan over low heat, add garlic & next 6 ingredients, cook 5 minute or until tamarind paste melts. Step 3: Brush shrimp with olive oil, grill over med High heat for 4-6 min or until shrimp turn pink, turning once & basting often with tamarind glaze.

Dish Name: Chipotle Lime Dip And Bbq D Tiger Shrimp
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, sour cream, barbecue sauce, garlic, lime rind, lime juice, tiger shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, stir together mayonnaise, sour cream, chipotle sauce, garlic, lime rind and lime juice. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate until serving using metal skewers or wooden skewers that have been soaked in water for at least 30 minutes, thread two or three shrimp on each skewer. Step 3: Place each skewer on greased grill and grill until pink. Step 4: Serve either hot or cold with chipotle lime dip for dipping.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, fresh lime juice, dried chipotle powder, orange zest, sugar, salmon, extra virgin olive oil, corn tortillas, hass avocado, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f in a small bowl, whisk the mayo with the lime juice In another small bowl, combine the chipotle powder with the orange zest and sugar Rub each salmon piece with 1 t Olive oil and then the chipotle-orange zest mixture, let sit 5 minutes. Step 2: Wrap the tortillas in foil and bake for about 8 minutes, until they are soft and heated through. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat a grill pan. Step 4: Season the salmon with salt and grill over high heat, until nicely browned and just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side Gently break each salmon piece in half. Step 5: Spread the mashed avocado on the warm tortillas, top with the salmon, and the cabbage.

Ingredient Names: dried chipotle powder, mild chili powder, sugar, kosher salt, ground cumin, large raw shrimp, olive oil, white corn tortillas, iceberg lettuce, hass avocadoes, salsa verde, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Step 2: Add shrimp, tossing to coat. Step 3: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add shrimp mixture to pan. Step 5: Cook 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until done, remove from heat. Step 6: Heat tortillas in microwave according to package directions. Step 7: Place 2 tortillas on each of 4 plates. Step 8: Arrange 4 shrimp on each tortilla. Step 9: Top each tortilla with 1 / 4 cup lettuce, 2 avocado slices and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons salsa verde.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, cumin seeds, water, cider vinegar, chipotle chiles adobo, oregano, oranges, orange juice, light brown sugar, shrimp, coarse salt, fresh cilantro, pineapple
Instructions: Step 1: For marinade, heat oil in medium skillet over medium heat; add onions, cook until light golden, about 7 minutes; add garlic and cumin; cook 1 minute. Step 2: Remove from heat; stir in water, vinegar, chilies and oregano; pour into a blender or food processor and puree. Step 3: Return mixture to skillet; heat over low heat; stir in zest, orange juice and brown sugar; cook until thickened, about 10 minutes and then refrigerate for 20 minutes. Step 4: Place shrimp in a large plastic food storage bag; add marinade; seal; turn to coat shrimp. Step 5: Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Step 6: Soak 10 skewers in water for 30 minutes, if using wooden skewers. Step 7: Heat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat; place shrimp on each skewer (if using pineapple, place cubes on skewer in-between each shrimp); discard marinade. Step 8: Grill 2-3 minutes per side; garnish with cilantro and serve.

Dish Name: Chorizo And Shrimp Quesadillas With Smoky Guacamole
Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, lime, salt, sour cream, chipotle peppers, chorizo sausage, extra virgin olive oil, garlic clove, shrimp, salt & freshly ground black pepper, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avocados all the way around with a sharp knife Scoop out the pit, then spoon avocado flesh away from skin into a food processor. Step 2: Add the juice of 1 lime, a couple of pinches salt, sour cream and chipotles in adobo Pulse guacamole until smooth. Step 3: Transfer to a serving bowl. Step 4: Heat a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat Brown chorizo 2 to 3 minutes, then remove from pan. Step 5: Add oil, garlic, then shrimp. Step 6: Season shrimp with salt and pepper and cook shrimp until pink, 2 or 3 minutes. Step 7: Transfer shrimp to a cutting board and coarsely chop.

Dish Name: Churros De Pescado Fried Fish Fingers
Ingredient Names: fish fillets, garlic, parsley, beer, flour, baking powder, saffron, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine garlic, parsley, beer, flour, baking powder, saffron and salt with a whisk until well blended, and there are no lumps. Step 2: Heat sunflower oil to medium high heat in a deep frying pan. Step 3: Dip pieces of fish in batter and fry until golden, turning once. Step 4: Drain on paper towels and serve with garlic mayo and lemon wedges.

Ingredient Names: cod fish fillets, pepper, dried onion flakes, garlic clove, olive oil, ground cumin, fresh cilantro, limes, margarine
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Place each fillet on a piece of heavy-duty foil. Step 3: Sprinkle with pepper. Step 4: In a saucepan, saute onion and garlic in oil, stir in cumin. Step 5: Spoon over fillets. Step 6: Sprinkle with cilantro. Step 7: Place lime slices over each. Step 8: Drizzle with margarine. Step 9: Fold foil around fish and seal tightly.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, salt, fresh lime juice, orange marmalade, fresh cilantro, olive oil, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, fresh ground black pepper, large shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together garlic and 1 teaspoon salt. Step 2: Whisk together garlic paste, lime juice, marmalade, cilantro, 3 tablespoons oil, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon salt and pepper in a small bowl. Step 3: Transfer 1 / 3 of mixture to small serving bowl and reserve for dipping sauce. Step 4: Combine shrimp with remaining mixture in a large sealable plastic bag and seal bag, pressing out excess air. Step 5: Marinate shrimp, refrigerated, turning bag once, for 15 minutes. Step 6: Drain shrimp and gently pat dry Shrimp can be cooked on the girll or Pan fried: Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoon oil in a large non-stick skillet over moderately high heat. Step 7: Add half of shrimp and cook, turning occasisionly until shrimp is cooked through, about 3 minutes total.

Dish Name: Cilantro Lime Shrimp With A Honey Lime Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: shrimp, lime, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, olive oil, cracked pepper, vegetable oil, honey, garlic clove, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large zip lock bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Step 2: Soak wooden skewers in water for a few minutes Skewer the shrimp on the wooden skewers then place on the grill over medium heat. Step 3: Cook for a few minutes on each side or until pink and juicy. Step 4: Remove skewers from grill and serve with the honey lime dipping sauce Enjoy Honey lime dipping sauce: add all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl and whisk to combine, set aside.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, red onion, fresh cilantro, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, fresh lime juice, sugar, salt, chili powder, pepper, water, fresh shrimp, avocado, lime slice, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Process first 10 ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides. Step 2: Cover and chill sauce for up to a week. Step 3: Bring 6 cups water to a boil. Step 4: Add shrimp and cook 2-3 minutes or just until shrimp turn pink. Step 5: Drain and rinse with cold water. Step 6: Chill up to 24 hours Peel shrimp, leaving tails on Devein, if desired. Step 7: Stir avocado into sauce. Step 8: Spoon sauce evenly into 6 chilled martini glasses or small bowls.

Dish Name: Citrus Ceviche With Shrimp And Scallops
Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, bay scallop, lemons, limes, oranges, cucumber, red onion, diced tomato, avocado, cilantro leaf, extra virgin olive oil, salt, lemon pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-sized stainless steel or clear glass bowl, place lemon, lime and orange juices. Step 2: Stir in the shrimp, scallops, cucumber and red onion If you are adding chiles or peppers, add them now as well. Step 3: Refrigerate for 3 hours The shrimp and scallops should have turned white meaning that the citrus juices have "cooked" them 30 minutes prior to serving, remove from the fridge and stir in the tomato, avocado, chopped cilantro, and olive oil. Step 4: Serve in martini glasses with saltine crackers on the side if you want to be fancy, otherwise just put the bowl out with a few spoons and a whole bunch of saltine crackers and tortilla chips and let everyone dig in! Step 5: To serve, divide the ceviche between 6 chilled martini glasses.

Ingredient Names: salsa, shrimp, orange juice, lime juice, fresh cilantro, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl Chill for 30 minutes or until ready to serve Serve with tortilla chips and additional lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: beer, all-purpose flour, salt, garlic powder, dry mustard, dried mexican oregano, fresh ground black pepper, mayonnaise, plain yogurt, chipotle chile, adobo sauce, dijon mustard, lime juice, cilantro, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Make the batter: Combine beer, flour, salt, garlic powder, dry mustard, oregano and pepper in a blender and blend until smooth, about 20 seconds. Step 2: Transfer to a bowl and let stand, covered for 1 hour. Step 3: Make the sauce: Stir together mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard, chipotle and salt in a small bowl. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate. Step 5: Fry the fish: Put a rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 350f. Step 6: Heat 2 inches oil in a 4 quart deep heavy saucepan until it registers 350f on thermometer. Step 7: Put flour in pie plate or shallow dish.

Ingredient Names: cooked shrimp, tomatoes, white onions, cilantro, jalapeno, avocado, tomato juice, lime juice, salt and pepper, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: After you chop the tomatoes, onions and cilantro mix together in a bowl, add the diced jalapeno pepper. Step 2: Add about 1-1 / 2 cups of tomato juice. Step 3: Then add about 2 tablespoons or more to taste of lime juice add garlic salt to taste do the same to the salt and pepper. Step 4: Add the shrimp and avocado Do a taste test to see if you may need to add one or more of the above ingredients. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate about an hour or until ready to serve. Step 6: Serve with crackers.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, fresh lime juice, fresh oregano, medium shrimp, ice, tomato juice, hot sauce, onion, tomatoes, english cucumber, black pepper, salt, fresh cilantro, avocado, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Combine broth, 1 t lime juice and oregano in a large saucepan, bring to a simmer. Step 2: Cook 5 minutes and discard oregano, add shrimp to pan. Step 3: Cook 3 minutes or until done. Step 4: Transfer shrimp mixture to a large bowl. Step 5: Stir in ice, tomato juice and hot sauce. Step 6: Let stand 1 minute or until ice melts. Step 7: Stir in remaining 1 / 4 cup lime juice, onion, tomato, cucumber, pepper and salt. Step 8: Cool, cover and chill.

Dish Name: Coconut Lime Shrimp W Mango Jalapeno Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: jumbo shrimp, canola oil, tortilla chips, shredded coconut, flour, beer, lime juice, salt, cayenne pepper, mango, jalapenos, rice, cumin, sweet onion, orange
Instructions: Step 1: Make the sauce first. Step 2: In a food processor or blender, mix all ingredients until blended For shrimp Crush tortilla chips until coarsely ground and mix with shredded coconut You can use a processor if you have one. Step 3: Place mixture on plate and set aside. Step 4: In a bowl, whisk flour, beer and lime juice until blended and lump free Butterfly each shrimp by cutting down it's center. Step 5: In a skillet, heat canola oil. Step 6: Dip shrimp in beer batter and press each side in coconut mixture until heavily coated.

Ingredient Names: lemon, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns, sea salt, large shrimp, coconut milk, lime juice, red onion, serrano chilies, cilantro leaf, coconuts, rock salt, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make the ceviche: put a large pot of water over high heat and add the lemon, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns and salt, to taste. Step 2: When it comes to a boil add the shrimp and turn off the heat. Step 3: Let the shrimp poach just until they are cooked through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove the shrimp to a sheet pan and refrigerate. Step 5: When they are cool slice them in half lengthwise. Step 6: Combine the coconut milk, lime juice, onion, chiles, and cilantro in a large bowl and season it with salt. Step 7: Add the cooled shrimp and let them marinate, refrigerated, for about 1 / 2 hour. Step 8: Prepare the coconut shells: take a hammer and hit the coconut repeatedly around its equator, turning the coconut in your hand It will eventually split into 2 halves. Step 9: Drain the liquid from the coconuts.

Dish Name: Coctel De Camaron Mexican Shrimp Cocktail
Ingredient Names: vegetable juice, shrimp, avocados, cucumbers, red onion, fresh cilantro, limes, hot sauce, celery, tomatoes, ketchup, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Are optional items Mix all items together in a glass bowl or other non-reactive container Chill for 2 hours Serve in glass with lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: yellow rice, olive oil, shallot, garlic clove, large shrimp, chorizo sausage, chicken broth, fresh parsley, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saute pan, heat olive oil, then add rice and stir until it browns lightly. Step 2: Stir in shallot and garlic and continue to saute for only about a minute, so the garlic doesn't burn. Step 3: Add shrimp, chorizo, and broth. Step 4: Cover pan tightly and reduce heat to medium-low. Step 5: Cook for 18 minutes. Step 6: Remove lid, add parsley and peas and cook until heated through Continue cooking uncovered until all liquid is absorbed.

Dish Name: Corona Gambas Al Ajillo Garlic Shrimp
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, bulb of garlic, cherry pepper, shrimp, salt and pepper, beer, cilantro, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Make sure that you have all of the ingredients ready to go! Step 2: Bring a large non-stick frying pan or a wok to medium-high heat. Step 3: Add olive oil, garlic and minced cherry pepper. Step 4: Cook until light brown and add shrimp. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Cook for a minute or two until shrimp are almost changed colour. Step 7: Add corona extra and finish cooking. Step 8: Serve on a platter topped with cilantro or parsley and juice of two real limes. Step 9: Slice third lime into thin wheels for pretty garnish along the top of the dish.

Dish Name: Crab And Goat Cheese Poblanos With Mango Salsa
Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, egg whites, mozzarella cheese, goat cheese, garlic cloves, ground cumin, fresh ground black pepper, dried red pepper flakes, lump crabmeat, frozen whole kernel corn, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, cooking spray, mango salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Broil chile peppers on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet 5 inches from heat for 5 minutes on each side or until peppers look blistered. Step 2: Place peppers in a large zip-top plastic bag Seal and let stand 10 minutes to loosen skins Peel peppers Carefully cut peppers open lengthwise on one side, keeping stems intact, discard seeds. Step 3: Set peppers aside Process egg whites in a food processor until foamy. Step 4: Add mozzarella cheese and next 5 ingredients, processing until blended. Step 5: Place cheese mixture in a large bowl.

Ingredient Names: cream of chicken soup, onion, crab, monterey jack cheese, corn tortillas, milk, nutmeg, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl stir together soup, onion, nutmeg and white pepper In another bowl, place half of the soup mixture, crab, and 1 cup of the cheese, set aside. Step 2: Wrap the tortillas in paper towels and microwave for 30-60 seconds Use fresh tortillas for best results. Step 3: Place 1 / 3 cup of the mixture on each tortilla and roll up. Step 4: Place seam side down in a greased 11 x 7 ich baking dish. Step 5: Stir milk into the reserved soup mixture, pour over the enchiladas. Step 6: Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Step 7: Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and sauce is slightly bubbly. Step 8: Let stand for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lump crabmeat, sour cream, lime juice, green onions, salt, fresh ground pepper, queso fresco, fresh cilantro, fat-free flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Shred crab meat. Step 2: Mix together with sour cream, lime juice, and green onions in a small bowl. Step 3: Season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 4: Heat griddle or small frying pan with a small amount of oil or cooking spray. Step 5: Take a tortilla, place about 1 / 8 of crab mixture on it and spread evenly. Step 6: Top with 1oz Cheese and sprinkle with some chopped cilantro. Step 7: Place on hot griddle. Step 8: When cheese starts to melt, fold in half. Step 9: Allow to heat through and brown nicely, then remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, onions, crabmeat, manchego cheese, cream cheese, dry white wine, white pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a skillet Saut the onion until transparent Add rest of the ingredients and cook on low to medium heat until cheeses melt Serve hot or warm.

Dish Name: Crabby Tortilla Wrap With 3 Cheese Filling
Ingredient Names: whole wheat tortillas, crab, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, cayenne pepper, tabasco sauce, fresh cilantro, fresh spinach, roma tomatoes, fresh carrot, green bell pepper, sweet red pepper, yellow sweet pepper, pitted black olives, green olives
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Cut the tops off the green, red, and yellow peppers. Step 3: Place peppers on a shallow pan in the oven and roast until the skin begins to bubble and separates from the flesh- about 15 minutes. Step 4: Turn frequently to allow all sides to roast. Step 5: Remove from the oven and let cool Peel the peppers, make one slit in the peppers to open. Step 6: Remove and discard the seeds Coarse-chop the roasted peppers and set aside This is the only time you will use your oven Cheddar cheese: shred cheese and set aside in a separate bowl.

Ingredient Names: onion, vegetable oil, flour, reduced-fat milk, green chili peppers, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, canola oil, corn tortilla, crabmeat, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Step 2: Saute onion in oil, add flour, milk and chili. Step 3: Cook until medium thick Reserve 1 / 4 cup of cheeses to sprinkle over top of sauce. Step 4: Heat 1 / 2 to 1 tsp of canola oil at a time in skillet. Step 5: When oil is warm quickly dip tortillas in oil until soft and warm Immediately put 1 tablespon each of cheese, crabmeat and sauce in tortilla and roll up. Step 6: Place seam side down in a 11x7 inch pan. Step 7: Repeat until all tortillas are used. Step 8: Pour the remaining sauce on top and sprinkle with reserved cheeses.

Ingredient Names: tomato-basil tortillas, cooking oil, cheddar cheese, jalapeno, crabmeat, roma tomato, garlic clove, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Coat 12" skillet with cooking oil and warm over medium heat. Step 2: Place tortilla in skillet and rub meat from roasted garlic on tortilla. Step 3: Place jalapeno, tomato, crabmeat and cilantro on 1 / 2 of the tortilla. Step 4: Spread cheese on top. Step 5: Add the rest of the items and fold over tortilla to cover cheese. Step 6: Cook for 1 minute and flip tortilla to the other side continue to cook for an additional minute. Step 7: Remove from skillet, slice and serve.

Dish Name: Crispy Corn And Beer Battered Fish Tacos
Ingredient Names: cod, kosher salt, all-purpose flour, yellow cornmeal, seasoning salt, hot smoked paprika, baking powder, baking soda, lager beer, club soda, cider vinegar, vegetable oil, salsa, hot sauce, vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Special equipment: a deep-fry thermometer Lightly season cod with salt and black pepper. Step 2: Transfer to a wire rack set inside a rimmed baking sheet. Step 3: Chill, uncovered, at least 1 hour or up to overnight. Step 4: Whisk flour, cornmeal, seasoned salt, paprika, baking powder, baking soda, in a medium bowl. Step 5: Add beer, club soda and vinegar and whisk just until combined and no lumps remain Fit a large heavy pot with thermometer. Step 6: Pour in oil to a depth of 3" Heat over medium-high until thermometer registers 375 Working in batches, dip fish into batter, allowing excess batter to drip back into bowl.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, panko breadcrumbs, eggs, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, halibut fillets, corn tortillas, napa cabbage, mayonnaise, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: To fry the fish: fill a large heavy bottomed pot about 1 / 3 full of peanut oil. Step 2: Heat to 375 degrees f While the oil is heating, put the breadcrumbs into a shallow dish Break the eggs into another shallow dish, season with salt and pepper, and beat them with 2 tablespoons of water. Step 3: Cut the fish into 1-inch wide strips. Step 4: Dip them into the egg, then coat them well with the breadcrumbs. Step 5: Set aside and let them rest for 10 minutes. Step 6: Cook the fish a few pieces at a time until golden brown and cooked through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Drain on paper towels To make the tacos: heat a dry cast iron skillet over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: tuna, mayonnaise, eggs, bread, green chilies, pickled jalapeno peppers, walnuts, fresh cilantro, lime juice, dried chives, green onion, garlic clove, cumin, salt and pepper, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Cakes: Mix all ingredients in a bowl Consistency should be moldable when squeezed if otherwise add either more liquid or dry ingredients as necessary. Step 2: Refrigerate for 1 / 2 to 1 hour Pat and form into cakes. Step 3: Fry on a skillet or in a large pan in 2 tbsp butter set to medium low to medium heat For my electric skillet this is 300f. Step 4: Fry until golden, approximately 5 minutes per side. Step 5: Serve with sauce on top and / or to the side of the cakes while still warm or even when cold. Step 6: Garnish can be a bit of lime and cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, dried oregano leaves, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, jalapeno pepper, tomatoes, clam juice, red snapper fillet, fresh lemon juice, capers, pimento stuffed olives
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat and cook onions, stirring, until they're softened. Step 2: Add garlic, oregano, cinnamon, cloves and jalapeno peppers and cook, stirring, for one minute. Step 3: Add tomatoes and clam juice and bring to a boil. Step 4: Transfer this mixture to your slow cooker and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours-- until the mixture is hot and bubbling. Step 5: Stir in fish and lemon juice. Step 6: Cover and cook on high for 20 minutes or until fish is cooked through. Step 7: Stir in capers and pour mixture onto a warmed platter. Step 8: Garnish with sliced olives and serve.

Dish Name: Croquetas De Atn Tuna Fish Balls
Ingredient Names: potatoes, tuna fish, parsley, nutmeg, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt & pepper, egg, flour, breadcrumbs, olive oil, red pepper, yellow pepper, cucumber, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: First of all make all the ingredients ready. Step 2: In a big bowl combine potatoes, tuna fish, parsley, spices and salt Work with a fork If it doesnt stick together add 1 egg and about 2 tablespoon of flour Form walnuts sized balls, coat first with egg and then with the breadcrumbs Flat them slightly and place them on a dish. Step 3: Preheat a non sticky pan with about 2 tablespoon oil to medium temperature. Step 4: Fry the meatball on the first size when golden brown, turn, add 2 tablespoon oil and brown the second size For the serving suggestion combine all the vegetable in a bowls toss, eventually add some salt. Step 5: Serve with lemon and olive oil.

Ingredient Names: ground cumin, salt, fresh ground pepper, salmon fillets, olive oil, avocado, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 425 degree. Step 2: In a small bowl, stif together cumin, salt and pepper. Step 3: Sprinkle over salmon. Step 4: Heat oil in large ovenproof nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 5: Add salmon and cook 2 min or until brown. Step 6: Turn and then place in oven. Step 7: Bake 5 to 8 mins or until salmon just begins to flake While salmon is baking, mash up the avocado and mix it in with the salsa. Step 8: When the salmon is done, remove from oven and top with guacamole.

Dish Name: Cumin Fish Roasted Corn Salsa 21 Day Wonder Diet Day 10
Ingredient Names: corn cobs, coriander, red capsicum, green onions, lime juice, white fish fillets, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Cut kernals from corn cobs Roast corn in heated medium fry pan, stirring constantly. Step 2: Transfer to medium bowl. Step 3: Stir in coriander, capsicum, onion and juice. Step 4: Sprinkle fish with cumin. Step 5: Cook in same heated pan. Step 6: Serve corn salsa topped with fish. Step 7: Serve with lime wedges if you like.

Ingredient Names: cumin seed, salt, paprika, black pepper, garlic cloves, tilapia fillet, canola oil, avocado, mango, green onion, red onion, cilantro, lime juice, ground red pepper, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add cumin seeds, cook 2 minutes or until toasted, shaking pan frequently. Step 3: Combine cumin, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, paprika, and black pepper in a spice grinder Process until finely ground. Step 4: Combine cumin mixture and garlic Rub over fish. Step 5: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add oil to pan swirling to coat, add fish. Step 6: Cook 2 minutes on each side or until done, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: curry powder, butter, shallots, garlic cloves, fish fumet, heavy cream, lime, salt, wellfleet oysters, whitefish trimmings, mushroom, carrot, white onion, oyster liquor, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a very heavy skillet, saute the curry powder in the butter until fragrant. Step 2: Stir in the shallots and garlic, and add the fumet. Step 3: Reduce the mixture until 1 / 4 cup remains. Step 4: Whisk in the cream and continue reducing until slightly thick. Step 5: Whisk in the lime juice and salt Broil or grill the oysters over pecan or mesquite until they open. Step 6: Remove the top shell, pour the curry sauce over them and top with the banana salsa. Step 7: Serve Fish fumet: Combine all of the ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Curried fish tacos with bean salad
Ingredient Names: avocados, lemons, kidney beans, finger-length cucumber chunk, cherry tomato havled, skinless haddock fillets, flour, mild curry powder, vegetable oil, tacos shells
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the avocado with the lemon juice in a bowl. Add the beans, cucumber and tomatoes, then mix well with some seasoning. Slice the fish into thick, finger-length strips and toss in a bowl with the flour and curry powder. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan, then fry the fish slices for 1 min on each side until cooked through. Serve in the tacos, with the bean salad, soured cream and lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, olive oil, garlic cloves, medium shrimp, worcestershire sauce, tabasco sauce, fresh oregano, salt & freshly ground black pepper, ketchup, brandy, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook, stirring often, until it is fragrant, one to two minutes. Step 3: Stir in the shrimp, worcestershire sauce, tabasco, oregano, and some salt and pepper and let the mixture simmer until the shrimp are partially cooked through and beginning to curl, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in ketchup and simmer until the shrimp are opaque and just cooked through, two more minutes. Step 5: Add the brandy and parsley. Step 6: Stir to combine, remove from heat and serve.

Ingredient Names: fish fillets, butter, fresh ground black pepper, picante sauce, mexican blend cheese, corn chips, sour cream, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 400 degrees f. Step 2: Grease a baking sheet. Step 3: Rinse the fillets under cold water then pat completely dry using paper towels. Step 4: Place the fillets onto the baking sheet Lightly brush both sides of each fillets very lightly with melted butter or mayonnaise, then sprinkle lightly with black pepper to taste. Step 5: Spoon / drizzle about 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 cup picante sauce over each fillet. Step 6: Sprinkle about 1 / 4 cup shredded cheese over the salsa, then sprinkle crushed corn chips over the top. Step 7: Bake uncovered for about 12-15 minutes or until the fish flakes. Step 8: Serve topped with sour cream and green onions Delicious!

Ingredient Names: large raw shrimp, ketchup, water, white onions, plum tomato, fresh cilantro, lime juice, hot sauce, salt, hass avocadoes, saltines
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to a boil, add salt and shrimp. Step 2: Boil for 3-4 mins or until pink, do not overcook. Step 3: Strain shrimp out of the water Shock the shrimp in icy cold water, to stop the cooking process. Step 4: Remove the tails Run water through a strainer to strain the grits. Step 5: Put warm water and entire bottle of ketchup in a glass container, and whisk until well blended To this sauce add in the onion, tomato, cilantro, lime juice, and hot sauce. Step 6: Stir Last but not least add the shrimp.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, shrimp, chili powder, ground cumin, taco shells, iceberg lettuce, cheddar cheese, tomatoes, red onions, sour cream, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook shrimp in hot oil over medium heat, stirring frequently about 2 minutes or until shrimp are pink and firm. Step 2: Add in the chile powder and cumin. Step 3: Stir and toss for about 10 seconds or until shrimp are well coated. Step 4: Take pan off of burner and cover to keep shrimp warm. Step 5: Heat the taco shells according to the package directions. Step 6: For each taco: place 8-12 shrimp in a shell. Step 7: Top with about 1/2 cup lettuce, 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese, 1-2 tablespoons tomatoes, 1-2 teaspoons onion, a dollop of sour cream, and a sprinkling of cilantro. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, mayonnaise, lime juice, jalapeno peppers, capers, dried oregano, ground cumin, dried dill weed, ground cayenne pepper, fish fillets, olive oil, black beans, flour tortillas, taco shells, carrots
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the fish sauce ingredients in a bowl, cover and refrigerate till needed. Step 2: Cut up the tomato and set aside on a small plate. Step 3: In a bowl, mix together the 1 tbs lime juice, 2 tbs olive oil and 2 tsp of minced jalapeno pepper. Step 4: Rinse the fish under cold water, pat dry, place in the bowl and toss to coat, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate till the grill is hot. Step 5: Heat a gas grill or a charcoal grill to medium-high heat Scrape off any jalapeno particles from the fish and lightly sprinkle chili powder on both sides of the fish, if you wish Oil the grill grate and grill the fish over medium-high heat till the fish flakes easily, turning after 4 minutes, about 10 minutes total cooking time. Step 6: Cut the fish into 8 equal portions, wrap in foil and keep warm in a preheated oven set to 170f Warm each flour tortilla on the grill till soft, wrap in foil and keep warm in the oven. Step 7: Make a fluid assembly line of the ingredients: taco shells, fish, sauce, coleslaw, tomatoes, tortillas and refried beans.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, tuna steaks, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, soft tortillas, avocados, tomatoes, limes, fresh coriander, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Rub oil over each steak, then sprinkle with the spices. Heat a griddle pan until hot, then cook the steaks on one side for 2 mins. Turn and cook for 1-2 mins more. Cut into strips. Step 2: Heat the tortillas for 30 secs in a microwave until soft. Pile tuna, avocado and tomatoes on top of each, then squeeze over the lime juice and scatter with coriander. Dollop soured cream on top, if you like, then roll up and eat.

Dish Name: Grilled salmon tacos with chipotle lime yogurt
Ingredient Names: garlic salt, smoked paprika, sugar, salmon fillets, fat-free yogurt, chipotle paste, limes, soft flour tortillas warmed, green cabbage, coriander picked, pickled jalapeno chilies, lime wedges, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Rub the garlic salt, paprika, sugar and some seasoning into the flesh of the salmon fillet. Heat grill to high. Step 2: Mix the yogurt, chipotle paste or hot sauce and lime juice together in a bowl with some seasoning, and set aside. Place the salmon on a baking tray lined with foil and grill, skin-side down, for 7-8 mins until cooked through. Remove from the grill and carefully peel off and discard the skin. Step 3: Flake the salmon into large chunks and serve with the warmed tortillas, chipotle yogurt, shredded cabbage, coriander, jalapeños and lime wedges. Add a shake of hot sauce, if you like it spicy.

Dish Name: Meal In A Bowl Guacamole Salad
Ingredient Names: lettuce, tomatoes, pitted ripe olives, green onion, corn chips, tuna, cheddar cheese, avocado, lemon juice, sour cream, salad oil, garlic clove, sugar, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: To make the salad: have all ingredients chilled Break the lettuce into a serving bowl. Step 2: Add other ingredients except cheese. Step 3: Toss lightly with avocado dressing. Step 4: Top with grated cheese To make the avocado dressing: put all ingredients in the blender and blend well.

Ingredient Names: cod, salsa, sharp cheddar cheese, corn chips, avocados, sour cream, green chili, olives
Instructions: Step 1: Lay the fish fillets in a single layer in a greased 8"x12" baking dish. Step 2: Pour the salsa over the top, and then sprinkle evenly with the shredded cheese. Step 3: Top everything with the crushed corn chips. Step 4: Bake, uncovered, at 400°F for 15 minutes, or until fish is opaque and flakes with a fork. Step 5: Serve with choice of garnish: sliced avocado, green chiles, olives and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: fresh carrot, clam juice, onions, butter, salt, pepper, garlic powder, firm white fish fillets, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, mix clam juice and carrots. Step 2: Simmer 'til carrots are crunchy-tender. Step 3: Meanwhile in a large saucepan, fry onions in oil 'til transparent. Step 4: Add the seasonings and optional salt - and fry another 4 minutes. Step 5: Stir the clam juice and carrots into the onions and simmer 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the fish and cilantro and simmer 8-10 minutes or 'til fish is of desired doneness. Step 7: Add water if needed and adjust seasonings. Step 8: Garnish with cilantro leaves or parsley and serve. Step 9: Salsa and hot sauce can be present on the table.

Ingredient Names: limes, skinless white fish fillet, egg whites fork, coarse breadcrumb, squirts oil spray, tzatziki, wedge iceberg lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the lime zest over the pieces of fish, then season. Dip the fish into the egg whites, then coat with breadcrumbs and place on a baking sheet. Spray the fish with 2 squirts oil, then grill for 2 mins. Flip them over, spray with more oil, then grill for a further 2 mins until the fish is cooked and the breadcrumbs are golden and crispy. Step 2: Squeeze the lime juice into the tzatziki and stir. Warm the tortillas according to pack instructions. To assemble the wraps, place a handful of cabbage or lettuce onto the top two-thirds of a tortilla, then rest 3 fish fingers on top with a good dollop of the lime tzatziki. Bring the bottom third of the tortilla up and fold the sides over to envelop the filling.

Ingredient Names: limes, red chile, garlic, fresh coriander, raw shrimp, avocados, sour cream, olive oil, red peppers, flour tortillas mixed salad leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Mix half the lime juice, half the chilli, half the garlic and half the coriander with some seasoning in a shallow dish. Add the prawns and mix to coat them all. Leave to marinate while you prepare the avocado. Step 2: Roughly chop the avocado and pop it in a small food processor with the remaining lime juice, chilli, garlic, the soured cream and some seasoning. Whiz until smooth, then stir in the remaining coriander. (You could also use a stick blender for this.). Step 3: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the pepper for a few mins, until starting to soften. Add the prawns and fry, in a single layer, for 1-2 mins each side – you will know they are cooked when they turn pink and feel firm to the touch. Serve in warm tortillas with salad leaves, if you like, alongside the avocado cream, soured cream and some lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, limes, garlic, chili flakes, tabasco sauce, raw shrimp, tacos shells, iceberg lettuce, low-fat guacamole, half-fat sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the oil, lime juice, garlic, chilli and a dash of Tabasco. Stir in the prawns and set aside for 5 mins. Heat the tacos according to pack instructions. Step 2: Tip the prawns and the marinade into a frying pan and fry for 2 mins until the prawns turn pink and are cooked through. Spoon into the warm tacos, add some lettuce and serve with guacamole, soured cream and salsa.

Ingredient Names: cheddar cheese, green chili peppers, olives, green onions, mayonnaise, baby shrimp, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350°F. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine cheese, chili peppers, olives, green onions, and mayonnaise. Step 3: Gently stir in shrimp. Step 4: Using two 12-inch pizza pans, arrange about half of the tortilla chips. Top each chip with a teaspoon or two of the cheese-shrimp mixture. Step 5: Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or just until cheese is melted. Let cool a minute or so before transferring to serving plate as the cheese will be very hot.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, jalapenos, garlic, tomatoes juice, milk, monterey jack cheese, extra-sharp cheddar cheese, cornstarch, shrimp, mexican pepper sauce, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and jalapeno and cook, stirring often, until the onion is translucent, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and cook, stirring often, until they give off their juices and they evaporate, about 5 minutes.
