Step 5: (The mixture should look somewhat dry.) Add the milk and bring to a simmer. Step 6: In a medium bowl, toss the Monterey Jack and Cheddar with the cornstarch. Step 7: Stir the cheese into the milk mixture, a handful at a time, stirring with the hot sauce. Step 8: Transfer to a mini crockpot or fondue pot. Step 9: Serve warm, with the tortilla chips for dipping.

Dish Name: Spicy seafood stew with tomatoes & lime
Ingredient Names: ancho, olive oil, onions, garlic, chipotle paste, ground cumin, chicken stock, tomato from, raw shrimp, halibut, clam, new potato boiled, limes, lime wedges, avocados, fresh cilantro, red onions, corn tortillas baked
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the chillies in a hot dry frying pan for a few moments (they will puff up a bit), then remove. Deseed and stem chillies, and soak in boiling water for 15 mins. Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, season and cook for about 5 mins or until softened. Add the chipotle paste, reconstituted chillies, cumin, stock and tomatoes. Sauté for 5 mins, then purée until very fine in a blender. Pour back into the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 mins. When close to eating, add the prawns, fish fillets, clams and potatoes. Place a lid on top and cook for 5 mins over a medium-high heat. Add the lime juice and serve with lime wedges, avocado, coriander, red onion and tortilla chips for sprinkling over.

Ingredient Names: halibut fillets, cajun seasoning, green cabbage, red cabbage, cider vinegar, sour cream, green onions, salt, flour tortillas, lemon wedges, salsa, tartar sauce, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Put halibut chunks in a bowl; sprinkle with cajun seasoning and toss to coat. Step 2: Transfer halibut to a well-greased grill wok (the kind with holes in it). Step 3: Stir-grill over hot coals for 8-10 minutes, tossing while cooking. Step 4: In a big bowl, add cabbages; mix well. Step 5: In a smaller bowl, add vinegar, sour cream, green onions, and salt; stir to combine. Step 6: Add dressing mixture to cabbage; toss to coat well. Step 7: For each tortilla, fill with 1/3 cup cabbage mixture and 4-5 chunks of halibut; fold up and serve with lemon wedges, salsa, tartar sauce, guacamole, and a pitcher of margaritas.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, guacamole, sour cream, garlic powder, ground cumin, chili powder, salt and pepper, sharp cheddar cheese, plum tomato, pitted black olives, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Spread the beans over the bottom of a 10" round glass baking dish. Step 2: Cover in guacamole. Step 3: In a separate bowl, combine the sour cream and spices. Step 4: Spread over the guacamole with spatula. Step 5: Sprinkle the top with the cheese, tomatoes, olives and scallions. Step 6: Serve at room temperature or bake in a 425f oven for 15 minutes and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, hormel chili, sour cream, cheddar cheese, jalapeno pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Spread refried beans in a 13x9 inch pan. Step 3: Spread chili on top of beans. Step 4: Spread sour cream on top of chili. Step 5: Sprinkle cheddar cheese on top of sour cream. Step 6: Put jalapeno peppers on top As many as desired. Step 7: Cook in stove 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted. Step 8: Serve hot with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: corn tortilla chips, guacamole, chili, cheddar cheese, sour cream, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to the broiler setting. Step 2: Place each chip, not overlapping, in an oven proof dish Working with one chip at a time, spread one teaspoon of guacamole over each chip Carefully dollop 1 / 2 tsp of chili on the guacamole, then sprinkle a little cheese on top of the chili. Step 3: Place the dish in the oven, and remove after 3 minutes. Step 4: Spoon 1 / 2 teaspoon of sour cream on top of each chip, then sprinkle a little bit of green onion on top of each for presentation. Step 5: Serve at once Serves 1 Can be easily mul.

Dish Name: 5 Layer Mexican Dip Or Nachos Supreme
Ingredient Names: spicy refried beans, sour cream, mayonnaise, taco seasoning mix, diced green chilies, avocados, fresh lemon, salt, garlic powder, cheddar cheese, green onions, tomatoes, black olives, fresh cilantro, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a 13 x 9-inch glass serving dish, spread the refried beans. Step 2: Mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise and seasoning mix. Step 3: Spread this on top of the beans. Step 4: Put on a layer of the chopped green chiles. Step 5: Mix together the diced avocados, lemon juice, salt and garlic powder. Step 6: Spread this on top of the green chiles. Step 7: Mix together the shredded cheese, green onions, chopped tomatoes and chopped olives. Step 8: Sprinkle this on top. Step 9: Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro May be served right away, or cover and chill for up to 24 hours.

Dish Name: 5 Things Hot Mexican Green Chile Dip
Ingredient Names: sour cream, cheddar cheese, tomatoes and green chilies, diced green chilies, knorr vegetable soup mix
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees In mixing bowl, first combine the sour cream and vegetable soup mix. Step 2: Then drain the excess liquid off of the rotel and green chiles and stir both cans in with the sour cream mixture Lastly, add 2 cups of the cheese and stir everything together. Step 3: Pour mixture into a 10" round baking dish, top with additional 1 / 2 cup or more of cheese. Step 4: Bake for 30 minutes. Step 5: Allow the dish to cool for at least 20 minutes before serving with your favorite tortilla or corn chips Happy dipping!

Ingredient Names: sour cream, mayonnaise, taco seasoning mix, avocado, salsa, lemon juice, hot pepper sauce, refried beans, cheddar cheese, tomatoes, black olives, flour, oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl stir sour cream, mayo and taco mix In another bowl mash the avocado. Step 2: Stir in the salsa, lemon juice and 1 / 4 tsp hot sauce. Step 3: Stir 1 / 2 hot sauce into the beans if desired In 13x9 dish, spread the beans. Step 4: Top with the avocado mixture. Step 5: Top with the sour cream mixture. Step 6: Sprinkle cheese over this, top with tomatoes. Step 7: Sprinkle with olives.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lemon juice, salt, pepper, mayonnaise, sour cream, taco seasoning mix, bean dip, tomatoes, green onion, black olives, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix avocados, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Step 2: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix. Step 3: Layer ingredients as follows Bottom layer: bean dip Second layer: avocado mixture Third layer: sour cream mixture Fourth layer: tomatoes Fifth layer: onions Sixth layer: olives Seventh layer: cheese.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, avocados, lime, salt, sour cream, taco seasoning, green onion, black olives, tomatoes, sharp cheddar cheese, nacho chip
Instructions: Step 1: Layer #1: spread the entire can of refried beans on a dinner-sized plate / platter. Step 2: Layer #2: mash the avocados with a little fresh lime juice & salt to taste. Step 3: Spread avocado evenly over refried beans. Step 4: Layer #3: mix the taco xeasoning into the container of sour cream. Step 5: Spread this evenly over the avocado layer. Step 6: Layer #4: chopped green onion. Step 7: Layer #5: sliced black olives. Step 8: Layer #6: chopped tomatoes--i like to remove the seeds before chopping so it does not turn into 7-layer soup. Step 9: Layer #7: freshly grated sharp cheddar cheese. Step 10: Serve with nacho chips--i like to get the nacho chips from a local mexican restaurant.

Ingredient Names: spicy refried beans, red enchilada sauce, guacamole, taco seasoning mix, sour cream, cheddar cheese, black olives, green onion, roma tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Spread unheated beans in the bottom of a 9x11 size glass dish or glass baking pan. Step 2: Pour enchilada sauce evenly over the beans. Step 3: Spoon on guacamole and spread evenly. Step 4: In a separate dish, mix together the taco seasoning and the sour cream until well blended. Step 5: Spoon this sour cream mixture over the guacamole and spread around evenly. Step 6: Sprinkle cheese on top of these layers until you have a complete "layer" of cheese. Step 7: Drain the cans of black olives and sprinkle them evenly on top of the cheese Do the same with the green onions, and then finally with the diced tomatoes. Step 8: Cover tightly and chill in refrigerator for about 2 hours. Step 9: Now, invite a few friends over, set it on the table with some tortilla chips, and watch it disappear!

Dish Name: A Pico De Gallo For Pico Addicts Anon
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic, diced onion, cilantro, jalapenos, limes, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients and let it sit for half an hour Inhale - use a spoon to assist.

Ingredient Names: serrano peppers, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, onion, avocados, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all diced ingredients together Add cilantro leaves Salt to taste Allow to set for 1 hour for flavors to meld.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, butter, all-purpose flour, ground beef, ground pork, onion, garlic, ground cumin, seasoning salt, jalapeno, tomato puree, pine nuts, raisins, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees In mixing bowl, combine both packages of cream cheese, butter and flour. Step 2: Beat until soft dough forms. Step 3: Wrap in wax paper and chill 1 hour. Step 4: In a large skillet, brown ground meats, then drain. Step 5: Return meat to skillet and add onion and saute. Step 6: Add garlic, cumin, seasoned salt and jalapeno. Step 7: Stir in tomato puree, pine nuts and raisins. Step 8: Simmer about 10 minutes. Step 9: When dough chills, roll out 1 / 4 inch thickness and cut with a large biscuit cutter.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, sour cream, taco sauce, cheddar cheese, tomatoes, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: Blend together cream cheese and sour cream until smooth. Step 2: Spread cream cheese and sour cream mixture in bottom of a 9x13" pan. Step 3: Layer taco sauce on top, tilting pan if need be to get an even layer throughout. Step 4: Layer cheese, tomatoes and finish with olives keep all layers even. Step 5: Serve cold with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic, sweet onion, cilantro, jalapeno, tomatillo, ground cumin, cajun seasoning, hot sauce, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Chop in processor on pulse, slow. Step 2: Chop onion first and tomatoes last. Step 3: Add spices, juice Be careful not to over-process. Step 4: Drain to get excess water out. Step 5: Serve alone with chips or as a condiment.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, marinated artichoke hearts, basil leaves, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, poblano chile
Instructions: Step 1: With a food processor running, add the garlic clove through the feed tube until it is finely chopped. Step 2: Add the drained artichoke hearts and the basil Pulse until mixture is finely chopped. Step 3: Spread one half of each tortilla with a few tablespoons of the artichoke mixture. Step 4: Sprinkle about 1 / 3 cup of the grated cheese over the artichoke spread. Step 5: Arrange a few strips of chili over the cheese. Step 6: Fold tortillas in half over the filling and brush both sides with some of the reserved artichoke marinade. Step 7: Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 8: Put 2 to 3 quesadillas into the skillet and cook until lightly browned. Step 9: Turn over and cook until golden.

Ingredient Names: dried arbol chiles, delmonte stewed tomatoes, yellow onion, jalapeno, cilantro, garlic clove, lemon juice, pepper, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Take the stems off the peppers and throw away the stems. Step 2: Place the peppers and seeds in the bender. Step 3: Blend well Next toss in the stewed tomatoes with juice, 1 jalepeno, 1 / 2 yellow onion, 1 garlic clove, handful of cilantro, lemon juice, salt and pepper and blend til you have the consistancy desired I dont like my salsa chunky, thats what pico de gallo is! Step 4: I also dont want it to runny so it runs off your chips, so i just "pulse" it a few times If you feel the salsa looks to white from the onion this just means you need to add more cilantro to your salsa Try the salsa with your chips and adjust the seasonings as needed Refridgerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: frozen corn, grape tomatoes, avocado, fresh cilantro, lime juice, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Toss avocados, tomatoes, corn, cilantro, lime juice and salt in a medium bowl.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, green chili peppers, lime juice, avocados, garlic, onion, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients into a blender, in the order they are listed and blend to a rough puree Or mash by hand and mix well. Step 2: Serve immediately to avoid darking Guacamole is usually accompanied by tostaditas.

Ingredient Names: oil, avocados, flour, ground cumin, chili powder, salt, white pepper, eggs, milk, breadcrumbs, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, habanero pepper, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare ketchup, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in deep fryer to 350 degrees. Step 3: Cut avocados in half lengthwise and remove seeds Carefully slice each one into 4 wedges and remove skin. Step 4: Combine flour, cumin, chili powder, salt and pepper in small bowl. Step 5: Whisk eggs and milk together in second bowl Dredge avocados in flour, dip into egg mix to coat Coat each wedge in breadcrumbs Deep-fry until golden brown.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, avocado, red onion, fresh lemon juice, tabasco sauce, sour cream, fresh cilantro, flour tortillas, vegetable oil, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Stir together tomatoes, avocado, onion, lemon juice and tabasco, and season with salt and pepper In another bowl, stir together sour cream, coriander, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 3: Put tortillas on a large baking sheet and brush tops with oil Broil tortillas on a rack set 2 to 4 inches from heat until pale golden. Step 4: Turn tortillas and broil until other sides are pale golden. Step 5: Sprinkle tortillas evenly with cheese and broil until melted and bubbling. Step 6: Spread avocado mixture evenly over 2 tortillas and top each with one of remaining tortillas, cheese side down, to make 2 quesadillas. Step 7: Transfer to a cutting board and cut each into 8 wedges.

Ingredient Names: avocados, onion, lime juice, garlic powder, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, seed and mash the avocadoes Add the onion, lime juice, garlic powder, salt & pepper Mix well Serve with tortilla chips.

Dish Name: Avocado Tomato And Jack Cheese Salsa
Ingredient Names: monterey jack cheese, avocados, tomatoes, green onions, fresh cilantro, diced green chilies, black olives, italian salad dressing
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, mix all ingredients Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: avocados, flour tortillas, green chilies, monterey jack cheese, butter, onions, bacon, garlic powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine avocados, chiles, cheese, onion and bacon, mixing well. Step 2: Divide mixture in fourths, and spread mixture on each tortilla, leaving a 1 / 4-inch edge. Step 3: Fold each tortilla in half and crimp edges. Step 4: Brush a large skillet and tortillas with melted butter. Step 5: Fry until golden brown or until cheese melts. Step 6: Cut each into 4 wedges and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, white onion, plum tomato, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avocados in half and remove pits Scoop the avocado into a bowl and coarsely mash. Step 2: Add the onions, tomatoes, serrano chili, lime juice, and salt, stir to combine. Step 3: Press plastic wrap down tightly on top of the guacamole until ready to serve to prevent the avocado from turning brown.

Ingredient Names: avocados, tomatillos, garlic cloves, onion, serrano pepper, cilantro, salt, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Rmove the husks from the tomatillos, wash them well, and roughly chop them. Step 2: Put the tomatillos, onion, garlic, and pepper in a food processor or blender Process for about eight seconds. Step 3: Add the avocado chunks, cilantro, salt, and lime juice to the food processor bowl Process an additional ten seconds The texture is supposed to be somewhat chunky - not a puree. Step 4: Taste to adjust seasoning You may need to add more serrano pepper The tomatillos and lime will keep the guacamole fresh and it won't turn brown.

Ingredient Names: avocados, cream cheese, sour cream, taco seasoning mix, cheddar cheese, fresh tomatoes, green onions, black olives, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Layer 1: mash the avocados and blend in the lemon juice, mixing well, and spread evenly in a bowl or on a serving plate to the edges of the dish. Step 2: Layer 2: beat the cream cheese until smooth and creamy. Step 3: Blend in the sour cream, mixing well, and blend in the taco seasoning, blending well. Step 4: Spread over the avocado layer. Step 5: Layer 3: sprinkle the cheddar cheese over the cream cheese mixture. Step 6: Layer 4: distribute the tomatoes over the cheddar cheese layer. Step 7: Layer 5: spread the green onions over the tomato layer. Step 8: Layer 6: top with the black olives. Step 9: Serve at room temperature Suggested dippers: tortilla chips, bell peppers, lobster,.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cheddar cheese, flour, taco seasoning mix, dried oregano, cumin seeds, tortilla chips, corn chips, pita bread, ripe olives, sausage, red pepper, green pepper, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Toss together cheese and flour. Step 2: Heat broth in a 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan, until bubbles rise. Step 3: Turn heat to med-low, and add cheese and flour blend, 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring until cheese is melted after each addition. Step 4: Stir in taco mix, oregano, and crushed cumin seed. Step 5: Transfer to a fondue pot, and serve immediately, along with all your dippers.

Dish Name: Bacon And Cheese Quesadillas For Two
Ingredient Names: tortillas, bacon, shallot, cheddar cheese, adobo sauce, chilies, salt, vegetable oil, salsa, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the bacon in a small non-stick skilled over medium heat until crisp. Step 2: Remove bacon and transfer to a pper towel to drain. Step 3: Pour out all but 1 tablespoon of bacon fat, then return to medium heat. Step 4: Add the minced shallots, pinch of salt and cook, stirring occasionally until softened, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Transfer shallots to small bowl and set aside Wipe out skillet with paper towels and return to medium-low heat and lightly toast each tortilla on one side Slide the tortillas to a cutting board. Step 6: Divide the cheese, bacon and shallots equally between the four tortillas Spreading the filling over half of each toritilla, leaving a 1 / 2-inch border around the edge. Step 7: Top with jalapenos and / or adobo sauce.

Ingredient Names: flour tortilla, mozzarella cheese, blue cheese, roma tomatoes, avocado, bacon, red onion, spinach, ranch dressing, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Top flour tortilla in listed order, spreading the cheese over the entire surface, and the rest of the fillings over half of the surface Nestle the slice of tomato in the curve of each slice of avocado Brown quesadilla on a medium grill. Step 2: Fold in half, cut into thirds. Step 3: Serve with 1 / 4 c avocado ranch dressing Avocado ranch dressing: Dice california avocado. Step 4: Blend avocado, ranch dressing, and parsley, freshly chopped until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides Yield 2 1 / 2c.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno peppers, cream cheese, garlic cloves, sun-dried tomato, fresh cilantro, coarse sea salt, bacon, toothpick
Instructions: Step 1: Mix cream cheese, garlic, sundried tomatoes, cilantro and salt until well blended You can now set the mixture aside or even freeze for up to a couple of months in a freezer bag You'll want to wear some kitchen gloves for this step! Step 2: Slice the jalapeos lengthwise, being careful not to slice them in half. Step 3: Then slice at the top along the width of the pepper just about a quarter inch below the base of the stem until you cut through the core, again being careful not to cut completely through the pepper. Step 4: Now you need to decide whether you want to keep the seed webbing for those that like it really hot, or remove them for a lot less heat I like to do about half and half so that you can please everyone Anyway, if removing the seeds, gently remove the core using a paring knife by spreading the pepper carefully, you may need to shake some of the remaining seeds out Separate the strips of bacon and cook in the microwave for about 5 minutes on high, just enough to give it a head start. Step 5: Then pat dry with paper towels Just to soak up some of the grease.

Ingredient Names: eggs, cottage cheese, all-purpose flour, baking powder, butter, green onions, green chilies, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine eggs and cottage cheese. Step 2: Blend until almost smooth. Step 3: Add in flour, baking powder, and butter, stir to combine. Step 4: Stir in onion, chiles, and cheese. Step 5: Pour mixture into a lightly greased 8x8 inch pan. Step 6: Bake in a 350 oven for 30-40 minutes, let cool slightly, cut into squares.

Ingredient Names: jello gelatin, water, coconut rum, schnapps, unsweetened pineapple juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place your jello shot cups on a cookie sheet This will make for easy transport. Step 2: Place 2 cups very hot water in a pitcher Slowly pour in contents of jello packages while stirring constantly. Step 3: Stir until completely mixed. Step 4: Add in the remaining ingredients and stir well. Step 5: Pour into plastic jello shot cups or you can use a 9x13 pan if you don't have the cups. Step 6: Chill 4 hours or more until set If you are using a cake pan, simply cut the set jello into squares and place on individual cupcake cups for serving If you want to get silly, top each one with a small dollop of whip cream just before serving!

Ingredient Names: hummus, avocado, fresh lime juice, chunky salsa, sour cream, fresh cilantro, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Spread the hummus over the bottom of a 1-quart glass dish Next, sprinkle evenly with avocado. Step 2: Sprinkle lime juice over the avocado. Step 3: Season lightly with salt and pepper if desired. Step 4: Top with salsa, sour cream, and cilantro. Step 5: Cover and chill until ready to serve. Step 6: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: baby spinach, onion, garlic cloves, canola oil, tomatoes and green chilies, cream cheese, salt, mexican blend cheese, red wine vinegar, hot pepper sauce, black olives
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, bring 1 / 2 inch of water to a boil. Step 2: Cut stems off spinach, cut leaves in thirds, add spinach. Step 3: Cook for 2 minutes or until wilted, drain well. Step 4: In a large skillet, saute onion in oil until tender, the baking does not cook them much so saut to your preference, add garlic. Step 5: Stir in tomatoes and cream cheese until blended. Step 6: Remove skillet from burner. Step 7: Stir in spinach, salt, cheese blend, vinegar, pepper sauce, and sliced black olives.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, chili seasoning mix, green onion, sour cream, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together in baking dish Bake at 350 for about 30 minutes Serve warm with chips.

Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, chili powder, cream cheese, eggs, garlic powder, ground cumin, diced green chilies, green onion, salsa, cheddar cheese, black olives, sour cream, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 f Heavily spray bottom and side of 9-inch springform pan with non stick cooking spray. Step 2: Combine corn meal and chili powder. Step 3: Sprinkle over bottom and side of prepared pan. Step 4: Beat cream cheese, eggs, garlic powder, and cumin in large mixer bowl until smooth. Step 5: Stir in chiles and 1 / 2 cup green onion. Step 6: Pour half of batter into pan. Step 7: Spoon 1 cup salsa over top of batter. Step 8: Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 cups cheddar cheese over salsa. Step 9: Spread remaining batter over top of cheese.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, eggs, vegetable oil, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, paprika, chili peppers, flour, baking powder, milk, pam cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken strips across the grain in thin slices. Step 2: Set aside In medium mixing bowl, add eggs, oil, chili powder, ground cumin, salt and paprika. Step 3: Add optional diced peppers if desired. Step 4: Whisk until mixed In separate bowl mix flour and baking powder. Step 5: Add into egg mixture and add milk. Step 6: Mix with spoon Batter will be sticky and texture like peanut butter, preheat oven 400.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, onion, green bell pepper, fresh garlic, tomatoes, oregano leaves, puff pastry sheets
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Cook sausage, onion, green pepper and garlic in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until sausage is browned and onion is crisply tender, drain well. Step 3: Stir in tomato and oregano, set aside. Step 4: Roll 1 sheet puff pastry to 12-inch square. Step 5: Cut into 16 squares. Step 6: Place 1 rounded tablespoon filling in center of each square. Step 7: Fold opposite corners of squares together to form triangles Pinch edges of pastry together.

Ingredient Names: jalapenos, cream cheese, bacon, cayenne pepper, monterey jack cheese, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Set out cream cheese to let it get soft. Step 2: Take the jalapenos and cut in halves. Step 3: Make sure you remove all seeds and the enter membrane that the seeds are on. Step 4: Once the cream cheese is soft mix in the monterey jack, cayenne pepper or cajun spice if you have that instead of the cayenne. Step 5: Fill each half with the mix and then wrap each piece with a slice of bacon Slightly oil cookie sheet with olive oil and place stuffed jalapenos on it. Step 6: Put in an oven at 375f and cook until bacon starts to crisp. Step 7: Make sure not to cook to long, you don't want the cream cheese to become to soft.

Ingredient Names: plantains, olive oil, salt, garlic powder, ground coriander, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Cut the plantains into the shape of fries. Step 3: Spread fries on a baking sheet. Step 4: Brush fries with olive oil. Step 5: Combine salt, garlic powder, ground coriander, and cayenne pepper. Step 6: Sprinkle mixture on fries. Step 7: Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes Turning them over about after 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Baked Queso Fresco With Tomatillo Sauce
Ingredient Names: tomatillo, garlic, cilantro, lime, avocado, jalapeno, salt, queso fresco
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: In a large saucepan, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Step 3: Remove husks from tomatillos. Step 4: Boil tomatillos for about two minutes or until soft. Step 5: Remove tomatillos from water and place in a blender or food processor. Step 6: Add garlic, cilantro, lime juice, avocado, jalapeo and salt Pure until smooth. Step 7: Place cheese in ovenproof serving dish. Step 8: Pour sauce over cheese and bake for 20 minutes. Step 9: Remove from oven and serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: italian sausage, refried beans, mild salsa, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, black olives, green onion, sour cream, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Cook sausage over medium heat, breaking up the meat with the edge of a spoon, drain. Step 3: Spread the beans over the bottom of a 2 1 / 2 quart shallow baking dish and top with sausage. Step 4: Pour salsa over sausage, add cheeses, sprinkle with olives and green onions. Step 5: Bake uncovered 25-30 minutes, top with sour cream and serve with chips.

Ingredient Names: jalapeno peppers, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, worcestershire sauce, bacon
Instructions: Step 1: Cut jalapeo peppers in half lengthwise, remove seeds. Step 2: Place peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain well. Step 3: Combine cream cheese, cheddar cheese and worcestershire sauce, stir well. Step 4: Place one heaping teaspoon cheese mixture on each pepper half. Step 5: Sprinkle with bacon. Step 6: Place on a baking sheet. Step 7: Bake at 400f for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: avocados, cilantro leaf, white onion, tomatoes, jalapeno pepper, salt, lime, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, scoop the flesh of the avocados and mash lightly. Step 2: Add the remaining ingredients and stir gently The mixture should be a mix of chunky and smooth. Step 3: Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, mild green chilies, rotisserie-cooked chicken, extra-sharp cheddar cheese, taco sauce, fresh cilantro stem, salsa, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 450f. Step 2: Place 1 tortilla on large baking sheet. Step 3: Spread with 1 tablespoon chiles. Step 4: Top with one-quarter of chicken, cheese and taco sauce. Step 5: Place another tortilla on top. Step 6: Repeat with remaining tortillas, chiles, chicken, cheese and sauce, for a total of 4 separate quesadillas. Step 7: Bake in 450f oven 8 minutes, until crispy and cheese melted, remove from oven. Step 8: Let stand for 5 minutes. Step 9: Cut into quarters.

Ingredient Names: cooked pork, barbecue sauce, pinto beans, lime, cajun seasoning, tomatoes, pickled jalapeno peppers, fresh cilantro, white corn tortilla chips, sour cream, shredded cheddar cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Toss the meat with 1 cup of bbq sauce and set aside Coarsely mash the beans in a bowl with the lime juice, about half the cajun rub, and salt to taste In another bowl, toss the tomatoes with the jalapenos and the 1 / 2 cup cilantro. Step 3: Season with additional salt and pepper to taste Scatter half the chips in a baking dish Scatter the meat, beans, and 1 / 3 cup sour cream, and about half the tomato mixture over the chips. Step 4: Cover with remaining chips, then scatter the remaining tomatoes, sauce, and cajun rub evenly over the chips. Step 5: Sprinkle the shredded cheese over all. Step 6: Bake the nachos until cheese melts and begin to brown.

Ingredient Names: green bell pepper, olive oil, yellow bell pepper, red bell pepper, onion, barbecue sauce, ranch dressing, butter, flour tortillas, barbecued beef, mild cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Stir fry peppers and onions in oil. Step 2: Combine barbecue sauce and ranch dressing, mix well. Step 3: Spread butter evenly on 1 side of each tortilla. Step 4: Layer barbecue beef, pepper and onion blend, and cheese evenly on non-buttered side of 4 tortillas. Step 5: Cover with remaining tortillas, buttered side up. Step 6: Grill each quesadilla in large skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side or until golden and cheese melts, cut into wedges. Step 7: Serve with barbecue ranch dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: corn tortilla chips, refried beans, monterey jack cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Spread refried beans over each tortilla chip. Step 3: Top with a mound of cheese, and lay the chips in a single layer on a baking sheet. Step 4: Heat under the broiler until the cheese is melted and bubbly, about1 minute. Step 5: Top each chip with a dollop of salsa, serve at once.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, sour cream, taco seasoning, green onion, tabasco sauce, bean dip, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients and put in a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish, covered Bake at 350 for 30 minutes Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, pinto beans, sour cream, sharp cheddar cheese, onion, rotel tomatoes & chilies, canned jalapeno slices, corn chips
Instructions: Step 1: Mix refried beans, pinto beans, rotel tomato's, cheese and place in an 8x8 baking dish. Step 2: Bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes ot until heated thru. Step 3: After cooling slightly, put a layer of sour cream followed by the chopped onion and if you choose, the jalapeno's. Step 4: Serve with dip size fritos or tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, mexican blend cheese, corn tortillas, peanut oil, avocados, fresh cilantro, lime, garlic, jalapeno pepper, onions, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Make guacamole first by combining all ingredients except sour cream. Step 2: Mash and stir until only small lumps of avocado remain. Step 3: Garnish with sour cream piled in the center and refrigerate until ready to use. Step 4: Combine beans, tabasco, cumin, coriander, salt and cheese stirring well Microwave tortillas between 2 paper towels, 3 at a time on high for 30 seconds Work with one tortilla at a time, keeping the others covered in paper towels so they stay warm and moist. Step 5: Place 1 tablespoon of filling at the center edge of tortilla closest to you and roll tightly away from you like skinny cigar. Step 6: Keep filling away from the edges, as it may leak out when frying and cause the oil to spatter. Step 7: Put seam side down on a paper towel or wax paper and repeat the process until you've made all 24 taquitos. Step 8: Using medium-thick cotton string, toothpicks, or bamboo skewers secure the center seam of each taquito.

Ingredient Names: condensed bean with bacon soup, cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soup, cheese, and salsa in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Heat until cheese is melted and it's heated through. Step 3: Make sure you stir it often. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips or your favorite dippers.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, black pepper, onion powder, mexican chili powder, garlic powder, olive oil, flour tortillas, cheese, tomatoes, cilantro, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Chicken preparation: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Step 2: In a small bowl, combine seasonings Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 2-inch thickness. Step 3: Season both sides of chicken breasts. Step 4: Grill chicken breasts for 8-10 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Step 5: Allow chicken to cool for 10-15 minutes and then slice into thin pieces Chicken may be broiled instead of a grilled per your preference Quesadilla assembly: On two dinner plates, place one flour tortilla onto each.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, lemon, mayonnaise, jalapeno, onion, tomatoes, kosher salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Scoop and mash avocados. Step 2: Add lemon juice and mayo and combine. Step 3: Add chopped veggies and combine. Step 4: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Serve with favorite brand of tortilla chips or fresh veggies Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, onion, jalapeno, garlic cloves, chorizo sausage, all-purpose flour, chili powder, ground cumin, lager beer, whole milk, monterey jack cheese, fresh cilantro leaves, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add 1 tablespoon of the butter, the onion, jalapeno and garlic. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables soften and begin to caramelize, about 20 minutes. Step 4: Remove from the heat. Step 5: Heat 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 6: Add the chorizo and cook, breaking it up with the side of a spoon, until well browned, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add to the cooked vegetables in the skillet using a slotted spoon. Step 8: Set aside Wipe out the saucepan the chorizo cooked in and return it to medium heat. Step 9: Add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter.

Dish Name: Before You Know It Bean Dip
Ingredient Names: black beans, onion, garlic clove, roasted red pepper, fat-free chicken broth, balsamic vinegar, sour cream, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Drain most of the liquid out of the canned beans Load all the ingredients, in the order they are listed, into a blender. Step 2: Cover and quickly pulse until you reach the desired consistency You can substitute your favorite beans, pinto, white, or whatever you're into.

Ingredient Names: green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, monterey jack cheese, ripe olives, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut bell pepper strips crosswise into halves. Step 2: Arrange in ungreased broiler proof pie pan, 9 x 1 1 / 4-inches or round pan 9 x 2-inches. Step 3: Sprinkle with cheese, olives and red pepper. Step 4: Set oven control to broil Broil peppers with tops 3 to 4 inches from heat until cheese is melted, about 3 minutes.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, red onion, orange bell pepper, fuji apple, roma tomatoes, jalapenos, fresh cilantro, garlic powder, kosher salt, sour cream, celery seed, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Turn your radio to a spanish station. Step 2: Cut open the 4 avocado's around the equator Scoop out the avocado insides and place into medium-sized bowl. Step 3: Now, mash up the avocados in the bowl with a potato masher Next, cut up the bell pepper, onion Tomatoes, jalapenos, apple and cilantro. Step 4: Place all of this into the bowl with the mashed avocados Next, measure out the sour cream, garlic powder, lime juice, and celery seed. Step 5: Add to the avocado bowl and mix thoroughly with a spoon Salt / pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, jalapeno pepper, garlic, chopped tomato, onion, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsly mash the avacados, garlic and jalapeno until the avacados are creamy but still very chunky. Step 2: Add the chopped tomato, onion and salt to taste, and stir together. Step 3: Sprinkle with the lime juice and cilantro, then stir and taste once more. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips More jalapeno, onion and lime juice may be added to your taste.

Dish Name: Best Mexican Cheese Corn Dip Ever
Ingredient Names: mexicorn whole kernel corn, cheddar cheese, diced green chilies, green onion, ground cumin, black pepper, mayonnaise, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium to large bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise and cumin, stir well. Step 2: Add corn, cheese, chiles, black pepper, and onions to the sour cream mixture. Step 3: Stir with a wooden spoon til all is combined. Step 4: Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight. Step 5: Serve with warm tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, jalapenos, spanish onion, cilantro, garlic cloves, vinegar, liquid smoke, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place the tomatoes on a grill at medium heat, turning every 4 minutes to char all sides About halfway through, place jalapenos on the grill and do the same. Step 2: Once the skin has been blackened and is peeling from the tomatoes, place on a plate and set aside to cool In the meantime, place quartered onion, garlic cloves and cilantro into a food processor and pulse until everything is about the same size chunks. Step 3: Place in a bowl, and add the rest of the ingredients. Step 4: Once the tomatoes and jalapenos are cooled, slice the jalapenos open and remove the ribs and seeds completely for mild salsa, halfway for medium, or not at all for hot. Step 5: Remove some of the blackened charred skin from the tomatoes. Step 6: Put all the cooled veggies in the food processor and blend. Step 7: Combine with the rest of the ingredients and chill Flavors will develop and salsa will be ready to serve within a few hours.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, sour cream, avocados, cheddar cheese, mild taco sauce, jalapeno sauce, black olives, scallion, tomatoes, onion, chili powder, garlic powder, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Spread beans evenly on the bottom of a baking dish or casserole. Step 2: Mash avocados with chili powder, onion, pepper and garlic. Step 3: Spread avocado mixture over the beans Next, layer the sour cream over the first two layers. Step 4: Mix together the taco sauce, cheese, jalapeo sauce, olives, scallions, and tomatoes. Step 5: Spread over the sour cream layer. Step 6: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: tortilla chips, mexican blend cheese, canned black beans, canned chicken, salsa, sour cream, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Line 8 inch round cake pan with tin foil, if desired. Step 3: Spread tortilla chips evenly in cake pan Some overlap is fine. Step 4: Sprinkle cheese over the chips, making sure all the chips have some cheese on them. Step 5: Sprinkle salsa over the cheese. Step 6: Pour black beans and chicken over the salsa and cheese. Step 7: Bake for about 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. Step 8: Serve in the cake pan. Step 9: Serve with sour cream and guacamole, if desired.

Ingredient Names: avocados, tomatoes, salt, garlic, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and mash avocados until lumpy Add remaining ingredients and chill for 1 - 2 hours.

Ingredient Names: monterey jack cheese, shredded cheddar cheese, green chilies, eggs, milk, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Place half the cheeses in a greased 8 inch baking pan. Step 2: Sprinkle with chilies and remaining cheeses. Step 3: In a bowl beat the eggs add the milk and flour, pour over cheese. Step 4: Bake at 375 for 30 minutes cut into small squares.

Ingredient Names: black beans, white shoepeg corn, cilantro, green pepper, purple onion, tomatoes, jalapeno, canola oil, salt, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Drain & rinse corn & beans, add cilantro, green pepper onion, tomatoes & jalapeno, blend well. Step 2: Drizzle the oil and lime juice over top, then add spices, stir. Step 3: Refrigerate 2-4 hours or overnight. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, black beans, tomato sauce, chili powder, dried onion, salt, cheddar cheese, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, jalapenos, avocado, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 400 degrees Lay the tortilla on 2 baking sheets Spray lightly with non-stick cooking spray. Step 2: Place in oven for 5 minutes or until they just start to get crispy. Step 3: Heat the tomato sauce, chili powder, salt and dried onion in a sauce pan and let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 4: Rinse the beans and add to the sauce, mash the beans slightly to thicken the sauce. Step 5: Allow to cool while you prepare the toppings. Step 6: Top each tortilla with the sauce and beans, leaving about 1 / 2 inch around the edge of the tortilla Each one will take about 1 / 4-1 / 3 cups. Step 7: Top with the cheese and back for 8 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crisp around the edges.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, yellow onion, scallions, pickled jalapeno pepper, tomato sauce, limes, salt, ground black pepper, fresh garlic, cayenne pepper, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in large bowl, refrigerate to allow flavors to marry for 1 hour Alter salt, garlic, jalapenos and cayenne to taste I tend to make it mild for all of the whimps i have to cook for 5 minutes, but i love it spicy! Step 2: If available in your area, enjoy this salsa with tostito chile& lime tortilla chips!

Ingredient Names: bell peppers, jalapeno peppers, serrano pepper, garlic cloves, cilantro, green chili peppers, tomatillos, condensed cream of chicken soup, american cheese, chicken stock, flour
Instructions: Step 1: Seed and dice peppers, garlic, and cilantro. Step 2: Saute peppers and garlic in pot with a splash of chicken stock. Step 3: Add soup, cilantro, green chilies, and tomatillos to the pot, cook until warm. Step 4: Pour into blender and blend until smooth Move mixture back to the pot and add cheese. Step 5: Cook until cheese melted through. Step 6: Serve warm For thicker boom boom: Sift 1-2t flour into blender with sauce.

Dish Name: Border Town Refried Beans Or Bean Dip
Ingredient Names: fat-free refried beans, monterey jack cheese, beer, butter, onion, garlic clove, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan Over medium heat, stir until the beans are heated through, about 5-10 minutes For dip, transfer beans to a fondue pot to keep warm. Step 2: Serve with tostitos.

Dish Name: Boudro's Famous Guacamole Riverwalk San Antonio
Ingredient Names: orange, limes, avocados, roma tomato, serrano peppers, red onions, fresh cilantro, sea salt, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Squeeze juice of orange and lime into bowl Scoop avocado from skin, add to bowl and coarsely chop. Step 2: Add tomato, peppers, onion, garlic, and cilantro, and fold into avocado mixture. Step 3: Add salt to taste Result should be crudely chopped, not mashed.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, white onion, garlic-flavored olive oil, hot pepper, lime, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: With the 6 roma tomatoes- cut them up in small chunks. Step 2: Mix all remaining ingredients together in a bowl, it gets more flavor to it as it sits in the frig covered You can add the above ingredients to cut up shrimp, or shrimp and cocktail sauce You can, also, omit the lime, if you choose It's still yummy!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: refried beans, taco seasoning, sour cream, mayonnaise, avocados, lemon juice, garlic, cheese, tomatoes, spring onions, corn chips
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the re-fried beans with half the packet of seasoning. Step 2: Mix the sour cream with the mayonnaise and the remaining seasoning. Step 3: Mix the avocados with the lemon juice and the garlic. Step 4: Layer in a large lasagne dish, firstly, the bean mixture, followed by the sour cream mixture, the avocado mixture, followed by the cheese, the tomatoes and finally the spring onions. Step 5: Serve with the corn chips.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, brown sugar, tequila, molasses, salt, pepper, garlic cloves, water, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork cubes in single layer in 10-inch skillet. Step 2: Top with remaining ingredients except green onion, heat to boiling, reduce heat. Step 3: Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally until the water has evaproated and the pork is slightly caramelized, about 35 minutes. Step 4: Sprinkle with green onion and serve with wooden picks.

Ingredient Names: dried anaheim chiles, shortening, flour, garlic, dried oregano, water, pork
Instructions: Step 1: Most recipes tell you to remove the seeds Don't! Step 2: Melt the shortening and stir in the flour. Step 3: Heat until browned Don't let it burn Crumble the chiles finely. Step 4: Toss them in the pot. Step 5: Add the garlic and oregano. Step 6: Stir Slowly stir in the water, and heat.

Ingredient Names: carrots, ice cube, pickled jalapeno peppers, onions, oil, white vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place carrots in large bowl and cover with hot water and let stand about 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain and plunge into cold water. Step 3: Add about a dozen ice cubes, and let stand 15 to 20 minutes. Step 4: Combine jalapenos with onions, oil, vinegar, and salt. Step 5: Drain carrots well and add to pepper mixture. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate at least 6 to 8 hours before serving.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, cream cheese, lettuce, diced tomato, cheddar cheese, taco seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Allow cream cheese to warm and soften. Step 2: Mix sour cream, cream cheese and taco seasoning in a bowl, mix until smooth. Step 3: Spread the mixture evenly across a 14" or 16" platter, or a cookie sheet works well for this, too. Step 4: Sprinkle lettuce and tomatoes evenly on top of the mixture. Step 5: Sprinkle the cheddar cheese on top of that. Step 6: Serve with your favorite taco chips.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, picante sauce, reduced-fat monterey jack cheese, light sour cream, cream cheese, chili powder, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients Put into crock pot and cook on high for 2 hours or until heated through, stirring once or twice Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, red onion, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro, salt, black pepper, california avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler Broil tomatillos in a flameproof shallow baking pan about 4 inches from heat until tops are charred, 7 to 10 minutes. Step 2: Turn tomatillos over with tongs and broil until charred, about 5 minutes more. Step 3: Combine onion, chiles, cilantro, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Step 4: Add tomatillos 2 at a time, mashing with a fork or pestle to form a coarse paste Pit and peel avocados. Step 5: Add avocados to mixture and continue mashing until incorporated but still chunky.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, button mushroom, jalapeno, fresh cilantro leaves, salt, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet, heat the 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the mushrooms and chiles, stir well, and cover Continue to stir every minute or so, replacing the cover each time, until the mushrooms have released a lot of juice, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Uncover, and let briskly simmer until all the liquid has evaporated, about 3 minutes. Step 4: Taste and season with salt, usually about 1 / 4 teaspoon, add the cilantro. Step 5: Heat a well-seasoned or nonstick griddle or heavy skillet over medium heat. Step 6: Turn the oven on to its lowest setting One by one, make the quesadillas: lightly brush 1 side of each tortilla with oil, then lay it oiled side down on the hot griddle. Step 7: Spread with about 1 / 4 cup of the cheese, leaving a 1 / 4-inch border all around.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, low-fat cheddar cheese, diced green chilies, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Place tortillas on cookie sheet and sprinkle each tortilla with grated cheese and chilies. Step 3: Bake for 2 minutes, or until cheese bubbles. Step 4: Remove to serving platter and sprinkle with diced tomato. Step 5: Serve with salsa and fat free sour cream.

Dish Name: Cheesiest Fried Chicken Empanadas With Queso Dip
Ingredient Names: chicken, cheese, cream cheese, red bell pepper, jalapeno, ground cumin, salt, ground black pepper, refrigerated pie crusts, water, velveeta cheese, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat vegetable oil in a deep-fryer to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a large bowl using a rubber spatula, combine the chicken, colby and monterey cheese, cream cheese, red pepper, jalapeno, cumin, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Remove 1 pie crust from pie tin onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a 15-inch circle. Step 4: Cut out rounds, using a 3-inch cookie cutter Re-roll dough as needed. Step 5: Repeat procedure with remaining pie crusts, making 12 to 15 circles total. Step 6: Arrange 1 round on a clean, flat surface. Step 7: Using a pastry brush, lightly brush the edges of crust with water. Step 8: Place 1 heaping teaspoon of chicken mixture in the center of the round. Step 9: Fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges with a fork to seal.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, colby-monterey jack cheese, sour cream, cinnamon sugar, apple, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Spread each flour tortillas with 1 tablespoon sour cream. Step 2: Sprinkle with 1 teaspoons cinnamon sugar. Step 3: Top one tortilla 1 / 3 cup cheese, 1 / 4 cup chopped apple and second tortilla For each serving, melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet, brown quesadilla 1 minute on each side or until lightly browned, carefully turning over tortilla, cut into wedges. Step 4: Serve with sour cream, if desired.

Ingredient Names: beans, green chilies, salsa, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour beans into the blender with a 1 / 4 cup salsa blend till smooth. Step 2: Place into a microwave safe bowl with chilies, rest of the salsa and cheese. Step 3: Mix to blend then microwave for 3 minutes mix till smooth and gooey. Step 4: Serve with chips of vegies.

Ingredient Names: bacon, garlic cloves, green onion, black beans, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, picante sauce, dried oregano, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, cilantro, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Step 2: Remove bacon from pan, crumble, and set aside If there is more than about 1 tablespoon of grease in the pan, drain off some of the excess. Step 3: Saute garlic and onions in bacon drippings for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add beans, cheese, picante sauce, oregano, cumin, and cayenne to pan, and mix well. Step 5: Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted, stir in bacon. Step 6: Transfer to a serving bowl, garnish if desired and serve with chips or vegetables.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, serranos, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, green onions, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f. Step 2: Remove chorizo from skins and cook in a skillet until no longer pink, add the serranos, and continue cooking until well browned and a bit caramelized. Step 3: Sprinkle chorizo over tops of tortillas, leaving a 1 / 8 inch free around the edge. Step 4: Cover with cheeses, you may certainly add more-i do, sprinkle with green onions, and bell pepper slices. Step 5: Bake until cheese is golden and the edges are slightly browned, about ten to fifteen minutes, depending on oven, etc. Step 6: Serve topped with salsa, sour cream, and guacamole.

Ingredient Names: fresh jalapenos, cream cheese, mexican blend cheese, garlic, shortcut bacon, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: After cutting the jalepenos in half and seeding them, set them aside. Step 3: Place cream cheese in a bowl. Step 4: Add the garlic and shredded cheese. Step 5: Combine mixture until thouroughly mixed. Step 6: Place about 2 spoonfuls of cheese mixture into each half of jalepeno, then wrap each half with a piece of bacon and place on a greased cookie sheet. Step 7: Cook for about 15-20 minutes, or until jalepenos are tender.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, bermuda onion, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, jalapeno peppers, lime, seasoning salt, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: One jalapeno seeds and veins removed will be fairly mild 2 with seeds and veins, will be medium Substituing serrano peppers will increase the heat since the serrano chili is about 3 times hotter than a jalapeno The lime should be peeled like an orange You will be using the pulp and seeds in a food processor, mix the chili peppers, garlic, lime, and some of the juice from the canned tomatoes. Step 2: Blend until your mixture is almost pureed. Step 3: Chop the tomatoes and onions fine The roma tomatoes are used because they are nice and firm, the sweet onions are used because they add sweetness without sugar The mexican style canned tomatoes are used because they have the correct seasoning in them already. Step 4: Chop the cilantro as finely as you can.

Ingredient Names: processed cheese, granulated garlic, diced green chilies, jalapeno, green pepper, red peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Cut processed cheese into pieces no more than 1 inch thick. Step 2: Spread cheese pieces evenly in the bottom of a microwavable dish large enough for all ingredients. Step 3: Spread all remaining ingredients evenly over the top of the processed cheese. Step 4: Cover with a microwavable plastic lid and microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir. Step 5: Repeat the microwaving process and stirring process until melted and heated to a temperature of 150f. Step 6: Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: green onions, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, tabasco sauce, stewed tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cut up stewed tomatoes and combine in saucepan with onions, fresh tomato, salt and pepper. Step 2: Bring just to a boil. Step 3: Boil hard 1 min And remove from heat. Step 4: Put half of mixture through blender just to mince fine, but not to puree. Step 5: Return to remaining half of mixture. Step 6: Cool and refrigerate in tightly covered container Use within a few weeks Freezes well up to 6 months.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, barbecue sauce, onion, flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the chicken, barbecue sauce, and onion together in a small saucepan until warmed through. Step 2: Meanwhile, have your kids use 2 1 / 2- or 3-inch cookie cutters to cut the tortillas into pairs of matching shapes. Step 3: Place one of each pair of shapes on your work surface and sprinkle cheese on them. Step 4: Add a tablespoon of the chicken mixture and a little more cheese, then top with the matching tortilla shapes Right before serving, place the assembled tortillas, a few at a time, on a warmed griddle and cook over moderate heat for 2 minutes on each side As you cook them, transfer the tortillas to a baking sheet kept in a warm oven until the whole batch is done, serve at once.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, mexican blend cheese, chicken, green chilies, butter, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Top one half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken and green chilies. Step 2: Fold other half over filling. Step 3: Press down with back of pancake turner Lightly brush melted butter on both sides of each filled tortilla. Step 4: Heat 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 5: Cook 2 filled tortillas at a time 3 to 4 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and hot, cut into wedges, serve with salsa.

Ingredient Names: picante sauce, cooked chicken, onion, cumin, dried oregano, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper, flour tortillas, mexican blend cheese, vegetable oil, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Prepare a greased baking sheet. Step 3: In a large saucepan or dutch oven combine the picante sauce with chopped chicken, onion, cumin, oregano and cayenne cook uncovered stirring often for about 30 minutes or until some of liquid has evaporated. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Spoon about 1 / 3 cup of the mixture below center of each tortilla, then top with about 3 tablespoons of shredded cheese. Step 6: Fold in two sides of the tortillas to enclose the filling, then fold over top and bottom edges of the tortillas Secure with wooden picks. Step 7: Place folded-side down on a greased baking sheet Lightly brush the tops with vegetable oil. Step 8: Bake for about 8-10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: puff pastry, boneless chicken breasts, monterey jack pepper cheese, onion, celery, garlic, mild green chilies, corn tortilla chips, chicken broth, ground cumin, chili powder, oil, salt and pepper, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat about 2 tablespoons of oil in a large saute pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Season the chicken breasts lightly with salt and pepper, add them to the pan, and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Step 3: Remove the chicken to the cutting board to cool. Step 4: Meanwhile, add the onions, celery and spices to the oil that remains in the pan. Step 5: Add a little more oil if necessary. Step 6: Saute until the onions are soft. Step 7: Add the garlic and cook until just starting to brown. Step 8: Add the chilies and chicken stock to stop the browning process and to collect the browned bits of flavor off the bottom of the pan, scraping the pan with a wooden spoon As this is coming up to a boil, dice the chicken breast into a small dice and return the chicken to the pan. Step 9: Add the crushed tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, taco seasoning, cooked chicken, taco sauce, cheddar cheese, canned jalapeno slices, tomatoes, sliced ripe olives
Instructions: Step 1: Cream taco seasoning and cream cheese together. Step 2: Spread in a 9-by-13-inch baking dish, top with chicken. Step 3: Cover chicken with coating of taco sauce and jalepenos. Step 4: Cover with shredded cheese. Step 5: Place in 350-degree oven for about 20 minutes, until cheese is bubbly and mixture is warmed through. Step 6: Garnish with chopped tomatoes, more jalapenos if you're daring, and olives.

Ingredient Names: carrots, onions, garlic cloves, fresh oregano, pickled jalapeno peppers, olive oil, white wine vinegar, black pepper, bay leaves, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot of boiling water, blanch the sliced carrots for 30 seconds, drain. Step 2: In a bowl, mix all of the ingredients with the hot carrots. Step 3: Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving Keeps refrigerated for 6 days.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic cloves, serrano peppers, jalapeno peppers, butter, flour, milk, cheese, plum tomatoes, sour cream, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a saucepan on medium-low heat, and then cook the onions and peppers for about five minutes or until onions are translucent 2. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook for another minute 3. Step 3: Whisk the flour into the butter, vegetable mix and cook for about 30 seconds 4. Step 4: Add the milk to the pot, and cook on medium, whisking constantly until sauce is thick, about five minutes. Step 5: Stir in the tomatoes 5.

Dish Name: Chile Con Queso Chile Cheese Dip
Ingredient Names: onion, butter, tomatoes, green chili peppers, salt, cheddar cheese, milk, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet, cook onion in butter until tender but not brown. Step 2: Stir in tomatoes, chili peppers and salt. Step 3: Simmer, uncovered for 10 minutes. Step 4: Add cheese a little at a time, stirring until cheese melts. Step 5: Stir in a little milk if mixture becomes too thick. Step 6: Serve immediately with chips. Step 7: Keep warm in a fondue pot over low heat.

Ingredient Names: poblano peppers, vegetable oil, white onion, cayenne, all-purpose flour, tomatoes, cream, extra-sharp cheddar cheese, monterey jack pepper cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Roast peppers by placing them on open gas flame, turning frequently with tongs until all sides are charredblack, about 7-10 minutes Can also roast peppers under broiler or on the grill. Step 2: Place blackened peppers in a plasic or paper bag, and let rest until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes Peel peppers, split in half lengthwise, and discard all seeds and stems Finely chop and set aside In large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add onions and cayenne and cook, stirring, until very soft, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Add flour and stir until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add tomatoes and chopped chilies. Step 6: Cook for 1 minute.

Dish Name: Chile Con Queso For The Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: velveeta cheese, cream of chicken soup, rotel tomatoes & chilies, ground beef, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Cube cheese, put cheese into crock-pot w / 2 cans of soup and 2 cans of tomatoes. Step 2: Heat on low to melt cheese Brown meat, add meat to cheese mixture. Step 3: Cover and cook on low to keep warm. Step 4: Serve w / tortilla chips.

Dish Name: Chile Con Queso Melted Cheese Dip
Ingredient Names: tortilla chips, salad oil, onion, diced green chilies, heavy cream, cheddar cheese, green bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In a 3-4 quart pan, combine oil and onion. Step 2: Cook, stirring, over medium heat until onion is soft. Step 3: Add chilies and cream. Step 4: Cook, stirring, until hot. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and add cheese, stirring until melted. Step 6: Pour into a chafing or fondue dish over a low flame or into a dish on an electric warming tray Offer with bell pepper strips and tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: asadero cheese, jalapenos, half-and-half cream, onion, cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat ingredients over low heat, stirring constantly until the cheese is melted Serve warm Asadero cheese is a white mexican cheese and is made by cacique.

Ingredient Names: chilies, tomatillo, garlic clove, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Take the moritas and cook them in a hot dry cast-iron skillet until they inflate and start to pop a little Into the cast-iron skillet, pour water over the chiles, turn off the heat, and allow them to soften and become plumper, which will take about half an hour. Step 2: Meanwhile, stir the whole tomatillos in another skillet until they blister and black spots appear Immediately transfer them to a blender. Step 3: Place the garlic, moritas and a pinch of salt in the blender, and puree until smooth It will be a deep red color with lots of seeds.

Dish Name: Chiles Con Queso Chilies In Cheese Sauce
Ingredient Names: serrano chilies, vegetable oil, red onion, monterey jack cheese, creme fraiche, heavy cream, tomatoes, tequila
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chilies in a dry frying pan over a medium heat until all the skin blisters and darkens Be careful not to allow the chili flesh to burn. Step 2: Place the chilies in a polythene bag for 20 minutes, and then remove the skins and seeds. Step 3: Cut the chilies into thin strips and then cut the strips in half to make short strips. Step 4: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion until it is beginning to soften. Step 5: Add the cheese, creme fraiche and cream and continue heating over a low heat until the cheese melts. Step 6: Add the chilies and stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth Dice the tomatoes into 1 / 2in pieces. Step 7: Stir into the sauce, and then pour into a serving dish Just before serving, stir in the tequila and mix well.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, canola oil, avocado, red onions, salsa, lime, bacon, salt and pepper, chili, cheddar cheese, jalapeno pepper, whole tomato, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees For the chips: cut each tortilla into quarters. Step 2: Heat the oil in a skillet on medium heat The oil should be about 1 / 2 inch deep in the skillet. Step 3: Place about 8 to 10 of the tortilla quarters in the hot oil at a time. Step 4: Turn the tortilla chips as they cook so each side is golden brown. Step 5: When the chips are golden brown on both sides, remove them from the skillet and lay them on a plate over a paper towel to absorb the excess oil. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Step 7: Set aside For the bacon guacamole: in a small bowl, add the avocado, 1 tablespoon of the red onions, 1 tablespoon salsa, 1 tablespoon of the crumbled bacon and the juice from 1 quarter of the lime.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, cheddar cheese, green chilies, picante sauce, chili powder, garlic salt, onion powder, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
Instructions: Step 1: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese. Step 2: Add the cheddar cheese, chilies, picante sauce, chili powder, garlic salt and onion powder Separate each tube of crescent roll dough into four rectangles. Step 3: Press perforations to seal. Step 4: Spread about 1 / 4 cup cheese mixture over each rectangle. Step 5: Roll up jelly-roll style, starting with a short side. Step 6: Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour. Step 7: Cut each roll into eight slices. Step 8: Place on ungreased baking sheets. Step 9: Sprinkle with additional chili powder, if desired.

Dish Name: Chili Con Queso Dip Or Enchilada Sauce
Ingredient Names: velveeta cheese, mild cheddar cheese, chunky salsa, chili, sour cream, chili powder, garlic powder, louisiana hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy saucepan over low heat melt the velveeta and mild cheddar cheese. Step 2: Stir until completely melted and combined. Step 3: When the cheese has melted add in the salsa, chili, sour cream, chili powder, garlic and hot pepper sauce. Step 4: Cook over low heat for about 8-10 minutes, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, sour cream, chipotle chiles in adobo, lime, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mayonnaise, sour cream, peppers, and lime juice in a blender and process to a puree. Step 2: Refrigerate the mayo for 1 / 2 hour to let the flavors to blend. Step 3: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese, chili
Instructions: Step 1: On a platter, arrange sort of a single layer of tortilla chips With a spoon, drop pieces of chili all over the tortillas. Step 2: Sprinkle with some of the cheese. Step 3: Then put another layer of chips, chili, and cheese until all are used. Step 4: Put in the microwave for a couple of minutes to melt the cheese and make everything hot. Step 5: Put the platter on the table and let everyone dig inches.

Ingredient Names: avocados, pico de gallo, corn, jalapeno, lime juice, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Husk and wash corn, then deep fry for 1 minute. Step 2: Wash jalapeno and deep fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Place corn on the cob and jalapeno on gas grill and cook until slightly blackened on each side. Step 4: Remove corn kernels from cob and measure out 1 cup of kernels Finely chop jalapeno after removing stem. Step 5: In a large bowl, mash the avocados. Step 6: Mix in pico de gallo, fire-grilled corn kernels, jalapenos, lime juice, cilantro, and salt. Step 7: Serve with tortilla chips and salsa Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, hormel chili without beans, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spread cream cheese on bottom of casserole dish Top with chili Sprinkle cheddar over chili Bake or broil until cheddar cheese melts Serve with taco chips.

Dish Name: Chilis Copycat Skillet Queso By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: velveeta cheese, no-bean chili, milk, paprika, ground cumin, ground cayenne pepper, chili powder, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the velveeta into one inch cubes and place in medium saucepan over medium heat Combine remaining ingredients Stir frequently until cheese melts.

Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, butter, oil, bacon, onion, minced garlic cloves, cumin, basil, chili powder, tomato paste, wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and oil in a large frypan and lightly fry bacon, onion and garlic. Step 2: Add cumin, basil and chilli powder and cook gently for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add beans and mash. Step 4: Cook over a low heat stirring often. Step 5: Add tomato paste and vinegar and continue to cook until bubbling. Step 6: Serve Optional:transfer to oven safe serving dish and put some grated cheese on top and heat till cheese is melted before serving.

Dish Name: Chiltomate Cooked Tomato And Chile Salsa
Ingredient Names: habanero peppers, white onion, firm ripe tomatoes, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, oregano, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a griddle or a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat Roast the vegetables and the garlic on the griddle for 6 to 8 minutes, turning them with tongs to brown all sides Peel the chile and discard the skin and seeds Peel and dice the onion, tomatoes and garlic. Step 2: Place the roasted ingredients and dried oregano in a mortar, blender or food processor, and grind or chop to the desired consistency Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the salsa and saut for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the fresh oregano and cilantro, and season to taste with salt. Step 5: Serve warm or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: toasted sesame oil, ginger, ground lean pork, chili-garlic sauce, hoisin sauce, toasted sesame seeds, corn tortilla chips, muenster cheese, napa cabbage leaves, rice vinegar, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Make the firecracker pork: heat the sesame oil over medium heat in a large saute pan or wok. Step 2: Stir-fry the ginger until it starts to soften, approximately one minute. Step 3: Raise the heat to high Break up the ground pork into chunks and place in pan. Step 4: Stir in chili garlic sauce and the hoisin sauce Continue to cook, stirring and breaking up the pork. Step 5: Add the sesame seeds. Step 6: Cook until the pork is dry on the outer surface and the juices have started to evaporate, so the chips dont get soggy. Step 7: Preheat the oven to 475f Assemble the nachos: arrange the tortilla chips on a 12-by-18-inch baking sheet or ovenproof platter.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, diced tomatoes with green chilies, chipotle chiles in adobo
Instructions: Step 1: Dice chipotle peppers in blender Mix in adobo sause other ingred Blend till smooth.

Ingredient Names: eggs, mayonnaise, canned chipotle chiles, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Peel eggs and cut in half lengthwise. Step 2: Spoon yolks into small bowl. Step 3: Arrange whites on platter Finely grate yolks on small holes of box grater into medium bowl. Step 4: Mix in mayonnaise, then 2 teaspoon chipotle chiles. Step 5: Add more chopped chiles, if desired, for more heat. Step 6: Season filling to taste with salt, if desired. Step 7: Using pastry bag fitted with 1 / 2 inch diameter star. Step 8: Cover and chill eggs at least 2 hours and up to 1 day. Step 9: Press 1 cilantro leaf into filling in each egg and serve.

Ingredient Names: white onions, lime juice, chipotle chile in adobo, coarse salt, avocados, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl or molcajete, combine 2 tablespoons of the minced onion, lime juice, chiles and salt Smash with fork or pestle to a coarse paste. Step 2: Cut avocados in half, remove seeds and scoop pulp into bowl or molcajete. Step 3: Add the cilantro and mash, leaving some lumps. Step 4: Taste and adjust the salt if necessary. Step 5: Sprinkle with additional cilantro and the reserved 1 tablespoon minced onion. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: ground chipotle chile pepper, sugar, coarse salt, whole almonds, almond oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preparation: Stir together ground chipotle, sugar and salt in a small bowl, and set aside. Step 2: Heat almonds and almond oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat, stirring and shaking the pan occasionally, until the almond skins are popping and almonds are fragrant. Step 3: Turn down heat to medium-low and stir in chipotle mixture. Step 4: Heat and shake skillet for about 30 seconds, to release chipotle's oils Move to a bowl and let cool just slightly before serving warm.

Ingredient Names: roma tomatoes, sweet peppers, onions, garlic cloves, hot pepper, chipotle pepper, cider vinegar, salt, sugar, paprika, tomato paste, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Blanch the tomatoes, remove the skin, and then chop Measure 8 cups. Step 2: Mix all ingredients except the cilantro in a large pot and simmer until desired thickness is reached, approximately 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours Ad the cilantro just before you are ready to pour into jars. Step 3: Fill into hot, sterilized pint jars and top with hot, sterilized canning lids I do not process in a canner and have never had a problem, but you may process in a hot-water-bath canner at this point for 20 minutes if you are concerned about food safety If you buy a half-bushel of tomatoes and adjust the rest of the ingredients accordingly you get about 6 batches and 36 pints.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, onion, fresh cilantro, chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic cloves, salt, cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, puree the tomatoes with the rest of the ingredients Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve Technique.

Ingredient Names: plain yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, salt, lime, chipotle chile, guajillo chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in blender until smooth. Step 2: Serve with grilled seafood or make seafood taco with grilled seafood, chopped lettuce, cilantro and some of the chipotle sauce.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, mexican cheese, oil, corn tortilla, guacamole, salsa, queso blanco
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the chorizo in oil until completely "browned" and very crispy. Step 2: Keep the chorizo on heat that's just high enough to keep it hot. Step 3: Heat another pan over medium heat. Step 4: When the pan is hot, place a corn tortilla in the bottom for about 15-30 seconds and then flip it and repeat this with the opposite side. Step 5: Cut a reasonable piece of mexican cheese and place on one half of the tortilla in the hot pan. Step 6: When it starts to melt, spoon about a tablespoon of chorizo onto the melting cheese, fold the tortilla in half and immediately remove the taco from the heat. Step 7: Stuff a little guacamole, salsa, queso blanco, sour cream or whatever you prefer in the tortilla to keep it company and immediately eat These are good hot -- so don't bother making a bunch ahead This is the kind of food you cook for people standing around in the kitchen so they can eat it fresh.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onion, chorizo sausage, manchego cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the onions, lightly brush them with the teaspoon of olive oil. Step 2: Cook on a grill pan or indoor grill for one or two minutes until the onions have started getting a little soft and have a few grill marks. Step 3: Remove from grill and break slices into rings To prepare the chorizo, place a skillet over medium high heat until hot, not smoking. Step 4: Add the chorizo and cook about 1 minute on each side. Step 5: Drain the sausage on a paper towel to remove the excess grease To assemble the quesadilla, start the tortilla that will become the bottom. Step 6: Top with a tenth of the cheese. Step 7: Sprinkle with 1 / 5 of the onions, then the sausage. Step 8: Cover that with another tenth of the cheese and top with another tortilla.

Ingredient Names: portabella mushroom caps, chorizo sausage, cheddar cheese, green onion, red wine
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the chorizo, green onions, and cheddar cheese. Step 2: Stuff mushroom caps with the mixture evenly, place in a greased baking dish with the red wine. Step 3: Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 20-25 minutes or until sausage is cooked through and mushrooms are softened.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausages, potato, chipotle chiles in adobo, salt, monterey jack cheese, flour tortillas, butter, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Remove skin from sausages and crumble into small skillet. Step 2: Cook over low heat until fat renders, taking care to avoid burning--about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain off all but 3 tablespoons fat. Step 4: Add potatoes, chiles and salt. Step 5: Cook over medium heat, stirring from time to time, until potatoes begin to brown--about 8 minutes. Step 6: Brush one side of tortilla sparingly with butter. Step 7: Place on medium-hot flat griddle pan. Step 8: Spread with about 1 / 4 cup of filling and sprinkle with 2-3 tablespoons of cheese. Step 9: Top with second tortilla. Step 10: Brush top with butter.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, mexican blend cheese, chive & onion cream cheese, milk, diced tomato, green onion, jalapeno pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove casing from chorizo. Step 2: Heat skillet over medium-high heat Crumble chorizo into skillet. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently and using a spoon to break up lumps, until sausage is well-browned, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove sausage to paper towels to drain. Step 5: In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine mexican cheese, cream cheese and milk Microwave at medium stirring every minute until melted and hot, 6 to 8 minutes Alternatively, you can prepare in the top of a double boiler over simmering water, stirring constantly, but melting time may differ. Step 6: Stir in chorizo, tomato, green onion and jalapeno. Step 7: Place in fondue pot or slow cooker to keep warm.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, chunky salsa, mild cheddar cheese, flour tortillas, guacamole, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a large skillet, saute the sausage over medium heat until browned - about 6 minutes. Step 3: Drain 1 / 4 cup of oil from the cooked sausage. Step 4: Set sausage aside to cool. Step 5: Stir salsa and cheese into the skillet of sausage, mix well. Step 6: Place a tortilla on a work surface and spoon 1 / 4 cup of the sausage mixture down the center. Step 7: Fold tortilla in half, then roll up Secure with toothpicks. Step 8: Place on foil-lined cookie sheet. Step 9: Repeat until all sausage / tortillas are gone.

Ingredient Names: avocados, onion, tomatoes, cilantro, salt
