Instructions: Step 1: Scrape out the avocado from skin Smash w / fork til you have a chunky paste. Step 2: Add onions and mix well. Step 3: Add tomatos and salt. Step 4: Finally add the cilantro. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, milk, hidden valley ranch dressing mix, green chilies, pickled jalapeno pepper, cilantro, salt, garlic powder, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix mayo, milk and ranch mix. Step 2: Let stand for at least an hour. Step 3: Chop chilies, jalapenos, and cilantro together. Step 4: Mix in salt, garlic powder, and lime. Step 5: Add chile mixture to ranch. Step 6: Serve with tortilla chips The longer it sits, the hotter it gets.

Dish Name: Chuy's Jalapeno Ranch Dip The Real Deal
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, buttermilk, jalapeno, green tomatillo sauce, cilantro, dry ranch dressing mix
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 5 ingredients in a blender until smooth Stir in ranch mix with a whisk Chill and serve.

Ingredient Names: avocado, white onion, lime, tomatoes, cilantro leaf, jalapenos, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, seed and mash the avocado in a bowl. Step 2: Add all the other ingredients. Step 3: Serve right away, or refrigerate for a few hours after sprinking with some extra lime juice, then pressing plastic wrap onto the surface. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sour cream and cilantro. Step 2: Add a good squeeze of your lime and stir it up Done. Step 3: Add a dollup to tacos, grilled chicken, fajitas, omelettes, burgers Or serve with chips as a dip.

Dish Name: Cindy's Black Bean And Corn Salsa
Ingredient Names: black beans, corn, salsa, ground cumin, lime juice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together -- chill -- serve with your favorite taco chips.

Ingredient Names: butter, seasoning salt, garlic powder, hot pepper sauce, mixed nuts, worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 300. Step 2: Melt butter with salt, garlic powder and pepper sauce. Step 3: Mix well- add nuts, toss to coat. Step 4: In a jelly roll pan, bake for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce and bake 15 minutes longer.

Ingredient Names: fresh coconut, lemon juice, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: After getting off the shell of a coconut, break it into pieces Sprinkle lemon juice on each piece Sprinkle chile powder on each piece Serve Good chilled.

Dish Name: Company's In The Driveway Shrimp And Avocado Salsa
Ingredient Names: salsa, onion, avocado, baby shrimp, lime juice, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Place shrimp in strainer and run under cold water until thawed, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Meanwhile, dice onion and avocado In medium bowl place salsa, onion, avocado and shrimp. Step 3: Squeeze lime juice over all. Step 4: Stir gently to combine. Step 5: Serve immediately with tortilla chips, if desired.

Dish Name: Contest Winner Blender Tomato Or Mango Salsa
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, sweet onion, jalapeno pepper, serrano pepper, garlic cloves, sea salt, fresh lime juice, whole canned tomatoes, liquid smoke, cumin, chili powder, black pepper, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Add ingredients, in the order listed, to your blender Pulse to desired consistency Mango salsa - substitute fresh ripe mango for the tomato and red onion for the sweet onion I serve this with puerco pibil, jerk chicken and carribean black beans I don't use the optional seasonings for mango salsa and sometimes add orange juice with the lime juice.

Ingredient Names: ranch dressing, green chili, jalapeno, fresh cilantro leaves, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Pulse all ingredients in a blender in batches until smooth Chill and use as needed.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, red onions, tomato paste, water, garlic powder, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, salt, sugar, jalapeno peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Place tomatoes, onions, tomato paste, water, garlic powder, cilantro, cumin, salt and sugar in a blender or food processor. Step 2: Puree until smooth. Step 3: Add remaining measure of tomatoes and mix till blended. Step 4: Add optional jalepeno peppers to taste.

Ingredient Names: whole kernel corn, green pepper, red bell pepper, red onion, tomatoes, ripe olives, pickled jalapeno peppers, pickled jalapeno pepper juice, cider, garlic salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl Cover and chill for several hours.

Ingredient Names: corn, jalapenos, red onion, fresh cilantro, limes, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine all ingredient and mix well Adjust salt and pepper, lime and jalapenos to your desired taste.

Ingredient Names: fresh cranberries, orange rind, pecans, chipotle chile in adobo, fresh cilantro, cream cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Put the cranberries, orange peel, and nuts in a food processor and pulse rapidly four or five times until coarsely chopped. Step 2: Add the chipotle, cilantro, and cream cheese and blend until smooth. Step 3: Spoon into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 4: Serve with good crackers, french bread, or mexican pan tostado.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, rotel tomatoes, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Cut blocks of cream cheese into cubes and put in small crock pot. Step 2: Pour can of rotel over cream cheese. Step 3: Set crock pot to low and heat through. Step 4: Stir often, it will burn. Step 5: Once the cream cheese is really soft stir well I use a whisk or hand blender to get the ingredients to combine better You don't want it to be lumpy This dip will stay in the crockpot for just a couple of hours before it will start to burn and just turn gross. Step 6: Make sure you turn the crockpot off after about 2 hours. Step 7: Serve with tortilla chips!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, flour tortillas, green onions, marjoram, savory, parsley, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, chili powder, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Soften cream cheese, slice up your green onions and add your herbs -- i taste as i go and there are many combinations but this has been my favorite. Step 2: Blend well and put your tortillas on a flat surface. Step 3: Spread cream cheese mixture to edges and roll up If you use the 6 inch tortillas it makes about 6 or 7 rolls depending on how thick you spread the cheese. Step 4: Put in the refrigerator covered with saran wrap. Step 5: Let them chill back until they are firm. Step 6: Then remove and cut in 3 / 4 inch slices. Step 7: Arrange on a dish with toothpicks and have your salsa in the center to dip!, delicious!

Dish Name: Creamy Avocado With Bacon Dip Guacamole
Ingredient Names: avocado, garlic clove, lemon juice, sour cream, onion powder, hot sauce, bacon, cucumber, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Pit, peel, and mash the avocado with a fork. Step 2: Blend in the lemon juice, blending well and then add the sour cream, blending well. Step 3: Mix in all the rest of the ingredients, blending well. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro, cover and chill.

Ingredient Names: black beans, lime juice, mild salsa, fresh parsley, cumin, tahini
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first five ingredients in a blender. Step 2: Blend until very smooth. Step 3: Drizzle in the tahini, and salsa if you didn't yet, and blend again till well combined. Step 4: Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: chipotle chiles in adobo, adobo sauce, green onions, garlic, mayonnaise, sour cream, lime juice, ground cumin, monterey jack cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Using a food processor, whir the chipotle chiles until smooth. Step 2: Chop the green onions. Step 3: In a non-reactive bowl stir together the onions, pureed chiles, garlic, and remaining ingredients and season to taste. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving. Step 5: Pour into serving dish, top with shredded cheese, and serve with tortilla chips, bell pepper strips, other raw veggies, or crackers It will keep, refrigerated and covered, for about 3 days Makes about 1 1 / 2 cups If you like cilantro, you can add a teaspoon of fresh, minced or chopped cilantro to the dip.

Ingredient Names: monterey jack cheese, cream cheese, onion, jalapeno, cumin, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Set crock pot on low, and put in all ingredients Stir occasionally to incorporate ingredients.

Ingredient Names: whipping cream, jalapenos, light sour cream, jalapeno juice, chicken bouillon, clarified butter, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, flour
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy saucepan on high heat, bring cream to the boil Just as it is ready to boil, stir in sour cream until completely blended. Step 2: Reduce heat and add chicken and jalapeno juice. Step 3: Simmer until heated thoroughly. Step 4: Meanwhile, in another pan, melt butter and add flour to create a roux / paste. Step 5: Whisk paste until it browns slightly. Step 6: Add paste to cream pot just before it boils up. Step 7: Whisk continuously until paste dissolves into cream. Step 8: Remove from stove and add cheese and chopped jalepenos. Step 9: Serve / use immediately.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, sharp cheddar cheese, salsa, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium size bowl, mixall of the ingredients together until the mixture is smooth and the ingredients are well blended. Step 2: Cover the bowl, and chill until ready to serve. Step 3: Serve with crisp tortilla chips, dry herbed crackers, fresh sliced vegetables, or an assortment of deli snack breads.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic clove, onion, bell pepper, white mushrooms, jalapeno peppers, salt, pepper, mayonnaise, burrito-size flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, onion, bell peppers, mushrooms, jalapeos, salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook, stirring occasionally, 7-9 minutes or until the vegetables are soft. Step 4: Transfer to bowl and cool. Step 5: Stir mayonnaise into cooled mushrooms. Step 6: Place tortillas on work surface. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese and top with mushroom mixture. Step 8: Fold each in half to form a semi-circle Wipe out skillet and return to stove over medium heat. Step 9: When hot, add quesadillas 2 at a time to skillet.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, diced green chilis, taco sauce, garlic salt, assorted fresh vegetable
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cream cheese, chiles, taco sauce and garlic salt in medium bowl Cover Refrigerate for 30 minutes Serve with vegetables.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken, cream cheese, garlic powder, seasoning salt, onion powder, salsa, burrito-size flour tortillas, flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first 6 ingredients well & set aside. Step 2: Mix flour & water until it is pasty but not dry. Step 3: Put about 1 / 3 cup chichen mix into each tortilla roll tightly, put paste on the bottom flap of tortilla and place flap side down for about 10 min so it will stay sealed I like to cut them in half & fry at 350 until golden brown These are good with salsa or sweet & sour sauce.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, bisquick, sugar, ground cinnamon, milk, vanilla, egg, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4 quart heavy saucepan, heat the oil until a thermometer reaches 360 degrees. Step 2: In a bowl, combine the dry ingredients. Step 3: Stir in the milk, vanilla, and egg. Step 4: Drop a tablespoonful of batter into the hot oil, frying just until golden. Step 5: Drain on paper towels and sprinkle the hot churros with the cinnamon / sugar mixture. Step 6: Serve as-is or drizzled with chocolate, caramel, or with ice cream.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, picante sauce, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, sour cream, cream cheese, chili powder, ground cumin, tortilla chips, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the first 8 ingredients. Step 2: Transfer to a slow cooker. Step 3: Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or until heated through, stirring once or twice. Step 4: Serve with chips and salsa.

Ingredient Names: cheese spread, diced tomatoes with green chilies, green onion, ground coriander, ground cumin, hot pepper sauce, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients to slow cooker and stir until well blended. Step 2: Cover and cook on low 2 to 3 hours or until hot. Step 3: Garnish with green onion strips and hot pepper slices, if desired.

Ingredient Names: pork roast, taco seasoning mix, refried beans, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place pork in crock pot, sprinkle 1 / 2 the taco envelope on meat Smear refried beans on pork, then sprinkle on the rest of the taco mix. Step 2: Cook on low for 6-8 hours. Step 3: When done, shred or break up roast, stir in cheese and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, season salt, garlic powder, chili powder, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Slice tortillas into thin strips 1 / 4-inch wide Next cut tortillas in half through the center. Step 2: Heat oil over medium heat until bubbly. Step 3: Drop in tortilla strips and season with half of seasoning while frying. Step 4: Turn constantly and cook until browned and crispy, about five minutes. Step 5: Transfer to paper towels and season with remaining seasoning Great served with soups, such as southwest chicken black bean.

Ingredient Names: small white beans, onion, garlic cloves, olive oil, spanish chorizo, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Bring beans to a boil in a saucepan. Step 2: Strain liquid and discard Loosely mash beans with a fork. Step 3: Fry and crumble spanish chorizo, discard fat. Step 4: Fry onion till translucent. Step 5: Fry garlic in olive oil. Step 6: Stir in onion, garlic, olive oil, chorizos and salt / pepper. Step 7: Return to saucepan and over low heat stir until heated thoroughly.

Ingredient Names: crescent roll dough, salami, cheese, egg, water
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450f. Step 2: Beat well egg and water Open and separate crescent rolls. Step 3: Place a salami link on each one, and sprinkle with cheese. Step 4: Roll up from the long side and curve to form a "little horn" Brush with beaten egg mixture and place on a greased or parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Step 5: Bake 12-15 minutes, or until golden.

Ingredient Names: avocados, white onions, tomatoes, cilantro, mayonnaise, sour cream, chili powder, salt, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avocadoes, remove pit and scoop out --place into medium sized bowl. Step 2: Mash avocado well with fork. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Step 4: Serve chilled with tortilla chips Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, chili, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Spread cream cheese in the bottom of an 8 inch glass baking dish. Step 2: Layer entire can of chili over cream cheese. Step 3: Sprinkle shredded cheese over chili. Step 4: Bake at 450 degrees until cheese on top is melted and serve with tortilla chips! Step 5: Refrigerate left-overs.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, taco seasoning mix, avocados, light sour cream, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, black olives, diced tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Spread refried beans on a pizza pan. Step 2: Sprinkle with 1 / 3 of taco seasoning. Step 3: Spread mashed avacados over bean layer. Step 4: Sprinkle with 1 / 3 of taco seasoning. Step 5: Spread sour cream over avacado layer. Step 6: Sprinkle with 1 / 3 of taco seasoning. Step 7: Sprinkle cheeses evenly over sour cream layer. Step 8: Top with black olive slices and diced tomatoes if you choose. Step 9: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: tortilla chips, refried beans, cheese, jalapeno, salsa, avocado, sour cream, black olives, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Spread the chips evenly on a plate. Step 2: Spread the beans on top of the chips If you use refried beans, put little globs of them on the chips around the plate - these don't spread easily. Step 3: Cover with the cheese. Step 4: Sprinkle the chopped jalapenos over the cheese Microwave for 1 minute or until all the cheese is melted. Step 5: Spread the salsa over the nachos. Step 6: Spread the sour cream over the salsa. Step 7: Spread the avocado, black olives, and tomatoes over the sourcream Enjoy! Step 8: We usually end up making a second plate.

Dish Name: Delicious Pico De Gallo Salsa Fresca
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onion, jalapeno peppers, fresh cilantro, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients together Leave in fridge for a couple hours for flavors to marinade together Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: avocados, jalapenos, cilantro, tomatillo, red onion, garlic clove, lime juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avacado in half, remove seed, and use a spoon to put the meat into a medium bowl. Step 2: Combine all of the diced ingrediants and the lime Use a potato masher to combine all ingrediants until it is a paste consistency. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Serve with corn chips or over salad.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, fresh cilantro, onions, garlic cloves, jalapenos, habanero peppers, green peppers, cumin, sea salt, vinegar, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and chop tomatoes in a food processor. Step 2: Chop cilantro, onion, garlic and add to tomatoes. Step 3: Chop jalepenos with seeds and put in to 10 quart stock pot. Step 4: Add cumin, salt and vinegar and stir all together. Step 5: Bring to a boil and lower temperature to keep at a low boil for 2-3 hours. Step 6: Boil down to about half to get rid of all the extra tomato water I use 3 cup reusable plastic containers. Step 7: Fill and leave 1 / 2 inch head space let cool to avoid condensation and ice on top of salsa. Step 8: Place lids on and freeze.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, pineapple, red onion, jalapeno chile, cucumber, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh lime juice, garlic clove, jicama, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Don Pablo's Copycat Chili Con Queso
Ingredient Names: onion, butter, chili powder, canned tomatoes, jalapenos, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In small skillet over medium heat, melt butter Saut the onion in the butter for 10 minutes, uncovered. Step 2: Add the chili powder, tomatoes, jalapeos and simmer, stirring frequently, until slightly thickened. Step 3: Add the cheese, stirring constantly. Step 4: Cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese melts. Step 5: Add the sour cream and cook for 1 minute more. Step 6: Serve with soft or crispy tortillas Yield: 2 to 3 servings.

Ingredient Names: manwich sloppy joe mix, ground beef, refried beans, cheddar cheese soup, rotel tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground beef and drain well Mix all ingredients well Heat and serve.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, jalapeno, green onions, onion, fresh cilantro leaves, garlic, fresh lemon juice, fresh lime juice, sugar, ground coriander, ground cumin, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, combine the tomatoes, jalapeno, green onion, sweet onion, cilantro and garlic. Step 2: In a measuring cup, stir together the lemon juice, lime juice, sugar, coriander, cumin and salt. Step 3: Stir until the sugar and salt dissolve, and then pour over the tomato mixture. Step 4: Stir gently to combine. Step 5: Transfer to a serving bowl, cover, and set aside for at least 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lime juice, onions, tomatoes, cilantro, jalapeno, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Halve and pit the avocados, then scoop the flesh into a bowl and mash to your desired consistency. Step 2: Add lime juice to prevent browning and enhance flavor. Step 3: Stir in finely chopped onions, tomatoes, cilantro and minced jalapeno. Step 4: Season with salt to taste, mixing everything together gently. Step 5: Serve immediately with tortilla chips, as guacamole is best enjoyed fresh.

Ingredient Names: avocados, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avacado in half, remove seed, and scoop insides into a bowl. Step 2: Mash the avacado like you would mash potatoes. Step 3: Add salsa to taste I usually add about 1 / 2 the jar, or more depending on how many avacados i use. Step 4: Mix avacado and salsa very well. Step 5: Add sour cream to the mixture, to taste I usually add at least 4-8 oz of sour cream, but if i make a big batch i'll sometimes add more Mine is usually a light color of green, but it is definately green.

Ingredient Names: ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, vegetable oil, onions, red peppers, rump steak, fresh cilantro, tortillas wraps, cheddar cheese, guacamole sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the cumin, coriander and cayenne with some salt and pepper, then set aside. Heat half the oil in a frying pan, then throw in the onion, peppers and half the spice mix. Cook for about 3 mins. Tip the vegetables into a bowl. Step 2: Place pan back on the heat with remaining oil, then fry the steak and remaining spice mix together for 4 mins until cooked through. Tip the steak into a separate bowl, garnishing with coriander. Heat the wraps. Bring everything to the table and let everyone help themselves.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, taco seasoning, tomato paste, canned chilies, eggs, plain breadcrumbs, fresh cilantro, fresh corn, cheese, guacamole, dice pico de gallo, sour cream, cheddar cheese, monterey jack pepper cheese, cornstarch, milk, canned chile
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, taco seasoning, tomato paste, 2 tablespoons chopped chilis, egg, breadcrumbs and chopped cilantro. Form into 2-inch meatballs and place on prepared baking sheet. Step 3: Bake for 15-20 minutes until cooked through. Remove and place each meatball in a corn chip scoop. Drizzle with queso, and top with guacamole, pico de gallo and chopped cilantro. Serve with a side of sour cream, for the Queso:. Step 4: In a large bowl, toss to combine cheddar cheese, pepper jack cheese and cornstarch. In a medium saucepan, bring milk to a simmer. Whisk in cheeses and chopped chilis. Bring to a simmer to thicken, about 1-2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, taco seasoning, water, cheddar cheese soup, low-fat american cheese, salsa, nonfat milk, bell pepper, avocado, sour cream, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in a skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Once brown, add taco seasoning and water. Step 3: Stir and let simmer for five minutes. Step 4: Drain meat slightly, but not completely Stack slices of american cheese and cut into thin strips, then cut those strips into little squares Into a large pot, add the cheese squares, soup, salsa, milk and bell pepper, add the taco meat. Step 5: Stir to combine and cook over medium heat until cheese squares have melted and incorporated and the mixture is almost boiling. Step 6: Top with avocado and sour cream if you choose. Step 7: Serve hot with plenty of tortilla chips for dipping or crushing on top.

Ingredient Names: garlic, olive oil, onion, fresh jalapeno peppers, ground cumin, coriander powder, salt & freshly ground black pepper, carrot, celery, chicken stock, corn, red bell pepper, fresh coriander, cayenne, corn tortilla strips
Instructions: Step 1: In a kettle cook the garlic in the oil over moderately low heat, stirring for 1 minute, add the onion and the jalapeno peppers, and cook the mixture, stirring, until the onion is softened. Step 2: Add the cumin, the ground coriander seed, and salt and black pepper to taste and cook the mixture, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the carrot and the celery and cook the mixture over moderate heat, stirring, for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the stock, the corn cobs, and 2 1 / 2 cups water and simmer the mixture for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add all but 1 cup of the reserved corn kernels, simmer the mixture for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the kernels are very tender, and discard the cobs. Step 6: In a blender puree the mixture in batches, blending each batch on high speed for at least 1 minute, or until it is very smooth. Step 7: Let the soup cool to room temperature. Step 8: In a small saucepan of boiling water boil the remaining 1 cup reserved corn kernels for 2 to 4 minutes, or until they are tender, drain them in a colander, and refresh them under cold water. Step 9: Stir the corn into the soup with the roasted bell pepper, the minced coriander, the cayenne, and salt and black pepper to taste and serve the soup at room temperature. Step 10: Garnish with fried tortilla strips.

Dish Name: Applebee's Cheese Chicken Tortilla Soup Recipe
Ingredient Names: yellow onion, fresh garlic, vegetable oil, chicken stock, green pepper, tomato puree, jalapeno pepper, salt, pepper, sugar, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saut oil, garlic and onions in large pan or dutch oven until soft. Step 2: Add ingredients 4 through 13. Step 3: Bring to low boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Step 4: Cut tortillas into 1 / 4-inch strips and fry in oil or spray with oil and bake at 400f. Step 5: Sprinkle with salt if desired Thoroughly mix flour and water, then whisk into soup. Step 6: Bring to a low boil, then simmer 5 minutes. Step 7: Add chicken and simmer 5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in sour cream and cheese Ensure 165f serving temperature.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, garlic cloves, cumin powder, onion, oil, black pepper, cayenne, chili powder, salt, oregano, white hominy, pork broth, diced green chilis, fresh jalapenos, ancho chilies
Instructions: Step 1: This recipe requires a simple prep. Step 2: Prepare the onion, peel the garlic, chop the onion, peel and chop the 2 garlic cloves, chop the green chilies and jalapenos if you are using them and get the hominy drained and rinsed I boil my ancho chilies in a separate small pot for the garnish part. Step 3: Now you are ready to cook. Step 4: Place the meat in a large saucepan and just cover with lightly salted water. Step 5: Add 1 / 2 chopped onion, the 2 cloves peeled garlic, pepper, cumin, and oregano. Step 6: Bring to a boil over medium heat, skim off any foam that rises, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Step 7: Remove meat and broth, reserving both. Step 8: Saute the remaining chopped onion and garlic in oil until translucent. Step 9: Add the remaining spices, stir for a minute.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, rich chicken broth, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Remove pulp from the avocados Use a blender to puree the avocados with the broth. Step 2: Heat the mixture to just short of boiling and serve garnished with broken tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, olive oil, avocados, low-fat chicken broth, green peppercorns in brine, salt and pepper, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, cook the onion, garlic, and spices in the olive oil over moderate heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 2: Add the avocados and chicken stock and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Reduce the heat to moderate and cook for 20 minutes. Step 4: Cool to room temperature Pure the soup mixture in a blender until very smooth. Step 5: Transfer back to the saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 6: Add the peppercorns and salt and pepper. Step 7: Reduce the heat to moderate and cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: Serve with a garnish of cilantro and a few peppercorns.

Dish Name: Aztec Onion Lime Soup With Corn Dumplings
Ingredient Names: corn oil, yellow onions, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, tomatoes, chicken stock, lime juice, lime zest, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cornflour, baking powder, salt, vegetable shortening, egg, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Over low heat, warm the corn oil in a large heavy pot. Step 2: Add the onions and stir to coat them with oil. Step 3: Cover and cook them slowly for 20 minutes. Step 4: Uncover the pot and raise the heat to moderate. Step 5: Stir in the garlic and serrano chile and saute for 2 minutes. Step 6: Then add the tomato and continue to cook, stirring for 1 more minute. Step 7: Add the stock, lime juice and zest and salt and pepper. Step 8: Bring the soup to a boil. Step 9: Lower the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Step 10: Meanwhile, prepare the blue corn dumplings.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, white onion, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, chicken broth, epazote leaves, salt and pepper, dried pasilla peppers, monterey jack cheese, avocado, sour cream, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Place tomatoes in boiling water for about 2 minutes. Step 2: Remove tomatoes and in a food processor, blend them with the onion and garlic. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil in a 2 litre sauce pan. Step 4: Add the blended tomato mixture. Step 5: Cook until it changes colour and has a pleasant cooked taste. Step 6: Add the broth and heat until it just starts to boil. Step 7: Simmer and add the epazote leaves, salt and pepper. Step 8: In a separate pan or griddle roast the dried pasilla chilies in the remaining vegetable oil until they change colour but do not blacken If burnt, the chillies will taste bitter and unpleasant To serve, use deep bowls.

Ingredient Names: lamb, dried guajillo chilies, garlic cloves, sesame seeds, whole cloves, cider vinegar, ground cumin, black peppercorns, salt, sugar, diced tomatoes, dried oregano, bay leaves, ground cinnamon, corn tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the meat: trim the fat from the meat. Step 2: Cut into 2 large pieces. Step 3: Put meat into a large non-corrosive baking dish or pan. Step 4: Prepare the marinade / glaze: heat a griddle or large cast-iron skillet over medium heat Tear chiles into flat pieces and toast a few at a time, pressing them against the hot surface, until they crack and blister. Step 5: Flip them and press down again. Step 6: Transfer chiles to a large bowl and cover with boiling water Weight down with a plate to keep them submerged, and soak at least 30 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, roast the garlic in the same griddle or skillet, turning frequently, until soft inside and blackened outside, about 15 minutes, cool and peel.

Dish Name: Black And Red Mexican Slow Cooker Soup
Ingredient Names: onions, carrots, garlic cloves, chicken broth, white sugar, frozen corn, kidney beans, black beans, stewed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, diced green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything in the pot, and cook on low for about 8-9 hours. Step 2: Garnish with grated cheese, sour cream, cilantro, etc Freezes great Crumbled sauteed chorizo is yummy in this.

Dish Name: Black And White Mexican Bean Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic clove, flour, taco seasoning mix, milk, chicken broth, frozen corn, great northern beans, black beans, diced green chilies, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pan or dutch oven over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion and garlic. Step 3: Cook until onion is tender. Step 4: Stir in flour and taco seasoning mix Gradually stir in milk until blended. Step 5: Add remaining ingredients except cilantro. Step 6: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: Reduce heat to low. Step 8: Simmer 15 minutes or until thicken, stirring occasionally, stir in cilantro.

Ingredient Names: black beans, beef broth, thick & chunky salsa, cumin, sour cream, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor with a metal blade or a blender container, combine the beans, broth, salsa, and cumin Process 1 minute, or until smooth. Step 2: Heat bean mixture in a medium saucepan over medium heat, until thoroughly heated To serve, ladle soup into 2 individual bowls. Step 3: Spoon 1 tablespoon of sour cream on top of each Swirl gently. Step 4: Sprinkle with green onions.

Dish Name: Black Bean Soup Sopa De Frijoles Negros
Ingredient Names: black beans, chicken broth, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, salsa, lime, ground cumin, crushed red pepper flakes, plain yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Place beans with liquid and chicken broth in blender or food processor and blend until smooth You can leave part of the beans whole if you wish, it gives a nice texture. Step 2: Heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add onion and garlic: cook for 1-2 or until the onion is tender. Step 4: Add beans, salsa, lime juice, cumin and red pepper. Step 5: Bring to boil and reduce heat to low, cover. Step 6: Cook while stirring occasionally, for 25-30 minutes. Step 7: Serve with a drizzle of youghurt, and garnish with chopped red onion and fresh cilantro.

Ingredient Names: safflower oil, red onion, white onion, garlic cloves, poblano chiles, red bell pepper, green bell peppers, chili powder, ground cumin, chicken broth, turkey meat, corn kernel, black beans, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the safflower oil over medium heat in a 6-quart saucepan. Step 2: Add the onions and garlic and saut until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the peppers, chilies, chili powder, and cumin. Step 4: Add the chicken broth and cook 25 to 30 minutes. Step 5: Add turkey, corn, and black beans to the broth. Step 6: Stir in salt, pepper, and cornmeal and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Step 7: Serve with bowls of garnish arid warm corn tortillas or corn muffins 4-6 grams fat 250-275 calories.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, onion, diced tomatoes, red kidney beans, taco seasoning, corn, green chilies, jalapeno, ranch dressing, bow tie pasta, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Brown the ground beef then add the onion and jalapeno. Step 2: Cook until softened. Step 3: Add the tomatoes, kidney beans, chilies, ranch dressing, stir until heated through 2. Step 4: Cook the pasta and stir into the soup 3. Step 5: Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

Dish Name: Boracho Bean Soup Or Frijoles A La Charra Restaurant Style
Ingredient Names: pinto beans, bacon, onion, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, tomatoes and green chilies, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot, cook pinto beans with enough water to cover and salt for approximately 4 hours, until done, set aside 2. Step 2: Put bacon pieces in skillet and fry until half done 3. Step 3: Add onion, jalapeno, cilantro, ro-tel tomatoes and saute approximately 4 minutes over medium heat 4. Step 4: Add to cooked pinto beans and blend, serve hot.

Dish Name: Ca Kitchen White Corn Tortilla Soup
Ingredient Names: olive oil, corn tortillas, fresh garlic, white onions, jalapeno peppers, white corn kernels, plum tomatoes, tomato paste, ground cumin, kosher salt, white pepper, chili powder, water, chicken stock, blue corn tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium-high heat, fry tortilla squares in olive oil until they begin to crisp and turn a golden yellow. Step 2: Add garlic, onion and jalapeno. Step 3: Cook 1 to 2 minutes, until onion becomes translucent. Step 4: Transfer to an 8 quart pot. Step 5: Add half the corn along with all other ingredients, reserving other half of corn to be added at the end. Step 6: Bring the soup to a low, even boil. Step 7: Boil for 5 minutes. Step 8: Remove soup from heat Use a hand-held propeller blade processor to process in batches to the consistency of a course puree. Step 9: Return the soup to the burner and add the reserved corn.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, dried oregano, chicken broth, mexican-style tomatoes, zucchini, yellow squash, corn, diced green chilies, velveeta cheese, salt, pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil. Step 2: Add oregano, chicken broth and tomatoes. Step 3: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 4: Stir in squash, corn and green chilies. Step 5: Return to boil and simmer till squash is tender. Step 6: Stir in velveeta, salt, pepper and cilantro.

Dish Name: Caldo De Pollo Mexican Chicken Stew Soup
Ingredient Names: onion, carrots, potatoes, celery, salsa, chicken thighs, olive oil, water, salt, salt and pepper, cilantro, lemon wedges
Instructions: Step 1: In one tablespoon olive oil, heat pot on high heat and sear the chicken pieces till brown on all sides. Step 2: Remove and transfer to a plate / bowl Sautee onions with the rest of the olive oil in that same pot till translucent. Step 3: Add all the veggies. Step 4: Add chicken, water, el pato sauce, and 1 tsp salt. Step 5: Bring to boil, cover, lower heat to medium and cover and let cook for 25 minutes. Step 6: Lower heat to medium-low and let cook for 35 more minutes--the chicken will be falling off the bone:d yumm! Step 7: Taste and add more salt and then pepper as needed Then throw in the cilantro, give it a good stir, then cover again and let it simmer for about 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, garlic cloves, white onion, anaheim chilies, roma tomatoes, chicken bouillon powder, all-purpose flour, boiling water, whole milk, queso fresco, dried tepin chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the flour take the flour out of the pan and clean the pan with a napkin, Add oil to the pan and when the oil is hot add the potatoes to brown them, add some salt You don't want the potatoes fully cooked because you are going to add them to the soup later, but you want them sealed. Step 2: Take the potatoes out, then add to the same pan the garlic and the onion finely chopped, for like 2-3 minutes and add there the anaheim green peppers the green peppers should be finely chopped also, and mix them with the onion and garlic At the end add the tomato finely chopped also, and mix it with the onion, garlic and green chiles. Step 3: Add the toasted flour and mix. Step 4: Add the boiling water and the chicken bouillon, salt, pepper. Step 5: Add the potatoes and the milk, and as soon as it boils, add the cheese pieces let it boil for like a minute and turn it off I add it to each plate at the end but thats up to you).

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, celery, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, chicken stock, milk, baking soda, velveeta cheese, ground black pepper, garlic salt, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a pot large enought to hold all the ingredients. Step 2: Saute onions and celery over low heat until soft. Step 3: Add the flour and cornstarch and stir until it bubbles Gradually add chicken stock and milk and stir until smooth. Step 4: Add baking soda, cheese, pepper and garlic salt, stir. Step 5: Cook over low heat until the cheese melts and blends into the mixture. Step 6: Add the parsley and cook for five more minutes more and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, carrots, green onion, tomato paste, milk, all-purpose flour, dry mustard, ground pepper, cream cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, fresh cilantro, parsley sprig, parmesan cheese, olive oil, lime peel
Instructions: Step 1: Soup: Stir together chicken broth, carrot, green onion and tomato paste in a large saucepan, bring to boiling. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2 minutes. Step 3: Combine milk, flour, mustard and 1 / 4 tsp pepper. Step 4: Stir into chicken broth mixture. Step 5: Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Step 6: Cook and stir for one minute more. Step 7: Place cream cheese in a mixing bowl. Step 8: Stir about 1 cup of the hot milk mixture into the cream cheese until smooth.

Ingredient Names: condensed cream of chicken soup, old el paso mild enchilada sauce, milk, cheddar cheese, southwestern chicken strips, tortilla chips, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In 3-quart saucepan, mix soups, enchilada sauce and milk. Step 2: Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally till warmed. Step 3: Add shredded cheese and cooked, chopped southwestern chicken Continue cooking over medium heat until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted. Step 4: Top individual servings with tortilla chips and / or sour cream.

Ingredient Names: water, garlic, onion, tomatoes, carrots, celery, zucchini, squash, potatoes, cabbage, cilantro, bay leaf, chicken breasts, salt and pepper, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Sautee onions and garlic in oil Put in water, chicken, bay leaf, salt and pepper Bring to a boil Add the rest of ingredient and let boil to your likes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, olive oil, green onion, jalapenos, garlic cloves, low sodium chicken broth, roma tomatoes, ground cumin, salt and pepper, cilantro, fresh lime juice, avocados, tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Once hot, add green onions and jalapenos and saut until tender, about 2 minutes, adding garlic during last 30 seconds of sauting. Step 3: Add chicken broth, tomatoes, cumin, season with salt and pepper to taste and add chicken breasts. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Then reduce heat to medium, cover with lid and allow to cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken has cooked through 10 - 15 minutes. Step 6: Reduce burner to warm heat, remove chicken from pan and let rest on a cutting board 5 minutes, then shred chicken and return to soup. Step 7: Stir in cilantro and lime juice. Step 8: Add avocados to soup just before serving. Step 9: Serve with tortilla chips, cheese and sour cream if desired.

Ingredient Names: bell peppers, onion, celery, mushroom, red bell pepper, garlic, del monte zesty jalapeno pepper diced tomato, black beans, chicken broth, frozen corn and black beans, bay leaf, cumin, coriander, cilantro, sazon con azafran seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: In a large soup pot add 1 tsp olive oil add onion, garlic, celery, mushrooms and fresh bell pepper Saut until onion is clear approximately 5 minutes. Step 2: Add tomatoes, chicken stock, beans and bay leaf cook for 15 minutes. Step 3: Add spices and frozen peppers and corn. Step 4: Add black beans and meat. Step 5: Cook for 25 -40 minutes over medium heat. Step 6: Check for seasoning - add more heat if you like add more cilantro, cumin etc - this is really all about your desired level of taste - make it yours). Step 7: Serve in a large bowl with your favorite mexican toppings - enjoy Feliz navidad - a great change from the american standard!

Ingredient Names: onion, green pepper, margarine, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, rotel tomatoes, tortilla chips, cheese, cooked chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and peppers in margarine until tender. Step 2: Add soups and broth and simmer for five minutes. Step 3: Add tomatoes and chips and simmer for ten minutes. Step 4: Top with cheese and serve.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, garlic, ground cumin, vegetable juice, lime juice, diced tomatoes, chicken breasts, black beans, corn, fresh cilantro, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the garlic and cumin briefly in a soup pot sprayed with cooking spray. Step 2: Add the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer at least 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, chicken broth, onion, minced garlic cloves, tomato sauce, cilantro, ground cumin, chili powder, bay leaf, salt, boneless skinless chicken breasts, avocado, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200 degrees and thinly slice one of the tortillas and place it on a baking sheet and bake for about 15 to 20 minutes until crisp Crush the remaining 2 tortillas into small pieces. Step 2: Heat 2 tbs of the chicken broth in a pot and add your onion and garlic and cook about 2 minutes until softened. Step 3: Add the remaining chicken broth, crushed tortillas, tomato sauce, cilantro, cumin, chili powder, bay leaf and salt. Step 4: Bring this mixture to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 5: Discard bay leaf and transfer the mixture to a blender and puree working in batches to avoid overflows. Step 6: Pour soup into 4 bowls and top each with tortilla strips, chicken, avocado and cheese Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: carrots, celery, onions, garlic powder, salt, pepper, corn oil, chicken broth, tomatoes, rotel tomatoes & chilies, taco seasoning, corn, chicken meat, milk, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute carrots, onions, celery in corn oil, garlic, salt and pepper until tender. Step 2: Add chicken broth and bring to boil. Step 3: Add tomatoes, rotel, taco seasoning, and chicken. Step 4: Cut tortillas into small pieces and add to broth mixture. Step 5: Let boil for 45 minutes or until tortillas are thoroughly incorporated into soup stirring occasionally to keep from sticking. Step 6: Reduce heat and add 8 oz Cheese. Step 7: Simmer for additional 10 minutes. Step 8: Add milk and simmer for additional 10 minutes If thicker soup is desired, add more diced tortillas and let incorporate into soup.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes and green chilies, corn, stewed tomatoes, chicken, onion, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese, hot pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix first five ingredients together and heat Sprinkle each serving with chips and cheese Add hot pepper sauce for those who are so inclined.

Dish Name: Chicken Tortilla Soup In A Flash
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, chicken broth, long-grain white rice, ground cumin, mexican-style corn, salsa, fresh cilantro, lime juice, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Spray saucepot with vegetable cooking spray and heat one minute. Step 2: Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring often. Step 3: Add broth, rice and cumin, heat to a boil. Step 4: Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Step 5: Stir in corn, salsa, cilantro and lime juice and heat thoroughly. Step 6: Top with crisp tortilla strips: Crisp tortilla strips. Step 7: Preheat oven to 425. Step 8: Cut 4 corn tortillas into thin strips and place on baking sheet.

Ingredient Names: country-style spareribs, dried ancho chiles, water, garlic clove, white onion, cumin seed, tomatillos, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ribs into a large sauce pan and barely cover with water. Step 2: Add salt to taste, and cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 3: Remove any stalks from the dried chiles, slit them open, and scrape out and discard any veins and seeds. Step 4: Put chiles into a saucepan, cover with hot water, and simmer for 5 minutes, remove from heat. Step 5: Let soak 5 minutes. Step 6: Put 1 / 2 cup of the water in a blender. Step 7: Add garlic, onion, and cumin seed, blend thoroughly. Step 8: Add remaining 1 / 2 cup of water and some of the chiles.

Ingredient Names: milk, shredded coconut, coconut milk, chicken stock, heavy cream, salt, white pepper, sugar, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the milk in to a large saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, stir in the coconut, lower the heat and let simmer for 30 minutes. Step 3: Spoon the mixture into a food processor and process until smooth This may take a while--up to 5 minutes--so pause frequently and scrape down the sides of the bowl. Step 4: Rinse the pan to remove any coconut that remains, pour in the processed mixture and add the coconut milk. Step 5: Stir in the chicken stock cream, salt, pepper, and sugar. Step 6: Bring the mixture to a boil, stirring occasionally then lower the heat and cook for 10 minutes Reserve a few cilantro leaves to garnish, then chop the rest finely and stir into the soup. Step 7: Pour the soup into a large bowl, let it cool, then cover and put into the refrigerator until chilled Just before serving taste the soup and adjust the seasoning as chilling will alter the taste.

Ingredient Names: diced onions, red bell pepper, garlic, ground turkey, brown sugar, dried ancho chile powder, unsweetened cocoa, cumin, black pepper, salt, canned pinto beans, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, chipotle chiles in adobo, unsweetened chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a dutch oven over medium-high heat Coat pan with cooking spray. Step 2: Add onion, bell pepper, garlic, and turkey to pan. Step 3: Saute 8 minutes or until turkey is browned and vegetables are tender. Step 4: Add sugar and next 9 ingredients to pan, stirring to blend, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 5: Simmer 15 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add chocolate, stirring to melt Ladle 1 1 / 4 cups chile in each of 8 bowls.

Ingredient Names: chorizo sausage, onion, green pepper, garlic, black beans, chicken broth, cumin, bay leaf, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the casing from the chorizo and begin to break it up and brown it in a medium saucepot. Step 2: After a few minutes add the onion, garlic and green pepper and cook the mixture for about five minutes total. Step 3: Add the beans and broth, then the cumin and bay leaf. Step 4: Let it come to a boil and then simmer about a half hour. Step 5: Add the lemon juice For crockpot use, follow the first step, then transfer all the ingredients into the crockpot and cook on low about 3 hours. Step 6: Garnish with cilantro if desired.

Ingredient Names: dried ancho chiles, water, bacon, chorizo sausages, onions, garlic cloves, brown lentils, chicken stock, carrots, celery ribs, salt, fresh ground black pepper, parsley, cilantro, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the chiles in a dry, cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until brown all over They will soften, bubble and release their aroma. Step 2: Place the chiles in a saucepan with the water. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cook 5 minutes, or until soft. Step 4: Transfer the chiles with their water to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth Reserve. Step 5: Fry the bacon in large heavy stockpot over medium-high heat, about 4 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the chorizo and saute 3 minutes longer, or until browned. Step 7: Spoon out excess fat. Step 8: Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden.

Dish Name: Chuy's Chicka Chicka Boom Boom Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, cooked chicken, vegetable broth, water, salt and pepper, roasted green chilies, tomatillos, cilantro, green onion, serrano pepper, lime juice, american cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, add vegetable broth, water and spices and place over a medium to high flame. Step 2: Using a food processor, puree roasted green chilies, tomatillos, cilantro, green onions, serranos and lime juice. Step 3: Add to saucepan, stirring in well. Step 4: Bring mixture to a slow boil. Step 5: Lower flame and slowly add american cheese, whipping as needed to remove clumps and make sure it doesnt stick to the bottom. Step 6: When the cheese is melted and mixed, remove from heat To make enchiladas, fill a corn tortilla with 2 ounces of cooked, roasted chicken. Step 7: Roll up and place in a baking pan. Step 8: Top with mixed cheese, as needed Warm in a hot oven for 4 minutes, until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, celery, garlic clove, green chilies, refried beans, black pepper, chili powder, hot pepper sauce, chicken broth, cheddar cheese, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a 2 quart sauce pan cook bacon until crisp. Step 2: Add onion, celery, and garlic. Step 3: Cook covered over low heat stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients, bring to boil. Step 5: When heated through, serve in bowls and top with cheese, serve with chips.

Dish Name: Conga Lime Pork In Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: salt, black pepper, boneless pork shoulder, canola oil, onion, garlic cloves, water, chipotle chiles in adobo, molasses, broccoli coleslaw mix, mango, lime juice, lime zest, corn muffins
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper over roast In large skillet, brown pork in oil on all sides, transfer to 3 or 4 quart crockpot In same skillet, saut onion until tender, add garlic and cook one minute longer, add water, chipotle, and molasses, stirring to loosen brown bits from pan, pour over pork. Step 2: Cover and cook on high for 4 to 5 hours or until meat is tender. Step 3: Remove meat, cool slightly Skim fat from cooking juices Shred pork and return to crockpot, heat through. Step 4: In a large bowl, combine the broccoli coleslaw mix, mango, lime juice, zest, and remaining 1 / 4 t salt and 1 / 4 t black pepper.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, onion, margarine, all-purpose flour, chicken broth, half-and-half, condensed cream of chicken soup, salsa, creamed corn, cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts, ground cumin, fajita seasoning mix, fresh cilantro, tortilla chips, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot over medium heat, saute the garlic and onion in the butter or margarine for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add flour and stir well, cooking for 1 minute more. Step 3: Add the broth and half-and-half. Step 4: Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Step 5: Add the soup, salsa, corn, chicken, cumin, fajita seasoning and 2 tablespoons cilantro. Step 6: Stir and continue to heat for 15 minutes Crumble tortilla chips into individual bowls, add 1 / 2 ounce shredded cheese to each bowl and ladle in soup. Step 7: Top each bowl with more crumbled chips, remaining 1 / 2 ounce cheese and remaining 1 tablespoon cilantro, few chopped green onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: corn on the cob, red capsicum, oil, onion, garlic cloves, chicken stock, lime juice, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a bbq or grill. Step 2: Remove the husks and silk from the corn cobs and cook on the bbq or grill for about 10 minutes, turning frequently, until roasted and slightly blackened. Step 3: Cool, then cut the kernels from the cobs with a small sharp knife. Step 4: Cut the capsicum into quarters. Step 5: Discard the seeds and membrane and cook under the grill or on the bbq until the skin has blackened and blistered. Step 6: Remove from the heat and place in a plastic bag to cool Peel away the skin and finely chop the flesh. Step 7: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes, or until very soft and lightly golden. Step 8: Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Step 9: Add the corn kernels, capsicum and chicken stock to the pan, bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for about 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Corn Avocado Soup With Cheesy Toasts
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, jalapeno chile, avocados, limes, fresh cilantro leaves, salt and pepper, chicken broth, frozen corn, baguette, feta
Instructions: Step 1: Using a food processor, finely chop 2 cloves garlic and the jalapeno. Step 2: Add the avocados, lime peel, lime juice and 1 / 2 cup cilantro leaves. Step 3: Season to taste with salt and pepper Process until just combined With the machine on, slowly pour in the chicken broth until smooth If the soup is too thick, slowly add up to 1 cup water. Step 4: In a small nonstick skillet, toast the corn kernels over medium heat, stirring, until lightly browned. Step 5: Season with salt and let cool. Step 6: Stir 1 1 / 2 cups corn kernels into the soup. Step 7: Preheat the broiler.

Ingredient Names: ears of corn, garlic clove, salt, butter, onion, tomatoes, beef broth, chile, dried oregano leaves, whipping cream, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: If using fresh corn, cut kernels from cobs Scrape cobs with a spoon. Step 2: Discard cobs Measure corn You should have about 1-1 / 2 cups. Step 3: Puree 3 / 4 cup corn in a blender or food processor, set aside. Step 4: Mash garlic with salt to make a paste. Step 5: Melt butter in a large saucepan. Step 6: Add onion and garlic paste.

Ingredient Names: bacon, yellow onion, salt, fresh ground pepper, chicken stock, bay leaves, boiling potato, squash, heavy cream, limes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large soup pot over low heat, fry the bacon until almost all the fat is rendered, or melt the butter. Step 2: Raise the heat to medium, add the onion, salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the stock or water, bay leaves and potato and simmer until the potato slices are soft, about 20 minutes. Step 4: When the potato slices are soft, remove and discard the bay leaves and bacon. Step 5: Add the chayotes and bring to a boil. Step 6: Return the heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, until the chayotes are soft, about 15 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the heat and let cool slightly Working in batches, puree the soup in a blender until smooth As each batch is pureed, pour the puree through a sieve placed over a bowl, pressing with the back of a spoon to extract all the juices. Step 8: Pour the puree back into the pot, add the cream or half-and-half and bring just to a boil.

Dish Name: Cream Of Cilantro Soup Crema De Cilantro
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, chicken stock, butter, onions, garlic cloves, flour, salt, heavy cream, chihuahua cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Place cilantro leaves in a blender with 1 cup of the chicken stock and blend to form a puree, set aside. Step 2: Melt the butter in a large saucepan, add the onion and garlic, and saut until soft but not brown. Step 3: Add the flour and stir to make a roux Gradually add the remaining broth, stirring with a whisk after each addition. Step 4: Add the cilantro puree, stirring to blend thoroughly. Step 5: Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes The soup may be made ahead up to this step. Step 6: Stir in the cream, place in serving bowls and garnish with shredded cheese and a cilantro sprig if desired.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, flour, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, pepper, vegetable oil, onion, poblano pepper, garlic, butter, chicken broth, half-and-half, cooked chicken, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cut three tortillas into ninths. Step 2: Place in food processor and chop until fine. Step 3: Add flour, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Step 4: Blend to the consistency of cornmeal. Step 5: Place oil in stockpot over medium high heat. Step 6: Add onion, 1 / 2 cup poblano pepper, and garlic and saut until the onion is transparent. Step 7: Add butter and let it melt. Step 8: Add tortilla-flour mixture to the pan and mix to form a roux. Step 9: Cook 4-5 minutes stirring constantly with a whisk- do not let mixture burn While stirring, slowly add broth, scraping down sides and bottom often.

Dish Name: Cream Of Zucchini Soup Crema De Calabacitas
Ingredient Names: zucchini, water, salt, cilantro leaves, butter, onions, all-purpose flour, evaporated milk, chicken broth, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Wash zucchini. Step 2: Cut off stem ends, then cut into large pieces. Step 3: Place in a saucepan. Step 4: Add water and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Step 6: Cool zucchini in cooking liquid. Step 7: Place zucchini, 1 cup cooking liquid and 2 tablespoons cilantro in a blender Process until pureed. Step 8: Heat butter in a medium saucepan.

Ingredient Names: bacon, onion, celery, salt, red pepper, garlic powder, rotel tomatoes, chicken broth, refried beans, water
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and celery in bacon grease you get from frying your bacon strips. Step 2: Combine all ingredients including the crumbled bacon and heat till hot. Step 3: Add water to desired consistency Soup should be creamy. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips.

Dish Name: Creamy Spicy Oaxacan Sweet Onion Soup
Ingredient Names: yellow onions, butter, garlic, sherry wine, flour, chicken stock, chilies, heavy cream, white cheddar cheese, poblano chiles, salt, baguette, blue cheese, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onions in butter until tender, about 5-10 minutes. Step 2: Take out about 1 / 3 cup for garnish and set aside. Step 3: Add garlic and sherry to the onions in pan. Step 4: Stir in flour and cook 1 minute. Step 5: Add chicken stock and chiles, bring to a boil, simmer 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove and discard chiles. Step 7: Add cream, cheese and diced poblano chiles. Step 8: Simmer 5-10 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, cumin, chicken breasts, white beans, chickpeas, white corn, black beans, canned diced green chiles, water, chicken bouillon cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat, saute onion and cumin until soft, add chicken. Step 2: Saute cooked through. Step 3: Transfer to a slow cooker. Step 4: Add white beans, chick-peas, corn, black beans, chiles, water & bouillon cubes, mix well. Step 5: Cook on high for 4 hours. Step 6: Garnish with chopped tomatoes, sour cream, avocado, chopped cilantro, shredded cheese or tortillas.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, fajita seasoning mix, fat free chicken broth, water, red pepper, green pepper, frozen corn, cilantro salsa, garlic cloves, cilantro, black beans, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a slow crock pot. Step 2: Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or on high for 4 to 6 hours. Step 3: Remove bay leaf and stir to break up chicken before serving. Step 4: Serve topped with shredded cheddar cheese, sour cream, if desired Or serve with tortillas cut into strips for some variety.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Texas Pozole Mexican Pork And Hominy Soup
Ingredient Names: pork steaks, salt, pepper, hominy, chicken broth, onion, garlic cloves, green chili peppers, chili powder, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, saut onion until soft, then add garlic and saut for another minute. Step 2: Cut pork into bite sized pieces. Step 3: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 4: Combine pork with hominy, chicken broth, sauted onion and garlic, chili peppers, chili powder, and cumin in crock pot, mix thoroughly. Step 5: Cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours.

Ingredient Names: black beans, whole kernel corn, diced tomatoes with green chilies, chicken broth, tomato sauce, tortilla chips, sour cream, avocado, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pour all canned goods into 3 qt crock pot. Step 2: Add crushed tortilla chips. Step 3: Set to cook on low for 5 to 6 hours If desired - you can add 2 cups cooked, shredded chicken in the last hour. Step 4: Spoon into bowls -- top with crushed tortillas, sour cream, avocado dices, cheese, etc -- let your imagination go wild.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder blade roast, tomatoes, garlic cloves, onion, cilantro, chili powder, ground cumin, black pepper, oregano, paprika, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Trim the visible fat from the pork. Step 2: Place 1 can tomatoes on the bottom of the crockpot, follow w / pork, garlic and onion, sprinkle the taco seasoning evenly on the top, then cover w / cilantro. Step 3: Cook on high for the 1st 3 hrs and on low for another 5 hours. Step 4: Remove the pork and shred it, return to the crockpot, mix w / juice.

Ingredient Names: bourbon, coffee, tomato sauce, tomatoes, ground beef, italian sausage, bacon, ear of corn, leek, red pepper, green onion, yellow onion, head of garlic, jalapeno pepper, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Remove seeds from jalapeos and red pepper Dice all vegetables and add to large pot along with all liquids, spices, and legumes. Step 2: Cook bacon in separate pan until semi-cooked, then add italian sausage and beef--cook until browned, and mash into small pieces, discarding liquid as it accumulates. Step 3: Add meat to pot with sauce and vegetables, cover and simmer for at least 45 minutes. Step 4: After cooking, add another shot or two of bourbon.

Ingredient Names: fat-free chicken broth, celery, yellow sweet onion, green enchilada sauce, pumpkin puree, chicken breasts, sweet corn, hot sauce, salt, taco seasoning, fat-free cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot bring the broth, celery, onion, and enchilada sauces to a boil. Step 2: Whisk in the pumpkin. Step 3: Add corn and raw chicken and cover the pot tightly with a lid, turn the oven burner off, and let the pot sit, covered, for one hour Do not take the lid off!, do not peek! Step 4: The chicken needs to cook fully, taste the soup. Step 5: Add a dash or more hot sauce, salt, and / or taco seasoning. Step 6: Serve and, if you like, top with shredded cheese and / or crushed chips.

Dish Name: Don Pablos Chicken Tortilla Soup Copycat
Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, water, carrots, celery ribs, onion, garlic, salt, white pepper, black pepper, cayenne pepper, cumin, fresh cilantro, rotel tomatoes, heavy whipping cream, canned corn
Instructions: Step 1: Boil chicken, carrots, celery, onion, garlic, salt, and peppers in water for about 1-2 hours. Step 2: Remove chicken and let cool. Step 3: Add rotel, cilantro, corn, and cumin to the pot, stir well. Step 4: Remove chicken from the bone and add to the pot. Step 5: Add cream just to get color and thickness. Step 6: Cut tortillas in strips and fry in peanut oil. Step 7: Put tortillas in bottom of bowl, sprinkle with cheese and pour soup on top Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, fresh cilantro, garlic, lime juice, ground cumin, sauce, salt, pepper, onions, vegetable oil, green chilies, italian-style stewed tomatoes, chicken stock, chili powder, all-purpose flour
Instructions: Step 1: Meatballs: Combine the ground beef with the cilantro, garlic, lime juice, cumin, hot sauce and salt and pepper. Step 2: Form into 1-ounce balls. Step 3: Heat oil in skillet over moderate heat. Step 4: Cook until brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Soup: In a large soup pot, heat 2 tablespoon vegetable oil. Step 6: Add onions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes over low heat until translucent. Step 7: Add chiles and cook 2 minutes. Step 8: Add tomatoes and their juice, chicken stock, chili powder, cumin, and hot sauce. Step 9: Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Step 10: In a small bowl, combine flour and chicken stock, whisk into soup. Step 11: Bring back to a boil. Step 12: Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 13: Add meat balls and simmer an additional 5 minutes. Step 14: Serve soup topped with sour cream, monterey jack cheese or fried tortilla strips.

Dish Name: No Copycats Here Homemade Chicken Tortilla Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, salt and pepper, cumin, celery ribs, green bell pepper, white onion, ear of corn, fresh cilantro, jalapeno pepper, chipotle chiles in adobo, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Add 1 tbsp of olive oil to your soup pot, let heat on medium heat for about 3 minutes prior to adding chicken Salt and pepper chicken breasts I like to cut the cooking time down, so i slice my chicken in half to thin it out. Step 2: Sprinkle with cumin on both sides and add chicken to the pan. Step 3: Cook until both sides are golden brown. Step 4: Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside for at least 10 minutes to cool prior to cutting in thin slices. Step 5: Cut up celery, bell pepper, onion and jalapeo and add to the pan on medium heat. Step 6: Let this cook for about 5 minutes prior to adding the corn. Step 7: Cut the corn off the cobb and add to the hot pan. Step 8: Let all veggies cook for 10 minutes on medium heat.

Dish Name: Potato, pepper & chorizo stew with fried eggs
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, pepper, garlic, chorizo, potato, chicken stock, eggs, fresh flat-leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a pan with a lid and add the onion and peppers. Fry for 10-15 mins until soft, then add the garlic and chorizo and sizzle until the chorizo releases its oils. Step 2: Add the potatoes and stir for 1 min. Pour over the stock, cover with a lid and simmer for 15 mins, or until the potatoes are tender. Remove the lid and season. Bring to the boil and boil rapidly to reduce until most of the liquid has evaporated. Step 3: Meanwhile, fry the eggs in the remaining oil. Spoon the stew onto bowls, then place a fried egg on top and serve sprinkled with parsley.

Dish Name: Quick Taco Soup with Pork Carnitas
Ingredient Names: olive oil, brown, red bell peppers, black beans, sweet corn, garlic, oregano, cumin, paprika, chili, mexican pulled pork, tomato puree passata, chicken, salt, pepper, corn chips, sour cream, cheese, cilantro cilantro, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Add the pulled pork and cook for 1 minute until parts of it are browned, then remove from the saucepan. Do this step even if you are using shredded chicken or another meat. Step 3: Add garlic and onion, sauté until onion becomes translucent (2 minutes), then add the capsicum (bell pepper) and cook for 1 minute until softened. Step 4: Return the pulled pork into the saucepan and add all other ingredients except salt and pepper. If you are making this ahead to FREEZE, see below for instructions. Step 5: Stir to scrap the brown bits from the pulled pork off the bottom of the pan to mix in with the soup flavours. Step 6: Bring to boil then turn down heat slightly and allow to simmer rapidly for 3 minutes so the flavours can come together. If you are using crushed tinned tomatoes instead of passata, let it simmer for a further 5 minutes to let the tomatoes breakdown a bit. If the soup gets too thick to your liking, just add a bit more water. Step 7: Do a taste test, then season with salt and pepper. It is important to season last because different stock brands have different levels of saltiness. Step 8: Serve with toppings of choice. The more toppings = more delicious! Step 9: Follow steps 1 to 3. Step 10: In step 4, do not add the tomato passata or chicken/vegetable stock/broth. Instead, add 1 cup of water, bring to simmer and stir, scraping the bottom of the pot to get the brown bits off. Step 11: Remove pot from heat and set aside to cool, then pour the contents into a container or ziplock bag and freeze. Step 12: To cook, defrost, then pour the contents into a saucepan. Add the tomato passata and chicken stock/broth. Then follow steps 6 onwards as per above.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, ground beef, white breadcrumb, ground cumin coriander, chipotle paste, basmati rice, fresh tomato, kidney beans, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the onion for 8-10 mins until soft, then remove from the pan. Step 2: Meanwhile, place the mince, breadcrumbs, spices and chipotle paste in a bowl, season generously and mix thoroughly. Roll mixture into 20 walnut-sized meatballs. Add the remaining oil to the pan and fry the meatballs for about 8 mins until brown all over. Step 3: Meanwhile, cook the rice following pack instructions. Return the onion to the pan, adding the tomatoes, as well as a can full of water. Simmer for 5 mins, then add the kidney beans and cook for a further 10 mins, until the sauce has thickened and the meatballs are cooked through. Season the meatballs, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice.

Dish Name: Spicy Hearty Mexican Ground Turkey Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, yellow onions, garlic, ground turkey, serrano peppers, fresh cilantro, stewed tomatoes, fresh corn kernels, button mushrooms, chipotle powder, limes, low sodium chicken broth, salt, pepper, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a 4 quart soup pot on medium high. Step 2: Sautee onions and garlic until soft and transparent. Step 3: Push it to the side and add ground turkey. Step 4: Cook until nicely browned and mix with onion mixture. Step 5: Add serrano peppers, cilantro, stewed tomatoes and corn, cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 6: Add mushrooms, chipotle chile powder, lime juice and chicken broth. Step 7: Bring to boil, lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, olive oil, refried beans, tomatoes, rotel tomatoes, chicken broth, tortilla chips, sour cream, cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onions and garlic in oil until transparent. Step 2: Add all of the rest of the ingredients. Step 3: Stir the lumps out of the refried beans and heat through. Step 4: Garnish individual servings with crushed tortilla chips. Step 5: I like Tostitos with Hint of Lime--mmmm, sour cream. Step 6: Shredded cheese-- any kind.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, tomatoes, fresh corn, black beans, kidney beans, envelope ranch dressing mix, envelope taco seasoning, onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker, cover. Step 2: Cook on low 4 to 6 hours. Step 3: Garnish individual servings with tortilla or corn chips, cheese and sour cream.

Ingredient Names: fat-free refried beans, hot taco sauce, taco cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Take one flour tortilla, put it on a microwaveable plate and spread a layer of refried beans in the middle of the tortilla leaving lots of room free on the sides for easy rolling I put on about 2t, my husband maybe 3t of beans. Step 2: Pour a strip of taco sauce long ways down the beans, about 1-2t Grab a handful of cheese and put on top of the beans and sauce, about 1 / 4 cup Microwave 30 seconds on high. Step 3: Roll it up like a burrito and microwave 20-30 seconds more. Step 4: Repeat for remaining tortillas, or for however many you can eat All ingredients can stay in fridge for later Enjoy while piping hot!

Ingredient Names: zucchini, red peppers, onions, fresh basil, fresh cilantro, lime, vinegar, bell peppers, jalapeno, chipotle chiles in adobo, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place all in a large pot bringing to a boil then reduce and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 2: Fill into hot sterile jars leaving 1 / 2 inch head space Being careful not to leave any salsa on the rims Wipe jar rims with a clean, damp paper towel. Step 3: Put on lids and screw on metal bands Process for 10 minutes in a hot water bath Label and store in a dark place Use with 1 year.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, chili, cumin, red bell pepper, button mushrooms, kidney beans, refried beans, diced tomatoes, tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and saute onion, garlic, chilli and cumin until fragrant and soft. Step 2: Add bell pepper and mushrooms, saute until soft. Step 3: Add both types of beans and the tomatoes. Step 4: Bring to the boil then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Serve with warm tortillas and other fillings at the table for people to wrap into burritos.

Dish Name: 3 Ingredient Fabulous Salsa Delicious Fresh And So Easy
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, garlic, jalapenos
Instructions: Step 1: Core the tomatoes Dig the cloves from the head of garlic. Step 2: Chop the stem off the jalapeos Throw the cored tomatoes, the cloves of garlic, and the stemless jalapeos into a pot of water. Step 3: Bring it to a boil, and turn down to medium / high heat. Step 4: Turn burner off when tomatoes start to peel, usually in 30-40 minutes on the stove. Step 5: Drain tomatoes, garlic, and jalapeo and let cool Throw ingredients into a blender or food processor and pulsate until desired consistency. Step 6: Add salt if desired.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, refried beans, taco sauce, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, green onion, crushed red pepper flakes, four-cheese mexican blend cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 f. Step 2: Place tortillas on baking sheet. Step 3: Bake for 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp. Step 4: Spread refried beans evenly on tortillas. Step 5: Spread 1 tablespoon taco sauce over beans. Step 6: Top with bell peppers, green onions and crushed red pepper. Step 7: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 8: Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until cheese is melted. Step 9: Cut into wedges A pizza cutter works great for this.

Ingredient Names: red ripe tomatoes, onion, fresh cilantro, fresh parsley, garlic, fresh cracked pepper, salt, ground cumin, serrano chili, jalapeno, lime, sun-dried tomato packed in oil, brown sugar, chipotle chile in adobo, adobo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Main tomato salsa: Mix all ingredients together and chill for flavors to meld Smoky and spicy salsa: Add the ingredients to the main salsa Depending on how smoky and spicy you can add the ingredients to 1 / 3 to all the main salsa Spiked fruity salsa: Pour the lime vodka over the mango and cucumbers let sit for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add the ingredients to the main salsa Your choice of how much main salsa you add to it Guacamole:.

Dish Name: 5 Minute Easy Vegan Chicken Guacamole Tacos
Ingredient Names: taco shells, avocado, garlic clove, onion, vegetarian chicken pieces, tomatoes, salt, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine avacado, salt, lemon juice, garlic, and onion Mush into a paste Microwave nuggets for 1 minute and then chop. Step 2: Fill shells with guacamole, 'chicken', and top with tomatoes! Step 3: Serve with whatever you like Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: refried black beans, salsa, sour cream, guacamole, lettuce, beefsteak tomatoes, cheddar cheese, black olives, pimento stuffed olives, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In large mixing bowl, combine refried beans and salsa Consistency should be that of cake frosting--spreadable but not thick Adjust amount of salsa accordingly. Step 2: Spread bean and salsa mixture onto serving platter. Step 3: Layer remaining ingredients. Step 4: Serve with baked tostitos scoops tortilla chips Even my green-veggie-phobic children devour this dish! Step 5: This recipe is moderately spicy Change the heat of the salsa to adjust You could also top with jalapenos or other hot peppers to add more heat I sometimes use different greens instead of iceberg lettuce and use different cheeses.

Ingredient Names: goat cheese, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, fresh ground black pepper, flour tortillas, onions, tomatoes, fresh spinach, cilantro, chives, jalapeno peppers, garlic cloves, parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 425f. Step 2: In a blender, puree the goat cheese, cottage cheese, half of the mozzarella cheese, and pepper to taste. Step 3: Spread half of the cheese mixture on each tortilla to 1 / 2" inside the edge. Step 4: Sprinkle half of each remaining ingredient over each tortilla. Step 5: Place one tortilla on a cookie sheet. Step 6: Place the other on top of it. Step 7: Sprinkle the top with the remaining mozzarella. Step 8: Bake 8-10 minutes, or until cheese begins to brown. Step 9: Slice into four wedges and serve warm Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: hunts tomato sauce, garlic granules, chili flakes, onion, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients in a bowl Refrigerate for at least an hour for best taste Be warned, the longer it sits the hotter it gets It's yummy!

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, sweet onion, dried oregano, chili powder, dried basil, ground black pepper, salt, ground cumin, dried parsley, taco sauce, tomato sauce, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and saute for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the onion, oregano, chili powder basil, ground black pepper salt cumin, parsley, taco sauce, and tomato sauce 2. Step 4: Mix together and then stir in the broth. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: pineapple juice, grapefruit juice, coconut milk, cream
Instructions: Step 1: Shake all of the ingredients together with ice in a cocktail shaker or a jar with lid Strain into a cocktail glass and serve Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: annatto seeds, cumin seeds, black pepper, allspice berries, salt, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients into a spice grinder, and grind until you have a fine powder. Step 2: Take the powder and put it into a bowl and add teaspoons of water at a time until you get a thick paste which binds together, in a putty like consistency Separate into tablespoon size portions and freeze individually.
