Step 3: When you want to use it, mix the tb size portion with 10 cloves of garlic crushed, and 4 tb seville orange juice and marinade pork or chicken overnight Some might say to add tequila, but that is an americanization of this yucatecan specialty Annato seeds are very, very hard, and are difficult to grind with a mortar and pestle, use the grinder or it won't make a paste They do, and will stain your grinder, and anything you happen to spill it on, be careful You can double, or mul About 4x this recipe It freezes very well, and will last the year in the freezer no problem.

Dish Name: Adobo Chips With Warm Goat Cheese And Cilantro Salsa
Ingredient Names: chipotle chiles in adobo, fresh cilantro, tomatillo, red onion, fresh lime juice, olive oil, adobo sauce, paprika, cumin, white corn tortillas, low-fat cream cheese, goat cheese
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare salsa: Finely chop the chipotle peppers to measure 2 teaspoons. Step 2: Remove 1 teaspoon adobo sauce from can, and set aside. Step 3: Combine chiles, cilantro, tomatillos, onion, and 1 / 4 cup lime juice in a medium bowl. Step 4: Cover and chill for 1 hour. Step 5: Preheat oven to 375 To prepare chips: Combine 2 1 / 2 teaspoons lime juice, olive oil, adobo sauce, paprika, and cumin in a small bowl, stirring with a whisk. Step 6: Brush 1 tortilla with about 1 / 4 teaspoon juice mixture, spreading to edge. Step 7: Top with another tortilla.

Ingredient Names: garlic, salt, dried mexican oregano, ground cumin, dried thyme, red wine vinegar, orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together and use on meats, chicken, tempeh, or fish.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, tomatoes, rice, oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Blend in the blender the garlic and tomato till pured. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet. Step 3: Add rice Toast until light brown, being careful not to burn. Step 4: Add water and pured mixture. Step 5: Cover and turn down to simmer. Step 6: Cook for 15 minutes or till all water is absorbed.

Dish Name: Agua De Arroz Mexican Rice Water
Ingredient Names: white rice, water, cinnamon stick, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all together ingredients and let stand 3 hours. Step 2: Simmer for 1 / 2 hour. Step 3: Let cool, then puree in a blender and strain through a cloth or fine-mesh strainer. Step 4: Taste for sweetness and add sugar if necessary. Step 5: Chill and serve over ice.

Ingredient Names: rice, ground cinnamon, vanilla, sweetened condensed milk, water
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse the rice in a colander. Step 2: Place in a blender and add enough water to cover by an inch. Step 3: Soak 5 or 10 minutes. Step 4: Add the vanilla and cinnamon and blend until finely ground. Step 5: Drain the liquid through colander into a pitcher. Step 6: Return the ground rice to the blender. Step 7: Add the condensed milk and about 2 cups water and blend again. Step 8: Drain into the pitcher. Step 9: Discard any remaining rice. Step 10: Add more water to the pitcher, one cup at a time, until it has the right amount of sweetness for you.

Ingredient Names: watermelon, water, sugar, ice cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Remove rind from watermelon, and cut into chunks In batches, blend water, sugar, watermelon and ice in a blender Pour into a large pitcher.

Dish Name: Agua Fresca De Melon Watermelon Sparkling Water
Ingredient Names: watermelon, fresh mint leaves, sparkling water, sugar, ice cube, mint sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Whirl melon in blender in batches, adding mint leaves to one of the batches. Step 2: Pour puree into large pitcher, stir in sparkling water and add sugar to taste. Step 3: Chill at least one hour. Step 4: Pour over ice in tall glasses and garnish with mint sprig.

Ingredient Names: papayas, sugar, lime juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Choose very ripe fruit Peel, seed, and coarsely chop Smoothly puree measured fruit pulp and juice in blender with sugar and lime juice. Step 2: Add flavored fruit mixture to water, then rub through a fine strainer into a large jar or pitcher and discard pulp. Step 3: Pour the agua fresca over ice cubes into tall glasses Slices or chunks of matching fruit may be added as garnish just before serving.

Dish Name: Agua Fresca Flor De Jamaica Hibiscus Flower Iced Tea
Ingredient Names: dried hibiscus flowers, cold water, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put flowers and 3 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil Continue boiling approximately 5 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat and add remaining cup of water and sugar. Step 3: Set aside at least 4 hours. Step 4: Strain into a pitcher and refrigerate. Step 5: Serve well-chilled.

Dish Name: Alan's Vegetarian Vegan Bean And Rice Burger Mashup
Ingredient Names: black beans, pinto beans, brown rice, breadcrumbs, picante sauce, chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt, black pepper, garlic, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: 1) soak beans in a large pot, covered 2) drain beans and refill pot with fresh water, cover, bring to a boil again, simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours. Step 2: Drain again and let cool at room temperature for at least 5-10 minutes 3) about halfway through the cook time for the beans, start cooking the brown rice. Step 3: Add 4 cups of water and 2 cups rice to a pot, covered. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then simmer for 30-40 minutes 4) combine all seasonings and breadcrumbs in a large bowl 5) once both the rice and beans have cooled enough to be able to mix by hand, combine the beans and rice 6) combine all of the dry seasoning with the beans and rice mixture 7) start mashing! Step 5: I start off using a potato masher, but always end up using my hands to get the beans and rice mashed up enough.

Ingredient Names: semi-sweet chocolate chips, pine nuts, red chili powder, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Heat condensed milk in the top of a double boiler. Step 2: Heat until very warm, but not boiling. Step 3: Add chocolate chips and stir until melted. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients and stir until thoroughly mixed and smooth. Step 5: Turn out into a 9 inch x 9 inch square pan. Step 6: Cool in the refrigerator until hardened. Step 7: Using a sharp narrow knife, cut into 1x1 inch squares. Step 8: Store in an airtight container in one layer.

Dish Name: Alligator Claws Avocado Fritters With Chipotle Lime Dip
Ingredient Names: creme fraiche, lime, ground chipotle chile pepper, flour, water, hass avocadoes, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dip: Put the crme frache into a medium-sized mixing bowl Zest the lime finely and mix the zest into the crme frache. Step 2: Roll the lime on your counter, placing enough pressure to soften the pulp inside without breaking the lime's skin. Step 3: Cut the lime in half and squeeze the juice from one half, reserving the other half for another use While stirring, slowly add the juice to the crme frache until you get a consistency just the runny side of mayonnaise. Step 4: Add a couple of pinches of ground chipotle, stir in and taste, repeating until you have both a heat and smokiness you like If you are making this a day or two ahead of time, stop adding the chile when you are just shy of how strong you think you'd like it to be It will get stronger overnight Fritters:.

Ingredient Names: almonds, flour, salt, egg yolks, amaretto, vanilla extract, sugar, egg whites, cream of tartar, strawberry, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 f Butter and flour a 10 inch bundt pan. Step 2: Stir together the almonds, flour and salt, set aside. Step 3: Beat the egg yolks at high speed using an electric mixer for about 6 minutes or until they are thick and lightly colored. Step 4: Add the amaretto and vanilla Gradually add 1 / 3 cup sugar, beating until it is dissolved. Step 5: Set this mixture aside. Step 6: Wash and dry the beaters thoroughly. Step 7: In a large bowl, combine the egg whites and cream of tartar and beat until soft peaks form.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, zucchini, onion, vegetable oil, salsa, water, sliced almonds, cheddar cheese, chilies, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap tortillas in foil. Step 2: Bake at 375f 10-15 minutes or until soft and heated through Can also be wrapped in plastic wrap and microwaved for 1-2 minutes on high until soft While tortillas heat, saute zucchini, onion and canned chilies in oil for three minutes on medium heat. Step 3: Reduce heat to low, add water and salsa, cover and cook for three minutes, stir in almonds, remove from heat. Step 4: Spoon 1 / 2 cup vegetable mixture down center of each tortilla. Step 5: Divide cheese into sixths and sprinkle on top of vegetable mixture. Step 6: Roll up tortillas.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, lime, kosher salt, ground cumin, cayenne, onion, roma tomatoes, cilantro, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Wash and prepare produce. Step 2: Put avocado innards and lime juice into a large bowl, toss to coat. Step 3: Add salt, cumin, and cayenne, and mash with a potato masher or whatever you can find to mash it with. Step 4: Fold in onions, tomatoes, cilantro, and garlic. Step 5: Let sit at room temp temperature for an hour, then serve.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, tomato paste, onions, garlic cloves, jalapeno peppers, green peppers, kosher salt, vinegar, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients into a large pan Simmer 30 minutes Pour into canning jars put the lids and rings on and process the method you like best.

Ingredient Names: ancho chilies, dried chipotle chiles, boiling water, red bell peppers, cloves, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, sunflower seeds, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, tomato paste, bittersweet chocolate, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, cover the anchos and chipotles with the boiling water. Step 2: Let soak for 30 minutes, until softened. Step 3: Drain, reserving the liquid. Step 4: Discard the stems, cores and seeds Coarsely chop the chiles. Step 5: Preheat the broiler or light a gas flame Char the peppers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred all over. Step 6: Transfer to a medium bowl, cover with plastic and let steam for 5 minutes Peel the peppers and discard the skin, stems and seeds, then coarsely chop. Step 7: In a small dry skillet, toast the cloves, cumin and cinnamon stick over moderately low heat until darkened and fragrant, 1 1 / 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: club soda, lime juice, orange juice, juice, ice cubes, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Pour club soda, lime juice, orange juice, and grenadine juice all together over ice Stir Garnish with a lime wedge.

Ingredient Names: midori melon liqueur, blue curacao, banana liqueur, lemon juice, soda water
Instructions: Step 1: Mix togher the midori, blue curacao and banana liqueur together over ice Add a dash of lemon juice Top with the soda water Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: cornflour, egg yolk, water, salt, cheese, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the water and the egg yolk. Step 2: In a large bowl mix the flour and the egg / water mixture. Step 3: Mix and kneed the dough for about 5 minutes until it is compact. Step 4: Cover with a damp cloth and set aside for 5 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile heat a deep fryer to 170c, or fill a frying pan with lots of oil and heat. Step 6: Take a small ball of the dough, the size of an egg and mold into a flat circle, about 1 cm thick. Step 7: Fry until golden brown, turning regularly. Step 8: Turn out onto crumpled absorbent paper and leave to cool slightly Split them open and fill with cheese, ham, butter, honey or whatever you wish. Step 9: Serve immediately--they don't keep and don't re-heat.

Ingredient Names: avocados, onion, lemon juice, chili powder, cumin, tabasco sauce, salt, tomatoes, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Peel tomato and cut off top Scoop out pulp Peel and dice the avocados, add lemon juice and coat well add onion, chili, cumin tabasco, and salt. Step 2: Stuff tomato with avocado mixture, chill for at least 1 / 2 hour and serve over lettuce.

Dish Name: Arriba Baked Winter Squash Mexican Style
Ingredient Names: winter squash, mexican seasoning, mixed spice, honey, butter, olive oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Make a choice and proceed with recipe Depending on size of squash, cut into half or fourths. Step 2: Remove seeds For spicy squash, drizzle olive oil or melted butter over each cut squash piece. Step 3: Season with mexican seasoning mix ii For sweet squash, drizzle melted honey, butter, grated piloncillo over each cut squash piece. Step 4: Season with sweet mexican spice mix. Step 5: Bake at 350 degrees, again depending on size, for 40 minutes up to an hour, until a fork can easily pierce the skin Be careful not to burn the squash especially if you opt to use sugar or butter If you feel more comfortable, cover the squash with aluminum foil the first half hour, give or take, of baking.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, poblano peppers, jalapeno, scallions, fresh cilantro, fresh parsley, salt, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, parboiled rice, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Place the peppers, scallions, parsley, cilantro, garlic, and salt in a food processor and process until smooth. Step 2: Add a little water if needed. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Step 4: Add the rice and stir to coat all the grains. Step 5: Cook, stirring for about 2 minutes more. Step 6: Add the ingredients from the blender to the rice and stir two more minutes, to incorporate well. Step 7: Add the chicken broth or water. Step 8: Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Step 9: Cover and cook until the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Step 10: Turn the heat off and stir in the lime juice, making sure it's evenly dispersed.

Ingredient Names: fresh parsley leaves, fresh cilantro leaves, white onion, water, green chili pepper, lime juice, garlic cloves, olive oil, rice, vegetable broth, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender combine the parsley, cilantro, white onion, water, chili pepper, lime juice, and garlic Process until almost smooth If necessary, stop blender and scrape down sides. Step 2: In a large saute pan heat the olive oil on medium heat. Step 3: Saute the rice for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Step 4: Heat up the broth and add to the rice along with the cilantro / parsley mixture. Step 5: Cover pan and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to simmer and cook for approximately 20 minutes or unti rice is tender and liquid is absorded. Step 7: Once cooking is complete, turn off heat, keep pan on heating element for 10-15 minutes to allow rice grains to firm up. Step 8: Season with salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: artichoke bottoms, red onion, beefsteak tomato, fresh lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, toasted sesame oil, scallion, fresh cilantro leaves, coarse salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place artichoke bottoms in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the artichokes are very soft, about 20 minutes, drain. Step 3: When cool enough to handle, finely chop the artichokes and place in a medium-size mixing bowl. Step 4: Add the onion, tomato, lemon juice, olive oil, sesame oil, scallions, cilantro, salt, and pepper and gently mash with a fork Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, asparagus, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, salt and pepper, olive oil, salsa, avocado, green onion, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare grill For each taco, spread 1 / 4 of the cheeses and 4 pcs of the asparagus on each tortilla, then season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Fold in half and lightly brush the outside with olive oil. Step 3: Grill for 3 minutes on each side or until the tortilla is crispy and cheese has melted. Step 4: Add any optional ingredients.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, white wine, vanilla pod, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan Simmer over low heat until liquid is almost evaporated Remove vanilla and puree in food processor.

Ingredient Names: onion, black beans, salsa, lime, fresh cilantro, whole wheat tortillas, low-fat mexican cheese, cooked brown rice, lettuce, cooked chicken breast, cooked beef, avocado, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Coat a large nonstick skillet with olive oil and heat over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook until soft. Step 3: Add the beans, salsa, lime juice, and cilantro. Step 4: Cook, stirring until heated through. Step 5: Meanwhile, fry or heat the tortillas as desired. Step 6: Place the tortillas on individual plates and spoon bean mixture on each. Step 7: Add cheese and desired toppings.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lime juice, garlic clove, cilantro, green onion, cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avocados into halves Pit and peel the avocado halves. Step 2: Combine avocados and remaining ingredients in medium-large bowl With a fork, mash avocados and mix in ingredients to desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, sour cream, fresh basil, garlic, fresh lemon juice, fresh lime juice, jalapeno pepper, shallot, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, coarsely mash the avocados with a fork. Step 2: Fold in the sour cream, basil, garlic, lemon juice, lime juice, chile and shallot. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper and serve The avocado aioli may be made ahead and can be covered with plastic wrap, pressed directly onto the surface and refrigerated overnight.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, avocado, goat cheese, red onion, cumin seed, lemon juice, hot sauce, salt, black pepper, fresh cilantro, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Bake corn tortillas on a baking sheet for 15-20 minutes or until crisp. Step 3: Grate goat cheese if necessary, and mash with avocado in a small bowl. Step 4: Add onion, cumin seeds, lemon juice, tabasco, salt, and pepper, mixing well. Step 5: Top tortillas with mixture, dividing evenly. Step 6: Place one tablespoon of sour cream on top of each filled tortilla. Step 7: Garnish with a little cilanto, and serve.

Ingredient Names: avocados, goat cheese, lime, garlic, chilies, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut avocados in half with knife and separate. Step 2: Remove seed, and with a large spoon, scoop out flesh into a bowl. Step 3: Squeeze the lime juice over the avocado and mash the flesh with a fork. Step 4: Stir in remaining ingredients. Step 5: Serve immediately or store refrigerated, with one of the avocado seeds pressed into the dip to help retain its color Goes well with tortilla chips, warm tortillas, toasted pita bread, fresh veggies and crudites, as a topping for chimichangas, whatever you desire Just don't go putting dallops into your margaritas!

Ingredient Names: tomatillo, garlic, avocados, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh lime juice, red onion, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Remove husks and rinse tomatillos under warm water to remove stickiness. Step 2: Heat a well-seasoned cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until hot and lightly brown tomatillos and garlic, careful not to burn. Step 3: Cool to room temperature. Step 4: In a food processor pure tomatillos and garlic until smooth Halve and pit avocados and scoop into tomatillo mixture Pulse until coarsely chopped. Step 5: Stir in cilantro, lime juice, onion, salt and pepper. Step 6: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, lemon, hot sauce, extra virgin olive oil, plum tomatoes, scallions, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Cut into and all around the pit of each avocado, down to the pits Twist the avocados and separate them Whack the corner of your knife into each pit and remove it. Step 2: Using a large spoon, scoop out each avocado half and arrange them on a plate Dress the avocados with lemon juice, a few drops of hot sauce and a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil. Step 3: Combine the tomatoes and scallions and season with salt. Step 4: Fill the avocados with plum tomatoes and serve.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, lime, green onions, parsley, cilantro, jalapeno, cashews, sour cream, garlic clove, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mash avocados and add lime juice. Step 2: Add green onions through garlic, mix well. Step 3: Fill a 7 x 11 inch baking dish with half of enchilada sauce. Step 4: Heat tortilla in microwave, in a lightly oiled skillet, or over a gas burner for 15 seconds, or until flexible. Step 5: Place 1 / 2 cup filling in tortilla and roll up. Step 6: Place seam side down in dish. Step 7: Repeat with remaining tortillas. Step 8: Pour rest of sauce over tortillas and top with cheese. Step 9: Bake covered at 350 for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, fresh lime juice, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cilantro leaf, red jalapeno chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange avocado slices on a serving dish Sprinkle with lime juice and season with salt and pepper Sprinkle with cilantro leaves and jalapeos Serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, salt, tomatoes, avocados, scallions, garlic clove, extra virgin olive oil, ground cumin, boston lettuce, cucumber, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium glass or ceramic bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons lime juice and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt. Step 2: Add tomatoes, avocados, scallions and garlic. Step 3: Using rubber spatula, gently fold to combine. Step 4: Season to taste with pepper In large bowl, whisk together olive oil, cumin, remaining tablespoon lime juice and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt. Step 5: Add lettuce and toss. Step 6: Season to taste with pepper. Step 7: Divide lettuce among plates. Step 8: Top each with mound of avocado mixture. Step 9: Top with cucumber slices.

Ingredient Names: avocado, mango, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place lettuce leaves on 4 salad plates. Step 2: Top with wedges of avocado. Step 3: Sprinkle with diced mango In small bowl, combine cumin, chili powder and garlic powder. Step 4: Mix with fork until blended. Step 5: Using fingers pinch spices lightly over avocado and mango to taste, serve.

Ingredient Names: avocado, lemon, salt, cayenne pepper, extra virgin olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the avocado and cut it in half Scoop out the flesh and put it into the blender. Step 2: Add lemon juice, salt, and cayenne pepper and blend together With blender running, add olive oil slowly You many have to stop the machine several times to redistribute ingredients. Step 3: Puree to a smooth creamy mixture Makes 3 / 4 cup.

Dish Name: Avocado Salad With Cumin Lime Mayo Dressing
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, mayonnaise, fresh lime juice, honey, ground cumin, salt and pepper, iceberg lettuce, avocados, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a glass or woodenbowl, whisk together olive oil, mayonnaise, lime juice, honey and cumin. Step 2: Season with salt and pepper. Step 3: In a large bowl, combine the lettuce with the dressing. Step 4: Top with the avocado pieces, serve and enjoy!

Dish Name: Avocado Salad With Hearts Of Palm
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, garlic, lemon, sugar, salt, olive oil, lettuce, avocado, hearts of palm, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: Dressing: Mix all the ingredients in a blender or food processor Salad: Arrange the lettuce on four small plates. Step 2: Stir together the avocado, hearts of palm and onion in a small bowl. Step 3: Stir in enough dressing to just wet the ingredients. Step 4: Arrange in mounds atop the lettuce, serve.

Ingredient Names: avocado, lime, salt, jalapeno, cilantro, cold water, olive oil, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Put the avocado, lime juice, salt, jalapeno, cilantro, water and olive oil in a food processor. Step 2: Puree until smooth. Step 3: Add the onion and pulse to roughly blend inches. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: hass avocado, tomatoes, romaine lettuce, salsa, red wine vinegar, red onions, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place lettuce on on plate. Step 2: Top with sliced tomatoes. Step 3: Sprinkle vinegar May not need all, just eyeball it, top with salsa. Step 4: Place avocado in fan shape atop salad and tomato mixture. Step 5: Sprinkle red onion on top Salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: avocado, bread, lemon, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mash the avocado and spread it evenly on the toast pieces Squirt the lemon juice over the avocado Salt and pepper Eat immediately before it gets soggy This dish is best prepared by the person eating it so they are available to eat it right away!

Dish Name: Avocado Tomato And Mozzarella Tower Salad
Ingredient Names: fresh mozzarella cheese, avocados, tomatoes, salt, balsamic vinegar, baby greens, hot chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a 3-inch ring mold, layer 1 / 4 cup mozzarella, 1 / 3 cup avocado and 1 / 4 cup tomato. Step 2: Repeat in remaining ring molds. Step 3: Using a spatula, slide each mold onto a rack over a sheet pan to drain. Step 4: Refrigerate until serving. Step 5: Place baby greens on plates, invert ring mold onto salads. Step 6: Place balsamic vinegar and chili oil on table to pass around Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: avocados, garlic cloves, cumin, fresh cilantro, grape tomatoes, red onion, black olives, feta cheese, lime, italian dressing
Instructions: Step 1: Toss everything together gently, chill for a couple of hours and serve with tortilla chips!

Ingredient Names: lime peel, lime juice, brown sugar, olive oil, fresh parsley, jalapeno peppers, avocados
Instructions: Step 1: In a small browl, combine lime peel, lime juice, brown sugar, oil, parsley and chili peppers Whish until well combined. Step 2: Spoon over avocados. Step 3: Serve as a tangy side salad to fish, shellfish, chicken or meat dishes.

Dish Name: Award Winning Cinco De Mayo Guacamole With Blue Cheese And Sage
Ingredient Names: avocados, vegetarian bacon, blue cheese, red onion, roma tomato, jalapeno pepper, cumin powder, kosher salt, garlic, lime, fresh cilantro, tabasco sauce, chili powder, dried sage, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine onion, tomato, jalapeno, cilantro, cumin powder, kosher salt and garlic in a bowl. Step 2: Mix well, cover, and sit in refrigerator for at least 60 minutes. Step 3: Chop 1 avocado into small chunks. Step 4: Add to bowl with other ingredients Mush remaining 2 avocados and add to bowl, fold into mixture. Step 5: Add blue cheese and bacon crumbles. Step 6: Fold again, try not to stir the guacamole up too much, as you want to maintain the firmness of the avocados as much as possible. Step 7: Add tabasco, chipolte powder, sage and six pepper blend to taste. Step 8: Fold in as necessary.

Dish Name: Awesome White Cheese And Chocolate Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, mexican blend cheese, green onions, olive oil, onion, garlic, dried oregano, ground cumin, cinnamon, flour, chili powder, vegetable stock, semisweet chocolate
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce: saute onion in oil until tender. Step 2: Add garlic, oregano, cumin and cinnamon. Step 3: Saute together for a few minutes. Step 4: Stir in flour and chili powder, coating onion mixture Slowly whisk in vegetable stock. Step 5: Reduce until sauce thickens, whisking frequently. Step 6: Stir in semisweet chocolate until melted and smooth Assemble enchiladas: steam or soften tortillas in a lightly greased skillet. Step 7: Roll up 1 / 2 cup of cheese in each corn tortilla. Step 8: Sprinkle with green onions and pour sauce over.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, eggs, milk, salt, bacon, cheese, salsa, sour cream, taco shell
Instructions: Step 1: Cover a large baking sheet with sides with foil & lay out sliced bacon strips. Step 2: Put into a cold oven & turn the heat to 400f cook about 20 minutes Be careful not to overcook / overcrisp, heat skillet. Step 3: Melt butter in skillet. Step 4: Saute onion over medium low heat until soft, brown & caramelized Do not skimp on this step. Step 5: Beat eggs with milk, add salt. Step 6: Add to onions & cook until set, occasionally scraping up from the bottom.

Dish Name: Baja Black Beans Corn And Rice
Ingredient Names: cooked brown rice, black beans, corn, fresh tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, jalapeno pepper, fresh lime juice, olive oil, salt, fresh ground pepper, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook brown rice. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine black beans, corn, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, jalapeno, lime juice, oil, salt, pepper and hot sauce To serve, place a scoop of hot rice in a bowl or on a plate, top with a generous scoop of the black bean mixture. Step 3: Stir together before eating.

Ingredient Names: onion, zucchini, red sweet bell pepper, garlic cloves, green chili pepper, olive oil, tofu, canned spinach, vegan egg replacer powder, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, dried oregano, paprika, dried parsley, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion, zucchini, pepper, garlic and chile in olive oil at medium heat until onion is approaching translucence. Step 2: Mash together tofu, spinach, egg replacer, cilantro, dried spices. Step 3: Add the juice from the lime wedges. Step 4: Add tofu mash to the onion-veggie-garlic-chile mix and fry at slightly lower heat, till everything is hot, tender and mixed together. Step 5: Add soy sauce and black pepper as needed Garish, and serve.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat bread, low-fat cream cheese, avocado, taco sauce, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Spread cream cheese on both pieces of bread. Step 2: Put avocado on top of cream cheese on one piece of bread. Step 3: Squeeze lemon over avocado, sprinkle salt, and then drizzle with taco sauce. Step 4: Put other piece of bread on top Optional: make a bunch, cut into squares or other shapes and serve as finger sandwiches Fun for cinco de mayo!

Ingredient Names: strawberry, mango, jicama, red bell pepper, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly stir together all ingredients in a medium bowl Salad may be served immediately or covered and refrigerated for several hours.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, carrot, apple cider vinegar, pickled jalapeno peppers, salt, fresh ground black pepper, soy yogurt, lime juice, oil, fresh cilantro leaves, beer, garlic cloves, soy sauce, chili powder, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare the slaw first: mix first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Step 2: Cover and place in fridge Weigh down slaw with canned beans or full pickle jar Slaw improves the longer it's allowed to mellow. Step 3: Allow to press for at least 1 hour. Step 4: When ready to use, squeeze out handfuls to release any excess juice. Step 5: Make the lime cream: blend ingredients from yogurt to 1 / 2 t salt in a blender until creamy and smooth. Step 6: Add more salt or lime juice to taste, if desired. Step 7: Pour into an airtight container and chill for 1 hour. Step 8: Make the marinade: whisk together ingredients from beer to cumin and pour into a glass pie plate or casserole dish.

Ingredient Names: red chili peppers, olive oil, onion, garlic, cumin, tomatoes, broth, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, zucchini, corn, salt and pepper, black beans, kidney bean, cider vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet, roast chilies for 20-30 seconds over high heat. Step 2: Remove from heat and let cool. Step 3: In a large pot, heat 2 tsp olive oil over medium-high heat and sautee onions until golden. Step 4: Add garlic and cumin and cook, stirring constantly for about 30 seconds. Step 5: Add tomatoes, broth and chilies. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally In batches in a blender or with a stick blender, puree the soup. Step 7: Pour through a fine sieve, cheesecloth or food mill, if desired. Step 8: In a skillet, heat 2 tsp olive oil over medium-high heat. Step 9: Add bell peppers, zucchini and corn.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, water, sugar, light corn syrup, baking soda, dark brown sugar, pecans, butter, flour, baking apples, apple cider
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the cajeta, combine the milk, sugar and corn syrup in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: When the mixture comes to a boil, add the baking soda which should cause the brew to become quite bubbly. Step 3: Lower the heat to acheive a steady but slow simmer. Step 4: Cook for 60 minutes Initially, you can stir occasionally, but as the syrup thickens and becomes caramel colored you will need to stir more often. Step 5: When done, cajeta will have the of a very thick syrup like one you might use on top of ice cream Indeed, it's great on ice cream so if you have leftovers -- The cajeta can be made well in advance and can keep for a month or more if stored properly Just cool and store in the fridge in a tightly covered container Rewarm before serving, adding a bit of milk or water as needed to thin it.

Ingredient Names: whole green chilies, monterey jack cheese, butter, eggs, milk, all-purpose flour, baking powder, sharp cheddar cheese, marinara sauce, pitted ripe olives
Instructions: Step 1: Cut a slit down the side of each chile and remove seeds and pith. Step 2: Fold or stuff equal lamounts of cheese inside each chile. Step 3: Arrange chiles side by side in a lightly buttered shallow 3-quart casserole or 9x13-inch baking dish With an electric mixer, beat eggs until thick and foamy. Step 4: Add milk, flour, and baking power. Step 5: Beat until mixture is smooth. Step 6: Pour egg batter evenly over chiles and sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Step 7: Bake, uncovered, in a 375 degree f oven for about 30 minutes or until casserole is puffed and jiggles only slightly when gently shaken Just before casserole is ready, heat marinara sauce to simmering and place in a small serving bowl Quickly garnish hot casserole with olives and serve at once with marinara sauce.

Ingredient Names: bananas, orange zest, lime zest, fresh orange juice, fresh lime juice, raisins, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 2: In a shallow baking dish just large enough to hold them, arrange the bananas in a single layer. Step 3: In a small bowl, combine the zests, juices, raisins, vanilla, and cinnamon and whisk to blend. Step 4: Pour over the bananas and bake, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until the bananas are lightly browned and bubbling Use a spatula to put 3 banana pieces in the center of each plate and spoon the sauce from the dish over them.

Ingredient Names: black beans, cheese, cumin, coriander, chili powder, cayenne pepper, sour cream, jalapeno, fresh cilantro, lettuce, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Mix black beans with cumin, coriander, chili powder and cayenne pepper and spread over the bottom of an over-proof baking dish I don't usually measure the spices, so please use them to your own taste. Step 2: Sprinkle the grated cheese over top of the beans I usually sprinkle a little chili powder or cumin on top of the cheese to give it a little color. Step 3: Bake in preheated oven at 375f for 10-15 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbling slightly. Step 4: Remove from oven and spoon sour cream evenly over the top of the cheese. Step 5: Add shredded lettuce, jalapeos, and top with fresh cilantro. Step 6: Serve immediately with nacho chips for dipping.

Ingredient Names: prickly pears, sugar, butter, cinnamon, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Gather large ripe fruit. Step 2: Wash and slit to remove seeds. Step 3: Preheat oven to 325- 350 degrees. Step 4: Spread fruits in a sigle layer in a buttered 8 inch pan. Step 5: Combine sugar, cinnamon, and butter and mix well with fingers. Step 6: Add lemon juice and stir well with a spoon. Step 7: Sprinkle mixture evenly over fruits. Step 8: Bake 30- 35 minutes and serve warm with cream.

Ingredient Names: safflower oil, onion, red bell pepper, garlic, chili powder, cayenne, water, hot salsa, tofu sour cream, tempeh, whole wheat tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 Coat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick vegetable spray. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat Poach tempeh for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic to saucepan. Step 4: Cover and cook 5 minutes or until softened. Step 5: Stir in chili powder, cayenne, water, and salsa, and cook, stirring, until sightly thickened. Step 6: Remove from heat and add tofu sour cream. Step 7: Combine 2 cups sauce and tempeh. Step 8: Spoon a rounded 1 / 3 cup tempeh mixture onto each tortilla and roll up.

Ingredient Names: corn, black beans, salsa, firm tofu, salt, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce, cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Grease 2 9x13 baking dishes. Step 2: Combine beans, corn, salsa, tofu, and salt, mixing thoroughly. Step 3: Add 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 of the cheese, and mix it in with the rest. Step 4: Spoon some of the mixture into a warm tortilla and roll it up. Step 5: Place the seam side in the baking dish. Step 6: Pour enchilada sauce over enchiladas. Step 7: Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Step 8: Bake at 350f For 20 to 30 minutes If desired, garnish each enchilada with a dollop of sour cream.

Ingredient Names: water, butter, milk, all-purpose flour, baking powder, eggs, banana, oil, sugar, ground cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the water, butter and milk to a boil. Step 2: Add the flour and baking powder, stirring rapidly until a soft ball is formed and dough pulls away from the sides of the pan With an electric mixer, beat in the eggs one at a time and then add the banana. Step 3: Allow to cool for a few minutes and pipe into 2 - 4 inch tubes with a pastry bag filled with a star. Step 4: Fry in 350f oil until golden brown. Step 5: Combine the cinnamon and sugar or if you would like more of a pronounced banana flavor use plain granulated sugar While the churros are still warm, dust with cinnamon sugar.

Ingredient Names: banana, mango, milk, ice cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth Pour into 2 stemmed glasses.

Ingredient Names: bananas, ice, pineapple juice, coconut milk, lime, allspice, vanilla, spiced rum, colored crystal sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Add all ingredients to blender and blend until smooth Serve in glasses chilled in the freezer Dip rims in sugar before serving.

Ingredient Names: fat-free refried beans, kidney beans, beans, red capsicum, low-fat cheese, tortillas, tomato sauce, onion, corn kernel, vegetarian sausages, spices
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180c. Step 2: Put enchilladas in microwave for 1 minute to separate. Step 3: In a large bowl, mix together refried beans, kidney beans, mexican beans, diced capsicum And anything else you are adding Foil a baking tray and lay out the enchilladas on it. Step 4: Spoon enough of the mixture in to make a roll 1 inch in diameter. Step 5: Roll enchillada around and put seam down on tray Lay all enchilladas together on tray and pour over sauce and top with grated cheese. Step 6: Bake 10 minutes or until cheese is melted I've specifed a serve as 2, which does me, but 3 may be needed for larger appetities.

Ingredient Names: black beans, water, salt, ground black pepper, cumin, onion powder, garlic powder, bay leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse beans in a colander under running water, picking out any debris. Step 2: Place rinsed beans in a heavy pot filled with 6 cups of water and soak overnight. Step 3: Add bay leaf and 1 / 4 tsp each of cumin, onion powder, and garlic powder. Step 4: Bring just to a boil, then cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 2 hours, or until beans are tender. Step 5: Add 1 tsp salt and 1 / 2 tsp pepper Makes about 6 cups of cooked beans.

Ingredient Names: avocados, fresh basil, chopped tomato, green onions, fresh lime juice, salt, crushed red pepper flakes, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mash avocado with a fork. Step 2: Stir in basil, tomato, green onion, lime juice, salt, and red pepper. Step 3: Serve immediately with tortilla chips Makes about 2 cups.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, monterey jack cheese, corn, salsa, flour tortillas, sour cream, avocado, diced tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Heat refried beans, corn, and salsa in a small saucepan- stir to combine well. Step 2: Heat a skillet over medium heat Warm each tortilla for just a minute in the skillet. Step 3: Spread the corn, bean and salsa mix on 2 tortillas. Step 4: Add diced tomato and avocado if you like. Step 5: Sprinkle generously with cheese. Step 6: Top with the extra tortillas. Step 7: Heat about 3 minutes, flip, heat until all hot and melted Use a pizza cutter to cut into 8 wedges. Step 8: Garnish with sour cream and salsa.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, red cayenne pepper, ground cumin, vegetable stock, tomato juice, cornstarch, tomatoes, red beans, potatoes, fresh coriander, monterey jack cheese, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, hot pepper and cumin for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the vegetable stock and tomato juice, and let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 3: Mix the cornstarch with a bit of cold water and add to the sauce while stirring. Step 4: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 5: In a bowl, mix the tomato, beans, potatoes, coriander and cheese. Step 6: Divide this mixture among the tortillas, cover with a large tablespoon of the sauce and roll up. Step 7: Place the enchiladas in a lightly oiled rectangular ovenproof dish. Step 8: Cover the enchiladas with the remainder of the sauce and cook in the oven at 350 f for 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Serve immediately accompanied with your favourite garnish or dip.

Dish Name: Bean And Rice Stuffed Red Bell Peppers Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: red peppers, vegetarian chili, cooked rice, monterey jack cheese, diced tomatoes with green chilies, low-fat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the tops, membranes and seeds from the red peppers. Step 2: Stir together rice, chili, and 1 / 2 of the cheese. Step 3: Spoon into the peppers. Step 4: Pour the diced tomatoes and juice into a 5-6 quart crock pot Placed stuffed peppers filled side up into crock pot. Step 5: Cover and cook on low for 5 hours or high for 3 hours Scoop out peppers to a serving plate, spoon tomato sauce from the bottom of the crock pot over the peppers, and top with remaining grated cheese. Step 6: Serve with sour cream.

Ingredient Names: sweet potato, olive oil, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, onion, garlic cloves, chili, paprika, chopped tomatoes, red pepper, green pepper, red kidney beans, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: In a large baking dish, mix the sweet potato, 2 tblsp of oil, cumin and coriander seeds, and bake, uncovered, at 180c / 350f / gas mark 4, for 50-60 minutes until tender. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil gently in a pan and add the onion, garlic, chilli and paprika. Step 3: Cover and cook until the onion is soft, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add the tomatoes with their juice, and the peppers, and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes, stir in the beans. Step 5: Divide the corn chips between four individual ovenproof dishes, top with the bean mixture, then the sweet potato, and finish with the cheese. Step 6: Bake for 10 minutes until the nachos are well heated through, and the cheese has melted. Step 7: Serve sprinkled with coriander, with avocado and soured cream served separately I mashed it with a tblsp lemon juice, then i added a chopped fresh tomato, a few drops of hot pepper sauce, and some ground salt and pepper I beat some lemon juice into a cup of cream.

Ingredient Names: soft taco-size flour tortillas, enchilada sauce, refried beans, corn, monterey jack cheese, diced green chilis
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f coat the bottom of a 9 x 9 inches baking pan with enchilada sauce For each enchilada, brush both sides of the tortilla with enchilada sauce. Step 2: Place in prepared pan. Step 3: Spoon two large spoonfuls of beans into tortilla. Step 4: Spoon three spoonfuls of corn on top of beans. Step 5: Spread 1 / 2 cup of cheese over corn. Step 6: Sprinkle 2 tsp of chilies on top, if using, roll up enchilada. Step 7: Repeat for the other two enchiladas. Step 8: Pour the remaining enchilada sauce on the enchiladas.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, chopped tomatoes, tomato sauce, diced green chilies, fresh oregano, fresh basil, salt, black pepper, vegetarian refried beans, black beans, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in oil, just until softened. Step 2: Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, chilies, oregano, basil, salt, and pepper, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 5: Combine the black beans and refried beans in a bowl. Step 6: Combine both types of cheeses in a separate bowl. Step 7: Place 6 tablespoons or 1 / 10th of the beans and about 2 tablespoons of cheese in a tortilla. Step 8: Roll it up and place it in and ungreased 9 x 13 baking dish. Step 9: Repeat with all 10 tortillas.

Dish Name: Bean Dip Pantry Friendly Healthy Easy
Ingredient Names: garbanzo beans, fat-free refried beans, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Pour undrained garbanzos into a medium bowl Microwave on high for 2 minutes Smash garbanzos with masher & add refried beans & mix. Step 2: Cook 2 minutes more & smash & mix again. Step 3: Add tomatoes & mix. Step 4: Put dip into serving bowls & eat or let cool in fridge & eat later Variation: omit tomatoes & add 1tb garlic powder, 1tb lemon pepper & 1ts ground cumin.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red capsicums, red chilies, onions, celery, carrot, leeks, garlic cloves, bay leaf, thyme, fennel seed, fenugreek seeds, sweet smoked paprika, butter beans, red kidney beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stockpot, cook the chillies and capsicum in the olive oil over high heat for about 6-8 minutes, until the capsicum has blackened around the edges. Step 2: Add the other vegetables, and stir another 5-6 minutes on high heat. Step 3: Add the bay leaf and thyme and other spices and cook for another 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the three tins of beans and the tomatoes and tomato paste and stir well to combine. Step 5: Season well with salt and pepper, cover the whole mixture with water, then simmer for 30 minutes. Step 6: Serve over rice with diced avocado mixed with lime juice, a dollop of yoghurt, and sprinkle with coriander.

Ingredient Names: chipotle chile in adobo, jalapeno, garlic cloves, cumin, red pepper flakes, lime, orange zest, fresh cilantro, scallions, salsa, celery, red bell pepper, black beans, pinto beans, chickpeas
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together and chill for at least 1 hour for flavors to blend.

Ingredient Names: black beans, pinto beans, chipotle chiles in adobo, green chilies, whole wheat panko, fresh lemon juice, cheddar cheese, garlic cloves, egg, honey, lawry's seasoned salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mash your black beans and pinto beans together in a large bowl with a potato masher or fork. Step 2: Chop your adobo peppers then stir them and the green chiles into the beans. Step 3: Mix in cheese, panko bread crumbs, and garlic, in a small bowl. Step 4: Beat your egg then beat in the honey, lemon juice, lawry's, and pepper. Step 5: Add the egg mixture to the bean mixture and blend well Form mix into 6 patties and place them on a lightly greased baking sheet. Step 6: Set the oven to low broil with the rack in 2nd position from the top Broil burgers for 10 minutes then flip them over and broil 10 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: black beans, kidney beans, sweet corn, olive oil, roma tomatoes, garlic cloves, cooking onion, fresh jalapenos, lime, fresh cilantro, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a big pot. Step 2: Add garlic, onion, and jalepeno. Step 3: Stir until onion is soft and clear. Step 4: Add the kidney beans and 1 / 2 the water, still stirring. Step 5: Mash the beans up a little with a fork or a poato masher. Step 6: Add the black beans and stir them inches if you want you can mash them up a little also, keep stirring. Step 7: Once this starts to simmer, and the corn, tomatoes, and the retained tomato juices. Step 8: Add the rest of the water If you are going to let this simmer for a long time while you clean up or make salsa, or if your tomatos weren't very juicy, you will need to add an extra cup of water.

Dish Name: Beans Beans Beans Beans Beans Beans Onions And Beans
Ingredient Names: onions, olive oil, garlic, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, nutmeg, refried beans
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion in the oil with the garlic, spices and seasoning Stir in the beans and mix thoroughly Reheat and serve.

Dish Name: Beer A Summer Refreshing Tex Mex Drink
Ingredient Names: beer, lime slices, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Dust a tounch of salt into the beer add lime slice. Step 2: Place thumb over opening and flip till lime reaches the bottom. Step 3: Bring upright and enjoy Optional: Rub lime slice on rim of a beer mug. Step 4: Pour beer into glass lightly sprinkle salt in and add lime slice Salud!

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, canola oil, red pepper, green pepper, zucchini, onion, salt, salsa, reduced-fat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat tortillas as package directs. Step 2: Meanwhile heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add peppers, zucchini and onions. Step 4: Saute 5 to 6 minutes until crisp-tender and slightly browned, season with salt. Step 5: Mix salsa with sour cream. Step 6: Top tortillas equally with vegetables, then salsa mixture, and roll up Or just let everyone make their own Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: honeydew melon, fresh strawberries, fresh raspberry, sugar, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine fruit and 2 cups cold water Whirl until pured and add sugar and lime juice to taste. Step 2: Pour mixture through a strainer into a serving pitcher, serve cold.

Dish Name: Best Ever Low Fat Mexican Soup
Ingredient Names: red beans, pinto beans, black beans, whole kernel corn, taco seasoning, fat free ranch dressing, picante sauce, whole wheat tortillas, fat-free cheddar cheese, water, salt and pepper, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except cheese in large pot Cook for approximately 30 minutes Add cheese and continue cooking until cheese is melted.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lime, purple onion, garlic cloves, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine avocado, garlic cloves, and onion. Step 2: Add lime juice, but taste as you add it -- the one thing that could potentially kill this recipe is too much lime. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Bisabuelita's Crock Pot Refried Beans Vegetarian
Ingredient Names: pink beans, garlic cloves, onion, onions, bay leaf, black pepper, cumin powder, mexican oregano, liquid smoke, real butter, salt, oil, scallion, sharp white cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Soak beans at least 4 hours or up to 12 hours in plenty of water. Step 2: Add to the beans one of the garlic cloves, finely minced, 2 tablespoons of the onion, bay leaf and a dash of black pepper. Step 3: Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours then cook on low for approximately 5-6 additional hours Or cook on low all day for about 9-10 hours. Step 4: Once cooking time has commenced, check to see if beans are soft Do not drain! Step 5: Heat a cast iron skillet on medium heat and saute the onion, other garlic clove, cumin powder, and oregano in a little bit of oil With a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked beans to the skillet and begin by mashing using a potato masher. Step 6: Add some reserved cooking liquid to help mash Mashing to desired consistency.

Ingredient Names: black beans, corn tortillas, avocados, nonfat sour cream, salsa, cilantro leaf, lettuce, cheese, onion, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Drain beans, reserving 1 / 2 cup of liquid. Step 2: Rinse beans and drain again. Step 3: Combine beans and reserved liquid in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until simmering. Step 4: Simmer 4-5 minutes or until heated through. Step 5: Cover and set aside to keep warm. Step 6: Meanwhile, heat a nonstick griddle over medium heat Warm each tortilla on the griddle for about 1 minute each side, or until hot but still soft. Step 7: Place on plate in oven to keep warm Continue until all the tortillas are heated. Step 8: Cover plate of tortillas with foil.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Brown Rice Burritos
Ingredient Names: black beans, onion, green chilies, fresh cilantro, red chili powder, whole wheat tortillas, cooked brown rice, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees In large mixing bowl mash beans with grated onion. Step 2: Stir in chiles, cilantro and chili powder. Step 3: Spread tortillas out on counter and place equal amounts of the bean mixture on each one. Step 4: Top with 1 / 4 cup of cooked brown rice. Step 5: Fold in sides and roll tortilla to completely enclose contents. Step 6: Place all 8 burritos, seam side down, in a sprayed or nonstick baking pan. Step 7: Pour salsa evenly over the top and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with shredded lowfat cheese and fat free sour cream.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic cloves, celery, jalapeno chile, cumin, oregano, cinnamon, ground cloves, ground coriander, chili powder, ground black pepper, salt, bell peppers, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and garlic and saut until onions become soft and translucent, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the celery and chile, cover and cook for another five minutes more. Step 4: Reduce the heat and stir in spices, along with the bell peppers. Step 5: Cover again and cook for another five minutes. Step 6: Stir often to keep the spices from burning If the pan gets too dry add a little liquid from the diced tomatoes, or some water Next, add the black beans, tomatoes, lime juice and soy sauce. Step 7: Let the chili simmer on low for 5 to 10 minutes, until it thickens slightly and flavors combine. Step 8: Stir in the chocolate.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Corn Enchilada Casserole No Meat
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, bell pepper, garlic cloves, cumin, mexican chili powder, salt, black pepper, reduced sodium black beans, frozen corn kernels, rotel tomatoes & chilies, nonstick cooking spray, red enchilada sauce, corn tortillas, reduced-fat mexican cheese blend
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees 2. Step 2: Put the evoo in a saut pan. Step 3: Add the onion and bell pepper and saut for about 7 minutes. Step 4: Add the garlic and saut another 2 minutes 3. Step 5: Add the spices, and saut with the veggies for 1 minute before adding the black beans, corn, and the 2 cans of rotel Do not drain the rotel, since you need the liquid 4.

Ingredient Names: black beans, salsa, lime juice, fresh cilantro, frozen corn, monterey jack pepper cheese, flour tortillas, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Pour beans into a shallow 2- to 3 - quart casserole. Step 2: Stir in 1 / 2 cup salsa, 1 tablespoon of the lime juice, and the cilantro. Step 3: Top bean mixture with corn, then sprinkle with cheese. Step 4: Bake in a 400 d f oven until mixture is hot throughout and cheese is bubbling, about 15 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, stack tortillas and wrap in foil. Step 6: Place in the oven until tortillas are warm, about 5 minutes While bean mixture and tortillas heat, pit and peel avocado. Step 7: Cut into thin wedges and arrange on a small serving plate. Step 8: Sprinkle avocado with remaining lime juice To assemble tacos, spoon bean and corn mixture into warm tortillas.

Ingredient Names: red onion, red pepper, oranges, jalapeno pepper, garlic, limes, fresh cilantro, black beans, mango
Instructions: Step 1: Feel free to adjust jalapeno and garlic according to your taste. Step 2: Combine all ingredients Optional: for a smoother texture, pure the onions, peppers, garlic, lime juice and cilantro in a food processor, and then mix with the beans and mango. Step 3: Refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavours to blend. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips or tostado as an appetizer, or as an additional salad with grilled meat, or use it to fill a pita for an easy lunch.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Poblano Tortilla Wraps
Ingredient Names: reduced-fat sour cream, ground cumin, black beans, avocado, poblano chile, red onion, diced tomato, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh lime juice, salt, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sour cream and cumin in a small bowl, stir with a whisk. Step 2: Combine beans and next 7 ingredients in a bowl. Step 3: Spoon equal amounts of black bean mixture down center of each tortilla. Step 4: Roll up, cut in half, and secure with wooden picks if necessary. Step 5: Serve with sour cream mixture.

Ingredient Names: black beans, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, frozen chopped spinach, cayenne pepper, tortillas, enchilada sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 375. Step 2: In a large pan or skillet, thaw the frozen spinach over medium high heat. Step 3: When completely thawed, add black beans and pepper. Step 4: Add cream cheese to the skillet and work with it to combine the ingredients. Step 5: Add cheddar, stirring to help it melt and combine, remove from heat. Step 6: Divide the mixture into the center of the six tortillas, folding both ends over and rolling to the center. Step 7: Pour one can of the enchilada sauce in the bottom of a 9 by 13 glass baking pan. Step 8: Arrange the enchiladas in the pan, pour the remaining can of sauce over them and top with more shredded cheddar to garnish. Step 9: Bake approximately 15-20 minutes, until sauces is bubbling and cheddar garnish is browned slightly.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Sweet Potato Burritos Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: chili powder, dried oregano, ground cumin, sweet potato, black beans, garlic cloves, onion, jalapeno pepper, green pepper, frozen corn, fresh lime juice, cilantro, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chili powder, oregano, and cumin in small bowl and set aside. Step 2: Layer sweet potato, beans, half of chili powder mix, garlic, onion, jalapeno pepper, green pepper, remaining half of chili powder mix and corn in slow cooker. Step 3: Cover and cook on low 5 hours ore until sweet potato is tender. Step 4: Stir in lime juice and cilantro. Step 5: Spoon 2 tbs cheese in tortilla and top with 1 cup filling. Step 6: Fold tortilla to close Microwave until cheese melts.

Dish Name: Black Bean And Sweet Potato Enchiladas
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, black beans, sweet potatoes, olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, fresh spinach, cumin, chili powder, paprika, salsa, low-fat sour cream, light cheddar cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 In skillet set over medium-high heat, saute onion and garlic in olive oil. Step 2: Cook for three minutes, then add spices and cook another two minutes. Step 3: Add spinach and cook until wilted. Step 4: Add sweet potatoes, half the cheese and black beans and stir to combine. Step 5: Add a bit of salt if you want. Step 6: Grease a 9x13 baking dish. Step 7: Place about a 1 / 2 cup of filling in each tortilla, and fold mix salsa and sour cream, then pour over enchiladas and sprinkle on remaining cheese. Step 8: Bake for 25 minutes, covered, then remove cover for 5 minutes to let cheese melt.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, onion, chopped tomato, green onion, chili powder, cumin powder, tomato sauce, black beans, cilantro, salt and pepper, corn tortillas, low-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 f Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Step 2: Add garlic, onions, tomato, green onion, cumin, and chili powder. Step 3: Cook on medium heat until onion is tender. Step 4: Add tomato sauce and cook 5 minutes more. Step 5: Stir in beans, cilantro, salt and pepper Spray a 9 inch square baking dish with cooking spray. Step 6: Layer 4 tortillas, 1 / 3 cheese, and 1 / 3 of the bean mixture. Step 7: Repeat 2 more times. Step 8: Top with reserved 2 tablespoons of cheese.

Ingredient Names: black beans, cumin, fresh cilantro, tomatoes, avocados, green onion, salsa, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together Save avocado pits and leave in mixture to keep avocado from turning brown Serve with tortilla chips.

Dish Name: Black Bean Burrito Filling Or Side Dish
Ingredient Names: olive oil, jalapeno chile, garlic cloves, onion, black beans, cilantro leaves, ground cumin, cayenne pepper sauce, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add olive oil, jalapeno, garlic and onion Saut for 2 or 3 minutes. Step 2: Add beans and stir in seasonings and cayenne pepper sauce. Step 3: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.

Dish Name: Black Bean Corn And Cheddar Fritters
Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, unbleached white flour, baking powder, salt, chili powder, ground cumin, cayenne, low-fat milk, egg yolk, black beans, sharp cheddar cheese, corn kernel, fresh cilantro, red bell pepper, green chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Sift together the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, chili powder, cumin, and cayenne in a medium-sized bowl. Step 2: Beat the milk with the egg yolk, and add it to the dry ingredients, mixing well. Step 3: Stir in the beans, cheese, corn, cilantro, red pepper, and green chilies In another bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until stiff Gently fold them into the batter. Step 4: Heat 1 / 2 cup oil in a 10-inch iron skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Spoon in about 1 / 4 cup of batter for each fritter, making three or four at a time. Step 6: Fry until golden brown on one side, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Turn and fry until golden brown on the other side, and drain on paper towels. Step 8: Fry the rest of the batter in batches.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, flour, cocoa powder, oregano, cumin, garlic cloves, water, vegetable stock, tomato sauce, salt, olive oil, onion, green pepper, chipotle peppers, black beans
Instructions: Step 1: Make the enchilada sauce: combine chili powder, flour, cocoa powder, oregano, cumin and garlic in a small saucepan While whisking, slowly add water one tablespoon at a time until a fairly thick paste forms. Step 2: Whisk in stock, bring to boil and then lower hit and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture thickens. Step 3: Now whisk in the tomato sauce, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes, uncovered You can add salt at this point, but if your chili powder has salt you might want to skip it or use only a small amount. Step 4: Remove from heat and set sauce aside for now. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 6: Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat, then add the onion and bell pepper. Step 7: Saute for about five minutes, then add the garlic and chipotle peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes longer. Step 8: Stir in the black beans with can liquid.

Dish Name: Black Bean Corn Tacos With Radish Salsa Feta
Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, black beans, corn, cilantro, salt, pepper, radishes, green onions, serrano pepper, limes, corn tortillas, feta cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium pot, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil. Step 2: Add garlic and cook for about 1 to 2 minutes until the garlic is just fragrant barely starting to brown. Step 3: Add the black beans along with the can liquid, corn, 1 tablespoon of cilantro, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes or until the liquid condenses While the beans & corn cook, prepare the salse: combine 1 tablespoon olive oil, 3 tablespoons cilantro, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper, radishes, green onions, serrano pepper and lime juice To serve the tacos, place the beans & corn in the middle of a tortilla and top with salsa and feta. Step 5: Sprinkle with additional cilantro, if desired.

Dish Name: Black Bean Enchiladas With Warm Salsa Verde
Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, mexican blend cheese, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, white onions, jalapeno, black beans, ground cumin, tomato paste, coarse salt, tomatillos, vegetable stock, avocado, oregano leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil, and heat in oven at 275f until fillings and sauce are ready Black bean filling: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in large skillet, and add 1 clove of chopped garlic. Step 2: Grate 1 onion into pan with a hand grater. Step 3: Add half of the jalapeno. Step 4: Cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 5: Add beans, and mash with back of a fork. Step 6: Stir in 1 teaspoon cumin and tomato paste, and season with salt Warm salsa verde: Place tomatillos in a food processor, and pulse to a coarsely ground paste.

Dish Name: Black Bean Lasagna Rolls Oamc Ww
Ingredient Names: whole wheat lasagna noodles, monterey jack-style soy cheese, silken tofu, chili powder, taco seasoning, salt, fresh cilantro, black beans, salsa, fresh cilantro stem
Instructions: Step 1: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions, drain well. Step 2: Rinse with cold water and lay individually on kitchen towels While noodles are cooking, combine 1 cup of soy cheese, tofu, chili powder, taco seasoning, salt and chopped cilantro, add black beans. Step 3: Spoon mixture onto lasagna noodles. Step 4: Roll up noodles, jellyroll fashion, beginning at narrow ends Spray a 13x9-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Step 5: Spread 8 ounces of salsa on the bottom. Step 6: Place lasagna rolls, seam sides down, in baking dish.

Dish Name: Black Bean Mango And Jicama Salsa
Ingredient Names: mango, black beans, jicama, cilantro, jalapeno, lime, salt and pepper, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Cut mango into small pieces The easiest way is to sit the mango on it's narrow side and slice the fruit off either side of the central pit, which is about 1 1 / 2 inches in the center. Step 2: Take a large spoon and slide it between the skin and flesh of the two halves. Step 3: Chop the flesh and toss in a medium bowl You can also cut a small amount of flesh from around the pit, or take the cooks reward and bite it off for yourself! Step 4: Add the remaining ingredients to the mango and stir together Taste for seasonings and adjust as necessary.

Ingredient Names: black beans, salsa, cheddar cheese, coriander, green onion, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: Puree black beans and salsa together. Step 3: Add coriander and green onions to mixture, mix well. Step 4: Divide evenly in bowl into 1 / 6's. Step 5: Spread over tortillas. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheese. Step 7: Fold tortilla in half. Step 8: Place on baking sheet so they aren't overlapping too much. Step 9: Bake for 5 minutes and then flip over for another 4-5 minutes.

Dish Name: Black Bean Rice Enchiladas Inexpensive Vegetarian Cuisine
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, mixed peppers, reduced sodium black beans, cumin, chili powder, ground red pepper, whole grain rice, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, whole wheat tortillas, green enchilada sauce, reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, salsa, greek yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Add olive oil, peppers and onion to a large non-stick skillet and saute until tender. Step 3: Add black beans, cumin, chili powder, red pepper and cooked rice to skillet, stir to combine. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in cilantro and lime juice. Step 5: Set aside Spray bottom of baking dish with cooking spray. Step 6: Spoon 1 / 8th of mixture into each tortilla, roll up and place into baking dish, seam side down. Step 7: Repeat with remaining tortillas. Step 8: Pour enchilada sauce evenly over enchiladas, cover with foil and bake 15 minutes.

Dish Name: Black Bean Salad With Lime Cilantro Vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: black beans, fresh corn, red onion, red bell peppers, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, shallots, avocados, limes, fresh lime juice, extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, cayenne pepper, sugar, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients, except avocados, in a large bowl and mix well. Step 2: Toss with desired amount of dressing. Step 3: Cover and chill for a few hours or overnight Right before serving, add avocados and mix gently, being careful not to mash avocados. Step 4: Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, black beans, salsa, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, dijon mustard, cumin, salt, whole grain buns, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and saut for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in the beans, salsa, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, mustard, cumin, and salt. Step 4: Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and spoon onto buns. Step 6: Top with cheese and serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, dried oregano, garlic cloves, jalapeno pepper, dry sherry, braggs liquid aminos, black beans, seitan, black pepper, taco shells, romaine lettuce, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, oregano, garlic, and jalapeno and cook 8 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 3: Stir in sherry, soy sauce, beans, and seitan, bring to a boil then cook until liquid almost evaporates, season to taste. Step 4: Prepare taco shells. Step 5: Spoon about 1 / 3 cup bean mixture into each shell, top each taco with lettuce, avocados, and other desired toppings, serve.

Ingredient Names: black beans, water, sunflower oil, scallion, ground coriander, ground cumin, cilantro, chipotle pepper, lemon, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Warm the beans in the water. Step 2: Heat the oil in a small skillet. Step 3: Add the scallion and spices and cook on medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the cilantro and turn off the heat Coarsely puree the beans, scallion mixture, and chile in a food processor. Step 5: Taste and if you want it hotter, add more chile in small measures. Step 6: Add lime juice and salt to sharpen the flavors Enjoy!

Dish Name: Black Bean Tostadas With Garlicky Greens
Ingredient Names: whole wheat tortillas, vegetable oil, onion, black beans, smoked paprika, dried oregano, garlic cloves, swiss chard, chipotle salsa, queso fresco, cilantro, low-fat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f spray both sides of tortillas with cooking spray. Step 2: Place on a baking sheet and toast 8-10 minutes, or until crisp. Step 3: Heat 1 tbs Oil in saucepan over medium heat. Step 4: Add onion, and cook 5 minutes or until soft. Step 5: Add beans, paprika, and oregano. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 10 minutes. Step 7: Heat remaining 1 tbs Oil in skilled over medium-low heat. Step 8: Add garlic, and cook 2 minutes, or until beginning to brown.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, zucchini, jalapenos, salt, garlic cloves, kalamata olive, ground cumin, ground coriander, salsa verde, black beans, corn tortillas, scallion, soy yogurt, lemon zest, lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a heavy bottomed skille tover medium-high heat. Step 2: Pour in the oil and add the zucchini and jalapeno, sprinkle with the salt. Step 3: Saute for about 7 minutes, or until the zucchini is lightly browned. Step 4: Add the garlic, olives, cumin, and coriander, and saute for 2 minutes more. Step 5: Add the salsa verde and black beans and cook for 5 minutes The salsa should reduce a bit so its not soupy. Step 6: Mix the ingredients for the garlic-lemon yogurt if your using Warm the tortillas in a skillet or wrap in a moist towel & nuke for a minute Assembly the tacos by adding the filling, yogurt, and topping with scallions Enjoy!

Dish Name: Black Beans And Rice With Cheese
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, water, chili powder, salt, dried oregano, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground red pepper, black beans, cooked brown rice, reduced-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare brown rice according to package directions While brown rice is cooking heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion and bell pepper. Step 3: Cook 5 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally Ladd garlic, cook 1 minute. Step 4: Add water and next 7 ingredients, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Step 6: Place 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup rice in bowls and top with bean mixture.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, black beans, corn kernels, paprika, oregano, garlic salt, pico de gallo, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the olive oil in a small pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onions, and sautee for 5 minutes, or until soft. Step 3: Add the beans, corn, paprika, oregano and garlic salt to the pan and stir well. Step 4: Lower the heat to low and cook for 10 minutes while stirring occasionally. Step 5: Serve this over brown rice if you like, or top with pico de gallo and / or avocados.

Dish Name: Black Beans In Chipotle Adobo Sauce
Ingredient Names: black beans, bay leaf, cold water, onion, salt & freshly ground black pepper, garlic cloves, olive oil, chipotle chiles in adobo, adobo sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the beans, onion, bay leaf and water in a large saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then let boil for 1 minute. Step 3: Lower the heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, for 40 minutes, until the beans are very tender and about half the water has evaporated. Step 4: Remove the bay leaf and onion before serving While the beans are cooking, prepare the chipotle adobo sauce: in a heavy bottomed skillet over medium heat, saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until the onion is very soft, 10 to 12 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the chipotles and adobo sauce, cook for 30 seconds, and remove from heat. Step 6: Allow to cool a few minutes, empty the sauce into a food processor bowl, and briefly pulse until a chunky sauce forms You may also use an immersion blender to do this. Step 7: Serve the sauce drizzled over individual servings of beans.

Ingredient Names: black beans, onion, lemon juice, sour cream, fresh parsley, radishes, cooking oil, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Sautee onion in oil. Step 2: Add beans and lemon juice Separatelty, mix sour cream with parsley and radish. Step 3: Serve beans hot and place a dollop of the prepared cream on top of them May be served with tortilla chips.

Dish Name: Black White Vegetarian Chipotle Chili Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: black beans, navy beans, diced tomatoes, tomatoes and green chilies, onion, garlic cloves, chili powder, sweet hungarian paprika, dried cilantro, fresh coarse ground black pepper, chipotle chile
Instructions: Step 1: Stir everything together in a 4 1 / 2 quart or larger slow cooker Set power to low and cook for 6 hours or longer Serve with cheese or sour cream if you wish.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, jalapeno chiles, onion, fresh cilantro, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pan, simmer tomatoes and chiles for 10 minutes Drain Place in a blender and add remaining ingredients Blend until smooth.

Dish Name: Bob's Favorite Hot Salsa Hot Water Bath Canning Method
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, green chili peppers, white onion, white vinegar, kosher salt, black pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the tomatoes, peppers and onions and boil for 10 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Step 3: Fill hot pint jars to 1 / 2 inch of the top Process for 15 minutes in a hot water bath. Step 4: Let cool and remove bands and store in a cool dry place for up to 1 year.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, ground cumin, salt, mexican-style stewed tomatoes with jalapeno peppers, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium-high heat with cover. Step 2: Add rice, fry, stirring until rice is lightly browned, 3-5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the minced onion, garlic, cumin and salt, fry another minute. Step 4: Add tomatoes with liquid plus the water. Step 5: Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cook another 15 minutes, until rice is fluffy and dry.

Ingredient Names: flour, salt, sugar, fresh yeast, water
Instructions: Step 1: Crumble the yeast into 1 / 4 cup warm water to dissolve. Step 2: Mix the flour, salt and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Step 3: Make a well in the center of these ingredients, pour in the dissolved yeast and the water, and stir the mixture thoroughly, but do not knead. Step 4: Cover it with a damp cloth and let it sit in a warm place for about two hours Punch down the dough and knead it very well on a floured board. Step 5: Roll it, still kneading, into 20 equally-sized balls. Step 6: Brush them with vegetable oil, dust with flour, and flatten them with your hand into oblongs the easiest way to score them is in the telera form, making two light indentations running lengthwise down the"football "this will form three sections Do not score too deeply. Step 7: Place the rolls on baking sheets, cover them and set them in a warm place until they are somewhat less than doubled in bulk.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lime wedge, red onion, jalapeno, cilantro, tomatoes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Mash avocado in a bowl, then add lime juice 2 Mix in rest of ingredients Serve w / tortilla chips or your favorite mexican dish Enjoy! Step 2: This recipe can be doubled for bigger groups.

Ingredient Names: butter, onion, potato, eggs, french style green bean, cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in butter until translucent Dice cooked potato into small pieces, add to onion. Step 2: Take out of pan Scramble eggs, pour into pan, cook slow. Step 3: Add drained green beans, add onion mixture, heat tortillas.

Ingredient Names: grape tomatoes, avocados, red onion, capers, jalapeno pepper, lemon, lime, dijon mustard, kosher salt, ground black pepper, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place tomatoes, avocados, and red onions in a bowl Carefully mix remaining ingredients together and pour over the tomato mixture. Step 2: Chill for 30 minutes to let flavors meld.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, lemon juice, toasted sesame oil, broccoli florets, red sweet peppers
Instructions: Step 1: For sauce, in a small bowl stir together soy sauce, lemon juice and sesame oil, set aside. Step 2: Place a steamer basket in a 12 inch skillet. Step 3: Add enough water to come just below bottom of basket and bring to a boil. Step 4: Place broccoli in steamer basket and reduce heat to medium low. Step 5: Cover and steam for 4 minutes, add sweet peppers. Step 6: Cover and steam for 3 to 4 minutes more or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Step 7: Transfer vegetables to a serving bowl. Step 8: Drizzle sauce over vegetables and toss gently to coat.

Ingredient Names: burrito-size flour tortillas, monterey jack cheese, cooked broccoli
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat griddle or heavy skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes. Step 2: Add a flour tortilla or two and sprinkle each with about 1 / 2 cup cheese. Step 3: Divide broccoli between tortillas, sprinkling it over the cheese, then divide remaining cheese over broccoli. Step 4: Top each tortilla with a second tortilla and cook for several minutes, until bottom of lower tortilla is light gold. Step 5: Flip quesadilla over and cook on second side until bottom is golden Cheese should be completely melted. Step 6: Remove from pan and slice into wedges, serve hot or warm. Step 7: Cut into smaller wedges for appetizers.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, egg, egg white, milk, cheese, flour tortillas, margarine, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Microwave broccoli with a little water for 6 minutes or until tender and drain.
