Step 2: Meanwhile, whisk egg, egg white and milk with salt and pepper until frothy Scramble egg mixture in margarine. Step 3: Heat tortillas in microwave for 1 minute or until soft and pliable. Step 4: Mix broccoli with eggs. Step 5: Place broccoli / egg mixture down the middle of the tortilla, place slice of cheese on top. Step 6: Roll burrito-style: tuck ends in and roll, enveloping entire mixture inside. Step 7: Place flap-side down in a warm skillet to seal and melt cheese. Step 8: Flip to heat on other side To freeze: place burritos individually on a cookie sheet to flash freeze.

Ingredient Names: broccoli, low-fat yogurt, onions, low-fat mayonnaise, lemon juice, chili powder, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until very smooth. Step 2: Chill at least a few hours before tasting Can serve with chips, crackers, or as a veggie dip Keeps well in fridge Cooking time listed is for chilling time.

Ingredient Names: onions, carrots, bell peppers, tomatoes, scotch bonnet pepper, cilantro, garlic, lemon zest, salt and pepper, cayenne, cumin, vinegar, vegetable stock, tomato juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook all vegetables in a medium pot over high heat, season as desired. Step 2: Add cilantro, garlic, and lemon zest. Step 3: Cook out remaining liquid from vegetables. Step 4: Add vinegar, stock, and tomato juice. Step 5: Reduce until 2 / 3 liquid remains. Step 6: Let stand for one hour Reseason if needed with salt, pepper, and spices Purree blend until smooth, adding more tomato or stock for desired consistency. Step 7: Serve with chips and salsa!

Ingredient Names: black beans, cooked brown rice, water, olive oil, onion, bell peppers, minced garlic clove, ground cumin, cremini mushrooms, tomatoes, salsa, pepper, hot sauce, salt, lavash bread
Instructions: Step 1: Soak beans overnight, if using dried. Step 2: Cook beans, if using dried, cook brown rice. Step 3: Heat water and oil in a large saucepan. Step 4: When hot, add onion and saute until soft. Step 5: Add bell pepper, garlic, and cumin and cook 2 minutes more, adding more water, if necessary to prevent sticking. Step 6: Stir in beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, and salsa. Step 7: Cook about 10 minutes, until mushrooms are soft Warm the amount of lavash breads or tortillas you are using. Step 8: Add rice and pepper, hot sauce, and salt or tamari.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, green bell peppers, onion, oil, tomatoes, salt, pepper, eggs, cheddar cheese, pico de gallo, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the green bell pepper and onion into a large dice. Step 2: Fry in the oil with the minced garlic over med-high heat. Step 3: Meanwhile, dice the tomato. Step 4: When the peppers and onions are soft add the tomato. Step 5: Season with salt and pepper and put the mixture aside in a bowl. Step 6: Add a little more oil to the pan if necessary and scramble your 6 eggs, cook over med-high heat stirring constantly. Step 7: Heat up your tortillas in the microwave individually as you assemble the burritos To assemble: put 1 / 4 of the scrambled eggs on the tortilla, sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup cheddar cheese, cover with the pepper / onion mix and roll up It will be huge This is a knife and fork burrito for sure!

Ingredient Names: lavash bread, no-salt-added pinto beans, low-sodium salsa, red bell peppers, chili powder, garlic powder, ground cumin, oregano, hot sauce, salad greens, tomatoes, carrot, avocado, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Warm the lavash or tortillas one by one in a dry skillet or in the microwave Stack them in a clean towel to keep warm. Step 2: Combine beans, salsa, bell pepper, and seasonings in a medium saucepan. Step 3: Heat uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, then remove from heat. Step 4: Mash beans to desired consistency. Step 5: Spoon 1 / 4 of bean mixture onto each tortilla, allowing room for rolling into burrito shape. Step 6: Add any topping you desire. Step 7: Roll into burrito shape.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, scallions, red onions, serrano peppers, tomatoes, cilantro, red wine vinegar, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, combine ingredients and mix well Add garlic salt and pepper to taste Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: tequila, prepared sweet-and-sour mix, triple sec, lime juice, grand marnier
Instructions: Step 1: Shake tequila, triple sec, sweet and sour mix, and lime juice with ice. Step 2: Pour over ice in salt-rimmed margarita glass Float grand marnier on top. Step 3: Garnish with slice of lime if desired.

Dish Name: Caf De Olla Sweet Cinnamon Coffee
Ingredient Names: water, ground coffee, cinnamon stick, dark brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the water to a boil Add the coffee, cinnamon and sugar, and continue boiling for 30 seconds Stir and strain into hot mugs.

Ingredient Names: long grain white rice, water, kosher salt, fresh cilantro, white onion, scallion, fresh jalapenos, fresh lime juice, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring rice, water & 1 teaspoon salt to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat, cover pan & simmer 20 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove lid & fluff with a fork While rice is cooking, using a blender, puree cilantro, onion, scallion, jalapeno, lime juice, olive oil & remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt. Step 5: Add mixture to rice & stir with a fork till well blended.

Ingredient Names: sugar, evaporated milk, philadelphia cream cheese, eggs, vanilla, salt, caramel topping
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f place 1 cup of the sugar in small heavy saucepan. Step 2: Cook on medium heat until sugar is melted and deep golden brown, stirring constantly with wooden spoon. Step 3: Remove from heat Immediately pour into 9-inch round baking pan Tilt pan to evenly cover bottom of pan with syrup, set aside. Step 4: Place milk and cream cheese in blender, cover. Step 5: Blend until smooth. Step 6: Add remaining 1 cup sugar, the eggs, vanilla and salt.

Dish Name: Calabacitas Casserole With Polenta And Cheese
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, frozen corn kernels, garlic cloves, jalapenos, zucchini, yellow squash, yellow onion, stewed tomatoes, chili powder, salt and pepper, prepared polenta, monterey jack cheese, scallions, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Step 2: Grease a 9 x 13 baking dish with 1 t olive oil. Step 3: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add remaining 2 t olive oil, corn, garlic and jalapenos, saute 3 minutes. Step 5: Add zucchini, yellow squash and onions, season with salt, pepper and chili powder, cook 7-8 minutes. Step 6: Add stewed tomatoes and heat through. Step 7: Transfer skillet contents to baking dish. Step 8: Cut tube of polenta in 1 / 2-inch slices.

Ingredient Names: roasted green chilies, onion, minced garlic cloves, bacon grease, zucchini, whole kernel corn, cream, cheddar cheese, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the onion and garlic in the bacon grease or oil until translucent. Step 2: Add the chiles, zucchini, and corn. Step 3: Simmer until the squash is tender, about 20 minutes, add the cream. Step 4: Raise heat until cream starts to boil. Step 5: Cook until vegetables are hot and the sauce is slightly thickened Salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Sprinkle with cheddar, and serve.

Dish Name: Calabacitas Con Leche Squash With Milk
Ingredient Names: yellow squash, butter, whole kernel corn, onion, salt, pepper, green chilies, milk, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute squash in butter until tender. Step 2: Reduce heat and add corn, onions, salt, pepper, and green chilies. Step 3: Mix well and add milk. Step 4: Simmer until well blended. Step 5: Pour into a 1-quart casserole dish, top with cheese. Step 6: Cover and bake at 400f for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, whole kernel corn, stewed tomatoes, salt, low-fat monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 2: Place all ingredients, except cheese, into casserole dish. Step 3: Cover and bake until veggies are tender, approximately 20 minutes Or microwave on high approximately 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and sprinkle with cheese. Step 5: Toss lightly and serve hot.

Dish Name: Caldo Largo Cream Of Chile Poblano
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, poblano chiles, vegetable oil, vegetable stock, low-fat plain yogurt, monterey jack cheese, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, heat the oil and saute the onion, garlic and chiles on medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add the stock and simmer for 15 minutes In another saucepan, add the yogurt Slowly add the broth to the yogurt, one cup at a time, blending well after each addition, add the salt. Step 3: Heat on low for a few minutes, stirring constantly Do not boil the soup Distribute the cheese between six bowls and pour the soup over the cheese in each bowl. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, sour cream, jalapeno pepper, scallion, olive, garlic, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients into a paste. Step 2: Spread paste thinly on tortillas all the way to the ends. Step 3: Roll burritos tightly. Step 4: Refrigerate over night. Step 5: Cut burritos into 1 / 4 in slices and serve with salsa.

Ingredient Names: hass avocadoes, fresh lemon juice, onion, tomatoes, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the avocados in half and remove the seeds Scoop out the pulp and place in a bowl. Step 2: Drizzle the pulp with lemon juice and mash. Step 3: Combine with the remaining ingredients, mix well and serve.

Ingredient Names: lettuce, red onion, cheddar cheese, vegetarian baked beans, corn chips, tomatoes, vegetable oil, red wine vinegar, sugar, ketchup, onion powder
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, ketchup and onion powder to make the dressing. Step 2: Cut and prepare all the ingredients Ideally, serve all the ingredients separately so everyone can mix their own salad and so the chips and lettuce don't get soggy in the dressing If the salad will be eaten immediately and completely then it is ok to premix it in a bowl.

Ingredient Names: pumpkin seeds, granulated sugar, brown sugar, paprika, salt, fresh orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pumpkin seeds in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring often, about 8-10 minutes or till puffed Watch closely so the don't brown Move to a bowl. Step 2: Combine sugar, brown sugar, paprika and salt, set aside. Step 3: Toss pumpkin seeds with orange juice. Step 4: Stir in sugar mixture, tossing to coat. Step 5: Spread in a single layer on wax paper lined jelly roll pan. Step 6: Bake at 350f For 6 minutes, stirring once.

Ingredient Names: plum tomatoes, pickling salt, onions, garlic, jalapeno pepper, bell peppers, cilantro, ground cumin, tomato paste, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil Blanch the tomatoes by dropping them into the boiling water for one minute You will need to do them in batches. Step 2: Transfer them to a large bowl or sink full of cold water Fish them out and peel them. Step 3: Chop them coarsely and sprinkle with pickling salt in layers as you go - i try to use about 4 tablespoons. Step 4: Put them in a strainer and set in a cool place to drain for several hours. Step 5: When you are ready to procede, put all the canning jars in a large canner full of water to cover by one inch, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Boil for 10 minutes If your water is very hard, add a shot of vinegar to the water before it boils.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onions, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, pepper, salt, sugar, lime juice, cilantro, tomato sauce, tomato paste
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients except tomato sauce and paste - bring to a boil If you wish to drain off some of the juice now is the time to do it - if not then add tomato sauce and tomato paste Slowly boil for 10 minute Seal into half pints, pints and quarts and process in water bath for 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Canned The Summer In A Salsa
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, chile, sweet onion, vinegar, lime, cumin powder, dried parsley, salt, black pepper, garlic cloves, tomato paste, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place all but the paste and cilantro in a heavy bottom pot bring to a boil then simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Step 2: Add paste stir in and cook 10 minutes. Step 3: Add the cilantro stir in and simmer for 5 more minutes Ladle into hot jars leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace Wipe jars and adjust lids and process in water canner for 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: piloncillo cones, water, cinnamon sticks, green onions, french bread, soft margarine, raisins, pecans, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water, piloncillos, cinnamon sticks and green onions in large pot or dutch oven. Step 2: Bring to a boil and cook until the piloncillos are dissolved and the syrup is dark from the spices. Step 3: Taste- you may want to add additional brown sugar or spices depending on your personal tastes. Step 4: Remove from heat and take out onions and cinnamon sticks Toast the french bread. Step 5: Spread margarine liberally on both sides of toast. Step 6: Layer toast, cheese, raisins, and nuts in 2 9x13 pans, repeating until both pans are full, ending with a layer of cheese, raisins and nuts. Step 7: Pour the syrup over the top, dividing evenly between both pans, and making sure that all the bread is moistened. Step 8: Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Step 9: Serve hot or cold.

Ingredient Names: toasted breadcrumbs, water, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, salt, cheddar cheese, raisins, butter, whipped cream
Instructions: Step 1: Toast the sliced bread, break into 2" pieces. Step 2: Make a syrup of water, sugar, spices and salt. Step 3: Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes Butter an oblong baking pan. Step 4: Layer bread, cheese, raisins and butter. Step 5: Pour syrup over bread mixture and bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until syrup is absorbed May be served warm or cold If served warm, top with whipped cream.

Ingredient Names: polenta, self-rising flour, baking powder, cracked black pepper, sun-dried tomatoes, egg whites, grapeseed oil, soymilk, creamed corn, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 180c. Step 2: Grease rectangular baking tin with olive oil spray, and line with paper Sift flour and baking powder into large bowl, then mix in polenta and black pepper. Step 3: Rinse & roughly chop sundried tomatoes, and stir into dry ingredients. Step 4: Beat oil into egg whites, then add soy milk and tabasco. Step 5: Pour liquid ingredients into dry, add creamed corn and mix well. Step 6: Pour mixture into prepared tin, smooth top and bake for about 30 minutes or until golden brown on top.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, red onion, cilantro, cumin, salt, jalapeno, limes, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Place cauliflower in a pot with one inch of salted water, and allow to steam, approximately 5 minute cauliflower is ready when it gently slides off a fork when stabbed. Step 2: Allow cauliflower to cool While cauliflower is cooling, add chopped onion to a bowl of salted water. Step 3: Allow to soak 5 minutes, then drain Give cauliflower a rough chop to create small pieces, about the size of a dime It's okay if there are different sized pieces. Step 4: Place in a large mixing bowl. Step 5: Squeeze juice of 6 limes over mixture and mix well. Step 6: Add chopped cilantro, drained onions, chopped jalapeo, salt, pepper, and cumin to bowl, blend well.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, whipping cream, cayenne, salt & freshly ground black pepper, poblano chile, cotija cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In a 6- to 8-quart pan over high heat, bring 3 quarts water to a boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, trim and discard leaves from cauliflower Separate heads into florets. Step 3: Slice florets 1 / 4 inch thick. Step 4: Add sliced cauliflower to boiling water and cook until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 5: Drain and rinse under cold water, drain well. Step 6: In a glass measure, stir together cream and cayenne. Step 7: Line bottom of a shallow 3 1 / 2- to 4-quart baking dish with a fourth of the cauliflower slices. Step 8: Drizzle a fourth of the cream mixture over cauliflower.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, chili powder, paprika, chipotle chiles in adobo, pineapple juice, white vinegar, pineapple chunks, olive oil, cauliflower, onion, jalapeno, fresh cilantro, flour tortillas, feta, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender or food processor combine the garlic, chili powder, paprika, chipotle chiles, pineapple juice, vinegar and 1 cup of the pineapple chunks. Step 2: Blend until smooth, set aside. Step 3: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Step 4: Add cauliflower and onions, season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Cook for 12-15 minutes or until the cauliflower is tender and the onions have caramelized. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low stir in the pineapple sauce, the remaining cup of pineapple chunks and the jalapeno. Step 7: Simmer for 8-10 minutes or until the sauce has reduced and coats the cauliflower, there will still be sauce left in the pan, this is good. Step 8: Remove from the heat and stir in the cilantro. Step 9: Divide the cauliflower among the warmed tortillas, drizzling each taco with the remaining sauce left in the pan.

Ingredient Names: jalapenos, habaneros, onion, garlic cloves, cilantro, cumin seed, oregano, thyme, salt and pepper, red wine vinegar, olive oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put peppers, onion, garlic, cilantro and cumin in a food processor, and process until finely minced, but not a paste Or, if you're mincing the peppers by hand-be sure to wear rubber gloves, as the oil from the peppers is very irritating to skin and eyes. Step 2: Add seasonings, vinegar, olive oil and water and mix well. Step 3: Store in a glass container with a tight fitting lid Stores well in the refrigerator for a couple of days. Step 4: Serve on chips, eggs, grilled chicken, in burritos, on tacos, mixed into rice or beans, anything you can think of!

Ingredient Names: beet, garlic cloves, bay leaves, white wine vinegar, red onion, lime juice, lime zest, grapefruit juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put beets in medium saucepan and add garlic, bay leaves, vinegar and 4 cups water. Step 2: Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to medium, and simmer 10 minutes. Step 3: Put onions in a medium bowl. Step 4: Strain hot beet cooking liquid over onions and set aside to rest until onions soften slightly, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain onions and return to bowl. Step 6: Add sour orange juice and salt to taste and toss well. Step 7: Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour before serving.

Ingredient Names: whole milk, masa harina, water, brown sugar, unsweetened chocolate, cinnamon stick
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the milk and chocolate in a saucepan, stirring to dissolve the chocolate. Step 2: When chocolate is completely dissolved, remove from the heat and set aside to keep warm. Step 3: Mix the masa harina with the water in another saucepan. Step 4: Place over low heat, add the cinnamon stick, and cook until the mixture has thickened and the masa becomes translucent. Step 5: Add the chocolate milk and sugar. Step 6: Stir to dissolve the sugar and simmer for a few minutes. Step 7: Remove the cinnamon stick and serve the champurrado hot in cups or mugs.

Dish Name: Charred Corn Tacos With Zucchini Slaw
Ingredient Names: red radish, zucchini, limes, salt, corn, unsalted butter, olive oil, white onion, garlic cloves, black beans, epazote, cotija cheese, chili powder, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Cut radishes and zucchini into tiny matchsticks with a mandoline If you dont have a mandoline, you can use a peeler to peel thick ribbons down the long side of the zucchini Stack the ribbons and cut them crosswise into thin matchsticks. Step 2: Cut the radishes into a similar shape by hand. Step 3: Toss radishes and zucchini together. Step 4: Squeeze the juice of half a lime over the radish and season with salt to taste. Step 5: Add more lime juice if desired. Step 6: Set aside Over a hot grill or an open gas-stove flame char the ears of corn until well-blackened but not completely burnt If youre using the burner method, youll probably, quickly, notice that corn likes to pop and snap, occasionally spraying you with splats of corn.

Ingredient Names: poblano peppers, olive oil, garlic cloves, scallions, cilantro leaf, queso fresco, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large cast iron skillet Rub the chiles with oil and set in the skillet, skin side down. Step 2: Add the garlic and scallions and cook over medium high heat, flattening the chiles with a spatula, until charred all over, about 6 minutes Move to a plate. Step 3: Let cool slightly Peel the chiles and garlic and chop Move to a mini food processor. Step 4: Add the scallions and cilantro Pulse until minced With the machine on, add 3 tablespoons of oil and process to a coarse paste.

Ingredient Names: chayotes, serrano chili pepper, fresh cilantro, lemon, extra virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh cilantro stem
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chayote, chile pepper, cilantro, lemon juice, oil, and vinegar in large bowl. Step 2: Toss to thoroughly coat. Step 3: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro springs.

Ingredient Names: cooked white rice, sour cream, green chilies, canned black beans, monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f Butter a 2-quart glass baking dish. Step 2: Combine cheese together in a bowl and set aside. Step 3: In a medium bowl, mix sour cream, chiles and beans Alternate layers of cooked rice, cheeses and sour cream mixture, finishing with the cheese. Step 4: Bake 30 minutes or until the top is nicely browned.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic clove, chile, ground cumin, olive oil, bell peppers, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, salt, vegetable oil, corn tortillas, canned tomatoes, green pepper, onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saute the onions, garlic, chiles, and cumin in the oil for 5-7 minutes, until onions are soft. Step 2: Add the chopped peppers, cover, and cook on low heat for about 10 minutes, until peppers are tender. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in all the cheeses. Step 4: Add salt to taste and set aside. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350f Soften tortillas by frying individually in a little oil for just a few seconds on each side. Step 6: Drain well on paper towels. Step 7: Place a tortilla on a flat surface. Step 8: Spoon 1 / 4 - 1 / 2 cup of cheese and pepper filling onto the half of the tortilla closest to you. Step 9: Roll and place, seam side down, in a greased baking pan.

Ingredient Names: corn tortillas, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, onion, garlic, tomato sauce, green chilies, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cups cheddar, 2 cups monterey jack cheese, sour cream, onion and garlic. Step 2: Spoon about 1 / 2 cup cheese mixture down center of each tortilla, roll up. Step 3: Place seam sides down in ungreased oblong baking dish, 12 x 7 1 / 2 x 2" Mix tomato sauce, chilies and cumin. Step 4: Spoon tomato mixture lengthwise down center of each enchilada. Step 5: Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over tomato mixture Freeze To cook: thaw then bake at 350f uncovered until cheese is melted and filling is bubbly, about 20 minutes.

Dish Name: Cheese Enchiladas In Yummy Red Sauce
Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, garlic cloves, onion, chili powder, dried basil, black pepper, salt, cumin, dried parsley, sugar, salsa, tomato paste, beef broth, water, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: Place garlic in cold, non-reactive large sauce pan with oil. Step 2: Bring up to a medium heat, stirring so that garlic doesn't scorch Saut for 1 minute, then add onions. Step 3: Add remaining dry spices and saut for 3-4 minutes, to develop oil & spices' flavors. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients, except cilantro. Step 5: Simmer gently on low for 30 minutes. Step 6: Add cilantro at the end. Step 7: Cool, and then chill overnight in fridge to let flavors meld Enchiladas:.

Ingredient Names: yellow cornmeal, baking soda, all-purpose flour, eggs, buttermilk, cream-style corn, margarine, green chilies, baking powder, low-fat monterey jack cheese, sugar, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 230c. Step 2: Grease bottom and sides of a 8x8 inch or 9x9 inch square pan, or a 22 or 23 cm or 25 cm oven proof skillet. Step 3: Mix all ingredients. Step 4: Beat vigorously 30 sec. Step 5: Pour batter into pan. Step 6: Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, butter, green onions, monterey jack cheese, fresh spinach, garlic salt, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in a skillet and place a tortilla on it. Step 2: Add half of the cheese to the tortilla On top of the cheese, add half of the green onion and spinach. Step 3: Sprinkle with half the garlic salt and chili powder. Step 4: Top with another tortilla, turn over and fry in skillet until the cheese melts. Step 5: Slice into quarters and serve hot. Step 6: Repeat with next 2 tortillas Good served with salsa and sour cream! Step 7: This would be great served with guacamole on lettuce and refried beans or / and rice.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, monterey jack cheese, cream cheese, milk, jalapeno
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cheeses and milk over medium low heat and stir until smooth and creamy. Step 2: Add beans and jalepenos and stir until uniform consistency. Step 3: Pour into a bowl and serve with tortilla chips If you use the pepper jack cheese, you may not need to add any additional jalapenos This makes enough for any picnic or bbq, if you want to cut the recipe, just keep the cheeses and milk in equal thirds, and add beans to taste.

Ingredient Names: avocado, lime juice, garlic, green onion, diced tomato, yellow onion, green bell pepper, chili powder, olive oil, flour tortillas, shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Pit avocado and mash in a small mixing bowl with the lime juice. Step 2: Add garlic, green onion, tomato, yellow onion, bell pepper, salt and chili powder, mix thoroughly. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil over medium heat in a medium skillet. Step 5: Place tortilla in skillet and top with 1 / 3 cup cheese. Step 6: When cheese has melted and tortilla is slightly browned, spoon on some guacamole and top with another tortilla. Step 7: Flip, and allow the second tortilla to brown. Step 8: Remove from heat and cut into wedges. Step 9: Repeat with remaining ingredients.

Ingredient Names: enchilada sauce, instant rice, green bell pepper, vegetarian refried beans, flour tortillas, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, bring the sauce to a boil. Step 2: Add rice and pepper. Step 3: Cover, remove from burner and let stand 5-10 minutes then fluff with a fork Next, spread 1 / 4 cup of the beans evenly over tortillas to within 1 inch of edges. Step 4: Top each with 1 / 4 of the rice mixture, tomato and cheese. Step 5: Spoon in the sour cream down centers of tortillas, roll tortillas up. Step 6: Serve right away while warm.

Dish Name: Cheesy Roasted Corn Red Pepper Black Bean Dip Rsc
Ingredient Names: black beans, fresh garlic cloves, apple cider vinegar, seasoning, fresh corn, butter, salt, white pepper, red pepper, fresh cilantro, scallion, lime, monterey jack cheese, reynolds wrap foil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Remove top of red pepper, remove seeds and cut red pepper into quarters Flatten and lay on a small piece of reynolds wrap on top of a cookie sheet. Step 3: Place in 450 degree oven for 8 minutes. Step 4: Remove & allow to cool Shuck ears of corn, wash and pat dry Lay out a piece of reynolds wrap large enough to completely wrap up and cover the corn Salt and white pepper to taste. Step 5: Place a tbs of butter on each ear. Step 6: Wrap tightly and place in oven and roast for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, vegetable oil, milk
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the flour and baking powder in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Add the salt and vegetable oil to the lukewarm milk and whisk briefly to incorporate Gradually add the milk to the flour, and work the mixture into a dough It will be sticky. Step 3: Turn the dough out onto a surface dusted with flour and knead vigorously for about 2 minutes The kneading will take care of the stickiness. Step 4: Return the dough to the bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rest for 15 minutes. Step 5: Divide your dough into 8 balls of equal size, cover them, and let them rest again for about 20 minutes Avoid letting them touch, if you don't want them to stick together. Step 6: Dust your work surface with flour.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, white onion, garlic cloves, serrano peppers, vegetable stock, vegan chicken, tomatoes, green chili sauce, lime juice, black pepper, cayenne pepper, cilantro, corn tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the onion, garlic, and hot pepper, and cook for about 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Step 2: Stir in the stock, chickette, tomato, hot sauce, lime juice, pepper, and cayenne. Step 3: Simmer until the "chicken" is cooked, about 5 to 7 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the cilantro and adjust the seasonings as needed While the soup is cooking, preheat the oven to 350f spread the tortilla strips on a baking sheet and bake for about 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned and crispy. Step 5: Top the soup with the tortilla strips.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, taco seasoning, flour tortillas, lettuce, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Dump both cans of beans into a skillet. Step 2: Stir and let simmer for about 10-15 minutes. Step 3: Add beans to flour tortillas and then put lettuce, salsa or anything really that you like on burritos.

Ingredient Names: chickpeas, vegetable broth, anaheim chilies, salt, pepper, cooking oil, flour tortillas, lettuce, avocado, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, green onion, black olives, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the drained beans with vegetable broth in a saucepan or microwave. Step 2: Place in a blender or food processor with chilies Process until coarsely chopped, or puree if you want it smooth. Step 3: Season to taste with salt and peppers. Step 4: Set aside To cook tostadas: Heat oil in skillet to about 365f. Step 5: Fry tortillas in hot oil, one at a time, on both sides just until crisp, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Drain To assemble tostadas:.

Dish Name: Chihuahua Tomato Soup With Crispy Lime Chili Tortillas
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic, olive oil, diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, dried pasilla pepper, masa harina, lime, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, salt, chili powder, chihuahua cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in olive oil until slightly browned. Step 2: Add garlic, cumin and oregano. Step 3: Cook for 10 more minutes, stirring frequently. Step 4: Add tomatoes, vegetable broth and pasilla chile. Step 5: Bring to a boil, then lower heat slightly and add masa harina, stirring well until it's dissolved. Step 6: Simmer gently 30 minutes In the meantime, heat vegetable oil in a skillet Carefully add tortilla strips. Step 7: Sprinkle with salt and chili powder and fry until lightly crispy. Step 8: Sprinkle with the juice of 1 / 2 lime and set aside.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, zucchini, black beans, tomatoes, corn, cumin, salt, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce, reduced-fat cheddar cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f Lightly coat a 9x13-inch backing dish with cooking spray. Step 2: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onion and cook Stirring often, until starting to turn brown. Step 4: Stir in zucchini, beans, tomatoes, corn, cumin and salt. Step 5: Cook stirring occasionally Scatter half of the tortilla pieces in the baking dish. Step 6: Top with with about half of the vegetable mixture, enchilada sauce and half the cheese. Step 7: Repeat with one more layer of tortillas, veggies, sauce, and cheese.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onion, green onions, jalapeno chiles, habanero peppers, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Chop one of the tomatoes coarsely and place in a blender with one each of the jalapenos, habaneros, serranos, and the lime juice Pulse until the mixture has broken down into a sauce. Step 2: Chop the other tomato Also finely chop the remaining jalapeno, habanero, and serrano, placing all in a small bowl. Step 3: Mix in onions, cilantro, and mixture from blender. Step 4: Add salt and adjust to taste. Step 5: Allow to sit 1-2 hours to blend flavors before serving.

Ingredient Names: mild chiles, cheddar cheese, flour tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Roast and peel the chiles and cut open lengthwise. Step 2: Remove the seeds and stuff with the cheese. Step 3: Wrap each chile tightly in a flour tortilla. Step 4: Place on a microwaveable plate and heat for a couple of minutes on medium heat, until the cheese is melted Or, heat in the oven for about 5-8 minutes at 350f, until cheese is melted, serve hot.

Dish Name: Chile Rellenos With Red Chile Sauce
Ingredient Names: green chili peppers, monterey jack cheese, egg, flour, baking powder, salt, water, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Make a 2" slit lengthwise in each green chile pepper Very carefully remove the seeds. Step 2: Place 1 / 8 of the cheese strips in each pepper In large bowl combine egg, flour, baking powder, salt, and water. Step 3: Whisk together making a thick batter I large heavy pot place oil and heat on high until hot You can deep fry or just an inch of oil will do. Step 4: Dip stuffed chiles in batter. Step 5: Cook in hot oil for 3-4 minutes until they are golden brown. Step 6: Drain well on paper towels.

Dish Name: Chileatole Green Chile Soup With Corn Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, white onion, jalapeno chiles, poblano chiles, anaheim chilies, fresh corn kernels, water, kosher salt, epazote leaves, fresh cilantro, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a 10-inch skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and all the chiles and cook, stirring, until the onion is soft and pale gold, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Transfer to a 5 quart slow cooker. Step 4: Place the corn in a food processor and pulse several times, until the kernels are broken up but it is not quite smooth. Step 5: Add to the slow cooker along with the water and salt. Step 6: Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Step 7: Stir in the epazote, cilantro, and pepper. Step 8: Puree in batches in a blender, or with an immersion blender right in the crockpot, until it is smooth If necessary, thin the soup with a little water. Step 9: Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

Ingredient Names: chilies, monterey jack cheese, all-purpose flour, butter, onions, garlic clove, tomato puree, dry oregano, salt, eggs
Instructions: Step 1: Roast chiles 3" under broiler, rotating until charred and blistered, about 3-4 minutes. Step 2: Place chiles in a sealed plastic bag or bowl covered with plastic wrap until cool enough to handle and skin is loose enough to peel Peel off skins under cold running water, then make a small slit three-quarters down length of chile and discard seeds, leaving stem attached. Step 3: Cut cheese in six 3 / 4 - 1" thick slices slightly smaller than the chiles. Step 4: Stuff each chile with 1 piece of cheese. Step 5: Roll stuffed chiles in flour, shake off excess and set aside In medium size frying pan, melt butter over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add onion and garlic, cook, stirring until golden. Step 7: Add tomato puree and oregano, season to taste with salt. Step 8: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes and keep warm.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, wonton skins, cheddar cheese, ricotta cheese, green chili, hot sauce, scallion, cumin, sliced ripe olives, pimentos
Instructions: Step 1: Spray two miniature muffin tins with cooking spray With a 3-inch cookie cutter, cut wonton skins into circles. Step 2: Place one circle in each muffin cup Mold it to the cup Spray lightly with additional cooking spray. Step 3: Bake at 350f For 7 to 8 minutes or until golden brown. Step 4: Remove from tins and place on cookie sheet. Step 5: Combine cheeses, chiles, hot sauce, green onion, and cumin in medium bowl, mix well.

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, red bell pepper, fresh corn kernels, green onion, pine nuts, garlic cloves, cheese, fresh cilantro, salt, black beans, butter, ground cumin, ground nutmeg, all-purpose flour, chipotle chile
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler I using broiler place chiles on a foil-lined baking sheet, broil 3 inches from heat 8 minutes or until blackened, turning after 4 minutes. Step 2: Place in zip-lock bag, seal. Step 3: Let stand for 15 minutes Peel and discard skins, cut a lengthwise slit in each chile, discarding seeds, leaving stems intact. Step 4: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 5: Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat. Step 6: Add bell pepper, cook 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 7: Add corn, onions, nuts and garlic, cook 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Remove from heat, stir in 3 / 4 cup cheese, cilantro, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, corn, manchego cheese, poblano chiles, rice, crema, salsa, anejo cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Saute the onion until translucent, add garlic and cook 1 minute more. Step 3: Add corn, salt and pepper, and saute about 2 minutes. Step 4: Place in a bowl and cool. Step 5: Stir in the mexican manchego cheese and set aside Slit the roasted and peeled poblano chiles lengthwise, remove the seeds and veins. Step 6: Leave the stems and tops intact. Step 7: Stuff the chiles with the corn mixture Arrance the rice in a shallow buttered casserole Nestle the stuffed chiles into the rice, in a single layer.

Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, cream cheese, eggs, flour, salt, oil, onions, peanut oil, tomato sauce, oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Slit peppers at lower end. Step 2: Remove seeds and pulpy connective tissue, but leave on stems Parboil until tender. Step 3: Stuff each pepper with two pieces of cream cheese 1 / 8-inch thick. Step 4: Beat egg whites until they are white. Step 5: Add yolks and continue beating until uniform and fluffy Salt the egg batter. Step 6: Heat oil for cooking. Step 7: Roll pepper in flour then dip in egg batter. Step 8: Fry until egg is golden.

Ingredient Names: mild green chilies, monterey jack cheese, flour, eggs, oil, sour cream, cilantro, onion, garlic cloves, tomatoes, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Place chiles on a comal or dry hot skillet and roast over high heat turning as skins blacken. Step 2: Place chiles in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap allow to steam 15 minutes While chiles are steaming, make tomato sauce Tomato sauce: heat oil in a large saucepan. Step 3: Add onion and garlic and cook only until the onion is soft. Step 4: Add pureed tomatoes and chicken broth, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer over low heat while you finish the rest of the recipe. Step 5: Remove charred peels from chiles I use two different methods for removing the seeds depending on the type of chile Anaheim- slice off the top 1 / 2 inch of chile on the stem end removing the seed placenta and any loose seeds with your fingers Poblano- carefully slit each chile lengthwise along one side.

Ingredient Names: hot peppers, vegetable oil, coarse salt, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat a comal, griddle, or small cast iron skillet over medium high heat Slightly flatten whole chiles Rub each chile with a thin coat of oil, then roast them on the preheated pan for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until they begin to blister and char. Step 2: Remove roasted chiles to a serving dish. Step 3: Sprinkle with coarse salt to taste, and squeeze lime wedges over chiles. Step 4: Serve as a bar snack, or as an accompaniment to grilled meats.

Dish Name: Chili Con Elote Chili With Corn
Ingredient Names: onions, garlic cloves, sweet pepper, vegetable stock, tomato paste, corn, kidney beans, cumin, paprika, chili powder, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the onion and garlic and fry gentle for a few minutes. Step 2: Chop the bell pepper, add to the pan and fry for 2-3 minutes longer. Step 3: Add the stock and tomato paste and bring to the boil. Step 4: Add the corn and lower the heat to a simmer. Step 5: Mash half of the beans and add both the mashed and the whole beans to the pan. Step 6: Stir and simmer for 15 minutes, serve.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, chili beans, onion, frozen mixed vegetables, celery, tomato juice, water, sugar, lime juice, fresh ground pepper, cayenne pepper, chili powder, sodium-free seasoning, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Put everything in a 4 quart or larger slow cooker. Step 2: Cook on low for at least 6 hours We like our soups very long simmered, so i let this go a good 8-10 hours I don't think you can overcook it.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, celery, carrot, green pepper, garlic, chili powder, ground cumin, tomatoes with juice, water, canned pinto beans, bulgar wheat, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place the oil in a heavy 3-quart saucepan. Step 2: Add the onions, celery, carrots and peppers. Step 3: Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender but not brown. Step 4: Stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin, cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the tomatoes with juice and water, bring chili to a simmer. Step 6: Cover the pan, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour. Step 7: Add the beans and bulgar. Step 8: Cook for 30 minutes, or until the bulgur is cooked through and the vegetables are tender. Step 9: Add salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: dried chilies, dried ancho chiles, dried mulato chiles, pasilla chiles, dried guajillo chilies, chipotle chiles, dried chile pequins, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, whole cloves, dried mexican oregano, mild paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Stem and deseed dried chiles and break into large pieces Toast dried chile pieces in an ungreased iron skillet for about 1 minute, or until just fragrant. Step 2: Remove chiles and set aside to cool Over low heat, toast cumin, coriander, and cloves in the iron skillet for about 2-3 minutes or until they become aromatic. Step 3: Set aside in a small dish to cool Grind the chile pieces in a spice grinder or small coffee mill and set in a bowl Grind the toasted spices and oregano the same way and add to the bowl, and stir Regrind the mixture to a fine powder. Step 4: Blend the paprika and red pepper into the chili powder if you are using them. Step 5: Store mixture in an airtight container away from light and heat.

Ingredient Names: chile, sharp cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, eggs, evaporated milk, flour, salt, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Layer chilies and cheese in 9x13 baking dish. Step 2: Mix egg yolks, milk flour and salt. Step 3: Beat egg whites until stiff. Step 4: Fold into yolk mixture. Step 5: Pour over cheese and chilies. Step 6: Bake at 325 for 1 hour. Step 7: Pour tomato sauce over. Step 8: Return to oven for 10 more minutes.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, diced green chilies, fat free sour cream, low-fat cheddar cheese, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients and pour into a lightly oiled baking disk Bake in oven, uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Chili's Copycat Salsa Recipe By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: canned tomatoes, jalapenos, lime juice, salt, cumin, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, jalapenos, lime juice and spices in food processor Run on high speed until tomatoes are nearly pureed, yet still chunky. Step 2: Pour into bowl and add onions. Step 3: Stir well, cover & store overnight for flavors to properly develop.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, onions, green peppers, red peppers, vinegar, sugar, salt, clove, allspice, cinnamon, bay leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Chop everything and cook slowly over a low flame or on low Simmer until thick, and then seal in jars.

Ingredient Names: red kidney beans, pinto beans, chickpeas, whole kernel corn, celery, green onions, parsley, diced green chilies, lettuce leaf, salad oil, wine vinegar, garlic clove, salt, chili powder, dried oregano
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all salad ingredients together except for the lettuce. Step 2: Make dressing by combining all the ingredients in a small bowl, and stirring well. Step 3: Pour dressing over salad, and mix lightly. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Step 5: Stir lightly before serving on lettuce leaves.

Ingredient Names: artichoke hearts, parmesan cheese, green chili peppers, mayonnaise, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: In a small mixing bowl combine the arty chokes, cheese, peppers and mayonnaise. Step 2: Transfer the mixture to an 8-inch round baking dish. Step 3: Bake, uncovered, in a 350f oven for 20 minutes. Step 4: Serve warm with tortilla chips or tostadas.

Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, vegetarian refried beans, salsa, brown rice, black beans, green chilies, salt, chili powder, cumin powder, wheat flour tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Fry onions and garlic in a little oil. Step 2: Set aside tortillas and mix all other ingredients together. Step 3: Put 1 / 2 cup mixture in tortillas, fold bottom of tortilla up, sides in and top down over mixture. Step 4: Fry in oil, or a low-fat method is, spray or brush each side of chimis with oil-i use 1 / 2 tsp Oil per chimi If doing this put the chimis on a cookie sheet and bake at 400f degrees about 10 minutes or until the bottom of the chimis are light brown. Step 5: Turn chimis over and bake about another 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: extra virgin olive oil, onion, salt, garlic cloves, chipotle chile in adobo, ground cumin, dried oregano, pinto beans, breadcrumbs, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add onions and salt, and cook, stirring often, 7 to 10 minutes, or until softened. Step 3: Add garlic, chipotle chile, cumin and oregano. Step 4: Cook, stirring often, 1 minute. Step 5: Add a third of the beans and 1 / 3 cup water, and, using potato masher or fork, mash beans. Step 6: When liquid is absorbed, add another third of beans and 1 / 3 cup liquid, and mash until mixture is chunky. Step 7: Stir in last third of beans, and mash lightly. Step 8: Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is very thick and mostly dry. Step 9: Transfer beans to mixing bowl to cool, about 15 minutes. Step 10: Stir in 1 / 4 cup breadcrumbs.

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, granny smith apple, sherry wine vinegar, light brown sugar, granulated sugar, chipotle chile, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the poblano or aneheim chiles directly over a gas flame or under the broiler as close to the heat as possible, turning, until charred on all sides Move to a paper bag and let steam for 10 minutes Peel off the blackened skins and discard the cores, ribs and seeds Finely chop the chiles. Step 2: In a medium nonreactive saucepan, combine the roasted chiles with the apple, vinegar, brown sugar, granulated sugar, chipotle chile and garlic. Step 3: Cook over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until the apple is tender and the liquid is almost completely evaporated, about 25 minutes. Step 4: Let the chutney cool This chutney can be refrigerated up to one week You may can if desired, by boiling in a water bath 10 minutes.

Dish Name: Chipotle Corn And Black Bean Stew
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic cloves, cumin, chipotle peppers, crushed tomatoes, water, russet potatoes, carrots, corn, black beans, fresh cilantro, lime, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a stockpot, saute the onions in the oil over moderate heat for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the garlic, cumin, salt and pepper. Step 3: Saute 1 minute more. Step 4: Add the chipotles, tomatoes, and water, stir. Step 5: Add the potatoes and carrots, bring to a low boil, and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 6: Uncover, add the corn and beans Thin with more water if needed. Step 7: Cook uncovered for 5 more minutes. Step 8: Add the cilantro, lime zest, and lime juice. Step 9: Let sit for at least 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, chipotle chile in adobo, fresh cilantro, green onions, garlic clove, crescent roll dough
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all ingredients for the filling. Step 2: Spoon approximately one tablespoon of filling in the center of the larger side of a crescent roll, and spread out just a bit. Step 3: Roll up crescent roll beginning with large end, and press any seams together to keep in filling. Step 4: Repeat with remaining crescent rolls. Step 5: Bake at 375 degrees farenheit for 11-13 minutes, or until rolls are browned.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour, broth, water, cumin, garlic, oregano, chipotle chiles, adobo sauce, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a small saucepan, stir in flour. Step 2: Cook this roux until it is light brown. Step 3: Remove pan from heat and slowly stir in broth. Step 4: Place pan over medium heat and whisk in water. Step 5: Add the spices, garlic, chiles, and adobo sauce. Step 6: Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Step 7: Whisk in sour cream.

Dish Name: Chipotle Grill Inspired Tomatillo Green Chili Salsa
Ingredient Names: tomatoes, tomatillos, red onion, garlic cloves, jalapeno peppers, limes, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, red pepper flakes, ground coriander, tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce, sea salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the above ingredients into a food processor Pulse until desired consistency is reached I gave it about 4 pulses to reach a small sized chunk, perfect for scooping with chips.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, garlic, virgin olive oil, chipotle powder, salt, black pepper, lime juice, coriander cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200°C/390°F. Step 2: Place cauliflower in a large bowl. Drizzle over oil, sprinkle with garlic. Use hands to mix and rub oil over all cauliflower. Step 3: Sprinkle over chipotle, salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Step 4: Spread out on tray. Bake 25 minutes, tossing once, until the edges are caramlised and cauliflower is just tender. Step 5: Remove from oven. Push cauliflower together, drizzle over lime juice. Step 6: Sprinkle with coriander and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, red onions, red wine vinegar, chipotle chile in adobo, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients and mix well The pico de gallo can be used immediately, or it can be stored in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: water, salt, rice, fresh cilantro, lime, olive oil, green pepper, red onion, salt and pepper, monterey jack cheese, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water and salt to a boil, add rice and stir. Step 2: Simmer for 20 minutes covered. Step 3: Add juice of a lime and cilantro and mix. Step 4: Cover till ready to serve Towards the end of the 20 minute rice, start the vegetables. Step 5: Heat olive oil on medium heat. Step 6: Add sliced peppers and onions. Step 7: Add salt and pepper to taste Saut for 7-10 minutes till almost stir-fried brown.

Ingredient Names: avocados, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, onion, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Using fork, mash avocado with lime juice in small bowl. Step 2: Add cilantro, onion, garlic, serrano chilies and salt, stir to combine. Step 3: Chill until ready to serve. Step 4: Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: tomatillos, plum tomatoes, garlic, onion, canned chipotle chiles, fresh cilantro, vegan sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Line baking pan with foil Lightly oil pan with olive oil Broil tomatillos, tomatoes, garlic, and onion until browned on all sides, turning frequently. Step 3: Remove skins from garlic. Step 4: Place vegetables in food processor or blender and add remaining ingredients. Step 5: Chop coarsely or pulse lightly, season to taste.

Ingredient Names: sweet onion, garlic cloves, dried chipotle chiles, fresh cilantro, water, coarse salt, sugar, tomatillo, lime
Instructions: Step 1: To roast tomatillos: Place in shallow baking pan and place under broiler, turning occasionally, until charred and softened To roast in a skillet, place whole fruit, in a hot skillet over medium high heat and roast, turning occasionally, until quite charred all over and slightly softened. Step 2: Combine onion, garlic, chipotles, cilantro, and water in a small saucepan. Step 3: Bring to a boil and simmer until the chile softens, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to a blender. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients and puree until smooth. Step 6: Store in a container in the fridge 2-3 days.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes with juice, tomato paste, chipotle chiles in adobo, spanish onion, cilantro, ground cumin, salt, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in 5-quart pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add sliced onions and saut for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 3: Add all remaining ingredients except salt and simmer for 20 minutes. Step 4: Turn off heat and use an immersion or regular blender to puree salsa, taste. Step 5: Add salt to your liking. Step 6: Serve warm or cold with beef empanadas, pork dishes, soups, stuffed sweet plantains, tortilla chips or plantain chips.

Dish Name: Chipotles En Adobo Chipotles Chili In Adobo Sauce
Ingredient Names: dried chipotle chiles, onion, cider vinegar, garlic cloves, ketchup, salt, cumin, dark brown sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a heavy bottom pan, cover, and cook over very low heat for 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours, until the chiles are very soft and the liquid has reduced down to 1 cup Alternate method: Place ingredients in a dutch oven and bake at 325 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours till peppers are tender, and sauce is thick You can also can this into a half pint jar and water bath it for 12 minutes at sea level.

Dish Name: Chocolate And Chipotle Black Bean Chilli
Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, garlic clove, red pepper, chili powder, paprika, chipotle paste, chopped tomatoes, salt and pepper, black beans, dark chocolate, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion and garlic on a medium heat for about 5 minutes until soft, then add the red pepper, chili powder, paprika and chipotle paste mix well and cook for a further few minutes. Step 2: Add the tinned tomatoes and season well. Step 3: Turn the heat up until simmering and add the black beans and chocolate and stir in well. Step 4: Cook for around 10 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Step 5: Serve topped with spring onions with tortilla chips and dips, or rice.

Ingredient Names: butter, flour tortillas, semi-sweet chocolate chips, ground cinnamon, sugar, vanilla yogurt
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly butter both sides of each tortilla. Step 2: Place each tortilla in a medium-hot skillet and sprinkle 1 / 4 of the chocolate chips on each tortilla. Step 3: Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar to taste on top As the chocolate starts to melt and stick to the tortilla, fold over and brown lightly on each side. Step 4: Cut into wedges and serve with vanilla yogurt.

Dish Name: Chopped Mexican Salad With Roasted Peppers Corn Tomatoes And
Ingredient Names: orange bell peppers, corn, extra virgin olive oil, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic clove, fresh lime juice, fresh orange juice, shallots, honey, cumin seed, tomatoes, jicama, black beans, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425-degrees. Step 2: Line baking sheet with foil. Step 3: Drizzle 1 tablespoon oil over peppers and corn, rubbing in to vegetables. Step 4: Sprinkle with salt and pepper Roast peppers about 20 minutes. Step 5: Turn corn occasionally throughout cooking time. Step 6: After roasting cut corn off cob and scrape skin off peppers Dice peppers To make dressing, mince garlic and combine with salt to make a paste. Step 7: Whisk with ingredients.

Ingredient Names: pecan halves, unsalted butter, sweetened flaked coconut, dried cranberries, semisweet chocolate morsel, sweetened condensed milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Step 2: Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or use a non-stick cookie sheet, set aside. Step 3: Toss the pecans in the melted butter to evenly coat. Step 4: Spread the nuts on an ungreased baking sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden. Step 5: Set aside to cool, then roughly chop. Step 6: Place the chopped pecans and remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix with a wooden spoon until moistened. Step 7: Spoon about 2 tablespoons of batter for each cookie onto the lined cookie sheet and gently flatten to circles of about 2 1 / 4 inches in diameter These cookies do not spread. Step 8: Bake 10 mintes or until the coconut turns a very pale golden, being careful not to brown too much. Step 9: Transfer to racks to cool.

Ingredient Names: tomatoes, stewed tomatoes, avocados, scallion, garlic cloves, lime juice, cilantro, black olives, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl You can save some of the juice from the cans of stewed tomatoes and mixed in, if desired You determine how chunky the salsa is depending on how small you chop / slice the ingredients.

Ingredient Names: sugar, ground cinnamon, puff pastry, dulce de leche
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees f. Step 2: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. Step 3: Mix the sugar with the cinnamon in a small bowl and set aside. Step 4: Sprinkle some cinnamon sugar on your work surface and place the puff pastry in an even, single layer on top. Step 5: Brush the pastry lightly with water and sprinkle generously with cinnamon sugar. Step 6: Flip the pastry over and repeat on the second side. Step 7: Cut the pastry into 1 / 2 to 3 / 4-inch wide strips. Step 8: Place them on the prepared baking sheet, twisting the ends of each strip so it looks like a corkscrew. Step 9: Bake until they're puffed and golden brown, 20 minutes and set aside to cool completely. Step 10: Serve with dulce de leche or caramel dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Cilantro Cream Sauce Tastes Like Guacamole
Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, sour cream, fresh cilantro leaves, lime peel, garlic, cumin, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Step 2: Add more salt and pepper to season to your liking If you let sit in refrigerator it will firm up a bit If you will serve warm, stir in a spoon of fresh cream and just pop in microwave for a few seconds before serving Serving suggestions: -spoon a bit under skin of chicken breast and add some cheese before baking. Step 3: Then drizzle baked chicken with more of this sauce - drizzle over any style enchiladas - serve as dip next to salsa for chips - leftover sauce makes an amazing salad dressing.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, salt, cilantro, parsley, sherry wine vinegar, olive oil, hot pepper sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Using your steel knife in the food processor mix garlic and salt Process until it is a paste. Step 2: Add cilantro and parsley Process to a fine mince. Step 3: Add vinegar Process for 10 seconds. Step 4: Add oil in a slow steady stream with the processor on. Step 5: Add hot pepper sauce and a pinch of sugar. Step 6: Chill the dressing for several hours in a glass jar Shake to combine before using.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, honey, olive oil, lime juice, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, cumin powder, chili flakes, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Press tofu well and slice into 8 thick slabs. Step 2: Whisk together remaining ingredients Coat tofu in marinade. Step 3: Marinate in the refrigerator for at least two hours, and up to overnight Tofu tends to stick to grills, so prepare your barbecue with a non-stick cooking spray or by rubbing it with oil. Step 4: Grill over a pre-heated grill for 6-7 minutes on each side, until browned, brushing occasionally with extra marinade.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, limes, lime, fresh cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Once your rice is cooked fluff with fork Add lime juice, zest, cilantro and salt Stir well Serve warm Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: cilantro leaf, tomatoes, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Place ingredients in food processer bowl and process until it has a pesto like consistency In other words, you don't want it to be cilantro juice. Step 2: Line an ice cube tray with saran wrap and spoon cilantro mixture into tray. Step 3: When frozen, transfer to a freezer bag or container. Step 4: Wash your ice cube tray otherwise your ice will be cilantro-flavored To thaw a single cube for use in a burrito, microwave it for 20 seconds or add it to the frying pan about a minute before you're done cooking.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, jalapeno pepper, red bell pepper, red onion, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, olive oil, ground cumin, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together all ingredients in a medium bowl Chill until ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: onion, tortilla chips, fresh garlic, fresh jalapeno peppers, mozzarella cheese, green pepper, black beans, tomatoes, sour cream, salsa, olive
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a non-stick pan to saute onions on medium high until clear. Step 2: Add garlic and saute for one minute. Step 3: Add beans, pepper, and jalapenos to pan, cook and stir for about 10 minutes. Step 4: Take the pan off the stove, transfer the contents to a bowl. Step 5: Mash bean mixture until smooth, only adding water if necessary to make puree smooth. Step 6: Place chips on a baking sheet. Step 7: Spread beans, onions and pepper mixture evenly on top of tortilla chips. Step 8: Then sprinkle with cheese and diced tomatoes. Step 9: Bake until cheese melts, about 10 minutes. Step 10: Arrange chopped onions and toppings around serving dish.

Ingredient Names: avocados, scallions, garlic cloves, grape tomatoes, jalapeno, salt, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Slice avacados in half, remove the pit, and scoop out the flesh with a spoon. Step 2: Add lime juice and mash. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine, chunks are more than acceptable! Step 4: Check for seasoning, and add more salt of needed. Step 5: Cover bowl with saran wrap, pressed down to the very top of the guacamole to prevent from browning. Step 6: Chill until ready to serve. Step 7: Serve over tacos or burritos, or with tortilla chips!

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, sugar, cinnamon, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cinnamon and sugar, set aside. Step 2: Pour oil 2" deep in medium skillet, heat to 375. Step 3: Cut each tortilla into 8 strips, each approx 1" wide. Step 4: Fry 3-5 strips at a time until golden brown and crisp, turning once. Step 5: Remove and drain on paper towels. Step 6: Sprinkle with cinnamon mix while still warm. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Cinnamon Pumpkin Empanadas Empanadas De Calabazas
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, ground cloves, water, dry yeast, baking powder, flour, vegetable shortening
Instructions: Step 1: For the filling: mix ingredients together and set aside. Step 2: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 3: Combine water, sugar, salt, yeast, baking powder, and cinnamon. Step 4: Using an electric mixer, gradually blend in half of the flour. Step 5: Add shortening and thoroughly mix, then gradually blend in remaining flour. Step 6: Divide dough into 4 equal parts, then shape each of those parts into 4 dough balls Slap the dough balls between the palms of your well-floured hands until somewhat flattened, then roll out on a floured surface into circles approximately 4 inches in diameter and 1 / 8-inch thick. Step 7: Put about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of pumpkin filling in the center of each circle, fold over, and seal edges by moistening slightly and pressing lightly with a fork on both sides. Step 8: Bake on a greased cookie sheet until golden brown, 18 to 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: avocados, lemon juice, orange juice, lime juice, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro leaves, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients food processor and pulse until smooth If not using immediately, store in a container with plastic wrap pressed on top of the dip to prevent browning Makes about 2 cups Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: poblano chiles, mild cheddar cheese, all-purpose flour, salt, fresh ground black pepper, vegetable shortening, egg yolks, egg whites, sharp cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Roast the chiles: Roast the chilies by broiling three to five minutes on each side The skin will begin to char and get black spots. Step 2: Remove, cool a minute or two, then wrap in plastic wrap and let it sit five minutes. Step 3: Remove the wrap and peel chilies. Step 4: Keep the broiler on Carefully cut a lengthwise slit into each chile and stuff with some cheddar cheese. Step 5: Combine the flour, salt and pepper and dredge the chiles. Step 6: In a large saucepan, heat 1 / 2" of shortening till very hot. Step 7: Fold the egg yolks into the whites and working with 2 chiles at a time, dip the chiles into the egg batter and fry, turning occasionally, until golden brown, no more than a couple of minutes.

Dish Name: Classic Chili Rellenos With Anaheim Peppers
Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, cheddar cheese, eggs, water, flour, salt, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: To roast chilies: Place chile peppers on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet Broil 5 inches from the heat 5 minutes on each side or until chile peppers are blistered. Step 2: Place chile peppers in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag Seal. Step 3: Let stand 10 minutes to loosen skins Peel peppers, leaving stems attached. Step 4: Make a slit in the side of each chile, remove seeds, and stuff with cheese sticks Dredge chiles with flour. Step 5: Beat egg whites until they become stiff and peaks form.

Ingredient Names: sugar, water, whole milk, eggs, vanilla extract, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f stir 1 / 2 cup sugar and 1 / 4 cup water in heavy small saucepan over low heat until sugar dissolves Increase heat. Step 2: Boil without stirring until syrup is deep amber color, brushing down sides of pan with wet pastry brush and swirling pan occasionally, about 10 minutes. Step 3: Divide caramel among six 3 / 4-cup custard cups Working quickly, tilt cups, coating bottoms and part of sides. Step 4: Stir milk and 1 / 2 cup sugar in medium saucepan over low heat just until sugar dissolves. Step 5: Whisk eggs in medium bowl until blended Slowly whisk in milk mixture. Step 6: Whisk in vanilla and salt. Step 7: Strain custard into prepared cups.

Ingredient Names: black beans, onion, pickled jalapeno pepper, garlic, black pepper, cumin, chili powder, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in blender and process until smooth Serve with tortilla chips, carrots and bell peppers for dipping.

Ingredient Names: sugar, milk, sweetened coconut milk, egg yolks, eggs, vanilla extract, crystallized ginger, sliced almonds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350'f. Step 2: Bring one quart of water to a boil. Step 3: In a thin saute pan, cook the sugar over medium heat until it is amber-coloured and bubbly Watch the pan closely and lift the pan off the burner if the sugar is cooking quickly or unevenly Shake the pan to distribute the melting sugar. Step 4: When the sugar is completely caramelized, pour the hot mixture into the bottom of a 3-quart flan mold, bundt pan, loaf pan or individual molds Rotate the mold in your hands, using potholders, so that the sugar syrup covers the entire bottom of the pan. Step 5: Set aside Please be careful, because the sugar is extremely hot, and it can burn your skin. Step 6: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the milk, sweetened coconut milk, egg yolks, eggs, vanilla, and ginger and whisk well.

Ingredient Names: low-fat milk, unsweetened coconut milk, sweetened condensed milk, unsweetened cocoa powder, vanilla, sweetened whipped cream, chocolate shavings
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan combine the low fat milk, coconut milk, and sweetened condensed milk. Step 2: Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Whisk in cocoa powder until well combined. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla You may add more sugar if desired. Step 5: Serve in mugs topped with the whipped cream and chocolate shavings if desired Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: zucchini, garlic cloves, diced onion, cilantro, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Place olive oil and garlic over medium heat in a pan Sautee until garlic cloves turn lightly brown. Step 2: Add diced zucchini and onion, sautee until zucchini obtains a transparent appearance. Step 3: Add water, chopped cilantro, salt and pepper to taste. Step 4: Cover, reduce heat and cook for five minutes.

Dish Name: Cold Spicy Vegetable Soup Take A Look No Cook
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, fresh basil, garlic, tomatoes, vidalia onion, celery, carrot, tomatillo, lime, chipotle chile in adobo, yogurt, ice cubes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put all soup ingredients into blender and blend till smooth You can serve as is or chill for an hour. Step 2: Top with 1 teaspoon of a mixture of every finely diced tomato, celery, and onions or herbs like basil or cilantro, and lime slices and serve in a margarita glass.

Ingredient Names: chopped tomatoes, jalapeno, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a hot, dry skillet, blister the jalapenos, turning until blackened on all sides. Step 2: Remove from the skillet and let cool. Step 3: When cool enough to handle, stem, seed, and roughly chop. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and jalapenos to a blender or food processor, and puree to desired consistency. Step 5: Add garlic salt to taste, keeping in mind that the taste will become more pronounced after it chills. Step 6: Store in a pint jar in the fridge.

Ingredient Names: dried red beans, cold water, vegetable shortening, white onion, salt, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse beans thoroughly in sieve under cold running water, picking out any debris or blemished beans. Step 2: Place beans, water, 1 tblspn shortening and sliced onion in 3ltr saucepan. Step 3: Bring to a boil over high heat. Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Step 5: Cover and simmer one and a half hours or just until beans are tender, not soft The onion cooks properly even in the shorter time, i cooked the beans like this for about 30 minutes. Step 6: Stir in salt, cover and simmer over very low heat 30 to 45 minutes until beans are very soft Do not drain. Step 7: Heat remaining 1 / 3 cup shortening in heavy large skillet over high heat until very hot. Step 8: Add chopped onion and garlic.

Ingredient Names: habaneros, mango, yellow mustard, brown sugar, white vinegar, curry powder, ground cumin, chili powder, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Slice caps off of habaneros, remove seeds and set aside Coarsely chop the body of the habaneros and add to food processor bowl. Step 2: Cut mango into bowl trying to catch all juice. Step 3: Add the mango flesh and juice to the processor bowl and puree. Step 4: Now add the remaining ingredients and process till smooth. Step 5: Taste, and add the seed bundles you reserved from the habaneros a few at a time to taste. Step 6: Pour into jar or bottle and store in refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: tomato sauce, water, yellow onion, fresh jalapeno peppers, white vinegar, salt, dried onion flakes, garlic powder
Instructions: Step 1: Bring all ingredients to a boil in saucepan over med-high heat. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until thick. Step 3: Remove from heat and cool. Step 4: Store in an airtight jar in refrigerator until serving.

Dish Name: Corn And Black Bean Salad With A Kick
Ingredient Names: black beans, sweet corn, red onion, red pepper, balsamic vinegar, oil, salt, white sugar, ground black pepper, ground cumin, chili powder, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all the veggies. Step 2: In a separate bowl, mix together the dressing. Step 3: Pour the dressing over the veggies. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro or parsley. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate overnight.

Dish Name: Corn And Black Eyed Pea Salad
Ingredient Names: frozen whole kernel corn, black-eyed peas, green pepper, red onion, fresh cilantro leaves, chunky salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the corn, peas, green pepper, red onion and cilantro in a 2-qt Bowl. Step 2: Stir the salsa into the corn mixture until well coated. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate the salad for 4 hours stir the salad before serving.

Ingredient Names: frozen corn, pasilla chiles, onion, olive oil, salt, garlic powder, ground black pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Chopp onion and chile such that the pieces are comparable in size to the kernels of corn. Step 2: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add chopped onion and chile and cook until onions are translucent but still firm. Step 4: Pour frozen corn into skillet. Step 5: Stir as much as possible and then cover. Step 6: Cook covered for about 3 to 5 minutes. Step 7: Stir corn mixture Corn should be thawed at this point. Step 8: Cook for about 5 minutes without stirring You want to corn to char a little bit but not too much.

Dish Name: Corn And Fire Roasted Poblano Salad With Cilantro
Ingredient Names: red onion, champagne vinegar, olive oil, corn, salt, water, poblano chile, fresh lime juice, cayenne pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Roasted poblanos: rub the chilies lightly with oil and place them on a stovetop grill or directly over an open flame. Step 2: Grill over medium-high heat and turn, using metal tongs until the skins are evenly blistered and charred. Step 3: Remove from the heat, transfer to a bowl, and cover with a plate or a lid They'll steam as they cool Loosen and peel the skins from the chilies Bits of charred skin are ok You can dip your fingers in water, but don't be tempted to dip the chilies in water or peel them under the running faucet-you'll lose their delicious flavor Salad: bring a small pot of water to a boil and drop in the onions for 20 seconds. Step 4: Drain and toss with the vinegar. Step 5: Heat the oil in a large saut pan.

Ingredient Names: unsalted butter, garlic cloves, fresh corn kernels, half-and-half, fresh thyme, salt & freshly ground black pepper, white onion, zucchini, poblano chiles, lasagna sheets, oaxaca cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a medium, heavy saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add 2 / 3 of the garlic and saute for 1 minute. Step 4: Mix in the corn and saute for 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the cream and thyme. Step 6: Cook over medium-low heat for 5 minutes for the flavors to incorporate. Step 7: Turn off the heat and let cool slightly. Step 8: Transfer to a blender and puree until smooth. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper. Step 10: Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a small, heavy skillet over medium heat.

Dish Name: Corn Black Bean And Red Onion Quesadillas
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, frozen corn, black beans, red onion, monterey jack cheese, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place 4 of the tortillas on a work surface. Step 2: Sprinkle one-quarter of the corn, beans, onion, cheese and chili powder evenly on each tortilla, leaving a 1 / 2-inch border. Step 3: Top with the remaining tortillas and press down to help them stick together To cook them on the stovetop: heat a large, lightly greased with cooking spray a skillet or grill pan over medium heat. Step 4: Add 1 quesadilla and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, then flip over and cook another 4 to 5 minutes It's done when it begins to get brown flecks and the cheese is melted To bake: preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Step 5: Place the quesadillas on a large, ungreased, rimmed baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes per side. Step 6: Transfer the quesadillas to a cutting board and cut each into 4 wedges. Step 7: Let them rest for 1 to 2 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Corn Fritters With Black Bean Salad
Ingredient Names: black beans, avocado, fresh cilantro leaves, red onion, fresh lime juice, fresh corn kernels, all-purpose flour, eggs, garlic cloves, ground cumin, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine beans, avocado, cilantro, onion, lime juice and 1 / 4 teaspoons salt - toss well In another large bowl, combine corn, flour, eggs, garlic, cumin and 1 / 2 teaspoons salt until well mixed. Step 2: In a 12-inch skillet, heat oil on medium-high heat until very hot. Step 3: Add batter to oil by 1 / 4 cupfuls, forming mounds Gently press tops to flatten. Step 4: Cook 4-5 minutes or until browned on each side, turning over once Be careful Oil will splatter. Step 5: Transfer to cookie sheet in 225 degree f Oven to keep warm.

Ingredient Names: corn, green chili peppers, red bell pepper, butter, garlic, salt, cumin, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute pepper and garlic until browned Add chile, spices, butter and corn Heat through and serve.

Ingredient Names: cooking spray, corn muffin mix, mexican blend cheese, chopped pimiento, cilantro leaves, poblano peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Step 2: Prepare corn muffin mix according to package directions, adding cheese, pimentos and cilantro when you add other ingredients. Step 3: Arrange poblano pepper halves on prepared baking sheet and fill each pepper with an equal amount of corn muffin mix. Step 4: Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until a wooden pick inserted in 1 muffin comes out clean, serve and enjoy! Step 5: For vegetarian do not use jiffy corn mix It contains lard [animal fat].

Ingredient Names: olive oil, corn kernels, salt, fresh ground black pepper, scallion, water, oil, flour tortillas, white cheddar cheese, cilantro, poblano chiles, guacamole, mexican crema, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a medium pan and add corn, salt and pepper. Step 2: Cook over medium heat 1 minute. Step 3: Add scallion and water, cover and cook until corn is tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to a bowl. Step 5: Heat a large cast-iron skillet or griddle and add just enough oil to coat. Step 6: Place 1 tortilla in pan and heat 30 seconds until soft, flip and heat other side. Step 7: Repeat to heat all tortillas, adding oil to pan as needed. Step 8: Keep them warm by covering with clean kitchen towels. Step 9: Spread 1 / 3 cup corn mixture on half of each tortilla Follow with cheese and cilantro, distributing evenly over corn.

Ingredient Names: masa harina flour, water, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix flour and salt, then add warm water. Step 2: Knead until a soft dough forms, adding more water or flour as needed Tightly wrap dough in plastic wrap and let sit for 10-30 minutes. Step 3: Divide dough into about 16 balls, about 1 / 2-inch in diameter each. Step 4: Place each ball between 2 sheets of plastic wrap or waxed paper and roll into 5-inch round using a rolling pin, heavy flat-bottomed pan or tortilla press If the edges of the tortilla are uneven and crumbly, the dough needs a little more water If the dough sticks to the waxed paper and it is very soft, add a few tablespoons of flour.
