Step 5: Repeat with remaining dough, leaving each tortilla between the sheets of waxed paper. Step 6: Heat an ungreased cast iron griddle or large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat Peel off the top sheet of waxed paper and invert the tortilla into the hot pan, quickly and carefully peel off remaining wax paper.

Ingredient Names: squash, olive oil, yellow onion, corn kernels, fresh parsley, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut sqash in half lengthwise and thinly slice crosswise and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add onions and cook, stirring frequently, until soft, 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add squash and cook, stirring often, until just soft, about 6-8 minutes. Step 5: Add corn and cook, stirrig often, about 5 minutes more. Step 6: Add parsley and season to taste with salt and pepper.

Dish Name: Corn With Tomatoes And Green Chiles
Ingredient Names: canola oil, whole kernel corn, onion, garlic, tomatoes, diced green chilies, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add corn, onions, garlic. Step 3: Cook stirring occasionally, for 2 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender. Step 4: Add tomato, chiles, and salt. Step 5: Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through.

Ingredient Names: flour, polenta, eggs, milk, butter, olive oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground cardamom, canned red kidney beans, water, avocado, canned jalapeno peppers, coriander, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Sift flour into bowl, add polenta and stir. Step 2: Make well in centre and add combined eggs and milk, stir until smooth. Step 3: Grease non-stick pan with melted butter. Step 4: Heat over medium heat. Step 5: Pour in enough batter to cover base. Step 6: Cook 1-2 minutes then turn over and cook other side, repeat. Step 7: Meanwhile heat oil in pan. Step 8: Add cumin, coriander, cardamom, cook stirring constantly for 1 minute. Step 9: Add 1 / 2 of the beans and water stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: mexican-style stewed tomatoes, water, onion, taco seasoning mix, couscous, firm tofu, taco shells, lettuce, cheddar cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan combine undrained stewed tomatoes, water, onion, and taco seasoning mix, bring to a boil. Step 2: Stir in couscous and tofu, cover. Step 3: Remove from heat- let stand for 5 minutes. Step 4: Spoon couscous mixture into taco shells. Step 5: Top with lettuce and cheese- serve with salsa.

Dish Name: Creamy Avocado And Cherry Tomato Toast
Ingredient Names: bread, avocado, lime juice, salt, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Put the bread into toaster and start it toasting. Step 2: Meanwhile, scoop out the avocado flesh and put into a bowl. Step 3: Add lime juice and pinch of salt and then mash all of it together until pretty much smooth. Step 4: Spread avocado mixture over toast. Step 5: Divide between cherry tomatoes between slices and arrange on top, serve.

Dish Name: Creamy Avocado And White Bean Wrap
Ingredient Names: cider vinegar, canola oil, chipotle chiles in adobo, salt, red cabbage, carrot, fresh cilantro, white beans, avocado, sharp cheddar cheese, red onions, whole wheat tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk vinegar, oil, chipotle chile and salt in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add cabbage, carrot and cilantro, toss to combine. Step 3: Mash beans and avocado in another medium bowl with a potato masher or fork. Step 4: Stir in cheese and onion To assemble the wraps, spread about 1 / 2 cup of the bean-avocado mixture onto a wrap and top with about 2 / 3 cup of the cabbage-carrot slaw, roll up. Step 5: Repeat with remaining ingredients. Step 6: Cut the wraps in half to serve, if desired Look for the small cans with the mexican foods in large supermarkets.

Ingredient Names: avocado, lime juice, hot pepper sauce, garlic clove, salt & freshly ground black pepper, cooked shrimp, chile, cherry tomatoes, coriander sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, dice and de-pit avocado and place in a food processor. Step 2: Add lime juice, hot pepper sauce and garlic Process until smooth and then season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and cover by placing plastic wrap directly onto the surface of avocado mixture. Step 4: Refrigerate until serving To serve, you can serve it as is or add some of the optional toppings and serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, salt, black pepper, frozen sweet corn, green chili pepper, spinach, light cream cheese, light sour cream, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, garlic powder, corn tortillas, green tomatillo sauce, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion in large skillet until soft. Step 2: Add salt and pepper to onion while sauteing. Step 3: In a large bowl, defrost corn in microwave and drain well. Step 4: Return to large bowl. Step 5: Add diced hatch chile to corn. Step 6: Add spinach to sauteing onions and cook down, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add softened cream cheese, 4 oz of sour cream, chopped cilantro, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and onion / spinach mixture to corn and hatch chile and mix well Lightly grease 9x13 baking dish with olive oil. Step 8: Fill each tortilla with 2 or 3 large spoonfuls of corn / spinach mixture. Step 9: Roll tortillas and line in baking dish.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, cheddar cheese, milk, corn, taco seasoning, tortilla chips
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients into a casserole dish except about 1 / 2 cup topping Top casserole with remaining chips Bake at 350f for about 30 minutes.

Dish Name: Creamy Mexican Corn On The Skillet
Ingredient Names: corn kernel, cream cheese, fresh lime juice, chili powder, ground red pepper, ground cumin, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in a skillet with 1-2 t water Stir until cream cheese is dispersed throughout and corn is hot.

Ingredient Names: sour cream, extra-sharp cheddar cheese, salsa, avocado, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together well, except the avocado. Step 2: Then fold in the avocado gently Enjoy this right away or cover and refrigerate This is great with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: lemon yogurt, carbonated lemon-lime beverage, lime juice, lime slice, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place the partially frozen yogurt, soda and lime juice into a blender and process until smooth If desired, wet the rims of your margarita glasses and dip into either kosher salt or sugar. Step 2: Pour drink into the glasses. Step 3: Garnish w / lime slices, if desired.

Ingredient Names: red beans, red pepper, red onion, parsley, coriander, jalapeno pepper, olive oil, red wine vinegar, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Puree all the ingredients in a food processor or blender and pour into a serving bowl Chill for at least 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rotel tomatoes & chilies, vegetable broth, vegetarian refried beans, black beans, corn, fresh cilantro, corn tortilla strips, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Combine tomatoes, broth, beans and corn in medium saucepan. Step 2: Stir together and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce and bring to a simmer till heated through. Step 4: Turn off heat and stir in the cilantro. Step 5: Top each bowl of soup with cheese and crushed tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: black beans, vegetarian refried beans, chili powder, cumin, minced garlic clove, flour tortillas, scallions, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, salsa, low-fat sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400. Step 2: Combine black and refried beans in a saucepan, and add the chili powder, cumin and garlic. Step 3: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 4: Mash the bean mixture into a thick puree On a plate, lay a tortilla flat and place 2 tablespoons of the bean mixture in the center of the tortilla. Step 5: Top with some scallions, tomatoes and cheese. Step 6: Roll up into a tube shape and place into a 9x13-inch baking pan, seam side down. Step 7: Repeat until you've used all the tortillas and / or bean mixture. Step 8: Bake the burritos until they are browned, about 15 minutes. Step 9: Top with salsa and / or sour cream as desired.

Ingredient Names: red onions, oil, milk, flour, salt, sugar, brown sugar, chili powder, ground cumin, ground black pepper, paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all of the dry ingredients together. Step 2: Dip onion rings in milk, then toss in seasoned flour, separating rings Deep fry in 365f oil until crispy and just turning dark brown. Step 3: Drain well on paper towels Makes 16 servings This is good served with steak, beans and barbecue sauce.

Dish Name: Crispy Black Bean Tacos With Feta Cabbage Slaw
Ingredient Names: black beans, ground cumin, olive oil, fresh lime juice, coleslaw mix, green onions, fresh cilantro, corn tortillas, feta cheese, chipotle hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place beans and cumin in small bowl Partially mash. Step 2: Mix 2 teaspoons olive oil and lime juice in medium bowl. Step 3: Add coleslaw, green onions, and cilantro and toss to coat. Step 4: Season slaw to taste with salt and pepper. Step 5: Heat 3 teaspoons olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add tortillas in single layer. Step 7: Spoon 1 / 4 of bean mixture onto half of each tortilla, cook 1 minute. Step 8: Fold tacos in half.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, green onion, garlic cloves, pinto beans, frozen whole kernel corn, cooked brown rice, tomatoes, cotija cheese, chipotle chile in adobo, phyllo pastry sheets, light sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the green onions and garlic. Step 4: Cook about 3 minutes or just until tender, stirring occasionally, remove from heat. Step 5: Stir in beans, corn, rice 1 / 3 cup of the tomatoes, cheese, and chili peppers. Step 6: Set aside Unroll phyllo dough. Step 7: Remove one sheet of the phyllo dough and place on a flat surface Lightly coat the phyllo sheet with cooking spray.

Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, olive oil, kosher salt, sour cream, lime, ground cumin, fresh ground black pepper, shredded cheddar cheese, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the broiler. Step 2: Brush the tortillas on both sides with oil and lightly salt. Step 3: Heat a large saute pan over medium heat and cook the tortillas, 1 at a time, until slightly golden on both sides. Step 4: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the sour cream, lime zest and juice, cumin, and salt and pepper, to taste, until smooth. Step 5: Pour into a plastic squeeze bottle or sturdy resealable plastic bag and cut small. Step 6: Arrange the browned tortillas on a baking sheet and sprinkle evenly with cheese Broil until the cheese bubbles and begins to brown, about for 1 to 2 minutes, being careful not to burn. Step 7: Slice each quesadilla into 8 wedges and drizzle sour cream decoratively over the top. Step 8: Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: onion, carrot, bell pepper, garlic cloves, frozen corn kernels, black beans, jalapeno chile, vegetable stock, tamari, fresh cilantro, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray over medium heat, saute the onion, bell pepper and carrot about 5 minutes, until softened. Step 2: Transfer the bell pepper, onions and carrot to the cooker, and add the garlic, corn, black beans, and jalapeno. Step 3: Stir in the stock, tamari, and cilantro. Step 4: Cook on low for 4-5 hours. Step 5: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Frijoles Refritos Refried Beans
Ingredient Names: dried pinto bean, water, sea salt, vidalia onion, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, fresh green chile, jalapenos, ground cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Sort & rinse beans. Step 2: Place in crockpot, cover with water and soak 8 hours or overnight. Step 3: Drain water from beans & rinse again. Step 4: Remove water from the crockpot and rinse again. Step 5: Place back in crock pot and add water & salt. Step 6: Cover and cook on low 10 hours Reserving liquid, drain beans & place in bowl. Step 7: Heat oil in skillet & saute onions and garlic over medium heat until tender. Step 8: Transfer to blender. Step 9: Add chilies, cumin, and jalepenos, and blend until smooth.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Huevos Rancheros Mexican Ranch Style Eggs Low Carb
Ingredient Names: butter, eggs, light cream, mexican blend cheese, pepper, chili powder, garlic clove, green chilies, red enchilada sauce, sharp cheddar cheese, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Grease crock pot with the butter, and set aside. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the eggs, cream, mexican cheese, pepper, and chili powder. Step 3: Add the garlic and chilies, and stir. Step 4: Pour mixture into the crock pot, cover, and cook on low for 3 hours and 45 minutes. Step 5: Remove lid and top with enchilada sauce and cheddar cheese Replace lid and cook until sauce is warm and cheese is melted. Step 6: Top tortillas with eggs and serve.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti squash, sweet onion, jalapeno, corn, black beans, no-salt-added diced tomatoes, portabella mushroom cap, vegetable broth, oatmeal, cornmeal, salsa, mccormick's montreal low-sodium steak seasoning
Instructions: Step 1: Layer in the crockpot: 1 / 2 of the beans, corn, jalapenos, tomatoes 1 / 4 of the grains1 / 4 of the grill seasoning 1 / 2 of the squash, mushrooms, onions, salsa Continue layering till done Gently pour broth around the edges till you see it coming up the side. Step 2: Cook on high for 4 - 5 hours, low for 7 - 8 hours Options: Add other vegetables. Step 3: Add a layer of soy cheese.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, tomatoes, green bell pepper, jalapeno pepper, onion, garlic, fresh lime juice, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, dried dill weed, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl stir together all ingredients Cover and refrigerate at least one hour Serve with tortilla chips.

Ingredient Names: diced tomatoes, tomatoes, cucumber, diced green chilies, jalapenos, cilantro, green onions, garlic, lemon juice, lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in blender You may need to do in 2 batches Blenderize to desired consistency Salt to taste If you like it chunkier, add extra diced cucumber, tomato, and green onion when placing in jars Stores in glass jar in refrigerator up to 3 weeks. Step 2: Serve with chips or food.

Ingredient Names: mung bean sprouts, cucumber, celery, lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, fresh cilantro, sunflower seeds, salt and black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the veggies and sprouts in a bowl. Step 2: Whisk together the salt, pepper, lemon juice and olive oil in a separate bowl. Step 3: Add to the salad and toss well to mix. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro and sunflower seeds and serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

Ingredient Names: cuervo tequila, lemon juice, grenadine, club soda
Instructions: Step 1: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice Strain and pour into two chilled martini glasses.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, curry powder, cumin, dried basil, dried thyme, turmeric, soy sauce, nutritional yeast, frozen spinach, onion, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, salsa, tortillas
Instructions: Step 1: Sautee the onions in pan with a little bit of oil. Step 2: Add tofu and spices and cook until tofu is firm and browned well on all sides. Step 3: Add the thawed spinach, soy sauce and yeast and cook until combined and thoroughly heated. Step 4: Serve as a burrito, with the tofu, cheddar cheese and salsa to taste and diced tomatoes wrapped in the tortilla.

Ingredient Names: monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, white flour, egg, whole green chilies, green chili salsa, tomato sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Grate cheese Deseed chilies. Step 2: Layer chilies and cheese in a greased 11x9-inch casserole dish, beginning with chilies and ending with cheese You must have two layers of chilies and two of cheese, cheese being the last layer I use the aluminum foil pans you get in the store that come with a plastic cover when taking to pot lucks or family gatherings, easy clean up In separate bowl beat eggs, add flour, beat until smooth. Step 3: Pour over cheese / chilie mixture. Step 4: Bake 30 minutes at 350f. Step 5: Pour tomato sauce and chilie salsa over top and bake 15-20 minutes more. Step 6: Let stand 10 minute before serving.

Ingredient Names: avocados, red onion, pickled jalapeno pepper, cilantro, lime zest, lime juice, salt, ground black pepper, garlic cloves, eggs, all-purpose flour, dry breadcrumbs, vegetable oil, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and pit avocados. Step 2: In a bowl, coarsely mash avocados. Step 3: Fold in onion, jalapenos, cilantro, lime zest and juice, salt, pepper, and garlic. Step 4: Line an 8-inch square baking pan with wax or parchment paper. Step 5: Spoon avocado mixture into pan. Step 6: Spread into an even layer. Step 7: Place another sheet of parchment on top Freeze until solid, 6 to 8 hours At least 30 mins before serving, in a small shallow bowl, beat eggs with 3 tablespoons water. Step 8: Remove avocado mixture to a cutting board.

Ingredient Names: eggs, green onions, mushroom, avocados, cheese, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Spray hot skillet with pam cooking spray. Step 2: Pour in beaten eggs. Step 3: Add green onions and sliced mushroom. Step 4: Add shredded cheese. Step 5: Add avocado slices, flip in half. Step 6: Top with salsa Plate.

Ingredient Names: refried beans, dried ancho chile powder, ground cumin, salsa, sour cream, salt & freshly ground black pepper, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste Use in your tostadas, tacos, or any dish that calls for refried beans For extra-special beans, you can add cubes of monterey jack or pepperjack cheese, spread it into a lightly oiled or buttered pan, and heat through in a 350 degree f oven before serving.

Ingredient Names: dried brown lentils, onion, oil, tomatoes, cumin, garlic salt, paprika, onion powder, cayenne pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, when hot, brown the onions. Step 2: Add the lentils and then cover with water. Step 3: Add all other ingrediants and bring to the boil. Step 4: Turn heat to low and simmer until the mixture thickens. Step 5: Add more water if required and stir often so that the mixture doesn't stick to the pan Continue checking and stirring for approx 1 hour or until the mixture is the consistancy of cooked oatmeal. Step 6: Serve with your favourite taco setup.

Ingredient Names: soy crumbles, vegan taco seasoning, water, refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, corn chips, vegan sour cream, lettuce, tomatoes, olive, guacamole
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Cook the"faux" meat until heated through. Step 3: Stir in the seasoning mix and water. Step 4: Simmer the"meat" mixture about 5 minutes Separate the crescent rolls. Step 5: Press into an ungreased pie pan to form a crust. Step 6: Sprinkle 1 cup of the corn chips over the crust. Step 7: Spoon the"meat" mixture over the crust and chips. Step 8: Spread the sour cream over the meat mixture. Step 9: Sprinkle the remaining chips on top.

Ingredient Names: green bell pepper, red bell pepper, orange bell peppers, red onions, garlic cloves, peanut oil, menudo spice mix, cumin, salt, black pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large fry-pan, adding all the spices, including the garlic The more menudo spice you add - the spicier it will be Do not go above medium to medium-high heat. Step 2: Add all the sliced bell peppers and heat for 5-10 minutes until they are softened. Step 3: After bell peppers are soft, add all the onions and cook to desired taste and texture Approximately 10 to 15 minutes Before serving, turn the heat up to almost high and allow veggies to blacken on one side This will intensify the flavor Before moving into a serving dish, toss with cilantro for one minute Keeping pan hot, heat up the corn or flour tortillas one minute each on both sides.

Ingredient Names: vegetarian refried beans, picante salsa, colby-monterey jack cheese, cream cheese, italian cheese, hot sauce, onion powder, cumin, chili powder, garlic salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Crumble slices of colby jack cheese into bite size pieces. Step 2: Mix salsa and refried beans together in a bowl. Step 3: Add all of the remaining ingredients including all the cheeses and stir well. Step 4: Pour contents of bowl into pie pan. Step 5: Bake in the oven for 5-10 minutes until all cheese is melted. Step 6: Stir well before serving Tastes good with tortilla chips, fritos, crackers, and pitas Can be made lowfat by using reduced-calorie substitutes!

Ingredient Names: eggs, pickle relish, mayonnaise, chipotle pepper, celery, cilantro, salt and pepper, avocados, olive oil, flour tortillas, red cabbage, fresh lime juice, molasses, red wine vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Place the eggs in a small saucepan and cover with cold water. Step 2: Bring water to a boil and reduce heat to low. Step 3: Simmer for 12 minutes. Step 4: Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking Peel the eggs and put them in a medium bowl. Step 5: Add the relish, mayonnaise, chipotle, celery, cilantro, and salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Mash together with a fork until the mix is pretty uniform. Step 7: Stuff 1 / 4 of the mixture into the center of each avocado half and set aside If you want to make tortilla chips: In a large saute pan, heat the olive oil until hot but not smoking.

Ingredient Names: flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, salt, orange juice, oil, vinegar, vanilla, water, mini chocolate chip, confectioners' sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine dry ingredients. Step 2: Make a well in the middle. Step 3: In a separate bowl, combine wet ingredients, including the 1 / 3 cup water. Step 4: Put wet mixture in the well of dry ingredients. Step 5: Stir just until moistened. Step 6: Fold in chips Use a light hand A heavy hand leads to heavy cupcakes Use cupcake liners for muffin pans. Step 7: Fill about 2 / 3 full with batter.

Ingredient Names: dried pinto bean, water, olive oil, onions, roma tomatoes, serrano chilies, celery, carrot, cilantro, coarse salt, dark beer
Instructions: Step 1: Combine beans and water in a large pot. Step 2: Cover, bring to a simmer and cook over low heat 1 1 / 2-2 1 / 2 hours, until beans are tender. Step 3: Add more warm water if needeed to prevent scorching, remove from heat. Step 4: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan or skillet over medium high heat. Step 5: Saute the onions until lightly browned. Step 6: Stir in tomatoes, chiles, celery, carrot and cilantro and cook for 1 minute. Step 7: Add the cooked beans, salt and beer. Step 8: Cook uncovered, over low heat, until the juices have thickened, about 30 minutes Move the hot beans to a nice ceramic dish and serve.

Ingredient Names: salt, onion powder, garlic powder, ground black pepper, ground oregano, ground cumin, citrus zest, saffron, achiote powder
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid You can use any or all of the optional ingredients Shake well and store for up to 2 months in a cool dry place.

Ingredient Names: half-and-half, vanilla bean, sugar, egg yolks, dulce de leche, unsalted butter, egg whites, challah
Instructions: Step 1: Crme anglaise: Set a large fine strainer over a medium bowl and set the bowl in a shallow pan of cold water. Step 2: In a large saucepan, combine the half-and-half and vanilla bean and cook over moderately low heat just until small bubbles appear around the rim, about 5 minutes In another medium bowl, whisk the sugar and egg yolks just until combined. Step 3: Whisk in half of the hot half-and-half in a thin stream. Step 4: Pour the mixture into the saucepan and cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the sauce has thickened slightly, 4 to 5 minutes Immediately strain the sauce into the bowl in the cold water bath to stop the cooking Scrape the vanilla seeds into the sauce. Step 5: Serve right away or refrigerate until chilled Bread pudding:.

Ingredient Names: butter, brown sugar, eggs, milk, flour, baking soda, salt, toffee pieces, heavy cream, confectioners' sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare cupcakes: preheat oven to 350f line 9 muffin cups with paper liners. Step 2: Beat butter and sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer until light and creamy. Step 3: Add eggs and milk, then beat on medium-high speed for two minutes. Step 4: Add flour, baking soda and salt. Step 5: Beat for an additional minute. Step 6: Stir in toffee bits. Step 7: Spoon into prepared tins and bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Step 8: Remove from tins while still slightly warm Frosting: while cupcakes are baking, combine brown sugar, cream and butter in a heavy saucepan to prepare frosting. Step 9: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.

Dish Name: Dulces De Calabasas Mexican Pumpkin Candy
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, water, brown sugar, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut pumpkin in half, remove seeds and as much of the "stringy stuff" as you can, and chop into pieces approximately 1-1 5 inches by 1 5-2 5 inches. Step 2: Slice off skin, taking off as little flesh as you can Measure to make sure you have approximately one quart of pumpkin pieces. Step 3: Put in a fairly heavy saucepan and cover with water. Step 4: Cover, bring to a boil, and boil for 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Drain, but save water, and place pumpkin back in pan Measure water to make sure you have about 1 1 / 2 cups.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, garlic, pinto, tomatoes, zucchini, smoked paprika, fresh cilantro, flour, iceberg lettuce, mini cucumber very using potato peeler, sour cream chive dip
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 2 mins. Add 1 can of the beans and heat for a further 2-3 mins, while mashing into the onions with a masher or fork to make a rough paste. Step 2: Add the remaining can of beans, the tomatoes, courgettes, paprika and 5 tbsp water. Cover and very gently simmer for 10 mins until thickened and pulpy, stirring occasionally. Season to taste with lime juice, salt and pepper, then stir in the coriander. Warm the flour tortillas in a dry frying pan, then lay out with the chilli beans, shredded lettuce, sliced cucumber and soured cream dip. Ask everyone to help themselves: fill, roll and eat!

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, green, canned, pork, ground cumin, tortillas, avocados, sour cream, red chile, fresh cilantro, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Toss together the oil and peppers, then cook in a non-stick frying pan for 3 mins until starting to brown. Add the sweetcorn, pork and cumin and stir well. Cook for 2 mins more until the pork and sweetcorn are heated through and starting to turn golden. Season well. Step 2: Heat the tortillas in the microwave for 30 secs to soften. To serve, place the tortillas, pork, avocado and other ingredients on the table and allow everyone to help themselves – pile up the pork and veg in the tortillas, top with avocado and your choice of soured cream, chilli, coriander leaves and lime.

Ingredient Names: potato, olive oil, onions, garlic, mild chili powder, paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the potatoes for 5 mins. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and gently fry the onion for 8 mins. Add the garlic and spices, then fry for 2 mins more. Step 2: Drain the potatoes and tip into the onion mix. Turn up the heat and shake the potatoes around so that they are all covered. Cook for 10 mins more until tender, then serve with soured cream, sprinkled with a little cayenne.

Ingredient Names: butter, button mushrooms, chili powder, kosher salt, fresh cilantro leaves, flour tortillas, monterey jack pepper cheese, feta cheese, sour cream, salsa
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Step 2: Line baking sheet with foil. Step 3: Melt 2 Tablespoon butter in a mediun skillet over med-high heat. Step 4: Add mushrooms and shake pan to evenly distribute the mushrooms, then cook without moving the mushrooms around. Step 5: This should take about 5 minutes. Step 6: Add remaining butter. Step 7: Toss the mushrooms and continue to cook until nicely browned, 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Season the mushrooms with chili powder and salt and cook for 1 more minute. Step 9: Stir in the chopped cilantro and set aside. Step 10: Toast the tortillas using any method you prefer, until slightly blistered. Step 11: Place the tortillas on the prepared baking sheet. Step 12: Spread the jack cheese on 1/2 of each tortilla and top with some of the mushrooms, then feta cheese. Step 13: Fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling. Step 14: Lay another sheet of foil over the quesadillas. Step 15: Bake until the cheese melts, 12-15 minutes. Step 16: Serve whole or slice into wedges. Step 17: Serve garnishes on side.

Ingredient Names: carrots, butter, onion, sliced mushrooms, zucchini, celery, green pepper, cloves, tomatoes, chili powder, ground cumin, oregano, cayenne pepper, flour, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot, cover carrots with water to cover. Step 2: Bring to a boil, then lower heat. Step 3: Simmer 10 minutes or until just tender While simmering carrots, pour contents of can of tomatoes into a bowl and squish into little pieces with your hands, wash hands. Step 4: Blend chili powder, cumin, oregano, and cayenne into tomatoes. Step 5: Take the 2 tbs of flour and blend with 1 / 4 cup cold water in a small cup. Step 6: Pour this into tomato mixture and stir to blend. Step 7: Drain carrots, and cut into 3 / 4 in pieces. Step 8: Put both aside for now.

Ingredient Names: soft silken tofu, avocado, chunky salsa, fresh cilantro, lime juice, hot sauce, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and pit avocado, put in a large mixing bowl. Step 2: Add entire block of tofu and salsa. Step 3: Combine ingredients using a hand mixer on medium speed for about 1 minute or until the mixture becomes smooth. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients, mix on low speed until all ingredients are blended together. Step 5: Chill for one hour and serve. Step 6: Store leftovers in the fridge in an air-tight container.

Dish Name: Veggie Quesadillas With Cilantro Sour Cream
Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, garlic, spinach, monterey jack cheese, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, olive oil, flour tortillas, sour cream cilantro, sour cream, fresh cilantro, curry curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Chop cilantro and add to sour cream,along with curry, mix well. Step 2: Roughly chop the bell pepper and onion and place in a large non-stick saute pan (I use my iron-skillet) that has been drizzled with 2-3 Tablespoons of olive oil,add the garlic and seasonings and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes,or until the veggies are crisp tender,tossing to coat. Step 3: Slice mushrooms and gently tear the spinach and add to saute pan. Step 4: Add more olive oil if needed and gently saute the vegetables until the spinach is nicely wilted,about 5 minutes. Step 5: Remove vegetables from skillet and place in bowl. Step 6: In same skillet that has been wiped clean with a napkin,add 2 Tablespoons of olive oil. Step 7: Place one tortilla in skillet and add a generous amount of cheese (first),veggies,then cheese,to one half side of tortilla,like an omelet. Step 8: Fold the empty side over the other side of tortilla and cook until cheese melts and the tortilla is nicely browned. Step 9: Due to the fact that mine is stuffed with veggies and cheese I will flip it over once to ensure even melting and browning. Step 10: Transfer to a plate and slice into wedges. Step 11: Serve with Cilantro sour cream or your choice of additions (guacamole,salsa,ect--) This recipe will make 2 generously stuffed large tortilla quesadillas or 4 small.

Ingredient Names: chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, coriander, lemongrass, red curry paste, sweet chili sauce, fish sauce, hot chicken stock, noodles, coconut milk, assorted fresh vegetables, peanut oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok until it is hot. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp peanut oil and 1 tsp sesame oil. Step 3: When the oils are hot add the chopped onion and stir for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the ginger, garlic, curry paste, then stir until thoroughly mixed Do not burn Next, open widows in the house and grab a tissue to wipe your teary eyes because the aromatic smell is so strong but smells delicious. Step 5: Add chicken and stir for 2 minutes, coating well with the paste. Step 6: Add chili sauce, fish sauce and stir for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add the hot stock, stir. Step 8: Add the cooked noodles and simmer for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Asian Steak Topped With Bell Pepper Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: thai sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, fresh ginger, new york strip steaks, vegetable oil, onion, red bell peppers, green onions, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375f. Step 2: Whisk chili sauce, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, and ginger in medium bowl. Step 3: Place in large zip-loc bag. Step 4: Add steaks and turn to coat. Step 5: Let marinate at room temperature 15 minutes, turning occasionally. Step 6: Heat 1 / 2 tablespoon vegetable oil in large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat Scrape most of marinade off steaks and back into bowl. Step 7: Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper. Step 8: Add to skillet and cook until browned, about 3 minutes. Step 9: Turn steaks over and transfer skillet to oven.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, lean ground beef, shallots, garlic, lemon juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, fresh mint leaves, sugar, cayenne pepper, romaine lettuce leaf, bean sprouts, green bell pepper, thai red chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a heavy skillet over high heat, add raw rice. Step 2: Cook, stirring, and shaking pan, for 3 minutes, or until golden. Step 3: Cool rice slightly. Step 4: Blend to a coarse powder in a blender or spice mill. Step 5: Stir-fry meat, shallots, and garlic till meat is browned. Step 6: Drain off all excess fat. Step 7: Stir in rice powder, lemon juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, mint, sugar, and cayenne pepper Mound meat in the center of serving tray. Step 8: Arrange romaine leaves and bean sprouts on either side of meat.

Ingredient Names: char siu sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, lean ground beef, cilantro, garlic, ginger, thai chile, oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, cornstarch, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Put the skewers into water to soak This helps prevent them burning. Step 2: Combine the char sui sauce, water and chile-garlic sauce in a small bowl and set aside This is the glazing sauce. Step 3: Combine all the remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly The best way is to use your hands. Step 4: Roll mixture into 18 meatballs About a rounded tablespoon mixture each. Step 5: Thread 3 meatballs onto each skewer If you like you can add slices of red or green pepper between meatballs.

Ingredient Names: shallot, canola oil, olive oil, strip steaks, garlic cloves, bay leaf, fresh ground black pepper, soy sauce, coconut vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a 12-in Frying pan over medium heat, cook shallots in oils, stirring often, until deep golden, 7 to 8 minutes With a slotted spoon, transfer shallots to paper towels. Step 2: Discard all but 2 tablespoons oil from pan Increase heat to high. Step 3: Add beef & crushed red pepper flakes to frying pan. Step 4: Cook until browned on underside, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 5: Stir in garlic and bay leaf, turn meat. Step 6: When second side is brown, stir in pepper, soy sauce, and vinegar.

Ingredient Names: unsalted peanuts, coconut milk, massaman curry paste, stewing beef steak, waxy potatoes, onions, kaffir lime leaves, cinnamon, tamarind paste, palm, fish sauce, red chile, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6, then roast the peanuts on a baking tray for 5 mins until golden brown. When cool enough to handle, roughly chop. Reduce oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp coconut milk (use the cream on top if there is any) in a large casserole dish with a lid. Add the curry paste and fry for 1 min, then stir in the beef and fry until well coated and sealed. Step 3: Stir in the rest of the coconut with half a can of water, the potatoes, onion, lime leaves, cinnamon, tamarind, sugar, fish sauce and most of the peanuts. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook for 2 hrs in the oven until the beef is tender. Step 4: Sprinkle with sliced chilli and the remaining peanuts, then serve straight from the dish with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Bright And Fresh Thai Beef Salad
Ingredient Names: anaheim chilies, tomatoes, lemongrass, fish sauce, limes, of fresh mint, honey, garlic, serrano chili, olive oil, beef tenderloin, fresh ground pepper, lettuce head, radicchio, arugula
Instructions: Step 1: Char 2 anaheim chili over broiler until blackened on all sides. Step 2: Wrap in paper bag and let stand 10 mins to steam Peel core and seed chli cut into 1 / 2 inch pieces, set aside Blanch tomatoes in sauce pan of boiling water for 10 seconds. Step 3: Transfer to bowl of cold water using slotted spoon. Step 4: Drain Pull off skins using small sharp knife. Step 5: Cut tomatoes crosswise in half. Step 6: Squeeze tomatoes gently to remove seeds Finely dice tomatoes and set aside.

Dish Name: Crispy Thai Beef Salad With Ginger Lime Dressing
Ingredient Names: lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, fresh ginger, sriracha sauce, sirloin steak, napa cabbage, red onion, carrot, of fresh mint, fresh cilantro, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dressing, whisk together the lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, ginger and sriracha in a small bowl. Step 2: Put the beef in a large bowl and drizzle with 1 tablespoons of the dressing. Step 3: Toss until coated evenly Spray a nonstick spray on a grill pan or nonstick skillet and set over medium-high heat. Step 4: Place some of the slices of beel on the grill pan and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy along the edges, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Repeat with remaining beef, transferring it to a large plate. Step 6: Layer the cabbage, onion, carrots, and mint on a platter. Step 7: Top with the steak and sprinkle with the cilantro and peanuts. Step 8: Drizzle with remaining sauce.

Ingredient Names: beef, chicken, curry powder, chile, garlic cloves, onions, lemon juice, honey, bamboo skewer, peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, chili sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the meat into thin strips, no more than 1 / 4" thick and about 1 / 2" wide for both the beef and chicken. Step 2: Combine the curry powder, chilies, garlic, onions, salt, lemon juice, and honey in a large bowl. Step 3: Add the meat strips and toss well to marinate for about fifteen minutes. Step 4: Thread meat strips onto bamboo skewers, 3 or 4 pieces per skewer. Step 5: Arrange the finished skewers in a glass casserole. Step 6: Cover with the remaining marinade, and refrigerate while making the sauce Brown under a broiler or grill the meat skewers. Step 7: Serve with a peanut butter sauce for dipping Sauce: blend all ingredients together well to make a smooth sauce. Step 8: Keep refrigerated until needed, but warm before serving.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, flank steaks, onion, yellow pepper, water, soy sauce, splenda sugar substitute, curry powder, crushed red pepper flakes, tomatoes, lettuce, sour cream, shredded cheddar cheese, low-carb tortilla
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Step 2: Stir in the vegetables then fry for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the beef along with the remaining ingredients, simmer until there is no liquid left. Step 4: Spread sour cream on the tortilla shells then top with the beef, vegetables, & cheese Enjoy!

Dish Name: Curried Beef Short Ribs Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: canola oil, beef short ribs, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, shallot, garlic, fresh ginger, water, red curry paste, light coconut milk, sugar, fish sauce, lime zest, fresh lime juice, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Sprinkle ribs with 3 / 4 t Salt and 1 / 8 t Pepper. Step 3: Add half of the ribs to pan. Step 4: Cook 2 minutes on each side or until browned. Step 5: Place ribs in an electric slow cooker or crock pot. Step 6: Repeat procedure with remaining ribs. Step 7: Add shallots, garlic, and ginger to skillet, saute 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Dry Beef Curry With Peanut And Lime Nua Pad Prik
Ingredient Names: stewing beef, coconut milk, beef stock, red curry paste, coriander seeds, cumin seed, green cardamom pods, ground nutmeg, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, paprika, orange, red chilies, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Place the meat in the freezer for 30-40 minutes until firm. Step 2: Slice the meat thinly, cut into strips, and chop finely. Step 3: Strain the coconut milk into a bowl. Step 4: Place the thin part and half of the thick part of the milk in a large saucepan. Step 5: Add the beef, and beef stock, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for 50 minutes To make the curry paste, dry fry the coriander, cumin seeds, and cardamom in a wok for 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Combine with the nutmeg, clove, cinnamon, paprika, and the zest of the mandarin orange Pound the chilies with the sugar and salt. Step 7: Add the chili paste, lemon grass, garlic, galangal or ginger, shallots or onion, and shrimp paste Lastly add the cilantro, juice of 1 / 2 lime, and oil.

Dish Name: Ga Pao Thai Stir Fried Beef With Basil Leaves
Ingredient Names: ground beef, garlic cloves, red onion, red paprika, yellow pepper, green pepper, basil leaves, eggs, black pepper, vegetable oil, rice, fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, red chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In a frying pan, heat vegetable oil, over a medium heat. Step 2: Add minced garlic until slightly colored and aroma is released. Step 3: Add ground beef and fry until brown. Step 4: When ground beef is almost cooked through, add veggies. Step 5: Stir fry quickly so that veggies remain crunchiness. Step 6: Combine 4 ingredients to make sauce. Step 7: Add sauce to frying pan and mix well. Step 8: Make space in the pan for frying egg. Step 9: Fry until egg white gets crispy on the edge. Step 10: Finally, add basil leaves, mix well.

Dish Name: Honey Soy Short Ribs With Spicy Peanut Glaze
Ingredient Names: beef, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, garlic cloves, minced ginger, honey, water, green onion, crushed red pepper flakes, coconut juice, hoisin sauce, fresh lemon juice, salted peanuts, peanut butter, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: In a dutch oven on high heat sear the short ribs until browned then add soy sauce, hoisin, vinegar, garlic, ginger, 1 / 2 cup honey, water, green onion, crushed red pepper, and 2 tablespoons of the coconut or orange juice Braise the ribs covered, for about 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bones. Step 3: Remove the short ribs from the braising liquid and cover to keep warm Increase the oven temperature to 425 degrees. Step 4: Drain the fat off of the cooking liquid and discard. Step 5: In a bowl add the peanut butter and place into the microwave for 30 seconds to soften, add the hot sauce, honey and stir. Step 6: Spread a thin layer of the peanut butter and honey mixture over the top of the rib and then coat with the crushed peanuts. Step 7: Bake the peanut crusted ribs for another 10 minutes, until the short ribs are heated through and glazed. Step 8: Serve over rice and pour a small ladle of the braising liquid on top of the ribs.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, brown sugar, flank steak, fresh lime juice, thai red chili peppers, green onions, fish sauce, water, cilantro, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare grill. Step 2: Combine soy sauce, and brown sugar in shallow dish, stirring to dissolve sugar. Step 3: Add flank steak, turning to coat both sides. Step 4: Set aside Dipping sauce: puree all ingredients in blender until smooth. Step 5: Transfer to small bowl. Step 6: Grill flank steak over medium-hot coals 12 minutes per sides for well done. Step 7: Transfer to cutting board and let stand for 5 minutes. Step 8: Cut steak into thin slices. Step 9: Drizzle with dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, ground beef, lime juice, fish sauce, shallot, gingerroot, scallions, mint leaf, fresh cilantro, cilantro, chili-garlic sauce, light brown sugar, lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Toast rice in a dry skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook rice, shaking pan frequently until rice turns golden, about 8 minutes While rice is toasting, combine beef, 3 tablespoons of the lime juice, fish sauce, shallots and ginger in a bowl. Step 3: When rice is golden, pour on plate to cool In same skillet over high heat, add beef mixture. Step 4: Cook, breaking meat into small pieces, about 5-7 minutes or until cooked through, remove from heat. Step 5: Add remaining tablespoon of lime juice, scallions, mint, cilantro, garlic chili pepper sauce and sugar to meat, mix well. Step 6: Add cooled rice to spice grinder or blender, and grind into a sandy powder.

Ingredient Names: ginger, garlic chopped, lemongrass outer leaves, fresh cilantro, red chilies, vegetable oil, stewing beef, dark soy sauce, five spice powder, brown sugar, beef stock, wide rice noodles, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ginger, garlic, lemongrass, coriander and 1 chilli in a food processor, then pulse until puréed. Heat the oil in a pan over a low heat. Add the purée and cook for 5 mins. Stir in the beef, soy, five-spice, sugar and stock. Put on a lid and bring to the boil, then lower heat and simmer for 1 hr 15 mins. Remove the lid and cook for a further 15 mins until the beef is tender. Step 2: Just before serving, prepare noodles following pack instructions. Drain well, then divide between 2 bowls and spoon over the beef stew. Serve sprinkled with the remaining chilli and coriander leaves, with lime wedges for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: sirloin tip steaks, soy sauce, red onion, cucumber, red bell pepper, lime juice, fish sauce, garlic, hot pepper sauce, sugar, romaine lettuce leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler or grill. Step 2: Sprinkle the sirloin with soy sauce and rub it into the surface Broil or grill until done to your liking, about 5 minutes on each side for rare. Step 3: Let the steak relax for 10 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain. Step 4: Toss with the onion and cucumber and red bell pepper. Step 5: In a small bowl combine the lime juice, fish sauce, garlic and hot pepper sauce. Step 6: Taste dressing and add sugar to taste. Step 7: Pour over the salad an toss well to combine. Step 8: Arrange the salad on lettuce and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, stewing beef, white onion, coconut milk, curry paste, water, ground cardamom, bay leaves, sugar, tamarind pulp, cinnamon stick, salt, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and cut up potatoes into big chunks, 1" x 1" x 1" Cut up beef and onion into the same size You can substitute chicken or lamb for beef, if you like. Step 2: Heat coconut milk and masaman curry paste in a pot over medium to low heat and stir Break up the paste and mix well with coconut milk. Step 3: Stir constantly to keep the mixture from sticking. Step 4: When you see the red oil bubbling up, add the meat and stir to cover the meat with curry. Step 5: Add half a cup of water or enough to cover all the meat. Step 6: Add the rest of the ingredients, except for potatoes, onions and peanuts Stew for 1 / 2 hour or until beef is getting tender.

Dish Name: Meiling's Yummy Thai Red Curry With Beef
Ingredient Names: canola oil, red curry paste, beef, coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, paprika, lime, potatoes, yellow pepper, carrots, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pan on medium heat and add curry paste. Step 2: Stir fry until fragrant. Step 3: Add beef and cook for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, paprika, and lime zest or kaffir leaves Continue to simmer beef for about 10 minutes, then add potatoes. Step 5: Add other veggies about 5 minutes after potatoes Total cooking time after adding chicken to pan is ~30 minutes. Step 6: Serve with rice I like to use brown rice because it is healthy I cook the brown rice for about 20 minutes before adding white rice -- it makes a great mixture that is much healthier than plain white rice.

Dish Name: Minced Beef With Chilli Garlic Holy Basil
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red chilies, garlic cloves, palm sugar, fish sauce, sweet soy sauce, oyster sauce, lean ground beef, kaffir lime leaves, chicken stock, basil leaves, green onions, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok and stirfry small chillies and garlic until they begin to colour. Step 2: Add palm sugar, fish sauce, sweet soy and oyster sauce. Step 3: Mix well and add minced beef Gently cook until sealed, continually mashing with a wooden spoon. Step 4: Then add lime leaves and cup stock. Step 5: Mix well and cook for another 10 minutes taste for seasoning and add holy basil and long red chillies. Step 6: Stir and cook until wilted. Step 7: Sprinkle with spring onion and serve with steamed rice on the side.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, beef steaks, curry paste, yellow onions, potatoes, coconut milk, water, brown sugar, fish sauce, roasted peanuts, chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok to moderately hot. Step 2: Add beef and stir-fry until cooked. Step 3: Drain beef, if necessary. Step 4: Add curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Add coconut milk, chili peppers, potatoes and water and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, until potatoes are semi-soft. Step 7: Add onions, sugar and fish sauce, stir well and simmer for a couple of minutes. Step 8: Top with peanuts and serve.

Ingredient Names: orange, soy sauce, seasoned rice wine vinegar, honey, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, chili sauce, flank steak, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a large zip lock bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 4-6 hours. Step 2: Grill your flank steak to your liking. Step 3: Let the meat rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin slices against the grain. Step 4: Boil the remaining marinade for 5-7 minutes until thickened. Step 5: Drizzle sauce over the sliced meat Enjoy.

Dish Name: Pad Ped Nuea Stir Fried Curry Beef With Long Beans
Ingredient Names: oil, garlic cloves, ground beef, string beans, fish sauce, red curry paste, sugar, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, pepper, thai chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet and add the oil and garlic. Step 2: Add the ground beef and saut on medium-high heat until done. Step 3: Add the beans and all the other ingredients, including the chilies if desired, and continue to cook for about 30 seconds or until the beans are tender. Step 4: Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, cornflour, rice wine, fish sauce, ketjap manis, oyster sauce, sugar, sesame oil, fresh ground black pepper, ginger, spring onion, shallot, birds eye chile, beef, wide rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together first 13 ingredients. Step 2: Add beef and marinate for at least an hour or overnight. Step 3: Soak the noodles in warm water for about 5 minutes, then drain and separate with your fingers. Step 4: Heat wok, add a little oil and stir fry the marinaded beef until it just begins to cook. Step 5: Add noodles and remaining ingredients, stir until blended and heated through. Step 6: Serve with rice and any thai table condiments you want!

Dish Name: Panaeng Nua Panaeng Thai Beef Curry
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, stewing beef, garlic clove, ground coriander, ground black pepper, salt, lemongrass, fish sauce, lemon zest, chunky peanut butter, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, green onion, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, bring the coconut milk to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionaly. Step 2: Reduce heat to low & simmer, uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients & stir. Step 4: Cover & simmer over a medium heat, stirring occasionally for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours or until the beef is tender. Step 5: Serve hot over rice. Step 6: Garnish with the basil or chillies.

Ingredient Names: beef, salt, white pepper, dried red chilies, ginger, shallots, garlic cloves, lemongrass, coriander root, kaffir lime leaf, lime peel, peppercorns, shrimp paste, coconut milk, coconut cream
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beef into thin slices, season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Soak chiles to soften. Step 3: Chop chiles, ginger, shallots and garlic. Step 4: Place them in mortar with lemon grass, coriander root, lime peel, peppercorns, and shrimp paste, pound until smooth. Step 5: Pour coconut milk in wok, bring to boil. Step 6: Add beef, cook until tender, remove, set aside, discard milk. Step 7: Pour coconut cream in wok, bring to boil. Step 8: Reduce heat and simmer until oil separates. Step 9: Add spice paste, cook 4-5 minutes, stirring constantly.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, thai red curry paste, stew meat, onions, potatoes, carrots, baby corn, coconut milk, thai fish sauce, brown sugar, roasted unsalted peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large stew pot. Step 2: Add red curry paste Saut for 1 minute. Step 3: Add beef and brown on all sides. Step 4: Add onions and carrots and saut until onions are soft. Step 5: Add potatoes, coconut milk, fish sauce, canned corn, and brown sugar. Step 6: Cover and simmer for approximately 1 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Step 7: Garnish with peanuts and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: chuck roast, satay sauce, coconut milk, baby carrots, peanuts, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place beef in slow cooker. Step 2: Pour sauce and coconut milk over. Step 3: Turn meat several times to combine sauce and milk and to coat the roast Scatter baby carrots over and around roast. Step 4: Cook on low heat 8-10 hours until fork-tender. Step 5: Sprinkle with peanuts and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: lean beef, peanut oil, garlic cloves, chilies, green onions, fresh ginger, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Pat meat dry, heat oil in wok over medium high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and stirfry until lightly golden. Step 3: Add chilis and stirfry green onion and ginger for 1 minute. Step 4: Add beef and stirfry just until browned, 1 minute. Step 5: Blend in fish sauce, lime juice and sugar, Sprinkle with coriander and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: oil, sirloin steaks, gingerroot, salt, red curry paste, onion, red bell peppers, red chili sauce, soy sauce, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over a high heat. Step 2: Add beef and one tablespoon of the ginger Salt to taste and stir-fry until meat is barely cooked With a slotted spoon, remove beef to a bowl, draining oil back into skillet. Step 3: Add curry paste and onion to oil Stirring, cook until curry is dissolved and fragrant. Step 4: Add peppers and remaining ginger. Step 5: Stir-fry until vegetables are tender crisp. Step 6: Add sweet red chili sauce and soy sauce to vegetables, stir to combine.

Ingredient Names: vegetables, garlic cloves, thai chiles, flank steak, shallots, red bell pepper, fish, soy sauce, black soy, chili paste, thai basil, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and chiles and cook until aromatic, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the steak and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the shallots and bell pepper and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the fish sauce, sweet soy sauce, black soy sauce and chili paste. Step 6: Bring the mixture to a low simmer and cook, stirring frequently until the meat is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the basil and mint until wilted. Step 8: Transfer to a serving dish and serve over steamed white rice.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic, beef, birds eye chiles, onion, red capsicum, broccolini, basil leaves, oyster sauce, fish sauce, pepper, coriander, beef stock, cornflour, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok with oil and cook meat in batches and transfer to a dish and keep warm. Step 2: Add more oil if required and add the garlic and chillies and stir fry for a few minutes and then return beef to the wok. Step 3: Now add the onion, capsicum and broccolini stems and stir fry till vegetables are cooked but still very crisp and then add the broccolini heads and the basil. Step 4: Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce and pepper and mix well. Step 5: Add the cup of beef stock and then mix the cornflour and water and add to the wok to thicken the sauce. Step 6: Garnish with coriander / cilantro if using and serve with rice or fried rice.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, onion, garlic clove, crushed red pepper flakes, carrots, white rice, soy sauce, water, fresh mint leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large frying pan over high heat, add beef. Step 2: Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until browned. Step 3: Add onion, garlic and crushed red pepper. Step 4: Stir-fry 1 minute longer. Step 5: Mix in carrots, rice, 1 1 / 2 cups water and soy sauce, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to low. Step 7: Cover and simmer 20 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed. Step 8: Mix in mint and coriander.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin, olive oil, sweet onion, red chilies, shiitake mushrooms, scallions, garlic cloves, lime, fish sauce, oyster sauce, chili sauce, brown sugar, cilantro, toasted sesame seeds, romaine lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the steak into 1 inch pieces about 1 / 4 inch thick Broil steak on each side 3-4 minutes. Step 2: Heat olive oil over medium heat in a frying pan. Step 3: Add onions, chillies and mushrooms to frying pan and cook about 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove from heat and add beef, stirring to cover beef with mushroom mixture. Step 5: Stir together scallions, garlic, lime juice, fish and oyster sauce, brown sugar, chili saucecilantro and sesame seeds. Step 6: Add this mixture to the beef and mushrooms. Step 7: Toss the lettuce and cucumbers together, place on plates then spoon warm steak mixture over the lettuce and serve.

Dish Name: Spicy Thai Beef Salad With Lemongrass Mint Vinaigrette And Nuts
Ingredient Names: hoisin sauce, soy sauce, fresh ginger, red wine vinegar, sugar, new york strip steaks, sesame oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, olive oil, lemongrass, shallot, garlic, kaffir lime leaf, thai fish sauce, fresh lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: ---to make the marinade--- In a shallow dish, combine all the marinade ingredients. Step 2: Add the steak strips and let sit at room temperature for 5 minutes. Step 3: In a large saut pan or skillet over high heat, heat the sesame oil and saut the steak for 5 minutes per side for medium rare. Step 4: Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 5: Using slotted spoon, transfer the steak to a plate and let rest for 10 minutes ---to make the vinaigrette--- In the same pan over high heat, heat the olive oil and saut the lemongrass, shallot, ginger, garlic, and lime leaves for about 10 seconds, or until lightly browned. Step 6: Stir in the remaining ingredients, set aside.

Dish Name: Spicy Thai Meat Satay Skewers No Peanuts
Ingredient Names: meat, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, white pepper, brown sugar, salt, coconut milk, bamboo skewer
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the meat cubes with the rest of the spices, seasoning and coconut milk. Step 2: Let it marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour but preferably overnight To freeze ahead: place in a ziplock bag and freeze To heat: thaw, and continue with cooking directions. Step 3: When ready to grill, soak skewers in cold water and dry. Step 4: Drain the meat and discard the marinade. Step 5: Place 4 cubes of meat on a skewer and grill for 4-5 minutes per side over a hot flame.

Ingredient Names: oil, basil, garlic, shallots, red chilies, beef sirloin, green beans, ginger, fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, unsalted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in or skillet over medium heat until hot and stir-fry 1 / 2 of the basil leaves for 2 to 3 minutes until crispy. Step 2: Remove and drain on paper towels. Step 3: Set aside In the same pan, heat the leftover oil over medium heat and stir-fry the garlic, shallots and chillies for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the beef and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked. Step 5: Add the green beans and ginger, and season with the fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar Continue to stir-fry for another 2 to 3 minutes until the green beans are tender and cooked. Step 6: Stir in the remaining basil leaves and remove from the heat. Step 7: Transfer to a serving platter, garnish with cashew nuts and the reserved crispy fried basil leaves, and serve hot with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: chili powder, galangal, ground black pepper, cumin, salt, ground coriander, lemongrass, garlic, onion, blachan, coconut milk, water, chuck steaks
Instructions: Step 1: Place all of the spices in a mortar with the lemon grass, peeled and crushed garlic, onion and blachan Pound to a paste and set aside. Step 2: Put two thirds of the coconut milk into a pan, add the water and bring to the boil Wipe and trim the meat, cut into cubes, add to the coconut milk. Step 3: Cover and simmer for one hour. Step 4: Heat the remaining coconut milk in a wok and add the spice paste and dry fry gently for five minutes. Step 5: Drain the meat, reserving the liquor, add the meat to the pan and fry over a high heat for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the saved liquor and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until the meat is tender. Step 7: Taste and add salt if required. Step 8: Serve with boiled rice.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, lime juice, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, garlic cloves, extra virgin olive oil, kosher salt, thai sweet chili sauce, fresh ginger, fresh basil, english cucumber, red bell pepper, fresh bean sprouts, chuck, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Directions. Step 2: Prepare a medium hot fire in a charcoal grill with a cover, or preheat a gas grill to medium high To make the mayonnaise, whisk the mayonnaise, lime juice and cilantro in a small bowl. Step 3: Cover with plastic wwrap and set aside To make the salad, whisk the lime juice, garlic, olive oil, salt, sweet chili sauce, ginger, cilantro and basil in a small bowl. Step 4: Combine the cucumber, red pepper and bean sprouts in a large bowl. Step 5: Toss with the dressing to coat. Step 6: Cover with plastic wrap and set aside To make the patties, combine the chuck, salt, sweet chili sauce, green onions and chips in a large bowl, handling as little as possible. Step 7: Shape into 6 patties to fit the buns.

Dish Name: Taste Of Thai Beef Salad Yam Nuea
Ingredient Names: flank steak, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, red chili peppers, garlic, red onion, cucumber, fresh cilantro, scallions, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Grill or broil flank steak. Step 2: Slice into thin bite size pieces, chill. Step 3: Combine lime juice, fish sauce, minced red chili peppers, and garlic in a large bowl and mix well. Step 4: Add red onion, cucumber, cilantro, scallions and chilled steak. Step 5: Toss together well and serve over torn lettuce.

Ingredient Names: lemongrass, sugar, shallots, garlic, fish sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, peanut oil, five-spice powder, chili bean paste, baby back ribs
Instructions: Step 1: Put everything in food processor and finely puree Separate ribs, rinse and pat dry Thoroughly coat each rib with sauce. Step 2: Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour or refrigerate for 24 hours. Step 3: Prepare a medium hot charcoal fire. Step 4: Grill about 6 inches from coals, turning frequently until ribs are nicely browned and cooked through about 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, sesame oil, garlic cloves, onion, bell pepper, red chili pepper, fresh basil leaf, oyster sauce, fish sauce, chicken stock, sugar, black pepper, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat, film with sesame oil and saute onions, bell peppers and chilis until softened, ~3-4 minutes, remove from pan. Step 2: Cook ground beef with garlic & black pepper, crumbling into small bits until browned and cooked through, ~8-10 minutes. Step 3: Add vegetables back to pan. Step 4: Stir in chicken stock, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar. Step 5: Stir well and cook until reduced a bit, ~2 minutes. Step 6: Fold in basil leaves and stir to combine, serve over rice. Step 7: Top with grated carrot, cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice if you want.

Dish Name: Thai Beef And Rice Salad With Mint
Ingredient Names: cooked rice, vegetable oil, beef, cucumber, red onion, cherry tomatoes, of fresh mint, fish sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a frypan and cook beef over a medium high heat until cooked to your liking. Step 2: Remove from the pan and set aside to cool. Step 3: Mix all dressing ingedients together, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Step 4: In a bowl, combine all other ingredients. Step 5: Slice the beef thinly and add to the salad along with the cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, baby carrots, stir-fry sauce, unsweetened coconut milk, peanuts, noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Cut flank steak into strips, on diagonal. Step 2: Place meat and carrots in a crock pot. Step 3: Pour peanut stir-fry sauce over meat and carrots. Step 4: Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 4 hours. Step 5: Cook thai noodles according to directions. Step 6: Stir in coconut milk to crock pot. Step 7: Serve over noodles, and sprinkle with peanuts.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, chili sauce, jalapeno, fish sauce, red onion, salt, pepper, lime, fresh cilantro, carrot, bibb lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a grill or pan over high heat. Step 2: Season the beef with salt, pepper and place on grill or in pan. Step 3: Cook on each side for about 4 minutes It should be firm but yielding to the touch. Step 4: Let cool for 5 minutes. Step 5: Mix chili sauce, fish sauce, and the juice from one lime in a small sauce pan over low heat to form sauce. Step 6: Slice the steak thinly If is skirt or flank, cut against the grain. Step 7: Drizzle warm sauce over the slices. Step 8: Set out the beef, lettuce, jalapeo, onion slices, cilantro, and carrots.

Ingredient Names: beef, cooking spray, onion, salt, coconut milk, curry paste, water, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, potatoes, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind paste, roasted peanuts, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Trim meat of excess fat and sinew and cut into 2-3cm cubes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a heavy-based pot and fry the onion until brown. Step 3: Add the meat, season and continue to brown all over From top of the coconut milk tin, scoop out the thick cream and add to the pot. Step 4: Add curry paste, lower the heat and cook gently for about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the water, remaining coconut milk, cinnamon and bay leaves and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Step 6: Add the potatoes and cook for another 30 min or until the meat and potatoes are tender You may need to add a little water as the curry is cooking. Step 7: Season to taste with fish sauce, palm sugar and tamarind paste. Step 8: Garnish with peanuts and coriander and serve with steamed basmati or jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: reduced sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, orange juice, canola oil, sesame oil, garlic cloves, ground ginger, peanut butter, salt, cayenne pepper, spaghetti, broccoli floret, snow peas, red pepper, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: For dressing, combine the first 10 ingredients in a blender. Step 2: Cover and process until blended, cook spaghetti. Step 3: Drain and place in a large bowl. Step 4: Add the broccoli, peas, red pepper, zucchini, celery and cooked beef. Step 5: Add dressing and toss to coat. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours Just before serving, sprinkle with sesame seeds, if desired.

Dish Name: Thai Beef Noodle Soup Gwaytio Nuea Nam
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, round steak, garlic cloves, ground beef, celery, scallions, beef stock, ground black pepper, ground cinnamon, fish sauce, noodle sheets, bean sprouts, fresh cilantro leaves, white vinegar, dried red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Fry beef strips in the oil until browned, using a large soup pot. Step 2: Remove the browned strips, leaving the oil and juice in the pot. Step 3: Fry the garlic until golden, stirring to keep from burning Quickly add the ground beef, celery, and scallions--cook while stirring until the beef just browns. Step 4: Add beef stock, black pepper, cinnamon, and fish sauce, bring to a boil. Step 5: Add noodles and return to a boil. Step 6: Remove from heat and add bean sprouts. Step 7: Top with beef strips and cilantro If desired, soak the red pepper flakes in the vinegar, and allow to be added to individual bowls.

Ingredient Names: top round beef, jalapenos, vegetable oil, beef-flavor ramen noodles, steak sauce, carrot, fresh cilantro, unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Have your steak half frozen for easy cutting and slice into 1" strips by 3" long in a medium bowl combine the beef, jalapeno& oil, toss to coat Break the noodles into 3 or 4 pieces and cook according to instructions& drain add beef& peppers with oil to a hot skillet and stir fry until the ouside surface of the meat is no longer pink, about i min Do not over cook, remove from skillet& keep warm in the same skillet combine noodles, carrot, cilantro, seasoning packet from noodles and the steak sauce, cook until heated through over medium heat add beef, mix& serve, garnish with peanuts.

Dish Name: Thai Beef Patties With Noodle Salad
Ingredient Names: dried rice noodles, beef mince, red curry paste, vegetable oil, cherry tomatoes, lebanese cucumber, spring onions, red capsicum, bean sprouts, cilantro, sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in large heatproof bowl. Step 2: Cover with boiling water and stand until noodles are just tender, drain. Step 3: Using your hands, combine minced beef and paste in a bowl. Step 4: Shape mixture into 12 patties. Step 5: Heat oil in a large frying pan and cook patties, in batches, until browned and cooked through. Step 6: Meanwhile, combine tomatoes through cilantro in a large bowl. Step 7: Add noodles and half of the combined chilli sauce and vinegar, toss gently to combine. Step 8: Serve patties with the noodle salad, drizzled with the remaining dressing.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, red bell peppers, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, cilantro, peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, lime, green onions, pita pockets, romaine lettuce leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Crumble beef into large nonstick skillet and cook over medium heat. Step 2: Stir occasionally until browned, about 5-6 minutes, drain well. Step 3: Add peppers, ginger, garlic, and red pepper flakes to skillet. Step 4: Cook until peppers are crisp tender. Step 5: Whisk together in a small bowl peanut butter, cilantro, soy sauce, lime juice, and sesame oil. Step 6: Stir into beef and pepper mixture. Step 7: Cut pitas in half and line with lettuce leave. Step 8: Fill each with about 1 / 2 cup of the meat mixture. Step 9: Sprinkle with green onions and serve.

Ingredient Names: stir-fry sauce, raw sugar, lime, mangoes, raw cashews, crushed red pepper flakes, cilantro, chinese cabbage, purple onion, romaine lettuce, chinese noodles, sirloin strip steak
Instructions: Step 1: Put crushed red pepper and cilantro in to a small bowl and crush In your serving bowl, mix korean teriyaki sauce, sugar, and lime juice. Step 2: Cook the steak / meat if used to your liking. Step 3: Boil water to a rolling boil and add the chinese noodles. Step 4: Cook for 3 minutes, picking apart with a fork while they are cooking. Step 5: Check for tenderness, strain and rinse with cold water. Step 6: Rinse the cooking pan with cold water, then return the noodles to the pan and toss with 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil so the noodles don't stick together. Step 7: Cut up chinese cabbage into small pieces, and add with mixed greens to the serving dish. Step 8: Toss with the "dressing" mixture. Step 9: Slice steak thin, and place it on top of your tossed greens.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, brown sugar, vegetable oil, lime juice, fresh gingerroot, crushed red pepper flakes, peanut butter, ground beef, spaghetti noodles, green beans, red bell pepper, green onion, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil and cook noodles according to package directions. Step 2: Mix together the first 8 ingredients for the sauce and set aside. Step 3: Fry the beef until no longer pink. Step 4: Add vegetables, cooked noodles and sauce to the cooked beef and stir fry until vegetables are tender and sauce has reduced down.

Dish Name: Thai Beef With Broccoli In Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, boneless beef roast, broccoli floret, oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in deep, heavy skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook until a bit of garlic sizzles at once, toss well. Step 3: Add beef and toss until it changes color. Step 4: Add broccoli florets and toss for about 1 min, until they turn shiny and bright green. Step 5: Add oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, and water and cook 3-4 min, tossing often, until broccoli is tender and beef is cooked. Step 6: Transfer to small serving platter and serve hot or warm.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, thai red curry paste, cilantro, egg, light soy sauce, fresh ground black pepper, baguette, lettuce, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the ground beef with the red curry paste, chopped cilantro, egg, light soy sauce and black pepper. Step 2: Mix the ingredient together with your hand until sticky. Step 3: Divide into 8 portions and shape into mini burger patties. Step 4: Heat up the grill and cook this over high heat for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Step 5: Cut the baguette into 4 Assemble each with 2 cooked mini burger patties, shredded lettuce and a little sweet chili sauce, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: beef sirloin, egg, vegetable oil, tofu, shallots, garlic clove, red curry paste, coconut milk, curry powder, fish sauce, sugar, rice noodles, peanuts, lime wedges, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: If using raw beef, put beef in a small pan and cover with water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Simmer gently for 10 minutes and set aside If using leftover meat, skip this part. Step 3: Soak rice flour noodle for 20 minutes in water and drain. Step 4: Boil water in a pot. Step 5: Put the noodles in a sieve or strainer and dip them into the boiling water for 2 to 3 seconds only and drain. Step 6: Divide into two serving bowls. Step 7: Cut the eggs into quarters and set aside. Step 8: In a small frying pan heat 1 t of oil and fry the sliced tofu until slightly browned. Step 9: Drain and set aside.

Dish Name: Thai Curry Burger With Grilled Onions And Curry Dressing
Ingredient Names: ground beef, garlic salt, green curry paste, water, fresh basil, red onion, hamburger buns, butter, basil, cheese, ketchup, lettuce, mayonnaise
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk curry paste and water until it creates a smooth sauce. Step 2: Combine in a bowl, ground beef, garlic salt, curry paste mixture, and basil. Step 3: Mix throughly with hands Create burger patty Pan fry burger in a pan coated with non-stick cooking spray. Step 4: Cook until done for your taste. Step 5: When burger is done, saut onions until golden. Step 6: Mix butter garlic salt, and basil, spread on bun and toast or broil. Step 7: Combine curry paste and mayonnaise and spread on bun. Step 8: Add lettuce, ketchup, cheese, and onions on burger and other burger dressings.

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin steak, canola oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, water, sugar, garlic clove, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, sambal oelek, seedless cucumber, red onion, mung bean sprouts, mint leaf, dry roasted salted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat your grill or grill pan over medium-high to high heat Rub the steaks with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Step 2: Grill the steaks, turning once, until an instant-read thermometer reads 125 degrees f - about 12 minutes This will depend on your grill / grill pan heating. Step 3: Let the steaks rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat the water with the sugar in a small skillet, stirring until the sugar is dissolved. Step 5: Transfer to a large bowl. Step 6: Add the garlic, fish sauce, lime juice and sambal oelek and let it cool. Step 7: Add the cucumber, onion, bean sprouts, mint and sliced steak and toss well.

Ingredient Names: beef mince, flour, peanut oil, coriander, red curry paste, crunchy peanut butter, brown sugar, lemon juice, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Roll mince into small balls and coat lightly in flour According to preference, deep or shallow fry meatballs until cooked through. Step 2: Drain on absorbent paper and put aside. Step 3: Drain most of the oil from pan in which meatballs were cooked. Step 4: Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add all other ingredients, except for meatballs and coriander, and bring to the boil. Step 6: Add meatballs, lower heat, and simmer for 5-10 minutes, or until sauce has thickened. Step 7: Sprinkle with coriander to serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, red peppers, ginger, garlic, smooth peanut butter, brown sugar, coconut milk, basil, coriander, minced beef, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix half of the coriander, half of the garlic and 2 tbsp fish sauce into the meat, using hands to mix well Form little balls, with wet hands. Step 2: Saute the balls in oil for about 5 minutes. Step 3: When cooked lay them on paper towels to drain, keep them warm. Step 4: Put the rest of the garlic, pepper and ginger root in the same pan and saute for 1 minute. Step 5: Add coconut milk, peanut butter, sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce and the rest of the coriander. Step 6: Let it simmer while stirring, till the sauce thickens. Step 7: Add basil, and serve with meat balls Nice with rice noodles.

Dish Name: Thai Noodles With Curried Ground Beef Sauce
Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce, rice noodles, black soy sauce, vegetable oil, ground beef, garlic, curry powder, onion, cherry tomatoes, ground pepper, chicken broth, cornstarch, water, fish sauce, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and cut lettuce into bite size pieces. Step 2: Keep refrigerated until ready to use Separate noodles into strands and stir-fry in heated non-stick wok or skillet. Step 3: Add 4 tbsp black soy sauce, and stir until noodles become brown and a little crispy on the bottom. Step 4: Remove to a bowl, and set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in the same wok, and saut garlic until aromatic. Step 6: Add ground beef and stir to break up meat and brown it. Step 7: Add curry powder and ground pepper. Step 8: Mix well until beef is done. Step 9: Add chopped onion and tomatoes.

Ingredient Names: ground beef, peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, fresh ginger, cilantro, cayenne pepper
