Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together I would do this with my hands to get everything really combined, but if you're sqeamish, use a wooden spoon. Step 2: Grill, broil or pan fry until done to your taste I usually have to hold back the urge to eat it a la tartare -). Step 3: Serve on buns with your choice of condiments.

Dish Name: Thai Red Beef Curry For Two
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, light brown sugar, flank steak, red bell pepper, sugar snap pea, fresh basil leaf, fresh lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in 12-inch skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Step 2: Add curry paste and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 3: Whisk in coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar and simmer until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add beef and cook until pieces separate and turn firm, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in bell pepper and peas and cook until peas are crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Step 6: Turn off heat, stir in basil and lime juice. Step 7: Season with salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: beef mince, thai red curry paste, fresh breadcrumb, fresh coriander, kaffir lime leaves, egg, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place mince in bowl, stir in red curry paste. Step 2: Add breadcrumbs, coriander, lime leaves, egg and soy sauce. Step 3: Mix till sticky with clean hands. Step 4: Shape mixture into large patties. Step 5: Cook on preheated grill pan, 4 - 5 minutes each side till cooked through. Step 6: Serve in buns with sweet chilli sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Salad With Grilled Flank Steak
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, sesame oil, hot bean paste, soy sauce, garlic, chili pepper, spring onions, cucumbers, tomatoes, red onion, of fresh mint, cilantro, parsley, fish sauce, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients for marinade, marinate the flank steak for several hours or overnight. Step 2: Combine the ingredients for the dressing, whisk to combine. Step 3: Set aside Over medium high flame, grill the flank steak to desired doneness. Step 4: Allow to rest at least 20 minutes. Step 5: Prepare the vegetables: peel the cucumber leaving strips of the skin. Step 6: Cut in half lengthwise and remove seeds, slice diagonally into thin slices. Step 7: In a large bowl, combine the vegetables with the herbs and toss Lightly dress to taste with the reserved dressing, adding salt, pepper, and additional lime juice to taste. Step 8: Slice the steak thinly against the grain.

Ingredient Names: sirloin steak, garlic, onion, brown sugar, lime, fish sauce, tamarind pulp, hot water, vegetable oil, crunchy peanut butter, coconut milk, cayenne pepper, lemongrass, soy sauce, wooden skewer
Instructions: Step 1: Hint: if you slice beef while partially frozen, it slices thinner and easier for you. Step 2: Soak wooden skewers for 25-30 minutes prior to preparing food. Step 3: Blend marinade in a blender until smooth. Step 4: Thread strips onto wooden skewers and place in large shallow dish. Step 5: Pour marinade over meat and let sit for 60 minutes to 2-3 hours, refrigerated, turning sticks occasionally. Step 6: Combine sauce ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring. Step 7: Remove from heat and cool. Step 8: Then pour into small bowls Broil, grill, or bbq kebabs at high heat,, until meat on kebabs is cooked through, not more than 5 minutes. Step 9: Serve kebabs with bowls of sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, fresh ginger, thai red curry paste, ground allspice, salt, pepper, beef short ribs, cinnamon stick, white onion, reduced-sodium beef broth, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine oil, ginger, curry paste, allspice, salt and pepper in a small bowl to make a paste Rub on ribs. Step 2: Put ribs, cinnamon, onion & broth into a 4 1 / 2 quart or larger crockpot. Step 3: Cover and cook until beef is tender, 6 to 7 hours on low or 3 1 / 2 to 4 hours on high Skim excess fat from broth. Step 4: Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, green beans, oil, garlic, red curry paste, unsweetened coconut milk, lime zest, bamboo shoot, fish sauce, sugar, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok or large frying pan. Step 2: Add vegetables and stir-fry until crisp tender. Step 3: Remove and keep warm. Step 4: Add garlic and curry paste and stirfry for 45 seconds Immediately add coconut milk and lime zest. Step 5: Stir-cook for 1-2 minutes until it's bubbling and thick, add beef. Step 6: Stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 7: Add fish sauce and sugar and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 8: Return veges to pan.

Ingredient Names: limes, lime, fish sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, olive oil, top sirloin steak, green onions, fresh cilantro, carrot, mango, red onion, bibb lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce and olive oil in a medium bowl. Step 2: Place steak in a food storage bag with half of the marinade or non-reactive bowl with cover. Step 3: Marinate 30 minutes Reserve remaining marinade in a small bowl, refrigerate. Step 4: Heat grill pan over high heat. Step 5: Remove steak from marinade. Step 6: Cook, turning once, until desired degree of doneness, about 5-6 minutes on each side for medium. Step 7: Transfer to a cutting board. Step 8: Cover loosely with aluminum foil.

Ingredient Names: lean sirloin steaks, fresh gingerroot, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic, vegetable oil, baby corn, green bell peppers, fresh shiitake mushrooms, white onion, thai red chili peppers, beef stock, cornstarch, water, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Slice beef thinly into 1"x2" pieces. Step 2: In a bowl, combine ginger, sugar, soy sauce and garlic, add beef. Step 3: Allow meat to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes, or refrigerated, for up to several hours. Step 4: In a wok, heat the oil. Step 5: Drain beef, reserving marinade. Step 6: Stir-fry beef over high heat until browned. Step 7: Add corn, green peppers, mushroom, onion, and thai chilies, stir-frying for 1 minute. Step 8: Add marinade and beef stock. Step 9: Reduce heat to medium and cook for 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.

Dish Name: Thai Stir Fried Wide Rice Noodles Pad Si Iew
Ingredient Names: garlic, egg, cornstarch, rice wine, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, palm sugar, sesame oil, black pepper, ginger, green onion, shallots, thai red chili pepper, beef
Instructions: Step 1: Slice about 8 ounces of beef paper thin and marinade the beef in the marinade for about an hour. Step 2: Cook the noodles until tender, in plain water, then put in cold water to halt the cooking process. Step 3: Heat a wok and a little oil to stir fry the marinaded beef until it just begins to cook. Step 4: Add the noodles and the remaining ingredients, and stir until blended and heated through. Step 5: Taste the sauce for balance of flavors.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, beef chuck, salt and pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven, warm the oil over low heat and add the curry paste. Step 2: Stir and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes, then add to the coconut milk cook and stir for another 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the beef, bring to a boil and lower the heat to a gentle simmer. Step 4: Cook covered for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours, stirring from time to time By now the meat should be soft, if it is not, continue cooking until it is. Step 5: Raise the heat and cook uncovered another 10 minutes or until the sauce is thick taste for seasoning and serve garnished with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: fish sauce, lime juice, dark soy sauce, garlic, minced ginger, coriander, green onion, shallot, sesame oil, sweet chili sauce, beef, sweet onion, tomatoes, cucumber, mung bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Mix dressing ingredients and chill several hours to let flavors develop. Step 2: Grill beef on medium hot grill until medium-rare or until your preferred degree of doneness We have a range of eaters - rare to medium-well done & slice accordingly Thinly slice across the grain Plate salad family style & let each person choose slices of beff to place on top of salad. Step 3: Serve with dressing on the side so each my take as much as he / she wants May present with jasmine rice or hot naan bread Use sriracha sauce on the side if you would like more heat.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, lemongrass, chili peppers, garlic, parsley roots, shallot, fresh ginger, fish sauce, sugar, kaffir lime leaves, oil, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut steak lengthwise, with grain, in strips 1-2 inches wide and 4-5 inches long. Step 2: Combine lemongrass, chili peppers, garlic, parsley roots, shallots and ginger into a mortar or food processor and grind together, until well mixed. Step 3: Add mixture from last step to a gallon sized zip top freezer bag and add fish sauce, sugar and kaffir lime leaves -- stir to mix in new ingredients. Step 4: Add beef strips and mix well to coat. Step 5: Refrigerate bagged beef mixture overnight Lay beef strips out on a large cookie sheet and heat in the oven on the lowest setting for 5-7 hours, until dried The dried beef can either be deep fried immediately for a couple minutes to give it a crispy outside, or you could refrigerate a portion for frying later that week. Step 6: Serve hot with sriracha sauce and sticky rice, or steamed jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Tiger Cries Salad A Spicy Thai Beef Salad
Ingredient Names: beef flank steak, white pepper, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, palm sugar, garlic, sugar, shallots, serrano peppers, lemongrass, rice powder, salad greens, red onion, scallions, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare a batch of thai sticky rice to serve with this salad Marinade: mix ingredients in a ziploc and let meat marinade from 2-24 hours in liquid Char grill or broil meat to med rare, about 3-4 minutes per side. Step 2: Let rest at least 10 minutes then slice very thin against the grain Usevery good quality meat for this dish, you want it to be fork-tender and melt-in-your-mouth! Step 3: Dressing: mix all dressing ingredients together 1+ hours before serving salad You may want to make extra dressing to spoon over the sticky rice Salad: pour half of dressing over the red onions, lemon and cuke in a large salad bowl and let them absorb the flavor, 15+ minutes. Step 4: Add lettuce, tomatoes, scallions and mint along with the rest of the dressing. Step 5: Toss the salad until all ingredients are very well coated and mixed.

Ingredient Names: beef broth, chunky peanut butter, soy sauce, lemon pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, beef sirloin steaks, green bell pepper, green onions, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Start 6 servings of white rice cooking according to package directions. Step 2: Whisk together broth, peanut butter, soy sauce and lemon pepper in small bowl- set aside. Step 3: Heat large nonstick skillet on medium high-heat until hot, then add beef, onion powder, garlic powder and pepper to taste- cook and stir 5 to 7 minutes or until no longer pink. Step 4: Add green pepper and cook, stirring, 2 to 3 minutes or until tender- reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Stir in peanut sauce until well blended, and sprinkle with green onions. Step 6: Serve over hot rice- enjoy!

Ingredient Names: beef tenderloin, fresh ground black pepper, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, thai red chili peppers, shallot, scallions, fresh coriander leaves, fresh mint leaves, seedless cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare grill Halve tenderloin horizontally to form 2 approximately 1-inch-thick pieces Rub both sides of each piece with black pepper, pressing it into meat. Step 2: Grill beef on an oiled rack set 5 to 6 inches over glowing coals 5 to 8 minutes on each side for medium-rare. Step 3: Transfer beef to a cutting board and cool 30 minutes If desired, chill beef, loosely wrapped, at least 2 hours and up to 1 day to facilitate thin slicing But beef across grain into very thin slices. Step 4: In a large bowl stir together lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and chilies until combined will. Step 5: Add beef, shallots, scallions, coriander, and mint and toss will Score cucumber lengthwise with tines of a fork and cut crosswise into thin slices.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, fresh coriander, straight-to-wok pad thai noodles, fresh bean sprouts, egg fork, limes, fish sauce, sugar, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Dry-fry the prawns and coriander stalks in a non-stick frying pan for 1-2 mins until the prawns are just pink. Add the noodles, beansprouts, egg, lime juice, fish sauce and sugar. Quickly toss together for 1 min more until the egg is just cooked and everything is well mixed – you might want to use a pair of tongs to make this easier. Step 2: Remove from the heat, mix in most of the coriander leaves, then divide between 2 bowls. Scatter with the remaining coriander and the peanuts, and serve with lime wedges for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: garlic, coriander stems, vegetable oil, raw shrimp, pickled turnips, sugar, eggs, oyster sauce, fish sauce, fresh bean sprouts, limes, green onions diagonal, peanuts, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in cold water for up to 2 hrs, then drain and set aside. Using a pestle and mortar, pound the garlic with the chopped coriander stems or roots. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat. When shimmering, add the garlic and coriander mix. Stir for a few moments, then add the prawns and pickled turnip, if using. Cook for 30 secs, then add the sugar. Add the noodles and stir for 1 min, making sure everything is well mixed. Add the eggs and cook for 2 mins more. Step 3: Pour in the oyster and fish sauce, then add the beansprouts, lime juice, most of the spring onions, most of the roasted peanuts and most of the chilli. Toss and cook for around 2 mins, then serve scattered with coriander and the rest of the chilli, peanuts and spring onions.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, water, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, worcestershire sauce, limes, red pepper flakes, pulled pork, thai rice noodles, fresh bean sprouts, julienned carrots, julienned orange bell peppers, scallions, unsalted peanuts, fresh cilantro, avocado oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all sauce ingredients in a large bowl, whisk thoroughly, and set aside. Step 2: Bring a gallon of water to boil, then take off heat. Step 3: Soak noodles in hot water, cover with lid, then strain after 7 minutes. Step 4: Heat avocado oil in large pan or wok. Step 5: Add julienned (or splintered) carrots, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add julienned bell pepper to pan, continue stir-frying for 4-5 minutes. Step 7: Add pulled pork, sprouts, and noodles to pan simultaneously, and continue stir-frying for 3-4 minutes. Additional oil may be needed. Step 8: Take pan off heat, whisk sauce briefly, then add sauce, scallions, and peanuts to pan. Mix thoroughly. Step 9: Add back to heat, continue mixing thoroughly and bringing sauce-covered ingredients up to serving temperature. Step 10: Divide pad thai into bowls, and top with shredded cilantro. Step 11: Dish pairs well with plum wine or medium-sweet white wines.

Ingredient Names: megrim sole, sunflower oil for deep frying, flour, fast-action yeast, lager, sparkling water, green beans, thai fish sauce, soft brown sugar, garlic, bird's-eye chilies, ball stem ginger syrup, limes, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: First make the batter by mixing the flour with the yeast and some seasoning. Add the lager and enough sparkling water to make a mixture a little thicker than double cream. Cover with cling film and allow to bubble somewhere warm for at least 30 mins. Step 2: To make the Thai sauce, blanch the beans in boiling water for 2 mins, then drain and refresh under cold water. Slice the beans as finely as possible and set aside. Warm the fish sauce with the sugar until dissolved. Remove from the heat and add the garlic, chillies and ginger while still warm. Allow to infuse for a few mins. Add the green beans and lime juice. Add some water if it tastes a little strong. Step 3: Cut the fish fillets into finger-width strips and sprinkle very lightly with salt. Fill a deep saucepan, wok or deep-fat fryer one-third full with oil and heat to about 180C or until a cube of bread browns in 20 secs. Roll the fish in the seasoned flour and shake off the excess. Dip into the foaming batter and carefully place into the hot oil. Fry in batches for about 3 mins until crisp, golden and the fish is cooked through. Remove and drain on kitchen paper. Serve with the Thai dipping sauce add some lime wedges.

Dish Name: Thai Lettuce Wraps (Larb Gai, Laab Gai)
Ingredient Names: cornflour cornstarch, water, lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, peanut oil, ginger, garlic, lemongrass, thai, chicken ground meat, red onions, coriander cilantro leaves, mint leaves, peanuts, to lettuce leaves, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: Place water and cornflour OR rice powder into a small bowl. Mix into a slurry. Add lime juice, fish sauce and sugar and mix to combine. Set aside. Step 2: Heat peanut oil in a wok (or heavy based fry pan) over medium high heat. Add ginger, garlic, lemongrass and chilli and sauté for 45 seconds to 1 minute until fragrant. Do not let the garlic burn, it will taste bitter. Step 3: Add the chicken and turn up the heat to high. Cook the chicken, breaking up the mince into small pieces. Step 4: Once the chicken turns white and is almost cooked through (about 3 to 4 minutes), add Sauce. Cook for 45 seconds to 1 minute to coat the chicken and for the sauce to thicken. Step 5: Remove wok from heat. Stir through onion, coriander/cilantro and mint. Step 6: Spoon filling into a bowl, and serve with lettuce, peanuts, extra herbs and lime wedges on the side - leave everyone to make their own. Spoon filling into lettuce cups and garnish with what you want! Step 7: Sauce option: Take it over the top by serving with Thai Peanut Satay Sauce, as pictured in the first photo in post! It's extra amazing (though not traditional!).

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, sunflower oil, turkey breast steak, green beans, red onions, garlic, limes, chili powder, red chile, fish sauce, mint, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the rice noodles following pack instructions. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the turkey over a high heat for 2 mins. Add the beans, onion and garlic, and cook for a further 5 mins. Step 2: Stir in the lime juice, chilli powder, fresh chilli and fish sauce, then cook for 3 mins more. Stir in the noodles and herbs, then toss everything together before serving.

Ingredient Names: trout fillets, ginger, garlic, red chile, limes, baby pak choi, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Nestle the fish fillets side by side on a large square of foil and scatter the ginger, garlic, chilli and lime zest over them. Drizzle the lime juice on top and then scatter the pieces of pak choi around and on top of the fish. Pour the soy sauce over the pak choi and loosely seal the foil to make a package, making sure you leave space at the top for the steam to circulate as the fish cooks. Step 2: Steam for 15 minutes. (If you haven’t got a steamer, put the parcel on a heatproof plate over a pan of gently simmering water, cover with a lid and steam.).

Dish Name: Salapow Steam Buns Dia Bao Or Dim Sum
Ingredient Names: pork, fresh ginger, water chestnuts, onion, oyster sauce, pepper, garlic cloves, salt, sweet soy sauce, light soy sauce, sugar, sesame seed oil, flour, milk, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix filling ingredients in a large bowl. Step 2: Transfer to covered container and refrigerate while making the buns. Step 3: Cut wax paper into 24 - 3" squares. Step 4: Put bottom of water filled steamer over high heat and cover. Step 5: Put 2 packages of mix in bowl and add sugar. Step 6: Mix, Add flour and oil, and mix with hands in bowl, adding any additional flour as needed to keep from being too sticky. Step 7: Knead in bowl 10 minutes. Step 8: Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Step 9: Knead again for 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: butter, icing sugar, black sesame seed, white bread
Instructions: Step 1: Soften butter by setting out 15 minutes before starting. Step 2: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius or 300 degrees fahrenheit Cream the butter with the icing sugar to form butter cream icing. Step 3: Spread the icing thinly over the bread, on both sides. Step 4: Cut the crusts off the bread to neaten them up. Step 5: Cut the slices into quarters and place of a baking tray. Step 6: Sprinkle with a few sesame seeds over the top. Step 7: Bake in a low oven, 150 degrees celsius or 300 degrees fahrenhei for 15 minutes They will crisp up as they cool and the icing sugar and butter sets.

Ingredient Names: turkey ground meat, fresh breadcrumb, red thai curry paste if you are using authentic thai brand, green onions, eggs, sunflower oil, mango pickle mayo, spicy mango salsa, ciabatta rolls, baby gem lettuce leaves, cucumbers, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Place mince, breadcrumbs, curry paste, spring onions and egg into a large bowl. Season lightly, then mix well with your hands to combine. Divide into 4 and shape into burgers. Chill for 20 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the salsa and mayo. Brush the burgers with oil and grill for 7 mins each side, or until firm, golden and cooked through. Alternatively, cook on the barbecue. Step 3: Once cooked, toast the rolls, cut-side up, under the grill. To serve, top the rolls with a turkey burger, add lettuce, cucumber, tomato slices and a spoonful of mayo or salsa and put the lids on.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, creamy peanut butter, white wine vinegar, cayenne pepper, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, garlic, fresh gingerroot, green onion, broccoli florets, green pepper, red pepper, dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, stir together the soy sauce, peanut butter, vinegar, and cayenne pepper, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a skillet or wok over high heat. Step 3: Add chicken, garlic and ginger, and cook, stirring constantly, until chicken is golden on the outside, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium, and add green onion, broccoli, peppers peanuts, and the peanut butter mixture. Step 5: Cook, stirring frequently, for 8 to 10 minutes, or until broccoli is tender, and chicken is cooked through. Step 6: Serve over rice or rice noodles.

Dish Name: Asian Chicken Salad With Glass Noodles
Ingredient Names: noodles, boneless skinless chicken breast, green onions, carrots, cucumber, bean sprouts, of fresh mint, fresh cilantro, toasted sesame seeds, hot chili sauce, lime juice, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cover noodles with boiling water and let sit 5-8 minutes, or until cooked. Step 2: Drain and rinse under cold water. Step 3: Steam chicken for 15 minutes, then shred into small pieces. Step 4: Place noodles, chicken, onions, carrots, cucumber, bean sprouts, mint and cilantro into large bowl. Step 5: Mix together chili sauce, lime juice and sesame oil then pour over noodle mixture and toss well. Step 6: Top with toasted sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, chicken broth, sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, ketchup, dried red pepper flakes, boneless skinless chicken breasts, tofu, vegetable oil, egg, garlic, medium raw shrimp, red bell pepper, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice stick noodles noodles in a bowl of warm water for about 12-15 minutes. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: In a small bowl whisk together the chicken broth with sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, ketchup and red pepper flakes, set aside. Step 4: Slice the chicken or pork into about 1 / 4-inch strips, then cut the tofu onto about 1 / 2-inch cubes, set aside. Step 5: In a wok or large frypan heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Step 6: Add in beaten egg and cook stirring occasionally until scambled and cooked. Step 7: Transfer to a large bowl, then wipe the wok or skillet clean. Step 8: Add in 1 tablespoon oil, then increase the heat to medium-high.

Dish Name: Authentic Thai Red Curry With Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, oil, chicken stock, chicken bouillon cube, yellow onions, green bell peppers, carrots, japanese eggplants, sugar, lemon juice, fish sauce, sweet basil, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut onion, bell pepper, and eggplant into bite size pieces and set aside Shred carrots with a vegetable peeler and set aside. Step 2: Cut tomatoes in half and set aside. Step 3: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and set aside. Step 4: Pour the oil into a five-quart pot and put over medium heat. Step 5: When the oil is hot, but not smoking, add the thai red curry paste and stir, sauting for about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the coconut milk and chicken stock, then throw the chicken bullion cube in the pot and stir. Step 7: After the liquid begins to boil, add the vegetables, carrots, and tomatoes. Step 8: Add sugar, lemon juice, sweet basil leaves, and crushed basil, then bring to a boil again. Step 9: Add the chicken and bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, vegetable oil, fresh ginger, red curry paste, coconut milk, water, salt, lemongrass, fish sauce, brown sugar, boneless skinless chicken breasts, pineapple chunks, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok, add the garlic, saute. Step 2: Add the curry, ginger and the thicker cream on top of the can of coconut milk to the wok, whisk. Step 3: Now add the rest of the coconut milk in along with everything but the chicken and pineapple, whisk. Step 4: Bring to a slow boil for 7 minutes, then discard the lemongrass add the chicken and pineapple and cook till the chicken is no longer pink inside, about 7-9 minutes. Step 5: Serve over jasmine rice and top with green onion Soooooooooooooo yummy!

Dish Name: Banana Chilli Stuffed With Crab And Chicken In Green Curry Sauce
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, coriander, ground chicken, crabmeat, white pepper, chilies, coconut milk, vegetable oil, green curry paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a mortar, pound the garlic and coriander to a paste. Step 2: Combine with chicken mince, crabmeat and white pepper in a mixing bowl. Step 3: Cut tops off the banana chillies and remove the seeds and ribs. Step 4: Stuff the chillies with the chicken and crab mix Skim thick cream from the top of the can of coconut milk and combine with vegetable oil in a wok. Step 5: Heat until sizzling. Step 6: Add curry paste and stir for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add remaining coconut milk, fish sauce and palm sugar. Step 8: Place the stuffed chillies in the simmering sauce and cook until the chillies are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Step 9: Remove chillies from the sauce and place on a serving platter.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, brown rice, garlic cloves, red bell peppers, green bell pepper, onions, fresh basil, curry paste, fish sauce, bamboo shoots, light coconut milk, canola oil, chilies, sriracha sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Add rice and boil for 40 minutes, or until rice is tender, then drain 2 While rice is boiling, begin cleaning and prepping the vegetables and other ingredients. Step 3: When cooking with a wok, its important to have everything right next to the wok and ready to go because of the high cooking temps Youll need to be prepared to be stirring constantly 3. Step 4: When rice has been drained and plated, heat the wok on high until it starts to smoke slightly. Step 5: Then add oil and dried chilis.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, salted peanuts, lime peel, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, rice vinegar, chili sauce, cooking oil, chicken breast, garlic, egg, fresh bean sprout, green onion, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a large bowl. Step 2: Add enough hot tap water to cover. Step 3: Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes or until pliable but not soft. Step 4: Drain well in a colander. Step 5: Meanwhile, for peanut topping, combine peanuts and lime peel, set aside. Step 6: In a small bowl combine fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and chile sauce, stir until smooth, set aside. Step 7: In a 12-inch nonstick skillet heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: chicken, garlic, salt, black peppercorns, fresh coriander, lime juice, cherry tomatoes, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken in half lengthways, and if you like, remove the bones with a small pointed knife, leaving only the wing bones If using chicken pieces, proceed directly to Crush the garlic with the salt to a smooth paste Coarsely crush the peppercorns in a motar and pestle or a blender. Step 2: Combine in a flat dish with the coriander, and the lime juice Rub the mixture into the cicken on all sides, cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least an hour However, this recipe tastes better if refrigerated over night Barbecue the chicken halves or chicken pieces, turning the chicken every 5 minutes or so, until the chicken is no longer pink and the skin is crisp If the weather does not permit, you can cook under a grill, or in the oven To serve the boned chicken, diagonally slice the chicken skin side up and place on a serving platter.

Dish Name: Beef Or Chicken Satay With Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: flank steaks, peanut oil, lemongrass, garlic, chili peppers, curry powder, honey, thai fish sauce, cilantro, peanut butter, soy sauce, sugar, rice wine, chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Method for meat and marinade: trim the meat and cut into long thin strips. Step 2: Combine all of the marinade ingredients, add the meat, and let marinate under refrigeration for at least 2 hours and up to 12 hours. Step 3: Soak bamboo skewers in water for a least 10 minutes before you are ready to grill the satays. Step 4: Thread the meat on the skewers, one strip per skewer Skewer meat can be returned to the marinade to hold until cooking time. Step 5: Place the skewered meat on the grill or boiler rods. Step 6: Grill or broil undisturbed for about 1 minute, turn and grill 1 minute more for medium rare, or as needed for the desired doneness Server the satays with the spicy peanut sauce Method for spicy peanut sauce: process all ingredients in food processor until smooth. Step 7: Cover and set aside at room temperature for 1 hour or overnight in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: curry, onion, ginger, chili, garlic cloves, oil, ground coriander, ground cumin, ground turmeric, chicken breast fillets, chicken stock, tomato paste, coconut cream, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Process onion, ginger, chilli, garlic and oil in a food processor until smooth. Step 2: Cook in pan with coriander, cumin and turmeric for 2-3mins. Step 3: Add chicken and little more oil if needed and cook 2-3mins. Step 4: Add chicken stock and tomato paste and stir well to combine. Step 5: Bring to boil then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes. Step 6: Stir in coconut cream and heat through then stir in coriander.

Dish Name: Broiled Thai Chicken With Mango Coleslaw
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, honey, vegetable oil, lime juice, salt, pepper, red cabbage, savoy cabbage, carrot, mango, creamy peanut butter, water, soy sauce, hot red pepper flakes, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler to low Pound chicken with your fists to flatten slightly Spray a broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray and arrange chicken on the broiler pan. Step 2: Place broiler pan about 4 inches from the heat source Broil for 7 minutes, then turn and continue cooking for about 6 minutes more, or until fork can be inserted easily and chicken is tender. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix the honey, vegetable oil, lime juice, salt and pepper. Step 4: In a large bowl, place the red cabbage, savoy cabbage, and carrots, toss well to mix. Step 5: Add honey-lime mixture and mango to cabbage and toss getnly to mix. Step 6: Arrange the cabbage mixture on a platter with chicken on top.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red bell pepper, carrot, zucchini, cabbage, broccoli, boneless skinless chicken breasts, rice, smooth peanut butter, coconut milk, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, garlic cloves, brown sugar, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix peanut sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 2: Heat 2 tbs peanut oil in a large skillet or wok on medium-high heat. Step 3: Add chicken and cook until chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Remove from skillet and set aside. Step 5: Heat remaining 2 tbs of peanut oil in the skillet. Step 6: Add veggies and saute until tender crisp. Step 7: Toss the veggies with the chicken and peanut sauce, then serve over rice You should have plenty of leftover sauce for that.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, black pepper, oil, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Remove skins and extra fat from chicken. Step 2: Remove the outer leaves from the lemongrass, cut into 1 inch pieces, and pound until somewhat flattened with a meat tenderizer Crush garlic and blend with lemongrass, fish sauce, sugar, and pepper. Step 3: Add chicken and toss to coat well. Step 4: Marinate 3-4 hours If needed, you can marinate for 15 minutes and cook- the flavor will be less intense, but it will still work if you're in a hurry. Step 5: Remove chicken from marinade. Step 6: Heat oil in a pan with a tight-fitting lid Brown the chicken in the oil. Step 7: Pour the remaining marinade into the pan, and add enough water to just cover the bottom of the pan.

Dish Name: Cheesecake Factory Bang Bang Chicken And Shrimp By Todd Wilbur
Ingredient Names: chili oil, onion, minced garlic cloves, ginger, chicken broth, ground cumin, ground coriander, paprika, salt, ground black pepper, ground mace, turmeric, coconut milk, carrots, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: Make the curry sauce by heating the chili oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: When the oil is hot add the onion, garlic, and ginger Saut for about about 30 seconds then add the chicken broth. Step 3: Add the spices and stir well. Step 4: Simmer for 5 minutes then add the coconut milk. Step 5: Bring mixture back up to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until sauce begins to thicken. Step 6: Add the julienned carrots and zucchini, and the frozen peas. Step 7: Simmer mixture for 10 minutes or until carrots become tender. Step 8: Make peanut sauce by combining peanut butter, water, sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, lime juice, and chili oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Step 9: Heat just until mixture begins to bubble, then cover the pan and remove it from the heat.

Dish Name: Chiang Mai Curry Noodles Kao Soi
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, red curry paste, boneless chicken, unsweetened coconut milk, chicken broth, ground turmeric, dark soy sauce, sugar, salt, lime juice, fresh chinese noodles, shallot, fresh cilantro, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat, and then add the garlic. Step 2: Toss well and add the red curry paste, mashing and stirring to soften it in the oil, about 1 minute. Step 3: Add the chicken and cook 1 to 2 minutes, tossing now and then to brown it evenly and mix it with the curry paste. Step 4: Add the coconut milk, chicken broth, turmeric, soy sauce, sugar and salt and stir well. Step 5: Bring to a gentle boil and adjust heat to maintain a lively simmer. Step 6: Cook about 10 minutes until meat is cooked through. Step 7: Stir in lime juice, remove from heat and cover to keep curry warm while you prepare the noodles. Step 8: Cook the noodles in a large pot of rapidly boiling water until tender but still firm, as little as 2 minutes for fresh noodles and 7 minutes or more for dried. Step 9: Drain, rinse well in cold water, drain again and divide the noodles among individual serving bowls Ladle on hot curry, and sprinkle each serving with the shallots, cilantro and green onions.

Ingredient Names: green curry paste, coconut milk, fresh basil, bamboo shoot, fish sauce, brown sugar, chicken broth, chicken breast, fresh broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan combine curry paste and coconut milk and heat Just before boiling, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 10-15 minutes. Step 3: Serve over freshly cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, chicken stock, chicken breast, lemongrass, fresh ginger, red pepper flakes, fresh lime leaves, button mushroom, fish sauce, lime juice, granulated sugar, salt, pepper, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, combine coconut milk & chicken stock, bringing to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Lower the heat, add the chicken pieces & simmer about 10 minutes or until cooked through. Step 3: Remove chicken with a slotted spoon & set aside. Step 4: Add lemongrass, ginger, chile & lime leaves & simmer for 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove larger pieces of spices with a slotted spoon, then return the chicken to the saucepan, along with the mushrooms & heat through, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Turn off the heat & stir in the fish sauce, lime juice & sugar, then season with salt & pepper, before garnishing with the cilantro, if desired.

Dish Name: Chicken And Galangal Soup Tom Ka Gai
Ingredient Names: lemongrass, coconut milk, tom kha paste, boneless chicken breasts, fish sauce, soft brown sugar, tomatoes, water, sliced mushrooms, chili peppers, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lemon grass, 1 / 2 can of coconut milk and tom ka paste in a medium pan and bring to a boil Continue to simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for a couple minutes. Step 2: Add the fish sauce, brown sugar and chicken and simmer until chicken is cooked. Step 3: Add tomatoes and remaining coconut milk and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add water, as needed, for desired consistency and taste and bring to a boil. Step 5: Add mushrooms and cook until desired consistency. Step 6: Add brown sugar, fish sauce or chilies, as necessary, to adjust taste. Step 7: Turn off heat, add cilantro and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red curry paste, garlic, coconut milk, chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken breasts, ginger, onion, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, mango, straw mushrooms, fish sauce, brown sugar, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep frying pan or wok heat oil over medium heat until hot. Step 2: Add curry paste and garlic and cook, stirring, for about 30 seconds Slowly stir in coconut milk and chicken broth. Step 3: Reduce heat to simmer. Step 4: Add chicken and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove and discard garlic. Step 6: Add ginger, onion, and peppers. Step 7: Cook until tender, about 7 minutes. Step 8: Add mango, straw mushrooms, fish sauce, and sugar. Step 9: When heated through, serve over individual plates of hot rice.

Ingredient Names: coriander seed, cumin seed, ground cumin, gingerroot, cilantro, jalapeno pepper, lime zest, fresh lime juice, canola oil, black pepper, salt, boneless skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Crush the coriander and cumin seeds lightly. Step 2: Combine with the ground cumin, minced ginger, cilantro, jalapeno, lime zest and juice, oil, black pepper and salt. Step 3: Put the chicken breasts in a glass dish and pour marinade over. Step 4: Turn the chicken to coat. Step 5: Marinate at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate for longer marination. Step 6: Heat large nonstick grill pan or skillet over medium heat. Step 7: Remove chicken from marinade, discard marinade. Step 8: When pan is hot, add chicken and cook about 5 to 6 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.

Dish Name: Chicken Chili And Sweet Potato Soup
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, red chile, chicken breast, chicken broth, pepper, salt, light cream
Instructions: Step 1: Fry / cook chicken breast and once cooked, dice into small pieces Peel and dice up sweet potatoes Throw into a pan of boiling water for about 10-15 minutes check they are well cooked by poking them with a blunt knife. Step 2: Chop up 1 / 2 chili and remove seeds Dice into small pieces. Step 3: Put the dice chili into the chicken broth, stir and mix. Step 4: Add pepper and salt. Step 5: Put the potatoes into a food processor. Step 6: Mix for 2 minutes on low.

Ingredient Names: wooden skewers, boneless chicken breasts, shallots, garlic, coconut milk, lemon juice, brown sugar, coriander leaves, salt, whole cumin seed, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Soak skewers in cold water for 1 to 2 hours before grilling. Step 2: Cut meat into 3 / 4 inch pieces. Step 3: Place in a medium sized bowl. Step 4: In a food processor or blender whirl together shallots, garlic, coconut milk, lemon juice, sugar, coriander, salt, cumin and turmeric to form a smooth paste. Step 5: Combine with meat and marinate, covered in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours. Step 6: Thread onto skewers without crowding, about 4 pieces per skewer. Step 7: Grill or broil until crisp and browned, but still juicy, about 3 to 6 minutes, turning to cook evenly.

Dish Name: Chicken Coriander And Sweet Chilli Patties
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, red onion, garlic cloves, fresh coriander, thai sweet chili sauce, egg white, cooking spray, rice vinegar, sugar, lemon juice, fish sauce, water, romaine lettuce, carrot, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Mix patty ingredients together, shape into 8 patties and pan fry with a little cooking spray. Step 2: Mix dressing ingredients together, adding water a little at a time, to taste. Step 3: Serve patties over salad and / or cooked rice with dressing drizzled over everything.

Dish Name: Chicken Curry Soup With Coconut And Lime
Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium chicken broth, unsweetened coconut milk, curry powder, jalapeno chile, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, fresh lime juice, salt and pepper, green onion, cilantro, cooked white rice, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken broth, coconut milk, curry powder and chili to a simmer in a heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken and simmer until chicken is just cooked through, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes, mix in lime juice. Step 3: Season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Divide rice between 4 bowls Ladle soup over rice. Step 5: Sprinkle with green onions and cilantro Pass lime wedges separately, serve.

Dish Name: Chicken Curry With Green Peppercorns And Pumpkin
Ingredient Names: chicken thigh pieces, green peppercorns, vegetable oil, coconut milk, red curry paste, palm sugar, fish sauce, peanuts, pumpkin, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Rub chicken pieces with crushed peppercorns. Step 2: Combine vegetable oil and the thick coconut cream from top of the can in a wok Stirring constantly, heat until sizzling. Step 3: Add curry paste and cook, stirring until fragrant for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken and stir until sealed, about 5-7 minutes. Step 5: Add remaining coconut milk, sugar, fish sauce and peanuts and bring to the boil, stirring well. Step 6: Add pumpkin pieces and simmer until well coated with the sauce and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add basil leaves and stir until wilted.

Dish Name: Chicken Drumsticks With Asian Barbecue Sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chinese five spice powder, chicken drumsticks, salt, fresh ground pepper, hoisin sauce, asian chili sauce, rice vinegar, chicken stock, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, toasted sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 425f. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix the vegetable oil with the five-spice powder. Step 3: Add the chicken, season with salt and pepper and toss. Step 4: Arrange the chicken on a foil-lined baking sheet Roast for about 35 minutes, turning twice, until cooked. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a blender, combine the hoisin sauce, chile sauce, rice vinegar, stock, ginger, garlic and sesame oil and puree until very smooth. Step 6: Transfer to a saucepan and simmer until slightly thickened, 5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer the chicken to a bowl and toss with the sauce, until completely coated. Step 8: Preheat the broiler and position a rack 8 inches from the heat. Step 9: Return the chicken to the baking sheet and broil for about 10 minutes, brushing with the sauce and turning occasionally, until glazed and sticky.

Dish Name: Chicken Filets With Pecan Or Walnut Crust
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, pecans, panko breadcrumbs, apricot jam, light soy sauce, coconut oil, lemon, fresh ginger, lemon wedges, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put pecans and bread crumbs together in a food processor and and pulse a couple of times until mixture is finely ground and well mixed, empty on a plate Lightly pound filets between two sheets of wax paper, moisten them with a dash of lemon juice and add salt to taste Dredge filets on both sides in crumb - nut mixture, using the palm of your hand to pat it on, shake off excess. Step 2: Heat coconut oil in a heavy skillet, add chicken and saute on both sides until nice and brown. Step 3: Turn only once Work in batches if necessary Do not let the oil get too hot otherwise the nuts will turn bitter. Step 4: In a small skillet heat apricot jam and soy sauce with the rest of the lemon juice, add grated ginger and chili flakes to taste, heat through. Step 5: Divide chicken filets between 4 heated plates, garnish with lemon wedge and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, green curry paste, chicken stock, fish sauce, brown sugar, fresh basil, bamboo shoot, chicken, snow peas
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 4 ounces of coconut milk to a boil with the curry paste, sugar, stock and fish sauce. Step 2: Simmer for 15 minutes. Step 3: Add the remaining cocnut milk, basil, bamboo, and chicken and simmer another 10 minutes Just before serving, stir in the snow peas. Step 4: Serve over rice This recipe also works well with fish or shrimp.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red curry paste, creamy peanut butter, sugar, fish sauce, chicken breasts, garlic, onion, cornstarch, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium sauce pan heat coconut milk, curry paste, peanut butter, sugar, and fish sauce until they come to a very small boil. Step 2: Set aside and cool adding cornstarch to thicken While the sauce is cooling, stir fry 1 chopped onion and 1 t minced garlic. Step 3: Cut up chicken into small pieces and stir fry with the onion and garlic until chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Combine the garlic, onion and chicken with the sauce and heat. Step 5: Spoon the chicken peanut curry over rice and enjoy.

Dish Name: Chicken In Red Curry With Bamboo Shoots
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, red curry paste, unsweetened coconut milk, sweet basil, kaffir lime leaves, hot red chili pepper, zucchini, fish sauce, water, bamboo shoots, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat about 1 / 2 the coconut milk to a boil in a large pan. Step 2: Stir in the red curry paste. Step 3: Add the chicken, reduce heat, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Step 4: Add the rest of the coconut milk, water, bamboo shoots, sugar, and fish sauce and return to a boil. Step 5: Stir in the zucchini, kaffir lime leaves, and hot chillies. Step 6: Cook several minutes or until zucchini are done to your liking. Step 7: Garnish with sweet basil before serving. Step 8: Serve with hot rice, if desired.

Dish Name: Chicken Kabobs With Thai Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, green onions, teriyaki sauce, hot sauce, peanut butter, orange juice concentrate, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Thread chicken, cucumber, tomatoes and onions alternately on metal skewers. Step 2: Set aside To prepare thai dipping sauce: Combine teriyaki baste & glaze sauce, hot sauce, peanut butter, orange juice concentrate and garlic. Step 3: Mix well Reserve 2 / 3 cup sauce for dipping. Step 4: Brush skewers with some of the remaining sauce. Step 5: Grill kabobs on an oiled rack over hot heat for 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, turning and basting often with remaining sauce. Step 6: Serve skewers with thai dipping sauce Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: dried guajillo chilies, shallots, garlic cloves, ginger, cilantro, ground coriander, ground turmeric, curry powder, vegetable oil, unsweetened coconut milk, chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken thighs, chinese egg noodles, fish sauce, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place chiles in a small heatproof bowl, add boiling water to cover, and let soak until softened, 2530 minutes. Step 2: Drain chiles, reserving soaking liquid Pure chiles, shallots, garlic, ginger, cilantro, coriander, turmeric, curry powder, and 2 tablespoons soaking liquid in a food processor, adding more soaking liquid by tablespoonfuls, if needed, until smooth You've just made khao soi paste! Step 3: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Step 4: Add khao soi paste. Step 5: Cook, stirring constantly, until slightly darkened, 46 minutes. Step 6: Add coconut milk and broth, bring to a boil, add chicken.

Ingredient Names: noodles, red chilies, garlic cloves, green ginger, ground coriander, coriander root, sesame oil, skinless chicken breasts, light coconut milk, chicken stock, fish sauce, lime, mint leaf, green onions, fresh bean sprout
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Put chillies, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, fresh coriander and oil into food processor and process to a coarse paste. Step 4: Slice the chicken breasts diagonally. Step 5: In a large saucepan over medium heat add the paste and fry for 1 minute, stir well. Step 6: Add coconut milk and stock. Step 7: Bring to boil, simmer gently for 10 minutes. Step 8: Add fish sauce and chicken and cook for 5 minutes, add lime juice. Step 9: Divide noodles between bowls and ladle soup over them.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, of fresh mint, lime juice, vegetable oil, white sugar, thai fish sauce, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Rub the chicken breasts with vegetable oil and grill or pan fry for about 15 minutes, until tender. Step 2: Allow to rest Pick the mint leaves from the stalks and finely chop half, leaving the rest whole. Step 3: Stir the lime juice and sugar with the fish sauce, until the sugar dissolves. Step 4: Remove the skin from the chicken and slice the breast finely on the diagonal. Step 5: Toss the chicken, chopped mint and chilli powder in the dressing, pile onto a plate, scatter with the whole leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, coconut milk, red curry paste, chicken stock, fresh lime leaves, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Put coconut milk, curry paste, chicken stock and lime leaves in a pan and simmer for 10 mins until thickens slightly. Step 2: Add the sugar and chicken and cook for 10 more mins until chicken is cooked, adding more stock if necessary. Step 3: Serve with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Chicken Patties With Hot And Sour Sauce
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, red curry paste, kaffir lime leaf, egg, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the chicken mince, curry paste, lime leaf, egg and fish sauce and form into small patties about 5cm wide and 1cm thick Barbecue the patties on medium heat for 3-4 minutes on each side.

Dish Name: Chicken Pumpkin Curry 21 Day Wonder Diet Day 13
Ingredient Names: brown rice, red onion, coriander roots, coriander leaves, red chilies, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground turmeric, chicken stock, chicken breast fillets, light coconut milk, butternut pumpkin, baby corn, bean sprouts, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in large saucepan of boiling water unril tender, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, blend onion, coriander root and stem mixture, coriander leaves, chilli, garlic, ginger, and turmeric until smooth. Step 3: Cook paste in medium frying pan, stirring, until fragrant. Step 4: Add stock, chicken and coconut milk, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 5: Simmer, covered, 10 minutes. Step 6: Add pumpkin and corn to pan. Step 7: Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Step 8: Serve rice topped with curry, sprouts and extra coriander.

Dish Name: Chicken Rama In Thai Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, ground ginger, boneless skinless chicken, creamy peanut butter, red curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, roasted peanuts, spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Add coconut and ginger to a medium saucepan, and stir until well blended. Step 2: Cook it over medium heat and bring it to a boil. Step 3: Add the chicken pieces to the saucepan. Step 4: Reduce the heat and let it simmer 5-7 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through With a slotted spoon, remove the chicken and transfer to a bowl. Step 5: Cover and set aside If any coconut milk accumulates at the bottom of the bowl, just pour it back into the saucepan To the saved coconut milk, add the peanut butter, red curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, and chopped peanuts Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes or until the sauce is creamy and not grainy in appearance. Step 6: Add the chicken, and heat for another 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rice sticks, garlic cloves, soy sauce, limes, peanut butter, ginger, hot chili paste, canola oil, chicken breasts, napa cabbage, carrot, red bell pepper, red onion, cucumber, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in a pot of boiling water until tender. Step 2: Drain And cut noodles in several places with scissors. Step 3: Puree next 7 ingredients in a blender and with machine running add oil, blending until dressing is smooth. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper if desired, set aside. Step 5: In a large salad bowl combine salad ingredients. Step 6: Toss with dressing Although i tossed the noodles with the salad in the bowl, the original recipe suggests to arrange noodles on a platter and arrange salad on top of noodles and sprinkle with peanuts, passing additional dressing Can be served warm or is best refrigerated.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, black pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, garlic, brown sugar, vegetable oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, fish sauce, bamboo skewers, oil, peanut sauce, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut thin slices that run the length of the chicken breast to get 16 slices If you find it difficult to cut thinly through fresh meat, leave it in the freezer for 15-20 minutes to harden slightly and then slice. Step 2: Place the chicken strips in a plastic freezer bag. Step 3: Add all the marinating ingredients and gently toss until well mixed. Step 4: Let the chicken marinate in the fridge for at least 2 to 24 hours. Step 5: When ready to cook the satays, stir chicken in its marinade and then thread each slice onto a skewer, working the skewer in and out of the meat, down the middle of the slice, so that it stays in place during grilling Baste the chicken with oil or coconut milk and grill on a barbecue or under the broiler. Step 6: Cook for not much more than 2 minutes each side, turning fairly often to prevent unnecessary burning, and baste one more time with oil or coconut milk The satays are done when they have turned golden brown and crispy along the edges. Step 7: Serve on lettuce leaves, decorated with fresh cilantro leaves, and accompanied by a small bowl of peanut sauce on the side.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, brown sugar, curry powder, garlic, hot pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a ziplock bag and let chicken marinate overnight. Step 2: Place cubes of chicken on skewers and grill on both sides until done To bake, cook at 450 for 17 or 18 minutes.

Ingredient Names: whole wheat spaghetti, vegetable oil, chicken breast, garlic cloves, peanut butter, tamari, thai red curry paste, tomato paste, chicken broth, fresh ginger, savoy cabbage, apple juice, bean sprouts, peanuts, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil, salt it, add the pasta an cook until al dente, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a soup pot, heat the oil over med heat. Step 3: Add the chicken and garlic and cook, stirring until the chicken is opaque, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to a plate. Step 5: Add the peanut butter, tamari, curry paste and tomato paste to the pot and stir Increase the heat to med high and whisk in the chicken broth, add the ginger. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then stir in the cabbage and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Return the chicken to the pot and stir in the apple juice. Step 8: Divide the pasta among 4 bowls.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, roasted peanuts, garlic cloves, ground ginger, curry powder, ground coriander, soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, chili powder, bamboo skewers
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into 1 / 2" chunks. Step 2: In a skillet, roast the peanuts over medium heat for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger and cook for 2 more minutes. Step 4: Add curry and coriander and heat for 1 more minute. Step 5: Combine with all remaining ingredients, mix well. Step 6: Let chicken marinate in mixture overnight. Step 7: Preheat oven to 325f. Step 8: Thread chicken evenly onto the skewers. Step 9: Cover a baking sheet with foil and rest the skewered chicken on top.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, coconut milk, fish sauce, red curry paste, palm sugar, cilantro, ground turmeric, salt & freshly ground black pepper, bamboo skewer
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine all the marinade ingredients except the chicken. Step 2: Slice the chicken into long, thin strips and pound it to flatten it. Step 3: Add the chicken to marinade. Step 4: Turn chicken to coat, cover and refrigerate at least one hour. Step 5: Thread each chicken strip onto a skewer. Step 6: Grill for 7 minutes or until done, turning once. Step 7: Serve with the peanut sauce Peanut sauce 1 cup coconut milk 3 tablespoons red curry paste.

Ingredient Names: smooth peanut butter, garlic clove, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, sugar, cayenne, water, boneless skinless chicken thighs, shallot, garlic cloves, dark brown sugar, black pepper, peanut oil, fish sauce, chinese rice wine
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender blend together the peanut butter, the garlic, the lime juice, the soy sauce, the sugar, the cayenne, the water, and salt and pepper to taste until the mixture is smooth and transfer the sauce to a bowl The sauce may be made 2 days in advance and kept covered and chilled. Step 2: Combine chicken with shallots, garlic, palm sugar, pepper, oil, fish sauce, rice wine, and salt in a sealable plastic bag and turn to coat chicken, then squeeze bag to eliminate as much air as possible and seal. Step 3: Marinate chicken, chilled, at least 12 hours but no longer than 24. Step 4: Thread each chicken strip lengthwise onto a skewer, keeping strip as straight as possible. Step 5: Discard any remaining marinade. Step 6: Prepare grill for cooking over medium-hot charcoal. Step 7: Grill skewers, turning over once, until chicken is cooked through, about 4 minutes total Cooks' If you aren't able to grill outdoors, sats can be cooked in a hot lightly oiled large well-seasoned ridged grill pan over moderately high heat.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, curry powder, chicken breasts, red curry paste, unsalted dry roasted peanuts, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together the 1 / 4 cup coconut milk and curry powder and marinate the chicken strips in this overnight. Step 2: Put the red curry paste and can of coconut milk in a pan and cook for 4 minutes. Step 3: Add the peanuts, salt and sugar and cook until mixture thickens, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Thread the chicken strips onto wooden skewers and barbecue over med heat until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Step 5: Serve with the peanut sauce.

Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, fresh coriander, sugar, salt, mild curry powder, vegetable oil, ground turmeric, coconut milk, skinless chicken breasts, crunchy peanut butter, sweet chili sauce, tamarind paste, light soy sauce, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: For marinade, add onion, garlic, coriander, 2 tsp sugar and salt to food processor and pulse briefly. Step 2: Add curry powder, oil, turmeric, and coconut mild and pulse until combined Empty this mixture into a large bowl. Step 3: Cut chicken into thin strips. Step 4: Add to marinade and chill two hours or overnight in refridgerator. Step 5: Soak 16 wooden skewers in cold water for half and hour. Step 6: Add peanut butter, sweet chilli sauce, tamarind paste, soy sauce, 2 tsp sugar, and lime juice in a bowl and mix well with electric mixer. Step 7: Add 2 to 3 tbsp boiling water, still mixing, to desired consistency and set aside. Step 8: Take meat from marinade and thread on skewers. Step 9: Add a little bit of oil to a frying pan and heat on high.

Dish Name: Chicken Wings With Thai Sweet Hot Chili Glaze
Ingredient Names: sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, dark sesame oil, fresh ginger, chicken wings, vegetable oil, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Make the glaze, in a small bowl, whisk the sauces, sesame oil and ginger together Trim excess skin from the edges of the wings Lightly brush or spray with the oil, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 2: Grill the chicken wings over direct medium heat until the skin begins to crisp, about 10 minutes, turning once or twice. Step 3: Brush the wings with the glaze and continue to grill until the meat is no longer pink at the bone, 8 to 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze 2 or 3 times, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, green cabbage, carrot, papaya, fresh cilantro, green onion, peanuts, garlic cloves, chili peppers, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, fresh lime juice, oil, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Step 2: Add the chicken breasts, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes. Step 3: When the chicken is done, remove from heat, drain water, let cool, and shred with two forks. Step 4: Chop the cabbage into very thin pieces, like it would be for coleslaw I use a mandolin Peel and grate the carrots. Step 5: Cut off the skin, remove the seeds, and grate the papaya Roughly chop the cilantro and green onions. Step 6: Toss the chicken and vegetables in a large bowl and keep chilled Mince the garlic and chili peppers.

Dish Name: Cilantro Chicken And Spicy Thai Noodles
Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, canola oil, salt & freshly ground black pepper, garlic, cilantro leaf, limes, seasoned rice vinegar, fresh ginger, lime, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, chicken stock, green curry paste, scallions, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: For the chicken, combine all the ingredients in a nonreactive bowl and let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Step 2: Prepare a grill pan to medium-high heat and grill the chicken thighs 4 minutes per side or until done For the sauce, add canola oil to a saute pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add the ginger, lime zest, juice, garlic, red pepper flakes and chicken stock. Step 4: Stir well to combine and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Step 5: Add the curry paste, seasoned rice vinegar and scallions. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low and simmer 2 minutes. Step 7: Place the cooked noodles in a large serving bowl and add sauce, carrots and peanuts - toss well. Step 8: Add the cilantro chicken and serve.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, turmeric, vegetable oil, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, red bell pepper, kosher salt, basil leaves, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Pat chicken dry and remove any excess fat. Step 2: Sprinkle with turmeric. Step 3: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and brown chicken on both sides. Step 4: Transfer to a plate and discard all but 1 tbsp of oil in the pan. Step 5: Add curry paste and stir, mixing it with the oil until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the coconut milk and bring to a boil, stirring and scraping any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Step 7: Stir in fish sauce, lime juice and sugar. Step 8: Boil for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 9: Lower the heat, add the chicken with any juices, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 10: Uncover, turn the chicken pieces and simmer for another 15 minutes.

Ingredient Names: baby spinach, snow peas, chow mein noodles, vegetable oil, shallots, garlic cloves, thai red curry paste, madras curry powder, ground coriander, ground turmeric, chicken stock, unsweetened coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, cooked chicken
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the spinach and snow peas just until the spinach wilts, 30 seconds. Step 2: Remove the vegetables. Step 3: Add the noodles to the water and cook until ad dente, 8 minutes, drain well. Step 4: Transfer the spinach, snow peas and noodles to bowls Meanwhiles, in a large saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil. Step 5: Cook the shallots over moderately high heat until lightly browned, 2 minutes. Step 6: Transfer to a plate. Step 7: Reduce the heat to moderate. Step 8: Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, the garlic, curry paste, curry powder, coriander and turmeric and stir-fry for 30 seconds.

Ingredient Names: light coconut milk, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, chicken tenders, romaine lettuce, red cabbage, snow peas, fresh cilantro, red onions
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f 2. Step 2: Whisk coconut milk, lime juice, sugar and salt in an 8-by-8-inch glass baking dish. Step 3: Transfer 1 / 4 cup of the dressing to a large bowl, set aside. Step 4: Place chicken in the baking dish. Step 5: Bake until cooked through, about 20 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile, add lettuce, cabbage, snow peas, cilantro and onion to the large bowl with the dressing, toss to coat. Step 7: Divide between 2 plates. Step 8: Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and thinly slice.

Dish Name: Coconut Mango Chicken With Black Beans
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless chicken breast, ground coriander, chicken broth, coconut milk, mango, salt and pepper, black beans, fresh lime juice, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the oil over high heat. Step 2: Add the chicken and cook, turning once, until browned, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the coriander, and stir for about 30 seconds. Step 4: Add the chicken broth, lower the heat and simmer for 3 minutes, scraping up any browned bits. Step 5: Transfer to a plate. Step 6: Add the coconut milk to the skillet, increase the heat and boil to reduce by half, about 4 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the mango and cook until warmed through. Step 8: Return the chicken to the skillet, toss and remove from the heat. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper. Step 10: Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, simmer the black beans over low heat.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, cilantro salsa, peanut butter, ginger, soy sauce, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Put all ingredients in crock pot on low for 6-8 hours. Step 2: Garnish with cilantro, scallions, and peanuts. Step 3: Serve with jasmine rice made with half coconut milk and half water.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Thai Chicken With Vegetables
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, flour, curry, garlic, salt, chicken breasts, onion, carrots, bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk coconut milk, flour, and curry base in slow-cooker until smooth. Step 2: Whisk in garlic and salt. Step 3: Add chicken, onion, and carrots. Step 4: Stir to mix Scatter bell pepper over top. Step 5: Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours until chicken and vegetables are tender.

Ingredient Names: chicken, red bell pepper, onion, chicken broth, soy sauce, cumin, garlic cloves, red chili pepper flakes, salt, pepper, cornstarch, creamy peanut butter, lime juice, cilantro, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken, bell pepper and onion in crockpot. Step 2: Mix soy sauce, broth and spices together. Step 3: Pour mixture over chicken. Step 4: Cook on high for 3 hours. Step 5: Whisk peanut butter, starch, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and lime juice together. Step 6: Add 1 cup of juices from crock pot and mix until smooth. Step 7: Stir mixture into crock pot. Step 8: Cook 30 minutes more. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro, green onion and peanuts, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Curried Chicken And Shrimp With Apricot Brown Rice
Ingredient Names: brown rice, water, dried apricot, salt, jumbo shrimp, boneless chicken breast, black pepper, canola oil, onion, garlic, gingerroot, madras curry powder, chicken broth, cornstarch, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Make rice: place rice in fine strainer and rinse thoroughly. Step 2: Place rice in small saucepan, stir in water, apricots, and 1 / 3 of the salt. Step 3: Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over very low heat until rice is tender, about 40 minutes. Step 4: Keep warm For curry: season shrimp and chicken with remaining salt and pepper. Step 5: Heat half of the oil in large saute pan over medium high heat. Step 6: Add chicken and shrimp and cook until brown on all sides. Step 7: Cook in batches to keep from overcrowding the pan. Step 8: Remove from pan and reserve. Step 9: Add remaining oil to pan.

Ingredient Names: angel hair pasta, cooked chicken, unsweetened coconut milk, thai seasoning, roasted peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and return pasta to the pan. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine chicken, coconut milk, and thai seasoning in a large skillet. Step 4: Cook and gently stir over medium heat until mixture is heated through. Step 5: Pour chicken mixture over cooked pasta in pan. Step 6: Add peanuts and cilantro. Step 7: Toss gently to coat.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, chicken breasts, unsalted cashews, chilies, chili paste, diced onion, red bell pepper, scallion, stock, black bean sauce, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and saute until lightly browned, approximately 1 minute. Step 3: Add chicken and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 4: Add cashews, dried chilies, and chili paste and cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Step 5: Add all remaining ingredients and cook, stirring constantly, 3 minutes. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chicken quarters, lemongrass, purple onion, fish sauce, soy sauce, chili, brown sugar, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice the lemongrass and then chop it up as finely as you can Do the same with the purple onion and mix both in a bowl to create the marinade. Step 2: Add the chili and sauces and stir again. Step 3: Finally, add the carnation milk and sugar. Step 4: Stir everything together until sugar is dissolved. Step 5: Place chicken pieces in a flat baking pan. Step 6: Pour the lemongrass concoction over, turning chicken to saturate. Step 7: Turn pieces skin-side down and set in refrigerator to marinate at least 15 minutes or up to 4 hours. Step 8: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Step 9: Turn chicken pieces skin-side up and spoon a little more of the marinade from the pan over the surface of each piece.

Dish Name: Easy Thai Chicken Stir Fry With Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, creamy peanut butter, ground ginger, sesame oil, chili oil, rice vinegar, chicken broth, rice noodles, frozen broccoli cuts, carrots, peanut oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, garlic salt, sliced mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: In a microwave-safe bowl, whisk soy sauce and brown sugar together until dissolved then add gradually to peanut butter, stir until smooth. Step 2: Stir in ginger, sesame oil, chili oil, and rice vinegar. Step 3: Blend well Fyi: at this point the thick peanut sauce makes a great dipping sauce! Step 4: Stir chicken broth into peanut sauce. Step 5: Cook in microwave oven about 45 seconds or just until bubbly around edges. Step 6: Stir and set aside. Step 7: Bring a large saucepan containing 5-6 cups water to a boil. Step 8: Remove pan from heat and add rice noodles.

Ingredient Names: chinese noodles, crushed red pepper flakes, ground black pepper, chicken breasts, garlic, sugar, sesame oil, tomato ketchup, green onions, tamari soy sauce, peanuts, fresh cilantro, bean sprouts, lemon slice
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare noodles according to package directions, and set aside. Step 2: Heat oil and saut chicken until cooked. Step 3: Add garlic, sugar, ketchup, onions and tamari sauce. Step 4: Using chopsticks or two forks, mix the chicken and noodles, and then add the peanuts or cashews and cilantro. Step 5: Garnish with sprouts and lemon.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breast, red chili peppers, fresh lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, vegetable oil, coconut milk, salt, fish sauce, sweet basil, cabbage, sriracha sauce, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken in to thin strips Grind together peppers, lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves in a mortar or food processor. Step 2: Heat oil to medium-high in a medium saucepan and add peppers, lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves mixture, sauting for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add coconut milk to the pan and stir well, continue cooking for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add chicken to the pan and continue cooking for 5 more minutes. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low, stir in fish sauce, sriracha sauce, and brown sugar, and basil and simmer for 1 last minute. Step 6: Serve atop the bed of cabbage and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, papayas, red capsicums, cucumber, pine nuts, avocados, salad greens, lime zest, fresh lime juice, safflower oil, light brown sugar, thai fish sauce, chili sauce, ginger, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: In a small jar combine the dressing ingredients and shake well. Step 2: Pour half the dressing over the chicken and marinate at least 15 minutes. Step 3: Set aside the rest of the dressing Barbecue, grill or roast the chicken, basting with the used marinade. Step 4: Cool and cut into bite sized pieces and refrigerate until ready to use Peel, seed and dice the papayas. Step 5: Cut up the capsicums into squares after removing seeds and ribs. Step 6: Cut the cucumber into cubes. Step 7: Wash and dry the salad greens To toast the pine nuts, place them on a baking tray in a preheated 325 degree oven for about 8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, honey, low sodium soy sauce, red chili pepper flakes, gingerroot, cooked chicken, california dried fig, green onions, mint, cantaloupe, red bell pepper, cucumber, iceberg lettuce, roasted peanuts, mint sprig
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, combine first five ingredients. Step 2: Place the chicken in a medium bowl, and toss with the figs, green onions and chopped mint. Step 3: Pour the marinade over chicken mixture with the cantaloupe, bell pepper and cucumber. Step 4: Arrange lettuce on a chilled platter Mound the chicken salad attractively in center. Step 5: Sprinkle with peanuts and garnish with mint as desired.

Ingredient Names: rice paper sheet, noodles, garlic, sesame oil, thin soy sauce, garlic powder, white pepper, mung bean sprouts, lettuce, fresh basil, cilantro, chicken breast, plum sauce, sweet chili sauce, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak clear noodle in hot / boiling water till soft. Step 2: Place oil and garlic in large pan / wok and cook, add noodles, stir fry. Step 3: Add soy sauce, garlic powder, and pepper. Step 4: Remove from heat and place in bowl Assemble other ingredients on counter or table in bowls. Step 5: Soak 1 rice paper in warm water until soft, no longer than 30 seconds and lay on a plate or counter. Step 6: Layer on rice paper: lettuce, plum sauce, chicken, noodle, cilantro, basil, sprouts, Carefully start to roll up eggroll style, tucking in the sides, then continue to roll up. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: chicken, olive oil, dark soy sauce, fish sauce, lime, palm sugar, galangal, garlic cloves, shallots, black peppercorns
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f Into a covered casserole add oil, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar, stir just a bit. Step 2: Using a microplane grater grate galangal and garlic. Step 3: Add to casserole with shallot and black pepper. Step 4: Add chicken and toss with"sauce" Freshly squeeze the lime juice over the whole mess and toss again. Step 5: Cover casserole and bake for about 45 minutes. Step 6: Remove cover and bake until nicely browned and meat pulls away from bones.

Dish Name: Gaeng Keow Wan Gai Thai Green Curry Chicken
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, coconut milk, fish sauce, laos powder, green curry paste, fresh sweet basil leaves, fresh lime leaves, green peas, serrano chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Place your chicken, 2 cups of coconut milk, fish sauce, and laos powder in a wok or large frying pan, and bring to a boil, allowing them to boil until the chicken is cooked and tender. Step 2: Remove your chicken from the pan with a slotted spoon leaving everything else behind, and put it on a plate and set aside. Step 3: Allow the milk to continue boiling until it is very thick and"oily" Then take your curry paste, and add it to the pan. Step 4: Allow this to cook for 3 minutes or so, until everything is smooth and even Next, take your chicken and return it to the pan, and pour in the rest of the coconut milk, and return entire mixture to a boil. Step 5: Reduce your heat and allow it to cook for approximately 10 minutes. Step 6: Finally, add your basil and citrus leaves, peas and serranos, increase your heat and allow it to boil for 5 minutes. Step 7: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Gai Krapow Minced Chicken With Basil
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, dry white wine, ground black pepper, sesame oil, salt, cornstarch, garlic powder, vegetable oil, jalapenos, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, stir together all the ingredients except the vegetable oil, jalepenos, and basil. Step 2: Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat, add the oil. Step 3: Add the chicken mixture and stir fry until chicken is cooked, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Stir in the jalepenos and basil, serve right away.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, green beans, curry paste, oil, fish sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken breast into bite sized pieces. Step 2: Cut fresh green beans into bite sized pieces. Step 3: Stir fry curry paste in oil. Step 4: Add chicken and beans. Step 5: Add fish sauce and sugar. Step 6: Cook until chicken is done and beans are crisp.

Ingredient Names: cashew nuts, oil, green onion, chicken broth, stir-fry sauce, garlic, dried small red chilies, cornstarch, chicken, carrot, green pepper, onion, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the vegetables into smaller pieces. Step 2: Preheat the pan and pour in the oil. Step 3: Add the garlic and chicken when the oil is hot. Step 4: Place the carrots and onions into the pan and toss. Step 5: Add the chicken broth, the green and red peppers, green onion, chile, and nuts, and mix it in the pan until it is lightly cooked, but do not over-cook! Step 6: Add cornstarch to the sauce according to desired thickness.

Dish Name: Garlic Pepper Chicken Mix Bowl Thai Gai Tod Kratiem Prik Tai
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic cloves, white pepper, soy sauce, sea salt, oyster sauce, sugar, peanut oil, lettuce leaf, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken, minced garlic, ground white pepper, soy sauce, salt, oyster sauce, and sugar in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Step 2: Allow to marinate for at least 1 / 2 an hour in the refrigerator. Step 3: Preheat a frying pan over high heat and add peanut oil.
