Step 4: Heat oil for 2 minutes and place the marinated chicken pieces in the pan. Step 5: Cook for 5-10 minutes. Step 6: Drain left over oil from chicken on paper towels. Step 7: Serve with jasmine rice or sticky rice, lettuce leaves, and cucumber slices.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken, olive oil, mushrooms, coconut milk, chicken stock, fresh lime leaves, thai fish sauce, basil leaves, fresh coriander, fresh ground black pepper, lemongrass, hot green chili peppers, garlic, ginger, shallots
Instructions: Step 1: Make the paste by slicing the lemongrass finely and putting into a food processor with all the remaining curry paste ingredients Whizz to a thick paste, pushing the mixture down from time to time with a spatula. Step 2: Put into a glass bowl, cover tightly and refrigerate. Step 3: Cut the chicken into finger size strips Warm the oil in a casserole and when it is hot and sizzling add the chicken strips and let them colour slightly on all sides Do this in batches if necessary Lift out with a draining spoon and set aside. Step 4: Add the mushrooms to the pan and fry until golden brown, adding more oil if needed. Step 5: Pour in the coconut milk and stock, then add the lime leaves, 4 tablespoons of the curry paste, the fish sauce, half of the chopped herbs and a generous grinding of black pepper. Step 6: Bring to the boil then turn down the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring from time to time.

Dish Name: Green Curry Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: hokkien noodles, peanut oil, onion, green curry paste, baby corn, beans, coconut milk, chicken stock, chicken breasts, brown sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a heatproof bowl cover with boiling water and soak for 1 minute or until tender, drain well. Step 2: Heat a wok over high heat, add the oil and swirl to coat. Step 3: Cook chicken, in batches, until cooked through and to your liking. Step 4: Remove and keep warm. Step 5: Stir-fry the onion for 1-2 minutes, or until softened. Step 6: Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Step 7: Add the baby corn, beans, coconut milk and stock to the wok and simmer for 4 minutes or until reduced slightly. Step 8: Add the chicken back to the wok. Step 9: Stir in plam sugar, fish sauce and lime juice.

Dish Name: Green Curry With Chicken And Eggplant
Ingredient Names: chicken, green curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, eggplant, bamboo shoot, kaffir lime leaves, basil leaves, red chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken with sauce ingredients and bring to a boil Continue to simmer until chicken is done. Step 2: Add eggplant, bamboo shoots and lime leaves. Step 3: Cook until eggplant is tender. Step 4: Garnish with basil leaves and chili pepper before serving, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Green Curry With Chicken And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, green curry paste, lime, lime rind, fish sauce, cilantro, chicken breast, onion, peanuts, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a pan, bring the coconut milk to a boil until it becomes glossy. Step 2: Simmer for a few minutes In another pan, add some oil, onion and green curry paste. Step 3: Cook over high heat for about a minute. Step 4: Add the chicken, stir-fry for a few minutes, until the chicken is almost cooked. Step 5: Add the peanuts, cook for a few minutes. Step 6: Add the coconut milk, half the cilantro, fish sauce, lime rind, and lime juice. Step 7: Simmer for around 10 minutes. Step 8: Serve with rice, top with the remaining cilantro Goes great with thai iced coffee!

Dish Name: Grilled Chicken With Coriander Cilantro Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, sesame oil, fish sauce, sugar, garlic, red chilies, cilantro, rice vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the marinade ingredients together, pour over chicken and leave it in the fridge to marinate for at least 30 minutes While chicken is in the fridge, prepare the sauce. Step 2: Heat vinegar, sugar in a saucepan over low heat, and stir until dissolved. Step 3: Bring to boil and simmer until the sauce thickens, and a syrup forms, pour into a bowl, preheat grill. Step 4: Place chicken about 20cm / 8 inches from the heat, and cook both sides until coloured. Step 5: Serve with coriander / cilantro sauce and fragrant rice.

Dish Name: Grilled Chicken With Thai Spiced Oil
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, fresh ginger, garlic, lemon peel, soy sauce, ground turmeric, boneless skinless chicken breast halves
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare grill. Step 2: Whisk first 6 ingredients in 9-inch pie dish to blend. Step 3: Transfer 1 / 4 cup spiced oil to small bowl and reserve. Step 4: Place chicken in mixture in pie dish, turn to coat. Step 5: Grill until cooked through, about 6 minutes per side. Step 6: Serve with reserved spiced oil.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, onion powder, honey, dijon mustard, soy sauce, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a ziploc bag and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Step 2: Grill Alternatively can cook in oven. Step 3: Preheat oven to 350 degrees, cook 20 minutes, turn over thighs. Step 4: Cook an additional 25 minutes. Step 5: Turn off oven can leave in an additional ten minutes if needed.

Dish Name: Ground Chicken Stir Fried With Basil Kai Pad Bai Kaprow
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, white onion, fresh basil, garlic, green onions, thai red chili peppers, ginger, ground chicken, fish sauce, dark brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In oil over medium-high heat, saute onion, basil, garlic, green onions, chilies, and grated ginger in oil until onions are soft. Step 2: Add ground chicken and saut until browned. Step 3: Mix fish sauce and brown sugar together. Step 4: Add into chicken / basil mixture and stir to coat. Step 5: Saute for another 3 to 4 minutes, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, green bell pepper, fish sauce, thai holy basil, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, onion, red bell pepper, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok, add tablespoon oil and chicken. Step 2: Stir-fry until chicken is almost done. Step 3: Puree 2 slices onion, 2 slices bell peppers, 2 cloves garlic, jalapeno, 1 tablespoon oil in blender or food processor. Step 4: Add pureed mixture from food processor to wok. Step 5: Stir for one minute. Step 6: Add rest of peppers and onions. Step 7: Stir-fry two minutes. Step 8: Add rest of ingredients and stir-fry one minute Soy sauce or small amount of salt can be substituted for fish sauce. Step 9: Serve over steamed rice.

Dish Name: Hot And Sour Soup With Chicken And Lemon Grass
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh gingerroot, brown sugar, lemongrass, limes, shallot, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To a medium size cooking pot, add chicken broth, ginger and brown sugar To prepare lemon grass. Step 2: Remove all but the bottom 5 inches of the stalks. Step 3: Place 8 to 10 outside lemon grass sheaths into soup pot, Mince the bottom 2 inches of the tender inside leaves and set aside, With a potato peeler, peel 6 strips of rind from one lime and add to the broth. Step 4: Bring broth to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 15 minutes While chicken is cooking, grate rind from the remaining lime and set aside Juice both limes to measure 3 tablespoons of juice and set aside.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, granulated sugar, sesame oil, soy sauce, fresh ginger, fresh garlic clove, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken wings, and pat dry with paper towels. Step 2: Place chicken in ziploc bag 2 For the marinade / sauce, in a medium mixing bowl, combine sugar, sesame oil, soy sauce, grated ginger, garlic and chili sauce. Step 3: Mix well, and pour mixture into bag with chicken. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours 3. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f 4.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, lime juice, olive oil, garlic cloves, light brown sugar, salt, red pepper flakes, fine breadcrumbs, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the wings apart at the first joint, separating the "drumstick" from the wing Reserve the Beginning at the narrower end of each drumstick, with a sharp knife, cut the tendons and scrape the meat down the bones as far as possible toward the thicker end to make a plump lollipop, or drumstick shape The bare bone showing makes a neat handle for easier eating. Step 2: In a bowl, whisk together the lime juice, the oil, garlic, brown sugar, red pepper flakes and salt. Step 3: Add the chicken wings, tossing them to coat with marinade. Step 4: Let them sit in the refrigerator at least 2 hours and up to 8 hours. Step 5: In a large zip-lock bag, toss together the bread crumbs and peanuts. Step 6: Add 4 or 5 wings at a time to the bag, shaking well to cover the wings with the crumb / peanut mixture. Step 7: Repeat with the rest of the wings.

Dish Name: Jack's Thai Green Curry With Coconut Rice
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, coconut milk, salt, chilies, ginger, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, garlic cloves, shallots, thai basil, peanut oil, water, chicken thigh fillets, coconut cream, green beans
Instructions: Step 1: Coconut rice - to make coconut rice, place rice in a large saucepan and add coconut milk and salt amd slowly bring to the boil over medium heat, cover with a lid, reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes or until rice has absorbed liquid and then remove from heat and stand covered for a further 10 minutes or until rice is tender Curry paste - meanwhile to make curry paste, place all ingredients in a food processor, cover and then process until it forms a smooth paste Green curry - heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large deep frying pan over medium high heat and add 1 / 2 cup of the curry paste and cook, stirring for 1 minute or until fragrant and then add the chicken and cook, stirring for 4 minutes or until chicken is browned and almost cook through and then add coconut cream, beans and lime leaves and stir to combine and then simmer, stirring for 2 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and then add fish sauce and sugar, and stir to combine. Step 2: Divide the rice among 4 bowls and top with the curry, then garnish with coriander sprigs and thai basil and serve with lime wedges The remaining curry paste will keep covered in the fridge for 7 days.

Dish Name: Kaeng Phet Daeng Kai Hot Red Chicken Curry
Ingredient Names: chicken, coconut milk, japanese eggplant, red curry paste, nam pla, sweet basil, palm sugar, kaffir lime leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken up, then briefly fry the curry paste until fragrant, reduce the heat, add the coconut milk slowly, and continue to stir while cooking until a thin film of oil apppears on the surface Skim off the oil, and discard it. Step 2: Add the chicken and other ingredients except the eggplant. Step 3: Bring to a boil and cook until the chicken begins to change colour Adjust the flavors to suit yourself. Step 4: When it is at a boil again add the eggplant and continue till thechicken is cooked through. Step 5: Serve with steamed white jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: broiler-fryer chicken, maggi seasoning, nam pla, onion, gingerroot, cooked jasmine rice, brown bean sauce, garlic, cilantro roots, chilies, oil, vinegar, sweet soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Rub the chicken with the sauces inside and out. Step 2: Stuff the ginger and onion inside the chicken and immerse it in water. Step 3: Bring it to a boil and simmer for 40 Minutes. Step 4: Remove the chicken from the heat and allow it to cool Retain the stock to make jasmine rice, if desired For the sauce: heat the oil. Step 5: Stir fry the bean sauce, garlic and cilantro root. Step 6: Pour into a bowl and add the soy sauce, vinegar and chilies To finish - mold the rice in a bowl, slice the chicken and place on top of the rice.

Dish Name: Khao Suratan Rice Of The Sultans
Ingredient Names: chicken drumsticks, rice, chicken stock, saffron thread, turmeric, cayenne pepper, fresh lemon juice, fish sauce, nutmeg, cinnamon, sweet bell pepper, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, spring onions, fresh lemon
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f Measure out 1 cup of chicken stock. Step 2: Add the turmeric and saffron, stirring with a fork to dissolve the turmeric. Step 3: Place chicken in a casserole dish, and pour this flavored stock over the chicken. Step 4: Cover and set in the oven to bake 30-35 minutes, or until chicken is nearly cooked. Step 5: Turn the chicken pieces in the stock, ensuring all sides are permeated with the bright saffron color / flavor. Step 6: Drain off the saffron-flavored stock ino a glass measuring cup. Step 7: Cover the casserole dish to keep chicken hot To the stock, add the cayenne pepper, lemon juice, 3 tbsp fish sauce, nutmeg, and cinnamon, stir well.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, hot chili pepper, rice flour, green onions, fresh cilantro, red onions, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: Brown meat in wok over medium heat without any oil. Step 2: Transfer to a bowl and mix with lime juice, fish sauce and hot pepper. Step 3: Add the ground rice and remaining ingredients and combine mixture. Step 4: Place mixture on a bed of shredded lettuce. Step 5: Garnish with cucumber, carrot and cabbage. Step 6: Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: white rice, cooking oil, garlic, ground beef, shallots, scallions, thai fish sauce, lime juice, fresh mint leaves, ground red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Dry roast the rice in a skillet until browned, then pound or process to a coarse powder and set aside Brown the ground meat with the garlic- if using ground chicken, saute the garlic for a minute in oil first. Step 2: Add shallots, scallions, mint leaves and roasted rice powder. Step 3: Stir fry until the shallots become limp, remove from heat. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients. Step 5: Let chill slightly. Step 6: Serve with rice, cellophane noodles or wrapped in lettuce leaves.

Ingredient Names: chicken fillets, chicken stock, shallots, hot chili peppers, garlic cloves, rice, dried red chili, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, coriander, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the chicken stock to a boil then add the chopped chicken and cook for 7 or 8 minutes. Step 2: Drain but reserve the stock. Step 3: Mix all the remaining ingredients in a bowl and then add the drained chicken. Step 4: Add 2 or 3 tblsp of the reserved stock and mix well. Step 5: Serve with salad either hot or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground chicken, lemongrass, green onion, red onion, ground galangal, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, dried red chilies, rice, iceberg lettuce, mint leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To make toasted rice, place rice in a dry hot wok Swirl until golden brown, allow to cool, then grind in a mortar& pestle or spice mill. Step 2: Heat the oil over medium heat in wok and add the chicken. Step 3: Stir-fry until cooked through. Step 4: Drain chicken and place in mixing bowl, adding lemongrass, green onion, red onion, galangal, fish sauce, lime juice, chiles, and ground rice. Step 5: Mix well and set aside On a bed of lettuce leaves, arrange chicken mixture and garnish with mint and cilantro. Step 6: Serve with steamed sticky rice or steamed jasmine rice, using small amounts of rice to pick up the larb.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, rice powder, cayenne powder, green onions, fresh mint leaves, fresh cilantro, fish sauce, limes, palm sugar, red onions, cabbage, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Grill or broil the chicken until just cooked through. Step 2: Allow to cool and remove skin and bones. Step 3: Chop the meat very finely Use only the tender white portion of the lemon grass and cut into thin slices. Step 4: Slice out the mid-ribs from the lime leaves and shred the leaf very finely. Step 5: Put the chopped chicken meat in a bowl and mix with the chopped lemon grass, shredded lime leaf, roasted rice powder, cayenne, scallions, mint, red onion and cilantro. Step 6: Combine fish sauce, lime juice and palm sugar. Step 7: Pour over the chicken mixture and combine well. Step 8: Serve with cabbage leaves and garnished with extra mint To eat, pick up a cabbage leaf and "pinch" or roll up some chicken salad in it.

Ingredient Names: lemongrass, chicken breasts, egg white, carrot, chile, garlic chives, cilantro, sunflower oil, salt, pepper, lime slice
Instructions: Step 1: If using the long lemon grass stems, cut in half across the middle to make four short stems for a total of eight stems Coarsely chop chicken in a food processor and add egg white Process to make a smooth paste. Step 2: Add carrot, chile, chives, cilantro, salt and pepper and process to mix. Step 3: Place mixture in refrigerator to chill, about 15 minutes. Step 4: When chilled, divide mixture into eight equal portions. Step 5: Using your hands, shape the portions around the lemon grass stems The lemon grass stem will be the "skewer" for the chicken mixture. Step 6: Preheat broiler to medium hot, brush skewers with oil and broil approximately 4-6 minutes. Step 7: Turn them occasionally until golden brown and cooked thru.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, fresh lemongrass, fresh ginger, fresh jalapeno chilies, cabbage, mushrooms, carrots, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, garlic cloves, diced tomatoes, lemon juice, fish sauce, green onion, cooked rice, lemons
Instructions: Step 1: In an 1 to 10-quart pan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Meanwhile, pull off and discard course outer layers from lemon grass and trim off and discard stem ends. Step 3: Cut each stalk into about 3-inch lengths With the flat side of a knife, lightly crush lemon grass and ginger. Step 4: Cut one or two chilies in half lengthwise Stem remaining chilies, finely chop and reserve. Step 5: Add lemon grass, ginger, and halved chilies to boiling broth. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 30 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, rinse cabbage and cut into shreds about 1 / 4 inch wide and 2 to 3 inches long. Step 8: Rinse mushrooms, trim off and discard stem ends and discolored parts, and slice lengthwise 1 / 4 inch thick.

Ingredient Names: lemongrass, lime juice, chili paste, fish sauce, sugar, dried red chilies, water, minced chicken, oil, large shrimp, shredded coconut, cabbage, green beans, roasted peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lemongrass, lime juice, chilli paste, fish sauce, sugar and dried chilli in a small bowl to make a dressing and set aside. Step 2: Bring the water to the boil in a pot. Step 3: Add chicken and cook until chicken is cooked. Step 4: Drain and rinse chicken under cold water and drain again. Step 5: Heat a grill pan and spray with oil. Step 6: Cook shrimp until just cooked, about 2 minutes per side, set shrimp aside. Step 7: Spread coconut in a small pan and toast under a broiler until lightly browned, stir often as it burns easily. Step 8: In a large salad bowl combine the cabbage and beans with the coconut, peanuts, cilantro, onion, mint and lime leaves. Step 9: Add chicken and dressing and toss together well.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, chicken breast, salt, pepper, olive oil, red onion, lemongrass, serrano pepper, eggs, red bell pepper, lemons, fish sauce, tamarind paste, peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the chicken and stir-fry until brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes, set aside. Step 4: Return the wok to medium-high heat You should have a good bit of oil left If not, add a some more. Step 5: When the oil is hot, add the lemongrass, onion and serrano pepper. Step 6: Stir-fry until the onion is soft, about 1 minute Push the mixture to one side of the wok, then add the eggs to the other side.

Dish Name: Mango Chicken Lettuce Wraps With Crispy Noodles
Ingredient Names: vermicelli rice noodles, oil, iceberg lettuce, boneless chicken breasts, garlic cloves, white wine, cornstarch, soy sauce, snow peas, fresh mango, red pepper, fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, oyster sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To make the crispy noodles, pour at least 1 cup canola into a wok or small frying pan Warm the oil for at least 5 minutes over medium to medium-high heat The oil needs to be hot to make crispy noodles. Step 2: When you see bubbles rising from the bottom of the pan, try dipping in a few noodle strands If they begin to sizzle and expand, the oil is ready If nothing happens, your oil isn't hot enough yet. Step 3: When oil is ready, drop in small handfuls of noodles at a time Noodles should puff up almost immediately. Step 4: Using tongs, turn them so that both sides of the noodles cook and puff up Noodles turn very white and expansive when cooked- golden brown is okay too, but don't leave the noodles in the oil too long, or they will burn.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, teriyaki sauce, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, thai red curry paste, ground coriander, ground turmeric, ground cumin, dried chili, salt, pepper, chicken breasts, sweet green pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients listed under marinade. Step 2: Marinate chicken, covered, overnight in the refrigerator. Step 3: Preheat oven to 450f. Step 4: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Step 5: Remove chicken from marinade, discarding liquid, and cook on baking sheet for 4-6 minutes Skewer chicken with green pepper on toothpicks.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, potatoes, cashews, light coconut milk, curry paste, oil, sugar, soy sauce, tamarind juice, cilantro, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: Place a pot over medium high heat, add oil and curry paste. Step 2: Stir until the oil begins to separate out then add the coconut milk, chicken and potatoes. Step 3: Cook until chicken is done and potatoes are tender then add sugar, soy sauce, tamarind juice and toasted cashews. Step 4: Garnish with cilantro and avocado. Step 5: Serve with nan bread and rice if desired.

Ingredient Names: chicken, two thumb-size ginger, lemongrass rolling pin, limes, massaman curry paste, olive oil, baby new potatoes any larger ones, fl coconut milk, brown sugar any type, green beans, fish sauce, unsalted peanuts, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put the chicken in a roasting tin or large casserole. Roughly chop half the ginger and put into the cavity of the chicken with the lemongrass and half the lime, then tie the legs together with string. Mix 1 tsp of the curry paste with the oil, rub it all over the chicken, then season with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6, cover the chicken loosely with foil, then put it in to roast. After 35 mins, take the foil off the bird. Add the potatoes to the tin, then stir them around in any juices. Roast for another 40 mins until the chicken is cooked through and golden and the potatoes are tender. Step 2: Take the chicken out of the tin and leave to rest, loosely covered. Put the tin on the hob, add the remaining curry paste, grate in the remaining ginger, then fry for 2 mins until fragrant. Stir in the coconut milk and sugar, then boil for about 5 mins until the sauce is slightly thickened. Step 3: Tip in the beans, simmer for 4 more mins (or until tender), then splash in the fish sauce, any resting juices and squeeze over the remaining lime. Scatter with the peanuts for the authentic Massaman flavour. Carve the chicken and serve with the saucy potatoes and basmati rice.

Dish Name: Mee Krob Thai Crisp Fried Noodles
Ingredient Names: rice vermicelli, tamarind pulp, peanut oil, eggs, salt, garlic, green onions, red chile, boneless pork, shrimp, tamarind juice, fresh lime juice, palm sugar, thai fish sauce, lime zest
Instructions: Step 1: Gather all ingredients together before commencing to cook. Step 2: Cover tamarind pulp with 2 / 3 cup hot water, and crush and break up pulp with a fork. Step 3: Let stand for 20 minutes, then pour mixture through a strainer and press to extract the liquid Reserve 4 tablespoons of tamarind liquid for the sauce. Step 4: Place rice vermicelli inside a large paper or plastic bag, and break into pieces. Step 5: Heat peanut oil until very hot. Step 6: Fry noodles in small batches until they puff up and turn light to golden brown each batch will only take a few seconds. Step 7: Remove at once with a slotted spoon, or wire strainer, and drain immediately on paper towels Next, deep fry the diced tofu until golden brown, drain and keep warm in a low oven Lastly, drizzle the egg into the oil in a circular fashion, and cook for around 30 seconds until golden brown and crisp on both sides.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, chicken breasts, russet potatoes, light coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, cashew nuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat skillet over medium high heat, add olive oil. Step 2: Saute chicken in skillet until browned, approximately 5 minutes, remove chicken. Step 3: Add coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce and brown sugar, whisk to combine. Step 4: Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium low. Step 5: Add chicken and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add cubed potatoes and continue cooking until potatoes are firm but cooked through, approximately 5-7 minutes longer. Step 7: Remove from heat and sprinkle with cashews and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, ground coriander, limes, lemons, boneless skinless chicken breast, portabella mushrooms, thai fish sauce, cherry tomatoes, birds eye chiles, baby spinach, fresh basil, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Place the stock in a saucepan. Step 2: Add the ginger, garlic, coriander, lime zest and juice and bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the diced chicken, mushrooms and fish sauce. Step 4: Simmer slowly, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Step 5: Check and adjust seasoning. Step 6: Add the tomatoes and chiles and cook for 5 more minutes. Step 7: Stir in the baby spinach and cook 1 minute longer, discard ginger. Step 8: Serve, topped with shredded basil. Step 9: Garnish with fresh lime wedges in case you want to squeeze some into your soup.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, spanish onion, green pepper, red pepper, broccoli, basil, red chile, garlic, thai fish sauce, soya sauce, sugar, lime
Instructions: Step 1: In a mortar and pestle add: red chilli, garlic, 1 cup of basil and the sugar Pound until you get a nice smooth paste. Step 2: Add fish sauce, soya and lime juice, stir. Step 3: Taste and adjust I like mine kind of sweet with lots of basil flavour. Step 4: Heat wok, add chicken, stir fry on high. Step 5: Add broccoli and toss for a minute. Step 6: Add onion and peppers, toss for about 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Nat's Version Of Crock Pot Easy Pad Thai
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, salsa, peanut butter, lime, soya sauce, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, coconut milk, mushrooms, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, snow peas, bean sprouts, peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat crock to med. Step 2: Cut chicken into chunks. Step 3: Heat frying pan on high Sear chicken, throw into crock pot. Step 4: In a bowl mix: Salsa, peanut butter, soya sauce, ginger, garlic, juice and zest of 1 lime, 2 tbsp of fresh chopped cilantro, and coconut milk. Step 5: Pour over chicken Salt and pepper to taste, put lid on crock. Step 6: After 2 hours cooking, if not turn crock up a bit.

Dish Name: Noodle Salad With Poached Chicken And Peanut Lime Dressing
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, ginger, garlic cloves, cilantro leaves and stems, lemongrass, salt & freshly ground black pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, lime juice, rice vinegar, fish sauce, brown sugar, peanut butter, rice noodles, carrots, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: For the poached chicken: Fill a large, deep pan with water and add the soy sauce, ginger, garlic, cilantro, lemongrass, salt and pepper and bring to a rolling simmer over medium heat. Step 2: Add the chicken breasts and bring the liquid back to a boil. Step 3: Cook for a few minutes, then remove from the heat, cover, and let stand for about 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Remove the chicken from the poaching liquid with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 5: Let cool and then shred with two forks (dont throw that liquid out! Step 6: Youve now got a beautiful broth cover and bring to a rolling boil for at least 5 minutes then strain and serve. Step 7: Add chicken or any veggies you like ) For the peanut-lime vinaigrette:.

Dish Name: Northern Thai Curry With Chicken And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: dried hot red chili peppers, cumin, turmeric powder, coriander seed, ground mace, galangal, lemongrass, salt, shallot, garlic cloves, shrimp paste, turmeric, fish sauce, palm sugar, chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chili peppers in a bowl. Step 2: Pour enough water over the chili peppers to cover. Step 3: Allow the peppers to soak until softened, about 10 minutes, drain. Step 4: Chop the peppers and set aside Grind the cumin, turmeric, coriander, and mace using a mortar and pestle into a fine powder. Step 5: Add the galangal, lemon grass, salt, shallot, garlic, shrimp paste, fresh turmeric, and reconstituted chile peppers and grind into a paste. Step 6: Stir the fish sauce and palm sugar into the paste. Step 7: Transfer to a large bowl. Step 8: Add the chicken to the paste and toss to coat the chicken evenly.

Dish Name: Our Favorite Chicken And Coconut Soup Thai Style
Ingredient Names: oil, lemongrass, fresh ginger, garlic, onion, thai red curry paste, tom kha paste, chicken stock, fish sauce, sugar, unsweetened coconut milk, red pepper flakes, asian chili sauce, boneless skinless chicken breast, fresh mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large stock pot add the lemon grass, ginger, garlic, and onion and stir fry for about one minute. Step 2: Add the curry paste and tom kha soup mix paste and stir fry for about 30 seconds. Step 3: Add the chicken stock, fish sauce, and sugar and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes. Step 5: Slice the baby corn vertically into four pieces so that the corn resembles small strips. Step 6: Add the corn to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 7: Add the coconut milk, chicken, mushrooms, tomato, lime juice, hot sauce, and pepper flakes. Step 8: Simmer until the chicken is no longer pink, about 5 to 10 minutes. Step 9: Taste the soup and add more sugar, lime juice, or hot sauce, depending on your taste I usually add one more tbs of sugar.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, mini chicken fillet, thai green curry paste, basmati wild rice mix, red peppers, juice lime, reduced-fat coconut milk, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Heat the oil in a shallow ovenproof casserole dish, then soften the onion for 5 mins. Add the chicken and curry paste, then cook for 3 mins, stirring to coat. Step 2: Tip in the rice and peppers, then stir in the lime zest and juice, coconut milk and 250ml boiling water. Bring to the boil, then pop the lid on and bake for 20 mins until the rice is fluffy. Scatter with coriander before serving.

Ingredient Names: thai chile, garlic, sugar, rice vinegar, black pepper, fish sauce, vegetable oil, ground pork, wide egg noodles, thai basil, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar and pepper in a small bowl Also combine the fish sauce and soy sauce in another bowl Have everything ready and next to the stove. Step 2: Heat a wok over high heat and add 2 tablespoons oil and heat until a piece of the chopped garlic sizzles immediately when dropped into the wok. Step 3: Add the rest of the garlic to the oil and stir fry for 30 seconds, until garlic is golden. Step 4: Add the chillies and stir fry another 30 seconds. Step 5: Then add either the pork or chicken and stir fry for 3-5 minutes until browned and cooked. Step 6: Add the sugar mixture and toss to mix, then the fish sauce mixture, also the vinegar and continue stir frying until the sauce bubbles and thickens a little, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add the rice noodles and fold gently and repeatedly until they soften and absorb the sauce, about 3-5 minutes, adding more oil if needed. Step 8: Add most of the basil and toss gently until it begins to wilt.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, red onion, green pepper, lime juice, hot chili sauce, sesame oil, cilantro, soy sauce, peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all your ingredients in a medium bowl until consistent in texture. Step 2: Heat a medium to large skillet over medium heat Spray with non-stick spray. Step 3: Divide the mixture into four and place each portion into the pan shaping with a spatula into a round burger that is no more than 1 / 2-3 / 4" thick If you prefer a thicker burger, increase the cooking time. Step 4: Cover with a lid and cook each side for approximately 7 minutes or until the juices run clear and the burgers reach 170 degrees. Step 5: Serve with mayo on a fresh round roll and enjoy.

Dish Name: Pad Thai Thai Stir Fried Noodles
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, shallot, eggs, black pepper, vegetable oil, brown sugar, oyster sauce, fish sauce, white vinegar, soy sauce, green onion, bean sprouts, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Boil noodles until just soft. Step 2: Drain water and place noodles in separate bowl. Step 3: Meanwhile, heat 3 tbsp oil in wok on high heat. Step 4: Add garlic, shallots, oyster sauce, chicken and stir-fry until cooked Move mixture to 1 / 2 of wok and add eggs on empty 1 / 2 of wok, cook eggs. Step 5: Mix eggs and chicken. Step 6: Add noodles, fish sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, black pepper and brown sugar, stirring quickly so that noodles do not stick together. Step 7: Stir in bean sprouts, green onion and peanuts. Step 8: Garnish with fresh cilantro and a quick squeeze of lime juice.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, vegetable oil, garlic, yellow onion, chicken breasts, red chilies, sugar, fish sauce, salt, lime juice, ketchup, black pepper, fresh bean sprout, green onions, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a pot of boiling water, drop int he rice noodles for about 1 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Step 2: Remove fom heat and drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large wok and stir-fry the garlic and onion until golden brown. Step 4: Add the chicken and chilis. Step 5: Stir-fry for 5 minutes and add the sugar, fish sauce, salt, lime juice, ketchup, black pepper, noodles and bean sprouts. Step 6: Stir well for 2 minutes. Step 7: Transfer to a large serving platter and garnish with green onion and crushed peanuts.

Dish Name: Pad Thai With Chicken And Shrimp
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, fish sauce, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, peanut oil, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breast, fresh shrimp, red pepper flakes, eggs, bean sprouts, green onions, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in large bowl and cover with boiling water for about 10 minutes, drain, set aside. Step 2: Mix together fish sauce, ketchup, worcestershire, chili-garlic sauce and sugar, set aside. Step 3: Cut chicken into 1" cubes Peel and de-vein raw shrimp and chop coarsely Finely chop garlic. Step 4: Heat peanut oil in large frying pan or wok. Step 5: Add garlic, chicken, shrimp and red pepper flakes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, pineapple, zucchini, carrots, onion, fish sauce, oyster sauce, tomato sauce, sugar, garlic, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pour oil in a wok, add garlic and heat until it turns golden. Step 2: Add chicken, stir until cooked through. Step 3: Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar, stir constantly. Step 4: Add tomato sauce, veggies and pineapple. Step 5: Cook until veggies are al dente. Step 6: Serve with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Panang Curry Barbecue Chicken With Lemon Grass
Ingredient Names: chicken quarters, lemongrass, garlic cloves, red curry paste, olive oil, fresh lime juice, splenda granular, kosher salt, unsweetened coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken quarters in a large zip-top freezer bag Process lemon grass, garlic, red curry paste, olive oil, lime juice, splenda granular and salt in a food processor until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides. Step 2: Add coconut milk and pulse until blended. Step 3: Pour over chicken Seal bag and chill 4 to 6 hours, turning occasionally. Step 4: Remove chicken from marinade, discarding marinade. Step 5: Grill over indirect heat for 40-60 minutes or until done.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, canned pineapple, cucumbers, tomatoes, baby corn, spring onion, onion, fish sauce, oyster sauce, tomato sauce, sugar, garlic, cooking oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken, vegetables, and pineapple into mouth sized pieces. Step 2: Pour oil in a work, fry garlic until it becomes golden color. Step 3: Add sliced chicken and stir, then add oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and stir contantly. Step 4: Pour pineapple, cucumber, tomatoes, large onion and baby corn in the wok then add tomato sauce. Step 5: Stir until fresh vegetable are all dente, add spring onion Flavour to taste and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, chicken thighs, creamy peanut butter, light soy sauce, honey, lemon zest, fresh lemon juice, honey-roasted peanuts, panko breadcrumbs, garlic cloves, salt, ground red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken legs and thighs in a gallon-size zip-top plastic freezer bag Microwave peanut butter and next 4 ingredients in a microwave-safe bowl at high 1 to 2 minutes, stirring until smooth. Step 2: Spoon mixture over chicken in bag, and seal. Step 3: Using hands, work peanut butter mixture onto chicken until evenly coated. Step 4: Chill 30 minutes, turning occasionally. Step 5: Remove chicken from peanut butter mixture, discarding mixture Process peanuts and next 4 ingredients in a food processor until peanuts are finely ground. Step 6: Place crumbs in a large zip-top plastic freezer bag. Step 7: Add chicken, and seal Shake to coat.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, sweet onion, scallions, garlic, creamy peanut butter, brown sugar, fish sauce, paprika, ground cayenne pepper, coconut milk, limes, chicken breasts, spinach, red bell pepper, green bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onions, scallions, and garlic and cook until onion is tender. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and add peanut butter, brown sugar, fish sauce, paprika, juice of limes, and cayenne pepper. Step 4: Stir into a smooth sauce, then add coconut milk in 4 parts, stirring into a smooth sauce again. Step 5: Heat sauce to boiling, then reduce heat to low and allow to simmer stirring occasionally. Step 6: In a large pot, heat enough water to completely submerge chicken to boiling While water is heating, trim chicken of fat and slice into 1 / 2 inch wide by 2 inch long pieces. Step 7: Add chicken to boiling water and allow to cook just long enough to completely cook chicken. Step 8: Remove chicken from water and add to peanut sauce, also adding steamed spinach and bell pepper. Step 9: Mix thoroughly, and increase heat to medium.

Ingredient Names: chicken parts, canola oil, diced tomatoes, chunky peanut butter, garlic, gingerroot, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, cook chicken through until no longer pink This will probably take 30 to 40 minutes depending on size of chicken parts. Step 2: Remove chicken from pan. Step 3: Set aside In the same skillet, add the remaining ingredients. Step 4: Stir and simmer 3 minutes. Step 5: Return chicken to skillet. Step 6: Cook 2 minutes, turning chicken to heat through and cover with sauce. Step 7: Garnish with chopped peanuts and cilantro, if desired.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, red bell pepper, dry roasted peanuts, green onions, fresh cilantro, cooked jasmine rice, chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, fresh garlic, cayenne pepper, fresh ginger, cornstarch, smooth peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in a wok over medium heat. Step 2: Add in the chicken thighs. Step 3: Cook tossing with a wooden spoon until thoroughly cooked through. Step 4: Add in red bell pepper and continue to cook until crisp-tender For peanut sauce. Step 5: In a bowl mix together chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, cayenne pepper, ginger and cornstarch until smoooth, then mix in the peanut butter until well combined. Step 6: Season sauce with salt to taste then add to the wok along with the chopped green onions and continue to cook for 4-5 minutes stirring with a spoon over medium heat until slightly thickened. Step 7: Add / mix in peanuts. Step 8: Serve with cooked jasmine rice and garnish with chopped green onions.

Dish Name: Peanut Thai Chicken With Vermicelli Noodles
Ingredient Names: chunky peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, fresh lemon juice, brown sugar, garlic cloves, salt, cayenne pepper, chicken broth, vermicelli, peanut oil, scallions, boneless skinless chicken breasts, snow peas, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the peanut butter, 1 1 / 2 cups of the coconut milk, soy sauce, lemon juice, brown sugar, garlic, salt, and cayenne in a small saucepan over low heat. Step 2: Stir constantly and cook until thickened. Step 3: Blend or process to puree. Step 4: Add broth and remainin 1 / 4 cup of coconut milk and blend until smooth. Step 5: Cover and set aside. Step 6: Cook vermicelli, drain and rinse. Step 7: Toss with peanut oil and cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally Just before serving place pasta on individual plated. Step 8: Spoon over the sauce and sprinkle with scallions. Step 9: Slice chicken on the diagonal and re-assemble 1 / 2 breast on top of each serving.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, ready-cooked chicken breasts, red peppers, fresh bean sprouts, sweet chili sauce, light soy sauce, green onions, peanuts, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the rice noodles according to the pack instructions. Meanwhile, put the chicken and pepper in a microwave-proof dish and cover. Microwave on High for 2 mins, until piping hot. Step 2: Drain the rice noodles and tip into a bowl. Stir through the beansprouts. Whisk the chilli sauce and soy sauce together, then stir through the noodles, along with the chicken, pepper and spring onions. Scatter over the peanuts and coriander to serve.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, salt, pineapple salsa, red curry paste, oil, eggs, onion, garlic clove, boneless skinless chicken breasts, unsweetened coconut milk, fresh pineapple chunk, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In 2-quart saucepan, bring 2 cups water to a boil, add rice and salt. Step 2: Reduce heat to low. Step 3: Cover and simmer 18 minutes. Step 4: Chill in 1-quart covered bowl at least 2 hours until cold. Step 5: Whisk pineapple salsa and red curry paste together until smooth In nonstick 12-inch skillet, heat 1 teaspoon oil over medium heat. Step 6: Add eggs and scramble. Step 7: Remove from skillet and set aside In same skillet, heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil over medium heat.

Dish Name: Prawn And Chicken Stuffed Calamari Thai Style
Ingredient Names: calamari, prawns, minced chicken, garlic clove, fish sauce, frypowder, oil, red capsicum, vinegar, sugar, fresh chili peppers, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Calamari: Mix the prawn chicken and garlic together. Step 2: Stuff the calamari with the mixture until full, but taking care not to over-stuff as the calamari will expand when cooked Secure the open end of the calamari with toothpick / s. Step 3: In a steamer, steam the calamari for about 25- 30 minutes Use this opportunity to make sauce. Step 4: When the steaming is completed, roll the calamari tube in a shallow dish containing the fry powder. Step 5: Once coated, remove the calamari tube and add water to the fry powder to make a paste as per the packets instructions. Step 6: Heat oil is a wok so that it is just starting to smoke. Step 7: Add calamari tube and fry quickly on all sides the coating should be a light, crisp batter.

Dish Name: Quick And Easy Tom Kha Gai
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, red curry paste, kaffir lime leaves, fresh galangal root, fresh lemongrass, low-fat chicken broth, chicken breast, cornstarch, coconut milk, straw mushrooms, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: I leave them in all the way till serving and tell my guests to look for them and set them aside as they eat The recipezaar ingredient format makes it hard to enter how much galangal to use: i use a root-knob about twice the size of the ball of my thumb I use half of a 4-ounce tin of red curry paste for a pretty spicy-hot soup You can use 1 / 4 can for milder heat, but the recipe for tom kha gai on the maesri tin calls for the whole thing- wow that must be hot! Step 2: In a large stock pot, saute the curry paste, garlic, lemon grass, lime leaves and kha in the vegetable oil for two minutes. Step 3: Stir in chicken broth and bring to a boil While broth is heating, slice the chicken breast and toss it in cornstarch The amount of cornstarch doesn't need to be exact Just make sure the slices are evenly coated and shake off any excess. Step 4: Add chicken to boiling broth, stir gently, and bring back up to a simmer.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, green pepper, medium curry paste, new potatoes, frozen green pea, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep frying pan, brown chicken thighs in oil. Step 2: Remove chicken from pan& keep warm. Step 3: Saute onion and green pepper until soft. Step 4: Add garlic and saute 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in curry paste and cook 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add chicken, potatoes, peas and coconut milk. Step 7: Simmer 10 minutes or until curry sauce has thickened to desired consistency, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken thigh fillets, red curry paste, coconut milk, lemon juice, cooking spray
Instructions: Step 1: Thread chicken onto 8 skewers. Step 2: Whisk curry paste, coconut milk and juice in a large shallow dish. Step 3: Add skewers, turning to coat. Step 4: Cover with plastic food wrap, chill for 1 hour. Step 5: Heat a large frying pan over moderately high heat. Step 6: Drain skewers, reserving marinade Spray skewers with oil. Step 7: Cook and turn skewers for 2-3 minutes or until browned lightly. Step 8: Add reserved marinade.

Dish Name: Red Curry Chicken With Snake Beans Long Beans
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red curry paste, low sodium chicken broth, chicken breast, long beans, green peppercorns, kaffir lime leaves, shallots, palm sugar, fish sauce, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat As the oil is heating, add curry paste, and 1 cup of the broth, stirring until smooth Continue heating and stirring until the curry becomes fragrant and the wok has reached full heat, 1-2 minutes. Step 2: Add chicken and stir fry until just cooked through, about 4 minutes. Step 3: Add green beans, peppercorns, kaffir lime leaves, shallots, palm sugar, fish sauce and stir quickly to combine Continue cooking for 2 minutes If mixture becomes dry, add additional broth, cup at a time. Step 4: Add basil and cook just until basil begins to wilt, about 1 minute. Step 5: Remove from heat and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, yellow onion, garlic, cilantro, zucchini, red bell pepper, chicken breast, light coconut milk, chicken stock, red curry paste, fish oil, lime juice, honey, red pepper flakes, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in soup pot, add onions and cook until translucent, add garlic and red curry paste, saut for 2 minutes more. Step 2: Add chicken stock, coconut milk, red bell pepper, zucchini, cilantro and season with fish oil, lime juice, honey, red pepper flake, & salt & pepper, bring to boil. Step 3: Add chicken, bring back up to a boil, reduce heat and simmer covered for 25 minutes. Step 4: After 25 minutes remove chicken and shred, then return to soup, let it simmer for another 5 minutes then serve!

Ingredient Names: boneless, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, red pepper chunks, zucchini, red onions, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Fire up the barbecue or heat a griddle pan to high. Step 2: Tip chicken, curry paste and coconut milk into a bowl, then mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. Step 3: Thread vegetables and chicken onto skewers. Step 4: Cook the skewers on the barbecue or griddle for 5-8 mins, turning every so often, until the chicken is cooked through and charred. Step 5: Serve with herby rice, salad and a lime half to squeeze over.

Dish Name: Refreshing Ginger Chicken With Spinach Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: fish sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, olive oil, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced mushrooms, fresh ginger, brown sugar, habanero pepper, fresh spinach, cooked brown rice, green onions, carrot, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine first three ingredients and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok until hot. Step 3: Add the garlic and chicken, and stir-fry for 3 minutes or until chicken begins to change color. Step 4: Add the reserved sauce and cook until it beings to simmer, stirring constantly, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the mushrooms, ginger, brown sugar, and habanero pepper. Step 6: Simmer for 6 minutes. Step 7: Mix in spinach, then simmer for 2 more minutes or until spinach is wilted. Step 8: Serve over brown rice, and top with green onions, carrot, and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, vegetable oil, garlic powder, white button mushrooms, boneless skinless chicken breasts, sriracha sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, broccoli floret
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken Clean and slice mushrooms. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet on medium. Step 3: Place rice noodles into bowl & cover with very hot water. Step 4: Add garlic and mushrooms to skillet & cook until mushrooms are almost tender. Step 5: Add fish sauce and chicken to skillet. Step 6: Fry until chicken is done. Step 7: Add soy sauce, sriracha and brown sugar. Step 8: Stir until sugar is dissolved, add broccoli.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, orange juice, soy sauce, garlic cloves, sriracha sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the orange juice, soy sauce, garlic, sriracha, rice wine vinegar and sesame oil in a small bowl. Step 2: Place the chicken wings in a self-sealing freezer bag and add the marinade. Step 3: Press out all the air, seal and refrigerate for 6 to 24 hours, turning once or twice to ensure even flavor. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 450f line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick spray. Step 5: Arrange the chicken wings in a single layer, skin side down. Step 6: Discard the remaining marinade Roast the wings for 15 minutes, then turn skin side up Baste with any juices that may have accumulated in the pan and roast for an additional 10 to 15 minutes, until the skin is golden and crisp and the chicken is cooked through. Step 7: Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, ground coriander, brown sugar, lime juice, vegetable oil, coconut milk, crunchy peanut butter, thai fish sauce, chili powder, ground black pepper, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into pieces, place in a bowl. Step 2: Blend all marinade ingredients, pour over chicken, stir. Step 3: Cover with cling film, marinate in fridge for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Remove chicken and grill under preheated grill for 8 to 10 minutes or until cooked, turning and brushing with marinade. Step 5: Meanwhile, make peanut sauce by blending peanut butter, fish sauce, lime juice, chilli powder, and sugar. Step 6: Pour into saucepan and cook gently for 5 minutes stirring occasionally, season to taste with pepper. Step 7: Add chicken and stir through. Step 8: Serve with rice, garnish with fresh coriander.

Ingredient Names: red curry paste, coconut milk, fresh basil, bamboo shoot, fish sauce, brown sugar, chicken stock, mushroom, red bell pepper, green pepper, yellow pepper, onion, chicken breasts, brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan combine 1 / 2 to tbsp red curry paste with one can of coconut milk. Step 2: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add 1 / 4 cup fresh basil, 1 / 4 cup bamboo shoots, 3 tsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 / 3 cup chicken stock, and 1 / 2 cup of your favorite mushrooms. Step 4: Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes While you are simmering -- saute the chopped peppers and chopped onion in a frying pan or wok lightly covered in olive oil. Step 5: Fry lightly peppered chicken breasts till cooked through. Step 6: Place sauteed peppers and onions on bowls of rice and spoon curry sauce over rice You can either use curry sauce to lightly flavor rice or more as a soupy type mixture I use short grain brown rice -- but any type is fine. Step 7: Add cut chicken breast or other meat / tofu if desired.

Dish Name: Shannon's Curry Chicken That Firefighter Hubby Loves
Ingredient Names: green curry paste, coconut milk, fresh basil, fish sauce, brown sugar, chicken stock, chicken breasts, frozen sweet peas, onion, garlic, green onions, jalapeno peppers, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan or pot, warm coconut milk over medium high heat for 1 minute. Step 2: Add in curry paste, using a whisk to completely dissolve curry paste. Step 3: Bring to a slight boil, then turn heat down and simmer 5 minutes. Step 4: Add basil, fish sauce, brown sugar, chicken stock, peas, onions, green onions, garlic, peppers and chicken. Step 5: Bring to a slight boil again by turning up the heat, then simmer over medium heat 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring often. Step 6: Serve with steaming jasmine rice. Step 7: Garnish with extra sliced green onion.

Ingredient Names: pasta, salt, green beans, olive oil, boneless chicken breast half, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red pepper, light coconut milk, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: 1 In large pot, cook pasta in boiling salted water as label directs. Step 2: When there is just 3-4 minutes left of cooking time, add green beans to pasta cooking water and continue cooking until pasta and beans are done 2. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until hot. Step 4: Add chicken and cook about 2 minutes until chicken just loses its pink color, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add ginger, garlic, crushed red pepper, and 3 / 4 tsp salt, stirring constantly, about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add in coconut milk and lime juice and bring to a boil. Step 7: Cook until chicken is no longer pink in the middle, just a minute or two 3.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, garlic cloves, purple onion, shrimp, oil, fish sauce, brown sugar, lime juice, tamarind paste, water, egg, bean sprouts, peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Deep rice noodles in warm water until soft but firm, drain a set aside, heat oil in a wok. Step 2: Add garlic and purple onion, stir fry 3 minutes. Step 3: Add shrimp or chicken, cook for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add noodles Pre-mix fish sauce, brown sugar, lime juice and tamarind concentrate with water, then pour it onto the noodles. Step 5: Cook until almost dry Slowly add the beaten egg. Step 6: Remove from the heat. Step 7: Top with cilantro, bean sprouts and peanuts.

Dish Name: Simple Thai Chicken And Noodle Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, green curry paste, low sodium chicken broth, light coconut milk, fish sauce, red bell pepper, udon noodles, boneless skinless chicken breast, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic and curry paste and cook, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken broth, coconut milk and fish sauce. Step 5: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add the bell pepper and noodles and simmer, uncovered, until the noodles are al dente, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the chicken and simmer until just cooked through, about 3 more minutes. Step 8: Stir in the lime juice and cilantro. Step 9: Add more cilantro and lime juice, if desired, for serving.

Dish Name: Slow Cooker Crock Pot Thai Chicken Curry
Ingredient Names: red curry paste, water, chicken bouillon, fish sauce, brown sugar, chicken breasts, red bell pepper, onion, ginger paste, lime juice, coconut milk, crushed red pepper flakes, sriracha sauce, thai basil, bamboo shoots
Instructions: Step 1: Add everything to crock pot except coconut milk and any fresh vegetables. Step 2: Stir well, ensuring chicken bouillon and sugar is dispersed. Step 3: Cook on high for 3 hours or until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Step 4: Add fresh vegetables and cook for an additional hour or until vegetables are done. Step 5: Add coconut milk and stir. Step 6: Heat until desired temperature or eat immediately. Step 7: Serve with white rice or coconut rice.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, thai red curry paste, lime peel, salt, pepper, coconut milk, smooth peanut butter, low sodium soy sauce, green beans, shallot, rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: In a gallon-size resealable plastic bag, combine chicken with red curry paste, lime peel, salt and pepper. Step 2: Refrigerate overnight. Step 3: In a 6- to 7-quart slow cooker bowl, combine coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, green beans, and shallot. Step 4: Place chicken in slow cooker bowl on top of vegetables. Step 5: Cover and cook for 5 hours on low setting or until chicken is cooked through. Step 6: Transfer chicken to a cutting board Pull meat from bones skim and discard fat from cooking liquid. Step 7: Stir 1 / 4 t Salt into cooking liquid if necessary. Step 8: Toss everything with rice noodles and serve.

Dish Name: Spiced chicken meatballs with noodles, basil & broth
Ingredient Names: onions, thumb-size ginger, long red chilies, garlic, white peppercorns, fresh coriander, milk, white breadcrumbs, chicken ground meat, vegetable oil, chicken stock, sesame oil, fish sauce, star anise, black peppercorns, green onions, fresh egg noodles, chilies, basil leaves picked
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz the onion, ginger, chillies, garlic, white pepper and half of the coriander stalks, roots (if using) and leaves in a food processor until finely chopped. Mix the milk and breadcrumbs together in a large bowl. Add the onion mix and chicken into the breadcrumbs, then season. Now, really mix – I mean mix – until the whole thing becomes a paste rather than lumpy. If you have a tabletop mixer, then use that instead of your hands. Shape into small balls around the size of a 50p piece. Place a large frying pan or casserole over a medium heat, add a drizzle of oil then fry the balls until well coloured – about 10 mins. You’ll need to do this in batches, adding more oil each time. Set aside. Step 2: For the broth, put the stock into a large saucepan, bring to the boil, then simmer. Add the sesame oil, fish sauce, ginger, remaining coriander stalks and roots, star anise and peppercorns. Simmer, covered, for 20 mins. Add the spring onions, noodles and chillies, if using. Take 6 large bowls, then divide the noodles between them – tongs are the best tool. Drop in the warm meatballs then ladle in the stock. Scatter with coriander and basil leaves then tuck in.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, jalapeno peppers, unsweetened coconut milk, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, fresh lime juice, oriental sesame oil, fresh ginger, honey, hot pepper sauce, red bell pepper, sliced mushrooms, green onion, boneless skinless chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 t oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and jalapeno. Step 3: Saute 3 minutes until tender but not brown. Step 4: Add coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, ginger, honey and hot pepper sauce. Step 5: Whisk until smooth and bring to a simmer, remove from heat. Step 6: Season with salt and pepper This sauce can be made well in advance, covered and refrigerated. Step 7: Heat remaining 1 t oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Step 8: Add bell pepper, mushrooms, and green onions.

Ingredient Names: dark sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken breasts, green onion, fresh cilantro, low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, sambal oelek, rice sticks, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 t Oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add ginger and garlic to pan. Step 3: Cook 45 seconds, stirring constantly. Step 4: Place in a large bowl. Step 5: Stir in remaining 1 t Oil, chicken, and next 6 ingredients. Step 6: Cook noodles according to package directions. Step 7: Drain and rinse under cold water, drain again.

Ingredient Names: chili oil, garlic cloves, hot chili peppers, chicken breast, white sugar, garlic salt, black pepper, oyster sauce, fresh mushrooms, onion, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, and cook the garlic and chili peppers until golden brown. Step 2: Mix in chicken and sugar, and season with garlic salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook until chicken is no longer pink, but not done. Step 4: Stir oyster sauce into the skillet. Step 5: Mix in mushrooms and onions, and continue cooking until onions are tender and chicken juices run clear. Step 6: Remove from heat, and mix in basil. Step 7: Let sit 2 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Spicy Chicken Soup With Hints Of Lemongrass And Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, fish sauce, sesame oil, cornflour, button mushrooms, chicken stock, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, onion, coconut milk, birds eye chiles, lime juice, sugar, salt, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place stock in a pot and add lemon grass, kaffir lime leaves, and onions. Step 2: Bring to boil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, chicken, lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and salt. Step 4: Cook slowly uncovered for 10 minutes then add coconut milk and chillies. Step 5: Bring to almost a boil, stirring frequently, then remove from heat and serve, garnishing with the coriander sprigs.

Dish Name: Spicy Chicken With Peppers And Basil
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, boneless skinless chicken breasts, canola oil, hot sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, onion, red bell peppers, garlic cloves, fish sauce, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Place rice on the stovetop to cook, according to package directions. Step 2: Cut chicken on an angle across the breast into thin strips. Step 3: Cut strips across into bite size pieces, set chicken aside. Step 4: Wash hands and cutting board. Step 5: When the rice is 6 or 7 minutes away from being done, begin your stir fry. Step 6: Heat a wok, wok shaped skillet, or large nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 7: When the pan smokes, add wok or light cooking oil. Step 8: Sprinkle in crushed pepper flakes. Step 9: Add chicken and stir fry 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, oil, garlic cloves, onion, ginger, red pepper, red chili peppers, chicken stock, spring onion, fish sauce, oyster sauce, light soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put oil into wok or frying pan. Step 2: When hot, add garlic and stir-fry until brown. Step 3: Add onion and chicken. Step 4: Stir-fry until chicken begins to turn white. Step 5: Add ginger and red pepper, combine well. Step 6: Add chilies and chicken stock / water, and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 7: Check chicken is white throughout, and then add spring onions. Step 8: Cook for 30 seconds, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, light vegetable oil, hot chili oil, chicken breasts, onion, red bell peppers, garlic cloves, coarse black pepper, tamari
Instructions: Step 1: Start rice according to package directions. Step 2: Heat oils in large non-stick skillet or wok over high heat. Step 3: Cut chicken into thin strips and chop into bite-sized pieces. Step 4: Add chicken and stir fry until golden, 2-3 minutes Push chicken off to sides of the skillet, and add onions and peppers to the center of the pan. Step 5: Stir-fry 2-3 minutes, then combine with meat. Step 6: Add the garlic and pepper, stir 1 minute, then add soy sauce Adjust seasonings to taste and wilt in basil. Step 7: Remove from heat and serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: curry, coconut milk, chicken broth, kaffir lime leaves, fresh basil, fresh cilantro, lemongrass, fish sauce, brown sugar, peanut oil, gingerroot, onion, garlic, red pepper, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: In a sauce pot simmer first 10 ingredients for 5 minutes. Step 2: In a frying pan heat 1 tablespoon oil and quickly saute ginger, garlic, onion, & red peppers till crisp, add to coconut milk mixture. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon oil and brown chicken slices, 2 minutes, add to coconut mixture. Step 4: Add the amount chili peppers to pot according to how hot you like your food! Step 5: Simmer for 5 more minutes Serve with cooked jasmin rice Topped with toasted pine nuts.

Ingredient Names: cilantro, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, ginger, salt, olive oil, lime juice, chicken breast, linguine
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, combine the cilantro, jalapeno pepper, garlic, ginger, salt oil, and lime juice Process to a smooth puree. Step 2: Transfer 1 / 4 cup of the puree to a shallow bowl, add hte chicken and toss Broil the chicken about 4 inches from heat, turning once, until just done About 8 minutes. Step 3: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes. Step 4: Cut into 1 / 4 in slices across the grain. Step 5: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the linguine until just done, about 12 minutes, drain. Step 6: Toss the pasta with the chicken and remaining cilantro puree.

Ingredient Names: cooked chicken breasts, red bell peppers, celery, red onion, cucumber, fresh cilantro leaves, italian salad mix, fresh lemon juice, fish sauce, sesame seeds, sugar, ground ginger, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare salad by combine salad ingredients in a bowl To prepare dressing, combine lemon juice and remaining dressing ingredients, stirring with a whisk. Step 2: Drizzle the dressing over salad and toss well.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, garlic, onion, basil, green onions, cilantro, fish sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, hoisin sauce, chili-garlic sauce, salt and pepper, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix fish sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, hoisin sauce and chili garlic sauce in a medium sized bowl. Step 2: Add chicken, sliced thinly and marinate 5 minutes while you chop the veggies. Step 3: Heat peanut oil in large fry pan or even better, a wok. Step 4: Add garlic, stir fry until golden, then add onion, and fry another minute. Step 5: Add chicken and the marinade, and stir fry until no longer pink--about 5-7 minutes. Step 6: Add remaining vegetables, except basil, and stir fry about 2-3 minutes, until color pops. Step 7: Add basil and cook about 1 more minute, until basil wilts. Step 8: Serve over steamed white rice I sometimes add red pepper, spinach, bean sprouts, water chestnuts, whatever i have on hand.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, sesame oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, serrano peppers, red bell pepper, soy sauce, water, brown sugar, fresh basil leaf, green onions, chicken breast
Instructions: Step 1: Saute garlic, ginger and peppers in canola and sesame oils in a large wok or skillet for about 1 minute Increase heat to high and add chicken. Step 2: Stir-fry until chicken is browned, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in soy sauce, water and brown sugar. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium and cook for 5 more minutes or until chicken is completely cooked through. Step 5: Add in basil and scallions, serve!

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red curry paste, sambal oelek, chicken breasts, coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, creamy peanut butter, cooked jasmine rice, peanuts, lime
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saute pan saute peanut oil, red curry and sambal over med. Step 2: Heat for a few minutes. Step 3: Add the chicken and cook through. Step 4: Add coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar and peanut butter. Step 5: Simmer about 10 minutes. Step 6: Serve over steamed jasmine rice. Step 7: Top with fresh lime juice and crushed peanuts Try it after everything has been added and if it's not spicy enough you can then add more curry If then you want it more spicy you can add more sambal, the sambal is more spicy than the curry.

Dish Name: Spicy Thai Peanut Sauce With Chicken And Rice Noodles
Ingredient Names: creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, ground ginger, garlic, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, hot chili oil, honey, chicken breasts, broccoli, green onions, carrots, thai rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: combine peanut butter, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, oils, vinegar and honey in sauce pan. Step 2: Simmer, covered, on low heat for 5-10 minutes or until hot, stirring occasionally Chicken: cut and saut chicken breasts over olive oil, adding vegetables when chicken is almost finished cooking. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste Noodles: cook rice noodles in water with salt, according to package instructions. Step 4: Serve chicken / vegetables over noodles with sauce poured generously on top.

Dish Name: Sticky Coconut Chicken With Chili Glaze And Coconut Rice
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, coconut milk, fresh ginger, fresh ground black pepper, hot chili flakes, green onions, rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, light coconut milk, water, garlic cloves, salt, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: For chicken: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Step 2: In a large bowl, mix coconut milk, ginger, pepper, and hot chili flakes. Step 3: Add chicken and mix. Step 4: Cover airtight and chill at least 1 hour or up to 1 day. Step 5: Prepare glaze Lift chicken from bowl, reserving marinade Pull thighs open and lay flat on a lightly oiled barbecue grill over a solid bed of hot coals or high heat on a gas grill Close lid on gas grill. Step 6: Cook, turning thighs as needed to brown on both sides, until meat is no longer pink in center of thickest part, 10 to 12 minutes, basting frequently with remaining marinade until 2 minutes before chicken is done.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Chicken With Lemon Capers And Basil
Ingredient Names: olive oil, red onion, butter, skinless chicken breasts, fresh lemon rind, capers, lemon juice, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok until hot, add half the oil and swirl to coat. Step 2: Add the onion and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until softened. Step 3: Remove from the wok and set aside Reheat the wok, add another teaspoon of oil and half the butter, and stir-fry the chicken in two batches for 3-5 minutes each batch, or until browned, adding the remaining oil and butter between batches. Step 4: Return all the chicken to the wok with the onion. Step 5: Stir in the rind, capers and lemon juice. Step 6: Toss well and cook until heated through. Step 7: Add the basil and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, red curry paste, shrimp, fish sauce, brown sugar, garlic, onion, bell pepper, chile, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, heat oil on medium low, saute onion, peppers, garlic. Step 2: Add curry paste, stir well. Step 3: Add shrimp stirring. Step 4: Add fish sauce and sugar. Step 5: Cover and cook for 3 minutes then add basil leaves remove from stove, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, vermicelli rice noodles, dried wood ear mushrooms, ground pork, onion, carrot, egg, fish sauce, salt and pepper, cornflour
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200c De-bone the chicken wings by cutting around the bone with a sharp knife Holding the wing. Step 2: Soak the vermicelli in warm water for 10 minutes then drain thoroughly and cut into short strands. Step 3: Soak the wood ear fungus in boiling water for 10 minutes then squeeze dry and chop into thin slices. Step 4: Mix all other stuffing ingredients together The mixture should be firm Mold the stuffing into a ball and insert it into the bag of flesh and skin of the chicken wing. Step 5: Steam the stuffed wings for 10-15 minutes. Step 6: After steaming, place in a lightly oiled roasting pan and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fryer chickens, oyster sauce, garlic, black pepper, soy sauce, sugar, sea salt, lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly wash the chicken and pat dry with a paper towel. Step 2: Combine oyster sauce, garlic, black pepper, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and lemon grass in a bowl. Step 3: Mix ingredients together thoroughly and apply as a marinade to the chicken. Step 4: Refrigerate for at least 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Grill over charcoal at medium-high heat for 30-40 minutes, turning occasionally to prevent burning. Step 6: Remove from grill and serve with chili sauce for chicken.

Dish Name: Super Quick Thai Flavoured Stir Fried Chicken
Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillets, oil, garlic cloves, spring onions, soy sauce, white vinegar, chili powder, sugar, chicken stock, cornflour, thai sweet chili sauce, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken fillets into thin strips. Step 2: Mix chicken with oil, garlic, spring onions, soy sauce, vinegar, chili powder and chili sauce and sugar. Step 3: Using a high heat, fry chicken mixture in a large frypan until chicken is well cooked through, stirring all the time The mixture will reduce slightly as the chicken cooks. Step 4: Mix cornflour with the chicken stock in a small cup, so there are no lumps. Step 5: Add cornflour mixture to the chicken mixture and cook on high until mixture reduces by half. Step 6: Toss in the coriander. Step 7: Serve on rice or noodles with a salad I often omit the chili sauce if serving to young children and it tastes a little bit more bland but great all the same This cooks so fast that i cut up the chicken, put it in the fridge, have everything else ready in the frypan and the cornflour and coriander ready to go and just fling everything together at the very last moment.

Dish Name: Sweet And Sour Sticky Thai Boneless Oven Baked Chicken Wings
Ingredient Names: chicken tenderloins, buttermilk, panko breadcrumbs, whole wheat flour, thai sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, dark brown sugar, peanut butter, tomato paste, apple juice, rice vinegar, lime, fish sauce, garlic, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 475f line a baking sheet with foil and spray or brush it with the olive oil. Step 2: Add the chicken to a large bowl and pour the buttermilk overtop. Step 3: Mix well and set aside. Step 4: In a shallow pie dish or large bowl add the panko, whole wheat flour and a pinch of salt and pepper, mix well. Step 5: Remove each piece of chicken from the buttermilk, and dredge through the crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. Step 6: Place on the prepared baking sheet. Step 7: Repeat until all the chicken has been used. Step 8: Make sure not to crowd your pan, if necessary use two baking sheets Spray each chicken "wing" with non-stick spray or a mist of olive oil.

Dish Name: Sweet Chili Chicken With Asian Vegetable Rice
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, seasoned rice vinegar, fresh cilantro, minced ginger, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breasts, thai sweet chili sauce, jasmine rice, carrot, sugar snap pea, red bell pepper, black sesame seeds, salt, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a large sealable plastic bag, combine the soy sauce, vinegar, cilantro, ginger and garlic. Step 2: Add chicken and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours. Step 3: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Step 4: Line a baking sheet with foil Spray foil with nonstick spray. Step 5: Remove chicken from marinade and drain, discard marinade. Step 6: Place sweet chili sauce in a large bowl add chicken and toss to coat. Step 7: Place chicken on baking sheet and bake 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Step 8: Meanwhile, cook rice according to package directions, omitting butter or margarine.

Dish Name: Tamarind Chicken With Bean Sprouts Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: tamarind paste, water, soy sauce, brown sugar, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breast, mushrooms, onion, garlic cloves, bean sprouts, habanero pepper, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine first four ingredients, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Step 3: Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the mushrooms, onion, and garlic. Step 5: Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add the sauce, and stir until it just begins to simmer. Step 7: Remove from heat, then stir in bean sprouts and habanero pepper. Step 8: Serve over brown rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, green curry paste, peanut oil, coconut milk, thai sweet chili sauce, fish sauce, salt, peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine curry paste and oil in a bowl. Step 2: Stir until paste is softened. Step 3: Mix in 3 / 4 of the coconut milk and taste the mixture If it tastes bland, add more curry paste and salt, until it is pleasantly pungent If too spicy, add a little more coconut milk. Step 4: Place chicken into a plastic zip lock bag, pour in marinade and seal. Step 5: Toss to coat evenly. Step 6: Allow to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes For a more intense flavor, marinate for several hours in refrigerator. Step 7: Drain and discard the marinade.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, wide rice noodles, eggs, green onions, fresh bean sprouts, garlic cloves, rice wine, vegetable oil, fish sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, chili-garlic sauce, unsalted dry roasted peanuts, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into 1 / 2 inch cubes and marinate in the 2 teaspoons of wine for 10 minutes. Step 2: Prepare rice noodles according to package Mince the garlic Lightly beat the eggs. Step 3: Cut the green onions into 2 inch lengths. Step 4: Rinse the bean sprouts, chop the peanuts. Step 5: Cut the lime into wedges. Step 6: Place a stir-fry pan or wok over high heat until hot. Step 7: Add vegetable oil and swirl it around the sides of the pan.

Ingredient Names: fettuccine pasta, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, red pepper, snow peas, carrot, low-fat chicken broth, reduced-fat peanut butter, fresh cilantro, fresh basil, sugar, gingerroot, lemon zest, sesame oil, cornstarch, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all sauce ingredients in a blender and whirl until smooth, set aside. Step 2: Cook fettucine according to package directions. Step 3: Drain well and keep warm While pasta is cooking, spray a large work or skillet with non-stick spray and place over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and cook until no longer pink. Step 5: Add red pepper, snow peas and carrots. Step 6: Cook and stir for three more minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp, add sauce. Step 7: Cook until bubbly and thickened.

Dish Name: Thai Barbecue Chicken W Spicy Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: black peppercorns, garlic cloves, salt, coriander seed, thai fish sauce, boneless chicken breasts, rice vinegar, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes
