Instructions: Step 1: To make the sauce, bring vinegar to a boil in small non-reactive sauce pan. Step 2: Add sugar and stir till dissolved. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and let simmer 5 minutes. Step 4: Add 2 cloves garlic and crushed red peppers. Step 5: Cool to room temperature and pour into glass jar Leftovers will keep in the fridge for a couple weeks To make the meat, combine peppercorns, 5 cloves garlic, coriander seed, and fish sauce in mini food processor Whir till a lumpish paste forms. Step 6: Spread paste over chicken and cover. Step 7: Marinate in the refrigerator for several hours.

Dish Name: Thai Barbecue Chicken With Sweet Hot Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken parts, fresh coarse ground black pepper, cilantro, garlic cloves, fish sauce, light coconut milk, cider vinegar, sugar, salt, sambal oelek
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together all the marinade ingredients. Step 2: Add chicken and toss to coat. Step 3: Marinate at room temp 45 minutes or overnight, chilled. Step 4: Bring vinegar to a boil in a non-reactive pan. Step 5: Add sugar and simmer 5 minutes, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Step 6: Add the garlic, salt, and sambal and remove from heat. Step 7: Cool before serving. Step 8: Remove chicken from marinade and discard the marinade. Step 9: Grill or broil 7-10 minutes on each side, until juices run clear. Step 10: Serve with sticky rice and dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, chicken breasts, ground turmeric, cilantro, white pepper, garlic cloves, salt, tamarind juice, fish sauce, light coconut milk, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Place cilantro, garlic, fish sauce, turmeric, pepper, red pepper flakes and salt in food processor or blender, blend 45 seconds. Step 2: Add tamarind nectar and blend 1 more minute. Step 3: Add coconut milk and blend 1 minute Pierce chicken with fork to also mariade to seep. Step 4: Arrange chicken in bowl in single layer or in a resealable bag and pour marinade over, making sure it goes under skin. Step 5: Cover, refrigerate and marinate at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 6: Remove chicken from marinade and place in single layer in baking dish. Step 7: Brush with marinade. Step 8: Pour remaining marinade in small oven-proof container and place both chicken and marinade in 350 degrees.

Ingredient Names: bok choy, onion, red bell pepper, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, garlic, red pepper flakes, basil, peanut oil, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, chili paste, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok. Step 2: Stir-fry onions, peppers, and white part of bok-choy until crisp tender. Step 3: Remove and keep warm. Step 4: Add oil to wok if needed and stir-fry chicken, garlic, and pepper flakes until chicken is done. Step 5: Add sauces in order, stirring between each addition to coat. Step 6: Add cooked vegetables back and stir to coat. Step 7: Add green part of bok choy and basil, stirring just unti hot-crisp, and beginning to wilt. Step 8: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red curry paste, fish sauce, curry powder, garlic powder, onion powder, ginger, black pepper, chicken pieces
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all marinade ingredients Add chicken Refrigerate 4 hours to overnight Grill over medium to hot coals 15-20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, raw cashews, garlic, onions, chicken thighs, green onions, red cayenne pepper, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, fish sauce, white sugar, water, red chile, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: Mix all the Sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Step 2: Cook cashews: Heat oil over medium heat in a wok or large skillet. Add cashews and cook for 5 minutes until they become a dark golden colour and crunchy (yep, you might have to eat one to check!). Remove from skillet with a slotted spoon. Step 3: Garlic & onion: Turn heat up to high. Add garlic and onion. Cook for 30 seconds. Step 4: Chicken: Add chicken. Cook for 1 minute until the outside changes from pink to white. Step 5: White part of green onion & chilli: Add white part of green onions and chilli. Cook for 1 minute until chicken is just cooked through. Step 6: Add Sauce: Cook for 1 minute until it reduces down to a syrup, coating the chicken nicely. Step 7: Green onion & cashews: Add green part of green onions and cashews. Toss for 30 seconds. Step 8: Serve: Transfer to serving dish. Serve with jasmine rice, or other rice of choice, garnished with extra red chilli (if you can handle the heat!).

Dish Name: Thai Casserole Chicken With Peas And Browned Potatoes
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, boneless skinless chicken thighs, potatoes, onion, garlic cloves, green curry paste, brown sugar, fresh ginger, lime juice, fish sauce, light coconut milk, coconut milk, dried cilantro, frozen peas
Instructions: Step 1: On medium high, heat 1 / 2 taplespoon oil in a non stick fry pan - a stove top wok works really well for this - and quickly brown chicken thighs until golden and caramelized. Step 2: Remove them to a sprayed casserole In the same pan heat another 1 / 2 tablespoon oil and brown the diced potatoes until golden and caramelized - they do not have to be cooked through the important thing is that they are nicely browned. Step 3: Add them to the casserole Again - in the same pan - heat the remaining one half tablespoon of oil and caramelize the onion and garlic. Step 4: Lower the heat and add the curry paste, brown sugar, ginger, lime juice and fish sauce. Step 5: Stir in the coconut milk and cilantro. Step 6: Pour over the chicken and potatoes, cover with the lid and bake in a 300 degree f preheated oven for one hour. Step 7: Check and stir after first 30 minutes. Step 8: Remove casserole from oven and stir in the frozen peas - do not cook further, the peas will be nice and tender crisp.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken thighs, hot salsa, hot sauce, peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, fresh gingerroot, peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in crock pot. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients except peanuts and cilantro, pour over chicken. Step 3: Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 to 9 hours or until juice of chicken is no longer pink in the thickest places My crock pot usually does the job in about 6 hours. Step 4: Remove chicken from pot and using a slotted spoon, place on serving platter. Step 5: Remove fat from sauce. Step 6: Pour remaining sauce over chicken. Step 7: Sprinkle with peanuts and cilantro.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Broccoli Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, peanut oil, garlic, thai red chili peppers, fresh lemongrass, broccoli florets, sambal oelek, fish sauce, peanut butter, galanga powder, lime, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp oil in wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, lemongrass, and chiles, heating until they become fragrant, then add chicken to wok. Step 3: Stir-fry chicken 3-4 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Remove from pan and set aside. Step 5: Add another 1 / 2 tbsp oil to wok if needed. Step 6: Allow to heat and add broccoli florets, stir-frying for about 3-4 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender. Step 7: Return chicken to pan with broccoli and stir well. Step 8: Stir together peanut butter with chile sauce, galanga powder, and the juice of the half of lime until smooth. Step 9: Add to pan along with the fish sauce and blend well. Step 10: Add chopped basil right at the end, stir well and serve.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Broccoli With Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: spaghetti, cooked chicken, lime juice, curry powder, ground ginger, garlic, canola oil, broccoli, all-purpose flour, fat-free evaporated milk, low-fat vanilla yogurt, peanut butter, soy sauce, ground red pepper, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and drain spaghetti according to package directions, set aside. Step 2: Toss chicken, lime juice, curry powder, ginger, and garlic. Step 3: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cook chicken mixture and broccoli in oil 5-7 minutes. Step 5: Remove mixture from skillet, keep warm. Step 6: Mix flour, yogurt, peanut butter, soy sauce and red pepper in the same skillet. Step 7: Cook over medium heat 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture begins to thicken. Step 8: Toss spaghetti and sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Coconut Soup Cooking Light
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, lime rind, fresh lime juice, fresh lemongrass, thai fish sauce, fresh ginger, thai chile, chicken breast, light coconut milk, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Step 3: Stir in chicken and coconut milk. Step 4: Cook 3 minutes or until chicken is done. Step 5: Sprinkle with cilantro.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Coconut Soup Tom Kha Kai
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass, ginger, hot green chili peppers, coriander, chicken breasts, coconut milk, lime juice, palm sugar, fish sauce, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the chicken stock into a wok over a high heat. Step 2: Add the kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass, ginger, chillies, coriander stems and roots. Step 3: Bring to the boil and reduce the heat to a simmer for 10-15 minutes pressing the solids with a wooden spoon to release the flavour until reduced by half. Step 4: Add coconut milk and simmer gently for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken and stir for 30 seconds until chicken is just cooked. Step 6: Stir through the lime juice, sugar and fish sauce. Step 7: Serve immediately sprinkled with coriander leaves.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Eggplant Aubergine Curry
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, green curry paste, boneless skinless chicken breast, japanese eggplant, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, brown sugar, sweet basil, hot chili pepper, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat coconut milk in wok and whisk curry paste in until smooth. Step 2: Bring coconut milk to a boil, add chicken, then simmer for 8-10 minutes until chicken is opaque. Step 3: Add eggplant, lime leaves, fish sauce, brown sugar. Step 4: Taste for sweetness, saltiness etc, and correct if needed Continue to simmer until eggplant is tender and chicken is cooked through, about 8-10 minutes more. Step 5: Stir in basil leaves and chilies and serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, salad oil, sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, linguine, nectarines, bok choy, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a screw-top jar combine broth, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, salad or olive oil, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, cover Shake well. Step 2: Rinse chicken, pat dry. Step 3: In a large skillet cook chicken in a small amount of boiling water, covered, for 12 to 15 minutes or until no longer pink, drain. Step 4: Cool slightly and cut into cubes. Step 5: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 6: In a bowl toss pasta with 3 tablespoons of the dressing.

Ingredient Names: green onions, carrot, zucchini, boneless skinless chicken thighs, salad oil, gingerroot, linguine, salt, soy sauce, creamy peanut butter, chili sauce, seasoned rice vinegar, coconut extract, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice green onions. Step 2: Cut the carrot and zucchini into pencil-thin strips. Step 3: Cut each chicken thigh into 6 pieces In nonstick 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, cook half the chicken thighs at a time until golden brown With a slotted spoon, remove the chicken thighs to a plate as they brown In the same skillet in hot salad oil, cook the gingerroot and carrots until the carrots are lightly browned. Step 4: Stir in the zucchini and green onions and continue cooking until the vegetables are tender. Step 5: Remove the vegetable mixture to a small bowl and keep warm. Step 6: In a saucepan, prepare the linguine as itslabel directs, using 1 tablespoon salt in the water, then drain. Step 7: Meanwhile, in the same skillet, stir the soy sauce, peanut butter, chili sauce, rice vinegar, coconut extract, and 1 1 / 4 cups water until well blended.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Rice Soup Kao Tom Gai
Ingredient Names: short-grain rice, water, salt, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh lime juice, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, white pepper, green onion, celery leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium size pot over low heat, simmer rice, water and salt for about an hour or so until rice is soft. Step 2: Marinate chicken in lime juice / salt for about 5 minutes. Step 3: In a skillet, heat oil and saute onion and garlic until tender. Step 4: Add white pepper and marinated chicken. Step 5: Cook, stirring for 10 minutes or so In small bowls, put 1 cup of heated rice broth and sprinkle with chicken, chopped green onion, celery leaves, and cilantro, serve.

Ingredient Names: string beans, jalapeno peppers, garlic clove, coconut, green curry paste, brown sugar, fish sauce, lemongrass, boneless skinless chicken breast, basil, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Stream green beans in a steamer basket on stove in a microwave, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes, drain well. Step 2: Set aside Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Step 3: Add jalapeno and garlic. Step 4: Cook, stirring frequently, about 1 minute. Step 5: Add cup of coconut milk, curry paste, brown sugar, fish sauce and lemon grass, bring to a simmer. Step 6: Add chicken and reduce heat to medium-low. Step 7: Simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Step 8: Add string beans and basil.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken And Vegetable Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: lemongrass, fresh ginger, garlic, sunflower oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, scallions, carrots, green beans, oyster sauce, sugar, salt & freshly ground black pepper, salted peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice the lemon grass Peel and chop the ginger and garlic. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large wok style pan over high heat. Step 3: Add the lemon grass, ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds, or until brown. Step 4: Add the chicken and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 5: Then add the vegetables and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are almost cooked. Step 6: Finally stir in the oyster sauce, a pinch of sugar and seasoning to taste and stir-fry doe another minute for flavors to blend. Step 7: Serve immediately, sprinkled with the crushed peanuts and freshly chopped cilantro leaves on top accompanied with cooked rice or asian noodles Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halve, fresh lime juice, lime zest, gingerroot, green onions, italian salad dressing, crushed red pepper flakes, soy sauce, unsweetened coconut milk, chunky peanut butter, lime juice, rice wine vinegar, chicken broth, garlic cloves, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse chicken Pat dry with paper towels. Step 2: Slice chicken crosswise into 3-inch-wide strips, 1 / 4-inch to 3 / 8-inch thick. Step 3: Place in a shallow glass dish. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine the marinade ingredients. Step 5: Pour over the chicken and toss well to coat. Step 6: Cover and marinate in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, but no more than 2 hours. Step 7: Stir mixture occasionally. Step 8: Prepare grill for direct cooking. Step 9: Brush rack with vegetable or peanut oil.

Ingredient Names: minced chicken, fresh breadcrumb, sweet chili sauce, fresh coriander, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well Roll into balls Bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes- basically until they are cooked though and look cooked! Step 2: I line the tray with baking paper. Step 3: Serve with extra sweet chilli sauce for dipping I often add more breadcrumbs / coriander and chilli sauce-- just judge how wet / dry the mixture is.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, green onions, garlic, pearl barley, fresh cilantro, salt, black pepper, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, jalapeno peppers, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, water, rice vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, red curry paste
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 cup onions and 1 tablespoon garlic Saut 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in barley, 1 / 4 cup cilantro, salt, black pepper, 1 / 2 cup broth, and jalapeos, bring to a boil. Step 4: Cook 3 minutes or until liquid is nearly absorbed, stirring constantly. Step 5: Add remaining broth, 1 / 2 cup at a time, stirring constantly until each portion is absorbed before adding the next. Step 6: Combine juice and next 5 ingredients, set aside. Step 7: Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: linguine, nonstick cooking spray, boneless skinless chicken breast, garlic clove, broccoli florets, cold water, red bell pepper, green onions, peanut butter, hot water, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Step 2: Set aside Spray large nonstick skillet with cooknig spray. Step 3: Heat over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken and minced, garlic clove. Step 5: Stir-fry 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Step 6: Remove chicken from skillet, set aside. Step 7: Add broccoli and cold water to skillet.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic clove, fresh gingerroot, onion, fresh coriander, green chili, olive oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Toss the chicken, garlic, ginger, onion, coriander and chilli into a food processor and season well with salt and pep Blitz until the chicken is finely ground and everything is well mixed Use your hands to shape six small cakes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan, then fry the cakes over a medium heat for about 6-8 minutes, turning once. Step 3: Serve hot, with sweet chilli sauce, lime wedges, coriander, shredded spring onion and red chilli.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic cloves, dried red chili peppers, boneless skinless chicken breasts, onion, sugar, fish sauce, oyster sauce, green pepper, celery, chicken stock, cashews, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare all of your ingredients before starting this dish. Step 2: Once started, it goes fast, and you won't have time to chop the veggies or find the oyster sauce in the back of the fridge! Step 3: Start rice cooking, if necessary. Step 4: Using a wok, heat oil on a medium high heat Being careful not to burn the garlic or chili peppers, add combined with the chicken. Step 5: Stir-fry for two minutes, constantly stirring and flipping. Step 6: Add onion, stir-fry for another minute or two. Step 7: Turn heat down to medium. Step 8: Add sugar, fish sauce, and oyster sauce. Step 9: After another minute, add veggies and stock / water.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, hot salsa, peanut butter, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, gingerroot, peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in slow cooker. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients except chopped peanuts and cilantro, pour over chicken. Step 3: Cover and cook on low setting 8 to 9 hours. Step 4: Sprinkle with peanuts and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, hot water, coconut, thai red curry paste, boneless chicken breast, cooking onion, tomatoes, sweet potato, hot pepper, mango, fresh ginger, minced garlic cloves, ground cayenne pepper, raisins, water
Instructions: Step 1: Coconut milk recipe: The day before, make the coconut milk by placing the grated flesh of an entire coconut,, into a bowl, pour 2 cups of very hot water over the coconut. Step 2: Stir and let it cool. Step 3: After it is cool, use your hand to squeeze coconut in the water to extract all of the milk Do this for about five minutes. Step 4: Strain the entire mix thru cheesecloth, being careful to squeeze every bit of the milk out of the grated coconut. Step 5: Refrigerate the milk till next day Main recipe: First, parboil the sweet potato,, till al-dente. Step 6: In a wok, place the curry paste, and the coconut milk.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Curry With Dried Apricots
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, garlic, red bell pepper, thai red curry paste, fresh ginger, boneless skinless chicken breasts, unsweetened coconut milk, mango chutney, fresh cilantro, dried apricot, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a heavy skillet heat oil over medium heat. Step 2: Add in onions, garlic and red bell pepper. Step 3: Saute for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add in red curry paste and minced ginger. Step 5: Saute for about 1 minute longer. Step 6: Add in the cubed chicken breast and cook, stirring for 5 minutes. Step 7: Transfer the chicken to a bowl. Step 8: Add in 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk and dried apricots to skillet and boil until mixture is reduced to about 2-1 / 2 cups. Step 9: Add in mango chutney and half of the chopped fresh cilantro, mix to combine.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Enchiladas From Homesweeteats Com
Ingredient Names: flour tortillas, boneless skinless chicken breasts, canola oil, sweet onion, carrot, cabbage, garlic cloves, salt, pepper, green onions, peanuts, fresh cilantro, light coconut milk, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add canola oil Throw in onions, cabbage, carrots, garlic and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, stirring to mix. Step 3: Let cool until vegetables are soft, about 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Add in chicken, green onions, peanuts, cilantro, remaining salt and pepper, tossing to coat, and let cook for 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add in 3 / 4 cup coconut milk and 1 / 3 cup sweet chili sauce, mixing thoroughly to combine. Step 6: Turn off heat Spray a 913 baking dish with nonstick spray. Step 7: Whisk together remaining coconut milk and sweet chili sauce. Step 8: Pour about 1 / 2 a cup or so on the bottom of the dish.

Ingredient Names: picante sauce, peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, ground ginger, fettuccine, chicken, red bell peppers, orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything except fettuccine in skillet. Step 2: Heat until boiling. Step 3: Remove from heat and add fettuccine, stir well. Step 4: Cook time does not include fettuccine.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Fried Rice With Basil Kao Pad Krapao
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, thai red chili pepper, boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked rice, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, shallots, thai holy basil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large skillet, stir-fry garlic in oil until golden. Step 2: Then add chilies and chicken and stir-fry until chicken is cooked. Step 3: Add rice, sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce, and stir-fry, mixing gently. Step 4: When well mixed, add shallots, basil leaves and cilantro. Step 5: Cook another minute or so, and serve If you desire, serve with lime wedges, chile sauce, fish sauce, or soy sauce at the table.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, green curry paste, fresh lime leaves, thai basil, fresh green chilies, chicken, eggplant, mushroom, fish sauce, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Scoop the rich cream that has risen to the top of the coconut milk into a bowl. Step 2: Cook and stir four spoons of coconut cream in a heavy saucepan over medium heat until the coconut oil begins to separate. Step 3: Add lime leaves, fresh chilies and green curry paste to the coconut cream and cook until fragrant and well mixed. Step 4: Add chicken pieces and stir well to coat them with the paste Continue to cook to allow the flavors to penetrate the chicken but do not allow the paste to scorch. Step 5: Add coconut milk, the rest of the coconut cream, the fish sauce, the sugar and a pinch of salt. Step 6: Stir and bring the curry to a boil before reducing heat to a simmer and cooking uncovered for 15 minutes. Step 7: Cut vegetables into bite-sized pieces and start adding the ones which require the longest cooking, so that when you finish cooking the dish all the vegetables will be evenly cooked and look their best Correct the seasoning: taste the sauce and add sugar, fish sauce, chilies or salt to suit your taste. Step 8: Stir in the whole basil leaves, garnish and serve.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken In Peanut Sauce Dinner For Two
Ingredient Names: chicken tenderloins, olive oil, salt, minced garlic cloves, peanut butter, soy sauce, chili sauce, red pepper, rice vinegar, broccoli, bean sprouts, light coconut milk, boil-in-the-bag rice
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken in olive oil in skillet#1. Step 2: Add broccoli and garlic in skillet#1 Warm up peanut butter in microwave then spoon peanut butter, salt, soy, chili sauce, red pepper, and vinegar into skillet #2 Warm this mixture and add coconut milk to achieve desired taste and creaminess. Step 3: Once veggies and chicken are nearly finished cooking in skillet #1, add bean sprouts. Step 4: Add sauce from skillet #2 when bean sprouts are light brown. Step 5: Serve contents on a bed of white rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, fat-free chicken broth, fresh ginger, water chestnut, red onion, green onion, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, sugar, fish sauce, salt, bibb lettuce, peanuts, serrano chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken in food processor Pulse until coarsely ground. Step 2: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add chicken, broth and ginger to pan. Step 4: Cook 8 minutes or until chicken is done. Step 5: Drain well, transfer to a large bowl. Step 6: Add water chestnuts, red onion, green onions, cilantro, lime juice, sugar / splenda, fish sauce and salt to bowl, toss well. Step 7: Place 1 / 3 c chicken mixture into each lettuce leaf. Step 8: Serve with peanuts and serrano.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, fresh breadcrumb, scallions, ground coriander, fresh cilantro, sweet chili sauce, fresh lemon juice, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together, except oil Wet hands, and take one tbsp of mixture and form into meatball. Step 2: Repeat Shallow-fry the meatball until they are brown and cooked through. Step 3: Serve with thai cucumber sauce and thai red chile sauce, or other dipping sauces of choice, if desired.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Noodle Salad Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: thai rice noodles, rice vinegar, gluten-free soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil, honey, hot sauce, garlic clove, fresh ginger, rotisserie-cooked chicken, carrots, red bell pepper, english cucumber, bean sprouts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a large heat-proof bowl. Step 2: Bring 5 cups of water to a boil and pour water over the noodles. Step 3: Make sure noodles are fully submerged. Step 4: Let stand, stirring occasionally, until noodles become tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Step 5: Drain well and place noodles back in the bowl While noodles are standing, stir together rice vinegar, soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil, honey or sugar, hot sauce, garlic and ginger in a small bowl. Step 6: After noodles have been drained, add this dressing to noodles and toss to coat. Step 7: Add chicken, carrots, red pepper, cucumber, bean sprouts and green onions to noodles, tossing to combine. Step 8: Divide noodles among serving plates and garnish with cilantro or basil and sesame seeds. Step 9: Serve with lime wedges on the side.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, sweet chili sauce, fresh cilantro, garlic clove, fresh lemon rind, sour cream
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the mince, sauce, cilantro, garlic and rind in a small bowl and mix well Wet your hands and shape the mixture into 24 patties. Step 2: Place onto a tray and refrigerate patties for 30 minutes, or longer. Step 3: Heat a small amount of oil in a non-stick pan and cook the patties in batches, until browned on both sides and cooked through To make the sauce, combine sour cream, chili sauce and cilantro in a small bowl. Step 4: Serve the patties alongside the sauce.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, peanut butter, rice vinegar, soy sauce, chili oil, ginger, honey, sesame oil, sesame seeds, green onion, chicken breast, salt, cayenne pepper, olive oil, mozzarella cheese
Instructions: Step 1: In food processor or blender, combine peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, chili oil, ginger, honey and sesame oil, set aside. Step 2: Season chicken to taste with salt and cayenne pepper. Step 3: Saute in olive oil until done. Step 4: Cut chicken into bite sized pieces and coat with 2 tablespoons of the peanut sauce. Step 5: Spread peanut sauce over the surface of the italian pizza crust Scatter chicken pieces over top and sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions. Step 6: Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella cheese and 1 / 2 cup of the monterey jack cheese. Step 7: Bake, uncovered in 400f oven for 12 minutes. Step 8: Remove from oven and sprinkle with shredded carrot and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: curry paste, fish sauce, peanut butter, tamarind juice, sugar, paprika, garlic powder, coconut milk, peanuts, boneless chicken breast, egg, lettuce, cucumber, carrot, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Peanut sauce: Add all peanut sauce ingredients to heavy duty sauce pan and bring to the boil. Step 2: Stir 15 minutes on medium heat until reduced to 1 cups. Step 3: Set aside to cool while you prepare the salad Salad: Add enough water to medium-sized saucepan to cover chicken and bring to the boil. Step 4: Add chicken and cook fro 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove and set aside to cool. Step 6: Once cool, shred Compose chicken shreds, egg, lettuce, cucumber, carrot, tomato and shredded onion on plate.

Ingredient Names: thai sweet chili sauce, chili-garlic sauce, chicken breasts, hamburger buns, mayonnaise, ketchup, vegetable oil, lime juice, soy sauce, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix soy sauce, lime juice, vegetable oil, chili garlic sauce and ketchup 2. Step 2: Add chicken breasts to mixture and refrigerate for at least 6 hours 3. Step 3: Remove from refrigerator and season chicken with salt and pepper 4. Step 4: Place on a hot grill or bake in a 400 degree oven until cooked completely through A meat thermometer should read at least 155-160 degrees 5.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, chicken breasts, garlic cloves, yellow onion, red bell pepper, carrot, scallions, creamy peanut butter, tamari, chinese five spice powder, honey, garlic clove, cayenne pepper, peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add chicken, garlic and onion, stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 3: Add remaining veggies and stir-fry 5 more minutes. Step 4: Combine and heat all ingredients for sauce together in a sauce pan over low heat, stirring the sauce until all ingredients are combined. Step 5: Transfer stir-fry to a large platter and pour sauce evenly over the chicken and vegetables. Step 6: Sprinkle the platter with chopped nuts and cilantro, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Satay And Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, beef, shrimp, pork, oil, coconut milk, garlic, lemongrass, ginger, curry powder, peanut butter, sugar, red curry paste, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: For the marinade: Slice 1 / 2 long strips of chicken that will easily accommodate a skewer and place in a bowl. Step 2: Combine all the ingredients besides the chicken in a food processor and blend for 30 seconds. Step 3: Pour the marinade over the meat and massage the marinade in with your fingers until each piece of chicken is evenly coated. Step 4: Cover the bowl and marinade for approx 3 hours. Step 5: Preheat grill Skewer the meat. Step 6: Grill chicken skewers for 4 - 5 minutes on front and back sides until fully cooked Total cooking time varies on heat and meat thickness, but mine usually take 9 - 10 minutes Meat should be tender and not over-cooked.

Ingredient Names: boil-in-the-bag rice, chicken breast tenders, cornstarch, fish sauce, canola oil, onion, garlic, ground ginger, light coconut milk, sriracha sauce, sugar, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package directions and keep warm. Step 2: Toss chicken with cornstarch and fish sauce. Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add chicken to pan Saut 5 minutes. Step 5: Remove chicken from pan. Step 6: Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in pan. Step 7: Add onion, garlic, and ginger to pan Saut 1 minute. Step 8: Return chicken to pan.

Ingredient Names: natural yogurt, coriander, fresh ginger, lemongrass, red chilies, fish sauce, ground cumin, chicken tenderloins, greens, hoisin sauce, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the yoghurt, coriander, ginger, lemongrass, chilli, fish sauce and cumin. Step 2: Add the chicken to the bowl and toss well to coat. Step 3: Allow to marinate for 15 minutes in the fridge. Step 4: Thread the chicken onto damp skewers. Step 5: Heat a char-grill or pan on medium Spray with oil. Step 6: Cook skewers for 4-5 minutes each side until the chicken is cooked through. Step 7: Serve with lime wedges and steamed asian greens. Step 8: Steam asian greens in a steamer over gently simmering water. Step 9: Drain and drizzle with hoisin to serve.

Ingredient Names: chicken carcass, red chile, onions, garlic, ginger, lime, lemongrass, coriander, soy sauce, fresh ginger, rice noodles, coconut milk, baby spinach, spring onions, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Place the carcass and all the stock ingredients in a large pan. Step 2: Cover with a litre of water and bring to a boil, then turn down the heat until the water is barely simmering and leave to bubble for an hour or so You will need to add a cup of water from time to time, to keep the stock topped up. Step 3: When the hour is up, strain the broth through a fine sieve into a bowl Measure out 150ml of this broth into a pan for the soup The rest can be frozen for another day. Step 4: Add a dash of soy sauce, the lime juice, red chilli and ginger to the broth and bring it slowly back to the boil. Step 5: Meanwhile, cook the rice noodles according to the directions on the packet. Step 6: Add the coconut milk, spinach, coriander and noodles to the bubbling broth and leave a few minutes to heat through Don't let it come to a boil.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Soup With Coconut Tom Ka
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass, galangal, fish sauce, lime juice, chicken breasts, coconut milk, thai red chili pepper, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the stock, add the lime leaves, lemon grass, galangal, fish sauce, and lime juice. Step 2: Stir thoroughly, bring to a boil, and add the chicken and coconut milk. Step 3: Bring back to the boil, lower the heat to keep it simmering and cook for about 2 minutes Not really intended to be eaten as a separate course, you could serve it with just a serving of steamed thai jasmine rice, or together with a thai meal This quantity serves 4 with other food, but is probably only enough for two if eaten separately.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Stir Fried With Holy Basil Gai Pad Graprow
Ingredient Names: boneless chicken thighs, garlic cloves, shallots, peanut oil, black soy sauce, thai fish sauce, thai holy basil, kaffir lime leaves, thai chiles, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Leave the fresh basil leaves whole The flowers may also be used The dried holy basil will soften when soaked in tap water for 10-15 minutes Pull off and discard the hard stems, drain. Step 2: Heat a wok until the surface is smoking hot Swirl in the oil to coat the wok surface Wait a few seconds for the oil to heat, then stir in the garlic, followed a few seconds later with shallots. Step 3: Stir another few seconds before adding the chicken. Step 4: Stir-fry a minute or two, or until most of the chicken has started to change color on the outside and is no longer pink.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken With Crispy Shallots In Yellow Rice Kao Moke Gai
Ingredient Names: ground cayenne pepper, ground cumin, coriander powder, ground turmeric, fresh ground white pepper, salt, chicken thighs, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic, onion, jasmine rice, water, shallot, distilled white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the cayenne, cumin, coriander, turmeric, pepper, and 1 / 2 tsp of salt in a small bowl and mix well. Step 2: Sprinkle half of the spice mixture over the chicken pieces, rubbing in to coat well. Step 3: Set aside coated chicken and remaining spice mixture Be careful with the spices, as turmeric will leave a yellow stain if it gets on clothing! Step 4: In a dutch oven, heat 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add chicken, skin side down, and cook 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until well-browned. Step 6: Remove chicken to a shallow bowl, cover, and set aside. Step 7: Spoon off some of the oil from the dutch oven, leaving about 2 tbsp, taking care not to remove any of the browned bits left from the chicken Reheat the oil and saute the ginger slices for about 30 seconds, turning and pressing down to release the juices. Step 8: Add garlic and saute, stirring and turning constantly, until golden brown.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken With Ginger And Mushrooms Gai King
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, gingerroot, fresh mint leaves, shiitake mushrooms, green onions, thai red chili pepper, rice vinegar, brown sugar, fish sauce, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a small dish, mix together vinegar, fish sauce and brown sugar until brown sugar dissolves, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in wok and stir-fry onions, garlic and chicken for 2 minutes for 2-3 minutes or until onions are limp. Step 3: Add soy sauce, ginger, mint, mushrooms, green onions, chilies and cook until chicken is cooked through Working fast, add vinegar, brown sugar, and fish sauce mixture to chicken and take off the heat. Step 4: Serve at once with steamed jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken With Spicy Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: instant rice, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, vegetable oil, instant minced garlic, ginger, green onion, bamboo shoots, unsalted peanuts, reduced sodium soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, creamy peanut butter, rice vinegar, dark sesame oil, ground cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Make peanut sauce: combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and whisk until well combined, set aside. Step 2: Bring 2 1 / 2 cups water to a boil in a 2-qt Saucepan. Step 3: When the water boils, add the rice. Step 4: Cover the pan, and remove from the heat until ready to serve. Step 5: Cut the chicken into short strips about 1 / 2 inch wide. Step 6: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 7: Add the chicken, garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook until the chicken is no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add the green onions, bamboo shoots, peanuts, soy sauce, sherry and sugar.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, coconut milk, laos powder, green onions, serrano chilies, nam pla, lemongrass, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 1 cup coconut milk to boil. Step 2: Add chicken, lemon grass, and laos. Step 3: Cover and simmer til chicken is tender. Step 4: Add remaining 1 cup coconut milk, green onions and chilis Do not boil. Step 5: Stir in lime juice and fish sauce just before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup Tom Kha Gai
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, coconut milk, lemongrass, fresh lime leaves, shrimp paste, thai red chili peppers, ginger, fish sauce, soy sauce, palm vinegar, bergamot oil, boneless chicken breasts, mushrooms, cilantro, bok choy
Instructions: Step 1: Gently simmer all but last 5 ingredients for 30 minutes. Step 2: Add chicken and mushrooms and simmer for another 5 minutes. Step 3: Add noodles, bok choi, cilantro. Step 4: Let stand 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, thai curry paste, cilantro roots, chicken breasts, chicken broth, carrot, fresh lime leaves, lemongrass, fish sauce, juice, ginger, bean sprouts, rice noodles, cilantro leaf, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Scoop the thick coconut cream from the top of just one of the cans into a large stockpot set over a medium-high heat. Step 2: Melt the cream, add the curry paste and stir for a few minutes until they begin to sizzle. Step 3: Add the chicken and saut until the chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the coconut juice from the first can and all the contents of the second can along with the chicken broth, carrot, lime leaves, lemon grass, fish sauce and lime zest and juice. Step 5: Grate the frozen ginger into the broth with a microplane grater or standard box grater. Step 6: Simmer for 20 minutes or so. Step 7: Stir in the bean sprouts. Step 8: Add the rice noodles, gently pushing them beneath the surface of the broth. Step 9: Turn off the heat and let stand until the noodles soften, about 5 minutes Rice noodles dont need to simmer like pasta to cook.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Ginger Soup Or Tom Kha Gai
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, water, lemongrass, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, fresh ginger, sugar, chicken stock, chili paste, straw mushrooms, boneless chicken, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, water, lemongrass, fish sauce, lime juice, ginger and sugar in a large pot and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Step 2: Add chile paste, stock, mushrooms and chicken, simmer for 10 minutes. Step 3: Remove lemongrass and ginger before serving and garnish with cilantro.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Milk And Chicken Soup
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, chicken stock, galanga root, fresh lemongrass, unsweetened coconut milk, thai fish sauce, lime, scallion, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place chicken, chicken stock, galanga, and lemon grass in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and simmer until chicken is cooked through. Step 3: Add coconut milk and continue cooking on low until soup comes back to a simmer Just before serving stir in fish sauce and lime juice. Step 4: Pour into soup bowls and sprinkle top with scallions and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: creamy peanut butter, light coconut milk, low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, salt, cayenne pepper, low sodium chicken broth, ground cumin, curry powder, boneless skinless chicken breasts, green onions, carrot, limes, angel hair pasta
Instructions: Step 1: For the sauce: heat coconut milk, peanut butter, and broth in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until smooth and heated through. Step 2: Add remaining sauce ingredients, seasoning to taste, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens to the consistency of thin spaghetti sauce. Step 3: Remove from heat and cover, if will continue to thicken off the heat To prepare the chicken: Heat some sesame oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and stir fry the chicken chunks until almost cooked through While the chicken is cooking, squeeze some lime juice into the pan to add moisture, as much as needed. Step 4: Set aside about 1 / 2 cup of the diced scallions for a garnish later, and add the rest to the chicken, along with the carrots and stir fry until the veggies are lightly browned and the chicken is fully cooked, adding even more lime juice as needed for moisture. Step 5: Pour some of the peanut sauce over the chicken in the pan and toss to coat Portion cooked pasta onto serving plates and ladle some more peanut sauce on top of each Ladle chicken mixture on top of each portion, and drizzle with a bit more peanut sauce if desired.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Rice Noodles With Chicken
Ingredient Names: rice vermicelli, peanut oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, light coconut milk, smooth cashew butter, soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic cloves, mild curry powder, brown sugar, red cayenne pepper, baby portabella mushrooms, red bell pepper, scallions, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water for noodles and cook pasta 6-8 minutes or according to package directions. Step 2: Drain noodles, rinse under cool water and allow to drain. Step 3: Cut into smaller pieces if desired. Step 4: Meanwhile, toast coconut if necessary. Step 5: Using a whisk, mix together ingredients for sauce: coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic, curry powder, brown sugar, and cayenne pepper. Step 6: Heat oil in large pan until almost smoking. Step 7: Add chicken and stir-fry until almost done and nicely browned. Step 8: Add bell pepper and cook 1-2 minutes. Step 9: Add mushrooms and cook until they are tender. Step 10: Add chopped scallions, basil, and the juice of the lime and cook briefly.

Dish Name: Thai Curried Chicken And Bok Choy Gai Galumblee
Ingredient Names: peppercorns, coriander root, salt, boneless skinless chicken breasts, unsweetened coconut milk, ground galangal, bok choy, curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, lime juice, thai chile, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Using a mortar and pestle, grind salt, peppercorns, and coriander roots until they become a paste. Step 2: Slice chicken into 2-inch strips. Step 3: Heat wok over med-high heat. Step 4: Add coconut milk, coriander root paste, galangal powder, and chicken. Step 5: Bring mixture to a boil and cook, simmering until chicken is cooked, about 8-10 minutes. Step 6: Add the bok choy and cook until it is crisp-tender, about 10-12 minutes, or to taste. Step 7: In a bowl, mix together remaining ingredients until they are smooth. Step 8: Add to wok and stir well. Step 9: Serve with sliced thai chillies over steamed rice in a bowl.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, lemon, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, onion, serrano pepper, curry powder, thai red curry paste, salt and pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: 1 lb of chicken breast diced into cubes Butterfly the chicken breast first to make thinner, then cube. Step 2: Rinse chicken under cold water and drain well. Step 3: Squeeze the juice of half a lemon onto chicken breast and set aside. Step 4: In a saute pan over medium heat warm oil and saute garlic, serrano pepper, and onions about 2 minutes or until cooked down. Step 5: Add curry powder to pan and cook for 2 more minutes. Step 6: Add curry paste and stir in well and cook for a few more minutes. Step 7: Add diced chicken along with the lemon juice to the curry mixture and stir until chicken is completely coated with the curry. Step 8: Saute for 10-12 minutes or until chicken is cooked. Step 9: Add salt and pepper to taste.

Ingredient Names: plain flour, salt and pepper, chicken breasts, canola oil, green onions, button mushrooms, green curry paste, coconut cream, kaffir lime leaves, frozen peas, lime, fresh coriander, puff pastry, egg
Instructions: Step 1: Season flour with salt and pepper. Step 2: Toss chicken in flour then shake off excess. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet on high and cook chicken in batches for 5-6 minutes or until golden brown on all sides. Step 4: Add the green onion and mushrooms, cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the curry paste and cook, stirring for 1 minute. Step 6: Add coconut cream, kaffir lime leaves, peas, lime juice and rind, reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Remove lime leaves and stir in coriander, allow to cool. Step 8: Preheat oven to 200c Lay pastry out on a work surface and cut two 1cm strips from sides of each sheet.

Dish Name: Thai Curry Chicken With Sweet Potato
Ingredient Names: sweet potato, water, canola oil, green curry paste, chicken breast, onion, garlic cloves, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, low-fat cream cheese, skim milk, black pepper, fish sauce, brown sugar, dried basil
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the sweet potato, microwave for 2 minutes -to soften it up Peel, cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes, put cubes into steamer bag, add 1 teaspoon water, microwave for 3 minutes And set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet on medium heat for about 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in curry paste until well blended. Step 4: Add chicken, onions, and garlic. Step 5: Cook and stir 6 to 8 minutes or until chicken is slightly rare inside. Step 6: Stir in red and yellow peppers and sweet potato. Step 7: Cook 4 minutes or until peppers are crisp tender and sweet potato is done. Step 8: Add cream cheese, milk, pepper, fish sauce, brown sugar, and basil.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, curry powder, red pepper flakes, olive oil flavored cooking spray, green onions, garlic cloves, broccoli florets, carrot, olive oil, chicken breast halves, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, curry powder and red pepper flakes. Step 2: Set aside Spray wok or large skillet with cooking spray. Step 3: Heat over medium high heat. Step 4: Add onions and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, remove from wok. Step 5: Add broccoli and carrot to wok. Step 6: Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp tender, remove from wok. Step 7: Add oil to hot wok.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, rice noodles, peanut oil, red onion, garlic cloves, red pepper, green pepper, mixed mushrooms, broccoli, fresh basil leaf, lime juice, thai sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, cilantro, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles and set aside. Step 2: Add a small amount of peanut oil to keep from sticking. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet. Step 4: Add the garlic and brown lightly. Step 5: Add chicken and cook until no longer pink. Step 6: Add onions, pepper, mushrooms, and broccoli. Step 7: Stir fry lightly for 4 to 5 minutes. Step 8: Add noodles and stir. Step 9: Add lime juice, chili sauce, soy sauce, pepper flakes, basil, brown sugar, and salt. Step 10: Stir continuously until noodles are firm but tender.

Ingredient Names: garlic, coriander, salsify, fresh chili peppers, caster sugar, ground turmeric, curry powder, fish sauce, chicken thigh fillets, vegetable oil, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the garlic, coriander root and salt in mortar and pestle. Step 2: Add the chilie peppers, sugar, turmeric and curry powder and pound to a fine paste. Step 3: Add the fish sauce to the paste and marinate the chicken for 2 hours. Step 4: Heat a little veg oil in a wok / large saucepan, add the chicken and fry until a good crust forms. Step 5: Reduce the heat and continue stir-frying until the chicken is cooked through. Step 6: Serve with coconut milk spooned over the top--optional.

Dish Name: Thai Galangal Chicken Soup Tom Ka Gai
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, galangal, fresh lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, coriander roots, chicken thigh fillets, straw mushrooms, coconut milk, lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, fresh coriander leaves, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the lemongrass into 5 cm pieces and pound the pieces with the side of your kitchen knife to bruise them This helps to release the flavour into the soup. Step 2: Using a large saucepan- combine the stock, lemongrass pieces, galangal, whole lime leaves and coriander roots and stems mixture, bring to the boil, reduce the heat. Step 3: Simmer covered for 5 minutes. Step 4: Remove from the heat and allow to stand for 10 minutes. Step 5: Strain the stock through muslin or a fine strainer into a large heatproof bowl. Step 6: Discard the solids. Step 7: Rinse your saucepan.

Ingredient Names: boneless chicken breasts, garlic, fresh ginger, limes, sunflower oil, dark soy sauce, red chile, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cut gashes into chicken, through skin if present. Step 2: Mix all the ingredients for the marinade in a deep glass bowl. Step 3: Put the chicken pieces in the bowl, making sure to coat each piece thoroughly and press into gashes. Step 4: Cover and leave the chicken in the marinade at least 2 hours. Step 5: Mix it around at some point during this time using 2 forks Next cook the chicken in a foil-lined oven pan at the top of a hot oven for 20-30 minutes, or grill / broil it, or cook on the bbq at medium heat for 15-20 minutes until cooked through. Step 6: Keep basted with the marinade while cooking. Step 7: Serve with buttered rice, perhaps some wild rice mixed in, along with fresh greens and a salad.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, jalapenos, fresh ginger, olive oil, yellow onion, eggplant, unsweetened coconut milk, soy sauce, kosher salt, boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Place the cilantro, jalapeos, ginger, and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a food processor and pulse until combined. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion and eggplant and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the coconut milk, soy sauce, and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt, bring to a simmer. Step 5: Add the reserved cilantro mixture, the remaining salt, and the chicken. Step 6: Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens slightly, about 7 minutes. Step 7: Serve over the rice.

Ingredient Names: mung bean noodles, vegetable oil, whole boneless skinless chicken breast, salt and pepper, red chili peppers, lime juice, nam pla, sugar, shallots, cilantro leaf, bay shrimp, lettuce, shallot
Instructions: Step 1: Put mung bean noodles in a bowl and pour in lukewarm water to cover. Step 2: Let soak until soft and pliable, drain. Step 3: Add noodles to a large pot of boiling water. Step 4: Reduce to medium heat. Step 5: Cook until noodles are plump and glasslike. Step 6: Drain in a colander. Step 7: Rinse with cold water, drain again. Step 8: Cut into 3- or 4-inch lengths.

Dish Name: Thai Green Chicken Curry With Spaghetti
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, coconut milk, sweet basil, eggplants, green curry paste, fish sauce, sugar, thai chile, kaffir lime leaf, spaghetti
Instructions: Step 1: Heat coconut milk and curry paste until it turns creamy, add chicken. Step 2: Cook for 5-7 minutes. Step 3: Add eggplants and sweet basil. Step 4: Cook for further 5 minutes Finish with thai chili and kaffir lime leaves. Step 5: Boil spaghetti for 10 minutes and serve hot with curry.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, red onions, celery ribs, carrots, mushrooms, red pepper, lemongrass, kale, green beans, chicken, coconut milk, chicken broth, green curry paste
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in large stock pot. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger, onions, celery and cook until tender. Step 3: Add the rest of the vegetables and simmer 10 minutes longer. Step 4: Add the broth, milk and curry paste. Step 5: Simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Add fish oil and cilantro to taste.

Dish Name: Thai Green Curry For The Crockpot
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, green curry paste, lemongrass, chicken broth, fish sauce, sugar, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground turmeric, lime juice, chicken breasts, frozen peas, green beans, red bell pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the coconut milk and curry paste with a whisk. Step 2: Add everything in the crock pot except for peas and cilantro. Step 3: Cook low 6 to 8 hours or high 3 to 4 hours. Step 4: Add cilantro and peas at the last 15 minutes. Step 5: Remove lemon grass.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic, shallots, green beans, bamboo shoots, red chile, fresh pineapple, vegetable oil, green curry paste, coconut milk, lemongrass, fish sauce, lime, basmati rice, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large frying pan or wok and add the cooking oil, curry paste and three tablespoons of coconut milk. Step 2: Stir-fry for a couple minutes, then add the garlic, chilli and shallots. Step 3: Fry another 2-3 minutes then add the meat and cook until it is coloured on all sides. Step 4: Add the bruised lemon grass to the pan along with the beans, fish sauce and the rest of the coconut milk. Step 5: Lower the heat and simmer gently for 25 minutes or until the meat is tender. Step 6: Add a squeeze of lime juice at the end While the curry is simmering, wash the rice and place it in a pot with three times as much water. Step 7: Boil, then take the heat down to low, cover and leave to cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: Remove the pan from the heat and leave the rice without taking off the lid for another 10 minutes Just before serving, stir in the bamboo shoots, a bit of coriander and pineapple.

Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, chinese chili sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, garlic cloves, sugar, boneless chicken breasts, lettuce, mint sprig, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine cilantro, chili sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, garlic and sugar. Step 2: Spread on chicken and marinate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight Pre-heat broiler or barbeque Broil or grill chicken, skin side down, for 4 minutes. Step 3: Turn and broil / grill 4 minutes longer until skin is crispy and chicken is cooked through. Step 4: Cut chicken on the bias into 1 / 2 inch strips. Step 5: Place lettuce leaves on a platter and arrange chicken on top. Step 6: Garnish with cilantro, mint sprigs and green onions To eat in the traditional thai manner, roll chicken in lettuce leaves along with herbs and onions. Step 7: Dip into thai dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: white peppercorns, cilantro leaf, garlic, sugar, water, distilled white vinegar, salt, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, chicken pieces, cooked long-grain rice
Instructions: Step 1: To make pesto, crush or grind the peppercorns with a mortar and pestle or in a spice or pepper grinder. Step 2: Combine pepper, cilantro, and garlic and work into a smooth paste with a mortar and pestle or in a food processor. Step 3: Add a little oil or water if needed to facilitate the grinding To make sauce, combine sugar, water, vinegar, garlic, and salt in a small, non-reactive saucepan. Step 4: Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat. Step 5: Stir to dissolve sugar and reduce heat to low. Step 6: Simmer until slightly reduced and thickened to a light syrup consistency, about 20 minutes. Step 7: Remove from heat and stir in chili-garlic sauce. Step 8: Cool to room temperature If not using right away, transfer to a jar and seal tightly.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, creamed coconut, garlic, boiling water, green chili pepper, fresh ginger, lime, fresh cilantro, lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Make the marinade: slice the creamed coconut, dissolve in the boiling water, set aside and allow to become cold. Step 2: Stir in the remaining marinade ingredients. Step 3: Wash the chicken thighs and remove the skin Trim off any excess fat. Step 4: Turn the chicken in the marinade, then cover and refrigerate for about 2 hours or overnight. Step 5: Heat the grill to its highest temperature. Step 6: Place the chicken on the grill rack, spoon over some of the marinade and cook for 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally The chicken is cooked when pierced and the juices run clear.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, tom yum paste, garlic clove, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, chicken breast halves, fresh mushrooms, fish sauce, lime juice, green chili pepper, fresh coriander, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, bring the chicken stock to a boil. Step 2: Stir in the tom yum paste and garlic, and cook for about 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the lemon grass and kaffir lime leaves. Step 4: Place the chicken in the saucepan, and cook 5 minutes, or until no longer pink and juices run clear. Step 5: Mix in the mushrooms. Step 6: Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and green chile pepper Continue cooking until well blended. Step 7: Remove from heat, and serve warm with the coriander and basil Prawns may be substituted for chicken in this recipe. Step 8: Cook them only until opaque.

Ingredient Names: chicken tenderloins, nutmeg, ground cloves, cayenne pepper, turmeric, cinnamon, ground coriander, ground cumin, coconut milk, lemongrass, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, dark soy sauce, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor combine all ingredients except chicken and whole star anise. Step 2: Blend until smooth, taste and adjust as needed: for more salt add fish sauce If it's too sour, add more agave nectar. Step 3: In a large saucepan lay the chicken pieces in one layer and pour the sauce over them. Step 4: Turn chicken pieces to coat well. Step 5: Add the whole star anise. Step 6: Cook uncovered until chicken is done, this time will vary depending on if the chicken has bones in or not For bone-in chicken, simmer until the sauce reduces by half For boneless, remove chicken then reduce the sauce by half, returning chicken to pan to reheat when you are ready to serve. Step 7: Serve atop fragrant rice and garnish enjoy!

Dish Name: Thai Inspired Coconut Chicken With Spinach And Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, fresh ginger, garlic clove, onion, lime, red pepper flakes, paprika, curry powder, salt, boneless skinless chicken breasts, mushroom, oyster sauce, baby spinach, fresh basil leaf, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Saute chicken and mushrooms together until chicken is browned and mushrooms are tender, set aside. Step 2: Puree 1 / 2 cup coconut milk, ginger, garlic, onion, lime juice and zest, pepper flakes, paprika, and curry powder in blender or food processor. Step 3: Heat mixture in skillet over med-high heat. Step 4: Cook 1-2 minutes or until mixture thickens and turns a brighter red. Step 5: Add chicken and mushrooms, remaining coconut milk, and oyster sauce and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, 8-10 minutes, until chicken is done. Step 7: Stir in spinach, basil and salt, cover and heat through, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Thai Inspired Stuffed Chicken Breast And Napa Slaw
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cooked jasmine rice, shredded coconut, green onions, thai basil, fresh cilantro, thai sweet chili sauce, limes, flour, kosher salt, white pepper, coconut milk, roasted peanuts, panko breadcrumbs, white sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl, mix together rice, coconut, green onion, basil, cilantro, chili sauce, 1 tablespoon lime juice and zest of 1 lime. Step 2: Place chicken between 2 sheets of plastic wrap Pound to even thickness. Step 3: Place equal amounts of rice mixture on each chicken breast half. Step 4: Wrap chicken around filling Secure with wooden pick In glass pie plate, mix together flour, zest of 1 lime, salt and pepper In another plate, mix coconut milk and 2 tablespoons lime juice In third plate, mix together peanuts, panko, black and white sesame seeds. Step 5: Roll chicken breasts, one at a time, first in flour mixture.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, black peppercorns, kosher salt, cilantro, lemongrass, lime, skinless chicken thighs, fresh cilantro stem
Instructions: Step 1: In a mortar or spice mill, grind garlic, peppercorns, cilantro roots and salt and set aside in a large dish or resealable plastic bag. Step 2: Using spice mill or food processor, pulse lemongrass a few times until it is finely shredded and add to ground spices. Step 3: Mix in lime juice, mixing well. Step 4: Add chicken to mixture and work mixture into flesh, using your hands, and allow to marinate for 6 hours or overnight. Step 5: Preheat oven to 400f Roast chicken in a pan with a drainage rack for 40-45 minutes or until juices run clear. Step 6: Serve garnished with fresh cilantro sprigs, if desired Pass thai red chile sauce at the table, and serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: lemongrass, shallots, garlic, fish sauce, soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, kosher salt, granulated sugar, whole chickens, fresh cilantro, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a nonreactive dish large enough to hold the chicken, combine all but 2 tbs Of the lemongrass with all of the shallots, garlic, fish sauce, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, salt, and sugar. Step 2: Add the chicken and turn it to coat, tucking some of the marinade underneath its skin. Step 3: Pour any excess marinade into the birds cavity. Step 4: Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight. Step 5: Bring the chicken to room temperature before cooking it. Step 6: Heat the oven to 350f put the chicken, breast side down, on a rack in a roasting pan. Step 7: Cook for 40 minute turn the bird over and roast until the chicken is cooked and nicely browned, 20 to 30 minute the sugar in the marinade may cause the pan juices to burn, but this wont affect the chickens flavor About 10 minute before the chicken is done, combine the remaining 2 tbs Lemongrass with the cilantro and vegetable oil.

Ingredient Names: dried rice noodles, vegetable oil, ginger, lemongrass, red chili pepper flakes, minced chicken, lime juice, fish sauce, fresh cilantro, fresh basil, green onions, jalapeno, lime
Instructions: Step 1: In a large covered pot, boil enough water to cover the noodles. Step 2: Remove from heat and place noodles. Step 3: Leave for about 10 minutes or until tender, drain. Step 4: Meanwhile: Heat a non-stick frying pan over high heat. Step 5: Add the oil, ginger, lemongrass chile and optional jalapeno and saute for 1 minute. Step 6: Add the minced chicken and cook, stirring until cooked through. Step 7: Stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, cilantro, basil and onions. Step 8: Serve over hot noodles with lime wedges to squeeze over top.

Dish Name: Thai Lime Chicken With Bok Choy
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, chicken thigh fillets, fish sauce, lime juice, lime zest, palm sugar, garlic clove, red thai chile, baby bok choy, lime, green onions, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large frying pan. Step 2: Cook chicken in batches until cooked through. Step 3: Meanwhile place fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic and chilli in a screw-top jar and shake well. Step 4: Boil, steam or microwave bok choy until tender, drain. Step 5: Add lime slices to same frying pan and cook until both sides are browned. Step 6: Divide chicken among service plates The original recipe states to spoon the dressing over the chicken, and top with the onion and cilantro I prefer to add the dressing and half the onion and cilantro to the pan and deglaze the pan for a minute or two, then spoon it onto the chicken, topping with the remainder of the onion and cilantro. Step 7: Serve with bok choy, lime slices and jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Thai Mussamun Curry With Chicken Potatoes And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, curry paste, boneless chicken thighs, potato, onion, dry roasted salted peanut, cinnamon sticks, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind juice, salt, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Open 1 can of coconut milk and use a fork to stir the contents until smooth and well combined. Step 2: In a 6-quart saucepan or dutch oven, bring 1 / 2 cup of the stirred coconut milk to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the curry paste and cook 1 minute, stirring and mashing the paste into the coconut milk. Step 4: Add the chicken and cook 2 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken begins to change color. Step 5: Add all the remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, tamarind liquid and salt and bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce the heat to maintain a simmer and cook 15 to 20 minutes, until the potato is tender and the chicken is cooked through. Step 7: Add 2 tablespoons of the lime juice and stir well. Step 8: Taste and add more, if desired. Step 9: Remove from the heat and let stand 10 minutes. Step 10: Transfer to a serving bowl, removing and discarding the cinnamon sticks, or leaving them in as a traditional garnish not to be eaten.

Ingredient Names: ramen noodles, oil, garlic, thai red chili peppers, lemongrass, boneless skinless chicken breasts, broccoli floret, carrot, mushroom cap, fresh bean sprout, fresh cilantro, peanuts, lime, peanut butter, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add ramen noodles, discarding seasoning packet. Step 3: Cook ramen, stirring occasionally, for 3 minutes. Step 4: Drain ramen, and rinse with cold water in strainer or colander. Step 5: Allow to drain while preparing stir-fry. Step 6: Heat 1 1 / 2 tsp oil in large skillet or small wok. Step 7: Add garlic, chilies, and lemongrass, stirring until fragrant. Step 8: Add chicken to pan and cook, stirring, for 3-4 minutes or until chicken is done. Step 9: Remove chicken from pan. Step 10: Add broccoli and 2 tbsp water to pan and steam-fry for 1 minute.

Dish Name: Thai Noodles With Chicken Patties Soup Or Salad
Ingredient Names: ground chicken, fresh basil, cilantro, garlic clove, birds eye chiles, soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, egg, bread, peanut oil, sweet chili sauce, chicken stock, ginger, lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: To make patties: mix all required ingredients in a medium bowl using your hands. Step 2: Cover and let marinate in the fridge for 30mins. Step 3: Shape chicken mixture into patties. Step 4: Heat 1-2 tb oil in skillet over med-hi heat and cook patties, turning once, for 6 minutes or until cooked through and golden brown. Step 5: Set aside in a low oven to keep warm. Step 6: Whisk together dressing / dipping sauce ingredients, set aside To make salad: bring salted water to boil in a saucepan, add noodles and cook for 4 mins or until tender. Step 7: Drain You may also blanch your vegetables in the boiling water for a few minutes, depending on how 'crunchy' you like your salad to be, drain.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, canned unsweetened coconut milk, pizza dough, cooked chicken, mango, scallions, mozzarella cheese, fresh bean sprout, fresh mint leaves, dry roasted peanuts, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: In a medium bowl, combine the peanut butter, chili garlic sauce and coconut milk. Step 3: Spread the pizza crust with the peanut sauce. Step 4: Top with the chicken, mango and scallions. Step 5: Sprinkle with the cheese. Step 6: Bake for 10-12 minutes or until cheese is melted. Step 7: Remove from oven and sprinkle with the bean sprouts, mint and nuts. Step 8: Slice and serve immediately with the lime wedges for some extra zing Optional: top with thinly sliced thai bird chiles and serve with a thai beer to beat the heat!

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, coconut milk, red curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, red bell peppers, curry powder, chili paste, lime juice, sweet basil, garlic clove, fresh ginger, onion, sweet chili sauce, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add chicken, and cook just until white on all sides. Step 3: Remove chicken and drain. Step 4: Add onion, garlic and ginger and cook until transparent. Step 5: Add coconut milk, then add the rest of the ingredients. Step 6: Mix well and let come to a boil. Step 7: Turn down heat to a simmer, and add chicken back into the skillet. Step 8: Cover and simmer, stirring about every 10 minutes I usually simmer it for about a half an hour covered, then remove the cover for the last 10 minutes to thicken a bit. Step 9: Serve over rice, and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: chicken breast halves, baby corn, fresh mushrooms, broccoli floret, water chestnuts, jasmine rice, peanut sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a slightly oiled wok / skillet. Step 2: Stir fry chicken until no longer pink. Step 3: Prepare the rice while stir frying the chicken. Step 4: Add vegetables to chicken in wok / skillet and stir fry for approximately 3 minutes. Step 5: When done, you can place a serving of rice on plate with stir fry on top, then add satay or thai peanut sauce to the top If you prefer, you can also combine just the vegetables and sauce This is my variation on my favorite dish at my favorite thai establishment.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken breasts, peanut butter, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet bring broth to a boil. Step 2: Add chicken breasts. Step 3: Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until chicken is no longer pink, remove chicken. Step 4: Cool Shred chicken Reserve 1 / 4 cup chicken broth In medium bowl combine peanut butter, soy sauce, reserved chicken broth, vinegar, sesame oil, and tabasco sauce. Step 5: Add chicken to sauce and toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, bell pepper, orange juice, shredded coconut, creamy peanut butter, curry powder, water, cayenne pepper, non-fat cooking spray, brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine orange juice, coconut, peanut butter, curry powder water and cayenne in blender or food processor. Step 2: Blend until fairly smooth consistency is achieved Lightly spray bottom of 9x13 pan with cooking spray and arrange chicken pieces and bell pepper slices. Step 3: Pour sauce blend over all. Step 4: Bake at 375 degrees for 40-50 minute be sure chicken is cooked thoroughly as ovens may vary. Step 5: Serve over steamed rice Special.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, water, salt, fresh spinach leaves, vegetables, sugar, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, cooking oil, garlic, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok or large non-stick skillet to medium heat and add 1 / 2 cup water. Step 2: Add chicken and sprinkle with salt. Step 3: Stir thoroughly until chicken is cooked and water is almost dried. Step 4: Meanwhile, in medium sized pot combine sugar, peanut butter, soy sauce, water, cooking oil, and garlic Do not add coconut milk yet. Step 5: Heat over medium heat until bubbling, stirring occasionally, then reduce heat to medium low. Step 6: Once peanut butter and sugar has melted completely, slowly add cocnut milk, stirring until dark sauce has become caramel colored. Step 7: Let sauce simmer over low heat to thicken. Step 8: Steam cook spinach leaves and / or follow cooking instructions on stirfry veggies package Instead of adding the sauce that comes with the veggies, add enough prepared peanut sauce to coat veggies and cook together about 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken, oyster sauce, soy sauce, vegetable oil, sugar, coconut milk, red curry paste, palm sugar, tamarind paste, fish sauce, roasted unsalted peanuts, broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: Method for chicken: place chicken in medium bowl. Step 2: Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, vegetable oil, and sugar and let marinade for 15 minutes. Step 3: Cook chicken in boiling water for just a minute or two, drain and set aside Method for sauce: in mortar and pestle, pound peanut until very fine and smooth, set aside. Step 4: In a wok, heat coconut milk. Step 5: Keep stirring until coconut oil comes up to the surface, then add red curry paste. Step 6: Cook until fragrant. Step 7: Add more coconut milk if you prefer. Step 8: Season with sugar, tamarind and fish sauce.

Ingredient Names: thai red curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, cooked chicken, cooked jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, over medium high heat, combine coconut milk and curry paste heat and stir constantly until the majority of the paste has dissolved And fish sauce and brown sugar, stirring until dissolved. Step 2: Add bamboo shoots and water chestnuts. Step 3: Let simmer for 10 minutes Skip the following step if doing a totally meatless option. Step 4: Add meat or tofu, stirring gently until well incorporated. Step 5: Simmer for another 10 to 15 minutes, until heated thoroughly, serve over rice.

Dish Name: Thai Rice Noodles With Chicken And Asparagus
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, oil, garlic cloves, boneless skinless chicken, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, asparagus spear
Instructions: Step 1: Pour noodles into bowl and cover with very hot tap water. Step 2: Soak for 15-20 minutes. Step 3: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add garlic and stir fry until golden. Step 5: Add fish sauce or salt and chicken. Step 6: Stir fry until done. Step 7: Add soy sauce, chili pepper sauce, and brown sugar. Step 8: Mix until sugar is dissolved. Step 9: Drain noodles and add to skillet along with asparagus. Step 10: Stir fry noodles until firm but tender.

Ingredient Names: oil, lemon grass root, red chili peppers, spring onions, rice, chicken, mint leaves, coriander leaves, lemon basil, lime juice, white sugar, thai fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a frying pan or wok at high temperature. Step 2: Add oil, lemongrass, peppers and spring-onion an stir fry for 3 minutes. Step 3: Mix rice, meat, mint, coriander, lime leaves and lemon grass root mixture in a bowl. Step 4: Mix lime juice, sugar and fish sauce and pour over salad, serve chilled.

Dish Name: Thai Rice Salad With Peanut Dressing
Ingredient Names: white rice, chunky peanut butter, white wine vinegar, vegetable oil, soy sauce, sugar, fresh ginger, garlic, cayenne, cooked chicken, cucumber, onion, fresh spinach
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice as directed on package. Step 2: Transfer to a large bowl. Step 3: Whisk together peanut butter, vinegar, oil, soy sauce, sugar, ginger, garlic, and cayenne. Step 4: Add peanut sauce, chicken, cucumber and onion to rice and mix well. Step 5: Chill Just before serving, stir in spinach.

Ingredient Names: chicken wings, ground cumin, light soy sauce, salt, sesame oil, curry powder, ground turmeric, coconut milk, sugar, oil, garlic cloves, chicken stock, lemon juice, peanut butter, dried breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Cut or prepare the chicken, place aside. Step 2: Mix ingredients for the satay sauce. Step 3: Place in a gallon size ziplock bag. Step 4: Add chicken into bag, and place into the fridge overnight If making satay, place the thinly sliced chicken on skewers Use a long pan in place of the ziplock bag, cover, and keep in fridge overnight. Step 5: Make the peanut sauce by mixing the stock, sugar, salt and lemon juice and setting aside. Step 6: Heat a pan with the oil. Step 7: Add garlic and cook till golden.

Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, bottled clam juice, fish sauce, instant minced garlic, fresh ginger, red curry paste, mushrooms, large shrimp, boneless skinless chicken breast, snow peas, fresh lime juice, sugar, green onion tops, fresh cilantro, light coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, clam juice, fish sauce, minced garlic, minced ginger, and red curry paste in a large dutch oven, stirring with a whisk. Step 2: Add mushrooms, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes. Step 4: Add the shrimp, chicken and snow peas, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 3 minutes. Step 6: Stir in lime juice, sugar, green onions, cilantro and coconut milk. Step 7: Cook 2 minutes longer or until thoroughly heated.

Dish Name: Thai Spiced Chicken And Carrot Stew
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, chicken broth, carrots, scallion, minced ginger, garlic, soy sauce, peanut sauce, sugar, sesame oil, salt and pepper, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except sesame oil, salt, pepper and rice in slow cooker. Step 2: Cover and cook on high 3-4 hours. Step 3: Season to taste with sesame oil, salt and pepper. Step 4: Serve hot over rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic cloves, green chili, fresh ginger, fresh coriander, lime, light soy sauce, caster sugar, coconut cream
Instructions: Step 1: Using a sharp knife, cut 3 deep slashes into the skinned side of each chicken breast. Step 2: Place the breast in a single layer in a wide, non-metallic dish. Step 3: Put the garlic, chilli, ginger, coriander, lime rind and juice, soy sauce, caster sugar and coconut cream in a food processor and process until a smooth puree forms. Step 4: Spread the puree over both sides of the chicken breasts, coating them evenly.
