Step 5: Cover the dish and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for about 1 hour Lift the chicken from the marinade, put into a baking dish. Step 6: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 30 minutes until thoroughly and evenly cooked. Step 7: Meanwhile, place the remaining marinade in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Step 8: Lower the heat and simmer for several minutes to heat thoroughly. Step 9: Pour sauce over the chicken breasts, accompanied with rice and vegetables.

Ingredient Names: chicken legs, peanuts, soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, honey, lime, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Trim chicken of excess skin and fat Hack into smaller pieces with cleaver. Step 2: Mix together marinade ingredients and pour over chicken in a large ziplock bag or shallow dish, coating chicken completely. Step 3: Remove excess air from bag, and refrigerate for several hours If using dish, stir occasionally to mix marinade on meat. Step 4: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Step 5: Bake chicken skin side up in a preheated oven for 30 minutes. Step 6: Then top with sauce and sprinkle with chopped peanuts, and bake 20 minutes more. Step 7: Serve with hot rice or asian noodle dishes.

Ingredient Names: chicken liver, onion, green onions, vegetable oil, oyster sauce, black pepper, chicken broth
Instructions: Step 1: Saut both types of onions in the vegetable oil over low-medium heat for about 3-5 minutes. Step 2: Add the chicken livers and turn the heat up to medium-high and saut livers on each side until the livers darken in color and become opaque looking. Step 3: Add the chicken broth, oyster sauce and black pepper and stir thoroughly. Step 4: Then let simmer uncovered for approximately 10-15 more minutes. Step 5: Serve over steamed white / jasmine rice and enjoy!

Dish Name: Thai Stir Fried Chicken With Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breasts, soy sauce, ginger, fresh mint leaves, fresh shiitake mushrooms, green onions, thai red chili peppers, rice wine vinegar, granulated sugar, fish sauce, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok and stir-fry onions until limp. Step 2: Add garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes more. Step 3: Remove onion and garlic. Step 4: Add chicken and stir-fry. Step 5: Add soy sauce, ginger, 2 / 3 of mint leaves, mixing into chicken. Step 6: Add mushrooms, green onions, chilies, onion, garlic, and cook, until chicken is just cooked and tender. Step 7: Then quickly season with vinegar, sugar, and fish sauce, stirring well. Step 8: Then remove from heat. Step 9: Taste for seasoning. Step 10: Add 1 tbsp more fish sauce if you prefer.

Ingredient Names: chicken, limes, lemongrass, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, palm sugar, coconut milk, thai fish sauce, light soy sauce, shallots
Instructions: Step 1: Trim off the roots of the lemon grass, cut apart the stalks and chop roughly. Step 2: Place into a blender / food processor along with all the other marinade ingredients Process until the mixture has reached a smooth consistency. Step 3: Put the chicken pieces in a deep enough dish and pour over the marinade. Step 4: Stir to mix well, then cover the dish and place in chiller to marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Step 5: Prepare the bbq or preheat the oven to 200c / 400f If cooking in the oven, arrange the chicken pieces on a rack over a roasting tin Barbecue or bake in the oven for 20-30 minutes until the pieces are cooked and golden brown. Step 6: Turn the pieces and brush with the marinade once or twice during cooking. Step 7: Remove from oven or bbq and serve with lime wedges.

Dish Name: Thai Style Grilled Chicken W Spicy Sweet And Sour Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, table salt, chicken breasts, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, distilled white vinegar, lime juice, fish sauce, fresh ginger, ground black pepper, ground coriander, fresh cilantro leaves, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: To brine the chicken: dissolve sugar and salt in 2 quarts cold water in large container or bowl Submerge chicken in brine and refrigerate at least 30 minutes but not longer than 1 hour. Step 2: Rinse chicken under cool running water and pat dry with paper towels For the dipping sauce: whisk ingredients in small bowl until sugar dissolves. Step 3: Let stand 1 hour at room temperature to allow flavors to meld To make and apply the rub: combine all rub ingredients in small bowl Work mixture with fingers to thoroughly combine Slide fingers between skin and meat to loosen skin, taking care not to detach skin Rub about 2 tablespoons mixture under skin Thoroughly rub even layer of mixture onto all exterior surfaces, including bottom and sides.

Dish Name: Thai Style Warm Chicken Salad With Chilli Mint Lime
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, vegetable oil, fresh mint leaves, fresh coriander leaves, sea salt, fresh ground pepper, salted peanuts, lime, lime juice, fish sauce, sesame oil, sugar, red shallots, red chile, spring onions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill. Step 2: Brush the chicken with vegetable oil and grill until cooked through. Step 3: Let it rest for five minutes and then slice thinly For the dressing, whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, sesame oil, and sugar until the sugar dissolves. Step 4: Add the sliced shallots, chilli and spring onions and toss together Tear the mint and coriander leaves and lightly toss with the chicken, salt and pepper At the last minute, add the dressing to the chicken and toss lightly. Step 5: Arrange it on plates, scatter with peanuts and serve with lime wedges.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken thighs, onion, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, thai sweet chili sauce, fish sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, vegetable oil, kosher salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the 1 / 2 of the onions, 1 / 2 of the ginger, and all the garlic in a very hot pan / pot with vegetable oil. Step 2: After browning the edges of the onions, add chicken. Step 3: Fry for five more minutes. Step 4: Add sweet chili sauce, fish sauce, red pepper flakes. Step 5: Reduce heat to med-low and allow the chicken to simmer without the lid for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally The liquid should reduce by at least half Salt / pepper to taste. Step 6: Add the rest of the onions and ginger, then cook for 3-5 more minutes Enjoy with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, salsa verde, thai sweet chili sauce, peanut sauce, lime juice, fish sauce, scallions, ginger, cashews, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place salsa, chili sauce, peanut sauce, juice, fish sauce, scallions and ginger in a bowl mix thoroughly. Step 2: Chill this mixture for 30 minutes, then taste and adjust spice / heat to taste. Step 3: Place this mixture and the thighs in a gallon freezer bag or a covered plastic container Shake well to thoroughly coat thighs and marinate overnight in fridge, turning once or twice Dump the whole shootin match in ye olde crocke potte and cook on low setting for about 7 hours or till chicken is cooked thoroughly Carefully remove chicken to a pre-warmed serving dish. Step 4: Taste sauce again and adjust seasonings to taste. Step 5: Place cashews in plastic baggie and bash em with a kitchen hammer / mallet. Step 6: Serve chicken with sauce poured over and garnish with bashed cashews and chopped cilantro / parsley.

Ingredient Names: seitan, button mushrooms, green curry paste, coconut milk, eggplant, lime juice, serrano pepper, fish sauce, white sugar, cooking oil, basil, cilantro, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the green curry paste in oil over medium heat until fragrant, reduce the heat, gradually add 1 1 / 2 cups of the coconut milk a little at a time, stir until a film of green oil surfaces. Step 2: Add the seitan and lime juice, continue cooking for 3 minutes until fragrant and the "meat" is cooked through. Step 3: Place over medium heat and cook until boiling. Step 4: Add the remaining coconut milk along with the palm sugar, fish sauce and serrano pepper. Step 5: When the mixture returns to the boil add the eggplants and sliced mushrooms. Step 6: Cook until the eggplants are done, sprinkle sweet basil leaves and cilantro then turn off the heat. Step 7: Arrange on a serving dish over jasmine rice rice.

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce hearts, mixed baby greens, fresh bean sprouts, daikon radishes, carrots, scallions, seedless cucumber, grape tomatoes, red onion, fresh mint leaves, fresh basil leaf, nuts, toast, tamari soy sauce, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Arrange salad bar ingredients in attractive dishes and bowls as you prepare them: romaine, baby mixed greens, bean sprouts, daikon or red radishes, carrots, scallions, cucumbers, tomatoes, red onions, mint leaves, basil leaves, nuts and sweet almond or anise"croutons" Heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Step 2: Combine soy and oil in a shallow dish. Step 3: Add chicken and turn to coat. Step 4: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Step 5: Drizzle fish with oil and season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Grill chicken 3 minutes on each side. Step 7: Cut chicken into strips on an angle and place onto a serving plate. Step 8: Grill fish 4 to 5 minutes on each side, until opaque. Step 9: Squeeze lime over the fish and break up into chunks as you transfer it to a serving plate.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, thai red curry paste, thai fish sauce, sugar, juice limes, portobello mushrooms, green onions, leftover chicken
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the stock into a saucepan, then stir in the curry paste, fish sauce, sugar, lime juice and most of the zest. Bring to the boil, then add the mushrooms and whites of the spring onion. Cover, then simmer for 2 mins. Step 2: Stir in the chicken and most of the spring onion greens to gently heat through, then serve ladled into bowls and scattered with the remaining lime zest. Serve with extra lime juice, sugar and fish sauce on the side so everyone can adjust their own bowlfuls.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, eggplants, rapeseed oil, desiccated coconut, fresh breadcrumb, skinless chicken breasts, eggs, cherry tomato, thai red curry paste, fresh cilantro, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. In a large, shallow roasting tin, toss the squash and aubergine in the oil, then season and spread out in a single layer. Roast for 30 mins, turning once. Step 2: On a plate, mix the coconut and breadcrumbs with some seasoning. Dip the chicken breasts in the egg, then press in the crumbs to coat, shaking off any excess. Step 3: Toss the tomatoes and curry paste in with the roasted veg and give everything a good stir. Nestle the chicken breasts in the veg and pop back in the oven for a further 25-30 mins until the chicken is cooked through, shaking the pan once or twice. Sprinkle over the coriander and serve with lime wedges to squeeze over.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, onions, skinless chicken thigh fillets, garlic, thai green curry paste, coconut milk, chicken stock, fresh lime leaves, fish sauce, green onions white diagonal green, fine green bean, bamboo shoots, limes, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in your largest pan, add the onion and fry for 3 mins to soften. Add the chicken and garlic, and cook until the chicken changes colour. Step 2: Add the curry paste, coconut milk, stock, lime leaves and fish sauce, then simmer for 12 mins. Add the chopped onion tops, green beans and bamboo shoots and cook for 4-6 mins, until the beans are just tender. Step 3: Meanwhile, put the lime juice and basil in a narrow jug and blitz with a hand blender to make a smooth green paste. Pour into the soup with the sliced spring onion and heat through. Serve with lime wedges for a light lunch or supper or as a make-ahead starter.

Dish Name: Thai roast chicken with mango & apple salad
Ingredient Names: shallots, red chilies, juice lime, thumb-length ginger, sunflower oil, chicken breasts skin, red-skinned apple, mango, mint leaves picked, green onions, cilantro picked, fish sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz the shallots in a food processor until finely chopped. Add the roughly chopped chilli, ¾ of the ginger and all the lime zest, then whizz to a chunky paste. Tip into a frying pan with 1 tsp oil and some seasoning, then fry for a couple of mins until fragrant. Step 2: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Release the skin from the chicken breasts along one side, and stuff with spicy shallot stuffing. Can be done up to a day ahead. Season the skin, then roast in a roasting tin for 15-20 mins until golden, crisp and cooked through. Meanwhile, make the rice. Step 3: Toss together the apple, mango, mint, spring onions and half the coriander. Mix the fish sauce, caster sugar, remaining ginger and lime juice, then set aside. Step 4: When the chicken is ready, remove it to a plate to rest. Sit the roasting tin on the hob. Spoon off any excess fat, then gently heat, adding the remaining lime juice and a splash more fish sauce, scraping up the chicken juices to make a sauce. Chop the remaining coriander, then stir into the sauce with the finely chopped chilli. Toss the salad with the dressing, then serve with the chicken, sauce and sticky rice.

Dish Name: Thai shredded chicken & runner bean salad
Ingredient Names: runner beans, red chile, shallots, lemongrass, ginger, mint leaves, thai basil, lime wedges, steamed jasmine rice, coconut milk, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, limes, bird's eye chili
Instructions: Step 1: Run a potato peeler down either side of the beans to remove any stringy bits. Cut into strips using a bean slicer, or on the diagonal into 2cm pieces. Cook the beans in simmering salted water for 4 mins or until tender but still bright green. Drain and put in a bowl with the chilli, shallots, lemongrass and ginger. Pull the chicken breasts into shreds using your fingers and add to the bowl. Step 2: Make the dressing. Mix the coconut with the garlic, fish sauce, sugar, lime and chilli. Tear the mint and Thai basil over the chicken and toss everything together. Pile onto a plate and pour over the dressing. Serve with the lime to squeeze over and jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: green chilies, coriander stems, garlic, ginger, ground turmeric, soy sauce, fish sauce, palm, clear honey, chicken thighs skin, slabs pork loin ribs, steamed rice, sugar, white vinegar, limes, red bird's-eye chili, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To make the marinade, put the chillies, coriander stalks, garlic, ginger, turmeric, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and honey in a food processor. Whizz to a rough paste. Cut each chicken thigh into 2 pieces down the side of bone (so one side keeps the bone). Put all the chicken and ribs in a ceramic dish or suitable plastic container and pour over the marinade. Turn the meat over so it is coated, cover and put it in the fridge until needed (up to 24 hrs). Step 2: Make the sauce. Put the sugar in a pan with 250ml water, bring to the boil, simmer for a few mins to make a sugar syrup, then stir in garlic, vinegar, lime juice, fish sauce and chilli. Cool, then stir in coriander. Will keep for 24 hrs in the fridge. Step 3: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Lift the ribs into a baking dish, cover with foil and put in the oven for 1 hr. Add the chicken pieces around the ribs, turn up the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and cook, uncovered, for 20 mins or so until the chicken is cooked through. By now the surface of the ribs and chicken should be quite brown and the marinade slightly sticky; if it isn’t, put the lot under the grill – but keep an eye on it. Step 4: Cut the ribs into sections and pile onto a platter with the chicken, drizzle over some sauce and serve the rest alongside with the salad and some steamed rice.

Dish Name: The Best Spicy Sriracha Chicken Wings
Ingredient Names: chicken wings, coriander, cumin, cinnamon, kosher salt, extra virgin olive oil, chili sauce, unsalted butter, cilantro, limes, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a very large bowl, mix the coriander and cumin seeds, cinnamon, kosher salt and olive oil. Step 2: Add split chicken wings and toss to cover completely. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Step 4: Preheat your oven to 375f. Step 5: Spread them wings on a few rimmed baking sheets and roast for about 30 minutes, until the wings are firm but not cooked all the way through. Step 6: Wash out your bowl. Step 7: Add the sriracha, butter, cilantro, lime zest and juice. Step 8: In a deep fryer or a very large saucepan, heat the vegetable oil to 375f. Step 9: Fry the wings in 4 or 5 batches until golden and crisp, about 5 minutes per batch. Step 10: Drain, shaking off the excess oil.

Dish Name: The ultimate makeover: Thai green chicken curry
Ingredient Names: fresh cilantro, shallots, lemongrass, garlic, ginger, green chilies, larger, fresh basil leaves, ground cumin coriander, black pepper, freeze-dried kaffir lime leaves, lime juice, sunflower oil, fl reduced-fat coconut milk, boneless, fish sauce, granulated palm, freeze-dried lime leaves, mange tout, green beans, green onions, thai fragrant rice, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: For the curry paste, finely chop the coriander stalks and put them into a mini food blender or small food processor with the shallots, lemongrass, garlic and ginger. Pulse until as smooth as you can get it. Add the chillies, basil, threequarters of the coriander leaves, the ground cumin, coriander, pepper, lime leaves and lime juice, then pulse again. Mix in the oil and set aside. You will only be using half of this paste, the rest can be chilled for a couple of days, or frozen for up to a month. Step 2: For the curry, heat the oil in a non-stick wok or deep sauté pan, stir in half the curry paste, then stir-fry for 1 min. Shake the coconut milk in its can, open, then pour two-thirds into the pan. Let it bubble away for 4-5 mins, stirring now and then, until reduced and thickened slightly. Step 3: Tip in the chicken, then stir-fry for 1-2 mins until no longer pink. Stir in the fish sauce and sugar, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk to give a thinnish, creamy sauce. Lower the heat, add the lime leaves, then simmer for 5 mins to gently finish cooking the chicken. Can be frozen at this point for up to 1 month. Step 4: While the chicken simmers, steam the mangetout and beans for a couple of mins. Serve the curry in bowls with some of the veg piled on top (serve the rest separately) along with the spring onions and the rest of the coriander leaves. Serve with a bowl of Thai fragrant rice and lime wedges for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, chili paste with soybean oil, thin soy sauce, paprika, straw mushroom, sugar, msg, tamarind soup mix, chicken, coconut milk, kaffir lime leaf, lemongrass, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cut chicken into thin strips and boil in chicken stock with chili paste and thin soy sauce for to 2 to 3 minutes until the chicken turns white. Step 2: Add coconut milk and bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients. Step 4: Simmer until the chicken is done, 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle with fresh cilantro and serve steaming hot.

Ingredient Names: curry paste, olive oil, peanut butter, boneless skinless chicken breasts, basil leaves, cilantro leaf, coconut milk, soy sauce, light brown sugar, salt, fresh ground black pepper, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large microwave safe pot with a lid, mix together curry paste, oil, and peanut butter. Step 2: Cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken to the pot and stir. Step 4: Cover with the lid and microwave on medium for 8 minutes. Step 5: Add basil, cilantro, coconut milk, soy sauce, and brown sugar and season with salt and pepper. Step 6: Stir to mix very well, cover it, and microwave on medium for 4 minutes. Step 7: Stir again, cover, and let it rest for 3 to 4 minutes. Step 8: Serve hot over white rice.

Dish Name: Tom Ka Kai Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, salt, fresh mushrooms, green onions, lemongrass, fresh galangal root, red chilies, chicken stock, coconut milk, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, fresh cilantro, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In the bottom of a large soup pot, heat the oil over high heat until very hot but not smoking I often make this is a wok on the stove Salt the chicken and add to oil, tossing to brown all the pieces. Step 2: Cook about 3 minutes or until outside is browned, but not necessarily cooked all the way through. Step 3: Add mushrooms and toss. Step 4: Allow to cook until some of the moisture is cooked out and the mushrooms are soft. Step 5: Turn down heat to medium-low To prepare the lemongrass, slice and mince the lower portion and reserve the stalk to flavor the soup You can use a food processor for this, or just mince it by hand The woody upper portion of the stalk will be removed later, so don't chop it up, simply score it by making a few superficial cuts in it to allow it to flavor the soup.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic cloves, gingerroot, red curry paste, tomato paste, boneless skinless chicken thighs, reduced-fat coconut milk, tomatoes, thai fish sauce, coriander, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or pot and saut the onion, garlic and ginger gently until the onion is soft. Step 2: Stir in the curry paste and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring. Step 3: Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes until it's coated in the spice mix and almost cooked. Step 4: Stir in the coconut milk and bring to the boil. Step 5: Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the tomatoes, fish sauce, coriander and sugar. Step 7: Simmer for another 5 minutes. Step 8: Serve with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, lemon zest, orange zest, garlic clove, chives, salt, black pepper, fresh lime juice, fresh lemon juice, honey, balsamic vinegar, vegetable oil, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Between two layers of plastic wrap, pound chicken breasts with meat mallet to an even thickness of about 1 / 2 inch. Step 2: Place chicken in large, self sealing plastic bag. Step 3: In a medium bowl, whisk together lemon zest, orange zest, garlic, chives, salt, pepper, lime juice, lemon juice, honey and balsamic vinegar. Step 4: Pour into bag, over chicken Close bag securely and turn to distribute marinade. Step 5: Refrigerate at least 2 hours or as long as 24 hours, turning occasionally. Step 6: Remove chicken from bag Shake excess marinade into bag and reserve In large, heavy, nonstick skillet over high heat, warm oil. Step 7: Saute chicken until browned, about 2 to 3 minutes per side.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, fresh egg noodles, handfuls greens, carrots, green onions, red peppers, fresh cilantro, red chile, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, limes, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the grill to high. Put the chicken on a baking tray and grill for 10-12 minutes without turning, until cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to instructions. Drain and run cold water through to stop them sticking together. Step 3: Mix the vegetables in a bowl. Thinly slice the chicken and add to the bowl, along with the noodles and coriander leaves. Step 4: Mix the dressing ingredients together with 2 tablespoons water, pour over the salad and toss well. Serve straight away.

Dish Name: Wok Tossed Lime And Chilli Chicken
Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, lemongrass, hot red chili peppers, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, rice, lime, mild chili pepper, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Mince ginger, lemongrass, chillies and garlic with a touch of salt in a processor to make a paste. Step 2: Stir fry the paste in half the oil in a wok over a very high heat for about a minute or so Briefly pulse the chicken breasts until coarse minced but not mushy. Step 3: Take off the heat and toss through all the remaining ingredients and serve with crunchy leaves, and extra lemon or lime wedges to squeeze over. Step 4: Keep shaking the pan so that it doesn't burn. Step 5: Cool and whizz to a fine powder in a coffee grinder or spice mill.

Ingredient Names: oil, onions, garlic clove, chicken breasts, thai red curry paste, creamed coconut, boiling water, tomato puree, potatoes, low-fat plain yogurt, fresh coriander, bananas, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Saute onion and garlic in oil until soft. Step 2: Stir in chicken cubes and cook until lightly brown. Step 3: Add curry paste and cook for another 2 minutes Dissolve creamed coconut in boiling water and add to pan. Step 4: Add in potato and puree. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Step 6: Stir in yogurt and coriander. Step 7: Chop bananas and mix in with lime juice and zest and chill until curry is ready to serve.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, coconut milk, yellow curry paste, bamboo shoot, frozen peas, pineapple, carrot, water, basil leaves, cashews, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a stir fry pan mix 1 can coconut milk and the amount of curry you desire. Step 2: Then add other can of milk and heat till boiling. Step 3: Add the meat and continue to cook. Step 4: When the meat is about 1 / 2 way done add the carrots and water and cook till carrots are tender. Step 5: Add basil, pineapple, peas, and bamboo shoots and cook 2 more minutes. Step 6: Serve over rice, and garnish with chopped cashews if you desire.

Dish Name: Your Pad Or Mine Chicken Shrimp Pad Thai
Ingredient Names: thai rice noodles, chicken breasts, tofu, roasted unsalted peanuts, tamarind juice, fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, vegetable oil, garlic, shrimp, eggs, bean sprouts, green onion, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Soak noodles in cold water for about 1 hour or warm water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Cut the chicken into 1 / 4-inch strips, set aside. Step 3: Cut the tofu into 3 / 4-inch cubes. Step 4: In a well oiled pan, fry the tofu on all sides until browned. Step 5: Set aside Coarsely chop peanuts with knife or coarsely grind in food processor, set aside. Step 6: In a small bowl, add tamarind juice, fish sauce, sugar and lime juice. Step 7: Beat to thoroughly mix and set aside.

Ingredient Names: bananas, coconut milk, sugar, salt, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat coconut milk until boiled Add banana, sugar and salt and cook for 5 minutes Add mint leaf and turn off the heat.

Dish Name: Bananas Simmered In Jasmine Scented Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: bananas, coconut milk, granulated sugar, sea salt, jasmine essence
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the bananas just before you are ready to cook them. Step 2: In a sauce pan, heat the coconut milk. Step 3: Add sugar to the desired sweetness and a little bit of salt The salt enhances the rich creamy taste of coconut milk, especially if you are using canned milk. Step 4: Sprinkle in a few drops of mali essence, if you wish a delicatae floral scent in the background. Step 5: When the mixture is hot and smooth, add the bananas and simmer about 5 minutes, or until the bananas are cooked but still in whole pieces.

Ingredient Names: sugar, rice, salt, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sugar and vinegar in a saucepan until sugar dissolves. Step 2: Boil the mixture until it starts to thicken. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in salt and chili. Step 4: Allow to cool before serving.

Dish Name: Beef strips with crunchy Thai salad
Ingredient Names: lean steaks total, lime juice, fish sauce, light muscovado sugar, red chile, crunchy salad mixed bsp orange juice, carrots, fresh bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Lightly season the steaks, then grill on each side for 2-3 mins for medium-rare, or longer if you like. Mix the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli together in a jug. Tip the salad, carrot and beansprouts into a bowl, then add the dressing, tossing everything together. Divide between four plates. Step 2: Thinly slice the beef and add to the salad. Some steamed rice flavoured with rice vinegar is a good side dish.

Dish Name: Chai Spiced Cheesecake With Ginger Crust
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil cooking spray, all-purpose flour, ground ginger, salt, unsalted butter, sugar, egg yolk, crystallized ginger, cream cheese, mascarpone cheese, eggs, egg yolks, ground cardamom, vanilla extract, ground allspice
Instructions: Step 1: For crust: spray 9-inch-diameter springform pan with 3 high sides with nonstick spray Sift flour, ginger, and salt into medium bowl. Step 2: Using electric mixer, beat butter and sugar in another medium bowl until blended. Step 3: Beat in egg yolk, then flour mixture. Step 4: Stir in crystallized ginger Gather dough into ball Flatten into disk. Step 5: Roll out on floured surface to 9-inch round. Step 6: Transfer to prepared pan. Step 7: Press onto bottom and 1 inch up sides of pan.

Ingredient Names: mini chicken fillets, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, peanut butter, coconut milk, fresh cilantro, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Take the mini chicken fillets and slice any large ones into fingersize lengths. Mix with the soy and sweet chilli sauces. Thread onto skewers, then place on a baking tray lined with baking parchment, cover with cling film and freeze. Step 2: To serve, defrost in the fridge overnight and cook at 200C/180C fan/gas 6 for 10-12 mins or until cooked through. For the dip, combine the peanut butter and coconut milk. Scatter the skewers with coriander leaves and chopped peanuts, if you like. Serve with the dip.

Ingredient Names: coconut cream powder, warm water, sugar, salt, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the coconut cream powder and the warm water together. Step 2: Spoon a bit of the liquid into the cornstarch to liquefy, and then add back into the coconut milk mix. Step 3: Add sugar and salt and bring to a boil If lumps form for any reason, strain them out. Step 4: Cool mixture and use in your ice cream maker Delicious! Step 5: You can also do the poor man's freeze ice cream where you freeze, scrape, freeze, scrape like granita but the texture is not going to be as nice as the ice cream machine If your ice cream maker only makes a quart at at a time then just double the recipe.

Ingredient Names: heavy cream, coconut milk, sugar, egg yolks, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Mix beaten eggs with the sugar, zest and lime juice, then add the cream and coconut milk Follow instructions for ice cream maker and then when at a soft serve consistancy, put in freezer to allow it to firm up.

Ingredient Names: rice flour, sugar, salt, coconut milk, eggs, coconut, vegetable oil, red food coloring, green food coloring, sweetened condensed milk, shredded coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Beat flour, sugar / splenda, salt, coconut milk and eggs in medium size bowl until smooth. Step 2: Stir in 3 / 4 cup coconut. Step 3: Divide batter evenly among 3 bowls, and tint one bowl with red coloring, and another with green coloring - leaving one batter untinted Lightly oil an 8" nonstick frying pan and heat until it is hot To make the pancakes, pour about 1 / 4 cup batter in the skillet and swirl the pan until the batter completely covers the bottom. Step 4: Cook until the tope of the pancake is almost dry and the bottom is light brown Gently turn the pancake and brown the other side Upon removing the pancake, roll the pancake up and place on an oven-proof dish. Step 5: Place in a warm oven to keep warm. Step 6: When serving, drizzle with sweetened condensed milk, and sprinkle with coconut.

Ingredient Names: cream cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, sherry wine, worcestershire sauce, curry powder, salt, mango chutney, peanuts, green onion, coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Blend pate ingredients together until combined. Step 2: Line an 8" cake pan with plastic wrap and fill pan with cheese mixture. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and chill 4 hours Defrost at room temperature before proceeding Unmold pate on a large platter. Step 4: Pour chutney over, then sprinkle with peanuts, onions, and coconut. Step 5: Serve with crackers Enjoy!

Dish Name: Duck Spring Rolls With Dipping Sauces
Ingredient Names: spring roll wrappers, sage leaves, basil leaves, cilantro leaves, zucchini, sweet potatoes, cooked duck, balsamic vinegar, rhubarb, cherry preserves, orange zest, scallion, water, peanut butter, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat in a saucepan all rhubarb cherry sauce ingredients for 5-10 minutes till rhubarb is tender With a hand blender blend till smooth. Step 2: Place in a small bowl garnished with scallions, set aside. Step 3: Heat all peanut sauce ingredients till blended about 30 seconds in the microwave. Step 4: Place in small bowl and garnish with peppers, set aside. Step 5: In a bowl of room temperature water soak spring rolls to soften Lay them on work surface place on each herbs following with rest of ingredients off center. Step 6: Then roll, bring sides in, then roll to seal.

Ingredient Names: sweet chili sauce, oranges, garlic, thai red curry paste, chicken drumsticks skin
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with foil. Mix the chilli sauce with the orange zest and juice, garlic, curry paste and ¼ tsp salt. Add the chicken and coat really well. Step 2: Arrange the drumsticks on the foil, spaced apart. Coat the chicken with any marinade left in the bowl, then roast for 35-40 mins until tender. Wrap in foil or pack into a food container.

Ingredient Names: palm sugar, bananas, coconut milk, coconut ice cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the sugar in a small frying pan. When melted, add the bananas and caramelise on each side for 3-4 mins. Lift out and set aside. Step 2: Tip the coconut milk into the pan with a pinch of salt, stir into the sugar and bubble until syrupy. Divide between 2 bowls, top with the caramelised bananas, then add a scoop of ice cream and scatter with toasted coconut.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, sunflower oil, ginger, mild red chili, green onions, sweet soy sauce, sugar, cilantro only
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Place the fish in a shallow baking dish, then grill for 4-5 mins until cooked through, but still a little pink in the centre. Cover and set aside. Step 2: Heat a wok, add the oil, then stir-fry the ginger, chilli and spring onions for 2-3 mins. Stir in the soy, sugar and a splash of water, then take off the heat. Throw in the coriander and serve immediately with the salmon. Delicious with rice or noodles.

Dish Name: I Tim Ma Muang Mango Ice Cream
Ingredient Names: egg yolks, sugar, milk, heavy cream, vanilla extract, mango
Instructions: Step 1: Ina heavy-bottomed medium saucepan, beat egg yolks and sugar together. Step 2: Stir in milk until well combined. Step 3: Cook medium heat, stirring constantly with a whisk until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove pan from heat, cover, and let cool. Step 5: Stir in heavy cream and vanilla until well combined. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate until cold Peel and cut mango. Step 7: Remove all flesh and discard seed. Step 8: In a food processor, process mango flesh until slightly chunky. Step 9: Stir mango into cold custard.

Dish Name: Khanom Puto A Steamed Sweet Savory Coconut Muffin
Ingredient Names: plain flour, desiccated coconut, baking powder, egg, sugar, coconut milk, coconut cream, glutinous-rice flour, cornflour, salt, sweet corn, dried anchovies, garlic chives
Instructions: Step 1: Muffins: mix together the 1 1 / 3 cup of flour, dessicated coconut, baking powder, egg, sugar and coconut milk to make a smooth batter. Step 2: Pour the batter to half fill the mini silicone muffin cups. Step 3: Steam the muffins for 5 minutes, Topping: mix together the 1 / 2 cup coconut cream, glutinous rice flour, corn flour, sugar, salt to make the coconut cream topping. Step 4: Take the muffins at 5 minutes and smear evenly with a small teaspoonful of coconut cream topping mixture, and then sprinkle with dried anchovies dust, corn kernels and garlic chives, then return to steamer for additional 3 minutes Lift from steamer, release gently from silicone molds and serve.

Dish Name: Khao Pad Sapparod Thai Pineapple Rice
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, cooked rice, roasted cashews, pineapple, shrimp, coriander roots, white pepper, sugar, fish sauce, coconut milk, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Cut half of the pineapple into cubes. Step 2: Prepare all remaining ingredients and have at hand. Step 3: In a small saucepan, heat the coconut milk to a boil. Step 4: Add the coriander root, white pepper, sugar and fish sauce. Step 5: Reduce heat and simmer the sauce for 3-5 minutes, then strain. Step 6: Preheat a wok over medium high heat and add the oil, to coat the sides of the wok. Step 7: When the oil is hot, add the meat, pineapple, cashews and rice. Step 8: Stir and toss to combine well Slowly pur the seasoned coconut milk over the rice, 1 / 4 cup at a time until the rice is just moistened You will have more than enough seasoned coconut milk, any leftovers can be frozen for future use.

Ingredient Names: sticky rice, water, coconut milk, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice several times until the water runs clear. Step 2: Soak in water above the level of the rice 6-8 hours or overnight. Step 3: Steam rice until soft It will be sticky - it's supposed to be In the meantime, pour coconut milk into a saucepan and add salt and sugar. Step 4: Heat just to a slow simmer - do not boil, as it will curdle. Step 5: Remove from heat and reserve 1 / 3 cup to use as a sauce Peel and slice mango. Step 6: When rice is done, pour remaining sauce over the rice and allow to sit until all sauce is soaked into rice To serve, scoop out a mound of sticky rice and serve with sliced mangoes on the top or the side.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, gelatin, hot water, granulated sugar, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Scoop out the flesh of the mangoes & puree it in a food processor or blender until smooth. Step 2: Set it aside in the processor / blender. Step 3: In a saucepan, heat water until is reaches a rolling boil, then remove it from the heat While stirring the water with a whisk or fork, sprinkle the gelatin over the surface of the water & stir briskly to remove any lumps. Step 4: Add the sugar to the gelatin mixture & stir to dissolve. Step 5: Add this mixture to the mango in the processor / blender, then add the coconut milk & process briefly until ingredients are combined. Step 6: Pour this finished mixture into 4 dessert bowls & put in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours but not more than 24 hours. Step 7: Serve cold on its own, or with fresh fruit & enjoy!

Dish Name: Mashed Thai Red Curry Sweet Potatoes
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, coconut milk, thai red curry paste, maple syrup, unsalted butter, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f Prick sweet potatoes all over with a fork Roast on a baking sheet for about an hour, until soft. Step 2: Cool slightly, peel and scoop out flesh Alternative method: peel and dice sweet potatoes and roast till soft This produces more roasted flavor / texture. Step 3: Mash with a potato masher. Step 4: In a saucepan, combine coconut milk and curry paste. Step 5: Bring to a bare simmer Do not allow to boil as the coconut milk will curdle.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, coconut milk, sugar, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel mangos and cut fruit from pit. Step 2: Puree all ingredients except one mango in food processor. Step 3: Refrigerate 1 hour or more. Step 4: Serve a generous portion over vanilla ice cream as well as remaining fresh, chopped mango I triple the recipe for a dinner party -- which is enough for about a gallon of ice cream Enjoy!

Dish Name: Mung Bean Cake With Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: mung beans, coconut milk, light brown sugar, eggs, shallot, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium pot, combine beans with 2 cups water and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and cook for 20 minutes, until beans are soft, puree in blender. Step 3: In a bowl, beat coconut milk and sugar until frothy. Step 4: Add eggs and beat well. Step 5: Add bean puree and mix thoroughly. Step 6: Put mixture in a saucepan and cook over medium heat until mixture begins to thicken Pre-heat oven to 350f grease an 8-inch square cake pan. Step 7: Fold mixture into pan. Step 8: Bake for 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: fresh coriander, coconut milk, lemongrass bruised, fresh lime leaves, green chilies, mussels, fish sauce, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Crush the coriander stems in a mortar using a pestle, then put into a large pan with the coconut milk, lemongrass and ginger. Bring to the boil and simmer for 4 mins. Add the lime leaves and chillies, then stir in the coconut cream. Step 2: Add the mussels and fish sauce, then cover with an ill-fitting lid or baking tray so that the mussels can steam, but the broth won’t boil over and make a mess of your stove. Bring the liquid back to the boil, then simmer for a few mins, shaking the pot every so often so the mussels move around and open up – this should take about 3-5 mins. Step 3: When all the mussels are open, add the lime juice but don’t boil again. Taste, and if you like it, good – otherwise add more chilli for heat, more lime for sourness and more fish sauce if you think it needs salt. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with the coriander leaves to serve.

Ingredient Names: lean pork steak, light soy sauce, sesame oil, coconut milk, red thai curry paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind paste, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak 12 bamboo skewers in water while marinating the meat. Mix the meat with the soy sauce and sesame oil, and place in the fridge for at least 30 mins or up to 24 hrs. Step 2: In a saucepan, combine coconut cream and red curry paste, then cook for 5 mins on a low heat. Add the fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind paste and chopped peanuts, cook for a further 5 mins, then add the coconut milk. Step 3: Heat the grill to high, thread marinated meat onto the soaked skewers and place on a baking tray. Grill for 5 mins on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately with the satay dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Salt & pepper squid with roast chilli dressing
Ingredient Names: size squid, white peppercorns, flaky sea salt, flour, groundnut, long chili, palm sugar, limes, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the squid into large pieces, then score a criss-cross diamond pattern into the flesh, without cutting all the way through. To make the chilli dressing, pound the roasted dried chilli in a mortar and pestle (or food processor), then add the palm sugar. Pound again, adding the lime juice and the fish sauce. Mix well and place to one side. Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4 and slide a baking sheet in. Step 2: Pound the peppercorns and sea salt together, then stir into the flour in a large bowl and set to one side. Heat a few cms oil in a wok or deep frying pan. Step 3: Place the wok over a high heat; when the oil starts to shimmer, it is ready. Toss the squid in the seasoned flour so that it is coated well. Step 4: Drop a quarter of the squid into the oil and fry for about 1 min. The squid should curl and go crisp. Lift out of the oil with a slotted spoon and keep warm in the oven on the baking sheet while you cook the rest. Serve straight away, with the dressing on the side.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken drumsticks skinless chicken thighs, juice lime, lemongrass very, thumb-size chunks ginger very, garlic, peanut butter crunchy, turmeric ground cumin, coconut milk, fresh coriander, oil, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Slash several deep cuts into each drumstick and thigh, then put into a large, non-metallic container. Put the lime zest and juice, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, peanut butter, spices, coconut cream and 1 tsp salt into a food processor, then whizz until it’s as smooth as you can get it. Roughly chop the coriander leaves and finely chop the stalks, then add to the mix. Pour the marinade over the chicken, massage it into the meat with your hands, then leave to chill for at least 2 hrs, or up to 24 hrs if you have time. Step 2: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Line 1-2 large baking trays with foil and grease with a little oil. Spread out the chicken over the trays, skin-side up, and roast for 1 hr, or until the chicken is cooked through and the coating golden and slightly charred in places. Cool, then chill well and pack in a container, ready to transport. Scatter with a few more coriander leaves to serve, if you like.

Dish Name: Skinny Thai burgers with sweet potato chips & pineapple salsa
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes unpeeled, olive oil, lean pork, thai red curry paste, green onions, fresh coriander, pineapple chunks, limes, red chile, sweet chili sauce, gem lettuce, buns
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the sweet potato chips with the oil and some seasoning on a baking sheet. Roast for 40-45 mins until golden and crisp. Step 2: Mix the mince with the curry paste, half the spring onions, half the coriander and some seasoning. Shape into 4 burgers. Step 3: Mix remaining spring onions and coriander with the pineapple, lime juice, red chilli and sweet chilli sauce. Step 4: When the chips have 10 mins to go, heat a non-stick frying pan or griddle and cook the burgers for 3-5 mins on each side until golden and cooked through. Serve the burgers in the buns with lettuce leaves and salsa piled on top, the sweet potato chips and extra chilli sauce for dipping.

Ingredient Names: cinnamon sticks, ground nutmeg, whole cloves, cream, palm sugar, coconut milk, eggs, egg yolks
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to warm 160c. Step 2: Put the spices, cream and 1 cup water in a pan. Step 3: Bring to a simmer then reduce heat to very low. Step 4: Leave for 5 minutes to let the spices flavour the liquid. Step 5: Add the sugar and coconut milk. Step 6: Return to low heat and stir until sugar is dissolved. Step 7: Whisk the eggs and egg yolks together. Step 8: Pour the spiced mixture over the eggs and stir well. Step 9: Strain- discard the whole spices. Step 10: Pour the custard mixture into eight 1 / 2 cup dishes.

Dish Name: Spicy Sweet Potato Fries With Sriracha Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: olive oil, chili-garlic sauce, sweet potatoes, ground cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, fresh ground black pepper, sour cream, garlic clove, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Step 2: Whisk olive oil and sriracha together in a small bowl. Step 3: Pour over sweet potatoes in a large bowl and toss to coat. Step 4: Combine cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt and pepper in a small bowl. Step 5: Add spices to potatoes and toss to coat. Step 6: Arrange potatoes in one layer on an unoiled baking sheet. Step 7: Bake on lowest rack 10 minutes. Step 8: Turn potatoes with a spatula and bake 10 more minutes, or until golden brown on all sides While potatoes are cooking, whisk dipping sauce ingredients together in a small bowl. Step 9: Remove potatoes from oven and serve with sriracha dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, ginger, garlic, red chilies, chicken turkey, light brown sugar, fish sauce, limes, fresh lime leaves, mix iceberg lettuce gem cos leaves, mint cilantro, peanuts, shallots rings
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Fry the ginger, garlic and chillies for 1 min. Add the mince, then cook on a high heat until golden brown, breaking it up with a wooden spoon as you go. Sprinkle over the brown sugar, fish sauce, lime juice and shredded lime leaves, then cook everything down until sticky. Step 2: Tip the mince into a serving bowl, then serve with a bowl of lettuce leaves for wrapping the mince in; the herbs, shallots and peanuts for scattering over; and the lime wedges for squeezing.

Dish Name: Sticky Rice With Mango Thai Dessert
Ingredient Names: glutinous rice, water, coconut milk, sugar, salt, cornstarch, mangoes
Instructions: Step 1: To speed things up even further, make your sauces and prep your fruit while your rice is soaking / cooking Be sure to use glutinous rice, which can be found at asian markets It will be labeled "glutinous rice" and / or "sweet rice" Good ripe mangoes are a must, so be sure you can find them first, before you go any further. Step 2: Soak raw rice in plenty of water for 30 minutes. Step 3: Rinse the rice by stirring it with your fingers, draining, and refilling with water. Step 4: Stir-drain-refill a couple or three times, then finally drain most of the water away until the rice is covered by about a quarter inch of water Microwave on high, covered, for ten minutes Shake a 13 5 ounce can of coconut milk well before opening then divide in half: pour one half into a bowl or tall glass to make the rice sauce, and keep the other half in the can to make the cream sauce.

Ingredient Names: sticky rice, unsweetened coconut milk, sugar, salt, mangoes
Instructions: Step 1: Drain soaked rice and transfer it to steamer basket. Step 2: Place steamer basket over several inches of water in a saucepan or the base of a steamer. Step 3: Bring water to rolling boil over medium-high heat. Step 4: Cover and cook, adjusting heat to maintain steady flow of steam, until rice swells and glistens and is sticky enough to pinch into chewy lumps, 30-45 minute replenish steamer basket with water as needed to maintain flow of steam While rice steams, combine coconut milk, sugar, and salt in medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 5: Cook and stir gently for 3-4 mins, until sugar and salt dissolve into smooth sauce. Step 6: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 7: When rice is cooked, transfer to large bowl You will have about 4 cups cooked sticky rice.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Broccoli With Thai Oyster Sauce
Ingredient Names: broccoli, garlic cloves, shallots, peanut oil, oyster sauce, fish sauce, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok over high heat until it begins to smoke Swirl in the oil to coat its surface evenly. Step 2: Let the oil heat for 15-20 seconds. Step 3: Add chopped garlic, followed 10 seconds later with the sliced shallots or onion. Step 4: Saute 15-20 seconds to flavor the oil, add broccoli. Step 5: Toss with the oil for about a minute before sprinkling with oyster sauce to lightly coat the pieces. Step 6: Stir-fry another minute. Step 7: Season with fish sauce If the stove is very hot, add 1-2 tablespoons water as needed to help steam the vegetable so it doesn't burn.

Ingredient Names: egg, coconut cream, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients in a blender. Step 2: Blend on medium speed for just a half minute, or until the mixture is smooth. Step 3: Pour into a bowl or other container you can use in a steamer. Step 4: Heat a steamer until the water in steamer is boiling. Step 5: Set container on steamer basket which rests inside the steamer pan above the boiling water. Step 6: Cover and steam for about 30 - 45 minutes until the custard is set. Step 7: Remove from heat and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, peas, shrimp, sunflower oil, fresh bean sprouts, green onions, eggs, peanuts, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, cilantro only
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pan of water to the boil, add the noodles and cook for 3 mins, adding the peas and prawns for the final min. Drain, and set aside while you heat the oil in a large frying pan. Step 2: Fry the noodles, prawns, peas, beansprouts and spring onions, tossing to coat in the oil for a few mins. Push everything to one side of the pan and pour in the egg. Stir until cooked, then mix everything well. Toss through the peanuts, soy and sweet chilli sauce so everything is combined. Scatter with the coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, olive oil, red curry paste, panang curry paste, coconut milk, chili, fresh spinach, fish sauce, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Saut onion, garlic, and ginger in the olive oil on medium high heat in a large pot until the onion is transparent. Step 2: Add the sweet potato and pastes, mix well. Step 3: Allow for mixture to heat up. Step 4: Add coconut milk and chili, stir. Step 5: Allow for mixture to heat up. Step 6: Add all the spinach to the pot, but do not mix, cover the pot. Step 7: After 5 minutes, the spinach should be wilted.

Dish Name: Sweet Potatoes With Red Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: sweet potatoes, thai red curry paste, chicken stock, unsalted butter, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place potatoes in a saute pan, cover with chicken stock and swirl in the red curry paste. Step 2: Cook covered until tender Reserve liquid for another use like cooking rice. Step 3: Mash potatoes, add butter, salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Cake With Mango Sauce
Ingredient Names: eggs, brown sugar, salt, oil, coconut milk, coconut extract, baking powder, all-purpose flour, mangoes, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350, grease a tube pan. Step 2: Beat the egg whites on high for about 3 minutes - till they resemble whipped cream, and set aside. Step 3: Beat the egg yolks, adding in the sugar, salt, oil, coconut milk and coconut extract. Step 4: Add the baking powder and then the flour to the yolk mixture. Step 5: Beat just till blended. Step 6: Fold the egg whites into the yolk mixture just till incorporated - you want to keep it as fluffy as you can but still mixed. Step 7: Pour into your prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes - or till the top is golden brown and an inserted knife / cake tester comes out clean Sauce: Place all the sauce ingredients into a blender or food processor and blend till smooth.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, evaporated milk, sugar, eggs, all-purpose flour, butter, salt, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Beat the eggs, coconut milk, sugar, salt, evaporated milk, vanilla and for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add the butter to a medium saucepan. Step 3: When melted add the egg mixture. Step 4: Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until a think paste is formed. Step 5: Remove from heat and cool. Step 6: Add the flour and mix. Step 7: Preheat the oven to 375f. Step 8: Fill a piping bag with the cooled paste and pipe out the mixture into cookie shapes onto a butteres baking sheet or parchment lined cookie sheet. Step 9: Bake for 20 minutes until brown.

Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, sugar, and salt in medium saucepan and bring to gentle boil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cook, stirring often, until sugar dissolves and mixture is smooth. Step 3: Transfer to bowl, cool to room temp, and then cover and chill until very cold. Step 4: Transfer to bowl of ice-cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's directions. Step 5: Serve at once, or transfer to airtight container and freeze for up to 2 weeks.

Ingredient Names: eggs, all-purpose flour, vanilla essence, coconut, brown sugar, coconut milk, mint leaf, icing sugar, fresh fruit, butter
Instructions: Step 1: Grease one baking dish or 3 individual ramekins with butter. Step 2: Preheat oven to 260c. Step 3: Beat eggs and sugar well till it thickens. Step 4: Add essence and coconut milk, beat again. Step 5: Mix in grated coconut I have to add here that i think you should use only fresh coconut for the best result, mix well. Step 6: Pour into baking dish. Step 7: Place dish in a baking tray filled halfway with hot water.

Ingredient Names: red rice, chicken stock, canola oil, limes, soy sauce, honey, cucumber, green onions, red bell pepper, red onion, cherry tomatoes, kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Wash the rice well and drain. Step 2: In a heavy-bottomed pot, combine the rice and stock. Step 3: Bring to a boil over high heat and let boil for 1 minute. Step 4: Stir the rice to prevent sticking. Step 5: Cover the pot and reduce the heat to the lowest possible setting and simmer until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender, about 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove the pan from the heat and let stand covered for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, whirl the canola oil, lime juice, soy sauce and honey in a blender until smooth to make the vinaigrette. Step 8: When done, fluff the rice with a fork and combine the rice and vegetables in a large bowl. Step 9: Add the vinaigrette and stir to combine. Step 10: Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Dish Name: Thai Mango With Sticky Rice Mamuang Kao Nieo
Ingredient Names: glutinous rice, coconut cream, coconut milk, sugar, salt, sweet mangoes
Instructions: Step 1: To make the sticky rice, refer to my sticky rice recipe, which i have also posted. Step 2: Season the coconut cream with some salt and refrigerate it Dissolve sugar and salt in coconut milk. Step 3: Mix and stir the coconut milk with the warm sticky rice and let it stands for 30 mins To serve, place some mango strips over a large scoop of sticky rice mixture and add some coconut cream over the top.

Ingredient Names: water, sugar, water chestnuts, red food coloring, tapioca flour, coconut milk, rose essence
Instructions: Step 1: For sugar syrup --------------- Dissolve sugar in water by bringing it to a boil This takes about 1 minute. Step 2: Then remove and chill in the fridge For the water chestnuts ------- Peel the skin from the water chestnuts Diced them into small cubes about 3 to 5 by 3 to 5mm. Step 3: Mix the diced water chestnuts with red food colouring. Step 4: Add the diced water chestnuts into a plastic bag of tapioca flour and shake well to cover them with flour. Step 5: Pour the water chestnuts from the bag into a sieve.

Ingredient Names: bananas, self-rising flour, rice flour, water, salt, roasted sesame seeds, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the bananas and cut the very end off both sides then cut the banana in half and then again lengthwise Sift the self-rising flour, the rice flour and salt into a bowl. Step 2: Add enough water to make a smooth batter then mix in the roasted sesame seeds. Step 3: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or deep fryer to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Step 4: Dip each banana piece into the batter until fully coated then fry a few pieces at a time until crisp and golden. Step 5: Remove the banana pieces with a large slotted spoon or a wire basket and drain on some paper towels You can enjoy the banana pieces either hot or at room temperature as is, or by dipping them into golden or maple syrup.

Ingredient Names: serrano peppers, garlic, fish sauce, rice vinegar, water, granulated sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Remove stems from chillies and place chillies and peeled whole garlic in a mortar and grind into a paste Or alternately, you may place in a small spice mill set on pulse. Step 2: Combine ground garlic / chilli mixture with fish sauce, rice vinegar, water and sugar in a small saucepan, and whisk together. Step 3: Set heat on medium, and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, and cook, stirring, until mixture has thickened and lightly coats the back of a spoon, about 15-20 minutes. Step 5: Allow to cool, and store in a sealed container in the refrigerator until used.

Dish Name: Thai chicken and sweet potato soup
Ingredient Names: olive, garlic, red chile, chunk ginger, lemongrass, cilantro separately, red thai curry paste, chicken stock, coconut milk, sweet potato, skinless chicken breasts, lime juice only, sugar, fish sauce, crusty bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Add the garlic, chilli, ginger, lemongrass, coriander stalks and curry paste and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until the aromas are released. Step 2: Add the chicken stock, coconut cream and sweet potatoes and cook for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are soft. Remove the lemongrass and discard. Carefully transfer to a blender and blitz until smooth. If freezing, for best results freeze at this point, otherwise as an easier option freeze complete recipe. Step 3: Return to the saucepan, add the chicken and cook gently for 5 - 10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Stir through the lime juice, sugar and fish sauce, scatter with the coriander leaves and serve.

Dish Name: Thai fishcakes with sweet chilli sauce
Ingredient Names: skinless salmon fillet, skinless white fish fillet, prepared squid, red chili paste, fresh lime leaves, green beans, fish sauce, egg whites, oyster sauce, groundnut, white rice vinegar, granulated sugar, fat red chilies, cucumbers, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Put the salmon, white fish and squid into a food processor, then whizz until smooth. Add the chilli paste and pulse until well mixed. Place all the other ingredients, except the oil, into a large bowl. Add the fish mixture, then knead together for 5 mins until smooth and elastic. Step 2: Shape into small flat discs about 5cm across. Heat a few cms oil in a wok until it shimmers, then fry the fishcakes in batches for 2-3 mins until golden. Drain on kitchen paper. Can be chilled for up to 1 day, then reheated in a hot oven for 5 mins. Step 3: For the chilli sauce, place the vinegar, sugar, 2 tbsp water and the whole chillies in a small saucepan, then bring to the boil. Simmer for 15 mins, then remove from the heat. Place in a food processor and blend until smooth. Strain, saving 1 tsp chilli, then stir in the saved chilli and leave to cool. Will keep in the fridge for up to 1 week. Serve fishcakes with the chilli sauce, cucumber and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: creamed coconut, soft brown sugar, fish sauce, thai green curry paste, sweet potato, red peppers, skinless chicken breasts, cilantro lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Dissolve the creamed coconut with 3 tbsp boiling water and mix to a smooth paste. Stir in the sugar, fish sauce and curry paste. Step 2: Place a large piece of baking parchment on a baking sheet. Arrange the sweet potato and pepper in the middle of the paper, clearing a space in the centre. Lay the chicken breast in the space and pour over the sauce. Fold over the top edges of the parchment to form a seal and scrunch up the ends like a sweet wrapper. Step 3: Cook in the oven for 25-30 mins or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender. Sit the parcel on a dinner plate or shallow bowl and carefully open. Sprinkle with coriander and squeeze over some lime juice, to taste.

Dish Name: Tom yum (hot & sour) soup with prawns
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, lemongrass, galangal, coriander roots, fresh lime leaves, shrimp, thai fish sauce, green chilies, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the stock to a boil in a medium-sized saucepan. Add the lemongrass, galangal, coriander roots and lime leaves, then simmer for 2 mins. Step 2: Add the prawns, fish sauce, chillies and lime juice, then return to the boil. Taste and adjust the seasoning with either more lime juice or fish sauce, then garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

Ingredient Names: granulated sugar, water, lime rind, lime juice, cantaloupe, mango, bananas, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In small saucepan, cook sugar with water over medium heat, stirring, until sugar is dissolved, remove from heat. Step 2: Stir in lime rind and juice. Step 3: Let cool Peel, seed and cube cantaloupe, place in bowl. Step 4: Cut off 2 opposite sides of mango as close to pit as possible. Step 5: Cut grid pattern of 1 / 2-inch cubes in flesh of each side down to skin, turn inside out, cut off cubes.

Dish Name: Winter Squash In Coconut Milk Fusion Soup
Ingredient Names: winter squash, butter, coconut milk, brown sugar, salt, vanilla extract
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, combine squash, butter, coconut milk, sugar and salt and bring to a slow boil. Step 2: Cook, stirring, until squash is very tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Step 3: Cool to room temperature or refrigerate Just before serving, stir in vanilla Pure mixture in a blender or leave it chunky. Step 4: Serve cold or at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: thai rice noodles, crunchy peanut butter, sambal oelek chili paste, lime, fish sauce, dark brown sugar, vegetable oil, shrimp, cherry tomatoes, bean sprouts, cilantro, roasted peanuts, lime slice
Instructions: Step 1: Place rice noodles in a large bowl. Step 2: Cover with very hot tap water, stir and set aside until tender, 20 minutes Do not over soak. Step 3: Drain and reserve 1 cup soaking liquid. Step 4: Whisk to combine peanut butter, sambal, lime zest, fish sauce and brown sugar in a medium bowl, set aside. Step 5: In a large skillet over high heat, warm oil until shimmering. Step 6: Add shrimp and cook until nearly cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Step 7: Add noodles, peanut butter mixture and cup reserved soaking water. Step 8: Cook until fragrant and warmed through.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, thangkwa, hom daeng, nam som paep, haeo, prik chi fa daeng
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the cucumber in four lengthwise, then slice the pieces to segments about an eighth of an inch thick. Step 2: Slice the tops of the chilies, tap out any loose seeds and discard, then slice the chilies across into thin rounds. Step 3: Slice the shallots and water chestnuts. Step 4: Combine and serve This will keep 2 or 3 weeks in a refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, green onions, garlic cloves, ginger, tamarind paste, honey, peanut butter, rice vinegar, fish sauce, chinkiang vinegar, sesame oil, olive oil, serrano pepper, bell pepper, artichoke hearts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice noodles according to directions on package. Step 2: Add oils to a medium sauce pan or skillet, then add garlic, ginger, and 3 chopped green onions and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Step 3: Add rice noodles and blend thoroughly. Step 4: Add all remaining ingredients except for egg whites and cilantro, and blend thoroughly. Step 5: Heat for about 5 minutes while stirring. Step 6: Blend egg whites in thoroughly and cook until opaque, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Serve with lime wedge and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, panko breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, cilantro, garlic cloves, green onion, egg, brown sugar, white wine, soy sauce, fresh ginger, garlic sauce, safflower oil, soba noodles
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, over low heat, add the brown sugar, white wine and soy sauce. Step 2: Stir and cook just until the sugar melts, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the ginger and sriracha. Step 4: Stir and continue to simmer over very low heat, for 10 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the heat, set aside. Step 6: In a large bowl, add all of the meatball ingredients. Step 7: Using your hands, mix well Form the mixture into small meatballs. Step 8: In a shallow frying pan, add about a 1 / 4 inch of safflower oil.

Dish Name: Awesome Spicy Thai Boneless Pork Loin
Ingredient Names: soya sauce, lime juice, honey, oil, ginger, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, roast
Instructions: Step 1: Mix soya sauce, lime juice, honey, oil, ginger, garlic and chilies, blend well. Step 2: Put pork roast in a zip lock bag and add marinate. Step 3: Refrigerate overnight and turn occasioally 400 oven. Step 4: Grease a shallow roasting pan roast pork uncovered for 15 mins. Step 5: Reduce to 350 Interior temperature should reach 170 f.

Dish Name: Basil Eggplant Aubergine Pud Makua Yow
Ingredient Names: oil, thai basil, sugar, garlic cloves, fish sauce, japanese eggplants, chili peppers, water
Instructions: Step 1: Peel eggplant if desired. Step 2: Slice the eggplant into irregular shapes for easy turning while cooking. Step 3: When it is sliced into rounds it makes it difficult to flip around the pan. Step 4: Heat a pan or wok to medium high. Step 5: Add oil, chili peppers and garlic. Step 6: Stir until the garlic is toasted slightly. Step 7: Add eggplant and stir. Step 8: Add a cup of water and cover the pan. Step 9: Keep the lid closed until the eggplant is cooked, about 5 minutes Almost all of the water should be evaporated.

Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, beef rump, garlic cloves, cinnamon stick, star anise, light soy sauce, thai fish sauce, granulated sugar, bean sprouts, scallion, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the stock into a large, heavy pan. Step 2: Add the beef, garlic, chopped coriander roots, cinnamon sticks, star anise, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar. Step 3: Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes Skim off any form that rises to the surface of the liquid with a slotted spoon. Step 4: Meanwhile, divide the bean sprouts among four individual serving bowls. Step 5: Remove and discard the cinnamon sticks and star anise from the stew with a slotted spoon Ladle the stew over the bean sprouts, garnish with the chopped scallions and chopped fresh coriander and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: oil, garlic cloves, shallots, coconut milk, curry powder, red curry paste, beef, fish sauce, sugar, turmeric, lime juice, water, egg noodles, green onion, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large saucepan and add oil. Step 2: When oil hot, stir-fry garlic & shallots for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add coconut milk, curry posder, red curry paste, and then the beef. Step 4: Heat to boiling, then reduce to medium heat. Step 5: Simmer for ~30 minutes. Step 6: Add fish sauce, sugar, turmeric, and lime juice. Step 7: Stir to combine all the ingredients and bring to a slow boil Continue to cook for 10 minutes. Step 8: In a medium saucepan, heat the water to rapid boiling. Step 9: Stir in fresh noodles and cook for 1 minute in rapidly boiling water.

Dish Name: Chicken Stir Fry With Chili And Basil
Ingredient Names: chicken breast fillets, vegetable oil, green onions, birds eye chiles, soy sauce, fish sauce, palm sugar, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok and swirl to coat. Step 3: Add the chicken in batches and stir fry over high heat for 5 minutes each batch, or until the chicken is tender. Step 4: Add the spring onion and chili and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar and toss briefly. Step 6: Stir in the basil and serve with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Chicken Stir Fry With Spicy Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, sesame oil, peanut butter, water, garlic powder, vinegar, boneless skinless chicken breasts, olive oil, onion, broccoli spear, carrot, snow peas, cayenne pepper, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly whisk together ingredients for marinade and marinate sliced chicken for 30 minutes at room temperature or 1-2 hours refrigerated While chicken is marinating, thoroughly whisk together ingredients for sauce in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat 1 tbs Oil in wok at medium-high heat. Step 3: Drain chicken and cook for 10 minutes or until no longer pink. Step 4: Set cooked chicken aside, covered. Step 5: Reduce temperature to medium heat and heat 1 tbs Oil in wok. Step 6: Cook vegetables for 10 minutes or until tender but crisp.

Dish Name: Chicken With Basil And Red Peppers
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, scallions, red bell pepper, chicken breast, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok or frying pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic, scallions, red pepper and stir fry 5 minutes. Step 3: Add chicken and cook until done. Step 4: Stir in fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar and cook until sauce begins to become thick. Step 5: Stir in basil leaves and cook 5 minutes or just until leaves are wilted. Step 6: Garnish with fresh basil if desired and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: onion, mushroom, olive oil, curry powder, potato flour, water, cream, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil a couple of minutes. Step 2: Add curry powder and fry gently until softened. Step 3: Add potato flour, stir. Step 4: Add water, cream and sweet chili sauce. Step 5: Stir and cook 5-7 minutes on low heat.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, red onions, garlic cloves, butternut squash, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, vegetable stock, lemongrass, lime, baby spinach leaves, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Using a large, heavy based saucepan, heat the sunflower oil and add the onion Over a gentle heat, cook this for 7-8 mins, until the onion is golden and tender. Step 2: Add garlic and squash. Step 3: Cook over a medium heat for 3-4 minutes, stir occasionally. Step 4: Stir in the coconut milk, curry paste and stock and bring it all to the boil. Step 5: Add the lemon grass, reduce the heat and cover the pan. Step 6: Allow to simmer for 25-30 mins or until the squash is tender. Step 7: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the coriander, lime juice and spinach. Step 8: Serve immediately, ideally with rice.

Dish Name: Crockpot Peanut Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps
Ingredient Names: natural-style peanut butter, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, hot chili paste, chicken broth, chicken breasts, sweet pepper, green onion, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix peanut butter, garlic, ginger, soy sauces, sesame oil, sriracha and broth. Step 2: Place frozen chick breast in bottom of crockpot and pour peanut sauce over breasts. Step 3: Cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours Shred chicken and add back about cup of the peanut sauce. Step 4: Serve on lettuce with green onions and peppers.

Dish Name: Do It Yourself Mild And Creamy Yellow Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, red onion, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, lemon zest, lemon juice, brown sugar, ground coriander, cumin, turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Whirl all ingredients in a food processor or blender, scraping down sides as needed, until pureed, 1 to 2 minutes Use immediately or refrigerate in a jar for up to a month Storage Pop out and store in a freezer bag Makes 9 cubes.

Dish Name: Do It Yourself Red Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, red onion, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, lime zest, lime juice, brown sugar, ground coriander, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Whirl all ingredients in a food processor or blender, scraping down sides as needed, until pureed, 1 to 2 minutes Use immediately or refrigerate in a jar for up to a month Storage Pop out and store in a freezer bag Makes 9 cubes.

Dish Name: Do It Yourself Spicy Green Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, jalapeno, fresh basil leaf, fresh cilantro, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, lime zest, lime juice, brown sugar, ground coriander, cumin
Instructions: Step 1: Whirl all ingredients in a food processor or blender, scraping down sides as needed, until pureed, 1 to 2 minutes Use immediately or refrigerate in a jar for up to a month Storage Pop out and store in a freezer bag Makes 9 cubes.

Ingredient Names: wide rice noodles, vegetable oil, garlic, cooked chicken, soy sauce, oyster sauce, eggs, sugar, mung bean sprouts, fresh basil, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Soften noodles by soaking in hot water. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Add oil to hot pan or wok, cook garlic. Step 4: Add precooked chicken. Step 5: Add soy sauce and oyster sauce, and noodles, stir until everything is mixed well Move noodles to side of pan and crack eggs, mix to scramble, move noodles over egg until cooked, add sugar. Step 6: When everything cooked and ready to serve, add bean sprouts, peppers and basil. Step 7: Add crushed red pepper or pepper sauce to taste.

Ingredient Names: red chilies, shallots, garlic, lemongrass, galangal, coriander powder, ground cumin, coriander roots, shrimp paste, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Using a pestle and mortar or grinder blend all ingredients together until they form a smooth paste You should have about 6 tablespoons.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, peking duck, chicken stock, palm sugar, fish sauce, snake beans, kaffir lime leaves, cherry tomatoes, fresh pineapple chunks, thai basil, salt, dried red chilies, shrimp paste, garlic, shallots
Instructions: Step 1: To make make curry paste soak chillies in water for 1-2 minutes or until soft. Step 2: Remove stems and seeds and roughly chop. Step 3: Heat frypan over high heat, wrap shrimp paste in foil and heat in the pan for 5 minutes or until fragrant. Step 4: Cool then use a mortar and pestle to pound the shrimp paste and remaining curry paste ingredients into a fine paste, adding a little water if necessary Or chop ingredients into a paste using a small food processor To make duck curry, place coconut milk and curry paste in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add duck, stock, sugar, fish sauce, beans, lime leaves and a pinch of salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add tomatoes and pineapple and cook for another 3 minutes Just before serving stir in basil leaves.

Ingredient Names: chicken breast, vegetable oil, onion, potatoes, yellow curry paste, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the chicken in the vegetable oil until just starting to turn golden. Step 2: Add the onion and keep cooking until soft. Step 3: Add the potatoes and pour in the yellow curry paste and the coconut milk, mix well. Step 4: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked through You can add a little chicken stock if the mixture starts to dry out. Step 5: Serve with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: bird chiles, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, peanut oil, coconut milk, tofu, fresh basil leaves, thai fish sauce, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the peppers, lemongrass and lime leaves to a paste. Step 2: Heat the oil in a skillet and add the paste. Step 3: Fry until fragrant. Step 4: Add the chicken or tofu and cook until chicken is cooked through. Step 5: Add the basil and fish sauce to taste. Step 6: Serve on thinly shredded cabbage.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, fish sauce, five-spice powder, sesame oil, palm sugar, garlic cloves, coriander root, rice wine, pork spareribs
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Add the spareribs, coat well and leave to marinate overnight. Step 3: Preheat oven to 180c and bake spareribs for 20 minutes Barbecue over medium heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean pork, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, onion, red bell pepper, dried red chili, fresh ginger, fresh ground black pepper, fish sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil to medium-high. Step 2: Stir-fry garlic, dried chile, and pork, about 3-4 minutes until pork is nearly done. Step 3: Add onions, ginger, bell pepper, and stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 4: Add black pepper and remaining liquids and stir-fry another 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Taste and adjust seasonings. Step 6: Serve over white rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, thai chiles, fresh ginger, ground pork, fish sauce, green onion, cilantro, yellow onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok. Step 2: Add first 3 ingredients till fragrant, add ground pork, cook till no pink. Step 3: Add yellow onion cook about 2 minutes, add green onions. Step 4: Cook another 2 minutes. Step 5: Add cilantro and fish sauce. Step 6: Cook 1 more minute. Step 7: When cooking last 3 ingredients, use your judgment on how you like the firmness of them--you might want to cook more or less.

Dish Name: Green Beans And Ground Pork Spicy
Ingredient Names: fresh green beans, ground pork, thai chiles, garlic cloves, oil, water, fish sauce, pork bouillon cube, salt, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok on med heat. Step 2: Add garlic and peppers, saute 1 minute. Step 3: Add ground pork and cook until pink is gone.
