Step 4: Add green beans, water, fish sauce, salt, bouillon cube, and brown sugar, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cook on medium heat until green beans are tender. Step 6: Add more water, salt or fish sauce as desired for your taste. Step 7: Serve with white rice if desired--enjoy.

Dish Name: Green Curry Paste Gaeng Kiow Wan
Ingredient Names: green chilies, lemongrass, shallots, garlic, galangal, coriander roots, coriander powder, ground cumin, white pepper, kaffir lime zest, shrimp paste, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Using a mortar and pestle or a grinder, blend all the ingredients together until they form a smooth paste This will make approximately 3 tablespoons.

Dish Name: Green Curry Paste Namphrik Gaeng Keau
Ingredient Names: thai green chili, turmeric, garlic, galangal, lemongrass, coriander root, lime peel, shallots, ginger, shrimp paste
Instructions: Step 1: Put chillies, turmeric and garlic in a mortar & pestle and pound / grind well. Step 2: Add lemongrass, galangal, coriander, and lime Pound / grind well. Step 3: Add shallot, lesser ginger & shrimp paste - grind / pound until smooth and there are no major lumps.

Ingredient Names: galangal, lemongrass, fresh lime leaves, coriander, green onions, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, green chili, lime zest, lime, sugar, dark soy sauce, fish sauce, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together all of the ingredients You can use a blender to chop and mix the ingredients if you wish To use- heat oil in a pan. Step 2: Add some curry paste and fry until fragrant Use in recipes as required.

Ingredient Names: pork shoulder, coconut milk, green curry paste, japanese eggplants, fish sauce, palm sugar, salt, kaffir lime leaves, thai holy basil, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan, warm 1 / 2 cup coconut milk over medium heat until it boils and simmer 5 minutes. Step 2: Add curry paste and cook 2 minutes. Step 3: Add sliced pork and stir fry 4 minutes. Step 4: Add coconut milk, eggplant, red pepper, fish sauce, sugar, salt and 5 lime leaves. Step 5: Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Taste and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce or sugar. Step 7: Slice remaining lime leaves into very thin strips. Step 8: Add lime leaves and basil. Step 9: Serve over jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, thai basil, fresh cilantro leaves, green onions, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, jaggery, hot chili sauce, ground pork, chunky peanut butter, fresh ginger, garlic, ground star anise, vegetable oil, french rolls
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare a medium-hot fire in a charcoal grill with a cover, or preheat a gas grill to medium high For the dressing: combine the mayonnaise, basil, cilantro, green onions, and lime juice in a bowl. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate For the patties: combine the fish sauce, jaggery, and chili sauce in a medium bowl. Step 3: Add the pork, peanut butter, ginger, garlic, and star anise and blend loosely with a fork Form into 6 equal patties the approximate dimensions of the rolls, making a slight depression in the middle of the patties to compensate for the tendency to bulge during cooking. Step 4: Brush the grill rack with oil. Step 5: Grill the patties with the grill top closed for 4 minutes. Step 6: Turn and grill until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of the patties registers 160 degrees f, about 4 minutes longer During the last 2 minutes of grilling the patties, place the rolls, cut side down, on the grill to toast.

Dish Name: Grilled Pork Skewers With Smoked Red Curry Bbq Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, red onion, fresh pineapple, salt and pepper, olive oil, sugar, red curry paste, onion, garlic cloves, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Soak wooden skewers 30-45 minutes Preheat ~ ignite ~ light -- fire up your grill! Step 2: In a medium-sized saucepan, combine all bbq sauce ingredients. Step 3: Cook over medium heat until it starts bubbling, then reduce to simmer It will thicken into a barbecue sauce consistency - then you can turn off the heat. Step 4: Put pork and onion in a bowl. Step 5: Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper to season. Step 6: Stir until all is coated Assemble skewers: alternating pineapple, red onion then grilled pork Each skewer will have approximately two large pieces of each.

Dish Name: Grilled Thai Sirloin With Tangy Lime Sauce
Ingredient Names: boneless beef top sirloin steaks, soy sauce, olive oil, chili oil, garlic powder, pepper, cilantro, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, lime slice, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, combine 3 tablespoons soy sauce, olive oil and hot chili oil. Step 2: Whisk until blended In second small bowl, combine garlic powder and 3 / 4 teaspoon pepper. Step 3: Place beef steak in large shallow dish. Step 4: Pour 1 / 2 of soy sauce mixture over one side of steak. Step 5: Sprinkle with 1 / 2 of garlic powder mixture and 1 / 2 of chopped cilantro Rub mixture firmly into beef. Step 6: Turn steak over and repeat on second side. Step 7: Cover and marinate in refrigerator 20 minutes. Step 8: Place steak on grid over medium, ash-covered coals.

Dish Name: Homemade Thai Seasoning Blend Thai Spice Mix
Ingredient Names: ground cumin, sea salt, fresh ground white pepper, fresh ground black pepper, thai red chili pepper, dried lemongrass, lime zest, garlic powder, ground ginger, dried mint, unsweetened coconut, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Process all ingredients in a food processor or bash together with a pestal and mortar Seal in an airtight container.

Ingredient Names: red chilies, garlic cloves, fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Pound chillies and garlic together until a paste is formed. Step 2: Transfer to a bowl, add fish sauce, lime juice and sugar to taste and stir well to mix Adjust flavours to that sauce is equally salty and sour with a touch of sweetness Rest the sauce for 15 minutes before using to allow the flavours to merge.

Dish Name: Instant Pot Thai Green Curry Chicken
Ingredient Names: green curry paste, coriander powder, cumin powder, onion, coconut milk, chicken breasts, chicken broth, fish sauce, lime juice, green bell pepper, zucchini, green beans, bamboo shoots, fresh lime leaves, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: In your instant pot, saute curry paste with spices for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Step 2: Add onion and saute a couple of minutes And coconut milk, chicken, broth, fish sauce, and lime juice Seal cooker, bring to pressure, and cook 4 minutes Do a quick release. Step 3: Add bell pepper, zucchini, green beans, and bamboo shoots. Step 4: Saute for about 5 minutes or until veggies reach your desired level of tenderness. Step 5: Add lime leaves and basil and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, fish sauce, lime, ginger, garlic cloves, brown sugar, sesame oil, onions, serrano peppers, thai basil, black pepper, breadcrumbs, ground pork
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl add the fist 9 ingredients, stir and microwave for 30 seconds, stir and microwave again until mixtures just starts to bubble. Step 2: Set aside to cool for 10 minutes. Step 3: Combine remaining ingredients into sauce that has cooled and mix with hands to incorporate all ingredients. Step 4: Place meat mixture in fridge for an hour. Step 5: Make 4 patties and grill to medium well in middle. Step 6: Serve on a roll with a spicy mayo. Step 7: Top with favorite burger toppings.

Dish Name: Karee Curry With Chicken From Thailand
Ingredient Names: chicken, curry powder, coconut milk, onion, baby potatoes, chili, sugar, salt, fish sauce, rice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the chicken into portion sized pieces Legs and thighs can be left whole. Step 2: Heat a small amount of oil in a frying pan, and stir in curry powder until fragrant. Step 3: Stir in one cup of coconut milk until the powder mixture is well dissolved. Step 4: Place the chicken into the mixture and simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through. Step 5: Meanwhile, slice the onion, peel and dice the potatoes. Step 6: Add the vegetables and remaining coconut milk and spices to the pan and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Step 7: Meanwhile, prepare rice according to package directions Immediately serve the karee over top of the rice.

Dish Name: Ken Hom's Stir Fried Mixed Vegetables
Ingredient Names: broccoli, asparagus, pak choi, baby corn, peanut oil, shallots, red chilies, fish sauce, water, oyster sauce, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Separate the broccoli florets and peel and thinly slice the stems on the diagonal. Step 2: Cut the asparagus into 4cm pieces. Step 3: Cut the chinese leaves into 4cm strips Halve the baby corn lengthways or leave it whole Blanch the broccoli in a large pot of boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Step 4: Drain and plunge them into cold water to stop them from cooking. Step 5: Heat a wok or large frying pan until hot. Step 6: Add the oil and when it is very hot and slightly smoking, add the shallots and chillies and stir fry for 1 minute. Step 7: Then add the baby corn and the asparagus. Step 8: Stir fry for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce and water, bring the mixture to the boil, cover and cook over high heat for 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Krung Gaeng Keo Wan Thai Green Curry Paste
Ingredient Names: caraway seed, black peppercorns, whole cloves, laos powder, ground nutmeg, dried rhizome, lemongrass, cilantro, garlic, shallots, lime rind, serrano chilies, shrimp paste, salt, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the whole, dries spices in a mortar and grind to a smooth powder. Step 2: Take your food processor, and put these spices plus other ground spices in, and add the rest of the ingredients and process til everything combines and forms a smooth, thoroughly combined paste.

Ingredient Names: carrots, coriander, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Juice the carrots Blend with coriander and coconut milk in a blender or food processor Drink.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, hot pepper, peanut oil, soy sauce, splenda granular, rice vinegar, sesame oil, tea, scallions, fresh cilantro, lemongrass, ground turkey, instant brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f Coat 6 muffin pan cups with nonstick spray Thai peanut sauce: Puree all ingredients together to make an almost smooth sauce Chunky peanut butter can be used for more texture Loaves: Pulse scallions, cilantro, lemongrass and garlic 8 to 10 times in food processor until finely chopped Scrape into large bowl. Step 2: Add turkey, rice, 1 / 2 cup each of coconut milk and peanut sauce, and the sesame oil. Step 3: Mix thoroughly with your hands.

Ingredient Names: thai chiles, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic clove
Instructions: Step 1: Chop the seedless chilies and garlic, and pound in a mortar Add all the other ingredients and pound just to mix them.

Ingredient Names: pumpkin puree, coconut milk, thai red curry paste, maple syrup, unsalted butter, coarse salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, combine coconut milk and curry paste. Step 2: Bring to a bare simmer Do not allow to boil as the coconut milk will curdle. Step 3: Cook for five minutes, stirring the curry into the coconut milk. Step 4: Add squash, 2 tbs Butter and salt, mix to combine. Step 5: Add maple syrup to taste Butter small gratin dishes or a large casserole. Step 6: Spoon mixture into dishes and dot with remaining butter.

Ingredient Names: dried small red chilies, lemongrass, shallot, garlic, galanga root, kaffir lime leaves, fresh cilantro, coriander seed, salt, ground cinnamon, nutmeg, ground cloves, brown sugar, shrimp paste, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Soak chiles briefly in warm water till they begin to soften, then drain. Step 2: Remove stems from chiles and chop into pieces, set aside. Step 3: Place coriander seed in a small skillet over low heat and heat, swirling the pan, until the seeds are fragrant and toasty. Step 4: Remove from heat and set aside. Step 5: In a food processor, place the shallots, lemongrass, garlic, galanga, kaffir lime leaves, cilantro, chopped chiles, coriander seed, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, brown sugar, shrimp paste, and 2 tbsp oil Process till fairly smooth and even colored, adding some more of the oil as necessary to keep blades moving. Step 6: Store in an airtight container under refrigeration Can be frozen, as needed.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, yellow curry paste, chicken, coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, paprika, lime, potatoes, yellow pepper, carrots, onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pan on medium heat and add curry paste. Step 2: Stir fry until fragrant. Step 3: Add chicken and cook for about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, paprika, and lime zest or kaffir leaves Continue to simmer chicken for about 10 minutes, then add potatoes. Step 5: Add other veggies about 5 minutes after potatoes Total cooking time after adding chicken to pan is ~30 minutes. Step 6: Serve with rice I like to use brown rice because it is healthy I cook the brown rice for about 20 minutes before adding white rice -- it makes a great mixture that is much healthier than plain white rice.

Ingredient Names: pork, sugar, tamarind pulp, soy sauce, thai fish sauce, eggs, peanut oil, garlic cloves, tofu, vermicelli rice noodles, bean sprouts, scallions, dried shrimp, dry roasted peanuts, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Set out condiments: chile-vinegar sauce recipe#425009, 1 / 2 cucumber - sliced, lettuce leaves, 1 lime cut into wedges, salted radish, a small bowl of sugar, and a small bowl of cayenne pepper. Step 2: Place the pork in a bowl and add the sugar. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix the tamarind, soy sauce, and fish sauce In another bowl, lightly beat the eggs. Step 4: Place all the bowls within reach. Step 5: Place a large wok over high heat. Step 6: Add about 1 1 / 2 t of the oil. Step 7: Once hot, add the garlic and fry until the color changes. Step 8: Toss in the pork and fry until it has all changed color About 1 minute if it is cut thin.

Ingredient Names: madras curry powder, cayenne pepper, onion, extra virgin olive oil, butter, coconut milk, chicken stock, peanut butter, salt, boneless chicken, potato, whole tomatoes, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat butter and oil in saute pan. Step 2: When hot add slivered onions and saut to near opaque. Step 3: Add cayenne and madras curry powder. Step 4: Saute for five minutes. Step 5: Add chicken stock and all ingredients except potatoes and chicken. Step 6: Cook on medium for 20 minutes stirring often. Step 7: Add chicken and potatoes cook to warm Thai curry is more like a soup I like to serve this over plain white rice.

Dish Name: Nam Jim Satay Thai Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: roasted unsalted peanuts, garlic cloves, onion, red curry paste, fish sauce, coconut milk, lime juice, palm sugar, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: If you wish use peanut butter rather than fresh peanuts First grind or crush the peanuts to a fairly fine powder. Step 2: Then combine them with the remaining ingredients, to form a smooth sauce If the sauce is too thick, you can thin it with a little chicken stock. Step 3: Now add the lime juice, tasting as you progress to check the balance of flavors is correct If you are doing shrimp satay then use half the quantity of massaman paste.

Dish Name: Nam Prik Nam Pla Traditional Thai Sauce
Ingredient Names: thai fish sauce, fresh lime juice, birds eye chiles, brown sugar, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix until thoroughly blended. Step 2: Store in airtight container up to two weeks. Step 3: Serve with thai fried rice, grilled meats and satays, noodle soups or even with plain jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Not Your Average Joe's Voodoo Pizza
Ingredient Names: frozen pizza, peanut butter, peanuts, curry sauce, carrots, fresh ginger, onion, green onions, bean sprouts, sesame seeds, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle, spread and dot your favorite frozen pizza with the peanut butter, peanuts, carrots, ginger, curry sauce, onions, green onions, bean sprouts and sesame seeds. Step 2: Bake according to manufacturer's instructions Dress with coriander leaves.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, curry powder, garlic, shallots, jalapeno peppers, fish sauce, palm sugar, basil leaves, bell pepper, peppercorn
Instructions: Step 1: Grind the garlic, shallots, curry powder and peppercorns into a paste. Step 2: Put the paste into a medium sized skillet, and stir-fry the paste until thick. Step 3: Add in the chicken and the remaining ingredients and stir fry until the chicken is thoroughly cooked, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: dried rice noodles, pork, cooking oil, garlic cloves, broccoli, eggs, oyster sauce, sweet soy sauce, light soy sauce, sugar, ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare noodles, soak in room temperature water to soften for 20 to 40 minutes. Step 2: Heat 4 tblsp cooking oil in a wok over medium heat until hot. Step 3: Add garlic, followed by pork, and stir fry for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the noodles and stir fry another 2-3 minutes until brown and soft. Step 5: Add the vegetables and stir fry to combine. Step 6: Then add the sauce ingredients and stir fry to combine Move the stir-fry mixture to one side of the wok and add the remaining oil. Step 7: Add the beaten egg and fry for one minute and then combine with the rest of the noodle mixture. Step 8: Stir fry to combine and serve.

Dish Name: Pad Thai Or Thai Fried Noodle
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, shrimp, eggs, bean sprouts, peanuts, fish sauce, chili powder, sugar, vegetable oil, black soy sauce, cold water, green onion, limes, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Soak rice noodle stick in warm water for 15 minutes or in cold water for 1 hour, drain. Step 2: In a hot frying pan, add oil, add eggs and stir. Step 3: Add shrimp or chicken and stir fry until cooked. Step 4: Mix rice noodle stick with cold water, vinegar, black soy sauce, sugar, fish sauce, and chili powder in the pan, stirring occasionally until absorbed, turn off heat. Step 5: Add bean sprouts, ground peanuts, and chopped green onion, mix well. Step 6: Serve with slice of lime.

Ingredient Names: white vinegar, sugar, fish sauce, zinfandel
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients and boil for 10 minutes Will keep in refrigerator for up to a month.

Dish Name: Pad Thai With Peanut Butter Sauce
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, olive oil, garlic cloves, thai fish sauce, sugar, vinegar, paprika, egg, sweet soy sauce, green onions, roasted peanuts, bean sprouts, green onion, lemon, red chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Pad thai: Soak rice noodles in cold water for 30 minutes or until soft. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium heat. Step 4: Stir-fry garlic for 3-4 minutes. Step 5: Add the noodles and stir-fry until the noodles are translucent. Step 6: Reduce heat if the noodles begin to stick together. Step 7: Add fish sauce, sugar, vinegar and paprika Continue to stir-fry until combined, stir in egg.

Ingredient Names: dried arbol chiles, dried guajillo chilies, fresh lemongrass, roasted peanuts, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, shallot, garlic cloves, serrano chilies, ground coriander, kosher salt, ground cumin, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place dried chiles in a medium bowl. Step 2: Cover with hot water and soak for 15 minutes, drain. Step 3: Place chiles and all remaining ingredients in a mini-processor Process until paste forms. Step 4: Place on sheet in tablespoon lumps to freeze. Step 5: Then place in airtight bag Can be made 2 months ahead.

Ingredient Names: peanuts, dried thai chiles, salt, coriander, galangal, lemongrass, shallots, garlic, nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Pound all ingredients with a mortar an pestle until completely smooth, adding the peanuts last Although recipe makes enough for a curry dish with only 2 servings, you can make as much as you like and refrigerate or freeze in small portions This is an adopted recipe.

Ingredient Names: chunky peanut butter, brown sugar, soy sauce, lime juice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all ingredients together in a microwave safe container or a small saucepan If using the microwave, place covered container in microwave and microwave one minute. Step 2: Whisk again Microwave another 30-60 seconds. Step 3: Whisk again Sauce should now be well blended If using the stovetop, place the saucepan over medium heat and heat, whisking occasionally, until well blended and heated through. Step 4: Spoon over chicken, rice, broccoli, or whatever you wish.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, coconut milk powder, water, peanuts, sugar, fish sauce, thai basil, bell pepper, onion, panang curry paste, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Place the curry paste and sugar in the pan and cook to reduce a bit. Step 3: Add the chicken and stir to coat well. Step 4: Add the peppers and onions, stirring to coat. Step 5: Add the coconut concentrate followed by the water / stock and stir well. Step 6: When chicken is almost cooked through add the remaining ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: dried rice noodles, oil, firm tofu, eggs, peanuts, chives, bean sprouts, chicken, lime, crushed red pepper flakes, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, ketchup, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: Soak noodles in warm water until rubbery, at least 30 minute drain well While noodles soak, prepare all the other ingredients. Step 2: In a skillet or wok, cook eggs until done, breaking up as they cook. Step 3: Set aside In same pan, add a little oil and cook chicken, stir-frying until done, set aside. Step 4: Put 3 tbs Oil in wok and heat until hot. Step 5: Add noodles and stir-fry Noodles will stick together forming a ball.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, green curry paste, coconut milk, vegetable stock, caster sugar, shallots, lemongrass, eggplants, bamboo shoots, pork fillets, salt, fish sauce, lime juice, coriander leaves, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large deep frypan and fry the curry paste over medium-low heat for a few minutes, stirring until fragrant. Step 2: Add the coconut milk, vegetable stock, sugar, eschalots, lemongrass and salt and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes Thickly slice the eggplant and cut each slice into quarters. Step 3: Add to the curry with the bamboo shoots, and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until tender. Step 4: Add the pork and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for 5-8 minutes or until pork is cooked. Step 5: Stir in the fish sauce and lime juice, adjusting to taste. Step 6: Serve the curry with steamed rice and lime wedges, scattered with the coriander and mint leaves.

Dish Name: Pork Sirloin Roast With Thai Peanut Sauce Slow Cooker
Ingredient Names: pork sirloin roast, salt and pepper, vegetable oil, creamy peanut butter, palm sugar, nam pla, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, sambal oelek, low sodium chicken broth, scallion, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large skillet with oil. Step 2: Season pork roast with salt and pepper and brown on all sides in skillet This will take about 20 minutes While that is browning, combine all of the sauce ingredients except for the broth in a blender or bowl, and blend until smooth in the blender or with an immersion blender. Step 3: Remove pork roast and place in slow cooker. Step 4: Reduce skillet to low. Step 5: Pour the broth into the skillet and deglaze. Step 6: Pour into the sauce and buzz briefly to incorporate. Step 7: Pour over the pork roast. Step 8: Cover and cook on low for about 4 hours, or until roast reads 140-145 deg f.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, white wine, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, olive oil, red peppers, green onions, fresh cilantro, lime wedges, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tenderloin in half lengthwise. Step 2: In a ziplock bag, combine wine, soy sauce, pepper flakes, ginger, garlic, fish sauce, lime juice and brown sugar. Step 3: Place the pork tenderloin in the marinade. Step 4: Place in refrigerator for 1 / 2 hour, turning occasionally. Step 5: Remove meat from marinade, reserving marinade. Step 6: Heat oil in skillet Brown tenderloin pieces on all sides. Step 7: Cook until almost done. Step 8: Remove from skillet and place on cutting board. Step 9: Place marinade into the same skillet and bring to a simmer.

Dish Name: Pork Tenderloin With Low Fat Lime Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, butter, onions, shallots, dry white wine, reduced-sodium chicken broth, fat free sour cream, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: First make the sauce This can be done well in advance, even frozen. Step 2: Melt butter in a 10 inch non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add onion and shallot. Step 4: Cook, stirring for 3 or 4 minutes or until onion is soft but not brown, add wine. Step 5: Boil until liquid is reduced by half, about 8 minutes, add broth. Step 6: Boil until sauce is syrupy and reduced to 2 cups, reduce heat.

Ingredient Names: green beans, vegetable oil, curry paste, dried shrimp, pork, chicken stock, fish sauce, palm sugar, fresh lime leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a rolling boil. Step 2: Add the green beans and cook 3 minutes, until tender but crisp. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: Heat the oil in a large skillet over low heat, and add the prik king paste and dried shrimp, if using. Step 5: Cook 3-4 minutes, pressing the curry paste and stirring as it softens and becomes fragrant Increase the heat to medium high and add the prok, tossing about 1 minute to coat it with sauce. Step 6: Stir in chicken stock, fish sauce, palm sugar, cooked green beans, and lime leaves, if using, and cook 2-3 minutes more, tossing often, until beans are heated through and sauce is well combined. Step 7: Transfer to a serving dish and serve hot or warm.

Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, orange bell pepper, bamboo shoots, scallion, garlic clove, fresh ginger, red curry paste, boneless skinless chicken breast, curry, reduced-sodium chicken broth, light coconut milk, fish sauce, light brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat medium pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add coconut milk, garlic, ginger, broth, fish sauce and brown sugar, bring to a simmer. Step 3: Add pepper and scallions to coconut sauce while cooking chicken. Step 4: Add bamboo shoots before adding chicken. Step 5: Add red curry paste to taste. Step 6: Cut chicken into 1 / 2 cubes or smaller. Step 7: Add chicken to frying pan with non-stick oil spray and add curry powder. Step 8: Cook so that it is 90% done. Step 9: Add to sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, shallots, gingerroot, green curry paste, chicken broth, cooked chicken, coconut milk, bamboo shoots, salt, basil leaves, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add shallots and ginger. Step 3: Stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Stir in curry paste. Step 6: Stir in chicken broth. Step 7: Cook until broth is reduced by half, about 10 minutes. Step 8: Stir in chicken, coconut milk, bamboo shoots and salt, heat to a boil, reduce heat.

Ingredient Names: cauliflower, peanut oil, onion, garlic clove, light coconut milk, fresh ginger, chili sauce, fish sauce, thai chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the cauliflower until crisp-tender, 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain in a colander, then plunge into a bowl of ice water until cooled. Step 3: Drain very well This can be done 1 day ahead. Step 4: In a medium skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add the onion and saute until golden, 6 minutes. Step 6: Add the garlic and cook until the onion is lightly browned about 1 minute. Step 7: Add the coconut milk. Step 8: When it boils, reduce the heat to medium. Step 9: Stir in the ginger, chili sauce, fish sauce and the chili paste.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, boneless skinless chicken breasts, sugar, fish sauce, red bell pepper, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Equipment: a large frying pan, which works much better than a wok! Step 2: Heat the oil in the frying pan over medium heat. Step 3: Add the curry base and simmer for 2 minutes, so that it is dissolved and foaming. Step 4: Stir in the can of the coconut milk. Step 5: Cook over medium heat for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Add the sliced chicken. Step 7: Simmer for 4 minutes. Step 8: Stir in the sugar, fish sauce and bell pepper. Step 9: Simmer until the chicken is cooked, about 3 minutes more. Step 10: Add the chopped basil.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, garlic cloves, fresh lemongrass, galangal, lime rind, coriander roots, fresh ground white pepper, shrimp paste, ground cumin, ground coriander, red paprika
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the chillies in 5 tablespoons hot water for 1-2 hours. Step 2: Put the chillies together with their soaking liquid, into a blender, along with all the remaining ingredients in the order listed. Step 3: Blend, pushing down with a rubber spatula as many times as necessary, until you have a smooth paste What you do not use immediately should be refrigerated or frozen.

Ingredient Names: dried red chilies, coriander powder, ground cumin, white pepper, garlic, lemongrass, coriander roots, kaffir lime zest, galangal, salt, shrimp paste
Instructions: Step 1: Using mortar and pestle or grinder blend all the ingredients together until they form a smooth paste You should have about 6 tablespoons.

Dish Name: Red Curry Paste Krung Gaeng Deng
Ingredient Names: dried small red chilies, coriander seeds, cumin seed, black peppercorns, lemongrass, coriander root, galangal, lime zest, garlic, shallot, salt, shrimp paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place chiles in a bowl and cover with hot water. Step 2: Keep chiles submerged for 30 minutes or more. Step 3: Heat a small heavy skillet over medium high heat and dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seed and peppercorns Use a spice grinder to grind the spices together into a powder Mortar and pestle method: place ground spices in mortar, add lemongrass, coriander roots and galangal and pound to a paste. Step 4: Add lime zest to blend. Step 5: Add garlic, shallots and salt and pound to a smooth paste. Step 6: Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Step 7: Drain chiles, place in mortar, and pound to a paste. Step 8: When chiles are fairly smooth, add shrimp paste and pound together.

Dish Name: Red Curry Sauce For Fish Rice Or Veggies
Ingredient Names: red curry paste, coconut milk, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all ingredients in a small saucepan until blended. Step 2: Add more curry to taste Be careful, a lot goes a long way. Step 3: Heat over medium-low until bubbling. Step 4: Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Step 5: Pour over fish, rice, and vegetables.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red curry paste, chicken stock, fish sauce, brown sugar, zucchini, sugar snap peas, mushroom, bamboo shoot
Instructions: Step 1: Combine 4 ounces coconut milk, curry paste, stock, fish sauce, and sugar and bring to a boil. Step 2: Simmer for 15 minutes. Step 3: Add vegetables and remaining coconut milk and simmer an additional 15 minutes If using snow peas, add just before serving, serve with rice.

Dish Name: Rockin Jimi Hendrix Thai Chicken Curry
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, thai red curry paste, lime juice, chicken broth, brown sugar, fish sauce, chicken breasts, sliced mushrooms, yellow pepper, garlic, broccoli florets, onion, dried basil, green chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Prep the veggies & chicken and set aside Over medium heat, combine coconut milk with curry paste & blend well. Step 2: Add fish sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, lime juice and garlic. Step 3: Bring to a boil, reduce heat & simmer for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add in all remaining ingredients Continue to simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Add broccoli & yellow peppers, simmer an additional 3-5 minutes. Step 6: Serve over y9our favorite white rice Enjoy the amazing thai curry that you just created with someone special:).

Dish Name: Sesame Coated Pork Medallions With Thai Style Citrus Glaze
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, canola oil, egg white, cornstarch, soy sauce, lemon juice, fresh ginger, ground szechuan peppercorns, sesame seeds, grapefruit juice, fresh orange juice, fresh lime juice, fresh lemon juice, light corn syrup, chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine all the coating ingredients except the sesame seeds. Step 2: Add the pork, toss well so that all pieces are well coated, and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, prepare the citrus glaze. Step 4: Mix the citrus juices with the ginger in a non-reactive saucepan. Step 5: Bring to a boil and boil vigorously for ten minutes. Step 6: Add the corn syrup, chili sauce, and fish sauce, stir, and continue to boil until the sauce reduces to a very light syrup. Step 7: Taste the sauce--it should have a tangy citrus flavor Adjust the flavor as necessary with additional sugar or lemon juice, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Step 8: Place the sesame seeds on a plate and press the medallions into the seeds so that they're well coated on both sides. Step 9: Set aside to dry slightly.

Dish Name: Siamese Watercress With Yellow Beans And Garlic
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, red chilies, watercress, yellow bean sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, thai basil, safflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: Crush the garlic and chillies and transfer to a bowl. Step 2: Stir in the watercress, yellow bean sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and basil. Step 3: In a wok, heat the oil until smoking, then add the watercress mixture and stir-fry for about 1-2 minutes, or until the watercress has wilted. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, oil, garlic, shrimp, chicken, eggs, bean sprouts, peanuts, red chili peppers, cabbage, cilantro leaf, lime wedge, thai fish sauce, white vinegar, white sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice noodles in cold water at least two hours before cooking, drain. Step 2: In a large wok, heat oil and stir-fry garlic for 30 seconds. Step 3: Add shrimp and other meat if used. Step 4: Add the noodles, and stir-fry until done. Step 5: Add sauce ingredients, cook to allow most of this to be absorbed. Step 6: Spread wok contents out to the sides. Step 7: Add eggs, scramble or crack the eggs directly into the wok. Step 8: Stir until partially cooked or in forms of'streaky' yellow and white eggs. Step 9: Add noodle mixture into wok.

Dish Name: Slow Cooker Crock Pot Massaman Curry
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onions, beef brisket, salt, coconut cream, curry paste, water, cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, potatoes, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind paste, roasted peanuts, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Trim meat of excess fat and sinew and cut into 2-3cm cubes. Step 2: Heat the oil in a heavy-based pot and fry the onion until brown. Step 3: Add the meat, season and continue to brown all over. Step 4: Add curry paste, heat through until fragrant. Step 5: Add half the coconut cream, lower the heat and cook gently for about 5 minutes. Step 6: Put the potatoes on the bottom of the slow cooker. Step 7: Pour the mix on top of the potatoes. Step 8: Add the water, remaining coconut cream, cinnamon and bay leaves and cook on low, covered, for 8 hours In the last hour, season to taste with fish sauce, palm sugar and tamarind paste. Step 9: Garnish with peanuts and coriander and serve with steamed basmati or jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, pork, wide rice noodles, broccoli, egg, black soy sauce, soy sauce, white sugar, white pepper powder
Instructions: Step 1: Separate the noodles from each other, and place on a plate. Step 2: Cut the chinese broccoli stems at an angle so they cook easier, in about 2 inch long pieces. Step 3: Make sure to clean well. Step 4: Fry the garlic on high in the oil until lightly browned and fragrant. Step 5: Add the pork and fry until cooked through. Step 6: Keep stirring so the garlic doesnt burn, add the noodles. Step 7: Keep stirring so they dont stick. Step 8: Add the chinese broccoli, and mix well You may need to add a little bit of water so everything cooks & doesnt stick.

Dish Name: Spicy Chicken Stir Fry With Basil
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, chicken breasts, red bell peppers, yellow bell pepper, onion, fresh garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil, sweet basil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare jasmine rice according to package directions. Step 2: In a large wok, heat oil until its very hot. Step 3: Sprinkle red pepper flakes in and add chicken Be very careful not to let the red pepper flakes scorch! Step 4: Trust me, this was learned the hard way. Step 5: Cook chicken until it is no longer pink. Step 6: Add garlic, onion, and bell peppers. Step 7: Cook until the onions and bell peppers are cooked but still have some crispness You don't want them to be too soft, stir frequently. Step 8: Remove wok from heat.

Ingredient Names: coconut vinegar, white sugar, fish sauce, english cucumber, red chilies, unsalted peanuts, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the vinegar, sugar and fish sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Bring to a gentle boil, stirring occasionally and cook for 1 minute. Step 3: Remove from heat and cool to room temperature Peel cucumber, scrape out seeds and cut into small dice. Step 4: Place the cucumber, chillies, peanuts and coriander in a bowl. Step 5: Pour over dressing and toss gently.

Dish Name: Spicy Peanut Sauce From Eating Well
Ingredient Names: smooth peanut butter, light coconut milk, lime juice, reduced sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper in a small bowl until smooth.

Dish Name: Spicy Stir Fried Pork Asparagus And Onions With Lemon Grass
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, fish sauce, soy sauce, low sodium chicken broth, lime juice, light brown sugar, cornstarch, garlic cloves, lemongrass, red pepper flakes, peanut oil, asparagus, water, onion, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Freeze the tenderloin until firm, 20 to 30 minutes. Step 2: Cut the tenderloin crosswise into 1 / 3-inch-thick medallions. Step 3: Slice each medaillon into 1 / 3-inch-wide strips. Step 4: Combine the pork, 1 tsp fish sauce, and the soy sauce in a small bowl. Step 5: Whisk the remaining 2 tbsp fish sauce, the chicken broth, lime juice, brown sugar, and cornstarch in a measuring cup. Step 6: Combine garlic, lemon grass, red pepper flakes and 1 tbsp of the oil. Step 7: Heat 1 1 / 2 tsps oil in a nonstick 12-inch skillet or in a wok over high heat until smoking. Step 8: Add half of the pork to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally and breaking up the clumps, until well browned, about 2 minutes. Step 9: Transfer pork to a bowl. Step 10: Repeat with an additional 1 1 / 2 tsps oil and the remaining pork.

Dish Name: Spicy Thai Basil Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, rice noodles, peanut oil, garlic, thai chile, boneless skinless chicken breast, carrot, green onions, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix sugar, lime juice and fish sauce in small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Bring large pot of water to boil, remove from heat. Step 3: Add rice noodles, stirring to separate noodles. Step 4: Let stand 5 to 7 minutes, or until noodles are tender but firm, drain well, set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in large skillet or wok on medium high heat. Step 6: Add garlic and chili.

Dish Name: Spicy Thai Coconut Shrimp With Rice Noodles
Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic, fresh ginger, coriander, cumin, cinnamon, thai peppers, turmeric, tomatoes, unsweetened coconut milk, water, salt, large shrimp, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet or wok on med-hi heat. Step 2: Add onions and stir, cook for 3 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Add next 5 spices, cook 1 minute. Step 5: Add tomatoes, cook 1 minute. Step 6: Add coconut milk, water, and salt, and bring to a simmer until thickened 5-10 minutes. Step 7: Add shrimp, simmer, stirring for 3-5 minutes. Step 8: Stir in cilantro, lemon juice and zest. Step 9: Serve over rice noodles with lime wedges Rice noodle cooking directions:.

Ingredient Names: skinless chicken breasts, paprika, ginger, ground cumin, ground turmeric, sambal oelek, lemon zest, lemon juice, fresh coriander, salt, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the above ingredients and marinade meat for as long as possible, turning occasionally. Step 2: Cook under grill or barbecue for 3-4 minutes each side. Step 3: Serve with salads hot or cold and gujarati potatoes.

Ingredient Names: tofu, red spanish onion, carrot, green pepper, peanuts, red chilies, lime juice, brown sugar, fish sauce, fresh lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu into 1cm cubes. Step 2: Cut onion in half then into fine slices. Step 3: Cut carrot and pepper into fine strips. Step 4: Combine tofu, onion, carrot, pepper and dressing in bowl, mix well. Step 5: Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Step 6: Serve salad sprinkled with peanuts Dressing: combine chillies, juice, sugar and lemon grass in jar and shake well.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Mixed Vegetables Thai Style
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic cloves, broccoli floret, snow peas, carrot, green pepper, red pepper, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, salt, fresh ground black pepper, scallions, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok, add oil when hot, add the garlic and giger and stirfry for one minute. Step 2: Add broccoli and stir-fry for 1 minute, then add snow peas, carrots and the green and red peppers. Step 3: Stir-fry for an additional 3-4 minutes or until tender but still crisp. Step 4: Blend the soy sauce, hoisin sauce and sugar in a small bowl. Step 5: Stir well, season to taste with salt and pepper and pour into the wok, stirring well to distribute. Step 6: Transfer to a serving dish. Step 7: Garnish with scallions.

Ingredient Names: tea bags, cinnamon sticks, star anise, black cardamom pods, whole cloves, water, sugar substitute, fat-free evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except sugar substitute and milk in a saucepan. Step 2: Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and allow to simmer for 15 minutes. Step 3: Strain into a pitcher. Step 4: Add the sugar substitute and stir until dissolved. Step 5: Chill until very cold To serve, pour 2 tablespoons of evaporated milk over ice in a tall glass. Step 6: Pour over 6-8 oz of iced tea, stir and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: sugar, garlic, water, salt, white vinegar, chili-garlic sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a small, heavy saucepan, combine the sugar, water, vinegar, garlic and salt. Step 2: Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat. Step 3: Stir to dissolve the sugar and salt and reduce the heat to low. Step 4: Simmer until the liquid reduces slightly and thickens to a light syrup. Step 5: Remove from the heat and stir in the garlic chili sauce. Step 6: Cool to room temperature before serving. Step 7: Transfer the cooled sauce to a tightly sealed jar and store at room temperature for 2 to 3 days.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, sugar, salt, water, onion, carrot, cucumber, chili paste, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Boil vinegar, sugar, salt and water in a saucepan for 1 minutes. Step 2: Mix onion, carrot and cucumber pieces in a serving bowl. Step 3: Pour just vinegar mixture over vegetables to cover. Step 4: Taste to see if extra vinegar, sugar or salt is needed to balance flavor For those who prefer spicy relish, in small amounts add chili paste. Step 5: Garnish with chopped coriander. Step 6: Serve with satays, fish cakes or crispy deep-fried snacks.

Ingredient Names: mayonnaise, thai sweet chili sauce, fresh ginger, limes, honey, eggs, panko breadcrumbs, soy sauce, tuna in water, celery, green onion, red bell pepper, sandwich buns, baby greens, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: If baking, preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Step 2: In a small bowl, mix sauce ingredients. Step 3: Place 2 tbls Of the sauce in a large bowl. Step 4: Cover and chill the remaining sauce in the fridge To the same large bowl, add the eggs, panko, soy sauce, and thai chili sauce Break up the tuna and add to the bowl. Step 5: Add celery, green onions and red bell pepper Salt and pepper to taste. Step 6: Stir and let stand about 10 minutes.

Ingredient Names: thai fish sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, fresh ginger, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in food processor and mix, or in a bowl using a whisk Pour over meat of your choice and marinate, refrigerated, overnight.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, onion, fresh ginger, orange juice, garlic and red chile paste, honey, tomato juice, balsamic vinegar, plum sauce, hoisin sauce, worcestershire sauce, dijon mustard, soy sauce, fresh cilantro, fresh lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the sesame oil and cook onion. Step 2: Add ginger and cook 5 minutes. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and cook 20 minutes. Step 4: Strain and cook another 20 minutes This will keep well in the refrigerator.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic cloves, japanese eggplants, fish sauce, sugar, basil, thai chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Peel eggplant if desired. Step 2: Cut into irregular shapes but same sizes That makes them easier to turn and keeps them from sticking to the pan. Step 3: Heat wok over med-high heat. Step 4: Add oil, peppers and garlic. Step 5: Cook until garlic becomes lightly browned, 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Add eggplant and stir. Step 7: Add 1 / 2 cup water cover and simmer 5 minutes, until eggplant has soaked up most of the water and becomes translucent You may need to add more water as it cooks. Step 8: Add fish sauce and sugar.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, sliced mushrooms, carrot, fresh basil, cilantro, soy sauce, fish sauce, lime, ginger, garlic, sugar, sambal oelek chili paste, cornstarch, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, combine the fish sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, ginger, garlic, sugar, and sambal oelek for the sauce. Step 2: Set aside The sauce in this is thin from the veggies If you like a thicker sauce, add 1 tbsp Cornstarch to your sauce, but it won't affect the flavor either way. Step 3: Heat oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add zucchini, mushrooms, and carrots to pan. Step 5: Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add sauce in bowl to pan. Step 7: Stir to mix well, and continue cooking for 5 minutes, until vegetables are crisp-tender.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, fresh cilantro, fresh gingerroot, thai red curry paste, lime, garlic cloves, salt & freshly ground black pepper, olive oil, shallot, gingerroot, hot sauce, soy sauce, creamy peanut butter, water, butter lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix all burger ingredients together except for the olive oil, adjusting the salt and pepper to taste With hands lightly mix the mixture and shape into 4 equal patties about 1 inch thick, pressing in the middle to prevent it from bulging while cooking. Step 2: Place the burgers in the refrigerator and allow to stand for 30 to 45 minutes to allow the flavors to blend Separate the lettuce leaves from the core and wash under running water, place on paper towels to drain. Step 3: Wash the bell pepper, core, seed and slice into thin strips. Step 4: In a large non-stick skillet, heat the olive oil, thoroughly coating the pan. Step 5: Add the shaped burgers and cook over medium-high heat until brown on the outside and cooked through, turning once, approximately 6 minutes per side While the burgers are cooking, place all the dipping sauce ingredients in blender jar and blend until smooth and creamy. Step 6: Pour prepared sauce into individual serving dishes and set aside To plate, place a couple of drained lettuce leaves on a plate, top with cooked burger, a few slices of cucumber and several slices red bell pepper.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, fish sauce, chili paste with garlic, sugar, peanut oil, fresh ginger, garlic, green cabbage, red bell peppers, carrots, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first four ingredients in a bowl. Step 2: Stir well, set aside. Step 3: Heat peanut oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Step 4: Add ginger and garlic, saute 1 minute. Step 5: Add cabbage, bell pepper and carrot, saute 2 minutes. Step 6: Add lime juice mixture. Step 7: Saute an additional 2 1 / 2 minutes, or until cabbage is tender. Step 8: Remove from heat and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: chunky salsa, creamy peanut butter, orange juice, honey, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, fettuccine pasta, boneless skinless chicken breast, olive oil, sweet red pepper, cilantro, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In saucepan or microwave, combine salsa, peanut butter, orange juice, honey, soy sauce and red pepper flakes. Step 2: Heat until well blended. Step 3: In a large skillet, cook chicken in oil over medium heat for 3-5 minutes until browned. Step 4: Add julienned red pepper and cook and stir until crisp-tender. Step 5: Cook fettuccine according to package directions and fold into chicken mixture. Step 6: Stir in sauce, salt to taste and sprinkle with cilantro Wonderful with spiced fruit salad.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken With Basil Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: uncooked rice, water, coconut milk, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, fish sauce, red pepper flakes, olive oil, onion, fresh gingerroot, garlic cloves, ground turkey, sliced mushrooms, green onions, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring rice and water to a boil in a pot. Step 2: Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 15-20 minutes, or according to package instructions. Step 3: In a bowl, mix the coconut milk, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, fish sauce, and red pepper flakes. Step 4: In a skillet or wok, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Stir in the onion, ginger, mushrooms, and garlic, and cook until lightly browned - about 8 minutes. Step 6: Mix in ground turkey, and cook until browned. Step 7: Stir in the coconut milk sauce Continue cooking until sauce is reduced be about 1 / 3. Step 8: Mix in green onions, and basil, and cook until heated through. Step 9: Serve over the cooked rice.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Chicken With Homemade Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut, water, soy sauce, fresh lime juice, fresh ginger, thai chili paste, sugar, shallots, boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Step 1: For coconut milk: Combine dried coconut and boiling water. Step 2: Let steep 5 minutes. Step 3: Puree in a blender or food processor. Step 4: Drain into a bowl with a fine colander or cheesecloth, squeezing coconut to get as much milk as possible. Step 5: Discard coconut and voila!, coconut milk! Step 6: Combine coconut milk, soy sauce, fresh lime juice, fresh ginger, thai chile paste, sugar, and shallots Reserve 1 / 2 cup coconut mixture. Step 7: Pour remaining coconut mixture in a zip-top plastic bag. Step 8: Add chicken breast halves.

Ingredient Names: fresh egg noodles, ground pork, snow peas, minced garlic clove, red curry paste, low-fat coconut milk, chicken stock, curry powder, turmeric powder, fish sauce, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Separate noodles in hot water, as per instructions on the packet, drain & keep warm. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, heat the coconut mild on low heat and slowly stir in the curry paste. Step 3: When it begins to simmer, add in the remaining ingredients, except for the port and snow peas. Step 4: Stir for around 2 minutes then add the port and heat until the pork is cooked. Step 5: Stir in the noodles and snow peas and serve.

Ingredient Names: coffee, coriander seed, cardamom seeds, sugar, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients in the coffee machine and prepare the coffee as you do as usual, let it cool. Step 2: Pour the coffee in a tall glass and add sugar as desired. Step 3: Add 5-6 cubes of ice and decorate with whipped cream.

Ingredient Names: rice, red curry paste, flour, chicken breast, fish sauce, green onions, red onion, gingerroot, sugar, fresh lime juice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: 1-2 cup steamed rice, mixed with 1-2 tb red curry paste allow to dry out a bit or bake at 300 degrees for 15 minutes. Step 2: Heat skillet very hot with 1 tb oil, add rice allowing to puff and jump, set aside and cook ground chicken in same skillet. Step 3: Add 2 tb fish sauce. Step 4: Add 3 tb fresh lime juice. Step 5: Add: 3 inch piece peeled, slivered ginger, cup sliced green onion, red onion slivered, and bunch cilantro chopped. Step 6: Serve on romaine lettuce leaves with red bell pepper garnish.

Dish Name: Thai Cucumber Sauce Nam Chim Taeng Kwa
Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, water, sugar, salt, cucumber, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in saucepan. Step 2: Heat over medium heat, stirring until sugar and salt dissolve. Step 3: Bring to a boil and remove from heat, allow to cool. Step 4: Pour over cucumber, and sprinkle cayenne pepper on top, serve.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, thai red curry paste, tomato paste, canned unsweetened coconut milk, chicken broth, straw mushrooms, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, golden brown sugar, cherry tomatoes, cornish hens, red chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 t oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add curry paste and tomato paste and stir until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add coconut milk, broth, mushrooms, kaffir limes leaves, fish sauce, and brown sugar, bring to simmer, remove from heat. Step 4: Add cherry tomatoes. Step 5: Season sauce with salt and pepper. Step 6: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 7: Heat 2 t oil in large nonstick skiller over high heat. Step 8: Sprinkle hens with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: scallion, fresh cilantro, garlic, fresh gingerroot, lemons, brown sugar, red chilies, fresh lemon juice, ground coriander, turmeric, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all of the curry paste ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree until quite smooth Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, sriracha sauce, sugar, garlic, sesame oil, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl combine all ingredients and stir until the sugar is dissolved.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, basil, lemon zest, extra virgin olive oil, golden raisin, salt, black pepper, chevre cheese, bread, basil leaves, fresh basil leaves, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400f For the eggplant spread, pierce the eggplant in several places with the tines of a fork. Step 2: Wrap in aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour Unwrap the eggplant, let cook slightly, and cut it in half Scoop the cooked pulp onto a cutting board, discarding as many seeds as possible Coarsely chop the eggplant and plant it in a mixing bowl. Step 3: Add the basil leaves, lemon zest, oil, and raisins, combine well. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper, set aside.

Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, spring onions, egg, cornflour, fish sauce, coriander leaves, red curry paste, red chili pepper, green beans, oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Add fish fillets, egg, fish sauce, corn flour, red curry paste, red chillies and coriander leaves in blender. Step 2: Blend it until combined and turns in to the thick paste. Step 3: Transfer the paste in to a bowl now add spring onion and green beans in to the paste. Step 4: Mix well Form the paste in to round patties using wet palms. Step 5: Keep them aside heat oil in a large pan and deep fry patties from both sides until golden- browned. Step 6: Turn off heat drain patties on an absorbent paper serve hot with chili sauce.

Ingredient Names: pizza dough, olive oil, chili-garlic sauce, scallions, garlic cloves, lemongrass, fish sauce, peanut sauce mix, white wine
Instructions: Step 1: Stretch pizza dough to desired size. Step 2: Brush with olive oil Evenly distribute remaining ingredients over the top of the dough. Step 3: Bake in 450 degrees f Oven until golden on bottom.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, peanut oil, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, peanut butter, salt, pepper, garlic, cayenne pepper, coriander powder, ground cumin, onion powder, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut washed, unpeeled potatoes into french-fry shaped pieces. Step 2: Mix together peanut oil, lime juice, fish sauce, peanut butter, salt, pepper, garlic, cayenne, coriander powder, cumin, and onion powder in a large ziplock bag or mixing bowl. Step 3: Add cut potatoes and mix around, making sure potatoes are evenly coated. Step 4: Allow to marinate in this mixture for 1 hour. Step 5: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Step 6: Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Step 7: Pour small amount of vegetable oil on foil and wipe around with paper towel. Step 8: Spread potatoes in single layer on foil, without potatoes touching, if you can. Step 9: Bake for 40-45 minutes, turning potatoes once or twice during cooking.

Ingredient Names: pork steaks, hungarian paprika, ground ginger, lime juice, lime, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle pork steaks with lime juice on both sides. Step 2: Mix paprika, ginger, lime zest, salt & pepper and rub into both sides of pork steak. Step 3: Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours. Step 4: Grill pork steaks on medium high heat until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f Or until barely pink in the middle.

Dish Name: Thai Green Curry Paste Gone Greener
Ingredient Names: hot green chili peppers, onion, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, lemon leaves, fresh lemon rind, coriander leaves, fresh spinach leaves, fenugreek leaves, mint leaf, salt, vinegar, black peppercorns, coriander seed
Instructions: Step 1: In a tava roast the coriander and cumin seeds on low heat for about 2 mins till just fragrant Do not allow to brown. Step 2: Cool and grind with the rest of the ingredients in a blender. Step 3: Store refrigerated for a week.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, reduced sodium soy sauce, green onions, fresh cilantro, crunchy peanut butter, canola oil, brown sugar, fresh ginger, lime zest, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, cooked turkey, pizza dough, oil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare grill for indirect-heat cooking. Step 2: Combine lime juice, soy sauce, onion, cilantro, peanut butter, oil, brown sugar, ginger, lime zest, red pepper flakes and garlic in a stockpot. Step 3: Stir in shredded turkey. Step 4: Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally Unroll pizza dough and pat into a rectangle, approximately 10 x 13 inches. Step 5: Cut dough into 4 equal pieces. Step 6: Reduce grill heat to low. Step 7: Brush grill rack with olive oil. Step 8: Using the indirect grilling method, slide pizza crusts on grill and cook until golden, about 3 to 4 minutes, until dough is puffy and lightly browned. Step 9: Turn pizza crusts over.

Ingredient Names: sugar, cornstarch, reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth, rice wine vinegar, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, fresh ginger, lemongrass, red pepper flakes, cayenne pepper, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, mix together sugar and cornstarch. Step 2: Whisk in broth, vinegar, lime juice, fish sauce, ginger, lemongrass, pepper flakes, and cayenne. Step 3: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until lightly thickened. Step 4: Then reduce heat and simmer 2-3 minutes more. Step 5: Remove from heat and stir in basil. Step 6: Brush on pork or chicken during the last 10-12 minutes of grilling.

Ingredient Names: regular grind coffee, sugar, heavy cream, ground cardamom, almond flavoring, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Add the cardamom to the ground coffee, and brew the coffee. Step 2: When the coffee is brewed, add the sugar and almond flavoring, mix well and then let the coffee cool to lukewarm. Step 3: Fill four 12 ounce highball glasses half-way to the rim with crushed ice and then fill two-thirds full with coffee Into each glass, stir about 1 tablespoon of heavy cream To achieve a layered effect, hold a spoon on top of the coffee and pour the cream slowly into the spoon so that the cream floats on top of the glass over the coffee.

Dish Name: Thai Iced Coffee 12 Hour Brew Technique
Ingredient Names: ground coffee, cold water, vanilla extract, sweetened condensed milk
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together ground coffee and cold water in a pitcher until well combined. Step 2: Let stand at room temperature for 12 hours. Step 3: Pour coffee mixture through a large, fine wire mesh strainer into a dutch oven or other large container, discarding grounds Clean strainer. Step 4: Place a coffee filter or double layer of cheesecloth in strainer. Step 5: Pour coffee mixture through lined strainer into a pitcher. Step 6: Add vanilla extract. Step 7: Cover and store in refrigerator up to 1 week, if desired. Step 8: Stir together coffee mixture and sweetened condensed milk, serve over ice.

Ingredient Names: water, thai tea powder, sugar, ice, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: In a med saucepan over med-heat, bring the water to a boil. Step 2: Stir in the thai tea powder & remove from heat. Step 3: Stir well to mix in the sugar & then let it cool. Step 4: When the tea has cooled to room temp, strain it thru a fine-mesh strainer or coffee filter into a pitcher & chill until serving time To serve, fill 4-6 tall glasses w / ice & then add about 3 / 4 cup thai tea to ea glass. Step 5: Top off ea glass w / 3-4 tbsp evaporated milk. Step 6: Serve at once, as the evaporated milk cascades over the ice & swirls languidly into the tea.

Dish Name: Thai Inspired Chicken And Rice Or Udon Noodles Guey Teow Pad
Ingredient Names: minced chicken, olive oil, udon noodles, fresh garlic cloves, chili powder, fish sauce, sweet soy sauce, soy sauce, water, tomatoes, kaffir lime leaves, unsalted cashews, basil leaves, coriander leaves, shallot
Instructions: Step 1: If using dry noodles or udon noodles soak in water to soften If cooking omelette. Step 2: Whisk together egg and milk. Step 3: Mix in chives or other herbs. Step 4: Heat oil in wok, add omelette mixture and cook until slightly crisp on both sides. Step 5: When the omelette is cooked, remove from the pan. Step 6: Chop the omelette into thin slices and then into small pieces, set aside. Step 7: Heat oil in wok and stir fry garlic and chilli powder for 2 minutes [ Add minced chicken and stir fry until browned.

Dish Name: Thai Inspired Turkey Burgers Low Fat
Ingredient Names: fresh lemongrass, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green onion, fresh cilantro, red chili pepper flakes, lime, water, lean ground turkey, egg white
Instructions: Step 1: Put the lemongrass, garlic, ginger, green onions, cilantro, chili flakes and lime zest into a food processor or chopper along with the water and blitz them until they are finely chopped and combined. Step 2: Add the mixture to the turkey and also put in the egg white. Step 3: Mix the turkey and the other ingredients together by hand until they are well combined. Step 4: Put into the fridge to chill for about 30 minutes for them to firm up a bit. Step 5: Take out of the fridge and shape into four equal sized burger patties. Step 6: Then either fry them off in a pan as you would normally do or do as i do and brush them very lightly with a bit of extra virgin olive oil and cook them on a foreman type grill It takes about 8 minutes or so for them to be fully cooked, serve.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, water, sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat water to a boil and stir in lime juice, empty lime shells, sugar / splenda, and salt. Step 2: Remove from heat and allow to steep for 15 minutes, then allow to cool. Step 3: Strain to remove lime shells if desired, and serve over ice.

Ingredient Names: oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, fresh ginger, red thai chile, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all ingredients together and marinade your choice of meat overnight or at least 30 minutes Perfect for skewer food--my favourite is with chicken or pork.

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, orange juice, soya sauce, fresh ginger, garlic, cilantro, black pepper, bay leaf, honey, pork steaks
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all marinade ingredients together Pour over pork chops or pork steaks Marinade for 4-24 hours Broil or grill as usual.

Dish Name: Thai Marinated Pork With Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: garlic, cilantro, fish sauce, soy sauce, coconut cream, cooking oil, sugar, white pepper, pork, limes, chili powder, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Pork& marinade:combine everything until it's all blended together well. Step 2: Add the pork and let sit for at least 30 minutes I like to let it sit in the fridge overnight Some people like to use dishes or bowls to marinade the meat, but i like to use large zipper seal bags While the meat is soaking we can get going on the dipping sauce: mix everything together and taste If it's too spicy-hot, just add a little more sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice till the flavor is right. Step 3: When it's time to cook the meat, start your grill Skewer the meat if thats what you are doing, and place the items on the grill. Step 4: Cook both sides evenly for a couple of minutes and make sure it's cooked all the way through. Step 5: When eating, dip the meat into the sauce and enjoy.

Dish Name: Thai Masaman Chicken Gaeng Masaman Gai
Ingredient Names: chicken, coconut milk, roasted peanuts, white pearl onions, yukon gold potatoes, bay leaves, cardamom seeds, cinnamon stick, palm sugar, tamarind paste, water, lime juice, curry paste, garlic, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Masaman curry paste is also available in asian markets Peel potatoes, parboil in a cooking pot for 10-15 minutes, then cut in 1 to 2-inch chunks. Step 2: Allow the coconut milk to separate and you will have about two cups of thick "cream" and one cup of thin "milk" In a small saucepan bring the coconut milk to a simmer and add the meat of your choice or tofu. Step 3: Simmer the meat until it begins to become tender because beef takes longer, hence the additional milk. Step 4: Put the coconut cream in a wok and bring to almost a boil, add the massaman paste and "stir fry" until the flavor is maximized. Step 5: Add the remaining cream and curry paste to the meat, add the peanuts. Step 6: Taste and adjust the flavor until it is a good balance of sweet, sour and salty. Step 7: Add the remaining ingredients and cook until heated through.

Ingredient Names: chuck steaks, water, coconut milk, roasted peanuts, nam pla, tamarind juice, coconut sugar, dried chilies, fresh ground black pepper, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, lemongrass, cinnamon stick, cardamom seeds, fresh nutmeg
Instructions: Step 1: Put the steak and water in a pan and bring to the boil. Step 2: Lower the heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour or until the meat is tender To make the curry paste: put the chilies in a pan with the pepper, coriander, cumin, lemon grass, cinnamon, cardamom and nutmeg. Step 3: Cook over low heat until the mixture browns, stirring constantly. Step 4: Transfer to a mortar and pound to a smooth paste. Step 5: Add the remaining ingredients and pound the mixture until smooth. Step 6: Remove the meat from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 7: Add the coconut cream to the liquid in the pan and heat gently, stirring frequently. Step 8: Add the peanuts and a little nam pla. Step 9: Boil the liquid until reduced in volume by one third.

Dish Name: Thai Noodles In Gravy Red Nah
Ingredient Names: yellow bean sauce, water, vegetable oil, flour, sugar, soy sauce, garlic, flat rice noodles, broccoli, pork, chicken, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Coat the chicken and pork well with the flour. Step 2: Mix the garlic and 2 cups of water with the remaining flour and mix well. Step 3: Heat a wok or large fry pan and add the oil. Step 4: Fry the meat in small batches until brown. Step 5: When finished drain the excess oil and add the flour and water mixture and add all the meat. Step 6: Turn to a low heat until a gravy mixture is formed To thicken the gravy add a little more flour and water in a light paste form. Step 7: In a large saucepan cook the noodles as per instructions on the packet. Step 8: Mix the soy sauce with the sugar and mix the yellow bean paste with a little hot water then mix into the meat mix 5 minutes before serving add the chinese broccoli.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, shredded coconut, creamy peanut butter, curry powder, water, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine orange juice, coconut, peanut butter, curry powder, water and cayenne pepper in blender or food processor. Step 2: Blend until fairly smooth consistency is achieved Use as a marinade or to bake or stir fry meat or vegetables.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, dijon mustard, creamy peanut butter, light brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic clove, fresh ginger, cornstarch, vegetables, vegetable oil, linguine, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, combine chicken broth, mustard, peanut butter, sugar, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and cornstarch. Step 2: Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and keep warm In large skillet, over medium high heat, saute vegetables in oil until tender about 5 minutes In large serving bowl, combine hot cooked pasta, vegetables and peanut sauce, tossing until well coated. Step 4: Garnish with chopped peanuts and scallion brushes. Step 5: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: creamy peanut butter, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder, ground ginger, cayenne pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine above ingredients and stir until creamy Add sauce to the stir-fry during the last minute of cooking, stirring to coat food evenly.

Ingredient Names: eggs, water, thin soy sauce, black soy sauce, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, pork stew meat
Instructions: Step 1: Hard boil the eggs, strain and let stand to cool. Step 2: Mix the water, thin soy sauce, black soy sauce in a four quart pot. Step 3: Press the 4 cloves of garlic with a garlic press and place in the solution Finely chop the cilantro and place in the solution. Step 4: Remove the shell from the eggs and place in the solution. Step 5: Add the pork to the solution. Step 6: Bring to a boil and then cook for another twenty minutes or so on high For best flavor let cool and then place in the refrigerator overnight and then boil for another fifteen minutes. Step 7: Serve with rice but best served with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, water, red curry paste, low-fat coconut milk, chicken breast halves, fish sauce, chili paste, sugar, bamboo shoots, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, sugar snap pea, onion, pineapple chunk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring rice and water to a boil in a pot. Step 2: Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 25 minutes. Step 3: In a bowl, whisk together curry paste and coconut milk. Step 4: Transfer to a wok, and mix in chicken, fish sauce, chili paste, sugar, and bamboo shoots. Step 5: Bring to a boil, and cook until chicken juices run clear about 10 minutes. Step 6: Mix the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, snap peas and onion into the wok Continue cooking until are tender If the liquid needs thickening, add flour to a little of the sauce and stir back into the curry. Step 7: Remove from heat, and stir in pineapple. Step 8: Serve over the cooked rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, pork rib chops, jalapeno peppers, garlic cloves, fish sauce, sugar, fresh cilantro, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Step 2: Add the pork chops and cook for 10 min, turning once or until it is no longer pink in the center. Step 3: Remove to a plate and cover with foil while you prepare the sauce. Step 4: Reduce the heat to medium and add the jalapeno peppers and garlic to the skillet If you need to add a little more oil to the skillet, do so now. Step 5: Cook for 1-2 min or until softened, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Stir in the fish sauce and sugar. Step 7: Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Step 8: Pour the sauce over the pork chops and sprinkle with the chopped cilantro and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red curry paste, pork tenderloin, coconut milk, lime, fresh ginger, thai fish sauce, sugar, serrano peppers, habanero pepper, baby corn, garlic, basil leaves, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok to medium high, add oil, add curry paste, stir fry until heat hits you, up heat and add pork, continue stir frying, for a couple of minutes, then stir in coconut milk, toss in lime zest, ginger and garlic, bring to boil, cut heat and simmer until pork is tender. Step 2: Stir in fish sauce, sugar, peppers and baby corn, drained-- if this is too runny at this point add 1 tbls corn starch mixed in a little water, cook until thickened then add basil and cilantro leaves-- serve with any good rice, but fragrant jasmine rice is best with any thai dish.

Ingredient Names: pork mince, breadcrumbs, lemongrass, basil, chili flakes, shallots, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together with hands Shape into four patties Cook on barbeque or pan 3- 5 minutes on each side.

Dish Name: Thai Pork With Coconut Cilantro Sauce
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, fresh cilantro, scallions, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, lemon, chili, lemongrass, light brown sugar, soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil, coconut milk, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: If you have a pork tenderloin, cut it into diagonal slices about 1 / 2 inch thick. Step 2: Make a marinade by adding the cilantro, scallions, ginger, garlic, lemon zest, chile, and lemongrass into a food processor and whiz till you have a paste. Step 3: Put in a bowl and add in the rest of the marinade ingredients If using a blender just blend everything together. Step 4: Place the pork in a dish and mix through the paste and leave to marinade for half an hour or even overnight. Step 5: Heat a frying pan with no oil and add the pork in a single layer, or as close as you can to a single layer, for a minute or two each side until golden Don't worry about the marinade getting all burned and sticky in the pan! Step 6: When the pork is golden remove from the pan and keep warm While the pork is cooking, place reserved marinade in a small saucepan. Step 7: Add in the coconut milk, bring to a boil and boil uncovered for about 5 minutes, until it has thickened a bit. Step 8: Add the fish sauce, lemon juice and chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, red bell peppers, teriyaki sauce, rice vinegar, red pepper flakes, garlic cloves, creamy peanut butter, green onion, dry roasted peanuts, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Put the pork, bell pepper, teriyaki sauce, rice vinegar, red pepper lakes, and garlic in the slow cooker. Step 2: Cover and cook on low until the pork is fork-tender, 8-9 hours. Step 3: Remove the port and coarsely chop. Step 4: Add the peanut butter to the liquid in the cooker. Step 5: Stir well to dissolve the peanut butter and blend with the liquid. Step 6: Return the pork to the sauce and toss to coat. Step 7: Serve in shallow bowls over hot rice and sprinkle with green onions and peanuts Oamc: mix all ingredients in. Step 8: Place in ziptop bag and freeze To serve, thaw overnight and complete recipe as directed.

Dish Name: Thai Red Chicken Curry With Coconut
Ingredient Names: skinless chicken, thai red curry paste, coconut milk, water, coconut, chicken stock cube, tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pan mix the coconut milk with the curry paste and water, bring to the boil, reduce heat to simmer, and, add the chicken pieces. Step 2: Cook for 20 mins or till chicken is cooked, add the tomatoes and the grated coconut. Step 3: Cook for 2 minutes, serve.

Dish Name: Thai Red Chile Sauce Nam Prik Dang
Ingredient Names: thai red chili peppers, garlic, brown sugar, fish sauce, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Puree ingredients in blender or food processor Store in sealed container in refrigerator Serve as a table condiment for thai and other asian dishes.

Dish Name: Thai Red Curry Chicken And Eggplant Aubergine
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red curry paste, boneless skinless chicken thighs, japanese eggplants, fish sauce, kaffir lime leaves, lime, red chilies, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a heavy saute pan over medium high heat. Step 2: Add 1 / 4 can of the thicker coconut milk. Step 3: When it bubbles, add curry paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Step 4: Add additional 1 / 4 can of the thicker coconut milk and cook for 5- 8 minutes, until the oil begins to separate. Step 5: Add chicken and stir to coat well. Step 6: Cook for about 4 minutes until the chicken has changed color and firmed up. Step 7: Add remaining coconut milk, bring to a boil, add eggplant and cook at a simmer, covered until chicken and eggplant are completely cooked. Step 8: Stir in fish sauce and lime leaves. Step 9: Cook at a low simmer for 5 minutes Just before serving, stir in lime juice, chiles and basil.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, beef steak, garlic cloves, red curry paste, coconut cream, beef stock, thai fish sauce, brown sugar, red chilies, coconut, baby spinach leaves, fresh basil leaves, dried red chilies, salt, galangal
Instructions: Step 1: For the nam prik gaeng daeng paste: in a mortar and pestle, pound the ingredients for the red curry paste in the order listed, adding one at a time Alternatively, a much easier method is to use a stick-blender. Step 2: Blend all the paste ingredients together, with a few drops of water, until they form a fine paste For the curry: heat a wok on high, and add the vegetable oil. Step 3: When hot, stir-fry the beef strips in batches for 1 minute, removing each batch when cooked. Step 4: Set aside Saut the garlic until golden brown, then stir 2 tablespoons of curry paste into the wok and fry for a few seconds. Step 5: Add the coconut cream and stir well, bringing to the boil. Step 6: Add the beef stock, and return to the boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: Reduce to a simmer and stir in the thai fish sauce, brown sugar, chilies, coconut shavings and baby spinach leaves.

Ingredient Names: shallots, lemongrass, red chilies, garlic cloves, gingerroot, black pepper, ground cumin, coriander seeds, fish sauce, lime zest, sugar, chili powder, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and process well To use immediately, fry the paste in some oil to release flavors before adding meat, tofu or wheat gluten, or vegetables. Step 2: Add more coconut milk, as desired Include the leftover pieces of lemongrass in your cooking pot - this will add more flavor to the curry Before serving, always do a taste test If not salty enough, add more fish sauce If too salty, add a squeeze of lime juice If too sour, add a little more sugar If too spicy, add more coconut milk or a little plain yogurt. Step 3: When serving, sprinkle fresh coriander and / or ground nuts over the curry.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, thai red curry paste, chicken broth, coconut milk, lime, garlic, gingerroot, tomatoes, cilantro, fish sauce, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in saucepan. Step 2: Add onion and saute until golden brown. Step 3: Add curry paste and stir 1 minute. Step 4: Add broth and coconut milk.
