Step 5: Boil 3 minutes, then stir in lime juice, garlic, ginger, tomato, cilantro, fish sauce and sugar. Step 6: Simmer uncovered until lightly thickened, about 20 to 30 minutes. Step 7: Pour sauce into a blender and blend until smooth. Step 8: Return sauce to pan and re-heat if needed.

Dish Name: Thai Red Pork Curry With Corn And Peas
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red curry paste, lean pork, coconut milk, corn kernel, fresh peas, fish sauce, brown sugar, lime rind, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok, add curry paste and stir fry for one minute. Step 2: Add pork, stir fry until lightly browned. Step 3: Add coconut milk and one cup water, bring to the boil. Step 4: Simmer for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add corn and peas to wok, cook for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add fish sauce, brown sugar, lime rind and basil leaves, toss well. Step 7: Serve with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, gingerroot, thai red curry paste, vegetable stock, coconut milk, pumpkin, asparagus, pattypan squash, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat wok or deep frying pan over high heat. Step 2: Add oil, onions, ginger and curry and cook 1 minute. Step 3: Add stock and coconut milk and bring to simmer. Step 4: Add the pumpkin, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the eggplants and beans and cook another 5 minutes until the pumpkin is soft, stir in basil, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: flank steaks, teriyaki sauce, vegetable oil, fresh gingerroot, garlic, red chili peppers, skewers
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare basting mixture by mixing teriyaki sauce, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic and crushed red chili peppers. Step 2: Cover and refrigerate. Step 3: Cut beef diagonally, against the grain, into 1 / 4 inch slices. Step 4: Thread each slice onto a skewer. Step 5: Cover and marinate overnight For each serving: brush 2 beef ribbons generously with basting mixture Broil or grill to desired doneness, basting once or twice.

Dish Name: Thai Roast Red Pork Moo Daeng
Ingredient Names: boneless pork loin, red food coloring, fish sauce, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, brown sugar, garlic, fresh gingerroot, five-spice powder, sesame oil, cilantro leaves, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Pat the pork loin dry. Step 2: Mix the food coloring with 2 tbsp water, and rub the pork with this solution To prepare marinade, combine fish sauce, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sherry, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, five spice, and sesame oil in a blender and mix on high for about 30 seconds. Step 3: Marinate pork in a large ziplock bag or shallow dish, working marinade all over meat, for at least 2 hours, turning meat occasionally. Step 4: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Step 5: Line a baking dish with heavy foil. Step 6: Place a meat rack in the dish Oil rack to prevent sticking. Step 7: Place roast on rack in dish and place in preheated oven. Step 8: After 15 minutes, reduce heat to 350 degrees f.

Ingredient Names: ginger, lemongrass, garlic cloves, red curry paste, ground cumin, ground turmeric, coconut cream, fish sauce, granulated sugar, pork
Instructions: Step 1: Cut meats thin to fit on skewers later. Step 2: Combine ingredients and marinade meat overnight or 1 - 2 hours in a vacuum bowl. Step 3: Place meat on skewers and cook over open flame.

Dish Name: Thai Sauteed Greens With Chili And Garlic
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic cloves, leafy greens, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, salt & freshly ground black pepper, hot red chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Step 3: Add a few handfuls of the greens, allow them to wilt slightly, then add more greens in the same manner. Step 4: Toss well to coat with oil. Step 5: Add the soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar, toss to combine. Step 6: Raise the heat to medium-high and cook until the water released by the greens mostly evaporates, about 5 minutes The greens are done when a little liquid still clings to the leaves and the stems are tender. Step 7: Season with salt and black pepper to taste, sprinkle with chilies and serve.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, garlic clove, ground coriander, ground cumin, sweetened flaked coconut, peanuts, lemon juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan with high sides. Step 2: Add onion & garlic and cook until soft over medium heat. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in coriander, cumin, coconut, peanuts, and lemon juice. Step 4: Season to taste with salt. Step 5: Cook, stirring often, until coconut is lightly browned. Step 6: Let cool & serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, cooked rice, garlic clove, thai red curry paste, black pepper, coriander, salt, lime juice, cilantro, peanut oil, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, place first nine ingredients in bowl and knead mixture with your hands until evenly combined Separate mixture into twelve balls and shape into small link sausage shapes. Step 2: In a large skillet using medium heat, add peanut oil. Step 3: When oil is hot begin adding sausage links, in batches if neccessary, and fry for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown. Step 4: Turn sausages occasionally to brown evenly on all sides. Step 5: Serve immediately with coconut sambai or soy sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Squid With Chilies And Basil
Ingredient Names: green chilies, red chilies, garlic cloves, fresh cilantro stems, salt, peanut oil, squid, chilies, fish sauce, palm sugar, kaffir lime leaves, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Pound of grind the red and green chilies, the garlic, the cilantro, and salt to a paste. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok or skillet and fry the paste over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant. Step 3: Add the squid and banana peppers and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until squid is cooked. Step 4: Add fish sauce, sugar, lime leaves and basil The mixture should taste hot, salty and sweet, so adjust seasonings if necessary.

Ingredient Names: eggs, tomatoes, soy sauce, broth, onion, pepper, garlic, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: You will need a steamer that your bowls will fit inside. Step 2: Bring water to a boil in the bottom your steamer Lightly grease your heat proof bowls. Step 3: Beat eggs thoroughly. Step 4: Add the broth, tomatoes, pepper and soy sauce and stir to combine. Step 5: Place the bowl onto the rack in your pot and cover. Step 6: Steam for 15 minutes until the eggs are firm. Step 7: Sprinkle the eggs with the minced onion and coriander, and serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: dried shiitake mushrooms, snow peas, red bell pepper, green onions with tops, baby corn, garlic, vegetable oil, soy sauce, water, sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch, black pepper, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Prep all veggies. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan on high heat. Step 3: Add garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add mushrooms and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add snow peas, red pepper, onions, and baby corn and stir to combine. Step 6: Add soy sauce, water, sugar, sesame oil, and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until everything is shiny and hot-crisp. Step 7: Add cornstarch / water mixture, and stir-fry for 1 more minute, until the sauce has thickened somewhat. Step 8: Transfer to serving dish, and garnish as desired.

Dish Name: Thai Stir Fried Vermicelli Pad Wun Sen
Ingredient Names: rice vermicelli, canola oil, onion, garlic, pork loin, dried shrimp, cayenne pepper, carrots, black pepper, fish sauce, green onions, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Soak rice vermicelli in a bowl of warm water 10 minutes, then drain well, set aside. Step 2: Soak dried shrimp in 1 / 4 cup water for 5 minutes, set aside, heat oil in wok. Step 3: Stir-fry onion and garlic until golden, adding a few drops of water if onion begins to stick. Step 4: Add pork and shrimp in water and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add cayenne, carrots, black pepper, and fish sauce, cook 2 minutes. Step 6: Add vermicelli and stir well 1 minute.

Dish Name: Thai Style Asparagus With Chiles Garlic Basil
Ingredient Names: light olive oil, fresh garlic, serrano peppers, asparagus, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, water, sugar, basil, chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok or large, deep skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add oil, making sure bottom of pan is completely oiled. Step 3: Add garlic and minced chile, toss until garlic begins to turn golden About 15 seconds, add the asparagus. Step 4: Stir-fry until coated with oil, about 15 seconds. Step 5: Add the soy sauces, sugar, basil, and 1 t water. Step 6: Stir-fry until basil starts to wilt, serve hot. Step 7: Garnish with sliced chiles.

Dish Name: Thai Style Barbecued Baby Back Ribs
Ingredient Names: fish sauce, peanut oil, soy sauce, fresh lime juice, garlic, lemongrass, fresh cilantro, fresh ginger, sugar, sesame oil, pork baby back ribs
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a small bowl and blend well. Step 2: Put the ribs into a zip-lock bag or shallow dish and pour the marinade over the meat. Step 3: Cover if necessary and refrigerate the meat overnight turning occasionally About 30 minutes before cooking, remove the ribs from the refrigerator. Step 4: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Step 5: Place a roasting pan half full of water in the bottom third of the oven. Step 6: Remove the ribs from the marinade and reserve the marinade Shake off the excess marinade and place the ribs on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Step 7: Put the pan in the top third of the oven and roast for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours, basting the ribs from time to time with the reserved marinade The ribs are done when they begin to pull away from the bone and the bone.

Ingredient Names: light soy sauce, fish sauce, caster sugar, white pepper, zucchini, mushrooms, peanut oil, garlic cloves, chili, ground chicken, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy, fish sauces, sugar and pepper in a small bowl and set aside. Step 2: Cut zucchini into 1 inch cubes and steam until tender. Step 3: Heat wok over high heat, add oil and stirfry zucchini until golden. Step 4: Remove zucchini with slotted spoon and set aside. Step 5: Add chili and garlic to the wok, stir fry for 1 minute. Step 6: Add mince and cook until brown. Step 7: Return zucchini to wok adding the sauce mix and the coriander. Step 8: Stir fry for 2 minutes until slightly thickened. Step 9: Serve with jasmine rice or your chosen sides.

Ingredient Names: chicken pieces, onion, yellow pepper, fresh coriander, yogurt, cream, curry powder, basmati rice, turmeric, boiling water
Instructions: Step 1: Method: Set oven to 200 oc chop onions and peppers fry in a little oil until soft. Step 2: Pour over chicken pieces in a baking dish. Step 3: Bake chicken pieces covered until just cooked and browned and place aside. Step 4: In a bowl mix yoghurt and honey, cream, half the coriander chopped and the curry powder. Step 5: Pour this mixture over chicken cover and place back into oven for 15 minutes In your saucepan of boiling water add your washed basmati rice and turmeric, allow to return to boil then simmer for 10 minutes on a low heat well covered. Step 6: Remove the lid from yor chicken and allow 5 minutes to brown the chicken off. Step 7: Serve over the rice and garnish with the rest of the coriander.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, olive oil, low sodium soy sauce, ground ginger, garlic cloves, pork tenderloin, lime, cilantro, papaya
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice. Step 2: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil on medium for 1 minutes. Step 3: Add soy sauce, ginger, garlic and pork and cook for 3-4 minutes, occasionally flipping pork strips with a spatula until meat is cooked through. Step 4: Remove skillet from heat and stir in lime juice and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, salad oil, soy sauce, granulated sugar, distilled vinegar, toasted sesame oil, hot chili sauce, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Combine ingredients in bowl Mix well with whisk Serve over rice, hot or cold noodles, pot stickers or as a spring roll dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Style Pork In Black Pepper Moo Pat Prik Thai Dam
Ingredient Names: lean pork, garlic cloves, onion, bell pepper, chili peppers, ginger, fresh pepper, black pepper, fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, vegetable oil, water
Instructions: Step 1: Fry garlic in hot cooking oil until fragrant. Step 2: Add pork and keep stir fry until almost ready. Step 3: Add onions, ginger, bell peppers, chili peppers, fresh pepper and liquids. Step 4: Add fish sauce, oyster sauce sugar and black pepper, taste and adjust flavors. Step 5: Stir fry for a minute. Step 6: Serve hot with white rice.

Ingredient Names: pork loin, red bell peppers, teriyaki sauce, rice wine vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, creamy peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Place everything except the peanut butter in crockpot. Step 2: Cook on low setting for 8 hours. Step 3: Remove pork and chop coarsely. Step 4: Add peanut butter to crockpot, stirring to incorporate in sauce. Step 5: Return pork to crockpot. Step 6: Serve over rice, with chopped scallions and chopped peanuts on top, with a lime wedge on the side.

Ingredient Names: sugar snap peas, carrot, portabella mushroom, bean sprouts, fresh basil, fresh lemongrass, garlic, thai red chili peppers, sambal oelek, fish sauce, peanut oil, peanut butter, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Place oil in wok or large skillet and turn fire over medium high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and cook until fragrance starts to release- do not burn. Step 3: Add peas, carrots, mushrooms, bean sprouts, and fish sauce. Step 4: Steam-fry over heat until vegetables start to get tender, about 10-15 minutes The fish sauce and the liquid exuded from the mushrooms should be plenty of liquid as it was for me If not, add a tbsp Of water or fish sauce to the pan to finish cooking, but don't get too heavy or it won't have time to cook out. Step 5: Add the sambal oelek, the basil and the lemongrass, the chilies, and stir well Beware of the odors coming from the pan The peppers may get you in the eyes.

Dish Name: Thai Sweet And Sour Fried Egg Kai Look Keay
Ingredient Names: hard-boiled eggs, cooking oil, sugar, tamarind paste, red shallot, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Boil egg and peel the shell. Step 2: Let the egg dry for 10 minutes. Step 3: Pour cooking oil into the pan and fry the boiled egg until the skin starts to be crispy and brown. Step 4: Take the egg out of the pan and remove the excess oil by placing on the clean kitchen napkin. Step 5: Mix the tamarind paste, sugar with water and heat up until boiled. Step 6: Taste the sauce as you want You may add salt if you want. Step 7: Pour the sauce on top of fried boiled eggs. Step 8: Garnish the dish with fried shallots. Step 9: Serve with hot rice.

Ingredient Names: chili paste, garlic, rice wine vinegar, water, sugar, salt, cornstarch, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything, except cilantro, in a small sauce pan and mix. Step 2: Once blended, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer about 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove from heat and stir in cliantro.

Ingredient Names: peanuts, sugar, salt, coriander leaves, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, place the water and sugar and bring to the boil Add the salt and chopped peanuts and leave to cool Add the coriander.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, pork tenderloin, thai fish sauce, brown sugar, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place all of the ingredients within easy reach of the cooking area. Step 2: Set wok or skillet over medium high heat. Step 3: Add oil and garlic and heat till garlic sizzles Rotate pan so the oil coats the sides. Step 4: When the oil is hot, add the pork. Step 5: Stir-fry 2- 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the remaining ingredients and stir fry 2-3 minutes until brown sugar mixture has thickened.

Ingredient Names: sweetcorn, flour, rice flour, green curry paste, fish sauce, oil, sugar, water, red chile, green chili, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Place half the sweetcorn in a blender and whiz until smooth Scrape into a bowl, add the remaining ingredients and beat until you have a thick batter. Step 2: Heat enough oil in a frying pan for shallow frying Use a teaspoon to put spoonfuls of batter in the oil and fry until golden This will take no more than 30 seconds on each side. Step 3: Drain on paper towel Don't make the fritters too big or they won't cook through. Step 4: Mix the ingredients for the dipping sauce together and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: water, thai tea, sugar, evaporated milk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add the tea and remove the pan from heat. Step 3: Stir to submerge all the tea leaves in the water Steep for about 5 minutes. Step 4: Pour the brew through a coffee filter or a fine-mesh strainer into a large pitcher. Step 5: Add the sugar to the hot tea and stir to dissolve. Step 6: Cool to room temperature. Step 7: Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Step 8: Fill tall glasses with crushed ice. Step 9: Add enough of the tea to fill the glasses to within 1 inch from the top.

Dish Name: Thai Tofu And Green Bean Red Curry
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, thai red curry paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, button mushrooms, green beans, firm tofu, kaffir lime leaves, red chilies, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat approximately 1 / 3 of the coconut milk in a large pan. Step 2: When it starts to separate, add the curry paste, fish sauce, and sugar and stir to mix well. Step 3: Add the cleaned mushrooms and cook 1 minute. Step 4: Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and bring to a boil. Step 5: Add the green beans and tofu, then reduce heat, and simmer gently for about 4-5 minutes. Step 6: Add the kaffir lime leaves and hot chillies. Step 7: Garnish with cilantro before serving. Step 8: Serve with hot cooked rice, if desired.

Dish Name: Thai Tofu W Red Curry Sauce Over Coconut Scallion Rice
Ingredient Names: lime zest, coconut milk, water, salt, jasmine rice, cilantro, garlic cloves, unsalted dry roasted peanuts, fish sauce, canola oil, chili sauce, firm tofu, broccoli, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: If using lime leaves, soak in hot water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Bring coconut milk, 2 1 / 2 cups water, 1 tsp salt to a boil, then add rice. Step 3: Cover the pan and reduce heat to lowest setting. Step 4: Cook for 25 minutes Pan fry tofu until golden brown. Step 5: Drain on papertowel & set aside. Step 6: Chop lime leaves in small pieces. Step 7: In a food processor or blender, combine lime rind / leaves, 2 / 3 cup cilantro, garlic, & peanuts Run the machine in spurts With the machine running, add the fish sauce & 3 tbsp oil, then the chili sauce.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, coarse sea salt, garlic cloves, red bell pepper, fresh asparagus, baby portabella mushrooms, frozen peas, arborio rice, vegetable stock, white wine, coconut milk, fresh basil, of fresh mint, fresh ginger
Instructions: Step 1: In a large cast iron skillet over medium-high, heat olive oil to shimmering. Step 2: Add onion and saute, stirring frequently, until translucent. Step 3: Add garlic, red bell pepper, mushrooms, and asparagus and saute until softened. Step 4: Add rice and saute, stirring frequently, for about 4 minutes or until it starts to toast. Step 5: Add vegetable stock and cook, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium. Step 7: Add wine and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Step 8: Add 1 / 3 of the coconut milk. Step 9: Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Step 10: Repeat two more times until all of the coconut milk is added and has mostly been absorbed by the rice.

Dish Name: Thai Turkey Burgers With Red Curry Mayo
Ingredient Names: fat-free mayonnaise, thai red curry paste, lime, lime juice, honey, ground turkey breast, peanuts, cilantro, mint, salt, pepper, hamburger buns, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: In small bowl, stir the first 5 ingredients with whisk, cover. Step 2: Refrigerate until serving time. Step 3: Heat gas or charcoal grill In large bowl, mix all burger ingredients except buns and lettuce. Step 4: Shape mixture into 4 patties, 1 / 2 inch thick Carefully brush oil on grill rack. Step 5: Place patties on grill over medium heat, cover grill. Step 6: Cook 9 to 12 minutes, turning once, until meat thermometer inserted in center of patties reads 165f.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, water, fish sauce, brown sugar, cucumber, cilantro leaf, lime juice, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Brown ground turkey in a nonstick pan. Step 2: Add water, fish sauce and brown sugar and cook, stirring until liquid has almost evaporated. Step 3: Toss with cucumber, cilantro, lime juice and peanuts. Step 4: Serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping.

Dish Name: Thai Yellow Chicken Curry With Potatoes And Tomatoes
Ingredient Names: red chilies, cooking onion, galangal, garlic cloves, ground coriander, ground cumin, fresh nutmeg, fish sauce, turmeric, brown sugar, kaffir lime leaves, coconut milk, fresh lime juice, ketchup, chicken piece
Instructions: Step 1: Put all curry paste ingredients in a blender / food processor / mortar and pestle, blend until quite smooth. Step 2: Put chicken pieces and potatoes into a casserole dish, pour curry sauce over, cover and cook in a 375 degree oven for 45 minutes Gently burst each tomato. Step 3: Remove casserole from oven and add tomatoes and capsicum. Step 4: Stir, cover and return to oven for another 20 minutes. Step 5: Taste - add more chilli, lemon, salt or sugar as desired. Step 6: Serve with steamed jasmine or basmati rice.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, fresh ginger, crushed red pepper flakes, olive oil, unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chicken broth, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, zucchini
Instructions: Step 1: Cook garlic, ginger, and red pepper in oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Step 2: Add peanuts and next 4 ingredients, stirring well. Step 3: Add zucchini, and cook, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes, or until crisp tender. Step 4: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: thai seasoning, coconut milk, raw sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, chunky peanut butter, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, add 2 / 3 cup coconut milk and thai seasoning on high until smooth. Step 2: Pour in small saucepan, simmer on low for 10 minutes. Step 3: Add remaining coconut milk, sugar, lime juice, and fish sauce. Step 4: Simmer 4 more minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and blend in peanut butter and cilantro. Step 6: Let cool to room temperature, add additional coconut milk if consistency is too thick.

Dish Name: The Towering Inferno Chilli Coconut And Coriander Pork Burger
Ingredient Names: pork sausage, garlic cloves, fresh coriander leaves, coconut cream, dried chipotle powder, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt and black pepper, homemade mayonnaise, lime, fresh coriander, salt and pepper, relish, barbecue sauce, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: If your coconut cream is very hard, soften it in the microwave for about 10 seconds - or leave it in a warm place until it is malleable. Step 2: Put the sausage meat or skinned sausages in to a large bowl and add the all the remaining burger ingredients. Step 3: Mix it all together with your hands, making sure that all the seasonings and herbs have been distributed throughout the burger mix. Step 4: Shape in to 4 burgers / patties and chill them in the fridge for about 30 minutes to 1 hour to firm up. Step 5: Meanwhile, make the mayonnaise sauce: mix all the seasonings and herbs into the mayonnaise - set to one side in the fridge until needed. Step 6: Heat the barbecue or grill and brush the pan or rack with a little oil to prevent the burgers sticking. Step 7: Cook the burgers for about 5 minutes on each side or until the juices run clear when you pierce the centre. Step 8: Serve on toasted burger buns with the lime and garlic mayonnaise and your choice of accompaniments. Step 9: Take a photo and have a glass of wine or beer!, cheers!

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, fresh lemon juice, fish, honey, vegetables, red onion, shallots, lemongrass, thai chiles, kosher salt, ground turkey, fresh mint leaves, fresh ground black pepper, butter lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Dressing: in a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, lemon juice, fish sauce and honey. Step 2: Set aside Larb: in a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Step 3: Add the onion, shallots, lemongrass, chile, and salt, to taste. Step 4: Cook until the vegetables begin to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the turkey and season with salt. Step 6: Cook, stirring frequently, until the meat and vegetables are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the dressing to the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Step 8: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the mint. Step 9: Season with salt and pepper, to taste.

Ingredient Names: coriander seed, white peppercorns, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, turmeric, crushed red pepper flakes, cauliflower, salt, shallot, kumquats, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Step 2: In a small skillet, toast the seeds and peppercorns on a moderately high heat until fragrant. Step 3: Transfer to a spice grinder and let cool completely, then grind to a powder and transfer to a small bowl. Step 4: Stir in the olive oil, garlic, turmeric and crushed red pepper. Step 5: Spread cauliflower over a baking sheet and drizzle with the oil mixture, tossing to coat, then season with salt Roast for 25 minutes or until tender Scrape into serving bowl and toss with kumquats, shallots and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: crunchy peanut butter, tomato paste, lime, thai fish sauce, soy sauce, cilantro, red chili peppers, garlic cloves, ginger, vegetable oil, red onions, carrots, butternut squash, coconut milk, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Measure out 7 / 8 cup hot water in a large jug, add the peanut butter and stir until it dissolves. Step 2: Stir in the tomato paste, lime zest and juice, thai fish sauce and soy sauce. Step 3: Remove the leaves from the cilantro and set aside. Step 4: Chop the stalks and roots as finely as possible and mix with the chopped chili peppers, garlic and ginger. Step 5: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onions over a high heat for a few minutes until they start to soften and slightly brown. Step 6: Add the carrots and fry for 2 minutes, followed by the squash. Step 7: Fry for a further 2 minutes. Step 8: Sprinkle over the chili mixture, cook for one minute and pour over the coconut milk and the peanut butter mixture. Step 9: Simmer until the liquid has reduced a little and the vegetables are tender about 25 30 minutes For the last minute add the spinach, allowing it to wilt a little.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, coriander sprigs, green peppercorns, nam pla, light soy sauce, sugar, sirloin steak, thai rice, lemon juice, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: To make the 'weeping tiger', pound together the garlic and coriander in a pestle and mortar. Step 2: Transfer to a large mixing bowl and combine with the peppercorns, fish sauce, soy sauce and sugar. Step 3: Add the steak to the bowl and rub with the marinade. Step 4: Leave in a cool place for 20 minutes For the chilli sauce, toast the rice in a dry wok over a low heat, until golden brown all over Grind to a fine powder using a mortar and pestle. Step 5: Transfer the toasted rice powder to a small bowl, add the fish sauce, lemon juice, crushed chillies and sugar, stirring until the sugar has dissolved. Step 6: Leave on one side For the steak, preheat a grill until hot, and lightly grease a grill rack. Step 7: Grill the steak for 1 - 2 minutes on each side, if you like your steak rare.

Ingredient Names: dried hot red chilies, shallots, fresh lemongrass, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, white pepper powder, curry powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground cinnamon, shrimp paste, ground turmeric
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the red chillies in 5 tablespoons hot water for 1-2 hours. Step 2: Put the chillies, together with their soaking liquid, into a blender along with all the remaining ingredients in the order listed. Step 3: Blend, pushing down with a rubber spatula as many times as necessary, until you have a smooth paste What you do not use immediately should be refrigerated or frozen.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, fish sauce, rice vinegar, dark brown sugar, cayenne, coriander, ginger, chili powder, soy sauce, ketchup, water, canola oil, eggs, garlic cloves, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Start by boiling a large pot of water for the rice noodles. Step 2: Meanwhile, prep the ingredients You want everything ready for the stir-fry in an hour and it will take longer than you think! Step 3: Mix the fish sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, soy sauce, chili powder, cayenne, coriander, ginger, and juice from one of the limes into a medium bowl for the sauce Lighly beat the eggs with a few dashes of salt in another bowl. Step 4: Cut the green onions into 1 inch pieces and mince the garlic and place each in a separate bowl. Step 5: Place the peanuts in a plastic bag and crush with a rolling pin or other instrument. Step 6: Place these into a bowl. Step 7: Slice your remaining lime wedge and place in another bowl. Step 8: Using a veggie peeler, grate your carrots into slices and place into a bowl.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onions, lean lamb, basmati rice, thai green curry paste, chicken stock, reduced-fat coconut milk, peas, lemons, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for 3-5 mins until soft. Add the lamb and stir-fry for 5-7 mins until brown. Step 2: Stir in the rice, curry paste, stock and coconut milk. Bring to the boil, then turn down the heat and simmer very gently for 10-12 mins until the rice is tender and the liquid has mostly been absorbed. Stir in the peas, cook for 2 mins more, then squeeze over the lemon, sprinkle over the coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: bow tie pasta, curry powder, soy sauce, chicken breast, oil, frozen mixed vegetables, lime juice, peanut butter, alfredo sauce, coconut, green onions, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in large saucepan as directed on package, drain. Step 2: Return to saucepan and cover to keep warm. Step 3: Meanwhile, in medium bowl, combine curry powder and soy sauce. Step 4: Add chicken strips, toss to coat. Step 5: Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot, add chicken. Step 6: Cook and stir 4 to 5 minutes or until no longer pink in center. Step 7: Add frozen sauce and vegetables from meal starter.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, red curry paste, tofu, cooked long-grain rice, soy sauce, green onion, cilantro leaf, green onions, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add the curry paste and stir-fry until it releases its aroma. Step 4: Add the tofu and cook another 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the rice, mix and fry for 2 minutes. Step 6: Add the soy sauce, green onion and cilantro and transfer to a serving dish and garnish. Step 7: Serve immediately Refrigerated it will keep a couple of weeks.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, coconut milk, water, salt, oil, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Rub oil on bottom of pot. Step 2: Put the rice, coconut milk, water, and salt in a saucepan on med high heat stir occasionally until it comes to a gental boil. Step 3: Add brown sugar if you decide to go with that option. Step 4: Cover 3 / 4 of the way with lid and put on a med low heat gently simmer until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 15 to 20 minutes. Step 5: When liquid is absorbed let it rest off of burner with the lid completely covering for 5 to 10 minutes Fluff with a fork and stir in the lime zest if you decide to go with that option, serve.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, onion, gingerroot, coconut milk, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse jasmine rice under cold running water until water runs clear, let drain, set aside. Step 2: In a saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Cook garlic, onion and gingerroot, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until softened. Step 4: Stir in coconut milk and 1-1 / 4 cups water, bring to boil, stir in rice. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, remove from heat.

Dish Name: Crazy Chicken Rice Noodle Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, thai fish sauce, fresh lime juice, sugar, sambal oelek, canola oil, shallots, ground chicken, scallion, thai basil, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Fill up a large bowl with warm water. Step 2: Add the noodles and soak them until they are tender, about 20 minutes. Step 3: Drain and set aside While the noodles are soaking, you can combine the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and sambal - in a small bowl. Step 4: Stir until dissolved. Step 5: Heat up a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 6: Add the oil and swirl to coat the pan. Step 7: Add the shallots and stir-fry until brown - about 1 minute. Step 8: Add the chicken and stir-fry, breaking up the meat, until cooked through - about 3 minutes or so. Step 9: Add the noodles and sauce mixture and heat through, stirring.

Ingredient Names: thai red curry paste depending taste, chicken stock, skinless turkey breast, rice noodles, red peppers, fresh bean sprouts, reduced-fat coconut milk, limes, sugar, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a large saucepan and fry the curry paste for 1 min, until fragrant. Tip in the stock and bring to the boil, then throw in the turkey and cook for 5 mins. Add the rice noodles and cook for 3 mins more. Step 2: Add the pepper and beansprouts and cook for 2 mins more. Add the coconut milk, bring to a simmer, season with the lime juice and sugar, then spoon into bowls, sprinkle with the coriander leaves and serve.

Dish Name: Easy And Quick Jasmine Jasmati Rice With Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, light coconut milk, chicken broth, salt, sugar, red pepper flakes, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse jasmine rice, in mesh colander, until water runs clear. Step 2: Combine all the ingredients in a non-stick, deep sauce pan. Step 3: Turn heat on to medium high and let mixture come to a boil. Step 4: Put a tight lid over the mix and immediately turn heat down to lowest level. Step 5: Let cook for 30 minutes. Step 6: Turn heat off and let mix sit for another 15-20 minutes Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, long grain rice, chicken stock, coconut milk, salt, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, heat oil and saute uncooked rice for 2 minutes or until edges start to turn slightly white, stirring constantly to avoid burning it. Step 2: Stir in stock and coconut milk. Step 3: Stir to combine then add salt. Step 4: Bring mixture to a boil then reduce to a simmer for approximately 20 minutes or until rice is fully cooked and liquid are absorbed. Step 5: Remove from heat and stir in chopped green onions.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic powder, fresh ginger, ground black pepper, ground cardamom, mild chili powder, soy sauce, pork loin, white vinegar, curry powder, carrots, cauliflower, broccoli, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Blend oil, garlic powder, ginger, pepper, cardamom, chili powder and soy sauce in large skillet, add pork. Step 2: Stir-fry pork over medium-high heat 3 minutes. Step 3: Add vegetables, vinegar and curry, reduce heat. Step 4: Simmer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: pork stock, fresh gingerroot, shallots, celery, lemongrass, cooked rice, ground pork, thai fish sauce, lime juice, fresh cilantro, firm tofu, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan combine stock with gingerroot, shallots, lemon grass, rice and salt to taste. Step 2: Bring to a boil and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 30 minutes, or until soup is a porridge-like consistency. Step 3: Remove and discard lemon grass. Step 4: Add the pork, cilantro, fish sauce and lime juice and simmer 5 minutes more. Step 5: Garnish with scallions and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: wide rice noodles, pork, gai lan, garlic cloves, chicken broth, cornstarch, black soy sauce, preserved black bean, black pepper, sugar, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-soak rice noodle in warm water for at least an hour, then drain. Step 2: Cut gai lan into bite-size pieces, peeling and cutting stems Thinly cut pork, beef or chicken into bite-sized pieces. Step 3: Add a splash of fish sauce, pepper, and lightly coat with cornstarch. Step 4: In a frying pan brown the noodles in oil As you stir-fry the noodles, pour in about 2-4 tablespoonful of thick sweet black soy sauce. Step 5: Stir thoroughly to coat noodles, remove and set aside on serving plates Wipe the pan clean and pour in about 2 tablespoonful of oil and lightly brown garlic and black beans. Step 6: Stir in meat for about a minute, then add in the broccoli. Step 7: After about 3-4 more minutes, pour in about 1 / 2 - 1 cup chicken broth and flavor with fish sauce.

Ingredient Names: ground chicken, fish sauce, lime juice, green onion, red onion, rice powder, lettuce, chili pepper, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the ground meat until done and drain. Step 2: Mix the meat with the lime juice, fish sauce, red onions, chili peppers, roasted rice powder and mix well. Step 3: Serve on bed of lettuce and top with sliced green onions and mint leaves May add additional red peppers if you desire it hotter Enjoy.

Dish Name: Low G I Spicy Thai Vegetable Rice With Cilantro
Ingredient Names: basmati rice, pearl barley, onion, chicken broth, olive oil, ground ginger, diced tomatoes, fresh cilantro, fresh garlic cloves, red bell pepper, black beans, salt and pepper, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, saute the oil, onion, rice, barley, and ginger for 3 minutes. Step 2: Then add the broth, tomatoes, garlic, bell pepper and cover Salt and pepper to taste then simmer for 20 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Step 3: Then add the beans and hot sauce to taste if desired Re-cover and simmer an additional 5-10 minutes or until rice and barley are fully cooked. Step 4: Remove from heat and stir in coarsley chopped cilantro. Step 5: Serve and enjoy You may add shrimp or another pre-cooked meat if you desire. Step 6: Add when you put in the beans Also if you don't want to use barley, you can use the full cup of rice.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, raw peanuts, jalapeno, garlic clove, fresh ginger, soy sauce, water, rice vinegar, sriracha sauce, sugar, sesame oil, kosher salt, rice noodles, fresh cilantro, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the peanut oil. Step 2: Add peanuts and fry over moderate heat until golden, about 8 minutes, let cool slightly. Step 3: Transfer peanuts and oil to a food processor. Step 4: Add the jalapeno, garlic, and ginger and process until minced. Step 5: Add the soy sauce, water, rice vinegar sriracha, sugar and sesame oil and process until smooth. Step 6: Season generously with salt. Step 7: In a pot of boiling salt water, cook the noodles until al dente. Step 8: Drain, at this point you can with either rinse with cold water and toss with the sauce for an excellent salad or you can toss the hot noodles with the sauce for an excellent hot meal. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro and lime wedge.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, peanut oil, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breasts, eggs, green onions, palm sugar, thai fish sauce, oyster sauce, frozen peas, cucumber, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat While pan is warming, toss the cold rice with your hands, making sure to separate the grains from any clumps. Step 2: Add the garlic to the heated wok, and toss until fragrant and slightly golden. Step 3: Add chicken, beef, or pork and stir fry for about 1 minute Push the meat and garlic up the sides making a well in the middle and add eggs Scramble eggs for 1 minute in middle of pan then, add green onions and peas and incorporate all ingredients together, stir frying for another minute. Step 4: Add rice, turning over rice with pan ingredients several times to coat and stir frying for 2-3 minutes You want the rice to begin to have a toasted smell, making sure that all the ingredients are constantly being moved around the pan for even cooking If your pan seems to have cooled down to the point where the ingredients are no longer sizzling, you may need to turn the heat up slightly. Step 5: Sprinkle in the sugar and add the fish sauce and oyster sauce.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, peanut butter, soy sauce, seasoned rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, sambal oelek, honey, green onions, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut butter in microwave for 20 seconds to soften. Step 2: In a large bowl whisk together softened peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sambal oelek and honey. Step 3: Add spaghetti, green onions and sesame seeds, toss well. Step 4: Chill until ready to serve - or serve at room temperature.

Dish Name: No Meat Lotsa Heat Pad Thai
Ingredient Names: anchovy fillets, garlic, soya sauce, worcestershire sauce, sugar, fresh lime juice, firm silken tofu, flat rice noodles, peanut oil, green onions, red pepper, bean sprouts, red pepper flakes, peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: To make fish sauce: mash anchovies with one clove of garlic and soya sauce. Step 2: Combine fish sauce with worcestershire, sugar, and lime juice in a bowl. Step 3: Add tofu and marinate for one hour at room temperature or up to 8 hours in fridge. Step 4: Drain tofu, reserving marinade. Step 5: Cook noodles and set aside. Step 6: Heat oil in wok and add garlic, onions, and red pepper Saut for 2-3 minutes on med-high heat then add hot pepper, tofu and 1 tbsp peanuts. Step 7: Stir fry 2-3 minutes more and add sprouts and noodles, heat through. Step 8: Add cilantro, remaining peanuts, chili just before serving.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, fresh garlic cloves, soy sauce, salt, white pepper, all-purpose flour, raw chicken, fresh broccoli florets, egg, dark soy sauce, thai fish sauce, white vinegar, msg
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare noodles according to package directions, usually by soaking in water for a specified time, drain and have cut into 1 / 2 pieces before you been cooking Prep all of your ingredients before you start as this cooks very quickly Have the meat strips in a small bowl. Step 2: Heat oil and garlic in a wok or large deep skillet on about medium or medium high heat and saute for about 1 minute. Step 3: Sprinkle the meat quickly with salt& pepper, sprinkle lightly with some soy sauce, and just a little cornstarch or flour to coat very lightly and add to the pan. Step 4: Stir fry until almost cooked, then add the broccoli and stir fry another couple of minutes. Step 5: Lower heat to medium, add noodles, and stir fry to heat together- about 1-2 minutes Clear a spot in the middle of the pan and pour in the beaten egg- tossing quickly to scramble the egg in that spot, then mixing the cooked egg in with the rest of the ingredients. Step 6: Add remaining seasonings to taste quickly, stir to coat, remove from heat, and serve.

Ingredient Names: coarse salt, whole wheat spaghetti, broccoli, red bell peppers, onion, creamy peanut butter, dark brown sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook spaghetti 3 minutes less than al dente. Step 2: Add broccoli, bell peppers, and onion. Step 3: Cook until pasta is al dente and vegetables are tender, 3 minutes more Reserve 1 / 2 cup pasta water. Step 4: Drain pasta and vegetables. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together peanut butter, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, garlic, and red-pepper flakes. Step 6: Add hot pasta and vegetables. Step 7: Toss to coat, thinning sauce with a little pasta water, if necessary. Step 8: Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Ingredient Names: thai curry paste, green onions, carrots, mugful vegetable stock, peas, straight-to-wok noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Add the Thai curry paste to a pan and fry over a medium heat for 2 mins. Step 2: Stir in the spring onions and grated carrot, then cook for 1 min. Step 3: Pour in a big mugful of hot vegetable or chicken stock and a handful frozen peas. Step 4: Bring to the boil, then simmer for 2 mins until the carrot is just cooked. Step 5: Stir in the sachet of straight-to-wok noodles and heat through. Step 6: Ladle into a mug or a bowl and scatter with sesame seeds, if you like. Step 7: Serve straight away.

Ingredient Names: oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles, green chili paste, soymilk, lime juice, cornstarch
Instructions: Step 1: Boil four cups of water. Step 2: Add the ramen and a seasoning packet, cook for three minutes Reserve about 1 / 2 cup of the liquid and drain the noodles. Step 3: Put them aside In the same pot, add the ramen liquid, the curry paste, the soy creamer, and the lime juice, whisk together. Step 4: Add the cornstarch, whisk again, and bring everything to a boil for a few seconds. Step 5: Lower the heat and whisk until the sauce just begins to thicken, then pour over the noodles If you like things like presentation, garnish with cilantro springs and chopped peanuts.

Dish Name: Quick And Simple Thai Style Noodles
Ingredient Names: udon noodles, peanut butter, egg, olive oil, chili flakes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok at a medium heat. Step 2: Mix egg and noodles in a bowl. Step 3: Add peanut butter to oil and stir until it has melted and blended with oil. Step 4: Add chili flakes and blend with peanut butter. Step 5: Add the noodles and stir continuously until egg has fully cooked and noodles are heated through add salt to taste For a bit of variety i like to add mini corns and green beans before adding any other ingredient these should be stir fried.

Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, coconut milk, red curry paste, ginger, cilantro, thai sweet chili sauce, chicken broth, rice noodles, yellow onion, red peppers, broccoli, salt
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot over medium heat, scoop the cream off the top of each can of coconut and put it in the pot The cream will be used as the fat instead of oil or butter Along with the cream, add the curry paste and ginger. Step 2: Let this simmer, stirring constantly, for about one minute. Step 3: Add the chicken and onions. Step 4: Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is no longer pink, about 5-6 minutes. Step 5: Add the coconut milk, sweet thai chili sauce, cilantro, and chicken broth. Step 6: Bring this to a simmer. Step 7: Add the red pepper, broccoli slaw and / or carrots and noodles and salt. Step 8: Simmer, stirring occasionally to prevent the noodles from sticking to the bottom, for about 5-8 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, sunflower oil, garlic clove, gingerroot, scallions, chile, boneless skinless chicken, chicken livers, celery, carrot, cabbage, lime juice, thai fish sauce, soy sauce, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl of hot water soak rice noodles for 15 minutes and drain well. Step 2: Using a wok or large skillet heat oil. Step 3: Add the garlic, ginger, scallions, and chile, stir fry for approximately one minute. Step 4: Stir in the chicken and chicken livers and stir fry over high heat for 2-3 minutes or until browning begins. Step 5: Add celery and carrot to chicken mixture, stir fry for about 2 minutes or until they soften. Step 6: Stir in napa cabbage, lime juice, fish sauce, and soy sauce Begin adding noodles while stirring and heat thoroughly If desired sprinkle with shredded mint and pickled garlic. Step 7: Place on serving dish, optional garnish sprig of mint, and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, coconut cream, sugar, salt, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice in several changes of water. Step 2: Drain, discard water and set aside. Step 3: In a medium pot, over medium heat, bring coconut cream to a boil. Step 4: Add rice, sugar and salt. Step 5: Add coconut milk and return to a boil. Step 6: Cook, partially covered, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, 15 to 20 minutes, or until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice has fluffed.

Ingredient Names: sticky rice, bacon, shallot, shiitake mushroom, garlic, chili, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, soy sauce, green onions, banana leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 cups sweet rice in 3-4 cups water, or enough so water exceeds the rice by at least 1 inch. Step 2: Soak for at least 40 minutes While rice is soaking, prepare your steamer. Step 3: Line a bamboo steamer or colander with 2 layers of banana / bamboo leaf, or use cheesecloth, or a clean kitchen cloth To clean and thaw the leaf, rinse under hot water. Step 4: Cut the leaf large enough that it extends over the top. Step 5: Place steamer over a large pot, and have a tight-fitting lid ready. Step 6: Place bacon in a large frying pan / wok together with 1-2 tablespoons water. Step 7: Fry over medium-high heat until cooked. Step 8: Remove from heat, leaving all or half the fat in the frying pan.

Ingredient Names: onion, carrot, celery, broccoli, green pepper, red pepper, snow peas, cauliflower, tomatoes, oil, garlic clove, chili flakes, brown sugar, lime juice, soya sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Brown chicken in oil, with a few chili flakes if desired, then remove from pan. Step 2: Add all veggies into some oil except tomatoes, saut 5-10 minutes. Step 3: Mash garlic into a paste, and add flakes, brown sugar, lime juice, soya sauce and peanut butter, mix well. Step 4: Add 1 / 3 sauce to the veggies, heat through for 5 minutes. Step 5: Add in tomatoes and sliced chicken, pour 1 / 3 sauce over, and heat through 5 minutes. Step 6: Cook noodles according to package directions. Step 7: When cooked, add 1 / 3 of sauce to noodles. Step 8: Place veggies and chicken over the noodles, and enjoy!

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, mung bean sprouts, carrot, scallions, yellow bell pepper, red bell pepper, lemongrass, thai chiles, cooking oil, peanuts, cilantro, creamy peanut butter, brown sugar, soy sauce, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender, drain. Step 2: Mix ingredients for sauce in a bowl with a whisk until smooth, set aside. Step 3: Heat 2 tablespoons cooking oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Step 4: Add lemongrass and thai chiles and cook until fragrant. Step 5: Add carrot, scallions, and bell peppers and cook until carrot starts to become crisp-tender. Step 6: Add bean sprouts and cook 1-2 minutes more. Step 7: Add drained noodles to the pan and pour sauce over noodles. Step 8: Using two utensils, lift vegetables from bottom to integrate throughout noodles and mix well.

Dish Name: Sweet Red Chili Noodles With Sesame Seeds
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, chili sauce, olive oil, lime juice, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Put a large pot of salted water on to boil. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix sweet red chili sauce, oil, lime juice and sesame seeds in small bowl. Step 3: Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse briefly. Step 4: Pour noodles into serving bowl and mix with sweet red chili mixture, serve.

Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, cooking oil, shallots, garlic, hot red chili peppers, red curry paste, lean pork loin, carrot, fish sauce, brown sugar, scallions, cilantro leaf, red chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles in boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until just tender, drain, heat oil in wok. Step 2: Add shallots, garlic, chilies and curry paste, cooking until just fragrant. Step 3: Add the pork in several batches and cook for 3-4 minutes each batch. Step 4: Place all meat in wok and add carrot, fish sauce, and brown sugar, bring to a boil. Step 5: Add noodles and scallions and combine to mix. Step 6: Garnish with cilantro leaves and serve with nam prik dang sauce as a dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Clear Noodle Salad Yum Woon Sen
Ingredient Names: mung bean noodles, ground turkey, carrots, celery ribs, shallots, green onion, cilantro, roasted peanuts, romaine lettuce, cabbage, chili flakes, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, red jalapeno chiles
Instructions: Step 1: Soak mung bean noodles in warm water for 15 minutes. Step 2: Drain and cut into short lengths and place in a bowl. Step 3: Pour hot water over the noodles and soak for another 5 minutes. Step 4: Drain in a colander, and rinse with cold water to separate the noodles. Step 5: Let stand in the colander until ready to use. Step 6: Cook ground turkey with a little water over medium heat. Step 7: When brown, drain any excess water, and place in a large mixing bowl. Step 8: Let cool 5 minutes. Step 9: Mix dressing ingredients in a small bowl, and taste for proper balance of sweet / sour / salty / spicy Adjust if necessary.

Ingredient Names: water, long-grain white rice, ground pork, vegetable oil, onion, fresh ginger, jalapeno pepper, garlic cloves, ground turmeric, fish sauce, vegetables, eggs, green onions, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water and rice to a boil in medium saucepan over high heat. Step 2: Reduce heat to medium-low. Step 3: Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until water is absorbed. Step 4: Transfer rice to large bowl and fluff with fork. Step 5: Let come to room temperature, 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours. Step 7: When rice is cold, cook pork in wok or medium skillet over medium-high heat until no longer pink. Step 8: Drain off excess fat. Step 9: Transfer pork to bowl and set aside. Step 10: Heat wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, sunflower oil, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Grate fresh ginger and garlic and place in a saucepan with 3 tablespoons of sunflower oil. Step 2: Let the mixture grill for a minute and add the raw rice. Step 3: Add the chicken stock mixed with water and let the rice cook. Step 4: Make sure to add water if the rice is not cooked enough.

Dish Name: Thai It You Ll Like It
Ingredient Names: fettuccine, red bell peppers, snow peas, green onion, low-sodium low-fat chicken broth, sesame oil, reduced-fat peanut butter, reduced sodium soy sauce, white vinegar, gingerroot, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and keep warm While pasta is cooking, prepare sauce. Step 3: In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients except shrimp, mix well, bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium. Step 5: Cook and stir for 3-4 minutes, until vegetables are crisp-tender and sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened. Step 6: Stir in shrimp and cook just until heated through, 1-2 minutes Do not overcook or shrimp will be rubbery.

Dish Name: Thai Noodle Delight With Sweet Spicy Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: wheat noodles, boneless pork, canola oil, garlic, natural-style peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, sambal oelek, sweet chili sauce, red onion, snow pea pods, celery, broccoli florets
Instructions: Step 1: Disolve 1 / 8 cup salt and 1 / 4 cup sugar in 1 quart of water in a glass or plastic container. Step 2: Cut your meat into bite-sized pieces, place in the brine, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Step 3: Drain meat and allow to dry on paper towels. Step 4: In a large pan, bring plenty of salted water to boiling. Step 5: Add noodles and cook according to directions. Step 6: In a small bowl, whisk together peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, sambal oolek, and sweet chile sauce until smooth Warm in heavy bottomed pan on stove, but do not cook! Step 7: Heat to no more than steaming or the sauce might break. Step 8: In a wok or large, heavy skillet, heat 1 tbls oil on medium-high heat until the oil just starts to smoke Immediately add your meat, stirring constantly, until the meat is almost done. Step 9: Add the garlic and continue cooking about a minute.

Ingredient Names: linguine, sesame oil, green onions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, honey, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, mung bean sprouts, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite, drain. Step 2: Transfer pasta to large bowl. Step 3: Add 3 tablespoons sesame oil and toss to coat. Step 4: Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add 6 green onions, garlic, and ginger Saut until onions soften, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add honey, peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce, whisk to blend. Step 7: Simmer sauce 1 minute.

Ingredient Names: dried rice noodles, oil, garlic, egg, shrimp, water, fish sauce, sugar, paprika, green onion, roasted peanuts, bean sprouts, cilantro, lime slice, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in cool water until they are soft. Step 2: Heat oil in skillet or wok until hot and then add garlic, shrimp and egg. Step 3: Stir fry until shrimp and egg are cooked. Step 4: Reduce the temperature if needed to keep from overcooking. Step 5: Drain noodles and add to pan with shrimp mixture. Step 6: Stir fry until noodles are translucent and become somewhat soft, loosing their stiffness. Step 7: Add water as needed to keep from sticking. Step 8: When noodles are soft, add the fish sauce, sugar and paprika Thoroughly combine. Step 9: Add peanut, bean sprouts, green onion and mix well.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, onion, oil, pasta, crunchy peanut butter, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, curry powder, ground cloves, garlic, coconut milk, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Saute cabbage& onion in oil until just softened. Step 2: Set aside in large bowl. Step 3: Cook pasta until al dente While pasta cooks, mix next 9 ingredients in a saucepan. Step 4: Heat gently, adding coconut milk gradually Do not boil. Step 5: Mix cooked pasta with sauce& veggies. Step 6: Mix in cilantro and basil. Step 7: Serve immediately, topped with chopped roasted peanuts if desired You can also substitute hot sauce for the red pepper flakes.

Dish Name: Thai Oven Baked Rice With Shiitake Mushrooms
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground pork, onion, fresh garlic, chicken broth, low sodium soy sauce, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, cayenne pepper, red bell peppers, shiitake mushrooms, short-grain rice, salt, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Set oven to 375 degrees. Step 2: Grease a medium-size casserole dish. Step 3: Heat oil in a large saucepan or a dutch oven over medium heat. Step 4: Add in the ground pork and small onion, cook stirring until well browned. Step 5: Stir in the chicken broth plus 1 full can water, soy sauce, lime juice, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce and cayenne, bring to a boil. Step 6: Add in bell pepper strips, shiitake mushroom slices and rice to the boiling broth. Step 7: Stir with a wooden spoon, then bring to a boil again, then season with salt. Step 8: Remove from heat and transfer to casserole dish, or leave in the dutch oven. Step 9: Bake for about 35-40 minutes or until the rice is desired tenderness.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, chicken broth, light coconut milk, fresh gingerroot, soy sauce, smooth peanut butter, honey, hot chili paste, garlic cloves, carrot, bean sprouts, green onion, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Add noodles and cook until tender according to package directions, drain. Step 3: Meanwhile, combine chicken broth, coconut milk, ginger, soy sauce, peanut butter, honey, chili paste, and garlic in a small saucepan. Step 4: Cook over medium heat until peanut butter melts and is heated through. Step 5: Add noodles, carrots and bean sprouts, and toss to coat. Step 6: Garnish with green onions and peanuts.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, tomatoes, onions, rice, eggs, garlic cloves, tomato paste, cooking oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Saut the onion with garlic add 2-3 tbs oil then add chopped tomatoes. Step 2: Beat the eggs in a dish add to onions, cook over low heat until its done. Step 3: Cook the shrimps in boiling water then pour into eggs and mix together Solve the tomato paste into warm water add salt'n pepper and add to the egg mixture. Step 4: Mix the ingredients with half cooked rice and cook it over medium heat.

Ingredient Names: thai rice, sesame oil, fresh lime juice, red chile, garlic clove, fresh ginger, light soy sauce, clear honey, pineapple juice, wine vinegar, spring onions, pineapple rings, bean sprouts, cashew nuts, toasted sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the thai fragrant rice for 20 minutes, then rinse in several changes of water. Step 2: Drain, then boil in salted water for 10-20 minutes until tender. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: Whisk together the lime juice, sesame oil, chilli, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey, pineapple juice and wine vinegar in a large bowl, stir in the rice. Step 5: Add the spring onions, pineapple rings, sprouted lentils or bean sprouts, red pepper, celery, cashew nuts and the toasted sesame seeds and mix well If the rice grains stick together on cooling, simply stir them with a metal spoon This dish can be served warm or at room temperature and is a good accompaniment to grilled or barbecued meats and fish.

Ingredient Names: oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, white sugar, olive oil flavored cooking spray, cooked jasmine rice, garlic cloves, thai chiles, red bell pepper, onion, egg substitute, shrimp, thai basil, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Step 2: Set aside Spray a wok or large frying pan with olive oil spray and heat over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add the garlic and chili peppers and stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add the red pepper and onion and stir fry until the onion is translucent If using chicken or beef, add it with the the onion and red pepper. Step 5: Cook until chicken is done, or beef is about medium Push ingredients in the wok / pan aside and quickly scramble the egg. Step 6: Add the oyster sauce mixture and stir everything together. Step 7: Raise the heat to high and add the chilled rice.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, cornstarch, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, boneless skinless chicken breasts, jalapeno peppers, red pepper, baby carrots, snow peas, vegetable oil, garlic, minced ginger, chicken broth, curry powder
Instructions: Step 1: Fill a large saucepan with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 2: Add spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 8-10 minutes drain pasta, but do not rinse. Step 3: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir cornstarch with fish sauce, lime juice & sugar until dissolved. Step 4: Slice chicken into thin strips Core and seed jalapeno, then finely chop Core and seed red pepper, then thinly slice. Step 5: Slice baby carrots in half lengthwise or slice small carrots into julienned pieces Peel and discard strings from snow peas Lightly coat a large wide saucepan with oil and set over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add chicken, jalapeno, garlic and ginger.

Ingredient Names: rice, pork tenderloin, green pepper, red pepper, vegetable oil, garlic, hot chili peppers, soya sauce, sugar, oyster sauce, water, basil leaves, cornstarch, lemon juice, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare favourite rice for 4 and put to side. Step 2: Slice pork into 1 / 4-inch strips. Step 3: Cut red & green pepper in 1 inch thin strips. Step 4: Heat oil in wok until it is about to smoke. Step 5: Add garlic and chilies and stir fry for 35 seconds. Step 6: Add pork strip and stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 7: Add soya, sugar, oyster sauce and water and stir fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 8: Add red & green peppers and 3 / 4 of basil leaves and stir fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Step 9: Take wok off stove Dissolve 1 / 2 tsp cornstarch in cold water.

Dish Name: Thai Sticky Rice With Nam Pla And Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: sticky rice, coconut milk, nam pla
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice. Step 2: Soak it in water to cover for at least 1 hr and up to 24. Step 3: Drain, then wrap in cheesecloth. Step 4: Put in a steamer above boiling water. Step 5: Steam for about 30 minutes until tender. Step 6: Toss cooked rice with coconut milk and nam pla Rewrap and steam for 5 more minutes to reheat.

Dish Name: Thai Stir Fried Rice Noodles With Basil And Chillies Kway Teow
Ingredient Names: serrano peppers, garlic, sugar, salt, black pepper, fish sauce, soy sauce, vegetable oil, ground pork, wide rice noodles, fresh basil leaf, cherry tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Boil the noodles until tender to your liking, then drain and set aside till needed. Step 2: Set up a little system of bowls to help you when you cook. Step 3: Place the garlic in one and the chiles in another. Step 4: Mix the sugar, salt and pepper in a third bowl. Step 5: Mix the fish sauce and the soy sauce in a fourth bowl and keep them all near your wok or frying pan. Step 6: Heat the oil in your pan until nice and hot then add the garlic In about 30 seconds, when it sizzles nicely and starts to turn golden, add the peppers and stand back a little. Step 7: Stir them for 30 seconds or so more until they get really fragrant. Step 8: Add the pork and cook until it browns, breaking up the meat as it lumps. Step 9: Sprinkle in the sugar from the bowl to season the meat, and toss until it is mixed.

Dish Name: Thai Stuffed Poblano Or Green Bell Peppers
Ingredient Names: ground turkey, onion, garlic cloves, sesame oil, thai basil, soy sauce, water, fish sauce, hoisin sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, red pepper flakes, cooked white rice, bell peppers
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet heat seasame oil over medium high heat and coat bottom, add turkey, onion, and garlic and cook until turkey meat is browned, stirring to break up chunks of meat. Step 2: Make sauce: in a bowl combine soy sauce, water, fish sauce, hoisin sauce, brown sugar, and corn starch and quickly whisk until all ingredients are incorporated. Step 3: Stir sauce into meat mixture, along with red pepper flakes and thai basil. Step 4: Simmer 10-15 minutes, then stir in cooked rice- remove from heat and let cool, or leave overnight in refridgerator. Step 5: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 6: Cut tops off the peppers de-seed and de-vein as much as possible. Step 7: Stuff meat mixture into peppers until full- arrange in a greased 9x13 baking dish- add 2 / 3 cup water to baking dish and baked covered for 45 minutes to 1 hr- when fork easily inserts into pepper flesh- it is done.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, butter, shallots, basil, garlic, green onion, long grain white rice, water, chicken bouillon powder, red pepper flakes, unsweetened flaked coconut
Instructions: Step 1: In a large, heavy saucepan, melt the butter and oil together over medium heat. Step 2: Add the shallots and chopped basil and cook until shallots are slightly soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic and green onion and saut another 2 to three minutes. Step 4: Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat well Saut for 3 minutes while stirring. Step 5: Mix together the water and chicken bouillon and stir until dissolved. Step 6: Add bouillon liquid to rice in saucepan and bring to a boil If using, stir in red pepper and coconut flakes. Step 7: Cover saucepan, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and rice is to preferred texture Fluff with fork, serve, and enjoy.

Dish Name: Thai Style Fried Rice With A Curry Flavor Hmmm
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, peanut oil, onion, red chili pepper, fresh green chile, thai red curry paste, curry powder, pork chops, garlic cloves, raw shrimp, eggs, pepper, soy sauce, fish sauce, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Be sure rice is completely cool, better cold! Step 2: Heat oil in wok over medium heat and stir-fry onions and chilies until soft. Step 3: Add the the red curry paste along with the curry powder to the pan and fry until the oil separates from the mixture Along with the garlic, add pork or chicken and fry until cooked. Step 4: Add shrimp and cook until they turn pink. Step 5: Add rice and toss thoroughly until coated with curry mixture and heated through If your wok is large enough, push rice to side and pour eggs into center. Step 6: Cook and stir until eggs just start to set, then mix with rice, tossing on high until eggs are cooked. Step 7: Sprinkle pepper and fish sauce evenly over top and lightly toss, remove from heat. Step 8: Now lightly toss the chopped green onions into the rice.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, light coconut milk, water, lime, red pepper flakes, turmeric, granulated onion, sugar, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredints except basil in pot, stir over medium heat until reaches boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 15-20 minutes without lifting lid. Step 3: Remove lid, add basil and fluff with fork. Step 4: Let sit, covered for 5 additional minutes If your rice seems sticky, a small squeeze of fresh lime juice stirred into rice will help.

Ingredient Names: fine vermicelli rice noodles, fresh bean sprouts, juice limes, fish, muscovado sugar, red onions, gem lettuce hearts, pork, ginger, cayenne pepper, sunflower oil, sesame seeds, oil, sirloin steaks, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Place the noodles and beansprouts in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 4 mins, or until the noodles are tender. Drain, then cool under cold running water and drain again. Return to the bowl. Step 2: Stir together the lime zest and juice, fish or soy sauce and sugar. Stir into the noodles with the red onion and lettuce. Step 3: To make with mince, heat a little oil in a non-stick frying pan and stir-fry 500g minced pork, a small knob of grated ginger and pinch cayenne pepper or chilli powder for 10 mins, until the mince is browned and cooked through. Mix into the noodles, divide between four bowls and serve warm. Step 4: To make with steak, make the rice noodle salad. Heat 1 tsp sunflower oil in a frying pan. Tip 2 tbsp sesame seeds onto a plate. Rub 1 tsp oil into 4 x 175g sirloin steaks and press into sesame seeds. Fry for 5 mins for medium rare, turning halfway. Leave to rest for 5 mins, then thinly slice. Toss 1 deseeded and shredded red chilli, and a handful mint leaves into noodles. Top with steak to serve.

Dish Name: Thai spiced turkey patties with noodle salad
Ingredient Names: turkey breast, lemongrass, garlic, juice lime, low-sodium soy sauce, fresh coriander, red chile, nests wheat noodles, mixed peppers stir-fry vegetables, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the grill to Medium. Put the turkey in a food processor and pulse until minced. Add the lemongrass, garlic and lime zest, and half the soy sauce, coriander and chilli, then pulse again until combined. Tip the mix into a bowl and add some black pepper. Shape into 8 patties, then transfer to a non-stick baking tray and grill for 3-4 mins each side, until cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, soak the noodles following pack instructions, then drain and add the vegetables, the remaining soy sauce and the lime juice. Toss well, divide between plates and sprinkle with the remaining coriander and chilli. Serve with the turkey patties and some sweet chilli sauce for dipping, if you like.

Ingredient Names: rice sticks, tamarind juice, fish sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, tomato ketchup, vegetable oil, garlic, shrimp, tofu, egg, bean sprouts, unsalted peanuts, cilantro, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Optional garnishes: sprigs of fresh cilantro and lime wedges. Step 2: Soak rice noodles in cold water for at least 1 hour. Step 3: Drain and set aside. Step 4: In a bowl, combine tamarind juice, fish sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and ketchup, set aside. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok, add garlic Saut for 30 seconds until garlic is fragrant. Step 6: Add shrimp, tofu and egg. Step 7: Stir-fry for 1 minute, until egg is scrambled. Step 8: Add rice noodles and tamarind juice mixture.

Ingredient Names: tortellini, red bell pepper, green onion, snow peas, carrot, chinese cabbage, rice vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, fresh ginger, sugar, hot pepper flakes, dry mustard, five-spice powder, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cook and drain tortellini according to package directions. Step 2: Place in a large bowl To make dressing, combine 4 tablespoons vinegar, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, garlic, ginger, sugar, hot-pepper flakes, dry mustard and five-spice powder in a small bowl, whisk in oil. Step 3: Toss warm tortellini with dressing. Step 4: Toss in red bell pepper, green onion, snow peas and carrot. Step 5: Add more vinegar and soy sauce to taste, if desired. Step 6: Line a serving platter or individual serving plates with cabbage or spinach leaves. Step 7: Arrange salad over greens. Step 8: Serve at room temperature.

Ingredient Names: chicken, fish sauce, red curry paste, lime, red onion, spring onion, capsicum, celery, mushroom, evaporated skim milk, olive oil, stock, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in the stock by absorbtion. Step 2: Make and mix the rub Coat meat. Step 3: Chop and cook vegetables. Step 4: Cook meat Deglaze pan with evaporated milk and reduce, serve over rice. Step 5: Garnish with fresh coriander and basil.

Ingredient Names: thai green curry paste, groundnut oil, vegetable stock, reduced-fat coconut milk, rice noodles, chestnut mushroom, sugar snap peas, beansprout, thai fish sauce, limes, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Put a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the curry paste in the oil for 1 min until it starts to release its aroma. Pour in the stock and coconut milk and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and stir in the noodles. Simmer for 7 mins, then stir in the mushrooms and sugar snaps. Cook for 3 mins more, then add the beansprouts, fish sauce and lime juice. Remove the pan from the heat. Step 2: Ladle the noodles and soup into bowls, then scatter with spring onions, mint and coriander to serve.

Dish Name: Coconut Curried Tofu with Green Jasmine Rice
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut, water, salt, jasmine rice, fresh cilantro, unsweetened light coconut milk, ginger, lime juice, garlic, vegetable oil, firm tofu, green onions, curry powder, ground cumin, dry red pepper, cherry tomatoes, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Stir shredded coconut in small nonstick skillet over medium heat until light golden, about 5 minutes, transfer to bowl. Step 2: Bring 1 3/4 cups water and salt to boil in heavy medium saucepan. Step 3: Stir in rice; bring to boil. Step 4: Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until water is absorbed and rice is tender, about 18 minutes. Step 5: Meanwhile, puree cilantro, 1/2 cup coconut milk, 1 teaspoon ginger, lime juice, and half of garlic in blender. Step 6: Mix puree and coconut into rice, set aside. Step 7: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat. Step 8: Add tofu; stir-fry until golden, about 6 minutes. Step 9: Add onions, curry, cumin, red pepper, remaining ginger, and remaining garlic. Step 10: Stir-fry 1 minute. Step 11: Stir in tomatoes and remaining coconut milk. Step 12: Season with salt and pepper. Step 13: Divide rice among 4 plates. Step 14: Top with tofu mixture. Step 15: Sprinkle with peanuts. Step 16: *Availableat specialty foods stores and natural foods stores. Step 17: **Availableat Asian markets and in the Asian foods section of many supermarkets.

Dish Name: Sticky coconut rice, mango & passion fruit
Ingredient Names: thai sticky rice, unsweetened coconut milk, golden sugar, limes, mango, oranges, lime juice, mangoes, passion fruits, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: A day ahead, wash the rice with plenty of cold water, then drain and tip it into a bowl. Pour over enough cold water to more than cover it, then leave to soak overnight. Step 2: Make the mango sauce. Liquidise the mango flesh with the orange juice, lime juice and sugar. Taste and add a little extra sugar or lime juice if necessary. Pass through a fine sieve, then chill if making ahead. Step 3: Drain the rice, transfer to a steamer and steam for 25-30 mins until soft and tender, making sure the water doesn’t boil dry. Simmer the coconut milk with 85g of the sugar for 1 min. Pour in the lime juice, stir in the steamed rice, then leave, covered, for 5 mins until it has a thick, creamy consistency. Check for sweetness, adding more sugar to taste if needed. Cool slightly, about 10 mins, until tepid and holding its shape. The rice is best served slightly warm, as the longer it is left, the firmer and sticker it becomes. Step 4: For each serving, place a 6.5cm diameter x 3.5cm tall ring mould in the middle of a large plate. Spoon in one-sixth of the sticky rice. Drizzle a little mango sauce on the plate around the rice. Arrange a few slices of mango on the sauce and lay a few on top of the rice with a sprinkling of lime zest. Spoon around some passion fruit seeds and juice. Scatter over a few mint leaves. Serve the remaining mango sauce separately.

Ingredient Names: lemon juice, seasoned rice vinegar, fish sauce, water, dark sesame oil, creamy peanut butter, sugar, ground ginger, granulated garlic, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the wet and dry ingredients in a mixing bowl Wisk together until thoroughly mixed Use immedately or refrigerate for up to 7 days.

Ingredient Names: fresh asparagus, onion, mint, coriander, peanut oil, lime juice, thai fish sauce, red chili pepper flakes, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Slice asparagus diagonally into 3 inch lengths. Step 2: Steam, covered until just tender-about 5 minutes. Step 3: Drain, and cool under running water, drain. Step 4: Toss asparagus with onion, mint and coriander. Step 5: Cover and chill for at least 2 hours Before serving, blend together oil, lime juice, fish sauce and chili flakes, pour over asparagus mixture, and serve on lettuce lined plates.

Dish Name: Caramelised Pumpkin Salad With Chilli Jam Juice Dressing
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, oil, spinach leaves, lettuce leaves, red capsicum, tomatoes, cucumber, coriander, basil, red onion, chile pepper jam, lime juice, soy sauce, palm sugar, stock
Instructions: Step 1: To make dressing bring chili jam, lime juice, soy, sugar and stock to boil, set aside. Step 2: Toss cubed pumpkin in oil and and roast till golden 200c about 45minutes. Step 3: Mix all salad ingredients together add pumpkin and drizzle over dressing! Step 4: Can add 1-2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, and fresh sliced chili.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, smooth peanut butter, peanut oil, low sodium soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, fish sauce, asian chili sauce, sesame oil, sugar, ground pepper, garlic powder, cucumber, red bell pepper, green onion, vegetables
Instructions: Step 1: Cook noodles al dente. Step 2: Strain and rinse under cold water until cooled. Step 3: Mix or wisk together all "dressing" ingredients until blended In large bowl stir together noodles, 2 / 3 sauce, and vegetables. Step 4: Chill minimum 2 hours. Step 5: Transfer to a bowl or platter, if you you want Before serving pour reserved "dressing" over noodles. Step 6: Sprinkle sesame seeds and reserved green onions.
