Ingredient Names: limes, thai red curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, fresh green beans, bean sprouts, red pepper, red onion, fresh coriander, of fresh mint, red chilies, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the lime juice, curry paste, fish sauce and brown sugar in the bottom of a medium sized bowl. Step 2: Boil the green beans for one minute, then drain and let cool. Step 3: Put the green beans, bean sprouts, red pepper, red onion, coriander, mint and chilli in the bowl with the dressing, toss until mixed. Step 4: Arrange the lettuce leaves on a plate, then put some salad on top.

Ingredient Names: boneless duck breasts, olive oil, sesame oil, lime juice, orange, fish sauce, ginger, garlic clove, soy sauce, scallions, sugar, salad leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook duck I recommend salting the duck and broiling until cooked through. Step 2: Let duck cool for 10-15 minutes For dressing: beat all other ingredients together well. Step 3: Cut cooled duck into slices, adding a bit of dressing to each piece to moisten. Step 4: Arrange duck slices over salad leaves. Step 5: Drizzle dressing over duck and leaves and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Duck, watermelon & herb salad with roast cashews
Ingredient Names: duck breasts skin, cos, radishes, green onions, pink grapefruit segmented, watermelon, mint, salted cashews, red green bird's-eye chili, fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place the duck breasts, skin-side up, on a board. Score the skin all the way through, cutting down to, but not into, the flesh. Make sure you score all the way to the edges. This will ensure the skin doesn’t pull the flesh in as it shrinks. Step 2: Season the skin with a generous amount of salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place the duck, skin-side down, in a solid heavy-based cold pan, then put the pan over a medium heat. Now do not touch anything, do not move the pan. What will happen over the next 10-12 mins is that the fat under the skin will slowly melt, then the skin will brown and go crisp. Once all the fat has run from the skin, there will be a good 1-2cm of duck fat in the pan. Spoon off the excess fat, season the flesh side now (not before), then turn the duck over. Cook for 2 mins, then increase the temperature to full for just 1 min. Take off the heat, then leave in the pan to rest for 5 mins. Step 3: For the dressing, put all the ingredients into a small food processor and whizz. Remove the 2 outer leaves from each head of lettuce and discard, then peel the leaves away, one at a time. Lay them out on a big serving plate. Step 4: Thinly slice the duck, then toss with the radishes, spring onions, grapefruit, watermelon, herbs and some of the dressing. Spread over the leaves and scatter the nuts over the top. Drizzle more dressing over and serve.

Ingredient Names: papayas, garlic, green bird's eye chilies, french beans, dried shrimp, palm sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, cherry tomatoes, roasted peanuts, lettuce leaf, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a mortar, roughly pound the garlic and chillies. Step 2: Add the beans and pound, then the shrimps and pound again until crushed. Step 3: Add the sugar, fish sauce and lime juice and stir together. Step 4: Add the tomatoes and press with the pestle to bruise the tomatoes. Step 5: Add the peanuts and the papaya and stir until well mixed in. Step 6: Serve cold in a round dish lined with lettuce leaves and sprinkle coriander leaves on to of the salad.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, salt, salted peanuts, chilies, raw sugar, dried shrimp, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, plum tomatoes, long beans, papaya, lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender or mortar, blend or pound garlic, salt, peanuts, chilies, sugar and shrimp into a paste. Step 2: Transfer to a large bowl and mix in lime juice and fish sauce Use a spoon to lightly crush tomatoes and beans, then add to bowl and mix lightly Peel and coarsely grate or shred papaya, discarding seeds and inner membrane There should be 4 to 6 cups. Step 3: Add papaya to bowl and lightly but thoroughly toss together. Step 4: Taste for seasoning Mound in a bowl. Step 5: Sprinkle with peanuts and serve.

Dish Name: Larb Laab Thai Meat Salad With Mint And Lemongrass
Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, chili paste, low sodium chicken broth, ground chicken, green onion, shallot, fresh lemongrass, thai red chili peppers, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first four ingredients in a medium bowl Save this sauce for later. Step 2: Simmer the broth in heavy large skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add the ground chicken. Step 4: Simmer until cooked through, breaking up any clumps of meat with a spoon, about 8 minutes. Step 5: Add green onions, shallots, lemongrass and chillies. Step 6: Stir until vegetables are tender and most of liquid has evaporated, about 4 minutes, remove from heat. Step 7: Stir in sauce, cilantro and mint You can serve this salad as is with butter lettuce or use it as a filling for your fresh rolls.

Ingredient Names: cantaloupe, cucumber, carrot, pineapple chunks, butter lettuce, banana, salted cashews, mint leaf, vegetable oil, chili sauce, lime zest, fresh lime juice, honey, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cantaloupe, cucumber, carrot and pineapple in large serving bowl. Step 2: Cover and chill 1 hour. Step 3: Combine dressing ingredients in jar with screwtop lid. Step 4: Cover and shake until well blended. Step 5: Refrigerate To serve, line 6 individual salad plates with equal amounts of lettuce. Step 6: Add banana, cashews and mint to cantaloupe mixture Shake dressing. Step 7: Pour 1 / 4 cupful over fruit mixture and toss gently to coat all pieces. Step 8: Spoon 1 cup fruit salad into center of each lettuce-lined plate.

Dish Name: Mango Kerabu Spicy Sweet Mango Salad
Ingredient Names: mangoes, mint leaves, cilantro, sambal oelek
Instructions: Step 1: Dice mangoes and combine with other ingredients Mix well and serve chilled or room temperature.

Ingredient Names: mangoes, red onion, red bell pepper, lime, lime zest, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: I find the easiest way to cut up mango for this is to cut off as much as you can, slicing along the side of the pit You can tell what way the pit grows by its shape Score the mango halves lengthways, then crossways, into 3 / 4 inch cubes, going through to the skin, but not through it. Step 2: Turn the mango halves inside out and slice off the cubes. Step 3: Toss with remaining ingredients Goes well with any thai or indonesian dish Like indonesian ginger chicken!

Dish Name: Nam Sod Pork Salad With Mint Peanuts And Ginger
Ingredient Names: ground lean pork, water, lemon juice, fish sauce, dried chili, chili, onions, shallots, roasted peanuts, gingerroot, mint leaf, coriander, lettuce leaves, ginger, dried chilies
Instructions: Step 1: In large saucepan place minced pork with water. Step 2: Cook slowly over med heat until pork is cooked through but still tender. Step 3: Remove from heat and add lemon juice, fish sauce, dried and fresh chili, stir. Step 4: When cooled, add onion, shallots, peanuts, ginger, mint and coriander leaves, toss lightly. Step 5: Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves and garnish with mounds of peanuts, ginger and chili. Step 6: Decorate with mint and coriander sprigs if desired.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, pork mince, red onion, spring onions, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaf, lime juice, fish sauce, chili flakes, mint leaf, coriander leaves, fresh chili pepper, rice powder, lettuce, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok and stir fry the pork until cooked, about 6-7 minutes. Step 2: Remove from heat and mix in the remaining ingredients, put in a nice bowl. Step 3: Arrange the garnishes around the bowl on a nice platter Diners just help themselves to the lettuce leaves and pork, plus garnishes.

Dish Name: Quick And Easy Thai Style Coleslaw
Ingredient Names: coleslaw mix, lime juice, rice wine vinegar, thai fish sauce, sesame oil, honey, peanuts, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Place coleslaw mix or broccoli slaw mix in large bowl. Step 2: In a separate bowl mix the lime juice, rice vinegar, fish sauce, sesame oil, honey and peanuts. Step 3: Stir until well blended. Step 4: Taste and season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Add to the slaw mixture and toss gently to mix. Step 6: Refrigerate for a few hours, stir occasssionally to allow flavors to blend.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, onion, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, rice wine vinegar, water, sugar, kosher salt
Instructions: Step 1: Mix water, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Step 2: In a serving bowl arrange the cucumber, pepper, cilantro, and onion in layers. Step 3: Pour the vinegar mixture over the salad. Step 4: Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

Dish Name: Salt & pepper quails with Thai herb & bean salad
Ingredient Names: quails, thumb-size ginger, fresh coriander, garlic, white peppercorns, vegetable oil, flour, red chile, snake beans, fresh lime leaves, mint, thai shallots, green onion angle, fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put all the rub ingredients in a mortar and use a pestle to grind them together, then rub some inside each quail. Step 2: For the paste, again grind 1 tsp sea salt and the pepper together in a mortar using a pestle, then stir in the oil and flour. Step 3: Heat a little vegetable oil in a heavybased frying pan and carefully brown the quails all over – in batches if you need. Lift into a roasting tin, rub all over with the salt and pepper paste, then roast in the oven for 10-15 mins until golden and cooked to your liking. Step 4: For the salad, pound the dressing ingredients together using a mortar and pestle. Mix all the salad ingredients in a bowl. Just before serving, toss the dressing with the salad and serve alongside the quail and rice.

Dish Name: Satay pork with crunchy apple salad
Ingredient Names: crunchy peanut butter, sweet chili sauce, lean pork steaks, limes, thai fish sauce, sugar, apples, fresh cilantro, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat grill to high. Mix the peanut butter and sweet chilli sauce together, then season with pepper (the peanut butter is salty enough). Arrange the pork on a baking tray, brush the tops with half the nutty mixture, then grill for 3 mins. Carefully turn the pork steaks over, brush with the remaining mixture, then grill for 3-4 mins more until just cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, make the salad by mixing the lime juice, fish sauce and sugar in a bowl. Stir in the apple slices so they are well coated in the dressing, then toss with the coriander and mint. Serve the crunchy apple salad alongside the pork steaks, with jasmine rice on the side.

Dish Name: Sesame Pork With Thai Cucumber Salad
Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, soy sauce, garlic cloves, honey, brown sugar, fresh ginger, toasted sesame seeds, english cucumber, red onion, rice wine vinegar, lime juice, sugar, fresh cilantro, unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine soy sauce and garlic in a small cup. Step 2: Place tenderloin in a resealable food storage bag. Step 3: Pour soy / garlic mixture over the pork. Step 4: Turn to coat and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours While pork marinates, prepare cucumber salad. Step 5: Wash, but do not peel cucumber. Step 6: Cut into thin slices. Step 7: Mix cucumber and onion in a medium bowl. Step 8: Combine vinegar, lime juice and sugar in a small bowl. Step 9: Stir into cucumbers and onions.

Dish Name: Shiver Me Timbers Thai Inspired Cole Slaw
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, thai sweet chili sauce, ginger, dill pickles, lime, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, peanut butter, sugar, cabbage, fresh asparagus, frozen green pea, scallion, carrot
Instructions: Step 1: Place th' dressin' in'redient in a blender 'n blend 'til smooth. Step 2: In a large bowl toss all th' salad in'redients wit' th' dressin' Dressin' may seem thick but th' cabbage gunna exude liquid 'n be perfect. Step 3: Chill fer 1 hour fer flavors to meld. Step 4: Toss before servin', place in a servin' bowl toppin' wit' garnishes 'o ye likin's Thank you for trying my recipe.

Ingredient Names: english cucumbers, red onion, jalapeno pepper, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, sesame oil, unsalted dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Step 2: Slice the cucumbers thinly. Step 3: Place cucumbers, onions and chillies in a bowl. Step 4: Combine remaining ingredients and drizzle over the salad. Step 5: Toss well, Garnish with the peanuts & serve.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, white onion, fish sauce, chili paste with garlic, garlic cloves, lime, white vinegar, sugar, salt, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the cucumber and slice paper thin. Step 2: Slice the onion paper thin. Step 3: Make the dressing with the rest of the ingredients. Step 4: Toss the veggies with the dressing. Step 5: Set in the fridge to marinate I find that this salad improves with age as the cucumbers and onion soak up the flavors from the dressing, however if you slice your veggies thin enough, it's good enough to eat right away.

Ingredient Names: white vinegar, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, granulated sugar, jalapenos, garlic cloves, cucumbers, shallots, cilantro leaves, honey roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the vinegar, lime juice, fish sauce and sugar. Step 2: Add the pounded hot peppers and garlic, stir well. Step 3: Toss the cucumbers and shallots with the sauce and cilantro. Step 4: Chill Just before serving, sprinkle with chopped peanuts.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, lime, sugar, nam pla, red onion, red chili pepper, green chili pepper, plum tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Cut cucumber halves into 2-inch long sections, then cut each section into 1 / 4-inch thick strips or thick matchsticks. Step 2: Place cucumbers in a bowl. Step 3: Add the lime juice, sugar, and nam pla and toss gently until well combined. Step 4: Add onion, chilies and tomatoes and toss gently until well combined. Step 5: Garnish with whole chilies and coriander sprigs.

Dish Name: Thai Banana And Green Chilli Salad
Ingredient Names: bananas, lettuce, cucumber, snow pea sprouts, mint leaf, cilantro leaf, roasted peanuts, green chilies, ginger, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dressing, place chillies, ginger, fish sauce, lemon juice, sugar and coconut milk in a jar with a firm fitting lid Shake until combined. Step 2: Combine lettuce or packaged salad leaves with the banana, cucumber, snow peas, mint and coriander in a bowl. Step 3: Pour dressing over and top with roasted peanuts just before serving If you aren't planning on serving this immediately it is a good idea to leave the bananas out, then just before serving slice them and mix them through.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, rice vinegar, fish sauce, water, creamy peanut butter, chili paste with garlic, garlic, napa cabbage, red cabbage, red bell pepper, carrot, dry roasted peanuts, fresh cilantro, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: Combine lime juice, vinegar, fish sauce, water, peanut butter, chile paste and garlic in a large bowl, stirring with a whisk until blended. Step 2: Add cabbages, bell pepper, and carrot, and toss gently to coat. Step 3: Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour. Step 4: Stir in the peanuts, cilantro, and mint just before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Cucumber And Peanut Salad Relish
Ingredient Names: cucumbers, vegetable oil, onion, unsalted peanuts, white vinegar, lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, chili, fresh coriander, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Shred or finely chop cucumbers. Step 2: Leave to drain in a sieve for half an hour. Step 3: Squeeze drained cucumber to remove excess moisture and dry between paper towels. Step 4: Saute onions and peantus in oil for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Mix vinegar, juice, zest, fish sauce and sugar, stir to dissolve. Step 6: Now mix all the ingredients together Extra fish sauce or palm sugar may be added if desired, serve chilled.

Ingredient Names: pineapple, cucumber, green onions, cilantro, mint, fish sauce, lime, palm sugar, chili, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the pineapple, cucumber, green onions, cilantro and mint in a large bowl. Step 2: Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and chili in a small bowl. Step 3: Toss the dressing into the salad and stir lightly to coat. Step 4: Serve garnished with chopped roasted peanuts.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, chilies, red onions, dried shrimp, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, peanut oil, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Peel cucmbers. Step 2: Cut of the ends, cut them in half lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Step 3: Slice them thinly into half moons. Step 4: Add the cucumbers to a bowl with the chiles and onion. Step 5: Add the ground shrimp, lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and peanut oil, toss well. Step 6: Allow to sit or serve immediately sprinkled with the peanuts.

Dish Name: Thai Cucumber Salad With Roasted Peanuts
Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, jalapeno chiles, garlic cloves, english cucumbers, red onion, of fresh mint, dry roasted salted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk first 5 ingredients in medium bowl. Step 2: Place cucumbers, onion and mint in large bowl. Step 3: Add dressing and toss to coat. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Step 5: Sprinkle with peanuts and serve.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, clove, fish sauce, rice vinegar, lime, light brown sugar, sriracha sauce, fresh green beans, roma tomatoes, red bell pepper, cilantro, fresh basil, of fresh mint, peanuts, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: For dressing, whisk together soy sauce, garlic, fish sauce, rice vinegar, lime juice and zest, brown sugar, and sriracha. Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanche beans for about 2 minutes, still crunchy and bright green Shock in cold water. Step 3: Combine red pepper, tomato, cilantro, basil, mint, and green beans. Step 4: Toss with dressing and add black pepper to your liking. Step 5: Let sit for at least 30 minutes for flavors to meld Before serving, toss in peanuts, and garnish with green onion.

Dish Name: Thai Green Papaya Salad Aka Som Tam
Ingredient Names: papayas, tomatoes, garlic, dried shrimp, birds eye chiles, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, peanuts, roasted cashew nuts, long beans, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Pound garlic until fine. Step 2: Add garlic, lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar in a bowl, mix well. Step 3: Add papaya, tomato wedges and chili into a big mixing bowl. Step 4: Stir in the garlic mixture into papaya bowl Adjust seasoning if necessary It should be mixture of sweet, sour and salty. Step 5: Toss in dried shrimp, groundnut and cashew nut Served with long beans, cabbage or other raw vegetables.

Ingredient Names: limes, fish sauce, sugar, thai peppers, peanut oil, mangoes, red bell pepper, carrot, green onions, shallot, fresh cilantro, peanuts, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Zest peel from 1 lime and place in a measuring cup along with 1 / 4 cup of lime juice. Step 2: Whisk in fish sauce, sugar and thai pepper until sugar is dissolved Gradually whisk in peanut oil until blended. Step 3: Add shallot, mix well. Step 4: Set dressing aside Peel mangoes, then cut away chunks of fruit from pits then, cut into thin strips and place in a large bowl Seed sweet pepper, cut into very thin strips and add to mangoes. Step 5: Add carrot, half of green onions, and cilantro. Step 6: Toss gently until combined. Step 7: Add dressing and a pinch of salt, toss until mixed.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, lemon juice, low sodium soy sauce, light brown sugar, pineapple, red apple, green onions, romaine lettuce
Instructions: Step 1: Shake oil, lemon juice, soy sauce, and brown sugar in a tightly covered jar Twist top from pineapple. Step 2: Cut pineapple into quarters. Step 3: Cut fruit from rind. Step 4: Remove core and any "eyes" Slice each quarter lengthwise. Step 5: Cut crosswise into chunks. Step 6: Toss pineapple chunks, apple and green onions with dressing. Step 7: Place romaine in shallow bowl Mound fruit mixture in center.

Ingredient Names: pomelo fruit, red chile, garlic, honey, fish sauce, limes, lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and segment a large pomelo and place the pieces in a bowl. Step 2: Make a dressing by combining the other ingredients. Step 3: Pour the dressing over the fruit and garnish with fresh coriander.

Dish Name: Thai Roasted Eggplant Salad With Cilantro And Lime
Ingredient Names: japanese eggplant, shallots, cilantro, green onions, garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, hot green chili peppers, dried shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise. Step 2: Cook eggplant strips, skin-side down, on a lightly oiled hot grill until tender and lightly browned, or on a baking sheet in a 400-degree f oven for 15 minutes set aside to cool. Step 3: Meanwhile, place all remaining ingredients in medium bowl. Step 4: Cut thick strips of eggplant crosswise into 2-in Chunks and add to the bowl Gently toss well to mix eggplant with seasoning. Step 5: Garnish salad with cilantro leaves. Step 6: Serve at room temperature or chilled with all juices.

Ingredient Names: fresh lime juice, olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, fresh ginger, garlic clove, red chili pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together Will keep in fridge for two days.

Ingredient Names: carrot, unsalted cashews, red bell pepper, green onions, fresh coriander, fresh basil, lime juice, soy sauce, fish sauce, white wine vinegar, fresh garlic cloves, chili, white sugar, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: First make the dressing by mixing all salad dressing ingredients together in the bowl. Step 2: Taste-test for sourness / spiciness, adding more sugar if it's too sour for your taste, or more chili if it's not spicy enough, set aside. Step 3: Slice the cucumber, then cut the slices in half. Step 4: Place in a salad bowl. Step 5: Add the grated carrot, cashews, red pepper, and spring onions. Step 6: Pour the dressing over and toss well. Step 7: Place salad on a mixed bed of fresh coriander and fresh basil, and serve immediately Enjoy!

Dish Name: Thai Salad With Easy Spicy Dressing
Ingredient Names: head romaine lettuce, red bell pepper, carrot, bean sprouts, cucumber, snow peas, red onion, fresh cilantro, of fresh mint, roasted peanuts, lime juice, olive oil, sesame oil, sugar, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Toss veggies and herbs together in a large salad bowl. Step 2: Whisk dressing ingredients in a small bowl until sugar is dissolved Gently toss salad with dressing. Step 3: Top with chopped nuts and serve.

Dish Name: Thai Steak Salad With Basil And Mint
Ingredient Names: sugar, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, water, thai chili paste, flank steak, salt, fresh ground black pepper, cooking spray, romaine lettuce, cucumber, red bell pepper, red onion, fresh basil, of fresh mint
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare dressing, combine first 5 ingredients. Step 2: Set aside To prepare salad, sprinkle both sides of steak with salt and pepper. Step 3: Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat. Step 4: Add steak, cook 8 minutes or until desired degree of doneness, turning after 4 minutes. Step 5: Remove steak from pan. Step 6: Cover and set aside. Step 7: Combine lettuce and remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Step 8: Drizzle with 3 tablespoons dressing. Step 9: Arrange 1 1 / 4 cups salad on each of 4 plates.

Ingredient Names: brown sugar, water, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, soy sauce, lime juice, peanut oil, fresh ginger, salt, green beans, baby spinach, green cabbage, green onions, red pepper, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dressing, combine brown sugar, water, garlic and pepper flakes in a jar with a lid. Step 2: Add remaining dressing ingredients Shake well Or you can whisk the ingredients in a medium bowl To make the salad, toss together all salad ingredients except peanuts, basil, and vegetable chips Immediately before serving, drizzle about two-thirds of dressing over salad, toss well. Step 3: Sprinkle with roasted peanuts, herbs and vegetable chips Pass remaining dressing at the table.

Ingredient Names: steak, thai chiles, cornstarch, garlic cloves, romaine lettuce hearts, thai basil, fresh cilantro, mint leaves, red onion, edible orchid, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, peanut oil, sugar, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Mix lime juice, fish sauce, peanut oil, sugar, salt and pepper, set aside. Step 2: Add the constarch to the beef strips and toss. Step 3: Add 3 tb oil to a heavy bottomed pan and heat to medium-high. Step 4: When the oil is hot, but not smoking add the beef strips and stir constantly, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add a pinch of salt and sugar The starch will stick to the pan, but that is ok. Step 6: Add the chiles and cook two minutes more. Step 7: Add the garlic and cook another minute, remove and set aside to cool to lukewarm. Step 8: Slice the romaine lettuce in half lengthwise, and then each half into thin strips, and spread them out on a serving platter.

Ingredient Names: tuna in vegetable oil, lemongrass, mint, spring onions, chilies, lemon juice, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place tuna and oil in mixing bowl Chop chilis, lemon grass, mint, and onion Mix with tuna Stir in lemon juice and fish sauce.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, red chile, zucchini, carrot, fresh cilantro leaves, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl whisk together dressing ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Add zucchini, carrot, and cilantro to dressing, tossing well Salad may be made 2 hours ahead and chilled, covered. Step 3: Bring salad to room temperature before serving. Step 4: Serve salad sprinkled with peanuts.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, thai green curry paste, sugar, fresh cilantro, baby spinach leaves, limes, thai fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Open the coconut milk, pour the thin milk into a jug, keeping back any thick coconut cream. Scoop the coconut cream into a blender. Add 2-3 tbsp of the coconut milk plus curry paste, sugar and coriander stalks and blend to a smooth paste. Heat a wok, tip in the paste, stir fry for 1-2 mins, then pour in the remaining milk from the jug. Step 2: Bring to a simmer, then add the prawns and spinach. Cook until the prawns are heated through and spinach has wilted. Add lime juice and fish sauce, then spoon into bowls. Scatter over coriander leaves and serve with plain rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, low-fat peanut butter, low-fat catalina dressing, water, reduced sodium soy sauce, chili powder
Instructions: Step 1: Thread shrimp onto skewers. Step 2: Mix peanut butter, salad dressing until smooth. Step 3: Stir in water and soy sauce. Step 4: Brush 1 / 2 of sauce on shrimp. Step 5: Grill or broil for about 3-5 minutes or until shrimp becomes opaque. Step 6: Serve with remaining sauce for dipping.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, sugar, fish sauce, sambal oelek chili paste, shrimp, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly combine the lime juice, sugar, fish sauce or oyster sauce and sambal or chili paste in a jar or small bowl sauce. Step 2: Pour this sauce into a 10-inch non-stick pan. Step 3: Turn the heat to medium high and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add the shrimp and reduce heat to medium low. Step 5: Cook until the shrimp is tender and the sauce thickens slightly, about 3 to 4 minutes if you like a thicker sauce, temporarily remove the cooked shrimp with a slotted spoon while the sauce continues to thicken, this will prevent the shrimp from becoming overcooked and rubbery. Step 6: Add cilantro to the sauce. Step 7: Taste and adjust the seasonings, pour over cooked rice or noodles.

Dish Name: American Kitchen Classic Basic Thai Curry
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red curry paste, low sodium chicken broth, fresh lime leaves, lime, fresh ginger, lemongrass, chicken, carrots, cabbage, light brown sugar, thai fish sauce, fresh basil leaf, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Read the method from start to finish and then choose and prep your ingredients Curry base: shake the can of coconut milk or stir it well. Step 2: In a 3-4 qt saucepan or wok over medium heat, simmer 1 / 2 cup of coconut milk, stirring occasionally until reduced by half It will get very thick and shiny and may or may not separate-either is fine. Step 3: Add your choice of curry paste, whisk well and cook, continuing to whisk, for 1 minute. Step 4: Whisk in the broth and the remaining coconut milk. Step 5: Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat Aromatics / simmer: add your choice of aromatics, proteins, vegetables and fruits as well as the brown sugar and fish sauces to the simmering sauce Be aware that some ingredients take longer than others to cook. Step 6: Add the ingredients in stages, as listed in the next step.

Dish Name: Asian Mint's Thai Red Curry With Shrimp
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, red curry paste, medium shrimp, water, bamboo shoots, sugar, paprika, thai fish sauce, salt, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, sweet basil, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, bring half the coconut milk to a slow boil, stirring constantly. Step 2: Add the curry paste and shrimp, stir well, and cook until done, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the remaining coconut milk, water, bamboo shoots, sugar, paprika and fish sauce, and bring to a boil slowly, add salt. Step 4: Add bell peppers and basil leaves, and remove from heat. Step 5: Serve immediately over steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: rice sticks, extra firm tofu, chinese chives, bean sprouts, garlic cloves, shallot, vegetable oil, peanuts, fish sauce, sugar, tamarind pulp, dried arbol chile, preserved turnip, egg, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dry noodles in lukewarm water while preparing the other ingredients, for 10-15 minutes Julienne tofu and cut into pieces 1 inch long. Step 2: Cut up chinese chives into 1 inch long pieces. Step 3: Set aside a few fresh chives for a garnish. Step 4: Rinse the bean sprouts and save half for serving fresh Mince shallot and garlic together. Step 5: Heat the oil in a wok on high. Step 6: Fry the peanuts until toasted and remove them from the wok. Step 7: Add shallot, garlic and tofu and stir them until they start to brown The noodles should be flexible but not expanded at this point.

Dish Name: Baked Crab Rangoon With Thai Ginger Lime Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, white crab meat, low-fat cream cheese, green onion, onion, teriyaki sauce, white pepper, peanuts, lime juice, rice wine vinegar, low sodium soy sauce, water, brown sugar, of fresh mint, ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Prehat the oven to 350 Lightly spray the bottom of the cups of a muffin tin with a non-stick cooking spray Filling - add the crab meat, cream cheese, chopped green onion, minced onion, teriyaki sauce and white pepper to a small mixing bowl and mix until well blended. Step 2: Place the wonton wrappers on a flat surface. Step 3: Add spoonfuls of the crab filling to the center of each wonton wrapper, take two opposite. Step 4: Take the other two opposite Gently pinch the four. Step 5: Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers Lift each crab rangoon appetizer gently and place one into each of the cups of the coated muffin tin.

Dish Name: Baked Prawns With Pepper And Garlic
Ingredient Names: prawns, light soya sauce, sugar, black pepper, garlic cloves, cilantro, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven at 180c. Step 2: Wash prawns, cut off feelers and make a slit down the back to de-vein Dry prawns with paper towels, and arrange on oven-proof serving dish Pound the coriander with pepper and garlic. Step 3: Heat oil in a small frying pan. Step 4: Add the pounded ingredients and stir-fry for two minutes, or till it is fragrant. Step 5: Stir in the soya sauce and sugar, turn off the heat. Step 6: Pour the sauce mixture over the prawns and bake for 10 minutes or till the shells turn bright red. Step 7: Serve on a pretty looking dish and enjoy.

Ingredient Names: fish, english cucumber, thai fish sauce, oyster sauce, honey, fresh lemon juice, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, hot chili pepper, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: I give directions for oven-baking a whole fish, but you can just as well fry fish fillets in a skillet Never overcook! Step 2: Then serve with this sauce If possible, make the sauce the day before or earlier in the day, so the flavours develop, but i confess i always make it at the last minute Do not boil the sauce -- heat gently. Step 3: Make the sauce: coarsely grate the cucumber into a small pot, liquid and all, then stir in the rest of the ingredients given above Use enough cucumber! Step 4: The sauce is not really strong, just flavourful -- don't overdo the hot pepper! Step 5: If in doubt, add a few drops of tabasco. Step 6: Taste for seasoning, keeping in mind that fish and oyster sauces are salty, and their flavours become more pronounced on standing. Step 7: Cover and keep cool To prepare the dish, for a using a whole fish: Heat oven to 425 deg f.

Dish Name: Big John's Thai Crab Fried Rice Khao Phad Pu
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, crabmeat, cooking oil, soy sauce, eggs, green onions, sesame oil, garlic cloves, black pepper, sugar, thai fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine sugar, pepper, soy & fish sauces then set aside Warm oils in a large frying pan over medium heat Lightly saute garlic and green onion. Step 2: Add rice and mix thoroughly to separate. Step 3: Add egg, mix until it's cooked and evenly dispersed. Step 4: Mix in crab meat, making sure it is broken up and mixed well. Step 5: Add sauce combination and mix well. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Broiled Halibut With Thai Stir Fry Vegetables
Ingredient Names: halibut fillet, rice vinegar, honey, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, canola oil, red pepper, zucchini, mushroom, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Combine vinegar, honey, garlic and red pepper flakes. Step 3: Place fish in a glass dish or plastic bag, spoon 3 tablespoons vinegar mixture over fish Seal bag or cover dish, turn to coat well and marinate 15 minutes Reserve remaining vinegar mixture Spray broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray. Step 4: Drain fish and place on broiler pan Broil 5 minutes, turn and broil 3 minutes or just until fish is done and flakes easily. Step 5: Meanwhile, heat oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Broiled Red Snapper With Tamarind Sauce
Ingredient Names: tamarind pulp, cold water, shallots, garlic cloves, cilantro stems, fish sauce, thai basil, sugar, salt, vegetable oil, red snapper fillets, scallions, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl combine water and tamarind and let stand for 10 minutes. Step 2: Strain this using a strainer and squeeze the tamarind gently to remove as much juice as possible To this tamarind water add the shallots, garlic cilantro stems, fish sauce, sugar and salt. Step 3: Simmer this sauce stirring occasionally until slightly thickened, keep warm. Step 4: Preheat broiler Lightly brush a small rack of a broiler pan with oil and arrange the snapper fillets skin side down. Step 5: Season fillets with salt and broil 4 to f inches from the heat until just cooked through While fish is broiling, thinly slice the scallions and chillies. Step 6: Stir the whole basil leaves into sauce just before serving.

Dish Name: Broiled Tilapia With Thai Coconut Curry Sauce
Ingredient Names: dark sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, red bell pepper, green onion, curry powder, red curry paste, ground cumin, low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, salt, light coconut milk, fresh cilantro, tilapia fillets, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat broiler. Step 2: Heat 1 / 2 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add ginger and garlic, cook 1 minute. Step 4: Add peppers and onions, cook 1 minute. Step 5: Stir in curry powder, curry paste, and cumin, cook 1 minute. Step 6: Add soy sauce, sugar, 1 / 4 teaspoon salt, and coconut milk. Step 7: Bring to a simmer.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, garlic clove, scallion, dark soy sauce, thai fish sauce, fresh cilantro, egg, wonton wrappers, red bird's eye chilies, scallions, beef stock, rice wine, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Wontons: Finely chop the shrimp. Step 2: Put them in a bowl and stir in the garlic, scallion, soy sauce, fish sauce, cilantro and egg yolk Lay the wonton wrappers on work surface in a single layer and place about 1 tablespoon of the filling mixture into the middle of each. Step 3: Brush the edges with egg white and fold each one into a triangle, pressing lightly to seal. Step 4: Bring the 2 bottom corners of the triangle around to meet in the middle, securing with a little egg white to hold in place Soup: Slice the chilies on a steep diagonal angle to make long slices, removing seeds if you prefer. Step 5: Slice the scallions on the same angle. Step 6: Place the stock, fish sauce, soy sauce, and rice wine in a large pot and bring to a boil.

Dish Name: Chilli Prawn And Bean Thread Noodle Salad
Ingredient Names: prawns, lime juice, sweet chili sauce, red thai chile, thai green chili, bean thread noodles, fresh mint leaves, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Shell and devein the prawns leaving the tails intact. Step 2: Combine the prawns with the lemon juice, sauce, chillies and sugar in a large bowl. Step 3: Place noodles in large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water, stand until tender, drain. Step 4: Combine noodles and mint with prawn mixture.

Dish Name: Coconut Lime Shrimp With Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: creamy peanut butter, chicken broth, canned unsweetened coconut milk, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, fish sauce, hot pepper sauce, fresh basil, garlic, fresh ginger, golden brown sugar, shrimp, bamboo skewers
Instructions: Step 1: For peanut sauce: puree all ingredients in processor until smooth For shrimp: blend first 8 ingredients in processor until almost smooth. Step 2: Transfer marinade to 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish. Step 3: Add shrimp and turn to coat. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, turning occasionally, prepare barbecue. Step 5: Thread 5 shrimp onto each of 4 skewers. Step 6: Grill until just cooked through, basting with marinade, about 2 minutes per side Alternatively, you can grill shrimp under a preheated broiler. Step 7: Serve shrimp with peanut sauce.

Dish Name: Coconut Thai Shrimp And Rice Crock Pot
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, water, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt, cayenne, limes, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, onion, red bell pepper, carrot, flaked coconut, golden raisin, converted white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Mix chicken broth, water, coriander, cumin, salt, cayenne, lime zest, lime juice, garlic and ginger in crock pot. Step 2: Stir in onion, bell pepper, carrot, coconut, raisins and rice. Step 3: Cover and cook on low setting 3 1 / 2 hours, or until rice is just tender. Step 4: Stir in the shrimp and snow peas. Step 5: Cover and cook another 30 minutes. Step 6: Serve garnished with toasted coconut.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, snow pea pods, red bell pepper, medium shrimp, peanut sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling bowl. Step 2: Add the spaghetti and cook as directed on package. Step 3: Rinse with cold water to cool While the spaghetti is cooking, combine the pea pods, bell pepper, shrimp and peanut sauce in a large bowl. Step 4: Add the cooked spaghetti. Step 5: Toss gently to mix and serve.

Ingredient Names: linguine, cooked shrimp, bean sprouts, red pepper, english cucumber, green onions, of fresh mint, fresh coriander, fish sauce, seasoned rice vinegar, granulated sugar, garlic cloves, lime juice, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water for about 10 minutes or until tender but firm. Step 2: Drain and rinse under cold water and drain well. Step 3: Place in large bowl. Step 4: Add shrimp, bean sprouts, red pepper, cucumber, onions, mint and coriander, if using To make thai dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, lime juice and chili paste. Step 5: Pour over linguine, shrimp and vegetables and toss well to coat. Step 6: Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: tamarind paste, water, fish sauce, rice vinegar, granulated sugar, cayenne pepper, peanut oil, dried rice noodles, eggs, table salt, medium shrimp, garlic cloves, shallot, dried shrimp, preserved radish
Instructions: Step 1: Soak tamarind paste in 3 / 4 cup boiling water for about 10 minutes, then push it through a mesh strainer to remove the seeds and fibers and extract as much pulp as possible. Step 2: Stir fish sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, cayenne, and 2 tablespoons oil into tamarind liquid and set aside. Step 3: Cover rice sticks with hot tap water in large bowl. Step 4: Soak until softened, pliable, and limp but not fully tender, about 20 minutes. Step 5: Drain noodles and set aside. Step 6: Beat eggs and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt in small bowl, set aside. Step 7: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in 12-inch skillet over high heat until just beginning to smoke, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Add shrimp and sprinkle with remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon salt. Step 9: Cook, tossing occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and browned about the edges, about 3 minutes.

Dish Name: Crispy Orange Glazed Salmon Thai Inspired
Ingredient Names: orange juice, rice wine vinegar, light soy sauce, red thai chile, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh ginger, salmon fillets, olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, honey
Instructions: Step 1: Stir together the first 6 ingredients in a glass baking dish or shallow bowl. Step 2: Add salmon and drizzle with 1 tablespoons of the olive oil, turning to evenly coat. Step 3: Marinate at least 30 minutes. Step 4: Remove salmon, reserving the marinade, and season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, and add remaining 1 tablespoons olive oil. Step 6: Cook salmon 3-4 minutes per side or until fish begins to flake with fork. Step 7: Remove from pan, pour reserved marinade into skillet, and add honey. Step 8: Heat about 3 minutes or until syrupy. Step 9: Serve salmon warm over a mound of rice topped with some of the sauce and garnish, if desired.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, onion, carrots, garlic cloves, curry powder, long-grain white rice, salt and pepper, large shrimp, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Step 2: Add the onion and carrots and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 6 to 8 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic and curry and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the rice, 2 1 / 2 cups water, 1 / 2 teaspoon salt, and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 6: Season the shrimp with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and nestle them in the partially cooked rice. Step 7: Cover and cook until the shrimp are opaque throughout, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 8: Fold in the basil and serve.

Ingredient Names: white bread, chicken broth, shrimp, water chestnuts, ginger, salt, hot sauce, egg yolks, egg whites, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Save yourself endless trouble in peeling, and buy packets of raw, tiny shrimp The cooked ones do not taste as good as raw Defrost and drain well, and pat with kitchen paper to remove excess liquid Tear the bread into a small bowl with the chicken broth or stock, and let bread absorb the liquid Lift the soaked bread into a bowl, leaving excess liquid behind but do not squeeze out the broth Break up the wet bread as much as possible, and add to the shrimps. Step 2: Mix in all the ingredients except the beaten egg white The ginger and chestnuts should be really fine: do it by chopping them on a board with a carving knife, as you've seen the tv chefs do! Step 3: Heat oil to a depth of about 4 inches: when a cube of bread is dropped in and sizzles, the oil is ready Stir the beaten egg whites into the shrimp mixture.

Dish Name: Deep Fried Shrimp Cakes Taud Man Goong
Ingredient Names: shrimp, lard, salt, sugar, fresh breadcrumbs, oil, white vinegar, cauliflower, baby corn, cucumber, chilies, shallots
Instructions: Step 1: Chop shrimp and lard together until fine. Step 2: Add salt, sugar& bread crumbs and shape into small patties Deep fry until golden brown& fragrant For the accompaniment: bring vinegar and 1 / 2 cup sugar to a boil- then cool. Step 3: Add all vegetables, chilis& shallots- set aside. Step 4: Serve with fried patties.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, garlic cloves, oil, oyster sauce, green onions, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a non-stick skillet or wok over high heat. Step 2: Add oil and heat until nearly smoking. Step 3: Add shrimp and garlic to pan. Step 4: Stir-fry for 1 minute then add the oyster sauce Continue to stir-fry until shrimp is pink, about 2 minutes. Step 5: Remove from heat and add the green onions and sriracha sauce. Step 6: Stir and serve over steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, curry paste, onion, plum tomatoes, frozen shrimp, celery, green onions, fresh coriander, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pour coconut milk into a large, wide frying pan and set over medium heat. Step 2: Stir in curry paste Finely chop onion and stir into sauce. Step 3: Slice tomatoes in half. Step 4: Squeeze out and discard seeds Coarsely chop. Step 5: Then stir into gently boiling sauce. Step 6: Stir often, uncovered until sauce thickens, 7-10 minute meanwhile, defrost shrimp according to package directions Pat dry with paper towels. Step 7: Once sauce is almost as thick as you like, stir in shrimp and celery.

Dish Name: Easy Thai Coconut Shrimp And Rice
Ingredient Names: shrimp, poblano pepper, garlic cloves, minced ginger, honey, soy sauce, light coconut milk, olive oil, kosher salt, onion, red bell pepper, basil leaves, green onion, fresh cilantro, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: A The original recipe called for 2 seeded chopped jalapeos, so i think any hot pepper would work I use the pre-cleaned frozen shrimp and they are fine for this recipe, you don't need anything fancy If i am making pineapple salad, i use fresh pineapple in this recipe Otherwise, i use canned crushed pineapple Start by placing the shrimp in a large self-close bag or medium glass bowl. Step 2: Add the peppers, garlic, ginger, honey, soy sauce, and coconut milk. Step 3: Allow to marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 4 hours. Step 4: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine olive oil, salt, onions, and bell peppers. Step 5: Cook until vegetables become slightly soft, but not browned.

Ingredient Names: shallots, fresh ginger, fresh coriander, fish sauce, tamarind paste, dark brown sugar, fresh chili peppers, chicken broth, salt, fish fillet, scallions, basil, fresh coriander leaves, fresh green chilies
Instructions: Step 1: Put first 7 ingredients in blender and process to a puree. Step 2: Add this puree to the rest of the broth in a wide heavy based pan, bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer 5 minutes. Step 3: Taste now for seasoning, adding salt / soy if necessary Optional extra step: sear fish pieces in a separate very hot saute pan in some butter or oil--no more than 30 seconds each side. Step 4: Add fish pieces to simmering liquid and poach on slightly lowered heat, turning once, about 5 to 8 minutes total Do not overcook! Step 5: Remove fish and serve in a platter, with sauce poured over the fish Sprinkle with garnishes.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onions, ginger, thai red curry paste, tomatoes, coconut milk, raw shrimp, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan. Tip in the onion and ginger, then cook for a few mins until softened. Stir in the curry paste, then cook for 1 min more. Pour over the chopped tomatoes and coconut cream. Bring to the boil, then leave to simmer for 5 mins, adding a little boiling water if the mixture gets too thick. Step 2: Tip in the prawns, then cook for 5-10 mins more, depending on how large they are. Serve alongside some plain rice and sprinkle with a little chopped coriander, if you like.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, red thai curry paste, leftover rice, shrimp, green beans, limes, thai fish sauce, cucumbers
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan on a medium heat. Pour in the egg, tilt the pan so it forms a thin omelette and cook for about 1 min until set. Tip out onto a chopping board, roll up, then slice into ribbons. Set aside. Step 2: Heat the curry paste with 1 tbsp water until hot, then tip in the rice, stir to break up and toss to coat. Step 3: Add the prawns and beans, and heat through. Add the lime juice and fish sauce, then stir though the egg strips. Serve the fried rice in bowls with extra lime wedges and fish sauce. Scatter with some sliced cucumber, chilli and coriander leaves, if you like.

Dish Name: Fillet Of Red Snapper With Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: red snapper fillets, lime, olive oil, garlic, white onion, celery, tomato paste, coconut milk, chicken bouillon cube, bay leaves, tomatoes, cooked white rice
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle fillets with lime juice In deep skillet, heat oil on medium. Step 2: Stir in garlic, onion, celery, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring often. Step 3: Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Stir in coconut milk, bouillon, and bay leaves. Step 5: Bring to boil and simmer on low for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Stir in sliced tomatoes. Step 7: Add fillets, skin side up, gently pushing them into the sauce. Step 8: Simmer 5 minutes or until fish is cooked and flakes easily with a fork. Step 9: Transfer to warm serving tray and keep warm.

Ingredient Names: pink salmon, eggs, chilies, coriander, shredded coconut, five-spice powder, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, spring onions, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Remove any large bones from salmon Process all ingredients in food processor until smooth. Step 2: Refrigerate the fish mixture for 15 minutes for easier handling Form the mixture into small cakes. Step 3: Heat oil in a non-stick frypan over a medium heat. Step 4: Fry cakes approximately 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Step 5: Serve with a squeeze of lemon juice If you are preparing food for people on a gluten-free diet, always check the ingredients on all food labels, especially any prepared items like sauces.

Dish Name: Fish Potato Yellow Curry Gaeng Leuang Pla
Ingredient Names: tiny new potatoes, sweet potatoes, coconut milk, yellow curry paste, fish stock, fish sauce, lime juice, dark brown sugar, molasses, maple syrup, white fish fillets, green onions, lemongrass, coriander, thai chile
Instructions: Step 1: Cook potatoes. Step 2: In a large pan bring half the coconut milk to a boil. Step 3: Boil, stir occasionally, until it has reduced by halve and the oil separates from the coconut milk. Step 4: Now add the curry paste, cook for about 1 minute. Step 5: Add remaining coconut milk, stock sauce, juice,, sugar, molasses and maple syrup. Step 6: Cook and stir until sugar is dissolve. Step 7: Add fish and cooked potatoes to the pan: cook, and stir occasionally. Step 8: Remove lemon grass, stir in onion and coriander. Step 9: Place curry in a serving bowl. Step 10: Sprinkle with sliced chili and coriander leaves.

Dish Name: Fragrant Coconut Lime Ginger Fish Bake
Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, fresh coriander, fresh ginger, hot chili peppers, red onion, cumin, ground coriander, cumin seed, garam masala, ground turmeric, white fish fillets, coconut cream, lime
Instructions: Step 1: In a frying pan saute the garlic, onion, ginger and chillies until soft. Step 2: Add the spices and more oil if necessary. Step 3: Blend the fried food with the coriander and juice of one lime leaving out the fish and coconut cream, leave overnight. Step 4: Take your fish fillets and cut in half so you should have 8 serves Smother the marinade over the fish generously. Step 5: Leave to marinade at least for four hours best overnight. Step 6: Take some aluminium foil, break off enough to make a loose parcel to hold the fish Get your coconut cream and on the foil put 2 to 3 tablespoons of the coconut cream, place one fish fillet on top, join up the foil allowing for a lot of space. Step 7: Cook on the barbq of in a hot oven for about 10-15 minutes the fish steams itself in the coconut cream - this is so yummy a great dinner party dish - serve with plain rice, mango salsa and a dry white wine.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, egg white, cornflour, kaffir lime leaves, ginger, wasabi, flat leaf parsley, oil, lime juice, soya sauce, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: To make the salmon cakes, remove any bones from the salmon and chop into 5mm dice. Step 2: Combine the chopped salmon with the egg white, corn flour, lime leaves, ginger, wasabi paste and chopped parsley. Step 3: Heat 1 cm of oil in frying pan over medium heat, to shallow fry the cakes. Step 4: Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture into the hot oil and cook for 35-45 seconds each side, or till golden brown in colour. Step 5: Drain on kitchen towels, and keep warm in a low oven till you finish cooking up the batter To make the lime dipping sauce, combine all the ingredients. Step 6: Serve the dipping sauce with the warm salmon cakes.

Dish Name: Fried Catfish With A Creamy Thai Sauce
Ingredient Names: catfish fillets, vegetable oil, curry powder, garlic powder, coriander seed, salt, cornmeal, flour, canola oil, onions, fresh ginger, garlic, lemongrass, red curry paste, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine spices, salt, cornmeal, flour Coat catfish with mixture. Step 2: Let sit while making sauce. Step 3: In a saucepan heat 2 teaspoons oil add and saute onions, ginger, garlic and lemon grass until soft. Step 4: Add red curry paste and cook add brown sugar, fish sauce, coconut milk, basil and lime juice, stir mixture. Step 5: Place 1 cup of sauce mixture in a blender with cashews blending well add back to pot. Step 6: Cook over medium heat until thick about 5 minutes. Step 7: Heat 2 tablespoons oil shaking off excess breading. Step 8: Add catfish and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side depending on size.

Dish Name: Gaeng Paa Pla Dook Jungle Curry With Catfish
Ingredient Names: catfish, oil, fish sauce, water, japanese eggplant, green jalapeno pepper, sweet basil, kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass, shallots, garlic cloves, ginger, jalapeno peppers, peppercorn, shrimp paste
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all the ingredients for the curry paste, using a mortar and pestle or a blender. Step 2: Heat a large saucepan and add the oil and curry paste. Step 3: Stir-fry for 1 minute on medium-high heat. Step 4: Add the fish, fish sauce, water and eggplant and heat to boiling. Step 5: Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the remaining ingredients and remove from the heat, serve.

Dish Name: Gang Kai Thai Red Curry Soup
Ingredient Names: cooking oil, curry paste, coconut milk, chicken, thai fish sauce, lime, lemon, red pepper flakes, basil leaves, kaffir lime leaves, bamboo shoot, straw mushroom, red bell peppers, potato, chinese eggplant
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saute pan. Step 2: Add curry paste and stir-fry until smooth. Step 3: Add coconut milk and mix thoroughly. Step 4: Add meat and simmer until no longer pink. Step 5: Mix in fish sauce and lime juice and keffir leaves. Step 6: Add slower cooking vegetables, like potatoes, and simmer covered until soft. Step 7: Add basil and faster cooking veggies, like peppers and zucchinis and simmer about two minutes until tender but still firm. Step 8: Serve in bowls over rice.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, fresh ginger, thai red chili peppers, garlic, sugar, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, water, vegetable oil, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Grind together the ginger, chile pepper, garlic and sugar in a mortar and pestle to get a coarse paste. Step 2: Transfer paste to a bowl and add fish sauce, lime juice, sriracha and water, mix to combine, season with salt. Step 3: Set aside This sauce will be divided Dry with paper toweling and season salmon with salt. Step 4: Pour over the fillets 4 tablespoons sauce, turning to coat. Step 5: Set aside the remaining sauce. Step 6: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet.

Ingredient Names: orange juice, orange peel, garlic, ginger, vegetable oil, tilapia fillets, flour, salt and pepper, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare the marinade, in a small bowl, whisk together orange juice and peeled garlic, ginger and oil. Step 2: Place the fillets in a shallow dish and cover with the marinade for 20-30 minutes. Step 3: Remove the tilapia from the marinade and reserve it Dredge the fillets in seasoned flour to coat shaking off excess. Step 4: Heat 2 tbs oil in a large saute pan over medium high heat and add tilapia and cook until lightly golden 3-4 minutes per side and then remove from the pan. Step 5: Add remaining marinade to the pan bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute, reduce heat and simmer until it has a glaze consistency, 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Pour the sauce over the tilapia and garnish with green onions.

Ingredient Names: thai rice noodles, tamarind paste, water, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fried tofu, roasted unsalted peanuts, fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, vegetable oil, garlic, shrimp, eggs, bean sprouts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in a good amount of cold water for an hour or more. Step 2: Place 1 / 4 cup warm water in a small bowl and combine with the tamarind paste and soak it for at least 15 minutes or more. Step 3: Slice chicken ino 1 / 4-inch long strips If you are having a hard time cutting thinly through fresh chicken meat, place it in the freezer for about 15-20 minutes or so to harden a little bit. Step 4: Then slice it It should now slice easilly. Step 5: Set the sliced chicken aside. Step 6: Now slice the fried tofu into 3 / 4 inch size cubes. Step 7: Set the tofu aside Use a blender or food processor to grind peanuts into a coarse meal.

Ingredient Names: oil, onion, garlic, fresh ginger, green curry paste, coconut milk, water, lime juice, fish sauce, fish, green chili, vegetables, spring onions, fresh coriander, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large wok, and fry the onion, ginger and garlic for about 5 minutes or until softened. Step 2: Add the green curry paste, and fry for another 2 minutes. Step 3: Add the coconut milk, water, lime juice and fish sauce and bring to the boil. Step 4: Reduce to a simmer and add the fish, and any of the longer-to-cook vegetables you have chosen and cook for about 5 minutes Also add about half the fresh coriander. Step 5: Add the remaining softer vegetables, and cook for a further 2-3 minutes, being careful not to overcook the fish, or knock it around too much as you stir through the vegetables. Step 6: Stir through the fresh herbs gently. Step 7: Serve in deep bowls over steamed rice, scattered with the fresh spring onions.

Dish Name: Green Curry Fish With Thai Eggplants
Ingredient Names: fish, unsweetened coconut milk, green curry paste, eggplant, shelled peas, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, palm sugar, sweet basil, thai chile
Instructions: Step 1: Do not shake the can of coconut milk before opening, so the cream remains on the top. Step 2: Spoon about 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 cup of this thick cream into a medium-size sauce pan and heat over medium to high heat. Step 3: Reduce until the cream is smooth and bubbly and the oil begins to separate. Step 4: Add the curry past and fry in the cream until the aromas are released - about 3-5 minutes. Step 5: Then add the remaining milk. Step 6: Bring to a boikl and add the fish. Step 7: Bring back up to a boil, reduce heat and simmer about 5 minutes before adding the eggplants. Step 8: Simmer a few minutes more, then add the peas and kaffir lime leaves. Step 9: Season to taste with fish sauce. Step 10: Add palm sugar to balance and enhance the spice and herb flavors.

Dish Name: Green Curry With Cod And Green Beans
Ingredient Names: cod, vegetable oil, green curry paste, unsweetened coconut milk, chicken broth, green beans, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, palm sugar, thai basil, red chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into bite-size chunks and set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a 2- to 3-quart saucepan over medium heat until a bit of curry paste just sizzles when added to the pan. Step 3: Add the rest of the curry paste and cook, pressing and stirring with a wooden spoon or spatula, to soften the paste and mix it in with the oil, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the coconut milk and broth and bring to a simmer. Step 5: Add the green beans and half the lime leaves and stir well Gently simmer, stirring occasionally, until the green beans are almost tender, about 4 minutes. Step 6: Add the cod, stir, and cook until the fish is just about done, about 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the fish sauce and sugar and stir to combine. Step 8: Remove from the heat Tear the basil leaves in half, and stir them into the curry, along with the remaining lime leaves.

Dish Name: Green Curry With Shrimp And Fish Kaeng Khiao
Ingredient Names: lemongrass, galangal, cumin, fresh cilantro, garlic cloves, green bell pepper, jalapeno peppers, shrimp paste, lime zest, coconut milk, white fish fillet, shrimp, fish sauce, sugar, coconut cream
Instructions: Step 1: To make curry paste. Step 2: Place all the nine green curry paste ingredients in a blender / processor and process until smooth If too dry, add a couple tbsp water to get a constancy that will process smoothly. Step 3: Pour the coconut milk and green curry paste into a large saucepan and heat 'til boiling. Step 4: Add the fish pieces, shrimp, fish sauce, and sugar, cook at a med. Step 5: Simmer for 5-minutes. Step 6: Add the coconut cream and lime juice, stir to combine. Step 7: Taste to adjust seasonings.

Dish Name: Grilled Lemon Sole With Lemongrass Butter
Ingredient Names: sole, butter, salt & freshly ground black pepper, lemongrass, lime, lime juice, fresh gingerroot, parsley, salted butter, thai fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: First make the lemongrass butter: put everything into a food processor and season well with black pepper. Step 2: Blend until smooth, then spoon the mixture into the centre of a large sheet of clingfilm, shape into a roll 4cm / 1in thick, wrap and chill in the fridge or freezer until firm. Step 3: When the butter is firm, preheat the grill to high Trim the fins and tails of the fish with kitchen scissors. Step 4: Brush the fish on both sided with the melted butter and season with a little salt and pepper Depending on the size of your grill, cook them 1 or 2 at time, dark side up, on a buttered baking tray or the rack of a grill pan for 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Keep warm while you cook the rest Unwrap the lemongrass butter and slice into thin rounds and serve on top of the fish.

Dish Name: Gulai Labu Spicy Shrimp And Cucumber Curry
Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, kirby cucumbers, shallots, garlic, ground coriander, ground fennel, white pepper, ground cumin, ground turmeric, dried hot red chilies, salt, sugar, coconut milk, unsweetened coconut, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein the shrimp. Step 2: Wash them and pat them dry Peel the cucumber and cut it crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-thick rounds Peel 7 of the shallots and chop them very finely Peel and finely slice the remaining shallots Peel the garlic cloves. Step 3: Chop 4 of them very finely and cut the other 2 into fine slivers. Step 4: Combine the sliced shallots and slivered garlic and set these aside. Step 5: In a medium-sized pan combine the chopped shallots, chopped garlic, ground coriander, ground fennel, white pepper, ground cumin, turmeric and 2 1 / 2 cups water Crumble in the red chilies.

Ingredient Names: coriander seeds, ginger, chicken, rice noodles, fish sauce, fat red chilies, garlic, raw, skinless salmon fillet, green onions, fresh cilantro, mint leaves, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Put the coriander seeds and galangal or ginger in a saucepan. Pour in the stock, bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 5 mins. Leave to stand for 10 mins. Step 2: Meanwhile, cook the noodles following pack instructions. Drain and keep warm. Return stock to the boil. Add the fish sauce, chillies and garlic, reduce the heat and simmer for 2 mins. Add the prawns and salmon, return to a simmer and cook gently for about 5 mins until both are firm and cooked. Add the spring onions, herbs and lime juice, to taste. Step 3: Divide the noodles between soup bowls. Using a slotted spoon, lift out the prawns and fish, and place on the noodles. Season the hot stock, pour into the bowls and serve with Spring rolls on the side.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, water, gingerroot, garlic cloves, dried hot red chili peppers, sugar, lemongrass, catfish fillets, baby corn, button mushroom, green onions, sweet red pepper, fresh coriander, lemon rind, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In saucepan bring chicken stock, water, gingerroot, garlic, hot peppers and sugar to boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Step 3: Strain through a fine sieve and return to pot Trim dry ends off lemongrass and peel away any tough outer leaves. Step 4: Cut into 1" lengths and add to pot. Step 5: Add fish, corn, mushrooms and green onions. Step 6: Bring to simmer and simmer for 3 minutes or unt9il fish flakes easily. Step 7: Stir in red pepper, coriander, lime rind and juice.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, garlic, green onion, jalapeno, cooked jasmine rice, sugar, soy sauce, fish sauce, cooked shrimp, fresh cilantro, fresh basil leaf, toasted sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Pour olive oil into a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, onions and chiles and saut until wilted, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add rice, sugar, soy sauce and fish sauce. Step 4: Reduce heat to medium and saut until ingredients are well coated and hot, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 5: Add shrimp, cilantro, basil, and sesame oil and saut until shrimp are hot to touch, about 3 minutes.

Dish Name: Jumbo Shrimp Rolls With A Sweet Soy Sauce
Ingredient Names: red bird's eye chili, honey, soy sauce, fresh cilantro, garlic clove, red curry paste, wonton wrappers, egg white, jumbo shrimp, sunflower oil
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dip, finely chop the chili, then mix with the honey and soy and stir well: set aside To make the shrimp rolls, finely chop the cilantro and garlic and mix with the curry paste. Step 2: Brush each wonton wrapper with egg whites and place a small dab of the cilantro mixture in the center. Step 3: Place a shrimp on top and fold over, enclosing the shrimp and leaving the tail exposed. Step 4: Repeat with the other shrimp. Step 5: Heat the oil in a deep heavy bottomed pot or pan to 350 degrees f. Step 6: Fry shrimp in small batches for 1-2 minutes each until are golden brown and crisp. Step 7: Drain on paper towels. Step 8: Serve with the dip.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, chunky peanut butter, tamari soy sauce, honey, gingerroot, crushed red pepper flakes, angel hair pasta, sesame oil, carrot, green onion, fresh cilantro, ground pork, egg roll wraps, egg
Instructions: Step 1: In large bowl mix peanut butter, tamari sauce, honey, ginger, crushed red pepper, green onions, cilantro, carrots and pork In large sauce pan heat sesame oil until very hot. Step 2: Add pork mixture to pan and cook stirring constantly for about 3 minutes or until pork is done In large bowl add angel hair pasta and pork mixture and mix well. Step 3: Cut shrimp down center where it has been deveined and add about 1 tablespoon pork mixture to each shrimp. Step 4: Take one egg roll wrapper and fold in half to form triangle. Step 5: Place shrimp on folded edge with tail dropped past fold, it will stick out the bottom and you can use as handle. Step 6: Fold top down over the shrimp as tight as possible Next fold right side onto shrimp as tight as possible. Step 7: Beat egg in a bowl.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic, lemongrass, red bell pepper, bamboo shoots, red curry paste, fish sauce, fresh shrimp, light coconut milk, fresh basil leaf, fresh cilantro, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in a large saut pan over medium heat. Step 2: Add garlic and lemongrass pieces until fragrant and golden. Step 3: Add red bell pepper strips and saut for about 30 seconds 1 minute, just until slightly tender. Step 4: Add the can of bamboo shoots and 1-4 tbsp curry paste,, as well as the fish sauce. Step 5: Mix around in pan to coat everything evenly with paste Shake can of coconut milk well, open, and slowly add it to the pan. Step 6: Bring liquid to a simmer for about 4-5 minutes, to let the lemongrass release its flavor Next, add 1- lbs of the seafood of your choice. Step 7: Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes or until seafood is cooked through If you can, try and remove the lemongrass pieces before serving, they are a bit woody.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, salt, pepper, lime juice, shallot, fresh gingerroot, garlic clove, olive oil, cherry tomatoes, fresh mushrooms, reduced-sodium chicken broth, light coconut milk, curry powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salted cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle shrimp with salt, pepper, and 1 tb lime juice. Step 2: In a large skillet, saute the shallot, ginger and garlic in oil for 1 minute, add shrimp. Step 3: Cook and stir for 2-3 mins or until shrimp turns pink. Step 4: Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Step 5: Add tomatoes, mushrooms, broth, coconut milk, curry powder, pepper flakes, and remaining lime juice to the skillet, bring to a boil, reduce heat. Step 6: Simmer, uncovered, for 8-10 mins or until mushrooms are tender and sauce is slightly reduced, stirring occasionally, add shrimp.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, fresh ginger, spring onions, garlic cloves, caster sugar, rice vinegar, fish sauce, lime rind, lime juice, white fish fillets, kaffir lime leaves, fresh herb, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the oil, ginger, spring onions, garlic, sugar, vinegar, fish sauce, lime rind and juice in a small bowl and mix well. Step 2: Place fish fillets in a single layer in a large shallow dish. Step 3: Pour the ginger mixture over the fish. Step 4: Cover and marinate in fridge for 1 hour. Step 5: Place each fish fillet onto a piece of lightly oiled foil. Step 6: Top each one with some of the ginger mixture from the dish and some lime leaves. Step 7: Fold in the edges of the foil and enclose fish well. Step 8: Cook the packets on a grill or bbq for about 15 minutes or until cooked through Open the top of each packet and sprinkle with herbs and garnish with a lime wedge Goes well with stir-fried asian vegetables and rice.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, hungarian paprika, lemongrass, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: While the salmon is still partially frozen, cut into serving pieces I usually serve this as an appetizer so the pieces are smallish squares. Step 2: Place the salmon in a large pot and cover with water Throw in the handfuls of paprika and lemon grass. Step 3: Add the salt and pepper. Step 4: Bring the whole thing to a rolling boil and let cook for 20 minutes Don't treat the fish delicately, it can take it, don't worry. Step 5: Turn off the heat, let sit for about 10 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon. Step 6: Chill for at least two hours and serve.

Dish Name: Mussels Steamed In Coconut Milk Lime And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: onion, garlic cloves, red chili peppers, coconut milk, fish sauce, limes, cilantro, mussels
Instructions: Step 1: Put the onion, garlic, chili peppers, coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice and cilantro into a large saucepan. Step 2: Bring to the boil and cook for about 8 minutes or until the onions are cooked. Step 3: Check that all the mussels are tightly closed If one is open, tap it - if it closes it's good, but if any stay open, throw those ones out. Step 4: When the onions are cooked in the saucepan, throw in all the good mussels, put the lid on and cook until the mussels are widely open. Step 5: Serve the mussels in their shells with the broth and some garlic bread.

Dish Name: Mussels With Chili Garlic And Basil
Ingredient Names: mussels, red chilies, fresh coriander, vegetable oil, oyster sauce, fish sauce, chicken stock, fresh basil, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Make a paste from the chilies, garlic and coriander using a mortar or small food processor. Step 2: Stir fry this paste in a wok or frying pan with the oil for about one minute, use a pan you have a lid for 5 minutes and large enough to hold the mussels. Step 3: Add the oyster and fish sauce, stir and then add the stock and the mussels. Step 4: Cover and cook on a medium heat, or until the mussels have opened and are cooked. Step 5: Taste the sauce or it needs extra fish sauce or water. Step 6: Stir in the basil, arrange the mussels on a dish, discard any mussel that has not opened and pour the sauce over them.

Ingredient Names: oil, shallot, fresh ginger, curry, white wine, clam juice, lime peel, lime, coconut milk, fresh mussels, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In large stockpot, saute shallots and ginger for 5 minutes. Step 2: Add curry, saute 2 minutes. Step 3: Add wine, simmer 4 minutes. Step 4: Add clam juice, lime zest, and juice, simmer 4 minutes. Step 5: Add coconut milk, and simmer for 4 minutes. Step 6: Add mussels, cover pot, and steam 4 minutes, or until all or most mussels are open With slotted spoon, remove mussels and place into 4 bowls. Step 7: Discard any mussels that did not open. Step 8: Add cilantro to broth, cook for 30 seconds, then spoon over mussels into bowls, serve.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, raw king shrimp, sunflower oil, eggs, fresh bean sprouts, baby bok choi, green onions, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce shrimp crackers
Instructions: Step 1: Pour a kettleful of boiling water over the noodles and cover for 10 mins. Meanwhile, mix together the prawns and ginger. Heat 1 tsp oil in a large non-stick frying pan and stir-fry the gingery prawns over a high heat for 2 mins until pink. Tip into a bowl. Return the pan to the heat and add another tbsp oil. When hot, pour in the beaten eggs, spreading out to form an even layer. Cook until set, then lift out of the pan, roughly shred with a knife and set aside. Drain the noodles. Step 2: Heat the remaining oil in the pan and stir-fry the beansprouts, bok choi and spring onions for 2 mins or until the bok choi softens. Return the prawns, noodles, eggs and soy sauce to the pan, tossing to combine. Serve immediately with sweet chilli sauce and prawn crackers, if you like.

Dish Name: Oven Baked Thai Style Fish Cakes
Ingredient Names: mashed potatoes, fish fillets, fresh coriander leaves, coriander root, red chile, fresh ginger, garlic clove, plain flour, egg, breadcrumbs
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a baking tray with spray oil. Step 2: In a mixing bowl combine first 7 ingredients, mix well. Step 3: Divide into 8 equal round cakes Coat with flour, then dip in egg and finally coat with the crumbs. Step 4: Place cakes on prepared tray. Step 5: Chill for 10 minutes. Step 6: Meanwhile preheat oven to 190c Spray cakes with oil and bake, turning once They will take about 30 minutes in total to cook.

Dish Name: Paad Thai Shrimp Stir Fried Thai Noodles
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, vegetable oil, fresh shrimp, eggs, garlic cloves, onion, fried tofu, white radish, bean sprouts, green onions, unsalted peanuts, chili flakes, lemon wedges, tamarind juice, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the rice noodles in hot water to cover, for at least 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Prepare all the remaining ingredients to be ready to cook. Step 4: Make the sauce - combine the tamarind juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, and paprika in a small saucepan. Step 5: Stir and heat over medium heat until it starts to boil, then lower the heat and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes. Step 6: Taste for the proper balance of sweet / sour / salty, and adjust if necessary, set aside. Step 7: Heat 1 tbsp oil in large wok or non-stick skillet. Step 8: Add eggs and scramble them. Step 9: Remove eggs and set them aside when just done.

Ingredient Names: fish sauce, miso, oyster sauce, sugar, low sodium soy sauce, bok choy, dried rice noodles, vegetable oil, medium shrimp, salt, garlic cloves, eggs, bird chiles, salted peanuts, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the fish sauce, miso, oyster sauce, sugar and soy. Step 2: In a large pot of boiling lightly salted water, cook the bok choy until crisp-tender About 2 minute. Step 3: Transfer to a plate. Step 4: Add the noodles to the boiling water and cook until firm but pliable, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Drain and rinse under cold water Shake out any excess water. Step 6: Transfer the noodles to a bowl. Step 7: Toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil. Step 8: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large nonstick skillet.

Dish Name: Pad Thai Fried Noodles With Shrimp
Ingredient Names: large raw shrimp, thai rice noodles, garlic, vegetable oil, eggs, sugar, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, green onions, peanuts, fresh cilantro, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and devein shrimp, set aside. Step 2: Cook noodles in boiling water 3 to 4 minutes, drain. Step 3: Saute minced garlic cloves in hot vegetable oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat for about 2 inutes. Step 4: Add shrimp and cook for another 2 minutes or just until shrimp turns pink. Step 5: Add beaten egg to shrimp mixture in skillet. Step 6: Cook shrimp mixture over medium heat, without stirring, until egg begins to set. Step 7: Stir until cooked, breaking up egg. Step 8: Add sugar, fish sauce, and garlic-chili sauce, stirring until blended. Step 9: Add noodles and cook 1 minute or until thoroughy heated.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, rice noodles, water, egg, sugar, fish, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, chili-garlic sauce, hot red chili pepper flakes, garlic cloves, green onions, red peppers, fresh coriander, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a large bowl. Step 2: Cover completely with boiling water, soak, stirring occasionally, until noodles are just tender, about 15 minutes. Step 3: Drain well and set aside. Step 4: Whisk egg in a small bowl, then stir in sugar, fish or oyster sauce, ketchup, worcestershire, chili-garlic sauce and chili flakes, set aside. Step 5: Boil broth over high heat, uncovered and stirring occasionally, until liquid is reduced by half, about 6 minutes. Step 6: Pour reduced chicken broth into a large, non-stick skillet, add garlic, chicken and shrimp. Step 7: Stir frequently until shrimp start to turn pink and chicken starts to turn white. Step 8: Stir in egg mixture, then add drained noodles. Step 9: Stir to evenly coat.

Dish Name: Pan Seared Salmon With A Tangy Thai Sauce
Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, canola oil, rice vinegar, honey, garlic cloves, chili, fish sauce, soy sauce, lemongrass, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: To make the marinade / sauce, place all marinade ingredients together in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Stir as you bring the sauce to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat to medium and allow to simmer for 10 minutes, uncovered The sauce will gradually thicken.
