Step 4: When marinade / sauce has thickened, place in the refrigerator or freezer to cool for 5 minutes. Step 5: Place salmon fillets in a flat-bottomed pan or casserole dish. Step 6: When the sauce / marinade has cooled, spoon 2 tablespoons over each fillet, 1 per side, slathering it over the flesh. Step 7: Marinate in the refrigerator 10 minutes or up to 24 hours. Step 8: Place a frying pan or wok on medium-high heat, allowing it to warm up for at least 1 minute before adding the oil. Step 9: When pan is hot, add 1-2 tablespoons oil, lifting and turning the pan to distribute evenly.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, spaghetti, broccoli, creamy peanut butter, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Thoroughly combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic and peanut butter. Step 2: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Step 3: Cook spaghette for 9 minutes, add broccoli and cook for 2 more minutes, add shrimp and cook for 2 more minutes, drain. Step 4: Mix in peanut butter mixture and red pepper flakes and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: pak choi, groundnut oil, sesame oil, garlic, chili, thai fish sauce, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Cut a thick slice from the pak choi root to separate the leaves. Rinse and drain. Step 2: Heat the groundnut oil in a large wok over a medium heat and add 1 tbsp sesame oil, the garlic, chilli, fish sauce (if using) and pak choi. Toss until coated and clamp a pan lid over them. Reduce the heat and cook for 3-6 minutes, tossing occasionally, just until the leaves have wilted (the stalks should be tender-crisp). Step 3: Add the rest of the sesame oil and salt. Toss the leaves, scatter over the sesame seeds if you wish, and serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: breadcrumbs, coconut milk, prawns, fresh ginger, coriander leaves, egg, fish sauce, vegetable oil, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the breadcrumbs in coconut milk Pulse the prawn meat in a food processor with the ginger, coriander leaves, egg and fish sauce. Step 2: Add the soaked breadcrumbs and pulse until just blended Do not overwork the mixture. Step 3: Heat the oil to 180c and drop teaspoonfuls of the mixture into the oil. Step 4: Turn and cook until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, thai red curry paste, fish sauce, chili, prawns
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce and chilli in a wok Slowly bring the boil over medium low heat, stirring occasionally. Step 2: Reduce heat to low, add prawns. Step 3: Cook, uncovered, stirring, about 10 minutes or until prawns are cooked. Step 4: Serve with hot jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: garlic clove, ground turmeric, coriander root, salt, sugar, oil, prawns, bamboo skewers, satay sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare marinade: in bowl combine chopped garlic, turmeric, coriander root, salt, sugar and oil. Step 2: Add prawns, ensuring that they are completely covered. Step 3: Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes To prepare skewers: Thread prawns onto satay skewers using one prawn per skewer. Step 4: Grill or bbq over high heat until pink, about 2 minutes each side. Step 5: Serve with satay sauce.

Ingredient Names: raw, green thai chili, garlic, fresh cilantro, sugar, limes, fish sauce, groundnut oil, ginger, green onions, red peppers, water chestnuts, fresh bean sprouts, soy sauce, eggs, lime wedges
Instructions: Step 1: Put the prawns in a bowl. Put the chilli, garlic, coriander stalks (snip these up using scissors first) and caster sugar in a spice grinder or small food processor and whizz together. Add half of the lime juice and the fish sauce, then pour this over the prawns. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok, add the ginger and spring onions and fry for 1 min. Add the red pepper and fry for 1 min, until the pepper starts to soften. Add the water chestnuts and bean sprouts, and toss together until the bean sprouts start to wilt. Add the soy sauce and a really good grind of black pepper, then tip the lot into a serving dish. Step 3: Heat the remaining oil in the wok and add the prawns, lifting them out of their juices. Toss for 1-2 mins until they turn pink, add the marinade and swirl the wok quickly, then tip the lot onto the veg. Snip over the coriander leaves and sprinkle on the remaining lime. Serves over noodles with extra lime for squeezing over.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, onion, red chilies, king prawns, garlic, tamarind juice, palm sugar, fish sauce, spring onions, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in wok until smoking then add onion and chili and stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 2: Add prawns and garlic, stir fry until prawns are just starting to colour, around 2 minutes. Step 3: Add tamarind water, palm sugar and fish sauce and stir fry until the prawns are cooked and the sauce has slightly thickened, around 3 minutes transfer to a serving plate and garnish with the spring onion and coriander leaves. Step 4: Serve with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: fresh ginger, fish sauce, garlic, lime rind, chili paste with garlic, medium shrimp, chicken broth, light coconut milk, green onions, fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, cooked basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a medium saucepan, and bring mixture to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes, remove from heat. Step 3: Stir in coconut milk, onions, chopped cilantro, and lime juice. Step 4: Spoon rice into a soup bowl Ladle soup over rice.

Ingredient Names: oysters, red curry paste, lemon, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place the oysters on a dinner plate which could be used in a microwave. Step 2: Make sure the top bit of the oysters is facing towards the end of the place to catch any of the juices Distribute red curry paste in each oysters, you can add less or more paste it depends on you. Step 3: Squeeze lemon juice in each oyster. Step 4: Once again depending on your taste bugs. Step 5: Place it in the microwave for 1 minute on high. Step 6: Garnish oysters with coriander / cilantro.

Ingredient Names: vegetables, thai red curry paste, onions, reduced-fat coconut milk, skinless salmon fillet, green beans, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large pan, then add the curry paste. Stir in the onion, then cook gently for about 5 mins until softened. Pour in the coconut milk and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer, then add the salmon chunks and beans. Step 2: Leave to gently simmer for 5 mins until the fish flakes easily and the beans are tender. Scatter with the coriander or basil, and serve with plain rice.

Dish Name: Red spiced fish with green salad
Ingredient Names: fillets white fish such as hake, thai red curry paste, avocados, cucumber fingers, romaine, fresh coriander, juice lime, clear honey, brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Brush each fish fillet with 1 tsp of curry paste, then roast on a baking sheet for 8-10 mins until the fish flakes easily. Step 2: Meanwhile, mix together the rest of the ingredients, apart from the rice, in a large bowl with some seasoning. Serve with the spiced fish and brown rice, plus extra lime wedges for squeezing over.

Dish Name: Roast sea bass with chilli & lime leaves
Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, thai fish sauce rice wine vinegar, garlic, red onions very, fennel bulbs very, red chile, lime leaves very, very lemongrass, fresh coriander, sea bass descaled filleted, long outside leaves from green onions
Instructions: Step 1: 1 Mix all the dressing ingredients together,then set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil, then fry the onions and fennel with the chilli, lime leaves and lemongrass for 10 mins, or until the onion and fennel are completely tender. Stir in the coriander. Step 3: 3 Lay two of the fillets from each fish, skin side down, on a sheet of foil on a large baking tray with sides. Cover with the stuffing, then top with the matching fillets, skin side up. Tie the fillets together with spring onion (or string) and chill until ready to cook. You can do this on the morning of your dinner party. Step 4: To serve: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Spoon the dressing over the fish, then roast for 12-15 mins or until the fish is cooked. Serve with jasmine rice to soak up the delicious juices.

Dish Name: Salmon And Pineapple Fish Cakes Thai Style
Ingredient Names: crushed pineapple, canned salmon, coriander, garlic cloves, ginger, sugar, lemon rind, red curry paste, egg, potato, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place fish, coriander, garlic, ginger, sugar, lemon rind and curry paste in bowl, mix well. Step 2: Stir through pineapple, egg and potato Mould into cakes and refrigerate until firm. Step 3: Heat oil in pan and fry until golden brown. Step 4: Serve with salad and sweet chilli sauce.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, bamboo skewers, sesame and ginger marinade, sesame oil, peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat ove to 450. Step 2: Cut salmon into eight equal pieces and thread lengthwise onto skewers. Step 3: Combine in a small bowl, marinade, sesame oil, and peanut butter Reserve 1 / 3 sauce for final step. Step 4: Brush the mixture over both side of salmon. Step 5: Place on baking sheet and bake 2 minutes. Step 6: Turn salmon and bake 2-4 minutes or until flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork Use reserved sauce for dipping.

Ingredient Names: low-salt chicken stock, thai red curry paste, flat rice noodles, shiitake mushrooms, baby corn, skinless salmon fillet, limes, reduced-salt soy sauce, brown sugar, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Pour the stock into a large pan, bring to the boil, then stir in the curry paste. Add the noodles and cook for 8 mins. Tip in the mushrooms and corn and cook for 2 mins more. Step 2: Add the salmon to the pan and cook for 3 mins or until cooked through. Remove from the heat and stir in the lime juice, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar. Ladle into 4 bowls and sprinkle over the coriander just before you serve.

Dish Name: Sauteed Fish With Thai Coriander Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, onion, cilantro, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, lemon juice, soy sauce, olive oil, tilapia fillet, lemon wedge, steamed rice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine bell pepper, onion, cilantro, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, lemon juice, soy sauce, and oil in a small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Saute tilapia in oil until cooked through. Step 3: Serve immediately, topped with sauce. Step 4: Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped cilantro. Step 5: Serve with steamed rice.

Ingredient Names: sea bass fillets, fresh coriander, fresh ginger, orange, lemon, light soy sauce, spring onion, thai fish sauce, rice wine vinegar, red chile, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Apart from the sea bass, mix all the other ingredients together. Step 2: Arrange the sea bass fillets on a sheet of tin foil so that the shiny side is on the outside Score the fillets, and pull up the corners of the foil. Step 3: Spoon over the thai dressing and crimp the corners together to create a sealed bag. Step 4: Dip the base of the bag in some oil and place on a chargrill or hot dry pan and cook for 10 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the pan, tear open bag and serve.

Dish Name: Shrimp And Butternut Squash In Coconut Milk Broth
Ingredient Names: fat-free low-sodium chicken broth, brown sugar, salt, tomato paste, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh ground black pepper, light coconut milk, butternut squash, red bell pepper, large shrimp, cooked basmati rice, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine chicken broth, brown sugar, salt, tomato paste, crushed red pepper, black pepper and coconut milk in a large saucepan and stir with a whisk. Step 2: Stir in squash and bell peppers, bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until squash is tender, stir in shrimp. Step 4: Bring to a boil and cook for about 1-2 minutes or until shrimp are done Stirring occasionally. Step 5: Stir in rice, lime juice, and cilantro. Step 6: Heat for 2 minutes, serve!

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, thai curry paste, coconut milk, chicken stock, baby corn, snow peas, shrimp, red chili pepper, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 3-4 minutes until softened, then drain and rinse with cold water. Step 2: Cook the curry paste in a non-stick pan until it smells fragrant, then gradually stir in the coconut milk and stock. Step 3: Bring to a simmer, add the corn and snow peas and cook for 2-3 minutes, then add the shrimp and noodles to heat through Scatter with chili and scallions.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, oil, onions, garlic cloves, tomatoes, bell pepper, coconut milk, salt, cumin, red chile, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil. Step 2: Add the onion and garlic. Step 3: When onions soften up, add shrimps, salt, cumin and red chilli and stir for 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Once the shrimp become pinkish and curled up, add the coconut milk, capsicum, tomato, and heat on high heat. Step 5: Once the mixture comes to a boil, reduce heat to medium and let simmer for 5 minutes Enjoy.

Dish Name: Shrimp In Hot Lime Leaf Broth
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, thai chiles, oyster mushroom, medium shrimp, fresh lime juice, thai fish sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Over medium heat, bring the broth and lemongrass to a boil in a medium pot. Step 2: Add the lime leaves and chiles, bring it back to a boil and let cook, gently, for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the mushrooms, return to a vigorous boil and add the shrimp. Step 4: Cook for 1 minute, or until the shrimp have turned pink. Step 5: Remove from heat, stir in the lime juice and fish sauce. Step 6: Taste and adjust flavor with fish sauce or salt if needed. Step 7: Serve in small bowls.

Dish Name: Shrimp In Yellow Curry Gang Lueng Goong
Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, oil, onion, ginger, garlic cloves, yellow curry paste, light coconut milk, potatoes, carrots, bell pepper, chili peppers, curry powder, fish sauce, sugar, spring onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan Brown onion and then and ginger and garlic. Step 2: Add curry paste, and mix well It might be a bit globular, but don't worry - it will mix in nicely once you add the liquid next. Step 3: Add coconut milk and mix well You can add about 1 / 3cup water if it is too thick. Step 4: Add carrot and potatoes and bring to a boil. Step 5: Leave the pot uncovered so that the water previously added will evaporate and you will get a nice thick gravy. Step 6: When the carrots and potato are just about cooked, add shrimp, bell pepper, fish sauce, sugar, chili peppers and curry powder. Step 7: Simmer for 5 minutes until shrimp turn pink.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, green curry paste, garlic, lime juice, fish sauce, jumbo shrimp, lemongrass, salt & freshly ground black pepper, vegetable oil, marinade, sugar, mint
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, curry paste and garlic in a saucepan and bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until coconut milk has thickened slightly. Step 2: Stir in lime juice and fish sauce, cool then toss with shrimp and marinate for 1 hour. Step 3: Remove shrimp from marinade and thread shrimps onto lemon grass stalks, spearing shrimps in 2 places so that they don't turn on the skewers. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Preheat grill to high. Step 6: Brush shrimp with extra oil and grill about 2 minutes per side or until shrimps are cooked While shrimp is cooking, place reserved marinade in a small pot over high heat, bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes or until quite thick. Step 7: Remove from heat, stir in extra lime juice and sugar. Step 8: Drizzle over grilled shrimp and sprinkle with mint.

Dish Name: Shrimp With Green Beans In Thai Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, red curry paste, fresh lime leaves, water, medium raw shrimp, onion, green beans, sugar, red bell pepper, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in work, add red curry paste and stir to dissolve. Step 2: Add 1 / 2 cup water and lime leaves or juice. Step 3: Stir cook about 1 more minute. Step 4: Add shrimp, green beans, onion, and sugar, cook 1 minute on high, stirring. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and add the rest of the water Continue cooking until shrimp and done and beans are hot-crisp, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Transfer to serving dish and garnish with red pepper and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: lemongrass, galangal, cumin, cilantro, garlic, thai green chili, jalapenos, shrimp paste, shallot, lime zest, coconut milk, shrimp, fish sauce, sugar, bamboo shoot
Instructions: Step 1: To make curry paste: place all ingredients in blender, food processor, or mortar and process until the mixture is smooth. Step 2: Pour coconut milk and green curry paste into large sauce pan. Step 3: Heat to boiling, add fish sauce and sugar. Step 4: Cook for 5 minutes at a low boil. Step 5: Add bamboo shoots and any other vegetables, creabmeat, or mushrooms as desired. Step 6: Add coconut cream and simmer 3-5 minutes until shrimp is cooked through. Step 7: Add lime leaves and basil, adjust seasoning to taste. Step 8: Serve in individual bowls, garnished with slivers of red chiles.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, butter, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti according to package directions When pasta is done, drain and return to pot Add butter, salt and pepper to taste Mix well and serve.

Dish Name: Simple Thai Style Lemongrass Shrimp Soup
Ingredient Names: lemongrass, gingerroot, lime, red chilies, water, fish sauce, chili paste with garlic, tomatoes, mushrooms, shrimp, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cut off the dry end and a few top leaves of the lemongrass stem Bruise the stem with the handle of a knife and cut into 1-inch long pieces Reserve Bruise the chilies, cut them in half, scoop out and discard the seeds Reserve the chilies. Step 2: Bring the water to boil. Step 3: Add lemongrass and ginger, and squeeze out half the lime into the water, boil 2-3 minutes. Step 4: Add fish sauce and chili-garlic paste. Step 5: Cook for another minute.

Dish Name: South Beach Thai Shrimp Soup With Lime And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: canola oil, fresh ginger, onion, reduced-sodium chicken broth, red pepper flakes, napa cabbage, shrimp, fish sauce, lime zest, lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large pot. Step 2: Add ginger and onion. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently for about 3 minutes. Step 4: Add broth and red pepper flakes and bring to a low boil. Step 5: Add cabbage and cook for approximately 2 to 3 minutes. Step 6: Add shrimp, lime zest and lime juice. Step 7: Cook just until shrimp turns pink. Step 8: Serve hot sprinkled with cilantro or scallions.

Dish Name: Spicy Coconut Shrimp Stew With Tomatoes And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, salt, oil, red bell pepper, scallions, cilantro, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, diced tomatoes, light coconut milk, lime juice, cooked jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Lightly season shrimp with salt, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in 5- to 6-quart dutch oven over medium-high heat, add pepper. Step 3: Cook, stirring, until almost tender, 4 minutes. Step 4: Add scallion whites, 1 / 4 cup cilantro, garlic, and pepper flakes Continue to cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds. Step 5: Add tomatoes and coconut milk, bring to a simmer. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium.

Dish Name: Spicy Crab And Prawn Fritters With Chilli Lime Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, crabmeat, red curry paste, egg, green onions, fresh coriander, fresh lemongrass, red thai chile, peanut oil, chili, lime juice, water, fish sauce, sugar, kaffir lime leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Shell and devein prawns, blend or process with crab, paste, egg, onion, herbs and chill until just combined. Step 2: Using hands, shape level tablespoons of mixture into fritter shapes. Step 3: Heat oil in a large frying pan, cook fritters, in batches, until golden brown and cooked through, drain on absorbent paper. Step 4: Serve fritters with chili lime dipping sauce.

Ingredient Names: halibut steaks, white onion, purple onion, fresh cilantro, jalapenos, mango, curry, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Saute the jalapeno slices in the peanut oil in a wok or pan. Step 2: Add onions and cook for about 2 minutes on medium heat. Step 3: Add diced mangos and cilantro and cook for an additional 3-5 minutes Do not over cook the mango - basically cook them until they turn form the bright yellow to a duller yellow. Step 4: Add curry, salt and pepper Move the pan of chutney to the side and move on to cooking the halibut. Step 5: Saute the halibut steaks in peanut oil with a teaspoon of shopped garlic. Step 6: Cook until the halibut is about 80% done. Step 7: Add the chutney to the halibut pan and cover the halibut completely.

Ingredient Names: red curry paste, fish sauce, sambal oelek chili paste, sweet chili sauce, medium shrimp, light sesame oil, scallion, sweet soy sauce, light coconut milk, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine curry paste, fish sauce, sambal and chili sauce in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add shrimp, tossing to coat. Step 3: Place a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Step 4: Add oil, and heat until smoking, then add shrimp mixture. Step 5: Saute for 2 minutes, add scallions. Step 6: Cover, and cook for 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in soy sauce and coconut milk. Step 8: Cook for 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Step 9: Add cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: oil, medium shrimp, snow peas, red bell pepper, yellow onion, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, unsweetened coconut milk, soy sauce, red curry paste, salt and pepper, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a wok or a heavy skillet over high heat. Step 2: Add shrimp and stir-fry about 1-2 minutes on each side or until the shrimp is just cooked through. Step 3: Remove shrimp from the wok with a slotted spoon and transfer it on a plate. Step 4: Add snow peas, bell pepper, onion, ginger and garlic to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Add coconut milk, soy sauce, and curry paste. Step 6: Boil until sauce thickens slightly, stirring frequently for about 2 minutes. Step 7: Add the shrimp and stir for 1 minute. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper. Step 9: Transfer to a serving dish. Step 10: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: white fish fillet, red chili peppers, green beans, spring onions, coriander leaves, thai fish sauce, kaffir lime leaves, thai red curry paste, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the fish into chunks, put in your food processor with the rest of the ingredients, except the oil, and blend using the on / off technique until you have a minced texture but not a paste. Step 2: Remove from the food-processor bowl to another dish. Step 3: Take approx a dessert spoon full of the fish mix, with wet hands form into balls then flatten them with the palm of your hand into cakes. Step 4: Leave them in the fridge, covered, to firm up for an hour or more. Step 5: When ready to cook, heat up the oil and fry the little cakes about 1 minute on each side. Step 6: Drain on paper kitchen towel. Step 7: Serve with a thai dipping saucethere several recipes on the site.

Dish Name: Spicy Thai Fish Cakes With Green Beans
Ingredient Names: white fish fillet, thai red curry paste, egg, fish sauce, sugar, cornstarch, cilantro, fresh green beans, lime zest, lime juice, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Finely chop fish. Step 2: Add curry paste through lime juice Process or mix with your hands until finely ground and blended. Step 3: Using lightly floured hands, form about 12 small patties. Step 4: Chill patties 2 hours or until firm. Step 5: Heat deep-frying pan over high heat, add oil and fry fish cakes a few at a time Turning carefully until browned. Step 6: Drain on paper towels. Step 7: Serve alone, or will a cool sauce I like sour cream.

Ingredient Names: shallots, dried red pepper flakes, kaffir lime leaves, thai red curry paste, egg, salt, sugar, mayonnaise, cornstarch, raw shrimp, salmon, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine everything but salmon in food processor and process until smooth. Step 2: Mix in salmon and cilantro. Step 3: Shape into patties about 3 inch diameter and 1 / 2 inch thick. Step 4: Dust patties with cornstarch on both sides If freezing,,, freeze on sheets, then vacuum pack, and store in freezer To cook, defrost if frozen Skillet fry in about 1 / 3 inch of moderately hot oil until each side is just done and golden brown. Step 5: Drain on paper towels Quite nice served with thai sweet chili sauce on top.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, vegetable oil, lettuce, mint leaf, cilantro leaf, shallot, red onion, lemongrass, thai peppers, chili paste, palm sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the sauce ingredients and whisk until well incorporated, set aside. Step 2: Prepare the vegetables The thick outer layers of the lemongrass should be peeled away and only the tender, bottom 1 / 3 of the stalk should be used. Step 3: Slice the lemongrass, shallots, red onion and chili peppers very finely Peel and devein the shrimp. Step 4: Brush a bit of oil on both sides of the shrimp and grill until they're cooked through This takes only a few minutes per side. Step 5: Toss together vegetables in a bowl and pour over dressing, more or less to taste. Step 6: Then add the grilled shrimp to the bowl while they are still hot and toss everything together.

Ingredient Names: thai rice noodles, sesame oil, eggs, red chile, thumb-size ginger, atlantic shrimp, soy sauce, fresh coriander, mint, juice lime, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles following the pack instructions, drain and set aside for later. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and pour in the beaten egg. Swirl around the pan to make a thin omelette, cook for 1-2 mins, then flip over and cook the other side for 1 min. Tip out and slice into thin strips. Step 2: Add the chilli and ginger to the pan, fry for 1-2 mins then tip in the noodles, prawns and egg. Splash in the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 min more. Throw in the chopped herbs and pour over the lime juice and zest, then sprinkle over the chopped peanuts and serve.

Ingredient Names: raw shrimp, water chestnuts, pork ground meat, fish sauce, shaohsing wine, sesame oil, ginger, green onions, long, vegetable oil, red curry paste, palm sugar, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all the ingredients except the chillies to a loose paste. Slit open the chillies, take the seeds out using a teaspoon, then fill the centres with the mix. Pack it in tightly and seal each one with a toothpick. Step 2: Make the sauce: heat the oil and add the curry paste. Reduce the heat and fry the paste gently until fragrant, about 2 mins. Add the sugar and the fish sauce, then increase the heat and cook for 5 mins, stirring all the time. Add the coconut milk and bring to the boil, then add 100ml water and stir well. Step 3: Drop in the stuffed chillies and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for 10 mins. Take from the heat and serve. Can be made up to a day ahead and gently reheated.

Ingredient Names: thumb-size ginger, garlic, fat green chilies seeds left, fresh coriander, shrimp water for mins, groundnut, pork, fish sauce, palm sugar, pineapple very
Instructions: Step 1: Put the ginger, garlic, chilli, coriander stalks (or root) and shrimp into a food processor and whizz to a paste. Step 2: Heat a wok, add the oil, then add the paste. Fry until fragrant. Add the pork, stir well and fry for 5 mins until cooked through. Stir in the fish sauce and the palm sugar, then cook for a good 10 mins more, until the meat becomes sticky, dark and caramelised. Can be made up to 2 days ahead, then reheated. Cool a little, top each pineapple slice with a teaspoon of the sticky pork and devour.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Noodles With Shrimp Chiles Lime
Ingredient Names: wide rice noodles, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, chile sauce with garlic, vegetable oil, medium shrimp, whole green chilies, bean sprouts, unsalted peanuts, fresh cilantro, mint leaves, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dried rice noodles in a bowl of very warm water and soak until they're pliable but still rather firm, about 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain in a colander - no need to pat dry. Step 3: Meanwhile prep the rest of the ingredients. Step 4: In a small bowl, combine the fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, hoisin sauce and chile-garlic sauce. Step 5: Once the noodles are drained, heat the oil in a large skillet or stir-fry pan over high heat until very hot. Step 6: Add the garlic, stir and immediately add the shrimp. Step 7: Stir-fry until the shrimp turn pink and firm, 2 to 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the fish sauce mixture. Step 9: Stir to mix for about 20 seconds, then add the chile slivers and the noodles. Step 10: Stir-fry until the noodles are tender and the liquid is absorbed, 1 to 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Pork Shrimp And Pineapple Padd Moo Goong Sapparod
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic cloves, lean boneless pork, fresh pineapple, sea salt, sugar, fish sauce, medium shrimp, bird chiles, white peppercorns, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a 12 inch skillet, heat the oil over high heat for 1-2 minutes, or until it is very hot and just barely smoking. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook, stirring and tossing until golden, about 15 seconds. Step 3: Add the pork and cook, stirring, until cooked through, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the pineapple chunks and cook, stirring, until darkened and soft, 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Season with the salt, sugar and fish sauce and mix well. Step 6: Add the shrimp and cook, stirring, until pink, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add the chiles and mix well. Step 8: Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with the ground peppercorns and the chopped cilantro. Step 9: Serve immediately.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Rice Noodles With Curried Shrimp America's Test Kit
Ingredient Names: noodles, water, vegetable oil, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, onion, red bell pepper, extra-large shrimp, garlic cloves, curry powder, scallions, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Cover noodles with boiling water in bowl. Step 2: Soak until softened but not completely tender, about 15 - 20 minutes, drain noodles. Step 3: Whisk water, 2 t Oil, fish sauce, lime juice and sugar until sugar dissolves. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in large nonstick skillet over med heat until shimmering. Step 5: Cook onion and bell pepper until softened, about 3 minute. Step 6: Stir in shrimp, garlic and curry powder. Step 7: Cook until fragrant and shrimp are nearly cooked thru, about 1 minute. Step 8: Add scallions, softened noodles and fish sauce mixture.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Veggie Shrimp In Soy Based Sauce Gluten Free
Ingredient Names: sesame oil, olive oil, medium shrimp, red bell pepper, carrots, onion, green beans, zucchini, broccoli florets, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, mirin, gluten-free soy sauce, tabasco sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large wok, heat up the sesame and olive oil on medium-high heat Be careful not to burn the oils You can check if the oil is hot by drizzling a drop of water into the wok If it's hot it'll sizzle 2. Step 2: When the oils are hot add the vegetables, garlic and ginger. Step 3: Stir fry until the vegetables are slightly tender 3. Step 4: When the vegetables are slightly tender, add the sauce ingredients and the shrimp to the vegetables.

Ingredient Names: aldi specially selected smoked scottish salmon fillets, thai red curry paste, thumb-size ginger, soy sauce, coriander half, vegetable oil, lemon wedges, carrots, half, white wine vinegar, golden sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Tip the Aldi Salmon Fillets into a food processor with the paste, ginger, soy and chopped coriander. Pulse until roughly minced. Tip out the mix and shape into 4 burgers. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan, then fry the burgers for 4-5 mins on each side, turning until crisp and cooked through. Step 2: Meanwhile, use a swivel peeler to peel strips of carrot and cucumber into a bowl. Toss with the vinegar and sugar until the sugar has dissolved, then toss through the coriander leaves. Divide the salad between 4 plates. Serve with the burgers and rice.

Ingredient Names: prawns, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, lime zest, honey, sweet chili sauce, chicken stock, rice paper, baby spinach leaves, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Shell and devein prawns, and chop them roughly. Step 2: Combine prawns, ginger, garlic and your sweet stuff in a large shallow bowl, and refrigerate at least three hours, or until you need them. Step 3: Heat oiled pan, and cook the prawns until they're just right - remember, cooking prawns too long will make them rubbery. Step 4: Take them off the pan while keeping all the liquid they might have left behind in the pan. Step 5: Place the chili sauce and the chicken stock to the pan, and let simmer until it thickens. Step 6: Pour over the prawns. Step 7: Take one sheet of rice paper and put it in a large bowl of warm water until it's soft. Step 8: Take the paper out from water and place on a board, pat dry with a towel or paper. Step 9: Place some baby spinach and coriander leaves in the middle of the paper, add prawn mixture to the top. Step 10: Fold in top and bottom, roll from side to enclose the filling.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, almond butter, shrimp, chicken stock, diced tomato, unsweetened applesauce
Instructions: Step 1: Add chicken stock and diced tomato in a small pot and simmer over low heat. Step 2: Add coconut milk and continue to simmer to meld all the flavors together and that the sauce has thickened. Step 3: Add shrimp and cook for another 5 minutes. Step 4: Turn off heat and take shrimp out on a separate dish and add almond butter and apple sauce and whisk in the thickened sauce. Step 5: Add the shrimp into bowls and add extra tomato slices for garnish as desired.

Ingredient Names: rock salt, oyster, low-sodium barbecue sauce, fine dry breadcrumb, fresh cilantro, green onions, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle a layer of rock salt in a 15x10x1-inch jellyroll pan. Step 2: Set aside Scrub oyster shells and open, discarding tops. Step 3: Arrange oysters over rock salt. Step 4: Brush oysters on half shells with barbecue sauce. Step 5: Combine breadcrumbs and remaining ingredients in a small bowl, stir well. Step 6: Sprinkle evenly over oysters. Step 7: Bake at 425 for 12 minutes or until oysters begin to curl.

Ingredient Names: tiger shrimp, garlic cloves, lemongrass, lime, gingerroot, fish sauce, thai red chili peppers, soy sauce, water, sugar, white onion, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a med bowl mix the soy, water, fish sauce, lemon grass and sugar let shrimp marinate 10 minutes. Step 2: Heat oil in the wok, add the onion and stir fry 2 minutes, add the ginger, garlic and the peppers- cook 30 seconds. Step 3: Using a slotted spoon remove the shrimp from the marinade and place in the wok stir fry 3 minutes do not completely cook the shrimp. Step 4: Add the remaining marinade and cook another 30 seconds, Remove from the wok and stir in the basil. Step 5: Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with more basil.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, shrimp, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, unsalted butter, garlic, onion, arborio rice, dry white wine, chicken stock, thai basil, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add 1 tbs oil and swirl to coat bottom. Step 3: When oil is hot, add the shrimp and saute, stirring, until shrimp are pink, about 1 minute. Step 4: Season with salt and pepper. Step 5: Transfer the shrimp to a plate and set aside. Step 6: Add the remaning tbs of oil and 1 tbs of butter to the pan. Step 7: When the mixture is hot, add the garlic and onions and saute until soft, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the rice and saute until rice is opaque, about 2 minutes. Step 9: Add the wine, deglaze the pan, and simmer until liquid is absorbed by the rice, 2 to 3 minutes Ladle in the stock 1 / 2 cup at a time, allowing each addition to be absorbed by the rice before adding the next.

Dish Name: Thai Catfish Salad Yam Pla Dook Foo
Ingredient Names: catfish, cooking oil, fish sauce, brown sugar, birds eye chiles, green mango, shallot, peanut oil, breadcrumbs, lettuce leaf, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Steam catfish till done and let cool. Step 2: Remove flesh and crumble into small bite-sized pieces and spread. Step 3: Heat oil at medium heat and deep fry the catfish crumbs. Step 4: Fry until golden brown, remove and drain oil from crumbs using kitchen towel. Step 5: In a mixing bowl, mix sugar, fish sauce and birdeye chili. Step 6: Add mangoes, shallot, groundnut and mix well. Step 7: Serve on lettuce and garnish with coriander.

Ingredient Names: swordfish steaks, olive oil, of fresh mint, fresh coriander, chili sauce, nam pla, fresh ginger, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle a little sea salt over the fish. Step 2: Heat the oil in a very hot skillet. Step 3: Cook the fish in the skillet for about 4 minutes each side, or until cooked to your liking. Step 4: Meanwhile, put remaining ingredients in a screw-top jar and shake vigorously. Step 5: Serve the fish with a little of the sauce drizzled over.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, dried shrimp, red chilies, green chilies, shrimp paste, water, fresh pumpkin, coconut milk, salt, fresh lemon juice, fresh cilantro, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, stir-fry onion in oil until golden brown. Step 2: Add shrimp, chiles, and shrimp paste, fry for 1 minute. Step 3: Add water and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add pumpkin, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add coconut milk and salt. Step 6: Return to a boil and cook until pumpkin is tender. Step 7: Serve garnished with lemon juice, basil leaves, and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, coconut milk, water, galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, shiitake mushrooms, lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, curry powder, green onion, green onions, dried red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Step 2: Boil the shrimp until cooked, about one minute. Step 3: Drain shrimp, and set aside. Step 4: Pour the coconut milk and 2 cups of water in a large saucepan, bring to a simmer. Step 5: Add the galangal, lemon grass, and lime leaves. Step 6: Simmer for 10 minutes, or until the flavors are infused. Step 7: Strain the coconut milk into a new pan and discard the spices. Step 8: Simmer the shiitake mushrooms in the coconut milk for five minutes. Step 9: Stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, and brown sugar.

Dish Name: Thai Country Style Fish Pla Nai Suan Rot Det
Ingredient Names: fish, shallots, garlic cloves, coriander sprigs, green onions, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chili powder, rice, vegetable oil, hard-boiled eggs
Instructions: Step 1: 500gr fish slices fried to crispy golden color, let rest. Step 2: Fry to golden color 5 shallots and 5 large garlic cloves, let rest. Step 3: Chop 2 shallots, 2 large garlic cloves, 2 coriander springs and 2 green onions. Step 4: Mix 2 tbls fish sauce, 2 tbls lime juice, 1 tbls sugar, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tbsl roasted & pounded rice. Step 5: Mix 3 and 4 2 boiled eggs, cut into quarters On a plate arrange fish, boiled eggs, add fried onions, garlic, pour the herbs. Step 6: Garnish with mint and roasted dry chilli.

Ingredient Names: gingerroot, garlic, honey, chili powder, turmeric, fresh cilantro, sweetened coconut, curry, salt, fish sauce, lime juice, vegetable oil, shrimp, scallops, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Using a food processor, puree the ginger and garlic. Step 2: Add in the rest of the sauce ingredients to form a relatively thick paste It's best to refrigerate the paste for a few hours to let the flavors inter-mingle, but if you have to use it right away, than do so. Step 3: Heat the oil over high heat, and add the scallops and shrimp when the pan is uniformly hot At the same time, boil some water for the noodles. Step 4: Stir the shrimp and scallops frequently for about 2 minutes, until slightly browned. Step 5: Add in the paste, and reduce heat slightly, coating the scallops and shrimp thoroughly. Step 6: After about 90 seconds, slowly stir in a can of coconut milk. Step 7: Reduce heat and simmer for a few minutes to reduce the liquid. Step 8: Serve over noodles or rice.

Ingredient Names: butter, plum tomatoes, garlic, fresh ginger, unsweetened coconut milk, thai red curry paste, fresh cilantro, salt, mussels
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add the tomatoes, garlic and ginger, sauteeing until garlic is tender, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Pour in the coconut milk, then the curry paste, 4t chopped cilantro and the salt. Step 4: Simmer for just 4 minutes to blend the flavors, add mussels. Step 5: Cover and cook about 5 minutes until the mussels are opened Remember to discard any mussels that are not opened! Step 6: Place broth and mussels in soup bowls-- 6 first course or 4 main course Serve with crusty bread to dunk in the delicious broth.

Dish Name: Thai Curry Penne With Ginger Tomato Chutney
Ingredient Names: butter, onion, granny smith apple, garlic, curry powder, dry marsala, chicken stock, fish sauce, thai red curry paste, unsweetened coconut milk, penne pasta, crabmeat, fresh basil, chutney
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in heavy, large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion, apple, and garlic. Step 3: Saute' until onion is soft, about 6 minutes. Step 4: Stir in curry powder, add marsala. Step 5: Boil until liquid is slightly reduced, about 2 minutes. Step 6: Add stock, fish sauce, and curry paste. Step 7: Simmer until liquid is slightly reduced, about 5 minutes, add coconut milk. Step 8: Simmer until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.

Dish Name: Thai Fish Cakes With Hot Peanut Dip
Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, thai fish sauce, red curry paste, lime juice, garlic clove, dried kaffir lime leaves, egg white, fresh cilantro, salt and pepper, vegetable oil, red chile, light soy sauce, brown sugar, chunky peanut butter, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Put the fish fillet in a food processor with the fish sauce, curry paste, lime juice, garlic, kaffir lime leaves, salt & pepper, and egg white and process until a smooth paste forms. Step 2: Stir in the cilantro and quickly process again until mixed. Step 3: Divide the mixture into 8-10 pieces and roll into balls, then flatten to make round patties and set aside For the dip, halve and seed the chili, then chop finely. Step 4: Place in a small pan with the remaining ingredients and heat gently, stirring constantly, until well blended Adjust the seasoning to taste Pan-fry the fish cakes in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. Step 5: Drain on paper towels and serve hot on a bed of green salad leaves with the chili-flavored peanut dip.

Ingredient Names: onion, red bell pepper, thai red chili peppers, oil, red curry paste, garlic, kaffir lime leaves, galanga powder, vegetable broth, sake, shrimp sauce, coconut milk, lemongrass, monkfish, roma tomatoes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet or wok. Step 2: Add curry paste, garlic, lime leaves, and galanga. Step 3: Stir-fry for 1 minute or until mixture becomes very fragrant. Step 4: Add onions, chiles, and peppers and stir-fry until onions are slightly tender. Step 5: Add vegetable broth, sake wine, shrimp sauce, coconut milk, lemongrass and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add the fish cubes and tomato quarters, then cover, and simmer for 6-8 minutes or until fish is firm and cooked. Step 7: Stir together cornstarch into water to make a slurry and add to wok. Step 8: Stir until curry is thickened. Step 9: Remove kaffir leaves before serving if desired. Step 10: Add the juice of the lime and stir in, then sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro just before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Fish Curry Kaeng Ped Pla Or Tofu
Ingredient Names: lime, fish sauce, soy sauce, red chili pepper, fish, salmon fillets, cake tofu, coconut milk, kaffir lime leaves, red curry paste, lemongrass, jasmine rice, fresh cilantro, brown sugar, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: The marinade, prepare at least 1-2 hours before, or even overnight: Combine the lime juice, half of the fish sauce, and the soy sauce in a shallow non-metallic dish. Step 2: Add the chile and the fish, stir or use your hands to coat. Step 3: Cover and let chill for 1-2 hours, or overnight Ready to cook: Start your rice as per package directions Depending on the sort you are using, the cooking time will vary. Step 4: Add the curry paste to a med hot pan, warm it up a bit and then add the coconut milk, the lime leaves, the remaining fish sauce and the lemon grass. Step 5: Simmer gently for 10-15 minutes. Step 6: Add the fish, the marinade and red bell pepper or other veg if you're using one.

Dish Name: Thai Fish En Papilotte With Lime Garlic Butter Sauce
Ingredient Names: sea bass, ginger, chili, shallot, lime, kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 180c If you are serving rice, put this on first you can keep it warm while the other components cook. Step 2: Prepare the ingredients for the fish. Step 3: Cut the shallot in half width-ways and finely slice Finely slice the chilli, ginger and lime zest into very thin matchsticks take time to do this carefully, you want thin, delicate pieces. Step 4: Cut the lemongrass stalks in half lengthways. Step 5: Mix together the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar. Step 6: Cut two pieces of parchment paper about 25cm long and lay them flat on a surface. Step 7: Place four kaffir lime leaves in a row in the centre of each piece and lay a fish fillet on top. Step 8: Put the two halves of the lemongrass stalk either side of the fillet and sprinkle the slivers of shallot, ginger, lime zest and chilli across the top of the fillet evenly.

Dish Name: Thai Fish Fillets And Shrimp In Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: green chilies, red chilies, white fish fillets, prawns, lemongrass, coriander, kaffir lime leaves, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, spring onions, soft brown sugar, coconut milk, coconut cream, fish sauce, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a wok, or large pan, until hot, add whole chillies and roast until just beginning to brown all over. Step 2: Remove the chillies from the wok, cool and slice. Step 3: Cut the fish into 5 cm pieces Bruise the lemongrass and coriander roots by crushing them with the flat side of a knife. Step 4: Add lemongrass, coriander roots, kaffir lime leaves, ginger, garlic, onions, sugar and coconut milk to wok. Step 5: Stir to combine, bring to the boil. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for two minutes. Step 7: Add the fish pieces and prawns / shrimp, and simmer gently for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the fish is tender. Step 8: Stir in the coconut cream. Step 9: Stir through the chopped chillies, fish sauce, salt and lime juice, to taste.

Dish Name: Thai Fish Mini Muffins With Coconut Tuna
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, tuna in brine, rice vermicelli, thai curry paste, eggs, curry powder, red onion, garlic cloves, fresh chili pepper, fresh ginger, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Fry off the onion, ginger, chilli and garlic. Step 2: Put rice vermicelli into a large bowl and pour over boiling water - leave until soft then drain. Step 3: Cut up into small pieces with scissors. Step 4: In a very large bowl put in the two cans of tuna drained, vermicelli, onions, garlic, chili and ginger, 3 eggs, curry past and powder and finally the coconut milk. Step 5: Mix all up together. Step 6: Preheat oven to 200c grease small muffin tin and spoon mixture into each section to the top. Step 7: Cook until muffin springs back Ease out of tin and leave to cool. Step 8: Serve with a bowl of sweet chilli sauce as a dip yum!

Ingredient Names: dried lemon grass, galanga root, fish stock, coconut milk, red chilies, scallions, fresh cilantro, white fish fillet, limes, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Simmer the laos root and lemongrass in 1 cup of the stock for 1 / 2 hour. Step 2: Add more liquid as necessary. Step 3: In a large saucepan, simmer the coconut milk and 2 remaining cups of stock, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the chiles, scallions, cilantro, and fish. Step 5: Strain the lemongrass and laos mixture and add that liquid to the pot. Step 6: Simmer, uncovered, until the fish is just cooked, remove from heat. Step 7: Stir in the lime juice and the fish sauce, adding more if desired.

Dish Name: Thai Fishcakes With Sweet Chilli Sauce And Cucumber Relish
Ingredient Names: white fish fillets, red curry paste, fish sauce, cornflour, egg, green beans, green onion, vegetable oil, sweet chili sauce, cucumber relish
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor, mince fish to a paste. Step 2: Add curry paste, fish sauce, cornflour and egg, combine well. Step 3: Transfer to a bowl and mix in beans and onions Wet hands and shape mix into flat round cakes approximately 5cm in diameter and 1cm thick Deep-fry in vegetable oil until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Step 4: Drain on paper towel. Step 5: Serve with sweet chili sauce and cucumber relish.

Ingredient Names: sesame oil, leek, bok choy, plaice fillets, lime juice, chili pepper, light soy sauce, sugar, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius heat oil in a small frying pan and stir fry leek and bok choy until just starting to wilt. Step 2: Cut 4 large squares of kitchen foi. Step 3: Divide veg between them, and lay 2 pieces of fish on top of each square In small bowl, mix together fish sauce, lime juice, chilli, soy sauce, and sugar. Step 4: Pour over fish Seal foil together and place on baking tray. Step 5: Place tray in oven and cook 10 minutes. Step 6: Let packets sit for a couple of minutes before opening to prevent steam burns Open and scatter fish with coriander. Step 7: Serve with noodles.

Dish Name: Thai Flavoured Prawn Salad 21 Day Wonder Diet Day 14
Ingredient Names: brown rice, small shrimp, carrot, green onions, coriander, garlic clove, lime rind, lime juice, red thai chile
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice in large saucepan of boiling water, uncovered, until tender, drain, cool Combine rice in large bowl with remaining ingredients.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggs, onion, garlic, boneless pork loin, shrimp, lump crabmeat, salt, black pepper, fish sauce, thai red chili peppers, ketchup, cooked rice, green onion, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp Oil in wok and stir-fry the eggs, scrambling them. Step 2: Remove from wok and set aside In same wok, heat remaining oil and fry onion and garlic until tender. Step 3: Add pork, salt, pepper, fish sauce, chilies, and ketchup. Step 4: Stir-fry for 2-4 minutes, or until pork looks done. Step 5: Add shrimp and crab and continue stir-frying for another 3 minutes, add egg and rice. Step 6: Cook, stirring well, for another 2 minutes. Step 7: Fold in green onion and cilantro just before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Garlic Shrimp With Lemon Coriander Sauce
Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, red onion, garlic, soy sauce, vegetable oil, sugar, fresh lemon juice, unsalted peanuts, fresh cilantro, shrimp, black pepper, lettuce leaf, fresh cilantro leaves, tomatoes, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Sauce: Thoroughly mix all ingredients for sauce in a bowl and let rest for 20-30 minutes Shrimp: Combine all ingredients except oil in a bowl. Step 2: Toss and mix so that all the shrimp are thoroughly coated in the marinating ingredients. Step 3: Let sit of 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan on high heat. Step 5: Add shrimps and marinade and stir-fry on high heat Shrimp should be cooked through and slightly browned - about 3 minutes To serve:.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, shrimp, wood ear mushrooms, garlic, green onions, mushroom soy sauce, white pepper, wonton wrappers, chives, vegetable oil, thai sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Chop up shrimp and mix with ground pork, mushrooms, garlic, green onions, mushroom soy sauce, and black pepper Scoop a teaspoonful of mixture onto the wrapper Pull the edges up and pinch to close making a little bag. Step 2: Repeat until all the mixture is used up Optional: tie with a chive If you are using green onions, place them in boiling water for 20 seconds to make more pliable. Step 3: Cut each green onion into 3-5 thin strips and tie around the bags. Step 4: Heat oil in deep fryer or wok until very hot. Step 5: Fry until golden brown. Step 6: Place on a paper towel to drain excess oil.

Ingredient Names: skinless salmon fillet, unsweetened coconut milk, green curry paste, brown sugar, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, red bell pepper, mushroom, fresh basil, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Remove 1 cup of the cream that has risen to the top of the chilled coconut milk and add to a large skillet or wok. Step 2: Bring to a boil and cook for 5-8 minutes until the oil begins to separate from the white solids. Step 3: Add curry paste and continue to cook for another 5-8 minutes. Step 4: Add some thin coconut milk a little at a time if the mixture begins to stick. Step 5: Meanwhile, combine the thin coconut milk remaining in the can the cream was removed from with cup of well stirred milk from the second can Reserve the remaining milk from the second can for a later use, add cup of water. Step 6: Add salmon pieces to the skillet with the curry paste and coconut cream. Step 7: Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 8: Add the remaining thin coconut milk and let simmer, turning occasionally until the salmon is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, eggplants, white onion, red bell pepper, garlic, green curry paste, lemon juice, unsweetened coconut milk, fish stock, medium shrimp, basil, salt, cornstarch, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or large saute pan, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onions and garlic, and cook until softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the eggplant and the peppers and cook, stirring, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Add the curry paste, lemon juice and cook, stirring, for 15 seconds. Step 5: Add the coconut milk and fish stock and bring to a boil. Step 6: Lower the heat and simmer until thickened, 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes, add basil. Step 8: Stir cornstarch that you mixed with the water if it needs more thickening, remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, green curry paste, straw mushrooms, carrot, green beans, chinese cabbage, tamarind paste, brown sugar, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, simmer shrimp in enough water to cover, until cooked or orange-pink in color, about 1-2 minutes. Step 2: Cool shrimp in the stock and then peel Reserve 4 cups of the stock, set aside. Step 3: Heat the reserved 4 cups of stock in a saucepan over high heat. Step 4: Stir in the green curry paste. Step 5: Add the mushrooms, carrot, green beans, and cabbage. Step 6: Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are just tender. Step 7: Stir in tamarind paste, sugar, and fish sauce. Step 8: Place some shrimp in a bowl and ladle in the soup.

Dish Name: Thai Grilled Sea Bass Pla Pao
Ingredient Names: sea bass fillet, plain nonfat yogurt, coconut extract, red curry paste, garlic, lime, cilantro, lemongrass, thai red chili peppers, fish sauce, ponzu sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except sea bass to form marinade. Step 2: Pour marinade over fish in a ziplock bag or shallow dish and allow to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Step 3: Grill over medium-hot coals until cooked through, turning once, and basting frequently with marinade. Step 4: Serve with steamed jasmine rice, sauteed bok choy, and / or grilled zucchini medallions on kebabs, if desired Good table condiments include lime wedges and chile sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Hot And Sour Shrimp Soup Tom Yum Goong
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, red onion, water, black pepper, lemongrass, fresh galangal root, red chilies, green chilies, kaffir lime leaves, medium shrimp, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pot with garlic until aromatic. Step 2: Add onion and cook, stirring, until onion is light brown. Step 3: Add the water and bring to a boil. Step 4: Add black pepper, lemongrass, galangal, chiles, and lime leaves. Step 5: Return to a boil and boil for 2 minutes. Step 6: Place shrimp in the pot along with the fish sauce and lime juice. Step 7: Simmer for 3 more minutes, or until shrimp are firm and cooked. Step 8: Garnish soup with fresh cilantro before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Mango Salad With Marinated Shrimps
Ingredient Names: wonton wrappers, shrimp, lemongrass, ginger, lime, limes, lime zest, honey, fish sauce, garlic, mango, cucumber, birds eye chile, granny smith apple, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: First, make the wonton cups- press wonton wrappers into greased muffin cups, bake them for 10mins at 350f. Step 2: Cool and store them in airtight container up to 1 day ahead. Step 3: Add lemongrass, ginger, lime zest and juice to approx 2 cups of water and bring to boil in a small saucepan Poach the shrimps in the stock for 5-10mins, until shrimps just turned pink. Step 4: Remove and cool Peel the shrimps and set aside. Step 5: Make the dressing / marinade- combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Step 6: Place cooled shrimps in a ziplock bag, and pour in the dressing. Step 7: Marinate shrimps for 1-2 days in the fridge for best results A few hours before serving, combine all salad ingredients except the black pepper and garnish, in a medium non-reactive bowl.

Dish Name: Thai Noodle Salad With Shrimp And Sugar Snap Peas
Ingredient Names: chunky peanut butter, gingerroot, garlic cloves, red pepper flakes, thai fish sauce, sugar, fresh lime juice, basil leaves, cilantro leaf, toasted sesame oil, sugar snap pea, udon noodles, large shrimp, scallions, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In the bowl of a food processor, combine the peanut butter, ginger, garlic, pepper flakes, fish sauce and sugar and pulse until finely chopped Do not overprocess. Step 2: Add the lime juice and pulse to blend. Step 3: Add the basil, cilantro and mint leaves and pulse until evenly chopped Scrape down the sides of the processor. Step 4: Pour the sesame oil through the feed tube, pulsing until the pesto is emulsified Scrape the pesto into a bowl and set aside Blanch the sugar snap peas in salted boiling water, drain, shock under cold water, then blot dry. Step 5: Cook the noodles according to the package directions, then drain and cool. Step 6: Combine the noodles, shrimp, sugar snap peas and scallions in a large bowl.

Dish Name: Thai Noodles With Prawns And Broccoli Stirfry
Ingredient Names: rice sticks, vegetable oil, garlic, shallots, chili paste, ketchup, granulated sugar, fish sauce, salt, low sodium chicken broth, bean sprouts, scallions, roasted peanuts, yellow onion, prawns
Instructions: Step 1: Noodles: Bring 2 quarts of water to a rolling boil. Step 2: Cook noodles for 2 minutes, then rinse extremely well under cold running water. Step 3: Drain noodles in colander and spread out to dry for at least 20 minutes The noodles will stick together, but don't be alarmed. Step 4: Meanwhile, heat the 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large nonstick saucepan over moderate heat. Step 5: Add garlic, shallots and chile paste and allow to sizzle until golden, about 30 seconds. Step 6: Add catsup, sugar, fish sauce and salt and reduce slightly, about 1 minute. Step 7: Add 2 / 3 cup chicken stock and reduce heat Stirring frequently, simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, prawns, scallops, squid, fish fillet, mussels, basil leaves, birds eye chiles, oil, garlic, light soya sauce, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut 500g of mixed seafood into bite-size pieces, first removing any shells If you are using mussels, wash and scrape the shells and open them by putting them in a pot with a little boiling water. Step 2: Cover and boil for a few minutes, removing each mussel as it opens to prevent overcooking. Step 3: Chop a handful of basil leaves and seed and finely slice 3 bird's eye chillies. Step 4: In a frying pan or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil Brown 2 tablespoons of crushed garlic and saute the seafood for a couple of minutes. Step 5: Drain off the oil and set the garlic seafood mixture aside. Step 6: Put another tablespoon of oil in the pan and increase the heat. Step 7: Add 2 tablespoons of light soya sauce and the noodles and saute for 2-3 minutes, stir well.

Dish Name: Thai Pineapple Curry Or Gaeng Kua Sapparod Recipe
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, medium shrimp, coconut cream, coconut milk, pineapple chunks, brown sugar, fish sauce, tamarind juice, red curry paste, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put coconut cream in a pot I used my dutch oven and heat it on low. Step 2: Add the paste and whisk it in until the sauce becomes pinkish in color. Step 3: Bring to a low boil and add the chicken. Step 4: Add fish sauce, drained pineapple chunks, coconut milk, sugar and tamarind juice and cook for about 10 minutes At 10 minutes add your shrimp and cook for about 5 minutes or until shrimp is pink Don't overcook the shrimp because it will get chewy. Step 5: Serve over jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, medium shrimp, red bell pepper, red onion, garlic cloves, red chili peppers, eggs, cooked rice, fish sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, fresh pineapple, dry-roasted cashews, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add shrimp and stir-fry 1 minute or until they turn pink on the outside but are only halfway cooked through. Step 3: Remove shrimp to a plate with a slotted spoon. Step 4: Add to skillet bell pepper, onion, garlic, and chile. Step 5: Stir-fry 3 minutes or until onion is translucent. Step 6: Add eggs and stir-fry 30 seconds. Step 7: Stir in rice, separating grains with back of spoon, and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 8: Add fish sauce, soy sauce, and lime juice. Step 9: Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Step 10: Return shrimp to skillet with fresh pineapple and stir-fry 2 minutes or until shrimp are cooked through.

Ingredient Names: long grain rice, thai red curry paste, coconut cream, salmon fillets, green beans, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to the packet instructions. Step 2: Meanwhile, heat a medium frying pan. Step 3: Add curry paste and cook, stirring, for a few seconds Gradually stir in a coconut cream and bring to a simmer. Step 4: Add salmon fillets, cover and simmer for 7-8 minutes, turning the fish over halfway. Step 5: Meanwhile, blanch green beans in a pan of simmering water until just tender. Step 6: Drain and divide between 2 hot serving plates. Step 7: Stir some fresh cilantro leaves into the sauce. Step 8: Top the beans with the salmon, spooning over the sauce. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro and serve with the cooked rice.

Dish Name: Thai Prawn And Glass Noodle Salad
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, king prawns, fish sauce, lime juice, coconut milk, palm sugar, garlic cloves, ginger, chilies, white pepper, mint leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Soak glass noodles in boiling water until softened Drained well Peel and devein prawns. Step 2: Mix fish sauce, lime juice, coconut milk, palm sugar, garlic, ginger, chillies and pepper in a bowl. Step 3: Add prawns, mint and noodles and toss through dressing. Step 4: Transfer to serving plate.

Dish Name: Thai Prawn And Pineapple Curry Kaeng Khua Saparot
Ingredient Names: garlic, red curry paste, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk, pineapple, fish sauce, palm sugar, lime juice, prawns, kaffir lime leaves, thai red chili pepper, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Peel, devein, and behead the shrimp, leaving only the small tail shells on. Step 2: Drop two tomatoes into boiling water for about a minute, then remove to cold water, peel, quarter, discard the seed pulp, and chop the flesh You want 2 tablespoons of chopped tomatoes. Step 3: In a little oil in a medium hot wok, briefly saute the garlic and basil, removing it and reserving it when the aroma is fully developed. Step 4: Cook the curry paste briefly to develop the aroma, then add half the coconut milk, the fish sauce, tomatoes, pineapple, lime juice and sugar. Step 5: Stir to combine fully. Step 6: Add the prawns and cook until they turn slightly pink and opaque. Step 7: Add the remainder of the coconut milk, the lime leaves and slivered chili, at the same time returning the sauted garlic and basil to the pan. Step 8: Transfer to a serving dish and serve with steamed thai jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: king prawns, red chilies, spring onions, fresh coriander leaves, oil, garlic, onion, fresh lime leaves, lemons, lemongrass, curry powder, coconut milk, cinnamon stick, crunchy peanut butter, tamarind juice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half of the oil in a wok and fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes. Step 2: Add the chillies lime leaves, lemon grass and the curry powder, cook for 2 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the coconut milk cinnamon stick, peanut butter, tamarind juice, fish sauce, sugar and lemon juice. Step 4: Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 mins, stir to prevent the mixture from sticking. Step 5: Heat the remaining oil in a separate pan and fry the prawns till they are pink and just firm. Step 6: Mix the prawns with the sauce and serve garnished with the sliced spring onions, red chillies and coriander leaves. Step 7: Serve with lemon rice Wonderful.

Ingredient Names: prawns, onion, tomatoes, turmeric, cayenne pepper, oil, ginger-garlic paste, chives, green coriander, salt, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil and add onions. Step 2: When brown, add tomato and spices, salt. Step 3: Add 1 / 4 cup water and stir, add prawns. Step 4: Add coconut / or coconut milk. Step 5: When prawns are cooked, add chopped green coriander Just before serving, put a few chives on top to garnish. Step 6: Serve with steamed rice or with my tomato rice.

Dish Name: Thai Red Curry Coconut Sauce For Salmon
Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, thai red curry paste, light brown sugar, fresh lime juice, salt, cornstarch, fresh basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat sauce ingredients except for the cornstarch and the basil leaves in a small saucepan. Step 2: Taste and adjust to your preferences Just before salmon is done, add cornstarch to the sauce with a small amount of water to make a slurry. Step 3: Stir until it is glossy and coats the back of a spoon Stack and roll basil leaves like a small cigar Sliver them cross-wise into narrow ribbons and drop into the sauce. Step 4: Keep sauce warm but be careful not to simmer for a long time. Step 5: Serve sauce over the fish with jasmine or basmati rice.

Dish Name: Thai Red Curry Shrimp And Calamari
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, squid rings, coconut milk, tomato puree, red pepper, soy sauce, white vinegar, thai red curry paste, eggplant, onion, fish sauce, sugar, lime zest, basil leaves, canola oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat canola oil in a large pot or wok. Step 2: Add onions and eggplant and cook until eggplant is cooked through. Step 3: Add peppers and cook for 1 more minute. Step 4: Add shrimp and calamari and cook for 1 more minute. Step 5: Add rest of ingredients and bring up to a boil while stirring Immediately turn off heat. Step 6: Serve with steamed brown rice.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, fish sauce, sambal oelek, chicken stock, cornstarch, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare all your ingredients and have them ready to go in separate bowls. Step 2: Mix the corn starch into the chicken stock. Step 3: Heat your wok on high. Step 4: Add the oil to the wok and stir fry the bell peppers for 1 minute. Step 5: Add the garlic and stir fry for 30 seconds. Step 6: Add the shrimp and stir fry until they curl and turn pink, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the fish sauce and sambal, stir fry for about 10 seconds. Step 8: Finally, add the chicken stock / cornstarch mixture, and mix thoroughly. Step 9: Boil the sauce for about a minute or two just until it thickens up. Step 10: Serve over brown rice.

Ingredient Names: salmon fillets, unsweetened coconut milk, ginger, palm sugar, fish sauce, red curry paste, lime, fresh basil, fresh cilantro, thai chile, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Remove the skin from the fillets and cut the fish into medium / large cubes. Step 2: Place the coconut milk into a large saute pan and add ginger, sugar, fish sauce, curry paste, and lime juice Use a whisk to blend it until it is smooth. Step 3: Bring the coconut milk to a boil and add the fish. Step 4: Cook, turning fish gently to cook all sides as it cooks, for 5-7 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle curry with chopped basil and cilantro. Step 6: Serve garnished with minced thai bird chiles, if you like, but remember that these are very hot, and you might want to taste one small thin ring before adding a lot of them to your serving Ladle into bowls over steamed jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, thai chiles, salmon fillets, olive oil, onions, tomatoes, fresh basil, mixed greens
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Step 2: Prepare the dressing by combining the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and chopped chiles in a small bowl; set aside. Step 3: Place the salmon filet on a baking tray, and rub olive oil over. Step 4: Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until easily flaked. Step 5: Let cool for at least 15 minutes. Step 6: Place salmon filet into a big bowl; use fork to break salmon meat into big chunks. Step 7: Add onion, tomato and basil; pour dressing over, and toss lightly until well mixed. Step 8: Place mixture on lettuce leaves, and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Thai Seafood Curry Over Coconut Jasmine Rice
Ingredient Names: olive oil, toasted sesame oil, garlic cloves, green curry paste, shrimp, scallops, grouper, light coconut milk, fish sauce, red pepper, snake beans, carrots, lemongrass, basil leaves, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: To cut carrot flowers, peel or scrub carrots and cut into 4 inch lengths. Step 2: Using a very sharp knife cut a small v out of the side by placing the sharp edge of the knife down the length of the carrot piece, twice. Step 3: Repeat this 3-4 times per carrot piece. Step 4: Slice into 1 / 4-1 / 2" thick 'flowers' to finish. Step 5: In a saucepan with glass lid, combine 1 1 / 2 cup water, 3 / 4 cup coconut milk, and rice. Step 6: Cover and bring just to a boil Immediately reduce heat to lowest setting and cook for 15 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed Do not remove lid or stir while cooking. Step 7: Heat the oils in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Step 8: Add the garlic and curry paste and saute until fragrant.

Ingredient Names: red curry paste, light coconut milk, water, shrimp, scallops, mussels, fresh basil, lime juice, nam pla, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put curry paste in lge heavy pot, add 1 / 2 can coconut milk, bring to boil. Step 2: Add remaining coconut milk and water. Step 3: Add seafood, cover and simmer until mussels open, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Discard unopened mussels add basil, lime juice, nam pla and serve over rice.

Dish Name: Thai Shrimp And Fresh Vegetable Rice
Ingredient Names: fresh shrimp, fresh lime juice, low sodium soy sauce, fresh jalapeno pepper, fresh ginger, garlic clove, cooking oil, asparagus spear, sweet red pepper, cooked rice, peanuts, flat leaf parsley
Instructions: Step 1: Thaw shrimp, if frozen. Step 2: Rinse shrimp Pat dry. Step 3: Place shrimp in medium bowl For marinade, combine lime juice, soy sauce, jalapeo pepper, ginger, and garlic, pour over shrimp, toss to coat. Step 4: Marinate at room temperature for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 5: Drain shrimp well, reserving marinade. Step 6: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti noodles, broccoli florets, fresh shrimp, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil, gingerroot, garlic cloves, green onions, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4 qt dutch oven, bring a large amount of water to boil. Step 2: Add pasta and cook 4 minutes. Step 3: Add broccoli and cook 2 minutes. Step 4: Add shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until pink. Step 5: Meanwhile, in a bowl combine peanut butter and soy sauce. Step 6: Stir in vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil, gingerroot, and garlic. Step 7: Drain spaghetti mixture and return to pan. Step 8: Add peanut butter mixture, green onions and nuts. Step 9: Toss gently to coat.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, garlic cloves, zucchini, button mushrooms, bell pepper, hot chili pepper, light coconut milk, red curry paste, kaffir lime leaves, splenda granular, fish sauce, large shrimp, fresh basil leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a large deep skillet, heat oil and add onions, garlic and chopped chillies and cook for 1-3 minutes If you are sensitive to volatile odors from heated chillies, just add them when you add the coconut milk, but in any case, vent the cooking area. Step 2: Add the zucchini, mushrooms, and bell pepper to the pan, cooking until they are half-tender. Step 3: Add coconut milk, curry paste, lime leaves, splenda and fish sauce, stirring mixture until curry paste mingles with the coconut milk. Step 4: Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are mostly cooked through. Step 5: Add shrimp to the pan and stir over medium heat, uncovered, until shrimp become pink but are not curled too tightly Either stir basil into the curry or use as a garnish, whichever you prefer.

Ingredient Names: light coconut milk, fresh ginger, chili paste with garlic, shrimp, all-purpose flour, low sodium soy sauce, diced tomatoes, green onion, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, fresh mushrooms, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, ginger and chili paste in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add shrimp, reduce heat, and simmer for 3 minutes, or until shrimp is cooked through. Step 3: Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon. Step 4: Combine flour and soy sauce in a small bowl, and stir with a whisk, then add to coconut milk in saucepan. Step 5: Add tomatoes, green onion, lime juice and sugar, then bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 6: Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes until mixture thickens slightly, stirring occasionally. Step 7: Stir in mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Step 8: Return the shrimp to the pan and cook until thoroughly heated. Step 9: Serve sprinkled with cilantro, if desired.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, water, shrimp, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, lime juice, mushrooms, red curry paste, green onions, galangal, coriander leaves, sea salt, jalapeno peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Add water and coconut milk to pot and whisk, add salt, bring to the boil. Step 2: Add galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and red curry paste. Step 3: Reduce the heat to a simmer for 10-15 minutes. Step 4: Strain of the big pieces. Step 5: Add mushrooms and jalapeno peppers. Step 6: Cook for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add shrimp and cook till shrimp is done. Step 8: Add green onions and lime juice.

Ingredient Names: cooked rice, medium raw shrimp, garlic cloves, red chili peppers, egg, green onions, carrots, fresh cilantro, white pepper, vegetable oil, lime juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all 'stir fry sauce' ingredients together in a cup until sugar dissolves, set aside. Step 2: Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 3: Drizzle in 1-2 tablespoons oil, then add garlic and chili. Step 4: Stir-fry 30 seconds to release the fragrance, then add shrimp. Step 5: Stir-fry until shrimp turn pink and plump If needed, add a little more oil or 1 teaspoons water to keep ingredients moist and sizzling. Step 6: Add carrot and fresh coriander and continue stir-frying 1-2 more minutes. Step 7: Add rice and drizzle the stir-fry sauce over Use a large flat utensil or spoon, use a scooping motion to fry rice 2-3 minutes, or until sauce is well distributed.

Dish Name: Thai Shrimp In Curried Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, thai red curry paste, garlic clove, fresh ginger, nam pla, limes, shrimp, mango, cilantro, rice vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the coconut milk, curry paste, garlic, ginger, 2 tablespoons of the nam pla and the juice of 1 lime in a saucepan. Step 2: Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the shrimp and simmer for 5 minutes, until they turn pink and are cooked through. Step 4: Add the mango and cilantro. Step 5: Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon nam pla, the juice of the second lime and the rice vinegar. Step 6: Serve this soup-like curry in shallow bowls with steamed jasmine rice on the side.

Dish Name: Thai Shrimp Kabobs With Hot Ginger Sauce
Ingredient Names: large shrimp, canola oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, fresh ginger, garlic, apricot preserves, cornstarch, orange juice
Instructions: Step 1: Combine marinade ingredients in a ceramic or glass bowl. Step 2: Stir in shrimp, cover and refrigerate between 3 hours and overnight. Step 3: Thread shrimp on skewers and grill just until opaque Sauce: In a small saucepan, combine apricot preserves, soy sauce, lemon juice and 1 / 2 tsp grated ginger. Step 4: Bring to a boil Dissolve cornstarch in orange juice and add to apricot mixture. Step 5: Stir just until sauce thickens. Step 6: Serve hot with shrimp.

Ingredient Names: fresh linguine, fresh snow pea, carrots, fresh mushrooms, olive oil, medium shrimp, peanut sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine according to package directions, adding snow peas and linguine at the same time. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook carrots and mushrooms in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes, add shrimp. Step 3: Cook and stir 3 minutes longer or until shrimp turns pink. Step 4: Stir in peanut sauce, heat through. Step 5: Drain linguine and snow peas. Step 6: Transfer to a serving bowl. Step 7: Top with shirmp mixture, toss to coat.

Ingredient Names: simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes, heavy cream, bacon, fresh spinach, goat cheese, large shrimp, sweet chili sauce, dry white wine, olive oil, salt, fresh ground pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saut pan, saut bacon until cooked Be careful not to crisp the bacon. Step 2: Set aside and reserve bacon fat for later use. Step 3: Leave 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in saut pan for spinach. Step 4: Add spinach to saut pan and quickly saut over med High heat until wilted. Step 5: Remove spinach and set aside In large saucepan, add mashed potatoes, cream, goat cheese, and cooked bacon. Step 6: Cook over medium-low heat until potatoes are hot and cheese has melted completely. Step 7: Stir in sauted spinach and season with salt and pepper.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, honey, fish sauce, thai red curry paste, rice noodles, romaine lettuce leaves, rice paper, fresh basil leaves, shrimp, cucumbers, green onion tops, carrots, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: To prepare sauce, combine vinegar, honey, fish sauce, and curry paste, stir well and set aside To prepare rolls, cook rice sticks according to package directions, drain and rinse under cold water. Step 2: Drain well Trim fibrous ribs from lettuce leaves to flatten leaves. Step 3: Add hot water to a large, shallow dish to a depth of 1 inch. Step 4: Place 1 rice paper sheet in dish.
