Step 5: Let stand 30 seconds or until soft. Step 6: Place sheet on a flat surface. Step 7: Arrange 1 lettuce leaf over sheet. Step 8: Top lettuce with 2 basil leaves, 4 shrimp halves, 2 tablespoons noodles, 5 cucumber strips, 5 carrot strips, 5 green onion strips, and 3 mint leaves.

Ingredient Names: unsweetened coconut milk, green curry paste, medium shrimp, nam pla, carrots, red bell pepper, spinach, fresh coriander, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Spoon about 1 / 3 cup of the thick coconut cream from the top of the coconut milk and in a large heavy skillet cook the cream over moderate heat, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes, or until it is thickened slightly. Step 2: Add the curry paste and cook the mixture, whisking, for 1 minute. Step 3: Add the shrimp and saut the mixture over moderately high heat, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the shrimp turn pink. Step 4: Add the coconut milk and the naam pla and simmer the mixture, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute, or until the shrimp are just cooked through. Step 5: Transfer the shrimp with a slotted spoon to a bowl, to the skillet add the carrots and the bell pepper, and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the spinach in batches, stirring until each batch is wilted, return the shrimp to the skillet, and simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute. Step 7: Sprinkle the dish with the coriander and serve it with the rice.

Ingredient Names: bread, shrimp, ground pork, egg, thin soy sauce, cilantro, garlic cloves, white pepper, salt, sesame seeds, vegetable oil, thai sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Chop up shrimp and mix with pork In another bowl mix cilantro, garlic, salt, and pepper, then add into shrimp and pork mixture. Step 2: Add in egg and soy sauce. Step 3: Divide the mixture into 10 parts. Step 4: Spread mixture onto the bread and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Step 5: Heat oil in a wok or pan until hot. Step 6: Place bread in hot oil face down, cook until golden. Step 7: Remove and place it on paper towel to remove excess oil. Step 8: Serve with thai sweet chili sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Shrimp With Coconut Almond Rice
Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, water, light coconut milk, canola oil, medium shrimp, chili sauce, slivered almonds, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice according to the package directions, but replace half the water called for with coconut milk. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large skillet. Step 3: Add shrimp and cook 3-4 minutes until pink. Step 4: Add chili sauce and stir until heated through. Step 5: Stir almonds into cooked rice and top with shrimp mixture. Step 6: Garnish with onions.

Ingredient Names: large shrimp, egg, green onion, fresh lemon juice, dijon mustard, fresh cilantro, sriracha sauce, salt, ground black pepper, panko breadcrumbs, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Coarsely chop shrimp in processor. Step 2: Add egg, green onion, lemon juice, mustard, cilantro, sriracha sauce, salt, and pepper. Step 3: Blend in using on / off turns. Step 4: Add 1 cup panko and blend in using on / off turns Form mixture into twelve 3-inch" diameter cakes. Step 5: Roll cakes in remaining 1 cup panko. Step 6: Transfer cakes to waxed-paper-lined baking sheet. Step 7: Refrigerate 10 minutes. Step 8: Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil in heavy large skillet, over medium-high heat Working in batches, fry cakes until cooked through and golden brown on both sides, adding more oil to skillet as needed, about 6 minutes.

Dish Name: Thai Snapper With Ginger Pla Bae Sae
Ingredient Names: savoy cabbage, red snapper fillets, mushrooms, fresh ginger, pickling onions, chicken stock, fish sauce, oyster sauce, palm sugar, white peppercorns, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Line a medium heatproof bowl with the cabbage leaf, then add the fish, mushrooms, ginger and onions. Step 2: Bring the stock to the boil, then add the fish sauce, oyster sauce and palm sugar. Step 3: Pour the stock over the fish, place the bowl in a steamer, and steam for about 10 minutes or until the fish is cooked. Step 4: Serve sprinkled with pepper and cilantro.

Dish Name: Thai Spicy Shrimp Salad Yaam Goong
Ingredient Names: green leaf lettuce, shrimp, gingerroot, red onion, red chilies, lemongrass, garlic cloves, brown sugar, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, black pepper, green onions, fresh cilantro, fresh mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Put lettuce in salad bowls, and arrange shrimp on top. Step 2: Place ginger, onion and chilies over shrimp. Step 3: In a small bowl, mix lemongrass, garlic, sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, and black pepper. Step 4: Pour over salads and garnish with green onion, cilantro, and mint leaves, serve.

Dish Name: Thai Spicy Shrimp Soup Tom Yum Koong
Ingredient Names: shrimp, fresh mushrooms, straw mushrooms, stock, fresh lemongrass, fresh lime leaves, galangal, fresh chili peppers, fish sauce, fresh lime juice, sugar, chili paste, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Devein shrimp, rinse and drain. Step 2: Bring stock to a boil, and add remaining ingredients. Step 3: Cook until shrimp changes color. Step 4: Remove chunks of lemon grass and whole chiles. Step 5: Sprinkle with fresh cilantro, serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, fresh cilantro, crabmeat, ground pork, eggs, carrot, onion, fish sauce, pepper, sugar, salt, cellophane noodles, egg roll wraps, egg yolk
Instructions: Step 1: Soak cellophane noodles in warm water for 5 minutes. Step 2: Drain, and cut into 2" lengths. Step 3: Set aside In small frying pan, stir-fry garlic and cilantro for a few seconds. Step 4: Pour into a large bowl and mix with crab, pork, eggs, carrots, onions, fish sauce, pepper, sugar, salt, and cellophane noodles Separate spring roll wrappers. Step 5: Place a wrapper with one pointed edge toward you On each corner, put a little of the egg mixture to seal edges of the spring roll. Step 6: Put 2 tbsp of the meat mix 1 / 3 of the way down. Step 7: Fold the closest edge over, then the right and left sides, then roll closed.

Ingredient Names: low-fat coconut milk, lemon, green onions, fresh ginger, cilantro, garlic clove, red pepper flakes, ground turmeric, halibut fillets, parchment paper, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, salt, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk with lemon peel, green onions, ginger, 1 teaspoon cilantro, garlic, red pepper flakes and turmeric. Step 2: Cut halibut into serving pieces and place in an 8 or 9 inch glass pan. Step 3: Pour coconut milk marinade over fish. Step 4: Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours Do not marinade longer as the fish will become too soft. Step 5: Line a steamer with parchment paper and poke holes in paper. Step 6: Combine lime juice and fish sauce. Step 7: Remove halibut from marinade, keeping marinade on the fish, and place in steamer set over boiling water. Step 8: Discard excess marinade Or set a rack over the water, place fish on a plate and set on rack not touching the water.

Ingredient Names: fresh mussels, fresh lime juice, unsweetened coconut milk, dry white wine, thai red curry paste, garlic, fish sauce, white sugar, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large stock pot, combine the lime juice, coconut milk, wine, curry paste, garlic, fish sauce and sugar. Step 2: Stir to dissolve sugar and curry paste and bring to a boil over high heat. Step 3: Boil for 2 minutes then add mussels. Step 4: Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until mussels are opened, 5 to 8 minutes. Step 5: Remove from the heat and discard any unopened mussels. Step 6: Pour mussels and liquid into a serving dish and toss with cilantro.

Dish Name: Thai Sticky Shrimp With Coconut Rice
Ingredient Names: reduced-fat coconut milk, short-grain rice, red grapefruits, brown sugar, cornstarch, soy sauce, rice vinegar, fresh ginger, shrimp
Instructions: Step 1: In 4qt saucepan, on high heat, combine coconut milk, rice, and 3 / 4 cup water, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Step 3: Meanwhile, cut peel and membrane from grapefruit. Step 4: Cut between fruit and membrane to release segments into a bowl. Step 5: In a 12in skillet mix sugar and cornstarch. Step 6: Add soy sauce, vinegar, and ginger. Step 7: Stir on high heat until boiling. Step 8: Add shrimp and stir until shrimp are opaque. Step 9: Add grapefruit segments.

Ingredient Names: lump crabmeat, lemon juice, ginger, green onions, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh parsley, mayonnaise, egg, fresh breadcrumb, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Gently toss the crabmeat with lemon juice and ginger. Step 2: Set aside In oil, saute' onions, pepper, and garlic until it is all soft. Step 3: Let cool and toss with crabmeat. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients, except for breadcrumbs Form into small patties, about 2 5" in diameter. Step 5: Place on wax paper in freezer for 30 minutes. Step 6: Remove from freezer and pat with bread crumbs on both sides Palace on parchment-covered baking sheet and bake for 2 minutes at 350, or until browned.

Dish Name: Thai Style Open Crab Meat Sandwich
Ingredient Names: lime juice, gingerroot, lemongrass, mayonnaise, crusty bread, avocado, crabmeat, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Mix half the lime juice with the ginger and lemon grass. Step 2: Add the mayonnaise and mix well. Step 3: Spread 1 tablespoon mayonnaise over each slice of bread Halve the avocado and remove the pit Peel and slice the flesh thinly, then arrange the slices on the bread. Step 4: Sprinkle with lime juice. Step 5: Spoon the crab meat over the avocado, then add any remaining juice. Step 6: Spoon over the remaining mayonnaise, top with a cilantro spring. Step 7: Serve immediately To make lime-and ginger-flavored mayonnaise, place 2 egg yolks, 1 tablespoon lime juice, and 1 / 2 teaspoon grated ginger in a blender.

Dish Name: Thai Style Prawn Shrimp Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: olive oil, prawns, lemongrass, chili, garlic cloves, ginger, brown onion, baby corn, broccolini, red capsicum, green beans, carrots, water, basil, bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a large wok on high until the wok is hot and add the prawns and stir fry for 1 minute and then add the lemongrass, chilli, garlic and ginger and stir fry for 2 minutes or until the prawns just change colour and remove from the wok and set aside. Step 2: Heat remaining oil in the wok on medium high and add the onion, corn, broccolini, capsicum, green beans and carrot and then add the water and cook covered toss twice for 2 minutes or until the vegetables are just tender. Step 3: Return prawn mixture to the wok and toss to combine and heat through, remove wok from the heat and toss in the basil leaves and bean sprouts. Step 4: Divide mixture between shallow bowls to serve and accompany with the lime wedges.

Dish Name: Thai Style Salmon On Coconut Milk Noodles
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic cloves, pepper, skinless salmon fillet, rice vermicelli, olive oil, curry powder, turmeric, salt and pepper, coconut milk, fresh ginger, corn kernel, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Marinade: in a bowl, combine all the ingredients except for the fish. Step 2: Season with pepper. Step 3: Slice the salmon lengthwise into four 2 5-cm wide pieces. Step 4: Place in the marinade, coat thoroughly and let marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature, drain the salmon. Step 5: Wrap each piece on itself to form tournedos and keep everything in place with string. Step 6: Keep refrigerated Noodles: cook the noodles in salted boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes or until tender. Step 7: Drain and rinse under cold running water.

Dish Name: Thai Style Spring Roll Salad With Red Curry Shrimp
Ingredient Names: large raw shrimp, red curry paste, sugar, vegetable oil, salt, cooking oil, lime juice, fresh gingerroot, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, rice noodles, iceberg lettuce, carrot, cucumber, fresh bean sprout
Instructions: Step 1: Failing that, any asian market would have them Marinating the shrimp: Mix the curry paste, sugar, oil and salt in a medium bowl. Step 2: Add shrimp and stir to coat. Step 3: Marinate shrimp for 15 minutes while you prepare the rest of the components of the dish Vinaigrette: Combine all the vinaigrette ingredients except for the oil in a mixing bowl. Step 4: Using a whisk, gradually mix in the oil. Step 5: Set aside Noodles:.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, almonds, white onion, ground ginger, ground turmeric, fresh lemongrass, salt, tilapia fillets, salt and pepper, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a food processor or blender, combine the coconut milk, almonds, onion, ginger, turmeric, lemon grass, and 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt Process until smooth. Step 2: Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper on both sides, then place them skin-side up in the skillet. Step 4: Pour the pureed sauce over the fish Use a spatula to coat the fish evenly with the sauce. Step 5: Sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Step 6: Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes, until the puree is thickened and fish flakes easily with a fork.

Dish Name: Thai Style Tomato And Shrimp Wrap Ww
Ingredient Names: cooked shrimp, tomatoes, carrot, of fresh mint, lemon zest, reduced sodium soy sauce, fat free flour tortillas, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine shrimp, chopped tomato, shredded carrot, chopped mint, grated lemon zest, and soy sauce. Step 2: Spoon onto 1 large tortilla. Step 3: Sprinkle with chopped peanuts. Step 4: Roll up and cut in half at a slight angle One wrap serves 2.

Dish Name: Thai Sweet Potato With Crab Soup
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic, thai red curry paste, ground coriander, ground cumin, sweet potato, chicken stock, coconut milk, crabmeat, roasted red pepper, salt & pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil over medium-high heat in a large pot. Step 2: Saute onion until translucent, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Add garlic& saute for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add curry, coriander& cumin and saute for 30 seconds longer. Step 5: Add sweet potato& saute for another 30 seconds. Step 6: Pour in stock& milk, bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer until the sweet potato is cooked- 20 to 30 minutes. Step 7: Remove from the heat, let cool slightly& ladle into a food processor Whirl until well blended, pour back into the pot, add crab& roasted red pepper and reheat.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, ground pork, garlic, fish sauce, tapioca, crabmeat, pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the stock to simmering in a large pan. Step 2: Pour 1 / 2 cup of the hot stock into a bowl and stir in the pork. Step 3: Return mixture to the pan. Step 4: Add the garlic and fish sauce, then add the tapioca and cook for 5 to 10 minutes. Step 5: When the tapioca is clear, add the crab meat and season to taste with pepper. Step 6: Remove from the heat. Step 7: Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Tuna And Pearl Onion Shish Kebabs
Ingredient Names: tuna steaks, frozen pearl onions, coconut milk, thai peppers, brown sugar, lime, fresh ginger, lemongrass, fish sauce, basil, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Mix all marinade ingredients except for the oil in a large ziplock bag. Step 2: Add tuna cubes and pearl onions Marinade for 60 minutes turning a couple times. Step 3: Thread 5 tuna cube and 5 onions alternating on each soaked skewer. Step 4: Pour the remaining marinade into a small pot and bring to a boil then simmer for 5 minutes. Step 5: Brush olive oil over skewered tuna and onions. Step 6: Preheat grill to medium and lightly wipe with an oiled rag. Step 7: Grill for 5-7 minutes until golden, turning frequently. Step 8: Serve over a bed of rice topped with the heated marinade.

Ingredient Names: pillsbury refrigerated classic pizza crust, thai chili flavored tuna, olive oil, tomatoes, fresh basil, monterey jack cheese
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425f Lightly grease a cookie sheet Unroll dough onto cookie sheet and spread to desired size and thickness. Step 2: Brush crust with olive oil mixed with chili flavored oil from tuna. Step 3: Spread tuna evenly over crust Distribute tomatoes and sprinkle basil over all. Step 4: Spread shredded cheese over top. Step 5: Bake 13-17 minutes or until cheese is melted and crust is deep golden brown.

Dish Name: Thai Tuna Burgers With Ginger Lemon Mayonnaise
Ingredient Names: kirby cucumbers, red onion, rice vinegar, sugar, kosher salt, fresh ground pepper, fresh ginger, garlic clove, thai chiles, fish sauce, cilantro, basil, tuna, vegetable oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, toss the cucumbers, onion, vinegar, 1 tablespoon of the sugar and 1 teaspoon of salt. Step 2: Season with pepper and let stand for 1 hour at room temperature. Step 3: In a mortar or medium bowl, using the back of a spoon, mash the ginger with the garlic, chile and remaining 1 teaspoon of sugar to a paste. Step 4: Stir in the fish sauce, cilantro and basil On a clean cutting board, thinly slice the tuna Stack the slices and cut into thin matchsticks. Step 5: Cut the matchsticks into rough cubes, then chop until the pieces are roughly 1 / 8 inch. Step 6: Add the tuna to the ginger paste and stir until evenly combined. Step 7: Using lightly moistened hands, shape the tuna mixture into 4 patties about 1 inch thick. Step 8: Set them on a large plate lined with plastic wrap.

Ingredient Names: tuna, eggs, rice crumbs, green curry paste, ketjap manis, light soy sauce, chili sauce, fish sauce, kaffir lime leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Mix ingredients together in a large bowl Form into patties Fry until golden brown on each side.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, cumin, brown sugar, toasted sesame oil, cayenne, tuna steaks, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together first 5 marinade ingredients in glass pie plate. Step 2: Add the tuna steak and turn to coat. Step 3: Cover pie plate with wax paper and microwave on high 1 minutes. Step 4: Sprinkle tuna with scallion. Step 5: Cover and microwave 1 minutes. Step 6: Allow to stand 1 minute before serving.

Dish Name: Thai Whole Grilled Fish With Sweet Sour Glaze
Ingredient Names: rockfish, soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh ginger, garlic, chili paste, fresh cilantro, vegetable oil, sugar, rice wine vinegar, fish sauce, ginger, red bell pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Score each side of the fish with 3-4 small shallow cuts. Step 2: Combine all marinade ingredients and marinate the fish for at least an hour or up to overnight. Step 3: Prepare the glaze: place the oil and garlic in a small saucepan, place on medium heat. Step 4: Simmer until garlic begins to turn golden. Step 5: Strain and let cool In another small pot, combine sugar and vinegar, bring to a boil, and simmer for one minute. Step 6: Add fish sauce, ginger, bell pepper, chili paste, and 3 tbsp of the garlic oil. Step 7: Cook together for 3-5 minutes until sauce reduces slightly Making sure your grill is clean and well-lubricated with plenty of vegetable oil, grill fish over medium heat, approximately 7 minutes per side or until flesh is just opaque at the bone Plate fish and spoon sauce over each fish.

Ingredient Names: olive oil, thai green curry paste, lemongrass, red peppers, baby new potatoes, coconut milk see tip, chicken stock, fresh lime leaves, green onions, peas, raw king shrimp, baby spinach, thai fish sauce, cilantro picked, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large frying pan or wok. Fry the curry paste and lemongrass for 1 min, until fragrant. Tip in peppers and new potatoes, then stir them to coat in the paste. Cook for 1-2 mins. Pour in coconut milk, stock and lime leaves, then bring to the boil. Simmer and cook for 15 mins, until potatoes are just tender. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients, but if you’re freezing don’t add spinach or coriander yet, and cook until the prawns turn pink, about 4 mins. Serve, with some extra lime wedges, if you like, or cool before freezing in containers.

Ingredient Names: eggs, olive oil, thai red curry paste, green onions, sweet potato, vegetables, skimmed milk, skinless salmon fillets half then fine, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles following the pack instructions, rinse and drain. Heat the oil in a deep saucepan and fry the curry paste for 1 min until fragrant. Add the spring onions, reserving 1 tbsp, the sweet potato, stock and milk, bring quickly to the boil and simmer for 5 mins until the potato is tender. Add the salmon pieces and cook for 2 mins, then stir in half the coriander. Step 2: Divide the noodles between 4 bowls and spoon over the salmon and sauce. Sprinkle over the remaining coriander and spring onions.

Ingredient Names: brown rice noodle, chicken, thai red curry paste, fresh lime leaves, fish sauce, skinless sustainable white fish such as pollock, raw king shrimp, pak choi leaves, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Cook the noodles following pack instructions. Refresh in cold water and drain well. Step 2: Put the stock in a large saucepan and stir in the curry paste, lime leaves, fish sauce and 250ml cold water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 mins. Step 3: Cut the fish into roughly 3cm cubes and add to the pan. Return to a simmer, then cook for 2 mins uncovered. Step 4: Stir in the noodles, prawns and pak choi, and simmer for 2-3 mins or until the fish and prawns are just cooked. Serve in bowls scattered with coriander.

Ingredient Names: tilapia fillets, cornstarch, sunflower oil, scallions, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, lime, red chili pepper, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Coat the fish fillets in the cornstarch, then set aside. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan, sizzle the fillets for 2-3 mins on each side until crisp, then remove and keep warm In the same pan, briefly fry the scallions, garlic and ginger, then add the soy sauce, brown sugar and lime juice and simmer until slightly syrupy. Step 3: Spoon the sauce over the fish, scatter with chili and cilantro, then serve with the lime wedges.

Dish Name: Tilapia With Thai Peanut Coconut Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut sauce, light coconut milk, canola oil, tilapia fillets, spinach
Instructions: Step 1: In a large measuring cup combine peanut sauce and coconut milk, set aside. Step 2: In a large skillet heat oil. Step 3: Add tilapia and cook for 3-5 minutes and then turn fish and cook for 3-5 more minutes or until done. Step 4: Season fish with salt and pepper and then remove to a plate and keep warm. Step 5: Add coconut / peanut sauce mixture and spinach to skillet. Step 6: Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Step 7: Cook for 2 minutes or so or until spinach wilts. Step 8: Spoon sauce over fish.

Dish Name: Tod Mun Goong Thai Fish And Shrimp Cakes
Ingredient Names: flounder, shrimp, onion, cilantro, green beans, cornstarch, fish sauce, red curry paste, egg, sugar, oil, pickling cucumber, shallot, thai red chili pepper, water
Instructions: Step 1: Process the onion and cilantro until chopped up. Step 2: Put in a large bowl Process the fish until pasty and then the the shrimp until mostly pasty, but still somewhat coarse, add to the bowl. Step 3: Slice the green beans approximately 1 / 8, or process them, and add. Step 4: Mix the cornstarch with the fish sauce, and add the curry paste, egg and sugar. Step 5: Add to the bowl and mix very very well. Step 6: Heat some oil in a frying pan Use a tablespoon to form small patties and fry in the oil. Step 7: When golden, turn over and fry the other side.

Dish Name: Tom Ka With Tofu Or Tom Yam Soup
Ingredient Names: fish sauce, coconut milk, chicken stock, water, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaf, lime, garlic cloves, silken tofu, shrimp, mushroom, red chili paste, fresh gingerroot, cilantro, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: Throw everything in a pot and boil for about 10 minutes, saving shrimp until last. Step 2: Garnish and serve To make tom yam instead of tom ka, do everything the same, except substitute more chicken stock to replace the coconut milk.

Dish Name: Tom Kha Coconut Soup With Shrimp
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, fresh lemongrass, shallots, fresh cilantro, fish sauce, chicken broth, coconut milk, sugar, sliced mushrooms, raw shrimp, lime juice, thai red curry paste, jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Cook as much jasmine rice as needed. Step 2: Heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat until just shimmering. Step 3: Add lemon grass, shallots, cilantro and 1 tbsp fish sauce. Step 4: Cook, stirring frequently, until just softened, 2 to 5 minutes. Step 5: Stir in chicken broth and 1 can of coconut milk. Step 6: Bring to simmer over high heat. Step 7: Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer until flavors have blended, 10 minutes. Step 8: Pour broth through fine mesh strainer and discard solids in strainer. Step 9: Rinse saucepan and return broth mixture to pan. Step 10: Return pan to medium-high heat.

Dish Name: Tom Yaam Goong Spicy Prawn Soup Flavored With Lemon Grass
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, lemongrass, galangal, straw mushrooms, tiger shrimp, lime juice, sugar, fish sauce, oil, kaffir lime leaves, red chilies, whipping cream, coriander leaves, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring chicken stock to a boil. Step 2: Add lemon grass, galangal, straw mushrooms. Step 3: Season to taste with lime juice, sugar, fish sauce and chili in oil. Step 4: Add kafir lime juice, red chili sliced and cream. Step 5: Add shrimp, cook approximately 30 seconds longer, until shrimp barely done. Step 6: Garnish with coriander leaves and a few drops of chili oil on top.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, lime juice, lemongrass, galanga powder, kaffir lime leaves, garlic cloves, chili pepper, bell pepper, cilantro, fish sauce, shiitake mushrooms, raw shrimp, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Pour stock and lime juice into a deep cooking pot. Step 2: Place lemongrass in a food processor and process until finely grated. Step 3: Add to pot The bulb can be thrown into the pot for additional flavor. Step 4: Add the galanga powder to the pot. Step 5: Add garlic, chilies, peppers, and kaffir leaves. Step 6: Bring to a mild boil. Step 7: Add the mushrooms and shrimp Gently simmer 'til shrimp is pink. Step 8: Turn down the heat to low then add the coconut milk and fish sauce.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, lemongrass, garlic cloves, ginger, chili sauce, cilantro, lime, green onions, shrimp paste, fish sauce, oil, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Place the lemon grass, garlic, galangal, chili, cilantro, lime juice and zest, green onions, shrimp paste, fish sauce, oil and palm sugar in a foor processor and process. Step 2: Marinate the shrimp in the paste for at least 10 minutes Skewer the shrimp. Step 3: Grill until cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side Shrimp can be sauteed in oil if not grilled.

Dish Name: Warm Pumpkin Spinach Prawn Salad With Chilli Lime Dressing
Ingredient Names: chile pepper jam, lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, chicken stock, pumpkin, vegetable oil, prawns, baby spinach leaves, red onion
Instructions: Step 1: To make dressing, combine all ingredients in a pan and bring to the boil. Step 2: Set aside Preheated oven to 200c. Step 3: Toss pumpkin lightly in 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil, place in baking tray and baked in until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Step 4: Heat remaining oil in wok and stir-fry prawns until just cooked, about 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Drizzle half the dressing over the prawns and toss to coat To assemble, combine pumpkin, baby spinach and onion in a bowl. Step 6: Divide mixture between individual serving plates. Step 7: Arrange prawns on top of salad and drizzle remaining dressing around the plates.

Dish Name: Wing Bean And Grilled Prawn Salad
Ingredient Names: king prawns, peanut oil, wing beans, pomelo fruit, mint leaf, thai basil, coriander leaves, lemongrass, cherry tomatoes, birds eye chile, garlic clove, dried shrimp, palm sugar, lime juice, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: To make the dressing, place the chilli, garlic and a pinch of salt into a mortar and pound to a paste with the pestle. Step 2: Add the shrimp and pound to combine. Step 3: Add the palm sugar and stir until it has dissolved, then stir in the lime juice and fish sauce. Step 4: Remove and discard the prawn heads, then peel the prawns, leaving the tails intact. Step 5: Using a pair of kitchen tweezers, devein the prawns. Step 6: Place the prawns into a bowl with the oil, season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper, then toss to combine. Step 7: Preheat a chargrill pan until hot, then cook the prawns for 2 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through. Step 8: Transfer the prawns to a bowl, add the remaining ingredients and dressing, and toss gently. Step 9: Serve immediately as a light lunch or as part of a thai-style banquet They're available from asian food stores and from some greengrocers.

Dish Name: Ww Tv Dinner Thai Shrimp Rice
Ingredient Names: olive oil, frozen chopped onions, cooked brown rice, unsweetened pineapple chunks, anaheim chili, small shrimp, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large skillet. Step 2: Add onions, cook until tender, about 2 minutes, add rice. Step 3: Cook over medium heat for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add remaining ingredients. Step 5: Cook until heated through and shrimp are done, about 6 more minutes. Step 6: Divide evenly into the 6 containers.

Ingredient Names: pork tenderloin, lemongrass, garlic, shallot, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, wooden skewers
Instructions: Step 1: Slice pork thinly into 2 inch long strips and place into bowl. Step 2: Combine lemon grass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce and sesame oil in food processor. Step 3: Add water as needed to achieve smooth texture. Step 4: Pour mixture over meat. Step 5: Set aside for 30 minutes to an hour. Step 6: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes. Step 7: Thread pork onto skewers and leave 2 inches on each end. Step 8: Grill or broil 1-2 minutes per side.

Ingredient Names: frozen puff pastry, oil, garlic cloves, onion, gingerroot, minced beef, potatoes, curry powder, water, sugar, salt and pepper, vegetables, fresh coriander, egg
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok or pan, heat a little oil and fry chopped garlic until golden add onion and ginger. Step 2: Add in the minced meat and fry for 2 minutes breaking up the meat into small pieces. Step 3: Add potatoes, cook for further 2-4 minutes. Step 4: Add the curry powder, water, sugar salt and pepper and simmer over a medium low heat stirring occasionally to prevent burning, until the potatoes are almost soft You may need to add a little extra water if there is no sauce left. Step 5: Add in the mixed vegetables and coriander last and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes until the vegetables are just starting to soften. Step 6: Remove from heat and cool. Step 7: Cut the puff pastry into 4 inch by 4 inch squares. Step 8: Put some filling onto one half of the square. Step 9: Brush edges with a little water and fold over pastry to make a rectangle or triangle shape.

Ingredient Names: chicken thighs, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, black peppercorns, fresh coriander, thick soy sauce, olive oil, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Prick the thighs all over. Step 2: Blend the garlic, ginger, coriander and peppercorns to a paste And rub into the chicken. Step 3: Wrap in plastic and place in fridge for at least 2 hours. Step 4: Mix soysauce& oil Baste the chicken with the soy mixture Bbq over medium heat until the outside is crisp and the inside is cooked. Step 5: Brush with soy while cooking.

Dish Name: Chicken Wraps With Nam Jihm Dressing
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, fish sauce, coriander leaves, shallot, roasted peanuts, coconut, birds eye chile, mint leaf, red chilies, gingerroot, coriander, garlic cloves, salt, limes, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Make the nam jihm dressing. Step 2: Using a pestle and mortar, pound the chillies, ginger, coriander and garlic with the salt. Step 3: Add to this the limejuice, sugar and fish sauce It should taste hot, sour and sweet For the wraps, mix the chicken together with the remaining wrap ingredients and stir in 2 tablespoons of the nam jihm dressing. Step 4: Spoon the mixture into the chosen leaves, sprinkle with the rice powder and serve immediately Cooks Nam jihm means chilli lime.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, egg, green onions, garlic, bean thread noodles, fresh bean sprout, soy sauce, fish sauce, egg roll wrap, oil, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a skillet cook the pork until no pink remains. Step 2: Drain of grease and set aside in a bowl. Step 3: Add the beaten egg to the pork, along with chopped green onions, bean sprouts, minced garlic, salt and pepper, mix all together. Step 4: Add the softened bean thread noodles and the soy sauce and fish sauce, if using I use about 2 teaspoons of soy and just a dash of fish sauce It depends on your taste, mix all together. Step 5: Place a heaping tablespoon of meat mix in the wrapper, close to the edge. Step 6: Wrap as directed on package.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, garlic, coriander root, black pepper, vegetable oil, dry roasted peanuts, fish sauce, palm sugar, red chili pepper, cilantro leaves and stems, orange sections
Instructions: Step 1: Pound the garlic, coriander roots, and black pepper together in a mortar and pestle. Step 2: Heat the oil in a frying pan and on low heat fry the mixture until it smells fragrant. Step 3: Add the pork and fry until it changes color. Step 4: Add the peanuts, fish sauce, palm sugar, chili, and coriander and continue to fry until the mixture is well cooked, dark brown and quite dry Segment the oranges or mandarins Slit through the membrane and flesh and open the segments flat, removing any seeds. Step 5: Place a spoonful of pork on each piece of fruit.

Ingredient Names: ground turkey, garlic, serrano peppers, fresh ginger, lemongrass paste, green onions, mushroom, water chestnut, fish sauce, hoisin sauce, salt, pepper, peanut oil, carrots, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground turkey, lemon grass paste, fish sauce and salt / pepper until thoroughly mixed and let sit for 10 minutes. Step 2: In a large saucepan or wok, heat peanut oil and stir fry the green onions, serrano peppers, ginger, mushrooms, water chestnuts, and garlic until soft. Step 3: Now add the ground turkey and hoisin sauce then cook until done. Step 4: Chop the fresh herbs as above and place each in an individual serving container To make the sauce: in a small mixing bowl, soak the crushed red pepper in lime juice for several minutes add the garlic, sugar, and fish sauce and stir to dissolve the sugar. Step 5: Transfer to a serving container and add the grated carrots and serve at room temperature refrigerated, the sauce will keep in a tightly covered container for up to 5 days To serve: arrange lettuce on a large platter surrounded by the containers of chopped herbs, etc And the sauce To make a wrap take a lettuce leaf in hand, scoop a large tablespoon of meat on to lettuce leaf, then add any herbs that you like. Step 6: Add a teaspoon of sauce onto the mixture on the leaf and then roll and eat.

Dish Name: Larb Gai Spicy Thai Chicken Salad
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breast, rice powder, fresh cilantro, spring onions, shallots, mint leaves, cayenne pepper, lime juice, fish sauce, garlic and red chile paste, cabbage, fresh cilantro stem
Instructions: Step 1: Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat, no oil necessary. Step 2: Add chicken, stir until cooked through. Step 3: Remove from heat, drain excess liquid. Step 4: Add fish sauce and lime juice. Step 5: Toss all together with cilantro, onion, shallots, mint, cayenne, rice powder, and ground chile / garlic paste Adjust seasoning to taste. Step 6: Serve immediately over lettuce leaves or thinly sliced cabbage. Step 7: Garnish with cilantro sprigs.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, pork, fish sauce, palm sugar, pineapple, sweet red peppers, fresh cilantro leaves, white peppercorns, fresh coriander, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: First, make the pesto by: using a mortar and pestle or a spice grinder, crush or grind the peppercorns into a fine powder. Step 2: Combine the pepper, cilantro and garlic and work into a fairly smooth paste in the mortar or in a small blender or food processor If you opt to use a blender or food processor, you may need to add a little vegetable oil or water to ease the grinding To keep the pesto for later use, put it in a glass jar, pour a little oil on top to cover it and seal tightly. Step 3: Heat a wok or medium skillet over medium heat. Step 4: Add the oil, and swirl to coat the surface of the pan. Step 5: When oil is hot, add the cilantro pesto. Step 6: Stir-fry the pesto until quite fragrant, about 2 minutes Increase heat to medium high and crumble in the ground pork. Step 7: Stir-fry the pork until it breaks up into small lumps, renders some of its fat, and is no longer pink, approzimately 2 minutes.

Ingredient Names: black-eyed peas, flour, breadcrumbs, eggs, cheese, carrot, soy sauce, mirin, garlic, onion, ground cumin, ground coriander, fenugreek seeds, turmeric, instant chicken bouillon granules
Instructions: Step 1: Start by soaking the beans in boiling water for 30 minutes - 1 hour, or until the skins start to come off. Step 2: Drain the beans, and put them in a food processor, and pulse them for a few minutes, until the mixture resembles moist breadcrumbs. Step 3: Put the beans into a large mixing bowl, and add the eggs, flour, and breadcrumbs. Step 4: Stir until combined. Step 5: Add all of the other ingredients, and mix well. Step 6: Shape the mixture into small balls, and flatten them with the back of a spatula. Step 7: Fry the rissoles in peanut oil until golden and crispy. Step 8: Serve with gravy, and steamed vegetables.

Dish Name: Minced Pork With Thai Basil Bangkok Style Pat Krapao Moo Sap
Ingredient Names: ground pork, oil, red thai chile, garlic cloves, oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, water, thai basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a hot pan, add the oil and stir fry garlic and chili until fragrant. Step 2: Add pork and continue to stir fry on medium heat until almost ready. Step 3: Keep stir frying and add pork stock as needed. Step 4: Add oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar Increase heat to high and add fresh thai basil. Step 5: Keep stir frying for few seconds. Step 6: Serve with white basmati rice and fried eggs.

Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, brown sugar, rice vinegar, chili paste, fish sauce, hot sauce, ground ginger
Instructions: Step 1: Mix brown sugar, rice vinegar, chile paste, fish sauce, sriracha, and ginger. Step 2: Marinate chicken for 6-8 hours in plastic bag. Step 3: Thread chicken onto metal or soaked wooden skewers. Step 4: Take reserved marinade and bring to boil to use as a basting sauce. Step 5: Grill chicken 15 minutes, turning and basting occassionally.

Dish Name: Satay Peanut Sauce Nam Jim Satay
Ingredient Names: tamarind paste, sugar, peanut butter, fish sauce, red curry paste, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Add coconut milk to a medium size sauce pan warm at a medium heat As it begins to heat, incorporate the red curry paste and blend. Step 2: Allow mix to heat until you see the oil from the paste begin to surface. Step 3: Add remaining ingredients and continue blending until smooth. Step 4: Reduce heat allow to simmer for an additional 5 minutes. Step 5: Serve in a small bowl or small plate with your satay appetizers.

Dish Name: Savory Stuffed Omelets Kai Yad Sai
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, ground pork, diced tomatoes, green peas, onions, sugar, fish sauce, white pepper, soy sauce, eggs, cilantro leaf, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Heat half the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork for 2 minutes, add all remaining ingredients except eggs, garnishes& remaining oil, and stir-fry 2 minutes more. Step 2: Heat a 6-8" omelet pan and add a drop of the remaining oil. Step 3: Pour in enough egg to thinly cover the bottom of the pan Brown the omelet lightly on both sides, flipping over halfway through cooking. Step 4: Repeat until all the egg is used. Step 5: Place a tablespoon full of the pork mixture in the center of each omelet. Step 6: Fold two opposite sides toward the center& then fold in the remaining sides so that it resembles a square. Step 7: Place omelet on serving plate and repeat until all omelets and pork mixture are used. Step 8: Garnish if desired.

Ingredient Names: corn kernels, celery, all-purpose flour, rice flour, baking powder, red curry paste, fish sauce, light soy sauce, salt, egg white, water, fresh cilantro, oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except for the oil, mixing well. Step 2: Set aside for about 10 minutes to allow the baking powder to become activated heat oil in large pan or flat-bottomed wok over medium to high heat. Step 3: Drop large teaspoonfuls of corn mixture into the oil. Step 4: Allow to fry about 3 minutes each, until golden, turning once or twice. Step 5: Remove corn cakes from oil and place on paper or cloth towel to wick excess oil away. Step 6: Arrange on plate and serve.

Ingredient Names: birds eye chiles, shallots, garlic, dried shrimp paste, lime juice, sugar, salt and pepper, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Remove seed from chilli to tone down the spiciness. Step 2: Blend all ingredient. Step 3: Add salt and pepper to taste Do add additional sugar and lime juice before serving if you like it less spicy. Step 4: Keep in bottle- chill if possible.

Dish Name: Thai Chicken Cakes With Sweet Chilli Sauce
Ingredient Names: chicken breasts, garlic clove, fresh gingerroot, onion, coriander, green chili, salt & freshly ground black pepper, olive oil, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Place the chicken, garlic, ginger, onion and coriander in a food processor with the chilli and season to taste Blitz for 15-20 seconds. Step 2: Shape the chicken mixture into small cakes. Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over a moderate heat and fry the chicken cakes until golden. Step 4: Serve immediately, with sweet chilli sauce and sliced spring onion.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, chili paste, green onions, zucchini, red bell pepper, fresh lime juice, cilantro, wonton wrapper, tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: In large skillet, heat oil over high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, ginger and chili paste, stir-fry 1 minute. Step 3: Add green onions and cook 1 minute. Step 4: Add zucchini and bell pepper and cook, stirring often, until vegetables are just tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Step 5: Add lime juice and cilantro. Step 6: Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool. Step 7: Transfer mixture to food processor and coarsely chop Dipping sauce: in small bowl, mix all sauce ingredients and set aside. Step 8: Line baking sheet with plastic wrap.

Dish Name: Thai Ginger Pork Appetizer Or Meal
Ingredient Names: ground pork, garlic salt, red pepper flakes, onion, minced ginger, lemongrass, fish sauce, sweet chili sauce, sesame oil, honey, dry sherry, dry roasted peanuts, green cabbage, green onion top, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium nonstick skillet, sprinkle garlic salt and red pepper flakes over ground pork and saute until slightly pink. Step 2: Add slivered onion, ginger, and lemongrass. Step 3: Saute until onion is translucent. Step 4: Add fish sauce, chili sauce, sesame oil, and honey. Step 5: Saute for 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Add dry sherry and simmer for about 2-3 minutes. Step 7: Add roasted peanuts. Step 8: Serve in cabbage leaves as an appetizer, garnished with green onion tops and cilantro leaves Four appetizer servings. Step 9: Serve as a meal for by adding steamed rice, sugar snap peas, and sliced carrots.

Ingredient Names: reduced sodium soy sauce, fresh lime juice, water, hot chili oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, pork tenderloin, red bell peppers, red onion, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: If hot chili oil is not available, combine 2 teaspoons vegetable oil and 1 / 2 teaspoon red pepper flakes in small microwavable cup Microwave at high 30 to 45 seconds. Step 2: Let stand 5 minutes to allow flavor to develop. Step 3: Combine soy sauce, lime juice, water, chili oil, garlic and ginger in medium bowl Reserve 1 / 3 cup mixture for dipping sauce, set aside. Step 4: Cut pork tenderloin lengthwise in half. Step 5: Cut crosswise into 4-inch-thick slices. Step 6: Cut slices into 1 / 2-inch strips. Step 7: Add to bowl with soy sauce mixture.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, garlic, boneless skinless chicken breast halves, chicken broth, green onions, fresh mint leaves, cilantro, lime juice, ground red pepper, ground ginger, bibb lettuce, bean sprouts, plain low-fat yogurt, cucumber, dried dill weed
Instructions: Step 1: Heat peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat 1 minute. Step 2: Add garlic and chicken. Step 3: Cook, stirring constantly, 3 to 5 mins Or until chicken is lightly browned. Step 4: Add broth and cook over medium heat until most of liquid evaporates. Step 5: Stir in green onions and next 5 ingredients. Step 6: Spoon 2 tbls Chicken mixture onto each lettuce leaf. Step 7: Sprinkle with bean sprouts, and fold over. Step 8: Serve with cucumber dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Thai Red Pepper Dipping Sauce Hot
Ingredient Names: thai red chili peppers, garlic clove, green onion, cilantro, fresh lime juice, msg, fish sauce, water
Instructions: Step 1: Crush red peppers and garlic in morter Transfer to a bowl, add everything Mix well Add small lime chunks Enjoy.

Ingredient Names: ground pork, rice noodles, coleslaw, onion, prepared yellow mustard, light soy sauce, cayenne pepper, black pepper, chili-garlic sauce, worcestershire sauce, egg, spring roll wrappers, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Soak bean thread noodles in warm water for 10 minutes, drain, and cut into approximately 1" sections. Step 2: Mix ground pork, noodles, vegetables, and seasonings in a large bowl. Step 3: Place 2 tsp of filling in corner of spring roll wrap, roll to middle, fold in side corners, use the beaten egg to seal the top corner as you finish rolling the spring roll Deep-fry the spring rolls in batches so that they don't stick together, and drain on papertowels. Step 4: Serve while still hot with sweet chili sauce for chicken Alternatively, freeze the rolls prior to deep-frying. Step 5: Fry when needed, and they will be just as good as if you had rolled them that day.

Ingredient Names: fish sauce, sugar, broccoli floret, oil, garlic cloves
Instructions: Step 1: Stir fish sauce with sugar until dissolved, set aside. Step 2: Drop broccoli florets into a saucepan of boiling water. Step 3: Cover and boil 2- 3 minutes, drain. Step 4: Heat oil in wok over medium heat. Step 5: Add garlic and fry until golden and crisp, about 3 minutes. Step 6: Drain on paper towel. Step 7: Add fish sauce mixture to remaining oil. Step 8: Add broccoli and stir until blended with seasonings and heated through.

Ingredient Names: medium raw shrimp, rice noodles, rice paper sheets, fresh cilantro leaves, roast pork, peanuts, lime peel, dipping sauce, water, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic clove, chili oil
Instructions: Step 1: Bring large saucepan of water to a boil over high heat, add shrimp. Step 2: Simmer 1-2 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and opaque. Step 3: Remove shrimp with slotted spoon to a small bowl. Step 4: When cool, slice shrimp in half lengthwise. Step 5: Meanwhile, soften rice noodles in medium bowl of boiling water for two minutes, drain. Step 6: Cut noodles into managable 3-inch lengths Soften rice paper wrappers in a large bowl of warm water 30 to 40 seconds or until pliable. Step 7: Drain wrappers, 1 at a time, on paper towels and transfer to clean work surface.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, green onions, fish sauce, limes, cilantro, chili-garlic sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the above ingredients and allow to marinate overnight Makes approximately 2 cups.

Ingredient Names: beef stock, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, kaffir lime leaves, green chilies, fish sauce, palm sugar, dumplings, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Bring all ingredients except dumplings and coriander to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 2: Strain the soup and keep hot. Step 3: Boil dumplings in water until they float to the top and are cooked through, about five minutes. Step 4: Place dumplings in the bottom of bowls and pour over strained soup. Step 5: Garnish with coriander leaves.

Dish Name: Chiang Mai Curried Noodle And Chicken Soup Kao Soi Gai
Ingredient Names: red chilies, red shallots, garlic cloves, fresh turmeric, fresh ginger, fresh coriander, coriander seed, salt, coconut cream, chicken leg, palm sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, stock, fresh egg noodles
Instructions: Step 1: Pre-heat oven to 200c To make the paste: Roast the chillies, shallots, garlic, turmeric and ginger until softened, remove from oven. Step 2: When cool enough to handle, peel the shallots and garlic. Step 3: Then pound the roasted ingredients together until smooth To make the soup: Simmer the coconut cream until it is thick and beginning to separate. Step 4: Then add the paste and fry until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Add the chicken, reduce the heat and simmer for several minutes.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, coconut milk, coconut cream, salt, palm sugar, lemongrass, shallots, coriander, thai green chili, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, mushrooms, boneless skinless chicken thighs, fish sauce, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a 4 quart saucepan, heat chicken stock, coconut milk, coconut cream, salt and palm sugar to boiling. Step 2: Meanwhile bruise lemongrass, shallots, cporiander roots and chiles using a mortar and pestle. Step 3: Add to boiling stock along with galangal and lime leaves. Step 4: Simmer slowly for 20 minutes. Step 5: Strain out all solids. Step 6: Return liquid to pot and add chicken and mushrooms. Step 7: Simmer until chicken is cooked. Step 8: Add fish sauce and lime juice. Step 9: Stir to incorporate Ladle into bowls.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, chicken broth, boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced mushrooms, butter, fresh ginger, thai chiles, garlic clove, shallots, lime, fresh cilantro, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Grill the chicken breast and shred it, set aside. Step 2: Saute the mushrooms with the butter. Step 3: Set aside Grind the ginger, shallots, chiles and garlic to make a paste. Step 4: In a sauce pan, combine the chicken broth, coconut milk and spice paste. Step 5: Let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the chicken and mushrooms to the soup. Step 7: Let simmer for 5 minutes. Step 8: Squeeze fresh lime into the soup to taste.

Ingredient Names: oil, jalapenos, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, chicken broth, smooth peanut butter, dried onion, soy sauce, garbanzo beans, cooked brown rice, coconut milk, dried cilantro, cayenne pepper, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Step 2: Add jalapenos, red bell pepper and garlic. Step 3: Saute five minutes or until peppers are soft. Step 4: Add chicken broth and bring to a boil. Step 5: Whisk in peanut butter and stir continuously until peanut butter is melted. Step 6: Add minced onion, soy sauce, beans, rice, coconut milk and cayenne. Step 7: Simmer for about ten minutes. Step 8: Add cilantro and lime juice and heat through.

Ingredient Names: shallots, onion, butter, canola oil, sea salt, fresh ground black pepper, fresh thyme, lime, butternut squash, lemongrass, chicken stock, coconut milk, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat slow-cooker for 20 minutes on high. Step 2: Add onions to pot or carmelise onions in a frying pan If carmelised, add later with stock. Step 3: Add butter and oil to slow-cooker, chop shallots. Step 4: Add to oil along with salt and pepper and thyme. Step 5: Allow to cook until translucent. Step 6: Add roasted butternut squash, broken into several pieces, stock and fresh lime juice. Step 7: Cook all day or overnight on low setting. Step 8: Remove lemongrass.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, tom yam broth cubes, fresh gingerroot, spring onions, red chilies, lemongrass, garlic, fresh coriander, lime, fish sauce, coconut milk, heavy cream
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the chicken stock, tom yum cube, ginger, spring onions / scallions, chillies, lemon grass and garlic together. Step 2: Simmer gently for 30 minutes. Step 3: Strain the mixture, and liquidize with the coriander / cilantro stalks, lime juice, fish sauec and coconut milk. Step 4: Return to the pan, reheat and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Step 5: Strain once more and return to the rinsed out pot. Step 6: Add cream, and finely chopped coriander / cilantro to the soup and heat through once more Ladle into bowls and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Crock Pot Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, thai curry paste, water, chicken broth, skinless chicken breast, white mushrooms, fresh lemongrass, fresh lime juice, cilantro, fresh ginger, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, curry paste, water, broth, chicken, mushrooms, ginger and lemongrass in slow cooker 2. Step 2: Cover and cook on low for about 4 hours, or on high for about 2-3 3. Step 3: Remove lemongrass and discard 4. Step 4: Add in lime juice, to taste, and cilantro, if desired Plenty of salt and pepper to taste, stir and serve.

Dish Name: Easy Tom Kha Thai Coconut Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken breast, egg white, cornstarch, water, oil, coconut milk, chicken broth, white mushrooms, green onions, cilantro, gingerroot, fish sauce, red chili sauce, lime juice, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: To velvet chicken: lightly beat egg white and combine with cornstarch. Step 2: Toss the chicken strips or cubes in this mixture, then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Step 3: Heat the water and oil in a pot or a wok, until it's hot enough that a piece of chicken floats to the top when you put it inches put the chicken in, in shifts if you have to to keep it from crowding, and cook until it's white, about 30 seconds If you're not using the chicken straight away, refrigerate it until you do To prepare the soup: heat coconut milk and chicken broth to boiling. Step 4: Turn down heat, add fish sauce, chili sauce, ginger, lemon and lime juices, and lemon zest, chicken, and mushrooms and simmer for a couple minutes. Step 5: Add chopped green onions and chopped cilantro and serve.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, green curry paste, low sodium chicken broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, red bell peppers, rice noodles, boneless skinless chicken breasts, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Step 3: Add the garlic and curry paste and cook, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the chicken broth, coconut milk and fish sauce. Step 5: Cover and bring to a boil. Step 6: Add the bell peppers and noodles and simmer, uncovered, until the noodles are al dente, about 3 minutes. Step 7: Add the chicken and simmer until just cooked through, about 3 more minutes. Step 8: Stir in the lime juice and cilantro. Step 9: Add more fish sauce and lime juice, if desired.

Ingredient Names: fish sauce, coconut milk, reduced-sodium chicken broth, shrimp soup paste, lemon grass root, lime peel, lime, garlic, red chile, fresh gingerroot, cilantro, boneless skinless chicken, half-and-half cream
Instructions: Step 1: In medium to large saucepan, bring to boil all ingredients except garlic, red chili, ginger root, cilantro, chicken, and half and half cream. Step 2: Meanwhile, chop the remaining ingredients finely in chopping machine, then add this to the pot. Step 3: Chop and boil the chicken pieces in the soup for around 5 minutes or until fully cooked. Step 4: Add the half-and-half cream to the soup and stir constantly to avoid curdling for around three minutes. Step 5: Remove lemon grass root upon serving, or tell victims to remove before eating the soup! Step 6: Serve soup warm or hot Also, sometimes your local store will carry these items.

Ingredient Names: chicken stock, galanga root, lemongrass
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a medium stockpot and bring to boil over high heat. Step 2: Reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes, skimming any fat that rises to the surface, strain.

Ingredient Names: water, vegetable stock base, lemongrass, ginger, cremini mushrooms, firm tofu, garlic, chili-garlic sauce, vegetarian oyster sauce, hot chili sauce, coconut milk, lime juice, fresh ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Clean and smash lemongrass stocks, then tie in a knot and boil with ginger in water for 30 minutes. Step 2: Remove lemongrass and ginger. Step 3: Add mushrooms, tofu, garlic, garlic chili sauce, oyster sauce, chili sauce, coconut milk, lime juice, and black pepper. Step 4: Let simmer for 10-15 minutes. Step 5: Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator for better flavor.

Ingredient Names: medium shrimp, carrot, garlic cloves, onion, thyme leaves, water, oil, ginger, pickled ginger, lemongrass, serrano pepper, tamarind paste, fish sauce, light coconut milk, mushroom
Instructions: Step 1: If making the stock, combine carrots, garlic, onion, thyme, and water in a large pot and bring to a boil, then lower to a simmer. Step 2: Add shells and juices reserved from the shrimp. Step 3: Cover and allow to simmer for at least half an hour. Step 4: Strain liquids out and set aside If not making the stock, bring pre-made stock to a boil, then lower to a simmer. Step 5: Add shells and juices reserved from the shrimp. Step 6: Cover and allow to simmer for at least half an hour. Step 7: Strain liquids out and set aside Separate seeds, if any, from tamarind paste and discard. Step 8: Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat.

Dish Name: Oprah's Thai Chicken Coconut Curry Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken stock, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, green curry paste, coriander seeds, cumin seed, black peppercorns, cilantro leaves and stems, fresh cilantro leaves, unsweetened coconut milk, shallot, sliced mushrooms, boneless chicken breast, fish sauce, fresh lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: In a large heavy-bottom pot over high heat, combine chicken stock, garlic, ginger, curry paste, coriander, cumin, peppercorns and cilantro, bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Step 3: Strain broth over a bowl through a fine-mesh sieve, discard solids. Step 4: Return broth to pot. Step 5: Add coconut milk, shallots, mushrooms and chicken. Step 6: Return to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until chicken is cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes. Step 7: In a small bowl, combine fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and jalapeo, if desired. Step 8: Stir until sugar is dissolved, then add mixture to soup.

Ingredient Names: pumpkin, peanut oil, yellow mustard seeds, garlic clove, onion, celery rib, red chile, chicken stock, dried shrimp, coconut cream, salt and pepper, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the pumpkin and remove the seeds. Step 2: Cut away the skin and dice the flesh. Step 3: Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the mustard seeds until they begin to pop. Step 4: Stir in the garlic, onion, celery, and chili and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Step 5: Add the pumpkin with the stock and dried shrimp and bring to a boil. Step 6: Lower the heat, cover and simmer gently for about 30 minutes until the ingredients are very tender. Step 7: Transfer the mixture to a food processor or blender and process till smooth I like to use my hand-held emulsifier Adjust the seasoning to taste with salt and pepper. Step 8: Serve hot, sprinkled with chopped cilantro.

Ingredient Names: tom yum paste, garlic, celery, tomatoes, button mushrooms, chicken breast, prawns, chicken stock cube, water, pepper, salt, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Set water to boil in a pot, add water and mix in tom yum soup. Step 2: Put garlic, celery, tomatoes, mushrooms, chicken and prawns inside the pot, leave to boil. Step 3: Add chicken, stock cube, salt and pepper. Step 4: Leave to boil for another 5 - 10 minutes, until the fragrant smell of the soup wafts around the kitchen or until the oil from the tom yum soup appears on the surface on the soup. Step 5: Garnish with coriander and serve.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, carrots, ginger, onions, chicken stock, water, unsweetened coconut milk, red curry paste, salt, pepper, scallions, fresh cilantro, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or stockpot. Step 2: Add the sliced carrots (not the matchstick carrots) and ginger and sautee over medium-high heat, until the carrots are crisp-tender and lightly browned, about 6 to 7 minutes. Step 3: Add the onion and cook until softened but not browned, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the stock, water, coconut milk and curry paste to the saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer over until the carrots are tender, about 25 minutes. Step 6: Strain out the solids, reserving the liquid; discard the ginger. Step 7: Transfer the carrots to a blender and puree with 1 cup of the cooking liquid until very smooth. Step 8: Return the puree to the cooking liquid. Step 9: This can also be done with a stick blender if you have one and will be much easier- just remove the ginger and puree in the pot. Step 10: Add the carrot matchsticks and cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Step 11: Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Step 12: Serve hot, garnished with the scallion, cilantro and basil. Step 13: For Vegetarian use Vegetable stock.

Ingredient Names: butter, carrot, celery, banana, onion, garlic clove, bay leaf, clove, low sodium chicken broth, pumpkin puree, light coconut milk, sweetened condensed milk, ground nutmeg, ground cinnamon, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add carrot and next 6 ingredients and saut until vegetables are soft, about 10 minutes, discard bay leaf. Step 3: Transfer mixture to processor and blend until smooth. Step 4: Return mixture to pot. Step 5: Add broth and all remaining ingredients except cilantro. Step 6: Boil soup over medium-high heat 15 minutes to blend flavors. Step 7: Cool slightly Working in batches, puree soup in blender until smooth. Step 8: Return soup to pot.

Dish Name: Super Low Cal Thai Noodle Soup
Ingredient Names: chicken broth, tofu shirataki noodles, egg, green onion, lemongrass, minced garlic clove, minced ginger, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Heat chicken broth in a sauce pan. Step 2: Add green onion, lemon grass, garlic, ginger and fish sauce. Step 3: Cook 3 minutes on high. Step 4: Rinse noodles very well under running water, and then add to broth mixture, cook for 1 minute. Step 5: Turn off heat and slowly stir in beaten egg Egg will turn into cooked threads. Step 6: Let stand for a couple minutes, soup will be very hot Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: canola oil, lemongrass, fresh ginger, garlic clove, thai red curry paste, chicken stock, fish sauce, sugar, unsweetened coconut milk, boneless skinless chicken breasts, straw mushrooms, lime juice, salt, fresh cilantro leaves, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large stockpot or dutch oven over medium heat. Step 2: Add the lemon grass, ginger, and garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until aromatic, 30 to 60 seconds. Step 3: Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 30 seconds. Step 4: Add 1 / 2 cup chicken stock to the pot and stir to dissolve the curry paste. Step 5: Add the remaining stock, fish sauce, and sugar and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 6: Reduce the heat to low, partially cover, and simmer to blend flavors, about 20 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the coconut milk, chicken, mushrooms, and lime juice. Step 8: Bring back to a simmer and cook until the stock is hot and the chicken is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Step 9: Taste for seasoning and add salt if desired. Step 10: Serve immediately, garnishing each bowl with cilantro and scallions.

Ingredient Names: oil, spanish onion, garlic cloves, gingerroot, carrots, canned chicken broth, fresh cilantro, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in 3-quart saucepan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add onion, garlic, ginger, and carrots. Step 3: Cook, stirring frequently, until hot and fragrant about 4 minutes, add 3 cups stock. Step 4: Simmer, covered, until carrots are tender, about 25 minutes. Step 5: Drain liquid from solids Reserve liquid. Step 6: Puree solids with cilantro in blender or processor until smooth. Step 7: Add as much liquid as container can hold. Step 8: Puree until even smoother.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, potato, chicken broth, chicken, coconut milk, fresh basil, fresh cilantro, lime juice, soy sauce, peanut butter, brown sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, heat the oil. Step 2: Add the bell pepper, garlic and ginger Saut for 4 minutes or until the pepper is crisp-tender. Step 3: Add the potatoes and broth, and bring to a boil. Step 4: Reduce to a simmer and cover for 7 minutes or until the potatoes are firm-tender. Step 5: Add the chicken, coconut milk, basil, cilantro, lime juice, soy sauce, peanut butter, and brown sugar to the pan, bring to a boil. Step 6: Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the chicken and potatoes are cooked through.

Ingredient Names: eggplants, coarse salt, chicken broth, green beans, green cabbage, onion, ginger, garlic, lemongrass, cilantro, bananas, plum tomato, coconut milk, cooked rice
Instructions: Step 1: Sprinkle the eggplants with 1 tsp of the salt and let stand for 15 minutes, rinse and pat dry. Step 2: Heat the chicken broth in a large pot over medium heat. Step 3: Add the eggplants and cook for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the green beans, cabbage, onion, ginger, garlic, lemongrass, cilantro, and remaining 1 tsp salt. Step 5: Cook covered over medium heat for 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in the banana, tomatoes and coconut milk. Step 7: Simmer uncovered 10 minutes longer. Step 8: Remove from heat and stir in the cilantro leaves. Step 9: Divide the rice between 8 shallow soup bowls.

Dish Name: Thai Coconut Soup Tom Kha Kai
Ingredient Names: boneless skinless chicken breasts, coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, lime juice, fish sauce, oyster sauce, water, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Dice the chicken into bite size cubes Marinade with oyster sauce. Step 2: Leave in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Step 3: Slice the ginger up into really thin strips. Step 4: Remove the outer leaves from the lemon grass until you get to the soft bit in the center. Step 5: Now take a rolling pin or something heavy and batter the lemongrass. Step 6: Place the water in a pot and start to heat, while the water is heating, juice your lime. Step 7: When the water is getting hot, put the lime juice, lemongrass, galangal and fish sauce inches and bring to the boil. Step 8: Once it starts to boil add the chicken and coconut milk, stir and bring it back to boil. Step 9: Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for about 2 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, extra firm tofu, olive oil, sweet potato, raw cashews, broccoli floret, spinach leaves, coconut milk, vegetable broth, turmeric, cumin, ginger, curry powder, garam masala, cinnamon
Instructions: Step 1: Coat tofu with soy sauce and saute in olive oil. Step 2: Add cashews and sweet potato chunks and saute. Step 3: Add broccoli, spinach leaves, coconut milk, vegetable broth, and spices. Step 4: Cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender.

Ingredient Names: garlic, peanut oil, chicken broth, soy sauce, fish sauce, cabbage, carrots, celery, sliced mushrooms, fresh lemongrass, thai red chili peppers, fresh lime juice, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep saucepan, heat garlic in oil until fragrant. Step 2: Add broth, soy sauce, fish sauce, cabbage, carrots, celery, mushrooms, lemongrass, and chilies. Step 3: Bring mixture to a boil. Step 4: Then reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until vegetables are tender Adjust seasonings for soy sauce, and fish sauce. Step 5: Then add lime juice and basil, serve.

Dish Name: Thai Lemongrass And Chile Soup Tom Yum
Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger, chili paste, oyster mushrooms, fresh lime juice, fish sauce, tomatoes, fresh cilantro, hot green chili peppers, rice noodles
Instructions: Step 1: In medium saucepan, heat vegetable broth to a simmer with lemongrass and lime leaves if desired In small skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and ginger, and cook, stirring often, about 30 seconds. Step 3: When broth has simmered for 5 minutes, remove lemongrass and lime leaves and discard. Step 4: Add cooked garlic and ginger to broth. Step 5: Return broth to a boil, and stir in chile paste and mushrooms. Step 6: Cook until mushrooms have wilted, about 30 seconds, then stir in lime juice and fish sauce. Step 7: Remove from heat, and ladle soup into small bowls along with your favorite rice noodles. Step 8: Top each bowl with chopped tomatoes, cilantro and a pinch of hot green chiles if you want it really really spicy Alternatively, tomatoes and chiles can be mixed together and placed in small serving bowl for people to help themselves.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, garlic clove, shrimp paste, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, chicken stock, medium egg noodles, thai fish sauce, lime, hot red pepper, light brown sugar, fresh spinach, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add the garlic and shrimp paste and fry gently over a medium heat for 1 minute. Step 3: Meanwhile, lightly crush the lemon grass stalks with a rolling pin or the blade of a large knife To make the soup add the lemon grass, kaffir lime leaves and chicken stock to the pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 4: Meanwhile, drop the noodles into a pan of boiling water, remove from the heat and leave to soak for 4 minutes, before draining To refine the soup, strain the stock through a fine sieve into a bowl, return to the pan and add the fish sauce, lime juice, red chilli and sugar. Step 5: Simmer for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the egg noodles and spinach, or pak choi and simmer for a further 30 seconds. Step 7: Finally, ladle into bowls, dividing the noodles equally between them and scatter over the cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: onion, celery, carrot, sweet red peppers, butter, flour, lemongrass, red chile, chicken broth, unsweetened coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cook onion, celery, carrot and red pepper in butter until softened, about 5 minutes. Step 2: Add the lemon grass, red chili, stir and cook for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir in the flour, and let cook for 1 minute, stirring all the time. Step 4: Add chicken broth, coconut milk and soy sauce, and stir to combine well. Step 5: Add the peanut butter. Step 6: Keep stirring until well combined. Step 7: Heat until hot and bubbly. Step 8: Serve with chopped fresh roasted peanuts and green onions as a garnish.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, chicken stock, fresh pumpkin, hot pepper, shallots, garlic, lime, lemongrass, salt and pepper, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Add the coconut milk and the stock to a large cooking pan, and bring to the boil. Step 2: Add the pumpkin, hot pepper, shallots, garlic and lime zest. Step 3: When the mixture returns to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for approximately 10 minutes, uncovered, or until the pumpkin is cooked and softened At this point you can refrigerate and finish the dish later if desired. Step 4: Puree the mixture with a hand blender or in a food processor. Step 5: Add the lemongrass, and bring the mixture again up to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Step 6: Take the pan off the heat, add the lime juice and add salt and pepper, if needed. Step 7: Serve immediately, garnished with chopped cilantro, if desired.

Ingredient Names: chicken broth, lemongrass, ginger, garlic clove, red pepper flakes, turkey, shiitake mushrooms, coconut milk, lime juice, fish sauce, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 5 ingredients and 1 cup water in a large pot and simmer for 3-5 minutes. Step 2: Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer for another minute or so. Step 3: Serve in bowls, garnished with additional cilantro, if desired.

Ingredient Names: low-sodium low-fat chicken broth, coconut milk, lemongrass, fish sauce, shrimp paste, low sodium soy sauce, white vinegar, limes, serrano chili peppers, ginger, garlic, brown sugar, boneless skinless chicken breasts, white mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: In 4qt or larger, heavy-bottomed pot, begin heating chicken broth and coconut milk on low-medium heat. Step 2: Add the other ingredients for the broth, down through the brown sugar, as you prepare them. Step 3: Bring broth to a slow simmer Never allow it to reach a rolling boil, and do not cover it at any time during cooking. Step 4: When broth is simmering, begin adding remaining ingredients starting with the chicken, as you prepare them in the order listed, stirring regularly. Step 5: Make sure the chicken is fully cooked by the time you add the cilantro--if you cube the chicken finely enough and use a normal length of time preparing the vegetables, this should not be an issue, but allow it to simmer a few extra minutes if necessary before adding the cilantro About a minute after adding the cilantro, taste the soup and add some additional lime juice as desired to punch up the flavor. Step 6: Serve immediately.

Ingredient Names: thai red curry paste, vegetable oil, vegetable stock, half-fat coconut milk, brown sugar, fresh egg noodles, carrots, chinese leaf, fresh bean sprouts, cherry tomatoes, limes, green onions, fresh coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Place the curry paste in a large saucepan or wok with the oil. Fry for 1 min until fragrant. Tip in the vegetable stock, coconut milk and brown sugar. Simmer for 3 mins. Step 2: Add the noodles, carrots and Chinese leaf and simmer for 4-6 mins, until all are tender. Mix in beansprouts and tomatoes. Add lime juice to taste and some extra seasoning, if you like. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with spring onions and coriander.

Dish Name: The Best Ever Red Pepper Curry Coconut Soup
Ingredient Names: red bell peppers, onions, butter, curry paste, coconut milk, chicken stock
Instructions: Step 1: Roasting peppers------------ Preheat grill or top oven to a high heat. Step 2: Wash peppers and place in oven The peppers will go black, turn to blacken all sides. Step 3: When pepper skins are blackened place in a plastic bowl and cover for 15 minutes. Step 4: Then peel and seed the peppers, cut into large segments ----------------- Melt butter in pan, add onions and saute until translucent. Step 5: Add curry paste and fry a further 3 minutes. Step 6: Add stock and peppers and let simmer a further 20 minutes.

Ingredient Names: broth, red pepper, mushroom, green onion, kaffir lime leaf, ground galangal, dried lemon grass, lime juice, cilantro, chicken breast, light coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Bring broth to a boil, add chicken While chicken is cooking, cut up peppers, mushrooms and onions. Step 2: Add veggies to soup and simmer about 5 minutes, until mushrooms are done. Step 3: Add coconut milk and seasonings. Step 4: Simmer about 5 minutes more. Step 5: Add lime juice, garnish with cilantro Fresh lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime leaves would be great if available If so, add with veggies.

Dish Name: Tom Yum Gai Thai Hot Sour Chicken Soup
Ingredient Names: onion, green onions, tomatoes, skinless chicken breasts, straw mushrooms, button mushrooms, chicken stock, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, fresh ginger, fish sauce, chili paste, serrano chilies, fresh cilantro, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium-sized soup pot, heat the peanut oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Saute the chicken and / or tofu, onion, half each of the ginger and lemongrass until the chicken is only a little bit pink and the onion translucent. Step 3: Add the stock, fish sauce, remaining ginger and lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and serrano chilies. Step 4: Simmer 10 - 15 minute covered on medium-low heat. Step 5: Add the sugar, nam prik pao, and sliced tomatoes. Step 6: Simmer an additional 2 minute. Step 7: Turn heat fully to low and add the lime juice to taste. Step 8: Add half of the diced cilantro and the green onions, then let simmer on low for another few minutes. Step 9: Sprinkle with the remaining cilantro and serve with additional lime juice.

Ingredient Names: water, mushroom, lime, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, fresh cilantro, chili peppers
Instructions: Step 1: Wash mushrooms and set aside Crush lemongrass with back of knife to release flavor. Step 2: Tie in a knot and drop into pot of water. Step 3: Bring water to a boil. Step 4: Add mushrooms Pull kaffir lime leaves from their stems and place in water If using lime zest instead, add it. Step 5: Turn off heat on stove Crush chili peppers and place into a serving bowl This will make the dish very spicy.

Ingredient Names: shrimp, kaffir lime leaves, tomatoes, mushrooms, water, lemongrass, fish sauce, lime juice, red chili peppers, chili paste
Instructions: Step 1: Pour water into medium saucepan and place over high head on stove. Step 2: Bring to boil and add kaffir lime leaves & lemon grass. Step 3: Cook for 2 minutes. Step 4: Reduce to low heat, add fish sauce, lime juice, fresh ground red chili, and chili paste in soy bean oil. Step 5: Add mushrooms & tomatoes. Step 6: Cook for several minutes. Step 7: Add shrimp or chicken. Step 8: Turn heat to high, do not stir. Step 9: When shrimp or chicken is cooked, continue to cook for 2 minutes more. Step 10: Serve with hot rice.

Dish Name: A Jaad Thai Cucumber Cool Down
Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, sugar, salt, red chile, seedless cucumber, shallot, cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Combine vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small pan. Step 2: Cook, swirling occasionally, on low until sugar disolves, about 2 minutes. Step 3: Turn off heat, add chili, and let cool. Step 4: Place cucmbers and shallots in a bowl. Step 5: Add vinegar mixture and stir Just before serving add the chopped cilantro & stir. Step 6: Garnish with whole cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, sugar, salt, ground black pepper, cucumber, red onion, fresh cilantro leaves, red chili pepper, mixed greens
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl, stir vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper until sugar and salt are dissolved Quarter cucumber lengthwise, remove seeds. Step 2: Cut quarters crossswise into 1 / 8 thick slices. Step 3: Add cucumber, onion, cilantro and chili pepper to vinegar dressing. Step 4: Toss until combined. Step 5: Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Step 6: Serve on bed of greens.

Ingredient Names: jasmine rice, water, lemongrass, red chile, fresh gingerroot, garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients into a large saucepan and let stand for five minutes. Step 2: Cover the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and cook over a low heat for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed.
