Step 3: Remove the pan from the heat and allow to stand covered for five further minutes. Step 4: Remove the flavourings, if wished, and pile into a serving dish. Step 5: Serve immediately, while very hot.

Dish Name: Asian Slaw With Spicy Thai Vinaigrette
Ingredient Names: green cabbage, red cabbage, napa cabbage, green onion, red bell pepper, carrots, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper, rice wine vinegar, fresh lime juice, chili-garlic sauce, honey, fresh ginger, garlic, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk all ingredients except oils in a large bowl Slowly drizzle in oils while whisking. Step 2: Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt and lime juice if needed. Step 3: Combine the vegetables in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper. Step 4: Toss to mix thoroughly. Step 5: Pour in the thai vinaigrette to taste and toss to mix Adjust, adding more if desired Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: seedless watermelon, ice, lime, condensed milk
Instructions: Step 1: Combine watermelon, ice, and lime juice, blending until smooth To sweeten, add condensed milk to taste, while blending Pour and serve!

Ingredient Names: banana blossom, salt, oil, onion, garlic, tomatoes, vinegar, salt and pepper, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Discard tough outer layers and slice the blossom thinly, first cutting it in two lengthways if it is large. Step 2: Put the slices in a bowl, sprinkle with a tablespoon of salt, rubbing it well inches leave for 10-15 minutes, squeeze out juices, rinse under cold water and squeeze dry. Step 3: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan and saute onion and garlic until golden brown. Step 4: Add tomato, stir for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add banana blossom and vinegar and bring to the boil. Step 6: Simmer for 5 minutes. Step 7: Taste and add salt and pepper as required. Step 8: Cook until blossom is tender, then stir in coconut milk and remove from heat, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: bananas, coconut milk, granulated sugar, salt, cinnamon stick, coconut, mango
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, heat the coconut milk with the cinnamon, sugar and salt, and cook gently until the sugar has dissolved. Step 2: Add the banana pieces and cook gently for 5 minutes. Step 3: Remove cinnamon and discard. Step 4: Divide the mixture into 6-8 small bowls and serve warm.

Ingredient Names: canned beets, summer squash, garlic, fresh jalapeno pepper, onion, fresh basil, kosher salt, soy sauce, olive oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in stainless steel pot over high heat. Step 2: Add garlic and jalapeno, stir until garlic begins to brown. Step 3: Add soy sauce, beets, squash and salt. Step 4: Add a dash of water, just to keep things moist. Step 5: Stir occasionally, until thickened, about 3-4 minutes. Step 6: Add onion, stir until onion softens slightly. Step 7: Add basil, stir until wilted, about 30 seconds. Step 8: Serve immediately, over rice if you like.

Dish Name: Beans With Ginger And Coconut Milk
Ingredient Names: long beans, oil, fresh lemongrass, fresh ginger, chilies, coconut milk, cabbage
Instructions: Step 1: Cut beans into 5 cm length. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok, add lemon grass, ginger and chilli and cook until oil begins to bubble. Step 3: Stir in the coconut milk and beans, bring to boil then simmer uncovered for about 3 minutes or until the beans are just tender. Step 4: Serve the mixture over cabbage.

Dish Name: Bitter Melon And Eggs Mara Pad Kai
Ingredient Names: bitter melon, eggs, peanut oil, light soy sauce, white pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Cut the bitter melon in half lengthwise, remove the seeds and slice each half crosswise in thin pieces. Step 2: Beat the eggs in a bowl with 1 to 2 tsp of light soy sauce and a dash of ground white pepper. Step 3: Heat a wok until its surface begins to smoke Swirl in the oil and let heat 10 to 15 seconds. Step 4: Add the bitter melon and saut in the oil for about one minute. Step 5: Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of light soy sauce and continue to saut for another 1 to 2 minutes, or until the melon starts to soften. Step 6: Spread the melon pieces thinly over the wok surface. Step 7: Pour the beaten eggs evenly over the melon pieces. Step 8: Let eggs set about half a minute, then flip the mixture over to cook the other side. Step 9: Cook until eggs are set and lightly browned.

Dish Name: Bua Loi Phuak Taro Balls In Coconut Cream
Ingredient Names: taro root, glutinous-rice flour, cornstarch, coconut milk, palm sugar, salt, water
Instructions: Step 1: Put the rice flour and cornstarch in a bowl. Step 2: Add the mashed taro and knead. Step 3: Add water as needed to create a soft dough, knead well. Step 4: Roll into little balls and set aside Dissolve the palm sugar and salt in the coconut milk over low heat, stirring constantly. Step 5: Bring to a boil and add the taro balls. Step 6: When they are cooked through, remove from the heat. Step 7: Serve hot Optional: can sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, sea salt, olive oil, garlic cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, fresh ginger, pecans, turbinado sugar, cilantro, brussels sprout
Instructions: Step 1: Wrap the tofu with paper towels, place a heavy skillet on top and press for a few minutes to remove some of the excess water. Step 2: Cook the tofu strips in hot 12" nonstick skillet with a pinch of salt and about 1-2 teaspoons of oil. Step 3: Saute until lightly golden, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Add the garlic, red pepper flakes, if using, and pecans, and cook for another minute, stir in sugar. Step 5: Cook for a few more minutes. Step 6: Remove from the heat and stir in cilantro Scrape the tofu out onto a plate with a spatula and set aside. Step 7: Now, in the same pan, add 1-1 1 / 2 teaspoons more oil, another pinch of salt, and turn up the heat to medium-high. Step 8: When the pan is hot stir in the sliced brussels sprouts.

Dish Name: Carrot Soup With Coconut And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: butter, onion, salt, carrots, potatoes, fresh cilantro, vegetable stock, coconut milk, orange, limes, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt butter in heavy bottomed saucepan. Step 2: Cook gently on low heat for about 5 minutes to soften without browning. Step 3: Add carrots and potatoes, stir. Step 4: Cover and leave to sweat for 10 minutes. Step 5: Add cilantro, stock or water or water and stock, coconut milk, orange juice, a squeeze of lime, and some salt and pepper. Step 6: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, till the carrots are soft This could take 30-40 minutes depending upon the size of the carrots. Step 7: Let cool, then liquidize in a blender until smooth Reheat gently, stirring, and check seasoning.

Ingredient Names: oil, kaffir lime leaves, chili flakes, roasted cashews, fried shallots, garlic, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, add in the shredded lime leaves and chilli flakes and fry just until the leaves change colour. Step 2: Remove from the heat and drain off any oil you can. Step 3: Add the cashews to the pan and stir over a low heat for a minute or so. Step 4: Remove from the heat and add the shallots, garlic and salt to taste Try to not eat the lot!

Ingredient Names: onion, peanuts, shredded coconut, water, garlic powder, brown sugar, cayenne, soy sauce, lemon juice
Instructions: Step 1: Put all in the ingredients into a blender or food processor, and blend until almost smooth. Step 2: Pour into a small saucepan, cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens May be served warm or cold.

Dish Name: Coco Banana's Thai Green Vegetable Curry
Ingredient Names: basil, coriander, green chilies, ginger, garlic, coconut milk, onion, lemongrass, broccoli, baby corn, zucchini, sweet potato, green beans, snow peas, salt and pepper
Instructions: Step 1: In a blender, combine the basil, coriander, chillis, ginger, garlic and coconut milk You may need to add 1 / 2 cup of water, or more coconut milk if you want it very creamy. Step 2: Blend until very smooth. Step 3: In a pan, combine onion and sweet potato with the herb / coconut mixture. Step 4: Bring to a boil and simmer until the sweet potato has softened a little. Step 5: Add the zucchini baby corn, and cook for 10 minutes. Step 6: Add the broccoli, green beans and snow peas and season to taste. Step 7: Cook until the greens are bright green, serve over rice.

Ingredient Names: water, basmati rice, coconut milk, turmeric, salt, cinnamon stick, raisins
Instructions: Step 1: Bring water to the boil While water heats, rinse the rice well. Step 2: When water boils, stir in the rice and all of the remaining ingredients, return to a boil. Step 3: Stir, cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Step 4: Take off the heat and allow rice to rest for 10 minutes. Step 5: Remove the cinnamon stick, stir to fluff the rice and serve.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, cauliflower floret, vegetable oil, green curry paste, cilantro, chili powder, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Coat the bottom of a thick bottomed skillet with vegetable oil. Step 2: When hot, add the cauliflower florets and fry them until brown, taking care not to burn them. Step 3: Pour in the coconut milk and stir in the curry paste until well integrated. Step 4: Simmer gently until the coconut milk is thick and creamy, about 10 minutes Just before serving add the cilantro and salt to taste.

Ingredient Names: brown rice, light coconut milk, water, green curry paste, lime, scallion, basil, cashews
Instructions: Step 1: Add rice to cooker, stir in coconut milk, 2 sliced lime and curry paste the fill water or broth to marking that corresponds to the number of cups of brown rice used under "brown rice", or use the plastic measuring cup used to measure the rice and add 1-1 / 2 to 2 times the amount of liquid to rice The rice should be completely submerged and leveled to ensure even cooking Close lid securely, plug in the rice cooker and press the cooking switch to start. Step 2: When cooking completes, allow the rice to "rest" for 15 minutes before opening the lid On some advanced models, this is done automatically Open the cooker and use the nonstick rice spatula to fluff remove lime slices and serve your brown rice with garnishes, top with cashews. Step 3: Garnish with remaining lime slices, green onions and or fresh basil.

Ingredient Names: carrots, bell pepper, celery, onion, vegetable broth, broccoli, lemongrass, potatoes, dried shiitake mushrooms, chickpeas, fresh ginger, fish sauce, thai curry paste, soy sauce, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: Heat coconut oil over medium heatdo not let it smokeand add carrots, bell pepper, celery and onion. Step 2: Saute until crisp-tender. Step 3: Add all ingredients, down to and including tamarind paste: broth, broccoli, lemongrass, potatoes, shitakes, chick peas, ginger, fish sauce, curry paste, soy sauce, tamarind paste. Step 4: Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Step 5: Reduce heat to simmer: add remaining ingredients and simmer until potatoes are soft Do taste tests from time to time If the flavor is lacking, add more tamarind, or soy sauce, or fish sauce, or more curry paste if you like it hot! Step 6: You are unlikely to need to salt this soup with all those delicious seasonings If you dont like the veggie-to-broth ration, add more broth. Step 7: Remove lemongrass and serve. Step 8: Put some sriracha on the table for the hot-sauce devotees.

Dish Name: Cold Noodle Salad With Spicy Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: creamy peanut butter, tamari, rice wine vinegar, cayenne, garlic cloves, ginger, water, linguine, sesame oil, carrot, red bell pepper, scallions
Instructions: Step 1: In medium bowl, combine peanut butter, tamari, vinegar, cayenne, garlic and ginger, stirring to blend well. Step 2: Stir in water to make a thick sauce, set aside. Step 3: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente about 10 minutes. Step 4: Drain and rinse pasta under cold water, transfer to large bowl. Step 5: Toss with sesame oil to coat. Step 6: Add carrot, bell pepper, and scallions to the bowl with the linguine. Step 7: Add reserved peanut sauce to coat, tossing gently to combine. Step 8: Refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: mung bean sprouts, rice noodles, fresh lime juice, tomato sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, soy sauce, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, carrots, eggs, salt, peanuts, scallions, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: I find that the dish is very simple to put together once everything is prepped and waiting next to the stove. Step 2: Boil a bit of water and quickly blanch the mung beans for no more than 20 seconds, strain and run cool water across them to protect their crispness. Step 3: Using the same pot, boil the rice noodles for 3 to 5 minutes They should been tender but still have a lot of elasticity to them. Step 4: When cooked, strain and run cool water over them to prevent them from getting gummy Create the sauce in a bowl by combining: lime juice, sugar, soy sauce, chili sauce and tomato sauce. Step 5: Using a large wok, heat the oil and swirl the garlic around for about 20 seconds. Step 6: Add the grated carrots and ginger stir frying them for one minute. Step 7: Using a spatula, push the carrots up along the sides of the wok and pour the eggs into the center Quickly scramble the eggs.

Ingredient Names: vegetable stock, baby carrots, onion, garlic clove, gingerroot, thai red curry paste, salt, silken tofu, mint leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan, bring broth, carrots, onion, garlic and ginger to a boil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes Until carrots are tender. Step 3: Stir in thai curry paste and salt. Step 4: Simmer 1 minute to blend flavors, remove from heat, cool slightly. Step 5: Add tofu to saucepan and puree in soup pot using an immersion hand blender until smooth. Step 6: Serve mint leaves on side Yields about 1 cup per serving.

Ingredient Names: onions, sweet potatoes, carrot, vegetable stock, lemongrass, coriander seed, ground cumin, coconut milk, roasted cashew nuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a large saucepan, fry onions in a small amount of oil for 3-4 minutes until soft. Step 2: Add chopped sweet potato and carrot and fry dry for a further 3-4 minutes. Step 3: Add herbs and spices, stir. Step 4: Add stock and coconut milk and leave to simmer with the pan lid on until vegetables are soft. Step 5: Remove lid and simmer until thickened slightly. Step 6: Take off heat and blend with hand mixer until a smooth consistency. Step 7: Add nuts to serve.

Ingredient Names: distilled white vinegar, superfine sugar, sambal oelek, fresh coriander, cucumbers
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first three ingredients in a small pan over medium heat and heat gently until sugar is dissolved and chili paste is thoroughly mixed. Step 2: Remove from heat and pour into a bowl. Step 3: Allow mixture to cool to room temperature. Step 4: Stir in the coriander and the cucumber and serve immediately Or, store in a well-sealed container in the refrigerator for as long as four days.

Dish Name: Deep Fried Tofu With Asian Plum Sauce Or Thai Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, sesame seeds, cornstarch, flour, sugar, vegetable oil, salt and pepper, plum sauce, peanut sauce, your favorite sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix together sesame seeds, sugar, cornstarch & flour. Step 2: Roll tofu in sesame mixture till well coated. Step 3: Heat oil in skillet till hot. Step 4: Fry squares till well browned. Step 5: Drain on paper towels & set aside. Step 6: Arrange on a platter & serve warm with the sauce.

Dish Name: Delectable Spicy Sweet And Salty Tofu
Ingredient Names: firm tofu, olive oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, asian chili sauce, maple syrup, braggs amino acids, lemon juice, roasted almonds
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium saucepan on medium high heat, saute the tofu in olive oil until browned. Step 2: Reduce the heat to medium low and add the garlic, ginger, and chili sauce. Step 3: Saute for 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the maple syrup, braggs, and lemon juice. Step 5: Cover and cook until the liquid has evaporated. Step 6: Garnish with the roasted almonds Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: light coconut milk, fresh cilantro, red curry paste, curry powder, chili sauce, soy sauce, garlic cloves, extra firm tofu, extra virgin olive oil, baby spinach, red bell pepper, red onion, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Drain tofu and cut into thin slices. Step 2: Heat oil over medium heat. Step 3: Cook tofu in a single layer without stirring about 5 minutes or until slightly browned on bottom, stir gently. Step 4: Then continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thouroughly cooked, about 5-7 minutes While tofu is cooking, prepare sauce by mixing coconut milk, cilantro, curry paste, curry powder, chili sauce, soy sauce, and garlic. Step 5: Add veggies and sauce and cook, stirring, until veggies are barely wilted, about 1-2 minutes. Step 6: Serve with brown rice and garnish with extra cilantro.

Ingredient Names: thai peppers, fresh lime juice, garlic cloves, brown sugar, salt, white vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: Rough chop the chiles and garlic and add all ingredients to food processor and chop away until you get a smooth sauce You can add filtered water to the mixture to get your desired consistency. Step 2: Pour mixture right into jars and leave in fridge It will get better every day until its gone If you have a strainer and dont like texture to your sauce, feel free to get fancy and use it The sauce will keep in your fridge for a month.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sesame seeds, coleslaw mix, firm tofu, peanuts, sweet and sour sauce, rice paper sheets, fresh cilantro, green onion
Instructions: Step 1: For dipping sauce. Step 2: Stir together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and sesame seed in a small bowl and set aside For filling. Step 3: Combine slaw mix, tofu and nuts. Step 4: Add sweet and sour sauce, toss to coat, and set aside To prepare. Step 5: Dip rice papers in a bowl of warm water and drain off excess. Step 6: Place between damp kitchen towels until ready to fill One at a time works best! Step 7: In the center of a rice paper place a cilantro leaf and / or a thin shred of green onion.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, eggs, brown sugar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: Beat the eggs together, 1 at a time Gradually add sugar, milk and salt. Step 3: Beat well In double broiler, stirring constantly, cook mixture until soft and texture resembles scrambled eggs. Step 4: Pour mixture in a small casserole dish and bake 1 / 2 hour. Step 5: When baked, brown custard under broiler.

Dish Name: Easy Thai Ish Noodles And Vegetables
Ingredient Names: chunky peanut butter, soy sauce, tomato puree, dry sherry, lime, fresh lime juice, brown sugar, chili paste with garlic, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, peanuts, scallions, red bell pepper, snow peas, mushrooms
Instructions: Step 1: I use whole wheat spaghetti To make sauce: place peanut butter in medium-sized bowl With fork stir in soy sauce, tomato sauce / puree, sherry, lime zest, lime juice, brown sugar, and chili paste. Step 2: Heat oil in small saucepan over medium heat. Step 3: Add the garlic and cook 1 minute. Step 4: Stir in the peanut sauce and keep warm over low heat Do not let the sauce simmer (or, heavens forbid, boil -- it will be too thick to use Just keep it warm. Step 5: Combine the vegetables and peanuts in a bowl and set aside. Step 6: Cook your pasta of choice according to directions.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, frozen edamame, sesame oil, green onions, mung bean sprouts, red bell pepper, zucchini, carrots, portabella mushroom, peanuts, braggs liquid aminos, rice wine vinegar, honey, garlic clove, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare rice noodles according to package directions, adding edamame for the last 4-5 minutes of cooking time, drain. Step 2: Meanwhile, in a large wok or pan, sautee the the veggies and peanuts in the oil. Step 3: Whisk the remaining ingredients together in a medium bowl to form the sauce. Step 4: Toss the noodles, veggies and sauce together. Step 5: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: shallot, lemongrass, red chilies, garlic cloves, fresh gingerroot, lime, fresh coriander leaves, tofu, eggplant, peanut oil, wooden skewers, ground cumin, ground coriander, crunchy peanut butter, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Curry paste: Grind all the ingredients together until you have a paste. Step 2: Store in the refrigerator in a screw top jar for up to 2 weeks Skewers: Mix 3 tbsp green curry paste together with 1 tbsp groundnut oil. Step 3: Cut the tofu and eggplant into 1 / 2 inch cubes and thread onto 12 short wooden skewers Lay flat on a plate and pour over the paste mixture to coat well, rubbing the eggplant and tofu all over. Step 4: Leave for 30 minutes minimum, covered in the fridge to marinade. Step 5: Brush the vegetables with a the remaining oil and grill under a medium heat until golden Satay sauce:.

Ingredient Names: miso, soy sauce, dry sherry, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, pepper, japanese eggplants, cornstarch, water, toasted sesame oil, olive oil, chili oil, garlic cloves, gingerroot, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Mix the seasonings in a bowl until the sugar is dissolved and set aside. Step 2: Rinse and dry the eggplant and cut off stems Don't peel Quarter them lengthwise and cut each quarter into 2-inch wedges, set aside. Step 3: In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch with the water and sesame oil, set aside. Step 4: Heat a large, heavy skillet over high heat for 30 seconds. Step 5: Add the olive oil with the chili-pepper oil, swirl, and heat for 30 seconds Throw in the garlic, ginger, and scallions and stir rapidly for 15 seconds.

Ingredient Names: shallot, fresh ginger, garlic, vegetable broth, coconut milk, cilantro, lemon, chili sauce, soy sauce, fresh spinach leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Saute shallot, garlic and ginger in a small amount of vegetable oil. Step 2: Add coconut milk and vegetable broth, bring to a boil. Step 3: Turn down to simmer. Step 4: Add cilantro, lemon juice, chili sauce, soy sauce and vegetables. Step 5: Simmer until spinach is wilted and veggies are tender but not limp, approximately 5 minutes, serve with rice.

Ingredient Names: duck breasts total, green thai curry paste, light brown sugar, coconut milk, fish sauce, limes, lime leaves left, french beans, fresh bean sprouts, fresh cilantro, red chile
Instructions: Step 1: Place a sauté pan over a low heat and add the duck breasts, skin-side down, to the dry pan. Slowly fry until the skin is brown and a lot of the fat has rendered off – this can take about 20 mins. Flip them over to seal the other side for 1 min, then remove to a board until cool enough to handle. Pour all but 2 tbsp of the fat from the pan. Step 2: While the meat is resting, return the pan to the heat, then fry the curry paste and sugar for 1-2 mins until it becomes fragrant. Tip in the coconut milk, then fill the can with water and add this, too. Add the fish sauce, half the lime juice and the whole lime leaves, then bring to a simmer. Slice the duck breasts, then tip into the curry. Cover the pan, then simmer everything on the lowest heat for 1 hr until the duck is tender. Add the beans to the curry, then continue to cook, covered, for 10 mins until the beans are tender with a slight crunch. Taste and add more lime juice, fish sauce or sugar to season. Step 3: Stir in the bean sprouts, cook for 1 min more, then serve with coriander, shredded lime leaves and sliced chilli, if you like, and boiled jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Fried Tofu With Sweet And Sour Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: fried tofu, seasoned rice vinegar, sugar, salt, red pepper flakes, peanuts, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, heat water over medium high heat. Step 2: Once water begins to boil, add the tofu This will rinse the frying oil off and bring the tofu to room temperature. Step 3: Boil for 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Remove tofu from the water and drain the saucepan. Step 5: Place tofu on a towel to dry. Step 6: Return the saucepan to the stove and add the vinegar, sugar, and salt to it. Step 7: Simmer until it reaches a slightly syrupy consistency, stirring often. Step 8: Remove from heat and add remaining ingrediants. Step 9: Serve in a small dipping bowl alongside tofu.

Dish Name: Fried Tofu With Tangy Chilli Dressing
Ingredient Names: firm silken tofu, flour, vegetable oil, rice wine vinegar, garlic, salt, sugar, chili paste, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu into six slices after taking out of pack and draining excess water. Step 2: Heat oil in saucepan. Step 3: Cover tofu with flour, make sure all sides are covered. Step 4: Fry until golden brown. Step 5: Mix garlic, chilli, vinegar, sugar and salt together in small bowl. Step 6: Add water to sauce and stir thoroughly. Step 7: Drain tofu and serve with sauce.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, shallots, crunchy peanut butter, light brown sugar, soy sauce, pineapple, lime, red chili pepper, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a little oil in a frying pan and fry the shallots until they brown. Step 2: Reduce the heat and add the peanut butter, sugar and soy sauce and stir until the sugar has melted The mixture should be sweet and salty so add a little salt if you need to, cool. Step 3: Arrange the pineapple cubes on a plate and put a heaped tsp of mixture on each. Step 4: Top each with a squeeze of lime, a piece of chili and a cilantro leaf.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, salt, jasmine rice, water
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice with water until water runs clear. Step 2: Heat butter or oil in pan over medium to low heat. Step 3: Saute garlic, ginger & salt for about a minute at most or until fragrant. Step 4: Add rice and stir well, add liquid, bring to a boil. Step 5: Cover, reduce heat, simmer about 15 minutes or until water is absorbed and rice tender.

Dish Name: Green Beans Tofu With Crunchy Thai Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: unsalted peanuts, peanut oil, fresh ginger, garlic, lemon zest, firm tofu, salt, fresh lemon juice, fresh green beans, red pepper flakes, peanut butter, hot water, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar
Instructions: Step 1: For the stir-fry: Place the peanuts in a blender, and grind briefly until they form a coarse meal, set aside. Step 2: Heat a medium-sized heavy skillet. Step 3: Add 1 tablespoon of the oil, and the ginger and garlic Saut for a few minutes, then add the crushed peanuts and the lemon zest. Step 4: Cook over medium-low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the peanuts are lightly toasted. Step 5: Remove from heat and set aside As the peanut mixture is cooking, heat a large, nonstick wok or deep skillet. Step 6: Drizzle in a little oil.

Ingredient Names: pineapple, sweet red pepper, red onion, coriander, mint, granulated sugar, vegetable oil, lime juice, fish sauce, garlic clove, hot pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Dressing: in a small saucepan, heat sugar, oil, lime juice, fish sauce, garlic and hot pepper sauce over medium heat, stirring occasionally, just until sugar is dissolved. Step 2: Let cool completely With a sharp knife, cut off crown and base of pineapple, cut off skin With. Step 3: Place on greased grill over medium heat Close lid and cook, turning once for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender and browned, let cool. Step 4: Cut each slice into quarters, trimming off core. Step 5: Place in large bowl.

Ingredient Names: zucchini, summer squash, reduced-sodium vegetable broth, lime juice, of fresh mint, fresh basil, gingerroot, jalapeno, reduced sodium soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place zucchini and squash in square baking dish 8 8 2 inches. Step 2: Mix remaining ingredients. Step 3: Pour over vegetables. Step 4: Cover and let stand at least 1 hour but no longer than 2 hours. Step 5: Heat coals or gas grill. Step 6: Remove vegetables from marinade Reserve marinade. Step 7: Cover and grill vegetables 4 inches from medium heat 10 to 15 minutes, turning and brushing 2 or 3 times with marinade, until golden brown and tender. Step 8: Cut each crosswise into 4 pieces. Step 9: Toss with any remaining marinade.

Ingredient Names: red chile, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, vinegar, sugar, salt, lime zest
Instructions: Step 1: Blend the chillies, garlic, ginger and lemon grass in a food processor or mortar and pestle While processing gradually add the vinegar. Step 2: Place the pureed mixture into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 3: Reduce the heat and simmer for 3 minutes. Step 4: Add the sugar and stir until dissolved. Step 5: Add the salt and lime zest. Step 6: Remove from the heat, cool and bottle in sterilised jars.

Ingredient Names: red chilies, chilies, onion, garlic cloves, sunflower oil, sugar, white vinegar, thai fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place chillies, onions and garlic in food processor Process to rough textured paste. Step 2: Heat oil in saucepan. Step 3: Add chilli mixture. Step 4: Cook over medium low heat for 10 minutes till soft but not browned. Step 5: Add sugar and vinegar, bring to the boil. Step 6: Stir till sugar dissolves. Step 7: Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes till it is reduced and syrupy. Step 8: Season with fish sauce to taste. Step 9: Pour into clean glass bottles, seal tightly.

Dish Name: Hot And Sour Mushroom Soup Tom Yum Het
Ingredient Names: water, onion, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, fresh ginger, tamarind pulp, dried red chilies, hot green chili peppers, vegetable oil, tom yum paste, fried tofu, shiitake mushrooms, button mushrooms, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put the first nine ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Step 2: Simmer for 15-20 minutes over low-medium heat. Step 3: Remove from the heat and strain Reserve the stock and discard the rest. Step 4: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and saut the soup paste for a minute until fragrant. Step 5: Add the tofu, shiitake and button mushrooms and stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute. Step 6: Bring the prepared stock to a boil. Step 7: Turn the heat to medium and add the sauted tofu and mushrooms, the soy sauce, sugar and lemon juice. Step 8: Simmer for 5-6 minutes over medium heat until the mushrooms are tender. Step 9: Sprinkle the coriander and basil and remove from heat.

Ingredient Names: thai red chili peppers, garlic cloves, lemongrass, galangal, red onion, salt, ground coriander, vegetable oil, baby sweet corn cobs, red bell peppers, fresh green beans, fresh button mushrooms, broccoli, vegetable stock, dark soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare curry paste by mixing in a food processor or blender. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok or deep skillet and add curry paste, cooking until fragrant. Step 3: Add vegetables, coating thoroughly with curry paste, and cooking until almost crisp-tender. Step 4: Add stock, soy sauce, lime leaves, sugar, and salt. Step 5: Cook until vegetables are done to your liking. Step 6: Serve garnished with cilantro and sliced chiles, over steamed rice or noodles.

Ingredient Names: pineapple juice, peanut butter, garlic, sweet chili sauce, soya sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put everything in a pan Stir over medium heat until it is smooth If it is too thick, add a little water Or if you want it creamier, add a little coconut milk.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, shallots, ground coriander, cumin powder, red chili paste, soy sauce, water, lemon juice, lemon, brown sugar, vegetable oil, salt, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Cut tofu into slices of the size you desire. Step 2: Mix together garlic, ginger, shallots, coriander powder, cumin, chilli paste, soy sauce, water, lemon juice, lemon rind, sugar, 1 tablespoon of the oil, and the salt in a dish to make a marinade, stir it well. Step 3: Place the tofu in the marinade, making sure each piece is well coated. Step 4: Cover and leave in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Step 5: Heat a frying pan to medium-hot and put the rest of the oil in it. Step 6: Take the tofu out of the dish, letting excess marinade drip back into the dish Do not discard the leftover marinade! Step 7: Cook tofu in pan for 5 to 10 minutes, until nicely browned. Step 8: When the tofu is cooked, put it aside and keep it warm. Step 9: Turn the heat down to medium-low and pour the leftover marinade into it.

Ingredient Names: lemongrass, water, sugar, ice cubes
Instructions: Step 1: Slice the lemongrass into rings, and place into a pot with the water, leaving enough room to boil. Step 2: Boil 10-15 minutes, depending on how strong you like your tea. Step 3: Add the sugar to the just boiled water, then pour into a pitcher over ice cubes.

Ingredient Names: iceberg lettuce, garlic cloves, galangal, red chile, shallots, firm tofu, carrot, shiitake mushrooms, egg, cabbage, spring onions, mixed sprouts, lime juice, soy sauce, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Place oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add garlic, galangal, chilli, and shallots. Step 3: Stir-fry one minute, or until fragrant, stir-frying. Step 4: Add tofu, carrot, shiitake mushrooms, cabbage, and spring onions As you stir-fry, add the lime juice, soy sauce, fish sauce, and oyster sauce. Step 5: Stir-fry about 1 minute Push ingredients to the side of the wok or pan, and crack in the egg. Step 6: Stir-fry the egg quickly, breaking the yolk. Step 7: Mix in with the other ingredients.

Ingredient Names: fresh mango, lime, unsweetened coconut milk, sugar-free honey, vanilla
Instructions: Step 1: Puree in food processor Chill Freeze in ice cream maker according to your machine's directions.

Dish Name: Mango Summer Rolls Thai Dipping Sauce
Ingredient Names: mango, seedless cucumber, fresh cilantro leaves, rice noodles, peanuts, rice paper sheets, rice vinegar, water, chili oil, garlic clove, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Mango summer rolls: Boil a medium-sized pot of water. Step 2: Turn off heat and add the rice noodles. Step 3: Let them soak for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Drain the noodles and run them under cold water. Step 5: Set aside in separate bowl. Step 6: Fill pie pan or large wide bowl with hot tap water. Step 7: Place the rice paper wrappers, two at a time, into the water until they are flexible Carefully remove wrappers from water and lay flat on clean surface In the lower two-thirds of the wrapper, place a tablespoon of the noodles and 1 / 2 teaspoon of chopped peanuts.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, potatoes, roasted peanuts, onion, water, brown sugar, salt, cardamom pods, coriander seed, cumin seed, cloves, red chilies, garlic cloves, ground cinnamon, gingerroot
Instructions: Step 1: First make the paste Crack the cardamom pods and remove the seeds Dry fry the seeds with the cumin, cloves and coriander for 2 minutes place these in a processor and grind, add all the other paste ingredients and process until they come together as a paste. Step 2: Heat the coconut milk in a large pan and add 2 tbsp of the paste. Step 3: Mix and heat until simmering. Step 4: Turn down heat and add spuds to cook for 6 minutes. Step 5: Add peanuts, onion, water sugar and salt, stir well until all ingredients are mixed and dissolved. Step 6: Simmer until the potatoes are tender. Step 7: Serve with rice or naan bread.

Dish Name: Mediterranean Thai Eggplant White Bean Soup
Ingredient Names: globe eggplant, yellow onion, garlic, scallions, white beans, fresh basil, red pepper, coconut milk, vegetable broth, dry sherry, soy sauce, fish sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Cut the ends off the eggplant then cut the eggplant lengthwise Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray and lay the eggplant pieces cut-side-down on the sheet. Step 3: Bake the eggplant in the oven for 45 minutes While eggplant is baking, grate half of the onion and chop the other half. Step 4: When the eggplant is done, take one half and simply scoop out the soft inner parts The other half you want to cut into chunky cubes, turn off the oven. Step 5: In a food processor, put half of the white beans, half of the chopped basil, the chopped onion, the garlic, half of the chopped scallions, and the half of the eggplant that you scooped out Whir the mixture until it is smooth.

Ingredient Names: cucumber, limes, white vinegar, superfine sugar, mint leaf, chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Finely slice half of the cucumber into a large bowl. Step 2: Cut the skin off the lime, then cut out the segments. Step 3: Add these to the bowl and squeeze any juice out of the bit left in the middle. Step 4: Add the vinegar and sugar, cover and leave in the fridge. Step 5: When ready to serve, slice and add the remaining cucumber, the mint and the chili and toss together. Step 6: Season with salt and a touch more vinegar if you like.

Ingredient Names: chinese egg noodles, vegetable oil, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, orange, frozen orange juice concentrate, soy sauce, hot chili sauce, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In a stockpot over high heat, bring about 8 cups of water to a boil. Step 2: Add the noodles and cook until al dente, 7 to 10 minutes. Step 3: Drain well and place in large bowl, set aside. Step 4: In a bowl, whisk together the remaining ingredients. Step 5: Pour the dressing over the noodles and toss well. Step 6: Let sit at least 10 minutes before serving. Step 7: Garnish with chopped scallions, if using.

Ingredient Names: oranges, sugar, water, rose water, ice
Instructions: Step 1: Peel and segment all the oranges. Step 2: Place oranges in a bowl, cover, and refrigerate. Step 3: Mix water and sugar in a saucepan and bring to a boil on medium-high heat. Step 4: Stir until sugar dissolves. Step 5: Boil gently for about 10 minutes. Step 6: Stir in rose water and remove from heat. Step 7: Cool and refrigerate for 30 minutes or more To serve place oranges in individual serving bowls, pour rose water syrup on top and add some crushed ice.

Dish Name: Oranges With Star Anise Thai Style
Ingredient Names: water, white sugar, star anise pods, orange blossom water, oranges, mint sprig
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the water, sugar and star anise pods in a medium saucepan. Step 2: Stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves. Step 3: Simmer the liquid until it is reduced to a generous 1 cup This will take about 15 minutes. Step 4: Remove pan from heat and stir in the orange blossom flower water. Step 5: Remove star anise and set aside. Step 6: Cover liquid and chill until cold Use a sharp knife and cut off the orange peel and white pith. Step 7: Slice oranges crosswise into 1 / 3" rounds. Step 8: Set the oranges slices on a platter and pour the syrup over them.

Ingredient Names: red bell pepper, green onion, thai basil, firm tofu, coconut milk, panang curry paste, sugar, vegetable oil, salt, pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Step 2: Heat oil in a frying pan and saut bell pepper, onion for 5 minutes. Step 3: In a blender or food processor, blend tofu, coconut milk, curry paste, sugar, salt and pepper until smooth. Step 4: Pour mixture into a souffl dish or small casserole and add peppers, onions and basil. Step 5: Place dish in a roasting pan that is filled half way with water. Step 6: Bake for 30-45 minutes or until souffl is firm and top is golden brown. Step 7: Serve with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Paul Gayler's Thai Inspired Risotto With Pumpkin
Ingredient Names: margarine, onion, garlic, lemongrass, red chile, curry powder, fresh gingerroot, pumpkin, arborio rice, dry white wine, vegetable stock, coconut milk, of fresh mint, fresh coriander, salt & freshly ground black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Melt the margarine in a large heavy bottomed pan. Step 2: Add the onion, garlic, lemongrass, chili, curry powder and ginger and cook, stirring over a low heat for 5 minutes. Step 3: Add the pumpkin and rice and cook for 1 minute more. Step 4: Pour in the wine and a ladle full of stock and cook, stirring, until the liquid is absorbed. Step 5: Keep adding the stock, a ladle full at a time, stirring continuously, until the rice is tender, but al dente, about 25 minutes Towards the end of cooking, add the stock in smaller quantities and check frequently to see if the rice is cooked. Step 6: Add the coconut milk, mint, and coriander. Step 7: Remove from the heat, season and sprinkle with grated coconut to serve.

Ingredient Names: water, natural-style peanut butter, rice vinegar, soy sauce, honey, minced ginger, garlic cloves, chili sauce, extra firm tofu, extra virgin olive oil, baby spinach, sliced mushrooms, red onion, cooked brown rice
Instructions: Step 1: Drain tofu and cut into small slices. Step 2: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add tofu and cook in a single layer about 5 minutes or until browned slightly on bottom. Step 4: Then stir and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until thouroughly cooked While tofu cooks, prepare sauce by mixing water, peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, and chili sauce. Step 5: Whisk in a small bowl until well-mixed. Step 6: Add vegetables and sauce to skillet. Step 7: Cook, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes or until vegetables are lightly steamed. Step 8: Serve with brown rice.

Ingredient Names: oil, chili pepper flakes, green onions, red curry paste, kaffir lime leaves, coconut milk, crunchy peanut butter, palm sugar, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil and carefully fry the dried chilli flakes on low heat. Step 2: Add the spring onion, red curry paste and lime leaves and cook until fragrant. Step 3: Stir in 1 cup of coconut milk, the peanut butter and sugar. Step 4: Bring to the boil, stirring, and add the lime juice. Step 5: Thin to desired consistency with remaining coconut milk.

Ingredient Names: sunflower oil, thai yellow curry paste, onions, lemongrass back knife, cardamom pods, mustard seed, pumpkin, vegetable stock, reduced-fat coconut milk, chickpeas, limes, mint leaves, naan bread
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a sauté pan, then gently fry the curry paste with the onions, lemongrass, cardamom and mustard seed for 2-3 mins until fragrant. Stir the pumpkin or squash into the pan and coat in the paste, then pour in the stock and coconut milk. Bring everything to a simmer, add the chickpeas, then cook for about 10 mins until the pumpkin is tender. The curry can now be cooled and frozen for up to 1 month. Step 2: Squeeze the juice of one lime into the curry, then cut the other lime into wedges to serve alongside. Just before serving, tear over mint leaves, then bring to the table with the lime wedges and warm naan breads.

Ingredient Names: water, cardamom, artificial sweetener, soymilk, tea bags
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, all water, cardamom, sweetener, and milk and bring to a boil Remove from heat and add tea bags Let steep 3-10 minutes before serving.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, extra firm tofu, sweet potato, light coconut milk, vegetable broth, thai red curry paste, green beans, brown sugar, lime juice, salt, fresh cilantro, lime
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add the tofu and cook, stirring every 2-3 minutes, until browned, about 6-8 minutes total. Step 3: Transfer to a plate. Step 4: Heat the remaining 2 teaspoons oil over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add sweet potato and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Step 6: Add coconut milk, broth and curry paste to taste, bring to a boil. Step 7: Reduce to a simmer and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until the sweet potato is just tender, about 4 minutes. Step 8: Add the tofu, green beans and brown sugar. Step 9: Return to a simmer and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until the green beans are tender-crisp, 2 to 4 minutes.

Ingredient Names: lean ground beef, red chilies, thumb-size ginger, eggs, sunflower, thai red curry paste depending how spicy you like it, reduced-fat coconut milk, bamboo shoots, fine green beans, limes, fresh basil, basmati rice
Instructions: Step 1: Put the mince into a large bowl with the chopped chilli, ginger and egg, then season generously. Mix well with your hands, then shape into 20 meatballs. Can be made and chilled up to a day ahead. Step 2: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan, then brown the meatballs for 5 mins. Tip onto a plate. Add the curry paste, fry for 1 min, then pour in the coconut milk and half a can of water. Bring back to the boil and stir to make a smooth sauce. Step 3: Return the meatballs to the pan with the bamboo shoots and beans. Simmer for 5 mins until the beans are just tender and meatballs cooked through. To serve, season the sauce with salt, pepper and lime juice, then tear in the basil leaves. Scatter with sliced chilli and serve with rice or noodles and more lime wedges for squeezing over.

Dish Name: Rice Noodles With Coconut Cashew Sauce
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, water, fresh ginger, lime juice, serrano chilies, garlic, ground coriander, fresh cilantro leaves, fresh mint leaves, salt, sugar, cashews, rice noodles, green onions, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the coconut milk and water in a medium-sized saucepan. Step 2: Add the ginger, lime juice, chilies, garlic, coriander, cilantro, mint, and salt, and bring to a boil. Step 3: Lower the heat to a simmer, and cook uncovered for 10 minutes. Step 4: Remove from the heat and stir in the sugar At this point, you can let the sauce steep for a stronger flavor for a few hours, or even overnight, or continue on with the recipe. Step 5: Strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a bowl. Step 6: Press all the liquid from the garlic, ginger, cilantro, etc, then discard the solids that remain in the sieve. Step 7: Place the cashews in a blender, and then pour in the coconut milk mixture. Step 8: Puree until smooth.

Dish Name: Rice Noodles With Ginger And Snow Peas
Ingredient Names: rice noodles, hot water, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic, scallions, fresh green chile, carrot, snow peas, salt, sesame oil, hot chili oil, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Soak or prepare the rice noodles according to the package directions. Step 2: Drain and set aside. Step 3: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, and cook the ginger and garlic, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes. Step 4: Add the scallions, chili, carrots and snow peas. Step 5: Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes, stir in the salt. Step 6: Add the noodles and toss to coat. Step 7: Remove from the heat. Step 8: Stir in the sesame and chili oil. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro or parsley.

Ingredient Names: eggs, low-fat coconut milk, cilantro, ginger, cooked rice, green onion, unsalted peanuts, all-purpose flour, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk eggs and milk in large bowl. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients, plus some salt and pepper, if desired Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Step 3: Drop 1 / 4c batter into the skillet and smooth it down with a spatula. Step 4: Cook 4-5 minutes, until bottoms are golden-brown, then flip pancakes. Step 5: Let cook for another 3-4 minutes, then remove when both sides are browned and crispy. Step 6: Repeat with remaining batter.

Dish Name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts With Sriracha Aioli
Ingredient Names: brussels sprout, olive oil, salt and pepper, mayonnaise, sriracha sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350. Step 2: In a baking dish add the brussels sprouts and toss with olive oil until well coated and season with salt and pepper. Step 3: Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, so the brussels are still firm. Step 4: Serve with dipping sauce as a main dish or appetizer Sriracha aioli: Mix the ingredients in a small bowl and let sit in refrigerator until ready to use.

Dish Name: Roasted Eggplant Dip With Thai Flavors
Ingredient Names: eggplant, palm sugar, soy sauce, salt, chili paste, lime juice, fresh cilantro, green onions, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f Lightly grease a baking sheet. Step 2: Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise, stem and all, and place on baking sheet, cut side down. Step 3: Bake until soft, about 30 minutes. Step 4: Cool to room temperature Scoop out the flesh and transfer it to a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Step 5: Add the sugar soy sauce, salt, chili paste, and lime or lemon juice. Step 6: Using on-off pulses, process to a thick, coarse puree, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed to grind evenly. Step 7: Transfer to a bowl and stir in the chopped cilantro and green onions. Step 8: Serve at room temp, garnished with cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: head cauliflower, fish sauce, olive oil, peanut sauce mix
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 450 f. Step 2: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Step 3: In a large bowl mix olive oil and fish sauce Core cauliflower and break into bite size flowerettes. Step 4: Toss the cauliflower with the oil / fish sauce mix until pieces are coated. Step 5: Add the peanut sauce mix and mix together until cauliflower is covered. Step 6: Spread cauliflower on cookie sheet in a single layer Roast for 20 minutes or until cauliflower is tender crisp and edges are. Step 7: Serve as an appetizer with toothpicks or as a vegetable side.

Dish Name: Salad Topper By Fresh Use W Tangled Thai Salad Zwt 9
Ingredient Names: puffed quinoa, goji berry, currants, sliced almonds, hazelnuts, pistachios, sea salt
Instructions: Step 1: Put all of the ingredients in a bowl, mix well & store in an airtight container To serve: sprinkle 2 tbsp of mixture atop the tangled thai salad or other salad of choice.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, japanese eggplants, water, sesame seeds, rice vinegar, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, sugar, minced ginger, garlic, asian chili sauce, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: Place wok or skillet over high heat, when hot, add 2tbs oil and swirl to coat the pan. Step 2: When hot but not smoking, about 1 minute, add eggplant, stir fry about 1 minute. Step 3: Add water, or more as needed, and continue to stir-fry moving pan off and on the heat as necessary to prevent scorching, until water evaporates and eggplant is tender when pierced, about 5 minutes. Step 4: Transfer to a bowl and let cool to room temperature. Step 5: Mix all dressing ingredients in a bowl, whisk to blend. Step 6: Pour over cooled eggplant and toss to coat well To serve, mound on a serving plate and garnish with onions.

Ingredient Names: medium egg noodles, vegetable oil, onion, red chile, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, ground coriander, turmeric, lemongrass, coconut milk, vegetable stock, cabbage, green beans, mushrooms, unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Place noodles in a bowl and cover with boiling water, leave to stand. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok and gently fry the onion, chilli, garlic, coriander, ginger, turmeric and lemongrass for 5 minutes. Step 3: Pour coconut milk and stock into the wok and just bring to the boil. Step 4: Turn down heat and add the vegetables and drained noodles. Step 5: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the peanuts and serve.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, kosher salt, rice vinegar, water, sugar, crushed red pepper flakes, red onions, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Place the cucumber slices in a colander. Step 2: Sprinkle with salt, toss well, drain 1 hour. Step 3: Place cucumber slices on several layers of paper towels. Step 4: Cover with additional paper towels. Step 5: Let stand 5 minutes, pressing down occasionally, rinse and pat dry. Step 6: Combine vinegar, water, sugar, and pepper in a small saucepan, bring to a boil.

Ingredient Names: frozen corn, red bell pepper, red onion, fresh cilantro, lime juice, thai sweet chili sauce, sugar, cucumber, bean sprouts, snow peas, beans
Instructions: Step 1: Bring a saucepan of water to boil on high heat, add corn. Step 2: Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through, drain well. Step 3: Place corn in a large bowl. Step 4: Add bell pepper, red onion and cilantro, toss well. Step 5: Mix lime juice, chili sauce and sugar in small bowl until sugar is dissolved. Step 6: Pour over the corn, toss well.

Ingredient Names: creamy peanut butter, vegetable broth, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, crushed red pepper flakes, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, whisk the peanut butter, vegetable broth and soy sauce until smooth Stir in the remaining ingredients Dip away.

Ingredient Names: grapeseed oil, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, red onion, garlic cloves, red curry paste, peanut butter, coconut milk, frozen green pea
Instructions: Step 1: Heat a skillet over medium high heat, add 1 tsp oil, the peppers and onion, saut for 3-4 minutes, just until slightly tender. Step 2: Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Step 3: Transfer vegetables to a bowl and set aside. Step 4: Add 1 tsp of oil back to the same pan and add the red curry paste. Step 5: Cook for 30 seconds and then add peanut butter and pour in the coconut milk, continue whisking. Step 6: Add the bowl of vegetables, frozen peas and lime juice back to the pan and stir. Step 7: Cook 1 minute done!

Dish Name: Spoon It Up Zesty Hoisin Chili Sauce
Ingredient Names: soy sauce, dark sesame oil, hoisin sauce, honey, thai sweet chili sauce, orange zest, ginger, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Stir all of the ingredients together in a bowl. Step 2: Taste and adjust seasoning to your liking Use as a sauce over salmon or other fish, dumplings and potstickers, as a marinade or sauce for fish, tofu or tempeh, and with grilled veggies, especially eggplant!, enjoy!

Ingredient Names: kosher salt, sriracha sauce, granulated garlic
Instructions: Step 1: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Step 2: Mix the salt, sriracha sauce and granulated garlic in a bowl. Step 3: Spread the mixture out thinly on a baking sheet and allow it to dry slowly, uncovered for a day or two, stirring once or twice during the process It can then be stored for future use in an airtight container at room temperature Quicker method: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 4: Spread the mixture out thinly on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Step 5: Put the baking sheet in the oven and turn off the heat immediately. Step 6: Allow the salt to sit in the residual heat until completely dry, usually within 2-3 hours If mixture clumps just put in a plastic bag and run a rolling pin or round glass jar over to break up clumps.

Dish Name: Sticky Rice With Mango And Lime
Ingredient Names: glutinous rice, water, coconut cream, sugar, banana leaves, mango, lime rind, lime juice, palm sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse rice well under cold water, then drain. Step 2: Place rice and water in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to the boil. Step 3: Allow rice to simmer until almost all liquid has been absorbed. Step 4: Remove pan from heat and pour coconut cream over rice. Step 5: Cover rice and allow to stand for 5-7 minutes or until coconut cream has been absorbed. Step 6: Stir sugar through rice and set aside. Step 7: Place banana leaves in boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until they are soft. Step 8: Divide rice into 6 portions. Step 9: Spread half of each portion over the middle of the banana leaf. Step 10: Top rice with a sprinkling of mango, lime rind and juice, and palm sugar.

Dish Name: Stir Fried Noodles With Tofu Scallions And Peanuts
Ingredient Names: wide rice noodles, soy sauce, molasses, rice vinegar, ketchup, fresh ginger, kosher salt, cayenne pepper, vegetable oil, garlic, extra firm tofu, bean sprouts, scallions, egg, unsalted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the dried rice noodles in a bowl of very warm water until they're pliable, but still rather firm, about 30 minutes. Step 2: Drain in a colander - no need to pat dry. Step 3: Meanwhile prep the rest of the ingredients. Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, molasses, rice vinegar, ketchup, ginger, salt and cayenne. Step 5: Once the noodles are drained, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet or stir-fry pan over high heat until very hot. Step 6: Add the garlic, stir, and then immediately add the soy sauce-molasses mixture. Step 7: When the mixture is bubbling, add the tofu. Step 8: Stir briefly to combine. Step 9: Add the noodles and cook, stirring and tossing, until the noodles are tender and the liquid is absorbed, 1 to 2 minutes If the noodles aren't tender and the liquid is gone, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of water.

Ingredient Names: white sugar, distilled white vinegar, soy sauce, tamarind pulp, dried rice noodles, vegetable oil, garlic, eggs, firm tofu, salt, peanuts, ground dried oriental radish, fresh chives, paprika, fresh bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Begin soaking rice noodles in cold water. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, and tamarind pulp. Step 3: Heat sauce over medium to low heat until pulp is dissolved. Step 4: Drain noodles once they become soft Over medium-high heat, warm up a large wok, add and heat up the oil, add garlic and eggs, and cook until eggs are scrambled. Step 5: Add tofu and stir until mixed. Step 6: Add noodles and continue stirring until noodles are cooked. Step 7: Stir in sauce, the 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of sugar, and salt until mixed. Step 8: Stir in peanuts and ground radish. Step 9: Remove from heat and stir in chives and paprika.

Ingredient Names: spaghetti, peanut butter, rice vinegar, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, garlic clove, gingerroot, water
Instructions: Step 1: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Step 2: Place the other ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and microwave for 1 minute. Step 3: Stir hot peanut sauce with a fork until combined and glossy - aboout 1-2 minutes and if necessary thin with more water. Step 4: Combine with hot pasta and serve.

Ingredient Names: unbleached cane sugar, water, white vinegar, garlic, salt, hot chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, comine the sugar, water, vinegar, garlic and salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Turn to medium-low and keep cooking until the sauce is a little syrupy. Step 4: Remove from heat and add the chili sauce--mix well It will turn a nice amber-orange. Step 5: Let cool to room temperature, then keep refrigerate in an airtight jar for up to three weeks. Step 6: When using, heat a little bit until it thins to a slightly syrupy consistency.

Dish Name: Sweet And Spicy Tofu W Veggies
Ingredient Names: extra firm tofu, mixed vegetables, onion, olive oil, sesame oil, water, low sodium soy sauce, asian chili sauce, brown sugar, peanut butter, rice
Instructions: Step 1: Prepare tofu - drain all water out and cut into 1" cubes. Step 2: Make sauce with water, soy sauce, hot sauce, brown sugar and peanut butter. Step 3: Stir well and set aside. Step 4: Heat a skillet on medium / medium high and add vegetable oil and sesame oil. Step 5: Toss in chopped onions and saute until almost golden brown. Step 6: Add other veggies if you wanted to have other veggies in your recipe. Step 7: Add tofu and stir occasionally until brown on some sides. Step 8: Add sauce and simmer for 5-10 minutes. Step 9: Serve with rice, noodles or eat by itself Enjoy!

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, onion, garlic clove, fresh ginger, sweet potatoes, lemongrass, vegetable stock, coconut cream, limes
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and gently fry the onion, garlic and ginger for about 5 minutes until tender. Step 2: Add the sweet potatoes and lemon grass and cook for a further 3 minutes. Step 3: Add the stock and bring to the boil. Step 4: Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Step 5: Cool the soup slightly, then liquidise with half of the coconut cream and process until smooth. Step 6: Return the soup to the saucepan, add the remaining coconut cream And season with salt and pepper. Step 7: Heat through without allowing the soup to boil, and add the lime juice Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with the lime zest.

Dish Name: Sweet Potato Ginger And Coconut Soup
Ingredient Names: fresh gingerroot, garlic clove, olive oil, dry chili peppers, dried lemon grass, sweet potato, coconut cream, plain yogurt, vegetable stock
Instructions: Step 1: Saut garlic and ginger in oil for 1min in large sauce pan, to release flavours. Step 2: Add vegetable stock. Step 3: Simmer for 2 minutes. Step 4: Add diced potato, reduce heat and simmer for 10mins, add lemon grass and chili, and continue to simmer until potato is soft, approximately 5mins Liquidise, return to heat. Step 5: Add coconut and yogurt Do not boil!, serve.

Ingredient Names: sesame seeds, limes, bananas, sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: In a dry skillet, toast the sesame seeds until golden, set aside. Step 2: Squeeze lime juice over banana slices and set aside. Step 3: In a heavy saucepan, heat the sugar and water over a slow, even heat until the temperature reaches about 235f On a candy thermometer and the mixture forms threads The syrup should be thick and bubbling. Step 4: Remove from the heat Butter a sheet of waxed paper. Step 5: Dip the banana slices into the syrup, place them on the waxed paper. Step 6: Sprinkle them with the sesame seeds.

Ingredient Names: red cabbage, cucumbers, tomatoes, bell peppers, mushrooms, flour, sugar, tomato ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, water, vegetable oil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok. Step 2: When it is hot, put in the cabbage, cucumbers, tomato, bell peppers, mushrooms and water and stir fry. Step 3: When everything is done, mix in the ketchup. Step 4: Season with the sugar, soy sauce and vinegar. Step 5: Mix some water with the flour and add with stirring to thicken. Step 6: Taste and season as desired.

Ingredient Names: napa cabbage, jicama, carrot, yellow beet, cucumbers, raw peanuts, lime wedge, cilantro, garlic cloves, peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, rice vinegar, fresh ginger, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: For the salad: Put napa cabbage in a lrg, shallow serving bowl & top w / jicama Pile the carrot & beet on top & drizzle w / the dressing. Step 2: Garnish w / cucumber, peanuts, salad topper, lime & cilantro. Step 3: Drizzle w / 4 tbsp of the peanut lime dressing For the dressing: In a blender, puree all ingredients except the sunflower oil W / blender running, add sunflower oil in a thin stream until dressing is emulsified.

Ingredient Names: duck leg, light brown sugar, red thai curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, kaffir lime leaves, pineapple, red chile, thai basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Dry-fry the duck legs in an ovenproof frying pan or casserole dish on a low heat for a good 10-15 mins, turning once, until coloured all over. Remove from the pan. Add the sugar to the fat in the pan and cook until caramelised, then add the curry paste and cook for few mins until fragrant. Stir in the coconut milk and half a can of water. Simmer and stir until everything is combined, then add the fish sauce and lime leaves. Step 2: Slip in the duck legs, cover the pan and cook in the oven for 1½ hrs until the duck is really tender. Lift the duck legs into a serving dish and remove fat from the sauce, if you like. The curry can be prepared to this stage up to 2 days ahead and left in the fridge, in which case it will be easier to remove the fat. Step 3: Place the pan back on the heat, add the pineapple and simmer for 2 mins. Adjust the seasoning, adding more fish sauce for salt, and more sugar for sweetness. At the last moment, stir through half the chilli and half the Thai basil leaves, if using, pour over the duck, then scatter with the rest of the chilli and basil. Serve with jasmine rice.

Dish Name: Terong Belado Eggplant With Chilli Sauce
Ingredient Names: eggplants, coconut oil, shallots, garlic, ginger, red chilies, tomatoes, limes, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Halve the eggplants and brush them with 3 tablespoons of oil. Step 2: Place them on a tray and bake at 180 degrees celcius for about 40 minutes or until they soften Grind the shallots, garlic, ginger and / or galangal and chillies into a paste with a mortar and pestle. Step 3: Heat the remaining oil in a wok, and the paste along with the tomatoes and salt and stir until heated through. Step 4: Stir in the lime juice. Step 5: Place the eggplant in a bowl and pour over the sauce. Step 6: Serve with rice or cut the eggplants and serve as part of a banquet.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, thai curry paste, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Cut each block of tofu in three slices that are about 1 / 2 inch thick Stack the slices, then cut through all the layers diagonally, making an 'x', Combine the curry paste and soy sauce. Step 2: In a lightly oiled baking dish, arrange the tofu triangles. Step 3: Cover them with the curry paste and soy sauce mixture. Step 4: Bake at 350f for 45 minutes, turning twice during the baking process.

Ingredient Names: black beans, frozen corn kernels, red bell pepper, white onion, scallions, fresh cilantro, soy ginger broth, thai red curry paste, lime, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium serving bowl, whisk the broth, curry paste, lime zest, lime juice, scallions, cilantro, and sesame oil until well combined and smooth. Step 2: Add black beans, corn, diced onions, and diced red pepper and toss to coat and distribute evenly. Step 3: Refrigerate at least an hour, or overnight to allow flavors to develop The curry paste is hot stuff, use more or less to taste.

Ingredient Names: black rice, salt, sugar, cold water, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Place rice in a bowl and rinse with water by stirring in a counter clockwise motion Do this repeatedly until the water is clear and clean, indicating the rice is clean Pick out any odd grains. Step 2: In a medium saucepan, stir rice, salt, sugar and water and bring to a boil. Step 3: Stir well and reduce heat to low. Step 4: Cover and simmer gently for 1 1 / 2 hours to 2 hours until all of the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Step 5: Stir in the coconut milk and serve immediately as a hot dish Or chill and serve cold.

Ingredient Names: peanut butter, hot water, apple cider vinegar, tamari, molasses, cayenne, soya oil, water, turbinado sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, curry powder, nutritional yeast, salt, firm tofu
Instructions: Step 1: Combine marinade ingredients in a bowl Cube tofu and add to marinade. Step 2: Allow to sit for 30 minutes. Step 3: Combine sauce ingredients except for oil, set aside. Step 4: In a medium skillet, saute the vegetables and ginger in oil Gradually stir in the marinated tofu cubes. Step 5: Top with the peanut sauce, and serve over basmati rice. Step 6: Garnish with chopped peanuts.

Dish Name: Thai Butternut Squash And Corn Bisque
Ingredient Names: coconut milk, vegetable stock, lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, thai red curry paste, paprika, butternut squash, sweet potato, yukon gold potato, onion, garlic cloves, ginger, corn kernels, soy sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Put the coconut milk and stock in a medium sized pot and add the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves. Step 2: Add the thai red curry paste and paprika, then bring to a simmer over medium heat. Step 3: Turn the heat down to low and cook for 1 / 2 hour while you prepare the other ingredients. Step 4: After the half hour is up, add the vegetables, garlic and ginger and cook over low heat until the vegetables are fully cooked and soft, but not falling apart. Step 5: Remove about a cup to a cup and a half of the liquid and set aside. Step 6: Remove the galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves and discard. Step 7: Puree the rest of the ingredients right in the pot, and add back some or all of the liquid you set aside. Step 8: Stir n the corn kernels and season to taste with soy sauce or fish sauce. Step 9: Turn off heat and add lime juice to taste, then garnish with the cilantro leaves and sliced chilies and scallion tops Makes enough to feed four adults as a main dish with a salad and a bread, or enough for eight first course portions.

Ingredient Names: butternut squash, onion, garlic cloves, fresh ginger, carrots, mango, oil, vegetable stock, coconut milk, curry powder, lemongrass, chili pepper, salt, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Peel the squash, remove seeds and cut into large cubes together with the carrot. Step 2: Heat the oil and cook the onione with garlic and ginger until soft, but not browned. Step 3: Add the squash, carrots and lemongrass, just cover with vegetable stock, bring to boil and cook on low power until squash is tender. Step 4: Add the mango and chilli sometime during the cooking. Step 5: Add the coconut milk and curry powder, cream using a food processor or a handheld blender until smooth. Step 6: Take out any stubborn lemongrass pieces ). Step 7: Heat again and season to taste.

Ingredient Names: lime juice, rice vinegar, soy sauce, peanut butter, water, chili-garlic sauce, garlic clove, cabbage, carrot, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, rice vinegar, soy sauce, peanut butter, water, chili garlic sauce, and garlic. Step 2: Add remaining ingredients and toss to coat with dressing. Step 3: Garnish with chopped peanuts, if desired.

Ingredient Names: cantaloupe, canola oil, onion, grape tomatoes, water, sugar, salt, cayenne pepper, nuoc nam, green onion, peanuts, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Half cantalope, discard seeds, scoop out flesh and set aside Reserve shells to use for "bowls" Heat oil in a saucepan. Step 2: Add onion Saut 2 minutes. Step 3: Add cantaloupe flesh and tomatoes, cook 5 minutes. Step 4: Add the next 5 ingredients, bring to a boil, reduce.

Ingredient Names: butter, garlic clove, celery, carrot, rice, water, dried chili
Instructions: Step 1: Saute Carrot Add celery Add garlic Put into rice cooker Add rice water and chili Cook.

Ingredient Names: black sticky rice, water, coconut milk, raw sugar, salt, sweetened flaked coconut
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse and drain rice, place in a large saucepan. Step 2: Add water to cover rice. Step 3: Remove any rice grains that float to the top. Step 4: Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower heat to just keep a simmer. Step 5: Simmer about 45 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender. Step 6: Add more water if needed, or pour some off You want the water level to be just below the level of the rice. Step 7: Add coconut milk, sugar, and salt, and continue cooking until a pudding consistency is reached. Step 8: Sprinkle shredded coconut over top, if desired, serve warm.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, coconut milk, sugar, mango
Instructions: Step 1: Rice: cook rice according to package directions, but substitute coconut milk for half of the water, and add half the sugar It should be fairly dry when you finish cooking it, without any liquid visible in the pot Sauce: in a medium saucepan, boil the rest of the coconut milk with the second half of the sugar. Step 2: Keep this at a full boil until the rice is cooked, or until it reaches a thick, syrupy consistency Presentation: arrange the cooked coconut rice in a bowl or plate with the mango slices in some kind of pretty formation and dribble a bit of the sauce over the whole thing.

Ingredient Names: fresh corn kernels, cilantro, garlic, jalapeno, red bell peppers, eggs, cornstarch, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, corn oil, mixed salad green
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 350f. Step 2: Spread corn out in a single layer on a lightly oiled baking sheet Roast corn for 12 to 15 minutes. Step 3: Cool and divide into 2 batches While corn is cooking, prepare chopped ingredients. Step 4: Combine 1 batch of corn with eggs, cornstarch, chopped ingredients, salt, and pepper Pure in a food processor. Step 5: Fold in remaining corn by hand. Step 6: Heat corn oil to medium high in a skillet. Step 7: Drop in 12 heaping tablespoons of batter and fry until golden brown, turn over and fry other side till golden brown.

Dish Name: Thai Crystal Sauce Nahm Jeem Gratien
Ingredient Names: sugar, water, rice vinegar, garlic, salt, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all but the crushed red pepper flakes in a small saucepan. Step 2: Simmer about 20 minutes, until liquid reduces to a light syrup. Step 3: Stir in the red pepper flakes. Step 4: Keep refrigerated in a jar Shake before use Keeps indefinately.

Dish Name: Thai Dipping Sauce For Spring Wrap Or Egg Rolls
Ingredient Names: water, cornstarch, seasoned rice vinegar, brown sugar, reduced sodium soy sauce, fresh ginger, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together all the ingredients in a small saucepan Bring to a boil, whisking all the while until it thickens Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

Dish Name: Thai Eggplant Kumara Curry With Barley Low Gi
Ingredient Names: pearl barley, canola oil, onion, green curry paste, eggplant, light coconut milk, reduced-sodium vegetable stock, kaffir lime leaves, kumara, soft brown sugar, lime juice, lime zest
Instructions: Step 1: Rinse & drain the barley. Step 2: Fill a large saucepan with 5 cups water and add barley. Step 3: Bring to the boil then reduce heat. Step 4: Simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until tender. Step 5: Drain While barley is cooking, heat oil in large wok then add curry paste and onion. Step 6: Cook, stirring, over medium heat for 3 minutes. Step 7: Add eggplant and cook for a further 4 minutes, or until softened. Step 8: Pour in stock and coconut milk. Step 9: Bring to the boil.

Ingredient Names: cabbage, cucumber, red bell pepper, scallions, basil leaves, toasted sesame seeds, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, rice wine vinegar, honey, canola oil, sesame oil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all salad ingredients into serving bowl. Step 2: Combine dressing ingredients into glass jar and shake well until combined. Step 3: Drizzle over vegetables and toss. Step 4: Let stand about 10-20 minutes in fridge Re-toss salad before serving and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Dish Name: Thai Fried Rice With Vegetable Ribbons
Ingredient Names: carrot, leek, snow peas, peanut oil, cooked rice, lime, honey, hot pepper sauce, peanut butter, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Set a strainer in the sink and place carrot, leek, and pea strips in it. Step 2: Pour boiling water over vegetables for about 12 seconds. Step 3: Set vegetables aside. Step 4: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 5: Add vegetables, garlic, and rice and saute until heated through and fragrant, 4 minutes. Step 6: In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice and pulp, honey, hot pepper sauce, peanut butter, and basil or mint, if used. Step 7: Add to rice mixture and toss well to combine, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: garlic, cilantro, rice wine, peppercorns, vegetable oil, fresh shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, sugar, peanuts, pineapple, orange, avocado, red chili peppers, fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Using a blender or mortar& pestle, blend the garlic, cilantro roots, rice wine& peppercorns into a paste. Step 2: Add the vegetable oil to a skillet over medium heat. Step 3: Add the paste& stir-fry a few seconds until fragrant. Step 4: Add the shiitake& stir-fry until cooked, 3-5 minutes. Step 5: Add soy sauce, sugar and peanuts and fry until the sugar is blended into the mixture. Step 6: Remove from the heat& let cool. Step 7: Slice the pineapple into 1 / 2" thick rings and then cut the rings into 1 / 2" x 1 1 / 2" chunks. Step 8: Put a small amount of the cooled stir-fry mixture on individual pineapple chunk, orange slices and avocado slices. Step 9: Decorate each"horse" with a few slivers of chili and a cilantro leaf.

Ingredient Names: ginger, sesame oil, cauliflower, carrot, bell pepper, peas, coconut milk, salt, black pepper, turmeric, chili powder, paprika, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Saute ginger in sesame oil over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add in cauliflower, carrots, peppers, spices, lime juice, and a bit of water, toss well. Step 3: Once liquid starts bubbling, cover and simmer for about 5-7 minutes Give another stir, and at this point your vegetables should be getting tender You should also add in about another quarter cup or less of water. Step 4: Simmer for a few minutes, then check to see if vegetables are tender If they aren't, let simmer until they are If they are, turn heat to very low and add peas. Step 5: Cover, stir, and let sit for five minutes.

Dish Name: Thai Green Curry With Butternut Squash And Yellow Peppers Veget
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, yellow bell peppers, green curry paste, garlic cloves, butternut squash, light coconut milk, spinach leaves, cilantro, basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in pot over medium heat. Step 2: Add onion, and saut 5 to 7 minutes. Step 3: Add bell peppers, and cook 3 minutes. Step 4: Stir in curry paste and garlic, and cook 1 minute. Step 5: Add butternut squash and coconut milk, and bring to a simmer Partially cover pot, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer 20 minutes. Step 6: Place spinach, cilantro, and basil in blender with 1 / 4 cup water. Step 7: Blend until smooth. Step 8: Stir into curry mixture, and cook 1 minute to allow flavors to meld.

Ingredient Names: romaine lettuce hearts, cilantro, egg whites, noodles, chicken breast, onion, italian dressing, garlic, hard-boiled egg yolks, peanut butter, mayonnaise, water, fish sauce, sugar
Instructions: Step 1: Thinly slice half a white onion and marinate it with the italian dressing Hard boil 4 eggs. Step 2: Cool, then peel the eggs Separate the yolks from the whites. Step 3: Make the dressing: mash the egg yolks in a bowl. Step 4: Add the garlic, peanut butter, mayonnaise, water, fish sauce, and italian dressing. Step 5: Stir well to combine It should be a smooth sauce, with very little lumps. Step 6: Add the marinated onions to the dressing. Step 7: Add in the sugar, a little at a time, until it reaches the desired balance of sweet to tart.

Ingredient Names: white vinegar, sugar, water, salt, cucumber, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a small pan, combine vinegar, sugar, water and salt. Step 2: Cook over medium heat, stirring, until liquid boils and sugar is dissolved. Step 3: Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature Peel or score cucumber, if desired and cut lengthwise into quarters. Step 4: Then cut quarters crosswise into 1 / 8-inch-thick slices. Step 5: Place in a serving bowl, pour marinade over cucumbers. Step 6: Stir to blend If made ahead, cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Step 7: Top with peanuts before serving.

Ingredient Names: rice sticks, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, soya sauce, lime juice, garlic cloves, ginger, fresh white mushrooms, sweet red pepper, snow peas, carrot, green onions, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, soak noodles in hot water for 20 minutes. Step 2: Drain and cook in boiling water for 2 minutes. Step 3: Drain well and place in large bowl. Step 4: Meanwhile in a measuring cup, or jar with lid, combine hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, soya sauce, lime juice, garlic and gingerroot. Step 5: Stir or shake to blend well. Step 6: Pour half of the dressing over drained cooked noodles. Step 7: Toss mushrooms, pepper, peas, carrot, onions and cilantro and remaining dressing with noodles. Step 8: Serve at room temperature or chill until the next day.

Dish Name: Thai Noodles With Spicy Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: linguine, sesame oil, green onion, carrot, stir fry vegetables, fresh garlic, ground ginger, honey, creamy peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili-garlic sauce
