Instructions: Step 1: Cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions. Step 2: Drain and return to pot. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp sesame oil and toss to coat, set aside. Step 4: Heat remaining 2 tbsp sesame oil in heavy pot over medium-high heat. Step 5: Add green onions, carrots, stir-fry veggies, garlic and ginger. Step 6: Saute until vegetables soften, about 4 minutes. Step 7: Add honey, peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar and chili-garlic sauce and mix well. Step 8: Simmer sauce 2 minutes. Step 9: Pour sauce over pasta and toss well.

Ingredient Names: all-purpose flour, water, egg, sweetened condensed milk, sugar, salt, butter, banana
Instructions: Step 1: Watch the videos metioned in the recipe description. Step 2: In a bowl, combine water, egg, condensed milk, sugar, and salt, mix well. Step 3: Set aside Sift the flour into a large bowl, and form a crater in the sifted flour. Step 4: Pour the water / egg mixture into the flour, and mix well, add melted butter. Step 5: Knead this until the bowl is clean and you have a nice ball of dough Lightly coat the dough ball with vegetable oil. Step 6: Let it sit for 30 minutes.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, rice vinegar, brown sugar, chunky peanut butter, soy sauce, olive oil, sesame oil, hot chili oil, linguine, snow peas, scallions, yellow bell pepper, sesame seeds
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients for dressing and set aside. Step 2: Boil noodles according to pkg directions and drain. Step 3: Combine vegetables with linguine. Step 4: Toss with dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Step 5: Chill before serving.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, garlic clove, water, soy sauce, sugar, creamy peanut butter
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Step 2: Saute the garlic till golden. Step 3: Add water, soy sauce, and sugar. Step 4: Stir until sugar is dissolved and the mixture is heated through. Step 5: Add peanut butter and stir till well combined. Step 6: Simmer till reaching desired thickness, then serve over meat, seafood, or whatever else you like.

Ingredient Names: rice vinegar, cucumbers, red onion, cilantro leaves, red chili pepper, sugar, salt, black pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a glass jar or bowl. Step 2: Refrigerate at least 3 hours This will theoretically keep for a couple of weeks, but i've never had them last more than a few days.

Ingredient Names: cooked brown rice, mozzarella cheese, crunchy peanut butter, egg, hot water, cilantro leaf, soy sauce, dark sesame oil, ground red pepper, broccoli florets, red onion, carrots, fresh ginger, mung bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine cooked brown rice, 1 cup of the mozzarella, 1 / 4 cup peanut butter and egg in a large bowl. Step 2: Press firmly into a 10-inch pie plate or a 12-inch pizza pan coated with cooking spray. Step 3: Bake at 400f For 8 minutes. Step 4: Mix remaining 3 / 4 cup peanut butter, hot water, cilantro, soy sauce, 2 tbsps Sesame oil, and red pepper in a small bowl, set aside. Step 5: Stir-fry broccoli, red onion, carrots and ginger in remaining 1 tablespoons Sesame oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until tender crisp If shredded carrots are being used instead of julienned, add the carrots with the ginger.

Dish Name: Thai Pineapple Fried Rice Pad Kao Saparod
Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, garlic, carrot, green beans, fresh pineapple chunks, cooked rice, ketchup, salt, cucumber, green onions, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a wok, heat oil over medium heat and stir-fry onion and garlic until golden brown. Step 2: Add the carrots and green beans and stir-fry 2 minutes. Step 3: Add pineapple, rice, ketchup, and salt, mixing well and stir-frying for 3 minutes. Step 4: Garnish with green onion and cilantro before serving. Step 5: Serve with soy sauce, if desired.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, red chile, lemongrass, coriander leaves, spring onions, eggs, plain flour, oil, sweet chili sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Grate potatoes, then put in clean tea towel and squeeze to remove as much moisture as possible. Step 2: Mix potato in bowl with chilli, lemongrass, coriander, spring onions, egg and flour. Step 3: Heat 1 5cm oil in a frying pan Use two heaped tablespoons of mixture for each cake and cook in batches for 3- 4 minutes on each side, or until crisp and cooked through. Step 4: Drain on paper towels and keep warm whilst cooking remainder of cakes. Step 5: Serve hot, with sweet chilli sauce.

Ingredient Names: potatoes, vegetable oil, yellow bell pepper, red bell pepper, carrot, zucchini, garlic cloves, red chili pepper, scallion, coconut milk, lemongrass, lime juice, lime, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Using a sharp knife, cut the potatoes into small cubes. Step 2: Bring a large pan of water to a boil and cook the diced potatoes for 5 minutes, drain thoroughly. Step 3: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet, swirling the oil around the bottom of the wok until it is really hot. Step 4: Add the potatoes, diced bell peppers, strips of carrot and zucchini, and the garlic and chile to the wok, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Stir in the scallions, coconut milk, chopped lemongrass, and the lime juice, and stir-fry the mixture for another 5 minutes. Step 6: Add the lime zest and cilantro and stir-fry for 1 minute, serve hot.

Dish Name: Thai Pumpkin And Coconut Cream Soup
Ingredient Names: pumpkin, vegetable stock, ginger, lemongrass, scallions, coconut cream, salt, white pepper, lime, kaffir lime leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a saucepan, combine the pumpkin, stock or water, ginger, and lemongrass. Step 2: Cover, bring to a boil, reduce the heat to medium-low, and simmer until the pumpkin is very tender, about 12 minutes. Step 3: Add the scallions and cook briefly. Step 4: Transfer the contents of the saucepan to a blender or food processor and process until the soup is partially pured. Step 5: Pour in half of the coconut cream and process until smooth. Step 6: Rinse the saucepan and pour the pure into it. Step 7: Add half of the remaining coconut cream. Step 8: Season with salt and pepper and heat through without allowing the soup to boil. Step 9: Taste and adjust the seasoning and squeeze in lime or lemon juice If using the kaffir lime leaves, fold them in half and, using a sharp knife, trim away the hard central rib.

Ingredient Names: pumpkin, olive oil, garlic clove, onion, carrot, celery, vegetable stock, fresh ginger, coconut milk
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425. Step 2: Slice pumpkin in half and core. Step 3: Discard membrane and seeds Baste sides of the pumpkin with a cloth or paper towel in 3 tablespoons of olive oil Roast both halves of pumpkin uncovered for 35 to 40 minutes, checking frequently. Step 4: Remove from oven and allow to cool Peel away hard outer skin using a peeler and reserve flesh. Step 5: Cut into 1-2 inch cubes. Step 6: In a large stockpot, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Step 7: Add in garlic, onion, carrot and celery stirring frequently until tender.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, salt, brown sugar, tamari, vegetable oil, thai red curry paste, green beans, eggplant, red bell pepper, fresh mushrooms, fresh basil leaves, lime zest
Instructions: Step 1: Combine coconut milk, salt, sugar and tamari, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat. Step 3: Add curry paste and stir fry for 1 minute Increase heat to high and add beans, eggplant, red pepper and mushrooms. Step 4: Stir fry until the vegetables are tender crisp. Step 5: Reduce heat to medium and add coconut milk mixture while stirring, heat for 1 minute. Step 6: Serve hot over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with basil leaves and lime zest.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, onion, carrots, celery, bell pepper, bamboo shoots, savoy cabbage, bok choy, broccoli, button mushroom, zucchini, red curry paste, light coconut milk, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: In large, deep skillet, heat oil and saute onions, carrots, and celery for a minute or two. Step 2: Add the rest of the vegetables and saute for another two or three minutes. Step 3: Add curry paste and stir until all vegetables are coated. Step 4: Stir in coconut milk The vegetables should be nicely coated If more liquid is needed, stir in a little vegetable stock or water. Step 5: Let cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are cooked to the doneness that you like Salt to taste, and serve over jasmine rice or brown rice, sprinkled with basil.

Ingredient Names: rice paper sheets, green onions, english cucumber, carrots, rice noodles, bean sprouts, peanuts, lime juice, minced garlic cloves, hot pepper flakes, sesame oil, chunky peanut butter, hoisin sauce, brown sugar, water
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients for the peanut sauce ahead of time, and set aside. Step 2: In a medium pan, add about 1 1 / 2 inces of water in, and leave on medium to low head. Step 3: Place the rice papers in the warm water for no longer than 30 seconds, or until tender, but not falling apart. Step 4: Set on counter or cutting board, and layer noodles, carrot, cuccumber, onions, sprouts and chopped peanuts Be mindful that you still have to roll it up, so do not overfill. Step 5: Drizzle peanut sauce over filling before rolling, or use as a dipping sauce Other dipping sauces used are hiosin, soy, and a chili sauce.

Ingredient Names: crunchy peanut butter, sweet chili sauce, coconut milk, vegetable stock, soy sauce, cooked noodles, sesame oil, fresh ginger, broccoli florets, red pepper, baby corn, mange-touts peas, garlic cloves, fresh basil, roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a bowl mix the peanut butter, chilli sauce, coconut milk, vegetable stock and soy sauce to make a smooth sauce. Step 2: Heat the oil in a wok and stir fry the broccoli, red pepper, baby corn and ginger for 3 minutes add the mange tout and garlic and cook for a further 2 minutes pour over the satay sauce and bring to the boil. Step 3: Drain the noodles or remove from pack and add to the wok. Step 4: Stir fry over a high heat for a couple of minutes. Step 5: Serve with the basil leaves and peanuts sprinkled over.

Ingredient Names: fresh basil, fresh cilantro, low sodium soy sauce, fresh lime juice, of fresh mint, molasses, fresh ginger, olive oil, curry powder, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic, firm tofu, cooking spray, cooked vermicelli
Instructions: Step 1: Combine first 11 ingredients in a large baking dish. Step 2: Stir with a whisk until blended. Step 3: Cut each tofu cake crosswise into 4 slices. Step 4: Place tofu slices in soy sauce mixture, turning to coat slices. Step 5: Cover and marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Step 6: Remove tofu slices from dish, reserving marinade Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Step 7: Place over medium high heat, add tofu slices. Step 8: Cook 2 minutes on each side.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, thai red curry paste, sugar, fish sauce, green beans, vegetable broth, peanut oil
Instructions: Step 1: Place the tofu between layers of paper towels and weigh them down with a heavy skillet to remove excess water. Step 2: Set aside to drain for 10 minutes. Step 3: Combine the curry paste, sugar, and fish sauce. Step 4: Put half this sauce in a resealable plastic bag. Step 5: Add the tofu, seal, and set aside for 15 minutes. Step 6: In a saucepan, combine the green beans, broth, oil, and the remaining curry. Step 7: Simmer until the beans are tender, about 5 minutes. Step 8: Cover to keep warm Lightly coat a nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray and place it over medium heat. Step 9: When hot, add the tofu and cook until golden, about 4 minutes per side.

Ingredient Names: water, lemongrass, galanga root, kaffir lime leaves, chili paste, mushroom, onion, oil, lemon juice, vegetarian oyster sauce, tomatoes, chile, light soy sauce, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Combine water and chili paste, and bring to a boil. Step 2: Add glalnga root, keffir lime leaf, lemon grass, mushrooms and onion. Step 3: Simmer a few minutes. Step 4: Add the lemon juice, oyster sauce, tomato and chili peppers. Step 5: Simmer until ready to serve Adjust seasonings with soy sauce and lemon juice, if necessary. Step 6: Pour into bowls and garnish with coriander.

Ingredient Names: fresh spinach, sour cream, plain fat-free yogurt, of fresh mint, peanuts, peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, crushed red pepper flakes, baby carrots
Instructions: Step 1: In a medium bowl combine spinach, sour cream, and yogurt. Step 2: Stir in mint, peanuts, peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, and crushed red pepper. Step 3: Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours.

Ingredient Names: basmati rice, green onion, broccoli, carrots, peanut sauce, vegetable broth, cornstarch, cilantro, dry roasted peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and heat over meduim heat. Step 2: Saute vegetables until tender crisp. Step 3: Combine the vegetable broth and cornstarch. Step 4: Stir the vegetable broth and peanut sauce into the vegetable and heat until boiling, stir until the sauce is thick. Step 5: Serve over rice and garnish with cilantro and peanuts Enjoy!

Dish Name: Thai Style Apple And Celery Salad
Ingredient Names: lime juice, sesame oil, peanut butter, sugar, soy sauce, apples, celery ribs, cilantro, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the first 5 ingredients to make dressing In serving bowl mix the next 3 Then add dressing Toss to coat Just before serving add the peanuts and toss.

Ingredient Names: chunky peanut butter, sugar, hot water, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, sesame oil, red pepper flakes, canola oil, fresh broccoli florets, red bell pepper, onion, garlic, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl combine the peanut butter, sugar, water, lime juice, soy sauce, sesame oil, and pepper flakes. Step 2: Whisk until well blended and set aside. Step 3: Heat vegetable oil over medium high heat in a large skillet or wok. Step 4: Add the broccoli, bell pepper, onions, and garlic. Step 5: Stir fry for 4 minutes or until vegetables are just tender crisp. Step 6: Remove from heat and stir in the peanut butter mixture. Step 7: Toss well to combine, sprinkle on chopped peanuts and serve hot or at room temp.

Ingredient Names: carrot, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, garlic cloves, zucchini, tomato sauce, peanut butter, braggs liquid aminos, curry powder, garbanzo beans, frozen peas, salt, cooked rice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Place diced carrots, onion, peppers, and garlic in a kettle with a small amount of water and curry powder. Step 2: Simmer about 5 minutes until tender. Step 3: Add zucchini, cover, and simmer 5 more minutes. Step 4: Blend all the remaining ingredients, except the peas and garboanzos or lentils, in a blender until smooth. Step 5: Add the blended ingredients, the peas, and the garbanzos or lentils to the rest of the vegetables. Step 6: Heat and serve over rice.

Dish Name: Thai Style Potato And Spinach Soup
Ingredient Names: onions, garlic, vegetable oil, red chilies, lemon, potatoes, vegetable stock cubes, salt and pepper, tabasco sauce, spinach leaves, coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large fry pan and saute onion and garlic for five minutes. Step 2: Remove two strips of zest from the lemon and add chilli and lemon zest into the frying pan. Step 3: Cook for another few minutes. Step 4: Stir the potatoes into the mixture and cook for a couple minutes, before adding the hot stock. Step 5: Bring soup to a boil, turn down heat immediately. Step 6: Add one tablespoon lemon juice, salt and pepper. Step 7: Simmer, partially covered, for about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked Adjust seasoning with salt, lemon juice and tabasco Squash the spinach into the pan, coarsely chop the coriander and add that in as well. Step 8: When the spinach is wilted, the soup is ready.

Dish Name: Thai Style Tofu Ww In Microwave
Ingredient Names: reduced-sodium vegetable broth, reduced sodium soy sauce, lime juice, fresh ginger, red curry paste, reduced-fat firm tofu, fresh bean sprout, carrot, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Combine the broth, soy sauce, lime juice, ginger, and curry paste in a medium bowl. Step 2: Place the tofu in a 1 1 / 2-quart microwavable dish and pour the broth mixture over the top. Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap. Step 4: Then prick a few holes in the plastic Microwave on high until heated through, 4-5 minutes. Step 5: Top with the bean sprouts, carrots, and basil.

Dish Name: Thai Sweet And Sour Cucumber Salad
Ingredient Names: white vinegar, water, sugar, salt, cucumber, red onion, dry roasted salted peanut, fresh cilantro, cilantro leaf
Instructions: Step 1: In a small saucepan, combine vinegar, water, sugar, and salt and boil gently over medium heat. Step 2: Stir occasionally to dissolve the sugar and salt. Step 3: After about 2 minutes, when the syrup is clear and slightly thickened, remove from heat and cool to room temperature Peel the cucumber and slice lengthwise in quarters. Step 4: Slice these strips into 1 / 4 inch thick triangles. Step 5: In a bowl, combine the cucumbers, cooled vinegar mixture, onion, and cilantro and mix well Use a slotted spoon to serve into individual dishes. Step 6: Sprinkle servings with the chopped peanuts and cilantro leaves.

Ingredient Names: thai red chili peppers, garlic, shallot, tomatoes, sugar, rice vinegar, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Step 2: Reduce heat to very low, cover and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until sauce is thickened. Step 3: Taste and adjust seasonings as necessary. Step 4: Transfer to small dipping dishes.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, tempeh, vegetable stock, tamari, garlic, serrano peppers, ginger, unsweetened coconut milk, scallions, salt, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a large deep skillet, brown tempeh on both sides in oil. Step 2: Cut tempeh into thin strips. Step 3: Add stock, tamari, garlic, minced serrano chile / s, and ginger to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Step 4: Add tempeh strips, then cover the pan and cook until all the liquid has been absorbed. Step 5: Add the coconut milk, and scallions, and season with salt, and simmer for several minutes or until dish is hot. Step 6: Stir in lime juice and sprinkle cilantro over the dish. Step 7: Serve hot, with steamed jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, butternut squash, vegetable oil, onion, garlic cloves, thai red curry paste, light coconut milk, vegetable stock, soy sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, salt, sweet red pepper, fresh cilantro, lime juice
Instructions: Step 1: Pat tofu dry with paper towels. Step 2: Cut into 3 / 4-inch cubes. Step 3: Set aside Peel and seed squash. Step 4: Cut into 3 / 4-inch cubes to make 3 cups. Step 5: Set aside In skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Step 6: Cook onion, garlic and curry paste, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Step 7: Add squash, coconut milk, stock, soy sauce, sugar, fish sauce and salt, bring to boil.

Ingredient Names: soy sauce, fresh lime juice, sugar, chili pepper, shallot, salt, vegetable oil, tofu, black pepper, english cucumber, green onions, cilantro leaf, mint
Instructions: Step 1: For the dressing: Stir together the liquids with the sugar Lightly crush & add the chilis & shallots to the liquid Will taste hugely overwhelming - no worries It is balanced by the tofu For the salad: Heat the oil over a medium-high flame in a large skillet Author suggests cast iron - i use french stainless Dry the tofu Brown the tofu in the skillet - about 5 minutes a side.

Dish Name: Thai Tofu With Zucchini Red Bell Pepper And Lime
Ingredient Names: peanut oil, extra firm tofu, zucchini, red bell pepper, gingerroot, canned unsweetened coconut milk, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, thai red curry paste, fresh basil
Instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbls Of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over mdium high heat. Step 2: Add the tofu and saute until golden, about 5 minutes Move the tofu to a bowl. Step 3: Add the remaining 1 tbls Oil, then add zucchini and red bell pepper to the skillet. Step 4: Saute until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Step 5: Return tofu to the skillet. Step 6: Add ginger and stir about 30 seconds. Step 7: Add the coconut milk, 3 tbls.

Dish Name: Thai Vegan Fried Rice Khao Phad Jay
Ingredient Names: cooked long-grain rice, vegetable oil, garlic, onion, fresh ground black pepper, green beans, frozen corn kernels, soy sauce, green curry paste, scallions, cucumber, lime
Instructions: Step 1: To start with uncooked rice, start with 2 cups raw rice, cook, spread out on a baking pan to cool, and then refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Step 2: Prepare the garnishes: cut the scallions on a slight diagonal into 1-inch lengths, cut the cucumber into very thin slices, cut the lime into wedges, set aside. Step 3: Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat and add the oil. Step 4: When the oil is very hot and slightly smoking, add the garlic, onion, and black pepper and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 5: Add the green beans and corn and continue to stir-fry for 3 minutes. Step 6: Add the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Step 7: Add the soy sauce and curry paste and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Step 8: Garnish with the scallions, cucumber, and lime, and serve hot.

Ingredient Names: cooking oil, onion, green curry paste, canned unsweetened coconut milk, low sodium chicken broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, salt, bamboo shoot, boiling potato, broccoli, tomatoes, carrot, lime juice, basil leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a dutch oven, heat the oil over moderate heat. Step 2: Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Step 3: Stir in the curry paste and fry, stirring, for 1 minute. Step 4: Add the coconut milk and broth and bring to a boil. Step 5: Stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar, salt, bamboo shoots, potatoes, and broccoli. Step 6: Reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes. Step 7: Stir in the tomato and heat through, about 2 minutes. Step 8: Remove from the heat and add the lime juice and basil Variations: Other vegetables that would taste good in place of the broccoli include carrots, eggplant, cauliflower, snow peas, cabbage, green beans, and canned baby corn.

Ingredient Names: garlic cloves, vegetable oil, vegetable broth, soy sauce, firm tofu, vegetables, fresh cilantro, fresh cracked pepper, hot sauce
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep saucepan heat vegetable oil and sautee garlic until golden brown. Step 2: Add soy sauce and let it bubble and sizzle before adding the vegetable broth, bring to a boil. Step 3: Turn down heat and add the remaining ingredients. Step 4: Simmer for 5 minutes I like my vegetables crunchy.

Ingredient Names: cooked jasmine rice, peas, garlic cloves, red pepper, canola oil, fresh ginger, eggs, tomatoes, hot chili paste, light soy sauce, fresh lime juice, scallion
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok. Step 2: Add ginger and garlic and stir fry for 1-2 minutes. Step 3: Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside In the same pan add peas and red pepper. Step 4: Stir fry for 2 minutes until slightly softened. Step 5: Remove and set aside. Step 6: Add the cold rice to the skillet and heat thoroughly With a spoon make a hole in the center of the rice pushing the rice to the sides. Step 7: Add the beaten eggs into the center without touching the rice. Step 8: Stir the eggs until pretty well set then start incorporating the rice into them.

Ingredient Names: yams, red bell pepper, scallions, pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds, raisins, olive oil, sesame oil, gingerroot, garlic clove, lime juice, soy sauce, red pepper sauce
Instructions: Step 1: Mix dressing together Pour over other ingredients Mix well Serve chilled or warm Cooking time is for baking the yams.

Ingredient Names: peanut oil, curry paste, garlic, coconut milk, vegetable broth, fresh ginger, potatoes, onion, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, carrots, mushroom, soy sauce, brown sugar, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: In a deep frying pan or wok, heat oil over medium heat until hot. Step 2: Add curry paste and garlic and cook, stirring for about 30 seconds Slowly stir in coconut milk and vegetable broth. Step 3: Reduce heat to simmer. Step 4: Add potatoes and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Step 5: Add ginger, onion, and peppers. Step 6: Cook until tender, about 7 minutes. Step 7: Add carrots, mushrooms, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Step 8: When heated through, serve over individual plates of hot rice. Step 9: Garnish with cilantro.

Ingredient Names: vegetable oil, green onions, fresh coriander, pork tenderloin, thai red curry paste, peanut butter, soft brown sugar, soy sauce, light coconut milk, baby corn, limes, steamed jasmine rice
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or flameproof casserole. Add the spring onions and coriander stalks and cook for 1 min. Add the pork slices and cook for 5 mins until starting to brown. Step 2: Stir in the curry paste and peanut butter. After 30 secs, add the sugar, soy and coconut milk, plus ½ can of water. Mix well, put a lid on and leave to simmer for 15 mins, stirring occasionally. Step 3: Remove the lid, add the baby corn and increase the heat. Bubble for 3 mins until the corn is cooked and the sauce has thickened a little. Stir in the lime juice and check the seasoning. Can now be frozen for up to 2 months. To cook from frozen: thoroughly defrost, then heat in a pan on the hob until curry is hot all the way through. Serve scattered with the coriander leaves and rice.

Ingredient Names: vegetables, onions, thai red curry paste, butternut squash, fl reduced-fat coconut milk, vegetable stock, green beans, pineapple chunks natural juice, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the oil in a wok or pan. Fry the onion for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the red curry paste, then add the squash, coconut milk and stock. Simmer for 15-20 mins until the squash is tender. After 10 mins cooking, tip in the green beans. Step 2: Stir in the pineapple and coriander, cooking for just a few mins until the pineapple heats through. Sprinkle with the coriander leaves and serve the curry in bowls with noodles or rice.

Dish Name: This Has Hardly Any Calories Spicy Pad Thai
Ingredient Names: shirataki noodles, soy sauce, garlic clove, chili sauce, fresh ginger, lime juice, oil, cilantro, basil, bean sprouts, cashew nuts, red pepper flakes
Instructions: Step 1: Mix everything together in a bowl. Step 2: Let it sit over night if you really want the flavor to blow you away, otherwise, use it right away. Step 3: Add to well-drained shirataki noodles and enjoy!

Dish Name: Tho Ruung Red Curry Stir Fry
Ingredient Names: thai red curry paste, sugar, garlic cloves, vegetable oil, eggplants, onion, mustard greens, light coconut milk, lime wedge
Instructions: Step 1: Whisk together curry paste, sugar, garlic, and 2 tbsp water in small bowl, set aside. Step 2: Heat oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Step 3: Add eggplant and onion, and cook 5 minutes, or until eggplant is browned. Step 4: Stir in curry mixture, and cook 30 seconds, or until vegetables are coated. Step 5: Add mustard greens, and cook 1 to 2 minutes, or until leaves are wilted. Step 6: Stir in coconut milk and 1 1 / 2 cups water, and season with salt, if desired. Step 7: Cover, and bring to a simmer. Step 8: Reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, or until eggplant is tender. Step 9: Serve with lime wedges.

Dish Name: Tofu And Broccoli With Peanut Sauce
Ingredient Names: peanut butter, hot water, cider vinegar, tamari, blackstrap molasses, cayenne pepper, fresh broccoli, oil, garlic, tofu, salt, onions, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: -----------thesauce----------- In a small saucepan, whisk together the peanut butter and hot water until uniform in consistency. Step 2: Whisk in the remaining ingredients. Step 3: Set aside -------thesaute------------- Cut off the bottom half-inch of the broccoli stems Shave off the tough outer skins of the stalks with a sharp paring knife or a vegetable peeler. Step 4: Cut the stalks diagonally into thin slices Coarsely chop the flowerettes, set aside.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, peanut oil, firm tofu, low sodium soy sauce, peanut butter, sugar, ketchup, rice vinegar, carrots, green onions, bean sprouts, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400f cut the tofu into thirds & lightly coat with 1 teaspoons peanut oil per tofu slice. Step 2: Once done put tofu into oven until pieces are golden & sizzling. Step 3: Once the tofu is done cut into small cubes. Step 4: Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Step 5: Once the noodles have cooked cool off with cold water, drain, & set aside Shred carrots & dice green onions while noodles & tofu are cooking. Step 6: Mix together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, ketchup & peanut butter, set aside. Step 7: Heat 1 teaspoons oil in large wok. Step 8: Add cooked noodles, green onions, bean sprouts, carrots & sauce mixture.

Dish Name: Tofu With Lychee And Black Mushrooms Tao Hoo Neung Lychee
Ingredient Names: tofu, dried lychees, ginger, soy sauce, vegetable stock, sesame oil, fresh coriander leaves
Instructions: Step 1: In a steamer, place dried lychee, ginger and black mushroom on the tofu cubes. Step 2: Fill in with stock, soy sauce and sesame oil. Step 3: Steam for 3-5 minutes. Step 4: Sprinkle with coriander leaves, serve hot.

Ingredient Names: vegetable broth, lemongrass, dried kaffir lime leaves, vegetable oil, garlic, fresh ginger, chili paste, white mushrooms, fresh lime juice, soy sauce, tomatoes, cilantro, hot green chili pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Medium saucepan, heat vegetable broth, lemon grass, chilis and lime leaves to a simmer. Step 2: In a small skillet over medium heat, add oil, garlic and ginger. Step 3: Cook, stirring often for 30 seconds. Step 4: When broth has simmered about 5 minutes, remove lemon grass, chilis and leaves and discard them. Step 5: Add the cooked garlic and ginger to the broth. Step 6: Return broth to a boil. Step 7: Stir in chili paste and mushrooms. Step 8: Cook until mushrooms have wilted. Step 9: Stir in lime juice and soy sauce. Step 10: Remove from heat, ladle into bowls and top each bowl with tomato and cilantro.

Dish Name: Tom Yum Thai Hot And Sour Soup
Ingredient Names: dried wood ear mushrooms, soft tofu, water, soy sauce, black pepper, garlic, sugar, rice vinegar, hot chili sauce, salt, bamboo shoot, sesame oil, cornstarch, egg yolks, red pepper
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the wood ears in warm water for 20-30 minutes until they swell up and become soft. Step 2: Rinse under cold water, and cut into thin ribons, discarding any hard centers, set aside. Step 3: Slice tofu into long thin strips, set aside. Step 4: Bring the 4 cups of water to a boil in a soup pot. Step 5: Add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic, sugar, vinegar, sambal oelek, and salt and stir to blend. Step 6: Lower heat to medium and cook for several minutes. Step 7: Add the bamboo shoots and cook for a minute before adding the wood ears, the tofu, and the sesame oil. Step 8: Cook the soup for 2-3 minutes, then stir in the cornstarch which should be dissolved in the 1 tablespoonful of water.

Dish Name: Traditional Thai Iced Tea With Star Anise
Ingredient Names: star anise pods, orange blossom water, vanilla pod, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, black tea leaves, granulated sugar, red food coloring, half-and-half
Instructions: Step 1: Bring 1 / 2 gallon of cold water to a boil. Step 2: Add 8 finely crushed star anise pods, 1 teaspoon orange blossom water, the scrapings of 1 vanilla pod or 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, a pinch each of ground cloves and ground cinnamon, and 1 / 2 cup chinese black tea leaves. Step 3: Boil for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Step 4: Remove from the heat and stir in 1 cup sugar and a few drops of red food coloring. Step 5: Cover, steeping until tepid. Step 6: Strain & place in the refriderator for a few hours to really chill. Step 7: Pour the tea over plenty of crushed ice. Step 8: Top with half-and-half or sweetened condensed milk.

Ingredient Names: napa cabbage, red cabbage, cucumber, beans, carrots, green onions, olive oil, fresh cilantro, sugar, garlic cloves, limes, salt, pepper, avocado
Instructions: Step 1: For the thai salad: in a large serving bowl, toss the cabbages, cucumber, edamame, carrots and green onions For the sweet lime-cilantro dressing: put the oil, cilantro, sugar, garlic, lime juice, salt and pepper in a large blender and blend until smooth. Step 2: Top each serving of salad with 2 tablespoons of the sweet lime-cilantro dressing and 2 slices of avocado for garnish, cook's.

Dish Name: Vegan Butternut Squash Thai Curry Crepes With Coconut Ginger Pea
Ingredient Names: chickpea flour, white flour, salt, extra virgin olive oil, warm water, coconut milk, green curry paste, water, butternut squash, basil, unbleached cane sugar, red pepper, fresh ginger, peanut butter, peanuts
Instructions: Step 1: First, we get the crepes started. Step 2: In a bowl, whisk together the flours and the salt. Step 3: Add the oil and water and mix together. Step 4: Pour this into the blender and blend until thoroughly combined. Step 5: Let the batter sit for at least 20 minutes While the batter is sitting, we make the filling. Step 6: In a sauce pan, bring the coconut milk to a boil. Step 7: Let it do its thing until it smells very coconutty, about 3 minutes. Step 8: Add the curry paste and stir constantly for 1-2 minutes. Step 9: Add the water, butternut squash, basil, salt, and sugar and bring back to a boil.

Ingredient Names: coconut oil, rice noodles, tamari soy sauce, ginger, curry powder, red peppers, peanuts, gluten, green onions, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, cilantro, mushroom, tamarind paste
Instructions: Step 1: Soak the noodles in hot water for 10 minutes, while heating up a large frying pan or wok. Step 2: Once the pan is hot melt the coconut oil in it, and throw in the gluten and peanuts. Step 3: Season this with 1 / 4 tsp of the curry powder and stirfry while the noodles are softening. Step 4: Mix in the garlic, sliced peppers and chopped green onion and continue to stirfry on medium. Step 5: Drain the noodles and add them to the stirfy makeing sure they get covered evenly in oil The noodles will soak up the oil and when that happens add the soy sauce, add the mushrooms. Step 6: Season with crushed red pepper, ginger, curry, cilantro, b Pepper, caynne, salt and continue to stirfry on low until noodles become slightly caramelized and the dish is evenly coated in it's seasonings.

Dish Name: Vegan Thai Quorn Tenders With Lime And Cilantro
Ingredient Names: rice, quorn tenders, minced ginger, scallion, vegetable broth, red pepper flakes, cabbage, fish sauce, lime juice, lime zest, zucchini, mushrooms, fresh cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Coat medium sauce pan with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Step 2: Add 1 t of the ginger and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently, add rice and stir. Step 3: Add 2 cups veggie broth and bring to boil. Step 4: Cover and simmer low for 20 min for basmati or 40 for brown Flufff with fork and let sit for 5 or more minutes Coat wok or large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Step 5: Add remaining ginger and scallions, stirring often for 2-3 minutes. Step 6: Add remaining broth and red pepper flakes to taste and increase heat to bring to boil. Step 7: Add cabbage and cook 2 minutes.

Dish Name: Vegetable Kebabs With Coriander Coconut Cream Sauce
Ingredient Names: vegetables, tofu, vegetable oil, shallots, garlic, ginger, ground cumin, paprika, coconut cream, lime juice, chili sauce, coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Thread vegetables and tofu onto skewers- keep warm Coconut cream sauce: blend all ingredients, warm slightly and pour over kebabs. Step 2: Serve on rice to soak up sauce.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, fresh coriander, garlic, ginger, vegetable oil, yellow pepper, sugar snap peas, eggs, red chili finely, sugar, fish sauce, oyster sauce, fresh bean sprouts, limes, peanuts, green onions
Instructions: Step 1: If using dried noodles, soak according to pack instructions. Cut the stalks off the coriander and finely chop them (set the leaves aside for later). Tip the chopped stalks into a mortar along with the garlic and ginger, then pound to form an aromatic paste. Step 2: Heat a wok and, when smoking, tip in the oil, then the paste. Cook for a few secs, then stir in the pepper and peas. Cook a few mins more until softened, then pour in the egg and chilli. Stir around the pan until cooked, then add the sugar, fish and oyster sauces. Drain the noodles, then add to the pan. Toss everything together, adding a little water if the noodles seem a bit dry. Just before serving, stir in the beansprouts and lime juice, then place on a serving plate and scatter over the roasted peanuts, spring onions and coriander leaves.

Dish Name: Vegetables With Fusilli And Thai Sauce
Ingredient Names: carrots, butter, red pepper, green pepper, broccoli, snow peas, cremini mushroom, cream, cornstarch, hot chili sauce, fresh ginger, fresh coriander, green onions, garlic clove, salt
Instructions: Step 1: Saute carrots in butter for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add remaining vegetables and saute a further 2 minutes. Step 3: In a small bowl mix together cream and cornstarch. Step 4: Stir until smooth and set aside add remaining sauce ingredients to vegetables, except fusilli. Step 5: Cook, vegetables and sauce ingredients for 2 minutes Gradually stir in cream mixture. Step 6: Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Step 7: Turn down heat and simmer for 1 minute. Step 8: Pour vegetable mixture over fusilli and serve immediately.

Dish Name: Vegetarian Fish Sauce For Asian Cooking
Ingredient Names: water, soy sauce, dried kelp, sun-dried tomato
Instructions: Step 1: Put all the ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Step 2: Let it cool, strain into a sterilized container, and store in the fridge or freezer Use anytime fish sauce is called for in a recipe.

Ingredient Names: tempeh, sesame oil, soy sauce, lime, green onion, red onion, rice powder, chili pepper, mint leaves, lettuce, cucumber
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the sesame oil Saut the crumbled tempeh, turn off heat. Step 2: Add soy sauce, lime, chilies, onion, rice powder and mint Play with the proportions I like mine more lime-y and hot than this but i start out this way. Step 3: Serve on a bed of lettuce and cucumber or eat like lettuce wraps or in napa cabbage leaves.

Ingredient Names: rice noodles, peanut oil, garlic, red bell pepper, tomatoes, snow peas, firm tofu, reduced sodium soy sauce, fresh lime juice, fresh cilantro, cashews, scallions, fresh bean sprouts
Instructions: Step 1: In large pot, bring 3 quarts water to a boil. Step 2: Add noodles, stir to prevent sticking. Step 3: Cook until tender, about 4 minutes. Step 4: Drain well and set aside. Step 5: Meanwhile, in large wok or skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Step 6: Add garlic and bell pepper and stir-fry 3 minutes. Step 7: Stir in tomatoes, snow peas and tofu and stir-fry until vegetables are just tender, about 4 minutes. Step 8: Add soy sauce and lime juice and bring to a simmer. Step 9: Cook, stirring often, 2 to 3 minutes more. Step 10: Stir in cooked noodles and cilantro.

Ingredient Names: canola oil, shallot, fresh ginger, garlic cloves, peanut butter, turmeric, ground cumin, thai red curry paste, water, coconut milk, lime zest, brown sugar, sea salt, extra firm tofu, sweet potato
Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in large pot over medium-high heat. Step 2: Add shallots, ginger, and garlic and let cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Step 3: Stir in peanut butter, turmeric, cumin, and curry paste and let cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Step 4: Whisk in water, coconut milk, lime zest, brown sugar, and salt until combined. Step 5: Add tofu, sweet potato, and kale, and bring to a boil. Step 6: Let simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until sweet potatoes are fork tender. Step 7: Stir in lime juice and adjust seasoning to taste. Step 8: Garnish with cashews and serve over rice or quinoa.

Ingredient Names: coconut milk, vegetable stock, lemongrass, fresh gingerroot, kaffir lime leaves, cauliflower, light soy sauce, sugar, chilies, lemon juice, cilantro
Instructions: Step 1: Heat the coconut milk with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, soy, chilis, sugar and stock. Step 2: Simmer with the lid on the pot ten minutes and strain. Step 3: Put strained soup base into. Step 4: Simmer until cauliflower is al dente. Step 5: Remove from heat and lemon juice. Step 6: Stir once, place in bowls and garnish with cilantro. Step 7: Pour a teaspoon of sesame chili oil on top for more kick I am lucky enough to have a kaffir tree but if you cannot find kaffir leaves use lemon leaves or lime zest as a last resort Cauliflower is used in the book and works wonderfully with this soup but i like to mix it up and use mushrooms, tofu, tomatoes, water chestnuts, bell peppers, and even vermicelli noodles.

Ingredient Names: firm tofu, soy sauce, limes, red chilies, vegetable oil, reduced-fat coconut milk, zucchini chunks, eggplant chunks, red pepper chunks, mushrooms, sugar snap peas, basil leaves picked, brown sugar, jasmine rice, lemongrass, shallots, red peppers, from coriander, thumb-size ginger, garlic, ground pepper, ground coriander
Instructions: Step 1: Whizz the paste ingredients in a food processor. Marinate the tofu in 2 tbsp soy sauce, juice 1 lime and the chopped chilli. Step 2: Heat half the oil in a large pan. Add 3-4 tbsp paste and fry for 2 mins. Stir in the coconut milk with 100ml water, the courgette, aubergine and pepper and cook for 10 mins until almost tender. Step 3: Drain the tofu, pat dry, then fry in the remaining oil in a small pan until golden. Step 4: Add the mushrooms, sugar snaps and most of the basil to the curry, then season with the sugar, remaining lime juice and soy sauce. Cook for 4 mins until the mushrooms are tender, then add the tofu and heat through. Scatter with sliced chilli and basil and serve with jasmine rice.

Ingredient Names: eggplant, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow onion, garlic cloves, serrano chili, cooking oil, fish sauce, ground ginger, ground coriander, ground turmeric, salt and pepper, coconut milk, hot water
Instructions: Step 1: Cut vegetables as directed into bite-sized pieces. Step 2: Heat oil over med-high high in wok or large saute pan. Step 3: Saute vegetables until onions turn translucent and eggplant begins to soften, season as desired. Step 4: Add fish sauce and cook while stirring for 1 or 2 minutes. Step 5: Add spices and stir well. Step 6: Add coconut milk and stir until all ingredients are well distributed. Step 7: Cook until sauce bubbles. Step 8: Reduce head to low and simmer for 10 to 20 minutes. Step 9: Taste and adjust seasoning as desired.

Ingredient Names: cucumbers, low-fat yogurt, scallion, of fresh mint, fresh dill, fresh oregano, fresh tarragon, fresh thyme, garlic cloves, raisins, walnuts, salt and pepper, dried rose petals, pita bread
Instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients except the last three. Step 2: Mix thoroughly with 1 cup water. Step 3: Refrigerate several hours or overnight Just before serving stir in rose petals and add a few ice cubes. Step 4: Garnish with additional mint and pita bread croutons.
